translation.en: That thy trust may be in the  Lord  , I have made known to thee this day , even to thee .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ba phin buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha U  Trai  ; kata ka long balei ba nga ïai ïathuh ïa ki ha phi mynta .

translation.en: For the body is not one member , but many .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka met hi ym shym la pynlong tang da kawei ka dkhot met , hynrei da shibun ki dkhot .

translation.en: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification .
translation.kha: Pynban , ma ngi baroh , ngi dei ban pynsngewbha ïa ki parabangeit jong ngi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki , khnang ban tei ïa ki ha ka jingngeit .

translation.en: And Ehud escaped while they tarried , and passed beyond the quarries , and escaped unto Seirath .
translation.kha: U Ehud u la ïohphet katba ki dang ïa-ap . U la leit narud ki maw ba la ohdur bad u leit poi sha Seirah .

translation.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him , seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u long uba lah , mynta bad borabor , ban pynim ïa kita kiba wan sha U Blei da u , namar u im junom ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees , saying unto him , Get thee out , and depart hence : for Herod will kill thee .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la ong ha u ,  Me dei ban phet noh nangne bad leit shawei pat , namar u Herod u kwah ban pynïap ïa me .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  , Doest thou well to be angry ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Me don hok aïu ban bitar ?

translation.en: And Israel journeyed , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la nang ïaid noh , bad u la sher dara ha kawei pat ka liang jong u mot Eder .

translation.en: Behold , I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions , and over all the power of the enemy : and nothing shall by any means hurt you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ! Nga la ai ha phi ka bor , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaid halor ki bseiñ bad ki  ñianglartham bad jop ïa ka bor baroh jong u Nongshun , bad ym don kano kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land  ; but they could not : for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous against them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki maji pat , ki la pyrshang ban ïaleh ban pynpoi ïa ka lieng sharud duriaw , da kaba king katba don ka bor jong ki . Hynrei ka  erïong ka la nang jur , bad kim poi shuh shano shano ruh .

translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , Wherefore come these things upon me ? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered , and thy heels made bare .
translation.kha: Lada pha kylli balei kane baroh ka la jia ha pha — balei ba ki jaiñ jong pha ki la kad noh bad pha la shah batbor — ka dei namar ba ka pop jong pha ka long kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee , and shall hang thee on a tree  ; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee .
translation.kha: Hapoh lai sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi — un phah khrai khlieh ïa phi ! Nangta un sa sdien ïa ka met jong phi ha u dieng , bad ki sim kin bam ïa ka doh jong phi .

translation.en: Paul , called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God , and Sosthenes our brother ,
translation.kha: Na u Paul , ïa uba la khot ban long u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , bad na u Sosthenes u parabangeit jong ngi —

translation.en: But when David saw that his servants whispered , David perceived that the child was dead : therefore David said unto his servants , Is the child dead ? And they said , He is dead .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la ïohi ba ki ïakren pasiaw para ma ki , u la sngewthuh ba u khunlung u la ïap . Kumta u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato u khunlung u la ïap ?   Ho-oid , u la ïap ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Now when I passed by thee , and looked upon thee , behold , thy time was the time of love  ; and I spread my skirt over thee , and covered thy nakedness : yea , I sware unto thee , and entered into a covenant with thee , saith the Lord  God  , and thou becamest mine .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang ïaid lyngba biang , nga la ïohi ba ka por ka la poi ïa pha ban shoh jingieit . Nga la tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit jong pha da ka jaiñ jynsur jong nga bad nga la kular ban ieit ïa pha . Ho-oid nga la pynlong ka jutang shongkurim bad pha , bad pha long ka jong nga .  Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .

translation.en: But there was a certain man , called Simon , which beforetime in the same city used sorcery , and bewitched the people of Samaria , giving out that himself was some great one :
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Simon u shong u sah hangta , uba shipor u la pynlyngngoh ïa ki nong Samaria da ka jingleh myntor jong u .

translation.en: And they were all amazed , and spake among themselves , saying , What a word is this ! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits , and they come out .
translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewphylla bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ki jait ktien aïu kine ? Da ka iktiar bad ka bor une u briew u ai ki hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki ïamihnoh !

translation.en: As it is written , For thy sake we are killed all the day long ; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Na ka bynta jong phi ngi la long ha ka jingma jong ka jingïap ha ki por baroh ; la leh ïa ngi kum ïa ki langbrot ba la ïalam sha ka jingpynïap .

translation.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean  ; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba u briew u bymkhuid u ktah ka long ka bymkhuid , bad uno uno uwei pat uba ktah ïa kata u long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up , but rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God :
translation.kha: Hynrei phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad phim treh ban leit rung sha kata ka ri .

translation.en: And he took the blind man by the hand , and led him out of the town  ; and when he had spit on his eyes , and put his hands upon him , he asked him if he saw ought .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew uba matlah na ka kti bad ïalam ïa u shabar ka nongrit . Hadien ba u la bynthiew ha ki khmat jong uta u briew , U Jisu u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u bad kylli ïa u ,  Me lah ban ïohi ei ei ?

translation.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy , whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kata ka hukum na ka bynta uta u briew uba ïoh ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh hynrei u bym kotbor ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kumba ju long ka rukom ïa kiba yn pyndonkam ha ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Fear not : for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee  ; and thou shalt be king over Israel , and I shall be next unto thee  ; and that also Saul my father knoweth .
translation.kha: da kaba ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng . I pa jong nga in ym lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi . I tip bha ba phi dei uta u ban sa long u syiem jong ki Israel bad ba ma nga , nga dei uba ar ha ka kyrdan .

translation.en: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest , the scribe , even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the  Lord  , and of his statutes to Israel .
translation.kha: U Artakserksis u ai ïa kane ka jingthoh ha u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad , uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel :

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop .

translation.en: And , behold , I come quickly  ; and my reward is with me , to give every man according as his work shall be .
translation.kha: Shahshkor !  ong U Jisu .  Nga wan kloi ! Ngan wallam ïa ki bainong jong nga , ban ai ha uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: It may be that the  Lord  will look on mine affliction , and that the  Lord  will requite me good for his cursing this day .
translation.kha: Lehse U  Trai  un ïohi ïa ka jinglanot jong nga bad un ai ha nga katto katne ki jingkyrkhu ban shim bujli ïa ka jingtim jong u .

translation.en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom , and which is in the valley of the giants on the north , and descended to the valley of Hinnom , to the side of Jebusi on the south , and descended to En–rogel ,
translation.kha: Nangta u hiar arsut shaduh trai jong u lum na uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Hinnom , ha ka tduh kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Them Rephaim . Nangta u suh arsut lyngba ka Them Hinnom , shathie na ka sharing lum jong ka Jebus , sha ka Enrogel .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto Aaron thy brother , that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil before the mercy seat , which is upon the ark  ; that he die not : for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ïathuh ha u hynmen jong me u Aaron ba dei tang ha ka por kaba dei ba un leit shadien ka jingkah jong ka jaka kaba khuid tam , namar ba dei hangta ba nga mihpaw ha u lyoh halor ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang . Lada um kohnguh , un shah pynïap .

translation.en: And Joab said unto the king , Now the  Lord  thy God add unto the people , how many soever they be , an hundredfold , and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it : but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joab u jubab ïa u syiem ,  Syiem Kynrad , to U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynroi ïa ki Israel shispah shah ban ïa kaba ki don mynta , bad to phin dang im ban ïohi ïa u ba u leh ïa kata . Hynrei balei keiñ u Syiem Kynrad u kwah ban leh ïa kane ?

translation.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you , saith the  Lord  , thoughts of peace , and not of evil , to give you an expected end .
translation.kha: Tang ma nga hi nga tip ïa ki jingthmu kiba nga don na ka bynta jong phi , ki jingthmu ban wallam ha phi ka jingmanbha bad ym ka jingpynjot , ki jingthmu ban wallam ïa ka lawei kaba phi ap kyrmen .

translation.en: For the day is near , even the day of the  Lord  is near , a cloudy day  ; it shall be the time of the heathen .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan , ka sngi haba U  Trai  un leh , ka sngi jong ki lyoh bad jingjynjar ïa ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Therefore fear thou not , O my servant Jacob , saith the  Lord   ; neither be dismayed , O Israel : for , lo , I will save thee from afar , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and shall be in rest , and be quiet , and none shall make him afraid .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , wat ym sheptieng ; ko ki paid Israel , wat ym sngewshyrkhei . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri bajngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat sha ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin shngain , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa phi .

translation.en: Who shall not fear thee , O Lord , and glorify thy name ? for thou only art holy : for all nations shall come and worship before thee  ; for thy judgments are made manifest .
translation.kha: Uei u ban ym ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa me , A Trai ? Uei u ban kyntait ban pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me ? Tang ma me hi uba khuid . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin wan bad mane ïa me , namar ïa ki jingleh bahok jong me la ïohi da baroh .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray you , tarry ye also here this night , that I may know what the  Lord  will say unto me more .
translation.kha: Hynrei sngewbha to ïasah miet mynta ruh , ba nga lah ban ïoh tip aïu pat U  Trai  un ong ha nga .

translation.en: You will find such friends among Jehovah’s Witnesses .
translation.kha: Phin shem ïa kum kita ki paralok hapdeng ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .

translation.en: And then the  Lord s  wrath be kindled against you , and he shut up the heaven , that there be no rain , and that the land yield not her fruit  ; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the  Lord  giveth you .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , U  Trai  un khie bitar ïa phi . Un khang khop ïa u slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong eh ba ki jingthung kin ym mih shuh . Te phin sa ïap shen hangta , wat la kata ka khyndew kaba u ai ha phi ka long kaba seisoh .

translation.en: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job  ; and that man was perfect and upright , and one that feared God , and eschewed evil .
translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Job , uba shong ba sah ha ka ri Us , uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba ïaineh ha u . U long u briew uba bha , uba kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will help me  ; who is he that shall condemn me ? lo , they all shall wax old as a garment  ; the moth shall eat them up .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar da lade un kyrshan ïa nga — uno te , uba lah ban pynshisha ba nga long uba la shah pynrem ? Baroh ki nongmudui jong nga kin jah noh ; kin jah kum ka jaiñ ba la bam khñiang .

translation.en: Yet now hear , O Jacob my servant  ; and Israel , whom I have chosen :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor mynta , ko Israel , u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .

translation.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple , Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang shong halor u lum ki Olib , pyrshah ïa ka Templ , mynba u Petros , u Jakob , u Ïoannis bad u Andriw ki la wan jar jar ha u .

translation.en: Their heart is divided  ; now shall they be found faulty : he shall break down their altars , he shall spoil their images .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki long kiba shukor , mynta ki dei ban shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki . U Blei un pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki .

translation.en: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren , our children as their children : and , lo , we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants , and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already : neither is it in our power to redeem them  ; for other men have our lands and vineyards .
translation.kha: Ngi long na kajuh ka jaitbynriew kum ki para Jiw jong ngi . Hato ki khun ki kti jong ngi kim long kumjuh kum ki jong ki ? Hynrei ngi la hap ban pynlong mraw ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi . Ïa ki katto katne ki khun kynthei jong ngi , la lah die ïa ki kum ki mraw . Ngim donbor ei ei namar ïa ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ la shim noh na ngi .

translation.en: But the  Lord  was wroth with me for your sakes , and would not hear me : and the  Lord  said unto me , Let it suffice thee  ; speak no more unto me of this matter .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la bitar ïa nga namar jong phi bad um shahshkor shuh ïa nga . U ong pynban , ‘ Ka la biang katta ! Wat kren ei ei shuh shaphang kata !

translation.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power : he riseth up , and no man is sure of life .
translation.kha: U Blei , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u pynjot ïa kiba khrawbor ; U Blei u trei — bad u briew uba sniew u ïap .

translation.en: ( For as yet he was fallen upon none of them : only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus . )
translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid um pat shym la wan hiar hano hano ruh na ki ; la pynbaptis ïa ki tang ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: But there was none like unto Ahab , which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , whom Jezebel his wife stirred up .
translation.kha: ( Ym shym la don mano mano uba aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa ka bymdei ha khmat U  Trai  kum u Ahab — baroh da ka jingpynbor ka tnga jong u ka Jesebel .

translation.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things , though ye know them , and be established in the present truth .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïai pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang kine kiei kiei , wat la phi la tip lypa bad phi ïeng skhem ha ka jingshisha kaba phi la ïohpdiang .

translation.en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , and he would not let them go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad um shym la shah ïa ki ban leit .

translation.en: The  Lord  is good , a strong hold in the day of trouble  ; and he knoweth them that trust in him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba bha ; u ïada ïa ki briew jong u ha ki por ka jingjynjar ; u ri sumar ïa kito kiba phai sha u .

translation.en: Then he said , God do so and more also to me , if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day .
translation.kha: U kyang ,  Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada u Elisha um shah khrai khlieh shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut !

translation.en: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge : but a fool layeth open his folly .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sian , borabor ki pyrkhat ha shuwa ban leh ïa kano kano , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki thad ïa la ka jingbieit .

translation.en: Who can open the doors of his face ? his teeth are terrible round about .
translation.kha: Uei uba lah ban pynlong ïa u ban plie ïa ki tyngam jong u , kiba la ker da kito ki bniat kiba itriem ?

translation.en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him , and turned to the Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha Lydda bad Sharon ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ki la phai sha U Trai .

translation.en: Who in the days of his flesh , when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death , and was heard in that he feared  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim jong u ha kane ka pyrthei , U Jisu u la duwai bad khot kyrpad da kaba pyrta jam bad ïam ha khmat U Blei , uba lah ban pyllait ïa u na ka jingïap . Namar ba u long uba sngewrit bad aiti lut , U Blei u la shahshkor ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the seventh year , in the fifth month , the tenth day of the month , that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the  Lord  , and sat before me .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba san jong ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi . Katto katne ngut na ki nongïalam jong ka kynhun ki Israel , ki la ïawan ban kylli ïa nga shaphang ka mon jong U  Trai  , bad ki la shong ha khmat jong nga .

translation.en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people , there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree , and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei ka ban jia ha baroh ki jaitbynriew kylleng ka pyrthei . Kan long kum ka jingkut jong ka jingot , haba ïa ki soh Olib la dep tied pynhap na uwei pa uwei u dieng bad ba ïa ki sohwaiñ bakhatduh la kheit na ki dieng sohwaiñ .

translation.en: But of the times and the seasons , brethren , ye have no need that I write unto you .
translation.kha: Ym donkam ban thoh ha phi , ko parabangeit , shaphang ki por bad ki khep haba kine kiei kiei kin jia .

translation.en: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body , and the visions of my head troubled me .
translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw ki la pynsheptieng ïa nga , bad la pynwit shikatdei eh ïa nga .

translation.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came , which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban poi ki snem ka  nemsniew , u Joseph u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang na ka Asenath .

translation.en: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days  ; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba sanphew , ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton kaba hynñiew , wan ai shuh ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  da u kew thymmai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Let your hands be strong , ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets , which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the  Lord  of hosts was laid , that the temple might be built .
translation.kha: To long shlur ! Mynta phi ïohsngew ïa kijuh ki kyntien ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka por ba la buh nongrim na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong nga .

translation.en: And Arphaxad begat Salah  ; and Salah begat Eber .
translation.kha: U Arpakhshad u dei u kpa jong u Shelah , uba dei u kpa jong u Eber .

translation.en: Harden not your hearts , as in the provocation , in the day of temptation in the wilderness :
translation.kha: wat pyneh ïa la ka dohnud , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la long haba ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , kumba ki la long ha kata ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap haba ki la tynjuh ïa U .

translation.en: And they offered unto the  Lord  the same time , of the spoil which they had brought , seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  na ka jinglute kaba ki la wanrah biang : hynñiewspah tylli ki khlieh jong ki masi bad hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot .

translation.en: For , lo , the winter is past , the rain is over and gone  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ngin thaw ïa phi u kynjri da ka ksiar bad ki jingpynitynnat da ka rupa .

translation.en: Keeping mercy for thousands , forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin , and that will by no means clear the guilty  ; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children , and upon the children s children , unto the third and to the fourth generation .
translation.kha: Nga bat ïa la ka kular na ka bynta ki bun hajar ki pateng bynriew bad nga map ïa ka jingbymman , bad ïa ka pop ; hynrei , ngan pynshitom ïa ki khun ki ksiew haduh ka pateng bynriew kaba lai bad kaba saw namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .

translation.en: And houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not , and wells digged , which thou diggedst not , vineyards and olive trees , which thou plantedst not  ; when thou shalt have eaten and be full  ;
translation.kha: Ki ïing kin dap da ki mar kiba bha kiba phim shym la leit buh hangta , bad kin don ki pukri kiba phim shym la tih , bad ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Olib kiba phim shym la thung . Ynda U  Trai  u ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri bad phi ïoh kat ïa kaba phi kwah ban bam ,

translation.en: After this I saw in the night visions , and behold a fourth beast , dreadful and terrible , and strong exceedingly  ; and it had great iron teeth : it devoured and brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with the feet of it : and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it  ; and it had ten horns .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang ap khmih , u mradkhlaw uba saw u la mihpaw . U la long uba khrawbor , uba ingiew bad uba ishyrkhei . Da ki bniat nar bakhraw jong u , u khñiot pynlwet ïa ki ba u la ïoh , bad nangta u la kyrdem halor jong ki . Ym kum kita kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw , u la don shiphew tylli ki reng .

translation.en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the  Lord  , to repair and amend the house :
translation.kha: Nangta ïa kane ka pisa la pynkhamti ha ki lai ngut ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka jingtei pynbha ïa ka Templ ,

translation.en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate , ten cubits  ; and the length of the gate , thirteen cubits .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la thew sa ïa ka pyngkiang jong ka lynti ïaid kaba ha ka khyrdop . Ka la long baroh hynriew mitar shiteng bad ka jaka ba lait hapdeng ki khyrdop kiba rynghang ka la long san mitar .

translation.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed .
translation.kha: Une u paidbah um tip ïa ka Hukum u Moses , te ki long hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei !

translation.en: Woe unto them that join house to house , that lay field to field , till there be no place , that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth !
translation.kha: Phi long kiba la tim . Phi thied bun tylli ki ïing bad ki lyngkha ban bynrap shuh shuh ïa kito kiba phi la don lypa . Shen yn ym don jaka ïano ïano pat ban shong ban sah bad tang ma phi hi phin shong ha ka ri .

translation.en: And God appeared unto Jacob again , when he came out of Paddan–aram , and blessed him .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u la wan phai na Mesopotamia , U Blei u la mihpaw biang ha u , bad u la kyrkhu ïa u .

translation.en: For we walk by faith , not by sight .
translation.kha: Naba ngi iaid da ka jingngeit , ym da ka jingïohi .

translation.en: And he took unto him all these , and divided them in the midst , and laid each piece one against another : but the birds divided he not .
translation.kha: U Abram u la wallam ïa kine ki mrad sha U Blei , u ot ïa ki ar lyngkhot , bad u buh ïa ki lyngkhot doh marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat ha ki ar laiñ ; hynrei ïa ki sim um shym la ot lyngkhot .

translation.en: And they made a calf in those days , and offered sacrifice unto the idol , and rejoiced in the works of their own hands .
translation.kha: Ka la long hangta ba ki la thaw ïa ka bleithaw ha ka dur jong u masi , ki la ai jingkñia ha ka , bad ki la ïakhawai ha kaba ai burom ïa kaei kaba ma ki hi ki la lah thaw .

translation.en: they came
translation.kha: Ki La Wan

translation.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan , and his father was a man of Tyre , skilful to work in gold , and in silver , in brass , in iron , in stone , and in timber , in purple , in blue , and in fine linen , and in crimson  ; also to grave any manner of graving , and to find out every device which shall be put to him , with thy cunning men , and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka dkhot na ka jait Dan , bad u kpa jong u , u dei u traishnong jong ka Tyros . U tip kumno ban thaw ïa kiei kiei na ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , u maw bad ka dieng . U lah ruh ban trei bad ki jaiñ kiba jngum , sawbthuh , bad kiba rong saw , bad ka linen . U lah ban trei ïa bun jait ki jingohdur bad u lah ban bud ïa kano kano ka jingsaiñ dur kumba la ai jingmut ïa u . Shah ïa u ban trei bad ki nongtrei jong phi kiba tbit bad kito kiba la trei na ka bynta u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong phi .

translation.en: And as Jesus passed forth from thence , he saw a man , named Matthew , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he saith unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose , and followed him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , uba kyrteng u Matthaïos , uba shong ha ka jaka treikam jong u . U la ong ha u ,  To bud ïa nga .  U Matthaïos u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .

translation.en: For Jesus himself testified , that a prophet hath no honour in his own country .
translation.kha: Naba ma u hi u la ong ,  Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju ñiewkor ha la ka jong ka ri .

translation.en: Six days ye shall gather it  ; but on the seventh day , which is the sabbath , in it there shall be none .
translation.kha: Hynriew sngi phin ïalum jingbam , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka sngi shongthait , yn ym don ei ei .

translation.en: They are new every morning : great is thy faithfulness .
translation.kha: Ka pyngngad kum ka step , ka thikna kum ka jingmih ka sngi .

translation.en: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine , which shall be for their destruction , and which I will send to destroy you : and I will increase the famine upon you , and will break your staff of bread :
translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingwanrah bam ïa pha bad ngan pynshahthngan ïa pha . Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingtynrah ka jingthngan kum ki khnam banep ba la siat ban pynjot ïa pha .

translation.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies , and of all the truth , which thou hast shewed unto thy servant  ; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan  ; and now I am become two bands .
translation.kha: Ngam long uba bit dor ban ïohpdiang ïa baroh ka jinglehisynei bad ka jingieit baïaineh ba me la pynpaw ha nga , u shakri jong me . Nga la jam ïa ka wah Jordan tang bad u diengduh jong nga , bad mynta pat nga la wan phai bad kine ar ki kynhun .

translation.en: And yet indeed she is my sister  ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother  ; and she became my wife .
translation.kha: Ma ka , ka long shisha ka para jong nga . Ka dei ka khun jong u kpa jong nga , hynrei ym ka khun jong ka kmie jong nga ; bad nga la shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: Let us not therefore judge one another any more : but judge this rather , that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother s way .
translation.kha: Te kumta , to ngin sangeh noh na kaba ïabishar uwei ïa uwei pat . Hynrei phi dei ban kut jingmut ban ym leh ïa kaei kaei lano lano ruh ka ban pynlong ïa u parabangeit jong phi ban jynthut lane hap ha ka pop .

translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ïa ki balang !

translation.en: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste , and said thus unto him , I have found a man of the captives of Judah , that will make known unto the king the interpretation .
translation.kha: Kumta hi u Ariokh u la ïalam ïa u Daniel sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad u la ïathuh ha u syiem ,  Nga la shem uwei na ki Jiw kiba la shah ringmraw , uba lah ban ïathuh ha u Syiem Kynrad ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jong phi .

translation.en: These are the statutes and judgments , which ye shall observe to do in the land , which the  Lord  God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it , all the days that ye live upon the earth .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ba phi dei ban kohnguh katba phi dang shong ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u ai ha phi .

translation.en: And Leah said , Happy am I , for the daughters will call me blessed : and she called his name Asher .
translation.kha: bad ka Leah ka ong ,  Katno nga long kaba kmen ! Mynta ki kynthei kin khot ïa nga kaba kmen  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Asher .

translation.en: As we have therefore opportunity , let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith .
translation.kha: Kumta , katba ngi dang ïohlad bunsien , ngi dei ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei , bad khamtam ïa kito kiba na ka longïing ka jingngeit .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Distress not the Moabites , neither contend with them in battle : for I will not give thee of their land for a possession  ; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat pynjynjar ïa ki briew jong ka ri Moab , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot , lane wat ïaleh thma bad ki . Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka shnong Ar , bad ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na ka ri jong ki .’

translation.en: Give ye ear , and hear my voice  ; hearken , and hear my speech .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi .

translation.en: Let me not , I pray you , accept any man s person , neither let me give flattering titles unto man .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah liang ha kane ka jingïatainia ; ngan nym pynroh ïano ïano .

translation.en: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew , whose name was Mordecai , the son of Jair , the son of Shimei , the son of Kish , a Benjamite  ;
translation.kha: Hangta ha Susa la don u Jiw uba kyrteng u Mordekai , u khun jong u Jair ; uba na ka jait Benjamin bad u long uba hiarpateng na u Kish bad u Shimei .

translation.en: But if thine eye be evil , thy whole body shall be full of darkness . If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness , how great is that darkness !
translation.kha: hynrei lada ki khmat jong phi kim long kiba bha , ka met jong phi kan don ha ka jingdum . Kumta lada ka jingshai hapoh jong phi ka long ka jingdum , katno kan long ka jingdum kaba shyrkhei eh !

translation.en: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin , which is not betrothed , and lay hold on her , and lie with her , and they be found  ;
translation.kha: Lada lap ïa u briew ba u batbor ïa ka briew ka bym pat shym ïatehktien badno badno ,

translation.en: Fathers , provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged .
translation.kha: Ko ki kmie ki kpa , to wat pynbitar ïa la ki khun , ïoh ba kin noh mynsiem .

translation.en: The earth shall quake before them  ; the heavens shall tremble : the sun and the moon shall be dark , and the stars shall withdraw their shining :
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei ka khih katba ki nang tur ; ka sahit bneng ka khynñiuh . Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim shai shuh .

translation.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth  ; It is expedient for you that I go away : for if I go not away , the Comforter will not come unto you  ; but if I depart , I will send him unto you .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ka kham bha ïa phi ba nga leit noh , namar lada ngam leit noh , U Nongïarap un ym wan sha phi . Hynrei lada nga leit noh , te ngan phah ïa u sha phi .

translation.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall , and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken .
translation.kha: ki khlur kin hap na bneng , bad ïa ki bor ha ka haw haw yn pynkynriah noh na ki lynti ïaid jong ki .

translation.en: Hast thou faith ? have it to thyself before God . Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth .
translation.kha: To bat ïa kaei kaba phi ngeit shaphang kane ka kam , hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei . Suk uta u briew u bym sngew ïa ka jingpynrem haba u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u bishar ba ka long kaba dei !

translation.en: And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him : for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave , because in him there is found some good thing toward the  Lord  God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel kin ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad kin tep ïa u . Un dei tang ma u na ka longïing u Jeroboam ïa uba yn ïoh tep donburom , namar u long tang ma u hi ïa uba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u sngewbha .

translation.en: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes ? For our sakes , no doubt , this is written : that he that ploweth should plow in hope ; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope .
translation.kha: Hato da shisha um mut ïa ngi haba u la ong ïa kata ? Da shisha ïa kata la thoh na ka bynta jong ngi . U briew uba lur bad u briew uba ot ki dei ban trei ïa la ki kam da kaba kyrmen ban ïoh bynta na u jingthung .

translation.en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain : for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley :
translation.kha: Ki Amor ki beh da ka bor ïa ki briew na ka jait Dan sha ka ri lum bad kim shah ïa ki ban wan hiar sha ri thor .

translation.en: And they went up , and pitched in Kirjath–jearim , in Judah : wherefore they called that place Mahaneh–dan unto this day : behold , it is behind Kirjath–jearim .
translation.kha: Ki leit kiew bad sher dara ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Kiriath Jearim kaba ha Judah . Dei namar kata balei ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Jaka Sher Dara ki Dan .

translation.en: As he hath done this day , so the  Lord  hath commanded to do , to make an atonement for you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ngi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba ngi la leh mynta ka sngi , khnang ban map ïa ka pop jong phi .

translation.en: Or ministry , let us wait on our ministering : or he that teacheth , on teaching ;
translation.kha: lada ka long ban shakri , ngi dei ban shakri ; lada ka long ban hikai , ngi dei ban hikai ;

translation.en: Then the woman came and told her husband , saying , A man of God came unto me , and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God , very terrible : but I asked him not whence he was , neither told he me his name :
translation.kha: Te kata ka briew ka leit ïathuh ha la u tnga ,  U briew jong U Blei u la wan ha nga , bad ka durkhmat jong u ka iphieng kum u angel U Blei . Ngam shym kylli ba u wan na-ei , bad u ruh um shym ïathuh ïa la ka kyrteng .

translation.en: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and make an atonement for himself , and for his house .
translation.kha: Un kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia ban map ïa ki pop jong u bad jong ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains , and they robbed all that came along that way by them : and it was told Abimelech .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh briew ban apthap ïa u Abimelekh ha ki kliar lum , bad ki la lute ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti nangta . La ïathuh ïa kane ha u Abimelekh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  took me as I followed the flock , and the  Lord  said unto me , Go , prophesy unto my people Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la shim ïa nga na ka kam kum u nongaplangbrot bad u la hukum ïa nga ban wan bad ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .

translation.en: Yet thus saith the Lord  God   ; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Hadien sawphew snem ngan wallam pat ïa ki nong Ijipt na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ,

translation.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife ; and some also of good will :
translation.kha: Da shisha katto katne ngut na ki , ki ïalap ïa U Khrist namar ka jingpihuiñ bad ka jingïakajia , hynrei kiwei pat na ka mon kaba khuid .

translation.en: And the soldiers  counsel was to kill the prisoners , lest any of them should swim out , and escape .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki koidi baroh , khnang ban da ïa ki na kaba jngi sha rud duriaw bad ban lait phet .

translation.en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth : there was Abraham buried , and Sarah his wife .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka lyngkha kaba u Abraham u la thied na ki Hit , dei hangta ba la tep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka tnga jong u ka Sarah .

translation.en: And the angel answering said unto him , I am Gabriel , that stand in the presence of God  ; and am sent to speak unto thee , and to shew thee these glad tidings .
translation.kha: Nga long u Gabriel ,  u angel u la jubab .  Nga ïeng ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban kren ha me bad ïathuh ha me ïa kane ka khubor babha .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them , that they heard that they were their neighbours , and that they dwelt among them .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien kata ka jingïateh lok , ki Israel ki sa tip ba kine ki briew ki dei shisha kiba shong basah hajan .

translation.en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature , if it fulfil the law , judge thee , who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law ?
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma phi ki Jiw phin shah pynrem ha ki Jentil namar phi pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum , wat la na ka bynta jong phi ïa ka Hukum la thoh bad ïa phi la otsher ; hynrei ki kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , wat la ym shym la otsher ïa ki ha ka doh .

translation.en: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth–el and the towns thereof , and eastward Naaran , and westward Gezer , with the towns thereof  ; Shechem also and the towns thereof , unto Gaza and the towns thereof :
translation.kha: Ka ri ha kaba ki shim bad shongduh ka kynthup ïa ka Bethel bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka naduh shaphang mihngi ka Naaran bad haduh shaphang sepngi ka Geser bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka . Ka kynthup ruh ïa ki nongbah ka Shekhem bad ka Ayyah bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: And he shall not look to the altars , the work of his hands , neither shall respect that which his fingers have made , either the groves , or the images .
translation.kha: Kin ym shaniah shuh ha ki duwan kiba ki la thaw da ki kti jong ki , lane shaniah ha ki kam ki kti jong ki hi — ki dak jong ka bleithaw Asherah bad ki duwan ban thang jingiwbih .

translation.en: That , according as it is written , He that glorieth , let him glory in the Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban sngewsarong , u dei ban sngewsarong ha kaei kaba U Trai u la leh .

translation.en: And ye shall eat old store , and bring forth the old because of the new .
translation.kha: Ki jingmih ba phi lum kin long kiba bun , bad kin biang na ka bynta shisnem ; wat la katta ruh , phin hap bret noh ïa kaba dang sah na ka jinglum kaba rim ban pyllait jaka ïa ka jinglum kaba thymmai .

translation.en: The sons of Japheth  ; Gomer , and Magog , and Madai , and Javan , and Tubal , and Meshech , and Tiras .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Japheth — u Gomer , u Magog , u Madai , u Jaban , u Tubal , u Meshek , bad u Tiras — ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .

translation.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still : and they went down both into the water , both Philip and the eunuch  ; and he baptized him .
translation.kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la hukum ban pynsangeh ïa ka kali kulai , bad baroh ar ngut , u Philip bad uta u rangbah synshar ki la ïaleit hiar sha ka um , bad u Philip u la pynbaptis ïa u .

translation.en: A man s pride shall bring him low : but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng kan wanrah ïa ka jinghap jong phi , hynrei lada phi long kiba sngewrit , yn burom ïa phi .

translation.en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died : his eye was not dim , nor his natural force abated .
translation.kha: U Moses u la dap shispah arphew snem ka rta mynba u ïap ; ki khmat jong u kim pat byr-ïe , bad ka bor met jong u ruh kam pat duna .

translation.en: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them , they gathered all that were able to put on armour , and upward , and stood in the border .
translation.kha: Haba ki Moab ki ïohsngew ba ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , ki la khot ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba lah ban kieng atiar , naduh kiba tymmen haduh kiba dang khynnah , bad la buh ïa ki ha ki khappud .

translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem , building the rebellious and the bad city , and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations .
translation.kha: Ngi kwah ba u syiem un tip ba ki Jiw kiba la wan hangne na kiwei ki ri , ki la shong la sah ha Jerusalem bad ki dang tei pat ïa kato ka nongbah kaba sniew bad kaba ïaleh pyrshah . Ki la sdang ban tei pat ïa ki kynroh bad shen kin sa pyndep ïa ki .

translation.en: And the king went up into the house of the  Lord  , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the people , both small and great : and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad baroh lang ki leit sha ka Templ , ba la synran da ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew , kiba riewspah bad baduk kumjuh . Ha khmat jong ki baroh , u syiem u pule jam baroh kawei ïa ka Kitab ka Jutang kaba la shem ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem  ; Shammua , and Shobab , and Nathan , and Solomon ,
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki khun jong u ïa kiba la kha ha Jerusalem : U Shammua , u Shobab , u Nathan , u Solomon ,

translation.en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him , that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient .
translation.kha: Ai ha u khyndiat ka iktiar jong me , khnang ba u paidbah un kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them , that I will not turn away from them , to do them good  ; but I will put my fear in their hearts , that they shall not depart from me .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Ngan ym sangeh lano lano ruh ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki ban tiengburom ïa nga da ka dohnud jong ki baroh , khnang ba kin ym phai dien shuh na nga .

translation.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle s wife , he hath uncovered his uncle s nakedness : they shall bear their sin  ; they shall die childless .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong u kñi jong u , u pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kñi , kumta ma u bad kata ka briew kin kit hi ïa la ka pop ; baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun .

translation.en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years , and begat Enos :
translation.kha: Haba u Seth u la dap shispah san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Enosh ,

translation.en: Incline thine ear , O  Lord  , and hear  ; open thine eyes , O  Lord  , and see : and hear all the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent to reproach the living God .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , to sngap ïa ngi bad to peit ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To shahshkor ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u la ong ban ñiewbeiñ ïa me , U Blei ba-im .

translation.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord , we persuade men ; but we are made manifest unto God ; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U Trai , bad kumta ngi pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa kiwei . U Blei u tip lut shaphang jong ngi , bad nga kyrmen ba ha ki dohnud jong phi , phi tip ïa nga kumjuh .

translation.en: And when he had taken the book , the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb , having every one of them harps , and golden vials full of odours , which are the prayers of saints .
translation.kha: Katba u dang leh kumta , kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang    ki la dem khrup ha khmat U Khunlangbrot . Uwei pa uwei u la don ka duitara bad ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingiwbih , kiba long ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: For it shall be , that , as a wandering bird cast out of the nest , so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon .
translation.kha: Ki ap ha ki rudwah jong ka wah Arnon bad ki ïaid khlem jingmut shane shatai , kum ki sim kiba la shah beh noh na ki skum jong ki .

translation.en: And he said , Behold , I make a covenant : before all thy people I will do marvels , such as have not been done in all the earth , nor in any nation : and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the  Lord  : for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta nga pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel . Ha khmat jong ki ngan leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw , ïa kiba ym pat ju leh mynno mynno ha ka pyrthei hapdeng kano kano ka jaitbynriew . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa ki kam kiba khraw kiba ma nga , U  Trai  nga lah ban leh , namar ngan leh ïa kaei kaei kaba khraw na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
translation.kha: Ka jingaiei ka jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi . Amen .

translation.en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself , that they also might be sanctified through the truth .
translation.kha: Bad na ka bynta jong ki nga pynkyntang ïa lade sha me , khnang ba ma ki ruh , ki lah ban long kiba la ïoh pynkyntang da shisha sha me .

translation.en: When Jesus had spoken these words , he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron , where was a garden , into the which he entered , and his disciples .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa kane ka jingduwai , u la mihnoh bad la ki synran bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid ba la khot ka Kidron . Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la rung shapoh .

translation.en: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret , and he himself seeketh to be known openly . If thou do these things , shew thyself to the world .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba buhrieh ïa kaei kaba u leh lada u kwah ba kiwei kin tip . Naba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei , to ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan tip shaphang jong me !

translation.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels , and have not kept it .
translation.kha: Phi long kita kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka hukum jong U Blei , kata kaba la wan ai da ki angel — pynban phim shym la kohnguh ïa ka !

translation.en: While we look not at the things which are seen , but at the things which are not seen : for the things which are seen are temporal ; but the things which are not seen are eternal .
translation.kha: Naba ngi pynleit jingmut , ym ha kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïohi , hynrei ha kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi . Kata kaba lah ban ïohi ka neh tang shipor , hynrei kata ka bym lah ban ïohi ka neh junom .

translation.en: And he said unto them , What manner of man was he which came up to meet you , and told you these words ?
translation.kha: U long kumno uta u briew ?  u syiem u kylli .

translation.en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God , who liveth for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki saw tylli ki kherub u la ai ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingbitar jong U Blei , uba im junom la junom .

translation.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure : but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki sumar ïa ka spah jong ki , hynrei ki bymman ki duh ei ïa la ka jong haba ki por kiba eh ki wan poi .

translation.en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings .
translation.kha: Ka jaka ka ïar naduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang bashathie hajan ka Edom , shaduh Baalgad ha ka phang bashatei ha ka them jong ka Lebanon shaphang shathie jong u Lum Hermon . U Joshua u la ïaleh thma slem bad ki syiem jong kane ka thain , hynrei u la kurup ïa ki baroh bad u pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: And they lifted up their voice , and wept again : and Orpah kissed her mother in law  ; but Ruth clave unto her .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki sdang ban ïam . Nangta ka Orpah ka doh khublei ïa la ka kiaw kurim bad ka leit phai pat sha ïing , hynrei ka Ruth ka snoh rdin ha ka .

translation.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness , as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka dang poi bnai , namar ka long ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .
translation.kha: Lada ïa phi ym shym la pynshitom , kumba shah ki khun jong u baroh , ka mut ba phim dei ki khun bashisha jong u , hynrei ki khun khlem kpa .

translation.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts , and bring the description hither to me , that I may cast lots for you here before the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: To thoh ka jingbatai shaphang kine ki hynñiew bynta bad wallam ïa ka sha nga . Nangta ngan kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you , every man child in your generations , he that is born in the house , or bought with money of any stranger , which is not of thy seed .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta me dei ban otsher ïa u khunlung baroh haba u la dap phra sngi , kynthup ruh ïa ki mraw kiba la kha ha ki longïing longsem jong me bad ïa ki mraw kiba me la thied na ki nongwei . Kane kan pyn-i ba ka don ka jutang hapdeng jong nga bad me .

translation.en: For thou , O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , hast revealed to thy servant , saying , I will build thee an house : therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee .
translation.kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , U Blei ki Israel ! nga sngew shlur ban duwai kane ka jingduwai ha me , namar me la pynpaw ïa kane baroh ha nga , u shakri jong me , bad ba me la ong ha nga ba men pynlong syiem ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me : they walked not in my statutes , neither kept my judgments to do them , which if a man do , he shall even live in them  ; they polluted my sabbaths : then I said , I would pour out my fury upon them , to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Hynrei kata ka pateng bynriew ruh ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kim shym la bat ïa ki hukum jong nga , kiba wallam jingim ha uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki . Ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton . Nga la kloi ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha ka ri shyiap bad ban pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And when he came , lo , Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching : for his heart trembled for the ark of God . And when the man came into the city , and told it , all the city cried out .
translation.kha: U Eli , uba dang pyrkhat khuslai shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u dang shong harud lynti , u da peit lyngngoh . Uta u rangbah u pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng ka shnong bad uwei pa uwei u lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah , when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah , in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Barukh u thoh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ha u .

translation.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians , and was mighty in words and in deeds .
translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka jingstad baroh jong ki nong Ijipt bad u la long u briew uba khraw ha ki ktien bad ki kam .

translation.en: He went to Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Pilat bad u la pan ïa ka met U Jisu . U Pilat u la hukum ban ai ïa ka met ha u Joseph .

translation.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .
translation.kha: namar kim pat shym la sngewthuh ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka jingbsa ïa ki san hajar ngut ; ki jingmut jong ki kim lah ban ïohkem ïa kata .

translation.en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all : the king himself is served by the field .
translation.kha: Wat u syiem u shaniah ha ka jingot .

translation.en: And I will send an angel before thee  ; and I will drive out the Canaanite , the Amorite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite :
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa u angel jong nga ban ïalam ïa phi , bad ngan beh noh ïa ki Kanaan , ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock , and their children dance .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong ki , ki mareh bad ki ïalehkai kum ki khunlangbrot

translation.en: The heaven , even the heavens , are the  Lord s  : but the earth hath he given to the children of men .
translation.kha: Ka bneng ka long ka jong U  Trai  hi , hynrei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha u bynriew .

translation.en: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world  ; but that the world through him might be saved .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei um shym la phah ïa la U Khun sha ka pyrthei ba un long u nongbishar jong ka , hynrei , ba un long u nongpynim jong ka .

translation.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind , the sea covered them : they sank as lead in the mighty waters .
translation.kha: Pynban tang shisien pyrsad na me , ko  Trai  , ka la pynïap jyllop ïa ki nong Ijipt ; ki ngam kum ka sisa ha ka umbah bashyrkhei .

translation.en: Be it known therefore unto you , that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles , and that they will hear it .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynkut bad ki jingkhublei shimet

translation.en: Your Bible teacher will be pleased to explore the answers with you so that you and your family can “keep yourselves in God’s love , . . . with everlasting life in view .” —Jude 21 .
translation.kha: I nonghikai Baibl jong phi in kmen ban wad lang ïa ki jubab bad phi khnang ba maphi lem bad ka ïing ka sem jong phi phin lah ban ‘ ri noh ia lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih hir hir ia . . . ka jingim bymjukut .’ —Judah 21 .

translation.en: And one Ananias , a devout man according to the law , having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka nongbah la don u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias , u briew uba riewblei uba la kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong ngi bad ïa uba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da ki Jiw baroh kiba shong basah hangta .

translation.en: And Amaziah strengthened himself , and led forth his people , and went to the valley of salt , and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u la long shlur bad u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u sha ka Them Mluh . Hangta ki la ïaleh bad ki pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ,

translation.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said , He hath Beelzebub , and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki ïa-ong ,  U don ïa u Beelsebul ha u ! U dei u ksuid rangbah uba ai ïa u ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki .

translation.en: Declare ye in Egypt , and publish in Migdol , and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes : say ye , Stand fast , and prepare thee  ; for the sword shall devour round about thee .
translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka ha ki shnong jong ka Ijipt , ha Migdol , Memphis , bad Tahpanhes : ‘ To pynkhreh ban ïada ïa lade ; ïa kiei kiei kiba phi don yn pynjot ha ka thma !

translation.en: Then said he also to him that bade him ,  When thou makest a dinner or a supper , call not thy friends , nor thy brethren , neither thy kinsmen , nor thy rich neighbours  ; lest they also bid thee again , and a recompence be made thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u nongpdiang ïa u ,  Haba me ai ïa ka bam step ne ka bam miet , wat khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong me lane ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me lane ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong me lane ki paramarjan kiba riewspah jong me — naba kin khot sngewbha kylliang ïa me , bad ha kane ka rukom yn sa siew ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la leh .

translation.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .
translation.kha: U la bitar ruh ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u Job . Kim shym don lynti ban jubab ïa u Job , bad ka pynpaw pynban kumba U Blei u la bakla .

translation.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him , because he gave not God the glory : and he was eaten of worms , and gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u angel jong U Trai u la tied ïa u Herod , namar ba um shym ai burom ïa U Blei . La bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ , bad u la ïap .

translation.en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way  ; others cut down branches from the trees , and strawed them in the way .
translation.kha: U paidbah babun u la siang ïa la ki jaiñkup ha lynti katba kiwei pat ki la khyllad da ki tnat dieng bad ki la siang ïa ki ha lynti .

translation.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled , saying one to another , Behold , are not all these which speak Galilaeans ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jinglyngngoh bad jingphylla ki la pynbna ,  Kine ki briew kiba kren kumne ki long ki nong Galilaïa !

translation.en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas , who shall also tell you the same things by mouth .
translation.kha: Ngi phah ha phi , te , ïa u Judas bad u Silas , ki ban ïathuh ïa phi markhmat ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba ngi thoh .

translation.en: And now , brethren , I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko hynmen ko para jong nga , nga tip ba kaei kaba ma phi bad ki nongïalam jong phi , phi la leh ïa U Jisu ka long namar ka jingbymtip jong phi .

translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the  Lord s  lot fell , and offer him for a sin offering .
translation.kha: U Aaron un kñia ïa u  langsohmoh uba hap ha U  Trai  da ka jingkynting sbai , bad un kñia ïa u kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .

translation.en: And the woman conceived , and sent and told David , and said , I am with child .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ka la shem ba ka la punkhun bad ka phah ktien sha u Dabid ban ïathuh ïa u .

translation.en: O Israel , thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah : there they stood : the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel kim shym la sangeh ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga naduh ka por ba ki leh pop ha Gibeah . Kumta ha Gibeah ka thma kan lap ïa ki .

translation.en: And he began to say unto them ,  This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears .
translation.kha: katba u ong ha ki  Kane ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la wan urlong shisha mynta ka sngi , haba phi ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will bring up a company upon them , and will give them to be removed and spoiled .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Wallam ïa u paidbhur ban pynshyrkhei ïa ki bad ban lute ïa ki .

translation.en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies , which minister questions , rather than godly edifying which is in faith : so do .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa kito ki puriskam bad kito ki thup bajrong jong ka jinghiarpateng , kiba pynmih tang ïa ki jingïania ; kim ïadei ei ei bad ka jingthmu U Blei , ïa kaba lah ban tip da ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as it is fit in the Lord .
translation.kha: ki kynthei , to pynhapoh ïa lade ha ki tnga jong phi , naba kata ka long kaei kaba phi dei ha U Blei

translation.en: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence , and thou hast sinned : therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God : and I will destroy thee , O covering cherub , from the midst of the stones of fire .
translation.kha: Me la bunkam ha kaba thied bad kaba die , bad kane ka la ïalam ïa me sha ka jingleh jubor bad ka pop . Te nga pynbor ïa me ban ieh ïa u lumbah bakhuid jong nga , bad u angel uba ap phira ïa me u la beh noh ïa me na ki mawlynnai batyngshaiñ .

translation.en: It is a book .
translation.kha: Haoid kadei ka kot .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto the people , Sanctify yourselves : for to morrow the  Lord  will do wonders among you .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Pynkhuid ïa lade , namar lashai U  Trai  un leh ki kambah hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king s guard , which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon :
translation.kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun ai jingïada jong u syiem , uba la ïoh hukum ban pyndep ïa ka jingpynïap . Da kaba jied biang biang ïa ki kyntien jong u ,

translation.en: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in , then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar .
translation.kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki lai snem kiba la buh da u syiem , u Ashpenas u la ïalam ïa baroh ki samla shynrang sha u Nebukhadnessar .

translation.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u la rai ban tei ïa ka Templ ha kaba yn mane ïa U  Trai  , bad ruh ban tei ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: Now because we have maintenance from the king s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king  ;
translation.kha: Mynta , namar ba ngi don hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong phi , ko syiem , ngim kwah ban ïohi ïa kane ba kan jia , bad kumta ngi ai jingmut

translation.en: Then all the multitude kept silence , and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul , declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la sngap jar katba ki dang sngap ïa ka jingïathuh jong u Barnabas bad u Paul ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla baroh kiba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong ki hapdeng ki Jentil .

translation.en: And thence sailed to Antioch , from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled .
translation.kha: bad na kata ka jaka ki la leit pat da ka lieng sha Antiokh , ka jaka ha kaba la aiti ha ki ha ka jingsumar jong ka jingaiei jong U Blei na ka bynta ka kam kaba mynta ki la pyndep .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights , that the  Lord  gave me the two tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , hadien kita ki sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba u la thoh ïa kata ka jutang .

translation.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem , they that were of the circumcision contended with him ,
translation.kha: Haba u Petros u la leit sha Jerusalem , kito kiba ïashah ba dei ban otsher ïa ki Jentil ki la wohnia ïa u , da kaba ong ,

translation.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag , and the best of the sheep , and of the oxen , and of the fatlings , and the lambs , and all that was good , and would not utterly destroy them : but every thing that was vile and refuse , that they destroyed utterly .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki pynsah im ïa u Agag , bad kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam , ïa ki khun masi bad ki khunlangbrot kiba kynsai tam , bad ïa kano kano kaba kordor ; ki la pynjot tang ïa kata ka bymlarkam ne bymdonkam ei ei shuh .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations , that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon  ; and they shall serve him : and I have given him the beasts of the field also .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba un buh ka lyngkor nar halor kine ki jaitbynriew baroh bad ba kin shakri ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia . U  Trai  u la ong ba un pynlong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban shakri ïa u Nebukhadnessar .

translation.en: Yet the  Lord  would not destroy Judah for David his servant s sake , as he promised him to give him alway a light , and to his children .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  um mon ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , namar ba u la kular ïa u Dabid u shakri jong u ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .

translation.en: If I had called , and he had answered me  ; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice .
translation.kha: Pynban wat la katta , lada u shah ïa nga ban kren , Ngam lah ngeit ba un shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house , and the king s entry without , turned he from the house of the  Lord  for the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Bad khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa u patsha ki Assyria , u Ahas u weng ruh na ka Templ ïa ka rynsan na ka bynta ka khet syiem bad u set noh ïa ka jaka rung bakyrpang jong u syiem sha ka Templ .

translation.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force , to make him a king , he departed again into a mountain himself alone .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip lypa ba kin sa wan bad kem ïa u khnang ban pynlong syiem ïa u da ka bor ; kumta u la leit phai biang sha ki jaka lum marwei hi .

translation.en: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal : and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him , Thou knowest the thing that the  Lord  said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh–barnea .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katto katne ki briew na ka jait Judah ki la wan ha u Joshua ha Gilgal . Uwei na ki , u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh u nong Kenis , u ong ha u ,  Phi tip kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ha Kadesh Barnea shaphang jong phi bad nga ha u Moses , u briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: So likewise , whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath , he cannot be my disciple .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ,  U Jisu u la pynkut ,  ym don uno uno na phi uba lah ban long u synran jong nga lymda u iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .

translation.en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem , after he was come from Hebron : and there were yet sons and daughters born to David .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynriah na Hebron sha Jerusalem , u Dabid u shim shuh shuh ki tnga kliar bad ki tnga trai , bad u ïoh bun ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: Or speak to the earth , and it shall teach thee : and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee .
translation.kha: pan ïa ka jingstad na ki jingthaw ba-im ha khyndew bad ha duriaw .

translation.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee , he went unto him , and besought him that he would come down , and heal his son : for he was at the point of death .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la wan na Judia sha Galilaïa , u la leit sha u bad kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha Kapernam bad ban pynkhiah ïa u khun jong u , uba don ha tmier ka jingïap .

translation.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram , and the bread that is in the basket , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ki dei ban bam ïa ka lem bad u kpu uba dang sah ha kata ka shang .

translation.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee , and the pride of thine heart , O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , that holdest the height of the hill : though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle , I will bring thee down from thence , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ym don ba sheptieng ïa pha katta kumba pha pyrkhat ba ki long kumta . Pha shong ha ki synrang maw , ha kliar ki lumbah ; hynrei wat la pha shong hajrong tam kum u pukni , U  Trai  un wallam ïa pha sha tbian . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And he said ,  A certain man had two sons :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ban ong ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang .

translation.en: Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the terrible God , who keepest covenant and mercy , let not all the trouble seem little before thee , that hath come upon us , on our kings , on our princes , and on our priests , and on our prophets , and on our fathers , and on all thy people , since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day .
translation.kha: A Blei , U Blei jong ngi , katno me long uba khraw ! Katno me long uba shyrkhei bad uba donbor ! Me batskhem ïa ki kular ka jingïateh jutang . Naduh ka por ba ki syiem Assyria ki banbeiñ ïa ngi , wat haduh kane ka por , haduh katno ngi shahshitom ! Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki lyngdoh jong ngi bad ki nongïathuhlypa , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad baroh ki briew jong ngi ki shitom . To kynmaw haduh katno ngi la shahshitom !

translation.en: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it , to buy hewn stone , and timber for couplings , and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed .
translation.kha: bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki misteri dieng bad ki nongtei ban thied maw bad dieng sawdong ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei pynbha ïa ki ïing kiba ki syiem ka Judah ki la ieh ba kin pyut noh .

translation.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me : and let not thy dread make me afraid .
translation.kha: Shah ba ngan pan ar tylli kiei kiei ; to mynjur ïa ki , bad ngan nym pyrshang ban buhrieh na me : to sangeh noh ban pynshitom ïa nga , bad wat khñiot ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem .

translation.en: Be ye strong therefore , and let not your hands be weak : for your work shall be rewarded .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi dei ban long kiba khlaiñ bad phim dei ban noh mynsiem . Ka kam kaba phi leh yn sa ai bainong .

translation.en: Who would not fear thee , O King of nations ? for to thee doth it appertain : forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations , and in all their kingdoms , there is none like unto thee .
translation.kha: Uei u ban ym pyndonburom ïa me , u syiem jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ? Me dei hok ban ïoh ka pyndonburom . Ym don mano mano uba kum ma me hapdeng ki riewstad baroh jong ki jaitbynriew lane napdeng uno uno u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Thou art permitted to speak for thyself . Then Paul stretched forth the hand , and answered for himself :
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul ,  La shah ïa me ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade .  U Paul u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ïasaid da ïa lade kumne :

translation.en: And when they saw him , they worshipped him : but some doubted .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la mane ïa u , wat la don na ki , kiba la sngew artatien .

translation.en: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot , so is the laughter of the fool : this also is vanity .
translation.kha: Haba u bieit u rkhie , ka long kum ka jingsawa ki dieng shiah ha ka ding . Kam don jingmut ei ei .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will not believe thee , neither hearken to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Lada kim ngeit ïa me lane kim lah pdiang ïa ka kambah kaba nyngkong , te kane kan pynngeit ïa ki .

translation.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat iwei ruh i shñiuh na ki khlieh jong phi in ym jah noh .

translation.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten  ; it shall be burnt with fire : and as for the flesh , all that be clean shall eat thereof .
translation.kha: Lada ka doh kaba la kum dei bad kaei kaei ïa kaba la ñiew bymkhuid , ym dei ban bam , hynrei ban thang noh ïa ka . Uno uno ïa uba la ñiew ba u long uba khuid u lah ban bam ïa ka doh ,

translation.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man  ; but that which cometh out of the mouth , this defileth a man .
translation.kha: Kam dei kata kaba rung shapoh ka shyntur jong u briew kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid kat kum ka lehniam ; pynban , dei kaba mih shabar na ka , kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid .

translation.en: Then the king said unto me , For what dost thou make request ? So I prayed to the God of heaven .
translation.kha: U patsha u kylli ,  Kaei kaba me kwah ?

translation.en: Behold , the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place : ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place , as I commanded .
translation.kha: Namar ba ïa ka snam jong u  langsohmoh ym shym la wanrah shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , phi la dei ban bam ïa ka jingkñia hangta , kumba nga la hukum .

translation.en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned , but cast them down to hell , and delivered them into chains of darkness , to be reserved unto judgment  ;
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la shah jem ïa ki angel kiba la leh pop , hynrei u la bret ïa ki sha dujok , ha kaba la khum kynjri ïa ki ha ka jingdum , da kaba ap ïa ka Sngi ka Jingbishar .

translation.en: And he hath confirmed his words , which he spake against us , and against our judges that judged us , by bringing upon us a great evil : for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Me la leh ïa kaei kaba me la ong ba men leh ha ngi bad ha ki nongsynshar jong ngi . Me la pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kham jur ban ïa kano kano kawei pat ka nongbah ha ka pyrthei ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Whosoever hath sinned against me , him will I blot out of my book .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Dei ïa kito kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga kiba ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab jong nga .

translation.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man  ; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi ïoh da jingbymhok phi lah ban lehkmen kum ka jingbam babha tam , hynrei shen kan long kum u shyiap ba-dap ha ka shyntur .

translation.en: And hath taken of the king s seed , and made a covenant with him , and hath taken an oath of him : he hath also taken the mighty of the land :
translation.kha: U la shim ïa uwei na ka longïing jong u syiem , u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u , bad u la pynlong ïa u ban smai ban long uba ïaineh skhem . U la rah koidi ïa ki rangbah badonkam

translation.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba tip ba ki long kiba duk ha kaba kynja mynsiem ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !

translation.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother , it is wickedness : they shall be burnt with fire , both he and they  ; that there be no wickedness among you .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew bad sa ïa ka kmie jong ka , dei ban thang im ïa ki baroh lai ngut , ba kan duh kan dam ka kam sniew hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : but a wise man will pacify it .
translation.kha: U briew uba stad un pyrshang ban ïai pynkmen ïa u syiem ; lada u syiem u bitar , don uba lah ban ïap .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came also unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren pat ha nga bad u la ong ,

translation.en: Lo , this only have I found , that God hath made man upright  ; but they have sought out many inventions .
translation.kha: Kane ka long baroh kaba nga la tip : U Blei u la thaw ïa ngi kiba synlar , hynrei ngi la pynjyrthiaw shibun eh ïa lade .

translation.en: And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Judaea , beginning from Galilee to this place .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïa-ban kham jur shuh shuh ,  Da ka jinghikai jong u , u la sdang ka jingpynkhihwin hapdeng ki briew ha baroh kylleng ka Judia . U la sdang ha Galilaïa bad mynta u la poi hangne .

translation.en: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .
translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .

translation.en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power : who went about doing good , and healing all that were oppressed of the devil  ; for God was with him .
