translation.kha: Phi tip shaphang U Jisu uba na Nasareth bad kumno U Blei u la theh halor jong u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ïa ka bor . U la leit kylleng , u da leh ki kam babha bad u da pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la long hapoh ka bor jong u Ksuid , naba U Blei u la don lem bad u .

translation.en: The nations have heard of thy shame , and thy cry hath filled the land : for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty , and they are fallen both together .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingshah lehrain jong pha ; baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong pha . Uwei u shipai u ban halor uwei pat , bad baroh ar ngut ki kyllon ha madan .

translation.en: He that is not with me is against me : and he that gathereth not with me scattereth .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym long ha ka liang jong nga u pyrshah da shisha ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lum u pynsaphriang da shisha .

translation.en: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk , the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur , unto the place over against the sepulchres of David , and to the pool that was made , and unto the house of the mighty .
translation.kha: U Nehemaïah , u khun jong u Asbuk , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Bethsur distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud haduh ka jingtep u Dabid , ka pungsum bad jaka sah shipai .

translation.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father s stead in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah bad ki pynsleh syiem ïa u ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Samuel said to all the people , See ye him whom the  Lord  hath chosen , that there is none like him among all the people ? And all the people shouted , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Hangne u long uta u briew uba U  Trai  u la jied . Ym don uba kum ma u hapdeng jong ngi .  Baroh u paidbah u risa ,  To un im slem u syiem !

translation.en: And the king of Ai they took alive , and brought him to Joshua .
translation.kha: La kem ïa u bad la ïalam ïa u sha u Joshua .

translation.en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified , and by thy words thou shalt be condemned .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kyntien jong phi yn sa pyndonkam ban bishar ïa phi — ban pynbna ïa phi la phi long uba lui lui ne uba shah pynrem .

translation.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud , that our prayer should not pass through .
translation.kha: da u lyoh jong ka jingbitar shla jong me uba rben katta katta ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi ban ksam lyngba .

translation.en: Tremble , thou earth , at the presence of the Lord , at the presence of the God of Jacob  ;
translation.kha: To khynñiuh , ko khyndew , ha ka jingwan jong U  Trai  , ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei jong u Jakob ,

translation.en: Who shall tell thee words , whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved .
translation.kha: Un kren ki kyntien ha phi da kaba ma phi bad baroh ka longïing phin ïohlait im .’

translation.en: So the  Lord  sent pestilence upon Israel : and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha ki paid Israel , bad hynñiewphew hajar ngut na ki , ki la ïap .

translation.en: And when he had brought them into his house , he set meat before them , and rejoiced , believing in God with all his house .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha ka ïing jong u bad u la ai ha ki katto katne ka jingbam ban bam . Ïa u bad ka longïing jong u la pyndap da ka jingkmen , namar mynta ki la ngeit ha U Blei .

translation.en: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God , which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation  ; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels , and in the presence of the Lamb :
translation.kha: u hi da lade un dih ïa ka waiñ ka jong U Blei , ka waiñ ka jingbitar shla jong U , kaba u la theh noh ha ka bor jong ka baroh ha ka khuri ka jingbitar jong U ! Baroh kiba leh ïa kane kin shah pynsaja ha ka ding bad ha u kyndok ha khmat ki angel bakhuid bad ha khmat U Khunlangbrot .

translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh lano lano ruh .

translation.en: And the fourth , Adonijah the son of Haggith  ; and the fifth , Shephatiah the son of Abital  ;
translation.kha: u Adonijah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Haggith ; u Shephataïah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abital ;

translation.en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives , and said unto them , Why have ye done this thing , and have saved the men children alive ?
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Ijipt u phah khot ïa kita ki nongpynkha khun , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi leh kumne , bad phi shah ïa ki khun shynrang ba kin im ?

translation.en: For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth .
translation.kha: naba ka dei ka jingshai kaba pynmih ïa ka jingot kaba kyrhai ha baroh ki jinglong babha , bahok , bad bashisha .

translation.en: Yet I will distress Ariel , and there shall be heaviness and sorrow : and it shall be unto me as Ariel .
translation.kha: bad nangta U Blei un wallam ka jingjot ïa ka nongbah ïa kaba la khot  ka duwan U Blei .  Kan don ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew , bad ka nongbah baroh kawei kan long kum ka duwan ba la tap da ka snam .

translation.en: The burden of Moab . Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Moab . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ar bad ka Kir la pynjot tang ha kawei ka miet , bad ka jingkynjah ka tap ïa ka ri Moab .

translation.en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom phin pyrkhat ïa lade kum kiba la ïap , ha ka jingïadei bad ka pop , hynrei kiba im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei lyngba U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  It is one of the twelve , that dippeth with me in the dish .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Un long uwei na phi ki khat-ar ngut , uta u ban wieh ïa u kpu jong u ha ka pliang bad nga .

translation.en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us ( not the putting away of the filth of the flesh , but the answer of a good conscience toward God , ) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: kaba long ka dak kaba kdew sha ka jingpynbaptis , kaba pyllait im ïa phi mynta . Kam dei ka jingsait noh ïa ka jakhlia na ka met , hynrei ka jingkular ba la pynlong sha U Blei na ka jingïatiplem babha . Ka pynim ïa phi da ka jingmihpat jong U Jisu Khrist ,

translation.en: When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka kmen haba ki briew kiba hok ki manbha , bad ka don ki jingrisa sngewbha haba u bymman u ïap .

translation.en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt , unto their horses , and to their chariots  ; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you , and how the  Lord  hath destroyed them unto this day  ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi kumno U  Trai  u la pynduh lut ïa kynhun ïapom ki nong Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali thma jong ki , da kaba pynngam jyllop ïa ki ha ka Duriaw Basaw mynba ki beh nadien jong phi .

translation.en: And he spake to his sons , saying , Saddle me the ass . And they saddled him .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha la ki khun shynrang ,  Teh jin lem ïa ka kada jong nga .

translation.en: He made him lord of his house , and ruler of all his substance :
translation.kha: U la buh ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ka sorkar jong u bad pynlong ïa u , u nongsynshar halor ka ri baroh kawei ,

translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was tried , offered up Isaac : and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son ,
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ai kum ka jingkñia ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , mynba U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham . U Abraham u la long uta ïa uba U Blei u la ïateh kular , la katta ruh u long la kloi ban ai ïa la u khun marwei kum ka jingkñia .

translation.en: And Saul answered , God do so and more also : for thou shalt surely die , Jonathan .
translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha u ,  Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada yn ym pynïap ïa me !

translation.en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , hapoh ka ïingsyiem , ka Bashti , ka mahadei ka ai ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki kynthei .

translation.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters .
translation.kha: U la long u kpa jong ki hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang bad ki lai ngut ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: Are all religions pleasing to God , or is just one ?
translation.kha: Hato baroh ki niam ki pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , ne tang kawei ?

translation.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel , and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece , for each prince one , according to their fathers  houses , even twelve rods : and the rod of Aaron was among their rods .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel , bad uwei pa uwei na ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ai ha u mar uwei u diengduh , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait , baroh ki long khat-ar tylli , bad ïa u diengduh jong u Aaron la buh lem bad ki .

translation.en: When a man hath taken a new wife , he shall not go out to war , neither shall he be charged with any business : but he shall be free at home one year , and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u dang shu dep shongkurim , ym dei ban phah ïa u sha ka thma , ne pynkit ha u ïa kano kano ka kam bakhia hapoh shisnem , khnang ba un ïoh shong ha ïing bad lehkmen bad la ka tnga .

translation.en: And Gideon said unto God , Let not thine anger be hot against me , and I will speak but this once : let me prove , I pray thee , but this once with the fleece  ; let it now be dry only upon the fleece , and upon all the ground let there be dew .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u ong ha U Blei ,  Wat bitar ïa nga ; shah ngan tynjuh sa tang shisien . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban pyrshang sa shisien da une u shñiuh langbrot . Ha kane ka sien , ai ba u shñiuh langbrot un rkhiang , bad ba ka khyndew pat kan jhieh .

translation.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock , or for one ram , or for a lamb , or a kid .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka rukom haba wanrah ïa uwei u masi , u langbrot , ka langbrot , ne u  langsohmoh .

translation.en: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple ? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba ki rangbah kiba trei ha ka Templ ki ïoh bam na ka Templ bad kito kiba kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha ka duwan ki ïoh ïa ka bynta na ki jingkñia ?

translation.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord  : one bullock , one ram , seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian , let him not be ashamed  ; but let him glorify God on this behalf .
translation.kha: Pynban , lada phi shahshitom namar ba phi long u Khristan , wat sngewlehrain ïa kata , hynrei ainguh ïa U Blei ba phi kup ïa ka kyrteng U Khrist .

translation.en: And he said , This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you : He will take your sons , and appoint them for himself , for his chariots , and to be his horsemen  ; and some shall run before his chariots .
translation.kha: Uta u syiem u ban synshar ïa phi un leh kumne ,  u Samuel u pynshai .  Un pynlong shipai ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi ; don na ki , ki ban trei ha ki kali ïapom jong u , don ki ban long ki shipai shong kulai , bad don ruh ki ban mareh na khmat ki kali ïapom jong u .

translation.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place  ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .
translation.kha: bad ba u nongpdiang ïa phi , uba la khot sngewbha ïa phi baroh ar ngut , un hap wan bad ong ha phi , ‘ Ai noh ha u ïa kane ka jaka shong .’ Nangta phin sngewlehrain bad wan ban shong ha ka jaka ba hapoh eh .

translation.en: When I was a child , I spake as a child , I understood as a child , I thought as a child : but when I became a man , I put away childish things .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khynnah , ka jingkren jong nga , ki jingsngew , bad ki jingpyrkhat ki long baroh kum ki jong u khynnah ; mynta ba nga la rangbah , nga iehnoh ïa ki rukom khynnah .

translation.en: After these things , when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .
translation.kha: Hadien , wat haba ka jingbitar u syiem ka la pjah , u ïai pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba ka Bashti ka la leh bad shaphang ka jingpynbna jong u pyrshah ïa ka .

translation.en: Doth God pervert judgment ? or doth the Almighty pervert justice ?
translation.kha: U Blei um ju pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok , um ju pep ban leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James  ; and all the elders were present .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Paul u la leit bad ngi ban ïakynduh ïa u Jakob ; bad baroh ki nongsharai balang jong ka balang ki la ïadon lang .

translation.en: And when he heard of Jesus , he sent unto him the elders of the Jews , beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant .
translation.kha: Haba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , u la phah katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san jong ki Jiw ban kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban wan bad pynkhiah ïa u shakri jong u .

translation.en: Now I tell you before it come , that , when it is come to pass , ye may believe that I am he .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane mynta , khnang ba haba kata kan jia , phin ngeit ba ‘ Nga long uba nga long .’

translation.en: And he brake in pieces the images , and cut down the groves , and filled their places with the bones of men .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki rishot maw , u ot lyngkhot ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ka jaka ha kiba ki ïeng u la tap da ki shyieng briew .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as Jesus sat at meat in his house , many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples : for there were many , and they followed him .
translation.kha: Hadien kata U Jisu u leit bam ha ka ïing u Lebi . Don bun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei kiba la shah kyntait na ka imlang ka sahlang kiba ïabud ïa U Jisu , bad bun na ki , ki la ïadon bynta bad u lem bad ki synran jong u ha ka miej bam .

translation.en: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish , and a ram out of the flock without blemish .
translation.kha: Haba me la dep ban leh ïa kata , shim ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u langbrot lud , baroh ar na ki , ki bym don kino kino ki jingduna , bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ye have not hearkened unto me , in proclaiming liberty , every one to his brother , and every man to his neighbour : behold , I proclaim a liberty for you , saith the  Lord  , to the sword , to the pestilence , and to the famine  ; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ba phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga : phim shym la ai ka jinglaitluid ïa la ki para Israel . Kumta te , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jinglaitluid : ka jinglaitluid ban ïap da ka thma , ka jingpang , bad ka jingïapthngan . Ngan pynlong ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ban sngewshyrkhei ïa kaei kaba nga leh ïa phi .

translation.en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only :
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ba sha Sepngi ,  Da shisha phi ïabun paid , bad phi long kiba khlaiñbor . Phi ïoh shuh shuh nalor ka shi bynta .

translation.en: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side , and three on that side  ; they three were of one measure : and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side .
translation.kha: Kine ki kamra ap phira ha baroh arliang ka jaka ïaid ki long baroh katjuh ka jingheh ; bad ki kynroh baroh arliang katjuh ka jingrben .

translation.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water , which Abimelech s servants had violently taken away .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ujor ha u Abimelekh shaphang ka pukri um ïa kaba ki shakri u Abimelekh ki la knieh bor .

translation.en: Then he questioned with him in many words  ; but he answered him nothing .
translation.kha: Kumta u Herod u la kylli ïa U Jisu shibun ki jingkylli , hynrei U Jisu um shym jubab ei ei .

translation.en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki jinghikai u Moses u shakri jong nga , ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la ai ha u ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel baroh ban kohnguh .

translation.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John .
translation.kha: Haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis baroh ki nongïathuhlypa bad ka Hukum u Moses ki la kren shaphang ka Hima ;

translation.en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy : for the  Lord  had made them joyful , and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them , to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God , the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki rakhe da ka jingkmen ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki la dap da ka jingkmen namar U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa u patsha jong ka Assyria ban lehsbun ïa ki , ba u kyrshan ïa ki ha ka jingtrei jong ki ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ jong U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Yea , and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith , I joy , and rejoice with you all .
translation.kha: Lehse ïa ka snam jong ka jingim jong nga la dei ban theh noh kum ka jingainguh halor ka jingkñia kaba long ka jingngeit jong phi ba ai sha U Blei . Lada kata ka long kumta , nga shadkmen bad nga ïasam bynta lem ïa ka jingkmen jong nga bad phi baroh .

translation.en: But he answered and said ,  Every plant , which my heavenly Father hath not planted , shall be rooted up .
translation.kha: Ïa u jingthung baroh ïa uba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng um shym la thung , yn rat noh ,  la jubab U Jisu .

translation.en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time : also he hath set the world in their heart , so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end .
translation.kha: U la buh ka por kaba dei ïa kaei kaei baroh . U la ai ha ngi ka jingkwah ban tip ïa ka lawei , hynrei um ju ai ha ngi ka jinghun ban sngewthuh lut ïa kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: And they stood up in their place , and read in the book of the law of the  Lord  their God one fourth part of the day  ; and another fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Kumba lai kynta , ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , la pule ha ki , bad ha ki lai kynta kiba bud , ki phla ïa la ki pop bad mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: These are the sons of Shem , after their families , after their tongues , in their lands , after their nations .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .

translation.en: Behold , all his fellows shall be ashamed : and the workmen , they are of men : let them all be gathered together , let them stand up  ; yet they shall fear , and they shall be ashamed together .
translation.kha: Baroh uba mane ïa ka un shah ñiewbeiñ . Ki briew kiba shna ïa ki bleithaw ki long tang ki briew bad ym don shuh . Shah ïa ki ban wan bad ban ïeng ha ka jingbishar — kin khynñiuh bad kin shah pynjahburom .

translation.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country , and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur , and sojourned in Gerar .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la kynriah noh na Mamre sha ki bynta bashathie jong ka Kanaan bad u la shong la sah hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka Shur .

translation.en: And if by grace , then is it no more of works : otherwise grace is no more grace . But if it be of works , then is it no more grace : otherwise work is no more work .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingjied jong u la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingaiei jong u , ym ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Namar lada ïa ka jingjied U Blei la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba ki briew ki leh , te ka jingaiei jong u kan ym long ka jingaiei bashisha .

translation.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way : and his heart fretteth against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pynjot ïa lade da ki kam ba-mutlop jong ki hi bad nangta ki kynnoh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together , and edify one another , even as also ye do .
translation.kha: Bad kumta to pyntngen iwei ïa iwei pat bad to ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba phi leh mynta .

translation.en: I thank thee , and praise thee , O thou God of my fathers , who hast given me wisdom and might , and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee : for thou hast now made known unto us the king s matter .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me bad pyndonburom ïa me , A U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong nga . Me la ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; me la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad me la pyn-i ha ngi kaei ba ngin ïathuh ha u syiem .

translation.en: Soon , though , an amazing event will take place .
translation.kha: Hynrei satang katto katne kein , ka jingjia kaba phylla kan sa wan jia .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I also will ask you one thing , which if ye tell me , I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ha nga ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ha phi da ka bor aïu nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry , nor are given in marriage , but are as the angels of God in heaven .
translation.kha: Naba haba kiba ïap ki mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng bad kin ym ïashongkurim .

translation.en: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment , therefore the misery of man is great upon him .
translation.kha: Ka don ka por kaba dei bad ka lynti kaba dei ban leh ïa kiei kiei , hynrei ngi tip tang khyndiat eh !

translation.en: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem , to bring in to the  Lord  the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki la phah ktien sha kylleng ka Jerusalem bad ka Judah ïa baroh ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ka khajna ba u Moses , u shakri U Blei , u la lum nyngkong ha ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us , even eternal life .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Khrist hi da lade u la kular ban ai ha ngi — ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And Jephthah said unto them , I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon  ; and when I called you , ye delivered me not out of their hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jephthah u ong ha ki ,  Ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi don ka jingïakajia kaba jur bad ki Ammon . Nga la khot ïa phi , hynrei phim shym la wan pyllait ïa nga na ki .

translation.en: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled , and his countenance was changed in him , and his lords were astonished .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jingmut u syiem Belshassar u la nang kham lieh blaid blaid , bad ki rangbah donburom jong u kim tip shuh kumno yn leh .

translation.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people , and their officers , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi , u Pharaoh u la hukum ïa ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw bad ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam :

translation.en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought , which say , Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength ?
translation.kha: Phi kob shaphang kaba ïoh kurup ïa ka shnong Lodebar . Phi kob ,  Ngi la long kiba khlaiñ bha ban ïohknieh ïa ka Karnaim .

translation.en: And he said , It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to restore the preserved of Israel : I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles , that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Nga don ka kam kaba kham khraw ïa me , ko shakri jong nga . Ym tang ba men rah pat sha ka jingkhraw ïa ki paid Israel kiba la lait im , hynrei ngan pynlong ruh ïa me ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew — khnang ba ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohlait im .

translation.en: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth , where no gin is for him ? shall one take up a snare from the earth , and have taken nothing at all ?
translation.kha: Hato ka sim kan shu ngat ha ka jingriam lymda la pynap jingriam ïa ka ? Hato ka shangkhawiah ka ju bsiat hi lymda ngat ei ei ha ka ?

translation.en: He cometh forth like a flower , and is cut down : he fleeth also as a shadow , and continueth not .
translation.kha: Ngi san bad ngi ïapstai kloi kloi kum ki syntiew ki skud ; lane ngi jah noh kum ki syrngiew .

translation.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress , that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands , and shine upon the counsel of the wicked ?
translation.kha: Hato ka long kaba dei ïa me ban lehbeiñ katne katne ? Ban ñiewbeiñ ïa uta uba me hi me la thaw ? Bad nangta ban phuh samrkhie ha ki jingthmu ki riewbymman ?

translation.en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah : and the  Lord  struck him , and he died .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam um shym lah khie khlieh shuh ha ka bor jong u ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u Abijah . Ha kaba khatduh U  Trai  u shoh ïap ïa u .

translation.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , The  Lord  be witness between us , if we do not so according to thy words .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ngi mynjur ïa kata . U  Trai  un long u sakhi hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: And he said , I will hide my face from them , I will see what their end shall be : for they are a very froward generation , children in whom is no faith .
translation.kha: ‘ Ngan ym ïarap shuh ïa ki ,’ u ong ; ‘ bad ngan peit kai kumno kan jia ïa ki . Kine ki dei ki briew kiba mutlop , kiba ym don ka jingïaineh .

translation.en: The  Lord  thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee , of thy brethren , like unto me  ; unto him ye shall hearken  ;
translation.kha: Un phah ha phi napdeng jong phi hi ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba kum ma nga , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: First , I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all , that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world .
translation.kha: Nyngkong , nga ainguh ïa U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta jong phi baroh , namar ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïohsngew shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi .

translation.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler , and shall come forth and fight with him , even with the king of the north : and he shall set forth a great multitude  ; but the multitude shall be given into his hand .
translation.kha: U syiem Ijipt ha la ka jingbitar un leit sha ka thma pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Syria bad kem ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong u .

translation.en: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters , and that spreadeth out her roots by the river , and shall not see when heat cometh , but her leaf shall be green  ; and shall not be careful in the year of drought , neither shall cease from yielding fruit .
translation.kha: U long kum u dieng uba mih hajan ka wahduid bad uba ki thied ki ksam sha ka um . Um sheptieng haba ka jingshit ka suiñbneng ka wan , namar ki sla jong u ki sah jyrngam ; um don jingkhuslai haba ym don slap ; u ïai pynmih soh .

translation.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?
translation.kha: Namar ba kane ka long kaba shisha , kaba katno tam lah ban pyndep da ka snam U Khrist ! Lyngba U Mynsiem bymjukut u la aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia kaba janai ha U Blei . Ka snam jong u kan pynkhuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi na ki niam ki rukom ki bymmyntoi , khnang ba ngi lah ban shakri ïa U Blei uba im .

translation.en: The isles saw it , and feared  ; the ends of the earth were afraid , drew near , and came .
translation.kha: Ki briew na ki ri bajngai ki la ïohi kaei ba nga la leh ; ki da sheptieng bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Kumta ki la ïalumlang baroh bad ki ïawan .

translation.en: And the king answered , Chimham shall go over with me , and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee : and whatsoever thou shalt require of me , that will I do for thee .
translation.kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Ngan ïalam ïa u bad nga , ngan leh na ka bynta jong u kat kaba phi kwah . Bad ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ïa kano kano kaba phi ong .

translation.en: He said unto him , I am a prophet also as thou art  ; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Bring him back with thee into thine house , that he may eat bread and drink water . But he lied unto him .
translation.kha: Te u nongïathuhlypa tymmen uba na Bethel u ong ha u ,  Nga ruh nga dei u nongïathuhlypa kum ma phi , bad ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u angel u la ong ïa nga ban ïalam ïa phi sha ïing bad ban ai ïa ka jingpdiang sngewbha ïa phi .  Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u lamler .

translation.en: Ye have not gone up into the gaps , neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kim sumar ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh ki la khyllem , lymne ba ki tei pat ïa ki kynroh , bad kumta ym lah ban ïada ïa ka Israel haba wan ka thma ha ka sngi ka jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , saying , The king of Moab hath rebelled against me : wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle ? And he said , I will go up : I am as thou art , my people as thy people , and my horses as thy horses .
translation.kha: U la phah ktien sha u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah :  U syiem ka Moab u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; hato phin ïasoh bad nga ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u ?   Ngan ïasoh ,  u syiem Jehoshaphat u jubab .  Nga kloi ban ïarap ïa phi kat kaba nga lah bad kumta ruh ki long ki rangbah bad ki kulai jong nga .

translation.en: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped , and the rain from heaven was restrained  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki umpohliew shapoh ka khyndew bad ïa ki khyrdop um jong ka suiñbneng la khang noh .

translation.en: The  Lord  is exalted  ; for he dwelleth on high : he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness .
translation.kha: Katno uba khraw u long U  Trai  ! U synshar halor kiei kiei baroh . Un pyndap ïa ka Jerusalem da ka jinglehhok bad ka jinglong ba-beit bad pynlong ka jingskhem ha ka hima .

translation.en: And he said , Thou shalt not go through . And Edom came out against him with much people , and with a strong hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Edom ki ban ktien biang ,  Ngim shah !  Bad ki la wan mih bad ka kynhun ïapom kaba khlaiñ ban tur ïaleh ïa ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Lest I strip her naked , and set her as in the day that she was born , and make her as a wilderness , and set her like a dry land , and slay her with thirst .
translation.kha: Lada kam sangeh , ngan law lyngkhuit ïa ka kumba ka la long ha ka sngi ba la kha ïa ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ka , kum ka ri kaba tyrkhong bad ka bymseisoh , bad kan sa ïap namar ka jingsliang .

translation.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place  ; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father s house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynskhem triang ïa u kum ïa u snar , bad un long ka tynrai jong ka jingpyndonburom ïa ka longïing jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: But as God is true , our word toward you was not yea and nay .
translation.kha: Kat kumba U Blei u kren ïa ka jingshisha , ka jingkular jong nga ïa phi kam long kaba  Ho-oid  bad kaba  Em .

translation.en: Then asked he them again ,  Whom seek ye ?  And they said , Jesus of Nazareth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ïa ki ,  Ïano phi ïawad ?   U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la ong .

translation.en: And he said , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak yet but this once : Peradventure ten shall be found there . And he said , I will not destroy it for ten s sake .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  Sngewbha wat bitar , A Trai , bad ngan kren biang sa tang shisien . Kumno lada don tang shiphew ngut hangta ?  U jubab ,  Ngan ym pynjot ïa ka lada don shiphew ngut .

translation.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , O my people , I will open your graves , and cause you to come up out of your graves , and bring you into the land of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad ong ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan plied ïa ki jingtep jong ki . Ngan sei noh ïa ki shabar , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri Israel .

translation.en: And Jacob called unto his sons , and said , Gather yourselves together , that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days .
translation.kha: Te u Jakob u khot ïa la ki khun shynrang bad u ong ,  Ïalumlang baroh , ba ngan ïathuh aïu kan jia ïa phi ha ka lawei :

translation.en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock , nor shear the firstling of thy sheep .
translation.kha: Buh kyrpang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ki shynrang baroh ba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi ; wat pyntreikam ïa kita ki masi , bad wat ot shñiuh ïa kita ki langbrot .

translation.en: And I bowed down my head , and worshipped the  Lord  , and blessed the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , which had led me in the right way to take my master s brother s daughter unto his son .
translation.kha: Nga la dem khohsiew bad mane ïa U  Trai . Nga ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , uba la ïalam beit ïa nga sha u kur u jait jong u kynrad jong nga , ha kaba nga la shem ïa ka khun jong u na ka bynta u khun jong u kynrad jong nga .

translation.en: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pdiang pisa ban pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: Woe to the multitude of many people , which make a noise like the noise of the seas  ; and to the rushing of nations , that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters !
translation.kha: Ki hima kiba khlaiñbor ki don ha ka jingkhynwin ha ka jingsawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw , kum ka jingphaloh jong ki jingat phyllung kiba khraw .

translation.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach , both he , and Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha u bad ha u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ïa ka sap ban hikai ïa ki buit treikam ha kiwei pat .

translation.en: It is like a letter to us from a loving father .
translation.kha: Ka long kum ka shithi na u kpa ba ieit sha la ki khun .

translation.en: How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .
translation.kha: Mynno kane ka la jia ? Hato ka la long ha shuwa ne hadien ba la otsher ïa u Abraham ? Ka la long ha shuwa ym hadien .

translation.en: And God said unto Jacob , Arise , go up to Beth–el , and dwell there : and make there an altar unto God , that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Jakob ,  Khie leit sha Bethel bad shongsah hangta . Tei ïa ka duwan hangta ïa nga , U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me mynba me dang phet ïap na u Iso u hynmen jong me .

translation.en: And his father in law , the damsel s father , retained him  ; and he abode with him three days : so they did eat and drink , and lodged there .
translation.kha: U kpa u ïai ban ba un sah , bad kumta u sah hangta lai sngi . Ki shi jur ki ïabam ïadih bad ki sah hangta baroh lai miet .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will plead thy cause , and take vengeance for thee  ; and I will dry up her sea , and make her springs dry .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ,  Ngan shimti na ka bynta jong phi bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin hap siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa phi . Ngan pynrngad ïa ki tyllong um jong ka Babilonia bad ngan pynlong ïa ki wah jong ka ban tyrkhong .

translation.en: Wherewith shall I come before the  Lord  , and bow myself before the high God ? shall I come before him with burnt offerings , with calves of a year old ?
translation.kha: Da-ei ngan wallam sha U  Trai  , U Blei ka bneng , haba nga wan ban mane ïa u ? Hato ngan wallam sha u da ki khun masi bakynsai tam kum ki jingainguh thang ?

translation.en: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia , and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia ,
translation.kha: Ki la leit lyngba ki thain ka Phrygia bad Galatia namar U Mynsiem Bakhuid um shym la shah ïa ki ban ïalap ïa ka khubor ha ka probins    jong ka Asia .

translation.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner , and commanded his head to be brought : and he went and beheaded him in the prison ,
translation.kha: Kumta shisyndon u la phah ïa u nongap phira ryngkat bad ki hukum ban wallam ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis . U nongap phira u la mihnoh , u leit sha ka byndi , bad khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis ;

translation.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed , do all in the name of the Lord Jesus , giving thanks to God and the Father by him .
translation.kha: Nangta , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh ne phi ong , dei ban leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu , ha kaba phi ainguh da u ïa U Blei uba U Kpa .

translation.en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward , saying , Come , and let us join ourselves to the  Lord  in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten .
translation.kha: Kin kylli ïa ka lynti sha Seïon bad nangta kin leit ha kata ka phang . Kin pynlong ka jutang baïaineh bad nga bad da lei lei kin ym pynkheiñ ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that he went out , and stood , and said to all the people , Ye be righteous : behold , I conspired against my master , and slew him : but who slew all these ?
translation.kha: Ynda mynstep , u leit sha kata ka khyrdop shnong , bad u ong ha ki briew kiba don hangta ,  Nga dei ma nga uba la sylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram bad uba la pynïap ïa u ; phim dei kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta kata . Hynrei mano ba la pynïap ïa kine baroh ?

translation.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them : but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them .
translation.kha: Lada phi long kiba beit , la ïalam ïa phi da ka jinglonghok . Ïa ki briew kiba ym lah ban shaniah la pynjot da ka jingbymhok jong ki hi .

translation.en: And some fell upon a rock  ; and as soon as it was sprung up , it withered away , because it lacked moisture .
translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap ha ka jaka maw , bad haba ki jingthung ki la shylluit , ki la tyrkhong noh namar ka khyndew kam don kano kano ka jingsngem .

translation.en: I will call on the  Lord  , who is worthy to be praised : so shall I be saved from mine enemies .
translation.kha: Nga khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong nga . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that the king of the children of Ammon died , and Hanun his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Nahash u syiem Ammon u la ïap , bad u Hanun , u khun jong u , u la long syiem .

translation.en: I am come to send fire on the earth  ; and what will I , if it be already kindled ?
translation.kha: Nga la wan ban pynmeh ding ïa ka pyrthei , bad katno nga kwah ba ïa ka , la lah pynmeh lypa !

translation.en: And Absalom said unto him , See , thy matters are good and right  ; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee .
translation.kha: u Absalom u ju ong ,  Khmih , ka aiñ ka ha ka liang jong me , hynrei ym don mano mano u ban mihkhmat ïa u syiem ban sngap ïa ka kam jong me .

translation.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things , and hast profaned my sabbaths .
translation.kha: Phim don jingburom ïa ki jaka bakhuid , bad phim sumar ïa ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the  Lord  , and find the knowledge of God .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , phin sa tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad phin sa lah ban sngewthuh shaphang U Blei .

translation.en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïarwai jingrwai bad ki la leit noh sha u lum ki Olib .

translation.en: And so it is written , The first man Adam was made a living soul ; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ïa u briew uba nyngkong , u Adam , la thaw uba don jingim ;  hynrei u Adam uba khatduh u la long U Mynsiem uba ai jingim .

translation.en: And Moses called unto all Israel , and said unto them , Ye have seen all that the  Lord  did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh , and unto all his servants , and unto all his land  ;
translation.kha: U Moses u khot lang ïa ki Israel baroh , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi la ïohi da lade hi aïu U  Trai  u la leh ïa u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he said , How can I , except some man should guide me ? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar u la jubab ,  Kumno ngan lah ban sngewthuh lymda don mano mano ba batai ïa ka ha nga ?  Bad u la khot sngewbha ïa u Philip ban wan kiew bad shong ha ka kali kulai ryngkat bad u .

translation.en: And if a man have committed a sin worthy of death , and he be to be put to death , and thou hang him on a tree :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh ïa kano kano ka kam runar bad na ka bynta kata u shah phasi ha u dieng ,

translation.en: He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .
translation.kha: U lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba la kñia ainguh ha nga , ïa ka jingkñia ainguh bam kaba kyntang , bad kaba kyntang eh ;

translation.en: And lay siege against it , and build a fort against it , and cast a mount against it  ; set the camp also against it , and set battering rams against it round about .
translation.kha: Nangta , ban pyn-i nuksa ïa ka jingshah kerkut , buh ki kharai , ki kynton khyndew , ki jaka sher dara bad ki tiar pynpait kynroh baroh sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon : and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Iphtah–el :
translation.kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud u phai shaphang ka Hannathon , bad u kut ha ka Them Iphtahel .

translation.en: And say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant ,
translation.kha: ba ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la buh ka jingtim halor uwei uwei baroh u bymkohnguh ïa ki kyndon jong kane ka jutang .

translation.en: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , and advanced him , and set his seat above all the princes that were with him .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u syiem Serksis u la pynkiew kyrdan ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Haman sha ka kyrdan myntri rangbah . U Haman u dei u khun jong u Hammedatha , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , which was the second day of the month , that David s place was empty : and Saul said unto Jonathan his son , Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat , neither yesterday , nor to day ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ka sngi hadien ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , ka jaka shong bam u Dabid ka dang thylli hi , bad u Saul u kylli ïa u Jonathan ,  Balei u Dabid um shym wan sha ka jingkhawai mynhynnin bad mynta ka sngi ruh ?

translation.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty , and the arms of the fatherless have been broken .
translation.kha: Phi la kyntait noh ym tang na kaba ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei , hynrei phi la lute ïa ki khunswet ba la shah lehbeiñ .

translation.en: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Ahab u syiem Israel , ka ri Moab ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial , because thou hast destroyed thy land , and slain thy people : the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned .
translation.kha: Namar me la pynjot pynpra ïa ka ri , bad pynïap ïa la ki briew , ïa me yn ym tep kum ïa kiwei pat ki syiem . Ym don mano mano na ka longïing basniew jong me ban lait im .

translation.en: Who is gone into heaven , and is on the right hand of God  ; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him .
translation.kha: uba la leit noh sha bneng bad u don ha ka kti kamon U Blei , da kaba synshar halor ki angel baroh bad ki nongsynshar bad ki bor ba kynja bneng .

translation.en: And whatsoever we ask , we receive of him , because we keep his commandments , and do those things that are pleasing in his sight .
translation.kha: Ngi ïohpdiang na u ïa kano kano kaba ngi pan , namar ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u bad ngi leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .

translation.en: The people of the land have used oppression , and exercised robbery , and have vexed the poor and needy : yea , they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully .
translation.kha: Kiba riewspah ki shukor bad ki lute . Ki leh bymdei ïa kiba duk bad ki shim kabu ïa ki nongwei .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Rehoboam u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity , and sin as it were with a cart rope :
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phim shym lah ban pyllaitluid na la ki jong ki pop .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan , that reigned in Hazor  ; the captain of whose host was Sisera , which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u shah ba kin shahjop ha u Jabin , u syiem Kanaan uba la synshar ha ka nongbah Hasor . U rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u , u dei u Sisera , uba shong ha Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil .

translation.en: And the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and the spirit of all the remnant of the people  ; and they came and did work in the house of the  Lord  of hosts , their God ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhih mynsiem ïa uwei pa uwei ban trei ha ka Templ : U Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah ; u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw . Ki la sdang ban trei ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki ,

translation.en: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand , Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth , that I may lean upon them .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ïa u khynnah uba btin ïa u na ka kti ,  Ai ba ngan ktah ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa kane ka ïing . Nga kwah ban shaniah ha ki !

translation.en: My little children , of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you ,
translation.kha: Ko ki khun ba-ieit jong nga ! Sa shisien , kum ka kmie kaba suh kha , nga sngew ïa kajuh ka jait jingsuh na ka bynta jong phi tad haduh ka jinglong U Khrist kan da thawdur ha phi .

translation.en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the  Lord  withal .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw , ïa u soh baroh dei ban pynkyntang kum ka jingainguh ïaroh ïa nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: I was eyes to the blind , and feet was I to the lame .
translation.kha: Nga la long ki khmat ïa kiba matlah , bad ki kjat ïa kiba dkoh .

translation.en: And the ass saw me , and turned from me these three times : unless she had turned from me , surely now also I had slain thee , and saved her alive .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kada jong me ka la ïohi bad kiar ïa nga lai sien . Lada kam shym la leh kumta , ngan jin da la pynïap ïa me bad pyllait im ïa ka kada .

translation.en: The woman then left her waterpot , and went her way into the city , and saith to the men ,
translation.kha: Nangta kata ka briew ka la iehnoh ïa la u khiew um , ka la leit phai sha shnong , bad ka la ong ïa ki briew hangta ,

translation.en: And woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !
translation.kha: A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ha kito ki sngi ïa ki kynthei kiba armet bad ïa ki kmie kiba don ki khun rit !

translation.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment , and he that doeth righteousness at all times .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , kiba leh borabor ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth , the gospel of your salvation : in whom also after that ye believed , ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise ,
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ruh , kiba la kylla long ki briew jong U Blei mynba phi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor kaba shisha , ka khubor babha kaba wallam ïa phi ka jingpynim . Phi la ngeit ha U Khrist , bad U Blei u la buh ïa ka jingshonshab ka jinglong trai ha phi da kaba ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba u la kular .

translation.en: The sons of Moses were , Gershom , and Eliezer .
translation.kha: U Moses u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershom bad u Elieser .

translation.en: Can any man forbid water , that these should not be baptized , which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we ?
translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba ma ngi ruh ngi la ïohpdiang . Hato don uno uno , te , u ban khang ïa ki na kaba shah pynbaptis da ka um ?

translation.en: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers  ; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them , according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Bad lada ki paid Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la ai ïa ki , te ngan ym shah ban beh noh ïa ki na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: But when Peter was come to Antioch , I withstood him to the face , because he was to be blamed .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Petros u la wan sha Antiokh , nga la pyrshah ïa u ha kaba paw , namar ba u la bakla shai .

translation.en: So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa u Og , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh , khlem da pynsah uwei ruh , bad nangta ki kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .

translation.en: And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong ha ki synran jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,  A katno ka long kaba eh ïa kiba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !

translation.en: And he said , I am Abraham s servant .
translation.kha: Nga dei u shakri jong u Abraham ,  u la sdang .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Hushai the Archite , David s friend , was come unto Absalom , that Hushai said unto Absalom , God save the king , God save the king .
translation.kha: Haba u Hushai , u paralok bajan jong u Dabid , u la ïakynduh ïa u Absalom , u la pyrta ,  To u syiem un im slem ! To u syiem un im slem !

translation.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord  ; and whence is he then his son ?  And the common people heard him gladly .
translation.kha: U Dabid hi da lade u la khot ïa u ‘ U Trai’ ; te kumno U Messaïah u lah ban hiarpateng na u Dabid ?  U paidbah babun u dang shahshkor ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman . And when Naaman saw him running after him , he lighted down from the chariot to meet him , and said , Is all well ?
translation.kha: Kumta u leit mih hadien jong u Naaman . Haba u Naaman u la ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh hadien jong u , u la hiar na la ka kali ïapom ban ïashem ïa u , bad kylli ,  Don ei ei kaba pher ?

translation.en: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard , saying ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la hukum ïa u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , ban ai ïa kane ka hukum harum :

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh jong u kpa jong u , u Jehoïakhin u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: The  Lord  was ready to save me : therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynkhiah ïa nga . Ngin tem ki duitara bad rwai ka jingïaroh ïa me , ngin rwai ïaroh ha ka Templ jong me katba ngi dang im .

translation.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things , and wrote these things : and we know that his testimony is true .
translation.kha: U long u synran uba la kren kine kiei kiei , uta uba la thoh ruh ïa kine ; bad ngi tip ba kaei kaba u ong ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: Then Joseph said unto the people , Behold , I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh : lo , here is seed for you , and ye shall sow the land .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha kita ki briew ,  Phi ïohi mynta ba nga la thied ïa phi bad ïa ki khyndew jong phi na ka bynta u syiem . Shim une u symbai ba phin ïabet ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: Then thus came every maiden unto the king  ; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king s house .
translation.kha: Haba ka leit na ka ïing ki kynthei sha ka ïingsyiem , ka lah ban riam kano kano ka jingriam kaba ka kwah .

translation.en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice  ; and arise , flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran  ;
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun , leh kumba nga ong .

translation.en: And if thy brother , an Hebrew man , or an Hebrew woman , be sold unto thee , and serve thee six years  ; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee .
translation.kha: Lada u para Israel , shynrang lane kynthei , ki die mraw ïa lade ha phi , phi dei ban pyllait ïa ki hadien ba ki la shakri ïa phi hynriew snem . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew phi dei ban pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: Wherefore ye must needs be subject , not only for wrath , but also for conscience sake .
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar — ym tang namar ka jingpynshitom U Blei , hynrei na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem ruh .

translation.en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt , even unto this day , rising early and protesting , saying , Obey my voice .
translation.kha: Haba nga wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na Ijipt , nga la maham kyntang ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga la ïai maham ïa ki briew tad haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: And he said , For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand , that they may be a witness unto me , that I have digged this well .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  To pdiang ïa kine ki hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot . Da kaba leh kumne , me kubur ba dei ma nga uba la tih ïa kane ka pukri .

translation.en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .
translation.kha: Bad nangta u ong ,  Nga don hangne ka Kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u ai ha nga .  Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .

translation.en: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth , and was sore afraid , because of the words of Samuel : and there was no strength in him  ; for he had eaten no bread all the day , nor all the night .
translation.kha: Mar kumta u Saul u kyllon kram bad u thiah lytar ha khyndew , ba u sheptieng eh ïa kaei kaba u Samuel u la ong . U la shoh tlot ngai , namar ba um shym la bam ei ei baroh shi sngi bad baroh shi miet .

translation.en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased , and came to Samaria .
translation.kha: U syiem u leit phai noh sha la ïing ha Samaria da kaba khuslai bad rit mynsiem .

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: Even they sent , and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison , and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , that he should carry him home : so he dwelt among the people .
translation.kha: Ki la buh ïa nga hapoh ka jingsumar u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphan , u ban peit ba nga poi suk sha ïing . Bad kumta nga la sah hangta hapdeng ki briew .

translation.en: And ye are risen up against my father s house this day , and have slain his sons , threescore and ten persons , upon one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his maidservant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother  ; )
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta phi phai pyrshah ïa ka longïing jong i pa jong nga . Phi la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong i — hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah halor uwei u maw — bad namar ba u Abimelekh , u khun ba i ïoh na ka shakri jong i , u dei uba ha ïing jong phi , phi la pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Shekhem .

translation.en: Get you out of the way , turn aside out of the path , cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us .
translation.kha: Wat ïeng ha ka lynti jong ngi bad wat kah ïa ka lynti ïaid jong ngi . Ngim kwah ban ïohsngew shaphang U Blei Bakhuid jong phi ki Israel .

translation.en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses : and I will call for the corn , and will increase it , and lay no famine upon you .
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa phi na kata baroh kaba pyntngit ïa phi . Ngan hukum ïa u kew ba un bun kyrhai , khnang ba phin ym mad shuh ïa ki jingïapthngan .

translation.en: And when the Gentiles heard this , they were glad , and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed .
translation.kha: Haba ki Jentil ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kmen bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , bad kito ïa kiba la jied na ka bynta ka jingim bymjukut ki la long ki riewngeit .

translation.en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death , we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection :
translation.kha: Naba naduh ba ngi la long kawei bad u ha ka jingïap kum ma u , ha kajuh ka rukom ngin ïalong kawei bad u ha ka jingmihpat kum ma u .

translation.en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he first bind the strong man ? and then he will spoil his house .
translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban phrung jubor shapoh ka ïing jong u briew uba khlaiñ bad kit noh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u lymda nyngkong eh u teh u khum shuwa ïa u briew uba khlaiñ , nangta u sa lah ban lute ïa ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood , so is my beloved among the sons . I sat down under his shadow with great delight , and his fruit was sweet to my taste .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingiw kaba iwbih shaphang jong phi ; ka jingsawa ka kyrteng jong phi ka pynkynmaw ïa kata . Ym don kano kano ka briew ka bym lah khlem da ieit ïa phi .

translation.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la ïohsngew ïa ki paidbah ba ki ïarisa bad u la ong ha u Moses ,  Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaleh thma ha ka jaka sher dara .

translation.en: The  Lord  is high above all nations , and his glory above the heavens .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u synshar halor ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka burom jong u ka don halor ki bneng .

translation.en: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the  Lord  have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree to flourish : I the  Lord  have spoken and have done it .
translation.kha: Baroh ki dieng kin tip ba nga long U  Trai . Nga khet ïa ki dieng bajrong bad nga pynlong ïa ki dieng rit ban san jrong . Nga pynïap stai ïa ki dieng bajyrngam bad pynlong ïa ki dieng ba-tyrkhong ban kylla jyrngam . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .

translation.en: Hath not the scripture said , That Christ cometh of the seed of David , and out of the town of Bethlehem , where David was ?
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Syiem Dabid bad yn kha ïa u ha Bethlehem , ka shnong ha kaba u Dabid u la im .

translation.en: Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest  ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u long uba hok , namar ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u . To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki briew hangno hangno ; to khmih ïa nga ha ka jingpang jong nga . Ki samla shynrang bad kynthei jong nga ki la shah ringmraw noh .

translation.en: And the man said unto Joab , Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand , yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king s son : for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai , saying , Beware that none touch the young man Absalom .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew u jubab ,  Wat la phi ai ïa nga shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , ngan ym rah iwei i shynriah ti pyrshah ïa u khun jong u syiem . Baroh ngi la ïohsngew ba u syiem u hukum ïa phi , ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Ittai , ‘ Na ka bynta jong nga wat pynmynsaw ïa u samla Absalom .’

translation.en: They say , If a man put away his wife , and she go from him , and become another man s , shall he return unto her again ? shall not that land be greatly polluted ? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers  ; yet return again to me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , bad ka iehnoh ïa u bad ka long noh ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , um dei ban shim pat ïa ka . Kane kan pyntngit lut ïa ka ri . Hynrei , ko Israel , pha la lah don shibun ki nongleh-ieit , bad mynta pha kwah ban wan phai sha nga !

translation.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the  Lord  , that I die not :
translation.kha: Bad lada nga dang im , sngewbha bat ïa la ka kular bakyntang bad ïaineh skhem bad nga ; hynrei lada jia ba nga ïap ,

translation.en: Yea also , when he that is a fool walketh by the way , his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool .
translation.kha: Ka jingmutlop jong u ka paw wat ha ki nongwei kiba u ïakynduh ha ka lynti ; u ailad ïa iwei pa iwei ban tip ba u dei u bieit .

translation.en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea , very much , until he left numbering  ; for it was without number .
translation.kha: La don kyrhai eh u kew kat haduh ba u Joseph um donkam shuh ban da thew ïa u — u la long kum u shyiap ka duriaw .

translation.en: And said to his servant , Go up now , look toward the sea . And he went up , and looked , and said , There is nothing . And he said , Go again seven times .
translation.kha: U ong ïa la u shakri ,  Khie leit peit shaphang ka duriaw .  U shakri u leit bad u wan phai bad u ong ,  Ngam ïohi ei ei .  Hynñiew sien u Elijah u ong ïa u ban leit bad ban peit .

translation.en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers , and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt , and with an high arm brought he them out of it .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ki paid Israel u la jied ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad u la pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw ïa une u paid ha ka por ba ki la im kum ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt . U Blei u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor bakhraw jong u ,

translation.en: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong , whom ye see and know : yea , the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bor jong ka kyrteng jong u kaba la ai jingkhlaiñ ïa une u briew uba dkoh . Ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi bad tip , la leh da ka jingngeit ha ka kyrteng jong u ; ka long ka jingngeit ha U Jisu kaba la pynkhiah ïa u , kumba phi baroh phi ïohi .

translation.en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan , and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground , until all the people were passed clean over Jordan .
translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïaid sha shiliang ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ki ïeng ha ka dewryngkhiang hapdeng jong ka Jordan tad haduh ba uta u paidbah un da jam sha shiliang .

translation.en: And she said unto her father , Let this thing be done for me : let me alone two months , that I may go up and down upon the mountains , and bewail my virginity , I and my fellows .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ong ha la u kpa ,  To leh kane kawei ïa nga . Ai por ïa nga ar bnai ba ngan ïoh leit sha ki lum bad la ki paralok , ban ïa-ïam sngewsih ba nga dei ban ïap kum kaba dang sotti .

translation.en: For our God is a consuming fire .
translation.kha: namar ba U Blei jong ngi u long shisha ka ding kaba bam duh .

translation.en: And king David said to Ornan , Nay  ; but I will verily buy it for the full price : for I will not take that which is thine for the  Lord  , nor offer burnt offerings without cost .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Syiem u jubab ,  Em , ngan siew ha me ïa ka dor ba-pura . Ngan ym ai kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai  ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong me , da kaei kaba shu ïoh ei .

translation.en: Now we command you , brethren , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly , and not after the tradition which he received of us .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi hukum ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ban kiar noh na ki bangeit baroh kiba im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba ngi ai ha ki .

translation.en: And hope maketh not ashamed ; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingkyrmen ka ai ha ngi ka jingkmen , namar U Blei u la theh noh ïa ka jingieit jong u ha ki dohnud jong ngi lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba long ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei ïa ngi .

translation.en: Judge in yourselves : is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered ?
translation.kha: To bishar hi da lade la ka long kaba dei ïa ka briew ban duwai ha U Blei ha ka jingïamane lang khlem da tap ïa la ka khlieh .

translation.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee , and bring thee in unto the Amorites , and the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites : and I will cut them off .
translation.kha: U angel jong nga un leit ha shuwa jong phi bad un ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri jong ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus ; bad ngan pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed , that could deliver his people out of mine hand , that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno napdeng ki blei jong kito ki ri baroh , kiba lah ban pyllait ïa la ka ri na ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U Blei jong phi un pynim ïa phi ?

translation.en: Then he said unto him , Come home with me , and eat bread .
translation.kha: Wan ngin ïaleit sha ïing ban ïabam jingbam bad nga ,  u ong .

translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear  ; for it came of God , that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait ban shahshkor . Ka dei ka mon U Blei ba U Amasaïah un shahjop , namar ba u la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki nong Edom .

translation.en: Cast out the scorner , and contention shall go out  ; yea , strife and reproach shall cease .
translation.kha: Phet noh na u briew uba shukor , bad nangta yn ym don shuh ki jingïakajia , ka jingïamai lane ka jingsin kyrteng .

translation.en: Thou shalt stand abroad , and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee .
translation.kha: ap habar bad ieh un da wallam hi ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the king s house of Judah  ; Thou art Gilead unto me , and the head of Lebanon : yet surely I will make thee a wilderness , and cities which are not inhabited .
translation.kha: Ha nga , ka ïingsyiem Judah ka long kaba itynnat kum ka ri Gilead , bad kum ki lumbah Lebanon ; hynrei ngan pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka kynjah ha kaba yn ym don bashong basah .

translation.en: Watch therefore : for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come .
translation.kha: To sumar , te , namar ba phim tip ha kano ka sngi ba U Trai jong phi un wan .

translation.en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . ) And Jehu said , If it be your minds , then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram uba dang don ha Jesreel , ha kaba u la leit ban ïoh jingkoit na ki jingmong kiba u la ïoh ha ka thma ha Ramoth pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Kumta u Jehu u la ong ha ki para rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Lada phi don bad nga , pynthikna ba uwei ruh na phi un ym leit noh na Ramoth bad maham ïa ki briew jong ka Jesreel .

translation.en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well ; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better .
translation.kha: Kumta u briew uba shongkurim u leh ïa kaba dei , hynrei uta u bym shongkurim u leh ïa kaba kham bha .

translation.en: The king s heart is in the hand of the  Lord  , as the rivers of water : he turneth it whithersoever he will .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynïaid ïa ka jingmut jong u syiem kham suk kumba u pynïaid ïa ka lynti ka wahduid .

translation.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang im , ka trei ban pynbha bad ym ban pynsniew ïa u .

translation.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him , Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high , and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon : then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet . And the thing pleased Haman  ; and he caused the gallows to be made .
translation.kha: Kumta ka tnga jong u bad ki paralok jong u baroh ki ai jingmut ,  Balei ba phim shna da ka diengphasi kaba arphew ar mitar ka jingjrong ? La shai mynstep phi lah ban ong ïa u syiem ban sdien ïa u Mordekai halor jong ka , bad nangta sa leit sha ka jingkhawai da kaba kmen .  U Haman u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long kaba dei , kumta u la phah thaw ïa ka diengphasi .

translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? therefore they shall be your judges .
translation.kha: Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor ban leh kumta . Ñiuma , te , mano ba ai ha ki briew jong phi ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ? Kaei kaba ki briew jong phi hi ki leh ka pynshisha ba phi bakla !

translation.en: For then will I turn to the people a pure language , that they may all call upon the name of the  Lord  , to serve him with one consent .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan pynkylla ïa ki briew jong ki hima , bad kin duwai tang sha nga bad ym sha kiwei pat ki blei . Ki baroh kin kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks ? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich ?
translation.kha: Haduh katno ki thapniang jong ka Ostrit ki kaweh stet ! Hynrei ym don kano kano ka Ostrit kaba lah ban her kum ka thring .

translation.en: Don't worry .
translation.kha: Wat khuslai .

translation.en: Then I commanded , and they cleansed the chambers : and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God , with the meat offering and the frankincense .
translation.kha: Nga ai hukum ban leh ka jinglehniam jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa ki kamra bad ïa ki tiar ki tar ka Templ , jingkñia jingbam , bad ki jingiwbih ban buh pat hangta .

translation.en: Arise , and let us go by night , and let us destroy her palaces .
translation.kha: Ngin tur ïaleh mynmiet ; ngin pynjot ïa ki kut jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: O Lord , righteousness belongeth unto thee , but unto us confusion of faces , as at this day  ; to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and unto all Israel , that are near , and that are far off , through all the countries whither thou hast driven them , because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee .
translation.kha: Ma me ko Trai , me leh borabor ïa kaba dei , hynrei borabor ngi la wallam ka jingjahburom ha lade hi . Kane ka long kaba shisha ïa baroh na ngi kiba shong basah ha Judia bad ha Jerusalem bad jong baroh ki khun Israel ïa kiba me la pynsakma ha ki ri kiba jan bad kiba jngai namar ki la long ki bymïaineh ha me .

translation.en: And they fell upon their faces , and said , O God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses bad u Aaron ki dem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ong ,  A Blei , me , me long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh . Haba uwei na ngi u leh pop , hato men shu bitar lep ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ?

translation.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi haba ki lumbah ki twa bad ki mawsiang baskhem ki kynriah noh .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask of you one question , and answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ïa nga ïa ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ïa phi da kaei ka hok ba nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand , that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father .
translation.kha: Mar ïasngewskhem ha ka bor , u Amasaïah u pynïap ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïap ïa u kpa jong u , uba long u syiem .

translation.en: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect . For they are not all Israel , which are of Israel :
translation.kha: Ngam ong ba ka kular jong U Blei kam shym la treikam ; namar ym baroh ki paid Israel ki long ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Zimri went in and smote him , and killed him , in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Simri u rung hapoh ïing bad u la pynïap ïa u Elah , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u . Kane ka jia ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah .

translation.en: And this is the thing that ye shall do , Ye shall utterly destroy every male , and every woman that hath lain by man .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa baroh ki shynrang , bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ka bym dei shuh ka theisotti .

translation.en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee , the fir tree , the pine tree , and the box together , to beautify the place of my sanctuary  ; and I will make the place of my feet glorious .
translation.kha: Ïa ki dieng jong u dieng Kseh , u dieng Kseh-Juniper , bad u dieng Kseh-Sypress , ki dieng kiba kynsai tam jong ka khlaw Lebanon yn wallam ban tei biang ïa pha , ko Jerusalem , ban pynitynnat ïa ka Templ jong nga , ban pyndonburom ïa ka nongbah jong nga .

translation.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery , even thy truth , O my God : unto thee will I sing with the harp , O thou Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Da shisha ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka duitara ; ngan ïaroh ïa ka jingïaineh jong me , A Blei jong nga . Ha ka duitara jong nga ngan tem ïa ki jingrwai sha me , Uta Uba Khuid ki Israel .

translation.en: His heart is as firm as a stone  ; yea , as hard as a piece of the nether millstone .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud maw jong u kam ju don jingsheptieng , kaba eh tasam kum u mawtylliat .

translation.en: Arise ye , and depart  ; for this is not your rest : because it is polluted , it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit bad mihnoh ; naba ym don shuh ka jingshngain hangne . Ki pop jong phi ki la long jingtim sha ka jingpynjot ïa kane ka jaka .

translation.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day : and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , thou knowest very well .
translation.kha: To U Trai un ai ïa ka jinglehisynei ha u ha kata ka Sngi ! Bad phi tip shai kdar katno ba u la leh na ka bynta jong nga ha Ephesos .

translation.en: But the high places were not removed : nevertheless Asa s heart was perfect with the  Lord  all his days .
translation.kha: Wat la u Asa um shym la pynjot lut ïa ki jaka mane blei thala baroh , u ïaineh ha U  Trai  katba u dang im .

translation.en: In the day that thy walls are to be built , in that day shall the decree be far removed .
