translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , ka por ban tei pat ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah ka la poi . Ha kata ka por ïa ka ri jong phi yn pynïar .

translation.en: And sow the fields , and plant vineyards , which may yield fruits of increase .
translation.kha: Ki rep lyngkha bad ki thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki lum ka jingot kaba dap kyrhai .

translation.en: The sons of Mushi  ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .
translation.kha: U Mushi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mahli , u Eder , bad u Jeremoth .

translation.en: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant , and unto the supplication of thy people Israel , to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee .
translation.kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to peit ieit borabor sha ki briew jong me ki Israel bad u syiem jong ki , bad to sngap ïa ka jingduwai jong ki ha man ba ki kyrpad jingïarap na me .

translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus , and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad .
translation.kha: Ngan pynpluh ïa ki kynroh jong ka Damaskos da ka ding bad yn thang khoit ïa ki ïingsyiem jong u syiem Benhadad . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .

translation.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: But when they sought to lay hands on him , they feared the multitude , because they took him for a prophet .
translation.kha: kumta ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u . Hynrei ki la sngewsheptieng ïa u paidbah , uba la ñiew ba U Jisu u dei u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And when Saul enquired of the  Lord  , the  Lord  answered him not , neither by dreams , nor by Urim , nor by prophets .
translation.kha: bad kumta u la kylli ïa U  Trai  kaei ba un leh . Hynrei U  Trai  um shym jubab ei ei ïa u , la ha ki jingphohsniew , lane da u Urim bad u Thummim , lane da ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Then Peter said , Silver and gold have I none  ; but such as I have give I thee : In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ngam don pisa ei ei , hynrei nga ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga don : Ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth nga hukum ïa me ban ïeng joit bad ïaid !

translation.en: By the breath of God frost is given : and the breadth of the waters is straitened .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong U Blei ka pyndait thah ïa ki um , bad ka pynkylla thah ïa ki .

translation.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover , in the feast day , many believed in his name , when they saw the miracles which he did .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang don ha Jerusalem ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , shibun ki la ngeit ha u haba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .

translation.en: And when they were escaped , then they knew that the island was called Melita .
translation.kha: a Jinglamphrang Ïa  Ka Shithi U Paul Sha Ki Nong Rom  la thoh ban pynkhreh lynti ïa ka jingthmu u Paul ban leit khmih ïa ka Balang ha Rom . Ka jingthmu jong u ka long ban trei hapdeng ki Khristan kiba don hangta katto katne por bad nangta , da ka jingkyrshan jong ki , ban leit sha Spain . U la thoh ban batai ïa ka jingsngewthuh jong u ïa ka jingngeit Khristan bad ka jingpyntreikam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingim Khristan . Ka shithi ka don ha ka ïa ka jingïathuh ba-dap pura shaphang ka khubor jong u Paul . Hadien ba u la ai khublei ïa kiba ha ka balang ha Rom bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa ka jingduwai jong u na ka bynta jong ki , u Paul u ïathuh ïa ka phangpdeng jong ka shithi :  Naba ka Gospel ka pynpaw kumno U Blei u pynlong ïa ki briew ban don ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U hi : ka long lyngba ka jingngeit naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut  (

translation.en: But it shall be on the seventh day , that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows , even all his hair he shall shave off : and he shall wash his clothes , also he shall wash his flesh in water , and he shall be clean .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un khi biang ïa la u  ñiuhkhlieh , u  ñiuhtmoh , u  ñiuhmat , bad u shñiuh baroh na ka met jong u ; un sait ruh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad un sum un sleh de , bad nangta un sa long uba khuid .

translation.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and cleave to his wife  ;
translation.kha: ‘ Bad na kane ka daw , u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie bad ïaineh bad la ka tnga ,

translation.en: And , behold , your eyes see , and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you .
translation.kha: U Joseph u bteng ,  Mynta , phi baroh , bad phi ruh , Benjamin , phi ïohi ba nga dei shisha u Joseph uba kren ha phi .

translation.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory ; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves .
translation.kha: Wat leh ei ei na ka jingkhwan myntoi lane na ka jingkwah bymmyntoi ban sngewsarong , hynrei , to long kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei pat , kiba ñiew borabor ïa kiwei kiba kham bha ban ïa lade .

translation.en: And Saul arose from the earth  ; and when his eyes were opened , he saw no man : but they led him by the hand , and brought him into Damascus .
translation.kha: U Saul u la khie joit na madan bad u la peit , hynrei um lah ban ïohi ei ei . Kumta ki la shim ïa u na ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha Damaskos .

translation.en: Is any thing too hard for the  Lord  ? At the time appointed I will return unto thee , according to the time of life , and Sarah shall have a son .
translation.kha: Hato don kaei kaei kaba eh ïa U  Trai  ? Kumba nga la ong , ngan sa wan biang hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah kan sa ïoh khun shynrang .

translation.en: Israel was holiness unto the  Lord  , and the firstfruits of his increase : all that devour him shall offend  ; evil shall come upon them , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha long tang ka jong nga hi ; pha long ka jingdon bakyntang jong nga . Nga la phah ka jingshitom bad ka jingpynjot ha uwei pa uwei uba pynmong ïa pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan ,  u ong .  Kan long ka jingïohkynti jong phi hi .

translation.en: Then if any man shall say unto you , Lo , here is Christ , or there  ; believe it not .
translation.kha: Nangta , lada uno uno u ong ha phi , ‘ Ha khmih , hangne U don U Messaïah !’ lane ‘ U don hangtai !’ — wat ngeit ïa kata .

translation.en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai , and spakest with them from heaven , and gavest them right judgments , and true laws , good statutes and commandments :
translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai me wan hiar na bneng ; me kren ha ki briew bad me ai ïa ki , ki hukum babha bad ki jinghikai baskhem .

translation.en: And they caught him , and cast him out of the vineyard , and slew him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa u , bad ki la bret ïa u shabar ka bri sohwaiñ , bad ki la pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la jia ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar .

translation.en: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you , and ye in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka kyrteng jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na phi , bad ma phi na u , da ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi bad jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai .

translation.en: And she said , Truth , Lord : yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters  table .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha , ko Kynrad ,  ka la jubab ;  hynrei wat ki ksew ki ïabam ïa kiba sah tam kiba hap na ka miej u kynrad jong ki .

translation.en: Rejoice in the Lord alway : and again I say , Rejoice .
translation.kha: Ai ba phin shadkmen borabor ha U Trai ; nga ban biang ïa ka : To ïakmen .

translation.en: They shewed his signs among them , and wonders in the land of Ham .
translation.kha: Ki la leh ïa ki kam kiba donbor jong U Blei bad leh ïa ki kambah ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And Ziklag , and Beth–marcaboth , and Hazar–susah ,
translation.kha: ka Siklag , ka Beth Markaboth , ka Hasar Susah ,

translation.en: The plain also , and Jordan , and the coast thereof , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , under Ashdoth–pisgah eastward .
translation.kha: Shaphang sepngi , ka ri jong ki ka poi haduh wah Jordan , naduh ka pung Galilaïa shaphang shatei , arsut haduh ka Duriaw Baïap shaphang shathie , bad nangta shaduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples , he gave them power against unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u bad u la ai ha ki ka iktiar ban beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymman bad ban pynkhiah ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingpang bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshitom .

translation.en: Be not a terror unto me : thou art my hope in the day of evil .
translation.kha: Wat ym long ka jingshyrkhei ïa nga ; me long ka jaka shngain jong nga haba ka jingjynjar ka wan .

translation.en: Moreover thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Shall they fall , and not arise ? shall he turn away , and not return ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Haba uno uno u kyllon , hato un ym ïeng pat ? Lada uno uno u bakla lynti , hato un ym wan phai pat ?

translation.en: As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear  ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long khlem jingïarap ha khmat u nongsynshar uba sniew ; u long uba shyrkhei kum u sing uba kyrhuh ne ka dngiem kaba tur .

translation.en: Then said I , Whither goest thou ? And he said unto me , To measure Jerusalem , to see what is the breadth thereof , and what is the length thereof .
translation.kha: Shano phin leit ?  nga la kylli .  Ban thew ïa ka Jerusalem ,  u la jubab ,  ban ïohi katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingïar jong ka .

translation.en: I will run the way of thy commandments , when thou shalt enlarge my heart .
translation.kha: Ngan kohnguh da kaba angnud eh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar men ai shuh shuh ka jingshemphang ïa nga .

translation.en: Did you have lunch ?
translation.kha: Phi la dep bam ja shiteng sngi ?

translation.en: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom ; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u ai ha uwei ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingstad , katba ha uwei pat , ujuh U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingtip .

translation.en: For if a man think himself to be something , when he is nothing , he deceiveth himself .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u mut ba u long ei ei haba da shisha um long ei ei , u long tang u nongshukor ïa lade .

translation.en: O my God , incline thine ear , and hear  ; open thine eyes , and behold our desolations , and the city which is called by thy name : for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses , but for thy great mercies .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ngi , A Blei ; to khmih sha ngi , bad peit ïa ka jingjynjar kaba ngi don bad ïa ka jingshah shitom jong ka nongbah kaba kit ïa ka kyrteng jong me . Ngi duwai ha me namar ba me long uba dap da ka jingisynei , ym namar ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields , and make an atonement for the house : and it shall be clean .
translation.kha: Nangta un pyllait ïa kata ka sim ba kan her noh shabar ka nongbah kat shaba ka mon . Da kumta un pyndep ïa ka niam ka rukom kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing , bad kan sa long kaba khuid .

translation.en: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering , the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel : but the  Lord  thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines , and discomfited them  ; and they were smitten before Israel .
translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u dang ai ïa ka jingkñia , ki Philistia ki tur sha jan ban ïaleh ; hynrei hangta U  Trai  u kyrhuh kum u pyrthat na bneng pyrshah ïa ki . Ki la shaïong ngaiñ , bad ki la phet krad ha ka jingkulmar .

translation.en: And if they will learn any thing , let them ask their husbands at home : for it is a shame for women to speak in the church .
translation.kha: Lada ki kwah ban tip ei ei shaphang kano kano , ki dei ban kylli ha la ki tnga ha ïing . Ka long kaba i jahburom ïa ka kynthei ban kren ha ka jingïaseng .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha u Moses , ban ong ha ki kynhun Israel ,

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , We speak that we do know , and testify that we have seen  ; and ye receive not our witness .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ngi kren ïa kaei kaba ngi tip bad ngi ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ngi la ïohi , pynban , ym don na phi uba mon ban pdiang ïa ka khubor jong ngi .

translation.en: If thine enemy be hungry , give him bread to eat  ; and if he be thirsty , give him water to drink :
translation.kha: Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , bsa ïa u ; lada u sliang , ai um ba un dih .

translation.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded : and as I prophesied , there was a noise , and behold a shaking , and the bones came together , bone to his bone .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba la bthah ïa nga . Katba nga dang kren , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kum ka jingkhih shane shatai , bad ki shyieng ki la sdang ban ïadait lang .

translation.en: By a new and living way , which he hath consecrated for us , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh  ;
translation.kha: U la plie namar jong ngi ïa ka lynti kaba thymmai , ka lynti kaba im , lyngba kata ka jingkah — kata ka long , lyngba ka met jong u hi .

translation.en: Let thy servant , I pray thee , turn back again , that I may die in mine own city , and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother . But behold thy servant Chimham  ; let him go over with my lord the king  ; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee .
translation.kha: Nangta shah ba ngan leit phai pat sha ïing bad ban ïap hajan ka jingtep jong i mei bad i pa jong nga . Une hangne u Shimham , u khun jong nga , u ban shakri ïa phi ; shim ïa u bad phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ; bad leh na ka bynta jong u katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .

translation.en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs , and found a wild vine , and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full , and came and shred them into the pot of pottage : for they knew them not .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u leit sha lyngkha ban ïoh katto katne ki jhur . U lap uwei u jyrmi khlaw bad u kheit bun tylli ki klong katba u lah ban kit . U la wanrah ïa ki bad ot dkhot ïa ki hapoh ka syrwa , khlem da tip ki dei kiba kumno .

translation.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , whom she bare unto Saul , Armoni and Mephibosheth  ; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul , whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite :
translation.kha: Pynban , u la shim ïa u Armoni bad ïa u Mephibosheth , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Rispah , ka khun u Aïah , ba ka la ïoh na u Saul ; u shim ruh ïa ki san ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Merab , ka khun jong u Saul , ba ka la ïoh na u Adriel u khun jong u Barsillai uba na Meholah .

translation.en: And Judah went up  ; and the  Lord  delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand : and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men .
translation.kha: bad Judah ki la leit ryngkat sha ka thma . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki ka jingjop halor ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad ki la jop ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Besek .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim :
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ki la sdang ban shakri ïa ki Baal .

translation.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat , Azariah , and Jehiel , and Zechariah , and Azariah , and Michael , and Shephatiah : all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoram , u khun jong u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u don hynriew ngut ki para shynrang : u Asaraïah , u Jehiel , u Sekharaïah , u Asaraïahu , u Mikhael , bad u Shephataïah .

translation.en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment  ; and a babbler is no better .
translation.kha: Kaba tip kumno ban pynshohbieit ïa u bseiñ ka long ka bymdonkam lada phi shah ïa u bseiñ ban puh nyngkong .

translation.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei , ïa baroh la pynlong ka hok bad u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki .

translation.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship , and humility , and neglecting of the body ; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh .
translation.kha: Da shisha kiba kum kine ki kyndon ki i kumba la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingstad ha ka jingmane ba shu pynbor ïa ki angel , bad ka jingsngewrit bymdei , bad ka jingleh palat ïa ka met ; hynrei ki bymdondor ei ei ha kaba synshar ïa ki jingbrai ka doh .

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons , and consecrate them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri ïa nga .

translation.en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb , and by his strength he had power with God :
translation.kha: U kpa tymmen jong ki u Jakob u la ïaleh ïa u hynmen synrap jong u , u Iso , katba baroh ar ngut ki dang don hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong ki ; haba u Jakob u la nang san , u ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei —

translation.en: And thou , O tower of the flock , the strong hold of the daughter of Zion , unto thee shall it come , even the first dominion  ; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Bad ma pha , ko Jerusalem , ha kaba U Blei , kum u nongaplangbrot , u sumar ïa la ki briew , phan long pat sa shisien ka nongbah jong ka hima kaba la ju long ka jong pha .

translation.en: This is my covenant , which ye shall keep , between me and you and thy seed after thee  ; Every man child among you shall be circumcised .
translation.kha: Ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ki dei ban mynjur ban otsher ïa uwei pa uwei u khunlung hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook , and as the stream of brooks they pass away  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei phi , ko paralok jong nga , phi shukor ïa nga kum ki wahduid kiba ju rngad noh ha bym don slap .

translation.en: Tom asked me a lot of questions that I couldn't answer .
translation.kha: U Tom u kylli ianga bun ki jingkylli kiba ngam lah jubab .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat klim .

translation.en: And Saul said unto his uncle , He told us plainly that the asses were found . But of the matter of the kingdom , whereof Samuel spake , he told him not .
translation.kha: U ïathuh ïa ngi ba la lap ïa ki kada ,  u Saul u jubab — hynrei um shym ïathuh ha u kñi jong u ïa kaei kaba u Samuel u la kren shaphang ka jingpynlong Syiem ïa u .

translation.en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God , and said , Behold , if the  Lord  would make windows in heaven , might this thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
translation.kha: U nongbud ba-hajan jong u syiem u la ong ha u Elisha ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  U Elisha u jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: Of the sons of Izhar  ; Shelomith the chief .
translation.kha: U Ishar , u khun uba ar jong u Kohath , u don u khun , u Shelomith , u khlieh jong ka kur .

translation.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil  ; and he departed out of him : and the child was cured from that very hour .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u ksuid , bad u la mihnoh shabar jong u khynnah , bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa u .

translation.en: That thou givest them they gather : thou openest thine hand , they are filled with good .
translation.kha: Me ai ïa ka ha ki , bad ki bam ïa ka , me pynbiang jingbam , bad ki sngewhun .

translation.en: And a stone of stumbling , and a rock of offence , even to them which stumble at the word , being disobedient : whereunto also they were appointed .
translation.kha: Bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Une u long u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin kyllon .  Ki la jynthut namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka ktien , katta ka la long ka mon U Blei ïa ki .

translation.en: And Noah went forth , and his sons , and his wife , and his sons  wives with him :
translation.kha: Kumta u Noah lem bad la ka tnga , bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki tnga jong ki , ki la ïamih shabar na kata ka lieng .

translation.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt , to drink the waters of Sihor ? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria , to drink the waters of the river ?
translation.kha: Kaei me pyrkhat ba men ïoh da kaba leit sha Ijipt ban dih um na ka Nile ? Kaei me pyrkhat ba men ïoh da kaba leit sha Assyria ban dih um na ka Ïuphratis ?

translation.en: ( 2 ) His miracles proved that he was God’s Son .
translation.kha: ( 2 ) Ki kambah jong u ki pynshisha ba u long u Khun U Blei .

translation.en: Which is his body , the fulness of him that filleth all in all .
translation.kha: Ka Balang ka long ka met U Khrist , kaba pyndap pura ïa u , uba da lade hi u pyndap pura ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kylleng ki jaka .

translation.en: And I will make thee swear by the  Lord  , the God of heaven , and the God of the earth , that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I dwell :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa me ban pynlong ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew , ba men ym jied ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga na ki briew hangne ha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Rise , take up thy bed , and walk .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to ïaid .

translation.en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days  ; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths :
translation.kha: Ki Israel baroh ki dei ban shong hynñiew sngi ha ki ïingtrep ,

translation.en: And it came to pass in the month Nisan , in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king , that wine was before him : and I took up the wine , and gave it unto the king . Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , saw bnai hadien , haba u patsha Artakserksis u dang shong bam , nga leit rah ïa ka waiñ sha u . Um pat ju ïohi ïa nga ba nga imat sngewsih mynshuwa ,

translation.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same : all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Ki shylluit , ki tnat , bad u diengpynïeng sharak ki dei ban long kiba ïadait lang kawei bad kiba la shu shoh da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And they cast lots , as well the small as the great , according to the house of their fathers , for every gate .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka longïing , la ka heh ne ka rit , ka kynting sbai ban tip ïa kano ka khyrdop ka kitkhlieh .

translation.en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa pha kum ïa u phlangïap uba la beh noh da ka lyer ri shyiap .

translation.en: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year , and it shall bring forth fruit for three years .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew ha ka snem kaba hynriew khnang ba kan pynmih bam kyrhai na ka bynta ar snem .

translation.en: Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?
translation.kha: Balei ba ma phi ruh phi pynshitom ïa nga kumba U Blei u leh ? Hato phim shym la pynshitom la biang ïa nga ?

translation.en: Who among you will give ear to this ? who will hearken and hear for the time to come ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi un sngap ïa kane ? Naduh mynta hato phin shahshkor bha ?

translation.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year , not without blood , which he offered for himself , and for the errors of the people :
translation.kha: hynrei tang u rangbah lyngdoh uba rung sha ka bynta kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad u leh kumta tang shisien shisnem . U rah bad u ïa ka snam ïa kaba u ainguh ha U Blei na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki pop ba ki briew ki leh khlem sngewthuh ba ki la leh pop .

translation.en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the  Lord  rest , and Moab shall be trodden down under him , even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïada ïa u Lum Seïon , hynrei ki briew jong ka Moab kin shah ïuhroit , kumba ïa u phlangïap la ïuh haba shna sboh .

translation.en: For the  Lord  your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you , until ye were passed over , as the  Lord  your God did to the Red sea , which he dried up from before us , until we were gone over :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynrngad ïa ka um jong ka Jordan na ka bynta jong phi haduh ba phin da la jam sha shiliang , kumba u la pynrngad ïa ka Duriaw Basaw na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions  ; her judges are evening wolves  ; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ka ki long kum ki sing bakyrhuh ; ki nongbishar jong ka ki long kum ki suri bathngan , kiba lalot eh kat ban pynsah sa tang ka shyieng haduh mynstep .

translation.en: But after that faith is come , we are no longer under a schoolmaster .
translation.kha: Mynta ba ka por ka jingngeit ka la poi , ka Hukum kam donbor shuh halor jong ngi .

translation.en: And he was sore athirst , and called on the  Lord  , and said , Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant : and now shall I die for thirst , and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised ?
translation.kha: Nangta , u Samson u la sliang um palat , kumta u kyrpad ïa U  Trai  bad u ong ,  Me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka jingjop kaba khraw ; hato ngan shu ïap mynta na ka jingsliang um bad ban hap ha ki kti jong kine ki Philistia bymngeit ?

translation.en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons , and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat .
translation.kha: Namar ba la palat ka jingthngan , phin hap bam sa ïa la ki jong ki khun .

translation.en: Let the priests , the ministers of the  Lord  , weep between the porch and the altar , and let them say , Spare thy people , O  Lord  , and give not thine heritage to reproach , that the heathen should rule over them : wherefore should they say among the people , Where is their God ?
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh , kiba shakri ïa U  Trai hapdeng ka duwan bad ka jaka rung ka Templ , ki dei ban ïam bad duwai :  To isynei ïa la ki briew , A  Trai . To wat ai ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi da kaba ong , ‘ Hangno U Blei jong phi ?’

translation.en: The burden upon Arabia . In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge , O ye travelling companies of Dedanim .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Arabia . Phi ki briew jong ka Dedan , kiba ki kynhun leit jingleit jong phi ki shong dara ha ka rudnong bashrah jong ka Arabia ,

translation.en: But when I speak with thee , I will open thy mouth , and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; He that heareth , let him hear  ; and he that forbeareth , let him forbear : for they are a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Nangta haba nga kren biang ïa me bad ai biang ha me ïa ka bor ban kren , men ïathuh ïa ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Don na ki , ki ban sngap , hynrei don na ki , ki bym leh salia ïa me , naba ki long ka jaitbynriew jong ki nongïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth : but the righteous are bold as a lion .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki phet ha bym don ba beh ïa ki , hynrei u briew uba hok u shlur kum u sing .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , that the hand of the Lord  God  fell there upon me .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba hynriew , jong ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , ki rangbah kiba la shah ringmraw na Judah ki ïashong bad nga ha ka ïing jong nga . Kynsan kynsan ka bor jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar ka la wan halor jong nga .

translation.en: And there are differences of administrations , but the same Lord .
translation.kha: Don bun jait ki rukom shakri , hynrei ïa ujuh U Trai la shakri .

translation.en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air  ; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven , from the throne , saying , It is done .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynñiew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha suiñ . Ka sur kaba jam ka la wan na ka khet kaba ha ka templ , ka da ong ,  La pyndep !

translation.en: And Ziklag , and Madmannah , and Sansannah ,
translation.kha: ka Siklag , ka Madmannah , ka Sansannah ,

translation.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings , he took Peter and John and James , and went up into a mountain to pray .
translation.kha: Kumba shi taïew hadien ba u la kren ïa kine kiei kiei , U Jisu u la ïalam lem bad u ïa u Petros , u Ïoannis bad ïa u Jakob bad leit sha u lum ban duwai .

translation.en: Command the children of Israel , and say unto them , My offering , and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire , for a sweet savour unto me , shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season .
translation.kha: ban hikai ïa ki Israel ban wanrah sha U Blei ha ki por ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh bam badonkam kiba pynsngewbha ïa u .

translation.en: And Amnon said unto Tamar , Bring the meat into the chamber , that I may eat of thine hand . And Tamar took the cakes which she had made , and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ka ,  Wallam ïa kito ki kpu hangne ha ka jingthiah jong nga bad pyntian ïa nga da ma phi hi .  Ka la shim ïa ki kpu bad ka la leit sha u .

translation.en: And when I was present with you , and wanted , I was chargeable to no man : for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied : and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you , and so will I keep myself .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka por ba nga la don bad phi , ngam shym la pynkhuslai ïa phi ban ïarap haba nga la donkam pisa ; ki parabangeit kiba la wan na Makedonia ki la wanrah sha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la donkam . Kum ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta ruh ha ka lawei : Da lei lei ngan ym bankhia ïa phi !

translation.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people , and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled , as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel in the day of battle : the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children .
translation.kha: ka thma kan sa wan ha ki briew jong phi , bad ïa ki kut jong phi baroh yn pynjot . Kan long kum ka sngi ha kaba u syiem Shalman u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah Betharbel ha ka thma , ha kaba ïa ki kmie bad ki khun jong ki la pynlwet haduh ban da ïap .

translation.en: Is not the whole land before thee ? separate thyself , I pray thee , from me : if thou wilt take the left hand , then I will go to the right  ; or if thou depart to the right hand , then I will go to the left .
translation.kha: Kumta te to ngin ïakhlad noh . Jied ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri kaba me mon . Me leit shawei , bad nga ngan leit shawei pat .

translation.en: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe  ; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times  ; and be thou ravished always with her love .
translation.kha: kaba itynnat bad shongkhia kum ka skei . Ai ba ki jingitynnat jong ka kin pynkmen ïa phi ; ai ba kan ker sawdong ïa phi da ka jingieit jong ka .

translation.en: But now , because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger  ; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity :
translation.kha: Me pyrkhat ba U Blei un ym pynshitom , ba um da pynleit jingmut shaphang ka pop .

translation.en: Yea , all the people of the land shall bury them  ; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un ïarap lang ha kaba tep ïa ki , bad ïa ki yn ai burom na ka bynta kane , ha ka sngi jong ka jingjop thiaw jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth : and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingthmu jong nga ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka ïa ka kti jong nga la kner ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit , ye are not under the law .
translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem u ïalam ïa phi , te phim long shuh hapoh ka Hukum .

translation.en: Until the  Lord  removed Israel out of his sight , as he had said by all his servants the prophets . So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day .
translation.kha: haduh ha kaba khatduh U  Trai  u pyndam noh ïa ki na khmat jong u , kumba u la maham lyngba ki shakri jong u ki nongïathuhlypa , ba un leh kumta . Te ki paid Israel ki la shah pynryngkang par sha Assyria , ha kaba ki dang ïaisah hangta .

translation.en: And he received them at their hand , and fashioned it with a graving tool , after he had made it a molten calf : and they said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U la shim ïa kita ki sohshkor , u thang pynum ïa ki , u theh ïa ka ksiar ha ka tiar saiñdur , bad u thaw ïa ka dur u khun masi . Ki paidbah ki ïa-ong ,  Ko Israel , une u long u blei jong ngi , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !

translation.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban pynbeit ïano ïano ha kaba paw ban ïa kaba pynlong ïa u ban pyrkhat ba phim suidñiew satia ïa u .

translation.en: Beware that thou forget not the  Lord  thy God , in not keeping his commandments , and his judgments , and his statutes , which I command thee this day :
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; wat lyndet ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah , and his brethren , and all his sons , and the whole house of the Rechabites  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa ka kur Rekhab baroh kawei — u Jaasanaïah ( u khun jong uwei pat u Jeremaïah , uba dei u khun jong u Habassinaïah ) bad ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u bad ki khun shynrang jong u — bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Templ .

translation.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,
translation.kha: Ngan long shlur bad ngan kren tang shaphang kaei kaba U Khrist u la leh lyngba jong nga , ban ïalam ïa ki Jentil ban kohnguh ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa kane da ki ktien bad ki kam ,

translation.en: And two olive trees by it , one upon the right side of the bowl , and the other upon the left side thereof .
translation.kha: Don ar tylli ki dieng Olib hajan u diengpynïeng sharak , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u .

translation.en: Master , Moses wrote unto us , If a man s brother die , and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong ngi : ‘ Lada u briew u ïap bad u iehnoh ïa ka tnga khlem don khun , u para jong uta u briew u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka khnang ba ki lah ban don ki khun ïa kiba yn ñiew kum ki khun jong uta u briew uba la ïap .’

translation.en: Hereby ye shall be proved : By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence , except your youngest brother come hither .
translation.kha: Yn tynjuh ïa phi kumne : Nga smai ha ka kyrteng u syiem ba phin ym ïoh mihnoh na kane ka jaka lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan shane .

translation.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter , or concerning the treasures .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingbthah kiba u Dabid u la ai ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïadei bad ki ïing buh tiar bad kiwei kiwei ki kam la bud bniah .

translation.en: How long wilt thou not depart from me , nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle ?
translation.kha: Balei mem shu phai noh shawei tang shipor , ba ngan ïoh nguid ïa la ka umbiah ?

translation.en: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets , and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days . Thy dream , and the visions of thy head upon thy bed , are these  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei don U Blei ha bneng , uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan . U la pyntip ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka ban jia ha ka lawei . Mynta ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingphohsniew , ka jingïohipaw kaba phi lah ïoh mynba phi dang ïohthiah .

translation.en: Yet for love s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged , and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga ieit ïa me , nga pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad . Nga leh ïa kane wat la nga long u Paul , u nonglamktien jong U Khrist Jisu , bad mynta ruh u nongsah byndi na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: And now , I pray you , consider from this day and upward , from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Hato phim ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha phi ? Ha shuwa ba phin sdang ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ,

translation.en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon , Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark  ; for the oxen stumbled .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan sha ka jaka shoh kew ha Khidon , u masi u jynthut , bad u Ussah u kner ïa la ka kti bad u kyrshan ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang .

translation.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes , and make thy supplication to the Almighty  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei to phai mynta bad to ïasaid bad U Blei Badonbor Baroh ;

translation.en: Behold , I have told you before .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane ha shuwa ba ka por kan poi .

translation.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious ?
translation.kha: Lada kata ka Hukum , kaba wallam ïa ka jingïap haba la pyntreikam ïa ka , ka la wan ha kat kata ka burom , kaba katno tam ka burom kaba kham khraw ka long kata ka jingtrei jong U Mynsiem!

translation.en: Avoid it , pass not by it , turn from it , and pass away .
translation.kha: A wat leh ïa kata ! Kiar na ka kam bymman ! Kyntait ïa ka bad ïaid ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: That which is far off , and exceeding deep , who can find it out ?
translation.kha: Kumno uno uno un shem aïu ka jingim ka mut ? Ka long kaba jylliew eh ïa ngi , kaba eh than ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Woe unto us ! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods ? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Uei keiñ uba lah ban pyllait ïa ngi na kine ki blei kiba khlaiñbor ? Kine ki dei kita ki blei kiba la shoh ïap ïa ki Ijipt ha ka ri shyiap !

translation.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?
translation.kha: Te balei ba me wad bniah ïa baroh ki pop jong nga bad ïit lut ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingduna ba nga don ?

translation.en: He must increase , but I must decrease .
translation.kha: Ka dei ïa u ban long kham khraw katba ma nga , ngan long kham rit .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem , in the house of the  Lord  , before the new court ,
translation.kha: bad ma ki bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki ïalumlang ha ka phyllaw bathymmai jong ka Templ . U syiem Jehoshaphat u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad duwai jam ,

translation.en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium , we launched , meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia  ; one Aristarchus , a Macedonian of Thessalonica , being with us .
translation.kha: Ngi la kiew da ka lieng na Adramyttion kaba la khreh ban leit sha ki kadlieng jong ka probins    jong ka Asia , bad ngi la leit . U Aristarkhos , u nong Makedonia uba na Thessaloni , u la don lem bad ngi .

translation.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not : and doeth not good to the widow .
translation.kha: Kata ka jia namar u la lehbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei bad um ju pyn-i jingsbun ïa ki kynthei ki bym don khun .

translation.en: He was in the world , and the world was made by him , and the world knew him not .
translation.kha: U Ktien u la don ha ka pyrthei , bad wat la U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei da u , pynban , ka pyrthei kam shym la ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: Then said Jesus to them again ,  Peace be unto you : as my Father hath sent me , even so send I you .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong pat ha ki ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi . Kumba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga , kumta ruh nga phah ïa phi .

translation.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee , or abide by thy crib ?
translation.kha: Hato u masi prut un trei na ka bynta jong me ? Hato u mon ban pynlut ïa ka miet ha ka sem jong me ?

translation.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin , and defiled my horn in the dust .
translation.kha: Nga sngewsih bad nga phong da ki jaiñ khain , bad nga shong hangne ha u pui pui , ba la shahjop .

translation.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest , so is a faithful messenger to them that send him : for he refresheth the soul of his masters .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien uba lah ban shaniah u ai jinghun mynsiem ïa uta uba phah ïa u , kum ka umkhriat ha ka jingshit tyrha ha ka aïom ot .

translation.en: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh , nor the inhabitants of Beth–anath  ; but he dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh and of Beth–anath became tributaries unto them .
translation.kha: Ki jait Naphtali kim shym la beh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah Beth Shemesh bad ha Bethanath . Ki paid Naphtali ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka , hynrei ki la pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels , and them that transgress against me : I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn , and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan shim noh napdeng jong phi ïa kito kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba dap da ka pop . Ngan shim noh ïa ki na ki ri ha kaba ki shong ki sah mynta , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki ban wan phai pat sha ka ri Israel . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  unto this people , Thus have they loved to wander , they have not refrained their feet , therefore the  Lord  doth not accept them  ; he will now remember their iniquity , and visit their sins .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang kine ki briew ,  Ki ieit ban phet noh na nga , bad kin ym lah ban bat synshar ïa lade . Kumta ngam shym la sngewbha bad ki . Ngan kynmaw ïa ki jingbakla kiba ki la leh bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor  ; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not  ;
translation.kha: namar u la banbeiñ bad leh bymsuidñiew ïa kiba duk bad ba u knieh noh ïa ki ïing kiba kiwei ki la thaw ,

translation.en: But what think ye ? A certain man had two sons  ; and he came to the first , and said , Son , go work to day in my vineyard .
translation.kha: Mynta , phi pyrkhat aïu ? La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang . U la leit sha uba kham san bad u la ong , ‘ Ko khun , khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ mynta ka sngi .’

translation.en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel , Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea , a remnant shall be saved :
translation.kha: Bad U Isaïah u la pyrta shaphang ki Israel :  Wat lada ki paid Israel ki bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw , pynban tang khyndiat na ki yn pynim ;

translation.en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God : and this is that spirit of antichrist , whereof ye have heard that it should come  ; and even now already is it in the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba len ïa kane shaphang U Jisu , um don U Mynsiem na U Blei . U mynsiem ba u don , u long na u Nongshun jong U Khrist ; phi la ïohsngew ba un wan , bad mynta u la da don hangne ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Render unto them a recompence , O  Lord  , according to the work of their hands .
translation.kha: To pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh , A  Trai  ;

translation.en: And the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel , who is the father of Birzavith .
translation.kha: U Beraïah u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Heber bad u Malkhiel . ( U Malkhiel u seng ïa ka nongbah Birsaith . )

translation.en: And if I also ask you , ye will not answer me , nor let me go .
translation.kha: bad lada nga kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , phin ym jubab .

translation.en: Then came Eliakim , the son of Hilkiah , that was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph , the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rabshakeh .
translation.kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad leit bad ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaba u rangbah synshar Assyria u la ong .

translation.en: And ye shall compass the city , all ye men of war , and go round about the city once . Thus shalt thou do six days .
translation.kha: Ma me lem bad ki shipai jong me men ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah shisien shi sngi haduh hynriew sngi .

translation.en: For I have kept the ways of the  Lord  , and have not wickedly departed from my God .
translation.kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  ; Ngam shym la phai noh na U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: And David said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah , that ye should this day be adversaries unto me ? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel ? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para jong u ,  Mano ba pan ïa ka jingmut na phi ? Hato phi thmu ban pynwit ïa nga ? Mynta , nga dei ma nga u Syiem jong ka Israel bad ha kane ka sngi yn ym pynïap ïa uno uno ruh u Israel .

translation.en: Moreover all the chief of the priests , and the people , transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen  ; and polluted the house of the  Lord  which he had hallowed in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nalor kane , ki nongïalam ka Judah , ki lyngdoh , bad ki briew ki bud ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ki ha kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kumta ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ , ïa kaba U  Trai  da lade hi u la pynlong kaba kyntang .

translation.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season : and my sinews take no rest .
translation.kha: Mynmiet ki shyieng jong nga baroh ki pang ; ka jingpang kaba bam ïa nga kam kut shuh .

translation.en: And Moses laid up the rods before the  Lord  in the tabernacle of witness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u buh ïa kita ki diengduh baroh hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And moreover the king s servants came to bless our lord king David , saying , God make the name of Solomon better than thy name , and make his throne greater than thy throne . And the king bowed himself upon the bed .
translation.kha: Nalor kata , ki rangbah synshar ka ïingbishar ki la leit bad ai ka jingñiewburom jong ki ïa u Syiem Kynrad , u Syiem Dabid bad ki ong , ‘ To U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa u Solomon uba kham pawnam ban ïa phi , bad ai ba ka jingsynshar jong u Solomon kan long kaba man roi shibun ban ïa ka jong phi .’

translation.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ka Sebulun bad Naphtali , Ki kheiñduh la ka jingim ha ka madan thma .

translation.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight : for by the law is the knowledge of sin .
translation.kha: Naba ym don uno uno ruh uba hok ha khmat U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ; kaei kaba ka Hukum ka leh ka long ban pynlong ïa u briew ban tip ba u la leh pop .

translation.en: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted , because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely ?
translation.kha: Ngam shym la buh dor ei ei ïa phi haba nga la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong U Blei ha phi ; nga la pynrit ïa lade khnang ban kyntiew ïa phi . Hato nga la leh bakla ?

translation.en: And she said , I pray you , let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves : so she came , and hath continued even from the morning until now , that she tarried a little in the house .
translation.kha: Ka kyrpad ïa nga ban shah ba kan bud nadien jong ki nongot bad tam ïa u kew . Ka la trei naduh dang step phyrngab bad dang myntan ka shongthait shipor hapoh ka jingkahtngen .

translation.en: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow , and loveth the stranger , in giving him food and raiment .
translation.kha: U lehhok ïa ki khunswet bad ïa ki riewkynthei ; u ieit ïa ki nongwei kiba don bad ngi , bad u ai bam bad ai kup ai sem ïa ki .

translation.en: And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba la ïakut , u Herod u la phong ki jaiñkup syiem , u la shong halor ka khet jong u , bad u la kren ha u paidbah .

translation.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine , which shall be in the land of Egypt  ; that the land perish not through the famine .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingbam kan long kum ka jingbuh pynap ïa ka ri ha kita ki hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew ki ban sa wan ha ka ri Ijipt . Da kane ka rukom ki briew kin ym ïapthngan .

translation.en: Whithersoever they went out , the hand of the  Lord  was against them for evil , as the  Lord  had said , and as the  Lord  had sworn unto them : and they were greatly distressed .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba ki leit sha ka thma , U  Trai  u long pyrshah ïa ki , kumba u la lah ong ba un leh kumta . Ki la don ha ka jingkhuslai bakhraw .

translation.en: In his days Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates : and king Josiah went against him  ; and he slew him at Megiddo , when he had seen him .
translation.kha: Katba u Josaïah u long syiem , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai sha ka wah Ïuphratis ban ïarap ïa u patsha ka Assyria . U syiem Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Ijipt ha Megiddo bad u la shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them  ; that they may return every man from his evil way  ; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin .
translation.kha: Lehse haba ki paid Judah kin ïohsngew shaphang baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga thmu ban wallam halor jong ki , kin phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong ki . Te ngan map ïa ka jingbymman jong ki bad ïa ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: They mar my path , they set forward my calamity , they have no helper .
translation.kha: Ki la khang ïa ka lynti phet jong nga bad pyrshang ban pynjot ïa nga ; bad ym don mano mano ban pynsangeh ïa ki .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Whose is this image and superscription ?
translation.kha: bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Kane ka dur bad ka kyrteng ki dei ki jongno ?

translation.en: Then his father and his mother said unto him , Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren , or among all my people , that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines ? And Samson said unto his father , Get her for me  ; for she pleaseth me well .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa bad ka kmie jong u ki ong ïa u ,  Balei phin da leit sha kito ki Philistia bymngeit ban ïoh ïa ka kurim ? Hato phim lah ban shem ïa ka theisamla na la ka kur ka jait , hapdeng ki briew jong ngi baroh ?  Hynrei u Samson u ong ha la u kpa ,  Kane ka dei kaba nga kwah ba phin pynïoh na ka bynta jong nga . Nga itynnat ïa ka .

translation.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters : and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father s flock .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Moses u dang shongthait harud kawei ka pukri , hynñiew ngut ki khun kynthei jong u Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Midian , ki ïawan tong um ban pyndap ïa ki shyngoid ba kin ïoh ai um ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong u kpa jong ki .

translation.en: And where is now my hope ? as for my hope , who shall see it ?
translation.kha: Hangno ka don ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? Mano ba ïohi ïa nga ?

translation.en: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father , saying , A man child is born unto thee  ; making him very glad .
translation.kha: Long ba la tim uta u briew uba la pynkmen ïa i pa jong nga mynba u la wallam ha i ka khubor ,  I dei u shynrang ! Phi la don khun shynrang !

translation.en: And the men did the work faithfully : and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah , the Levites , of the sons of Merari  ; and Zechariah and Meshullam , of the sons of the Kohathites , to set it forward  ; and other of the Levites , all that could skill of instruments of musick .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba trei ïa ka kam ki long kiba da sngur hok . La peit bniah halor jong ki da ki saw ngut ki Lebi : u Jahath bad u Obadaïah na ka kur Merari , bad u Sekharaïah bad u Meshullam na ka kur Kohath . ( Ki Lebi ki dei ki nongtem nongput batbit bha . )

translation.en: Satan questioned whether God rules in a worthy way and in the best interests of His subjects .
translation.kha: U Soitan u la woh nia la U Blei u donhok ne em ban synshar bad la ka jingsynshar jong u ka pynmyntoi ne em ïa la ki khun ki hajar .

translation.en: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred : for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it .
translation.kha: Mynta , halor ka jingai jingmut u Mordekai , ka Esther ka bat tang ha lade khlem ïathuh hano hano ba ka long ka Jiw .

translation.en: And in those days shall men seek death , and shall not find it  ; and shall desire to die , and death shall flee from them .
translation.kha: Ha kine ki san bnai kin wad ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka ; kin kwah ban ïap noh , hynrei ka jingïap kan phet na ki .

translation.en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , or that useth divination , or an observer of times , or an enchanter , or a witch ,
translation.kha: Wat kñia ïa la ki khun da kaba thang ïa ki ha ka duwan jong phi ; wat shah ïa la ki briew ban khan , lane ban shat ban kheiñ , lane ban ai myntor ,

translation.en: Wherefore tongues are for a sign , not to them that believe , but to them that believe not : but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not , but for them which believe .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ka jingai ba lah ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher ka long ka jingpynshisha ha ki bymngeit , ym ha kiba ngeit , katba ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka long ka jingpynshisha ïa kiba ngeit , ym ïa ki bymngeit .

translation.en: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children , and the heart of the children to their fathers , lest I come and smite the earth with a curse .
translation.kha: Un wallam lang ïa ki kpa bad ki khun sa shisien ; lym kumta ngan hap ban wan bad pynjot ïa ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: When thou art come unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt possess it , and shalt dwell therein , and shalt say , I will set a king over me , like as all the nations that are about me  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad phi la shong la sah hangta , phin sa ïa-pyrkhat ban don noh u syiem kumba ïalong lem ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong jong phi .

translation.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink , and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry .
translation.kha: Phi kyntait ban ai um ïa kito kiba la thait , bad phi kyntait ban bsa ïa kito kiba thngan .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron , when they offered before the  Lord  , and died  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses hadien ka jingïap jong ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron kiba la shah pynïap mynba ki kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  da ka ding bymkhuid .

translation.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat , and my roarings are poured out like the waters .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ban bam , nga ïam sngewsih , bad ngam shym sangeh ban ud .

translation.en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee , which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois , and thy mother Eunice ; and I am persuaded that in thee also .
translation.kha: Nga kynmaw ïa ka jingngeit basngur kaba me don , ka jingngeit kaba kum ka jong ka kmierad jong me ka Lois bad kaba ka kmie jong me ka Ïuniki ruh ka don . Nga sngewthikna ba me ruh me don ïa ka .

translation.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la im shispah phraphew snem ,

translation.en: For by them judgeth he the people  ; he giveth meat in abundance .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kumno u bsa ïa ki briew bad u pynbiang kyrhai ka bam .

translation.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night , when deep sleep falleth on men ,
translation.kha: Kum ka jingruma ka pynwit ïa ka jingïohthiah jong nga .

translation.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth : but he that hath mercy on the poor , happy is he .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban long kiba kmen , to lehsbun ïa kiba duk ; ka long ka pop ban ñiewbeiñ ïano ïano .

translation.en: But Pekah the son of Remaliah , a captain of his , conspired against him , and smote him in Samaria , in the palace of the king s house , with Argob and Arieh , and with him fifty men of the Gileadites : and he killed him , and reigned in his room .
translation.kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ka kynhun shipai u Pekahaïah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah , ki ïasylla lem bad ki sanphew ngut ki rangbah na Gilead , ki pynïap ïa u Pekahaïah ha ka bynta bashapoh jong ka kynroh ka ïingsyiem ha Samaria , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: A time to get , and a time to lose  ; a time to keep , and a time to cast away  ;
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban shem bad ka por ban jah , ka por ban kynshew bad ka por ban bret noh ,

translation.en: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day , that it may be an holy convocation unto you : ye shall do no servile work therein : it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi , hynrei ïalumlang ban mane Blei . Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban leh ïa kane ka hukum pateng la pateng shano shano ba ki don .

translation.en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron : and his firstborn was Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess  ;
translation.kha: Kine harum ki hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang , ha ka jingbuh ryntih kat kum ka jingkha ïa ki ; la kha na ka bynta u Dabid ha Hebron : u Amnon , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , kaba na Jesreel ;

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or parents , or brethren , or wife , or children , for the kingdom of God s sake ,
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing lane ïa ka tnga lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa ki kmie ki kpa lane ïa ki khun na ka bynta ka Hima U Blei

translation.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come , they were all with one accord in one place .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi Pentekost ka la poi , baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïalumlang ha kawei ka jaka .

translation.en: And the sons of Zilpah , Leah s handmaid  ; Gad , and Asher : these are the sons of Jacob , which were born to him in Paddan–aram .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Silpah , ka mraw ka Leah , ki long u Gad bad u Asher . Ïa kine ki khun shynrang la kha ha Mesopotamia .

translation.en: That lie upon beds of ivory , and stretch themselves upon their couches , and eat the lambs out of the flock , and the calves out of the midst of the stall  ;
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba thiah halor ki jingthiah baremdor , kiba ïakhawai da ki khun masi bad khunlangbrot !

translation.en: Your wives , your little ones , and your cattle , shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan  ; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed , all the mighty men of valour , and help them  ;
translation.kha: Ki tnga jong phi , ki khun jong phi , bad ki jingri jong phi kin sah hangne , hynrei ki shipai jong phi , kiba la kieng atiar na ka bynta ka thma , kin jam shuwa ïa kiwei pat ki Israel khnang ban ïarap ïa ki

translation.en: And Esau said , I have enough , my brother  ; keep that thou hast unto thyself .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Iso u ong ,  Ko hep , nga dap biang kyrhai ; buh ïa kaei kaba phi don .

translation.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the  Lord  , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued  ;
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane , lem bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u la kurup na ki jaitbynriew kiba u la jop —

translation.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion , and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Ngan wan sha Jerusalem ban ïada ïa phi bad ban pynim ïa phi baroh kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: And Esau said unto his father , Hast thou but one blessing , my father ? bless me , even me also , O my father . And Esau lifted up his voice , and wept .
translation.kha: U Iso u ïai kyrpad ha la u kpa .  Ko Pa , hato phi don tang kawei ka jingkyrkhu ? Pa , to kyrkhu ïa nga ruh !  U la sdang ban ïam .

translation.en: And they brake down the image of Baal , and brake down the house of Baal , and made it a draught house unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynjot ïa u rishot bakyntang bad ïa kata ka templ , bad ki pynkylla jaka leit shabar ïa ka — kaba dang don haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people , that thou wilt not let them go ?
translation.kha: Pynban me dang sngew hangamei , bad me kyntait ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , ngan leh kumjuh ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

translation.en: And he sent , and brought him in . Now he was ruddy , and withal of a beautiful countenance , and goodly to look to . And the  Lord  said , Arise , anoint him : for this is he .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jesse u phah khot ïa u . U long uba bhabriew , u samla bakoit bakhiah bad ki khmat kiba phyrnai . U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,  Dei une — pynsleh ïa u !

translation.en: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years : and he begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Adam u la im sa phraspah snem .

translation.en: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day .
translation.kha: lada phi kohnguh ïa u bad phi sumar biang biang ïa kata baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels . Let now the astrologers , the stargazers , the monthly prognosticators , stand up , and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee .
translation.kha: Pha long kaba khlem bor wat la pha ïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut . To ai ba ki nongbatai kupar kin wan sha khmat ban pyllait im ïa pha — kito ki briew kiba wad jingtip shaphang ki khlur , kiba pruid dak ïa ki bynta jong ki bneng bad ïathuh ïa pha na uwei u bnai sha uwei pat kaei ka ban jia ïa pha .

translation.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him .
translation.kha: ( Wat ki para shynrang jong u hi kim shym la ngeit ha u . )

translation.en: Wherefore David arose and went , he and his men , and slew of the Philistines two hundred men  ; and David brought their foreskins , and they gave them in full tale to the king , that he might be the king s son in law . And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife .
translation.kha: u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki leit bad pynïap arspah ngut ki Philistia . U wanrah ïa ki doh otsher jong ki baroh sha u syiem bad u da ñiew ïa ki ha u , khnang ba un lah ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u . Kumta u Saul u hap ban ai ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u ban shongkurim ïa u Dabid .

translation.en: I beheld the mountains , and , lo , they trembled , and all the hills moved lightly .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ha ki lumbah — ki la khynñiuh , bad ki lumrit ki khih shadien bad sha khmat .

translation.en: Then the disciples looked one on another , doubting of whom he spake .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïa-peit uwei ïa uwei pat da ka jinglyngngoh kaba jur , shaphang jongno u mut .

translation.en: And when these days were expired , the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace , both unto great and small , seven days , in the court of the garden of the king s palace  ;
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u syiem u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah jong ka hima , ka Susa , ïa kiba duk bad kiba riewspah kumjuh . Ka neh shi taïew bad la pynlong ha ki kper jong ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken : and he was there when Jerusalem was taken .
translation.kha: Bad ïa nga la buh ha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingsyiem haduh ka sngi ba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the people believed : and when they heard that the  Lord  had visited the children of Israel , and that he had looked upon their affliction , then they bowed their heads and worshipped .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ngeit , bad haba ki ïohsngew ba U  Trai  u la wan sha ki bad ba u la ïohi kumno ki la shah lehbeiñ tyngeh , ki la nguh la dem bad ki la ïamane ruh .

translation.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh , and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth .
translation.kha: Ka sniehdoh jong nga kam ïadait bha shuh bad ki shyieng ; nga la shu lait im da ka said .

translation.en: Gather the pieces thereof into it , even every good piece , the thigh , and the shoulder  ; fill it with the choice bones .
translation.kha: To thep ïa ki dkhot doh kiba kynsai tam — ki tyrpeng bad ki kjat — pyndap ïa u ruh da ki kyrkhoit shyieng ba la jied .

translation.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery , the wormwood and the gall .
translation.kha: Ka jingpyrkhat ïa ka jingpang jong nga , ka jingbymdon ïing jong nga , ka long ka bih bakthang .

translation.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him , as also Moses was faithful in all his house .
translation.kha: U long uba shaniah ha U Blei , uba la jied ïa u ban leh ïa kane ka kam , kumba u Moses u la long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka kam jong u ha ka ïing U Blei .

translation.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .
translation.kha: U la long u nongïalam jong ki Israel haduh arphew lai snem . Nangta u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Shamir .

translation.en: They also do no iniquity : they walk in his ways .
translation.kha: Ki bym ju leh ïa ka bymdei ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti U  Trai .

translation.en: And the king said unto the man of God , Come home with me , and refresh thyself , and I will give thee a reward .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa ,  Wan ngin ïaleit bad nga sha ïing bad ngin ïabam ei ei . Ngan ainong ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh .

translation.en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house  ; and Absalom went in unto his father s concubines in the sight of all Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki pynïeng kawei ka ïingjaiñ ïa u Absalom ha tnum ka ïingsyiem ; bad ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei baroh , u Absalom u leit rung shapoh bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And the children of Reuben , and the children of Gad , and half the tribe of Manasseh , passed over armed before the children of Israel , as Moses spake unto them :
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad na ka shiteng ka jait Manasseh , ki la khreh ïa ka thma , ki la jam ha shuwa jong kiba sah jong uta u paidbah , kumba u Moses u la bthah ïa ki ban leh .

translation.en: And command thou the people , saying , Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau , which dwell in Seir  ; and they shall be afraid of you : take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore :
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kine ki jinghikai : ‘ Mynta phin ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri lum Edom , ka ri ki kur ki jait jong phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .

translation.en: Yet many years didst thou forbear them , and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets : yet would they not give ear : therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands .
translation.kha: Na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat , ha ka jingïaishah me la maham ïa ki . Me pyrsad mynsiem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren , hynrei ki briew jong me ki long kyllut , kumta me shah ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ban jop ïa ki .

translation.en: Because he considereth , and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: U sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba u leh bad u sangeh ban leh pop , kumta un ym ïap da shisha , hynrei un ïai im .

translation.en: I am become a fool in glorying ; ye have compelled me : for I ought to have been commended of you : for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles , though I be nothing .
translation.kha: Nga la leh mynleh kum u bieit — hynrei phi la pynlong ïa nga ban leh kumta . Dei ma phi kiba la dei ban pynpaw ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi ïa nga . Naba wat lada ngam long ei ei , ngam shym duna ei ei na kita ki  apostol  kiba kham kyrpang jong phi .

translation.en: And Jesus , which is called Justus , who are of the circumcision . These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God , which have been a comfort unto me .
translation.kha: U Joshua , ïa uba la khot ruh u Justos , u phah ruh ïa ki jingai khublei . Kine lai ngut ki long tang ma ki , ki parabangeit Jiw kiba trei bad nga na ka bynta Ka Hima U Blei , bad ki la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa nga .

translation.en: Hear , I beseech thee , and I will speak : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
translation.kha: Me ong ïa nga ban shahshkor katba me dang kren bad ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong me .

translation.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat  ; of which we cannot now speak particularly .
translation.kha: Haneng ka Synduk la don ki kherub kiba long ka dak ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , bad ki thapniang jong ki , ki pyiar halor ka jaka ha kaba la ju map ïa ki pop . Hynrei mynta kam dei ka por ban batai bniah nadong shadong .

translation.en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering , and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot :
translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad un shim khyndiat ka snam bad un tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon jong uta u briew , ka  tikmie kamon jong u , bad ha ka  jatkmie kamon jong u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la kylla noh ïa la ka jingmut bad um shym wallam ha ki briew jong u ïa ka jingpynjot kaba u la byrngem .

translation.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes , and take away thy fair jewels .
translation.kha: Kin pynkad ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad kin shim ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha .

translation.en: The burden of Damascus . Behold , Damascus is taken away from being a city , and it shall be a ruinous heap .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka Damaskos kan ym long shuh ka nongbah ; kan long tang ka thup ki jingjot jingpra .

translation.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not , and upon the families that call not on thy name : for they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him , and consumed him , and have made his habitation desolate .
translation.kha: Pynphai ïa ka jingbitar jong me halor ki jaitbynriew ki bym mane ïa me bad halor ki briew kiba kyntait ïa me . Ki la pynïap ïa ki briew jong me ; ki la pynjot khoit ïa ngi bad iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ha ka jingjot jingpra .

translation.en: There was a man of the Pharisees , named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews :
translation.kha: La don u nongïalam jong ki Jiw uba kyrteng u Nikodemos , uba dei na ka kynhun ki Pharisi .

translation.en: And now , O Lord our God , that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand , and hast gotten thee renown , as at this day  ; we have sinned , we have done wickedly .
translation.kha: A Trai U Blei jong ngi , me la pyn-i ïa ka bor jong me da kaba wallam noh ïa ki briew jong me na ri Ijipt , bad ïa ka bor jong me la ïai kynmaw . Ngi la leh pop ; ngi la leh bakla .

translation.en: For your prayers to be heard by God , you must be trying your best to live by his laws .
translation.kha: Khnang ba U Blei un sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , phi dei ban ïaleh ban im katkum ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah jong ka Gibeon , kiba dei ki Hib , ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Joshua u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa ka Ai ,

translation.en: I receive not honour from men .
translation.kha: Ngam wad ïa ka jingïaroh ki briew .

translation.en: Then fled Moses at this saying , and was a stranger in the land of Madian , where he begat two sons .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la phet noh na Ijipt bad u la leit noh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri ki Midian . Hangta u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang .

translation.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain .
translation.kha: Shisha , ka niam kam pynriewspah palat ïa u briew , lada u sngewhun bad kaei kaba u don .

translation.en: God also told Noah to build a huge boat , called an ark , and to take into it his family and every sort of animal .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ruh ha u Noah ban thaw ïa ka ïinglieng kaba heh , bad ban wallam ïa la ka ïing ka sem bad ki mrad ba laiphew jait hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: They lavish gold out of the bag , and weigh silver in the balance , and hire a goldsmith  ; and he maketh it a god : they fall down , yea , they worship .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki plied ïa la ki pla pisa bad ki theh shabar ïa ka ksiar ; ki thew ïa ka rupa ha ki tarajur . Ki ainong ïa u bania ban shna durblei ; nangta ki dem ngon bad mane ïa ka !

translation.en: Behold , I am against them that prophesy false dreams , saith the  Lord  , and do tell them , and cause my people to err by their lies , and by their lightness  ; yet I sent them not , nor commanded them : therefore they shall not profit this people at all , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: To sngew ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ! Nga long pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa la ki jingphohsniew kiba dap da ki jinglamler . Ki ïathuh ïa kine ki jingphohsniew bad ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da ka jinglamler bad ka jingsngewmeng jong ki . Ngam shym la phah ne hukum ïa ki ban leit , bad kim shym la long satia ka jingïarap ïa ki briew . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds , and I punished the goats : for the  Lord  of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah , and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga bitar ïa kito ki nongwei kiba synshar ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki paid Judah ki long ki jong nga , bad ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ngan sumar ïa ki . Kin long ki kulai thma badonbor jong nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , the son of Meshullam , the scribe , to the house of the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u syiem Josaïah u phah ïa u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u khun jong u Asalaïah bad u ksiew jong u Meshullam , sha ka Templ bad ka hukum :

translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity : the earth also shall disclose her blood , and shall no more cover her slain .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan na ka jaka shong jong u na bneng ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei namar ki pop jong ki . Ki jingpynïap briew ha ka pyrthei ïa kiba la leh ha kaba rieh , yn pynpaw , bad ka khyndew kan ym lah shuh ban buhrieh ïa kito ïa kiba la pynïap .

translation.en: There were also women looking on afar off : among whom was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses , and Salome  ;
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki kynthei ki la don hangta , ki khmih na jngai . Napdeng jong ki , long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie jong u Jakob ba kham rit bad u Josis , bad ka Salome .

translation.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide : and he lifted up his eyes , and saw , and , behold , the camels were coming .
translation.kha: U la mih shabar ha ka por janmiet ban ïaid kai pyngngad ha ki pyntha bad u ïohi ïa ki ut ba ki dang wan .
