translation.en: And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce  ; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .
translation.kha: Ka Judah ka la ïohi ba nga la pyllait tnga ïa ka Israel bad phah noh ïa ka namar ba ka la phai noh na nga bad ka la kylla long ka nuti . Hynrei ka Judah , ka para bymïaineh jong ka Israel , kam shym sheptieng . Ma ka ruh ka la kylla long ka nuti

translation.en: Sigh therefore , thou son of man , with the breaking of thy loins  ; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to ud kumba ka dohnud jong me ka la pait ha ka jingjynjar . To ud da ka jingsngewsih ha kaba baroh kin khmih ïa me .

translation.en: Then they reviled him , and said , Thou art his disciple  ; but we are Moses  disciples .
translation.kha: Ki la tim ïa u bad ki da ong ,  Me long u synran jong une u briew : Hynrei , ngi long ki synran u Moses .

translation.en: Where is the dwelling of the lions , and the feedingplace of the young lions , where the lion , even the old lion , walked , and the lion s whelp , and none made them afraid ?
translation.kha: Hangno mynta ka don ka nongbah kata kaba long kum ka krem jong ki sing , ka jaka ha kaba la bsa ïa ki sing samla , ha kaba u sing bad ka sing kin leit bad ki khun jong ki kin don ha ka jingshngain ?

translation.en: And the men took that present , and they took double money in their hand , and Benjamin  ; and rose up , and went down to Egypt , and stood before Joseph .
translation.kha: Kumta kita shi para ki shim ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha , ki rah pisa sa ar shah , bad ki leit noh sha Ijipt ryngkat bad u Benjamin . Hangta ki la leit ïakynduh ïa u Joseph .

translation.en: And the two disciples heard him speak , and they followed Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la leit lem bad U Jisu .

translation.en: After two days was the feast of the passover , and of unleavened bread : and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft , and put him to death .
translation.kha: Ka la long mynta ar sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait bad U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wad ka lad ban kem jar jar ïa U Jisu bad ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And God helped him against the Philistines , and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal , and the Mehunims .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïarap ïa u ban jop ïa ki Philistia , ïa ki Arab kiba shong ha Gurbaal , bad ïa ki Meun .

translation.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the  Lord  , and to record , and to thank and praise the  Lord  God of Israel :
translation.kha: U Dabid u thung katto katne ki Lebi ban ïalam ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , da ki jingrwai bad ki jingïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la kad arliang ïa ka Duriaw basaw , ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors , when it brake forth , as if it had issued out of the womb ?
translation.kha: Mano ba khang ïa ki khyrdop ban bat ïa ka duriaw haba ka bthei na ka kpoh jong ka khyndew ?

translation.en: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering , which I have commanded in my habitation  ; and honourest thy sons above me , to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people ?
translation.kha: Balei mynta pat , me da kwah rhah sa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ba nga dawa na la ki briew ? Balei Eli ba me kham ai burom ïa la ki khun shynrang ban ïa nga da kaba me shah ba kin pynsngaid ïa lade da ki bynta kiba bha tam na ki jingkñia ba ki briew ki ai ha nga ?

translation.en: Then they hasted , and took every man his garment , and put it under him on the top of the stairs , and blew with trumpets , saying , Jehu is king .
translation.kha: Mar kumta ki para rangbah shipai jong u Jehu ki siang ïa ki barandi jong ki ha kliar jong ki mawkyrdon ba u Jehu un ïoh ïeng , ki la put ïa ki turoi , bad ki la pyrta ,  U Jehu u long u syiem !

translation.en: If thieves came to thee , if robbers by night , ( how art thou cut off ! ) would they not have stolen till they had enough ? if the grapegatherers came to thee , would they not leave some grapes ?
translation.kha: Haba ki nongtuh ki wan mynmiet , ki rah tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah . Haba ki briew ki lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , borabor ki pynsah khyrdong khyndiat . Hynrei ki nongshun jong pha ki la pyndam noh khoit ïa pha .

translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang jong nga bad pha , bad phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Circumcision is nothing , and uncircumcision is nothing , but the keeping of the commandments of God .
translation.kha: Naba kaba otsher ne kaba khlem otsher ïa u briew kam don jingmut ei ei ; kaei kaba donkam ka long ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Blei .

translation.en: Because they turned back from him , and would not consider any of his ways :
translation.kha: namar ki la sangeh na kaba bud ïa u bad leh bymsalia ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house , he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder , to repair the house of the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u , hadien ba u la pynkhuid ïa ka ri bad ïa ka Templ da kaba pynkut noh ïa ka jingmane blei thala , u syiem Josaïah u phah lai ngut ki rangbah ban tei pynbha ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  U Blei : u Shaphan u khun jong u Asalaïah , Maaseïah , u lat ka Jerusalem , bad u Joah u khun jong u Joahas , u rangbah synshar ba-halor .

translation.en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san , ai khyndai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone  ; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai : wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , even the people of Mordecai .
translation.kha: bad haba u tip ba u Mordekai u dei u Jiw , u la rai ban pynshitom ym tang ïa u Mordekai marwei . U la don ka jingthmu ban pynïap ïa baroh ki Jiw ha ka hima Persia baroh kawei .

translation.en: And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them ,  Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ïa u paidbah sha u sa shisien bad ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor ïa nga , baroh na phi , bad to long kiba shemphang .

translation.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus  ; and fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Ephesos ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ; la pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu la ai ka burom kaba kham khraw .

translation.en: Thou shalt be perfect with the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Ïaineh skhem ha U  Trai .

translation.en: But when ye go over Jordan , and dwell in the land which the  Lord  your God giveth you to inherit , and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about , so that ye dwell in safety  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi jam ïa ka wah Jordan , U  Trai  un shah ïa phi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri bad un ïada ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh shongsuk shongsaiñ .

translation.en: How shall I give thee up , Ephraim ? how shall I deliver thee , Israel ? how shall I make thee as Admah ? how shall I set thee as Zeboiim ? mine heart is turned within me , my repentings are kindled together .
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban ieh ïa phi , ko Israel ? Kumno nga lah ban iehnoh ïa phi ? Hato ngan pynjot junom ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Admah , lane ngan leh ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Seboiim ? Ka dohnud jong nga kan ym shah ïa nga ban leh ïa kata ! Ka jingieit jong nga ïa phi ka long khlaiñ haduh katta katta .

translation.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it upon both their shoulders , and went backward , and covered the nakedness of their father  ; and their faces were backward , and they saw not their father s nakedness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shem bad u Japheth ki la shim kawei ka jaiñkup bad ki tawah ïa ka hadien jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng . Ki ïaid dadien shapoh ka ïingjaiñ bad ki tap ïa la u kpa , ki da phai dien khnang ba kin ym ïohi ïa u , ba u lyngkhuit .

translation.en: Iron is taken out of the earth , and brass is molten out of the stone .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ka nar na ka khyndew ; bad ki pynum ïa ka rnong na ki maw .

translation.en: And David called one of the young men , and said , Go near , and fall upon him . And he smote him that he died .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u khot ïa uwei na ki briew jong u , bad u ong ,  Pynïap ïa u !  U briew u la shoh ïa u nong Amalek bad u la pynmynsaw ïa u ,

translation.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded , and ran into the midst of the congregation  ; and , behold , the plague was begun among the people : and he put on incense , and made an atonement for the people .
translation.kha: U Aaron u la kohnguh , u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding bad mareh sha pdeng ki briew ba la ïalumlang . Haba u ïohi ba ka khlam ka la lah sdang , u buh ïa ka jingiwbih ha uta u rnga ding bad u pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta u paidbah .

translation.en: And you hath he quickened , who were dead in trespasses and sins ;
translation.kha: Mynshuwa phi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong mynsiem namar ka jingbymkohnguh bad ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: And sent Timothy , our brother , and minister of God , and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ , to establish you , and to comfort you concerning your faith :
translation.kha: Bad ngi la phah ïa u Timothi , u parabangeit jong ngi uba ïatrei lem bad ngi na ka bynta U Blei ha kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist . Ngi la phah ïa u ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi bad ïarap ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ,

translation.en: Which all are to perish with the using ; ) after the commandments and doctrines of men ?
translation.kha: Kine baroh ki kdew ïa kiei kiei kiba long ki bymmyntoi shisien ba la dep pyndonkam ; ki long tang ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai u briew .

translation.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba pdiang ïa ka khubor jong u , u pynskhem da kane ba U Blei u long uba shisha .

translation.en: Tom pulled out his key and opened the door .
translation.kha: U Tom u sei ia u shabi bad u plie ia ka jingkhang .

translation.en: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne , who liveth for ever and ever ,
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ki rwai ki jingrwai jong ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom bad ki jingsngewnguh ïa uta uba shong ha ka khet , bad mane ïa uta uba im junom la junom .

translation.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom  ; and in her tongue is the law of kindness .
translation.kha: Ka kren da ka jingstad kaba jai jai .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep , and hath closed your eyes : the prophets and your rulers , the seers hath he covered .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynshoh samthiah ïa phi , bad phi sdang ban ngat ha ka jingïohthiah kaba jur . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki dei ban long ki khmat jong ki briew , hynrei U Blei u la pynmatlah ïa ki .

translation.en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba ïa ka kyrteng jong u ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab kiba im la bret sha ka pung ka ding .

translation.en: ( After that Jeconiah the king , and the queen , and the eunuchs , the princes of Judah and Jerusalem , and the carpenters , and the smiths , were departed from Jerusalem  ; )
translation.kha: Nga la thoh ïa ka hadien ba u syiem Jehoïakhin , ka kmie jong u , ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , ki nong-ohdur , bad ki nongtrei batbit ki la shah ringmraw .

translation.en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings , and called upon the  Lord   ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering .
translation.kha: U la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U la duwai , bad U  Trai  u la jubab ïa u da kaba phah ïa ka ding na bneng ban thang ïa ki jingainguh halor ka duwan .

translation.en: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki kmen , hynrei ïa baroh kiba bymman la pynsngap jar .

translation.en: Now the Egyptians are men , and not God  ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the  Lord  shall stretch out his hand , both he that helpeth shall fall , and he that is holpen shall fall down , and they all shall fail together .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt kim dei ki blei — ki long tang ki briew . Ki kulai jong ki kim dei kita kiba don ka bor bapalat liam . Haba U  Trai  u trei , ka hima bakhlaiñbor kan khyllem , bad ka hima batlot bor kaba ka ïarap kan kyllon . Baroh ar na ki kin shah pynjot .

translation.en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways , go not astray in her paths .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba kum kata ka briew kan ïoh jop ïa ka dohnud jong phi ; wat leit shang kylleng shaba ïaid ma ka .

translation.en: Neither as being lords over God s heritage , but being ensamples to the flock .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban leh trai khlieh halor kito ha kiba la ai ïa phi ban sumar , hynrei to long ka nuksa ïa ka kynhun .

translation.en: And Bath–sheba said , Well  ; I will speak for thee unto the king .
translation.kha: To ,  ka jubab .  Ngan kren ha u syiem na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate , but left their own habitation , he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki angel ki bym shym la ri ïa ka burom hapoh ki pud ka bor synshar jong ki , hynrei ki la iehnoh ïa ki jaka shong jong ki hi : Ki shah khum da ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh kaba dum tliw tliw , ha kaba U Blei u buh ïa ki na ka bynta kata ka Sngi kaba khraw ha kaba yn pynrem ïa ki .

translation.en: By lot was their inheritance , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses , for the nine tribes , and for the half tribe .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , ïa ki jaka jong ki khyndai jait bad kawei ka shiteng jait ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la rai da kaba kynting sbai .

translation.en: And when we were all fallen to the earth , I heard a voice speaking unto me , and saying in the Hebrew tongue ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi la hap sha madan , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren ha nga ha ka ktien Hebru , ‘ Saul , Saul ! balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ? Me pynmong ïa lade da kaba ïaleh pyrshah , kumba u masi dab u kynjat pyrshah ïa u dieng jong u kynrad jong u .’

translation.en: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing seem right before the king , and I be pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king s provinces :
translation.kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , bad lada phi sngewsynei ïa nga bad ka long kaba dei ha phi , sngewbha pynmih ka jingpynbna ban khang ïa ki hukum u Haman na kaba pyntreikam ïa ki — kito ki hukum kiba u khun jong u Hammedatha uba hiarpateng na u Agag u la ai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw baroh ha ka hima .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , and to keep the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh na kiba lait im na ki jaitbynriew kiba la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin leit shata man la ka snem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem bad ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter : now his sons were with his cattle in the field : and Jacob held his peace until they were come .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la tip ba la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei namar ba ki khun shynrang jong u ki dang don sha ki pyntha bad la ki jingri , um shym leh ei ei tad haduh ba kin da wan phai .

translation.en: And with them , by their generations , after the house of their fathers , were bands of soldiers for war , six and thirty thousand men : for they had many wives and sons .
translation.kha: Ki ïoh shibun ki tnga bad ki khun , haduh ba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki lah ban pynmih laiphew hynriew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

translation.en: Giving thanks unto the Father , which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light :
translation.kha: Ai ba yn pynkhlaiñ ïa phi da ka jingkhlaiñ baroh kaba wan na ka bor badonburom jong u , khnang ba phi lah ban shah ïa kiei kiei baroh da ka jingïaishah . Bad da ka jingkmen to ainguh ïa U Kpa , uba la pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ban ïoh ïa la ka bynta na kaei kaba U Blei u la tyngkai na ka bynta ki briew jong u ha ka hima ka jingshai .

translation.en: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïai peit sawdong ban ïohi mano ba la leh ïa kata .

translation.en: Then Joab came to the king , and said , What hast thou done ? behold , Abner came unto thee  ; why is it that thou hast sent him away , and he is quite gone ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Joab u leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Kaei kane kaba phi la leh ? U Abner u la wan sha phi — balei phi shah ba un shu leit kumto ?

translation.en: For , as the  Lord  liveth , which saveth Israel , though it be in Jonathan my son , he shall surely die . But there was not a man among all the people that answered him .
translation.kha: Nga kular ha U  Trai  uba im , uba ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop , ba uta uba la leh un shah pynïap , wat la u dei u Jonathan u khun jong nga .  Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba ong ei ei .

translation.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the  Lord s  wrath  ; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy : for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi haba U  Trai  un pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u , wat ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki baroh kan ym lah ban pynim ïa ki . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar jong u . Un pynkut — ka jingkut kaba kynsan — ïa uwei pa uwei uba im ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Nevertheless what saith the scripture ? Cast out the bondwoman and her son : for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman .
translation.kha: Hynrei aïu ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ? Ka ïathuh ,  Beh noh ïa ka kynthei mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka ; naba u khun jong ka kynthei mraw un ym ïoh bynta na ka jingdon jingem u kpa lem bad u khun jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .

translation.en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus , Lord , and what shall this man do ?
translation.kha: Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa u , u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Trai , kumno shaphang une u briew ?

translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil concerning thee .
translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren lamler ïa me . Hynrei ma u hi da lade u la rai ba phin ngat ha ka jingjot !

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and sought not unto Baalim  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u Jehoshaphat namar u la bud ïa ka nuksa ba-mynshuwa jong ka jingim u kpa jong u bad um shym mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you , or whosoever be among you in your generations , and will offer an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; as ye do , so he shall do .
translation.kha: Bad lada ha kano kano ka por ki nongwei ki wan ban shong ban sah bad phi , la ka long tang shipor lane baroh shi rta , bad ki ai ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , ki dei ban bud ïa kijuh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man  ; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons .
translation.kha: U samla Lebi u mynjur ban shong bad u Mikah bad u la long hi kum u khun .

translation.en: What do ye imagine against the  Lord  ? he will make an utter end : affliction shall not rise up the second time .
translation.kha: Aïu phi ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ? un pynjot ïa phi . Ym don mano mano uba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u palat ïa ka shisien .

translation.en: And the sons of Dan  ; Hushim .
translation.kha: U Dan bad u Hushim u khun jong u .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba ïa ki ïing , ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ yn sa thied biang ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: And many women were there beholding afar off , which followed Jesus from Galilee , ministering unto him :
translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki kynthei hangta , kiba la ïakhmih na pajih , kiba la ïabud ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa bad kiba la ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: And when these things begin to come to pass , then look up , and lift up your heads  ; for your redemption draweth nigh .
translation.kha: Haba kine kiei kiei baroh ki sdang ban jia , ïeng joit bad pynïeng ïa la ki khlieh , namar ka jingpynim jong phi ka la jan .

translation.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: ban ong ha u ,  U blei ha uba phi shaniah u la ong ïa phi ba phin ym hap ha ki kti ki jong nga , hynrei wat shah ba yn shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings , because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat .
translation.kha: U Solomon u pynkyntang ïa ka jaka pdeng jong ka phyllaw , ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u ai ki jingkñia hangta ba la thang tylli , ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ na ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba ka duwan rnong ba u la thaw ka rit than ïa kine ki jingainguh baroh .

translation.en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled , and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel , which ye have heard , and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven ; whereof I Paul am made a minister ;
translation.kha: Phi dei , da shisha , ban ïaineh ha ka nongrim kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad phim dei ban shah ïa lade ban shah pynkhynñiuh na ka jingkyrmen kaba phi la ïoh myn haba phi la ïohsngew ïa ka gospel . Ka dei na kane ka gospel ba ma nga u Paul , nga la kylla long u shakri — kane ka gospel kaba la ïalap ha uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun  ; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba saw u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka sngi , bad la shah ïa ka ban thang ïa ki briew da jingshit tyrha bajur jong ka .

translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Because the  Lord  hath heard that I was hated , he hath therefore given me this son also : and she called his name Simeon .
translation.kha: Ka la punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U  Trai  u la ai ruh ha nga ïa une u khun , namar u la ïohsngew ba ngam shym long kaba la ieit  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Simeon .

translation.en: But Jesus said ,  Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  namar ym don uba leh ïa ka kambah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , ba shen hadien un ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: Carry neither purse , nor scrip , nor shoes : and salute no man by the way .
translation.kha: Wat rah ïa ka pla pisa lane ïa ka pla khrong lane ïa ki juti ; wat sangeh ban khublei ïano ïano ha ka lynti .

translation.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen : and they inherited the labour of the people  ;
translation.kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ki ri jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad u la shah ïa ki ban shim noh ïa ki pyntha jong ki ,

translation.en: And said , If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and wilt do that which is right in his sight , and wilt give ear to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of these diseases upon thee , which I have brought upon the Egyptians : for I am the  Lord  that healeth thee .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Lada phi kohnguh ïa nga naduh ka dohnud da kaba leh ïa kata kaba nga ñiew ba ka long kaba dei , bad da kaba sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi da kano kano ka jingpang kaba nga la pynngat ha ki nong Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkhiah ïa phi .

translation.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people , and hast sinned against thy soul .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki buit jong phi ki wanrah ka jinglehrain ha la ka longïing ; da kaba pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew babun phi la wallam tang ka jingjot ha lade .

translation.en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed , to make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa kaba dang sah na kata ka umphniang un kyllan ha ka khlieh jong uta u briew , bad da kumta un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .

translation.en: What then ? are we better than they ? No , in no wise : for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles , that they are all under sin ;
translation.kha: Haba kumta , hato ma ngi ki Jiw ngi don ha kano kano ka bynta kaba kham bha ban ïa ki Jentil ? Ym kumta! Nga la lah pyn-i ba ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki long kumjuh baroh hapoh ka bor jong ka pop .

translation.en: His work is honourable and glorious : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba u leh ki dap da ka jingpyndonburom bad kaba iphieng ; ka hok jong u ka neh junom .

translation.en: With the work of an engraver in stone , like the engravings of a signet , shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel : thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold .
translation.kha: Wad ïa u bania uba tbit ba un ohdur ha kita ki ar tylli ki mawkordor ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob bad pynshong ïa ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim , when they heard that the Philistines fled , even they also followed hard after them in the battle .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat , kiba dang rieh ha ki lum Ephraim , ki la ïohsngew ba ki Philistia ki la phet krad ; kumta ki ruh ki la wan ïasoh bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ,

translation.en: But Gehazi , the servant of Elisha the man of God , said , Behold , my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian , in not receiving at his hands that which he brought : but , as the  Lord  liveth , I will run after him , and take somewhat of him .
translation.kha: haba u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha , u ong ha lade ,  U kynrad jong nga u la pyllait ïa u Naaman ban leit noh khlem da siew ei ei ! U la dei ban pdiang ïa kaei kaba uto u Syria u tyrwa ïa u . Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan mareh hadien jong u bad ngan ïoh ei ei na u .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u pynlong jingïasuk bad u syiem Israel .

translation.en: But even after that we had suffered before , and were shamefully entreated , as ye know , at Philippi , we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention .
translation.kha: Phi tip kumno ba ngi la shah lehbeiñ bad shah krenbeiñ ha Philippi shuwa ba ngin wan sha phi ha Thessaloni . Bad wat la ka la don ka jingpyrshah kaba jur , U Blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingshlur ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka Khubor Babha kaba wan na u .

translation.en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh , and went out from before Pharaoh .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kyrkhu khublei bad u leit noh .

translation.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel  ; and one king shall be king to them all : and they shall be no more two nations , neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all :
translation.kha: Ngan pyntylli ïa ki kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri , halor ki lumbah ka Israel ; kin don tang uwei u syiem u ban synshar halor jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ka jingïaphiah ha ki ar ki jaitbynriew lane ïabynta ha ki ar tylli ki hima .

translation.en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab : for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u la long syiem haba u la don arphew ar snem ka rta , bad u la synshar shisnem ha Jerusalem . U Ahasaïah ruh u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ka longïing jong u Syiem Ahab , naduh ba ka Athalaïah , ka kmie jong u — ka khun jong u syiem Ahab bad ka ksiew jong u Omri , u syiem ka Israel — ka la ai jingmut ïa u , kaba la ïalam sha ka jingsniew .

translation.en: If any man have an ear , let him hear .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery , which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God , who created all things by Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: U Blei uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , u la buhrieh ïa ka jingmaïan ha ki pateng baroh kiba mynshuwa ,

translation.en: And the king s servants said unto the king , Behold , thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , Syiem Kynrad ,  ki la jubab .  Ngi la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi ong .

translation.en: And Jacob sod pottage : and Esau came from the field , and he was faint :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Jakob u dang shet syrwa jhur , u Iso u la wan na kaba behmrad .

translation.en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses , through the heap of great waters .
translation.kha: Me ïuh halor ka duriaw da ki kulai jong me , bad ki umbah ki thnam shaid .

translation.en: And they did so  ; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and smote the dust of the earth , and it became lice in man , and in beast  ; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron u shoh ïa ka khyndew da la u diengduh ; te u pui pui baroh ha Ijipt u kylla mait , bad kumta la boi da u mait ha u briew bad ha u mrad .

translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon s princes , then thy soul shall live , and this city shall not be burned with fire  ; and thou shalt live , and thine house :
translation.kha: Te nga la ong ha u Sedekaïah ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Lada phi pyndem ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia , ïa ka jingim jong phi yn tyngkai , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn ym thang noh . Ïa phi bad ïa ka longïing jong phi yn pyllait im .

translation.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge , and fill his belly with the east wind ?
translation.kha: Ki ktien ba-thylli , ko Job ! Ki ktien ba-thylli !

translation.en: And , behold , there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot , and subtil of heart .
translation.kha: Bad hangta ka la ïakynduh ïa u , ka da riam kum ka nuti bad ka da pyrkhat sniew .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world , there shall also this , that this woman hath done , be told for a memorial of her .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga pynthikna ïa phi ba hangno hangno haba yn ïalap ïa kane ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ïa ka ban kynmaw ïa ka .

translation.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment : who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain :
translation.kha: me tap ïa lade da ka jingshai . Me pyiar ïa ki bneng kum ka ïingjaiñ

translation.en: Is not God in the height of heaven ? and behold the height of the stars , how high they are !
translation.kha: Hato U Blei um shong ha ki bneng kiba hajrong tam bad jngoh shapoh ïa ki khlur , wat la ki don hajrong ?

translation.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :
translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba stad uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u mawsiang .

translation.en: So then , brethren , we are not children of the bondwoman , but of the free .
translation.kha: Haba kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , ngim dei ki khun jong kata ka kynthei mraw , hynrei jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .

translation.en: Hearken not unto them  ; serve the king of Babylon , and live : wherefore should this city be laid waste ?
translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki ! Pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia bad phin im ! Balei ba kane ka nongbah kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra ?

translation.en: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles , and their offspring among the people : all that see them shall acknowledge them , that they are the seed which the  Lord  hath blessed .
translation.kha: Kin long kiba pawnam hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , uwei pa uwei uba ïohi ïa ki un tip ba ki long ki briew ïa kiba nga la kyrkhu .

translation.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter : so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men .
translation.kha: U Abijah bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki thom ïa ki Israel da ka jingjop kaba khraw — shiteng na ki shipai bakynsai ka Israel ki la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohkem shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . U la buh bun tylli ki kulai na ka bynta ki shispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ïa kiba sah u la pyndkoh .

translation.en: Come , my beloved , let us go forth into the field  ; let us lodge in the villages .
translation.kha: Nga la wan hiar napdeng ki dieng Almond ban ïohi ïa ki jingthung balung ha ka them , ban ïohi ïa ki sla bathymmai halor ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki syntiew halor ki diengsoh Pomkranet .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall make thee a desolate city , like the cities that are not inhabited  ; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee , and great waters shall cover thee  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba shah iehnoh kum ki nongbah ba la pynjot ha kaba ym don mano mano ban shong hangta . Ngan tap ïa pha da ka um jong ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah .

translation.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour : but the rich hath many friends .
translation.kha: Ym don kiba sngewtynnat ïa kiba duk , wat ki paramarjan jong ki , hynrei kiba riewspah ki don shibun ki paralok .

translation.en: The book Holocaust Politics , published in 2001 , says : “If more people practiced versions of what the Jehovah’s Witnesses preach and practice , the Holocaust could have been prevented and genocide would scourge the world no more .”
translation.kha: Ka kot Holocaust Politics , ia kaba la pynmih ha u snem 2001 , ka ong , “lada khambun naki briew ki pynmlien banleh ia kaba ki nongsakhi u Jehoba ki ialap bad leh , ia ka jingpynjot ia ka jingim yn jin dala lah ban iada bad kan nym don shuh ka jingpynduh jait ka ban pynshitom ha ka pyrthei .”

translation.en: And said , If Esau come to the one company , and smite it , then the other company which is left shall escape .
translation.kha: U la pyrkhat ,  Lada u Iso u wan ïaleh ïa kawei ka kynhun bad u pynjot ïa ka , kata kawei pat ka kynhun ka lah ban lait im .

translation.en: And when he had lifted up his eyes , he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city : and the old man said , Whither goest thou ? and whence comest thou ?
translation.kha: Uta u tymmen u ïohi ha madan shnong ïa uta u nongleit jingleit bad u kylli ïa u ,  Na-ei phi wan ? Shano phin leit ?

translation.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God : but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways , and hatred in the house of his God .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa nga kum u nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel . La katta ruh shano shano ba nga leit , phi pyrshang ban riam ïa nga kum ïa ka sim . Wat ha ka Templ U Blei , ki briew ki dei ki nongshun jong u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible .
translation.kha: Naba ym don kano kano kaba U Blei um lah ban leh .

translation.en: Therefore will he give them up , until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth : then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta , U  Trai  un sa aiti noh ïa la ki briew sha ki nongshun jong ki haduh ba ka briew ka ban sa kha kan ïoh ïa u khun jong ka . Nangta kito ki paid Israel kiba dang don ha ka jingshah ringmraw kin wan ïasoh lang bad ki briew la jong .

translation.en: Did I fear a great multitude , or did the contempt of families terrify me , that I kept silence , and went not out of the door ?
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju sheptieng ïa kaei kaba ki briew kin ong ; ngam ju sngap jar ne shong hapoh ïing namar ba sheptieng ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong ki .

translation.en: He mocketh at fear , and is not affrighted  ; neither turneth he back from the sword .
translation.kha: Kim tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingsheptieng , bad ym don waitlam kaba lah ban pynphai dien ïa ki .

translation.en: And made him king over Gilead , and over the Ashurites , and over Jezreel , and over Ephraim , and over Benjamin , and over all Israel .
translation.kha: Hangta u Abner u thung ïa u Ishbosheth kum u syiem jong ki ri ha Gilead , Asher , Jesreel , Ephraim , bad Benjamin , bad shisha halor ka Israel baroh kawei .

translation.en: To the weak became I as weak , that I might gain the weak : I am made all things to all men , that I might by all means save some .
translation.kha: Hapdeng kiba tlot ha ka jingngeit nga long uba tlot kum uwei na ki , khnang ban jop ïa ki . Kumta nga don ka jingïadei ha baroh ïa ki briew baroh , khnang ba nga lah ban pyllait katto katne na ki da ki lad baroh kiba don .

translation.en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day : wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta u Akhish u ai ha u ïa ka shnong Siklag , bad na kane ka daw ka Siklag ka long noh ka jong ki syiem Judah naduh kata ka por .

translation.en: And Saul said , Blessed be ye of the  Lord   ; for ye have compassion on me .
translation.kha: U Saul u jubab ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ba lehsbun ïa nga !

translation.en: But before faith came , we were kept under the law , shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ka por ba ka jingngeit kan wan , ka Hukum ka set ïa ngi baroh kum ki koidi tad haduh ban da pynpaw ïa kane ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings  ; and they love him that speaketh right .
translation.kha: U syiem u kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingshisha bad u sngewbha ïa kito kiba kren ïa ka .

translation.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked : but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness .
translation.kha: U Blei , uta uba hok , u tip ïa kaei kaba jia ha ki longïing ki riewbymman , bad un wallam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jingpra .

translation.en: Some men s sins are open beforehand , going before to judgment ; and some men they follow after .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba ki pop jong ki , ki long kiba paw tyngkreiñ , bad ki pop jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa jong ki sha ka jingbishar ; hynrei ki pop jong kiwei pat ki paw kham hadien .

translation.en: Wherefore we labour , that , whether present or absent , we may be accepted of him .
translation.kha: Pynban , palat ban ïa kaei kaei baroh , ngi kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u , la ngi don ha kane ka ïing hangne lane hangtei .

translation.en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes , the chief ruler of the synagogue , and beat him before the judgment seat . And Gallio cared for none of those things .
translation.kha: Ki baroh ki la kem ïa u Sosthenes , uta u nongïalam jong ka synagog , bad ki la shoh ïa u ha khmat jong ka ïingbishar . Hynrei kata kam shym pynsalia wat khyndiat ruh ïa u Gallio .

translation.en: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things , yet he himself is judged of no man .
translation.kha: Pynban uno uno uba don U Mynsiem , u lah ban bishar ïa ka dor jong kiei kiei baroh , hynrei ym don uba lah ban bishar ïa u .

translation.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward : and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .
translation.kha: U shim jingkheiñ ïa baroh ki shynrang Lebi kiba la don laiphew snem lane tam . Baroh ki don laiphew phra hajar ngut .

translation.en: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants , and to eat and drink with the drunken  ;
translation.kha: bad un sdang ban shoh ïa la ki para shakri bad ban ïabam ïadih bad ki nongbuaid .

translation.en: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat , thou shalt destroy and cut them down  ; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee , until it be subdued .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban pynngat ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng bad pyndonkam ïa ki ha kaba tei ïa ki kynton ïada pyrshah ïa kata ka shnong haduh ba kan da kyllon .

translation.en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs , and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell . Arise , my love , my fair one , and come away .
translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u don ka jingiw jong ka mirr haba u dem halor ka shadem jong nga .

translation.en: I have heard many such things : miserable comforters are ye all .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew kum kita ki ktien mynshuwa ; ka jingpyntngen kaba phi ai ka long tang ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel  ;
translation.kha: Pynban , kane ka long kaei kaba u Joel u nongïathuhlypa u la kren shaphang jong ka :

translation.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us , Make brick : and , behold , thy servants are beaten  ; but the fault is in thine own people .
translation.kha: Ym shym la ai phlangïap shuh ïa ngi , hynrei la ïai hukum ïa ngi ban shna maw-it ! Bad mynta pat ngi shah shoh . Dei ki briew jong phi keiñ kiba bakla .

translation.en: For brass I will bring gold , and for iron I will bring silver , and for wood brass , and for stones iron : I will also make thy officers peace , and thine exactors righteousness .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa pha ïa ka ksiar ha ka jaka ka rnong , ka rupa bad ka tama ha ka jaka u nar bad ka dieng , bad u nar ha ka jaka u maw . Ki nongsynshar jong pha kin ym banbeiñ shuh ïa pha ; ngan pynlong ïa ki ban synshar da ka hok bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Now ye are the body of Christ , and members in particular .
translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ka met U Khrist , bad uwei pa uwei u long u bynta jong ka .

translation.en: The sun ariseth , they gather themselves together , and lay them down in their dens .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka mih , ki leit phai noh bad ki thiah ha ki krem jong ki .

translation.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac , I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these which are of the daughters of the land , what good shall my life do me ?
translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka ong ha u Isaak ,  Nga la sngewngiah bad sngewthait ïa ki tnga nongwei jong u Iso . Lada u Jakob ruh u shongkurim ïa kawei na kine ki nong Hit , nga lah ban sa shu ïap noh ruh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts , that they may come up upon the land of Egypt , and eat every herb of the land , even all that the hail hath left .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti halor ka ri Ijipt ban wallam ïa ki puit . Kin wan bad bam ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba mih , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba lait na u phria .

translation.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate  ; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the  Lord  had commanded to Israel .
translation.kha: Haba la poi u bnai uba hynñiew , ki briew ka Israel ki la ïashong ïasah ha ki shnong . Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong uta u bnai , ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem , ha ka jaka basawdong hapoh ka Khyrdop Um . Ki ong ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ka Hukum ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses , ban wanrah ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum .

translation.en: So ye in like manner , when ye shall see these things come to pass , know that it is nigh , even at the doors .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , haba phi ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei ba ki jia , phin tip ba ka por ka la jan , kaba la kloi ban sdang .

translation.en: And thou shalt take fine flour , and bake twelve cakes thereof : two tenth deals shall be in one cake .
translation.kha: Shim khat-ar kilo u  purew bad shet khat-ar tylli ki kpu .

translation.en: Doth not he see my ways , and count all my steps ?
translation.kha: U Blei u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga leh ; u ïohi man ka sien jam ba nga jam .

translation.en: Their wings were joined one to another  ; they turned not when they went  ; they went every one straight forward .
translation.kha: Ar tylli ki thapniang jong uwei uwei u jingthaw ki pyiar bad kita ki jingthaw ki pynlong ïa ka dur basawdong da ki khmut thapniang kiba ïakynduh . Haba ki khih , ki khih kum ka kynhun khlem da pynphai ïa ki met jong ki .

translation.en: But the  Lord  hath taken you , and brought you forth out of the iron furnace , even out of Egypt , to be unto him a people of inheritance , as ye are this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi , phi dei ki briew kiba u la pyllait im na Ijipt , ka pajwa kaba klang da ka ding . U la wan ïalam ïa phi ban pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumne kumba phi long mynta .

translation.en: And the first went , and poured out his vial upon the earth  ; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast , and upon them which worshipped his image .
translation.kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la leit bad u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka pyrthei . Ki prum kiba shyrkhei bad kiba tyrha ki la mih ha kito kiba la don ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw bad ha kito kiba la mane ïa ka dur jong u .

translation.en: Shall they therefore empty their net , and not spare continually to slay the nations ?
translation.kha: Hato kin pyndonkam ïa la ki waitlam junom bad ïai pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew khlem jingisynei ?

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you .
translation.kha: Ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu to kan long lem bad phi .

translation.en: And now is not Boaz of our kindred , with whose maidens thou wast ? Behold , he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba une u briew , u Boas , uba phi la ïatrei lem bad ki kynthei jong u , u dei u ba-ha-ïing jong ngi . Shahshkor mynta . Ha kane ka janmiet un leit dung ïa u barli .

translation.en: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts , as of woollen and linen together .
translation.kha: Wat phong ïa ka jaiñ ba la thain lang da u  saiwul bad u  sai linen .

translation.en: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar : and they filled a sponge with vinegar , and put it upon hyssop , and put it to his mouth .
translation.kha: La don ka pliang hangta , kaba dap da ka waiñ ka bym bha ; kumta la wieh ïa spoiñ ha ka waiñ , la teh ha ka khum Hissop , bad la kyntiew ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u .

translation.en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , who made Israel sin , but walked therein : and there remained the grove also in Samaria . )
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la iehnoh ïa ki pop sha kiba u syiem Jeroboam u la ïalam ïa ki Israel , hynrei ki ïai leh ïa ki ; bad ka durblei Asherah ka dang ïaisah ha Samaria .

translation.en: The captain of fifty , and the honourable man , and the counsellor , and the cunning artificer , and the eloquent orator .
translation.kha: ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki nongïalam paidbah jong ki , ïa ki nongmihkhmat paidbah jong ki bad ïa baroh kiba pyndonkam ïa ka myntor ban bat ïa kino kino ki jingjia .

translation.en: And that ye may prolong your days in the land , which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed , a land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh shong slem ruh ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba U  Trai  u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .

translation.en: Ye have condemned and killed the just  ; and he doth not resist you .
translation.kha: Phi la pynrem bad phi la pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui , bad kim shym pyneh ïa phi .

translation.en: And now , behold , I know well that thou shalt surely be king , and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand .
translation.kha: Mynta nga da sngewthikna ba phin sa long u syiem ki Israel bad ba ka hima Israel kan ïaineh ha ka jingsynshar jong phi .

translation.en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief , that he might have mercy upon all .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la pynlong ïa baroh ki briew , ki koidi jong ka jingbymkohnguh , khnang ba un lah ban pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: All things are delivered unto me of my Father : and no man knoweth the Son , but the Father  ; neither knoweth any man the Father , save the Son , and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him .
translation.kha: U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ym don mano mano ba ithuh ïa U Khun lait tang U Kpa , bad ym don mano mano ba ithuh ïa U Kpa lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba U Khun u jied ban pynpaw ïa u .

translation.en: But if a man live many years , and rejoice in them all  ; yet let him remember the days of darkness  ; for they shall be many . All that cometh is vanity .
translation.kha: To long uba sngewnguh ïa kawei pa kawei ka snem ba phi im . Kam pher haduh katno phi im , kynmaw ba phin ïap kham slem . Kam don kano kano ruh ïa ka ban khmih lynti .

translation.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth : And Joseph opened all the storehouses , and sold unto the Egyptians  ; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka  nemsniew ka la kham jur , bad ka la saphriang ïa ka ri baroh kawei , u Joseph u la plie ïa kita ki ïing kynshew jingbam baroh , bad u la die kew ha ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: And , lo , a spirit taketh him , and he suddenly crieth out  ; and it teareth him that he foameth again , and bruising him hardly departeth from him .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymman u tur ïaleh ïa u da ka jinglynñiar kynsan bad bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring , ba kumta u sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur ; u ïai pynshitom ïa u bad da kaba eh un pyllait ïa u !

translation.en: And I looked , and behold a pale horse : and his name that sat on him was Death , and Hell followed with him . And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth , to kill with sword , and with hunger , and with death , and with the beasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai uba lieh bthuh . Ïa u nongshong kulai la ai kyrteng  ka Jingïap  , bad ka Hades ka bud syndah nadien . La ai ha ki ka bor halor shipawa na ka pyrthei , ban pynïap da ka thma , ka  nemsniew , ka khlam , bad da ki mradkhlaw .

translation.en: He sent his word , and healed them , and delivered them from their destructions .
translation.kha: U pynkhiah ïa ki da ka hukum jong u bad pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingtep .

translation.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me : for I trust in thy word .
translation.kha: Te ngan lah ban jubab ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga namar nga shaniah ha ka ktien jong me .

translation.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee , and despise not thy mother when she is old .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa la u kpa ; khlem ma u phin ym ïoh jingim . Haba ka kmie ka la tymmen , pyn-i ha ka ïa ka jingïaroh jong phi .

translation.en: For your shame ye shall have double  ; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion : therefore in their land they shall possess the double : everlasting joy shall be unto them .
translation.kha: Ki jinglehrain bad jingjahburom jong phi kin kut noh . Phin sa shong ha la ka jong ka ri , bad ka spah jong phi kan roi ar shah ; ka jingkmen jong phi kan neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Sound speech , that cannot be condemned ; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say of you .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam da ki ktien kiba shongnia ïa kiba yn ym don ba wad daw , khnang ba yn ïoh pynlehrain ïa ki nongshun jong me da ka bym don ei ei kaba sniew ban ïoh kren pyrshah shaphang jong ngi .

translation.en: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds , his knops , and his flowers :
translation.kha: Ka ktang jong uta u diengpynïeng sharak ka don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ka dur ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .

translation.en: Yet ye say , The way of the Lord is not equal . Hear now , O house of Israel  ; Is not my way equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
translation.kha: Hynrei phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh kam long kaba dei .’ To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki Israel . Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki lynti jong nga kiba nga leh ïa kiei kiei kim long kiba dei ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dei .

translation.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost , and Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph hindermost .
translation.kha: U buh ha khmat eh ïa ki tnga kliar bad ki khun jong ki , nangta sa ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka , bad khatduh ïa ka Rakhel bad u Joseph hadien duh .

translation.en: When therefore I have performed this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will come by you into Spain .
translation.kha: Haba nga la pyndep ïa kane ka kam bad ba nga la dep aiti sha ki ïa baroh ka pisa ïa kaba la dep pynmih na ka bynta jong ki , ngan sa mih ban leit sha Spain bad wan khmih artat ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti shata .

translation.en: Yea , and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba kwah ban im ïa ka jingim bariewblei ha U Khrist Jisu kin shah pynshitom ;

translation.en: For they were departed from Rephidim , and were come to the desert of Sinai , and had pitched in the wilderness  ; and there Israel camped before the mount .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki mihnoh na Rephidim , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba lai naduh ba ki mih na Ijipt ki wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sinai . Ki sher dara hangta ha kjat u Lum Sinai ,

translation.en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly : and indeed bear with me .
translation.kha: Nga da kwah ba phin ïaishah bad nga , wat haba nga leh bieit khyndiat . Sngewbha leh kumta!

translation.en: Say not , I will do so to him as he hath done to me : I will render to the man according to his work .
translation.kha: Wat ong ,  Ngan leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa nga ! Ngan leh kylliang kumba u la leh !

translation.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .
translation.kha: U briew uba bieit mutlop tam u kham bha ban ïa uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba stad haba um long kumta .

translation.en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he  ; take him , and lead him away safely .
translation.kha: U nongshetkylla u la lah ai ha u paidbah ïa ka dak :  U briew ïa uba ngan doh u dei uta ïa uba phi kwah . Kem ïa u bad ïalam ïa u da kaba ap phira bha .

translation.en: For through the anger of the  Lord  it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah , until he had cast them out from his presence , that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar haduh katta katta ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Judah ha kaba u la beh noh ïa ki na khmat jong u .

translation.en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols , nor with their detestable things , nor with any of their transgressions : but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces , wherein they have sinned , and will cleanse them : so shall they be my people , and I will be their God .
translation.kha: Kin ym pyntngit shuh ïa lade da ki bleithaw kiba ijli lane pynjot ïa lade da ka pop . Ngan pyllait ïa ki na ki lynti jong ka jingleh pop bad ka jingshetkylla ïa nga . Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki , kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban pynpait ïa u khra ha khmat jong ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit bad nga

translation.en: Ye that stand in the house of the  Lord  , in the courts of the house of our God ,
translation.kha: kiba ïeng ha ka ïing jong U  Trai  , ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt , to be a reproach and a proverb , a taunt and a curse , in all places whither I shall drive them .
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynngat ha ki ka jinglanot ha kaba ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei baroh kin da sngewshyrkhei , ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ki ; kin ïakren kai ïa ki , kin ïakynshi ïa ki , bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim kylleng kat shaba nga pynsakma ïa ki .

translation.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? this that is glorious in his apparel , travelling in the greatness of his strength ? I that speak in righteousness , mighty to save .
translation.kha: Uei une uba wan na ka nongbah Bosrah ha Edom ? Uei une uba riam itynnat ha ki jaiñkup rong saw u da ïaid ryngkat ha ka bor bad jingkhlaiñ ?   U dei U Trai , uba donbor ban pyllait im , u wan ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop jong u .

translation.en: His breasts are full of milk , and his bones are moistened with marrow .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki koit ki khiah haduh ka sngi ka jingïap ; ki ïap suk bad khlem shitom , ki met jong ki kiba la ïoh jingbsa bha .

translation.en: When the waves of death compassed me , the floods of ungodly men made me afraid  ;
translation.kha: Ki jingat phyllung ka jingïap ki don sawdong jong nga , ki jingat phyllung ka jingpynjot ki tyllun halor jong nga ;

translation.en: Let your will take place , as in heaven , also on earth .”
translation.kha: Long ka mon jong me ha ka khyndew kumba ha bneng .”

translation.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour ;
translation.kha: U Blei u la theh noh kyrhai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ngi lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi ,

translation.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded :
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la wan ha u Asaraïah u khun jong u Oded , bad u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem Asa .

translation.en: ( For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian , whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple . )
translation.kha: ( Ki la ong ïa kane namar ki la lah ïohi ïa u Trophimos uba na Ephesos ryngkat bad u Paul ha ka nongbah , bad ki la pyrkhat ba u Paul u la ïalam ïa u shapoh ka Templ . )

translation.en: Then the angel of the  Lord  went forth , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san hajar ngut ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ka sngi kaba bud hangta ki thiah , baroh ki la ïap !

translation.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel : and beside all this , to day is the third day since these things were done .
translation.kha: Bad ngi la kyrmen ba un dei ma u uta u ban sa wan ban pyllaitluid ïa ki Israel ! Nalor kata baroh , kane mynta ka dei ka sngi kaba lai naduh ba ka la jia .

translation.en: I was a father to the poor : and the cause which I knew not I searched out .
translation.kha: Nga la long kum u kpa ïa kiba duk bad nga la long ha ka liang ki nongwei haba ki shem jingeh .

translation.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made . He saith not , And to seeds , as of many ; but as of one , And to thy seed , which is Christ .
translation.kha: Mynta , U Blei u la pynlong ïa ki jingkular jong u ha u Abraham bad ha u nonghiarpateng jong u . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kam shym pyndonkam da ki kyntien  ki nonghiarpateng ,  kaba thew shibun ki briew , hynrei ka pyndonkam da ka kyntien  u nonghiarpateng ,  kaba mut tang uwei u briew , kaba mut U Khrist .

translation.en: The paper reeds by the brooks , by the mouth of the brooks , and every thing sown by the brooks , shall wither , be driven away , and be no more .
translation.kha: bad baroh ki jingthung ba la bet ha ki rudwah jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong bad yn sa rong noh .

translation.en: Suffer me that I may speak  ; and after that I have spoken , mock on .
translation.kha: Ai ïa nga ka lad ba ngan kren bad nangta , haba nga la dep kren , krenbeiñ lada phi kwah .

translation.en: In his days did Hiel the Beth–elite build Jericho : he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn , and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , u Hiel uba na Bethel u tei pat ïa ka Jerikho . Kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren da u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u Hiel u la duh noh ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , u Abiram mynba u buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka Jerikho , bad ïa u khun khatduh jong u , u Segub mynba u tei ïa ki khyrdop jong ka .

translation.en: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord  , Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the  Lord  given by Moses .
translation.kha: Katba dang sei ïa ka pisa na ka jaka kynshew , u Hilkaïah u shem ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum jong U  Trai  , ka Hukum kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Moses .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga , bad u la ong ,

translation.en: I was a stranger , and ye took me not in : naked , and ye clothed me not : sick , and in prison , and ye visited me not .
translation.kha: nga la long u nongwei , hynrei phim shym la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jong phi , nga la lyngkhuit , hynrei phim shym la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad nga la don ha ïingbyndi , hynrei phim shym la sumar ïa nga .’

translation.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly  ; and who knoweth the ruin of them both ?
translation.kha: kum kita ki briew kin shah pynjot ha ka shikhyllipmat . Hato phi sngewthuh ba ka jingjot kaba kumno kan lah ban jia na U Blei ne na u syiem ?

translation.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour , and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit .
translation.kha: Me la ai ha nga ïa ka jingim bad ka jingieit baïaineh , bad ka jingsumar sukher jong me ka ri pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots , and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate .
translation.kha: Ïa ki them kiba seisoh jong ka Judah la pyndap da ki kali ïapom ; ki shipai halor ki kulai ki da ïeng ha khmat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the Levites took down the ark of the  Lord  , and the coffer that was with it , wherein the jewels of gold were , and put them on the great stone : and the men of Beth–shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba don kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki halor uta u mawbah . Nangta ki nong Beth Shemesh ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa kiwei pat ki jingkñia ha U  Trai .

translation.en: A bell and a pomegranate , a bell and a pomegranate , round about the hem of the robe to minister in  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar hapdeng jong kita ki dur soh baroh sawdong , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people , because they were many : and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: ma u lem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la pdiang ïa kane ka jingai jingmut , bad u ong ha ki ,

translation.en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which I command thee this day , to do them .
translation.kha: Namar kata , kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la lah hikai ïa phi , sumar ban leh ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: Satisfying answers to life’s big questions . —Proverbs 2 :1-5 .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ba sngewhun jong ki jingkylli ba kongsan shaphang ka jingim .—Proberb 2 :1-5 .

translation.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher s coat unto him , ( for he was naked , ) and did cast himself into the sea .
translation.kha: U synran ïa uba U Jisu u ieit u la ong ha u Petros ,  U dei U Trai !  Haba u Petros u la ïohsngew ba dei U Trai , u tap da ka jaiñ ïa la ka met ( naba u la loit noh ïa la ki jaiñphong ) bad u la ryngkoh shapoh um .

translation.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country , even from Babylon .
translation.kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u kylli ,  Nangno kine ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong aïu ïa me ?  U Hesekaïah u jubab ,  Ki la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , na Babilonia .

translation.en: It is sown in dishonour ; it is raised in glory : it is sown in weakness ; it is raised in power :
translation.kha: Haba la tep , ka long kaba ijli bad kaba tlot ; haba yn pynmihpat , kan long kaba itynnat bad kaba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Who can discover the face of his garment ? or who can come to him with his double bridle ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban tar noh ïa ka jingsop bashabar jong u lane pynpei ïa ka atiar jingïada kaba u phong .

translation.en: And the statutes , and the ordinances , and the law , and the commandment , which he wrote for you , ye shall observe to do for evermore  ; and ye shall not fear other gods .
translation.kha: Phi dei borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la thoh na ka bynta jong phi . Phim dei ban kohnguh ïa kiwei ki blei ,

translation.en: ( Ecclesiastes 9 :5 ) Jesus taught that the dead will be resurrected —an unnecessary action if humans had an immortal soul .
translation.kha: ( Ekesiastis 9 :5 ) U Jisu u la hikai ba ia kiba iap yn sa pynmihpatlada ka mynsiem u briew ka im junom , yn ym donkam ban pynmihpat ia u .

translation.en: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers : so shalt thou find in the book of the records , and know that this city is a rebellious city , and hurtful unto kings and provinces , and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time : for which cause was this city destroyed .
translation.kha: ba phin hukum ban wad ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la buh . Lada phi leh kumta , phin shem ba kane ka nongbah ka la long borabor kaba ïaleh pyrshah bad ba naduh ki por mynhyndai , ka la ju ai jingshitom ïa ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar ki jylla . Ka long borabor kaba eh ban synshar ïa ki briew jong ka . Dei na kane ka daw ba ïa ka nongbah la pynjot .

translation.en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand : but the hand of the diligent maketh rich .
translation.kha: Ka jinglong jaipdeh kan pynlong ïa phi ban kyrduh , hynrei ka jingtrei shitom kan pynriewspah ïa phi .

translation.en: Did I say , Bring unto me ? or , Give a reward for me of your substance ?
translation.kha: Hato nga la pan na phi ban ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha lane ban tyrwa ei ei ïano ïano na ka bynta jong nga

translation.en: There the righteous might dispute with him  ; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge .
translation.kha: Nga long uba hok ; nga lah ban ïasaidnia bad U Blei ; un pynbna shisien pynbna , ba nga long uba hok .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ngan ai ha pha bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims  ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u hukum ïa uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ban shim ïa ka ding napdeng ki shalyntem kiba don hapoh ki kherub , uta u briew u rung shapoh bad u ïeng hajan kawei na ki shalyntem .

translation.en: Judas saith unto him , not Iscariot , Lord , how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us , and not unto the world ?
translation.kha: U Judas ( ym u Judas Iskariot ) u la ong ,  Ko Trai , kumno ka lah ban long ba men pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi bad ym ha ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita kiei kiei baroh kiba nga lah ban ñiew kum ka jingmyntoi ; ïa kine , nga la ñiew mynta ka jingduh na ka bynta U Khrist .

translation.en: Behold , I have made thee small among the heathen : thou art greatly despised .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Edom ,  Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba tlot bor ; baroh kin ibeiñ ïa pha .

translation.en: Saying , Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven , and whose sins are covered .
translation.kha: Suk kita ïa kiba la map noh ïa ki jingleh bymdei , kiba ïa ki pop la map noh!

translation.en: My face is foul with weeping , and on my eyelids is the shadow of death  ;
translation.kha: Nga la ïam haduh ba ka durkhmat jong nga ka la sawkyr-ang , bad ki khmat jong nga ki la sieb bad la paw syrngiew sawdong jong ki ,

translation.en: And Reuben spake unto his father , saying , Slay my two sons , if I bring him not to thee : deliver him into my hand , and I will bring him to thee again .
translation.kha: U Reuben u ong ha la u kpa ,  Lada ngam wan ïalam biang sha phi ïa u Benjamin , phi lah ban pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong nga baroh ar ngut . Buh ïa u ha ka jingsumar jong nga , bad ngan wan ïalam biang ïa u .

translation.en: And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Paul u la rung ha ka synagog bad ha ki lai bnai u la kren shlur bad ki paidbah , u da pynlong ki jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki bad pyrshang ban pynngeit ïa ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware , and will cut him in sunder , and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers .
translation.kha: nangta u kynrad un wan phai pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um tip . U kynrad un ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bad un pynlong ïa u ban ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong ki bymkohnguh .

translation.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold  ; for it is their perpetual possession .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka phlang kiba don sawdong ki shnong jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi , ym dei ban die ïa ki , namar ki long ka hok kynti jong ki shi junom .

translation.en: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded  ; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ka Ijipt la pynlehrain ; la jop ïa ki da ki briew ba na shatei . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites , Peradventure ye dwell among us  ; and how shall we make a league with you ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ong ,  Balei ngin pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad phi ? Ka lah ban long pynban ba phi shong phi sah hajan .

translation.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat , and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel , and all their transgressions in all their sins , putting them upon the head of the goat , and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness :
translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ki kti baroh ar ha ka khlieh jong uta u  langsohmoh , bad halor jong u un phla ïa ki jingbymman , ïa ki pop , bad ïa ki jingïaleh pyrshah baroh jong ki Israel , bad da kumta un pynkit ïa ki ha ka khlieh jong uta u  langsohmoh . Nangta dei ban ñiah noh ïa uta u  langsohmoh sha ka ri shyiap da u briew uba la jied kyrpang na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And he said unto him , If they hear not Moses and the prophets , neither will they be persuaded , though one rose from the dead .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u la ong , ‘ Lada kim shahshkor ïa u Moses bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , yn ym lah ban pynngeit ïa ki wat lada uno uno un mihpat na ka jingïap .’

translation.en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests ? therefore it shall be , that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king s house , thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests .
translation.kha: U Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh kin don hangta ; ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ïohsngew ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: For ye see your calling , brethren , how that not many wise men after the flesh , not many mighty , not many noble , are called :
translation.kha: Mynta to kynmaw aïu phi la long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi . Na ka liang kaba kynja briew tang khyndiat na phi , phi la long kiba stad ne kiba khlaiñbor ne kiba don kyrdan kaba halor ha ka imlang sahlang .

translation.en: Therefore the he goat waxed very great : and when he was strong , the great horn was broken  ; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh u la nang sngewmeng , hynrei ha ka jingdap rynïeng ka bor jong u , ka reng jong u ka la kheiñ . Ha ka jaka jong ka la wan mih saw tylli ki reng , kawei kawei ka phai sha ki liang baïapher .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Aaron , Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . And he went , and met him in the mount of God , and kissed him .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por U  Trai  u la ong ha u Aaron ,  Khie leit sha ka ri shyiap ban ïakynduh ïa u Moses .  Kumta u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u ha uta u lum bakhuid ; bad haba u ïashem bad u , u doh ïa u .

translation.en: And they said , If ye send away the ark of the God of Israel , send it not empty  ; but in any wise return him a trespass offering : then ye shall be healed , and it shall be known to you why his hand is not removed from you .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  Lada phi pynphai ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel , phi dei da shisha ban phah bad ka ïa ka jingai sngewbha sha u ban siew noh na ka bynta ka pop jong phi . Ka Synduk ka Jutang kam dei ban leit noh khlem ka jingai sngewbha . Da kumne , yn pynkoit ïa phi bad phin sa sngewthuh balei ba u ïai pynshitom ïa phi .

translation.en: For I have set my face against this city for evil , and not for good , saith the  Lord  : it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall burn it with fire .
translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut skhem ba ngan ym pynsah ïa kane ka nongbah , hynrei ban pynjot ïa ka . Yn ai ïa ka ha u syiem ka Babilonia , bad un thang lut khoit ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And forgive us our debts , as we forgive our debtors .
translation.kha: To map ïa ngi ïa ki jingpalat kiba ngi la leh , kumba ngi map ïa ki jingpalat kiba kiwei ki la leh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father : and the physicians embalmed Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u hukum ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met u kpa jong u . Ki nongkyllan jingiwbih ruh ki leh kumta .

translation.en: For with what judgment ye judge , ye shall be judged : and with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you again .
translation.kha: naba U Blei un bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi bishar ïa kiwei pat , bad un pyndei ha phi ïa kijuh ki jingthew kiba phi pyndei ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel , because it was desolate , so will I do unto thee : thou shalt be desolate , O mount Seir , and all Edom , even all of it : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: kumba me shadkmen ha ka jingpynjot ïa ka Israel , ka nongkynti jong nga . Ki lumbah ka Seir , ho-oid , baroh ka ri Edom kin sah kynjah . Te baroh kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And herein do I exercise myself , to have always a conscience void of offence toward God , and toward men .
