translation.kha: U Abner u leit sha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad u ong ha ki ,  La slem bah phi la kwah ïa u Dabid ban long u syiem jong phi .

translation.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rezin  ; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken , that it be not a people .
translation.kha: Balei ? Namar ba ka Syria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Damaskos , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Damaskos kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Resin . Katba ïa ka Israel , hapoh ki hynriewphew san snem yn sa pynkhynñiuh ïa ka ruh ban lait im kum ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven : if any man eat of this bread , he shall live for ever : and the bread that I will give is my flesh , which I will give for the life of the world .
translation.kha: Nga long u kpu uba im uba la wan hiar na bneng . Lada uno uno u bam ïa une u kpu , un im junom . U kpu ba ngan ai ha u , u long ka doh jong nga , ïa kaba nga ai khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ïoh im .

translation.en: Thy hands were not bound , nor thy feet put into fetters : as a man falleth before wicked men , so fellest thou . And all the people wept again over him .
translation.kha: Ym shym la teh ïa ki kti jong u , Bad ïa ki kjat jong u ym shym la khum ; U la ïap kum uba la shah pynïap ha ki nongkamsniew !  Bad ki briew baroh ki la ïam sa shisien pat na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Behold , I know your thoughts , and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me .
translation.kha: Nga tip ki jingmut pyrshah aïu phi don .

translation.en: But he slew not their children , but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses , where the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers , but every man shall die for his own sin .
translation.kha: Pynban um shym la pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong ki , hynrei u la bud ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ha Ka Hukum u Moses :  Ïa ki kmie ki kpa ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ïa ki khun ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba ma u hi u la leh .

translation.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins , which took their lamps , and went forth to meet the bridegroom .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don shiphew ngut ki theisotti kiba la rah ïa la ki sharak bad ki la mih ban ïashem ïa u nongleitkurim .

translation.en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people  ; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth .
translation.kha: Naba ha kane ka kynti ngan pynshitom ym tang ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ïa ki briew jong me , hynrei ïa me hi ruh , khnang ba men ïoh tip ba ym don uba kum ma nga ha ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers , which refused to hear my words  ; and they went after other gods to serve them : the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers .
translation.kha: Ki la leit phai pat sha ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba la kyntait ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Baroh ar , ka Israel bad ka Judah ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision ,  Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , hynrei ïai kren bad wat sangeh , naba nga long lem bad me .

translation.en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people : the  Lord  made me have dominion over the mighty .
translation.kha: Nangta kita kiba lah ban shaniah ki la wan hiar sha la ki nongïalam ; Ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la wan sha u da ka jinglakloi ban ïaleh .

translation.en: When he was removed out of the highway , all the people went on after Joab , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la pynkynriah ïa ka metïap na lynti , uwei pa uwei u la bud ïa u Joab ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .

translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net , that was cast into the sea , and gathered of every kind :
translation.kha: Kumjuh , ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . Katto katne ki nongtong dohkha ki bret ïa ka jar jong ki hapoh ka duriaw bad ki ïoh bun jait ki dohkha .

translation.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed .
translation.kha: To burom ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long tang marwei da shisha .

translation.en: And her lord rose up in the morning , and opened the doors of the house , and went out to go his way : and , behold , the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house , and her hands were upon the threshold .
translation.kha: Haba u tnga jong ka u khie ha kata ka step , bad haba u plie ïa ka jingkhang ban mih shabar ban leit noh , u lap ïa la ka tnga kliar ba ka thiah ha khmat jingkhang , ryngkat bad ki kti kiba kner sha kata ka jingkhang .

translation.en: Lo , he goeth by me , and I see him not : he passeth on also , but I perceive him not .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïaid najan , hynrei ngam ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward :
translation.kha: Ngi ong ïa kane namar ngi don ka jingsngewskhem ha U Blei lyngba U Khrist .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Peace be unto thee  ; fear not : thou shalt not die .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Long ka jingsuk . Wat sheptieng . Men ym ïap .

translation.en: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum , there came unto him a centurion , beseeching him ,
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung shapoh Kapernam , u rangbah pynïaidkam ka Hima Rom u la wan ïakynduh ïa u bad u la kyrpad jingïarap :

translation.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father ?  They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .
translation.kha: Uno na kine ar ngut uba la leh ïa kaei kaba u kpa u la kwah ?   Uta uba kham san ,  ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ong ha phi : Ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki leit rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity , and is polluted with blood .
translation.kha: Ka Gilead ka long ka nongbah kaba dap da ki riewbymman bad ki nongpynïap briew .

translation.en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen : and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen , whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots , and with the king at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Solomon u lumlang ïa ki shihajar sawspah tylli ki kali ïapom bad khat-ar hajar tylli ki kulai thma . Katto katne na kita u buh ha Jerusalem , bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .

translation.en: The people asked , and he brought quails , and satisfied them with the bread of heaven .
translation.kha: Ki pan , bad u phah ïa ki syiar khlaw ; u ai ïa ki ka jingbam na bneng ban pynhun ïa ki .

translation.en: I will send my fear before thee , and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come , and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa phi ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan pynkulmar thlim ïa kito kiba phi ïaleh pyrshah , bad ngan pynher krad ïa ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Jerubbaal , and Bedan , and Jephthah , and Samuel , and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side , and ye dwelled safe .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u Gideon , u Barak , u Jephthah , bad khatduh ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei na ngi , ngi la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi , bad phi la ïoh shongsuk shongshngain .

translation.en: And the Levites , of the children of the Kohathites , and of the children of the Korhites , stood up to praise the  Lord  God of Israel with a loud voice on high .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi kiba dei na ka kur u Kohath bad u Korah ki ïeng bad da ka sur kaba jam ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Then Saul arose , and went down to the wilderness of Ziph , having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him , to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph .
translation.kha: U Saul u leit mar mar ryngkat bad lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel sha ka ri khlaw Siph ban wad ïa u Dabid ,

translation.en: Will a lion roar in the forest , when he hath no prey ? will a young lion cry out of his den , if he have taken nothing ?
translation.kha: Hato u sing u ju kyrhuh ha khlaw lymda u la lap ei ei ban kynrup ? Hato u sing samla u ju byrngem ha la krem lymda u la ïohkem ei ei ?

translation.en: For true and righteous are his judgments : for he hath judged the great whore , which did corrupt the earth with her fornication , and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand .
translation.kha: Ki jingbishar jong u ki long kiba shisha bad kiba hok ! U la pynrem ïa ka nuti kaba pynpyut ïa ka khyndew da ki jingawria jong ka . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki shakri jong u .

translation.en: Then he said unto them ,  O fools , and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Katno kiba bieit phi long , katno phi long kiba suki ban ngeit ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong !

translation.en: And hast given them this land , which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them , a land flowing with milk and honey  ;
translation.kha: Me la ai ha ki ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Behold , they have there with them their two sons , Ahimaaz Zadok s son , and Jonathan Abiathar s son  ; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear .
translation.kha: Ki don bad ki ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan , bad phi lah ban phah ïa ki sha nga lem bad ki jingtip baroh kiba phi la ïohlum .

translation.en: And Samuel told him every whit , and hid nothing from him . And he said , It is the  Lord  : let him do what seemeth him good .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u ïathuh ha u nadong shadong ; um shym buhrieh ei ei shuh na u . U Eli u ong ,  U long U  Trai  ; ieh un leh katba u sngewbit ïa u .

translation.en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves , he said unto them ,  Why reason ye these things in your hearts ?
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïa-pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki .  Balei ba phi ïa-pyrkhat kum ïa kita kiei kiei ?

translation.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon , and in Shaalbim : yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed , so that they became tributaries .
translation.kha: Ki Amor ki dang sah ha Aijalon , Shaalbim , bad ha u Lum Heres , hynrei ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ki buh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong ki bad ki pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And again he sent unto them another servant  ; and at him they cast stones , and wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully handled .
translation.kha: Nangta u trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw ; ki nongshimwai ki la tied ïa u na ka khlieh bad ki la leh khlem akor ïa u .

translation.en: Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki lur ïa ki lyngkha jong ka jingsniew bad ki bet ïa ka jingbymman kum u symbai ; mynta ki ot da ka jingbymman bad ka jingsniew .

translation.en: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : he hath a blemish  ; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God .
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew uba hiarpateng na u Aaron , u lyngdoh , uba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .

translation.en: For as we have many members in one body , and all members have not the same office :
translation.kha: Ngi don bun ki dkhot ha kawei ka met bad baroh kine ki dkhot ki don ki jingtreikam bapher bapher .

translation.en: Labour not to be rich : cease from thine own wisdom .
translation.kha: To long uba stad bha ym ban ym pyrshang ban pynpaw ïa lade ban ïoh spah .

translation.en: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongaplangbrot ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba u angel u la ïathuh shaphang u khunlung .

translation.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received , how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ;
translation.kha: Nga la aiti ha phi ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohpdiang , kaba long kaba donkam tam : Ba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ;

translation.en: But let him ask in faith , nothing wavering . For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai , phi dei ban ngeit bad ban ym artatien da lei lei . Uno uno uba artatien u long kum ka jingat phyllung ha ka duriaw ïa kaba la beh bad ba la pynshad kynting da ka lyer .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord  for the avenging of Israel , when the people willingly offered themselves .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ki Israel ki la kut jingmut ban ïaleh ; U paidbah da kaba kmen u tyrwa mon sngewbha .

translation.en: And it was broken in that day : and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ka jutang la pyndam noh ha kata ka sngi . Kito kiba la thied bad die ïa ki langbrot ki ap khmih ïa nga , bad ki tip ba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba kaei kaba nga la leh .

translation.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .
translation.kha: Pynban , ka jingbhabriew jong phi ka shong ha ka jinglong bashisha hapoh jong phi , ka jingbhabriew bym sti noh jong ka mynsiem ba long jai jai bad bajar jar , kaba long kaba khraw tam ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakhin u la don khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar tang lai bnai bad shiphew sngi ha Jerusalem . U ruh u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Fear not  ; for thou shalt not be ashamed : neither be thou confounded  ; for thou shalt not be put to shame : for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth , and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more .
translation.kha: Wat nym sheptieng — phan ym shah pynlehrain biang ; phan ym shah pynjahburom . Phan klet noh ïa ka jingbymlongkhuid kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , bad ïa ka jinglong marwei ba shah ibeiñ kum ka riewkynthei .

translation.en: Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi bad u la ïohi kumno U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa ki briew , u la kmen bad u la kyntu ïa ki baroh ban ïaineh bad ban long kiba beit ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .

translation.en: That he told her all his heart , and said unto her , There hath not come a razor upon mine head  ; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother s womb : if I be shaven , then my strength will go from me , and I shall become weak , and be like any other man .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha .  Ïa u shñiuh jong nga ym pat ju khap ,  u ong ,  Ïa nga la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir naduh ka por ba kha ïa nga . Lada la khi ïa u shñiuh jong nga , ngan duh noh ïa ka bor bad ngan long uba tlot kumba long lem kiwei .

translation.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En–rogel  ; for they might not be seen to come into the city : and a wench went and told them  ; and they went and told king David .
translation.kha: U Jonathan , u khun jong u Abiathar , bad u Ahimaas , u khun jong u Sadok , ki dang ap hajan ka umpohliew Enrogel , kaba ha rudnong jong ka Jerusalem , namar kim nud ban rung shapoh ka nongbah ïoh don ba ïohi ïa ki . Kawei ka shakri kynthei ka ju leit ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba jia , bad ki pat ki ju leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid .

translation.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali , even for the children of Naphtali according to their families .
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba hynriew la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Naphtali .

translation.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew , circumcision nor uncircumcision , Barbarian , Scythian , bond nor free : but Christ is all , and in all .
translation.kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka long ba ym don shuh ka jingpynïapher hapdeng ki Jentil bad ki Jiw , kiba la shah otsher bad ki bym shym la shah otsher , ki riewkhlaw , ki riewdum , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid ; hynrei U Khrist u long baroh , U Khrist u long ha baroh .

translation.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood .
translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba wat ka jutang kaba nyngkong ka treikam tang da kaba pyndonkam da ka snam .

translation.en: Why standest thou afar off , O  Lord  ? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble ?
translation.kha: Balei me don jngai palat , A  Trai  ? Balei me buhrieh ïa lade haba ngi don ha ka jynjar ?

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: And then shall many be offended , and shall betray one another , and shall hate one another .
translation.kha: Shibun kin iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki ha kata ka por ; kin ïashetkylla iwei ïa iwei pat bad kin isih iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor , and ate the sacrifices of the dead .
translation.kha: Nangta ha Peor , ki briew jong U Blei ki la ïasnohlang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal , bad bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki blei bym don jingim .

translation.en: What Is the Good News ?
translation.kha: Kaei Ka Khubor Babha ?

translation.en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u long syiem haba u la don khathynriew snem ka rta ; bad u synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jerusalem .

translation.en: He said also unto me , Turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Men dang ïohi ïa ki ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli ban ïa kata .

translation.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the  Lord  abhorreth .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u sngewsarong ha la ki jong ki jingkwah basniew ; u riewlalot u tim bad kyntait ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead , and the people made him head and captain over them : and Jephthah uttered all his words before the  Lord  in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jephthah u leit bad ki nongïalam ka Gilead , bad u paidbah u thung ïa u kum u nongsynshar bad u nongïalam jong ki . U Jephthah u pynpaw ïa ki kyndon na ka liang jong u ha Mispah ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land , and shalt gather in the fruits thereof :
translation.kha: Ha ki hynriew snem to thung to tep ha la ka lyngkha , bad lumlang ïa ki jingmih jong ka .

translation.en: And Saul said , They have brought them from the Amalekites : for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God  ; and the rest we have utterly destroyed .
translation.kha: U Saul u jubab ,  Ki briew jong nga ki la shim ïa ki na ki Amalek . Ki la buh ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïa kiba sah ngi la pynduh lut khoit .

translation.en: But blessed are your eyes , for they see : and your ears , for they hear .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi , katno kiba donbok phi long ! Ki khmat jong phi ki ïohi bad ki shkor jong phi ki ïohsngew .

translation.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them , the Holy Ghost came on them  ; and they spake with tongues , and prophesied .
translation.kha: U Paul u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan ha ki ; ki la kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher bad ki la pynbna ruh ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .

translation.en: For as the rain cometh down , and the snow from heaven , and returneth not thither , but watereth the earth , and maketh it bring forth and bud , that it may give seed to the sower , and bread to the eater :
translation.kha: Ka ktien jong nga ka long kum ka ïor bad u slap kiba wan hap na suiñbneng ban ai um ïa ka pyrthei . Ki pynlong ïa ki jingthung ban san bad pynmih ïa u symbai ban ïoh bet bad ka jingbam ban bam .

translation.en: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned twenty years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba sanphew ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u Syiem ka Judah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar arphew snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country , Go into the harlot s house , and bring out thence the woman , and all that she hath , as ye sware unto her .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongsyntiat ,  Khie leit sha ka ïing jong ka nuti bad wan ïalam ïa ka bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka , kumba phi la kular ïa ka .

translation.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe , of which no man gave attendance at the altar .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai jong ngi , ïa uba kine kiei kiei ki kren , u wan na kawei pat ka jait , bad ym don uno uno u dkhot na ka jait jong u , uba la shakri kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: And the Father himself , which hath sent me , hath borne witness of me . Ye have neither heard his voice at any time , nor seen his shape .
translation.kha: Bad U Kpa , uba la phah ïa nga , u ruh u phla na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .
translation.kha: Ïa ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew la shna da ka rupa bad ka ksiar ; la pynwandur da ki kti ki briew .

translation.en: And Moses brought Aaron s sons , and put coats upon them , and girded them with girdles , and put bonnets upon them  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u wallam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u pynphong sopti ïa ki , u buh ïa ki panpoh sawdong ka syngkai jong ki , bad u pynteh tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: As for their rings , they were so high that they were dreadful  ; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four .
translation.kha: Ïa ki rmiang jong ki shalyntem la tap da ki khmat .

translation.en: And they were instant with loud voices , requiring that he might be crucified . And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïai pyrta da ka sur kaba jam eh ba ïa U Jisu dei ban sahnarphna , bad khatduh ka jingpyrta jong ki ka la jop .

translation.en: And all the people went to Gilgal  ; and there they made Saul king before the  Lord  in Gilgal  ; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the  Lord   ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad hangta ha ka jaka kyntang ki pynbna ba u Saul u long u syiem . Ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad u Saul bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalehkmen ha kane ka jingjia .

translation.en: Ye shall do my judgments , and keep mine ordinances , to walk therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Bud ïa ki aiñ jong nga , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering ; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance ?
translation.kha: Lane lehse phi ibeiñ ïa ka jingsbun bakhraw jong u , ka jingshah laitluid , bad ka jingïaishah . Da shisha phi tip ba U Blei u long uba sbun , namar u pyrshang ban ïalam ïa phi ban kylla-kaba-mut .

translation.en: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin , saying , Go and lie in wait in the vineyards  ;
translation.kha: Ki ong ha ki Benjamin ,  Khie leit rieh ha ki bri sohwaiñ bad ap khmih .

translation.en: And his head was brought in a charger , and given to the damsel : and she brought it to her mother .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khlieh la wallam shapoh ha ka pliang bad la ai ha ka khynnah , kaba la rah ïa ka sha la ka kmie .

translation.en: Then said I , I will not feed you : that that dieth , let it die  ; and that that is to be cut off , let it be cut off  ; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ha ka kynhun langbrot ,  Ngan ym long shuh u nongaplangbrot jong phi . Ai kin ïap kito kiba dei ban ïap . Ai ba yn pynjot kito kiba dei ban shah pynjot . Kito kiba dang sah kin pynjot iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And God said , Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed  ; and thou shalt call his name Isaac : and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant , and with his seed after him .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  Em . Ka Sarah , ka tnga jong me kan sa kha khun shynrang ïa me , bad men khot kyrteng ïa u , u Isaak . Ngan bat ïa ka jutang jong nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ka dei ka jutang baïaineh junom .

translation.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified .
translation.kha: Te da kawei ka jingkñia , u la pynjanai ha la ka rta ïa kito kiba la pynkhuid na ka pop .

translation.en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent  ; thou shalt forgive him .
translation.kha: Lada u leh pop pyrshah ïa phi hynñiew sien ha ka shi sngi , bad man ka por u wan sha phi da kaba ong , ‘ nga kylla-kaba-mut ,’ phi dei ban map ïa u .

translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?
translation.kha: Balei U Blei un ainong ïa phi lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ? Wat ki nonglum khajna ki leh ïa kata !

translation.en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit , and his life from perishing by the sword .
translation.kha: Un ym shah ba yn pynjot ïa ki ; u pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingïap hi .

translation.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not  ; so he that getteth riches , and not by right , shall leave them in the midst of his days , and at his end shall be a fool .
translation.kha: U briew uba ïoh pisa da ka jingbymhok u long kum ka sim kaba pynmih khun na ki pylleng kiba ka khlem kha . Ha ka rta ba la ih bha un duh noh ïa ka spah jong u , bad ha kaba kut um long ei ei hynrei u bieit .

translation.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet : I will be glad in the  Lord .
translation.kha: To un kmen ïa ka jingrwai jong nga , namar ka jingkmen jong nga ka wan na u .

translation.en: And Abram said , Lord  God  , what wilt thou give me , seeing I go childless , and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abram u ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , kan myntoi aïu ka bainong jong me ïa nga haba ngam don khun ? U nongïoh pateng jong nga u dei tang u Eliesar uba na Damaskos .

translation.en: Which was the son of Enos , which was the son of Seth , which was the son of Adam , which was the son of God .
translation.kha: u khun jong u Enosh , u khun jong u Seth , u khun jong u Adam , u khun jong U Blei .

translation.en: For we are labourers together with God : ye are God s husbandry , ye are Gods building .
translation.kha: Naba ngi long ki nongïatrei lem bad U Blei , phi long ka lyngkha jong U Blei , phi long ruh ka jingtei jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Cast the net on the right side of the ship , and ye shall find .  They cast therefore , and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Bret ïa ka jar shaphang kamon jong ka lieng , bad phin sa ngat katto katne .  Kumta ki la bret ïa ka jar bad kim lah tan shuh ïa ka , namar ba ki la ngat bun eh ki dohkha .

translation.en: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me , and have multiplied your words against me : I have heard them .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki rukom kren kob-pia jong me ba me la kren pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And Elisha said unto him , Go , say unto him , Thou mayest certainly recover : howbeit the  Lord  hath shewed me that he shall surely die .
translation.kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha nga ba un ïap ; hynrei khie leit sha u bad ïathuh ha u ba un koit pat .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were gone over , that Elijah said unto Elisha , Ask what I shall do for thee , before I be taken away from thee . And Elisha said , I pray thee , let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me .
translation.kha: Hangta , u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  To ong ha nga kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ha shuwa ba yn shim noh ïa nga .   Ai ngan ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong ka bor jong phi ka ban pynlong ïa nga u nongmih bujli jong phi ,  u Elisha u jubab .

translation.en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne .
translation.kha: U Khunlangbrot u la leit bad u la shim ïa ka kot kli na ka kti kamon jong uta uba shong halor ka khet .

translation.en: And they all forsook him , and fled .
translation.kha: Te baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet noh .

translation.en: And the ark rested in the seventh month , on the seventeenth day of the month , upon the mountains of Ararat .
translation.kha: Te ha ka sngi kaba khathynñiew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , kata ka lieng ka wan neh den halor u lumbah ha ki lynter lum Ararat .

translation.en: And as David and his men went by the way , Shimei went along on the hill s side over against him , and cursed as he went , and threw stones at him , and cast dust .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki bteng la ka jingïaid lynti . U Shimei u bud ïa ki , u da ïaid na ka sharing lum ; u da tim bad kawang maw bad khyndew ha ki katba u dang ïaid .

translation.en: He shall not depart out of darkness  ; the flame shall dry up his branches , and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away .
translation.kha: Wat ka syrngiew jong u kan jah noh , bad un ym lait na ka jingdum . Un long kum u dieng ïa kiba ki tnat la thang da ka ding , uba ki shylluit la rong noh da ka lyer .

translation.en: And he could there do no mighty work , save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk , and healed them .
translation.kha: Um shym la lah ban leh kino kino ki kambah hangta , lait noh tang kaba buh ïa ki kti jong u ha ki khyndiat ngut ki briew kiba pang bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit . For of thorns men do not gather figs , nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng la tip da u soh uba u pynmih ; phim ju kheit soh Dumbur na ki bniap shiah lane lum ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki bniap shiah buid .

translation.en: And when Gideon was come , behold , there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow , and said , Behold , I dreamed a dream , and , lo , a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian , and came unto a tent , and smote it that it fell , and overturned it , that the tent lay along .
translation.kha: Haba u Gideon u la poi , u la ïohsngew ïa uwei u briew uba ïathuh ha la u paralok shaphang ka jingphohsniew . U ong ,  Nga phohsniew ba uwei u kpu barli u tyllun sha ka jaka sher dara jong ngi bad u tyngkhuh ïa ka dara . Ka dara ka la kyllon bad ka don lyngktar ha madan .

translation.en: When on earth Jesus cured the sick , fed the hungry , and calmed storms .
translation.kha: Mynba u Jisu u don ha pyrthei u pynkoit ïa kiba pang , u pynkdang ïa kiba thngan bad u pynjaijai ïa ki eriong .

translation.en: And her parents were astonished : but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done .
translation.kha: Ka kmie bad u kpa jong ka ki la lyngngoh shikatdei , hynrei U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba la jia .

translation.en: And Abram was fourscore and six years old , when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram .
translation.kha: U Abram u la don phraphew hynriew snem ha kata ka por .

translation.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him , and he passeth : thou changest his countenance , and sendest him away .
translation.kha: Me pynduhbor ïa u briew bad phah noh ïa u junom ; ka durkhmat jong u ka sniew dur ha ka por ka jingïap .

translation.en: On this side Jordan , in the valley over against Beth–peor , in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt at Heshbon , whom Moses and the children of Israel smote , after they were come forth out of Egypt :
translation.kha: Dei hadien ba ki la wan mih na Ijipt bad mynba ki don ha kata ka them kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan , marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Bethpeor , ba u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum . Kane ka long ha ka hima u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba synshar ha ka shnong Heshbon . Mynba U Moses bad ki Israel ki la jop ïa u ynda ki la mih na Ijipt .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What would ye that I should do for you ?
translation.kha: Kaei kata ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest , which are these ; Adultery , fornication , uncleanness , lasciviousness ,
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja briew ka leh ka long kaba paw shynna . Ka pynpaw ïa lade ha kaba klim , ka jingbymkhuid , bad ki jingleh khlem akor ;

translation.en: Then he called his twelve disciples together , and gave them power and authority over all devils , and to cure diseases .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la ai ha ki ka bor bad ka iktiar ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid baroh bad ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang .

translation.en: In fact , Tom told me never to come back to his house again .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , u Tom u iathuh ia nga ba ngam dei ban wan shuh ha iing jong u .

translation.en: They were stoned , they were sawn asunder , were tempted , were slain with the sword : they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins  ; being destitute , afflicted , tormented  ;
translation.kha: La lynthem maw ïa ki , la ot arliang ïa ki , la pynïap ïa ki da ka waitlam . Ki la ïaid kylleng , ki da phong da ki jaiñ snieh langbrot lane snieh blang — ha ka jingduk , ha ka jingshah pynshitom , bad ha ka jingshah lehbeiñ .

translation.en: The valley gate repaired Hanun , and the inhabitants of Zanoah  ; they built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate .
translation.kha: U Hanun bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah Sanoah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Them . Ki pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop , bad ki shna pynbha ïa ka kynroh kaba sawspah sawphew mitar , haduh ka Khyrdop Synrum .

translation.en: And God was with the lad  ; and he grew , and dwelt in the wilderness , and became an archer .
translation.kha: U Blei u la long ryngkat bad uta u khynnah katba u nang heh nang san ; u la im ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Paran bad u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit .

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .
translation.kha: Suit ksiar ïa kita ki jingker , bad pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban bat ïa ki diengkhap . Suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki diengkhap .

translation.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand : but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant s sake , whom I chose , because he kept my commandments and my statutes :
translation.kha: Hynrei , ngan ym knieh ïa ka hima baroh kawei na u Solomon , bad ngan pynneh ïa u ha ka bor katba u dang im . Kane ngan leh na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga , ïa uba nga la jied bad uba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: The candlestick also for the light , and his furniture , and his lamps , with the oil for the light ,
translation.kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar kiba ïadei bad u ; ïa ki sharak bad ka umphniang jong ki ;

translation.en: Then went Samson down , and his father and his mother , to Timnah , and came to the vineyards of Timnah : and , behold , a young lion roared against him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samson u leit hiar sha Timnah ryngkat bad la u kpa bad ka kmie . Katba ki dang ïaid lyngba ki bri sohwaiñ hangta , u ïohsngew ïa u sing samla ba u kyrhuh .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass at that time , that I will search Jerusalem with candles , and punish the men that are settled on their lees : that say in their heart , The  Lord  will not do good , neither will he do evil .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan shim ïa ka sharak bad wad ïa ka Jerusalem . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sngewhun ha lade bad kiba sngewskhem , kiba ong ha lade , ‘ U  Trai  um ju leh ei ei , kumne lane katai .’

translation.en: If one man sin against another , the judge shall judge him : but if a man sin against the  Lord  , who shall entreat for him ? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father , because the  Lord  would slay them .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh pop pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , U Blei u lah ban ïasaid na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei mano ba lah ban ïasaid na ka bynta u briew uba leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ?  Hynrei kim shym sngap ïa la u kpa , naba U  Trai  u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: For precept must be upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little :
translation.kha: U pyrshang ban hikai ha ngi ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai .

translation.en: And they passed over Jordan , and pitched in Aroer , on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad , and toward Jazer :
translation.kha: Ki la jam ïa ka Jordan bad ki la sher dara ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Aroer , ka nongbah kaba don hapdeng jong ka them , ha ka ri ki Gad . Na kata ka jaka ki la leit shaphang shatei sha Jaser ;

translation.en: Jesus’ ministry included teaching , performing miracles , and even offering up his life for us
translation.kha: Ki Kam u Jisu ki kynthup ïa ka ban hikai , ban leh ïa ki kambah , wat haduh ban aiti noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi

translation.en: Deliver thyself , O Zion , that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha la ki briew ,  Nga la pynsakma ïa phi ha ki liang baroh . Hynrei mynta , ma phi kiba shah ringmraw , phet noh na Babilonia bad leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Moses took half of the blood , and put it in basins  ; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar .
translation.kha: U Moses u shim shiteng na ka snam jong kita ki mrad bad u buh ïa ka ha ki dabor , bad shiteng pat na kata ka snam u synreit ha kata ka duwan .

translation.en: Thou therefore , my son , be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong me , ko khun jong nga , to long khlaiñ da ka jingaiei kaba dei ka jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , Micaiah the son of Imlah , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me , but evil . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .
translation.kha: U Ahab u jubab ,  Don sa uwei , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u , namar um ju ïathuhlypa ïa kaba bha shaphang jong nga , borabor ka dei tang ïa kaba sniew suda .   Phim dei ban ong kumta !  U Jehoshaphat u jubab .

translation.en: Charge them that are rich in this world , that they be not highminded , nor trust in uncertain riches , but in the living God , who giveth us richly all things to enjoy ;
translation.kha: To hukum ïa kita kiba riewspah ha kiei kiei jong kane ka jingim ba kin ym sngewsarong , hynrei ban buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ki , ym ha kata kaei kaei ka bym thikna kum ka spah , hynrei ha U Blei , uba ai kyrhai ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka jingsngewbha jong ngi .

translation.en: And their words pleased Hamor , and Shechem Hamor s son .
translation.kha: Kine ki kyndon ki ibit ibiang ïa u Hamor bad ïa u Shekhem u khun jong u ,

translation.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts : and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way .
translation.kha: Namarkata , to puson ha ki dohnud jong phi , halor ki jingai kiba kham donkam . Pynban , kaba bha tam ka long ka rukom kaba bud nangne .

translation.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes !
translation.kha: A katno nga kyrmen ba ngan long uba ïaineh ha kaba sumar ïa ki jingbthah jong me !

translation.en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went , and stood to view afar off : and they two stood by Jordan .
translation.kha: bad sanphew ngut na ki nongïathuhlypa ki la bud ïa ki sha ka Jordan . U Elijah bad u Elisha ki la sangeh harud wah , bad ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïeng kham pajih .

translation.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot : he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment .
translation.kha: U king ïa ka duriaw kum ka um kaba thnam bad u pynlong ïa ka ba kan tyrtho kum u khiew umphniang .

translation.en: Therefore the showers have been withholden , and there hath been no latter rain  ; and thou hadst a whore s forehead , thou refusedst to be ashamed .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba la bat noh ïa u slap , bad u slap pyrem um shym la wan . Pha la da i syriem hi kum ka nuti ; pham don kano kano ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , This woman said unto me , Give thy son , that we may eat him to day , and we will eat my son to morrow .
translation.kha: Kaei ka jynjar jong pha ?  Ka jubab ,  Ha kato ka sngi , kane ka briew hangne ka ai jingmut ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong nga , bad ban bam ïa u khun jong ka ha ka sngi kaba bud .

translation.en: And Jacob their father said unto them , Me have ye bereaved of my children : Joseph is not , and Simeon is not , and ye will take Benjamin away : all these things are against me .
translation.kha: U kpa jong ki u ong ha ki ,  Phi kwah ba ngan duh lut ïa la ki jong ki khun ? U Joseph um don shuh , u Simeon ruh um don , bad mynta pat phi kwah ban shim noh sa ïa u Benjamin . Dei ma nga keiñ uba shah jynjar !

translation.en: In time , God’s Kingdom will even restore the peaceful relations that existed in the garden of Eden between animals , and between animals and humans .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima jong u Blei kan pynïoh pat ka jingsuk kaba ïadei bad kato kaba don ha ka Kper Eden hapdeng ki mrad , bad hapdeng ki mrad bad ki briew .

translation.en: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing , thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai kylliang ei ei ïa uno uno u briew , wat leit rung sha ïing jong u ban shim ïa ka jaiñkup ban buh bynda ha phi ;

translation.en: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me , saying , Come , let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono . But they thought to do me mischief .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sanballat bad u Geshem ki phah khubor sha nga , da kaba ai jingmut ba ngan ïakynduh bad ki ha kawei na ki nongrit jong ka Madan Ono . Kane ka la long ka buit sianti jong ki ban pyrshang ban buh ïa nga ha ka jingma .

translation.en: Thus he shewed me : and , behold , the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline , with a plumbline in his hand .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai . Ha ka , nga ïohi ïa u ba u dang ïeng marsyndah ka kynroh ïa kaba la tei da ka jingïarap u sawar , bad la don u sawar ha ka kti jong u .

translation.en: Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men die ïa ka jaka , ka dei ka jong me ; bad hadien ba me la die ïa ka , ka pisa ka la long ka jong me . Balei , te , ba me la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane ? Mem shym la shukor ïa ki briew — me la shukor ïa U Blei !

translation.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him : for they feared him , because all the people was astonished at his doctrine .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , kumta ki la sdang ban ïawad da kano ka lad ban pynïap noh ïa U Jisu . Ki la sheptieng ïa u , namar uta u paidbah baroh u la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the  Lord  had done to Israel , whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , u la kmen bad u la ong ,

translation.en: And they said unto him , We are come down to bind thee , that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines . And Samson said unto them , Swear unto me , that ye will not fall upon me yourselves .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Ngi la wan hangne ban khum ïa me , khnang ba ngin ïoh aiti ïa me ha ki .  U Samson u ong ,  Kular ha nga da ka ktien ba phin ym pynïap ïa nga da phi hi .

translation.en: And Joram said , Make ready . And his chariot was made ready . And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out , each in his chariot , and they went out against Jehu , and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite .
translation.kha: U syiem Joram u hukum ,  Pynkhreh ka kali ïapom jong nga .  Ynda la pynkhreh , ma u bad u syiem Ahasaïah ki mih mar la ka kali ïapom ban leit ïakynduh ïa u Jehu . Ki ïakynduh ïa u ha ka lyngkha kaba la ju long ka jong u Naboth .

translation.en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever : and thou ,  Lord  , art become their God .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong me hi junom , bad me , A  Trai  , me la long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab , u Abimelekh u khot lang ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , bad u ïathuh ha ki ïa kaba la jia ; bad ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh .

translation.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness , and tempted God in the desert .
translation.kha: Ïa ki la pyndap da ki jingkwah bymdei ha ka ri shyiap bad tynjuh ïa U Blei ;

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the  Lord  , the Lord of all the earth , shall rest in the waters of Jordan , that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above  ; and they shall stand upon an heap .
translation.kha: Haba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  jong ka pyrthei baroh kin ïuh ïa la ki kjat ha um , ka Jordan kan sangeh ban tuid , bad ka um kaba wan tuid na shaneng kan lang shi jaka .

translation.en: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob , and also my covenant with Isaac , and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember  ; and I will remember the land .
translation.kha: ngan sa kynmaw ïa la ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad u Jakob bad u Isaak bad u Abraham , bad ngan sa pynthymmai ïa la ka kular ban ai ïa kata ka ri ha ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la dem ngon ha madan ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh .

translation.en: Every Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses bears God’s holy name .
translation.kha: Man la ka Ïing Hima jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong U Blei .

translation.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing , and the breath of all mankind .
translation.kha: Dei U Blei uba pynïaid ïa ka jingim jong ki jingthaw jong u ; ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei ka don hapoh ka bor jong u .

translation.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee : O let me not wander from thy commandments .
translation.kha: Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh nga pyrshang ban shakri ïa me ; to sumar ïa nga na ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And said , O man greatly beloved , fear not : peace be unto thee , be strong , yea , be strong . And when he had spoken unto me , I was strengthened , and said , Let my lord speak  ; for thou hast strengthened me .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  U Blei u ieit ïa me , kumta wat ai ba kano kano kan pynkhuslai ïa me lane pynsheptieng ïa me .  Haba u la ong ïa kane , nga la nang kham sngewkhlaiñ shuh shuh bad ong ,  Ko rangbah , to ïathuh ha nga ïa kaei kaba phi don ban ong . Phi la pynlong ïa nga ban kham sngewkhlaiñ .

translation.en: And said unto his servants , This is John the Baptist  ; he is risen from the dead  ; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .
translation.kha: U dei shisha u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , uba la im pat ,  u la ïathuh ha ki rangbah synshar jong u .  Dei kata keiñ balei ba une u la don ïa kane ka bor ban leh ki kambah .

translation.en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded him  ; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: U Moses u leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , bad haba ki paidbah ki la ïalumlang ,

translation.en: But when he saw the wind boisterous , he was afraid  ; and beginning to sink , he cried , saying , Lord , save me .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa ka lyer kaba khlaiñ , u la sheptieng bad u la sdang ban ngam shapoh um .  To pynim ïa nga , A Trai !  u la pyrta .

translation.en: And upon Kiriathaim , and upon Beth–gamul , and upon Beth–meon ,
translation.kha: Kiriathaim , Bethgamul , Bethmeon ,

translation.en: And it came to pass about three months after , that it was told Judah , saying , Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot  ; and also , behold , she is with child by whoredom . And Judah said , Bring her forth , and let her be burnt .
translation.kha: Kumba lai bnai hadien kane , don ba ïathuh ha u Judah ,  Ka pyrsa kurim jong phi ka la leh kum ka nuti , bad mynta ka la punkhun .   Sei shabar ïa ka , bad thang im ïa ka ,  ong u Judah .

translation.en: And the heat-parched ground will have become as a reedy pool , and the thirsty ground as springs of water .”—Isaiah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
translation.kha: U shyiap uba shit phyrnai un long ka pung , bad ka khyndew kaba thrang um kan long ki umpohliew . —Isaïah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .

translation.en: And they laid it up till the morning , as Moses bade : and it did not stink , neither was there any worm therein .
translation.kha: Kumba u Moses u la hukum , kumta ruh ki buh ïa kaba tam haduh kawei pat ka sngi . Te kam shym la sniew , bad kam shym la boi ksaiñ .

translation.en: Which was the son of Saruch , which was the son of Ragau , which was the son of Phalec , which was the son of Heber , which was the son of Sala ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Serug , u khun jong u Reu , u khun jong u Peleg , u khun jong u Eber , u khun jong u Shelah ,

translation.en: Every man shall give as he is able , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee .
translation.kha: baroh ki dei ban ai katba ki kotbor , kat kum ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.en: And she was in bitterness of soul , and prayed unto the  Lord  , and wept sore .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ynda ki la dep bam dep dih ha ka ïing U  Trai  ha Shiloh , ka Hannah ka ïeng joit , ka la sngew jynjar sat bad ka la ïamkthang katba ka dang duwai ha khmat U  Trai . Ha kata ka por , u lyngdoh Eli u shong ha ka jaka jong u ha syndah jingkhang .

translation.en: Give heed to me , O  Lord  , and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la duwai ,  A  Trai  , to sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong bad to shahshkor ïa kaei ba ki nongshun jong nga ki ong shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: Let a little water , I pray you , be fetched , and wash your feet , and rest yourselves under the tree :
translation.kha: Shah ngan wanrah khyndiat ka um ba phin ïoh sait ïa ki kjat jong phi ; phi lah ban shong jahthait ha trai jong une u dieng .

translation.en: But Hannah went not up  ; for she said unto her husband , I will not go up until the child be weaned , and then I will bring him , that he may appear before the  Lord  , and there abide for ever .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka kynti ka Hannah kam shym la leit . Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga tang shu pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ngan wan ïalam ïa u sha ïing U  Trai  , bad hangta un shong baroh shi rta .

translation.en: A people great , and many , and tall , as the Anakims  ; but the  Lord  destroyed them before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead :
translation.kha: Ki long kiba jrong kat ki Anakim , kiba bun paid , bad kiba khlaiñ . Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynjot ïa ki baroh , kumta ki Ammon ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shong hangta .

translation.en: Moreover I will make thee waste , and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee , in the sight of all that pass by .
translation.kha: Uno uno na ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong jong pha uba dei ïaid lynti un rkhiebeiñ ïa pha bad un kiar na pha .

translation.en: And they answered him , He was an hairy man , and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins . And he said , It is Elijah the Tishbite .
translation.kha: U phong ka jingkup kaba la shna na ki snieh mrad , ïa kaba la teh da u panpoh snieh ,  ki jubab .  U dei u Elijah !  u syiem u la ong jam .

translation.en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand : and I heard the number of them .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingdon jong ki shipai shong kulai : Ki la long arphew lakh ngut .

translation.en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther , Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king s house , more than all the Jews .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba phan kham lait im ban ïa kiwei pat ki Jiw tang namar ba pha don ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee : for thou hast gone and made thee other gods , and molten images , to provoke me to anger , and hast cast me behind thy back :
translation.kha: Me la leh ïa ki pop kiba khraw palat liam ban ïa kito kiba la synshar ha shuwa jong me . Me la kyntait ïa nga bad me la pynbitar lep ïa nga da kaba me thaw ïa ki bleithaw bad ki dur ba la shu saiñ ban mane .

translation.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid , knowing that they do gender strifes .
translation.kha: Hynrei to kiar noh na ki jingïatainia ba-bieit bad ba khlem jingmut ; me tip ba ki kut ha ka jingïakajia .

translation.en: And when the messengers turned back unto him , he said unto them , Why are ye now turned back ?
translation.kha: bad ki nonglamktien ki la leit phai sha u syiem .  Balei phi wan phai noh ?  u la kylli .

translation.en: And they said , It is false  ; tell us now . And he said , Thus and thus spake he to me , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have anointed thee king over Israel .
translation.kha: Em , ngim tip !  ki la jubab .  Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei ba u ong !   U ïathuh ïa nga ba U  Trai  u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem ka Israel .’

translation.en: And the king of Syria said , Go to , go , and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel . And he departed , and took with him ten talents of silver , and six thousand pieces of gold , and ten changes of raiment .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ,  Khie leit sha u syiem Israel bad rah ïa kane ka shithi sha u .  Kumta u Naaman u leit , u da rah laiphew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa , hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot ksiar , bad shiphew riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .

translation.en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn , nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Baroh ki mrad ha ki khlaw jong ka Lebanon kim pat biang na ka bynta ka jingkñia sha U Blei jong ngi , bad ki dieng jong ka ki khyndiat eh ban pynmeh ïa ka ding .

translation.en: For which of you , intending to build a tower , sitteth not down first , and counteth the cost , whether he have sufficient to finish it ?
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na phi u thmu ban tei ïa ka jaka ap phira , nyngkong u shong bad u kheiñ ïa ka jinglut , ban khmih la u don bun ka pisa ban pyndep ïa ka kam .

translation.en: Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha u ,  Mem kren ei ei ha nga ? To kynmaw , nga don ka bor ban pyllait ïa me bad ruh ban phah sahnarphna ïa me .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book , until they were finished ,
translation.kha: U Moses u thoh lut ïa ka Aiñ U Blei ha ka kitab , khlem da ieh kawei ruh ka ktien .

translation.en: Then said Jeremiah , It is false  ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans . But he hearkened not to him : so Irijah took Jeremiah , and brought him to the princes .
translation.kha: Nga la jubab ,  Kam long kumta ! Ngam phet noh .  Hynrei u Irijah um sngap ïa nga . Pynban , u la kem ïa nga bad ïalam ïa nga sha ki rangbah synshar .

translation.en: And , behold , Saul came after the herd out of the field  ; and Saul said , What aileth the people that they weep ? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Saul u dang shu wan ñiah ïa la ki masi lur na lyngkha ; u kylli ,  Kaei kaba la jia ? Balei ba ki briew ki ïalynñiar katta katta ?  Ki ïathuh ha u ïa ka khubor ba ki rangbah na Jabesh ki wanrah .

translation.en: And Joseph saw his brethren , and he knew them , but made himself strange unto them , and spake roughly unto them  ; and he said unto them , Whence come ye ? And they said , From the land of Canaan to buy food .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u la ïohi ïa la ki hynmen , bad u la ithuh ïa ki , hynrei u leh kum bym ithuh ïa ki , bad u kren khor ïa ki ,  Phi kiba na-ei ?   Ngi ïawan na ka ri Kanaan , ban thied jingbam ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs , En–gannim with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Jarmuth , bad ka Engannim , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water : yet they shall flee away . Stand , stand , shall they cry  ; but none shall look back .
translation.kha: Kum ka um na ka jaka den um ba la pra ki briew ki mareh napoh ka Ninebeh !  Sangeh ! Sangeh !  ka jingpyrta ka sawa — hynrei ym don mano mano ba phai dien .

translation.en: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day s journey , and he cried , and said , Yet forty days , and Nineveh shall be overthrown .
translation.kha: U Jonah u sdang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah , bad hadien ba u la ïaid baroh shi sngi , u la pynbna ,  Hapoh sawphew sngi ïa ka Ninebeh yn sa pynjot !

translation.en: For her blood is in the midst of her  ; she set it upon the top of a rock  ; she poured it not upon the ground , to cover it with dust  ;
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew ha ka nongbah , hynrei ka snam kam shym pashait ha ka khyndew ha kaba ka khyndew kam lah ban buhrieh ïa ka ; ka la pashait ha u mawsiang basyllen .

translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u la leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki paidbah baroh na ka Israel bashatei ki la ïawanlang ban pynlong syiem ïa u .

translation.en: Plead with your mother , plead : for she is not my wife , neither am I her husband : let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight , and her adulteries from between her breasts  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , kyrpad jur ïa la ka kmie — wat lada kam dei tnga shuh ïa nga , bad nga ruh ngam dei shuh u tnga jong ka . Kyrpad ïa ka ba kan sangeh noh na kaba klim bad ka jingleh nuti .

translation.en: Let the prophets speak two or three , and let the other judge .
translation.kha: Ar ne lai ngut kiba ïoh ïa ka khubor U Blei ki dei ban kren , katba kiwei pat kin bishar ïa kaei kaba ki kren .

translation.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men . The Lord is at hand .
translation.kha: To pynpaw ïa ka jinglong jemnud sha uwei pa uwei baroh . U Trai u la jan wan .

translation.en: In that day shall he swear , saying , I will not be an healer  ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing : make me not a ruler of the people .
translation.kha: Hynrei un jubab ,  Ym ma nga ! Ngam lah ban ïarap ïa phi . Ngam don jingbam ei ei lane ki jaiñ ruh kumjuh . Wat pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong phi !

translation.en: And if they be bound in fetters , and be holden in cords of affliction  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada la teh ïa ki briew ha ki kynjri , da kaba shahshitom na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh ,

translation.en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim , whose sister s name was Maachah  ; ) and the name of the second was Zelophehad : and Zelophehad had daughters .
translation.kha: U Makhir u pynïoh kawei ka tnga ïa u Huppim bad kawei pat ïa u Shuppim . Ka para jong u ka kyrteng ka Maakah . U khun uba ar jong u Makhir u dei u Selophehad , bad u don tang ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the  Lord  : and he made a trench about the altar , as great as would contain two measures of seed .
translation.kha: Da kine ki maw , u thaw biang ïa ka duwan ban mane ïa U  Trai . U tih ïa ka kharai sawdong jong ka , kaba heh kat haduh ban ngiam kumba khatsaw litar ka um .

translation.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years , and begat a son in his own likeness , after his image  ; and called his name Seth :
translation.kha: Haba u Adam u la dap shispah laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang uba syriem ïa u bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .

translation.en: But God , who is rich in mercy , for his great love wherewith he loved us ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingisynei U Blei ka shlei katta katta , bad ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ,

translation.en: And he brought me to the north gate , and measured it according to these measures  ;
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop bashatei . U la thew ïa ka , bad ka la long katjuh ka jingheh kum kiwei pat .

translation.en: And Ham , the father of Canaan , saw the nakedness of his father , and told his two brethren without .
translation.kha: Haba u Ham , u kpa jong u Kanaan , u la ïohi ba u kpa jong u , u la lyngkhuit , u la mih shabar bad ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her  ; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more :
translation.kha: Ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ruh kin ïam bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong ka , namar ba ym don shuh mano mano ban thied ïa ki mar jong ki ;

translation.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread , and a bottle of water , and gave it unto Hagar , putting it on her shoulder , and the child , and sent her away : and she departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u ai katto katne ka jingbam bad ka pla snieh ba-dap um ha ka Hagar . U pynbah ïa u khun ha ka met jong ka bad u la phah noh ïa ka . Ka la mihnoh bad ka ïaid sakma ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Beersheba .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Josaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour , for to give repentance to Israel , and forgiveness of sins .
translation.kha: U Blei u la kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong u kum u Nongïalam bad u Nongpynim , ban ai ha ki paid Israel ka kabu ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: If there arise among you a prophet , or a dreamer of dreams , and giveth thee a sign or a wonder ,
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa ne u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew u lah ban kular ïa ka kambah ne ka kamphylla ,

translation.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Ka thma kaba la sdang hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ka neh katba u Abijah u dang im .

translation.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares , who were before of old ordained to this condemnation , ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness , and denying the only Lord God , and our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Naba don ki briew ki bymriewblei hapdeng jong ngi , kiba la syntuid noh khlem poi pyrkhat , ki briew kiba la pynkylla ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi , khnang ban pynksan ïa la ki jingleh bajakhlia , bad kiba kyntait ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba long tang ma u hi U Kynrad bad U Trai jong ngi . La slem bah , ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ïathuhlypa ïa ka jingpynrem kaba ki la ïohpdiang .

translation.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds , and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods , knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance .
translation.kha: Phi shahshitom lem bad ki koidi , bad haba ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh ki la shah kurup , phi la shah ïa la ka jingduh da kaba kmen , namar phi la tip ba phi la ïoh kam kynti shibun kiei kiei kiba kham bha , kiba neh junom .

translation.en: For the word of God is quick , and powerful , and sharper than any twoedged sword , piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit , and of the joints and marrow , and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart .
translation.kha: Ka ktien U Blei ka long kaba im bad kaba donbor , kaba kham nep ban ïa kano kano ka waitlam arliang syrti . Ka pei lyngba shaduh kaba ka jingim bad ka mynsiem ki ïakynduh , shaduh kaba ki mat bad ki khleiñ shyieng ki ïakynduh lang . Ka bishar ïa ki jingkwah bad ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud u briew .

translation.en: Now when the even was come , he sat down with the twelve .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran ki la ïashong ban bam .

translation.en: For he had possession of flocks , and possession of herds , and great store of servants : and the Philistines envied him .
translation.kha: Namar ba u don shibun ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi , bad bun ngut ki shakri , ki Philistia ki la bishni ïa u .

translation.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness : for they shall be filled .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba ka jingangnud bakhraw tam jong ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; U Blei un pynhun jrut ïa ki !

translation.en: Say unto the king and to the queen , Humble yourselves , sit down : for your principalities shall come down , even the crown of your glory .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To ïathuh ïa u syiem bad ïa ka kmie jong u ban wan hiar na ki khet jong ki , namar ba ki pansngiat ba-itynnat jong ki , ki la hap noh na ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: And Abner said to him , Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left , and lay thee hold on one of the young men , and take thee his armour . But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him .
translation.kha: Sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa nga !  ong u Abner .  Khie leit beh ïa uwei na ki shipai bad shim kat ïa kaba u don .  Hynrei u Asahel u ïai beh kthong hi sia ïa u .

translation.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain  ; yet he shall come to his end , and none shall help him .
translation.kha: Un pynïeng ruh ïa ki ïingjaiñ syiem kiba heh hapdeng ki duriaw bad ki lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng . Hynrei un ïap , khlem don mano mano hangta ban ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: But I have made Esau bare , I have uncovered his secret places , and he shall not be able to hide himself : his seed is spoiled , and his brethren , and his neighbours , and he is not .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la sloit lut ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso bad pynpaw ïa ki jakarieh jong ki , te ba kin ym lah buhrieh shuh . Ïa baroh ki briew ka Edom la pynjot . Khlem pynsah shuh ïa uwei ruh .

translation.en: But if ye have respect to persons , ye commit sin , and are convinced of the law as transgressors .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi ñiew ïa ki briew kat kum ba ki paw shabar , phi long ba la rem ha ka pop , bad ka hukum ka pynrem ïa phi kum u nongpynkheiñ hukum .

translation.en: Great in counsel , and mighty in work : for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men : to give every one according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings :
translation.kha: Me thaw ïa ki jingthmu bastad bad me leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khrawbor ; me ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki briew ki leh , bad me ainong ïa ki kat kum ki jingleh jong ki .

translation.en: For the tabernacle of the  Lord  , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of the burnt offering , were at that season in the high place at Gibeon .
translation.kha: Ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong U  Trai  kaba u Moses u la thaw ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ki jingkñia ka dang don ha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon ha kane ka por ;

translation.en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and disperse them among the countries  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki nong Ijipt kylleng ka pyrthei . Te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure .
translation.kha: namar U Blei u trei borabor hapoh jong phi , ban pynlong ïa phi kiba don ka mon bad kiba lah ban kohnguh ïa ka jingthmu jong u hi .

translation.en: And Barzillai said unto the king , How long have I to live , that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Barsillai u jubab ,  Ngam don bun snem shuh ban im ; balei ngan leit bad U Syiem Kynrad sha Jerusalem ?

translation.en: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u Saul u la sah bad ki bad u la leit kylleng ka Jerusalem , da kaba ïalap da ka jingshlur ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .

translation.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast , the nation of the Cherethites ! the word of the  Lord  is against you  ; O Canaan , the land of the Philistines , I will even destroy thee , that there shall be no inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki Philistia phi long kiba la tim , phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha shi lynter jong ka rud duriaw . U  Trai  u la ai ka rai bishar halor jong phi . Un pynjot ïa phi , bad yn ym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Thy bruise is incurable , and thy wound is grievous .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Ki jingmong jong phi ki long ki bym lah ban koit , ïa ki jingmynsaw jong phi ym lah ban pynkhiah .

translation.en: And who is he that will harm you , if ye be followers of that which is good ?
translation.kha: Uei u ban pynsniew ïa phi lada phi shitrhem ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha ?

translation.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea , and the  Lord  brought again the waters of the sea upon them  ; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang . Hynrei haba ki kali ïapom jong ki nong Ijipt lem bad ki kulai bad nongñiah ki leit shapoh ka duriaw , U  Trai  u pynïadait pat ïa ka um bad ka la tyllep ïa ki .

translation.en: And God said unto Moses , I AM THAT I AM : and he said , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , I AM hath sent me unto you .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Moses ,  NGA LONG UBA NGA LONG . Kane ka long kaei kaba me dei ban ong ha ki : ‘ Uta ïa uba la khot UBA NGA LONG u phah ïa nga sha phi .’

translation.en: So Job died , being old and full of days .
translation.kha: Bad nangta u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Jehu u Nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Hanani bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na ka bynta u Baasha :

translation.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money , that ye may eat  ; and ye shall also buy water of them for money , that ye may drink .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbam bad ka um phi lah ban thied na ki .’

translation.en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people Israel , saying , Why build ye not me an house of cedar ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit jong nga baroh bad ki paid Israel ngam pat ju ong ha uno uno na ki nongïalam ba nga la thung , balei ba kim shym la tei ïa nga ka templ kaba thaw da ki dieng Kedar .’

translation.en: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one .
translation.kha: San sien la shoh ïa nga laiphew khyndai thri da ki Jiw ; lai sien la sympat ïa nga da ki nong Rom ; bad shisien nga la shah lynthem maw .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it , they are the flesh , and this city is the caldron : but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it .
translation.kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phi . Kane ka nongbah ka dei da shisha u khiew shet , hynrei kaei ka doh ? Ki metïap jong kito kiba phi la pynïap ! Phin ym don shuh hangne — Ngan bret ïa phi shabar kane ka nongbah .

translation.en: And David sware moreover , and said , Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes  ; and he saith , Let not Jonathan know this , lest he be grieved : but truly as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , there is but a step between me and death .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u jubab ,  I pa jong phi i tip bha katno ba phi sngewieit ïa nga , bad i la rai ba phin ym tip ïa kaei ba i thmu ban leh , namar ba phin sa sngewkthang eh . Nga smai ha phi da U  Trai  uba im ba nga don sa tang shisien jam na ka jingïap !

translation.en: For since by man came death , by man came also the resurrection of the dead .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ka jingïap ka la wan da uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ka wan da uwei u briew .

translation.en: Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .
translation.kha: Me la long u nongshong basa ha ka ïing jong ki Jentil kiba khlem otsher , bad me da ïabam lem bad ki !

translation.en: The sons of Shimei  ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan .
translation.kha: kiba long ki khlieh jong ki kur kiba hiarpateng na u Ladan . ( U Shimei u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shelomoth , u Hasiel , bad u Haran . )

translation.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people : and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled upon the altar round about ,
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u langbrot kum ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok na ka bynta ki paidbah . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ha u ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: Cry aloud , spare not , lift up thy voice like a trumpet , and shew my people their transgression , and the house of Jacob their sins .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To pyrta jam katba phi lah ! Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel shaphang ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him , whom Sarah bare to him , Isaac .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Isaak ,

translation.en: And the king of Israel said , Take Micaiah , and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ,  Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad ïalam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat jong kane ka nongbah , bad sha u Joash u khun syiem .

translation.en: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand  ; and they came unto Balaam , and spake unto him the words of Balak .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nongïalam jong ki Moab bad ki Midian ki rah bad ki ïa ka jingsiew na ka bynta ka jingtim , ki la leit sha u Balaam bad ki ai ha u ïa ka khubor na u Balak .

translation.en: And Joseph made haste  ; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother : and he sought where to weep  ; and he entered into his chamber , and wept there .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u mihnoh kynsan namar ka dohnud jong u ka shlei da ka jingsngewieit ïa la u para . Namar ba um lah kun shuh , u leit sha la ka kamra , bad u la ïam .

translation.en: My heart panted , fearfulness affrighted me : the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me .
translation.kha: Ka khlieh jong nga ka king , bad nga khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Nga la khmih lynti ïa ka janmiet ban wan , hynrei kam shym wallam ei ei hynrei tang ka jingtriem .

translation.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts : Judah shall abide in their coast on the south , and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ri yn pynbynta mar katjuh ha ki hynñiew bynta ; ka jait Judah kan sah ha la ka jaka shaphang shathie , bad ka jait Joseph ha la ka jaka shaphang shatei .

translation.en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of , and saved himself there , not once nor twice .
