translation.kha: Kumta u syiem ka Israel u la maham ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta , bad ki la long phikir ïa lade . Kane ka jia bun bunsien .

translation.en: And he rose up that night , and took his two wives , and his two womenservants , and his eleven sons , and passed over the ford Jabbok .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet , u Jakob u la khie , u shim ïa la ki tnga baroh ar ngut , ïa ki tnga kliar jong u ar ngut , bad ïa la ki khun baroh khatwei ngut , bad u la jam ïa ka wah Jabbok .

translation.en: And makest men as the fishes of the sea , as the creeping things , that have no ruler over them ?
translation.kha: Kumno me lah ban pynlong ïa ki briew kum ka dohkha lane kum ka kynhun ki khñiang ki bym don nongsynshar ban ïalam ïa ki ?

translation.en: And Moses took the breast , and waved it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : for of the ram of consecration it was Moses  part  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka shadem bad u ai ïa ka kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai . Kata ka long ka bynta jong u Moses na u langbrot ka jingpynkyntang . U Moses u la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Moreover , because I have set my affection to the house of my God , I have of mine own proper good , of gold and silver , which I have given to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house ,
translation.kha: Nalor kane baroh kaba nga la pynbiang , nga la ai ruh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar na ka jingdon jingem jong nga namar ka jingieit jong nga ïa ka Templ jong U Blei .

translation.en: And our adversaries said , They shall not know , neither see , till we come in the midst among them , and slay them , and cause the work to cease .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki pyrkhat ba ngin ym ïohi ïa ki ne tip ïa kaei kaba jia haduh ba ki la long halor jong ngi , ban pynïap ïa ngi bad ban pynduh pyndam ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi .

translation.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water , that bringeth forth his fruit in his season  ; his leaf also shall not wither  ; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki dieng kiba mih harud ka wahduid , kiba seisoh ha ka por kaba dei , bad kiba ki sla jong ki kim tyrkhong . Ki jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ki leh .

translation.en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee , the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ki hima badonbor kin ïaroh ïa me bad yn sheptieng ïa me ha ki nongbah jong ki hima bashyrkhei .

translation.en: Go not forth into the field , nor walk by the way  ; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side .
translation.kha: Ngim nud ban leit sha ki rudnong lane ïaid ha ki surok , namar ki nongshun jong ngi ki la kieng atiar bad ka jingshyrkhei ka don ha baroh sawdong jong ngi .

translation.en: But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la leit noh bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ha kylleng jong kata ka bynta jong ka ri .

translation.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba , and Dedan . And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim , and Letushim , and Leummim .
translation.kha: U Jokshan u dei u kpa jong u Sheba bad u Dedan , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dedan ki long ki Asshurim , Ki Letushim , bad ki Leummim .

translation.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria  ; and the dogs licked up his blood  ; and they washed his armour  ; according unto the word of the  Lord  which he spake .
translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom jong u la sait ha ka pung Samaria ; ha kaba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam jong u , bad ki nuti ki sum ki sleh hangta , kumba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia .

translation.en: Now it came to pass upon a day , that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over to the Philistines  garrison , that is on the other side . But he told not his father .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Jonathan u ong ha u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jong u ,  Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia .  Hynrei u Jonathan um shym ïathuh ha la u kpa , u Saul

translation.en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly , then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it , and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u bym dei na ka longïing lyngdoh khlem da poi pyrkhat u bam ïa kano kano ka jingkñia ainguh , u dei ban pynphai sha uta u lyngdoh ïa ka dor jong ka bad un ai ruh nalor kata sa shi bynta na ka san bynta jong ka dor jong ka .

translation.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you , brethren beloved of the Lord , because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth :
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi , ko parabangeit , phi kiba U Trai u ieit . Naba U Blei u la jied ïa phi kum kiba nyngkong ban pynim da ka bor U Mynsiem ban pynlong ïa phi ki riewkhuid jong u bad da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Up , sanctify the people , and say , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow : for thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee , O Israel : thou canst not stand before thine enemies , until ye take away the accursed thing from among you .
translation.kha: Ïeng joit ! Pynkhuid ïa u paidbah bad pynkhreh ban wan ha khmat jong nga . Bthah ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi lashai ka sngi , namar ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel nga don kane ban ong : ‘ Israel , phi don ha ki jingdon jingem jong phi katto katne kiba nga la hukum ïa phi ban pynjot ! Phim lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi tad haduh ba phin da lait na kine kiei kiei !’

translation.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake , hearing and seeing the miracles which he did .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynleit jingmut bha ïa kaei kaba u Philip u la ong , haba ki la shahshkor ïa u bad ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .

translation.en: A man s gift maketh room for him , and bringeth him before great men .
translation.kha: Hato phi kwah ban ïakynduh ïa u briew uba khraw ? Rah sha u ka jingai sngewbha bad kan pynsuk ïa phi .

translation.en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people .
translation.kha: Lada phim shahshkor ïa nga , te U Blei un pyndonkam da ki nongwei kiba kren da kawei pat ka sur ktien ba sngew khyllah ban hikai ïa phi .

translation.en: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders , which is become the head of the corner .
translation.kha: U Jisu u long uta ïa uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,   ‘ U maw uba ma phi ki nongtei phi la kyntait u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .’

translation.en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart , and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah : and Uzza and Ahio , the sons of Abinadab , drave the new cart .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ka na ka ïing jong u Abinadab kaba don halor lum , bad ki buh ïa ka ha ka kali thymmai . U Ussah bad u Ahio , ki khun shynrang jong u Abinadab , ki lam lynti ïa ka kali ,

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever .
translation.kha: Kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , nga kular ba u Jonadab u khun jong u Rekhab un don borabor ïa u shynrang u ban hiarpateng ban shakri ïa nga .

translation.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together , the floods stood upright as an heap , and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea .
translation.kha: Me la pyrsad ïa ka duriaw bad ka um ka kynton shajrong eh ; ka ïeng beit thik kum ka kynroh ; ka bynta bajylliew tam jong ka duriaw ka kylla eh .

translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given your brethren rest , as he hath given you , and they also have possessed the land which the  Lord  your God giveth them : then ye shall return unto the land of your possession , and enjoy it , which Moses the  Lord s  servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha ki . Hadien ba u la pynïoh ïa ka jingshongshngain ïa ki jait Israel baroh , te phi lah ban wan phai pat bad shongsah hangne ha ka ri jong phi ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work made he them .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba tbit tam napdeng kita kiba trei ki shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki shna ïa ka na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen bani , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ha kiba la suh pynpur itynnat da ki dur jong ki Kherub .

translation.en: His countenance was like lightning , and his raiment white as snow :
translation.kha: Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka leilieh , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki lieh kum ka ïor .

translation.en: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning , and encamped against Gibeah .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki mih ha ka step kaba bud bad ki sher dara hajan ka nongbah Gibeah .

translation.en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love ? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways .
translation.kha: Phi tip thikna kumno ban ïabeh nadien ki nongleh-ieit . Wat ki kynthei kiba sniew eh ki lah ban ïoh jinghikai na phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  opened the mouth of the ass , and she said unto Balaam , What have I done unto thee , that thou hast smitten me these three times ?
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai bor ïa kata ka kada ban kren , bad ka ong ha u Balaam ,  Nga la leh aïu keiñ ïa phi ba phi da sympat ïa nga ha kine lai sien ?

translation.en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations , and didst divide them into corners : so they possessed the land of Sihon , and the land of the king of Heshbon , and the land of Og king of Bashan .
translation.kha: Me la shah ïa ki ban jop ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima , ïa ki ri kiba markhap bad ki . Ki jop ïa ka ri ki Heshbon , ha kaba u Sihon u synshar , bad ïa ka ri ki Bashan , ha kaba u Og u long syiem .

translation.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come , when it shall come for my hire before thy face : every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats , and brown among the sheep , that shall be counted stolen with me .
translation.kha: Hadien habud phin sa shem da kaba suk lada nga lah lehhok . Haba phin wan ban khmih ïa ka bainong jong nga , lada nga don ki blang ki bym thohbria bad ki bym thohbroin , lane kino kino ki khunlangbrot ki bym ïong , phin tip ba nga la tuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And Joseph was the governor over the land , and he it was that sold to all the people of the land : and Joseph s brethren came , and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth .
translation.kha: U Joseph kum u lat jong ka ri Ijipt u die kew ha ki briew kiba wan na kylleng ka pyrthei . Kumta ki hynmen shynrang jong u Joseph ki la ïawan bad nguh ngon ha khmat jong u , ki da pyndem la ki khmat sha khyndew .

translation.en: For the vile person will speak villany , and his heart will work iniquity , to practise hypocrisy , and to utter error against the  Lord  , to make empty the soul of the hungry , and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail .
translation.kha: Uba bieit u kren bieit bad u pyrkhat ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Kaei kaba u leh bad kaei kaba u ong ka long ka jingibeiñ ïa U  Trai  , bad um ju bsa ïa kiba thngan lane um ju ai ka jingdih ïa kiba sliang .

translation.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar : the sinews of his stones are wrapped together .
translation.kha: U tdong jong u , u ïeng kum u dieng Kedar ; ki ksah ha ki khohwah jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Who is the wise man , that may understand this ? and who is he to whom the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken , that he may declare it , for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness , that none passeth through ?
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ,  Ko  Trai  , balei ka ri ka ha ka jingjot jingpra bad ka tyrkhong kum ka ri shyiap , ba ym don mano mano ba leit jingleit lyngba jong ka ? Uei uba stad eh ban shemphang ïa kane ? Hano me la batai ïa ka ba u lah ban ïathuh ha kiwei pat ?

translation.en: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity , according to the number of the days , three hundred and ninety days : so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta thiah pyrshing ha ka krung kadiang , bad ngan pynkit ha me ïa ki kam bymman ka jaitbynriew Israel . Kumba laispah khyndaiphew sngi men sah hangta bad shahshitom namar ki kam bymman jong ki . Nga la pynshitom ïa me shi sngi na ka bynta kawei kawei ka snem haduh ba ka jingpynshitom jong ki kan kut noh .

translation.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee , and will keep the passover to the  Lord  , let all his males be circumcised , and then let him come near and keep it  ; and he shall be as one that is born in the land : for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof .
translation.kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong basah bad phi u kwah ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , nyngkong eh phi dei ban otsher shuwa ïa ki shynrang baroh na ka ïing jong u . Hadien kata , lah ban kheiñ ïa u kum u traishnong , bad nangta u lah ban ïashim bynta ha ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days , the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . Ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingsawa ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingkhawai shongkurim . Ki briew hangne kin im ban ïohi ba kane ka jia .

translation.en: Therefore I am full of the fury of the  Lord   ; I am weary with holding in : I will pour it out upon the children abroad , and upon the assembly of young men together : for even the husband with the wife shall be taken , the aged with him that is full of days .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong me pyrshah ïa ki ka pluh ruh hapoh jong nga , A  Trai  , bad ngam lah ban kun slem shuh ïa ka .  Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To theh noh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga halor ki khynnah ha ki surok bad ha ki jingïalang jong ki samla shynrang . Ïa ki rangbah bad ki tnga jong ki yn shim noh , bad wat ïa kiba tymmen tam yn ym pynsah .

translation.en: And that first slaughter , which Jonathan and his armourbearer made , was about twenty men , within as it were an half acre of land , which a yoke of oxen might plow .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingpynïap kaba nyngkong , u Jonathan bad u samla ki la pynïap kumba arphew ngut ki briew ha ka jaka kaba heh kumba shipawa hektar .

translation.en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim , which is the seventh month .
translation.kha: Baroh ki ïalumlang ha ka por ba ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha u bnai uba hynñiew , u bnai Ethanim .

translation.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .
translation.kha: U Petros u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad ha ki bad da ki kyntien babun u la kyrpad ïa ki , da kaba ong ,  To pynim ïa lade na ka jingpynshitom kaba wan ha une u paidbah ba-bymman !

translation.en: Salute Apelles approved in Christ . Salute them which are of Aristobulus  household .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa u Apelles , uba ïa ka jingïaineh ha U Khrist la pynshisha . Ki jingkhublei ïa kito kiba na ka longïing jong u Aristobulos .

translation.en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John , to be baptized of him .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la wan poi na Galilaïa bad u la wan sha u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan ba yn shah pynbaptis ha u .

translation.en: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah , for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger , and made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Ka longïing jong me kan long kum ka longïing u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , bad kum ka longïing u syiem Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah , namar ba me la pynkhih bitar ïa nga da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .’

translation.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them , with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria , and with all on whom she doted : with all their idols she defiled herself .
translation.kha: Ka long ka nuti ïa baroh ki shipai Assyria , bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka , ka pynlong ïa ka ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Assyria .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee , and say , Nineveh is laid waste : who will bemoan her ? whence shall I seek comforters for thee ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa pha kin kynran dien . Kin ong , ‘ Ka Ninebeh ka don ha ki jingjot ! Mano ba don kano kano ka jingisynei ïa ka ? Mano ba kwah ban pyntngen ïa ka ?’

translation.en: Yea , I attended unto you , and , behold , there was none of you that convinced Job , or that answered his words :
translation.kha: Nga la shahshkor bha bad shem ba phi la bakla ; phim shym lah ban pynduh nia ïa kaei kaba u Job u la ong .

translation.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment , and the worm shall eat them like wool : but my righteousness shall be for ever , and my salvation from generation to generation .
translation.kha: kin jah noh kum ki jaiñ ba la bam khñiang ! Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba ngan wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan neh ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more  ; neither shall his place any more behold him .
translation.kha: Un jah noh na ka jaka kaba u ju shong ju sah ;

translation.en: And if any man ask you , Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him , Because the Lord hath need of him .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u kylli ïa phi balei ba phi loit ïa u , ong ha u ba u Kynrad u donkam ïa u .

translation.en: And Sheva was scribe : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :
translation.kha: u Sheba u dei u sekretari ka ïingbishar ; u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki dei ki lyngdoh ,

translation.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la leit phai sha ïing .

translation.en: And he brought the meat offering , and took an handful thereof , and burnt it upon the altar , beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning .
translation.kha: U kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam bad u shim shi kham u purew bad u thang ïa u halor ka duwan . ( Kane ka long nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi . )

translation.en: But , beloved , we are persuaded better things of you , and things that accompany salvation , though we thus speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ngi kren kumne , ko paralok ba-ieit , ngi sngewskhem shaphang jong phi . Ngi tip ba phi ïoh ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba kham bha kiba ïadei bad ka jingpynim jong phi .

translation.en: But if any man be ignorant , let him be ignorant .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um pynleit jingmut ïa kane , phi wat salia ïa u .

translation.en: Now I know that the  Lord  is greater than all gods : for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them .
translation.kha: Mynta nga tip ba U  Trai  u kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh , namar u la leh ïa kane mynba ki nong Ijipt ki la lehbeiñ shaba palat ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And when David was a little past the top of the hill , behold , Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him , with a couple of asses saddled , and upon them two hundred loaves of bread , and an hundred bunches of raisins , and an hundred of summer fruits , and a bottle of wine .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la jam kham sha khmat na ka kliar lum , u la ïakynduh kynsan ïa u Siba , u shakri jong u Mephibosheth , uba la don bad u shi jur ki kada kiba kit arspah tylli ki kpu , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh kismis , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh ba dang shu kheit , bad kawei ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .

translation.en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for , the evidence of things not seen .
translation.kha: Ban ngeit ka long ban sngewskhem ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ngi kyrmen , ban sngewthikna ïa kiei kiei kiba ngim lah ban ïohi .

translation.en: And Moses commanded them , saying , At the end of every seven years , in the solemnity of the year of release , in the feast of tabernacles ,
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki ,  Man kaba kut ka hynñiew snem , ynda poi ka snem ban pyllait noh ïa ki jingkit ram baroh , pule jam ïa kane ka hukum ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Stand by thy burnt offering , and I will go : peradventure the  Lord  will come to meet me : and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee . And he went to an high place .
translation.kha: Nangta u Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga pat ngan leit peit la U  Trai  un ïakynduh ne em ïa nga . Ngan sa ïathuh ha phi kat ïa kaba u pynpaw ha nga .  Kumta u la leit marwei sha kliar jong uwei u lum ,

translation.en: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself  ; first the blade , then the ear , after that the full corn in the ear .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew hi ka pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san bad ban seisoh ; nyngkong u speh balung u mih , hadien ka kop , bad khatduh ka kop ba-dap da u symboh kew .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it , that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim , and the curse upon mount Ebal .
translation.kha: Ynda U  Trai  u wan ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , phin pynbna ïa ka jingkyrkhu nalor u lum Gerisim bad ïa kata ka jingtim nalor u lum Ebal .

translation.en: If so be that ye have heard him , and have been taught by him , as the truth is in Jesus :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew shisha shaphang jong u , bad kum ki nongbud jong u , la hikai ha phi ïa kata ka jingshisha kaba don ha U Jisu .

translation.en: Through mighty signs and wonders , by the power of the Spirit of God ; so that from Jerusalem , and round about unto Illyricum , I have fully preached the gospel of Christ .
translation.kha: da ka bor jong ki kambah bad ki jingphylla , bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem jong U Blei . Bad kumta , ha ka jingleit baroh shi lynter lynti naduh Jerusalem sha Illyrikom , nga la pynbna pura ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .

translation.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger : for ye know the heart of a stranger , seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa u nongwei ; phi tip kumno phi sngew ban long u nongwei , naba phi la ju long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man : seek out his wickedness till thou find none .
translation.kha: Pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ki riewbymman bad ki riewsniew ; pynshitom ïa ki namar ka jingbakla kaba ki la leh tad haduh ba kin ym leh shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew , all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la ithuh ba u dei u Jiw , ki la ïa-pyrta lang ïa kajuh haduh ar kynta :  Kaba khraw ka long ka Artemis jong ka Ephesos !

translation.en: And two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , such as he is able to get  ; and the one shall be a sin offering , and the other a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Un wallam ruh ar tylli ki paro ne ki lyngdkhur , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance : for ye serve the Lord Christ .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba U Trai un ai ha phi kum ka bainong ïa kaei kaba u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . Naba U Khrist u dei U Kynrad bashisha uba phi shakri .

translation.en: Of the Amramites , and the Izharites , the Hebronites , and the Uzzielites :
translation.kha: Ïa ki kamram la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .

translation.en: And God stirred him up another adversary , Rezon the son of Eliadah , which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah :
translation.kha: U Blei u pynjia ruh ïa u Reson u khun jong u Eliada ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Solomon . U Reson , u la phet ïap na la u kynrad , u Hadadeser u syiem ka Sobah , bad u la long u nongïalam ïa kawei ka kynhun ki riewrunar .

translation.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring , like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab , and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father s house , which were better than thyself :
translation.kha: Pynban me la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiem ka Israel bad me la ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad Jerusalem sha ka jinglong bymïaineh shuh ha U Blei , kumba u Ahab bad ki nongmih bujli jong u ki la ïalam ïa ki Israel sha ka jingbymïaineh . Me la pynïap wat ïa la ki para shynrang , kiba long ki rangbah kiba kham bha ban ïa kaba me long .

translation.en: There is no peace , saith my God , to the wicked .
translation.kha: Ym don jingshngain ïa ki nongpop ,  ong U  Trai .

translation.en: How are the things of Esau searched out ! how are his hidden things sought up !
translation.kha: Ko ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , ïa ki jingkynshew bakordor jong phi la lute .

translation.en: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me , that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream .
translation.kha: Nga la hukum ban wallam sha nga ïa baroh ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ha Babilon khnang ba ki lah ban ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew .

translation.en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers , and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings  ; for they said , He is a leper : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jaka tep syiem hynrei namar ka jingpang jong u ym shym la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . U Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Then said one unto him , Lord , are there few that be saved ? And he said unto them ,
translation.kha: Don kiba la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Kynrad , hato tang khyndiat ngut ki briew ki ban lait im ?

translation.en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself , that kingdom cannot stand .
translation.kha: Lada ka ri ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka ri kan kyllon noh .

translation.en: And they watched him , and sent forth spies , which should feign themselves just men , that they might take hold of his words , that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khmih ïa ka kabu . Ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leh mynleh kum kiba shida , bad ki la phah ïa ki ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli , khnang ba kin lah ban aiti ïa u ha ki bor synshar bad sha ka bor jong u lyngskor ka Hima Rom .

translation.en: I write unto you , little children , because your sins are forgiven you for his name s sake .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , namar ïa ki pop jong phi la map na ka bynta U Khrist .

translation.en: And we have sent with them our brother , whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things , but now much more diligent , upon the great confidence which I have in you .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi phah ïa u parabangeit jong ngi lem bad ki ; ngi la tynjuh ïa u bunsien bad ngi la shem ïa u ba u long borabor uba thrang ban ïarap . Bad mynta ba u la don haduh katta ïa ka jingshaniah ïa phi , u nang kham thrang shuh shuh ban ïarap .

translation.en: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt , namely , Elnathan the son of Achbor , and certain men with him into Egypt .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoïakim , pynban , u la phah ïa u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah sha Ijipt ban wallam ïa u Uriah .

translation.en: And Menahem slept with his fathers  ; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep , bad u Pekahaïah u khun shynrang jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment : but the righteous into life eternal .
translation.kha: Te , ïa kine , yn phah noh sha ka jingpynshitom bymjukut , hynrei kiba hok kin leit sha ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: This is he of whom I said , After me cometh a man which is preferred before me : for he was before me .
translation.kha: Une u long uta ïa uba nga la kren mynba nga la ong , ‘ U briew uba wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga , namar u la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’

translation.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold : the spear , the dart , nor the habergeon .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano ka waitlam kaba lah ban pynmong ïa u ; Ym don sum ne khnam ne waitsum kaba lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .

translation.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour : but he that seeketh mischief , it shall come unto him .
translation.kha: Lada ki jingthmu jong phi ki long kiba bha , yn ñiewkor ïa phi , hynrei lada phi wad ïa ka jingjynjar , kata ka long kaei kaba phin ïoh .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye are all become dross , behold , therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Te mynta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki ba ki long bymmyntoi ei ei kum kata hi . Ngan wallam lang ïa ki baroh ha Jerusalem

translation.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also ? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness .
translation.kha: Hato kane ka jingsuk kaba U Dabid u la kren ka long tang ïa kito ïa kiba la otsher ? Ym kumta keiñ! Ka long ruh ïa kito ki bym shym la otsher . Naba ngi ong na ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .

translation.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day , it is abominable  ; it shall not be accepted .
translation.kha: namar ka long ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , bad lada uno uno u bam ïa ka , ngan ym pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .

translation.en: He scorneth the multitude of the city , neither regardeth he the crying of the driver .
translation.kha: Ki shong jngai bah na ki nongbah kiba khynwin ; bad ym don ba lah ban pynjuh bad pyntreikam ïa ki .

translation.en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and without blame before him in love :
translation.kha: Wat shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , U Blei u la jied lypa ïa ngi ban long ki jong u ha U Khrist , khnang ba ngin ïoh long kiba khuid bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: As also in all his epistles , speaking in them of these things  ; in which are some things hard to be understood , which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest , as they do also the other scriptures , unto their own destruction .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong ha ki shithi jong u baroh haba u thoh halor kane ka phang . Don katto katne kiei kiei kiba eh ha ki shithi jong u ha kiba ki bym da shemphang bad ki briew ki bymneh jingmut ki batai bakla , kumba ki leh ïa kiwei pat ki bynta ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid . Kumta ki wanrah hi ïa la ka jingjot .

translation.en: Hungry and thirsty , their soul fainted in them .
translation.kha: Ki la thngan bad sliang bad ki la duh baroh ka jingkyrmen .

translation.en: They sent a letter unto him , wherein was written thus  ; Unto Darius the king , all peace .
translation.kha: Ha u patsha Darius , to synshar ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: That which I see not teach thou me : if I have done iniquity , I will do no more .
translation.kha: Hato me la pan na U Blei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ki jingduna jong me , bad hato me la kohnguh ban ym leh pop shuh ?

translation.en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing we have sworn by the  Lord  that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ?
translation.kha: Ngin leh kumno ban pynïoh tnga ïa ki rangbah Benjamin kiba dang sah ? Ngi la ai ïa ka jingkular kaba kyntang sha U  Trai  ba ngin ym ai ha ki ïa la ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: And let thy name be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God over Israel : and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee .
translation.kha: Ka nam jong me kan long kaba khraw , bad ki briew kin ong junom , ‘ U  Trai  Nongsynshar u long U Blei halor ki Israel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa ka longïing syiem jong nga ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle  ; twenty boards for the south side southward :
translation.kha: Ki shna arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,

translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .
translation.kha: U syiem Serksis nangta u ong ha ka Esther ka mahadei bad u Mordekai , u Jiw ,  Peit , nga la sdien phasi ïa u Haman na ka bynta ka jingsylla pyrshah ïa ki Jiw , bad nga la ai ha ka Esther ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .

translation.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u briew uba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban rung lyngba i thliew thyrnia .

translation.en: And Jonadab said unto the king , Behold , the king s sons come : as thy servant said , so it is .
translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Dabid ,  Kito kiba wan ki dei ki khun shynrang jong phi , kumba nga la ong ba kin sa wan .

translation.en: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel , which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance , when they shall look after them : but they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin nym shaniah shuh ha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Ka kupar ki nong Ijipt kan pynkynmaw ïa ki Israel kumno ka la long kaba bakla ban shaniah ha ki . Te ki Israel kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: ( Luke 21 :1-4 ) Thus anyone can regularly “set something aside” to give “just as he has resolved in his heart .” —1 Corinthians 16 :2  ; 2 Corinthians 9 :7 .
translation.kha: ( Loukas 21 :1-4 ) Te mano mano ruh ki lah ban “buh noh ha lade” barabor ban ai “katba u thmu ha la ka dohnud .” —1 Korinth 16 :2 ; 2 Korinth 9 :7 .

translation.en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir : and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher .
translation.kha: Nangta u leit tur ïaleh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha Debir . ( Ïa kane ka nongbah la ju khot ka Kiriath Sepher . )

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard , which was in Jezreel , hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria .
translation.kha: Hajan ka ïingsyiem jong u Ahab ha Jesreel , ka la don ka bri sohwaiñ kaba long trai da u briew uba kyrteng u Naboth .

translation.en: I know both how to be abased , and I know how to abound : every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry , both to abound and to suffer need .
translation.kha: Nga sngewthuh kumno ka long haba kyrduh , bad kumno ka long ban don pahuh kyrhai . Nga la nang ïa kane ka buit barieh , ba hangno hangno ha kano kano ka por , nga sngewhun haba lada nga sngewdap kyrhai ne sngew kyrduh lane haba nga don palat than eh ne don khyndiat eh .

translation.en: Let his heart be changed from man s , and let a beast s heart be given unto him  ; and let seven times pass over him .
translation.kha: Haduh hynñiew snem un ym don ka bor pyrkhat briew , hynrei ka jingpyrkhat kum u mrad .

translation.en: Even him , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders ,
translation.kha: Uta u Basniew un wan ha ka bor u Soitan bad un leh shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba bakla ,

translation.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity , in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month , that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me , saying , The city is smitten .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba shiphew jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , uwei u briew uba la lait im na Jerusalem , u la wan sha nga bad u la ïathuh ha nga ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , go , get thee unto the house of Israel , and speak with my words unto them .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , leit sha ki paid Israel bad ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa me ba men ong .

translation.en: ( For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat . )
translation.kha: ( Ki synran jong u ki la lah leit sha shnong ban thied jingbam . )

translation.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these  ; The first , Simon , who is called Peter , and Andrew his brother  ; James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol : uba nyngkong , U Simon ( ïa uba la khot u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw ; u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi ;

translation.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen : for the Lord  God  shall slay thee , and call his servants by another name :
translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kum ka jingtim . Ma nga , U  Trai  nongsynshar ngan pynïap ïa phi . Hynrei ngan ai ka kyrteng bathymmai ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye , and tell that fox , Behold , I cast out devils , and I do cures to day and to morrow , and the third day I shall be perfected .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa uta u myrsiang : ‘ Nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid bad nga pynkhiah mynta bad la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba lai ngan pyndep ïa ka jingtrei jong nga .’

translation.en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer , and in the thirteenth year they rebelled .
translation.kha: Ki lah don hapoh ka jingsynshar u Khedorlaomer haduh khat-ar snem , hynrei ha ka snem kaba khatlai ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: Then thou shalt take an awl , and thrust it through his ear unto the door , and he shall be thy servant for ever . And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise .
translation.kha: ïalam ïa u sha ka jingkhang ïing jong phi bad sam shkor ïa u hangta , te un sa long u mraw jong phi shi rta . Leh kumjuh ïa ka mraw jong phi .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the congregation , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded to be done .
translation.kha: u la ong ha ki ,  Kaei kaba ngan sa leh ka long ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Give thanks unto the  Lord  , call upon his name , make known his deeds among the people .
translation.kha: Ai ki jingnguh sha U  Trai  , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; Ïathuh ha ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall , and upon them that have daubed it with untempered mortar , and will say unto you , The wall is no more , neither they that daubed it  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynroh bad kito kiba tap ïa ka da ka jingpushara lieh kin sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga . Nangta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ba ka kynroh kam don shuh bad kumta ruh long kito kiba ñiad pushara lieh ïa ka —

translation.en: But as he which hath called you is holy , so be ye holy in all manner of conversation  ;
translation.kha: Pynban , to long kiba khuid ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh , kumba U Blei uba la khot ïa phi u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Do you know how much profit we made ?
translation.kha: Phi tip katno ngi lah iohnong ?

translation.en: Lachish , and Bozkath , and Eglon ,
translation.kha: ka Lakhish , ka Boskath , ka Eglon ,

translation.en: That Hanani , one of my brethren , came , he and certain men of Judah  ; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped , which were left of the captivity , and concerning Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Hanani , uwei na kiba shi para bad nga , u wan poi na Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun jong kiwei pat ki rangbah , bad nga kylli ïa ki shaphang ka Jerusalem bad shaphang ki para Jiw jong ngi kiba la leit phai na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilon .

translation.en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred , and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time that their iniquity had an end :
translation.kha: Me la long u nongshun baïaineh ka Israel bad me shah ba ki briew jong ka kin shah pynïap ha ka por ka jingjynjar jong ka , ka por jong ka jingshah pynshitom bakhatduh namar ki pop jong ka .

translation.en: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches , and with a shadowing shroud , and of an high stature  ; and his top was among the thick boughs .
translation.kha: Me long kum u dieng Kedar ka Lebanon , lem bad ki tnat kiba itynnat bad ba kah syrngiew , u dieng uba jrong katta katta uba kot haduh ki lyoh .

translation.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it ; that as there was a readiness to will , so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have .
translation.kha: To ïai trei , te , bad pyndep ïa ka kam ! To long kiba thrang ban pyndep ïa ka kumba phi la long ha kaba thmu ïa ka , bad to leh ïa ka da kaei kaba phi don mynta .

translation.en: And this I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment ;
translation.kha: Bad kane nga duwai , ba ka jingieit jong phi kan nang ïoh roi kyrhai shuh shuh , ryngkat bad ka jingtip bashisha bad ka jingbishar bajanai .

translation.en: Saying ,  Go ye into the village over against you  ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied , whereon yet never man sat : loose him , and bring him hither .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka shnong hangta kaba ha khmat jong phi ; haba phi rung shapoh , phin shem ïa u khun kada uba la teh ha uba ym pat ju don bashong halor jong u . To loit bad wallam ïa u shane .

translation.en: As we said before , so say I now again , If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received , let him be accursed .
translation.kha: Kumba Ngi la ong mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ong biang ïa ka : Lada uno uno u ïalap ha phi ïa ka Gospel kaba pher na kata kaba phi la pdiang , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok !

translation.en: They shall be holy unto their God , and not profane the name of their God : for the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and the bread of their God , they do offer : therefore they shall be holy .
translation.kha: U dei ban long uba khuid bad um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; u kñia ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga , bad kumta u dei ban long uba khuid .

translation.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes , and his commandments , which I command thee this day , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , for ever .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , khnang ba ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha . Phin ïaishong sah ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ba kan long ka nongkynti jong phi junom .

translation.en: That being justified by his grace , we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life .
translation.kha: khnang ba ngi lah ban don ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut kaba ngi ap kyrmen .

translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt in Heshbon , and ruled from Aroer , which is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and from the middle of the river , and from half Gilead , even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
translation.kha: Uwei u dei u Sihon , u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon . Ka hima jong u ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Gilead : naduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad na ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them , shaduh ka wah Jabbok , ka khappud jong ki Ammon ;

translation.en: And honey , and butter , and sheep , and cheese of kine , for David , and for the people that were with him , to eat : for they said , The people is hungry , and weary , and thirsty , in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki la wanrah ki pliang , ki khra , bad ki jaiñkup thiah , bad ki jingbam ruh ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u : u kew , u barli , u  purew , u kew sdieh , u rymbai , u motor , ka ngap , ka ktung dud    , ka malai , bad katto katne ki langbrot . Ki tip ba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan , ki la sliang , bad ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ahas u syiem ka Judah , u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khyndai snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: Moreover , brethren , we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia ;
translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong ngi , ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa kaei kaba ka jingaiei U Blei ka la pynpaw ha ki balang ha Makedonia .

translation.en: Be thou ashamed , O Zidon : for the sea hath spoken , even the strength of the sea , saying , I travail not , nor bring forth children , neither do I nourish up young men , nor bring up virgins .
translation.kha: Ko nongbah Sidon , pha long kaba la jahburom ! Ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw-rit bad duriaw-bah ki la kyntait ïa pha bad ki ong ,  Ngam ju don kino kino ki khun . Ngam ju pynheh pynsan ïa ki khun shynrang ne ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: And the fourth row a beryl , and an onyx , and a jasper : they shall be set in gold in their inclosings .
translation.kha: bad u Beryl , u Karnelian , bad u Jasper ha ka kyrdon kaba saw . Pyndait ïa ki baroh ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: For they all made us afraid , saying , Their hands shall be weakened from the work , that it be not done . Now therefore , O God , strengthen my hands .
translation.kha: Ki pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa ngi ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam . Nga la duwai ,  Hynrei mynta , A Blei , pynlong khlaiñ ïa nga !

translation.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali , and said unto him , Hath not the  Lord  God of Israel commanded , saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor , and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka la phah khot ïa u Barak u khun jong u Abinoam na ka nongbah Kedesh kaba ha Naphtali bad ka ong ha u ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha me ïa kane ka hukum : ‘ Shim shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtali bad Sebulun bad ïalam ïa ki sha u Lum Tabor .

translation.en: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth ?
translation.kha: Aïu ngi ïohnong na ka kam jong ngi baroh ?

translation.en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon , saying , The  Lord  make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab , whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire  ;
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba la shah rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia ki kwah ban wallam ka jingtim hano hano , kin ong , ‘ To U  Trai  un ñiew ïa phi kum u Sedekaïah bad u Ahab , kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u la syang im !’

translation.en: The father shall be divided against the son , and the son against the father  ; the mother against the daughter , and the daughter against the mother  ; the mother in law against her daughter in law , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
translation.kha: Ki kpa ki long pyrshah ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , bad ki khun shynrang pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki ; ki kmie kin long pyrshah ïa ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki ; ki kiaw kurim kin long pyrshah ïa ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong ki bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kiaw jong ki .

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol .
translation.kha: Bad ka bor U  Trai  ka la sdang ban pynkhlaiñ ïa u katba u dang don hapdeng Sorah bad Eshtaol ha ka jaka sher dara jong ki Dan .

translation.en: Speak unto the congregation , saying , Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki briew ban kynriah sha jngai na ki ïingjaiñ jong u Korah , u Dathan , bad u Abiram .

translation.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears . And Pharaoh awoke , and , behold , it was a dream .
translation.kha: U syiem u la kyndit thiah bad u sngewthuh ba u la phohsniew .

translation.en: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth , and I am come to shew thee  ; for thou art greatly beloved : therefore understand the matter , and consider the vision .
translation.kha: Mynba me la sdang ban ïasaid bad U Blei , u la jubab ïa me . U ieit ïa me , bad kumta nga la wan ban ïathuh ïa ka jubab ha me . Mynta to pynshahshkor katba nga dang batai ïa ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee  ; and thou shalt fear day and night , and shalt have none assurance of thy life :
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong phi kan don borabor ha ka jingma . Synñia sngi phin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng , bad phin sngew kum ban ïap ha kano kano ka khyllipmat .

translation.en: A father must also provide for his family’s spiritual needs .
translation.kha: U kpa u dei ruh ban pynbiang  ha la ïing ïa ki jingdonkam ba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , the top thereof , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns thereof  ; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: Suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the  Lord  thy God in Horeb , when the  Lord  said unto me , Gather me the people together , and I will make them hear my words , that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth , and that they may teach their children .
translation.kha: Ïathuh pateng ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi shaphang kata ka sngi ba phi ïeng ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha u Lum Sinai , mynba u ong ha nga , ‘ Lumlang ïa u paidbah . Nga kwah ba kin ïohsngew aïu ngan ong , ba kumta kin tiengburom ïa nga katba ki dang im bad ba kin hikai ïa la ki khun ki kti ban leh kumjuh .’

translation.en: Let their eyes be darkened , that they may not see , and bow down their back alway .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki khmat jong ki kin matlah khnang ba kin ym ïohi ; bad ai ba kin dem hapoh ki jingjynjar jong ki ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: They shall be carried to Babylon , and there shall they be until the day that I visit them , saith the  Lord   ; then will I bring them up , and restore them to this place .
translation.kha: Yn sa rah ïa ki sha Babilonia bad kin sah hangta tad haduh ba ngan da phai ka jingmut jong nga sha ki . Nangta ngan wallam pat ïa ki bad buh biang ïa ki ha kane ka jaka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And there shall be , like people , like priest : and I will punish them for their ways , and reward them their doings .
translation.kha: Phin sa shah ïa kajuh ka jingpynshitom kum ki riewpaidbah ! Ngan pynshitom ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi ban siew na ka bynta ka jingsniew ba phi leh .

translation.en: And when the living creatures went , the wheels went by them : and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingthaw ki ïaid , ki shalyntem ki ïatyllun lang bad ki , bad haba ki jingthaw ki kiew na ka khyndew ki shalyntem ruh ki leh kumjuh .

translation.en: O Lord , to us belongeth confusion of face , to our kings , to our princes , and to our fathers , because we have sinned against thee .
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynlehrain bad ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me a Trai .

translation.en: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive , and shall see this land no more .
translation.kha: Un ïap ha ka ri sha kaba ki la rah ïa u , bad un ym ïohi shuh ïa kane ka ri .

translation.en: And when they were come out of the ship , straightway they knew him ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la hiar na ka lieng , mar kumta hi , ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him , and shall be broken  ; yea , also the prince of the covenant .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba pyrshah ïa u , wat u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei , un shah sar noh bad shah pynduh .

translation.en: These are the generations of Shem : Shem was an hundred years old , and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood :
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Shem . Ar snem hadien ka jingshlei um , haba u Shem u la dap shispah snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Arpakhshad .

translation.en: And cinnamon , and odours , and ointments , and frankincense , and wine , and oil , and fine flour , and wheat , and beasts , and sheep , and horses , and chariots , and slaves , and souls of men .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka siasia , ki musla , ïa ka jingiwbih , ka mirr , bad ka jingiwbih remdor ; ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ïa u  purew bad u kew , ïa ki jingri bad ki langbrot , ïa ki kulai bad ki kali kulai , ïa ki mraw bad wat ïa ki mynsiem briew ruh .

translation.en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me , nor with my son , nor with my son s son : but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee , thou shalt do unto me , and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned .
translation.kha: Kumta to kular skhem hangne ha khmat U Blei ba men ym shukor ïa nga , ïa ki khun ki kti jong nga , lane ïa ki nonghiarpateng jong nga . Nga la ju lehhok ïa me , kumta to kular ba men lehhok kylliang ïa nga bad ïa kane ka ri ha kaba me shong me sah .

translation.en: Let our lord now command thy servants , which are before thee , to seek out a man , who is a cunning player on an harp : and it shall come to pass , when the evil spirit from God is upon thee , that he shall play with his hand , and thou shalt be well .
translation.kha: Kumta , syiem kynrad , ai ka hukum ïa ngi bad ngin leit wad ïa u briew uba nang ban tem duitara . Te haba u mynsiem bymman u wan ha phi , uta u briew un tem ïa la ka duitara , bad phin sa shait sa koit pat .

translation.en: And they encamped against them , and destroyed the increase of the earth , till thou come unto Gaza , and left no sustenance for Israel , neither sheep , nor ox , nor ass .
translation.kha: Ki sher dara ha ka ri bad ki pynjot ïa ki jingthung baroh shaduh ka jaka bashaphang shathie sawdong ïa ka Gasa . Ki shim ïa baroh ki langbrot , ki jingri , bad ki kada , bad kim shym pynsah ei ei shuh ïa ki Israel ban bam .

translation.en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many : yet they shall fall by the sword , and by flame , by captivity , and by spoil , many days .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam bastad jong ki briew kin ïasam ïa ka jingstad jong ki bad kiwei pat ki briew babun . Hynrei shipor katto katne na ki kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane shah thang ïap , bad katto katne kin shah lute bad shah pynlong koidi .

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon him , and he went down to Ashkelon , and slew thirty men of them , and took their spoil , and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle . And his anger was kindled , and he went up to his father s house .
translation.kha: Hangta hi ka bor jong U  Trai  ka pynshaitbor ïa u , bad u leit hiar sha Ashkelon , ha kaba u pynïap laiphew ngut ki rangbah , u law ïa ki jaiñ jong ki , bad u ai ïa ki jaiñkup baremdor ha kita ki shynrang kiba batai ïa kata ka jingkyntip . Hadien kata , u leit phai noh sha la ïing , da kaba bitar halor kaei kaba la jia ,

translation.en: All that pass by clap their hands at thee  ; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem , saying , Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty , The joy of the whole earth ?
translation.kha: U Trai u rkhiebeiñ ïa baroh ki shipai bakhlaiñ tam jong nga ; u la phah ka kynhun shipai ban pynjot ïa ki samla shynrang jong nga . U la pynlwet ïa ki briew jong nga kum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka khñiot sohwaiñ .

translation.en: As in water face answereth to face , so the heart of man to man .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka durkhmat jong phi hi kaba phalang ha ka um bad ka dei ka malade jong phi hi kaba phi ïohi ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .
translation.kha: Nga ïaid shane shatai ha ka jingdum , khlem ka jingshai ka sngi ; nga ïeng ha khmat ki briew bad nga kyrpad jingïarap .

translation.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts : he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them : he clave the rock also , and the waters gushed out .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba khluit , kaba tyrkhong , kim shym la shahshitom na ka jingsliang . U la pynlong ïa ka um ban mih na u mawsiang na ka bynta jong ki ; u pynpait ïa u mawsiang , bad ka um ka mih nangta .

translation.en: And the mountains shall be molten under him , and the valleys shall be cleft , as wax before the fire , and as the waters that are poured down a steep place .
translation.kha: Te ki lum kin um hapoh jong u kum ka bthing ha ka ding , kin noh sha ki jaka them kum ka um batuid arsut ïa u lumrit .

translation.en: Then Daniel went to his house , and made the thing known to Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah , his companions :
translation.kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha ïing bad u la ïathuh ïa ki paralok jong u — u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah — ïa kaei kaba la jia .

translation.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will , working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight , through Jesus Christ  ; to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: U Blei uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba long u Nongaplangbrot uba khraw jong ki langbrot da kata ka jingïap ha kaba la kñia ïa u , da kaba la pynskhem ïa ka jutang bymjukut . To ai ba U Blei ka jingsuk un pyndap ïa phi da kaei kaei kaba bha baroh kaba phi donkam khnang ban leh ïa ka mon jong u , bad ai ba ma u , da U Jisu Khrist , un leh ha ngi ïa kaei kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Bad ha U Khrist to long ka burom junom la junom , Amen .

translation.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .
translation.kha: Ka kur Gershon ka ïoh khatlai tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Issakhar , Asher , Naphtali , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi .

translation.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore .
translation.kha: Ïa kane la kynmaw kum ka kam babha jong u naduh kata ka por bad yn ïai kynmaw ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .

translation.en: I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki riewdonburom ban kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .

translation.en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u hukum ïa ki nongïalam

translation.en: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi u lah ban im kham slem da kaba u khuslai shaphang jong ka ?

translation.en: And they shall comfort you , when ye see their ways and their doings : and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: te phin tip ba ka la don ka daw kaba bha ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple , neither with multitude , nor with tumult .
translation.kha: Ka la long mynba nga dang leh ïa kane , ba ki la lap ïa nga hapoh ka Templ hadien ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid . Ym shym don u paidbah bad nga bad kam shym don ka jingkulmar .

translation.en: But I say unto you , that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom , than for that city .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi Bishar , U Blei un pyn-i shibun ka jingisynei ïa ka Sodom ban ïa kata ka shnong !

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God , and keep his charge , and his statutes , and his judgments , and his commandments , alway .
translation.kha: Ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïai kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .

translation.en: That they do good , that they be rich in good works , ready to distribute , willing to communicate ;
translation.kha: To hukum ïa ki ba kin leh ïa kaba bha , ban man kyrhai ha ki kam babha , ban long kiba sbun bad kiba kloi ban ïasam bad kiwei .

translation.en: And when Moses  father in law saw all that he did to the people , he said , What is this thing that thou doest to the people ? why sittest thou thyself alone , and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even ?
translation.kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u dei ban leh , u la kylli ,  Kaei keiñ kane kaba phi leh na ka bynta u paidbah ? Balei phi shu leh hi marwei ïa kane baroh katba ki briew ki shu ïa-ïeng hangne naduh dang step haduh ban da miet ban ïasyllok bad me .

translation.en: And they had breastplates , as it were breastplates of iron  ; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle .
translation.kha: Ïa ki shadem jong ki la tap da kaei kaba i kum ki jingïada shadem da ka nar , bad ka jingsawa kaba mih na ki thapniang jong ki ka long kum ka jingriew jong ki kali kulai thma babun kiba leit tur sha ka thma .

translation.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said , The thing proceedeth from the  Lord  : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good .
translation.kha: U Laban bad u Bethuel ki jubab ,  Namar ba kane ka kam ka wan hi na U  Trai  , kam dei ïa ngi ban shim rai .

translation.en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves  ; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the  Lord  spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire :
translation.kha: Mynba U  Trai  u kren ha phi napdeng ka ding ha u Lum Sinai , phim shym la ïohi ïa kano kano ka dur .

translation.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish , a male of the first year : ye shall take it out from the sheep , or from the goats :
translation.kha: Lah ban jied da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , tangba u dei ban long u shynrang uba shisnem bad u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy : and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment , thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place .
translation.kha: Uno uno ne uei uei uba ktah ïa ka doh jong uta u jingkñia un mynsaw da ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka . Lada kano kano ka bynta jong jaiñkup ka bit snam na uta u jingkñia , dei ban sait ïa ka ha ka jaka bakhuid .

translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come into his courts .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong U  Trai  ; to wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u .

translation.en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth , and shall set on fire and burn the weapons , both the shields and the bucklers , the bows and the arrows , and the handstaves , and the spears , and they shall burn them with fire seven years :
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ki Israel kin ïamih shabar bad khar ïa ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh ïa ka ban thang diengïap . Kin sliew ding da ki stieh , ki ryntieh , ki khnam , ki sum bad ki dieng tangon , bad kin biang haduh hynñiew snem .

translation.en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit  ; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit .
translation.kha: U dieng uba plung bha u pynmih ki soh kiba bha , hynrei u dieng uba swai u pynmih ki soh kiba sniew .

translation.en: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David .
translation.kha: bad u Ira , uba na ka shnong Jair u long ruh uwei na ki lyngdoh jong u Dabid .

translation.en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances , and with the bag of deceitful weights ?
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban map ïa kito kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bashukor ?

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What I do thou knowest not now  ; but thou shalt know hereafter .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Mem sngewthuh satia mynta ïa kaei kaba nga leh , hynrei men sa sngewthuh hadien .

translation.en: Then answered one of the servants , and said , Behold , I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth–lehemite , that is cunning in playing , and a mighty valiant man , and a man of war , and prudent in matters , and a comely person , and the  Lord  is with him .
translation.kha: Uwei na kita ki nongap jong u , u ong ,  U Jesse , uba na ka shnong Bethlehem , u don u khun uba long u nongtem nongput uba tbit . U long ruh uba shlur bad uba bhabriew , u shipai uba bha bad uba pnah thylliej . U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against them  ; and he departed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki ; bad kumta katba u dang leit noh ,

translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh bad kan long kaba thylli .

translation.en: For surely there is an end  ; and thine expectation shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , phi don ka lawei kaba phyrnai .

translation.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much , and given to the poor .
translation.kha: Ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih lah ban die ha ka dor kaba rem bad ïa ka pisa ban ai ha kiba duk .

translation.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire , and into the waters , to destroy him : but if thou canst do any thing , have compassion on us , and help us .
translation.kha: Bunsien u mynsiem bymkhuid u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u da ka bret ïa u ha ka ding bad ha ka um . To isynei ïa ngi bad ïarap ïa ngi , lada me lah !

translation.en: And the sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka pyrda ba la wah hapoh ka Templ la pynkad arliang .

translation.en: He built Elath , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u kurup biang bad tei pat ïa ka Elath hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u .

translation.en: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .
translation.kha: Ma ngi baroh kiba la ih bha ka jinglong mynsiem , ngi dei ban ïoh ïa kane kajuh ka jingmut . Hynrei lada don napdeng jong phi kiba don da ka jingmut baïapher , U Blei un pynshai ïa kane ha phi .

translation.en: Tom fell off his mother's lap .
translation.kha: U Tom u hap na lybong kmie jong u .

translation.en: He said ,  Bring them hither to me .
translation.kha: Te wanrah ïa ki hangne ha nga ,  U Jisu u la ong .

translation.en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the  Lord  against the altar in Beth–el , and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria , shall surely come to pass .
translation.kha: Ki ktien ba u kren da ka hukum U  Trai  pyrshah ïa ka duwan ha Bethel bad pyrshah ïa ki jaka mane baroh ha ki shnong kiba ha Samaria , da shisha kin sa urlong .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days , should it also be marvellous in mine eyes ? saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Kane ka lah ban i kum ka bym lah long ha kito ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah mynta , hynrei kam long ka bym lah ban long ïa nga .

translation.en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year , then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations : it shall not go out in the jubilee .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um thied pat ïa ka hapoh kata ka snem , u duh noh ïa kata ka hok ban thied biang , bad kata ka ïing ka sah duh ha uta u nongthied bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u pateng la pateng ; yn ym pyllait ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .

translation.en: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith , wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons , which followed him .
translation.kha: Ki ai ïa u hynñiewphew tylli ki sbai rupa na ka templ jong u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang , bad da kata ka pisa u la wai shi kynhun ki riewdakaid ban ïasoh bad u .

translation.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt , both of man and beast .
translation.kha: Ha Ijipt u la pynïap ïa baroh kiba la kha nyngkong na ki briew bad na ki mrad kumjuh .

translation.en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom . And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri , and cast it out to Joab . And he blew a trumpet , and they retired from the city , every man to his tent . And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king .
translation.kha: Nangta ka leit sha ki briew jong ka nongbah lem bad ka jingthmu jong ka , bad ki la khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Sheba bad bret ïa ka sha u Joab nalor ka kynroh . U la put ïa ka turoi kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , bad ki leit phai noh sha ïing . Bad u Joab u la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem sha u syiem .

translation.en: And it shall be , if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten , that the judge shall cause him to lie down , and to be beaten before his face , according to his fault , by a certain number .
translation.kha: Lada la rai ban sympat ïa uta uba la leh palat , u nongbishar un pyndem pyllup ïa u ha madan bad un phah sympat ïa u . Ka jingsympat kan long kat kum ka kam palat jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive .
translation.kha: Nga bishni ïa kito kiba la ïap bad kiba la leit noh ; ki long kiba kham bha ban ïa kito kiba dang im .

translation.en: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing  ; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season  ; there shall be showers of blessing .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki bad ngan shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha sawdong u lum bakyntang jong nga . Hangta ngan kyrkhu ïa ki da kaba pynhap ïa u  lap praw haba ki donkam ïa u .

translation.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced : and the city was quiet , after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword .
translation.kha: La pyndap da ka jingkmen ïa ki briew baroh , bad ka nongbah ka la shongsuk , mynta ba la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah .

translation.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul that is above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and burn them upon the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , weng noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki snier , ïa u dohnud , bad ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Pass ye away , thou inhabitant of Saphir , having thy shame naked : the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel  ; he shall receive of you his standing .
translation.kha: Phi ki briew ka Shaphir , leit shah ringmraw , ha ka jinglyngkhuit bad jinglehrain . Kito kiba shong ha Saanan kim nud ban mih shabar na ka nongbah jong ki . Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki briew jong ka Bethesel ki ïambriew , phin tip ba ym don jakarieh hangta .

translation.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise upon his sword , and died with him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap lem bad u Saul .

translation.en: I beseech thee , O  Lord  , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , ba nga la shakri ïa me ha ka hok bad jingïaineh skhem , bad nga la pyrshang borabor ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh .  Bad u sdang ban ïamkthang .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David , and a little lad with him .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Jonathan u leit sha ki bri ban ïakynduh ïa U Dabid kumba u la ïakut . U ïalam ïa uwei u khynnah samla bad u ,

translation.en: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Jehoash u phah kylla ïa ka jubab kumne :  Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u phah ïa ka khubor sha u dieng Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jong phi ban shongkurim bad u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïaid nangta bad u kyrdem ïa u dieng shiah shapoh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , and will make them like vile figs , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ Nga wallam ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang ha ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki kum ki soh Dumbur kiba la pyut eh ïa ka ban bam .

translation.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world .
translation.kha: Kumta ong U Trai , uba la pyntip ïa kane slem bah mynshuwa .’

translation.en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves .
translation.kha: U Abraham u pynkyrpang hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot na ka kynhun langbrot jong u ,

translation.en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king , Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king ? let me go over , I pray thee , and take off his head .
translation.kha: U Abishai , uba ka kmie jong u , ka Seruïah , u ong ha u syiem ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi shah ïa une u ksew ban tim ïa phi ? Shah ngan leit hangtai bad khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u !

translation.en: Though Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither son nor daughter  ; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness .
translation.kha: wat lada u Noah , u Daniel , bad u Job ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Ka jingbha jong ki kan pyllait im tang ïa ka jingim jong ki .

translation.en: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss .
translation.kha: To ïakhublei parabangeit da ka jingdoh parabangeit .

translation.en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt , and brought them into the wilderness .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt sha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast , they give suck to their young ones : the daughter of my people is become cruel , like the ostriches in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Wat ka kmie suri kan sumar ïa la ki khun , hynrei ki briew jong nga ki long kum ki ostrit , kiba lehbeiñ ïa ki khun rit jong ki .

translation.en: And I fell at his feet to worship him . And he said unto me , See thou do it not : I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus : worship God : for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy .
translation.kha: Nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u ban mane ïa u , hynrei u la ong ha nga ,  Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u para shakri bad me bad kita ki parabangeit jong me , kito baroh kiba bat ïa ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw . To mane ïa U Blei !  Naba ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw ka long kata kaba pyrsad mynsiem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna : and it was like coriander seed , white  ; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki khot ïa kata ka jingbam ,  ka manna . Ka long kum u symbai balieh uba rit , bad ka shngiam kum u kpu lyngkniap ba la shet bad ka ngap .

translation.en: If men strive , and hurt a woman with child , so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow : he shall be surely punished , according as the woman s husband will lay upon him  ; and he shall pay as the judges determine .
translation.kha: Lada ki rangbah kiba ïashoh ki pynmynsaw ïa ka kynthei kaba punkhun , bad kata ka briew ka hap khun , hynrei kam shym mong shym mynsaw da kumwei pat , uta uba pynmynsaw ïa ka un shah shaiñ kuna kat kumba u tnga jong kata ka briew u dawa , bad u dei ban siew kumba la buh dor ki nongbishar .

translation.en: Yea , better is he than both they , which hath not yet been , who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .
translation.kha: Hynrei kham bha ban ïa kine baroh ar long kito ki bym pat shym la kha , ki bym pat ïohi ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Sing , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O Israel  ; be glad and rejoice with all the heart , O daughter of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: To rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid Israel ! To shadkmen da la ka dohnud baroh , ko Jerusalem !

translation.en: He shall return no more to his house , neither shall his place know him any more .
translation.kha: Kum u lyoh uba mih bad u jah noh , u briew u ïap bad um wan phai shuh ; la klet noh da baroh kiba ithuh ïa u .
