translation.en: For I know thy rebellion , and thy stiff neck : behold , while I am yet alive with you this day , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord   ; and how much more after my death ?
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno phi long kiba mutlop bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah . Phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynba nga dang im , bad ynda nga la ïap lei lei , phin nang kham ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: And they returned , and prepared spices and ointments  ; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha ïing bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ki musla bad ki jingiwbih na ka bynta ka met . Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki la shongthait , kumba ka Hukum ka dawa .

translation.en: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and said , Send away the ark of the God of Israel , and let it go again to his own place , that it slay us not , and our people : for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city  ; the hand of God was very heavy there .
translation.kha: Kumta sa shisien pat ki khot lang ïa ki syiem Philistia baroh bad ki ong ,  Pynphai noh ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel sha ka jaka jong ka , ba kumta kan ym pynïap ïa ngi bad ïa ki longïing jong ngi .  La don ka jingkulmar baroh kawei ka nongbah namar ba U Blei u la pynshitom jur ïa ki .

translation.en: Then answered Simon , and said , Pray ye to the Lord for me , that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me .
translation.kha: U Simon u la ong ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,  Sngewbha duwai ha U Trai na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba kawei ruh na kita kiei kiei kiba phi la kren kan ym jia ha nga .

translation.en: Yea , the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times  ; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming  ; but my people know not the judgment of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ki thring ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban wan phai ; ki lyngdkhur , ki lyntait , bad ki throsh    ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban leit noh shawei . Hynrei , ko ki briew jong nga , phim shym tip ïa ki aiñ da kiba nga synshar ïa phi .

translation.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali  ; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife :
translation.kha: U Ahimaas , uba shongkurim ïa ka Basemath , kawei pat na ki khun kynthei jong u Solomon : ka ri Naphtali

translation.en: Jesus cried and said ,  He that believeth on me , believeth not on me , but on him that sent me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga u ngeit ym tang ha nga hynrei ruh ha uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto Isaiah , Go forth now to meet Ahaz , thou , and Shear–jashub thy son , at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Isaïah ,  To shim ïa u Shear Jashub u khun jong me , bad khie leit ban ïakynduh ïa u Syiem Ahas . Men shem ïa u ha ka lynti ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , ha kaba kut ka nala kaba wallam um na ka pung kaba haneng .

translation.en: And Cain said unto the  Lord  , My punishment is greater than I can bear .
translation.kha: Bad u Kain u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Kane ka jingpynshitom ka long palat ïa kaba nga lah ban shah .

translation.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and said unto him , Thus saith the king , Come forth . And he said , Nay  ; but I will die here . And Benaiah brought the king word again , saying , Thus said Joab , and thus he answered me .
translation.kha: U la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u ong ha u Joab ,  U syiem u hukum ba men mih shabar .   Em ,  u Joab u jubab ,  ngan ïap hangne .  U Benaïah u la leit phai sha u syiem bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Joab u la ong .

translation.en: Who found favour before God , and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob .
translation.kha: U la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Blei , bad u la kyrpad ïa U Blei ban shah ïa u ban pynkhreh ka ïing na ka bynta U Blei jong u Jakob .

translation.en: Gather the people , sanctify the congregation , assemble the elders , gather the children , and those that suck the breasts : let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber , and the bride out of her closet .
translation.kha: To ïalumlang ïa ki paidbah ; to pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïalang bakyntang ; to wallam ki briew ba la tymmen ; to ïalumlang ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ruh . Wat kito kiba dang shu dep shongkurim ki dei ban mihnoh na la ka kamra bad ban wan .

translation.en: And I will dash them one against another , even the fathers and the sons together , saith the  Lord  : I will not pity , nor spare , nor have mercy , but destroy them .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan lynthaw ïa ki kum ïa ki khra uwei pyrshah ïa uwei pat , uba tymmen bad uba samla kumjuh . Ym don ka jingsngewsynei , ka jingsngewlem , lane ka jingisynei ka ban pynsangeh ïa nga na kaba pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar , which is in the king s dale : for he said , I have no son to keep my name in remembrance : and he called the pillar after his own name : and it is called unto this day , Absalom s place .
translation.kha: Mynba u dang im , u Absalom u la tei u mot na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka Them jong u Syiem , naba um don khun shynrang u ban ri pynim ïa ka kyrteng jong u . Kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa u da la ka jong ka kyrteng , bad haduh kane ka sngi la tip ïa u kum u Mot jong u Absalom .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us : for they shall not depart .
translation.kha: Ma nga U  Trai  , nga maham ïa me ban ym shukor ïa lade da kaba pyrkhat ba ki nong Babilonia kin ym wan shuh , namar kin sa wan biang .

translation.en: But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Pynban katba ki Israel ki nang shah pynshitom beiñ , katta ruh ki nang ïaroi bad ki nang saphriang kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: Pride goeth before destruction , and an haughty spirit before a fall .
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong ka ïalam sha ka jingjot , bad ka jingsngewmeng sha ka jingkyllon noh .

translation.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the  Lord  who had sent him , and all the signs which he had commanded him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la ong mynba u phah ïa u ban leit phai sha Ijipt ; u ïathuh ruh ha u shaphang ki kambah kiba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ban leh .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist : notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u long uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki bneng u long uba kham khraw ban ïa u Ïoannis .

translation.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard , Behold , these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree , and find none : cut it down  ; why cumbereth it the ground ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la ong ha u nongsumar kper jong u , ‘ Ha khmih , la lai snem nga la wan shane da kaba wad soh Dumbur ha une u diengsoh Dumbur , bad ngam shym shem ei ei . Khet noh ïa u ! Balei un shu pynsep-ei ïa ka khyndew ?’

translation.en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord , and his mother and mine .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhublei ïa u Ruphos , ba u la jied ia U Trai , bad ïa ka kmie jong u , bad jongnga .

translation.en: And the prophet came to the king of Israel , and said unto him , Go , strengthen thyself , and mark , and see what thou doest : for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Ahab , bad u ong ,  Khie leit noh bad pynkhlaiñ ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me , bad da pynbha ïa ka rukom ïaleh namar u syiem Syria un wan tur ïaleh biang ha ka por pyrem ka ban wan .

translation.en: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days  ; neither shall there any thing of the flesh , which thou sacrificedst the first day at even , remain all night until the morning .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter ym bit ïa uno uno ha kata ka ri ban don thiat ha ïing jong u ; bad ïa ka doh ba phi kñia ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba nyngkong dei ban bam lut ha kajuh hi ka miet .

translation.en: The blind receive their sight , and the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , and the deaf hear , the dead are raised up , and the poor have the gospel preached to them .
translation.kha: kiba matlah ki lah ban ïohi , kiba dkoh ki lah ban ïaid , ïa kito kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh la pynkhuid , kiba kyllut ki ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïap la pynim pat , bad ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ha kiba duk .

translation.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , ( the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty , )
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , ka la don ka jingïalang jong ki riewngeit , kumba shispah arphew ngut baroh , bad u Petros u la ïeng ban kren .

translation.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as thy father David did walk , then I will lengthen thy days .
translation.kha: Bad lada me kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , ngan ai ha me ka jingim kaba jlan .

translation.en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ ; that every one may receive the things done in his body , according to that he hath done , whether it be good or bad .
translation.kha: Naba baroh na ngi ngin paw ha khmat U Khrist , ba yn bishar ïa ngi da u . Ngin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba ngi dei hok , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi la leh , la bha ne la sniew , ha kane ka jingim ha ka met jong ngi .

translation.en: So he went back with him , and did eat bread in his house , and drank water .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u leit sha ka ïing jong u nongïathuhlypa tymmen bad u bam u dih bad u .

translation.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Did I not make thee to swear by the  Lord  , and protested unto thee , saying , Know for a certain , on the day thou goest out , and walkest abroad any whither , that thou shalt surely die ? and thou saidst unto me , The word that I have heard is good .
translation.kha: u la phah khot ïa u bad u ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me ban smai ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ban ym mihnoh na Jerusalem . Bad nga la maham ïa me ba lada me leh kumta , men ïap da shisha . Hato mem shym la mynjur ïa ka bad ong ba men kohnguh ïa nga ?

translation.en: And he said , Certainly I will be with thee  ; and this shall be a token unto thee , that I have sent thee : When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt , ye shall serve God upon this mountain .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ,  Ngan long lem bad me , bad haba me ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga na Ijipt , phin ïamane ïa nga ha une u lum . Kata kan long ka jingpynshisha ba nga la phah ïa me .

translation.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me : and I caused the widow s heart to sing for joy .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don ha ki jingjynjar bakhraw ki ïaroh ïa nga , bad nga la ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei ban ïoh jingshngain .

translation.en: Do not ye yet understand , that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly , and is cast out into the draught ?
translation.kha: Hato phim shemphang ? Kano kano kaba rung shapoh ka shyntur jong u briew ka leit shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nangta pat shabar na ka met jong u .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  unto them  ; Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar hapdeng jong phi ïa ki langbrot kiba khlaiñ bad ki langbrot kiba tlot .

translation.en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him , they sent out into all that country round about , and brought unto him all that were diseased  ;
translation.kha: Kumta ki la phah khot ïa ki briew kiba pang ha baroh ki jaka sawdong jong ka ri bad ki la wallam ïa ki sha U Jisu .

translation.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Ammon um patiaw ei ei ruh em ïa kane ka khubor na u Jephthah .

translation.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; and he fell upon him that he died .
translation.kha: Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la leit bad pynïap ïa u Adonijah .

translation.en: And he took the book of the covenant , and read in the audience of the people : and they said , All that the  Lord  hath said will we do , and be obedient .
translation.kha: Nangta pat u shim ïa ka kitab ka jutang ha kaba la thoh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  bad u pule jam ïa ka ha uta u paidbah ; ki ruh ki ïa-ong ,  Ïa kita baroh kiba U  Trai  u la hukum , ngin leh , bad ngin kohnguh .

translation.en: And Achish believed David , saying , He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him  ; therefore he shall be my servant for ever .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Akhish u shaniah ïa u Dabid , u da ong ha lade ,  U la long uba la isih haduh katta katta da ki briew jong u hi ki Israel ba kumta un hap long u shakri ïa nga baroh shi rta .

translation.en: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him  ; and they pleased him not .
translation.kha: Haba u Hiram u leit jngoh ïa kita ki shnong , um mon ïa ki .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head , because thou canst not make one hair white or black .
translation.kha: Wat ym smai da ka khlieh jong phi , naba phim lah ban pynlieh lane pynïong ïa iwei i shñiuh .

translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place , and shall not be quenched .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar jong nga da baroh kaba ki la leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la khie buk , bad ngan ym pynjah kumto .

translation.en: Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die . And Elijah departed .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u syiem ba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Men ym ïohkhiah na ki jingmynsaw jong me ; men ïap !’  U Elijah u la leh kumba la hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: I'm not going to tell them that .
translation.kha: Ngan nym iathuh iaki kata .

translation.en: There they cry , but none giveth answer , because of the pride of evil men .
translation.kha: Ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , hynrei U Blei um jubab , naba ki long kiba sarong bad ba-bymman .

translation.en: And if any man say ought unto you , ye shall say , The Lord hath need of them  ; and straightway he will send them .
translation.kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong ei ei , ïathuh ha u , ‘ U Kynrad u donkam ïa ki ;’ bad nangta un sa pyllait ïa ki shisyndon .

translation.en: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan , and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city : and set thy face against it , and it shall be besieged , and thou shalt lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Shim uwei u khiew nar bad pynïeng ïa u kum ka kynroh hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah . Phai khmat sha ka nongbah . Ka don ha ka jingshah kerkut , bad dei ma me uba kerkut ïa ka . Kane kan long ka dak ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel .

translation.en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver , if she lose one piece , doth not light a candle , and sweep the house , and seek diligently till she find it ?
translation.kha: Lane tharai kawei ka briew kaba don shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa ka duh noh kawei na ki — kaei ba kan leh ? Ka thang ïa ka sharak , ka sar ïa la ka ïing , bad ka khmih biang biang kylleng kylleng haduh ba kan da shem ïa ka .

translation.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite , whose name was Shua  ; and he took her , and went in unto her .
translation.kha: Hangta u Judah u la ïakynduh ïa ka samla nong Kanaan uba u kpa jong ka u kyrteng u Shua .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath performed his word that he spake , and I am risen up in the room of David my father , and sit on the throne of Israel , as the  Lord  promised , and have built an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Bad mynta U  Trai  u la pyndep ïa ka kular jong u . Nga la kiew ïa ka khet u kpa jong nga , u syiem ki Israel bad nga la tei ïa ka Templ ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: He yearns to bring back those who are in his memory and to see them live on earth again . —Job 14 :14 , 15 .
translation.kha: U kwah ban wanrah biang ïa kito kiba u buh jingkynmaw bad ban ïohi ba ki im biang ha pyrthei .—Job 14 :14 , 15 .

translation.en: Who is he that will plead with me ? for now , if I hold my tongue , I shall give up the ghost .
translation.kha: Hato me wan ban kynnoh ïa nga , A Blei ? Lada me leh kumta , nga kloi ban shu sngap jar bad ïap noh .

translation.en: And the men of Gibeah rose against me , and beset the house round about upon me by night , and thought to have slain me : and my concubine have they forced , that she is dead .
translation.kha: Ki nong Gibeah ki wan ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad mynmiet ki kerkut ïa ka ïing . Ki thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ; pynban ki leh pynjahburom ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad ka da ïap noh .

translation.en: And a mitre of fine linen , and goodly bonnets of fine linen , and linen breeches of fine twined linen ,
translation.kha: bad ka jaiñspong , ki tupia , ki patlun ,

translation.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it : and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynïoh myntoi ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un ïoh ïa ka .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga .

translation.en: Wherefore , my brethren , ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ ; that ye should be married to another , even to him who is raised from the dead , that we should bring forth fruit unto God .
translation.kha: Ka long kumta bad phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . Ha ka jingïadei bad ka hukum , ma phi ruh phi la ïap namar phi long ka bynta jong ka met U Khrist ; bad mynta phi long ki jong u , uta ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba U Blei u lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam jong u .

translation.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ , the Son of the living God .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ngi ngeit bad ngi tip ba me long uta U Bakhuid uba la wan na U Blei .

translation.en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the  Lord  in the presence of all the congregation of Israel , and spread forth his hands toward heaven :
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat u paidbah , u Solomon u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat ka duwan , u rah ïa la ki kti ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the  Lord  against the sun , that the fierce anger of the  Lord  may be turned away from Israel .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh bad da kaba kohnguh ïa nga , pynïap ïa ki haba shai ka sngi te ngan ym bitar shuh ïa ki briew .

translation.en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the  Lord  : but such as are upright in their way are his delight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba don jingmut sniew , hynrei u ieit ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: Of whom it was said , That in Isaac shall thy seed be called :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Dei lyngba u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba nga la kular .

translation.en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses , inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house .
translation.kha: U briew uba tei ïa ka ïing u ïoh kham bun ka burom ban ïa ka ïing hi . Ha kajuh ka rukom U Jisu u long uba dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa u Moses .

translation.en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you , and ye shall afflict your souls , by a statute for ever .
translation.kha: Kata ka sngi ka dei ban long ka sngi kaba khuid bha , ka sngi ha kaba ki shahjingit bad kim trei ïa kano kano ka kam . Kine ki dei ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ban rakhe pateng la pateng .

translation.en: The same was in the beginning with God .
translation.kha: Naduh kaba sdang u Ktien u la don bad U Blei .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Thus saith Hezekiah , This day is a day of trouble , and of rebuke , and of blasphemy : for the children are come to the birth , and there is not strength to bring forth .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba u ïathuh ha ki ban ai ha u Isaïah ;  Mynta ka long ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar ; ngi la shah pynshitom bad ngi long ha ka jinglehrain . Ngi long kum ka kynthei kaba la suh kha , hynrei kaba tlot katta katta ba kam lah ban kha .

translation.en: And the king arose in the night , and said unto his servants , I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us . They know that we be hungry  ; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field , saying , When they come out of the city , we shall catch them alive , and get into the city .
translation.kha: Ka dang long mynmiet eh , hynrei u syiem u khie joit na jingthiah bad u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei ba ki Syria ki thmu . Ki tip ba ngi shahthngan hangne , kumta ki mih na la ka jaka shong dara ban leit rieh ha ki rudnong . Ki da pyrkhat ba ngin iehnoh ïa ka nongbah ban leit wad jingbam bad kumta kin sa kem ïa ngi bad kurup ïa kane ka nongbah .

translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen , and although I have scattered them among the countries , yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come .
translation.kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki para ba shah ringmraw ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Nga long uta uba la phah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri kiba jngai bad pynsakma ïa ki ha kiwei de ki ri . Pynban , ïa mynta shipor ngan don bad ki ha ki jaka sha kaba ki la leit .

translation.en: And the temple of God was opened in heaven , and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament : and there were lightnings , and voices , and thunderings , and an earthquake , and great hail .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Templ U Blei ha bneng la plie , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang la ïohi hangta . Nangta la don ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ka jingkhynñiuh jumai bad ka jinghap phria kaba jur .

translation.en: And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .
translation.kha: U Judas bad u Silas , kiba long hi ki nongïathuhlypa , ki la kren slem bad ki , da kaba ai ha ki ka jingpynshlur bad ka jingpynkhlaiñ .

translation.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son , We were Pharaoh s bondmen in Egypt  ; and the  Lord  brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ Ngi la long ki mraw u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , bad U  Trai  u la pyllait ïa ngi da ka borbah jong u .

translation.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour , to slay him with guile  ; thou shalt take him from mine altar , that he may die .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u briew da kaba bitar u pynïap khnang ïa uwei pat , dei ban pynïap ïa u , wat la u wan ban rieh ha ka duwan jong nga .

translation.en: To every thing there is a season , and a time to every purpose under the heaven :
translation.kha: Baroh kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei ka jia ha ka por kaba U Blei u jied .

translation.en: Look down from thy holy habitation , from heaven , and bless thy people Israel , and the land which thou hast given us , as thou swarest unto our fathers , a land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: To khmih nangto na ka jaka shong bakhuid jong me ha bneng bad kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , bad ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba me la ai ha ngi , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .’

translation.en: And as they went about to kill him , tidings came unto the chief captain of the band , that all Jerusalem was in an uproar .
translation.kha: U paidbhur u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u Paul , haba la phah ïa ka khubor sha u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Rom ba ka Jerusalem baroh ka la khihwin .

translation.en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this : why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?
translation.kha: Leh ïa kane shisyndon , khnang ba yn ym don shuh ka jingma ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .

translation.en: And I saw , and behold a white horse : and he that sat on him had a bow  ; and a crown was given unto him : and he went forth conquering , and to conquer .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai balieh . Halor jong u , u nongshong kulai u la bat ïa ka ryntieh , bad ha u la ai ïa ka pansngiat . U la shong halor jong u kum u nongjop ban jop .

translation.en: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight : and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him ,
translation.kha: U Moses u la sngewlyngngoh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi , bad u la leit hajan ka  lawlynnong ban ïohi kham bha . Hynrei u la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Trai :

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath done to him , as he spake by me : for the  Lord  hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand , and given it to thy neighbour , even to David :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la leh ha me kumba u la kren da nga : u la knieh kynthet ïa ka hima na me , bad pynban u la ai ïa ka ha u Dabid .

translation.en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother  ; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver , and gave them to the founder , who made thereof a graven image and a molten image : and they were in the house of Micah .
translation.kha: Kumta u pynphai pat ïa ki sha la ka kmie . Ka shim arspah tylli ki sbai rupa bad ka ai ïa ki ha u bania , uba la thaw ïa ka bleithaw , da kaba shniah ïa ka na ka dieng bad suit da ka rupa . La buh ïa ka ha ïing u Mikah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand , and with an outstretched arm , and with great terribleness , and with signs , and with wonders :
translation.kha: Da ka borbah bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt . U leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla , bad u la pynjia ïa kiei kiei kiba sngewtriem .

translation.en: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day , neither do ye any work , but hallow ye the sabbath day , as I commanded your fathers .
translation.kha: lane rah ïa kano kano shabar ki ïing jong ki ha ka Sabbaton . Kim dei ban trei ha ka Sabbaton ; ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngi bakyntang , kumba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: And they that kept them fled , and went their ways into the city , and told every thing , and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet noh bad ki la leit shapoh ka shnong , ha kaba ki la ïathuh ïa ka jingjia baroh kawei bad ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki rangbah kiba shongksuid .

translation.en: And he thought within himself , saying , What shall I do , because I have no room where to bestow my fruits ?
translation.kha: U la sdang ban pyrkhat ha lade , ‘ Ngam don hangno hangno ban buh ïa ki jingthung jong nga baroh . Aïu nga lah ban leh ?

translation.en: Which was a figure for the time then present , in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices , that could not make him that did the service perfect , as pertaining to the conscience  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka dur kaba kdew sha ka por kaba mynta . Ka mut ba ka jingainguh bad ki jingkñia da ki mrad ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei kim lah satia ban pynjanai ïa ka dohnud jong uta uba mane ,

translation.en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened , and be ye valiant : for your master Saul is dead , and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them .
translation.kha: To long kiba khlaiñ bad kiba shlur ! U Saul , u syiem jong phi u la ïap , bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsleh ïa nga kum u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: That make a man an offender for a word , and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate , and turn aside the just for a thing of nought .
translation.kha: U Blei un pynjot ïa kito kiba kren sniew ïa kiwei , kito kiba khanglad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki riewrunar , bad kito kiba kren lamler ban khang ïa ki briew kiba hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Whereupon the king took counsel , and made two calves of gold , and said unto them , It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem : behold thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pyrkhat bha , u shna ar tylli ki khun masi kiba da ka ksiar bad u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Phi la hap ïaleit mane jngai palat shaduh Jerusalem . Ko ki paid Israel , khmih kine ki blei kiba la wanlam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt !

translation.en: Then washed I thee with water  ; yea , I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee , and I anointed thee with oil .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa ka um bad sait ïa ka snam na pha . Nga kyllan umphniang Olib halor ka sniehdoh jong pha .

translation.en: But when the people were put forth , he went in , and took her by the hand , and the maid arose .
translation.kha: Hynrei mar ïa pynmih ïa ki briew shabar , U Jisu u la rung shapoh ka kamra jong ka khynnah bad u la bat ïa ka kti jong ka , bad ka la khie joit .

translation.en: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good : and whoso trusteth in the  Lord  , happy is he .
translation.kha: Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , bad phin ïoh manbha ; shaniah ha U  Trai  bad phin long uba kmen .

translation.en: Just tell me what's going on .
translation.kha: Shu iathuh ianga jia aiu .

translation.en: Which was the son of Joanna , which was the son of Rhesa , which was the son of Zorobabel , which was the son of Salathiel , which was the son of Neri ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Joanan , u khun jong u Rhesa , u khun jong u Serubbabel , u khun jong u Shealtiel , u khun jong u Neri ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians , so that they lent unto them such things as they required . And they spoiled the Egyptians .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin ñiewburom ïa ki Israel bad ba kin ai kat ïa kaba ki pan . Dei da kumne ba ki Israel ki rah noh ïa ka spah ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not , and if he be pleased to dwell with her , let her not leave him .
translation.kha: Bad lada ka parabangeit ka la shongkurim ïa u briew u bymngeit bad u mynjur ban ïaishong bad ka , kam dei ban pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.kha: U Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Asahel bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u ha Bethlehem . Nangta ki la ïaid baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por kynjat shai ki la wan poi biang ha Hebron .

translation.en: Unto Timothy , my own son in the faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit : To U Blei U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Teams of construction servants and volunteers move from one congregation to the next within a country , even in remote areas , assisting the local congregations with the construction of their Kingdom Halls .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun jong ki nongtei mon sngewbha ki leit na kawei ka balang sha kawei pat ha kajuh ka ri , wat sha ki jaka ba kyndong , ban ïarap tei ïa ki Ïing Hima jong ki .

translation.en: And Moses told his father in law all that the  Lord  had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel s sake , and all the travail that had come upon them by the way , and how the  Lord  delivered them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ïathuh ha u Jethro ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki nong Ijipt khnang ba un ïoh pyllait im ïa ki Israel . U la ïathuh ruh ha u ïa ki jingeh ba ki Israel ki la ïakynduh ha lynti bad kumno U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit jong u , U Blei u la rai lypa ba da U Jisu Khrist un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u — kane ka long ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingthmu jong u .

translation.en: And now I say unto you , Refrain from these men , and let them alone : for if this counsel or this work be of men , it will come to nought :

translation.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners : thy wise men , O Tyre , that were in thee , were thy pilots .
translation.kha: Ki maji jong pha ki long na ki nongbah ka Sidon bad Arbad . Ki rangbah batbit jong pha hi ki la long ki maji .

translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba hynñiew u wan phai bad u ong ,  Nga ïohi khyndiat u lyoh u bym da heh palat ïa ka kti briew ba u kiew na ka duriaw . translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , which giveth the sun for a light by day , and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night , which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynbiang ïa ka sngi ban pynshai mynsngi , ïa u bnai bad ki khlur ban pynshai mynmiet . U pynkhih ïa ka duriaw bad pynlong ïa ka ban kyrhuh ; ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old , all that enter into the host , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: La pynsleh bad la pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ,

translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba phi dei ban sumar bad leh ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .

translation.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass ? or loweth the ox over his fodder ?

translation.kha: Lada phi lah ban pyllut shibun ka por lane tang khyndiat por man ka taiew , ki wongsakhi ki lah ban pyllait ïalade ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: And if they were all one member , where were the body ?

translation.en: And he turned back , and looked on them , and cursed them in the name of the  Lord . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood , and tare forty and two children of them .

translation.en: And Ish–bosheth sent , and took her from her husband , even from Phaltiel the son of Laish .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ishbosheth u phah shim noh ïa ka na u tnga jong ka , u Paltiel u khun jong u Laish .

translation.en: Praise the  Lord   ; for the  Lord  is good : sing praises unto his name  ; for it is pleasant .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; to rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , namar u long uba bha sbun .

translation.en: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them , On this condition will I make a covenant with you , that I may thrust out all your right eyes , and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel .
translation.kha: U Nahash u jubab ,  Ngan ïateh jutang bad phi halor kawei ka kyndon : Ngan khlaw ïa ka khmat kamon jong phi baroh , bad da kumta ngan pynjahburom halor ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last shall be first .
translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba mynta ki long kiba ha shuwa kin long kiba khatduh , bad bun kiba mynta ki long kiba khatduh kin long kiba ha shuwa .

translation.en: And Solomon awoke  ; and , behold , it was a dream . And he came to Jerusalem , and stood before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and offered up burnt offerings , and offered peace offerings , and made a feast to all his servants .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la kyndit thiah bad u sngewthuh ba dei U Blei uba la kren ïa u ha ka jingphohsniew . Nangta u la leit sha Jerusalem bad u la ïeng ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang ka jong U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha U  Trai . Hadien kata u la ai ka jingkhawai ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u .

translation.en: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections : for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature :
translation.kha: Namar ba ki leh ïa kane , U Blei u la ai noh ïa ki sha ki jingkwah brai bakhlemrain . Wat ki kynthei ki la pynbakla noh ïa ka jingpyndonkam kaba dei kat kum ka rukom ha ka jingshongkurim da ki jingleh ki bym dei kat kum ka rukom .

translation.en: In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him .
translation.kha: U ryndang jong u , u long uba khlaiñ eh ba baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa u ki sngewtriem .

translation.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle , for the two sides westward .
translation.kha: san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei pat ka liang , bad san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba shadien , shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: For who hath despised the day of small things ? for they shall rejoice , and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven  ; they are the eyes of the  Lord  , which run to and fro through the whole earth .
translation.kha: Ki la noh mynsiem namar ka jingsuki jong ka jingïaid ka kam . Hynrei kin ïohi ba u Serubbabel u dang ïai tei ïa ka Templ , bad kin long kiba kmen .  U angel u la ong ha nga ,  Ki hynñiew tylli ki sharak ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki khmat jong U  Trai  kiba khmih halor ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made , to consecrate and to sanctify them : but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy .
translation.kha: Kin bam tang ïa kata ïa kaba la pyndonkam ha ka jinglehniam ka jingmap ha ka por ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki . Tang ki lyngdoh ki lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingbam , namar ka long kaba kyntang .

translation.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles , whom God drave out before the face of our fathers , unto the days of David  ;
translation.kha: Hadien , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka ïingjaiñ na ki kpa jong ki , ki la bah ïa ka lem bad ki haba ki la leit bad u Joshua bad shimti ïa ka ri na ki jaitbynriew kiba U Blei u la beh katba ki nang tur sha khmat . Bad ka la don hangta haduh ka por jong u Dabid .

translation.en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim , and the kingdom from Damascus , and the remnant of Syria : they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kan long kaba khlem jingïada , bad ka Damaskos kan duh noh ïa ka jinglaitluid jong ka . Kito ki nong Syria kiba lait im kin don ha ka jinglehrain kum ki briew jong ka Israel . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .

translation.en: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel , thou , and all thy bands , and the people that is with thee : I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort , and to the beasts of the field to be devoured .
translation.kha: U Gog bad ka kynhun shipai jong u bad kiba ïateh lok bad u kin kyllon ïap ha ki lumbah ka Israel , bad ngan ai ïa ki met jong ki ba kin long ka jingbam ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw .

translation.en: Thou art my portion , O  Lord  : I have said that I would keep thy words .
translation.kha: Me long baroh uba nga kwah , A  Trai  ; nga kular ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel , even of all the mighty men of wealth , of each man fifty shekels of silver , to give to the king of Assyria . So the king of Assyria turned back , and stayed not there in the land .
translation.kha: U Menahem u ïoh ïa ka pisa na kiba riewspah ka Israel da kaba pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei ban noh synñiang sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa . Te u Tiglath Pileser u leit phai pat sha la ka ri .

translation.en: And the  Lord  discomfited Sisera , and all his chariots , and all his host , with the edge of the sword before Barak  ; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot , and fled away on his feet .
translation.kha: Haba u Barak u tur ïaleh lem bad la ka kynhun shipai , U  Trai  u buh ïa u Sisera ha ka jingshaïong jingmut lem bad ki kulai ïapom bad ki rangbah jong u baroh . U Sisera u hiar na la ka kali ïapom bad u phet ïap da ka kjat .

translation.en: Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , ki angel jong U Blei ki risa halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut .

translation.en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria , and from the fortified cities , and from the fortress even to the river , and from sea to sea , and from mountain to mountain .

translation.en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh , what will he do unto those husbandmen ?
translation.kha: Mynta , haba u trai ka bri sohwaiñ u wan , kaei kaba un leh ïa kito ki nongshimwai ?  U Jisu u la kylli .

translation.en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain , I will come to you : for I trust to see you in my journey , and to be brought on my way thitherward by you , if first I be somewhat filled with your company .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïakynduh ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti artat jong nga sha Spain , bad ba phin ïarap ïa nga ha ka jingleit jong nga shata , hadien ba nga la sngewhun ban sah shipor ha ka jingwan khmih ïa phi .

translation.en: And to love him with all the heart , and with all the understanding , and with all the soul , and with all the strength , and to love his neighbour as himself , is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices .
translation.kha: Bad u briew u dei ban ieit ïa U Blei da ka dohnud jong u baroh bad da ka jingmut jong u baroh bad da ka bor jong u baroh ; bad u dei ban ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba u ieit ïa lade . Ka long kaba kham donkam ban kohnguh ïa kine ki ar tylli ki hukum ban ïa kaba ai jingainguh da ki mrad bad kiwei ki jingkñia sha U Blei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand toward heaven , that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt , even darkness which may be felt .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti shajrong ba ka jingdum kaba rben la kumba lah ban tba ïa ka , kan tap ïa ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Come near , ye nations , to hear  ; and hearken , ye people : let the earth hear , and all that is therein  ; the world , and all things that come forth of it .
translation.kha: Ale , phi ki briew jong ki hima baroh ! To ïalumlang bad to shahshkor . Ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un wan hangne bad shahshkor .

translation.en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them  ; that they may be one , even as we are one :
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka burom kaba me la ai ha nga , khnang ba kin long kawei , kumba ma me bad nga ngi long kawei .

translation.en: And he commanded the steward of his house , saying , Fill the men s sacks with food , as much as they can carry , and put every man s money in his sack s mouth .
translation.kha: U Joseph u hukum ïa u shakri bahakhlieh ha ka ïing jong u ,  Pyndap ïa ki byrni jong kine ki briew da ka jingbam , katba ki lah ban kit , bad thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei na ki ha khlieh ka byrni jong u .

translation.en: Of course , there are requirements to be met if we are to live forever in the coming Paradise on earth .
translation.kha: Hooid , ki don ki jingdawa kiba ngi hap ban pynbiang lada ngi kwah ban im junom la junom ha ka Paradais ban sa wan ha ka Pyrthei .

translation.en: ▪ PRACTICES LOVE : True worshippers are “no part of the world ,” are not divided by race or culture , and display ‘ love among themselves .’
translation.kha: ▪ KA PYNI IA KA JINGIEID : Ki nongmane bashisha kim “long na ka jong ka pyrthei ,” ym shym la phiah ia ki da ka jait ne ka dustur , bad ki pynpaw ba ki ‘ don ka jingioieit paralok hapdeng jong ki .’

translation.en: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites , and unto the judge that shall be in those days , and enquire  ; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment :

translation.en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea , they were troubled , saying , It is a spirit  ; and they cried out for fear .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohi ba u ïaid halor ka um , ki la sngewshyrkhei .  Ka dei ka rngai !  ki la ong , bad ki la lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob , because they be replenished from the east , and are soothsayers like the Philistines , and they please themselves in the children of strangers .

translation.en: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands  ; yet ye turned not to me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ki lyer ba-tyrkhong bad u phria ban pynjot ïa baroh kiba phi pyrshang ban thung , hynrei phim kylla-kaba-mut hi .

translation.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter , though I have been a rebuker of them all .
translation.kha: ka kharai kaba jylliew ha ka nongbah Akasia ; bad ngan pynshitom ïa phi baroh .

translation.en: Shew me a penny . Whose image and superscription hath it ?  They answered and said , Caesar s .
translation.kha: To pyn-i hangne ïa ka sbai rupa . Ka durkhmat bad ka kyrteng jongno long kine kiba don ha ka ?   Jong u Patsha ,  ki la jubab .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki ai ksuid ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban pynpang lane wat ban pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon , first and last , are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite , and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat ?
translation.kha: Ïa kiwei kiwei ki jingïathuh shaphang u Solomon naduh ba sdang haduh ba kut la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori u Nathan u Nongïathuhlypa  , ha  Ka Jingïathuhlypa u Ahijah uba na Shiloh  , bad ha  Ki Jingïohipaw u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa  , kiba ïathuh ruh shaphang ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother , Behold , Esau my brother is a hairy man , and I am a smooth man :
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jakob u ong ïa la ka kmie ,  Phi tip ba Iso u long u briew uba bun shñiuh , katba nga pat nga long uba jlih ka sniehdoh .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness  ; that , when ye fail , they may receive you into everlasting habitations .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u ïai bteng ban ong ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : Pynlong paralok na ka bynta ïa lade da ka spah ba kynja pyrthei , khnang ba haba kam don shuh , yn pdiang sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing bymjukut .

translation.en: Therefore I will judge you , O house of Israel , every one according to his ways , saith the Lord  God . Repent , and turn yourselves from all your transgressions  ; so iniquity shall not be your ruin .
translation.kha: Mynta , ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa phi ki Israel ba ngan bishar ïa phi iwei pa iwei da kaei kaba phi la leh . To phai noh na kaba sniew baroh kaba phi leh , bad wat shah ba ka pop jong phi kan pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .
translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha ki , bad ngan ïai leh kumta , khnang ba ka jingieit kaba me don ïa nga kan ïoh long bad ki , bad kumta nga ruh ngan ïoh long bad ki .

translation.en: After this I will return , and will build again the tabernacle of David , which is fallen down  ; and I will build again the ruins thereof , and I will set it up :
translation.kha: ‘ Hadien kane ngan wan phai pat , ong U Trai , bad ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka hima jong u Dabid . Ngan tei pat ïa kaba la jot jong ka bad ngan pynkhlaiñ pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And Joseph answered and said , This is the interpretation thereof : The three baskets are three days :
translation.kha: Te u Joseph u jubab ,  Kane ka mut kumne : ki lai tylli ki shang ki long lai tylli ki sngi .

translation.en: And again he went away , and prayed , and spake the same words .
translation.kha: U la leit noh sa shisien bad u la duwai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki ktien .

translation.en: Wherefore , as by one man sin entered into the world , and death by sin ; and so death passed upon all men , for that all have sinned :
translation.kha: Ka pop ka la wan sha ka pyrthei lyngba uwei u briew , bad ka pop jong u ka la wallam ryngkat bad ka ïa ka jingïap . Ka jingmih ka long , ba ka jingïap ka la pur sha u bynriew baroh namar uwei pa uwei u la leh pop .

translation.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen  ; they shall go into thickets , and climb up upon the rocks : every city shall be forsaken , and not a man dwell therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingsawa jong ki shipai shong kulai bad jong ki nongsiatkhnam , uwei uwei baroh u phet krad . Katto katne kin phet sha khlaw , kiwei kin ïakiew shajrong hapdeng ki mawsiang . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong yn iehnoh thylli , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong ban sah pat ha ki .

translation.en: And there were six steps to the throne , with a footstool of gold , which were fastened to the throne , and stays on each side of the sitting place , and two lions standing by the stays :
translation.kha: Don hynriew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka khet bad ka don ka jingïuhkjat kaba la pyndait ha ka , ba la sop da ka ksiar . Ki don ki jingshan kti ha baroh arliang jong ka khet , bad ka dur u sing ka ïeng ha kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: So when they had dined , Jesus saith to Simon Peter ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me more than these ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my lambs .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam , U Jisu u la ong ïa u Simon Petros ,  Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me kham ieit ma me ïa nga ban ïa kaba kine kiwei ki ieit ?   Ho-oid , ko Trai ,  u la jubab ,  me tip ba nga ieit ïa me .  U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To sumar ïa ki khunlangbrot jong nga .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did so : and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .
translation.kha: Ki khun U Jakob ki leh kumta kumba la bthah ïa ki . U Joseph u ai kali ïa ki , kumba u syiem u la hukum , bad u ai jingbam ïa ki ba kin bam ha lynti .

translation.en: I desired Titus , and with him I sent a brother . Did Titus make a gain of you ? walked we not in the same spirit ? walked we not in the same steps ?
translation.kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa u Titos ban leit , bad nga la phah ïa uwei pat u parabangeit bad u . Hato phi lah ban ong ba u Titos u la shim kabu ïa phi ? Hato ma u bad ma nga ngim shym la leh na kijuh hi ki jingthmu bad leh ha kajuh ka rukom ?

translation.en: God also bearing them witness , both with signs and wonders , and with divers miracles , and gifts of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will ?
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , U Blei ruh u la ai shuh ïa la ki sakhi ha ki , da kaba leh bun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla bad da kaba ïasam ïa ki jingai U Mynsiem Bakhuid kat kum ka mon jong u .

translation.en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again  ; one of his brethren may redeem him :
translation.kha: Hadien ba la die ïa u , pynban u dang don hi ka hok ban shah thied biang .

translation.en: Seek ye the  Lord  while he may be found , call ye upon him while he is near :
translation.kha: To phai sha U  Trai  bad duwai ha u , mynta ba u don hajan .

translation.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .
translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ka miet , ki parabangeit ki la phah ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha Beria . Haba ki la poi hangta , ki la leit sha ka synagog .

translation.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently .
translation.kha: A  Trai  me la ai ha ngi ïa ki aiñ jong me bad me la ong ïa ngi ban kohnguh biang biang ïa ki .

translation.en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno me lah ban shah ïa kine ki riewshukor , ki briew kiba sniew ? Ki khmat jong me ki khuid palat kat ban peit ïa kaba sniew , bad mem lah shah ban peit ïa ki briew ba leh bymdei . Te balei ba me shu sngap jar jar katba ki dang pynjot ïa ki briew kiba kham hok ban ïa ki ?

translation.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth , Gallio said unto the Jews , If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness , O ye Jews , reason would that I should bear with you :
translation.kha: U Paul sa ba un sdang kren , haba u Gallio u la ong ha kita ki Jiw ,  Lada kane ka long ka kam runar lane ka kam sniew ba la leh , kan long kaba shongnia ïa nga ban ïaishah bad ki Jiw .

translation.en: Discretion shall preserve thee , understanding shall keep thee :
translation.kha: Ka jingsian bad ka jingshemphang jong phi kin ïada ïa phi

translation.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim , and dwelt therein  ; and went out from thence , and built Penuel .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u syiem ki Israel u la tei kynroh ïa ka shnong Shekhem kaba ha ri lum Ephraim bad u la sah hangta katto katne por . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u tei kynroh sa ïa ka shnong Penuel .

translation.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth–tabor , and then goeth out to Daberath , and goeth up to Japhia ,
translation.kha: Na kawei pat ka liang jong ka Sarid , u pud u suh shaphang mihngi sha u pud jong ka Khisloth Tabor , nangta sha Daberath bad artet haduh Japhia .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , to the saints which are at Ephesus , and to the faithful in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U Khrist Jisu — Sha ki briew jong U Blei ha Ephesos , kiba ïeng skhem ha ka jingim jong ki ha U Khrist Jisu :

translation.en: Behold my servant , whom I uphold  ; mine elect , in whom my soul delighteth  ; I have put my spirit upon him : he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Une u long u shakri jong nga , uba nga pynshaitbor — Uta uba nga la jied , ha u nga shem sngewbha . Nga la pyndap ïa u da U Mynsiem jong nga , bad un wallam jingbishar hok ha man la ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And Judas also , which betrayed him , knew the place : for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples .
translation.kha: U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ha-ei ka don , namar bunsien U Jisu u la ïakynduh hangta bad la ki synran .

translation.en: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed , and that he should not die in the pit , nor that his bread should fail .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long ki koidi shen yn sa pyllaitluid ïa ki ; kin im ka jingim kaba jlan bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingbam kat kaba ki donkam .

translation.en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine , manner of life , purpose , faith , longsuffering , charity , patience ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , me la bud ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , ka jinglong jingim jong nga , bad ka jingthmu jong nga ha ka jingim ; me la khmih ïa ka jingngeit jong nga , ka jingïaishah jong nga , ka jingieit jong nga , ka jingïaineh jong nga , ka jingshah pynshitom jong nga , bad ki jingshah shitom jong nga .

translation.en: Let me alone , that I may destroy them , and blot out their name from under heaven : and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they .
translation.kha: Me wat khang ïa nga , naba ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki ba kumta yn ym don shuh u ban dang kynmaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa ki .’

translation.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board , and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka jingker kan long saw mitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people  ; there remained not one .
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  ruh u leh kumba u Moses u la kyrpad . Ki skain ki phet noh na u Pharaoh , na ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad na ki briew jong u ; wat tang uwei ruh um sah shuh .

translation.en: And the priest said unto them , Go in peace : before the  Lord  is your way wherein ye go .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u jubab ,  Phim donkam ban khuslai ei ei . U  Trai  un sumar ïa phi ha ka jingleit jong phi .

translation.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins ? make me to know my transgression and my sin .
translation.kha: Kiei ki pop jong nga ? Kiei ki bym dei kiba nga la leh ? Ki kam sniew aïu ba la ujor ïa nga ?

translation.en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel , No soul of you shall eat blood , neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood .
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kam bit ïa uno uno na ki , lane ïa uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , ban bam ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka .

translation.en: And again he saith , Rejoice , ye Gentiles , with his people .
translation.kha: Ka ong biang ,  Shadkmen , ko ki Jentil , ryngkat bad ki briew jong U Blei!

translation.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .
translation.kha: U la kyrshut ïa ka durkhmat jong nga ha khyndew bad la pynkheiñ ïa ki bniat jong nga ha ki mawria .

translation.en: But every man is tempted , when he is drawn away of his own lust , and enticed .
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew u shah pynshoi haba u shah ring pah bad shah riam ha ki jingkwah brai jong u hi .

translation.en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the  Lord  ! to what end is it for you ? the day of the  Lord  is darkness , and not light .
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba angnud ïa ka sngi U  Trai  ! Kaei kaba bha ba kata ka sngi kan long ïa phi ? Na ka bynta jong phi kan long tang ka sngi jong ka jingdum , bad ym jong ka jingshai .

translation.en: I will shew thee , hear me  ; and that which I have seen I will declare  ;
translation.kha: Mynta to shahshkor , ko Job , ïa kaei kaba nga tip ngan ïathuh .

translation.en: And I say also unto thee , That thou art Peter , and upon this rock I will build my church  ; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha me , ko Petros : me long u mawsiang , bad halor kane ka nongrim mawsiang ngan tei ïa ka balang jong nga , bad wat ka jingïap hi kan ym lah ban jop ïa ka .

translation.en: And Jesse said unto David his son , Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn , and these ten loaves , and run to the camp to thy brethren  ;
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Jesse u ong ha u Dabid ,  Shim shiphew kilo une u krai sdieh bad kine ki kpu shiphew tylli , bad leit rah kyrkieh ïa ki sha ki hynmen jong phi ha ka jaka sher dara .

translation.en: Be sober , be vigilant  ; because your adversary the devil , as a roaring lion , walketh about , seeking whom he may devour :
translation.kha: To leh adkar , to sharai ! U nongshun jong phi , u Ksuid , u shang kylleng kum u sing bakyrhuh , da kaba wad ïa uno uno ba un nguid tylli .

translation.en: And Cain talked with Abel his brother : and it came to pass , when they were in the field , that Cain rose up against Abel his brother , and slew him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Kain u ong ïa u Abel u para jong u ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha lyngkha .  Haba ki la don ha lyngkha , u Kain u la shoh ïa la u para bad u la pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him .
translation.kha: Ïa ka sharak ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u yn pyndum .

translation.en: I have seen servants upon horses , and princes walking as servants upon the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki mraw ba ki shong da ki kulai katba ki riewdonburom ki ïaid da ka kjat kum ki mraw .

translation.en: And said to the judges , Take heed what ye do : for ye judge not for man , but for the  Lord  , who is with you in the judgment .
translation.kha: Da pyrkhat bha haba phi ai jingrai ; phim pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka bor briew , hynrei ha ka bor U  Trai  , bad u long bad phi haba phi ai ïa ka jingrai .

translation.en: Saying , What shall we do to these men ? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem  ; and we cannot deny it .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin leh ïa kine ki briew ?  ki la kylli .  Uwei uwei baroh ha Jerusalem u tip ba ïa kane ka kambah kaba pher la leh da ma ki , bad ngim lah ban len ïa ka .

translation.en: And David the king came and sat before the  Lord  , and said , Who am I , O  Lord  God , and what is mine house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Dabid u rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , u shong bad u duwai ,  Ngam long uba dei hok ïa kaei kaba me la lah leh na ka bynta jong nga , ko  Trai  U Blei , lane ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: A blessing , if ye obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , which I command you this day :
translation.kha: ïa ka jingkyrkhu , lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ;

translation.en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn , that the  Lord  met him , and sought to kill him .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka sahmiet ha lynti , U  Trai  u ïashem bad u Moses , bad u mut ban pynïap noh ïa u .

translation.en: Neither give place to the devil .
translation.kha: Wat ailad ïa u Soitan .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate .
translation.kha: bad teh ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh .

translation.en: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim  ; and they shall be upon Aaron s heart , when he goeth in before the  Lord  : and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the  Lord  continually .
translation.kha: Buh ïa u Urim bad u Thummim    hapoh ka jingdeng shadem , khnang ba u Aaron un rah ïa ki haba u wan ha khmat ka jingdon kaba kyntang jong nga . Kum ha kata ka por , u dei ban phong ïa kane ka jingdeng shadem , khnang ba u lah ban tip bad sngewthuh ïa ka mon jong nga na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul : he that keepeth understanding shall find good .
translation.kha: Lehbha ïa lade bad wad jinghikai kat kaba phi lah ; nangta kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi ïoh jinghikai bad phin manbha .

translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la jam sha khmat bad ki la pynlong ki jingmudui kiba khlaiñ pyrshah ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth , that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: bad ba ïa uno uno u bym dem ngon bad mane dei ban bret ha ka lawar ding baklang .

translation.en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the  Lord  , and of judgment , and of might , to declare unto Jacob his transgression , and to Israel his sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , U  Trai  u pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem bad ka bor , bad u ai ha nga ka jingsngewthuh ïa ka jingbishar hok bad ka jingshlur ban ïathuh ha ki paid Israel kiei ki long ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And the man Elkanah , and all his house , went up to offer unto the  Lord  the yearly sacrifice , and his vow .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi biang ba u Elkanah bad kiba ha ka ïing jong u ki leit biang sha Shiloh ban kñia ka jingainguh kaba man ka snem ha U  Trai  , bad ban ai ka jingainguh kyrpang ba u la kular .

translation.en: For ye know how that afterward , when he would have inherited the blessing , he was rejected : for he found no place of repentance , though he sought it carefully with tears .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , phi tip , u la kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu u kpa jong u , hynrei u la shah kyntait ; namar um ïohlad shuh ban pynkylla ïa kaei kaba u la leh , la u la wad ïa ka da ki jingjaw ummat .

translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes , and my judgments : which if a man do , he shall live in them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bud ïa ki rukom leh bad ki hukum kiba nga ai ha phi ; da kaba leh kumta , phin ïoh im . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And if one prevail against him , two shall withstand him  ; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki briew ki lah ban ïada na ka jingtur ïaleh kaba lah ban jop ïa u briew ba tang marwei . U tyllai uba la jyrthiaw da ki lai tylli ki tyllai u long uba jwat ban dkut .

translation.en: And Abram said unto Lot , Let there be no strife , I pray thee , between me and thee , and between my herdmen and thy herdmen  ; for we be brethren .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abram u ong ha u Lot ,  Ki briew jong me bad ki briew jong nga kim dei ban ïakajia , namar ngi ïalong shi ïing shi sem .

translation.en: And , lo , thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice , and can play well on an instrument : for they hear thy words , but they do them not .
translation.kha: Ha ki mem long ei ei lait tang u nongpynbyrngia da kaba rwai ki jingrwai jingieit ne tem ka duitara . Ki shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong me baroh hynrei kim kohnguh ïa kawei ruh na ki .

translation.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .
translation.kha: Ym don jingthaw ba-im ba lah ban ïohi ïa ka , ym don , wat ka sim kaba her .

translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prophesy against Gog , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Gog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ko khun u briew , to kren pyrshah ïa u Gog , u nongsynshar rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew ka Meshekh bad ka Tubal bad ïathuh ïa u ba nga long u nongshun jong u .

translation.en: Again he said unto me , Prophesy upon these bones , and say unto them , O ye dry bones , hear the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  To ïathuhlypa halor kine ki shyieng . Ïathuh ha kine ki shyieng kiba tyrkhong ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien U  Trai .

translation.en: And when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , the  Lord  raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel , who delivered them , even Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki la kyang ha U  Trai  , bad u la phah ïa uwei u briew ban pyllait ïa ki . Une u dei u Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas uba dei u para jong u Kaleb .

translation.en: Thou shalt not eat it  ; that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , U  Trai  un sngewbha , bad ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha .

translation.en: And the tongs thereof , and the snuffdishes thereof , shall be of pure gold .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki nap bad ki pliang jong u da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they sent messengers , and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river : and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them .
translation.kha: Ki Syria ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , kumta ki la wallam shipai na ki jylla Syria kiba naphang mihngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis bad buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingai hukum u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai u syiem Hadadeser jong ka Sobah .

translation.en: Serve the  Lord  with fear , and rejoice with trembling .
translation.kha: Shakri ïa U  Trai  da ka jingsheptieng ;

translation.en: John did baptize in the wilderness , and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap , da kaba pynbaptis bad ïalap .  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah pynbaptis ,  u la ong ïa ki briew ,  bad U Blei un map noh ïa ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear , we thought it good to be left at Athens alone ;
translation.kha: Ha kaba kut ngim lah shah shuh . Kumta ngi la rai ban sah tang ma ngi ha Athens

translation.en: I hearkened and heard , but they spake not aright : no man repented him of his wickedness , saying , What have I done ? every one turned to his course , as the horse rusheth into the battle .
translation.kha: Nga la shahshkor biang biang , hynrei phim shym kren ïa ka jingshisha . Ym don mano mano na phi uba la sngewsih ïa la ka jinglong basniew ; ym don mano mano na phi uba la kylli , ‘ Nga la leh bakla aïu ?’ Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïaid ha la ka lynti , kum u kulai uba pynstet sha ka thma .

translation.en: But the hour cometh , and now is , when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth : for the Father seeketh such to worship him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka por ka poi bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ha ka bor jong U Mynsiem U Blei ki briew kin mane ïa U Kpa kumba u long hi , da kaba ai ha u ïa ka jingmane kaba shisha kaba u dawa .

translation.en: Go ye up unto this feast : I go not up yet unto this feast  ; for my time is not yet full come .
translation.kha: Ma phi to nang ïaleit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Nga ngam leit sha kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar ba ka por kaba biang kam pat poi na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Only thy holy things which thou hast , and thy vows , thou shalt take , and go unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose :
translation.kha: Leit rah ïa ki jingainguh jong phi bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular sha U  Trai  tang sha kata ka jaka mane Blei .

translation.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Bad to U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur , un pynlah ïa phi ban don kajuh ka jingmut hapdeng jong phi da kaba bud ïa ka nuksa U Khrist Jisu ,

translation.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous , but grievous : nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby .
translation.kha: Haba la sneng sympat ïa ngi , ngi ju pyrkhat ha kata ka por ïa kaei kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa ngi , bad ym kaba pynkmen ïa ngi . Pynban hadien , kito kiba shah pynbeit da kita ki rukom sneng sympat ki ïoh ot ïa ka bainong kaba ai jingsuk jong ka jingim bahok .

translation.en: Again , he sent forth other servants , saying , Tell them which are bidden , Behold , I have prepared my dinner : my oxen and my fatlings are killed , and all things are ready : come unto the marriage .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kiwei pat ki shakri lem bad kane ka khubor ïa ki nongshahkhot sngewbha : ‘ La dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong nga mynta , la dep shohdoh ïa ki masi dab bad ïa ki khun masi bakynsai jong nga , bad la khreh ïa kiei kiei baroh . To ale sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim !’

translation.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun , twelve cities .
translation.kha: Ki longïing jong ka kur Merari ki ïoh khat-ar tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Reuben , Gad , bad Sebulun .

translation.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife  ; and he said , She is my sister : for he feared to say , She is my wife  ; lest , said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah  ; because she was fair to look upon .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew hangta ki kylli shaphang ka tnga jong u , u jubab ba ka dei ka para jong u . Um shym ïathuh ba ka dei ka tnga jong u , namar u sheptieng ïoh ba ki briew hangta kin pynïap ïa u ban ïoh ïa ka Rebekka , kaba long kaba bhabriew eh .

translation.en: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight , and have provoked me to anger , since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt , even unto this day .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ha ki briew jong nga , namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad pynkhih bitar ïa nga naduh ka por ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la mihnoh na Ijipt haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: And she shall put the raiment of her captivity from off her , and shall remain in thine house , and bewail her father and her mother a full month : and after that thou shalt go in unto her , and be her husband , and she shall be thy wife .
translation.kha: bad pli ïa la ki jaiñ . Ka dei ban sah ha ïing jong phi , bad ïam sngewsih shi bnai ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie . Hadien kata , phi lah ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends , even the eyes of his children shall fail .
translation.kha: Ha ka proberb ba-mynshuwa , u briew u die ïa la ki paralok na ka bynta ka pisa , bad ki khun jong u ki shahshitom na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: Do you remember where Tom left his umbrella ?
translation.kha: Hato phi kynmaw haei u Tom u ieh ka shatri ?

translation.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon s officers , even two hundred and fifty , that bare rule over the people .
translation.kha: Don arspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba dei peit ïa ki nongtrei ba la pynbor ban trei ïa kiba bunkam tei jingtei .

translation.en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead , have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God , saying ,
translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingmihpat kiba ïap : Hato phim pat ju pule ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ? U la ong ,

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ai ngin ïasyllok shuwa bad U  Trai .

translation.en: Rejoice not , O Israel , for joy , as other people : for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God , thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , sangeh noh kaba rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam kum ki riewthala . Phi la phai lyndet na la U Blei bad phi la long ki bymïaineh ha u . Ha baroh kawei ka ri phi la die ïa lade kum ki nuti ha u blei Baal bad phi la ieit ïa u kew uba phi pyrkhat ba u la siew na ka bynta jong phi !

translation.en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again , because he loved him : for he loved him as he loved his own soul .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u Jonathan u pynlong ïa u Dabid ban kular ban ieit ïa u , naba u Jonathan u ieit ïa u Dabid kumba u ieit ïa lade hi .

translation.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me , all shall be thine .
translation.kha: Kane baroh kan long ka jong me , te , lada me mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And Shaalabbin , and Aijalon , and Jethlah ,
translation.kha: ka Shaalbim , ka Aijalon , ka Ithlah ,

translation.en: Ye stand upon your sword , ye work abomination , and ye defile every one his neighbour s wife : and shall ye possess the land ?
translation.kha: Phi shaniah ha ki waitlam jong phi . Ki kam jong phi ki long kiba ijli . Uwei pa uwei u klim . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?

translation.en: If we suffer , we shall also reign with him : if we deny him , he also will deny us :
translation.kha: Lada ngi ïai bteng ban ïaishah , ngin sa synshar ruh lem bad u . Lada ngin len ïa u , u ruh un len ïa ngi .

translation.en: And he cometh unto the disciples , and findeth them asleep , and saith unto Peter ,  What , could ye not watch with me one hour ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat sha ki lai ngut ki synran bad u la shem ïa ki ba ki ïohthiah ; bad u la ong ha u Petros ,  Kumno keiñ ma phi lai ngut phim shym lah ban ïa-ap lem bad nga wat tang shi kynta ?

translation.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments : but a prating fool shall fall .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki pdiang ïa ki jingpyn-i kiba dei , ki briew kiba kren bieit ki tur ruma sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And they shall take other stones , and put them in the place of those stones  ; and he shall take other mortar , and shall plaster the house .
translation.kha: Nangta un bujli da kiwei pat ki maw ha ka jaka kita kiba la weng noh , bad yn sa ñiad astor thymmai ïa kita ki kynroh .

translation.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne , clothed in their robes , and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki syiem , ba la riam ha ki jingphong syiem , ki shong halor ki khet jong ki ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba don shabar ka khyrdop jong ka Samaria , bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .

translation.en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said , Why did the heathen rage , and the people imagine vain things ?
translation.kha: Da U Mynsiem Bakhuid me la kren lyngba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong ngi , u shakri jong me , haba u la ong ,   ‘ Balei ba ki Jentil ki bitar shla ; balei ki briew ki thaw ïa ki jingsylla bymmyntoi ?

translation.en: Ye call me Master and Lord : and ye say well  ; for so I am .
translation.kha: Phi khot ïa nga ‘ U Nonghikai’ bad ‘ U Trai’ , bad ka long kaba dei ba phi leh kumta , namar kata ka dei kaei kaba nga long .

translation.en: Only the  Lord  had a delight in thy fathers to love them , and he chose their seed after them , even you above all people , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingieit U  Trai  ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba u la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad phi dang long haduh mynta ka jaitbynriew ba la jied jong u .

translation.en: And after those days we took up our carriages , and went up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ngi la pynlut katto katne por hangta , ngi la khreh ïa la ki tiar ki tar bad ngi la leit noh sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: If any be blameless , the husband of one wife , having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly .
