translation.kha: U nongsharai balang u dei ban long u bym don jingshah kynnoh pop ; u dei ban don tang kawei ka tnga , bad ki khun jong u ki dei ban long ki bangeit bad ki bym don jingbudnam ba ki long kiba leh thurmur lane ki bymkohnguh .

translation.en: And he entered again into the synagogue  ; and there was a man there which had a withered hand .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit pat sha ka synagog , ha kaba u la ïohi ïa uba ïapshiliang ka kti .

translation.en: And he prayed again , and the heaven gave rain , and the earth brought forth her fruit .
translation.kha: Sa shisien u la duwai , bad ka suiñbneng ka la theh noh ïa la u slap bad ka khyndew ka la pynmih ïa ki jingthung .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Call his name Jezreel  ; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu , and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , u ‘ Jesreel ,’ namar kan ym slem shuh shuwa ba ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem ki Israel namar ki kam pynïap briew ba u kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehu u la leh ha Jesreel . Ngan pynkut noh ïa ka jingsynshar na ka longïing syiem jong u Jehu .

translation.en: Therefore came I forth to meet thee , diligently to seek thy face , and I have found thee .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta nga la wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi . Nga la kwah eh ban wan wad ïa phi , bad nga la lap ïa phi !

translation.en: Hear us , my lord : thou art a mighty prince among us : in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead  ; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre , but that thou mayest bury thy dead .
translation.kha: Ngi khmih sha phi kum u nongïalam uba khraw ; tep ïa la ka tnga ha ka jaka tep kaba bha tam kaba ngi don . Uno uno na ngi un da sngewkmen ban ai jaka tep ha phi , ba phin ïoh ban tep ïa ka .

translation.en: For there is one God , and one mediator between God and men , the man Christ Jesus ;
translation.kha: Naba don tang uwei U Blei , bad don uwei uba pynwan lang ïa U Blei bad ïa u khunbynriew , U Khrist Jisu uba long ruh u briew , uba la aiti ïa lade ban siewspah ïa ki briew baroh .

translation.en: Special schooling is provided for those who devote their full time to the Kingdom-preaching work so that they can ‘ fully accomplish their ministry .’ —2 Timothy 4 :5 .
translation.kha: La pynkhreh ïa ki skul bakyrpang na ka bynta kito kiba trei pura ïa ka kam ïalap khnang ba kin lah ban “pyndep ïa la ka kam nongïalap .”—2 Timotheus ( Timothi ) 4 :5 , Baibyl Khasi Katholik .

translation.en: His ways are always grievous  ; thy judgments are far above out of his sight : as for all his enemies , he puffeth at them .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u jop ha kiei kiei baroh . Um lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingbishar U Blei ; u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongshun jong u .

translation.en: If thou count me therefore a partner , receive him as myself .
translation.kha: Namarkata , lada me pyrkhat ïa nga kum u para ba-ïatrei lem jong me , to pdiang sngewbha pat ïa u kumba men pdiang sngewbha ïa nga .

translation.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things , wherein thou hast been instructed .
translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba phin tip ïa ka jingshisha ba-pura shaphang kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la hikai ïa phi .

translation.en: And when he had opened the seventh seal , there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour .
translation.kha: Haba U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynñiew , ka la don ka jingsngap jar ha bneng kumba shiteng kynta .

translation.en: And falling into a place where two seas met , they ran the ship aground  ; and the forepart stuck fast , and remained unmoveable , but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka lieng ka la tyngkhuh ïa ka jaka shyiap bad ka la sangeh ; ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng ka la sahkut bad kam lah ban khih , katba ka bynta ba shadien ka la shah pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki jingat phyllung bashyrkhei .

translation.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus , and called the elders of the church .
translation.kha: Na Miletos u Paul u la phah khubor sha Ephesos , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki nongsharai balang    , ban ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them . And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley . So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third .
translation.kha: U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ammon bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u bad u jop ïa ki . Nangta u pynbor ïa ki Ammon ban siew ïa u ka khajna man ka snem haduh lai snem kumne : lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa , shihajar ton u kew , bad shihajar ton u barli .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , am against thee , and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la ïathuh ïa pha ba nga long u nongshun jong pha , nga ai ka jingbishar ïa pha ha kaba baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kata .

translation.en: World conditions confirm that God’s Kingdom will soon come .
translation.kha: Ki jinglong jong ka pyrthei ki pynshisha ba ka Hima jong U Blei ka la jan .

translation.en: Repent ye therefore , and be converted , that your sins may be blotted out , when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord  ;
translation.kha: Te , to kylla-kaba-mut , bad to phai sha U Blei , khnang ba un map ïa ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery .
translation.kha: Wat klim .

translation.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people ?
translation.kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la shakri ïa u Solomon u kpa jong u kum ki nongaibuit .  Kaei ka jubab ba phin ai jingmut ïa nga ba ngan ai ha kine ki briew ?  u kylli .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day , shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: ba ka por ka poi haba ïa kiei kiei kiba ha ka ïingsyiem , kiei kiei kiba ki kpa tymmen ki la kynshew haduh kane ka sngi , yn rong noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don ei ei ka ban sah .

translation.en: But thou , son of man , hear what I say unto thee  ; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house : open thy mouth , and eat that I give thee .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong ha me . Wat ïaleh pyrshah kum ma ki . Ang ïa la ka shyntur bad bam ïa kaei kaba ngan ai ha me .

translation.en: Woe unto them that call evil good , and good evil  ; that put darkness for light , and light for darkness  ; that put bitter for sweet , and sweet for bitter !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi khot kaba bha ïa kaba sniew bad kaba sniew ïa kaba bha . Phi pynphai ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai bad ïa ka jingshai sha ka jingdum . Phi pynlong kaba thiang ïa kaba kthang bad kaba kthang ïa kaba thiang .

translation.en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle , and the fruit of thy land , until thou be destroyed : which also shall not leave thee either corn , wine , or oil , or the increase of thy kine , or flocks of thy sheep , until he have destroyed thee .
translation.kha: Kin bam ïa ki jingri jingdup bad ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad phin ïapthngan . Kin ym pynsah ei ei , ïa u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ki masi , lane ki langbrot ; bad phin ïap .

translation.en: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days  ; and it was noised that he was in the house .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne sngi U Jisu u la leit phai pat sha Kapernam , bad ka khubor ka la phriang ba u la don ha ïing .

translation.en: The first man is of the earth , earthy : the second man is the Lord from heaven .
translation.kha: Ïa u Adam uba nyngkong , la thaw na ka dewmet , ba la wan na ka khyndew ; u Adam uba ar u la wan na bneng .

translation.en: He answered and said , Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not : one thing I know , that , whereas I was blind , now I see .
translation.kha: Ngam tip la u dei u nongpop ne um dei ,  uta u briew u la phai ktien .  Tang ïa kane kawei nga tip : Nga la long uba matlah , bad mynta nga la imat .

translation.en: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and wash them with water .
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka khyrdop jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad ong ïa ki ban sum kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: And said unto him , Run , speak to this young man , saying , Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein :
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u la kren ha uta uwei pat ,  Khie mareh bad ong ha u samla uba don u ksai thew ba yn sa don bun byllien ki briew bad shibun bah ki jingri ha Jerusalem , ba kan long kaba heh katta katta ban don ki kynroh .

translation.en: And thou shalt hear what they say  ; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host . Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host .
translation.kha: Men sa ïohsngew aïu ki ïakren , bad nangta men ïoh ka jingshlur ban tur ïaleh .  Kumta u Gideon bad u Purah u shakri jong u ki leit hiar sha ka tduh jong ka jaka sher dara jong ki nongshun .

translation.en: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David , and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la shahjop ha ki rangbah jong u Dabid ; ka long ka jingshahjop kaba sngewshyrkhei , ha kaba la pynïap arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: Take with you words , and turn to the  Lord  : say unto him , Take away all iniquity , and receive us graciously : so will we render the calves of our lips .
translation.kha: To phai sha u Trai , bad ai ba kane ka jingduwai kan long ka jingainguh sha u :  To map ïa ki pop jong ngi baroh bad pdiang ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi , bad ngin ïaroh ïa me kumba ngi la kular .

translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar among the people .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa ka ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam ,  ki la ong ,  ïoh ba u paidbah un khihwin .

translation.en: For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee .
translation.kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kan ai ïa phi ka jingim kaba jlan bad kaba manbha .

translation.en: And David numbered the people that were with him , and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , u pynbynta ïa ki ha ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad kiba shispah ngut , bad u buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ki .

translation.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down , and gave up the ghost : and great fear came on all them that heard these things .
translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane , u Ananias u la kyllon ïap ; bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la sngewshyrkhei .

translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Take thy father s young bullock , even the second bullock of seven years old , and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath , and cut down the grove that is by it :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon  Shim ïa u masi kyrtong jong u kpa jong me bad uwei pat u masi kyrtong uba hynñiew snem ka rta , pynpra noh ïa ka duwan ba u kpa jong me u la tei ha u Baal , bad pynkhyllem ïa ka dak jong ka blei Asherah kaba don ha syndah jong ka .

translation.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him .
translation.kha: U ryndang jong phi u long kum u mot jong u Dabid , uba pyllun bad jlih , lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba kum shihajar tylli ki stieh kiba pynsdien sawdong jong u .

translation.en: And when she was baptized , and her household , she besought us , saying , If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord , come into my house , and abide there . And she constrained us .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ma ka bad ki dkhot jong ka ïing jong ka ki la shah pynbaptis , ka la khot sngewbha ïa ngi ,  To wan bad sah hapoh ka ïing jong nga lada phi la pdiang ba nga long ka parabangeit bashisha ha U Trai .  Bad ka la pynkohnguh ïa ngi ban leit .

translation.en: And by a prophet the  Lord  brought Israel out of Egypt , and by a prophet was he preserved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt bad ban sumar ïa ki .

translation.en: Flee out of the midst of Babylon , and deliver every man his soul : be not cut off in her iniquity  ; for this is the time of the  Lord s  vengeance  ; he will render unto her a recompence .
translation.kha: To phet noh na Babilonia ! Phet ban lait im ! Wat ai ba yn shah pynïap na ka bynta ka pop jong ka Babilonia . Nga mynta nga siew kylliang bad pynshitom ïa ka kumba ka dei hok .

translation.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war : for with thee will I break in pieces the nations , and with thee will I destroy kingdoms  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Babilonia , pha long u tyrnem jong nga , ka atiar jong nga ha ka thma . Nga la pyndonkam ïa pha ban ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki hima ,

translation.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy , and between unclean and clean  ;
translation.kha: Me dei ban pynïapher ïa kata kaba long ka jong U  Trai  na kata kaba lah ban pyndonkam paidbah , ïa kata kaba khuid na kata ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the  Lord s  priests .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha u kumno ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer , and the kings that were with him , and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim , and the Zuzims in Ham , and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw , u Khedorlaomer lem bad kita ki syiem kiba don ha ka liang jong u ki la wan ryngkat bad la ki shipai bad jop ïa ki Rephaim ha Ashteroth Karnaim , ïa ki Susim ha Ham , ïa ki Emim ha ka pyntha jong ka Kiriathaim ,

translation.en: You are so beautiful .
translation.kha: Phi bhabriew bha .

translation.en: And of Joseph he said , Blessed of the  Lord  be his land , for the precious things of heaven , for the dew , and for the deep that coucheth beneath ,
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Joseph u ong ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ka ri jong ki da u slap Bad da ka um napoh khyndew .

translation.en: When the Son of man shall come in his glory , and all the holy angels with him , then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory :
translation.kha: Haba U Khun U Briew un wan kum u Syiem bad ki angel baroh lem bad u , un shong halor ka khet syiem jong u ,

translation.en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision : for the men that were with me saw not the vision  ; but a great quaking fell upon them , so that they fled to hide themselves .
translation.kha: Nga la long tang ma nga hi uba la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw . Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad nga kim shym ïohi ei ei , hynrei ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ïamareh bad leit rieh .

translation.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning , and try him every moment ?
translation.kha: Me wan jngoh ïa ki man ka step , bad me tynjuh ïa ki man la ka minit ?

translation.en: And of Benjamin  ; Eliada a mighty man of valour , and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand .
translation.kha: U nongïalam jong ki shipai na ka kur Benjamin u dei u Eliada , u shipai batbit , uba long halor ki ar lakh ngut ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh .

translation.en: And the famine was sore in the land .
translation.kha: Kata ka  nemsniew ha Kanaan ka la nang jur nang jur ,

translation.en: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah , If I declare it unto thee , wilt thou not surely put me to death ? and if I give thee counsel , wilt thou not hearken unto me ?
translation.kha: Nga la jubab ,  Lada nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha , phin sa pynïap ïa nga , bad lada nga ai jingmut ïa phi , phin ym shahshkor satia .

translation.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers , and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance .
translation.kha: Hynrei kynmaw , lada ki ïashongkurim bad ki shynrang kiba na kawei pat ka jait , ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kan long noh ka jong kata ka jait , bad ka bynta kaba dei ka jong ngi kan nang duna .

translation.en: And be found in him , not having mine own righteousness , which is of the law , but that which is through the faith of Christ , the righteousness which is of God by faith :
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong u , nga la bret noh ïa kiei kiei baroh ; nga ñiew ïa ka baroh tang kum ka synrum , khnang ba ngan ïoh ïa U Khrist , bad ba yn pynïasoh pura bad u . Ngam long shuh uba don ka hok ka jong nga hi , ka bynta kaba nga ïoh da kaba kohnguh ïa ka hukum . Nga mynta , nga ïoh ïa ka hok kaba la ai da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist , ka hok kaba wan na U Blei bad kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit .

translation.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death , and to the house appointed for all living .
translation.kha: Nga tip me la rah ïa nga sha ka jingïap , sha ka kupar ba la buh ïa baroh .

translation.en: When one told me , saying , Behold , Saul is dead , thinking to have brought good tidings , I took hold of him , and slew him in Ziklag , who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings :
translation.kha: U nonglamktien uba la wan sha nga ha Siklag bad ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingïap u Saul , u la pyrkhat ba u la wallam ka khubor babha . Nga la kem ïa u , bad phah pynïap ïa u . Kata ka dei ka bainong ba nga la ai ha u na ka bynta kata ka khubor babha jong u !

translation.en: And he said unto me , What seest thou ? And I answered , I see a flying roll  ; the length thereof is twenty cubits , and the breadth thereof ten cubits .
translation.kha: U angel u la kylli ïa nga kaei nga la ïohi . Nga la jubab ,  Ka kot kli baher ha ka lyer ; ka don khyndai mitar ka lynter bad saw mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang .

translation.en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death , not regarding his life , to supply your lack of service toward me .
translation.kha: namar u la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim , bad u la jan ïap na ka bynta ka kam U Khrist , khnang ba un ai ïa nga ka jingïarap , kaba ma phi da lade phim lah ban ai .

translation.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ , they are again entangled therein , and overcome , the latter end is worse with them than the beginning .
translation.kha: Lada ki briew ki la lait im na ki bor ba pynpyut jong ka pyrthei da ka jingtip jong ki ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi , bad nangta ki ngat biang bad shahjop ha ki , kum kita ki briew ki don ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ha kaba kut ban ïa kaba ki la long ha kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: Their bull gendereth , and faileth not  ; their cow calveth , and casteth not her calf .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , baroh ki jingri jong ki , ki pun bad ki kha khlem don ka jingeh .

translation.en: And the third row , a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .
translation.kha: ïa u Turkwois , u Agate , bad u Amethyst ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;

translation.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion , and unto the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to an innumerable company of angels ,
translation.kha: Pynban , phi la wan sha u lum Seïon bad sha ka nongbah jong U Blei uba im , ka Jerusalem kaba kynja bneng , ha kaba la don bun hajar ki angel .

translation.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year  ; they shall be without blemish :
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba nyngkong , ai ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : khatlai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , baroh ki dei ban long ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk , and curdled me like cheese ?
translation.kha: Me la ai ka bor ïa u kpa jong nga ba un pynkha ïa nga , Me la pynlong ïa nga ban san ha ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga .

translation.en: And this is the condemnation , that light is come into the world , and men loved darkness rather than light , because their deeds were evil .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ka jingbishar ka trei : Ka jingshai ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , hynrei ki briew ki ieit ïa ka jingdum ban ïa ka jingshai , namar ba ki kam jong ki , ki long kiba sniew .

translation.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law , and take away thy coat , let him have thy cloak also .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar ban mudui ïa phi na ka bynta ka sopti-poh jong phi , ai ha u ïa ka jaiñkup jynsur ruh .

translation.en: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest , and commanded them , saying , Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead with the edge of the sword , with the women and the children .
translation.kha: Kumta ka jingïalang ka phah khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah bashlur tam lem bad ka hukum ,  Khie leit bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ha Jabesh , kaba kynthup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .

translation.en: Let thy fountain be blessed : and rejoice with the wife of thy youth .
translation.kha: Kumta shongsuk bad ka tnga jong phi bad shem ïa ka jingkmen bad ka kynthei kaba phi shongkurim —

translation.en: When Mordecai perceived all that was done , Mordecai rent his clothes , and put on sackcloth with ashes , and went out into the midst of the city , and cried with a loud and a bitter cry  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Mordekai u tip ïa kata baroh ba la leh , u tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jinglyng-a bajur . Nangta u phong da ki jaiñ khain bad sleh ïa ka khlieh da u dpei , bad ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah , u da ïam lynñiar kthang , haduh ba un da poi ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And the  Lord  smelled a sweet savour  ; and the  Lord  said in his heart , I will not again curse the ground any more for man s sake  ; for the imagination of man s heart is evil from his youth  ; neither will I again smite any more every thing living , as I have done .
translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong ka jingkñia ainguh ka la pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , bad U la ong ha lade ,  Lano lano ruh ngan ym buh ïa ka pyrthei hapoh ka jingtim namar kaei kaba ki briew ki leh ; nga tip ba naduh ba ki dang samla , ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki long kiba sniew . Lano lano ruh ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , kumba nga la leh ha kane ka sien .

translation.en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah , When thou comest to Babylon , and shalt see , and shalt read all these words  ;
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa u Seraïah ,  Haba men poi ha Babilon , pynthikna ban pule jam ha ki briew ïa kiei kiei baroh ba la thoh hangne .

translation.en: ( Psalm 122 :1 ) This also creates a favorable impression in the community . —2 Corinthians 6 :3 .
translation.kha: ( Salm 122 :1 ) Ka shnong ka thaw ka ïaroh ïa kane . —2 Korinth 6 :3 .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga .

translation.en: Saying , God hath forsaken him : persecute and take him  ; for there is none to deliver him .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  U Blei u la iehnoh ïa u ; ïa ngin ïabeh bad kem ïa u ; ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa u .

translation.en: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her , My daughter , shall I not seek rest for thee , that it may be well with thee ?
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ong ha ka Ruth ,  Nga dei ban shem u tnga na ka bynta jong phi , khnang ba phin don la ka jong ka longïing .

translation.en: And when he was entered into the house from the people , his disciples asked him concerning the parable .
translation.kha: Haba u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bad leit sha la ïing , ki synran jong u ki la ong ïa u ban batai ïa kane ka jingong .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Art thou a master of Israel , and knowest not these things ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me long u nonghikai uba khraw ha Israel , bad mem tip ïa kane ?

translation.en: For we are sold , I and my people , to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish . But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen , I had held my tongue , although the enemy could not countervail the king s damage .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga bad ïa nga , la die sha ka jingpynïap . Lada kam da long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba die sha ka jinglongmraw , ngan jin da la shu sngap jar bad ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ; hynrei ngi la jan shah pynjot — shah pynduh pyndam !

translation.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha , and the cities about them in like manner , giving themselves over to fornication , and going after strange flesh , are set forth for an example , suffering the vengeance of eternal fire .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , bad ki shnong ba-marjan , ha kaba ki briew ki leh kumba la leh kito ki angel bad ki kyrsum ha ki jingleh nuti bad bajakhlia : Ki shah ïa ka jingpynshitom ha ka ding bymjukut kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh .

translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds , the officers of the host , and said unto them , Have her forth without the ranges : and him that followeth her kill with the sword . For the priest had said , Let her not be slain in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada um kwah ba ka Athalaïah kan shah pynïap ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , te u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai :  Rah ïa ka shabar napdeng ki ar laiñ ba ïeng ki nongap phira , bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa ka .

translation.en: And he lighted the lamps before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad hangta ha ka jingdon U  Trai  u thang ïa kita ki sharak , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: He among the sons of Aaron , that offereth the blood of the peace offerings , and the fat , shall have the right shoulder for his part .
translation.kha: ha u lyngdoh uba kñia ïa ka snam bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: The Lord was as an enemy : he hath swallowed up Israel , he hath swallowed up all her palaces : he hath destroyed his strong holds , and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop ; ki la bat ïa ka ha ka bor jong ki . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka ban shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop kiba bun jong ka baroh . Ïa ki khun jong ka la kem bad la shah rah noh .

translation.en: But thou shalt go unto my father s house , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son .
translation.kha: Pynban , men leit sha ki briew u kpa jong nga , bad sha ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad jied ka tnga na ka bynta jong u .’

translation.en: Now let them put away their whoredom , and the carcases of their kings , far from me , and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever .
translation.kha: Mynta ki dei ban sangeh noh na kaba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei bad weng ïa ki metïap jong ki syiem jong ki . Lada ki leh kumta , ngan shong hapdeng jong ki junom .

translation.en: And afterward when David heard it , he said , I and my kingdom are guiltless before the  Lord  for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner :
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ïa kata , u ong ,  U  Trai  u tip ba ma nga bad ki khun ki hajar jong nga ngim don jingrem ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .

translation.en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound , who shall prepare himself to the battle ?
translation.kha: Bad lada u briew u put ïa ka ronsing ka bym ai ka jingsawa kaba shai , uei u ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka thma ?

translation.en: Thus he said , The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth , which shall be diverse from all kingdoms , and shall devour the whole earth , and shall tread it down , and break it in pieces .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbatai kaba la ai ha nga :  U mradkhlaw uba saw u dei ka hima kaba saw ka ban don ha ka pyrthei bad kan long kaba pher na kiwei pat ki hima . Kan pynlwet ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad kan kyrdem ïa ka .

translation.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth , which is by En–rogel , and called all his brethren the king s sons , and all the men of Judah the king s servants :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Adonijah u ai ka jingkñia da ki langbrot , ki masi dab , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid ha u Mawsiang Bseiñ , hajan ka umpohliew Enrogel . U la khot sngewbha ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong U Syiem Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem kiba dei na Judah ban wan sha kane ka jingkhawai ai jingkñia ,

translation.en: The Kenites , and the Kenizzites , and the Kadmonites ,
translation.kha: kaba kynthup ïa ka ri ki Ken , ki Kenis , ki Gadmon ,

translation.en: And Elisha prayed , and said ,  Lord  , I pray thee , open his eyes , that he may see . And the  Lord  opened the eyes of the young man  ; and he saw : and , behold , the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha .
translation.kha: Nangta u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong u bad ai un ïohi .  U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad u shakri jong u Elisha haba u peit shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa ka sharing lum ba la dap da ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom kiba da ka ding baroh sawdong jong u Elisha .

translation.en: And to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Men rah bad me ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa na ka bynta ki jingainguh , ïa kiba ma nga bad ki nongai jingmut jong nga , ngi kwah ban ai sha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka Templ jong u ka don ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God , let him answer it .
translation.kha: Ko Job , me la kob ïa U Blei Badonbor Baroh ; hato men sangeh noh mynta , ne men jubab ?

translation.en: And not holding the Head , from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered , and knit together , increaseth with the increase of God .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong U Khrist la bsa ïa ka met baroh kawei bad la pyndait lang da ki mat bad doh-satar jong ka , bad ka san kumba U Blei u kwah ïa ka ba kan san .

translation.en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross , that we may see and believe . And they that were crucified with him reviled him .
translation.kha: To ngin ïakhmih ïa U Messaïah , u syiem ki Israel , un hiar na ka diengphna mynta , bad ngin ngeit ha u !  Bad kita ki ar ngut kiba la shah sahnarphna bad U Jisu , ki la krenbeiñ ruh ïa u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Keep ye judgment , and do justice : for my salvation is near to come , and my righteousness to be revealed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Leh ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaba dei , naba shen ngan pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;
translation.kha: Ba ka jingaiei ka hikai ïa ngi ban iehnoh ïa ka rukom im bymriewblei bad ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei , bad ban im da kaba synshar ïa lade , ban im hok , bad ban im riewblei ha kane ka pyrthei ,

translation.en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl : his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires .
translation.kha: ïa u saphron , u kalamus , ïa ka siasia , lane ka jingiwbih kaba bun jait . Ka mirr bad ka alos ki mih hangta lem bad ki jingsleh kiba iwbih tam .

translation.en: Then Tatnai , governor on this side the river , Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , according to that which Darius the king had sent , so they did speedily .
translation.kha: Nangta u Tattenai , u lat , u Shethar Bosenai bad ki paralok jong ki , ki la leh thik kumba u patsha u la hukum .

translation.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah , in Issachar :
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Paruah : ka ri Issakhar

translation.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging : for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , to pynkhreh ïa ka kamra na ka bynta jong nga , namar nga kyrmen ba U Blei un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi baroh bad ban ai pat ïa nga ha me .

translation.en: And the man of God was wroth with him , and said , Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times  ; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it : whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u Elisha , bad u ong ïa u syiem ,  Me la dei ban pduh san ne hynriew sien , bad nangta men jin da la jop pura halor ki Syria ; hynrei mynta men jop ïa ki tang lai sien .

translation.en: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea . And Cornelius waited for them , and had called together his kinsmen and near friends .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la poi ha Kaisaria , ha kaba u Kornelios u dang ap ïa u , lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ki paralok bajan jong u kiba u la khot sngewbha .

translation.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea , they came thither also , and stirred up the people .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki Jiw ha Thessaloni ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul u la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei ha Beria ruh , ki la ïawan shata bad ki la sdang ban pynkhih bad pynkulmar ïa u paidbhur .

translation.en: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him ? be it far from me : let not the king impute any thing unto his servant , nor to all the house of my father : for thy servant knew nothing of all this , less or more .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga la kylli na U Blei na ka bynta jong u , bad kam shym dei ka sien banyngkong . Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa phi , wat ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un kynnoh ïa nga lane ïano ïano na ka longïing jong nga . Ngam tip ei ei shaphang kane !

translation.en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him , and he in him . And hereby we know that he abideth in us , by the Spirit which he hath given us .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei , u ïaisah ha U Blei bad U Blei u ïaisah ha u . Bad dei namar U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ha ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u ïaisah ha ngi .

translation.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem , from before the tabernacle of the congregation , and reigned over Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u mihnoh na ka jaka mane ha Gibeon , ha kaba don ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Hangta u synshar ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous : wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five ? And he said , If I find there forty and five , I will not destroy it .
translation.kha: Hynrei , lehse don sawphew san ngut ha ka jaka sanphew ngut kiba hok . Hato men pynjot noh ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei namar ba duna san ngut ?  U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan ym pynjot noh ïa ka lada nga shem sawphew san ngut kiba hok .

translation.en: Maon , Carmel , and Ziph , and Juttah ,
translation.kha: Don ka Maon , ka Karmel , ka Siph , ka Juttah ,

translation.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation , he departed from him for a season .
translation.kha: Haba u Soitan u la dep ban pynshoi ïa U Jisu ha ki rukom bapher bapher , u la iehnoh ïa u shipor .

translation.en: And Elisha came to Damascus  ; and Ben–hadad the king of Syria was sick  ; and it was told him , saying , The man of God is come hither .
translation.kha: U Elisha u leit sha Damaskos ha ka por ba u Benhadad u syiem Syria u pang . Haba la ïathuh ha u syiem ba u Elisha u don hangta ,

translation.en: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily , saying , Behold , Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem  ; and , behold , they fortify the city against thee .
translation.kha: U phah ki nonglamktien sha u Abimelekh ha Arumah ban ong ,  U Gaal u khun jong u Ebed bad ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u ki la wan sha Shekhem , bad kin ym shah ïa phi ban wan rung shapoh ka nongbah .

translation.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times , and cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , I pray thee , let this child s soul come into him again .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u dem lai sien halor uta u khynnah bad u duwai ,  Ko  Trai  U Blei jong nga , pynwan biang ïa ka jingim ha une u khynnah !

translation.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir .
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u leit phai pat ha kata ka sngi sha Edom .

translation.en: And all the city was moved , and the people ran together : and they took Paul , and drew him out of the temple : and forthwith the doors were shut .
translation.kha: Ka jingkulmar ka la pur ha ka nongbah baroh kawei , bad ki briew ki la ïamareh lang , ki la kem ïa u Paul , bad ki la patan ïa u shabar jong ka Templ . Shisyndon hi la khang ïa ki jingkhang jong ka Templ .

translation.en: And he said , Appoint me thy wages , and I will give it .
translation.kha: To kheiñ ïa ka bainong jong me , bad ngan siew ïa ka .

translation.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him .
translation.kha: U kpa jong u briew uba hok u don ka daw babiang ban kmen . Phi lah ban sngewsarong ha u khun uba stad .

translation.en: For as the body without the spirit is dead , so faith without works is dead also .
translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka met khlem ka mynsiem ka long kaba ïap , kumta ruh ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long kaba ïap .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the mean while , that the heaven was black with clouds and wind , and there was a great rain . And Ahab rode , and went to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Tang hadien khyndiat por , ki lyoh dum ki la tap ïa ka suiñbneng , ka lyer ka sdang ban beh bad u slap bajur u sdang ban hap . U Ahab u shong ha ka kali ïapom bad u sdang ban leit phai sha Jesreel .

translation.en: And when he had so said , he shewed unto them his hands and his side . Then were the disciples glad , when they saw the Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , u la pyn-i ha ki ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ka krung . Ki synran ki la dap da ka jingkmen haba ki la ïohi ïa U Trai .

translation.en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted , until Asshur shall carry thee away captive .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi ki Ken phin sa shah pynjot thiaw Ynda u Assyria u ringmraw ïa phi .

translation.en: And when Jesus saw her , he called her to him , and said unto her ,  Woman , thou art loosed from thine infirmity .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrta ïa ka ,  Ko ka briew , pha la lait phar na ka jingpang jong pha !

translation.en: Wherefore the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Amaziah , and he sent unto him a prophet , which said unto him , Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people , which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand ?
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban bitar , kumta u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa sha u Amasaïah . U nongïathuhlypa u la dawa ,  Balei ba phi mane ïa ki blei nongwei ki bym lah wat ban pyllait im ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jong me ?

translation.en: And they put the fat upon the breasts , and he burnt the fat upon the altar :
translation.kha: halor ki shadem jong ki bad u rah ïa ki baroh sha ka duwan . U thang ïa ka khleiñ halor ka duwan ,

translation.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters , and to please them well in all things ; not answering again ;
translation.kha: Ki mraw kin pyndem ha la ki kynrad bad ban pynsngewbha ïa ki ha kiei kiei baroh . Kim dei ban pynphai ktien kylliang ïa ki .

translation.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth–maim , and all the Sidonians , them will I drive out from before the children of Israel : only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance , as I have commanded thee .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa ka ri baroh jong ki nong Sidon , kiba shong ha ka ri lum hapdeng ki lum Lebanon bad Misrephoth Maim . Ngan beh noh ïa kine ki briew katba ki Israel ki nang tur sha khmat . Me dei ban pynbynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki Israel , kumba nga la hukum ïa me ban leh .

translation.en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle , even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba shen ngan sa iehnoh ïa kane ka met bapyut kumba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi u la ïathuh shai ha nga .

translation.en: And when Saul sent messengers to take David , she said , He is sick .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew u Saul ki wan ban kem ïa u Dabid , ka Mikhal ka ïathuh ïa ki ba u pang .

translation.en: And were carried over into Sychem , and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem .
translation.kha: Ïa ki met jong ki la leit rah sha Shekhem , ha kaba la tep ïa ki ha ka jingtep kaba u Abraham u la thied da ka pisa na ka jait Hamar .

translation.en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee , O  Lord  , among the heathen , and I will sing praises unto thy name .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïaroh ïa me , ko  Trai  , hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , nga rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .

translation.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away , and went into the house : and his disciples came unto him , saying , Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bad u la leit rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  To ïathuh ïa ngi aïu ka pharshi shaphang ki ñiut hapoh ka lyngkha ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord  , no man shall abide there , neither shall a son of man dwell in it .
translation.kha: Kajuh hi kan jia ïa ka Edom kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , mynba ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong ba-marjan la pynjot . Yn ym don ban sah biang hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers , and stood and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong ujuh u bnai , ki Israel ki ïalumlang ban shahjingit ban pynpaw ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop jong ki . Ki la lah pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki nongwei baroh . Ki phong ki jaiñ khain bad sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki kum ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih . Nangta ki ïeng bad sdang ban phla ïa ki pop kiba ma ki bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh .

translation.en: For the  Lord  had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee : therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee , that I may know what to do unto thee .
translation.kha: Naba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki ,  Phi long u paidlang uba mutlop . Lada ngan leit ryngkat bad phi wat tang shikhyllipmat ruh , ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa phi . Law noh mynta ïa kito ki jingdeng jong phi , bad ngan sa rai ngan leh kumno ïa phi .

translation.en: And now she is planted in the wilderness , in a dry and thirsty ground .
translation.kha: Mynta la thung ïa u ha ka ri shyiap , ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad ka bym don um .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Surely I will be with thee , and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Me lah ban leh ïa ka namar ngan ïarap ïa me . Men pynlwet ïa ki Midian da kaba suk i kumba ki long tang uwei u briew .

translation.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them : for they said , Lest the earth swallow us up also .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Israel kiba don hangta ki la phet ïap haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ki . Ki la ïa-pyrta ,  Phet , Ka khyndew ka lah ban nguid ïa ngi ruh !

translation.en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth , and his abominations from between his teeth : but he that remaineth , even he , shall be for our God , and he shall be as a governor in Judah , and Ekron as a Jebusite .
translation.kha: Kin ym lah shuh ban bam ïa ka doh lem bad ka snam ha ka , lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingbam ba la mana . Baroh kiba lait im kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga bad kin long kum ka kur ha ka jait Judah . Ka Ekron kan kylla long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga , kumba ki Jebus ki la long .

translation.en: So David stayed his servants with these words , and suffered them not to rise against Saul . But Saul rose up out of the cave , and went on his way .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u pynkohnguh ïa la ki rangbah ba kim dei ban ktah kti ïa u Saul . U Saul u ïeng joit , u mihnoh na ka krem , bad u leit noh .

translation.en: And he was king in Jeshurun , when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem jong ki Israel ki briew jong u , mynba ki jait bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki ïalumlang .

translation.en: One God and Father of all , who is above all , and through all , and in you all .
translation.kha: don tang uwei U Blei uba long U Kpa jong u bynriew baroh , uba long U Trai halor baroh , uba trei lyngba kiei kiei baroh , bad u long ha baroh .

translation.en: For my people have committed two evils  ; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters , and hewed them out cisterns , broken cisterns , that can hold no water .
translation.kha: namar ki briew jong nga ki la leh ar tylli ki pop : Ki la phai noh na nga , ka umpohliew ki um basngur ; bad ki la tih ki jaka pynlang um , ki jaka pynlang um kiba la pdang ki bym lah ban pynlang ïa ka um .

translation.en: And one of Joab s men stood by him , and said , He that favoureth Joab , and he that is for David , let him go after Joab .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Joab u la ïeng harud ka metïap jong u Amasa bad u pyrta ,  Uno uno uba ha ka liang jong u Joab bad u Dabid , to un bud ïa u Joab !

translation.en: Son of man , prophesy against the shepherds of Israel , prophesy , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto the shepherds  ; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves ! should not the shepherds feed the flocks ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ki nongsynshar ka Israel . Ïathuhlypa ha ki , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong ha ki : Phi long ki bym don jingkyrmen shuh , a phi ki nongsharai ka Israel ! Phi sumar bha tang ïa lade , hynrei phim ju bsa bha ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: And many nations shall be joined to the  Lord  in that day , and shall be my people : and I will dwell in the midst of thee , and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto thee .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por shibun ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha U  Trai  bad long ki briew jong u . Un shong un sah hapdeng jong phi , bad phin tip ba u la lah phah ïa nga sha phi .

translation.en: Son of man , eat thy bread with quaking , and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kyiuh haba me bam , bad to khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng haba me dih .

translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ïa nga , ba nga la pynïap shibun eh ki briew bad ïaleh shibun ki thma . Bad kumta , namar ba nga la pynmih shibun ka snam , un ym shah ïa nga ban tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is written , Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U bynriew um im tang da u kpu hi , hynrei u donkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba U Blei u kren .’

translation.en: That ye receive her in the Lord , as becometh saints , and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you : for she hath been a succourer of many , and of myself also .
translation.kha: To pdiang ïa ka ha ka kyrteng U Trai , kumba ki briew jong U Blei ki dei ban leh , bad to ai ha ka ïa kano kano ka jingïarap kaba ka lah ban donkam na phi ; namar ma ka hi , da lade ka long ka paralok babha ïa kiba bun ki briew bad ïa nga ruh .

translation.en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days , that I will bring again the captivity of Elam , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Elam ba kin manbha biang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment , and with his skirt do touch bread , or pottage , or wine , or oil , or any meat , shall it be holy ? And the priests answered and said , No .
translation.kha: Tharai uno uno u shim ïa ka lyngkhot doh ba la pynkyntang na ka jingkñia bad u rah ha ka jingkhylliap jong ka jaiñkup jong u . Te lada u kum pyndei ïa la ka jaiñkup ha uno uno u kpu , ka jingbam ba la shet , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ne ka dei kano kano ka jait jingbam , hato kan pynlong ba la pynkyntang ruh ïa kata ka jingbam ?  Haba la kylli ïa kata ka jingkylli , ki lyngdoh ki jubab ,  Em .

translation.en: Which sometime were disobedient , when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah , while the ark was a preparing , wherein few , that is , eight souls were saved by water .
translation.kha: Kine ki la long ki mynsiem jong kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei mynba u la ap da ka jingshahslem ha ki sngi ba u Noah u dang shna ïa ka ïinglieng jong u . Ki briew kiba don tang khyndiat ha ka ïinglieng — phra ngut ha baroh — ki la lait im da ka um ,

translation.en: And it came to pass on the third day , when they were sore , that two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , Dinah s brethren , took each man his sword , and came upon the city boldly , and slew all the males .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien , katba kita ki rangbah ki dang ïa-ud pang na ka jingotsher jong ki , ar ngut na ki khun shynrang u Jakob , u Simeon bad u Lebi , ki hynmen shynrang jong ka Dinah , ki la shim ïa la ki waitlam bad ki leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , bad ki pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang baroh , kynthup ïa u Hamor bad u Shekhem u khun jong u .

translation.en: Then will we give our daughters unto you , and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .
translation.kha: Te kumta ngin kohnguh ba kan don ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi . Ngin shong ngin sah hapdeng jong phi , bad ngin ïalong kawei ka jaitbynriew bad phi .

translation.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour  ; as he hath done , so shall it be done to him  ;
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynmynsaw ïa uwei pat u briew , kumba u la leh ïa uta , kumta ruh yn leh kylliang ïa u .

translation.en: Wherefore the well was called Beer–lahai–roi  ; behold , it is between Kadesh and Bered .
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba ki briew ki khot kyrteng ïa ka pukri hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka Bered  Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .

translation.en: That in every thing ye are enriched by him , in all utterance , and in all knowledge ;
translation.kha: Naba ha U Khrist la pynlong ïa phi kiba man kyrhai ha kiei kiei baroh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingkren bad ka jingtip baroh .

translation.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth , and honoureth me with their lips  ; but their heart is far from me .
translation.kha: ‘ Kine briew , ong U Blei , ki pyndonburom ïa nga da ki kyntien jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki , da shisha ka long jngai eh na nga .

translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the Lord , saith thus  ; Wailing shall be in all streets  ; and they shall say in all the highways , Alas ! alas ! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning , and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , u ong ,  Kan don ka jinglynñiar bad ki jingïam sngewsih ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah . Wat ïa ki nongrep yn khot ban ïam na ka bynta kiba ïap lem bad kito ïa kiba lah da siew ban ïambriew .

translation.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon , and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up : and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him : yea , the wall of Babylon shall fall .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u Bel , u blei ki nong Babilonia , bad ngan pynlong ïa u ban aiti noh ïa ki tiar jong u kiba shu tuh ; ki jaitbynriew kin ym mane shuh ïa u .  Ki kynroh ka Babilon ki la khyllem .

translation.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the towns of Jair , which are in Bashan , threescore cities :
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Mahanaim bad kynthup ïa ka Bashan baroh — baroh ka hima u Og , u syiem Bashan , bad ruh baroh hynriewphew tylli ki shnong jong u Jair ha Bashan .

translation.en: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards , and are more fierce than the evening wolves : and their horsemen shall spread themselves , and their horsemen shall come from far  ; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat .
translation.kha: Ki kulai jong ki , ki kham stet ban ïa ki  labasa , kham shyrkhei ban ïa ki suri bathngan . Ki nongshong kulai jong ki , ki wan tur na ki jaka ba sha jngai ; ki kulai jong ki , ki trud ïa ka khyndew . Ki wan suh wia kum ki pukni kiba tur ha ka jingbam .

translation.en: And they made two rings of gold , and put them on the two ends of the breastplate , upon the border of it , which was on the side of the ephod inward .
translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki na shapoh jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ki tduh kiba sha trai jong ka , hajan ka ephod .

translation.en: Thou shalt build the altar of the  Lord  thy God of whole stones : and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  thy God :
translation.kha: Tei ïa ka duwan na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da ki maw tylli ; bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ;

translation.en: For he knew who should betray him  ; therefore said he ,  Ye are not all clean .
translation.kha: ( U Jisu u la lah tip lypa uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa u ; na kata ka daw balei u la ong ,  Baroh na phi , lait noh uwei , phi long kiba khuid .  )

translation.en: As sorrowful , yet alway rejoicing ; as poor , yet making many rich ; as having nothing , and yet possessing all things .
translation.kha: Wat haba la pynshitom , ym shym la pynïap ; wat haba la pynsngewsih , ngi long borabor kiba kmen ; ngi paw kum kiba duk , hynrei ngi pynriewspah ïa ki briew kiba bun ; ngi paw kum ki bym don ei ei , pynban ngi don lut ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: And she brought forth her firstborn son , and wrapped him in swaddling clothes , and laid him in a manger  ; because there was no room for them in the inn .
translation.kha: Ka la kha ïa u khun nyngkong jong ka bad ka la sop ïa u da ki jaiñsop , bad ka la pynthiah ïa u ha ka shyngoid — ym shym don jaka ïa ki ha ka kamra sah   .

translation.en: The sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher . U don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah , bad kawei ka khun , ka Serah .

translation.en: And many of them said , He hath a devil , and is mad  ; why hear ye him ?
translation.kha: Bun na ki , ki la ïa-ong ,  U shongksuid ! U la lamwir ! Balei phi ïa-shahskhor ïa u ?

translation.en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just  ; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him .
translation.kha: U briew uba nyngkong ban kren ha ka ïingbishar borabor u sngewdei tad haduh ba uba ïaleh pyrshah u sdang ban buh jingkylli ïa u .

translation.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him : and Esau said in his heart , The days of mourning for my father are at hand  ; then will I slay my brother Jacob .
translation.kha: U Iso u la isih ïa u Jakob , namar ba u kpa jong u , u la ai ha u Jakob ïa ka jingkyrkhu . U la pyrkhat ,  Ka por ban ïambriew na ka bynta i pa jong nga ka la jan ; te kumta ngan sa pynïap ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: But the people answered , Thou shalt not go forth : for if we flee away , they will not care for us  ; neither if half of us die , will they care for us : but now thou art worth ten thousand of us : therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban leit lang bad ngi ,  ki la ong .  Kam don jingktah ei ei ïa u nongshun lada kiba sah na ngi ki phai dien bad phet lane lada shiteng na ngi ki la shah pynïap ; hynrei phi ïaryngkat dor bad shiphew hajar ngut na ngi . Kan kham bha lada phi shong hangne ha ka nongbah bad phah jingïarap ïa ngi .

translation.en: Wilt thou trust him , because his strength is great ? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban shaniah ha ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw jong u bad khmih lynti ïa u ban trei ïa ki kam bakhia jong me ?

translation.en: They chose new gods  ; then was war in the gates : was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?
translation.kha: Nangta la don ka thma ha ka ri , Haba ki Israel ki jied ki blei thymmai . Na ki sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Israel Don mano mano ba rah ïa ka stieh ne u sum ?

translation.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold : their hooks shall be of gold , upon the four sockets of silver .
translation.kha: Wah ïa ka halor ki saw tylli ki rishot kiba da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar , ha kiba la buh ïa ki bnoh ksiar , bad ïa kiba la thep ha ki thliew tnaw rupa .

translation.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had , and came to Beer–sheba , and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u mihnoh , u da kit lut baroh kat kiba u don , bad u leit sha Beersheba , bad hangta u kñia ainguh ha U Blei jong u Isaak u kpa jong u .

translation.en: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets , which spake in thy name to our kings , our princes , and our fathers , and to all the people of the land .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong me , kiba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong me sha ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad ka jaitbynriew jong ngi baroh kawei .

translation.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers , and have not hid it :
translation.kha: Kito kiba stad ki la hikai ïa nga ïa ki jingshisha kiba ki la nang na ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kim shym buhrieh ei ei .

translation.en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , even what my God saith , that will I speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan ong ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ong ïa nga ban ong !

translation.en: He also tells us about his purpose and what he wants us to do .
translation.kha: U ïathuh ruh ha ngi shaphang ka jingthmu jong u bad kaei kaba u kwah ïa ngi ban leh .

translation.en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth , and hath given him power to eat thereof , and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labour  ; this is the gift of God .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u ai ha ngi ka spah bad ka jingdon jingem bad to ngin lehkmen ha ki , ngi dei ban sngewnguh bad lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai na U Blei .

translation.en: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land  ; I will bereave them of children , I will destroy my people , since they return not from their ways .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong ha ka ri nga la kynting ïa phi sha ka lyer kum ïa u phlangïap . Nga la pynjot ïa phi , ki briew jong nga , nga la pynïap ïa ki khun jong phi namar phim shym sangeh ïa ki rukom basniew jong phi .

translation.en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee , and gird them with sackcloth , and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing .
translation.kha: Ki khi noh ïa la ki khlieh na ka bynta jong pha bad ki kup ïa lade ha ki jaiñ khain . Ki dohnud jong ki , ki kthang sngewsih katba ki dang ïam .

translation.en: And forthwith he came to Jesus , and said , Hail , master  ; and kissed him .
translation.kha: U Judas u la leit beit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad me , ko Nonghikai ,  bad u la doh ïa u .

translation.en: If there be found among you , within any of thy gates which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , man or woman , that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , in transgressing his covenant ,
translation.kha: Lada phi shem ha kawei na ki shnong jong phi ïa u shynrang lane ka kynthei kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong u ,

translation.en: Who is like unto the  Lord  our God , who dwelleth on high ,
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . U shong ha kiba kynjang shajrong ,

translation.en: Every man may see it  ; man may behold it afar off .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba u la leh ; hynrei ngi lah tang ban shu khmih na jngai .

translation.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above , but is earthly , sensual , devilish .
translation.kha: Kaba kum kata ka jingstad kam long kaba wan hiar na bneng ; ka long jong ka pyrthei , kam long kaba kynja mynsiem bad ka long kaba kynja ksuid .

translation.en: For if these things be in you , and abound , they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jinglong kiba phi donkam , bad lada phi don kyrhai ïa ki , kin pynlong ïa phi kiba smat bad kiba seisoh ha ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: I said in my haste , All men are liars .
translation.kha: wat haba nga la sheptieng bad nga ong ,  Ym don uwei ruh ïa uba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: And they sat before him , the firstborn according to his birthright , and the youngest according to his youth : and the men marvelled one at another .
translation.kha: Kumta kita shi para ki ïashong ha khmat jong u , ha ka miej marpyrshah ïa u Joseph kat kum ka rta jong ki naduh uba nyngkong haduh uba khatduh . Haba ki ïohi kumno ki ïashong bam , ki shu ïa-peit lyngngoh para ma ki .

translation.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain , and upon every high hill , rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter , when the towers fall .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba ïa ki jaka ba la kerkut jong ki nongshun jong phi la kurup bad ba ïa ki briew jong ki la pynïap , ki wahduid kin tuid na baroh ki lumbah bad ki lumrit .

translation.en: Give to him that asketh thee , and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u pan ei ei na phi , to ai ïa kata ha u ; haba uno uno u kwah ban pan kylliang ei ei na phi , to ai kylliang ïa u .

translation.en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the  Lord   ; and his name was Doeg , an Edomite , the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul .
translation.kha: ( U rangbah nongap jingri jong u Saul , u Doeg uba na Edom , da kaba jia ryngkhat u don hangta ha kata ka sngi , namar u hap ban pyndep ïa ka kamram lehniam . )

translation.en: Who are Israelites ; to whom pertaineth the adoption , and the glory , and the covenants , and the giving of the law , and the service of God , and the promises ;
translation.kha: Ki long ki briew jong U Blei ; u la pynlong ki khun jong u ïa ki bad u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u ha ki ; u la pynlong ki jutang bad ki bad u la ai ïa ki ka Hukum ; ki don ka jingmane bashisha ; ki la ïoh ïa ki jingkular U Blei ;

translation.en: Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .
translation.kha: To kieng noh ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei baroh , khnang ba phi lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki buit thap basniew jong u Soitan .

translation.en: How art thou fallen from heaven , O Lucifer , son of the morning ! how art thou cut down to the ground , which didst weaken the nations !
translation.kha: Ko syiem ka Babilonia , u khlur step baphyrnai , me la hap na bneng ! Ha kaba mynshuwa me la jop ïa ki hima , hynrei mynta la bret ïa me sha madan .

translation.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the  Lord  : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad u la leit bad shong harud ka wahduid Kherith .

translation.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you .
translation.kha: Kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kin teh kumjuh ïa ki traishnong bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi .

translation.en: The watchmen that went about the city found me , they smote me , they wounded me  ; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me .
translation.kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno phi long kaba janai !

translation.en: That Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father s servants with him , to go into Egypt  ; Hadad being yet a little child .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la sah hynriew bnai ha Edom , bad ha kata ka por ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang ha Edom lait noh u Hadad bad katto katne ngut ki nong Edom kiba long ki shakri u kpa jong u , kiba la phet ïap sha Ijipt . ( Ha kata ka por u Hadad u dang long tang u khynnah . )

translation.en: He said furthermore unto me , Son of man , seest thou what they do ? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here , that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? but turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia ? Khmih ïa kito kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki paid Israel ki leh hangne , ban beh noh ïa nga sha jngai bad kham sha jngai na ka jaka bakhuid jong nga . Men dang ïohi shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba kham jahburom ban ïa kane .

translation.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard . My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill :
translation.kha: To pynshahshkor katba nga rwai ha phi ïa kane ka jingrwai , ka jingrwai u paralok jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong u : U paralok jong nga u don ka bri sohwaiñ ha u lumrit uba seisoh bha .

translation.en: As for me , behold , my covenant is with thee , and thou shalt be a father of many nations .
translation.kha: Nga pynlong ïa kane ka jutang bad me : Nga kular ba men long u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kiba bun .

translation.en: Let my lord , I pray thee , pass over before his servant : and I will lead on softly , according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure , until I come unto my lord unto Seir .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , khie nang ïaid sha khmat , ngan nang bud suki suki , ban ïaid katba nga lah lem bad kine ki jingri bad ki khynnah haduh ba ngin sa ïashem pat bad phi ha Edom .

translation.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh s , and captain of the guard .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ha Ijipt , ki Midian ki la die noh ïa u Joseph ha u Potiphar , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem , uba dei u kapten jong ki nongap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast , that the image of the beast should both speak , and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed .
translation.kha: La shah ïa u mradkhlaw uba ar ban pyrsad jingim ha kata ka dur jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , khnang ba ka durblei ka lah ban kren bad pynïap ïa kito baroh ki ban ym mane ïa ka .

translation.en: Paul , a prisoner of Jesus Christ , and Timothy our brother , unto Philemon our dearly beloved , and fellowlabourer ,
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u nongsah byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Ha u Philemon , u paralok jong ngi bad u para ba-ïatrei lang ,

translation.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets : therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni kam lah ban set ïa kaba buhrieh . Kiar na ki briew kiba bunktien palat .

translation.en: Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,
translation.kha: U Issakhar , U Sebulun , U Benjamin ,

translation.en: And he changeth the times and the seasons : he removeth kings , and setteth up kings : he giveth wisdom unto the wise , and knowledge to them that know understanding :
translation.kha: U bat synshar ïa ki por bad ki aïom ; u pynlong bad u weng ïa ki syiem ; long ma u , uba ai ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: And that lord answered the man of God , and said , Now , behold , if the  Lord  should make windows in heaven , might such a thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
translation.kha: ha kaba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la jubab ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  Bad u Elisha u la jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow , and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work :
translation.kha: kum u mraw uba kwah hir hir ïa ka jakarieh tngen ; kum u nongtrei uba ap ïa la ka bainong .

translation.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars  hill , and said , Ye men of Athens , I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious .
translation.kha: U Paul u la ïeng ha khmat jong ka dorbar jong ka nongbah bad u la ong ,  Nga ïohi ba ha ki liang baroh ma phi ki nong Athens phi long kiba kit niam bha .

translation.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads : and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynlong ruh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban shitom namar ka jingbymman jong ki , kumba u Jotham , u khun jong u Gideon , u ong ïa ki ba kin long kumta haba u la tim ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly , that God hath made that same Jesus , whom ye have crucified , both Lord and Christ .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel , te , ki dei ban tip da kaba thikna ba une U Jisu , uba phi la sahnarphna , u dei uta uba U Blei u la pynlong U Trai bad U Messaïah !

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  If a man love me , he will keep my words : and my Father will love him , and we will come unto him , and make our abode with him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Uno uno uba ieit ïa nga un kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga . U Kpa jong nga un ieit ïa u , bad U Kpa jong nga bad ma nga ngin wan ha u bad sah hapoh jong u .

translation.en: And now go to  ; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard : I will take away the hedge thereof , and it shall be eaten up  ; and break down the wall thereof , and it shall be trodden down :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba ngan leh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga : Ngan weng noh ïa ka jingker baroh sawdong jong ka , ngan pynpra ïa ka kynroh kaba da ïa ka , ngan shah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban bam ïa ka bad ïuhroit ïa ka .

translation.en: They reap every one his corn in the field : and they gather the vintage of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ki hap ban ot ha ki lyngkha ki bym dei la ki jong , bad lum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki briew kiba sniew .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Hinder me not , seeing the  Lord  hath prospered my way  ; send me away that I may go to my master .
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong ,  Wat pynsah shuh ïa ngi . U  Trai  u la ai jingjop ïa ka jingleit jong nga ; to shah ngan leit phai pat sha la u kynrad .

translation.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years , and begat Terah :
translation.kha: Haba u Nahor u la dap arphew khyndai snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Terah ;

translation.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh , the abomination of Moab , in the hill that is before Jerusalem , and for Molech , the abomination of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Halor u lum uba sha mihngi na Jerusalem u tei ka jaka mane ïa u Khemosh , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Moab , bad ka jaka mane ïa u Molekh , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .

translation.en: So the king returned , and came to Jordan . And Judah came to Gilgal , to go to meet the king , to conduct the king over Jordan .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit phai jong u , ki rangbah ka Judah kiba la wan sha Gilgal ban synran ïa u sha shiliang ka wah , ki la ïakynduh ïa u ha ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand : he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness : these forty years the  Lord  thy God hath been with thee  ; thou hast lacked nothing .
translation.kha: Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la leh . U la sumar sukher ïa phi haba phi ïaid sakma lyngba kane ka ri shyiap kaba ïar . U la don ryngkat bad phi ha kine ki sawphew snem , bad phi la ïoh ruh kat ïa kaba phi donkam .

translation.en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka synagog .

translation.en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .
translation.kha: U Nathan u ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .

translation.en: For all the promises of God in him are yea , and in him Amen , unto the glory of God by us .
translation.kha: Dei namar kane lyngba U Jisu Khrist ba ngi ïa-ong  Amen  na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .

translation.en: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas , which had kept his bed eight years , and was sick of the palsy .
translation.kha: Hangta u la shem ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ainias , uba la pang ïapshiliang bad u bym shym la lah ban khie na ka jingthiah la phra snem .

translation.en: The joy of our heart is ceased  ; our dance is turned into mourning .
translation.kha: Ka jingkmen ka la duh noh na ki jingim jong ngi ; ka jingsngewsih ka la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki jingshad jong ngi .

translation.en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished : but he that gathereth by labour shall increase .
translation.kha: Ka jingïoh ïa ka spah da kaba suk eh , ka jinglut noh jong ka ruh ka long kaba kloi eh . Kaba kham eh ban ïoh ïa ka , kaba kham roi ruh ka jingïoh ïa ka .

translation.en: But if ye cannot declare it me , then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments . And they said unto him , Put forth thy riddle , that we may hear it .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ha ki ,  Shah ngan buh ha phi kawei ka jingkyntip . Ngan thong ïa phi uwei pa uwei shi lyngkhot ka jaiñ linen bad laiphew riam ki jaiñ baremdor lada phi lah ban batai ha nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka ha shuwa ban kut kine ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai shongkurim .  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kata ka jingkyntip jong phi ,  ki ong .  To ai ba ngin ïohsngew ïa kata .

translation.en: And of Asher he said , Let Asher be blessed with children  ; let him be acceptable to his brethren , and let him dip his foot in oil .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Asher u ong ,  U Asher u kham ïoh jingkyrkhu ban ïa la ki para jait . To ki hynmen ki para jong u kin burom eh ïa u , Bad to ka ri jong u kan dap da ki diengsoh Olib .

translation.en: And it was told Saul , saying , Behold , David is at Naioth in Ramah .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u don ha Naïoth kaba ha Ramah , kumta u Saul u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban kem ïa u .

translation.en: Speak , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field , and as the handful after the harvestman , and none shall gather them .
translation.kha: Ki metïap ki la saphriang ha kylleng , kum ki kynton sboh halor ki lyngkha , kum u riewhadem ba la ot bad iehnoh da ki nongot , u riewhadem u bym don mano mano ba lum . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Suffer ye thus far .  And he touched his ear , and healed him .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Keiñ noh kane !  U la ktah ïa ka shkor jong uta u briew bad u la pynkhiah ïa u .

translation.en: Hear ye this , O house of Jacob , which are called by the name of Israel , and are come forth out of the waters of Judah , which swear by the name of the  Lord  , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki paid Israel , phi kiba hiarpateng na u Judah : Phi smai da ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad kam ba phi mane ïa U Blei ki Israel — hynrei phim shym buh jingmut ïa kawei ruh ka ktien kaba phi ong .

translation.en: So Esther s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her . Then was the queen exceedingly grieved  ; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai , and to take away his sackcloth from him : but he received it not .
translation.kha: Haba ki shakri kynthei jong ka Esther bad ki ïunukh ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u leh , ka la shitom jingmut haduh katta katta . Ka phah sha u Mordekai katto katne ki jaiñ ban phong ha ka jaka ki jaiñ khain , hynrei um shym pdiang ïa ki .

translation.en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , saying , This house shall be like Shiloh , and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant ? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Balei ba me la kren ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ba kane ka Templ kan long kum ka Shiloh bad ba ïa kane ka nongbah yn pynjot bad yn ym don bashong ba sah hangta ?  Nangta ki briew ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga .

translation.en: And he entered into a ship , and passed over , and came into his own city .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw sha la ka jong shnong ,

translation.en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water :
translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ban pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .
