translation.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity , whose name is Holy  ; I dwell in the high and holy place , with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit , to revive the spirit of the humble , and to revive the heart of the contrite ones .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba khraw bad uba khuid , uba im shi junom . Nga shong ha ki jaka kiba jrong bad kiba khuid , bad nga im ruh bad ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kylla-kaba-mut , kumta ba ngan pynïoh biang ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen jong ki .

translation.en: And Jacob said , O God of my father Abraham , and God of my father Isaac , the  Lord  which saidst unto me , Return unto thy country , and to thy kindred , and I will deal well with thee :
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la duwai ,  A U Blei jong u parad jong nga u Abraham , bad U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u Isaak , to shahshkor ïa nga ! Me la bthah ïa nga , A  Trai  , ban leit phai pat sha la ka ri bad sha la ki kur ki jait , bad men pynbiang ba kiei kiei baroh kin ïaid beit bad nga .

translation.en: But he said unto them ,  Give ye them to eat .  And they said , We have no more but five loaves and two fishes  ; except we should go and buy meat for all this people .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ba kin bam .  Ki la jubab ,  Baroh kaba ngi don ki long san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha . Hato phi kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad thied jingbam na ka bynta une u paidbah ?

translation.en: Riches and honour are with me  ; yea , durable riches and righteousness .
translation.kha: Nga don ka spah bad ka burom ban ai , ka jingdap kyrhai bad ka jingjop .

translation.en: And his return was to Ramah  ; for there was his house  ; and there he judged Israel  ; and there he built an altar unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u ju leit pat sa sha la ïing ha Ramah , hangta ruh u ju shakri kum u nongbishar . Ha Ramah u la tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  hangta .

translation.en: I have digged and drunk strange waters , and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places .
translation.kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih pukri bad dih ïa ki um ha ki ri nongwei bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïoh ïuh pyntyrkhong ïa ka wah Nile .

translation.en: Thou also shalt be drunken : thou shalt be hid , thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy .
translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha ruh phan hap ha ka jingbuaid bymtip briew ! Pha ruh phan pyrshang ban lait phet na ki nongshun jong pha .

translation.en: And they made two other golden rings , and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart of it , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha trai jong kita ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng kiba sha khmat jong ka ephod , hamar ka jaka suh pyndait , bad haneng ka jingpanpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .

translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , I am a Levite of Beth–lehem–judah , and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .
translation.kha: U Mikah u kylli ïa u ,  Nangno phi wan ?  U jubab ,  Nga dei u Lebi na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . Nga dang khmih hangno ba ngan shong ngan sah .

translation.en: And he took them , and sent them over the brook , and sent over that he had .
translation.kha: Ynda u la phah ïa ki sha shiliang , u la phah ruh sha shiliang ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba u don ,

translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  , that we may enquire of the  Lord  by him ? And one of the king of Israel s servants answered and said , Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat , which poured water on the hands of Elijah .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato don nongïathuhlypa hangne da uba ngi lah ban kylli na U  Trai  ?  U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki kynhun u syiem Joram u jubab ,  U Elisha u khun jong u Shaphat u don hangne . U dei u nongïarap jong u Elijah .

translation.en: And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .
translation.kha: Haba u shem ïa ka , nga ong ha phi , u kham kmen ïa kane kawei ka langbrot ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki bym shym la jah .

translation.en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love , which ye have shewed toward his name , in that ye have ministered to the saints , and do minister .
translation.kha: U Blei um dei uba bishar bymhok . Un ym klet ïa ka kam kaba phi la leh lane ïa ka jingieit kaba phi la pynpaw na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïarap kaba phi la ai bad dang ïai ïarap ïa ki parabangeit .

translation.en: Wherefore he saith , When he ascended up on high , he led captivity captive , and gave gifts unto men .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Mynba u la kiew shajrong eh , u la ïalam bad u ïa shibun kiba shah ringmraw ; u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u bynriew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hardened the heart of Pharaoh , and he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh bad , kumba u la lah ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: So that ye come behind in no gift ; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang U Khrist ka la shong skhem ha phi kat haduh ba phim shym duh noh ban pdiang wat tang ïa kawei ka jingkyrkhu , katba phi dang ap khmih lynti ba yn pynpaw ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that in all the land , saith the  Lord  , two parts therein shall be cut off and die  ; but the third shall be left therein .
translation.kha: bad ha kylleng ka ri , ar na ka lai bynta ki briew kin ïap .

translation.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man , when he giveth of his seed unto Molech , and kill him not :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u paidbah u leh bymsuidñiew ïa kata kaba u la leh bad kim pynïap ïa u ,

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres , which indeed appear beautiful outward , but are within full of dead men s bones , and of all uncleanness .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi long kum ki jingtep ba la pushara lieh , kiba itynnat ha kaba shabar hynrei kiba dap da ki shyieng bad ki metïap bapyut ha kaba shapoh .

translation.en: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne , as the appearance of a sapphire stone : and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it .
translation.kha: Halor ka tnum ka don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ; ba la shna da u mawkordor Sapphir ; bad don bashong halor kata ka khet ba i kum u briew .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Tyre , and will cause many nations to come up against thee , as the sea causeth his waves to come up .
translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko nongbah Tyros . Ngan wallam ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ban tur ïaleh ïa pha , bad kin wan kum ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .

translation.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant , when they contended with me  ;
translation.kha: Haba uno uno na ki shakri jong nga u mudui pyrshah ïa nga , ngan shahshkor bad leh da kaba hok ïa u .

translation.en: And Abraham said , I will swear .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  Nga kular .

translation.en: And I will make with them a covenant of peace , and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land : and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness , and sleep in the woods .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki kaba pynskhem ïa ka jingshongshngain jong ki . Ngan beh noh ïa ki mrad kynsha baroh na ka ri , khnang ba ki langbrot jong nga kin im ha ka jingshngain ha ki jaka phlang bad thiah ha ki khlaw .

translation.en: O Lord , hear  ; O Lord , forgive  ; O Lord , hearken and do  ; defer not , for thine own sake , O my God : for thy city and thy people are called by thy name .
translation.kha: A Trai , to sngew ïa ngi . A Trai , to map ïa ngi . A Trai , to shahshkor ïa ngi , bad to trei ! Khnang ba uwei uwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei , wat ym pynslem ! Kane ka nongbah bad kine ki briew ki long ki jong me .

translation.en: And he said , Who made thee a prince and a judge over us ? intendest thou to kill me , as thou killedst the Egyptian ? And Moses feared , and said , Surely this thing is known .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Mano ba thung ïa phi kum u syiem bad nongbishar jong ngi ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap ïa nga kumba phi la pynïap ïa uto u nong Ijipt ?  Kumta u Moses u la sheptieng , bad u pyrkhat ,  Pleng , ki briew ki la tip ïa kaei ba nga la leh .

translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron s garments to consecrate him , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Khot ïa ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit kiba nga la ai ha ki ka sap bad ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa ki jaiñkup u Aaron khnang ba yn ïoh pynkyntang ïa u kum u lyngdoh ban shakri ïa nga .

translation.en: Now there were seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and dying left no seed .
translation.kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong eh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun .

translation.en: And David , according to the saying of Gad , went up as the  Lord  commanded .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad u la leit kumba u Gad u la ïathuh ïa u .

translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto the  Lord  , We have sinned : do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee  ; deliver us only , we pray thee , this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paid Israel ki ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ngi la leh pop . Leh ïa ngi katba me mon ; hynrei sngewbha , pyllait im ïa ngi ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David , on the west side of Gihon , in the valley , even to the entering in at the fish gate , and compassed about Ophel , and raised it up a very great height , and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Manasseh u tei pynjrong ïa ka kynroh bashabar ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nongbah u Dabid , na ka tduh jong ka them hajan ka umpohliew Gihon shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Dohkha bad ka jaka jong ka nongbah ba khot ka Ophel . U buh ruh ïa u shipai pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ki shipai ha man ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah .

translation.en: Take also your brother , and arise , go again unto the man :
translation.kha: Ïalam ruh ïa la u para , bad ïawan phai mar mar .

translation.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la paw ha u , u da ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .

translation.en: There is one alone , and there is not a second  ; yea , he hath neither child nor brother : yet is there no end of all his labour  ; neither is his eye satisfied with riches  ; neither saith he , For whom do I labour , and bereave my soul of good ? This is also vanity , yea , it is a sore travail .
translation.kha: Hangne don uwei uba shong basah marwei . Um don khun shynrang lymne u para , pynban u ïai trei , um ju sngewhun ïa ka spah kaba u don . Na ka bynta jongno ba u trei shitom haduh katta katta bad ba u khanglad ïa lade hi na kano kano ka jingpynsngewbha ? Kane ruh ka long ka bymmyntoi — bad ka lynti ba-isangsot ban im .

translation.en: Then the priest shall look : and , behold , if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white  ; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin  ; he is clean .
translation.kha: Lada kita ki dak ki long kiba lieh blad , ki dei tang ki dak thohbria ha ka sniehdoh jong ; uta u briew u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Art thou the first man that was born ? or wast thou made before the hills ?
translation.kha: Hato me pyrkhat ba me dei u briew uba nyngkong ba la kha napdeng u khunbynriew ? Hato me don hangta mynba U Blei u la thaw ïa ki lumbah ?

translation.en: But the thing displeased Samuel , when they said , Give us a king to judge us . And Samuel prayed unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u sngewsih ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki ban ïoh syiem ; kumta u duwai ha U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus , which said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And he went out , and wept bitterly .
translation.kha: bad u Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ha u :  Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .  U la mihnoh bad u la ïamkthang .

translation.en: Is not this laid up in store with me , and sealed up among my treasures ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kynmaw aïu ki nongshun jong ki , ki la leh ; u ap ïa ka por kaba biang ban pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted , and the angel of his presence saved them : in his love and in his pity he redeemed them  ; and he bare them , and carried them all the days of old .
translation.kha: Ym dei u angel , hynrei dei U  Trai  hi uba pyllait im ïa ki . Ha ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei jong u , u la pyllait ïa ki . U la ju sumar ïa ki borabor ha ki por kiba mynshuwa ,

translation.en: When they that fed them saw what was done , they fled , and went and told it in the city and in the country .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ap sumar ïa ki sniang ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , kumta ki la phet noh bad ki la pynphriang ïa ka khubor hapoh ka shnong bad ha ki jaka ri jingri .

translation.en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria . And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that he had with him , and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Bun snem hadien , u Jehoshaphat u leit sha ka nongbah Samaria ban leit khmih ïa u Ahab . Ban lehburom ïa u Jehoshaphat bad kito kiba bad u , u Ahab u phah pynïap shibun ki langbrot bad ki masi ban pynlong ka jingkhawai . U pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa u Jehoshaphat ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .

translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  will carry thee away with a mighty captivity , and will surely cover thee .
translation.kha: Me lah ban long uba donkam , hynrei U  Trai  un shim ïa me bad bret noh ïa me sharud .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as they went in the way , a certain man said unto him , Lord , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , uwei u briew u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ngan bud ïa me kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: His fart smelled .
translation.kha: Ka ksem jong u ka sma .

translation.en: I will make thee a terror , and thou shalt be no more : though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa pha ka nuksa ba-itriem , bad kata kan long kaba kut jong pha . Ki briew ki lah ban wad ïa pha , hynrei kin ym lap ïa pha .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran : and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka pynbuh briew ïa u bad ka nong Ijipt .

translation.en: Therefore night shall be unto you , that ye shall not have a vision  ; and it shall be dark unto you , that ye shall not divine  ; and the sun shall go down over the prophets , and the day shall be dark over them .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki nongïathuhlypa , ka sngi jong phi ka la jan kut noh ; ka sngi ka la jan wai na ka bynta jong phi . Namar ba phi ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga , phin ym don shuh ki jingïohipaw ban ïathuhlypa , bad phin ym lah ban ïathuh lypa ei ei .

translation.en: And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil  ; and they shall hear Jezreel .
translation.kha: bad ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa u kew , bad ki sohwaiñ , bad ki soh Olib .

translation.en: A fire goeth before him , and burneth up his enemies round about .
translation.kha: Ka ding ka ïaid ha shuwa jong u bad ka thang ïa ki nongshun kiba don sawdong jong u .

translation.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land , even forty days , each day for a year , shall ye bear your iniquities , even forty years , and ye shall know my breach of promise .
translation.kha: Phin shah jynjar sawphew snem namar ka pop jong phi , kawei kawei ka snem na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi na kita ki sawphew sngi ba phi la pynlut ha kaba swar ïa ka ri . Te phin sa sngewthuh ka long kumno haba nga ïeng pyrshah ïa phi !

translation.en: I am the God of Beth–el , where thou anointedst the pillar , and where thou vowedst a vow unto me : now arise , get thee out from this land , and return unto the land of thy kindred .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me ha Bethel , ha kaba me la pynkyntang ïa u maw kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw da kaba me la theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u bad ha kaba me la smai ha nga . Mynta to khreh ban leit phai pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .’

translation.en: And spice , and oil for the light , and for the anointing oil , and for the sweet incense .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki musla bad ïa ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh , bad na ka bynta ka jingiwbih .

translation.en: And if the man like not to take his brother s wife , then let his brother s wife go up to the gate unto the elders , and say , My husband s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel , he will not perform the duty of my husband s brother .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u para jong uta uba la ïap um mon ban shongkurim ïa ka , ka dei ban leit ha khmat ki nongïalam shnong bad ban ong , ‘ U para kynsi jong nga um treh ban pynneh ïa ka kyrteng u hynmen jong u hapdeng ki Israel ; um mon ban pyndep ïa la ka kamram .’

translation.en: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout , they said , What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews ? And they understood that the ark of the  Lord  was come into the camp .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingrisa bad ki ong ,  Sngap ïa kata ka jingrisa baroh ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ! Ka mut aïu kata ?  Haba ki shem ba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka la poi ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ,

translation.en: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the  Lord  , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines : for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel .
translation.kha: U kpa bad ka kmie jong u kim tip ba kane baroh ka dei na U  Trai  , naba U  Trai  u wad ka lad ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki synshar ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And the first beast was like a lion , and the second beast like a calf , and the third beast had a face as a man , and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle .
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u don ka dur kum u sing ; uba ar u don ka dur kum u masi kyrtong ; uba lai u don ka durkhmat kum ka durkhmat u briew ; bad uba saw u don ka dur kum u pukni uba her .

translation.en: But Peter continued knocking : and when they had opened the door , and saw him , they were astonished .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Petros u ïai tied . Khatduh ki la plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la sngewlyngngoh .

translation.en: But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .
translation.kha: Kam mut ba nga dei ban da ïoh ïa ka jingphla jong u briew ; nga ong ïa kane ba khnang ba phin ïohlait im .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if ye diligently hearken unto me , saith the  Lord  , to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day , but hallow the sabbath day , to do no work therein  ;
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa kine ki briew ba ki dei ban kohnguh ïa baroh ki hukum jong nga . Kim dei ban kit kano kano ka jingkit shapoh lyngba ki khyrdop jong kane ka nongbah ha ka Sabbaton . Ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton kum ka sngi bakyntang bad kim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam .

translation.en: And they gave him audience unto this word , and then lifted up their voices , and said , Away with such a fellow from the earth : for it is not fit that he should live .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynshahshkor ïa u Paul haduh ba un da dep kren ; hynrei pynban ki la sdang ban kyang jam eh ,  Pynduh ïa u ! Pynïap ïa u ! Um long uba bit ban im !

translation.en: And when they were gone over , they came into the land of Gennesaret .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaleit sha shiliang ka duriaw bad ki la wan poi ha Gennesaret , ha kaba ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: Now I would not have you ignorant , brethren , that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you , (but was let hitherto ,) that I might have some fruit among you also , even as among other Gentiles .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kynmaw , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba bunsien nga la thmu ban wan jngoh ïa phi , hynrei don kaei kaei kaba la ju khang ïa nga borabor na kaba leh kumta . Nga kwah ban jop ïa ki mynsiem napdeng jong phi ruh , kumba nga la ju leh hapdeng kiwei ki Jentil .

translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( he saith to the sick of the palsy , )
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha uta u briew ba la ïapshiliang ,

translation.en: Then went he also to Ramah , and came to a great well that is in Sechu : and he asked and said , Where are Samuel and David ? And one said , Behold , they be at Naioth in Ramah .
translation.kha: Nangta da lade hi u leit sha Ramah . Ynda u la poi ha ka pukri kaba heh ha Seku , u kylli ha-ei u Samuel bad u Dabid ki don bad la ïathuh ha u ba ki don ha Naïoth .

translation.en: And Jacob went on his way , and the angels of God met him .
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u nang leit ha la ka lynti , katto katne ngut ki angel ki la wan ïashem ïa u .

translation.en: And he said unto them , The  Lord  is witness against you , and his anointed is witness this day , that ye have not found ought in my hand . And they answered , He is witness .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  bad u Syiem uba u la jied ki long ki sakhi mynta ka sngi ba phi la shem ba nga long uba lui lui .   Ho-oid , U  Trai  u long u sakhi jong ngi ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: He shall pray unto God , and he will be favourable unto him : and he shall see his face with joy : for he will render unto man his righteousness .
translation.kha: Haba u duwai , U Blei un jubab ïa u ; un mane ïa U Blei da kaba kmen ; U Blei un buh beit sa shisien pat ïa kiei kiei na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Now when the centurion , and they that were with him , watching Jesus , saw the earthquake , and those things that were done , they feared greatly , saying , Truly this was the Son of God .
translation.kha: Haba u rangbah shipai bad ki shipai kiba bad u , kiba la ïa-ap ïa U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa u jumai bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ong ,  Da shisha u la long U Khun U Blei !

translation.en: Let the proud be ashamed  ; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause : but I will meditate in thy precepts .
translation.kha: Ai ba kiba sarong kin lehrain , namar ki mudui lamler ïa nga ; hynrei ma nga , ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .

translation.en: And Abimelech called Isaac , and said , Behold , of a surety she is thy wife : and how saidst thou , She is my sister ? And Isaac said unto him , Because I said , Lest I die for her .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abimelekh u phah khot ïa u Isaak , bad u ong ,  Pleng , ka dei ka tnga jong me ! Balei pat me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me ?  U jubab ,  Namar nga pyrkhat ïoh ba nga shah pynïap lada nga ong ba ka dei ka tnga jong nga .

translation.en: And Elijah said unto him , Tarry , I pray thee , here  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jordan . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And they two went on .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  Mynta ap hangne ; U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha ka wah Jordan .  Hynrei u Elisha u jubab ,  Nga smai da ka jingshaniah skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi .  Kumta ki la leit ,

translation.en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait , ( for the people were distressed , ) then the people did hide themselves in caves , and in thickets , and in rocks , and in high places , and in pits .
translation.kha: Nangta ki pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Israel , da kaba buh ïa ki ha ka khim khait . Katto katne na ki Israel ki rieh ha ki krem bad ha ki thliew , lane hapdeng ki mawsiang lane ha ki thliew bad ki pukri um ;

translation.en: O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban don u ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong nga , kumba u briew u ïasaid na ka bynta u paralok jong u .

translation.en: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house . After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house .
translation.kha: U Benjamin bad u Hasshub ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ki ïing jong ki . U Asaraïah , u khun jong u Maaseïah bad u ksiew jong u Ananaïah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , because the midwives feared God , that he made them houses .
translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki nongpynkha khun ki sheptieng ïa U Blei , u ruh u pynmanbha ïa ki , bad u ai ha ki ba kin don la ki khun ki kti . Ki Israel ruh ki nang roi bad ki nang khlaiñ .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Depart , and go up hence , thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt , unto the land which I sware unto Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , saying , Unto thy seed will I give it :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Khie ïamihnoh nangne , ma me bad ki paidbah kiba me la ïalam na ka ri Ijipt , bad leit sha kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la kular ban ai ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .

translation.en: And God hath both raised up the Lord , and will also raise up us by his own power .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa U Trai na ka jingïap , bad un pynmihpat ruh ïa ngi da ka bor jong u .

translation.en: Finally , my brethren , be strong in the Lord , and in the power of his might .
translation.kha: Ha kaba pynkut noh , to long kiba khlaiñ ha U Trai bad ha ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong u .

translation.en: The man answered and said unto them , Why herein is a marvellous thing , that ye know not from whence he is , and yet he hath opened mine eyes .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  Kata te kaba da phylla ! Phim tip nangno u wan , hynrei u la pynkoit ïa nga na ka jingmatlah jong nga !

translation.en: I the  Lord  have said , I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation , that are gathered together against me : in this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die .
translation.kha: Nga smai ba ngan leh ïa kane ha phi u paidlang bymman uba la ïalumlang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Hangne ha ka ri khlaw uwei pa uwei na phi un ïap . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’

translation.en: Command Aaron and his sons , saying , This is the law of the burnt offering : It is the burnt offering , because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning , and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it .
translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingainguh thang . Ïa ka jingainguh thang dei ban ieh halor ka duwan baroh shi miet , bad hangta ka ding ruh ka dei ban ïai meh .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house , that ruled over all that he had , Put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh :
translation.kha: U ong ha u shakri jong u , uba la rangbah bha , uba peit halor baroh kiba u don ,  Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong nga bad pynlong ka jingsmai .

translation.en: So then because thou art lukewarm , and neither cold nor hot , I will spue thee out of my mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba pha long kaba blem blem , ka bym shit lymne khriat , ngan prie noh ïa pha na ka shyntur jong nga !

translation.en: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits : The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth  ; even the bottom shall be a cubit , and the breadth a cubit , and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span : and this shall be the higher place of the altar .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingthew jingwoh jong ka duwan , kiba long ha kajuh ka rukom kumba thew ïa ka Templ . Ha baroh sawdong ka trai jong ka duwan ka don ka nur kaba sanphew sentimitar ka jingjylliew bad sanphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad ka rmiang ha ka tduh kaba shabar kaba long arphew san sentimitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God .
translation.kha: U khunbynriew baroh u dei ban ïohi ïa ka jingpynim ka jong U Blei !’

translation.en: I saw in the night visions , and , behold , one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven , and came to the Ancient of days , and they brought him near before him .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet , nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum u briew . U la wan sha nga , ba la ker sawdong da u lyoh , bad u la leit sha uta uba la im junom bad la ai sngewbha ha u .

translation.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand , and wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen , in whose sight I brought them forth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah ïohi ïa nga ba nga ïalam ïa ki Israel shabar na ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And upon the first day of the week , when the disciples came together to break bread , Paul preached unto them , ready to depart on the morrow  ; and continued his speech until midnight .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka taïew ngi la ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingïabam miet . U Paul u la kren ha ki paidbah bad u la ïai kren haduh shiteng synñia , namar ba un sa mihnoh ha ka sngi kaba bud .

translation.en: God can hear even silent prayers said in our heart .
translation.kha: U Blei u lah ban ïohsngew wat ïa ki jingduwai ba jar jar hapoh ka dohnud jong ngi .

translation.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven : not as your fathers did eat manna , and are dead : he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever .
translation.kha: Une te , u long u kpu uba la wan hiar na bneng ; um long kum uta u kpu uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la bam , hynrei hadien ki la ïap . Uta uba bam ïa une u kpu un im junom .

translation.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day , removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle , and all the brown cattle among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats : and of such shall be my hire .
translation.kha: Shah ba ngan ïaid hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong phi mynta ka sngi bad ban shim ïa baroh ki khunlangbrot baïong bad ïa ki khunblang baroh kiba thohbria bad thohbroin . Kata kan long ka bainong kaba nga kwah .

translation.en: And , behold , two blind men sitting by the way side , when they heard that Jesus passed by , cried out , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
translation.kha: Bad ar ngut ki rangbah bamatlah kiba shong harud lynti ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u ïaid nangta , kumta ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !

translation.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards on the south side southward .
translation.kha: Thaw arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,

translation.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt , and bring out the children of Israel from among them .
translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  , haba nga rah ïa la ka kti pyrshah ïa ki bad ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , if I have found grace in thy sight , shew me now thy way , that I may know thee , that I may find grace in thy sight : and consider that this nation is thy people .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , nga kyrpad ïa me ba men ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingthmu jong me , khnang ba nga lah ban ïai shakri bad pynsngewbha ïa me . To da kynmaw ruh ba me la jied ïa kane ka jaitbynriew ba kan long u paidlang jong me .

translation.en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee , and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Jebusites , and the Girgashites , to give it , I say , to his seed , and hast performed thy words  ; for thou art righteous :
translation.kha: Me shem ba u ïaineh ha me , bad me pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad u . Me kular ban ai ha u ïa ka ri ki Kanaan , ka ri jong ki Hit bad ki Amor , ka ri ki Peris , ki Jebus bad ki Girgash , kan long ka ri ha kaba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin shong kin sah . Me bat ïa la ka kular , namar me long uba ïaineh .

translation.en: And he stayed yet other seven days  ; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark  ;
translation.kha: U la ap sa hynñiew sngi , bad u pyllait biang ïa kata ka paro .

translation.en: And when I come , whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters , them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la poi , ngan sa ai ïa ki shithi jingpynithuh sha kito kiba phi la mynjur , bad ban phah ïa ki ban leit rah ïa ka jingai jong phi sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do this thing that he hath spoken  ;
translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab ,  U  Trai  un ai ha me ka dak ban pynshisha ba un bat ïa la ka kular .

translation.en: Charity suffereth long , and is kind ; charity envieth not ; charity vaunteth not itself , is not puffed up ,
translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka ïaishah slem bad ka lehsbun ; kam ju pihuiñ lane kam ju kob sarong ;

translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold , to bear the table .
translation.kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah , even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah , and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth , and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite , and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite , they and their men .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ishmael u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah , u Seraïah u khun jong u Tanhumeth , ki khun shynrang jong u Ephai na Netophah , bad u Jesanaïah na Maakah ki la leit bad la ki rangbah sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah .

translation.en: And when the people were come into the camp , the elders of Israel said , Wherefore hath the  Lord  smitten us to day before the Philistines ? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of Shiloh unto us , that , when it cometh among us , it may save us out of the hand of our enemies .
translation.kha: Ynda ki shipai kiba lait im ki wan phai sha ka jaka shong dara , ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki ong ,  Balei keiñ U  Trai  u shah ba ki Philistia kin jop ïa ngi mynta ka sngi ? Ïa ngin ïaleit bad wanrah ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai  na Shiloh , ba kumta un leit lem bad ngi bad pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi .

translation.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart , and be no more stiffnecked .
translation.kha: Kumta , naduh mynta , kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , bad wat long shuh kiba mutlop .

translation.en: But I will lie with my fathers , and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt , and bury me in their buryingplace . And he said , I will do as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin tep ïa nga bad la ki kpa tymmen ; rah ïa nga na Ijipt , bad tep ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la tep ïa ki .  U Joseph u jubab ,  Ngan leh kumba phi ong .

translation.en: (For many walk , of whom I have told you often , and now tell you even weeping , that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ :
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane bunsien mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ïathuh biang ïa ka da ki jingjaw ummat ; don shibun kiba ka jingim jong ki , ka pynlong ïa ki , ki nongshun jong ka jingïap U Khrist ha ka diengphna .

translation.en: Thy graven images also will I cut off , and thy standing images out of the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw bad ki rishot maw bakyntang jong phi ; phin ym mane shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi hi phi la thaw .

translation.en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare , and into many foolish and hurtful lusts , which drown men in destruction and perdition .
translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba kwah ban riewspah ki hap ha ka jingpynshoi bad ki ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki jingkwah ba-bieit bad ki jingkwah ba-pynmynsaw , kiba tan ïa ki sha ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: Blessed are those servants , whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching : verily I say unto you , that he shall gird himself , and make them to sit down to meat , and will come forth and serve them .
translation.kha: A katno kiba kmen long kito ki shakri kiba u kynrad jong ki u shem ba ki dang peitmat bad kiba la kloi haba u wan ! Nga ong ha phi , ba un law ïa la ka jaiñkup , un ong ïa ki ban shong , bad un shakri ïa ki .

translation.en: Where thou diest , will I die , and there will I be buried : the  Lord  do so to me , and more also , if ought but death part thee and me .
translation.kha: Hangno hangno ba phi ïap , hangta ngan ïap , bad dei hangta ba yn tep ïa nga . Ai ba ka jingpynshitom bashyrkhei eh jong U  Trai  kan wan hap halor jong nga lada nga shah ïa kaei kaei lait noh ka jingïap hi ka ban pynïakhlad ïa nga na phi !

translation.en: Because the sons of Jehonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father , which he commanded them  ; but this people hath not hearkened unto me :
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u kpa tymmen jong ki u la ai ha ki , hynrei ma phi phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them , and that I may consume them : and I will make of thee a great nation .
translation.kha: Mynta , wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa nga . Nga bitar ïa ki , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

translation.en: And as for thee , if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked , and do according to all that I have commanded thee , and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments  ;
translation.kha: Lada me shakri hok ïa nga kumba leh u Dabid u kpa jong me , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum ïa me ,

translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it  ; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel s , the same shall save it .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno u ban duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Gospel un pynim ïa ka .

translation.en: Go thee one way or other , either on the right hand , or on the left , whithersoever thy face is set .
translation.kha: Ot na sha kamon bad na sha kadiang , pha ka waitlam banep ! Ot na sha kano kano ka phang ba pha phai .

translation.en: And he said unto me , These sayings are faithful and true : and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga ,  Kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah . Bad U Trai uba U Blei , uba ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha ki nongïathuhlypa , u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen .

translation.en: And he said , Take them alive . And they took them alive , and slew them at the pit of the shearing house , even two and forty men  ; neither left he any of them .
translation.kha: U Jehu u la hukum ïa la ki briew ,  Kem im ïa ki .  Ki la kem ïa ki , bad u pynïap ïa ki hajan kawei ka thliew hangta . Baroh ki ïadon sawphew ar ngut , bad ym shym la pyllait im ïa uwei ruh na ki .

translation.en: And he charged him to tell no man :  but go , and shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing , according as Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano , hynrei khie leit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai un peit bniah ïa me ; nangta un pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la koit . To ai ïa ka jingkñia kumba U Moses u la hukum .

translation.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief .
translation.kha: Namar ba kim don ka jingngeit , um shym la leh shibun ki kambah hangta .

translation.en: Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .
translation.kha: To wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phi , ko ki khun jong nga ! Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei , u long uba hok , kumba U Khrist u long uba hok .

translation.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips  ; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .
translation.kha: Nga leh borabor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u hukum ; nga bud ïa ka mon jong u , ym ïa ki jingkwah jong nga hi .

translation.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .
translation.kha: Ki briew basniew ki ngat ha la ki jong ki pop , katba ki briew bahok ki kmen bad ki laitluid .

translation.en: And number thee an army , like the army that thou hast lost , horse for horse , and chariot for chariot : and we will fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they . And he hearkened unto their voice , and did so .
translation.kha: Nangta sa khot bad buh da ka kynhun shipai kaba ka jingbun paid ka long kat kato kaba la phai dien noh na phi , buh katjuh ka jingbun ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ngin ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ki jaka madan , bad ha kane ka sien ngin jop ïa ki .  U syiem Benhadad u la mynjur bad bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel , which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them ?
translation.kha: Dei ma me uta uba nga kren la slem bah , haba nga pynbna lyngba ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa ka Israel , ba ha ki sngi ki ban wan ngan sa wallam ïa uno uno ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great , and he shall divide the spoil with the strong  ; because he hath poured out his soul unto death : and he was numbered with the transgressors  ; and he bare the sin of many , and made intercession for the transgressors .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ai ha u ïa ka burom , ka jaka hapdeng kiba khraw bad kiba donbor . U la aiti mon sngewbha ïa la ka jingim bad u la shim bynta lem bad ki riewbymman . U la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki nongpop kiba bun bad u la duwai ba ki kin ïoh ïa ka Jingmap-ei .

translation.en: I beheld , and , lo , there was no man , and all the birds of the heavens were fled .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba ym don briew ; wat ki sim ki la lah her noh .

translation.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully , that , when ye see him again , ye may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .
translation.kha: Nga phah ia u kumta da jingpeitbha , khnang , ynda phi iohi biang ia u ,  phin shadkmen , bad ka jingsngewsih jong nga kan jah noh .

translation.en: If I wash myself with snow water , and make my hands never so clean  ;
translation.kha: Ym don sabon kaba lah ban sait ïa ki pop jong nga .

translation.en: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary , unto the inner court , to minister in the sanctuary , he shall offer his sin offering , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la long khuid biang , u dei ban ap hynñiew sngi bad nangta un leit sha ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh jong ka Templ bad ai ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid ïa u , khnang ba un lah ban shakri biang ha ka Templ . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: Wherefore then do ye harden your hearts , as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts ? when he had wrought wonderfully among them , did they not let the people go , and they departed ?
translation.kha: Balei phin pyneh ïa la ki dohnud kumba leh u Pharaoh bad ki nong Ijipt ? Wat klet kumno U Blei u la pynlong ki bieit ïa ki haduh ba kin da shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na Ijipt .

translation.en: And he said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me .
translation.kha: U Gideon u jubab ,  Lada me sngewbha ïa nga , ai ha nga katto katne ka jingpynshisha ba me dei da shisha U  Trai .

translation.en: So Joshua rose up early in the morning , and brought Israel by their tribes  ; and the tribe of Judah was taken :
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Joshua u wan ïalam ïa ki Israel sha khmat , shi jait shi jait , bad la kdew ïa ka jait Judah .

translation.en: She riseth also while it is yet night , and giveth meat to her household , and a portion to her maidens .
translation.kha: Ka khie dang step phyrngab bad ka pynkhreh jingbam ïa kiba ha ka ïing jong ka , bad ban ong ïa la ki shakri kynthei ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban leh .

translation.en: So Jotham became mighty , because he prepared his ways before the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Jotham u la nang khlaiñbor , namar u kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .

translation.en: And he brought them before the king of Moab : and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie ha u syiem Moab , bad ki la sah hangta katba u Dabid u dang rieh ha ka krem .

translation.en: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts , glory not , and lie not against the truth .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada hapoh ka dohnud jong phi , phi don ka jingpihuiñ , bad khwan myntoi , to wat leh pop pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha da kaba kren sarong ïa la ka jingstad .

translation.en: Thou shalt not avenge , nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people , but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat pynhiarkput ïano ïano lane ban ïai isih ïa u , hynrei ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .
translation.kha: Don uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap , ‘ Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti na ka bynta U Trai ; Pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta jong u ban ïaid !’

translation.en: And I will give unto thee , and to thy seed after thee , the land wherein thou art a stranger , all the land of Canaan , for an everlasting possession  ; and I will be their God .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me , ïa kane ka ri ha kaba mynta me long u nongwei . Ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei kan long ka jingïohkynti junom jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me ; bad nga ngan long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time :
translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade , namarkata , hapoh ka kti badonbor U Blei , khnang ba un ïoh kyntiew ïa phi shajrong ha ka por kaba biang jong u hi .

translation.en: Would you say . . .
translation.kha: Hato phin ong . . .

translation.en: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse , and said , Send me David thy son , which is with the sheep .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Jesse ban ong ,  Phah ïa u khun jong me u Dabid , uto uba sharai ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel s hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins  ; and his meat was locusts and wild honey .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaiñ jong U Ïoannis la shna da u shñiuh jong ka ut ; u la panpoh da u panpoh snieh ha ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .

translation.en: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col–hozeh , the ruler of part of Mizpah  ; he built it , and covered it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king s garden , and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David .
translation.kha: U Shallum , u khun jong u Kolhoseh , u nongsynshar ïa ka Mispah distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Umpohliew . U siang ïa ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khyrdop , u pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop . Ha ka Pungsum Shelah , u tei ïa ka khyrdop markhap ïa ka kper syiem , haduh ki mawjam kiba hiar sha ka Nongbah u Dabid .

translation.en: But grow in grace , and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ . To him be glory both now and for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Hynrei to phin nang roi ha ka jingaiei bad ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi . Ha u , to long ka burom , mynta bad shaduh bymjukut ! Amen .

translation.en: For Christ sent me not to baptize , but to preach the gospel : not with wisdom of words , lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect .
translation.kha: U Khrist um shym la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis . U la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad ban ïathuh ïa ka khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka ktien ha ka jingstad briew , khnang ban pynthikna ba ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna kan ym pynduh noh ïa ka bor jong ka .

translation.en: And it shall be , that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire , he and all that he hath : because he hath transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel .
translation.kha: Ïa uta uba la shah kdew bad ha uba la lap ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba la mana yn thang ha ka ding , lem bad ïa ka longïing jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , naba u wanrah ïa ka jinglehrain bashyrkhei ïa ki Israel bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks , that , behold , every man s bundle of money was in his sack : and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money , they were afraid .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang pynthylli ïa la ki byrni , uwei pa uwei u lap ïa la ka pla pisa ha ka byrni jong u ; bad haba ki la ïohi ïa ka pisa , ma ki bad u kpa jong ki u Jakob ki la ïasheptieng .

translation.en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude , the Jews putting him forward . And Alexander beckoned with the hand , and would have made his defence unto the people .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki paidbah ki la pynskhem ba u Aleksandar u kitkhlieh , namar ba ki Jiw ki la pynlong ïa u ban leit sha khmat . Te u Aleksandar u la ai dak da la ka kti ba ki paidbah kin sngap jar , bad u la pyrshang ban kren ïasaid da .

translation.en: And , behold , here cometh a chariot of men , with a couple of horsemen . And he answered and said , Babylon is fallen , is fallen  ; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground .
translation.kha: Kynsan , hangne ki wan ! Ki rangbah halor jong ki kulai , shi jur shi jur . U nongap phira u ai ka khubor ,  Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! Baroh ki bleithaw kiba ki la mane ki la kyllon ha ka jingpait jingpra ha madan .

translation.en: Then she spake , saying , They were wont to speak in old time , saying , They shall surely ask counsel at Abel : and so they ended the matter .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Mynhyndai ki ju ong , ‘ Khie leit wad jubab na ka nongbah Abel’ — bad kata ka dei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel : speak unto them , saying , At even ye shall eat flesh , and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong ki Israel . Ïathuh ïa ki ba ynda la kem ïongreiñ kin sa ïoh ka doh ban bam , bad ha ka por mynstep kin sa ïoh u kpu uba ki kwah . Te kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  nga long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And they shall fight against thee  ; but they shall not prevail against thee  ; for I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to deliver thee .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko Jeremaïah ! Uwei pa uwei ha kane ka ri — ki syiem ka Judah , ki rangbah synshar , ki lyngdoh , bad ki briew — kin long pyrshah ïa me . Hynrei ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka jingkhlaiñ ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki ; men long kum ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , u rishot nar , bad ka kynroh rnong . Kin ym lah ban jop ïa me , naba ngan don lem bad me ban ïada ïa me . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: And the navy also of Hiram , that brought gold from Ophir , brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees , and precious stones .
translation.kha: ( Ka kynhun lieng jong u Hiram , kaba la wan kit ksiar na Ophir , ka la wan kit ruh nangta shibun ki dieng Kseh-Juniper bad ki mawlynnai .

translation.en: As soon then as he had said unto them ,  I am he ,  they went backward , and fell to the ground .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Dei ma nga uta ,  ki la kynriah shadien bad ki la kyllon ha madan .

translation.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Seraiah was the scribe  ;
translation.kha: u Sadok , u khun jong u Ahitub bad u Ahimelekh , u khun jong u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; u Seraïah u long u sekretari ka ïingbishar ;

translation.en: Let both grow together until the harvest : and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers , Gather ye together first the tares , and bind them in bundles to burn them : but gather the wheat into my barn .
translation.kha: Ai ba u kew bad ki ñiut kin ïasan lang tad haduh ka aïom ot . Nangta ngan ong ha ki nongot ban rat nyngkong ïa ki ñiut , ban tehsong ïa ki bad ban thang ïa ki , bad nangta ban lumlang shapoh ïa u kew bad buh ïa u ha ka thiar jong nga .’

translation.en: But he answered and said unto him that told him ,  Who is my mother ? and who are my brethren ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka kmie jong nga , bad kiei ki para shynrang jong nga ?

translation.en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city , they smote the city with the edge of the sword  ; but they let go the man and all his family .
translation.kha: Kumta u la pyn-i ïa ki , bad ki paid Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hapoh ka nongbah , lait tang une u briew bad ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And he rode upon a cherub , and did fly : and he was seen upon the wings of the wind .
translation.kha: U her stet halor ki Kherub u ïaid halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .

translation.en: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth .
translation.kha: U Ananias , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u la hukum ïa kita kiba ïeng hajan jong u Paul ban thab ïa u na ka shyntur .

translation.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of  ; and Abraham built an altar there , and laid the wood in order , and bound Isaac his son , and laid him on the altar upon the wood .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha kata ka jaka kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha u , u Abraham u tei ïa ka duwan bad u pynbeit ïa kita ki dieng halor jong ka . U la khum ïa la u khun bad pynthiah ïa u halor ka duwan , hajrong kita ki dieng .

translation.en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations , and their countries ,
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi tip , A  Trai  , ba ki patsha ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , bad pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki , ki bym don briew ,

translation.en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon : but they came with one accord to him , and , having made Blastus the king s chamberlain their friend , desired peace  ; because their country was nourished by the king s country .
translation.kha: U Herod u bitar shikatdei eh ïa briew jong ka Tyros bad Sidon , kumta ki la leit shi kynhun ban ïakynduh ïa u . Nyngkong ki la pynngeit ïa u Blastos , u briew uba dei khmih ïa ka ïingsyiem , ba u dei ban ïarap ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit sha u Herod bad pan ban ïasuk bad u , namar ka ri ka jong ki ka ïoh ïa ki jingbam na ka ri ka jong u syiem .

translation.en: Then both the men , between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the  Lord  , before the priests and the judges , which shall be in those days  ;
translation.kha: baroh arliang ki dei ban leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba yn bishar ïa ki da ki lyngdoh bad ki nongbishar kiba treikam ha kata ka por .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: Your riches are corrupted , and your garments are motheaten .
translation.kha: Ka spah jong phi ka la pyut noh , bad ki jaiñ jong phi ki la bam kruiñ .

translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when I chose Israel , and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob , and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt , when I lifted up mine hand unto them , saying , I am the  Lord  your God  ;
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Mynba nga la jied ïa ka Israel , nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ki . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha Ijipt bad ong ïa ki : Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Yea , and we are found false witnesses of God ; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ : whom he raised not up , if so be that the dead rise not .
translation.kha: Kaba kham palat ïa kata ka long ba ïa ngi la pynpaw ba ngi shu lamler shaphang U Blei , namar ba ngi la ong ba u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap — hynrei lada ka long kaba shisha ba ïa kiba ïap ym shym la pynmihpat , te um shym la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: Train up a child in the way he should go : and when he is old , he will not depart from it .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa u khynnah kumno u dei ban im , bad un kynmaw ïa ka baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers , Whose damsel is this ?
translation.kha: U Boas u kylli ïa u briew uba pynïaidkam ,  Katai ka theisamla ka dei mano ?

translation.en: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised  ; for to build the house of the  Lord  , and his own house , and Millo , and the wall of Jerusalem , and Hazor , and Megiddo , and Gezer .
translation.kha: U Syiem Solomon u la pyndonkam da ka jingpyntrei jubor ban tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , ban pyndap khyndew ïa ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka nongbah , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U la pyndonkam ruh ïa ka , na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ki nongbah Hasor , Megiddo bad Geser .

translation.en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty , If I be a man of God , then let fire come down from heaven , and consume thee and thy fifty . And there came down fire from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty .
translation.kha: Lada nga dei u briew jong U Blei ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  ai ba ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad pynïap ïa me bad ïa ki rangbah jong me !  Hangta hi ka ding ka la wan hiar bad ka la pynïap ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ïa ki rangbah jong u .

translation.en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do  ; for evil is determined against our master , and against all his household : for he is such a son of Belial , that a man cannot speak to him .
translation.kha: Sngewbha da pyrkhat shaphang kane bad sa rai ïa kaei ban leh . Kane ka lah ban long kaba shyrkhei ïa u kynrad jong ngi bad ïa ka longïing jong u baroh . U long uba sniew jinglong ba un ym sngap ïano ïano ruh !

translation.en: And say ye , Save us , O God of our salvation , and gather us together , and deliver us from the heathen , that we may give thanks to thy holy name , and glory in thy praise .
translation.kha: To ong ha u ,  Pynim ïa ngi , A Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ; lumlang ïa ngi baroh ; pyllait ïa ngi na ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba ngin sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .

translation.en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this  ; yea , also from this withdraw not thine hand : for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all .
translation.kha: Kiar ïa baroh ar tylli ki tduh . Lada phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei , la kumno kumno phin long kiba jop .

translation.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest , that is passed into the heavens , Jesus the Son of God , let us hold fast our profession .
translation.kha: Te , to ngin batskhem ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba ngi phla . Naba ngi don U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba khraw uba la leit haduh ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei — U Jisu , U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew , ki ban kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma u !’ bad kin shukor ïa kiba bun ki briew .

translation.en: If I must needs glory , I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities .
translation.kha: Lada nga dei ban sngewsarong , ngan sngewsarong shaphang kiei kiei kiba pyn-i haduh katno nga long uba tlot .

translation.en: The light of the body is the eye : if therefore thine eye be single , thy whole body shall be full of light .
translation.kha: Ki khmat ki long kum ka sharak ïa ka met . Lada ki khmat jong phi ki bha , ka met jong phi baroh kawei kan dap da ka jingshai ;

translation.en: And laid it in his own new tomb , which he had hewn out in the rock : and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre , and departed .
translation.kha: bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u hi , ïa kaba u dang phah tih shen na u mawsiang . Nangta u la pyntyllun ïa u maw uba heh na khmat ka jaka rung sha ka jingtep bad u la leit noh .

translation.en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity : the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ar , u nongïathuhlypa bad uta uba kylli na u , kin ïoh ïa kajuh ka jingshah pynshitom .

translation.en: I prayed therefore unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .
translation.kha: Bad nga la duwai , ‘ A  Trai  Nongsynshar , wat pynjot ïa la ki briew , ki briew kiba me la pyllait bad ïalam na Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka borbah jong me .

translation.en: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead , that they might be judged according to men in the flesh , but live according to God in the spirit .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ruh ha kiba ïap , ha kito ïa kiba la bishar katba kum ka jingim ha ka doh kumba ïa uwei pa uwei la bishar ; la ïalap ha ki khnang ba ha jingim ba kynja mynsiem kin ïoh im kumba U Blei u im .

translation.en: And Joseph took them both , Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel s left hand , and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel s right hand , and brought them near unto him .
translation.kha: U Joseph u buh ïa u Ephraim ha ka liang kadiang jong u Jakob bad ïa u Manasseh ha ka liang kamon jong u .

translation.en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years .
translation.kha: U la long syiem sawphew snem ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: And Ruth the Moabitess said , He said unto me also , Thou shalt keep fast by my young men , until they have ended all my harvest .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Ruth ka ong ,  Kaba kor tam na baroh , u ong ba ngan ïai tam kew bad ki nongtrei jong u haduh ba kin da pyndep ïa ka jingot .

translation.en: And the chief priests took the silver pieces , and said , It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury , because it is the price of blood .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la khar ïa ki sbai rupa bad ki la ong ,  Kane ka dei ka pisa babit snam , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban buh ïa ka hapoh ka jingkynshew ka Templ .

translation.en: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath , from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering  ; seven sabbaths shall be complete :
translation.kha: Kheiñ hynñiew taïew naduh kata ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton ha kaba phi wallam ïa ka song kew ban ainguh sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And they will salute thee , and give thee two loaves of bread  ; which thou shalt receive of their hands .
translation.kha: Kin khublei ïa me bad tyrwa ïa me ar tylli ki kpu , ïa kiba me dei ban pdiang .

translation.en: It hath pleased them verily ; and their debtors they are . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingïakut ka la long ka jong ki hi ; hynrei ha ka jingshisha , ki la don ïa ka jingsngew kit ram ban ïarap ïa ki . Namar ki Jiw ki la ïasam bynta lem ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem jong ki bad ki Jentil , ki Jentil ki dei ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba ki don ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw .

translation.en: But when his brethren were gone up , then went he also up unto the feast , not openly , but as it were in secret .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki para shynrang jong u ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam , U Jisu ruh u la leit ; pynban , um shym la leit ha kaba paw , hynrei ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael , which shall devour the palaces of Ben–hadad .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ka ïingsyiem ba la tei da u syiem Hasael , bad ngan thang duh ïa ki kut jong u syiem Benhadad .

translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Zidon  ; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee : and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall have executed judgments in her , and shall be sanctified in her .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki briew hangta ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong shaphang jong ki : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko Sidon ; ki briew kin ïaroh ïa nga namar kaei kaba nga leh ïa pha . Kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai  , haba nga pyn-i katno uba khuid nga long da kaba pynshitom ïa kito kiba im hapdeng jong pha .

translation.en: Furthermore the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , and sware that I should not go over Jordan , and that I should not go in unto that good land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance :
translation.kha: Dei namar jong phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la bitar ïa nga bad u la kren da kaba shai ba ngan ym ïoh jam ïa ka wah Jordan ban leit sha kata ka ri kaba seisoh kaba u ai kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi .

translation.en: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar : and he was driven from men , and did eat grass as oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven , till his hairs were grown like eagles  feathers , and his nails like birds  claws .
translation.kha: Ki kyntien ki wan urlong shisha mar kumta hi . Ïa u Nebukhadnessar la beh noh na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad u la bam phlang kum u masi dab . Ka umjer ka la hap halor ka met jong u , bad u shñiuh jong u , u la san jrong kum ki sner jong ki pukni bad ki tyrsim jong u ki jrong kum ki tnaw jong ki sim .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Have I been so long time with you , and yet hast thou not known me , Philip ? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father  ; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Naba la slem nga la don bad phi baroh ; pynban mem ithuh ïa nga , ko Philip ? Uno uno uba la ïohi ïa nga u la ïohi ïa U Kpa . Balei , te , me ong , ‘ To pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ?’

translation.en: Behold , the days come , that I will cut off thine arm , and the arm of thy father s house , that there shall not be an old man in thine house .
translation.kha: Ha sngap , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynïap lut ïa ki samla shynrang baroh kiba na ka longïing jong me bad na ka kur jong me , kumta ba yn ym don uwei ruh u briew u ban im tymmen ha ka ïing jong me .

translation.en: And a voice came out of the throne , saying , Praise our God , all ye his servants , and ye that fear him , both small and great .
translation.kha: Nangta , ka jingsawa jong ka sur ka la wan na ka khet , ka da ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi , phi baroh ki shakri bad ki briew jong u , kiba rit bad kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba ñiewburom ïa u !

translation.en: And say , What is thy mother ? A lioness : she lay down among lions , she nourished her whelps among young lions .
translation.kha: A katno kmie jong phi ka la long kum ka sing ! Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa ki khun jong ka hapdeng ki sing shynrang kiba ishyrkhei .

translation.en: And they shall build houses , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and eat the fruit of them .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin tei ïa ki ïing ki sem bad kin shong hi ha ki — yn ym pyndonkam ïa ki da kiwei pat . Kin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad leh sngewbha ha ka waiñ — yn ym dih ïa ka da kiwei pat .

translation.en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth , and warmeth them in dust ,
translation.kha: Ka Ostrit ka iehnoh ïa la ki pylleng ha madan ba ka jingshit hapoh ka khyndew kan pynsyaid ïa ki .

translation.en: And at the king s commandment they made a chest , and set it without at the gate of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem u hukum ïa ki Lebi ban shna ka synduk na ka bynta ki jingnoh synñiang bad ban buh ïa ka ha ka khyrdop ka Templ .

translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  preserve knowledge , and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khmih ba ïa ka jingshisha la ri kyndong da kaba pynpulom ïa ki ktien jong ki nonglamler .

translation.en: How Do Bible Principles Benefit Us ?
translation.kha: Kumno ki Aiñ jong U Blei ki ai Jingmyntoi ïa ngi ?

translation.en: Then they shall answer , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  their God , and worshipped other gods , and served them .
translation.kha: Te kin jubab ba ka long namar ba phi la lyndet ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U Blei jong phi , bad phi la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: So the king of the north shall come , and cast up a mount , and take the most fenced cities : and the arms of the south shall not withstand , neither his chosen people , neither shall there be any strength to withstand .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem ka Syria un kerkut ïa ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad kurup ïa ka . Ki shipai jong ka Ijipt kin ym ïaleh shuh ; wat kiba tbit tam na ki kin ym don ka jingkhlaiñ kaba biang .

translation.en: But if all prophesy , and there come in one that believeth not , or one unlearned , he is convinced of all , he is judged of all :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uwei pa uwei u pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei haba u bymngeit ne u riewpaidbah u rung hapoh , un ïoh jingkynduh ïa la ki pop da kaei kaba u ïohsngew .

translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you , which also ye have received , and wherein ye stand ;
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga kwah ban pynkynmaw ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa ka Khubor Babha kaba nga la ïalap ha phi , ïa kaba phi la pdiang , bad ha kaba ka jingngeit jong phi ka ïeng skhem .

translation.en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the  Lord  for ever :
translation.kha: U Ammon lane u Moab — lane uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba shiphew pateng bynriew — ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .

translation.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah , which he hath , which is in the end of his field  ; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you .
translation.kha: Ong ïa u ban die ha nga katba ka shongdor haba phi dang ïadon ryngkat , ba ngan ïohkynti ïa ka kum ka jaka tep .

translation.en: Forbearing one another , and forgiving one another , if any man have a quarrel against any : even as Christ forgave you , so also do ye .
translation.kha: To ïaishah iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat ha man ba uno uno na phi u don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa uno uno uwei pat . Phi dei ban ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat kumba U Trai u la map ïa phi .

translation.en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver , and the ornament of thy molten images of gold : thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth  ; thou shalt say unto it , Get thee hence .
translation.kha: Phin shim ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ba la sop da ka rupa bad ïa ki blei jong phi ba la tap da ka ksiar , bad phin bret noh ïa ki kum ïa ka jakhlia , bad phin pyrta ,  Wat don shuh ha khmat jong nga !

translation.en: They shall perish  ; but thou remainest  ; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment  ;
translation.kha: Kita kin jah noh , hynrei me men ïaisah ; baroh kin sa jot noh kum ki jaiñ .

translation.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country : there shalt thou die , and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord s house .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa me kum ïa ka bol bad un kynting sha ka ri kaba kham khraw . Men ïap hangta hajan ki kali ïapom kiba me , me la sngewsarong . Me long ka jingjahburom ïa ka longïing jong u kynrad jong me .

translation.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens , and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work .
translation.kha: U la pynbeit hynñiewphew hajar ngut na ki ban kit ïa ki tiar ki tar bad phraphew hajar ngut ban shtah maw ha ki jaka lum , bad u la thung lai hajar hynriewspah ngut ki nongpynïaidkam ki ban pynthikna ba yn pyndep ïa ka kam .

translation.en: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane , and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin hikai ïa ki briew jong nga ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba khuid bad ka bymkhuid , bad hapdeng kaei kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad kaei ka bym long kumta .

translation.en: As for these things which ye behold , the days will come , in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Kane baroh kaba phi ïohi — ka por kan poi ha kaba yn ym iehnoh hangne ïa uwei ruh u maw ha ka jaka ba u don ; ïa uwei uwei baroh yn bret sha tbian .

translation.en: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite , and Jadon the Meronothite , the men of Gibeon , and of Mizpah , unto the throne of the governor on this side the river .
translation.kha: U Melataïah na Gibeon , u Jadon na Meronoth , bad ki rangbah ka Gibeon bad Mispah , ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka jaka sah jong u lat ka Ïuphratis kaba shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him : whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David .
translation.kha: Mar kumta , u Saul u rah ïa la u sum sha u Jonathan ban pynïap ïa u , bad u Jonathan u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u la da kut jingmut shisha ban pynïap ïa u Dabid .

translation.en: And he looked on the Kenites , and took up his parable , and said , Strong is thy dwellingplace , and thou puttest thy nest in a rock .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u ïohi ïa ki Ken , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka jaka kaba phi shong ka long kaba skhem , Kaba shngain kum ka skum ba la shna shajrong halor ka synrang ;

translation.en: Which knew me from the beginning , if they would testify , that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee .
translation.kha: Ki la tip borabor , lada ki mon ban phla , ba naduh kaba nyngkong nga la im kum u dkhot jong ka seng kaba pyrkhing tam jong ka niam jong ngi , ki Pharisi .

translation.en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles , carried away unto these dumb idols , even as ye were led .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba mynba phi dang long kiba mane bleithaw , la ïalam sakma ïa phi ha ki rukom kiba bun sha ki jingmane ïa ki bleithaw ki bym don jingim .

translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel  ; and they fled every man to their tents .
translation.kha: Ki shipai u Amasaïah ki shahjop , bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki phet krad sha la ki ïing .

translation.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him , whether he would heal on the sabbath day  ; that they might find an accusation against him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la kwah daw ban mudui ïa U Jisu ba u leh bakla , kumta ki la ïakhmih bniah ïa u ban ïohi lada un pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and she called his name Onan .
translation.kha: Ka punkhun biang bad ka la kha ïa uwei pat u khun shynrang , la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Onan .

translation.en: When I would have healed Israel , then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered , and the wickedness of Samaria : for they commit falsehood  ; and the thief cometh in , and the troop of robbers spoileth without .
translation.kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba nga kwah ban pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad pynlong ïa ki ban manbha sa shisien pat , baroh kaba nga lah ban ïohi ka long ka jingbymman jong ki bad ka kam sniew kaba ki leh . Ki shukor uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki rung jubor ha ki ïing bad ki tuh ; ki lute ïa ki briew ha ki lynti bah .

translation.en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God , and from his power  ; and no man was able to enter into the temple , till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled .
