translation.kha: Ïa ka templ la pyndap da ka tdem na ka burom bad ka bor jong U Blei , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit shapoh ka templ tad haduh ba ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ba la wanrah da ki hynñiew ngut ki angel , ki la poi sha kaba kut .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of the house : and David played with his hand , as at other times : and there was a javelin in Saul s hand .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u mynsiem bymman na U Blei kynsan kynsan u ïoh tylli ïa u Saul , bad u pynkulmar ha ïing la kum uba lamwir . U Dabid u dang tem ïa ka duitara , kumba u ju leh man ka sngi , bad u Saul u bat ïa la u sum .

translation.en: For the  Lord  will not cast off his people , neither will he forsake his inheritance .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ym iehnoh ïa la ki briew ; bad un ym iehnoh ïa kito kiba long ki jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel , that they looked toward the wilderness , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the cloud .
translation.kha: Katba u Aaron u dang kren ha ka kynhun baroh kawei , ki phai shaphang ka ri shyiap , bad kynsan ka jingshai baphyrnai jong U  Trai  ka la paw ha u lyoh .

translation.en: From Jordan eastward , all the land of Gilead , the Gadites , and the Reubenites , and the Manassites , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , even Gilead and Bashan .
translation.kha: shaduh shaphang shathie sha ka shnong Aroer kaba harud ka wah Arnon — kane ka kynthup ïa ki thain jong ka Gilead bad ka Bashan , ha kaba ki jait Gad , Reuben , bad ki Manasseh kiba shaphang mihngi ki shong ki sah .

translation.en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily , therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil .
translation.kha: Balei ki briew ki stet haduh katta katta ban leh ïa ki kam sniew ? Namar ïa ka kam sniew ym ju kham pynshitom kloi .

translation.en: He shall see of the travail of his soul , and shall be satisfied : by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many  ; for he shall bear their iniquities .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingim ba la shahshitom , un ïoh pat ïa ka jingkmen ; un tip ba um shym la shahshitom lehnoh-ei . U shakri ba la aiti lut jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha , un shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong kiba bun bad na ka bynta jong u ngan map ïa ki .

translation.en: Through faith he kept the passover , and the sprinkling of blood , lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u ban pynskhem ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad hukum ban synreit ïa ka snam ha ki jingkhang , ba u Angel jong ka Jingïap un ym pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And David said unto Abiathar , I knew it that day , when Doeg the Edomite was there , that he would surely tell Saul : I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father s house .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Haba nga ïohi ïa u Doeg hangta ha kato ka sngi , nga la tip skhem ba un sa ïathuh ha u Saul . Kumta nga kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi baroh .

translation.en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts , and they shall bereave thee  ; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee  ; and I will bring the sword upon thee . I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan bad ki mradkhlaw ba kin pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha , bad ngan phah ïa ka jingpang , ka jingleh thombor , bad ka thma ban pynïap ïa pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches , and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches :
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ka jingkhaïi bastad bad me ïai pynïohnong . Katno uba sarong me long ïa ka spah jong me !

translation.en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me , and I have nothing to set before him ?
translation.kha: U paralok jong nga uba don ha ka jingleit u la dang shu wan poi ha ka ïing jong nga , bad ngam shym don jingbam ei ei na ka bynta jong u !’

translation.en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country , and of the south of Judah , and had taken Beth–shemesh , and Aijalon , and Gederoth , and Soco with the villages thereof , and Timnah with the villages thereof , Gimzo also and the villages thereof : and they dwelt there .
translation.kha: Ha kane kajuh ka por ki Philistia ruh ki hiarthma ïa ki shnong kiba ha ki kjat lum kiba shaphang sepngi bad ïa ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ki la ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shemesh , ka Aijalon , bad ïa ka Gederoth , bad ruh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Soko , ka Timnah , bad ka Gimso lem bad ki nongrit jong ki , bad ki shongduh hangta .

translation.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats  ; and the rocks for the conies .
translation.kha: Ki blang khlaw ki im ha ki lumbah bajrong , bad ki phyllad ki rieh ha ki synrang maw .

translation.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan sa pynjot ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka pyrthei ,

translation.en: But the men would not hearken to him : so the man took his concubine , and brought her forth unto them  ; and they knew her , and abused her all the night until the morning : and when the day began to spring , they let her go .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita ki briew kim shahshkor satia ïa u . Kumta u Lebi u shim ïa la ka tnga kliar bad u buh ïa ka shabar bad ki . Ki pynjahburom da kaba leh sang ïa ka baroh shi miet bad ki khlem sangeh haduh mynstep .

translation.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in unto this evil place ? it is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates  ; neither is there any water to drink .
translation.kha: Balei ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt sha ka jaka kaba sniew kum kane ha kaba u jingthung ei ei ruh um mih ? Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba u kew ruh um long , u soh Dumbur ruh um long , u sohwaiñ ruh um long , bad u soh Pomkranet ruh um long . Wat ka umdih ruh kam don !

translation.en: For if by one man s offence death reigned by one ; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one , Jesus Christ .)
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingshisha ba lyngba ka pop jong uwei u briew , ka jingïap ka la sdang ban synshar , namar jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei katno kaba kham khraw ka long ka jingmih jong kaei kaba la leh da uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist ! Baroh kiba ïohpdiang ïa jingaiei bakyrhai U Blei bad ba la pynïasuk bad u kin synshar ha ka jingim lyngba U Khrist .

translation.en: And the king said unto his servants , Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel ?
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Phim ïasngewthuh ba ha kane ka sngi uwei u nongïalam bakhraw ha Israel u la ïap ?

translation.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him , Will ye plead for Baal ? will ye save him ? he that will plead for him , let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning : if he be a god , let him plead for himself , because one hath cast down his altar .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joash u ong ha kito baroh kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u ,  Hato phi ïeng na ka bynta u Baal ? Hato phi ïasaid da ïa u ? Uno uno uba ïasaid na ka bynta jong u un shah pynïap ha shuwa ka step . Lada u Baal u dei u blei , ieh un ïada hi ïa lade . Ka dei ka duwan jong u ïa kaba la pynkhyllem .

translation.en: I have declared , and have saved , and I have shewed , when there was no strange god among you : therefore ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , that I am God .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , bad nangta nga wan ban ïarap ïa phi . Ym don u blei nongwei uba ju leh ïa kane ; phi long ki sakhi jong nga .

translation.en: And one of them , when he saw that he was healed , turned back , and with a loud voice glorified God ,
translation.kha: Haba uwei na ki , u la ïohi ba u la ïohkhiah , u la wan phai pat , da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka sur bajam .

translation.en: For David speaketh concerning him , I foresaw the Lord always before my face , for he is on my right hand , that I should not be moved :
translation.kha: Naba u Dabid u la ong shaphang jong u ,   ‘ Nga la ïohi ïa U Trai ha khmat jong nga ha ki por baroh ; u don hajan jong nga , bad ngan ym don ha ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon , Rule thou over us , both thou , and thy son , and thy son s son also : for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ki Israel ki ong ha u Gideon ,  To long u nongsynshar jong ngi — ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me . Me la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Midian .

translation.en: And if there be in the bald head , or bald forehead , a white reddish sore  ; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head , or his bald forehead .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka prum kaba byrsaw-lieh ka mih ha ka jaka hap shñiuh , ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: Thou hast heard my voice : hide not thine ear at my breathing , at my cry .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kyrpad ïa me ban shahshkor ïa ka jingkyang jong nga , me la ïohsngew .

translation.en: Howbeit , as the disciples stood round about him , he rose up , and came into the city : and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki parabangeit ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u , u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha shnong . Ha ka sngi kaba bud ma u lem bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha Derbe .

translation.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us , saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles , that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: Naba kane ka long ka hukum kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi :   ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa phi ka jingshai na ka bynta ki Jentil , khnang ba baroh ka pyrthei ka lah ban lait im .’

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber mourn , as long as the bridegroom is with them ? but the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken from them , and then shall they fast .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi khmih lynti ba kiba shah khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim kin sngewsih katba u nongleitkurim u dang don lem bad ki ? Em kam long kumta ! Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , bad kumta keiñ kin sa shahjingit .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh would hardly let us go , that the  Lord  slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of beast : therefore I sacrifice to the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , being males  ; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharaoh u mutlop bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ngi ban leit , U  Trai  u la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt , uba na u briew bad na u mrad ruh . Dei namar kata ba ngi kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  ïa uwei pa uwei uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad , hynrei ngi pyllait pat ïa la ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong .

translation.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness : I will go into them , and I will praise the  Lord  :
translation.kha: To plie ïa nga ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Templ ; ngan leit rung shapoh bad ainguh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly , that said in her heart , I am , and there is none beside me : how is she become a desolation , a place for beasts to lie down in ! every one that passeth by her shall hiss , and wag his hand .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka nongbah kaba sarong katta katta ïa la ka bor bad kaba pyrkhat ba ka don ha ka jingshngain . Ki briew jong ka ki pyrkhat ba ka nongbah jong ki ka long kaba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei . Katno kan long ka jaka kaba kynjah , ka jaka ha kaba ki mradkhlaw kin pynjahthait ! Uwei uwei baroh uba ïaid lyngba jong ka un kynran dien ha ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: That say , Let him make speed , and hasten his work , that we may see it : and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come , that we may know it !
translation.kha: Phi ong ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un pynstet bad leh ïa kaei kaba u ong ba un leh , ba kumta ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Ai ba U Blei bakhuid ka Israel un pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong u , to ngin khmih kaei u don ha ka jingmut jong u .

translation.en: Then came also publicans to be baptized , and said unto him , Master , what shall we do ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonglum khajna ki la wan ban shah pynbaptis , bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko nonghikai , kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron , and say unto them , There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ban kren ha ki lyngdoh , ki khun u Aaron , bad ong ha ki ba uno uno na ki um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka por ba lehniam haba don uba ïap napdeng ki briew jong u ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Say unto them , Go not up , neither fight  ; for I am not among you  ; lest ye be smitten before your enemies .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha nga , ‘ Maham ïa ki ban ym leit tur , naba ngan ym long ryngkat bad ki , bad ki nongshun jong ki kin sa jop ïa ki .’

translation.en: Remember that thou magnify his work , which men behold .
translation.kha: La ïai ïaroh ïa u namar kaei kaba u leh ; phi ruh phi dei ban ïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme  ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta U Trai , to pynkohnguh ïa lade ha ki bor synshar baroh : Ha u Patsha uba long ka bor kaba ha khlieh tam ,

translation.en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ki kynthei , to pyndem ha la ki tnga , kumba ha U Trai .

translation.en: But whoso hath this world s good , and seeth his brother have need , and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him , how dwelleth the love of God in him ?
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba riewspah u ïohi ïa la u parabriew ha ka jingkyrduh , pynban , u khang khyrdep ïa la ka dohnud pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , kumno u lah ban kam ba u ieit ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: Thou son of man , shew the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities : and let them measure the pattern .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong shuh ,  Ko u khun u briew , to ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel shaphang ka Templ , bad ai ba kin ïitbniah ïa ka jingthmu jong ka . Pynlong ïa ki ban sngewlehrain ïa ki kam pop jong ki .

translation.en: That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong ki ka long ban pynshisha ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka long kaba sngur . Wat ïa ka ksiar , ïa kaba lah ban pynduh , la phrang da ka ding ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , kaba kham kordor shuh shuh ban ïa ka ksiar , dei ruh ban phrang , khnang ba kan lah ban shah . Te phin sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingïaroh bad ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom ha ka Sngi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .

translation.en: There is a lad here , which hath five barley loaves , and two small fishes : but what are they among so many ?
translation.kha: Don uwei u khynnah hangne uba don san tylli ki kpu barli bad ar tylli ki dohkha . Hynrei kine kin ym pat biang na ka bynta kine ki briew baroh .

translation.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more :
translation.kha: Ko Job , hato me la phla ïa ki pop jong me ha U Blei bad kular ban nym leh pop shuh ?

translation.en: Therefore they gathered them together , and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves , which remained over and above unto them that had eaten .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïalum ïa baroh kaba la tam bad ki la pyndap haduh khat-ar tukri da ki lyngkhot kiba la sah tam na ki san tylli ki kpu barli kiba ki briew ki la bam .

translation.en: So he came to the king . And the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall we forbear ? And he answered him , Go , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
translation.kha: Haba u wan mih ha khmat u syiem Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Mikaïah , hato u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Khie tur ïaleh !  u Mikaïah u jubab .  Da shisha phin jop . U  Trai  un ai ha phi ka jingjop .

translation.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham , that God blessed his son Isaac  ; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap jong u Abraham , U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , uba sah hajan  Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .

translation.en: Thou hast increased the nation , O  Lord  , thou hast increased the nation : thou art glorified : thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynlong ïa ka hima jong ngi ban roi , da kaba pynïar ïa ka ri ha baroh sawdong , bad kane ka la wallam ïa me ka burom .

translation.en: And afterward Joshua smote them , and slew them , and hanged them on five trees : and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u pynïap ïa ki syiem bad u sdien ïa ki ha ki san tylli ki dieng , ha kaba ki met jong ki , ki la sah haduh janmiet .

translation.en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father , and the daughter against her mother , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
translation.kha: Nga la wan ba ki khun shynrang kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki , ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki , ki pyrsa kurim kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kiaw kurim jong ki ;

translation.en: And the Philistine said , I defy the armies of Israel this day  ; give me a man , that we may fight together .
translation.kha: Hangne mynta nga kob ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel . Nga kob ïa phi ba phin phah da uno uno ban ïaleh bad nga !

translation.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly .
translation.kha: Kin ym long shuh ki bymïaishah , hynrei kin trei ha ka jingshemphang bad kin ong ïa kaei kaba ki mut .

translation.en: Then these men assembled , and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongshun jong u Daniel ki la khmih ïa u ba u duwai sha U Blei ,

translation.en: In this thing the  Lord  pardon thy servant , that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there , and he leaneth on my hand , and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon : when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon , the  Lord  pardon thy servant in this thing .
translation.kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ba U  Trai  un map ïa nga haba nga synran ïa la u syiem sha ka templ u Rimmon , u blei Syria , bad mane ïa u . Da shisha U  Trai  un map ïa nga !

translation.en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion , How are we spoiled ! we are greatly confounded , because we have forsaken the land , because our dwellings have cast us out .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Seïon ,  La pynjot ïa ngi ! La pynlehrain khoit ïa ngi ! Ngi dei ban iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ; ïa ki ïing jong ngi la pynkhyllem .

translation.en: And when he heard this , he was very sorrowful : for he was very rich .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewsih eh , namar u la long uba riewspah shibun .

translation.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice , ye would not have condemned the guiltless .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Dei ka jingbhasbun kaba nga kwah , ym ïa ka jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Lada phi la tip kaei ka jingmut jong kane , phin ym da la pynrem ïa ki briew ki bym shym shah pynrem ;

translation.en: And Joshua said unto them , Fear not , nor be dismayed , be strong and of good courage : for thus shall the  Lord  do to all your enemies against whom ye fight .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ha ki rangbah shipai ,  Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Long uba kut jingmut triang uba skhem namar kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  un leh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent fiery serpents among the people , and they bit the people  ; and much people of Israel died .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la phah da ki bseiñ ba-dap da ka bih hapdeng kita ki briew , bad bun ki Israel ki la shah puh bad ïap .

translation.en: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly , the prince asketh , and the judge asketh for a reward  ; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire : so they wrap it up .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba tbit baroh ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew . Ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongbishar ki bamsap . U briew uba lah u ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba u kwah , bad kumta ki ïasylla lang .

translation.en: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain , and to the king s pool : but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka bynta kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah , nga leit shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Umpohliew bad ka Pungsum u Syiem . U kada u ba nga shong um lah ban shem kano kano ka lynti lyngba ki synrum ,

translation.en: Howbeit they did not hearken , but they did after their former manner .
translation.kha: Hynrei kito ki briew kim shahshkor , bad ki ïai bteng ban bud ïa ki rukom kiba rim jong ki .

translation.en: Saying , Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name ? and , behold , ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine , and intend to bring this man s blood upon us .
translation.kha: Ngi la ai ha phi ïa ki hukum bapyrkhing ban ym hikai ha ka kyrteng jong une u briew ,  u la ong ;  hynrei peit kaei kaba phi la leh ! Phi la pynphriang ïa ka jinghikai jong phi kylleng ka Jerusalem , bad phi kwah ban pynlong ïa ngi kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u !

translation.en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses , that the skin of Moses  face shone : and Moses put the veil upon his face again , until he went in to speak with him .
translation.kha: bad ki ïohi ba ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ . Kumta u buh biang ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat haduh ba un da leit ïakren pat bad U  Trai .

translation.en: He that feared the word of the  Lord  among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses :
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar jong u Pharaoh ki la sheptieng namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren , bad ki wan ïalam noh kloi ïa la ki mraw bad ïa la ki jingri shapoh ïing .

translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , being yet present with you .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane katba nga dang don bad phi .

translation.en: But I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment , than for you .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Sidon ban ïa phi !

translation.en: None eye pitied thee , to do any of these unto thee , to have compassion upon thee  ; but thou wast cast out in the open field , to the lothing of thy person , in the day that thou wast born .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba khmih isynei ïa pha ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei na ka bynta jong pha . Mynba la kha ïa pha , ym don mano mano ba la ieit ïa pha . La bret ïa pha ha madan bym don jingkah .

translation.en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat , but it withereth the grass , and the flower thereof falleth , and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth : so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka mih lem bad ka jingshit kyr-ang bad ka thang ïa u jingthung ; u syntiew jong u , u hap noh , bad ka jingitynnat jong u ka jah noh . Ha kajuh ka rukom ïa uba riewspah yn pynjot noh katba u dang don ha ka kam jong u ba u trei .

translation.en: I know that thou canst do every thing , and that no thought can be withholden from thee .
translation.kha: Nga tip , A  Trai  , ba me long uba khrawbor tam ; ba me lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me kwah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go , return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus : and when thou comest , anoint Hazael to be king over Syria :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Leit phai noh sha ka ri khlaw kaba hajan Damaskos , bad nangta rung shapoh ka nongbah bad pynsleh ïa u Hasael kum u syiem ka Syria ;

translation.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee , and from thy houses , and from thy servants , and from thy people  ; they shall remain in the river only .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad ki briew jong phi , phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .

translation.en: Haman said moreover , Yea , Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself  ; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba khamtam ïa ka kata ,  u Haman u ong shuh shuh ,  ka Esther , ka mahadei , ka la pynlong ka jingkhawai ym na ka bynta jongno jongno , hynrei tang ïa u syiem bad ïa nga , bad la khot sngewbha biang ïa ngi na ka bynta la shai ka sngi .

translation.en: When they heard these things , they were cut to the heart , and they gnashed on him with their teeth .
translation.kha: Katba ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki pynshahshkor ïa u Stephan , ki la bitar shla bad ki la kyr-iat bniat ïa u ha ka jingbitar .

translation.en: And they answered the angel of the  Lord  that stood among the myrtle trees , and said , We have walked to and fro through the earth , and , behold , all the earth sitteth still , and is at rest .
translation.kha: Ki la wan ïathuh ha u angel :  Ngi la leit sha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngi la shem ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka don hapdeng ka jingbymlah ban leh ei ei bad ha ka jingshah pyndem .

translation.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations , even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba jar uba leh ïa kano kano na kine ki kam kiba ijli yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months : it shall be the first month of the year to you .
translation.kha: Une un long ha phi u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem .

translation.en: I will speak , that I may be refreshed : I will open my lips and answer .
translation.kha: Ngam lah shah shuh , nga dei ban kren .

translation.en: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant , who is for you a faithful minister of Christ ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïoh tip ïa ka jingaiei jong U Blei na u Epaphras , u para shakri ba-ieit jong ngi , uba long u nongtrei baïaineh jong U Khrist na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: O inhabitant of Lebanon , that makest thy nest in the cedars , how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee , the pain as of a woman in travail !
translation.kha: Phi shong sngewskhem hapdeng ki dieng Kedar ba wanrah na Lebanon ; hynrei katno kaba sngewsynei ynda wan ka jingshitom ha phi , bad phin ud haba ka jingsuh kan lap ïa phi , ki jingshitom kum kito ki jong ka kynthei kaba suh kha .

translation.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours ? only let us consent unto them , and they will dwell with us .
translation.kha: Hato ki jingri jong ki bad baroh kaba ki don , kin ym long ki jong ngi ? To ngin ïamynjur ba ki lah ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: And Heshbon shall cry , and Elealeh : their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz : therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out  ; his life shall be grievous unto him .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang jam , bad ïa ka jingkyang jong ki lah ban ïohsngew kat shaduh Jahas . Wat ki shipai ki khynñiuh ; ka jingshlur jong ki ka duh noh .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And when I saw that ye delivered me not , I put my life in my hands , and passed over against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  delivered them into my hand : wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day , to fight against me ?
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ba phim shym wan ïarap ïa nga , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim bad nga jam ïa u pud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ; bad U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka jingjop halor jong ki . Te balei pat phi wan ban ïaleh ïa nga mynta ?

translation.en: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .
translation.kha: Katno uba kmen u long uta u shakri lada u kynrad jong u , u shem ba u leh ïa kane haba u wan sha ïing !

translation.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us , that might lay his hand upon us both .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don uno uno uba wan hapdeng jong ngi — ym don u ban bishar ïa U Blei bad ïa nga .

translation.en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering , and the log of oil , and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad ïa kata ka umphniang Olib bad un ai ïa ki kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai  na ka bynta u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem , and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha nga ka khubor na ka bynta u Shemaïah jong ka Nehelam , uba la phah ka shithi ha ka kyrteng jong u hi sha baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad sha u Sephanaïah , u lyngdoh u khun jong u Maaseïah bad sha baroh kiwei pat ki lyngdoh . Ha kane ka shithi , u Shemaïah u la thoh sha u Sephanaïah :

translation.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the  Lord   ; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth , and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: te phin shem ka jingkmen kaba wan na kaba shakri ïa nga . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ban ïoh burom ha kylleng ka pyrthei . Bad phin lehkmen ha ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha u kpa tymmen jong phi , u Jakob . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And it was told Solomon , saying , Behold , Adonijah feareth king Solomon : for , lo , he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar , saying , Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Adonijah u la sheptieng ïa u , bad ba u bat sah ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan , u da ong ,  Nyngkong eh , nga kwah ba u Syiem Solomon un smai ha nga ba un ym phah pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels , that the excellency of the power may be of God , and not of us .
translation.kha: Pynban ma ngi kiba don ïa kane ka jingkynshew kaba kynja mynsiem ngi long kum ki khiew khyndew , khnang ban pyn-i ba ka bor kaba halor tam ka long ka jong U Blei , ym ka jong ngi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses face to face , as a man speaketh unto his friend . And he turned again into the camp : but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , departed not out of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïakren markhmat bad u Moses , kumba u briew u ïakren bad la u paralok . Nangta u Moses u leit phai sha ka jaka sher dara . Hynrei u samla , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u , u shongsah ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say , Come into Heshbon , let the city of Sihon be built and prepared :
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba ki myllung ki rwai ,  Wan sha Heshbon , sha ka nongbah u syiem Sihon ! Ngi kwah ïohi ba yn tei pat bad pynïeng biang ïa ka .

translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold , whose height was threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof six cubits : he set it up in the plain of Dura , in the province of Babylon .
translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah thaw ka durbriew ksiar , arphew hynñiew mitar ka kynjang bad jan lai mitar ka pyngkiang , bad u la phah pynïeng ïa ka ha ka pyntha Dura ha ka probins    jong ka Babilon .

translation.en: Then said Daniel to Melzar , whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u nongap phira uba u Ashpenas u la buh ban khmih ïa u bad ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u .

translation.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal , Choose you one bullock for yourselves , and dress it first  ; for ye are many  ; and call on the name of your gods , but put no fire under .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ,  Namar ba phi kham ïabun , shim shuwa ma phi ïa u masi dab . Duwai ha u blei jong phi , tangba phim dei ban ai ding ïa ki diengthang .

translation.en: And David came to Baal–perazim , and David smote them there , and said , The  Lord  hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me , as the breach of waters . Therefore he called the name of that place Baal–perazim .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit sha Baal Perasim bad hangta u la jop ïa ki Philistia . U ong ,  U  Trai  u la sar naphang lin ïa ki nongshun jong nga kum ka jingshlei um .  Bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot Baal Perasim .

translation.en: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city , which reigneth over the kings of the earth .
translation.kha: Ka briew kaba me la ïohi ka long ka nongbah bakhraw kaba synshar halor ki syiem jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Sarai said unto Abram , My wrong be upon thee : I have given my maid into thy bosom  ; and when she saw that she had conceived , I was despised in her eyes : the  Lord  judge between me and thee .
translation.kha: Te ka Sarai ka ong ha u Abram ,  Dei namar jong me ba ka Hagar ka ibeiñ ïa nga ! Nga hi nga la ai ïa ka ha me , bad naduh ba ka tip ba ka la punkhun , ka ibeiñ ïa nga . Ai ba U  Trai  un bishar mano ba dei napdeng jong ngi , ma me lane ma nga !

translation.en: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil ; not that we should appear approved , but that ye should do that which is honest , though we be as reprobates .
translation.kha: Ngi duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym leh ïa ka bymdei — ym ban pynpaw ba ngi long kiba la jop , te hynrei ba phin ïoh leh ïa kaba dei , wat la ka i kumba ngi long kiba la shahjop .

translation.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom , and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them , and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them , neither turned they from their wicked works .
translation.kha: Da ki jingkyrkhu jong me , ki syiem ki la synshar ïa ki briew jong me haba ki shong ki sah ha ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh ba me la ai ïa ki ; hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ka pop ban shakri ïa me .

translation.en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do ? he will come and destroy the husbandmen , and will give the vineyard unto others .
translation.kha: Kaei te , kaba uta u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ?  la kylli U Jisu .  Un sa wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki briew bad ai noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ sha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai .

translation.en: While I was with them in the world , I kept them in thy name : those that thou gavest me I have kept , and none of them is lost , but the son of perdition  ; that the scripture might be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Mynba nga la don lem bad ki , nga la ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga . Nga la ïada ïa ki , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki uba la jah noh , lait tang u briew uba la dei ban jah — khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said ,  A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho , and fell among thieves , which stripped him of his raiment , and wounded him , and departed , leaving him half dead .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Shisien la don u briew uba la leit hiar na Jerusalem sha Jerikho mynba ki nonglute ki la tur ïaleh ïa u , ki la sloit lyngkhuit ïa u , bad ki la shoh ïa u , ki da iehnoh lyngktop ïa u kum uba ïap .

translation.en: He hath said in his heart , I shall not be moved : for I shall never be in adversity .
translation.kha: U ong ha lade ,  Ngan ym bakla da lei lei ; da lei lei ngan ym poi ha ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: And the angel of God said unto him , Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes , and lay them upon this rock , and pour out the broth . And he did so .
translation.kha: U angel u hukum ïa u ,  Buh ïa ka doh bad u kpu halor une u mawsiang , bad theh ïa ka syrwa halor jong ki .  U Gideon u leh kumta .

translation.en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the king of Egypt died : and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage .
translation.kha: Bun snem hadien kane , u syiem Ijipt u ïap noh , hynrei ki Israel ki dang ïai ud namar kata ka jinglongmraw jong ki bad ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And Samuel said , As thy sword hath made women childless , so shall thy mother be childless among women . And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the  Lord  in Gilgal .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Kumba ka waitlam jong me ka la pynlong ïa kiba bun ki kmie ban duh khun , kumta mynta ka kmie jong me kan long khlem khun .  Bad u pom lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Agag ha khmat ka duwan ha Gilgal .

translation.en: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints , and to overcome them : and power was given him over all kindreds , and tongues , and nations .
translation.kha: La shah ïa u ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew jong U Blei bad ban jop ïa ki , bad la ai ha u ïa ka bor halor kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka hima , ka ktien bad halor u bynriew baïapher .

translation.en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia , that the word of the  Lord  spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished , the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia , that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom , and put it also in writing , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong ba u Syros ka ri Persia u long u patsha . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kaei kaba u la ong lyngba u nongïathuhlypa Jeremaïah ban urlong shisha . U pynsngew ha u Syros ban pynmih ïa ka hukum harum bad ban phah ha ka jingthoh ïa ka ban pule jam ha kylleng ka hima jong u :

translation.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him , because we have trusted in his holy name .
translation.kha: Ngi la kmen namar jong u , ngi shaniah ha ka kyrteng bakhuid jong u .

translation.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , and saith , What need we any further witnesses ?
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñkup bad u la ong ,  Ngim donkam shuh kino kino ki sakhi !

translation.en: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim , from the rock , and upward .
translation.kha: Shatei na Sela , u pud ka Edom u ïaid lyngba ka Khim Akrabbim .

translation.en: Then Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Doth Job fear God for nought ?
translation.kha: U Soitan u jubab ,  Hato u Job un mane ïa me lada um ïoh ei ei na ka ?

translation.en: The hay appeareth , and the tender grass sheweth itself , and herbs of the mountains are gathered .
translation.kha: Phi ot ïa u jyntang bad nangta ot ïa u phlang ha ki sharing lum katba u jyntang ba dang lung u dang san .

translation.en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes , and gave thanks , and brake them , and gave to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad ki dohkha , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran ; bad ki synran ki la ai ïa ki ha u paidbah .

translation.en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins .
translation.kha: U siat ïa la ki khnam jylliew shapoh ka met jong nga .

translation.en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth , and hath determined the times before appointed , and the bounds of their habitation  ;
translation.kha: Na uwei u briew u la thaw ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei bad u la pynlong ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U hi da lade u la pynskhem lypa ïa ki por kiba biang bad ïa ki pud jong ki jaka ha kaba kin shong kin sah .

translation.en: How thy garments are warm , when he quieteth the earth by the south wind ?
translation.kha: Em , me lah ban shah tang ïa ka jingshit haba ka lyer na shaphang shathie ka lynshop ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And I John saw the holy city , new Jerusalem , coming down from God out of heaven , prepared as a bride adorned for her husband .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , kaba da wan hiar na bneng na U Blei , kaba la pynkhreh bad kaba la kloi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba la riam ban ïashem ïa u tnga jong ka .

translation.en: Therefore , son of man , prophesy and say unto Gog , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely , shalt thou not know it ?
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha u Gog ïa kaei kaba u ong ïa u :  Mynta katba ki Israel , ki briew jong nga ki dang shong ha ka jingsngewskhem ,

translation.en: And they that use this world , as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away .
translation.kha: kito kiba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ba ki ïoh , kumba kim shym lap miet ha kita . Naba kane ka pyrthei , kumba ka long mynta , kan ym neh slem .

translation.en: Though he slay me , yet will I trust in him : but I will maintain mine own ways before him .
translation.kha: Nga la duh baroh ka jingkyrmen , te yn lei lada U Blei u pynïap noh ïa nga ? Ngan leit ban ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga ha u .

translation.en: And as I was considering , behold , an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth , and touched not the ground : and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang lyngngoh aïu kane ka mut , u  langsohmoh u la wan mareh na shaphang sepngi , u da mareh stet eh ba ki kjat jong u kim shym kynduh khyndew . U la don tang kawei ka reng hapdeng ki khmat jong u .

translation.en: But he answered and said , Verily I say unto you , I know you not .
translation.kha: ‘ Da lei lei ruh em ! ngam ithuh ïa phi ,’ u nongleitkurim u la jubab .

translation.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward : and the border was drawn to Shicron , and passed along to mount Baalah , and went out unto Jabneel  ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u pud u suh sha u lum shaphang shatei jong ka Ekron , u phai sha ka Shikkeron , lyngba u Lum Baalah , bad ter ter sha Jamnia . U kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian ,

translation.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake , some to everlasting life , and some to shame and everlasting contempt .
translation.kha: Bun na kito kiba la lah ïap kin im pat : Katto katne kin ïoh ka jingim bymjukut , bad katto katne kin shah ka jingjahburom bymjukut .

translation.en: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony , before the mercy seat that is over the testimony , where I will meet with thee .
translation.kha: Buh ïa kane ka duwan shabar ka pyrda kaba la wah ha khmat jong ka Synduk Ka Jutang . Kata ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngan ïashem bad me .

translation.en: And he discerned him not , because his hands were hairy , as his brother Esau s hands : so he blessed him .
translation.kha: Um shym la ithuh ïa u Jakob namar ba ki kti jong u ki long kiba mih shñiuh kum ki jong u Iso .

translation.en: He hath made the earth by his power , he hath established the world by his wisdom , and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ka khyndew da ka bor jong u ; da la ka jingstad u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad pynïar ïa ki bneng .

translation.en: So Omri slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria : and Ahab his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Omri u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Samaria , bad u Ahab u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Of whom be thou ware also ; for he hath greatly withstood our words .
translation.kha: Na u ruh men kiar , namar u la kren pyrshah ïa ka jingïalap jong ngi .

translation.en: And I will make this city desolate , and an hissing  ; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingpynjot kaba shyrkhei kum kane ha kane ka nongbah ha kaba uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lyngba un kyndit bad lyngngoh .

translation.en: And if Christ be not raised , your faith is vain ; ye are yet in your sins .
translation.kha: Bad lada ïa U Khrist ym shym la pynmihpat , te ka jingngeit jong phi kam long kaba shisha bad phi dang don hi ha ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: In the dark they dig through houses , which they had marked for themselves in the daytime : they know not the light .
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki nongtuh ki rung shapoh ki ïing , hynrei mynsngi ki rieh bad ki kiar ïa ka jingshai .

translation.en: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet , and that I will not take any thing that is thine , lest thou shouldest say , I have made Abram rich :
translation.kha: Te men ym ïoh ong , ‘ Dei ma nga uba la pynriewspah ïa u Abram .’

translation.en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons  by a statute for ever from the children of Israel : for it is an heave offering : and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings , even their heave offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka rai jong nga ka ban ym kylla ba haba ki briew jong nga ki pynlong ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok , ka shadem bad ka lbong jong u mrad ki long ka bynta jong ki lyngdoh . Kane ka long ka jingai sngewbha jong ki briew sha nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness , and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son .
translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na ka bor jong ka jingdum bad u la wallam ha ka jingsuk ïa ngi sha ka hima jong U Khun ba-ieit jong u .

translation.en: And the Word was made flesh , and dwelt among us , ( and we beheld his glory , the glory as of the only begotten of the Father , ) full of grace and truth .
translation.kha: U Ktien la kylla long u briew bad , uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha , u la im hapdeng jong ngi . Ngi la ïohi ïa ka burom jong u , ka burom kaba u la ïohpdiang kum U Khun marwei jong U Kpa .

translation.en: Therefore being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him , that of the fruit of his loins , according to the flesh , he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne  ;
translation.kha: U la long u nongïathuhlypa , bad u la tip aïu U Blei u la kular ïa u : U Blei u la pynlong ka jingsmai ba un pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid , kumba u Dabid u la long .

translation.en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude  ; and their camels were without number , as the sand by the sea side for multitude .
translation.kha: Ki Midian , ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ki la saphriang ha ka them kum ka kynhun ki puit , bad ki la don bun bah ki ut kat ki symboh shyiap ka rud duriaw .

translation.en: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates : and they feared , when they heard that they were Romans .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la ïathuh ïa kine ki ktien ha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul bad u Silas ki dei ki traishnong ka Hima Rom , ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: And as they spake unto the people , the priests , and the captain of the temple , and the Sadducees , came upon them ,
translation.kha: U Petros bad u Ïoannis ki dang kren ha ki paidbah mynba katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh , u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ , bad katto katne ngut ki Saddusi ki la wan poi .

translation.en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart : and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly .
translation.kha: Baroh ki ktien jong nga ki long kiba beit bad nga kren ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath taken away thy judgments , he hath cast out thine enemy : the king of Israel , even the  Lord  , is in the midst of thee : thou shalt not see evil any more .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkut ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa phi ; u la weng noh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh . U  Trai  , u syiem ka Israel , u long bad phi ; ym don daw mynta ban sheptieng .

translation.en: After him repaired their brethren , Bavai the son of Henadad , the ruler of the half part of Keilah .
translation.kha: U Babbai , u khun jong u Henadad , u nongsynshar ïa kawei pat ka shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ;

translation.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , ka don ka jingbishar hok , hynrei ki jingshukor ki ïalam sha ka jingshah bishar bymhok .

translation.en: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa u Belshassar , u syiem ka Babilonia , la pynïap ;

translation.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida  ; and they bring a blind man unto him , and besought him to touch him .
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Bethsaida , ha kaba katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ha U Jisu ïa u briew uba matlah , bad ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ktah ïa u .

translation.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen  ; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers .
translation.kha: ban pynïap ïa ki nongaplangbrot bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki , ban pynïap ïa ki nonglur bad ïa ki kulai jong ki , ban ïuhroit ïa ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah synshar ba-halor .

translation.en: Today’s realities are war , crime , hunger , sickness , aging—to mention just a few .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingshisha ka long ka thma , jingsniew , jingïapthngan , jingpang ban kdew tang katto kattne .

translation.en: And they said , We saw certainly that the  Lord  was with thee : and we said , Let there be now an oath betwixt us , even betwixt us and thee , and let us make a covenant with thee  ;
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Mynta ngi tip ba U  Trai  u don bad phi , bad ngi pyrkhat ba ka dei ban don ka jingïateh kular badonburom hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: Then went the Pharisees , and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la leit noh bad ki la pynlong ka jingthmu ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli .

translation.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained .
translation.kha: Kine ki longïing jong ka kur Kohath ki la ïohpdiang shiphew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: Now when this was noised abroad , the multitude came together , and were confounded , because that every man heard them speak in his own language .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ka jingsawa , u paidbah babun u la ïalum . Ki la ïasngewtynnat , namar ba uwei pa uwei na ki u la ïohsngew ba ki riewngeit ki kren ha ka ktien jong u hi .

translation.en: And the second took her to wife , and he died childless .
translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad nangta sa uba lai .

translation.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices , which can never take away sins :
translation.kha: Man la u lyngdoh Jiw , u trei ïa la ka kam man ka sngi bad ai kijuh ki jingkñia man ka por ; hynrei kine ki jingkñia kim lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .

translation.en: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynïap briew ha kaba rieh .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: But he knew their thoughts , and said to the man which had the withered hand ,  Rise up , and stand forth in the midst .  And he arose and stood forth .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bad u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Ïeng joit bad wan shane sha khmat .  Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la ïeng hangta .

translation.en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests , saying , Come ye up out of Jordan .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la leh kumta ,

translation.en: Then they brought out the king s son , and put upon him the crown , and gave him the testimony , and made him king . And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam shabar ïa u Joash , u buh ïa ka pansngiat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ kiba ïadei bad ka jingsynshar . U Jehoïada u lyngdoh bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynsleh ïa u Joash , bad uwei pa uwei u pyrta :  To un im slem u syiem .

translation.en: He which testifieth these things saith ,  Surely I come quickly .  Amen . Even so , come , Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Uta uba ai ïa ka jingphla jong u ha kane baroh , u ong ,  Ho-oid da shisha ! Nga wan kloi !  Ai kan long kumta . To wan , Trai Jisu !

translation.en: Let us therefore fear , lest , a promise being left us of entering into his rest , any of you should seem to come short of it .
translation.kha: Mynta , U Blei u la tyrwa ha ngi ïa ka jingkular ba ngi lah ban pdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba u la kren . Te , to ngin da sumar , ba yn ym shem ïa uno uno na phi u bym kot ban ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ba la kular .

translation.en: We are encouraged when we hear the experiences of those who are successfully meeting the challenge of living as Christians in these difficult times .
translation.kha: Ngi ïoh jingshlur haba ngi ïohsngew ïa ki jingjia ba la mad da kito kiba la jop ïa ki jingeh ban im kum ki Khristan ha kine ki sngi ba lanot .

translation.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest : and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes .
translation.kha: Nangta , ïa U Jisu la ïalam sha ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ha kaba la ïalumlang ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki rangbah nongïalam bad ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum .

translation.en: Then went Samson to Gaza , and saw there an harlot , and went in unto her .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Samson u leit sha Gasa , ka shnong ki Philistia , hangta u ïakynduh ïa ka nuti bad u leit ïathiah bad ka .

translation.en: Come , see a man , which told me all things that ever I did : is not this the Christ ?
translation.kha: To wan bad khmih ïa u briew uba la ïathuh ïa nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh . Hato une u lah ban long U Messaïah ?

translation.en: And the sons of Zebulun  ; Sered , and Elon , and Jahleel .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Sebulun : u Sered , u Elon , bad u Jahlil .

translation.en: Canst thou by searching find out God ? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban shem ïa ki pud ki sam jong ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong U Blei ?

translation.en: And he returned to Judah , and said , I cannot find her  ; and also the men of the place said , that there was no harlot in this place .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit phai noh sha u Judah , bad u ong ,  Ngam shym lap satia ïa ka . Ki rangbah jong kata ka jaka ruh ki ong ba ym ju don nuti hangta .

translation.en: He spake , and the locusts came , and caterpillers , and that without number ,
translation.kha: U la hukum , bad ki puit ki ïawan da ki million bad ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki ;

translation.en: To an inheritance incorruptible , and undefiled , and that fadeth not away , reserved in heaven for you ,
translation.kha: Kane ka pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingkyrmen ba-im , bad kumta ngi peit sha khmat ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkyrkhu kyrhai kiba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . U buh ïa ki ha bneng na ka bynta jong phi , ha kaba kim lah ban pyut lane duh noh lane sep noh .

translation.en: And ye , in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing , lest ye make yourselves accursed , when ye take of the accursed thing , and make the camp of Israel a curse , and trouble it .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim dei ban rah ïa kano kano kaba dei ïa ka ban pynjot ; lada phi leh kumta , phin wanrah ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpynjot ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Israel .

translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight , as stuff for removing : and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight , as they that go forth into captivity .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang shai , to teh ïa ka song jong me na ka bynta ka jingshah ringmraw , khnang ba kin lah ban ïohi ïa me , bad nangta shah ïa ki ban khmih ïa me ba me mihnoh ha ka premmiet kumba me leit sha ka jingshah ringmraw .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as we went to prayer , a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us , which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ngi dang ïaleit sha ka jaka duwai , kawei ka shakri samla kaba la don u mynsiem bymman uba la pynlah ïa ka ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka ban sa wan , ka la ïakynduh ïa ngi . Ka la kamai bun ka pisa na ka bynta ki trai jong ka da kaba batai kupar .

translation.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven , and will scatter them toward all those winds  ; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki lyer ban beh pyrshah ïa ka Elam na ki liang baroh , bad ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong ka kylleng , haduh ba yn ym don ki ri ha kiba ki nongphetwir na ka kim shym poi .

translation.en: If he take him another wife  ; her food , her raiment , and her duty of marriage , shall he not diminish .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shim tnga sa kawei , u dei ban ai ïa ka tnga banyngkong jong u katjuh ka bam bad ka jaiñkup jaiñsem , bad ïa kijuh ki hok , kumba ka ju ïoh .

translation.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the  Lord   ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance .
translation.kha: Suk kata ka jaitbynriew kaba U Blei jong ka U long U  Trai  ; suk kita ki briew kiba u la jied ban long ka jingïohkynti jong u .

translation.en: And he sent him away to his house , saying ,  Neither go into the town , nor tell it to any in the town .
translation.kha: U Jisu te u la phah ïa u sha ïing ryngkat bad ka hukum ,  Wat leit phai pat sha ka nongrit .

translation.en: And God spake unto Noah , and to his sons with him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u ,

translation.en: Therefore now go , lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee : behold , mine Angel shall go before thee : nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them .
translation.kha: Mynta khie leit , ïalam ïa u paidbah sha kata ka jaka kaba nga la ïathuh ïa me . Kynmaw ba u angel jong nga un ïalam ïa phi , hynrei ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynshitom ïa kine ki briew namar ka pop jong ki .

translation.en: And he came to Capernaum : and being in the house he asked them ,  What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way ?
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Kapernam , bad hadien ba u la rung shapoh ïing U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shaphang kaei phi la ïatainia hapdeng jong phi ha lynti ?

translation.en: And she answered and said unto him , Yes , Lord : yet the dogs under the table eat of the children s crumbs .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ka la jubab ,  wat ki ksew ha khrum ka miej ki bam ïa ki jingbam ba la sah tam na ki khun !

translation.en: And all the acts of his power and of his might , and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai , whereunto the king advanced him , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia ?
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh , kumjuh ruh ïa baroh ka jingïathuhkhana kumno ba u la pynkiew ïa u Mordekai sha ka kyrdan treikam kaba halor , la buh jingkynmaw ha ki jingthoh ba dei ïa ki syiem ka Persia bad Media .

translation.en: My breath is strange to my wife , though I entreated for the children s sake of mine own body .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong nga kam lah ban shah ïa ka jingsma ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong nga , ki hynmen ki para jong nga kim wan hajan jong nga .

translation.en: Which was the son of Cainan , which was the son of Arphaxad , which was the son of Sem , which was the son of Noah , which was the son of Lamech ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Kainan , u khun jong u Arphaksad , u khun jong u Shem , u khun jong u Noah , u khun jong u Lamekh ,

translation.en: O remember that my life is wind : mine eye shall no more see good .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei , ba ka jingim jong nga ka long tang ka jynhaw , ka jingsuk jong nga ka la kut noh .

translation.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people , that thou mayest know and try their way .
translation.kha: Ko Jeremaïah , tynjuh ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba men tynjuh ïa ka nar , bad to ïit ki long kiba kumno .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Say unto thy brethren , This do ye  ; lade your beasts , and go , get you unto the land of Canaan  ;
translation.kha: U la ong ha u Joseph ,  Ong ïa ki hynmen jong phi ban pyndap da ki jingkit ïa ki mrad jong ki bad ban leit phai sha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: Then Bath–sheba bowed with her face to the earth , and did reverence to the king , and said , Let my lord king David live for ever .
translation.kha: Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon bad ka ong ,  Ai ba u kynrad jong nga , u syiem un im junom !

translation.en: For they call themselves of the holy city , and stay themselves upon the God of Israel  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: Bad pynban phi sngewsarong ban ong ba phi long ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah bakhuid bad ba phi shaniah ha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved off the one half of their beards , and cut off their garments in the middle , even to their buttocks , and sent them away .
translation.kha: U Hanun u la kem ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Dabid , u la khi shiliang ïa u  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , u khap ïa ki jaiñ jong ki na mar skhep , bad u la phah noh ïa ki .

translation.en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and pitched in Jahzah , and fought against Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shym shah ïa ki Israel ba kin leh kumta . U lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong u baroh , u sher dara ha Jahas , bad u tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , thus shall ye say to him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , As touching the words which thou hast heard  ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta u syiem hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga ong : pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ,

translation.en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the  Lord  , ye shall offer it at your own will .
translation.kha: Haba phi pynïap ïa u mrad ban pynlong ka jingainguh ïasyllok , bud beit ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .

translation.en: From whence come wars and fightings among you ? come they not hence , even of your lusts that war in your members ?
translation.kha: Nangno ki mih ki thma bad ki jingïakajia hapdeng jong phi ? Ki mih na ki jingkwah brai jong phi ïa ka jingsngewbha , kiba ïai ïaleh hapoh jong phi .

translation.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom : but a man of understanding walketh uprightly .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop ki kmen ha la ka jingbieit , hynrei kiba stad kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium .
translation.kha: Baroh ki riewngeit ha Lystra bad Ikoniom ki ïakren babha shaphang u Timothi .

translation.en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kat kum kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ong pyrshah ïa u Baasha lyngba u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh na ka longïing jong u Baasha .

translation.en: And besought him greatly , saying , My little daughter lieth at the point of death : I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her , that she may be healed  ; and she shall live .
translation.kha: bad u la kyrpad rit ïa u ,  Ka khun rit jong nga ka pang jur . To sngewbha ban wan bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ka , khnang ba kan khiah bad ïoh im .

translation.en: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God , and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba phi long ka templ jong U Blei bad ba U Mynsiem U Blei u shong hapoh jong phi !

translation.en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Hapdeng ki paid Israel yn ym don shuh ki jingïohipaw ba bakla lane ki jingïathuhlypa kiba ïalam bakla .

translation.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless : for thou art a wise man , and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him  ; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem dei ban shah ïa u ban lait khlem ka jingpynshitom . Me tip kaei ba men leh , bad me dei ban khmih ba u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .
translation.kha: Wallam man ka snem sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa u soh nyngkong uba phi ot .  Wat shet ïa u khunblang ne khunlangbrot ha ka dud ka kmie jong u .

translation.en: The day following , when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there , save that one whereinto his disciples were entered , and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat , but that his disciples were gone away alone  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki paidbah kiba la sah ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw ki la sngewthuh shai ba la don tang kawei ka lieng hangta . Ki la tip ba U Jisu um shym la kiew ha ka lem bad ki synran jong u , hynrei ba ki la leit noh khlem ma u .

translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall scatter them among the nations , and disperse them in the countries .
translation.kha: Haba nga pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ha ki ri nongwei , kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah . And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Mikaïah ka khun u Uriel , na ka nongbah Gibeah . Ka thma ka la khie hapdeng u Abijah bad u Jeroboam .

translation.en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah Seïon ka long kaba itynnat , hynrei ïa ka yn sa pynjot ;

translation.en: My son , if sinners entice thee , consent thou not .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongkamsniew ki pynshoi ïa phi , ko khun jong nga , wat kohnguh .

translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels , Go your ways , and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka Templ , ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel :  Khie leit bad theh noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang jong ka jingbitar U Blei ha ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Then when he was come into Galilee , the Galilaeans received him , having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast : for they also went unto the feast .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha Galilaïa , ki briew hangta ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , namar ba ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem bad ki la ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: The godly principles in the Bible show us how to live in a way that brings physical benefits .
translation.kha: Ka tynrai jong ka jingim ba riew Blei kaba don ha ka Baibl ka pyni ïa ngi kumno ban im ban sah ha ka rukom ka ban wanrah ka jingmyntoi shimet .

translation.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal : for there I hated them : for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house , I will love them no more : all their princes are revolters .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Baroh ki kam sniew jong ki , ki la sdang ha Gilgal . Ka la long hangta ba nga sdang ban isih ïa ki . Bad namar ka jingsniew ba ki la leh , ngan beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong nga . Ngan ym ieit shuh ïa ki ; baroh ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And they said unto her , Thou art mad . But she constantly affirmed that it was even so . Then said they , It is his angel .
translation.kha: Pha long kaba lamwir !  ki la ong ïa ka . Hynrei ka la ïai ban ba ka la long kaba shisha . Kumta ki la jubab ,  U dei u angel jong u .

translation.en: And entering into the sepulchre , they saw a young man sitting on the right side , clothed in a long white garment  ; and they were affrighted .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la rung shapoh ka jingtep , ha kaba ki la ïohi ïa u samla uba shong ha ka liang kamon uba phong da ka jaiñkup balieh — bad ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: In a moment , in the twinkling of an eye , at the last trump : for the trumpet shall sound , and the dead shall be raised incorruptible , and we shall be changed .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane ka jingshisha barieh : Ngi baroh ngin ym ïap , hynrei haba ka turoi bakhatduh kan sawa , ïa ngi baroh yn pynkylla dur ha kaba shikhyllipmat . Naba haba ka turoi kan sawa , ïa kiba ïap yn pynmihpat , ba kin ym ïap shuh da lei lei , bad ïa ngi baroh yn pynkylla dur .

translation.en: Evil pursueth sinners : but to the righteous good shall be repayed .
translation.kha: Ka jingjynjar ka buddien ïa ki nongpop kylleng , hynrei ki briew kiba hok kin ïoh bainong da kiei kiei kiba bha .

translation.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God :
translation.kha: Wat lada hadien ba la bam noh ïa ka doh jong nga da ka jingpang , wat ha kane hi ka met ngan ïohi ïa U Blei .

translation.en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon , and said unto him , Ask what I shall give thee .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la mihpaw ha u Solomon bad u kylli ,  Kaei me kwah ba ngan ai ïa me ?

translation.en: Whose leaves were fair , and the fruit thereof much , and in it was meat for all  ; under which the beasts of the field dwelt , and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation :
translation.kha: Ki sla jong u ki la long kiba itynnat , bad u la don kyrhai ki soh ha u ban bsa ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Ki mradkhlaw ki la pynjahthait hapoh jong u , bad ki sim ki la thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ha ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the even .
translation.kha: Uta uba thang ïa kata ka masi ruh u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , hynrei u ruh u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity .
translation.kha: Palat ïa shisien , haba nga donkam jingïarap ha Thessaloni , phi la phah ïa ka sha nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt have goats  milk enough for thy food , for the food of thy household , and for the maintenance for thy maidens .
translation.kha: Kiba sah na ki blang kin ai ka dud na ka bynta jong phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , bad ïa ki shakri kynthei jong phi kumjuh .

translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that endureth to the end shall be saved .
translation.kha: Baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong nga . Hynrei uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait im .

translation.en: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive , and brought them unto the top of the rock , and cast them down from the top of the rock , that they all were broken in pieces .
translation.kha: bad ki la ïohkem sa shiphew hajar ngut . Ki la ïalam ïa ki koidi sha ka kliar uwei u mawsiang ha ka nongbah Sela bad ki bret ïa ki , ba kumta la pynïap ïa ki ha ki mawsiang kiba don sha trai .

translation.en: For yourselves , brethren , know our entrance in unto you , that it was not in vain :
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi hi phi tip ba ka jingwan jngoh jong ngi ïa phi kam shym la long kaba sep-ei .

translation.en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing : and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven , and among the inhabitants of the earth : and none can stay his hand , or say unto him , What doest thou ?
translation.kha: U la khmih halor ki briew jong ka pyrthei kum bym long ei ei ; ki angel ha bneng bad ki briew ha ka pyrthei ki don hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyrshah ïa ka mon jong u lane kylli jingkylli ïa kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king :
translation.kha: Kumta katto katne ngut na ki nongai jingmut u syiem kiba ïajan bad u ki ai jingmut ,  Balei phim pynlong ka jingwad ban shem katto katne ki theisotti ba-bhabriew ?

translation.en: He that is born in thy house , and he that is bought with thy money , must needs be circumcised : and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei dei ban otsher , bad kane kan long ka dak kaba paw shabar ban pyn-i ba ka jutang jong nga bad me ka long kaba ïaineh junom .

translation.en: And he said , The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council , as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ki rangbah Jiw ki la ïakut ban kyrpad ïa me lashai ka sngi ban ïalam ïa u Paul sha ka Dorbar , da kaba leh mynleh ba ka Dorbar ka kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba kham thikna shaphang jong u .

translation.en: Then there came out a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will entice him . And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ?
translation.kha: haduh ba u mynsiem u wan sha khmat , u wan ha U  Trai  , bad ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ma nga ïa u .’ ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli .

translation.en: This is that Moses , which said unto the children of Israel , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear .
translation.kha: U Moses u long uta uba la kren ha ki paid Israel , ‘ U Blei un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uba napdeng ki briew jong phi .’

translation.en: And when ye shall come into the land , and shall have planted all manner of trees for food , then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised : three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you : it shall not be eaten of .
translation.kha: Ynda phi poi ha ri Kanaan bad thung ïa uno uno u jait diengsoh , ñiew ba u soh jong u , u long u bymkhuid haduh lai snem . Hapoh kane ka por phim dei ban bam ïa u .

translation.en: He is green before the sun , and his branch shooteth forth in his garden .
translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki khie lung kum ki ñiut ha ka sngi , kum ki ñiut kiba saphriang kylleng ka kper .

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: To ka jingaiei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai kan long lem bad phi baroh .

translation.en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come , he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab , which is in the border of Arnon , which is in the utmost coast .
translation.kha: Haba u Balak u ïohsngew ba u Balaam u la wan , u leit ïakynduh ïa u ha Ar , ka nongbah kaba harud ka wah Arnon ha ka khappud Moab .

translation.en: Which long for death , but it cometh not  ; and dig for it more than for hid treasures  ;
translation.kha: Ki ap ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kam wan satia ; ki kham mon ban jied ïa ka jingtep ban ïa ka spah .

translation.en: That Moses commanded the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Ynda u la dep , u ong ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , u para jong u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah ; kumta u Kaleb u la ai ha u ïa la ka khun kynthei ban shongkurim .

translation.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor , and turn aside the way of the meek : and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid , to profane my holy name :
translation.kha: Ki kyrdem ïa kiba tlot bad ki bymdonbor bad ki khynñiat sharud lynti ïa kiba duk . U briew bad u kpa jong u ki ïathiah shongkha ïa kajuh ka kynthei mraw , bad kumta ki pyntngit ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga .

translation.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the  Lord  your God  ; arise therefore , and build ye the sanctuary of the  Lord  God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynta , shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh . Sdang noh ban tei ïa ka Templ , khnang ba phi lah ban buh ha ka ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar bakyntang ba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u .

translation.en: If grapegatherers come to thee , would they not leave some gleaning grapes ? if thieves by night , they will destroy till they have enough .
