translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki kheit sohwaiñ , ki ieh de katto katne halor dieng , bad haba ki nonglute ki wan mynmiet , ki shim tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .

translation.en: That they may know from the rising of the sun , and from the west , that there is none beside me . I am the  Lord  , and there is none else .
translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei shaduh kawei pat ka tduh kan tip ba nga long U  Trai bad ym don uwei pat U Blei .

translation.en: And take heed to yourselves , lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting , and drunkenness , and cares of this life , and so that day come upon you unawares .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ! Wat pynlut por shaba palat ha ka jingkhawai bad ka jingïadih bad ha ki jingkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ïoh ba kata Ka Sngi kan kem kynsan ïa phi kum ka jingriam .

translation.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker : and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished .
translation.kha: Lada phi rkhiebeiñ ïa ki briew kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki . Phin shah pynshitom lada phi leh sngewbha ha ka apot jongno jongno .

translation.en: This is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’

translation.en: And when he sowed , some seeds fell by the way side , and the fowls came and devoured them up :
translation.kha: Katba u dang bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , khyndiat na u symbai u la hap ha lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat , bad ki sim ki la wan bad bam noh .

translation.en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him  ; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters : for they knew all that his father was a Greek .
translation.kha: U Paul u la kwah ban ïalam bad u ïa u Timothi , kumta u la otsher ïa u . U la leh kumta namar baroh ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha kita ki jaka ki tip ba u kpa jong u Timothi u long u Grik .

translation.en: Ye observe days , and months , and times , and years .
translation.kha: Phi pynleit jingmut kyrpang ïa ki katto katne ki sngi , ki bnai , ki aïom , bad ki snem .

translation.en: And while he lingered , the men laid hold upon his hand , and upon the hand of his wife , and upon the hand of his two daughters  ; the  Lord  being merciful unto him : and they brought him forth , and set him without the city .
translation.kha: U Lot u leh tud pynban . Hynrei U  Trai  u la leh-isynei ïa u ; kumta kita ki rangbah ki shim ïa u , ïa ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u na ka kti bad ki la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , who redeemed Abraham , concerning the house of Jacob , Jacob shall not now be ashamed , neither shall his face now wax pale .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la pyllait ïa u Abraham na ka jingjynjar , u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong nga , phin ym shah pynlehrain shuh , bad ki khmat jong phi kin ym i-blad shuh da ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: Then they suborned men , which said , We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses , and against God .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ki rangbah ban ong ,  Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u da kren pyrshah ïa u Moses bad pyrshah ïa U Blei .

translation.en: The burden of the word of the  Lord  in the land of Hadrach , and Damascus shall be the rest thereof : when the eyes of man , as of all the tribes of Israel , shall be toward the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor jong U  Trai  : U la rai pynshitom ïa ka ri Hadrakh bad ïa ka nongbah Damaskos . Ym tang ki jait Israel hynrei ka nongbah Syria ruh ka long ka jong U  Trai .

translation.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison , desirous to apprehend me :
translation.kha: Haba nga la don ha Damaskos , u lyngskor hapoh u syiem Aretas u la pynap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah ban kem ïa nga .

translation.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall , and were set down together , Peter sat down among them .
translation.kha: La pynmeh ïa ka ding hapdeng jong ka phyllaw , bad u Petros u la ïasoh lem bad kito kiba ïashong sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: For we brought nothing into this world , and it is certain we can carry nothing out .
translation.kha: Ngi wallam aïu sha ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei ! Ngi lah ban rah aïu pat na ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei !

translation.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers : for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness ? and what communion hath light with darkness ?
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban ïatreilang ryngkat bad ki bymngeit , naba kam lah ban long . Kumno kaba dei bad kaba bakla kin ïadon bynta lang ? Kumno ka jingshai bad ka jingdum kin ïasah lang ?

translation.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward .
translation.kha: Kumta u la sdang bishni bad suba sniew ïa u Dabid naduh kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And he said ,  Woe unto you also , ye lawyers ! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne , and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  A katno kaba shyrkhei ruh ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi buh ki jingkit halor ki met jong ki briew , kiba eh ïa ka ban kit , hynrei phi hi phim kner wat kawei ka shympriah kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa kita ki jingkit .

translation.en: Even after a certain rate every day , offering according to the commandment of Moses , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts , three times in the year , even in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: u la kñia ki jingainguh thang kat kum ka jingdawa jong ka Hukum u Moses na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi kaba khuid : ki Sabbaton , ki Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam kiba man ka snem — ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , bad ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: Be not afraid , ye beasts of the field : for the pastures of the wilderness do spring , for the tree beareth her fruit , the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength .
translation.kha: Ko ki mrad , wat sheptieng . Ki jaka phlang ki long kiba jyrngam ; ki dieng ki sei ïa la ki soh , bad don kyrhai ki soh Dumbur bad sohwaiñ .

translation.en: For except we had lingered , surely now we had returned this second time .
translation.kha: Lada ngim shym la pyntud katne katne , ngin jin da la wan phai kylla ar sien .

translation.en: For , behold , the days are coming , in the which they shall say , Blessed are the barren , and the wombs that never bare , and the paps which never gave suck .
translation.kha: Naba ki sngi ki wan ha kaba ki briew kin ong , ‘ Katno kiba donbok long ki kynthei ki bym ju don khun , ki bym ju kha khunlung , ki bym ju bsa ïa ki !’

translation.en: And I heard a voice from heaven , as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of a great thunder : and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps :
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka kshaid , bad kum ka jingtied jam jong u pyrthat . Ka sawa kum ka sur jingtem ba la tem da ki nongtem kiba tem ïa la ki duitara .

translation.en: And the saying pleased the king and the princes  ; and the king did according to the word of Memucan :
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synshar ki la sngewtynnat ïa kata ka jingai jingmut , bad u syiem u la leh ïa kaei kaba u Memukan u la ai jingmut .

translation.en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity , and walketh with wicked men .
translation.kha: U sngewtynnat ha ka kynhun paralok bad ki briew kiba bymman bad u ïaid sawdong bad ki nongpop .

translation.en: A new heart also will I give you , and a new spirit will I put within you : and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh , and I will give you an heart of flesh .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka dohnud kaba thymmai bad ïa ka jingmut kaba thymmai . Ngan khlaw noh na phi ïa ka dohnud maw ba-eh rang jong phi , bad ngan ai ha phi ka dohnud kaba kohnguh .

translation.en: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof , and darkness shall pursue his enemies .
translation.kha: Kum ka jingsyllad ka jingshlei um bakhraw u pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong u ; u phah sha ka jingïap jong ki ïa kito kiba pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: And the nations were angry , and thy wrath is come , and the time of the dead , that they should be judged , and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets , and to the saints , and them that fear thy name , small and great  ; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth .
translation.kha: Kiba mane blei thala ki la dap da ka jingbitar shla , namar ka por jong ka jingbitar jong me ka la poi , ka por ban bishar ïa kiba ïap . Ka por ka la poi ban ainong ïa ki shakri jong me , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ïa ki briew jong me baroh , kito baroh kiba tiengburom ïa me , kiba khraw bad kiba rit kumjuh . Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa kito kiba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long kiba na ka longïing longsem jong u Aaron bad u Moses ha ka por ba U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai .

translation.en: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia .
translation.kha: Kumta phi la kylla long ka nuksa ïa kiba ngeit baroh ha Makedonia bad ha Akhaïa .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people  ; Ye have scattered my flock , and driven them away , and have not visited them : behold , I will visit upon you the evil of your doings , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong shaphang ki nongsynshar kiba la tharai ba kin sumar ïa ki briew jong u :  Phim shym la sumar bha ïa ki briew jong nga ; phi la pynsakma ïa ki bad phi la beh noh ïa ki . Mynta ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingbymman jong phi kaba phi la leh .

translation.en: Then began he to curse and to swear , saying , I know not the man . And immediately the cock crew .
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ,  Nga smai ba nga ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa nga lada ngam long kumta ! Ngam ithuh ïa uta u briew !  Kumta hi u syiar u la kyn-ih ,

translation.en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight , to them that have sworn oaths : but he will call to remembrance the iniquity , that they may be taken .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem kim lah ban ngeit ïa kane , namar ki jingïateh lok kiba ki la pynlong . Hynrei kane ka jingïathuhlypa ka long ban pynkynmaw ïa ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ban maham ïa ki ba kin sa shah kurup .

translation.en: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men ; and the weakness of God is stronger than men .
translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba i kum ka jingibieit U Blei ka long kaba kham stad ban ïa ka jingstad briew , bad kaei kaba i kumba ka long ka jingtlot U Blei ka long kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka bor briew .

translation.en: I have cut off the nations : their towers are desolate  ; I made their streets waste , that none passeth by : their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , that there is none inhabitant .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la pynduh lut ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; nga la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki bad iehnoh ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki kut jong ki ha ki jingjot . Ki nongbah ki la shah iehnoh ; ki lynti bah ki thylli — ym shym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .

translation.en: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed , he went into his house  ; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem , he kneeled upon his knees three times a day , and prayed , and gave thanks before his God , as he did aforetime .
translation.kha: Haba u Daniel u la tip ba ïa ka hukum la lah soi , u la leit sha ïing . Ha ka kamra kaba haneng jong ka ïing jong u la don ki jingkhangïit kiba phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta , kumba u la ju ïai leh , u la dem khohsiew ha ki jingkhangïit ba la plie bad u duwai sha U Blei lai sien shi sngi .

translation.en: And Solomon told her all her questions : and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not .
translation.kha: U jubab ïa ki baroh ; ym don kano kano kaba eh than kaba um lah ban batai .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you : for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba shoh ïa phi u shoh ïa uta uba kordor eh ha nga .  Kumta U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga lem bad kane ka khubor ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba la lute ïa ki briew jong u :

translation.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him ! that I might come even to his seat !
translation.kha: Haduh katno nga kwah ba ngan tip hangno ngan shem ïa u , ban tip kumno ngan leit shano ba u don .

translation.en: If ye had known me , ye should have known my Father also : and from henceforth ye know him , and have seen him .
translation.kha: Mynta ba phi la ithuh ïa nga ,  u la ong ha ki ,  phin ithuh ïa U Kpa jong nga ruh ; bad naduh mynta phi da ithuh ïa u bad phi la ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: Remove from me the way of lying : and grant me thy law graciously .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa nga na kaba leit ha ka lynti kaba bakla , bad ha ka jingbha jong me to hikai ïa nga ïa ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us : and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip kaei ka jingieit : U Khrist u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi . Ngi ruh , namarkata , ngi dei ban ai ïa la ki jingim na ka bynta ki parabriew !

translation.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty , thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness : I will cast thee to the ground , I will lay thee before kings , that they may behold thee .
translation.kha: Me la sngewsarong ba me long uba bhabriew , bad ka nam jong me ka la pynlong ïa me ban leh kum u bieit . Namar kane nga la bret ïa me sha khyndew bad ieh ïa me kum ka jingmaham ïa kiwei pat ki syiem .

translation.en: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . Then Libnah revolted at the same time .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por ka Edom ka la laitluid na ka Judah . Ha kane kajuh ka por ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him , they said , The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha . And they came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .
translation.kha: Ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa na Jerikho ki la ïohi ïa u bad ki ong ,  Ka bor u Elijah ka don ha u Elisha !  Ki la leit ban ïashem ïa u , ki la nguh ngon ha khmat jong u ,

translation.en: In which room did you sleep ?
translation.kha: Ha kano ka kamra phi thiah ?

translation.en: In those days there was no king in Israel : every man did that which was right in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Ym shym la don syiem ha Israel ha kata ka por . Uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Go in peace . So he departed from him a little way .
translation.kha: Khie leit suk leit saiñ ,  u Elisha u ong . Bad u Naaman u leit noh . U la leit dang khyndiat ka jingjngai ,

translation.en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years , that the  Lord  will visit Tyre , and she shall turn to her hire , and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Haba ki hynñiewphew snem ki la kut , U  Trai  un sa shah ïa ka Tyros ban leit phai pat sha ka kam khaïi kaba mynshuwa , bad kan aiwai ïa lade sha baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Therefore I will look unto the  Lord   ; I will wait for the God of my salvation : my God will hear me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ap khmih ïa U  Trai  ; ngan ap skhem ïa U Blei , u ban pyllait im ïa nga . U Blei jong nga un sngew ïa nga .

translation.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali , and Shechem in mount Ephraim , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .
translation.kha: Kumta , ha ka liang sepngi jong ka Jordan ki buh kyrpang ïa ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , ha ka ri lum Naphtali , ïa ka Shekhem ha ka ri lum Ephraim , bad ïa ka Hebron ha ka ri lum Judah .

translation.en: Ask thy young men , and they will shew thee . Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes : for we come in a good day : give , I pray thee , whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants , and to thy son David .
translation.kha: Shu kylli ïa ki , bad kin ïathuh ïa phi . Ngi la wan ha ka sngi jingkhawai , bad u Dabid u kyrpad ïa phi ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi . Sngewbha ai ïa kaba phi lah ha ngi ki shakri jong phi bad ha u paralok ba-ieit jong phi , u Dabid .

translation.en: And now I have sent a cunning man , endued with understanding , of Huram my father s ,
translation.kha: Nga phah sha phi u nongshna jingshna uba stad bad uba tbit bha , uba kyrteng u Huram .

translation.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle , and the tabernacle of the congregation , his covering , and the covering of the badgers  skins that is above upon it , and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
translation.kha: Na ka jait u Kohath ki mih ki longïing jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .

translation.en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters , that it might bring forth branches , and that it might bear fruit , that it might be a goodly vine .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la lah thung ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh bad kaba biang bha ka um ba kumta u lah ban sei ki sla bad pynmih ki sohwaiñ bad long u dieng sohwaiñ uba itynnat eh .

translation.en: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name , that will I do , that the Father may be glorified in the Son .
translation.kha: Bad ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pan ha ka kyrteng jong nga , khnang ba ïa ka burom U Kpa yn ïoh pynpaw lyngba U Khun .

translation.en: And he cried , saying , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
translation.kha: U la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! U Khun u Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !

translation.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn , and Heth ,
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Kanaan — u Sidon , u khun nyngkong jong u , bad u Heth — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .

translation.en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife : but he that putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be made fat .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhapnap ka pynmih tang ka jingjynjar . Phi long kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And Samuel did that which the  Lord  spake , and came to Beth–lehem . And the elders of the town trembled at his coming , and said , Comest thou peaceably ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha u ban leh bad u leit sha Bethlehem , ha kaba ki nongïalam jong kata ka nongbah ki wan da kaba kyiuh ban ïakynduh ïa u bad ki kylli ,  Hato kane ka long ka jingwan jngoh ha ka jingsuk , ko nongïohipaw ?

translation.en: And I said unto them , If ye think good , give me my price  ; and if not , forbear . So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ha ki ,  Lada phi mon , to ai ïa ka bainong jong nga . Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to bat noh ïa ka .  Kumta ki la siew ïa nga laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa kum ka bainong jong nga .

translation.en: For every house is builded by some man  ; but he that built all things is God .
translation.kha: Man la ka ïing , ha ka jingshisha , la tei da uno uno — Bad uta uba la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh long U Blei keiñ .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer :
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Nga la kwah shikatdei eh ban ïabam bad phi ïa kane ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha shuwa ba ngan shahshitom !

translation.en: Take an harp , go about the city , thou harlot that hast been forgotten  ; make sweet melody , sing many songs , that thou mayest be remembered .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka duitara , khie leit sawdong ïa ka shnong , Pha ka bapli ka nuti ba la klet noh ! To tem bad rwai biang ïa ki jingrwai jong pha To wallam ïa ki rangbah sa shisien pat .

translation.en: But whoso keepeth his word , in him verily is the love of God perfected : hereby know we that we are in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong u , u long uta uba ïa ka jingieit ïa U Blei la pynjanai da shisha . Dei da kane ba kumno ngi lah ban sngewskhem ba ngi long ha U Blei :

translation.en: But ( which becometh women professing godliness ) with good works .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ruh ba ki kynthei kin long kiba biang bad kiba sngewthuh ïa ki jaiñ ba ki riam bad ban riam da kaba dei ; ym da ki jingkhyllong shñiuh bakhyllah ne da ki jingdeng ksiar ne ki paila ne da ki jaiñkup riam kiba remdor , hynrei da ki kam babha , kumba ka dei ïa ki kynthei kiba kam ba ki long kiba riewblei .

translation.en: After this I beheld , and lo another , like a leopard , which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl  ; the beast had also four heads  ; and dominion was given to it .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang ap khmih , sa uwei pat u mradkhlaw u la mihpaw . U syriem kum u  labasa , hynrei ha ka met jong u la don saw tylli ki thapniang , kum ki thapniang jong ka sim , bad u don saw tylli ki khlieh . U don ka dur kum uba don ka bor .

translation.en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the  Lord  , and all the judgments : and all the people answered with one voice , and said , All the words which the  Lord  hath said will we do .
translation.kha: U Moses u wan ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa ki hukum baroh bad ïa ki aiñ baroh jong U  Trai  , bad ki briew baroh ki ïajubab lang ,  Ïa kita baroh kiba U  Trai  u ong , ngin leh .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him , But what hast thou lacked with me , that , behold , thou seekest to go to thine own country ? And he answered , Nothing : howbeit let me go in any wise .
translation.kha: Balei ?  u syiem u kylli .  Hato ngam shym lah ban ai ei ei ïa me ? Hato dei kata balei ba me da kwah ban leit phai sha ïing ?   Shu shah ïa nga ban leit ,  u Hadad u jubab ïa u syiem . Bad u leit phai sha la ka ri . Kum u syiem Edom , u Hadad u long uba bymman , u nongshun uba pynkthang ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa U Jisu ban mihnoh na ka thain jong ki .

translation.en: Blessed be God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of mercies , and the God of all comfort ;
translation.kha: To ngin ai ka jingnguh sha U Blei bad U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Kpa ba-dap da jingisynei , U Blei na uba ka jingïarap baroh ka wan !

translation.en: He that believeth on me , as the scripture hath said , out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Ki wahduid ka um kaba ai jingim kin tuid noh na ka dohnud jong u .’

translation.en: And they removed the burnt offerings , that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people , to offer unto the  Lord  , as it is written in the book of Moses . And so did they with the oxen .
translation.kha: Nangta ki pynïabynta hapdeng ki briew , kat kum ki kynhun longïing , ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang , khnang ba kin lah ban ai ïa ki kat kum ki jingbthah ha ka Hukum u Moses .

translation.en: Then answered the Jews and said unto him , What sign shewest thou unto us , seeing that thou doest these things ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la jubab da ka jingkylli ,  Ka kambah aïu ba me lah ban leh ban pyn-i ha ngi ba me don hok ban leh ïa kane ?

translation.en: And if the latter husband hate her , and write her a bill of divorcement , and giveth it in her hand , and sendeth her out of his house  ; or if the latter husband die , which took her to be his wife  ;
translation.kha: bad uta ruh u rai ba um mon shuh ïa ka , kumta u thoh ïa ki kot ïapyllait tnga , u ai ïa ki ha ka , bad u phah mihnoh ïa ka na ïing jong u , lane , haba u tnga jong ka uba ar u ïap ,

translation.en: God brought him forth out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn : he shall eat up the nations his enemies , and shall break their bones , and pierce them through with his arrows .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ; U ïaleh namar jong ki la kum u masi prut . Ki bam duh ïa ki nongshun jong ki , Ki pynlwet ïa ki shyieng jong ki , ki pynkheiñ ïa ki khnam jong ki .

translation.en: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph , of the house of David  ; and the virgin s name was Mary .
translation.kha: U la don ka khubor ïa ka theisotti kaba la ïatehktien bad u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph , uba long u nonghiarpateng na u syiem Dabid . Ka kyrteng jong ka , ka long ka Mari .

translation.en: Then saith Jesus unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ha kane hi ka miet phi baroh phin ïaphet noh bad iehnoh ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ki langbrot jong ka kynhun yn pynsakma .’

translation.en: Saul also sent messengers unto David s house , to watch him , and to slay him in the morning : and Michal David s wife told him , saying , If thou save not thy life to night , to morrow thou shalt be slain .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka miet u Saul u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban khmih siar ïa ka ïing u Dabid bad ban pynïap ïa u ha ka step kaba bud . Ka Mikhal , ka tnga u Dabid , ka maham ïa u ,  Lada phim phet mynta ka miet , lashai ka sngi phin long uba la ïap noh .

translation.en: So they turned and departed , and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them .
translation.kha: Ki phai bad ki leit noh , bad ki khynnah , ki jingri jingdup , bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa .

translation.en: And declared to be the Son of God with power , according to the spirit of holiness , by the resurrection from the dead :
translation.kha: shaphang ka jinglong Blei bakhuid jong u , la pyn-i shynna da ka bor bakhraw ban long U Khun jong U Blei da kaba pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: For he that said , Do not commit adultery , said also , Do not kill . Now if thou commit no adultery , yet if thou kill , thou art become a transgressor of the law .
translation.kha: Naba ujuh uba la ong ,  Wat klim ,  u la ong ruh ,  Wat pynïap .  Wat lada phim shym klim , phi la long nongpynkheiñ hukum lada phi pynïap briew .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans , which besiege you without the walls , and I will assemble them into the midst of this city .
translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , ngan jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Babilonia bad ki shipai jong u . Ngan kynton ïa ki tiar ïapom jong ki shipai jong me hamar pdeng jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: And when David s young men came , they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David , and ceased .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Nabal ha ka kyrteng u Dabid .

translation.en: And he called one of the servants , and asked what these things meant .
translation.kha: Kumta u la khot ïa uwei na ki shakri bad u la kylli ïa u , ‘ Ka jia aïu ?’

translation.en: But he denied , saying , I know not , neither understand I what thou sayest . And he went out into the porch  ; and the cock crew .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la len ïa kata .  Ngam tip . . . ngam sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba pha kren ,  u la jubab , bad u la leit noh sha ka baranda . Hamar kata ka por u syiar u la kyn-ih .

translation.en: The prophets prophesy falsely , and the priests bear rule by their means  ; and my people love to have it so : and what will ye do in the end thereof ?
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa kim kren ei ei hynrei tang ki jinglamler ; ki lyngdoh ki synshar tang kumba hukum ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki briew jong nga kim shym pynpaw jingpyrshah ei ei . Hynrei kin leh aïu haba baroh ka poi sha kaba kut ?

translation.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Eat no bread , nor drink water , nor turn again by the same way that thou camest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam lane dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba nga la wan .

translation.en: Have you started studying the Bible with Jehovah’s Witnesses ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la sdang pule ïa ka Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ?

translation.en: And sent messengers before his face : and they went , and entered into a village of the Samaritans , to make ready for him .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jong u , kiba la leit sha ka nongrit ha Samaria ban pynkhreh ïa kaei kaei baroh na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: And they that passed by railed on him , wagging their heads , and saying , Ah , thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki la kyrngah ïa la ki khlieh bad krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu :  Ade ! men pynjot ïa ka Templ bad tei pat ïa ka hapoh lai sngi !

translation.en: And thou shalt say , Thus shall Babylon sink , and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her : and they shall be weary . Thus far are the words of Jeremiah .
translation.kha: ‘ Kane ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Babilonia — kan ngam bad kan ym lah khie shuh , namar ka jingpynjot ba U  Trai  un wallam ha ka .’   Ki ktien jong u Jeremaïah ki kut hangne .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai , and had utterly destroyed it  ; as he had done to Jericho and her king , so he had done to Ai and her king  ; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel , and were among them  ;
translation.kha: U Adonisedek , u syiem ka Jerusalem , u ïohsngew ba u Joshua u la kurup bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka Ai bad u la pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka , kumba u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa u syiem jong ka . U ïohsngew ruh ba ki nong Gibeon ki la ïasuk bad ki Israel bad ba ki shong hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens , that thou wouldest come down , that the mountains might flow down at thy presence ,
translation.kha: Balei ba mem kad arliang ïa ka sahit bneng bad wan hiar ? Ki lumbah kin ïohi ïa me bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And when the sabbath was past , Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James , and Salome , had bought sweet spices , that they might come and anoint him .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka sngi Sabbaton ka la kut , ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob , bad ka Salome ki la thied ki musla ban leit pynsleh ïa ka met U Jisu .

translation.en: Say among the heathen that the  Lord  reigneth : the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved : he shall judge the people righteously .
translation.kha: To ong ha ki jaitbynriew baroh ,  U  Trai  u long u syiem ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynshong skhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhih ; un bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew da ka hok .

translation.en: In that day sing ye unto her , A vineyard of red wine .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  un ong shaphang ka bri sohwaiñ ba-itynnat jong u ,

translation.en: And he said , Peace be to you , fear not : your God , and the God of your father , hath given you treasure in your sacks : I had your money . And he brought Simeon out unto them .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri u ong ,  Wat khuslai . Wat sheptieng ruh . Dei U Blei jong phi , U Blei jong u kpa jong phi , uba la thep ïa ki pisa ha ki byrni jong phi na ka bynta jong phi . Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka dor ba phi la siew .  Nangta u wan ïalam ïa u Simeon sha ki .

translation.en: For if thou refuse to let them go , and wilt hold them still ,
translation.kha: Lada me kyntait biang ban shah ïa ki ban leit ,

translation.en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor , one  ; the king of the nations of Gilgal , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Dor ( harud duriaw ) , Goiim ( ha Galilaïa ) ,

translation.en: That there came certain from Shechem , from Shiloh , and from Samaria , even fourscore men , having their beards shaven , and their clothes rent , and having cut themselves , with offerings and incense in their hand , to bring them to the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , shuwa ba uno uno un tip shaphang ka jingshah pynïap u Gedalaïah , phraphew ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha Shekhem , Shiloh bad Samaria . Ki la khi ïa la ki  ñiuhtmoh , kad ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki pynmong ïa lade . Ki dang ïashim kew bad jingiwbih ban ai ha ka Templ .

translation.en: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .
translation.kha: Namar ba ka dohnud jong phi kan ïai don ha ka jaka kaba don ka spah jong phi .

translation.en: And the children of Israel said to Samuel , Cease not to cry unto the  Lord  our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: bad ong ha u Samuel ,  To ïai duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia .

translation.en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night  ; There stood a man of Macedonia , and prayed him , saying , Come over into Macedonia , and help us .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba u la ïohi ïa u nong Makedonia uba ïeng bad kyrpad ïa u ,  Ale shane sha Makedonia bad ïarap ïa ngi !

translation.en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number , then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the  Lord  , when thou numberest them  ; that there be no plague among them , when thou numberest them .
translation.kha: Haba me shim jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon ki paid Israel , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban siew ïa nga ïa ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , khnang ba kano kano kaba sniew kan ym wan ha u katba dang shim jingkheiñ .

translation.en: And , behold , I am with thee , and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest , and will bring thee again into this land  ; for I will not leave thee , until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , ba ngan long ryngkat bad me bad ïada ïa me kat shaba me leit , bad ngan wallam pat ïa me sha kane ka ri . Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me tad haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kata baroh ïa kaba nga la kular ha me .

translation.en: But thou , O man of God , flee these things ; and follow after righteousness , godliness , faith , love , patience , meekness .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , ko u briew jong U Blei , to kiar na kine kiei kiei . To ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka hok , ka jingriewblei , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , ka jingïaishah , bad ka jingjemnud .

translation.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward :
translation.kha: Da shisha phi la ïohsngew ba U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name , and I sent them not , yet they say , Sword and famine shall not be in this land  ; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa kaei ba ngan leh ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ngam shym phah hynrei kiba kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad ong ba ka thma bad ka jingïapthngan kin ym lynshop ïa kane ka ri — ngan pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma bad da ka jingïapthngan .

translation.en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites , and said to them , Go out unto the cities of Judah , and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year , and see that ye hasten the matter . Howbeit the Levites hastened it not .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban leit sha ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ban lum na ki briew baroh kat ban biang ban shna pynbha ïa ka Templ man ka snem . U ong ïa ki ban leh kloi , hynrei ki Lebi ki pyntud ,

translation.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters : in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me .
translation.kha: Ki la rung lyngba ki thliew jong ki jaka ïada jong nga bad ki wan ïuh beit nalor jong nga ;

translation.en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul , and bind them for a sign upon your hand , that they may be as frontlets between your eyes .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kine ki hukum bad ñiewkor ïa ki . Teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi kum ka jingpynkynmaw .

translation.en: And as the people were in expectation , and all men mused in their hearts of John , whether he were the Christ , or not  ;
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong ki briew ka la sdang ban kiew , bad ki la sdang ban pyrkhat la u Ïoannis lehse u lah ban dei U Messaïah .

translation.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first .
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw balei nga la ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha phi ha kaba nyngkong ; ka long namar ba nga la pang .

translation.en: And she said , These six measures of barley gave he me  ; for he said to me , Go not empty unto thy mother in law .
translation.kha: Ka bynrap ,  U ong ïa nga ba ngam dei ban wan phai thylli sha phi , kumta u ai ïa nga ïa une u barli baroh .

translation.en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies ? who can forgive sins but God only ?
translation.kha: Kumno u nud ban kren kumne ? Kane ka dei ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei ! Dei tang U Blei hi marwei uba lah ban map ïa ki pop !

translation.en: He stood , and measured the earth : he beheld , and drove asunder the nations  ; and the everlasting mountains were scattered , the perpetual hills did bow : his ways are everlasting .
translation.kha: Haba u sangeh , ka pyrthei ka khih ; u tang shu peit , ki jaitbynriew ki kyiuh . Ki lumbah ba bymjukut ki khih ; ki lumrit baneh junom ki ngam shapoh , ki lumrit ha kiba u ju ïaid ha ki por mynbarim .

translation.en: For as yet they knew not the scripture , that he must rise again from the dead .
translation.kha: ( Kim pat sngewthuh hi ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba la ong ba u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap . )

translation.en: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah , What have I offended against thee , or against thy servants , or against this people , that ye have put me in prison ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ,  Kaei ka kam runar ba nga la leh pyrshah ïa phi lane ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi lane ïa kane ka jaitbynriew , kaba pynlong ïa phi ban thep ïa nga ha byndi ?

translation.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno kan jia ha ka sngi ba yn pynpaw ïa U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: And the angel took the censer , and filled it with fire of the altar , and cast it into the earth : and there were voices , and thunderings , and lightnings , and an earthquake .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u la shim ïa kata ka pliang thang jingiwbih , u la pyndap ïa ka da ki rnga ding barhem na ka duwan , bad u la bret ïa ka halor ka khyndew . La don ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ki jingthaba leilieh , bad u jumai .

translation.en: And David said unto Jonathan , Behold , to morrow is the new moon , and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat : but let me go , that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even .
translation.kha: Lashai ka sngi ka dei ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai  u Dabid u jubab  bad nga dei ban ïashong bam ryngkat bad u syiem . Hynrei lada ka long kaba biang ïa phi , ngan leit noh ban rieh ha ki bri haduh la shi sngi janmiet .

translation.en: And the  Lord  smote the king , so that he was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house . And Jotham the king s son was over the house , judging the people of the land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u shoh ïa u Ussaïah da ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba shyrkhei kaba la sah bad u shi lynter ka jingim jong u . U sah hi marwei ha la ka jong ka ïing , la pyllait ïa u na ki kamram baroh , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u pynïaid ïa ka hima .

translation.en: And saith unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death : tarry ye here , and watch .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsngewsih ha ka dohnud jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta katta haduh ba ka la jan pynlwet ïa nga . Ïashong hangne bad to ïai ap .

translation.en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill , she caught him by the feet : but Gehazi came near to thrust her away . And the man of God said , Let her alone  ; for her soul is vexed within her : and the  Lord  hath hid it from me , and hath not told me .
translation.kha: hynrei haba ka la wan ha u Elisha ka la nguh ngon ha khmat jong u bad ka la bat ïa ki kjat jong u . U Gehasi u la mut sa ban khynñiat ïa ka sharud , hynrei u Elisha u ong ,  Wat pynwit ïa ka . Mem ïohi ba ka khuslai jur ? Bad U  Trai  um shym ïathuh ei ei shaphang kata .

translation.en: And Mizpah  ; for he said , The  Lord  watch between me and thee , when we are absent one from another .
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ruh ,  To U  Trai  un khmih halor jong ngi haba ngi la ïakhlad iwei na iwei pat .  Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ruh ka Mispah .

translation.en: And he brought me into the inner court of the  Lord s  house , and , behold , at the door of the temple of the  Lord  , between the porch and the altar , were about five and twenty men , with their backs toward the temple of the  Lord  , and their faces toward the east  ; and they worshipped the sun toward the east .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh ka Templ . Hangta hajan ka jaka rung sha ka jaka kyntang , hapdeng ka duwan bad ka lynti rung , la don arphew san ngut ki rangbah . Ki phai dadien ïa ka jaka kyntang , bad ki pyndem ïa lade shaphang mihngi , ki da mane ïa ka sngi kaba dang mih .

translation.en: Saying , When will the new moon be gone , that we may sell corn ? and the sabbath , that we may set forth wheat , making the ephah small , and the shekel great , and falsifying the balances by deceit ?
translation.kha: Phi ong ha lade ,  Ngim lah ap slem ïa ki sngi bakhuid ba kin kut noh khnang ba ngi lah ban die ïa u kew jong ngi . Lano ka sngi Sabbaton kan kut , khnang ba ngin ïoh sdang ban die biang ? Nangta ngi lah ban oh dor rem , pyndonkam da ki jingthew bymhok , bad pynbakla ïa ki tarajur ban thok ïa ki nongthied jong ngi .

translation.en: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel . Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies . Furthermore I tell thee that the  Lord  will build thee an house .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ka jaka na ka bynta ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad nga la pynshong pynsah ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kin shongduh shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh ba ki la rung ha kane ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh pyrshah ha ki briew kiba runar , hynrei kane kan ym jia shuh . Nga kular ban jop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me bad ban ai ha me ki nonghiarpateng .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as Moses entered into the tabernacle , the cloudy pillar descended , and stood at the door of the tabernacle , and the  Lord  talked with Moses .
translation.kha: Ynda u Moses u la rung shapoh jong ka , u rishot lyoh u wan hiar bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses na uta u lyoh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the  Lord  their God , for which the  Lord  their God had sent him to them , even all these words ,
translation.kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa ki paidbah baroh kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha ki .

translation.en: I pray thee , forgive the trespass of thine handmaid : for the  Lord  will certainly make my lord a sure house  ; because my lord fighteth the battles of the  Lord  , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days .
translation.kha: Sngewbha map ïa nga , ko kynrad , na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa phi u syiem , bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ruh , naba phi ïaleh ïa ki thma jong u ; bad phin ym leh kano kano kaba sniew katba phi dang im .

translation.en: And it is yet far more evident : for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest ,
translation.kha: Kane ka bynta ka la kham shai shuh shuh , ba uwei pat u lyngdoh uba pher u la paw , uba syriem ïa u Melkhisedek .

translation.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart : thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour , and not suffer sin upon him .
translation.kha: Wat buhnud ïano ïano , hynrei ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïapher jingmut hapdeng jong phi , khnang ba yn ym pynleh pop ïa phi namar jong u .

translation.en: Little children , keep yourselves from idols . Amen .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , to phin ri kyndong ïa lade na ki blei ba-thala !

translation.en: And slew famous kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba pawnam ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: And sounded , and found it twenty fathoms : and when they had gone a little further , they sounded again , and found it fifteen fathoms .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynhiar ïa u tyllai lem bad u sisa ba la teh ha u , bad ki la shem ba ka um ka don kumba sawphew mitar ka jingjylliew ; kham katto katne hadien ki la leh kumjuh bad ki la shem ba ka don laiphew mitar ka jingjylliew .

translation.en: And also thus said the king , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which hath given one to sit on my throne this day , mine eyes even seeing it .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid u dem ngon ha ka jingmane ha la ka jingthiah bad u duwai , ‘ To ngin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba ha kane ka sngi u la pynlong syiem hadien jong nga ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad ba u la shah ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kata !’

translation.en: Then came Peter to him , and said , Lord , how oft shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? till seven times ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la wan sha U Jisu bad u la kylli ,  Ko Trai , lada u hynmen u para jong nga u ïai leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , haduh katno sien nga dei ban map ïa u ? Haduh hynñiew sien ?

translation.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks , and for the coulters , and for the forks , and for the axes , and to sharpen the goads .
translation.kha: ka bai shut sdie bad ka bai moramot ïa ki dieng tyndung ka long shi sbai rit , bad ka bai shut nar lyngkor lane shut mohkhiew ka long ar tylli ki sbai rit . )

translation.en: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes , Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only , but also to all the princes , and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Nangta u Memukan u ong ha u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar :  Ka Bashti , ka Mahadei ka la krenbeiñ ym tang ïa u syiem hynrei ïa ki rangbah synshar ruh — ha ka jingshisha , ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha ka hima !

translation.en: That confirmeth the word of his servant , and performeth the counsel of his messengers  ; that saith to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be inhabited  ; and to the cities of Judah , Ye shall be built , and I will raise up the decayed places thereof :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u shakri jong nga u pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa , haba nga phah ïa u nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , Nga pynlong ïa kito ki jingthmu bad ki jingïathuh lypa ban jia shisha . Nga ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki briew kin shong biang hangta , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn sa tei pat . Kito ki nongbah kin ïeng na ki jingjot .

translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand , in the fruit of thy body , and in the fruit of thy cattle , and in the fruit of thy land , for good : for the  Lord  will again rejoice over thee for good , as he rejoiced over thy fathers :
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynroi kyrhai ïa phi kat ha kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh kyrhai ki khun ki kti bad kyrhai ki jingri , bad ki lyngkha jong phi ruh kin pynmih kyrhai . Un da sngewbha eh ban pynmanbha ïa phi kumba u la sngewbha ban pynmanbha ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ;

translation.en: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola , and Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .
translation.kha: U Issakhar u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Tola , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .

translation.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own ? Is thine eye evil , because I am good ?
translation.kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban leh katba nga sngewbit ïa la ka jong ka pisa ? Ne phi ïa-bishni namar ba nga long uba sbun ?’

translation.en: Behold , my servant shall deal prudently , he shall be exalted and extolled , and be very high .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  U shakri jong nga un jop ha ka kam jong u ; un ïoh ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years . Then died Jephthah the Gileadite , and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Jephthah u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynriew snem . Hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha shnong jong u kaba ha Gilead .

translation.en: And he straitly charged him , and forthwith sent him away  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong skhem ïa u bad phah noh ïa kumta hi ,

translation.en: And Joab said unto the man that told him , And , behold , thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground ? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver , and a girdle .
translation.kha: U Joab u jubab ,  Lada me la ïohi ïa u , balei men shym pynïap ïa u ha shen ? Nga da lade hi ngan jin da la ai ha me shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad uwei u panpoh .

translation.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves , and the changers of money sitting :
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Templ u la lap ïa ki briew kiba ïadie ïa ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki paro , bad ki nongïapeiñ pisa ruh ki ïashong ha ki miej jong ki .

translation.en: But those things , which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets , that Christ should suffer , he hath so fulfilled .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynbna naduh mynshuwa lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa baroh ba U Messaïah jong u , u dei ban shahshitom ; bad u la pynlong ïa ka , ban jia shisha ha kane ka rukom .

translation.en: Thy men shall fall by the sword , and thy mighty in the war .
translation.kha: Ïa ki rangbah jong ka nongbah , ho-oid wat ki rangbah bakhlaiñ tam , yn pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things ? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves ?
translation.kha: Slem haduh katno ki riewrunar kin leh sarong bad kob shaphang ki kam runar jong ki ?

translation.en: Behold , I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ka sngi kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei jong U  Trai  kan wan , ngan phah ha phi ïa u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And let us not be weary in well doing : for in due season we shall reap , if we faint not .
translation.kha: Kumta to ai ba ngin ym man thait ha kaba lehbha ; namar lada ngim duh bor noh , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngin lum ïa ka jingot .

translation.en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem , A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people , not to fan , nor to cleanse ,
translation.kha: Ka por ka wan ha kaba ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem yn ïathuh ba ka lyer khluit ka beh shapoh sha ki na ka ri shyiap . Kan ym long ka lyer kaba jai jai kaba shu beh pynher noh ïa u stait —

translation.en: For I say , through the grace given unto me , to every man that is among you , not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think ; but to think soberly , according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith .
translation.kha: Bad namar ka jingaiei U Blei ïa nga , nga ong ïa uwei pa uwei na phi : To wat ñiewkor palat than ïa lade ban ïa kaba phi dei ban leh . Pynban , to long adkar ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi , bad to bishar ïa lade kat kum ka jingngeit kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Because they had not executed my judgments , but had despised my statutes , and had polluted my sabbaths , and their eyes were after their fathers  idols .
translation.kha: Nga la leh ïa kane namar ba ki la lah kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton , bad mane ïa kijuh ki bleithaw kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la shakri .

translation.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh  ; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew la kha ha ka doh na ki kmie ki kpa kiba long ki briew , hynrei la kha ha kaba kynja mynsiem na U Mynsiem .

translation.en: Yet now be strong , O Zerubbabel , saith the  Lord   ; and be strong , O Joshua , son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ; and be strong , all ye people of the land , saith the  Lord  , and work : for I am with you , saith the  Lord  of hosts :
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta to wat duh jingkyrmen , mano mano ruh na phi . Leh la ka kam , naba nga long ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob , and sent him away to Paddan–aram , to take him a wife from thence  ; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan  ;
translation.kha: U Iso u la ïoh jingtip ba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u Jakob bad ba u la phah noh ïa u sha Mesopotamia ban shem ïa ka tnga . U la ïoh jingtip ruh ba haba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u , u hukum ba un ym shongkurim ïa ka kynthei nong Kanaan .

translation.en: And now the  Lord  shew kindness and truth unto you : and I also will requite you this kindness , because ye have done this thing .
translation.kha: Bad mynta pat , to U  Trai  un lehsbun bad ïaineh skhem bad phi . Nga ruh ngan lehbha ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh .

translation.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk , even as he walked .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ong ba u ïaisah ha U Blei u dei ban im kumba U Jisu Khrist u la im .

translation.en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened , and have tasted of the heavenly gift , and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost ,
translation.kha: Naba da kumno lah ban ïalam pat ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ba kin kylla-kaba-mut biang ? Ki la don shisien ha ka jingshai U Blei ; ki la ïohmad ïa ka jingai ba kynja bneng , bad ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;

translation.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves , and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long kawei ka jaiñ jingtap , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah ba kin long kawei pat ka jaiñ jingtap . Khylliap ar syrtap ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba hynriew kaba ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: So Hanameel mine uncle s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the  Lord  , and said unto me , Buy my field , I pray thee , that is in Anathoth , which is in the country of Benjamin : for the right of inheritance is thine , and the redemption is thine  ; buy it for thyself . Then I knew that this was the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumba U  Trai  u la ong , u Hanamel u la wan sha nga hangta ha ka phyllaw bad u la ong ïa nga ba ngan thied ïa ka lyngkha . Kumta nga sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la kren shisha ha nga .

translation.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites , which dwelt in Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , which dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei :
translation.kha: hadien ba U  Trai  u la jop ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba shong ha Heshbon , bad ïa u Og u syiem Bashan , uba synshar ha ki shnong Ashtaroth bad Edrei .

translation.en: There was in the days of Herod , the king of Judaea , a certain priest named Zacharias , of the course of Abia : and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron , and her name was Elisabeth .
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynba U Herod u long u syiem ka Judia , la don u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Sekharaïah , uba dei na ka pateng lyngdoh jong u Abijah . Ka kyrteng jong ka tnga jong u , ka long ka Elisabeth ; ma ka ruh ka la long na ka longïing lyngdoh .

translation.en: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon , who will commit to your trust the true riches ?
translation.kha: Te lada ym pat lah ban shaniah ïa phi ha kaba pynïaid ïa ka spah pyrthei , kumno yn shaniah ha phi ïa ka spah bashisha ?

translation.en: And he said , Take now thy son , thine only son Isaac , whom thou lovest , and get thee into the land of Moriah  ; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u khun jong me ,  U Blei u ong ,  u Isaak , u khun ba tang marwei jong me , ïa uba me ieit thep mynsiem , bad leit sha ka ri Moraïah . Hangta halor u lum ïa uba ngan sa pyn-i ha me , kñia ïa u kum ka jingainguh ha nga .

translation.en: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys , thy flowing valley , O backsliding daughter ? that trusted in her treasures , saying , Who shall come unto me ?
translation.kha: Balei ba ma phi ki briew bymïaineh phi kren sarong ? Ka jingkhlaiñ jong phi ka la nang hiar . Balei ba phi shaniah ha la ka bor bad phi ong ba ym don ba nud ban tur ïaleh ïa phi ?

translation.en: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it : and as he was destroying , the  Lord  beheld , and he repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed , It is enough , stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa u angel ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jerusalem ; hynrei u kylla ïa kaba u mut bad u ong ha u angel ,  Keiñ noh ! Katto ka la biang !  U angel u ïeng hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .

translation.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols , then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it  ; and , lo , thus have they done in the midst of mine house .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi hi ba ki pynïap ïa ki khun jong nga kum ki jingkñia sha ki bleithaw , ki la wan sha ka Templ jong nga bad pyntngit ïa ka !

translation.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again , and be changed unto white , he shall come unto the priest  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei haba kata ka prum ka la jem bad ka la kylla lieh biang , uta u briew u dei ban leit sha u lyngdoh , u ban khmih bniah biang ïa u .

translation.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban kren tipbriew ha uba bieit ; um lah ban ïaroh ïa ka .

translation.en: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him , and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need , in that which he wanteth .
translation.kha: pynban , to long kiba kylluid mynsiem bad ai kylliang ïa u kat kaba u donkam .

translation.en: And they said , What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpah to the  Lord  ? And , behold , there came none to the camp from Jabesh–gilead to the assembly .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli lada don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha Mispah , ki shem ba ym don uwei ruh na Jabesh ha Gilead kiba la don hangta ;

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte , and when he is made , ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi leit lyngba ki duriaw bad phi ïaid sha kylleng ki ri baroh ban pynkylla ïano ïano ; bad haba phi lah , phi pynlong ïa u ar shah uba dei ban leit sha dujok kumba phi hi , phi long !

translation.en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering  ; and they shall cleanse the altar , as they did cleanse it with the bullock .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud men shim ïa u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad ai ïa u kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . To pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da ka snam jong u ha kajuh ka rukom kumba me leh da u masi lyngraw .

translation.en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter : and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam .
translation.kha: U tur ïaleh ïa ki khlem riej bad u pynïap shibun na ki . Nangta u leit bad u sah ha ka krem mawsiang ha Etam .

translation.en: Behold , the  Lord s  hand is not shortened , that it cannot save  ; neither his ear heavy , that it cannot hear :
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u tlot palat ban pynim ïa phi lane ba u kyllut palat ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong phi ban ïoh jingïarap !

translation.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets : my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword  ; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger  ; thou hast killed , and not pitied .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki jingud jong nga ; ym don mano mano ban pyntngen ïa nga . Ki nongshun jong nga ki kmen ba me la wallam ka jingjot halor jong nga . To wallam ïa ka sngi kaba me la kular ; to pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban shahshitom kum ma nga .

translation.en: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren , strong men , eighteen .
translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u Meshelemaïah ka pynmih khatphra ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,

translation.en: That I may make it manifest , as I ought to speak .
translation.kha: To Duwai , te , ba nga lah ban kren , kumba nga dei , ha kata ka rukom ba kan long kaba shai .

translation.en: For thou hast made of a city an heap  ; of a defenced city a ruin : a palace of strangers to be no city  ; it shall never be built .
translation.kha: Me la pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad pynpra ïa ki jingtei-kut . Ki ïingsyiem kiba ki nongshun jong ngi ki la tei ki la jah noh junom .

translation.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward .
translation.kha: san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei pat ka liang , bad san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba shadien , shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples , and said ,  Blessed be ye poor : for yours is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih ha la ki synran bad u la ong ,  Suk phi kiba duk ; ka Hima U Blei ka long ka jong phi !

translation.en: And thus I saw the horses in the vision , and them that sat on them , having breastplates of fire , and of jacinth , and brimstone : and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions  ; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai jong ki : Ki don ki jingïada shadem kiba saw kum ka ding , kiba jngum kum u Sapphir , bad kiba stem kum u kyndok . Ki khlieh jong ki kulai ki la long kum ki khlieh sing , bad na ki shyntur jong ki la mih ka ding , ka tdem bad u kyndok .

translation.en: But he , being full of the Holy Ghost , looked up stedfastly into heaven , and saw the glory of God , and Jesus standing on the right hand of God ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Stephan , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Blei bad ïa U Jisu uba ïeng sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .

translation.en: Then said they , What shall be the trespass offering which we shall return to him ? They answered , Five golden emerods , and five golden mice , according to the number of the lords of the Philistines : for one plague was on you all , and on your lords .
translation.kha: Ka jingai sngewbha aïu ngin phah ïa u ?  Ki briew ki kylli . Ki la jubab ,  San tylli ki dur jong u thung kiba da ka ksiar bad san tylli ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u syiem Philistia . Ïa kajuh ka khlam la pynngat ha phi baroh bad ha baroh san ngut ki syiem .

translation.en: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it : and it shall bring forth boughs , and bear fruit , and be a goodly cedar : and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing  ; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell .
translation.kha: halor u lumbah bakynjang tam jong ka Israel . Un sei ki tnat bad pynmih ki symbai bad kylla long u dieng Kedar ba-itynnat eh . Ki sim kiba bun jait kin im hangta bad ïoh jingda ha ka syrngiew jong u .

translation.en: Now that being broken , whereas four stood up for it , four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation , but not in his power .
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki reng kiba la wan mih shalor haba la pynkheiñ noh ïa ka reng kaba nyngkong ki ïeng na ka bynta ki saw tylli ki hima sha kiba kata ka hima yn pynïabynta bad kin ym long kiba khlaiñ kum ka hima kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: And the messengers came again , and said , Thus speaketh Ben–hadad , saying , Although I have sent unto thee , saying , Thou shalt deliver me thy silver , and thy gold , and thy wives , and thy children  ;
translation.kha: Hadien ki nonglamktien ki wan biang sha u Ahab bad kawei pat ka jingdawa na u Benhadad ;  Nga la phah ktien sha me ba men aiti noh ha nga ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong me , bad ïa ki kynthei bad ki khun jong me .

translation.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies , and the house of Israel with deceit : but Judah yet ruleth with God , and is faithful with the saints .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki la ker sawdong ïa nga da ki jinglamler bad jingshukor , bad ki paid Judah ki dang ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , U Blei baïaineh bad uba khuid .

translation.en: But it shall be , when evening cometh on , he shall wash himself with water : and when the sun is down , he shall come into the camp again .
translation.kha: Ynda janmiet u dei ban sait ban sum ïa lade , bad ha ka por sep sngi u lah ban wan pat sha ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: Who is as the wise man ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing ? a man s wisdom maketh his face to shine , and the boldness of his face shall be changed .
translation.kha: Tang u briew uba stad u tip aïu kiei kiei ki kit jingmut shisha . Ka jingstad ka pynlong ïa u ban phuh samrkhie bad ka pynjah ïa ka jingnoh sngewsih ka durkhmat jong u .

translation.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit , or that is a wizard , shall surely be put to death : they shall stone them with stones : their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew lane ka briew kiba leh byrtong kin shah lynthem maw haduh ba kin da ïap ; uno uno u briew uba leh ïa kane u pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: We have an altar , whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei jong ki Jiw kim don hok ban bam na kano kano ka jingkñia ïa kaba la buh halor ka duwan jong ngi .

translation.en: And he went from thence to mount Carmel , and from thence he returned to Samaria .
translation.kha: U Elisha u la nang leit sha u Lum Karmel , bad hadien u la leit phai sha Samaria .

translation.en: And David was afraid of the  Lord  that day , and said , How shall the ark of the  Lord  come to me ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad u ong ,  Mynta kumno ngan lah ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ?

translation.en: And Mizpeh , and Chephirah , and Mozah ,
translation.kha: ka Mispah , ka Shephirah , ka Mosah ,

translation.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies , and before them that seek their life : and I will bring evil upon them , even my fierce anger , saith the  Lord   ; and I will send the sword after them , till I have consumed them :
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Elam ban sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ki , kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki . Ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jong nga ngan pynjot ïa ki briew ka Elam bad ngan phah ki shipai pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba ngan da pynduh khoit ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ask ye now among the heathen , who hath heard such things : the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kylli ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew la kaba kum kane kaei kaei ka la ju jia mynshuwa . Ki paid Israel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba shyrkhei !

translation.en: Now Saul , and they , and all the men of Israel , were in the valley of Elah , fighting with the Philistines .
translation.kha: U syiem Saul , ki hynmen jong phi , bad baroh kiwei ki Israel ki don ha ka Them Elah , ki dang ïaleh thma ïa ki Philistia .

translation.en: And Pharaoh s daughter said unto her , Take this child away , and nurse it for me , and I will give thee thy wages . And the woman took the child , and nursed it .
translation.kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka ,  Shim ïa une u khunlung bad ri ïa u na ka bynta jong nga , bad ngan da siew ïa pha .  Kumta kata ka kynthei ka shim ïa uta u khunlung , bad ka ri ka sumar ïa u .

translation.en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount , and put the tables in the ark which I had made  ; and there they be , as the  Lord  commanded me .
translation.kha: Nangta , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , nga buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk ba nga la thaw — bad ki dang don hangta naduh kata ka por .

translation.en: And being found in fashion as a man , he humbled himself , and became obedient unto death , even the death of the cross .
translation.kha: U la long uba sngewrit bad u la ïaid ha ka lynti jong ka jingkohnguh baroh shi lynter lynti sha ka jingïap — ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna .

translation.en: And they found an Egyptian in the field , and brought him to David , and gave him bread , and he did eat  ; and they made him drink water  ;
translation.kha: Kita ki briew kiba leit bad u Dabid ki lap ïa uwei u khynnah Ijipt ha lum , bad ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Dabid . Ki ai ha u ïa u kpu ban bam bad ka um ban dih ;

translation.en: When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite : and they turned in thither , and said unto him , Who brought thee hither ? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here ?
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur kren jong u samla Lebi , kumta ki leit sha u bad ki kylli ,  Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba wallam ïa me shane ?

translation.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians : and it shall come to pass , that , when ye go , ye shall not go empty :
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ruh ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin sngewburom ïa phi khnang ba ynda ki briew jong nga kin mih , kin ym mihnoh thylli .

translation.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil  ; and when it is baken , thou shalt bring it in : and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Dei ban khleh ïa u bad ka umphniang bad shet ha u khiew ba la tap bad nangta dei ban pynlwet ïa u bad ai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year , and one young bullock , and two rams : they shall be for a burnt offering unto the  Lord  , with their meat offering , and their drink offerings , even an offering made by fire , of sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ryngkat bad kita ki kpu , baroh phin ïa-ai hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem , uwei u masi lyngraw , bad ar tylli ki  langsohmoh ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Yn ai ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh dih . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work , and ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days :
translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kaba ai burom ïa U  Trai  hynñiew sngi lynter , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

translation.en: Then the mariners were afraid , and cried every man unto his god , and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea , to lighten it of them . But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship  ; and he lay , and was fast asleep .
translation.kha: Ki maji ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , uwei pa uwei sha la u jong u blei . Nangta , khnang ban pynduna ïa ka jingma , ki bret noh ïa ka jingkit nalor lieng . Ha kata ka por , u Jonah u la hiar sha ka bynta bashapoh , u thiah ha trai ka lieng , u ïohthiah lyngngai .

translation.en: I decked thee also with ornaments , and I put bracelets upon thy hands , and a chain on thy neck .
translation.kha: Nga buh ki mawlynnai ha pha — ki khadu bad ki kpieng .

translation.en: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings  ; and ye shall go forth , and grow up as calves of the stall .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi kiba kohnguh ïa nga , ka bor jong nga kaba pynim kan kiew halor jong phi kum ka sngi bad kan wallam jingkhiah kum ki kjat sngi . Phin long kiba laitluid bad bakmen kum ki khun masi ba la pyllait na ka sem .

translation.en: But the people held their peace , and answered him not a word : for the king s commandment was , saying , Answer him not .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki sngap jar , kumba u syiem Hesekaïah u la ong ïa ki ban leh kumta ; kim shym kren shikyntien ruh .

translation.en: And , behold , there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou seen all this great multitude ? behold , I will deliver it into thine hand this day  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Ahab , bad u la ong ,  U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Wat sheptieng ïa katai ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ! Ngan ai jingjop ïa me halor jong ka mynta ka sngi , bad men ïoh tip ba nga dei U  Trai .’

translation.en: Gaius mine host , and of the whole church , saluteth you . Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you , and Quartus a brother .
translation.kha: U Gaïos , uba ai jaka sah ïa nga , uba ha ka ïing jong u ka balang ka ïaseng , u phah ïa phi ki jingai khublei ; u Erastos , u nongsumar ïa ki jingkynshew ha ka nongbah , bad u Kuartos , u parabangeit jong ngi , ki phah ïa ki jingkhublei jong ki .

translation.en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets , and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien ïa kiba la kren lah slem bah da ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid , bad ïa ka hukum na U Trai bad U Nongpynim ïa kaba la ai ha phi da ki apostol .

translation.en: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof , that the brass of it may be hot , and may burn , and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it , that the scum of it may be consumed .
translation.kha: Mynta buh ïa u khiew rnong ba suda halor ki rnga bad ai ba un sawlep . Te u khiew un long ba la pynkhuid ha ka jinglehniam sa shisien hadien ba ka sarang ka la ing lut ,

translation.en: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her , and disallowed her not : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .
translation.kha: ka dei ban pyndep lut ïa kata kaba ka la kular lymda u tnga jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .

translation.en: Yet was she carried away , she went into captivity : her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets : and they cast lots for her honourable men , and all her great men were bound in chains .
translation.kha: Pynban ïa ki briew jong ka Thebes la rah noh sha ka jinglongmraw . Ha kawei pa kawei ka kyndong jong ka lynti bah ïa ki khun jong ki la tied pynïap . Ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki la ïalam noh ha ki kynjri bad la pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongkurup .

translation.en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities  ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
translation.kha: Pynban ki paid Manasseh kim shym lah ban beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha kito ki nongbah , kumta ki Kanaan ki dang ïaishong hangta .

translation.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel , which he counselled in those days , was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God : so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano ka jingai jingmut ba u Ahithophel u la ai ha kito ki sngi , la pdiang kumba ka long hi ka ktien jong U Blei ; u Dabid bad u Absalom baroh ar ngut ki bud ïa ka .

translation.en: And shall say unto them , Hear , O Israel , ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies : let not your hearts faint , fear not , and do not tremble , neither be ye terrified because of them  ;
translation.kha: ‘ To sngap , ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phin leit ban ïaleh thma . Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong phi , wat noh mynsiem , lane wat sngew syier .

translation.en: And say ye moreover , Behold , thy servant Jacob is behind us . For he said , I will appease him with the present that goeth before me , and afterward I will see his face  ; peradventure he will accept of me .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ong , ‘ U shakri jong phi u Jakob u hadien jong ngi .’   U Jakob u la pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynum ïa ka mynsiem jong u da ki jingai sngewbha , bad haba nga ïakynduh ïa u , lehse un map ïa nga .

translation.en: Saying ,  The Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be slain , and be raised the third day .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un shah pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .

translation.en: And in hell he lift up his eyes , being in torments , and seeth Abraham afar off , and Lazarus in his bosom .
translation.kha: bad ha Hades , ha kaba u la don ha ka jingshitom bakhraw , u la khmih shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa u Abraham , sha jngai bah , bad ïa u Lasaros ha syndah jong u .
