translation.en: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people  ; for the cause was from the  Lord  , that he might perform his saying , which the  Lord  spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
translation.kha: Ka long ka mon jong U  Trai  ban pynjia ïa kaei kaba U la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Dei namar kane balei ba u syiem um shym shahshkor ïa ki paidbah .

translation.en: She came by bus yesterday .
translation.kha: Ka wan da ka bus mynnin .

translation.en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled , that is to say , with unwashen , hands , they found fault .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ba katto katne ngut ki synran jong u ki dang ïabam ïa la ki jingbam da ki kti ki bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam — kata , kim pat sait ha kata ka rukom kaba ki Pharisi ki ong ba ki briew ki dei ban leh .

translation.en: And , behold , the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop , and brought in a great spoil with them : but Abner was not with David in Hebron  ; for he had sent him away , and he was gone in peace .
translation.kha: Kham hadien , u Joab bad ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la wan phai na kaba leit lute , ki da wanrah shikatdei ka mar lute bad ki . Hynrei u Abner um don shuh bad u Dabid hangta ha Hebron , namar u Dabid u la lah phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .

translation.en: I know thy works , that thou art neither cold nor hot : I would thou wert cold or hot .
translation.kha: Nga tip ïa kaei kaba pha la leh ; nga tip ba pham long kaba khriat ne kaba shit . Katno nga kwah ba phan jin da la long kawei na kita !

translation.en: And we took all his cities at that time , there was not a city which we took not from them , threescore cities , all the region of Argob , the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh ngi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong jong u baroh — ym don kawei ruh kaba lait ; baroh kita ki shnong ki long hynriewphew tylli — ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei ha kaba u Og u Syiem Bashan u synshar .

translation.en: And the  Lord  drave out from before us all the people , even the Amorites which dwelt in the land : therefore will we also serve the  Lord   ; for he is our God .
translation.kha: Katba ngi nang ïaid sha khmat sha kane ka ri , U  Trai  u la beh ïa ki Amor baroh kiba shong basah hangne . Kumta ma ngi ruh , ngin shakri ïa U  Trai  , u long U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: For when ye offer your gifts , when ye make your sons to pass through the fire , ye pollute yourselves with all your idols , even unto this day : and shall I be enquired of by you , O house of Israel ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .
translation.kha: Wat haduh mynta phi ai ïa kijuh ki jingai sngewbha bad pyntngit ïa lade da kijuh ki bleithaw da kaba kñia ïa la ki khun sha ki ha ka ding . Bad nangta ma phi ki Israel phi dang ïai wan ban kylli kaei ka long ka mon jong nga ! Kumba da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban kylli ei ei na nga .

translation.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom , Absalom spake unto him , saying , Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner : shall we do after his saying ? if not  ; speak thou .
translation.kha: Haba u Hushai u la wan poi , u Absalom u ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka jingai jingmut jong u Ahithophel kaba u la ai ïa ngi ; Hato ngin bud ïa ka ? Lada em , to ïathuh ma phi ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh .

translation.en: He that overcometh shall inherit all things  ; and I will be his God , and he shall be my son .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïoh ïa ka jingjop un ïohpdiang ïa kane na nga : Ngan long U Blei jong u , bad un long u khun jong nga .

translation.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leit sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïada , uno uno uba ïaisah hapoh ka jingkah jong U Badonbor Baroh ,

translation.en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers , and they buried him in his own house : and Amon his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u Amon u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: But who may abide the day of his coming ? and who shall stand when he appeareth ? for he is like a refiner s fire , and like fullers  soap :
translation.kha: Hynrei uei uba lah ban ïai ap ïa ka sngi haba un wan ? Uei uba lah ban lait im haba un paw ? Un long kum ka sabon basboh bha , kum ka ding kaba phrang ïa ka nar .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehoïakim u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb , and her mouth is smoother than oil :
translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ki lah ban thiang kum ka ngap , bad ki jingdoh jong ka ki long jlih kum ka umphniang Olib ;

translation.en: Sorrow is better than laughter : for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewsih ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingrkhie ; ka lah ban pynsngewsih ïa ka durkhmat jong phi , hynrei ka pynnep ïa ka jingshemphang jong phi .

translation.en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem . So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpyntrei ïa ka Templ la lah pynsangeh noh bad ka la sahkut khlem pyntrei shuh haduh ka snem ba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Darius , u patsha ka Persia .

translation.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews  religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God , and wasted it :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew kumno ba nga la ju im mynba nga dang don ha ka niam Jiw , kumno nga la pynshitom beiñ khlem jingisynei ïa ka balang U Blei bad nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynduh noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace ;
translation.kha: bad da ka jinglong la kloi ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha ka jingsuk , kum ki juti jong phi .

translation.en: And brought out Israel from among them : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la ïalam noh ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: Why do you drive the car ?
translation.kha: Balei phi ngiah ia ka kali ?

translation.en: ( 1 Peter 3 :18 ) Since then , God has made him a King .
translation.kha: ( 1 Petros 3 :18 ) Hadien kata , U Blei u la thung ïa u kum u Syiem .

translation.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses , the same commit thou to faithful men , who shall be able to teach others also .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ki jinghikai kiba me la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ha khmat ki sakhi babun , bad aiti ïa ki ha ki briew kiba lah ban shaniah , kiba lah ban hikai ïa kiwei ruh .

translation.en: And if the servant shall plainly say , I love my master , my wife , and my children  ; I will not go out free :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u mraw u pynbna ba u ieit ïa la u kynrad , ïa la ka tnga , bad ïa la ki khun , bad um kwah ban ïoh laitluid ,

translation.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you , and ye need not that any man teach you : but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things , and is truth , and is no lie , and even as it hath taught you , ye shall abide in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , U Khrist u la theh noh ïa la U Mynsiem ha phi . Katba U Mynsiem jong u , u dang ïaisah ha phi , phim donkam ïano ïano ban hikai ïa phi . Naba U Mynsiem jong u , un hikai ïa phi shaphang kiei kiei baroh , bad kaei kaba u hikai ka long kaba shisha , ym kaba lamler . Namarkata , to kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Mynsiem bad ïaisah ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And in the valley , Eshtaol , and Zorah , and Ashnah ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah ha kjat ki lum ki long ka Eshtaol , ka Sorah , ka Ashnah ,

translation.en: And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father ,
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïamihnoh na Ijipt bad ki wan phai sha la u kpa ha Kanaan .

translation.en: As for the wheels , it was cried unto them in my hearing , O wheel .
translation.kha: Kine ki shalyntem ki long kumjuh kum kito kiba nga la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kaba nyngkong jong nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  that made thee , and formed thee from the womb , which will help thee  ; Fear not , O Jacob , my servant  ; and thou , Jeshurun , whom I have chosen .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  uba la thaw ïa phi ; naduh ka por ba la kha ïa phi , nga la ïarap ïa phi . Wat sheptieng ; phi long u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga kiba nga ieit .

translation.en: Tremble , ye women that are at ease  ; be troubled , ye careless ones : strip you , and make you bare , and gird sackcloth upon your loins .
translation.kha: Phi la ju im suk , phim don ki jingkhuslai ; hynrei mynta , to khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ! To loit ïa la ki jaiñ bad teh da ki jaiñjot sawdong ïa la ka syngkai .

translation.en: If his loins have not blessed me , and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep  ;
translation.kha: Nga ju ai ïa u ki jaiñkup ba la thain da u  saiwul uba la ïoh na ka kynhun langbrot jong nga hi . Nangta te u ïaroh ïa nga naduh ka dohnud jong u baroh .

translation.en: This he said , not that he cared for the poor  ; but because he was a thief , and had the bag , and bare what was put therein .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa kane , ym namar ba u da sngewkhia ïa kiba duk , hynrei namar ba u la long u nongtuh . U bat ïa ka pla pisa bad uba la ju shim na ka ban pyndonkam ïa lade .

translation.en: And that no man might buy or sell , save he that had the mark , or the name of the beast , or the number of his name .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban thied ne die khlem don kane ka shab , kaba long , ka kyrteng jong u mradkhlaw lane u dak jingkheiñ uba ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: u la ai ïa ki ha u Israel , u shakri jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such , and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ban bud ïa ka jingïalam jong kiba kum kita ki briew , bad uno uno de uba trei bad shakri lang bad ki .

translation.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground , the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth :
translation.kha: u bseiñ lane ka dohkha .

translation.en: And when he had made an end to offer the present , he sent away the people that bare the present .
translation.kha: Haba u Ehud u la dep ai ha u ïa ki jingai sngewbha , u la ong ha ki rangbah kiba la kit ïa kita ban leit phai noh pat sha ïing .

translation.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness ; and hold such in reputation :
translation.kha: To pdiang ïa u , te , da ka jingkmen , kum u para ha U Trai . To phin ñiewburom ïa kiba kum kita ki briew kum ma u ,

translation.en: Because thou sayest , I am rich , and increased with goods , and have need of nothing  ; and knowest not that thou art wretched , and miserable , and poor , and blind , and naked :
translation.kha: Pha ong , ‘ Nga long kaba riewspah bad kaba dap babiang ; nga don baroh kaba nga donkam .’ Hynrei pham tip haduh katno pha long kaba lanot bad kaba isynei ban khmih ! Pha long kaba duk , kaba lyngkhuit , bad kaba matlah .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar , and will set it  ; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one , and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan shim ïa ka kliar jong u dieng Kedar bajrong bad kdiah ïa i shylluit balung ; ngan thung ïa i halor u lum bakynjang ,

translation.en: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire , that thou mayest be rich  ; and white raiment , that thou mayest be clothed , and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear  ; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve , that thou mayest see .
translation.kha: Te nga ai jingmut ïa pha ban thied ksiar na nga , ka ksiar banylla , khnang ba phan riewspah . Thied ruh ïa ki jaiñkup balieh ban kup ïa lade bad ban tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit bakhlemrain jong pha . Thied ruh katto katne ka jingtah ban tah ha ki khmat jong pha , khnang ba pha lah ban ïohi .

translation.en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee , thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high  ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ka nongbah jong pha ka long ka kut mawsiang baskhem ; ka ïing jong pha ka don ha kliar ki lumbah , bad kumta phi ong ha lade , ‘ Uei uba lah ban pynhiar ïa nga sha tbian ?’

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses bad u Aaron ha Ijipt :

translation.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth , and put my life in mine hand ?
translation.kha: Nga long uba kloi ban kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: And the priest shall look on the plague , after that it is washed : and , behold , if the plague have not changed his colour , and the plague be not spread  ; it is unclean  ; thou shalt burn it in the fire  ; it is fret inward , whether it be bare within or without .
translation.kha: Hadien kata un khmih bha ïa ka , bad lada kata ka jingbthuh kam kylla rong , wat la kam pur , ka dang long hi ka bymkhuid ; dei ban thang noh ïa ka , kam pher la kata ka jingbthuh ka long na shapoh ne shalor .

translation.en: But the chief priests moved the people , that he should rather release Barabbas unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah ban pan ba u Pilat un pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Wherefore then serveth the law ? It was added because of transgressions , till the seed should come to whom the promise was made ; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator .
translation.kha: Kaei te , ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum ? La bynrap khnang ban pyn-i ïa kaei ba ka long ka jingpalat , bad la thmu ba kan neh haduh ka jingwan uta u nonghiarpateng jong u Abraham , ha uba la pynlong ïa ka jingkular . Ïa ka Hukum la aiti da ki angel , lem bad u briew uba ïeng kum u ksiang .

translation.en: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty . And he went up to him : and , behold , he sat on the top of an hill . And he spake unto him , Thou man of God , the king hath said , Come down .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah ban wanlam ïa u Elijah . U rangbah pynïaidkam u shem ïa u ba u shong halor u lum bad u ong ha u ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban wan hiar shane .

translation.en: Then these men were bound in their coats , their hosen , and their hats , and their other garments , and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khum ïa ki , ki da phong jaiñ pura — ki sopti-poh , ka jaiñkup jynsur , ki tupia , bad baroh — bad ki la bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .

translation.en: And David said unto the young man that told him , Whence art thou ? And he answered , I am the son of a stranger , an Amalekite .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u samla uba la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor ,  Me dei uba na-ei ?  U jubab ,  Nga dei u nong Amalek , hynrei nga shong ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed  ;
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u Jakob ,  Kane ka kynton maw kan long ka jingpynkynmaw ïa ngi baroh ar ngut .  Namar kata , la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Galeed .

translation.en: Then he remembered the days of old , Moses , and his people , saying , Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock ? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei nangta ki kynmaw ïa ki por kiba mynshuwa , ïa ki sngi u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  bad ki kylli ,  Hangno mynta u don U  Trai  , uba pyllait im ïa ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong u na ka duriaw ? Hangno u don U  Trai  , uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha u Moses ?

translation.en: And the fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth : and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba san u la put ïa ka turoi . Nga la ïohi ïa u khlur uba la hap sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha u ïa u shabi jong ka liewlong ba khlem trai .

translation.en: The man , who is the lord of the land , spake roughly to us , and took us for spies of the country .
translation.kha: U lat jong ka ri Ijipt u la kren khor ïa ngi , bad u la kynnoh ba ngi syntiat ïa kata ka ri .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Lashai dang step , leit ïakynduh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïathuh ha u ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga , khnang ba ki lah ban mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day . And many of the people of the land became Jews  ; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah bad probins , hangno hangno ba la pule ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , ki Jiw ki pynlong ki shuti lehkmen ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai sngewbha bad jingkmen . Ha ka jingshisha , bun kiwei ki briew ki la kylla Jiw , namar mynta ki la sheptieng ïa ki .

translation.en: This I recall to my mind , therefore have I hope .
translation.kha: Pynban ka jingkyrmen ka wan phai haba nga kynmaw ïa kane kawei :

translation.en: And last of all the woman died also .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh eh , ka kynthei ka la ïap .

translation.en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother s brethren , and communed with them , and with all the family of the house of his mother s father , saying ,
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u khun jong u Gideon u leit sha ka nongrit Shekhem ha kaba ki ba-ha-ïing baroh jong ka kmie jong u ki shong ki sah , bad u ong ha ki

translation.en: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti . And the thing pleased the king  ; and he did so .
translation.kha: Nangta sa shim ïa ka samla kaba phi itynnat tam bad pynlong ïa ka , ka mahadei ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .  U syiem u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long ka jingai jingmut kaba bha , kumta u la pdiang ïa kata .

translation.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us ,
translation.kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Bun ki briew ki la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh ka jingïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: And as soon as it was day , the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together , and led him into their council , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba ka la long mynsngi , ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïashem lang , bad ïa U Jisu la wallam ha khmat ka dorbar .

translation.en: Woe unto him that saith unto his father , What begettest thou ? or to the woman , What hast thou brought forth ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno un nud ban ong ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ,  Balei phi pynlong ïa nga kumne ?

translation.en: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rab–shakeh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joah ki kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ki leit bad ïathuh sha u syiem ïa kaei kaba u rangbah synshar ka Assyria u la ong .

translation.en: But they constrained him , saying , Abide with us : for it is toward evening , and the day is far spent . And he went in to tarry with them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki la bat ïa u , ki da ong ,  To sah bad ngi ; ka sngi la jan kut bad ka la khreh dum .  Kumta u la leit ban sah bad ki .

translation.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it : whithersoever it turneth , it prospereth .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba kaba pynbam sap ka treikam kum ka myntor ; ki ngeit ba ka lah ban leh lut ïa kiei kiei .

translation.en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world .
translation.kha: Bad ngi la ïohi bad ïathuh ha kiwei ba U Kpa u la phah ïa la U Khun ban long U Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: It'd be about time to reply to his letter .
translation.kha: Lah jan dei por ban jubab iaka shithi jong u .

translation.en: Tell me where the wine is .
translation.kha: Iathuh ianga haei ka waiñ ka don .

translation.en: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee  ; and the mother of Jesus was there :
translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien , la don ka jingkyntiew kurim ha ka shnong Kana kaba ha Galilaïa .

translation.en: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord , and hast said , With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains , to the sides of Lebanon , and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof , and the choice fir trees thereof : and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders , and into the forest of his Carmel .
translation.kha: Me phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban kob sarong ïa nga ba da ki kali ïapom baroh ki jong me , me la jop thiaw ïa ki lum bajrong tam u Lebanon . Me kob sarong ba hangta me pom ïa ki dieng Kedar bajrong tam bad ïa ki dieng Kseh-Sypress bakynsai tam bad me ïohrung shaduh ki bynta bashapoh tam jong ki khlaw .

translation.en: For from within , out of the heart of men , proceed evil thoughts , adulteries , fornications , murders ,
translation.kha: Naba na shapoh , na ka dohnud u briew , ki wan ki jingmut basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban leh ki kam awria , ban lute , ban pynïap ,

translation.en: And he cometh , and findeth them sleeping , and saith unto Peter ,  Simon , sleepest thou ? couldest not thou watch one hour ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat bad u la shem ïa ki lai ngut ki synran ba ki ïohthiah . U la ong ha u Petros ,  Ko Simon , me ïohthiah ? Hato mem lah ban ïaishah bad nga wat tang shi kynta ?

translation.en: Grudge not one against another , brethren , lest ye be condemned : behold , the judge standeth before the door .
translation.kha: To wat ïakren khñium paralok hi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ba U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi . U Nongbishar u la jan , u la kloi ban wanpaw .

translation.en: Which are a shadow of things to come ; but the body is of Christ .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba kum kita ki long tang ka syrngiew jong kiei kiei ha ka lawei ; ka jingshisha ka long U Khrist .

translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them , after that they be destroyed from before thee  ; and that thou enquire not after their gods , saying , How did these nations serve their gods ? even so will I do likewise .
translation.kha: Ynda U  Trai  u la pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew , da lei lei wat bud ïa ki rukom lehniam jong ki , namar ka long kaba ma . Wat pyrshang ban tip kumno ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , ïoh ba phi mane Blei kumba leh ma ki .

translation.en: And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki ,

translation.en: And every man went unto his own house .
translation.kha: Te kumta ,  ki la jubab ,  phi ruh phi dei na Galilaïa ? To pule minot ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad phin shem ba ym don nongïathuhlypa uba ju mih na Galilaïa .

translation.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together : for before they were at enmity between themselves .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Herod bad u Pilat ki la ïalong paralok ; ha shuwa jong kane , ki la ïalong ki nongshun .

translation.en: And , behold , thou shalt be dumb , and not able to speak , until the day that these things shall be performed , because thou believest not my words , which shall be fulfilled in their season .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem shym ngeit ïa ka khubor jong nga , ka ban urlong shisha ha ka por kaba dei . Namar ba mem shym la ngeit , men ym lah ban kren , men ïailong uba jar jar tad ynda ka sngi ha kaba ka jingkular jong nga ha me ka urlong shisha .

translation.en: And they asked him , saying , Master , but when shall these things be ? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass ?
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la kylli ,  lano kane kan jia ? Bad kaei ka ban jia khnang ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan jia ?

translation.en: And , behold , men passed by , and saw the carcase cast in the way , and the lion standing by the carcase : and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki ïohi ïa kata ka metïap ha lynti , bad ïa u sing uba ïeng hajan jong ka . Ki leit haduh Bethel bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki la ïohi .

translation.en: Then David arose , and all the people that were with him , and they passed over Jordan : by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sdang ban jam ïa ka Jordan , bad kat ban da kynjat shai mynstep , baroh ki la poi lut sha shiliang .

translation.en: Now when we had discovered Cyprus , we left it on the left hand , and sailed into Syria , and landed at Tyre : for there the ship was to unlade her burden .
translation.kha: Ngi la poi ha ka jaka ha kaba ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka Sypros , bad nangta ngi la leit shaphang shathie jong ka sha Syria . Ngi la hiar ryngkew ha Tyros , ha kaba ka lieng ka dang pynhiar ïa ka jingkit jong ka .

translation.en: For I know that in me ( that is , in my flesh , ) dwelleth no good thing : for to will is present with me ; but how to perform that which is good I find not .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba kaba bha kam im hapoh jong nga — kata , ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong nga . Naba wat la ka jingkwah ban leh ïa kaba bha ka don hapoh jong nga , ngam lah ban leh ïa ka .

translation.en: But Jesus answered and said ,  Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?  They say unto him , We are able .
translation.kha: Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan ,  U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki khun shynrang jong ka .  Hato phi lah ban dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba ngan sa dih ?   Ngi lah ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Woe is me ! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits , as the grapegleanings of the vintage : there is no cluster to eat : my soul desired the firstripe fruit .
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingduh jingkyrmen ! Nga long kum u briew uba thngan uba shem ba ym don soh ba dang sah ha ki dieng bad ym don sohwaiñ ha ki dieng sohwaiñ . Ïa baroh ki sohwaiñ bad baroh ki soh Dumbur ba-bang la kheit lut .

translation.en: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition : and , behold , if the witness be a false witness , and hath testified falsely against his brother  ;
translation.kha: Kita ki nongbishar kin tohkit bniah ïa kata ka mokotduma ; bad lada uta u briew u la mudui lamler ,

translation.en: Set thee up waymarks , make thee high heaps : set thine heart toward the highway , even the way which thou wentest : turn again , O virgin of Israel , turn again to these thy cities .
translation.kha: To pynïeng ki jingkdew lynti bad pruid dak ha ka surok ; to wad biang ïa ka lynti kaba phi la iehnoh . To wan phai biang , ko phi ki paid Israel , to wan sha la ka ri , sha ki shnong kiba phi la iehnoh .

translation.en: ( John 17 :17  ; 2 Timothy 3 :16 , 17 ) They treat God’s Word as being more important than human ideas or customs .
translation.kha: ( Ioannis 17 :17 ; 2 Timothi 3 :16 , 17 ) Ki shim ba ka ktien U Blei ka kham kongsan ban ïa ki dustur ne jingmut jong ki briew .

translation.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u ai jaka shong jaka sah ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ki hynmen ha Ijipt , ha ka bynta kaba bha tam hajan ka nongbah Rameses , kumba u syiem u la hukum .

translation.en: The  Lord  bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought : he maketh the devices of the people of none effect .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pyndiaw ïa ki jingthmu ki jaitbynriew ; um shah ïa ki ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingthmu jong ki .

translation.en: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone , and cast it into the sea , saying , Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down , and shall be found no more at all .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel bakhlaiñbor u la shim ïa u maw uba heh la kat u mawtylliat baheh bad u la kawang ïa u sha ka duriaw , da kaba ong ,  Kane ka long kumno ïa ka nongbah Babilon bakhraw yn pynkhyllem ha ka borbah bad yn ym ïohi shuh ïa ka da lei lei .

translation.en: Now therefore , Tatnai , governor beyond the river , Shethar–bozenai , and your companions the Apharsachites , which are beyond the river , be ye far from thence :
translation.kha: Nangta u Darius u phah ïa kane ka jubab :  Ha u Tattenai , u lat jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , u Shethar Bosenai , bad ki para rangbah synshar ha Ïuphratis Sepngi .

translation.en: Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished  ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .
translation.kha: Ki jingieit jong ki , ki jingisih jong ki , ki jingkwah jong ki , baroh ki ïap lem bad ki . Kin ym lah shuh da lei lei ban ïashim bynta ha kano kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel , and his cupbearers , and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .
translation.kha: Ka la ïohi ïa ka jingbam ba la buh ha ka miej jong u , ïa ki ïing sah jong ki rangbah synshar jong u , ïa ki shakri kiba shakri ïa u ha ki jingkhawai , bad ïa ki jingkñia kiba u la ai ha ka Templ . Ki la pynlyngngoh ïa ka .

translation.en: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years , whereof the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah the prophet , that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u , nga la pule bniah ïa ki kitab bakyntang bad pyrkhat shaphang ki hynñiewphew snem kiba ka Jerusalem kan don ha ki jingpra , kat kum kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ïathuh ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: He brought them out , after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt , and in the Red sea , and in the wilderness forty years .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , u da leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka Duriaw Basaw bad haduh sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And the  Lord  gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians . Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt , in the sight of Pharaoh s servants , and in the sight of the people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin sngewburom ïa ki Israel . Shisha , ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew baroh ki ñiew ba u Moses u dei u briew uba khraw katta katta .

translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  of hosts said , Hew ye down trees , and cast a mount against Jerusalem : this is the city to be visited  ; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la hukum ïa kine ki syiem ban khet ïa ki dieng bad ban shna ki kynton khnang ban kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem . U la ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa kane ka nongbah namar ka la dap da ka jingbanbeiñ .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh s army was come forth out of Egypt : and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them , they departed from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka dang kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem , hynrei haba ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la jam sha shiliang u pud ka Ijipt , ki la phai dien noh .

translation.en: And all the people that heard him , and the publicans , justified God , being baptized with the baptism of John .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ïa u ; ma ki bad khamtam ki nonglum khajna ki long kita kiba la kohnguh ïa ka jingdawa bahok jong U Blei bad kiba la shah pynbaptis ha u Ïoannis .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ïaisah bun sngi ha Joppa lem bad u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon .

translation.en: Then said I , Lo , I come ( in the volume of the book it is written of me , ) to do thy will , O God .
translation.kha: Te nga la ong , ‘ Nga hangne , ban leh ïa ka mon jong me , A Blei , kumba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka kitab ka Hukum .’

translation.en: For this ye know , that no whoremonger , nor unclean person , nor covetous man , who is an idolater , hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sngewskhem ba yn ym don uno uno uba awria , uba long jakhlia , lane uba kwah lalot (naba ka jingkwah lalot ka long hi ka rukom mane bleithaw) u ban ïoh bynta ha ka Hima jong U Khrist bad jong U Blei .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God , which had cried against the altar in Beth–el , that he put forth his hand from the altar , saying , Lay hold on him . And his hand , which he put forth against him , dried up , so that he could not pull it in again to him .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Jeroboam u ïohsngew ïa kane , u kdew ïa u bad u hukum ,  Kem ïa uto u briew !  Mar kumta hi ka kti u syiem ka long kumba ïap haduh ba um lah pynkhun shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul .
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju leh pop da kaba duwai ba kin ïap .

translation.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places : a fire not blown shall consume him  ; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kaba u la kynshew yn pynjot ; ka ding ïa kaba ym shym la pynmeh da ki kti briew ka thang ïa u bad ïa baroh ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And he did evil , because he prepared not his heart to seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , namar ba um shym pyrshang ban wad ïa ka mon U  Trai .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
translation.kha: Bad kumno shaphang ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?

translation.en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand : that the  Lord  may turn from the fierceness of his anger , and shew thee mercy , and have compassion upon thee , and multiply thee , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers  ;
translation.kha: Wat shim sha lade ïa kaei kaei kaba la mang ban pynjot , te U  Trai  un phai na ka jingbitar shla jong u bad un isynei ïa phi . Un leh-isynei ïa phi bad un pynroi ïa phi , kumba u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,

translation.en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah : but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him .
translation.kha: U Amasa u la leit khot ïa ki , hynrei um shym poi ha ka por ba u syiem u la buh .

translation.en: I will answer thee , and thy companions with thee .
translation.kha: Ngan jubab ïa me bad ïa ki paralok jong me ruh .

translation.en: And the first day of unleavened bread , when they killed the passover , his disciples said unto him , Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka sngi ha kaba la pynïap ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki synran U Jisu ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno me kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?

translation.en: Save us , O  Lord  our God , and gather us from among the heathen , to give thanks unto thy holy name , and to triumph in thy praise .
translation.kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , bad wallam pat ïa ngi napdeng ki jaitbynriew , ba ngi lah ban sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .

translation.en: For they served idols , whereof the  Lord  had said unto them , Ye shall not do this thing .
translation.kha: bad kim kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ban ym mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And he said , What meanest thou by all this drove which I met ? And he said , These are to find grace in the sight of my lord .
translation.kha: U Iso u kylli ,  Kumno pat shaphang kato ka kynhun kaba nga la ïakynduh ? Ka mut aïu kato ?  U Jakob u jubab  Ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .

translation.en: Come , eat of my bread , and drink of the wine which I have mingled .
translation.kha: Ale , bam na ka jingbam jong nga , bad dih na ka waiñ ba nga la khleh .

translation.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage , in mortar , and in brick , and in all manner of service in the field : all their service , wherein they made them serve , was with rigour .
translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt ki la sdang ban sheptieng ïa ki Israel , bad kumta ki pynsaja sat ïa ki da kaba pynlong mraw jubor ïa ki ban trei ha ki kam dewbyrtha bad shna maw-it , bad ha ki lyngkha jong ki , bad kim don jingisynei ïa ki .

translation.en: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea ; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints ;
translation.kha: To duwai ba ngan lait na ka jingma na ki bymngeit kiba don ha Judia bad ba ka jingshakri jong nga ha Jerusalem kan long kaba la pdiang da ki briew jong U Blei hangta .

translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Malchijah , and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , saying ,
translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u la phah ïa u Pashhur , u khun jong u Malkhaïah , bad ïa u Sephanaïah u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Maaseïah , sha nga lem bad kane ka jingkyrpad :

translation.en: Moreover your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , and your children , which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil , they shall go in thither , and unto them will I give it , and they shall possess it .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha ngi baroh , ‘ Ki khun ki kti jong phi , kiba dang lung palat ban tip ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew , kin rung sha kata ka ri — ki khun ki kti kiba phi ong kin shah kurup ha ki nongshun jong phi . Ngan ai ïa ka ri ha ki , ban kin ïohkynti ïa ka .

translation.en: And when they came down to him , Elisha prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , Smite this people , I pray thee , with blindness . And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha .
translation.kha: Haba ki Syria ki wan tur ïaleh , u Elisha u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynmatlah ïa kine ki briew .  U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u bad shoh pynmatlah ïa ki .

translation.en: I commend unto you Phebe our sister , which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea .
translation.kha: Nga phah sha phi , da kaba sngewburom ïa ka parabangeit jong ngi , ka Phibi , kaba shakri ïa ka balang ha Kenkhria .

translation.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns  ; such as hear the word ,
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet hapdeng ki bniap shiah . Kine ki long kita kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,

translation.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth .
translation.kha: Ki briew bariewspah jong phi ki kjit na kiba duk , bad baroh ki long ki nongshukor .

translation.en: When Saul heard that David was discovered , and the men that were with him , ( now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah , having his spear in his hand , and all his servants were standing about him  ; )
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Saul u don ha Gibeah , u da shong ha trai u dieng Tamarisk halor u lum , lem bad la u sum ha ka kti , bad baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ki don sawdong jong u .

translation.en: But woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs , and pass over judgment and the love of God : these ought ye to have done , and not to leave the other undone .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ai sha U Blei ïa kawei na ki shiphew jong ki jhur pynbang jingbam , kum u pudina bad u rue    bad baroh kiwei pat ki jait jhur , hynrei phi leh klet ïa ka jinglehhok bad ka jingieit ïa U Blei . Ïa kine phi la dei ban leh , khlem da leh klet ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil . Provide things honest in the sight of all men .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u la leh bymdei ïa phi , to wat siew kylliang ïa u da ka bymdei . To pyrshang ban leh ïa kaei kaba baroh ki ñiew ba ka long kaba bha .

translation.en: As obedient children , not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance :
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad wat shah ba ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pynwandur da kito ki jingkwah brai kiba phi la ju don mynba phi dang don ha ka jingbymtip .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , O my Lord , I am not eloquent , neither heretofore , nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant : but I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ,  Em , ko  Trai  , wat phah ïa nga . Ngam ju long u nongkren ba-pnah , bad ngam shym long kum uwei na kita naduh ba me la sdang ban kren ïa nga . Nga long u bym pnah ban kren , uba suki bad uba thlun .

translation.en: And Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron , stood before it in those days , ) saying , Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother , or shall I cease ? And the  Lord  said , Go up  ; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand .
translation.kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei ka don hangta ha Bethel ha kito ki sngi , bad u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u khun ksiew jong u Aaron , u khmih ïa ka , ki briew ki kylli ïa U  Trai  ,  Hato ngin leit ïaleh pyrshah biang ïa ki Benjamin , ki para jait jong ngi , ne ngin keiñ noh ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki . Lashai ka sngi ngan ai ïa ka jingjop ha phi .

translation.en: Now therefore hearken unto their voice : howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them , and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them .
translation.kha: Kumta , sngap ïa ki , tangba me dei ban maham jur ïa ki bad pynshai kumno kita ki syiem kin leh ïa ki .

translation.en: But go your way , tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee : there shall ye see him , as he said unto you .
translation.kha: Mynta to leit bad ai ïa kane ka khubor sha ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Petros : ‘ Un leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u , kumba u la ong ha phi .’

translation.en: And it shall be , when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people , that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people .
translation.kha: Ynda kita ki rangbah synshar ki la dep kren ha uta u paidïapom , sa jied ïa ki nongïalam ïa kawei pa kawei ka kynhun shipai .

translation.en: I have glorified thee on the earth : I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do .
translation.kha: Nga la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong me ha ka pyrthei ; nga la pyndep ïa ka kam kaba me la ai ha nga ban leh .

translation.en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles , and shall take many : but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease  ; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him .
translation.kha: Hadien kata un tur ïaleh ïa ki hima kiba harud duriaw bad u jop ïa kiba bun na ki . Hynrei u nongïalam nongwei un jop ïa u bad un pynkut ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u ; da shisha un pynphai pat ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u syiem ka Syria sha u .

translation.en: And Pilate , when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people ,
translation.kha: U Pilat u la khot lang ïa ki rangbah lyngdoh , ïa ki nongïalam , bad ïa u paidbah , bad u la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , when men began to multiply on the face of the earth , and daughters were born unto them ,
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la saphriang ha kylleng ka pyrthei , bad haba ki la ïoh ki khun kynthei ,

translation.en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the  Lord  , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .
translation.kha: Kito kiba don ki mawkordor ki la ai ïa ki sha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ , kaba la khmih da u Jehiel jong ka kur Lebi jong u Gershon .

translation.en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart , and said , Why could not we cast him out ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu ha kaba jar jar bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u ksuid shabar ?

translation.en: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ , both which are in heaven , and which are on earth ; even in him :
translation.kha: Kane ka jingthmu , ïa kaba U Blei un sa pyndep ha ka ïa kaba biang , ka long ban lumlang ïa ka jingpynlong baroh , ha bneng bad ha khyndew , lem bad U Khrist kum u khlieh .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons , Uncover not your heads , neither rend your clothes  ; lest ye die , and lest wrath come upon all the people : but let your brethren , the whole house of Israel , bewail the burning which the  Lord  hath kindled .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha u Aaron bad ha u Eleasar bad u Ithamar , ki khun shynrang jong u ,  Wat ieh ra-ngiep ïa la u shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jaiñ ban pyn-i ba phi ïam sngewsih , lada phi leh kumta phin ïap , bad U  Trai  un bitar ïa u paidlang baroh . Hynrei ïa baroh ki para jait Israel jong phi la shah ba kin ïa-ïam briew na ka bynta kane ka jingïap ba la wallam da ka ding kaba U  Trai  u la phah .

translation.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity  ; and the earth shall rise up against him .
translation.kha: Ka bneng ka pynpaw ïa ka pop jong une u briew , bad ka pyrthei ka phla pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this night , before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  Nga ong ha me ba mynta ka miet , ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: But what I do , that I will do , that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion ; that wherein they glory , they may be found even as we .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh mynta , khnang ban khanglad ïa kito kiwei ki  apostol  ba kin ïoh daw ban kob sarong bad ban ong ba ki trei ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ngi trei .

translation.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and , behold , he is by the altar . Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , saying , Go , fall upon him .
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka la poi ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Joab u la phet krad sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad ba u don harud ka duwan , u Solomon u la phah ïa u nonglamktien sha u Joab ban kylli ïa u balei ba u la phet sha ka duwan . U Joab u jubab ba u la phet krad sha U  Trai  namar ba u la sheptieng ïa u Solomon . Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la phah ïa u Benaïah ban pynïap ïa u Joab .

translation.en: His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judaea , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ka la jan , kumta ki para shynrang jong U Jisu ki la ong ïa u ,  To mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit sha Judia , ba ki nongbud jong me kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba me leh .

translation.en: Let them be only thine own , and not strangers  with thee .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong phi kin san ban ïarap ïa phi , ym ki nongwei .

translation.en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts , that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering  ; but for a vow it shall not be accepted .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban kñia ainguh ïa u jingri uba raid lane u bym shong beit ka met ka phad kum ka jingainguh sngewbha , hynrei yn ym pdiang ïa u haba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular .

translation.en: Not of works , lest any man should boast .
translation.kha: Namar dei da ka jingaiei U Blei ba ïa phi la pynim da ka jingngeit . Kam dei na ka jingmih na ki kam jong phi hi , hynrei ka long ka jingai U Blei , khnang ba uno uno un ym lah ban kren sarong shaphang kata .

translation.en: The king sent and loosed him  ; even the ruler of the people , and let him go free .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u la phah pyllait ïa u ; u nongsynshar ki jaitbynriew u la pyllait ïa u .

translation.en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle : set yourselves , stand ye still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  with you , O Judah and Jerusalem : fear not , nor be dismayed  ; to morrow go out against them : for the  Lord  will be with you .
translation.kha: Phin ym hap ban ïaleh ïa kane ka thma . Shu don ha la ki jaka bad ap ; phin ïohi U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa phi . Ko ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , wat sangeh ne sheptieng . Leit sha ka thma , bad U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad phi !

translation.en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano kaba u lah ban ïa-peiñ na ka bynta la ka jingim .

translation.en: And laid their hands on the apostles , and put them in the common prison .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ki apostol bad ki la set ha ka phatok .

translation.en: Son of man , these men have set up their idols in their heart , and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face : should I be enquired of at all by them ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kine ki briew ki la ai ïa ki dohnud jong ki ha ki bleithaw bad ki la shah ba ki bleithaw kin ïalam ïa ki sha ka pop . Hato ki pyrkhat ba ngan ai ha ki ka jubab ?

translation.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul .
translation.kha: Haba nga lyng-a bad khuslai , me pyntngen bad pynkmen ïa nga .

translation.en: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath : and he sought no more again for him .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la phet ïap sha Gath , u sangeh noh ban wad ïa u .

translation.en: But as it is written , Eye hath not seen , nor ear heard , neither have entered into the heart of man , the things which God hath prepared for them that love him .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la ïohi ne ïohsngew , ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la pyrkhat ba lah ban jia , ka long kata hi kaei kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkhreh ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul , that David took an harp , and played with his hand : so Saul was refreshed , and was well , and the evil spirit departed from him .
translation.kha: Naduh nangta hi , man ka por ba uta u mynsiem bymman ba phah U Blei u wan ha u Saul , u Dabid u shim ïa la ka duitara bad u tem ïa ka . Uta u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh , bad u Saul ruh u sngewpyngngad kdar , bad u shait u koit pat .

translation.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness , to work all uncleanness with greediness .
translation.kha: Ki la duh noh ïa baroh ki jingsngew jong ka jinglehrain ; ki pynlapmiet ïa lade ha ki kam thala bad ki leh ïa baroh ki jait kam sniew khlem salia .

translation.en: Who really are we , and why do we publicly share our beliefs ?
translation.kha: Ngi dei kiei bad balei ngi ïalap paidbah ïa ki jingngeit jong ngi ?

translation.en: Then the king s countenance was changed , and his thoughts troubled him , so that the joints of his loins were loosed , and his knees smote one against another .
translation.kha: U la kylla lieh blaid blaid bad u la sheptieng katta katta ba ki khohsiew jong u ki la sdang ban khynñiuh .

translation.en: And Judah said unto his brethren , What profit is it if we slay our brother , and conceal his blood ?
translation.kha: U Judah u ong ha la ki hynmen ki para shynrang ,  Kan myntoi aïu ïa ngi ba ngin pynïap noh ïa la u para bad buhrieh ïa ka kam pynïap briew ?

translation.en: For if I by grace be a partaker , why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks ?
translation.kha: Lada nga ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingbam jong nga , balei ba uno uno un wohnia ïa nga na ka bynta ka jingbam ïa kaba nga da ainguh ?

translation.en: The nakedness of thy son s daughter , or of thy daughter s daughter , even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover : for theirs is thine own nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka ksiew ; kata kan long ka jingjahburom ïa me .

translation.en: And it shall be , when they say unto thee , Wherefore sighest thou ? that thou shalt answer , For the tidings  ; because it cometh : and every heart shall melt , and all hands shall be feeble , and every spirit shall faint , and all knees shall be weak as water : behold , it cometh , and shall be brought to pass , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli ïa me balei ba me ud , ïathuh ïa ki ba ka long na ka daw ka khubor kaba la ïohpdiang . Haba ka wan , ki dohnud jong ki kin dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki kti jong kin noh kyrwep , ka jingshlur jong ki kan duh , bad ki khohsiew jong ki kin kyiuh . Ka por ka la poi ; ka long hangne .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow : and the father of a fool hath no joy .
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ïa u kpa hynrei ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang haba u khun jong u leh ïa ki kam bieit .

translation.en: How long shall the land mourn , and the herbs of every field wither , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein ? the beasts are consumed , and the birds  ; because they said , He shall not see our last end .
translation.kha: Sa katno ba ka ri jong ngi kan tyrkhong , bad ba u phlang ha kawei pa kawei ka pyntha un ïapstai ? Ki mrad bad ki sim ki ïap namar ka jingbymman jong ki briew jong ngi , ki briew kiba ong , ‘ U Blei um ïohi ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .’

translation.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies . He that loveth his wife loveth himself .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang ki dei ban ieit ïa ki tnga jong ki kumba ki ieit ïa la ki jong ki met . U shynrang uba ieit ïa la ka tnga u ieit ïa lade hi .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel , to do it for them  ; I will increase them with men like a flock .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Sa shisien pat ngan shah ïa ki Israel ba kin pan jingïarap na nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ba kin roi ha ka jingbun briew kum ka kynhun langbrot .

translation.en: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers , the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Then Moses trembled , and durst not behold .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .’ U Moses u la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad um shym la nud ban peit .

translation.en: Your little ones , your wives , and thy stranger that is in thy camp , from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water :
translation.kha: ki kynthei bad ki khynnah jong phi , ki nongwei kiba shong bad phi , bad kito kiba long ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um ïa phi ,

translation.en: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity , whereby they have sinned against me  ; and I will pardon all their iniquities , whereby they have sinned , and whereby they have transgressed against me .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki na ki pop kiba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki .

translation.en: If she please not her master , who hath betrothed her to himself , then shall he let her be redeemed : to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power , seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her .
translation.kha: Lada la die ïa ka ha uno uno uba mut ban pynlong ïa ka , ka tnga jong u , hynrei um sngewbha ïa ka , te u dei ban die pat ïa ka ha u kpa jong ka ; u kynrad jong ka um lah ban die ïa ka ha ki nongwei , namar u la leh bymdei ïa ka .

translation.en: Examine some of the material that will be discussed at the next few meetings .
translation.kha: Pynkhreh lypa katto katne ki kot ba ngin sa ïasyllok ha ki jingïalang ki ban sa wan .

translation.en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden : and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen  ; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king .
translation.kha: U syiem u ïeng ha ka jingbitar , u mih na ka kamra bad u leit shabar sha ki kper ka ïingsyiem . U Haman u ïohi ba u syiem u la kut jingmut ban pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta kane , kumta u sah hangta ban kyrpad ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: And they shall come from the cities of Judah , and from the places about Jerusalem , and from the land of Benjamin , and from the plain , and from the mountains , and from the south , bringing burnt offerings , and sacrifices , and meat offerings , and incense , and bringing sacrifices of praise , unto the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah bad na ki shnongrit sawdong jong ka Jerusalem ; kin wan na ka thain Benjamin , na ki kjat lum , na ki lumbah , bad na ka bynta bashathie jong ka Judah . Kin wallam sha ka Templ jong nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa ki jingkñia , ki jingainguh bam bad ka jingiwbih , kumjuh ruh ka jingainguh sngewnguh .

translation.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe : and I will send them , and they shall rise , and go through the land , and describe it according to the inheritance of them  ; and they shall come again to me .
translation.kha: Ai ha nga lai ngut ki rangbah na kawei kawei ka jait . Ngan phah ïa ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei bad jurip ïa kata ka jaka kaba kin mon ban ïohkynti . Hadien kata kin wan pat ha nga .

translation.en: Now therefore , if ye will obey my voice indeed , and keep my covenant , then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people : for all the earth is mine :
translation.kha: Te mynta , lada phin kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ka jutang jong nga , phin long ki briew jong nga . Ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka long ka jong nga , bad phi pat phin long ki briew kiba nga la jied ,

translation.en: And Elijah said unto him , Elisha , tarry here , I pray thee  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jericho . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . So they came to Jericho .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  Mynta ap hangne ; U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha Jerikho .  Hynrei u Elisha u jubab ,  Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  uba im bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi .  Kumta ki la leit sha Jerikho .

translation.en: And if the man have none to redeem it , and himself be able to redeem it  ;
translation.kha: U briew u bym don ba-ha-ïing ban thied pat ïa ka , hadien habud haba u la manbha bad dap biang u lah ban thied pat ïa ka da lade .

translation.en: There the wicked cease from troubling  ; and there the weary be at rest .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtep , ki riewbymman ki sangeh noh ban leh ki kam bymman , bad ki nongtrei ba la thait , khatduh ki ïoh jingjahthait .

translation.en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida , the city of Andrew and Peter .
translation.kha: ( U Philip u dei na Bethsaida , ka shnong ha kaba u Andriw bad u Petros ki sah . )

translation.en: I would know the words which he would answer me , and understand what he would say unto me .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban tip kaei ba un ong bad kumno un jubab ïa nga .

translation.en: Yet he also is wise , and will bring evil , and will not call back his words : but will arise against the house of the evildoers , and against the help of them that work iniquity .
translation.kha: U tip ïa kaei kaba u leh ! U phah ka jingjot . U phah ïa ki jingbyrngem ban pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sniew bad kito kiba ïada ïa ki .

translation.en: Whosoever denieth the Son , the same hath not the Father : ( but ) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kyntait ïa U Khun u kyntait ruh ïa U Kpa ; uno uno uba pdiang ïa U Khun u don ïa U Kpa ruh .

translation.en: Ye shall have a song , as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept  ; and gladness of heart , as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the  Lord  , to the mighty One of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ki briew jong U Blei , phin long kiba kmen bad phin rwai kumba phi leh ha ka miet jong ka Jingkhawai Niam bakyntang . Phin long kiba kmen kum kito kiba ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jong ki tangmuri sha ka Templ U  Trai  , u nongkyrshan jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And he came and found them asleep again : for their eyes were heavy .
translation.kha: U wan phai biang sa shisien bad u la shem ba ki synran ki ïohthiah ; kim lah ban khyllie ïa ki khmat jong ki .

translation.en: And they said , There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin , that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kim dei ban duh noh kawei na ki khat-ar jait jong ki . Ngi dei ban shem ka lynti na ka bynta ka jait Benjamin ban ym duh jait ,

translation.en: If any man defile the temple of God , him shall God destroy ; for the temple of God is holy , which temple ye are .
translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u pynjot ïa ka templ jong U Blei , U Blei un pynjot ïa u . Naba ka templ jong U Blei ka long kaba khuid , bad phi hi phi long ka templ jong u .

translation.en: Arise , O  Lord   ; O God , lift up thine hand : forget not the humble .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , to pynshitom ïa kito ki riewbymman ! To kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom !

translation.en: And he smote Moab  ; and the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .
translation.kha: U jop ruh ïa ki Moab kiba kylla long ki raïot jong u bad siew khajna sha u .

translation.en: And , behold , a woman , which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years , came behind him , and touched the hem of his garment :
translation.kha: Ka kynthei kaba la shitom na ka jingmihsnam bajur la khat-ar snem , ka la wan na shadien jong U Jisu bad ka la ktah ïa ka rmiang jong ka jaiñkup jong u .

translation.en: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men , saying , My father made your yoke heavy , and I will add to your yoke : my father also chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
translation.kha: U ong ,  I pa i la buh ha phi ïa ka jingkit kaba khia ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita . I pa i la shoh ïa phi da u riphin ; nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk !

translation.en: But Adoni–bezek fled  ; and they pursued after him , and caught him , and cut off his thumbs and his great toes .
translation.kha: U la phet krad , hynrei ki la beh ïa u , kem ïa u bad ki ot noh ïa ki  tikmie bad ki  jatkmie jong u .

translation.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel  ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel halor u lum Gilboa . Shibun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiba sah na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki la phet ïap .

translation.en: But thou , when thou fastest , anoint thine head , and wash thy face  ;
translation.kha: Haba phi leit khlem bam ei ei , bta ïa ka khmat jong phi bad sad ïa u shñiuh jong phi ,

translation.en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord , so walk ye in him :
translation.kha: Naduh ba phi la pdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu kum U Trai , to im ha u .

translation.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition , and of one Jesus , which was dead , whom Paul affirmed to be alive .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki don ka long katto katne ki jingïania shaphang ka niam jong ki bad shaphang u briew uba kyrteng U Jisu , uba la ïap ; hynrei u Paul u kam ba u dang im .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people , so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them .
translation.kha: Kumba nga la wallam ïa kane ka jingjot ha kine ki briew , kumta ruh ngan ai ïa ki baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la kular .

translation.en: And that the passages are stopped , and the reeds they have burned with fire , and the men of war are affrighted .
translation.kha: U nongshun u la kurup ïa ka jaka ba jam ïa ka wah bad u la thang ïa ki kut . Ki shipai Babilonia ki la lamwir .

translation.en: Charity never faileth : but whether there be prophecies , they shall fail ; whether there be tongues , they shall cease ; whether there be knowledge , it shall vanish away .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka neh bymjukut . Ki don ki khubor da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem , hynrei ki long tang shipor ; ki don ki jingai ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , hynrei kin dam noh ; ka don ka jingtip , hynrei kan sa jah noh .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Balaam , Go with the men : but only the word that I shall speak unto thee , that thou shalt speak . So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u angel u ong ,  Khie leit bad kine ki briew , hynrei kren tang ïa kaba nga ong ha me ban kren .  Kumta u Balaam u la leit ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: Laadan his son , Ammihud his son , Elishama his son ,
translation.kha: u Ladan , u Ammihud , u Elishama ,

translation.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple , having the seven plagues , clothed in pure and white linen , and having their breasts girded with golden girdles .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ki la mihnoh na ka Templ , kiba la kup da ki jaiñ linen ba-thaba kiba khuid lem bad ki panpoh ksiar ba la teh sawdong ki shadem jong ki .

translation.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament  ; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam kiba stad kin tyngshaiñ da ka jingphyrnai baroh jong ka suiñbneng . Bad kito kiba la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei kin tyngshaiñ kum ki khlur junom .

translation.en: The name of the  Lord  is a strong tower : the righteous runneth into it , and is safe .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long kum ka kut baskhem , sha kaba kiba hok ki lah ban leit bad sngewshngain .

translation.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women , and the chief men of the city , and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and expelled them out of their coasts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la pynkhih ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka nongbah bad ïa ki kynthei Jentil kiba don ha ki kyrdan kiba halor ha ka imlang ka sahlang kiba la mane ïa U Blei . Ki la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ pyrshah ïa u Paul bad u Barnabas bad ki la beh ïa ki shabar na ka thain jong ki .

translation.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa uba khlaiñbor tam na ki kynrad baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles , when we walked in lasciviousness , lusts , excess of wine , revellings , banquetings , and abominable idolatries :
translation.kha: Phi la pynlut shibun ka por kaba la leit noh da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ki bymngeit ki kwah ban leh . Ïa ka jingim jong phi la pynlut ha kaba im awria , jingkwah brai , jingdih buaid , jingleh jakhlia , ki jingïaleh-sngewbha buaid , bad ha ka jingmane ba-ijli ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she lighted off the camel .
translation.kha: Haba ka Rebekka ka ïohi ïa u Isaak , ka la hiar noh na ka ut ,

translation.en: The  Lord  hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest , that ye should be officers in the house of the  Lord  , for every man that is mad , and maketh himself a prophet , that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa phi u lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u Jehoïada , bad mynta phi long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka Templ . Ka dei ka kamram jong phi ban khmih ba ïa uwei pa uwei u riewlamwir uba leh mynleh ba u long u nongïathuhlypa dei ban buh ha ki kynjri lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba da ka nar .

translation.en: And he wrote in the letter , saying , Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle , and retire ye from him , that he may be smitten , and die .
translation.kha: U thoh :  Buh ïa u Uriah ha khmat duh , ha ka jaka kaba jur tam ka jingïaleh , nangta kynran dien noh bad ai ba un shah pynïap .

translation.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach , nor to usurp authority over the man , but to be in silence .
translation.kha: Ngam shah ïa ki kynthei ba kin hikai lane leh donbor halor ki shynrang ; ki dei ban long kiba jar jar .

translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even gather you from the people , and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta to ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan ai pat ïa ka ri Israel ha ki .

translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki nonghikai Aiñ ki ong ba u Elijah u la dei ban wan shuwa ?

translation.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour , and leadeth him into the way that is not good .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba leh jubor ki shukor ïa la ki paralok bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: Moses commanded us a law , even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob .
translation.kha: Ngi kohnguh ïa ka Aiñ ba u Moses u ai ha ngi , ka spah kordor tam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .

translation.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife  ; for he is a prophet , and he shall pray for thee , and thou shalt live : and if thou restore her not , know thou that thou shalt surely die , thou , and all that are thine .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , to pynphai noh ïa kato ka briew ha u tnga jong ka . U dei u nongïathuhlypa , bad un sa duwai na ka bynta jong me , ba kumta men ym ïap . Hynrei lada mem pynphai pat ïa ka , nga maham ïa me ba men ïap , ma me bad ki briew jong me baroh .

translation.en: Keep thee far from a false matter  ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not : for I will not justify the wicked .
translation.kha: Wat ai ki jingkynnoh kiba lamler , bad wat pynïap ïa uba lui lui , namar ngan pynrem ïa uno uno uba leh kum kata ka kam bymman .

translation.en: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim , Azariah the son of Johanan , Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth , and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum , and Amasa the son of Hadlai , stood up against them that came from the war ,
translation.kha: Saw ngut na ki rangbah ba kham pawkhmat jong ka Hima Bashatei , u Asaraïah u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Berekhaïah u khun jong u Meshillemoth , u Jehiskaïah u khun jong u Shallum , bad u Amasa u khun jong u Hadlai ruh ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki jingleh ka kynhun shipai .

translation.en: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men , saying , Fear not to serve the Chaldeans : dwell in the land , and serve the king of Babylon , and it shall be well with you .
translation.kha: U Gedalaïah u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ai ïa phi ïa la ka ktien ba kam donkam ïa phi ban sheptieng ban pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , to shongduh ha kane ka ri , to shakri ïa u syiem ka Babilonia , bad baroh kan bha ïa phi .

translation.en: And the hand of the  Lord  was on Elijah  ; and he girded up his loins , and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan ha u Elijah ; u la pynskhem ïa la ki jaiñ sawdong ka syngkai jong u bad u mareh ha shuwa u Ahab haduh ban da poi ha Jesreel .

translation.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh , saying , It is not in me : God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace .
translation.kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Syiem Kynrad , ngam lah ; hynrei U Blei un ai ka jingbatai kaba ai jinghun .

translation.en: And said unto him , Get thee out of thy country , and from thy kindred , and come into the land which I shall shew thee .
translation.kha: ‘ Iehnoh ïa la ka longïing bad ïa ka ri bad leit sha ka jaka kaba ngan pyn-i ïa me .’

translation.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren , and wept upon them : and after that his brethren talked with him .
translation.kha: Nangta katba u dang ïam kumta , u piam u doh sa ïa ki hynmen jong u baroh ; hadien kata , ki hynmen jong u ki sa ïakren ïakhana bad u .

translation.en: And they conspired against him , and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Joash u la ïasnohkti ha ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u Sekharaïah , bad ha ka hukum jong u syiem , ki paidbah ki la lynthem maw ïa u Sekharaïah ha ka phyllaw ka Templ .

translation.en: People from every continent , including Antarctica , are benefiting .
translation.kha: Ki briew na baroh ki jaka , ba kynthup ruh ïa ka Antarctica ki ïoh jingmyntoi .

translation.en: But , beloved , remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei to kynmaw , ko ki paralok jong nga , ïa kaei ba la ïathuh ha phi mynshuwa da ki apostol jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him , one on the right hand , and another on the left .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki nonglute lem bad U Jisu , uwei sha ka liang kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .

translation.en: His watchmen are blind : they are all ignorant , they are all dumb dogs , they cannot bark  ; sleeping , lying down , loving to slumber .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Baroh ki nongïalam , kiba dei ban maham ïa ki briew jong nga , ki long kiba matlah ! Kim tip ei ei . Ki long kum ki  sew-ap ki bym ju wiar — ki shu thiah bad phohsniew . Katno ki sngewtynnat ban thiah !

translation.en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria , and say , Thy god , O Dan , liveth  ; and , The manner of Beer–sheba liveth  ; even they shall fall , and never rise up again .
translation.kha: Kito kiba smai ha ki bleithaw jong ka Samaria , kiba ong , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Dan ,’ lane , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Beersheba ,’ — kito ki briew kin kyllon , bad kin ym khie pat .

translation.en: How can ye believe , which receive honour one of another , and seek not the honour that cometh from God only ?
translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban ïohpdiang jingïaroh uwei na uwei pat , hynrei phim pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh na uta uba ma u hi u long U Blei ; kumno , te , phi lah ban ngeit ha nga ?

translation.en: But if it be of God , ye cannot overthrow it  ; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God .
translation.kha: hynrei lada ka wan na U Blei , phim lah ban jop ïa ki . Phi lah ban shem ïa lade kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei !  Ka Dorbar ka la kohnguh ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u Gamaliel .

translation.en: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this , that the righteous , and the wise , and their works , are in the hand of God : no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat slem bad pyrkhat shitom ïa kane baroh bad nga la ïohi ba U Blei u synshar ïa ki jingleh jong ki briew kiba stad bad bahok , wat ïa ka jingieit bad ka jingisih jong ki . Ym don mano mano batip ei ei shaphang kaei kaba don ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: I love them that love me  ; and those that seek me early shall find me .
translation.kha: Nga ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga ; kita kiba wad ïa nga kin shem ïa nga .

translation.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest s palace , and went in , and sat with the servants , to see the end .
translation.kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai , haduh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U la leit shapoh ka phyllaw bad u la shong lem bad ki nongap byndi ban khmih kumno kan jia baroh .

translation.en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem  ; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech :
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Abimelekh bad ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban ïashun iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils , and fire out of his mouth devoured : coals were kindled by it .
translation.kha: Ka tdem ka mih na ki thliew khmut jong u , bad ka ding ba bam duh bad ki rnga kiba rhem na ka shyntur jong u .

translation.en: The churches of Asia salute you . Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord , with the church that is in their house .
translation.kha: Ki ingmane jong ka Asia ki phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi ; u Akwila bad ka Priskila bad ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong ki , ki phah ïa ka jingkhublei parabangeit .

translation.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity , and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty .
translation.kha: Ka jingbymman jong me ka paw da kaei kaba me kren ; me pyrshang ban buhrieh ha lyndet ki ktien sian jong me .

translation.en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots , with mighty men , and with all men of war , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ha ka miej jong nga kin bam baroh katba lah na ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai jong ki bad na ki shipai bad ki nongïaleh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
