translation.en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon : all other they took in battle .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah kaba la ïasuk bad ki paid Israel ka dei ka Gibeon , ha kaba katto katne ki Hib ki shong . Baroh kiwei pat ki la shahjop ha ka thma .

translation.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness , than with a contentious and an angry woman .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha bashong ha ka ri shyiap ban ïa kaba bad ka tnga kaba bunktien bad ïai thnum .

translation.en: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron : forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things : and as iron that breaketh all these , shall it break in pieces and bruise .
translation.kha: Bad nangta kan don ka hima kaba saw , kaba eh kum ka nar , kaba pynkhynñiuh bad pynpait ïa kaei kaei baroh . Bad kumba ka nar ka pynkhynñiuh ïa kaei kaei baroh , kan pynkhynñiuh bad pynlwet ïa baroh ki hima kiba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Now go , write it before them in a table , and note it in a book , that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban thoh ha ka kot ba ki briew kiba kumno ki long , khnang ba kan don ka jingthoh jingkynmaw baneh shi rta , haduh katno ki la long kiba sniew .

translation.en: Let all the earth fear the  Lord  : let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him .
translation.kha: To mane ïa U  Trai  , phi baroh ka pyrthei ! To pyndonburom ïa u , phi baroh ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Israel is an empty vine , he bringeth forth fruit unto himself : according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars  ; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba dap da ki sohwaiñ . Katba ki nang manbha , katta ki nang tei kham bun ki duwan . Katba ka ri jong ki ka nang pahuh , katta ruh ki nang pynitynnat ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang ba ki mane .

translation.en: For I will defend this city , to save it , for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
translation.kha: Ngan ïeng namar kane ka nongbah bad ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom ka jong nga hi bad namar ka kular kaba nga la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong nga .’

translation.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime , and their congregation shall be established before me , and I will punish all that oppress them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka bor mynbarim jong ka jaitbynriew bad pynskhem biang ïa ka ; ngan pynshitom ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come , and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother , which slew them  ; and upon the men of Shechem , which aided him in the killing of his brethren .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia kumta khnang ba u Abimelekh bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem , kiba la pynshlur ïa u ban pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon , kin siew na ka bynta ka kam sniew jong ki .

translation.en: Thy righteousness also , O God , is very high , who hast done great things : O God , who is like unto thee !
translation.kha: Ka hok jong me , A Blei , ka kot ïa ki sahit bneng . Me la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw , ym don mano mano uba kum ma me .

translation.en: And in the third chariot white horses  ; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses .
translation.kha: ïa kaba lai da ki kulai rong lieh , bad ïa kaba saw da ki kulai thohbroin .

translation.en: The crown is fallen from our head : woe unto us , that we have sinned !
translation.kha: Ym don shuh kano kano kaba dang sah na baroh kaba ngi la ju sngewsarong . Ngi la leh pop bad mynta ngi long kiba la tim .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years , until they came to a land inhabited  ; they did eat manna , until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ka manna sawphew snem lynter , haduh ba kin da poi ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba ki la shongduh .

translation.en: Neither from a stranger s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these  ; because their corruption is in them , and blemishes be in them : they shall not be accepted for you .
translation.kha: Wat ju kñia ïa uba kum uta u jingri ba phi ïoh na ki nongwei na ka bynta ka jingainguh bam . Kum ïa kita ki jingri la ñiew ba ki long kiba don ka jingduna , bad ym lah ban pdiang ïa ki .

translation.en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh–barnea , until we were come over the brook Zered , was thirty and eight years  ; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host , as the  Lord  sware unto them .
translation.kha: Kane ka long laiphew phra snem hadien ba ngi la mih na Kadesh Barnea . Ki rangïapom baroh jong kata ka pateng ki la ïap lut , kumba U  Trai  u la kren lypa .

translation.en: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you , ye said unto me , Nay  ; but a king shall reign over us : when the  Lord  your God was your king .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohi ba u Nahash u syiem Ammon u wan tur pyrshah ïa phi , phi la kyntait ïa U  Trai  kum u syiem jong phi bad phi ong ha nga , ‘ Ngi kwah syiem ban synshar ïa ngi .’

translation.en: Remember ye not the former things , neither consider the things of old .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ,  Wat snoh ha ki jingjia jong ka mynnor ne shongsah ha kaei kaba la jia slem mynshuwa .

translation.en: And when he saw them , he said unto them ,  Go shew yourselves unto the priests .  And it came to pass , that , as they went , they were cleansed .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki bad u la ong ha ki ,  Khie leit bad ai ba ki lyngdoh kin da khmih bniah ïa phi .  Ha lynti la pynkhuid ïa ki .

translation.en: And he wept aloud : and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard .
translation.kha: U ïam rangbah rangsan hangta haduh ba kita ki nong Ijipt ki ïohsngew , bad la leit rah ïa ka khubor sha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens . And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities , Pithom and Rameses .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nong Ijipt ki thung ïa ki nongpyntrei mraw kiba pynsaja ïa ki da kaba pynbor ba kin trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . Ki Israel ki tei ïa ki nongbah Pithom bad Rameses ba kin long ki jaka kynshew jingbam u Pharaoh .

translation.en: Terrors are turned upon me : they pursue my soul as the wind : and my welfare passeth away as a cloud .
translation.kha: Nga la shahjop ha ka jingshyrkhei ; ka burom jong nga ka la mihnoh kum ka lyer , bad ka spah jong nga kum u lyoh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished , he departed to his own house .
translation.kha: Haba ka por jingshakri jong u ha ka Templ ka la kut , u Sekharaïah u la leit phai sha ïing .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant  ; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the  Lord  with thee : notwithstanding , if there be in me iniquity , slay me thyself  ; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father ?
translation.kha: Sngewbha leh ïa kane namar jong nga ; bad bat ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba phi la ai ha nga . Hynrei lada nga long ba la pynrem , pynïap ïa nga da lade hi ! Balei phin shim ïa nga sha i pa jong phi ban shah pynïap ?

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and all his might , and how he made a pool , and a conduit , and brought water into the city , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u , bad ki jingïathuh ba kumno u la tei ïa ka jaka pynlang um bad u tih ïa ka nur ban wallam um sha ka nongbah , la buh jingthoh baroh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: And they that passed by reviled him , wagging their heads ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid lynti nangta ki pynkhih ïa la ki khlieh bad ki da ther ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa U Jisu :

translation.en: And some of them believed , and consorted with Paul and Silas  ; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and of the chief women not a few .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la sngewïahap bad ki la ïasoh bad u Paul bad u Silas ; kumta ruh ka la long ïa kiba bun ki kynthei kiba pawkhmat bad ka kynhun bah jong ki Grik kiba la mane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And upon all the high mountains , and upon all the hills that are lifted up ,
translation.kha: Un pynmadan ïa ki lumbah bakynjang bad ïa ki lumrit ,

translation.en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures , thou shalt also be taken : and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together .
translation.kha: Ko Moab , pha shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ha la ka spah , hynrei mynta wat ïa pha ruh yn jop noh ; ïa u blei Khemosh jong pha yn ringmraw , lem bad ki khun syiem bad ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses , every man according to his service , the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings , to minister , and to give thanks , and to praise in the gates of the tents of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u pynskhem biang ïa ka kynhun ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , hapoh jong kata uwei pa uwei u don la ka jong ka jong ka kamram . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok , kaba shim bynta ha ka jingmane ha ka templ , bad kaba ai ïa ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ha ki bynta bapher jong ka Templ .

translation.en: So I opened my mouth , and he caused me to eat that roll .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ang ïa la ka shyntur , bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli ban bam .

translation.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord , which gave testimony unto the word of his grace , and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la sah slem hangta , ki da kren shlur shaphang U Trai , uba la pynshisha ba ka khubor jong ki shaphang ka jingaiei ka long kaba shisha da kaba ai ha ki ka bor ban leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla .

translation.en: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them  ; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband .
translation.kha: u Mahlon bad u Khilion ruh ki la ïap , bad ka Naomi ka la shah iehnoh sa tang marwei , khlem u tnga ne ki khun shynrang .

translation.en: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land , and they spoil it , so that it be desolate , that no man may pass through because of the beasts :
translation.kha: Lane nga lah ban phah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban pynïap ïa ki briew , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ri kaba ma katta katta ba ym don uno uno uba lah ban leit lyngba ïa ka ,

translation.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim , and out of the tribe of Dan , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh , ten cities .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat kiba sah jong ka kur Kohath ki ïoh shiphew tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Ephraim , Dan , Manasseh ba sha Sepngi .

translation.en: At the same time , saith the  Lord  , will I be the God of all the families of Israel , and they shall be my people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan wan haba ngan long U Blei jong ki jait Israel baroh , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples , and came into the parts of Dalmanutha .
translation.kha: bad mar kumta hi u la kiew halor ka lieng ryngkat bad ki synran jong u bad u la leit sha ka distrik Dalmanutha .

translation.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin  ; for his seed remaineth in him : and he cannot sin , because he is born of God .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba long u khun jong U Blei , um ïai leh pop , naba ka jinglong blei batynrai jong U Blei hi ka don ha u ; bad namar U Blei u long u Kpa jong u , um lah ban ïai bteng ban leh pop .

translation.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you , he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you .
translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , u im hapoh jong phi , te uta uba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap , un ai jingim ruh ïa ki met ba kynja doh jong phi da ka jingdon U Mynsiem jong u hapoh jong phi .

translation.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka Dinah , ka khun jong u Jakob bad ka Leah , ka la leit jngoh ïa ki katto katne ki kynthei Kanaan .

translation.en: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry , with carved works , with fine linen of Egypt .
translation.kha: Nga la siang pynitynnat ïa ka jingthiah jong nga da ka jaiñ linen bun rong na Ijipt .

translation.en: And they returned to Joshua , and said unto him , Let not all the people go up  ; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai  ; and make not all the people to labour thither  ; for they are but few .
translation.kha: ki wan ïathuh ha u Joshua ,  Ym da donkam ba baroh kin leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Ai . Phah tang kumba ar ne lai hajar ngut ki rangbah . Wat phah ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei ban leit ïaleh ; kam dei ka shnong kaba heh .

translation.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is , and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei khlem ka jingngeit , naba uta uba wan sha U Blei u dei ban don ka jingngeit ba U Blei u don , bad ba u ainong ïa kita kiba wad ïa u .

translation.en: And our hope of you is stedfast , knowing , that as ye are partakers of the sufferings , so shall ye be also of the consolation .
translation.kha: Kumta ba ka jingkyrmen jong ngi sha phi kan ym khih lano lano ; ngi tip ba kumba phi ïoh bynta na kita ki jingshahshitom jong ngi , kumjuh ruh phi ïoh bynta lem na kata ka jingïarap kaba ngi ïohpdiang .

translation.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah , and came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U knieh ïa ki nongbah ba la kerkut jong ka Judah bad u tur shaphrang shaduh Jerusalem .

translation.en: Again , ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time , Thou shalt not forswear thyself , but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ruh ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ki por mynbarim , ‘ Wat pynkheiñ ïa ka kular jong phi , hynrei to leh ïa kaei kaba phi la smai ha U Trai ban leh .’

translation.en: So Jehu rode in a chariot , and went to Jezreel  ; for Joram lay there . And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram .
translation.kha: Nangta u kiew ha la ka kali ïapom bad u leit sha Jesreel . U Joram um pat shym ïoh jingkoit , bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Judah u dang don hangta , u leit jngoh ïa u .

translation.en: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah san snem .

translation.en: But he knoweth the way that I take : when he hath tried me , I shall come forth as gold .
translation.kha: Pynban U Blei u tip ïa ka jingjam baroh kaba nga shim ; lada u tynjuh ïa nga , un shem ba nga long khuid .

translation.en: And they shall mock him , and shall scourge him , and shall spit upon him , and shall kill him : and the third day he shall rise again .
translation.kha: ki ban sa rkhiebeiñ ïa u , kin bynthiew halor jong u , kin sympat ïa u , bad pynïap ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi un sa mihpat .

translation.en: There are , it may be , so many kinds of voices in the world , and none of them is without signification .
translation.kha: Don shibun ki jait ktien kiba pher ha ka pyrthei , pynban ym don na ki , kiba khlem jingmut .

translation.en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Behold , thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : now tell me , I pray thee , wherewith thou mightest be bound .
translation.kha: Ka Delilah ka ong ha u Samson ,  Peit , phi la pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba shisha . Sngewbha ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .

translation.en: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not : one man among a thousand have I found  ; but a woman among all those have I not found .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ïa kiwei pat ki jubab hynrei ngam shem ei ei . Nga la shem uwei u briew na ki shihajar ngut uba nga lah ban burom , hynrei ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei .

translation.en: And he had in his right hand seven stars : and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword : and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength .
translation.kha: U bat ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur ha ka kti kamon jong u , bad ka waitlam arliang syrti ka mih na ka shyntur jong u . Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long phyrnai kum ka sngi kaba shai ha ka por shiteng sngi .

translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , covereth it with a vessel , or putteth it under a bed  ; but setteth it on a candlestick , that they which enter in may see the light .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba thang ïa ka sharak bad tap ïa ka da ka shang lane buh ïa ka ha khrum jingthiah . Pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki dang wan rung .

translation.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he , and his wife , and all that he had , and Lot with him , into the south .
translation.kha: U Abram u leit noh shaphang shatei na ka ri Ijipt sha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don , bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .

translation.en: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down , lay low , and bring to the ground , even to the dust .
translation.kha: Un pynjot ïa ki kut jong ki Moab bad ïa ki kynroh bajrong jong ki bad pynhap ïa ki shapoh khyndew .

translation.en: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin , kaba na Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith , Abraham believed God , and it was imputed unto him for righteousness : and he was called the Friend of God .
translation.kha: Bad ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid la pynshisha haba ka la ong ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei ; bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .  Bad kumta ïa u Abraham la khot u paralok jong U Blei .

translation.en: And the officers of the children of Israel , which Pharaoh s taskmasters had set over them , were beaten , and demanded , Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day , as heretofore ?
translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw ki shoh ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam , ha kiba ki la buh ban khmih ïa ka kam . Ki la dawa ,  Balei ba phim shym shna katjuh ki maw-it kumba phi la ju shna mynshuwa ?

translation.en: And Samuel called the people together unto the  Lord  to Mizpah  ;
translation.kha: U Samuel u khot lang ïa ki briew sha ka jingïalang niam ha Mispah ,

translation.en: Six days shall work be done : but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest , an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no work therein : it is the sabbath of the  Lord  in all your dwellings .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei ïa la ka kam , hynrei kynmaw ba ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka Sabbaton , ka dei ka sngi shongthait . Ha kata ka sngi , wat trei ei ei . Ka Sabbaton ka long ka jong U  Trai  , ha ki ïing jong phi baroh .

translation.en: ( Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley . ) To morrow turn you , and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
translation.kha: ha kaba ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan ki shong mynta ha ki them jong ka . Phai noh lashai ka sngi bad leit sha kata ka ri khlaw ha ki phang jong ka khmut duriaw Akaba .

translation.en: This is the law of the burnt offering , of the meat offering , and of the sin offering , and of the trespass offering , and of the consecrations , and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings  ;
translation.kha: Kine keiñ ki long kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , ki jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat , ki jingkñia pynkyntang , bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: Let love be without dissimulation . Abhor that which is evil ; cleave to that which is good .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka dei ban long kaba sngur . To isih ïa kaei kaba sniew , to batskhem ïa kaei kaba bha .

translation.en: And thou , son of man , take thee a sharp knife , take thee a barber s razor , and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard : then take thee balances to weigh , and divide the hair .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , shim ïa ka waitlam kaba nep , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ban khi ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh bad u  ñiuhkhlieh jong me baroh . Nangta thew ïa u shñiuh ha ka tarajur bad pynbynta ïa u ha ki lai bynta .

translation.en: But the  Lord  was with Joseph , and shewed him mercy , and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad kyrkhu ïa u , ba kumta u nongap byndi u la sngewbha eh ïa u .

translation.en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight  ; her skin , and her flesh , and her blood , with her dung , shall he burn :
translation.kha: Dei ban thang ïa kata ka masi lem bad ka snieh , ka doh , ka snam , bad ki snier jong ka ha khmat jong u lyngdoh .

translation.en: How long will ye vex my soul , and break me in pieces with words ?
translation.kha: Balei ba phi ïai pynshitom ïa nga da ki ktien ?

translation.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil  ; for the devil sinneth from the beginning . For this purpose the Son of God was manifested , that he might destroy the works of the devil .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïai leh ïa ka pop , u long jong u Soitan , namar u Soitan u la leh pop naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . U Khun U Blei u la paw na ka bynta kane hi ka daw , ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba la leh da u Soitan .

translation.en: And they went to bury her : but they found no more of her than the skull , and the feet , and the palms of her hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba mih ban leit tep ïa ka , kim shem ei ei shuh lait tang ka shynrong khlieh jong ka bad ki shyieng kti bad shyieng kjat jong ka .

translation.en: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem , and saw not the king s face .
translation.kha: U Absalom u la shong ar snem ha Jerusalem khlem ïohi ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And he went up , and lay upon the child , and put his mouth upon his mouth , and his eyes upon his eyes , and his hands upon his hands : and he stretched himself upon the child  ; and the flesh of the child waxed warm .
translation.kha: Nangta u dem halor jong u khynnah , u da buh ïa la ka shyntur , ki khmat , bad ki kti halor ka shyntur , ki khmat bad ki kti jong u khynnah . Katba u dang dem halor u khynnah , ka met jong u khynnah ka sdang ban syiad .

translation.en: Millions of families earth wide have found the guidance provided in the book The Secret of Family Happiness to be a real benefit .
translation.kha: Ha satlak ka pyrthei da ki million , ki briew ki la shem da shisha ka jinghun na ka kot kaba ha ka ktien Phareng ka ba kyrteng u shabi jong ka longïng longsem ka ba kmen .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , as they went , that he entered into a certain village : and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki dang leit ha ka jingleit jong ki , u la wan sha ka shnong ha kaba ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Martha ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa u sha ka ïing jong ka .

translation.en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee , and the sons shall eat their fathers  ; and I will execute judgments in thee , and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds .
translation.kha: Kaba mih nangta kan long ba ki kmie ki kpa ha Jerusalem kin bam ïa la ki khun , bad ki khun pat kin bam ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha bad ngan pynsakma kylleng ïa kino kino kiba dang im .

translation.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment , which was inflicted of many .
translation.kha: Ka la biang ba ïa une u briew la pynshitom ha kane ka rukom da kiba bun na phi .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , while my glory passeth by , that I will put thee in a clift of the rock , and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by :
translation.kha: Haba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon jong nga ka ïaid najan nangta , ngan buh ïa me ha khmat ka krem jong uta u mawsiang bad ngan tap ïa me da la ka kti haduh ba ngan da ïaid lait nangta .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Thy brother is come  ; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf , because he hath received him safe and sound .
translation.kha: ‘ U para jong me u la wan phai pat sha ïing ,’ u shakri u la jubab , ‘ bad u kpa jong me u la phah pynïap ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha , namar u la ïoh pat ïa u ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingkoit jingkhiah .’

translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh forth out of his place , and will come down , and tread upon the high places of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan mih na ka jaka bakhuid jong u ; un wan hiar bad ïaid ha kliar jong ki lumbah .

translation.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion , and as a young lion to the house of Judah : I , even I , will tear and go away  ; I will take away , and none shall rescue him .
translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki paid Israel bad Judah kum u sing . Ma nga hi da lade ngan patar lyngkhot ïa ki , bad nangta ngan iehnoh ïa ki . Haba nga patan tyngeh ïa ki , yn ym don uba lah ban pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ngan pyntlot ïa u bad pynkhlaiñ ïa u syiem ka Babilonia . Haba nga ai ha u ïa ka waitlam jong nga bad u kdew ïa ka ban thew sha ka liang ka Ijipt , baroh kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun , and for the precious things put forth by the moon ,
translation.kha: To ka ri jong ki kan dap da u soh uba ih kat kum ka aïom , Bad kaba dap kyrhai da ki soh kiba kynsai man la ka aïom .

translation.en: She chatted with her friends about the baseball game .
translation.kha: Ka iakren bad ki paralok jongka shaphang ka baseball game .

translation.en: And said unto them , Sirs , I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage , not only of the lading and ship , but also of our lives .
translation.kha: Ko rangbah , nga ïohi ba ka jingleit jong ngi da ka lieng nangne sha khmat kan long kaba ma ; kan don ka jingjulor bakhraw ïa ka jingkit bad ïa ka lieng , bad ka jingduh ruh ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me  ; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me .
translation.kha: Mynta nga long kum u ban sa ïap noh ; ym don jinglait na ka jingjynjar jong nga .

translation.en: And he forsook the  Lord  God of his fathers , and walked not in the way of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U kyntait ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad um shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai .

translation.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you , and all the saints . They of Italy salute you .
translation.kha: To ai ki jingkhublei jong ngi sha baroh ki nongïalam jong phi bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh . Ki parabangeit jong ngi na Italy ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Hiram heard the words of Solomon , that he rejoiced greatly , and said , Blessed be the  Lord  this day , which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people .
translation.kha: U Hiram u la kmen shaba palat haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na u Solomon , bad u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ha kane ka sngi ba u la ai ha u Dabid ïa u khun uba stad kum une ban long u syiem hadien jong u ïa kata ka jaitbynriew bakhraw !

translation.en: O how love I thy law ! it is my meditation all the day .
translation.kha: A katno nga ieit ïa ka aiñ jong me ! Nga pyrkhat ïa ka baroh shi sngi .

translation.en: But God said unto him , Thou fool , this night thy soul shall be required of thee : then whose shall those things be , which thou hast provided ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u , ‘ A me uba bieit ! Ha kane hi ka miet men hap ban iehnoh ïa la ka jingim ; te mano ban ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh kiba me la buh na ka bynta ïa lade ?’

translation.en: Wherefore , holy brethren , partakers of the heavenly calling , consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession , Christ Jesus  ;
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga ïa kiba U Blei u la khot ! To pyrkhat ïa U Jisu , ïa uba U Blei u la phah ban long U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïaphla .

translation.en: And Ehud put forth his left hand , and took the dagger from his right thigh , and thrust it into his belly :
translation.kha: U Ehud pat da la ka kti kadiang u sei ïa ka waitlam na ka liang kamon jong u bad u dung pynngam ïa ka ha ka kpoh jong u syiem .

translation.en: He turned their waters into blood , and slew their fish .
translation.kha: U la pynkylla ïa ki wah jong ki sha ka snam bad pynïap ïa baroh ki dohkha jong ki .

translation.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians , and how I bare you on eagles  wings , and brought you unto myself .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi aïu ma nga , U  Trai  nga la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt bad kumno ba nga la kit ïa phi kum ka pukni kaba kit ïa la ki khun ha ki thapniang jong ka , bad nga la wan ïalam ïa phi sha nga ha kane ka jaka .

translation.en: And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  And they said , Seven .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kdiah ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki briew ,  U Jisu u la kylli ,  katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu ba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ?   Hynñiew ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: For as touching the ministering to the saints , it is superfluous for me to write to you :
translation.kha: Kam da donkam shisha ïa nga ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïarap ïa kaba dang ïai phah sha ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .

translation.en: And thou didst divide the sea before them , so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land  ; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps , as a stone into the mighty waters .
translation.kha: Lyngba ka duriaw me pynlong ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta ki briew jong me bad me ïalam ïa ki lyngba ka khyndew ba-rkhiang . Ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki , me pynïap jyllop ha ka um bajylliew , kum u maw uba ngam ha ka duriaw ba-atphyllung .

translation.en: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness .
translation.kha: Shisyndon U Mynsiem u la pynlong ïa u ban leit sha ka ri shyiap ,

translation.en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth : but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong , hynrei kito kiba shukor ki thrang tang ban leh jubor .

translation.en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned , and which he made Israel sin , by his provocation wherewith he provoked the  Lord  God of Israel to anger .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar u Jeroboam u pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop kiba u la leh bad u la pynlong ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: He made many to fall , yea , one fell upon another : and they said , Arise , and let us go again to our own people , and to the land of our nativity , from the oppressing sword .
translation.kha: Ki shipai jong phi ki jynthut bad ki kyllon ; uwei u ong ïa uwei pat , ‘ Pynkloi ! Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïing sha ki briew jong ngi bad ban ïohlait im na ka waitlam u nongshun !’

translation.en: And gave their land for an heritage , an heritage unto Israel his people .
translation.kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jong ki sha ki briew jong u ; u la ai ïa ki ha ki Israel .

translation.en: In righteousness shalt thou be established : thou shalt be far from oppression  ; for thou shalt not fear : and from terror  ; for it shall not come near thee .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok bad ka hok tynrai kin pynkhlaiñ ïa pha . Phan lait na ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingtriem .

translation.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep , and three thousand camels , and five hundred yoke of oxen , and five hundred she asses , and a very great household  ; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east .
translation.kha: U don ruh shibun ngut ki shakri bad u la long u briew bariewspah tam ha ka ri Mihngi .

translation.en: And they took Absalom , and cast him into a great pit in the wood , and laid a very great heap of stones upon him : and all Israel fled every one to his tent .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Absalom , ki la bret ïa ka ha ka thliew bajylliew hapoh ka khlaw , bad ki la tep ïa ka da ka kynton maw kaba khraw . Baroh ki Israel ki phet krad sha la shnong .

translation.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished , as many as came with Peter , because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Ki Jiw kiba la ngeit kiba la wan na Joppa lem bad u Petros ki la sngewlyngngoh ba U Blei u la theh ïa ka jingai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel : and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury  ; and they shall know my vengeance , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki Israel kin pynhiarkput ïa ka Edom namar jong nga , bad kin pynlong ïa ka Edom ban mad ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga . Ki Edom kin tip ka mut aïu ban shah ha ka jingpynhiarkput jong nga .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bud ïa u . U la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , u la kren ha ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god , and to rejoice : for they said , Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand .
translation.kha: Ki syiem Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh sngewbha bad ban ai ïa ka jingainguh kaba khraw ïa u Dagon u blei jong ki . Ki ïarwai ,  U blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop ïa u Samson u nongshun jong ngi .

translation.en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
translation.kha: Uba lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u kren , Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Badonbor .

translation.en: For he longed after you all , and was full of heaviness , because that ye had heard that he had been sick .
translation.kha: U kwah eh ban ïohi ïa phi baroh , bad u la sngew pisa shibun namar ba phi la ïohsngew ba u la pang .

translation.en: And I said unto them , Whosoever hath any gold , let them break it off . So they gave it me : then I cast it into the fire , and there came out this calf .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba kin wallam ha nga ïa la ki jingdeng ksiar , bad kito kiba don ki law ïa ki bad ki ai ïa ki ha nga . Nga bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad wan mih da une u khun masi .

translation.en: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ym don jingpynrem shuh mynta na ka bynta kito kiba im ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , ka ktien jong U Trai ka la ïai saphriang bad nang khlaiñ .

translation.en: But take ye heed : behold , I have foretold you all things .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ïa lade ! Nga la ïathuh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha phi shuwa ba ka por kan poi .

translation.en: I have declared my ways , and thou heardest me : teach me thy statutes .
translation.kha: Nga phla ïa baroh kaba nga la leh , bad me la jubab ïa nga ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki lynti jong me .

translation.en: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took firebrands , and turned tail to tail , and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit ban kem laispah tylli ki myrsiang . U teh syrdoh ïa ki tdong jong ki , shi jur shi jur , bad u buh ïa ki dongmusa ha kita ki syrdoh .

translation.en: The people shall hear , and be afraid : sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Philistia .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew , bad ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng ; ïa ki Philistia la kynrup da ka jingsngewtriem .

translation.en: Asshur is there and all her company : his graves are about him : all of them slain , fallen by the sword :
translation.kha: Ka Assyria ka don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ha baroh sawdong .

translation.en: For my flesh is meat indeed , and my blood is drink indeed .
translation.kha: Naba ka doh jong nga ka long ka jingbam bashisha ; ka snam jong nga ka long ka jingdih bashisha .

translation.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
translation.kha: U sdie u la khreh ban khet ïa ki dieng na ki thied ; ïa uno uno u dieng baroh u bym sei u soh babha yn khet noh bad bret ha ka ding .

translation.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name : I have not sent them , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ki jinglamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong nga . Ngam shym phah ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles , whither I will drive them .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ,  Kane ka long kum ka dak ba ki Israel ki hap ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba ka Aiñ ka khang , haba ngan pynsakma ïa ki sha ki ri nongwei .

translation.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands , and brought it down unto us , and brought us word again , and said , It is a good land which the  Lord  our God doth give us .
translation.kha: Ki la wanrah khyndiat ki soh ba ki shem hangta , bad ki la ïathuh ruh ba kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi ka long kaba seisoh bha .

translation.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them , and said unto them , Ye are spies  ; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ki jingphohsniew ba u la phohsniew shaphang jong ki , bad u ong ,  Phi dei ki nongsyntiat ; phi ïawan ban khmih ha-ei ka ri jong ngi ka shong tlot .

translation.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean ? not one .
translation.kha: Ym don kaba khuid kaba lah ban wan na kano kano ka bymkhuid kat ki khunbynriew .

translation.en: And the men of his city , even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city , did as Jezebel had sent unto them , and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them .
translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba ka Jesebel ka la hukum .

translation.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was  ; and could not for the press , because he was little of stature .
translation.kha: U la pyrshang ban ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u long uba kumno , hynrei u long u briew uba rit bad um lah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu namar ki paidbah .

translation.en: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy , and scall ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long kita ki aiñ shaphang ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ;

translation.en: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law , he took the blood of calves and of goats , with water , and scarlet wool , and hyssop , and sprinkled both the book , and all the people ,
translation.kha: Nyngkong , u Moses u la pynbna ha u paidlang ïa ki hukum baroh kat kum ba la buh ha ka hukum . Nangta u la shim ïa ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang , u la khleh ïa ka bad ka um , bad u la synreit ïa ka halor kata ka kitab ka hukum bad halor u paidbah baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u tnat Hissop bad katto katne u  saiwul uba saw .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Joshua , Choose us out men , and go out , fight with Amalek : to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Joshua ,  Jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ban leit ïaleh ïa ki Amalek lashai ka sngi . Ngan ïeng ha kliar u lum da kaba bat ïa u diengduh ba U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban rah .

translation.en: Now , O  Lord  God , let thy promise unto David my father be established : for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude .
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei , to pyndep ïa ka kular kaba me la ong ha u kpa jong nga . Me la pynlong syiem ïa nga halor u paidlang uba bun katta katta kat haduh ba ym lah ban ñiew , kumta to ai ha nga ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip kaba nga donkam ban synshar ïa ki .

translation.en: Who hath also sealed us , and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts .
translation.kha: uba la shon ïa ka shab jong ka jinglong trai halor jong ngi , bad uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki dohnud jong ngi kum ka jingbahkhlieh ïa kata baroh kaba u la buh tyngkai na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .
translation.kha: Ïalang paralok bad uba stad bad phin kylla stad . Lada phi ïalang paralok bad ki briew kiba bieit , phin long kiba bieit .

translation.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul : but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh .
translation.kha: Phi myntoi ïa lade haba phi bha sbun . Haba phi leh ki kam runar , phi pynmynsaw hi ïa lade .

translation.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness , but rather reprove them .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad ki kam bym don jingmyntoi kiba ki briew ki leh , kiba long ki kam ka jingdum . Pynban wallam ïa ki sha ka jingshai .

translation.en: Before I go whence I shall not return , even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death  ;
translation.kha: Ngan sa leit noh shen bad ngan ym wan phai shuh — ban leit sha ka ri kaba dum bad kaba bym don jingkyrmen ,

translation.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world , and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles ; how much more their fulness ?
translation.kha: Ka pop jong ki Jiw ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ha ka pyrthei , bad ka jingduk ba kynja mynsiem jong ki ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ïa ki Jentil . Te , haduh katno ki jingkyrkhu ba kham khraw kin long haba ïa baroh ki Jiw yn kynthup lang!

translation.en: And she wrote in the letters , saying , Proclaim a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people :
translation.kha: Ki shithi ki ong :  Pynbna ïa ka sngi ban shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah baroh bad ai ïa u Naboth ka jaka kaba donburom .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Holy One of Israel , and his Maker , Ask me of things to come concerning my sons , and concerning the work of my hands command ye me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel , uta uba saiñdur ïa ka lawei , u ong :  Phim don hok ban kylli ïa nga shaphang ki khun jong nga lane ban ïathuh ïa nga kaei ba nga dei ban leh !

translation.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .
translation.kha: U Aaron u ïathuh ha ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la kren ha u Moses , bad nangta u Moses u leh ïa ki kambah baroh ha khmat ki paidbah .

translation.en: And there shall be signs in the sun , and in the moon , and in the stars  ; and upon the earth distress of nations , with perplexity  ; the sea and the waves roaring  ;
translation.kha: Kin don kiei kiei kiba phylla ki ban jia ha ka sngi , ha u bnai , bad ha ki khlur . Ha ka pyrthei , ki ri baroh kin don ha ka jingnoh mynsiem , ki tieng ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw bad ïa ka jingkhih phaloh ki jingat phyllung .

translation.en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten , and that which they have laid up , shall they carry away to the brook of the willows .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki leit sha shiliang jong ka Them ki dieng Jamynrei , da kaba pyrshang ban lait phet lem bad la ki jingdon jingem jong ki .

translation.en: Lift up your eyes on high , and behold who hath created these things , that bringeth out their host by number : he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might , for that he is strong in power  ; not one faileth .
translation.kha: A to khmied sha ka sahit bneng ! Mano ba thaw ïa ki khlur ba phi ïohi ? Uta uba ïalam ïa ki shabar kum ka kynhun shipai , u tip katno ki don bad u khot ïa uwei uwei da ka kyrteng ! Ka bor jong u ka khraw katta katta — Ym don uwei na ki u ban jah noh .

translation.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god , whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory : and he shall cause them to rule over many , and shall divide the land for gain .
translation.kha: Ban ïada ïa la ki kut , un pyndonkam ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u blei nongwei . Un ai ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw ïa kito kiba pdiang ïa u kum u nongsynshar , un buh ïa ki ha ki jaka treikam ba-halor , bad un ai ka jaka ïa ki kum ka bainong .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong shuh ,  Hynrei nyngkong , to ngin ïakylli ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And they answered , that they could not tell whence it was .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la jubab ,  Ngim tip nangno ka la wan .

translation.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother , And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah ? ask for him the kingdom also  ; for he is mine elder brother  ; even for him , and for Abiathar the priest , and for Joab the son of Zeruiah .
translation.kha: Balei ba phi pan na nga ban ai ïa ka Abishag ha u ?  u syiem u kylli .  Phi lah ban sa pan ruh na nga ban ai ha u ïa ka khet ruh . Nalor kata , u dei u hynmen ba kham heh jong nga , bad ba u Abiathar u lyngdoh bad u Joab ki don ha ka liang jong u !

translation.en: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the  Lord  thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand , which thou shalt give unto the  Lord  thy God , according as the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee :
translation.kha: bad nangta rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , da kaba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi kat kumba u la kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David . And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .
translation.kha: U dei u syiem Hesekaïah uba set ïa ka jingmih ka um na ka Umpohliew Gihon bad ban pun ïa ka um ba kan tuid lyngba ka nur-um sha ka tduh hapoh ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead . In his days the land was quiet ten years .
translation.kha: U syiem Abijah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid . U Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u , bad hapoh ka jingsynshar u Asa ka ri ka mad ïa ka jingsuk haduh shiphew snem .

translation.en: Let the heavens rejoice , and let the earth be glad  ; let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof .
translation.kha: To lehkmen , ko ka khyndew bad ka sahit bneng ! To kyrhuh , ko ka duriaw bad baroh ki jingthaw ba don ha pha ;

translation.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion : and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus , men of Macedonia , Paul s companions in travel , they rushed with one accord into the theatre .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhihwin ka la par ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei . Ki paidbhur ki la kem ïa u Gaïos bad ïa u Aristarkhos , ki ar ngut ki nong Makedonia kiba ïaleit ryngkat bad u Paul , bad ki la paring mareh bad ki sha ka rynsan leh tamasa .

translation.en: I will say to the north , Give up  ; and to the south , Keep not back : bring my sons from far , and my daughters from the ends of the earth  ;
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka shatei ban shah ïa ki ban leit bad ïa ka shathie ban ym bat noh ïa ki . Ai ba ki briew jong nga ki wan phai na ki ri bajngai , na man la ki bynta baroh jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Moses said , Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the  Lord  ? but it shall not prosper .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ,  Te balei phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynta ? Phin ym jop !

translation.en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar : and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and he shall be clean .
translation.kha: bad un kñia ïa u bad ka jingainguh bam halor ka duwan . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid , bad uta u briew un sa long uba khuid .

translation.en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand , and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven : there shall no man be able to stand before thee , until thou have destroyed them .
translation.kha: Un aiti ha phi ïa ki syiem jong ki . Phin pynïap ïa ki , bad yn klet noh ïa ki . Yn ym don mano mano ban khang ïa phi ; phin pynjot ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Now therefore be ye not mockers , lest your bands be made strong : for I have heard from the Lord  God  of hosts a consumption , even determined upon the whole earth .
translation.kha: Wat rkhiebeiñ ïa ka jingmaham ba nga ai ïa phi ! Lada phi leh kumta , kan long kaba kham eh ïa phi ban lait im . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingrai jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ban pynjot ïa ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack : but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse .
translation.kha: Ai ha kiba duk bad phin ym don ha ka jingkyrduh lano lano ruh . Lada phi khapbrip la ki khmat sha kiba duk , ki briew kiba bun kin tim ïa phi .

translation.en: And a man s foes shall be they of his own household .
translation.kha: ki nongshun basniew tam jong u briew kin dei ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong u hi .

translation.en: And at Taberah , and at Massah , and at Kibroth–hattaavah , ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath .
translation.kha: Phi la pynbitar ruh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi mynba phi don ha Taberah , ha Massah , bad ha Kibroth Hattaabah .

translation.en: ( Psalm 119 :97-100 ) Yet , true Christians do not respect God’s standards merely to benefit themselves .
translation.kha: ( Salm 119 :97-100 ) Ki Khristan bashisha ki burom ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei ym namarba ki ïoh jingmyntoi ïalade .

translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
translation.kha: U Joshua u shakri U  Trai  , u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .

translation.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land , concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein , save Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .
translation.kha: Nga la kular ba ngan shah ïa phi ban shong hangta , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ïoh ïa kata , lait tang u Kaleb bad u Joshua .

translation.en: Turn you , and take your journey , and go to the mount of the Amorites , and unto all the places nigh thereunto , in the plain , in the hills , and in the vale , and in the south , and by the sea side , to the land of the Canaanites , and unto Lebanon , unto the great river , the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Lied noh ïa la ka dara bad ïaid shaphrang . Leit sha ri lum Amor bad sha ki jaka kiba markhap bad ka — sha ka Them Jordan , sha ki ri lum bad ri them , sha ka jaka kaba shathie bad sha ka rud duriaw Mediterranian . Leit sha ka ri Kanaan bad nangta sha lyndet ki lum Lebanon haduh ka wahbah Ïuphratis .

translation.en: He slept the whole night .
translation.kha: U Thiah Baroh Shimiet .

translation.en: Now I beseech you , brethren , for the Lord Jesus Christ s sake , and for the love of the Spirit , that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me ;
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit , da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi bad da ka jingieit kaba U Mynsiem u ai : To ïasoh bad nga ha ka jingduwai shitrhem sha U Blei na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity , they allure through the lusts of the flesh , through much wantonness , those that were clean escaped from them who live in error .
translation.kha: Ki kren ïa ki jingkren sarong bad ba-mutlop , bad ki riam pah da ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh ïa ki briew kiba dang shu sdang ban phet ïap napdeng ki briew kiba im ha ka jingleh bymdei .

translation.en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving  ; I will pay that that I have vowed . Salvation is of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me ; ngan ai ka jingkñia ïa me bad ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . Ka jingpynim ka wan na U  Trai  !

translation.en: And she went forth , and said unto her mother , What shall I ask ? And she said , The head of John the Baptist .
translation.kha: Kumta ka khynnah ka la leit noh bad ka la kylli ïa ka kmie jong ka ,  Kaei ngan pan ?   Ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ka la jubab .

translation.en: And the Syrians fled before Israel  ; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians , and forty thousand horsemen , and smote Shobach the captain of their host , who died there .
translation.kha: bad ki Israel ki la pynher krad ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria . U Dabid lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la pynïap hynñiewspah ngut ki nongñiah kali ïapom bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong u nongshun , uba la ïap ha ka madan thma .

translation.en: Wherefore shew ye to them , and before the churches , the proof of your love , and of our boasting on your behalf .
translation.kha: To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki , khnang ba ki balang baroh kin sngewskhem ïa kata bad kin tip ba ngim shym bakla ha kaba ngi kob sarong shaphang jong phi .

translation.en: Then spake Joshua to the  Lord  in the day when the  Lord  delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel , and he said in the sight of Israel , Sun , stand thou still upon Gibeon  ; and thou , Moon , in the valley of Aijalon .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa ki Israel halor ki Amor , u Joshua u kren ha U  Trai . Ha khmat ki Israel u ong ,  Ko Sngi , to ïeng thik halor ka Gibeon , Ko Bnai , to sangeh ha ka Them Aijalon .

translation.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kynthei kin don ha ka jaka tylliat kpu : Ïa kawei yn shim noh , ïa kawei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship , and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida , while he sent away the people .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew halor ka lieng bad ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha Bethsaida , sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , katba u dang phah noh ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse : every man to your tents , O Israel : and now , David , see to thine own house . So all Israel went to their tents .
translation.kha: Haba kita ki briew ki ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor ïa ki , ki pyrta jam ,  Keiñ noh ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ngin ïaleit noh sha la ïing ! Ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi na ka bynta ïa lade .  Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïaleh pyrshah ,

translation.en: And , behold , one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand , and drew his sword , and struck a servant of the high priest s , and smote off his ear .
translation.kha: Uwei na kito kiba la ïadon lang bad U Jisu , u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , da kaba mait noh ïa ka shkor jong u .

translation.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke , because the  Lord  descended upon it in fire : and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mount quaked greatly .
translation.kha: Ïa u Lum Sinai baroh uwei la tap da ka tdem , namar U  Trai  u la wan hiar ha u ha ka ding . Ka tdem ka kiew kum kaba mih na ka lawar ding , bad ki briew baroh ki la kyiuh shibun eh .

translation.en: Else , if thou refuse to let my people go , behold , to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast :
translation.kha: Lada me dang ïai kyntait , te ngan wallam ïa ki puit ha ka ri jong me .

translation.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove , and would have set them at one again , saying , Sirs , ye are brethren  ; why do ye wrong one to another ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la ïohi ar ngut ki Israel kiba dang ïashoh , bad u la pyrshang ban pynïasuk ïa ki u da ong , ‘ Shahshkor , ko rangbah ,’ u la ong , ‘ phi ïalong para Israel ; balei ba phi ïashoh kumne ?’

translation.en: Pass through thy land as a river , O daughter of Tarshish : there is no more strength .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad rep ïa kata ka ri , phi ki briew ha ki jaka buhai shnong ha Spain ! Ym don shuh mano mano ban ïada ïa phi .

translation.en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats : and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting , clothed in white raiment  ; and they had on their heads crowns of gold .
translation.kha: Sawdong ïa ka khet , la don arphew saw tylli kiwei pat ki khet , ha kaba la shong arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang    kiba la riam da kaba lieh bad phong ki pansngiat ksiar .

translation.en: I will get me unto the great men , and will speak unto them  ; for they have known the way of the  Lord  , and the judgment of their God : but these have altogether broken the yoke , and burst the bonds .
translation.kha: Ngan leit sha ki briew kiba ha ka bor ; bad ïakren bad ki . Da shisha ki tip kaei ba U Blei u dawa , kaei ba U  Trai  u kwah ïa ki ban leh .  Hynrei ki baroh ki la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong U  Trai bad ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: And when I saw him , I fell at his feet as dead . And he laid his right hand upon me , saying unto me ,  Fear not  ; I am the first and the last :
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ïa u , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u kum u briew ba la ïap . U la buh ïa ka kti kamon jong u halor jong nga bad u la ong ,  Wat sheptieng ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh .

translation.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave . It was a cave , and a stone lay upon it .
translation.kha: Haba la ktah jur sa shisien , U Jisu u la leit sha ka jingtep , kaba long ka krem ba la khang da u mawkhang .

translation.en: When the king of Babylon s army fought against Jerusalem , and against all the cities of Judah that were left , against Lachish , and against Azekah : for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai ka dang tur ïaleh ruh ïa ka Lakhish bad ka Asekah , kiba long tang ma ki kiwei pat ki nongbah ba la tei kynroh kiba dang sah jong ka Judah .

translation.en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come , and not the very image of the things , can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect .
translation.kha: Ka Hukum ki Jiw kam dei ka nuksa ba-pura bad baïaineh jong kiei kiei kiba shisha ; ka long tang ka nuksa batlot jong kita kiei kiei kiba bha ki ban sa wan . Ïa kijuh ki jait jingkñia la ju ainguh lynter , na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem . Kumno kata ka Hukum , te , da kaba leh ïa kine ki jingkñia kan lah ban pynjanai ïa ki briew kiba wan sha U Blei ?

translation.en: A time to love , and a time to hate  ; a time of war , and a time of peace .
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban ieit bad ka por ban isih , ka por ïa ka thma bad ka por ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Pass me the pen .
translation.kha: Ai sha nga u khulom .

translation.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies , and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines  ; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka ri ki la sdang ban ïakajia para ma ki .  U syiem Dabid u la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ,  ki ïa-ong uwei ïa uwei pat .  U la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia ; hynrei mynta pat u la phet krad na u Absalom bad u la iehnoh ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Many therefore of his disciples , when they had heard this , said , This is an hard saying  ; who can hear it ?
translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki nongbud jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kane bad ki la ong ,  Kane ka jinghikai ka long kaba eh than . Uei u ban shahshkor ïa ka ?

translation.en: And Mary arose in those days , and went into the hill country with haste , into a city of Juda  ;
translation.kha: Shen hadien , ka Mari ka la khreh bad ka la leit bran bran sha ka shnong ha ka ri lum ha Judia .

translation.en: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him , and saith , Behold the Lamb of God , which taketh away the sin of the world .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u wan sha u , bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih , U Khunlangbrot jong U Blei , uba kit noh ïa ka pop jong ka pyrthei !

translation.en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace : a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee .
translation.kha: Kan long ka pansngiat ka burom ha phi .

translation.en: Behold my hands and my feet , that it is I myself : handle me , and see  ; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones , as ye see me have .
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki kti jong nga bad ki kjat jong nga , bad peit ba dei ma nga hi . Tba ïa nga , bad phin tip , naba ka rngai kam don ka doh bad ki shyieng , kumba phi ïohi ba nga don .

translation.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels : who can stand before his cold ?
translation.kha: U phah ïa u phria kum u mawria ; ym don uba lah ban shah ïa ka jingkhriat ba u phah !

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob , and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel , and will be jealous for my holy name  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Hynrei mynta ngan sngewsynei ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ki briew ka Israel , bad ngan pynmanbha biang ïa ki . Ngan ïada ïa la ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih

translation.en: Behold , I come quickly : blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book .
translation.kha: Shahshkor !  ong U Jisu .  Nga wan kloi ! Suk kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien ïathuhlypa kiba hapoh kane ka kitab !

translation.en: And when he had spoken such words unto me , I set my face toward the ground , and I became dumb .
translation.kha: Haba u la kren ïa kane , nga la peit sha khyndew , khlem lait kren .

translation.en: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem , to appoint captains , to open the mouth in the slaughter , to lift up the voice with shouting , to appoint battering rams against the gates , to cast a mount , and to build a fort .
translation.kha: Mynta ! Ka kti kamon jong u ka bat ïa ka jingkdew ba la thoh ‘ Jerusalem’ ! Ka ïathuh ïa u ban leit bad buh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh , ban pyrta ïa ka jingkyang thma , ban buh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh pyrshah ïa ki khyrdop , ban bret shajrong ïa ka khyndew ba la tih , bad ban tih ïa ki kharai .

translation.en: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride ,
translation.kha: Hato pham shym biria shaphang ka Sodom ha kito ki sngi mynba pha la sngewsarong

translation.en: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki halor u khun kada bad ki la ïarap ïa U Jisu ban kiew halor jong u .

translation.en: For great is the  Lord  , and greatly to be praised : he also is to be feared above all gods .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba eh dei ban ïaroh ; ïa u dei ban ai ka burom palat ban ïa kiwei ki blei baroh .

translation.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , and took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he took all : he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
translation.kha: U syiem Shishak u wan sha Jerusalem bad u shim ïa ki jingkynshew na ka Templ bad na ka ïingsyiem . U shim lut ïa kiei kiei , kaba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kaba u syiem Solomon u la thaw .

translation.en: And it came to pass in Iconium , that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews , and so spake , that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha Ikoniom : U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha ka synagog bad ki la kren ha kata ka rukom ba kiba bun ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki la kylla long ki riewngeit .

translation.en: And as for the king of Judah , who sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , so shall ye say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard  ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta u syiem ïa lade hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga ong : To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ,

translation.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kumno la pynkhiah ïa uta u briew .

translation.en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me , then I will punish you seven times more for your sins .
translation.kha: Lada wat hadien kat kane phim treh satia ban shahshkor ïa nga , ngan pynshitom jur ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .

translation.en: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant , when , lo , he had given his hand , and hath done all these things , he shall not escape .
translation.kha: U la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la lah pynlong . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , bad mynta un ym ïohlait ban phet .

translation.en: Thy right hand , O  Lord  , is become glorious in power : thy right hand , O  Lord  , hath dashed in pieces the enemy .
translation.kha: Ka kti kamon jong me , A  Trai  , ka long kaba khraw eh ha ka bor ; ka pynlwet thiaw ïa u nongshun .

translation.en: And it shall be with him , and he shall read therein all the days of his life : that he may learn to fear the  Lord  his God , to keep all the words of this law and these statutes , to do them :
translation.kha: Un buh bad u ïa kata ka kitab bad un pule na ka synñia sngi , ba un tip ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai  bad kohnguh hok ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba la thoh hangta .

translation.en: He appointed also the king s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings , to wit , for the morning and evening burnt offerings , and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths , and for the new moons , and for the set feasts , as it is written in the law of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Na la ki kynhun jingri u pyndap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet , bad na ka bynta kito ïa kiba ainguh ha ka sngi Sabbaton , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha kiwei ki jinglehkmen ïa kiba donkam da ka hukum jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses , whom the  Lord  knew face to face ,
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don u nongïathuhlypa ha Israel uba kum u Moses ; U  Trai  u ïakren bad u markhmat .

translation.en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness , where he encamped at the mount of God :
translation.kha: U Jethro u la wan bad ka tnga jong u Moses lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka sha ka ri shyiap ha kaba u Moses u la sher dara ha u lum bakhuid .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day , that the Amalekites had invaded the south , and Ziklag , and smitten Ziklag , and burned it with fire  ;
translation.kha: Hadien ar sngi , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki wan poi pat ha Siklag . Ki Amalek ki la lute ïa ka ri Judah kaba shathie bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Siklag . Ki la thang ïa ka shnong

translation.en: But as for the mighty man , he had the earth  ; and the honourable man dwelt in it .
translation.kha: Phi pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi bad ïa ka kyrdan jong phi ban shim noh ïa ka jaka baroh .

translation.en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth , and enquired of him : and he described unto him the princes of Succoth , and the elders thereof , even threescore and seventeen men .
translation.kha: u la ïohkem ïa uwei u samla uba na Sukkoth bad u kylli ïa u . U samla u la thoh na ka bynta u Gideon ïa ki kyrteng jong ki hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba ha khmat eh jong ka Sukkoth .

translation.en: And it shall be , that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , even upon them shall be no rain .
translation.kha: Lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka kyntait ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem , te u slap un ym hap ha ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: With all lowliness and meekness , with longsuffering , forbearing one another in love ;
translation.kha: To long borabor kiba sngewrit , kiba jemnud , bad kiba ïaishah . To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi da kaba ïaishah iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Peter saith unto him , Thou shalt never wash my feet . Jesus answered him ,  If I wash thee not , thou hast no part with me .
translation.kha: U Petros u la pynbna ,  Da lei lei ha kano kano ka por men ym ïoh ban sait ïa ki kjat jong nga .   Lada ngam ïoh ban sait ïa ki kjat jong me ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  men ym ïoh long shuh u synran jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , he breaketh down , and it cannot be built again : he shutteth up a man , and there can be no opening .
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u pyntwa , uei uba lah ban tei pat , bad uno uba lah ban pyllait ïa u briew uba U Blei u la set byndi ?

translation.en: And the sons of Javan  ; Elishah , and Tarshish , Kittim , and Dodanim .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jaban ki long ki briew jong ka Elishah , ka Spain , ka Sypros , bad ka Rhodes ; ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba shong ha ki rud duriaw bad ha ki dewlynnong .

translation.en: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .
translation.kha: Kaba bam than ïa ka ngap kam bha ïa phi ; bad kumta ruh ka long kaba pyrshang ban ïoh palat ka jingïaroh .

translation.en: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony , and cover the ark with the veil .
translation.kha: Buh hangta ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki Shiphew Hukum , bad kah ïa ka da ka pyrda .

translation.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water : Jesus saith unto her ,  Give me to drink .
translation.kha: Ka nong Samaria ka la wan ban tong um , bad U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  To ai um ba ngan dih .

translation.en: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la kylli jar jar ïa u ,  Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid ?

translation.en: And the woman said , Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God ? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty , in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished .
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u ,  Balei ba phi la leh kum kane ka jingbakla ha ki briew jong U Blei ? Phim shym la shah ïa la u jong u khun ban wan phai noh na ka jingphet wir , bad kumta phi la pynrem ïa lade da kaei kaba phi dang shu dep ong .

translation.en: Tell us therefore , What thinkest thou ? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar , or not ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , te , kaei kaba me pyrkhat ? Hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong ngi ban siew khajna sha u Patsha ka hima Rom , ne kam long ?

translation.en: Watch therefore , for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  To sumar bha , te , namar ba phim tip ïa ka sngi lane ïa ka kynta .

translation.en: And they answered Joshua , saying , All that thou commandest us we will do , and whithersoever thou sendest us , we will go .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u Joshua ,  Ngin leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me la ong ïa ngi bad ngin leit kat shaba me phah ïa ngi .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house , that David said to Nathan the prophet , Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars , but the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  remaineth under curtains .
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid mynta u shong ha ka ïingsyiem jong u . Ha kawei ka sngi u phah khot ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa bad ong ha u ,  Hangne nga shong ha ka ïing ba la thaw da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !

translation.en: For we are strangers before thee , and sojourners , as were all our fathers : our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is none abiding .
translation.kha: Me tip , A Trai , ba ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingim kum ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh . Ki sngi jong ngi ki long kum ka syrngiew bad ngin ym lait na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines , and unto the border of Egypt : they brought presents , and served Solomon all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Ka hima u Solomon ka kynthup ïa baroh ki ri naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri ki Philistia bad ka pud Ijipt . Ki la siew khajna ïa u bad ki la hap hapoh jong u katba u dang im .

translation.en: And he said unto them , I am an hundred and twenty years old this day  ; I can no more go out and come in : also the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Mynta nga la dap shispah arphew snem bad ngam lah shuh ban long u nongïalam jong phi . Nalorkata , U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ba ngan ym ïoh ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And then the coast turneth to Ramah , and to the strong city Tyre  ; and the coast turneth to Hosah  ; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib :
translation.kha: Nangta u pud u khun sha Ramah , u da poi ha Tyros , ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta u khun sha Hosah bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Ka kynthup ïa ka Mahalab , ka Akhsib ,

translation.en: See then that ye walk circumspectly , not as fools , but as wise ,
translation.kha: Kumta da sumar kumno phi im . Wat im kum ki briew kiba bieit , hynrei , kum ki briew kiba stad .

translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What sawest thou , that thou hast done this thing ?
translation.kha: Balei me leit leh ïa ka ?

translation.en: For as in Adam all die , even so in Christ shall all be made alive .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ki briew baroh ki ïap namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha u Adam , kumjuh ruh ïa baroh yn pynmihpat namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David . And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword : and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .
translation.kha: U la ai jingkheiñ ha u Dabid ïa ka jingdon baroh lang jong ki rangbah kiba bit ïa ka kam shipai : Khatwei lakh ngut ha Israel , bad saw lakh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ha Judah .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Uzziah did : howbeit he entered not into the temple of the  Lord . And the people did yet corruptly .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , kumba u kpa jong u , u la leh ; hynrei , ym kum u kpa jong u , um shym la leh pop da kaba thang jingiwbih ha ka Templ . Ki briew pynban , ki dang ïai leh pop .

translation.en: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of : The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits , the breadth of it fifty cubits , and the height of it thirty cubits .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka shispah laiphew lai mitar ka lynter , arphew ar mitar ka pyngkiang bad khatlai mitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind , and with all thy strength : this is the first commandment .
translation.kha: Men ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh , da ka mynsiem jong me baroh , da ka jingmut jong me baroh , bad da ka bor jong me baroh .’

translation.en: And go , get thee to them of the captivity , unto the children of thy people , and speak unto them , and tell them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear .
translation.kha: To leit sha la ki para ri kiba shah ringmraw bad ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki , la ki shahshkor ne kim shahshkor ïa me .

translation.en: Which was the son of Melea , which was the son of Menan , which was the son of Mattatha , which was the son of Nathan , which was the son of David ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Melea , u khun jong u Menna , u khun jong u Mattatha , u khun jong u Nathan , u khun jong u Dabid ,

translation.en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men .
translation.kha: Mynta khatduh U Trai u la ïarap ïa nga ,  ka la ong .  U la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga hapdeng ki briew !

translation.en: But man dieth , and wasteth away : yea , man giveth up the ghost , and where is he ?
