translation.kha: Hynrei u briew u ïap noh , bad kata ka long kaba kut jong u ; u ïap bad hangno keiñ u don ?

translation.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him : and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight .
translation.kha: la kum ba leh ïa u nongbylla uba trei snem . U kynrad jong u , um dei ban pynshitom beiñ ïa u .

translation.en: That brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ba ngan ïoh long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Then he took unto him the twelve , and said unto them ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem , and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïalam sharud ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ha sngap ! Ngi ïaleit sha Jerusalem ha kaba ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh shaphang U Khun U Briew kan urlong shisha .

translation.en: And after eight days again his disciples were within , and Thomas with them : then came Jesus , the doors being shut , and stood in the midst , and said ,  Peace be unto you .
translation.kha: Shi taïew hadien ki synran ki la ïadon lang biang hapoh ïing , bad u Thomas u la don lem bad ki . Ïa ki jingkhang la khang skhem , hynrei U Jisu u la wan bad u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi .

translation.en: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter .
translation.kha: Haba ki la rung pat shapoh ïing , ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang kane .

translation.en: Many of the people therefore , when they heard this saying , said , Of a truth this is the Prophet .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew ha uta u paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la ong ,  Une u briew u dei da shisha u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit , they are created : and thou renewest the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba me ai pat ha ki ïa ka jingpyrsad jong me , la thaw ïa ki ; me ai ka jingim bathymmai ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave  ; and whole , as those that go down into the pit :
translation.kha: Ki lah ban shait ban khlaiñ haba ngi lap ïa ki , hynrei kin ïap haba ngi ïoh leh dusmon ïa ki !

translation.en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs  ; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols .
translation.kha: Keiñ noh kaba rwai da ka sur bajam ; ngam kwah ban sngap ïa ki duitara jong phi .

translation.en: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp , they went into one tent , and did eat and drink , and carried thence silver , and gold , and raiment , and went and hid it  ; and came again , and entered into another tent , and carried thence also , and went and hid it .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah saw ngut ki poi harud kata ka jaka shong dara , ki leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ , ki bam ki dih kat kaba don , ki la rah noh ïa ka rupa , ka ksiar , bad ki jaiñ ba ki shem bad ki leit noh bad buhrieh ïa ki ; nangta ki wan phai , ki la rung ha kawei pat ka ïingjaiñ bad ki leh kumjuh .

translation.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin ïa-ong te , ba u Abraham u kpa , jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi , Kaei ka jingshem jong u ?

translation.en: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men , beside women and children .
translation.kha: Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki rangbah kiba la bam ka la long san hajar ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Saul was returned from following the Philistines , that it was told him , saying , Behold , David is in the wilderness of En–gedi .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u wan phai na kaba ïaleh ïa ki Philistia , la ïathuh ha u ba u Dabid u don ha ka ri khlaw hajan Engedi .

translation.en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days  ; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee , neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ; ym dei ban don u thiat ne u kpu ba la khleh thiat hangno hangno ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: So there was hail , and fire mingled with the hail , very grievous , such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka  erïong kaba jur tam ba ka Ijipt ka la mad ha ka histori jong ka baroh .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Without understanding , covenantbreakers , without natural affection , implacable , unmerciful :
translation.kha: kim don ka jingïatiplem ; kim bat ïa la ki kular , bad kim pyn-i jingsbun lane jingisynei ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Then I said unto you , Dread not , neither be afraid of them .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Wat tieng ïa kita ki briew .

translation.en: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds , to meet the Lord in the air : and so shall we ever be with the Lord .
translation.kha: nangta ïa ngi kiba dang im ha kata ka por yn lumlang lem bad ki ha ki ha ki lyoh ban ïashem ïa U Trai ha suiñ . Bad kumta ngin ïailong borabor bad U Trai .

translation.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude  ; and the  Lord  hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also ?
translation.kha: Kaba khyndiat kaba phi don shuwa ba ngan wan ka la roi kyrhai , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi kat shaba nga leit . Mynta ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban peit sa na bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: But Jesus turning unto them said ,  Daughters of Jerusalem , weep not for me , but weep for yourselves , and for your children .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai sha ki bad u la ong ,  Ko kynthei Jerusalem ! Wat ïam na ka bynta jong nga , hynrei na ka bynta ïa lade bad ki khun jong phi .

translation.en: But I had pity for mine holy name , which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen , whither they went .
translation.kha: Kata ka pynlong ïa nga ban khuslai shaphang ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ki Israel ki pynjahburom ïa ka kat shaba ki leit .

translation.en: When saw we thee a stranger , and took thee in ? or naked , and clothed thee ?
translation.kha: Mynno ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me long u nongwei , bad ba ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa me ha ki ïing jong ngi , lane ba me lyngkhuit bad ba ngi pynkup jaiñ ïa me ?

translation.en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead , and fought with Ephraim : and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim , because they said , Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites , and among the Manassites .
translation.kha: Hangta u Jephthah u lumlang ïa ki rangbah Gilead baroh , ki ïaleh ïa ki rangbah Ephraim , bad u jop ïa ki . ( Naba ki Ephraim ki ong ,  Phi ki Gilead kiba ha Ephraim bad Manasseh phi dei ki nongphetwir na Ephraim !  )

translation.en: And I will send hornets before thee , which shall drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pyntieng kulmar ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Hib , ki Kanaan , bad ki Hit katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

translation.en: And saith unto him , Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine  ; and when men have well drunk , then that which is worse : but thou hast kept the good wine until now .
translation.kha: kumta u la phah khot ïa u nongleitkurim , bad u la ong ha u ,  U briew baroh u ai shuwa ïa ka waiñ kaba bha tam , bad hadien ba kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki la dih pahuh , u pynbud sa da ka waiñ kaba kham duna ka jingmad . Hynrei ma me , me tyngkai ïa ka waiñ kaba bha tam haduh mynta !

translation.en: And Jesus went with him  ; and much people followed him , and thronged him .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad u . Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïaleit lang bad U Jisu , ki da ïa-thngian sha u na baroh ki liang .

translation.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans , and dwelt in Charran : and from thence , when his father was dead , he removed him into this land , wherein ye now dwell .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u la iehnoh ïa la ka ri bad u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Haran . Hadien ba u kpa jong u Abraham u la ïap , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u ban kynriah sha kane ka jaka ha kaba phi mynta phi shong phi sah .

translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Have not I chosen you twelve , and one of you is a devil ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai ktien ,  Hato ngam shym la jied ïa phi baroh khat-ar ngut ? Pynban uwei na phi u long u ksuid !

translation.en: And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la leit ha shuwa jong ki , u da nguh ngon haduh khyndew hynñiew sien katba u nang leit sha jan u hynmen jong u .

translation.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way , who walk in the law of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba ka jingim jong ki ka long ka bym don jingbakla , kiba im kat kum ka aiñ jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And all Israel shall hear , and fear , and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh kin sa ïohsngew aïu ka la jia , bad kin sheptieng ; bad yn ym don shuh mano mano u ban leh kum ïa kata ka kam bymman .

translation.en: Neither shall any priest drink wine , when they enter into the inner court .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ shuwa ban leit rung hapoh ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh .

translation.en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting : whatsoever I speak therefore , even as the Father said unto me , so I speak .
translation.kha: Bad nga tip ba ka hukum jong u ka wallam ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Kaei kaba nga ong , namarkata , ka long kaei kaba U Kpa u la ïathuh ïa nga ban ong .

translation.en: Say ye not , A confederacy , to all them to whom this people shall say , A confederacy  ; neither fear ye their fear , nor be afraid .
translation.kha: Wat ïasoh ha ki jingïathmu basniew jong ki briew bad wat sheptieng ïa kiei kiei kiba ki sheptieng .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong phi , namar ba ka long kaba eh ban hikai ïa phi .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came unto Hosea , the son of Beeri , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Hosia u khun jong u Beri , ha ki sngi mynba u Ussaïah , u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki long ki syiem ha Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long syiem ha Israel .

translation.en: Who , being in the form of God , thought it not robbery to be equal with God :
translation.kha: U don borabor ïa ka jinglong U Blei ; hynrei um shym pyrkhat ïa kata da ka bor ba u dei ban pyrshang ban pynlong mar ryngkat bad U Blei .

translation.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted , and shall kill you : and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name s sake .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa phi yn kem bad yn aiti ban shah pynshitom bad ban shah pynïap . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong nga .

translation.en: How long wilt thou go about , O thou backsliding daughter ? for the  Lord  hath created a new thing in the earth , A woman shall compass a man .
translation.kha: Haduh katno phin pynslem , ko ki briew bym don jingngeit ? Nga la thaw kaei kaei kaba thymmai bad kaba pher , kaba pher kum ka briew kaba ïada ïa u briew .

translation.en: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee , and thou shalt be cut off for ever .
translation.kha: Namar ba pha lute bad pynïap ïa la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa pha yn pynjot bad pynjahburom junom .

translation.en: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him : and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them , therefore will I sacrifice to them , that they may help me . But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel .
translation.kha: U kñia ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki Syria , kiba la jop ïa u . U ong ,  Ki blei jong ki Syria ki la ïarap ïa ki syiem Syria , kumta lada nga ai jingkñia sha ki , ki lah ban ïarap ïa nga ruh .  Kane ka la wanrah jingpynjot ïa u bad ha ka hima jong u .

translation.en: Saying , Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord : peace in heaven , and glory in the highest .
translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa u syiem uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! Ka jingsuk ha ki bneng bad ka burom ïa U Blei !

translation.en: Canst thou send lightnings , that they may go , and say unto thee , Here we are ?
translation.kha: Bad lada me hukum ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ; hato kan wan sha me bad ong ,  Nga kloi ban leh ei ei  ?

translation.en: Jesus was a perfect human just like Adam .
translation.kha: U Jisu u long u briew u bajanai kum u Adam .

translation.en: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the  Lord . And they took Dagon , and set him in his place again .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki briew ka Ashdod , ki la ïohi ïa u mot jong u Dagon ba u la kyllon da pyllup ha madan ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai . Kumta ki khyllie bad buh biang ïa u ha kajuh ka jaka .

translation.en: Unto the place of the altar , which he had made there at the first : and there Abram called on the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la poi ha kata ka jaka hapdeng ka Bethel bad ka Ai ha kaba u la sher dara mynshuwa , bad ba u la lah tei ïa ka duwan . Hangta u la mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And when he had received meat , he was strengthened . Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus .
translation.kha: bad hadien ba u la bam jingbam , u la ïohbor pat . U Saul u la sah katto katne sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Damaskos .

translation.en: Then Jael Heber s wife took a nail of the tent , and took an hammer in her hand , and went softly unto him , and smote the nail into his temples , and fastened it into the ground : for he was fast asleep and weary . So he died .
translation.kha: U Sisera u la thait haduh katta katta ba u da ïohthiah jar . Nangta ka Jael ka shim ïa u tyrnem bad u snar pynskhem dara , ka la leit mian mian sha u , bad ka pynïap ïa u da kaba sah ïa u snar na ka moi moi jong u ha ban da pei phlait haduh khyndew .

translation.en: And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence , and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth , to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :
translation.kha: Ngan beh kthong ïa ki da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin sngewtriem ha kaei kaba ki ïohi . Kylleng kylleng nga pynsakma ïa ki , ki briew kin kyndit bad sngewshyrkhei ha kaei kaba la jia ha ki . Ki briew kin krenbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .

translation.en: Then answered one of the lawyers , and said unto him , Master , thus saying thou reproachest us also .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki nonghikai ka Hukum u la ong ha u ,  Ko Nonghikai , haba me ong ïa kane , me ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi ruh !

translation.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day , nor the pillar of fire by night , from before the people .
translation.kha: Uta u rishot lyoh u don borabor ha shuwa uta u paidbah ha ka por mynsngi , bad u rishot ding pat , mynmiet .

translation.en: For , lo , he that formeth the mountains , and createth the wind , and declareth unto man what is his thought , that maketh the morning darkness , and treadeth upon the high places of the earth , The  Lord  , The God of hosts , is his name .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uta uba la thaw ïa ki lumbah bad uba pynlong ïa ki lyer . U pynpaw ïa la ki jingmut ha u briew ; u pynkylla ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U ïaid ha kiba kynjang jong ka pyrthei . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong u : U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh !

translation.en: And they came , every one whose heart stirred him up , and every one whom his spirit made willing , and they brought the  Lord s  offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation , and for all his service , and for the holy garments .
translation.kha: bad baroh kiba mon ban leh kumta , ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  ïa kaba yn pyndonkam ha kaba shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki wallam kat ïa kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingmane , bad na ka bynta ban thain ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh .

translation.en: Ye have heard the blasphemy : what think ye ? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei . Kaei ka jingrai jong phi ?  Baroh ki la rai pyrshah ïa u : U long ba la rem bad dei ban pynïap noh ïa u .

translation.en: For so is the will of God , that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men :
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingkren khlem pyrkhat jong ki briew kiba bieit da ki kam babha ba phi leh .

translation.en: Thou therefore which teachest another , teachest thou not thyself ? thou that preachest a man should not steal , dost thou steal ?
translation.kha: Phi hikai ïa kiwei pat — balei phim hikai ïa lade ? Phi ïalap ,  Wat tuh  — hynrei phi hi phi tuh ?

translation.en: Then said David , Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul ? And the  Lord  said , They will deliver thee up .
translation.kha: Bad hato ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga ha u Saul ?  u Dabid u kylli biang .  Kin ai ,  U  Trai  u jubab .

translation.en: The  Lord  said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant  ; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ai ba ki jingtim jong ki baroh kin urlong shisha lada ngam shym la shakri bha ïa me , lada ngam shym la ïasaid bad me na ka bynta ki nongshun jong nga mynba ki don ha ka jingjynjar bad jingeh bajur .

translation.en: And when they went , I heard the noise of their wings , like the noise of great waters , as the voice of the Almighty , the voice of speech , as the noise of an host : when they stood , they let down their wings .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki thapniang haba ki her ; ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , kumba khynwin ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ; kum ka sur jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Haba ki sangeh na kaba her , ki khylliap ïa la ki thapniang ,

translation.en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem da kijuh ki tiar da kiba la suh ïa ka ephod , bad ki pynpur itynnat ïa ka ruh ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: And his servants conspired against him , and slew him in his own house .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices very great store , and precious stones : there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon .
translation.kha: Ka la ai sngewbha ïa u syiem Solomon da ki jingai kiba ka la wanrah palat saw hajar kilo ka ksiar bad shikatdei eh ki jingiwbih bad ki mawlynnai . Kat kita ki jingiwbih ba ka ai ïa u ka long kaba bun tam ba um pat ju ïoh ha kano kano ka por .

translation.en: The baptism of John , whence was it ? from heaven , or of men ?  And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say unto us , Why did ye not then believe him ?
translation.kha: Nangno ka hok jong u Ïoannis ban pynbaptis ka wan : hato ka long na U Blei ne na u briew ?  Ki la sdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki ,  Aïu ngin ïa-ong ? Lada ngi jubab ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , phim ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’

translation.en: But Mary kept all these things , and pondered them in her heart .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei baroh bad ka la pyrkhat jylliew shaphang kita .

translation.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual , but that which is natural ; and afterward that which is spiritual .
translation.kha: Kam shym long kaba kynja mynsiem kaba la wan shuwa , hynrei kaba kynja doh , bad nangta kaba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: The king of Jericho , one  ; the king of Ai , which is beside Beth–el , one  ;
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem jong kine ki nongbah : ka Jerikho , ka Ai ( hajan Bethel ) ,

translation.en: So I spake unto the people in the morning : and at even my wife died  ; and I did in the morning as I was commanded .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab nga la kren bad ki briew . Ha kata ka janmiet ka tnga jong nga ka la ïap , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud nga la leh kumba la bthah ïa nga .

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? behold , they that wear soft clothing are in kings  houses .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u briew uba la kup da ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ? Ki briew kiba riam kumta ki shong ki sah ha ki ïingsyiem !

translation.en: The sower soweth the word .
translation.kha: U nongbet u bet ïa ka khubor U Blei .

translation.en: The  Lord  forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed : but , I pray thee , take thou now the spear that is at his bolster , and the cruse of water , and let us go .
translation.kha: Da lei lei U  Trai  un ym shah ïa nga ban pynmynsaw ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem ! To ngin ïashim ïa une u sum bad une u khiew um jong u , bad ïa ngin ïaleit noh .

translation.en: Also when I cry and shout , he shutteth out my prayer .
translation.kha: Nga kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap , hynrei U Blei u kyntait ban shahshkor ;

translation.en: I advised Tom not to waste his time trying to do that .
translation.kha: Nga ai-jingmut ia u Tom ba un ym pynlut por ban leh ia kato .

translation.en: Whose end is destruction , whose god is their belly , and whose glory is in their shame , who mind earthly things .
translation.kha: Ka jingkut jong ki kan long ha dujok , namar u blei jong ki u long ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong ki . Ki sngewsarong ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban sngewlehrain , bad ki pyrkhat tang ïa kiei kiei kiba long ki jong kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Thou makest darkness , and it is night : wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa ka miet , bad ha ka jingdum baroh ki mradkhlaw ki mih shabar .

translation.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes : but love covereth all sins .
translation.kha: Ka jingshun ka pynmih ïa ki jingïakajia , hynrei ka jingieit ka klet noh ïa ki kam palat baroh .

translation.en: Length of days is in her right hand  ; and in her left hand riches and honour .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi kumjuh ruh ka pynïoh ïa ka spah bad ka burom .

translation.en: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea  ; and it became as the blood of a dead man : and every living soul died in the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba ar u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka duriaw . Ka um ka la kylla long kum ka snam jong u briew uba ïap , bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba-im hapoh duriaw u la ïap .

translation.en: Husbands , love your wives , and be not bitter against them .
translation.kha: Ko ki shynrang , to ieit ïa la ki tnga bad wat long kiba leh khor ïa ki .

translation.en: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the  Lord  , we will not hearken unto thee .
translation.kha: Ngi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba phi la ïathuh ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai .

translation.en: In the day of prosperity be joyful , but in the day of adversity consider : God also hath set the one over against the other , to the end that man should find nothing after him .
translation.kha: Haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , to kmen , bad haba ka jingjynjar ka wan , shu kynmaw : U Blei u phah ïa ka jingkmen bad ka jingjynjar ; phin ym tip da lei lei kaei ka ban jia hadien .

translation.en: Behold , I go forward , but he is not there  ; and backward , but I cannot perceive him :
translation.kha: Nga la wad shaphang mihngi , hynrei U Blei um don hangta ; ngam shym la shem ïa u haba nga wad shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: And turn ye not aside : for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver  ; for they are vain .
translation.kha: Wat ïabeh ïa ki blei thala ; kim lah ïarap ïa phi ne pynim ïa phi namar kim dei kiba shisha .

translation.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban banbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u la maham ïa ki syiem ;

translation.en: Then said we unto them after this manner , What are the names of the men that make this building ?
translation.kha: Ki pan ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong baroh ki rangbah kiba ïarap ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will break the bow of Elam , the chief of their might .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ngan pynïap ïa ki nongsiatkhnam kiba la pynlong ïa ka Elam ban long kaba khrawbor .

translation.en: For these are not drunken , as ye suppose , seeing it is but the third hour of the day .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kim shym buaid , kumba phi tharai ; ka dang khyndai baje mynstep .

translation.en: And I , brethren , if I yet preach circumcision , why do I yet suffer persecution ? then is the offence of the cross ceased .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , ko parabangeit , lada nga dang bteng ban ïalap ba ka jingotsher ka long kaba donkam , balei te ba nga dang shah pynshitom beiñ ? Lada kata ka la long kaba shisha , te ka jingïalap jong nga ïa ka diengphna U Khrist kan ym long daw jingeh ei ei .

translation.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the  Lord  your God hath commanded you , that ye may live , and that it may be well with you , and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki baroh , khnang ba phin manbha , bad ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïohkynti .

translation.en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me , neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions  ; but that they may be my people , and I may be their God , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ban da ïa ki Israel na kaba klet noh ïa nga bad pynjakhlia ïa lade da ki pop jong ki . Ki dei ban long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a son .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Silpah ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , in the province of Babylon .
translation.kha: Bad u syiem u la pynkiew kyrdan ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego sha ki kyrdan ba kham halor ha ka probins jong ka Babilon .

translation.en: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms , whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms : and in that thou givest a reward , and no reward is given unto thee , therefore thou art contrary .
translation.kha: Pha long ka jait nuti kaba kyrpang . Ym don mano mano ba pynbor ïa pha ban long kumta . Pham shym ïoh jingsiew , pha siew ïa ki ! Ho-oid , pha long kaba pher .

translation.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry , and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house ? when thou seest the naked , that thou cover him  ; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh ?
translation.kha: Ïasam lang ïa ki jingbam jong phi bad kiba thngan , bad ai jaka sah ïa kiba duk ki bym don ïing . Ai jaiñphong ïa kito ki bym don jaiñ ban phong , bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa la ki jong ki ba-ha-ïing .

translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was born , was hid three months of his parents , because they saw he was a proper child  ; and they were not afraid of the king s commandment .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa ki kmie ki kpa u Moses ban buhrieh ïa u lai bnai hadien ba la kha ïa u . Ki la ïohi ba u la long u khunlung uba bhabriew , bad kim shym la sheptieng ban pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum u Pharaoh .

translation.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees , which deny that there is any resurrection  ; and they asked him ,
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi , who receive the office of the priesthood , have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law , that is , of their brethren , though they come out of the loins of Abraham :
translation.kha: Bad ïa kito kiba hiarpateng na u Lebi kiba long ki lyngdoh la ai ïa ki da ka Hukum ba kin lum kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na ki paid Israel , kata ka long , na la ki briew , wat haba ki briew jong ki ruh ki hiarpateng na u Abraham .

translation.en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down , and without walls .
translation.kha: Lada phim lah ban synshar ïa ka jingbitar jong phi , phin long khlem ka jingïarap kum ka nongbah bym don kynroh , kaba lait rynghang ban shah tur ïaleh .

translation.en: Behold , God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un ym iehnoh ïa kiba shaniah ha u ne um ju ai jingïarap ïa ki riewbymman .

translation.en: Even a fool , when he holdeth his peace , is counted wise : and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding .
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , wat ïa uba bieit la pyrkhat ba u long uba stad bad shemphang lada u shu shong jar jar bad set ïa la ka shyntur .

translation.en: And after this it came to pass , that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them : and David took Metheg–ammah out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Syiem Dabid u la tur ïaleh biang ïa ki Philistia , u la jop ïa ki bad la pynkut noh ruh ïa ka jingsynshar jong ki halor ka ri .

translation.en: And the people said unto me , Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us , that thou doest so ?
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa nga ,  Balei ba me leh kumne ?

translation.en: And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John .
translation.kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bitar ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis .

translation.en: Their heart is as fat as grease  ; but I delight in thy law .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kim don ka jingshemphang , hynrei nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: And as he entered into a certain village , there met him ten men that were lepers , which stood afar off :
translation.kha: U la leit lyngba ka shnong ha kaba la ïashem ïa u da ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: English
translation.kha: Khasi

translation.en: Ye shall fall by the sword  ; I will judge you in the border of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad yn pynïap ïa phi ha ka thma ha ka ri jong phi hi . Te uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And the  Lord  smote Benjamin before Israel : and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men : all these drew the sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin . Ki Israel ki pynïap arphew san hajar shispah ngut ki shipai Benjamin ha kata ka sngi ,

translation.en: And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say) Let us do evil , that good may come ? whose damnation is just .
translation.kha: Balei yn ym ong te ,  To ngin leh ïa kaba sniew khnang ba kaba bha kan mih ?  Katto katne ngut ki briew , shisha , ki pynjahburom ïa nga da kaba pharep ïa nga da kaba ong ïa kane kaei kaei hi ! Kin shah pynrem , kumba ki dei ban shah .

translation.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father , saying , If I bring him not unto thee , then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh , nga la bahkhlieh ha i pa da la ka jingim na ka bynta u para . Nga ong ïa i ba lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u para sha i , ngan sa kit pop ma nga shi rta .

translation.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews  ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Moses ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt khlem da sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar u Pharaoh . Ka la long kumba u la ïohi ïa U Blei u bym lah ban ïohi , u la kyntait ban phai dien .

translation.en: Yea , I will cause men to walk upon you , even my people Israel  ; and they shall possess thee , and thou shalt be their inheritance , and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wallam pat ïa phi , ki briew jong nga ki Israel ban shong biang ha ka ri . Kan long noh ka ri jong phi bad ki khun jong phi kin ym kyrduh bam .

translation.en: And Moses went up into the mount , and a cloud covered the mount .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leit kiew ïa u Lum Sinai , bad u lyoh u tap ïa uta u lum .

translation.en: If I do not remember thee , let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth  ; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy .
translation.kha: To ai ba ngan nym lah shuh ban rwai biang lada ngam kynmaw ïa pha , lada ngam pyrkhat ïa pha kum ka jingkmen bakhraw tam jong nga !

translation.en: And the bow shall be in the cloud  ; and I will look upon it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth .
translation.kha: Haba u simpyllieng u paw ha ki lyoh , ngan khmih ïa u , bad ngan kynmaw ïa ka jutang baïaineh junom hapdeng jong nga bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: The people therefore , that stood by , and heard it , said that it thundered : others said , An angel spake to him .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïeng hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur , bad don na ki kiba la ong ba ka dei ka jingtied pyrthat , katba kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U angel u la kren ha u !

translation.en: And the guard stood , every man with his weapons in his hand , round about the king , from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple , along by the altar and the temple .
translation.kha: bad u pynïeng ïa ki rangbah kiba don ki waitlam ba la sei lypa ha baroh ki bynta ba sha khmat ka Templ , ban ïada ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew ha ka lieng bad ban nang leit sha shiliang ka duriaw , katba u la nang phah noh ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: And say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys  ; Behold , I , even I , will bring a sword upon you , and I will destroy your high places .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki lum ka Israel ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  — ban sngap ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki lumbah , ki lumrit , ki khap maw bad ki them : Ngan phah ïa ka waitlam ban pynjot ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane bleithaw .

translation.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath , and was come again .
translation.kha: Haba u Solomon u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Shimei u la leh ,

translation.en: But I know him : for I am from him , and he hath sent me .
translation.kha: Phim ithuh ïa u ; hynrei , nga ithuh ïa u , namar nga wan na u bad u la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn  ; and his disciples were an hungred , and began to pluck the ears of corn , and to eat .
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien U Jisu u la ïaid lyngba ki katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Ki synran jong u ki la thngan , ba kumta ki la sdang ban ïakheit ïa ki rynjup kew bad bam ïa ki symboh kew .

translation.en: The Lord  God  hath opened mine ear , and I was not rebellious , neither turned away back .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingshemphang , bad nga shym la ïaleh pyrshah lane phai noh na u .

translation.en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes , which is over against Galilee .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la leit da ka lieng sha ka thain Gadara , kaba don sha shiliang jong ka duriaw Galilaïa .

translation.en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem ,  Sngap jar bad mihnoh na une u briew !

translation.en: For we are members of his body , of his flesh , and of his bones .
translation.kha: naba ngi long ki dkhot ka met jong u .

translation.en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend  ; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar kum kane nga donkam ïa ki paralok bashisha — la nga la klet ne khlem klet ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn  ; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground .
translation.kha: Ki khyrdop ka nongbah kin ïambriew bad kin kyang , bad ka nongbah hi kan long kum ka kynthei kaba shong ha madan kaba la shah sloit lyngkhuit .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . I will praise the  Lord  with my whole heart , in the assembly of the upright , and in the congregation .
translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ngan ainguh ïa U  Trai ha ka jingïalang ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Yet they seek me daily , and delight to know my ways , as a nation that did righteousness , and forsook not the ordinance of their God : they ask of me the ordinances of justice  ; they take delight in approaching to God .
translation.kha: Ki mane ïa nga man la ka sngi , ki da kam ba ki thrang ban tip ïa ki lynti jong nga bad kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga . Ki ong ba ki kwah ïa nga ban ai ïa ki aiñ kiba beit bad ba ki shem sngewbha ha kaba mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of Israel , why is this come to pass in Israel , that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , balei kane ka la jia ? Balei ba ka jait Benjamin kan sa jah noh na Israel ?

translation.en: And there were eight boards  ; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver , under every board two sockets .
translation.kha: Kumta don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .

translation.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria , and carried Israel away into Assyria , and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes .
translation.kha: kaba long ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea , u patsha ka Assyria u kurup ïa ka Samaria , u rah ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki koidi , bad pynsah katto katne ngut na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto katne pat hajan ka wah Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad katto katne ha ki nongbah jong ka Media .

translation.en: And as they thus spake , Jesus himself stood in the midst of them , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .
translation.kha: Katba ki ar ngut ki dang ïathuh ha ki ïa kane , kynsan U Trai hi u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .

translation.en: My kinsfolk have failed , and my familiar friends have forgotten me .
translation.kha: ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ki paralok jong nga kim don shuh .

translation.en: If I have told you earthly things , and ye believe not , how shall ye believe , if I tell you of heavenly things ?
translation.kha: Mem ngeit ïa nga haba nga ïathuh ïa me shaphang kiei kiei jong kane ka pyrthei ; kumno men lah ban ngeit ïa nga , te , haba nga ïathuh ha me shaphang kiei kiei jong ka bneng ?

translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Behold , ye shall lie in wait against the city , even behind the city : go not very far from the city , but be ye all ready :
translation.kha: lem bad kine ki hukum :  Rieh ha kawei ka liang jong ka nongbah , hynrei wat leit jngai than na ka ; long ba la khreh ban tur ïaleh .

translation.en: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .
translation.kha: Hangta phin shong , nga ong ïa phi , tad haduh ba phin da siew dep ïa ka pisa bakhatduh jong ka jingshahdaiñ kuna .

translation.en: Now Peter sat without in the palace : and a damsel came unto him , saying , Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee .
translation.kha: U Petros u dang shong habar ha ka phyllaw mynba kawei na ki shakri kynthei jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh ka la wan sha u bad ka la ong ,  Ma me ruh , me long bad U Jisu u nong Galilaïa .

translation.en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines . For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace  ; not with meats , which have not profited them that have been occupied therein .
translation.kha: Wat shah ba ki jinghikai bakhyllah baroh kin ïalam bakla ïa phi na ka lynti kaba dei . Ka long kaba bha ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba kyrsoi na shapoh da ka jingaiei U Blei , bad ym da kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba ïadei bad ki jingbam ; kito kiba kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum kim shym la ïoh jingïarap ei ei na ki .

translation.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom , and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba da jaipdeh wat ban tian jingbam ha la ki jong ki shyntur .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Who hath made man s mouth ? or who maketh the dumb , or deaf , or the seeing , or the blind ? have not I the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u ,  Uei uba ai ha u briew ïa ka shyntur ? Uei uba pynlong ïa u uba kyllut ne u bymnang kren ? Uei uba ai ha u ïa ka jingïohi ne pynlong ïa u , uba matlah ? Dei ma nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: But this I say , brethren , the time is short : it remaineth , that both they that have wives be as though they had none ;
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ka long kane : Ka por kam don shuh , bad naduh mynta ki rangbah kiba la shongkurim ki dei ban im kumba kim shym la shongkurim ;

translation.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain :
translation.kha: U Blei u sneng ïa u briew da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang bad pyndap ïa ka met jong u da ka jingshitom .

translation.en: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki maw ba phi la ñiad astor , thoh shai ïa ki ktien baroh jong ki hukum U Blei .

translation.en: And the sound of the cherubims  wings was heard even to the outer court , as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh .
translation.kha: Ka jingriew ki thapniang ki kherub ka sawa shaduh ka phyllaw kaba shabar . Ka sawa kum ka sur kren U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow , than that thou shouldest vow and not pay .
translation.kha: Kham bha ban ym kular ei ei ban ïa kaba pynlong ka jingkular hynrei khlem bat ïa ka .

translation.en: Yea , whiles I was speaking in prayer , even the man Gabriel , whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning , being caused to fly swiftly , touched me about the time of the evening oblation .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang duwai , u Gabriel , uba nga la lah ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw mynshuwa , u la wan her sha tbian sha ka jaka ha kaba nga don . Ka la long ha ka por ban ai ïa ka jingkñia janmiet .

translation.en: It can also cause you to give in very quickly to other temptations .—Proverbs 23 :20 , 21 , 29-35 .
translation.kha: Ka lah ruh ban pynliat ïa phi sha kiwei pat ki jingpynshoi .—Proberb 23 :20 , 21 , 29-35 .

translation.en: Therefore they say unto God , Depart from us  ; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki ong ïa U Blei ba un ieh ïa ki ha la ka mon jong ki ; kim kwah ban tip ïa ka mon jong u ha ka jingim jong ki .

translation.en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort :
translation.kha: U Rehum ruh , u lat , bad u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins    , ki thoh ïa kane ka shithi sha u Artakserksis na Jerusalem :

translation.en: When a man hath taken a wife , and married her , and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes , because he hath found some uncleanness in her : then let him write her a bill of divorcement , and give it in her hand , and send her out of his house .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew , bad hadien u shem ha ka ïa kaei kaei ha kaba um sngewbha ; u rai ba um mon shuh ïa ka , kumta u thoh ïa ki kot ïapyllait tnga bad u ai ïa ki ha ka , bad u phah mihnoh ïa ka na ka ïing jong u ,

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Blessed is the man that feareth the  Lord  , that delighteth greatly in his commandments .
translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Suk uta u briew uba pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: And Moses called unto them  ; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him : and Moses talked with them .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u khot ïa ki , bad u Aaron lem bad ki nongïalam jong uta u paidlang ki ïaleit sha u , bad u Moses u ïakren bad ki .

translation.en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness , and in the bond of iniquity .
translation.kha: Naba nga ïohi ba me dap da ka jingbishni bajur bad me long u koidi jong ka pop .

translation.en: Nevertheless for David s sake did the  Lord  his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem , to set up his son after him , and to establish Jerusalem :
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta u Dabid , U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la ai ïa u Abijah u khun ban synshar hadien jong u ha Jerusalem bad ban sumar ïa ka Jerusalem ba kan skhem .

translation.en: A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me , because I go to the Father .
translation.kha: Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .

translation.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in , and told Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Let my people go , that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh , bad ki la ong ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit , khnang ba kin ïoh pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka ri shyiap ban pyndonburom ïa nga .’

translation.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes , she doted upon them , and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea .
translation.kha: Ka tang mar shu ïohi ïa ki , ka la dap da ka jingkwah brai bad ka phah nonglamktien sha ki ha Babilonia .

translation.en: And ye also shall bear witness , because ye have been with me from the beginning .
translation.kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phin kren shaphang jong nga , namar ba phi la don lem bad nga naduh kaba sdang .

translation.en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son , and she called his name Peresh  ; and the name of his brother was Sheresh  ; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem .
translation.kha: Ka Maakah , ka tnga u Makhir , ka kha ar ngut ki khun shynrang , kiba ka ai kyrteng ïa ki u Peresh bad u Sheresh . U Peresh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Ulam bad u Rakem ,

translation.en: And he said unto him , God forbid  ; thou shalt not die : behold , my father will do nothing either great or small , but that he will shew it me : and why should my father hide this thing from me ? it is not so .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U Blei un ym shah ba phin shu ïap ! I pa i da ïathuh shuwa ha nga ïa kaei kaei ba i leh , kaba donkam ne ka bymdonkam , bad im ju buhrieh ïa kane na nga : Kam long kaba shisha !

translation.en: All thy rulers are fled together , they are bound by the archers : all that are found in thee are bound together , which have fled from far .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong phi baroh ki la phet krad bad ki la shah kem ha shuwa ba kin ïoh siat uwei u khnam .

translation.en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you : that in the seventh month , on the tenth day of the month , ye shall afflict your souls , and do no work at all , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger that sojourneth among you :
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban bud pateng la pateng . Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong ryngkat bad ki , ki dei ban shahjingit bad ban ym trei ïa kano kano ka kam .

translation.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this , that I may be restored to you the sooner .
translation.kha: Bad nga da kyrpad jur ïa phi ban duwai ba U Blei un phah pat ïa nga sha phi kham kloi .

translation.en: And when he saw that , he arose , and went for his life , and came to Beer–sheba , which belongeth to Judah , and left his servant there .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la sheptieng bad u la phet ban pyllait im ïa lade ; u shim ïa u shakri jong u bad leit noh sha Beersheba kaba ha Judah . Da kaba iehnoh ïa u shakri hangta ,

translation.en: Then stood there up one in the council , a Pharisee , named Gamaliel , a doctor of the law , had in reputation among all the people , and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na ki , u Pharisi uba kyrteng u Gamaliel , uba long u nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa uba la burom shikatdei da ki briew baroh , u la ïeng ha ka Dorbar . U la hukum ban ïalam ïa ki apostol shipor shabar ,

translation.en: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia , and answereth to Jerusalem which now is , and is in bondage with her children .
translation.kha: Ka Hagar , kaba ïeng na ka bynta u lum Sinai ha Arabia , ka long ka dur jong ka nongbah Jerusalem kaba mynta , ka shong mraw ryngkat bad ki briew jong ka baroh .

translation.en: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ , yet have ye not many fathers : for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel .
translation.kha: Wat haba phi don shiphew hajar ngut ki nongsumar ha ka jingim jong phi kum ki bangeit , phi don tang uwei u kpa . Naba ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu nga la long u kpa jong phi da kaba wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi .

translation.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song  ; and they that wasted us required of us mirth , saying , Sing us one of the songs of Zion .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ringmraw ïa ngi ki ong ba ngin rwai ; ki ong ïa ngi ba ngin pynsngewbha ïa ki :  To rwai ha ngi ïa ka jingrwai shaphang ka Seïon .

translation.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses , they will faint by the way : for divers of them came from far .
translation.kha: Lada nga phah ïa ki sha ïing khlem bsa ïa ki , kin ïapler katba ki dang ïaid , namar katto katne ngut na ki , ki la wan na ka lynti bajngai .

translation.en: And he slew the burnt offering  ; and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled round about upon the altar .
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u mrad ïa uba la wanlam na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang jong u hi . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: A man shall not take his father s wife , nor discover his father s skirt .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba u ïathiah shongkha bad kawei na ki tnga u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him : but Benjamin s mess was five times so much as any of theirs . And they drank , and were merry with him .
translation.kha: La sam jingbam ïa ki na ka miej u Joseph , bad ïa u Benjamin la sam san shah ban ïa uno uno na ki . Kumta keiñ ki la ïabam ïadih bad leh sngewbha bad u Joseph .

translation.en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening , and presented himself forty days .
translation.kha: U Goliath u kob ïa ki Israel man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet haduh sawphew sngi .

translation.en: Ye shall do no servile work therein : but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  , bad wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .

translation.en: For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban shah kñia ; ka por ka long mynta ïa nga ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim .

translation.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn , whose name was Tamar .
translation.kha: Ïa u Er , u khun nyngkong jong u , u Judah u la pynïoh ka tnga kaba kyrteng ka Tamar .

translation.en: And Zabad his son , and Shuthelah his son , and Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew , because they came down to take away their cattle .
translation.kha: U Ephraim u don sa ar ngut ki khun shynrang nalor u Shuthelah : u Eser bad u Elead , kiba la shah pynïap haba ki la pyrshang ban tuh ïa ki jingri kiba dei jong ki traishnong jong ka Gath .

translation.en: And Paul , as his manner was , went in unto them , and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures ,
translation.kha: Kumba u ju leh , u Paul u la leit sha ka synagog . Hangta , ha ki lai tylli ki sngi Sabbaton u la ïatainia bad ki paidbah ,

translation.en: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former , saith the  Lord  of hosts : and in this place will I give peace , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ka Templ kaba bathymmai kan kham iphuh ban ïa kaba rim , bad hangta ngan ai ha ki briew jong nga ïa ka jingdap kyrhai bad ka jingsuk .  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren .

translation.en: And the lord said unto the servant , Go out into the highways and hedges , and compel them to come in , that my house may be filled .
translation.kha: Kumta u kynrad u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ Khie leit sha ki lynti bah ha rudnong bad sha ki lynti khim bad ïawer ïa ki briew ban wan shapoh khnang ba ka ïing jong nga kan dap .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , my servants shall eat , but ye shall be hungry : behold , my servants shall drink , but ye shall be thirsty : behold , my servants shall rejoice , but ye shall be ashamed :
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ba kito kiba mane bad kohnguh ïa nga kin ïoh kyrhai ban bam ban dih , hynrei phi phin thngan bad phin sliang . Ma ki kin shadkmen hynrei ma phi phin jahburom .

translation.en: Now concerning his sons , and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him , and the repairing of the house of God , behold , they are written in the story of the book of the kings . And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ka Komentari halor ka Kitab ki Syiem  ka don ki jingïathuhkhana shaphang ki khun shynrang jong u Joash , ki jingïathuhlypa kiba la kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ka jingbuh jingthoh kumno ba u la tei pat ïa ka Templ . U Amasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass , than one tittle of the law to fail .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kham jem ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ban jah noh ban ïa kaba iehnoh ïa ka bynta kaba rit tam jong ka Hukum .

translation.en: Then she arose with her daughters in law , that she might return from the country of Moab : for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the  Lord  had visited his people in giving them bread .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ïohsngew ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa la ki briew da kaba ai ha ki ka jingot kaba bha ; kumta ka la khreh ban mihnoh na Moab lem bad la ki pyrsa kurim .

translation.en: But Jesus took him by the hand , and lifted him up  ; and he arose .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u khynnah na ka kti bad u la ïarap pynïeng ïa u , bad u la ïeng joit .

translation.en: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the  Lord  in Jerusalem : and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ; ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong ki pynïap ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: And I will put my spirit within you , and cause you to walk in my statutes , and ye shall keep my judgments , and do them .
translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga hapoh jong phi bad ngan peit ba phi bud ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga kiba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off , and knew him not , they lifted up their voice , and wept  ; and they rent every one his mantle , and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don kham sha jngai ki la ïohi ïa u Job , hynrei kim shym ithuh ba dei ma u . Haba ki la ithuh , ki la sdang ban ïam bad lynñiar kthang , ki kad ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka jingsngewsih bad ki kynting pui pui sha suiñ bad ha la ki khlieh .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto Achan , My son , give , I pray thee , glory to the  Lord  God of Israel , and make confession unto him  ; and tell me now what thou hast done  ; hide it not from me .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha u ,  Ko khun shynrang jong nga , ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha hangne ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad phla . Ïathuh ha nga mynta ïa kaei kaba me la leh . Wat pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ka na nga .

translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  spoken unto me , Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey , when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him , he will not be afraid of their voice , nor abase himself for the noise of them : so shall the  Lord  of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion , and for the hill thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kam pher kumno ki nongaplangbrot ki kynhied bad ki pyrta , kim lah ban pyntieng ïa u sing ba un phet na ka jingri ba u la pynïap ; ha kajuh ka rukom , ym don kano kano kaba lah ban khang ïa nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh na kaba ïada ïa u Lum Seïon .

translation.en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread , that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?
translation.kha: Kumno te ba phim shemphang ba ngam shym kren ha phi shaphang u kpu ? To sumar ïa lade na u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi !

translation.en: Then Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , arose and warred against Israel , and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Moab , u Balak u khun jong u Sippor , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi . U la phah ktien ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor bad u la ong ïa u ban buh ka jingtim halor jong phi .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time , even Terah , the father of Abraham , and the father of Nahor : and they served other gods .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha uta u paidbah baroh ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u don ban ong : ‘ Mynhyndai , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki shong ki sah sha shiliang jong ka wah Ïuphratis , bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Uwei na kito ki kpa tymmen u dei u Terah , u kpa jong u Abraham bad u Nahor .

translation.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee  ; and my soul , which thou hast redeemed .
translation.kha: Ngan pyrta da kaba kmen katba nga dang tem na ka bynta jong me ; da ka longrynïeng jong nga baroh kawei ngan rwai namar ba me la pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel , nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them , that despised them  ; and they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Yn ym don na ki hima ba-marjan kiba la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka Israel da ka jingkrenbeiñ , ki ban long pat kum ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ban pynmong ïa ki Israel . Bad kin tip ba ma nga , nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , Saul s sons .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki bad pynïap ïa ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Saul : u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .

translation.en: And he touched her hand , and the fever left her : and she arose , and ministered unto them .
translation.kha: U la ktah ïa ka kti jong ka , ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la khie joit bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa u .

translation.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit , and worketh miracles among you , doeth he it by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
translation.kha: Hato U Blei u ai ïa U Mynsiem bad leh ïa ki kambah hapdeng jong phi namar ba phi leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ne namar ba phi ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad ngeit ïa ka ?

translation.en: And they said unto him , Why do the disciples of John fast often , and make prayers , and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees  ; but thine eat and drink ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Ki synran jong U Ïoannis ki shahjingit man ka por bad ki duwai , bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki leh kumjuh , hynrei ki synran jong me ki ïabam bad ïadih .

translation.en: The Jews answered him , saying , For a good work we stone thee not  ; but for blasphemy  ; and because that thou , being a man , makest thyself God .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  Ngim kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me namar kano kano na ki kam babha , hynrei namar ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei jong me ! Me long tang u briew , hynrei me pyrshang ban pynlong Blei ïa lade !

translation.en: And Gehazi passed on before them , and laid the staff upon the face of the child  ; but there was neither voice , nor hearing . Wherefore he went again to meet him , and told him , saying , The child is not awaked .
translation.kha: U Gehasi u la nang leit sha khmat , bad u buh ïa u diengduh jong u Elisha halor u khynnah , hynrei ym don jingsawa ei ei lane kano kano ka dak ba don jingim . Kumta u la leit phai ban ïashem ïa u Elisha bad u ong ,  U khynnah um shym kyndit .

translation.en: And when thou comest thither , look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi , and go in , and make him arise up from among his brethren , and carry him to an inner chamber  ;
translation.kha: bad ynda me la poi hangta , wad ïa u Jehu u khun jong u Jehoshaphat bad u ksiew jong u Nimshi . Ïalam ïa u sha ka kamra kaba kyrpang jngai na ki paralok jong u ,

translation.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night  ; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat , the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh . Ha kata ka Sngi , ki bneng kin jah noh lem bad ka jingsawa kaba jam , ki metbneng kin ing duh bad yn pynjot , bad ka pyrthei lem bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka kin jah rngai .

translation.en: Therefore doth my Father love me , because I lay down my life , that I might take it again .
translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa nga namar ba nga kloi ban aiti ïa la ka jingim , khnang ba nga lah ban ïohpdiang pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine  ; and she doted on her lovers , on the Assyrians her neighbours ,
translation.kha: La ka long ka jong nga , ka Oholah ka ïai bteng ban long ka nuti bad ka dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki nongleh-ieit jong ka na Assyria .

translation.en: And one kid of the goats , to make an atonement for you .
translation.kha: Kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: The  Lord  maketh poor , and maketh rich : he bringeth low , and lifteth up .
translation.kha: U pynduk ïa ki katto katne bad u pynriewspah ïa kiwei pat ; U pynrit ïa ki katto katne bad u pynkhraw ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thy days approach that thou must die : call Joshua , and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation , that I may give him a charge . And Moses and Joshua went , and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Me te , men ym im slem shuh . Khot ïa u Joshua bad wan ïalam ïa u sha ka Ïingjaiñ khnang ba ngan ai hukum ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he saw her , that he rent his clothes , and said , Alas , my daughter ! thou hast brought me very low , and thou art one of them that trouble me : for I have opened my mouth unto the  Lord  , and I cannot go back .
translation.kha: Haba u ïohi ïa ka , u kad ïa la ki jaiñkup ha ka jingsngewsih bad u ong ,  Waw , ko khun ! Phi la pynpait ïa ka dohnud jong nga ! Balei ba yn dei da ma phi kaba pynpang ïa nga ? Nga la ai ïa ka jingkular bakyntang ha U  Trai  , bad ngam lah ban kylla pat ïa la ka kular !

translation.en: There is gold , and a multitude of rubies : but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel .
translation.kha: Lada phi tip shaphang kaei kaba phi kren , phi don ei ei kaba kham kordor ban ïa ka ksiar ne ki mawkordor .

translation.en: And wheresoever he taketh him , he teareth him : and he foameth , and gnasheth with his teeth , and pineth away : and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out  ; and they could not .
translation.kha: Haba u mynsiem u tur ïaleh ïa u , u bret ïa u sha madan , bad u sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur , u kyr-iat ki bniat , bad u eh tnen baroh shi rynïeng . Nga la ong ïa ki synran jong me ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid , hynrei kim shym la lah .

translation.en: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau : and I gave unto Esau mount Seir , to possess it  ; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt .
translation.kha: bad ha u Isaak nga la ai ïa u Jakob bad u Iso . Nga la ai ha u Iso ïa ka ri lum Edom kum ka jingïohkynti jong u , hynrei u Jakob , u kpa tymmen jong phi , bad ki khun ki kti jong u , ki leit hiar sha Ijipt .

translation.en: And the man did as Joseph bade  ; and the man brought the men into Joseph s house .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri u leh kumba la hukum ïa u , bad u leit ïalam ïa kita shi para sha ka ïing u Joseph .

translation.en: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .
translation.kha: U Jotham u long syiem haba u la don arphew san snem ka rta , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jerushah , ka khun jong u Sadok .

translation.en: Don't tell a lie .
translation.kha: Wat thok .

translation.en: Children and parents worship together and learn how to benefit from the good news . —Read Micah 4 :1-4 .
translation.kha: Ki khun bad ki kmie ki kpa ki ïa mane lang bad ki ïoh jinghikai kumno ban myntoi na ka khubor babha .—Pule Mikah 4 :1-4 .

translation.en: For they cast down every man his rod , and they became serpents : but Aaron s rod swallowed up their rods .
translation.kha: Ki la bret ïa la ki diengduh , bad kita ki kylla bseiñ . Hynrei u diengduh jong u Aaron u la nguid ïa ki diengduh jong ki .

translation.en: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah s neck , and brake it .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hananaïah u la loit ïa ka lyngkor na u ryndang jong nga , u la pynkheiñ lyngkhot ïa ka ,

translation.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee , where he made the water wine . And there was a certain nobleman , whose son was sick at Capernaum .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u leit biang sha Kana ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la pynkylla waiñ ïa ka um . Uwei u rangbah synshar ka sorkar u la don hangta uba u khun jong u , u la pang , ha Kapernam .

translation.en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art , and I will commune with my father of thee  ; and what I see , that I will tell thee .
translation.kha: Ngan leit bad ngan ïeng hajan i pa ha kata ka jaka ba phi rieh , bad ngan ïakren bad i shaphang jong phi . Lada nga shem ei ei , ngan sa ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year , and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof : it shall be a jubilee unto you  ; and ye shall return every man unto his possession , and ye shall return every man unto his family .
translation.kha: Bad to pynkyntang khuid ïa ka snem kaba sanphew bad pynbna ïa ka jinglaitluid ha ki traishnong baroh jong kata ka ri . Ha kane ka snem , ïa ki jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka , lane sha ki khun ki ksiew jong u , bad uno uno u briew uba la shah die mraw un leit phai pat sha la ïing .

translation.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it  ; let a cloud dwell upon it  ; let the blackness of the day terrify it .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka , ka sngi jong ka jingdum tliw bad synñia ; kah ïa ka da ki lyoh , bad tap noh ïa ka sngi .

translation.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind : and cold out of the north .
translation.kha: Ki  erlangthari ki wan na shaphang shathie , bad ka lyer khriat na shaphang shatei .

translation.en: For thus Amos saith , Jeroboam shall die by the sword , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong , ‘ U Jeroboam un ïap ha ka thma , bad ki briew ka Israel kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’

translation.en: Children in whom was no blemish , but well favoured , and skilful in all wisdom , and cunning in knowledge , and understanding science , and such as had ability in them to stand in the king s palace , and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban long kiba bhabriew , kiba nep jingmut , kiba la ïoh jinghikai bha , kiba stet ban nang , bad kiba lait na ka jinganna , ba kumta kin lah ban long kiba bit ban shakri ha ka ïingbishar jong u syiem . U Ashpenas u dei ban hikai ïa ki ban pule bad ban thoh ïa ka ktien ki nong Babilonia .

translation.en: Drop down , ye heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness : let the earth open , and let them bring forth salvation , and let righteousness spring up together  ; I the  Lord  have created it .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingjop na sahit bneng kum u slap ; ka khyndew kan ang ban pdiang ïa u bad kan phuh da ka jinglaitluid bad ka jingbishar hok . Nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynlong ïa kane ban jia .

translation.en: Wherefore , beloved , seeing that ye look for such things , be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace , without spot , and blameless .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok jong nga , katba phi dang ap ïa kata ka Sngi , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ka jong phi ban long kiba khlem thohbria bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat U Blei bad ban don ka jingïasuk bad u .

translation.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano hapoh ka kynhun kiba don ka jingdonkam . Kito kiba long trai ïa ki lyngkha , ki wallam ïa ka pisa ba la ïohpdiang na ka jingdie ,

translation.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the  Lord   ; and that which he hath given will he pay him again .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai ha kiba duk , ka long kumba phi ai kylliang sha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  un sa siew pat ïa phi .

translation.en: And caused me to pass by them round about : and , behold , there were very many in the open valley  ; and , lo , they were very dry .
translation.kha: U la pynïaid ïa nga sawdong ka them , bad nga la ïohi ba la don shibun bah ki shyieng bad ki long kiba la tyrkhong bha .

translation.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .
translation.kha: U nongsynshar uba khlem ka jingshemphang un long u nonglehbeiñ uba runar . Uta uba isih ïa ka jingbymhok un synshar slem .

translation.en: Hearken unto me now therefore , O ye children , and attend to the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , sngap ïa nga . Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong .

translation.en: Yea , young children despised me  ; I arose , and they spake against me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki peitbeiñ ïa nga bad ki rkhie haba ki ïohi ïa nga .

translation.en: Ye are the salt of the earth : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be salted ? it is thenceforth good for nothing , but to be cast out , and to be trodden under foot of men .
translation.kha: Phi , phi long kum ka mluh ïa u paid bynriew baroh . Hynrei lada ka mluh ka la blad noh , ym don kano kano ka lad ban pynbha pat ïa ka . Ka la kylla long ka bymdondor , kumta la bret noh ïa ka sharud bad ki briew ki ïuh halor jong ka .

translation.en: Do ye not yet understand , neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
translation.kha: Hato phim pat shemphang ? Phim kynmaw mynba nga la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?

translation.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished : there make ready .
translation.kha: Un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng , kaba heh , kaba la pynbit pynbiang , ha kaba phin pynkhreh ïa kaei kaei baroh .

translation.en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth , and to save your lives by a great deliverance .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa nga ha shuwa jong phi ban pyllait im ïa phi ha ka rukom kaba phylla , bad ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin im .

translation.en: Then said Daniel unto the king , O king , live for ever .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !

translation.en: And Judah said , The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed , and there is much rubbish  ; so that we are not able to build the wall .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah ki don ka jingrwai kaba ki rwai :  Ngi long tlot ba ngi bah ki jingkit bakhia ; Don bun bah ka synrum ban pynkhuid . Kumno ngi lah ban tei ïa ka kynroh mynta ka sngi ?

translation.en: And the foolish said unto the wise , Give us of your oil  ; for our lamps are gone out .
translation.kha: Nangta kita kiba bieit ki la ong ha kiba stad , ‘ Ai lem ha ngi ïa ka umphniang jong phi , namar ki sharak jong ngi ki la jan lip .’

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you : they make you vain : they speak a vision of their own heart , and not out of the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ha ki briew ka Jerusalem :  Wat sngap ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ; ki pyndap ïa phi da ki jingkyrmen bymshisha . Ki ïathuh ïa phi ïa kaei kaba ki shu mutdur bad ym ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .

translation.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey , to kill us in the wilderness , except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us ?
translation.kha: Hato kam pat biang tang ba phi la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt kaba seisoh ban pynïap ïa ngi hangne ha ri khlaw ? Phi kwah sa ban da long kynrad halor jong ngi ?

translation.en: And Moses said unto God , Behold , when I come unto the children of Israel , and shall say unto them , The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you  ; and they shall say to me , What is his name ? what shall I say unto them ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien ,  Haba nga leit sha ki Israel bad ngan ong ha ki , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la phah ïa nga sha phi ,’ kin sa kylli ïa nga , ‘ Kaei ka kyrteng jong u ?’ Ngan ong kumno ïa ki ?

translation.en: Did not your fathers thus , and did not our God bring all this evil upon us , and upon this city ? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka daw balei ba U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba u wanrah ka jingjot halor kane ka nongbah . Bad pynban , phi pan kwah ba U Blei un phah shuh shuh ka jingbitar halor ka Israel da kaba pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: And David sat between the two gates : and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall , and lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold a man running alone .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dang shong ha ka jaka hapdeng ka khyrdop kaba shabar bad ka khyrdop kaba shapoh jong ka nongbah . U nongap phira u kiew shajrong kynroh bad u ïeng halor ka tnum jong ka khyrdop ; u peit sha khmat bad u ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh marwei .

translation.en: Then those men , when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did , said , This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kane ka kambah kaba U Jisu u la leh , ki la ong ,  Da shisha une u long u nongïathuhlypa , uba la dei ban wan sha ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me , the works that I do shall he do also  ; and greater works than these shall he do  ; because I go unto my Father .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh — ho-oid , un leh wat ïa ki kiei kiei kiba kham khraw , namar ngan leit sha U Kpa .

translation.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness , than he that is perverse in his ways , though he be rich .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ba duk bad ba long hok ban ïa kaba riewspah bad ïaid kynriang .

translation.en: He saith to him again the second time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .
