translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba ar U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa nga ?   Ho-oid , ko Trai ,  u la jubab ,  me tip ba nga ieit ïa me .  U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To sumar ïa ki langbrot jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , there came fire down from heaven , and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties : therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight .
translation.kha: Ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jong ki la pynïap da ka ding na bneng ; hynrei sngewbha isynei ïa nga !

translation.en: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua , saying , Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit , seeing I am a great people , forasmuch as the  Lord  hath blessed me hitherto ?
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph ki ong ha u Joshua ,  Balei phi ai ïa ngi tang shi bynta jong ka ri ba ngin kam kynti kum la ka jong ? Ngi ïadon bun ngut namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ngi .

translation.en: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days , saith the  Lord . Thus far is the judgment of Moab .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki sngi ki ban wan U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ka Moab kaba dap kyrhai sa shisien . Kane baroh ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia ïa ka Moab .

translation.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ong ïa kita kiei kiei , ki ong shai ba ki ïawad ïa ka ri la ka jong hi .

translation.en: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen . Now thou , O Belteshazzar , declare the interpretation thereof , forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation : but thou art able  ; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh ,  ong u syiem Nebukhadnessar .  Mynta , ko Belteshassar , ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Ym don man mano na ki nongai jingmut na ka ïingsyiem jong nga kiba lah ban ïathuh ha nga , hynrei me lah , namar ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me .

translation.en: But when ye pray , use not vain repetitions , as the heathen do : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking .
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , wat pyndonkam bun ki kyntien bym kit jingmut , kumba ki nongmane blei thala ki leh , kiba pyrkhat ba ki blei jong ki kin ïohsngew ïa ki namar ba ki jingduwai jong ki , ki long kiba jlan .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord will cast her out , and he will smite her power in the sea  ; and she shall be devoured with fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai un shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don . Un kynting ïa ka spah jong ka sha ka duriaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn thang haduh khyndew .

translation.en: And they taught in Judah , and had the book of the law of the  Lord  with them , and went about throughout all the cities of Judah , and taught the people .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum U  Trai  bad ki leit lyngba ïa baroh ki shnong ka Judah , da kaba hikai ïa ka ha ki briew .

translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ba-thaba ka la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop bashaphang mihngi bad rung shapoh ka Templ .

translation.en: But thy servants will pass over , every man armed for war , before the  Lord  to battle , as my lord saith .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh na ngi , ngi la kloi ban leit sha ka thma hapoh ka hukum jong U  Trai . Ngin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ïaleh , kumba phi la ong .

translation.en: At this also my heart trembleth , and is moved out of his place .
translation.kha: Ka  erïong , ka pynlong ïa ka dohnud jong nga ban kyndeh stet .

translation.en: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee , and another third kingdom of brass , which shall bear rule over all the earth .
translation.kha: Hadien jong phi kan don sa kawei ka hima , ka bym da khraw kum ka jong phi , bad hadien kata sa kaba lai , ka hima kaba da ka rnong , ka ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: Comfort from knowing that God feels for us when we suffer . —Zechariah 2 :8 .
translation.kha: Ngi ioh jingtngen naba ngi tip ba U Blei u don jingsngew haba ngi jynjar .—Sekharaiah 2 :8 .

translation.en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
translation.kha: Nangta u la kdew sha la ki synran bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Hangne ki long ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong nga !

translation.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , Therefore we turn again to thee now , that thou mayest go with us , and fight against the children of Ammon , and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .
translation.kha: Ki ong ïa u Jephthah ,  Ngi phai sha me mynta namar ngi kwah ïa me ban leit lang bad ngi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon , bad ban long u nongïalam ïa ki Gilead baroh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , How long wilt thou mourn for Saul , seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel ? fill thine horn with oil , and go , I will send thee to Jesse the Beth–lehemite : for I have provided me a king among his sons .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,  Sa katno slem men dang ïai sngewsih ïa u Saul ? Nga la kyntait ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel . Hynrei mynta pynïoh katto katne ka umphniang Olib bad leit sha Bethlehem , sha u briew uba kyrteng u Jesse , namar nga la jied ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u ban long syiem .

translation.en: Hast thou found honey ? eat so much as is sufficient for thee , lest thou be filled therewith , and vomit it .
translation.kha: Wat ju bam ïa ka ngap palat ban ïa kaba phi donkam ; kaba bam palat ka lah ban pynlong ïa phi ban prie .

translation.en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaleb u ong ,  Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba kurup ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .

translation.en: I have raised up one from the north , and he shall come : from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name : and he shall come upon princes as upon mortar , and as the potter treadeth clay .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u briew uba shong basah shaphang mihngi ; ngan wallam ïa u ban tur ïaleh na shaphang shatei . Un ïuh halor ki nongsynshar la kumba dei ka ktieh , kum u nongthaw khiew uba ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight : stand not in an evil thing  ; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him .
translation.kha: U syiem u lah ban leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon , kumta mihnoh na khmat jong u ; wat shong ha kaba kum kane ka jaka ba ma .

translation.en: For among my people are found wicked men : they lay wait , as he that setteth snares  ; they set a trap , they catch men .
translation.kha: Ki riewsniew ki don hapdeng ki briew jong nga ; ki apthap kum ki briew kiba phriang ïa ki jar ban riam ïa ki sim , hynrei kiba pynap ïa ki jingriam jong ki ban riam ïa ki briew .

translation.en: And he said to David , Thou art more righteous than I : for thou hast rewarded me good , whereas I have rewarded thee evil .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Dabid  Phi la leh ïa kaba dei , bad nga la leh bakla . Phi la lehbha shikatdei eh ïa nga , katba nga pat nga la leh haduh katne kaba sniew ïa phi !

translation.en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , who were ancient men , that had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice  ; and many shouted aloud for joy :
translation.kha: Bun na ki lyngdoh ba la kham tymmen , ki Lebi , bad ki rangbah kur , ki la ïohi ïa ka Templ banyngkong , bad ki peit ïa ka nongrim jong kane ka Templ katba dang tei , ki ïam pangnud . Hynrei kiwei pat kiba don hangta ki pyrta da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees , which were of Jerusalem , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wan sha U Jisu na Jerusalem bad ki la kylli ïa u ,

translation.en: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi , he asked his disciples , saying ,  Whom do men say that I the Son of man am ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka thain hajan ka shnong Kaisaria Philippi , ha kaba u la kylli ïa la ki synran ,  Ki briew ki ong ba U Khun U Briew u long uei ?

translation.en: They helped every one his neighbour  ; and every one said to his brother , Be of good courage .
translation.kha: Ki nongshna da ki kti ki ïarap bad ki pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: Also they reported his good deeds before me , and uttered my words to him . And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakren ha khmat jong nga shaphang baroh ki kam babha kiba u Tobiah u la leh bad ki ïathuh ha u ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga la kren . Bad u ïai phah ïa nga ki shithi ban pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .

translation.en: We accept it always , and in all places , most noble Felix , with all thankfulness .
translation.kha: Ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa kane ha kylleng kylleng bad ha ki por baroh , bad ngi da sngewnguh eh ïa me .

translation.en: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God of Israel , even a God to Israel : and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee .
translation.kha: Ka nam jong me kan khraw , bad ki briew kin ong junom , ‘ U  Trai  Bakhrawbor baroh u long U Blei ha Israel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa ka longïing syiem jong nga ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: And the one woman said , O my lord , I and this woman dwell in one house  ; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki ka ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , ma nga bad kane ka briew ngi ïasah ha kajuh ka ïing , bad nga la kha khun shynrang hangta ha ïing ha kaba ka ruh ka don lang .

translation.en: And the sound of a trumpet , and the voice of words  ; which voice they that heard entreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more :
translation.kha: ka jingriew ka turoi , bad ka jingsawa jong ka sur kaba kren . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsawa , ki la kyrpad ba kim kwah shuh ban ïohsngew sa ïa kawei pat ka ktien .

translation.en: Not boasting of things without our measure , that is , of other men s labours ; but having hope , when your faith is increased , that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly ,
translation.kha: Kumta ngim leh sarong shaphang ka kam kaba kiwei ki la leh palat shabar u pud ïa uba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi . Pynban , ngi kyrmen ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka nang san bad ba ngi lah ban leh ïa ka kam kaba kham khraw hapdeng jong phi , borabor hapoh ki pud ba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Persecuted , but not forsaken ; cast down , but not destroyed ;
translation.kha: La pynjynjar ïa ngi bunsien , hynrei ym shym la pynlwet noh ; teng teng hapdeng ka jingartatien , hynrei da lei lei ym ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen ; don bun ki nongshun , hynrei ngim ju duh paralok ; bad wat la ngi jur ka jingmong hateng hateng , ym shym la pynjot noh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God .
translation.kha: bad un wallam pat ïa ki briew babun sha U Trai U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Wherefore saith my lord these words ? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing :
translation.kha: Ki ruh ki jubab ïa u ,  Phi mut kumno , bah , da kaba kren ïa ngi kumne ? Ngi smai ba ngim shym leh ïa kaba kum kane .

translation.en: Thou didst say , Woe is me now ! for the  Lord  hath added grief to my sorrow  ; I fainted in my sighing , and I find no rest .
translation.kha: Nangta u ïathuh ïa nga ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Barukh , me ong , ‘ Nga la ngiah ! U  Trai  u la ban ïa ka jingsngewsih halor ki jingjynjar jong nga . Nga la thait na kaba shu ud , bad ngam shem kano kano ka jingjahthait !’

translation.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , the fat with the breast , it shall he bring , that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ka khleiñ lem bad ka shadem jong u mrad ban ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And the child Samuel ministered unto the  Lord  before Eli . And the word of the  Lord  was precious in those days  ; there was no open vision .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki sngi , haba uta u khynnah Samuel , u shakri ïa U  Trai  hapoh ka jingïalam u Eli , don tang khyndiat eh ki khubor na U  Trai  ; bad ñiar eh ban don ki jingïohipaw .

translation.en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead , and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall . And there was great indignation against Israel : and they departed from him , and returned to their own land .
translation.kha: Kumta u shim ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , uba dei ban long syiem hadien jong u , bad u la tyrwa ïa u halor ka kynroh shnong kum ka jingkñia sha u blei Moab . Ki Israel ki la sngewshyrkhei bad kumta ki la kynran na ka nongbah bad ki la leit phai sha la ka ri .

translation.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka la kren biang na bneng , ‘ Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .’

translation.en: And I stayed in the mount , according to the first time , forty days and forty nights  ; and the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also , and the  Lord  would not destroy thee .
translation.kha: Nga la sah ha uta u lum sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , kumba nga la leh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong . U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa nga sa shisien bad um mon ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Where is he ? He said , I know not .
translation.kha: Hangno u don ?  ki la kylli .  Ngam tip ,  u la jubab .

translation.en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt ? or is there any taste in the white of an egg ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uei uba lah bam ïa ka jingbam ka bym don jingmad bad kaba khlem mluh ? Don jingmad aïu ha ka bynta kaba lieh jong ka pylleng ?

translation.en: He giveth snow like wool : he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes .
translation.kha: U pyiar ïa ka ïor kum ka nep bad u pynphriang ïa u thah kum ka khyndew .

translation.en: And he removed from thence , and digged another well  ; and for that they strove not : and he called the name of it Rehoboth  ; and he said , For now the  Lord  hath made room for us , and we shall be fruitful in the land .
translation.kha: U la kynriah noh nangta bad tih ïa kawei pat ka pukri . Ym shym don jingïakajia shuh ïa kata , kumta u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  Ka Jinglaitluid .  U ong ,  Mynta te U  Trai  u la ai jinglaitluid ïa ngi ban shong ban sah ha kane ka jaka , bad ngin sa nang roi ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .
translation.kha: Ka jingïasoh jong nga bad U Trai Jisu ka pynlong thikna ïa nga ba ym don ka jingbam ha ka hi , kaba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ; hynrei lada u briew u ngeit ba katto katne ka jingbam ka long ka bymkhuid , te ka long bymkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken ! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !
translation.kha: Ka Babilonia ka la tied tyrnem ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei lyngkhot lyngkhai , bad mynta uta u tyrnem u khynñiuh ! Ki jaitbynriew baroh ki kyndit halor kaei kaba la jia ïa kata ka ri .

translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Rise up , Balak , and hear  ; hearken unto me , thou son of Zippor :
translation.kha: bad u Balaam u kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ale , ko Balak u khun jong u Sippor , Bad sngap aïu nga don ban ong .

translation.en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new : for he saith , The old is better .
translation.kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba kwah ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hadien ba u la dih ïa ka waiñ barim . ‘ Kaba rim ka kham bha ,’ u ong .

translation.en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom , Thus saith thy brother Israel , Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us :
translation.kha: U Moses u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien na Kadesh sha u syiem Edom . Ki ong ,  Kane ka khubor ka wan na ki para kur jong phi , kiba na ka jait Israel . Phi tip ïa ki jingeh kiba ngi la shah ,

translation.en: The king also said unto them , Take with you the servants of your lord , and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule , and bring him down to Gihon :
translation.kha: u ong ha ki ,  Ïalam bad phi ïa ki rangbah synshar ka ïingbishar jong nga ; pynshong ïa u Solomon , u khun jong nga halor u khashor jong nga , bad synran ïa u shathie sha ka Umpohliew Gihon ,

translation.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad da baroh ka spah bakyrhai jong u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , U Blei jong nga un pyndap ïa ka jingdonkam jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And the king lamented over Abner , and said , Died Abner as a fool dieth ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner :  Balei u Abner u dei ban ïap kum u bieit ?

translation.en: These words spake his parents , because they feared the Jews : for the Jews had agreed already , that if any man did confess that he was Christ , he should be put out of the synagogue .
translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la ong ïa kane namar ba ki la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , kiba la lah mynjur lypa ba uno uno uba ong ba u ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah un shah beh noh na ka synagog .

translation.en: Tom is a friend of a friend of mine .
translation.kha: U Tom u dei u paralok jong u paralok jong nga .

translation.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him , How can these things be ?
translation.kha: Kumno kane ka lah ban long ?  la kylli u Nikodemos .

translation.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts , forty kine , and ten bulls , twenty she asses , and ten foals .
translation.kha: laiphew tylli ki ut ai dud lem bad ki khun jong ki , sawphew tylli ki masi kynthei bad shiphew tylli ki masi kyrtong , arphew tylli ki kada kynthei bad shiphew tylli ki kada shynrang .

translation.en: And she spake out with a loud voice , and said , Blessed art thou among women , and blessed is the fruit of thy womb .
translation.kha: bad ka la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba la kyrkhu na baroh ki kynthei , bad long ba la kyrkhu ita i khunlung iba phan sa kha !

translation.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp , and the priest shall be unclean until the even .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , un sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , bad nangta u lah ban rung sha ka jaka shong dara ; hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: And I am sure that , when I come unto you , I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ .
translation.kha: Haba ngan wan sha phi , nga tip ba ngan wan ryngkat bad ka jingkyrkhu ba-dap jong U Khrist .

translation.en: Hear instruction , and be wise , and refuse it not .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , long uba stad ; wat kyntait ïa ka .

translation.en: When I have brought them again from the people , and gathered them out of their enemies  lands , and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations  ;
translation.kha: Khnang ban pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew babun ba nga long uba khuid , ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri baroh kiba ki shong ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: And there came a fear on all : and they glorified God , saying , That a great prophet is risen up among us  ; and , That God hath visited his people .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .  U nongïathuhlypa uba khraw u la mihpaw hapdeng jong ngi !  ki la ong ;  U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa ki briew jong u !

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sep , bad ba ka la dum , u khiew uba mih tdem bad ka dongmusa kaba mehding ki paw kynsan bad ïaid napdeng kita ki lyngkhot doh .

translation.en: And he began to teach them , that the Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders , and of the chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki synran jong u :  U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un sa shah pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .

translation.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever : the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha un ym bakla da lei lei ; yn ïai kynmaw borabor ïa u .

translation.en: I am a brother to dragons , and a companion to owls .
translation.kha: Ka sur jong nga ka long sngewsih bad marwei kum ka jingïam u myrsiang lane ka ostrit .

translation.en: But all Israel and Judah loved David , because he went out and came in before them .
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei pa uwei ha Israel bad Judah ki ieit ïa u Dabid ba u long u nongïalam uba jop .

translation.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God , than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season  ;
translation.kha: U la kham jied ban shahshitom bad ki briew jong U Blei ban ïa kaba lehkmen ha ka pop katto katne por .

translation.en: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses , neither will your Father forgive your trespasses .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim map ïa kiwei , te U Kpa jong phi un ym map ïa ki jingpalat kiba phi la leh .

translation.en: And Cornelius said , Four days ago I was fasting until this hour  ; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house , and , behold , a man stood before me in bright clothing ,
translation.kha: U Kornelios u la ong ,  Ka la long kumba ha kane ka por lai sngi mynshuwa ba nga dang duwai ha ka ïing jong nga ha ka por lai baje nohphai sngi . Kynsan u briew uba riam ha ki jaiñ kiba phyrnai u la ïeng ha khmat jong nga , bad u la ong :

translation.en: Cry and howl , son of man : for it shall be upon my people , it shall be upon all the princes of Israel : terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people : smite therefore upon thy thigh .
translation.kha: To jlew da ka jingsngewsih , ko khun u briew ; kane ka waitlam ka dei na ka bynta ki briew jong nga bad na ka bynta ki nongïalam ki Israel baroh . Ïa ki yn pynïap lang bad kiba sah baroh na ki briew jong nga . Tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingnoh mynsiem !

translation.en: I was just making sure .
translation.kha: Nga shu pynthikna .

translation.en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me no meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me no drink :
translation.kha: Nga la thngan , hynrei phim shym bsa ïa nga , nga la sliang , hynrei phim shym ai jingdih ïa nga ;

translation.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created , till iniquity was found in thee .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh jong me ka la long kaba janai naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me haduh ba me la sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do , that ye may live , and multiply , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers .
translation.kha: Da kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , ba phin ïoh im , phin roi , bad phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle s eye , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u riewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban leit lyngba ka thliew thyrnia .

translation.en: Then he said , I have sinned : yet honour me now , I pray thee , before the elders of my people , and before Israel , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Nga la leh pop ,  u Saul u jubab .  Hynrei la kumno kumno pyn-i ka jingñiewkor ïa nga ha khmat ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong nga bad ki Israel baroh . Ïaleit phai ryngkat bad nga , ba ngan lah ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  taketh pleasure in them that fear him , in those that hope in his mercy .
translation.kha: hynrei u sngewbha ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u , ha kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u .

translation.en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour  ; and love no false oath : for all these are things that I hate , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat thmu ïa ki rukom pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat . Wat ai ïa ka jingsakhi lamler ha kaba jingsmai . Nga isih ïa ka jinglamler , ka jingbymlehhok bad ka jinglehbor .

translation.en: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee , and set darkness upon thy land , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlip ïa baroh ki jingshai jong ka bneng , bad ngan pyndum ngaiñ ïa ka pyrthei jong me ha ka jingdum , ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga la kren .

translation.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities  ; but was in all points tempted like as we are , yet without sin .
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ngi um long uta u bym lah ban sngewlem ïa ki jingtlot jong ngi . Pynban , ngi don U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba la shah pynshoi ha kiei kiei baroh kum ma ngi , hynrei u bym shym la leh pop .

translation.en: That the man of God may be perfect , thoroughly furnished unto all good works .
translation.kha: khnang ba u briew uba shakri ïa U Blei un lah ban long uba bit pura bad uba la biang bha ban leh ïa baroh ki jait kam kiba bha baroh .

translation.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things : but the counsel of the wicked is far from me .
translation.kha: Bad pynban u dei U Blei uba la pynriewspah ïa ki — ngam lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bymman .

translation.en: O come , let us sing unto the  Lord  : let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation .
translation.kha: Ale , to ngin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; to ngin ïarwai da ka jingkmen ha U Blei , uba ïada ïa ngi !

translation.en: A true witness delivereth souls : but a deceitful witness speaketh lies .
translation.kha: U sakhi u pyllait im ïa ki briew haba u ong ïa kaba shisha ; haba u ong ïa kaba shukor , u shetkylla ïa ki briew .

translation.en: When his candle shined upon my head , and when by his light I walked through darkness  ;
translation.kha: U Blei u long borabor bad nga ha kata ka por bad u ai jingshai ïa nga katba nga ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingdum .

translation.en: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers . For there is no power but of God : the powers that be are ordained of God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar , namar ym don ka bor khlem ka jingaibor jong U Blei , bad ïa ki bor synshar kiba don mynta la buh hangta da U Blei .

translation.en: For what nation is there so great , who hath God so nigh unto them , as the  Lord  our God is in all things that we call upon him for ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khraw katno katno , kaba don u blei uba hajan kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , haba ki donkam ïa u . Man ka por ba ngi khot kyrpad ïa u , u jubab ïa ngi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob , and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father , that Esau his brother came in from his hunting .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la pyndep ban ai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , bad shen hadien ba u Jakob u la leit , u Iso u hynmen jong u , u la wan phai na kaba behmrad .

translation.en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded , and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that were to go out on the sabbath : for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi bad ki briew ka Judah ki leh kumba la bthah da u Jehoïada . Ym shym la phah noh ïa ki rangbah haba ki la pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Sabbaton , kumta ki rangbah ai hukum ki ïoh lang ïa kito kiba dang wan sha la ki kam bad kito kiba la pyndep kam .

translation.en: And when the thousand years are expired , Satan shall be loosed out of his prison ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki shihajar snem ki la kut , yn pyllait ïa u Soitan na ka byndi jong u ,

translation.en: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah , Good is the word of the  Lord  which thou hast spoken . And he said , Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days ?
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u sngewthuh ïa kane ba ka mut ba kan don ka jingsuk bad jingshngain shi jingim jong u , kumta u jubab ,  Ka khubor ba me la ai ïa nga na U  Trai  ka long kaba bha .

translation.en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer , and put him in a prison house  ; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing . And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa u Asa ban bitar haduh katta katta ïa u nongïathuhlypa bad phah teh kynjri ïa u . Ka la long ha kane kajuh ka por ba u Asa u sdang ban lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa katto katne ngut ki briew .

translation.en: And Paul said , I would to God , that not only thou , but also all that hear me this day , were both almost , and altogether such as I am , except these bonds .
translation.kha: La ka long ha ka por balyngkot lane ha ka por bajlan ,  u Paul u la jubab ,  ka jingduwai jong nga ha U Blei ka long ba ma me bad baroh kiwei pat kiba sngap ïa nga ha kane ka sngi ki lah ban long kum ma nga — lait noh , da shisha , ïa kine ki kynjri !

translation.en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel . And the land had rest fourscore years .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki Israel ki la jop ïa ki Moab , bad ka jingsuk ka la don ha ka ri haduh phraphew snem .

translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  , and served Baal and Ashtoreth .
translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U  Trai  bad ki la shakri ïa ki blei Baal bad Astarte .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .
translation.kha: To map ïa ka pop jong u syiem bad jong ki paid Israel . Hikai ïa ki ban leh ïa kaba dei . Nangta , A  Trai  to phah ïa u slap ha kane ka ri jong me , ïa kaba me la ai ha la ki jong ki briew kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .

translation.en: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .
translation.kha: La pynkhuslai eh ïa ka Mari da ka khubor jong u angel , bad ka la lyngngoh aïu ki kyntien jong u ki kit jingmut .

translation.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust  ; if so be there may be hope .
translation.kha: ngi dei ban nguh ha ka jingpyndem , namar dang lah ban don ka jingkyrmen .

translation.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law , the priest of Midian : and he led the flock to the backside of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , even to Horeb .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Moses u dang ap ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u Jethro , u kthaw kurim jong u , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u ïalam ïa kata ka kynhun lyngba ka ri shyiap , bad u wan poi ha Sinai , u lum uba khuid .

translation.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice , and wherein the snow is hid :
translation.kha: Ki wahduid kiba la khleh lang bad ka ïor lem bad u thah ,

translation.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness  ;
translation.kha: ki briew kiba iehnoh ïa ka jingim hok ban im ha ka jingdum ka pop ,

translation.en: And , behold , they cried out , saying , What have we to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God ? art thou come hither to torment us before the time ?
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la lynñiar ,  Me kwah aïu bad ngi , me U Khun jong U Blei ? Hato me la wan ban pynshitom ïa ngi ha shuwa ka por kaba dei ?

translation.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country unto me , even from Babylon .
translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u la kylli ,  Nangno kine ki briew ki wan bad kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ?  U Hesekaïah u la jubab ,  Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bha , na Babilonia .

translation.en: And said , For this cause shall a man leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife : and they twain shall be one flesh ?
translation.kha: Bad U Blei u la ong , ‘ Namar kane ka daw u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga , bad ma ki baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’

translation.en: But Moses  hands were heavy  ; and they took a stone , and put it under him , and he sat thereon  ; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side  ; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun .
translation.kha: Haba ki kti u Moses ki la sakhrai , u Aaron bad u Hur ki rah uwei u maw ba un shong , katba ma ki pat ki ïeng ha syndah jong u , uwei sha kadiang bad uwei pat sha kamon , bad ki kyrshan ïa ki kti jong u , ki da kyrshan skhem ïa ki kumta haduh ban da sep ka sngi .

translation.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba hok ha ka jingkhmih U Blei ne uba sngur ha khmat u Nongthaw jong u ?

translation.en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name  ; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel : I am the  Lord  which hallow you ,
translation.kha: Wat shim thala ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , hynrei to ai ban pynkyntang khuid ïa nga hapdeng ki Israel ; Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa phi ,

translation.en: In the mean time , when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people , insomuch that they trode one upon another , he began to say unto his disciples first of all ,  Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy .
translation.kha: Katba da ki hajar ngut ki briew ki dang ïalumlang , ba kumta ki la ïa-ïuh para ma ki , U Jisu u la ong nyngkong ha la ki synran ,  To sumar na u thiat jong ki Pharisi — nga mut ïa ka jingarsap jong ki .

translation.en: Shall I not in that day , saith the  Lord  , even destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mount of Esau ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki Edom , ngan pynduh noh ïa ki rangbah basian buit jong ki bad pynjah noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed  ; because thou hast obeyed my voice .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban kyrkhu ïa ki kumba nga la kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me — baroh namar ba me la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga .

translation.en: And it was told king David , saying , The  Lord  hath blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that pertaineth unto him , because of the ark of God . So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed–edom into the city of David with gladness .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ïohsngew ba namar ka Synduk ka Jutang , U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka longïing jong u Obed Edom bad baroh kat kiba u don ; kumta u leit shim noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang na ka ïing jong u Obed ban leit rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad ka jinglehkmen kaba khraw .

translation.en: Neither is there salvation in any other : for there is none other name under heaven given among men , whereby we must be saved .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynim dei ban shem tang lyngba jong u ; ha ka pyrthei baroh ym don uno uno ïa uba U Blei u la ai uba lah ban pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the  Lord  is God , and that there is none else .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang U  Trai  hi u long U Blei — ym don uwei pat .

translation.en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Kaleb u ong ,  Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga , ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba ïohknieh ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .

translation.en: Behold , he is hid now in some pit , or in some other place : and it will come to pass , when some of them be overthrown at the first , that whosoever heareth it will say , There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom .
translation.kha: Wat mynta hi u dang rieh ha kawei na ki krem lane ha kawei pat ka jaka . Hamar ba u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong phi , kat uba ïohsngew ïa kata un ong ba ki rangbah jong phi ki la shahjop .

translation.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers .
translation.kha: To nang ïaid , bad pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la sdang !

translation.en: I am happy .
translation.kha: Nga sngewkmen .

translation.en: But though he had done so many miracles before them , yet they believed not on him :
translation.kha: Wat la U Jisu u la leh ïa kine ki kambah baroh ha khmat jong ki , kim shym la ngeit ha u , ba yn pyndep ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la ong ba kan long shisha :

translation.en: And this they did , not as we hoped , but first gave their own selves to the Lord , and unto us by the will of God .
translation.kha: Ka la long palat ban ïa kaba ngi la khmih lynti! Nyngkong ki la aiti ïa lade ha U Trai ; bad nangta , da ka mon U Blei ki la aiti ïa lade ha ngi ruh .

translation.en: And being made perfect , he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him  ;
translation.kha: Haba la pynlong janai ïa u , u la jia long ka tynrai jong ka jingim bymjukut na ka bynta kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u ,

translation.en: ( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees , and with gold , according to all his desire , ) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .
translation.kha: U Hiram jong ka Tyros u la pynbiang ïa u ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh , bad ïa ka ksiar ruh , katba u donkam . Ynda la dep tei ïa ki , u Syiem Solomon u ai ïa u Hiram arphew tylli ki shnong ha ka thain Galilaïa .

translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When her branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is near :
translation.kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un ai ka jinghikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnat jong u ki la jyrngam bad khie lung bad u la sdang ban sei ki sla , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .

translation.en: The second woe is past  ; and , behold , the third woe cometh quickly .
translation.kha: Ka jingshyrkhei kaba ar ka la kut , hynrei ka jingshyrkhei kaba lai kan sa wan shen !

translation.en: For I have satiated the weary soul , and I have replenished every sorrowful soul .
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai bor ïa kito kiba la thait bad pynhun da ka jingbam ïa baroh kiba la tlot na ka jingthngan .

translation.en: And the seventh angel sounded  ; and there were great voices in heaven , saying , The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord , and of his Christ  ; and he shall reign for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynñiew u la put ïa la ka turoi , bad la don ki sur kiba jam ha bneng , kiba ong ,  Ka bor ban synshar halor ka pyrthei ka long mynta ka jong U Trai jong ngi bad jong U Messaïah jong u , bad un synshar junom la junom !

translation.en: And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki khynnah ha la ki ksang ti , u la buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki , bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .

translation.en: And they turned aside thither , to go in and to lodge in Gibeah : and when he went in , he sat him down in a street of the city : for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging .
translation.kha: Ki phai noh na ka lynti bah ban leit sahmiet hangta . Ki rung shapoh ka nongbah bad ki shong ha madan shnong , hynrei ym don ba khot basa ïa ki ha kata ka miet .

translation.en: For if they fall , the one will lift up his fellow : but woe to him that is alone when he falleth  ; for he hath not another to help him up .
translation.kha: Lada uwei na ki u kyllon , uwei pat u lah ban khyllie joit ïa u . Hynrei lada uno uno u don marwei bad u kyllon ; ka long kaba sangsot tam , namar ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: Woe unto them ! for they have gone in the way of Cain , and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward , and perished in the gainsaying of Core .
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa ki ! Ki la bud ha ka lynti kaba u Kain u la ïaid . Na ka bynta ka tyngka , ki la aiti ïa lade sha ka jingbakla kaba u Balaam u la leh . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah kumba u Korah u la ïaleh pyrshah , bad kum ma u , la pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: Be not afraid of their faces : for I am with thee to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki , naba ngan don lem bad me ban ïada ïa me . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren !

translation.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed : thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation .
translation.kha: Me bat ïa la ka kular , me la ïalam noh ïa ki briew kiba me la pyllait im ; da ka bor jong me , me la btin ïa ki sha ka ri kaba kyntang jong me .

translation.en: And after that I looked , and , behold , the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened :
translation.kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa ka templ ha bneng ba ka plie , lem bad ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: Howbeit the  Lord  would not destroy the house of David , because of the covenant that he had made with David , and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  um mon ban pynduh ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid , namar u la lah pynlong ka jutang bad u Dabid bad ba u la kular ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .

translation.en: To wit , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem , and which see visions of peace for her , and there is no peace , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ai jingpynthikna ïa ka Jerusalem ba kaei kaei baroh ka bit ka biang , haba baroh kam bit kam biang !  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And it came to pass after many days , that the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah in the third year , saying , Go , shew thyself unto Ahab  ; and I will send rain upon the earth .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingrang ryngkhiang , U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah ,  Khie leit pyn-i ïa lade ha u syiem Ahab , bad ngan sa phah slap .

translation.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted , and sinneth , being condemned of himself .
translation.kha: Me tip ba kum uta ki briew u long uba bamsap bad ki pop jong u ki pynshisha ba u bakla .

translation.en: And they , when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la ai ïa ka jingphla jong ki bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Ha lynti ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiba bun ki shnong ha Samaria .

translation.en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field , and thou hast increased and waxen great , and thou art come to excellent ornaments : thy breasts are fashioned , and thine hair is grown , whereas thou wast naked and bare .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa pha ban san kum u jingthung baplung . Pha la nang khlaiñ bad jrong bad pha la long ka kynthei samla . Ka shadem jong pha ka la wandur itynnat , bad u shñiuh jong pha u la san , hynrei pha long kaba lyngkhuit .

translation.en: Then Ahimelech answered the king , and said , And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David , which is the king s son in law , and goeth at thy bidding , and is honourable in thine house ?
translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u jubab ,  U Dabid u dei u rangbah pynïaidkam uba hok tam uba phi don ! U dei u pyrsa kurim jong phi , u kapten jong ki shipai kiba ïada ïa phi , bad ïa uba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da uwei pa uwei ha ka ïingsyiem jong phi .

translation.en: Then the king answered and said , Give her the living child , and in no wise slay it : she is the mother thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u ong ,  Wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka kynthei kaba nyngkong — ka dei ka kmie bashisha jong u .

translation.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice , but they could not : so there were lice upon man , and upon beast .
translation.kha: Kita ki nongleh myntor ki pyrshang ban pyndonkam ïa ki buit myntor jong ki ban pynmih mait , hynrei kim lah . Bad kat shaba leit don tang ki mait suda .

translation.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts , neither are your ways my ways , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingmut jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kim long kum ki jong phi , bad ki lynti jong nga ki ïapher na ki jong phi .

translation.en: For the love of money is the root of all evil : which while some coveted after , they have erred from the faith , and pierced themselves through with many sorrows .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingieit ïa ka spah ka long ka thymmei jong ki jait jingsniew baroh . Don kiba da kwah eh ban ïoh ïa ka haduh ba ki la ïaid sakma na ka jingngeit bad ki pait dohnud na ki jingsngewsih babun .

translation.en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him ? saith the  Lord . Do not I fill heaven and earth ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban rieh ha kaba ngam lah ban ïohi ïa u . Hato phim tip ba nga don ha ki jaka baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew ?

translation.en: Know therefore and understand , that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks , and threescore and two weeks : the street shall be built again , and the wall , even in troublous times .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa kane bad to shemphang ïa ka : Naduh ka por ba la ai ïa ka hukum ban tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , tad haduh ba wan u nongïalam ba la jied da U Blei , ki hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snem kin leit noh . Ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat lem bad ki lynti bah bad ki jingïada bakhlaiñ , bad kan ïeng haduh hynñiew sien ki hynriewphew ar snem , hynrei kane kan long ka por ki jingjynjar .

translation.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children s children : and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha kin don ka spah ban ieh pateng ha ki ksiew jong ki , hynrei ka spah jong ki nongpop kan leit sha kiba hok .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning , that there were thunders and lightnings , and a thick cloud upon the mount , and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud  ; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled .
translation.kha: Ha ka step jong ka sngi kaba lai , la don u pyrthat bad ka leilieh , u lyoh uba rben u la paw halor u lum , bad la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi kaba sawa jam . Baroh ki briew kiba don ha ka jaka sher dara ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And I said , Lord , they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee :
translation.kha: ‘ Ko Kynrad ,’ nga la jubab , ‘ ki ïatip bha ba nga la leit sha ki synagog bad nga la kem bad shoh ïa kito kiba ngeit ha me .

translation.en: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon , with the freewill offering of the people , and of the priests , offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: Men rah ruh baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba me la lum na baroh kawei ka probins    Babilon bad ki jingainguh kiba ki Israel bad ki lyngdoh jong ki , ki ai na ka bynta ka Templ jong U Blei jong ki ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then they went out of the city , and came unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïamih na shnong bad ki la leit sha U Jisu .

translation.en: And the righteous men , they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses , and after the manner of women that shed blood  ; because they are adulteresses , and blood is in their hands .
translation.kha: Ki briew bahok kin pynrem ïa ki halor ka daw jong ka jingawria bad jingpynïap briew , namar ki ïai klim bad ki kti jong ki , ki bit da ka snam .

translation.en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age , so that he could not see . And he brought them near unto him  ; and he kissed them , and embraced them .
translation.kha: U Jakob , namar ba u la tymmen , u la byr-ïe ki khmat , bad um imat bha shuh . U Joseph u ïalam ïa ki hajan jong u ; u ruh u piam u kdup ïa ki bad u doh de ïa ki .

translation.en: Yea , so have I strived to preach the gospel , not where Christ was named , lest I should build upon another man s foundation :
translation.kha: Ka jingangnud jong nga borabor ka long ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki jaka ha kiba ïa U Khrist ym pat shym la ïohsngew , khnang ban ym tei halor ka nongrim ba la seng da kiwei pat .

translation.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father , and bitterness to her that bare him .
translation.kha: U khun uba bieit u pynsngewsih ïa la u kpa bad u pynbabe da ki jingkthang ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi , the son of Gedaliah , the son of Amariah , the son of Hizkiah , in the days of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Sephanaïah ha ka por ba u Josaïah u khun jong u Ammon u long u syiem ka Judah . ( U Sephanaïah u la hiarpateng na u syiem Hesekaïah lyngba u Amaraïah , u Gedalaïah , bad u Kushi . )

translation.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh : What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ka long thik kumba nga la ïathuh ha phi — U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi ïa kaei ba un sa leh .

translation.en: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places , wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods , upon the high mountains , and upon the hills , and under every green tree :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka ri ba phi ïohkynti , pynjot ïa ki jaka baroh ha kiba ki briew ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki ha ki lum kiba jrong , ha ki lumrit , bad hapoh ki dieng kiba jyrngam .

translation.en: To receive the instruction of wisdom , justice , and judgment , and equity  ;
translation.kha: Ki lah ban hikai ïa phi kumno ban im kum kiba stad bad kumno ban long uba hok , uba lehhok , bad uba ïaid beit .

translation.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day : if the plague be spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in a skin , or in any work that is made of skin  ; the plague is a fretting leprosy  ; it is unclean .
translation.kha: Un khmih bha pat ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la pur , kata ka long ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare , to fight with Israel . And Achish said unto David , Know thou assuredly , that thou shalt go out with me to battle , thou and thy men .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki Philistia ki la ïalumlang ïa la u paidïapom ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel bad U Akhish u ong ha u Dabid ,  Da shisha phi tip ba ma phi bad ki briew jong phi ki dei ban ïaleh ha ka liang jong nga .

translation.en: Then Joshua called the twelve men , whom he had prepared of the children of Israel , out of every tribe a man :
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kiba u la jied ,

translation.en: And it shall be , if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee , and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did  ; that I will be with thee , and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee .
translation.kha: Lada me kohnguh tylli ïa nga , me im hapoh ki hukum jong nga , bad me ïoh ïa ka jingmynjur jong nga da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum , kumba u Dabid u shakri jong nga u la leh , ngan ïai don ryngkat bad me . Ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel bad ngan pynthikna ba kiba hiarpateng na me kin synshar hadien jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Dabid .

translation.en: And he took a yoke of oxen , and hewed them in pieces , and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers , saying , Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel , so shall it be done unto his oxen . And the fear of the  Lord  fell on the people , and they came out with one consent .
translation.kha: U shim shi jur ki masi lur , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki bad u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit rah ïa kita ki lyngkhot kylleng ka ri Israel ryngkat bad kane ka jingmaham :  Kat u bym bud ïa u Saul bad u Samuel sha ka thma , kumne yn leh ïa ki masi lur jong u .  Te ki paid Israel ki sheptieng her ïa kaei ba un leh U  Trai  , bad baroh khlem lait uwei ruh , ki ïawan mih ryntih lang baroh .

translation.en: And the dove came in to him in the evening  ; and , lo , in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off : so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet , kata ka paro ka wan phai pat sha u , ka da wanrah ha la ka shyntur ïa u sla dieng Olib ba dang shu kheit . Kumta u Noah u tip ba ka um ka la rngad .

translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?
translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat bor wat tang bad uba don ha kyrdan ba hapoh eh jong ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria , bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki nong Ijipt kin phah kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai !

translation.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews , devout men , out of every nation under heaven .
translation.kha: La don ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , ki riew niam kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka ri ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: When he speaketh fair , believe him not : for there are seven abominations in his heart .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban sawa sngewtynnat , hynrei wat ngeit ïa u , namar ka dohnud jong u ka dap haduh rymmiang da ka jingisih .

translation.en: In all labour there is profit : but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury .
translation.kha: To trei minot bad phin pahuh ha ka jingim ; lada phi shu bunktien phin ïoh long kiba kyrduh .

translation.en: I told you before , and foretell you , as if I were present , the second time ; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned , and to all other , that , if I come again , I will not spare :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïathuh ha kito na phi kiba la leh pop ha ki por ba la leit , bad sha baroh kiwei pat ; nga la ong ïa kane mynshuwa ha ka jingwan jngoh kaba ar ïa phi , hynrei ngan ong biang mynta ba nga don jngai : Ha kawei ka por ba nga wan yn ym don mano mano ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom .

translation.en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour , and saith , Am not I in sport ?
translation.kha: U briew uba ïalam bakla ïano ïano bad nangta u kam ba u shu biria u long kum u briew uba lamwir uba ïalehkai bad ka tiar kaba pynïap .

translation.en: And he came and touched the bier : and they that bare him stood still . And he said ,  Young man , I say unto thee , Arise .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïaid sha khmat bad u la ktah ïa ka krong , bad ki briew kiba bah ïa ka ki la sangeh . U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko samla ! To khie joit , nga ong ïa me !

translation.en: And if thy brother be waxen poor , and fallen in decay with thee  ; then thou shalt relieve him : yea , though he be a stranger , or a sojourner  ; that he may live with thee .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u para Israel uba shong marjan bad phi u kylla duk bad um lah shuh ban kyrshan hi ïa lade , phi dei ban ïarap ïa u kumba phi leh ïa u nongtrei , khnang ba u lah ban ïailong u paramarjan jong phi .

translation.en: When Israel went out of Egypt , the house of Jacob from a people of strange language  ;
translation.kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , mynba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob ki la mihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei ,

translation.en: And the Hivite , and the Arkite , and the Sinite ,
translation.kha: ki Hib , ki Ark , ki Sin ,

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of seven days , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba la kut kita ki hynñiew sngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him .
translation.kha: ki la ïohi ïa u , hynrei kumno re kumno kim shym ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ïa kane ka jingainguh thang dei ban ainguh man la ka Sabbaton nalor ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .

translation.en: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther . So Esther arose , and stood before the king ,
translation.kha: U syiem u la pyn-i ïa u diengsynshar ksiar ha ka , kumta ka ïeng bad ka ong ,

translation.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth  ; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ban ïalam ïa pha , ym don uno uno napdeng ki briew jong pha ban btin ïa pha da ka kti .

translation.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers , and that Joab the captain of the host was dead , Hadad said to Pharaoh , Let me depart , that I may go to mine own country .
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka poi ha u Hadad ha Ijipt ba u Dabid u la ïap bad ba u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u ruh u la ïap , u Hadad u ong ha u syiem ,  Shah ba ngan leit phai sha la ka ri .

translation.en: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory ? and how do ye see it now ? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno hapdeng jong phi uba dang kynmaw katno ka jingiphuh ka Templ ka la ju long ? Kumno phi ïohi ïa kane mynta ? Ka paw kumba kam long ei ei ruh .

translation.en: It stood still , but I could not discern the form thereof : an image was before mine eyes , there was silence , and I heard a voice , saying ,
translation.kha: Nga lah ban ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba ïeng hangta ; nga peit lyngngoh , hynrei ngam lah ban ong ka dei kaei .

translation.en: And one loaf of bread , and one cake of oiled bread , and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Shim ruh uwei u kpu , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , bad uwei u kpu lyngkniap na kata ka shang kpu ba la ainguh sha nga .

translation.en: As unknown , and yet well known ; as dying , and , behold , we live ; as chastened , and not killed ;
translation.kha: kumba ym don ba la ithuh , pynban la ithuh ïa ngi da baroh ; la kum kiba la ïap , hynrei , kumba phi ïohi , ngi dang ïai im .

translation.en: I the  Lord  search the heart , I try the reins , even to give every man according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga wad ïa ki jingmut bad nga tynjuh ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew . Nga leh ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ka lynti ba u im , kat kum kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: And these three men , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Te u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , kiba dang shah khum , ki la hap sha ka pdeng jong ka ding baklang .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses and unto Aaron , Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace , and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Shim katto katne kham u dpei na ka lawar ding ; u Moses un kynting ïa u shajrong ha khmat u Pharaoh .

translation.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah , and came and said before Jonathan , What have I done ? what is mine iniquity ? and what is my sin before thy father , that he seeketh my life ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u phet na Naïoth kaba ha Ramah bad u leit sha u Jonathan .  Kaei kaba nga la leh ?  u kylli .  Ka kam sniew aïu nga la leh ? Ka kam palat aïu nga la leh ïa i pa jong phi ba i da thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ?

translation.en: If thou sinnest , what doest thou against him ? or if thy transgressions be multiplied , what doest thou unto him ?
translation.kha: Lada me leh pop , kata kam ktah ei ei ïa U Blei . Lada bunsien me leh bakla , hato kata ka ktah ïa u ?

translation.en: For while they be folden together as thorns , and while they are drunken as drunkards , they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry .
translation.kha: Kum ïa ki shiah kiba la thain bad ïa u phlangïap ba-tyrkhong , ïa phi ki nongbuaid yn thang duh !

translation.en: But take heed to yourselves : for they shall deliver you up to councils  ; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten : and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them .
translation.kha: Ma phi ïa lade hi phi dei ban long kiba sumar bha . Phin shah kem bad shah ïalam sha ka ïingbishar . Ïa phi yn sa shoh ha ki synagog ; phin sa ïeng ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem na ka bynta jong nga ban ïathuh ha ki ïa ka Khubor Babha .

translation.en: But he shall say , I tell you , I know you not whence ye are  ; depart from me , all ye workers of iniquity .
translation.kha: Hynrei un ong biang , ‘ Ngam ithuh nangno phi ïawan . Khie leit noh na nga , phi baroh ki briew kiba bymman !’

translation.en: So Joash the king of Israel went up  ; and they saw one another in the face , both he and Amaziah king of Judah , at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoash , u syiem ka Israel u leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah , u syiem ka Judah . Ki la ïakynduh ha Beth Shemesh kaba ha Judah ,

translation.en: And he set the bread in order upon it before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  had commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad u buh halor jong ka ïa u kpu ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: And many nations shall pass by this city , and they shall say every man to his neighbour , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this great city ?
translation.kha: Hadien nangta , bun ki jaitbynriew nongwei kin ïaid lynti bad kin ïakylli uwei ïa uwei pat balei ba nga , U  Trai  nga la leh katne katne ïa kane ka nongbah kaba khraw .

translation.en: The cities of the south shall be shut up , and none shall open them : Judah shall be carried away captive all of it , it shall be wholly carried away captive .
translation.kha: Ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie ki don hapoh ka jingshah kerkut ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit lyngba sha ki . Ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Judah la shim noh sha ka jinglongmraw .

translation.en: Now is the end come upon thee , and I will send mine anger upon thee , and will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , kaba kut ka la wan . Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ; naba ngan bishar ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli jong pha baroh .

translation.en: That Christ should suffer , and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead , and should shew light unto the people , and to the Gentiles .
translation.kha: ba U Messaïah u dei ban shahshitom bad ban long uba nyngkong ban mihpat na ka jingïap , ban pynbna ïa ka jingshai jong ka jingpynim ha ki Jiw bad ha ki Jentil .

translation.en: Moreover this they have done unto me : they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day , and have profaned my sabbaths .
translation.kha: Bad kata kam dei kaba ki la leh baroh . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ki pynkheiñ ïa ka Sabbaton , kaba nga la pynskhem .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Lo , I am come unto thee : have I now any power at all to say any thing ? the word that God putteth in my mouth , that shall I speak .
translation.kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Nga la wan em ! Hynrei mynta nga donbor aïu ? Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaba U Blei u ong ha nga ban kren .

translation.en: Now thou art commanded , this do ye  ; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .
translation.kha: Ong ruh ïa ki ba kin shim ïa ki kali na Ijipt na ka bynta ki tnga bad ki khun rit jong ki , bad ban wan ïalam ïa u kpa jong phi bad ki .

translation.en: And they shall cover the face of the earth , that one cannot be able to see the earth : and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped , which remaineth unto you from the hail , and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field :
translation.kha: Kin jyllei kat haduh ba kin tap lin ïa ka khyndew baroh . Kin bam lut khoit ïa kata baroh kaba u phria um shym la pynjot , bad wat ïa ki dieng kiba dang sah .

translation.en: That he would grant you , according to the riches of his glory , to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man ;
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa U Blei na ka jingkynrei spah ka burom jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka bor da U Mynsiem jong u ba phin long kiba khlaiñ ha ki jinglong bashapoh jong phi , bad nga duwai ba U Khrist un pynlong ka ïingshong jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi da ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Speak unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will profane my sanctuary , the excellency of your strength , the desire of your eyes , and that which your soul pitieth  ; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword .
translation.kha: ba ngan ai ha ki Israel ïa kane ka khubor : Pha sarong ha ka jingkhraw jong ka Templ . Pha sngewbha ban khmih ïa ka bad ban leit jngoh ïa ka , hynrei U  Trai  un pyntngit ïa ka . Bad ki dkhot ba kham samla ha ki longïing jong pha kiba la shah iehnoh ha Jerusalem kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: And Jesus stood still , and called them , and said ,  What will ye that I shall do unto you ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la khot ïa ki .  Kaei phi kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills , and from the multitude of mountains : truly in the  Lord  our God is the salvation of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la ïoh jingïarap ei ei da ka jingmane jong ngi ka bym dei ïa me halor ki kliar lum . Ka jingïarap ïa ki Israel ka wan tang na U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .
translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi , te , kam shong ha ka jingstad briew , hynrei , ha ka bor U Blei .

translation.en: Also he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , whereof the  Lord  had said , In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever .
translation.kha: U tei ki duwan ki blei thala ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba yn mane ïa u junom .

translation.en: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side , where prayer was wont to be made  ; and we sat down , and spake unto the women which resorted thither .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ngi la mih shabar na ka nongbah sha ka rudwah , ha kaba ngi la pyrkhat ba yn don ka jaka ha kaba ki Jiw ki ïalumlang ban duwai . Ngi la ïashong bad ïakren bad ki kynthei kiba la ïalumlang hangta .

translation.en: And so it fell out unto him : for the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died .
translation.kha: Te ka la jia kumta ïa u ; u la ïap , da kaba shah ïuh ha ban da ïap ha u paidbah ha kata ka khyrdop shnong .

translation.en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together , to set forward the workmen in the house of God : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brethren the Levites .
translation.kha: U Jeshua , u Lebi , lem bad ki khun shynrang bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad u Kadmiel bad ki khun shynrang jong u ( na ka kur Hodabaïah ) , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha kaba khmih ïa ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ . ( Ïa ki la ïarap da ki Lebi jong ka kur Henadad . )

translation.en: And the princes of Moab rose up , and they went unto Balak , and said , Balaam refuseth to come with us .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit phai sha u Balak bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Balaam um treh ban wan bad ki .

translation.en: And I will set fire in Egypt : Sin shall have great pain , and No shall be rent asunder , and Memphis shall have distresses daily .
translation.kha: Ngan tbeh ding ïa ka Ijipt , bad ka Pelusium kan don ha ka jingkordit . Ki kynroh jong ka Thebes kin pra , bad ka nongbah kan shlei da ka um .

translation.en: The beginning of the word of the  Lord  by Hosea . And the  Lord  said to Hosea , Go , take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms : for the land hath committed great whoredom , departing from the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la kren nyngkong eh ïa ki Israel lyngba u Hosia , U la ong ïa u Hosia ,  Khie leit bad shongkurim , ka tnga jong me kan long ka bymïaineh , bad ki khun jong me kin long kum ma ka hi . Ha kajuh ka rukom , ki briew jong nga ki la ieh ïa nga bad ki la long ki bymïaineh .

translation.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches , and loving favour rather than silver and gold .
translation.kha: Lada phi dei ban jied hapdeng ka nam babha bad ka spah kaba khraw , jied ïa ka nam babha .

translation.en: The  Lord  do so and much more to Jonathan : but if it please my father to do thee evil , then I will shew it thee , and send thee away , that thou mayest go in peace : and the  Lord  be with thee , as he hath been with my father .
translation.kha: Lada i thmu ban pynsniew ïa phi , to U  Trai  un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pyntip ïa phi ïa kata bad ba phin ïohlait na ka jingma . To U  Trai  un long lem bad phi kumba u la long bad i pa jong nga !

translation.en: And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them ,  Why reason ye , because ye have no bread ? perceive ye not yet , neither understand ? have ye your heart yet hardened ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïakren , kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi ïakren shaphang ka jingbymdon kpu ? Hato phim pat tip lane sngewthuh ? Hato ki jingmut jong phi ki dang dum ?

translation.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night , he , and all his servants , and all the Egyptians  ; and there was a great cry in Egypt  ; for there was not a house where there was not one dead .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , la pynkyndit ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa baroh ki nong Ijipt . Ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , namar ym shym don kawei ruh ka ïing kaba ym don u khun uba khlem ïap .

translation.en: Why did she pay the money ?
translation.kha: Balei ka siew ia ka pisa ?

translation.en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds , to hear the bleatings of the flocks ? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart .
translation.kha: Balei ki sah shadien lem bad ki langbrot ? Hato ban sngap ki nongap langbrot kiba khot ïa ki jingri ? Ho-oid , ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .

translation.en: Then the fire of the  Lord  fell , and consumed the burnt sacrifice , and the wood , and the stones , and the dust , and licked up the water that was in the trench .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding najrong , bad ka thang duh ïa ka jingkñia , ïa ki diengthang bad ïa ki maw ; ka pyningkhong ïa ka khyndew bad pynrngad lut ïa ka um ha ka kharai .

translation.en: And ye are witnesses of these things .
translation.kha: Phi long ki sakhi ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: But the Jews which believed not , moved with envy , took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort , and gathered a company , and set all the city on an uproar , and assaulted the house of Jason , and sought to bring them out to the people .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la bishni bad ki la lumlang ïa ki riewkhñium bymsalia na ki lynti bad na u paidbah . Ki la pynkhihwin ïa ka shnong baroh kawei bad ki la tur ïa ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Jason , ha ka jingpyrshang ban lap ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ban wallam ïa ki shabar sha u paidbah .

translation.en: ( Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion  ; and the Amorites call it Senir  ; )
translation.kha: ( Ïa u lum Hermon la khot Sirion da ki nong Sidon , bad Senir da ki Amor )

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall utter his voice before his army : for his camp is very great : for he is strong that executeth his word : for the day of the  Lord  is great and very terrible  ; and who can abide it ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kyrhuh ïa ki hukum sha ka kynhun shipai jong u . Ki shipai kiba kohnguh ïa u ki long shibun bad kiba khlaiñbor . Haduh katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ka sngi jong U  Trai  ! Uei u ban lait im na ka ?

translation.en: And he went up from thence to Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U Isaak u mihnoh nangta bad u leit sha Beersheba .

translation.en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen , and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen , and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework .
translation.kha: Suh ïa ka sopti u Aaron da ka linen bani , bad ïa ka jaiñspong ruh da ka linen bani ; bad ïa u panpoh ruh uba la suh pynpur itynnat .

translation.en: And they , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear , ( for they are a rebellious house , ) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them .
translation.kha: La kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah kin shahshkor ïa me ne kim shahshkor , kin tip ba don u nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: See , I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah :
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah ,

translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Dwell with me , and be unto me a father and a priest , and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year , and a suit of apparel , and thy victuals . So the Levite went in .
translation.kha: U Mikah u ong ,  Shong noh bad nga . Long u nongaibuit bad u lyngdoh jong nga , bad ngan ai ïa phi shiphew ki sbai rupa shisnem , ki jaiñ bad ka jingbam ïa phi .

translation.en: And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .
translation.kha: U shakri uba ar u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai san tylli ki sbai ksiar na kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’

translation.en: That as sin hath reigned unto death , even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka pop ka synshar da ka jingïap , kumta ruh ka jingaiei U Blei ka synshar da ka hok , ka ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingim bymjukut lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand , and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes .
translation.kha: Kum ka dak ka jingpynkynmaw , teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi .

translation.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .
translation.kha: U Stad saiñpyrkhat u la pyrshang ban shem ïa ki kyntien pyntngen , hynrei ki ktien kiba u thoh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly , and went up from Gilgal all night .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la ïaid na Gilgal sha Gibeon bad ki la tur kyndit ban ïaleh ïa ki Amor .

translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  , praise ye the  Lord  : for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers .
translation.kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! u la pyllait im ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ na ka bor jong ki briew basniew .

translation.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment , in meteyard , in weight , or in measure .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïano ïano da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki jingthew thok , ha ka pruh , ha u mawthew , ne ha ka jingbun .

translation.en: Reward her even as she rewarded you , and double unto her double according to her works : in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ka thik kumba ka la leh ïa phi ; siew kylliang ar shah ïa ka na ka bynta baroh kaba ka la leh . Pyndap ïa ka khuri jong ka da ka jingdih kaba ar shah ka jingkhor kum ka jingdih kaba ka la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house  ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
translation.kha: U Krispos , uba long u nongïalam jong ka synagog , u la ngeit ha U Trai , lem bad ka longïing jong u baroh ; bad kiba bun kiwei pat ki briew ha Korinth ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki la ngeit , bad la pynbaptis ïa ki .

translation.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace : I forgat prosperity .
translation.kha: Nga la klet noh kaba kumno ka jingkhiah bad ka jingsuk bad ka jingkmen ki long .

translation.en: Don’t you agree that any family will benefit if the husband treats his wife with concern , as he himself would want to be treated ?
translation.kha: Phim ia mynjur mo ka ing ka sem kan bha lada u tnga u sumar ia ka tnga da ka jingsngewlem kumba u kwah ba ki wei ruh kin leh kumta ia u ?

translation.en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory . I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord .
translation.kha: Nga dei ban sngewsarong , wat la kam wanrah jingbha ei ei . Hynrei ngan kren mynta shaphang ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingpynpaw ba la ai ha nga da U Trai .

translation.en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend  ; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful .
translation.kha: U paralok u thmu ïa kaba bha , wat haba u pynmong ïa phi . Hynrei haba u nongshun u buh ïa ka ksang ti jong u halor ka tyrpeng jong phi — da husiar !

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs , or a piece of an ear  ; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed , and in Damascus in a couch .
