translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kumba u nongaplangbrot u shem pat sa tang ar tylli ki kjat , ne ka shkor jong ka langbrot ba u sing u la bam , kumta ruh yn pyllait im tang khyndiat ïa ki briew ka Samaria , kiba mynta ki shong shaniah ha ki jingthiah baremdor .

translation.en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal .

translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek : and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong ki baroh ha Aphek , katba ki Israel ki sher dara harud ka pung kaba ha ka them Jesreel .

translation.en: And he sent Eliakim , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests , covered with sackcloth , to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz .
translation.kha: U phah khot ïa u Eliakim , u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki lyngdoh kiba ha shuwa jong u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos . Ki ruh ki phong da ki jaiñ khain .

translation.en: And , behold , the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison : and he smote Peter on the side , and raised him up , saying , Arise up quickly . And his chains fell off from his hands .
translation.kha: Kynsan u angel jong U Trai u la ïeng hangta , bad ka jingshai ka la thaba hapoh ka kamra byndi . U angel u la pynkhih ïa u Petros na ka tyrpeng , u la kyrsiew ïa u , bad u la ong ,  Pynkloi ! Khie joit !  mar kumta hi ki kynjri ki la hap na ki kti jong u Petros .

translation.en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand :
translation.kha: U maham ïa phi ba phin ym shah ïa u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish , saying , I have offended  ; return from me : that which thou puttest on me will I bear . And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phah ïa ka khubor sha u Sennakherib , uba don ha Lakhish :  Nga la leh bakla ; sngewbha pynsangeh ïa ka jingtur ïaleh jong phi , bad ngan siew kat kaba phi dawa .  Ka jubab u nongsynshar ka long ba u Hesekaïah un phah sha u shiphew ton ka rupa bad shi ton ka ksiar .

translation.en: To them that are without law , as without law , ( being not without law to God , but under the law to Christ , ) that I might gain them that are without law .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh , haba nga dang trei bad ki Jentil , nga im kum u Jentil , shabar ka Hukum ki Jiw , khnang ban jop ïa ki Jentil . Kane kam mut ba nga khlem kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei ; nga long shisha hapoh ka hukum U Khrist .

translation.en: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword , and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds : and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ïa ki shipai bakynsai tam jong u yn pynïap ha ka thma bad ïa kiba lait im yn pynsakma ha ki phang baroh . Te phan tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels , until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day .
translation.kha: Me hi men ïoh ka jingpang bajur ha ki snier ka ban kham jur na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .

translation.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness , but unto holiness .
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la khot ïa ngi ban im ha ka jingthala , hynrei ha ka jinglongkhuid .

translation.en: Judah is a lion s whelp : from the prey , my son , thou art gone up : he stooped down , he couched as a lion , and as an old lion  ; who shall rouse him up ?
translation.kha: U Judah u long kum u sing , Haba u la pynïap ïa uba u thmu u leit phai sha la krem ; Hangta u dem , bad u thiah . Uei uba nud ban pynthut ïa u ?

translation.en: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave , all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth , which caused their terror in the land of the living  ; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit .
translation.kha: Ka Elam ka don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep ki shipai jong ka ha baroh sawdong . Ki long baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki la leit hiar , khlem otsher sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad jahburom .

translation.en: Thou shalt drink also water by measure , the sixth part of an hin : from time to time shalt thou drink .
translation.kha: Me dei ruh ban dih khyndiat ka um , ar khuri shi sngi .

translation.en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits , and after wizards , to go a whoring after them , I will even set my face against that soul , and will cut him off from among his people .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u leit pan jingmut na ki briew kiba wad jingtip na ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba la ïap , ngan phai pyrshah ïa u bad ngan ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And as for you , O my flock , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I judge between cattle and cattle , between the rams and the he goats .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ka kynhun jong nga ; ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na phi bad ngan pynkhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew , ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .

translation.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes , and all his chariots with him : and he rose up by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him in , and the captains of the chariots .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoram lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la mih bad ki kali ïapom bad ki hiarthma ïa ka Edom . Hangta ka kynhun shipai jong ki Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki , hynrei ha ka por mynmiet ki la ïohlad ban mih shabar bad lait phet .

translation.en: Of the sons of Hebron  ; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth .
translation.kha: U Hebron , u khun uba lai jong u Kohath , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeraïah , u Amaraïah , u Jehasiel , bad u Jekameam .

translation.en: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him , Turn , and slay the priests of the  Lord   ; because their hand also is with David , and because they knew when he fled , and did not shew it to me . But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ki nongap kiba ïeng hajan jong u ,  Pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai  ! Ki la ïasylla bad u Dabid bad kim shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba u la phet , wat la ki la tip ïa ka baroh shi katta .  Hynrei ki nongap kim treh ban rah ïa la ka kti ban pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .

translation.en: My beloved spake , and said unto me , Rise up , my love , my fair one , and come away .
translation.kha: U shñiuh jong phi u itynnat halor ki ngab jong phi , bad u noh rymphum ha ka ryndang jong phi kum ki mawkordor .

translation.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires : and it hath dust of gold .
translation.kha: Ki maw jong ka khyndew ki don u mawkordor Sapphir , bad ki pui pui jong u ki don ksiar .

translation.en: So the  Lord  smote the Ethiopians before Asa , and before Judah  ; and the Ethiopians fled .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Sudan mynba u Asa bad ki kynhun shipai jong ka Judia ki tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you , as it is written .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Na ka daw jong phi ki Jiw , ki Jentil ki kren sniew ïa U Blei .

translation.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery , which taketh strangers instead of her husband !
translation.kha: Pha long kum ka kynthei kaba ïaleh awria bad ki nongwei ha ka jaka ban ieit ïa la u tnga .

translation.en: And , behold , there are last which shall be first , and there are first which shall be last .
translation.kha: Nangta kito kiba mynta ki long kiba khatduh kin long nyngkong , bad kito kiba mynta ki long nyngkong kin long khatduh .

translation.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he even took away all : and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
translation.kha: U shim lut ïa baroh ki jingkynshew spah kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , kiba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba u Solomon u la thaw .

translation.en: And he believed in the  Lord   ; and he counted it to him for righteousness .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shaniah ha U  Trai  ; bad namar kane , U  Trai  u la sngewbha ïa u bad u la pdiang ïa u .

translation.en: And after that came his brother out , and his hand took hold on Esau s heel  ; and his name was called Jacob : and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them .
translation.kha: Ïa uba ar la kha da kaba u batskhem triang ïa ka khongdong jat jong u Iso ; kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Jakob . U Isaak u la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa ki .

translation.en: When they couch in their dens , and abide in the covert to lie in wait ?
translation.kha: haba ki rieh ha la ki krem ne haba ki dem ban ap ha la ki krem ?

translation.en: The evil bow before the good  ; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin hap ban pyndem ha kiba hok bad kyrpad rit ïa ka jinglehisynei na ki .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear ye not , stand still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  , which he will shew to you to day : for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day , ye shall see them again no more for ever .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Wat sheptieng ! Ïeng skhem , bad phin sa ïohi aïu U  Trai  un leh mynta ka sngi ban pyllait im ïa phi ; lano lano ruh phin ym ïohi shuh ïa kine ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem , as against the gods of the people of the earth , which were the work of the hands of man .
translation.kha: Ki ïakren shaphang U Blei ka Jerusalem kumba ki ïakren shaphang ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , ki bleithaw ba la shna da ki kti ki briew .

translation.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes , and shave off all his hair , and wash himself in water , that he may be clean : and after that he shall come into the camp , and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days .
translation.kha: Uta u briew pat un sait ïa la ki jaiñ , un khi lut ïa la u shñiuh , bad un sum un sleh ; te un sa long uba khuid . U lah ban wan rung sha ka jaka shong dara , hynrei u dei ban shong shabar ka ïingjaiñ jong u hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: For the  Lord  shall judge his people , and repent himself for his servants , when he seeth that their power is gone , and there is none shut up , or left .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa la ki briew haba u ïohi ba kim donbor shuh . Un isynei ïa kito kiba shakri ïa u haba u ïohi ba kim lah leh ei ei shuh .

translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them .
translation.kha: Kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad ki jingmaham jong nga kim shym long ki jingbyrngem lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: While as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the highest part of the dust of the world .
translation.kha: shuwa ba U Blei un thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ïa ki pyntha jong ka , ne wat shi kham ka khyndew kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: For our comely parts have no need : but God hath tempered the body together , having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked :
translation.kha: U Blei hi da lade u la buh lang ïa ka met ha kata ka rukom ban kham ai burom ïa kito ki dkhot met kiba donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: And as they came down from the mountain , Jesus charged them , saying ,  Tell the vision to no man , until the Son of man be risen again from the dead .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lumbah , U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phi la ïohi tad haduh ba ïa U Khun U Briew la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: O foolish Galatians , who hath bewitched you , that ye should not obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth , crucified among you ?
translation.kha: A phi ki nong Galatia kiba bieit! Uei uba la pynthame ïa phi ? Ha khmat ki khmat jong phi hi la batai shai kdar ïa ka jingïap U Jisu Khrist halor ka diengphna!

translation.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest  ;
translation.kha: bad lada hadien , ha kata ka jaka ba mih u tohjaw , ka don ka jingat kaba lieh ne ka dak kaba byrsaw-lieh , u dei ban leit pyn-i ha u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Where are they ? where are thy wise men ? and let them tell thee now , and let them know what the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt .
translation.kha: Ko syiem Ijipt , shano kito ki nongai jingmut bashalak jong me ? Lehse ki lah ban ïathuh ha me ïa ki jingthmu jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kiba u don ïa ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And Hazar–gaddah , and Heshmon , and Beth–pelet ,
translation.kha: ka Hasar Gaddah , ka Heshmon , ka Bethpelet ,

translation.en: For I desired mercy , and not sacrifice  ; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa ka jingieit baneh jong phi , ym ka jingkñia da ki mrad . Nga kham kwah ba ki briew jong nga kin ithuh ïa nga ban ïa ki jingainguh thang sha nga .

translation.en: And he said unto me , This chamber , whose prospect is toward the south , is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the house .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka kamra kaba phai shaphang shathie ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba lehniam ha ka templ ,

translation.en: When thou beatest thine olive tree , thou shalt not go over the boughs again : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .
translation.kha: Haba phi la dep kheit ïa ki soh Olib shisien , wat leit kheit shuh ïa kito kiba dang sah ; kita ki dei ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .

translation.en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected , and is nigh unto cursing  ; whose end is to be burned .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka pynmih ïa ki shiah bad ïa ki ñiut , kam dondor ei ei ; ka don ha ka , ka jingma naba U Blei un tim bad pynjot da ka ding .

translation.en: Son of man , behold , I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke : yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep , neither shall thy tears run down .
translation.kha: Ko Khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  tang shi syntied ngan shim noh ïa u briew uba pha ieit eh . Pham dei ban wad daw lane ïam ne jaw ki ummat .

translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward , and bear fruit upward .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ha Judah kiba lait im kin roi kum ki jingthung kiba ki thied ki sam jylliew ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .

translation.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment  ; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee , saith the  Lord  thy Redeemer .
translation.kha: Nga la phai noh da ka jingbitar tang shipor , hynrei ngan pyn-i ha pha ïa ka jingieit jong nga junom .  Kumta u ong U  Trai  uba pynim ïa pha .

translation.en: Then I heard one saint speaking , and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake , How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice , and the transgression of desolation , to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei u angel uba kylli ïa uwei pat ,  Haduh katno kine kiei kiei kiba la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kin ïailong ? Haduh katno ka pop ba-ijli kan bujli ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ? Haduh katno ïa ka kynhun shipai ba kynja bneng bad ïa ka Templ yn kyrdem ?

translation.en: And the king said , Who is in the court ? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king s house , to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him .
translation.kha: Don mano mano na ki rangbah synshar jong nga ha ïingsyiem ?  u syiem u kylli . Mynta u Haman u dang shu rung ha phyllaw ; u la wan ban ong ïa u syiem ban sdien phasi ïa u Mordekai ha ka diengphasi kaba la dep pynkhreh .

translation.en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is : but when Christ cometh , no man knoweth whence he is .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba U Messaïah un wan , ym don ba tip na-ei ba u wan . Bad baroh ngi tip nangno une u briew u wan .

translation.en: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire  ; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land  ; thou shalt be no more remembered : for I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Yn pynjot ïa phi da ka ding . Ïa ka snam jong phi yn pynmih ha la ka ri , bad yn ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa phi .’   U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: Behold , I am according to thy wish in God s stead : I also am formed out of the clay .
translation.kha: Ma phi bad ma nga ngi long kumjuh ha khmat U Blei , ïa baroh ar ngut na ngi la thaw na ka dewmet .

translation.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables : because they seeing see not  ; and hearing they hear not , neither do they understand .
translation.kha: Ka daw ba nga pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ha kaba ïakren bad ki ka long ba ki peit , hynrei kim ïohi , bad ki shahshkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew lane shemphang .

translation.en: And they tied unto it a lace of blue , to fasten it on high upon the mitre  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksai uba jngum , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And after the earthquake a fire  ; but the  Lord  was not in the fire : and after the fire a still small voice .
translation.kha: Hadien u jumai , la wan ka ding — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha ka ding . Bad hadien ka ding , la wan ka sur kaba sawa jem jai jai .

translation.en: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury  ; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban kheiñ sut haba phi ai ram ïa u nongwei , ym haba phi ai ram ïa la u para Israel , ba kumta U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu kat ïa kaba phi leh ha kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .

translation.en: If thou hast any thing to say , answer me : speak , for I desire to justify thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi don ei ei ban ong , to ai ba ngan sngew ïa kata ; ngan pdiang da kaba sngewbha lada kaba phi ong ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria , and into the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael , all their days .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u bitar ïa ki Israel , bad u shah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria bad u khun jong u , u Benhadad ban jop ïa ki Israel na ka por sha ka por .

translation.en: And the children of Israel went away , and did as the  Lord  had commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit bad leh kumta kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen  ; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit , and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver : and they brought Joseph into Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki hynmen jong u ki ïamynjur , bad haba katto katne ki nongkhaïi na Midian ki ïaid lynti nangta , ki hynmen ki la sei noh ïa u Joseph na kata ka pukri bad ki la die noh ïa u ha kita ki nong Ishmael arphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad ki ruh ki la ïalam noh ïa u sha Ijipt .

translation.en: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword : though their terror was caused in the land of the living , yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit : he is put in the midst of them that be slain .
translation.kha: Ka Elam ka don hapdeng kito kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ki don ha baroh sawdong jong ka . Ki long baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad ki jahburom , ki ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar ryngkat bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , wrought with needlework .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ , thaw ïa ka pyrda kaba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad ba la suh pynpur itynnat bha .

translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel , and it shall be forgiven them  ; for it is ignorance : and they shall bring their offering , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord  , and their sin offering before the  Lord  , for their ignorance :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa ka kynhun , bad yn sa map ïa ki , namar ka jingbakla ka long kaba khlem da mut khnang bad ba ki la wallam ruh ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days  ; and caused the dayspring to know his place  ;
translation.kha: Ko Job , ha baroh ka jingim jong me , hato me la hukum ïa ka sngi haduh ka step ?

translation.en: If thou meet thine enemy s ox or his ass going astray , thou shalt surely bring it back to him again .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa ka masi ne ïa ka kada u nongshun jong phi ba ka ïaid sakma , leit ïalam pat ïa ka sha u .

translation.en: He's stronger than me .
translation.kha: U kham khlaiñ ban ianga .

translation.en: Then ye shall answer them , That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord   ; when it passed over Jordan , the waters of Jordan were cut off : and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever .
translation.kha: phin ïathuh ïa ki ba ka um jong ka Jordan ka la sangeh ban tuid haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka jam ïa ka wah . Kine ki maw kin ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki paid Israel shaphang kaei kaba la jia hangne .

translation.en: And finding disciples , we tarried there seven days : who said to Paul through the Spirit , that he should not go up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hangta ngi la shem katto katne ngut ki parabangeit bad ngi la sah bad ki shi taïew . Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem ki la ïathuh ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger  ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .
translation.kha: Lada phi long uba shemphang , phin lah ban kan ïa la ka jingbitar . Haba uno uno u leh bakla ïa phi , ka dei ka jinglong bakhraw ban leh klet ïa ka .

translation.en: So is this great and wide sea , wherein are things creeping innumerable , both small and great beasts .
translation.kha: Ka don ka duriaw-bah , kaba heh bad kaba ïar , ha kaba ki jingthaw bym lah ñiew shuh ki im , kiba rit bad kiba heh kumjuh .

translation.en: Shalt thou reign , because thou closest thyself in cedar ? did not thy father eat and drink , and do judgment and justice , and then it was well with him ?
translation.kha: Hato ka pynlong ïa me u syiem uba kham bha lada me tei ki ïing da ki dieng Kedar kiba kham kynsai ban ïa kito ki jong kiwei ? U kpa jong me u la im kyrhai , u long borabor uba hok bad uba leh beit , bad u manbha ha kiei kiei baroh ba u la leh .

translation.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ka ktien U Blei ka la nang phriang bad nang roi .

translation.en: And Samuel said unto Saul , I will not return with thee : for thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hath rejected thee from being king over Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leit phai bad phi ,  u Samuel u jubab .  Phi la kyntait ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad u la kyntait ïa phi kum u syiem ki Israel .

translation.en: Wherefore thou art great , O  Lord  God : for there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
translation.kha: Katno me long uba khraw ; A  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Ym don uwei pat uba kum ma me , ngi la ju tip ba dei tang ma me hi uba long U Blei .

translation.en: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea , even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters , saying , Go , ye swift messengers , to a nation scattered and peeled , to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden down , whose land the rivers have spoiled !
translation.kha: Na kata ka ri , ki nongkit  tiensyiem ki la wan arsut ïa ka Nile ha ki lieng ba la shna da ki khah . Khie noh sha ïing , ko nonglamktien bastet ! Rah noh ïa ka khubor sha ka ri jong phi kaba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah , sha ka jaitbynriew jong phi kaba khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , sha ki briew jong phi kiba jrong bad kiba jlih ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha kylleng ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time . If we love one another , God dwelleth in us , and his love is perfected in us .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba la ïohi ïa U Blei mynno mynno ruh , hynrei , lada ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat , U Blei u im hapoh jong ngi , bad ïa ka jingieit jong u la pynjanai noh ha ngi .

translation.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep .
translation.kha: Ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phah ïa ki sha ka  liewlong khlem trai .

translation.en: If thy whole body therefore be full of light , having no part dark , the whole shall be full of light , as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light .
translation.kha: Lada ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka dap da ka jingshai , khlem kano kano ka bynta jong ka ha kaba dum , kan long kaba phyrnai ha baroh , kum haba ka sharak ka tyngshaiñ ha phi da ka jingphyrnai jong ka .

translation.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan : and why did Dan remain in ships ? Asher continued on the sea shore , and abode in his breaches .
translation.kha: Ki jait Gad ki shongduh sha mihngi jong ka Jordan , Bad ki jait Dan ki ïai don ha ki lieng . Ki jait Asher ki shongduh harud ka duriaw , Ki ïai don harud ka duriaw .

translation.en: And every creature which is in heaven , and on the earth , and under the earth , and such as are in the sea , and all that are in them , heard I saying , Blessing , and honour , and glory , and power , be unto him that sitteth upon the throne , and unto the Lamb for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingthaw baroh ha bneng , ha khyndew , ha ka pyrthei shapoh , bad ha ka duriaw — baroh kiei kiei kiba im ha ka pyrthei — bad ki ïarwai :  Ha uta uba shong halor ka khet bad ha U Khunlangbrot , long ka jingïaroh bad ka jingpyndonburom , ka burom bad ka bor , junom la junom !

translation.en: He hath dispersed , he hath given to the poor  ; his righteousness endureth for ever  ; his horn shall be exalted with honour .
translation.kha: U ai kylluid ïa kiba kyrduh , bad ka jingbhasbun jong u kam ju duh ; un long uba donbor bad uba ïoh burom .

translation.en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt : for in her youth they lay with her , and they bruised the breasts of her virginity , and poured their whoredom upon her .
translation.kha: Ka ïai bteng na kaei kaba ka la sdang kum ka nuti ha Ijipt , hangta ha kaba la duh noh ïa la ka jinglong sotti . Naduh ka por ba ka long ka samla ba dang khynraw , ki rangbah ki la ïathiah bad ka bad leh ïa ka la kum ka nuti .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , to give you the land of Canaan , and to be your God .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan bad ban long U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And , lo , the angel of the Lord came upon them , and the glory of the Lord shone round about them : and they were sore afraid .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la mihpaw ha ki , bad ka burom jong U Trai ka la tyngshaiñ halor jong ki . Ki la sngewsheptieng shikatdei eh ,

translation.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you , and ye shall carry up my bones from hence .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u ong ïa la ki briew ban smai .  Kular ïa nga ,  u ong ,  ba ynda U Blei u ïalam noh ïa phi sha kata ka ri , phin rah lang ïa ka met jong nga nangne .

translation.en: Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .
translation.kha: Nga khmih lynti borabor ban im slem bad ban ïap ha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Ahas u khun jong u Jotham u long u syiem ka Judah ha ka rta kaba arphew snem , bad u synshar ha Jerusalem khathynriew snem .

translation.en: For the ships of Kittim shall come against him : therefore he shall be grieved , and return , and have indignation against the holy covenant : so shall he do  ; he shall even return , and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant .
translation.kha: Ki nong Rom kin wan ha ki liengbah bad kin pyrshah ïa u , bad un sa sheptieng .  Te un leit phai pat ha ka jingbitar shla bad un pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong U Blei . Un bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa kata ka niam .

translation.en: And he said unto the elders , Tarry ye here for us , until we come again unto you : and , behold , Aaron and Hur are with you : if any man have any matters to do , let him come unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki nongïalam ,  Ap ïa ngi hangne ha ka jaka sher dara tad ynda ngi wan phai . U Aaron bad u Hur ki don hangne bad phi ; bad kumta uno uno uba don kano kano ka jingïakajia ban pynbeit , u lah ban leit sha ki .

translation.en: And he answering said , Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy strength , and with all thy mind  ; and thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,   ‘ Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , bad da la ka mynsiem baroh , da la ka jingkhlaiñ baroh , bad da la ka jingmut baroh’ ; bad ‘ Ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .’

translation.en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame , and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem un long khlem bor ban ïarap ïa ki , bad ka jingïada ka Ijipt kan kut ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: Their land also is full of idols  ; they worship the work of their own hands , that which their own fingers have made :
translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki bleithaw , bad ki mane ïa kita kiba ki la shna da ki kti jong ki hi .

translation.en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost , The Lord said to my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand , till I make thine enemies thy footstool .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la pynkhih ïa u Dabid ban kren :   ‘ U Trai u la ong ïa U Trai jong nga ; shong hangne sha ka liang kamon jong nga haduh ba ngan da pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong me hapoh ki kjat jong me .’

translation.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving , and will call upon the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ka jingkñia ainguh bad ai ka jingduwai sha me .

translation.en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand :
translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un theh khyndiat ka umphniang ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these sayings , he departed from Galilee , and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u la mihnoh na Galilaïa bad u la leit sha ka thain Judia sha shiliang jong ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke , I will add to your yoke : my father hath chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki , ‘ I pa jong nga i la buh ha phi ïa ka jingkit kaba khia ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita , i pa i la shoh ïa phi da u riphin ; nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk !’

translation.en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it , about two thousand cubits by measure : come not near unto it , that ye may know the way by which ye must go : for ye have not passed this way heretofore .
translation.kha: Phim pat ju poi hangta mynshuwa , kumta kin pyn-i ha phi ka lynti ba phin leit . Hynrei wat leit sha jan ka Synduk ka Jutang ; pynjngai kumba shi kilomitar nadien jong ka .

translation.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven thousand horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ïohknieh shihajar tylli ki kali ïapom jong u , hynñiew hajar ngut ki nongshong kulai , bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . U buh ki kulai kat ban biang na ka bynta shispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad u pyndkoh noh ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings , the pransings of their mighty ones .
translation.kha: Nangta ki kulai kin wan ïaid , Ki da kyrdem ïa ka khyndew da ki poh jat jong ki .

translation.en: Or a charmer , or a consulter with familiar spirits , or a wizard , or a necromancer .
translation.kha: lane ban leh myntor , lane ban ïakren bad ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap .

translation.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u ka ju long kaba samla bad kaba khlaiñ , hynrei shen kan sa kylla pui pui .

translation.en: And , behold , there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew uba ki kjat bad ki kti jong u ki la sieb u la wan sha U Jisu ,

translation.en: And Elisha said unto them , This is not the way , neither is this the city : follow me , and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek . But he led them to Samaria .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u sha ki bad u ong ,  Phi la bakla lynti ; kane kam dei kata ka shnong kaba phi wad . Bud ïa nga , bad ngan ïalam ïa phi sha uta u briew ïa uba phi wad .  Bad u ïalam ïa ki sha Samaria .

translation.en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel  ; and they were also both of them his wives .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la shongkurim ïa ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad mynta ka Abigail ruh ka la long ka tnga jong u .

translation.en: But he shall say , I am no prophet , I am an husbandman  ; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth .
translation.kha: Pynban , un ong , ‘ Ngam dei u nongïathuhlypa . Nga long u nongrep — nga la rep ha ka khyndew baroh shi rta ka jingim jong nga .’

translation.en: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Beth–shemesh , and went along the highway , lowing as they went , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left  ; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Beth–shemesh .
translation.kha: Kita ki masi kynthei ki leit beit beit shaphang Beth Shemesh , bad khlem da phai na ka lynti ba ki leit , ki da pah artat katba ki dang leit . Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki bud nadien jong ki haduh u pud jong ka Beth Shemesh .

translation.en: And they brought him upon horses , and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah .
translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u la wan kit sha Jerusalem halor u kulai , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid .

translation.en: And spake unto him , saying , Tell us , by what authority doest thou these things ? or who is he that gave thee this authority ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , me donhok aïu ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?

translation.en: And he said unto me , Unto two thousand and three hundred days  ; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa uta uwei pat u angel ba u jubab ,  Kan ïailong haduh shi hajar shispah sanphew sngi , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia janmiet bad mynstep yn ym ai . Hadien kata yn sa pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Let them give glory unto the  Lord  , and declare his praise in the islands .
translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba shong ha ki ri bajngai kin ai ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And I said , Hear , I pray you , O heads of Jacob , and ye princes of the house of Israel  ; Is it not for you to know judgment ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel ! Phi la dei ban sngewkhia shaphang ka jingbishar hok ,

translation.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan the son of Saul , because of the  Lord s  oath that was between them , between David and Jonathan the son of Saul .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ka kular kaba kyntang kaba ma u bad u Jonathan ki la pynlong uwei ïa uwei pat , u Dabid u la pyllait ïa u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan bad u ksiew jong u Saul .

translation.en: And the third angel followed them , saying with a loud voice , If any man worship the beast and his image , and receive his mark in his forehead , or in his hand ,
translation.kha: U angel uba lai u la bud ïa ki ar ngut ki angel kiba sha khmat , da kaba kren ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Uno uno u mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad pdiang ïa ka shab ha ka shyllangmat jong u lane ha ka kti jong u ,

translation.en: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive , and her father s household , and all that she had  ; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day  ; because she hid the messengers , which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la pyllait im ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ka baroh , namar ba ka la pynrieh ïa ki ar ngut ki nongsyntiat kiba u la phah sha Jerikho . ( Ki khun ki ksiew jong ka ki shong ki sah ha Israel haduh kane ka sngi . )

translation.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge : for I have believed thy commandments .
translation.kha: To ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingtip , namar nga shaniah ha ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: If thou wilt return , O Israel , saith the  Lord  , return unto me : and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight , then shalt thou not remove .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko paid Israel , lada phi kwah ban wan phai , to wan phai noh sha nga . Lada phi shaniah ha nga bad weng noh ïa ki bleithaw kiba nga ijli ,

translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted to heaven , shalt be thrust down to hell .
translation.kha: Bad ïa pha , ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kwah ban kyntiew ïa lade shaduh sha bneng ? Yn bret ïa pha sha tbian sha dujok !

translation.en: Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh , and said , My father and my brethren , and their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have , are come out of the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , they are in the land of Goshen .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u leit ïalam san ngut na ki hynmen jong u sha u syiem . U ong ,  I pa bad ki hynmen ki para jong nga ki la wan na ka ri Kanaan ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot bad ki jingri jingdup jong ki , bad baroh ruh kat kiba ki don . Mynta ki don ha Goshen .

translation.en: And Isaac said unto them , Wherefore come ye to me , seeing ye hate me , and have sent me away from you ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u kylli ,  Balei ba phi wan sha nga mynta , haba phi la isih ïa nga mynshuwa bad ba phi la pynlong ïa nga ban mihnoh na ka ri jong phi ?

translation.en: Give , and it shall be given unto you  ; good measure , pressed down , and shaken together , and running over , shall men give into your bosom . For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again .
translation.kha: Ai ha kiwei , bad U Blei un ai ha phi . Da shisha , phin ïohpdiang ka jingthew kaba dap biang , ka jingai basbun , kaba la theh ha ki kti jong phi — baroh kata kaba phi lah ban bat . Ka jingthew kaba phi pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei ka long kata kaba U Blei un pyndonkam ïa phi .

translation.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael , by their names , according to their generations : the firstborn of Ishmael , Nebaioth  ; and Kedar , and Adbeel , and Mibsam ,
translation.kha: ka la ïoh ïa kine ki khun shynrang , ïa kiba la thoh ter ter kat kum ka sngi kha jong ki : u Nebaïoth , u Kedar , u Adbeel , u Mibsan ,

translation.en: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things , which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began .
translation.kha: U dei ban don ha bneng tad ynda ka poi ka por ha kaba yn thaw thymmai kiei kiei baroh , kumba U Blei u la pynbna lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u kiba la im slem bah mynshuwa .

translation.en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ha kine ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam , ki shynrang baroh ki dei ban wan mane ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And they all wept sore , and fell on Paul s neck , and kissed him ,
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïa-ïam haba ki la kdup ïa u bad ki la doh khublei ïakhlad bad u .

translation.en: And when we came to Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard : but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him .
translation.kha: Ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist

translation.en: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died . And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him , and wept over his face , and said , O my father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof .
translation.kha: U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la kem pang na ka jait jingpang kaba shyrkhei , bad katba u dang thiah sa ba un ïap u Jehoash u syiem Israel u leit jngoh ïa u .  Ko pa jong nga , pa jong nga !  u pyrta da kaba ïam .  Phi la long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong ka Israel !

translation.en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice , and cried  ; and the people wept that night .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet ki paidbah ki la kyang ha ka jingnoh mynsiem .

translation.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer , Ramath of the south . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki nongrit sawdong kine ki nongbah haduh ka Baalath Beer ( lane ka Ramah ) , ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Simeon ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have taken no bread .
translation.kha: Ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki hi ,  U ong ïa kane namar ngim shym la wanrah jingbam ei ei .

translation.en: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts , but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil  ; for thine olive shall cast his fruit .
translation.kha: Ki diengsoh Olib kin mih kyrhai ha ka ri jong phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh umphniang , naba ki soh Olib kin hap khlem por .

translation.en: Howl , O Heshbon , for Ai is spoiled : cry , ye daughters of Rabbah , gird you with sackcloth  ; lament , and run to and fro by the hedges  ; for their king shall go into captivity , and his priests and his princes together .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Heshbon , ki kyang ! Ïa ka Ai la pynjot ! Ki kynthei ka Rabbah , ki leit ïam sngewsih ! Ki phong ïa ki jaiñ khain bad ïam pangnud . Ki mareh lamwir . Ïa u Molekh u blei jong phi yn ïalam mraw , lem bad ki lyngdoh bad ki khun syiem .

translation.en: And there is hope in thine end , saith the  Lord  , that thy children shall come again to their own border .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen na ka bynta ka lawei jong phi ; ki khun jong phi kin wan phai pat sha la ka ri . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And immediately I was in the spirit : and , behold , a throne was set in heaven , and one sat on the throne .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , U Mynsiem u la shimti ïa nga . Hangta ha bneng la don ka khet bad la don uwei uba shong halor jong ka .

translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded the angel  ; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa u angel ban buh noh sharud ïa ka waitlam jong u , bad u angel u kohnguh .

translation.en: But I will remove far off from you the northern army , and will drive him into a land barren and desolate , with his face toward the east sea , and his hinder part toward the utmost sea , and his stink shall come up , and his ill savour shall come up , because he hath done great things .
translation.kha: Ngan weng ïa ka kynhun ki puit kaba la wan na shaphang shatei bad ngan pynphai katto katne na ki sha ka ri shyiap . Kito kiba don ha ki bynta ba ha khmat kin shah beh sha ka Duriaw Baïap , kito kiba don ha ka bynta ba hadien sha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Ki metïap jong ki kin iwtung . Ngan pynjot ïa ki namar baroh kaba ki la leh ïa phi .

translation.en: And they cried with a loud voice , saying , How long , O Lord , holy and true , dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth ?
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,  Ko Trai Badonbor Baroh , u bakhuid bad uba shisha ! Sa katno kan long haduh ba men da bishar ïa ki briew ha ka pyrthei bad pynshitom ïa ki namar ba ki pynïap ïa ngi ?

translation.en: The whole earth is at rest , and is quiet : they break forth into singing .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait bad ka jingsuk , bad uwei pa uwei u rwai da kaba kmen .

translation.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor , and Shahazimah , and Beth–shemesh  ; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan : sixteen cities with their villages .
translation.kha: U pud u kynjoh ruh ïa ka Tabor , ka Shahasumah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , u da kut noh ha ka Jordan . Ka kynthup khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern , which was shewed thee in the mount .
translation.kha: Da kitkhia ba men thaw ïa ki kat kum ka dur ba nga la pyn-i ha me ha une u lum .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Take me an heifer of three years old , and a she goat of three years old , and a ram of three years old , and a turtledove , and a young pigeon .
translation.kha: U te u ong ha u ,  Wanrah kawei ka masi , kawei ka blang , uwei u langbrot , kawei pa kawei na ki ka dei ban long kaba lai snem ka rta , bad kawei ka paro , bad kawei ka lyngdkhur .

translation.en: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers , and the Levites from twenty years old and upward , in their charges by their courses  ;
translation.kha: Ha ki lyngdoh la aiti ïa ki kam kat kum ki kur , bad ïa ki Lebi kiba arphew snem ka rta ne kham ïaw la aiti ha ki kat kum ki kynhun trei .

translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
translation.kha: Baroh kin shun ïa phi na ka bynta jong nga . Hynrei uta uba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , un ïohlait im .

translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also love those that love them .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa ki !

translation.en: If the wicked restore the pledge , give again that he had robbed , walk in the statutes of life , without committing iniquity  ; he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: kum ka nuksa , lada u pynphai noh ïa ka bynda ba u shim ïa ka ram lane u pynphai noh ïa kaei ba u la tuh — lada u sangeh kaba leh pop bad u bud ïa ki aiñ kiba ai jingim , un ym ïap hynrei un im .

translation.en: Servants , be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh , with fear and trembling , in singleness of your heart , as unto Christ ;
translation.kha: Ki mraw , to kohnguh ïa la ki kynrad da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkhynñiuh ; bad leh ïa ka da ka dohnud basngur , kumba phi shakri ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: Woe unto you , when all men shall speak well of you ! for so did their fathers to the false prophets .
translation.kha: Katno kaba shyrkhei haba baroh ki briew ki kren bha shaphang jong phi ; ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la kren ïa kijuh kiei kiei shaphang ki nongïathuhlypa lamler .

translation.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys , which run among the hills .
translation.kha: Me pynlong ïa ki umpohliew ban tuid sha ki them , bad ïa ki wah ba kin tuid hapdeng ki lum .

translation.en: And they cried out again , Crucify him .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta kylla ,  Sahnarphna ïa u !

translation.en: And they said unto him , Hold thy peace , lay thine hand upon thy mouth , and go with us , and be to us a father and a priest : is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man , or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel ?
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Sngap jar . Wat ang shikyntien ruh . Ale bad ngi bad long u lyngdoh bad u nongaibuit jong ngi . Hato phim kham lah ban long u lyngdoh ïa ka jait Israel baroh kawei ban tang ïa kawei ka longïing jong uwei u briew ?

translation.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .
translation.kha: Namar ba U Jisu Khrist u la leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa u ban leh , ïa ngi baroh la pynkhuid na ka pop da ka jingainguh kaba u la aiti ïa la ka jong ka met tang shisien hi .

translation.en: Grace to you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: This only would I learn of you , Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kane kawei : Hato phi pdiang ïa U Mynsiem U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei ba ka Hukum ka dawa ne da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad ngeit ïa ka ?

translation.en: Over against the border were the rings , the places for the staves to bear the table .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kita ki kyrwoh hajan ka rmiang ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah haba rah ïa ka .

translation.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers , wherewith they that were burnt had offered  ; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar :
translation.kha: Kumta u Eleasar u lyngdoh u la shim ïa ki khiew buh ding bad u phah shoh pynstang ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka duwan .

translation.en: And Jonathan answered Saul , David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem :
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U la kyrpad ïa nga ba ngan shah ïa u ban leit sha Bethlehem .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Joash u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: Light is sown for the righteous , and gladness for the upright in heart .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka tyngshaiñ ha kiba hok , bad ka jingkmen ha kiba bha .

translation.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them : but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi , hynrei kim shemphang ïa kaei kaba u la mut .

translation.en: And the daughter of any priest , if she profane herself by playing the whore , she profaneth her father : she shall be burnt with fire .
translation.kha: Lada ka khun jong u lyngdoh ka ïaid nuti , ka pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa ; yn thang ïa ka haduh ba kan da ïap .

translation.en: And he said , Now also let it be according unto your words : he with whom it is found shall be my servant  ; and ye shall be blameless .
translation.kha: U ruh u ong ,  Nga mynjur ïa kata , tangba tang uta uba shim ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga ; kiwei pat ki lah ban leit noh .

translation.en: And if thou deal thus with me , kill me , I pray thee , out of hand , if I have found favour in thy sight  ; and let me not see my wretchedness .
translation.kha: Lada me leh kumne ïa nga , to sngewsynei ïa nga bad pynïap noh ïa nga , khnang ba ngan ym hap shah shuh ïa kane ka jingleh badonbor jong me .

translation.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them  ; I will spend mine arrows upon them .
translation.kha: ‘ Ha ki ngan pynngat ïa ki jingpynjot bymkut shuh , ngan siat lut la ki khnam ha ki .

translation.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop , and dip it in the blood that is in the basin , and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the basin  ; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning .
translation.kha: Shim shi song u Hissop bad wieh ïa u ha ka pliang kaba don ïa ka snam jong uta u mrad , bad tah ïa kata ka snam ha ki shawkad bad ha u bim ha khlieh ka jingkhang ïing jong phi . Uwei ruh um bit ban mih shabar na ïing haduh mynstep .

translation.en: Howbeit I believed not the words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the half was not told me : thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la ngeit ïa ki tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi ïa ki da lade hi . Hynrei ngam shym la ïohsngew wat shiteng jong ka ; ka jingstad bad ka spah jong phi ki long kiba khraw shibun eh ban ïa kaei kaba la ïathuh ha nga .

translation.en: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man s hand , and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaster of the wall of the king s palace : and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan la mihpaw ka kti briew bad ka la sdang ban thoh ha ka kynroh ba la astor jong ka ïingsyiem , ha kaba ka jingshai na ki sharak ka shai phyrnai eh . Bad u syiem u la ïohi ïa ka kti katba ka dang thoh .

translation.en: For I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to save thee : though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee , yet will I not make a full end of thee : but I will correct thee in measure , and will not leave thee altogether unpunished .
translation.kha: Ngan wan sha phi bad pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan ym shah ïa phi ban leit khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan long u bym leh shiliang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear ; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption , whereby we cry , Abba , Father .
translation.kha: Namar U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ïa phi um pynlong ïa phi ki mraw bad pynlong ïa phi ban sheptieng ; pynban U Mynsiem u pynlong ïa phi ki khun jong U Blei , bad da ka bor U Mynsiem ngi pyrta sha U Blei jong ngi ,  Ko Kpa ! Ko Kpa jong nga !

translation.en: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly , and he was very angry .
translation.kha: U Jonah u la sngewsih haduh katta katta shaphang kane bad u la bitar .

translation.en: But ye say , Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother , It is a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei phi hikai ba lada u briew u don kaei kaei kaba u lah ban pyndonkam ban ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka jong U Blei ,’ um donkam ban burom ïa la u kpa .

translation.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ka shang , bad wanrah ïa ki sha nga ha ka por ba me kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw bad ïa ki ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang .

translation.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet : for his God gave him rest round about .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoshaphat u synshar ha ka jingsuk , bad U Blei u ai ha u ka jingshongshngain ha ki liang baroh .

translation.en: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel , where he sojourned , and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose  ;
translation.kha: Uno uno u Lebi uba don ka jingkwah , u lah ban wan na kano kano ka shnong ha Israel sha kata ka jaka mane Blei

translation.en: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them , and fled by the way of the wilderness .
translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u ki leh mynleh kumba phai dien , bad ki phet sha ka jaka bashrah .

translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba baroh ki briew na shaphang shatei ka Israel ki la ïalumlang ban thung syiem ïa u .

translation.en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father  ; and he felt him , and said , The voice is Jacob s voice , but the hands are the hands of Esau .
translation.kha: U Jakob u tur kham sha jan u kpa jong u , uba la ktah ïa u bad u ong ,  Ka sur te kum ka sur jong u Jakob , hynrei ki kti jong me pat ki long kum ki kti jong u Iso .

translation.en: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa u Ampliatos , u paralok ba-ieit jong nga ha ka jingïasyllok U Trai .

translation.en: And all the men of his house , born in the house , and bought with money of the stranger , were circumcised with him .
translation.kha: ryngkat bad ki mraw baroh jong u Abraham .

translation.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour  ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year  ; they shall be unto you without blemish :
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die ? saith the Lord  God  : and not that he should return from his ways , and live ?
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga kmen ban ïohi ba ki briew kiba sniew ki ïap ?  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u kylli .  Em , nga kham mon ban ïohi ïa ki ba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki im .

translation.en: And his concubine played the whore against him , and went away from him unto her father s house to Beth–lehem–judah , and was there four whole months .
translation.kha: hynrei ka la bitar ïa u , ka leit phai pat sha ïing u kpa jong ka ha Bethlehem , bad ka sah hangta saw bnai .

translation.en: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ , so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki kynthei ki dei ban aiti lut ha ki tnga jong ki kumba ka balang ka aiti ïa lade ha U Khrist .

translation.en: Let not the swift flee away , nor the mighty man escape  ; they shall stumble , and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mareh stet kim shym lah ban phet ; ki shipai kim shym lah ban lait . Ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis , ki jynthut bad ki kyllon .

translation.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him , Rabbi , thou art the Son of God  ; thou art the King of Israel .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  la jubab u Nathanael ,  me long U Khun U Blei ! Me long u Syiem ki Israel !

translation.en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun  ; and he cried with a loud voice , saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven , Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha ka sngi . U la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ïa ki sim baroh kiba her ha shiteng suiñ :  Ale bad ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingkhawai kaba khraw jong U Blei !

translation.en: He is swift as the waters  ; their portion is cursed in the earth : he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew uba sniew la rong noh ha ka jingshlei , bad ka jaka kaba u long trai ka don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ; um leit shuh ban trei ha la ki bri sohwaiñ .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Away , get thee down , and thou shalt come up , thou , and Aaron with thee : but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the  Lord  , lest he break forth upon them .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit hiar , bad wan ïalam pat bad me ïa u Aaron . Hynrei ki lyngdoh bad ki briew kim bit ban jam ïa u pud ban wan sha nga , ïoh nga pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: The way of life is above to the wise , that he may depart from hell beneath .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki ïaid ha ka lynti kaba ïalam artet sha ka jingim , ym ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam arsut sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la lyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ong ,  Kumno une u briew u tip katne katne haba um pat ju ïoh jinghikai ei ei ?

translation.en: And others save with fear , pulling them out of the fire  ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh .
translation.kha: to pyllait im ïa kiwei , da kaba knieh kynthet ïa ki na ka ding ; bad ïa kiwei pat , to isynei da ka jingsheptieng , hynrei to da isih ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki hi , kiba la bit tngit da ki jingkwah brai bapop .

translation.en: And their eyes were opened  ; and Jesus straitly charged them , saying ,  See that no man know it .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka jingïohi jong ki la pynïoh pat . U Jisu u la maham jur ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh ïa kane hano hano ruh !

translation.en: And if the plague come again , and break out in the house , after that he hath taken away the stones , and after he hath scraped the house , and after it is plastered  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang ha kata ka ïing hadien ba la weng noh ïa kita ki maw bad hadien ba la khrud bad la ñiad astor thymmai ruh ïa ka , u lyngdoh un leit khmih bha ïa ka .

translation.en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains , and upon every high hill : yea , my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth , and none did search or seek after them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki langbrot jong nga ki ïaid sakma sha ki lumrit bajrong bad ki lumbah . La pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ka pyrthei , bad ym don ba ïit ïa ki ne pyrshang ban wad ïa ki .

translation.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip , saying , Arise , and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza , which is desert .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la ong ha u Philip ,  To khreh bad leit shaphang shathie sha kata ka lynti kaba leit na Jerusalem sha Gasa .  ( Kane ka long ka lynti ka bym ju pyndonkam shuh mynta . )

translation.en: This man went unto Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Pilat bad pan ïa ka met jong U Jisu .

translation.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just , and desired a murderer to be granted unto you  ;
translation.kha: U la long uba khuid bad uba bha , hynrei phi la kyntait ïa u , bad pynban phi la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ban pyllait ïa u nongpynïap briew .

translation.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , and said unto them , Blessed be ye of the  Lord  , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord , even unto Saul , and have buried him .
translation.kha: u la phah shata katto katne ngut ki rangbah lem bad kane ka khubor :  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi namar ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jingieit ïa la u syiem da kaba tep ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , I set before you this day a blessing and a curse  ;
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha phi ïa ka jingjied hapdeng ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim —

translation.en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , and knew the knowledge of the most High , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
translation.kha: Uba lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u ong , Bad uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip kaba wan na U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: And they called them , and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khot biang ïa ki shapoh bad ki la ong ïa ki ba kim dei da lei lei ban kren lane hikai ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu .

translation.en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace ! O Judah , keep thy solemn feasts , perform thy vows : for the wicked shall no more pass through thee  ; he is utterly cut off .
translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nonglamktien u wan halor ki lumbah lem bad ka khubor kaba bha ! U don ha la ka lynti ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop ! Ko ki paid Judah , to rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi bad to ai ha U Blei ïa kaei kaba phi la kular kyntang ha u . U bymman da lei lei ruh un ym hiarthma shuh ïa ka ri jong phi . La pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh !

translation.en: They turn the needy out of the way : the poor of the earth hide themselves together .
translation.kha: Ki khanglad ïa kiba duk ba kin ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki bad pynbor ïa kiba kyrduh ban phet rieh .

translation.en: And of his fulness have all we received , and grace for grace .
translation.kha: Na ka jingdap jong ka jingaiei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi baroh , da kaba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingkyrkhu kawei hadien kawei pat .

translation.en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head , and chains about thy neck .
translation.kha: Ki jinghikai jong ki kin pynbha ïa ka jinglong jong phi kum ka jaiñspong kaba ishongkhia ha ka khlieh jong phi , lane kum u jingdeng uba pyniphuh ïa ka dur jong phi .

translation.en: For the sins of her prophets , and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jia namar ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka ki la leh pop bad ki lyngdoh jong ka ki long kiba la rem namar ka jingpynjia ïa ka jingïap jong ki briew balui lui .

translation.en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal .
translation.kha: La pynpaw ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Mynsiem ha kano kano ka rukom ha uwei pa uwei na ka bynta ka jingbha ïa baroh .

translation.en: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit  ; through deceit they refuse to know me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki ïalam bakla ïa la ki paralok , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ; ki la hikai ïa la ki thylliej ban lamler bad kin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingleh pop jong ki . Ki leh ïa kawei ka jingleh jubor hadien kawei pat , bad kawei ka jingleh shukor ka bud ïa kawei pat . U  Trai  u ong ba ki briew jong u ki kyntait ïa u .

translation.en: I will feed them in a good pasture , and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be : there shall they lie in a good fold , and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ba kin bam phlang da ka jingsngewshngain ha ki jaka phlang u lumbah bad ki them bad ha ki jaka phlang bajyrngam jong ka ri Israel .

translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying , I am the  Lord  : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me .

translation.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck , behold , it was dead : but when I had considered it in the morning , behold , it was not my son , which I did bear .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , haba nga la khie thiah bad sa ban ai buiñ ïa la u khun , nga ïohi ba u la ïap . Nga la khmih bniah hajan bad nga shem pynban ba um dei u khun jong nga .

translation.en: And Joab answered , The  Lord  make his people an hundred times so many more as they be : but , my lord the king , are they not all my lord s servants ? why then doth my lord require this thing ? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?
translation.kha: U Joab u jubab ,  To U  Trai  un pynroi bun ïa ki paid Israel shispah shah ban ïa kaba ki long mynta ! Syiem Kynrad , ki baroh ki dei ki shakri jong phi . Balei phi kwah ban leh ïa kane bad pynkit pop ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ?

translation.en: Some had been dead for a short while , but one had been in a tomb for four days ! —John 11 :39-44 .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki la ïap tang shiphang , hynrei uwei na ki u la don ha jingtep la saw sngi .—Ioannis 11 :39-44 .

translation.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed : for the  Lord  dwelleth in Zion .
translation.kha: Ngan pynhiarkput na ka bynta kito kiba la shah pynïap ; ngan ym map ïa kiba leh kam sniew . Hynrei ha Judah bad Jerusalem yn don ki nongshong shnong junom , bad ma nga U  Trai  , ngan shong ha u lum Seïon .

translation.en: And they said unto him , We can . And Jesus said unto them ,  Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of  ; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized :
translation.kha: Ngi lah ,  ki la jubab . U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Da shisha phin sa dih na ka khuri kaba nga dei ban dih bad ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba dei ban pynbaptis ïa nga .

translation.en: Now therefore , our God , we thank thee , and praise thy glorious name .
translation.kha: Mynta ko Blei jong ngi , ngi ainguh ïa me , bad ngi ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba donburom jong me .

translation.en: Now when every maid s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus , after that she had been twelve months , according to the manner of the women , ( for so were the days of their purifications accomplished , to wit , six months with oil of myrrh , and six months with sweet odours , and with other things for the purifying of the women  ; )
translation.kha: Ka jingai jingsumar man ka por na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki kynthei ka neh shisnem — ki jingkhem met da ka umphniang mirr na ka bynta hynriew bnai bad da ka umphniang balsam sa hynriew bnai . Hadien kata , ïa kawei pa kawei ka samla yn ïalam kawei hadien kawei sha u syiem Serksis .

translation.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , which she had born unto Abraham , mocking .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Ishmael ïa uba ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt ka la kha na ka bynta u Abraham , u dang ïalehkai bad u Isaak , u khun jong ka Sarah .

translation.en: And the ass said unto Balaam , Am not I thine ass , upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day ? was I ever wont to do so unto thee ? And he said , Nay .
translation.kha: Ka kada ka phai ktien ,  Hato ngam dei kajuh ka kada ha kaba phi la ju shong baroh shi rta haduh mynta ? Hato nga la ju leh kumne ïa phi ?   Em ,  u jubab .

translation.en: The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked : who can know it ?
translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban shemphang ïa ka dohnud briew ? Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba shukor katta katta ; ka pang jur eh ban ïa kaba ïoh jingkoit .

translation.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven : for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good , and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust .
translation.kha: khnang ba phi lah ban long ki khun jong U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng . Namar u pynlong ïa ka sngi kaba u la thaw ban tyngshaiñ ha ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba bha kumjuh , bad u ai slap ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha bad ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: We have heard the pride of Moab , ( he is exceeding proud ) his loftiness , and his arrogancy , and his pride , and the haughtiness of his heart .
translation.kha: Ka Moab ka sarong palat ! Nga la ïohsngew katno ka jingsarong , ka jingsngewbiang ki briew ki long , katno ki pyrkhat shaphang ïa lade .

translation.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates  ; he hath blessed thy children within thee .
translation.kha: U pynskhem ïa ki khyrdop jong phi ; u kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the  Lord  , as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: bad u la kit sha Babilon ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ha ka Templ bad ïingsyiem . Kumba U  Trai  u la ïathuhlypa , u Nebukhadnessar u la pynpait ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ksiar kiba u syiem Solomon u la thaw na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness , and righteousness remain in the fruitful field .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka ri , ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok , yn pyndep .

translation.en: He cried aloud , and said thus , Hew down the tree , and cut off his branches , shake off his leaves , and scatter his fruit : let the beasts get away from under it , and the fowls from his branches :
translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ka sur bajam , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad khet noh ïa ki tnat jong u ; sloit ïa ki sla jong u bad pynsaphriang ïa ki soh jong u . Beh noh ïa ki mrad napoh jong u bad ïa ki sim na ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: O Lord , I beseech thee , let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant , and to the prayer of thy servants , who desire to fear thy name : and prosper , I pray thee , thy servant this day , and grant him mercy in the sight of this man . For I was the king s cupbearer .
translation.kha: To shahshkor mynta ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad ïa ki jingduwai jong baroh kiwei pat ki shakri jong me kiba kwah ban ai ïa me ka burom . Ai ïa ka jingjop mynta ka sngi bad pynlong ba u patsha un leh-isynei ïa nga .  Ha kita ki sngi nga la long u nongrah waiñ jong u patsha .

translation.en: It shall be health to thy navel , and marrow to thy bones .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , kan long kum ka dawai kaba bha , kaba pynkoit ïa ki jingmong jong phi bad pynjem ïa ki jingpang jong phi .

translation.en: Then answered one of the people , and said , Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day . And the people were faint .
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na ki rangbah u ong ha u ,  Ngi baroh ngi la tlot na ka jingthngan , hynrei i pa jong phi i la byrngem ïa ngi bad ong , ‘ Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam ei ei mynta ka sngi .’

translation.en: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face , and worshipped Daniel , and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him .
translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la dem khrup ha khyndew bad u la ai hukum na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh kiba dei ban ai ïa u Daniel .

translation.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God , and without a teaching priest , and without law .
translation.kha: Slem bah ki Israel ki la im khlem U Blei uba shisha , khlem ki lyngdoh ban hikai ïa ki , bad khlem ka hukum .

translation.en: And he overlaid the boards with gold , and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars , and overlaid the bars with gold .
translation.kha: Ki suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki jingker , bad ki pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban batskhem ïa kita ki diengkhap . Ïa kita ki diengkhap ruh la suit da ka ksiar .

translation.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel :
translation.kha: U Moses u ai ïa ki hukum bad ki jinghikai jong U Blei ha ki Israel .

translation.en: How then comfort ye me in vain , seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood ?
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ! Phi pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga ha ka jingbieit ! Baroh ka jubab ba phi ai ka long ka jingshukor !

translation.en: And the passover , a feast of the Jews , was nigh .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan .

translation.en: And they made signs to his father , how he would have him called .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki la ai dak ïa u kpa jong u , da kaba kyrpad ïa u kaei ka kyrteng u mon ba u khynnah un don .

translation.en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee : so will I destroy thy cities .
translation.kha: Ngan pynpra phom ïa ki dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah ha ka ri jong phi bad ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong phi .

translation.en: For this cause have I sent unto you Timothy , who is my beloved son , and faithful in the Lord , who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ , as I teach every where in every church .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu nga phah ha phi ïa u Timothi , uba long u khun ba-ieit bad baïaineh jong nga ha ka jingim kum uba ngeit . Un pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ki nongrim kiba nga bud ha ka jingim kaba thymmai ha U Khrist Jisu bad kaba nga hikai ha ki balang baroh kiba don kylleng .

translation.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure .
translation.kha: Mem shym la sngewbha ïa ki mrad kum ka jingainguh thang halor ka duwan lane ïa ki jingkñia ban shim noh ïa ki pop .

translation.en: But if not , let fire come out from Abimelech , and devour the men of Shechem , and the house of Millo  ; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem , and from the house of Millo , and devour Abimelech .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , ai ba ka ding kan mihnoh na u Abimelekh bad kan bam duh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo . Ai ba ka ding kan mih na ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo bad kan thang duh ïa u Abimelekh .

translation.en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard , and shall be removed like a cottage  ; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it  ; and it shall fall , and not rise again .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei hi kan khih kum u nongbuaid bad khih shane bad shatai kum ka ïingtrep ha ka  erïong . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynkhia da ki pop jong ka ; kan khyllem bad kan ym lah khie khlieh shuh .

translation.en: And , behold , the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom  ; and the earth did quake , and the rocks rent  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ïa ka pyrda kaba la wah hapoh ka Templ la kad arliang naduh khlieh haduh tbian . Ka khyndew ka la khynñiuh , ki mawsiang ki pra la ka jong ka jong ,

translation.en: The mountains melted from before the  Lord  , even that Sinai from before the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki khynñiuh ha khmat U  Trai  jong u Lum Sinai , Ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And Saul was afraid of David , because the  Lord  was with him , and was departed from Saul .
