translation.kha: U Saul u sheptieng ïa u Dabid namar ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u Dabid hynrei U la kynriah noh na u Saul .

translation.en: And all that sat in the council , looking stedfastly on him , saw his face as it had been the face of an angel .
translation.kha: Kita baroh kiba shong ha ka Dorbar ki la khmih shlip ha u Stephan bad ki la ïohi ba ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka durkhmat jong u angel .

translation.en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by , and said to Peter , Surely thou also art one of them  ; for thy speech bewrayeth thee .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba ki rangbah kiba ïeng hangta ki la ïawan sha u Petros .  Da shisha me long uwei na ki ,  ki la ong .  Nalor baroh , ka rukom kren jong me ka pynpaw ïa kata !

translation.en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar : but the breast shall be Aaron s and his sons .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un thang ïa kata ka khleiñ ha ka duwan , hynrei kata ka shadem kan dei jong ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .
translation.kha: bad u la kren biang ha u haba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem . Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la kren ha u bun bunsien , tad haduh ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah . Ha u bnai uba san jong kata ka snem , ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem la ringmraw noh .

translation.en: For even thy brethren , and the house of thy father , even they have dealt treacherously with thee  ; yea , they have called a multitude after thee : believe them not , though they speak fair words unto thee .
translation.kha: Wat ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me , ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong me hi , ki la shetkylla ïa me ; ki la ïasoh ha ki jingtur ïaleh pyrshah ïa me . Wat shaniah ïa ki , wat la ki kren ki ktien sngewieit .

translation.en: And he shall break down the house , the stones of it , and the timber thereof , and all the mortar of the house  ; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place .
translation.kha: Dei ban lied noh ïa ka , bad ïa ki maw , ki dieng , bad ka sorki jong ka baroh dei ban kit shabar shnong bad bret ha ka jaka theh ñiut .

translation.en: And they shall pass through it , hardly bestead and hungry : and it shall come to pass , that when they shall be hungry , they shall fret themselves , and curse their king and their God , and look upward .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïaid sakma lyngba ka ri , kiba la noh mynsiem bad thngan . Ha ka jingthngan bad jingbitar jong ki , kin tim ïa u syiem jong ki bad ïa U Blei jong ki . Ki lah ban khmih sha ka sahit bneng

translation.en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria , and Israel served for a wife , and for a wife he kept sheep .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kpa tymmen jong ngi u la dei ban phet ïap sha Mesopotamia , ha kaba , ban ïoh ïa ka tnga , u trei na ka bynta ïa uwei u briew bad sumar ïa ki langbrot jong u .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them , and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about , so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u la shah ïa ki nonglute ban tur ïaleh bad lute ïa ki . U shah ïa ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong ki ban thombor ïa ki , bad ki Israel kim lah shuh ban ïada ïa lade .

translation.en: Nicodemus saith unto him , How can a man be born when he is old ? can he enter the second time into his mother s womb , and be born ?
translation.kha: Kumno lah ban kha pat ïa u briew uba la rangbah ?  U Nikodemos u la kylli .  Kam lah ban long ba un rung shapoh ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u bad ban kha sa shisien !

translation.en: He said unto him ,  What is written in the law ? how readest thou ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Aïu ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ? Kumno me batai ïa ki ?

translation.en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , thou hast nothing to draw with , and the well is deep : from whence then hast thou that living water ?
translation.kha: Ko kynrad ,  kata ka briew ka la ong ,  mem don ïa ka jingtong , bad ka pukri ka long kaba jylliew . Nangno men ïoh ïa kata ka um kaba ai jingim ?

translation.en: They compassed me about  ; yea , they compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
translation.kha: Ki la don sawdong jong nga ha ki liang baroh ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U  Trai  !

translation.en: And the four angels were loosed , which were prepared for an hour , and a day , and a month , and a year , for to slay the third part of men .
translation.kha: La pyllait noh ïa kita ki saw ngut ki angel ; na ka bynta kane hi ka kynta jong kane hi ka sngi jong une hi u bnai bad ka snem ïa ki la buh pynkhreh ban pynïap noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bynriew baroh .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will punish the king of Babylon and his land , as I have punished the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ma nga U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad ïa ka ri jong u , kumba nga la pynshitom ïa u patsha ka Assyria .

translation.en: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne , saying , Amen  ; Alleluia .
translation.kha: Ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang bad ki saw tylli ki kherub ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , uba la shong ha ka khet . Ki la ong ,  Amen ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei !

translation.en: And this is the law of the meat offering : the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the  Lord  , before the altar .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh bam . U lyngdoh na ki khun shynrang u Aaron un wallam ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  ha khmat ka duwan .

translation.en: ( The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them  ; ) he was of Arimathaea , a city of the Jews : who also himself waited for the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph na Arimathaïa , ka shnong kaba ha Judia . U la long u briew uba bha bad uba donburom , uba la apkhmih ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Wat la u long u dkhot jong ka Dorbar , um shym la mynjur bad ka jingrai bad jingleh jong ki .

translation.en: My son , keep my words , and lay up my commandments with thee .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga kren , bad wat ju klet ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart , she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines , saying , Come up this once , for he hath shewed me all his heart . Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and brought money in their hand .
translation.kha: Haba ka Delilah ka sngewthuh ba u la ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha , ka phah ktien sha ki syiem Philistia bad ka ong ,  Wan biang sa shisien . U la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingshisha .  Kumta ki la ïawan bad ki wanrah artat ïa ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people ? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred ?
translation.kha: Kumno ngan lah ban shah ïa ka lada kane ka jingjot ka wan hap ha ki briew jong nga , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga ki shah pynïap ?

translation.en: And when the people were gathered thick together , he began to say ,  This is an evil generation : they seek a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given it , but the sign of Jonas the prophet .
translation.kha: Katba ki briew ki dang ïalum sawdong ïa U Jisu , u la bteng ban kren ,  A katno kiba sniew long ki briew jong kane ka juk ! Ki dawa ïa ka kambah , hynrei yn ym ai kano kano ha ki , lait tang ka kambah u Jonah .

translation.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land , and upon my mountains tread him under foot : then shall his yoke depart from off them , and his burden depart from off their shoulders .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Assyria ha ka ri Israel jong nga bad ngan kyrdem halor jong ki lumbah jong nga . Ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong nga na ka lyngkor jong ki nong Assyria bad na ki jingkit kiba ki don ban bah .

translation.en: They said unto him , Grant unto us that we may sit , one on thy right hand , and the other on thy left hand , in thy glory .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  Haba men shong halor ka khet jong me ha ka Hima kaba dap da ka burom jong me , ngi kwah ba men shah ïa ngi ban shong bad me , uwei sha kamon jong me bad uwei sha kadiang jong me .

translation.en: Why sayest thou , O Jacob , and speakest , O Israel , My way is hid from the  Lord  , and my judgment is passed over from my God ?
translation.kha: Ko Israel , balei te ba me mudui ba U  Trai  um tip ïa ki jingjynjar jong me lane ïa ki jingkhuslai lada me shahshitom bymdei ?

translation.en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep , and sent to Balaam , and to the princes that were with him .
translation.kha: ha kaba u Balak u la pynïap ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot , bad u phah rah de katto katne ka doh sha u Balaam bad kita ki nongïalam kiba ïadon lem bad u .

translation.en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .
translation.kha: kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad kiba knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta kiba pyn-i paidbah da kaba duwai jlan ! Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba kham shyrkhei !

translation.en: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her , and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la mihnoh ban leit tam kew , u Boas u hukum ïa ki nongtrei ,  Shah ïa ka ban tam wat na ka jaka ha kaba ki song ki don , bad wat ong ei ei ban khang ïa ka . Nalor kata , sei ruh katto katne ki kew na ki song bad ieh ïa ki ba kan ïoh tam .

translation.en: And in the vine were three branches : and it was as though it budded , and her blossoms shot forth  ; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes :
translation.kha: Mar ïasdang mih sla , ki syntiew ki la mih , bad ki sohwaiñ ki la ih .

translation.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved , what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness ,
translation.kha: Namar ba ïa kine kiei kiei baroh yn pynjot ha kane ka rukom , ki briew kiba kumno phi dei ban long ?

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  I have told you that I am he : if therefore ye seek me , let these go their way :
translation.kha: Nga la lah ïathuh ha phi ba dei ma nga uta ,  U Jisu u la ong .  Te , lada phi ïawad ïa nga , shah ba kine kiwei kin leit noh .

translation.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled , that thus it must be ?
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka long kumta , da kumno ki Jingthoh Bakhuid kiba ong ba kane ka long kaei kaba dei ban jia , kin jia long shisha ?

translation.en: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver  ; nor he that loveth abundance with increase : this is also vanity .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka pisa da lei lei ruh phin ym ïoh jinghun , lada phi angnud ban riewspah , phin ym ïoh ïa baroh kaba phi kwah . Ka long ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea , and had life , died  ; and the third part of the ships were destroyed .
translation.kha: Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka duriaw la pynkylla snam , shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki jingthaw ba-im ha ka duriaw ki la ïap , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki lieng la shah pynjot .

translation.en: And ye shall eat in plenty , and be satisfied , and praise the name of the  Lord  your God , that hath dealt wondrously with you : and my people shall never be ashamed .
translation.kha: Mynta phin don kyrhai ban bam , bad phin sngewhun . Phin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la leh kiei kiei kiba phylla na ka bynta jong phi ki briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .

translation.en: If God be glorified in him , God shall also glorify him in himself , and shall straightway glorify him .
translation.kha: Bad lada ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba jong u , te U Blei un pynpaw ïa ka burom jong U Khun U Briew ha lade , bad un leh kumta kumne kumne .

translation.en: Yea , surely God will not do wickedly , neither will the Almighty pervert judgment .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh un ym leh ïa kaba sniew ; um ju leh bymdei ïano ïano .

translation.en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb : and if thou redeem him not , then shalt thou break his neck . All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem . And none shall appear before me empty .
translation.kha: uba la kha nyngkong da kaba phin ai pat da u khunlangbrot ha ka jaka jong u . Lada phim thied biang ïa u , pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Thied biang ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong jong phi .  Uno uno ruh , um dei ban wan ha khmat jong nga khlem ka jingainguh .

translation.en: But his delight is in the law of the  Lord   ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki shem jingkmen ha kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai

translation.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus , saying unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno me kwah ïa ngi ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong me ?

translation.en: And the sons of his brother Helem  ; Zophah , and Imna , and Shelesh , and Amal .
translation.kha: U Hotham u para jong u , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Sophah , u Imna , u Shelesh , bad u Amal .

translation.en: This Jesus hath God raised up , whereof we all are witnesses .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa une hi U Jisu na ka jingïap , bad ngi baroh ngi long ki sakhi ïa kane ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven ? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip ïa ki aiñ kiba synshar ïa ki suiñbneng , bad hato me lah ban pyndei ïa ki ha ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .
translation.kha: Ki longïing babun jong ka kur Gershon ki la ïohpdiang baroh khatlai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him , but disguised himself , that he might fight with him , and hearkened not unto the words of Neco from the mouth of God , and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Josaïah u kut jingmut ban ïaleh . U kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ong lyngba u syiem Neko , kumta u riam pher ïa lade bad u leit sha ka thma ha ka them jong ka Megiddo .

translation.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners : but be thou in the fear of the  Lord  all the day long .
translation.kha: Wat sngewbishni ïa ki briew kiba leh pop , ai ba ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  kan long ha khmat ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .
translation.kha: U la ong , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la jied ïa me ban tip ïa ka mon jong u , bad ban ïohi ïa U Shakri bahok jong u , bad ban ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka sur jong u hi .

translation.en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months . And the  Lord  blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that he had .
translation.kha: Ka don hangta haduh lai bnai , bad U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa ka longïing u Obed Edom bad baroh kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong u .

translation.en: With twelve hundred chariots , and threescore thousand horsemen : and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt  ; the Libyans , the Sukkiims , and the Ethiopians .
translation.kha: U Shishak u syiem ka Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba shihajar arspah tylli ki kali ïapom , hynriewphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad shibun ki shipai ban ïa kaba lah ban ïa kaba lah ban ñiew , kaba kynthup ïa ki nong Libya , ki Sukki , bad ki kynhun Sudan .

translation.en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and all his house died together .
translation.kha: Da kumta u Saul bad lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ki la ïap lang bad ym don uba na ki khun ki ksiew jong u kiba ïoh ban synshar .

translation.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness , in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran , and Tophel , and Laban , and Hazeroth , and Dizahab .
translation.kha: Ki ktien ha kane ka kitab ki long kito kiba u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel mynba ki don ha ka ri khlaw sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan . Ki ïadon ha ka Them Jordan hajan Suph , hapdeng ka shnong Paran ha kawei ka liang bad ki shnong Tophel , Laban , Haseroth , bad Disahab ha kawei pat ka liang .

translation.en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel , If it seem good unto you , and that it be of the  Lord  our God , let us send abroad unto our brethren every where , that are left in all the land of Israel , and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs , that they may gather themselves unto us :
translation.kha: Nangta u pynbna sha baroh ki paid Israel ,  Lada phi ai ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi bad lada ka dei ka mon U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , to ai ba ngin ïaphah nonglamktien sha kiwei pat ki para ri jong ngi bad sha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ha ki shnong jong ki , bad ïathuh ïa ki ban ïalumlang hangne bad ngi .

translation.en: Therefore take no thought , saying , What shall we eat ? or , What shall we drink ? or , Wherewithal shall we be clothed ?
translation.kha: Kumta wat khuslai : ‘ Nangno ka jingbam jong nga kan wan ? lane ka jingdih jong nga ? lane ki jaiñ jong nga ?’

translation.en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo , to the top of Pisgah , that is over against Jericho . And the  Lord  shewed him all the land of Gilead , unto Dan ,
translation.kha: U Moses u leit kiew na ri them Moab sha u Lum Nebo haduh kliar jong u Lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi na Jerikho , bad nangta U  Trai  u pyn-i ha u ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei : ka ri Gilead shaduh Dan kaba shaphang shatei ;

translation.en: ( 2 Peter 3 :13  ; Revelation 21 :3 , 4 ) So make it a family habit to study the Bible together !
translation.kha: ( 2 U Petros 3 :13 ; Jingpynpaw 21 :3 , 4 ) Kumta ia leh ban pynmlien ba ka ïng ka sem kan pule lang ia ka Baibl .

translation.en: And Jehu said , Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal . And they proclaimed it .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u hukum ,  Pynbna ïa ka sngi jong ka jingmane ban lehburom ïa u Baal !

translation.en: Then the king arose , and tare his garments , and lay on the earth  ; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ïeng joit , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , bad u lympat ïa lade ha khyndew . Ki shakri ruh kiba don hangta bad u ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ .

translation.en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself , and is not rich toward God .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kane ka long kumno kan jia ha kito kiba kynton ka spah na ka bynta ïa lade hynrei ki bym riewspah ha ka jingkhmih jong U Blei .

translation.en: And the sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister : and the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel .
translation.kha: U Asher bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah lem bad ka Serah ka para jong ki . Ki khun shynrang u Beraïah ki long u Heber bad u Malkhiel .

translation.en: Son of man , thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house , which have eyes to see , and see not  ; they have ears to hear , and hear not : for they are a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  me im hapdeng ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah . Ki don ki khmat , hynrei kim ïohi ei ei ; ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew ei ei , namar ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: I write not these things to shame you , but as my beloved sons I warn you .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi , ym namar ba nga kwah ban pynlehrain ïa phi , hynrei ban sneng ïa phi kum ki khun ba-ieit jong nga .

translation.en: And many more believed because of his own word  ;
translation.kha: Bun kiwei ki la ngeit namar ka khubor jong u bad ki la ong ha kata ka briew ,

translation.en: Either his uncle , or his uncle s son , may redeem him , or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him  ; or if he be able , he may redeem himself .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynmen ki para jong u lane u kñi jong u lane u bakha jong u lane uwei na ki kur bajan jong u , u lah ban thied biang ïa u ; lane lada u la ïoh kynshew haduh ban da biang , u hi u lah ban thied biang ïa la ka jinglaitluid .

translation.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom , as my Father hath appointed unto me  ;
translation.kha: bad kumba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ka bor ban synshar , kumta ngan ai ha phi ïa kajuh ka bor .

translation.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free , and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage .
translation.kha: Ka jinglaitluid ka long kaei kaba ngi don — dei U Khrist u la pyllait ïa ngi ! Ïeng te , kum ki briew kiba laitluid , bad wat shah ïa lade ban long pat ki mraw .

translation.en: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God , even our Father , at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhlaiñ ïa phi , bad phin long kiba janai bad kiba khuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi haba U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi u wan lem bad baroh kiba dei ki jong u .

translation.en: We have sinned , and have committed iniquity , and have done wickedly , and have rebelled , even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments :
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop , ngi la long kiba sniew , ngi la leh bakla . Ngi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba me la hukum ïa ngi ban leh bad ngi la phai noh na kaei kaba me la pyn-i ha ngi ba ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba . And when they had called him unto David , the king said unto him , Art thou Ziba ? And he said , Thy servant is he .
translation.kha: Don uwei u shakri uba kyrteng u Siba ha ka longïing jong u Saul , bad la bthah ïa u ban leit sha u Dabid .  Me dei u Siba ?  u syiem u la kylli .  Nga hangne , ko Kynrad ,  u jubab .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the king s word prevailed against Joab , and against the captains of the host . And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king , to number the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u pynlong ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u ; ki la mihnoh na khmat jong u bad ki la leit ban ñiew ïa ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And the residue of the number of archers , the mighty men of the children of Kedar , shall be diminished : for the  Lord  God of Israel hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Ki  rang bahryntieh ki long ki rangbah kiba shlur tam jong ka Kedar , hynrei tang khyndiat na ki yn iehnoh , nga U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la kren .

translation.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden , and wouldest forbear to help him , thou shalt surely help with him .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ba ka kada jong u ka kyllon namar ba ban ka jingkit , ïarap ban pynïeng pat ïa ka ; wat shu ïaid lait .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Why art thou wroth ? and why is thy countenance fallen ?
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ïa u Kain ,  Balei me bitar , bad balei ka durkhmat jong me ka kylla dur ?

translation.en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki lai ngut ki synran ki la ïohi ïa u Elijah bad ïa u Moses ba ki ïakren bad U Jisu .

translation.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised , that he is a debtor to do the whole law .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat nga maham ba uno uno u briew uba shah ïa lade ban otsher u pynbor ban kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of the year , that the host of Syria came up against him : and they came to Judah and Jerusalem , and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people , and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus .
translation.kha: Haba ka synrai ka la poi ha kata ka snem , ka kynhun shipai Syria ka la tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïalam baroh , bad ki la kit shibun ki mar lute sha Damaskos .

translation.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Syria jong ka Damaskos ki phah ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u syiem Hadadeser , u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u pynïap arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: In those days the multitude being very great , and having nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them ,
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien , u paidbah uba bun u la ïawanlang . Haba ki briew kim don ei ei shuh ban bam , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki synran sha u bad u la ong ,

translation.en: And labour , working with our own hands : being reviled , we bless ; being persecuted , we suffer it :
translation.kha: Haba la tim ïa ngi , ngi kyrkhu ; haba la pynshitom ïa ngi , ngi ïaishah ; haba la krenbeiñ ïa ngi , ngi pynphai kylliang da ki ktien kiba jem .

translation.en: Rise up , let us go  ; lo , he that betrayeth me is at hand .
translation.kha: Ïeng joit , ïa ngin ïaleit noh . Ha khmih , hangne u don u briew uba shetkylla ïa nga !

translation.en: And this will we do , if God permit .
translation.kha: To ngin ïa-ïaid shaphrang ! Bad kane ka long kaei kaba ngin leh , lada U Blei u shah .

translation.en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases , Abram drove them away .
translation.kha: Ki pukni ki wan hiar ha kita ki metïap , hynrei u Abram u beh noh ïa ki .

translation.en: Which commandeth the sun , and it riseth not  ; and sealeth up the stars .
translation.kha: U lah ban khang ïa ka sngi ba kan mih , bad ïa ki khlur ban tyngshaiñ mynmiet .

translation.en: Their visage is blacker than a coal  ; they are not known in the streets : their skin cleaveth to their bones  ; it is withered , it is become like a stick .
translation.kha: Mynta ki thiah khlem don batip ha ki lynti bah , ïa ki durkhmat jong ki la pynïong ha ka jingïap ; ka sniehdoh jong ki , ka tyrkhong kum ka dieng , ka la sti halor ki shyieng jong ki .

translation.en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar , the shittah tree , and the myrtle , and the oil tree  ; I will set in the desert the fir tree , and the pine , and the box tree together :
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki dieng Kedar ban mih ha ka jaka shyiap bad ki dieng Akasia bad ki dieng Martl bad ki dieng Olib . Bad ki khlaw kin mih ha ki jaka shrah ki khlaw dieng Kseh bad dieng Kseh-Juniper bad dieng Kseh-Sypress .

translation.en: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers : for they indeed killed them , and ye build their sepulchres .
translation.kha: Phi da lade hi phi phla , te , ba phi pdiang ïa kaei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh ; ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad phi tei ïa ki mot jingtep jong ki .

translation.en: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee , and to thy brethren , to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , that do after the will of your God .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba sah na ka bynta kano kano kaba ma phi bad ki para ri jong phi , phi kwah ban pyndonkam , kat kum ka mon U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory : but he that seeketh his glory that sent him , the same is true , and no unrighteousness is in him .
translation.kha: U briew uba kren ha la ka jong ka bor u pyrshang ban ïoh burom na ka bynta ïa lade hi . Hynrei uba wad ïa ka burom jong uta uba la phah ïa u , u long uba shida , bad ym don ka bymshisha ha u .

translation.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass .
translation.kha: ki la ïakylliang noh ïa ka burom jong U Blei bad ka dur jong u mrad uba bam phlang .

translation.en: As concerning the sons of Laadan  ; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan , chief fathers , even of Laadan the Gershonite , were Jehieli .
translation.kha: U Ladan , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Gershon , u dei u kpa tymmen jong shibun ki kynhun longïing , kynthup ïa ka longïing jong u Jehiel u khun jong u .

translation.en: And Israel said , Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me , as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother ?
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Balei keiñ phi pynjynjar sat ïa nga katne katne ba phi da ïathuh ha uta u briew ba phi don sa uwei u para ?

translation.en: Build you cities for your little ones , and folds for your sheep  ; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth .
translation.kha: Kumta tei ïa ki shnong jong phi bad ki jingker ïa ki langbrot jong phi , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaba phi la kular .

translation.en: There be three things which go well , yea , four are comely in going :
translation.kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei kiba ktah jur ïa ka jingmut haba peit ba ki ïaid :

translation.en: And ye will not come to me , that ye might have life .
translation.kha: Pynban phim mon ban wan sha nga khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not commit adultery :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Wat klim .’

translation.en: Make bright the arrows  ; gather the shields : the  Lord  hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes : for his device is against Babylon , to destroy it  ; because it is the vengeance of the  Lord  , the vengeance of his temple .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhih ïa ki syiem jong ka Media , namar u thmu ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia . Dei da kumta un siew kylliang namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka Templ jong u . Ki rangbah ai hukum ban tur ïaleh , ki hukum ,  Pynnep ïa ki khnam jong phi ! Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi !

translation.en: Who hath woe ? who hath sorrow ? who hath contentions ? who hath babbling ? who hath wounds without cause ? who hath redness of eyes ?
translation.kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa uno uno uba dih kyrni , uba pyrshang katto katne ka jingdih bathymmai , bad nga pyn-i ïa phi ïa uwei uba kordit bad sngewsih na ka bynta ïa lade , uba pynmih jingeh borabor , bad uba khñium borabor .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; nga la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt ban long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , What seest thou , Jeremiah ? And I said , Figs  ; the good figs , very good  ; and the evil , very evil , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , me ïohi aïu ?  Nga jubab ,  Ki soh Dumbur . Kiwei kiba bha ki da bha shisha , bad kiwei kiba sniew ki da sniew shisha , haduh ba ym long bam shuh .

translation.en: And mine eye shall not spare thee , neither will I have pity : but I will recompense thy ways upon thee , and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha , ne pyn-i jingisynei ei ei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha na ka bynta ki kam ba-ijli kiba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation : every one that goeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka jingpynjot ka ban wan hap ha ka Edom kan long kaba da shyrkhei haduh ba kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad sheptieng .

translation.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah , according to the commandment of the  Lord  to Joshua , even the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua , la ai shi bynta na ka jaka jong ka Judah ha u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh , na ka jait Judah . U la ïohpdiang ïa ka Hebron , ka nongbah kaba dei jong u Arba , u kpa jong u Anak .

translation.en: And their coast was Jazer , and all the cities of Gilead , and half the land of the children of Ammon , unto Aroer that is before Rabbah  ;
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka kynthup ïa ka Jaser bad ki nongbah baroh jong ka Gilead , shiteng na ka ri ki Ammon haduh Aroer , kaba ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Rabbah ;

translation.en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day : for Saul had adjured the people , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening , that I may be avenged on mine enemies . So none of the people tasted any food .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la tlot na ka jingthngan ha kata ka sngi , namar u Saul , da ka jingsmai kyntang , u la ai hukum :  Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam kano kano ka jingbam mynta ka sngi ha shuwa ba ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong nga .  Kumta ym don uwei ruh na ki uba bam ei ei baroh shi sngi .

translation.en: Who is wise , and he shall understand these things ? prudent , and he shall know them ? for the ways of the  Lord  are right , and the just shall walk in them : but the transgressors shall fall therein .
translation.kha: To ai ba kito kiba stad kin shemphang ïa kaei kaba la thoh hangne ; bad ai ba kin pdiang ïa ki naduh ka dohnud . Ki lynti U  Trai  ki long kiba beit , bad ki briew kiba hok ki im da kaba bud ïa ki , hynrei ki nongpop ki jynthut bad ki kyllon namar ba kim suidñiew ïa ki .

translation.en: To give subtilty to the simple , to the young man knowledge and discretion .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban pynlong ïa u briew uba shida ban long sian bad hikai ïa ki samla kumno ban dap ban biang ka jingim .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid , and let me set a morsel of bread before thee  ; and eat , that thou mayest have strength , when thou goest on thy way .
translation.kha: Mynta pat , sngewbha leh ïa kaba nga ong . Shah ngan wanrah bam ïa phi . Phi dei ban bam ba phin dup ïohbor ynda phi leit sha la ka jingleit .

translation.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phin ithuh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler da kaei kaba ki leh .

translation.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïalam sha ki Pharisi ïa uta u briew uba la ju long uba matlah .

translation.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ktah ïa ka metïap ki long ki bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam haduh hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: God came from Teman , and the Holy One from mount Paran . Selah . His glory covered the heavens , and the earth was full of his praise .
translation.kha: U Blei u wan biang na Edom ; U Blei bakhuid u wan na ki lumrit ka Paran . Ka burom jong u ka dap ïa ki bneng , bad ka pyrthei ka dap da ka jingïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: And they said , Hath the  Lord  indeed spoken only by Moses ? hath he not spoken also by us ? And the  Lord  heard it .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Hato U  Trai  u la kren tang lyngba u Moses ? Hato um shym la kren lyngba jong ngi ruh ?  U  Trai  u la ïohsngew aïu ki ong .

translation.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall , and none shall raise him up : and I will kindle a fire in his cities , and it shall devour all round about him .
translation.kha: Ka hima basarong jong pha kan jynthut bad kyllon , bad yn ym don ban ïarap ban khyllie ïa pha . Ngan thang ïa ki nongbah da ka ding , bad kiei kiei baroh sawdong yn pynjot .

translation.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon  ; and my servants shall be with thy servants : and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint : for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians .
translation.kha: Kumta phah ïa ki rangbah jong me sha Lebanon ban pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar na ka bynta jong nga . Ki rangbah jong nga kin ïatreilang bad ki , bad ngan siew ïa ki rangbah jong me kat kaba me pynbeit . Kumba me tip bha , ki rangbah jong nga kim tip kumno ban pynngat ïa ki dieng kumba ki jong me ki tip .

translation.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder : the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet .
translation.kha: Men ïuhroit halor ki sing bad ki bseiñ , ïa ki sing ba-itriem bad ïa ki  seiñpuh .

translation.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Dabid u la pyndep ban ai ïa ki jingkñia , u kyrkhu ïa ki paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  bad sam jingbam ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And Azariah the chief priest , and all the priests , looked upon him , and , behold , he was leprous in his forehead , and they thrust him out from thence  ; yea , himself hasted also to go out , because the  Lord  had smitten him .
translation.kha: U Asaraïah bad kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , ki peit sah ïa ka shyllangmat jong u syiem da ka jingsheptieng , bad mar mar ki tan jubor ïa u shabar ban mihnoh na ka Templ . U pynkloi ban mih shabar , namar U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u .

translation.en: David therefore besought God for the child  ; and David fasted , and went in , and lay all night upon the earth .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la duwai ïa U Blei ba uta u khunlung un koit . Um treh bam ei ei , bad man ka miet u rung sha la ka kamra , bad u thiah ha madan baroh shi miet .

translation.en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month , in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa .
translation.kha: Ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ha u bnai uba lai jong ka snem kaba khatsan ba u Asa u long syiem .

translation.en: And , behold , seven other kine came up after them out of the river , ill favoured and leanfleshed  ; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river .
translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki masi kynthei ki wan mih ; ki long kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyieng suda . Ki la ki wan mih bad ki la ïeng hajan kita kiwei pat ki masi kynthei ha ka rudwah ,

translation.en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer , and they took the villages thereof , and drove out the Amorites that were there .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u phah ïa ki briew ban shem ka lynti babha tam kumno ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Jaser ; ki Israel ki la ïohknieh ïa ka bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka , bad ki la beh noh ïa ki Amor kiba shong hangta .

translation.en: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Bad u la hukum ïa ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ban khum ïa ki lai ngut ki rangbah bad ban bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .

translation.en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak , and say , For mischief did he bring them out , to slay them in the mountains , and to consume them from the face of the earth ? Turn from thy fierce wrath , and repent of this evil against thy people .
translation.kha: Balei ba ki nong Ijipt kin ïoh ong ba me la ïalam ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , da kaba me thmu ban pynïap ïa ki ha ki lum , bad ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki ? Sangeh ban bitar ; pynkylla noh ïa ka jingmut jong me , bad wat ai ba kane ka jingpynjot kan ngat ha ki briew jong me .

translation.en: The wicked , through the pride of his countenance , will not seek after God : God is not in all his thoughts .
translation.kha: U riewbymman um salia shaphang U  Trai  ; ha ka jingsarong jong u , u pyrkhat ba U Blei um da donkam .

translation.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass  ; and as thy days , so shall thy strength be .
translation.kha: To ki shnong jong u kin long kiba la ker da ki khyrdop nar , Bad to un shongsuk shongsaiñ borabor .

translation.en: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words , the king sought to put him to death : but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid , and fled , and went into Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Jehoïakim bad ki shipai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Uriah u la lah ong , u syiem u la pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u . Hynrei u Uriah u la ïohsngew shaphang kata ; kumta u la phet ha ka jingsngewtriem bad u la lait phet sha Ijipt .

translation.en: Lift up thine eyes round about , and see : all they gather themselves together , they come to thee : thy sons shall come from far , and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side .
translation.kha: Khmih sawdong jong pha bad peit kaei kaba jia : Ki briew jong pha kin ïalumlang ban wan phai sha ïing ; ki khun shynrang jong pha kin wan na sha jngai bah , bad ïa ki khun kynthei jong pha yn shu rah kum ïa ki khunlung .

translation.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee , and they shall deal furiously with thee : they shall take away thy nose and thine ears  ; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword : they shall take thy sons and thy daughters  ; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire .
translation.kha: Namar ba nga bitar ïa pha , ngan shah ïa ki ban leh ïa pha ha ka jingbitar jong ki . Kin ot ïa ka khmut jong pha bad ïa ki shkor jong pha bad kin pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha . Ho-oid , kin shim ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei na pha bad kin thang im ïa ki .

translation.en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing . Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name , he will give it you .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , phin ym pan ei ei na nga . Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.en: For these nations , which thou shalt possess , hearkened unto observers of times , and unto diviners : but as for thee , the  Lord  thy God hath not suffered thee so to do .
translation.kha: Kumta U Moses u ong ,  Ha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , ki briew ki shahshkor ïa kito kiba shat kiba kheiñ bad kiba wad ïa ki dak ki shin , hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u khang ïa phi ban leh kumta .

translation.en: And as for the prophet , and the priest , and the people , that shall say , The burden of the  Lord  , I will even punish that man and his house .
translation.kha: Lada uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh wat la u pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’ ngan pynshitom ïa u bad ïa ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty  ; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban ïaishah ban ïa kaba long uba donbor . Ka kham bha ban don ka bor halor lade ban halor ki nongbah baroh .

translation.en: But bring your youngest brother unto me  ; so shall your words be verified , and ye shall not die . And they did so .
translation.kha: Nangta phi dei ban wan ïalam ïa u para khatduh jong phi sha nga . Kane kan pynshisha ba phi kren hok , bad ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: And when they wanted wine , the mother of Jesus saith unto him , They have no wine .
translation.kha: Haba ka waiñ ka la lut noh , ka kmie U Jisu ka la ong ïa u ,  Kim don waiñ shuh .

translation.en: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard , and hath not yet eaten of it ? let him also go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man eat of it .
translation.kha: Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep rep bri sohwaiñ , hynrei u bym pat ïohlad ban kheit ïa ki soh jong ka ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un ïoh bam ïa ki soh jong ka .

translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed  ; and they fed in a meadow .
translation.kha: ha kaba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki wan mih na kata ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .

translation.en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan , and swear to the  Lord  of hosts  ; one shall be called , The city of destruction .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka ktien Hebru yn kren ha ki san tylli ki nongbah jong ka Ijipt . Ki briew hangta kin shim jingsmai ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ïa kawei na ki nongbah yn khot ,  Ka Nongbah jong ka Sngi .

translation.en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you , for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God ;
translation.kha: Mynta ngi lah ban ainguh ïa U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi ainguh ïa u na ka bynta ka jingkmen kaba ngi don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u namar jong phi .

translation.en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Asa u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka phang sepngi , shna hynriew tylli ki jingker

translation.en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God , or that is worshipped ; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God , shewing himself that he is God .
translation.kha: Un pyrshah ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la khot blei , lane ïa kano kano ban mane , bad un buh ïa lade halor jong ki baroh . Wat shapoh un leit rung bad shong hapoh ka Templ U Blei bad kam ba u long U Blei .

translation.en: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear : and there is a multitude of slain , and a great number of carcases  ; and there is none end of their corpses  ; they stumble upon their corpses :
translation.kha: Ki nongshong kulai ki kynha , ki waitlam ki thaba , ki sum ki phalang ! ïa ki metïap la kynton shajrong , ki metïap bym don jingkheiñ — ki briew ki jynthut halor jong ki !

translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David , king of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki proberb u Solomon , u khun jong u Dabid bad u syiem ki Israel .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will extend peace to her like a river , and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream : then shall ye suck , ye shall be borne upon her sides , and be dandled upon her knees .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan wallam ha phi ïa ka jingdap kyrhai baneh ; ka spah jong ki jaitbynriew kan tuid sha phi kum ka wah , ka bym ju rngad . Phin long kum i khunlung iba la sumar da la ka kmie , ba la rah ha ki ksang ti jong ka , bad sumar da ka jingieit .

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said , Go not down into Egypt  ; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Isaak bad u ong ,  Wat leit sha ri Ijipt ; sah ha kane ka ri ha kaba nga la ong ha me ban sah .

translation.en: And David said unto him , To whom belongest thou ? and whence art thou ? And he said , I am a young man of Egypt , servant to an Amalekite  ; and my master left me , because three days agone I fell sick .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Uei u kynrad jong me , bad na-ei me wan ?   Nga dei u nong Ijipt , u mraw jong u nong Amalek ,  u la jubab .  U kynrad jong nga u la iehnoh ïa nga lai sngi mynshuwa namar ba nga kem pang .

translation.en: But when his disciples saw it , they had indignation , saying , To what purpose is this waste ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la bitar .  Balei ba shu pynsep-ei ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that when any shall yet prophesy , then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him , Thou shalt not live  ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the  Lord  : and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth .
translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u ïaiban ban ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u hi kin ong ïa u ba u dei ban shah pynïap , namar u la kam ba u kren ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  , hynrei u kren pynban ïa ki jinglamler . Haba u ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u kin dung pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Ye have said , It is vain to serve God : and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance , and that we have walked mournfully before the  Lord  of hosts ?
translation.kha: Phi la ong , ‘ Kam myntoi ban shakri ïa U Blei . Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban leh ïa kaei kaba u ong lane kaba pyrshang ban pyn-i ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ba ngi sngewsih na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ?

translation.en: Helkath with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Helkath , bad ka Rehob , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house  ; his hands shall also finish it  ; and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  U Serubbabel u la buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ , bad un pyndep ïa ka jingtei . Haba kane ka jia , ki briew jong nga kin tip ba dei ma nga uba la phah ïa me sha ki .

translation.en: And saith unto him ,  See thou say nothing to any man : but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
translation.kha: hadien u la ong ïa u ,  Sngap , wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang kane . Hynrei leit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai ba un khmih ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshisha ha baroh ba me la ïohkhiah , sa ai ka jingkñia kaba u Moses u la hukum .

translation.en: And the king said , Whosoever saith ought unto thee , bring him to me , and he shall not touch thee any more .
translation.kha: U Syiem u jubab ,  Lada uno uno u byrngem ïa pha , wan ïalam ïa u sha nga , bad un ym pynwit shuh ïa pha lano lano .

translation.en: Heal me , O  Lord  , and I shall be healed  ; save me , and I shall be saved : for thou art my praise .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , pynkhiah ïa nga bad ngan ïohkhiah krat ; pyllait im ïa nga bad ngan long uba shngain janai . Me long uta uba nga ïaroh !

translation.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim , even against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod : waste and utterly destroy after them , saith the  Lord  , and do according to all that I have commanded thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Merathaim bad jong ka Pekod . Pynïap bad pynjot ïa ki . Leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba nga hukum ïa phi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And thou , Solomon my son , know thou the God of thy father , and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind : for the  Lord  searcheth all hearts , and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts : if thou seek him , he will be found of thee  ; but if thou forsake him , he will cast thee off for ever .
translation.kha: Bad ha u Solomon u ong ,  Ko khun jong nga , nga kyntu ïa me ban ithuh ïa U Blei u kpa jong me , bad ban shakri ïa u da ka dohnud kaba skhem bad da ka jingmut kaba pyndem . U tip ïa baroh ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingkwah jong ngi . Lada me leit sha u , un pdiang ïa me , hynrei lada me phai lyndet na u , u ruh un iehnoh ïa me junom .

translation.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kane kat kum ka jingthmu bymjukut kaba u la pyndep lyngba U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: There is Meshech , Tubal , and all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword , though they caused their terror in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ka Meshekh bad ka Tubal ki don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ki ha baroh sawdong . Ki long baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Pynban shisien ki la pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .

translation.en: And he put the breastplate upon him : also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim .
translation.kha: U pyndeng ha u ïa ka jingdeng shadem , bad u buh ha ka ïa u Urim bad u Thummim   .

translation.en: Out of whose womb came the ice ? and the hoary frost of heaven , who hath gendered it ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka kmie jong u thah bad jong u thah stang ,

translation.en: Go now to the flock , and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats  ; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father , such as he loveth :
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka kynhun blang bad to shim ar tylli ki khunblang kiba sngaid , khnang ba ngan ïoh shet ïa ki bad khreh katto katne ïa kato ka jingbam kaba i pa jong phi i bang eh .

translation.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city , and said unto him , Thus saith Ben–hadad ,
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ka nongbah sha u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ong ,

translation.en: Thou shalt be over my house , and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled : only in the throne will I be greater than thou .
translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa ka ri jong nga , bad ki briew jong nga baroh kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me . Ka iktiar jong me hadien ka jong nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt slay the ram , and thou shalt take his blood , and sprinkle it round about upon the altar .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa u , shim ïa ka snam jong u , bad synreit ïa ka sawdong kata ka duwan .

translation.en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses  ; and as horsemen , so shall they run .
translation.kha: Ki i kum ki kulai ; ki mareh kum ki kulai thma .

translation.en: How are the voluntary contributions used ?
translation.kha: Kumno la pyndonkam ïa ki jingnoh synñiang ?

translation.en: The  Lord  talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,
translation.kha: Hangta halor u lum , U  Trai  u la kren ha phi markhmat napdeng ka ding .

translation.en: The nakedness of thy father s wife s daughter , begotten of thy father , she is thy sister , thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka khun ka tnga u kpa jong me , naba ka ruh ka dei ka para jong me .

translation.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew uba shem ïa nga u shem ïa ka jingim , bad U  Trai  un sngewbha ïa u .

translation.en: Sit thou silent , and get thee into darkness , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called , The lady of kingdoms .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Babilon ,  To shong ha ka jingjar jar bad ha ka jingdum ; kin ym khot shuh ïa pha ka syiem jong ki jaitbynriew !

translation.en: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : the curtains were all of one size .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka long khat-ar mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingheh .

translation.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle : them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me .
translation.kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ban ïaleh thma , bad ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga .

translation.en: Fury is not in me : who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle ? I would go through them , I would burn them together .
translation.kha: Ngam bitar shuh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ . Tang lada ki don ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ban hap ban ïakhun pyrshah , te ngan thang ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this , and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga hukum ïa ka sahit bneng ba kan khih da ka jingingiew , ban long kaba iphylla bad kaba i lyngngoh ,

translation.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven , who shall hear report of thee , and shall tremble , and be in anguish because of thee .
translation.kha: U briew baroh un khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka kyrteng jong phi .’

translation.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb , then he shall bring for his trespass , which he hath committed , two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , unto the  Lord   ; one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wallam da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , un wanrah sha U  Trai  ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur kum ka jingpli ïa la ka pop , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: Now , lo , if he beget a son , that seeth all his father s sins which he hath done , and considereth , and doeth not such like ,
translation.kha: Mynta tharai une u briew uba ar u don khun shynrang . U ïohi ïa baroh ki pop kiba u kpa jong u , u la ju leh hynrei um shym bud ïa ki jingleh jong u .

translation.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield , with the flattering of her lips she forced him .
translation.kha: Kumta ka la pynshoi ïa u da ki jinglehieit jong ka , bad u la ngat ha ki ktien jali ja-um jong ka .

translation.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse , deceiving , and being deceived .
translation.kha: bad ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba shukor kin nang ïaid na kaba sniew sha kaba kham sniew , da kaba shukor ïa kiwei bad shah shukor ïa lade .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  Have ye not read , that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phim pat pule ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ba ha kaba mynnyngkong U Nongthaw u la thaw ïa ki briew , shynrang bad kynthei ?

translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , behold , I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem : and they shall eat bread by weight , and with care  ; and they shall drink water by measure , and with astonishment :
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ruh ,  Ko khun u briew , ngan sa pynduna bam ïa ka Jerusalem . Ki briew hangto kin da sa shem jynjar bad sngewkhuslai namar ba ki hap ban da thew ïa ka jingbam ba ki bam bad ïa ka um ba ki dih .

translation.en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob , and he loved the damsel , and spake kindly unto the damsel .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u shem ba ka samla ka long kaba i-ieit kat haduh ba u la ïapmat ïa ka , bad u la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewieit na ka .

translation.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him , and said , Put now this woman out from me , and bolt the door after her .
translation.kha: u la khot ïa la u shakri , bad u ong ,  Beh noh ïa kane ka briew na khmat jong nga ! Pynmih ïa ka shabar bad khang ïa ka jingkhang !

translation.en: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning  ; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïai pyrkhat shaphang ka jingkmen u dei u bieit . U briew uba stad u pyrkhat shaphang ka jingïap .

translation.en: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren .
translation.kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la bitar ïa kita ar ngut shi para .

translation.en: But the hand of the  Lord  was heavy upon them of Ashdod , and he destroyed them , and smote them with emerods , even Ashdod and the coasts thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynshitom jur ïa ki nong Ashdod bad u pyntriem ïa ki . U la pynshitom ïa ki bad ïa ki briew sawdong ka ri da kaba pynmih ha ki ïa ka jingpang thung .

translation.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron  ; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter s vessel .
translation.kha: Men pynkheiñ ïa ki da u diengduh nar ; men pynpra ïa ki lyngkhot lyngkhai kum ïa u khiew khyndew .’

translation.en: She considereth a field , and buyeth it : with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard .
translation.kha: Ka peit bniah ïa ka lyngkha bad ka thied ïa ka , bad da ka kamai ba ka ïoh ka thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha ka brisoh .

translation.en: Now Sarai Abram s wife bare him no children : and she had an handmaid , an Egyptian , whose name was Hagar .
translation.kha: Ka tnga u Abram ka Sarai , kam shym la ïoh khun satia . Hynrei ka la don bad ka , kawei ka mraw na Ijipt kaba kyrteng ka Hagar , bad kumta ka ong ha u Abram ,  U  Trai  u la khang ïa nga ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God , and is profitable for doctrine , for reproof , for correction , for instruction in righteousness :
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid baroh ka long kaba la pyrsad mynsiem da U Blei bad ka long kaba myntoi ban hikai ïa ka jingshisha , ban sneng ïa kaba bakla , ban pynbeit ïa ki jingduna , bad ban ai jingkyntu ïa ka jingim kaba bha ,

translation.en: I am come into my garden , my sister , my spouse : I have gathered my myrrh with my spice  ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey  ; I have drunk my wine with my milk : eat , O friends  ; drink , yea , drink abundantly , O beloved .
translation.kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ! Katno ki khmat jong phi hapoh ka jingtap khmat ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit . U shñiuh jong phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba hiar sha trai ki lum Gilead .

translation.en: And now , behold , I go unto my people : come therefore , and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days .
translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Mynta ngan leit phai pat sha la ki briew , hynrei shuwa ba ngan mih , nga maham lypa ïa phi aïu ki Israel kin leh ïa ki briew jong phi hadien habud .

translation.en: ( And his daughter was Sherah , who built Beth–horon the nether , and the upper , and Uzzen–sheerah . )
translation.kha: U Ephraim u don kawei ka khun kaba kyrteng ka Sheerah . Ka tei ïa ki shnong jong ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , bad ïa ka Ussen Sheerah .

translation.en: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted . I do send thee unto them  ; and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba mutlop bad kim burom ïa nga , kumta nga phah ïa me sha ki bad men ong ha ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki .

translation.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga phah ïa ki nonglamktien na ka ri shyiap Kedemoth sha u Sihon u syiem Heshbon ban tyrwa ïa ka jingïasuk , da kaba ong ,

translation.en: Produce your cause , saith the  Lord   ; bring forth your strong reasons , saith the King of Jacob .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , u Syiem ki Israel , u don ïa kane ban ong :  Phi ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew , to buh ïa ka kam jong phi . Wallam ïa ki jingïasaid nia babha tam ba phi don !

translation.en: Now therefore arise , go forth , and speak comfortably unto thy servants : for I swear by the  Lord  , if thou go not forth , there will not tarry one with thee this night : and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now .
translation.kha: Mynta , to leit ban pynskhem biang ïa ki rangbah jong phi . Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba lada phim leh kumta , yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na ki u ban don bad phi lashai mynstep . Kata kan long ka jingjynjar kaba sniew tam kaba phin shah ha ka jingim jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Surely at the commandment of the  Lord  came this upon Judah , to remove them out of his sight , for the sins of Manasseh , according to all that he did  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , khnang ban beh noh ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong u namar ki pop baroh kiba u syiem Manasseh u la leh ,

translation.en: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart , and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles , Men and brethren , what shall we do ?
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la khuslai shikatdei eh bad ki la ong ha u Petros bad ha kiwei pat ki apostol ,  Kaei kaba ngin leh , ko para ?

translation.en: And Zelah , Eleph , and Jebusi , which is Jerusalem , Gibeah , and Kirjath  ; fourteen cities with their villages . This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families .
translation.kha: ka Sela , ka Haeleph , ka Jebus ( lane ka Jerusalem ) , ka Gibeah , bad ka Kiriath Jearim : khatsaw tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki . Kane ka long ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke , as out of a seething pot or caldron .
translation.kha: Ka tdem ka wan mih na ki thliew khmut jong u , kum ka tdem ki ñiut kiba la thang sha trai jong u khiew .

translation.en: And he saith unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Hereafter ye shall see heaven open , and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin sa ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ki angel jong U Blei ba ki ïakiew bad ïahiar ha U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died , and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim , in the mount of the Amalekites .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Pirathon ha ka ri ki Ephraim ha ka ri lum jong ki Amalek .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the increase , that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh , and four parts shall be your own , for seed of the field , and for your food , and for them of your households , and for food for your little ones .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ot , phin ai shi bynta na ka san bynta ha u syiem , bad kaba sah saw bynta kan long ka jong phi , ba phin ïoh buh symbai , bad ba phin ïoh jingbam na ka bynta ïa lade bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi .

translation.en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel  ; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ai hukum ïa baroh ki nongwei baroh kiba shong basah ha Ri Israel ban ïalumlang , bad u pyntrei ïa ki . Katto katne na ki , ki shna ïa ki mawkynroh ban tei ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: If any man speak , let him speak as the oracles of God  ; if any man minister , let him do it as of the ability which God giveth : that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ , to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïalap , u dei ban ïalap ïa ki khubor jong U Blei ; uno uno uba shakri , u dei ban shakri da ka bor kaba U Blei u ai ïa u , khnang ba ha kiei kiei baroh yn ai ïa ka jingïaroh sha U Blei da U Jisu Khrist , ha uba ka burom bad ka bor ki long ki jong u junom la junom , Amen .

translation.en: But Jehosheba , the daughter of king Joram , sister of Ahaziah , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons which were slain  ; and they hid him , even him and his nurse , in the bedchamber from Athaliah , so that he was not slain .
translation.kha: Tang u Joash u khun jong u Ahasaïah u lait im . U la jan shah pynïap ryngkat bad kiwei , hynrei la pyllait im ïa u da ka ñiakha jong u , ka Jehosheba , kaba long ka khun jong u syiem Jehoram bad ka bakha u Ahasaïah . Ka shim ïa u lem bad ka nongsumar jong u sha ka kamra thiah kaba don ha ka Templ bad ka la pynrieh ïa u na ka Athalaïah , kumta um shym la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And they said , The man asked us straitly of our state , and of our kindred , saying , Is your father yet alive ? have ye another brother ? and we told him according to the tenor of these words : could we certainly know that he would say , Bring your brother down ?
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Uta u briew u ïai kylli bniah shaphang jong ngi bad shaphang ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi , u da ong , ‘ I pa jong phi i dang im ne em ? Phi dang don para shynrang shuh ?’ Ngi hap ban jubab ïa kita ki jingkylli . Kumno ngi lah ban tip ba un ong ïa ngi ban wan ïalam ïa u para jong ngi ?

translation.en: The same came to Jesus by night , and said unto him , Rabbi , we know that thou art a teacher come from God : for no man can do these miracles that thou doest , except God be with him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , une u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ha u ,  Ko Rabbi , ngi tip ba me long u nonghikai ïa uba la phah da U Blei . Ym don uno uno uba lah ban leh ïa ki kambah kiba me leh lymda U Blei u don ryngkat bad u .

translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  will roar from Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn , and the top of Carmel shall wither .
translation.kha: U Amos u ong ,  U  Trai  u kyrhuh na u lum Seïon ; Ka sur jong u ka tied kum u pyrthat na Jerusalem . Ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong , bad u phlang ha Lum Karmel u ïapstai .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage  ; for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought you out from this place : there shall no leavened bread be eaten .
translation.kha: U Moses u kren ha u paidbah ,  Kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi — ka sngi ha kaba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba phi long ki mraw . Kane ka dei ka sngi ba U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u . Wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .

translation.en: Hear now , O Joshua the high priest , thou , and thy fellows that sit before thee : for they are men wondered at : for , behold , I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH .
translation.kha: Kumta to pynshahshkor , ko Joshua , me uba long u Rangbah Lyngdoh , to pynshahshkor , phi ki para lyngdoh jong u , ma phi kiba long ka dak jong ka lawei babha : Ngan pynpaw ïa la u shakri , ïa uba la khot U Tnat !

translation.en: ( For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision , the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles : )
translation.kha: Naba da ka bor U Blei la pynlong ïa nga u Apostol sha ki Jentil , kumba ïa u Petros la pynlong u Apostol sha ki Jiw .

translation.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin .
translation.kha: Suk u briew uba ïa ki pop jong u , U Trai un ym buh jingkynmaw shuh !

translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  went up from the midst of the city , and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city .
translation.kha: Nangta ka jingshai batyngshaiñ ka iehnoh ïa ka nongbah bad ka la leit sha u lumbah ha ka phang mihngi jong ka .

translation.en: Say now to the rebellious house , Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold , the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem , and hath taken the king thereof , and the princes thereof , and led them with him to Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Kylli ïa kine kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah lada ki tip aïu ka pharshi ka mut . Ïathuh ïa ki ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan sha Jerusalem bad rah ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u lem bad u sha Babilonia .

translation.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared : there make ready for us .
translation.kha: Te un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng kaba heh , ba la pynkhreh bad pynbiang , ha kaba phin ïoh baroh kiei kiei ba la pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families , which were remaining of the families of the Levites , were by their lot twelve cities .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ka kur Merari la ai khat-ar tylli ki nongbah .

translation.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes , and the half tribe of Manasseh ,
translation.kha: Mynta te , pynbynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng kiwei pat ki khyndai jait bad ha ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , na ka bynta jong ki ba kin ïohkynti kum la ka jong .

translation.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king  ; but my lord the king is as an angel of God : do therefore what is good in thine eyes .
translation.kha: U la lamler shaphang jong nga ha phi ko Syiem kynrad ; hynrei phi , phi long kum u angel U Blei , kumta leh ïa kaei kaba idei ïa phi .

translation.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar .
translation.kha: Hamar ba mih ka sngi , u Lot u la poi ha Soar .

translation.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David , to salute him , and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer , and smitten him : for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . And Joram brought with him vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and vessels of brass :
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Joram , u khun jong u ban khublei ïa u Syiem Dabid bad ban ai khublei ïa u namar ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh pyrshah la bunsien . U Joram u rah na ka bynta u Dabid ki jingai sngewbha kiba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong .

translation.en: The priests said not , Where is the  Lord  ? and they that handle the law knew me not : the pastors also transgressed against me , and the prophets prophesied by Baal , and walked after things that do not profit .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim shym kylli , ‘ Hangno U  Trai  u don ?’ Ki lyngdoh jong nga hi kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki nongsynshar ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka kyrteng jong u Baal bad ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .

translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac , Go from us  ; for thou art much mightier than we .
translation.kha: Te u Abimelekh u ong ha u Isaak ,  To mihnoh na ka ri jong ngi . Me la kylla long uba kham khrawbor ban ïa kaba ngi long .

translation.en: He shall not be rich , neither shall his substance continue , neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth .
translation.kha: Un ym ïailong slem uba riewspah ; ym don kaba dei ka jong u ka ban neh .

translation.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink  ; and commanded the prophets , saying , Prophesy not .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi la pynlong ïa ki Nasir ban dih waiñ , bad phi la hukum ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ym kren ïa ka khubor jong nga .

translation.en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world , what shall the receiving of them be , but life from the dead ?
translation.kha: Naba haba ki la shah kyntait , ïa u bynriew la pynkylla na kaba long ki nongshun U Blei sha kaba long ki paralok jong u . Kaei ka ban long te , haba la pdiang ïa ki ? Kan long ka jingim ïa kiba la ïap!

translation.en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity , or for any sin , in any sin that he sinneth : at the mouth of two witnesses , or at the mouth of three witnesses , shall the matter be established .
translation.kha: Kam biang tang uwei u sakhi ban rai pynrem ïa u briew na ka bynta kano kano ka kam palat ; la kumno kumno , ar ngut ki sakhi ki dei ban pynsabut ba u briew u leh kam sniew .

translation.en: They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .
translation.kha: Ki kam ba ki tip ïa U Blei , hynrei ki jingleh jong ki , ki len ïa kata . Ki long kiba dap da ka jingisih bad bymkohnguh , ki bym biang ban leh ïa kano kano kaba bha .

translation.en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body , whether we be Jews or Gentiles , whether we be bond or free ; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , baroh na ngi , la ngi long ki Jiw ne ki Jentil , ki mraw ne kiba laitluid , la pynbaptis ha kawei ka met da ujuh U Mynsiem , bad la ai ha ngi ïa ujuh U Mynsiem ban ïoh dih .

translation.en: Thou , O king , sawest , and behold a great image . This great image , whose brightness was excellent , stood before thee  ; and the form thereof was terrible .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , ha ka jingïohipaw jong phi , phi la ïohi ba la ïeng ha khmat jong phi ka durbriew bakhraw , kaba phyrnai bad thaba , bad kaba ishyrkhei ban khmih .

translation.en: Saying , Say ye , His disciples came by night , and stole him away while we slept .
translation.kha: bad ki la ong ,  Phi dei ban ong ba ki synran jong u ki la wan mynmiet bad ki la tuh ïa ka met jong u katba phi dang ïohthiah .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; No stranger , uncircumcised in heart , nor uncircumcised in flesh , shall enter into my sanctuary , of any stranger that is among the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga pynbna ba yn ym don uno uno u nongwei bym shym la otsher , uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa nga , un rung ha ka Templ jong nga , wat u nongwei uba shong basah hapdeng ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days , and all Israel with him , a very great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Solomon bad baroh ki paid Israel ki la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep hynñiew sngi . La don u paidbah uba bun naduh ka Khim Hamath na shatei haduh ka khappud Ijipt na shathie .

translation.en: Say to them that are of a fearful heart , Be strong , fear not : behold , your God will come with vengeance , even God with a recompence  ; he will come and save you .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa baroh kiba rit mynsiem ,  To long khlaiñ bad wat sheptieng ! U Blei un wan ban pyllait ïa phi , un wan ban pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Thou hast answered right : this do , and thou shalt live .
translation.kha: Me ong kaba dei ,  U Jisu u la jubab ;  to leh ïa kane bad men im .

translation.en: The Pharisees also came unto him , tempting him , and saying unto him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan sha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da kaba kylli ,  Hato ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa u briew ban pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jong u na ka bynta kano kano ka daw kaba u mon ?

translation.en: Some even study over the telephone .
translation.kha: Don kiba pule lyngba ka telephone .

translation.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said unto him , What hast thou done unto us ? and what have I offended thee , that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done .
