translation.kha: Nangta u Abimelekh u khot ïa u Abraham , bad u ong ,  Kaei kane kaba me la leh ïa ngi ? Nga la leh sniew aïu ïa me ban pynlong ïa me ban pynngat ïa kane ka jynjar ha nga bad ha ka hima jong nga ? Ym don uwei ruh u ban leh ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa nga .

translation.en: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain , and shewed me that great city , the holy Jerusalem , descending out of heaven from God ,
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad u angel u la rah ïa nga sha kliar jong u lumbah uba jrong . U la pyn-i ha nga ïa ka Jerusalem , ka Nongbah Bakhuid , kaba da wan hiar na bneng na U Blei

translation.en: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God , and took a great stone , and set it up there under an oak , that was by the sanctuary of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Joshua u thoh ïa kita ki hukum ha ka kitab Ka Aiñ U Blei . Nangta u la shim uwei u maw uba heh , bad u pynïeng ïa u hapoh u dieng Sning ha ka jaka kyntang jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And another company turned the way to Beth–horon : and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .
translation.kha: kawei ka leit shaphang Beth Horon , bad kawei pat ka leit shaphang ka khappud na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Seboim bad ïa ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: And he stripped off his clothes also , and prophesied before Samuel in like manner , and lay down naked all that day and all that night . Wherefore they say , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
translation.kha: U loit noh ïa la ki jaiñ bad u shad bad risa ha khmat u Samuel , bad u thiah lyngkhuit ha kata ka sngi baroh shi sngi bad ha kata ka miet baroh shi miet . ( Ha kane ka rukom la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la kylla long u nongïathuhlypa ?  )

translation.en: You will not see any images , crucifixes , or things like these at the Kingdom Hall .
translation.kha: Phin ym ïohi ïa ki dur , ki diengphna , lane kum kine kiei kiei hapoh ka Kingdom Hall .

translation.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them ,  Murmur not among yourselves .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Keiñ noh kaba ïakren khñium hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: Now Naaman , captain of the host of the king of Syria , was a great man with his master , and honourable , because by him the  Lord  had given deliverance unto Syria : he was also a mighty man in valour , but he was a leper .
translation.kha: U Naaman , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Syria , u long u briew ïa uba la burom shikatdei eh bad ñiewkor shibun da u syiem Syria , namar lyngba u Naaman , U  Trai  u la ai ka jingjop ïa ki shipai Syria . U la long u shipai bakhraw , hynrei u don ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while he blessed them , he was parted from them , and carried up into heaven .
translation.kha: Katba u dang kyrkhu ïa ki , u la leit noh na ki bad la shim noh ïa u sha bneng .

translation.en: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise , than for a man to hear the song of fools .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban don ki briew kiba stad kiba sneng ïa phi ban ïa kaba don ki briew kiba tasngeng kiba rwai ki jingïaroh ïa phi .

translation.en: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .
translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah Israel !  ki la pyrta .  To ïarap ! Dei une u briew uba leit kylleng kylleng da kaba hikai ïa uwei pa uwei pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel , ïa ka Hukum u Moses , bad ïa kane ka Templ . Bad mynta u la wan ïalam wat katto katne ngut ki Jentil shapoh ka Templ bad pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka bakhuid !

translation.en: For this is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta ïa uba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong . ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien jong nga ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’

translation.en: Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , thy servants , to whom thou swarest by thine own self , and saidst unto them , I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven , and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed , and they shall inherit it for ever .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , ki shakri jong me . Kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba me la pynlong bad ki ban ai ha ki ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , bad ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ïa kata ka ri baroh kaba me la kular ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .

translation.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat :
translation.kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki kjat

translation.en: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men  ; all these were men of valour .
translation.kha: Khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai Benjamin kiba shlur ki la shah pynïap .

translation.en: For as he thinketh in his heart , so is he : Eat and drink , saith he to thee  ; but his heart is not with thee .
translation.kha: To wan bad bam shuh sa khyndiat ,  u ong , hynrei um mut kumta . Kaei kaba u pyrkhat ka long kaei kaba u long da shisha .

translation.en: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .
translation.kha: Da kaba ong ka jutang bathymmai , U Blei u la pynlong rim ïa kata kaba nyngkong ; bad kano kano kaba kylla rim bad nang tymmen kan sa jah noh shen .

translation.en: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks , rams , lambs , with their meat offerings and their drink offerings , and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynlut ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa kane ka pisa bad ban thied ki masi kyrtong , ki langbrot shynrang , ki khunblang , u kew bad ka waiñ bad ban ainguh ïa ki ha ka duwan jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands , and confirm the feeble knees .
translation.kha: Kin ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa ki kti kiba la thait bad ïa ki khohsiew bakyiuh da ka jingtlot .

translation.en: Each time you go to the Kingdom Hall , become acquainted with one of the elders or ministerial servants until you get to know all of them and their families .
translation.kha: Man ba phi leit sha ka Ïing Hima , pyrshang ban ithuh ïa iwei na ki rangbah balang ne nongïarap balang haduh ba phin da ithuh lut ïa ki bad ïa ka ïing ka sem jong ki .

translation.en: So the  Lord  sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed : and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer–sheba seventy thousand men .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha Israel , kaba neh naduh kata ka step haduh ka por kaba u la jied . Na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh ki la ïap haduh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki Israel .

translation.en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill , and under every green tree :
translation.kha: Ha baroh ki lumrit bad ha syrngiew jong uwei pa uwei u dieng ki pynïeng ïa ki païa maw bad ki dur jong ka blei Asherah ,

translation.en: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it  ; and they shall consecrate themselves .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki lyngdoh kin pynkyntang ïa ka duwan bad pynbiang ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron did so , as the  Lord  commanded  ; and he lifted up the rod , and smote the waters that were in the river , in the sight of Pharaoh , and in the sight of his servants  ; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood .
translation.kha: Nangta U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Ha khmat jong u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , u Aaron u la rah ïa la u diengduh bad u tied ïa ka sla um jong ka wah Nile , bad ka um baroh ka la kylla snam .

translation.en: In the last day , that great day of the feast , Jesus stood and cried , saying ,  If any man thirst , let him come unto me , and drink .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatduh bad kaba khraw tam eh jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , U Jisu u la ïeng joit bad u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Uno uno uba sliang u dei ban wan sha nga , bad uno uno uba ngeit ha nga u dei ban dih .

translation.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also : for they are God s ministers , attending continually upon this very thing .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ruh balei ba phi dei ban siew ki khajna , namar ki bor synshar ki trei na ka bynta U Blei haba ki pyndep ïa la ki kamram .

translation.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not , that ye come together not for the better , but for the worse .
translation.kha: Pynban , ha ki jingbthah harum , ngam ïaroh ïa phi , namar ki jingïaseng jong phi na ka bynta ka jingmane , da shisha ka kham pynsniew ban ïa kaba pynbha .

translation.en: And he said , What pledge shall I give thee ? And she said , Thy signet , and thy bracelets , and thy staff that is in thine hand . And he gave it her , and came in unto her , and she conceived by him .
translation.kha: Ngan ai aïu ïa phi kum ka dak ka jingkular ?  u phai ktien . Ka jubab ,  Ka muhor jong phi bad u ksai jong ka , bad uto u diengduh ba phi rah .  U la ai ïa ki ha ka . Nangta ki la ïathiah shongkha , bad ka la punkhun .

translation.en: If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , phi dei ban phai sha U Blei da ka jingsngewrit bad iehnoh ïa baroh kaba sniew kaba don ha ka ïing jong phi .

translation.en: But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kiba khwan myntoi bad kiba kyntait ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ban bud ïa kaei ka bym dei ; halor jong ki U Blei un theh noh ïa la ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla .

translation.en: And when he was come in , he saith unto them ,  Why make ye this ado , and weep ? the damsel is not dead , but sleepeth .
translation.kha: U la rung shapoh bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Balei katne katne ka jingkhynwin ? Balei ba phi ïa-ïam ? Ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !

translation.en: And I will take away mine hand , and thou shalt see my back parts : but my face shall not be seen .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan sa weng noh ïa ka kti jong nga , bad men sa ïohi ïa ka ingdong jong nga ym ïa ka khmat jong nga .

translation.en: And under the firmament were their wings straight , the one toward the other : every one had two , which covered on this side , and every one had two , which covered on that side , their bodies .
translation.kha: Hangta hapoh kata ka tnum kita ki jingthaw ki ïeng , uwei uwei u pyiar ar tylli ki thapniang sha kiwei pat kiba hajan bad u bad tap pat ïa lade da ki ar tylli ki thapniang .

translation.en: But Benjamin , Joseph s brother , Jacob sent not with his brethren  ; for he said , Lest peradventure mischief befall him .
translation.kha: hynrei u Jakob um shym phah ïa u Benjamin , u para trai jong u Joseph ba un leit lem bad ki , namar u sheptieng ïoh jia ei ei ïa u .

translation.en: For she sitteth at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,
translation.kha: Ka shong ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing jong ka lane ha ki jaka shong kiba jrong tam ha ka shnong ,

translation.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Nga phah ïa ki jingkhublei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila , ki para nongtrei jong nga ha ka jingshakri ïa U Khrist Jisu ;

translation.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives , and repent , and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives , saying , We have sinned , and have done perversely , we have committed wickedness  ;
translation.kha: Lada jia ba ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki duwai sha me , ki da phla haduh katno ki la long kiba pop bad kiba bymman , to sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong ki A  Trai .

translation.en: And if there be any blemish therein , as if it be lame , or blind , or have any ill blemish , thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei kaba duna ha kita ki jingri , lada ki dkoh lane ki matlah , lane lada palat eh kano kano ka jingduna , phim dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: The mountains skipped like rams , and the little hills like lambs .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki ryngkoh kum ki blang ; ki lumrit , ki kynthih kum ki khunlangbrot .

translation.en: Put me in remembrance : let us plead together : declare thou , that thou mayest be justified .
translation.kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïingbishar ; wallam ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ! Buh ïa ka kam jong phi ban pynshisha ba phi long ha kaba dei !

translation.en: These two things are come unto thee  ; who shall be sorry for thee ? desolation , and destruction , and the famine , and the sword : by whom shall I comfort thee ?
translation.kha: Ka jingjot kaba ar shah ka la hap halor jong pha : ïa ka jaka jong pha la pynjot ha ka thma , bad ki briew jong pha ki la ïapthngan . Ym don uno uno uba pyn-i jingsngewlem ïa pha .

translation.en: And I will make the land desolate , because they have committed a trespass , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki la long ki bymïaineh ha nga , bad kumta ngan pynlong ka ri khlaw ïa ka ri .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: This is he , that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sinai , and with our fathers : who received the lively oracles to give unto us :
translation.kha: U long ma u , uba la ïadon lem bad ki paid Israel haba ki la ïalumlang ha ka ri shyiap ; u la don lem hangta bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lem bad u angel uba la kren ha u , ha u lum Sinai , bad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba-im ka jong U Blei ban ai pateng ha ngi .

translation.en: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus  sake , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh .
translation.kha: Ha shi lynter ka jingim , ngi don ha tmier jong ka jingïap na ka bynta U Jisu , khnang ba yn ïohi ïa ka jingim jong u ha kane ka met baïap jong ngi .

translation.en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks , of the firstfruits of wheat harvest , and the feast of ingathering at the year s end .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot haba phi sdang ban ot ïa u soh nyngkong na u kew jong phi ; rakhe ruh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ka synrai haba phi lum ïa la ki soh .

translation.en: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth  ; because his sons made themselves vile , and he restrained them not .
translation.kha: Nga lah da ïathuh ha u ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka ïing jong u junom , namar ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kren sniew pyrshah ïa nga . U Eli u tip ba ki leh kumne hynrei bad um shym la khang ïa ki .

translation.en: And if any man said unto him , Let them not fail to burn the fat presently , and then take as much as thy soul desireth  ; then he would answer him , Nay  ; but thou shalt give it me now : and if not , I will take it by force .
translation.kha: Lada uta u briew u jubab ,  Ai ngin leh ïa kaba dei bad ieh kin da thang shuwa ïa ka khleiñ ; nangta sa shim katba phi kwah ,  uta u shakri u lyngdoh u ju ong ,  Em ! Ai noh mynta kumne ! Lym kumta , ngan shim ïa ka da ka bor !

translation.en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside , sealed with seven seals .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka kot kli ha ka kti kamon jong uta uba shong halor ka khet ; kaba la dap da ka jingthoh ha baroh arliang bad kaba la pyndait da ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait .

translation.en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera , the captain of Jabin s army , with his chariots and his multitude  ; and I will deliver him into thine hand .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Jabin , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi ha ka wah Kishon . Un don ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai , hynrei ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u .’

translation.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death : and his widows shall not weep .
translation.kha: Kito kiba lait im kin ïap ha ka jingpang , bad wat ki tnga jong ki kin ym ïam na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .

translation.en: Know therefore this day , and consider it in thine heart , that the  Lord  he is God in heaven above , and upon the earth beneath : there is none else .
translation.kha: Namar kata , kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi , bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano : U  Trai  u long U Blei ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . Ym don blei da uwei pat .

translation.en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron , and part of clay , so the kingdom shall be partly strong , and partly broken .
translation.kha: Ki shympriah kjat — shi bynta da ka nar bad shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha — ki mut ba shi bynta jong ka hima kan long kaba khlaiñ bad shi bynta jong ka kaba tlot .

translation.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon , to declare in Zion the vengeance of the  Lord  our God , the vengeance of his temple .
translation.kha: ( Ki nongphetwir ki la lait phet na Babilonia bad wan sha Jerusalem , bad ki ïathuh kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u siew kylliang na ka bynta kaei kaba ki nong Babilonia ki la leh ïa ka Templ jong u . )

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words , and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the  Lord  pronounced all this great evil against us ? or what is our iniquity ? or what is our sin that we have committed against the  Lord  our God ?
translation.kha: Haba me ïathuh ha ki ïa kane baroh , kin kylli ïa me balei ba nga la kut jingmut ban pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki . Kin kylli kaei ka kam runar kaba ki la shah pynrem bad kaei ka pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  rewarded me according to my righteousness : according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ainong ïa nga namar ba nga leh ïa kaba dei ; u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar ba nga long uba shida .

translation.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it : and he that hateth suretiship is sure .
translation.kha: Lada phi kular ban siew ïa ka ram u nongwei , phin babe ïa kata . Kan kham bha lada phi kiar na kata .

translation.en: Then they said , Behold , there is a feast of the  Lord  in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth–el , on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth–el to Shechem , and on the south of Lebonah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïa-pyrkhat ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba shisien shisnem ha U  Trai  ha Shiloh shen ka la wan poi .  ( Ka Shiloh ka don shatei na Bethel , shathie na Lebonah , bad sha mihngi na ka lynti bah hapdeng ka Bethel bad ka Shekhem . )

translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man , so the company of priests murder in the way by consent : for they commit lewdness .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki long kum ka kynhun ki nonglute kiba apthap ïa u briew . Wat ha ka lynti sha ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem ki pynïap briew . Bad ki leh ïa kane kaba sniew baroh da kaba thmu lypa !

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab , and all that he did , and the ivory house which he made , and all the cities that he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahab u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh shaphang ka ïingsyiem jong u ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati bad ïa baroh ki nongbah ïa kiba u la tei , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel

translation.en: And many false prophets shall rise , and shall deceive many .
translation.kha: Nangta shibun ki nongïathuhlypa lamler kin mih bad kin shukor ïa ki briew kiba bun .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall take her multitude , and take her spoil , and take her prey  ; and it shall be the wages for his army .
translation.kha: Te mynta kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga ai ïa ka ri ki nong Ijipt sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar . Un lute bad pynjot lut bad rong noh ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Ijipt kum ka bainong ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u .

translation.en: But when they persecute you in this city , flee ye into another : for verily I say unto you , Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel , till the Son of man be come .
translation.kha: Haba kin pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ha kawei ka shnong , to phet sha kawei pat . Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba phin ym pat lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam jong phi ha baroh ki shnong jong ka Israel ha shuwa ba U Khun U Briew un wan .

translation.en: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in Samaria : and Joash his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jehoash u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: There is one body , and one Spirit , even as ye are called in one hope of your calling ;
translation.kha: Don tang kawei ka met bad uwei U Mynsiem , kumba don tang kawei ka jingkyrmen sha kaba U Blei u la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue : whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard , they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly .
translation.kha: U la sdang ban kren shlur ha ka synagog . Haba ka Priskila bad u Akwila ki la ïohsngew ïa u , ki la ïalam ïa u sha la ïing bad ki la batai ha u kham bniah ïa ka Lynti jong U Blei .

translation.en: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king : only the spoil thereof , and the cattle thereof , shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves : lay thee an ambush for the city behind it .
translation.kha: Men leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba me la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka , hynrei ha kane ka sien me lah ban bat ha lade ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa ki jingri jong ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah da ka jingkyndit na lyndet jong ka .

translation.en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer , and said , Come up to us , and we will shew you a thing . And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer , Come up after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into the hand of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta ki pyrta ïa u Jonathan bad ïa uta u samla ,  Ale shane ! Ngi don ei ei ban ong ïa phi !  U Jonathan u ong ïa uta u samla ,  Bud ïa nga . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki .

translation.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah , in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite , which is before Mamre  ;
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u , u Isaak bad u Ishmael , ki la tep ïa u ha ka krem Makhpelah , kaba ha ka lyngkha kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , kaba dei ka jong u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar u nong Hit .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of Jehoiakim king of Judah  ; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David : and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat , and in the night to the frost .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ma nga U  Trai  , nga ong ha me , ko syiem Jehoïakim , ba yn ym don u ban hiarpateng na me u ban synshar shuh halor ka hima u Dabid . Ïa ka metïap jong me yn bret shabar ha ka jingshit kyr-ang ka sngi ha ka por mynsngi bad ha u thah mynmiet .

translation.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons , which they shall offer unto the  Lord  in the day when he is anointed  ; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual , half of it in the morning , and half thereof at night .
translation.kha: na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh lyngdoh ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron . Ha ka sngi ba yn pynkyntang ïa u , un ai kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  shi kilo u  purew ( kaba ïaryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba man ka sngi ) , shiteng ha ka por mynstep bad shiteng ha ka por janmiet .

translation.en: For want and famine they were solitary  ; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste .
translation.kha: Ki la long kiba duk haduh katta katta bad kiba thngan haduh ba ki bam ïa ki thied tyrkhong — mynmiet , ha khlaw , ha ki jaka kynjah .

translation.en: What are the questions ?
translation.kha: Kiei ki jingkylli ?

translation.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household , and eateth not the bread of idleness .
translation.kha: Ka long borabor kaba smat kaba sting bad ka khmih ïa ki jingdonkam ha ka longïing jong ka .

translation.en: And he shall judge among many people , and rebuke strong nations afar off  ; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up a sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
translation.kha: Un pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , hapdeng ki bor bakhraw hajan bad hajngai . Kin shoh tyrnem ïa la ki waitlam ban pynlong ki lyngkor bad ïa ki sum sha ki wait ngor tnat dieng . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh shuh ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato ym don sa uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ngin kylli ïa U  Trai  ?

translation.en: The bonnets , and the ornaments of the legs , and the headbands , and the tablets , and the earrings ,
translation.kha: bad ïa ki tupia jong ki ; ïa ki jingdeng myntor kiba ki deng ha ki kti jong ki bad ha ki syngkai jong ki ;

translation.en: The  Lord  is good unto them that wait for him , to the soul that seeketh him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba bha ïa uwei pa uwei uba shaniah ha u ,

translation.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way , but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places : whosoever would , he consecrated him , and he became one of the priests of the high places .
translation.kha: U syiem Jeroboam jong ka Israel um shym phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong u , hynrei u ïai jied ïa ki lyngdoh napdeng ki longïing riewpaidbah ban shakri ha ki duwan kiba u la tei . U pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh ïa uno uno kat uba kwah ban long u lyngdoh .

translation.en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it : in the holy place shall it be eaten , in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh uba kñia ïa uta u mrad un bam ïa u ha ka jaka bakhuid , ha ka phyllaw jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha u Sedekaïah ,

translation.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and said unto the princes of Balak , Get you into your land : for the  Lord  refuseth to give me leave to go with you .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Balaam u la leit sha ki nonglamktien jong u Balak bad u ong ,  Khie leit phai sha la ïing ; U  Trai  um shah ba ngan leit bad phi .

translation.en: If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .
translation.kha: Kam pher sha kano ka liang u dieng u khyllem , un don ha ka jaka kaba u la kyllon . Haba ki lyoh ki dap , ka slap .

translation.en: Daniel spake and said , I saw in my vision by night , and , behold , the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea .
translation.kha: Ki lyer ki beh kyrthep na ki liang baroh bad ki shoh ïa ka sla ka duriaw-bah .

translation.en: Then shall ye know that I am the  Lord  , when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars , upon every high hill , in all the tops of the mountains , and under every green tree , and under every thick oak , the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols .
translation.kha: Ïa ki metïap yn pynsaphriang hapdeng ki bleithaw bad sawdong ki duwan , yn pynsaphriang halor uwei pa uwei u lum uba jrong , ha kliar uwei pa uwei u lumbah , ha trai uwei pa uwei u dieng jyrngam bad uwei pa uwei u dieng Sning uba heh , ha ki jaka baroh ba ki thang ïa ki jingkñia ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: And Gederoth , Beth–dagon , and Naamah , and Makkedah  ; sixteen cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Gederoth , ka Bethdagon , ka Naamah , bad ka Makkedah : khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :
translation.kha: Ka leilieh ka thaba na ki lyoh ,

translation.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold  ; three pound of gold went to one shield : and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
translation.kha: U shna ruh laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit bad ar kilo ka ksiar ka leit ha kawei kawei ka stieh . U phah buh ïa kine ki stieh baroh ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon   .

translation.en: So the Levites stilled all the people , saying , Hold your peace , for the day is holy  ; neither be ye grieved .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki la pynjai jai ïa u paidbah bad ong ha ki ban ym sngewsih ha kum kata ka sngi kaba khuid .

translation.en: When thou buildest a new house , then thou shalt make a battlement for thy roof , that thou bring not blood upon thine house , if any man fall from thence .
translation.kha: Haba phi tei ïing thymmai , kynmaw ban da ker ïa ka tduh jong ka tnum ïing , ïoh phi hap kit pop lada uno uno u briew u hap nangta bad u ïap .

translation.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ :
translation.kha: To ngin ai ki jingnguh sha U Blei bad U Kpa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi! Naba ha U Khrist , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi da kaba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem baroh ha ka pyrthei kaba kynja bneng .

translation.en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives  ; and he begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u jied ar ngut ki tnga na ka bynta u syiem Joash , bad ki kha ïa u , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la kren biang ha u ,  Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .

translation.en: Yea , they despised the pleasant land , they believed not his word :
translation.kha: Nangta ki la kyntait ïa ka ri kaba itynnat , namar ba kim ngeit ïa ka jingkular U Blei .

translation.en: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti , unto the coast of Beth–horon the nether , and to Gezer : and the goings out thereof are at the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u suh shaphang sepngi sha ka jaka jong ki Japhlet haduh ka jaka jong ka Beth Haron kaba Sharum . Nangta u suh sha Geser bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .

translation.en: Their drink is sour : they have committed whoredom continually : her rulers with shame do love , Give ye .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dih shibun ka waiñ , ki ïaleh sngewbha ha ki kam nuti jong ki , ki jied ïa ka jingjahburom ban ïa ka burom .

translation.en: Beloved , let us love one another : for love is of God  ; and every one that loveth is born of God , and knoweth God .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit , to ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , namar ka jingieit ka wan na U Blei . Uno uno uba ieit , u long u khun jong U Blei bad u ithuh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And he bought fine linen , and took him down , and wrapped him in the linen , and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock , and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la thied ïa ka jaiñ linen , u la pynhiar ïa ka met shapoh , u la sop ïa ka da ka jaiñ , bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep ïa kaba la lah tih ha u mawsiang . Nangta u pyntyllun ïa u maw uba heh ha ka jaka rung jong ka jingtep .

translation.en: ( Psalm 104 :15  ; 1 Corinthians 6 :10 ) Godly principles benefit us by teaching us to guard not just our actions but also our thoughts .
translation.kha: ( Salm 104 :15 ; 1 Korinth 6 :10 ) Ki aiñ jong U Blei ki pynmyntoi ïa ngi da kaba hikai ïa ngi ban phikir ïa ki jingleh bad ki jingpyrkhat jong ngi .

translation.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance , that God may know mine integrity .
translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei un thew ïa nga ha ki tarajur bahok , bad un ïohi katno uba lui lui nga long .

translation.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes , the captains thereof , and all the rulers thereof , and all the land of his dominion .
translation.kha: Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia . Phah ïa ki syiem ka Media , ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki , bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ri baroh kiba ki synshar .

translation.en: Should ye not hear the words which the  Lord  hath cried by the former prophets , when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity , and the cities thereof round about her , when men inhabited the south and the plain ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa kiba mynshuwa ha ka por mynba ka Jerusalem ka dang manbha bad dap da ki briew bad mynba dang don bun ki briew kiba shong basah ym tang ha ki shnong sawdong ïa ka nongbah hynrei kumjuh ruh ha ka phang bashathie bad ha ki kjat lum ha ka phang sepngi .

translation.en: But thou shalt die in peace : and with the burnings of thy fathers , the former kings which were before thee , so shall they burn odours for thee  ; and they will lament thee , saying , Ah lord ! for I have pronounced the word , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Men ïap ha kaba suk , bad kumba ki briew ki thang jingiwbih haba ki tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong me , kiba long ki syiem ha shuwa jong me , ha kajuh ka rukom kin thang ki jingiwbih na ka bynta jong me . Kin ïambriew namar jong me bad kin ong , ‘ U syiem jong ngi u la ïap !’ Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: O  Lord  , the hope of Israel , all that forsake thee shall be ashamed , and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth , because they have forsaken the  Lord  , the fountain of living waters .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; baroh kiba la lyndet ïa me yn buh ha ka jinglehrain . Kin jah noh kum ki kyrteng ba la thoh ha ka khyndew , namar ki la lyndet ïa me , U  Trai  , uba long ka umpohliew ki um basngur .

translation.en: The mandrakes give a smell , and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old , which I have laid up for thee , O my beloved .
translation.kha: To shad , to shad , ko  theisamla ka Shullam . Shah ïa ngi ban peit ïa phi katba phi dang shad . Balei phi kwah ban khmih ïa nga katba nga dang shad hapdeng ki nongkhmih kai ?

translation.en: For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .
translation.kha: namar ka khun marwei jong u , kaba la khat-ar snem ka rta , ka la jan ïap . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid , ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: Exalt ye the  Lord  our God , and worship at his footstool  ; for he is holy .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; to mane ha khmat ka khet jong u ! Uba Khuid long ma u !

translation.en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands ,
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi tip , A  Trai  , ba ki patsha jong ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa shibun ki hima , ki pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki ban sah kynjah ,

translation.en: Then the priest shall see the plague : and , behold , if it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; and there be in it a yellow thin hair  ; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a dry scall , even a leprosy upon the head or beard .
translation.kha: Lada ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh hangta u lam stem bad stang , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
translation.kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .

translation.en: And the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel ba u ïeng hangta ba u da bat ïa ka waitlam , ka phet noh na surok bad ka la phai sha ki lyngkha . U Balaam u sympat ïa kata ka kada bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ka sha surok .

translation.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord  God  : I will make mention of thy righteousness , even of thine only .
translation.kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka bor jong me , A  Trai  U Nongsynshar ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingbha jong me , tang ka jong me hi .

translation.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : for the anointing oil of the  Lord  is upon you . And they did according to the word of Moses .
translation.kha: Wat mih shabar ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ïoh phi ïap , namar la pynkyntang ïa phi da ka umphniang pynsleh jong U  Trai .  Kumta ki la leh kumba u Moses u la ong .

translation.en: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , thou that killest the prophets , and stonest them which are sent unto thee , how often would I have gathered thy children together , even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings , and ye would not !
translation.kha: A Jerusalem , Jerusalem ! Pha pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad lynthem maw ïa ki nonglamktien kiba U Blei u la phah ha pha ! Katno sien nga la kwah ban kdup ha ki ksang ti jong nga ïa ki briew jong pha baroh , kumba ka syiar ka lumlang ïa la ki khun hapoh ki thapniang jong ka , hynrei pham shym la shah ïa nga .

translation.en: And he said , Art thou my very son Esau ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: Hynrei hamar ba un sa ai artat ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , u la kylli biang ,  Phi dei shisha u Iso ?  U ruh u jubab ,  Nga dei !

translation.en: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps , and strangled for his lionesses , and filled his holes with prey , and his dens with ravin .
translation.kha: U sing u pynïap ïa ka jingbam jong u bad u tar ïa ka lyngkhot lyngkhot na ka bynta ka sing jong u bad ki khun jong ka ; u la pyndap ïa ka krem jong u da ka doh ba la patar .

translation.en: Woe to Ariel , to Ariel , the city where David dwelt ! add ye year to year  ; let them kill sacrifices .
translation.kha: Ka duwan U Blei , kaba long ka Jerusalem hi , kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ka nongbah ha kaba u Dabid u la sher dara kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ai ba sa kawei ne ar ki snem kin wan bad leit , ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai bad ki Jingkhawai Niam ,

translation.en: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness , and all kings thy glory : and thou shalt be called by a new name , which the mouth of the  Lord  shall name .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ba pha ïoh ka jingjop ! bad ki syiem jong ki baroh kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong pha . Yn khot ïa pha da ka kyrteng kaba thymmai , ka kyrteng ba U  Trai  hi u ai .

translation.en: And the Chaldeans shall come again , and fight against this city , and take it , and burn it with fire .
translation.kha: Te ki nong Babilonia kin wan biang , kin tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , kin kurup ïa ka , bad kin thang duh ïa ka .

translation.en: Build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them  ;
translation.kha: ‘ Tei ïa ki ïing bad shongduh . Thaw ki kper bad bam ïa kaei kaba phi thung hangta .

translation.en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u la im sa sanspah snem bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker : of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus ;
translation.kha: Kaba kum kata ka jinghikai ka long kum ka prum kaba bam noh ïa ka doh . Ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la hikai kum ïa kita kiei kiei ki dei u Hymenaïos bad u Philetos .

translation.en: After these things the word of the  Lord  came unto Abram in a vision , saying , Fear not , Abram : I am thy shield , and thy exceeding great reward .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Abram u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw bad ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , ko Abram . Ngan ïada ïa me na ka jingma , bad ngan ai ha me ka bainong kaba khraw .

translation.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards  ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .
translation.kha: Nga la khynñiuh ; phi la pynlong ïa nga ban thrang eh ïa ka jingieit kum u nongñiah kali ïapom u thrang ïa ka thma .

translation.en: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples ,
translation.kha: Katba baroh ki paidbah ki dang shahshkor ïa u , U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,

translation.en: And one of the elders saith unto me , Weep not : behold , the Lion of the tribe of Judah , the Root of David , hath prevailed to open the book , and to loose the seven seals thereof .
translation.kha: Te uwei na ki nongsharai balang u la ong ha nga ,  Wat ïam . Ha khmih ! U Sing na ka jait Judah , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , u la ïoh ïa ka jingjop , bad u lah ban pynpait ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait bad ban plied ïa ka kot kli .

translation.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles  ; Prepare war , wake up the mighty men , let all the men of war draw near  ; let them come up :
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynbna hapdeng ki jaitbynriew : ‘ To Pynkhreh na ka bynta ka thma ; khot ïa ki nongïaleh thma ; ïalumlang ïa ki shipai bad tur shaphrang !

translation.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years : seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U la long u syiem ka Israel sawphew snem , u da synshar hynñiew snem ha Hebron bad laiphew lai snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And call no man your father upon the earth : for one is your Father , which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Bad phim dei ban khot ïano ïano ha kane ka pyrthei ‘ u Kpa ,’ namar ba phi don tang uwei u Kpa ha bneng .

translation.en: And Hamor communed with them , saying , The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter : I pray you give her him to wife .
translation.kha: U Hamor u ong ha u ,  U khun jong nga u Shekhem u la ïapmat ïa ka khun jong phi ; sngewbha shah ïa u ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And he overtook them , and he spake unto them these same words .
translation.kha: Ynda uta u shakri u la lap ïa ki , u la kren ha ki ïa kijuh ki ktien .

translation.en: And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee , or if thou know him not , then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house , and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it , and thou shalt restore it to him again .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u shong jngai , lane lada phim tip uei u trai jong ka , ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong phi . Ynda u trai u wan wad ïa ka , ai ïa ka ha u .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem , and drop thy word toward the holy places , and prophesy against the land of Israel ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kyntait ïa ka Jerusalem . Kyntait ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane . Maham ïa ka ri Israel .

translation.en: But he shall not defile himself , being a chief man among his people , to profane himself .
translation.kha: Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka jingïap jong kito kiba ïalong ba-ha-ïing bad u na ka jingshongkurim .

translation.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance , he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïoh spah da kaba kheiñ sut bad shim kabu ïa ki briew , ka spah jong phi kan leit sha uwei pat uba lehsbun ïa kiba duk .

translation.en: And there was a man of mount Ephraim , whose name was Micah .
translation.kha: Shisien la don u briew uba kyrteng u Mikah , uba shong ha ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I am not learned .
translation.kha: Lada phi ai ïa ka ha uno uno u bym lah ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha phi , un jubab ba um tip kumno ban pule .

translation.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , because he would not spend the time in Asia : for he hasted , if it were possible for him , to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost .
translation.kha: U Paul u la kut jingmut ban ïaid lait ïa ka Ephesos , ba kumta yn ym pynsep-ei ïa ka por ha ka probins jong ka Asia . U la kyrkieh ban poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Pentekost , lada ka long kaba lah .

translation.en: To keep the commandments of the  Lord  , and his statutes , which I command thee this day for thy good ?
translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ki ha phi mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa phi hi .

translation.en: And I saw a great white throne , and him that sat on it , from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away  ; and there was found no place for them .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka khet balieh kaba khraw bad ïa uta uba shong ha ka . Ka pyrthei bad ka bneng ki la phet na khmat jong u bad ym shym la ïohi shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness : but the righteous hath hope in his death .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki wallam ïa la ka jong ka jingkyllon noh da ki kam basniew jong ki , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba bha la ïada da ka jinglonghok jong ki .

translation.en: And he said unto Jesus , Lord , remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  To kynmaw ïa nga , ko Jisu , haba me wan kum u Syiem !

translation.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed , and will make him afraid : and all the people that are with him shall flee  ; and I will smite the king only :
translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa u katba u dang thait bad noh mynsiem . Un sa sheptieng ; bad ki rangbah jong u baroh kin phet krad . Ngan pynïap tang ïa u syiem ,

translation.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Libnah with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Nalor jong ka Hebron ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , la ai ïa kine ki nongbah harum ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron u lyngdoh : Ka Libnah ,

translation.en: Ten fat oxen , and twenty oxen out of the pastures , and an hundred sheep , beside harts , and roebucks , and fallowdeer , and fatted fowl .
translation.kha: shiphew tylli ki masi ba la bsa pynsngaid ha sem , arphew tylli ki masi bam phlang ha lum , bad shispah tylli ki langbrot , nalor ki skei , ki khiat , ki  keirang , bad ki syiar .

translation.en: So that the fishes of the sea , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the field , and all creeping things that creep upon the earth , and all the men that are upon the face of the earth , shall shake at my presence , and the mountains shall be thrown down , and the steep places shall fall , and every wall shall fall to the ground .
translation.kha: Man la ka dohkha bad ka sim , man la ka mrad , barit bad baheh , bad man la u briew halor ka sla pyrthei kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ïa nga . Ki lumbah kin khyllem , ki riat kin twa , bad kawei pa kawei ka kynroh kan kyllon .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest  ; ( for thou , even thou only , knowest the hearts of all the children of men  ; )
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki na ka ïing jong me ha bneng , map ïa ki , bad ïarap ïa ki . Tang ma me hi uba tip ïa ki jingmut jong ka dohnud briew .

translation.en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks  ; for they also are turned back , and are fled away together : they did not stand , because the day of their calamity was come upon them , and the time of their visitation .
translation.kha: Wat ki shipai ba shu wai jong ka ki long khlem bor kum ki khun masi . Kim shym ïeng ban ïaleh ; baroh na ki , ki phai bad phet noh . Ka sngi jong ka jingshahjop ka la poi , ka por jong ka jingpynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: I will hear thee , said he , when thine accusers are also come . And he commanded him to be kept in Herod s judgment hall .
translation.kha: u la ong ,  Ngan sa bishar ïa me ynda poi ki nongmudui jong me .  Nangta u la ai hukum ban buh ïa u Paul ha ka jingap phira hapoh ka jaka sah jong u lyngskor .

translation.en: ( Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah . ) Then said the children of Israel , Tell us , how was this wickedness ?
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki paid Benjamin ki ïohsngew ba ki para jait Israel baroh ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki Israel ki kylli ,  Ïathuh ïa ngi , kumno kane ka kam runar ka la jia ?

translation.en: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me : my judgment was as a robe and a diadem .
translation.kha: Borabor nga la lehhok bad lehbha .

translation.en: They that dwell in mine house , and my maids , count me for a stranger : I am an alien in their sight .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ju long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka ïing jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki shakri kynthei ki leh ïa nga kum ïa uba kim ithuh bad u nongwei .

translation.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them  ; then he shall bear her iniquity .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u pyndam ïa kata hadien , un hap ban shah ïa ki jingpynshitom na ka jingbymlah ban pyndep ïa ka kular .

translation.en: So he departed thence , and found Elisha the son of Shaphat , who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him , and he with the twelfth : and Elijah passed by him , and cast his mantle upon him .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la mihnoh bad shem ïa u Elisha ba u dang pynlur ïa shi jur ki masi dab ; la don khatwei jur ki masi dab kiba don ha ki lyngkor ha khmat jong u , bad u dang pynlur ïa kiba khatduh . U Elijah u la law noh ïa la ka barandi bad u la pynkup ha u Elisha .

translation.en: And he asked them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven .
translation.kha: Katno tylli u kpu phi don ?  U Jisu u la kylli .  Hynñiew tylli ki kpu ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: If then God so clothe the grass , which is to day in the field , and to morrow is cast into the oven  ; how much more will he clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangne mynta bad uba jah noh la shai , ïa uba la thang noh ha ka lawar ding . Hato Un ym jin da la thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? A katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !

translation.en: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king , and without a prince , and without a sacrifice , and without an image , and without an ephod , and without teraphim :
translation.kha: Ha kane kajuh ka rukom ki briew ka Israel kin hap ban ap slem khlem ki syiem ne ki nongïalam , khlem jingkñia lane rishot mawkyntang , khlem bleithaw lane dur ban pyndonkam ha kaba khan blei .

translation.en: And they sent and called him . So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba na ka jait bashaphang shatei ki phah khot ïa u ; bad baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam , bad ki ong ha u ,

translation.en: If the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee , then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock , which the  Lord  hath given thee , as I have commanded thee , and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka jaka mane Blei ka jngai eh , phi lah , ha kano kano ka por ba phi kwah , ban pynïap ïa kano kano ka masi lane ka blang ba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi , bad bam ïa ka doh jong ka ha la ïing , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea , to compass the land of Edom : and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la mihnoh na u Lum Hor na ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khmut duriaw Akaba , ban ïaid sawdong ïa ka ri Edom . Hynrei ha lynti kim lah shah shuh bad ki la kren pyrshah ïa U Blei bad ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And as they went on their way , they came unto a certain water : and the eunuch said , See , here is water  ; what doth hinder me to be baptized ?
translation.kha: Katba ki nang ïaleit ha lynti , ki la poi ha ka jaka ha kaba la don khyndiat ka um , bad uta u rangbah synshar u la ong ,  Hangne ka don ka um . Kaei kaba khang ïa nga na kaba shah pynbaptis ?

translation.en: And they answered , We will willingly give them . And they spread a garment , and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki jubab ,  Ngin ai ïa ki ha phi da kaba sngewbha .  Ki siang kawei ka jaiñ , bad uwei pa uwei u buh hangta ïa ki sohshkor ba u la shim .

translation.en: And when they saw him afar off , even before he came near unto them , they conspired against him to slay him .
translation.kha: Na jngai ki la ïohi ïa u , bad katba un da poi hajan jong ki , ki lah da ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad rai ban pynïap noh ïa u .

translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , I cannot speak : for I am a child .
translation.kha: Nga jubab ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngam tip kumno ban kren ; nga dang khynnah eh .

translation.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands  ; and let her own works praise her in the gates .
translation.kha: Ai burom ïa ka ïa baroh kaba ka leh . Ka dei hok ban burom da baroh .

translation.en: In him was life  ; and the life was the light of men .
translation.kha: U Ktien u la long u tyllong jong ka jingim ; bad kane ka jingim ka la wanrah ka jingshai ïa u bynriew .

translation.en: And they went into Capernaum  ; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue , and taught .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha ka shnong Kapernam , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , U Jisu u la leit sha ka synagog bad u la sdang ban hikai .

translation.en: For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare  ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them .
translation.kha: Phim tip da lei lei lano ka por jong phi ka wan . Kum ki sim kiba la ngat kynsan ha ki jingriam , kum ki dohkha kiba la ngat ha ka jar , ngi la shah riam ha ki katto katne ki khep basniew ha kaba ngim shym khmih lynti satia ïa kata .

translation.en: I find then a law , that , when I would do good , evil is present with me .
translation.kha: Kumta nga shem ba kane ka hukum ka treikam ; haba nga kwah ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha , kaei kaba sniew ka long tang ma ka , ka jingjied kaba nga don .

translation.en: He couched , he lay down as a lion , and as a great lion : who shall stir him up ? Blessed is he that blesseth thee , and cursed is he that curseth thee .
translation.kha: Kane ka jaitbynriew ka long kum u sing uba khlaiñ ; Haba u thiah , ym don ba nud ban kyrsiew ïa u . Uta uba kyrkhu ïa ki Israel un ïoh jingkyrkhu , Bad uta uba tim ïa ki Israel un ïoh ka jingtim .

translation.en: And they were glad , and covenanted to give him money .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewbha bad ki la tyrwa ban siew pisa ïa u .

translation.en: God is my strength and power : and he maketh my way perfect .
translation.kha: Une U Blei u long ka jakarieh baskhem jong nga , bad u pynshngain ïa ka lynti ïaid jong nga .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Forbid him not : for he that is not against us is for us .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa u bad ïa kiwei pat ki synran ,  namar uno uno u bym pyrshah ïa phi u long ha ka liang jong phi .

translation.en: And Thomas answered and said unto him , My Lord and my God .
translation.kha: U Thomas u la jubab ïa u ,  U Trai jong nga bad U Blei jong nga !

translation.en: It shall be accomplished before his time , and his branch shall not be green .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ka por jong u kan kut , un ïapstai noh , un ïapstai noh kum ki tnat bad kin ym jyrngam biang .

translation.en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen , such as they have not heard .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jong nga , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: And said , By myself have I sworn , saith the  Lord  , for because thou hast done this thing , and hast not withheld thy son , thine only son :
translation.kha: Nga la smai da ka kyrteng jong nga — U  Trai  u kren — ba ngan kyrkhu kyrhai ïa me . Namar me la leh ïa kane , bad mem shym la tyngkai noh ïa la u khun marwei na nga ,

translation.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled : thou hast not pardoned .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop bad ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , bad ma me A  Trai  , mem pat shym map ïa ngi .

translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle , and were gathered together at Soco , which belongeth to Judah , and pitched between Soco and Azekah , in Ephes–dammim .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh thma ha Sokoh , ka shnong kaba ha Judah ; ki sher dara ha kawei ka jaka kaba ki khot Ephes Dammim , kaba hapdeng ka Sokoh bad ka Asekah .

translation.en: But if , while we seek to be justified by Christ , we ourselves also are found sinners , is therefore Christ the minister of sin ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada , kumba ngi pyrshang ban pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi bad U Khrist , yn shem ïa ngi ba ngi long ki nongpop kumba long hi ki Jentil — hato kane ka mut ba U Khrist u pynlong ka daw ïa ka pop ? Da lei lei ruh em !

translation.en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words , and said unto him , Are we blind also ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki Pharisi kiba ïadon hangta lem bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Da shisha mem mut ba ngi ruh ngi matlah ?

translation.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red , when it giveth his colour in the cup , when it moveth itself aright .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba ka waiñ kan pynshoi ïa phi , wat la ka long kaba saw hain hain , wat la ka phyrnai ha ka khuri , bad ka hiar jem jai .

translation.en: Others said , These are not the words of him that hath a devil . Can a devil open the eyes of the blind ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ïa-ong ,  U briew uba shongksuid um lah ban kren kumne ! Kumno u ksuid u lah ban ai jingïoh imat pat ïa ki briew kiba matlah ?

translation.en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man , which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts ;
translation.kha: Kumta to iehnoh ïa u briew barim jong phi , uba pynlong ïa phi ban im kumba phi la ju im — u briew uba rim uba la nang pynjot da ki jingkwah brai bashukor jong ka .

translation.en: Ye therefore , beloved , seeing ye know these things before , beware lest ye also , being led away with the error of the wicked , fall from your own stedfastness .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , phi la tip lypa ïa kane . To sumar ïa lade , namarkata , ba phin ym shah ïalam bakla da ki jingpynbakla ki briew ki bym bat aiñ bad phi hap noh na ka jaka ba la shongshngain kaba phi don .

translation.en: And bring hither the fatted calf , and kill it  ; and let us eat , and be merry :
translation.kha: Nangta khie leit bad shim ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha bad pynïap ïa u , bad to ngin ïalehkmen da ka jingkhawai !

translation.en: This is my commandment , That ye love one another , as I have loved you .
translation.kha: Ka hukum jong nga ka long kane : To ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba nga ieit ïa phi .

translation.en: For though I would desire to glory , I shall not be a fool ; for I will say the truth : but now I forbear , lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me .
translation.kha: Lada nga la kwah ban sngewsarong , ngan ym jin da la long uba bieit , namar ngan jin da la ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Hynrei ngan ym kob sarong , namar ngam kwah mano mano ban don ka jingpyrkhat ba kham halor ïa nga ban ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi ba nga leh lane u la ïohsngew ïa kaba nga ong .

translation.en: For before that certain came from James , he did eat with the Gentiles : but when they were come , he withdrew and separated himself , fearing them which were of the circumcision .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba katto katne ngut ki rangbah ba la phah da u Jakob kin poi hangta , u Petros u la ïabam lang bad ki parabangeit Jentil . Hynrei hadien ba kine ki rangbah ki la poi , u la kynriah noh bad um shym ïabam lang shuh bad ki Jentil , namar u la sheptieng ïa kito kiba ha ka liang kiba otsher ïa ki .

translation.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof  ; but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri baseisoh , ban lehkmen ïa ki jingot jong ka , bad kiei kiei kiwei pat kiba bha jong ka . Hynrei pynban ki la pynjot ïa ka ri jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And the fear of the  Lord  fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah , so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki hima kiba don sawdong ban sheptieng ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat .

translation.en: And the king sent , and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  The children of this world marry , and are given in marriage :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ki shynrang bad ki kynthei jong kane ka juk ki ïashongkurim ,

translation.en: And the city lieth foursquare , and the length is as large as the breadth : and he measured the city with the reed , twelve thousand furlongs . The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka la long kaba sawdong janai , ka ïar kat ka lynter jong ka . U angel u la thew ïa ka nongbah da u diengthew jong u : Ka la don ar hajar sawspah kilomitar ka lynter bad ka la ïar bad kynjang kat ka lynter jong ka .

translation.en: If iniquity be in thine hand , put it far away , and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles .
translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa kaba sniew bad ka bymdei na ka ïing jong me .

translation.en: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers  ; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them , and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them .
translation.kha: Bad lada ki paid Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Aiñ baroh ba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la ai ha ki , nangta ngan ym shah ba yn beh noh ïa ki na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast  ; the males shall be the  Lord s .
translation.kha: Ynda u ai ïa ka ha phi , phi dei ban ai sha U  Trai  ïa u khun nyngkong baroh . Man uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad u long u jong U  Trai .

translation.en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles ; which is Christ in you , the hope of glory :
translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong U Blei ka long ban pyntip ïa ka jingmaïan jong u ha ki briew jong u , ïa kane ka jingmaïan basngewtynnat bad badonburom kaba u don na ka bynta ki briew baroh . Bad ka jingmaïan ka long , ba U Khrist u don hapoh jong phi , kaba mut , ba phin ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong U Blei .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; In those days it shall come to pass , that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations , even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew , saying , We will go with you : for we have heard that God is with you .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi shiphew ngut ki nongwei kin wan sha uwei u Jiw bad ong , ‘ Ngi kwah ban ïoh bynta ha ka lawei jong phi , namar ngi la lah ïohsngew ba U Blei u don bad phi .’

translation.en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me , and bow down themselves unto me , saying , Get thee out , and all the people that follow thee : and after that I will go out . And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynkut da kaba ong ,  Ki rangbah synshar jong phi baroh kin sa wan sha nga bad dem khrup ha khmat jong nga , bad kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh bad ban mihnoh . Hadien kata ngan sa leit .  Nangta u Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh da ka jingbitar bakhraw .

translation.en: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father , and from our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And I saw , and bare record that this is the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kata ,  la ong U Ïoannis ,  bad nga ong ha phi ba une u dei U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: Behold , the former things are come to pass , and new things do I declare : before they spring forth I tell you of them .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei kiba nga ïathuhlypa mynta ki la jia shisha . Mynta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai wat ha shuwa ba kin sdang ban jia .

translation.en: And for the majesty that he gave him , all people , nations , and languages , trembled and feared before him : whom he would he slew  ; and whom he would he kept alive  ; and whom he would he set up  ; and whom he would he put down .
translation.kha: U la long uba khraw katta katta ba ki briew jong ki hima baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ki la sheptieng ïa u bad khynñiuh . Lada u la kwah ban pynïap ïano ïano u leh kumta ; lada u kwah ban ri pynim ïano ïano , u leh kumta . U pyndonburom lane pynjahburom ïa uno uno , uba u kwah .

translation.en: Surely the Lord  God  will do nothing , but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar um ju leh ei ei khlem da pynpaw ïa ka jingthmu jong u ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor , saying , Get me this damsel to wife .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha u kpa jong u ,  Nga kwah ba phin pynïoh ïa ka Dinah kum ka tnga ïa nga .

translation.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba la kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem da ki kynhun shipai , te phin tip ba shen yn sa pynjot noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was yet in Egypt , heard of it , ( for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon , and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt  ; )
translation.kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban phet ïap na u syiem Solomon , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan phai noh na Ijipt .

translation.en: And when ye come into an house , salute it .
translation.kha: Haba phi rung shapoh ka ïing , to ong , ‘ Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .’

translation.en: Daniel answered in the presence of the king , and said , The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men , the astrologers , the magicians , the soothsayers , shew unto the king  ;
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , ym don uno uno u nongleh byrtong , u nongleh myntor , u nongbatai kupar , lane u nongkhmih khlur uba lah ban ïathuh ha phi ïa kata .

translation.en: Declare ye it not at Gath , weep ye not at all : in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust .
translation.kha: Wat ïathuh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ha Gath shaphang ka jingshahjop jong ngi ; wat ai ba kin ïohi ba phi ïam . Ko ki briew ka Beth Leaphrah , pyn-i ïa ka jinglyng-a jong phi da kaba kyrsum ha u pui pui !

translation.en: Having yet therefore one son , his wellbeloved , he sent him also last unto them , saying , They will reverence my son .
translation.kha: Uba dang sah ïa uba yn phah u long u khun ba-ieit jong u trai hi . Ha kaba khatduh , te , u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki nongshimwai . ‘ Nga ngeit skhem kin burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .

translation.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man  ; that all men may know his work .
translation.kha: U pynsangeh ïa ka jingtrei jong ki briew ; u pyn-i ha ki ïa kaei kaba u lah ban leh .

translation.en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces , and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire , and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate : for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot , and they shall return to the hire of an harlot .
translation.kha: Ïa ki bleithaw bakordor jong ka baroh yn pynpait lyngkhot , baroh kaba la ai sha ki nuti ka templ yn pynjot ha ka ding , bad ki durblei jong ka baroh kin long ka kynton ba la shu ieh . Ka Samaria ka la lum ïa kine kiei kiei na ka bynta ki jinglehniam ba pynseisoh , bad mynta ki nongshun jong ka kin rah noh ïa ki na ka bynta ki nuti ka templ shawei pat .

translation.en: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day , the loss of children , and widowhood : they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries , and for the great abundance of thine enchantments .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka shikhyllipmat , tang ha kawei ka sngi , kine baroh ar tylli kiei kiei ki wan jia . Wat hapdeng ki kam myntor baroh ba pha pyndonkam , phan duh noh ïa la u tnga bad ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: Thou , even thou , art  Lord  alone  ; thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host , the earth , and all things that are therein , the seas , and all that is therein , and thou preservest them all  ; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .
translation.kha: Bad nangta ki Israel ki duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai :  Ma me , Ko  Trai  , tang ma me hi marwei me long U  Trai  ; me thaw ïa ki bneng bad ki khlur jong ka sahit bneng . Me thaw ïa ka ryngkew bad ïa ka duriaw bad baroh kiba don ha ki ; me ai jingim ïa baroh . Ki bor ha bneng ki dem bad ki mane ïa me .

translation.en: Forty stripes he may give him , and not exceed : lest , if he should exceed , and beat him above these with many stripes , then thy brother should seem vile unto thee .
translation.kha: Lah ban sympat ïa u haduh sawphew thri , hynrei ym palat ïa kata ; lada palat ïa kata , kan pynpoh dor ïa u ha khmat ki briew .

translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , What hast thou done , that thou hast stolen away unawares to me , and carried away my daughters , as captives taken with the sword ?
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Balei me shukor ïa nga bad ïalam noh ïa ki khun kynthei jong nga la kum ïa ki kynthei kiba shah kem ha ka thma ?

translation.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth , which built desolate places for themselves  ;
translation.kha: ban ïohthiah kum ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar kiba la tei pat ïa ki ïingsyiem mynbarim .

translation.en: And the Lord  God  of hosts is he that toucheth the land , and it shall melt , and all that dwell therein shall mourn : and it shall rise up wholly like a flood  ; and shall be drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u ktah ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka khynñiuh baroh kiba shong ha ka ki ïambriew , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kiew ka hiar kum ka wah Nile .

translation.en: Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day , a sabbath of rest to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei jingtrei , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ban long kaba kyntang , ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga U  Trai . Uno uno uba trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .

translation.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee , Ye must be born again .
translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh namar ba nga ong ha me , ba ka dei ban kha pat ïa phi baroh .

translation.en: And say unto them , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , ye kings of Judah , and all Judah , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , that enter in by these gates :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki syiem bad ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah bad ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ba sah ha Jerusalem bad rung sha kine ki khyrdop , ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong .

translation.en: And he said , Thou canst not see my face : for there shall no man see me , and live .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym shah ba men ïohi ïa ka khmat jong nga , namar uno uno uba ïohi ïa ka un ym im shuh ,

translation.en: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised , which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war : and they have laid their swords under their heads , but their iniquities shall be upon their bones , though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ym shym la ai ha ki ka jingtep donburom kum ïa ki riewshlur ha ki por mynbarim , kiba da kieng atiar bha haba ki leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ïa ki waitlam jong ki la buh hapoh ki khlieh jong ki bad ïa ki stieh jong ki halor ki met jong ki . Kine ki riewshlur ki la long shisien kiba khlaiñbor bha ban pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .

translation.en: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age , and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father , in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
translation.kha: U Gideon u khun jong u Joash u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Joash u kpa jong u , kaba ha Ophrah , ka nongrit jong ka kur Abieser .

translation.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations , whose builder and maker is God .
translation.kha: Naba u Abraham u la ap khmih ïa ka nongbah kaba U Blei u la pynwandur bad u la tei , ka nongbah kaba don ki nongrim baneh .

translation.en: The  Lord  will not spare him , but then the anger of the  Lord  and his jealousy shall smoke against that man , and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him , and the  Lord  shall blot out his name from under heaven .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ym map kum ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka jingbitar shla jong u kan meh lep pyrshah ïa u , bad ki jingjynjar baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab kin ngat ha u haduh ba U  Trai  un da pynjot thiaw ïa u .

translation.en: But and if we say , Of men  ; all the people will stone us : for they be persuaded that John was a prophet .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi ong ‘ Na u briew ,’ kine ki paidbah hangne kin lynthem maw ïa ngi , namar ki la sngewskhem ba u Ïoannis u la long u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  Sayest thou this thing of thyself , or did others tell it thee of me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato kane ka jingkylli ka wan na me ne kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa me shaphang jong nga ?

translation.en: And he departed , and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him : and all men did marvel .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u briew u la leit bad u la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Dekapolis , da kaba ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la lah leh ïa u . Bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa kata , ki la sngewlyngngoh .

translation.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you , great is my glorying of you : I am filled with comfort , I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation .
translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna katta katta ïa phi ; nga sngewsarong na ka bynta jong phi ! Ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh nga dang dap hi da ka jingshlur ; nga shlei da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he bringeth them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine ; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers , having itching ears ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan sa poi haba ki briew kin ym shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai shongtynrai badei , hynrei kin kohnguh ïa la ki jingkwah bad kin nang pynbun ïa ki nonghikai ki ban ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki shkor ba-dait jong ki , ki kwah ban ïohsngew .

translation.en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven , and though she should fortify the height of her strength , yet from me shall spoilers come unto her , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat la ka Babilon ka lah ban kiew sha suiñbneng bad tei ka kut baskhem hangta , ngan dang ïai phah hi ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you , even a lamentation , O house of Israel .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko ki paid Israel , ïa kane ka jingrwai leit ontep kaba nga rwai ha phi :

translation.en: At the end of a regular pioneer’s first year of full-time service , he or she is enrolled in a six-day school that may be held at a nearby Kingdom Hall .
translation.kha: Ynda ki pioneer batista ki la trei pura shisnem , ïa ki la ju pynrung kyrteng ha ka skul ba hynriew sngi kiba ju pynlong ha ka Ïing Hima ba jan tam .

translation.en: Who hath wrought and done it , calling the generations from the beginning ? I the  Lord  , the first , and with the last  ; I am he .
translation.kha: Mano dei uta ba pynlong ïa kane ban jia ? Uba la thmu skhem ïa ka jingïaid ka histori ? Nga , U  Trai  , nga la don hangta naduh mynnyngkong , bad nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïai don hangta ha kaba kut .

translation.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove : and Asa cut down her idol , and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron .
translation.kha: U Syiem Asa u pynkynriah ïa ka Maakah ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan kum ka syiemsad , namar ka la thaw ka bleithaw kynsha jong ka Asherah ka blei jingseisoh . U Asa u pynpra ïa ka bleithaw , u pyndkut ïa ka , bad u thang ïa ki lyngkhot ha ka them Kidron .
