translation.en: And Micaiah said , If thou certainly return in peace , then hath not the  Lord  spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , all ye people .
translation.kha: Lada phi wan phai khlem shah pynïap ,  u Mikaïah u pyrta ,  te U  Trai  um shym la kren lyngba jong nga !  Bad u ong shuh ,  Sngap ïa nga phi baroh , ïa kaei kaba nga la ong !

translation.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us , and we will hang them up unto the  Lord  in Gibeah of Saul , whom the  Lord  did choose . And the king said , I will give them .
translation.kha: Kumta aiti ha ngi hynñiew ngut na ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u , bad ngin phasi ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai  ha Gibeah , ka shnong trai jong u Saul , u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai .   Ngan aiti ïa ki ,  u syiem u ong .

translation.en: Remember , I pray thee , who ever perished , being innocent ? or where were the righteous cut off ?
translation.kha: Pyrkhat pat mynta . Jer ïa kawei ka sien mynba u riewhok u ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: And he answered them , saying ,  Who is my mother , or my brethren ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka kmie jong nga ? Kiei ki para jong nga ?

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Are ye so without understanding also ? Do ye not perceive , that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man , it cannot defile him  ;
translation.kha: Phim long kiba kham stad ban ïa kiwei pat ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki .  Hato phim shemphang ? Ym don kaba rung shapoh u briew na shabar kaba lah shisha ban pynlong bymkhuid ïa u ,

translation.en: Grace be with you , mercy , and peace , from God the Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ , the Son of the Father , in truth and love .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong U Kpa , un ai ha ngi ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk ; to ai ba kin long ki jong ngi ha ka jingshisha bad ka jingieit .

translation.en: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it  ; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban isih ïa uno uno uba kwah ban pynmynsaw ïa u da ka jinglamler . Ka jingkren bymshisha kam wanrah ei ei hynrei ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: The merchandise of gold , and silver , and precious stones , and of pearls , and fine linen , and purple , and silk , and scarlet , and all thyine wood , and all manner vessels of ivory , and all manner vessels of most precious wood , and of brass , and iron , and marble ,
translation.kha: ym don mano mano ban thied ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila jong ki ; ki mar linen , ka jaiñ sawbthuh , ka jaiñ rusom , bad ka jaiñ basaw hain hain ; ïa baroh ki jait dieng bakynsai bad baroh ki jait jingthaw ba la shna na ka bniat hati bad na ka dieng baremdor , na ka rnong , ka nar , bad u maw marbl ;

translation.en: Before him went the pestilence , and burning coals went forth at his feet .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingpang ha shuwa jong u bad hukum ba ka jingïap kan bud ïa u .

translation.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .
translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki nongap langbrot ha kata ka bynta jong ka ri kiba la sahmiet ha ki lum , da kaba sumar ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .

translation.en: The fruit of thy land , and all thy labours , shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up  ; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway :
translation.kha: Ki nongwei kin bam ei ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi ha kiba phi la trei shitom , katba phi pat phim ym ïoh ei ei lait tang ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingshah lehbeiñ suda .

translation.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kat kum ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap , kane ka dei kaba kumno ka long ha kata ka Sngi ha kaba U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist un bishar ïa ki jingmut barieh jong ki briew baroh .

translation.en: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names , like the engravings of a signet  ; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes .
translation.kha: Ha uwei uwei na ki , thoh ïa ka kyrteng jong uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel .

translation.en: That we should be saved from our enemies , and from the hand of all that hate us  ;
translation.kha: ba un pynim ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi , na ka bor jong kito baroh kiba isih ïa ngi .

translation.en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself , saying , After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure , my lord being old also ?
translation.kha: Kumta ka Sarah ka rkhie sammut marwei , bad ka ong ,  Mynta ba nga la tymmen bad ngam donbor shuh , ngan dang lah mo ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha ? Nalor kata , u tnga jong nga ruh u la tymmen .

translation.en: Forasmuch as we have heard , that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words , subverting your souls , saying , Ye must be circumcised , and keep the law : to whom we gave no such commandment :
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ba katto katne ngut kiba la leit na ka kynhun jong ngi kiba la pynjynjar bad pynkhuslai ïa phi da kaei kaba ki la ong ; pynban , kim shym la ïohpdiang kano kano ka jingbthah na ngi .

translation.en: And this is his commandment , That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ , and love one another , as he gave us commandment .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u hukum ka long ba ngi ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong u bad ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , kumba U Khrist u la hukum ïa ngi .

translation.en: Say unto them , As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked  ; but that the wicked turn from his way and live : turn ye , turn ye from your evil ways  ; for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki , ba da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , Nga long U Blei uba im , ngam sngewbha ban ïohi ba u nongpop u ïap . Ngan jin da la ïohi ïa u ba u sangeh kaba leh pop bad u im . Ko Israel , sangeh noh ka bymman ba pha leh . Balei pha kwah ban ïap ?

translation.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: hynrei u la pynngam jyllop ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid ? and his dread fall upon you ?
translation.kha: bad ka bor jong u kan pyndap ïa me da ka jingtriem .

translation.en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful  ; and the end of that mirth is heaviness .
translation.kha: Ka jingrkhie ka lah ban buhrieh ïa ka jingkhuslai . Haba ka jingkmen ka la jah , ka jingsngewsih ka dang ïai don hangta .

translation.en: And I looked , and , behold , a whirlwind came out of the north , a great cloud , and a fire infolding itself , and a brightness was about it , and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber , out of the midst of the fire .
translation.kha: Nga la khmied , bad nga la ïohi ïa ka  erïong ba ka wan na shaphang shatei . Ka leilieh ka thaba na u lyoh uba rben , bad ka sahit bneng sawdong jong u , ka phyrnai . Ha ka jaka ba ka leilieh ka thaba , don kaei kaei kaba phyrnai kum ka rnong .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David , that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul .
translation.kha: Katba ka jingïaleh ka dang bteng hapdeng ki kynhun jong u Dabid bad ki kynhun kiba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul , u Abner u la nang kham khrawbor napdeng ki nongbud jong u Saul .

translation.en: I do set my bow in the cloud , and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth .
translation.kha: Kata kan long ka dak jong kata ka jutang jong nga bad ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites , nor the Maachathites : but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki Israel kim shym beh noh ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur bad Maakah ; ki dang shong ha Israel .

translation.en: Open ye the gates , that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in .
translation.kha: To plie ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad to ai ba ka jaitbynriew baïaineh kan rung , ka jaitbynriew kaba ki briew jong ka , ki leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: And all Naphtali , and the land of Ephraim , and Manasseh , and all the land of Judah , unto the utmost sea ,
translation.kha: ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei ; ki ri Ephraim bad Manasseh ; ka ri Judah shaduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi ;

translation.en: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded . Then all the king s sons arose , and every man gat him up upon his mule , and fled .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u Absalom bad ki la pynïap ïa u Amnon . Baroh kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki kiew halor ki khashor jong ki bad ki la phet krad .

translation.en: Lest I be full , and deny thee , and say , Who is the  Lord  ? or lest I be poor , and steal , and take the name of my God in vain .
translation.kha: Lada nga ïoh palat , nga lah ban ong ba ngam donkam ïa me . Hynrei lada nga kyrduh pat , nga lah ban tuh bad pynjahburom ïa U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Whosoever shall put away his wife , except it be for fornication , and shall marry another , committeth adultery : and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , te , ba uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga na kano kano ka daw , lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , u klim lada u shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew .

translation.en: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity , nor divine divinations : for I will deliver my people out of your hand : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad ki jingïathuhlypa ba ïalam bakla ki la kut . Nga pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ka bor jong phi , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: The altar of burnt offering , with his brasen grate , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ka kriah rnong jong ka , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ; ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ;

translation.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction ? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity : because thy sins were increased , I have done these things unto thee .
translation.kha: Wat ujor shuh shaphang ki jingmynsaw jong phi ; ym don kano kano ka jingpynkoit ïa phi . Nga la pynshitom ïa phi kumne namar ki pop jong phi ki long kiba bun bad ka jingbymman jong phi ka long kaba khraw .

translation.en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her , according to the time of life .
translation.kha: Hynrei , kumba u Elisha u la lah ong , hamar kata ka por ha ka snem kaba bud ka la kha khun shynrang .

translation.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah s tent , and took Rebekah , and she became his wife  ; and he loved her : and Isaac was comforted after his mother s death .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaak u ïalam ïa ka Rebekka shapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba ka Sarah ka kmie jong u ka la ju shong , bad ka la kylla long ka tnga jong u . U Isaak u ieit ïa ka Rebekka , bad da kumta u la ïoh jingtngen hadien ba u la duh ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout : and as the men of Judah shouted , it came to pass , that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah .
translation.kha: Ki Judia ki pyrta jam , bad hapoh ka jingïalam u Abijah , ki tur ïaleh ; U Blei u pynliem ïa u Jeroboam bad ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel .

translation.en: Take Aaron and his sons with him , and the garments , and the anointing oil , and a bullock for the sin offering , and two rams , and a basket of unleavened bread  ;
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad wanrah ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh , ka umphniang pynsleh , u masi lyngraw ban long ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ar tylli ki blang shynrang , bad ka shang ba buh ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat .

translation.en: His body also was like the beryl , and his face as the appearance of lightning , and his eyes as lamps of fire , and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass , and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u ka tyngshaiñ kum u mawlynnai . Ka durkhmat jong u ka thaba kum ka jingthaba ka leilieh , bad ki khmat jong u ki la meh kum ka ding . Ki kti bad ki kjat jong u ki tyngshaiñ kum ka rnong ba la shut phyrnai , bad ka sur jong u ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh u paidbah bakhraw .

translation.en: I speak as to wise men ; judge ye what I say .
translation.kha: Nga kren ha phi kum ki briew kiba sngewthuh ; to bishar hi da lade ïa kaei kaba nga ong .

translation.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise , and set him over the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta phi dei ban jied ïa u briew uba stad bad uba shemphang bad thung ïa u ba un peit ïa ka ri .

translation.en: After this opened Job his mouth , and cursed his day .
translation.kha: Ha kaba kut u Job u sdang ban kren bad ban sngewsih ïa ka sngi ha kaba la kha ïa u .

translation.en: Awake , O sword , against my shepherd , and against the man that is my fellow , saith the  Lord  of hosts : smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered : and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  To khie joit , ko waitlam , bad tur ïaleh ïa u nongaplangbrot uba trei na ka bynta jong nga ! Pynïap ïa u , bad ïa ki langbrot yn pynsakma . Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga

translation.en: The good man is perished out of the earth : and there is none upright among men : they all lie in wait for blood  ; they hunt every man his brother with a net .
translation.kha: Ym don shuh u briew uba hok uba dang don ha ka ri , ym don mano mano baïaineh bad U Blei . Uwei pa uwei u ap ïa ka kabu ban pynïap briew . Uwei pa uwei u behmrad ïa la u para shnong .

translation.en: But without a parable spake he not unto them : and when they were alone , he expounded all things to his disciples .
translation.kha: Um kren ha ki khlem pyndonkam da ki pharshi , hynrei haba u don tang bad ki synran , u batai ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ki .

translation.en: When they went into the tent of the congregation , and when they came near unto the altar , they washed  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: man kaba ki rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ne ki leit sha jan kata ka duwan , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil , blind , and dumb : and he healed him , insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw .
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu ïa u briew uba la matlah bad u bymnang kren namar u la shongksuid . U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa u briew , ba kumta u la lah ban kren bad ïohi .

translation.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed : which giveth food to the hungry . The  Lord  looseth the prisoners :
translation.kha: ha ka jingbishar , u don ha ka liang kiba shah banbeiñ bad u ai jingbam ïa kiba thngan . U  Trai  u pyllaitluid ïa ki koidi

translation.en: This is the word that the  Lord  hath spoken concerning him  ; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee , and laughed thee to scorn  ; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka nongbah Jerusalem ka rkhie ïa me , ko Sennakherib , bad ka kyntait beiñ ïa me .

translation.en: And the third took her  ; and in like manner the seven also : and they left no children , and died .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha baroh hynñiew ngut — ki la ïap khlem don khun .

translation.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council , and said , What do we ? for this man doeth many miracles .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la lum ïa ka dorbar bad ki la ong ,  Ngin ïaleh kumno ? Peit ïa ki kambah baroh kiba une u briew u la leh !

translation.en: These men are peaceable with us  ; therefore let them dwell in the land , and trade therein  ; for the land , behold , it is large enough for them  ; let us take their daughters to us for wives , and let us give them our daughters .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki long kum ki paralok ; ai ba kin shong kin sah bad ngi ha kane ka ri , bad kin leit kin wan laitluid . Ka ri ka long kaba kylluid bad kan biang ïa ki ruh . To ngin ïashongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ngin ai ruh ïa la ki jong ba kin ïashongkurim bad ki .

translation.en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren , Let me find grace in your eyes , and what ye shall say unto me I will give .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shekhem u ong ha u kpa jong ka Dinah bad ha ki hynmen shynrang jong ka ,  Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingkyrpad jong nga , bad kat kaba phi kwah ngan ai .

translation.en: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof , on this side , and on that side : and the going up to it had eight steps .
translation.kha: Ka kamra rung ka phai pyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong halor ki païa baroh arliang . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .

translation.en: He sent a man before them , even Joseph , who was sold for a servant :
translation.kha: Hynrei u la phah ïa u briew ha shuwa jong ki , u Joseph , ïa uba la die kum u mraw .

translation.en: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .
translation.kha: Bad man uwei pa uwei u nongïamareh uba don ha ka jingshah hikai , u pyndem ha ka jinghikai kaba pyrkhing , khnang ba yn pynphong da ka pansngiat sla dieng ka bymneh ; hynrei ma ngi pat ngi ïaleh na ka bynta kata ka ban neh junom la junom .

translation.en: Baana the son of Ahilud  ; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo , and all Beth–shean , which is by Zarethan beneath Jezreel , from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah , even unto the place that is beyond Jokmeam :
translation.kha: U Baana , u khun jong u Ahilud : ki nongbah Taanakh , Megiddo , bad baroh ka thain hajan ka Beth Shan , hajan ka nongrit Sarethan , kaba shaphang shathie jong ka Jesreel , haduh ka nongbah Abel Meholah bad ka nongbah Jokmeam

translation.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary , to comfort them concerning their brother .
translation.kha: Ka Bethania ka jngai kumba lai kilomitar duna na Jerusalem , bad shibun ki nong Judia ki la wan ban peit ïa ka Martha bad ka Mari ban pyntngen ïa ki ha ka jingïap noh u para jong ki .

translation.en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment : and it was early  ; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall , lest they should be defiled  ; but that they might eat the passover .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab la ïalam ïa U Jisu na ka ïing u Kaïaphas sha ka ïing jong u lyngskor . Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw kim shym la rung shapoh ka ïing , naba ki kwah ban sumar khuid ïa lade kat kum ka jinglehniam , khnang ba ki lah ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: Yea , many people and strong nations shall come to seek the  Lord  of hosts in Jerusalem , and to pray before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bakhlaiñbor kin wan sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u .

translation.en: Yet all this availeth me nothing , so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king s gate .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine baroh kim long ei ei ïa nga katba nga dang ïohi ïa uto u Jiw , u Mordekai ba u shong ha ka khyrdop sha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And be not conformed to this world : but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind , that ye may prove what is that good , and acceptable , and perfect , will of God .
translation.kha: To wat pynïasyriem ïa lade bad ki rukom jong kane ka pyrthei , hynrei to ai ba U Blei un pynkylla dur ïa kaba shapoh jong phi da ka jingpynkylla ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi baroh . Te phin lah ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei — kaei kaba bha bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad kaba janai .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Nay , but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Em ! Phi la ïawan ban khmih ha-ei kane ka ri ka shong tlot .

translation.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear : but now mine eye seeth thee .
translation.kha: Mynshuwa nga la tip tang ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa nga , da kaba nga ïohsngew pateng na kiwei ; hynrei mynta nga la ïohi ïa me da la ki jong ki khmat .

translation.en: Also , O Judah , he hath set an harvest for thee , when I returned the captivity of my people .
translation.kha: Bad na ka bynta jong phi , ki paid Judah , nga la buh ka por ban pynshitom ïa phi ruh na ka bynta kaei kaba phi leh .

translation.en: For out of prison he cometh to reign  ; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor .
translation.kha: Uno uno u lah ban kiew na ka jingduk ban long u syiem jong ka ri jong u , lane u ban leit na ka ïingbyndi sha ka khet , hynrei lada ha ka jinglong tymmen jong u , u long uba bieit eh ban shim ïa ka jingaibuit , um long uba kham bha kum u samla uba duk hynrei uba shemphang .

translation.en: Why did you sleep ?
translation.kha: Balei phi thiah ?

translation.en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you , who is a beloved brother , and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord :
translation.kha: U para ba-ieit jong ngi u Tukhikos , u nongtrei uba lah ban shaniah bad u para shakri ha ka kam jong U Trai , un sa ai ïa phi ka khubor baroh shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches , which hath devoured her fruit , so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule . This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u dieng sohwaiñ ka la kem ding ; ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki tnat bad ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat kin ym long shuh da lei lei kiba khlaiñ , kin ym long shuh da lei lei ki diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . Kane ka dei ka jingrwai jong ka jingsngewsih ; la ju rwai bad ïai rwai ïa ka .

translation.en: And he said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , I pray thee , send me good speed this day , and shew kindness unto my master Abraham .
translation.kha: U la duwai ,  A  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , to ai ka jingjop ïa nga mynta ka sngi bad to bat ïa la ka kular ïa u kynrad jong nga .

translation.en: Therefore hear now this , thou afflicted , and drunken , but not with wine :
translation.kha: Phi ki briew kiba jynjar jong ka Jerusalem , phi kiba ïaid sheng sheng kumba phi la buaid ,

translation.en: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue , against man or beast : that ye may know how that the  Lord  doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat u ksew ruh un ym wiar ïa ki Israel lane ïa ki jingri jingdup jong ki . Te men tip ba nga U  Trai  nga pynïapher hapdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Israel .’

translation.en: The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad kin nang ïoh ka nam ka burom , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kin nang mad ka jingjahburom .

translation.en: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver  ; and thy raiment was of fine linen , and silk , and broidered work  ; thou didst eat fine flour , and honey , and oil : and thou wast exceeding beautiful , and thou didst prosper into a kingdom .
translation.kha: Pha la don ki jingdeng kiba da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , bad borabor pha ju phong ki jaiñ linen bad rusom ba la suh syntiew . Pha la bam u kpu uba la shna na u  purew babha tam bad pha la don ka ngap bad ka umphniang Olib ban bam . Ka jingbhabriew jong pha ka long kaba phyrnai itynnat , bad pha la long ka syiem .

translation.en: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Te nga la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u syiem Sedekaïah ha Jerusalem katba ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years , that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath . And they told Shimei , saying , Behold , thy servants be in Gath .
translation.kha: Pynban , hadien lai snem , ar ngut na ki mraw jong u Shimei ki la phet noh sha u Akhish , u syiem ka Gath , u khun jong u Maakah .

translation.en: And when he came , behold , the captains of the host were sitting  ; and he said , I have an errand to thee , O captain . And Jehu said , Unto which of all us ? And he said , To thee , O captain .
translation.kha: ha kaba u la shem ba ki rangbah shipai ki dang ïashong pyrkhat kam . U ong ,  Kynrad , nga don ka khubor ïa phi .  U Jehu u kylli ,  Phi kren ïano na ngi ?   Ïa phi keiñ , ko rangbah ,  u jubab .

translation.en: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die , from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne , even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill  ; and all the firstborn of beasts .
translation.kha: bad man la u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt un ïap , naduh u khun nyngkong jong u syiem u ban ïoh ïa ka khet , haduh u khun nyngkong jong ka mraw kaba tylliat kew . Kiba kha nyngkong na ki jingri baroh ruh kin ïap .

translation.en: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer ,
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka phah sha u Mordekai ïa kane ka jubab :

translation.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar , and lieth upon the border of Moab .
translation.kha: bad ka sharing jong ki them kiba kot shaduh ka shnong Ar bad shaduh u pud ka ri Moab .

translation.en: And say , Thus saith the king , Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I come in peace .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ban thep byndi ïa u , bad ban ai kpu bad ka um ïa u haduh ba ngan da wan phai suk .

translation.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham , and his oath unto Isaac  ;
translation.kha: Un bat ïa ka jingïakut ba u la pynlong bad u Abraham bad ïa ka kular bad u Isaak .

translation.en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it  ; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith , even the bread of affliction  ; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste : that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life .
translation.kha: Haba phi bam ïa kane ka jingbam , wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat . Hynñiew sngi phin bam ïa u kpu khlem thiat , kumba phi la bam mynba phi la dei ban mihnoh kyrkieh na Ijipt . Bam ïa une u kpu — yn khot ïa u , u kpu ka jingshah shitom — ba katba phi dang im phin ïai kynmaw ïa kata ka sngi mynba phi mihnoh na Ijipt , kata ka jaka ka jingshah shitom .

translation.en: And he said , Nay , father Abraham : but if one went unto them from the dead , they will repent .
translation.kha: U riewspah u la jubab , ‘ Kata kam pat biang , ko kpa Abraham ! Hynrei lada uno uno u mihpat na ka jingïap bad leit sha ki , te kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .’

translation.en: For it hath been declared unto me of you , my brethren , by them which are of the house of Chloe , that there are contentions among you .
translation.kha: Naba katto katne ngut ki briew na ka longïing jong ka Khloi ki la ïathuh ïa nga da kaba shai kdar , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba don ki jingkajia hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them , What do ye , loosing the colt ?
translation.kha: katto katne ngut na kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ki la kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïaleh aïu ba phi ïalaw ïa u khun kada ?

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and his goodness , behold , they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh bad ka jingaiti lut jong u sha U  Trai  la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Jingïohipaw jong u Nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos  bad ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .

translation.en: Why did Jehovah create the earth ?
translation.kha: Balei U Jehobah u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: Wherefore if they shall say unto you , Behold , he is in the desert  ; go not forth : behold , he is in the secret chambers  ; believe it not .
translation.kha: Lane , lada ki briew kin ïathuh ïa phi , ‘ Ha khmih , u don ha ka ri shyiap !’ — wat leit shata , lane lada ki ong , ‘ Ha khmih , u rieh hangne !’ — wat ngeit ïa kata .

translation.en: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing , because , when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us , ye received it not as the word of men , but as it is in truth , the word of God , which effectually worketh also in you that believe .
translation.kha: Bad don sa kawei pat ka daw balei ba ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei . Haba ngi la wallam ha phi ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , phi la ïohsngew bad pdiang ïa ka , ym kum ka khubor na ki briew hynrei kum ka khubor jong U Blei , kaba long shisha kumta . Naba U Blei u trei ha phi kiba ngeit .

translation.en: And Hilkiah , and they that the king had appointed , went to Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath , the son of Hasrah , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college : ) and they spake to her to that effect .
translation.kha: Kat kum ka hukum jong u syiem , u Hilkaïah bad kiwei ki leit ïasyllok bad ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa kaba sah ha ki bynta ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u khun ksiew jong u Harhas , ki long kiba sumar ïa ki jaiñkup ha ka Templ . )

translation.en: And testifiedst against them , that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law : yet they dealt proudly , and hearkened not unto thy commandments , but sinned against thy judgments , ( which if a man do , he shall live in them  ; ) and withdrew the shoulder , and hardened their neck , and would not hear .
translation.kha: Me maham ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me , hynrei ha ka jingsarong ki kyntait ïa ki hukum jong me , wat la kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum ka long ka lynti sha ka jingim . Kiba mutlop bad kiba ehrang , ki kyntait ban kohnguh .

translation.en: Praise the  Lord  with harp : sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings .
translation.kha: To ai ki jingainguh ïa U  Trai  ha ki duitara , to rwai ha u da ki jingtem ksai .

translation.en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together , and took his journey into a far country , and there wasted his substance with riotous living .
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , u khun ba kham rit u la die ïa ka bynta jong ka jingdon jingem jong u bad u la mihnoh na ïing lem bad ka pisa . U la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai , ha kaba u la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka pisa jong u ha ka jingim ba-thurmur .

translation.en: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals , and fashioneth it with hammers , and worketh it with the strength of his arms : yea , he is hungry , and his strength faileth : he drinketh no water , and is faint .
translation.kha: U kamar u shim shi lyngkhot ka nar bad u pynwandur ïa ka ha ka ding . Ka ksang ti bakhlaiñ jong u ka pynkhih ïa u tyrnem ban tied pynwandur ïa ka nar . Katba u dang trei , u thngan , u sliang bad u la thait .

translation.en: And he spake that saying openly . And Peter took him , and began to rebuke him .
translation.kha: U la ong shai bha ïa kane ha ki . Kumta u Petros u la shim kyrpang ïa u bad u la sdang ban sneng ïa u .

translation.en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter : Fear God , and keep his commandments : for this is the whole duty of man .
translation.kha: Hadien kane baroh , don tang kawei ban ong : To tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , namar dei ïa kane keiñ ba la thaw ïa u briew .

translation.en: And he put them all together into ward three days .
translation.kha: Kumta u buh lang ïa ki ha byndi haduh lai sngi .

translation.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness : and all the upright in heart shall follow it .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan wan biang ha ki ïingbishar , bad baroh ki briew kiba hok kin kyrshan ïa ka .

translation.en: And Joshua spake unto the priests , saying , Take up the ark of the covenant , and pass over before the people . And they took up the ark of the covenant , and went before the people .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa ki lyngdoh ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad leit bad ka ha shuwa ki paidbah . Ki la leh kumba u la ong .

translation.en: And one of the company said unto him , Master , speak to my brother , that he divide the inheritance with me .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew na u paidbah u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , to ong ïa u hynmen jong nga ban ïabynta bad nga ïa ka jingdon jingem kaba u kpa jong ngi u la iehnoh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And the Levites shall speak , and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice ,
translation.kha: Ki Lebi kin kren ïa kine ki ktien ha ka sur kaba jam :

translation.en: And when he was come out of the ship , immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit ,
translation.kha: Tang shu hiar na ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba wan mih na ki krem jingtep kiba don hangta . Une u briew u don ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong u bad u shong u sah ha ki jaka tep briew .

translation.en: And they went out at noon . But Ben–hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions , he and the kings , the thirty and two kings that helped him .
translation.kha: Ka jingtur ïaleh ka la sdang ha ka por shiteng sngi katba u Benhadad bad ki laiphew ar ngut kiba ïateh lok bad u ki dang ïadih buaid ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .

translation.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness :
translation.kha: ka jingkren jong ki ka dap da ki jingtim bakthang .

translation.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command , and make her nest on high ?
translation.kha: Hato u pukni u ap hukum na me ban shna ïa la ka skum halor ki lumbah ?

translation.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men , the children of Belial , and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon , when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted , and could not withstand them .
translation.kha: Hadien u lumlang ïa ka kynhun ki riewmadan , bad ki pynbor ïa ka mon jong ki ha u Rehoboam u khun jong u Solomon , uba dang khynnah eh bad ba dang lung ka jingtbit ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out from before the children of Israel , and of the kings of Israel , which they had made .
translation.kha: Ki la mane ïa kiwei ki blei , ki bud ïa ki rukom jong ki briew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh katba ki briew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang , bad ki pdiang ïa ki rukom ba la sdang da ki syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: But I say , that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice , they sacrifice to devils , and not to God : and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils .
translation.kha: Em! Kaei kaba nga ong ka long ba ïa kaei kaba la kñia ha ki duwan jong ki bymngeit ka long kaba la kñia sha ki ksuid , ym sha U Blei . Bad ngam kwah ïa phi ban long kiba ïatrei lem bad ki ksuid .

translation.en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city , then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold  ; within a full year may he redeem it .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u die ïa ka ïing ha ka shnong ba la ker kynroh , u don hok ban thied pat ïa ka hapoh shisnem naduh ka sngi ba u la die ïa ka .

translation.en: I applied mine heart to know , and to search , and to seek out wisdom , and the reason of things , and to know the wickedness of folly , even of foolishness and madness :
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la pynleit ïa lade ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingpule bniah ; nga la kut jingmut ban shem ïa ka jingstad bad ïa ki jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga , bad ban tip haduh katno ka jingtasngeng ka long kaba sniew bad kaba bieit .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the letter came to them , that they took the king s sons , and slew seventy persons , and put their heads in baskets , and sent him them to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohpdiang ïa ka shithi jong u Jehu , ki nongïalam jong ka Samaria ki la pynïap ïa baroh ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab , ki buh ïa ki khlieh jong ki ha ki shang , bad ki la phah ïa ki sha u Jehu ha Jesreel .

translation.en: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai . And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .
translation.kha: U syiem u la loit noh ïa ka sati ba don muhor ha ka ( kaba u la shim noh na u Haman ) bad u ai ha u Mordekai . Ka Esther ka buh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u Haman ha ka jingpeit u Mordekai .

translation.en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past , and his owner hath not kept him in  ; he shall surely pay ox for ox  ; and the dead shall be his own .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada la tip ba uta u masi kyrtong mynshuwa ruh u dei uba la tynrah teng , bad u trai jong u um shym set ïa u , u dei ban buria da kaba ai ïa uta uwei pat da u masi kyrtong uba im , bad un ïoh ma u ïa uta uba ïap .

translation.en: And they left the house of the  Lord  God of their fathers , and served groves and idols : and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paidbah ki sangeh noh ban mane ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki sdang ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah . Ka jingrem jong ki namar kine ki pop ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  halor ka ha Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when she travailed , that the one put out his hand : and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread , saying , This came out first .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang suh kha , uwei na ki u pynmih shabar ïa la ka kti ; ka nongpynkha khun ka bat ïa kata ka kti , ka teh ïa ka da u  saisaw , bad ka ong ,  Une u dei uba mih nyngkong .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Is the  Lord s  hand waxed short ? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not .
translation.kha: Hato don u pud ïa ka bor jong nga ?  U  Trai  u jubab .  Men sa ïohi shen la kata kaba nga la ong kan urlong ne em !

translation.en: And I said unto her , Thou shalt abide for me many days  ; thou shalt not play the harlot , and thou shalt not be for another man : so will I also be for thee .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ka ba ka dei ban ap slem ïa nga khlem da leh nuti lane klim ; bad ha kane ka por ngan ïai ap ïa ka .

translation.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki ruh da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Lest the  Lord  see it , and it displease him , and he turn away his wrath from him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tip lada phi long uba rkhiebeiñ . Bad um sngewbha ïa kata ; bad nangta u lah ban ym pynshitom ïa u .

translation.en: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword , which say , The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop napdeng ki briew jong nga yn pynïap ha ka thma — ïa kito baroh kiba ong ‘ U Blei un ym shah ïa kano kano ka jingma ban wan hajan jong ngi .’

translation.en: And thou shalt stone him with stones , that he die  ; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
translation.kha: Lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap ! U la pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .

translation.en: She obeyed not the voice  ; she received not correction  ; she trusted not in the  Lord   ; she drew not near to her God .
translation.kha: Kam shym la pynshahshkor ïa U  Trai  lane pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jong u . Kam shym la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha U  Trai  lane kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong u .

translation.en: For they are life unto those that find them , and health to all their flesh .
translation.kha: Ki long ka jingim bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ïa uno uno uba sngewthuh ïa ki .

translation.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth , and seeth under the whole heaven  ;
translation.kha: Namar u ïohi ïa kiba kut jong ka pyrthei , u ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka suiñbneng .

translation.en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , and searched the scriptures daily , whether those things were so .
translation.kha: Ki briew hangta ki long kiba kham ïar jingmut ban ïa ki briew kiba ha Thessaloni . Ki la shahshkor ïa ka khubor da ka jingangnud bakhraw , bad man ka sngi ki ju pule bniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban khmih lada kaei kaba u Paul u ong ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and do , and judge thy servants , condemning the wicked , to bring his way upon his head  ; and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , to shahshkor na bneng bad bishar ïa ki shakri jong me . Pynshitom ïa uta u nongleh palat kumba ka dei hok ïa u ban ïoh , bad pynksan ïa uta uba lui lui .

translation.en: Now the chief priests , and elders , and all the council , sought false witness against Jesus , to put him to death  ;
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka Dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban lap ki sabut lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ban pynïap ïa u ;

translation.en: And they shall be upon Aaron , and upon his sons , when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation , or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place  ; that they bear not iniquity , and die : it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him .
translation.kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban phong ïa ki man ka por ba ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ne haba ki leit sha jan ka duwan ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang , khnang ba kin ym shah pynïap ba ki thad burom ïa lade . Kane ka long ka aiñ kaba neh shi rta ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab man ka step baroh ki briew ki la leit sha ka Templ ban sngap ïa u .

translation.en: We are bound to thank God always for you , brethren , as it is meet , because that your faith groweth exceedingly , and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth ;
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi . Ka long kaba dei ïa ngi ban leh kumta , namar ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka la san shikatdei eh bad ba ka jingieit kaba iwei pa iwei na phi , phi don na ka bynta kiwei pat ka la nang kham khraw .

translation.en: Then Jethro , Moses  father in law , took Zipporah , Moses  wife , after he had sent her back ,
translation.kha: Kumta u la wan ha u Moses , u da ïalam ruh ïa ka Sipporah , ka tnga jong u Moses , kaba u khlem ïalam lang ,

translation.en: And the children of Israel remembered not the  Lord  their God , who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side :
translation.kha: bad kim shym la shakri shuh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la pynim ïa ki na ki nongshun baroh kiba sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: If any man among you seem to be religious , and bridleth not his tongue , but deceiveth his own heart , this man s religion is vain .
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba riewblei ? Lada um synshar ïa la u thylliej , ka jinglong riewblei jong u kam myntoi bad u shukor ïa lade .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt , their father said unto them , Go again , buy us a little food .
translation.kha: bad haba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u Jakob ki la ïabam lut ïa u kew ba la thied na Ijipt , u Jakob u la ong ha la ki khun ,  Khie leit biang bad thied jingbam biang ïa ngi khyndiat .

translation.en: And the people answered and said , God forbid that we should forsake the  Lord  , to serve other gods  ;
translation.kha: U paidbah u jubab ,  Da lei lei ngin ym iehnoh ïa U  Trai  ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei !

translation.en: The way of man is froward and strange : but as for the pure , his work is right .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop ki ïaid ka lynti kyllaiñ ; hynrei kiba lui lui ki ïaid ha kaba beit .

translation.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind , he chose of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians :
translation.kha: U Joab u la ïohi ba ka kynhun u nongshun kan tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u la jied ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki shipai Israel , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria .

translation.en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man , and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd , to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him  ; but took the poor man s lamb , and dressed it for the man that was come to him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , la wan poi u nongwankai ha ïing jong uba riewspah . Uta u riewspah um kwah ban pynïap ïa uwei na ki jingri jong u ban khreh bam ïa uta u nongwan ; pynban , u la shim ïa i khunlangbrot jong uba duk , bad u la khreh jingbam ïa u nongwankai .

translation.en: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , What meaneth the noise of this tumult ? And the man came in hastily , and told Eli .
translation.kha: U Eli u la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsawa bad u kylli ,  Ka jingsawa aïu kata ?  Uta u rangbah u leit kloi kloi sha u Eli ban ïathuh ha u ïa kaba la jia baroh .

translation.en: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me  ; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me :
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa nga lane ïohsngew shaphang jong nga ki don ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la leh .

translation.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein , and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief :
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohsngew nyngkong ïa ka Khubor Babha kim shym ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait , namar ba kim shym la ngeit . Ki don , te , kiwei pat ïa kiba la shah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka .

translation.en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits , and the wizards , and the images , and the idols , and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem , did Josiah put away , that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Khnang ban pyntreikam ïa ki aiñ ba la thoh ha ka Kitab ba u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la shem ha ka Templ , u syiem Josaïah u la weng noh na Jerusalem bad ki bynta ka Judah ïa baroh ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongbatai kupar , bad ïa baroh ki blei ïing , ki bleithaw , bad ki tiar mane blei thala .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto them the third day , This do , and live  ; for I fear God :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , u Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Nga long u briew uba sheptieng Blei , kumta ngan pyllait im ïa phi ha kane ka kyndon :

translation.en: And take the ark of the  Lord  , and lay it upon the cart  ; and put the jewels of gold , which ye return him for a trespass offering , in a coffer by the side thereof  ; and send it away , that it may go .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , buh ïa ka ha kata ka kali , bad thep ha kawei ka synduk kaba ha syndah jong ka ïa kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar ba phi phah sha u kum ka jingainguh namar ki pop jong phi . Pyllait ïa ka kali ha ka lynti jong ka bad ieh kan leit hi .

translation.en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham , calling him lord : whose daughters ye are , as long as ye do well , and are not afraid with any amazement .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka la long kumta ; ka la kohnguh ïa u Abraham bad ka khot ïa u , u kynrad jong ka . Phi long ki khun kynthei jong ka mynta lada phi leh ïa kaba dei bad phim sheptieng ïa kano kano .

translation.en: Hear therefore , O Israel , and observe to do it  ; that it may be well with thee , and that ye may increase mightily , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee , in the land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa ki , ko Israel , bad kohnguh ïa ki ! Te phin shem bha , bad phin nang roi bad long ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor bad phin ïoh shong ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la kular .

translation.en: And the priest s heart was glad , and he took the ephod , and the teraphim , and the graven image , and went in the midst of the people .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynkmen shibun ïa u lyngdoh , kumta u shim ïa ki tiar bakyntang bad u leit lem bad ki .

translation.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens , and came to Corinth  ;
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Paul u la mihnoh na Athens bad u la leit sha Korinth .

translation.en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him , he shall be unclean .
translation.kha: Hynrei naduh ka por ba ka prum ka mih biang , u kylla long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : and it shall be unto the children of Israel , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them , for a statute for ever .
translation.kha: Uta uba khat ïa u dpei u dei ban da sait ïa la ki jaiñ , hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet . Kane ka rukom pynïaid ryntih ka long kaba dei ha ki por ki ban wan baroh na ka bynta ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: I have put off my coat  ; how shall I put it on ? I have washed my feet  ; how shall I defile them ?
translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki long kum u ribon basawbthuh ; katno ki long kiba i-ieit haba phi kren . Ki ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaiñtapkhmat .

translation.en: Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the  Lord s  house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men  ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah ïa nga shajrong bad u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka Templ . Hangta hajan jong ka khyrdop nga la ïohi arphew san ngut ki rangbah kynthup ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Assur bad u Pelataïah u khun jong u Benaïah , ki ar ngut ki nongïalam jong ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Tom lives in his own world .
translation.kha: U Tom u im ha la ka jong ka pyrthei

translation.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the altar : these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi , which come near to the  Lord  to minister unto him .
translation.kha: bad ka kamra kaba phai shaphang shatei ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ka duwan . Baroh ki dei ki lyngdoh kiba la hiarpateng na u Sadok ; dei tang ïa kine ki dkhot jong ka jait Lebi ba la shah ban leit ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ban shakri ïa U .

translation.en: And when Joseph had taken the body , he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u la shim ïa ka , u la spaiñ da ka jaiñ linen kaba thymmai ,

translation.en: But I said unto you , That ye also have seen me , and believe not .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba phi la ïohi ïa nga hynrei phin ym ngeit .

translation.en: The horseleach hath two daughters , crying , Give , give . There are three things that are never satisfied , yea , four things say not , It is enough :
translation.kha: U thliem u don ar ngut ki khun kynthei , bad baroh ar ki kyrteng  Ai ïa nga !  Don saw tylli kiei kiei ki bym ju kdang :

translation.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .
translation.kha: bad u la set ïa ki hapoh byndi ha ka ïing jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira , ha kajuh ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa u Joseph .

translation.en: And in the synagogue there was a man , which had a spirit of an unclean devil , and cried out with a loud voice ,
translation.kha: Ha ka synagog , la don u briew uba don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u , bad u la kyang da ka sur kaba jam ,

translation.en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace  ; that bringeth good tidings of good , that publisheth salvation  ; that saith unto Zion , Thy God reigneth !
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba phylla ban ïohi ïa u nonglamktien ba u wan na ki lumbah , u wanrah ïa ka khubor babha , ka khubor jong ka jingsuk ! U pynbna ïa ka jingjop bad u ong ïa ka Seïon ,  U Blei jong phi u long u syiem !

translation.en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons : and the rest of Manasseh s sons had the land of Gilead .
translation.kha: namar ba ki khun ki ksiew kynthei jong u bad ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u ki la ïoh jaka . Ïa ka ri Gilead la ai ha kiba sah jong ki khun ki ksiew u Manasseh .

translation.en: Pardon , I beseech thee , the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy , and as thou hast forgiven this people , from Egypt even until now .
translation.kha: Te mynta , A  Trai  , kat kum ka jingkhraw ka jingieit baïaineh jong me , to map , nga kyrpad na ka bynta ka pop jong kine ki briew kumba me la map ïa ki naduh ba ki la mih na Ijipt .

translation.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now : for ye shall be filled . Blessed are ye that weep now : for ye shall laugh .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi kiba thngan mynta ; yn pyndap ïa phi ! Suk ma phi kiba ïam mynta ; phin rkhie !

translation.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him , saying , Behold now , the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth : let thy word , I pray thee , be like the word of one of them , and speak that which is good .
translation.kha: Katba u rangbah synshar u leit ban khot ïa u Mikaïah , u ong ha u ,  Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ba u syiem un jop bad phi ruh ka bha ba phin leh kumjuh .

translation.en: And they sat down in ranks , by hundreds , and by fifties .
translation.kha: Kumta ki briew ki la shong ha ki laiñ , ha ki kynhun bashispah ngut bad ki kynhun basanphew ngut .

translation.en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end , the first and the last .
translation.kha: Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang bad uba kut .

translation.en: The  Lord  lifteth up the meek : he casteth the wicked down to the ground .
translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba sngewrit , hynrei u pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: And , behold , there came a leper and worshipped him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
translation.kha: Nangta u briew uba shitom na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u la wan sha u , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , lada me mon , me lah ban pynlong khuid ïa nga .

translation.en: And said , Cornelius , thy prayer is heard , and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .
translation.kha: ‘ Ko Kornelios ! U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong me bad u la kynmaw ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me .

translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of gold went to one target .
translation.kha: U Solomon u shna arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh bad hynñiew kilo ka ksiar la pyndonkam ha kawei kawei ka stieh .

translation.en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished , O daughter of Zion  ; he will no more carry thee away into captivity : he will visit thine iniquity , O daughter of Edom  ; he will discover thy sins .
translation.kha: Ka Seïon ka la siew na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ; U  Trai  un ym buh shuh ïa ngi ha ka jingshah ringmraw . Hynrei ko Edom , U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa pha ; un pynpaw ïa ki kam bymman jong pha .

translation.en: So he consented to them in this matter , and proved them ten days .
translation.kha: U la mynjur ban shah ïa ki ban pyrshang ïa ka na ka bynta shiphew sngi .

translation.en: Yes , God will call false religion to account for all the despicable acts she has committed in his name .
translation.kha: Haoid , u Blei un sa khot ia ka niam ba bakla ban ai jingkhein halor ki kam niewbein kiba ka la leh ha ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: And when the cherubims went , the wheels went by them : and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth , the same wheels also turned not from beside them .
translation.kha: Haba ki kherub ki kiew sha suiñ bad ki khih , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki . Haba ki pyiar ïa ki thapniang ban her , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki .

translation.en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus , saying , Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven ?
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu , da kaba kylli ,  Uei uba khraw tam ha ka Hima ki bneng ?

translation.en: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver , and built on the hill , and called the name of the city which he built , after the name of Shemer , owner of the hill , Samaria .
translation.kha: bad nangta u thied ïa u lum ka Samaria da hynriew hajar ki sbai rupa na u briew uba kyrteng u Shemer . U Omri u la tei ka kut ïa u lum , u tei ka shnong hangta , bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Samaria , da kaba pynbud ïa ka kyrteng u Shemer , u trai ba-mynshuwa jong uta u lum .

translation.en: Responsible brothers at the branch office approve the formation of new congregations .
translation.kha: Ki para bangeit kiba shim ka jingkitkhlieh ha ka tnad treikam ki mynjur ïa ki jingpynkha balang thymmai .

translation.en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki jong u ; ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin lehkmen !

translation.en: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant  ; even the waters forgotten of the foot : they are dried up , they are gone away from men .
translation.kha: Jngai na kaba ki briew ki shong ki sah ; lane ba ki kjat briew ki ju ïaid , ki briew ki tih ïa ki thliew ha ki par . Hangta ki trei ha ka jingkynjah marwei , da kaba sdien ïa ki tyllai ha ki thliew .

translation.en: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth : it shall not return unto me void , but it shall accomplish that which I please , and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it .
translation.kha: Kumta ruh kan long ka ktien kaba nga kren — kan ym pep ban pyndep ïa kaei kaba nga thmu na ka bynta jong ka ; kan pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga phah ïa ka ban leh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken , and her high gates shall be burned with fire  ; and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kynroh bakhlaiñ jong ka Babilon yn pyntwa haduh khyndew , bad ïa ki khyrdop bajrong jong ka yn thang noh . Ka jingtrei jong ki jaitbynriew baroh kam long ei ei ; ki jingpyrshang jong ki , ki kut ha ka ding . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh nga la kren .

translation.en: And they took their journey from Elim , and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin , which is between Elim and Sinai , on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na Elim , bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba ar naduh ba ki mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ki la wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sin , kaba don hapdeng ka Elim bad ka Sinai .

translation.en: They shall come all for violence : their faces shall sup up as the east wind , and they shall gather the captivity as the sand .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai jong ki , ki tur jubor sha khmat ban jop , bad uwei pa uwei u la sngewtriem katba ki nang tur . Kiba shah kem ki bun bah kum u shyiap .

translation.en: Who then is Paul , and who is Apollos , but ministers by whom ye believed , even as the Lord gave to every man ?
translation.kha: Haba kumta , uei u Apollos ? Bad uei u Paul ? Ngi dei tang ki shakri jong U Blei , kiba la ïalam ïa phi ban ngeit . Uwei pa uwei na ngi u trei ïa ka kam kaba U Trai u la ai ïa u ban leh :

translation.en: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi baroh lang , phi lah ban ïaroh da kawei ka sur ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego . Then they brought these men before the king .
translation.kha: Hangta hi , u syiem u la bitar shla bad u la hukum ban wallam ïa ki lai ngut ki rangbah sha u .

translation.en: He that is wounded in the stones , or hath his privy member cut off , shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew uba la shah shohdab kum u masi , lane uba la duh ïa la ka long shynrang ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .

translation.en: And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada , whereof were made vessels for the house of the  Lord  , even vessels to minister , and to offer withal , and spoons , and vessels of gold and silver . And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the  Lord  continually all the days of Jehoiada .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la pyndep ïa ka jingpynbha , ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba tam la ai sha u syiem bad sha u Jehoïada , kiba la pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba phah shna ïa ki pliang bad kiwei ki pat ki khiew ki pliang na ka bynta ka Templ . Katba u Jehoïada u dang im , ïa ki jingkñia la ai tista ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee , named Nazareth ,
translation.kha: Ha u bnai bahynriew jong ka jingpunkhun jong ka Elisabeth , U Blei u la phah ïa u angel Gabriel sha ka shong ha Galilaïa kaba kyrteng ka Nasareth .

translation.en: And so it was , when Israel had sown , that the Midianites came up , and the Amalekites , and the children of the east , even they came up against them  ;
translation.kha: Man ka por ba ki Israel ki thung jingthung , ki Midian , ki wan bad ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: But be shod with sandals  ; and not put on two coats .
translation.kha: Phong ïa ki juti , hynrei wat rah sopti nalor kaba phi la phong .

translation.en: And thinkest thou this , O man , that judgest them which do such things , and doest the same , that thou shalt escape the judgment of God ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko paralok jong nga , leh ïa kita kiei kiei hi kiba phi bishar ïa kiwei! Hato phi pyrkhat phin lait na ka jingbishar U Blei ?

translation.en: Then Paul , after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak , answered , Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation , I do the more cheerfully answer for myself :
translation.kha: Te u lyngskor u la ai dak ïa u Paul ban kren , u Paul u la ong ,  Nga tip ba me la long u nongbishar halor kane ka jaitbynriew la bun snem , bad kumta da kaba sngewbha nga ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong me .

translation.en: And if thou refuse to let them go , behold , I will smite all thy borders with frogs :
translation.kha: Lada me kyntait , ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri jong me da kaba pyndap ïa ka da ki jakoid .

translation.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours , captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously , horsemen riding upon horses , all of them desirable young men .
translation.kha: Ka ruh ka dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai nong Assyria — ki shipai ha ki riam shipai baphyrnai — bad ïa ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew , baroh kito ki samla shynrang ba-bhabriew .

translation.en: Entreat the  Lord  ( for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail  ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .
translation.kha: To duwai ha U  Trai  ! Ngi la shah la biang ïa une u pyrthat bad u phria ! Nga kular ban pyllait ïa phi ; phim donkam ban dang sah shuh hangne .

translation.en: Ye did run well ; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth ?
translation.kha: Phi la lehbha katta katta! Uei uba la pynlong ïa phi ban sangeh ban kohnguh ïa ka jingshisha ? Da kumno u la khroh ïa phi ?

translation.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise on the sword , and died .
translation.kha: Haba u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap .

translation.en: Weep ye not for the dead , neither bemoan him : but weep sore for him that goeth away : for he shall return no more , nor see his native country .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Judah , wat ïam na ka bynta u syiem Josaïah , wat ïam pangnud ïa ka jingïap jong u . Hynrei ïamkthang na ka bynta u Joahas , u khun jong u ; ki la rah noh ïa u bad un ym wan phai shuh , un ym ïohi shuh ïa ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa u .

translation.en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands , and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour before the  Lord  : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta , shim ïa ki na ki kti jong ki bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan , halor kata ka jingainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh bam sha nga . Ka jingiwbih kaba suhsieng na kane ka jingainguh ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .

translation.en: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters , and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness , wherewith their enemies , and they that seek their lives , shall straiten them .
translation.kha: U nongshun un kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad pyrshang ban pynïap ïa ki briew . Ka jingkerkut kaba shyrkhei katta katta ba ki briew hapoh ka nongbah kin ïabam iwei ïa iwei pat bad wat ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth ? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip mynno la kha ïa ki blang lum ? Hato me ju ïohi ïa ka skei khlaw ba ka kha khun ?

translation.en: His lightnings enlightened the world : the earth saw , and trembled .
translation.kha: Ka leilieh jong u ka pynshai ïa ka pyrthei ; ka khyndew ka ïohi ïa ka bad ka khynñiuh .

translation.en: And this house , which is high , shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it  ; so that he shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?
translation.kha: Ka Templ ka long mynta kaba ïoh burom shibun , hynrei kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un lyngngoh bad un kylli , ‘ Balei ba U  Trai  u la leh kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka Templ ?’

translation.en: And she answered them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell ye the man that sent you to me ,
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba la jia , bad ka ong ïa ki ban leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ban ai ha u ïa kane harum ka khubor na U  Trai  :

translation.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel : and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel ha u Lum Gilboa . Kiba bun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiwei pat na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun jong u ki la phet krad .

translation.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire  ; so shall it be in the end of this world .
translation.kha: Kumba ïa ki ñiut la lumlang bad la thang ïa ki hapoh ka ding , kumta kajuh hi kan jia ha kaba kut ka Ïa :

translation.en: I have coveted no man s silver , or gold , or apparel .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kwah ïa ka rupa lane ka ksiar lane ka jaiñphong jongno jongno .

translation.en: We see his love in all that he has made .
translation.kha: Ngi ïohi ïa ka jingieit jong u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la thaw .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  opened the eyes of Balaam , and he saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and he bowed down his head , and fell flat on his face .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u pynshai ïa ki khmat u Balaam ban ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng hangta bad la ka waitlam ; bad u Balaam u la dem khrup ha khyndew .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Sit down now , and read it in our ears . So Baruch read it in their ears .
translation.kha: To shong ,  ki la ong ,  bad to pule na ka kot kli ha ngi .  Te u Barukh u la leh kumta .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ki syiem jong kiba mane blei thala ki don ka bor halor ki briew jong ki , bad ki nongsynshar ki kam ïa ka nam ba ki dei ‘ Ki paralok jong u Paidbah .’

translation.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees , which say there is no resurrection  ; and they asked him , saying ,
translation.kha: Te katto katne ngut na ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Simon , I have somewhat to say unto thee .  And he saith , Master , say on .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha u ,  Ko Simon , nga don ei ei ban ong ha me .   Ko Nonghikai ,  u la ong ,  to ïathuh ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said Joab , I may not tarry thus with thee . And he took three darts in his hand , and thrust them through the heart of Absalom , while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por bad me ,  u Joab u ong . U rah lai tylli ki sum , bad u pynngam ïa ki ha ka shadem jong u Absalom katba u dang im , haba u dang sdien ha u dieng Sning .

translation.en: My heart shall cry out for Moab  ; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar , an heifer of three years old : for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up  ; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka kyang jam namar ka Moab ! Ki briew ki la phet sha ki shnong jong ka Soar , bad sha ka Eglath Shelishiyah . Katto katne ki kiew ïa ka surok sha Luhith , ki da ïam haba ki leit ; katto katne ki lait phet sha Horanaim , ki da ïam sngewsih jam .

translation.en: Go , and gather the elders of Israel together , and say unto them , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Jacob , appeared unto me , saying , I have surely visited you , and seen that which is done to you in Egypt :
translation.kha: Khie leit lumlang ïa ki tymmen ki san jong ki Israel bad ïathuh ha ki ba nga U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , U Isaak , bad u Jakob , nga la mihpaw ha me . Ïathuh ruh ha ki ba nga la wan jngoh ïa ki , bad nga la ïohi aïu ki nong Ijipt ki la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: How can God’s Word improve your life ?
translation.kha: Kumno ka ktien U Blei kan kham pynbha ïa ka jingim jong phi ?

translation.en: And when he cometh home , he calleth together his friends and neighbours , saying unto them , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found my sheep which was lost .
translation.kha: Nangta u khot lang ïa ki paralok bad ïa ki paramarjan jong u bad u ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta katta ba nga la shem ïa ka langbrot jong nga kaba la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’

translation.en: Then said Absalom , Call now Hushai the Archite also , and let us hear likewise what he saith .
translation.kha: U Absalom u ong ,  Mynta khot ïa u Hushai , bad to ngin sngap aïu u don ban ong .

translation.en: Likewise , thou son of man , set thy face against the daughters of thy people , which prophesy out of their own heart  ; and prophesy thou against them ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Mynta , ko khun u briew , khmih ïa ki kynthei hapdeng ki briew jong me kiba pynlong ki jingïathuh lypa . To kren pyrshah ïa ki

translation.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim ? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand ?
translation.kha: Hangno ki don mynta , ki blei jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ? Hangno don ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim ? Hato don uno uno uba pyllait ïa ka Samaria ?

translation.en: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery , even the hidden wisdom , which God ordained before the world unto our glory :
translation.kha: Ka jingstad kaba nga pynbna ka long ka jingstad barieh jong U Blei , ïa kaba la buhrieh na u bynriew , hynrei , ïa kaba u la jied lypa na ka bynta ka burom jong ngi wat ha shuwa ba yn pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For there shall be a day , that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry , Arise ye , and let us go up to Zion unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka por kan wan haba ki nongap kin khot ha ki lum ka Ephraim , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh Seïon , sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field , in the wilderness wherein they chased them , and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword , until they were consumed , that all the Israelites returned unto Ai , and smote it with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u nongshun ha ka jaka bashrah ha kaba ki la beh ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Ai bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba don hangta .

translation.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judaea , unto the city of David , which is called Bethlehem  ; ( because he was of the house and lineage of David : )
translation.kha: U Joseph ruh u la leit na ka shnong Nasareth , kaba ha Galilaïa sha ka shnong Bethlehem ha Judia , ka jaka ha kaba la kha ïa syiem Dabid . U Joseph u la leit shata namar u la long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid .

translation.en: For if a man find his enemy , will he let him go well away ? wherefore the  Lord  reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day .
translation.kha: Haduh katno sien ba u briew un kem ïa u nongshun jong u bad nangta un pyllait ïa u ban leit noh khlem mynsaw ? U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa nga ha kane ka sngi !

translation.en: And Jehoahaz besought the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hearkened unto him : for he saw the oppression of Israel , because the king of Syria oppressed them .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoahas u duwai ha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  , haba u ïohi kumno u syiem ka Syria u lehbeiñ sat ïa ki Israel , u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .

translation.en: After that , he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once ; of whom the greater part remain unto this present , but some are fallen asleep .
translation.kha: Nangta u la paw ha palat sanspah ngut ki nongbud jong u ha kajuh ka por , kiba kham bun na ki , ki dang im , wat la katto katne ngut ki la ïap .

translation.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel , saying , In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb , according to the house of their fathers , a lamb for an house :
translation.kha: Ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha u paid Israel baroh : ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai , uwei pa uwei u rangbah un jied ïa u khunlangbrot lane ïa u khunblang na ka bynta la ka jong ka ïing .

translation.en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers : and there arose another generation after them , which knew not the  Lord  , nor yet the works which he had done for Israel .
translation.kha: Kata ka pateng bynriew baroh ka la ïap , bad ka pateng bynriew kaba bud ka la klet ïa U  Trai  bad ïa kaei kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated , and the things which himself had dedicated , into the house of the  Lord  , silver , and gold , and vessels .
translation.kha: U buh ha ka templ ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh ïa kiba u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , lem bad ïa ki mar ksiar bad mar rupa ïa kiba u hi u la pynkyntang .

translation.en: Son of man , when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously , then will I stretch out mine hand upon it , and will break the staff of the bread thereof , and will send famine upon it , and will cut off man and beast from it :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  lada ka ri ka leh pop bad kam ïaineh ha nga , ngan kner ïa ka kti jong nga bad pynduh ïa ka jingpyndap jingbam jong ka . Ngan phah ïa ka  nemsniew bad pynïap ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .

translation.en: A whip for the horse , a bridle for the ass , and a rod for the fool s back .
translation.kha: Phi donkam ban sympat ïa u kulai , phi dei ban teh lakam ïa u kada , bad phi dei ban sympat ïa uba bieit .

translation.en: Then the disciples , every man according to his ability , determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea :
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kut jingmut ba uwei pa uwei na ki un phah katba lah bor ban ïarap ïa ki parabangeit kiba shong basah ha Judia .

translation.en: And when thy days be fulfilled , and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers , I will set up thy seed after thee , which shall proceed out of thy bowels , and I will establish his kingdom .
translation.kha: Ynda me ïap , bad la tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan thung syiem ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ka hima jong u .

translation.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel : there is the whoredom of Ephraim , Israel is defiled .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ha Israel : Ki briew jong nga ki la pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment : the earth is full of the goodness of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok ; ka jingieit baneh jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that he that is left in Zion , and he that remaineth in Jerusalem , shall be called holy , even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shah iehnoh ha Jerusalem , uba U Blei u la jied ban ïohlait im , yn khot uba khuid .
