translation.en: For what portion of God is there from above ? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high ?
translation.kha: Kaei U Blei Badonbor Baroh u leh ïa ngi ? Kumno u siew kylliang ïa ki kam u bynriew ?

translation.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki pynlong mraw ïa ki khunswet ba dang rit bad ki shim ïa ki khun jong u briew uba duk kum ka jingsiew ïa ki ram .

translation.en: And the  Lord  will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion , and upon her assemblies , a cloud and smoke by day , and the shining of a flaming fire by night : for upon all the glory shall be a defence .
translation.kha: Nangta halor u Lum Seïon bad halor baroh kiba la ïalumlang hangta , U  Trai  un phah ïa u lyoh ha ka por mynsngi bad ka tdem bad ka thylliej ding baphyrnai ha ka por mynmiet . Ka burom U Blei kan tap bad da ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other .
translation.kha: U diengkhap uba hapdeng , ïa uba la pynkhap hamar shiteng kita ki jingker , u kot naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka Ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness  ; and , behold , the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded , and brought forth buds , and bloomed blossoms , and yielded almonds .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , haba u Moses u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , u la ïohi ba u diengduh jong u Aaron , uba ïeng na ka bynta ka jait Lebi , u la khie lung . U la shylluit , phuh syntiew , bad sei ki soh almond kiba ih !

translation.en: For the  Lord  shall comfort Zion : he will comfort all her waste places  ; and he will make her wilderness like Eden , and her desert like the garden of the  Lord   ; joy and gladness shall be found therein , thanksgiving , and the voice of melody .
translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ïa ka Jerusalem , sha kito baroh kiba shong halor ki jingpra jong ka . Wat la ka jaka jong ka , ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ngan pynlong ïa ka , ka kper , kum ka kper kaba nga la thung ha Eden . Ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen kin don hangta , bad ki jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision . Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven .
translation.kha: Te ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha u Daniel ha ka jingïohipaw , bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka bneng :

translation.en: And if a soul sin , and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the  Lord   ; though he wist it not , yet is he guilty , and shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U  Trai  , u long uba la rem bad u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bainong .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the  Lord  their God , and they built them high places in all their cities , from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki um sngewbha ïa kita . Ki tei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ha ki shnong baroh , naduh ka shnong barit eh haduh ki nongbah baheh tam .

translation.en: That they might observe his statutes , and keep his laws . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: khnang ba ki briew jong u kin kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u bad ban bat ïa ki hukum jong u baroh . Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus , and so did another disciple : that disciple was known unto the high priest , and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros bad uwei pat u synran ki la bud ïa U Jisu . Uta uwei u synran u la long uba la ïa-ithuh bha bad u Rangbah Lyngdoh , kumta u la leit rung lem bad U Jisu sha ka phyllaw ïing jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , katba u Petros pat u la ïeng shabar hajan ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah  ; for there they blessed the  Lord  : therefore the name of the same place was called , The valley of Berachah , unto this day .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw , ki ïalumlang ha ka Them Berakah bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh . Dei na kata ka daw ba la khot ïa ka them ,  Ka Berakah .

translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear your words , when ye depart out of that house or city , shake off the dust of your feet .
translation.kha: Bad lada kano kano ka ïing ne ka shnong kam pdiang sngewbha ïa phi lane pynshahshkor ïa phi , te mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi .

translation.en: Now therefore , as the  Lord  liveth , which hath established me , and set me on the throne of David my father , and who hath made me an house , as he promised , Adonijah shall be put to death this day .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , u la pynskhem triang ïa nga ha ka khet jong u Dabid , u kpa jong nga ; u la bat ïa la ka kular bad u la ai ïa ka hima ha nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Nga smai da U  Trai  uba im ba u Adonijah un ïap ha kane hi ka sngi !

translation.en: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him , and said , Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the  Lord  , we have had enough to eat , and have left plenty : for the  Lord  hath blessed his people  ; and that which is left is this great store .
translation.kha: bad u Asaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , uba hiarpateng na u Sadok , u ong ha u ,  Naduh ba ki briew ki sdang ban wanrah ïa ki jingai jong ki sha ka Templ , kaba la don , ka la biang ban bam bad kaba sah tam ka long kaba bun . Ngi don ïa kane baroh namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Hell and destruction are before the  Lord  : how much more then the hearts of the children of men ?
translation.kha: Wat ka pyrthei kiba ïap kam lah ban buhrieh na U  Trai  ba un ym tip kaei kaba don hangta ; kumno te ngi lah ban buhrieh ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi na U Blei ?

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they say unto you , Thou land devourest up men , and hast bereaved thy nations  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Ka long kaba shisha kaba ki briew ki ong ba ka ri ka bam briew , bad ki ong ba ka knieh noh na ka jaitbynriew ïa ki khun jong ka .

translation.en: A friend loveth at all times , and a brother is born for adversity .
translation.kha: Ki paralok borabor ki pynpaw ïa ka jingieit jong ki . Ki hynmen ki para ki dei na ka bynta kaei lada kim ïarap lem ha por jingjynjar ?

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people rose early , and built there an altar , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings .
translation.kha: Dang step ha ka sngi kaba bud ki paidbah ki tei ïa ka duwan hangta , ki ai ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok bad thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk .

translation.en: And he saith unto him , Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee , thou wicked servant . Thou knewest that I was an austere man , taking up that I laid not down , and reaping that I did not sow :
translation.kha: U la ong ha u , ‘ Me u shakri bym long ! Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki ktien jong me ban pynrem ïa me ! Me tip ba nga long u briew uba eh , uba shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong nga bad uba ot ïa kaei kaba ngam shym bet .

translation.en: And last of all he was seen of me also , as of one born out of due time .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh u la paw ruh ha nga — wat la nga long kum uta uba la kha khlem biang por .

translation.en: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth , and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain :
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam bad ki nongbishar jong phi ki dei ban leit thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kata ka jaka ha kaba la lap ïa ka metïap bad ki shnong kiba marjan .

translation.en: But Absalom pressed him , that he let Amnon and all the king s sons go with him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ïai ban haduh ba u Dabid ha kaba khatduh u la shah ïa u Amnon bad ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ban leit bad u Absalom . U Absalom u la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai kaba ïabiang ïa u syiem

translation.en: And he said unto them , Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day , which ye shall command your children to observe to do , all the words of this law .
translation.kha: u ong ,  Sumar bha ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Ïathuh ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi , ba ki ruh kin ïai kohnguh ïa baroh ki jinghikai jong U Blei .

translation.en: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom : for he was comforted concerning Amnon , seeing he was dead .
translation.kha: hynrei haba u la sangeh ban pyrkhat ïa ka jingïap u Amnon , u la shlei da ka jingkynmaw ieit ïa u Absalom u khun jong u .

translation.en: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah .
translation.kha: Kumta ki khun Israel ki buh ïa ki briew ban apthap ïa ka Gibeah baroh sawdong .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses went out unto the tabernacle , that all the people rose up , and stood every man at his tent door , and looked after Moses , until he was gone into the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba u Moses u leit shata , ki paidbah ki ïeng ha ki jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki ïa-peit ïa u Moses haduh ba un da rung shapoh .

translation.en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers , and to the hand of the workmen .
translation.kha: Ngi la shim ïa ka pisa kaba la buh ha ka Templ bad ngi la aiti ha ki nongtrei bad ki nongkhmih ba-halor .

translation.en: Then went king David in , and sat before the  Lord  , and he said , Who am I , O Lord  God  ? and what is my house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , u shong bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngam long uba bit ïa kaei kaba me la leh na ka bynta jong nga lymne wat ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: And he answered and said , Must I not take heed to speak that which the  Lord  hath put in my mouth ?
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ïa nga ban kren .

translation.en: But they shall proceed no further : for their folly shall be manifest unto all men , as theirs also was .
translation.kha: Hynrei kin ym lah ban leit kham jngai , namar baroh kin ïohi ba katno ki long kiba mutlop . Kata ka long kaei kaba dang dep jia ïa u Jannes bad u Jambres .

translation.en: They answered and said unto him , Thou wast altogether born in sins , and dost thou teach us ? And they cast him out .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  La kha bad la pynsan ïa me hapoh ka pop — bad me pyrshang ban hikai ïa ngi ?  Bad kumta ki la beh noh ïa u na ka synagog .

translation.en: Wherefore , though I wrote unto you , I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong , nor for his cause that suffered wrong , but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you .
translation.kha: Kumta , wat la nga la thoh ïa kato ka shithi , ka la long ym namar jong uta uba la leh bymdei lane na ka bynta uta uba la shah leh bymdei . Pynban , nga la thoh ïa ka khnang ban pynshai ha phi , ha khmat jong U Blei , katno ka long da shisha kaba jylliew ka jingaiti jong phi sha ngi .

translation.en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines , and to cut off from Tyre and Zidon every helper that remaineth : for the  Lord  will spoil the Philistines , the remnant of the country of Caphtor .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa ka Philistia , ban pyndam noh na ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ïa ka jingïarap baroh kaba dang sah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Philistia , baroh kiba wan na ki rud duriaw ka Krit .

translation.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city , behold , there was a dead man carried out , the only son of his mother , and she was a widow : and much people of the city was with her .
translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong , ka kynhun leit ontep ka dang mih shabar . U briew uba la ïap u long u khun nyngkong jong ka briew kaba long ka riewkynthei , bad u paidbah babun na ka shnong u la ïadon lem bad ka .

translation.en: There are only books on the shelf .
translation.kha: Don tang ki kot ha duli .

translation.en: And they that did eat were four thousand men , beside women and children .
translation.kha: Ka jingkheiñ ki rangbah kiba la bam ka la long saw hajar ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .

translation.en: He that observeth the wind shall not sow  ; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap .
translation.kha: Lada phi ap haduh ba ka lyer bad ka jinglong ka suiñbneng kin bit kin biang , da lei lei phin ym thung ei ei bad phin ym ïoh ot ei ei .

translation.en: And they shall make the ephod of gold , of blue , and of purple , of scarlet , and fine twined linen , with cunning work .
translation.kha: Kin suh ïa ka ephod da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , u  sai ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .

translation.en: And , behold , thy cousin Elisabeth , she hath also conceived a son in her old age : and this is the sixth month with her , who was called barren .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ka ba-ha-ïing jong pha , ka Elisabeth . Ïa kaba la ong ba kam lah ban ïoh khun , hynrei mynta ka la hynriew bnai ka jingpunkhun , wat la ka la long kaba la tymmen bha .

translation.en: John answered them , saying , I baptize with water : but there standeth one among you , whom ye know not  ;
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab ,  Nga pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei hapdeng jong phi don uwei uba ïeng uba phim ithuh .

translation.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus  bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki synran , uta ïa uba U Jisu u ieit , u da shong shaniah ha U Jisu .

translation.en: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb  ; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . Kine ki jingainguh thang ki dei ki jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered , even Jesus , made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi U Jisu u la rung hapoh hangta shuwa jong ngi , bad u la jia long U Rangbah Lyngdoh junom , ha ka rukom long lyngdoh u Melkhisedek .

translation.en: So the Philistines were subdued , and they came no more into the coast of Israel : and the hand of the  Lord  was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Philistia ki la shahjop , bad U  Trai  u la khanglad ïa ki na kaba jop ïa ka ri Israel katba u Samuel u dang im .

translation.en: Having many things to write unto you , I would not write with paper and ink : but I trust to come unto you , and speak face to face , that our joy may be full .
translation.kha: Nga don shibun eh ban ïathuh ha phi , hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata ha ka kot bad ka sia ; pynban , nga kyrmen ban da wan jngoh ïa phi bad ïakren markhmat bad phi , ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .

translation.en: I will say of the  Lord  , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God  ; in him will I trust .
translation.kha: u lah ban ong ha u ,  Me long u nongkyrshan bad nongïada jong nga , me long U Blei jong nga ; ha me nga shaniah .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the house of Israel , Seek ye me , and ye shall live :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong kumne ha ki paid Israel ,  Wan sha nga , bad phin ïoh im .

translation.en: And when he had removed him , he raised up unto them David to be their king  ; to whom also he gave testimony , and said , I have found David the son of Jesse , a man after mine own heart , which shall fulfil all my will .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la weng noh ïa u , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban long u syiem jong ki . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang jong u : ‘ Nga la shem ba u Dabid u khun jong u Jesse , u long u jait briew uba nga sngewbha , u briew u ban leh ïa baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u ban leh .’

translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles : else the new wine doth burst the bottles , and the wine is spilled , and the bottles will be marred : but new wine must be put into new bottles .
translation.kha: Lymne ym don uno uno uba theh ïa ka waiñ thymmai ha ki lwa snieh barim , namar ka waiñ kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , bad baroh ar , ka waiñ bad ki snieh kin sniew noh . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ thymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai .

translation.en: I wish you'd quit throwing things at me .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin sangeh kawang tiar ha nga .

translation.en: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal .
translation.kha: Ka Athalaïah ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka tang shu mar ïatip ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jong ka , ka ai hukum ba yn pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem .

translation.en: And I , behold , I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians , and they shall follow them : and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
translation.kha: Ngan pynmutlop haduh katta katta ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin beh nadien jong ki , bad ngan ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ka jingjop jong nga ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u , ïa ki kali ïapom jong u , bad ïa ki nongñiah jong u .

translation.en: And saw him saying unto me ,  Make haste , and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem : for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me .
translation.kha: ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa U Trai , haba u la ong ha nga , ‘ Pynkloi bad mihnoh kyrkieh na Jerusalem , namar ki briew hangne kin ym pdiang ïa ka jingsakhi jong me shaphang jong nga .’

translation.en: And as ye would that men should do to you , do ye also to them likewise .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kiwei kumba phi kwah ïa ki ban leh ïa phi .

translation.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .
translation.kha: ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ha ka ri ; bad ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ba long jingbam .

translation.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said , Master , thou hast well said .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ong ,  Ka jubab kaba dei , ko Nonghikai !

translation.en: For when God made promise to Abraham , because he could swear by no greater , he sware by himself ,
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la pynlong ka jingkular ha u Abraham , u la smai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular . Namar ym don uwei ruh u ban kham khraw ban ïa u , u la pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka kyrteng haba u la pynlong ïa la ka jingsmai .

translation.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile , go with him twain .
translation.kha: Bad lada uwei na ki shipai u pynbor ïa phi ban kit ïa ka jingkit jong u shi kilomitar , to kit ïa ka ar kilomitar .

translation.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment , saying , Alas , alas , that great city Babylon , that mighty city ! for in one hour is thy judgment come .
translation.kha: Kin ïeng jngai bah na ka , namar ba ki sheptieng ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshitom jong ka . Ki ong ,  Katno kaba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ! Kane ka nongbah Babilon kaba khraw bad kaba khlaiñbor ! Tang hapoh shi kynta pha la shah pynshitom !

translation.en: For they said unto me , Make us gods , which shall go before us : for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
translation.kha: Ki ong ïa nga , ‘ Ngim tip ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , u briew uba la ïalam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta , thaw noh ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .’

translation.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewphylla ïa kaei kaba lah jia ha ki apostol .

translation.en: But if they will not obey , I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew kam kohnguh , te ngan rat lut khoit bad pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: For what the law could not do , in that it was weak through the flesh , God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh , and for sin , condemned sin in the flesh :
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka Hukum kam lah ban leh , namar ka jinglong ba kynja doh ka long kaba tlot , U Blei u la leh . U la pynrem ïa ka pop ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh da kaba u la phah ïa U Khun jong u hi , uba la wan kum ka jinglong u briew uba pop , ban jop ïa ka pop .

translation.en: Which also said , Ye men of Galilee , why stand ye gazing up into heaven ? this same Jesus , which is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven .
translation.kha: Ko nong Galilaïa , balei phi ïa-ïeng hangne da kaba khmied sha ka sahit bneng ? Une U Jisu , ïa uba la shim noh sha bneng na phi , un wan pat ha kajuh ka rukom ba phi la ïohi ba u kiew sha bneng .

translation.en: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins : also they have dominion over our bodies , and over our cattle , at their pleasure , and we are in great distress .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka ri ka pynmih ka leit sha ki syiem kiba me la buh halor jong ngi namar ba ngi la leh pop . Ki leh katba ki sngewbha ïa ngi bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi , bad ngi don ha ka jinglanot kaba khraw !

translation.en: But when Herod heard thereof , he said , It is John , whom I beheaded : he is risen from the dead .
translation.kha: Haba u Herod u la ïohsngew ïa kata , u la ong ,  U dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ! Nga la phah khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u , hynrei u la im pat !

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families , the cities and their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon : for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the  Lord  his God was with him .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki wan sha ka liang u Asa na Ephraim , Manasseh , bad Simeon , bad ki shong ki sah ha ka hima jong u , namar ki la ïohi ba U  Trai  u long lem bad u . U Asa u phah khot ïa ki baroh bad ïa ki paid Judah bad Benjamin .

translation.en: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Kane ruh ka kynthup ïa phi kiba ha Rom , ïa kiba U Blei u la khot ban long ki jong U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek , there is neither bond nor free , there is neither male nor female : for ye are all one in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Kumta , ym don jingïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , hapdeng ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , hapdeng ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ; phi baroh phi ïalong kawei ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock s blood , and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi bad rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: This man was taken of the Jews , and should have been killed of them : then came I with an army , and rescued him , having understood that he was a Roman .
translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki la kem ïa une u briew bad sa ba kin pynïap ïa u . Nga la ïoh jingtip ba u long u traishnong ka Hima Rom , kumta nga la leit bad ki shipai jong nga bad nga la pyllait im ïa u .

translation.en: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said , It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab :
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Ka dei ka theisamla nongwei kaba la wan phai na Moab bad ka Naomi .

translation.en: And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded that ye should do : and the glory of the  Lord  shall appear unto you .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban leh ïa kane baroh , khnang ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan paw ha phi .

translation.en: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul : all they that hate me love death .
translation.kha: U briew u bym shem ïa nga u pynmong ïa lade ; kat uba isih ïa nga u ieit ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: And Moses did look upon all the work , and , behold , they had done it as the  Lord  had commanded , even so had they done it : and Moses blessed them .
translation.kha: U Moses u bishar bniah ïa ka kam baroh bad u ïohi ba ki la leh ïa ka kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kumta u Moses u kyrkhu ïa ki .

translation.en: And they asked Baruch , saying , Tell us now , How didst thou write all these words at his mouth ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ong ïa u ,  Ïathuh ha ngi , mynta , kumno phi la poi thoh ïa kane baroh ? Hato u Jeremaïah u la ong ïa ka ha phi ban thoh ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness , ( for the mountain did burn with fire , ) that ye came near unto me , even all the heads of your tribes , and your elders  ;
translation.kha: Katba uta u lum baroh uwei u dang mehding bad phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba wan napdeng ka jingdum , ki nongïalam bad ki tymmen ki san na ki jait jong phi ki ïawan sha nga

translation.en: Thou sayest , ( but they are but vain words , ) I have counsel and strength for the war . Now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?
translation.kha: U dawa ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit ha ka kam shipai bad ka bor ? Mano phi pyrkhat u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Assyria ?

translation.en: Your glorying is not good . Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump ?
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei ïa phi ba phin sngewsarong ! Phi tip ïa ka jingong ,  Tang khyndiat u thiat , u pynsieb ïa u kpu im ba la khleh ?

translation.en: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow . For what is your life ? It is even a vapour , that appeareth for a little time , and then vanisheth away .
translation.kha: Phim tip wat ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa ka jingim jong phi ha ka lashai ! Phi long kum ka tdem , kaba paw tang shipor bad nangta ka jah noh .

translation.en: And now I have told you before it come to pass , that , when it is come to pass , ye might believe .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane mynta ha shuwa ba baroh kan jia , ba kumta haba kata kan jia , phin ïoh ngeit .

translation.en: Wherefore , said they , if we have found grace in thy sight , let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession , and bring us not over Jordan .
translation.kha: Sngewbha ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jaka kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad to wat ai ïa ngi ban jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ban shong ban sah hangta .

translation.en: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps .
translation.kha: U syiem u kren ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi shaphang kine ki jingai ,

translation.en: And Jesus went about all Galilee , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit kylleng ka Galilaïa , u da hikai ha ki Synagog , u da ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima ki Bneng , bad u da pynkhiah ïa ki briew kiba la don baroh ki jait jingpang bad jingshitom .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and will break his arms , the strong , and that which was broken  ; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand .
translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u baroh ar tylli — kaba dang bha bad kaba la kheiñ lypa — bad ka waitlam kan hap na ka kti jong u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night  ; nor for the arrow that flieth by day  ;
translation.kha: Men ym sheptieng na ki jingma mynmiet ne na ki jingtur ïaleh ha ka por mynsngi ,

translation.en: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchijah , heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people , saying ,
translation.kha: U Shephataïah u khun jong u Mattan , u Gedalaïah u khun jong u Pashhur , u Jehukal u khun jong u Shelemaïah , bad u Pashhur u khun jong u Malkhaïah ki la ïohsngew ba nga la ong ïa ki paidbah ba

translation.en: How many are the days of thy servant ? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me ?
translation.kha: Slem sa katno nga dei ban ap ? Lano men pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?

translation.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment : for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again .
translation.kha: Lada don uno uno uba bitar shen , to ai ba un shim ïa ki soh ba mih na kata . Lada phi pyllait ïa u na ka jingjynjar shisien , phin sa hap leh biang .

translation.en: She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .
translation.kha: Ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka la lah ban leh ; ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh iwbih halor ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh lypa shuwa ka por jong ka jingtep ïa ka met jong nga .

translation.en: They were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe , cities of Lycaonia , and unto the region that lieth round about :
translation.kha: Haba ki apostol ki la tip shaphang kata , ki la phet sha ki nongbah Lystra bad Derbe kiba ha Lykaonia , bad sha ka thain ba-marjan .

translation.en: I also will do this unto you  ; I will even appoint over you terror , consumption , and the burning ague , that shall consume the eyes , and cause sorrow of heart : and ye shall sow your seed in vain , for your enemies shall eat it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynngat ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar — ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah , bad ki jingpang shit ki ban pynmatlah ïa phi bad ban pynlong ïa ka jingim jong phi ban sep-ei . Phin bet ïa u symbai , hynrei um myntoi ïa phi , naba ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi bad kin bam ïa kaba phi la thung .

translation.en: And Jacob loved Rachel  ; and said , I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïapmat ïa ka Rakhel , kumta u ong ,  Ngan trei hynñiew snem na ka bynta jong phi , lada phi shah ba ngan shongkurim ïa ka Rakhel .

translation.en: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned , and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .
translation.kha: Haba ki koidi jong u Ishmael ki la ïohi ïa u Johanan bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki shipai lem bad u , ki la kmen , bad phai bad mareh sha ki .

translation.en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom , saying , Let me , I pray thee , pass through thy land : but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab : but he would not consent : and Israel abode in Kadesh .
translation.kha: Nangta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Edom ban pan jingbit ban ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Hynrei u syiem Edom um shym shah ïa ki . Ki kyrpad ruh ïa u syiem Moab , u ruh um shym shah ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki hap ban sah ha Kadesh .

translation.en: Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying , When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month , even those seventy years , did ye at all fast unto me , even to me ?
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka ri bad ïa ki lyngdoh ba haba ki shahjingit bad ïambriew ha u bnai basan bad bahynñiew ha kine ki hynñiewphew snem , kam shym dei ha ka jingñiewburom ïa nga .

translation.en: The sea saw it , and fled : Jordan was driven back .
translation.kha: Ka Duriaw Basaw ka la khmih bad ka phet noh , ka wah Jordan ka la sangeh ban tuid .

translation.en: And I will set a sign among them , and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations , to Tarshish , Pul , and Lud , that draw the bow , to Tubal , and Javan , to the isles afar off , that have not heard my fame , neither have seen my glory  ; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynsah katto katne na ki bad phah ïa ki sha ki jaitbynriew bad sha ki ri kiba jngai ki bym pat shym la ïohsngew ïa ka nam jong nga lymne ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong nga : sha Spain , sha Libya bad sha Lydia , ryngkat bad ki nongrah ryntieh kiba tbit , bad sha Tubal bad sha Gris . Hapdeng kine ki jaitbynriew kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhrawbor jong nga .

translation.en: But did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , like unto the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki hima kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang , u Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness , and chased out of the world .
translation.kha: Yn sa beh noh ïa u na ka ri jong kiba im , yn sa beh noh na ka jingshai sha ka jingdum .

translation.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh , saying , Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki leit sha u Pharaoh bad ki la ujor ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi leh ïa kane ha ngi ?

translation.en: Which story did you tell ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka Jingiathuh khana ba phi iathuh ?

translation.en: And he said , What have I sinned , that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab , to slay me ?
translation.kha: U Obadaïah u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba nga la leh ba phi kwah ban buh ïa nga ha ka jingma jong ka jingshah pynïap noh ha u syiem Ahab ?

translation.en: Yet let no man strive , nor reprove another : for thy people are as they that strive with the priest .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Wat ai ba uno uno un kynnoh ïa ki briew lane pynrem ïa ki — ka jingmudui jong nga ka long pyrshah ïa phi ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the  Lord  will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem  ; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet , and their eyes shall consume away in their holes , and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam ka jingpang bashyrkhei halor ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka doh jong ki kan pyut noh katba ki dang im ; ki khmat bad ki thylliej jong ki kin pyut noh .

translation.en: So that none of the remnant of Judah , which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall escape or remain , that they should return into the land of Judah , to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there : for none shall return but such as shall escape .
translation.kha: Yn ym don na ki briew jong ka Judah kiba la iehnoh shadien bad kiba la wan sha Ijipt ban shong ban sah kin lait phet ne lait ïap . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban leit phai sha Judah , sha kaba ki sliang ban shong ban sah sa shisien pat . Yn ym don ba ïoh wan phai lait noh katto katne ki nongphetwir .

translation.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet .
translation.kha: Lada phi pynroh ïa ki paralok jong phi , phi buh jingriam ïa lade .

translation.en: And they were all amazed , and were in doubt , saying one to another , What meaneth this ?
translation.kha: Da kaba lyngngoh bad shaïong , ki la ïai kylli uwei ïa uwei pat ,  Aïu kane ka kit jingmut ?

translation.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee  ; I bare the loss of it  ; of my hand didst thou require it , whether stolen by day , or stolen by night .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba ka langbrot ka shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , nga kitkhlieh hi ma nga . Ngam ju wanrah ïa kata ban pyn-i ha phi ba kam shym dei ka jingbakla jong nga . Phi dawa ba ma nga hi ngan hap buria ïa kaba lah shah tuh la ka long mynsngi lane mynmiet .

translation.en: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem  ; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue , Aceldama , that is to say , The field of blood .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , bad ki la khot kyrteng ha ka ktien jong ki ïa kata ka lyngkha  Ka Akeldama ,  kaba mut  Ka lyngkha ka snam .  )

translation.en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet , resort ye thither unto us : our God shall fight for us .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingput ronsing , ïalumlang sawdong jong nga . U Blei jong ngi un ïaleh na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: But when thou doest alms , let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïarap ïa u briew uba kyrduh , leh ïa ka ha kata ka rukom ba wat u paralok bajan tam jong phi un ym tip shaphang kata .

translation.en: Behold , the eyes of the Lord  God  are upon the sinful kingdom , and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth  ; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga khmih ïa kane ka hima Israel kaba pop , bad ngan pynjot ïa ka na sla khyndew . Hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .

translation.en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jotham u khun jong u Ussaïah u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: And a curse , if ye will not obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day , to go after other gods , which ye have not known .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ka jingtim , lada phi leh lyndet ïa kine ki hukum bad phai noh ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ïa kiba phim pat ju tip mynno mynno .

translation.en: And he cried and said , Father Abraham , have mercy on me , and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water , and cool my tongue  ; for I am tormented in this flame .
translation.kha: Kumta u la pyrta , ‘ Ko Kpa Abraham ! To sngewsynei ïa nga , bad phah ïa u Lasaros ban wieh ïa ka shynriah ti jong u ha ka um khyndiat bad pyntngen ïa u thylliej jong nga , namar nga don ha ka jingshitom bakhraw ha kane ka ding !’

translation.en: But the end of all things is at hand : be ye therefore sober , and watch unto prayer .
translation.kha: Kaba kut jong kiei kiei baroh ka la jan . Phi dei ban long kiba lah ban synshar ïa lade bad kiba sharai , ban lah ban duwai .

translation.en: But I know you , that ye have not the love of God in you .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip kiba kumno ki briew phi long , bad nga tip ba phim don ka jingieit ïa U Blei ha ki dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel , whose name was called Belteshazzar  ; and the thing was true , but the time appointed was long : and he understood the thing , and had understanding of the vision .
translation.kha: ( Ha ka snem kaba lai kaba u Syros u long u patsha jong ka Persia , ïa ka khubor la pynpaw ha u Daniel , ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar . Ka khubor ka long kaba shisha hynrei kaba jwat eh ban sngewthuh . La batai ïa ka ha u ha ka jingïohipaw . )

translation.en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased  ; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit ïa lade yn pynkhraw .

translation.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand .
translation.kha: Da la ka kti hi nga thoh ïa kane :  Ki Jingai Khublei na u Paul .

translation.en: Where they crucified him , and two other with him , on either side one , and Jesus in the midst .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la sahnarphna ïa u ; bad ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang bad U Jisu hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee , and that he may perform the word which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
translation.kha: Ym dei namar ka hok jong phi ne ka jinglong beit ha ka dohnud ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki , hynrei ka long namar ka jingbymman jong kita ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la beh krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi ; ba un pynskhem ïa la ka kular ba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .

translation.en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee , to cause thee to hear it with thine ears ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga leh ïa kane , uno uno uba lait na ka jingpynjot un wan bad un ïathuh ha phi shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him , saying , And what shall we do ? And he said unto them , Do violence to no man , neither accuse any falsely  ; and be content with your wages .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki shipai ruh ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kumno ma ngi pat ? Kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ?  U la ong ha ki ,  Wat shim pisa nano nano da ka bor lane mudui lamler ïano ïano . To sngewhun ha la ka bainong .

translation.en: And immediately , while he yet spake , cometh Judas , one of the twelve , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren mynba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran u la poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah ba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa uba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum , bad ki rangbah nongïalam .

translation.en: For it is the day of the  Lord s  vengeance , and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka por ha kaba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ka Seïon bad pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong ka .

translation.en: And Samuel said unto Jesse , Are here all thy children ? And he said , There remaineth yet the youngest , and , behold , he keepeth the sheep . And Samuel said unto Jesse , Send and fetch him : for we will not sit down till he come hither .
translation.kha: Nangta u kylli ïa u ,  Phi dang don shuh ki khun shynrang ?  U Jesse u jubab ,  Don sa tang uba khatduh , hynrei u dang leit sharai ïa ki langbrot .   Bthah ïa u ban wan shane ,  u Samuel u ong .  Ngin ym ai jingkñia katba um pat wan .

translation.en: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u syiem Darius u la soi ïa ka hukum .

translation.en: And the  Lord  came down in a cloud , and spake unto him , and took of the spirit that was upon him , and gave it unto the seventy elders : and it came to pass , that , when the spirit rested upon them , they prophesied , and did not cease .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la kren ïa u . U la shim khyndiat ka bor mynsiem kaba u la ai ha u Moses bad u ai ïa ka ha kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam . Haba kata ka bor mynsiem ka la wan shong ha ki , ki sdang ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa , hynrei tang shipor .

translation.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki khat-ar ngut kiba u la jied : U Simon ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa u , u Petros ) ;

translation.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah , and I will save the house of Joseph , and I will bring them again to place them  ; for I have mercy upon them : and they shall be as though I had not cast them off : for I am the  Lord  their God , and will hear them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki paid Judah ; ngan pyllait im ïa ki paid Israel . Ngan don ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki baroh sha ïing . Kin long kum kiba ngam pat ju kyntait ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: ( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) It is good to find a quiet place away from other people to say our personal prayers .—Mark 1 :35 .
translation.kha: ( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) Kan kham bha lada ngi duwai ha ki jaka ba kynjah ha kaba ym don ba pynwit ïa ngi .—Markos 1 :35 .

translation.en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world , but was manifest in these last times for you ,
translation.kha: La jied ïa u da U Blei ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei bad la pynpaw ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel , when they give an offering unto the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .
translation.kha: Haba ki siew ïa kane ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , uba riewspah un ym ai tam , bad uba duk un ym ai duna .

translation.en: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people , she came to the people into the temple of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka syiem Athalaïah ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba mih na ki nongap phira bad u paidbah , kumta ka pynstet ban leit sha ka Templ , ha kaba u paidbah u la ïalumlang .

translation.en: And he arose , and did eat and drink , and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la khie joit , u bam bad u dih bad ka jingbam ka la ai bor ïa u ban ïaid sawphew sngi sha Sinai , u lum bakhuid .

translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will fill all the inhabitants of this land , even the kings that sit upon David s throne , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness .
translation.kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pyndap ïa ki briew ha kane ka ri da ka waiñ tad haduh ba kin buaid : ki syiem , kiba long kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then when Jesus came , he found that he had lain in the grave four days already .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la poi , u la shem ba la lah tep ïa u Lasaros saw sngi mynshuwa .

translation.en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked  ; and , behold , the multitude melted away , and they went on beating down one another .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ap phira jong u Saul ha Gibeah ha ri Benjamin ki ïohi ïa ki Philistia ba ki phet ha ka jingkulmar .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , that nation will I punish , saith the  Lord  , with the sword , and with the famine , and with the pestilence , until I have consumed them by his hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima kam pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u , te ngan pynshitom ïa kata ka jaitbynriew da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad da ka jingpang tad haduh ba ngan da shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban pynjot khoit ïa ka .

translation.en: These things I command you , that ye love one another .
translation.kha: Kane , te , ka long kaei kaba nga hukum ïa phi ; to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Then Jesse called Abinadab , and made him pass before Samuel . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jesse u khot ïa u Abinadab u khun jong u bad u wan ïalam ïa u sha u Samuel . Hynrei u Samuel u ong ,  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïa une ruh .

translation.en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth–el , and pitched his tent , having Beth–el on the west , and Ai on the east : and there he builded an altar unto the  Lord  , and called upon the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u la leit shaphang shathie sha ka ri lum ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Bethel bad u la pynïeng ïa ka dara hapdeng ka Bethel shaphang sepngi bad ka Ai shaphang mihngi . Hangta ruh u la tei ïa ka duwan bad u la mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Seek good , and not evil , that ye may live : and so the  Lord  , the God of hosts , shall be with you , as ye have spoken .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka jingthmu jong phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha , bad ym ïa kaei kaba sniew , khnang ba phin ïoh im . Te U  Trai  , U Blei Badonbor Baroh , da shisha un don ryngkat bad phi , kumba phi kam ba u long .

translation.en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite  ; the same is Jerusalem : and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward , which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward :
translation.kha: bad artet lyngba ka Them Hinnom ter ter sha ka phang bashathie jong u lum ha kaba don ka nongbah Jerusalem jong ki Jebus . Nangta u pud u kiew artet sha ka kliar u lum ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Them Hinnom , ha ka tduh bashatei jong ka Them Rephaim .

translation.en: Thou therefore , and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him , and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .
translation.kha: Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki shakri jong me , phin ïarep ha ka khyndew na ka bynta ka longïing jong u Saul , u kynrad jong phi , bad wallam ïa ka jingmih nangta ban pynbiang bam ïa ki . Hynrei u Mephibosheth hi un ïailong uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka miej bam jong nga .  ( U Siba u don khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang bad arphew ngut ki shakri . )

translation.en: In the second year of Darius the king , in the sixth month , in the first day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynriew , U  Trai  u la kren lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa . Ka khubor ka la long na ka bynta u lat ka Judah , u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel , bad na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak .

translation.en: And the saying pleased Absalom well , and all the elders of Israel .
translation.kha: Kane ka la i kum ka jingai jingmut kaba bha ïa u Absalom bad ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast : and they come and say unto him , Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast , but thy disciples fast not ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sien , ki nongbud jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki Pharisi ki dang ïashahjingit . Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wan ha U Jisu bad kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba ki synran jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki shahjingit , katba ki jong me kim shahjingit ?

translation.en: And one of the sons of Joiada , the son of Eliashib the high priest , was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite : therefore I chased him from me .
translation.kha: U Joïada u dei u khun jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh , hynrei uwei na ki khun jong u Joïada u la shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u Sanballat na ka shnong Beth Horon , kumta nga la pynlong ba u Joïada un mihnoh na Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine :
translation.kha: Ki masi kynthei kiba raikhoh ki la bam lut plain ïa kita kiba sngaid ,

translation.en: And the people waited for Zacharias , and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ki paidbah ki la ïa-ap ïa u Sekharaïah bad ki da sngewlyngngoh balei ba u pynlut bun por hapoh ka Templ .

translation.en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them , which I command thee this day , to love the  Lord  thy God , and to walk ever in his ways  ; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee , beside these three :
translation.kha: te phi dei ban jied sa lai tylli ki shnong . ( Un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri lada phi leh ïa baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi ha kane ka sngi bad lada phi ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad im kat kum ki jinghikai jong U . )

translation.en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest , where the scribes and the elders were assembled .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu ki la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïing jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kaba ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïalumlang .

translation.en: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen , neither shall the beast of the land devour them  ; but they shall dwell safely , and none shall make them afraid .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ba-thala kin ym lute shuh ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kin ym pynïap bad bam duh ïa ki . Kin im ha ka jingshngain , bad yn ym don ba pynsheptieng ïa ki .

translation.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us , we will go down and buy thee food :
translation.kha: Lada phi kloi ban phah ïa u para jong ngi bad ngi , ngin leit thied bam ïa phi .

translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  brought an east wind upon the land all that day , and all that night  ; and when it was morning , the east wind brought the locusts .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u rah ïa la u diengduh , bad U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka lyer na shaphang mihngi ban beh ha kata ka ri baroh shi sngi bad baroh shi miet . Ynda mynstep kata ka lyer mihngi ka wan kit ïa ki puit .

translation.en: They looked , but there was none to save  ; even unto the  Lord  , but he answered them not .
translation.kha: Ki wad jingïarap , hynrei ym don uba pyllait im ïa ki ; ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um jubab .

translation.en: And he is the head of the body , the church : who is the beginning , the firstborn from the dead ; that in all things he might have the preeminence .
translation.kha: U long u khlieh jong ka balang kaba long ka met jong u ; u long u tynrai jong ka jingim jong ka . U long U Khun uba la kha nyngkong , ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , khnang ba tang ma u hi un ïoh ïa ka bynta kaba nyngkong ha kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the  Lord  , as the showers upon the grass , that tarrieth not for man , nor waiteth for the sons of men .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin long kum ka umjer ba pynpyngngad ba la phah da U  Trai  na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew ba bun , kum ki um slap ha ki jingthung ba dang mih . Kin shaniah ha U Blei , ym ha u briew .

translation.en: They go up by the mountains  ; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them .
translation.kha: Ki tuid nalor ki lumbah bad sha ki them , sha ka jaka ba me la buh na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And he cast stones at David , and at all the servants of king David : and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left .
translation.kha: U Shimei u la sdang ban kawang maw ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , wat haba la ker tawiar ïa u Dabid da ki rangbah jong u bad ki nongïada jong u .

translation.en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales : and he received sight forthwith , and arose , and was baptized .
translation.kha: Kumta hi kaei re kaei kaba kum ki snep dohkha ki la hap na ki khmat jong u Saul , bad u la lah ban ïohi pat . U la ïeng joit bad la pynbaptis ïa u ;

translation.en: And he said unto them , Depart yet for three days , then come again to me . And the people departed .
translation.kha: Sa wan biang hadien lai sngi bad ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jubab jong nga ,  u phai ktien . Kumta ki leit noh .

translation.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil : he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words , even when the needy speaketh right .
translation.kha: U briew uba mutlop u long uba sniew bad u leh ïa ki kam kiba sniew ; u ïasylla ban pynsniew ïa kiba duk da ki jingshukor bad ban khanglad ïa ki ban ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki .

translation.en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head , and a reed in his right hand : and they bowed the knee before him , and mocked him , saying , Hail , King of the Jews !
translation.kha: Nangta ki la thain pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ki la buh ïa u dieng ha ka kti kamon jong u ; nangta ki la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u bad ki la kren ibeiñ ïa u .  Im slem u Syiem ki Jiw !  ki la ong .

translation.en: Yea , though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good : do not all go to one place ?
translation.kha: kham palat ban ïa u briew u bym ïoh lehkmen ha ka jingim , la u lah ban im ar hajar snem . Nalorkata , baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka .

translation.en: And Salah lived thirty years , and begat Eber :
translation.kha: Haba u Shelah u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Eber ;

translation.en: Thine , O  Lord  , is the greatness , and the power , and the glory , and the victory , and the majesty : for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine  ; thine is the kingdom , O  Lord  , and thou art exalted as head above all .
translation.kha: Me long uba khraw bad uba donbor , uba donburom , uba itynnat bad uba iphieng . Kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew ki dei ki jong me ; me dei u syiem , u nongsynshar bahakhlieh duh halor baroh .

translation.en: Behold the fowls of the air : for they sow not , neither do they reap , nor gather into barns  ; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them . Are ye not much better than they ?
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki sim : kim bet symbai , kim ïalum ïa ka jingot bad buh ïa ka ha ki thiar ; pynban U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u sumar sukher ïa ki ! Hato phim kam kor shibun ban ïa ki sim ?

translation.en: And he spake of trees , from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall : he spake also of beasts , and of fowl , and of creeping things , and of fishes .
translation.kha: U kren shaphang ki dieng bad ki jingthung , naduh ki dieng Kedar Lebanon haduh u Hissop uba mih halor kynroh ; u la kren shaphang ki mrad , ki sim , ki bseiñ , bad ki dohkha .

translation.en: They have belied the  Lord  , and said , It is not he  ; neither shall evil come upon us  ; neither shall we see sword nor famine :
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la len ïa u bad ki la ong ,  Un ym leh ei ei da shisha . Ngin ym mad ïa ki por ba-eh ; ngin ym mad ïa ka thma lane ka  nemsniew .

translation.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , that he take up the censers out of the burning , and scatter thou the fire yonder  ; for they are hallowed .
translation.kha: Ong ïa u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh ban weng noh ïa ki khiew buh ding kiba da ka rnong na kiba sah jong ki briew kiba la shah thang bad ban bret ïa u rnga ding na kita ki khiew shaei shaei , namar kita ki khiew buh ding ki long kiba khuid .

translation.en: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven : and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn , and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory .
translation.kha: Nangta ka dak U Khun U Briew kan paw ha ka sahit bneng , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin ïam haba ki ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u wan ha ki lyoh bneng ha ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion on them , because they fainted , and were scattered abroad , as sheep having no shepherd .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei na ka bynta jong ki , namar ki la khuslai bad kim lah ban leh ei ei , kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai .

translation.en: Wherefore , my brethren , when ye come together to eat , tarry one for another .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haba phi ïawanlang ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai U Trai , to da ïa-ap paralok hi .

translation.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink , that they should conceive when they came to drink .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki kynhun langbrot ha ki shyngoid dih um jong ki . U buh ïa ki hangta , namar ki langbrot ki ju ïa-pakor haba ki wan dih um .

translation.en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim , spoiling and great destruction .
translation.kha: Ki paid ka Horonaim ki kyang , ‘ Ka Jinglehbor ! Ka Jingpynjot !’

translation.en: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things , as silver and gold , from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers  ;
translation.kha: Naba phi tip ïa kaei kaba la siew ban pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka rukom im bymmyntoi kaba la ïohpateng na ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kam shym long kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban pynjot , kum ka rupa ne ka ksiar ;

translation.en: For thou ,  Lord  , art high above all the earth : thou art exalted far above all gods .
translation.kha: A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me long u nongsynshar ha ka pyrthei baroh ; me kham khraw palat ban ïa ki blei baroh .

translation.en: For I have not sent them , saith the  Lord  , yet they prophesy a lie in my name  ; that I might drive you out , and that ye might perish , ye , and the prophets that prophesy unto you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  hi u la ong ba um shym phah ïa ki bad ba ki lamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong u . Bad kumta un beh noh ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn pynïap , ïa phi bad ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa phi ïa kine ki jinglamler .

translation.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it : also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: U suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad u shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass .
translation.kha: U Jisu te u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ba baroh ki briew kin phiah ha ki kynhun kynhun bad shong halor u phlang bajyrngam .

translation.en: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ïatip kumno ba nga la pynlut ïa ka por haba nga la don bad phi , naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba nga la poi ha ka probins jong ka Asia .

translation.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the  Lord  on the altar of the  Lord  , which he had built before the porch ,
translation.kha: U Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai  ha ka duwan ba u la tei ha khmat ka Templ ,

translation.en: And Zadok the priest , and his brethren the priests , before the tabernacle of the  Lord  in the high place that was at Gibeon ,
translation.kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u pat , ki peit ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  ha ka jaka mane kaba ha Gibeon .

translation.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you , and not to boast in another man s line of things made ready to our hand .
translation.kha: Te ngi lah ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiwei pat ki ri jngai na phi bad yn ym donkam ban leh sarong shaphang ka jingtrei ïa kaba la lah leh lypa ha ka lyngkha jong uwei pat u briew .

translation.en: Then Samuel took a vial of oil , and poured it upon his head , and kissed him , and said , Is it not because the  Lord  hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u shim shi klong ka umphniang Olib bad u theh ïa ka ha ka khlieh u Saul , u doh ïa u , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa me kum u nongsynshar ki briew jong u , ki Israel . Men synshar ïa ki briew jong u bad men ïada ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki . Bad kane kan long ka jingpynshisha ïa me ba U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa me ban long u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u :

translation.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers , to give them a land flowing with milk and honey , as it is this day . Then answered I , and said , So be it , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ba ngan ai ha ki ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba ki don mynta .  Nga la ong ,  Ho-oid , ko  Trai .

translation.en: For the people were numbered , and , behold , there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead there .
translation.kha: ha ka jingkhot kyrteng ïa ki shipai ym shym la don uwei ruh na Jabesh uba jubab .

translation.en: Cease not to give thanks for you , making mention of you in my prayers ;
translation.kha: ngam shym la sangeh ban ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate , and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full , when I shall smite all them that dwell therein , then shall they know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda nga la pynlong kynjah ïa ka Ijipt bad pynjot noh ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka , kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

translation.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me : and many such things are with him .
translation.kha: Un pyndep ïa kata kaba u la thmu na ka bynta jong nga ; kata ka jingthmu ka long tang kawei na kiba bun kiba u don ;

translation.en: And commanded Judah to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers , and to do the law and the commandment .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki paid ka Judah ban leh ïa ka mon jong U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai bad hukum jong u .

translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and said ,  Take this , and divide it among yourselves :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ha U Blei , bad u la ong ,  Shim ïa kane bad sam ïa ka hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: And all that Samuel the seer , and Saul the son of Kish , and Abner the son of Ner , and Joab the son of Zeruiah , had dedicated  ; and whosoever had dedicated any thing , it was under the hand of Shelomith , and of his brethren .
translation.kha: U Shelomith bad ka longïing jong u , ki dei peit ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba la pynkyntang ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ , kynthup ruh ïa ki jingai sngewbha kiba la wanlam da u Samuel , u nongïathuhlypa , da u syiem Saul , da u Abner u khun jong u Ner , bad da u Joab u khun jong ka Seruïah .

translation.en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you , as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor , and as the fulness of the winepress .
translation.kha: Yn ñiew ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang ba ka ïaryngkat dor bad ka jingainguh ba u nongrep u wanrah da u kew thymmai bad ka waiñ thymmai .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A plumbline . Then said the Lord , Behold , I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel : I will not again pass by them any more :
translation.kha: U la kylli ïa nga ,  Amos , me ïohi aïu ?   U Sawar ,  nga la jubab . Nangta u ong ,  Nga pyndonkam ïa u ban pyn-i ba ki briew jong nga ki long kum ka kynroh ka bym biang sawar . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: I thank God , whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience , that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei , ïa uba nga shakri da ka jingïatiplem bakhuid , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la leh . Nga ainguh ïa u haba nga kynmaw ïa me borabor ha ki jingduwai jong nga mynmiet bad mynsngi .

translation.en: Bless them which persecute you : bless , and curse not .
translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Blei ban kyrkhu ïa kito kiba pynshitom ïa phi — ho-oid , to kyrpad ïa u ban kyrkhu , ym ban tim .

translation.en: For I am in a strait betwixt two , having a desire to depart , and to be with Christ ; which is far better :
translation.kha: Ïa nga la tan ha ki ar bynta . Nga da kwah eh ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim bad ban don bad U Khrist , kaba long kaei kaei kaba kham bha ;

translation.en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel .
translation.kha: U Dabid u khun jong u Jesse u synshar sawphew snem halor ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: On the eighth day he sent the people away : and they blessed the king , and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the  Lord  had done for David his servant , and for Israel his people .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra u Solomon u phah noh sha ïing ïa u paidlang . Baroh ki la ïaroh ïa u bad ki leit suk sha ïing namar ki jingkyrkhu baroh ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong u bad ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when God caused me to wander from my father s house , that I said unto her , This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me  ; at every place whither we shall come , say of me , He is my brother .
translation.kha: Kumta haba U Blei u la phah noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga sha ki ri nongwei , nga ong ha ka , ‘ Pha lah ban pyn-i haduh katno pha shaniah ïa nga da kaba ïathuh ïa iwei pa iwei ba nga long u hynmen jong pha .’

translation.en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the  Lord  : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward , by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u duwai ha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien ha ki mawkyrdon ba la buh da u Syiem Ahas .

translation.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination : how much more , when he bringeth it with a wicked mind ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ijli ïa kata , haba ki briew ba-bymman ki ai ki jingkñia ha u , khamtam lada ki leh ïa kata na ki jingthmu bymman .

translation.en: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ , happy are ye  ; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you : on their part he is evil spoken of , but on your part he is glorified .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba phi shah krenbeiñ namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong U Khrist ; kane ka mut ba U Mynsiem ka burom , U Mynsiem jong U Blei , u don ha phi .

translation.en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people , the priests , and the Levites , unto Ezra the scribe , even to understand the words of the law .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki rangbah kur , ryngkat bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , ki leit sha u Esra ban pule bniah ïa ka jinghikai jong ka Hukum .

translation.en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways , nor done after their abominations : but , as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways .
translation.kha: Hato pha la ïoh jinghun ban bud ïa ki dien jat jong ki bad pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki ? Em , tang hapoh khyndiat por pha la leh kham sniew palat ban ïa kaba ki long ha kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh .

translation.en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded : and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Ki la ïaleit kiew ïa u Lum Hor haba ïohi uta u paidlang baroh ,

translation.en: When thou shalt beget children , and children s children , and ye shall have remained long in the land , and shall corrupt yourselves , and make a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , and shall do evil in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , to provoke him to anger :
translation.kha: Haba phi la shong slem ha kata ka ri bad phi la ïoh khun ïoh ksiew , wat leh pop da kaba thaw blei ïa lade da kano kano ka dur . Kata ka long ka kam bymman ha khmat U  Trai  , bad kan pynbitar ïa u .

translation.en: Woe to thee that spoilest , and thou wast not spoiled  ; and dealest treacherously , and they dealt not treacherously with thee ! when thou shalt cease to spoil , thou shalt be spoiled  ; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously , they shall deal treacherously with thee .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la shahjop ! Ki la lute bad shetkylla , wat la ym shym don kiba la lute ne shetkylla ïa ki . Hynrei ka por ban lute bad shetkylla kan kut , bad ma ki hi kin sa long kiba shah lute bad kiba shah shetkylla .

translation.en: And Samson called unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , remember me , I pray thee , and strengthen me , I pray thee , only this once , O God , that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes .
translation.kha: Te u Samson u duwai ,  A  Trai  Bakhraw , to kynmaw ïa nga , ai ha nga ïa ka bor sa tang shisien , khnang ba tang da kane ngan lah ban pynhiarkput ïa ki Philistia namar ba ki la khlaw ïa ki khmat jong nga baroh ar .

translation.en: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance , which the  Lord  your God giveth you .
translation.kha: namar phim pat rung ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , ha kaba phin ïoh shongsuk shongsaiñ .

translation.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria , saying , If the  Lord  shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem , then I will serve the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang sah ha Geshur kaba ha Syria , nga la kular ïa U  Trai  ba lada un ïalam biang ïa nga sha Jerusalem , ngan mane ïa u ha Hebron .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring a nation against thee from far , from the end of the earth , as swift as the eagle flieth  ; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  un phah ïa ka jaitbynriew na kaba kut ka pyrthei pyrshah ïa phi , ka jaitbynriew kaba ka ktien ka thylliej jong ka phin ym sngewthuh . Kin wan hiar kynsan ha phi kumba suh u pukni .

translation.en: And the chief of all the people , even of all the tribes of Israel , presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God , four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel baroh ki ïadon ryngkat ha kata ka jingïalang jong ki briew U Blei , bad ki ïadon saw lakh ngut ki shipai hangta .

translation.en: By telling her lies , he got her to disobey God .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka ban saitlah ïa U Blei da ki ktien lamler jong u .

translation.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the  Lord  thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee , and to prove thee , to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no .
translation.kha: Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïalam ïa phi baroh shi lynter lynti lyngba ka ri shyiap ha kine ki sawphew snem kiba la dep ba un pyndem ïa phi , u da tynjuh ïa phi ba un ïoh tip aïu phi thmu ban leh , bad la phin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: Now we have received , not the spirit of the world , but the spirit which is of God ; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God .
translation.kha: Ngim shym ïohpdiang ïa u mynsiem jong kane ka pyrthei , pynban , ngi lah ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la phah da U Blei , khnang ba ngin lah ban tip ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la ai ha ngi .

translation.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate : for wide is the gate , and broad is the way , that leadeth to destruction , and many there be which go in thereat :
translation.kha: Rung shapoh lyngba ka khyrdop kaba khim , namar ka khyrdop sha ka dujok ka long kaba kylluid bad ka lynti kaba ïalam sha ka , ka long kaba suk , bad don shibun kiba ïaid na ka .

translation.en: And the Philistine said unto David , Am I a dog , that thou comest to me with staves ? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods .
translation.kha: U ong ïa u Dabid ,  Men leh aïu da uto u diengduh ? Me tharai nga dei u ksew ?  Bad u pyrta da ki jingtim ki blei jong u halor u Dabid .

translation.en: And Joshua rose early in the morning  ; and they removed from Shittim , and came to Jordan , he and all the children of Israel , and lodged there before they passed over .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Joshua bad ki paid Israel baroh ki khie dang step phyrngab , bad ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia , bad ki la leit sha Jordan , ha kaba ki la sher dara katba ki dang ap ban jam ïa ka .

translation.en: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king s meat , and of the wine which he drank : so nourishing them three years , that at the end thereof they might stand before the king .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ai ruh ki hukum ba man la ka sngi la dei ban ai ïa ki da kajuh ka jingbam bad ka waiñ kum ïa ki dkhot jong ka ïingbishar syiem . Hadien lai snem jong kane ka jingai jinghikai ki dei ban wan mih ha khmat u syiem .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam , and all that he did , and his might , how he warred , and how he recovered Damascus , and Hamath , which belonged to Judah , for Israel , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jeroboam Uba Ar u la leh , ki thma bashlur jong u , bad kumno u pynïoh pat ïa ka Damaskos bad ka Hamath sha ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently , that nothing be wanting unto them .
translation.kha: To leh kaba bha tam ban ïarap ïa u Senas u riewsaid bad ïa u Apollos ba kin sdang ïa ki jingleit jong ki , bad khmih ba kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki donkam .

translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not kill  ; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ka por mynbarim , ‘ Wat pynïap briew ; ïa uno uno uba leh kumta yn wallam sha ka jingbishar .’

translation.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry  ; her clothing is silk and purple .
translation.kha: Ka thain ïa ki jaiñ siang thiah bad ka phong da ki jaiñ linen bani bad basawbthuh .

translation.en: And there came out a fire from the  Lord  , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding kaba meh , bad ka bam duh khoit ïa kita ki arspah sanphew ngut ki briew kiba la wanrah ïa ki jingiwbih .

translation.en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee : for he would not walk in Jewry , because the Jews sought to kill him .
