translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la nang ïaid ha ka Galilaïa ; um shym kwah ban leit sha Judia , namar ba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw hangta ki la ïakwah ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard , and hold fast , and repent . If therefore thou shalt not watch , I will come on thee as a thief , and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee .
translation.kha: Kynmaw te , ïa kaei kaba la hikai ïa pha bad ïa kaei kaba pha la ïohsngew ; kohnguh ïa kata bad phai noh na ki pop jong pha . Lada pham kyndit bynriew noh , ngan wan ha pha kum u nongtuh , bad phan ym lah wat ban tip ïa ka por lano ngan wan .

translation.en: Then let me sow , and let another eat  ; yea , let my offspring be rooted out .
translation.kha: te ai ba yn pynjot ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong nga , lane to ai ba kiwei kin bam ïa ka jingbam ba nga pynmih .

translation.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,
translation.kha: Uta u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh u la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit lem bad me .  Hynrei U Jisu u la phah noh ïa u , u da ong ,

translation.en: All the king s servants , and the people of the king s provinces , do know , that whosoever , whether man or woman , shall come unto the king into the inner court , who is not called , there is one law of his to put him to death , except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre , that he may live : but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days .
translation.kha: Lada mano mano , u briew ne ka briew , u ban leit sha ka jaka ba kham shapoh ka phyllaw u syiem bad leit ïakynduh ïa u khlem shah khot , un ïap . Kata ka dei ka aiñ ; naduh ki nongai jingmut u syiem haduh ki riewpaidbah jong ki jylla , ki tip ïa kata . Ka don tang kawei ka lynti ban lait na kane ka aiñ : lada u syiem u pyn-i ïa u diengsynshar ksiar ïano ïano , tang kata ka ban pyllait im ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka la long mynta shi bnai ba u syiem u la phah khot ïa nga .

translation.en: And every daughter , that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel , shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father , that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers .
translation.kha: Man ka kynthei kaba ïohpateng ïa ka bri ka khyndew ha kano kano ka jait Israel ka dei ban ïashongkurim bad u briew uba na kata ka jait . Ha kane ka rukom ki Israel baroh kin ïohpateng ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kpa tymmen jong u ,

translation.en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices , which they offer in the open field , even that they may bring them unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest , and offer them for peace offerings unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingmut jong kane ka hukum ka long ba naduh mynta ki Israel ki dei ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ki mrad ba ki ju pynïap ha lum ha wah . Mynta ki dei ban wallam ïa ki ha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ bad pynïap ïa ki kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings , and the wheels beside them  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
translation.kha: Ki jingthaw ba-im ki la sdang ban her bad ki shalyntem ki la leit lem bad ki . Ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel ka don halor jong ki .

translation.en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early , and gone forth , behold , an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots . And his servant said unto him , Alas , my master ! how shall we do ?
translation.kha: Kum lashai dang step phyrngab , u shakri jong u Elisha u khie , u mih shabar ïing , bad u ïohi ba ki shipai Syria lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ki ba ki la kerkut ïa kata ka shnong . U leit phai sha u Elisha bad u pyrta ,  Ko kynrad , ngi la ïap ! Ngin leh kumno ?

translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me , because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor  ; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted , to preach deliverance to the captives , and recovering of sight to the blind , to set at liberty them that are bruised ,
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Trai u long ha nga , namar ba u la jied ïa nga ban wallam ka khubor babha ha kiba duk . U la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ka jingpyllaitluid ïa ki koidi bad ka jingpynïoh ïa ka jingimat ha kiba matlah ; ban pyllait ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ

translation.en: And David said unto God , Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered ? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed  ; but as for these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , O  Lord  my God , be on me , and on my father s house  ; but not on thy people , that they should be plagued .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la duwai ,  A Blei , nga long ma nga uta uba la leh bakla . Nga dei uta uba la hukum ban kheiñ briew . Kine ki paidbah bapli ki la leh aïu ? A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , pynshitom ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga , bad pyllait ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites , and the houses of the cities of their possession , may the Levites redeem at any time .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , kiba na ka jait Lebi ki don ka hok ban thied pat ha kano kano ka por ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki , kiba don ha ki shnong ba la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that on one of those days , as he taught the people in the temple , and preached the gospel , the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders ,
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u don ha ka Templ , u da hikai ïa ki briew bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ; ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum , lem bad ki tymmen ki san , ki la wan bad ong ha u ,

translation.en: I am the  Lord  , and there is none else , there is no God beside me : I girded thee , though thou hast not known me :
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  ; ym don uwei pat U Blei , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkhlaiñ ba me donkam , wat la mem shym la ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: Nor height , nor depth , nor any other creature , shall be able to separate us from the love of God , which is in Christ Jesus our Lord .
translation.kha: lymne ka pyrthei shalor lymne ka pyrthei sha tbian — ym don kano kano ha ki jingthaw baroh ki ban lah lano lano ruh ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit U Blei kaba ha ngi lyngba U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves .
translation.kha: Ki bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long tang kawei shi sut jingtap , bad ki leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .

translation.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh , bad u kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ,

translation.en: ( Genesis 1 :31 ) If they had obeyed God , they would have produced perfect children , and the earth would have become a global paradise , where people would live forever in peace and happiness .
translation.kha: ( Jenesis 1 :31 ) Lada kila kohnguh ia U Blei , kin jin da la kha ia ki khun ki bajanai , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan jin da la long ka paradais , ha kaba ki briew kin ioh im haka jingkmen bad jingsuk junom .

translation.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter phin ïabam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew phin pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign .
translation.kha: U Joash u la long u syiem ka Judah haba u la don hynñiew snem ka rta .

translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , Because ye speak this word , behold , I will make my words in thy mouth fire , and this people wood , and it shall devour them .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ba ki nongïathuhlypa kim long ei ei hynrei ki pla dap lyer bad ba kim don ka khubor na U  Trai . U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , namar ba kine ki briew ki la kren ïa kum kine kiei kiei , ngan pynlong ïa ki ktien jong nga kum ka ding ha ka shyntur jong me . Ki briew kin long kum ka dieng , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki .

translation.en: But and if she depart , let her remain unmarried , or be reconciled to her husband : and let not the husband put away his wife .
translation.kha: hynrei lada ka leh kumta , ka dei ban shong khynraw noh lane ka dei ban ïasuk pat bad la u tnga bad u tnga um dei ban pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga .

translation.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead : otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth .
translation.kha: naba ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh kam don jingmut ei ei katba u briew uba ai ïa ka u dang im ; ka treikam tang hadien ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert  ; as it is written , He gave them bread from heaven to eat .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la bam ïa ka mana ha ri shyiap , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U la ai ha ki ïa u kpu na bneng ba kin bam .’

translation.en: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner , and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him .
translation.kha: Namar kam i shongnia ha nga ban phah ïa u koidi khlem da kdew shai ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , but in his own country , and among his own kin , and in his own house .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang ha la ka shnong bad da ki ba-ha-ïing bad ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate , as thou art in the way , give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him  ; lest he hale thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and the officer cast thee into prison .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u wallam ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa phi bad rah ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia bad u ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Lada phim leh kumta , un tan ïa phi ha khmat u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi ha ki nongap phira , bad ïa phi yn buh ha ka byndi .

translation.en: As the waters fail from the sea , and the flood decayeth and drieth up :
translation.kha: Kum ki wah kiba la sangeh noh ban tuid , bad ki pung-um kiba la rngad noh ,

translation.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt , he , and his father s house : and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years .
translation.kha: U Joseph u shong u sah ha ka ri Ijipt bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u kpa jong u ; u la ïap noh haba u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka rta .

translation.en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude  ; and that thou go to battle in thine own person .
translation.kha: Ka jingai jingmut jong nga ka long ba phin lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat , ki ban bun kat u shyiap ka rud duriaw , bad ba ma phi da lade hi phin ïalam ïa ki ha ka thma .

translation.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection .
translation.kha: Ki kynthei ki dei ban nang ban sngap jar bad da ka jingsngewrit baroh .

translation.en: So Joab blew a trumpet , and all the people stood still , and pursued after Israel no more , neither fought they any more .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joab u put ïa ka turoi , kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban sangeh noh na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel , bad kumta ka jingïaleh ka la sangeh .

translation.en: But Barnabas took him , and brought him to the apostles , and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way , and that he had spoken to him , and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus .
translation.kha: Nangta u Barnabas u la ïarap ïa u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ki apostol . U la batai ha ki kumno u Saul u la ïohi ïa U Trai ha ka lynti bad ba U Trai u la lah kren bad u Saul . U la ïathuh ruh kumno u Saul u la ïalap da ka jingshlur ha Damaskos ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .

translation.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters : who maketh the clouds his chariot : who walketh upon the wings of the wind :
translation.kha: bad tei ïa ka ïing jong me halor ki um hajrong . Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyoh kum ki kali ïapom bad me shong halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .

translation.en: Then Paul stood up , and beckoning with his hand said , Men of Israel , and ye that fear God , give audience .
translation.kha: U Paul u la ïeng joit , u la ai dak da la ka kti , bad u la sdang ban kren :  Ko ki para Israel bad ko ki Jentil baroh hangne kiba mane ïa U Blei : To shahshkor ïa nga !

translation.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it somewhat lighter for us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Kane ka dei kaei ba phin ong ha ki : ‘ Ka  tiduh jong nga ka kham rben ban ïa ka syngkai i pa jong nga .’

translation.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying , he was the more afraid  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la kham sheptieng shuh shuh .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I am Pharaoh , and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ruh ha u ,  Nga long u syiem — bad yn ym don uwei ruh ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei u ban leh ei ei khlem ka jingai jingbit jong me .

translation.en: O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , that dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth : thou hast made heaven and earth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , uba shong ha ka khet shajrong ki kherub , me marwei me long U Blei , uba synshar ïa baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei . Me thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng .

translation.en: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high  ; and thou shalt come down very low .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi kin nang kham ïohbor katba ma phi pat phin nang duh ïa la ka bor .

translation.en: I beseech you , brethren , (ye know the house of Stephanas , that it is the firstfruits of Achaia , and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints ,)
translation.kha: Phi tip shaphang u Stephanas bad ka longïing jong u ; ki long ki Khristan kiba nyngkong eh ha Akhaïa bad ki la aiti ïa lade ïa ka ban shakri ïa ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Uriah said unto David , The ark , and Israel , and Judah , abide in tents  ; and my lord Joab , and the servants of my lord , are encamped in the open fields  ; shall I then go into mine house , to eat and to drink , and to lie with my wife ? as thou livest , and as thy soul liveth , I will not do this thing .
translation.kha: U Uriah u jubab ,  Ki rangbah Israel bad Judah ki don jngai ha ka thma , bad ka Synduk ka Jutang ka don bad ki ; u Joab u rangbah nongai hukum ïa nga bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ki ïasah ha madan . Kumno nga lah ban shu leit sha ïing , ban bam ban dih , bad ban thiah bad la ka tnga ? Ka long kaba kyntang ïa nga , nga smai ba ngan ym leh ïa kaba kum kata ka kam !

translation.en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements : once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations : it is most holy unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Shisien shisnem , u Aaron un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da kaba buh ha ki reng jong ka baroh saw tylli ïa ka snam jong ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Dei ban leh ïa kane man ka snem ha ki por baroh ki ban wan . Kane ka duwan ka dei ban long kaba khuid , kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross : all they are brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace  ; they are even the dross of silver .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel kim long jingmyntoi ei ei ïa nga . Ki long kum ka mar bymmyntoi shuh — ka tama , ka tin , ka nar , bad ka sisa — kiba la pynsah hadien ba la saiñ ïa ka rupa ha ka ding .

translation.en: O Ephraim , what shall I do unto thee ? O Judah , what shall I do unto thee ? for your goodness is as a morning cloud , and as the early dew it goeth away .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Israel bad Judah , Kaei kaba ngan leh ïa phi ? Ka jingieit jong phi ïa nga ka jah noh shen kum u slap mynstep ; ka long kum ka umjer , kaba jah noh shen ha ka sngi .

translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not : noses have they , but they smell not :
translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah ban ïohsngew ; bad ki khmut , hynrei kim lah ban iw .

translation.en: And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Oh , this people have sinned a great sin , and have made them gods of gold .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u leit phai sha U  Trai  , bad u ong ,  Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Ki la thaw ïa u blei uba da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamane ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u , u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit noh ban hikai bad ïalap ha ki shnong kiba hajan hangta .

translation.en: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another : the breadth was five and twenty cubits , door against door .
translation.kha: Nangta u la thew sa ïa ka jingjngai ka kynroh kaba nadien kawei ka kamra shaduh ka kynroh kaba shadien jong kawei pat ka kamra lyngba ka lynti ïaid na ka , bad ka long khat-ar mitar shiteng .

translation.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption , and this mortal must put on immortality .
translation.kha: Na kane u ba lalot rahah hab ban buh ha ka jing bymlalot , bad kaei kaba dei ban ïap ka dei ban kylla sha kaei ka bym dei ban ïap shuh .

translation.en: And he said ,  That which cometh out of the man , that defileth the man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ka long kaei kaba mih na u briew kaba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: They proclaimed a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people .
translation.kha: Ki pynbna ïa ka sngi shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah , bad ai ha u Naboth ka jaka shong badonburom .

translation.en: Stop tickling me !
translation.kha: Sangeh pynsmieij ianga .

translation.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch , and the dust thereof into brimstone , and the land thereof shall become burning pitch .
translation.kha: Ki wah ka Edom kin kylla um bsiang , bad ka khyndew kan kylla kyndok . Ka ri baroh kawei kan ing kum ka bsiang .

translation.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place , and spread not in the skin , but it be somewhat dark  ; it is a rising of the burning , and the priest shall pronounce him clean : for it is an inflammation of the burning .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka dak ka sah kumjuh , bad kam shym pur satia , hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , kata kam dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid , namar ka dei tang ka sohkhliang na kata ka dak ing ding .

translation.en: But as for you , turn you , and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi te , phi dei ban leit phai biang sha ka ri shyiap sha ka phang jong ka Duriaw Basaw .’

translation.en: And ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .
translation.kha: U nongsynshar jong ki un wan na ka jaitbynriew jong ki hi , u khun syiem jong ki napdeng ki briew jong ki hi . Un wan sha nga haba nga khot sngewbha ïa u , namar uei uba nud ban wan khlem shah khot sngewbha ? Kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
translation.kha: Pynkyntang mynta ïa ki Lebi kum ki jong nga ha ka jaka ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong baroh napdeng ki paid Israel , bad pynkyntang ruh ïa ki jingri jong ki Lebi ha ka jaka kito kiba la kha nyngkong na ki jingri jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And I will bless them that bless thee , and curse him that curseth thee : and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba kyrkhu ïa me , Hynrei ngan tim ïa kito kiba tim ïa me . Bad da me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: Masters , give unto your servants that which is just and equal ; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven .
translation.kha: Ko ki kynrad , to long kiba beit bad kiba hok ha ka rukom kaba phi leh ïa ki mraw jong phi . Kynmaw ba ma phi ruh phi don U Kynrad ha bneng .

translation.en: The king of Tirzah , one : all the kings thirty and one .
translation.kha: bad Tirsah — baroh ki long laiphew wei ngut ki syiem .

translation.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done , he glorified God , saying , Certainly this was a righteous man .
translation.kha: U rangbah shipai u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong ,  Da shisha u la long u briew uba bha !

translation.en: And when they found them not , they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city , crying , These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei haba kim shym lap ïa ki , ki la paring ïa u Jason bad ïa ki katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki parabangeit ha khmat ki bor synshar jong ka nongbah bad ki la pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki la thaw jingkulmar kylleng kylleng ! Mynta ki la wan sha ka nongbah jong ngi , bad u Jason u la pynsah ïa ki ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And , lo , he hath given occasions of speech against her , saying , I found not thy daughter a maid  ; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter s virginity . And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city .
translation.kha: U la kynnoh pynban ïa ka da kaba ong ba kam long shuh kaba sotti haba u shongkurim ïa ka . Hynrei kine ki long ki dak jong ka jinglong sotti ka khun jong nga ; khmih ïa ki jingbitsnam ha ka jingsiangthiah shongkurim !’

translation.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest .
translation.kha: Nga la bitar bad pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang : ‘ Phin ym ïohrung da lei lei ha ka ri sha ka jaka ha kaba ngan ai ka jingjahthait ïa phi .’

translation.en: Behold , to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now .
translation.kha: Lashai hamar kane ka por , ngan pynhap da u phria uba jur , uba kat uta ka ri Ijipt kam pat ju tip mynno mynno ha ka histori jong ka .

translation.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter .
translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba kine kiei kiei kin ym jia ha ka por tlang !

translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest , neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest : thou shalt leave them unto the poor , and to the stranger : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba ha tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit kylla dien ban khar ïa ki sohkew kiba sah ; ieh ïa ki na ka bynta kiba duk bad ki nongwei ; Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Then he sent out a second on horseback , which came to them , and said , Thus saith the king , Is it peace ? And Jehu answered , What hast thou to do with peace ? turn thee behind me .
translation.kha: Nangta la phah sa uwei u nonglamktien uba kylli ha u Jehu ïa kajuh ka jingkylli . U Jehu u la jubab biang ,  Kata kam dei ka kam jong me ! Bud nadien jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee , saying , Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth : for the right of redemption is thine to buy it .
translation.kha: ba u Hanamel , u khun jong u kñi jong nga , u Shallum , un wan sha nga bad ka jingkyrpad ban thied ïa ka lyngkha jong u ha Anathoth ha ka thain Benjamin , namar nga long u ba-ha-ïing bajan tam bad ba nga don ka hok ban thied ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: And they said , What need we any further witness ? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth .
translation.kha: Bad ki la ong ,  Ngim da donkam ïa kino kino ki sakhi ! Ma ngi hi ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u la ong !

translation.en: The burden of the valley of vision . What aileth thee now , that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Them ka Jingïohipaw . Kaei kaba jia ? Balei ki briew baroh jong ka nongbah ki rakhe lehkmen halor ki tnum ïing ?

translation.en: And the people said unto Joshua , The  Lord  our God will we serve , and his voice will we obey .
translation.kha: Nangta u paidbah u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ngin shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Ngin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: And Nabal answered David s servants , and said , Who is David ? and who is the son of Jesse ? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ap hangta , bad u Nabal ha kaba khatduh u la jubab ,  U Dabid ? Uei uta ? Ngam pat ju ïohsngew ïa u ! Ha kine ki sngi ka ri ka dap da ki mraw kiba phet na la ki kynrad !

translation.en: Saying , I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood . And they said , What is that to us ? see thou to that .
translation.kha: Nga la leh pop da kaba nga shetkylla ïa u briew uba lui lui ban ïap !  u la ong .  Kan ïadei aïu kata bad ngi ?  ki la jubab .  Kata ka dei ka kam jong me !

translation.en: And they shall dwell safely therein , and shall build houses , and plant vineyards  ; yea , they shall dwell with confidence , when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Kin im hangta ha ka jingshongshngain . Kin tei ïa ki ïing bad kin pynlong ïa ki bri sohwaiñ . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki paramarjan jong ki baroh kiba la ñiew ïa ki da ka jingibeiñ , bad ki Israel kin shong skhem . Te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And as he said these things unto them , the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently , and to provoke him to speak of many things :
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki la sdang ban wohnia shikatdei eh ïa u bad kylli ïa u ki jingkylli shaphang bun kiei kiei ,

translation.en: Then cometh he to Simon Peter : and Peter saith unto him , Lord , dost thou wash my feet ?
translation.kha: U la wan ha u Simon Petros , uba la ong ha u ,  Hato men sait ïa ki kjat jong nga , ko Trai ?

translation.en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem , and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof , if ye can find a man , if there be any that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth  ; and I will pardon it .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to phet lyngba ki surok bah jong phi ! To khmih sawdong ! Peit hi da lade ! To wad ïa ki jaka ïew ! Hato phi lah ban shem uwei u briew uba leh ïa kaba dei bad uba pyrshang ban ïaineh ha U Blei ? Lada phi lah , U  Trai  un map ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Arise , go thy way : thy faith hath made thee whole .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To khie joit bad leit ; ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .

translation.en: Shall I bring to the birth , and not cause to bring forth ? saith the  Lord  : shall I cause to bring forth , and shut the womb ? saith thy God .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba ngan wallam ïa ki briew jong nga sha ka jingsuh kha bad khlem lah ban kha ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary , the babe leaped in her womb  ; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Haba ka Elisabeth ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhublei jong ka Mari , i khunlung i la khih hapoh jong ka . La pyndap ïa ka Elisabeth da U Mynsiem Bakhuid

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , If ye have faith , and doubt not , ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree , but also if ye shall say unto this mountain , Be thou removed , and be thou cast into the sea  ; it shall be done .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lada phi ngeit bad phim sngew artatien , phin lah ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa une u dieng Dumbur . Bad ym tang kane , hynrei phin lah wat ban ong ha une u lum , ‘ Khie joit bad pynnoh ïa lade sha duriaw ,’ bad un leh kumta .

translation.en: From Aroer , that is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon  ;
translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them bad kaba kynthup ïa ka jaka padun baroh na Medeba shaduh Dibon .

translation.en: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to pluck up , and to pull down , and to destroy it  ;
translation.kha: Lada ha kano kano ka por nga ong ba ngan rat , ngan pynkheiñ , lane pynjot ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,

translation.en: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils  ; for the boil was upon the magicians , and upon all the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ki nongleh myntor kim lah ïeng shuh ha khmat u Moses namar ki la ïa-ïoh tohjaw lut kumba long lem kiwei pat ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples , if ye have love one to another .
translation.kha: Lada phi don ka jingieit iwei ïa iwei , te baroh kin tip ba phi long ki synran jong nga . Kumba nga la ieit ïa phi , kumta phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei .

translation.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee , and our sins testify against us : for our transgressions are with us  ; and as for our iniquities , we know them  ;
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ki kam runar jong ngi pyrshah ïa me ki long kiba bun . Ki pop jong ngi hi ki pynrem ïa ngi . Ngi tip bha ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: And to the others he said in mine hearing , Go ye after him through the city , and smite : let not your eye spare , neither have ye pity :
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U Blei ba u ong ha kita kiwei pat ki briew ,  Bud ïa u sawdong ka nongbah , bad pynïap . Wat tyngkai ïano ïano , wat sngewsynei ïano ïano .

translation.en: But when he was strong , his heart was lifted up to his destruction : for he transgressed against the  Lord  his God , and went into the temple of the  Lord  to burn incense upon the altar of incense .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u syiem Ussaïah u la kylla long uba khlaiñbor , u la sngewmeng noh pynban , bad kata ka ïalam sha ka jingkhyllem noh jong u . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u da kaba u leit rung sha ka Templ ban thang jingiwbih ha ka duwan thang jingiwbih .

translation.en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men , such as fear God , men of truth , hating covetousness  ; and place such over them , to be rulers of thousands , and rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens :
translation.kha: Hynrei nalor kata , phi dei ban jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit , bad thung ïa ki kum ki nongïalam jong u paidbah : ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ïa ki spah , ïa ki sanphew , bad ïa ki phew . Ki dei ban long ki briew kiba sheptieng ïa U Blei , kiba lah ban shaniah , bad kiba ym lah ban pynbam sap .

translation.en: He thanked me with his eyes .
translation.kha: U khublei ianga da ki khmat jongu .

translation.en: Therefore I write these things being absent , lest being present I should use sharpness , according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification , and not to destruction .
translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba nga thoh ïa kane katba nga dang don jngai na phi ; ka long kumta ba haba nga poi ngan ym hap ban leh tyngeh ha kaba pyndonkam ïa ka iktiar ïa kaba U Trai u la ai ha nga — ka bor ïa ka ban tei ïa phi , ym ïa ka ban pynpra .

translation.en: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah , and all the remnant of Judah , that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall know whose words shall stand , mine , or theirs .
translation.kha: Hynrei khyndiat na phi phin lait na ka jingïap bad leit phai na Ijipt sha Judah . Nangta kiba lait im kin tip ki ktien jongno ki la wan jia shisha , ki jong nga ne ki jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud : and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua ki la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad U  Trai  u wanpaw ha ki hangta ha u rishot lyoh uba ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Conscience , I say , not thine own , but of the other : for why is my liberty judged of another man s conscience ?
translation.kha: kata ka long , ym ka jingïatiplem jong phi , hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong uta uwei pat u briew .  Kumta , te ,  don u ban kylli ,  balei ba ïa ka jinglaitluid jong nga ban leh ïa kaei kaei la buh pud da ka jingïatiplem jong uwei pat ?

translation.en: Which is come unto you , as it is in all the world ; and bringeth forth fruit , as it doth also in you , since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth :
translation.kha: Ka gospel ka ïai wallam ki jingkyrkhu bad ka par kylleng ka pyrthei , kumba ka la long hapdeng jong phi naduh kata ka sngi kaba phi la ïohsngew nyngkong shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei bad phi la tip ïa ka kumba ka long shisha .

translation.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell , that they may prepare a city for habitation  ;
translation.kha: U shah ïa ki briew kiba thngan ban shongduh hangta , bad tei ki nongbah ban shong ban sah ha ki .

translation.en: And when the king entered into the house of the  Lord  , the guard came and fetched them , and brought them again into the guard chamber .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba u syiem u leit sha ka Templ , ki nongap ki rah ïa ki stieh bad nangta ki pynphai ïa ki sha ki kamra ba buh ïa ki .

translation.en: And when he looked on him , he was afraid , and said , What is it , Lord ? And he said unto him , Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God .
translation.kha: U la khmih shaiñ ïa u angel ha ka jingsheptieng bad u la ong ,  Ka dei kaei , ko Kynrad ?  U angel u la jubab ,  U Blei u la sngewbha ïa ki jingduwai jong me bad ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me , bad u kloi ban jubab ïa me .

translation.en: And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Lord , wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people ? why is it that thou hast sent me ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u la phai biang sha U  Trai  bad u la ong ,  A  Trai  , balei me lehbeiñ sat ïa la ki briew ? Balei me phah ïa nga shane ?

translation.en: For I will not see you now by the way ; but I trust to tarry a while with you , if the Lord permit .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïohi ïa phi kham palat ban ïa kaba shu wan jngoh ha ka jingïaid lynti ; nga kyrmen ban pynlut shibun ka por bad phi , lada U Trai u shah .

translation.en: His breath goeth forth , he returneth to his earth  ; in that very day his thoughts perish .
translation.kha: Haba kin ïap , kin leit phai pat sha ka khyndew ; ha kata ka sngi baroh ki jingthmu jong ki kin sa kut noh .

translation.en: Then he went down into the king s house , into the scribe s chamber : and , lo , all the princes sat there , even Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .
translation.kha: Te u la leit sha ka ïingsyiem , sha ka kamra u sekretari ka ïingbishar , ha kaba baroh ki rangbah synshar ki dang don ha ka jingïalang . U Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Delaïah u khun jong u Shemaïah , u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor , u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Shaphan , u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Hananaïah , bad baroh kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ki la don hangta .

translation.en: And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them : they shall deride every strong hold  ; for they shall heap dust , and take it .
translation.kha: Ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ki syiem bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki rangbah synshar ba-halor . Ym don ka kut kaba lah ban pynsangeh ïa ki — ki kynton ïa ka khyndew pyrshah ïa ka bad ki knieh ïa ka .

translation.en: And the covering of rams  skins dyed red , and the covering of badgers  skins , and the veil of the covering ,
translation.kha: ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , bad ïa ka jingkah pyrda ;

translation.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s house , thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s wife , nor his manservant , nor his maidservant , nor his ox , nor his ass , nor any thing that is thy neighbour s .
translation.kha: Wat kwah rhah ïa ka ïing u paramarjan jong phi ; wat ikwah ïa ka tnga jong u , lane ïa ki mraw jong u , lane ïa ki masi jong u , lane ïa ki kada jong u , lane ïa kaei kaei ruh kaba dei ka jong u .

translation.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai jong ngi u la theh noh buk ïa ka jingaiei ba-dap kyrhai ha nga bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kiba long ki jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Now therefore hearken , O Israel , unto the statutes and unto the judgments , which I teach you , for to do them , that ye may live , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  God of your fathers giveth you .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba nga hikai ïa phi , te phin ïoh im bad phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u ai ha phi .

translation.en: ( For we are but of yesterday , and know nothing , because our days upon earth are a shadow : )
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong ngi ka long kaba lyngkot , ngim tip ei ei ; ngi iehnoh kum ka syrngiew ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade , and mine arm be broken from the bone .
translation.kha: te to ai ba yn kdiah ïa ki kti jong nga ; to ai ba yn sloit ïa ki na ki tyrpeng jong nga .

translation.en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink , that puttest thy bottle to him , and makest him drunken also , that thou mayest look on their nakedness !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ha ka jingbitar shla jong phi , phi la pynpoh bad pynjahburom ïa la ki paramarjan ; phi pynlong ïa ki ban ïaid sheng sheng kum kiba la buaid .

translation.en: Now God himself and our Father , and our Lord Jesus Christ , direct our way unto you .
translation.kha: To U Blei hi uba U Kpa jong ngi da lade hi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong ngi ban wan sha phi!

translation.en: They die in youth , and their life is among the unclean .
translation.kha: Ki ïap haba ki dang samla , ki ringswai da ka jingim bajahburom

translation.en: And Samuel said unto him , The  Lord  hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day , and hath given it to a neighbour of thine , that is better than thou .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u ,  U  Trai  u la kad ïa ka hima Israel na me ha kane ka sngi , bad u la ai ïa ka ha uta u briew uba kham bha ban ïa me .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ahab saw Elijah , that Ahab said unto him , Art thou he that troubleth Israel ?
translation.kha: Haba u Ahab u ïohi ïa u , u ong ,  Me la wan — u nongthaw jingkulmar basniew tam ha Israel !

translation.en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah , and made obeisance to the king . Then the king hearkened unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Jehoïada u la ïap , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah ki khroh ïa u syiem Joash ban shahshkor noh ïa ki .

translation.en: And Isaac called Jacob , and blessed him , and charged him , and said unto him , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan .
translation.kha: U Isaak u khot ïa u Jakob , u khublei ïa u , bad u ong ha u ,  Wat shongkurim ïa ka nong Kanaan .

translation.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God , then the kingdom of God is come unto you .
translation.kha: Em , ym dei u Beelsebul , hynrei U Mynsiem U Blei , uba ai ha nga ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid , kaba pynshisha ba ka Hima U Blei ka la da wan lypa ha phi .

translation.en: And the Philistines were afraid , for they said , God is come into the camp . And they said , Woe unto us ! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore .
translation.kha: ki la sheptieng , bad ki ong ,  U blei u la wan poi ha dara jong ki ! Ngi la shahjop ! Kum kane kam pat ju jia ha ngi mynno mynno !

translation.en: Take heed unto thyself , and unto the doctrine ; continue in them : for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself , and them that hear thee .
translation.kha: To phikir bha ïa lade bad ïa ki jinghikai kiba me ai . To men ïai leh ïa kine kiei kiei , namar lada me leh kumta , me pynim ïa lade bad ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa me .

translation.en: And likewise also the men , leaving the natural use of the woman , burned in their lust one toward another ; men with men working that which is unseemly , and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki shynrang , ki la iehnoh ïa ka jingshongkurim bad ki kynthei kat kum ba dei ka rukom bad ki la ïa ing da ka jingkwah brai para ma ki hi . Ki shynrang ki leh kiei kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki , bad ka jingmih ka long ba ki wallam halor lade hi ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ki don hok ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingleh bym dei jong ki .

translation.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren , and all his sisters , and all they that had been of his acquaintance before , and did eat bread with him in his house : and they bemoaned him , and comforted him over all the evil that the  Lord  had brought upon him : every man also gave him a piece of money , and every one an earring of gold .
translation.kha: Baroh ki hynmen ki para jong u Job , kynthei bad shynrang , bad ki paralok barim jong u , ki la wan jngoh ïa u bad ïabam sngewbha bad u ha ka ïing jong u . Ki la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong ki bad ki pyngtngen ïa u namar ki jingjynjar baroh ba U  Trai  u la wallam halor jong u . Uwei pa uwei na ki u la ai katto katne ka pisa bad ka sati ksiar .

translation.en: But they cried , saying , Crucify him , crucify him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la pyrta biang ,  Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !

translation.en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth , to burn incense unto the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , as we have done , we , and our fathers , our kings , and our princes , in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem : for then had we plenty of victuals , and were well , and saw no evil .
translation.kha: Ngin leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba ngi la ong ban leh . Ngin ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka blei jong ngi , ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , bad ngin theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ sha ka , kumba ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u syiem jong ngi bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki la ju leh ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem . Nangta ngi don ka bam kyrhai , ngi manbha , bad ngim ju don jingjynjar .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien , U Jisu u la wan na Nasareth kaba ha ka probins jong ka Galilaïa , bad la pynbaptis da u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And they journeyed from Beth–el  ; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath : and Rachel travailed , and she had hard labour .
translation.kha: U Jakob bad la ka longïing longsem ki la ïamihnoh na Bethel , bad haba ki la jan poi ha Ephrath , ka por ka la poi ba ka Rakhel kan kha khun , bad ka la don ha ka jingsuh kha kaba shitom .

translation.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law , through breaking the law dishonourest thou God ?
translation.kha: Phi sngewsarong ba phi don ka Hukum U Blei — hynrei hato phi wallam ka jinglehrain ïa U Blei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum jong u ?

translation.en: And David was the youngest : and the three eldest followed Saul .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dei u khun khatduh , bad katba ki lai ngut shi para kiba nyngkong ki sah bad u Saul ,

translation.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report .
translation.kha: Ka dei da ka jingngeit jong ki , ba ki briew ha ki por mynbarim ki ïohpdiang ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Blei .

translation.en: And the sixth angel sounded , and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God ,
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la put ïa la ka turoi . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba wan na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: I therefore , the prisoner of the Lord , beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called ,
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , te — nga uba long u nongsah byndi namar ba nga shakri ïa U Trai ; to im ka jingim kaba la thew kat kum ka rukom kaba U Blei u la buh haba u la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: And behold at eveningtide trouble  ; and before the morning he is not . This is the portion of them that spoil us , and the lot of them that rob us .
translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet ki pynlong ka jingpyntriem , hynrei kat ban da step ki la jah noh . Kata ka dei ka kupar jong uwei uwei uba lute ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: And when he returned , he found them asleep again , ( for their eyes were heavy , ) neither wist they what to answer him .
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ba ki ïohthiah ; kim shym la lah ban khyllie ïa la ki khmat . Bad kim shym la tip ïa kaei ban ong ïa u .

translation.en: Then one said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to speak with thee .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei na ki briew hangta u la ong ha u ,  Ha khmih , ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong me ki ïa-ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban ïakren bad me .

translation.en: Say unto them which daub it with untempered mortar , that it shall fall : there shall be an overflowing shower  ; and ye , O great hailstones , shall fall  ; and a stormy wind shall rend it .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka kynroh jong ki kan khyllem . Ngan phah ïa u slap bajur . U phria un hap halor jong ka , bad ka lyer bajur kan beh pyrshah ïa ka .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , naba u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies : one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah , unto the land of Shual :
translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki mih ban leit ïaleh ha ki lai kynhun na ka jaka sher dara jong ki : kawei ka kynhun ka leit shaphang Ophrah ha ka ri Shual ,

translation.en: They are not humbled even unto this day , neither have they feared , nor walked in my law , nor in my statutes , that I set before you and before your fathers .
translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi phim shym la pynrit ïa lade . Phim shym la pyndonburom ïa nga lane im kat kum ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee , in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land , and hast prepared thine heart to seek God .
translation.kha: Hynrei la katta ruh , ka dang don katto katne ka jingbha ha phi . Phi la weng baroh ki dur jong ka blei Asherah kaba ki briew ki mane , bad phi la pyrshang ban bud ïa ka mon U Blei .

translation.en: And she say to me , Both drink thou , and I will also draw for thy camels : let the same be the woman whom the  Lord  hath appointed out for my master s son .
translation.kha: Lada ka mynjur bad tyrwa ruh ban wanrah um ïa ki ut jong nga , to ai ba kata kan long kaba me la jied kum ka tnga ïa u khun jong u kynrad jong nga .’

translation.en: So the altar shall be four cubits  ; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns .
translation.kha: Kane ka bynta ba-halor , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia la thang , ka long ruh ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng ha ki saw tylli ki dong ki long kham jrong ban ïa kiwei ha ka bynta ba-halor .

translation.en: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men : for all men have not faith .
translation.kha: To duwai ruh ba U Blei un pyllait im ïa ngi na ki briew kiba bymman bad kiba sniew ; naba ym uwei pa uwei baroh u ngeit ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: My days are swifter than a weaver s shuttle , and are spent without hope .
translation.kha: Ki sngi ki ïaid khlem don jingkyrmen , ki ïaid kham stet ban ïa ka latai jong u nongthain jaiñ .

translation.en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed them , and brake , and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , u la ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kita , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran ban sam ha u paidbah .

translation.en: I have overthrown some of you , as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah , and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la pynjot katto katne na phi kumba nga la pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . Kito na phi kiba la lait im ki long kum ka dieng barhem ba la sei na ka ding . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga ,  ong U  Trai .

translation.en: And he arose from thence , and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan : and the people resort unto him again  ; and , as he was wont , he taught them again .
translation.kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , u la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judia , bad u la jam sha shiliang ka wah Jordan . Ki paidbah ki la ïalum biang ha u , bad u la hikai ïa ki , kumba u ju leh .

translation.en: And Samson said , With the jawbone of an ass , heaps upon heaps , with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men .
translation.kha: Te u Samson u rwai ,  Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , shihajar ngut nga pynïap ; Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , nga kynton ïa ki ha ki kynton .

translation.en: And he that was dead sat up , and began to speak . And he delivered him to his mother .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba la ïap u la khie shong bad u la sdang ban kren , bad U Jisu u la ai ïa u pat sha ha ka kmie jong u .

translation.en: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record , Uriah the priest , and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah .
translation.kha: Wanlam ar ngut ki rangbah ba lah ban shaniah , u Uriah u lyngdoh bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeberekhaïah , ban long kum ki sakhi .

translation.en: He shall call upon me , and I will answer him : I will be with him in trouble  ; I will deliver him , and honour him .
translation.kha: Haba ki khot ïa nga , ngan jubab ïa ki ; haba ki don ha ka jingjynjar , ngan long ryngkat bad ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad ngan pyndonburom ïa ki .

translation.en: But avoid foolish questions , and genealogies , and contentions , and strivings about the law ; for they are unprofitable and vain .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiar na ki jingkylli ba-bieit , na ka thup kyrteng ki kpa tymmen , na ki jingïania bad ki jingïaleh shaphang ka Hukum . Kine ki long ki bymmyntoi bad kiba sep-ei .

translation.en: We can benefit greatly from the experience of these brothers and if they are married , that of their wives .
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban ïoh shibun ki jingmyntoi na ki bad na ki lok jong ki ruh lada ki la shongkurim .

translation.en: I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy bed , and go thy way into thine house .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa me , to ïeng , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to leit noh sha ïing !

translation.en: Breach for breach , eye for eye , tooth for tooth : as he hath caused a blemish in a man , so shall it be done to him again .
translation.kha: Lada u pynkheiñ ïa ka shyieng , yn pynkheiñ kylliang ïa kawei na ki shyieng jong u ; lada u pynmatlah ïa u na kawei ka khmat , yn pynmatlah kylliang ïa kawei na ki khmat jong u ; lada u lop ïa kawei ka bniat , yn lop kylliang ïa kawei na ki bniat jong u . Kumba u la pynmynsaw ïa uno uno u briew , kumta ruh yn pynmynsaw kylliang ïa u .

translation.en: These things command and teach .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ki jingbthah bad ki jinghikai .

translation.en: For Isaiah had said , Let them take a lump of figs , and lay it for a plaster upon the boil , and he shall recover .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u ïathuh ha u syiem ban buh ka jingtah ba la shna da ki soh Dumbur ha u tohjaw jong u , bad un sa jem .

translation.en: Now when Jesus heard these things , he said unto him ,  Yet lackest thou one thing : sell all that thou hast , and distribute unto the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , follow me .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la ong ha u ,  Dang don sa kawei pat kaei kaei kaba me donkam ban leh . Die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta wan bad bud ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , these are the men that devise mischief , and give wicked counsel in this city :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , kine ki rangbah ki thaw ki jingthmu basniew bad ki ai ïa ka jingai jingmut bym long hapoh kane ka nongbah .

translation.en: Then the priest shall consider : and , behold , if the leprosy have covered all his flesh , he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : it is all turned white : he is clean .
translation.kha: u lyngdoh un khmih bniah biang ïa uta u briew . Lada u shem ba kata ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la sop shisha ïa ka met jong u baroh shi rynïeng , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long uba khuid . Lada ka sniehdoh jong u baroh ka la kylla lieh un long uba khuid .

translation.en: Hear this , O ye that swallow up the needy , even to make the poor of the land to fail ,
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi kiba ïuhroit ïa kiba kyrduh bad kiba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa kiba duk ha ka ri .

translation.en: And he cried , A lion : My lord , I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime , and I am set in my ward whole nights :
translation.kha: U nongap phira u pyrta ,  Ko kynrad , nga la ïeng ap phira ha ka kam jong nga mynsngi bad mynmiet .

translation.en: Take heed to yourselves : If thy brother trespass against thee , rebuke him  ; and if he repent , forgive him .
translation.kha: Kumta da husiar ïa kaei kaba phi leh !  Lada u hynmen u para jong phi u leh pop , to sneng tyngeh ïa u , bad lada u kylla-kaba-mut , to map ïa u .

translation.en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation  ; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins , and baldness upon every head  ; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi sha ki jingtep briew bad ngan pynkylla ïa ki jingrwai kmen jong phi sha ki jingïam sngewsih . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ba phin khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh bad phin phong ka jaiñ khain , bad phin long kum ki kmie ki kpa kiba ïambriew na ka bynta u khun ba tang marwei jong ki . Kata ka sngi kan long kaba kthang haduh kaba kut .

translation.en: And said unto me , Thou art my servant , O Israel , in whom I will be glorified .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga ,  Ko Israel , me long u shakri jong nga ; namar jong me , ki briew kin ïaroh ïa nga .

translation.en: But so shall it not be among you : but whosoever will be great among you , shall be your minister :
translation.kha: Kane pat , kam dei ka rukom kaba long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long uba khraw , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei ;

translation.en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen , and shall give the vineyard to others .  And when they heard it , they said , God forbid .
translation.kha: Un wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki rangbah , bad un ai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai .  Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la ong ,  Ym kumta keiñ !

translation.en: And Moses rose up , and his minister Joshua : and Moses went up into the mount of God .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua u nongïarap jong u ki la khreh , bad u Moses u la leit kiew sha uta u lum uba kyntang .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye into all the world , and preach the gospel to every creature .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa ki ,  Leit sha ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad ïalap ïa ka Gospel sha ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ , and for your liberal distribution unto them , and unto all men ;
translation.kha: Bad namar ka jingpynshisha ïa kaba kane ka jingshakri jong phi ka wallam , bun ki ban ai burom ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel U Khrist , ïa kaba phi ïaphla , bad ïa ka jinglehsbun jong phi ha kaba ïasam bynta lem bad ki bad uwei pa uwei ruh .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That there be some of them that stand here , which shall not taste of death , till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong shuh shuh ,  Nga ong ïa phi , ki don katto katne ngut hangne ki ban ym ïap haduh ba kin da ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei ba ka wan ha ka bor .

translation.en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the  Lord  , and did worse than all that were before him .
translation.kha: U Omri u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  kham palat ban ïa kino kino kiba ha shuwa jong u .

translation.en: But ye know the proof of him , that , as a son with the father , he hath served with me in the gospel .
translation.kha: Bad phi hi phi tip , kumno u la pynshisha ïa ka jingkordor jong u , kumno ma u bad ma nga , kum u khun bad u kpa jong u , ngi la ïatreilang na ka bynta ka gospel .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth : for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it  ; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga ,  Halor jong ka la thoh ïa ka jingtim kaba dei ban leit sha ka ri baroh kawei . Ha kawei ka liang jong ka kot kli ka ong ba ïa uwei pa uwei u nongtuh yn weng noh na ka ri ; bad ha kawei pat ka liang ka ong ba ïa uno uno uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai yn shim noh ïa u ruh .

translation.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the  Lord  , and to the king s palace , and harps and psalteries for singers : and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah .
translation.kha: U Solomon u pyndonkam ïa uta u dieng ha kaba shna ïa ki mawkyrdon ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u , bad ha kaba shna ïa ki duitara bad jingtem ksai na ka bynta ki nongput nongtem . Ym pat ju don kum kata ha kaba lah ban ïohi mynshuwa ha ka ri Judah . )

translation.en: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly . The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , shen un pynlwet ïa u Soitan hapoh ki kjat jong phi . To ka jingaiei jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi .

translation.en: And Absalom , whom we anointed over us , is dead in battle . Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back ?
translation.kha: Ngi la pynsleh ïa u Absalom kum u syiem jong ngi , hynrei u la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Kumta , balei ym don mano mano ba pyrshang ban wallam biang ïa u syiem Dabid ?

translation.en: And with them he sent Levites , even Shemaiah , and Nethaniah , and Zebadiah , and Asahel , and Shemiramoth , and Jonathan , and Adonijah , and Tobijah , and Tob–adonijah , Levites  ; and with them Elishama and Jehoram , priests .
translation.kha: La synran ïa ki da khyndai ngut ki Lebi bad ar ngut ki lyngdoh . Ki Lebi ki long u Shemaïah , u Nethanaïah , u Sebadaïah , u Asahel , u Shemiramoth , u Jehonathan , u Adonijah , u Tobijah bad u Tobadonijah ; bad ki lyngdoh ki long u Elishama bad u Jehoram .

translation.en: We all benefit from our spiritual food
translation.kha: Baroh ngi ïoh jingmyntoi na ki jingbam bakynja mynsiem

translation.en: And ye shall be left few in number , whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude  ; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Wat la phi bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , tang khyndiat eh na phi phin lait im , namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain  ; and ye say , that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen nong Samaria jong nga ki la ïamane ïa U Blei halor une u lum , hynrei phi ki Jiw phi ong ba ka Jerusalem ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngi dei ban mane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And as they went through the cities , they delivered them the decrees for to keep , that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit lyngba ïa ki shnong , ki la ai ha ki parabangeit ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ba ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ha Jerusalem ki la rai , bad ki la bthah ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: Take ye heed , watch and pray : for ye know not when the time is .
translation.kha: Sumar bha bad peitngor , namar phim tip lano kata ka por kan wan .

translation.en: And at that time Solomon held a feast , and all Israel with him , a great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt , before the  Lord  our God , seven days and seven days , even fourteen days .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Templ , u Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ki hynñiew sngi . Hangta la don u paidbah bynriew babun naduh ki jaka kiba jngai kum ka Khim Hamath shaphang shatei bad ka u pud ka Ijipt shaphang shathie .

translation.en: Jesus answered them and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Ye seek me , not because ye saw the miracles , but because ye did eat of the loaves , and were filled .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phi ïawad ïa nga namar ba phi la bam ïa u kpu bad phi la ïoh baroh kaba phi kwah , ym namar ba phi la sngewthuh shai ïa ki kambah jong nga .

translation.en: The earth also was corrupt before God , and the earth was filled with violence .
translation.kha: U la im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei , hynrei baroh kiwei pat , ki la long kiba sniew ha khmat U Blei , bad ka jingleh jubor ka la saphriang kylleng .

translation.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God , it is evident : for , The just shall live by faith .
translation.kha: Tangba ym shym la pynksan ïano ïano ruh da ka Hukum ha U Blei  , namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Tang uta ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .

translation.en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever  ; and thou ,  Lord  , becamest their God .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki Israel ki briew jong me junom , bad me , ko  Trai  , me la long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty : and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags .
translation.kha: Kiba dih buaid bad kiba bam lalot kin kylla duk . Lada baroh kaba phi leh ka long tang ban bam bad thiah , shen phin sa phong da ki jaiñjot .

translation.en: The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh  ; now shall be their perplexity .
translation.kha: Wat kiba bha tam bad bahok tam na ki , ki long ki bymdondor kum ki ñiut . Ka sngi ka la poi haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa ki briew , kumba u la maham ïa ki lyngba ki nongap phira , ki nongïathuhlypa . Mynta ki don ha ka jingkulmar jingmut .

translation.en: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus ; for he oft refreshed me , and was not ashamed of my chain :
translation.kha: To U Trai un pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ha ka longïing u Onesiphoros , namar ba u la pyntngen ïa nga bunsien .

translation.en: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man , that he may send away your other brother , and Benjamin . If I be bereaved of my children , I am bereaved .
translation.kha: To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un pynlong ïa uta u briew ba un isynei ïa phi , khnang ba un pynphai sha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad ïa u Benjamin de . Ïa nga shimet te , lada nga dei ban duh ïa la ki khun , ieh ngan mat duh ïa ki .

translation.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly , lest thou also be like unto him .
translation.kha: Lada phi jubab ïa ka jingkylli bieit , phin long kum u briew uba bieit uba kylli ïa ka .

translation.en: But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
translation.kha: Haba u paidbah u la ïalum bad sdang ban kylli ïa u Pilat na ka bynta ka jingleh bakyrpang ba ju leh , u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ïa u syiem jong ki Jiw ?

translation.en: And the king was sorry : nevertheless for the oath s sake , and them which sat with him at meat , he commanded it to be given her .
translation.kha: U syiem u la sngewsih , hynrei namar ka jingkular kaba u la lah pynlong ha khmat baroh ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u , u la ai ki hukum ba ïa ka jingkwah jong ka yn ai .

translation.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee , of thy son s mandrakes .
translation.kha: Ha ka aïom ot kew , u Reuben u la leit sha lyngkha bad u lap ïa ki mandriek    , kiba u la wanrah sha ka kmie jong u ka Leah . Ka Rakhel ka ong ïa ka Leah ,  Ai lem katto katne ki mandriek jong u khun jong pha .

translation.en: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias  ; and on this wise shewed he himself .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la paw sa shisien pat ha la ki synran hajan ka duriaw Tiberias . Kane ka long kumno ka la jia .

translation.en: And he will be a wild man  ; his hand will be against every man , and every man s hand against him  ; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei u khun jong pha un im kum ka kada khlaw , un ïaleh pyrshah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , bad uwei pa uwei u briew un ïaleh pyrshah ïa u . Un shong khlad na la ki kur ki jait baroh .

translation.en: And God remembered Rachel , and God hearkened to her , and opened her womb .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la kynmaw ïa ka Rakhel ; u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong ka bad u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you , of them shall ye buy , and of their families that are with you , which they begat in your land : and they shall be your possession .
translation.kha: Phi lah ruh ban thied ïa ki khun jong ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi . Kum kita ïa kiba la kha ha ka ri jong phi ki lah ban long ka jingïohkynti jong phi ,

translation.en: Let no man deceive you by any means : for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first , and that man of sin be revealed , the son of perdition ;
translation.kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi ha kano kano ka rukom . Naba ka Sngi kan ym wan tad ynda ka Jingïaleh pyrshah ka jia bad ba uta Uba Sniew u mihpaw ïa uba la buh lypa na ka bynta ka dujok .

translation.en: The Bible answers that question at ISAIAH 48 :17 , 18 and 2 TIMOTHY 3 :16 , 17 .
translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka jubab ïa kata ka jingkylli ha ISAIAH 48 :17 , 18 bad 2 TIMOTHI 3 :16 , 17 .

translation.en: So the devils besought him , saying , If thou cast us out , suffer us to go away into the herd of swine .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Lada men beh noh ïa ngi shabar , to phah ïa ngi sha katai ka kynhun ki sniang .

translation.en: They spend their days in wealth , and in a moment go down to the grave .
translation.kha: Ki im ka jingim ha ka jingsuk bad ki ïap suk khlem ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,
translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki tiar pynïeng Ïingjaiñ , ïa ki diengkhap , ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , bad ïa ki tiar pyndait jong ka baroh . Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine ki tiar ki tar .

translation.en: And blessed be thy advice , and blessed be thou , which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood , and from avenging myself with mine own hand .
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa U Blei namar ka jingtipbriew jong phi , bad namar kaei kaba phi la leh ha kane ka sngi ha kaba khang ïa nga na ka jingpalat ka jingpynïap briew bad na kaba pynhiarkput da lade hi .

translation.en: If he destroy him from his place , then it shall deny him , saying , I have not seen thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei phut noh ïa ki — ym don mano mano batip ba ki ju don hangta .

translation.en: And I will drive thee from thy station , and from thy state shall he pull thee down .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un weng noh ïa me na ka jaka treikam bad pynhiar ïa me na ka kyrdan kaba halor .

translation.en: And when the man rose up to depart , his father in law urged him : therefore he lodged there again .
translation.kha: U Lebi u ïeng joit ban leit noh , hynrei u kpa u pynbor ïa u ban sah shuwa , kumta u sah sa shi miet hangta .

translation.en: For every head shall be bald , and every beard clipped : upon all the hands shall be cuttings , and upon the loins sackcloth .
translation.kha: Baroh na ki , ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la khapnoh ïa la ki  ñiuhtmoh . Baroh ki la pynmong ïa la ki kti , bad uwei pa uwei u phong ïa ki jaiñ khain .

translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !

translation.en: And it was told the house of David , saying , Syria is confederate with Ephraim . And his heart was moved , and the heart of his people , as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind .
translation.kha: Haba ka ktien ka la poi ha u syiem ka Judah ba ki kynhun shipai ka Syria ki la da don hapoh ka ri Israel , ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la sngewshyrkhei shikatdei ha kaba ki la khynñiuh kum ki dieng ba la pynkhih da ka lyer .

translation.en: Whom having not seen , ye love  ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :
translation.kha: Phi ieit ïa u , wat haba phim pat ïohi ïa u , bad phi ngeit ha u , wat la phim pat ïohi ïa u mynta . Te phi shadkmen da ka jingkmen kaba khraw bad kaba dap da ka burom kiba ki ktien kim lah ban batai ,

translation.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked : he covereth the faces of the judges thereof  ; if not , where , and who is he ?
translation.kha: U Blei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha ki bymman . U pynlong ïa baroh ki nongbishar kiba matlah . Bad lada ym dei U Blei uba leh ïa kata , uei uba leh ?

translation.en: Behold , I will send for many fishers , saith the  Lord  , and they shall fish them  ; and after will I send for many hunters , and they shall hunt them from every mountain , and from every hill , and out of the holes of the rocks .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga phah khot ïa shibun ki nongtong dohkha ban wan bad kem ïa kine ki briew . Nangta ngan phah khot ïa shibun ki nongbeh mrad ban thwet pynïap ïa ki halor uwei pa uwei u lumbah bad u lumrit bad hapoh ki krem hapdeng ki mawsiang .

translation.en: A greyhound  ; an he goat also  ; and a king , against whom there is no rising up .
translation.kha: ki  langsohmoh , ki  iar-ryngkuh kiba ïaid pyn-at shadem , bad u syiem ha khmat ki briew jong u .

translation.en: So now the  Lord  God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel , and shouldest thou possess it ?
translation.kha: Kumta dei U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la beh noh ïa ki Amor na ka bynta ki briew jong U , ki Israel keiñ .

translation.en: Being defamed , we entreat : we are made as the filth of the world , and are the offscouring of all things unto this day .
translation.kha: La ñiew ïa ngi kum ka synrum jong ka pyrthei ; ngi long ki briew kiba la shah kyntait beiñ haduh kane ka khyllipmat !

translation.en: As for you , O house of Israel , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Go ye , serve ye every one his idols , and hereafter also , if ye will not hearken unto me : but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts , and with your idols .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Bad mynta , ma phi ki Israel baroh , to pynsngewbha ïa lade ! To khie bad to shakri ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ! Hynrei nga maham ïa phi ba hadien kane , phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad sangeh ban pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga da kaba ai ki jingai sngewbha ha ki bleithaw jong phi .

translation.en: Say ye of him , whom the Father hath sanctified , and sent into the world , Thou blasphemest  ; because I said , I am the Son of God ?
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , U Kpa u la jied ïa nga bad u la phah ïa nga sha ka pyrthei . Kumno , te , phi lah ban ong ba nga krenbeiñ blei namar ba nga la ong ba nga long U Khun U Blei ?

translation.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations .
translation.kha: Hynrei shuwa ba ka jingkut kan wan , ïa ka Gospel yn ïalap ha ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And when the sixth hour was come , there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour .
translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum , kaba neh lai kynta .

translation.en: And he settled his countenance stedfastly , until he was ashamed : and the man of God wept .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u peit shlip ïa u da ka jingpeit kaba ishyrkhei ïa ka khmat jong u haduh ba u Hasael u la kem pang . Kynsan u Elisha u jaw ki ummat brup .

translation.en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass , and put forth his hand , and took it , and slew a thousand men therewith .
translation.kha: Nangta u lap kawei ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada kaba dang shu ïap shen . U dem bad u tam ïa ka , bad da kata u pynïap shihajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: They shall not dwell in the  Lord s  land  ; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt , and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kin ym ïoh shongsah ha ka ri U  Trai  ; hynrei kin hap leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki hap ban bam ka jingbam ba la kheiñ sang ha Assyria .

translation.en: And the children struggled together within her  ; and she said , If it be so , why am I thus ? And she went to enquire of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka la dei ban ïoh khun synrap , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa ki , ki ïakhih ïaksaid para ma ki ha ka kpoh jong ka . Ka ong ,  Balei kaba kum kane ka wan jia ha nga ?  Kumta ka la leit kylli na U  Trai  ban ïoh jubab .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Do ye not therefore err , because ye know not the scriptures , neither the power of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Katno phi la bakla ! Bad phi tip balei ? Ka long namar ba phim tip ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid lane ïa ka bor jong U Blei .

translation.en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams , wherewith his spirit was troubled , and his sleep brake from him .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar ba u Nebukhadnessar u long syiem , u la ïoh ka jingphohsniew . Ka la pynkhuslai shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba um shym ïohthiah ,

translation.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets , and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ïa ki samla shynrang yn pynïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , bad ïa ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot .

translation.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .
translation.kha: Bad lada um shahshkor ïa ki , te to ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh ha ka balang . Khatduh , lada um shahshkor ïa ka balang , to ñiew ïa u kumba u long u nongmane blei thala lane u nonglum khajna .

translation.en: Hath given forth upon usury , and hath taken increase : shall he then live ? he shall not live : he hath done all these abominations  ; he shall surely die  ; his blood shall be upon him .
translation.kha: bad u ai kylliang pisa na ka bynta ban ïohnong . Hato un im ? Em , un ym im . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh kiba ijli , bad kumta un ïap . Un long uba la shah kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u hi .

translation.en: ( Acts 11 :27-30 ) Similarly , when we learn that our brothers in some part of the world are facing hardship , we send donations through our local congregation to supply material aid to those in critical need . —2 Corinthians 8 :13-15 .
translation.kha: ( Kam 11 :27-30 ) Kumjuh ruh haba ngi tip ba ki para bangeit jong ngi ha kano kano ka bynta jong ka pyrthei ki shem jingeh , ngi phah ïa ki jingnoh synñiang lyngba ka balang la jong ban ai jingïarap sha kito kiba donkam bha . —2 Korinth 8 :13-15 .

translation.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear , neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it cometh .
translation.kha: Phin ym donkam ban khuslai ïa ka jingpynjot kaba wan kynsan , kum kaba wan ha ki riewbymman kum ka  erïong .

translation.en: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the  Lord  , and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw , U  Trai  u la pyn-i ha nga ïa u Joshua u rangbah lyngdoh uba ïeng ha khmat u angel jong U  Trai . Bad hangta hajan jong u Joshua la ïeng u Soitan , uba la khreh ban wallam ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u .
