translation.en: For though I made you sorry with a letter , I do not repent , though I did repent : for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry , though it were but for a season .
translation.kha: Naba wat lada kata ka shithi jong nga ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi , nga te ngam sngewsih ba nga la thoh ïa ka . Ngan jin da la sngewsih haba nga la ïohi ba ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi shipor .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri , and his treason that he wrought , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Simri u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïasylla jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them : and they pursued after Joshua , and were drawn away from the city .
translation.kha: La khot lang ïa ki rangbah baroh kiba ha ka nongbah ban leit beh ïa ki , bad katba ki nang beh ïa u Joshua , katta ruh ki nang jngai na ka nongbah .

translation.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us : for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you ;
translation.kha: Phi hi phi tip bha ba phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba ngi la leh . Ngim shym la long kiba jaipdeh mynba ngi la don bad phi .

translation.en: But as one was felling a beam , the axe head fell into the water : and he cried , and said , Alas , master ! for it was borrowed .
translation.kha: Katba uwei na ki u dang khet ïa uwei u dieng , kynsan u khlieh sdie jong u , u hap hapoh um .  Ko kynrad , ngan leh kumno ?  u pyrta ha u Elisha .  U dei u sdie ba la pan kylliang .

translation.en: But neither Titus , who was with me , being a Greek , was compelled to be circumcised :
translation.kha: Ïa u Titos u paralok jong nga , wat la u dei u Grik , ym shym la pynbor ïa u ban otsher ,

translation.en: He that is not with me is against me  ; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym long na ka bynta jong nga , u ïaleh pyrshah shisha ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lum ban lang u long shisha uba pynsaphred .

translation.en: Moreover I said unto the king , If it please the king , let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river , that they may convey me over till I come into Judah  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga kyrpad ïa u ban lehsbun ïa nga da kaba ai ha nga ïa ki shithi sha ki lat ka Probins    Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi , da kaba bthah ïa ki ban shah ïa nga ban ïaid lyngba sha Judah .

translation.en: And when Silas and Timothy were come from Macedonia , Paul was pressed in the spirit , and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ .
translation.kha: Haba u Silas bad u Timothi ki la poi na Makedonia , u Paul u la pynlut ïa ka por jong u baroh ha kaba ïalap ïa ka khubor , da kaba sakhi ha ki Jiw ba U Jisu u dei U Messaïah .

translation.en: If , when evil cometh upon us , as the sword , judgment , or pestilence , or famine , we stand before this house , and in thy presence , ( for thy name is in this house , ) and cry unto thee in our affliction , then thou wilt hear and help .
translation.kha: ba lada kano kano ka jingjia bashyrkhei kan ktah ban pynshitom ïa ki — ka thma , ka jingïapthem , lane ka  nemsniew — te ki lah ban wan bad ïeng ha khmat kane ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa me . Ki lah ban duwai ha me ha ka jingshitom jong ki bad ba men sngew bad pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon , to hear his wisdom , that God had put in his heart .
translation.kha: Baroh ki wad jingtip na u ban sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain : for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , naba nga U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ngan pynshitom ïa uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.en: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you , saying , Behold , the vessels of the  Lord s  house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon : for they prophesy a lie unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa ki lyngdoh bad ïa ki paidbah ba U  Trai  u la lah ong :  Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ong ba ïa ki jingkynshew ka Templ yn sa wanrah pat shen shen na Babilonia . Ki shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses , and speak one to another , every one to his brother , saying , Come , I pray you , and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko khun u briew , ki briew jong me ki ïakren shaphang jong me haba ki ïakynduh hajan ki kynroh ka nongbah ne ha ki lynti hajan jingkhang ki ïing jong ki . Ki ïa-ong para ma ki , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit bad sngap ka ktien aïu kaba wan na U Trai mynta .’

translation.en: Son of man , because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem , Aha , she is broken that was the gates of the people : she is turned unto me : I shall be replenished , now she is laid waste :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ki briew ha ka nongbah Tyros ki ïa sngewkmen . Ki pyrta , ‘ Ka Jerusalem ka la pra ! Ka bor khaïi pateng jong ka kam don shuh ! Kan ym long shuh ka nongïaleh pyrshah jong ngi !’

translation.en: And both these kings  hearts shall be to do mischief , and they shall speak lies at one table  ; but it shall not prosper : for yet the end shall be at the time appointed .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ar ngut ki syiem kin ïashong lang ban ïabam ha kajuh ka miej , hynrei ki jingthmu jong ki , kin long kiba sniew , bad kin ïa-lamler uwei ïa uwei pat . Kin ym ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , namar ka por na ka bynta kata kam pat poi .

translation.en: On the east three gates  ; on the north three gates  ; on the south three gates  ; and on the west three gates .
translation.kha: La don lai tylli ki khyrdop ha kawei kawei ka liang : Lai tylli ha ka phang mihngi , lai tylli ha ka phang shathie , lai tylli ha ka phang shatei , bad lai tylli ha ka phang sepngi .

translation.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father .
translation.kha: Ka dei lyngba U Khrist ba baroh ma ngi , ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , ngi la lah ban wan ha uwei U Mynsiem sha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa .

translation.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition  ; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul .
translation.kha: Ngim long ki briew kiba phai dien bad kiba jot noh . Pynban , ngi don ka jingngeit bad la pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation ? and to what are they like ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ,  Mynta bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk ? Ki long kiba kumno ?

translation.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus , and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world : which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Agabos , u la ïeng joit bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem u la ïathuh lypa ba ka  nemsniew bajur kan sa wan ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . ( Ka la wan jia mynba u Klaudius u la long u Patsha . )

translation.en: And I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh  ; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .
translation.kha: ngan kynmaw ïa la ka kular ha phi bad ha ki mrad baroh ba ka jingshlei um da lei lei ruh kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh .

translation.en: Come unto me , all ye that labour and are heavy laden , and I will give you rest .
translation.kha: To wan ha nga , phi baroh kiba thait na kaba kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia , bad ngan ai ha phi ka jingjahthait .

translation.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee , and of them that keep thy precepts .
translation.kha: Nga long u paralok jong kito baroh kiba shakri ïa me , jong baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant , and speak unto the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka jutang . Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem

translation.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly , working not at all , but are busybodies .
translation.kha: Namar ngi ïohsngew ba don katto katne ngut ki briew hapdeng jong phi kiba im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym trei ei ei lait tang ban lushia ha ka kam jong kiwei pat ki briew .

translation.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness , they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Shisien , katba ki Israel ki dang don ha ka ri khlaw , la lap ïa uwei u briew uba dang lum diengïap ha ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: The waters are hid as with a stone , and the face of the deep is frozen .
translation.kha: kaba pynkylla maw ïa ka um , bad kaba pynkhriat ïa ka sla duriaw ?

translation.en: For pass over the isles of Kittim , and see  ; and send unto Kedar , and consider diligently , and see if there be such a thing .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha sepngi sha ka dewlynnong Sypros , bad phah ïano ïano shaphang mihngi sha ka ri Kedar . Phin ïohi ba ym pat ju don kaba kum kane kaba la jia mynshuwa .

translation.en: I saw by night , and behold a man riding upon a red horse , and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom  ; and behind him were there red horses , speckled , and white .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa uwei u angel jong U  Trai  uba shong halor u kulai basaw . U la sangeh hapdeng katto katne tylli ki dieng Martl ha ka them , bad hadien jong u la don sa kiwei pat ki kulai — kiba saw , kiba thohbroin , bad kiba lieh .

translation.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad u Eleasar u khun jong u sha kliar u Lum Hor ,

translation.en: To Timothy , my dearly beloved son : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun ba-ieit jong nga : To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei , bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said , while he taught in the temple ,  How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David ?
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kylli ka jingkylli ,  Kumno ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum ki ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?

translation.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest , fluttereth over her young , spreadeth abroad her wings , taketh them , beareth them on her wings :
translation.kha: Kumba ka pukni ka hikai her ïa la ki khun , bad ka pyiar la ki thapniang ban kyrshan ïa ki , kumta ruh U  Trai  u kyrshan ïa ki Israel ba kin ym hap .

translation.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah ngut na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato ngan leit ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Tur ïaleh ïa ka ,  ki jubab ,  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .

translation.en: And the kingdom and dominion , and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven , shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High , whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and all dominions shall serve and obey him .
translation.kha: Ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhraw jong baroh ki hima ha ka pyrthei yn ai ha ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Ka bor ba kynja syiem jong ki kan ym kut shuh bad ki nongsynshar baroh ha ka pyrthei kin shakri bad kohnguh ïa ki .

translation.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the  Lord  hath given them ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi nud ban pyrshang ban pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki Israel na kaba jam sha shiliang ka Jordan ban leit sha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki ?

translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that they shall no more say , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan wan  , ong U  Trai  ,  haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa u paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea , being a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews , besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus : and Pilate gave him leave . He came therefore , and took the body of Jesus .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joseph , uba na ka shnong Arimathaïa , u la pan na u Pilat lada un shah ban rah ïa ka met U Jisu . ( U Joseph u la long u nongbud jong U Jisu , hynrei ym ha kaba paw , namar ba u la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . ) U Pilat u la ong ïa u ba u lah ban rah ïa ka met , kumta u Joseph u la leit bad rah noh ïa ka .

translation.en: Father , glorify thy name .  Then came there a voice from heaven , saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again .
translation.kha: Ko Pa , to pyndonburom ïa la ka kyrteng !  Te ka sur ka la kren na bneng ,  Nga la wallam ka burom ïa ka , bad ngan leh biang kumta .

translation.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
translation.kha: U paidbah byllien u la leit sha u Ïoannis ban shah pynbaptis ha u .  Phi ki bseiñ !  u la ong ha ki .  Mano ba la ong ïa phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?

translation.en: Give us day by day our daily bread .
translation.kha: To ai ha ngi man ka sngi ïa ka jingbam kaba ngi donkam .

translation.en: Stay yourselves , and wonder  ; cry ye out , and cry : they are drunken , but not with wine  ; they stagger , but not with strong drink .
translation.kha: To long uba mutlop ! To long uba matlah ! To long uba buaid khlem kano kano ka waiñ ! To ïaid sheng sheng khlem dih wat tang shi jaw !

translation.en: And they found written in the law which the  Lord  had commanded by Moses , that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month :
translation.kha: Ki shem ha ka Hukum kaba U  Trai  u la ai lyngba u Moses , ba ka la hukum ïa ki Israel ban shong ban sah ha ki jakarieh bashipor ha ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God , and saying ,
translation.kha: Kynsan ka kynhun bah jong ki angel ka bneng , ka la mihpaw lem bad u angel , ki da rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei :

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant ? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight , that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me ?
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha U  Trai  ,  Balei keiñ ba me la pynjynjar sat ïa nga katne katne ? Balei ba mem sngewbha ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kine ki paidbah baroh ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki Lebi ruh , phin hap shah ïa kiei kiei kiba mih na kano kano ka jingleh palat ha ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin shah ïa kiei kiba mih ha ka jingshakri ha ka jinglong lyngdoh .

translation.en: And I spake unto you at that time , saying , I am not able to bear you myself alone :
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Mynba ngi dang don ha u Lum Sinai , nga la ïathuh ha phi , ‘ Ka jingkitkhlieh ban ïalam ïa phi ka khia than ïa nga , ngam lah shuh ban kit ïa ka tang marwei .

translation.en: And Benjamin came again at that time  ; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh–gilead : and yet so they sufficed them not .
translation.kha: Ki Benjamin ki wan phai pat , bad kiwei ki Israel ki ai ha ki ïa kita ki theisotti na Jabesh ïa kiba kim shym la pynïap . Hynrei kita kim pat biang ïa ki .

translation.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant , wherein your fathers have dwelt  ; and they shall dwell therein , even they , and their children , and their children s children for ever : and my servant David shall be their prince for ever .
translation.kha: Kin shong ha ka ri ba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob , ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki shong ki sah . Kin shong junom hangta , bad kumta ruh ki khun jong ki bad baroh kiba hiarpateng na ki . U syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga , u Dabid un synshar halor jong ki junom .

translation.en: And thou , child , shalt be called the prophet of the Highest : for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways  ;
translation.kha: Ïa me , ko khun jong nga , yn khot u nongïathuhlypa jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Men leit ha shuwa jong U Trai ban pynkhreh ka lynti na ka bynta jong u ,

translation.en: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain , Take up , and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite : for remember how that , when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father , the  Lord  laid this burden upon him  ;
translation.kha: bad u Jehu u ong ha u Bidkar , u nongbud jong u ,  Shim bret ïa ka met jong u ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth . Phi kynmaw ba mynba ma phi bad ma nga ngi dang ïabud ha la ki kulai nadien u Ahab , u kpa jong u syiem Joram , U  Trai  u la kren ïa kine ki ktien pyrshah ïa u Ahab :

translation.en: As soon as the morning was light , the men were sent away , they and their asses .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab la phah noh ïa kita shi para bad ïa ki kada jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ha kaba kiba ïap kin mihpat , kan long ka tnga jongno ? Ma ki baroh ki la shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: They care for the important but often routine organizational and physical tasks that must be handled in the congregation .
translation.kha: Ki peit ïa ki kam ba donkam ba dei ban leh man la ka por ha ka balang .

translation.en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker , and buildeth temples  ; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities : but I will send a fire upon his cities , and it shall devour the palaces thereof .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la tei ïa ki ïingsyiem , hynrei ki la klet ïa la U Nongthaw . Ki paid Judah ki la tei ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh . Hynrei ngan phah da ka ding ka ban thang duh ïa ki ïingsyiem bad ki nongbah jong ki .

translation.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing , that they have no covering in the cold .
translation.kha: Mynmiet ki thiah khlem don ei ei ban tap nalor jong ki , kim don ei ei ban ïada na ka jingkhriat .

translation.en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the  Lord  continually .
translation.kha: U Aaron un sumar bad buh ryntih ïa kita ki sharak ha u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , bad un khmih ba kin meh man ka por ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Katto katne na kiba hiarpateng na me hi kin shah ïalam noh bad kin long ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .

translation.en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving , and came to him , and said , Lord , dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone ? bid her therefore that she help me .
translation.kha: Ka Martha ka la khuslai halor ki kam baroh kiba ka la dei ban leh , kumta ka la wan bad ka la ong ,  Ko Trai , hato mem pyrkhat lem ba ka para jong nga ka la ieh ïa nga ban leh ïa ka kam baroh da lade hi ? To ong ïa ka ban wan bad ïarap ïa nga !

translation.en: Because the ground is chapt , for there was no rain in the earth , the plowmen were ashamed , they covered their heads .
translation.kha: Namar bym don slap bad ba ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong ki nongrep ki pang ka dohnud ; ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .

translation.en: So Mordecai went his way , and did according to all that Esther had commanded him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Mordekai u leit noh bad u leh ïa baroh kaba ka Esther ka la ong ïa u ban leh .

translation.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them , and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki bym don jingtip ki ïap namar ba ki kyntait ïa ka jingstad . Ki briew kiba mutlop ki shah pynjot namar ba ki leh bymsuidñiew .

translation.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice  ; with the voice together shall they sing : for they shall see eye to eye , when the  Lord  shall bring again Zion .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ap phira ïa ka nongbah ki pyrta , ki pyrta lang da ka jingkmen ! Ki lah ban ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat ïa ka jingwan jong U  Trai  sha Seïon !

translation.en: If they sin against thee , ( for there is no man that sinneth not , ) and thou be angry with them , and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy , far or near  ;
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki leh pop pyrshah ïa me — bad ba ym don uwei ruh u briew uba khlem leh pop — bad ha la ka jingbitar me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ban ring koidi ïa ki sha kawei pat ka ri , wat la kata ka ri ka long kaba jngai , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong me .

translation.en: So I stood upon him , and slew him , because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen : and I took the crown that was upon his head , and the bracelet that was on his arm , and have brought them hither unto my lord .
translation.kha: Kumta nga leit sha u bad nga pynïap ïa u , namar nga tip ba un sa ïap hi la kumno kumno un tang shu kyllon . Nangta nga shim ïa ka pansngiat na ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka jingdeng na ka ksang ti jong u , bad nga la wallam ïa ki sha phi , ko kynrad .

translation.en: And be ready against the third day : for the third day the  Lord  will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad ban long kiba la khreh la shi sngi . Ha kata ka sngi ngan wan hiar ha u Lum Sinai ; ha kaba ki briew baroh kin ïohi ïa nga .

translation.en: But the children of Belial said , How shall this man save us ? And they despised him , and brought him no presents . But he held his peace .
translation.kha: Hynrei don ki riewkai kiba ong ,  Kumno da kum une u briew u lah ban lehbha ïa ngi ?  Ki ibeiñ ïa u Saul bad kim shym wanrah ïa u kano kano ka jingai sngewbha .

translation.en: Lord  , bow down thine ear , and hear : open ,  Lord  , thine eyes , and see : and hear the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent him to reproach the living God .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , khmih ïa kaei kaba jia ha ngi . Shahshkor ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u ong ban ibeiñ ïa me , U Blei uba im .

translation.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness , as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time . Spots they are and blemishes , sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you  ;
translation.kha: Yn sa pynjot ïa ki kum ïa ki mradkhlaw , bad kin hap shah ïa ka jingshahshitom kaba ki la pynlong . Ka jingsngewbha ha ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaei ha kaba shai ka sngi ka ban pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ; ki long ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom haba ki ïashong bam bad phi , katba ki nang leh sngewbha ha la ki lynti bashukor !

translation.en: And Jesus said unto the centurion ,  Go thy way  ; and as thou hast believed , so be it done unto thee .  And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie leit noh sha ïing , bad ïa kaei kaba me ngeit yn sa leh na ka bynta me .  Bad ïa u shakri jong u rangbah pynïaidkam la pynkhiah ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .

translation.en: I will therefore chastise him , and release him .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah sympat ïa u bad pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: When goods increase , they are increased that eat them : and what good is there to the owners thereof , saving the beholding of them with their eyes ?
translation.kha: Kat phi nang roi ha ka spah , katta ki shyntur phin hap ban bsa . Baroh kaba phi ïohnong ka dei ka jingtip ba phi long uba riewspah .

translation.en: And while he yet spake , behold , Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came : and Adonijah said unto him , Come in  ; for thou art a valiant man , and bringest good tidings .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un pynkut ïa ka jingkren , u Jonathan , u khun jong u Abiathar u lyngdoh , u la wan poi .  Ale rung ,  u Adonijah u ong .  Me long u briew uba bha — me dei ban wanrah ka khubor kaba bha .

translation.en: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven ,
translation.kha: Te u angel ïa uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng halor ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew u la rah ïa la ka kti kamon sha bneng

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they were burying a man , that , behold , they spied a band of men  ; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha : and when the man was let down , and touched the bones of Elisha , he revived , and stood up on his feet .
translation.kha: Shisien , katba dang leit ontep , la ïohi ïa kawei na kine ki kynhun , bad ki paidbah ki pynhap ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep u Elisha bad ki phet krad . Mar ïadei ka metïap ha ki shyieng u Elisha , uta u briew u im pat bad u ïeng joit .

translation.en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord , and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka kynta hi , ka la wan poi bad ka la ainguh ïa U Blei bad ka la kren shaphang u khunlung ha baroh kiba ap ïa U Blei ban pyllaitluid ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal , saying , Slack not thy hand from thy servants  ; come up to us quickly , and save us , and help us : for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Gibeon ki la phah ktien sha u Joshua ha ka jaka sher dara ha Gilgal , ki da ong ,  Kynrad , wat iehnoh ïa ngi ! Wan mar mar ban ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyllait im ïa ngi ! Baroh ki syiem Amor ha ri lum ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And they , when they had heard that he was alive , and had been seen of her , believed not .
translation.kha: Ka la leit bad ïathuh ïa ki nongbud jong u . Ki dang ïasngewsih bad ïam ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , ba ka ong ba U Jisu u im bad ba ka la lah ïohi ïa u , kim shym la ngeit ïa ka .

translation.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for : that all people of the earth may know thy name , to fear thee , as do thy people Israel  ; and that they may know that this house , which I have builded , is called by thy name .
translation.kha: Na bneng , ha kaba me shong , sngap ïa u bad leh ïa kaei kaba u kyrpad ïa me ban leh , khnang ba baroh ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei kin tip ïa me bad kohnguh ïa me kumba ki paid Israel ki leh . Te kin tip ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan long ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa me .

translation.en: Praise the  Lord  , O Jerusalem  ; praise thy God , O Zion .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko Jerusalem ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong pha , ko Seïon !

translation.en: Then assembled together the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders of the people , unto the palace of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka ïing paki dulan jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ,

translation.en: For if we would judge ourselves , we should not be judged .
translation.kha: Lada ngi la ïit shuwa ïa lade , ngin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar jong U Blei .

translation.en: And again another scripture saith , They shall look on him whom they pierced .
translation.kha: Bad don sa kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ,  Ki briew kin ïakhmih ïa uta ïa uba ki la sum .

translation.en: And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me ,  Arise , and go into Damascus  ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli , ‘ Aïu ngan leh , A Trai ?’ bad U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng joit bad leit sha Damaskos , bad hangta yn sa ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la thmu na ka bynta jong me ban leh .’

translation.en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice  ; great things doeth he , which we cannot comprehend .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong U Blei kiei kiei kiba khraw ki jia , kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba ngim lah ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: If it do evil in my sight , that it obey not my voice , then I will repent of the good , wherewith I said I would benefit them .
translation.kha: hynrei hadien , kata ka jaitbynriew kam kohnguh ïa nga bad ka leh ïa kaba sniew , ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .

translation.en: Sing , O heavens  ; and be joyful , O earth  ; and break forth into singing , O mountains : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , and will have mercy upon his afflicted .
translation.kha: To rwai , ko ki bneng ! Pyrta da ka jingkmen , ko ka pyrthei ! To ai ba ki lumbah kin win ha ka jingrwai ! U  Trai  un pyntngen ïa la ki briew ; un don jingisynei ha ki briew jong u kiba jynjar .

translation.en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him , and believed : among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite , and a woman named Damaris , and others with them .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la ïasoh bad u , napdeng jong ki , u dei u Dionysius , u dkhot jong ka dorbar ; la don ruh ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Damaris , bad kiwei pat ki briew .

translation.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ki jingjubab bastad jong u .

translation.en: They have mouths , but they speak not  ; eyes have they , but they see not  ;
translation.kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim lah ban kren , bad ki khmat , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi .

translation.en: O our God , wilt thou not judge them ? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us  ; neither know we what to do : but our eyes are upon thee .
translation.kha: Me long U Blei jong ngi ! Pynshitom ïa ki , naba ngim lah leh ei ei ruh em ha khmat jong kane ka kynhun shipai babun paid kaba tur ïaleh ïa ngi . Ngim tip kumno ngin leh , hynrei ngi phai sha me na ka bynta ka jingïarap .

translation.en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterward the hands of all the people . So thou shalt put the evil away from among you .
translation.kha: Ki sakhi ki dei ban lynthem maw nyngkong , bad nangta kiwei pat ki briew kin pynbud ïa ki , da kumta phin pynkhuid noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .

translation.en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month , when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land , ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days : on the first day shall be a sabbath , and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath .
translation.kha: Ynda phi la dep lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam hynñiew sngi naduh ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Ka sngi nyngkong ka dei ka sngi shongthait , bad kumjuh ruh ka sngi kaba phra .

translation.en: Look unto me , and be ye saved , all the ends of the earth : for I am God , and there is none else .
translation.kha: To phai sha nga mynta bad ban im , ko ki briew baroh kylleng ka pyrthei ! Nga long tang ma nga U Blei .

translation.en: He built the high gate of the house of the  Lord  , and on the wall of Ophel he built much .
translation.kha: Dei u Jotham uba tei ïa ka Khyrdop kaba shaneng jong ka Templ , bad u la tei pynheh shuh shuh ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah hapoh ka jaka jong ka Jerusalem ba la khot ka Ophel .

translation.en: And he made a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen : with cherubims made he it of cunning work .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad la suh pynpur itynnat bha ha ka da ki dur ki Kherub .

translation.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul , and a sword , and a sharp arrow .
translation.kha: Ka jingsakhi lamler ka long kaba ma kum ka waitlam , u dieng tangon ne u khnam banep .

translation.en: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying , the fire came down from heaven , and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices  ; and the glory of the  Lord  filled the house .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Solomon u la dep ban duwai , ka ding ka wan hiar na bneng bad ka thang duh ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh , bad ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka pyndap ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified , and not by faith only .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi , namarkata , ka dei da ki kam jong u ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha U Blei , ym tang da ka jingngeit jong u hi .

translation.en: He should be self-sacrificing in his love for his wife .
translation.kha: U dei ban kham ieit ïa la ka lok ban ïalade .

translation.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Eleasar , u Joshua , bad ha kiwei pat ki nongïalam jong ki Israel :

translation.en: In those days the  Lord  began to cut Israel short : and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  u la sdang ban pynrit ïa ka jingheh jong ka ri Israel . U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u la hiarthma ïa baroh ka ri Israel kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan

translation.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice , and weep with them that weep .
translation.kha: Kmen bad kiba kmen , ïa-ïam bad kito kiba ïam .

translation.en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds , until the day and night come to an end .
translation.kha: U pynïakhlad ïa ka jingshai na ka jingdum da ka syrwiang ba la pruid dak ha khmat ka duriaw .

translation.en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him , and saying unto him , Cornelius .
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kawei ka sngi kumba lai baje nohphai sngi mynba u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba u la ïohi da kaba shai kdar ïa u angel jong U Blei uba wan shapoh bad ong ha u ,  Kornelios !

translation.en: Have ye not seen a vain vision , and have ye not spoken a lying divination , whereas ye say , The  Lord  saith it  ; albeit I have not spoken ?
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ki : Kito ki jingïohipaw ba phi ïohi ki dei kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa kiba phi thaw ki long kiba lamler . Phi ong ba ki dei ki ktien jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la kren ha phi !

translation.en: And Jair died , and was buried in Camon .
translation.kha: U Jair u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Kamon .

translation.en: Set ye up a standard in the land , blow the trumpet among the nations , prepare the nations against her , call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat , Minni , and Ashchenaz  ; appoint a captain against her  ; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers .
translation.kha: To ai ïa ka dak ban tur ïaleh ! Put ïa ka turoi khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin ïohsngew ! Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia ! Ong ïa ki hima Ararat , Minni , bad Ashkenas ban tur ïaleh . Thung ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh . Wallam ïa ki kulai kum ka kynhun ki puit .

translation.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name , receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me , receiveth not me , but him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei na kine ki khynnah rit , u pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , u pdiang sngewbha ym tang ïa nga hynrei ïa uta ruh uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan , and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah , ( whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ) saying ,
translation.kha: Nga la ai ïa ka shithi ha u Elasah u khun jong u Shaphan bad ha u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Hilkaïah , ïa uba u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u phah sha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia . Ka ong :

translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee  ;
translation.kha: Hangne kine ki mawbah ba nga la kynton hapdeng jong ngi , bad hangne u maw pynsah jingkynmaw .

translation.en: When he was come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum , ki paidbah babun ki la bud ïa u .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam , how he warred , and how he reigned , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Jeroboam u la leh , ki thma kiba u ïaleh bad kumno u synshar , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: So I turned and came down from the mount , and the mount burned with fire : and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum , nga da rah ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli , ha kiba la thoh ïa ka jutang . Ki thylliej ding ki dang meh ha uta u lum .

translation.en: And he told it to his father , and to his brethren : and his father rebuked him , and said unto him , What is this dream that thou hast dreamed ? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth ?
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ruh ïa ka jingphohsniew ha la u kpa , bad u kpa jong u , u la mai ïa u ,  Ka jingphohsniew aïu kaba kum kata ? Hato me pyrkhat ba ka kmie jong me , ki hynmen shynrang jong me , bad ma nga ngin ïawan bad nguh ïa me ?

translation.en: And she called the name of the  Lord  that spake unto her , Thou God seest me : for she said , Have I also here looked after him that seeth me ?
translation.kha: Ka Hagar ka kylli ïa lade ,  Hato nga da ïohi shisha ïa U Blei bad ba nga dang im ban ïathuh ïa kata ?  Kumta ka la khot ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba la kren ha ka ,  U Blei uba ïohi .

translation.en: And the sons of Tola  ; Uzzi , and Rephaiah , and Jeriel , and Jahmai , and Jibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their father s house , to wit , of Tola : they were valiant men of might in their generations  ; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred .
translation.kha: U Tola u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ussi , u Rephaïah , u Jeriel , u Jahmai , u Ibsam , bad u Shemuel . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing kiba na ka kur Tola , bad ki dei ruh ki shipai bapawnam . Ha ka por u syiem Dabid , ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki don arphew ar hajar hynriewspah ngut .

translation.en: So the people went out into the field against Israel : and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai jong u Dabid ka la leit sha rudnong bad ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ka khlaw Ephraim .

translation.en: Go through , go through the gates  ; prepare ye the way of the people  ; cast up , cast up the highway  ; gather out the stones  ; lift up a standard for the people .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid ka Jerusalem , leit shabar ka nongbah bad shna ka lynti na ka bynta u paidlang u ban wan phai ! Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti bah ; da pynkhuid ïa ki maw kiba don ha ka ! To sieh ïa ka lama , khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin tip .

translation.en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families , every man in the door of his tent : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled greatly  ; Moses also was displeased .
translation.kha: U Moses u ïohsngew ba ki briew baroh ki ïakhñium katba ki dang ïa-ïeng lymbung kynhun kynhun ha khmat jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la sngewkhuslai namar ba U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki ,

translation.en: In which class is your sister studying ?
translation.kha: Ha ka klass aiu ka para ka jong phi ka pule ?

translation.en: When there were no depths , I was brought forth  ; when there were no fountains abounding with water .
translation.kha: La kha ïa nga shuwa ki duriaw-bah , mynba ki umpohliew kim pat don .

translation.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any  ;
translation.kha: Ki sing , kiba khlaiñ tam na ki mrad baroh bad ki bym tieng ïano ïano ;

translation.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints , as I have given order to the churches of Galatia , even so do ye .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ka pisa ka ban kynshew na ka bynta ban ïarap ïa ki briew U Blei ha Judia . Phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ïa ki balang ha Galatia ban leh .

translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts , and of thy wisdom :
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u syiem ,  Kaei kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad ka jingstad jong phi , ka long kaba shisha ,

translation.en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the  Lord  hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Me dei ban hikai ïa ki paid Israel ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha me lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and do his commandments and his statutes , which I command thee this day .
translation.kha: kumta kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight , and he served him : and he made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .
translation.kha: U Potiphar u la sngewbha eh ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u kum u shakri ïa u shimet hi ; kumta u buh ïa u ban long u nongpeit ïa ka ïing ka sem jong u , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .

translation.en: And Abraham was an hundred years old , when his son Isaac was born unto him .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la dap shispah snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa u Isaak .

translation.en: For Joshua drew not his hand back , wherewith he stretched out the spear , until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai .
translation.kha: U Joshua u rah ïa la u sum uba la kdew sha ka Ai bad um shym pynhiar ïa u tad haduh ba uwei pa uwei u briew hangta u la shah pynïap . Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong ka Ai kiba la shah pynïap ha kata ka sngi — khat-ar hajar ngut ki shynrang bad ki kynthei .

translation.en: That the  Lord  called Samuel : and he answered , Here am I .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khot , ïa u Samuel . U ruh u jubab ,  Oi , Kynrad !

translation.en: Flee , get you far off , dwell deep , O ye inhabitants of Hazor , saith the  Lord   ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you , and hath conceived a purpose against you .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Hasor , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga maham ïa phi ban phet noh bad ban leit rieh . U Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa phi , bad kane ka dei kaei kaba u ong ,

translation.en: And Saul s uncle said , Tell me , I pray thee , what Samuel said unto you .
translation.kha: Bad kaei u ïathuh ïa phi ?  u kñi u Saul u kylli .

translation.en: Unto the pure all things are pure : but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure ; but even their mind and conscience is defiled .
translation.kha: Baroh ka long kaba khuid ha kito kiba long kiba khuid ha lade ; hynrei ym don kaba khuid ha kito kiba la tngit bad ki bymngeit , namar ba ki jingmut bad ki jingïatiplem jong ki , ki long ba la pyntngit .

translation.en: And make me savoury meat , such as I love , and bring it to me , that I may eat  ; that my soul may bless thee before I die .
translation.kha: Shet ïa nga kum kato ka jingbam bang kaba nga ju sngewtynnat , bad wanrah ïa ka sha nga . Ynda nga la dep bam ïa ka , ngan sa ai ha me ka jingkyrkhu bakhatduh shuwa ba ngan ïap .

translation.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea , when it cannot rest , whose waters cast up mire and dirt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki riewbymman ki long kum ka duriaw kaba khih phaloh , kiba ki jingat phyllung jong ka kim ju sangeh , ki wanrah ïa ka jakhlia bad ka ktieh .

translation.en: And of the blue , and purple , and scarlet , they made cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ki suh ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup haba ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang . Ki suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And I will raise me up a faithful priest , that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind : and I will build him a sure house  ; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever .
translation.kha: Ngan jied ïa u lyngdoh u ban kohnguh ïa nga bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u . Ngan ai ha u ki khun ki ksiew ki ban ïai shakri ha khmat u syiem uba la jied jong nga .

translation.en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit  ; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare : for I will bring upon it , even upon Moab , the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban lait na ka jingshyrkhei un hap hapoh ki liewlep , bad uno uno uba kiew na ki liewlep un ngat ha ki jingriam , namar U  Trai  u la buh por na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ka Moab .

translation.en: And an angel of the  Lord  came up from Gilgal to Bochim , and said , I made you to go up out of Egypt , and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers  ; and I said , I will never break my covenant with you .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u leit na Gilgal sha Bokhim bad u ong ha ki Israel ,  Nga la shim ïa phi na Ijipt bad wallam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga la ong , ‘ Ngan ym pynkheiñ lano lano ïa ka jutang jong nga bad phi .

translation.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , and did obeisance , and said , Help , O king .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka leit sha u syiem , ka dem ngon haduh khyndew ha ka jingñiewburom bad ka ong ,  Ïarap ïa nga , ko Syiem Kynrad !

translation.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that ye have seen  ; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither .
translation.kha: Ïathuh keiñ ha i pa haduh katno nga long uba donbor ha Ijipt , bad ïathuh ruh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la ïohi . Khie ïaleit bran bran , bad wan ïalam ïa i shane .

translation.en: For all seek their own , not the things which are Jesus Christs .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u sngewkhia tang ïa la ki jong ki kam , ym ïa kiei kiei ki jong U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water , but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them : howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing .
translation.kha: Kane ka long namar ki Amon bad ki Moab kim shym la ai jingbam bad um ïa ki Israel ha ka lynti ba ki mih na Ijipt . Pynban , ki la siew pisa sha u Balaam ban tim ïa ki Israel , hynrei U Blei jong ngi u la pynkylla long ïa ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu .

translation.en: And the bay went forth , and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth : and he said , Get you hence , walk to and fro through the earth . So they walked to and fro through the earth .
translation.kha: Katba ki kulai thohbroin ki dang wan mih , ki la long kiba da kwah eh ban leit bad ban jurip ïa ka pyrthei . U angel u la ong ,  Khie leit bad jurip ïa ka pyrthei !  — bad ki la leh kumta .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day , shall be carried to Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Isaïah nangta u la ïathuh ha u syiem ,  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba ka por kan poi ba baroh kaba ha ka ïingsyiem jong me , baroh kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la lum haduh kane ka sngi , yn sa kit noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don shuh ka ban sah .

translation.en: Philip saith unto him , Lord , shew us the Father , and it sufficeth us .
translation.kha: U Philip u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ; kata ka long baroh kaba ngi donkam .

translation.en: Who is the image of the invisible God , the firstborn of every creature :
translation.kha: U Khrist u long ka dur bapaw jong U Blei u bym lah ban ïohi . U long U Khun ba la kha nyngkong , uba hakhlieh duh jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la thaw .

translation.en: To execute judgment upon all , and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed , and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him .
translation.kha: ban wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha baroh , ban pynrem ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki kam bymriewblei ba ki la leh bad na ka bynta ki ktien ba sngewtriem kiba ki nongpop ba khlem blei ki la kren pyrshah ïa u !

translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh , and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there . And the land was subdued before them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la jop ïa ka ri , ka kynhun Israel baroh kawei ka la ïalumlang ha Shiloh bad pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: And we have sent with him the brother , whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches ;
translation.kha: Lem bad u ngi phah ïa u parabangeit ïa uba la ñiewburom bha ha baroh ki balang na ka bynta ka jingtrei jong u ha kaba ïalap ïa ka gospel .

translation.en: And lo Zadok also , and all the Levites were with him , bearing the ark of the covenant of God : and they set down the ark of God  ; and Abiathar went up , until all the people had done passing out of the city .
translation.kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh u la don hangta , bad ryngkat bad u la don ki Lebi kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba kyntang . Ki la pynhiar ïa ka bad kim shym la rah shuh tad haduh ba ki briew baroh kin da mihnoh na ka nongbah . U Abiathar , u lyngdoh u la don lang hangta .

translation.en: And the sons of Japhlet  ; Pasach , and Bimhal , and Ashvath . These are the children of Japhlet .
translation.kha: U Japhlet ruh u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Pasakh , u Bimhal , bad u Ashbath .

translation.en: Who shall declare his way to his face ? and who shall repay him what he hath done ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano u ban pharep ïa u briew uba sniew lane ban siew kylliang ïa u na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And he cried mightily with a strong voice , saying , Babylon the great is fallen , is fallen , and is become the habitation of devils , and the hold of every foul spirit , and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird .
translation.kha: U la pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam :  Ka la kyllon ! Ka Babilon Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Mynta ka la long ka jaka shong ki ksuid bad ki mynsiem bymkhuid ; baroh ki jait sim kiba jakhlia bad kiba isaitmet ki shong ha ka .

translation.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence  ; and the images , that were on high above them , he cut down  ; and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingbthah jong u ïa ki duwan ha kaba la mane ïa u Baal la pynpra , bad ïa ki duwan jingiwbih hajan jong ki la pyntwa . Ki pynlwet kum ki pui pui ïa ki dur ka Asherah bad ïa kiwei ki bleithaw baroh bad nangta ki bret ïa u pui pui ha ki jingtep jong ki briew kiba la ai jingkñia ïa lade ha ki .

translation.en: Lord  , thou wilt ordain peace for us : for thou also hast wrought all our works in us .
translation.kha: Men ai ïa ngi ka jingroi jingpar , A  Trai  ; baroh kata kaba ngi pyndep ha ka jingjop ka long ka jingmih na kaei kaba me leh .

translation.en: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity , what is man the better ?
translation.kha: Katba phi dang ïania slem , katta ka dang long ka bymmyntoi , bad phim shym long uba kham bit kham biang .

translation.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh : and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ai shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong kaba shiteng na ka jait Manasseh kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Then the chief captain came , and said unto him , Tell me , art thou a Roman ? He said , Yea .
translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Ïathuh ïa nga , hato me dei u traishnong ka Hima Rom ?   Ho-oid ,  la jubab u Paul .

translation.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation .
translation.kha: na kawei ka pateng bynriew sha kawei pat u pyn-i ka jingisynei ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u .

translation.en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night , the manna fell upon it .
translation.kha: Ka hap ha ka jaka shong dara mynmiet ryngkat bad ka umjer . Ha ka step kaba bud ki briew ki leit kylleng kylleng ban khar ïa ka , ki tylliat ïa ka lane dung pynni ïa ka , bad nangta ki shet bad pynlong kpu stang ïa ka . Ka jingmad ka long kum u kpu ba la shet ha ka umphniang Olib . )

translation.en: They are vanity , and the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
translation.kha: Ki long ki bymdondor bad dei ban ñiewbeiñ ; yn sa pynjot ïa ki haba U  Trai  u wan ban leh ïa ki .

translation.en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house , seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many , and the holy flesh is passed from thee ? when thou doest evil , then thou rejoicest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew kiba nga ieit ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Ki don hok aïu ban don hapoh ka Templ jong nga ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba ki lah ban ïada na ka jingpynjot da kaba pynlong ki jingkular bad da kaba ai ki jingkñia da ki mrad ? Hato kata kan pynkmen ïa ki ?

translation.en: And Moses said , Hereby ye shall know that the  Lord  hath sent me to do all these works  ; for I have not done them of mine own mind .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Da kane phin tip ba dei U  Trai  uba la phah ïa nga ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , bad ba ym dei da ka mon jong nga ba nga la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Ïa kane la leh ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong :

translation.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words : and when I heard the voice of his words , then was I in a deep sleep on my face , and my face toward the ground .
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u , nga la kyllon ha khyndew khlem tipbriew bad nga thiah pyllup hangta .

translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat , and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong u bad un pynïap ïa u ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh ban map noh ïa ka pop .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest , into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki briew kiba pha isih bad pha ijli .

translation.en: But who am I , and what is my people , that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort ? for all things come of thee , and of thine own have we given thee .
translation.kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngim lah shisha ban ai ei ei ïa me , namar kaei kaei baroh ka dei ka jingai sngewbha jong me , bad ngi la ai biang sha me ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong me hi .

translation.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days , until the days of your consecration be at an end : for seven days shall he consecrate you .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi phim dei ban mih na ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ , tat ynda la pyndep lut ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang .

translation.en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour s house  ; lest he be weary of thee , and so hate thee .
translation.kha: Wat leit jngoh bunsien eh ïa u paramarjan jong phi , u lah ban sngewngiah ïa phi bad isih pynban ïa phi .

translation.en: So Jonah went out of the city , and sat on the east side of the city , and there made him a booth , and sat under it in the shadow , till he might see what would become of the city .
translation.kha: U Jonah u la mih bad leit shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah bad u la shong hangta . U la shna ka jakarieh tngen ïa lade bad shong ha ka syrngiew jong ka , da kaba ap ban khmih kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Ninebeh .

translation.en: ( Isaiah 43 :10 ) From small beginnings the organization has grown to millions of Witnesses , who are busy preaching in more than 230 lands .
translation.kha: ( Isaiah 43 :10 ) Na i jingsdang i barit ka seng ka la nangroi haduh ba ka la kot sha ki milian ngut Ki Nongsakhi , kiba mynta ki bunkam ha ka ban ïalap ha palat 236 tylli ki shnong .

translation.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day , all the while we were with them keeping the sheep .
translation.kha: Ki la ïada ïa ngi mynsngi bad mynmiet ha ka por baroh ba ngi don bad ki haba ngi sharai ïa la ki langbrot .

translation.en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces , and spread their net over him : he was taken in their pit .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa u ; ki briew ki la ïawan na kylleng sawdong . Ki la phriang ïa la ki jar behmrad bad ki la ïohkem ïa u ha ka jingriam jong ki .

translation.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus : for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied .
translation.kha: Nga sngewkmen shaphang ka jingwan u Stephanas , u Phortunatos , bad u Akhaikos ; ki la bujli ïa ka jingbymdon jong phi bad ki la pynsngewbha ïa nga , kumba ki la pynsngewbha ïa phi .

translation.en: And to masons , and hewers of stone , and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the  Lord  , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .
translation.kha: ki nongtrei maw , bad ki nongshniah maw , ki thied ïa ki dieng sawdong bad ïa ki maw kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingshna pynbha , bad siew ïa ki jingpynlut ba dei baroh .

translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the strangers  ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong ngi ; u ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet , hynrei u leit lam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jong ki .

translation.en: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David : wherefore he came down into a rock , and abode in the wilderness of Maon . And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon .
translation.kha: U Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki mih ban leit wad ïa u , hynrei u la ïohsngew shaphang kata bad u la leit sha u mawsiang lum ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Maon bad u la sah hangta . Haba u Saul u tip ïa kane , u leit beh nadien u Dabid .

translation.en: Yea , ye yourselves know , that these hands have ministered unto my necessities , and to them that were with me .
translation.kha: Phi hi phi ïatip ba nga la trei da kine ki kti jong nga ban pynbiang ïa kaei kaei kaba ki paralok jong nga bad ma nga ngi donkam .

translation.en: Now when these things were thus ordained , the priests went always into the first tabernacle , accomplishing the service of God .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno la buh ryntih ïa kita kiei kiei . Ki lyngdoh ki rung shapoh ka bynta kaba ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ man ka sngi ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki ,

translation.en: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands , and that it brake in pieces the iron , the brass , the clay , the silver , and the gold  ; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter : and the dream is certain , and the interpretation thereof sure .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi kumno u maw u la lait na ka synrang khlem don mano mano ba ktah ïa u bad kumno u la shoh ïa ka durbriew kaba la shna da ka nar , ka rnong , ka dewbyrtha , ka rupa bad ka ksiar . U Blei uba khraw u ïathuh ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka ban sa jia ha ka lawei . Nga la ïathuh thik ïa kaei kaba phi la phohsniew bad nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jingmut bashisha .

translation.en: One Lord , one faith , one baptism ,
translation.kha: Don tang uwei U Trai , kawei ka jingngeit , kawei ka jingpynbaptis ;

translation.en: I lifted up mine eyes again , and looked , and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw nga la ïohi ïa u briew uba don u ksai thew ha ka kti jong u .

translation.en: The governor answered and said unto them , Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you ? They said , Barabbas .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ïa u paidbah ,  Uno na kine ar ngut ba phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ?   Ïa u Barabbas !  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall revile you , and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely , for my sake .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki krenbeiñ bad pynshitom beiñ ïa phi , bad ong bun jait ki jinglamler basniew pyrshah ïa phi namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong nga .

translation.en: And I will set my tabernacle among you : and my soul shall not abhor you .
translation.kha: Ngan shong hapdeng jong phi ha ka ïingjaiñ bakyntang jong nga , bad ngan ym phai noh na phi da lei lei .

translation.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness , and all her paths are peace .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad kan pynsngewtynnat ïa ka jingim jong phi bad ka ai jingsuk lynter ïa phi .

translation.en: So then it is not of him that willeth , nor of him that runneth , but of God that sheweth mercy .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kiei kiei baroh ki shong , ym ha kaei kaba u briew u kwah ne u leh , hynrei tang ha ka jingisynei U Blei .

translation.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks , and into the tops of the ragged rocks , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei , ki briew kin rieh ha ki thliew bad ki krem ha ki mawsiang lum ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar jong u bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore glorify ye the  Lord  in the fires , even the name of the  Lord  God of Israel in the isles of the sea .
translation.kha: bad kito kiba ha mihngi kin ïaroh ïa u . Ki briew kiba im harud ka duriaw kin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la buh nongrim ïa ka nongbah halor ka kam runar bad la tei ïa ka da ka kam pynïap briew .

translation.en: Who , when he had found one pearl of great price , went and sold all that he had , and bought it .
translation.kha: bad haba u la shem ïa uwei uba ikordor tam , u leit bad die lut ïa kaei kaei kaba u la don , bad u thied ïa uta u mawlynnai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days , saith God , I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh : and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , and your young men shall see visions , and your old men shall dream dreams :
translation.kha: ‘ Kane ka long kaei kaba ngan leh ha ki sngi bakhatduh , U Blei u ong : Ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga halor uwei pa uwei baroh . Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki samla shynrang jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw , bad ki rangbah ba la tymmen jong phi kin ïoh ki jingphohsniew .

translation.en: And he prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , I pray thee , O  Lord  , was not this my saying , when I was yet in my country ? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish : for I knew that thou art a gracious God , and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repentest thee of the evil .
translation.kha: Kumta u la duwai ,  A Trai , hato ngam la ong shuwa ba ngan mih na ïing ba kane ka dei kaei kaba men leh ? Dei na kata ka daw ba nga la pyrshang tyngeh ban phet noh sha Spain ! Nga la tip ba me long U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei , uba ïaishah slem , uba sbun borabor , bad uba kloi borabor ban kylla ïa la ka jingmut ban ym pynshitom .

translation.en: I will meditate in thy precepts , and have respect unto thy ways .
translation.kha: Nga pule bniah ïa ki jingbthah jong me , nga bishar bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .

translation.en: So , as much as in me is , I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also .
translation.kha: Kumta te , nga kwah hir hir ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi ruh kiba shong ha Rom .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast forgotten me , and cast me behind thy back , therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Namar pha la klet ïa nga bad pha phai dadien ïa nga , phan sa shahshitom na ka bynta ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ka jingleh nuti jong pha .

translation.en: And take your father and your households , and come unto me : and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and ye shall eat the fat of the land .
translation.kha: Ai ba kin wan ïalam shane ïa u kpa jong phi ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ki ka jaka kaba bha tam ha Ijipt , bad kin ïoh palat ïa kaba ki donkam .

translation.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction , when he heard their cry :
translation.kha: Pynban U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki haba ki kyang , bad u khmih ïa ki jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff , even Bands , that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kdiah ïa u dieng uba ar , uta uba la khot  U Jingtylli ,  bad ïa ka jingtylli jong ka Judah bad ka Israel la pynkhynñiuh .

translation.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given , and no stranger passed among them .
translation.kha: Ym don nongwei ha ka ri jong ki ; ym don u ban ïalam jngai ïa ki na U Blei .

translation.en: And charged them that they should not make him known :
translation.kha: bad u la ai hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh ha kiwei pat shaphang jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore ( as the Holy Ghost saith , To day if ye will hear his voice ,
translation.kha: Kumta te , kumba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong ;  Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi ,

translation.en: So Abner came to David to Hebron , and twenty men with him . And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast .
translation.kha: Haba u Abner u wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron ryngkat bad arphew ngut ki rangbah , u Dabid u pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace  ; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever .
translation.kha: Namar ba uwei pa uwei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei , kan don ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain junom .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely mine oath that he hath despised , and my covenant that he hath broken , even it will I recompense upon his own head .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la smai ha ka kyrteng jong nga ban bat .

translation.en: And the people went out , and spoiled the tents of the Syrians . So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki nong Samaria ki mih shabar bad ki leit lute ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Syria . Bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren , lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli la die ha ka dor shi sbai rupa .

translation.en: And Esther spake yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet , and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite , and his device that he had devised against the Jews .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Esther ka kren biang ha u syiem da kaba dem ha ki kjat jong u bad ïam . Ka kyrpad ïa u ban leh ei ei ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingsylla basniew kaba u Haman , uba hiarpateng na u Agag , pyrshah ïa ki Jiw .

translation.en: And when the people heard these evil tidings , they mourned : and no man did put on him his ornaments .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sdang ban ïambriew bad kim shym deng jingdeng shuh .

translation.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ .
translation.kha: Naba ki ba bun na phi , ba la pynbaptis ha U Khrist , bad la pynkup ïa phi da U Khrist hi .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that like as I have watched over them , to pluck up , and to break down , and to throw down , and to destroy , and to afflict  ; so will I watch over them , to build , and to plant , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumba nga la ïaleh shitom ban rat noh , ban pyntwa , ban jop , ban pynjot bad ban pynpra ïa ki , kumta ruh ngan ïaleh shitom ban thung ïa ki bad ban tei pat ïa ki .

translation.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out , and found others standing idle , and saith unto them , Why stand ye here all the day idle ?
translation.kha: Ka la jan dap artat san baje haba u la leit sha ka jaka ïew bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba dang ïeng hi hangta . ‘ Balei ba phi pynsep-ei ïa ka sngi baroh kawei hangne khlem kam ?’ u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the  Lord  , to be accepted for you : on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it .
translation.kha: Uta un kaweh ïa kata ka song kum ka jingainguh kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  , khnang ba yn pdiang ïa phi . Uta u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei , Thou shalt not die . And the king sware unto him .
translation.kha: Bad u ong ha u Shimei ,  Nga khlei la ka jubanlak ha phi ba phin ym shah pynïap .

translation.en: And ye shall do as I have done : ye shall not cover your lips , nor eat the bread of men .
translation.kha: Nangta phan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh . Phan ym tap ïa la ki khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .

translation.en: And they shall wander from sea to sea , and from the north even to the east , they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the  Lord  , and shall not find it .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïaid sakma na ka Duriaw Baïap sha ka Mediterranian bad nangta shuh shuh na shatei shaduh mihngi . Kin ïakhmih kylleng kylleng ïa ka khubor na U  Trai  , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka .

translation.en: Behold , I stand here by the well of water  ; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water :
translation.kha: Hangne nga don harud kane ka pukri ha kaba ki samla kynthei jong ka nongbah kin sa ïawan tong um .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh : for I have hardened his heart , and the heart of his servants , that I might shew these my signs before him :
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha u Pharaoh . Nga la pynmutlop ïa u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , khnang ba nga lah ban leh ïa kine ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent an angel , which cut off all the mighty men of valour , and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria . So he returned with shame of face to his own land . And when he was come into the house of his god , they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa u angel uba pynap ïa ki shipai bad ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria . Te u patsha u leit phai pat sha Assyria ha ka jinglehrain . Ha kawei ka sngi haba u dang don ha ka templ jong U Blei jong u , katto katne na ki khun shynrang jong u ki la pynïap ïa u da la ki waitlam .

translation.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the  Lord   ; that he might fulfil the word of the  Lord  , which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u la pynkut noh ïa u Abiathar na kaba shakri kum u lyngdoh jong U  Trai  , bad kumta u la pynurlong ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha Shiloh shaphang u Eli , u lyngdoh bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: And the children of Israel , which were come again out of captivity , and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land , to seek the  Lord  God of Israel , did eat ,
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingkñia la bam da baroh ki Israel kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw bad da baroh kito kiba la iehnoh ïa ki rukom mane blei thala jong kiwei pat ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri bad kiba la wan ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And , behold , there was a man named Zacchaeus , which was the chief among the publicans , and he was rich .
translation.kha: La don hangta u nonglum khajna uba ha khlieh duh uba kyrteng , u Sakhaïos , uba riewspah .

translation.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl : and they four had one likeness : and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel .
translation.kha: Ki shalyntem baroh saw tylli ki ïasyriem kumjuh , kawei pa kawei ka phyrnai la kum u mawkordor , bad kawei kawei ka don kawei pat ka shalyntem halor jong ka ha ka liang ka mon ,

translation.en: And it shall be , that in the morning , as soon as the sun is up , thou shalt rise early , and set upon the city : and , behold , when he and the people that is with him come out against thee , then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion .
translation.kha: Khie joit lashai mynstep ha ka por ba mih ka sngi bad pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kynsan halor ka nongbah . Nangta haba u Gaal bad la ki rangbah ki mih shabar pyrshah ïa phi , tied tyngeh ïa ki kat kaba phi lah !

translation.en: Now as I beheld the living creatures , behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures , with his four faces .
translation.kha: Katba nga nang peit ïa kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw , nga la ïohi saw tylli ki shalyntem ba ki hiar ha ka khyndew , kawei kawei marsyndah bad ki .

translation.en: And there was a young man out of Beth–lehem–judah of the family of Judah , who was a Levite , and he sojourned there .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka por la don uwei u samla Lebi uba ju sah ha nongrit Bethlehem kaba ha Judah .

translation.en: I have fed you with milk , and not with meat : for hitherto ye were not able to bear it , neither yet now are ye able .
translation.kha: Nga hap ban bsa ïa phi da ka dud , ym da ka jingbam kaba eh , namar phim pat shym kotbor ïa ka . Bad wat haduh mynta phim pat long kiba kotbor ïa ka , namar phi dang im kumba im ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Swear now therefore unto me by the  Lord  , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me , and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father s house .
translation.kha: Hynrei kular ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba phin ri pynim ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , ba kumta ka kyrteng jong nga bad ka kyrteng ka jait jong nga kan ym jah junom .

translation.en: And they shall see his face  ; and his name shall be in their foreheads .
translation.kha: Kin ïohi ïa ka durkhmat jong u , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong u yn thoh ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .

translation.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed  ; for he giveth of his bread to the poor .
translation.kha: To long sbun bad ïasam ïa ka jingbam jong phi bad kiba duk , phin long kiba la kyrkhu na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And when they were come up out of the water , the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip , that the eunuch saw him no more : and he went on his way rejoicing .
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan kiew na kata ka um , U Mynsiem jong U Trai u la rah noh ïa u Philip . U rangbah synshar um shym la ïohi shuh ïa u , hynrei u la bteng ïa la ka jingleit , uba dap da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And every one that was in distress , and every one that was in debt , and every one that was discontented , gathered themselves unto him  ; and he became a captain over them : and there were with him about four hundred men .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la shah banbeiñ lane kiba dap ram lane kiba kthang mynsiem ki la leit sha u , baroh ki don kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah , bad u kylla long u nongïalam jong ki .

translation.en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled : and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people , and they said , Why have we done this , that we have let Israel go from serving us ?
translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba uta u paidbah u la phet , ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki kylla ka jingmut jong ki , bad ki la ong ,  Ngi la leh aïu ? Ngi la shah ïa ki Israel ba kin phet noh , bad ngi la duh ïa ki kum ki mraw jong ngi !

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ai ka jingnguh sha U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka long bymjukut .

translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families , were three thousand and two hundred .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel ki tam arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut ïa ki Lebi , phi dei ban pyllait pat ïa kine ki khun shynrang kiba tam ,
