translation.en: Then answered Peter , and said unto Jesus , Lord , it is good for us to be here : if thou wilt , let us make here three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la kren bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko Trai , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Lada me mon , ngan shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ hangne , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah .

translation.en: And when she knew Peter s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .
translation.kha: Ka la sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u Petros bad ka la kmen haduh katta katta ba ka la mareh pat shapoh khlem da plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad ka la pynbna ba u Petros u ïeng shabar .

translation.en: And Humtah , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , and Zior  ; nine cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Humtah , ka Hebron , bad ka Sior : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Will ye accept his person ? will ye contend for God ?
translation.kha: Hato me pyrshang ban ïada ïa u ? Hato men leit ban ïasaid ïa ka kam jong u ha ka ïingbishar ?

translation.en: His eyes shall see his destruction , and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki nongpop kin kit hi ïa ka jingpynshitom ; ai ba kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: For I say unto you , Ye shall not see me henceforth , till ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta , nga ong ha pha , phan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga tad haduh ba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong u Trai .’

translation.en: And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,
translation.kha: Ki la lynñiar , ki da khaweh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki da kynting ïa u pui pui sha suiñ .

translation.en: For I have five brethren  ; that he may testify unto them , lest they also come into this place of torment .
translation.kha: Shah ïa u ban leit bad maham ïa ki , khnang ba ma ki , la kumno kumno , kin ym wan sha kane ka jaka ka jingshitom .’

translation.en: So the spirit took me up , and brought me into the inner court  ; and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem U  Trai  u la rah ïa nga sha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh jong ka phyllaw , ha kaba nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ la pyndap da ka burom U  Trai .

translation.en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth , where moth and rust doth corrupt , and where thieves break through and steal :
translation.kha: Wat kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade hangne ha ka pyrthei , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang ki pynjot , bad ki nongtuh ki prong bad ki tuh .

translation.en: Behold that which I have seen : it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink , and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life , which God giveth him : for it is his portion .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba nga la shem : Kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban bam bad ban dih bad ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei ha ka jingim balyngkot kaba U Blei u la ai ïa ngi ; kane ka dei ka kupar jong ngi .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them , When ye have heaved the best thereof from it , then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor , and as the increase of the winepress .
translation.kha: Haba phi la ai ïa kaba bha tam , phi lah ban bat ïa kaba dang sah , kumba u nongrep u bat ïa kaba dang sah hadien ba u la wanrah ïa la ka jingainguh .

translation.en: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields , came to Gedaliah to Mizpah ,
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Johanan bad ki nongïalam jong ki shipai ki bym shym la pyndem ki la wan ha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad ki la ong ha u ,

translation.en: Yet it pleased the  Lord  to bruise him  ; he hath put him to grief : when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin , he shall see his seed , he shall prolong his days , and the pleasure of the  Lord  shall prosper in his hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka dei ka mon jong nga ba un shah pynshitom ; ka jingïap jong u ka long ka jingkñia ban wanrah ïa ka jingmap-ei . Bad kumta un ïohi ïa la ki khun ki ksiew ; un ïoh ïa ka jingim kaba jlan , bad lyngba jong u ïa ka jingthmu jong nga yn pyndep .

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him the same night , and said , I am the God of Abraham thy father : fear not , for I am with thee , and will bless thee , and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham s sake .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong ,  Nga long U Blei jong u kpa jong me u Abraham . Wat sheptieng , nga don ryngkat bad me . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew namar ka jingkular jong nga ïa u shakri jong nga u Abraham .

translation.en: Again , think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you ? we speak before God in Christ : but we do all things , dearly beloved , for your edifying .
translation.kha: Lehse phi pyrkhat ba baroh shi katta ngi la pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong phi . Em! Ngi kren kumba U Khrist un jin da la kwah ïa ngi ban kren ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei , bad baroh kaba ngi leh , ko paralok ba-ieit , la leh ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him .
translation.kha: Shi lynter ka jingim jong u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , namar u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la hikai ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt seek them , and shalt not find them , even them that contended with thee : they that war against thee shall be as nothing , and as a thing of nought .
translation.kha: bad kin jah noh na ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds :
translation.kha: Naba U Blei un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor .
translation.kha: Haba u Sisera u tip ba u Barak u la leit kiew sha u Lum Tabor ,

translation.en: The princes of Judah , and the princes of Jerusalem , the eunuchs , and the priests , and all the people of the land , which passed between the parts of the calf  ;
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki lyngdoh , bad baroh ki nongïalam , ki la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad nga da kaba ïaid hapdeng ar tylli ki shiteng jong u masi kyrtong ïa uba ki la ot ha ki ar bynta . Hynrei ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad kim shym la bat ïa ki kyndon jong ka . Kumta ngan leh ïa kine ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa u masi kyrtong .

translation.en: Who both killed the Lord Jesus , and their own prophets , and have persecuted us ; and they please not God , and are contrary to all men :
translation.kha: kiba la pynïap ïa U Trai Jisu bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi . A kumno ki la long ki bym pynsngewbha ïa U Blei! A kumno ki la long kiba shun iwei ïa iwei!

translation.en: They build up Zion with blood , and Jerusalem with iniquity .
translation.kha: Phi tei ïa ka nongbah jong U Blei , ka Jerusalem , ha ka nongrim jong ka jingpynïap briew bad ka jingbishar bymhok .

translation.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Ki la shem ba la pyntyllun noh ïa u maw na ka jaka rung sha ka jingtep , kumta ki la rung shapoh ;

translation.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us : and the truth of the  Lord  endureth for ever . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khlaiñ bad ka jingïaineh jong u ka long bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And gave their land for an heritage : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jong ki ha ki briew jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: Nay but , O man , who art thou that repliest against God ? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it , Why hast thou made me thus ?
translation.kha: Hynrei phi , phi long uei , ko paralok jong nga , ban jubab kylla ïa U Blei ? U khiew khyndew um lah ban kylli ïa u briew uba la thaw ïa u ,  Balei ba me thaw ïa nga kumne ?

translation.en: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden ? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth : thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword . This is Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: U dieng u dei u syiem ka Ijipt bad ki briew jong u baroh . Wat ki dieng ha Eden kim lah ban jrong ne ban ikhain kum ma u . Hynrei mynta , kum ki dieng ha Eden , un hiar shapoh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad ïasoh lem bad ki bymriewblei bad kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma , nga la kren ,  ong U Trai Nongsynshar .

translation.en: For all the land which thou seest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed for ever .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa ka ri baroh kat kaba me ïohi , bad kan long ka jong me junom .

translation.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast : but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki sumar ïa ki jingri jong ki , hynrei ki riew ba-bymman ki lehbeiñ ïa la ki jong .

translation.en: Let , I pray thee , thy merciful kindness be for my comfort , according to thy word unto thy servant .
translation.kha: Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me kan pyntngen ïa nga , kumba me la kular ïa nga , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another , we took ship  ; and they returned home again .
translation.kha: Nangta ngi la khublei ïakhlad iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ngi la leit kiew ha ka lieng katba ma ki , ki la leit phai sha ïing .

translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  said , The whole land shall be desolate  ; yet will I not make a full end .
translation.kha: ( U  Trai  u la ong ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan kylla long ka ri khlaw , hynrei ba un ym pynjot khoit ïa ka . )

translation.en: And hath not eaten upon the mountains , neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , neither hath defiled his neighbour s wife , neither hath come near to a menstruous woman ,
translation.kha: Um ju mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Israel lane bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana . Um ju khroh pynbieit ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew lane ïathiah shongkha bad ka kynthei ha ka por poi bnai jong ka .

translation.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children , whom I love in the truth  ; and not I only , but also all they that have known the truth  ;
translation.kha: Na u Nongsharai Balang    — Sha ka Kynthei badonburom bad sha ki khun jong ka , ïa kiba nga ieit da shisha . Bad ym dei tang ma nga hi , hynrei baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingshisha ki ieit ïa phi ,

translation.en: Then said the woman , Whom shall I bring up unto thee ? And he said , Bring me up Samuel .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka kylli ,  Ïano ngan khot na ka bynta jong phi ?   Ïa u Samuel ,  u jubab .

translation.en: Wherefore , my beloved brethren , let every man be swift to hear , slow to speak , slow to wrath :
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kane , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! Uwei pa uwei u dei ban long uba kloi ban shahshkor , hynrei uba suki ban kren bad uba suki ban bitar .

translation.en: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka mane blei thala halor ki lum , bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba kah syrngiew , u Ahas u ai jingkñia bad u thang jingiwbih .

translation.en: And I looked , and behold a white cloud , and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man , having on his head a golden crown , and in his hand a sharp sickle .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmih , bad la don u lyoh uba lieh , bad uba shong halor u lyoh u la long uta uba i kum u briew , uba don ka pansngiat ksiar halor ka khlieh jong u bad ka rashi kaba nep ha ka kti jong u .

translation.en: Jesus later appeared to his apostles .
translation.kha: U Jisu hadien  u la mih paw ha ki synran jong u .

translation.en: Behold , it is come , and it is done , saith the Lord  God   ; this is the day whereof I have spoken .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ka sngi ïa kaba nga la kren kan wan da shisha .

translation.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him . And he went into the Pharisee s house , and sat down to meat .
translation.kha: U Pharisi u la khot sngewbha ïa U Jisu ban ïabam miet bad u , bad U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u bad u la shong ban bam .

translation.en: For what purpose do circuit overseers visit the congregations ?
translation.kha: Balei ki nongsharai jylli ki wan ïakynduh ïa ki balang ?

translation.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it  ; the molten image , and a teacher of lies , that the maker of his work trusteth therein , to make dumb idols ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingdonkam jong ka bleithaw ? Ka long tang kaei kaei kaba la thaw da u briew , bad kam kren ei ei hynrei ka shukor . Kaei kaba bha ba ka leh ïa u nongthaw ba un shaniah ha ka — U Blei u bym lah wat ban kren !

translation.en: And Jacob was wroth , and chode with Laban : and Jacob answered and said to Laban , What is my trespass ? what is my sin , that thou hast so hotly pursued after me ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la bitar lep ,  Ka kam sniew aïu ba nga la leh ?  u kylli da ka jingbitar .  Ka aiñ aïu ba nga la pynkheiñ kaba shong hok ha phi ban thwet ïa nga haduh katne ?

translation.en: And the king , and all Israel with him , offered sacrifice before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon bad ki paidbah baroh hangta ki kñia ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: The land of Egypt is before thee  ; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell  ; in the land of Goshen let them dwell : and if thou knowest any men of activity among them , then make them rulers over my cattle .
translation.kha: Ieh kin ïashong ïasah ha Goshen , ka jaka kaba bha tam ha ka ri . Bad lada don napdeng jong ki , ki briew kiba tbit , buh ïa ki ban peit ïa ki jingri jong nga .

translation.en: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate , and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste  ; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki khun ki ksiew u Isaak ki mane Blei yn sa pynjot noh . Ïa ki jaka kyntang jong ki Israel yn sa iehnoh ha ki jingjot . Ngan wallam ïa ka longïing syiem jong u syiem Jeroboam sha ka jingkut .

translation.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor  ; yea , she reacheth forth her hands to the needy .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba sbun ïa kiba duk , bad kiba kyrduh .

translation.en: Job hath spoken without knowledge , and his words were without wisdom .
translation.kha: ba u Job u kren da ka jingbymtip bad kano kano kaba u ong kam don jingmut .

translation.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace , and calling one to another , and saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned to you , and ye have not wept .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat , ‘ Ngi la tem ka jingtem shongkurim na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei phim shym shad ! Ngi la rwai ki jingrwai ïapbriew , hynrei phim shym ïam !’

translation.en: Keep yourselves in the love of God , looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life .
translation.kha: bad to ri ïa lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ha ka jingisynei jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Depart not hence , I pray thee , until I come unto thee , and bring forth my present , and set it before thee . And he said , I will tarry until thou come again .
translation.kha: Wat pat leit tat ynda nga wanrah ha me ka jingainguh bam .  U jubab ,  Ngan ap haduh ba men da wan phai pat .

translation.en: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge : for he taketh a man s life to pledge .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai kylliang ei ei ïano ïano , phim dei ban shim bynda da u mawtylliat kew jong u , namar kata ka long kumba phi shim bynda ïa ka tiar khreh bam kaba kyrshan ïa ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: And the Pharisees also , who were covetous , heard all these things : and they derided him .
translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa U Jisu , namar ba ki ieit ïa ka pisa .

translation.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la pyn-i dak ïa u bad u la ong ,  Kylli ïa u ba u kren shaphang jongno .

translation.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man , which drinketh iniquity like water ?
translation.kha: Bad ngi dih ïa ka jingbymman la kum ba ka dei ka um ; ho-oid , ngi long kiba bamsap ; ngim dondor ei ei .

translation.en: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will , and to agree , and give their kingdom unto the beast , until the words of God shall be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la buh ha ki dohnud jong ki ïa ka mon ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong u da kaba ïatreilang bad da kaba ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong ki ban synshar tad ynda ki ktien jong U Blei ki wan urlong shisha .

translation.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies , and of the ashes , and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron , unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east , shall be holy unto the  Lord   ; it shall not be plucked up , nor thrown down any more for ever .
translation.kha: Ka them baroh kawei , ha kaba la tep ïa kiba ïap bad ha kaba la bret ïa ki jakhlia , bad baroh ki pyntha shaneng ka wah Kidron haduh ka Khyrdop Kulai shaphang mihngi , kin long kiba kyntang ha nga . Ka nongbah kan ym shah pynpra shuh lane shah pynjot .

translation.en: A loving father provides for his family materially and spiritually .
translation.kha: U Blei u khmih lynti ba ki kmie ki kpa kin hikai bad pynbeit ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick : but when the desire cometh , it is a tree of life .
translation.kha: Haba shah khñiot ka jingkyrmen , ka dohnud ruh ka shah khñiot , hynrei ka jingurlong jong ka jingkhmih lynti ka pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: But when the young man heard that saying , he went away sorrowful : for he had great possessions .
translation.kha: Haba u samla u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit noh da kaba sngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah bha .

translation.en: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also , he said unto them ,  Whosoever will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u khot ïa u paidbah bad ïa la ki synran sha u .  Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  u dei ban klet noh ïa lade , bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad bud ïa nga .

translation.en: And I heard another voice from heaven , saying , Come out of her , my people , that ye be not partakers of her sins , and that ye receive not of her plagues .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa kawei pat ka sur na bneng , ka da ong ,  To mihnoh , ko ki briew jong nga ! To mihnoh na ka ! Phim dei ban ïashim bynta ha ki pop jong ka ; phim dei ban ïoh bynta ha ka jingshah pynshitom jong ka !

translation.en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues , that he is the Son of God .
translation.kha: U la leit beit sha ki synagog u la sdang ban ïalap ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you , that our God would count you worthy of this calling , and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness , and the work of faith with power :
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ngi ïai duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei jong ngi ban pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ïa ka jingim kaba u la khot ïa phi ban im . Ai ba un pyndap da ka bor jong u ïa ka jingkwah jong phi baroh na ka bynta ka jingbha bad ban pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ka jingngeit jong phi .

translation.en: Say , I pray thee , thou art my sister : that it may be well with me for thy sake  ; and my soul shall live because of thee .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba pha dei ka para jong nga ; khnang ba na ka bynta jong pha kin shah ïa nga ban im bad lehbha ïa nga .

translation.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded  ; she that bare you shall be ashamed : behold , the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness , a dry land , and a desert .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ka nongbah bakhraw kaba dei ka jong phi yn pynpoh bad pynjahburom . Ka Babilonia kan long ka hima kaba poh tam na baroh ; kan long kaba ryngkhiang bad ka ri shyiap bym don um satia .

translation.en: And she said unto him , My lord , thou swarest by the  Lord  thy God unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Syiem Kynrad , phi la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang ha nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Blessed art thou , Simon Bar–jona : for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee , but my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Kaba bha ïa me , ko Simon u khun jong u Jonah !  la jubab U Jisu .  Naba kane ka jingshisha kam shym la wan ha me na uno uno u briew , hynrei la ai ïa ka ha me beit beit da U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts : for I have chosen him to be my son , and I will be his father .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Dei u Solomon u khun jong me u ban tei ïa ka Templ jong nga . Nga la jied ïa u ban long u khun jong nga , bad nga ngan long u kpa jong u .

translation.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles , and shall be mocked , and spitefully entreated , and spitted on :
translation.kha: Ïa u yn sa aiti noh ha ki Jentil , ki ban ibeiñ ïa u , krenbeiñ ïa u bad bynthiew ïa u .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , what have I to do with thee ? mine hour is not yet come .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban ong ïa nga ïa kaei ba ngan leh ,  U Jisu u la jubab .  Ka por jong nga kam pat poi .

translation.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people : and he shall be , even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth , and thou shalt be to him instead of God .
translation.kha: U un long u nongpynkren lem jong me bad un kren ha u paidbah na ka bynta jong me . Nangta me pat men long kum U Blei , da kaba ïathuh ha u aïu un ong .

translation.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father , that is ours , and our children s : now then , whatsoever God hath said unto thee , do .
translation.kha: Ka spah baroh kaba U Blei u la shim noh na i pa jong ngi ka dei ka jong ngi bad jong ki khun jong ngi . To leh katba U Blei u la bthah ïa phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn , saying , Surely as I have thought , so shall it come to pass  ; and as I have purposed , so shall it stand :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la smai ka jingsmai :  Kaei kaba nga la thmu kan jia . Kaei kaba nga la kut jingmut ban leh yn pyndep .

translation.en: And I , brethren , when I came to you , came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom , declaring unto you the testimony of God .
translation.kha: Haba nga la wan sha phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban ïalap ïa ka jingshisha barieh jong U Blei , ngam shym la pyndonkam da ki kyntien kiba eh bad ka jingtip kaba khraw .

translation.en: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers , even with the kings of Israel  ; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem , bad u khun jong u , u Sekharaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood , and led him throughout all the land of Canaan , and multiplied his seed , and gave him Isaac .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi , na ka ri kaba sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis bad nga ïalam ïa u lyngba ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei . Nga la ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Nga la ai ha u ïa u Isaak ,

translation.en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation , and of Egypt their glory .
translation.kha: Kito kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha ka Sudan bad kiba la kob sarong shaphang ka Ijipt kin shaïong jingmut ; la pynkhih ïa ki jingkyrmen jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  rejected all the seed of Israel , and afflicted them , and delivered them into the hand of spoilers , until he had cast them out of his sight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyntait ïa ki Israel baroh , u pynshitom ïa ki bad u aiti noh ïa ki sha ki nongshun barunar haduh ha kaba khatduh ban pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u .

translation.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast : seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan , ka sngi ha kaba ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba neh hynñiew sngi ka sdang ; ha kata ka por dei ban bam tang ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat .

translation.en: And when they shall have finished their testimony , the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them , and shall overcome them , and kill them .
translation.kha: Haba ki dep ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ki , uta u mradkhlaw uba wan kiew na ka liewlong ba khlem trai un ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky  ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?
translation.kha: Bad dang step phyrngab phi ong , ‘ Kan sa slap , namar ba ka suiñbneng ka saw bad ka dum .’ Phi lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglong ka suiñbneng da kaba khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , hynrei phim lah ban batai ïa ki dak kiba ïadei bad kine ki por !

translation.en: As a fountain casteth out her waters , so she casteth out her wickedness : violence and spoil is heard in her  ; before me continually is grief and wounds .
translation.kha: Kumba ka pukri ka pynneh sngur ïa ka um jong ka , kumta ruh ka Jerusalem ka pynneh ïa ka jingsniew jong ka . Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingpynjot hapoh ka nongbah , ka jingpang bad ki jingmong ki long baroh kiba nga ïohi .

translation.en: Again he said , Therefore hear the word of the  Lord   ; I saw the  Lord  sitting upon his throne , and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u ong shuh :  Mynta sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u shong halor ka khet jong u ha bneng , ryngkat bad baroh ki angel jong u kiba ïeng harud jong u .

translation.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .
translation.kha: U pynkylla ki pung-um ïa ki ri shyiap bad pynmih umpohliew ha ki jaka ba-rkhiang .

translation.en: For I will have respect unto you , and make you fruitful , and multiply you , and establish my covenant with you .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa phi bad ngan ai ha phi shibun ki khun ; ngan pynskhem ïa ka bynta ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la pynlong bad phi .

translation.en: And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .
translation.kha: ( Uta uba la ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia u la kren shaphang jong ka , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin ïoh ngeit . Kaei kaba u la ong ka long kaba shisha , bad u tip ba u kren ïa ka jingshisha . )

translation.en: Then said I , Lord , how long ? And he answered , Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant , and the houses without man , and the land be utterly desolate ,
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ,  Sa katno kan long kumne , ko  Trai  ?  U la jubab ,  Tad haduh ba ki nongbah kin jot kin pra bad long thylli — tad haduh ba ki ïing kin long ïingjah — tad haduh ba ka ri hi kan long ka jaka thylli kaba kynjah .

translation.en: And they came to Elim , where were twelve wells of water , and threescore and ten palm trees : and they encamped there by the waters .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la wan poi ha Elim , ha kaba la don khat-ar tylli ki umpohliew bad hynñiewphew tylli ki dieng Tlai ; bad hangta ki la ïasher dara harud um .

translation.en: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the  Lord  to accomplish his vow , or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep , it shall be perfect to be accepted  ; there shall be no blemish therein .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u kñia ïa ka jingainguh pynïasuk sha U  Trai  , la ka long ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha , kata ka jingainguh kam dei ban don kano kano ka jingduna khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa ka .

translation.en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab , every one shall howl : for the foundations of Kir–hareseth shall ye mourn  ; surely they are stricken .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Moab kin lynñiar namar ki jingjynjar ba ki shah . Baroh kin ïam haba ki kynmaw ïa ka jingbam babha kaba ki ju bam ha ka nongbah jong ka Kir Heres . Yn beh ïa ki baroh sha ka jingduh jingkyrmen .

translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have set a fire in Egypt , and when all her helpers shall be destroyed .
translation.kha: Haba nga tbeh ding ha ka Ijipt bad ïa ki nongkyrshan jong ka baroh yn pynïap , te ki tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way , when ye came forth out of Egypt  ; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia , to curse thee .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ban ai jingbam bad ai um ïa phi mynba phi don ha lynti na Ijipt , bad ki la khot wai ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba na ka shnong Pethor ha Mesopotamia , ban tim ïa phi .

translation.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel , and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies . Also the  Lord  telleth thee that he will make thee an house .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ka jaka ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad nga la pynsah ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kin im khlem da shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh ba ki rung sha kane ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh ha ki riewrunar , hynrei kane kan ym jia shuh . Nga kular ban sumar ïa me na ki nongshun jong me baroh bad ban ai ha me ki khun ki ksiew .

translation.en: O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .
translation.kha: Ko Pa Bahok ! Ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa me , hynrei nga ithuh ïa me , bad kine ki tip ba me la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And men were scorched with great heat , and blasphemed the name of God , which hath power over these plagues : and they repented not to give him glory .
translation.kha: La thang ïa ki da ka jingshit tyrha kaba jur , bad ki la tim ïa ka kyrteng jong U Blei , uba don ka bor halor kine ki khlam . Hynrei kim shym phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .

translation.en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil , and choose the good , the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings .
translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kata ka por kan wan , ïa ki ri jong kito ki ar ngut ki syiem kiba la pynshyrkhei ïa phi yn iehnoh .

translation.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground  ; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth ?
translation.kha: Mano ba ai um ïa ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad kaba thynrang , ba kumta u phlang u mih ?

translation.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt , which the head or tail , branch or rush , may do .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ha Ijipt , uba riewspah ne uba duk , uba donnam ne u bym donnam , uba lah ban tyrwa ban ïarap .

translation.en: So speak ye , and so do , as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty .
translation.kha: To kren bad to leh kum ki briew ïa kiba yn sa bishar da ka hukum kaba pyllaitluid ïa ngi .

translation.en: Even all that the  Lord  hath commanded you by the hand of Moses , from the day that the  Lord  commanded Moses , and henceforward among your generations  ;
translation.kha: Bad lehse hadien habud ka kynhun kam lah ban leh lut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave  ; and they mourned over him , saying , Alas , my brother !
translation.kha: U tep ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep jong ka longïing jong u hi , bad ma u bad la ki khun shynrang ki ïam sngewsih ïa ka , ki da ong ,  O u para jong nga , u para jong nga !

translation.en: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren , and that he turn not aside from the commandment , to the right hand , or to the left : to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom , he , and his children , in the midst of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kumta un ym sngew ba u kham halor ban ïa la ki para Israel bad un ym lyndet da kumno kumno ruh ïa ki hukum U  Trai . Te un synshar bun snem , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u ruh kin ïoh synshar bun pateng ha Israel .

translation.en: Then went the captain with the officers , and brought them without violence : for they feared the people , lest they should have been stoned .
translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la leit noh bad ki rangbah jong u bad wallam pat ïa ki apostol . Kim shym la pyndonkam ïa ka bor , namar ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ki paidbah ki lah ban lynthem maw ïa ki .

translation.en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne , even as I also overcame , and am set down with my Father in his throne .
translation.kha: Ha kito kiba ïoh ïa ka jingjop ngan ai ïa ka hok ban shong ha syndah jong nga ha ka khet jong nga , kumba nga ruh nga la jop bad mynta nga shong ha syndah U Kpa jong nga ha ka khet jong u .

translation.en: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison  ; and whatsoever they did there , he was the doer of it .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa u Joseph ban khmih ïa kiwei pat ki koidi kiba don hangta , bad u la buh jingkitkhlieh ha u ïa kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba la ju leh hangta .

translation.en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him : and he dipped his finger in the blood , and put it upon the horns of the altar , and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , bad u wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka , bad u tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad u theh ïa kaba sah baroh ha trai ka duwan .

translation.en: And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la sdang ban kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor jong ki kumba ka la long halor jong ngi ha kaba sdang .

translation.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth–aven : for the people thereof shall mourn over it , and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it , for the glory thereof , because it is departed from it .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka nongbah jong ka Samaria kin sheptieng bad ïam sngewsih namar ka jingduh noh ïa u masi ksiar ha Bethel . Ma ki bad kita ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ïa u bleithaw kin ïam sngewsih namar jong u . Kin sa ïam pangnud haba yn law lyngkhuit ïa ka jingthaba rong ksiar jong u .

translation.en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof  ; because they have transgressed the laws , changed the ordinance , broken the everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa ka pyrthei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei bad da kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong ban neh junom .

translation.en: And as they sat and did eat , Jesus said ,  Verily I say unto you , One of you which eateth with me shall betray me .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha ka miej ban ïabam , U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ïa phi , ba uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga — uta uba dang ïabam bad nga .

translation.en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha , that is to say , a place of a skull ,
translation.kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , kaba mut  Ka jaka ka Maloi khlieh .

translation.en: And they said , Arise , that we may go up against them : for we have seen the land , and , behold , it is very good : and are ye still ? be not slothful to go , and to enter to possess the land .
translation.kha: Ale ïeng ,  ki pynphai ktien ,  Ïa ngin leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Laish . Ngi la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka , bad ka long kaba seisoh bha . Wat shong hangne khlem leh ei ei ; pynkloi ! Leit rung shapoh bad dakhol ïa ka !

translation.en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again .
translation.kha: khnang ba haba nga don pat bad phi , phin don wat kham bun ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa nga ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which he shall offer unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok ïa kiba wanrah sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto you  ; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes , lying in a manger .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei ka ban pynshisha ïa kata ha phi : Phin shem ïa u khunlung uba la sop da ki jaiñsop bad uba thiah ha ka shyngoid .

translation.en: The lips of those that rose up against me , and their device against me all the day .
translation.kha: Baroh shi sngi ki ïakren shaphang jong nga bad ki thaw ki jingthmu jong ki .

translation.en: Destruction and death say , We have heard the fame thereof with our ears .
translation.kha: Wat ka jingïap bad ka jingpynjot ki ong ba ki la ïohsngew tang ki hamsaïa .

translation.en: Then Amaziah separated them , to wit , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim , to go home again : wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah , and they returned home in great anger .
translation.kha: Kumta u Amasaïah u la phah noh ïa ki kynhun shipai ba la shim wai bad u ong ïa ki ban leit noh sha ïing . Ha kane ki la leit sha ïing , ki da bitar tyngeh ïa ki briew ka Judah .

translation.en: And he went unto his father s house at Ophrah , and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal , being threescore and ten persons , upon one stone : notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left  ; for he hid himself .
translation.kha: U leit sha ïing u kpa jong u ha Ophrah , bad hangta ha khlieh jong uwei u maw u la pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon . Hynrei u Jotham , u khun khatduh jong u Gideon , u la rieh bad um shym la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And they put him in ward , that the mind of the  Lord  might be shewed them .
translation.kha: Ki set ïa u , bad ki ap haduh ba U  Trai  un ïathuh ïa ki kumno yn leh ïa u .

translation.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God ? he hath said in his heart , Thou wilt not require it .
translation.kha: Kumno u riewbymman u ibeiñ ïa U Blei bad ong ha lade ,  Un ym pynshitom ïa nga ?

translation.en: It is not in heaven , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go up for us to heaven , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?
translation.kha: Kam don hangtei ha sahit bneng . Phim donkam ban da ong , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit kiew shatei bad wallam ïa ka shane sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’

translation.en: But they were terrified and affrighted , and supposed that they had seen a spirit .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewshyrkhei , da kaba pyrkhat ba ki ïohi ïa ka rngai .

translation.en: Then saith he to his servants , The wedding is ready , but they which were bidden were not worthy .
translation.kha: Nangta u la khot ïa la ki shakri bad u la ong ha ki , ‘ La dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong nga , hynrei ki briew kiba nga la khot sngewbha kim don hok ban ïoh ïa ka .

translation.en: And he that blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , he shall surely be put to death , and all the congregation shall certainly stone him : as well the stranger , as he that is born in the land , when he blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba shong ha Israel uba krenbeiñ ïa U  Trai  un shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: He hath swallowed down riches , and he shall vomit them up again : God shall cast them out of his belly .
translation.kha: U briew uba sniew u prie noh ïa ka spah ba u la tuh ; U Blei u shim pat ïa ka , wat na ka kpoh jong u .

translation.en: These are also proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .
translation.kha: Hangne ki don shuh ki proberb u Solomon , ba la thoh da ki briew ha ka ïingbishar u Hesekaïah u syiem Judah .

translation.en: And the king sware , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress ,
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ka ,  Nga kular ïa pha da U  Trai  uba im , uba la pyllait im ïa nga na ki jingjynjar baroh ,

translation.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land , and many countries shall be overthrown : but these shall escape out of his hand , even Edom , and Moab , and the chief of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Un hiarthma wat ïa ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un pynïap da ki phew hajar , hynrei ki ri Edom , Moab , bad kaei kaba la iehnoh jong ka Ammon kin lait .

translation.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own , and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made , every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba la shong la sah ha Samaria ki ïai bteng ban thaw ïa la ki bleithaw , bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jaka mane kiba ki Israel ki la tei . Kawei pa kawei ka kynhun ka la thaw ïa ki bleithaw ha ki nongbah ha kiba ki shong ki sah :

translation.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ki dkhot jong ki balang ha Judia kim pat ithuh ïa nga markhmat .

translation.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father . Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew jong U Blei kin tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ha ka Hima jong U Kpa jong ki . To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: As for me , behold , I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans , which will come unto us : but ye , gather ye wine , and summer fruits , and oil , and put them in your vessels , and dwell in your cities that ye have taken .
translation.kha: Ma nga hi ngan sah ha Mispah bad ngan long u nongmihkhmat jong phi haba ki nong Babilonia kin wan shane . Hynrei phi lah ban lum bad kynshew ïa ka waiñ , ki soh , bad ka umphniang Olib , bad ban shong ban sah ha la ki shnongrit ba phi don .

translation.en: And he departed thence , and entered into a certain man s house , named Justus , one that worshipped God , whose house joined hard to the synagogue .
translation.kha: Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit sah noh ha ka ïing jong u Jentil uba kyrteng u Titius Justos , uba mane ïa U Blei ; ka ïing jong u ka don ha syndah jong ka synagog .

translation.en: The young man saith unto him , All these things have I kept from my youth up : what lack I yet ?
translation.kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh ,  u samla u la jubab .  Sa kaei pat ba nga donkam ban leh ?

translation.en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha , Behold , I pray thee , the situation of this city is pleasant , as my lord seeth : but the water is naught , and the ground barren .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki rangbah na Jerikho ki la leit sha u Elisha , bad ki ong ,  Kumba phi tip , ko kynrad , kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba itynnat , hynrei ka um ka sniew bad ka wanrah ki jinghap khun .

translation.en: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon , who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land , God left him , to try him , that he might know all that was in his heart .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u ïoh jingjop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , bad wat haba ki nonglamktien ka Babilon ki wan ban kylli shaphang ki jingjia bym ju kham jia kiba jia ha ka ri , U Blei u shah ba u Hesekaïah un leit ha la ka lynti tang ban tynjuh ïa ka jinglong jong u .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us  ; for it hath heard all the words of the  Lord  which he spake unto us : it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .
translation.kha: U ong ha u paidbah baroh ,  Une u maw un long u sakhi ïa ngi . U la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien baroh ba U  Trai  u la kren ha ngi . Kumta un long u sakhi pyrshah ïa phi , ban da ïa phi na kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And they shall eat up thine harvest , and thy bread , which thy sons and thy daughters should eat : they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds : they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees : they shall impoverish thy fenced cities , wherein thou trustedst , with the sword .
translation.kha: Kin bam duh ïa ki jingthung bad ïa ki jingbam jong phi ; kin pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi . Kin pynïap ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi jong phi bad pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad diengsoh Dumbur jong phi . Ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh ha kiba phi shaniah yn pynjot da ka kynhun shipai jong ki .

translation.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .
translation.kha: U mane ïa ka Astarte ka blei ki Sidon , bad ïa u Molekh u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .

translation.en: And he brought forth his people with joy , and his chosen with gladness :
translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam noh ïa ki briew ba la jied jong u , bad ki rwai bad pyrta da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Whom dost thou pass in beauty ? go down , and be thou laid with the uncircumcised .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki :  Hato me tharai ba me kham bhabriew ban ïano ïano ruh ? Men leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad thiah hangta hapdeng ki bymriewblei .

translation.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them , and told Absalom : but they went both of them away quickly , and came to a man s house in Bahurim , which had a well in his court  ; whither they went down .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi , jia ryngkhat uwei u khynnah u ïohi ïa ki , bad u leit ïathuh ha u Absalom ; kumta ki la leit bran bran ban rieh ha ka ïing jong uwei u briew ha Bahurim . U don ka pukri hajan ka ïing jong u , bad ki hiar shapoh jong ka .

translation.en: From Aroer , which is by the bank of the river Arnon , even unto mount Sion , which is Hermon ,
translation.kha: Kane ka ri ka ïar naduh ka shnong Aroer harud ka wah Arnon haduh u lum Seïon ( Sirion ) shaphang shatei , ( kaba mut , u lum Hermon . )

translation.en: And by reason hereof he ought , as for the people , so also for himself , to offer for sins .
translation.kha: Bad namar ma u hi u long uba tlot , u dei ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ym tang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew hynrei namar ki pop jong u ruh .

translation.en: And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying ,  This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , bad U la ainguh ha U Blei , U la kdiah ïa u , bad U la ai ïa u ha ki , da kaba ong ,  Une u long ka met jong nga , ïa kaba la ai na ka bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .

translation.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness .
translation.kha: bad haduh sawphew snem u la ïaishah bad ki ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: If there be a controversy between men , and they come unto judgment , that the judges may judge them  ; then they shall justify the righteous , and condemn the wicked .
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki Israel ki ïakajia , bad ki leit sha ka ïingbishar , ki nongbishar kin rai pynksan ïa uba hok bad pynrem ïa uba leh palat .

translation.en: Now if we be dead with Christ , we believe that we shall also live with him :
translation.kha: Namar ba ngi la ïap bad U Khrist , ngi ngeit ba ngin im ruh bad u .

translation.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness , and maketh collops of fat on his flanks .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u long uba sarong bad uba ïaleh pyrshah ; u bat ïa la ka stieh ha ka jingmutlop bad u tur ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin . And Saul numbered the people that were present with him , about six hundred men .
translation.kha: U Samuel u mihnoh na Gilgal bad u leit la ka lynti . Kiba sah na ki briew ki la bud ïa u Saul katba u dang leit ban ïasoh bad la ki shipai . Ki leit na Gilgal sha Gibeah ha ka thain Benjamin . U Saul u leit peit ïa la ka kynhun shipai , kiba don kumba hynriewspah ngut .

translation.en: And David girded his sword upon his armour , and he assayed to go  ; for he had not proved it . And David said unto Saul , I cannot go with these  ; for I have not proved them . And David put them off him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u bsuh ïa ka waitlam u Saul ha kata ka jingkieng atiar bad u pyrshang ban ïaid , hynrei um lah , namar ba um ju mlien ban phong ïa kita .  Ngam lah ban leit ïaleh ryngkat bad kine ,  u ong ïa u Saul .  Ngam ju mlien ïa ki .  Kumta u loit noh ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: That thou mightest fear the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command thee , thou , and thy son , and thy son s son , all the days of thy life  ; and that thy days may be prolonged .
translation.kha: Katba phi dang im , ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi , phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi , khnang ba phi lah ban im slem ha kata ka ri .

translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
translation.kha: shihajar laispah hynriewphew san shekel ka rupa ,

translation.en: And a man s uncle shall take him up , and he that burneth him , to bring out the bones out of the house , and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house , Is there yet any with thee ? and he shall say , No . Then shall he say , Hold thy tongue : for we may not make mention of the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U ba-ha-ïing jong u briew uba ïap , uta uba dei khmih ïa ka jingleit ontep , un sei shabar ïa ka metïap na ka ïing . Uba ha ïing un khot ïa uno uno ba dang sah hapoh ïing ,  Dang don mano mano bad phi hangto ?  Ka sur kan jubab ,  Em !  nangta u ba-ha-ïing un sa ong ,  Sngap jar ! Ngi dei ban sumar wat ban ym ong ei ei ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai .

translation.en: I will also smite mine hands together , and I will cause my fury to rest : I the  Lord  have said it .
translation.kha: Nga ruh ngan thab ïa la ki kti , bad ka jingbitar jong nga kan jah noh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats  hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle : eleven curtains shalt thou make .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap na ka bynta ka Ïingjaiñ na ki khatwei tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang .

translation.en: And they saw the God of Israel : and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone , and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness .
translation.kha: bad ki ïohi ïa U Blei ki Israel . Hapoh ki sla jat jong u , la don kaei kaba i kum ka jingsiang da u mawkordor Sapphir , kaba jngum kum ka suiñbneng .

translation.en: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness , and his chambers by wrong  ; that useth his neighbour s service without wages , and giveth him not for his work  ;
translation.kha: Long ba la tim ïa u briew uba tei ïa la ka ïing da ka jingbymhok , bad uba pynheh pynïar ïa ka da ka jingleh bymhok ; uba pynlong ïa la ki para shnong ban trei khlem kam , bad u bym siew bainong ïa ki .

translation.en: Though they bring up their children , yet will I bereave them , that there shall not be a man left : yea , woe also to them when I depart from them !
translation.kha: Hynrei wat la ki ïoh pynheh pynsan ïa la ki khun , ngan shim noh ïa ki bad ngan ym pynsah im uwei ruh . Haba ngan iehnoh noh ïa kine ki briew , kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin wan jia ha ki .

translation.en: It was foursquare  ; they made the breastplate double : a span was the length thereof , and a span the breadth thereof , being doubled .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba sawdong bad kaba la khylliap ar syrtap . Ka don arphew ar sentimitar ka lynter bad arphew ar sentimitar ka jingïar .

translation.en: Therefore now thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls , to cut off from you man and woman , child and suckling , out of Judah , to leave you none to remain  ;
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , mynta nga kylli ba balei phi leh kum kata ka kam kaba sniew ïa lade . Hato phi kwah ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha ki rangbah bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , khnang ba yn ym don na ki briew jong phi ban dang sah ?

translation.en: But they rebelled , and vexed his holy Spirit : therefore he was turned to be their enemy , and he fought against them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynsngewsih ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong u . Namar kata U  Trai  u la kylla long u nongshun jong ki bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , and Shebna , and Joah , unto Rab–shakeh , Speak , I pray thee , to thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and talk not with us in the Jews  language in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joah ki ïathuh ïa u rangbah synshar ,  Kren ha ka ktien Aramaik ïa ngi , ko kynrad . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïasngap .

translation.en: Lying lips are abomination to the  Lord  : but they that deal truly are his delight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa kiba lamler , hynrei u sngewbha ïa kito kiba bat ïa la ka ktien .

translation.en: As the holy flock , as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts  ; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba mynta ki don ha ka jingjot kin sa dap da ki paidbah kumba ka Jerusalem shisien ka ju dap da ki langbrot ba la wanrah kum ki jingkñia ha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking , that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand , and called that place Ramath–lehi .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u bret noh ïa kata ka shyieng tyngam . Ka jaka ha kaba kane ka la jia la ai kyrteng ka Ramath Lehi .

translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Come , I pray thee , I will bring thee unto another place  ; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence .
translation.kha: U Balak u ong ,  Ale bad nga , bad ngan ïalam ïa phi sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse U Blei un shah ïa phi ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga nangta .

translation.en: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal  ; and , behold , I will come down unto thee , to offer burnt offerings , and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings : seven days shalt thou tarry , till I come to thee , and shew thee what thou shalt do .
translation.kha: Men nang leit sha khmat jong nga sha Gilgal ; ha kaba ngan ïashem bad me ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ap hangta hynñiew sngi haduh ba ngan da wan bad ïathuh ha me kaei ba men leh .

translation.en: And he said unto them , This is that which the  Lord  hath said , To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the  Lord  : bake that which ye will bake to day , and seethe that ye will seethe  ; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ba lashai ka dei ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynkyrpang sha u . Shet mynta kat ïa kaba phi dei ban shet , bad pynthnam kat ïa kaba phi dei ban pynthnam . Sa buh kyrpang kat ïa kaba tam bad tyngkai ïa ka na ka bynta lashai .

translation.en: Then came one and told them , saying , Behold , the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple , and teaching the people .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei u briew u la wan rung shapoh bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor ! Ki briew kiba phi la buh ha byndi ki don ha ka Templ , ki da hikai ïa ki paidbah !

translation.en: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy ground , and the fruit of thy cattle , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ba phin roi kyrhai ha ki khun ki kti , ba ki jingthung jong phi kin seisoh shibun , bad ba ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi kin nang bun .

translation.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation  ; and give him a charge in their sight .
translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa u ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad u paidlang baroh , bad hangta ha khmat jong ki baroh to pynbna ba ma u un long u nongmih bujli jong me .

translation.en: And Tamar put ashes on her head , and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her , and laid her hand on her head , and went on crying .
translation.kha: Ka la ber dpei ha la ka khlieh , ka la kad ïa la ka sopti jynsur , bad da kaba buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat da kaba tap da ki kti ka la leit noh da kaba ïam .

translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , An eye for an eye , and a tooth for a tooth :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ka khmat namar ka khmat , bad ka bniat namar ka bniat .’

translation.en: And I say unto you my friends , Be not afraid of them that kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , ki paralok jong nga , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynrei ki bym lah hadien ban leh ïa kano kano kaba kham sniew .

translation.en: For they went and served other gods , and worshipped them , gods whom they knew not , and whom he had not given unto them :
translation.kha: Ki la shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei ba kim ju mane mynno mynno , bad ïa kiba U  Trai  u la adong ïa ki ban mane .

translation.en: He taketh it with his eyes : his nose pierceth through snares .
translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong u bad kem ïa u ? lane mano ba lah ban kem ïa ka khmut jong u ha ka jingriam ?

translation.en: For , lo , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and no razor shall come on his head : for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb : and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: bad hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong pha , wat pyndei syrti ha ka khlieh jong u , namar na ka sngi ba la kha ïa u un long uba la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir . Un sdang ïa ka kam ban pyllait ïa ki Israel na ki Philistia .

translation.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people , that they might send them out of the land in haste  ; for they said , We be all dead men .
translation.kha: Kita ki nong Ijipt ki la kyrpad jur ïa ki Israel ban pynstet bad mihnoh na kata ka ri .  Ngin sa ïap lut lada phim leit noh ,  ki ong .

translation.en: And Asa cried unto the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , it is nothing with thee to help , whether with many , or with them that have no power : help us , O  Lord  our God  ; for we rest on thee , and in thy name we go against this multitude . O  Lord  , thou art our God  ; let not man prevail against thee .
translation.kha: U Asa u duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u ,  A  Trai  , me lah ban ïarap ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba tlot da kaba suk kum kaba khlaiñ . Ïarap ïa ngi mynta , Ko  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , namar ba ngi shaniah ha me , bad ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la mih ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka kynhun shipai kaba bun . A  Trai  , me long U Blei jong ngi ; ym don u ban kyrmen ban jop ïa me .

translation.en: The tabernacle , his tent , and his covering , his taches , and his boards , his bars , his pillars , and his sockets ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ka jingsop jong ka bad ka jingsop kaba shabar jong ka , ïa ki bnoh bad ïa ki jingker jong ka ; ïa ki diengkhap , ki rishot , bad ki thliew tnaw jong ka ;

translation.en: There they made him a supper  ; and Martha served : but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkhreh ka jingbam miet ïa u hangta , ha kaba ka Martha ka la ïarap ban sam ; u Lasaros u long uwei na kito kiba la ïashong bam ha ka miej lem bad U Jisu .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah , first and last , behold , are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel ?
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kiwei kiwei pat kiba u Amasaïah u la leh naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut ka jingsynshar jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel

translation.en: And the taskmasters hasted them , saying , Fulfil your works , your daily tasks , as when there was straw .
translation.kha: Ki nongpyntrei mraw ki ïai pyrshang ban pynbor ïa ki ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la shna mynba dang ai phlangïap ïa ki .

translation.en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy : he stood with his right hand as an adversary , and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion : he poured out his fury like fire .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba wan sha ka Templ mynta ban mane ha ki sngi bakhuid . Ki kynthei samla kiba rwai hangta ki shahshitom , bad ki lyngdoh ki lah tang ban shu ud . Ki khyrdop ka nongbah ki ïeng thylli , bad ka Seïon ka don ha ka jingkordit .

translation.en: When the men were come unto him , they said , John Baptist hath sent us unto thee , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki la ong ,  U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la phah ïa ngi ban kylli lada me long Uta Uba u la ong ba Un wan ne lada ngi dei ban khmih lynti ïa Uwei pat .

translation.en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men , but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ha kaba shabar phi i kumba phi bha ïa baroh , hynrei shapoh phi dap da ka jingarsap bad ki pop .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be seen over them , and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning : and the Lord  God  shall blow the trumpet , and shall go with whirlwinds of the south .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un mihpaw halor ki briew jong u ; un siat ïa ki khnam jong u kum ka leilieh . U  Trai  Nongsynshar un pynsawa ïa ka turoi ; un ïaid ha ki  erïong na shathie .

translation.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth  ; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully  ; they have gathered themselves together against me .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ñiewbeiñ ïa nga ; ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga bad ki thap ïa nga .

translation.en: And David said to Ittai , Go and pass over . And Ittai the Gittite passed over , and all his men , and all the little ones that were with him .
translation.kha: Ka biang !  u Dabid u la jubab .  Dang ïaid sha khmat !  Kumta u Ittai u la ïaid sha khmat bad la ki rangbah jong u lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years .
translation.kha: U Jehu u la synshar arphew phra snem ha Samaria kum u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: And they took them out of the midst of the tent , and brought them unto Joshua , and unto all the children of Israel , and laid them out before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki wanrah ïa ki shabar ka ïingjaiñ , ki leit lam ïa ki sha u Joshua bad sha kita ki Israel baroh , bad ki buh ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: Then I said , I have laboured in vain , I have spent my strength for nought , and in vain : yet surely my judgment is with the  Lord  , and my work with my God .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Nga la trei , hynrei katno ka long kaba duh jingkyrmen ! Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym lah ban pyndep ei ei .  Pynban nga lah ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban kyrshan na ka bynta jong nga ; un ai bainong ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga leh .

translation.en: And he said , All is well . My master hath sent me , saying , Behold , even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets : give them , I pray thee , a talent of silver , and two changes of garments .
translation.kha: Em ,  u Gehasi u jubab .  Hynrei u kynrad jong nga u la phah ïa nga ba dang myntan ar ngut na ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka ri lum Ephraim ki la wan poi , bad u kwah ïa phi ban ai ha ki lai hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa bad ar riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .

translation.en: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab  ; the howling thereof unto Eglaim , and the howling thereof unto Beer–elim .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ki pud jong ka Moab la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang . La ïohsngew ha ki shnong jong ka Eglaim bad Beerelim .

translation.en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement .
translation.kha: Kane ka phyllaw kaba habar ka long kham hapoh ban ïa ka phyllaw kaba hapoh . Ka la don ka khyrdop kham hajrong kaba lam sha ka phyllaw kaba hapoh .

translation.en: And this is love , that we walk after his commandments . This is the commandment , That , as ye have heard from the beginning , ye should walk in it .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingieit kaba nga kren ka mut ba ngin ïaid ha ka jingkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei . Ka hukum , kumba phi baroh phi la ïohsngew naduh mynnyngkong , ka long ba baroh phi dei ban ïa-ïaid ha ka jingieit .

translation.en: Today , Jehovah is preparing millions of people for life in the future Paradise on earth .
translation.kha: Mynta ruh U Jehobah u dang ïai pynkhreh da ki phew lak ngut ki briew ban ïoh im ha paradais .

translation.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees , and told them what things Jesus had done .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na ki , ki la leit sha ki Pharisi bad ki la ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh .

translation.en: And if we know that he hear us , whatsoever we ask , we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him .
translation.kha: U ïohsngew ïa ngi man ba ngi kyrpad ïa u ; bad namar ba ngi tip ba kane ka long kaba shisha , ngi tip ruh ba u ai ha ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi kyrpad na u .

translation.en: He that hideth hatred with lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander , is a fool .
translation.kha: U briew uba buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun u dei uba lamler . Uno uno uba pynphriang ïa ka jinglorni u dei uba bieit .

translation.en: For if there be first a willing mind , it is accepted according to that a man hath , and not according to that he hath not .
translation.kha: Lada phi thrang ban ai , U Blei un pdiang ïa ka jingai jong phi ha ka nongrim jong kaei kaba phi dei ban ai , ym halor kaei kaba phim don .

translation.en: Behold Israel after the flesh : are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar ?
translation.kha: To pyrkhat ïa ki paid Israel ; kito kiba bam ïa kaei kaba la kñia ki ïoh bynta ha ka jingshakri ha ka duwan sha U Blei .

translation.en: In hope of eternal life , which God , that cannot lie , promised before the world began ;
translation.kha: kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingkyrmen ïa ka jingim bymjukut . U Blei , u bym ju shukor , u la kular ïa ngi ïa kane ka jingim naduh mynnyngkong ,

translation.en: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time , and numbered all Israel .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , u syiem Joram u mihnoh na Samaria bad u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u baroh .

translation.en: And he that was dead came forth , bound hand and foot with graveclothes : and his face was bound about with a napkin . Jesus saith unto them ,  Loose him , and let him go .
translation.kha: U Lasaros u la mihnoh , ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u la kyllaiñ da ki jaiñsop ïa kiba ïap , bad da ka jaiñ la teh ïa ka khmat jong u .  To law noh na u ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  bad ai ba un ïaid .

translation.en: Of the gold , the silver , and the brass , and the iron , there is no number . Arise therefore , and be doing , and the  Lord  be with thee .
translation.kha: Mynta sdang noh ïa ka kam , bad to U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad me .

translation.en: And he returned unto his brethren , and said , The child is not  ; and I , whither shall I go ?
translation.kha: U leit phai pat sha la ki para , bad u ong ,  U para um don shuh hangta ! Ngam tip shuh ngan leh kumno .

translation.en: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder , and pushed all the diseased with your horns , till ye have scattered them abroad  ;
translation.kha: Phi kyndat sharud ïa kiba pang bad phi ñiat ïa ki shabar na ka kynhun .

translation.en: As Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded the children of Israel , as it is written in the book of the law of Moses , an altar of whole stones , over which no man hath lift up any iron : and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , and sacrificed peace offerings .
translation.kha: U la tei ïa ka kat kum ki jingbthah ba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel , kumba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses :  Ka duwan ba la tei da ki maw ki bym shym la shtah da ki tiar nar .  Halor jong ka ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia ha U  Trai  , bad ki la ainguh ruh ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: And when they had brought their ships to land , they forsook all , and followed him .
translation.kha: Ki la tan ïa ki lieng sharud duriaw , ki la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ki la bud ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: David said furthermore , As the  Lord  liveth , the  Lord  shall smite him  ; or his day shall come to die  ; or he shall descend into battle , and perish .
translation.kha: Da U  Trai  uba im ,  u Dabid u bteng biang ,  nga tip ba U  Trai  hi un shoh ïap ïa u , lane un ïap hi ynda poi ka por ba un ïap , lane haba un ïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: Philip findeth Nathanael , and saith unto him , We have found him , of whom Moses in the law , and the prophets , did write , Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph .
translation.kha: U Philip u la shem ïa u Nathanael bad u la ong ïa u ,  Ngi la shem ïa uta ïa uba u Moses u la thoh ha ka kitab jong ka Hukum bad ïa uba ki nongïathuhlypa ruh ki la thoh shaphang jong u . U long U Jisu , u khun jong u Joseph , uba na Nasareth .

translation.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the timber shall answer it .
translation.kha: Wat ki maw ha ki kynroh ki kyang pyrshah ïa phi , bad ki shankhung ki pynsawa ïa ka jingkyang .

translation.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah  ; and he reigned a full month in Samaria .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar shi bnai ha Samaria .

translation.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee .
translation.kha: Nangta thep hapoh ka synduk ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba ngan ai ha me , ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time , in making war against it to take it , thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them : for thou mayest eat of them , and thou shalt not cut them down ( for the tree of the field is man s life ) to employ them in the siege :
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaleh ban knieh ïa kano kano ka shnong , wat pom ïa ki diengsoh jong ka , wat lada phi kerkut slem ïa ka . Bam ïa u soh , hynrei wat pynjot ïa ki diengsoh , naba kim dei ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim–zophim , of mount Ephraim , and his name was Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Elihu , the son of Tohu , the son of Zuph , an Ephrathite :
translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Elkanah , uba na ka jait Ephraim , uba shong ha ka shnong Ramah kaba ha ri lum Ephraim . U dei u khun jong u Jeroham bad u khun ksiew jong u Elihu , bad u dei na ka longïing jong u Tohu kaba hap hapoh ka jait Suph .

translation.en: So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him , against them by the waters of Merom suddenly  ; and they fell upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki ha ka por ba kim poi pyrkhat ha ka Wahduid Meron .

translation.en: And said , My Lord , if now I have found favour in thy sight , pass not away , I pray thee , from thy servant :
translation.kha: Ko rangbah , sngewbha wat ïaid lait na ka ïing jong nga khlem da wan rung ; nga don hangne ban shakri ïa phi .

translation.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death : but God had mercy on him ; and not on him only , but on me also , lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow .
translation.kha: Da shisha u la pang bad u la jan ïap . Hynrei U Blei u la isynei ïa u , bad ym tang ïa u hynrei ïa nga ruh , bad u la pyllait ïa nga wat na ka jingsngewsih kaba kham khraw .

translation.en: And when he had sent them away , he departed into a mountain to pray .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la khublei ïakhlad ïa ki briew , u la leit noh sha u lum ban duwai .

translation.en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came unto Joseph , and said , Give us bread : for why should we die in thy presence ? for the money faileth .
translation.kha: Haba ym don pisa shuh ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan , baroh ki nong Ijipt ki ïawan sha u Joseph , bad ki ong ,  Ai jingbam ba ngin bam ! Wat ai ba ngin shu ïapthngan ! Ngim don pisa shuh .

translation.en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable , but now profitable to thee and to me :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por u la long bymmyntoi shuh ïa me , hynrei mynta u long uba myntoi ïa me bad ïa nga .

translation.en: For if I pray in an unknown tongue , my spirit prayeth , but my understanding is unfruitful .
translation.kha: Naba lada nga duwai ha kane ka rukom , ka mynsiem jong nga ka duwai da shisha , hynrei ka jingmut jong nga kam don bynta ha ka .

translation.en: If any man s work abide which he hath built thereupon , he shall receive a reward .
translation.kha: Lada kaei kaba la tei ha ka nongrim kam ing ha ka ding , u nongtei un ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong .

translation.en: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband s , a mighty man of wealth , of the family of Elimelech  ; and his name was Boaz .
translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka don u ba-ha-ïing uba kyrteng u Boas , u briew uba riewspah bad ïa uba la ñiewkor shibun uba na ka longïing jong u tnga jong ka , u Elimelekh .

translation.en: For the  Lord  saw the affliction of Israel , that it was very bitter : for there was not any shut up , nor any left , nor any helper for Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïohi ïa ka jingshitom kaba jur jong ki Israel ; ym don mano mano ruh ban ïarap ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore I said , Hearken to me  ; I also will shew mine opinion .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta nga kwah ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga ; to shah ba ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba nga pyrkhat .

translation.en: Both the great and the small shall die in this land : they shall not be buried , neither shall men lament for them , nor cut themselves , nor make themselves bald for them :
translation.kha: Kiba riewspah bad kiba duk kin ïap ha kane ka ri , hynrei ym don mano mano ban tep ïa ki lane ban ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki . Ym don mano mano u ban ot ïa lade lane u ban khi ïa la ka khlieh ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong u .

translation.en: All go unto one place  ; all are of the dust , and all turn to dust again .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka — ka khyndew . Baroh ar ki la wan na ka bad baroh ar kin leit phai pat sha ka .

translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering , and the shoulder of the heave offering , which is waved , and which is heaved up , of the ram of the consecration , even of that which is for Aaron , and of that which is for his sons :
translation.kha: Haba la pynsleh ïa u lyngdoh , ïa ka shadem bad ka lbong jong uta u langbrot ïa uba la pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh dei ban pynkyntang sha nga kum ka jingai sngewbha bakyrpang bad kaba la buh kyrpang na ka bynta ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God , he stood by the lake of Gennesaret ,
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Jisu u la ïeng harud jong ka duriaw Gennesaret katba ki briew ki dang ïawan kiew sha u ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .

translation.en: And when they came thither to the hill , behold , a company of prophets met him  ; and the Spirit of God came upon him , and he prophesied among them .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul bad u shakri jong u ki poi ha Gibeah , shi kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïakynduh ïa u . Kynsan kynsan U Mynsiem jong U Blei u wan da ka bor ha u , bad u ïasoh lang bad ki ha ka jingïashad bashongshit bad ha ka jingïarisa .

translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of them that searched the land , rent their clothes :
translation.kha: Bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun bad u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh , ar ngut na kita ki nongsyntiat , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ da ka jingsngewsih ,

translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king , whose oath he despised , and whose covenant he brake , even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die .
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  une u syiem un ïap ha Babilonia namar u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ka jingïateh lok bad u syiem ka Babilonia , uba la buh ïa u halor ka khet .

translation.en: Because thou hast made the  Lord  , which is my refuge , even the most High , thy habitation  ;
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa U  Trai  u nongkyrshan jong me , ïa U Bahakhlieh Tam u nongïada jong me ,

translation.en: Woe unto the wicked ! it shall be ill with him : for the reward of his hands shall be given him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki long kiba la tim ; kaei kaba ki la leh ïa kiwei mynta yn leh ïa ka ha ki .

translation.en: Mark , Aristarchus , Demas , Luke , my fellowlabourers .
translation.kha: bad kumjuh ruh ki para ba-ïatrei lem bad nga u Markos , u Aristarkhos , u Demas , bad u Loukas .

translation.en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God .
