translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , U Khun U Briew ruh un kyntait ïa u ha khmat ki angel jong U Blei .

translation.en: These shall make war with the Lamb , and the Lamb shall overcome them : for he is Lord of lords , and King of kings : and they that are with him are called , and chosen , and faithful .
translation.kha: Kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Khunlangbrot ; hynrei U Khunlangbrot , lem bad ki nongbud jong u ïa kiba u la khot , u la jied , bad kiba ïaineh skhem , un jop ïa ki , namar ba u dei U Trai jong ki trai bad U Syiem jong ki syiem .

translation.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth , according to the effectual working in the measure of every part , maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u , baroh ki dkhot kiba ïapher jong ka met ki ïabiang lang sbiak , bad ïa ka met baroh kawei la bat lang da kawei pa kawei ka jingïapyndait ïa kaba ka la pynbiang . Kumta haba kawei pa kawei ka bynta kaba ïapher ka ïatrei kam kumba ka dei ban trei , ka met baroh kawei ka san bad ka tei ïa lade da ka jingieit .

translation.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus , and told him all things , both what they had done , and what they had taught .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la wan phai bad ki la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu ; bad ki la ïathuh ha u ïa baroh kaba ki la leh bad la hikai .

translation.en: I fast twice in the week , I give tithes of all that I possess .
translation.kha: Nga shahjingit ar sien shi taïew , bad nga ai ha me kawei na ki shiphew jong ki jingïoh jong nga baroh .’

translation.en: But every vow of a widow , and of her that is divorced , wherewith they have bound their souls , shall stand against her .
translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei lane ka kynthei kaba la ïapyllait tnga ka dei ban pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular ba ka la ai ban kyndiah noh na kano kano .

translation.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,
translation.kha: Namar mynhynne ka miet u angel jong U Blei ha uba nga long bad ïa uba nga mane u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,

translation.en: And when even was come , he went out of the city .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh na ka nongbah .

translation.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them  ; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them : and I will place them , and multiply them , and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki ka ban pynneh ïa ka jingsngewskhem jong ki junom . Ngan tei skhem ïa ki bad ngan pynroi ïa ka jingbun briew jong ki , bad ngan buh ïa ka Templ jong nga ha ka ri jong ki , ha kaba kan neh junom .

translation.en: Of how much sorer punishment , suppose ye , shall he be thought worthy , who hath trodden under foot the Son of God , and hath counted the blood of the covenant , wherewith he was sanctified , an unholy thing , and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace ?
translation.kha: Te , kaei kan long ïa u briew uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Khun U Blei ? uba ñiew dew thala ïa ka snam jong ka jutang U Blei kaba pynkhuid ïa u na ka pop ? uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Mynsiem ka jingaiei ? To pyrkhat haduh katno kan long ka jingpynshitom kaba kham shyrkhei kaba u dei ban ïoh !

translation.en: And the cares of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in , choke the word , and it becometh unfruitful .
translation.kha: hynrei ki jingpynkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ka jingieit ïa ka spah , bad baroh kiwei ki jait jingkwah ki tap bad kjap noh ïa ka khubor , bad kim seisoh satia .

translation.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .
translation.kha: Phin ym long uba jop ha ka jingim lada phi pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop . Phla ïa ki bad iehnoh ïa ki ; te U Blei un pyn-i ka jingisynei ïa phi .

translation.en: But now he is dead , wherefore should I fast ? can I bring him back again ? I shall go to him , but he shall not return to me .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba i la ïap , balei ngan shahjingit ? Nga lah mo ban pynim biang ïa i khunlung ? Ngan sa leit ha kawei ka sngi sha kaba i don , hynrei im lah da lei lei ban wan phai pat sha nga .

translation.en: His head is as the most fine gold , his locks are bushy , and black as a raven .
translation.kha: Ka jingmad ka ngap ka don ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; u thylliej jong phi u long ka dud bad ka ngap ïa nga . Ka jaiñ jong phi ka don baroh ki jingiwbih ka Lebanon .

translation.en: But thou shalt go unto my country , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son Isaac .
translation.kha: Me dei ban leit pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa nga , bad men pynïoh ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga u Isaak napdeng ki kur ki jait jong nga .

translation.en: And all his acquaintance , and the women that followed him from Galilee , stood afar off , beholding these things .
translation.kha: Baroh kito kiba la ithuh ïa U Jisu , kynthup ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa u na Galilaïa , ki la ïeng na pajih ban jngoh .

translation.en: They shall not drink wine with a song  ; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it .
translation.kha: Ym don shuh ka jingrwai bakmen ha ka por ba dih waiñ ; ym don basngewtynnat shuh ïa ka jingmad jong ka .

translation.en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave : that is the pillar of Rachel s grave unto this day .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la pynïeng u maw sahkynmaw hangta , bad u dang pynsah dak ïa ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: Lest there be any fornicator , or profane person , as Esau , who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un long uba im thala lane u bym kynja mynsiem , kum u Iso , uba tang namar shisien ka jingbam u la die noh ïa ki hok jong u kum u hynmen .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Nathan unto David . And he came unto him , and said unto him , There were two men in one city  ; the one rich , and the other poor .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa sha u Dabid . U Nathan u la leit sha u bad u ong ,  Don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba shong ha kajuh ka shnong ; uwei u long uba riewspah , bad uwei pat uba duk .

translation.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him , then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him , that God may be all in all .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la buh hapoh ka jingsynshar U Khrist , te ma u hi , U Khun , un pyndem ïa lade hapoh U Blei uba la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u ; bad U Blei un synshar lut halor baroh .

translation.en: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them , he consented not  ;
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah kham slem , hynrei u kyrngah .

translation.en: Or , Deliver me from the enemy s hand ? or , Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?
translation.kha: lane ban pyllait im ïa nga na uno uno u nongshun ne u nongbanbor ?

translation.en: Where there is no vision , the people perish : but he that keepeth the law , happy is he .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew kaba khlem ka jingïalam U Blei ka long ka jaitbynriew ka bym ïaid beit . A suk uta u briew uba sumar ïa ka hukum U Blei !

translation.en: And the land be subdued before the  Lord  : then afterward ye shall return , and be guiltless before the  Lord  , and before Israel  ; and this land shall be your possession before the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad shim kynti ïa ka ri . Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan phai , namar phi la pyndep ïa ka kamram jong phi sha U  Trai  bad sha kiwei pat ki para Israel . Te U  Trai  un pynskhem ba kane ka ri sha mihngi jong ka Jordan ka dei ka jong phi .

translation.en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth , and which the vulture s eye hath not seen :
translation.kha: Ym don u kbeit uba ïohi ïa ki lynti sha ki par , bad ym don u pukni ba ju her halor jong ki .

translation.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him , when the number of his months is cut off in the midst ?
translation.kha: Haba ka jingim u briew ka la kut , hato u pyrkhat shisha ne em ba ki khun jong u kin kmen ?

translation.en: So we boiled my son , and did eat him : and I said unto her on the next day , Give thy son , that we may eat him : and she hath hid her son .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi la shet ïa u khun jong nga , bad ngi la bam ïa u . Ha ka sngi kaba bud , nga ong ha ka ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong ka , hynrei ka la buhrieh ïa u !

translation.en: He said unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  Peter answering said , The Christ of God .
translation.kha: Kumno pat ma phi ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  Phi ong ba nga long uei ?  U Petros u la jubab ,  Me long U Messaïah jong U Blei .

translation.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about  ; yet thou dost destroy me .
translation.kha: Ki kti jong me ki la pynlong bad pynwandur ïa nga , bad mynta kito kijuh ki kti ki pynjot ïa nga .

translation.en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and his armourbearer , and all his men , that same day together .
translation.kha: Bad da kumta u Saul , ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut , bad uta u samla , ki la ïap ; baroh ki briew jong u Saul ki ïap ryngkat ha kajuh ka sngi .

translation.en: And I will destroy your high places , and cut down your images , and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols , and my soul shall abhor you .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi kiba ha ki lum , ngan pynpra ïa ki duwan thang jingiwbih jong phi , bad ngan bret ïa ki metïap jong phi halor ki bleithaw jong phi kiba la kyllon .

translation.en: And Isaiah said , Take a lump of figs . And they took and laid it on the boil , and he recovered .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ha kiba synran ïa u syiem ban tah ha u tohjaw da i symboh ba la shna na ki soh Dumbur , bad un ïohkhiah .

translation.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber , where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil , which was commanded to be given to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters  ; and the offerings of the priests .
translation.kha: U shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra kaba heh ïa kaba la thmu tang ban buh ïa u kew jingkñia bad ka jingiwbih , ki tiar ki tar ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ , ki jingainguh na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , bad kiba shiphew na u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba ai sha ki Lebi , ki nongtem nongput ka Templ , bad ki nongap phira ka Templ .

translation.en: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face , and were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur , ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta ba ki la dem khrup la ki durkhmat sha khyndew .

translation.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer : their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar  ; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha Seïon , sha u lum bakyntang jong nga , ngan ai ha phi ka jingkmen ha ka ïing jingduwai jong nga ; bad pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi ai ha ka duwan jong nga . Ïa ka ïing jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai na ka bynta ki briew jong ki ri baroh .

translation.en: And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep .
translation.kha: Don uba la ïathuh ha ka Tamar ba u kthaw kurim jong ka u la leit sha Timnah ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot .

translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Israel , who smote them , and chased them unto great Zidon , and unto Misrephoth–maim , and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward  ; and they smote them , until they left them none remaining .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki ; ki Israel ki tur ïaleh bad ki bad ki beh kthong ïa ki shaphang shatei haduh Misrephoth Maim bad Sidon , bad shaphang mihngi haduh ka them Mispah . Ka jingïaleh ka neh haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh u nongshun uba lait im .

translation.en: She hath wearied herself with lies , and her great scum went not forth out of her : her scum shall be in the fire .
translation.kha: wat la ka sarang baroh kan ym jah ha ki thylliej ding .

translation.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee in all thy ways .
translation.kha: U Blei un buh ïa ki angel ban khmih halor jong me ban ïada ïa me shano shano ba me leit .

translation.en: The  Lord  our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .
translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai , U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynlong ka jutang ,

translation.en: And when they saw him , they were amazed : and his mother said unto him , Son , why hast thou thus dealt with us ? behold , thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing .
translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la kyndit haba ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ka kmie jong u ka la ong ,  Ko khun jong nga , balei me la leh ïa kane ha ngi ? U kpa jong me bad ma nga ngi la khuslai shikatdei eh ha kaba pyrshang ban wad ïa me .

translation.en: Another parable spake he unto them  ;  The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven , which a woman took , and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki sa kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki Bneng ka long kumne . Ka briew ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u purew tad haduh ba u  purew ba la khleh u sieb .

translation.en: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed  ; and he reared up altars for Baal , and made a grove , as did Ahab king of Israel  ; and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .
translation.kha: U tei pat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ïa kiba u Hesekaïah u kpa jong u , u la pynjot ; u la tei ki duwan ban mane ïa u Baal bad thaw ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , kumba u Ahab u syiem Israel u la leh . U Manasseh u la mane ruh ïa ki khlur .

translation.en: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah : and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt  ; for he strengthened himself exceedingly .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki siew khajna ha u Ussaïah , bad u kylla long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta kata ba ka nam jong u ka phriang wat shaduh sha Ijipt .

translation.en: 3 Is the Good News Really From God ?
translation.kha: 3 Hato ka Khubor Babha ka Dei Shisha mo Na U Blei ?

translation.en: He that withholdeth corn , the people shall curse him : but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki tim ïa uno uno uba set ïa u kew , ban ap haba un kiew dor , hynrei ki ïaroh ïa uno uno uba sei ban die ïa u .

translation.en: In your patience possess ye your souls .
translation.kha: To ïeng skhem , bad phin ri pynim ïa lade hi .

translation.en: Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life  ; and I will raise him up at the last day .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad dih ïa ka snam jong nga u don ka jingim bymjukut , bad ngan sa pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u shna arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba hynriew kilo ,

translation.en: Take , I pray thee , my blessing that is brought to thee  ; because God hath dealt graciously with me , and because I have enough . And he urged him , and he took it .
translation.kha: Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingai sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi ; U Blei u la lehsbun ïa nga , bad u la ai ïa nga baroh kaba nga donkam .  U Jakob u la ïai kyrpad ïa u haduh ba un da pdiang .

translation.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more .
translation.kha: Bad nangta u ong ,  Ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïa ki jingleh palat jong ki .

translation.en: And blessed be the most high God , which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand . And he gave him tithes of all .
translation.kha: bad to kan long ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh uba ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong phi !  Bad u Abram u ai ha u Melkhisedek ïa kaba shiphew na ka jinglute kaba u la lah pynïoh pat .

translation.en: And the doors shall be shut in the streets , when the sound of the grinding is low , and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird , and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low  ;
translation.kha: Ki shkor jong phi kin ym ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha ki lynti . Da kaba shitom phin lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingtylliat haba ka tylliat , bad ïa ka sur jingtem haba ka sawa , hynrei wat ka jingpah jong ka sim kan kyrsiew ïa phi na ka jingïohthiah .

translation.en: And every one that hath forsaken houses , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name s sake , shall receive an hundredfold , and shall inherit everlasting life .
translation.kha: Bad uno uno uba la iehnoh ïa ki ïing ki sem lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa u kpa lane ïa ka kmie lane ïa ki khun ki kti lane ïa ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga , un ïohpdiang shispah shah tam ïa kata , bad yn ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: So the young man , even the young man the prophet , went to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa samla u leit sha Ramoth ,

translation.en: The highways lie waste , the wayfaring man ceaseth : he hath broken the covenant , he hath despised the cities , he regardeth no man .
translation.kha: Ki lynti bah ki long kiba ma shibun ba ym don uba ïaid ba ïeng ha ki . Ïa ki jingïateh kular la pynkheiñ bad ïa ki jingïakut ym shym burom . Ym don shuh ka jingïaburom ïano ïano ruh .

translation.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .
translation.kha: Ki la shoh ïa u na ka khlieh da u dieng , ki la bynthiew ïa u , ki la dem khohsiew , bad ki la nguh ïa u .

translation.en: Yet now , if thou wilt forgive their sin―  ; and if not , blot me , I pray thee , out of thy book which thou hast written .
translation.kha: To map ïa ka pop jong ki ; hynrei lada men ym map , nga kyrpad ba men weng noh ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na kata ka kitab ha kaba me la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong u paidlang jong me .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  This day is salvation come to this house , forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Mynta ka jingpynim ka la wan ha kane ka ïing , naba une u briew , ruh , u dei uba hiarpateng jong u Abraham .

translation.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them .
translation.kha: Ai ha ki Israel ïa kine ki hukum harum :

translation.en: That all flesh may know that I the  Lord  have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath : it shall not return any more .
translation.kha: Baroh kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad ba ngan ym buh noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And I will cut off the cities of thy land , and throw down all thy strong holds :
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ka ri jong phi bad pynpra ïa ki jingïada jong phi baroh .

translation.en: These great beasts , which are four , are four kings , which shall arise out of the earth .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Kine ki saw tylli ki mradkhlaw kiba khraw eh ki long ki saw tylli ki hima ki ban sa mih ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people , that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem . I Darius have made a decree  ; let it be done with speed .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba la jied ïa ka Jerusalem kum ka jaka ba yn mane ïa u , un pynjot noh ïa uno uno u syiem lane ka hima kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka hukum bad uba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka Templ hangta . Ma nga , u Darius , nga la ai ïa kane ka hukum . Dei ban kohnguh lut ïa ka .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die , it abideth alone : but if it die , it bringeth forth much fruit .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha : U symboh kew u ïaisah hi tang shi symboh lymda la pynhap ïa u ha ka khyndew bad u ïap . Lada u da ïap , te u sei shibun ki sohkew .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they had heard all the words , they were afraid both one and other , and said unto Baruch , We will surely tell the king of all these words .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la lah pule ïa ka , ki la ïaphai uwei sha uwei pat ha ka jingsngew sheptieng , bad ki la ong ha u Barukh ,  Ngi dei ban ïathuh ïa kane ha u syiem .

translation.en: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz , which the kings of Judah had made , and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the  Lord  , did the king beat down , and brake them down from thence , and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron .
translation.kha: Ïa ki duwan kiba ki syiem Judah ki la tei halor tnum ka ïingsyiem hajrong ka jaka sah u syiem Ahas , u syiem Josaïah u la pyntwa lut , ryngkat bad ki duwan ba la pynïeng da u syiem Manasseh ha ki ar tylli ki phyllaw jong ka Templ ; u la pynlwet ïa ki duwan lyngkhot lyngkhai bad bret ïa ki sha ka Them Kidron .

translation.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you , that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel , to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them ?
translation.kha: Phi tharai ba ka long kaei kaei kaba rit ba U Blei ki Israel u la pynkyrpang ïa phi na ka kynhun , ba phi lah ban leit sha u , ban leh ïa ka kamram jong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  , bad ban ai jingshakri ïa ka kynhun bad ban shakri ïa ki ?

translation.en: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts , to dishonour their own bodies between themselves :
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u la ai noh ïa kita ki briew sha ka ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba jakhlia kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki kwah , bad ki leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki .

translation.en: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah hynñiew snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing , and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation , because they are burned up , so that none can pass through them  ; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle  ; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled  ; they are gone .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ngan ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ki lumbah bad jaw ummat na ka bynta ki jaka pynbamphlang , namar ki la tyrkhong , bad ym don mano mano ba leit jingleit lyngba jong ki . Ïa ka jingsawa ki jingri ym shym ïohsngew shuh ; ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw ki la phet bad kim don shuh .

translation.en: And I will come near to you to judgment  ; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers , and against the adulterers , and against false swearers , and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages , the widow , and the fatherless , and that turn aside the stranger from his right , and fear not me , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan sa paw hapdeng jong phi ban bishar , bad ngan phla shisyndon pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh myntor , pyrshah ïa kiba klim , pyrshah ïa kito kiba sakhi lamler , kito kiba shukor ïa ki nongtrei ïa ki bainong jong ki , bad kito kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , bad ki nongwei — pyrshah ïa kito baroh ki bym ñiewkor ïa nga .

translation.en: For when I had brought them into the land , for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them , then they saw every high hill , and all the thick trees , and they offered there their sacrifices , and there they presented the provocation of their offering : there also they made their sweet savour , and poured out there their drink offerings .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki . Haba ki la ïohi ïa ki lum bajrong bad ïa ki dieng bajyrngam , ki la ai jingkñia ha ki baroh . Ki la pynbitar ïa nga da ki jingkñia kiba ki la thang bad da ka waiñ kaba ki la wallam kum ki jingainguh .

translation.en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .
translation.kha: Ki jinghikai jong kiba stad ki long ka umpohliew ka jingim ; kin ïarap ïa phi ban lait im haba ka jingim jong phi ka don ha ka jingma .

translation.en: Not that I speak in respect of want : for I have learned , in whatsoever state I am , therewith to be content .
translation.kha: Bad ngam shym ong ïa kane namar ba nga la shah leh klet , naba nga la nang ban sngewhun ha kaei kaba nga don .

translation.en: Say unto them , Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations , that goeth unto the holy things , which the children of Israel hallow unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , that soul shall be cut off from my presence : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong phi , katba u dang long u bymkhuid , u wan hajan ki jingainguh kiba kyntang ïa kiba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , un ym lah shuh lano lano ruh ban shakri ha kata ka duwan . Kane kan ïailong kumta pateng la pateng . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And the child grew , and waxed strong in spirit , and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel .
translation.kha: U khynnah u la nang san bad nang khraw ha ka met bad ka mynsiem . U la shong la sah ha ka ri shyiap tad haduh ka sngi ba u la paw paidbah ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils , no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you .
translation.kha: Em , ka long pynban da ka bor ka jong U Blei ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid , bad kane ka pynshisha ba ka Hima jong U Blei ka la da wan ha phi .

translation.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah um shym tip ba U Jisu u la long uei , naba la don u paidbah ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu u la lah mihnoh jar jar .

translation.en: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength , and it was infinite  ; Put and Libya were thy helpers .
translation.kha: Ka la synshar ïa ka Sudan bad ïa ka Ijipt , ym don pud ïa ka bor jong ka ; ka Libya ka la long ka paralok jong ka .

translation.en: Then Peter said unto them , Repent , and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins , and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ong ha ki ,  Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong u bad ba yn pynbaptis ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist , khnang ba yn map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad phin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba long ka jingai jong U Blei .

translation.en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead , which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan , where the Philistines had hanged them , when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa :
translation.kha: u leit shim ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad jong u Jonathan , u khun jong u na ki briew ka Jabesh ha Gilead . ( Ki la tuh ïa ki na ka jaka paidbah ha Beth Shan , ha kaba ki Philistia ki la sdien ïa ki met jong ki ha ka sngi ba ki la pynïap ïa u Saul halor u Lum Gilboa . )

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day , that they watched him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u la leit ban bam ha ka ïing jong uwei na ki Pharisi kiba kham pawkhmat ; bad ki briew ki la khmih bha ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever shall put away his wife , saving for the cause of fornication , causeth her to commit adultery : and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : lada uno uno u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , na ka bynta kano kano ka daw lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , te u long uba la shah rem ha kaba pynlong ïa ka ban klim lada ka shongkurim biang ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka , u ruh u klim .

translation.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed , he saddled his ass , and arose , and gat him home to his house , to his city , and put his household in order , and hanged himself , and died , and was buried in the sepulchre of his father .
translation.kha: Haba u Ahithophel u la ïohi ba ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u ym shym la pdiang , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u leit phai noh sha la shnong . Ynda u la dep pynbeit ïa la ki kam ïing kam sem , u la sdien phasi ïa lade . La tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And I will turn thee back , and put hooks into thy jaws , and I will bring thee forth , and all thine army , horses and horsemen , all of them clothed with all sorts of armour , even a great company with bucklers and shields , all of them handling swords :
translation.kha: Ngan pynphai sawdong ïa u , ngan buh ki khwai ha ki tyngam jong u bad ngan patan noh ïa u bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh . Ka kynhun shipai jong u ka long kaba khraw , lem bad ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai kiba riam ryntih , bad man la u shipai uba rah ka stieh bad kieng ka waitlam .

translation.en: I am the door : by me if any man enter in , he shall be saved , and shall go in and out , and find pasture .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long kata ka jingkhang . Uno uno uba rung shapoh da nga un ïoh im ; kin ïohrung shapoh bad mih shabar bad shem ïa ka jaka bam phlang .

translation.en: Gracious is the  Lord  , and righteous  ; yea , our God is merciful .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba bha ; U Blei jong ngi u long uba sngewlem .

translation.en: For ye have the poor always with you  ; but me ye have not always .
translation.kha: Phin ïai ïoh ïa ki briew kiba duk lem bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh ïa nga borabor .

translation.en: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka doh bad ïa ka snieh u thang shabar ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: And the devil , taking him up into an high mountain , shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time .
translation.kha: Nangta , u Soitan u la ïalam ïa u shajrong bad u la pyn-i ha u ha ka shikhyllipmat ïa baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful , and increased abundantly , and multiplied , and waxed exceeding mighty  ; and the land was filled with them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la ïaroi shikatdei eh ; ki la nang bun nang bun , bad ki la nang khlaiñ haduh ba kata ka ri ka la khapngiah da ki .

translation.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil : his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba-bymman ki kwah borabor ïa kaba sniew ; kim don jingisynei ïano ïano ruh .

translation.en: The woman was a Greek , a Syrophenician by nation  ; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la long ka Jentil , ba la kha ha ka thain Phoenisia ha Syria . Ka la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban beh noh ïa u ksuid na ka khun jong ka .

translation.en: And the  Lord  visited Hannah , so that she conceived , and bare three sons and two daughters . And the child Samuel grew before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u da kyrkhu shisha ïa ka Hannah , bad ka ïoh sa lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad ar ngut ki khun kynthei . Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san ha kaba shakri ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the mother of the child said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And he arose , and followed her .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka ong ha u Elisha ,  Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  uba im bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi !  Kumta baroh ar ngut ki la ïamih lang .

translation.en: Wherefore , though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient ,
translation.kha: Kum u hynmen jong me ha U Khrist na ka bynta kane ka daw ba nga lah ban sngew shlur katne , ban hukum ïa me ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei ban leh .

translation.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them , and their offspring before their eyes .
translation.kha: Ki don ki khun bad ki khun ksiew , bad ki im ban khmih ïa ki baroh ba ki heh ki san ;

translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards , a land of oil olive and of honey , that ye may live , and not die : and hearken not unto Hezekiah , when he persuadeth you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us .
translation.kha: haduh ba u patsha un pynshong pynsah pat ïa phi ha ka ri kumba ka dei ka jong phi hi , ha kaba don ki bri sohwaiñ ban ai sohwaiñ bad yn don ki kew ban pynlong kpu ; ka dei ka ri ki Olib , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap . Lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba u hukum , phin ym ïap , hynrei phin im . Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ba phin pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: And thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates , and the stranger , and the fatherless , and the widow , that are among you , in the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to place his name there .
translation.kha: Lehkmen ha khmat U  Trai  ryngkat bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi . Leh ïa kane ha kata ka jaka mane Blei .

translation.en: Behold , he shall come up as clouds , and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind : his horses are swifter than eagles . Woe unto us ! for we are spoiled .
translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nongshun u wan kum ki lyoh . Ki kali ïapom jong u ki long kum ka  erlangthari , bad ki kulai jong u ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukni . Ngi la shahjop ! Ngim lah khie khlieh shuh !

translation.en: Not purloining , but shewing all good fidelity ; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki dei ban pyn-i ba ki long borabor kiba bha bad ba lah ban shaniah , khnang ban pynshisha ïa ka jinghikai shaphang U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ha baroh ba ki leh .

translation.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity : every man that eateth the sour grape , his teeth shall be set on edge .
translation.kha: Pynban , uno uno uba bam ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba jew kan pynlong ba ki bniat jong u hi kin shyrkhei ; bad uwei uwei baroh un ïap namar ki pop jong u hi .

translation.en: But seek not Beth–el , nor enter into Gilgal , and pass not to Beer–sheba : for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity , and Beth–el shall come to nought .
translation.kha: Wat leit sha Beersheba ban mane Blei . Wat pyrshang ban wad ïa nga ha Bethel — ka Bethel kan ym long ei ei . Wat leit sha Gilgal — ïa ki briew jong ka la tim ba kin shah ringmraw .

translation.en: For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
translation.kha: Lada phi leit sha ka ïing jong ka , phi ïaid ha ka lynti sha ka jingïap . Ban leit shata ka long ban tur sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter , like rams with he goats .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki ban shah pynïap , kum ki khunblang , ki blang , bad ki langbrot shynrang . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: And there was yet a battle in Gath , where was a man of great stature , that had on every hand six fingers , and on every foot six toes , four and twenty in number  ; and he also was born to the giant .
translation.kha: Nangta la don ruh sa kawei pat ka thma ha Gath ha kaba la don uwei u ramhah uba sngewtynnat ban ïaleh . U don hynriew tylli ki shynriah ti ha kawei kawei ka kti , bad hynriew tylli ki shynriah jat ha kawei kawei ka kjat .

translation.en: Because he slew me not from the womb  ; or that my mother might have been my grave , and her womb to be always great with me .
translation.kha: namar um shym la pynïap ïa nga ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa nga . Te ka kpoh jong i mei jong nga kan jin da la long ka jingtep jong nga .

translation.en: Then was the iron , the clay , the brass , the silver , and the gold , broken to pieces together , and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors  ; and the wind carried them away , that no place was found for them : and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain , and filled the whole earth .
translation.kha: Kumta hi ka nar , ka dewbyrtha , ka rnong , ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki la khyllem bad ki la long kum u pui pui ha ka jaka shoh kew ha ka por lyiur . Ka lyer ka la kit noh ïa u , khlem da pynsah dien ei ei . Hynrei u maw u la san ban long u lumbah uba tap ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: And his sons walked not in his ways , but turned aside after lucre , and took bribes , and perverted judgment .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa u kpa jong ki ; ki im sngi tang ha kaba kamai spah , kumta ki bamsap bad kim bishar hok ïa ki jingïakajia .

translation.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people , saying , Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river , and every daughter ye shall save alive .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh , uta u syiem u hukum ïa ki briew jong u baroh ,  Shim ïa u khunlung Hebru baroh uba dang shu lah kha bad bret ïa u sha wah Nile , hynrei ai ba ki khun kynthei kin im .

translation.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat .
translation.kha: Bad u la beh noh ïa ki shabar ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the  Lord  , and Satan came also among them .
translation.kha: Haba la poi ka sngi ha kaba ki jingthaw ha bneng ki wanpaw ha khmat U  Trai  , u Soitan u la don lang hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .
translation.kha: Ynda ngi leit phai pat sha i pa , ngi ïathuh lut ha i kat ïa kaba phi ong .

translation.en: Then I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and behold a flying roll .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad ha kane ka por nga la ïohi ïa ka kot kli kaba her ha ka lyer .

translation.en: ( Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow : behold , it is written in the book of Jasher . )
translation.kha: bad u hukum ba yn hikai ïa ka ha ki briew ka Judah . ( La buh jingkynmaw ha  Ka Kitab U Jashar . )

translation.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew , which hath been sold unto thee  ; and when he hath served thee six years , thou shalt let him go free from thee : but your fathers hearkened not unto me , neither inclined their ear .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba man ki hynñiew snem ki dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uno uno u mraw Hebru uba la shakri ïa ki hynriew snem . Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim shym la suidñiew ïa nga lane shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .

translation.en: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel , and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kan ïasoh bad ka Judah , bad ryngkat lang kin ïawan na ka jingshah ringmraw ha ka ri kaba shatei bad kin wan phai sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi kum ka jingdon jingem kaba neh .

translation.en: And he carried away all his cattle , and all his goods which he had gotten , the cattle of his getting , which he had gotten in Paddan–aram , for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u khreh ban leit phai pat sha la u kpa ha ka ri Kanaan . U pynshong ïa ki khun bad ki tnga jong u halor ki ut , bad u ïalam ïa la ki kynhun jingri jong u baroh ha shuwa jong u , lem bad baroh kiba u la ïohlum ha Mesopotamia .

translation.en: And Samuel came to Saul : and Saul said unto him , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  : I have performed the commandment of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u la leit sha u Saul , uba la khublei ïa u , da kaba ong ,  U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa phi , Samuel ! Nga la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai .

translation.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day  ; that I should remove it from before my face ,
translation.kha: Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki la pynbitar bad pynbitar shla ïa nga naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa ka .

translation.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , from following the sheep , to be ruler over my people , over Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh nga ong ha u , ‘ Nga la shim ïa me na kaba sharai ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang , bad nga la thung ïa me u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel .

translation.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath–jearim to the place which David had prepared for it : for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: ( Pynban , Ka Synduk ka Jutang ka don ha Jerusalem , la buh ïa ka ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u Syiem Dabid u la pynïeng mynba u wanrah ïa Ka Synduk na Kiriath Jearim . )

translation.en: And , behold , a certain lawyer stood up , and tempted him , saying , Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
translation.kha: U nonghikai ka Hukum u la wan bad u la pyrshang ban riam ïa U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la kylli ,  kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?

translation.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire , and it sat upon each of them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum ki thylliej ding kiba pur kylleng bad ktah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew hangta .

translation.en: Now go and smite Amalek , and utterly destroy all that they have , and spare them not  ; but slay both man and woman , infant and suckling , ox and sheep , camel and ass .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , bad pynjot lut khoit kat kaba ki don . Wat pynsah ei ei ruh ; pynïap lut ïa ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ; ki masi bad ki langbrot , ki ut bad ki kada baroh .

translation.en: And he said , Hagar , Sarai s maid , whence camest thou ? and whither wilt thou go ? And she said , I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai .
translation.kha: Ko Hagar , ka mraw jong ka Sarai , na-ei pha wan bad shano phan leit ?  Ka jubab ,  Nga phet noh na la ka kynrad .

translation.en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake , so that the foundations of the prison were shaken : and immediately all the doors were opened , and every one s bands were loosed .
translation.kha: Kynsan la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba jur , kaba la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki nongrim jong ka byndi . Shisyndon ki jingkhang baroh ki la plie , bad ki kynjri ki la hap na ki koidi .

translation.en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit , and his life shall see the light .
translation.kha: U la bat ïa nga na ka ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , bad mynta nga dang im .

translation.en: And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubilee , both he , and his children with him .
translation.kha: Lada ym lah ban pyllait ïa u da kano kano na kine ki lad , ïa u bad ki khun jong u dei ban pyllait pat ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan .

translation.en: And laid them down at the apostles  feet : and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need .
translation.kha: bad ai ïa ka ha ki apostol ; bad ïa ka pisa la ïasam ha uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingdonkam jong u .

translation.en: But he answered and said ,  I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ïa nga la phah tang sha ki langbrot ba la jah noh jong ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Now also many nations are gathered against thee , that say , Let her be defiled , and let our eye look upon Zion .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun ki la ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki ong ,  Ïa ka Jerusalem dei ban pynjot ! Ngin ïohi ïa kane ka nongbah ha ki jingjot !

translation.en: Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and cry against it  ; for their wickedness is come up before me .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Khie leit sha Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah kaba khraw , bad to kren pyrshah ïa ka ; nga tip haduh katno kiba bymman ki briew jong ka ki long .

translation.en: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar , which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king .
translation.kha: Ki pyndep ïa ka Templ ha ka sngi kaba lai jong u bnai Adar ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u patsha Darius .

translation.en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the  Lord  , that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u buh ruh ki nongap phira ha ka kam ha ki khyrdop jong ka Templ ban khang ïa uno uno u bymkhuid kat kum ka niam .

translation.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman , or if I have laid wait at my neighbour s door  ;
translation.kha: Lada nga la ikwah ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong nga , bad ïai ap , ïai rieh , shabar ka jingkhang jong ka ,

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it , to offer burnt offerings thereon , and to sprinkle blood thereon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ngan ong ha me . Haba la tei ïa ka duwan , me dei ban pynkyntang ïa ka da kaba thang ki jingkñia halor jong ka bad da kaba synreit halor jong ka ïa ka snam jong ki mrad ba la kñia .

translation.en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever : for thou blessest , O  Lord  , and it shall be blessed for ever .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai lehkmen ha ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A  Trai  , me la kyrkhu ïa ki , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan neh bad ki junom .

translation.en: The sea is come up upon Babylon : she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof .
translation.kha: Ka duriaw ka la tyllep ïa ka Babilon bad tap da ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh .

translation.en: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the  Lord  : and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
translation.kha: Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ? bad pynhiarkput ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ?

translation.en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots , and the king of Maacah and his people  ; who came and pitched before Medeba . And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .
translation.kha: Ki laiphew ar hajar tylli ki kali ïapom kiba ki wai bad ka kynhun shipai u syiem Maakah ki wan sher dara hajan ka Medeba . Ki Ammon ruh ki wan na baroh ki nongbah jong ki bad ki long kiba la kloi ban ïaleh .

translation.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish , and upon all pleasant pictures .
translation.kha: Un pynngam wat ïa ki liengbah kiba khraw bad kiba itynnat tam .

translation.en: For behold this selfsame thing , that ye sorrowed after a godly sort , what carefulness it wrought in you , yea , what clearing of yourselves , yea , what indignation , yea , what fear , yea , what vehement desire , yea , what zeal , yea , what revenge ! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi aïu U Blei u la leh lyngba kane ka jingsngewsih jong phi : Katno ka la pynlong smat ïa phi . Katno phi kwah ban pynshisha ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong phi ! Kaba haduh katno ka jingsngew bitar , ka jingpeit pyrman halor kaba la jia , bad phi la sngew ka jingsngew , ka jingaiti , ka jinglong ba la kloi ban pynshitom ïa ka jingleh bakla ! Phi la pynpaw ïa lade kiba khlem bakla ha kane ka kam baroh .

translation.en: For I say unto you , that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me , And he was reckoned among the transgressors : for the things concerning me have an end .
translation.kha: Naba nga ong ha phi ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong , ‘ U la ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong kiba leh kam runar ,’ ka dei ban urlong shisha shaphang jong nga , namar kaei kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ka wan jia shisha .

translation.en: And he said ,  Go into the city to such a man , and say unto him , The Master saith , My time is at hand  ; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples .
translation.kha: To khie leit sha uwei u briew ha ka nongbah ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  bad ïathuh ha u : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong , ka por jong nga ka la poi ; ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ïing jong me !’

translation.en: And ye were now turned , and had done right in my sight , in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour  ; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name :
translation.kha: Dang tang khyndiat sngi mynshuwa phi la kylla jingmut bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Baroh na phi , phi la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki para Israel , bad phi la pynlong ïa ka jutang ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ha ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers , and held the lamps in their left hands , and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal : and they cried , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
translation.kha: Baroh ki bat ïa ki dongmusa ha la ki kti kadiang , ïa ki turoi ha la ki kti kamon , bad ki pyrta ,  Ka waitlam ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Gideon !

translation.en: Then take of them again , and cast them into the midst of the fire , and burn them in the fire  ; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta shim biang katto katne na ki , bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad ai ba yn thang ïa ki . Na ki ka ding kan klang sha ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh kawei .

translation.en: And when Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , saw it , he rose up from among the congregation , and took a javelin in his hand  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u ksiew jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh , u la ïohi ïa kane , u ïeng joit bad u mih na kata ka kynhun .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning : I covered the deep for him , and I restrained the floods thereof , and the great waters were stayed : and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him , and all the trees of the field fainted for him .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka sngi ba u dieng u leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan pynlong ïa ki um shapoh khyndew ban tap ïa u kum ka dak ka jingïambriew . Ngan set noh ïa ki wah bad ngan ym shah ïa ki wahduid ban tuid shabar . Namar ba u dieng u la ïap , ngan wallam ka jingdum halor ki lumbah ka Lebanon bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki dieng ha khlaw ba kin ïapstai .

translation.en: And he brought the family of Judah  ; and he took the family of the Zarhites : and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man  ; and Zabdi was taken :
translation.kha: U wan ïalam ïa ka jait Judah sha khmat , shi kur shi kur , bad la kdew ïa ka kur ki Serah . Nangta u wan ïalam ïa ka kur Serah sha khmat , shi ïing shi ïing , bad la kdew ïa ka ïing u Sabdi .

translation.en: For as the woman is of the man , even so is the man also by the woman ; but all things of God .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ïa ka briew la thaw na u briew , kumta ruh ïa u briew la kha na ka briew ; bad dei U Blei uba pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord  : where I will meet you , to speak there unto thee .
translation.kha: Ha ki por baroh ki ban wan , dei ban ai ïa kane ka jingainguh thang ha khmat jong nga ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kata ka long ka jaka ha kaba ngan ïashem bad ki briew jong nga bad ngan ïakren bad me .

translation.en: In that day the  Lord  with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent , even leviathan that crooked serpent  ; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka waitlam badonbor bad bashyrkhei jong u ban pynshitom ïa u Lebiathan , uta u Ïakjakor uba khih bad uba khyrwait , bad ban pynïap ïa uta u mrad kynsha uba im ha ka duriaw .

translation.en: And even to your old age I am he  ; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you : I have made , and I will bear  ; even I will carry , and will deliver you .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei jong phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi haduh ba phin da tymmen bad ba u shñiuh jong phi u la lieh . Nga la thaw ïa phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi ; Ngan ai jingïarap ïa phi bad ngan pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: And Laban went into Jacob s tent , and into Leah s tent , and into the two maidservants  tents  ; but he found them not . Then went he out of Leah s tent , and entered into Rachel s tent .
translation.kha: U Laban u leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong u Jakob , nangta u leit sha ïingjaiñ jong ka Leah , bad sha ka ïingjaiñ jong kita ki ar ngut ki mraw kynthei , hynrei um shym lap ïa ki blei jong u . Nangta u leit rung sa ha ka ïingjaiñ jong ka Rakhel .

translation.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee  ; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Men shu khmih ïa kata ka ri na jngai , ka ri ba nga ai ha ki Israel , hynrei men ym ïoh leit rung shata .

translation.en: And Joseph nourished his father , and his brethren , and all his father s household , with bread , according to their families .
translation.kha: U Joseph u pyndap pynbiang jingbam ïa la u kpa , ïa la ki hynmen ki para , bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing u kpa jong u baroh katba ki ïadon , haduh kiba khynnah tam .

translation.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la sdang ban leit da ka lieng tang ma ki hi sha ka jaka kynjah .

translation.en: And he said unto his mother , The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee , about which thou cursedst , and spakest of also in mine ears , behold , the silver is with me  ; I took it . And his mother said , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  , my son .
translation.kha: U ong ha la ka kmie ,  Mynba don ba tuh ïa ki shi hajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa na phi , phi buh ka jingtim halor uta u nongtuh . Nga la ïohsngew phi leh kumta . Khmih , nga don ka pisa . Dei ma nga uba shim ïa ki .  Ka kmie jong u ka ong ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko khun jong nga !

translation.en: But of the cities of these people , which the  Lord  thy God doth give thee for an inheritance , thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong kiba hapoh kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ban long ka jingïohpateng , pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another , Hath any man brought him ought to eat ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki synran ki la sdang ban ïakylli para ma ki hi ,  Hato la don mano mano ba la wanrah jingbam ïa u ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared again in Shiloh : for the  Lord  revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïai pynpaw ïa lade ha Shiloh , naba u la paw ha u Samuel , bad u la kren ruh ha u . Bad haba u Samuel u kren , ki Israel baroh ki shahshkor .

translation.en: When the centurion heard that , he went and told the chief captain , saying , Take heed what thou doest : for this man is a Roman .
translation.kha: Haba uta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u rangbah ai hukum bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ? Utai u briew u dei u traishnong ka Hima Rom ?

translation.en: And I saw the dead , small and great , stand before God  ; and the books were opened : and another book was opened , which is the book of life : and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books , according to their works .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa kiba ïap , kiba rit bad kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba ïeng ha khmat jong ka khet . Ïa ki kitab la plied , bad nangta la plied sa kawei pat ka kitab , ka kitab jong kiba im . Ïa kiba ïap la bishar kat kum kaei kaba ki la leh , kumba la buh jingthoh ha ki kitab .

translation.en: If any of you lack wisdom , let him ask of God , that giveth to all men liberally , and upbraideth not  ; and it shall be given him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno na phi u duna ïa ka jingstad , u dei ban duwai ha U Blei , u ban ai ïa ka ha u ; namar U Blei u ai kylluid bad ai ei ïa baroh .

translation.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering , and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness  ; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering :
translation.kha: Nangta pat u lyngdoh un pynlong sa ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u jingri namar ka jingainguh thang ,

translation.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked  ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .
translation.kha: Me tip ba ngam shym leh pop , bad ba ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban pyllait im ïa nga na me .

translation.en: And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?
translation.kha: Me u khun jong u Ksuid ! Me long u nongshun ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba bha . Me long uba dap da kiba bun jait ki buit bymman , bad me ju ïai pyrshang ban pynphai ïa ki jingshisha jong U Trai sha ki jinglamler !

translation.en: For he shall be like the heath in the desert , and shall not see when good cometh  ; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness , in a salt land and not inhabited .
translation.kha: U long kum ka bniap ha ka ri shyiap , kaba mih ha ka ri khlaw baryngkhiang , halor ka khyndew mluh ha kaba ym don kaei kaei kaba mih . Ym don kano kano kaba bha kaba la ju jia ha u .

translation.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba hynñiewspah hynñiewphew hynñiew snem .

translation.en: And the King shall answer and say unto them , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren , ye have done it unto me .
translation.kha: U Syiem un jubab , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ba man ba phi leh ïa kane na ka bynta uno uno uba rit tam na kine ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong nga , phi la leh ïa kane na ka bynta jong nga !’

translation.en: Behold , I have made thy face strong against their faces , and thy forehead strong against their foreheads .
translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ïa me uba mutlop bad eh dohnud kum ma ki .

translation.en: Then the king of Israel said , Take ye Micaiah , and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam ,  Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad leit lam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat ka nongbah , bad sha u khun syiem Joash .

translation.en: And when she had thus said , she turned herself back , and saw Jesus standing , and knew not that it was Jesus .
translation.kha: Te ka la phai dien bad ka la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïeng hangta ; hynrei kam shym tip ba u dei U Jisu .

translation.en: Then shall his mind change , and he shall pass over , and offend , imputing this his power unto his god .
translation.kha: Nangta ki her noh kum ka lyer bad ki jah syndon , kine ki briew kiba ka bor ka long u blei jong ki .

translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely because my flock became a prey , and my flock became meat to every beast of the field , because there was no shepherd , neither did my shepherds search for my flock , but the shepherds fed themselves , and fed not my flock  ;
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , phin kham bha ba phi shahshkor ïa nga . Ki langbrot jong nga ki la shah patar ha ki mradkhlaw kiba pynïap bad bam ïa ki namar bym don u nongsharai . Ki nongsharai jong nga kim shym la pyrshang ban wad ïa ki langbrot . Ki la sumar bha ïa lade bad ym ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother : in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger : in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh ha ka nongbah uba burom ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Phi shukor ïa ki nongwei bad shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet .

translation.en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain , or if I command the locusts to devour the land , or if I send pestilence among my people  ;
translation.kha: Man ba nga khang ïa u slap ba un ym hap lane phah ïa ki puit ban bam ïa ki jingthung lane phah ïa ka khlam ha ki briew jong nga ,

translation.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind , or be troubled , neither by spirit , nor by word , nor by letter as from us , as that the day of Christ is at hand .
translation.kha: ban ym shah pynshaïong jingmut da kaba suk ha ka jingpyrkhat jong phi lane ban shah pynkhuslai da ka jingkam ba ka Sngi jong U Trai ka la lah wan . Lehse ka long ba la mut ba ngi la ong ïa kane katba ngi dang ïathuhlypa lane ïalap , lane ba ngi la thoh ïa ka ha ka shithi .

translation.en: The nobleman saith unto him , Sir , come down ere my child die .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  la phai ktien u rangbah synshar ,  to wan bad nga shuwa ba u khun jong nga un ïap .

translation.en: As many as I love , I rebuke and chasten : be zealous therefore , and repent .
translation.kha: Nga sneng bad sympat ïa baroh kiba nga ieit . Long kaba thrang eh , te , bad phai noh na ki pop jong pha .

translation.en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment , and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate .
translation.kha: Un ai ïa ka jingshemphang jong ka jingbishar hok ïa kito kiba trei kum ki nongbishar , bad ka jingshlur ïa kito kiba ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah na ka jingshah hiarthma .

translation.en: And hearing the multitude pass by , he asked what it meant .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba u paidbah u ïaid najan , u la kylli ,  Kaei kane ?

translation.en: So the  Lord  was with Joshua  ; and his fame was noised throughout all the country .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joshua , bad ka nam jong u ka saphriang kylleng kata ka ri .

translation.en: The Jews then which were with her in the house , and comforted her , when they saw Mary , that she rose up hastily and went out , followed her , saying , She goeth unto the grave to weep there .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don hapoh ïing bad ka Mari , ban pyntngen ïa ka , ki la ïabud ïa ka haba ki la ïohi ba ka la ïeng joit bad mih kyrkieh . Ki la pyrkhat ba ka leit sha ka jingtep ban ïam hangta .

translation.en: They said therefore unto him , What sign shewest thou then , that we may see , and believe thee ? what dost thou work ?
translation.kha: Ki la phai ktien ,  Ka kambah aïu men leh ba ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka bad ngeit ha me ? Kaei ba men leh ?

translation.en: Quench not the Spirit .
translation.kha: Wat khang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;

translation.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee  ; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again .
translation.kha: Ai ha uno uno uba pan na phi ïa kano kano , bad haba uno uno u shim ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong phi , wat pan shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab , and upon the head of his seed for ever : but upon David , and upon his seed , and upon his house , and upon his throne , shall there be peace for ever from the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynshitom ïa ka jingshah pynïap jong ki kan hap ha u Joab bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u shi junom . Hynrei U  Trai  un ïai ai ka jingjop ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid kiba shong ha ka khet jong u .

translation.en: How forcible are right words ! but what doth your arguing reprove ?
translation.kha: Ki ktien hok ki long kiba lah ban pynngeit , hynrei phi kren khlem don jingmut .

translation.en: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me : forasmuch as when the  Lord  had delivered me into thine hand , thou killedst me not .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi phi la pyn-i haduh katno phi long uba bha ïa nga , naba phim shym la pynïap ïa nga , wat la U  Trai  u la buh ïa nga ha ka bor jong phi .

translation.en: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians , because thou wast unsatiable  ; yea , thou hast played the harlot with them , and yet couldest not be satisfied .
translation.kha: Namar ym shym la pynhun ïa pha da kiwei , pha la leit bud nadien ki nong Assyria . Pha la long ka nuti jong ki , hynrei ki ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .

translation.en: But when the blade was sprung up , and brought forth fruit , then appeared the tares also .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingthung ki la san bad ki kop sohkew ki la sdang mih , te ki ñiut ruh ki la paw .

translation.en: And when they had lifted up their eyes , they saw no man , save Jesus only .
translation.kha: Te haba ki la khmied bad kim shym la ïohi ïano ïano ruh hangta hynrei tang ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: Now gather thyself in troops , O daughter of troops : he hath laid siege against us : they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , lumlang ïa la u paid ! Ngi lah shah kerkut ! Ki ïatur ïaleh ïa u nongïalam ki Israel !

translation.en: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , stand in the holy place ,  ( whoso readeth , let him understand : )
translation.kha: Phin ïohi ïa ‘ Ka Jingijli Bashyrkhei’ ïa kaba u Daniel u nongïathuh lypa u la kren . Kan ïeng ha ka jaka bakhuid .  ( Ka jingkynthoh ïa u nongpule : Da pynthikna ban shemphang aïu kane ka kit jingmut ! )

translation.en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god , even his graven image : he falleth down unto it , and worshippeth it , and prayeth unto it , and saith , Deliver me  ; for thou art my god .
translation.kha: Ka dieng kaba sah u shna ïa ka bleithaw , bad nangta u dem bad mane ïa ka . U duwai ha ka bad u ong ,  Phi long U Blei jong nga — to pynim ïa nga !

translation.en: And the  Lord  said furthermore unto him , Put now thine hand into thy bosom . And he put his hand into his bosom : and when he took it out , behold , his hand was leprous as snow .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren biang ha u Moses ,  Bsuh ïa la ka kti shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me .  U Moses u la kohnguh ; bad ynda u sei pat ïa la ka kti , ka la ïoh jingpang kaba la tap da ki jingthohlieh , kum ka ïor .

translation.en: Take away the dross from the silver , and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer .
translation.kha: Weng noh ïa ki jingbymkhuid na ka rupa , bad u nong-ohdur un pynmih ïa kaei kaei kaba itynnat .

translation.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird , the birds round about are against her  ; come ye , assemble all the beasts of the field , come to devour .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga ki long kum ka sim kaba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki kbeit na baroh ki liang . To khot ïa ki mradkhlaw ban wan bad ïashim bynta ha ka jingkhawai !

translation.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above :
translation.kha: Kat kum ki jingbthah kiba khatduh jong u Dabid , ïa baroh ki Lebi la buh jingthoh ba kin shakri haba ki la dap arphew snem ka rta ,

translation.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner , in offering an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh ki traishnong Israel ki dei ban leh ïa kane haba ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day , then rejoice ye in Abimelech , and let him also rejoice in you :
translation.kha: Mynta te , lada kaei kaba phi leh mynta ka sngi ïa u Gideon bad ïa ka longïing jong u ka long da kaba khuid mynsiem bad kaba hok , te to kmen bad u Abimelekh bad ai ba un kmen bad phi .

translation.en: And the people asked him , saying , What shall we do then ?
translation.kha: U paidbah u la kylli ïa u ,  Te kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ?

translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  My meat is to do the will of him that sent me , and to finish his work .
translation.kha: Ka jingbam jong nga ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  ka long ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga bad ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba u la ai ha nga ban leh .

translation.en: And I will set up one shepherd over them , and he shall feed them , even my servant David  ; he shall feed them , and he shall be their shepherd .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa u syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long uwei u nongsharai jong ki , bad un sumar bha ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered , in that your transgressions are discovered , so that in all your doings your sins do appear  ; because , I say , that ye are come to remembrance , ye shall be taken with the hand .
translation.kha: Kane namarkata ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Ïa ki pop jong phi la pynpaw . Baroh ki tip katno kiba bymman phi long . Phi pyn-i ïa la ki pop ha ki kam jong phi baroh . Phi long ba la pynrem , bad ngan aiti noh ïa phi ha ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And the second lot came forth to Simeon , even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families : and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah .
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba ar ka long na ka bynta ki longïing na ka jait Simeon . Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh ka ri kaba la ai ha ka jait Judah .

translation.en: And say unto Tyre , O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea , which art a merchant of the people for many isles , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O Tyre , thou hast said , I am of perfect beauty .
translation.kha: kata ka nongbah kaba ïeng ha tduh jong ka duriaw bad kaba ïakhaïi pateng bad ki briew kiba shong ha man ki rud duriaw . To ong ha ka ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ko Tyros , pha sngewsarong ïa ka jingbhabriew bajanai jong pha .

translation.en: The dead praise not the  Lord  , neither any that go down into silence .
translation.kha: Ïa U  Trai  yn ym ïaroh da kiba ïap , da kino kino kiba leit hiar sha ka ri ka jingsngap jar .

translation.en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant which the  Lord  made with you , then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights , I neither did eat bread nor drink water :
translation.kha: Nga kiew ïa uta u lum ban pdiang ïa ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad phi . Nga sah hangta sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei ei .

translation.en: Thou also , son of man , take thee a tile , and lay it before thee , and portray upon it the city , even Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , shim uwei u maw-it , buh ïa u ha khmat jong me bad pruid dak ha u ban ïeng na ka bynta ka nongbah Jerusalem .

translation.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together , he rebuked the foul spirit , saying unto him ,  Thou dumb and deaf spirit , I charge thee , come out of him , and enter no more into him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u paidbah u la nang kyntur ïa ki , kumta u la hukum ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid .  Mynsiem bakyllut bad bymnang kren ,  u la ong ,  Nga hukum ïa me ban mihnoh na u khynnah bad wat ju rung shuh hapoh jong u !

translation.en: He gave them hail for rain , and flaming fire in their land .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa u phria bad ka leilieh ha ka ri jong ki ha ka jaka jong u slap ;

translation.en: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa u kew jong phi , bad ïa ka jingbam ba phi khreh da u .

translation.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time : and , behold , seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk , rank and good .
translation.kha: U la ïohthiah biang bad u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew . Hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met bad ba ih , ba ki san ha uwei u jyntang .

translation.en: Acquaint now thyself with him , and be at peace : thereby good shall come unto thee .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko Job , ïasuk noh bad U Blei bad sangeh noh na kaba pynlong ïa u kum u nongshun ; lada phi leh kumta , te un sa kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine : yea , their children shall see it , and be glad  ; their heart shall rejoice in the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kin long kiba khlaiñ kum ki shipai , kiba kmen kum ki rangbah kiba la dih waiñ . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin kynmaw ïa kane ka jingjop bad kin kmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh .

translation.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim , unto mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab , that is over against Jericho  ; and behold the land of Canaan , which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession :
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki Lum Abarim kiba ha ka ri Moab marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Jerikho ; kiew ïa u Lum Nebo bad khmih ïa ka ri Kanaan ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,
translation.kha: ka snieh  langsohmoh ba la wieh rong saw , ka snieh kaba bha , bad ka dieng akasia ;

translation.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not , that the spirits are subject unto you  ; but rather rejoice , because your names are written in heaven .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat kmen namar ba ki mynsiem bymman ki kohnguh ïa phi ; pynban , to kmen namar ba ïa ki kyrteng jong phi la thoh ha bneng .

translation.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab , to have sent him to the king  ; but he would not come to him : and when he sent again the second time , he would not come .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah khot ïa u Joab , ban kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha u syiem na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei u Joab um wan . Sa shisien u Absalom u la phah khot ïa u ; bad u Joab u kyntait biang ban wan .

translation.en: And straightway his ears were opened , and the string of his tongue was loosed , and he spake plain .
translation.kha: Shisyndon uta u briew u la lah ban ïohsngew , bad la weng noh ïa kata kaba teh ïa ka jinglah kren jong u , bad u la sdang ban kren khlem kano kano ka jingeh .

translation.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation , because he is thy seed .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh shibun ki khun ki kti ïa u khun jong kata ka mraw ba kin long kawei ka jaitbynriew . U ruh u dei u khun jong me .

translation.en: Little children , it is the last time : and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come , even now are there many antichrists  ; whereby we know that it is the last time .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , kaba kut ka la jan ! La ïathuh ha phi ba u Nongshun jong U Khrist un sa wan ; bad mynta ki nongshun babun jong U Khrist ki la lah paw , bad kumta ngi tip ba kaba kut ka la jan .

translation.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
translation.kha: Ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw ; hynrei U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki bneng .

translation.en: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen , and said , Go in between the wheels , even under the cherub , and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims , and scatter them over the city . And he went in in my sight .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ,  To leit hapdeng ki shalyntem hapoh ki kherub bad pyndap ïa ki kti jong phi da ki rnga ding barhem . Nangta bret ïa ki rnga halor ka nongbah .  Nga la peit ïa u ba u leit .

translation.en: And the disciples came , and said unto him , Why speakest thou unto them in parables ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei me pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi haba me kren ha ki paidbah ?

translation.en: Bless them that curse you , and pray for them which despitefully use you .
translation.kha: kyrkhu ïa kito kiba tim ïa phi , bad duwai na ka bynta kito kiba lehbeiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: Cain , Gibeah , and Timnah  ; ten cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Kain , ka Gibeah , bad ka Timnah : shiphew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I say not unto thee , Until seven times : but , Until seventy times seven .
translation.kha: Em , ym tang hynñiew sien ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  hynrei haduh hynñiewphew sien hynñiew ,

translation.en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth , even apparently , and not in dark speeches  ; and the similitude of the  Lord  shall he behold : wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses ?
translation.kha: Kumta nga ïakren bad u markhmat , da kaba shai , bad ym ha ki jingkyntip ; u la ïohi wat ïa ka dur jong nga . Kumno keiñ phi nud ban kren pyrshah ïa u Moses u shakri jong nga ?

translation.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter ? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle , so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff : they shall part alike .
translation.kha: Ym don u ban mynjur ïa kata ka jingong jong phi ! Baroh dei ban ïasam kumjuh : uta uba sah shadien bad ki jingkit jingbah un ïoh bynta mar katjuh kum uta uba leit sha ka thma .

translation.en: Then shall he bring it to the priest , and the priest shall take his handful of it , even a memorial thereof , and burn it on the altar , according to the offerings made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Un wanrah ïa u ha u lyngdoh , u ban shim shi kham na u kum ka dak ba la ainguh sha U  Trai  , bad un thang ïa u ha ka duwan kum ka jingkñia ainguh bam . Ka long ka jingkñia ban pynkhuid ïa ka pop .

translation.en: Now when they shall fall , they shall be holpen with a little help : but many shall cleave to them with flatteries .
translation.kha: Katba dang don ka jingpynïap , ki briew jong U Blei kin ïoh khyndiat ka jingïarap , wat la kiba bun kiba ïasoh bad ki kin leh kumta na ka bynta ki daw shimet .
