translation.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal , and said unto him , and to the men of Israel , We be come from a far country : now therefore make ye a league with us .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal , bad ki ong ha u Joshua bad ha ki Israel ,  Ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai . Ngi kwah ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .

translation.en: This is a great mystery : but I speak concerning Christ and the church .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingmaïan kaba la pynpaw ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , kaba nga sngewthuh kaba thew ïa U Khrist bad ïa ka balang .

translation.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves .
translation.kha: Wat ai phlangïap    shuh ïa kine ki briew ban shna maw-it . Ieh kin leit ïawad phlangïap hi da lade .

translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill , to set them among princes , and to make them inherit the throne of glory : for the pillars of the earth are the  Lord s  , and he hath set the world upon them .
translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba duk na ka dewmet , bad u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki . U pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem , bad buh ïa ki , ha ki jaka badonburom . Ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ki dei ki jong U  Trai  ; bad ha ki u la pynshong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .
translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki , ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u bad la pynbaptis ïa ki , bad kumba lai hajar ngut ki briew la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: As touching our brother Apollos , I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren : but his will was not at all to come at this time ; but he will come when he shall have convenient time .
translation.kha: Mynta , shaphang u Apollos u parabangeit , nga la ju pynshlur ïa u ban wan jngoh ïa phi ryngkat bad kiwei ki parabangeit , hynrei um da mon eh ban wan ha kane ka por . Pynban , ynda u ïoh ïa ka lad , un sa wan .

translation.en: And he said , Men , brethren , and fathers , hearken  ; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham , when he was in Mesopotamia , before he dwelt in Charran ,
translation.kha: U Stephan u la jubab ,  Ko ki hynmen ki para bad ko ki kpa , shahshkor ïa nga ! Ha shuwa ba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Abraham un leit noh ban shong ha Haran , U Blei ka burom u la mihpaw ha u ha Mesopotamia bad u la ong ha u ,

translation.en: But I have said unto you , Ye shall inherit their land , and I will give it unto you to possess it , a land that floweth with milk and honey : I am the  Lord  your God , which have separated you from other people .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la kular ha phi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi , bad ngan ai ïa ka ha phi . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: For every man shall bear his own burden .
translation.kha: Manla u briew un hab ban kit ïa la ki jong ki jingeh .

translation.en: He hath set me in dark places , as they that be dead of old .
translation.kha: U la pynbor ïa nga ban shong ha ka jingdum baneh hajuh jong ka jingïap .

translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : but whosoever will lose his life for my sake , the same shall save it .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh ïa ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un pynim ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass afterward , that David s heart smote him , because he had cut off Saul s skirt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong u Dabid ka sdang ban pynjynjar ïa u ,

translation.en: Also cedar trees in abundance : for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David .
translation.kha: U pynbeit ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Sidon ban wanlam sha u shibun ki dieng Kedar tylli .

translation.en: And he took thereof in his hands , and went on eating , and came to his father and mother , and he gave them , and they did eat : but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion .
translation.kha: U khur ïa kata ka ngap ha la ka kti bad u da bam ïa ka katba u dang ïaid ha la ka lynti . Nangta u leit sha la u kpa bad sha la ka kmie bad u ai ïa ki mar khyndiat . Ki bam ïa ka , hynrei u Samson um shym ïathuh ha ki ba u la shim ïa kata ka ngap na ka metïap u sing .

translation.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation , and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations : as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Pateng la pateng , kijuh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ki teh ïa phi bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi . Ma phi bad ma ki phi ïalong kumjuh ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: For the Father judgeth no man , but hath committed all judgment unto the Son :
translation.kha: Lymne U Kpa da lade hi um bishar ïano ïano . U la ai ha la U Khun ïa ka hok baroh ban bishar , ba baroh kin burom ïa U Khun kumba ki burom ïa U Kpa .

translation.en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock , and to scourge , and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again .
translation.kha: Kin pynrem ïa u sha ka jingïap bad kin aiti ïa u ha ki Jentil , ki ban krenbeiñ ïa u , kin sympat ïa u , bad kin sahnarphna ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .

translation.en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears , and brought them unto Aaron .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paidbah baroh ki ïalaw noh ïa la ki sohshkor ksiar bad ki wallam ïa ki ha u Aaron .

translation.en: O my dove , that art in the clefts of the rock , in the secret places of the stairs , let me see thy countenance , let me hear thy voice  ; for sweet is thy voice , and thy countenance is comely .
translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u long kum ki syntiew khlaw kiba phuh ha ki bri sohwaiñ ha Engedi .

translation.en: And when thou art spoiled , what wilt thou do ? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson , though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold , though thou rentest thy face with painting , in vain shalt thou make thyself fair  ; thy lovers will despise thee , they will seek thy life .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , pha long kaba la tim ! Balei pha riam ha kaba saw syn-iang ? Balei pha deng jingdeng bad airong ïa ki khmat jong pha ? Pha pynbhabriew ïa lade ym na ka bynta kano kano ! Ki nongleh-ieit jong pha ki la kyntait ïa pha bad ki kwah ban pynïap ïa pha .

translation.en: And as they led him away , they laid hold upon one Simon , a Cyrenian , coming out of the country , and on him they laid the cross , that he might bear it after Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ïalam noh ïa U Jisu , bad katba ki dang leit , ki la ïashem ïa u briew uba ka Kyrini uba kyrteng u Simon uba la wan rung sha ka nongbah . Ki la kem ïa u , ki buh ïa ka diengphna halor jong u , bad ki la pynlong ïa u ban bah ïa ka hadien U Jisu .

translation.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness , reap in mercy  ; break up your fallow ground : for it is time to seek the  Lord  , till he come and rain righteousness upon you .
translation.kha: Nga la ong , ‘ Lur ïa ka khyndew thymmai na ka bynta ïa lade , bet ïa ka jinglehhok , bad ot ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba ka jingmane ïa nga kan pynmih . Ka la dei ka por ïa phi ban phai sha nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad ngan sa wan bad theh ki jingkyrkhu halor jong phi .’

translation.en: Lay thine hand upon him , remember the battle , do no more .
translation.kha: Ktah ïa u shisien bad men ym pyrshang shuh da lei lei ; men ym klet da lei lei ïa ka jingïaleh !

translation.en: And I will take you to me for a people , and I will be to you a God : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God , which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga , bad nga ngan long U Blei jong phi . Phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi haba nga pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: For , behold , I will send serpents , cockatrices , among you , which will not be charmed , and they shall bite you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Husiar !  U  Trai  u ong ,  nga phah ki bseiñ hapdeng jong phi , ki bseiñ don bih ki bym lah ban pynshohbieit , bad kin puh ïa phi .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay : and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba dang lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Hasael , un shah pynïap ha u Jehu , bad uno uno uba lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Jehu un shah pynïap ha u Elisha .

translation.en: Yet ye have forsaken me , and served other gods : wherefore I will deliver you no more .
translation.kha: Pynban phi dang iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; kumta ngan ym pyllait ïa phi sa shisien pat .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Amaziah had done  ;
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa u kpa jong u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Behold , I send an Angel before thee , to keep thee in the way , and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa u angel ha shuwa jong phi ban ïada ïa phi haba phi leit jingleit bad ban ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka jaka kaba nga la pynkhreh .

translation.en: Of a talent of pure gold made he it , and all the vessels thereof .
translation.kha: U pyndonkam kumba laiphew san kilo ka ksiar nylla ban shna ïa uta u diengpynïeng sharak bad ïa ki jingpyndait jong u baroh .

translation.en: But as for thee , stand thou here by me , and I will speak unto thee all the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which thou shalt teach them , that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it .
translation.kha: Hynrei me pat , Moses , men sah hangne bad nga , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Hikai ïa ki ha u paidbah ba kin sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki .’

translation.en: And they came with haste , and found Mary , and Joseph , and the babe lying in a manger .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit kloi bad ki la shem ïa ka Mari bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa u khunlung uba thiah ha ka shyngoid .

translation.en: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation , upon the side of the tabernacle northward , without the veil .
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka miej hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei , shabar kata ka pyrda ,

translation.en: And he became very hungry , and would have eaten : but while they made ready , he fell into a trance ,
translation.kha: U la sngew thngan , bad u la kwah ban bam ei ei ; katba dang pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam , u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven  ; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days :
translation.kha: U Moses u rah ïa la ka kti shajrong , bad kumta ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka la dum ngaiñ lai sngi lynter .

translation.en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land : and yet there are five years , in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest .
translation.kha: Kane ka long tang ka snem kaba ar jong ka  nemsniew ha kane ka ri , bad kan dang sah sa san snem ha kiba yn ym don ba lur ne ba ot .

translation.en: And he answered , I have not troubled Israel  ; but thou , and thy father s house , in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the  Lord  , and thou hast followed Baalim .
translation.kha: Ngam dei u nongthaw jingkulmar ,  u Elijah u la jubab .  Dei ma phi — ma phi bad u kpa jong phi . Phim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  bad phi mane ïa ki bleithaw u Baal .

translation.en: Only they would that we should remember the poor ; the same which I also was forward to do .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki kyntu ka long ba ngin kynmaw ïa kiba kyrduh ha ka kynhun jong ki , kaba nga hi ruh nga da kwah eh ban leh .

translation.en: Drink no longer water , but use a little wine for thy stomach s sake and thine often infirmities .
translation.kha: Wat dih tang ïa ka um , hynrei shim khyndiat ka waiñ ban ïarap ïa ka  nierbah jong me , naba me long uba pang khah khah .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another , as ye walk , and are sad ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Shaphang kaei ba phi ïakren para ma phi , katba phi nang ïa-ïaid ?  Ki la ïeng , lem bad ka durkhmat basngewsih .

translation.en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse : Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha ki briew jong U Blei ha Kolossai kiba long ki parabangeit baïaineh ha U Khrist : Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: For the son dishonoureth the father , the daughter riseth up against her mother , the daughter in law against her mother in law  ; a man s enemies are the men of his own house .
translation.kha: Ha kine ki por , ki khun shynrang ki ñiew ïa la ki kpa kum kiba bieit , ki khun kynthei ki pyrshah ïa la ki kmie , bad ki kynthei samla ki ïakajia bad la ki kiaw ; ki nongshun jong u briew ki dei ki dkhot na ka longïing jong u hi .

translation.en: Which is the sweetest fruit ?
translation.kha: Uei u Soh u ba thiang bha ?

translation.en: Then called he them in , and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them , and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him .
translation.kha: U Petros u la khot sngewbha ïa kita ki rangbah shapoh bad u la kyrpad jur ïa ki ban sahmiet hangta . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la khreh bad u la leit bad ki ; bad katto katne ngut ki parabangeit na Joppa ki la ïasynran lem ïa u .

translation.en: If we say , We will enter into the city , then the famine is in the city , and we shall die there : and if we sit still here , we die also . Now therefore come , and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians : if they save us alive , we shall live  ; and if they kill us , we shall but die .
translation.kha: Kam long ka jingmyntoi ïa ngi ban leit shapoh ka nongbah namar ngin sa ïapthngan hangta , hynrei lada ngi shong hangne , ngin ïap kumjuh . Kumta , ïa ngin ïaleit noh sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria ; kaba sniew tam ba ki lah ban leh ka long ba kin pynïap ïa ngi , hynrei lehse kin pyllait im ïa ngi .

translation.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day , it is not hidden from thee , neither is it far off .
translation.kha: Ka hukum ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi kam dei kaba eh ban sngewthuh lane kaba sha palat ka bor jong phi .

translation.en: For John truly baptized with water  ; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei ha ki khyndiat sngi yn sa pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And king Solomon , and all the congregation of Israel , that were assembled unto him , were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and oxen , that could not be told nor numbered for multitude .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalumlang ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki kñia ainguh da bun bah ki langbrot bad ki masi — bun katta katta bym lah ñiew shuh .

translation.en: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel  ; the fire devoureth both the ends of it , and the midst of it is burned . Is it meet for any work ?
translation.kha: Ka bha tang ban thang ding . Haba ki tduh ki la ing lut khoit bad ba ka pdeng ka la kylla rnga , hato phi lah ban shna ei ei na ka ?

translation.en: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy land , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa phi da kaba pynduna ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , da kaba pynduna ïa ka jingseisoh ki jingthung jong phi , bad da kaba pynduna ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .

translation.en: This I say then , Walk in the Spirit , and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba nga ong : Shah ïa U Mynsiem ba un pynïaid ïa ki jingim jong phi , bad phin ym pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh .

translation.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh , and whereby indeed he divineth ? ye have done evil in so doing .
translation.kha: Balei phi tuh ïa ka khuri rupa u kynrad jong nga ? Ka dei kaba u ju pyndonkam ban dih na ka , kaba u ju pyndonkam ha ka kheiñ ka bishar ? Phi la leh ïa ka kam kaba shyrkhei .’

translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Defraud not , Honour thy father and mother .
translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; wat tuh ; wat kynnoh bym dei ïano ïano ; wat thok ; burom ïa u kpa jong me bad ïa ka kmie jong me .’

translation.en: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies , and seest horses , and chariots , and a people more than thou , be not afraid of them : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Haba phi leit ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad phi ïohi ba ki kali ïaleh thma , ki kulai , bad ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ban ïa ki jong phi , wat sheptieng ïa ki . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt , un don ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep : and there came down a storm of wind on the lake  ; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit ha ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïohthiah . Kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la sdang ban dap da ka um , ba kumta baroh ki la don ha ka jingma kaba khraw .

translation.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee  ; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips .
translation.kha: bad phin long kiba kmen lada phin kynmaw ïa ki bad phi lah ban kren ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And as they heard these things , he added and spake a parable , because he was nigh to Jerusalem , and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear .
translation.kha: Katba ki briew ki dang shahshkor ïa kane , U Jisu u la bteng bad u la ïathuh ïa ka pharshi ha ki . U la jan poi artat ha Jerusalem , bad ki la tharai ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jan paw .

translation.en: Who giveth food to all flesh : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: U ai jingbam ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him , and he shall direct thy paths .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa U  Trai  ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , bad un pyn-i ha phi ïa ki lynti kaba dei .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise the  Lord  , O my soul .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga !

translation.en: For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi pat , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , la khot ïa phi ban long kiba laitluid . Hynrei wat shah ba kane ka jinglaitluid kan kylla long ka jingailad ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ban synshar ïa phi . Pynban , ai ba ka jingieit kan pynlong ïa phi ban ïashakri iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you , and until they also possess the land which the  Lord  your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you .
translation.kha: Ïarap lem ïa la ki para Israel haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki sha sepngi na Jordan bad haduh ba U  Trai  un shah ba kin im suk im saiñ hangta , kumba u la leh ïa phi hangne . Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan phai sha kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Fire , and hail  ; snow , and vapour  ; stormy wind fulfilling his word :
translation.kha: phi ka leilieh bad u phria , ka ïor bad ki lyoh , ki lyer bakhlaiñ kiba kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .

translation.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance  ; the sacrifices of the  Lord  God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance , as he said unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . Kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ha u Moses , ki dei ban pdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki , ïa ka bhah jong ki jingainguh ba la thang ha ka duwan sha U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Henceforth I call you not servants  ; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth : but I have called you friends  ; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you .
translation.kha: Ngam khot shuh ïa phi ki shakri , namar u shakri um tip aïu u kynrad u leh . Pynban , nga khot ïa phi ki paralok , namar nga la ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ïohsngew na U Kpa jong nga .

translation.en: Thank you for taking the time to examine this brochure in order to familiarize yourself with Jehovah’s Witnesses as a people , to learn about our activities , and to see our organization in action .
translation.kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la ai por ban peit bniah ïa kane ka kot lyngkdop khnang ban tip shaphang ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , ïa ki kam jong ngi , bad ïa ki jingtreikam ka seng jong ngi .

translation.en: Can you give me your pen ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ai u khulom jong phi ?

translation.en: And they sat down to eat bread : and they lifted up their eyes and looked , and , behold , a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh , going to carry it down to Egypt .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , kynsan ki la ïohi shi kynhun ki nong Ishmael kiba wan ïaid lynti na Gilead sha Ijipt . Ïa ki ut jong ki la pynkit ïa ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih .

translation.en: And the saying pleased me well : and I took twelve men of you , one of a tribe :
translation.kha: Nga la sngewdei ïa kata ka jingai jingmut ; kumta nga la jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait .

translation.en: Those that be near , and those that be far from thee , shall mock thee , which art infamous and much vexed .
translation.kha: Ki ri ba-marjan bad ki ri ba hajngai ki krenbeiñ ïa pha namar ka jingbymdon aiñ ha pha .

translation.en: Who bare record of the word of God , and of the testimony of Jesus Christ , and of all things that he saw .
translation.kha: bad u Ïoannis u la ïathuh ïa baroh kaba u la ïohi . Kane ka long ka jingïathuh jong u shaphang ka khubor na U Blei bad ka jingshisha ba la pynpaw da U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: And the remnant of the sodomites , which remained in the days of his father Asa , he took out of the land .
translation.kha: U la pynduh jait ïa baroh ki nuti shynrang bad kynthei kiba shakri ha ki duwan jong ki blei thala kiba dang sah naduh ki sngi u Asa u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And the king of Israel went out , and smote the horses and chariots , and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab , u la hiar sha madan , u la knieh ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u jop thiaw ïa ki nong Syria .

translation.en: And they that weep , as though they wept not ; and they that rejoice , as though they rejoiced not ; and they that buy , as though they possessed not ;
translation.kha: kita kiba ïam , kumba kim shym la sngewsih ; kito kiba rkhie , kumba kim shym la don ka jingkmen ; bad kito kiba ïathied , kumba kim shym long trai ïa kaei kaba ki la thied ;

translation.en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh  ; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh : he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land , of every one according to his taxation , to give it unto Pharaoh–neco .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoïakim u la lum khajna na ki briew kat kum ka jingdon spah jong ki , khnang ban pynmih ïa ka pisa ba dei ban siew ïa ka bai nguh syiem kumba la dawa da u syiem Ijipt .

translation.en: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was , and her two daughters in law with her  ; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah .
translation.kha: Ki ïamih ban leit phai lang sha Judah , hynrei ha lynti ka ong ïa ki ,

translation.en: The king of Jerusalem , one  ; the king of Hebron , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Jerusalem , ka Hebron ,

translation.en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man : but God is faithful , who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able ; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape , that ye may be able to bear it .
translation.kha: Man la ka jingtynjuh kaba phi la mad ka long kata kaba ju wan ha ki briew . Hynrei U Blei u long uba bat ïa la ka kular , bad un ym shah ban tynjuh ïa phi sha palat ka bor jong phi ba phin ïoh ïaineh skhem ; ha ka por ba phi shah tynjuh , un ai ha phi ïa ka bor ba phi lah ban shah ïa ka , bad kumta un thaw ïa ka lad ba phi lah ban lait na ka .

translation.en: Have pity upon me , have pity upon me , O ye my friends  ; for the hand of God hath touched me .
translation.kha: Phi long ki paralok jong nga ! To isynei ïa nga ! Ka kti U Blei ka la ïaleh ïa nga .

translation.en: For it is a day of trouble , and of treading down , and of perplexity by the Lord  God  of hosts in the valley of vision , breaking down the walls , and of crying to the mountains .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka por jong ka jingkhih jingmut , ka jingshahjop , bad ka jingkulmar jingmut ha ka Them ka Jingïohipaw , bad U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa ka ha ngi . Ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongbah jong ngi la tied pynkhyllem , bad ki jingkyang ban ïoh jingïarap ki la sawa hapdeng ki lum .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron , Because ye believed me not , to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la sneng tyngeh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron . U ong  Namar ba phim don ka jingngeit kaba skhem ban pynpaw ïa ka bor bakhuid jong nga ha khmat ki paid Israel , phin ym ïoh ban ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi shaphang kito kiba pyrshang ban shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: And they that went before , and they that followed , cried , saying , Hosanna  ; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord :
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don ha khmat bad kito kiba bud nadien ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  Ïaroh ïa U Blei ! U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai !

translation.en: And when he had said these things , all his adversaries were ashamed : and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him .
translation.kha: Ka jingjubab jong u ka pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong u ban sngewlehrain ïa lade , katba ki briew ki la risa ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phylla kiba u la leh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ,

translation.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel , and all the heads of the tribes , the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel , unto king Solomon in Jerusalem , that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of the city of David , which is Zion .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u phah khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ki jait bad ki kur jong ki Israel ban wan sha u sha Jerusalem khnang ban leit shim noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  na ka Seïon , ka Nongbah u Dabid , sha ka Templ .

translation.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam , who did sin , and who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un iehnoh ïa ki Israel namar ba u Jeroboam u la leh pop bad u la ïalam ïa ki paid Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And he shall look on the plague , and , behold , if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes , greenish or reddish , which in sight are lower than the wall  ;
translation.kha: Lada don ki dak lam jyrngam lane lam saw kiba paw kumba ki la ngam ha ka kynroh ,

translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
translation.kha: Balei , te , ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u para jong phi , bad phi khlem pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng hapoh ka khmat jong phi hi ?

translation.en: This he said , signifying what death he should die .
translation.kha: ( Haba u ong ïa kane u kdew ïa ka jingïap kaba kumno un shah . )

translation.en: For thou writest bitter things against me , and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth .
translation.kha: Me wanrah ïa ki jingujor bakthang pyrshah ïa nga , wat ïa kaba nga la leh mynba nga dang khynnah .

translation.en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized  ; and there he abode .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit phai biang sha shiliang ka wah Jordan sha ka jaka ha kaba u Ïoannis u la ju pynbaptis , bad u la sah hangta .

translation.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: u la tei ïa ka pyrthei halor ki um bajylliew ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: When a ruler hath sinned , and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  his God concerning things which should not be done , and is guilty  ;
translation.kha: Lada u dei u nongsynshar uba leh pop khlem tip bad u hap ha ka jingpynrem ba u la pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long u Messaïah !’ bad kin shukor ïa ki briew kiba bun .

translation.en: How much are these ?
translation.kha: Katno kine ?

translation.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart  ; they are revolted and gone .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi ki briew ! Phi long kiba eh ryndang bad kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ; phi la phai noh sharud bad iehnoh ïa nga .

translation.en: As for me , is my complaint to man ? and if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled ?
translation.kha: Ka jingïania jong nga kam dei bad ki briew ki bym im junom ; nga don ka daw kaba biang ba ngam lah ban ïaishah .

translation.en: The Father loveth the Son , and hath given all things into his hand .
translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa la U Khun bad u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka bor jong u .

translation.en: Behold , the hour cometh , yea , is now come , that ye shall be scattered , every man to his own , and shall leave me alone : and yet I am not alone , because the Father is with me .
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi , bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ïa phi baroh yn sa pynsakma , uwei pa uwei sha la ka jong ka ïing , bad ngan shah iehnoh tang marwei . Hynrei ngam long shisha marwei , namar U Kpa u long lem bad nga .

translation.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem , and the city was besieged .
translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ba ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , ha ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Nebukhadnessar , ki la tur pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kerkut ïa ka .

translation.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the  Lord  for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the  Lord  to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka miet ba U  Trai  u ap miet ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ïa kane kajuh ka miet la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  pateng la pateng kum ka miet ha kaba ki Israel ki dei ban ap miet .

translation.en: Then will I make their waters deep , and cause their rivers to run like oil , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ïa ki um jong me ban long jai jai bad ngan pynlong sngur bad ngan shah ïa ki wah jong me ba kin tuid jai jai . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt , and that the  Lord  thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm : therefore the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kynmaw ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt , bad ba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga la pyllait im ïa phi da ka borbah jong nga . Dei namar kata ba nga hukum ïa phi ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them , to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands :
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kato ka por ba nga la kular ban shim noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la jied na ka bynta jong ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri kaba kynsai tam na baroh .

translation.en: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon s princes , then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans , and they shall burn it with fire , and thou shalt not escape out of their hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim pyndem , te ïa kane ka nongbah yn aiti noh sha ki nong Babilonia , ki ban sa thang duh ïa ka , bad phin ym lait im na ki .

translation.en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness .
translation.kha: Pynthikna , te , ba ka jingshai hapoh jong phi kam dei ka jingdum .

translation.en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat : because he hath nothing left him in the siege , and in the straitness , wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates .
translation.kha: Wat u briew uba jem tam ka dohnud uba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , un poi ha ka kutlad ha ka por ba u shah kerkut , kat ban da bam ïa la ki khun namar ba um don kawei pat ka jait jingbam . Un ym ai ei ei wat ïa la u para ne ka tnga kaba u ieit ne ïa la ki khun kiba dang don bad u .

translation.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said ,  Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .
translation.kha: Ki la pyntyllun noh ïa uta u mawkhang . U Jisu u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong ,  Nga ainguh ïa me , ko Kpa , ba me shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel , and the hair of thine head like purple  ; the king is held in the galleries .
translation.kha: Pynphai ïa ki khmat jong phi shawei pat na nga ; ki pynshohbieit ïa nga . U shñiuh jong phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba ïaid sha trai jong ki lum ka Gilead .

translation.en: And they buried him  ; and all Israel mourned for him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad ki tep ïa u , kumba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba u shakri jong u , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Now therefore be content , look upon me  ; for it is evident unto you if I lie .
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ka durkhmat jong nga . Ngam shukor .

translation.en: And again he sent another servant : and they beat him also , and entreated him shamefully , and sent him away empty .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah sa uwei pat u mraw ; hynrei , ki nongshimwai ki shoh ïa une ruh , ki da leh pynjahburom ïa u , bad ki la phah noh thylli ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore hear , ye nations , and know , O congregation , what is among them .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor phi ki jaitbynriew , bad to tip kaei ka ban jia ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: There is no fear in love  ; but perfect love casteth out fear : because fear hath torment . He that feareth is not made perfect in love .
translation.kha: Ym don ka jingsheptieng ha ka jingieit ; ka jingieit kaba janai ka beh noh ïa ka jingsheptieng baroh . Kumta te , ïa ka jingieit ym shym la pynjanai ha uno uno uba sheptieng , namar ka jingsheptieng ka don jingïadei bad ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab , and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah , Joab s brother , and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite . And the king said unto the people , I will surely go forth with you myself also .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , ryngkat bad u Joab lem bad u Abishai , u para jong u Joab bad u Ittai uba na Gath , kiba long ki nongai hukum ha la ka kynhun kynhun . Bad u syiem u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  Nga ruh da lade ngan leit lang bad phi .

translation.en: He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kaba pynrem ïa kiba lui lui lane kaba pynksan ïa ki bymman — baroh ar ki long ka jingijli ha U  Trai .

translation.en: Remove thy way far from her , and come not nigh the door of her house :
translation.kha: Pynjngai ïa lade na kum kata ka briew , wat ju leit tur sha jan ka jingkhang ka ïing jong ka .

translation.en: And saying , Repent ye : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
translation.kha: To phai noh na ki pop jong phi ,  u la ong ,  naba ka Hima ki bneng ka la jan !

translation.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be  ; but the end shall not be yet .
translation.kha: Bad wat sngewkhuslai haba phi ïohsngew ki jingsawa ki thma hajan jong phi bad ïa ki khubor jong ki thma jngai na phi . Ka dei ïa kine kiei kiei ban jia , hynrei kam mut ba ka jingkut ka la long .

translation.en: Or if there be any flesh , in the skin whereof there is a hot burning , and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot , somewhat reddish , or white  ;
translation.kha: Haba u briew u khluit ding , bad lada ka sniehdoh ka kylla lieh ne lam byrsaw-lieh , u lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the next day , when they were come down from the hill , much people met him .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Jisu bad ki lai ngut ki synran ki la hiar na u lum , bad u paidbah babun u la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations than these .
translation.kha: U la kylli ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa katai ? Men sa ïohi shuh shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli .

translation.en: And he saith unto him , Friend , how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment ? And he was speechless .
translation.kha: ‘ Ko paralok , kumno phi ïohrung hangne khlem ki jaiñ shongkurim ?’ u syiem u la kylli ïa u . Hynrei uta u briew um shym ong ei ei .

translation.en: Only be thou strong and very courageous , that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law , which Moses my servant commanded thee : turn not from it to the right hand or to the left , that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Me dei ban da kut jingmut triang , ban long skhem bad ban pynthikna ba men kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u shakri jong nga , u Moses u la ai ha me . Wat leh klet ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka , bad men sa jop kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches . I am the root and the offspring of David , and the bright and morning star .
translation.kha: Nga , U Jisu , nga la phah ïa u angel jong nga ban pynbna ïa kine kiei kiei ha phi ha ki balang . Nga la hiarpateng na ka longïing jong u Dabid ; nga long u khlur step uba phyrnai .

translation.en: And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kita kiba bud ïa kane ka rukom ha ka jingim jong ki , to ai ba ka jingsuk bad ka jingisynei kan long lem bad ki — ïa ki lem bad baroh ki briew jong U Blei !

translation.en: The children which thou shalt have , after thou hast lost the other , shall say again in thine ears , The place is too strait for me : give place to me that I may dwell .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong pha kiba la kha ha ka por ka jinglongmraw ha kawei ka sngi kin ong ha pha , ‘ Kane ka jaka ka rit eh — ngi donkam jaka shuh ban shong !’

translation.en: Afterward shall the children of Israel return , and seek the  Lord  their God , and David their king  ; and shall fear the  Lord  and his goodness in the latter days .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka por kan poi haba ki paid Israel sa shisien pat kin phai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; bad sha uba hiarpateng na u Dabid u syiem jong ki . Nangta kin sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad kin sa ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai babha ki jong u .

translation.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation , and said , It is a people that do err in their heart , and they have not known my ways :
translation.kha: Jin haduh sawphew snem nga la ijli ïa kito ki briew . Nga la ong , ‘ Haduh katno ki long kiba shetkylla ! Ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’

translation.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance , while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and be guilty  ;
translation.kha: Lada dei uwei na ki riewpaidbah uba leh pop khlem tip bad u long uba la rem ba u pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: They did work wilily , and went and made as if they had been ambassadors , and took old sacks upon their asses , and wine bottles , old , and rent , and bound up  ;
translation.kha: bad ki la ïa-rai ban shukor ïa u . Ki la leit bad rah katto katne ka jingbam bad ki pynkit ha ki kada jong ki da ki byrni jot bad ki pla snieh waiñ kiba la syrdep .

translation.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me , and will not hearken unto me  ; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins .
translation.kha: Lada phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad phim treh ban kohnguh ïa nga , ngan pynshitom shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .

translation.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents , and brethren , and kinsfolks , and friends  ; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death .
translation.kha: Yn aiti ïa phi da ki kmie ki kpa jong phi , da ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong phi , da ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , bad da ki paralok jong phi ; bad ïa katto katne na phi yn pynïap .

translation.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom : but within few days he shall be destroyed , neither in anger , nor in battle .
translation.kha: Yn bud ïa u da uwei pat u syiem , u ban phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew da ki khajna na ka bynta ban pynroi ïa ka spah jong ka hima jong u . Tang khyndiat por ïa uta u syiem yn pynïap , hynrei ym ha kaba paw bad ym ha ka thma .

translation.en: And the golden altar , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the tabernacle door ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ksiar , ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , ïa ka jingiwbih , ïa ka pyrda ïa ka jaka rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ ;

translation.en: But his wife said unto him , If the  Lord  were pleased to kill us , he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands , neither would he have shewed us all these things , nor would as at this time have told us such things as these .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka tnga jong u ka jubab ,  Lada U  Trai  u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ngi , un ym jin da la pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong ngi ; un ym jin da la pyn-i ha ngi ïa kine baroh lane ïathuh ha ngi ïa kita kiei kiei mynta .

translation.en: And they lifted up their voices , and said , Jesus , Master , have mercy on us .
translation.kha: Ki la ïeng kham pajih bad ki la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! Ko Kynrad ! To isynei ïa ngi !

translation.en: And they shall turn the rivers far away  ; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up : the reeds and flags shall wither .
translation.kha: Ki shnat jong ka wah kin iwtung katba ki dang rngad suki suki . Ki khah bad ki japung kin jlop ,

translation.en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done , shew them the form of the house , and the fashion thereof , and the goings out thereof , and the comings in thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the laws thereof : and write it in their sight , that they may keep the whole form thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and do them .
translation.kha: Te lada ki sngewlehrain ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , sa batai ïa ka jingthmu jong ka Templ ha ki : Ïa ka jingpynwandur jong ka , ïa ki khyrdop jingrung bad jingmih jong ka , ïa ka dur jong ka , ïa ka jingbuhbeit ryntih ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ïa baroh ki aiñ . To thoh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta jong ki khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi kumno ïa kiei kiei baroh la buh ryntih bad ba lah ban pyndep ïa baroh ki aiñ .

translation.en: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt , furnish thyself to go into captivity : for Memphis shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: To pynkhreh ban shah kem koidi , phi ki briew ka Ijipt ! Ïa ka Memphis yn sa pynlong ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot ha kaba yn ym don ban shong ban sah .

translation.en: Let not my lord , I pray thee , regard this man of Belial , even Nabal : for as his name is , so is he  ; Nabal is his name , and folly is with him : but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord , whom thou didst send .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , wat pynleit jingmut ei ei ïa u Nabal , uto u bym long ei ei ! U dei hi thik kumba ka kyrteng jong u ka mut — u bieit ! Kynrad , ngam shym don hangta haba ki shakri jong phi ki wan poi .

translation.en: Which was the son of Jose , which was the son of Eliezer , which was the son of Jorim , which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Joshua , u khun jong u Elieser , u khun jong u Jorim , u khun jong u Matthat , u khun jong u Lebi ,

translation.en: And go quickly , and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead  ; and , behold , he goeth before you into Galilee  ; there shall ye see him : lo , I have told you .
translation.kha: Khie leit bran bran mynta , bad ïathuh ha ki synran jong u , ‘ La pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , bad mynta u dang leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u !’ To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: But the lad knew not any thing : only Jonathan and David knew the matter .
translation.kha: khlem da peiphang ei ei ka mut aïu kane baroh ; tang u Jonathan bad u Dabid ki tip .

translation.en: Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .
translation.kha: Nangta u la kylli ïa uwei pat , ‘ Bad ma phi — sa katno phi dei ban pynphai ? Shihajar byrni u kew ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane hangne ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ïa u ; ‘ to thoh phraspah .’

translation.en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom , neither shall fruit be in the vines  ; the labour of the olive shall fail , and the fields shall yield no meat  ; the flock shall be cut off from the fold , and there shall be no herd in the stalls :
translation.kha: Wat la ki dieng Dumbur kim don soh bad ym don sohwaiñ ba mih ha ki dieng sohwaiñ , wat la u dieng Olib um sei ei ei bad ki lyngkha kim pynmih kew , wat la ki langbrot baroh ki ïap bad ki sem masi ki thylli ,

translation.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it : but the instruction of fools is folly .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka long ka umpohliew jong ka jingim ha kiba stad , hynrei kaba pyrshang ban ai jinghikai ïa kiba mutlop ka long tang ka jingpynlut kai ïa ka por .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel , At even , then ye shall know that the  Lord  hath brought you out from the land of Egypt :
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ong ha ki Israel baroh ,  Ha kane ka janmiet , phin tip ba dei U  Trai  uba la wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel  ; and the name of his second , Abiah : they were judges in Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U khun uba kham heh u kyrteng u Joel bad uba kham rit , u Abijah ; kine ki long ki nongbishar ha Beersheba .

translation.en: They hunt our steps , that we cannot go in our streets : our end is near , our days are fulfilled  ; for our end is come .
translation.kha: U Nongshun u la ap khmih ïa ngi ; ngim lah wat ban ïaid ha ki lynti bah . Ki sngi jong ngi ki la kut ; kaba kut ka la wan .

translation.en: I gave thee a king in mine anger , and took him away in my wrath .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la ai ha phi ïa ki syiem , bad ha ka jingbitar shla jong nga , nga la shim noh ïa ki .

translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  for his sin which he hath sinned , a female from the flock , a lamb or a kid of the goats , for a sin offering  ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin .
translation.kha: bad kum ka bainong namar ka pop jong u , u dei ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kynthei kum ka jingainguh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew .

translation.en: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence : and likewise also the wife unto the husband .
translation.kha: U briew u dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum u tnga , bad ka briew ka dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum ka tnga , bad ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And the children of Dan went their way : and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him , he turned and went back unto his house .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit sha khmat . U Mikah u ïohi ïa kata ba ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa u , kumta u leit phai noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through , and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . Therefore Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
translation.kha: U ong ha u samla uba rah atiar jong u ,  Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad dung ïap ïa nga , kumta ba kine ki Philistia bymriewblei kin ym ïoh dung bad pynïap ïa nga .  Hynrei uta u samla u la sheptieng eh ban leh ïa kata . Kumta u Saul u shim ïa la ka waitlam bad u rynsied ïa lade ha ka .

translation.en: Let no man say when he is tempted , I am tempted of God : for God cannot be tempted with evil , neither tempteth he any man :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shah pynshoi da kum kita ki jingtynjuh , um dei ban ong ,  Kane ka jingpynshoi ka wan na U Blei .  Naba ïa U Blei ym lah ban pynshoi da kaba sniew , bad ma u hi da lade um pynshoi ïano ïano .

translation.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and sware to him concerning that matter .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u shakri u buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong u Abraham , u kynrad jong u , bad u pynlong ka jingsmai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u Abraham u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah .
translation.kha: Kine ki la pynkthang mynsiem ïa u Isaak bad ïa ka Rebekka .

translation.en: And your strength shall be spent in vain : for your land shall not yield her increase , neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits .
translation.kha: Baroh ka jingtrei shitom jong phi kan long lehnoh-ei , namar ka khyndew jong phi kan ym pynmih jingthung jingtep bad ki dieng kin ym seisoh .

translation.en: And when they had set them in the midst , they asked , By what power , or by what name , have ye done this ?
translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa ki apostol ban ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad kylli ïa ki ,  Kumno phi la leh ïa kane ? Ka bor aïu phi la ïoh lane ïa ka kyrteng jongno phi pyndonkam ?

translation.en: And Elisha said unto her , What shall I do for thee ? tell me , what hast thou in the house ? And she said , Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house , save a pot of oil .
translation.kha: Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u kylli .  Ïathuh ïa nga , phi don aïu ha ïing ?   Ym don ei ei shuh , lait sa tang u khra umphniang Olib uba rit ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: Do not err , my beloved brethren .
translation.kha: To wat shah shukor , phi ki parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga !

translation.en: And they shall say , This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden  ; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced , and are inhabited .
translation.kha: Baroh kin ong kumno kane ka ri , kaba shisien ka la long ka jaka khlaw , ka la kylla long kum ka Kper Eden , bad kumno ba ki nongbah kiba la shah pynjot , shah lute bad shah iehnoh ha ki jingjot , ki long mynta ki jaka shong briew bad ki jaka ba la ker kynroh .

translation.en: Thou , O king , art a king of kings : for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom , power , and strength , and glory .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long uba khraw tam na ki syiem baroh . U Blei ka bneng u la pynlong ïa phi u patsha bad u la ai ha phi ka bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka burom .

translation.en: For she hath cast down many wounded : yea , many strong men have been slain by her .
translation.kha: Naba ka la pynjot shibun ki rangbah bad ka la long ka daw jong ka jingïap kiba bun kiba ym lah ñiew shuh .

translation.en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale s belly  ; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ba u Jonah u la pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet hapoh u dohkha uba heh , kumta U Khun U Briew un pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet ha kiba jylliew jong ka khyndew .

translation.en: And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the priests , and the Levites , and the singers , and the porters , and the Nethinims , unto Jerusalem , in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .
translation.kha: U Esra u long u riewstad uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ka Hukum kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la ai ha u Moses . Namar ba u Esra u don ïa ka jingkyrkhu U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u patsha u ai kat ïa kaba u pan . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u Esra u la mih na Babilonia ban leit sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki Israel kiba kynthup ïa ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem ka Templ , ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ki nongtrei .

translation.en: Dearly beloved , I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims , abstain from fleshly lusts , which war against the soul  ;
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , kum ki sohshnong bad ki nongphetwir ha kane ka pyrthei ! Wat aiti noh ha ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh , kiba long borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ka mynsiem .

translation.en: And say unto him , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority to do these things ?
translation.kha: bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Me don hok aïu ba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?

translation.en: Let all the nations be gathered together , and let the people be assembled : who among them can declare this , and shew us former things ? let them bring forth their witnesses , that they may be justified : or let them hear , and say , It is truth .
translation.kha: Khot hajir ïa ki jaitbynriew ban wan sha ka jingbishar . Kino na ki blei jong ki kiba lah ban ïathuhlypa ïa ka lawei ? Kino na ki kiba la ong lypa kaei ka ban jia mynta ? Ai ba kine ki blei kin wanrah ïa ki sakhi jong ki ban pynshisha ba ki long kiba dei , ban phla ïa ka jingshisha jong ki ktien jong ki .

translation.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , saying , We have sinned against thee , both because we have forsaken our God , and also served Baalim .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki kyang jam ha U  Trai  , ki da ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , namar ngi la iehnoh ïa me , U Blei jong ngi , bad ngi la mane ïa ki Baal .

translation.en: And he denied it again . And a little after , they that stood by said again to Peter , Surely thou art one of them : for thou art a Galilaean , and thy speech agreeth thereto .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la len biang ïa kata . Katto katne por hadien , kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ki la mudui biang ïa u Petros ,  Mem lah ban len ba me long uwei na ki , namar ma me ruh , me long na Galilaïa .

translation.en: And the king answered the people roughly , and forsook the old men s counsel that they gave him  ;
translation.kha: U syiem u kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad u kren tohmet ïa kita ki briew , kumba la ai jingmut kita ki samla .

translation.en: And Araunah said unto David , Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him : behold , here be oxen for burnt sacrifice , and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood .
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad , to shim ïa ka ,  u Araunah u ong ,  bad to kñia ha U  Trai  ïa kano kano kaba phi mon . Kine hangne ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh halor ka duwan ; kine hangne ki dei ki lyngkor jong ki bad ka lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee , to set thee on the throne of Israel : because the  Lord  loved Israel for ever , therefore made he thee king , to do judgment and justice .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ! Uba la pynpaw katno u sngewbha eh ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi u syiem ki Israel . Namar ba U  Trai  u ieit ïa ki Israel junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban synshar bha bad bishar hok .

translation.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold : and there was not one feeble person among their tribes .
translation.kha: Nangta u pynmih bad ïalam noh ïa ki Israel ; ki rah ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad baroh ki la long kiba koit kiba khiah bad kiba khlaiñ .

translation.en: And they covet fields , and take them by violence  ; and houses , and take them away : so they oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .
translation.kha: Haba ki ikwah ïa ki lyngkha , ki shu knieh ïa ki ; haba ki ikwah ïa ki ïing , ki shu shim ïa ki . Ym don ka longïing ne ka jingdon jingem jongno jongno kaba shongshngain .

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor sha ki briew lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa :

translation.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain , a man for the punishment of his sins ?
translation.kha: Balei ngin shu ïai khñium haba la pynshitom ïa ngi na ka bynta ka pop jong ngi .

translation.en: Your fathers , where are they ? and the prophets , do they live for ever ?
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kito ki nongïathuhlypa kim don shuh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: Ask of me , and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .
translation.kha: To pan , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan long ka jong me .

translation.en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times , and his days be prolonged , yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God , which fear before him :
translation.kha: U nongpop u lah ban leh shispah tylli ki kam runar bad u dang im . O ! ho-oid , nga tip ïa kaei ba ki ong :  Lada phi kohnguh ïa U Blei , kiei kiei baroh kin bit kin biang ,

translation.en: While the bridegroom tarried , they all slumbered and slept .
translation.kha: U nongleitkurim u la slem ban wan , kumta ki theisotti ki la sdang ban kohnguh samthiah .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha ki ,  Pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Pyndap ïa ki phyllaw jong ka da ki metïap . Sdang noh ïa ka kam !  Kumta ki la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki briew ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: But I said , How shall I put thee among the children , and give thee a pleasant land , a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations ? and I said , Thou shalt call me , My father  ; and shalt not turn away from me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Israel , nga la kwah ban pdiang ïa pha kum u khun jong nga bad ai ha pha ïa ka ri kaba pynkmen , ka ri kaba itynnat tam ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Nga la kwah ïa pha ban khot pa ïa nga bad ban ym phai shuh da lei lei na nga .

translation.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers , and under his wings shalt thou trust : his truth shall be thy shield and buckler .
translation.kha: Un tap ïa me da ki thapniang jong u ; men long shngain hapoh ka jingsumar jong u ; ka jinglong baïaineh jong u kan ïada bad kyrshan ïa me .

translation.en: And even things without life giving sound , whether pipe or harp , except they give a distinction in the sounds , how shall it be known what is piped or harped ?
translation.kha: Shu shim nuksa ïa ki jingput jingtem ki bym don jingim kum ka tangmuri ne ka duitara — kumno phin tip ïa ka sur lymda la tem ha ki sur kiba shai ?

translation.en: Watch and pray , that ye enter not into temptation : the spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak .
translation.kha: To ïa-ap bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka mon , hynrei ka doh ka tlot .

translation.en: And their king shall go into captivity , he and his princes together , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem jong ki bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , kin shah ringmraw .

translation.en: And thither were all the flocks gathered : and they rolled the stone from the well s mouth , and watered the sheep , and put the stone again upon the well s mouth in his place .
translation.kha: Ha man ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh ki la ïapoi lang hangta , ki nongap langbrot ki ju pyntyllun sharud ïa uta u maw bad ki ai um ïa ki . Nangta ki buh pat ïa uta u maw ha kajuh ka jaka .

translation.en: Be not deceived ; God is not mocked : for whatsoever a man soweth , that shall he also reap .
translation.kha: Wat ym shukor phi ïa lade hi , ym don mano mano uba ñiew bieit ïa U Blei . U briew un ot ïa kaei kaba u bet .

translation.en: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel , unto the place over against the water gate toward the east , and the tower that lieth out .
translation.kha: U Palal , u khun jong u Usai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba sdang na ka dong jong ka kynroh bad ka jingtei ap phira jong ka ïingsyiem kaba haneng kaba long habar ka jaka ap phira ; U Pedaïah , u khun jong u Parosh u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka bynta kaba sha mihngi hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad ka jingtei ap phira ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hajan kata ka bynta jong ka nongbah ba khot Ophel , ha kaba ki nongtrei shynrang ka Templ ki shong ki sah . )

translation.en: He teareth me in his wrath , who hateth me : he gnasheth upon me with his teeth  ; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar U Blei u la pyndkut ïa ki kti ki kjat jong nga ; u peit ïa nga da ka jingisih .

translation.en: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations , or of the bread , remain unto the morning , then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire : it shall not be eaten , because it is holy .
translation.kha: Lada don kaba tam na ka doh ne na u kpu kiba ym shym la lah bam lut haduh mynstep , dei ban thang noh ïa ki . Ym dei ban bam ïa ka , naba ka long kaba kyntang .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the name of the  Lord   ; praise him , O ye servants of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , phi ki shakri jong U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward  ; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times .
translation.kha: Un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad un synreit ïa ka da la ka shynriah ti ha khmat kata ka jingtap , bad nangta un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang .

translation.en: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech , and Seraiah the son of Azriel , and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel , to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet : but the  Lord  hid them .
translation.kha: Nangta u la hukum ïa u khun syiem Jerahmeel , ryngkat bad u Seraïah u khun jong u Asriel bad u Shelemaïah u khun jong u Abdeel , ban kem ïa nga bad ïa u sekretari jong nga u Barukh . Hynrei U  Trai  u la buhrieh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And as they bound him with thongs , Paul said unto the centurion that stood by , Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman , and uncondemned ?
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la lah khum ïa u ban sympat , u Paul u la ong ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam uba ïeng hangta ,  Hato ka shong aiñ ïa me ban sympat ïa u traishnong ka Hima Rom u bym shym la shah bishar na ka bynta kano kano ka kam runar ?

translation.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness : for he is a babe .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba dang dih dud u dang long u khynnah , khlem pat don kano kano ka jingshemphang ïa kaei kaba dei bad ka bymdei .

translation.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place , and the pillars thereof tremble .
translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa ki jumai bad u pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew ; u kynjrat ïa ki païa kiba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And these are they that conspired against him  ; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess , and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess .
translation.kha: ( Kito kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ki dei u Sabad , u khun jong ka nong Ammon kaba kyrteng ka Shimeath , bad u Jehosabad , u khun jong ka nong Moab kaba kyrteng ka Shimrith ) .

translation.en: Of fowls after their kind , and of cattle after their kind , of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind , two of every sort shall come unto thee , to keep them alive .
translation.kha: Shim bad me shapoh kata ka lieng ïa u shynrang bad ka kynthei na kawei pa kawei ka jait mrad bad jait sim baroh , na ka bynta ba yn ri pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: The harvest is past , the summer is ended , and we are not saved .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kyang jam ,  Ka lyiur ka la leit , ka jingot ka la kut , hynrei ym shym la pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God , and the song of the Lamb , saying , Great and marvellous are thy works , Lord God Almighty  ; just and true are thy ways , thou King of saints .
translation.kha: bad ki da rwai ïa ka jingrwai u Moses , u shakri jong U Blei , bad ïa ka jingrwai U Khunlangbrot :  U Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh , katno kiba khraw bad kiba phylla long ki kam jong me ! U Syiem jong ki jaitbynriew , katno kiba dei bad kiba shisha ki long lynti jong me !

translation.en: Behold , I will put a fleece of wool in the floor  ; and if the dew be on the fleece only , and it be dry upon all the earth beside , then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand , as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Te nga buh katto katne u shñiuh langbrot halor ka khyndew ha kaba ngi shoh kew . Lada ha ka por mynstep don umjer tang ha u shñiuh langbrot hynrei ym ha ka khyndew , te ngan tip ba men pyndonkam ïa nga ban pyllait ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did , and his might that he shewed , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Omri u la leh bad baroh ki jingjop jong u la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel , and Erech , and Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .
translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang , ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa ka Babilon , ka Erek , bad ka Akkad , kiba don baroh ha ka ri Babilonia   .

translation.en: And David smote the land , and left neither man nor woman alive , and took away the sheep , and the oxen , and the asses , and the camels , and the apparel , and returned , and came to Achish .
translation.kha: ki da pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei baroh , bad rah noh ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , ki kada , ki ut , bad wat ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem ruh .

translation.en: According to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel made all the work .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki trei ïa kane ka kam baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And the Spirit and the bride say , Come . And let him that heareth say , Come . And let him that is athirst come . And whosoever will , let him take the water of life freely .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem bad ka Nongleitkurim ki ong ,  To wan !  Uwei uwei baroh uba ïohsngew ïa kane u dei ruh ban ong ,  To wan !  To wan , uno uno uba sliang , to pdiang ïa ka um ka jingim kum ka jingai sngewbha , uno uno uba kwah ïa ka .

translation.en: And between the passages , by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines  garrison , there was a sharp rock on the one side , and a sharp rock on the other side : and the name of the one was Bozez , and the name of the other Seneh .
translation.kha: Ha ka khim Mikhmash , na kaba u Jonathan u hap ban ïaid lyngba ban poi sha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia , don ar tylli ki mawlong baheh kiba sohkhruh sohkhram , uwei uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka khim : ïa uwei la khot u Boses bad ïa uwei pat u Seneh .

translation.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets , and laid them on beds and couches , that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them .
translation.kha: Kaba mih na kaei ba ki apostol ki la leh , ka long ba ïa ki briew kiba pang la rah sha ki lynti bah bad la buh ha ki jingthiah bad ki shylliah khang ba la kumno kumno ka syrngiew jong u Petros kan dei ha ki katto katne ngut na ki katba u dang ïaid najan .

translation.en: And he made the candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work made he the candlestick  ; his shaft , and his branch , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , were of the same :
translation.kha: U shna ïa u diengpynïeng sharak uba da ka ksiar nylla . U shna ïa ka trai bad ïa ka ktang    jong u diengpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong jong u , kiba kynthup ïa ki shata bad ki sla jong ki , ki ïasoh lang kawei bad u .

translation.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear .
translation.kha: Kan ym da donkam ïa phi ban da ong , namar kin ïohi katno phi long kiba sngur bad ba donburom ha ka jinglong jingim jong phi .

translation.en: And when he was come nigh , even now at the descent of the mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen  ;
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hajan ka Jerusalem , ha ka jaka ha kaba ka lynti kaba hiar sha u lum ki Olib , ki paid synran jong u kiba bun bah ki la sdang ban ainguh ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa u ha ki sur bajam na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba khraw baroh kiba ki la lah ïohi :

translation.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant , and they that escape out of mount Zion : the zeal of the  Lord  of hosts shall do this .
translation.kha: Kin don ki briew ha Jerusalem bad halor u lum Seïon ki ban lait im , namar U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la thew ban pynjia ïa kane .

translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kren lyngba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa :

translation.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem , and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall .
translation.kha: Phi la shem ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem ki donkam ïa ka jingshna pynbha . Phi la leit khmih ïa ki ïing baroh ha Jerusalem bad phi la pynkhyllem katto katne na ki ban ïoh ki maw ban shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: For we know that the law is spiritual : but I am carnal , sold under sin .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ka Hukum ka long kaba kynja mynsiem ; hynrei nga long u briew uba kynja doh , ba la die kum u mraw ha ka pop .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Go yet , love a woman beloved of her friend , yet an adulteress , according to the love of the  Lord  toward the children of Israel , who look to other gods , and love flagons of wine .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit biang bad leh-ieit ïa ka briew kaba dang ïaleh nuti bad uba ieit jong ka . Me dei ban ieit ïa ka kumba nga ruh nga dang ieit ïa ki paid Israel , wat la ki phai sha kiwei pat ki blei bad ki ieit ban ainguh ha ki bleithaw da ki soh kismis .

translation.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us : for we are not ignorant of his devices .
translation.kha: Haba phi map ïano ïano ïa kaei kaba u la leh , nga ruh nga map ïa u kumjuh . Naba haba nga map — lada , shisha , ka dei ïa nga ban map ïa kano kano — nga leh ïa kata ha khmat U Khrist namar jong phi , khnang ban ym shah ïa u Soitan ban leh donbor halor jong ngi ; naba ngi tip kiei ki jingthmu jong u ki long .

translation.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .
translation.kha: haba nga ong katno ka jingsngewsih jong nga , katno ka jingpang ba khlem kut jong ka dohnud jong nga na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , kiba long ka doh ka snam jong nga!

translation.en: Take ye the spoil of silver , take the spoil of gold : for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture .
translation.kha: To lute ïa ka rupa ! To lute ïa ka ksiar ! Ka nongbah ka dap da ki jingkynshew !

translation.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites , all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh na ka jait Lebi kiba la dap shi bnai bad kham heh ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ñiew shi kur shi kur da ka hukum U  Trai  ki long arphew ar hajar ngut .

translation.en: And as they did eat , Jesus took bread , and blessed , and brake it , and gave to them , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la shim ïa u kpu , u la duwai ainguh bad u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synran jong u ,  Shim ïa u , une u long ka met jong nga  u la ong .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly  ; and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoshaphat u nang roi bad nang khrawbor .

translation.en: I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , or ever the earth was .
translation.kha: Ïa nga la thaw ha kaba sdang eh , ha kaba nyngkong , shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan sdang .

translation.en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly , and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah s son  ;
translation.kha: U ong ,  Namar kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa ki um bajai jai jong ka wahduid Shiloah bad khynñiuh ha khmat jong u syiem Resin bad u syiem Pekah ,

translation.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe , that observe and do  ; but do not ye after their works : for they say , and do not .
translation.kha: Kumta phi dei ban kohnguh bad leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki ; namar ba kim leh ïa kaei kaba ki ïalap .

translation.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good : and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat bad kren ïa kaba sniew u lah ban khmih lynti ban ym shem ei ei kaba bha — tang ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory ; why yet am I also judged as a sinner ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ka ban long lada ka jingbymshisha jong nga ka pynlong ïa ka burom U Blei da kaba pynlong ïa ka jingshisha jong u ban kham paw shai ? Balei yn dang ïai pynrem ïa nga kum u nongpop ?

translation.en: Yet thou sayest , Because I am innocent , surely his anger shall turn from me . Behold , I will plead with thee , because thou sayest , I have not sinned .
translation.kha: Hynrei nalor kane baroh , phi ong , ‘ Nga long uba lui lui , da shisha U  Trai  un ym bitar sah ïa nga .’ Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi len ba phi la leh pop .

translation.en: For God so loved the world , that he gave his only begotten Son , that whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have everlasting life .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la ieit katta katta ïa ka pyrthei kat haduh ba u la aiti noh ïa U Khun ba tang marwei jong u , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ïap noh hynrei un ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: If thou seekest her as silver , and searchest for her as for hid treasures  ;
translation.kha: Wad ïa ka kumba phi wad ïa ka rupa lane ïa kano kano ka spah ba la buhrieh .

translation.en: Receive my instruction , and not silver  ; and knowledge rather than choice gold .
translation.kha: Jied ïa ka jingbthah jong nga , ban ïa ka rupa ; jied ïa ka jingtip , ban ïa ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And the king said , Thou shalt surely die , Ahimelech , thou , and all thy father s house .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ,  Ahimelekh , ma me bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me baroh phi dei ban ïap .

translation.en: The glasses , and the fine linen , and the hoods , and the veils .
translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñ bastang jong ki , ki rumal linen jong ki , bad ïa ki jaiñ teh ryndang bad ki jaiñtapkhmat kiba jrong kiba ki tap ha ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: Wherefore it came to pass , when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived , that she bare a son , and called his name Samuel , saying , Because I have asked him of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Hannah ka punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka la pynkyrteng ïa u , u Samuel , naba ka ong ,  Nga la pan ïa u na U  Trai .

translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying , Behold , the tabernacle of God is with men , and he will dwell with them , and they shall be his people , and God himself shall be with them , and be their God .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka khet :  Mynta ka ïing jong U Blei ka long bad u bynriew ! Un shong bad ki , bad kin long ki briew jong u . U Blei da lade hi un long bad ki , bad un long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And she hasted , and emptied her pitcher into the trough , and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels .
