translation.kha: Ka pynstet ban phylliew ïa ka um na u khiew jong ka ha ka shyngoid ai um ïa ki jingri bad ka mareh sha kata ka pukri ban leit tong um shuh , haduh ba kan da dep ban ai um ïa ki ut jong u baroh .

translation.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up , the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people : and there shall be a time of trouble , such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time : and at that time thy people shall be delivered , every one that shall be found written in the book .
translation.kha: U angel uba kup ki jaiñ linen u la ong ,  Ha kata ka por , u Mikhael , u angel uba khraw , uba ïada ïa ki briew jong me , un mihpaw . Nangta kan don ka por ki jingjynjar , kaba kham sniew tam naduh ba ki jaitbynriew ki mih . Haba kata ka por ka wan , baroh ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong me kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha ka kitab ka jong U Blei yn pynim .

translation.en: Arise , shine  ; for thy light is come , and the glory of the  Lord  is risen upon thee .
translation.kha: To khie joit , ko Jerusalem bad tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ; ka burom ka jong U  Trai  ka tyngshaiñ ha phi !

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The sabbath was made for man , and not man for the sabbath :
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Ïa ka Sabbaton la thaw na ka bynta ka jingbha u briew ; ïa u briew ym shym la thaw na ka bynta ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: Then shall his brother s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders , and loose his shoe from off his foot , and spit in his face , and shall answer and say , So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother s house .
translation.kha: kata ka hynmen kynsi jong u kan leit sha u ha khmat kita ki nongïalam shnong , kan loit kawei ka juti jong u , kan bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u , bad kan ong , ‘ Kumne yn leh ïa uta u briew u bym treh ban ai symbai ïa la u hynmen .’

translation.en: They did eat , they drank , they married wives , they were given in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark , and the flood came , and destroyed them all .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , bad ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka lieng bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka la pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath , as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa u syiem Hadadeser jong ka jylla Sobah jong ka Syria , kaba hajan ka ri Hamath , namar u Hadadeser u la pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri kaba shaphang shaneng ka Ïuphratis .

translation.en: And say , Hear the word of the  Lord  , O king of Judah , that sittest upon the throne of David , thou , and thy servants , and thy people that enter in by these gates :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa nga ban leit sha ka ïing u syiem Judah , u khun jong u ksiew jong u Dabid , bad kren hangta ïa u syiem , ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong :

translation.en: For whosoever hath , to him shall be given , and he shall have more abundance : but whosoever hath not , from him shall be taken away even that he hath .
translation.kha: Naba ha u briew uba don ei ei yn nang ai shuh shuh , khnang ba un ïoh kham bun ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei yn shim noh na u wat ïa kaba rit tam kaba u don .

translation.en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath , but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: U Blei um shym jied ïa ngi ban shah ïa ka jingbitar jong u , hynrei ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynim lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ,

translation.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst  ; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life .
translation.kha: Ka um ïa kaba ngan ai ha u kan long ha u ka umpohliew ka ban pynïoh ïa u da ka um kaba ai jingim bad ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Look not every man on his own things , but every man also on the things of others .
translation.kha: Bad to khmih ïa ki jingdonkam jong iwei ïa iwei pat , ym tang ïa la ka jong .

translation.en: Then did he see it , and declare it  ; he prepared it , yea , and searched it out .
translation.kha: Ka long hangta ba u ïohi ïa ka jingstad bad u tynjuh ïa ka dor jong ka — U ai ïa ka , ka jingmynjur jong u .

translation.en: In the midst of the street of it , and on either side of the river , was there the tree of life , which bare twelve manner of fruits , and yielded her fruit every month : and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations .
translation.kha: bad ka tuid sha ka pdeng jong ka lynti bah jong ka nongbah . Ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka wah la don u dieng ka jingim , uba pynmih soh khat-ar sien shisnem , shisien ha uwei uwei u bnai , bad ki sla jong u ki long na ka bynta ban ai jingkhiah ïa ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Watch ye and pray , lest ye enter into temptation . The spirit truly is ready , but the flesh is weak .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ïa ki ,  To sumar bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka kwah hynrei ka doh ka tlot .

translation.en: For , lo , I will raise up a shepherd in the land , which shall not visit those that be cut off , neither shall seek the young one , nor heal that that is broken , nor feed that that standeth still : but he shall eat the flesh of the fat , and tear their claws in pieces .
translation.kha: Nga la buh u nongaplangbrot ban khmih ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong nga , hynrei um shym la ïarap ïa ki langbrot kiba la shah byrngem da ka jingpynjot ; lymne ba u leit wad ïa kaba la jah noh , lane pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la mynsaw , lane bsa ïa kiba khiah . Pynban u bam ïa ka doh jong ki langbrot kiba sngaid bad u weng noh ïa ki khnap jong ki .

translation.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles , and made their minds evil affected against the brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki bym shym la ngeit ki la pynkhih ïa ki Jentil bad ki la pynlong ïa ki ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa riewngeit .

translation.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the  Lord  , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u mihnoh na khmat U  Trai  bad u pynsaja da ki tohjaw ha baroh shi rynïeng ka met jong u Job .

translation.en: And he said , Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day ? it is neither new moon , nor sabbath . And she said , It shall be well .
translation.kha: Balei phi hap ban leit mynta ka sngi ?  u tnga jong ka u kylli .  Kam shym dei ka Sabbaton lane ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai .   Kam lei lei ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  Asaph and his brethren , to minister before the ark continually , as every day s work required :
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u buh pynskhem ïa u Asaph bad ïa ki para Lebi ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad ka jingmane ba pynlong ha ka jaka ba la buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . La buh ïa ki ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki hangta man ka sngi .

translation.en: And Dannah , and Kirjath–sannah , which is Debir ,
translation.kha: ka Dannah , ka Kiriath Sepher ( lane ka Debir ) ,

translation.en: And Hannah prayed , and said , My heart rejoiceth in the  Lord  , mine horn is exalted in the  Lord  : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies  ; because I rejoice in thy salvation .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka la duwai :  U  Trai  u la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da ka jingkmen ; katno nga sngewtynnat namar kaei kaba u la leh ! Nga rkhie ïa ki nongshun jong nga ; katno nga shadkmen namar ba U Blei u la ïarap ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , They have well spoken that which they have spoken .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Ki la kyrpad ïa kaba dei eh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , a people cometh from the north country , and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ki wan na ka ri ha ka phang bashatei ; ka jaitbynriew kaba khrawbor na sha jngai bah ka pynkhreh ïa ka thma .

translation.en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the  Lord  God of Israel in mount Ebal ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u tei ha u Lum Ebal ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart , These nations are more than I  ; how can I dispossess them ?
translation.kha: Wat leit ong ha la ka dohnud , kine ki jaitbynriew ki kham bun paid ban ïa ngi , kumno ngi lah ban beh ïa ki .

translation.en: Which also were accounted giants , as the Anakims  ; but the Moabites call them Emims .
translation.kha: Kum ïa ki Anakim , la ju khot ruh ïa ki , ki Rephaim ; hynrei ki nong Moab ki khot ïa ki , ki Emim .

translation.en: The flowers appear on the earth  ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land  ;
translation.kha: U syiem jong nga u thiah ha la ka jingthiah , bad ka jingsleh iwbih jong nga ka la pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiw ba-iwbih .

translation.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens .
translation.kha: To ngin plie ïa la ki dohnud sha U Blei ha bneng bad duwai ,

translation.en: I came near unto one of them that stood by , and asked him the truth of all this . So he told me , and made me know the interpretation of the things .
translation.kha: Nga la leit sha uwei na kito kiba ïeng hangta bad nga la kylli na u ban batai ïa ka baroh . Te u la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingmut .

translation.en: When that year was ended , they came unto him the second year , and said unto him , We will not hide it from my lord , how that our money is spent  ; my lord also hath our herds of cattle  ; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord , but our bodies , and our lands :
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba bud , ki ïawan sha u , bad ki ïa-ong ,  Kynrad , ngin ym buhrieh ïa ka jingshisha na phi ba ki pisa jong ngi baroh ki la lut , bad ba ki jingri jingdup jong ngi ki la dei ki jong phi . Ngim don ei ei shuh ban ai ïa phi lait noh sa tang ki met jong ngi bad ki lyngkha jong ngi .

translation.en: Then answered all the people , and said , His blood be on us , and on our children .
translation.kha: U paidbah baroh u la jubab ,  Ai ba ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u kan hap halor jong ngi bad halor ki khun jong ngi !

translation.en: Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said unto them , Ye rulers of the people , and elders of Israel ,
translation.kha: U Petros , uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ko nongïalam jong ki paidbah bad ko ki tymmen ki san :

translation.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them .
translation.kha: Me kner ïa la ka kti kamon , bad ka khyndew ka nguid ïa ki nongshun jong ngi .

translation.en: Her house is the way to hell , going down to the chambers of death .
translation.kha: Lada me leit sha ka ïing jong ka , me don ha ka lynti sha ka ri kiba ïap . Ka dei ka lynti kaba jan tam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: Moab is confounded  ; for it is broken down : howl and cry  ; tell ye it in Arnon , that Moab is spoiled ,
translation.kha: ‘ Ka Moab ka la kyllon ,’ kin jubab , ‘ ïam na ka bynta jong ka ; la pynjahburom ïa ka . Pynbna ha lynter ka wah Arnon ba ïa ka Moab la pynjot !’

translation.en: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost , it shall not be forgiven him , neither in this world , neither in the world to come .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew u lah ban ïoh jingmap ; hynrei uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap — mynta lane junom .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware .
translation.kha: U angel u jubab ,  Ka tnga jong phi ka dei ban sumar ban leh ïa kita baroh ïa kaba nga la bthah ïa ka .

translation.en: They can provide comfort and guidance in times of trouble .—James 5 :14-16  ; 1 Peter 5 :2 , 3 .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban ai jingtngen bad kdew lynti ha ki por bajynjar .—Jakob 5 :14-16 ; 1 Petros 5 :2 , 3 .

translation.en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah , Because Israel took away my land , when they came up out of Egypt , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and unto Jordan : now therefore restore those lands again peaceably .
translation.kha: U syiem Ammon u jubab ïa ki nonglamktien u Jephthah ,  Mynba ki Israel ki mihnoh na Ijipt , ki la knieh ïa ka ri jong nga naduh ka wah Arnon haduh ka wah Jabbok bad ka wah Jordan . Mynta me dei ban pynphai noh ïa ka da kaba suk .

translation.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness : but a faithful man who can find ?
translation.kha: Baroh ki kren shaphang katno u long uba kohnguh bad baïaineh , hynrei shu pyrshang ban wad ïa uno uno uba long kumta !

translation.en: The  Lord  is well pleased for his righteousness  sake  ; he will magnify the law , and make it honourable .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei uba kwah eh ban pynim , kumta u kyntiew ïa ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai jong u , bad u kwah ba ki briew jong u ki burom ïa ki .

translation.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart , that , as a man chasteneth his son , so the  Lord  thy God chasteneth thee .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba kumba u kpa u sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun , kumta ruh U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u sneng pynbeit ïa phi .

translation.en: To overthrow their seed also among the nations , and to scatter them in the lands .
translation.kha: bad pynsakma ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki hapdeng ki nongmane bleithaw , ban iehnoh ïa ki ba kin ïap ha ki ri nongwei .

translation.en: For the  Lord  brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel  ; for he made Judah naked , and transgressed sore against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Namar u Ahas u syiem Judah u la pynkheiñ ïa ki hok ki briew jong u bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U  Trai  u la wallam ki jingjynjar ha ka Judah .

translation.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink , thou , nor thy sons with thee , when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations :
translation.kha: Ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phim dei ban rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga hadien ba phi la dih waiñ lane dih kyiad ; lada phi leh kumta phin ïap . Kane ka long ka aiñ kaba dei ban bud da ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pateng .

translation.en: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the image which I have made  ; well : but if ye worship not , ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace  ; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands ?
translation.kha: Te mynta , tang mar shu ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong ki turoi , ki tangmuri , ki jingtem ksai , ki marynthing , ki duitara , bad baroh kiwei pat ki tiar put tiar tem , to dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew . Lada phim leh kumta , yn bret kloi lan ïa phi ha ka lawar ding baklang . Hato phi pyrkhat ba don uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phi ?

translation.en: And Noah was five hundred years old : and Noah begat Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
translation.kha: Ynda u Noah u la dap sanspah snem ka rta , u ïoh lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth .

translation.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering , that is for the people , and bring his blood within the veil , and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat , and before the mercy seat :
translation.kha: Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bynta u paidbah , un rah ïa ka snam jong u sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un synreit ïa ka halor ka jingtap bad ha khmat jong ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba u la leh da ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw .

translation.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman , which testified , He told me all that ever I did .
translation.kha: Bun na ki nong Samaria ha kata ka shnong ki la ngeit ha U Jisu namar kata ka briew ka la lah ong ,  U la ïathuh ïa nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga thung ïa me u lat halor ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it  ; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it : and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion , and the stones of emptiness .
translation.kha: Ki dkhoh bad ki tyngab kin shimti ïa ka ri . U  Trai  un ym pynseisoh shuh ïa ka , kumba ka la long ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: So thou , O son of man , I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel  ; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth , and warn them from me .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , nga la pynlong ïa me u nongap ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Me dei ban pynpoi sha ki ïa ki jingmaham ba nga ai ha me .

translation.en: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people , that I may discern between good and bad : for who is able to judge this thy so great a people ?
translation.kha: Kumta to ai ha nga ka jingstad kaba nga donkam ban synshar ïa ki briew jong me ha ka jinglehhok bad ban ithuh ka jingïapher hapdeng kaba bha bad kaba sniew . Lym kumta , kumno ngan lah ban synshar ïa u paidlang jong me uba khraw katne katne ?

translation.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy , that hath shewed no mercy  ; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei un ym pyn-i jingsngewsynei haba u bishar ïa u briew u bym shym la leh-isynei ; hynrei ka jinglehisynei ka jop noh halor ka jingbishar .

translation.en: My people , go ye out of the midst of her , and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to phet noh nangta ! Phet ban lait im na ka jingbitar shla jong nga .

translation.en: She girdeth her loins with strength , and strengtheneth her arms .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba trei shitom , kaba khlaiñ bad kaba minot .

translation.en: And a certain man lame from his mother s womb was carried , whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask alms of them that entered into the temple  ;
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , kumba la ju khot ïa ka , la don u briew uba la dkoh baroh shi jingim . Man ka sngi la ju bah ïa u sha ka khyrdop ban khrong pisa na ki briew kiba leit shapoh ka Templ .

translation.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them :
translation.kha: Kumta ki khun shynrang u Jakob ki leh kumba u la hukum ïa ki ;

translation.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them , saying , Ye men and brethren , if ye have any word of exhortation for the people , say on .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpule na ka Hukum u Moses bad na ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki rangbah synshar jong ka synagog ki la phah khubor sha ki :  Ko hynmen ko para , ngi kwah ïa phi ban kren ha u paidbah lada phi don ka khubor ai mynsiem na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place , where the ashes are poured out , and burn him on the wood with fire : where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt .
translation.kha: un rah ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara sha ka jaka lehniam bakhuid ha kaba yn theh ïa u dpei , bad hangta un thang ha ka kynton diengïap .

translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u phah ïa ka khubor kaba ong ha u syiem Hesekaïah kum ka jubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem

translation.en: And the people stood afar off , and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki dang ïeng hi sha jngai , bad tang u Moses uba la leit sha jan u lyoh uba rben ha uba U Blei u don .

translation.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house , and to be a joyful mother of children . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: U pyndonburom ïa ka tnga ka bym don khun ha ka ïingshong jong ka ; u pynkmen ïa ka da kaba ai ki khun ha ka . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness , and Judah saw his wound , then went Ephraim to the Assyrian , and sent to king Jareb : yet could he not heal you , nor cure you of your wound .
translation.kha: Haba ka Israel ka ïohi haduh katno ka pang jur bad haba ka Judah ka ïohi ïa la ki jingmong , nangta ki Israel ki leit sha Assyria ban pan jingïarap na u syiem uba khrawbor , hynrei um lah ban pynkoit ïa ki lane pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong ki .

translation.en: They reel to and fro , and stagger like a drunken man , and are at their wits  end .
translation.kha: ki jynthut bad ki ïaid sheng sheng kum kiba briew kiba buaid — baroh ka jingtbit jong ki ka la lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: But thou , when thou prayest , enter into thy closet , and when thou hast shut thy door , pray to thy Father which is in secret  ; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai , to leit sha ka kamra jong phi , khang ïa ka jingkhang , bad duwai sha U Kpa jong phi , ïa uba ym lah ban ïohi . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .

translation.en: Then they sent to Jezebel , saying , Naboth is stoned , and is dead .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khubor la phah sha ka Jesebel ,  Ïa u Naboth la pynïap .

translation.en: And they were to prove Israel by them , to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel , ban lap la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki da u Moses .

translation.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt  ; which my covenant they brake , although I was an husband unto them , saith the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Kan ym long kum ka jutang barim kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la shim ïa ki da la ka kti bad ïalam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Wat la nga la long kum u tnga ïa ki , kim shym la bat ïa kata ka jutang .

translation.en: And when the sabbath day was come , he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were astonished , saying , From whence hath this man these things ? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him , that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la sdang ban hikai ha ka synagog . Bun ki briew ki la don hangta ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u , baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .  Ka jingstad aïu kane ba la ai ha u ? Kumno u leh ïa ki kambah ?

translation.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïohi ïa nga u ïohi ruh ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: The works of the  Lord  are great , sought out of all them that have pleasure therein .
translation.kha: A katno kiba phylla long kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  u la leh ! Baroh kiba la kmen bad ki , ki kwah ban shemphang ïa ki .

translation.en: The chariots shall rage in the streets , they shall justle one against another in the broad ways : they shall seem like torches , they shall run like the lightnings .
translation.kha: Ki kali ïapom ki tyngkhuh kulmar ha ki lynti bah , da kaba mareh shane shatai lyngba ki jaka paidbah ka nongbah . Ki thaba kum ki dongmusa bad ki stet kum ka leilieh .

translation.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment  ; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great  ; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man  ; for the judgment is God s : and the cause that is too hard for you , bring it unto me , and I will hear it .
translation.kha: Wat ïashah liang ha ki rai jong phi ; bishar ïa uwei pa uwei ha kajuh ka nongrim , kam pher la u long uba kumno kumno . Wat sheptieng ïano ïano , naba ki rai kiba phi ai ki wan na U Blei . Lada kano kano ka kam ïakajia ka eh than ïa phi ban rai , wallam ïa ka sha nga , bad ngan rai ïa ka .’

translation.en: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , from the iron furnace , saying , Obey my voice , and do them , according to all which I command you : so shall ye be my people , and I will be your God :
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la wallam noh ïa ki na Ijipt , ka ri kaba long kum ka lawar ding baklang ïa ki . Nga la ong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la lah hukum . Nga la ong ïa ki ba lada ki kohnguh , kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad ngan ïoh long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And all mine are thine , and thine are mine  ; and I am glorified in them .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga don ka long ka jong me , bad baroh kaba me don ka long ka jong nga ; bad ïa ka burom jong nga la pynpaw lyngba jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wouldest thou ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada ba ka shong , bad u Kaleb u kylli aïu ba ka kwah .

translation.en: For we being many are one bread , and one body : for we are all partakers of that one bread .
translation.kha: Namar don uwei u kpu , baroh na ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met , naba ngi baroh ngi ïoh bynta lem na ujuh u kpu .

translation.en: And there went out fire from the  Lord  , and devoured them , and they died before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kynsan U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding , bad kata ka thang ïa ki hangta ha khmat jong U  Trai  haduh ba kin da ïap .

translation.en: And Saul built an altar unto the  Lord  : the same was the first altar that he built unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Saul u tei ka duwan ha U  Trai  ; ka duwan kaba nyngkong kaba u la tei .

translation.en: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down , What is sweeter than honey ? and what is stronger than a lion ? And he said unto them , If ye had not plowed with my heifer , ye had not found out my riddle .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ha shuwa ba u Samson un leit sha la kamra thiah , ki briew jong kata ka shnong ki ong ha u ,  Kaei kaba kham thiang ban ïa ka ngap ? Uei uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u sing ?  U Samson u jubab ,  Lada phim shym la lur da ka masi jong nga , Phin ym tip ïa ka jubab mynta .

translation.en: And David said to Achish , Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do . And Achish said to David , Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever .
translation.kha: Da shisha  u Dabid u jubab ,  Nga long u shakri jong phi bad phin sa ïohi da lade kaei ba nga lah ban leh .  U Akhish u ong ,  Ka biang ! Ngan pynlong ïa phi u nongïada jong nga shi rta .

translation.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour .
translation.kha: Wat sakhi lamler ïano ïano .

translation.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin , after their journeys , according to the commandment of the  Lord  , and pitched in Rephidim : and there was no water for the people to drink .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na ka ri shyiap Sin , da kaba ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ka jaka kat kum ka hukum U  Trai . Ki la sher dara ha Rephidim , hynrei ym don umdih hangta .

translation.en: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not , when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon , and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: ( Mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , bad ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , u la iehnoh ïa ki rishot , ka dabor tama , ki kali tan , bad katto katne tylli kiwei pat ki jingkynshew ka Templ . )

translation.en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man  ; the candle of the wicked shall be put out .
translation.kha: U riewsniew um don ïa ka lawei — ym don ei ei ba un peit sha khmat .

translation.en: And Abimelech chased him , and he fled before him , and many were overthrown and wounded , even unto the entering of the gate .
translation.kha: U Gaal u la phet ïap bad u Abimelekh u la beh kthong ïa u . Bun ngut ki la mynsaw , wat haduh khyrdop shnong .

translation.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest  ; but he that said unto him , Thou art my Son , to day have I begotten thee .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist um shym la shim ha lade ïa kane ka burom ka jinglong Rangbah Lyngdoh . Pynban , U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Me , me long U Khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .

translation.en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another , saying , Let us go speedily to pray before the  Lord  , and to seek the  Lord  of hosts : I will go also .
translation.kha: Kito kiba na kawei ka nongbah kin ong ha kito kiba na kawei pat , ‘ Ngi leit ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u . To wan bad ngi !’

translation.en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea  ; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba ki um ki ïeng kum ki kynroh na baroh arliang .

translation.en: And they that stood by said , Revilest thou God s high priest ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba hajan jong u Paul ki la ong ha u ,  Me krenbeiñ ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei !

translation.en: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was : and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it .
translation.kha: Ki met jong ngi kin kylla sha u pui pui khyndew , bad ka jingpyrsad ka jingim kan leit phai pat sha U Blei , uba la ai ïa ka ha ngi .

translation.en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war , even four hundred thousand chosen men : Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men , being mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: U Abijah u pynkhreh ka kynhun shipai kaba don saw lakh ngut , bad u Jeroboam u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u da ka kynhun shipai kaba don phra lakh ngut .

translation.en: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer , and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Bad ngan ïailong uba kmen , namar nga tip ba da ki jingduwai jong phi bad da ka jingïarap kaba wan na U Mynsiem jong U Jisu Khrist , ïa nga yn sa pyllaitluid .

translation.en: And her father hear her vow , and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul , and her father shall hold his peace at her : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand .
translation.kha: ka dei ban leh lut kumba ka la kular lymda u kpa jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel sin : but he walked therein .
translation.kha: U ruh u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u Syiem Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And David sware unto Saul . And Saul went home  ; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la kular ba un leh kumta . Nangta u Saul u leit phai sha ïing , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit phai biang sha la ka jakarieh .

translation.en: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you , and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles , that one should have his father s wife .
translation.kha: Mynta , la don ka jingong kaba thikna ba ka don ka jingïaleh awria hapdeng jong phi kaba shyrkhei haduh katta katta ba wat ki bymngeit kin sngewrem ïa kata . La ïathuh ïa nga ba uwei u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka meinah!

translation.en: The  Lord  shall reign for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ma me , ko  Trai  , men long u syiem junom la junom .

translation.en: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God , where is the garrison of the Philistines : and it shall come to pass , when thou art come thither to the city , that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery , and a tabret , and a pipe , and a harp , before them  ; and they shall prophesy :
translation.kha: Nangta men leit kiew sha u Lum jong U Blei ha Gibeah , ha kaba don ka jaka sher dara jong ki Philistia . Ha ka jaka rung shapoh shnong , men ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba dang wan hiar na ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum , ki da tem da put ïa ki duitara , ki ksing , ki sharati , bad ki kanjari . Kin sa ïashad bad ïarisa .

translation.en: And the commandment , which was ordained to life , I found to be unto death .
translation.kha: Bad ka hukum kaba dei ban wallam jingim , ha nga , ka la wallam ka jingïap .

translation.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , u shakri jong u ; ma phi ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , u briew uba u la jied : Kynmaw ïa ki kambah ba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .

translation.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
translation.kha: U la peit ïa ki briew kiba shong sawdong jong u bad u la ong ,  Khmih ! Hangne ki don ka kmie jong nga bad ki para jong nga !

translation.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way  ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .
translation.kha: to ieh ïa ka jingai jong phi hangta ha khmat jong ka duwan , khie leit shisyndon bad ïasuk bad la u para , bad nangta sa wan pat bad ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei .

translation.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering , mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil .
translation.kha: lem bad ka jingainguh bam kaba shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh lang bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha tam .

translation.en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him , then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand  ; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .
translation.kha: Lada uta uba wad kput u bud ïa u shata , ki briew jong ka nongbah kim dei ban aiti ïa u ha uta . Ki dei ban ïada ïa u namar ba u la pynïap ïa u briew da ka jingjia ryngkhat bad ym na ka jingbitar .

translation.en: How much more , when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed ? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand , and take you away from the earth ?
translation.kha: Katno kaba kham sniew kan long ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui uba dang ïohthiah ha la ka jong ka ïing ! Mynta ngan pynhiarkput ïa phi namar ka jingpynïap ïa u bad ngan pyndam ïa phi na sla khyndew !

translation.en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy , whithersoever thou shalt send them , and shall pray unto the  Lord  toward the city which thou hast chosen , and toward the house that I have built for thy name :
translation.kha: Haba me hukum ïa ki briew jong me ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ki bad ba ki duwai ha me , hangno hangno ha kaba ki don , ki da phai khmat sha kane ka nongbah ïa kaba me la jied bad sha kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me ,

translation.en: While they promise them liberty , they themselves are the servants of corruption : for of whom a man is overcome , of the same is he brought in bondage .
translation.kha: Ki kular ha ki ïa ka jinglaitluid katba ma ki , ki long ki mraw jong ki jingmlien bapynjot — naba u briew u long u mraw ha kano kano kaba jop halor u .

translation.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him , to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , and his statutes , and his judgments , which he commanded our fathers .
translation.kha: to un pynlong ïa ngi kiba kohnguh ïa u ba ngin lah ban im borabor kumba u kwah ïa ngi ban im , bad ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: I have declared the former things from the beginning  ; and they went forth out of my mouth , and I shewed them  ; I did them suddenly , and they came to pass .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ki Israel ,  La slem bah nga la ïathuh lypa kaei ka ban sa jia ; nangta kynsan nga pynlong ba kan jia .

translation.en: And ye are complete in him , which is the head of all principality and power :
translation.kha: U long uba hakhlieh tam halor kawei pa kawei ka jingsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad ka bor synshar .

translation.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance :
translation.kha: To leh ïa kito kiei kiei ki ban pyn-i ba phi la phai noh na ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod , and thy throat from thirst : but thou saidst , There is no hope : no  ; for I have loved strangers , and after them will I go .
translation.kha: Ko Israel wat pynlwait ïa ki kjat jong me , lane shah ïa u pdot jong me ban tyrkhong na kaba beh ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Hynrei me ong , ‘ Em ! Ngam lah ban phai dien . Nga la ieit ïa ki blei nongwei bad ngan leit hadien jong ki .’

translation.en: And Jezreel , and Jokdeam , and Zanoah ,
translation.kha: ka Jesreel , ka Jokdeam , ka Sanoah ,

translation.en: So the priest gave him hallowed bread : for there was no bread there but the shewbread , that was taken from before the  Lord  , to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u lyngdoh u ai ha u Dabid ïa uta u kpu bakyntang , namar u kpu uba u don , u dei uba la ainguh ha U Blei , ïa uba la weng noh na ka miej bakyntang , bad ba la bujli da u kpu uba dang lah shet .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath done that which he had devised  ; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old : he hath thrown down , and hath not pitied : and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee , he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries .
translation.kha: Nga kner ïa la ki kti , hynrei ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga . U  Trai  u la khot ïa ki nongshun pyrshah ïa nga na ki liang baroh ; ki la leh ïa nga kum ïa kaei kaei kaba jakhlia .

translation.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them  ; for he spake unto them by an interpreter .
translation.kha: Kim shym tip ba u Joseph u sngewthuh aïu ki ong , namar ki ïakren bad u da ka jingïarap u nongbatai ktien .

translation.en: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land , he blow the trumpet , and warn the people  ;
translation.kha: Haba u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan poi , u put ïa ka turoi ban maham ïa uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places : thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations  ; and thou shalt be called , The repairer of the breach , The restorer of paths to dwell in .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong phi kin tei pat ïa kaei kaba la pra la slem bah , kin tei pat halor ki nongrim ba-mynshuwa . Yn tip ïa phi kum ki briew kiba tei pat ïa ki kynroh , kiba pynbha pat ïa ki ïing ba la pra .

translation.en: He that walketh righteously , and speaketh uprightly  ; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions , that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes , that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood , and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil  ;
translation.kha: Phi lah ban lait im lada phi ong bad phi leh ïa kaba dei . Wat pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi ban shukor ïa kiba duk bad wat pdiang ïa ka pisa bashukor . Wat ïasnohkti bad kito kiba thmu ban pynïap briew lane ban leh ïa kiwei ki kam sniew .

translation.en: Peter saith unto him , Of strangers . Jesus saith unto him ,  Then are the children free .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei ,  la jubab u Petros .  Kumta , te ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  kata ka mut ba ki traishnong kim donkam ban siew .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families , the cities and their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured , It is the sabbath day : it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ong ïa uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah ,  Kane ka dei ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ïa me ban rah ïa la ka jingthiah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws ?
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Sa katno shuh phi ki briew phin dang kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ?

translation.en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the  Lord  your God hath commanded you : ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki Israel , wat pep ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa phi . Wat pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki aiñ jong u .

translation.en: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son : but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame .
translation.kha: U briew uba sngewthuh u lum ïa ki soh ha ka aïom kaba biang ; ka long kaba jahburom ban thiah thai ha ka por ka aïom ot .

translation.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees , when the kingdom of God should come , he answered them and said ,  The kingdom of God cometh not with observation :
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa U Jisu lano ka Hima U Blei kan wan . Ka jubab jong u ka long ,  Ka Hima U Blei kam wan ha ka rukom kum kaba lah ban ïohi .

translation.en: But the fig tree said unto them , Should I forsake my sweetness , and my good fruit , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u dieng Dumbur u ong , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap ban sangeh ban pynmih ki soh thiang babha .’

translation.en: Now when Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , one of the eunuchs which was in the king s house , heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon  ; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin  ;
translation.kha: Kumno re kumno , u Ebedmelekh , u nong Sudan , u ïunukh uba trei ha ka ïingsyiem u la ïohsngew ba ki la thep ïa nga ha ka pung . Ha kata ka por u syiem u dang pynlong ka jingbishar ha ka Khyrdop Benjamin .

translation.en: And Lebaoth , and Shilhim , and Ain , and Rimmon : all the cities are twenty and nine , with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Lebaoth , ka Shilhim , ka Ain bad ka Rimmon : baroh lang ki long arphew khyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the  Lord  , neither shall they be pleasing unto him : their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners  ; all that eat thereof shall be polluted : for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki ri nongwei kin ym lah ban ai ka jingainguh waiñ ha U  Trai  , lane wanlam ki jingkñia ha u . Ki jingbam jong ki kin pyntngit ïa uno uno uba bam ïa ki , kum ki jingbam ba bam ha ka por ïapbriew . Yn pyndonkam ïa ki tang ban pynkdang ïa la ka jingthngan ; ym don kawei ruh ka ban shim kum ka jingainguh ha ka Templ U  Trai .

translation.en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah , and said , Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal , knead it , and make cakes upon the hearth .
translation.kha: Te u Abraham u leit rung kyrkieh sha la ka ïingjaiñ bad u ong ha ka Sarah ,  Kloi kloi , shim shi byrni u  purew uba ni , khleh bad sa shet kpu .

translation.en: And when they were gone out of the city , and not yet far off , Joseph said unto his steward , Up , follow after the men  ; and when thou dost overtake them , say unto them , Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good ?
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïaid ym pat da jngai na shnong , u Joseph u ong ha uta u shakri bahakhlieh ha ka ïing jong u ,  Khie , leit bud mar mar nadien kito ki briew . Ynda phi lap ïa ki , ong ha ki , ‘ Balei phi siew kylliang da kaba sniew ïa kaba bha ?

translation.en: Those by the way side are they that hear  ; then cometh the devil , and taketh away the word out of their hearts , lest they should believe and be saved .
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; hynrei u Ksuid u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka khubor na ki dohnud jong ki khnang ban khang ïa ki na kaba ngeit bad ïohlait im .

translation.en: And have tasted the good word of God , and the powers of the world to come ,
translation.kha: ki la tip naba ki la ïohmad ba ka Ktien U Blei ka long kaba bha , bad ki la ïohmad ruh ïa ki bor jong ka por ka ban sa wan .

translation.en: Hearken now unto my voice , I will give thee counsel , and God shall be with thee : Be thou for the people to God-ward , that thou mayest bring the causes unto God :
translation.kha: Mynta shah ngan ai buit lem ïa phi , bad U Blei un don lem bad phi . Ka long kaba dei ba phin mihkhmat ïa kine ki briew ha khmat U Blei , bad ban leit rah ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki sha u .

translation.en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam  ; therefore he blessed you still : so I delivered you out of his hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la shahshkor ïa u Balaam , kumta u la kyrkhu ïa phi , bad da kumta nga la pyllait ïa phi na u Balak .

translation.en: And he went out about the third hour , and saw others standing idle in the marketplace ,
translation.kha: U la leit biang sha ka jaka ïew ha ka por khyndai baje , bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba ïa-ïeng hangta khlem kam ,

translation.en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Khrist Jisu , ïa phi kiba la ju long jngai la wallam hajan da ka jingïap kaba long ka jingkñia U Khrist .

translation.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine s snout , so is a fair woman which is without discretion .
translation.kha: Ka jingbhabriew ha ka briew ka bym don ka jingshemphang ka long kum ka sati ksiar ha ka khmut u sniang .

translation.en: The rings , and nose jewels ,
translation.kha: ïa ki sati ba ki deng ha ki shynriah ti jong ki bad ha ki khmut jong ki ;

translation.en: Following the method just outlined , prepare for the Watchtower Study or the Congregation Bible Study .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa kaei kaba la pyni haneng , pynkhreh ban pule ïa ka Kut Ap Phira ne ka Jingpule Baibl jong ka Balang .

translation.en: Or let him take hold of my strength , that he may make peace with me  ; and he shall make peace with me .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ki nongshun jong ki briew jong nga ki kwah ïa ka jingïada jong nga , ai ba kin ïasuk bad nga . Ho-oid , ai kin ïasuk bad nga .

translation.en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her , which shall make her land desolate , and none shall dwell therein : they shall remove , they shall depart , both man and beast .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew na shatei ka la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia bad yn pynlong ri shyiap ïa ka . Ki briew bad ki mrad kin phet krad noh , bad yn ym don bashong ba sah hangta .

translation.en: And the rest of Gilead , and all Bashan , being the kingdom of Og , gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh  ; all the region of Argob , with all Bashan , which was called the land of giants .
translation.kha: Ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , nga ai ïa kaba sah na ka ri Gilead bad ïa ka Bashan baroh kawei , ha kaba u Og u synshar , kaba mut ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei .  ( Ïa ka Bashan la tip kum ka ri jong ki Rephaim .

translation.en: And I put a jewel on thy forehead , and earrings in thine ears , and a beautiful crown upon thine head .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha pha ïa ka sati khmut bad ki sohshkor bad ka pansngiat ba-itynnat ban phong .

translation.en: And all the people that came together to that sight , beholding the things which were done , smote their breasts , and returned .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah kiba la ïalumlang hangta ban khmih ïa kata baroh , ki la ïohi kaei kaba la jia , baroh ki la ïaleit phai sha ïing , ki da tied ïa la ki shadem ha ka jingsngewsih .

translation.en: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased , and said unto them ,  Suffer the little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa kane , u la sngewbitar bad u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan ha nga , bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long na ka bynta kum kine .

translation.en: Cease , my son , to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge .
translation.kha: Ko khun , haba phi sangeh ban shah hikai , shen phin iehnoh noh ïa kaei kaba phi la tip mynshuwa .

translation.en: Then said Elkanah her husband to her , Hannah , why weepest thou ? and why eatest thou not ? and why is thy heart grieved ? am not I better to thee than ten sons ?
translation.kha: U Elkanah u tnga jong ka u kylli ïa ka ,  Hannah , balei ba phi da ïam ? Balei ba phim bam ei ei ? Balei ba phi shu sngewsih sah ? Hato ngam kham lah ma nga ha phi ban ïa shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang ?

translation.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters , that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass .
translation.kha: Katno kan long kaba kmen haba uwei pa uwei un ïoh kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki jingthung bad ki jaka pynbamphlang bashngain ha kylleng na ka bynta ki kada bad ki masi .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion : he hath stretched out a line , he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying : therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament  ; they languished together .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong ka , ka la leit noh ; ka la lyngkhuit bad ka la don ha ka jingshah ñiewbeiñ . Ka ud bad ka buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat ha ka jinglehrain . Ka Jerusalem ka la pynjakhlia ïa lade da ka pop kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down , and the feeble knees  ;
translation.kha: Te to rah ïa ki kti ba la thait jong phi , bad pynkhlaiñ ïa ki khohsiew kiba la kyiuh jong phi !

translation.en: Also thou shalt lie down , and none shall make thee afraid  ; yea , many shall make suit unto thee .
translation.kha: Men ym sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong me ; kiba bun ki briew kin kyrpad jingïarap na me .

translation.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen  ; she shall no more rise : she is forsaken upon her land  ; there is none to raise her up .
translation.kha: Ka theisotti Israel ka la kyllon ; Kan ym khie pat lano lano ! Ka shah iehnoh ha ka khyndew Bad ym don uwei ruh u ban khyllie ïa ka .

translation.en: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee : begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn .
translation.kha: Ñiew hynñiew taïew naduh ba phi sdang ot ïa u kew ,

translation.en: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart , because they are all estranged from me through their idols .
translation.kha: Kito ki bleithaw baroh ki la pynphai noh ïa ki Israel na nga , hynrei da ka jubab jong nga , nga kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki .

translation.en: And they served their idols : which were a snare unto them .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kane ka la pynlong ïa ki ba kin shah pynjot .

translation.en: And they say unto her , Woman , why weepest thou ? She saith unto them , Because they have taken away my Lord , and I know not where they have laid him .
translation.kha: Ko kynthei , balei pha ïam ?  ki la ïakylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab ,  Ki la rah noh ïa U Trai jong nga , bad ngam tip shano ki la buh ïa u !

translation.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel , and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ong ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u , ñiewburom ïa ki jingkñia kiba kyntang ba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , ba kumta phin ym pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: That is , They which are the children of the flesh , these are not the children of God : but the children of the promise are counted for the seed .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka rukom , kim dei ki khun jong U Blei ; hynrei , ïa ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka jingkular U Blei , la ñiew kum ki nonghiarpateng bashisha .

translation.en: Therefore if any man be in Christ , he is a new creature : old things are passed away ; behold , all things are become new .
translation.kha: Kumta Uno uno ïa uba la pynïasoh ha U Khrist u long u jingthaw uba thymmai ; kaba rim ka la leit noh , kaba thymmai ka la wan .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Thy brother shall rise again .
translation.kha: U para jong pha un sa im pat ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ka .

translation.en: If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba U Khrist u long uba hok ; phi dei ban tip , namarkata , ba uei uei baroh uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei u long u khun U Blei .

translation.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;
translation.kha: U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un wallam ka jingshah shitom ha kito kiba pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom ,

translation.en: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations , and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb .
translation.kha: Ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah la tei halor ki khat-ar tylli ki maw nongrim , kiba halor jong ki la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol jong U Khunlangbrot .

translation.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial  ; and ye shall keep it a feast to the  Lord  throughout your generations  ; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga , U  Trai  , nga la leh . Rakhe ïa ka pateng la pateng bynriew .

translation.en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues , and unto magistrates , and powers , take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer , or what ye shall say :
translation.kha: Haba ki wallam ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog lane ha khmat ki lyngskor lane ki nongsynshar , wat sngewkhuslai shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïa lade lane ïa kaei phin kren .

translation.en: But ye , O mountains of Israel , ye shall shoot forth your branches , and yield your fruit to my people of Israel  ; for they are at hand to come .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki lumbah ka Israel ki dieng kin sei biang ki sla bad pynmih soh na ka bynta jong phi , ki briew jong nga , ki Israel . Phi la jan ban wan noh sha la ka ri .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land , neither shalt thou have any part among them : I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Men ym ïoh ka jingdon jingem kum ka jingïohpateng bad ym don kano kano ka bynta na ka ri Israel ban ai ha me . Tang ïa nga U  Trai  , me donkam .

translation.en: I went out full , and the  Lord  hath brought me home again empty : why then call ye me Naomi , seeing the  Lord  hath testified against me , and the Almighty hath afflicted me ?
translation.kha: Mynba nga mihnoh nangne , nga don kyrhai , hynrei U  Trai  u la wallam thylli ïa nga . Balei yn khot ïa nga ka Naomi haba U  Trai  Uba Khrawbor u la pynrem bad phah jingjynjar ha nga ?

translation.en: And he shall speak great words against the most High , and shall wear out the saints of the most High , and think to change times and laws : and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time .
translation.kha: Un kren pyrshah ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh bad banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong U Blei . Un pyrshang ban pynkylla ïa ki aiñ niam bad ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong ki , bad ki briew jong U Blei kin long hapoh ka bor jong u haduh lai snem shiteng .

translation.en: And , behold , there talked with him two men , which were Moses and Elias :
translation.kha: Kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah ki la ïakren bad u . Ki la long u Moses bad u Elijah ,

translation.en: I am afraid of you , lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain .
translation.kha: Nga sngewkhuslai shaphang jong phi ! Hato ka lah ban long ba baroh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi ka la shu long lehnoh-ei ?

translation.en: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities , by the iniquity of thy traffick  ; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee , it shall devour thee , and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee .
translation.kha: Me la leh kat kata kaba sniew ha kaba thied bad die haduh ba ki jaka mane jong me ki la long kiba thala . Te nga la tbeh ding ïa ka nongbah bad thang duh ïa ka . Baroh kiba khmih ha me mynta ki ïohi ïa me ba la kylla dpei .

translation.en: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders ? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread .
translation.kha: Balei ba ki synran jong me kim kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ? Kim ju thet ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaba dei ha shuwa ba kin bam !

translation.en: But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons that were slain , and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber . So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest , ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , ) hid him from Athaliah , so that she slew him not .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u don kawei ka para ar kmie , ka Jehosheba , kaba shongkurim ïa u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Jehoïada . Ka la pyllait im jar jar ïa u Joash , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahasaïah , ka la shim ïa u na kiwei pat ki khun syiem kiba la dei ban shah pynïap bad ka la buhrieh ïa u bad ka nongri khun ha ka kamra thiah ha ka Templ . Da kaba buhrieh ïa u , ka la pyllait im ïa u na ka jingshah pynïap ha ki kti jong ka Athalaïah .

translation.en: Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam Israel baroh ki shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ki pynïap briew .

translation.en: As the Bible says , you will “not sorrow just as the rest also do who have no hope .”
translation.kha: Kumba ka Baibl ka ong , phin nym sngew sih kum kito “ki bymdon jingkyrmen .”

translation.en: If I had not come and spoken unto them , they had not had sin : but now they have no cloak for their sin .
translation.kha: Kin ym da la sngewrem ïa la ka pop lada ngam shym la wan bad ngam shym la kren ha ki ; kumba ka long , kim don nia ei ei shuh na ka bynta la ka pop .

translation.en: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house , and upon thy gates :
translation.kha: Thoh ïa ki ha ki shawkad ki ïing jong phi bad ha ki khyrdop jong phi .

translation.en: Therefore the people came to Moses , and said , We have sinned , for we have spoken against the  Lord  , and against thee  ; pray unto the  Lord  , that he take away the serpents from us . And Moses prayed for the people .
translation.kha: Uta u paidbah u ïawan sha u Moses bad u ong ,  Ngi la leh pop haba ngi la kren pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ïa phi ruh . Mynta to duwai ha U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kine ki bseiñ .  Kumta u Moses u la duwai na ka bynta uta u paidbah .

translation.en: And Hezekiah prayed before the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  God of Israel , which dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth  ; thou hast made heaven and earth .
translation.kha: bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel , uba don ha ka khet halor ki Kherub , me hi me long U Blei , uba synshar halor ki hima baroh jong ka pyrthei . me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa ka suiñbneng .

translation.en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation , and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan , and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead .
translation.kha: Ngan pynphai pat ïa ki paid Israel sha ka ri jong ki . Kin bam ïa ka jingbam kaba mih ha u lum Karmel bad ha ki phang ka Bashan , bad kin bam ïa baroh kaba ki kwah na ki jingthung kiba mih ha ki jaka jong ki Ephraim bad Gilead .

translation.en: The  Lord  killeth , and maketh alive : he bringeth down to the grave , and bringeth up .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynïap bad u pynim pat ; u pynhiar ïa ki briew sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , bad u pynkiew pat ïa ki .

translation.en: Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah ,
translation.kha: U Reuben , U Simeon , U Lebi , U Judah ,

translation.en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives : the name of Abram s wife was Sarai  ; and the name of Nahor s wife , Milcah , the daughter of Haran , the father of Milcah , and the father of Iscah .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shongkurim ïa ka Sarai , bad u Nahor u la shongkurim ïa ka Milkah , ka khun jong u Haran , uba long ruh u kpa jong ka Iskah .

translation.en: All the while my breath is in me , and the spirit of God is in my nostrils  ;
translation.kha: katba U Blei u dang ai ïa nga ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ,

translation.en: And the man waxed great , and went forward , and grew until he became very great :
translation.kha: U la nang manbha , bad u la kylla long uba riewspah eh .

translation.en: If thou seest the oppression of the poor , and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province , marvel not at the matter : for he that is higher than the highest regardeth  ; and there be higher than they .
translation.kha: Wat lyngngoh haba phi ïohi ba ka sorkar ka banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad kam ai ha ki ïa ka jinglehhok bad ïa ki hok jong ki . Ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah synshar la ïada da uno uno uba kham halor bad ïa baroh ar la ïada da ki rangbah synshar kiba kham halor .

translation.en: He that eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , dwelleth in me , and I in him .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad ba dih ïa ka snam jong nga ki ïaisah ha nga , bad ma nga ha ki .

translation.en: Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief , even among the Hebronites , according to the generations of his fathers . In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for , and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Jeraïah u dei u nongïalam jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron . Ha ka snem kaba sawphew ba u Dabid u la long syiem , la don ka jingtohkit shaphang ka pateng longïing jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , bad la shem ba ki shipai bapawkhmat kiba na kane ka longïing la lap ba ki shong ki sah ha Jaser ha ka ri Gilead .

translation.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel : and the people mourned greatly .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kren , ki ïamkthang .

translation.en: And they put him in ward in chains , and brought him to the king of Babylon : they brought him into holds , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa u hapoh ka ruh bad ki la rah ïa u sha u syiem ka Babilonia . Ki la buh ïa u hapoh ki nongap , ba kumta ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong u yn ym ïohsngew pat halor ki lum jong ka Israel .

translation.en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi ,  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ,  yn plie ïa ka umpohliew ban pynkhuid ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem na ka pop bad ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: And ye shall eat neither bread , nor parched corn , nor green ears , until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
translation.kha: Wat bam na uta u kew thymmai , la uba dang im , ne uba la sdieh pyrthiew , ne uba la pynlong kpu , tad haduh ba phi la wallam ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban leh pateng la pateng .

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  will come upon thee , and thou shalt prophesy with them , and shalt be turned into another man .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan , U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  un wan da ka bor ha me , bad me ruh men ïashad bad ïarisa lang bad ki , bad men kylla long da uwei pat u briew .

translation.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out , and said with tears , Lord , I believe  ; help thou mine unbelief .
translation.kha: U kpa mar kumta hi u la pyrta ,  Nga don ka jingngeit , hynrei kam da biang . To ïarap ïa nga ba ngan don shuh shuh !

translation.en: Many will say to me in that day , Lord , Lord , have we not prophesied in thy name ? and in thy name have cast out devils ? and in thy name done many wonderful works ?
translation.kha: Haba ka Sngi Bishar ka poi , kiba bun kin ong ha nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ! Ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la kren ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , da ka kyrteng jong me ngi la beh noh ïa shibun ki ksuid bad ngi la leh shibun ki kambah !’

translation.en: My fruit is better than gold , yea , than fine gold  ; and my revenue than choice silver .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba me ïoh na nga ka kham bha ban ïa ka ksiar banylla , ka kham bha ban ïa ka rupa kaba kynsai .

translation.en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano ba me leit . Nga tip kumno me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And David said unto Michal , It was before the  Lord  , which chose me before thy father , and before all his house , to appoint me ruler over the people of the  Lord  , over Israel : therefore will I play before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba la jied ïa nga ha ka jaka u kpa jong pha bad ka longïing jong u , ban pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong ki briew jong u ki Israel . Bad ngan ïai shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation , and in sure dwellings , and in quiet resting places  ;
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei kin lait na ki jingkhuslai , bad ki ïing jong ki kin suk bad kin shngain .

translation.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .
translation.kha: Uei te uba lamler ? U dei uno uno uba ong ba U Jisu um dei U Messaïah . Kum uta u briew , u long u Nongshun jong U Khrist — u kyntait ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun ruh .

translation.en: And I find more bitter than death the woman , whose heart is snares and nets , and her hands as bands : whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her  ; but the sinner shall be taken by her .
translation.kha: Nga la shem ïa kaei kaei kaba kham kthang ban ïa ka jingïap — ka kynthei kaba long kum ka jingriam . Ka jingieit ba ka ai ïa phi kan kem ïa phi kum ka jar , bad ki kti jong ka sawdong jong phi kin bat ïa phi kum u kynjri . U briew uba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei u lah ban lait , hynrei kan kem ïa u nongpop .

translation.en: So Haman came in . And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ? Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u wan shapoh , bad u syiem u ong ha u ,  Don uba nga kwah eh ban lehburom . Kaei kaba ngan leh na ka bynta une u briew ?  U Haman u la pyrkhat ha lade ,  Mynta ïano u syiem u kwah eh ban pyndonburom ? Dei ïa nga keiñ .

translation.en: And it came to pass , after they were departed , that they came up out of the well , and went and told king David , and said unto David , Arise , and pass quickly over the water : for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you .
translation.kha: Haba ki la leit noh , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan ki wan mih na kata ka pukri bad ki la leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid . Ki la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Ahithophel u la pynkhreh pyrshah ïa u bad ong ,  To pynkloi bad jam ïa ka wah .

translation.en: But the fat , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver of the sin offering , he burnt upon the altar  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u thang ha ka duwan ïa ka khleiñ , ïa ki khyllai , bad ïa ka bynta bakynsai tam jong u dohnud , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And the children of Dan set up the graven image : and Jonathan , the son of Gershom , the son of Manasseh , he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki pynïeng ïa ka bleithaw ïa ka ban mane , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Gershom bad u khun ksiew jong u Moses , ki shakri kum ki lyngdoh ïa ka jait Dan , bad ki shakri kiba hiarpateng kum ki lyngdoh haduh ka jingshah ringmraw ki briew na kata ka ri .

translation.en: But if the priest buy any soul with his money , he shall eat of it , and he that is born in his house : they shall eat of his meat .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki mraw jong u lyngdoh , ïa kiba u la thied ne ïa kiba la kha ha ïing jong u , ki lah ban bam ïa kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: Then said the Jews among themselves , Whither will he go , that we shall not find him ? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles , and teach the Gentiles ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Shano ba un sa leit ba ngi ngin ym shem ïa u ? Hato un leit sha ki shnong jong ki Grik ha kaba ki briew jong ngi ki sah , bad ban hikai ïa ki Grik ?

translation.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre , saying , As thou didst deal with David my father , and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein , even so deal with me .
translation.kha: U Solomon u phah khubor sha u Hiram u syiem ka Tyros :  To ïakhaïi bad nga kumba phi la leh bad u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong nga , mynba phi la die ïa u ki dieng Kedar tylli na ka bynta ban tei ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .

translation.en: The counsel of the  Lord  standeth for ever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingthmu jong u ki neh junom , ki jingthmu jong u ki long pateng la pateng .

translation.en: My little children , let us not love in word , neither in tongue  ; but in deed and in truth .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , ka jingieit jong ngi kam dei ban long tang da ki ktien bad ka jingkren ; ka dei ban long ka jingieit kaba shisha , kaba pynpaw ïa lade da ka kam .

translation.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus , and bound him ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki shipai Rom lem bad u rangbah shipai jong ki bad ki nongap phira jong ki Jiw , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , ki la khum ïa u ,

translation.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke , and burst thy bands  ; and thou saidst , I will not transgress  ; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest , playing the harlot .
translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ko Israel , la slem bah me la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong nga ; me la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga bad mane ïa nga . Ha uwei pa uwei u lum bakynjang bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam me la mane ïa ki blei ka jingkharoi .

translation.en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel , saying , When I come again in peace , I will break down this tower .
translation.kha: Kumta u ong ha ki ,  Ngan sa wan pat ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ , bad haba nga wan , ngan pyntwa phum ïa une u mot !

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus , I would also hear the man myself . To morrow , said he , thou shalt hear him .
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos ,  Nga kwah ban ïohsngew ïa une u briew da lade hi .   Phin ïohsngew ïa u lashai ka sngi ,  u Phestos u la jubab .

translation.en: My son , attend unto my wisdom , and bow thine ear to my understanding :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to sngap bad shahshkor ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang jong nga .

translation.en: And he said unto his people , Behold , the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we :
translation.kha: Une u ong ha la ki briew ,  Kine ki Israel ki la ïaroi palat , bad ki la ïakhlaiñ eh ruh , bad ki long ka jingma ïa ngi .

translation.en: Therefore , when they were come hither , without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat , and commanded the man to be brought forth .
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan hangne , te , ngam shym la pyntud ei ei , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud nga la shong ha ka ïingbishar bad nga la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa uta u briew .

translation.en: When they were but a few men in number  ; yea , very few , and strangers in it .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat ha ka jingbun briew , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city , which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt , where also our Lord was crucified .
translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki bad un pynïap ïa ki , bad ki metïap jong ki kin shu sah ha ka surok bah jong kata ka nongbah bakhraw , ha kaba ïa U Trai jong ki la sahnarphna . Ka kyrteng pharshi jong kata ka nongbah ka long ka Sodom , lane ka Ijipt .

translation.en: Or if he ask a fish , will he give him a serpent ?
translation.kha: Lane hato phin ai ha u da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?

translation.en: Then Martha , as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming , went and met him : but Mary sat still in the house .
translation.kha: Haba ka Martha ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan , ka la leit ban ïakynduh ïa u , hynrei ka Mari ka la sah ha ïing .

translation.en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years , year after year  ; and David enquired of the  Lord . And the  Lord  answered , It is for Saul , and for his bloody house , because he slew the Gibeonites .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u Dabid , la don ka  nemsniew kaba jur kaba la neh haduh lai snem lynter . Kumta u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  shaphang kata bad U  Trai  u ong ,  U Saul bad ka longïing jong u ki long kiba rem ha ka jingpynïap briew ; u la pynïap ïa ki paid Gibeon .

translation.en: For as I passed by , and beheld your devotions , I found an altar with this inscription , TO THE UNKNOWN GOD . Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship , him declare I unto you .
translation.kha: Naba katba nga dang ïaid lyngba ka nongbah jong phi bad khmih ïa ki jaka ha kiba phi mane , nga la lap ïa ka duwan ha kaba la thoh , ‘ Ha U Blei uba ngim tip .’ Te ïa uta ïa uba phi mane , wat haba phim tip ïa u , ïa une keiñ nga pynbna mynta ha phi .

translation.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover thee ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyrta hukum ïa ki lyoh bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynjhieh ïa me da u slap ?

translation.en: Her gates are sunk into the ground  ; he hath destroyed and broken her bars : her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more  ; her prophets also find no vision from the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka lah ban ïohi da kaba suk , hynrei kam shym la pynpaw jingsngewkhia ei ei ïa la ka kupar . Ka jingkyllon jong ka , ka long kaba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop , bad ka kyang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingisynei .

translation.en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon , distress them not , nor meddle with them : for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession  ; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession .
translation.kha: Te phin sa poi hajan ka ri ki Ammon , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot . Wat pynjynjar ïa ki lane ïaleh thma bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki .’

translation.en: That thou mayest remember , and be confounded , and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame , when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan map ïa ki jingbakla baroh kiba pha la leh , hynrei phan kynmaw ïa ki bad sngewlehrain palat ban ang ïa la ka shyntur .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And Saul said , Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . And Jonathan was taken .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ,  To rai hapdeng jong nga bad u Jonathan u khun jong nga .  La kdew ïa u Jonathan .

translation.en: And again they said , Alleluia . And her smoke rose up for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Sa shisien ki la pyrta ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba la bam duh ïa ka nongbah bakhraw ka la kiew shajrong junom la junom !

translation.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon , a virgin , neither had any man known her : and she went down to the well , and filled her pitcher , and came up .
translation.kha: Ka long ka samla kaba bhabriew eh bad kaba dang sotti . Ka leit hiar sha ka pukri , ka pyndap um ha la u khiew bad ka wan kiew biang .

translation.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life : and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life  ; but the wrath of God abideth on him .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ha U Khun u don ka jingim bymjukut ; uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa U Khun un ym ïoh ïa ka jingim , hynrei un ïaisah ha ka jingpynshitom jong U Blei .

translation.en: The shield of his mighty men is made red , the valiant men are in scarlet : the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation , and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken .
translation.kha: Ki shipai jong u nongshun ki rah ïa ki stieh rong saw bad ki phong ki sopti rong saw . Ki pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ! Ki kali ïapom jong ki , ki thaba kum ka ding ! Ki kulai jong ki jam stet !

translation.en: And I will pour my fury upon Sin , the strength of Egypt  ; and I will cut off the multitude of No .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ïa ka nongbah Pelusium , ka kut bakhraw jong ka Ijipt , ban mad ïa ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Ngan pynjot ïa ka spah jong ka Thebes .
