translation.en: When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu shibun kiba la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki . U Jisu u la beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid da ka ktien bad u la pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la shitom .

translation.en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death : that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father , even so we also should walk in newness of life .
translation.kha: Da ka jingpynbaptis , ïa ngi la btep bad u , bad ngi ïadon bynta bad ka jingïap jong u , khnang ba , kumba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap da ka bor jong ka burom U Kpa , kumta ruh ma ngi , ngi lah ban im ka jingim bathymmai .

translation.en: And would to God this people were under my hand ! then would I remove Abimelech . And he said to Abimelech , Increase thine army , and come out .
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ngan ïoh ïalam ïa kine ki briew ! ngan jin da la pynher krad ïa u Abimelekh ! Ngan ong ïa u , ‘ Pynbun shuh shuh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me , ale to mih ban ïaleh !’

translation.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar , and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god .
translation.kha: Ha man ka jaka mane blei ki rangbah ki thiah ha ki jaiñ ïa kaba ki la shim na kiba duk kiba la buh bynda na ka bynta ki ram . Ha ka templ U Blei jong ki , ki dih ïa ka waiñ ba ki la shim na kito kiba ki shah pisa .

translation.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets , which have been since the world began :
translation.kha: U la kular lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u na mynbarim

translation.en: And they shall be joined unto thee , and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , for all the service of the tabernacle : and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban ïarap ïa me bad pyndep ïa la ki kamram kiba ïadei bad ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ , hynrei uno uno u bym bit bym biang um lah ban ïarap ïa me .

translation.en: And we took all his cities at that time , and utterly destroyed the men , and the women , and the little ones , of every city , we left none to remain :
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh ngi la ïohknieh bad pynjot ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong , bad ngi la pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , shynrang bad kynthei bad khynnah khlem pynsah ei ei shuh .

translation.en: And again , The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise , that they are vain .
translation.kha: bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Trai u tip ba ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba stad ki long ki bymdondor ei ei .

translation.en: Even such as he is able to get , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , with the meat offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the  Lord .
translation.kha: kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ïa kata kawei pat kum ka jingainguh thang ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam . Kumne keiñ uta u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka niam ka rukom kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .

translation.en: As I live , saith the  Lord  , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand , yet would I pluck thee thence  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u syiem Jehoïakhin , u khun jong u Jehoïakim u syiem ka Judah ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei Uba im . Wat la me long kum ka sati muhor ha ka kti kamon jong nga , ngan weng noh ïa me ,

translation.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground , and thy children within thee  ; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another  ; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation .
translation.kha: Kin pynjot thiaw ïa pha bad ïa ki briew kiba hapoh ki kynroh jong pha ; yn ym pynsah wat uwei ruh u maw ha ka jaka ba u don , namar ba pham shym ithuh ïa ka por mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa pha !

translation.en: And I went up by revelation , and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles , but privately to them which were of reputation , lest by any means I should run , or had run , in vain .
translation.kha: Nga la leit namar U Blei u la pynpaw ha nga ba nga dei ban leit . Ha ka jingïakynduh bajar jar bad ki nongïalam , nga la batai ïa ka khubor ka Gospel ïa kaba nga ïalap ha ki Jentil . Ngam shym la kwah ba ka jingtrei jong nga kaba mynshuwa bad kaba mynta kin shu sep-ei .

translation.en: If thou hast nothing to pay , why should he take away thy bed from under thee ?
translation.kha: Lada phim lah ban siew , kin knieh noh wat ïa ka jingthiah jong phi ruh .

translation.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you , whosoever of you are justified by the law ; ye are fallen from grace .
translation.kha: Kito na phi kiba pyrshang ban pynksan ha khmat U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , phi la dkhat noh ïa lade na U Khrist . Phi long shabar ka jingaiei U Blei .

translation.en: And on the fourth day ten bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw , ai shiphew tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle , because it is none of his : brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation .
translation.kha: Mynta uno uno u lah ban shong ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u — hadien ba la ber da u kyndok ban pynïap ïa ki khñiang jingpang !

translation.en: A froward man soweth strife : and a whisperer separateth chief friends .
translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki pynphriang ïa ki ktien lorni ; ki pynjynjar bad pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .

translation.en: Behold , I will bring it health and cure , and I will cure them , and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan sa pynkhiah ïa kane ka nongbah bad ki briew jong ka bad ngan pynïoh pat ha ki ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah . Ngan pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingsuk kyrhai bad ka jingshongshngain .

translation.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh , Beth–shean and her towns , Taanach and her towns , Megiddo and her towns , Dor and her towns . In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Manasseh ki pynïaid ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shan , ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo , bad ka Dor , bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ki . Kine baroh ki dei ki jaka ha kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph , u khun jong u Jakob , ki shong ki sah .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou steal .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat tuh .

translation.en: And I will bring them out from the people , and gather them from the countries , and will bring them to their own land , and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers , and in all the inhabited places of the country .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam noh ïa ki na ki ri nongwei , ngan lumlang ïa ki , bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki sha ka ri jong ki hi , ngan ïalam biang ïa ki sha ki lumbah bad ki wahduid ka Israel bad ngan bsa ïa ki ha ki jaka bam phlang kiba sngewtynnat .

translation.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker ! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth . Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it , What makest thou ? or thy work , He hath no hands ?
translation.kha: Hato u khiew khyndew un nud ban ïatainia bad u nongthaw jong u , u khiew uba long kum baroh kiwei pat ? Hato ka dewbyrtha kan ong ïa u nongthaw khiew kaei ba u leh ? Hato u khiew un mudui ïa la u nongthaw khiew ba um don jingtbit ?

translation.en: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another , and toward all men , even as we do toward you :
translation.kha: To U Trai un pynlong ïa ka jingieit jong phi iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh ban nang ïai san bad ban man khraw ha ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi .

translation.en: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
translation.kha: Ka la long la jan shiteng sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Pilat u la ong ha ki briew ,  Une u syiem jong phi !

translation.en: And if , when the priest seeth it , behold , it be in sight lower than the skin , and the hair thereof be turned white  ; the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa u , bad lada kata ka dak ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka bad ba u shñiuh hangta ruh u la kylla lieh , un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid . Kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba sdang na uta u tohjaw .

translation.en: Her former husband , which sent her away , may not take her again to be his wife , after that she is defiled  ; for that is abomination before the  Lord  : and thou shalt not cause the land to sin , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
translation.kha: uta u tnga nyngkong um dei shuh ban ïapoi shongkurim bad ka , namar ba ka la shah pyntngit . Lada u leh kumta , kan long kaba ijli ha khmat U  Trai  , bad phim dei ban leh kum kata ka pop kaba sngewshyrkhei ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

translation.en: Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .
translation.kha: Mynta to shim ïa ka bainong jong phi bad khie leit sha ïing . Nga kwah ban ai ha une u briew uba la shah khot khatduh katjuh kumba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And I took your sin , the calf which ye had made , and burnt it with fire , and stamped it , and ground it very small , even until it was as small as dust : and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount .
translation.kha: Nga shim ïa kata kaei kaei kaba long hi ka pop — kata ka dur khun masi keiñ kaba phi la thaw bad nga bret ïa ka ha ka ding . Nangta nga pynpait pharia ïa ka , nga tylliat ni ïa ka haduh ba kan da long kum u pui pui , bad nga bret ïa kata ha ka wah kaba tuid na uta u lum .

translation.en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot , and stood at the door of the house of Elisha .
translation.kha: Kumta u Naaman u la leit lem bad la ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u la sangeh ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Elisha .

translation.en: And thou shalt beat some of it very small , and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation , where I will meet with thee : it shall be unto you most holy .
translation.kha: Tylliat khyndiat ïa ka haduh ba kan da lwet ni bha , rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ber ïa ka ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Kheiñ ïa kane ka jingiwbih kum kaba da kyntang janai .

translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari , according to all their service , in the tabernacle of the congregation , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: Kine ki kur u Merari kin shong dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Ïingjaiñ , lem bad u Suriel u khun jong u Abihail kum u rangbah kur .

translation.en: And hath not oppressed any , but hath restored to the debtor his pledge , hath spoiled none by violence , hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment  ;
translation.kha: Um ju shukor lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u buh bynda ; u bsa ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .

translation.en: Go and say unto David , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things  ; choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Gad , u nongïathuhlypa jong u Dabid ,  Khie leit bad ong ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .  Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Dabid u la khie thiah ,

translation.en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem , that were called  ; and they went in their simplicity , and they knew not any thing .
translation.kha: La don arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba ha ka jingkhot sngewbha u Absalom ki la leit na Jerusalem bad u ; kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingthmu barieh bad ki la leit da kaba sngur mynsiem .

translation.en: I will never forget thy precepts : for with them thou hast quickened me .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leh lyndet ïa ki jingbthah jong me , namar da ki me la ri pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: What think ye ? They answered and said , He is guilty of death .
translation.kha: Kaei phi ïa-pyrkhat ?  Ki la jubab ,  U long uba shah pynrem bad u dei ban ïap .

translation.en: To the law and to the testimony : if they speak not according to this word , it is because there is no light in them .
translation.kha: Me dei ban jubab ïa ki ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u hikai ïa phi ! Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongkren byrtong — kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi kan ym weng ïa ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .
translation.kha: Man la ka snem wallam ïa ki soh ba phi la lum nyngkong na ka jingot sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .  Wat ju shet ïa u khunlangbrot ne khunblang ha ka dud ka kmie jong u .

translation.en: And many of the brethren in the Lord , waxing confident by my bonds , are much more bold to speak the word without fear .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingdon jong nga ha byndi , ka la ai ïa kiba bun eh ki parabangeit ban kham sngewskhem ha U Trai , khnang ba kin nang kham shlur ha ki por baroh ban ïalap ïa ka khubor khlem sheptieng .

translation.en: For the  Lord  your God is God of gods , and Lord of lords , a great God , a mighty , and a terrible , which regardeth not persons , nor taketh reward :
translation.kha: Naba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u long uba khrawbor tam halor ki blei baroh bad halor ki bor baroh . U long uba khraw bad uba donbor , bad uba dei ban sheptieng . U bym ñiewshiliang khmat bad u bym ju pdiang ïa ki jingai kiba da ka dohnud ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure , wherewith the  Lord  was wroth against you to destroy you . But the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also .
translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar shla U  Trai  , naba u la bitar lep kat haduh ba u la kloi wat ban pynjot ïa phi ; hynrei sa shisien U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: With all his reign and his might , and the times that went over him , and over Israel , and over all the kingdoms of the countries .
translation.kha: Ki jingthoh ki ïathuh kumno u la synshar , haduh katno u long uba khrawbor , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia ha u , ha ki Israel , bad ha ki hima baroh kiba marjan .

translation.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil , and Israel to the robbers ? did not the  Lord  , he against whom we have sinned ? for they would not walk in his ways , neither were they obedient unto his law .
translation.kha: Mano ba la ai ïa ki Israel ha ki nonglute ? Ka long na U  Trai  hi , pyrshah ïa u ba ngi la leh pop ! Ngim shym im kumba u kwah ïa ngi ban im , lane kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai kiba u ai ha ngi .

translation.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly , that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith , giving heed to seducing spirits , and doctrines of devils ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la ong shai ba yn don ki briew ki ban iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit ha ki Ïa kiba khatduh : Kin kohnguh ïa ki mynsiem bashukor bad kin bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki ksuid .

translation.en: And , lo , I perceived that God had not sent him  ; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me : for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him .
translation.kha: Haba nga la pyrkhat bha ïa ka , nga sngewthuh ba U Blei um pat shym la kren ha u Shemaïah , hynrei ba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la pynbam pisa ïa u ban ai ïa nga ïa kane ka jingmaham .

translation.en: Then one of the twelve , called Judas Iscariot , went unto the chief priests ,
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran — uta uba kyrteng u Judas Iskariot — u la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ,

translation.en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
translation.kha: Baroh kiwei pat ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh .  Tur pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth bad phin sa jop ,  ki ong ,  U  Trai  un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .

translation.en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself , lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds .
translation.kha: To da pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba u la ïaid lyngba , kumno u la buh ïa lade ban shah isih ha ki nongpop ! Kumta wat ai ba phin noh mynsiem bad kynran dien .

translation.en: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle , and put the covering of the tent above upon it  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U siang ïa ka jingsiang halor ka Ïingjaiñ bad u buh sa ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: How is Sheshach taken ! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised ! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations !
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Babilon :  Ïa ka nongbah kaba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la ïaroh la kurup ïa ka ! Katno kaba itriem ban ïohi ba ka Babilon ka la long ïa ki jaitbynriew !

translation.en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops  ; and them that worship and that swear by the  Lord  , and that swear by Malcham  ;
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa uno uno uba leit kiew sha tnum ïing bad mane ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur . Nga pynjot ruh ïa kito kiba mane ïa nga bad kiba smai ban ïaineh ha nga , hynrei pynban ki shim smai ha ka kyrteng jong u blei Molekh .

translation.en: And now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning this city , whereof ye say , It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , ki briew ki ïa-ong ba ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah ban hap ha ki kti jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei de kaba nga don ban ong .

translation.en: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship , when they had let down the boat into the sea , under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki maji ki la pyrshang ban phet na ka lieng ; ki la pynhiar ïa ka lieng rit sha ka duriaw bad ki la leh mynleh kumba ki mut ban buh sa katto katne ki angkor ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng .

translation.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
translation.kha: Ynda nga la jop ïa ki , ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: The  Lord  liveth  ; and blessed be my rock  ; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u im ! To ïaroh ïa u nongïada jong nga ! To pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei uba khlaiñ uba pynim ïa nga !

translation.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar , and Ahuzzath one of his friends , and Phichol the chief captain of his army .
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u la wan na Gerar lem bad u Ahussath u nongaibuit jong u bad u Phikol u rangbah shipai jong u ban ïakynduh ïa u Isaak .

translation.en: And therefore will the  Lord  wait , that he may be gracious unto you , and therefore will he be exalted , that he may have mercy upon you : for the  Lord  is a God of judgment : blessed are all they that wait for him .
translation.kha: Pynban U  Trai  u ap ban leh-isynei ïa phi . U kloi ban sngewlem ïa phi namar u long borabor uba leh ïa kaba dei . Suk kito kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki ha U  Trai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Refrain thy voice from weeping , and thine eyes from tears : for thy work shall be rewarded , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy .
translation.kha: To sngap noh na ka jingïam jong phi bad to ñiad noh ïa ki ummat jong phi . Baroh kiba phi la leh na ka bynta ki khun jong phi kin ym long lehnoh-ei ; kin wan phai pat na ka ri u nongshun .

translation.en: The proud have digged pits for me , which are not after thy law .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong , ki bymkohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong me , ki la tih ki thliew ban riam ïa nga .

translation.en: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house  ; and the houses of ivory shall perish , and the great houses shall have an end , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki ïingshong tlang bad ki ïingshong lyiur . Ki ïing ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati kin kyllon ha ka jingjot ; man la kawei pa kawei ka ïing bah kan jot thiaw .

translation.en: Then Moses said unto Aaron , This is it that the  Lord  spake , saying , I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me , and before all the people I will be glorified . And Aaron held his peace .
translation.kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren shaphang jong ka mynba u ong , ‘ Baroh kiba shakri ïa nga ki dei ban burom ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong nga ; ngan pynpaw ïa ka burom jong nga ha la ki briew .’   Hynrei u Aaron u shu sngap jar .

translation.en: But let him that glorieth glory in this , that he understandeth and knoweth me , that I am the  Lord  which exercise lovingkindness , judgment , and righteousness , in the earth : for in these things I delight , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u kwah ban kob sarong , u dei ban kob sarong ba u ithuh bad ba u shemphang ïa nga , namar ka jingieit jong nga ka long kaba neh , bad nga leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba dei . Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren , that they would go before unto you , and make up beforehand your bounty , whereof ye had notice before , that the same might be ready , as a matter of bounty , and not as of covetousness .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam ban kyntu ïa kine ki parabangeit ban leit ha shuwa jong nga sha phi bad ïoh pynkhreh lypa ïa ka jingai kaba phi la kular . Te kan long kaba la pynkhreh haba nga poi , bad kan pyn-i ba phi ai namar ba phi kwah ban leh kumta , ym namar ba phi dei ban leh kumta .

translation.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail , and they shall not escape , and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki bymman kin peit sawdong ha ka jinglyng-a bad kin shem ba ym don lynti ban phet ïap . Tang kawei ka jingkyrmen ïa ki ka long ba ka jingïap kan wan .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they journeyed from the east , that they found a plain in the land of Shinar  ; and they dwelt there .
translation.kha: Te ynda ki briew ki la ïaid kylleng ha ka phang mihngi , ki la poi sha ka pyntha ha Babilonia bad ki la ïashong sah hangta .

translation.en: And saying , Sirs , why do ye these things ? We also are men of like passions with you , and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God , which made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all things that are therein :
translation.kha: Balei phi leh ïa kane ? Ngi hi ngi long tang ki briew kiba kum ma phi ! Ngi don hangne ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , ban pynphai noh ïa phi na kine kiei kiei ki bymmyntoi sha U Blei uba im , uba la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa baroh kat kaba don ha ki .

translation.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar , as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Nangta un thang ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh halor ka duwan , kumba ju thang ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u nongsynshar , bad yn map ïa u .

translation.en: Remember this , and shew yourselves men : bring it again to mind , O ye transgressors .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kane , phi ki nongpop ; pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .

translation.en: While Peter thought on the vision , the Spirit said unto him , Behold , three men seek thee .
translation.kha: U Petros u dang ïai pyrshang ban shemphang aïu ka jingïohipaw ka kit jingmut , haba U Mynsiem u la ong ,  Ha sngap ! Lai ngut ki rangbah ki ïawad ïa me .

translation.en: Then these men assembled unto the king , and said unto the king , Know , O king , that the law of the Medes and Persians is , That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed .
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah ki la wan biang sha u syiem bad ki la ong ha u ,  U Syiem Kynrad u tip ba kat kum ki aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia ym don kano kano ka hukum kaba u syiem u la ai ïa kaba lah ban pynkylla .

translation.en: If ye shall ask any thing in my name , I will do it .
translation.kha: Lada phi pan na nga ïa kano kano ha ka kyrteng jong nga , ngan leh ïa kata .

translation.en: But the children of the murderers he slew not : according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses , wherein the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers  ; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin .
translation.kha: Pynban , um shym pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki hynrei u kohnguh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ha ka Aiñ u Moses :  Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ki khun kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba u hi u la leh .

translation.en: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken .
translation.kha: U bymman u kyrhuh bad u byrngem kum ki sing , hynrei U Blei u pynsngap jar ïa ki bad u sloit ïa ki bniat jong ki .

translation.en: Praise him for his mighty acts : praise him according to his excellent greatness .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u namar ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh . To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw ba-halor tam jong u .

translation.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain : and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them . And he suffered them .
translation.kha: Hangta hajan , la don ka kynhun bah ki sniang , kiba ïabam jingbam ha ki sharing lum . Kumta ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban shah ïa ki ban rung shapoh ki sniang , bad u la shah ïa ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon : of shittim wood shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih .

translation.en: Son of man , Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre : every head was made bald , and every shoulder was peeled : yet had he no wages , nor his army , for Tyre , for the service that he had served against it :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la hiarthma ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Tyros . U la pynlong ïa ki shipai jong u ban kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia haduh ba ki khlieh jong ki , ki la dkhoi ki shñiuh bad ki tyrpeng jong ki , ki la tyrkhong khait , hynrei u syiem lymne ka kynhun shipai jong u kim shym ïoh ei ei na baroh ki jinglehshitom jong ki .

translation.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka dei ban long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .

translation.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating . And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet , he said , Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar ?
translation.kha: Katba u Adonijah bad baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha ki dang shu lah bam , ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa . Bad haba u Joab u la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi , u la kylli ,  Kaei ka jingmut jong kata ka jingsawa baroh hapoh ka nongbah ?

translation.en: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement : it shall be an holy convocation unto you  ; and ye shall afflict your souls , and offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ka long ka sngi ka jingpyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba man ka snem ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Wat bam ei ei ruh em ha kata ka sngi ; ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai .

translation.en: Without charge , a friendly neighbor qualified to teach the Bible can come to your home or another convenient location and spend a little time each week discussing the Bible with you .
translation.kha: Ïwei na ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah in wan sha ïing jong phi lane ha kano kano ka jaka kaba phi kwah , bad man la ka taiew kin wan ban phylliew jingmut bad phi na ka Baibl .

translation.en: I will surely consume them , saith the  Lord  : there shall be no grapes on the vine , nor figs on the fig tree , and the leaf shall fade  ; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them .
translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba u briew u lumlang ïa ka jingot jong u ; hynrei ki long kum u dieng sohwaiñ khlem ki sohwaiñ , kum u diengsoh Dumbur khlem ki soh Dumbur ; wat ki sla ki la jlop . Namar kata , nga la shah ïa kiba nabar ban shim noh ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And Miriam answered them , Sing ye to the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously  ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
translation.kha: Ka Miriam ka la rwai na ka bynta jong ki :  To rwai ha U  Trai namar ba u la jop ka jingjop badonburom ; u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong jong ki sha ka duriaw .

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , within and without shalt thou overlay it , and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla na shapoh bad shabar , bad pynpur da ka ksiar ha ka rmiang jong ka baroh sawdong .

translation.en: And they came over unto the other side of the sea , into the country of the Gadarenes .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la poi sha shiliang ka duriaw Galilaïa , ha ka ri Gerasa .

translation.en: But though we , or an angel from heaven , preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you , let him be accursed .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ma ngi ne u angel na bneng kin ïalap ïa ka Gospel kaba pher na kata ïa kaba ngi la ïalap ha phi , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok!

translation.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , but hast fretted me in all these things  ; behold , therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head , saith the Lord  God  : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Pha la klet kumno nga la leh ïa pha mynba pha dang samla , bad pha la pynbitar ïa nga da kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh . Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la pynlong ïa pha ban shah na ka bynta jong ki baroh . Balei pha bynrap ïa ka jingawria jakhlia ha baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba pha la leh ?  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: Ye are of God , little children , and have overcome them : because greater is he that is in you , than he that is in the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi long ki jong U Blei , ko ki khun jong nga , bad phi la jop ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , namar U Mynsiem uba don ha phi , u long uba kham donbor ban ïa u mynsiem ha kito kiba long na ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , but not as the kings of Israel that were before him .
translation.kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um shym tam ïa ki syiem kiba la synshar ha Israel ha shuwa jong u .

translation.en: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold , although they were yet alive : for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof , which shall not return  ; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life .
translation.kha: Yn ym don nongkhaïi ki ban im haduh ban ïoh biang ïa kaei kaba ki la duh , namar ka jingbitar U Blei ka long halor baroh . Kito kiba bymman kin ym lait im .

translation.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law , both of them shall surely be put to death : they have wrought confusion  ; their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim , baroh ar ngut kin shah pynïap . Ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang , bad ki la pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: And when he came to his disciples , he saw a great multitude about them , and the scribes questioning with them .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïadon bad kiwei ki synran , ki la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun sawdong jong ki bad katto katne na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ïania bad ki .

translation.en: And they rose up in the morning early , and worshipped before the  Lord  , and returned , and came to their house to Ramah : and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife  ; and the  Lord  remembered her .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Elkanah bad baroh kiba ha ka ïing jong u ki la khie dang step phyrngab , bad hadien ba ki la mane ïa U  Trai  ; ki leit phai pat sha la ïing ha Ramah . U Elkanah u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Hannah ka tnga jong u , bad U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong ka .

translation.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling , and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u jynthut , u tlot bad u lwait , ki ktien jong me ki kyrshan ïa u ban ïeng .

translation.en: But the high places were not taken away : the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places .
translation.kha: Pynban , ym shym la pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .

translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the people tremble : he sitteth between the cherubims  ; let the earth be moved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh . U shong ha ka khet halor ki kherub , bad ka pyrthei kan khynñiuh .

translation.en: For she had said unto the servant , What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us ? And the servant had said , It is my master : therefore she took a veil , and covered herself .
translation.kha: bad ka kylli ïa u shakri jong u Abraham ,  Uei utai u briew uba ïaid ha pyntha sha pyrshah jong ngi ?   U dei u kynrad jong nga ,  la jubab uta u shakri . Kumta ka shim ïa la ka jaiñsop ryndang bad ka la tap ïa la ka khmat .

translation.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei naduh mynta U Khun U Briew un shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: And as they went to tell his disciples , behold , Jesus met them , saying ,  All hail .  And they came and held him by the feet , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Kynsan U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa ki bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad phi .  Ki la leit sha u , bad ki la bat ïa ki kjat jong u , bad ki la mane ïa u .

translation.en: If we let him thus alone , all men will believe on him : and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation .
translation.kha: Lada ngi shah bad ïai leh ha kane ka rukom , baroh kin ngeit ha u , bad ki nongsynshar ka Hima Rom kin leh ei ei bad kin pynjot ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .

translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering .
translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong ka bad un pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Baroh na phi phin phet noh bad phin iehnoh ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ka kynhun langbrot yn pynsakma .’

translation.en: What manner of saying is this that he said ,  Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come ?
translation.kha: U ong ba ngin wad ïa u hynrei ngin ym shem ïa u , bad ba ngim lah ban leit sha kaba un don . U mut aïu ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Samuel was old , that he made his sons judges over Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Samuel u la tymmen , u thung nongbishar ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ha Israel .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Martha , Martha , thou art careful and troubled about many things :
translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab ïa ka ,  Martha , Martha ! Pha la khuslai bad pha la sngew jynjar halor bun kiei kiei ,

translation.en: If ye know these things , happy are ye if ye do them .
translation.kha: Mynta ba phi tip ïa kane ka jingshisha , katno kiba kmen phin long lada phi pyntreikam ïa ka !

translation.en: They were driven forth from among men , ( they cried after them as after a thief  ; )
translation.kha: Baroh ki la beh ïa ki ryngkat bad ki jingkynha , kumba ki kynha ïa ki nongtuh .

translation.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .
translation.kha: bad ban nym pynshahshkor shuh ha ki khanatang jong ki Jiw bad ha ki hukum briew kiba wan na ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul  ;
translation.kha: Phin sa long uba stad , bad ka jingtip jong phi kan ai jingkmen ïa phi .

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines : and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me : the  Lord  also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Un aiti noh ïa me bad ïa ki Israel ha ki Philistia . Lashai ka sngi ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin sa ïadon ryngkat bad nga , bad U  Trai  un aiti noh ruh ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ha ki Philistia .

translation.en: And he said unto him , I am the  Lord  that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldeans , to give thee this land to inherit it .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Nga long U  Trai  , uba la wan ïalam ïa me na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia , ban ai ha me ïa kane ka ri kum ka jong me hi .

translation.en: And he made in Jerusalem engines , invented by cunning men , to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks , to shoot arrows and great stones withal . And his name spread far abroad  ; for he was marvellously helped , till he was strong .
translation.kha: Ha Jerusalem , ki nongshna tiar jong u ki shna ïa ki tiar ki tar ban siat ïa ki khnam bad kawang ïa ki maw kiba heh na ki kut bad ki kyndong jong ka kynroh ka nongbah . Ka nam jong u ka la phriang kylleng sawdong , bad u la long uba khlaiñbor katta katta namar ka jingïarap ba u ïohpdiang na U Blei .

translation.en: Come to Beth–el , and transgress  ; at Gilgal multiply transgression  ; and bring your sacrifices every morning , and your tithes after three years :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , khie leit sha ka jaka bakhuid ka Bethel bad leh pop , lada phi hap ban leh kumta ! Khie leit sha Gilgal bad to leh pop da ka jingkhlaiñbor jong phi baroh ! Ïaid shaphrang bad wallam ïa ki mrad ban kñia na ka step sha ka step , bad wallam ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi man la ka sngi kaba lai .

translation.en: And these all , having obtained a good report through faith , received not the promise :
translation.kha: Ïa kine baroh la buh jingthoh naba ki la jop da ka jingngeit ! hynrei kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: And they sware unto the  Lord  with a loud voice , and with shouting , and with trumpets , and with cornets .
translation.kha: Ha ka sur kaba jam ki shim ïa ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba kin bat ïa ka jutang , bad nangta ki pyrta bad ki put ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying ,  Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , U Jisu u la phah noh lem bad kine ki jingbthah harum :  Wat leit sha kano kano ka thain jong ki Jentil lane sha kano kano ka shnong ki nong Samaria .

translation.en: Cursed be the day wherein I was born : let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed .
translation.kha: Long ba la tim kata ka sngi ba la kha ïa nga ! To klet noh ïa ka sngi ba i mei jong nga i kha ïa nga !

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: They shall also bring up a company against thee , and they shall stone thee with stones , and thrust thee through with their swords .
translation.kha: Kin pynkhih buk ïa u paidbah ban lynthem maw ïa pha , bad kin ot lyngkhot ïa pha da ki waitlam jong ki .

translation.en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Suffer little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: hynrei , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khynnah sha u bad u la ong ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan sha nga bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long ïa kiba kum kine .

translation.en: Lord , they have killed thy prophets , and digged down thine altars ; and I am left alone , and they seek my life .
translation.kha: Ko Trai , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me bad pynkhyllem ïa ki duwan jong me ; nga long sa tang ma nga marwei uba sah , bad ki pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance : but he that cometh after me is mightier than I , whose shoes I am not worthy to bear : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost , and with fire :
translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um ban pyn-i ba phi la kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei uta uba wan hadien jong nga un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding . U long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga ; bad ngam long uba bit wat tang ban rah ïa ki juti jong u .

translation.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity : and the rod of his anger shall fail .
translation.kha: Lada phi bet ïa ki symbai ka jingbymhok , ka jingpynjot kan mih , bad ka jingbanbeiñ jong phi ïa kiwei kan kut noh .

translation.en: Again , they are minished and brought low through oppression , affliction , and sorrow .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong U Blei ki shahjop bad shah ibeiñ da ki jingbanbeiñ bad jingjynjar bashyrkhei ,

translation.en: The fifth , sardonyx  ; the sixth , sardius  ; the seventh , chrysolite  ; the eighth , beryl  ; the ninth , a topaz  ; the tenth , a chrysoprasus  ; the eleventh , a jacinth  ; the twelfth , an amethyst .
translation.kha: uba san u maw Oniks , uba hynriew u maw Karnelian , uba hynñiew u mawleiñ bastem , uba phra u maw Beryl , uba khyndai u maw Topas , uba shiphew u maw Khalkedon , uba khatwei u maw Turkwois , uba khat-ar u maw Amethyst .

translation.en: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall : and when he had tasted thereof , he would not drink .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la tyrwa ïa U Jisu ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka kynja bakthang ; hynrei hadien ba u la mad ïa ka , um treh dih .

translation.en: Jesus said unto them ,  If ye were blind , ye should have no sin : but now ye say , We see  ; therefore your sin remaineth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Lada phi la long kiba matlah , te phin ym long kiba la shah pynrem ; hynrei naba phi kam ba phi ïohi , kane ka mut ba phi dang don ha ka jingpynrem .

translation.en: Likewise the second also , and the third , unto the seventh .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka jingjia ka la wan jia ha u para uba ar , uba lai , bad khatduh ha baroh hynñiew ngut .

translation.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te ban ym noh mynsiem namar nga shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi ; ka dei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong phi baroh .

translation.en: The new wine mourneth , the vine languisheth , all the merryhearted do sigh .
translation.kha: Ki bri sohwaiñ ki la ïapstai bad ka um sohwaiñ ka la nang duna . Baroh kiba la long shisien kiba kmen , mynta ki sngewsih ,

translation.en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God : and Aaron came , and all the elders of Israel , to eat bread with Moses  father in law before God .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jethro u la wanrah ïa ka jingainguh ban thang tylli bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki jingainguh ban ai jingkñia sha U Blei ; bad u Aaron lem bad nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh ki la ïaleit bad u ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba kyntang kum ka dak ka jingmane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  Ye know not what ye ask : can ye drink of the cup that I drink of ? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan . Hato phi lah ban dih na ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom kaba nga dei ban dih ? Hato phi lah ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynbaptis ?

translation.en: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth–el  ; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth–el : the words which he had spoken unto the king , them they told also to their father .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don uwei u nongïathuhlypa uba la tymmen uba shong ha Bethel . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki la wan ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u la leh ha Bethel ha kata ka sngi bad ïa kaei kaba u la kren ha u syiem Jeroboam .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the book of the law , that he rent his clothes .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka Kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsheptieng ,

translation.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves , or of the young pigeons , such as he can get  ;
translation.kha: Nangta un kñia ïa kawei na kita ki paro lane ki lyngdkhur

translation.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .
translation.kha: U Blei u kren ban pynlong ïa ki ban pynphai ïa ki na kaba leh pop bad ban pyllait ïa ki na kaba sngewsarong .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .
translation.kha: U ong ha nga ,  Ka jingpynjot kan thnam na ka phang bashatei halor baroh kiba shong basah ha kane ka ri ,

translation.en: And they journeyed from Oboth , and pitched at Iye–abarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , ki la sher dara ha ki nongrim ba la jot jong ka Abarim kaba ha ka ri khlaw , shaphang mihngi na ka ri Moab .

translation.en: But his citizens hated him , and sent a message after him , saying , We will not have this man to reign over us .
translation.kha: Mynta , ki para ri jong u ki la isih ïa u , bad kumta ki la phah ïa ki nonglamktien hadien jong u ban ong , ‘ Ngim kwah ïa une u briew ban long u syiem jong ngi .’

translation.en: Then Festus , when he had conferred with the council , answered , Hast thou appealed unto Caesar ? unto Caesar shalt thou go .
translation.kha: Nangta u Phestos , hadien ba u la ïakren bad ki nongai jingmut jong u , u la jubab ,  Me la apil sha u Patsha , kumta sha u Patsha men leit .

translation.en: And they took their bones , and buried them under a tree at Jabesh , and fasted seven days .
translation.kha: Nangta ki khar ïa ki shyieng bad ki tep ïa ki hapoh uwei u dieng Tamarisk uba ha kata ka shnong , bad ki ïashahjingit hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself : and when he came home , he sent and called for his friends , and Zeresh his wife .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la shu tyngkan ïa lade bad u leit sha ïing . Nangta u khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong u sha ka ïing jong u bad ong ïa ka tnga jong u ka Seresh ban wan ban ïadon ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the  Lord  , if the thing follow not , nor come to pass , that is the thing which the  Lord  hath not spoken , but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously : thou shalt not be afraid of him .
translation.kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u kren ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  bad kata kaba u kren kam shym urlong , kata kam dei ka khubor U  Trai . Uta u nongïathuhlypa u la kren na lade hi , bad phim dei ban sheptieng ïa u .

translation.en: That they feared greatly , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all the men thereof were mighty .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki sngewkyndit shikatdei eh da ka jingsheptieng ha kane , namar ka Gibeon ka long ka nongbah kaba heh kum kano kano ka nongbah kaba don la u syiem ; ka kham heh ban ïa ka Ai , bad ki rangbah jong ka ki long ki riewïaleh kiba tbit .

translation.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things  ; and holy is his name .
translation.kha: namar jong kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la leh na ka bynta jong nga . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba khuid ;

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will feed them , even this people , with wormwood , and give them water of gall to drink .
translation.kha: Kumta te , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan leh : Ngan ai ki jhur kthang ha ki briew jong nga ban bam bad ka bih ban dih .

translation.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil ? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip haduh katno ki kit ïa la ki khun rit ? Hato me tip ïa ka por ba yn kha ïa ki ?

translation.en: Thomas saith unto him , Lord , we know not whither thou goest  ; and how can we know the way ?
translation.kha: U Thomas u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , ngim tip shano ba men leit ; te kumno ngin tip ïa ka lynti ban poi hangta ?

translation.en: And Samuel said unto all Israel , Behold , I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me , and have made a king over you .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Nga la leh ïa kaba phi la ong ïa nga ban leh . Nga la ai ïa phi u syiem ban synshar ïa phi ,

translation.en: Behold , the name of the  Lord  cometh from far , burning with his anger , and the burden thereof is heavy : his lips are full of indignation , and his tongue as a devouring fire :
translation.kha: Ïa ka bor bad ka burom U  Trai  yn ïohi naduh na sha jngai . Ka ding bad ka tdem ki pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar jong u . U kren , bad ki ktien jong u ki meh kum ka ding .

translation.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong u briew uba bha kin long kiba donbor ha ka ri ; ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

translation.en: The righteous perisheth , and no man layeth it to heart : and merciful men are taken away , none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki ïap , bad ym don uba sngewthuh lane wat ban suidñiew . Hynrei haba ki ïap , yn ym don jingjynjar shuh ki ban ktah ïa ki .

translation.en: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses  ; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever .
translation.kha: Phi beh noh ïa ki kynthei jong ki briew jong nga na ki ïing ba ki ieit , bad phi lute khlem kut ïa ki jingkyrkhu jong nga na ki khun jong ki .

translation.en: And when the hour was come , he sat down , and the twelve apostles with him .
translation.kha: Haba ka kynta ka la poi , U Jisu u la shong ha la ka jaka ha ka miej lem bad ki apostol .

translation.en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them : but the people magnified them .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano nabar ka kynhun kiba la nud ban ïasoh bad ki , wat la ki paidbah ki la kren ïaroh ïa ki .

translation.en: But let patience have her perfect work , that ye may be perfect and entire , wanting nothing .
translation.kha: Pynthikna ba ka jingïaishah jong phi ka rah ïa phi artet ka lynti khlem da hap noh , khnang ba phin long kiba janai bad kiba dap pura , khlem jingduna ei ei .

translation.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights , and none spake a word unto him : for they saw that his grief was very great .
translation.kha: Nangta ki shong ha madan bad u haduh hynñiew sngi hynñiew miet khlem kren shikyntien ruh , namar ki la ïohi haduh katno u shah jynjar .

translation.en: And brought them to the magistrates , saying , These men , being Jews , do exceedingly trouble our city ,
translation.kha: Ki la ïalam ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom bad ki la ong ,  Kine ki briew ki dei ki Jiw , bad ki la thaw jingkulmar ha ka nongbah jong ngi .

translation.en: For I know not to give flattering titles  ; in so doing my maker would soon take me away .
translation.kha: Ngam nang kumno ban pynroh , bad U Blei shen un pynshitom ïa nga lada nga leh kumta .

translation.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh , arm yourselves likewise with the same mind : for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Khrist u la shahshitom ha ka doh , phi ruh phi dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa lade da kajuh ka jingpyrkhat kaba u la don ; namar uno uno uba shahshitom ha ka doh um ïakhleh shuh bad ka pop .

translation.en: For this is the will of God , even your sanctification , that ye should abstain from fornication :
translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban long kiba khuid bad kiba lait phar na ka jingjakhlia ka jingawria .

translation.en: Then again called they the man that was blind , and said unto him , Give God the praise : we know that this man is a sinner .
translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la khot biang ïa uta u briew ïa uba la kha matlah , bad ki la ong ha u ,  To kular ha khmat U Blei ba men ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Ngi tip ba une u briew uba la pynkoit ïa me u dei u nongpop .

translation.en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest , saying , It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house :
translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki ïing kiba bit bthuh . ( Kine kin treikam hadien ba ki Israel ki la rung sha ri Kanaan , ha kaba U  Trai  un ai ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti . ) Lada uno uno u shem ba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka jingpang bthuh ha ka ïing jong u , te u dei ban leit ïathuh ha u lyngdoh shaphang kata .

translation.en: One woe is past  ; and , behold , there come two woes more hereafter .
translation.kha: Ka jingkordit kaba nyngkong ka la kut ; hadien kane ka don sa ar tylli ki jingkordit ki ban wan .

translation.en: And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?
translation.kha: Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , u la ong ha ki ,  Ko para Israel , balei phi ïakyndit ha kane , bad balei ba phi peit seh ïa ngi ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei da ka bor jong ngi hi lane da ka jingriewblei jong ngi hi ba ngi la pynlong ïa une u briew ban ïaid ?

translation.en: And Esau said to Jacob , Feed me , I pray thee , with that same red pottage  ; for I am faint : therefore was his name called Edom .
translation.kha: U la thngan bad u ong ha u Jakob ,  Nga la thngan shaba palat , to ai khyndiat ba ngan dih ïa kato ka syrwa saw .  ( Dei namar kata ba la khot ïa u , u Edom . )

translation.en: These are spots in your feasts of charity , when they feast with you , feeding themselves without fear : clouds they are without water , carried about of winds  ; trees whose fruit withereth , without fruit , twice dead , plucked up by the roots  ;
translation.kha: Da ki jingkhroh bym don jinglehrain , ki long ka jingthohbria ha ki jingkhawai ïasyllok jong phi . Ki kitkhia tang na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki long kum ki lyoh ba rah ka lyer , hynrei khlem wanrah slap . Ki long kum ki dieng ba khlem soh , wat ha ka synrai , ki dieng ba la rat naduh ki thied bad kiba la ïap noh .

translation.en: For the king s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram : every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .
translation.kha: U don ka kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid sha duriaw ryngkat bad ki liengbah jong u syiem Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki lieng jong u ki wan phai , ki da kit ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .

translation.en: And the men of Israel said , Have ye seen this man that is come up ? surely to defy Israel is he come up : and it shall be , that the man who killeth him , the king will enrich him with great riches , and will give him his daughter , and make his father s house free in Israel .
translation.kha: Peit ïa une u briew  ki ïakren para ma ki .  Sngap ïa ki jingkob jong u . U syiem Saul un ai ka nong kaba khraw ïa u briew u ban pynïap ïa u ; u syiem un ai ruh ban shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u bad ka ïing u kpa jong u kam donkam ban siew khajna .

translation.en: Balaam also the son of Beor , the soothsayer , did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them .
translation.kha: Napdeng kito kiba ki paid Israel ki la pynïap , u dei u Balaam , u nongkren byrtong , u khun jong u Beor .

translation.en: And he said , Hear ye now , O house of David  ; Is it a small thing for you to weary men , but will ye weary my God also ?
translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab ïa kata ,  To shahshkor , mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka long kaba sniew eh ïa phi ban pynthait ïa ka jingïaishah jong ki briew — hato phi donkam ruh ban pynthait ïa ka jingïaishah ka jong U Blei ?

translation.en: For in that he died , he died unto sin once : but in that he liveth , he liveth unto God .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , namar ba u la ïap , ka pop kan ym donbor shuh halor jong u ; bad mynta u im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei .

translation.en: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la don ha ka ïingbishar syiem haduh ba u Syros u patsha jong ka Persia u la jop ïa ka Babilonia .

translation.en: Thus the  Lord  saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria , and from the hand of all other , and guided them on every side .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u syiem Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem na ka bor u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , bad ruh na kiwei ki nongshun jong ki . U ai ba ki briew kin im ha ka jingsuk bad baroh ki ri kiba marjan .

translation.en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious : but unto them which be disobedient , the stone which the builders disallowed , the same is made the head of the corner ,
translation.kha: Une u maw u long uba kordor eh ïa phi kiba ngeit ; hynrei ha kito ki bymngeit :  U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .

translation.en: These have power to shut heaven , that it rain not in the days of their prophecy : and have power over waters to turn them to blood , and to smite the earth with all plagues , as often as they will .
translation.kha: Ki don ka bor ban set ïa ka sahit bneng ba yn ym hap slap ha ka por ba ki pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Ki don ka bor ruh halor ki pukri um , ban pynkylla snam ïa ki ; ki don ka bor ruh ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da kano kano ka jait khlam katba shong ka mon jong ki .

translation.en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hair in the bright spot , and it be no lower than the other skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u shñiuh ha kata ka dak um kylla lieh , bad kata ka dak kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh u dei ban pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: And there was no bread in all the land  ; for the famine was very sore , so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine .
translation.kha: Kata ka  nemsniew ka la jur katta katta ba ym don jingbam shuh hangno hangno , ki briew ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan ki la nang tlot namar ka jingthngan .

translation.en: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed , which men deliver to one that is learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I cannot  ; for it is sealed :
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingmut jong kawei pa kawei ka jingïohipaw u nongïathuhlypa yn buhrieh noh na phi ; kan long kum ka kot kli ba la khang pynskhem da ka muhor . Lada phi leit rah ïa ka sha uno uno uba tip ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha phi , un ong ba um lah ban pule namar ba la khang pynskhem da ka muhor ïa ka .

translation.en: Therefore David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go and smite these Philistines ? And the  Lord  said unto David , Go , and smite the Philistines , and save Keilah .
translation.kha: Kumta u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Hato ngan leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ?   Ho-oid  U  Trai  u jubab .  Tur ïaleh ïa ki bad pyllait im ïa ka Keilah .

translation.en: Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la wan sha u na Jerusalem , na ka probins    baroh kawei jong ka Judia bad na kylleng ka ri kaba hajan ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: Neither did we eat any man s bread for nought ; but wrought with labour and travail night and day , that we might not be chargeable to any of you :
translation.kha: Ngim shym la pdiang ïa ka jingkyrshan jongno jongno khlem da siewdor ïa ka . Pynban , ngi la trei bad minot thop ; ngi ïai trei mynsngi bad mynmiet khnang ban ym long ka jingbankhia ïano ïano na phi .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto him , Master , all these have I observed from my youth .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  uta u briew u la ong ,  naduh ba nga dang khynnah , nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .

translation.en: ( Isaiah 2 :4 ) God will bring an end to all injustice and suffering .
translation.kha: ( Isaia 2 :4 ) U Blei un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingleh bymhok bad ki jingjynjar baroh .

translation.en: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city , and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain .
translation.kha: Phi la pynïap bun bah ki briew hangne hapoh ka nongbah ba ki lynti ki dap da ki metïap .

translation.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel , saying , The land , which we passed through to search it , is an exceeding good land .
translation.kha: bad ki la ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kata ka ri kaba ngi la leit swar ka long kaba bha shikatdei eh .

translation.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us : for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul .
translation.kha: Nangta ngin leit bad shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , ïa kaba la leh bymsuidñiew mynba u Saul u long syiem .

translation.en: Servants , obey in all things your masters according to the flesh ; not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but in singleness of heart , fearing God :
translation.kha: Ko ki shakri , to kohnguh ïa ki kynrad jong phi ha kiei kiei baroh , ym tang haba ki ïohi ïa phi namar ba phi kwah ban ïoh pynsngewbha ïa ki ; hynrei to leh ïa ka da ka dohnud bashisha namar ka jingsheptieng burom jong phi ïa U Trai .

translation.en: And the pillars of the court round about , and their sockets , and their pins , and their cords , with all their instruments , and with all their service : and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew ki long hynriew hajar arspah ngut .

translation.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved : but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once .
translation.kha: Long uba hok bad phin long shngain . Lada phi long bymhok phin kyllon kynsan .

translation.en: And he said ,  The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka bym lah ha u briew ka long kaba lah ha U Blei .

translation.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain , and spoiled the city , because they had defiled their sister .
translation.kha: Hadien kata ka jingpynïap , kita kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la lute ïa kata ka shnong ban pynhiarkput namar ka jingpynkheiñ burom ïa ka para jong ki .

translation.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb , throughout the seven lambs  ;
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .

translation.en: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets  ; This man is not worthy to die : for he hath spoken to us in the name of the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam bad ki paidbah ki ong ha ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa ,  Une u briew u la kren ha ngi ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; um dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain , and there he sat with his disciples .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew sha u lum bad hangta u la shong bad la ki synran .

translation.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel , who did very wickedly :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Israel , uba la leh bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .

translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth : I being in the way , the  Lord  led me to the house of my master s brethren .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , uba la batskhem ïa la ka kular ha u kynrad jong nga . U  Trai  hi u la ïalam beit ïa nga sha ki kur ki jait u kynrad jong nga .

translation.en: Is not my word like as a fire ? saith the  Lord   ; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces ?
translation.kha: Ka khubor jong nga ka long kum ka ding , bad kum u tyrnem uba pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki mawsiang .

translation.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron : and the whole congregation said unto them , Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt ! or would God we had died in this wilderness !
translation.kha: Ki la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad ki ong ,  Kan jin da la kham bha ban ïap ha Ijipt lane wat hangne ha ka ri khlaw !

translation.en: And he said also to the people ,  When ye see a cloud rise out of the west , straightway ye say , There cometh a shower  ; and so it is .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ruh ha ki briew ,  Haba phi ïohi ïa u lyoh ba u wan mih ha ka phang sepngi , hangta hi phi ong ba kan slap — bad ka long kumta .

translation.en: But these things have I told you , that when the time shall come , ye may remember that I told you of them . And these things I said not unto you at the beginning , because I was with you .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , ba haba ka por ka poi ïa ki ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei , phin sa kynmaw ba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .  Ngam shym la ïathuh ha phi ïa kine kiei kiei ha kaba mynnyngkong , naba nga la don lem bad phi .

translation.en: And they killed the passover , and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands , and the Levites flayed them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , ki Lebi ki khoh snieh ïa ki , bad ki lyngdoh ki synreit snam ha ka duwan .

translation.en: But the centurion , willing to save Paul , kept them from their purpose  ; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea , and get to land :
translation.kha: Hynrei u rangbah shipai u la kwah ban pyllait im ïa u Paul , kumta u la khang ïa ki na kaba leh ïa kane . Pynban , u la hukum ïa kito kiba lah ban jngi ban ryngkoh nyngkong bad ban jngi sha ryngkew ;

translation.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up  ; his sin is hid .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbymman ki Israel bad ki pop jong ki la buh jingthoh , bad ïa ki jingthoh la buh bha khop .

translation.en: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer : but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki pyrkhat ha shuwa ban jubab . Ki briew kiba sniew ki kloi ban jubab , hynrei ka wallam jingeh .

translation.en: I indeed have baptized you with water : but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month , as I was by the side of the great river , which is Hiddekel  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem , nga la ïeng harud jong ka wah Tigris kaba khraw .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother ,
translation.kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi —

translation.en: Behold , my servants shall sing for joy of heart , but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart , and shall howl for vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Kin rwai da kaba kmen , hynrei phi phin ïam ha ka jingpait dohnud .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  I tell you that , if these should hold their peace , the stones would immediately cry out .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ba lada ki sngap jar , ki maw hi kin sa sdang ban pyrta .

translation.en: Every beast , every creeping thing , and every fowl , and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth , after their kinds , went forth out of the ark .
translation.kha: Baroh ki mrad bad ki sim ki la ïamihnoh shabar na ka lieng ha la ka kynhun kynhun ka jait jong ki .

translation.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan , being burdened : not for that we would be unclothed , but clothed upon , that mortality might be swallowed up of life .
translation.kha: Katba ngi dang shong ha kane ka ïingjaiñ kaba na kane ka khyndew , ngi ud sat da ka jingsngew ba shah banbeiñ ; kam dei ba ngi kwah ban lait noh na ka met kaba na ka khyndew , hynrei ba ngi kwah ban ïoh noh ban phong da kata kaba kynja bneng , khnang ba ïa kata kaba ïap yn ïoh pynkylla dur noh da kaba im .

translation.en: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken  ; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee :
translation.kha: Wat pynleit jingmut ha kaei kaei baroh kaba ki briew ki ong — phi lah ban ïohsngew ba u shakri jong phi u ibeiñ ïa phi ,

translation.en: ( As it is written , I have made thee a father of many nations , ) before him whom he believed , even God , who quickeneth the dead , and calleth those things which be not as though they were .
translation.kha: kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ki jaitbynriew babun .  Kumta ka jingkular ka long kaba bha ha khmat U Blei , ha uba u Abraham u la ngeit — U Blei uba wallam ïa kiba la ïap sha ka jingim bad uba ka hukum jong u ka pynlong ïa kaei ka bym shym la don .

translation.en: And many brought gifts unto the  Lord  to Jerusalem , and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah : so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la wan sha Jerusalem , da kaba wanrah ïa ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  bad ki jingai ïa u Hesekaïah , ba nangta sha khmat baroh ki jaitbynriew ki pyndonburom ïa u Hesekaïah .

translation.en: She is empty , and void , and waste : and the heart melteth , and the knees smite together , and much pain is in all loins , and the faces of them all gather blackness .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh la pynjot , la iehnoh , kaba kynjah ! Ki dohnud ki um da ka jingsheptieng ; ki khohsiew ki khynñiuh , ka jingkhlaiñ ka la jah noh ; ki durkhmat ki la kylla lieh blaid blaid .

translation.en: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments  ; and they shall walk with me in white : for they are worthy .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na pha hangto ha Sardis kim shym la pyntngit ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki . Phan ïaid ryngkat bad nga , da kaba phong da ki jaiñkup balieh , namar pha long kaba dei hok ban leh kumta .

translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying , Himself took our infirmities , and bare our sicknesses .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong ,  Ma u da lade hi u la shim ïa ki jingshitom jong ngi bad u la bah noh ïa ki jingpang jong ngi .

translation.en: And they took Lot , Abram s brother s son , who dwelt in Sodom , and his goods , and departed .
translation.kha: U Lot , u pyrsa jong u Abram , u la shong la sah ha Sodom , kumta ki la shim ïa u lem bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u baroh .

translation.en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have hallowed for my name , will I cast out of my sight  ; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people :
translation.kha: ngan jynrat noh ïa ki Israel na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki ; bad ngan kyntait noh ïa kane ka ïing ïa kaba nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad ki Israel kin sa shah rkhiebeiñ bad shah kynshi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days , no flesh should be saved : but for the elect s sake , whom he hath chosen , he hath shortened the days .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynduna ïa ka jingjlan jong kita ki sngi ; lada um shym la leh kumta , yn ym don u ban lait im . Hynrei , na ka bynta ki briew ba la jied jong u , u la pynduna ïa kita ki sngi .

translation.en: Then saith he unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful , even unto death : tarry ye here , and watch with me .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsngewsih hapoh ka dohnud jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta kata kat haduh ba ka jan pynlwet ïa nga . To sah hangne bad ïa-ap lem bad nga .

translation.en: And take with thee ten loaves , and cracknels , and a cruse of honey , and go to him : he shall tell thee what shall become of the child .
translation.kha: Rah sha u shiphew tylli ki kpu , khyndiat ki kpu stang , bad shi khiew ka um ngap . Kylli ïa u kaei ka ban jia ïa u khun jong ngi , bad un sa ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation , and came out , and blessed the people : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto all the people .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad haba ki mih shabar , ki la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ na ka jingdon U  Trai  ka paw ha u paidbah baroh .

translation.en: Yea , all Israel have transgressed thy law , even by departing , that they might not obey thy voice  ; therefore the curse is poured upon us , and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God , because we have sinned against him .
translation.kha: Ki Israel baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong me bad ki kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me la ong . Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad kumta me la wallam ha ngi ïa ki jingtim kiba la thoh ha Ka Aiñ u Moses , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and went not fully after the  Lord  , as did David his father .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad um shym la bud hok ïa U  Trai  , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la long .

translation.en: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened , when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt : and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her : as for her , a cloud shall cover her , and her daughters shall go into captivity .
translation.kha: Ka jingdum kan tap ïa ka Tahpanhes haba ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ka Ijipt bad ngan pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba ki sngewsarong palat . U lyoh un kah ïa ka Ijipt , bad ki briew jong ki nongbah jong ka baroh kin shah ïalam kum ki koidi .

translation.en: And Cain knew his wife  ; and she conceived , and bare Enoch : and he builded a city , and called the name of the city , after the name of his son , Enoch .
translation.kha: U Kain bad la ka tnga ki la ïoh khun shynrang bad ki la kyrteng ïa u ,  U Enokh .  Nangta u Kain u la tei ka nongbah bad u la kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kyrteng u khun jong u .

translation.en: He causeth it to come , whether for correction , or for his land , or for mercy .
translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa u slap ban ai um ïa ka khyndew ; u lah ban phah ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , lane ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u .

translation.en: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness : in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ha phi , ki briew ka Bethel , namar ka pop bashyrkhei kaba phi la leh . Mar ïasdang ka thma , u syiem Israel un ïap .

translation.en: And he made ready his chariot , and took his people with him :
translation.kha: Kumta u Pharaoh u pynkhreh ïa la ka kali thma bad ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u ruh .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall fight for you , and ye shall hold your peace .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , bad phim donkam ban leh ei ei ruh em .

translation.en: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him : for they said , He is beside himself .
translation.kha: Mynba kiba na ka longïing jong u ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la leit ban shimti ïa u , namar ki briew ki la ïa-ong ,  U la lamwir !

translation.en: And Hazar–shual , and Balah , and Ezem ,
translation.kha: ka Hasar Shual , ka Balah , ka Esem ,

translation.en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet , What hath the  Lord  answered thee ? and , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
translation.kha: Ko Jeremaïah , kylli ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la jubab ïa phi ? Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren ?’

translation.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he walketh upon a snare .
translation.kha: U ïaid sha ka jar , bad ki kjat jong u ki ngat hangta ;

translation.en: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth , and the blood of his sons , saith the  Lord   ; and I will requite thee in this plat , saith the  Lord . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the  Lord .
