translation.kha: ‘ Nga la ïohi mynhynnin ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Naboth bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Bad nga kular ba ngan pynshitom kylliang ïa me ha kane hi ka jaka .’ Kumta shim ïa ka met jong u Joram ,  u Jehu u hukum ïa u nongbud jong u ,  bad leit bret ïa ka ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth , khnang ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim , and Anamim , and Lehabim , and Naphtuhim ,
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ijipt ki long ki briew jong ka Lydia , ka Anam , ka Lehab , ka Naphtuh ,

translation.en: Therefore will I return , and take away my corn in the time thereof , and my wine in the season thereof , and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka aïom ot ngan shim noh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong nga da u kew bad ka waiñ , bad ngan shim noh ruh ïa u  saiwul bad ka jaiñ linen ba nga la ai ïa ka ban phong .

translation.en: And they crucified him , and parted his garments , casting lots : that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , They parted my garments among them , and upon my vesture did they cast lots .
translation.kha: Ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad nangta ki la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki da kaba ïakhalai .

translation.en: But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Caesarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la jubab ,  Ïa u Paul la set kum u koidi ha Kaisaria , bad nga hi ngan sa leit pat shen shata .

translation.en: His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee  ; and goest thou thither again ?
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki synran ki la jubab ,  dang shen ki briew hangta ki la kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me , bad hato me thmu ban leit phai shata ?

translation.en: I will also send wild beasts among you , which shall rob you of your children , and destroy your cattle , and make you few in number  ; and your high ways shall be desolate .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki mradkhlaw kiba shyrkhei ba kin leh donbor halor jong phi ; kine kin pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , kin pynjot ïa ki jingri jingdup jong phi , bad kin sah sa tang khyndiat eh na phi , ba kumta ki lynti bah jong phi kin kynjah .

translation.en: When a wicked man dieth , his expectation shall perish : and the hope of unjust men perisheth .
translation.kha: Haba ki bymman ki ïap , ka jingkyrmen jong ki ruh ka ïap bad ki . Ka jingsngewskhem halor ka spah kam ïalam shano shano ruh .

translation.en: Moab hath been at ease from his youth , and he hath settled on his lees , and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel , neither hath he gone into captivity : therefore his taste remained in him , and his scent is not changed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka Moab ka la ju long kaba shongshngain bad ym pat ju ïalam mraw ïa ka . Ka Moab ka long kum ka waiñ kaba la shu ieh kumta khlem pynkhih bad ka bym ju phylliew na uwei u klong sha uwei pat . Ïa ka jingsuhsieng jong ka ym pat shu pynsniew , bad ka jingmad jong ka , ka long kaba bang kumba ju long .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof , when I shall bring again their captivity  ; The  Lord  bless thee , O habitation of justice , and mountain of holiness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Haba ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew sha ka ri jong ki , sa shisien pat kin ong ha ka ri Judah bad ki shnong jong ka ,   ‘ To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa u lum bakyntang jong ka Jerusalem , ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba u shong .’

translation.en: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah kumba u la long mynba u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei .

translation.en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal , and said , I have a secret errand unto thee , O king : who said , Keep silence . And all that stood by him went out from him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ehud ïa lade u la kylla dien ha ki maw ba la ohdur hajan Gilgal , u la leit biang sha u Eglon , bad u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , nga don ka khubor barieh na ka bynta jong phi .  Kumta u syiem u hukum ïa la ki shakri ,  Ieh ïa ngi tang baroh ar ngut !  Bad baroh ki la ïamih shabar .

translation.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .
translation.kha: Ki nongpyntrei kam jong u syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan kulai na Musri bad Kilikia bad ïa ka jingshalan kali ïapom na Ijipt .

translation.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah bariewblei kiba la tep ïa u Stephan , ki la ïambriew na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïam kaba jam .

translation.en: For the cloud of the  Lord  was upon the tabernacle by day , and fire was on it by night , in the sight of all the house of Israel , throughout all their journeys .
translation.kha: Ha ki jingïaid lynti jong ki baroh shi lynter , ki lah ban ïohi mynsngi ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ha uta u lyoh halor ka Ïingjaiñ , bad mynmiet pat ha ka ding kaba meh halor jong ka .

translation.en: Whose hope shall be cut off , and whose trust shall be a spider s web .
translation.kha: Ki shaniah ha u ksai — ka snur thapbawa .

translation.en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place , and made a feast .
translation.kha: Kumta u Laban u pynlong ka jingkhawai shongkurim bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew baroh .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers , of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods : write thou every man s name upon his rod .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wan ai ha me khat-ar tylli ki diengduh , uwei uwei u diengduh na u nongïalam jong kawei kawei ka jait . Thoh ïa ka kyrteng uta u briew ha u diengduh jong u ,

translation.en: And he said unto them , Look on me , and do likewise : and , behold , when I come to the outside of the camp , it shall be that , as I do , so shall ye do .
translation.kha: U ong ha ki ,  Haba nga poi ha ka tduh ka jaka sher dara , khmih sha nga bad leh ïa kaba nga leh .

translation.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift , and I will give according as ye shall say unto me : but give me the damsel to wife .
translation.kha: Ong phi kwah aïu ngan ai , bad pynshongdor katba phi sngewbit ïa ka nongleitkurim , ngan ai ha phi kat kaba phi pan , tang lada phi shah ïa nga ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: Thus the Bible explains : “ Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise [his son Isaac] up even from the dead . ”
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka Baibl ka pynshai : “ U Abraham da ka jingngeit-ba U Blei u lah ban pynmih-pat ia u khun jong u u Isak wat na ka jing iap . ”

translation.en: Aijalon with her suburbs , Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Aijalon , bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates , where they washed the burnt offering .
translation.kha: Ha ka phyllaw kaba shabar ka la don kawei ka kamra rit ba pynïasoh bad ka khyrdop bashapoh kaba shaphang shatei . Kane ka lam sha ka kamra rung kaba pyrshah ïa ka phyllaw bad hangta ki sait ïa ki metïap jong ki mrad ba la thang tylli kum ki jingkñia .

translation.en: So we , being many , are one body in Christ , and every one members one of another .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met ha U Khrist , bad la pynïasoh iwei bad iwei pat kum ki dkhot bapher jong kawei ka met .

translation.en: Passing through the street near her corner  ; and he went the way to her house ,
translation.kha: U dang ïaid ha lynti najan ka dong ha kaba shong kawei ka kynthei . U dang ïaid lyngba najan ïing jong ka

translation.en: And he put the wood in order , and cut the bullock in pieces , and laid him on the wood , and said , Fill four barrels with water , and pour it on the burnt sacrifice , and on the wood .
translation.kha: Nangta u buh ïa ki diengthang halor ka duwan , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u masi dab bad buh halor ki diengthang . U ong ,  Pyndap saw tylli ki khiew da ka um bad theh ïa ka um halor ka jingkñia bad ki dieng ,

translation.en: And when he had apprehended him , he put him in prison , and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him  ; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la kem ïa u , ïa u Petros la thep ha phatok , ha kaba la aiti ïa u ban ap phira da ki saw tylli ki kynhun kiba kawei kawei ka don saw ngut ki shipai . U Herod u la thmu ban bishar ha khmat u paidbah hadien ka Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and their sockets , and the hanging for the door of the court ,
translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka phyllaw , ki rishot bad ki thliew tnaw jong ka ; ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka phyllaw ;

translation.en: Sing unto him a new song  ; play skilfully with a loud noise .
translation.kha: To rwai ha u ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai , to tem da ka jingtbit ïa ka duitara , bad to risa jam da ka jingkmen !

translation.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them  ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jisu u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la kdiah ïa ki kpu bad ai ïa ki ha ki synran jong u ban sam ha ki briew . U la ïasam ruh ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha hapdeng jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .
translation.kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . To sngap ïa ki na bneng bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingjop .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God : but unto them that are without , all these things are done in parables :
translation.kha: Ha phi la ai ïa ka jingmaïan jong ka Hima U Blei ,  U Jisu u la jubab .  Hynrei kiwei pat , kiba long shabar , ki ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei baroh lyngba ki pharshi ,

translation.en: Being made so much better than the angels , as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they .
translation.kha: Ïa U Khun la pynlong uba kham khraw ban ïa ki angel , kumba ka kyrteng kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ka long kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jong ki .

translation.en: Paul and Timothy , the servants of Jesus Christ , to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi , with the bishops and deacons :
translation.kha: Na u Paul bad u Timothi , ki shakri U Khrist Jisu — Sha baroh ki briew jong U Blei ha Philippi kiba ha U Khrist Jisu , kiba ki kynthup ïa ki nongïalam balang bad ki nongïarap .

translation.en: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods , and all the women that stood by , a great multitude , even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt , in Pathros , answered Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah baroh kiba tip ba ki tnga jong ki , ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki kynthei baroh kiba ïeng hangta , kaba kynthup ïa ki Israel kiba shong ha ki bynta bashathie ka Ijipt — u paidbah babun baroh — ki ong ha nga ,

translation.en: And the high priest arose , and said unto him , Answerest thou nothing ? what is it which these witness against thee ?
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la ïeng bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Mem don jubab ban ai ïa kane ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa me ?

translation.en: When he raiseth up himself , the mighty are afraid : by reason of breakings they purify themselves .
translation.kha: Haba u ïeng joit , wat kiba khlaiñ tam ki sheptieng ; kim lah leh ei ei namar ka jingtieng .

translation.en: In the law it is written , With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people ; and yet for all that will they not hear me , saith the Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid la thoh :  Da ki briew kiba kren ha ki ktien kiba pher ngan kren ha ki briew jong nga , ong U Trai . Ngan kren da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki nongwei , hynrei wat la katta ki briew jong nga kin ym shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: So Baasha slept with his fathers , and was buried in Tirzah : and Elah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Baasha u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Tirsah , bad u khun jong u , u Elah u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre , and to all the cities of the Hivites , and of the Canaanites : and they went out to the south of Judah , even to Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit shaphang shathie sha Tyros ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta sha baroh ki nongbah jong ki Hib bad ki Kanaan , bad khatduh eh sha Beersheba , ha ka bynta bashathie jong ka Judah .

translation.en: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall , neither bought we any land : and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work .
translation.kha: Nga sei ïa ka bor jong nga baroh na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh bad ngam shym wad ban ïoh kano kano ka jingdon jingem . Baroh kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga , ki ïasnoh ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: Behold , this is the joy of his way , and out of the earth shall others grow .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , kata ka long baroh ka jingkmen ba ki riewbymman ki ïoh , kiwei pat mynta ki wan bad ki shim ïa ki jaka jong ki .

translation.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness , as he had appointed , speaking unto Moses , that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la don bad ki ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei , ha ka ri shyiap . La thaw ïa ka kat kumba U Blei u la ong ha u Moses ban thaw ïa ka , kat kum ka dur ïa kaba la pyn-i ha u Moses .

translation.en: Shall a man make gods unto himself , and they are no gods ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew u lah ban shna ïa ki blei jong u ? Em , lada u leh kumta , kin ym long shisha ki blei .

translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto him , We will go by the high way : and if I and my cattle drink of thy water , then I will pay for it : I will only , without doing any thing else , go through on my feet .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki ong ,  Ngin ïaid beit na lynti bah , bad lada ma ngi lane ki jingri jong ngi , ngi dih ïa ka um jong phi , ngin da siewdor ïa ka — baroh kaba ngi kwah ka long ban shu ïaid lyngba .

translation.en: Having a good conscience  ; that , whereas they speak evil of you , as of evildoers , they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ .
translation.kha: hynrei , to leh ïa kata ha ka jingjai jai bad da kaba burom . To sumar khuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong phi , khnang ba haba phi shah krenbeiñ , kita kiba kren sniew ïa ka jinglong jingim babha jong phi kum ki nongbud jong U Khrist kin shah lehrain na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong .

translation.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place , because it is thy due , and thy sons  due , of the sacrifices of the  Lord  made by fire : for so I am commanded .
translation.kha: Bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid ; ka long ka bynta kaba dei ka jong me bad jong ki khun shynrang jong me na kata ka jingbam ba la kñia ainguh sha U  Trai . Kata ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath purposed it , to stain the pride of all glory , and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la thmu ïa kata . U la thmu ïa kata khnang ban pynkut noh ïa ka jingsarong jong ki ha kaei kaba ki la leh bad ban pynpoh ïa ki rangbah ïa kiba la ñiewburom .

translation.en: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say , Because the  Lord  was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them , and because he hated them , he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Lymda kumta ki nong Ijipt kin ong ba mem lah ban ïalam ïa la ki briew sha ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki . Kin ong ba me la ïalam noh ïa la ki briew sha ka ri shyiap ban pynïap ïa ki , namar me la isih ïa ki .

translation.en: And he built fenced cities in Judah : for the land had rest , and he had no war in those years  ; because the  Lord  had given him rest .
translation.kha: U tei ïa ki kynroh na ka bynta ki nongbah ka Judah ha ka por jong u , bad ym shym don thma bun bun snem , namar ba U  Trai  u ai ha u ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel  ; and it was a cloud and darkness to them , but it gave light by night to these : so that the one came not near the other all the night .
translation.kha: U lyoh u wanrah jingdum ïa ki nong Ijipt , hynrei u ai jingshai ïa ki Israel , bad kumta baroh shi miet ki paidïapom kim shym ïawan jan para ma ki .

translation.en: Only take heed to thyself , and keep thy soul diligently , lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen , and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life : but teach them thy sons , and thy sons  sons  ;
translation.kha: Da leh husiar ! Kynmaw ba katba phi dang im phim dei ban klet ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi da la ki khmat .

translation.en: And Cainan lived seventy years , and begat Mahalaleel :
translation.kha: Haba u Kenan u la dap hynñiewphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Mahalalel ,

translation.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island .
translation.kha: Hynrei yn sa ïalam ïa ngi sha rud duriaw ha kawei ka dewlynnong .

translation.en: Remember , I beseech thee , that thou hast made me as the clay  ; and wilt thou bring me into dust again ?
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba me thaw ïa nga na ka dewbyrtha ; Hato men pynlwet pat ïa nga sha u pui pui ?

translation.en: When men strive together one with another , and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him , and putteth forth her hand , and taketh him by the secrets :
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki briew ki ïashoh , bad ka tnga jong uwei na ki ka pyrshang ban ïarap ïa la u tnga da kaba bat tyngeh na ka rain jong uta uwei pat ,

translation.en: And before this , Eliashib the priest , having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God , was allied unto Tobiah :
translation.kha: U Eliashib lyngdoh , uba khmih halor ki kamra buh tiar ka Templ , la slem u la don hapdeng ka jingïadei jingmut bad u Tobiah .

translation.en: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves : for charity shall cover the multitude of sins .
translation.kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , to ïa-ieit shitrhem iwei ïa iwei pat , namar ka jingieit ka tap noh lin ïa ki pop babun .

translation.en: ( Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread , after that the Lord had given thanks : )
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki lieng , kiba na Tiberias , ki la wan poi ha ka ryngkew hajan ka jaka ha kaba ki paidbah ki la bam ïa u kpu hadien ba U Trai u la ainguh .

translation.en: No lion shall be there , nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon , it shall not be found there  ; but the redeemed shall walk there :
translation.kha: Yn ym don sing hangta , ym don ki mrad bashyrkhei ki ban ïaid na kata ka lynti . Kito ïa kiba U  Trai  u la pyllait im kin ïaid sha ïing na kata ka lynti .

translation.en: The nakedness of thy father s wife shalt thou not uncover : it is thy father s nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano na ki tnga jong u .

translation.en: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem , and brought them into the temple of Babylon , those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon , and they were delivered unto one , whose name was Sheshbazzar , whom he had made governor  ;
translation.kha: U la pynphai pat ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa jong ka Templ kiba u Nebukhadnessar u la rah na ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad buh ha ka templ ha Babilon . U Syros u la aiti ïa kine ki khiew ki pliang ha u briew uba kyrteng u Sheshbassar , ïa uba u la thung kum u lat ka Judah .

translation.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper  ; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn . This is the heritage of the servants of the  Lord  , and their righteousness is of me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei yn ym don ka tiar thma ka ban lah ban pynmynsaw ïa pha ; phan don ka jubab ïa kito baroh kiba mudui ïa pha . Ngan kyrshan ïa ki shakri jong nga bad ngan ai jingjop ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: Salute Urbane , our helper in Christ , and Stachys my beloved .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa u Urbanos , uba ïatrei lem bad ngi ha ka kam U Khrist , bad ïa u Stakhos , u paralok ba-ieit jong nga .

translation.en: Come down , and sit in the dust , O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground : there is no throne , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Babilon , to hiar noh na ka khet jong pha , bad shong ha u pui pui halor ka khyndew . Shisien pha la long kum kaba sotti , ka nongbah bym pat shahjop , hynrei pham long shuh kaba jem bad ba long jai jai ! Mynta pha long ka mraw !

translation.en: I considered the horns , and , behold , there came up among them another little horn , before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots : and , behold , in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man , and a mouth speaking great things .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang khmih ïa ki reng , nga la ïohi ïa ka reng kaba rit , kaba mih napdeng kiwei pat . Ka la tar ïa ki lai tylli ki reng kiba la don lypa hangta . Kane ka reng ka la don ki khmat briew bad ka shyntur kaba kob sarong .

translation.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis ba ki rung shapoh , u la kyrpad ïa ki ban ai ei ei ïa u .

translation.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him , and cause every man to find according to his ways .
translation.kha: U ai bainong ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki leh bad u leh ha ki kat kum kaba ki dei hok .

translation.en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world , but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil .
translation.kha: Ngam kyrpad ba men shim noh ïa ki na ka pyrthei , hynrei nga da kyrpad ba men ri kyndong ïa ki na uta u bymman .

translation.en: He hath said in his heart , God hath forgotten : he hideth his face  ; he will never see it .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u ong ha lade ,  U Blei um sngew ei ei ! u la khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad un ym ïohi ïa nga da lei lei !

translation.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest , and multiplieth my wounds without cause .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ki  erïong ban lynshop bad pynmong jur ïa nga khlem daw satia ;

translation.en: But if I say thus unto the young man , Behold , the arrows are beyond thee  ; go thy way : for the  Lord  hath sent thee away .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada nga ong ha u , ‘ Ki khnam ki don ha kawei pat ka liang jong phi ,’ te phet noh , namar U  Trai  u la phah noh ïa phi .

translation.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the  Lord  : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him .
translation.kha: Long kiba beit bad phi pyn-i ba phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ; long kiba kynriang bad phi pyn-i ba phim don ïa kata .

translation.en: Wherefore I also said , I will not drive them out from before you  ; but they shall be as thorns in your sides , and their gods shall be a snare unto you .
translation.kha: Kumta nga ong ïa phi mynta ba ngan ym beh noh ïa kine ki briew katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Kin long ki nongshun jong phi , bad phin shah riam da ka jingmane ïa ki blei jong ki .

translation.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision : yet have I not declined from thy law .
translation.kha: Kiba sarong ki krenbeiñ borabor ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym phai noh na ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: For he said , Surely they are my people , children that will not lie : so he was their Saviour .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki long ki briew jong nga kin ym shukor ïa nga .  Bad kumta u la pyllait im ïa ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And David was displeased , because the  Lord  had made a breach upon Uzza : and he called the name of the place Perez–uzzah to this day .
translation.kha: bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot Peres Ussah naduh kata ka por . U Dabid u la dom namar ba U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u Ussah ha ka jingbitar .

translation.en: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth ; but if the husband be dead , she is loosed from the law of her husband .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei ba la shongkurim , kum ka nuksa , ka shah teh da ka hukum ha la u tnga katba u dang im ; hynrei haba u la ïap , te ka la laitluid na ka hukum kaba teh ïa ka bad u .

translation.en: But he himself went a day s journey into the wilderness , and came and sat down under a juniper tree : and he requested for himself that he might die  ; and said , It is enough  ; now , O  Lord  , take away my life  ; for I am not better than my fathers .
translation.kha: U Elijah u ïaid baroh shi sngi ha ka ri khlaw . U la sangeh bad shong ha ka jingkah syrngiew u dieng bad u kwah tang ban ïap noh .  Ka la long palat , ko  Trai  ,  u la duwai .  Shim noh ïa ka jingim jong nga ; ka bha ïa nga ban ïap noh .

translation.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also do even the same .
translation.kha: Bad lada phi lehbha tang ïa kito kiba lehbha ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki leh kumta !

translation.en: And they were scattered , because there is no shepherd : and they became meat to all the beasts of the field , when they were scattered .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki langbrot kim don u nongsharai , ki la sakma noh , bad ki mradkhlaw ki pynïap bad bam ïa ki .

translation.en: But watch thou in all things , endure afflictions , do the work of an evangelist , make full proof of thy ministry .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me to da sumar adkar ïa lade ha ki jingjia baroh ; to ïaishah shitom , trei ïa ka kam u nongïalap jong ka Khubor Babha , bad to pyndep ïa la ka kam baroh kum u shakri jong U Blei .

translation.en: How shall I pardon thee for this ? thy children have forsaken me , and sworn by them that are no gods : when I had fed them to the full , they then committed adultery , and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots  houses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Balei ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga ? Ki la iehnoh ïa nga , bad ki la mane ïa ki blei ki bymshisha . Nga la bsa ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin da kdang , hynrei ki la leh awria , bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki bad ki nuti .

translation.en: When I blow with a trumpet , I and all that are with me , then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp , and say , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
translation.kha: Ynda ma nga bad ka kynhun jong nga ngi put ïa la ki turoi , phi ruh put ïa la ki turoi baroh sawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad pyrta jam , ‘ Ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Gideon !’

translation.en: And , behold , Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the  Lord   ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king s matters : also the Levites shall be officers before you . Deal courageously , and the  Lord  shall be with the good .
translation.kha: U Amaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , un don ïa ka bor kaba hakhlieh tam ha baroh ki kam niam , bad u Sebadaïah u khun jong u Ishmael , u lat ka Judah , un don ïa ka bor bahakhlieh duh ha baroh ki kam hima sima . Ki Lebi kin kitkhlieh ban peit halor ki jingpyntreikam ïa ki jingrai jong ki ïingbishar . Long shlur bad pyndep ïa kine ki jingbthah , bad to U  Trai  un long ha ka liang jong kiba leh ïa kaba dei !

translation.en: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt , and heardest their cry by the Red sea  ;
translation.kha: Me ïohi kumno ki kpa tymmen ki la shahshitom ha Ijipt ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhot jong ki na ka bynta ka jingïarap ha ka Duriaw Basaw .

translation.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman in a wide house .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha kaba sah ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang bad ka tnga kaba bunktien .

translation.en: And Judah acknowledged them , and said , She hath been more righteous than I  ; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son . And he knew her again no more .
translation.kha: U Judah u la ithuh ïa kita ki tiar , bad u ong ,  Ka don ha ka hok . Ngam shym la pyndep ïa ka kamram ha ka — nga dei ban ai ha ka ïa u Shelah u khun jong nga ha ka jingshongkurim .  Bad u Judah um shym ïathiah shongkha shuh bad ka .

translation.en: So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem . And it came to pass , when they were come to Beth–lehem , that all the city was moved about them , and they said , Is this Naomi ?
translation.kha: Ki ïaid shaphrang haduh ba kin da poi ha Bethlehem . Haba ki la poi hangta , ka shnong baroh kawei ka la sngewkmen , bad ki kynthei kiba hangta ki la pyrta ,  Hato kane ka dei shisha ka Naomi ?

translation.en: Unless otherwise indicated , Scripture quotations are from the modern-language New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures —With References .
translation.kha: Ïa ki dkhot kotbah la sot na ka The Holy Bible Khasi - O .V . Reference .

translation.en: And straightway the damsel arose , and walked  ; for she was of the age of twelve years . And they were astonished with a great astonishment .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi ka la khie bad ka la sdang ban ïaid shane shatai . ( Ka la don khat-ar snem ka rta . ) Haba kane ka la jia , ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh .

translation.en: Even so ye , forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts , seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church .
translation.kha: Namar ba phi kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai jong U Mynsiem , phi dei ban pyrshang nalor kiei kiei baroh ban kham pyndonkam ïa kito kiba long jingïarap ban tei ïa ka balang .

translation.en: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood : and his name is called The Word of God .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jaiñkup kaba u phong la tap da ka snam . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long  U Ktien jong U Blei .

translation.en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish  ; yea , those nations shall be utterly wasted .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki hima ki bym shakri ïa pha yn pynjot thiaw .

translation.en: Write the things which thou hast seen , and the things which are , and the things which shall be hereafter  ;
translation.kha: Thoh te , ïa kiei kiei kiba me ïohi ; kita kiei kiei kiba long mynta bad kita kiei kiei ki ban sa jia hadien .

translation.en: And she yet again conceived , and bare a son  ; and called his name Shelah : and he was at Chezib , when she bare him .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ka la kha khun shynrang bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Shelah . U Judah u don ha Akhsib mynba la kha ïa u khunlung .

translation.en: From the blood of the slain , from the fat of the mighty , the bow of Jonathan turned not back , and the sword of Saul returned not empty .
translation.kha: Ka ryntieh u Jonathan ka long kaba shyrkhei Ka waitlam u Saul ka long ka bym don jingisynei , Ka pynkhyllem ïa kiba khlaiñbor , ka da pynïap ïa ki nongshun .

translation.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens , that he might fill all things . )
translation.kha: Kumta uta uba hiar shapoh u long uta ujuh uba leit kiew shaneng , shajrong bad sha lyndet ki bneng , ban pyndap ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .

translation.en: But the tongue can no man tame  ; it is an unruly evil , full of deadly poison .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don mano mano ba la lah ban pynjuh ïa u thylliej . U long uba sniew bad bym lah ban synshar , uba dap da ka bih ba pynïap .

translation.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them , to minister unto me in the priest s office : Take one young bullock , and two rams without blemish ,
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba me dei ban leh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ki ban shakri ïa nga . Shim uwei u masi lyngraw bad ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang ki bym don jingduna .

translation.en: Also he strengthened himself , and built up all the wall that was broken , and raised it up to the towers , and another wall without , and repaired Millo in the city of David , and made darts and shields in abundance .
translation.kha: U syiem u pynkhlaiñ ïa ki jingïada ïa ka nongbah da kaba tei bha ïa ka kynroh , kaba tei ïa ki kut halor jong ka , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh na shabar . Nalor kata , u tei pat ïa ki jingïada ba la tei ha ka jaka kaba la pyndap khyndew ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem ha ka bynta kaba rim . U phah shna ruh bun bah ki sum bad ki stieh .

translation.en: Only rebel not ye against the  Lord  , neither fear ye the people of the land  ; for they are bread for us : their defence is departed from them , and the  Lord  is with us : fear them not .
translation.kha: Wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad wat sheptieng ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Ngin jop da kaba suk ïa ki . U  Trai  u don lem bad ngi bad u la jop ïa ki blei kiba ïada ïa ki ; kumta te wat sheptieng .

translation.en: That thou hast slain my children , and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them ?
translation.kha: khlem da shim ïa ki khun jong nga bad kñia ïa ki ha ki bleithaw ?

translation.en: And the second is like , namely this , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself . There is none other commandment greater than these .
translation.kha: Kaba ar na ki hukum bakongsan tam ka dei kane : ‘ Men ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .’ Ym don kawei pat ka hukum kaba kham kongsan ban ïa kine ar tylli .

translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , and unto his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them  ; This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying ,
translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha baroh ki paid Israel ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: Saying , This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law .
translation.kha: Une u briew ,  ki la ong ,  u pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki briew ban mane ïa U Blei ha ka rukom kaba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ !

translation.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them  ; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .
translation.kha: Wat ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad khang ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban ïashongkha khleh bad ki ,

translation.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit ïa la u hynmen u para u ïaid ha ka jingshai , bad kumta ym don kaei kaei ha u ka ban pynlong ïano ïano pat ban leh pop .

translation.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month , which is the month Sebat , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khatwei ( u bnai Shebat ) , U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka khubor ha ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet .

translation.en: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah .
translation.kha: Haba u Isaïah u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong u syiem Hesekaïah , u phah pat ïa kane ka jubab :

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Why are ye fearful , O ye of little faith ?  Then he arose , and rebuked the winds and the sea  ; and there was a great calm .
translation.kha: Balei ba phi sheptieng haduh katne ?  U Jisu u la jubab .  Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !  Nangta u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ki lyer bad ïa ki jingat phyllung ban sangeh , bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .

translation.en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars , and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U thang ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh ba-thala ha ki duwan ba ki la mane . Da kaba leh ïa kane baroh , u pynlong ïa ka Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ba la pynkhuid pat kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O inhabitant of the valley , and rock of the plain , saith the  Lord   ; which say , Who shall come down against us ? or who shall enter into our habitations ?
translation.kha: Pha ko Jerusalem , pha kaba shong shajrong eh na ki ri them , kum u mawsiang uba ïeng shajrong na ka madan . Hynrei ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa pha . Pha ong ba ym don ba lah ban tur ïaleh ïa pha ne ban pynpra ïa ki jingker jong pha .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships , by the way whereof I spake unto thee , Thou shalt see it no more again : and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen , and no man shall buy you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un phah biang ïa phi da ka lieng sha Ijipt , wat la nga la ong ba phim dei ban leit shuh shata lano lano ; bad hangta phin sa tyrwa die mraw ïa lade ha ki nongshun jong phi , hynrei yn ym don ba thied ïa phi .

translation.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together , and came and pitched in Shunem : and Saul gathered all Israel together , and they pitched in Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ïalumlang bad ki wan sher dara ha Shunem ; u Saul pat u lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh bad ki sher dara ha u Lum Gilboa .

translation.en: And the king answered them roughly  ; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men ,
translation.kha: U syiem um ñiewkor ïa ki jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad u kren tohmet ïa kita ki briew ,

translation.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .
translation.kha: Ka wan phai pat sha ka lieng , bad u Noah u kner ïa la ka kti , bad u rah ïa ka shapoh .

translation.en: And he called unto him two centurions , saying , Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea , and horsemen threescore and ten , and spearmen two hundred , at the third hour of the night  ;
translation.kha: Te u rangbah ai hukum u la khot ar ngut na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad u la ong ,  Pynkhreh arspah ngut ki shipai ban leit sha Kaisaria , lem bad hynñiewphew ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad arspah ngut ki nongbat sum , bad pynkhreh ban mih ha ka por khyndai baje mynta ka miet .

translation.en: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Cushi , unto Baruch , saying , Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people , and come . So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand , and came unto them .
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ïa u Jehudi ( u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u ksiew jong u Shelemaïah , bad u ksiew tun jong u Kushi ) ban ong ïa u Barukh ban wallam ïa ka kot kli na kaba u la pule ha ki paidbah . U Barukh u la wallam ha ki ïa ka kot kli .

translation.en: Gad , a troop shall overcome him : but he shall overcome at the last .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki nonglute kin sa wan ïaleh ïa u Gad , Hynrei un phai kylla ban beh ïa ki nadien .

translation.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kaei kaba la lah jia ïa uta u briew uba don ksuid , bad ïa kita ki sniang .

translation.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city , and the people not be afraid ? shall there be evil in a city , and the  Lord  hath not done it ?
translation.kha: Hato ka turoi thma ka ju sawa ha ka nongbah khlem da pynlong ïa ki briew ban sheptieng ? Hato ka jingjynjar ka ju ngat ha ka nongbah lymda U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ?

translation.en: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel , and maketh merchandise of him , or selleth him  ; then that thief shall die  ; and thou shalt put evil away from among you .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba rong jubor ïa la u para Israel bad u pynlong mraw lane die mraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .

translation.en: And all the people answered together , and said , All that the  Lord  hath spoken we will do . And Moses returned the words of the people unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u paidbah baroh u la jubab lang ,  Ngin leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la kren ,  bad u Moses u la leit ïathuh ïa kane ha U  Trai .

translation.en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the  Lord  : but the words of the pure are pleasant words .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba sniew , hynrei u sngewbha ha ki ktien kiba sngur jingmut .

translation.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary , and had seen the things which Jesus did , believed on him .
translation.kha: Bun na ki briew kiba la wan jngoh ïa ka Mari ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh , bad ki la ngeit ha u .

translation.en: And the seven years of plenteousness , that was in the land of Egypt , were ended .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh kiba ka ri Ijipt ka la ïoh lehkmen ki la kut , bad ki hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew ki la sdang , kumba u Joseph u la lah ong .

translation.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free , which is the mother of us all .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ba kynja bneng ka long kaba laitluid , bad ka dei ka kmie jong ngi keiñ .

translation.en: Then said his wife unto him , Dost thou still retain thine integrity ? curse God , and die .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong u ka ong ha u ,  Me dang long hi uba ïaishah kumba ju long , hato kam dei kumta ? Balei mem tim ïa U Blei bad ïap noh artat ?

translation.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor , and goeth out from thence to Hukkok , and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side , and reacheth to Asher on the west side , and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: Hangta u pud u khun sha sepngi shaduh Asnoth Tabor , bad nangta sha Hukkok , da kaba kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun shaphang shathie , ka Asher shaphang sepngi , bad ïa ka Jordan shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done : and there is no respect of persons .
translation.kha: Bad ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla yn siew na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba bakla kiba u leh , namar U Blei u bishar ïa uwei pa uwei da kajuh ka jingthew .

translation.en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity  ; yea , thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity , nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity  ;
translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym rung shapoh ka nongbah jong ki briew jong nga ban risa beiñ halor ki jingshah shitom jong ki bad ban kurup ïa ka spah jong ki ha ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki .

translation.en: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came , and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha U Jisu ki la kwah ban riam ïa u , kumta ki la kyrpad ïa u ban leh ïa ka kambah na ka bynta jong ki , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .

translation.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out  ; and when he had found him , he said unto him ,  Dost thou believe on the Son of God ?
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la shem ïa uta u briew bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me ngeit ha U Khun U Briew ?

translation.en: And when Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves to him to the earth .
translation.kha: Ynda u Joseph u la wan sha ïing , ki leit rah sha u hapoh ïing ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha , bad ki nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: And Amnon was so vexed , that he fell sick for his sister Tamar  ; for she was a virgin  ; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her .
translation.kha: U shoh jingieit ïa ka haduh katta katta , haduh ba u da kem pang , naba um i don lad da kumno kumno ban ïoh ïa ka ; kum ka kynthei kaba dang sotti , ym shym shah ïa ka ban ïakynduh ïa ki shynrang .

translation.en: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years : and Athaliah reigned over the land .
translation.kha: Hynriew snem u la don hangta ha kaba rieh , katba ka Athalaïah ka synshar kum ka syiem .

translation.en: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him , and fought with Amalek : and Moses , Aaron , and Hur went up to the top of the hill .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la leh kumba u Moses u la hukum ïa u , bad u la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , katba u Moses , u Aaron , bad u Hur ki la leit kiew sha kliar u lum .

translation.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying , that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest , while as the first tabernacle was yet standing :
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u pyn-i shai na kine ki rukom pynbeit , ba ïa ka lynti sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam ym pat lah ban plie , katba kata ka Ïingjaiñ kaba ha khmat ka dang ïeng .

translation.en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east : and he measured the gate according to these measures .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop ba sha mihngi sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop bad ka la heh katjuh kum kiwei pat .

translation.en: If it please the king , let it be written that they may be destroyed : and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business , to bring it into the king s treasuries .
translation.kha: Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , pynmih da ka hukum ba dei ban pynïap noh ïa ki . Lada phi leh kumta , nga pynthikna ba ngan lah ban buh palat lai lakh sawphew hajar kilo ka rupa sha ka jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ka jingpynïaid kam ha ka hima .

translation.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom : but the froward tongue shall be cut out .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki kren ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ïa u thylliej uba kren sniew yn pynsangeh .

translation.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed , he called two of his household servants , and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually  ;
translation.kha: Te u angel u la leit noh , bad u Kornelios u la khot ar ngut na ki shakri ïing jong u bad uwei u shipai uba riewblei uba long uwei na kiba shakri ïa u .

translation.en: I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :
translation.kha: Nga sngewsynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la don bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei shuh ban bam .

translation.en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends , of wreathen work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .

translation.en: And Saul said unto Ahiah , Bring hither the ark of God . For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Wallam hangne ïa ka Ephod ,  u Saul u ong ha u Ahijah u lyngdoh . ( Ha kata ka sngi u Ahijah u dang rah ïa ka ha khmat ki paid Israel . )

translation.en: On the morrow , because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews , he loosed him from his bands , and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear , and brought Paul down , and set him before them .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la kwah ban tip thikna ïa kaei ba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa u Paul ; kumta ha ka sngi kaba bud u la phah weng noh ïa ki kynjri na u Paul bad u la hukum ïa ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ïa ka Dorbar baroh ban ïakynduh lang . Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u la pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki .

translation.en: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king s princes , which have heard of the deed of the queen . Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath .
translation.kha: Haba ki tnga jong ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem jong ka Persia bad Media kin ïohsngew shaphang ka jingleh jong ka mahadei kin ong ïa la ki tnga jong ki shaphang kata shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut . Ki kynthei ha kylleng sawdong kin ym burom shuh ïa la ki tnga , bad ki shynrang kin dap da ka jingbitar ïa la ki tnga .

translation.en: I am the true vine , and my Father is the husbandman .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u dieng sohwaiñ bashisha , bad U Kpa jong nga u long u nongsumar brisoh .

translation.en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you : but are there not with you , even with you , sins against the  Lord  your God ?
translation.kha: Bad mynta phi thmu sa ban pynlong ïa ki shynrang bad kynthei jong ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki mraw jong phi . Hato phim tip ba phi ruh phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong phi ?

translation.en: And there was a famine in the land : and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there  ; for the famine was grievous in the land .
translation.kha: Hynrei la don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri Kanaan , bad ka la long kaba jur shikatdei eh kat haduh ba u Abram u la leit jngai shaphang shathie sha ka ri Ijipt ban shong ban sah hangta shipor .

translation.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger : and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba mutlop palat kat ban kular ban bahkhlieh ïa ki ram jong u nongwei u dei ban don la ki jingdon jingem ban buh bynda .

translation.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki tang shu ïohi ïa uta u rishot lyoh ba u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki dem khrup .

translation.en: And if his father have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family , and he shall possess it : and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Lada u kpa jong u um don hynmen ne para shynrang lane ki kñi , u kur uba ïajan eh bad u un ïohpateng ïa ka , bad un bat ïa ka kum la ka jong ka nongkynti . Ki Israel ki dei ban kohnguh ïa kane ka aiñ kumba nga , U  Trai  , nga la hukum ïa me .

translation.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou , O love , for delights !
translation.kha: Ki bniat jong phi ki long kiba lieh kum ka kynhun jong ki langbrot ba dang shu dep pynsum . Ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba jah ; baroh ki long kiba ïaryntih bha .

translation.en: Then said Jonathan , My father hath troubled the land : see , I pray you , how mine eyes have been enlightened , because I tasted a little of this honey .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  Ka jingshyrkhei kaba khraw i pa jong nga i la leh ïa ki briew jong ngi ! Khmih haduh katno nga sngew ïohbor namar ba nga bam khyndiat ka ngap !

translation.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .
translation.kha: Bad uwei na ki u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ïa ka shkor kamon jong u .

translation.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell , neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
translation.kha: namar men ym iehnoh ïa nga ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; men ym shah ïa u shakri baïaineh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtep .

translation.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction ? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba U Blei u bitar bad u pynshitom , dei u briew uba sniew uba ju lait borabor .

translation.en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life , all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow ? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun ?
translation.kha: Kumno uno uno u lah ban tip kaei kaba bha ïa ngi ha kane ka jingim jong ngi kaba lyngkot bad ka bymmyntoi — ka jingim kaba ïaid kum ka syrngiew ? Kumno ngi lah ban tip aïu kan jia ha ka pyrthei hadien ba ngi la ïap ?

translation.en: Your iniquities , and the iniquities of your fathers together , saith the  Lord  , which have burned incense upon the mountains , and blasphemed me upon the hills : therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom .
translation.kha: na ka bynta ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ki la thang ki jingiwbih ha ki duwan thala kiba halor ki lum bad ki la kren sniew ïa nga . Kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei hok ïa ki namar ki kam ba ki la leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: And he said unto him , What is thy name ? And he said , Jacob .
translation.kha: Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ?  uta u briew u kylli .  U Jakob ,  u jubab .

translation.en: And the children of Israel said , Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the  Lord  ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the  Lord  to Mizpah , saying , He shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki kylli ,  Hato don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel baroh ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ha Mispah ?  ( Ki la shim ïa ka jingsmai bakyntang ba uno uno u bym shym la leit sha Mispah un shah pynïap . )

translation.en: The anger of the  Lord  hath divided them  ; he will no more regard them : they respected not the persons of the priests , they favoured not the elders .
translation.kha: U  Trai  um shym la don shuh ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta jong ki ; u la pynsakma ïa ki da lade hi . Um shym pyn-i jingñiewkor ei ei ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ngi .

translation.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men pynshitom ïa nga , nga la ju ïaid sakma ; hynrei mynta nga kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me .

translation.en: Make the heart of this people fat , and make their ears heavy , and shut their eyes  ; lest they see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and understand with their heart , and convert , and be healed .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa nga ,  Pynbthi ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong kine ki briew , pynkyllut ïa ki shkor jong ki , bad pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong ki , ba kumta kin ym lah ban ïohi lane ïohsngew lane sngewthuh . Lada ki leh kumta , ki lah ban phai sha nga bad ïoh jingkhiah .

translation.en: Our fathers have sinned , and are not  ; and we have borne their iniquities .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh pop , hynrei mynta kim don shuh , bad ngi shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: But we were gentle among you , even as a nurse cherisheth her children :
translation.kha: wat la kum ki apostol jong U Khrist ngi lah ban dawa na phi . Hynrei ngi la long kiba jai jai mynba ngi la don bad phi , kumba ka kmie ka sumar ïa ki khun jong ka .

translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel , whom God went to redeem to be his own people , to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness , by driving out nations from before thy people , whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kum ki Israel , ïa kaba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki ka jaitbynriew jong me . Kiei kiei ki bakhraw bad baphylla kiba me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei . Me la pyllait im ïa ki briew jong me na Ijipt bad pynher krad ïa kiwei ki jaitbynriew katba ki briew jong me ki nang tur shaphrang .

translation.en: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom , and with Birsha king of Gomorrah , Shinab king of Admah , and Shemeber king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela , which is Zoar .
translation.kha: ki la leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki san ngut kiwei pat ki syiem : u Bera jong ka Sodom , u Birsha jong ka Gomorrah , u Shinab jong ka Admah , u Shemeber jong ka Seboiim , bad u syiem jong ka Bela ( lane Soar ) .

translation.en: Better is an handful with quietness , than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long kumta , hynrei ka long kaba kham bha ban don tang khyndiat , bad ka jingpalei jingmut , ban ïa kaba bunkam shi lynter da ki kti baroh ar tylli , da kaba pyrshang ban kem ïa ka lyer .

translation.en: And his sisters , are they not all with us ? Whence then hath this man all these things ?
translation.kha: Hato ki para kynthei jong u baroh kim shong kim sah hangne ? Nangno u ïoh ïa kane baroh ?

translation.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds , and their post by my posts , and the wall between me and them , they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed : wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger .
translation.kha: Ki syiem ki la shna ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad ïingsyiem jong ki marpyrshah ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad jong ka Templ jong nga , ba kumta ka don tang ka kynroh hapdeng jong ngi . Ki la pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh , bad kumta ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: That they may see , and know , and consider , and understand together , that the hand of the  Lord  hath done this , and the Holy One of Israel hath created it .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin tip ba nga , U  Trai  , nga la leh ïa ka . Kin wan ban tip ba U Blei bakhuid ki Israel u la pynlong ïa ka ban jia .

translation.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her : for with such robes were the king s daughters that were virgins apparelled . Then his servant brought her out , and bolted the door after her .
translation.kha: U shakri u pynmih ïa ka shabar bad u khang ïa ka jingkhang . Ka Tamar ka kup ïa ka sopti jynsur kaba jrong kti , ka jait jaiñ ba ju phong da ki khun syiem kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim ha kito ki sngi .

translation.en: And David went up from thence , and dwelt in strong holds at En–gedi .
translation.kha: U Dabid u mihnoh bad u leit sha ka thain jong ka Engedi , ha kaba u la sah ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Draw out now , and bear unto the governor of the feast .  And they bare it .
translation.kha: Ki la pyndap shoiñ ïa ki , bad nangta u la ong ha ki ,  Mynta to tong khyndiat ka um bad leit rah ïa ka sha u nongpynïaid jong ka jingkhawai .

translation.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you , and have taught you publickly , and from house to house ,
translation.kha: Phi ïatip ba ngam shym la buhrieh ïa kano kano ka ban long ka jingïarap ïa phi haba nga ïalap bad hikai ha ki paidbah bad ha ki ïing jong phi .

translation.en: And Abimelech took sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and womenservants , and gave them unto Abraham , and restored him Sarah his wife .
translation.kha: Te u Abimelekh u pynphai pat ïa ka Sarah ha u Abraham , bad ha kajuh ka por u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , bad ki mraw .

translation.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban , and , behold , it was not toward him as before .
translation.kha: U la ïohi ruh ba u Laban um da leh jan shuh ïa u kumba mynshuwa .

translation.en: What ? came the word of God out from you ? or came it unto you only ?
translation.kha: Kaei ? Lane ka lah mo ban long ba ka ktien U Blei ka la wan na phi ? Lane hato dei tang ha phi ba ka la wan ?

translation.en: And Micaiah said , If thou return at all in peace , the  Lord  hath not spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , O people , every one of you .
translation.kha: Lada me wan phai da kaba suk ,  u Mikaïah u pyrta ,  te U  Trai  um shym la kren keiñ da nga !  bad u la bynrap ,  Shahshkor , uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba nga la kren !

translation.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance , then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada mano mano na phi , phi leh pop khlem da mut khnang , phi dei ban wanrah kawei ka blang kaba shisnem ka rta kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .

translation.en: And he laid hold on the dragon , that old serpent , which is the Devil , and Satan , and bound him a thousand years ,
translation.kha: U la kem ïa u Ïakjakor , ïa uta u  seiñ hyndai — kata , u Ksuid lane u Soitan — bad u la teh kynjri ïa u haduh shihajar snem .

translation.en: And all the cities of those kings , and all the kings of them , did Joshua take , and smote them with the edge of the sword , and he utterly destroyed them , as Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kine ki nongbah baroh bad ïa ki syiem jong ki , da kaba pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei , kumba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la hukum .

translation.en: Then Sihon came out against us , he and all his people , to fight at Jahaz .
translation.kha: U syiem Sihon u wan ryngkat bad la ki rangïapom ban ïaleh ïa ngi ha Jahas ,

translation.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him : righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne .
translation.kha: Ki lyoh bad ka jingdum ki ker sawdong ïa u ; u synshar da ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: And saying , Lord , my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy , grievously tormented .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad , u shakri jong nga u thiah pang ha ïing , um lah ban khih bad u da shitom jur eh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , all that he hath is in thy power  ; only upon himself put not forth thine hand . So Satan went forth from the presence of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kam pher ,  U  Trai  u ong ïa u Soitan ,  baroh kaba u don ki long hapoh ka bor jong me , hynrei men ym pynmong ïa u Job hi .  Te u Soitan u la leit noh .

translation.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering , or for a sacrifice in performing a vow , or peace offerings unto the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u masi kum ka jingainguh thang , lane kum ka jingkñia ha kaba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai skhem , lane kum ka jingainguh jingpynïasuk ,

translation.en: As it is written , He that had gathered much had nothing over ; and he that had gathered little had no lack .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uta uba la lum shibun um shym la don tam keiñ , bad uta uba la lum khyndiat um shym ïoh duna palat .

translation.en: And they turned thitherward , and came to the house of the young man the Levite , even unto the house of Micah , and saluted him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki leit sha ïing u Mikah , ha kaba u samla Lebi u sah , bad ki kylli ïa u Lebi kumno u long u man .

translation.en: In the fifth day of the month , which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin s captivity ,
translation.kha: ( Ka la long ka snem kaba san naduh ba la ringmraw ïa u syiem Jehoïakhin . )

translation.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man , he walketh through dry places , seeking rest , and findeth none .
translation.kha: Haba u mynsiem bymkhuid u la mihnoh na u briew , u ïaid napdeng ka jaka ryngkhiang da kaba khmih ïa ka jaka ban ïoh pynjahthait . Lada um lah ban shem ïa kano kano ,

translation.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave , though they cry in his destruction .
translation.kha: Balei ba me tur ïaleh ïa u briew ba la jot , uta u bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh hynrei uba kyrpad ïa ka jingisynei ?

translation.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant , and do them , that ye may prosper in all that ye do .
translation.kha: Namar kata , kohnguh hok ïa ki ktien baroh ba la thoh ha kane ka jutang khnang ba phin manbha ha ki jingtrei jingktah jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And when he had gone over those parts , and had given them much exhortation , he came into Greece ,
translation.kha: U la leit lyngba kito ki thain bad u la pynshlur ïa ki briew da ki khubor kiba bun .

translation.en: The secret things belong unto the  Lord  our God : but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever , that we may do all the words of this law .
translation.kha: Don kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u dang buhrieh na ka jingtip u briew ; hynrei u la pynpaw ïa ka Aiñ jong u , bad ma ngi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi , ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa ka junom .

translation.en: Therefore the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia : and the children of Israel served Chushan–rishathaim eight years .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u shah ïa u Kushan Rishathaim u syiem ka Mesopotamia ban jop ïa ki . Bad u synshar halor jong ki haduh phra snem .

translation.en: Then said David to Jonathan , Who shall tell me ? or what if thy father answer thee roughly ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ,  Mano ban pyntip ïa nga lada i pa jong phi i kren dom ïa phi ?

translation.en: Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka la long janmiet haba u Joseph na Arimathaïa u la wan poi . U la long u riewdonburom jong ka Dorbar , uba ap ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Ka la long ka sngi Pynkhreh ( kata , ka sngi shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton ) , kumta u Joseph u la leit da ka jingshlur sha u Pilat bad pan na u ïa ka met U Jisu .

translation.en: Gather yourselves together , and hear , ye sons of Jacob  ; and hearken unto Israel your father .
translation.kha: Ale lang bad sngap , phi ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , Shahshkor ïa u Israel u kpa jong phi .

translation.en: Thou answeredst them , O  Lord  our God : thou wast a God that forgavest them , though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , me la jubab ïa la ki briew ; me la pyn-i ïa ki ba me long U Blei uba map ei , wat la me pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And of Zebulun he said , Rejoice , Zebulun , in thy going out  ; and , Issachar , in thy tents .
translation.kha: Shaphang ki jait Sebulun bad Issakhar u ong ,  Kiba na ka jait Sebulun to kin manbha ha ki jingkhaïi pateng ha duriaw ; Bad to ka spah jong ka jait Issakhar kan nang roi ha la ka ri .

translation.en: God wants people to enjoy life on earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ba ki briew kin im ka jingim kaba kmen ha pyrthei .

translation.en: Go and get thee in unto king David , and say unto him , Didst not thou , my lord , O king , swear unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ? why then doth Adonijah reign ?
translation.kha: leit mar mar sha u Syiem Dabid bad pan na u , ‘ Syiem Kynrad , hato phim shym la kular kyntang ïa nga ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi ? Kumno te ka lah ban long ba u Adonijah u la long syiem ?’

translation.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches , and he that giveth to the rich , shall surely come to want .
translation.kha: Lada phi ai sngewbha sha ki briew kiba riewspah lane banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ban ïoh riewspah , phin long uba duk ïa lade .

translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : that the land , whither I bring you to dwell therein , spue you not out .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh , ba kumta phin ym shah kyntait ha ka ri Kanaan sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  called thy name , A green olive tree , fair , and of goodly fruit : with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it , and the branches of it are broken .
translation.kha: Shisien nga la khot ïa ki , u dieng Olib babun sla , uba dap da ki soh ba-itynnat ; hynrei mynta , da ka jingkyrhuh kum u pyrthat ngan thang ïa ki sla jong u ha ka ding bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: If I have made gold my hope , or have said to the fine gold , Thou art my confidence  ;
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju shaniah ha ka spah

translation.en: The elders guide and help to protect the congregation spiritually .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah balang ki pyni ïa ngi na ka Baibl bad ki ïarap ïa ka balang ban kham jan sha U Blei .

translation.en: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten , so thou shalt eat them : the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike .
translation.kha: Uno uno , u lah ban bam ïa kata ka doh , uba khuid ne bymkhuid , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .

translation.en: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up , and came in thither , and took the graven image , and the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image : and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war .
translation.kha: ki san ngut ki nongsyntiat ki rung beit shapoh ïing bad ki shim ïa kata ka bleithaw ba la suit da ka rupa , kiwei pat ruh ki bleithaw , bad ïa ka ephod , katba u lyngdoh u dang ïeng ha ka khyrdop bad ki hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah kiba la kieng atiar .

translation.en: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin , and smote them with the edge of the sword , as well the men of every city , as the beast , and all that came to hand : also they set on fire all the cities that they came to .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki wan phai pat ban ïaleh sa ïa kiwei ki Benjamin kiba dang sah , bad ki pynïap lut ïa ki baroh — ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki jingri jingdup ruh . Ki thang lut khoit ïa ki shnong baroh kiba don ha kata ka thain .

translation.en: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place , until he come out , and have made an atonement for himself , and for his household , and for all the congregation of Israel .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba u Aaron u leit rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam ban pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid haduh ba un da mih nangta , ym bit ïano ïano ban don hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . Ynda u la pyndep ïa kata ka rukom lehniam na ka bynta ïa lade , na ka bynta la ka longïing , bad na ka bynta u paidbah baroh ,

translation.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction , and would root out all mine increase .
translation.kha: Kan long kum ka jingpynjot , ka ding bashyrkhei , ka ban bam duh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga don .

translation.en: The kings of the earth , and all the inhabitants of the world , would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano hangno hangno , ym don wat ki nongsynshar jong ki hima nongwei , kiba la ngeit ba uno uno u nonghiarthma un lah ban rung lyngba ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you , and deliver the Midianites into thine hand : and let all the other people go every man unto his place .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon ,  Ngan pyllait im ïa me bad ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor ki Midian da ki laispah ngut ki rangbah kiba shu jliah ïa ka um . Ong ïa kiwei pat kin leit noh sha ïing .

translation.en: Then they rent their clothes , and laded every man his ass , and returned to the city .
translation.kha: Kita shi para ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , ki la buh biang ïa la ki jingkit halor ki kada jong ki bad ki la leit phai sha kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: Lord  , when thy hand is lifted up , they will not see : but they shall see , and be ashamed for their envy at the people  ; yea , the fire of thine enemies shall devour them .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong me kim tip satia ba men pynshitom ïa ki . A  Trai  , buh ïa ki ha ka jingjahburom bad ai ba kin jynjar ; ai ba kin jynjar da ka jingpynshitom kaba me la pynkhreh . To pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno me ieit ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes , and saw the place afar off .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , u Abraham u la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka na jngai .

translation.en: And all the people saw the thunderings , and the lightnings , and the noise of the trumpet , and the mountain smoking : and when the people saw it , they removed , and stood afar off .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingtied u pyrthat bad ïa ka jingsawa ka turoi , bad ïohi ïa ka leilieh bad ïa uta u lum uba mih tdem , ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïeng noh sha jngai .

translation.en: Then I beheld , and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire : from the appearance of his loins even downward , fire  ; and from his loins even upward , as the appearance of brightness , as the colour of amber .
translation.kha: Nga la khmied bad nga la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw ïa ka dur kaba i kum ka durbriew bameh ding . Na ka syngkai sharum , ka met jong u ka long kum ka ding , bad na ka syngkai shaneng , u shat phyrnai kum ka rnong ba la kyrshut phyrnai bha .

translation.en: He said , I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , Make straight the way of the Lord , as said the prophet Esaias .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab da kaba shim na u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah :  Nga long ‘ ka sur jong uta uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap : To pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid jong U Trai ba un ïaid !’

translation.en: Having therefore these promises , dearly beloved , let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit , perfecting holiness in the fear of God .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki jingkular baroh la pynlong na ka bynta jong ngi , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga . Te namarkata , to ngin pynkhuid ïa lade na kaei kaei baroh kaba pyntngit ïa ka met bad mynsiem , bad to ai ba ngin im ka jingim kaba khuid da kaba im ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee , and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee , thou shalt do : thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee , to the right hand , nor to the left .
translation.kha: Pdiang ïa ka rai jong ki bad leh thik kumba ki bthah ïa phi .

translation.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents , glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the  Lord  had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud kaba long ka sngi kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba hynñiew , u Solomon u phah noh ïa ki briew sha la ïing . Ki la kmen ïa baroh ki jingkyrkhu ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki briew jong u ki Israel , ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon .

translation.en: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands  ; and said , Let us not kill him .
translation.kha: Haba u Reuben u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa u Joseph .  To ngin ym pynïap ïa u ,  u ong .

translation.en: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him ; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki parabangeit Jiw ki la sdang leh kum ki khawpud ryngkat bad u Petros ; bad wat u Barnabas hi ruh u la liat lang ha ka jingleh khawpud jong ki .

translation.en: This is the water of Meribah  ; because the children of Israel strove with the  Lord  , and he was sanctified in them .
translation.kha: Kane ka jia ha Meribah , ha kaba ki Israel ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad ha kaba u la pynpaw ïa lade ba u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes , even to Ben–hail , and to Obadiah , and to Zechariah , and to Nethaneel , and to Michaiah , to teach in the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u phah ïa kine ki rangbah synshar ban hikai ha ki nongbah ka Judah : u Benhail , u Obadaïah , u Sekharaïah , u Nethanel bad u Mikaïah .

translation.en: We love him , because he first loved us .
translation.kha: Ngi ieit namar U Blei u la ieit shuwa ïa ngi .

translation.en: And the king of Israel answered and said , Tell him , Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u la jubab ,  Ïathuh ïa u syiem Benhadad ba u shipai bashisha u kob  hadien  jong ka thma , ym ha shuwa jong ka .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The fast of the fourth month , and the fast of the fifth , and the fast of the seventh , and the fast of the tenth , shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness , and cheerful feasts  ; therefore love the truth and peace .
translation.kha: Ki jingshah jingit kiba la long ha u bnai basaw , uba san , uba hynñiew , bad uba shiphew kin kylla long ki Jingkhawai Niam ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen ïa ki paid Judah . Phi dei ban ieit ïa ka jingshisha bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them , as they were able to hear it .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki briew , u da pyndonkam shibun kiwei pat ki pharshi kum kine ; u la ïathuh shibun ïa ki kat kaba ki lah ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Wherefore have we fasted , say they , and thou seest not ? wherefore have we afflicted our soul , and thou takest no knowledge ? Behold , in the day of your fast ye find pleasure , and exact all your labours .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ,  Balei ngin shahjingit , lada U  Trai  um patiaw ? Balei ngi dei ban leit khlem bam lada um shahshkor ?  U  Trai  u ong ïa ki ,  Ka jingshisha ka long ba ha kajuh ka por ba phi shahjingit , phi ïabeh ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi bad banbeiñ ïa la ki nongtrei .

translation.en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come , and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh , and let them keep food in the cities .
translation.kha: Hukum ïa ki ban lum ïa ka bam baroh ha kine ki snem kiba pahuh , bad ai bor ïa ki ban kynshew ïa u kew ha ki nongbah bad ban da buh nongap ïa u .

translation.en: I will be thy king : where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities ? and thy judges of whom thou saidst , Give me a king and princes ?
translation.kha: Phi pan ïa u syiem bad ki nongïalam , hynrei mynta kumno ki lah ban pyllait im ïa ka ri ?
