translation.en: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal , and brake it down  ; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly , and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . And the priest appointed officers over the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta ki paidbah ki leit sha ka templ u Baal bad ki pynkyllon ïa ka ; ki pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ïa ki bleithaw , bad ki pynïap ïa u Mattan , u lyngdoh jong u Baal , ha khmat ki duwan . U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki nongap phira kiba dei treikam ha ka Templ ,

translation.en: My son , be wise , and make my heart glad , that I may answer him that reproacheth me .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to long uba stad , bad ngan long uba kmen ; ngan don ka jubab ïa uno uno uba kem daw ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said Paul , I wist not , brethren , that he was the high priest : for it is written , Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people .
translation.kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Ko para nong Israel jong nga , ngam shym tip ba u dei u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Mem dei ban kren sniew ïa u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong me .’

translation.en: Some said , This is he : others said , He is like him : but he said , I am he .
translation.kha: Don kiba la ong ,  U dei ma u ,  hynrei kiwei ki la ong ,  Em , um dei ma u , u shu ïasyriem ïa u .  Kumta uta u briew hi u la ong ,  Dei ma nga uta u briew !

translation.en: But if thou say to me , We trust in the  Lord  our God : is it not he , whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away , and said to Judah and to Jerusalem , Ye shall worship before this altar ?
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ong shuh shuh ,  Lane hato phin ïathuh ha nga ba phi shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ? Ki long ki jaka mane blei bad ki duwan jong U  Trai  ba u Hesekaïah u la pynjot haba u ïathuh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban mane tang ha kawei ka duwan .

translation.en: And the second row , an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
translation.kha: ïa u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Diamond ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;

translation.en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach , and gave him commandment unto Mordecai  ;
translation.kha: bad ka Esther ka ai ïa kane ka khubor ban leit rah pat sha u Mordekai :

translation.en: After this he went down to Capernaum , he , and his mother , and his brethren , and his disciples : and they continued there not many days .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu bad ka kmie jong u , ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki synran ki la leit sha Kapernam bad ki la sah hangta katto katne sngi .

translation.en: What advantage then hath the Jew ? or what profit is there of circumcision ?
translation.kha: Hato ki Jiw te ki don ha kano kano ka jingmyntoi ban ïa ki Jentil ? Lane hato don kano kano ka dor ha ka jingotsher ?

translation.en: As many were astonished at thee  ; his visage was so marred more than any man , and his form more than the sons of men :
translation.kha: Bun ki briew kin kyndit haba kin ïohi ïa u ; la pynsniew briew ïa u haduh ba um i shuh kum u briew .

translation.en: And the Egyptians pursued , and went in after them to the midst of the sea , even all Pharaoh s horses , his chariots , and his horsemen .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ruh ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la leit nadien jong ki sha ka duriaw lem bad ki kulai , ki kali ïapom bad ki nongñiah .

translation.en: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them , saying , Return ye now every man from his evil way , and amend your doings , and go not after other gods to serve them , and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers : but ye have not inclined your ear , nor hearkened unto me .
translation.kha: Nga la ïai phah sha phi ïa baroh ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la ong ïa phi ban iehnoh ïa ki lynti bymman jong phi bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Ki la maham ïa phi ban ym mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaishong ha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane sngap ïa nga .

translation.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with her suburbs , Geba with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Benjamin la ai saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Gibeon , ka Geba ,

translation.en: And could not find what they might do : for all the people were very attentive to hear him .
translation.kha: hynrei kim shym shem ka lad ban leh ïa kata , namar baroh ki briew ki la ïai shahshkor ïa u , kim kwah ban duh noh wat kawei ka kyntien .

translation.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks , and into the caves of the earth , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin rieh ha ki krem ha mawsiang lum lane tih thliew ha khyndew ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar jong U  Trai  bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u , haba u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: I am crucified with Christ : nevertheless I live ; yet not I , but Christ liveth in me : and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God , who loved me , and gave himself for me .
translation.kha: khnang ba ym dei shuh ma nga uba im , hynrei dei U Khrist uba im ha nga . Kane ka jingim kaba nga im mynta , nga im da ka jingngeit ha U Khun U Blei , uba la ieit ïa nga bad uba la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Hear me now therefore , O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga bad wat klet ïa ki ktien jong nga .

translation.en: But God said unto me , Thou shalt not build an house for my name , because thou hast been a man of war , and hast shed blood .
translation.kha: hynrei u la khang ïa nga ban tei ïa ka , namar nga dei u nongïaleh thma bad nga lah pynmih shibun ka snam .

translation.en: And be ready in the morning , and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai , and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount .
translation.kha: Khreh la shai dang step , bad wan kiew ïa u Lum Sinai ban ïashem bad nga hangta ha kliar lum .

translation.en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not , nor unto any place of the river Jabbok , nor unto the cities in the mountains , nor unto whatsoever the  Lord  our God forbad us .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngim shym leit sha jan ka ri ki Ammon lane sha ki jaka harud ka Wah Jabbok lane sha ki shnong ha ri lum lane sha kano kano ka jaka sha kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la adong ïa ngi .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien kane , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga

translation.en: In journeyings often , in perils of waters , in perils of robbers , in perils by mine own countrymen , in perils by the heathen , in perils in the city , in perils in the wilderness , in perils in the sea , in perils among false brethren ;
translation.kha: Ha ki jingleit jong nga kiba bun nga la don ha ka jingma na ki jingshlei um bad na ki nonglute , ha ka jingma na ki para Jiw bad na ki Jentil ; ki la don ki jingma ha ki nongbah , ki jingma ha ki ri khlaw , ki jingma ha ki duriaw-bah , bad ki jingma na ki paralok kiba shukor .

translation.en: Then will I also walk contrary unto you , and will punish you yet seven times for your sins .
translation.kha: te nga ruh ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi bad ngan pynshitom ïa phi kham jur sa hynñiew shah .

translation.en: But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the  Lord  : and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïada , bad ngan ym aiti noh ïa me sha ki briew kiba me sheptieng .

translation.en: Son of man , I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and , lo , it shall not be bound up to be healed , to put a roller to bind it , to make it strong to hold the sword .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka ksang ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ym don ba la sop spaiñ ïa ka lane pynsdien ïa ka khnang ba kan ïohkhiah bad ban khlaiñ kat ban lah ban bat biang ïa ka waitlam .

translation.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye , but not to doubtful disputations .
translation.kha: To pdiang sngewbha ïa u briew uba tlot ha ka jingngeit , hynrei wat ïania bad u shaphang ki jingpyrkhat bashimet jong u .

translation.en: Then said he unto him , Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , behold , as soon as thou art departed from me , a lion shall slay thee . And as soon as he was departed from him , a lion found him , and slew him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kyntait , bad kumta u ong ïa u ,  Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , u sing un sa pynïap ïa phi tang mar shu ïakhlad bad nga .  Tang mar shu ïamih , u sing u wan bad pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: ( 1 Thessalonians 2 :13 ) If you apply what the Bible teaches , you will benefit greatly .
translation.kha: ( 1 Thessaloni 2 :13 ) Lada phi pyndonkam kaei ka jinghikai ka Baibl phin ioh shibun ka jingmyntoi .

translation.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth , and a foot out of joint .
translation.kha: Kaba shaniah ha u briew u bym lah ban shaniah ha ka por ka jingjynjar ka long kumba pyrshang ban ktha jingbam da ka bniat kaba la khih ne ïaid da ka kjat kaba dkoh .

translation.en: When ye come together therefore into one place , this is not to eat the Lord s supper .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaseng lang kum ka kynhun , kam dei ka Jingkhawai U Trai ba phi ïabam .

translation.en: For we are his workmanship , created in Christ Jesus unto good works , which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynlong ïa ngi kumba ngi long , bad ha U Khrist Jisu u la pynlong ïa ngi ban im na ka bynta ki kam babha , ïa kiba u la pynkhreh lypa ba ngin leh ïa ki .

translation.en: For whether we be beside ourselves , it is to God : or whether we be sober , it is for your cause .
translation.kha: Hato ngi da lamwir shisha ? Ka long na ka bynta U Blei . Lane hato ngi long kiba tipbriew ? Te ka long na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem : and with them were the prophets of God helping them .
translation.kha: Haba u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel bad u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak ki la ïohsngew ïa ki khubor , ki sdang ban tei biang ïa ka Templ ha Jerusalem , bad ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïarap ïa ki .

translation.en: And the watchman cried , and told the king . And the king said , If he be alone , there is tidings in his mouth . And he came apace , and drew near .
translation.kha: U pyrta sha tbian bad u ïathuh ha u syiem bad U syiem u ong ,  Lada u don tang marwei , u wanrah ka khubor babha .  Uta uba mareh u nang jan nang jan .

translation.en: Open thy mouth , judge righteously , and plead the cause of the poor and needy .
translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta jong ki bad long u nongbishar uba hok . Ïada ïa ki hok jong kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans , because they suffered such things ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Namar ba ïa kito ki nong Galilaïa la pynïap ha kata ka rukom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ka pynshisha ba ki la long ki nongpop kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nong Galilaïa ?

translation.en: Go up into Gilead , and take balm , O virgin , the daughter of Egypt : in vain shalt thou use many medicines  ; for thou shalt not be cured .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong ka Ijipt , khie leit sha Gilead bad wad ïa ka dawai ! Ki dawai jong pha baroh ki la pynshisha ba kim myntoi ei ei ; ym don ei ei ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa pha .

translation.en: Which was with the deputy of the country , Sergius Paulus , a prudent man  ; who called for Barnabas and Saul , and desired to hear the word of God .
translation.kha: U la long u paralok jong u lyngskor jong kata ka dewlynnong , u Sergius Paulos uba la long u briew uba shemphang bha . Uta u lyngskor u la phah khot ïa u Barnabas bad u Saul ha khmat jong u namar u la kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei .

translation.en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries : but the people that do know their God shall be strong , and do exploits .
translation.kha: Da ka buit shukor u syiem un ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa la ka niam , hynrei kito kiba bud ïa U Blei kin ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: From Ekron even unto the sea , all that lay near Ashdod , with their villages :
translation.kha: bad baroh ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba hajan ka Ashdod , naduh Ekron haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian .

translation.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her , so that he shall have no need of spoil .
translation.kha: U tnga jong ka u buh ka jingshaniah jong u ha ka , bad un ym kyrduh ei ei .

translation.en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help , whose hope is in the  Lord  his God :
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba don U Blei jong u Jakob ban ïarap ïa u bad uba shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u ,

translation.en: And two chains of pure gold at the ends  ; of wreathen work shalt thou make them , and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches .
translation.kha: bad ar tylli ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla kiba la jyrthiaw kum ki tyllai bad pyndait ïa ki ha kita ki shrong .

translation.en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you , nor persuade you on this manner , neither yet believe him : for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand , and out of the hand of my fathers : how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynta wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi lane ïalam bakla ïa phi kumta . Wat ngeit ïa u ! Ym don blei jong kano kano ka hima uba la lah ban pyllait ïa la ki briew na uno uno u patsha ka Assyria . Kumta da kaba thikna une U Blei jong phi un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa phi !

translation.en: And he sent forth a raven , which went forth to and fro , until the waters were dried up from off the earth .
translation.kha: Kam shym la wan phai , hynrei ka shu her kylleng kylleng haduh ba ka um kan da rngad .

translation.en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon :
translation.kha: U Jephthah u phah nonglamktien biang sha u syiem Ammon

translation.en: Put ye in the sickle , for the harvest is ripe : come , get you down  ; for the press is full , the fats overflow  ; for their wickedness is great .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba bymman haduh katta katta ; ot ïa ki kum ïa u kew ha ka aïom ot ; pynlwet ïa ki kum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka pynmih umsoh haduh ba ka umsoh ka shlei .

translation.en: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things , and every oblation of all , of every sort of your oblations , shall be the priest s : ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough , that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin ïoh ïa kaba bha tam na ki soh nyngkong jong ka jingot bad na baroh kiei kiei kiwei ïa kiba la ainguh ha nga . Man ka por ba ki briew ki shet kpu , kin ai sha ki lyngdoh ïa u kpu banyngkong kum ka jingainguh , bad ki jingkyrkhu jong nga kin neh ha ki ïing ki sem jong ki .

translation.en: So then if , while her husband liveth , she be married to another man , she shall be called an adulteress : but if her husband be dead , she is free from that law ; so that she is no adulteress , though she be married to another man .
translation.kha: Kumta te , lada ka ïashong bad uwei pat u briew katba u tnga jong ka u dang im ; yn khot ïa ka , ka briew kaba klim ; hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u la ïap , kat kum ka aiñ ka long ka briew ba la laitluid bad kam leh ïa ka jingklim haba ka shongkurim ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt : therefore I command thee to do this thing .
translation.kha: Wat klet ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt ; dei namar kata ba nga la ai ha phi ïa kane ka hukum .

translation.en: What shall I say ? he hath both spoken unto me , and himself hath done it : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul .
translation.kha: Kaei nga lah ban ong ? U  Trai  u la leh ïa kane . Ka dohnud jong nga ka kthang , bad ngam shym lah ïohthiah .

translation.en: And thou his son , O Belshazzar , hast not humbled thine heart , though thou knewest all this  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , u khun jong u , phim shym la pynrit ïa lade , wat la phi la tip ïa kane baroh .

translation.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man , even fourscore years old : and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim  ; for he was a very great man .
translation.kha: U Barsillai u long uba la tymmen bha , u la phraphew snem ka rta . U long uba riewspah bha , bad u la pynbiang jingbam ïa u syiem mynba u dang sah ha Mahanaim .

translation.en: Israel shall cry unto me , My God , we know thee .
translation.kha: Wat lada ki khot ïa nga U Blei jong ki bad ki kam ba ki dei ki briew jong nga bad ba ki tip ïa nga ,

translation.en: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;
translation.kha: Yn don ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang na ka bynta kito baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , na ka bynta ki Jiw nyngkong bad na ka bynta ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken  ; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate : but thou shalt be called Hephzi–bah , and thy land Beulah : for the  Lord  delighteth in thee , and thy land shall be married .
translation.kha: Yn ym khot shuh ïa pha ,  Kaba la shah iehnoh ,  ne ïa ka ri jong pha yn khot ,  Ka tnga ba la shah iehnoh .  Ka kyrteng bathymmai jong pha kan long  U Blei u sngewbha ïa ka .  Ïa ka ri jong pha yn khot ,  Ka jingshongkurim kaba suk ,  naba U  Trai  u sngewbha eh ïa pha , bad un long kum u tnga ïa ka ri jong pha .

translation.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba laiphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Asubah , ka khun jong u Shilhi .

translation.en: Jesus sent his followers to search for meek people and to teach them how to become acceptable to God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phah ïa la ki synran ban wad ïa ki briew kiba sngewrit bad ban hikai ïa ki kumno ban long ki paralok jong U Blei .

translation.en: He heard the sound of the trumpet , and took not warning  ; his blood shall be upon him . But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap jong u ka long na ka jingbakla jong u hi , namar um suidñiew ïa ka jingmaham . Lada u la shahshkor un jin da la lait im .

translation.en: Woe unto you ! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets , and your fathers killed them .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ! Phi thaw ki mot jingtep ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki nongïathuhlypa — kita ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynïap .

translation.en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked , yet will he not learn righteousness : in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly , and will not behold the majesty of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat la me lehsbun ïa ki riewbymman , pynban kim ju hikai ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Wat hangne ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba hok ki dang leh ïa ka bymdei ; ki kyntait ban ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .

translation.en: And I set my face unto the Lord God , to seek by prayer and supplications , with fasting , and sackcloth , and ashes :
translation.kha: Bad nga la duwai jur ha U Trai U Blei , da kaba ïasaid bad u , da kaba shahjingit , da kaba phong ki jaiñ khain , bad da kaba shong ha u dpei .

translation.en: Thou art good , and doest good  ; teach me thy statutes .
translation.kha: A katno me long uba bha — uba bha sbun ! To hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And when they had bound him , they led him away , and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor .
translation.kha: Ki la teh ïa u ha ki kynjri , ki la ïalam ïa u , bad ki la aiti ïa u ha u Pilat , u lyngskor ka hima Rom .

translation.en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king , and of his sons .
translation.kha: Ïa kane dei ban leh khnang ba ki lah ban ai ki jingkñia ba pdiang hun ha U Blei jong ka Bneng bad duwai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u halor jong nga bad ki khun shynrang jong nga .

translation.en: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks , they cast four anchors out of the stern , and wished for the day .
translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ka lieng kan leit sha ki mawsiang , kumta ki la pynhiar saw tylli ki angkor na shadien jong ka lieng bad ki la duwai ïa ka jingshai ka sngi .

translation.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man , then he shall be brought unto the priest  ;
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u ngat ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , dei ban ïalam ïa u ha u lyngdoh ,

translation.en: And he brought out the people that were in it , and cut them with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes . Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon . And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U rah ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah bad pyntrei ïa ki ha ki jaka ot dieng , jaka shna mohkhiew bad sdie . U leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei ki shnong ka ri Ammon . Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki wan phai sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Mother Earth .
translation.kha: Mei mariang .

translation.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them , and the bullocks with the bulls  ; and their land shall be soaked with blood , and their dust made fat with fatness .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin kyllon kum ki masi kyrtong khlaw bad ki masi lyngraw , bad ka khyndew kan saw da ka snam bad yn tap da ka khleiñ .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was alone praying , his disciples were with him : and he asked them , saying ,  Whom say the people that I am ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u dang duwai marwei , ki synran ki la wan ha u .  Ki paidbah ki ong ba nga long uei ?  U la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  repented for this : It shall not be , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylla noh la ka jingmut bad u ong ,  Kaei kaba phi la ïohi kan ym jia .

translation.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold , of beaten work shalt thou make them , in the two ends of the mercy seat .
translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kherub da ka ksiar kaba la shoh tylli ,

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh : and he said unto them , Go , serve the  Lord  your God : but who are they that shall go ?
translation.kha: Kumta la wan ïalam biang ïa u Moses bad u Aaron sha u Pharaoh , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi lah ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Hynrei pynthikna mano ban leit ?

translation.en: And when it was evening , his disciples came to him , saying , This is a desert place , and the time is now past  ; send the multitude away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves victuals .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka janmiet ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Ka la da dier eh , bad kane ka dei ka jaka bakynjah . To phah noh ïa ki paidbah bad shah ïa ki ban leit sha ki shnong ban thied jingbam na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and his sons  garments , to minister in the priest s office .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams , shall be put to death  ; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed you out of the house of bondage , to thrust thee out of the way which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to walk in . So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynïap ïa uno uno u nongïathuhlypa lane uno uno u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew uba ong ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw . Kum uta u briew u long uba bymman bad u pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na kata ka rukom im ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi . Ïa une dei ban pynïap , khnang ba phin lah ban pyllait ïa lade na kane ka jingbymman .

translation.en: And the Levite , the husband of the woman that was slain , answered and said , I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin , I and my concubine , to lodge .
translation.kha: U Lebi , uba ka tnga kliar jong u ka la shah pynïap , u jubab ,  Ma nga bad ka tnga kliar jong nga ngi leit sahmiet ha Gibeah kaba ha ka ri ki Benjamin .

translation.en: And God spake on this wise , That his seed should sojourn in a strange land  ; and that they should bring them into bondage , and entreat them evil four hundred years .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong ha u : ‘ Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin shong ha ka ri nongwei , ha kaba kin long ki mraw bad kin shah lehbeiñ haduh sawspah snem .

translation.en: And let the priests also , which come near to the  Lord  , sanctify themselves , lest the  Lord  break forth upon them .
translation.kha: Wat ki lyngdoh kiba wan sha jan jong nga ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade , lym kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles , and the glory of thy people Israel .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ban pynpaw ïa ka mon jong me ha ki Jentil bad ban wallam ka burom ha ki briew jong me , ki Israel .

translation.en: Blessed is he that readeth , and they that hear the words of this prophecy , and keep those things which are written therein : for the time is at hand .
translation.kha: Suk uta uba pule ïa kane ka kitab , bad suk kito kiba shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong kane ka khubor jong ka jingïathuhlypa bad kiba kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ! Naba ka por ka la jan haba baroh kine kiei kiei kin sa jia .

translation.en: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain , The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy ?
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba kam don ka jingshisha ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ,  Ka mynsiem kaba U Blei u la buh hapoh jong ngi ka dap da ki jingkwah kiba jur .

translation.en: Now therefore , if it seem good to the king , let there be search made in the king s treasure house , which is there at Babylon , whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem , and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter .
translation.kha: Mynta , lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , ai ba yn ïit ha ki jingthoh syiem ha Babilon ban shem lada u Syros u la ai ne um shym la ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa kane ka Templ ha Jerusalem , bad nangta sa pyntip ïa ngi kaei ka mon jong phi ha kane ka kam .

translation.en: Mine enemies chased me sore , like a bird , without cause .
translation.kha: Nga la shah riam kum ka sim ha ki nongshun ki bym don daw ban isih ïa nga .

translation.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves , but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place , having obtained eternal redemption for us .
translation.kha: Haba U Khrist u la ïaid lyngba kane ka ïingjaiñ bad rung tang shisien shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam , um shym la shim ïa ka snam ki blang bad ki masi kyrtong ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ; hynrei , u shim ïa la ka jong ka snam , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: katba ngi dang ap ïa ka jingwan jong kata ka Sngi ba la kyrkhu kaba ngi ap kyrmen , haba ka burom U Blei bakhraw bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi kan paw .

translation.en: Mountains , and all hills  ; fruitful trees , and all cedars :
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki lumrit bad ki lumbah , ki diengsoh bad ki khlaw ;

translation.en: And they came near before Eleazar the priest , and before Joshua the son of Nun , and before the princes , saying , The  Lord  commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren . Therefore according to the commandment of the  Lord  he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father .
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad sha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun bad sha ki nongïalam , bad ki ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ai ïa ngi , kumjuh ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing shynrang jong ngi , shi bynta jong ka ri ban ïohkynti .  Kumta , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , la ai jaka ha ki lem bad ha ki ba-ha-ïing shynrang jong ki .

translation.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust , and the worms shall cover them .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh kumjuh ki ïap bad la tep ïa ki ; ïa ki baroh la tap da ki kruiñ .

translation.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God  ; every precious stone was thy covering , the sardius , topaz , and the diamond , the beryl , the onyx , and the jasper , the sapphire , the emerald , and the carbuncle , and gold : the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created .
translation.kha: Me la shong ha Eden , ka kper jong U Blei , bad me deng ïa ki mawlynnai ba bun jait : ki Rubi bad ki Diamond ; u Topas , u Beryl , u Karnelian bad u Jasper ; ki Sapphir , ki Emerald , bad ki Garnet . Me don ki jingdeng da ka ksiar . Ïa ki la shna na ka bynta jong me ha ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me .

translation.en: And Sarah my master s wife bare a son to my master when she was old : and unto him hath he given all that he hath .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah , ka tnga u kynrad jong nga , ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u haba ka la tymmen , bad u kynrad jong nga u la ai lut ha u kat ïa kaba u don .

translation.en: Who is like unto thee , O  Lord  , among the gods ? who is like thee , glorious in holiness , fearful in praises , doing wonders ?
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , uei uba kat ma me hapdeng ki blei ? Uei keiñ uba kum ma me , uba phylla ha ka jinglongkhuid ? Uei uba lah ban leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kum ma me ?

translation.en: And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaïaphas , uba la long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata ka snem , u la ong ,  A katno phi long kiba bieit !

translation.en: Send me also cedar trees , fir trees , and algum trees , out of Lebanon : for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon  ; and , behold , my servants shall be with thy servants ,
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno ka jingtbit jong ki nongot dieng jong phi , kumta to phah ïa nga ki dieng Kedar , ki dieng Kseh-Sypress , bad ki dieng Kseh-Juniper tylli na Lebanon .

translation.en: Let such an one think this , that , such as we are in word by letters when we are absent , such will we be also in deed when we are present .
translation.kha: To ai ba kum uta u briew un sngewthuh ba kam don ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba ngi thoh ha ki shithi jong ngi haba ngi don sha jngai bad ïa kaei kaba ngin leh haba ngi don markhmat bad phi .

translation.en: For I am the  Lord  : I will speak , and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass  ; it shall be no more prolonged : for in your days , O rebellious house , will I say the word , and will perform it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan kren ha ki , bad ïa kaei kaba nga ong yn pyndep . Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ha ka por ka jong phi hi , ko ki nongïeng ïaleh pyrshah , ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la maham ïa phi ba ngan leh . Nga la kren ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  hath proclaimed unto the end of the world , Say ye to the daughter of Zion , Behold , thy salvation cometh  ; behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .
translation.kha: Ba U  Trai  u la pynbna shaduh ka pyrthei baroh :  To ong ha ki paid ka Jerusalem ba U Trai un wan ban ïada ïa phi un wallam bad u ïa ki briew kiba u la pyllait im .

translation.en: And all the cities of the plain , and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian , Evi , and Rekem , and Zur , and Hur , and Reba , which were dukes of Sihon , dwelling in the country .
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ki nongbah baroh jong ka jaka padun bad ka hima baroh kawei jong u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba la synshar ha Heshbon . U Moses u la jop ïa u , bad ruh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Midian : u Ebi , u Rekem , u Sur , u Hur , bad u Reba . Kine baroh ki la synshar na ka bynta u Sihon .

translation.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment , and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh , and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar , and he shall put them beside the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh , uba kup ïa ka jaiñkup linen bad uba phong ïa ka patlun linen kaba lyngkot , un weng noh ïa u dpei khleiñ ba sah ha ka duwan bad un buh ïa u harud jong ka duwan .

translation.en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers of the king s work , offered willingly ,
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah kur , ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki nongai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai , bad ki nongpynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u syiem da la ka mon sngewbha ki ai

translation.en: All the saints salute you .
translation.kha: Baroh ki riewkhuid  ki ai jingkhublei ïa phi .

translation.en: Let us walk honestly , as in the day ; not in rioting and drunkenness , not in chambering and wantonness , not in strife and envying .
translation.kha: To ngin leh donakor , kum ki briew kiba im ha ka jingshai jong ka sngi — khlem ki jingsngewbha thala bakhynwin ne ka jingïabuaid , khlem ka jingleh awria lane ka jingleh khlem akor , khlem ka jingïashoh ïadat lane ka jingbishni .

translation.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka dak ka pur , u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid ; u la bit jingpang .

translation.en: And Beth–peor , and Ashdoth–pisgah , and Beth–jeshimoth ,
translation.kha: ka Bethpeor , ki sharing jong u Lum Pisgah , bad ka Beth Jeshimoth .

translation.en: For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen ïa u dieng uba la khet ; u lah ban im pat bad un khie lung .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that came to do the service of the ministry , and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
translation.kha: U Moses u la kohnguh bad u la shim

translation.en: And Moses spake unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U Moses u duwai ,

translation.en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness , Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers , neither observe their judgments , nor defile yourselves with their idols :
translation.kha: Pynban , nga la maham ïa ki samla hapdeng jong ki : Wat sumar ïa ki aiñ kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki thaw ; wat bud ïa ki rukom jong ki lane pyntngit ïa lade da ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: And Balaam rose up , and went and returned to his place : and Balak also went his way .
translation.kha: Nangta u Balaam u la ïeng joit bad leit phai noh sha la ïing , bad u Balak ruh u la leit phai ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: For the goodman is not at home , he is gone a long journey :
translation.kha: U tnga jong nga um don ha ïing ; u la leit jingleit sha jngai .

translation.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us . Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
translation.kha: Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi . Hato ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki pyllait ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?

translation.en: And if the house be worthy , let your peace come upon it : but if it be not worthy , let your peace return to you .
translation.kha: Lada ki briew hapoh kata ka ïing ki pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ; hynrei lada kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to shim noh pat ïa ka jingkhublei jong phi .

translation.en: So the people took victuals in their hand , and their trumpets : and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent , and retained those three hundred men : and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley .
translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u phah noh ïa kita ki Israel baroh sha ïing , lait noh ki laispah ngut , kiba la sumar ïa baroh ki jingbam bad ki turoi . Ka jaka sher dara jong ki Midian ka don sharum jong ki ha ka them .

translation.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant  ; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver , and the ox shall be stoned .
translation.kha: Lada uta u masi kyrtong u pynïap ïa u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , uta u trai masi u dei ban siew ïa u kynrad jong uta u mraw laiphew ki sbai rupa , bad ïa uta u masi dei ban lynthem maw .

translation.en: Behold , I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain , to be an inheritance for your tribes , from Jordan , with all the nations that I have cut off , even unto the great sea westward .
translation.kha: Nga la ai kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki jait jong phi ïa ka ri jong kita ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah , lem bad ka jong kito ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la dep jop , naduh ka wah Jordan ha ka phang mihngi haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian ha ka phang sepngi .

translation.en: Go therefore now , and work  ; for there shall no straw be given you , yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks .
translation.kha: Mynta khie leit sha la ka kam ! Yn ym ai phlangïap shuh ïa phi , hynrei phi dei ban pynmih katjuh ki maw-it .

translation.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .
translation.kha: Un long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba duh noh ïa ki soh ki bym pat ih ; kum u dieng Olib uba hap noh ki shylluit .

translation.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood : and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls : for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul .
translation.kha: Ka jingim ki kynja ba-im baroh ka don ha ka snam , bad dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la hukum ba dei ban theh ïa baroh ka snam ha ka duwan ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Ka snam , kaba long ka jingim , ka weng noh ïa ki pop .

translation.en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds , with their knops and their flowers .
translation.kha: Ha ka met jong u diengpynïeng sharak hi yn don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew almond lem bad ki shylluit bad ki dop-syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .

translation.en: And Nathan said to the king , Go , do all that is in thine heart  ; for the  Lord  is with thee .
translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat , namar U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: Don't you want to stop Tom ?
translation.kha: Phim kwah pynsangeh ia u Tom ?

translation.en: Understand , ye brutish among the people : and ye fools , when will ye be wise ?
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , kumno phi lah ban long kiba bieit mutlop sat ? Lano phin nang ïa kane ?

translation.en: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel , I fear my lord the king , who hath appointed your meat and your drink : for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort ? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king .
translation.kha: U Ashpenas pat u la sheptieng ïa u syiem , kumta u la ong ha u Daniel ,  U syiem u la rai ïa kaei kaba phin bam bad dih , bad lada mem i kum uba bit kum kiwei pat ki samla shynrang , u lah ban pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats .
translation.kha: U Saul u ïalam lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel bad u la leit wad ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ha ka phang mihngi jong ki Mawsiang ki Blang Khlaw .

translation.en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick , and the Lord shall raise him up  ; and if he have committed sins , they shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingduwai ba la pynlong ha ka jingngeit kan pynkhiah ïa u briew uba pang ; U Trai un sa ai biang ha u ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah , bad ïa ki pop kiba u la leh yn map .

translation.en: Remember them , O my God , because they have defiled the priesthood , and the covenant of the priesthood , and of the Levites .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei , kumno kito ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa baroh ar , ka jinglong lyngdoh bad ka jutang kaba me la pynlong bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .

translation.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food , where all the beasts of the field play .
translation.kha: U phlang ban bsa ïa u , u mih ha ki lum ha kaba ki mradkhlaw ki ïalehkai .

translation.en: When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?
translation.kha: Hamar ka kynjat shai jong kata ka sngi , ki khlur ki ïarwai lang , bad baroh ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ki risa da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Haste thee , escape thither  ; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither . Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .
translation.kha: Pynkloi ! mareh ! ngan ym lah ban leh ei ei tad haduh ba men da poi hangta .  Namar ba u Lot u khot ïa ka kaba rit , ïa kata ka nongrit la ai kyrteng ka Soar .

translation.en: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning , neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use , nor given ought thereof for the dead : but I have hearkened to the voice of the  Lord  my God , and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me .
translation.kha: Mynba nga ïambriew , ngam shym la bam ei ei na ka ; mynba nga long u bymkhuid , ngam shym la rah ei ei na ka shabar ïing ; bad ngam shym la ai ei ei na ka kum ka jingainguh ïa kiba ïap . Nga la kohnguh ïa me , ko  Trai  ; nga la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba me la hukum ïa nga kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .

translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto them , Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah :
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la kren ha nga , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki rangbah kiba la phah sha nga ban ïathuh ha u Sedekaïah ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel u la ong ,

translation.en: And they cast dust on their heads , and cried , weeping and wailing , saying , Alas , alas , that great city , wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness ! for in one hour is she made desolate .
translation.kha: Ki la kynting pui pui halor ki khlieh jong ki , ki la lynñiar bad ki la ïambriew , da kaba ong ,  Katno kaba shyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw ! Ka long ka nongbah ha kaba baroh kiba don ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha ki duriaw ki la kylla riewspah ha ka spah jong ka ! Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kiei kiei baroh !

translation.en: To another faith by the same Spirit ; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit ;
translation.kha: Uwei bad ujuh hi U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka jingngeit ha uwei , katba ha uwei pat , u ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah .

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he kneeled down , and prayed with them all .
translation.kha: Haba u Paul u la dep kren , u la dem khohsiew bad ki bad u la duwai .

translation.en: Arise , cry out in the night : in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord : lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children , that faint for hunger in the top of every street .
translation.kha: Nga la khot ïa kiba ïateh lok bad nga , hynrei ki la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga . Ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam ki la ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , ki da wad ïa ka jingbam ban ri pynim ïa lade .

translation.en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah , accompanying the ark of God : and Ahio went before the ark .
translation.kha: bad u Ahio u ïaid na khmat .

translation.en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth , I did stamp them as the mire of the street , and did spread them abroad .
translation.kha: Nga pynlwet ïa ki , bad ki kylla long kum u pui pui , nga ïuh halor jong ki kum ïa ka ktieh ha ki lynti .

translation.en: That through them I may prove Israel , whether they will keep the way of the  Lord  to walk therein , as their fathers did keep it , or not .
translation.kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki ban shem la kine ki Israel kin bud ne em ïa ki lynti jong nga , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh .

translation.en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land , saying , But if thou wilt give it , I pray thee , hear me : I will give thee money for the field  ; take it of me , and I will bury my dead there .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Ephron , ba uwei pa uwei u lah ban ïohsngew ,  Sngewbha , shah ngan kyrpad ïa phi , ban shahshkor . Ngan thied ïa ka lyngkha baroh kawei . To pdiang ïa ka jingsiew jong nga , bad ngan tep ïa la ka tnga hangta .

translation.en: For when we were in the flesh , the motions of sins , which were by the law , did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death .
translation.kha: Naba haba ngi la im ka jinglong kum ki briew , ki jingkwah bapop ba la pynkhih da ka Hukum ki trei ha ki met jong ngi , bad baroh kaba ngi leh ka kut ha ka jingïap .

translation.en: And the king said unto Araunah , Nay  ; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price : neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  my God of that which doth cost me nothing . So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u jubab ,  Em , ngan da siewdor ïa ka . Ngan ym ai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ïa ki jingkñia kiba nga khlem da siewdor ei ei .  Bad u la thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad ïa ki masi dab ha ka dor sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs , and carried our sorrows : yet we did esteem him stricken , smitten of God , and afflicted .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la shah ïa ka jingshitom kaba la dei hok ïa ngi , ka jingpang kaba ngi la dei ban shah . Baroh shi katta ngi la pyrkhat ba ki jingshitom jong u ki la long ki jingpynshitom ba la phah da U Blei .

translation.en: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world ? and if the world shall be judged by you , are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ki briew U Blei kin sa bishar ïa ka pyrthei ? Te , namarkata , lada phi long ki ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hato phim long kiba lah ban bishar ïa kiei kiei kiba rit ?

translation.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me .
translation.kha: Me tip kumno ki nongshun jong nga ki la isih ïa nga bad kumno ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: No man can enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he will first bind the strong man  ; and then he will spoil his house .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban prong bad rung shapoh ka ïing kaba skhem jong u briew bad rah noh ïa ki tiar ki tar lymda u teh nyngkong ïa u briew uba khlaiñ ; te un sa lah ban lute ïa ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not kill .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat pynïap .

translation.en: And Samuel lay until the morning , and opened the doors of the house of the  Lord . And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision .
translation.kha: U Samuel u thiah haduh ban da shai ; nangta u la khie bad plie ïa ki jingkhang ka ïing U  Trai . U la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u Eli shaphang kata ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: And Moses spake before the  Lord  , saying , Behold , the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me  ; how then shall Pharaoh hear me , who am of uncircumcised lips ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien ,  Wat ki Israel ruh kim shym sngap ïa nga , u Pharaoh lei shano un sngap ? Nga dei u briew uba duna ka ktien ka thylliej .

translation.en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many  ; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist ruh u la kñia ainguh tang shisien ban bah noh ïa ki pop jong kiba bun . Un sa paw ha ka sien kaba ar , ym ban weng noh ïa ka pop , hynrei ban pynim ïa kita kiba ap khmih lynti ïa u .

translation.en: And , behold , seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them .
translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , kiba raikhoh bad ba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la nguid noh ïa kiba met .

translation.en: Rejoice over her , thou heaven , and ye holy apostles and prophets  ; for God hath avenged you on her .
translation.kha: To shadkmen , ko ka bneng , namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka ! to shadkmen , ko ki briew jong U Blei bad ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa ! Naba U Blei u la pynrem ïa ka na ka bynta kaei kaba ka la leh ïa phi !

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , the king rose up , and the governor , and Bernice , and they that sat with them :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem , u lyngskor , bad ka Berniki , bad baroh kiwei pat ki la ïeng joit ,

translation.en: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod : and the angel stood , saying , Rise , and measure the temple of God , and the altar , and them that worship therein .
translation.kha: La ai ha nga ïa u dieng uba syriem ïa u diengthew , bad la ong ïa nga ,  Khie leit bad thew ïa ka Templ U Blei bad ïa ka duwan , bad ñiew ïa kito kiba mane ha ka templ .

translation.en: And Rachel said , With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister , and I have prevailed : and she called his name Naphtali .
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  Nga la ïakhun ka jingïaleh kaba jwat bad la ka hynmen , hynrei nga la jop  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Naphtali .

translation.en: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up , saying , Wherefore dost thou prophesy , and say , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall take it  ;
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la set byndi ïa nga hangta bad u la mudui ba nga la pynbna ba U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan pynlong ba u syiem ka Babilonia un kurup ïa kane ka nongbah , bad u syiem Sedekaïah un ym lait im .

translation.en: And when she had so said , she went her way , and called Mary her sister secretly , saying , The Master is come , and calleth for thee .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Martha ka la ong ïa kane , ka la leit noh bad ka la khot jar jar ïa ka Mari ka para jong ka ,  U Nonghikai u don hangne ,  ka la ïathuh ïa ka ,  bad u phah khot ïa pha .

translation.en: But they that wait upon the  Lord  shall renew their strength  ; they shall mount up with wings as eagles  ; they shall run , and not be weary  ; and they shall walk , and not faint .
translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap kin shem ba la pynthymmai ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Kin ïeng joit ha ki thapniang kum ki pukni ; kin mareh bad kin ym sngewlwait ; kin ïaid bad kin ym sngewthait .

translation.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt , which knew not Joseph .
translation.kha: Nangta , u syiem bathymmai u bymtip ei ei shaphang u Joseph , u la synshar ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings , which have received no kingdom as yet  ; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast .
translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi ki long ki shiphew ngut ki syiem ki bym pat shym la sdang ban synshar , hynrei ki ban sa ïoh ka iktiar ban synshar kum ki syiem tang shi kynta bad u mradkhlaw .

translation.en: And she said unto him , My father , if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the  Lord  , do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth  ; forasmuch as the  Lord  hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies , even of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u ,  Lada phi la kular ha U  Trai  , leh ïa nga kumba phi la kular ban leh , naba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ba phin pynhiarkput ïa ki Ammon , ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: Can you lift the box ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban rah ka synduk ?

translation.en: Wherefore , when I came , was there no man ? when I called , was there none to answer ? Is my hand shortened at all , that it cannot redeem ? or have I no power to deliver ? behold , at my rebuke I dry up the sea , I make the rivers a wilderness : their fish stinketh , because there is no water , and dieth for thirst .
translation.kha: Balei ba ki briew jong nga kim jubab haba nga la leit sha ki ban pynim ïa ki ? Balei ba kim phai ktien haba nga la khot ïa ki ? Hato nga tlot eh ban pynim ïa ki ? Nga lah ban pynrngad noh ïa ka duriaw da kaba shu hukum bad pynkylla ïa ki wah sha ka ri shyiap , ba ki dohkha kiba don ha ki kin ïap na ka jingduna um .

translation.en: Persia , Ethiopia , and Libya with them  ; all of them with shield and helmet :
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Persia , Sudan bad na Libya ki don bad u , bad baroh ki don ki stieh bad ki jingda khlieh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as he was praying in a certain place , when he ceased , one of his disciples said unto him , Lord , teach us to pray , as John also taught his disciples .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi U Jisu u dang duwai ha kawei ka jaka . Haba u la dep , uwei na ki synran jong u , u la ong ha u ,  Ko Trai , to hikai ïa ngi ban duwai , kumba u Ïoannis u la hikai ïa ki synran jong u .

translation.en: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt , so my spirit remaineth among you : fear ye not .
translation.kha: Mynba phi la mihnoh na ri Ijipt , nga la kular ba ngan long lem bad phi borabor . Nga dang long lem bad phi , kumta wat sheptieng .

translation.en: And he asked them of their welfare , and said , Is your father well , the old man of whom ye spake ? Is he yet alive ?
translation.kha: U la kylli shaphang ka jingkoit jingkhiah jong ki bad u ong ,  Phi la ïathuh ha nga shaphang i pa jong phi , iba la tymmen — i long kumno ? I dang im , bad i shait i khlaiñ bha ?

translation.en: And when he came to him , behold , he stood by his burnt offering , and the princes of Moab with him . And Balak said unto him , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la leit phai pat bad u la lap ïa u Balak ba u dang ïeng harud ka jingainguh thang jong u lem bad ki nongïalam ka Moab . U Balak u la kylli aïu U  Trai  u la ong ,

translation.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son , whom he hath appointed heir of all things , by whom also he made the worlds  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh u la kren ha ngi lyngba U Khun jong u . U la long uta da uba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uta ïa uba U Blei u la jied ban long u nongïoh kynti ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kaba kut .

translation.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine  ; and ye say , He hath a devil .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan , bad u la shahjingit bad um dih waiñ , bad phi ong , ‘ U don u ksuid hapoh jong u !’

translation.en: For every one that asketh receiveth  ; and he that seeketh findeth  ; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno baroh uba pan un ïohpdiang , bad uno uno uba wad un shem , bad ka jingkhang kan plie ïa uta uba tied .

translation.en: ( Though Jesus himself baptized not , but his disciples , )
translation.kha: ( Ha ka jingshisha , U Jisu da lade um shym la pynbaptis ïano ïano ; tang ki synran jong u ki la leh . )

translation.en: Thou hast avouched the  Lord  this day to be thy God , and to walk in his ways , and to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and to hearken unto his voice :
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi phi la pynbna ba U  Trai  u long U Blei jong phi ; phi la kular ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u , bad ban leh ruh kat ïa kaba u hukum .

translation.en: Son of man , speak to the children of thy people , and say unto them , When I bring the sword upon a land , if the people of the land take a man of their coasts , and set him for their watchman :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew  , u la ong , ïathuh ha ki briew jong me ïa kaei kaba jia haba nga wanrah ïa ka thma ha ka ri . Ki briew ha kata ka ri ki jied ïa uwei napdeng jong ki ban long u nongap .

translation.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall perish .
translation.kha: Ym don uba kren lamler ha ka ïingbishar u ban ïohlait na ka jingpynshitom ; u la shah pynrem .

translation.en: See , I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness , until there come word from you to certify me .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ngan ap ha ka jaka jam ïa ka wah ha ka ri khlaw tad haduh ba ngan da ïoh khubor na phi .

translation.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la phai , u la khmih ïa ki synran jong u , bad u la sneng ïa u Petros .  Khie noh na nga , me u Soitan ,  u la ong .  Ki jingpyrkhat jong me kim shym wan na U Blei hynrei na u briew !

translation.en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty , and continueth therein , he being not a forgetful hearer , but a doer of the work , this man shall be blessed in his deed .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba peit bniah ïa ka hukum bajanai kaba pyllaitluid ïa ki briew , uba ïai pynleit jingmut ïa ka bad ym tang ban sngap ïa ka bad nangta ban klet noh , hynrei u pyntreikam ïa ka — uta u briew un ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks , and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , ki nongwei kin shakri ïa phi , Kin sumar ïa ki jingri jong phi kin lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , bad sumar ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi ,

translation.en: But his wife looked back from behind him , and she became a pillar of salt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka tnga u Lot ka la phai dien bad ka la kylla long u païa mluh .

translation.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said , We ought to obey God rather than men .
translation.kha: U Petros bad kiwei pat ki apostol ki la phai ktien ,  Ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei , ym ïa ki briew .

translation.en: So they feared the  Lord  , and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places , which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki mane ruh ïa U  Trai  bad ki jied napdeng jong ki baroh ki jait briew bapher ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ki jaka mane blei thala bad ban ai jingkñia ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: And when he was cast out , Pharaoh s daughter took him up , and nourished him for her own son .
translation.kha: La sumar ïa u ha ïing haduh lai bnai , bad haba la buh ïa u shabar na ka ïing jong u , ka khun jong u syiem ka la ting khun ïa u bad ka la pynheh pynsan ïa u kum la u jong u khun .

translation.en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses , even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam s transgression , who is the figure of him that was to come .
translation.kha: Hynrei naduh ka por jong u Adam haduh ka por jong u Moses , ka jingïap ka synshar halor u bynriew baroh , wat halor kito ki bym shym la leh pop ha ka rukom kumba u Adam u la leh mynba um shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei . U Adam u la long ka dur jong uta u ban sa wan .

translation.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth , and a twoedged sword in their hand  ;
translation.kha: Ai ba kin pyrta jam katba ki ïaroh ïa U Blei , bad ki waitlam banep ha ki kti jong ki

translation.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold  ;
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ar tylli ïa ki shrong ksiar ,

translation.en: Grace be to you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ïa phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And I saw another sign in heaven , great and marvellous , seven angels having the seven last plagues  ; for in them is filled up the wrath of God .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ha ka suiñbneng ïa kawei pat ka jingïohi kaba maïan , kaba khraw bad kaba iphylla . La don hynñiew ngut ki angel lem bad hynñiew tylli ki khlam , kiba long kiba khatduh , namar ki long ki jingpynpaw kiba khatduh jong ka jingbitar U Blei .

translation.en: And he , as a rotten thing , consumeth , as a garment that is moth eaten .
translation.kha: Kaba mih nangta ka long ba nga khyllem kum ka dieng pyut , kum ka jaiñphong ba la bam khñiang .

translation.en: When thou art come into the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations .
translation.kha: Ynda phi poi ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh kiba ijli jong ki jaitbynriew kiba shong hangta .

translation.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this , and the son of man that layeth hold on it  ; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and keepeth his hand from doing any evil .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba ïai sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad ki bym pyndonkam bakla ïa ka . Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito ki bym leh ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew .

translation.en: And unto this people thou shalt say , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I set before you the way of life , and the way of death .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ban ong ha u paidbah ,  To shahshkor ! Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ai ha phi ka jingjied hapdeng ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingim bad ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down , and he reared up altars for Baalim , and made groves , and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .
translation.kha: U tei pat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala kiba u Hesekaïah u kpa jong u , u la pynjot . U tei ki duwan ban mane ïa u Baal , u thaw ki dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah , bad u mane ïa ki khlur .

translation.en: But above all things , my brethren , swear not , neither by heaven , neither by the earth , neither by any other oath : but let your yea be yea  ; and your nay , nay  ; lest ye fall into condemnation .
translation.kha: Nalor kine baroh , ko parabangeit jong nga , wat pyndonkam da ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai da ka bneng ne da ka khyndew ne da kaei kaei pat . Shu ong  Ho-oid  haba phi mut ho-oid , bad  Em  haba phi mut em , bad phin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .

translation.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat , and he shall yield royal dainties .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew u Asher kan seisoh shibun , Bad un pynmih ki jait jingbam kiba biang wat ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly ; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk un pynlong ïa phi kiba khuid ha ki liang baroh bad un sumar ïa ka longrynïeng jong phi — ka mynsiem , ka jingim , bad ka met — kaba lait na kano kano ka jingbakla ha ka jingwan jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: But it came to pass within a while after , in the time of wheat harvest , that Samson visited his wife with a kid  ; and he said , I will go in to my wife into the chamber . But her father would not suffer him to go in .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Samson u leit jngoh ïa la ka tnga ha ka por ot kew , u da rah ïa ka uwei u khunblang . U ong ïa u kpa jong ka ,  Ngan leit rung sha kamra ka tnga jong nga .  Hynrei um shym shah ba un rung shapoh .

translation.en: And them that are turned back from the  Lord   ; and those that have not sought the  Lord  , nor enquired for him .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa kito kiba la phai lyndet bad ki bym bud shuh ïa nga , kito ki bym shym wan sha nga , lane kylli na nga ban kdew lynti ïa ki .

translation.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little : but godliness is profitable unto all things , having promise of the life that now is , and of that which is to come .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynmlien ïa ka met ka ai katto katne ka jingbha , hynrei ka jingpynmlien ba kynja mynsiem ka pynmyntoi ha ki liang baroh , namar ka kular ïa ka jingim ha ka mynta bad ha ka lawei .

translation.en: The  Lord  spake also unto me again , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren pat ha nga .

translation.en: For this , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not kill , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness , Thou shalt not covet ; and if there be any other commandment , it is briefly comprehended in this saying , namely , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Ki hukum ,  Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat tuh ; wat ikwah ïa kaei kaba dei jong kiwei pat  — ïa kine baroh , bad kino kino kiwei pat , la kynthup lang ha kawei ka hukum ,  Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba ïa lade .

translation.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel  ; and thus and thus have I counselled .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hushai u ïathuh ha u Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh , ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u la ai ha u Absalom bad ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai .

translation.en: Then Rab–shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and spake , saying , Hear the word of the great king , the king of Assyria :
translation.kha: Nangta u rangbah synshar u ïeng joit bad u pyrta ha ka ktien Hebru ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ong ïa phi !

translation.en: He that planted the ear , shall he not hear ? he that formed the eye , shall he not see ?
translation.kha: U Blei u la thaw ïa ki shkor jong ngi — hato un ym ïohsngew ? U la thaw ïa ki khmat jong ngi — hato un ym ïohi ?

translation.en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs , and two clusters of raisins : and when he had eaten , his spirit came again to him : for he had eaten no bread , nor drunk any water , three days and three nights .
translation.kha: ki ai ruh khyndiat ki soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ar rynjup ki soh kismis . Ynda u la dep bam , u la ïohbor biang ; naba um shym la bam la dih ei ei la lai sngi pura .

translation.en: What will be the answer ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka ban dei ka Jubab ?

translation.en: And hath raised us up together , and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Ha U Khrist Jisu , la pynmihpat ïa ngi lem bad u , ba ngin ïoh synshar lem bad u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .

translation.en: By the word of the  Lord  were the heavens made  ; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u thaw ïa ki bneng da ka hukum jong u , ïa ka sngi , u bnai bad ki khlur da ka sur kren jong u .

translation.en: Also regard not your stuff  ; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban khuslai ei ei shaphang la ki jingdon jingem ba ki hap ieh , namar kiba bha tam ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei kin long ki jong ki .

translation.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged  ; and they feared the king : for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him , to do judgment .
translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingrai jong u Solomon , ki la dap da ka jingñiewburom bakhraw ïa u , namar ki tip hangta ba U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingstad ban pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia ha ka hok .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of the men of Anathoth , that seek thy life , saying , Prophesy not in the name of the  Lord  , that thou die not by our hand :
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Anathoth ki la kwah ïa nga ban shah pynïap , bad ki la ong ïa nga ba kin pynïap ïa nga lada nga dang ïai pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity : for vanity shall be his recompence .
translation.kha: Lada u bieit katta katta ban shaniah ha ka jingsniew , te ka jingsniew kan long ka bainong jong u .

translation.en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , to offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , and a meat offering , a sacrifice , and drink offerings , every thing upon his day :
translation.kha: Kine ki long kita ki Jingkhawai Niam ha kiba phi ai burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba ïalumlang ban mane Blei bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , ïa ki jingkñia , bad ïa ki jingainguh dih , man la ka sngi kumba la buh .

translation.en: He ate an apple .
translation.kha: U Bam Ia U Soh Apple .

translation.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn , whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel , both of man and of beast : it is mine .
translation.kha: Pynkyntang ha nga ïa uba la kha nyngkong baroh , namar kat uba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel , la u briew ne u mrad , u long u jong nga .

translation.en: And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them  ; and she shall seek them , but shall not find them : then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband  ; for then was it better with me than now .
translation.kha: Kan leit beh nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka , hynrei kan ym lap ïa ki . Kan wad ïa ki hynrei kan ym shem ïa ki . Te kan sa ong ,  Ngan leit phai noh sha u tnga uba nyngkong jong nga — nga kham bit kham biang myn ha kata ban ïa kaba nga long mynta .

translation.en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things  ;
translation.kha: bad khang ïa phi na kaba leh ïa ka bymdei . Kin sumar ïa phi na ki briew kiba pynkhih jingkulmar da kaei kaba ki kren —

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first : and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables , which thou brakest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba mynshuwa , bad ngan sa thoh ha ki ïa ki ktien kiba la don ha ki mawlyngkniap kiba nyngkong , ïa kiba me la pynpait .

translation.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell ;
translation.kha: Naba ka la long da ka jingrai ka jong U Blei hi ba U Khun u la don ha lade hi ïa ka jinglong ba-pura jong U Blei .

translation.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly : for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlut hynñiew sngi ha kaba pynkyntang ïa ka duwan , bad nangta sa hynñiew sngi ha kaba rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam . Ha ka sngi kaba khatduh ki la pynlong ïa ka jingrakhe pynwai .

translation.en: If I have walked with vanity , or if my foot hath hasted to deceit  ;
translation.kha: Nga smai ba ngam shym la leh kaba bymman ; bad ngam ju pyrshang ban shukor ïa kiwei .

translation.en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Jehoram u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: Thou shalt not see thy brother s ox or his sheep go astray , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt in any case bring them again unto thy brother .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa ka masi lane ïa ka langbrot u para Israel ba ka sakma , wat shu ieh ïa ka ; leit ïalam pat ïa ka sha u .

translation.en: That they shall drive thee from men , and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field , and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen , and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven , and seven times shall pass over thee , till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will .
translation.kha: Yn beh noh ïa phi na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad phin shong phin sah bad ki mradkhlaw . Hynñiew snem phin bam phlang kum u masi dab , bad thiah ha bym don jingkah ei ei , ha kaba ka umjer kan hap halor jong phi . Te phin pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u bat synshar ïa baroh ki hima ki briew , bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .

translation.en: And as some spake of the temple , how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts , he said ,
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran ki dang ïakren shaphang ka Templ , ba katno ka long kaba itynnat lem bad ki maw bajlih jong ka bad ki jingai ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei .

translation.en: Martha saith unto him , I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day .
translation.kha: Nga tip ,  ka la jubab ,  ba un sa mihpat ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

translation.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose : he giveth goodly words .
translation.kha: U Naphtali u long kum ka skei Kaba mareh kat shaba ka mon , kaba kha ïa ki khun kiba itynnat .

translation.en: And he laid his hands upon him , and gave him a charge , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kumba u Trai u la hukum , u Moses u buh ïa la ki kti halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua , bad u la pynbna ba une un long u nongmih bujli jong u .

translation.en: ( There are eleven days  journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh–barnea . )
translation.kha: ( Ka shim por khatwei sngi ban ïaid na u Lum Sinai sha Kadesh Barnea na shaphang ka ri lum Edom . )

translation.en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour , or buyest ought of thy neighbour s hand , ye shall not oppress one another :
translation.kha: Kumta , haba phi ïadie ïathied khyndew para Israel , wat ïashukor paralok hi .

translation.en: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Abijah u khun jong u Syiem Jeroboam u kem pang .

translation.en: And strip Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son : and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people , and shall die there .
translation.kha: bad hangta law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh na u Aaron bad pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . U Aaron un ïap hangta .

translation.en: For the good that I would I do not : but the evil which I would not , that I do .
translation.kha: Ngam leh ïa kaba bha kaba nga kwah ban leh ; pynban , nga leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ngam kwah ban leh .

translation.en: If ye walk in my statutes , and keep my commandments , and do them  ;
translation.kha: Lada phi im kat kum ki aiñ jong nga , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ,

translation.en: That word , I say , ye know , which was published throughout all Judaea , and began from Galilee , after the baptism which John preached  ;
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingjia kaba khraw kaba la jia ha kylleng ka ri Israel , kaba sdang ha Galilaïa hadien ba u Ïoannis u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u shaphang ka jingpynbaptis .

translation.en: But there came a messenger unto Saul , saying , Haste thee , and come  ; for the Philistines have invaded the land .
translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por u nonglamktien u wan poi bad u ong ha u Saul ,  Wan phai noh shisyndon ! Ki Philistia ki la wan hiarthma ïa ka ri !

translation.en: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them  ; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath : their own way have I recompensed upon their heads , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Te ngan theh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ha ki , bad kum ka ding ngan pynjot ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong .

translation.en: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand , but shalt surely be taken , and delivered into his hand  ; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon , and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth , and thou shalt go to Babylon .
translation.kha: Phin ym lait im ; yn kem ïa phi bad yn ai noh ïa phi sha u . Phin ïohi ïa u markhmat bad kren ïa u da lade hi ; te nangta phin leit sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works , and went a whoring with their own inventions .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki jingleh jong ki bad ki la long bymïaineh ha U Blei .

translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God is a consuming fire , even a jealous God .
translation.kha: namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u long kum ka ding kaba bam duh ; um lah shah ba ki Israel kin mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth : so that if a man can number the dust of the earth , then shall thy seed also be numbered .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki baroh ; kan kham jem ban ñiew ïa ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew !

translation.en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly : and shalt thou be delivered ?
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato phi pyrkhat ba phin ïohlait im ?

translation.en: And ye shall seek me , and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart .
translation.kha: Phin wad ïa nga , bad phin shem ïa nga namar ba phin wad ïa nga da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city , and those that fell away , that fell to him , with the rest of the people that remained .
translation.kha: Khatduh u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la ringmraw sha Babilonia ïa ki briew ba dang sah ha ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa u .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Behold , when ye are entered into the city , there shall a man meet you , bearing a pitcher of water  ; follow him into the house where he entereth in .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Katba phi dang leit shapoh ka nongbah , u briew uba kit shi khra ka um un ïashem ïa phi . Bud ïa u shapoh ka ïing ba u rung , bad ong ha u trai jong ka ïing :

translation.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy , and from them that hated me : for they were too strong for me .
