translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun bakhlaiñbor jong nga bad na kito baroh kiba shun ïa nga — Ki long kiba khlaiñbor eh ban ïa nga .

translation.en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha kaba pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  dei ban pynlong ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong .

translation.en: Therefore said I , The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal , and I have not made supplication unto the  Lord  : I forced myself therefore , and offered a burnt offering .
translation.kha: kumta nga la pyrkhat , ‘ Ki Philistia kin wan tur ïaleh ïa nga hangne ha Gilgal , bad ngam shym la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U  Trai .’ Kumta nga sngew ba nga dei ban ai ka jingkñia .

translation.en: And he took a child , and set him in the midst of them : and when he had taken him in his arms , he said unto them ,
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa u khynnah rit bad pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki . U la buh ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,

translation.en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them  ; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone  ; till thy people pass over , O  Lord  , till the people pass over , which thou hast purchased .
translation.kha: Ka jingshyrkhei bad ka jingkhuslai ki wan hap halor jong ki . Ki ïohi ïa ka bor jong me , ko  Trai  , ki ïeng khlem lait kren da ka jingtieng , tad haduh ba ki briew jong me ki la ïaid lait sha shiliang — ki briew kiba me la pyllaitluid na ka jinglongmraw .

translation.en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the  Lord  at Jerusalem , then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord , even unto Rehoboam king of Judah , and they shall kill me , and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah .
translation.kha: U la ong ha lade ,  Kumba kiei kiei ki long mynta , lada ki briew jong nga ki leit sha Jerusalem bad ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  ha ka templ kaba don hangta , kin pynkynriah ka jingnguh syiem na nga sha u Rehoboam u syiem ka Judah bad kin sa pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither : and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na phi da ka jingjia ryngkhat u pynïap ïano ïano , u lah ban leit shata bad lait na uta uba wad kput .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Be not afraid because of them : for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel : thou shalt hough their horses , and burn their chariots with fire .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi ngan pynïap ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki Israel . Phi dei ban pyndkoh ïa ki kulai jong ki bad thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .

translation.en: The archers have sorely grieved him , and shot at him , and hated him :
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong u ki tur ïaleh tyngeh ïa u , Bad ki beh ïa u da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam ;

translation.en: Simon , ( whom he also named Peter , ) and Andrew his brother , James and John , Philip and Bartholomew ,
translation.kha: U Simon ( ïa uba u la ai kyrteng , u Petros ) bad u Andriw u para jong u , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , u Philip bad u Bartholomai ,

translation.en: And oil for the light , and spices for anointing oil , and for the sweet incense ,
translation.kha: ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingiwbih ;

translation.en: And he set all the people , every man having his weapon in his hand , from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple , along by the altar and the temple , by the king round about .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa ki rangbah kiba bat ki waitlam ha baroh ka bynta ba ha khmat jong ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .

translation.en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country , who called his own servants , and delivered unto them his goods .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don u briew u ban sa leit jingleit ; u la khot ïa ki shakri jong u bad u la buh ïa ki ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u .

translation.en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion without , I shall be slain in the streets .
translation.kha: U briew uba alhia u shong hapoh ïing ; u ong ba u sing u lah ban ïoh ïa u lada u mih shabar .

translation.en: For it is written , I will destroy the wisdom of the wise , and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ngan pynjot noh ïa ka jingstad jong kiba stad bad ngan kyntait sharud ïa ka jingshemphang jong ki riewshemphang .

translation.en: Then came Jesus forth , wearing the crown of thorns , and the purple robe . And Pilate saith unto them , Behold the man !
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la mih shabar , da kaba phong ïa ka pansngiat shiah bad kup da ka jaiñkup kaba sawbthuh . U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Khmih ! hangne uta u briew !

translation.en: Howl , ye ships of Tarshish : for your strength is laid waste .
translation.kha: To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ka duriaw-bah ! La pynjot ïa ka nongbah kaba phi shaniah .

translation.en: Hear , O earth : behold , I will bring evil upon this people , even the fruit of their thoughts , because they have not hearkened unto my words , nor to my law , but rejected it .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko pyrthei ! Kum ka jingpynshitom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nga wallam ka jingjot halor kine ki briew , namar ki la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga bad kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki ktien jong nga .

translation.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi , ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh bad la pynkhih ïa ka um .

translation.en: The table , and his staves , and all his vessels , and the shewbread ,
translation.kha: ïa ka miej , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad baroh ki tiar ki tar jong ka ; ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei ;

translation.en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations  ; and then shall the end come .
translation.kha: Bad ïa kane ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima yn ïalap ha kylleng ka pyrthei na ka bynta ka jingsakhi sha ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad nangta kaba kut kan wan .

translation.en: Then he said unto me , Son of man , these bones are the whole house of Israel : behold , they say , Our bones are dried , and our hope is lost : we are cut off for our parts .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , ki briew ka Israel ki long kum kine ki shyieng . Ki ong ba ki la tyrkhong , khlem kano kano ka jingkyrmen bad ym don shuh ka lawei .

translation.en: And they said , Some say that thou art John the Baptist : some , Elias  ; and others , Jeremiah , or one of the prophets .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki ong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong u Jeremaïah lane uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: * ( Revelation 17 :10-13 ) False religion straddles the back of this political beast , attempting to influence its decisions and to control its direction .
translation.kha: ( Jingpynpaw 17 :10-13 ) Ka niam ba bakla ka shong kulai halor une u mrad synshar pyrthei ban pynkohnguh ia la ka rai bad ban pyniaid ia la ka jingialam .

translation.en: Of the sons of Uzziel  ; Michah the first , and Isshiah the second .
translation.kha: U Ussiel , u khun uba saw jong u Kohath , u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Mikah bad u Isshaïah .

translation.en: Yea , in the way of thy judgments , O  Lord  , have we waited for thee  ; the desire of our soul is to thy name , and to the remembrance of thee .
translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka mon jong me bad ngi buh ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me ; me long tang ma me uba ngi kwah .

translation.en: And they caught him , and beat him , and sent him away empty .
translation.kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa uta u mraw , ki la shoh ïa u , bad phah kylla ïa u khlem ai ei ei .

translation.en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son : and when she saw him that he was a goodly child , she hid him three months .
translation.kha: Haba ka ïohi ba u long u khunlung uba bhabriew , ka buhrieh ïa u lai bnai .

translation.en: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh  ; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head .
translation.kha: Ha ka shang kaba halor eh , don bun ki jait jingbam ba la dep shet na ka bynta u syiem , bad ki sim ki la wan bam ïa ki .

translation.en: Behold ye among the heathen , and regard , and wonder marvellously : for I will work a work in your days , which ye will not believe , though it be told you .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha la ki briew ,  To khmih thuh ïa ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong phi , bad phin lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi . Ngan leh ei ei kaba phin ym lah ngeit haba phi ïohsngew shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: And he left off talking with him , and God went up from Abraham .
translation.kha: Ynda U Blei u la dep ïakren bad u Abraham , u iehnoh ïa u .

translation.en: And it shall be our righteousness , if we observe to do all these commandments before the  Lord  our God , as he hath commanded us .
translation.kha: Lada ngi kohnguh hok ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la hukum ïa ngi , u ruh un sngewbha ïa ngi .’

translation.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .
translation.kha: U Asa u syiem ka Judah bad u Baasha u syiem ka Israel ki don ha ka jingïaleh thma borabor katba ki dang don ha ka bor .

translation.en: So I went in and saw  ; and behold every form of creeping things , and abominable beasts , and all the idols of the house of Israel , portrayed upon the wall round about .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la rung shapoh bad nga khmih . Ïa ka kynroh la tap da ki jingdro ïa ki dur bseiñ , bad ïa kiwei pat ki mrad bymkhuid , bad ïa kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba ki Israel ki ïamane .

translation.en: ( She is loud and stubborn  ; her feet abide not in her house :
translation.kha: Ka dei ka briew kaba shlur bad ka bym don jinglehrain , kaba ju ïaid borabor ha ki lynti bah ;

translation.en: And they twain shall be one flesh : so then they are no more twain , but one flesh .
translation.kha: bad baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’ Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei .

translation.en: And Esau said , Behold , I am at the point to die : and what profit shall this birthright do to me ?
translation.kha: U Iso u ong ,  Ka biang hi ! Nga sngew kum ban sa ïap noh ; kita ki hok jong nga kin myntoi aïu pat ïa nga ?

translation.en: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold , and for their lamps of gold , by weight for every candlestick , and for the lamps thereof : and for the candlesticks of silver by weight , both for the candlestick , and also for the lamps thereof , according to the use of every candlestick .
translation.kha: na ka bynta kawei kawei ka sharak bad uwei uwei u diengpynïeng sharak ,

translation.en: And the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Girgashites , and the Jebusites .
translation.kha: ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Girgash , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Ben–hadad king of Syria gathered all his host , and went up , and besieged Samaria .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , u Benhadad u syiem ka Syria u la ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei pyrshah ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka nongbah Samaria .

translation.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall : and , behold , if the scall be not spread in the skin , nor be in sight deeper than the skin  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean : and he shall wash his clothes , and be clean .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u lyngdoh un peit biang ïa kata ka prum , bad lada kam pat pur bad kam kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid . Uta u briew un sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un long uba khuid .

translation.en: And he drank of the wine , and was drunken  ; and he was uncovered within his tent .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la dih khyndiat ka waiñ , u la buaid , u law ïa la ki jaiñ bad u thiah lyngkhuit hapoh la ka ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart , behold , Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder  ; and she went down unto the well , and drew water : and I said unto her , Let me drink , I pray thee .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ngan kut ka jingduwai bajar jar jong nga , ka Rebekka ka la wan bad u khiew um ha ka tyrpeng jong ka bad ka la leit hiar sha kata ka pukri ban tong um . Nga la ong ha ka , ‘ To ai um ba ngan dih .’

translation.en: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God : and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah , u long u khun U Blei ; bad uno uno uba ieit ïa u kpa , u ieit ïa u khun jong u ruh .

translation.en: This Moses whom they refused , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge ? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush .
translation.kha: U Moses u long uta uba la shah kyntait da ki paid Israel . ‘ Uei uba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ ki la kylli . U long ma u , uba U Blei u la phah ban synshar ïa ki briew bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki da ka jingïarap jong u angel uba la mihpaw ha u ha ka bniap kaba mehding .

translation.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name , because ye belong to Christ , verily I say unto you , he shall not lose his reward .
translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba uno uno uba ai ïa phi ka um ban dih namar ba phi long ha ka liang jong nga , un ïoh da shisha ïa la ka bainong .

translation.en: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half was the length of it , and a cubit and a half the breadth of it , and a cubit and a half the height of it :
translation.kha: U Besalel u shna ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang da ka dieng akasia , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: When he had said these words unto them , he abode still in Galilee .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa kane , bad nangta u la sah noh ha Galilaïa .

translation.en: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith s son unto the place of the Nethinims , and of the merchants , over against the gate Miphkad , and to the going up of the corner .
translation.kha: U Malkhijah , u bania , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka ïing ba la pyndonkam da ki nongtrei shynrang ka Templ bad ki nongkhaïi , kaba don hajan ka Khyrdop Miphkad , kaba don hajan ka kamra halor ka dong jong ka kynroh kaba shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi .

translation.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa ki sha U Trai ban kylli ïa u ,  Hato me long uta uba u Ïoannis u la ong u ban sa wan , ne hato ngin khmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?

translation.en: Nor scrip for your journey , neither two coats , neither shoes , nor yet staves : for the workman is worthy of his meat .
translation.kha: wat rah ïa ka pla khrong na ka bynta ka jingleit lane ka sopti bujli lane ka juti bujli lane u diengduh . Ïa u nongtrei dei ban ai ïa kaei kaba u donkam .

translation.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly , and turned me over into the hands of the wicked .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai noh ïa nga ha ki briew kiba sniew .

translation.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings :
translation.kha: To leh ïa kiei kiei baroh khlem da khñium ne khlem ïania ,

translation.en: And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east : and his voice was like a noise of many waters : and the earth shined with his glory .
translation.kha: bad hangta nga la ïohi ba wan na shaphang mihngi ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka jingdon U Blei ki Israel . Ka sur jong U Blei ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , bad ka pyrthei ka phyrnai da ka jingshai ba-thaba .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go , get thee down  ; for thy people , which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt , have corrupted themselves :
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie , leit hiar noh shisyndon , naba ki briew jong me kiba me la ïalam na ka ri Ijipt , ki la ïaleh pop bad ki la kyntait ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan ym shah ïa ki briew ban im junom , ki long kiba dei ban ïap . Nangne sha khmat kin im ym palat ïa ka shispah arphew snem .

translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David , the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth–rehob , and the Syrians of Zobah , twenty thousand footmen , and of king Maacah a thousand men , and of Ish–tob twelve thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki la sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong nongshun ïa u Dabid , kumta ki la phah wai arphew hajar ngut ki shipai Syria na Bethrehob bad na Sobah , khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah na Tob , bad ïa u syiem Maakah lem bad shihajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: And the king loved Esther above all the women , and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins  ; so that he set the royal crown upon her head , and made her queen instead of Vashti .
translation.kha: U syiem la u itynnat ïa ka palat ban ïa kiwei pat ki samla kynthei , bad palat ban ïa kiwei pat , ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehbha bad ka jingsngewieit . U buh ïa ka pansngiat syiem ha ka khlieh jong ka bad pynlong mahadei ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .

translation.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish ; because they received not the love of the truth , that they might be saved .
translation.kha: bad un pyndonkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshukor bymman ha kito ki ban sa jot noh . Kin jot noh namar ba kim pdiang sngewbha bad ieit ïa ka jingshisha khnang ba kin ïoh im .

translation.en: Then the king commanded to call the magicians , and the astrologers , and the sorcerers , and the Chaldeans , for to shew the king his dreams . So they came and stood before the king .
translation.kha: kumta u la phah khot ïa ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongkheiñ ksuid bad ki nongleh byrtong ban ïawan bad batai ïa ka jingphohsniew ha u . Haba ki la ïawan bad ïeng ha khmat u syiem ,

translation.en: The just  Lord  is in the midst thereof  ; he will not do iniquity : every morning doth he bring his judgment to light , he faileth not  ; but the unjust knoweth no shame .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u dang don ha ka nongbah ; u leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad da lei lei ruh em ïa kaei ka bymdei . Man ka step khlem bakla , u wallam ka jinglehhok ha ki briew jong u . Bad pynban hangta ki briew bymhok ki ïai leh bymdei bad kim sngewlehrain .

translation.en: And I beheld , and , lo , in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts , and in the midst of the elders , stood a Lamb as it had been slain , having seven horns and seven eyes , which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot uba ïeng hapdeng ka khet , ïa kaba la ker sawdong da ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki nongsharai balang . U Khunlangbrot u la paw ba u la shah pynïap . U don hynñiew tylli ki reng bad hynñiew tylli ki khmat , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynsiem U Blei ïa kiba la phah sha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And I will make thy windows of agates , and thy gates of carbuncles , and all thy borders of pleasant stones .
translation.kha: Ngan tei ïa ki kut jong pha da ki maw Rubi , ïa ki khyrdop jong pha da ki maw kiba rhem kum ka ding , bad ki kynroh sawdong jong pha da ki mawlynnai .

translation.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent , and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations : spare not , lengthen thy cords , and strengthen thy stakes  ;
translation.kha: Kham pynheh ïa ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba pha shong ; pynjrong ïa ki tyllai bad pynskhem ïa ki snar !

translation.en: And when he was come into his own country , he taught them in their synagogue , insomuch that they were astonished , and said , Whence hath this man this wisdom , and these mighty works ?
translation.kha: bad u la leit phai pat sha la ka shnong . U la hikai ha ka synagog , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh kat kane ka jingstad ?  ki la kylli .  Bad kumno shaphang ki kambah jong u ?

translation.en: The same heard Paul speak : who stedfastly beholding him , and perceiving that he had faith to be healed ,
translation.kha: U la shong hangta bad u la pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong u Paul . U Paul u la ïohi ba u la ngeit bad ba u lah ban ïohkhiah , kumta u la khmih shlip sha u bad u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,

translation.en: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , raise the dead , cast out devils : freely ye have received , freely give .
translation.kha: To pynkhiah ïa kiba pang , to pynim pat ïa kiba ïap , to pynkhiah ïa kito kiba shitom na ki jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad to beh noh ïa ki ksuid . Phi la ïohpdiang ei , kumta to ai ei .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah , which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria , and besieged it .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah — kaba long ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Syiem Hoshea ha Israel — u Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka Samaria .

translation.en: And needed not that any should testify of man : for he knew what was in man .
translation.kha: Ym da donkam mano mano ban ïathuh ha u shaphang jong ki , namar u hi u la tip kaei kaba don ha ka dohnud jong ki .

translation.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .
translation.kha: Haba wanrah kham bun ki jingri , ïa ki jingainguh bynrap dei ban pynbun kat ban ïabiang .

translation.en: That saith of Cyrus , He is my shepherd , and shall perform all my pleasure : even saying to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be built  ; and to the temple , Thy foundation shall be laid .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha u Syros , ‘ Me long uta u ban synshar na ka bynta jong nga ; men leh ïa kaei kaba nga kwah ïa phi ban leh ; men hukum ïa ka Jerusalem ban tei biang bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban seng pat .’

translation.en: But if the  Lord  make a new thing , and the earth open her mouth , and swallow them up , with all that appertain unto them , and they go down quick into the pit  ; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada U  Trai  u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ym pat ju ïohsngew , bad ba ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa ki bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don , ba kumta ki hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , te phin sa tip ba kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon :
translation.kha: Ki Lebi mynta ki long ki jong nga . Mynba nga la pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh jong ki nong Ijipt , nga la pynkyntang kum la u jong ïa u khun nyngkong na kawei pa kawei ka ïing Israel bad ïa uba la kha nyngkong na uwei pa uwei u mrad . Mynta , nga ïoh noh da ki Lebi kum la ki jong ha ka jaka ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel ; ki kin long ki jong nga . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable  ;  A certain man planted a vineyard , and let it forth to husbandmen , and went into a far country for a long time .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki paidbah ïa kane ka pharshi :  La don shisien uwei u briew uba don ka bri sohwaiñ , u la aiwai ha ki nongshimwai , bad nangta u la mihnoh na ïing ban jah kham slem .

translation.en: Saying ,  What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee ?  And he said , Lord , that I may receive my sight .
translation.kha: Kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ?   Ko Kynrad ,  u la jubab ,  nga kwah ban imat pat .

translation.en: The same followed Paul and us , and cried , saying , These men are the servants of the most high God , which shew unto us the way of salvation .
translation.kha: Ka la bud ïa u Paul bad ïa ngi , ka da pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki long ki shakri U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! Ki pynbna ha phi kumno ba yn pynim ïa phi !

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre : and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Abraham harud ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre . Katba u Abraham u dang shong ha ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ jong u ha ka por ba dang shit kyr-ang mynsngi , u la khmied bad u la ïohi lai ngut ki rangbah kiba ïeng hangta .

translation.en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men , as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit ;
translation.kha: Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ïa u khunbynriew ym shym la ïathuh ïa kane ka jingmaïan , hynrei , U Blei u la pynpaw ïa ka mynta da U Mynsiem ha ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u .

translation.en: And Jahzah , and Kedemoth , and Mephaath ,
translation.kha: ka Jahas , ka Kedemoth , ka Mephaath ,

translation.en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me , when Israel went astray , which went astray away from me after their idols  ; they shall even bear their iniquity .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa kito ki Lebi , ryngkat bad ïa kito kiba na ki paid Israel , kiba la iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kata ha ka jingstad bad jingïohi jong u baroh ïa kaei kaba u la thmu , bad u la pynpaw shynna ha ngi ïa ka jingthmu ba la buhrieh ïa kaba u la lah thmu lypa ban pyndep da U Khrist .

translation.en: And our father said , Go again , and buy us a little food .
translation.kha: Nangta i ong ban leit thied jingbam shuh sa khyndiat .

translation.en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs  ; and no man could bind him , no , not with chains :
translation.kha: Ym don shuh uba lah ban teh kynjri ïa u ;

translation.en: Because the  Lord  hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice  ; when her waves do roar like great waters , a noise of their voice is uttered :
translation.kha: Nga pynjot ïa ka Babilon bad nga pynsngap jar ïa ka . Ki kynhun shipai ki tur shapoh kum ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh bad tur ïaleh da ki jingpyrta bajam .

translation.en: And they took two princes of the Midianites , Oreb and Zeeb  ; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb , and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb , and pursued Midian , and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jong ki Midian , u Oreb bad u Seeb ; ki la pynïap ïa u Oreb ha u Mawsiang Oreb bad ïa u Seeb ha ka Thliew khem um sohwaiñ jong u Seeb . Ki bteng ban beh kthong ïa ki Midian bad ki wallam ïa ki khlieh jong u Oreb bad u Seeb sha u Gideon , uba don mynta sha mihngi jong ka Jordan .

translation.en: Go ye therefore into the highways , and as many as ye shall find , bid to the marriage .
translation.kha: Mynta to khie leit sha ki surok bah bad khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki briew katba phi lah ban ïashem .’

translation.en: Say unto them , As truly as I live , saith the  Lord  , as ye have spoken in mine ears , so will I do to you :
translation.kha: Mynta , ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab : ‘ Nga smai ba kumba nga long uba im , ngan leh kumba phi la pan . Nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And now , behold , I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem , not knowing the things that shall befall me there :
translation.kha: Bad mynta , da kaba kohnguh ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ngan leit sha Jerusalem , khlem da tip aïu kan jia ïa nga hangta .

translation.en: Philip , and Bartholomew  ; Thomas , and Matthew the publican  ; James the son of Alphaeus , and Lebbaeus , whose surname was Thaddaeus  ;
translation.kha: u Philip bad u Bartholomai ; u Thomas bad u Matthaïos , u nonglum khajna ; u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos bad u Thaddaïos ;

translation.en: But if any provide not for his own , and specially for those of his own house , he hath denied the faith , and is worse than an infidel .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno um sumar ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , khamtam ïa ki dkhot ka longïing jong u hi , u la len ïa ka jingngeit bad u kham sniew ban ïa u bymngeit .

translation.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , and Beth–hoglah , and the valley of Keziz ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba dei jong ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki long ka Jerikho , ka Beth Hoglah , ka Emek Kesis ,

translation.en: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Rephaïah , u khun jong u Hur , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice , and gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpyrta kaba jam , U Jisu u la ïap .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul , that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .
translation.kha: U Saul bad u Dabid ki la dep ka jingïakren hapdeng jong ki . Hadien kata , u Jonathan u khun jong u Saul u la sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid bad u sngewieit ïa u kumba u ieit ïa lade hi .

translation.en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said , Lord , I knew thee that thou art an hard man , reaping where thou hast not sown , and gathering where thou hast not strawed :
translation.kha: Nangta u shakri uba la ïohpdiang shihajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga tip ba me long u briew uba eh ; me ot ïa ki jingot na kaba mem shym la bet , bad me lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba mem shym la bet symbai .

translation.en: When they went from one nation to another , from one kingdom to another people  ;
translation.kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat .

translation.en: That all of you have conspired against me , and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you that is sorry for me , or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
translation.kha: Hato dei na kata ba phi baroh phi la ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la ïathuh ha nga ba u khun jong nga hi u la ïateh kular bad u Dabid . Ym don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat sngewlem ïa nga lane ïathuh ha nga ba u Dabid , uwei na ki rangbah jong nga , u don hangne mynta , u da wad ïa ka kabu ban pynïap ïa nga , bad ba u khun jong nga u la pynshlur ïa u !

translation.en: Fear thou not  ; for I am with thee : be not dismayed  ; for I am thy God : I will strengthen thee  ; yea , I will help thee  ; yea , I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng — nga long ryngkat bad me ! Nga long U Blei jong me — wat ai ba kano kano kan pynsheptieng ïa me ! Ngan pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ bad ngan ïarap ïa me ; ngan ïada ïa me bad ngan pynim ïa me .

translation.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle , and anointed Solomon . And they blew the trumpet  ; and all the people said , God save king Solomon .
translation.kha: U Sadok u shim ïa ka jingbuh umphniang Olib kaba u la wanrah na ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u la pynsleh ïa u Solomon . Ki la put ïa ka turoi , bad ki paidbah baroh ki pyrta ,  Im slem Syiem Solomon !

translation.en: And the speech pleased the Lord , that Solomon had asked this thing .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la sngewbha ba u Solomon u la pan ïa kane ,

translation.en: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem , Let the house be builded , the place where they offered sacrifices , and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid  ; the height thereof threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof threescore cubits  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka snem banyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u patsha Syros , u la hukum ba ïa ka Templ ha Jerusalem yn tei pat ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh yn thang . Ka Templ ka dei ban long arphew hynñiew mitar ka jingjrong bad arphew hynñiew mitar ka pyngkiang .

translation.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath : but grievous words stir up anger .
translation.kha: Ka jubab kaba jem ka tem ïa ka jingbitar , hynrei kaba khor ka pynkhih bitar .

translation.en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel :
translation.kha: Nga sngewlyngngoh ïa phi ! Tang katto katne por phi la iehnoh ïa uta uba la khot ïa phi da ka jingaiei U Khrist , bad ba phi la pdiang ïa kawei pat ka Gospel .

translation.en: For this cause left I thee in Crete , that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting , and ordain elders in every city , as I had appointed thee :
translation.kha: Nga la iehnoh ïa me ha Krit , khnang ba men buh ryntih ïa kiei kiei kiba dang donkam ban leh bad ban thung ïa ki nongsharai balang ha man la ki shnong . To kynmaw ïa ki jingbthah jong nga :

translation.en: And as for my flock , they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet  ; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki langbrot jong nga ki hap ban bam ïa u phlang ba phi la kyrdem bad dih ïa ka um kaba phi pynjngut .

translation.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba , and called there on the name of the  Lord  , the everlasting God .
translation.kha: Te U Abraham u la thung uwei u dieng Tamarisk ha Beersheba bad u la mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei Bymjukut .

translation.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men  ; and Eliab s anger was kindled against David , and he said , Why camest thou down hither ? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness ? I know thy pride , and the naughtiness of thine heart  ; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle .
translation.kha: U Eliab , u hynmen rangbah u Dabid , u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u ïakren bad kita ki rangbah . U la bitar ïa u Dabid bad u ong ,  Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba sumar ïa kito ki langbrot ki jong me kiba don ha ka ri khlaw ? Ma me , me uba sngewstad ! Me wan tang ban peit kai ïa ka jingïaleh thma !

translation.en: Parthians , and Medes , and Elamites , and the dwellers in Mesopotamia , and in Judaea , and Cappadocia , in Pontus , and Asia ,
translation.kha: Ngi dei na Parthia , na Media , bad na Elam ; na Mesopotamia , na Judia , bad na Kappadokia ; na Pontos bad na Asia ,

translation.en: And Jonadab , the son of Shimeah David s brother , answered and said , Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king s sons  ; for Amnon only is dead : for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jonadab , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , kim shym la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh . Tang u Amnon uba la ïap . Phi lah ban ong da kaba peit ïa u Absalom ba u la kut jingmut skhem ban leh ïa kane naduh ka por ba u Amnon u la batbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u .

translation.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge , said God : and after that shall they come forth , and serve me in this place .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan sa bishar ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ïa kaba kin shakri , bad hadien kata ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin mihnoh na kata ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha kane ka jaka .’

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga .

translation.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word , even in this ; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei la kyllum lang ha kawei ka hukum kaba ong ,  Phin ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade .

translation.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times , and strength of salvation : the fear of the  Lord  is his treasure .
translation.kha: U ïada borabor ïa la ki briew bad u ai ïa ki ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Ka jingkynshew spah bakhraw tam jong ki ka long ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt , and where thieves do not break through nor steal :
translation.kha: Hynrei , to kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade ha bneng , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang kim lah ban pynjot , bad ki nongtuh kim lah ban prong bad tuh .

translation.en: These have one mind , and shall give their power and strength unto the beast .
translation.kha: Kine baroh shiphew ngut ki don kajuh ka jingthmu , bad ki ai ïa ka bor bad ka iktiar jong ki ha u mradkhlaw .

translation.en: By the word of truth , by the power of God , by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left ,
translation.kha: Ngi don ïa ka hok kum ka atiar jong ngi , ïa ka ban ïaleh bad ban ïada ïa lade ruh .

translation.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest , and thou shalt put them in the ark .
translation.kha: Wan kiew sha nga ha uta u lum , bad ngan thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kito ki ktien kiba nga la thoh ha ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba me la lynthaw , bad nangta men buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk .’

translation.en: Not because we have not power , but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh ïa kane , ym namar ba ngim don ka hok ban dawa jingkyrshan ïa ngi ; ngi la leh ïa ka , ban long ka nuksa na ka bynta jong phi ban bud .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they fell upon their faces : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki kynriah noh na uta u paidbah bad ki la ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Ki dem khrup ha khyndew , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka la paw ha ki .

translation.en: They have blown the trumpet , even to make all ready  ; but none goeth to the battle : for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .
translation.kha: Ka turoi ka riew bad baroh ki la pynkhreh . Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha ka thma , naba ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka long halor baroh kumjuh .

translation.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman , neither the woman without the man , in the Lord .
translation.kha: Pynban ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Trai , u briew u long uba donkam ïa ka briew kumba ka briew ka long kaba donkam ïa u briew .

translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  is my rock , and my fortress , and my deliverer  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada jong nga , u long ka kut baskhem jong nga .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord  ; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u , bad u nonglamktien um long kham khraw ban ïa uta uba la phah ïa u .

translation.en: Thus I was  ; in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night  ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Bunsien nga shahshitom na ka jingshit mynsngi bad na ka jingkhriat mynmiet . Ngam ju ïohthiah satia .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Behold , the people is one , and they have all one language  ; and this they begin to do : and now nothing will be restrained from them , which they have imagined to do .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Mynta te , kine baroh ki la long uwei u paid bynriew bad ki ïakren kawei ka ktien ; kane ka dei tang ka jingsdang jong kaei kaba kin sa leh . Shen shen kin lah ban leh ïa kano kano kat kaba ki thmu !

translation.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Isaïah u khun jong u Amos shaphang ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem :

translation.en: And he enquired of the  Lord  for him , and gave him victuals , and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine .
translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u la kylli na U  Trai  ïa kaei ba u Dabid u dei ban leh , bad nangta u la ai katto katne ka jingbam ha u Dabid bad ïa ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Philistia .

translation.en: And the third angel sounded , and there fell a great star from heaven , burning as it were a lamp , and it fell upon the third part of the rivers , and upon the fountains of waters  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba lai u la put ïa la ka turoi . U khlur uba heh , uba meh kum ka dongmusa , u la hap na sahit bneng bad u la hap halor ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki wah bad halor ki pukri um .

translation.en: We remember the fish , which we did eat in Egypt freely  ; the cucumbers , and the melons , and the leeks , and the onions , and the garlick :
translation.kha: Ha Ijipt ngi ju ïabam ki dohkha baroh kiba ngi kwah , bad ngim siew ei ei . Kynmaw ïa ki sohkhia , ki pathaw bam-im , ki jyllang , ki piat , bad ki rynsun ba ngi ju ïoh ban bam ?

translation.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land , wasting nor destruction within thy borders  ; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation , and thy gates Praise .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingleh thombor yn ym ïohsngew shuh , ka jingjot kan ym don shuh hapoh ki pud jong pha ; ngan ïada bad kyrshan ïa pha kum ka kynroh : Phan ïaroh ïa nga namar nga la pyllait ïa pha .

translation.en: And they took it on that day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day , according to all that he had done to Lachish .
translation.kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hangta , kumba ki la leh ha Lakhish .

translation.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle s son , and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase , before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison .
translation.kha: bad nga la ai ïa ki ha u Barukh , u khun jong u Neraïah bad u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Nga la ai ïa ki ha u ha ka jingïadon lang u Hanamel bad ki sakhi kiba la soi ïa ka dulir thied jaka bad ki rangbah kiba ïashong ha ka phyllaw .

translation.en: Apply thine heart unto instruction , and thine ears to the words of knowledge .
translation.kha: To shahshkor bha ïa u nonghikai jong phi bad pynleit jingmut ïa baroh katba phi lah .

translation.en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta ïa ka longïing kaba don san ngut yn phiah , ki lai ngut pyrshah ïa ki ar ngut bad ki ar ngut pyrshah ïa ki lai ngut .

translation.en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel  ; and they seemed unto him but a few days , for the love he had to her .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la trei hynñiew snem ba u lah ban ïoh ïa ka Rakhel , bad kata ka por ka i kum khyndiat tylli ki sngi ïa u , namar u la ieit ïa ka .

translation.en: Not rendering evil for evil , or railing for railing : but contrariwise blessing  ; knowing that ye are thereunto called , that ye should inherit a blessing .
translation.kha: Wat siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew lane ïa ka jingtim da ka jingtim ; pynban , to siew kylliang da ka jingkyrkhu , namar ka jingkyrkhu ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa phi mynba u la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens  ; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth : he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um halor ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut ka khyndew . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra jingkynshew jong u .

translation.en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory , much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory .
translation.kha: Ka rukom pynïaid kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ka la long kaba donburom ; kaba katno tam kaba kham donburom kata ka jingtrei kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynim!

translation.en: Divers weights , and divers measures , both of them are alike abomination to the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad mawthew bymhok .

translation.en: And when they went from nation to nation , and from one kingdom to another people  ;
translation.kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat .

translation.en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved , we have a building of God , an house not made with hands , eternal in the heavens .
translation.kha: Naba ngi tip ba haba kane ka ïingjaiñ kaba ngi shong — ka met jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei — ka la jot noh , U Blei un buh ha bneng ïa ka ïing na ka bynta jong ngi ba ngin shong , ka ïing kaba ma u hi u la thaw , ka ban neh junom la junom .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him : and I prayed for Aaron also the same time .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa u Aaron ruh kat ban pynïap ïa u ; kumta ha kajuh ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong u ruh .

translation.en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtoreth : and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth–shan .
translation.kha: Nangta ki buh ïa ki tiar ïapom jong u ha ka ïing mane jong ka blei Astarte , bad ki sahnar ïa ka met jong u ha ka kynroh jong ka nongbah Beth Shan .

translation.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God , and the heritage of oppressors , which they shall receive of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kumno U Blei Badonbor Baroh u pynshitom ïa ki bymman , ki briew kiba lehbor .

translation.en: And while they yet believed not for joy , and wondered , he said unto them ,  Have ye here any meat ?
translation.kha: Kim pat lah hi ban ngeit , ki la shlei da ka jingkmen bad ka jingphylla ; kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Phi don ei ei hangne ban bam ?

translation.en: But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;
translation.kha: Namar ba phi long ki briew jong U Blei , kam long kaba dei wat ban ïakren hapdeng jong phi ïa kino kino ki kam awria ne ki kam jakhlia ne ki kam kwah lalot .

translation.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled , which he spake , Lord , who hath believed our report ? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed ?
translation.kha: A Trai , uno uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ? Hano ba U Trai u pynpaw ïa ka bor jong u ?

translation.en: This day will the  Lord  deliver thee into mine hand  ; and I will smite thee , and take thine head from thee  ; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air , and to the wild beasts of the earth  ; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel .
translation.kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi U  Trai  un aiti ïa me hapoh ka bor jong nga ; ngan pynkyllon ïa me bad ngan khrai ïa ka khlieh jong me . Bad ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki shipai Philistia ha ki sim bad ha ki mrad ba kin bam .

translation.en: And come to the king , and speak on this manner unto him . So Joab put the words in her mouth .
translation.kha: Nangta leit sha u syiem bad ong ha u ïa kaei kaba nga bthah ïa phi ban ong .  Nangta u Joab u la ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei ban ong .

translation.en: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired  ; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , hynrei ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka shnong ki kyntait ban leh ïa ki kam trei kti ba la aiti ha ki da ki nongpynïaidkam .

translation.en: For I have given you an example , that ye should do as I have done to you .
translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ka nuksa ïa phi , ba phin leh kumba nga la leh ma nga ïa phi .

translation.en: All the days of the afflicted are evil : but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong kiba duk ka don ha ka jingïaleh borabor , hynrei ki briew kiba kmen ki suk mynsiem ha ka jingim borabor .

translation.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death : but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep .
translation.kha: U Jisu u mut ban ong ba u Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei ki la pyrkhat ba u mut ba u shu ïohthiah .

translation.en: And the damsel was very fair , and cherished the king , and ministered to him : but the king knew her not .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba bhabriew shibun , ka la ap ïa u syiem bad ka la sumar ïa u , hynrei um shym la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .

translation.en: And they met Moses and Aaron , who stood in the way , as they came forth from Pharaoh :
translation.kha: Haba ki dang mihnoh , ki ïakynduh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba ap ïa ki .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem : and he went out again through the people from Beer–sheba to mount Ephraim , and brought them back unto the  Lord  God of their fathers .
translation.kha: Wat la u syiem Jehoshaphat u shong u sah ha Jerusalem , u leit borabor sha ki briew , na Beersheba shaphang shathie shaduh kaba kut jong ka ri lum Ephraim shaphang shatei , khnang ban khot pat ïa ki briew sha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way ? and do ye not know their tokens ,
translation.kha: Hato phim pat shym la ïakren bad ki briew kiba leit jingleit ? Hato phim tip ïa ki jingïathuh ba ki wanrah ?

translation.en: There shall not an hand touch it , but he shall surely be stoned , or shot through  ; whether it be beast or man , it shall not live : when the trumpet soundeth long , they shall come up to the mount .
translation.kha: dei ban shu lynthem ïa u da u maw , ne ban siat ïap ïa u da ki khnam , khlem da ktah kti mano mano ïa u . Kane ka treikam ïa ki briew bad ki mrad ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki . Hynrei haba la put ïa ka turoi , te ki briew kin sa leit kiew sha u lum .

translation.en: Bear ye one another s burdens , and so fulfil the law of Christ .
translation.kha: Ïakit markylliang ïa ki jingkit , bad ha kane ka rukom phin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Khrist .

translation.en: And so terrible was the sight , that Moses said , I exceedingly fear and quake : )
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la ïohi ka long kaba sngewtriem katta katta ba u Moses u la ong ,  Nga la khynñiuh bad nga la sheptieng !

translation.en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee , of all flesh , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth  ; that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply upon the earth .
translation.kha: Shim bad me ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mrad , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaroi bad saphriang kylleng ka khyndew .

translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil against thee .
translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka dei kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ban lamler ïa phi . Hynrei u hi da lade u la dep rai ba phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingshyrkhei !

translation.en: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom , and possess the kingdom for ever , even for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem bad ban bat ïa ka junom la junom .

translation.en: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , throughout thy tribes : and they shall judge the people with just judgment .
translation.kha: Thung ïa ki nongbishar bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ha man la ka shnong ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi . Kine kin bishar hok ïa ki briew .

translation.en: And after him arose Jair , a Gileadite , and judged Israel twenty and two years .
translation.kha: Hadien u Tola , la wan u Jair uba na Gilead . U la ïalam ïa ki Israel haduh arphew ar snem .

translation.en: And when they had mocked him , they took off the purple from him , and put his own clothes on him , and led him out to crucify him .
translation.kha: Haba ki la dep na kaba rkhiebeiñ ïa u , ki la law noh ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh bad ki la pynkup pat halor jong u da ki jaiñ jong u hi . Nangta ki ïalam noh ïa u ban sahnarphna .

translation.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes : but the  Lord  pondereth the hearts .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban tharai ba baroh kat kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei kynmaw ba U  Trai  u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi .

translation.en: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said ,  Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ,  Balei phi ïa-pyrkhat ïa kine kiei kiei kiba sniew ?

translation.en: Is not this David , of whom they sang one to another in dances , saying , Saul slew his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?
translation.kha: Nalorkata , une um dei u Dabid , uta uba ki kynthei ki ïaphawar katba ki dang ïashad , ‘ U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , hynrei u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar ?’

translation.en: And if ye be Christ s , then are ye Abraham s seed , and heirs according to the promise .
translation.kha: Lada phi dei ki jong U Khrist , te , phi long ki nonghiarpateng u Abraham bad phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: I know his wrath , saith the  Lord   ; but it shall not be so  ; his lies shall not so effect it .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga tip ïa ka jinglehmeng jong ki . Ki jingkob jong ki kim long ei ei ruh , bad kiei kiei kiba ki leh kin ym neh .

translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) Yes , “the world is passing away . . .  , but he that does the will of God remains forever .” —1 John 2 :17 .
translation.kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hooid , “kata ka pyrthei kan iaid jah noh . . .  , hynrei uta uba leh ka mon jong u Blei u iaisah bymjukut .” —1 Ioannis 2 :17 .

translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies , and on them that hate thee , which persecuted thee .
translation.kha: Un pynngat kylla ïa kine ki jingtim baroh ha ki nongshun jong phi , kiba isih bad banbeiñ ïa phi ,

translation.en: And they have turned unto me the back , and not the face : though I taught them , rising up early and teaching them , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction .
translation.kha: Ki la phai dien na nga ; bad wat la nga la ïai hikai ïa ki , kim shahshkor bad ïoh jinghikai .

translation.en: The servant therefore fell down , and worshipped him , saying , Lord , have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
translation.kha: U shakri u la dem khrup ha ki khohsiew ha khmat u Syiem . ‘ To ïaishah bad nga ,’ u la kyrpad , ‘ bad ngan siew ïa phi ïa kaei kaei baroh !’

translation.en: But be ye doers of the word , and not hearers only , deceiving your own selves .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa lade tang da kaba sngap ïa ka ktien jong u ; pynban , to pyntreikam ïa ka .

translation.en: How long wilt thou speak these things ? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind ?
translation.kha: Hato me la dep ka jingkren jong me kaba kum ka lyer ?

translation.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left : remove thy foot from evil .
translation.kha: Kiar na kaba sniew bad ïaid beit sha khmat . Wat jam palat na ka lynti kaba dei .

translation.en: So likewise ye , except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood , how shall it be known what is spoken ? for ye shall speak into the air .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , kumno uno uno u lah ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba phi kren lada ka khubor jong phi ha ki thylliej bapher kam long kaba shai ? Ki ktien jong phi kin jah noh ha suiñ!

translation.en: Let me pass through thy land : we will not turn into the fields , or into the vineyards  ; we will not drink of the waters of the well : but we will go along by the king s high way , until we be past thy borders .
translation.kha: Shah ngin ïaid na ka ri jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri ngin ym leit sakma na ka lynti lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi ; bad ngin ym dih um na ki pukri jong phi ; ngin ïaid beit na lynti bah haduh ba ngin da lait na ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: Even so have these also now not believed , that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , namar ka jingisynei kaba phi la ïohpdiang , ki Jiw mynta kim kohnguh ïa U Blei , khnang ba ma ki ruh mynta kin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei U Blei .

translation.en: And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour : and Solomon his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap ha ka rta kaba la tymmen bha , uba la dap kyrhai da ka spah bad ka burom ; bad u Solomon u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one , and bringest me into judgment with thee ?
translation.kha: Hato men ym khmih ïa nga , A Blei , lane buh ïa nga ha ka jingbishar bad jingtian bishar ?

translation.en: For , behold , I will shake mine hand upon them , and they shall be a spoil to their servants : and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  da lade hi un ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn sa lute da ki briew kiba shisien ki la long ki shakri jong phi .  Haba kane ka jia , uwei uwei baroh un tip ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Male and female created he them  ; and blessed them , and called their name Adam , in the day when they were created .
translation.kha: Shynrang bad kynthei u la thaw ïa ki , U la kyrkhu ïa ki , bad u la kyrteng ïa ki ,  Ki Briew . )

translation.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death : nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul : and the  Lord  repented that he had made Saul king over Israel .
translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u dang im , um shym ïohi shuh ïa u syiem ; hynrei u khuslai sat na ka bynta jong u . U  Trai  u la sngewsih ba u la thung ïa u Saul kum u syiem ki Israel .

translation.en: And they came in , and possessed it  ; but they obeyed not thy voice , neither walked in thy law  ; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do : therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them :
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ki la wan sha kane ka ri bad shimti ïa ka , kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me lane im kat kum ka jinghikai jong me ; kim shym la leh ïa kaba me la hukum ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta me la wallam ïa kane ka jingpynjot baroh ha ki .

translation.en: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Jakob , u khun jong u Isaak , u khun jong u Abraham , u khun jong u Terah , u khun jong u Nahor ,

translation.en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority , which the Lord hath given us for edification , and not for your destruction , I should not be ashamed :
translation.kha: Naba ngam sngewlehrain , wat lada nga la sngewsarong lehse palat shaphang ka bor kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi — ka bor ban tei ïa phi , ym ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn .
translation.kha: Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba phi pyndonkam ïa u ha kaba shoh kew .

translation.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf , and had an impediment in his speech  ; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ha u ïa u briew uba kyllut bad u bymnang kren , bad ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban buh ïa ki kti jong U halor jong u .

translation.en: And if he be poor , and cannot get so much  ; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved , to make an atonement for him , and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering , and a log of oil  ;
translation.kha: Lada uta u briew u long uba duk bad um kotbor haduh katta , un wallam na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid tang uwei u khunlangbrot kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat , kaba long ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai  na ka bynta u lyngdoh . Un wanrah ruh tang shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh bam bad sa kumba shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka umphniang Olib .

translation.en: Where did you come from ?
translation.kha: Naei phi wan ?

translation.en: The changeable suits of apparel , and the mantles , and the wimples , and the crisping pins ,
translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñ babha jong ki , ki jaiñ jynsur , ki jaiñkup bad ki pla kynsit ;

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he made mention of the ark of God , that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate , and his neck brake , and he died : for he was an old man , and heavy . And he had judged Israel forty years .
translation.kha: Haba uta u rangbah u ïathuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u Eli u kyllon da lyndang na la ka jaka shong kaba harud khyrdop . U la tymmen palat bad sngaid bad kata ka jinghap ka la pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong u , bad u la ïap . U la long u nongïalam ha Israel sawphew snem .

translation.en: Huz his firstborn , and Buz his brother , and Kemuel the father of Aram ,
translation.kha: u Us uba nyngkong , u Bus u para jong u , u Kemuel u kpa jong u Aram ,

translation.en: My son , fear thou the  Lord  and the king : and meddle not with them that are given to change :
translation.kha: Ko khun , tiengburom ïa U  Trai  bad burom ïa u syiem . Wat leh ei ei bad ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ;

translation.en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out , being hastened and pressed on by the king s commandment . And the decree was given at Shushan the palace .
translation.kha: Ha ka jinghukum u syiem , ki nongshong kulai ki kiew ha ki kulai syiem bad ki pynmareh ha ka jingstet bajur . Ïa ka hukum la pynbna paidbah ruh ha Susa , ka nongbah ka hima .

translation.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  will surely deliver us : this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Bad wat ai ïa u ban pynngeit ïa phi ban shaniah ha U  Trai . Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi bad ba un pynsangeh ïa ki shipai Assyria na kaba knieh noh ïa ka nongbah jong phi .

translation.en: And Hazael said , Why weepeth my lord ? And he answered , Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel : their strong holds wilt thou set on fire , and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword , and wilt dash their children , and rip up their women with child .
translation.kha: Balei kynrad phi ïam ?  u Hasael u kylli . U Elisha u jubab ,  Namar ba nga tip ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba men leh pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel .   Men sa wiang ding ïa ki kut jong ki , men sa pynïap ïa ki rangsamla bakynsai jong ki , men sa lynthaw ïa ki khun rit jong ki ha ban da ïap , bad men sa patar ïa ki kynthei jong ki kiba armet .

translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day , and wilt serve them , and answer them , and speak good words to them , then they will be thy servants for ever .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Lada phi kwah ban shakri bha ïa kine ki briew , ai ïa ka jubab kaba biang ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki , bad kin ïai shakri hok ïa phi .

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? yea , I say unto you , and more than a prophet .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi ïa uba kham palat ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar  ; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: bad un synreit khyndiat ïa ka snam jong ka ha ka krung jong ka duwan . Ïa ka snam kaba dang sah yn pjiar ha trai ka duwan . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ban map ïa ka pop .

translation.en: I say , sayest thou , ( but they are but vain words ) I have counsel and strength for war : now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?
translation.kha: U la dawa  Hato phi tharai ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit bad ka borbah ki shipai ? Mano phi tharai u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Assyria ?

translation.en: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof .
translation.kha: uwei ha kawei ka tduh bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka jingtap , bad pynlong ïa ki ba kin i kumba ki ïadait lang bad kata ka jingtap .

translation.en: And out of one of them came forth a little horn , which waxed exceeding great , toward the south , and toward the east , and toward the pleasant land .
translation.kha: Na kawei na kine ki saw tylli ki reng la mih kawei ka reng barit , kaba ka bor jong ka , ka ïar shaphang shathie bad sha mihngi bad sha ka Ri ka Jingkular .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah , that he came down with an ephod in his hand .
translation.kha: Mynba u Abiathar u khun jong u Ahimelekh u la lait phet bad leit ïasoh bad u Dabid ha Keilah , u la rah ïa ka ephod lem bad u .

translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king s house  ;
translation.kha: U la pyn-i ha ki ïa u Joash u khun jong u syiem Ahasaïah bad u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum harum :  Haba phi wan trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton , shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi phin ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem ;

translation.en: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said , This fellow doth not cast out devils , but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils .
translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la jubab ,  U la beh noh ïa ki ksuid tang namar ba u rangbah jong ki , u Beelsebul u ai bor ïa u ban leh kumta .

translation.en: And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kiew halor ka lieng , uta u briew uba shongksuid u la kyrpad ïa u ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit bad me !

translation.en: I speak not by commandment , but by occasion of the forwardness of others , and to prove the sincerity of your love .
translation.kha: Ngam buh ïa kino kino ki aiñ . Hynrei da kaba pyn-i kumno kiwei ki kloi ban ïarap , nga pyrshang ban wad katno ka jingieit jong phi hi ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way ,
translation.kha: hynrei , u la ïaid lyngba napdeng jong u paidbah bad u la leit ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , There be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don katto katne hangne ki ban ym ïap tad haduh ba kin da ïohi ba U Khun U Briew u wan kum u Syiem .

translation.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity , because they have no knowledge : and their honourable men are famished , and their multitude dried up with thirst .
translation.kha: kumta ïa phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ki nongïalam jong phi kin shahthngan haduh ban ïap , bad ki riewpaidbah kin ïap thynrang .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when Pharaoh shall call you , and shall say , What is your occupation ?
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u khot ïa phi bad u kylli phi ïatrei ïaktah aïu ,

translation.en: He entered the bank disguised as a guard .
translation.kha: U rung ha bank da kaba riam kum u nongap .

translation.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .
translation.kha: Nabynta kaei nga ruh nga jynjar kumne baroh , Hynrei nga dap da ka jingsngewskhem , namar nga tip hano nga la shaniah , bad nga sngewthikna ba u lah ban sumar skhem haduh kata ka Sngi ïa kaei kaba u la aiti ha nga .

translation.en: For thy waste and thy desolate places , and the land of thy destruction , shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants , and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ri jong pha la pynjot bad la iehnoh kynjah — hynrei mynta kan rit eh na ka bynta kito ki ban wan ban shong hangta . Bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa pha ha ka jingjot yn pynkynriah jngai na pha .

translation.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened , and the stars shall withdraw their shining .
translation.kha: Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim tyngshaiñ shuh .

translation.en: But lift thou up thy rod , and stretch out thine hand over the sea , and divide it : and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea .
translation.kha: Rah ïa la u diengduh bad bat ïa u halor ka duriaw . Ka um kan sa kad arliang , bad ki Israel kin lah ban ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka duriaw halor ka khyndew kaba rkhiang .

translation.en: And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .
translation.kha: Wat bamsap , naba kaba bamsap ka pynmatlah ïa ki briew ban ym ïohi shuh ïa kata kaba dei , bad ka pynduh ïa ka nia jong kiba lui lui .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; It shall yet come to pass , that there shall come people , and the inhabitants of many cities :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ka por ka poi haba ki briew na ki nongbah babun kin wan sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and his sockets , and the hanging for the court gate , his cords , and his pins , and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle , for the tent of the congregation ,
translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka ; ïa ka pyrda ïa ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka ; ïa ki snar jong ka Ïingjaiñ ; ïa ki tiar baroh kiba pyndonkam ha ka Ïingjaiñ ;

translation.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa une u shakri bymmyntoi — bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum ; hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’

translation.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the  Lord  thy God , and into his oath , which the  Lord  thy God maketh with thee this day :
translation.kha: ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka jutang kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynlong bad phi bad ban pdiang ïa ki ktien ba la thoh ha ka ,

translation.en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities : for we know not what we should pray for as we ought : but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ruh U Mynsiem u wan ban ïarap ïa ngi , ha ka jingtlot kaba ngi don . Naba ngim tip kumno ngi dei ban duwai ; U Mynsiem hi da lade u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi ha ki jingud kiba ki ktien kim lah ban pynpaw .

translation.en: And as he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom , and said unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose and followed him .
translation.kha: Katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , u Lebi u khun jong u Alphaïos , ba u shong ha ka jaka treikam jong u . U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Bud ïa nga .  U Lebi u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .

translation.en: And he dreamed yet another dream , and told it his brethren , and said , Behold , I have dreamed a dream more  ; and , behold , the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , bad u la ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang .  Nga la phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur khatwei tylli ba ki ïanguh ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain , vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold . And the  Lord  set a mark upon Cain , lest any finding him should kill him .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u jubab ,  Em . Lada uno uno ruh u pynïap ïa me , yn sa pynïap hynñiew ki mynsiem ha ka jingpynhiarkput .  Kumta U  Trai  u buh ka dak ha u Kain ban maham ïano ïano ba ïashem ïa u ban ym pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And the woman said unto him , Behold , thou knowest what Saul hath done , how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land : wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life , to cause me to die ?
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka jubab ,  Da shisha , phi tip aïu u syiem Saul u la leh , kumno u la beh ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong na Israel . Te balei phi riam ïa nga bad ba ngan shah pynïap ?

translation.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse : he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewbha jong u kam long ha ki kulai bakhlaiñ ; lymne ka jingkmen jong u ha ki shipai bashlur ;

translation.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears : we would know therefore what these things mean .
translation.kha: Katto katne kiei kiei kiba ngi ïohsngew ba me kren ki long kiba sngewphylla ïa ngi , bad ngi kwah ban tip aïu ki kit jingmut .

translation.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher , and an apostle , and a teacher of the Gentiles .
translation.kha: U Blei u la thung ïa nga kum u apostol bad u nonghikai ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad dei na kane ka daw ba nga shahshitom ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: And he shall take the two goats , and present them before the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta un shim ar tylli ki blang sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
translation.kha: Haba la pyndep ïa ka jingbishar hok , ki briew kiba bha ki kmen , hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki sngewsih .

translation.en: And king David said , Call me Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada . And they came before the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid phah khot ïa u Sadok , u Nathan , bad u Benaïah . Haba ki la rung shapoh ,

translation.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet , which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day s journey .
translation.kha: Nangta ki apostol ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem na u lum ki Olib , uba jngai kumba shi kilomitar na ka nongbah .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka por kan poi haba ngan pyndep ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong bad ki paid Israel bad Judah .

translation.en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness , but is in danger of eternal damnation :
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ong kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map lano lano ruh , namar u la leh ïa ka pop bymjukut .

translation.en: So she went from him , and shut the door upon her and upon her sons , who brought the vessels to her  ; and she poured out .
translation.kha: Kumta ka kynthei ka la leit sha la ïing lem bad la ki khun shynrang , ka la khang ïa ka jingkhang , ka la shim ïa u khra umphniang Olib uba rit , bad ka la phylliew umphniang ha ki khra kiba ki khun shynrang jong ka ki la wallam .

translation.en: For there are some eunuchs , which were so born from their mother s womb : and there are some eunuchs , which were made eunuchs of men : and there be eunuchs , which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven s sake . He that is able to receive it , let him receive it .
translation.kha: Naba don shibun ki daw baïapher balei ba ki briew kim lah ban shongkurim : katto katne , namar ba la kha ïa ki kumta ; kiwei pat , namar ba ki briew ki pynlong ïa ki kumta ; bad kiwei pat kim shongkurim na ka bynta ka Hima ki bneng . Ai ba uta uba lah ban pdiang ïa kane ka jinghikai un leh kumta .

translation.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens : and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy for to come to him with all speed , they departed .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba la ïalam ïa u Paul ki la ïaleit bad u haduh Athens bad nangta ki la wan phai sha Beria lem bad ki jingbthah na u Paul ba u Silas bad u Timothi ki dei ban leit sha u kloi katba lah .

translation.en: Be strong and courageous , be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria , nor for all the multitude that is with him : for there be more with us than with him :
translation.kha: U ong ha ki ,  To long kiba kut jingmut bad kiba sngewskhem , bad wat sheptieng ïa u patsha ki nong Assyria lane ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba u ïalam . Ngi don kham bun ka bor ha ka liang jong ngi ban ïa kaba u don ha ka liang jong u .

translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals to a bullock , and two tenth deals to one ram ,
translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,

translation.en: And David came to Saul , and stood before him : and he loved him greatly  ; and he became his armourbearer .
translation.kha: U Dabid u wan sha u Saul bad u rung kam noh bad u . U Saul u sngewbha eh ïa u bad u jied ïa u kum u nongrah atiar jong u .

translation.en: I called upon thy name , O  Lord  , out of the low dungeon .
translation.kha: Na trai jong ka thliew , Ko  Trai  , nga la kyang jam sha me ,

translation.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob , Come near , I pray thee , that I may feel thee , my son , whether thou be my very son Esau or not .
translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Sngewbha wan kham hajan , ba ngan da ïohktah ïa phi . Hato phi dei shisha u Iso ?

translation.en: The voice said , Cry . And he said , What shall I cry ? All flesh is grass , and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field :
