translation.kha: Ka sur ka pyrta jam ,  To pynbna ïa ka khubor !   Ka khubor aïu ngan pynbna ?  nga kylli .  To pynbna ba ki briew baroh ki long kum u phlang ; kin ym neh skhem ban ïa ki syntiew khlaw .

translation.en: For the king knoweth of these things , before whom also I speak freely : for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him  ; for this thing was not done in a corner .
translation.kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga lah ban kren ha me da ka jingshlur , namar ba me tip ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga sngewskhem ba me la bat bha ïa kawei pa kawei na ki , naba kane kaei kaei kam shym jia ha kaba rieh ha kyndong .

translation.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest , who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the  Lord  : at his word shall they go out , and at his word they shall come in , both he , and all the children of Israel with him , even all the congregation .
translation.kha: Un hap shaniah ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh , ban wad ïa ka mon jong nga da kaba pyndonkam ïa u Urim bad u Thummim   . Da kumne u Eleasar un kdew ïa u Joshua bad u paid Israel ha ki kam jong ki baroh .

translation.en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the  Lord  , make straight in the desert a highway for our God .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka pyrta jam ,  To pynkhreh ha ka ri khlaw ïa ka lynti na ka bynta U  Trai  ! To pynkhuid ïa ka lynti ha ka ri shyiap na ka bynta U Blei jong ngi !

translation.en: Son of man , say unto her , Thou art the land that is not cleansed , nor rained upon in the day of indignation .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa ki Israel ba ka ri jong ki kam long kaba khuid , bad kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ka ha ka jingbitar jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , now I have opened my mouth , my tongue hath spoken in my mouth .
translation.kha: Nga kloi ban ong ïa kaba don ha ka jingmut jong nga .

translation.en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  , he heard our voice , and sent an angel , and hath brought us forth out of Egypt : and , behold , we are in Kadesh , a city in the uttermost of thy border :
translation.kha: bad ngi la lynñiar sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap . U la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ngi bad u la phah ïa u angel , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na Ijipt . Mynta ngi don ha Kadesh , ka shnong kaba ha khappud ka hima jong phi .

translation.en: There shall the fire devour thee  ; the sword shall cut thee off , it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm : make thyself many as the cankerworm , make thyself many as the locusts .
translation.kha: Kam pher kaei pha leh , ïa pha hi yn thang pynïap lane yn pynïap ha ka thma . Yn weng noh ïa pha kum ki jingthung ba la bam noh da ki puit . Pha la roi kum ki puit !

translation.en: The  Lord  is King for ever and ever : the heathen are perished out of his land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem junom la junom . Kito kiba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei kin jah noh na ka ri jong u .

translation.en: And Jesus came and touched them , and said ,  Arise , and be not afraid .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan sha ki bad u la ktah ïa ki .  To ïeng joit ,  u la ong .  To wat sheptieng !

translation.en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace ! and it should be your wisdom .
translation.kha: Wat ong ei ei , bad don ki ban pyrkhat ba me long uba stad !

translation.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh , and in sight be not deeper than the skin , and the hair thereof be not turned white  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka long kaba lieh , bad kam shym paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh ha kata ka prum ruh um pat lieh , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa uta u briew hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: Lo , all these things worketh God oftentimes with man ,
translation.kha: U Blei u leh ïa kane baroh na kawei ka por sha kawei pat ;

translation.en: To open their eyes , and to turn them from darkness to light , and from the power of Satan unto God , that they may receive forgiveness of sins , and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me .
translation.kha: Me dei ban pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ki bad pynphai ïa ki na ka jingdum sha ka jingshai , bad na ka bor jong u Soitan sha U Blei , khnang ba da ka jingngeit jong ki ha nga kin ïoh ka jingmap noh ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka hapdeng ki briew kiba la jied jong U Blei .’

translation.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened , and his own counsel shall cast him down .
translation.kha: Ki jingjam jong u ki la ju long kiba skhem , hynrei mynta u jynthut ; u kyllon — u shah lehbeiñ ha la ka jong ka jingai jingmut jong u hi .

translation.en: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen , in which my people dwell , that no swarms of flies shall be there  ; to the end thou mayest know that I am the  Lord  in the midst of the earth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait ïa ka ri Goshen , ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong , ba kumta yn ym don skain hangta . Ngan leh ïa kane ba men tip ba nga U  Trai  nga trei ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: For , behold , we were binding sheaves in the field , and , lo , my sheaf arose , and also stood upright  ; and , behold , your sheaves stood round about , and made obeisance to my sheaf .
translation.kha: Baroh ngi ïadon lang ha lyngkha ba ngi ïateh song ïa u kew , ha kaba ka song jong nga ka khie joit bad ka ïeng beit . Ki song jong phi pat ki tawiar sawdong ïa ka song jong nga , bad ki ïanguh ïa ka .

translation.en: And when the devil was cast out , the dumb spake : and the multitudes marvelled , saying , It was never so seen in Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei mar syn beh noh ïa u ksuid , u briew u la sdang ban kren , bad uwei uwei baroh u la lyngngoh ,  Ngim pat ju ïohi mynno mynno ruh kum kane ha Israel !  ki la ong .

translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded us to do all these statutes , to fear the  Lord  our God , for our good always , that he might preserve us alive , as it is at this day .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la ong ïa ngi ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh bad ban tiengburom ïa u , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ngi ba un ri pynim ïa ngi kumba ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army , because of him that passeth by , and because of him that returneth : and no oppressor shall pass through them any more : for now have I seen with mine eyes .
translation.kha: Ngan ap phira ïa ka ri jong nga bad ngan ym shah ïa ki kynhun shipai ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . Ngan ym shah shuh ïa ki nongbanbor ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong nga . Nga la ïohi haduh katno ki briew jong nga ki la shahshitom .

translation.en: Let the redeemed of the  Lord  say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy  ;
translation.kha: To ïai-ong ïa kine ki ktien ha ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ma phi baroh ïa kiba u la pynim .

translation.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor : let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki sarong bad pynshitom beiñ ïa kiba duk ; pynngat ïa ki ha ki jingriam kiba ki la thaw .

translation.en: And Jesus stood , and commanded him to be brought unto him : and when he was come near , he asked him ,
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la hukum ban wallam sha u ïa u briew uba matlah . Haba u la wan hajan , U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,

translation.en: Surely after that I was turned , I repented  ; and after that I was instructed , I smote upon my thigh : I was ashamed , yea , even confounded , because I did bear the reproach of my youth .
translation.kha: Ngi la phai dien noh na me , hynrei shen ngi la kwah ban wan phai pat . Hadien ba me la pynshitom ïa ngi , ngi la pyndem ïa la ki khlieh ha ka jingsngewsih . Ngi la sngewlehrain bad jahburom , namar ngi la leh pop mynba ngi dang samla .’

translation.en: But if any man say unto you , This is offered in sacrifice unto idols , eat not for his sake that shewed it , and for conscience sake : for the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u ong ïa phi ,  Kane ka dei ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ki bleithaw ,  te wat nym bam phi ïa kata ka jingbam , na ka bynta uta uba la ïathuh ïa phi bad na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem —

translation.en: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them , and they stood upon their feet  ; and great fear fell upon them which saw them .
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi shiteng , ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ba ai jingim ka la wan na U Blei bad ka la rung ha ki , bad ki la ïeng joit ; bad baroh kiba la ïohi ïa ki , ki la sngewtriem .

translation.en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people , and thine eyes shall look , and fail with longing for them all the day long : and there shall be no might in thine hand .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn ai noh kum ki mraw ha ki nongwei katba phi pat phi shu peit . Man ka sngi phin pynshitom sat ïa la ki khmat ba phi ap lehnoh-ei ïa la ki khun ba kin wan phai pat .

translation.en: And Darius the Median took the kingdom , being about threescore and two years old .
translation.kha: bad u Darius u nong Mid , uba ha kata ka por u don hynriewphew ar snem ka rta , u la knieh ïa ka bor syiem .

translation.en: And all bare him witness , and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth . And they said , Is not this Joseph s son ?
translation.kha: Baroh ki la sngewhun ïa u bad ki la sngewphylla ha ki kyntien basngewtynnat kiba u la kren . Ki la ong ,  Hato une um dei u khun jong u Joseph ?

translation.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain , and came unto the valley of Eshcol , and searched it out .
translation.kha: Kita ki la ïaleit sha kata ka ri lum haduh Them Eshkol bad ki la syntiat ïa ka .

translation.en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp  ; and the priest shall look , and , behold , if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper  ;
translation.kha: bad u lyngdoh un ïalam ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara , bad un khmih bha ïa u .

translation.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father .
translation.kha: Phi baroh ar ngut phi tip ba nga la trei na ka bynta i pa jong phi katba kot la ka bor .

translation.en: And he made the table of shittim wood : two cubits was the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof :
translation.kha: U shna ruh ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .
translation.kha: Balei me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me , bad shah ïa nga ban shim ïa ka kum ka tnga jong nga ? Kane hangne ka tnga jong me ; shim noh ïa ka bad khie mihnoh .

translation.en: Hear , ye deaf  ; and look , ye blind , that ye may see .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor , phi ki briew kiba kyllut ! To peit bha , phi kiba matlah !

translation.en: So she discovered her whoredoms , and discovered her nakedness : then my mind was alienated from her , like as my mind was alienated from her sister .
translation.kha: Ka thadrong ïa lade bad ka ailad ba baroh kin tip ba ka long ka nuti . Nga la sngewngiah ïa ka kumba nga la long ïa ka hynmen jong ka .

translation.en: And there ye shall eat before the  Lord  your God , and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto , ye and your households , wherein the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee .
translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la kyrkhu ïa phi , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi phin ïabam bad ïalehkmen ha kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi la trei shitom .

translation.en: Therefore say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye unto me , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will turn unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi , ‘ To wan phai sha nga bad ngan wan phai sha phi .

translation.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and joy in my people : and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her , nor the voice of crying .
translation.kha: Ïa nga ruh yn pyndap da ka jingkmen namar ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Hangta yn ym don shuh ka jingïam , yn ym don shuh ki ban khot kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath brought forth our righteousness : come , and let us declare in Zion the work of the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki pyrta , ‘ U  Trai  u la pyn-i ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei . Ïa ngin ïaleit bad ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la leh .’

translation.en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt : these are that Moses and Aaron .
translation.kha: Dei ruh ma ki kiba la ong ha u Pharaoh ban pyllait noh ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and his abominations which he did , and that which was found in him , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoïakim u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong u bad ki kam bymman kiba u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah . U Jehoïakhin u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust , and prepare raiment as the clay  ;
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki lah ban don shibun bha ka rupa ban ñiew bad shibun ki jingriam ban ïa kaba ki donkam ;

translation.en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard , they have trodden my portion under foot , they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness .
translation.kha: Shibun ki nongsynshar nongwei ki la pynjot ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga ; ki la ïuhroit ïa ki lyngkha jong nga ; ki la pynkylla ïa ka ri ba-itynnat jong nga sha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , when Ehud was dead .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Ehud u la ïap , ki paid Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .
translation.kha: To leh ïa ki kambah na ka bynta jong nga , A  Trai  , kumba me la leh ha ki sngi mynba me la wallam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the  Lord  , and hath perceived and heard his word ? who hath marked his word , and heard it ?
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ym don na kine ki Nongïathuhlypa uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong U  Trai . Ym don na ki uba la ju ïohsngew ne sngewthuh ïa ka khubor jong U ne uba la ju shahshkor ne pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba U ong .

translation.en: How much less man , that is a worm ? and the son of man , which is a worm ?
translation.kha: Te kumta kumno shaphang u briew , uta u kruiñ , uta u khñiang ? u briew u long aïu ha ki khmat U Blei ?

translation.en: But he giveth more grace . Wherefore he saith , God resisteth the proud , but giveth grace unto the humble .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingaiei kaba U Blei u ai ka long kaba kham khlaiñ shuh shuh . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u ai ïa ka jingaiei ha kiba sngewrit .

translation.en: Holding forth the word of life ; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ , that I have not run in vain , neither laboured in vain .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ngan don ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa phi ha ka Sngi jong U Khrist , namar kan pyn-i ba baroh ka jingpyrshang bad ka jingtrei jong nga kam shym la long kaba lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan , or forward  ; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward .
translation.kha: Ngin ym shim kynti ïa kano kano ka jingdon jingem hapdeng jong ki ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan , namar ngi la ïohpdiang ïa la ka bhah hangne ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan .

translation.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof , and called them Havoth–jair .
translation.kha: U Jair uba na ka jait Manasseh u la tur ïaleh bad ïohknieh katto katne ki shnong bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ki  Ki shnong u Jair .

translation.en: The Bible alone tells us what we must do to please God .—Psalm 1 :1-3  ; Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
translation.kha: Dei tang ka Baibl kaba ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .—Salm 1 :1-3 ; Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .

translation.en: Behold now , I have ordered my cause  ; I know that I shall be justified .
translation.kha: Nga la kloi ban ïasaid ïa ka kam ka jong nga . Namar nga tip ba ngam shym bakla .

translation.en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace , and in all other places ;
translation.kha: Kaba mih nangta ka long , ba ka kynhun nongap phira jong ka ïingsyiem baroh kawei bad baroh kiwei pat hangne , ki tip ba nga don ha ka byndi namar nga long u shakri jong U Khrist .

translation.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father , and followed him .
translation.kha: bad shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa ka lieng bad ïa la u kpa bad ki la ïaleit bad u .

translation.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth : and it came to pass , after they went forth , that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul  ; so that his name was much set by .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ju wan ban ïaleh thma , hynrei ha man ki jingïaleh , u Dabid u kham jop ïa ki ban ïa uno uno u rangbah shipai jong u Saul . Kumta u Dabid u la pawnam shibun .

translation.en: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me , and now hear to be in me .
translation.kha: Mynta phi lah ban ïashim bynta lem bad nga ha ka thma . Ka dei kajuh ka thma kaba phi la ïohi ïa nga ba nga la ïaleh ha ki por kiba mynshuwa , bad kumba phi ïohsngew , ïa kata kaba nga dang ïaleh haduh mynta .

translation.en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul , that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth .
translation.kha: Nalorkata Nga ñiew ïa U Blei kum u sakhi jong nga — u tip ïa ka dohnud jong nga ! Ka long na ka bynta ban ïada ïa phi ba nga la rai ban ym leit sha Korinth .

translation.en: And Rephah was his son , also Resheph , and Telah his son , and Tahan his son ,
translation.kha: U Ephraim u don ruh uwei u khun uba kyrteng u Rephah , uba ki khun ki ksiew jong u ki long kumne harum : u Resheph , u Telah , u Tahan ,

translation.en: But God forbid that I should glory , save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom the world is crucified unto me , and I unto the world .
translation.kha: Pynban , na ka bynta jong nga , ngan sngewsarong tang shaphang ka diengphna U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ; naba da ka diengphna jong u , ka pyrthei ka la ïap ïa nga , bad nga la ïap ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Let thy mercy , O  Lord  , be upon us , according as we hope in thee .
translation.kha: Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me kan long ha ngi , A  Trai  , kumba ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that it shall no more be said , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And the woman made haste , and ran , and shewed her husband , and said unto him , Behold , the man hath appeared unto me , that came unto me the other day .
translation.kha: kumta ka mareh stet sha u , bad ka ong ,  Ha khmih ! U briew uba la wan sha nga ha kato ka sngi u wanpaw biang ha nga .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance , that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs , which were committed before you , and that ye defile not yourselves therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba nga ai bad wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong kito ki briew kiba shong ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi , bad wat pynbyrsieh ruh ïa lade da kaba leh ïa kano kano na kine ki kam . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: ( Now that he ascended , what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth ?
translation.kha: Mynta , ka mut aïu  u la kiew shajrong  ? Ka mut ba nyngkong u la leit hiar sha kiba jylliew tam shapoh ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Master , which is the great commandment in the law ?
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  u la kylli ,  kano ka hukum kaba khraw tam hapoh ka Hukum ?

translation.en: And it was so from that day forward , that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la buh ïa kane kum ka aiñ bad la ju bud ha Israel hadien kata .

translation.en: Then an herald cried aloud , To you it is commanded , O people , nations , and languages ,
translation.kha: u sangot u la pynbna ha ka sur bajam ,  Ko ki briew jong ki ri baroh , ki jaitbynriew bad ki jait ktien !

translation.en: Then the Amalekites came down , and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill , and smote them , and discomfited them , even unto Hormah .
translation.kha: Te ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan kiba shong hangta ki wan tur ïaleh bad ki la jop ïa ki , bad ki beh krad ïa ki haduh Hormah .

translation.en: And they came thither into the midst of the house , as though they would have fetched wheat  ; and they smote him under the fifth rib : and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei ha ka jingkhang ka la shoh samthiah ngai katba ka dang tai kew bad ka ïohthiah , kumta u Rekhab bad u Baanah ki ïohrung shapoh .

translation.en: What ? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in ? or despise ye the church of God , and shame them that have not ? What shall I say to you ? shall I praise you in this ? I praise you not .
translation.kha: Hato phim don la ka jong ka ïing ban ïabam ïadih ? Lane hato phi da kwah ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ka balang U Blei bad ban pynlehrain ïa ki briew kiba kyrduh ? Kaei ba phi khmih lynti ïa nga ban ong ha phi shaphang kane ? Hato ngan ïaroh ïa phi ? Em , ngan ym leh kumta!

translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Abdon the son of Micah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,
translation.kha: bad u ai ïa kane ka hukum harum ha u Hilkaïah , u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , u Abdon u khun jong u Mikaïah , u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :

translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye that know righteousness , the people in whose heart is my law  ; fear ye not the reproach of men , neither be ye afraid of their revilings .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba tip ïa kaei kaba dei , kiba don ka jinghikai jong nga kaba neh ha la ki dohnud . Wat sheptieng haba ki briew ki pynsalia bad krenbeiñ ïa phi ;

translation.en: For in those days shall be affliction , such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time , neither shall be .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingshitom jong kita ki sngi kan long kaba kham sniew , ban ïa kaei kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka la ju tip naduh myn nyngkong eh ba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei haduh ka por ba mynta . Lymne yn ym don shuh hadien kum kata kaei kaei .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines , before that Pharaoh smote Gaza .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u syiem jong ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa ka Gasa , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ka Philistia .

translation.en: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long , and five cubits broad .
translation.kha: Ki kamra ap phira jong ka , ka kamra rung jong ka , bad ki kynroh bashapoh jong ka ki la long katjuh ka jingheh kat kito kiba ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop . La don ruh jingkhangïit baroh sawdong bad ha ka jaka rung . Baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar ka jingjrong bad khat-ar mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang .

translation.en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah , Go into the land , unto all fountains of water , and unto all brooks : peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive , that we lose not all the beasts .
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Obadaïah ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit ban khmih ïa baroh ki umpohliew bad ki wah ha ka ri , ban shem la ngi lah ban ïoh phlang ban pyndap bam na ka bynta ki kulai bad ki khashor ba kin ym ïapthngan . Lehse ngin ym hap ban pynïap noh na ki mrad ba ngi ri .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Rachel had born Joseph , that Jacob said unto Laban , Send me away , that I may go unto mine own place , and to my country .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingkha ïa u Joseph , u Jakob u ong ha u Laban ,  Pyllait noh ïa nga , ba ngan ïoh leit phai noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: For I am the  Lord  , I change not  ; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  , bad ngam ju kylla . Bad kumta ma phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , phim pat shym la jah noh khoit .

translation.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good , and doeth it not , to him it is sin .
translation.kha: Kumta te , u briew u bym leh ïa kaba bha kaba u tip ba u dei ban leh u long uba shah pynrem namar ka pop .

translation.en: For he had healed many  ; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him , as many as had plagues .
translation.kha: U la lah pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew , bad baroh kito kiba pang ki la ïai kyntur sha u khnang ba ïohktah ïa u .

translation.en: For this cause I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles ,
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga u Paul , u nongsah byndi U Khrist Jisu na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil , nga duwai ha U Blei .

translation.en: And ye shall teach them your children , speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïalap shaphang jong ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .

translation.en: And all the people went over Jordan . And when the king was come over , the king kissed Barzillai , and blessed him  ; and he returned unto his own place .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid bad baroh ki rangbah jong u ki la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan . U la doh ïa u Barsillai bad u ai ha u ïa la ka jingkyrkhu kyrdoh , bad u Barsillai u leit phai noh sha ïing .

translation.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there : and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee , and will put it upon them  ; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee , that thou bear it not thyself alone .
translation.kha: Ngan wan hiar bad ïakren bad me hangta , bad ngan shim khyndiat ka bor mynsiem ïa kaba nga la ai ha me bad ngan ai ïa ka ha ki . Te kin sa lah ban ïakit lem ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta kine ki paidbah , bad men ym donkam shuh ban kit tang marwei hi .

translation.en: And the people said unto Saul , Shall Jonathan die , who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel ? God forbid : as the  Lord  liveth , there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground  ; for he hath wrought with God this day . So the people rescued Jonathan , that he died not .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki ong ha u Saul ,  Hato u Jonathan , uba la jop ka jingjop kaba khraw na ka bynta ki Israel , un shah pynïap ? Em ! Ngi kular ha U  Trai  uba im ba uwei u shñiuh na ka khlieh jong u ruh un ym hap ha khyndew . Kaei kaba u la leh ha kane ka sngi la leh da ka jingïarap jong U Blei .  Kumta ki paidbah ki la pyllait im ïa u Jonathan na kaba shah pynïap .

translation.en: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places , and see where thou hast not been lien with . In the ways hast thou sat for them , as the Arabian in the wilderness  ; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness .
translation.kha: Khmih shatei halor ki kliar lum . Hato don kano kano ka jaka ha kaba pham shym la leh kum ka nuti ? Pha la ap ïa ki nongleh-ieit shi lynter ka rud surok , kumba u Arab u apthap ha ka ri shyiap . Pha la pyntngit ïa ka ri da ka jingleh nuti jong pha .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto his young men , Abide ye here with the ass  ; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship , and come again to you .
translation.kha: Te u ong ha kita ki shakri ,  To shong hangne bad ka kada . Ma nga bad u khun ngin leit hangtai ban mane Blei , bad hadien kata ngin sa wan pat sha phi .

translation.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah , and the servants of David , went out , and met together by the pool of Gibeon : and they sat down , the one on the one side of the pool , and the other on the other side of the pool .
translation.kha: U Joab , u khun jong ka Seruïah , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la ïakynduh ïa ki ha ka pung , ha kaba baroh ki la ïashong , kawei ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang jong ka pung bad kawei pat ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang .

translation.en: As it is written in the prophets , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
translation.kha: Ka sdang kumba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la thoh :  U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong phi ban pynkhreh lynti na ka bynta jong phi .’

translation.en: Yes , I love you .
translation.kha: Haoid Nga ieid ia phi .

translation.en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake : and he had sheep , and oxen , and he asses , and menservants , and maidservants , and she asses , and camels .
translation.kha: Namar jong ka , u syiem u la lehbha ïa u Abram bad u la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad ki blang , ki masi , ki kada , ki mraw bad ki ut .

translation.en: And they arose out of Midian , and came to Paran : and they took men with them out of Paran , and they came to Egypt , unto Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; which gave him an house , and appointed him victuals , and gave him land .
translation.kha: Ki mihnoh na Midian bad ki leit sha Paran , ha kaba katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ïasoh lang bad ki . Nangta ki leit sha Ijipt bad sha u syiem uba la ai ïa u Hadad katto katne ka jaka bad ka ïing bad u pynbiang bam ïa u .

translation.en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the rising be white in the skin , and it have turned the hair white , and there be quick raw flesh in the rising  ;
translation.kha: u ban khmih bniah ïa u . Lada ka don ka prum kaba lieh ha ka sniehdoh jong u kaba la pynlieh ïa u shñiuh bad kaba dap da ka ksuit ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  our God delivered him before us  ; and we smote him , and his sons , and all his people .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la aiti ïa u ha ngi , bad ngi la pynïap ïa u , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh .

translation.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty , not walking in craftiness , nor handling the word of God deceitfully ; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man s conscience in the sight of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei la pynbna ki kam babuhrieh kiba pynlehrain ; ngim shym leh da ka jingshukor , lymne ngim pynbakla ïa ka ktien jong U Blei . Ha ka jingshai kaba pura jong ka jingshisha , ngi im ha khmat U Blei bad ngi pyrshang ban aiti ïa lade sha ka jingïatiplem babha jong uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: But , behold , I will raise up against you a nation , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts  ; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh da lade u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shipai nongwei ban knieh ïa ka ri jong phi . Kan banbeiñ ïa phi naduh ka Khim Hamath bashaphang shatei haduh ka wahduid Arabah bashaphang shathie .

translation.en: Now mine eyes shall be open , and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih halor kane ka Templ bad ngan kloi ban shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai baroh ba yn pynlong hangne ,

translation.en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Bad u Solomon u bteng ,  U Dabid u kpa jong nga u la thmu ban tei ïa ka Templ ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ,

translation.en: And cried with a loud voice , and said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of the most high God ? I adjure thee by God , that thou torment me not .
translation.kha: Ko Jisu , U Khun jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! Me kwah aïu bad nga ? Nga kyrpad ïa me ban ym pynshitom ïa nga !

translation.en: And it came to pass , as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda .
translation.kha: U Petros u la leit kylleng kylleng , bad ha kawei ka sien u la leit ban jngoh ïa ki briew jong U Blei kiba shong basah ha Lydda .

translation.en: Lest ye should say , We have found out wisdom : God thrusteth him down , not man .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban kubur ba phi la shem ïa ka jingstad ? U Blei u dei u ban jubab ïa u Job , naba phim shym lah leh ei ei .

translation.en: And God remembered Noah , and every living thing , and all the cattle that was with him in the ark : and God made a wind to pass over the earth , and the waters assuaged  ;
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la klet ïa u Noah , bad ïa ki mrad baroh kiba ïadon lem bad u ha ka lieng ; u la pynlong ïa ka lyer ban beh , bad ka um ka la sdang hiar .

translation.en: And he said , Hear thou therefore the word of the  Lord  : I saw the  Lord  sitting on his throne , and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u ong shuh shuh :  Mynta sngap ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u shong ha ka khet jong u ha bneng , lem bad ki angel jong u kiba ïeng hajan jong u .

translation.en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece , from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall , even unto the corner .
translation.kha: U Binnui , u khun jong u Henadad u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , naduh ka ïing u Asaraïah haduh ka dong jong ka kynroh .

translation.en: And Moses said unto him , Enviest thou for my sake ? would God that all the  Lord s  people were prophets , and that the  Lord  would put his spirit upon them !
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Hato me pyrkhat lem shaphang kiei kiei kiba ïadei bad nga ? A ban da U  Trai  u ai ïa la ka bor mynsiem ha ki briew jong u baroh bad u pynlong ïa ki ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa !

translation.en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely , and shall be quiet from fear of evil .
translation.kha: Hynrei jar uba shahshkor ïa nga un shongsuk kynjai . Un lait na ki jingma khlem sheptieng ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: What is my reward then ? Verily that , when I preach the gospel , I may make the gospel of Christ without charge , that I abuse not my power in the gospel .
translation.kha: Kaei te ka jingsiew ba nga ïoh ? Ka long ka lad ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha khlem buh dor na ka bynta kata , khlem da dawa ïa ki hok jong nga ha ka kam jong nga na ka bynta ka gospel .

translation.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread , that was before the  Lord  , he took one unleavened cake , and a cake of oiled bread , and one wafer , and put them on the fat , and upon the right shoulder :
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa uwei u kpu na ka shang ba la buh ïa ki kpu bakhlem thiat ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , uwei u kpu uba stang , bad u buh ïa ki halor kata ka khleiñ bad ka kjat-dien kamon .

translation.en: Then said he unto him ,  A certain man made a great supper , and bade many :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba la khreh ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha kaba u la khot sngewbha bun ki briew .

translation.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land , and went up to Samaria , and besieged it three years .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shalmaneser u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad u kerkut ïa ka Samaria . Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut ,

translation.en: That the blood of all the prophets , which was shed from the foundation of the world , may be required of this generation  ;
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk yn pynshitom na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la shah pynïap naduh ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ,

translation.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name , THE  Lord  THY GOD  ;
translation.kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Blei ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab , bad lada phim ñiewburom ïa ka kyrteng kaba phylla bad kaba khraw jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,

translation.en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing , I the  Lord  have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand upon him , and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel .
translation.kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u shah shukor ban ai ki jubab kiba bakla , ka dei namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la shukor ïa u . Ngan weng ïa u na ki paid Israel .

translation.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion , and doth teach him .
translation.kha: U tip kumno ban trei ïa ka kam jong u namar U Blei u hikai ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again , that they sent and called him unto the congregation , and made him king over all Israel : there was none that followed the house of David , but the tribe of Judah only .
translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohsngew ba u Jeroboam u la wan phai na Ijipt , ki khot sngewbha ïa u sha ka jingïalang paidbah bad ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ki Israel . Tang ka jait Judah kaba ïaisah ban ïaineh bad kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid .

translation.en: And unto Enoch was born Irad : and Irad begat Mehujael : and Mehujael begat Methusael : and Methusael begat Lamech .
translation.kha: U Enokh u la ïoh khun shynrang uba kyrteng u Irad , uba dei u kpa jong u Mehujael , bad u Mehujael u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Methushael , uba dei u kpa jong u Lamekh .

translation.en: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets : and it came to pass , when the people heard the sound of the trumpet , and the people shouted with a great shout , that the wall fell down flat , so that the people went up into the city , every man straight before him , and they took the city .
translation.kha: Kumta ki lyngdoh ki put ïa ki turoi . Uta u paidbah , u tang shu ïohsngew ïa kata , u la risa jam , bad kita ki kynroh ki la khyllem . Te ki shipai baroh ki leit beit beit sha u lum sha kata ka nongbah bad ki kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: He answered and said , A man that is called Jesus made clay , and anointed mine eyes , and said unto me ,  Go to the pool of Siloam , and wash :  and I went and washed , and I received sight .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  U briew ïa uba la khot U Jisu u la pynlong ïa i sboh ktieh , u la kyllan ha ki khmat jong nga , bad u la ong ha nga ban leit sha Siloam bad bta ïa ka khmat jong nga . Kumta nga la leit , bad tang mar ïa-bta khmat , nga la lah ban imat .

translation.en: Ye Ethiopians also , ye shall be slain by my sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynïap ruh ïa ki briew jong ka Sudan .

translation.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter , first say , Peace be to this house .
translation.kha: Ha man ba phi rung ha kano kano ka ïing , to ong nyngkong , ‘ Ka jingsuk kan long ha kane ka ïing .’

translation.en: The earth , O  Lord  , is full of thy mercy : teach me thy statutes .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ka pyrthei ka dap da ka jingieit baneh jong me ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me !

translation.en: Shuppim also , and Huppim , the children of Ir , and Hushim , the sons of Aher .
translation.kha: U Shuppim bad u Huppim ruh ki long na kane ka jait . U Dan u don uwei u khun , u Hushim .

translation.en: Behold , all ye yourselves have seen it  ; why then are ye thus altogether vain ?
translation.kha: Hynrei em , ha ka jingshisha , phi la ïohi hi da lade ; te kumta balei ba phi kren ïa kum kata ka jingkren bieit ?

translation.en: And the name of the man was Elimelech , and the name of his wife Naomi , and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion , Ephrathites of Beth–lehem–judah . And they came into the country of Moab , and continued there .
translation.kha: Slem bah mynshuwa , ha ki sngi shuwa ba ki Israel kin ïoh syiem , la don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri . Kumta u briew uba kyrteng u Elimelekh , uba na ka kur Ephrath bad uba shong ha Bethlehem kaba ha Judah , u leit bad ka Naomi ka tnga jong u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ki , u Mahlon bad u Khilion , ban sah shipor ha ka ri Moab . Katba ki dang sah hangta ,

translation.en: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women s house , to know how Esther did , and what should become of her .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi u Mordekai u ju ïaid sharum shaneng ha khmat ka phyllaw ka ïing ki kynthei , khnang ban tip kumno ka long bad kaei ka ban jia ïa ka .

translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that judgest righteously , that triest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I revealed my cause .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la duwai ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me long u nongbishar ba bishar hok ; me tynjuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingsngew jong ki briew . Nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me ; kumta shah ïa nga ban khmih ïa me ba me pynhiarkput halor kine ki briew .

translation.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight , thou hast been honourable , and I have loved thee : therefore will I give men for thee , and people for thy life .
translation.kha: Ngan kyntait ïa ki ri baroh ban pynim ïa ka jingim jong phi , namar phi long uba kordor ha nga bad namar ba nga ieit ïa phi bad ai ïa phi ka burom .

translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles  ; else the new wine will burst the bottles , and be spilled , and the bottles shall perish .
translation.kha: Lymne ba uno uno un theh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai ha ki lwa snieh ba la pyndonkam , namar ka waiñ bathymmai kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , bad ïa ki snieh yn pynjot .

translation.en: Yea , my reins shall rejoice , when thy lips speak right things .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewsarong haba ngan ïohsngew ba phi kren ïa ki ktien ka jingstad .

translation.en: And the sons of Shemida were , Ahian , and Shechem , and Likhi , and Aniam .
translation.kha: ( U Shemida u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ahian , u Shekhem , u Likhi , bad u Aniam . )

translation.en: At that time Berodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah : for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick .
translation.kha: Kumba ha kata kajuh ka por u syiem ka Babilonia , u Merodakh Baladan , u khun jong u Baladan , u ïohsngew ba u syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang , kumta u phah sha u ïa ka shithi bad ka jingai sngewbha .

translation.en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years : and Terah died in Haran .
translation.kha: U Terah u la ïap hangta ha ka rta kaba arspah san snem .

translation.en: And the king communed with them  ; and among them all was found none like Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah : therefore stood they before the king .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ïakren bad ki baroh , bad u Daniel , u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah ki la pynhun shibun ïa u ban ïa uno uno uwei pat . Kumta ki la kylla long ki dkhot jong ka ïingbishar jong u syiem .

translation.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit , and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints ;
translation.kha: To leh ïa kane baroh ha ka jingduwai , da kaba kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong U Blei . Duwai ha ki por baroh , katba U Mynsiem u ïalam . Namar kane ka daw , to sharai bad wat kynran dien ; duwai borabor na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei baroh .

translation.en: And I will also give thee into their hand , and they shall throw down thine eminent place , and shall break down thy high places : they shall strip thee also of thy clothes , and shall take thy fair jewels , and leave thee naked and bare .
translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa pha ha ka bor jong ki , bad kin pynkhyllem ïa ki jaka ha kiba pha ïaleh nuti bad mane bleithaw . Kin shim noh ïa ki jaiñ bad ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha bad kin iehnoh lyngkhuit khoit ïa pha .

translation.en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread , and drink this cup of the Lord , unworthily , shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord .
translation.kha: Kaba bud ka long , lada uno uno uba bam ïa u kpu lane dih na ka khuri jong U Trai ha ka rukom kaba pynjahburom ïa U , ma u ne ma ka ki long kiba la pynrem ha ka pop pyrshah ïa ka met bad ïa ka snam jong U Trai .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Prophesy unto the wind , prophesy , son of man , and say to the wind , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Come from the four winds , O breath , and breathe upon these slain , that they may live .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa ha ka lyer . To ïathuh ha ka lyer ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u hukum ïa ka ba kan wan na baroh sawdong , ban pyrsad mynsiem ha kine ki metïap , bad ban wallam pat ha ki ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: If any man trespass against his neighbour , and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear , and the oath come before thine altar in this house :
translation.kha: Haba u briew u shah mudui ba u leh bymdei ïa uwei pat , bad la wallam sha ka duwan jong me ha kane ka Templ ban shim ïa ka jingsmai ba u long uba lui lui ,

translation.en: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree , that we , being dead to sins , should live unto righteousness : by whose stripes ye were healed .
translation.kha: U Khrist da lade hi u la bah noh ïa ki pop jong ngi ha ka met jong u sha ka diengphna , khnang ba ngin ïap ïa ka pop bad ïoh im na ka bynta ka hok . Ka dei da ki jingjngem snam jong u ba la pynkhiah ïa phi .

translation.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king , Get thee to Anathoth , unto thine own fields  ; for thou art worthy of death : but I will not at this time put thee to death , because thou barest the ark of the Lord  God  before David my father , and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh ,  Khie leit sha la ka jong ka ri ha Anathoth . Me dei hok ban ïap , hynrei ngan ym phah pynïap ïa me mynta , namar ba me la khmih sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  mynba me dang don bad u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , bad me la ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .

translation.en: Saying ,  What think ye of Christ ? whose son is he ?  They say unto him , The Son of David .
translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat kumno shaphang u Messaïah ? U dei u nonghiarpateng jongno ?   U dei uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Declare this in the house of Jacob , and publish it in Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To ïathuh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah :

translation.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold  ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba jaipdeh palat ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u ha ka por kaba biang un ym ïoh ei ei ïa ka ban ot .

translation.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched , and that burned with fire , nor unto blackness , and darkness , and tempest ,
translation.kha: Naba phim shym la wan kumba wan ki paid Israel , sha kaei kaba phi lah ban tba , sha u lum Sinai ha kaba la don ka ding kaba klang , ka jingdum bad u lyoh ïong , ka  erïong ,

translation.en: But they hearkened not : and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the  Lord  destroyed before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Judah kim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad u Manasseh u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh wat ïa ki pop kiba kham khraw ban ïa kito kiba la leh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang .

translation.en: And after the second veil , the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all  ;
translation.kha: Ha lyndet ka jingkah kaba ar la don ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaba la khot ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go on before the people , and take with thee of the elders of Israel  ; and thy rod , wherewith thou smotest the river , take in thine hand , and go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ïalam bad me katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad leit sha shuwa jong u paidbah . Rah ruh ïa u diengduh da uba me la shoh ïa ka wah Nile .

translation.en: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah , when he had been sick , and was recovered of his sickness :
translation.kha: Hadien u Hesekaïah u koit pat na ka jingpang jong u , u thoh ïa kane ka jingrwai ïaroh :

translation.en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod , and in the palaces in the land of Egypt , and say , Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria , and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof , and the oppressed in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: To pynbna ha kito kiba shong ha ki ïingsyiem ha Ijipt bad Ashdod :  Ïalumlang ha ki lum sawdong ka Samaria , bad peit ïa ka jingkhynwin kaba khraw bad ka jingbymman ba la leh hangta .

translation.en: And Gideon said unto him , Oh my Lord , if the  Lord  be with us , why then is all this befallen us ? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of , saying , Did not the  Lord  bring us up from Egypt ? but now the  Lord  hath forsaken us , and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ong ha u ,  Kynrad , lada long ban kylli , balei kane ka wan jia ha ngi lada U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad ngi ? Jia aïu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phylla kiba ki kpa jong ngi ki ïathuh ïa ngi ba U  Trai  u ju leh — kumno u la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt ? U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa ngi bad u la ieh ïa ngi ha ka jingisynei jong ki Midian .

translation.en: They that make them are like unto them : so is every one that trusteth in them .
translation.kha: To ai ba baroh kiba la thaw ïa ki bad kiba shaniah ha ki kin kylla long kum ki bleithaw ba ki la shna !

translation.en: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures . And this was their appearance  ; they had the likeness of a man .
translation.kha: Hamar pdeng jong kata ka  erïong , nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba i kum ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ha ka dur ki briew ,

translation.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee : and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire  ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .
translation.kha: U la ailad ïa phi ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jong u na bneng khnang ba u lah ban hikai ïa phi ; bad hangne ha pyrthei u la ailad ba phin ïohi ïa ka ding kaba kyntang jong u , bad u la kren ha phi na ka .

translation.en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander ; whom I have delivered unto Satan , that they may learn not to blaspheme .
translation.kha: Napdeng kine ki long — u Hymenaïos bad u Aleksandar , ïa kiba nga la pynshitom da kaba aiti noh ïa ki sha ka bor u Soitan ; kane kan hikai ïa ki ban sangeh na kaba krenbeiñ Blei .

translation.en: Matthew and Thomas , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon called Zelotes ,
translation.kha: u Matthaïos bad u Thomas , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , bad u Simon ( ïa uba la khot , u Riew-ieit ri ) .

translation.en: For what is a man advantaged , if he gain the whole world , and lose himself , or be cast away ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew un ïohnong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u hi u duh noh lane u shahjop ? Em da shisha !

translation.en: And the Lord turned , and looked upon Peter . And Peter remembered the word of the Lord , how he had said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
translation.kha: U Trai u la phai sawdong bad u la khmih shlip ha u Petros , bad u Petros u la kynmaw ba U Trai u la lah ong ha u ,  Ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ha kane ka miet , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: And when he had given him licence , Paul stood on the stairs , and beckoned with the hand unto the people . And when there was made a great silence , he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue , saying ,
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la shah ïa u , kumta u Paul u la ïeng halor ki mawkyrdon bad u la ai dak da ki kti jong u ha u paidbah ban sngap jar . Haba ki la sngap jar , u Paul u la kren ïa ki ha ka ktien Hebru :

translation.en: Prophesy ye not , say they to them that prophesy : they shall not prophesy to them , that they shall not take shame .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïalap ha nga bad ki ong ,  Wat ïalap ha ngi . Wat ïalap shaphang kata baroh . U Blei un ym pynjahburom ïa ngi .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years , according to the days of one king : after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba ïa ka Tyros yn klet noh hynñiewphew snem , kat ka rta u syiem . Haba kita ki snem ki la kut noh , ka Tyros kan long kum ka nuti ha ka jingrwai :

translation.en: But she was plucked up in fury , she was cast down to the ground , and the east wind dried up her fruit : her strong rods were broken and withered  ; the fire consumed them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki kti ba bitar ki la rat ïa u naduh tynrai bad bret ïa u sha madan . Ka lyer mihngi ka la pyntyrkhong ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat jong u ki la kheiñ ; ki la tyrkhong bad la thang noh .

translation.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee , then he shall count with him , and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption .
translation.kha: U dei ban pynphai shi bynta na ka dor ha kaba la thied ïa u kat kum ka jingdon jong ki snem kiba dang sah ,

translation.en: And Josiah gave to the people , of the flock , lambs and kids , all for the passover offerings , for all that were present , to the number of thirty thousand , and three thousand bullocks : these were of the king s substance .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam ki briew ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u syiem Josaïah u la ai sngewbha na ki kynhun jong ki jingri jong u laiphew hajar tylli ki blang , ki langbrot , bad ki khunblang , bad lai hajar tylli ki masi lyngraw .

translation.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside : wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him  ; and he fell down there , and died in the same place : and it came to pass , that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Asahel um shym sangeh ; kumta u Abner , da ka jingtynrah shadien ïa la u sum , u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh ba kumta u sum u da pei bla ha ka ingdong jong u . U Asahel u kyllon ïap ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei uba wan poi ha ka jaka ha kaba u kyllon u la sangeh bad ïeng hangta .

translation.en: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah , and took them .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Hesekaïah , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah bad ki jop ïa ki .

translation.en: Because there is wrath , beware lest he take thee away with his stroke : then a great ransom cannot deliver thee .
translation.kha: Da sumar ban ym shah ïa ki jingbamsap ban shukor ïa phi , lane ka spah ban ïalam sakma ïa phi .

translation.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon , and for all that came unto king Solomon s table , every man in his month : they lacked nothing .
translation.kha: Ki khat-ar ngut ki lat jong u , uwei uwei ha u bnai ba la buh ïa u , ki pynbiang ka jingbam ïa u Syiem Solomon kaba u donkam ïa lade bad ïa baroh kiba bam ha ka ïingsyiem ; ki ju ïai pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba donkam .

translation.en: 1 What Is the Good News ?
translation.kha: 1 Kaei ka Khubor Babha ?

translation.en: And they set the altar upon his bases  ; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries : and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  , even burnt offerings morning and evening .
translation.kha: Wat la kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai , ki sheptieng ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri , pynban ki tei biang ïa ka duwan ha ka jaka ba ka ïeng mynshuwa . Nangta ki sdang biang ban thang halor jong ka ïa ki jingkñia man ka step bad man ka janmiet .

translation.en: If thy father at all miss me , then say , David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth–lehem his city : for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family .
translation.kha: Lada i pa jong phi i shem ba ngam don lang ha ka miej bam , ïathuh ïa i ba nga la pan jingbit na phi ban leit sha la ïing ha Bethlehem , namar ba ka dei ka por jong ka jingkñia ainguh ba shisien shisnem hangta ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga baroh .

translation.en: Hear now this , O foolish people , and without understanding  ; which have eyes , and see not  ; which have ears , and hear not :
translation.kha: To pynshahshkor , phi ki briew kiba bieit bad ba-mutlop , kiba don ki khmat , hynrei ki bym lah ïohi , bad kiba don ki shkor , hynrei ki bym lah ïohsngew .

translation.en: Also he built towers in the desert , and digged many wells : for he had much cattle , both in the low country , and in the plains : husbandmen also , and vine dressers in the mountains , and in Carmel : for he loved husbandry .
translation.kha: U tei ruh ki kut kiba skhem ha ki rudnong , bad u tih shibun ki pukri , naba u don ki kynhun jingri kiba bun ha kjat ki lum bashaphang sepngi bad ha ki pyntha . Namar ba u ieit ïa ka rep ka riang , u pynshlur ïa ki briew ban thung dieng sohwaiñ ha ki jaka lum bad ban rep ha ki jaka kiba seisoh .

translation.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel :
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba la mihpat na ka jingïap , uba la hiarpateng na u Dabid , kumba la hikai ha ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap .

translation.en: That we may buy the poor for silver , and the needy for a pair of shoes  ; yea , and sell the refuse of the wheat ?
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban die ïa u kew u bymdondor ha ka dor kaba heh . Ngin shem ïa u briew uba duk u bym lah siew ïa ki ram jong u , wat ym ïa ka dor jong shi jur ki juti , bad ngin thied ïa u kum u mraw .

translation.en: But ye should say , Why persecute we him , seeing the root of the matter is found in me ?
translation.kha: Kumno ngin pynshitom ïa u ?  Phi ap khmih ïa ka kabu ban tur ïaleh ïa nga ,

translation.en: By me kings reign , and princes decree justice .
translation.kha: Nga ïarap ïa ki syiem ban synshar , bad ki nongsynshar ban thaw ki aiñ kiba bha .

translation.en: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent , and his head bare , and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip , and shall cry , Unclean , unclean .
translation.kha: U briew uba la ïoh ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u dei ban phong da ki jaiñjot , un ieh khlem sad ïa la u shñiuh , un tap ïa la ka khmat naduh ki rmiang shyntur sharum , bad un pyrta ,  U bymkhuid , u bymkhuid !

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and enter into the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . And the king of Israel disguised himself , and went into the battle .
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Jehoshaphat ,  Katba ngi dang leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei phi riam ha ki jaiñphong syiem jong phi .  Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha ka thma da jingriam pher .

translation.en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day  ; then he establisheth all her vows , or all her bonds , which are upon her : he confirmeth them , because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ha ka sngi ba u ïohsngew ïa ka jingkular , um shym pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah , ka dei ban pyndep lut ïa kaba ka la kular . U la pynskhem ïa ka jingkular da kaba um pyrshah ei ei ha kata ka sngi ba u ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: And they clothed him with purple , and platted a crown of thorns , and put it about his head ,
translation.kha: Ki la pynkup ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh ha U Jisu , ki la thaw ïa ka pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah , bad pynphong ïa ka ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: I will smite them with the pestilence , and disinherit them , and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ka jingïapthem bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki , hynrei ïa me ngan pynlong u kpa ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki !

translation.en: Arabia , and all the princes of Kedar , they occupied with thee in lambs , and rams , and goats : in these were they thy merchants .
translation.kha: Ki Arab bad ki nongsynshar ka ri Kedar ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar khaïi jong pha da ki khunlangbrot , ki langbrot , bad ki blang .

translation.en: And those twelve stones , which they took out of Jordan , did Joshua pitch in Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hangta u Joshua u pynïeng ïa ki khat-ar tylli ki maw ba la shim na ka Jordan .

translation.en: His legs are as pillars of marble , set upon sockets of fine gold : his countenance is as Lebanon , excellent as the cedars .
translation.kha: Ki umpohliew ki ai um ïa ka kper , ki wah um batuid , ki wahduid kiba tuid sharum na ki lumbah ka Lebanon .

translation.en: If I justify myself , mine own mouth shall condemn me : if I say , I am perfect , it shall also prove me perverse .
translation.kha: Nga long uba lui lui , bad uba shaniah hok , hynrei ki ktien jong nga ki pynsngewrem , bad baroh kaba nga ong ka i kumba ka pynrem ïa nga .

translation.en: O Lord , according to all thy righteousness , I beseech thee , let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem , thy holy mountain : because for our sins , and for the iniquities of our fathers , Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us .
translation.kha: Me la ïada ïa ngi ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta te to wat bitar shuh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka long ka nongbah jong me , u lum bakyntang jong me . Baroh ki briew ha ki ri ba-marjan ki khmih beiñ ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong me namar ki pop jong ngi bad ka jingbymman ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh .

translation.en: And , behold , a woman in the city , which was a sinner , when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee s house , brought an alabaster box of ointment ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka shnong , la don ka briew kaba la im ka jingim kaba dap da ka pop . Ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u wan bam ha ka ïing jong u Pharisi , kumta ka la wallam ïa ka dabi alabastar kaba la dap da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih

translation.en: Have ye suffered so many things in vain ? if it be yet in vain .
translation.kha: Hato baroh kaba phi la mad kam don jingmut ei ei ? Da shisha ka don katto katne ka jingmut!

translation.en: And they drew out the staves , that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle , and they were not seen without : and there they are unto this day .
translation.kha: Ïa ki tduh jingbah lah ban ïohi da uno uno uba ïeng pyrshah ha khmat ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam , hynrei ym nawei pat . ( Kita ki dieng jingbah ki dang don hangta haduh mynta . )

translation.en: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come , that they may lay hold on eternal life .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom kin kynshew ïa lade ka spah ka ban long ka nongrim kaba skhem na ka bynta ka lawei . Bad nangta kin lah ban jop ïa ka jingim kaba long ka jingim kaba shisha .

translation.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up , and kissed his sons and his daughters , and blessed them : and Laban departed , and returned unto his place .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Laban u la doh khublei ïa la ki khun ksiew bad ïa la ki khun kynthei , bad u la leit phai pat sha la ïing .

translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Khyndiat na ki khun ki ksiew jong me hi yn sa ïalam noh bad ban pynlong ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .

translation.en: And he provided the first part for himself , because there , in a portion of the lawgiver , was he seated  ; and he came with the heads of the people , he executed the justice of the  Lord  , and his judgments with Israel .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ka jaka kaba bha tam na ka bynta ïa lade , Ïa ka bynta u nongïalam , la ai ha ki . Ki la kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum U  Trai Haba ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki ïalum shi jaka .

translation.en: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast : and they worshipped the beast , saying , Who is like unto the beast ? who is able to make war with him ?
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la mane ïa u Ïakjakor namar ba u la ai ïa la ka bor synshar ha uta u mradkhlaw . Ki la mane ruh ïa uta u mradkhlaw , bad ki la ong ,  Uei uba kum u mradkhlaw ? Uei uba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ?

translation.en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus : even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth–addar , unto Beth–horon the upper  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka ri jong ki longïing ka jait Ephraim : u pud jong ki u sdang na Ataroth Addar ha ka phang mihngi haduh Beth Horon kaba Shaneng ,

translation.en: Then the Pharisees went out , and held a council against him , how they might destroy him .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Pharisi ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynlong ki jingthmu ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And this is the blessing , wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingkyrkhu ba u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , u ai ha ki Israel shuwa ba un ïap .

translation.en: And the servant said unto him , Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u shakri u kylli ,  Kumno lada jia ba kata ka samla kam mon ban iehnoh ïa la ka ïing ban wan ryngkat bad nga sha kane ka ri ? Hato ngan phah noh ïa u khun jong phi sha kata ka ri na kaba phi wan ?

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Ahab u syiem ka Israel , u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u Asa u la long u syiem ka Judah ,

translation.en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father  ; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: bad pynlong ïa ngi ka hima jong ki lyngdoh ban shakri ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong u . Ha U Jisu Khrist , to long ka burom bad ka bor junom la junom ! Amen .

translation.en: And there came in two men , children of Belial , and sat before him : and the men of Belial witnessed against him , even against Naboth , in the presence of the people , saying , Naboth did blaspheme God and the king . Then they carried him forth out of the city , and stoned him with stones , that he died .
translation.kha: Kita ki ar ngut ki riewrunar ki kynnoh pyrshah ïa u ha khmat u paidbah ba u la tim ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem . Bad kumta la sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad lynthem maw ha ban da ïap .

translation.en: Tell others about Jehovah and his ways . —Isaiah 43 :10 .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha kiwei shaphang U Jehobah bad ki lynti jong u .—Isaiah 43 :10 .

translation.en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand , and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti kamon hangta , bad un synreit khyndiat na ka , hynñiew sien hangta ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication , and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her , and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies .
translation.kha: Naba ki jaitbynriew baroh ki la dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ bakhor jong ka jingkwah brai awria jong ka . Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh awria bad ka , bad ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ki la kiew spah bha na ka jingkwah brai bym lah teh lakam jong ka .

translation.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen , and close up the breaches thereof  ; and I will raise up his ruins , and I will build it as in the days of old :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka sngi ka la poi haba ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka hima u Dabid kaba long kum ka ïing kaba la khyllem ha ki jingjot . Ngan shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka . Ngan tei pat ïa ka bad ngan pynlong ïa ka kum ka la ju long mynshuwa .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat sakhi lamler ïano ïano .

translation.en: But he , knowing their thoughts , said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and a house divided against a house falleth .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem ; ka longïing kaba ïa-pait pyrshah ïa lade kan kyllon la ka jong ka jong .

translation.en: When they have a matter , they come unto me  ; and I judge between one and another , and I do make them know the statutes of God , and his laws .
translation.kha: Haba don kano kano ka jingïakajia hapdeng ar ngut , ki wan sha nga , nga hap ban bishar bad rai mano na ki uba dei , bad nga ïathuh ha ki ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ U Blei ki ong .

translation.en: And there ran a young man , and told Moses , and said , Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp .
translation.kha: Uwei u samla u la mareh ban leit ïathuh ha u Moses shaphang kaei ba u Eldad bad u Medad ki leh .

translation.en: And Laban said , It must not be so done in our country , to give the younger before the firstborn .
translation.kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Kam ju dei ka dustur hangne ban ai shuwa ïa ka khun khatduh ban shongkurim ha shuwa ka hynmen .

translation.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound , and with musical instruments of God . And the sons of Jeduthun were porters .
translation.kha: Ïa u Heman bad u Jeduthun ruh la buh ban peit ïa ki turoi bad ki shakuriaw bad kiwei ki jingtem ba pyndonkam ha ka por ba rwai ïa ki jingrwai ïaroh . Ïa ki dkhot jong ka kur u Jeduthun , la buh ban ap phira ïa ki khyrdop .

translation.en: And said ,  Where have ye laid him ?  They said unto him , Lord , come and see .
translation.kha: Hangno phi la tep ïa u ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  To wan bad peit Ko Trai ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion , to give unto them beauty for ashes , the oil of joy for mourning , the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness  ; that they might be called trees of righteousness , the planting of the  Lord  , that he might be glorified .
translation.kha: ban ai ha kito kiba ïam sngewsih ha Seïon ïa ka jingkmen bad jingsngewbha ha ka jaka ka jingsngewsih , ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh ha ka jaka ki ummat kthang . Kin long kum ki dieng ba U  Trai  da lade hi u la thung . Baroh kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Bad ïa U Blei yn ai ka jingïaroh ïa kaei ba u la leh .

translation.en: He answered and said , Who is he , Lord , that I might believe on him ?
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  To ïathuh ïa nga u dei uei , ko Kynrad , khnang ba ngan lah ban ngeit ha u !

translation.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone , and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof  ;
translation.kha: lane ïa ki khunswet ban shahthngan katba ïa lade nga dang bam .

translation.en: And they held their peace . And he took him , and healed him , and let him go  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym ong ei ei . U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew , U la pynkhiah ïa u , bad U la phah noh ïa u .

translation.en: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God , it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei ha ka jingstad jong u , um shym la pynlah ïa ki briew ban ithuh ïa u da ka jingstad jong ki hi . Pynban da kata kaba la khot ka khubor  ba-ibieit  kaba ngi ïalap , U Blei u la ibit ban pynim ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka .

translation.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife : but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife .
translation.kha: Kaba shit khlieh ka thaw ki jingïania , hynrei ka jingïaishah ka wallam ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: So David and his men went to Keilah , and fought with the Philistines , and brought away their cattle , and smote them with a great slaughter . So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit sha Keilah bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ; ki la pynïap bun ngut na ki bad ki la shim ïa ki jingri jong ki . Bad ka la long kumta ba u Dabid u la pyllait im ïa kata ka shnong .

translation.en: Beside those things that are without , that which cometh upon me daily , the care of all the churches .
translation.kha: Bad khlem da pynpaw ïa kiwei pat kiei kiei , man ka sngi la ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta ki balang baroh .

translation.en: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears , therefore I will put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka jingbitar shla jong me bad ïa kata ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan buh ïa u khwai lyngba ka khmut jong me bad u lakam ha ka shyntur jong me , bad ban ïalam pat ïa me na kajuh ka lynti ba me wan .

translation.en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered mortar , and bring it down to the ground , so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered , and it shall fall , and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga thmu ban pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh ba la pushara lieh , ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka , bad ban pynpaw shabar ïa ki maw nongrim . Kan khyllem bad pynïap ïa phi baroh . Te uwei uwei baroh un tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Then believed they his words  ; they sang his praise .
translation.kha: Te ki briew jong u ki la ngeit ïa ki kular jong u bad ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: Take heed in the plague of leprosy , that thou observe diligently , and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you : as I commanded them , so ye shall observe to do .
translation.kha: Haba phi pang  ñiangthohlieh , phi dei ban leh thik kumba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki ong ïa phi , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai ïa kiba nga la ai ha ki .

translation.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous : they shall inherit the land for ever , the branch of my planting , the work of my hands , that I may be glorified .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong pha kin leh baroh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri junom . Nga la thung ïa ki , nga la thaw ïa ki , ban pynpaw ïa ka jingkhraw jong nga sa baroh .

translation.en: Or if a soul swear , pronouncing with his lips to do evil , or to do good , whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u smai khlem da pyrkhat , kam pher la ka long ïa kano kano , u long uba la rem mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .

translation.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee : and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh , that he send the children of Israel out of his land .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga hukum ïa me , bad un ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba un shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .

translation.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure  ; and teach his senators wisdom .
translation.kha: bad ka bor halor ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem bad ka iktiar ban ai jingbthah ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u .

translation.en: For I know that my redeemer liveth , and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth :
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip ba don ha bneng u ban wan ha kaba khatduh ban pynksan ïa nga .

translation.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth , and he shall have no name in the street .
translation.kha: Ka nam jong u ka la kut ha ïing bad shabar ; ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa u .

translation.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon , to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .
translation.kha: bad ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kwah ban wan bad sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .

translation.en: And , behold , thou shalt conceive in thy womb , and bring forth a son , and shalt call his name JESUS .
translation.kha: Phan sa punkhun bad phan kha ïa u khun , bad phan kyrteng ïa u , U Jisu .

translation.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih bniah shapoh bad nga la ïohi ïa ki jingri bad ki mradkhlaw , ki kynja bapar , bad ki sim khlaw .

translation.en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and dieth in them  ; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba hok u sangeh ban leh ïa kaba bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad hadien kata u ïap , u ïap namar ka jingsniew kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: bad da la ka shynriah ti kamon un synreit khyndiat ïa ka , hynñiew sien hangta ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel , and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u phah khot ïa ki Israel baroh bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ban ïakynduh lang ha u Lum Karmel .

translation.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time , and in the world to come life everlasting .
translation.kha: kin ïohpdiang kham bun shah ha kane ka pateng bad ïa ka jingim bymjukut ha ka pateng ka ban wan .

translation.en: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death .
translation.kha: Ka nongshun kaba khatduh ïa kaba dei ban pynjot ka long ka jingïap .
