translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Thou couldest have no power at all against me , except it were given thee from above : therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me don ka bor halor jong nga tang namar ba la ai ha me da U Blei . Kumta u briew uba aiti noh ïa nga ha me u long uba la rem na ka pop kaba kham khraw .

translation.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture , and the laver and his foot ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ,

translation.en: And the sons of Gad  ; Ziphion , and Haggi , Shuni , and Ezbon , Eri , and Arodi , and Areli .
translation.kha: U Gad bad ki khun shynrang jong u : U Sephon , u Haggi , u Shuni , u Esbon , u Eri , u Arod , bad u Areli .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the man s rod , whom I shall choose , shall blossom : and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel , whereby they murmur against you .
translation.kha: Te u diengduh jong uta u briew ïa uba nga la jied un khie lung . Da kumta ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingïaikren khñium jong kine ki Israel pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen , that I might be their God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la pynpaw ïa la ka bor ha ki jaitbynriew baroh da kaba ïalam noh ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga lah ban long U Blei jong ki . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies : my house shall be built in it , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem ban pyn-i jingisynei ïa ka nongbah . Yn pynïeng pat ïa ka Templ jong nga , bad ïa ka nongbah yn tei pat .

translation.en: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the  Lord  , that it is mighty : that ye might fear the  Lord  your God for ever .
translation.kha: Namar kane , uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei un tip haduh katno ka bor jong U  Trai  ka long kaba khraw , bad ba phin burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi junom .

translation.en: Him God raised up the third day , and shewed him openly  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien lai sngi . U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u ban mihpaw ,

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien kane , u nongrah khuri jong u syiem Ijipt bad u nongshet kpu rangbah jong u ki la pynbitar ïa u syiem .

translation.en: Remember , O  Lord  , what is come upon us : consider , and behold our reproach .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , ko  Trai  , ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To khmih ïa ngi , bad peit ïa ka jingjahburom jong ngi .

translation.en: And afterward came out his brother , that had the scarlet thread upon his hand : and his name was called Zerah .
translation.kha: Nangta la kha sa ïa u para jong u , uba don  saisaw ha ka kti jong u , bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Serah .

translation.en: For he said , Because the  Lord  hath sworn that the  Lord  will have war with Amalek from generation to generation .
translation.kha: U ong ruh ,  Rah shajrong ïa ka lama U  Trai  ! U  Trai  un ïai ïaleh ïa ki Amalek junom !

translation.en: And I beheld , and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven , saying with a loud voice , Woe , woe , woe , to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels , which are yet to sound !
translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmih , nga la ïohsngew ïa u pukni uba her shajrong eh jong ka suiñ ba u pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Kaba kordit ! Kaba kordit ! Katno kaba kordit kan long ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei haba ka jingsawa ka mih na ki turoi ïa kaba kita kiwei pat ki lai ngut ki angel kin put .

translation.en: Now among these were of the children of Judah , Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah :
translation.kha: Napdeng kito kiba la shah jied ki long u Daniel , u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah ; baroh na ki , ki dei na ka jait Judah .

translation.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee : thy throne shall be established for ever .
translation.kha: Men ïai don ki khun ki ksiew , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong me ban neh junom . Ka longïing syiem jong me kan ym kut .’

translation.en: For how great is his goodness , and how great is his beauty ! corn shall make the young men cheerful , and new wine the maids .
translation.kha: Katno kaba bha bad kaba itynnat ka ri kan long ! Ki samla kin san kin khlaiñ da u kew bad ka waiñ jong ka .

translation.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant , and of thy people Israel , when they shall pray toward this place : and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place : and when thou hearest , forgive .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong me haba ki phai khmat sha kane ka jaka bad ki duwai . Na ka ïing jong me ha bneng to shahshkor ïa ngi bad to map ruh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And he came near , and kissed him : and he smelled the smell of his raiment , and blessed him , and said , See , the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the  Lord  hath blessed :
translation.kha: Katba u leit kham hajan ban doh ïa u , u Isaak u iw ïa ki jaiñ jong u — bad kumta u la ai ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u . U ong ,  Ka jingsma sngewtynnat u khun jong nga ka long kum ka jingiw ka lyngkha ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu .

translation.en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised , and Ishmael his son .
translation.kha: La otsher ïa ki baroh ar ngut ha kajuh ka sngi ,

translation.en: But when the Comforter is come , whom I will send unto you from the Father , even the Spirit of truth , which proceedeth from the Father , he shall testify of me :
translation.kha: U Nongïarap un wan — U Mynsiem , uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei bad uba wan na U Kpa . Ngan phah ïa u na U Kpa , bad un kren shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: As vinegar to the teeth , and as smoke to the eyes , so is the sluggard to them that send him .
translation.kha: Wat ju ailad ïa u briew uba jaipdeh ban leh ei ei na ka bynta jong phi ; un long kum ka sirka kaba pynshyrkhei ïa ki bniat , lane kumba pynsat ka tdem ïa ki khmat .

translation.en: For she said within herself , If I may but touch his garment , I shall be whole .
translation.kha: Ka la ong ha lade ,  Lada nga tang shu ïohktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , ngan sa koit .

translation.en: For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .
translation.kha: naba U Trai un pyndep kloi kloi ïa ka jingainong ba-pura na ka bynta ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Unto me men gave ear , and waited , and kept silence at my counsel .
translation.kha: Haba nga ai jingmut , ki briew ki sngap jar bad ki shahshkor bha ïa kaei kaba nga ong ;

translation.en: But there was a strong tower within the city , and thither fled all the men and women , and all they of the city , and shut it to them , and gat them up to the top of the tower .
translation.kha: La don uwei u mot baskhem hangta , bad uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ka kynthei ha ka nongbah , kynthup ïa ki nongïalam , ki mareh sha u . Ki khang ïa lade shapoh bad ki kiew shalor ka tnum .

translation.en: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel , Jezebel heard of it  ; and she painted her face , and tired her head , and looked out at a window .
translation.kha: U Jehu u la wan poi ha Jesreel . Ka Jesebel , haba ka la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , ka kyllan rong ïa la ki khmat , ka pynbeit ïa u shñiuh jong ka , bad ka ïeng ban khmih shapoh ka surok na ka jingkhangïit ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father , and said unto him , Let not the king sin against his servant , against David  ; because he hath not sinned against thee , and because his works have been to thee-ward very good :
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïaroh ïa u Dabid ha u Saul bad u ong ,  Pa kynrad , wat leh bymdei ïa u shakri jong phi u Dabid . Um pat ju leh palat ïa phi ; ha kawei ka liang , kat kaba u la leh ka la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa phi .

translation.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Hesekaïah u khun jong u Ahas u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: And it came to pass after two full years , that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal–hazor , which is beside Ephraim : and Absalom invited all the king s sons .
translation.kha: Hadien ar snem , u Absalom u la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot ha Baal Hasor , hajan ka shnong Ephraim , bad u la khot sngewbha ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ban ïadon hangta .

translation.en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Hitherto thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound . And he said unto her , If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web .
translation.kha: Ka Delilah ka ong ïa u Samson ,  Haduh mynta phi dang pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ïa kaba shisha . Ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .  U jubab ,  Lada phi thain ïa kine ki kynthrong shñiuh jong nga hynñiew tylli bad phi pynskhem ïa ki da ki snar ïingjaiñ , ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .

translation.en: Ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , and my servant whom I have chosen : that ye may know and believe me , and understand that I am he : before me there was no God formed , neither shall there be after me .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , phi long ki sakhi jong nga ; nga la jied ïa phi ban long u shakri jong nga , khnang ba phin tip ïa nga bad ngeit ha nga bad sngewthuh ba nga long tang ma nga U Blei . Nalor jong nga ym don uwei pat u blei ; u bym pat ju long bad u ban nym long .

translation.en: For those who wish to make a donation , there is a contribution box .—2 Corinthians 9 :7 .
translation.kha: Kito kiba kwah ban ai sngewbha ki lah thep ha i synduk ba la buh lypa .—2 Korinth 9 :7 .

translation.en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true : wherefore shut thou up the vision  ; for it shall be for many days .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw shaphang ki jingkñia ha ka por janmiet bad mynstep ïa kaba la batai ha me kan urlong shisha . Hynrei buhrieh ïa ka mynta , namar kan shim por shibun ha shuwa ban kan urlong shisha .

translation.en: My son , if thou wilt receive my words , and hide my commandments with thee  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun , to sngewthuh ïa kaei ba nga hikai ïa phi , bad wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub , named Abiathar , escaped , and fled after David .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abiathar , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahimelekh , u la lait im , bad u leit ïasoh bad u Dabid .

translation.en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him , so that he went into a ship , and sat  ; and the whole multitude stood on the shore .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïalum sawdong ïa u , ki la bun katta katta haduh ba u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la shong ha ka , katba ki paidbah ki la ïeng harud duriaw .

translation.en: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight , a perfect and just measure shalt thou have : that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam hok ïa ki mawthew bad ki diengthew kiba beit , khnang ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , that my joy might remain in you , and that your joy might be full .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong nga kan ïoh long ha phi bad ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan long kaba dap pura .

translation.en: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father , will he give him a stone ? or if he ask a fish , will he for a fish give him a serpent ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi kiba long ki kpa phin ai ïa u khun jong phi da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?

translation.en: Dominion and fear are with him , he maketh peace in his high places .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba donbor ; baroh ki dei ban ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa u ; U pynïeng ïa ka hima ba kynja bneng ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the angel of the  Lord  spake these words unto all the children of Israel , that the people lifted up their voice , and wept .
translation.kha: Haba u angel u la kren ïa kane , ki paid Israel baroh ki la sdang ban ïam ,

translation.en: Give them , O  Lord  : what wilt thou give ? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngan kylli na phi ban leh ïa kine ki briew ? Pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei jong ki ! Pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym lah ban sumar ïa ki khunlung jong ki !

translation.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly , whiles thou art in the way with him  ; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and thou be cast into prison .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u wallam ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa phi bad ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , to ïapynbeit noh ïa ka jingïakajia bad u katba dang don ka por ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Shisien ba phi la don hangta , un aiti ïa phi sha u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi sha u pulit , bad un set ïa phi ha ka ïingbyndi .

translation.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might , reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand .
translation.kha: Ki jingbuh jingthoh ïa baroh ki longïing jong ka jait Issakhar ki don phraphew hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

translation.en: ( And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them , they kept the more silence : and he saith , )
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka ktien Hebru , ki la kham sngap jar , bad u Paul u la bteng :

translation.en: The God of Abraham , and of Isaac , and of Jacob , the God of our fathers , hath glorified his Son Jesus  ; whom ye delivered up , and denied him in the presence of Pilate , when he was determined to let him go .
translation.kha: U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak , bad jong u Jakob , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la ai ïa ka burom ba kynja blei ha U Jisu u shakri jong u . Hynrei phi la aiti ïa u ha ki bor synshar , bad phi la kyntait ïa u ha khmat u Pilat , wat hadien ba u Pilat u la rai ban pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the  Lord  , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God .
translation.kha: Phan long kum ka pansngiat kaba itynnat ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Let the  Lord  , the God of the spirits of all flesh , set a man over the congregation ,
translation.kha: A  Trai  uba U Blei , uba long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh , nga kyrpad ïa me to thung ïa u briew uba lah ban ïalam ïa u paidbah ,

translation.en: I charge you , O ye daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , and by the hinds of the field , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , till he please .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa nga , ko ba-ieit jong nga , shano phin ïalam pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong phi ? Hangno kin pynjahthait na ka jingshit ka shiteng sngi ? Balei nga donkam ban wad ïa phi hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong kiwei pat ki nongap langbrot ?

translation.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord , and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink  ; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother s womb .
translation.kha: Un long u briew uba khraw ha khmat U Trai . Um dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ lane ka jingdih kaba khor . Naduh ka jingkha ïa u , yn pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,

translation.en: And Jacob said , Sell me this day thy birthright .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Ngan ai ïa ka lada phi ai shuwa ha nga ïa ki hok jong phi kum u khun nyngkong .

translation.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely , and thy foot shall not stumble .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ïaid da kaba suk ha ki lynti jong phi bad phin ym jynthut .

translation.en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures , which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad na dang khynnah , Me tip sngwthuh ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , kiba lah ban ai ha me ïa ka jingstad kaba ïalam sha ka jingpynim da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: This is the day which the  Lord  hath made  ; we will rejoice and be glad in it .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingjop jong U  Trai  ; to ngin ïakmen , to ngin ïalehkmen !

translation.en: What man of you , having an hundred sheep , if he lose one of them , doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness , and go after that which is lost , until he find it ?
translation.kha: Tharai uwei na phi u don shispah tylli ki langbrot bad u duh noh kawei na ki — kaei kaba un leh ? U ieh ïa kiwei ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki langbrot ha ka jaka bam phlang bad u leit ban wad ïa kata kaba la sakma haduh ba un da shem ïa ka .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus ,
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , ha uba la phah pynbna ïa ka jingim ba la kular kaba ngi don ha U Khrist Jisu —

translation.en: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round , and cut off our name from the earth : and what wilt thou do unto thy great name ?
translation.kha: Ki Kanaan bad baroh kiba hapoh ka ri kin sa ïohsngew ïa kane . Kin sa kerkut ïa ngi , bad kin sa pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ïa ngi ! Bad nangta aïu men leh ban ïada ïa la ka burom ?

translation.en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp .
translation.kha: Uta uba thang ïa ki u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un sum shuwa ba un leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: And they of Beth–shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley : and they lifted up their eyes , and saw the ark , and rejoiced to see it .
translation.kha: Ki nong Beth Shemesh ha kata ka por ki dang ïa-ot kew ha them , bad kynsan haba ki khmied ki la ïohi ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ki dap da ka jingkmen haba ki ïohi ïa ka .

translation.en: And the Jews also assented , saying that these things were so .
translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki la kyrshan ïa kane ka jingmudui bad ki la ong ba kane baroh ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered it also , and the king thereof , into the hand of Israel  ; and he smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein  ; he let none remain in it  ; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ruh ha ki Israel ka jingjop ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa u syiem jong ka . Kim shym la iehnoh wat uwei ruh , hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ha ka . Ki la leh ïa u syiem jong ka kumba ki la leh ïa u syiem ka Jerikho .

translation.en: My son , hear the instruction of thy father , and forsake not the law of thy mother :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba u kpa bad ka kmie jong phi ki ong ïa phi .

translation.en: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia , but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad ; so that we need not to speak any thing .
translation.kha: Naba ym dei tang ba ka khubor shaphang U Trai ka la mih na phi sha kylleng ka Makedonia bad Akhaïa , hynrei ka khubor shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Blei ka la par kylleng . Ym don shuh kano kano te ba ngi donkam ban ong .

translation.en: And Jacob vowed a vow , saying , If God will be with me , and will keep me in this way that I go , and will give me bread to eat , and raiment to put on ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u pynlong ka jingsmai ha U  Trai  :  Lada men long ryngkat bad nga bad ïada ïa nga ha kane ka jingleit jong nga , bad men ai ka bam ka dih bad ka kup ka sem ïa nga ,

translation.en: The righteous shall never be removed : but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki ïoh ka jingsngewskhem borabor , hynrei ki bymman kin ym lah ban im ha ka ri .

translation.en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life , save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u leh ïa kane namar ba u Dabid u la leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad um ju lyndet ïa kano kano na ki hukum jong u , lait noh tang ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad u Uriah u nong Hit .

translation.en: You could talk about a problem that your children encountered at school and how to deal with it .

translation.en: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon , and abode in the rock Rimmon four months .
translation.kha: Hynrei hynriewspah ngut na ki , ki lait bad ki phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon , bad ki sah hangta saw bnai .

translation.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it : it is a statute for ever unto the  Lord   ; it shall be wholly burnt .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka por baroh ka ban sa wan ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh dei ban leh da uwei pa uwei u Lyngdoh uba hiarpateng na u Aaron u ban shakri kum u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Dei ba yn thang lut khoit ïa ka kum ka jingkñia sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered , from twenty years old and above , shall give an offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la shah ñiew ha ka jingkheiñbriew , kata , naduh uba arphew snem shaneng , u dei ban siew sha nga ïa kane ka dor ba la buh .

translation.en: He hath builded against me , and compassed me with gall and travail .
translation.kha: U la set ïa nga ha ka ïingbyndi jong ka jingjynjar bad ka jinglyng-a .

translation.en: Again , if two lie together , then they have heat : but how can one be warm alone ?
translation.kha: Lada ka khriat , ki ar ngut ki lah ban ïathiah lang bad ban neh ha ka jingsyiad , hynrei kumno phin pynneh jingsyiad tang ma phi da lade hi ?

translation.en: The  Lord  our God be with us , as he was with our fathers : let him not leave us , nor forsake us :
translation.kha: To U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi un don ryngkat bad ngi , kumba u la don ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ; to un ym iehnoh ïa ngi lane lyndet ïa ngi ;

translation.en: And the other woman said , Nay  ; but the living is my son , and the dead is thy son . And this said , No  ; but the dead is thy son , and the living is my son . Thus they spake before the king .
translation.kha: Hynrei kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong ,  Em ! u khunlung uba dang im u dei u jong nga , bad uba la ïap u dei u jong pha !  Kata ka kynthei kaba nyngkong ka jubab ,  Em ! u khunlung uba la ïap u dei u jong pha , bad uba dang im dei u jong nga .  Bad kumta ki ïakajia ha khmat u syiem .

translation.en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar , and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem : and since that time even until now hath it been in building , and yet it is not finished .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sheshbassar u la wan bad buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka ; ka jingtrei ka la ïaid naduh kata ka por haduh mynta , hynrei ym pat pyndep ïa ka Templ .’

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a censer , and put fire therein from off the altar , and put on incense , and go quickly unto the congregation , and make an atonement for them : for there is wrath gone out from the  Lord   ; the plague is begun .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Shim ïa u khiew buh ding jong phi , buh hangta ïa u rnga uba rhem na ka duwan , bad buh khyndiat ka jingiwbih halor ki rnga . Nangta leit rah kloi kloi ïa ka sha u paidbah bad pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki . Pynkloi ! Ka jingbitar U  Trai  ka la mih , bad ka khlam ruh ka la sdang .

translation.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death , and the father the son  ; and children shall rise up against their parents , and shall cause them to be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin aiti noh ïa la ki hynmen ki para ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun , ki khun ki ïeng pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin aiti ïa ki ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And I besought the  Lord  at that time , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por nga kyrpad jur ,

translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried , and she bound him with them .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki syiem Philistia ki wanrah ha ka Delilah hynñiew tylli ki  saisiej thymmai ki bym pat ïap saw , bad ka khum ïa u Samson da ki .

translation.en: David also arose afterward , and went out of the cave , and cried after Saul , saying , My lord the king . And when Saul looked behind him , David stooped with his face to the earth , and bowed himself .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid ruh u mih shabar hadien jong u bad u khot ïa u ,  Syiem kynrad !  U Saul u phai dien , bad u Dabid u dem ngon sha khyndew ha ka jingburom

translation.en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun , namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt .
translation.kha: Hangne ka don kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba nga la ïohi ha ka pyrthei : Ki briew ki lah ban bat tang shipor ïa la ka pisa haba ki lah ban donkam ïa ka ,

translation.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed , or my mouth hath kissed my hand :
translation.kha: Ym pat la ïalam bakla ïa nga ban burom ïa ki da kaba doh ïa la ki kti kum ka jingnguh ïa ki .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ym don uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei lymda kha pat ïa u .

translation.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness , and drink the wine of violence .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh bymman bad ka jingleh jubor ki long kum ka bam ka dih ïa ki .

translation.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all , Watch .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi , te , nga ong ïa baroh : To khmih bha !

translation.en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away : and every branch that beareth fruit , he purgeth it , that it may bring forth more fruit .
translation.kha: U ngor noh ïa kano kano ka tnat kaba don ha nga ka bymseisoh , bad u khyllad ïa kano kano ka tnat kaba seisoh , khnang ba kan long khuid bad kan kham seisoh .

translation.en: And they went out , and preached that men should repent .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit bad ïalap ba ki briew kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth , and pitched in the wilderness of Paran .
translation.kha: Nangta ki mihnoh na Haseroth bad ki pynïeng dara ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Paran .

translation.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God : but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had .
translation.kha: Naba kiwei ki la ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki na kaei kaba ki don , ban ym ktah ïa ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la ai ïa baroh kaba ka donkam ïa lade .

translation.en: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong phi ki mane ha ki duwan bad ïa ki dak kiba la pynïeng na ka bynta ka blei Asherah harud jong uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ha ki kliar lum

translation.en: They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters  ; and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre , to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa , according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ai pisa ban siew ïa ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng bad ïa ka jingbam jingdih bad ka umphniang Olib ban phah sha ki nongbah jong ka Tyros bad Sidon kum ka jingïabujli na ka bynta ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon , ban wallam lyngba ka duriaw sha Joppa . Ïa kane baroh la leh da ka jingai jingbit u Syros , u patsha ka Persia .

translation.en: And Jesus went forth , and saw a great multitude , and was moved with compassion toward them , and he healed their sick .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hiar na ka lieng , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun , ïa ka dohnud jong u la pyndap da ka jingisynei ïa ki , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la pang .

translation.en: For the eyes of the  Lord  run to and fro throughout the whole earth , to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him . Herein thou hast done foolishly : therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khmih bha ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , ban ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa kito kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki ïaineh ha u . Me la leh bieit , bad kumta naduh mynta men don borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma .

translation.en: Thus saith thy Lord the  Lord  , and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people , Behold , I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling , even the dregs of the cup of my fury  ; thou shalt no more drink it again :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ïada ïa phi bad u ong ,  Nga shim noh ïa ka khuri kaba nga la ai ha phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga . Phin ym hap ban dih shuh ïa ka waiñ kaba pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid sheng sheng .

translation.en: And Shimei arose , and saddled his ass , and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants : and Shimei went , and brought his servants from Gath .
translation.kha: Haba u Shimei u ïohsngew ba ki don ha Gath , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u la leit sha u Syiem Akhish ha Gath , ban wad ïa la ki mraw . U la lap ïa ki bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ki sha ïing .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was gracious unto them , and had compassion on them , and had respect unto them , because of his covenant with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and would not destroy them , neither cast he them from his presence as yet .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  u long uba bha bad leh-isynei ïa ki . Um shah ba yn pynjot ïa ki , hynrei u ïarap ïa ki , namar ka jutang jong u bad u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob . Um pat ju klet ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: And truly , if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out , they might have had opportunity to have returned .
translation.kha: Kim shym la im sngi ban pyrkhat ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba ki la iehnoh ; lada ki leh kumta , kin jin da la ïoh ka kabu ban leit phai pat .

translation.en: But if I do , though ye believe not me , believe the works : that ye may know , and believe , that the Father is in me , and I in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada nga leh ïa ki , wat lada phim ngeit ïa nga , phi la dei ban ngeit ïa ki kam jong nga , khnang ba phi lah ban tip shi syn tip ba U Kpa u long ha nga bad ba nga long ha U Kpa .

translation.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried , and the fatherless , and him that had none to help him .
translation.kha: Haba kiba duk ki lynñiar , nga ïarap ïa ki ; nga ai jingïarap ïa ki khunswet ki bym don lad shuh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they fled from before Israel , and were in the going down to Beth–horon , that the  Lord  cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah , and they died : they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword .
translation.kha: Katba ki Amor ki dang phet arsut na ka khim lum na ki shipai Israel , U  Trai  u pynhap halor jong ki ïa u phria uba heh baroh shi lynter lynti haduh Asekah . Kham bun ki la ïap na u phria ban na kaba ki shah pynïap ha ki Israel .

translation.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous : but with kings are they on the throne  ; yea , he doth establish them for ever , and they are exalted .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa kito kiba hok ; u shah ïa ki ban synshar kum ki syiem bad u shah ïa ki ba kin ïoh ka jingpyndonburom junom .

translation.en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand , and put it upon Joseph s hand , and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen , and put a gold chain about his neck  ;
translation.kha: U syiem u law noh na ka shynriah ti jong u ïa ka sati kaba don ka muhor syiem bad u pyndeng ïa ka ha ka shynriah ti jong u Joseph . U pynkup ruh ïa u da ka jaiñ linen bani , bad u pyndeng ïa u kynjri ksiar ha ka ryndang jong u .

translation.en: And the sons of Uzziel  ; Mishael , and Elzaphan , and Zithri .
translation.kha: U Ussiel ruh u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mishael , u Elsaphan , bad u Sithri .

translation.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels , and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka nongbah Rabbah sha ka jaka ba ri ïa ki ut , bad ïa ka ri ki Ammon baroh kawei sha ka jaka ban ri ïa ki langbrot , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters ? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing .
translation.kha: Mem shym la ailad ba ngan ïoh doh ïa la ki khun ksiew bad ki khun kynthei jong nga . Kato ka long ka kam bieit ban leh !

translation.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord   ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock s head , and kill the bullock before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un wanlam ïa uta u masi sha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ , un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad un pynïap ïa u hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: And now , behold , the king walketh before you : and I am old and grayheaded  ; and , behold , my sons are with you : and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day .
translation.kha: bad mynta une u syiem un ïalam ïa phi . Nga te nga la tymmen bad phuh  ñiuhlieh , hynrei ki khun shynrang jong nga ki don bad phi . Nga la long u nongïalam jong phi naduh ba nga dang samla haduh mynta .

translation.en: Hear , O ye kings  ; give ear , O ye princes  ; I , even I , will sing unto the  Lord   ; I will sing praise to the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: To sngap , phi ki syiem ! Pynshahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ! Ngan rwai bad tem jingtem ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city , which was before the king s gate .
translation.kha: U Hathakh u leit sha u Mordekai ha ka phyllaw ka nongbah ha ka khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: This is a faithful saying , and worthy of all acceptation , that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners ; of whom I am chief .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha , ïa kaba dei ban pdiang pura bad ban ngeit : U Khrist Jisu u la wan sha ka pyrthei ïa ka ban pynim ïa ki nongpop , nga long uba sniew tam na ki ,

translation.en: And of Jezebel also spake the  Lord  , saying , The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Bad shaphang ka Jesebel , U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka ha ka nongbah Jesreel hi .’

translation.en: And God said , This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you , for perpetual generations :
translation.kha: Kum ka dak jong kata ka jutang baïaineh junom ïa kaba nga la pynlong bad phi lem bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , nga buh ïa ka ryntieh jong nga ha u lyoh .

translation.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey , to shed blood , and to destroy souls , to get dishonest gain .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah sorkar ki long kum ki suri kiba patar lyngkhot ïa ki mrad ba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap briew ba kin ïoh riewspah .

translation.en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness : your clothes are not waxen old upon you , and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot .
translation.kha: Sawphew snem U  Trai  u la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap , hynrei ki jaiñkup jong phi kim shym man rim , bad ki juti jong phi kim shym jot .

translation.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea  ; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith .
translation.kha: Pha la long ruh ka nuti ïa ki nong Babilonia , kata ka jaitbynriew ki nongkhaïi , hynrei kita ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .

translation.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch .
translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por katto katne ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la leit na Jerusalem sha Antiokh .

translation.en: For word came unto the king of Nineveh , and he arose from his throne , and he laid his robe from him , and covered him with sackcloth , and sat in ashes .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem ka Ninebeh u la ïohsngew shaphang kata , u ïeng joit na la ka khet , u law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u shong ha u dpei .

translation.en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem : and it shall be lifted up , and inhabited in her place , from Benjamin s gate unto the place of the first gate , unto the corner gate , and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king s winepresses .
translation.kha: Ïa ka thain baroh kawei naduh Geba ha ka phang bashatei bad shaduh Rimmon ha ka phang bashathie , yn pynmadan . Ka Jerusalem kan ïeng halor ka ri sawdong jong ka ; ka nongbah kan kot naduh ka Khyrdop Benjamin shaduh ka Khyrdop Kyndong , ha kaba la ju don ka khyrdop ba-mynshuwa , bad na u Mot Hananel sha ki jaka khñiot waiñ jong u syiem .

translation.en: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise ; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty ;
translation.kha: U Blei u la jied khnang ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka long kaba ibieit khnang ban pynlehrain ïa kiba stad , bad u la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka long kaba tlot khnang ban pynlehrain ïa kiba donbor .

translation.en: And ye my flock , the flock of my pasture , are men , and I am your God , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ki langbrot jong nga , ka kynhun kaba nga bsa , phi long ki briew jong nga , bad nga long U Blei jong phi ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees , and certain of the scribes , which came from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la lah wan na Jerusalem ki la ïalum sawdong ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And say , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O kings of Judah , and inhabitants of Jerusalem  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , the which whosoever heareth , his ears shall tingle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ,  Ko ki syiem jong ka Judah bad ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . Ngan wallam kaba kum kane ka jingpynjot ha kane ka jaka ba uwei pa uwei baroh uba ïohsngew shaphang jong ka un kyndit .

translation.en: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim , whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong syiem ïa u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u Josaïah u syiem ka Judah , ha ka jaka u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim .

translation.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
translation.kha: Kumta ki pynhiar kloi kloi ïa la ki byrni ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses

translation.en: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city , knit together as one man .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki rangbah ha Israel ki ïalumlang na ka bynta kawei ka jingthmu — ban tur ïaleh ïa kata ka shnong .

translation.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow , of things in heaven , and things in earth , and things under the earth ;
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kum ka burom ïa ka kyrteng U Jisu baroh ki jingthaw ha bneng , ha pyrthei bad ha ka pyrthei hapoh kin dem khrup ha ki khohsiew jong ki ,

translation.en: So the king died , and was brought to Samaria  ; and they buried the king in Samaria .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Ahab u la ïap . Ïa ka met jong u la kit bad la tep ha Samaria .

translation.en: But the women , and the little ones , and the cattle , and all that is in the city , even all the spoil thereof , shalt thou take unto thyself  ; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi lah ban shim sha lade ïa ki kynthei , ki khun rit , ki jingri jingdup , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha kata ka shnong . Phi lah ban rah ïa kata baroh kaba dei ka jong ki nongshun jong phi . U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: And he said ,  Take heed that ye be not deceived : for many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and the time draweth near : go ye not therefore after them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Sumar ; wat shah shukor . Kiba bun ki rangbah , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma u !’ bad , ‘ Ka por ka la poi !’ Hynrei wat bud ïa ki .

translation.en: It shall not be quenched night nor day  ; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever : from generation to generation it shall lie waste  ; none shall pass through it for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Kan ing mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad ka tdem kan kiew na ka junom . Ka khyndew kan sah lehnoh-ei na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad yn ym don shuh u ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .

translation.en: And they shall fall one upon another , as it were before a sword , when none pursueth : and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies .
translation.kha: Phin ïatyngkhuh para ma phi , wat la ym don uba beh ïa phi , bad phin ym lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa uno uno u nongshun .

translation.en: Pray for us : for we trust we have a good conscience , in all things willing to live honestly .
translation.kha: To ïai duwai namar jong ngi . Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi don ka jingïatiplem kaba khuid , namar ngi kwah ban leh ïa kaba dei ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: Then Peter took him , and began to rebuke him , saying , Be it far from thee , Lord : this shall not be unto thee .
translation.kha: U Petros u la shim kyrpang ïa U sharud bad u la sdang ban mai ïa u ,  U Blei un ym shah ïa kata , ko Trai !  u la ong .  Kata kan ym jia da lei lei ha me !

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amasaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants , Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours , and we be still , and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria ?
translation.kha: U Ahab u kylli ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Balei ba ngim shym la leh ei ei ban ïohknieh pat ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead na u syiem Syria ? Ka dei ka jong ngi !

translation.en: And he sware unto her , Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me , I will give it thee , unto the half of my kingdom .
translation.kha: Da ki jingsmai ba bunsien u la ong ha ka ,  Nga smai ba ngan ai ha pha kano kano kaba pha pan , wat haduh shiteng ka hima jong nga !

translation.en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer , while his heart is hot , and overtake him , because the way is long , and slay him  ; whereas he was not worthy of death , inasmuch as he hated him not in time past .
translation.kha: Lada don tang kawei ka shnong , ka lynti shata ka lah ban jngai than , bad uta uba wad kput u lah ban lap ïa u bad ha la ka jingbitar u lah ban pynïap ïa u briew u bym dei hok ban ïap , namar um shym don ka jingïashun bad la u paramarjan mynshuwa .

translation.en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men , that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , and said , How do ye advise that I may answer this people ?
translation.kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongaibuit jong u Solomon u kpa jong u ,  Ka jubab aïu phi ai jingmut ban ai ïa kine ki briew ?  U kylli .

translation.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab s name , and sealed them with his seal , and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city , dwelling with Naboth .
translation.kha: Nangta ka thoh katto katne ki shithi , bad ka soi ïa ki ha ka kyrteng u Ahab , ka shonshab ïa ki da ka muhor jong u , bad ka phah ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel .

translation.en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the  Lord  , and whose hope the  Lord  is .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan kyrkhu ïa u briew uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha nga .

translation.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions , and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u leit ha khmat u syiem ka Ijipt , U Blei u la ai ha u ka akor kaba pynsngewbha bad ka jingstad ; bad u syiem u la pynlong lyngskor ïa u Joseph halor ka ri bad ka longïing syiem .

translation.en: And he said ,  Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God : but to others in parables  ; that seeing they might not see , and hearing they might not understand .
translation.kha: bad u la jubab ,  Ïa ka jingtip ïa kiba rieh jong ka Hima U Blei la ai ha phi , hynrei ha kiwei pat ka wan ha ki pharshi , khnang ba ki lah ban peit hynrei kim ïohi , bad shahshkor hynrei kim shemphang .

translation.en: And they went up on the breadth of the earth , and compassed the camp of the saints about , and the beloved city : and fire came down from God out of heaven , and devoured them .
translation.kha: Ki la saphriang kylleng ka pyrthei bad ki la kerkut ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki briew jong U Blei bad ïa ka nongbah kaba u ieit . Hynrei ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall : and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee : for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kynroh da ka rnong tylli ha ka jingïadei bad ki . Kin ïakhun pyrshah ïa me , hynrei kin ym jop ïa me . Ngan long bad me ban ïada ïa me bad sumar pynim ïa me .

translation.en: Who delivered us from so great a death , and doth deliver : in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us ;
translation.kha: Na kiba kum kita ki jingma bashyrkhei jong ka jingïap u la pynim ïa ngi , bad un pynim ïa ngi ; bad ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha u ba un pynim biang ïa ngi , kumba phi ïarap ïa ngi lyngba ki jingduwai lem jong phi na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Behold , the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields , which is of you kept back by fraud , crieth : and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth .
translation.kha: Phim pat siew bainong ei ei ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ki lyngkha jong phi . To shahshkor ïa ki jingmudui jong ki ! Ki jingkyang jong kito kiba la lum ïa ki jingot ki la poi sha ki shkor jong U Blei , U Trai Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: The posts went out , being hastened by the king s commandment , and the decree was given in Shushan the palace . And the king and Haman sat down to drink  ; but the city Shushan was perplexed .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum u syiem ïa ka hukum la pyntip paidbah ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima , bad ki nongrah-khubor ki rah ïa ka khubor sha ki jylla . U syiem bad u Haman ki shong bad ïadih sngewbha katba ka nongbah Susa ka la don hapdeng ka jingkulmar .

translation.en: They did cry there , Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise  ; he hath passed the time appointed .
translation.kha: To ai da ka kyrteng bathymmai ïa u syiem ka Ijipt — ‘ U riew kob-pia uba la duh ei ïa la ka kabu’ .

translation.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs , and carried it into a land of traffick  ; he set it in a city of merchants .
translation.kha: kaba u la rah sha ka ri jingkhaïi bad u la buh ha ka nongbah ki nongkhaïi .

translation.en: And ye answered me , and said , The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do .
translation.kha: Bad phi ruh phi ïasngewdei ïa kata kaba bha ban leh .

translation.en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear ; but of power , and of love , and of a sound mind .
translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ha ngi um pynlong ïa ngi kiba khawpud ; pynban , U Mynsiem jong u , u pyndap ïa ngi da ka bor , ka jingieit , bad ka bor halor lade .

translation.en: Seeing many things , but thou observest not  ; opening the ears , but he heareth not .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , phi la ïohi shibun bha , hynrei ka don jingmut aïu ïa phi ? Phi don ki shkor ban sngew , hynrei phi ïohsngew aïu da shisha ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him : and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon  ; and they two made a league together .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bat la ka kular bad u la ai ka jingstad ïa u Solomon . La don ka jingïasuk hapdeng u Hiram bad u Solomon , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki pynlong ka jingïateh lok .

translation.en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before , that ye might have a second benefit ;
translation.kha: Nga la sngewthikna bha shaphang kane baroh kumta nga la buh ki jingthmu nyngkong eh ban wan jngoh ïa phi , khnang ba phin ïoh jingkyrkhu ar shah .

translation.en: How canst thou say , I am not polluted , I have not gone after Baalim ? see thy way in the valley , know what thou hast done : thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways  ;
translation.kha: Kumno me lah ban ong ba mem shym la pyntngit ïa lade , ba mem pat ju mane ïa u Baal ? Ha khmih kumno me la leh pop ha ka them ; ha peit kaei me la leh . Me long kum ka ut khlaw ha ka por jingkwah shongkha jong ka , kaba mareh laitluid kylleng ,

translation.en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families  ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jaka ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ïa ki longïing kiba sah na ka jait Manasseh : u Abieser , u Helek , u Asriel , u Shekhem , u Hepher , bad u Shemida . Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph bad ki long ki khlieh jong ki longïing .

translation.en: He burneth part thereof in the fire  ; with part thereof he eateth flesh  ; he roasteth roast , and is satisfied : yea , he warmeth himself , and saith , Aha , I am warm , I have seen the fire :
translation.kha: Da katto katne ki dieng u pynmeh ding ; u syang doh , u bam ïa ka , bad u kdang . U pynsyaid ïa lade bad u ong ,  Katno kaba sngewtynnat bad sngewsyiad ! Katno ka rhem ka ding !

translation.en: And as the ark of the  Lord  came into the city of David , Michal Saul s daughter looked through a window , and saw king David leaping and dancing before the  Lord   ; and she despised him in her heart .
translation.kha: Katba dang wallam ïa ka Synduk shapoh ka nongbah , ka Mikhal , ka khun jong u Saul , ka la peit na ka jingkhangïit bad ka la ïohi ïa u Syiem Dabid ba u shad bad kynthih kylleng sawdong ha ka jingshad bakyntang , bad ka la i ngiah ïa u .

translation.en: As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering : there is one law for them : the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .
translation.kha: Don tang kawei ka aiñ kaba ïadei lang ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat : ka doh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto him , Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  To da khmih bha ba men ym phah noh ïa u khun jong nga shata !

translation.en: And Eltekeh , and Gibbethon , and Baalath ,
translation.kha: ka Eltekeh , ka Gibbethon , ka Baalath ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall persuade Ahab , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one said on this manner , and another said on that manner .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli , ‘ Uei u ban shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’

translation.en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king , My lord , O king , the iniquity be on me , and on my father s house : and the king and his throne be guiltless .
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad ,  ka ong ,  ïa kano kano kaba phi leh , ma nga bad la ka longïing ngin shim ïa ka jingshah kynnoh ; ma phi bad la ka longïing syiem phi lait .

translation.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water  ; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar : it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour , and an offering made by fire unto the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa langbrot , bad u sait ïa ki doh jem bad ki kjat-dien da ka um , bad u thang ïa ka khlieh , ïa ka khleiñ bad ïa ki lyngkhot doh baroh ha ka duwan , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kane ka jingainguh thang ka long ka jingainguh bam , bad ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year , in the eleventh month , on the first day of the month , that Moses spake unto the children of Israel , according unto all that the  Lord  had given him in commandment unto them  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba khatwei , ha ka snem kaba sawphew hadien ba ki la mih na Ijipt , u Moses u ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ban ong ha ki ,

translation.en: And Solomon said unto God , Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father , and hast made me to reign in his stead .
translation.kha: U Solomon u jubab ,  Me ju ïai pynpaw ka jingieit bakhraw ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga , bad mynta ba me la shah ïa nga ban long syiem hadien jong u .

translation.en: Fear thou not , O Jacob my servant , saith the  Lord  : for I am with thee  ; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee : but I will not make a full end of thee , but correct thee in measure  ; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished .
translation.kha: Ngan wan ha phi bad pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki hima baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan nym shah ba phin lait khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan lehhok . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  shall raise him up a king over Israel , who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day : but what ? even now .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un buh ïa u syiem halor ki Israel u ban pynduh syndon ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Jeroboam .

translation.en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen , and disperse thee in the countries , and will consume thy filthiness out of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong pha sha man ki ri bad ki hima bad ngan pynkut noh ïa ki kam sniew jong pha .

translation.en: David therefore departed thence , and escaped to the cave Adullam : and when his brethren and all his father s house heard it , they went down thither to him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u phet krad na ka nongbah Gath bad u leit sha ka krem hajan ka nongrit Adullam . Haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u bad kiwei pat ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u ki tip ba u don hangta , ki la ïasoh bad u .

translation.en: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king , and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kane ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha nga , ym namar ba nga kham stad ban ïa uno uno uwei pat , hynrei khnang ba u Syiem Kynrad u lah ban ïoh tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jong phi bad shemphang ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba la wan ha phi .

translation.en: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtoreth , and served the  Lord  only .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki bret noh ïa ki bleithaw u Baal bad ka Astarte , bad ki la mane tang ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit , he cannot enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ym don uba lah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei khlem da kha na ka um bad na U Mynsiem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh s army ,
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la kynran dien noh na Jerusalem namar ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la wan .

translation.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees , whereof she hath said , These are my rewards that my lovers have given me : and I will make them a forest , and the beasts of the field shall eat them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjulor ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur jong ka , kiba ka ju ong ba kiba ieit jong ka ki ai ïa ka namar ba ka la shakri ïa ki . Ngan pynkylla ri khlaw ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki brisoh jong ka ; ki mradkhlaw kin pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied  ; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don nongïathuhlypa u ban sngewsarong ïa ki jingïohipaw jong u lane leh kum u nongïathuhlypa lane kup ïa ka jaiñkup bakhain jong u nongïathuhlypa khnang ban shukor ïa ki briew .

translation.en: I will also vex the hearts of many people , when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations , into the countries which thou hast not known .
translation.kha: Shibun ki jaitbynriew kin shah pynshitom haba ngan pynphriang ïa ka khubor jingpynjot ïa me lyngba ki ri kiba mem pat ju ïohsngew .

translation.en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge , and said , Be strong and of a good courage : for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them : and I will be with thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u kren ha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad u ong ha u ,  Long uba sngewskhem bha bad uba kut jingmut , namar me men ïalam ïa ki Israel sha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , bad ngan don ryngkat bad me .

translation.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos , they came to Perga in Pamphylia : and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Paul bad ki paralok jong u ki la leit da ka lieng na Paphos , bad ki la wan poi sha Perga , ka nongbah ha Pamphylia , ha kaba u Ïoannis Markos u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Because he hath loosed my cord , and afflicted me , they have also let loose the bridle before me .
translation.kha: Namar ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga uba tlot bad u bym lah leh ei ei , ki phai pyrshah ïa nga da ka jingbitar jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness  ; even Israel , when I went to cause him to rest .
translation.kha: Ha ka ri shyiap nga la pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei ïa kito ki briew kiba la lait na ka jingïap . Haba ki paid Israel ki la thrang ban ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait , nga la paw ha ki na sha jngai bah .

translation.en: And David said unto the young man that told him , How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead ?
translation.kha: Kumno me tip ba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la ïap ?  u Dabid u la kylli ïa u .

translation.en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Shaphan ,  Nga la shem ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum hangne ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And say unto the people of the land , Thus saith the Lord  God  of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and of the land of Israel  ; They shall eat their bread with carefulness , and drink their water with astonishment , that her land may be desolate from all that is therein , because of the violence of all them that dwell therein .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ba kane ka dei ka khubor jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem kiba dang shong dang sah ha ka ri jong ki : Kin kyiuh haba ki bam bad kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng haba ki dih . Ïa ka ri jong ki yn sloit lyngkhuit , namar uwei uwei baroh uba shong hangta u long uba thurmur .

translation.en: And said unto them , Ye men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men .
translation.kha: bad nangta u la ong ha ka Dorbar ,  Ko para Israel , da sumar ïa kaei kaba phi leh ïa kine ki briew .

translation.en: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness  ; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach :
translation.kha: Suh ki patlun lyngkot kiba da ka jaiñ linen , kiba kot naduh syngkai haduh lbong , khnang ba kin ym thad burom ïa lade .

translation.en: But the people took of the spoil , sheep and oxen , the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God in Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong nga kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam ba ki la ïoh kurup ; pynban , ki la wallam ïa ki hangne ha Gilgal ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Now where remission of these is , there is no more offering for sin .
translation.kha: Kumta haba la map ïa kine , ym donkam shuh ka jingainguh ban kit noh ïa ki pop .

translation.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him : and great multitudes came together to hear , and to be healed by him of their infirmities .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ka la kham phriang kylleng , bad ki paid byllien ki la wan ban sngap ïa u bad ban ïoh jingpynkhiah na ki jingpang jong ki .

translation.en: And next him was Jehozabad , and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war .
translation.kha: Uba hapoh jong u ha ka jingïalam ïa ki shipai u dei u Jehosabad uba long halor ki shi lakh phraphew hajar ngut ki rangbah , kiba la kieng atiar bha na ka bynta ka thma .

translation.en: Begin by getting an overall idea of the subject .
translation.kha: Nyngkong eh , pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingmut ba pura jong ka phang .

translation.en: Behold , Rebekah is before thee , take her , and go , and let her be thy master s son s wife , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka don hangne ; to shim bad ïalam ïa ka . Ai ba kan long ka tnga jong u khun u kynrad jong phi , kumba U  Trai  hi da lade u la kren .

translation.en: If so be they will hearken , and turn every man from his evil way , that I may repent me of the evil , which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings .
translation.kha: Lehse ki briew kin shahshkor bad iehnoh ïa la ki lynti basniew . Lada ki leh kumta , te ngan kylla ïa la ka jingmut shaphang ka jingpynjot kaba nga la thmu ban wallam halor jong ki na ka bynta ki kam bymman jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he interpreted to us , so it was  ; me he restored unto mine office , and him he hanged .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei ki la urlong kumba u la ong : Phi la buh biang ïa nga ha kajuh ka kyrdan , hynrei phi la pynïap noh ïa u nongshet kpu .

translation.en: Go up to the mountain , and bring wood , and build the house  ; and I will take pleasure in it , and I will be glorified , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynta to leit kiew sha ki lumrit , pynïoh ïa ki dieng shna ïing , bad tei pat ïa ka Templ ; te ngan sngewbha ha ka bad ïa nga yn mane kumba ka dei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,

translation.en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour : and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine , the fourth part of an hin .
translation.kha: Ryngkat bad uta , phin ai ruh ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Phin ai lang ruh bad kata ka jingkñia shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh dih .

translation.en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan , and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan phai na ka wah Jordan uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem sha ka ri shyiap ,

translation.en: And they came unto John , and said unto him , Rabbi , he that was with thee beyond Jordan , to whom thou barest witness , behold , the same baptizeth , and all men come to him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit sha u Ïoannis bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , phi kynmaw ïa u briew uba la don lem bad phi ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ïa uba phi la kren shaphang jong u ? Ha khmih , u la pynbaptis mynta , bad baroh ki la leit sha u !

translation.en: And in the same house remain , eating and drinking such things as they give : for the labourer is worthy of his hire . Go not from house to house .
translation.kha: Sah ha kata kajuh ka ïing , bam bad dih ïa kano kano kaba ki ai ïa phi , naba u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bainong jong u . Wat leit sawdong na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat .

translation.en: And he that smiteth his father , or his mother , shall be surely put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba shoh ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And these are the garments which they shall make  ; a breastplate , and an ephod , and a robe , and a broidered coat , a mitre , and a girdle : and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother , and his sons , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh : ka jingdeng shadem , ka ephod , ka barandi , ka sopti ba la suh pynpur itynnat , ka jaiñspong , bad ka jaiñ panpoh . Kin suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u khnang ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way , and said unto them ,
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kiew sha Jerusalem , u la shim kyrpang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la kren jar jar ha ki , katba ki dang ïa-ïaid .

translation.en: Smite a scorner , and the simple will beware : and reprove one that hath understanding , and he will understand knowledge .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewmeng dei ban pynshitom , khnang ba ki briew ki bym da sngewthuh bha kin ïoh jinghikai . Lada phi long uba stad , phin ïoh jinghikai haba pynbeit ïa phi .

translation.en: And judgment is turned away backward , and justice standeth afar off : for truth is fallen in the street , and equity cannot enter .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbishar hok la beh noh , bad ka hok kam lah ban wan hajan . Ka jingshisha ka kyllon ha ki lynti shnong , bad ka hok kam don jaka hangta .

translation.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him , saying , Of a truth thou art the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran hapoh ka lieng ki la mane ïa U Jisu .  Da shisha me long U Khun U Blei !  ki la pynbna .

translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son , they said among themselves , This is the heir  ; come , let us kill him , and let us seize on his inheritance .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u khun , ki la ong ha lade , ‘ Une u long u khun jong u trai . Ale , to ngin pynïap ïa u , bad ngin ïoh ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u !’

translation.en: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite , the porter toward the east , was over the freewill offerings of God , to distribute the oblations of the  Lord  , and the most holy things .
translation.kha: U Kore u khun jong u Imnah , u Lebi uba long u rangbah ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Mihngi jong ka Templ , u long u khlieh ha ka jingpdiang ïa ki jingai ba ai sha U  Trai  bad ha kaba sam ïa ki .

translation.en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife , and said , The  Lord  give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the  Lord . And they went unto their own home .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eli u ju kyrkhu ïa u Elkanah bad ka tnga jong u , bad u ong ha u Elkanah ,  To U  Trai  un ai shuh ki khun ïa phi na kane ka briew ha ka jaka uta uba phi la aiti sha u .  Hadien kata ki sa leit phai sha la ïing .

translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou killed , and also taken possession ? And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood , even thine .
translation.kha: Ong ïa u , ba nga U  Trai  nga ong ïa u , ‘ Hadien ba me la pynïap ïa u briew hato men shim ruh ïa ka khyndew jong u ?’ ïathuh ruh ha u ïa kaei ba nga ong : ‘ Ha kata hi ka jaka ba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam u Naboth , kin jliah ruh ïa ka snam jong me !’

translation.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted , and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he hath shed forth this , which ye now see and hear .
translation.kha: La kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Kpa jong u , bad u la ïohpdiang na u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba u la lah kular . Kaei kaba phi ïohi bad ïohsngew mynta ka long ka jingai sngewbha kaba u la theh noh ha ngi .

translation.en: But the prophet , which shall presume to speak a word in my name , which I have not commanded him to speak , or that shall speak in the name of other gods , even that prophet shall die .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u nongïathuhlypa u nud ban kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa ka khubor kaba ngam shym la hukum ïa u , u dei ban ïap namar kata ; bad uno uno u nongïathuhlypa uba kren ha ka kyrteng jong kiwei pat ki blei u ruh u dei ban ïap .’

translation.en: When thou vowest a vow unto God , defer not to pay it  ; for he hath no pleasure in fools : pay that which thou hast vowed .
translation.kha: Kumta haba phi pynlong ka jingkular ha U Blei , pyndep kloi ïa ka katba lah . Um donkam ïa u bieit . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi kular ban leh .

translation.en: Flee fornication . Every sin that a man doeth is without the body ; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body .
translation.kha: To kiar na ka jingleh awria . Kano kano kawei pat ka pop kaba u briew u leh kam ktah ïa ka met jong u ; hynrei u briew uba leh awria u leh pop ïa kata ka met jong u .

translation.en: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes , there met him two possessed with devils , coming out of the tombs , exceeding fierce , so that no man might pass by that way .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan sha ka thain Gadara ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw , la ïashem ïa u da ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la wan mih ïa ki krem jingtep kiba don hangta . Kine ki rangbah ki la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki bad ki la long kiba itriem shikatdei ba ym don mano mano ba nud ban leit na kata ka lynti .

translation.en: And it came to pass after a while , that the brook dried up , because there had been no rain in the land .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , kata ka wahduid ka rngad noh namar ba ym shym la don slap .

translation.en: Bring me venison , and make me savoury meat , that I may eat , and bless thee before the  Lord  before my death .
translation.kha: ‘ Wallam doh mrad ïa nga bad shet ïa ka na ka bynta jong nga . Ynda nga la dep bam ïa ka , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkyrkhu ha khmat U  Trai  shuwa ba ngan ïap .’

translation.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,
translation.kha: Bad kum u shakri jong U Trai , mem dei ban ïakajia . Bad to long jaijai ha ki briew baroh , bato hikai , jingiashah .

translation.en: Then she said , I desire one small petition of thee  ; I pray thee , say me not nay . And the king said unto her , Ask on , my mother : for I will not say thee nay .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Nga don kawei ka jingkyrpad barit ban pan na me ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga .   Kaei kata , mei ?  u kylli .  Ngan ym kyrngah ïa phi .

translation.en: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all , but one receiveth the prize ? So run , that ye may obtain .
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba don shibun ki nongïamareh kiba ïashim bynta ha ka jingmareh thong , hynrei tang uwei na ki u ïoh ïa ka prais . Kumta to mareh ha kata ka rukom ban ïoh ïa ka prais .

translation.en: Heap on wood , kindle the fire , consume the flesh , and spice it well , and let the bones be burned .
translation.kha: Wallam shuh shuh ki dieng ! Pynrhem ïa ka ding ! Shet ïa ka doh ! Phon ïa ka syrwa ! Thang noh ïa ki shyieng !

translation.en: And Jacob said unto Joseph , God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan , and blessed me ,
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la wan mihpaw ha nga ha Lus ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u la kyrkhu ïa nga .

translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them , saying ,  The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  La don shisien u briew uba riewspah uba don ka jaka kaba la pynmih kyrhai ki jingthung .

translation.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
translation.kha: Ïa u sdie la pynkhreh ban khet ïa ki dieng na ki thied ; ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng u bym sei ki soh babha yn khet noh bad bret ha ka ding .

translation.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety : neither shall he deliver any by his great strength .
translation.kha: Ki kulai thma kim lah ban ai jingjop ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki kam lah ban pyllait im .

translation.en: And Jonathan , Saul s son , had a son that was lame of his feet . He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel , and his nurse took him up , and fled : and it came to pass , as she made haste to flee , that he fell , and became lame . And his name was Mephibosheth .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u nonghiarpateng jong u Saul , u dei u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan , uba la dap san snem ka rta mynba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la shah pynïap . Haba ka khubor shaphang ka jingïap jong ki ka la wan poi na ka nongbah Jesreel , ka nongsumar jong u ka la rah ïa u bad ka phet krad ; hynrei namar ka jingkyrkieh palat ka la pynhap ïa u , bad u la kylla long uba dkoh .

translation.en: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house , of which the  Lord  said to David , and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :
translation.kha: U la buh ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah ha ka Templ , ka jaka kaba U  Trai  u ong ïa u Dabid bad ïa u Solomon u khun jong u :  Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka dei ka jaka ba nga la jied na ki ri baroh jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod , that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng    jong ka ephod ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak , and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech , the gods of Sepharvaim .
translation.kha: Ki bleithaw jong ka Nibhas bad Tartak ; bad ki briew ka Sepharbaim ki kñia ïa la ki khun kum ki jingainguh thang ïa ki blei Adrammelekh bad Anammelekh .

translation.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him .
translation.kha: U kpa bad ka kmie jong u khunlung ki la sngewlyngngoh ha kiei kiei kiba u Simeon u la kren shaphang jong u .

translation.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine ,  Beware of the scribes , which love to go in long clothing , and love salutations in the marketplaces ,
translation.kha: Katba u dang hikai ïa ki , u la ong ,  Sumar bha na ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba sngewtynnat ban leit kylleng ha ki jaiñkup jynsur bad ba yn khublei ïa ki da ka jinglehburom ha ka jaka ïew ,

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  prolongeth days : but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , bad phin im kham slem . Ki bymman ki ïap shuwa ka por jong ki .

translation.en: Behold , for peace I had great bitterness : but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption : for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back .
translation.kha: Ka jingkthang jong nga ka kylla sha ka jingsuk . Me pyllait ïa ka jingim jong nga na ka jingma baroh ; me map ïa ki pop jong nga baroh .

translation.en: And he called his ten servants , and delivered them ten pounds , and said unto them , Occupy till I come .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un mih , u la khot ïa ki shiphew ngut ki shakri jong u bad u la ai ha ki kawei kawei ka sbai ksiar bad u la ong ïa ki , ‘ Khmih aïu phi lah ban kamai da kane katba nga dang leit jingleit .’

translation.en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyndap ïa u da ka bor jong u , bad u la ai ruh ha u ïa ka jingtbit , ka jingnang , bad ka jingshemphang ban trei ïa ki jait kam ohdur kiba har rukom ,

translation.en: And the king said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah ? so let him curse , because the  Lord  hath said unto him , Curse David . Who shall then say , Wherefore hast thou done so ?
translation.kha: Kane kam dei ka kam jong me ,  u syiem u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para jong u .  Lada u tim ïa nga namar ba U  Trai  u la ong ïa u , mano ba don hok ban kylli balei u leh ïa ka ?
