translation.en: Take the girdle that thou hast got , which is upon thy loins , and arise , go to Euphrates , and hide it there in a hole of the rock .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka Wah Ïuphratis bad buhrieh ïa ki patlun lyngkot hapoh ka thliew ha ki mawsiang .

translation.en: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day , and it smote the gourd that it withered .
translation.kha: Hynrei dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ha ka hukum U Blei , u ksaiñ u la bam ïa u jingthung , bad u la ïap noh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses in Midian , Go , return into Egypt : for all the men are dead which sought thy life .
translation.kha: Katba u Moses u dang don ha Midian , U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit phai sha Ijipt , namar ba kito baroh kiba thmu ban pynïap ïa me ki la ïap .

translation.en: After they were come to Mysia , they assayed to go into Bithynia : but the Spirit suffered them not .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u pud jong ka Mysia , ki la pyrshang ban leit sha ka probins jong ka Bithynia , hynrei U Mynsiem jong U Jisu um shym shah ïa ki .

translation.en: This day the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments : thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ; kumta kohnguh ïa ki da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

translation.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment  ; all his commandments are sure .
translation.kha: Ha baroh kaba u leh u long uba ïaineh bad uba hok ; ki hukum jong u baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .
translation.kha: Naba ka dohnud jong phi kan ïai don hangta ha kaba don ka spah jong phi .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  And Peter answereth and saith unto him , Thou art the Christ .
translation.kha: Ma phi pat phi ïa-ong kumno ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  Phi ïa-ong ba nga long uei ?  U Petros u la jubab ,  Me long U Messaïah .

translation.en: Desire not the night , when people are cut off in their place .
translation.kha: Wat kwah ba ka miet kan wan , ka por ha kaba ki jaitbynriew kin duh noh .

translation.en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose  ; in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles : and they shall not appear before the  Lord  empty :
translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , ki shynrang jong phi baroh ki dei ban wanpaw ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha kata ka jaka mane Blei : ha ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot , bad ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep . Kim dei ban wan thylli ha khmat U  Trai  ;

translation.en: For it is written , that Abraham had two sons , the one by a bondmaid , the other by a freewoman .
translation.kha: Ka ong ba u Abraham u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , uwei na ka kynthei mraw bad uwei pat na ka kynthei kaba laitluid .

translation.en: Which were clothed with blue , captains and rulers , all of them desirable young men , horsemen riding upon horses .
translation.kha: Ki long ki shipai ha ka riam shipai ba rong jngum , ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai bahakhlieh ; baroh na ki , ki long ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew .

translation.en: At Parbar westward , four at the causeway , and two at Parbar .
translation.kha: Hajan ka jingtei kaba shaphang sepngi , don saw ngut ki nongap harud lynti bad ar ngut ha kata ka jingtei hi .

translation.en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate .
translation.kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh ,

translation.en: And Gad came that day to David , and said unto him , Go up , rear an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi u Gad u la leit sha u Dabid , bad u ong ha u ,  Khie leit shatei sha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah bad tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Let them bring them forth , and shew us what shall happen : let them shew the former things , what they be , that we may consider them , and know the latter end of them  ; or declare us things for to come .
translation.kha: Ale hangne bad ïathuhlypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , khnang ba ngin tip ïa ka haba ka urlong . To batai ha ka ïingbishar ïa ki jingjia kiba la dep bad ïathuh ïa ngi ka mut aïu .

translation.en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king , which would take account of his servants .
translation.kha: namar ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . Shisien la don u Syiem uba la kut jingmut ban jurip ïa ki jingkheiñ jingdiah jong u shakri jong u .

translation.en: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them , weeping all along as he went : and it came to pass , as he met them , he said unto them , Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam .
translation.kha: Te u Ishmael u la leit noh na Mispah ban ïakynduh ïa ki , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Haba u la wan ha ki , u la ong ,  Sngewbha wan shapoh ban khmih ïa u Gedalaïah .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  What did Moses command you ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab da ka jingkylli ,  Kaei kaba ka hukum u Moses ka ai ha phi ?

translation.en: But I said , Not so , Lord : for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Da lei lei ruh em , ko Trai ! Ym don kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam lane kaba sang kaba la ju rung ha ka shyntur jong nga .’

translation.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof  ; and I will destroy the counsel thereof : and they shall seek to the idols , and to the charmers , and to them that have familiar spirits , and to the wizards .
translation.kha: Ngan pynpulom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nong Ijipt bad ngan pynjot ïa ka jingsngewskhem jong ki . Kin kyrpad ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ban ïarap ïa ki , bad kin leit ban kylli na ki nongleh byrtong bad kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap ban ïoh jingmut .

translation.en: But he answered her not a word . And his disciples came and besought him , saying , Send her away  ; for she crieth after us .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym ong shikyntien ruh ha ka . Ki synran jong u ki la wan ha u bad ki la kyrpad ïa u ,  To phah noh ïa ka ! Ka wan bud ïa ngi bad ka pynlong ïa kane ka jingkhynwin baroh !

translation.en: And she said , I will surely go with thee : notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour  ; for the  Lord  shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman . And Deborah arose , and went with Barak to Kedesh .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Ñiuma , ngan leit ryngkat bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh burom ei ei ïa ka jingjop , namar U  Trai  un aiti ïa u Sisera ha ka kynthei .  Kumta ka Deborah ka leit bad u Barak sha Kedesh .

translation.en: Open thou mine eyes , that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law .
translation.kha: To pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong nga , khnang ba ngan ïohi ïa ki jingshisha baphylla hapoh ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years  ; and was gathered to his people .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ïap ha ka rta ba la ih bha haba u la dap shispah hynñiewphew san snem ka rta .

translation.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird ? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens ?
translation.kha: Hato men teh ïa u kum ïa ka sim ba ri ha ïing , kum kaei kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa ki shakri kynthei jong me ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he sowed , some fell by the way side , and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up .
translation.kha: Katba u bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , katto katne na u , u la hap ha ka lynti ïaid , bad ki sim ki la wan bad bam ïa u .

translation.en: Then went in also that other disciple , which came first to the sepulchre , and he saw , and believed .
translation.kha: Te uta uwei pat u synran , uba la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep , u ruh u la rung shapoh ; u la ïohi bad u la ngeit .

translation.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram , saying ,
translation.kha: U Solomon u phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Hiram :

translation.en: And he said unto them , Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company , or come unto one of another nation  ; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Phi hi phi tip bha ba la khang ïa u Jiw da ka niam jong u ban leit jngoh lane ïajan bad ki Jentil . Hynrei U Blei u la pyn-i ha nga ba ngam dei ban ñiew bymkhuid ne basang kat kum ka jinglehniam ïa uno uno u briew .

translation.en: Then David went over to the other side , and stood on the top of an hill afar off  ; a great space being between them :
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u leit noh sha shiliang jong ka them bad u ïeng ha kliar uwei u lum uba kham ha pajih ,

translation.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God ? and talk deceitfully for him ?
translation.kha: Balei ba me shukor ? Hato me pyrkhat ba ki jingshukor jong me kin long jingmyntoi ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u leit bran bran sha kata ka jaka ha kaba u la ïeng ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: And his mother said unto him , Upon me be thy curse , my son : only obey my voice , and go fetch me them .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka jubab ,  To ai ba kano kano ka jingtim kan hap halor jong nga ; ko khun jong nga , shu leh kumba nga ong ; bad khie leit bad wanrah ïa ki blang sha nga .

translation.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon , and arose , and went , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .
translation.kha: U Adonijah , ha ka jingsheptieng bakhraw ïa u Solomon , u la leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la bat ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan .

translation.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears ; not that ye should be grieved , but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh sha phi da ka dohnud kaba sngewkhia bad sngewkhuslai ryngkat bad ki ummat kiba bun ; ka jingthmu jong nga kam shym long ban pynsngewsih ïa phi , hynrei ban pynsngewthuh ïa phi haduh katno nga ieit ïa phi baroh .

translation.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;
translation.kha: Ym namar kano kano na ki kam babha kiba ma ngi hi ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingisynei jong u hi ba u la pynim ïa ngi , lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba ai ïa ngi ka jingkha thymmai bad ka jingim kaba thymmai da kaba sait ïa ngi .

translation.en: And he took the damsel by the hand , and said unto her ,  Talitha cumi  ;  which is , being interpreted ,  Damsel , I say unto thee , arise .
translation.kha: U la shim ïa ka na ka kti bad u la ong ïa ka ,   Talitha , koum ,   kaba mut ,  Ko Khynnah rit , nga ong ïa pha ban khie joit !

translation.en: And he said , God forbid that I should do so : but the man in whose hand the cup is found , he shall be my servant  ; and as for you , get you up in peace unto your father .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  O , em ! da lei lei ngan ym leh kumta ! Tang uta keiñ ha uba la shem ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga . Kiwei pat na phi ki lah ban leit phai suk sha la u kpa .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee , and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel  ;
translation.kha: Bad haba U  Trai  u la pyndep ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u la kular ïa phi bad ba u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem ki Israel ,

translation.en: And the king commanded all the people , saying , Keep the passover unto the  Lord  your God , as it is written in the book of this covenant .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u hukum ïa ki briew ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum ka jinglehburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jutang .

translation.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work : but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bymman da shisha kim ïohnong ei ei , hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , ka pynthikna ba phin ïoh ïa ka bainong .

translation.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard , nor perceived by the ear , neither hath the eye seen , O God , beside thee , what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him .
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don ba ïohi lane ïohsngew ïa U Blei uba kum ma me , uba leh ïa kiba kum kita ki kam na ka bynta kito kiba ap kyrmen ha u .

translation.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him .
translation.kha: U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki bun sngi , bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u ki wan pyntngen ïa u .

translation.en: And when there arose a great dissension , the chief captain , fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them , commanded the soldiers to go down , and to take him by force from among them , and to bring him into the castle .
translation.kha: Ka jingïakajia ka la shit haduh katta katta ba u rangbah ai hukum u la sheptieng ïoh ba kin tar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Paul . Kumta u hukum ïa ki shipai jong u ban leit sha ka kynhun , ban shim noh ïa u Paul na ki , bad ïalam ïa u shapoh ka kut shipai .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Why askest thou thus after my name , seeing it is secret ?
translation.kha: U angel u kylli ,  Balei ba phi da kwah ban tip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ? Ka long ka kyrteng kaba phylla .

translation.en: And he put all upon Aaron s hands , and upon his sons  hands , and waved them for a wave offering before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kata ka jingbam baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ki ai ïa kine kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let me fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for very great are his mercies : but let me not fall into the hand of man .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ïa u Gad ,  Nga don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba yn pynshitom ïa nga da ki briew . Ai ba U  Trai  da lade hi un long uta u ban pynshitom ïa nga , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .

translation.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .
translation.kha: Ym don kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban buhrieh na U Blei ; ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ki jingthaw baroh la pynpaw bad pyn-i shynna ha ki khmat jong u . Bad ka dei sha u ba ngi dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade .

translation.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls , let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar : for they offered them before the  Lord  , therefore they are hallowed : and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki kylla long kiba khuid haba la wanrah ïa ki ha ka duwan U  Trai . Kumta , shim ïa ki khiew buh ding jong kita ki briew kiba la shah pynïap namar ki pop jong ki , shoh pynstang ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka duwan . Kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Ye shall walk after the  Lord  your God , and fear him , and keep his commandments , and obey his voice , and ye shall serve him , and cleave unto him .
translation.kha: Bud ïa U  Trai  bad tiengburom ïa u ; kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ; mane ïa u bad ïaineh ha u .

translation.en: What daily practice is good for anyone wanting to learn God’s will ?
translation.kha: Ban tip ïa ka mon jong U Blei , aïu dei ban leh man la ka sngi ?

translation.en: But ye are a chosen generation , a royal priesthood , an holy nation , a peculiar people  ; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light :
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi long ka kynja ba la jied , ki lyngdoh jong U Syiem , ka jaitbynriew bakhuid , ki briew kiba dei jong U Blei hi , ba la jied ban pynbna ïa ki kam baphylla jong U Blei , uba la khot noh ïa phi na ka jingdum sha ka jingshai baphylla jong u hi .

translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !

translation.en: Now that the dead are raised , even Moses shewed at the bush , when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob .
translation.kha: Bad u Moses u pynshisha da kaba shai ba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Ha ka bynta shaphang ka  lawlynnong kaba ing u kren shaphang U Trai kum ‘ U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’

translation.en: Then again Abraham took a wife , and her name was Keturah .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Keturah .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will come with strong hand , and his arm shall rule for him : behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u wan ban synshar da ka bor , u da wallam bad u ki briew ba u la pyllait im .

translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  came from Sinai , and rose up from Seir unto them  ; he shined forth from mount Paran , and he came with ten thousands of saints : from his right hand went a fiery law for them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan na u Lum Sinai ; u mih kum ka sngi ha Edom , bad u tyngshaiñ ha la ki briew na u Lum Paran . Shiphew hajar ki angel ki don ryngkat bad u , bad ka ding kaba meh ha ka kti kamon jong u .

translation.en: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets , and thou hast given them blood to drink  ; for they are worthy .
translation.kha: Ki la theh noh ïa ka snam jong ki briew jong U Blei bad jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad kumta me la ai ha ki ïa ka snam ban dih . Ki la ïoh ïa kaba ki dei hok ban ïoh !

translation.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number , and set others in their stead .
translation.kha: Um da donkam ïa ka jingwad bniah ban weng noh ïa ki nongïalam bad ban bujli ïa ki da kiwei pat .

translation.en: And Achan answered Joshua , and said , Indeed I have sinned against the  Lord  God of Israel , and thus and thus have I done :
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ,  u Akhan u jubab ,  nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad kane ka long kaei ba nga la leh .

translation.en: And in all that mighty hand , and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa uba la lah ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba sngewtriem kum kiba u Moses u la leh ha khmat ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: And Joab blew the trumpet , and the people returned from pursuing after Israel : for Joab held back the people .
translation.kha: U Joab u la hukum ban put ïa ka turoi ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki shipai jong u , ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Then said the princes unto Baruch , Go , hide thee , thou and Jeremiah  ; and let no man know where ye be .
translation.kha: Te ki la ong ha u ,  Ma me bad u Jeremaïah phi dei ban leit noh bad ban rieh . Wat ai ïano ïano ban tip hangno phi ïadon .

translation.en: Now therefore , O our God , hear the prayer of thy servant , and his supplications , and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate , for the Lord s sake .
translation.kha: A Blei , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad jong nga . To pynbha pat ïa ka Templ jong me , ïa kaba la pynjot ; to pynbha ïa ka khnang ba uwei pa uwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei .

translation.en: Two are better than one  ; because they have a good reward for their labour .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kham bha ban ïa kaba marwei , namar ryngkat lang ki lah ban trei kham bha shibun .

translation.en: Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .
translation.kha: To ïalam ïa ki nongap phira ,  u Pilat u la ong ïa ki ,  Khie leit bad to pynskhem ïa ka jingtep kat kaba phi lah .

translation.en: And he blessed him , and said , Blessed be Abram of the most high God , possessor of heaven and earth :
translation.kha: u la kyrkhu ïa u , bad u ong ,  To U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew , un kyrkhu ïa u Abram !

translation.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation ? That the  Lord  hath founded Zion , and the poor of his people shall trust in it .
translation.kha: Kumno ngin jubab ïa ki nonglamktien kiba wan sha ngi na ki Philistia ? Ngin ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la seng nongrim ïa ka Seïon bad ba ki briew jong u kiba shahshitom kin shem ka jingshngain hangta .

translation.en: And beside all this , between us and you there is a great gulf fixed : so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot  ; neither can they pass to us , that would come from thence .
translation.kha: Nalor kata baroh , ka don ka kharai kaba jylliew hapdeng jong ngi , khnang ba kito kiba kwah ban jam sha shiliang nangne sha me kim lah ban leh kumta , lymne uno uno un lah ban jam sha shiliang sha ngi na ka jaka kaba me don .’

translation.en: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk , and his heart was merry , he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn : and she came softly , and uncovered his feet , and laid her down .
translation.kha: Haba u Boas u la dep bam dep dih , u la don ha ka jingsngewtynnat bha . U leit sha ka kynton barli bad u thiah hangta . Ka Ruth ka leit jar jar , ka khyllied ïa ki jaiñ tap bad ka thiah ha ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: But the Chaldeans  army pursued after them , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho : and when they had taken him , they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath , where he gave judgment upon him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la beh nadien jong ki bad kem ïa u Sedekaïah ha ki pyntha hajan ka Jerikho . Te ki la leit ïalam ïa u sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba don ha ka nongbah Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , bad hangta u Nebukhadnessar u la ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong u .

translation.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God , so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear .
translation.kha: Ka long da ka jingngeit ba ngi sngewthuh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien U Blei , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba lah ban ïohi la pynlong na kaei ka bymlah ban ïohi .

translation.en: And yet for all that , when they be in the land of their enemies , I will not cast them away , neither will I abhor them , to destroy them utterly , and to break my covenant with them : for I am the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Hynrei la katta ruh , katba ki dang don ha ka ri ki nongshun jong ki , ngan ym iehnoh syndon lane pynjot ïa ki . Da kumta ngan ym pyndkut noh ïa ka jutang jong nga bad ki , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Let the field be joyful , and all that is therein : then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
translation.kha: to lehkmen ko ki lyngkha bad baroh kiei kiei kiba don ha pha ! Ki dieng ha ki khlaw kin risa da ka jingkmen ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ? And he said , I will go forth , and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And he said , Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also : go forth , and do so .
translation.kha: ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli . U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler . U  Trai  u ong , leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin sa jop .’

translation.en: Unto which promise our twelve tribes , instantly serving God day and night , hope to come . For which hope s sake , king Agrippa , I am accused of the Jews .
translation.kha: ïa kata hi kaba ki khat-ar jait jong ki briew jong ngi ki kyrmen ban ïohpdiang , haba ki mane ïa U Blei mynsngi bad mynmiet . Bad ka dei namar jong kane ka jingkyrmen , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la shah mudui da ki Jiw !

translation.en: And I will bring them , and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God , in truth and in righteousness .
translation.kha: bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki na mihngi bad na sepngi ban shong ban sah ha Jerusalem . Kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki , da kaba synshar ha ka jingïaineh bad ha ka jinglehhok .

translation.en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the hair in the bright spot be turned white , and it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning : wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .
translation.kha: Lada u shñiuh ha ka dak khluit ding u la kylla lieh bad kata ka dak ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba la sdang na kata kaba khluit ding , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever :
translation.kha: U Trai u dap da ka jingisynei bad un ym kyntait ïa ngi junom .

translation.en: And she said unto him , How canst thou say , I love thee , when thine heart is not with me ? thou hast mocked me these three times , and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth .
translation.kha: Kumta ka ong ha u ,  Kumno phi lah ban ong ba phi ieit ïa nga haba phim mut kumta ? Phi pynlong ka bieit ïa nga la lai sien , bad phim pat shym la ïathuh satia ha nga kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi uba khlaiñbor bha .

translation.en: And he dealt among all the people , even among the whole multitude of Israel , as well to the women as men , to every one a cake of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine . So all the people departed every one to his house .
translation.kha: bad u sam jingbam sha ki baroh . U ai ha uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ha kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha Israel mar uwei u kpu , shi lyngkhot ka doh syang , bad katto katne ki soh kismis . Nangta baroh ki la leit phai sha ïing .

translation.en: And they shall sever out men of continual employment , passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth , to cleanse it : after the end of seven months shall they search .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la kut ki hynñiew bnai yn jied kyrpang ïa ki rangbah ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri khnang ban wad bad ban tep ïa kito ki metïap kiba dang sah ha madan , ba kumta yn pynlong khuid ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria , and was sick : and he sent messengers , and said unto them , Go , enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah , u syiem Israel u la hap na ka jaka jngoh kai halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Samaria , bad u la mynsaw jur . Kumta u phah katto katne ki nonglamktien ban kylli ïa u Baalsebub , u blei jong ka Ekron , ka nongbah Philistia , khnang ban tip la un ïohkhiah ne em .

translation.en: Yea , they are greedy dogs which can never have enough , and they are shepherds that cannot understand : they all look to their own way , every one for his gain , from his quarter .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki ksew kiba jlawnguid , ki bym ju ïoh bam kdang . Kine nongïalam ruh kim don ka jingshemphang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u leh katba u sngewbit , bad wad ïa la ka jong ka jingmyntoi .

translation.en: And David s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people . And David said unto the  Lord  , I have sinned greatly in that I have done : and now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  , take away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba u Dabid u la dep shim ïa ka jingkheiñbriew , ka jingïatiplem jong u ka la sdang ban pynshitom ïa u , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Nga la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei ha kaba leh ïa kane ! Sngewbha map ïa nga . Nga la leh bieit .

translation.en: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies , but turned their backs before their enemies , because they were accursed : neither will I be with you any more , except ye destroy the accursed from among you .
translation.kha: Dei namar kane ba ki Israel kim lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Ki kynran dien na ki namar ki hi ki la shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot ! Ngan ym don ryngkat shuh bad phi lymda phi pynjot thiaw ïa kiei kiei kiba la hukum ïa phi ban ym shim !

translation.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side , and shall drive him to his feet .
translation.kha: Baroh sawdong jong u ka jingshyrkhei ka ap ; ka bud ïa u ha man ka sien jam .

translation.en: For as the lightning , that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven , shineth unto the other part under heaven  ; so shall also the Son of man be in his day .
translation.kha: Kumba ka leilieh ka thaba na shiliang sha shiliang jong ka sahit bneng bad ka pynshai ïa ka na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , kumta un long U Khun U Briew ha ka sngi jong u .

translation.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt , he , and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .
translation.kha: Ynda u Joseph u la lah tep ïa la u kpa , u leit phai pat sha Ijipt ryngkat bad la ki hynmen ki para lem bad kita baroh kiba leit ontep ïa u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him .
translation.kha: Bad ki la ong shibun kiwei pat ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa u .

translation.en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish–bosheth , and said , Am I a dog s head , which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father , to his brethren , and to his friends , and have not delivered thee into the hand of David , that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman ?
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynbitar lep ïa u Abner ,  Me tharai ba ngan shetkylla ïa u Saul ? Me tharai shisha ba nga shakri ïa ki Judah ?  u ong .  Naduh mynnyngkong , nga la ïaineh skhem na ka bynta u Saul u kpa jong me , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki paralok jong u , bad nga da ïa me na kaba shahjop ha u Dabid ; pynban ha kane ka sngi me wad dong ïa nga shaphang ka kynthei !

translation.en: And the fourth row , a beryl , an onyx , and a jasper : they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings .
translation.kha: bad ïa u Beryl , u Karnelian , bad u Jasper ha ka kyrdon kaba saw . Ïa kine baroh la pyndait ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: And the king said , And where is thy master s son ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he abideth at Jerusalem : for he said , To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father .
translation.kha: Shaei u Mephibosheth u ksiew jong u Saul , u kynrad jong me ?  u syiem u kylli ïa u .  U sah ha Jerusalem ,  u Siba u la jubab ,  namar ba u la sngewthikna ba ki Israel mynta kin pynïoh pat ha u ïa ka hima jong u Saul , u kparad jong u .

translation.en: And till Moses had done speaking with them , he put a veil on his face .
translation.kha: Ynda u Moses u la lah ïakren bad ki , u tap ïa la ka khmat da ka jaiñtapkhmat .

translation.en: I have written unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I have written unto you , young men , because ye are strong , and the word of God abideth in you , and ye have overcome the wicked one .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , namar phi ithuh ïa U Kpa . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi ithuh ïa u , uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun samla , namar phi long kiba khlaiñ ; ka ktien U Blei ka ïaisah ha phi , bad phi la jop noh thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .

translation.en: Ask thee a sign of the  Lord  thy God  ; ask it either in the depth , or in the height above .
translation.kha: To pan na U  Trai  U Blei jong me ban ai ka dak ha me . Ka lah ban long na kaba jylliew ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap lane nang tei najrong eh jong ka bneng .

translation.en: Now therefore forgive , I pray thee , my sin only this once , and entreat the  Lord  your God , that he may take away from me this death only .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kane ka sien to map ïa ka pop jong nga bad duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ban shim noh na nga ïa kane ka jingpynshitom kaba shyrkhei na nga .

translation.en: And they understood none of these things : and this saying was hid from them , neither knew they the things which were spoken .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki synran kim shemphang ïa kano kano na kine kiei kiei ; ïa ka jingmut jong ki kyntien la buhrieh na ki , bad kim tip shaphang kaei U Jisu u kren .

translation.en: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong  ;
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u pyrshang ban pynsniew ïa uwei pat u briew da kaba mudui lamler ïa u ,

translation.en: And the Chaldeans , that fight against this city , shall come and set fire on this city , and burn it with the houses , upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal , and poured out drink offerings unto other gods , to provoke me to anger .
translation.kha: Kin sa thang duh ïa ka , ryngkat bad ki ïing ki sem hangno hangno ha kiba ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba thang ki jingiwbih ha u Baal halor ki tnum ïing bad da kaba theh ïa ka waiñ jong ki jingainguh sha kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for him  ; and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha ka duwan ban pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop jong phi ; bad yn sa map ïa phi .

translation.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father , through sanctification of the Spirit , unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ : Grace unto you , and peace , be multiplied .
translation.kha: Ïa phi la jied kat kum ka jingthmu U Blei uba U Kpa bad la pynlong ïa phi ki briew kiba khuid da U Mynsiem jong u , ban kohnguh ïa U Jisu Khrist bad ban ïoh pynkhuid da ka snam jong u . To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk kin long kiba dap pura ïa phi .

translation.en: When I went out to the gate through the city , when I prepared my seat in the street !
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka nongbah ki ïakynduh lang nga long uwei napdeng jong ki ,

translation.en: It may be they will present their supplication before the  Lord  , and will return every one from his evil way : for great is the anger and the fury that the  Lord  hath pronounced against this people .
translation.kha: Lehse kin duwai ha U  Trai  bad phai pat na ki lynti bymman jong ki , namar U  Trai  u la byrngem ïa kane ka jaitbynriew da ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei .

translation.en: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel , nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel .
translation.kha: Ym dei ïa u Israel , shynrang lane kynthei , ban leit long nuti ha ka jaka mane blei .

translation.en: Having damnation , because they have cast off their first faith .
translation.kha: Hynrei to wat kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei kiba dang kham samla ha ka thup ; namar haba ki jingkwah ka doh jong ki ban shongkurim , ki phai noh na U Khrist , bad kumta ki don ka jingpynrem ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingtehkular bad u kaba mynshuwa .

translation.en: And the first came out red , all over like an hairy garment  ; and they called his name Esau .
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u long uba saw doh , bad ka sniehdoh jong u ka long kum ka jaiñkup shñiuh ; kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Iso .

translation.en: And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongïaleh jong ka Teman kin kyiuh , bad ïa uwei pa uwei u shipai ha Edom yn pynïap .

translation.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .
translation.kha: Namar ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang kan ym lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .

translation.en: And he gave her his hand , and lifted her up , and when he had called the saints and widows , presented her alive .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kner ïa la ki kti , bad u la ïarap pynkhie ïa ka . Nangta u la khot ïa ki parabangeit baroh , kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei , u la aiti ïa ka ha ki , ka briew kaba la im pat .

translation.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom , and stretch her wings toward the south ?
translation.kha: Hato u kbeit u nang na me kumno ban her , haba u pyiar la ki thapniang shaphang shathie ?

translation.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be removed for ever .
translation.kha: Me la buh ïa ka pyrthei ha ki nongrim baskhem , bad yn ym pynkhih shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  : for ye have not walked in my statutes , neither executed my judgments , but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you .
translation.kha: Phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  bad ba katba phi dang bat ïa ki aiñ jong ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan , phi la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad khlem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me .
translation.kha: Wat ha ka jingshitom jong nga , la pyntngen ïa nga namar ka jingkular jong me ka ai jingim ïa nga .

translation.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images : and the kingdom was quiet before him .
translation.kha: Namar ba u pynduh noh ïa ki jaka mane blei thala bad ki duwan jingiwbih na baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah , ka hima ka don ha ka jingsuk hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary , and have given Jacob to the curse , and Israel to reproaches .
translation.kha: bad ki nongsynshar jong phi ki la pyntngit ïa ka ïingkyntang jong nga . Kumta nga la wallam ka jingpynjot ha Israel ; nga shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban shah rkhiebeiñ .

translation.en: And Hezekiah answered , It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees : nay , but let the shadow return backward ten degrees .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u jubab ,  Ka suk ban pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam sha khmat ! Pynlong ïa ka ban leit shiphew jam shadien .

translation.en: And I will give them one heart , and I will put a new spirit within you  ; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh , and will give them an heart of flesh :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ka dohnud bathymmai bad ka jingmut bathymmai . Ngan shim noh ïa ka dohnud maw ba-mutlop bad ngan ai ha ki ka dohnud bakohnguh .

translation.en: And as touching the dead , that they rise : have ye not read in the book of Moses , how in the bush God spake unto him , saying , I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ?
translation.kha: Mynta , na ka bynta kita kiba la ïap ki ban sa mihpat : Hato phim pat ju pule ha ka Kitab u Moses ïa ka bynta kaba dei shaphang ka  lawlynnong kaba ing ? Hangto la thoh ba U Blei u la ong ïa u Moses , ‘ Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’

translation.en: For this cause the people also met him , for that they heard that he had done this miracle .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba u paidbah u la ïakynduh ïa U — namar ba ki la ïohsngew ba U la leh ïa kane ka kambah .

translation.en: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life .
translation.kha: U Samuel u synshar ïa ki Israel katba u dang im .

translation.en: Let them praise his name in the dance : let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u da ka jingshad ; to tem ki ksing bad ki duitara ha ka jingïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , that eateth any manner of blood  ; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood , and will cut him off from among his people .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel , lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , u bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , U  Trai  un phai pyrshah ïa u bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And after him repaired the priests , the men of the plain .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki lyngdoh kiba tei pat ïa kiba bun ki bynta kiba bud jong ka kynroh : Ki lyngdoh kiba dei na ka jaka sawdong ka Jerusalem ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ;

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor , by the coast of the land of Edom , saying ,
translation.kha: uba ha khappud ka hima Edom . Hangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , get thee down quickly from hence  ; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves  ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them  ; they have made them a molten image .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Khie leit hiar kloi na une u lum , namar kita ki briew jong me ïa kiba me la ïalam na Ijipt , ki la mut sniew bad ki la leh bymman . Ki lah da kynriah noh na kata ka lynti ïa kaba nga la hukum ïa ki , bad ki la thaw pynban ïa ka durblei na ka bynta ïa lade .’

translation.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung : they which have seen him shall say , Where is he ?
translation.kha: hynrei un shah pyrsad noh kum u pui pui . Kito kiba ju ithuh ïa u kin lyngngoh shano ba u la leit .

translation.en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf , saying , Whose is the land ? saying also , Make thy league with me , and , behold , my hand shall be with thee , to bring about all Israel unto thee .
translation.kha: U Abner u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Dabid uba don ha Hebron ha kata ka por , ban ong ,  Uei u ban synshar ïa kane ka ri ? Ïateh kular bad nga , bad ngan ïarap ïa phi ban pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha ka liang jong phi .

translation.en: Then Peter arose and went with them . When he was come , they brought him into the upper chamber : and all the widows stood by him weeping , and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made , while she was with them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la khreh bad u la leit bad ki . Haba u la poi , la ïalam ïa u sha ka kamra kaba haneng , ha kaba ki riewkynthei baroh ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u , ki da ïam bad pyn-i ïa ki sopti bad ki jaiñkup kiba ka Dorkas ka la suh mynba ka dang im .

translation.en: And David said unto Achish , If I have now found grace in thine eyes , let them give me a place in some town in the country , that I may dwell there : for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Akhish ,  Lada phi long u paralok jong nga , ai jaka ïa nga ha kawei ka shnongrit ba ngan ïoh shong hangta . Bah , kam donkam ïa nga ba ngan sah ryngkat bad phi ha kane ka nongbah .

translation.en: When righteous men do rejoice , there is great glory : but when the wicked rise , a man is hidden .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki wan ha ka bor , baroh ki lehkmen , hynrei haba ki briew kiba sniew ki synshar , ki briew ki buhrieh ïa lade .

translation.en: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim , even unto Gaza , the Caphtorims , which came forth out of Caphtor , destroyed them , and dwelt in their stead . )
translation.kha: Ka jaka harud ka Duriaw Mediterranian ka long kaba shong da ki Kaphtorim kiba wan na ka dewlynnong Krit . Kine ki la pynjot ïa ki Abbim kiba dei ki trai jaka , bad ki knieh lut ïa ka ri jong ki haduh ka shnong Gasa kaba shaphang shathie . )

translation.en: Surely , shall one say , in the  Lord  have I righteousness and strength : even to him shall men come  ; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed .
translation.kha: Kin ong ba dei tang lyngba jong nga yn shem ïa ka jingjop bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; hynrei baroh kiba shun ïa nga kin shah pynjahburom .

translation.en: And he said , Behold , I have heard that there is corn in Egypt : get you down thither , and buy for us from thence  ; that we may live , and not die .
translation.kha: Nga ïohsngew ba don kew ha Ijipt ; khie leit thied kew nangta , ba ngin ym ïapthngan .

translation.en: Of such an one will I glory : yet of myself I will not glory , but in mine infirmities .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan sngewsarong shaphang une u briew — hynrei ngan ym kob sarong shaphang ïa lade , lait noh ïa kiei kiei kiba pynpaw haduh katno nga long uba tlot .

translation.en: And David said to Joab , and to all the people that were with him , Rend your clothes , and gird you with sackcloth , and mourn before Abner . And king David himself followed the bier .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ban kad ïa la ki jaiñ , ban phong ka jaiñ khain , bad ban ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner . Bad ha ka jingleit ontep , u syiem Dabid da lade hi u ïaid hadien ka synduk metïap .

translation.en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ? answer me .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , nangno u Ïoannis u la ïoh ïa ka hok ban pynbaptis : Ka la long na U Blei ne na u briew ?

translation.en: For what is a man profited , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew u ïohnong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em ym kumta ! Kam don kano kano kaba u lah ban ai ban ïoh pat ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , ïa ki snar , bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka phyllaw .

translation.en: Neither can they die any more : for they are equal unto the angels  ; and are the children of God , being the children of the resurrection .
translation.kha: Kin long kum ki angel bad kim lah ban ïap . Ki long ki khun jong U Blei , naba ki la mihpat na kaba ïap .

translation.en: O that there were such an heart in them , that they would fear me , and keep all my commandments always , that it might be well with them , and with their children for ever !
translation.kha: A , ba kin da la ïoh ïa kane ka dohnud ! Ba kin da la sheptieng burom ïa nga bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga borabor , ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin jin da la manbha junom .

translation.en: Then said the king , The one saith , This is my son that liveth , and thy son is the dead : and the other saith , Nay  ; but thy son is the dead , and my son is the living .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ,  Kawei pa kawei na phi ka kam ba u khun uba dang im u dei u jong ka bad ba u khun ba la ïap u dei jong kawei pat .

translation.en: I say unto you , that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth , more than over ninety and nine just persons , which need no repentance .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , kan don ka jingkmen kaba kham bun ha bneng halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai ki briew badonburom ki bymdonkam ban kylla-kaba-mut .

translation.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly : ye shall do no servile work therein :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

translation.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , that pertain unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: hynrei uno uno ïa uba la ñiew bymkhuid u bam ïa ka , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: Wherefore now return , and go in peace , that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Kumta khie leit phai noh sha ïing da kaba suk , bad wat leh ei ei kaba pynsngewsih ïa ki .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that as ye were a curse among the heathen , O house of Judah , and house of Israel  ; so will I save you , and ye shall be a blessing : fear not , but let your hands be strong .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Judah bad Israel ! Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ki nongwei ki ïatim iwei ïa iwei pat da kaba ong , ‘ Ai ba kijuh ki jingpynjot kiba la hap ha Judah bad Israel kin hap halor jong phi !’ Hynrei ngan pynim ïa phi , bad nangta kito ki nongwei kin ong iwei ïa iwei pat , ‘ Ai ba phin ïohpdiang ïa kijuh ki jingkyrkhu kiba la wan ha ka Judah bad Israel !’ Kumta to long shlur bad wat sheptieng .

translation.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon , and cast a stone upon me .
translation.kha: Ki la bret im ïa nga shapoh ka thliew bad ki la khang ïa ka da u maw .

translation.en: And the sons of Kohath  ; Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel : and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years .
translation.kha: U Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel . U Kohath u la im haduh shispah laiphew lai snem ka rta .

translation.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall  ; yea , the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ba ka kyllon noh , ki dewlynnong ki khynñiuh , bad ki briew jong ki , ki kyndit ha kata ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim , Zer , and Hammath , Rakkath , and Chinnereth ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah ba la ker da ki kynroh ki long ka Siddim , ka Ser , ka Hammath , ka Rakkath , ka Khinnereth ,

translation.en: For I was alive without the law once : but when the commandment came , sin revived , and I died .
translation.kha: Ma nga , shisien nga la im khlem ka hukum ; hynrei haba ka hukum ka la wan , ka pop ka khie im , bad nga la ïap .

translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka long kaba bang bha ; a katno ngi ieit ban nguid ïa ka !

translation.en: Which said unto God , Depart from us : and what can the Almighty do for them ?
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa U Blei bad kiba ngeit ba um lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .

translation.en: ( Acts 24 :15 ) That is why Jesus Christ could tell a repentant evildoer who expressed faith in him : “You will be with me in Paradise .” —Luke 23 :43 .
translation.kha: ( Kam ki Apostol 24 :15 ) Na kata ka daw u Jisu Khrist u la ong ha u nongpop ba la kylla bamut uba la pynpaw ia ka jingngeit ha u : “Men long lem bad nga ha ka paradais .” —Loukas 23 :43 .

translation.en: For I , saith the  Lord  , will be unto her a wall of fire round about , and will be the glory in the midst of her .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la lah kular ba ma u hi un long ka kynroh ding sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban ïada ïa ka bad ba un shong un sah hangta ha ka burom jong u baroh .

translation.en: The chains , and the bracelets , and the mufflers ,
translation.kha: bad ha ki ryndang-kti jong ki . Un shim noh ïa ka jaiñtapkhmat jong ki

translation.en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast :
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Grik hapdeng jong kito kiba la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane ha ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: O earth , cover not thou my blood , and let my cry have no place .
translation.kha: Ko Pyrthei , wat buhrieh ïa ki jingbakla ba la leh ïa nga ! Wat ai ba ka jingkhot jong nga ïa ka jingshisha , yn pynsngap jar !

translation.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe : for there is no difference :
translation.kha: U Blei u pynlong ka hok bad ki briew lyngba ka jingngeit jong ki ha U Jisu Khrist . U Blei u leh ïa kane ïa baroh kiba ngeit ha U Khrist , namar ym don satia kano kano ka jingïapher :

translation.en: And when he cometh , he shall smite the land of Egypt , and deliver such as are for death to death  ; and such as are for captivity to captivity  ; and such as are for the sword to the sword .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar un wan bad jop ïa ka Ijipt . Kito ki briew kiba la dei ban ïap na ka jingpang kin ïap ha ka jingpang , kito kiba dei ba yn ïalam kum ki koidi yn ïalam ïa ki kum ki koidi , bad kito kiba la dei ban sha pynïap ha ka thma kin ïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David , to enquire of his welfare , and to congratulate him , because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him  ; ( for Hadarezer had war with Tou  ; ) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .
translation.kha: Kumta u phah ïa u Joram u khun jong u ban leit khublei bad ai burom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh thma bunsien . U Joram u wallam ki jingai sngewbha ba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa bad ka rnong .

translation.en: He will go .
translation.kha: Yn sa leit ma u .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Do as he hath said , and fall upon him , and bury him  ; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood , which Joab shed , from me , and from the house of my father .
translation.kha: Leh kumba u Joab u ong ,  u Solomon u jubab .  Pynïap ïa u bad tep ïa u . Nangta ym ma nga ne mano mano na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid ki ban shah kynnoh shuh na ka bynta kaei kaba u Joab u la leh haba u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah kiba lui lui .

translation.en: And came down to Capernaum , a city of Galilee , and taught them on the sabbath days .
translation.kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la leit sha Kapernam , ka shnong ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la hikai ïa u paidbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: ( Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures , )
translation.kha: Ïa ka Khubor Babha la kular la slem bah da U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .

translation.en: And , lo , while she yet talked with the king , Nathan the prophet also came in .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang kren kumta bad u syiem , u Nathan u wan poi ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that make my people err , that bite with their teeth , and cry , Peace  ; and he that putteth not into their mouths , they even prepare war against him .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kular ïa ka jingsuk ïa kito kiba da siewdor ïa ki , hynrei ki byrngem da ka thma ïa kito ki bym siew .

translation.en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine  ; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was . Then said the king , Will he force the queen also before me in the house ? As the word went out of the king s mouth , they covered Haman s face .
translation.kha: U la dem ïa lade ha ka jaka shong shaniah jong ka Esther ban kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingisynei . Haba u syiem u wan phai pat shapoh kamra na ki kper , haba u ïohi ïa kane , u syiem u pyrta jam ,  Hato une u briew un leh be-ijot ïa ka mahadei hangne hi ha khmat jong nga , ha ka ïingsyiem jong nga ?  U syiem um pat kut bha ka jingkren , ba ki ïunukh ki tap ïa ka khlieh u Haman .

translation.en: Ephraim is joined to idols : let him alone .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki don hapoh ka jingshoh bieit ki bleithaw . Ai kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti .

translation.en: And there came a leper to him , beseeching him , and kneeling down to him , and saying unto him , If thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
translation.kha: U briew uba pang na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u la wan ha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap .  Lada me mon ,  u la ong ,  me lah ban pynkhuid ïa nga .

translation.en: While he yet spake , behold , a bright cloud overshadowed them : and behold a voice out of the cloud , which said , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased  ; hear ye him .
translation.kha: Katba u dang kren , u lyoh uba tyngshaiñ u la wan halor jong ki , bad ka sur na u lyoh ka la ong ,  Une u long U Khun uba ieit jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha eh — to shahshkor ïa u !

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses sat to judge the people : and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Moses u dang pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng u paidbah , bad kumta u la bunkam naduh mynstep haduh ban da miet .

translation.en: That we should be to the praise of his glory , who first trusted in Christ .
translation.kha: Te ma ngi , kiba long kiba nyngkong ban kyrmen ha U Khrist , ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom U Blei !

translation.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness  ; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit baneh jong me , to long uba bha ïa nga , khnang ba ngan lah ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: The land shall be utterly emptied , and utterly spoiled : for the  Lord  hath spoken this word .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan ka pra bad kan jot . U  Trai  u la kren bad ïa kata yn pyndep .

translation.en: A sound of battle is in the land , and of great destruction .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsawa jong ka thma la ïohsngew ha ka ri , bad ka don ka jingpynjot bakhraw .

translation.en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders , and carry it forth in the twilight : thou shalt cover thy face , that thou see not the ground : for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Shah ïa ki ban khmih ba me tawah ïa la ka song halor ka tyrpeng jong me bad mih shabar sha kaba dum da kaba tap ïa ki khmat jong me , khnang ba men ym ïohi shano me leit . Kaei kaba me leh kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth , and shall assure our hearts before him .
translation.kha: Kane , te , ka long kumno ngin tip ba ngi long ki jong ka jingshisha ; kane ka long kumno ngin sngewskhem ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee , and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king s meat : and as thou seest , deal with thy servants .
translation.kha: Te sa ïanujor ïa ngi bad ki samla shynrang kiba bam ïa ka jingbam jong ka ïingbishar syiem , bad pynshong nongrim ïa ka rai ka jong phi ha ka jingïohi kumno ngi long .

translation.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple  ; and at night he went out , and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pynlut ïa kita ki sngi da kaba hikai ha ka Templ , bad haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u ju mihnoh shabar bad pynlut ïa ka miet ha u lum ki Olib .

translation.en: And they shall kill him , and the third day he shall be raised again .  And they were exceeding sorry .
translation.kha: ki ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .  Ki synran ki la sngewsih eh .

translation.en: And he said , What then is to be done for her ? And Gehazi answered , Verily she hath no child , and her husband is old .
translation.kha: U Elisha u kylli ïa u Gehasi ,  Te kaei nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ka ?  U jubab ,  Kam don khun shynrang , bad u tnga jong ka ruh u la tymmen .

translation.en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth , and , behold , he eateth  ; but he awaketh , and his soul is empty : or as when a thirsty man dreameth , and , behold , he drinketh  ; but he awaketh , and , behold , he is faint , and his soul hath appetite : so shall the multitude of all the nations be , that fight against mount Zion .
translation.kha: Baroh ki hima kiba ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin long kum u briew uba ïap-tyrsaw uba phohsniew ba u bam jingbam bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah hapdeng ka jingthngan , lane kum u briew u ban sa ïap na ka jingsliang uba phohsniew ba u dih um bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah ryngkat bad u pdot ba-tyrkhong .

translation.en: Behold , a people shall come from the north , and a great nation , and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki wan na ka ri bashatei , ka jaitbynriew bakhrawbor na jngai bah ; shibun ki syiem ki pynkhreh ïa ka thma .

translation.en: Some of them that stood there , when they heard that , said , This man calleth for Elias .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew kiba ïeng hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa u bad ki la ong ,  U khot ïa u Elijah !

translation.en: The former treatise have I made , O Theophilus , of all that Jesus began both to do and teach ,
translation.kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Ha ka kitab banyngkong jong nga , nga la thoh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba U Jisu u la leh bad hikai naduh ka por ba u la sdang ïa ka jingtrei jong u tad haduh ka sngi ha kaba la shim noh ïa u sha bneng .

translation.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine , and men of strength to mingle strong drink :
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ki nongjop ïa ki klong waiñ ! Kiba shlur bad ki bym tieng ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingdih ba la khleh !

translation.en: So the service was prepared , and the priests stood in their place , and the Levites in their courses , according to the king s commandment .
translation.kha: Haba la dep pynbiang ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki shim ïa la ki bynta , kumba la hukum da u syiem .

translation.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way ? by taking heed thereto according to thy word .
translation.kha: Da kumno u samla un lah ban sumar khuid ïa la ka jingim ? Da kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: For when the Gentiles , which have not the law , do by nature the things contained in the law , these , having not the law , are a law unto themselves :
translation.kha: Ki Jentil kim don ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei haba ki leh da ka jingsngewthuh ha lade ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , ki long ka hukum ïa lade , wat la kim don ka Hukum .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and all that he did , and his sin that he sinned , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Manasseh u la leh , kynthup ïa ki pop ba u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah

translation.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .
translation.kha: Haba ïa u Lebi ym pat shym la kha , hynrei u la long , kum ban shu ong , ha ka met u kpa tymmen jong u , u Abraham haba u Melkhisedek u la ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there , neither his disciples , they also took shipping , and came to Capernaum , seeking for Jesus .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba U Jisu ne ki synran jong u kim don hangta , ki la kiew ha kita ki lieng bad ki la leit sha Kapernam ban wad ïa u .

translation.en: And they said , We cannot , until all the flocks be gathered together , and till they roll the stone from the well s mouth  ; then we water the sheep .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ngim lah ban leh kumta tad haduh ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh kin don hangne bad ba ym pat pyntyllun sharud ïa u maw ; nangta ngin sa ai um ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb , and shall compass about to Goath .
translation.kha: Bad u pud un bteng nangta na sepngi shaduh u lum Gareb bad nangta sawdong sha Goah .

translation.en: So when David was old and full of days , he made Solomon his son king over Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la tymmen bha , u thung ïa u Solomon u khun jong u kum u syiem halor ki Israel .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord  ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .
translation.kha: Namar kata , ko kynrad , ieh ngan sah ma nga hangne kum u mraw jong phi ha ka jaka u para , bad shah ïa u ba un leit phai bad la ki hynmen .

translation.en: And Jehiel , and Azaziah , and Nahath , and Asahel , and Jerimoth , and Jozabad , and Eliel , and Ismachiah , and Mahath , and Benaiah , were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother , at the commandment of Hezekiah the king , and Azariah the ruler of the house of God .
translation.kha: Shiphew ngut ki Lebi ki shimti ban trei hapoh jong ki : u Jehiel , Asasaïah , Nahath , Asahel , Jerimoth , Josabad , Eliel , Ismakhaïah , Mahath , bad u Benaïah . La leh ïa kane baroh hapoh ka bor jong u syiem Hesekaïah bad u Asaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

translation.en: For God commanded , saying , Honour thy father and mother : and , He that curseth father or mother , let him die the death .
translation.kha: Namar U Blei u la ong , ‘ To burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad ‘ Uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .’

translation.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes , your bodies to bodies of clay .
translation.kha: Ki proberb jong me kim don jingmyntoi shuh kum ki dpei ; ki jingïasaid jong me ki long kiba tlot kum ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed : and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka umphniang kaba dang sah ha ka sla ti un kyllan ha ka khlieh jong uta u briew . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .

translation.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs , and Beth–horon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Kibsaim , bad ka Beth Horon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you , saying , Shew a miracle for you : then thou shalt say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and cast it before Pharaoh , and it shall become a serpent .
translation.kha: Lada u Pharaoh u dawa ba phin pynshisha ïa lade da kaba leh kambah , ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh bad bret ïa u ha khmat u Pharaoh , bad un sa kylla bseiñ .

translation.en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family , because he hath no son ? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father .
translation.kha: Tang namar ba im don khun shynrang , balei keiñ ba ka kyrteng jong i kan jah na Israel ? Ai bynta kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi hapdeng ki kur ki jait jong i pa .

translation.en: And believers were the more added to the Lord , multitudes both of men and women . )
translation.kha: Hynrei la nang pynïasoh kham bun ki briew sha ka kynhun — u paid ki rangbah bad ki kynthei kiba la ngeit ha U Trai .

translation.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites :
translation.kha: U Lebi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershon , u Kohath , bad u Merari , kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong kita ki kur kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jong ki . U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : U Libni bad u Shimei ; u Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel ; bad u Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mahli bad u Mushi . Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki ïing kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .

translation.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee , saying , Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these ?
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me kin kylli kaei kane ka jingmut ,

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saith  ; Behold , I will punish the multitude of No , and Pharaoh , and Egypt , with their gods , and their kings  ; even Pharaoh , and all them that trust in him :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa u Amon , u blei jong ki Thebes , ryngkat lang bad ka Ijipt bad ki blei bad ki syiem jong ka . Ngan shim noh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa baroh kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u ,

translation.en: Then he said unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here ? for they have filled the land with violence , and have returned to provoke me to anger : and , lo , they put the branch to their nose .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa katai ? Kine ki briew ka Judah kim pat hun tang kaba leh ïa ki kam ba-ijli kiba me la ïohi hangne bad ban pynphriang ïa ka ri da ka jingleh thombor . Em , ki dei ban wan bad leh ïa ki hangne hi ha ka Templ ban pynbitar shuh shuh ïa nga . Peit kumno ki beiñ ïa nga ha ka rukom kaba kham palat .

translation.en: A kingdom is a government that is headed by a king .
translation.kha: Ka Hima ka dei ka jingsynshar ha kaba U Syiem u long u khliehduh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; For your sake I have sent to Babylon , and have brought down all their nobles , and the Chaldeans , whose cry is in the ships .
translation.kha: U Blei uba khuid ki Israel , U  Trai  uba pynim ïa phi u ong ,  Ban pynim ïa phi , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Babilon ; ngan pynpait ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah , bad ki jingrisa jong ki briew jong ka kin kylla jingïam .

translation.en: And if thy right hand offend thee , cut it off , and cast it from thee : for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish , and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell .
translation.kha: Lada ka kti kamon jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop , to ot noh ïa ka bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban duh ïa kawei na ki kti jong phi ban ïa kaba ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka leit sha dujok .

translation.en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab : and he said unto the king of Moab , Let my father and my mother , I pray thee , come forth , and be with you , till I know what God will do for me .
translation.kha: U Dabid u leit noh na kata ka jaka sha Mispah ha Moab bad u ong ha u syiem Moab ,  Sngewbha shah ïa i pa bad i mei jong nga ban wan bad sah bad phi haduh ba ngan da tip aïu U Blei un leh na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  What wilt thou ?  She saith unto him , Grant that these my two sons may sit , the one on thy right hand , and the other on the left , in thy kingdom .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba pha kwah ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab ,  To kular ïa nga ba kine ki khun shynrang jong nga kin shong ha ka liang kamon bad ka liang kadiang jong me haba men long u Syiem .

translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and the sun shone upon the water , and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood :
translation.kha: Haba ki la khie thiah ha ka step kaba bud , ka sngi ka la tyngshaiñ halor ka um , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ba kan saw kum ka snam .

translation.en: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel : and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites :
translation.kha: U Joab u long u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Israel ; u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u khmih ïa ka kynhun ïada ïa u Dabid ;

translation.en: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith , and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil , saying , It is ready for the sodering : and he fastened it with nails , that it should not be moved .
translation.kha: U misteri u ong ïa u bania , ‘ Me la lehbha !’ U briew uba shoh pynjlih ïa ka bleithaw u pynshlur ïa uwei uba sah preg ban pyndait lang ïa ka . Ki ong ‘ ka jingpyndait ka long kaba bha’ — bad ki pynskhem ïa ka bleithaw ha ka jaka da ki preg .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste  ; and he said , I have sinned against the  Lord  your God , and against you .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot kyrkieh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ,  Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïa phi ruh .

translation.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him , Timothy and Erastus  ; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Timothi bad u Erastos , ar ngut ki nongïarap jong u , sha Makedonia , katba u dang pynlut sa katto katne por ha ka probins jong ka Asia .

translation.en: For the Father loveth the Son , and sheweth him all things that himself doeth : and he will shew him greater works than these , that ye may marvel .
translation.kha: Naba U Kpa u ieit ïa U Khun bad u pyn-i ha u ïa baroh kaba ma u hi u leh . Un pyn-i ha u wat ïa kiei kiei kiba kham khraw kiba un leh ban ïa kane , bad baroh phin sngewlyngngoh .

translation.en: When thou goest , thy steps shall not be straitened  ; and when thou runnest , thou shalt not stumble .
translation.kha: Yn ym don u ban pynwit ïa ka lynti jong phi lada phi ïaid kum uba stad , bad phin ym jynthut haba phi mareh .

translation.en: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite , Wherefore goest thou also with us ? return to thy place , and abide with the king : for thou art a stranger , and also an exile .
translation.kha: bad u syiem u ong ha u Ittai , u nongïalam jong ki ,  Balei phi ïaleit bad ngi ? Khie leit phai noh bad sah bad u syiem thymmai . Phi dei u nongwei , u nongphetwir na la ka jong ka ri .

translation.en: I , even I , have spoken  ; yea , I have called him : I have brought him , and he shall make his way prosperous .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uba la kren bad ba la khot ïa u ; nga la ïalam ïa u shabar bad la ai ha u ïa ka jingjop .

translation.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others  ;
translation.kha: U pynshitom ïa ki nongpop ha kaba baroh kin ïohi ïa kata ,

translation.en: So the waters were healed unto this day , according to the saying of Elisha which he spake .
translation.kha: Bad kata ka um ka la khuid naduh kata ka sngi , kumba u Elisha u la ong ba kan long kumta .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The heaven is my throne , and the earth is my footstool : where is the house that ye build unto me ? and where is the place of my rest ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga bad ka khyndew ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Kaba kumno keiñ ka ïing men tei ïa nga , bad kaba kumno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?

translation.en: And you , being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh , hath he quickened together with him , having forgiven you all trespasses ;
translation.kha: Phi la long ha kawei ka por kiba la ïap ha kaba kynja mynsiem namar ki pop jong phi bad namar ba phi la long ki Jentil kiba khlem ka Hukum . Hynrei U Blei mynta u la wallam ïa phi sha ka jingim bad U Khrist .

translation.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees , This man is not of God , because he keepeth not the sabbath day . Others said , How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ? And there was a division among them .
translation.kha: Don ki Pharisi kiba la ong ,  Uta u briew uba la leh ïa kane um lah ban long na U Blei , naba um shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum Sabbaton .  Hynrei , kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  Kumno u briew uba long u nongpop u lah ban leh kum kita ki kambah kat kine ?  Bad ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: What ? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you , which ye have of God , and ye are not your own ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ka met jong phi ka long ka jaka shong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba shong hapoh jong phi bad ïa uba la ai ha phi da U Blei ?

translation.en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones , and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki kynrei ha Jerusalem kum ki maw , bad u dieng Kedar u jyllei kum u dieng Sykomore   .

translation.en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand ? will Saul come down , as thy servant hath heard ? O  Lord  God of Israel , I beseech thee , tell thy servant . And the  Lord  said , He will come down .
translation.kha: Hato ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga ha u Saul ? Hato u Saul un wan shisha , kumba nga la ïohsngew ? Ko  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga kyrpad ïa me ban jubab ïa nga !  U  Trai  u jubab ,  U Saul un wan .

translation.en: And the king , and all the people that were with him , came weary , and refreshed themselves there .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la thait hi ïan haba ki la poi ha Jordan , bad ki la shong pynjahthait hangta .

translation.en: And if any man will hurt them , fire proceedeth out of their mouth , and devoureth their enemies : and if any man will hurt them , he must in this manner be killed .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa ki , ka ding kan mih na ki shyntur jong ki bad kan bam duh ïa ki nongshun jong ki ; bad ha kane ka rukom , uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa ki un shah pynïap .

translation.en: Our soul waiteth for the  Lord  : he is our help and our shield .
translation.kha: Ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U  Trai  ; u long ka jingïada bad ka jingïarap jong ngi .

translation.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem , and be glad with her , all ye that love her : rejoice for joy with her , all ye that mourn for her :
translation.kha: To shadkmen bad ka Jerusalem ; to lehkmen na ka bynta jong ka , phi baroh kiba ieit ïa kane ka nongbah ! To shadkmen bad ka , mynta phi baroh kiba la ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong ka !

translation.en: And when they heard it , they glorified the Lord , and said unto him , Thou seest , brother , how many thousands of Jews there are which believe  ; and they are all zealous of the law :
translation.kha: Hadien ba la ïohsngew ïa u , ki baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei . Nangta ki la ong ,  Ko Paul , phi lah ban ïohi katno hajar ngut ki Jiw ki la kylla long ki parabangeit , bad katno ma ki baroh ki bat pyrkhing ïa ka Hukum .

translation.en: When Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , heard of it , it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Sanballat , na ka shnong Beth Horon , bad u Tobiah , u rangbah synshar jong ka probins Ammon , ki la ïohsngew ba don mano mano ba la wan ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki Israel , bad ki la bitar haduh katta katta .

translation.en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month , began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem  ; and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ha u bnai ba ar jong ka snem hadien ba ki la wan pat sha ka jaka jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem , ki sdang ban ïatrei . U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad kiwei pat ki para rangbah ka ri , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ha ka jingshisha , baroh kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha ka jingtrei .
