Ïa baroh ki Lebi kiba la dap arphew snem ka rta lane tam , la buh ban khmih ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have eternal life .
translation.kha: Kumba u Moses u la kyntiew ïa u  seiñ rnong ha u dieng ha ka ri shyiap , ha kajuh ka rukom ka dei ïa U Khun U Briew ba yn kyntiew shajrong , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits , and the breadth one cubit  ; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits , and the breadth one cubit .
translation.kha: Ka bynta kaba sha trai eh jong ka duwan , na ka bynta ba-halor jong ka trai , ka long shi mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynta kaba bud na ka tduh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong , bad ka long ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynta hadien kata na ka tduh ruh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong .

translation.en: And he was sad at that saying , and went away grieved : for he had great possessions .
translation.kha: Haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka jingidiaw ka la tap ïa ka khmat jong u baroh kawei , bad u la leit noh da ka jingsngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah haduh katta katta .

translation.en: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord , and the cup of devils : ye cannot be partakers of the Lord s table , and of the table of devils .
translation.kha: Phim lah ban dih na ka khuri U Trai bad ruh na ka khuri ki ksuid ; phim lah ban ïabam na ka miej U Trai bad ruh na ka miej ki ksuid .

translation.en: And another said , I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I go to prove them : I pray thee have me excused .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga la thied san jur ki masi dab bad nga don ha ka lynti ban tynjuh ïa ki ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jong nga .’

translation.en: Then Job answered the  Lord  , and said ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Job u jubab ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the people that were encamped heard say , Zimri hath conspired , and hath also slain the king : wherefore all Israel made Omri , the captain of the host , king over Israel that day in the camp .
translation.kha: bad haba ki ïohsngew ba u Simri u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem bad pynïap ïa u , hangta hi ki baroh ki pynbna ba u nongai hukum jong ki , u Omri , u long u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: Their Paradise home was the garden of Eden —a place of great beauty with a river and fruit trees and animals .
translation.kha: Ki sah ha paradais , ha ka kper Eden . ka long ka jaka kaba itynnat kaba don ka wah , ki dieng soh bad ki mrad .

translation.en: My face will I turn also from them , and they shall pollute my secret place : for the robbers shall enter into it , and defile it .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leh ei ei haba ïa ka Templ bakordor jong nga yn pyntngit , haba ki nongtuh kin rung sha ka bad kin pyntngit ïa ka .

translation.en: For it is not ye that speak , but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you .
translation.kha: Naba ki ktien kiba phin kren kim dei ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem jong U Kpa jong phi uba kren lyngba jong phi .

translation.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned : but he that believeth not is condemned already , because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ha U Khun un ym shah bishar ; hynrei ïa uno uno u bymngeit la lah bishar lypa ïa u , namar ba um shym la ngeit ha U Khun ba tang marwei jong U Blei .

translation.en: He hath shewed thee , O man , what is good  ; and what doth the  Lord  require of thee , but to do justly , and to love mercy , and to walk humbly with thy God ?
translation.kha: Em , U  Trai  u la ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba bha . Kaei kaba u dawa na ngi ka long kane : Ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok , ban pyn-i ïa ka jingieit baneh , bad ban im ha ka jingïasyllok basngewrit bad U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: Then he said , I pray thee therefore , father , that thou wouldest send him to my father s house :
translation.kha: Uta u riewspah u la ong , ‘ Kumta nga kyrpad ïa me , ko kpa Abraham , to phah ïa u Lasaros sha ka ïing u kpa jong nga , ha kaba nga don san ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang .

translation.en: And , behold , seven other kine came up after them , poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness :
translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei ki la wan mih kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyieng suda . Ki long ki masi kynthei kiba isangsot eh kiba ngam pat ju ïohi hangno hangno ha ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple , and departed , and went and hanged himself .
translation.kha: U Judas u la bret ïa ki sbai rupa ha madan hapoh ka Templ bad u la mihnoh ; nangta u la leit bad u la sdien phasi ïa lade .

translation.en: And it shall be upon Aaron s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts  ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Aaron u dei ban teh ïa u ha ka shyllangmat jong u , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingainguh ba ki Israel ki pynkyntang sha nga , wat la ki briew ki bakla haba ki ai ïa ki .

translation.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content .
translation.kha: Te namarkata , lada ngi don ka bam bad ka kup ka sem , kata kan dei ka la biang ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Laban said unto him , I pray thee , if I have found favour in thine eyes , tarry : for I have learned by experience that the  Lord  hath blessed me for thy sake .
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u ,  Shah ba ngan ong ïa kane : nga la ïoh jingtip da kaba wad na U Blei ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar jong me .

translation.en: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the  Lord  had gone six paces , he sacrificed oxen and fatlings .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïaid hynriew jam , u Dabid u la phah ïa ki ban sangeh katba u dang ai ka jingkñia ïa U  Trai  da u masi bad u khun masi ba la pynsngaid .

translation.en: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley , which is neither eared nor sown , and shall strike off the heifer s neck there in the valley :
translation.kha: Kin leit ïalam ïa ka sha ka jaka kaba harud kawei ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad um , ha kaba ym pat ju don ba lur ne thung jingthung , bad hangta kin pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong ka .

translation.en: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month : in the tenth month , on the first day of the month , were the tops of the mountains seen .
translation.kha: Kata ka um ruh ka la nang hiar nang hiar , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba shiphew , ki kliar lum ki la paw .

translation.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he hath commanded thee .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh kiba u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Then the handmaidens came near , they and their children , and they bowed themselves .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki tnga kliar ki la wan lem bad ki khun jong ki , bad ki nguh ;

translation.en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u pyndap ,  Nga don hangne ka kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u la ai ha nga .  Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .

translation.en: And one told Jacob , and said , Behold , thy son Joseph cometh unto thee : and Israel strengthened himself , and sat upon the bed .
translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Jakob ba u Joseph u khun jong u , u wan jngoh ïa u , u pyneh katba lah ban shong ha la jingthiah .

translation.en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whom the  Lord  put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary , according to all that the  Lord  had commanded .
translation.kha: U Besalel , u Oholiab , bad kiwei pat ki nongtrei ïa kiba U  Trai  u la ai ka jingtbit bad ka jingshemphang , kiba tip ban trei ïa ka kam baroh kaba ïadei bad ka jingtrei ïa ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang , ki dei ban shna ïa kaei kaei baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .
translation.kha: Um khuslai lane sheptieng ; u thikna ban ïohi ba ki nongshun jong u ki shahjop .

translation.en: O Israel , trust thou in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
translation.kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi ki paid Israel . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .

translation.en: Now the hand of the  Lord  was upon me in the evening , afore he that was escaped came  ; and had opened my mouth , until he came to me in the morning  ; and my mouth was opened , and I was no more dumb .
translation.kha: Ha ka janmiet shuwa ba un wan , nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai kaba jur . Haba uta u briew u la poi ha ka step kaba bud , U Trai u ai ha nga pat ïa ka bor ban kren .

translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , Thou shalt love thy neighbour , and hate thine enemy .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ieit ïa ki paralok jong phi bad isih ïa ki nongshun jong phi .’

translation.en: From the south , all the land of the Canaanites , and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians , unto Aphek , to the borders of the Amorites :
translation.kha: Ka dang don ka ri ki Kanaan baroh kawei , bad ka Mearah ( kaba dei ka jong ki nong Sidon ) , haduh ka Aphek , kaba ha khappud ki Amor ;

translation.en: Said he not unto me , She is my sister ? and she , even she herself said , He is my brother : in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this .
translation.kha: U Abraham hi u la ong ba ka dei ka para jong u , bad ka ruh ka ong kumjuh . Nga la leh ïa kane da ka jingïatiplem kaba sngur , bad ngam shym la leh bakla .

translation.en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim , and the ears of them that hear shall hearken .
translation.kha: Ki khmat bad ki shkor jong ki kin ïohi bad kin ïohsngew ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew .

translation.en: Behold , I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire , and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work  ; and I have created the waster to destroy .
translation.kha: Nga la thaw ïa u nongshoh-nar , uba pyrsad ïa ka ding bad shna ïa ki tiar thma . Nga la thaw ruh ïa u shipai , uba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ïapom ban pynïap .

translation.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass  ; his bones are like bars of iron .
translation.kha: Ki shyieng jong u ki khlaiñ kum ka rnong , bad ki khohwah jong u ki long kum ki shalyngka nar .

translation.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works : in doctrine shewing uncorruptness , gravity , sincerity ,
translation.kha: Ha kiei kiei baroh phi dei ban long ka nuksa jong ka jinglong babha . To long kiba minot bad kiba kitkhia ha ka jinghikai jong me .

translation.en: Thy sun shall no more go down  ; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself : for the  Lord  shall be thine everlasting light , and the days of thy mourning shall be ended .
translation.kha: Ki sngi ka jingjynjar jong pha kin kut noh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long ka jingshai bymjukut jong pha , kham palat ban ïa ka sngi bad u bnai .

translation.en: And the  Lord  did so  ; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh , and into his servants  houses , and into all the land of Egypt : the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u leh kumta ; ki skain da ki kynhun bah ki wan rung hapoh ïing jong u Pharaoh bad hapoh ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong u . Ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka julor ha kita ki skain .

translation.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain , even that was slain with the Midianite woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites .
translation.kha: Ka kyrteng uta u Israel uba la shah pynïap lang bad kata ka kynthei Midian ka long u Simri u khun jong u Salu , u khlieh jong ka longïing kaba na ka jait Simeon .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake to Manasseh , and to his people : but they would not hearken .
translation.kha: Wat la U  Trai  u la maham ïa u Manasseh bad ïa ki briew jong u , ki kyntait ban shahshkor .

translation.en: Where are you ?
translation.kha: Phi don shaei ?

translation.en: For I say unto you , Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist : but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ,  U Jisu u la bynrap ,  U Ïoannis u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta uba rit tam ha ka Hima U Blei u long uba kham khraw ban ïa u Ïoannis .

translation.en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not , when she had received the spies with peace .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la ïada ïa ka Rahab ka nuti na kaba shah pynïap lem bad kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei ; naba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongsyntiat na Israel .

translation.en: I have given them thy word  ; and the world hath hated them , because they are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong me , bad ka pyrthei ka la shun ïa ki , namar ba kim dei jong kane ka pyrthei , kumba nga ruh ngam dei na kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers , after your courses , according to the writing of David king of Israel , and according to the writing of Solomon his son .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ki jaka shong jong phi ha ka Templ shi kur shi kur , kat kum ki jingkitkhlieh ba la aiti ha phi da u syiem Dabid bad u syiem Solomon u khun jong u ,

translation.en: Then answered Amos , and said to Amaziah , I was no prophet , neither was I a prophet s son  ; but I was an herdman , and a gatherer of sycomore fruit :
translation.kha: U Amos u jubab ,  Ngam dei kum uta u jait nongïathuhlypa , uba ïathuhlypa na ka bynta ban ïoh jingsiew . Nga dei u nongri jingri , bad nga sumar ïa ki dieng Dumbur .

translation.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh hangta .

translation.en: Not now as a servant , but above a servant , a brother beloved , specially to me , but how much more unto thee , both in the flesh , and in the Lord ?
translation.kha: Bad mynta um long shuh tang kum u mraw , hynrei kham palat ban ïa u mraw : u long u para ba-ieit ha U Khrist . Katno u long uba kordor ïa nga ! Bad katno khraw un long uba kordor ïa me , kum u mraw bad kum u para ha u Trai !

translation.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers : and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u la ïap , bad u khun jong u , u Manasseh u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .
translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ap ha Athens ïa u Silas bad u Timothi , u sngew shitom jingmut shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ba ka nongbah ka shlei da ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand  ; and he shall magnify himself in his heart , and by peace shall destroy many : he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes  ; but he shall be broken without hand .
translation.kha: Namar ba u long uba sianti , un jop ha ki rukom shukor jong u . Un sngewsarong ïa lade bad pynjot ïa shibun briew khlem ka jingmaham . Un len wat ïa U Syiem bakhraw jong baroh , hynrei ïa u yn pynjot khlem da pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka bor ba kynja briew .

translation.en: Take the rod , and gather thou the assembly together , thou , and Aaron thy brother , and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes  ; and it shall give forth his water , and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock : so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u diengduh uba don ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad nangta ma me bad u Aaron men lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh . Hangta ha khmat jong ki baroh kren ha utai u mawsiang , bad ka um kan mihnoh na u . Ha kane ka rukom men pynmih um na uta u mawsiang na ka bynta jong u paidbah , khnang ba ma ki lem bad ki jingri jong ki kin ïoh dih .

translation.en: Shall vain words have an end ? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest ?
translation.kha: Hato phin shu kren junom ? Hato borabor phin don ka kyntien khatduh ?

translation.en: Not slothful in business ; fervent in spirit ; serving the Lord ;
translation.kha: To trei shitom bad wat long kiba alhia . To shakri ïa U Trai da ka dohnud kaba aiti lut .

translation.en: And Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite , which was of Bahurim , hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Shimei u khun jong u Gera , na ka jait Benjamin kaba na Bahurim , u la pynkloi ban leit sha ka Jordan ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem Dabid .

translation.en: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee , and accomplish mine anger upon thee : and I will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense thee for all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Mynta kumne kumne phan sa sngew ïa ka bor jingbitar jong nga baroh . Ngan bishar ïa pha kat kum kiei kiei kiba pha la leh , bad pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ba-ijli jong pha baroh .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumba u syiem Jehoïakim u la leh .

translation.en: And when he had taken him , and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees till noon , and then died .
translation.kha: U shakri u la bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u , kaba thum ïa u ha la ka pneh haduh shiteng sngi , ka por ha kaba u la ïap .

translation.en: Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had lamented him , and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land .
translation.kha: Mynta u Samuel u la ïap , bad baroh ki Israel ki la ïambriew ïa u bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka shnong jong u hi , ha Ramah . U Saul u la lah beh lut ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong baroh na Israel .

translation.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver .
translation.kha: Ka aiñ kaba me la ai ka kham kordor ïa nga ban ïa ka pisa baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas : besides , I know not whether I baptized any other .
translation.kha: ( O ho-oid , nga la pynbaptis ruh ïa u Stephanas bad ïa ka longïing jong u ; hynrei ngam kynmaw la nga la pynbaptis sa ïano ïano pat . )

translation.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; and it shall be thine , and thy sons  with thee , by a statute for ever  ; as the  Lord  hath commanded .
translation.kha: Kin wallam ïa ka kjat-dien bad ïa ka shadem katba dang kñia ïa ka khleiñ kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai . Kine ki bynta ki long ki jong me bad jong ki khun jong me pateng la pateng , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And saith unto him , If thou be the Son of God , cast thyself down : for it is written , He shall give his angels charge concerning thee : and in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha U ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , pynnoh ïa lade sha tbian ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :   ‘ U Blei un ai hukum ïa la ki angel shaphang jong me ; kin bat ïa me hajrong da ki kti jong ki , khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me ruh kin ym mynsaw ha ki maw .’

translation.en: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign , and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Zibiah of Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U Joash u la don hynñiew snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sibaïah na ka nongbah Beersheba .

translation.en: And I will break the pride of your power  ; and I will make your heaven as iron , and your earth as brass :
translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka jingsngewmeng jong phi ; yn ym don slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong bad eh kum u nar .

translation.en: And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Nga dei ban leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki ïawan sha nga ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei .

translation.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And let them make me a sanctuary  ; that I may dwell among them .
translation.kha: Ki dei ruh ban shna ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba ngan ïoh shong hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , From whence comest thou ? And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Na-ei me wan ?  U Soitan u jubab ,  Nga la leit ïaid shane bad shatai , da kaba shang kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: The preparations of the heart in man , and the answer of the tongue , is from the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban don ki jingthmu , hynrei khatduh ka rai ka dei jong U Blei .

translation.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban sngewthikna ba uno uno uba ai dih wat shi khuri ka umkhriat ha uwei uba rit tam na kine ki nongbud jong nga namar ba u dei u nongbud jong nga , un ïohpdiang da shisha ïa ka bainong .

translation.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare : but whoso putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be safe .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba ma ban sngewkhia ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki pyrkhat shaphang jong phi , hynrei lada phi shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi long shngain .

translation.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom jur ïa ki bad pynhiarkput pura halor jong ki . Kin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingim bymjukut ka mut ban ithuh ïa me , U Blei bashisha tang ma u hi , bad kaba ithuh ïa U Jisu Khrist , ïa uba me la phah .

translation.en: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came : for the famine was in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob lem bad kiwei pat ruh ki la ïawan ban thied kew , namar ba la don ka  nemsniew ha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre , and take thee much soap , yet thine iniquity is marked before me , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Wat lada me la sait da ka sabon kaba khlaiñ , ngan dang ïai ïohi ïa ka jingkhah jaboh jong ka jingpalat jong me .

translation.en: Now when Festus was come into the province , after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien ba u Phestos u la poi ha ka probins    , u la leit na Kaisaria , sha Jerusalem ,

translation.en: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death  ; and his deadly wound was healed : and all the world wondered after the beast .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki khlieh jong uta u mradkhlaw ka i kumba ka la shah pynmong jur , hynrei ka jingmong ka la ïohkhiah . Ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la sngewphylla bad ka la bud ïa uta u mradkhlaw .

translation.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me , and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee , and I will bless thee .
translation.kha: Tei ïa nga kawei ka duwan da ka khyndew , bad kñia ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi jong phi halor jong ka kum ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ha man la ka jaka ba nga pynkyrpang ba phin mane ïa nga , ngan wan bad kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread , and a bottle of wine , and a kid , and sent them by David his son unto Saul .
translation.kha: U Jesse u phah ïa u Dabid sha u Saul lem bad u khunblang , u kada uba kit shikhung u kpu bad ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .

translation.en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months .
translation.kha: U Dabid u sah ha ri Philistia khathynriew bnai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Where is the bill of your mother s divorcement , whom I have put away ? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you ? Behold , for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves , and for your transgressions is your mother put away .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Phi tharai ba nga la phah noh ïa la ki briew kum u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga ? Hangno te , ki don ki kot pyllait tnga ? Phi tharai nga la die ïa phi sha ka jingshahtehmraw kum u briew uba die ïa la ki khun kum ki mraw ? Em , phi la leit shahtehmraw noh namar ki pop jong phi ; la phah noh ïa phi namar ki kam bymman jong phi .

translation.en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering : as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor , so shall ye heave it .
translation.kha: Haba phi shet kpu , ïa uta uba phi shet nyngkong na u kew thymmai dei ban wanrah kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai . Ïa une dei ban wanrah kumjuh kumba phi wanrah jingainguh kyrpang na u kew ba phi shoh .

translation.en: And they said , Thy servants are twelve brethren , the sons of one man in the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , the youngest is this day with our father , and one is not .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Kynrad , baroh ngi ïadon khat-ar ngut shi para , ki khun jong ujuh u briew ha ka ri Kanaan . Uwei u para u la ïap , bad uba khatduh u don mynta bad i pa .

translation.en: But , beloved , be not ignorant of this one thing , that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years , and a thousand years as one day .
translation.kha: Hynrei to wat klet ïa kane kawei , ko paralok ba-ieit jong nga ! Kam don ka jingïapher ha khmat U Trai hapdeng ka shi sngi bad ka shihajar snem ; ha u , baroh ar ki long kumjuh .

translation.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children , My son , despise not thou the chastening of the Lord , nor faint when thou art rebuked of him :
translation.kha: Hato phi la klet noh ïa ki ktien pynshlur ïa kiba U Blei u la kren ha phi kum ïa la ki khun ?  Ko khun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut haba U Trai u sneng pynbeit ïa phi , bad wat sngew noh mynsiem haba u sneng ïa phi .

translation.en: And Gideon said unto them , I would desire a request of you , that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey . ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong shuh shuh ,  Shah ngan pan tang kawei na phi . Uwei pa uwei na phi un ai noh ha nga ïa ki sohshkor ba phi la shim .  ( Ki Midian kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , ki deng ki sohshkor ksiar . )

translation.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them , and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka namar kito ki por kiba ka la klet ïa nga mynba ka thang ki jingiwbih ïa u Baal bad ka la pynphuh pynphieng ïa lade da ki jingdeng bakordor haba ka leit bud nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land , and received in the same year an hundredfold : and the  Lord  blessed him .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la thung jingthung ha kata ka jaka , bad ha kata ka snem u ïoh ot shispah shah ïa kaba u la bet , namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u .

translation.en: Be it known now unto the king , that , if this city be builded , and the walls set up again , then will they not pay toll , tribute , and custom , and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings .
translation.kha: Ko syiem , lada ïa kane ka nongbah yn tei pat bad ïa ki kynroh jong ka yn pyndep , ki briew kin sa sangeh ban siew khajna , bad ki jingmih ka ïingsyiem kin sa duna .

translation.en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel : and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Ahab u khun u Omri u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar arphew ar snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Samuel , Hearken unto their voice , and make them a king . And Samuel said unto the men of Israel , Go ye every man unto his city .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Leh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , bad ai syiem noh ïa ki .  Nangta u Samuel u ong ïa ki rangbah Israel baroh ban leit phai sha la ïing .

translation.en: And he gave them their request  ; but sent leanness into their soul .
translation.kha: kumta u la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki la pan kwah , bad u la phah ruh ïa ka jingpang bashyrkhei hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death , to guide our feet into the way of peace .
translation.kha: bad ban tyngshaiñ na bneng halor kito baroh kiba im ha ka syrngiew ba-dum jong ka jingïap , ban ïalam ïa ki sien jam jong ngi ha ka lynti jong ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And now will I shew thee the truth . Behold , there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia  ; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all : and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia .
translation.kha: Bad kaei kaba ngan ïathuh ïa me ka long kaba shisha .  U angel u la ong ,  Sa lai ngut ki syiem kin synshar halor ka Persia , yn bud sa uba saw , u ban kham riewspah ban ïa baroh kiwei pat . Haba u la khlaiñbor bha bad riewspah eh un kob ïa ka hima Gris .

translation.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram , and take of his blood , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron , and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons , and upon the thumb of their right hand , and upon the great toe of their right foot , and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa u , shim khyndiat ka snam jong u , bad tah ïa ka ha ki shkor kamon jong u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ha ki  tikmie kamon jong ki , bad ha ki  jatkmie kamon jong ki . Synreit ïa ka snam kaba sah , sawdong kata ka duwan .

translation.en: And Gideon said , Therefore when the  Lord  hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand , then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers .
translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u ong ,  To , kam lei lei ! Haba U  Trai  u aiti ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ha nga , ngan shoh ïa phi da ki shiah bad da ki shiah buid na ka ri shyiap !

translation.en: And arms shall stand on his part , and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength , and shall take away the daily sacrifice , and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate .
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki shipai jong u kin pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Kin pynsangeh ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi bad kin pynïeng ïa ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli .

translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum hynñiew tukri pura jong ki lyngkhot kiba sah tam .

translation.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household , and twenty measures of pure oil : thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year .
translation.kha: bad u Solomon u la pynbiang ïa u Hiram da ar hajar ton u kew bad saw lakh litar ka umphniang Olib man ka snem ban bsa ïa ki rangbah jong u .

translation.en: And a cubit on the one side , and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent , it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side , to cover it .
translation.kha: Ïa ka sanphew sentimitar kaba tam na ka lynter jong kata ka jingtap ha baroh arliang dei ban wah ha ki krung jong ka Ïingjaiñ ba kan tap ïa ka .

translation.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u Joab u la phah khubor sha u Dabid da kaba ïathuh ïa u shaphang ka thma ,

translation.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up , and lose thy sweet words .
translation.kha: Phin hap prie noh ïa kaba phi la bam , bad baroh ki ktien pynroh jong phi kin sep-ei .

translation.en: But made himself of no reputation , and took upon him the form of a servant , and was made in the likeness of men :
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka kane , da ka mon balaitluid u kheiñduh noh ïa baroh kaba u don , bad u la shim ïa ka jinglong u shakri . U kylla long u kum u briew , bad u la wanpaw ha ka dur u briew .

translation.en: And he looked up , and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa ki briew bariewspah ba ki thep ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki ha ka jingkynshew ka Templ ,

translation.en: Now , behold , in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the  Lord  an hundred thousand talents of gold , and a thousand thousand talents of silver  ; and of brass and iron without weight  ; for it is in abundance : timber also and stone have I prepared  ; and thou mayest add thereto .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka Templ , da ki jingpyrshang jong nga , nga la lum palat ïa lai hajar sawspah ton ka ksiar bad palat ïa laiphew saw hajar ton ka rupa ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka . Nalor kata , la don bun bah ka rnong bad ka nar . Nga la pynkhreh ruh ïa ka dieng bad u maw , hynrei me dei ban pynïoh shuh shuh .

translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , This is the heir : come , let us kill him , that the inheritance may be ours .
translation.kha: Hynrei , haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la kren para ma ki , ‘ Une u dei u khun jong u trai . To ngin ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad ka jingdon jingem jong u kan long ka jong ngi !’

translation.en: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .
translation.kha: U paidbah byllien u la bud ïa u , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah jong u ha kaba pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang .

translation.en: But Abner the son of Ner , captain of Saul s host , took Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and brought him over to Mahanaim  ;
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Saul , u Abner u khun jong u Ner , u la phet bad u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul sha Mahanaim .

translation.en: Even the  Lord  God of hosts  ; the  Lord  is his memorial .
translation.kha: Une u dei U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh — U  Trai  long ka kyrteng ha uba dei ban mane .

translation.en: Thy first father hath sinned , and thy teachers have transgressed against me .
translation.kha: U kpa tymmen banyngkong eh jong phi u la leh pop ; ki nongïalam jong phi ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga ,

translation.en: And when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him .
translation.kha: U la beiñ ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u la pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don ba ïakren ha kaba paw , namar ba ki sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: And now the wise men , the astrologers , have been brought in before me , that they should read this writing , and make known unto me the interpretation thereof : but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing :
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongai jingmut bad ki nongleh myntor la wallam shapoh ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ban ïathuh ha nga aïu ka kit jingmut , hynrei kim shym lah ban shem ïa ka jingmut .

translation.en: This is the first and great commandment .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka hukum kaba khraw tam bad kaba donkam tam .

translation.en: In thee , O  Lord  , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga la wan ha me ban ïoh jingïada ; wat shah da lei lei ba ngan shahjop !

translation.en: When he is about to fill his belly , God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him , and shall rain it upon him while he is eating .
translation.kha: Ai un bam kat kaba u kwah ! U Blei un pynshitom ïa u ha ka jingbitar shla .

translation.en: If he be able to fight with me , and to kill me , then will we be your servants : but if I prevail against him , and kill him , then shall ye be our servants , and serve us .
translation.kha: Lada u jop bad u pynïap ïa nga , ngin long noh ki mraw jong phi ; hynrei lada ma nga , nga jop bad nga pynïap ïa u , phin long ki mraw jong ngi .

translation.en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife , and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband : else were your children unclean ; but now are they holy .
translation.kha: Naba ïa u tnga u bymngeit la pynlong uba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynïasoh ha ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ka tnga ka bymngeit la pynlong kaba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynïasoh ha la u tnga uba ngeit . Lada kane kam long kumta , ki khun jong ki kin long kum ki khun jong ki bymngeit ; hynrei kumba ka long , la pynlong ïa ki kiba la pdiang da U Blei .

translation.en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover , and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified .
translation.kha: Sa ar sngi , kumba phi tip , kan long ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti noh ïa ka ban shah sahnarphna .

translation.en: Now when all this was finished , all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah , and brake the images in pieces , and cut down the groves , and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin , in Ephraim also and Manasseh , until they had utterly destroyed them all . Then all the children of Israel returned , every man to his possession , into their own cities .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , baroh ki paid Israel ki leit sha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ha Judah bad ki pynpra ïa ki rishot maw , ki pyndkut ïa ki dur ka blei Asherah , bad ki pynjot ïa ki duwan bad ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki leh ïa kajuh ha baroh ki bynta basah jong ka Judah , bad ïa ki ri jong ki Benjamin , Ephraim bad Manasseh ; nangta baroh na ki , ki leit phai sha ïing .

translation.en: Then his lord , after that he had called him , said unto him , O thou wicked servant , I forgave thee all that debt , because thou desiredst me :
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah khot shapoh ïa uta u shakri . ‘ Me u shakri bymmyntoi !’ u la ong . ‘ Nga la map ïa ka ram jong me baroh kaba me shah na nga , namar ba me la kyrpad ïa nga kumta .

translation.en: Because Syria , Ephraim , and the son of Remaliah , have taken evil counsel against thee , saying ,
translation.kha: Ka Syria , lem bad ka Israel bad u syiem jong ka , ki la pynlong ka jingïasylla .

translation.en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance , being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will :
translation.kha: Ïa kiei kiei baroh la leh kat kum ka jingthmu bad ka jingrai U Blei ; bad U Blei u la jied ïa ngi ban long ki briew jong u hi ha U Khrist namar ka jingthmu jong u hi , ba la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba u la rai naduh kaba mynnyngkong .

translation.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings , and his anger was kindled greatly .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kane , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u wan ha u da ka bor , bad u bitar lep .

translation.en: And he said , Peaceably : I am come to sacrifice unto the  Lord  : sanctify yourselves , and come with me to the sacrifice . And he sanctified Jesse and his sons , and called them to the sacrifice .
translation.kha: Ho-oid  u jubab .  Nga la wan ban ai ka jingkñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Pynkhuid ïa lade , bad wan bad nga .  U ong ruh ïa u Jesse bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynkhuid ïa lade , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki sha kata ka jingkñia .

translation.en: The night is far spent , the day is at hand : let us therefore cast off the works of darkness , and let us put on the armour of light .
translation.kha: Ka miet ka la jan kut , ka sngi ka la jan sdang . To ngin ïasangeh noh na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba long jong ka jingdum , bad to ngin kieng ïa ki atiar ka jingïaleh ha ka jingshai .

translation.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother , Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye  ; and , behold , a beam is in thine own eye ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi nud ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Sngewbha , shah ïa nga ban khlaw noh ïa u thngiat na ka khmat jong phi ,’ haba phi don ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ?

translation.en: They say unto the blind man again , What sayest thou of him , that he hath opened thine eyes ? He said , He is a prophet .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa uta u briew sa shisien ,  Me ong u la pynkoit ïa me na ka jingmatlah jong me — haba kumta , me ong aïu shaphang jong u ?   U dei u nongïathuhlypa ,  uta u briew u la jubab .

translation.en: But I will put hooks in thy jaws , and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales , and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers , and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales .
translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa u bnoh lyngba ka tyngam jong me bad ngan pynlong ïa ka dohkha ha ka wah jong me ban sahkut sbak ha me . Nangta ngan tan ïa me na ka wah Nile bad ïa ki dohkha baroh kiba snoh ha me .

translation.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch , and mine own clothes shall abhor me .
translation.kha: U Blei u bret ïa nga sha ka thliew kaba jaboh , bad wat ki jaiñphong jong nga ki sngewlehrain ïa nga .

translation.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan  ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side , and went up through the mountains westward  ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven .
translation.kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud jong ki u sdang na Jordan bad u kiew artet ïa ka sharing lum kaba shatei na Jerikho bad u suh sha sepngi lyngba ka ri lum haduh ka ri shyiap Bethaben .

translation.en: And the evil spirit from the  Lord  was upon Saul , as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand : and David played with his hand .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u mynsiem bymman na U  Trai  u wan tyllep ïa u Saul . U dang shong ha la ïing bad u sum ha la ka kti , bad u Dabid u don hangta , u dang tem ïa la ka duitara .

translation.en: Why askest thou me ? ask them which heard me , what I have said unto them : behold , they know what I said .
translation.kha: Balei , te , ba phi kylli jingkylli ïa nga ? To kylli na kita ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa nga . Kylli na ki aïu nga la ïathuh ïa ki — ki tip ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .

translation.en: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee , which are not of the cities of these nations .
translation.kha: Da kumta phin leh ïa kita ki shnong kiba sha jngai na kata ka ri ha kaba phin shong .

translation.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof :
translation.kha: Don ka Ashdod bad ka Gasa , lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , kiba kynjoh sha ka wahduid ha khappud jong ka Ijipt bad ka rud jong ka Duriaw Mediterranian .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U Blei jong ka bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom .
translation.kha: Ka pyrda kaba wah ha ka Templ ka la kad arliang , naduh khlieh haduh tbian .

translation.en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven , whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel ;
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor bashisha , ka Khubor Babha , ka la wan nyngkong ha phi , phi la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingkyrmen ba ka tyrwa . Kumta ïa ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba phi kyrmen , ïa kaba la buh sumar na ka bynta jong phi ha bneng .

translation.en: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?
translation.kha: Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin ïai im ha ka pop ba ka jingaiei U Blei kan nang khraw ?

translation.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people , and flay their skin from off them  ; and they break their bones , and chop them in pieces , as for the pot , and as flesh within the caldron .
translation.kha: Phi bam syndon ïa ki briew jong nga . Phi puid noh ïa ka sniehdoh jong ki , pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki , bad shaiñ ïa ki kum ïa ka doh ha u khiew .

translation.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Shen shen hadien ba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah ,

translation.en: Lord  , how long shall the wicked , how long shall the wicked triumph ?
translation.kha: Slem haduh katno ki bymman kin ïalehkmen ? Slem haduh katno , A  Trai  ?

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel , or under a bed ? and not to be set on a candlestick ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ,  Hato ju don uno uno uba wallam ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang lane ha khrum jingthiah ? Hato um buh ïa ka ha u diengpynïeng sharak ?

translation.en: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses , clothed in fine linen , white and clean .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai ka bneng ki la bud ïa u , ki da shong halor ki kulai balieh bad ki la riam da ki jaiñ linen balieh bad bakhuid .

translation.en: And the firstborn said unto the younger , Our father is old , and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth :
translation.kha: Ka khun nyngkong ka ong ha la ka para ,  I pa jong ngi i la tymmen , bad ym don shynrang ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ki ban shongkurim ïa ngi ba ngin ïoh khun ïoh kti .

translation.en: And they went , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
translation.kha: Ki la leit bad ki la shem ïa kaei kaei baroh kumba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ha ki , bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity  ; and quicken thou me in thy way .
translation.kha: To sumar ïa nga na kaba pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ka bymdondor ; to long uba bha ïa nga , kumba me la kular .

translation.en: Mental Cleanness : If we fill our minds with clean , pure thoughts , our conduct will also be clean .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhuid ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat : Lada ngi pyndap ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi da kiei kiei kiba khuid , ka jinglong jong ngi ruh kan long kaba khuid .

translation.en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar , and sanctify it  ; and it shall be an altar most holy : whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter men leh ïa kane man la ka sngi . Te ka duwan kan sa long kaba khuid phar ; bad ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka kan pynmynsaw kat ïa uba ktah ïa ka .

translation.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man  ; he that sacrificeth a lamb , as if he cut off a dog s neck  ; he that offereth an oblation , as if he offered swine s blood  ; he that burneth incense , as if he blessed an idol . Yea , they have chosen their own ways , and their soul delighteth in their abominations .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki leh katba ki sngewbha . Baroh ka long kajuh ïa ki , la ki pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong kum ka jingkñia lane jingkñia da u briew ; la ki kñia da u khunlangbrot lane ki pyndkut ïa ka ryndang u ksew ; la ki wanrah ka jingainguh kew ne ki ainguh da ka snam sniang ; la ki thang jingiwbih ne ki duwai ha ka bleithaw . Ki shem sngewbha ha ki rukom ba-ijli ha ka jingmane .

translation.en: And when I looked , behold the four wheels by the cherubims , one wheel by one cherub , and another wheel by another cherub : and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ruh ba la don saw tylli ki shalyntem , baroh kiba ïasyriem , hajan uwei pa uwei kherub .

translation.en: To understand a proverb , and the interpretation  ; the words of the wise , and their dark sayings .
translation.kha: kumta ba kin shemphang ïa ki jingmut kiba rieh kiba don ha ki proberb bad ki jingeh ba ki riewstad ki kylli .

translation.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains , and for the precious things of the lasting hills ,
translation.kha: To ki lum kiba naduh mynbarim kin dap kyrhai da u soh uba kynsai .

translation.en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears , out of Judah three hundred thousand  ; and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand : all these were mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: U syiem Asa u don ka kynhun shipai kaba lai lakh ngut ki rangbah na Judah , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki sum , bad ar lakh phraphew ngut ki rangbah na Benjamin , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Baroh na ki , ki long kiba shlur , ki rangbah ba la pyntbit bha .

translation.en: The burden of Tyre . Howl , ye ships of Tarshish  ; for it is laid waste , so that there is no house , no entering in : from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor ïa ka Tyros . To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ki duriaw-bah ! Ïa ka kadlieng ha ka shnong jong phi , ka Tyros , la pynjot ; ki ïing bad ka kadlieng jong ka ki don ha ka jingjot . Kumba ki liengbah jong phi ki wan phai na Sypros , phi tip ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and he pursued after the children of Israel : and the children of Israel went out with an high hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad une u la beh kthong ïa ki Israel , kiba la mihnoh da ka jingjop .

translation.en: At the same time my reason returned unto me  ; and for the glory of my kingdom , mine honour and brightness returned unto me  ; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me  ; and I was established in my kingdom , and excellent majesty was added unto me .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai , ïa ka burom jong nga , ka jinglong syiem jong nga , bad ka burom jong ka hima jong nga la ai pat ha nga . Ki rangbah synshar jong nga bad ki rangbah donburom jong nga ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , bad la ai pat ha nga ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem , bad wat ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law , Remain a widow at thy father s house , till Shelah my son be grown : for he said , Lest peradventure he die also , as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father s house .
translation.kha: Nangta u Judah u ong ha ka Tamar ka pyrsa kurim jong u ,  Khie leit phai noh sha ka ïing u kpa jong pha bad to ïaisah riewkynthei tad haduh ba u Shelah u khun jong nga un da rangbah .  U ong kumta naba u sheptieng ïoh ba u Shelah un shah pynïap kum ki hynmen jong u . Kumta ka Tamar ka la leit phai noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name  ; for it is holy .
translation.kha: Baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba khraw bad kaba kynja syiem jong u . Uba Khuid long ma u !

translation.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .
translation.kha: Mynta nga la tei ïa ka Templ kaba khraw na ka bynta jong me , ka jaka na ka bynta jong me ba men shong junom la junom .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joab observed the city , that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .
translation.kha: Kumta katba u Joab u dang kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , u la phah ïa u Uriah sha ka jaka ha kaba u tip ba u nongshun u khlaiñ bha .

translation.en: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt , as I have punished Jerusalem , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa kito kiba shong ha Ijipt , kumba nga pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem — da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Are ye also yet without understanding ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Phim long shuh kiba kham nep jingmut ban ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: My son , forget not my law  ; but let thine heart keep my commandments :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi , kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: Who hath ascended up into heaven , or descended ? who hath gathered the wind in his fists ? who hath bound the waters in a garment ? who hath established all the ends of the earth ? what is his name , and what is his son s name , if thou canst tell ?
translation.kha: Uei uba la ju long kynrad ïa ka jingtip ba kynja bneng ? Uei uba la ju kham ïa ka lyer ha la ka kti ? Lane uba la tehsong ïa ka um ha ka jaiñ lyngkhot ? Lane uba la pynskhem ïa ki pud jong ka pyrthei ? U dei uei lada phi tip ? Uei u khun jong u ?

translation.en: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers , and read it : and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the  Lord  , and spread it before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u shim ïa ka shithi na ki nongrah-khubor bad pule ïa ka .

translation.en: And when ye see the south wind blow , ye say , There will be heat  ; and it cometh to pass .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi sngew ba ka lyer bashathie ka beh , phi ong ba kan shit — bad ka long kumta .

translation.en: So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the  Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days  journey .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jonah u la kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad u la leit sha Ninebeh , ka nongbah kaba heh haduh katta katta ba ka la shim por lai sngi ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when midday was past , and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that there was neither voice , nor any to answer , nor any that regarded .
translation.kha: Ki la ïai duwai lynñiar bad kumba lamwir haduh palat shiteng sngi ; hynrei ym shym don jingjubab , ne ïohsngew ïa kano kano ka sur .

translation.en: Greet one another with an holy kiss .
translation.kha: To phin ïakhublei paralok da ka jingïadoh parabangeit .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink  ; and instead of a girdle a rent  ; and instead of well set hair baldness  ; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth  ; and burning instead of beauty .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ba kin sleh jingiwbih kin sma iwkhong ; ha ka jaka ki panpoh ba-itynnat kin teh da ki tyllai barew ; ha ka jaka ban don u shñiuh ba-itynnat kin long kiba lyndum ; ha ka jaka ki jaiñ ba-itynnat kin phong ki jaiñjot ; ka jingbhabriew jong ki kan kylla sha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came out two women , and the wind was in their wings  ; for they had wings like the wings of a stork : and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih shajrong bad ïohi ïa ki ar ngut ki kynthei kiba her sha nga lem bad ki thapniang bakhlaiñbor kum kito ki jong ka thring . Ki la shim ïa ka shang bad ki her noh lem bad ka .

translation.en: And Moses took the blood , and sprinkled it on the people , and said , Behold the blood of the covenant , which the  Lord  hath made with you concerning all these words .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shim ïa kata ka snam na ki dabor bad u synreit ïa ka ha uta u paidbah . U ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad phi , mynba u ai ïa kine ki hukum baroh .

translation.en: Therefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more , but the word which I have spoken shall be done , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong : Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ïa kaei kaba nga la ong yn pyndep . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren !

translation.en: And they went forth , and preached every where , the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit bad ïalap kylleng , bad U Trai u la trei lem bad pynshisha ba ka jingïalap jong ki ka la long kaba shisha da ki kambah kiba ki la leh .]

translation.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite , though he hath gained , when God taketh away his soul ?
translation.kha: Don jingkyrmen aïu na ka bynta ki briew kiba khlem blei ha ka kynta ba U Blei un dawa ïa ka jingim jong ki ?

translation.en: And they beat down the cities , and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone , and filled it  ; and they stopped all the wells of water , and felled all the good trees : only in Kir–hareseth left they the stones thereof  ; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it .
translation.kha: bad pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki . Katba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka lyngkha baseisoh , uwei pa uwei u Israel u ju kawang maw ha ka haduh ba la tap lin ïa baroh ki lyngkha ; ki la pynsangeh ruh ïa ki umpohliew bad ki la pom ïa ki diengsoh . Ha kaba khatduh tang ka nongbah Kir Heres ka dang sah , bad ki nongkawang maw ki kerkut ïa ka bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: And Adam knew his wife again  ; and she bare a son , and called his name Seth : For God , said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel , whom Cain slew .
translation.kha: U Adam bad ka tnga jong u ki ka ïoh sa uwei pat u khun . Ka la ong ,  U Blei u la ai khun shynrang ïa nga ha ka jaka u Abel , ïa uba u Kain u la pynïap .  Kumta ka la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .

translation.en: And when she had opened it , she saw the child : and , behold , the babe wept . And she had compassion on him , and said , This is one of the Hebrews  children .
translation.kha: Haba ka plied ïa ka , ka ïohi ïa u khunlung . Uta u khunlung u ïam , bad ka sngewsynei ïa u .  Une te u dei uwei na ki khun Hebru ,  ka la ong .

translation.en: Strangers shall fade away , and they shall be afraid out of their close places .
translation.kha: Ki la duh ka jingshlur jong ki bad ki wan da kaba kyiuh na la ki jong ki kut .

translation.en: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak , Told not I thee , saying , All that the  Lord  speaketh , that I must do ?
translation.kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ha phi ba nga dei ban leh baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ?

translation.en: If thy children have sinned against him , and he have cast them away for their transgression  ;
translation.kha: Ki khun jong me ïoh ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei , bad kumta u pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei ïa ki .

translation.en: And Jehoash said to the priests , All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the  Lord  , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at , and all the money that cometh into any man s heart to bring into the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U Joash u phah khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad u hukum ïa ki ban kynshew ïa ki pisa ba siew ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingkñia ha ka Templ , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingsiew ba dei na ka bynta ki jingkñia ba ju leh bad ka pisa ba ai kum ki jingai sngewbha .

translation.en: Thou hypocrite , first cast out the beam out of thine own eye  ; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother s eye .
translation.kha: Phi u riewarsap ! Nyngkong eh weng noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na la ka khmat jong phi hi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai kdar ban khlaw ïa u thiat na ka khmat u para jong phi .

translation.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood , ( for under it the people received the law , ) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec , and not be called after the order of Aaron ?
translation.kha: Dei ha ka nongrim jong ka jinglong lyngdoh ki Lebi ba la ai ïa ka Hukum ha ki paid Israel . Mynta , lada ka kam lyngdoh jong ki Lebi ka la long kaba janai , yn ym donkam shuh ïa uwei pat u lyngdoh ban mih , uwei uba na ka jinglong lyngdoh u Melkhisedek , ym jong u Aaron .

translation.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .
translation.kha: bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa hapoh jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnaw hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita ki tnaw jong ka ar tylli .

translation.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father , and his heavy yoke which he put upon us , lighter , and we will serve thee .
translation.kha: U Solomon u kpa jong phi u la banbeiñ ïa ngi bad u buh ki jingkit kiba khia ha ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine ki jingkit bad pynsuk jingim ïa ngi , ngin long ki shakri bashaniah jong phi .

translation.en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them , and they that are great exercise authority upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh bad u la ong ,  Phi tip ba ki nongsynshar jong ki bymngeit blei ki donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ka iktiar ba-pura .

translation.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .
translation.kha: Shisien ne ar sien ki nongkhaïi kiba die bun jait ki tiar ki pynlut ïa ka miet shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton shabar ki kynroh ka nongbah .

translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( then saith he to the sick of the palsy , )  Arise , take up thy bed , and go unto thine house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka iktiar ha ka khyndew ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad leit sha ïing !

translation.en: But now I have written unto you not to keep company , if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator , or covetous , or an idolater , or a railer , or a drunkard , or an extortioner ; with such an one no not to eat .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba phin ym ïakhleh bad u briew uba khot ïa lade u parabangeit hynrei uba awria ne uba lalot ne uba mane bleithaw ne uba kren sniew ne uba buaid ne u nongtuh . To wat ïashong bam lem bad kum uta u briew .

translation.en: Dan , and Naphtali , Gad , and Asher .
translation.kha: U Dan , U Naphtali , U Gad , bad U Asher .

translation.en: Hear ye now what the  Lord  saith  ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingmudui U  Trai  pyrshah ïa ki Israel . To khie , A  Trai  , bad wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong me ; to ai ba ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me ong .

translation.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec .
translation.kha: bad U Blei u la pynbna ba u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh ha ka rukom long lyngdoh jong u Melkhisedek .

translation.en: All the heave offerings of the holy things , which the children of Israel offer unto the  Lord  , have I given thee , and thy sons and thy daughters with thee , by a statute for ever : it is a covenant of salt for ever before the  Lord  unto thee and to thy seed with thee .
translation.kha: Nga ai ha me , ha ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me , ha ki por ki ban wan baroh ïa ki jingai bakyrpang baroh ba ki Israel ki ai ha nga . Kane ka long ka jutang bym lah pynkheiñ kaba nga la pynlong bad me lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me .

translation.en: And they answered Joshua , and said , Because it was certainly told thy servants , how that the  Lord  thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land , and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you , therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you , and have done this thing .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  Bah , ngi la leh ïa ka namar ngi la tip shisha ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa u Moses u shakri jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri baroh kawei , bad ban pynïap ïa ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ka katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Ngi la leh ïa ka namar ba ngi la sngewsheptieng ïa phi ; ngi don ha ka jingsyier ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: ( Psalm 26 :12 , footnote  ; 111 :1 ) These gatherings create an opportunity to meet and associate with Witnesses from other congregations or even from other lands .
translation.kha: ( Salm 26 :12 ; 111 :1 ) Kine ki jingïalang ki plie lad ban ïakynduh bad ban ïa kren-ïa khana bad ki Nongsakhi kiba na kiwei ki balang ne na kiwei pat ki jaka .

translation.en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain , and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second : the loops held one curtain to another .
translation.kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka sut kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh , ba la suh lang ha ka sut kaba ar . Kita ki kyrwoh ki ïaphai marpyrshah .

translation.en: No doubt but ye are the people , and wisdom shall die with you .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , me long ka sur jong u paidbah . Ynda men ïap , ka jingstad jong me kan ïap lang bad me .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , unto all that are carried away captives , whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ha kito ki briew baroh kiba u la shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia :

translation.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water  ; but a man of understanding will draw it out .
translation.kha: Ki jingpyrkhat jong u briew ki long kum ka um ha ka pukri kaba jylliew , hynrei uba don ka jingïohi jngai u lah ban tong noh ïa ki shabar .

translation.en: And afterward he read all the words of the law , the blessings and cursings , according to all that is written in the book of the law .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u pule jam ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingkyrkhu bad ïa ki jingtim , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab ka Hukum .

translation.en: And Obal , and Abimael , and Sheba ,
translation.kha: ka Obal , ka Abimael , ka Sheba ,

translation.en: Prove all things ; hold fast that which is good .
translation.kha: Da tynjuh ïa kiei kiei baroh : Bat ïa kaei kaba bha

translation.en: Then said Micah , Now know I that the  Lord  will do me good , seeing I have a Levite to my priest .
translation.kha: U Mikah u ong ,  Mynta ba nga la don u Lebi kum u lyngdoh jong nga , nga tip ba U  Trai  un sa pynmanbha ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said she , Sit still , my daughter , until thou know how the matter will fall : for the man will not be in rest , until he have finished the thing this day .
translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka ong ha ka ,  Ruth , ïaishah mynta , tad haduh ba phin da ïohi kumno kane baroh kan sa long . U Boas un ym shongthait mynta ka sngi tad haduh ba un da pyndep ïa kane ka kam .

translation.en: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel , Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah , Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jehoram u khun jong u Jehoshaphat , u la long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house , and carried the people away into Babylon .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynbitar ïa U Blei ka Bneng , u la shah ba yn jop noh ïa ki da u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia , u syiem na ka longïing syiem Khaldi . Ïa ka Templ la pynjot bad ïa ki briew la ringmraw sha Babilonia .

translation.en: And I that am the  Lord  thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles , as in the days of the solemn feast .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt , ngan pynlong ïa phi ban sah biang ha ki ïingjaiñ , kumba phi la leh mynba nga wan sha phi ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .
translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta ki briew ki bym lah ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade . Ïada ïa ki hok jong baroh ki bym don jingïarap .

translation.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the custom , as the duty of every day required  ;
translation.kha: Ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ; ha kawei pa kawei ka sngi ki ai ki jingkñia kiba donkam ha kata ka sngi ;

translation.en: Furthermore the  Lord  spake unto me , saying , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ruh ha nga , ‘ Nga tip ba kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop palat .

translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee , whither thou goest to possess them , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their land  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang leit ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ki , ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka bad shong hangta .

translation.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat , and cockle instead of barley . The words of Job are ended .
translation.kha: nangta ha ka jaka u kew bad u barli , to ai ba ki ñiut bad ki shiah kin mih . Ki ktien u Job ki kut hangne .

translation.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the  Lord  , and hast not kept the commandment which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee ,
translation.kha: bad u la kren jam ha u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ,  U  Trai  u ong ba phi la lyndet ïa ka ktien U  Trai  , bad phim shym la leh kumba u la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them .
translation.kha: Namar haba ar lane lai ngut ki ïawanlang ha ka kyrteng jong nga , nga don hangta lem bad ki .

translation.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ , that we might be justified by faith .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka Hukum ka synshar ïa ngi tad haduh ba U Khrist u la wan , khnang ba yn lah ban pynksan ïa ngi ha U Blei da ka jingngeit .

translation.en: I likewise , and my brethren , and my servants , might exact of them money and corn : I pray you , let us leave off this usury .
translation.kha: Nga la shah ïa ki briew ban shim pisa kylliang bad u kew na nga , bad kumjuh ruh ki paralok jong nga bad ki briew kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga . To mynta ngin ym ïa-dawa shuh ïa ka jingpynphai biang ïa ka pisa .

translation.en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany , where Lazarus was which had been dead , whom he raised from the dead .
translation.kha: Hynriew sngi shuwa ka Niam Ka Jinglait , U Jisu u la leit sha Bethania , ka shnong u Lasaros , u briew ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me : and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit kham bun shah ïa la u kpa lane ka kmie ban ïa nga um long uba bit ban long u synran jong nga ; uno uno uba ieit kham bun shah ïa la u khun lane ka khun ban ïa nga , um long uba bit ban long u synran jong nga .

translation.en: A Bible was needed that was easy to understand .
translation.kha: La donkam ïa ka Baibl kaba suk ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Then I saw , and considered it well : I looked upon it , and received instruction .
translation.kha: Nga peit ïa kane , nga la pyrkhat shaphang jong ka , bad nga ïoh ka jinghikai na ka :

translation.en: But where shall wisdom be found ? and where is the place of understanding ?
translation.kha: Hynrei hangno lah ban shem ïa ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban shemphang ?

translation.en: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life : but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction .
translation.kha: Husiar ïa kaei kaba phi ong bad ri ïa la ka jingim . Uba kren thurmur u pynjot ïa lade .

translation.en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side , in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces , and foreigners entered into his gates , and cast lots upon Jerusalem , even thou wast as one of them .
translation.kha: Pha ïeng sharud ha kata ka sngi haba ki nongshun ki pynpra ïa ki khyrdop jong ki . Pha la long kaba sniew kum kito ki nongwei kiba rah noh ïa ka spah jong ka Jerusalem bad pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng jong ki hi .

translation.en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city , and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city , they shall take him into the city unto them , and give him a place , that he may dwell among them .
translation.kha: U lah ban phet ïap sha kawei na kine ki nongbah , un leit sha ka jaka bishar ha ka khyrdop sha ka nongbah , bad batai ha ki nongïalam ïa kaba la jia . Nangta kin shah ba un rung shapoh ka nongbah bad kin ai jaka sah ïa u , ba kumta u lah ban shong ban sah hangta .

translation.en: One board had two tenons , equally distant one from another : thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: bad ar tylli ki tnaw kiba kumjuh ba yn lah ban pyndait lang ïa ki . Baroh kita ki jingker ki don kine ki tnaw .

translation.en: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife , and hath not taken her ? let him go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man take her .
translation.kha: Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep ïatehktien ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un shongkurim ïa ka .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth  ; both man , and beast , and the creeping thing , and the fowls of the air  ; for it repenteth me that I have made them .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa u da ka jingbabe , kat haduh ba u la ong ,  Ngan pynduh khoit ïa kine ki briew kiba nga la thaw , bad ruh ïa ki mrad bad ki sim , naba nga la sngewsih ba nga la thaw ïa ki .

translation.en: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him , and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe : for they had made that the prison .
translation.kha: Ki la bitar haduh katta katta ïa nga bad hukum ban shoh ïa nga bad ban set ïa nga ha ka ïing u Jonathan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , kaba ïa ka ïing jong u la pynlong ka byndi .

translation.en: And it shall be , when thou hast made an end of reading this book , that thou shalt bind a stone to it , and cast it into the midst of Euphrates :
translation.kha: Ko Seraïah , ynda me dep ban pule ïa kane ka kot ha ki briew , nangta sa teh ïa ka ha u maw bad bret ïa ka ha ka wah Ïuphratis bad ong ,

translation.en: Your iniquities have turned away these things , and your sins have withholden good things from you .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki pop jong phi ki la bat noh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba bha na phi .

translation.en: Do you want to come sit by me ?
translation.kha: Phi kwah ban wan shong bad nga ?

translation.en: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the  Lord  sent me from Kadesh–barnea to espy out the land  ; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart .
translation.kha: Nga la don sawphew snem ka rta mynba u Moses u shakri U  Trai  u la phah ïa nga na Kadesh Barnea ban syntiat ïa kane ka ri . Nga la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor bashisha .

translation.en: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner , whom they would .
translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u lyngskor ka hima Rom u la ju don ka rukom ban pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi ïa uba u paidbah u pan .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Uno uno uba dih na kane ka um un sliang pat , hynrei uno uno uba dih na ka um kaba ngan ai ha u un ym sliang shuh .

translation.en: For finding fault with them , he saith , Behold , the days come , saith the Lord , when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u shem jingduna bad ki briew jong u haba u ong ,  Ki sngi ki wan , ong U Trai , haba ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai bad ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah ruh .

translation.en: And ye shall do no work in that same day : for it is a day of atonement , to make an atonement for you before the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi , naba kata ka long ka sngi ha kaba yn pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban weng noh ïa ka pop .

translation.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pynïap briew un shah pynïap ,

translation.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath met with us : and now let us go , we beseech thee , three days  journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me ong ha ki . Nangta me dei ban leit bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel sha u Pharaoh bad ong ha u , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Mynta shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi .’
