translation.en: Now the  Lord  had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah . And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum U  Trai ,  u dohkha uba heh u la nguid ïa u Jonah , bad u la don hapoh u dohkha lai sngi lai miet .

translation.en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
translation.kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ha phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma ki .

translation.en: The Jews therefore , because it was the preparation , that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day , ( for that sabbath day was an high day , ) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken , and that they might be taken away .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la pan na u Pilat ban shah ïa ki ban pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong kita ki briew kiba la shah sahnarphna , bad ban pynhiar noh ïa ki met jong ki na ki diengphna . Ki la kyrpad ïa kane namar ba ka la dei ka Sngi Thohdieng , bad kim kwah ba ki met kin sah kumta ha ki diengphna ha ka sngi Sabbaton , naba ka sngi Sabbaton ka long kyrpang kaba khuid .

translation.en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired , namely , by them beyond the river , by the king of Assyria , the head , and the hair of the feet : and it shall also consume the beard .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , U  Trai  un wai uwei u nongkhap shñiuh na sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis — u patsha jong ka Assyria ! — bad un khi ïa ki tmain jong phi bad ïa ki shñiuh halor ki khlieh bad ki met jong phi .

translation.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle : and when they saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead , that , behold , the place was a place for cattle  ;
translation.kha: Ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ki la don shibun ki jingri . Haba ki la ïohi ba ka ri Jaser bad ka ri Gilead ka long kaba bit eh na ka bynta ki jingri ,

translation.en: Give them sorrow of heart , thy curse unto them .
translation.kha: to tim ïa ki bad pyndap ïa ki da ka jingduh jingkyrmen !

translation.en: O house of Aaron , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
translation.kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi ki lyngdoh jong U Blei . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .

translation.en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king s household , and to do what he thought good . And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king , as he was come over Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Ki la jam sha shiliang jong ka wah ban synran ïa ka kynhun ba kynja syiem bad ban leh ïa kano kano kaba u syiem u kwah . Katba u syiem u khreh ban jam sha shiliang , u Shimei u rynsied ïa lade ha khmat jong u ,

translation.en: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall , when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit : and all the trees of Eden , the choice and best of Lebanon , all that drink water , shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth .
translation.kha: Haba nga phah ïa u shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyllon jong u , kan pynkhynñiuh ïa ki jaitbynriew . Baroh ki dieng ha Eden bad ki dieng baroh kiba kynsai , kiba la ïoh um bha jong ka Lebanon kiba la leit sha ka pyrthei shapoh kin sa sngewkmen ha ka jingkyllon jong u .

translation.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world : but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself .
translation.kha: Lymda kumta ka la dei ïa u ban shah bunsien naduh myn dang long ka pyrthei . Pynban , mynta haba ka por baroh ka la jan poi sha kaba kut , u la paw tang shisien hi , ban pyndam noh ïa ka pop da kaba kñia ïa lade .

translation.en: Whose possessors slay them , and hold themselves not guilty : and they that sell them say , Blessed be the  Lord   ; for I am rich : and their own shepherds pity them not .
translation.kha: Ki trai jong ki , ki pynïap ïa ki bad ki lait na ka jingshah pynshitom . Ki die ïa ka doh bad ki ong , ‘ To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ngi la riewspah !’ Wat ki nongaplangbrot jong ki hi kim don jingisynei ïa ki .

translation.en: Having therefore , brethren , boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus ,
translation.kha: Ngi don , namar kata , ko parabangeit jong nga ïa ka jinglaitluid ba-pura ban rung shapoh ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam da kata ka jingïap U Jisu .

translation.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt find him , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul .
translation.kha: Bad hangta phin wad ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad lada phi wad ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , phin shem ïa u .

translation.en: He feedeth on ashes : a deceived heart hath turned him aside , that he cannot deliver his soul , nor say , Is there not a lie in my right hand ?
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingsngewthuh kumba bam dpei . Ki jingmut ba-bieit jong u ki la ïalam bakla ïa u ha kaba u don sha lyndet ka jingïarap . Un ym pdiang ha lade ba ka bleithaw ba u bat ha ka kti jong u kam long satia ka blei .

translation.en: For what man knoweth the things of a man , save the spirit of man which is in him ? even so the things of God knoweth no man , but the Spirit of God .
translation.kha: Ka dei tang ka mynsiem kaba hapoh u briew hi , kaba tip ïa baroh shaphang jong u ; ha kajuh ka rukom , tang U Mynsiem U Blei , uba tip ïa baroh shaphang U Blei .

translation.en: And hath put all things under his feet , and gave him to be the head over all things to the church ,
translation.kha: U Blei u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat U Khrist bad u la ai ïa u ha ka Balang kum U Trai uba ha khlieh duh halor kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Therefore I said , Surely these are poor  ; they are foolish : for they know not the way of the  Lord  , nor the judgment of their God .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la pyrkhat ,  Kine ki long tang kiba duk bad ki bym sngewthuh . Ki la leh bieit ; kim tip ïa kaei kaba U Blei jong ki u dawa , ïa kaei U  Trai  u kwah ïa ki ban leh .

translation.en: I also could speak as ye do : if your soul were in my soul s stead , I could heap up words against you , and shake mine head at you .
translation.kha: Lada phi don ha ka jaka jong nga bad ma nga ha ka jaka jong phi , ngan lah ban ong ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi ong . Nga lah ban pynkhih ïa ka khlieh jong nga ha ka jingsian bad ngan pynïap jyllop ïa phi ha ka jingshlei jong ki ktien .

translation.en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: Then said Haggai , If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these , shall it be unclean ? And the priests answered and said , It shall be unclean .
translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u kylli ,  Tharai ïa uno uno la pyntngit namar ba u la ktah ïa ka metïap . Te lada u ktah ïa kano kano na kine ki jingbam , hato kata kan pynlong ïa ki ruh ba la pyntngit ?  Ki lyngdoh ki jubab ,  Ho-oid .

translation.en: And when the Philistine looked about , and saw David , he disdained him : for he was but a youth , and ruddy , and of a fair countenance .
translation.kha: U ïai wan kham sha jan , bad haba u la ïohi shai ïa u Dabid , u la dap da ka jingbitar shla ïa u namar ba u long tang u khynnah uba saw ngab , uba phyrnai khmat .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister , to vex her , to uncover her nakedness , beside the other in her life time .
translation.kha: Wat shim ïa la ka para ne hynmen kynsi kum kawei na ki tnga jong me katba ka tnga jong me , ka dang im .

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Who touched me ?  When all denied , Peter and they that were with him said , Master , the multitude throng thee and press thee , and sayest thou ,  Who touched me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli ,  Mano ba ktah ïa nga ?  Uwei pa uwei u len ïa ka , bad u Petros u ong ,  Ko kynrad , ki briew ki don sawdong jong me bad ki ïalum ha me .

translation.en: And Paul went down , and fell on him , and embracing him said , Trouble not yourselves  ; for his life is in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la leit hiar , bad u la dem pyllup halor jong u bad u la kdup ïa u .  Wat khuslai ,  u la ong ,  u dang im !

translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will circumcise thine heart , and the heart of thy seed , to love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , that thou mayest live .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi kiba kohnguh hukum , khnang ba phin ieit ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad ba phin ïaishong ha kata ka ri .

translation.en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Blei u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor u Jabin , u syiem Kanaan .

translation.en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u peit halor ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw , bad ki rangbah synshar ki Persia ki rai ban ym leh ei ei haduh ba kin da lah thoh sha u Darius bad ïoh ïa ka jubab .

translation.en: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old  ; and his eyes were dim , that he could not see .
translation.kha: ( Ha kata ka por u Eli u la dap khyndaiphew phra snem bad u la jan matlah ) .

translation.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely , he was afraid of him .
translation.kha: U Saul u ïohi ïa ka jingjop u Dabid bad u nang sheptieng shuh shuh ïa u .

translation.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island , and the satyr shall cry to his fellow  ; the screech owl also shall rest there , and find for herself a place of rest .
translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw kin ïaid kai hangta , bad ki ksuid kin ïakhot para ma ki . U mrad kynsha ba shang mynmiet un wan hangta bad un wad jaka shongthait .

translation.en: This is the interpretation , O king , and this is the decree of the most High , which is come upon my lord the king :
translation.kha: Kane , te , ka long kaei ba ka mut , ko Syiem Kynrad , bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynbna ba kan jia ha phi .

translation.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them , as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim : and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands .
translation.kha: Kin pyiar ïa la ki kti kumba ki pyrshang ban jngi , hynrei U Blei un pynjahburom ïa ki , bad ki kti jong ki kin ngam khlem ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: Because she takes after her younger sister , I cannot tell one from the other .
translation.kha: Namar ka bit iaka ka para jong ka , ngam nang pyniapher ia ki .

translation.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty ? will he always call upon God ?
translation.kha: Kin jin da la dei ban kwah ïa ka jingkmen ba u ai ; kin jin da la dei ban duwai borabor ïa u .

translation.en: And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron , and said to the king , Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy , which sought thy life  ; and the  Lord  hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed .
translation.kha: Ki ai ïa kata ka khlieh ha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron , bad ki ong ha u ,  Kane hangne ka dei ka khlieh u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul , u nongshun jong phi , uba la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Ha kane ka sngi U  Trai  u la shah ïa u Syiem Kynrad ban pynhiarkput ïa u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: Hell is naked before him , and destruction hath no covering .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap ka plie rynghang ha U Blei ; ym don ka jingtap kaba kah ïa ka na ka jingïohi jong u .

translation.en: And seeing the multitudes , he went up into a mountain : and when he was set , his disciples came unto him :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah bad u la kiew sha u lum , ha uba u la shong . Ki synran jong u ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u ,

translation.en: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes , and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man , in their sight .
translation.kha: Men pynmeh ding da ka jakhlia briew kaba tyrkhong , shet ïa u kpu ha ka ding , bad bam ïa u ha kaba baroh ki lah ban ïohi ïa me .

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  See thou tell no man  ; but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer the gift that Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To shahshkor ! Wat ïathuh hano hano , hynrei khie leit beit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai un khmih bniah ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la khiah , ai ïa ka jingkñia kaba u Moses u la hukum .

translation.en: Though thy beginning was small , yet thy latter end should greatly increase .
translation.kha: Baroh ka spah kaba me la duh , kam long ei ei ban ïapyrshang bad kaei kaba U Blei un sa ai pat ha me .

translation.en: Whoso sheddeth man s blood , by man shall his blood be shed : for in the image of God made he man .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew la thaw ha ka dur jong U Blei hi , kumta uno uno uba pynïap ïa uwei na ki , u ruh un shah pynïap ha uwei pat .

translation.en: Behold , they say unto me , Where is the word of the  Lord  ? let it come now .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ong ha nga ,  Hangno kito ki jingbyrngem kiba U  Trai  u la pynlong pyrshah ïa ngi ? To ai ba un pyndep ïa ki mynta !

translation.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness , and all the store cities , which he built in Hamath .
translation.kha: U la tei biang ïa ki nongbah baroh ha Hamath kiba long ki jaka buh jingbam .

translation.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part , that we are your rejoicing , even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngi thoh sha phi tang ïa kaba phi lah ban pule bad sngewthuh . Hynrei wat lada phi sngewthuh ïa ngi mynta tang katto katne , nga kyrmen ba phin poi sha kata ka jingsngewthuh kaba pura , khnang ba ha ka Sngi jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi phin ïoh sngewsarong ïa ngi kumba ngi sngewsarong ïa phi .

translation.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money , or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life :
translation.kha: lada nga la bam ei ïa ka jingbam kaba la mih hangta hynrei nga pynshahthngan ïa ki nongrep kiba la rep ïa ka —

translation.en: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood : for the blood is the life  ; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh .
translation.kha: Tangba wat bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka , namar ka jingim ka don ha ka snam , bad phim dei ban bam ïa kata ka jingim lem bad ka doh .

translation.en: The Jews answered him , We have a law , and by our law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God .
translation.kha: U paidbah u la phai ktien ,  Ngi don ka hukum kaba ong ba u dei ban ïap , namar u la kam ba u long U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife . Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Katba ki thylliej ding ki dang kiew shajrong na ka duwan , u Manoah bad ka tnga jong u ki ïohi ïa u angel U  Trai  ba u kiew sha bneng ha ki thylliej ding . U Manoah hangta u sngewthuh ba uta u briew u dei u angel jong U  Trai  , bad ma u lem bad ka tnga jong u ki dem khrup ha khyndew . Kim shym ïohi shuh ïa u angel .

translation.en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption , and this mortal shall have put on immortality , then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written , Death is swallowed up in victory .
translation.kha: Kumta haba kane ka jia , bad ïa kaba dei ban ïap la pynkylla sha ka bym dei ban ïap , te ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha :  Ïa ka jingïap la pynjot thiaw ; ka jingjop ka la long kaba pura!

translation.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons , and a desolation for ever : there shall no man abide there , nor any son of man dwell in it .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Hasor yn pynkylla ri shyiap junom , ka jaka ha kaba tang ki myrsiang kin im . Yn ym don mano mano shuh ban shong ban sah biang hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make , and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart thereof , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .
translation.kha: Thaw shuh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ka bynta kaba sha trai jong ka bynta kaba ha khmat jong ki ar tylli ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng hajan ka jaka ba la suh pyndait bad haneng jong u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .

translation.en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst : the young children ask bread , and no man breaketh it unto them .
translation.kha: Ki shah ïa ki khunlung jong ki ban ïap ha ka jingthngan bad jingsliang ; ki khynnah ki khrong jingbam kaba ym don mano mano ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: And they shall be gathered together , as prisoners are gathered in the pit , and shall be shut up in the prison , and after many days shall they be visited .
translation.kha: U Blei un buh khapngiah ïa ki syiem kum ki koidi ha ka thliew . Un set ïa ki ha ka ïingbyndi haduh ka por jong ka jingpynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: If the scourge slay suddenly , he will laugh at the trial of the innocent .
translation.kha: Haba uba lui lui u ïap kynsan , U Blei u rkhie .

translation.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week , they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun .
translation.kha: Dang step eh ha ka Sngi U Trai , hamar ba dang shu mih ka sngi , ki la leit sha ka jingtep .

translation.en: Who shall offer it before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for her  ; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood . This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un kñia ïa ka jingainguh jong ka ha U  Trai  bad un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka ; bad kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid . Kane ka long kaba ka kynthei ka dei ban leh hadien ba kha khun .

translation.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities , in reproaches , in necessities , in persecutions , in distresses for Christ s sake : for when I am weak , then am I strong .
translation.kha: Nga sngewhun ha ki jingtlot , ki jingkrenbeiñ , ki jingjynjar , ki jingshah pynshitom , bad ki jingeh na ka bynta U Khrist . Naba haba nga tlot , dei hangta ba nga khlaiñ .

translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his father s wife  ; because he uncovereth his father s skirt . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka tnga u kpa jong u .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: He was a mighty hunter before the  Lord  : wherefore it is said , Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Da ka jingïarap U  Trai  u la long u nongbeh mrad uba khraw ; ba kumta sa mih ka jingong ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un pynlong ïa me u nongbeh mrad uba khraw kat u Nimrod .

translation.en: Judah , and the land of Israel , they were thy merchants : they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith , and Pannag , and honey , and oil , and balm .
translation.kha: Ka Judah bad ka Israel ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha da u kew , ka ngap , ka umphniang Olib , bad ki musli musla .

translation.en: And I will clothe him with thy robe , and strengthen him with thy girdle , and I will commit thy government into his hand : and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and to the house of Judah .
translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa ka jaiñkup bad u panpoh nongpynïaidkam jong me halor jong u bad ngan ai ha u ka iktiar baroh kaba me la don . U , un long kum u kpa ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad ka Judah .

translation.en: Whosoever putteth away his wife , and marrieth another , committeth adultery : and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew u klim ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba la shah pyllait tnga u klim .

translation.en: And he set a carved image , the idol which he had made , in the house of God , of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka durblei ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u la ong ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon u khun jong u :  Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka long ka jaka ïa kaba nga la jied na baroh kawei ka ri jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .

translation.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors , and brought them forth , and said ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet u angel jong U Trai u la plie ïa ki khyrdop ka byndi , u la ïalam shabar ïa ki apostol , bad u la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kiaw kurim .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: And many of the people believed on him , and said , When Christ cometh , will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done ?
translation.kha: Hynrei bun na uta u paidbah u la ngeit ha u bad u la ong ,  Haba U Messaïah un wan , hato un leh kham bun ki kambah ban ïa kaba une u briew u la leh ?

translation.en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child  ; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him .
translation.kha: Ki khynnah na la ka tynrai ki leh kiei kiei kiba ibieit , khlem sumar , hynrei ka jingsneng sympat kaba bha ka hikai ïa ki kumno ban long .

translation.en: He rebuketh the sea , and maketh it dry , and drieth up all the rivers : Bashan languisheth , and Carmel , and the flower of Lebanon languisheth .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ka duriaw , bad ka rngad ! U pynlong ïa ki wah ban tyrkhong . Ki pyntha jong ka Bashan ki swai , u lumbah Karmel u kylla bthuh , bad ki syntiew jong u Lebanon ki jlop .

translation.en: And the glorious beauty , which is on the head of the fat valley , shall be a fading flower , and as the hasty fruit before the summer  ; which when he that looketh upon it seeth , while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong kito ki nongïalam basarong ka nang jah noh kum ki soh Dumbur ba mih nyngkong jong ka aïom , ba la shim bad bam ïa ki tang shu ih .

translation.en: And Harbona , one of the chamberlains , said before the king , Behold also , the gallows fifty cubits high , which Haman had made for Mordecai , who had spoken good for the king , standeth in the house of Haman . Then the king said , Hang him thereon .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki uba kyrteng u Harbonah , u ong ,  U Haman u la dep ïaid shaphrang ha kaba u la shna ïa ka diengphasi ha ka ïing jong u khnang ba un phasi ïa u Mordekai , uba pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi , ko syiem . Bad ka long kaba jrong arphew ar mitar !   Sdien phasi ïa u Haman ha ka !  u syiem u hukum .

translation.en: And the soldiers also mocked him , coming to him , and offering him vinegar ,
translation.kha: Ki shipai ruh ki la krenbeiñ ïa u : Ki la wan sha u bad ki la tyrwa ha u ïa ka waiñ bym bha , bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: One of themselves , even a prophet of their own , said , The Cretans are alway liars , evil beasts , slow bellies .
translation.kha: Dei u nong Krit hi , uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki , uba la kren ïa ka jingshisha mynba u la ong ,  Ki nong Krit ki long borabor kiba lamler , ki riewkhlaw bymman , bad ki jlawnguid bajaipdeh .

translation.en: He hath bent his bow , and set me as a mark for the arrow .
translation.kha: U la sei ïa ka ryntieh jong u bad u pynlong ïa nga ka sohpdung ïa ki khnam jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good , and judgments whereby they should not live  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ ki bym long kiba bha , bad ïa ki hukum ki bym lah ban wanrah jingim .

translation.en: Ye are the children of the prophets , and of the covenant which God made with our fathers , saying unto Abraham , And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .
translation.kha: Ki jingkular jong U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki long na ka bynta jong phi , bad phi ïoh bynta ha ka jutang kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kumba u la ong ha u Abraham , ‘ Lyngba ki khun ki ksiew jong me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .’

translation.en: The time is come , the day draweth near : let not the buyer rejoice , nor the seller mourn : for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi . Ka sngi ka la jan , ha kaba ka jingïadie ïathied kan ym don jingmut shuh , namar ka jingpynshitom U Blei kan hap ha baroh kumjuh .

translation.en: All these cities were fenced with high walls , gates , and bars  ; beside unwalled towns a great many .
translation.kha: Kine ki shnong baroh ki long kiba la kerkut skhem da ki kynroh kiba jrong , ki khyrdop , bad ki nar-khang khyrdop , bad don ruh bun ki shnong ki bym don kynroh .

translation.en: Then took Jeremiah another roll , and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah  ; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire : and there were added besides unto them many like words .
translation.kha: Te nga la shim ïa kawei pat ka kot kli bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u sekretari jong nga u Barukh , bad u la thoh hangta ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ong . U la thoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha ka kot kli kaba nyngkong bad kijuh ki khubor kiba nga la ong ha u ban thoh .

translation.en: For it increaseth . Thou huntest me as a fierce lion : and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me .
translation.kha: Lada nga ïoh ïa kano kano ka jingjop , me beh kthong ïa nga kum u sing ; ban pynmynsaw ïa nga me leh wat da ki kambah .

translation.en: You haven't even tried .
translation.kha: Phim pat pyrshang hi .

translation.en: And I will make Jerusalem heaps , and a den of dragons  ; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ka thup ki jingpra , ka jaka ha kaba ki myrsiang ki shong ; ki nongbah ka Judah kin kylla ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong ba sah .

translation.en: The cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki Lyngdoh ki dei ban phong haba ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh , bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ u Joshua u jop thiaw ïa ki Amalek .

translation.en: And next him were Eden , and Miniamin , and Jeshua , and Shemaiah , Amariah , and Shecaniah , in the cities of the priests , in their set office , to give to their brethren by courses , as well to the great as to the small :
translation.kha: Ha kiwei pat ki nongbah ha kiba ki lyngdoh ki shong , la kyrshan jingïarap ha kane da kiwei ki Lebi : u Eden , Miniamin , Jeshua , Shemaïah , Amaraïah , bad u Shekanaïah . Ki sam ryntih ïa ka jingbam sha ki para Lebi kat kum ki kamram jong ki , bad ym kat kum ki kur .

translation.en: For better it is that it be said unto thee , Come up hither  ; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shah khot sha ka jaka kaba kham shajrong ban ïa kaba shah ong ban ai noh ïa ka jaka jong phi ha uwei uba kham pawkhmat .

translation.en: The legs of the lame are not equal : so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka proberb tang kumba u briew uba dkoh u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean , and shall not shut him up : for he is unclean .
translation.kha: kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba la shong slem . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ym da donkam ban pynkyrpang ïa u , naba u la long lypa u bymkhuid .

translation.en: But when it is sown , it groweth up , and becometh greater than all herbs , and shooteth out great branches  ; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u san bad u long uba heh tam na ki jingthung baroh . U pynmih ki tnat kiba heh haduh ba ki sim ki wan bad thaw skum ha ka jingkah syrngiew jong u .

translation.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot , being of the number of the twelve .
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u la rung hapoh u Judas , ïa uba la khot u Iskariot , uba long uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .

translation.en: And when ye came unto this place , Sihon the king of Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , came out against us unto battle , and we smote them :
translation.kha: Bad ynda ngi la poi ha kane ka jaka , U Sihon u syiem Heshbon bad u Og u Syiem Bashan ki la wan ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , ( for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them  ; )
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Me la wallam ïa kine ki briew na Ijipt da ka bor jong me . Haba ki Ijipt ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa kine ki briew ,

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people  ; and they shall bring thee up in my net .
translation.kha: Ynda ki jaitbynriew ki ïalumlang , ngan pynngat ïa me ha ka jar jong nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ban tan ïa ka jar sha ryngkew .

translation.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent : and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands .
translation.kha: Un pyllait ïa phi lada phi long lui lui , lada kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand , and meted out heaven with the span , and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure , and weighed the mountains in scales , and the hills in a balance ?
translation.kha: Don uno uno uba lah ban thew ïa ka duriaw-bah da ki lynghoh kti lane ban thew ïa ka sahit bneng da ki kti jong u ? Don uno uno uba lah ban bat ïa ka khyndew jong ka pyrthei ha ka khuri lane thew ïa ki lumbah bad lumrit ha ki tarajur ?

translation.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin , or the leopard his spots ? then may ye also do good , that are accustomed to do evil .
translation.kha: U briew uba ïong u lah mo ban pynkylla ïa ka rong jong ka sniehdoh jong u , lane u  labasa u lah mo ban weng ïa ki jingthoh ïong jong u ? Lada ki lah , te ma pha ka bym leh ïa kano kano hynrei ka jingsniew pha lah ban tip ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: For all things are for your sakes , that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka long na ka bynta jong phi ; bad katba ka jingaiei U Blei ka dang kner noh sha kiba bun ki briew , kin ai sha ka burom U Blei kham bun ki jingduwai ainguh .

translation.en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ?
translation.kha: Hangno don na ki syiem jong ki nongbah ka Hamath , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena bad Ibbah ?

translation.en: And he said to them all ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross daily , and follow me .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga , u dei ban klet ïa lade , un bah ïa la ka diengphna man ka sngi , bad bud ïa nga .

translation.en: Then Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would give him time , and that he would shew the king the interpretation .
translation.kha: U Daniel shisyndon u la leit bad u la ïoh por da ka jingai jingbit jong u syiem , khnang ba u lah ban ïathuh ïa u syiem aïu ka jingphohsniew ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men , but to the will of God .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta , te , phi dei ban im ïa kaba sah jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei , ka jingim ba la synshar da ka mon U Blei bad ym da ki jingkwah jong ka doh .

translation.en: Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart  ; for God is with thee .
translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh kat kaba don ha ka jingmut jong phi , namar U Blei u long ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: And all king Solomon s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold  ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
translation.kha: Baroh ki khuri dih jingdih jong u Solomon ki long kiba la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon    ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ym shym pyndonkam da ka rupa , namar kam shym long kaba la ñiewkordor ha ki sngi u Solomon .

translation.en: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city , when the days of the siege are fulfilled : and thou shalt take a third part , and smite about it with a knife : and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind  ; and I will draw out a sword after them .
translation.kha: Ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong uta u shñiuh men thang hapoh ka nongbah , ynda la dep ka jingkerkut . Shim ïa ka bynta kaba ar bad shaiñ ïa ka da ka waitlam jong me haba me ïaid baroh sawdong ka nongbah . Ïa ka bynta kaba dang sah men pynher ha ka lyer , bad ngan sa pynbud da ka waitlam jong nga nadien jong ki .

translation.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the  Lord  , and said , O altar , altar , thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , a child shall be born unto the house of David , Josiah by name  ; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee , and men s bones shall be burnt upon thee .
translation.kha: Ha kaba bud ïa ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u nongïathuhlypa u kren pynrem ïa ka duwan :  Ko duwan , duwan ! Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ U khunlung ïa uba yn khot kyrteng u Josaïah , yn sa kha ha ka longïing jong u Dabid . Un sa pynïap ha pha ïa ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei thala , bad un thang ïa ki shyieng briew halor jong pha .’

translation.en: Even by the God of thy father , who shall help thee  ; and by the Almighty , who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above , blessings of the deep that lieth under , blessings of the breasts , and of the womb :
translation.kha: Dei U Blei jong u kpa jong me uba ïarap ïa me , U Blei Badonbor Baroh uba kyrkhu ïa me da ki jingkyrkhu u slap najrong , Bad da ki um kiba jylliew napoh khyndew , Ki jingkyrkhu da shibun ki jingri bad ki khun ki kti ,

translation.en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save : but thine eyes are upon the haughty , that thou mayest bring them down .
translation.kha: Me pyllait im ïa kito kiba sngewrit , hynrei me pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong .

translation.en: We will go three days  journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the  Lord  our God , as he shall command us .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , kumba u la hukum ïa ngi .

translation.en: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden , Come  ; for all things are now ready .
translation.kha: Haba ka la dei ka por ïa ka jingkhawai , u la phah ïa u shakri jong u ban ong ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u , ‘ To wan , la dep khreh ïa kaei kaei baroh !’

translation.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality .
translation.kha: Ki la shah tynjuh palat da ki jingjynjar kiba ki la ïaid lyngba ; hynrei ka jingkmen jong ki ka la long kaba khraw haduh katta katta ba ki la long kiba sbun shikatdei eh ha ka jingai jong ki , wat la ki long kiba duk shisha .

translation.en: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches : so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied him .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , uba itynnat , da ka jingpyiar ki tnat . U la long ka jingpihuiñ jong ki dieng baroh ha Eden , ka kper U Blei .

translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .

translation.en: In the first month , that is , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus , they cast Pur , that is , the lot , before Haman from day to day , and from month to month , to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Syiem Serksis , ha u Nisan , u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la hukum ban kynting sbai ( la khot ïa ki ,  purim  ) ban shem ïa ka sngi bad u bnai babiang ban pyntreikam ïa kata ka jingsylla jong u . La rai ban pyntreikam ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .

translation.en: And Naaman said , Be content , take two talents . And he urged him , and bound two talents of silver in two bags , with two changes of garments , and laid them upon two of his servants  ; and they bare them before him .
translation.kha: Sngewbha shim hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa ,  u Naaman u jubab . U la ïai ban ïa kata , u la teh ïa ka rupa ha ki ar tylli ki pla , u la ai ïa ki bad ïa ki ar riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ha ki ar ngut ki shakri jong u , bad u la phah ïa ki ha shuwa jong u Gehasi .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me , but evil ?
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Jehoshaphat ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa phi ba um ju ïathuhlypa ei ei kaba bha ïa nga ? Ka long borabor kaba sniew !

translation.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors .
translation.kha: Ki jingbthah jong me ki ai ka jingsngewbha ïa nga ; ki long ki nongaibuit jong nga .

translation.en: For this is an heinous crime  ; yea , it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges .
translation.kha: Kaba kum kata kaba da sang eh ka dei ban shah pynshitom da ka jingïap .

translation.en: It shall not be baken with leaven . I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire  ; it is most holy , as is the sin offering , and as the trespass offering .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin bam ïa kaba sah baroh . Yn pynlong ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat bad ban bam ha ka jaka bakhuid , ka phyllaw jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki na kata ka jingainguh bam . Ka long kaba khuid , kumba long ki jingainguh namar ka pop bad ki jingainguh namar ki jingleh palat .

translation.en: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Write , Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth : Yea , saith the Spirit , that they may rest from their labours  ; and their works do follow them .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba ong ,  To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito kiba naduh mynta ki ïap ha kaba shakri ïa U Trai !   Ho-oid shisha !  U Mynsiem u jubab .  Kin ïoh shongthait na ki jingtrei shitom jong ki , namar ki soh ka jingshakri jong ki , ki leit lem bad ki .

translation.en: And he from within shall answer and say , Trouble me not : the door is now shut , and my children are with me in bed  ; I cannot rise and give thee .
translation.kha: Bad tharai u paralok jong phi un jubab napoh ïing , ‘ Wat pynwit ïa nga ! Ïa ka jingkhang la lah khang , bad ma nga lem bad ki khun jong nga ngi la thiah . Ngam lah ban khie bad ai ei ei ha phi .’

translation.en: By the way that he came , by the same shall he return , and shall not come into this city , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un leit phai pat na ka lynti ha kaba u wan , khlem da rung ha kane ka nongbah . Nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side , and ten thousand at thy right hand  ; but it shall not come nigh thee .
translation.kha: Ha syndah jong me shihajar ngut ki lah ban kyllon , shiphew hajar ngut ha baroh sawdong jong me , hynrei men ym shah pynmynsaw .

translation.en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin , to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger with their vanities .
translation.kha: Kum u Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop jong u bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki briew ban leh pop bad mane bleithaw .

translation.en: All the saints salute you , chiefly they that are of Caesar s household .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew U Blei hangne ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei , khamtam kito kiba na ka ïingsyiem jong u Patsha .

translation.en: And being let go , they went to their own company , and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them .
translation.kha: Mar ïapyllait , u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis ki la leit phai sha la ka kynhun bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ong .

translation.en: For I neither received it of man , neither was I taught it , but by the revelation of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la ïohpdiang ïa ka na uno uno u briew , lane ym shym la don mano mano ruh ba la hikai ïa ka ha nga . U dei U Jisu Khrist hi uba la pynpaw ïa ka ha nga .

translation.en: And there was a very sore battle that day  ; and Abner was beaten , and the men of Israel , before the servants of David .
translation.kha: Nangta la khie ka thma kaba shyrkhei , bad u Abner bad ki Israel ki la shahjop ha ki rangbah jong u Dabid .

translation.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection , neither angel , nor spirit : but the Pharisees confess both .
translation.kha: ( Naba ki Saddusi ki ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap bad ba ym don ki angel lane ki mynsiem ; hynrei ki Pharisi ki ngeit ïa kine baroh lai tylli . )

translation.en: He shall be great , and shall be called the Son of the Highest : and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David :
translation.kha: Un long uba khraw , bad yn khot ïa u , U Khun jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . U Trai Uba U Blei un pynlong syiem ïa u , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la long ,

translation.en: Who , when he was reviled , reviled not again  ; when he suffered , he threatened not  ; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously :
translation.kha: Haba la krenbeiñ ïa u , um shym pynphai ktien kylliang da kaba krenbeiñ ; haba u shahshitom , um shym la byrngem , hynrei u la buh ïa la ki jingkyrmen ha U Blei , u Nongbishar bahok .

translation.en: By this we know that we love the children of God , when we love God , and keep his commandments .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip ba ngi ieit ïa ki khun U Blei : Ka long da kaba ieit ïa U Blei bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh ; but nourisheth and cherisheth it , even as the Lord the church :
translation.kha: ( Ym ju don uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka met . Pynban , u bsa bad sumar ïa ka , kumba U Khrist ruh u leh ïa ka balang ;

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the Jews which dwelt by them came , they said unto us ten times , From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka por sha ka por ki Jiw kiba shong hapdeng ki nongshun jong ngi ki wan ban maham ïa ngi ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nongshun jong ngi pyrshah ïa ngi .

translation.en: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom , which is by the entry of the east gate , and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee ,
translation.kha: bad ban leit lyngba ka Khyrdop Khra-pait shabar sha ka Them Hinnom . Hangta nga dei ban pynbna ïa ka khubor kaba un ai ha nga .

translation.en: And the king shall do according to his will  ; and he shall exalt himself , and magnify himself above every god , and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods , and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished : for that that is determined shall be done .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Syria un leh kat kaba u sngewbha . Un kob ba u long kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u blei , kham halor wat ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Un lah ban leh ïa kane tad haduh ha ka por haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa u . U Blei un leh thik ïa kaei kaba u la thmu .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Yet will I leave a remnant , that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations , when ye shall be scattered through the countries .
translation.kha: Ngan ailad ïa ki katto katne ban ïohlait na ka waitlam bad kin sakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad kin im kum kiba shah ringmraw .

translation.en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , and took Ijon , and Abel–beth–maachah , and Janoah , and Kedesh , and Hazor , and Gilead , and Galilee , all the land of Naphtali , and carried them captive to Assyria .
translation.kha: Ka la jia ba katba u Pekah u long syiem ba u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u kurup ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ijon , ka Abel Beth Maakah , ka Janoah , ka Kedesh , bad ka Hasor , bad ki ri jong ka Gilead , ka Galilaïa , bad ka Naphtali , bad u rah koidi ïa ki briew sha Assyria .

translation.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow , they said unto him , Lord , shall we smite with the sword ?
translation.kha: Haba ki synran kiba ïadon bad U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa kaei ka ban jia , ki la kylli ,  Hato ngin pyndonkam ïa ki waitlam jong ngi , ko Kynrad ?

translation.en: Because that thou mayest understand , that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship .
translation.kha: Kumba me lah ban shem hi da lade , ym pat palat khat-ar sngi ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane .

translation.en: Above when he said , Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not , neither hadst pleasure therein  ; which are offered by the law  ;
translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong u la ong ,  Mem shym la mon lane mem shym la sngewbha ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh lane ïa ki mrad ban thang ha ka duwan bad ïa ki jingkñia ïa ka ban kit noh ïa ki pop .  U la ong ïa kane wat haba ïa baroh ki jingkñia la ainguh kat kum ka Hukum .

translation.en: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uwei pa uwei uba khot kyrpad ïa U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap , un ïohlait im .

translation.en: And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ki balang la nang pynkhlaiñ ha ka jingngeit bad ki la nang roi ha ka jingbun briew man ka sngi .

translation.en: On this side Jordan , in the land of Moab , began Moses to declare this law , saying ,
translation.kha: Dei ha ka por ba ki Israel ki don ha Moab sha mihngi na Jordan ba u Moses u sdang ban batai bad hikai ïa ki hukum U Blei .

translation.en: Ye are all the children of light , and the children of the day : we are not of the night , nor of darkness .
translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ki briew jong ka jingshai , kiba long ki jong ka sngi . Ngim dei ki jong ka miet lane jong ka jingdum .

translation.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out thence  ; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea , thence will I command the serpent , and he shall bite them :
translation.kha: Lada ki rieh ha khlieh u lum Karmel , ngan wad ïa ki bad kem ïa ki . Lada ki rieh na jong nga ha trai duriaw , ngan hukum ïa ki mrad duriaw bakynsha ban dait ïa ki .

translation.en: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man , clothed with a garment down to the foot , and girt about the paps with a golden girdle .
translation.kha: bad napdeng jong ki , la don uba i kum U Khun U Briew , uba kup ka jaiñkup kaba kot haduh ki kjat jong u , bad u don u panpoh ksiar sawdong ka shadem jong u .

translation.en: So all the service of the  Lord  was prepared the same day , to keep the passover , and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the  Lord  , according to the commandment of king Josiah .
translation.kha: Te , kumba u syiem Josaïah u la hukum , la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kata ka sngi ban mane ïa U  Trai  , ban sumar ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa ka jingai ïa ki jingainguh thang ha ka duwan .

translation.en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye children of Israel : for the  Lord  hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land , because there is no truth , nor mercy , nor knowledge of God in the land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . To sngap , ko Israel , ïa kaei kaba u ong :  Ym don jingïaineh ne ka jingieit ha ka ri , Bad ki briew kim pdiang ïa nga kum U Blei .

translation.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity , until the pit be digged for the wicked .
translation.kha: Me ai ha u ïa ka jingjahthait na ki sngi ka jingjynjar haduh ban da tih ïa ka tliew ban ngat u bymman .

translation.en: Thou therefore endure hardness , as a good soldier of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To shim bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom , kum u shipai baïaineh jong U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth , whither the  Lord  had sent him to prophesy  ; and he stood in the court of the  Lord s  house  ; and said to all the people ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga la iehnoh ïa ka Topheth , ha kaba U  Trai  u la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u . Nga la leit bad ïeng hapoh ka phyllaw jong ka Templ bad ïathuh ha ki briew baroh

translation.en: I John , who also am your brother , and companion in tribulation , and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ , was in the isle that is called Patmos , for the word of God , and for the testimony of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Nga long u Ïoannis , u parabangeit jong phi , bad kum u nongbud jong U Jisu nga long uba ïadon bynta lem bad phi ban ïaishah ïa ka jingjynjar kaba wan ha kito kiba long na ka Hima jong u . Ïa nga la buh ha ka dewlynnong Patmos namar nga la pynbna ïa ka Ktien U Blei bad ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw .

translation.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts ? or who hath given understanding to the heart ?
translation.kha: Mano ba ïathuh ïa ka ibis    lano ka wah Nile kan shlei um , lane mano ba ïathuh ïa u syiar ba u slap un sa hap ?

translation.en: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet , and besought him , saying , Have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
translation.kha: U para shakri jong u , u la dem khrup bad u la kyrpad ïa u , ‘ to ïaishah bad nga , bad ngan siew pat ïa phi !’

translation.en: And the people stood beholding . And the rulers also with them derided him , saying , He saved others  ; let him save himself , if he be Christ , the chosen of God .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ïeng hangta da kaba khmih katba ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki krenbeiñ ïa u :  U la pynim ïa kiwei ; ai un pynim ïa lade lada u dei U Messaïah ïa uba U Blei u la jied !

translation.en: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices , I was about to write : and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered , and write them not .
translation.kha: Hamar ba ki la kren , nga la sdang ban thoh . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren na bneng ,  To buhrieh ïa kaei kaba ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la ong ; wat thoh ïa ka !

translation.en: After the discourse , there is a one-hour “Watchtower” Study , in which members of the congregation are welcome to participate in a discussion of an article from the study edition of The Watchtower .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingkren ka don ka Jingpule na “Ka Kut Ap Phira” kaba shikynta ha kaba ki dkhot ka balang ki lah ban ai jubab na ka Kut Ap Phira ( ha ka Phareng ) .

translation.en: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise , Say not in thine heart , Who shall ascend into heaven ? ( that is , to bring Christ down from above : )
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang ka jingïadei bad U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit ka long kane :  Phim dei ban kylli ïa lade , Uei u ban leit sha bneng ?  ( kata ka long , ban wallam ïa U Khrist sha tbian ) .

translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me  ; and , behold , he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth  ; and , lo , it was the latter growth after the king s mowings .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka nga la ïohi ïa u ba u pynmih shi kynhun ki puit tang hadien ba la ot noh ïa u skum uba long ka bynta u syiem bad u phlang u la sdang ban mih biang .

translation.en: And when Joshua had let the people go , the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la phah ïa ki paid Israel ha la ka lynti , bad uwei pa uwei u briew u la leit ban shim kynti ïa la ka bhah jong ka ri .

translation.en: So Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces , and all the people , obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  , to dwell in the land of Judah .
translation.kha: Kumta ym u Johanan lymne uno uno na ki rangbah shipai lymne kino kino na ki paidbah kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  ban ïaisah ha ka ri Judah .

translation.en: And I , behold , I establish my covenant with you , and with your seed after you  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ka jutang bad phi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ,

translation.en: Wisdom crieth without  ; she uttereth her voice in the streets :
translation.kha: Ha sngap ! Ka Jingstad ka pyrta ha ki lynti shnong bad ha ki jaka ïew ,

translation.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh , beside the land of Gilead and Bashan , which were on the other side Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba u Manasseh u ïoh shiphew bynta nalor ka Gilead bad ka Bashan ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ,

translation.en: That bringeth the princes to nothing  ; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity .
translation.kha: U pynhiar shapoh ïa ki nongsynshar badonbor um pynlong ei ei shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  saith , Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice , neither walked therein  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong nga ki la iehnoh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga kaba nga la ai ha ki . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga lane leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bthah ïa ki .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the  Lord  from the heavens : praise him in the heights .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  na bneng , phi kiba im ha ki jaka bakynjang shajrong .

translation.en: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty , and playedst the harlot because of thy renown , and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by  ; his it was .
translation.kha: Hynrei pha shim kabu ïa ka jingbhabriew bad ka nam jong pha , ban ïathiah bad uno uno uba pha ïakynduh .

translation.en: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even , and shall not eat of the holy things , unless he wash his flesh with water .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba kylla long u bymkhuid un ïaisah u bymkhuid haduh janmiet , hynrei la katta ruh um lah ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh ba u la dep sum .

translation.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , Because the  Lord  hath loved his people , he hath made thee king over them .
translation.kha: U syiem Hiram ha kaba jubab u phah da ka shithi sha u Solomon . U thoh ,  Namar U  Trai  u ieit ïa la ki briew , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: The son of Abinadab , in all the region of Dor  ; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife :
translation.kha: U Benabinadab , uba shongkurim ïa ka Taphath , ka khun jong u Solomon : ka thain Dor baroh kawei ;

translation.en: Then would I speak , and not fear him  ; but it is not so with me .
translation.kha: Ngam sheptieng , ngan ïai kren beit namar nga tip ïa la ka dohnud .

translation.en: And Ahab said to Elijah , Hast thou found me , O mine enemy ? And he answered , I have found thee : because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u Ahab u ïohi ïa u Elijah , u ong  Me u nongshun jong nga , me la lap mo ïa nga ?   Ho-oid , nga la lap ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  Me la aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: They zealously affect you , but not well ; yea , they would exclude you , that ye might affect them .
translation.kha: Kiba pyn-i ka jingsngewtynnat kaba katta katta ïa phi , hynrei kam bha . Hooid , kin kyntait ia phi , lah kumba phin pynsniew iaki .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me , and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kaei ka jingkynnoh ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la wanrah pyrshah ïa nga ? Kaei kaba pynlong ïa ki ban phai noh na nga ? Ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymdondor ei ei bad ki hi ki la kylla long ki bymdondor .

translation.en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel , which offered burnt offerings , and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa ki samla shynrang bad ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  bad ki la kñia katto katne tylli ki jingri kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok .

translation.en: And not only they , but ourselves also , which have the firstfruits of the Spirit , even we ourselves groan within ourselves , waiting for the adoption , to wit , the redemption of our body .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym dei tang ki jingthaw kiba ud ; ma ngi ruh kiba don ïa U Mynsiem kum ki jingai banyngkong jong U Blei , ngi ïa-ud hapoh lade hi , katba ngi dang ap ïa U Blei ba un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u bad ban pyllaitluid phar ïa ngi .

translation.en: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus , when thou comest , bring with thee , and the books , but especially the parchments .
translation.kha: Haba me wan , to wanrah ïa ka jaiñkup ba nga la iehnoh ha Troas bad u Karpos ; wanrah ruh ïa ki kot , bad khamtam ïa ki kot ba la sop snieh .

translation.en: ( For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast . )
translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u Pilat u la dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uwei na ki koidi na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And if he do not these three unto her , then shall she go out free without money .
translation.kha: Lada um pyndep ïa kine ki kamram ha ka , u dei ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ka khlem da siew ei ei .

translation.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger , and the strength of battle : and it hath set him on fire round about , yet he knew not  ; and it burned him , yet he laid it not to heart .
translation.kha: Kumta u pynlong ïa ngi ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong u bad shah jynjar ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka thma . Kum ka ding ka jingbitar jong u ka meh kylleng ka Israel , hynrei ngim ju tip aïu ka jia ; ngim shym ïoh jinghikai satia ei ei na ka .

translation.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh  ; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet : and Deborah went up with him .
translation.kha: U Barak u la khot ïa ki jait Sebulun bad Naphtali sha Kedesh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ki la bud ïa u . Ka Deborah ka la leit bad u .

translation.en: And Adoram was over the tribute : and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder :
translation.kha: u Adoniram u peit ïa kiba shah pyntrei jubor ; u Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud u dei u nongsumar ïa ki dulir ;

translation.en: Finally , brethren , farewell . Be perfect , be of good comfort , be of one mind , live in peace ; and the God of love and peace shall be with you .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko parabangeit jong nga , khublei! To ïabeh sha ka jingjanai ; to shahshkor ïa ki jingkyrpad jong nga , to don kajuh ka jingmut para ma phi , to ïa-im ha ka jingsuk . Bad U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingsuk un long ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up  ; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague .
translation.kha: Ka la ktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka jingmihsnam jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon ; bad ka la don ka jingsngewthuh hapoh jong ka ba ka ïohkhiah na ka jingshitom jong ka .

translation.en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness , and shall uncover her nakedness  ; he hath discovered her fountain , and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood : and both of them shall be cut off from among their people .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka dang poi bnai , dei ban tait noh ïa ki baroh ar ngut na la ki parabriew , namar ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingbymkhuid .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses bad u Aaron

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Tyre , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom , and remembered not the brotherly covenant :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Tyros ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ring ïa u paidbah baroh sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki Edom , bad kim shym bat ïa ka jutang ka jingïalong paralok ba ki la ïateh .

translation.en: And the angel said unto me , Wherefore didst thou marvel ? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman , and of the beast that carrieth her , which hath the seven heads and ten horns .
translation.kha: Balei ba me la sngewkyndit ?  u angel u la kylli ïa nga .  Ngan ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingmut barieh jong kata ka briew , bad jong u mradkhlaw uba kit ïa ka , uta u mradkhlaw uba don hynñiew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki reng .

translation.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ha U Blei long ka burom junom la junom! Amen .

translation.en: For I say unto you , That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees , ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Kumta , nga ong ïa phi , ba phin lah ban rung shapoh ka Hima ki bneng tang lada phi ïaineh skhem kham palat ban ïa ki nonghikai Aiñ bad ki Pharisi ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa .

translation.en: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him , I brought him forth into their council :
translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki la mudui ïa u , kumta nga la ïalam ïa u sha ka Dorbar jong ki .

translation.en: And the king said , Bring me a sword . And they brought a sword before the king .
translation.kha: U la phah shim ka waitlam , bad haba la wanrah ïa ka ,

translation.en: But Jesus held his peace . And the high priest answered and said unto him , I adjure thee by the living God , that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ , the Son of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u shu sngap . Sa shisien pat u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kren ha u ,  Ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei uba im , mynta nga buh ïa me ha ka jingsmai : Ïathuh ïa ngi lada me dei u Messaïah , U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Within a year , according to the years of an hireling , and all the glory of Kedar shall fail :
translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha nga ,  Hapoh shisnem thik ka jingkhraw jong ki jait jong ka Kedar kan poi sha kaba kut .

translation.en: And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,
translation.kha: ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ka snieh kaba jlih , bad ka dieng akasia ,

translation.en: And , behold , God himself is with us for our captain , and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you . O children of Israel , fight ye not against the  Lord  God of your fathers  ; for ye shall not prosper .
translation.kha: U Blei hi da lade u long u nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh jong u ki don hangne lem bad ki turoi , ba la khreh ban put ïa ki bad ban khot ïa ngi bad ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa phi . Ko paid Israel , wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi ! Phin ym jop !

translation.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought . And every shipmaster , and all the company in ships , and sailors , and as many as trade by sea , stood afar off ,
translation.kha: Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kane ka spah !  Baroh ki kapten jong ki liengbah bad ki nongshong lieng , ki maji bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la ïoh kamai na ka duriaw , ki la ïeng na sha jngai bah ,

translation.en: All these are the beginning of sorrows .
translation.kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki long kum ki jingpang banyngkong jong ka jingsuh kha .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Said I not unto thee , that , if thou wouldest believe , thou shouldest see the glory of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa pha ba phan sa ïohi ïa ka burom U Blei lada pha ngeit ?

translation.en: Neither be ye idolaters , as were some of them ; as it is written , The people sat down to eat and drink , and rose up to play .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U paidbah u la shong ha ka jingkhawai kaba la kylla long ka jingïadih buaid bad ka jingleh nuti .

translation.en: But if he will not hear thee , then take with thee one or two more , that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um sngap ïa me , ïalam uwei ne ar ngut kiwei pat ki briew lem bad me , khnang ba ‘ kawei pa kawei ka jingkynnoh lah ban kyrshan da ka jingsakhi jong ki ar lane lai ngut ki sakhi .’

translation.en: Have ye not known ? have ye not heard ? hath it not been told you from the beginning ? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ? Hato ym shym la ïathuh slem mynshuwa ? Hato phim shym ïohsngew kumno ka pyrthei ka sdang ?

translation.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better .
translation.kha: Ym don jingartatien ba uta uba kyrkhu u kham khraw ban ïa uta uba shah kyrkhu .

translation.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David  ;
translation.kha: U la ai ha ngi ïa U Nongpynim bakhrawbor , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid u shakri jong u .

translation.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing , and thy lips with rejoicing .
translation.kha: Un shah ïa phi ban rkhie bad ban kyang jam pat ,

translation.en: So they , being sent forth by the Holy Ghost , departed unto Seleucia  ; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus .
translation.kha: Haba la phah da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u Barnabas bad u Saul ki la leit sha Seleukia bad ki la leit da ka lieng nangta sha ka dewlynnong Sypros .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee : begin to possess , that thou mayest inherit his land .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Khmih shane , nga la aiti ïa u syiem Sihon bad ïa ka ri jong u ha phi ; knieh ïa ka ri jong u bad kam kynti ïa ka .’

translation.en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout , with the voice of the archangel , and with the trump of God : and the dead in Christ shall rise first :
translation.kha: Kan don ka jingpyrta da ka hukum , ka sur jong u angel rangbah , ka jingriew ka turoi jong U Blei , bad U Trai hi da lade un sa wan hiar na bneng . Kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha U Khrist kin ïamih pat shuwa ;

translation.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water :
translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .

translation.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels which are in heaven , neither the Son , but the Father .
translation.kha: Ym don pat batip , lano kata ka sngi lane ka kynta kin wan — lymne wat ki angel ha bneng , lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa u tip .

translation.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God , and the heritage appointed unto him by God .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sniew , ka kupar ba U Blei u la buh bynta ïa ki .

translation.en: But as for thee and thy servants , I know that ye will not yet fear the  Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip ba ma phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi phim pat sheptieng ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down , and took him , and brought him up , and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father . And he judged Israel twenty years .
translation.kha: Ki para bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u baroh ki wan shim bad rah noh ïa ka met jong u . Ki shim pat ïa u bad ki tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Manoah u kpa jong u , kaba hapdeng ka Sorah bad ka Eshtaol . U la long u nongïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem .

translation.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks , and look well to thy herds .
translation.kha: To khmih bha ïa ki langbrot bad ïa ki masi jong phi katba phi lah ,

translation.en: And he answered , Fear not : for they that be with us are more than they that be with them .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u Elisha u jubab .  Ngi don kham bun ha ka liang jong ngi ban ïa kaba ki don ma ki .

translation.en: And make straight paths for your feet , lest that which is lame be turned out of the way  ; but let it rather be healed .
translation.kha: Da ïaid ha ki lynti kiba beit , khnang ba ïa kata ka kjat kaba dkoh yn ym pynduhbor noh , hynrei pynban , yn pynkoit keiñ ïa ka .

translation.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought , and the scorner is consumed , and all that watch for iniquity are cut off :
translation.kha: Kan sa long kaba kut ïa kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad kiba pyn-i jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei . Ïa uwei pa uwei u nongpop yn pynjot .

translation.en: Then the Jews sought him at the feast , and said , Where is he ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïawad ïa u ha kata ka Jingkhawai Niam .  Hangno u don ?  ki la kylli .

translation.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh , they constrain you to be circumcised ; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pyrshang ban pynbor ïa phi ban otsher ki dei kito kiba kwah ban pynpaw bad kob ïa ki kam kiba paw shabar . Ki leh ïa ka , la kumno kumno , tang ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ na ka bynta ka diengphna U Khrist .

translation.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , hynrei uno uno u bym shym otsher um lah ban bam ïa ka .

translation.en: Let another man praise thee , and not thine own mouth  ; a stranger , and not thine own lips .
translation.kha: Ai ba kiwei pat ki briew kin ïaroh ïa phi — wat ki nongwei ; ym dei ban leh ïa ka na lade .

translation.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise , but understanding what the will of the Lord is .
translation.kha: Wat long kiba bieit , hynrei , pyrshang ban wad ïa kaei kaba U Trai u kwah ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves , that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets .
translation.kha: Kumta phi phla shisha ba phi long ki khun ki ksiew jong kito kiba la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa !

translation.en: Oh that my head were waters , and mine eyes a fountain of tears , that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people !
translation.kha: Nga kyrmen ba ka khlieh jong nga ka long ka pukri um , bad ba ki khmat jong nga ka umpohliew ki ummat , khnang ba nga lah ban ïam mynsngi bad mynmiet na ka bynta ki briew jong nga kiba la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And Abraham was old , and well stricken in age : and the  Lord  had blessed Abraham in all things .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la tymmen bha , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , when the meat offering was offered , that , behold , there came water by the way of Edom , and the country was filled with water .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , ha ka por kñia ba man ka step , ka um ka la wan tuid na ka phang Edom , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka madan .

translation.en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O Zedekiah king of Judah  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of thee , Thou shalt not die by the sword :
translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong shaphang jong me . Men ym shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau , Behold , I have made him thy lord , and all his brethren have I given to him for servants  ; and with corn and wine have I sustained him : and what shall I do now unto thee , my son ?
translation.kha: U Isaak u jubab ,  Nga la pynlong ïa u , u kynrad halor jong me , bad nga la pynlong ïa ki kur ki jait jong u ban long ki mraw jong u . Nga la ai ha u ïa u kew bad ka waiñ . Mynta ngam don ei ei shuh ba nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong me , ko khun ?

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers , that I will raise up thy seed after thee , which shall be of thy sons  ; and I will establish his kingdom .
translation.kha: Ynda me ïap bad tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun jong me bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u kaba khlaiñ .

translation.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about , and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about .
translation.kha: Thaw ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong bad pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .

translation.en: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way : but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka jingbeit ka pynsuk ïa ka jingim u briew uba bha , hynrei u bymman u kyllon da la ki jong ki kam bymman .

translation.en: Iron sharpeneth iron  ; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïoh jinghikai uwei na uwei pat , kumba u nar u pynnep ïa u nar .

translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God  ; and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left .
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar ba-halor tam ban ibeiñ ïa U Blei uba im . To ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingibeiñ bad un pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ha ki . Kumta duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew kiba lait im .

translation.en: If I have found favour in the sight of the king , and if it please the king to grant my petition , and to perform my request , let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them , and I will do to morrow as the king hath said .
translation.kha: Lada ma phi ko syiem phi lehsbun ban ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha kawei pat ka jingkhawai la shai ka sngi ba ngan pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi . Ha kata ka por ngan sa ong ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga kwah .

translation.en: Destruction cometh  ; and they shall seek peace , and there shall be none .
translation.kha: Ka jingjynjar ka wan . Phin wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei phin ym shem ïa ka .

translation.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith ,  With men it is impossible , but not with God : for with God all things are possible .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaiñ ha ki bad u la jubab ,  Kane ka long ka bym lah ïa u briew , hynrei ym ïa U Blei ; kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah ïa U Blei .

translation.en: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago , ( whether in the body , I cannot tell ; or whether out of the body , I cannot tell : God knoweth ; ) such an one caught up to the third heaven .
translation.kha: Nga ithuh ïa u briew uba ngeit ïa uba khatsaw snem mynshuwa la rong noh sha ka bneng kaba jrong tam ( ngam tip la kane ka da jia shisha ne u la ïoh ïa ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba tip ) .

translation.en: For this is the word of promise , At this time will I come , and Sara shall have a son .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular U Blei la pynlong ha kine ki ktien :  Ha ka por kaba dei ngan wan pat , bad ka Sarah kan ïoh khun shynrang .

translation.en: Looking to the future , the Bible tells of a “new heavens and a new earth that we are awaiting according to [God’s] promise , and in these righteousness is to dwell .”—2 Peter 3 :13  ; Isaiah 65 :17 .
translation.kha: Haba ngi peit ïa ka lawei , ka Baibl ka ïathuh shaphang “Ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ka khyndew kiba thymmai , katba kum kata ka jingkular jong u ( Blei ) ngi ïakhmih lynti , ha kiba ka hok ka shong sah” . —2 Petros 3 :13 ; Isaïah 65 :17 .

translation.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me : and eat ye every one of his vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern  ;
translation.kha: A wat sngap ïa u Hesekaïah ! U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa phi ban mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem . Ïa phi baroh yn shah ban bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki soh Dumbur na ki jong ki dieng jong ki , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jong phi —

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai : for thou chargedst us , saying , Set bounds about the mount , and sanctify it .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ki briew kim lah ban wan kiew shajrong , naba me la hukum ïa ngi ban kheiñ kyntang ïa u lum bad ban buh dak sawdong jong u .

translation.en: As the Father knoweth me , even so know I the Father : and I lay down my life for the sheep .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u nongaplangbrot uba bha . Kumba U Kpa u ithuh ïa nga bad nga , nga ithuh ïa U Kpa , ha kajuh ka rukom nga ithuh ïa la ki langbrot bad ki ithuh ïa nga . Bad nga kloi ban ïap na ka bynta jong ki .
