translation.en: Now when the congregation was broken up , many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas : who , speaking to them , persuaded them to continue in the grace of God .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki paidbah ki la mihnoh na ka jingïalang , ïa u Paul bad u Barnabas la bud da kiba bun ki Jiw bad da kiba bun ki Jentil kiba la kylla sha ka niam ki Jiw . Ki apostol ki la kren ha ki bad ki la pynshlur ïa ki ban ïai im ha ka jingaiei jong U Blei .

translation.en: Behold , a son shall be born to thee , who shall be a man of rest  ; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about : for his name shall be Solomon , and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , u la pynlong ka jingkular bad nga . U ong , ‘ Phin sa don u khun jong u ban synshar ha ka jingsuk , namar ba ngan ai ha u ka jingsuk na ki nongshun jong u baroh . Ka kyrteng jong u kan long u Solomon , namar ha ka jingsynshar jong u ngan ai ha ki Israel ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain .

translation.en: Therefore when they were gathered together , Pilate said unto them , Whom will ye that I release unto you ? Barabbas , or Jesus which is called Christ ?
translation.kha: Kumta haba u paidbah u la ïalumlang , u Pilat u la kylli ïa ki ,  Uno na kine phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ? Ïa u Jisu Barabbas ne ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?

translation.en: Will the  Lord  be pleased with thousands of rams , or with ten thousands of rivers of oil ? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression , the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?
translation.kha: Hato U  Trai  un sngewbha lada nga wallam sha u da ki hajar ki langbrot lane da ka umphniang Olib kaba tuid khlem kut ? Hato ngan ai ha u da u khun nyngkong jong nga ban siew na ka bynta ki pop jong nga ?

translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong uta u mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai jong kata ka duwan .

translation.en: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel , and he spied the company of Jehu as he came , and said , I see a company . And Joram said , Take an horseman , and send to meet them , and let him say , Is it peace ?
translation.kha: Uwei u nongap phira uba ïeng halor ka jaka ap phira ha Jesreel u la ïohi ïa u Jehu bad ki rangbah jong u ba ki wan ,  Nga ïohi shi kynhun ki shipai ,  u la pyrta . U Joram u jubab ,  Phah uwei u nongshong kulai ban pynthikna la ki dei ki paralok ne ki nongshun .

translation.en: Go your ways : behold , I send you forth as lambs among wolves .
translation.kha: Khie leit ! Nga phah ïa phi kum ki khunlangbrot hapdeng ki suri .

translation.en: And when this cometh to pass , ( lo , it will come , ) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki ktien jong me ki wan urlong — bad kin wan urlong shisha — te kin sa tip ba pleng hapdeng jong ki u don u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies , and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid  ; and she waited on Naaman s wife .
translation.kha: Ha kawei na ki jingleit thombor pyrshah ïa ki Israel , ki Syria ki la ringmraw ïa kawei ka khynnah rit Israel , kaba la long ka shakri jong ka tnga jong u Naaman .

translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the  Lord  : and the king said unto Jeremiah , I will ask thee a thing  ; hide nothing from me .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka por u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah wallam ïa nga sha u ha ka khyrdop kaba lai sha ka Templ , bad u la ong ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , bad nga kwah ba phin ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingshisha baroh .

translation.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness : now their own doings have beset them about  ; they are before my face .
translation.kha: Kam ju rung ha ki jingmut jong ki ba ngan kynmaw ïa kane ka kam sniew baroh ; hynrei ki pop jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa ki , bad ngam lah khlem da ïohi ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar , Arioch king of Ellasar , Chedorlaomer king of Elam , and Tidal king of nations  ;
translation.kha: Saw ngut ki syiem , u Amraphel jong ka Babilonia , u Ariokh jong ka Ellasar , u Khedorlaomer jong ka Elam , bad u Tidal jong ka Goiim ,

translation.en: Behold , all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded : they shall be as nothing  ; and they that strive with thee shall perish .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bitar ïa me kin tip ïa ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa me kin ïap

translation.en: And David saith , Let their table be made a snare , and a trap , and a stumblingblock , and a recompence unto them :
translation.kha: Bad u Dabid u ong ,  Ai ba kin ngat bad sahkut ha ki jingkhawai jong ki ; ai ba kin kyllon , ai ba kin shah pynshitom!

translation.en: Because he hath appointed a day , in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained  ; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead .
translation.kha: Naba u la buh ka sngi ha kaba un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka jinglehhok , da uta u briew ïa uba u la jied . U la ai ka jingpynshisha ïa kane ha uwei pa uwei da kaba pynmihpat ïa uta u briew na ka jingïap !

translation.en: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother  ; usury of money , usury of victuals , usury of any thing that is lent upon usury :
translation.kha: Wat shim sut na la u para Israel haba phi ai ram , lane phi ai jingbam , lane phi ai shah ïa kaei kaei ha u .

translation.en: And he returned to the man of God , he and all his company , and came , and stood before him : and he said , Behold , now I know that there is no God in all the earth , but in Israel : now therefore , I pray thee , take a blessing of thy servant .
translation.kha: U la leit phai pat sha u Elisha lem bad baroh ki rangbah jong u bad u ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba ym don uno uno u blei hynrei tang U Blei ki Israel ; kumta sngewbha , ko kynrad , pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha na nga .

translation.en: Behold , I will make them of the synagogue of Satan , which say they are Jews , and are not , but do lie  ; behold , I will make them to come and worship before thy feet , and to know that I have loved thee .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ! Na ka bynta kato ka kynhun kaba dei ka jong u Soitan , kito kiba lamler kiba kam ba ki dei ki Jiw hynrei kim dei , ngan pynlong ïa ki ban wan bad dem khrup ha ki kjat jong pha . Baroh kin tip ba nga ieit ïa pha .

translation.en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me , yea , four which I know not :
translation.kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei kiba phylla eh ïa nga ba ngan shemphang :

translation.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , Esau came , and with him four hundred men . And he divided the children unto Leah , and unto Rachel , and unto the two handmaids .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïohi ïa u Iso ba u wan lem bad sawspah ngut ki rangbah . Kumta u pynïabynta ïa ki khun hapdeng ha Leah , ka Rakhel , bad ki tnga kliar ar ngut .

translation.en: And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .
translation.kha: Ha khmih !  u la ong .  Nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ïa U Khun U Briew ba u ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei !

translation.en: And they went in to the king into the court , but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe , and told all the words in the ears of the king .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki buh ïa ka kot kli ha ka kamra u Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki leit sha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem , bad ki la ïathuh ïa baroh kiei kiei ha u syiem .

translation.en: But if they say thus , Come up unto us  ; then we will go up : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into our hand : and this shall be a sign unto us .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ki ong ba ngin leit sha ki , te ngin leit , namar kata kan long ka dak ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor jong ki .

translation.en: And the garment , either warp , or woof , or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash , if the plague be departed from them , then it shall be washed the second time , and shall be clean .
translation.kha: Lada u sait ïa kata bad ka jingbthuh ka jah noh , u dei ban sait biang ïa ka sa shisien , bad kan sa long kaba khuid .

translation.en: There are many devices in a man s heart  ; nevertheless the counsel of the  Lord  , that shall stand .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki lah ban thmu shibun kiei kiei , hynrei ïa ka mon U  Trai  yn hap ban pyndep .

translation.en: For the  Lord  is a great God , and a great King above all gods .
translation.kha: Naba U  Trai  u long U Blei bakhlaiñbor , u syiem uba khrawbor halor ki blei baroh .

translation.en: And if this come to the governor s ears , we will persuade him , and secure you .
translation.kha: Bad lada u lyngskor un ïohsngew ïa kane , ngin pynngeit ïa u ba phi long ki bymtip ei ei , bad phin ym don ei ei ban khuslai .

translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  If I have spoken evil , bear witness of the evil : but if well , why smitest thou me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Lada nga la kren ïa kano kano kaba bakla , to ïathuh ïa baroh hangne ka dei kaei . Hynrei lada ka long kaba dei ha kaei kaba nga la ong , balei ba me da thab ïa nga ?

translation.en: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering , and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house , without the sanctuary .
translation.kha: Me dei ban shim ïa u masi lyngraw ïa uba la ai kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop bad thang ïa u ha ka jaka ba la pynkhreh khnang shabar ka Templ .

translation.en: Therefore let us not sleep , as do others ; but let us watch and be sober .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ngim dei ban ïohthiah kum kiwei pat ; ngi dei ban peitmat bad pyngngad .

translation.en: For thou saidst , What advantage will it be unto thee ? and , What profit shall I have , if I be cleansed from my sin ?
translation.kha: ne ban kylli ïa U Blei ,  Da kumno ka pop jong nga ka ktah ïa me ? Nga ïohnong aïu na kaba khlem leh pop ?

translation.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required .
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la shim ka rai halor U Jisu ïa kaba ki la pan .

translation.en: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey , who left his house , and gave authority to his servants , and to every man his work , and commanded the porter to watch .
translation.kha: Kan long kumba u briew uba mih na ïing ban leit jingleit , bad u iehnoh ha ki shakri ban khmih ïa ka kam , hadien ba u ai ha uwei pa uwei ïa ka kam jong u ban leh , bad hadien ba u ong ïa u nongap khyrdop ban peit bha .

translation.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness  sake : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba shah pynshitom beiñ namar ba ki leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !

translation.en: For now we see through a glass , darkly ; but then face to face : now I know in part ; but then shall I know even as also I am known .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngi ïohi mynta ka long kum ka dur kaba byrngut ha ka ïitkhmih ; nangta ngin sa ïohi markhmat . Kaei kaba nga tip mynta ka long tang katto katne ; nangta kan sa long kaba dap pura — kaba dap pura kum ka jingtip jong U Blei ïa nga .

translation.en: The  Lord  doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem ; u wallam pat ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .

translation.en: He brought me to the banqueting house , and his banner over me was love .
translation.kha: To shim ïa nga bad phi , bad ngin ïaphet noh ; to long u syiem jong nga bad shim ïa nga sha ka kamra jong phi . Ngin ïakmen lang , ngin ïadih bun bad pyllaitluid war ïa lade ha ka jingieit . Kam long kaba phylla ba baroh ki kynthei ki ieit ïa phi !

translation.en: And Leah conceived , and bare a son , and she called his name Reuben : for she said , Surely the  Lord  hath looked upon my affliction  ; now therefore my husband will love me .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka la punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga , bad mynta u tnga jong nga un ieit ïa nga  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Reuben .

translation.en: For he was numbered with us , and had obtained part of this ministry .
translation.kha: U Judas u la long u dkhot jong ka kynhun jong ngi , namar la lah jied ïa u ban ïadon bynta lem ha ka kam jong ngi .

translation.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father , and departed not from it , doing that which was right in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kum u kpa jong u , u Asa , ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai  ;

translation.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood , he also himself likewise took part of the same  ; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death , that is , the devil  ;
translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki khun , kumba u khot ïa ki , ki long ki briew na ka doh bad ka snam , U Jisu u la long u briew kum ma ki hi bad ïoh bynta lang na ka jinglongbriew jong ki . U la leh ïa kane , khnang ba da ka jingïap jong u , u lah ban pynduh ïa u Bymman , uba don ka bor halor ka jingïap ,

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren pat ,

translation.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves , Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing ? behold , the world is gone after him .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Phi ïohi , ngim shym lah leh ei ei ruh em ! Khmih , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïabud ïa u !

translation.en: And they were offended in him . But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , save in his own country , and in his own house .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki la kyntait ïa u . U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang hapoh ka shnong jong u bad da kiba ha ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah , Let no man know of these words , and thou shalt not die .
translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u la jubab ,  Wat ai ba uno uno ruh un tip ïa kane ka jingïakren , bad ka jingim jong me kan ym don ha ka jingma .

translation.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down , after they were compassed about seven days .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa ki kynroh ka Jerikho ban kyllon , hadien ba ki khun Israel ki la ïaid tawiar sawdong ïa ki , hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel , saying , Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep : for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations  ; that ye may know that I am the  Lord  that doth sanctify you .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka sngi Sabbaton , ka sngi shongthait jong nga namar ka long ka dak hapdeng jong nga bad phi pateng la pateng , ba phin ïoh tip ba nga U  Trai  nga la pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga hi .

translation.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that were by the house of the  Lord  , where the women wove hangings for the grove .
translation.kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka ha ka Templ , ha kiba ju shong ki nuti ka Templ . ( Ka dei hangta ba ki kynthei ki ju thain ïa ki barandi kiba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa ka Asherah . )

translation.en: And God said unto him , Thy name is Jacob : thy name shall not be called any more Jacob , but Israel shall be thy name : and he called his name Israel .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u ,  Ka kyrteng jong me ka dei u Jakob , hynrei naduh mynta , kan long noh U Israel .  Kumta U Blei u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Israel .

translation.en: The same came therefore to Philip , which was of Bethsaida of Galilee , and desired him , saying , Sir , we would see Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha u Philip ( uba dei na Bethsaida kaba ha Galilaïa ) bad ki la ong ,  Ko Rangbah , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: But first must he suffer many things , and be rejected of this generation .
translation.kha: Hynrei , nyngkong u dei ban shahshitom shikatdei eh bad ban shah kyntait da ki briew jong kane ka pateng .

translation.en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God : for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .
translation.kha: Uta ïa uba U Blei u la phah , u kren ïa ki ktien jong U Blei , namar ba U Blei u ai ha u ïa ka jingdap jong U Mynsiem jong u .

translation.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph s hand  ; and he knew not ought he had , save the bread which he did eat . And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured .
translation.kha: Kumta u Potiphar u aiti ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba u don ha ka jingpeit u Joseph , bad um shym pynkhuslai ei ei shuh ïa lade lait tang ka bam ba u ju bam .

translation.en: And the servants also of Huram , and the servants of Solomon , which brought gold from Ophir , brought algum trees and precious stones .
translation.kha: ( Ki rangbah jong u syiem Hiram bad ki jong u syiem Solomon kiba wan kit ksiar na Ophir , ki wan kit ruh u dieng Kseh-Juniper bad ki mawkordor .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God  ;
translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : namar me mut ba me stad kum U Blei ,

translation.en: The rich ruleth over the poor , and the borrower is servant to the lender .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long ki mraw jong u briew bariewspah , pan kylliang pisa bad phin long u mraw jong u nongai ram .

translation.en: For the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof .
translation.kha: Naba , ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ka khyndew bad kiei kiei kiba don ha ka ki long ki jong U Trai .

translation.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God , and your sins have hid his face from you , that he will not hear .
translation.kha: Ka dei namar ki pop jong phi ba um shym ïohsngew ïa phi . Ka dei ki pop jong phi kiba pynïakhlad ïa phi na U Blei haba phi pyrshang ban mane ïa u .

translation.en: And the kings of the earth , and the great men , and the rich men , and the chief captains , and the mighty men , and every bondman , and every free man , hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains  ;
translation.kha: Te ki syiem jong ka pyrthei , ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah shipai , kiba riewspah bad kiba donbor , bad kiwei pat ki briew baroh , ki mraw ne kiba laitluid , ki la buhrieh ïa lade ha ki krem bad ha ki synrang maw ba-don ha ki lum .

translation.en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom , and of all the heathen , which are called by my name , saith the  Lord  that doeth this .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki briew ka Israel kin ïohknieh ïa kaei kaba dang sah jong ka ri Edom bad ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba shisien ki long ki jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  , u ban pynlong ïa kane ban jia .

translation.en: But he said , I am not mad , most noble Festus  ; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness .
translation.kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Ngam shym lamwir , ko Kynrad badonburom ! Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ka jingtipbriew .

translation.en: And David said unto him , Thy blood be upon thy head  ; for thy mouth hath testified against thee , saying , I have slain the  Lord s  anointed .
translation.kha: bad u Dabid u ong ha uta u nong Amalek ,  Me la wallam ïa kane halor lade . Me la pynrem ïa lade haba me phla ba me la pynïap ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la jied ban long syiem .

translation.en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities , and in Jerusalem , saying , Go forth unto the mount , and fetch olive branches , and pine branches , and myrtle branches , and palm branches , and branches of thick trees , to make booths , as it is written .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ai ïa kine ki jingbthah bad ki phah ïa ki sha baroh ha Jerusalem bad kiwei pat ki nongbah bad ki shnong :  Khie leit sha ki lum bad pom ïa ki tnat na ki dieng Kseh , ki dieng Olib , ki dieng Martl , ki dieng Tlai bad kiwei ki dieng , ban shna ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Follow me  ; and let the dead bury their dead .
translation.kha: Bud ïa nga ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad ai kiba ïap kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki .

translation.en: And I , behold , I have given with him Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan : and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded thee  ;
translation.kha: Nga la jied ruh ïa u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ban ïatrei lem bad u . Nga la ai ruh ïa ka jinglah kaba bakhraw ha kiwei pat ki misteri kiba tbit , khnang ba ki lah ban shna ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ba dei ban shna :

translation.en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt , saying , Let us alone , that we may serve the Egyptians ? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians , than that we should die in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Hato ngim shym la ong lypa ha phi shuwa ba ngin mih ba kane kan sa jia ? Ngi la ong ïa phi ban ym pynsalia ïa ngi bad ban shah ïa ngi ban ïailong ki mraw jong ki nong Ijipt . Kan jin da la kham bha ban long ki mraw hangta ban ïa kaba ïap hangne ha ri shyiap .

translation.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren , in the service of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: La ai ha ki ka jingkitkhlieh ban sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ïa ka Templ , bad ban ïarap ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron , ha ka jingmane ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants , Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?
translation.kha: Ngim lah ban shem u briew uba kham bit ban ïa u Joseph , u briew uba don U Mynsiem U Blei .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . To ong ha u kumno ba ma u bad baroh kiba ha ka ri Ijipt kin shah pynshitom .

translation.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen , that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard : but the husbandmen beat him , and sent him away empty .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang na ki ïa la ka bynta na ka jingkheit soh . Hynrei , ki nongshimwai ki shoh ïa uta u mraw bad ki la phah noh thylli ïa u .

translation.en: How was the journey yesterday ?
translation.kha: Kumno ka Jingiaid lynti jong phi mynnin ?

translation.en: Then said the high priest , Are these things so ?
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa u Stephan ,  Hato kane ka dei kaba shisha ?

translation.en: And when they came to the camp of Israel , the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites , so that they fled before them : but they went forward smiting the Moabites , even in their country .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la poi ha ka jaka shong dara , ki Israel ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki bad ki la beh krad ïa ki . Ki Israel ki la ïai beh kthong , da kaba pynïap ïa ki Moab

translation.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing , and obtaineth favour of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba shem ïa ka tnga , phi shem ïa kaei kaba bha ; ka pynpaw ba U  Trai  u lehbha ïa phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall establish thee an holy people unto himself , as he hath sworn unto thee , if thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , and walk in his ways .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad leh kat ïa kaba u hukum , un pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumba u la kular .

translation.en: They were amazed , they answered no more : they left off speaking .
translation.kha: Ko Job , kim don kyntien ïa phi ; kim don jubab ban ai ha phi .

translation.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the  Lord  : though hand join in hand , he shall not be unpunished .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa baroh kiba leh meng ; da lei lei un ym shah ba kin lait na ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , ka Ïingjaiñ jong ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynpur itynnat ha ki ïa ka dur ki kherub .

translation.en: “Satan” means an enemy or an opposer .
translation.kha: “Soitan” ka mut u nongshun ne u nongïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the  Lord  : and the bullock shall be killed before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong uta u paidlang kin buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad kin pynïap ïa u hangta .

translation.en: Whose mouths must be stopped , who subvert whole houses , teaching things which they ought not , for filthy lucre s sake .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba donkam ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingïathuh jong ki , namar ki pynkylla khongpong ïa ki longïing baroh da kaba hikai ïa kaei kaba kim dei ban hikai , bad baroh ka long ïa ka jingthmu basngewlehrain ban thaw pisa .

translation.en: And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them  ; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them :
translation.kha: U Angel jong U Blei uba la ju don ha khmat jong ki paid Israel u la kynriah bad u la leit shadien . U rishot lyoh ruh u kynriah noh tad haduh ba u la don hapdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Israel .

translation.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also : and the younger arose , and lay with him  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pyndih buaid ïa la u kpa ha kata ka miet ruh , bad kata ka khun kaba ar ka leit ïathiah shongkha bad u . Ha kane ka kynti ruh u la buaid shaba palat kat haduh ba um tip ei ei shaphang kata .

translation.en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate : for many , I say unto you , will seek to enter in , and shall not be able .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Leh ïa kaba bha tam ban rung lyngba ka khyrdop kaba khim ; namar bun ki briew da kaba thikna kin pyrshang ban phrung lyngba jong ka hynrei kin ym lah .

translation.en: And ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God , ye , and your sons , and your daughters , and your menservants , and your maidservants , and the Levite that is within your gates  ; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you .
translation.kha: Shadkmen ha khmat jong u hangta , lem bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi ; to kynmaw ba ki Lebi kim don bri don khyndew la ka jong .

translation.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule  ; he marketh it out with a line  ; he fitteth it with planes , and he marketh it out with the compass , and maketh it after the figure of a man , according to the beauty of a man  ; that it may remain in the house .
translation.kha: U misteri u thew ïa ka dieng , u buh dak ïa ka dur da u mawthoh , u ohdur ïa ka da ki tiar jong u , bad u pynlong ïa ka ha ka dur u briew , ka durbriew ba-itynnat , ban buh ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold , there were twins in her womb .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan kha , bad ka la ïoh ar ngut ki khun synrap shynrang .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , That ye shall weep and lament , but the world shall rejoice : and ye shall be sorrowful , but your sorrow shall be turned into joy .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin ïam bad phin ïamkthang , hynrei , ka pyrthei kan shadkmen ; phin ïasngewsih , hynrei ka jingsngewsih jong phi kan kylla sha ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked .
translation.kha: Men shu peit bad men ïohi kumno ki bymman ki shah pynshitom .

translation.en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation , which I cast out before you : for they committed all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .
translation.kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong ki briew kiba shong hangta ; ngan beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew ki bymngeit Blei ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka ri . Nga isih eh ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki baroh .

translation.en: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam , that is beside Zarethan : and those that came down toward the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , failed , and were cut off : and the people passed over right against Jericho .
translation.kha: ka um ka sangeh ban tuid bad ka lang shi jaka , kham jngai na kaba wan tuid ha Adam , ka nongbah hajan ka Sarethan . Ïa ka jingtuid jong ka arsut sha ka Duriaw Baïap la pyndkut , bad u paidbah u la lah ban jam sha shiliang hajan ka Jerikho .

translation.en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow , my heart is faint in me .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewsih jong nga ym lah ban pynkhiah ; nga pang ha ka dohnud .

translation.en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days . And so it was , that in the seventh day the battle was joined : and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day .
translation.kha: Haduh hynñiew sngi ki Syria bad ki Israel ki shong ha la ki jaka sher dara marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ki sdang ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki Israel ki pynïap da ki spah hajar ki Syria .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  the King of Israel , and his redeemer the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am the first , and I am the last  ; and beside me there is no God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  uba synshar bad uba ïada ïa ki Israel , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , u don ïa kane ban ong :  Nga long uba nyngkong , uba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blei ; ym don uwei pat U Blei hynrei tang ma nga .

translation.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïathuh ha u shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh , u la khot ar ngut na ki

translation.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature , and in favour with God and man .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la nang san ha ka met bad ha ka jingstad , da kaba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha bad U Blei lem bad ki briew .

translation.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates , and for the joinings  ; and brass in abundance without weight  ;
translation.kha: U pynbiang shibun ka nar ban shna preg bad ki nar ban pyndait ïa ki khyrdop dieng , bad shibun ka rnong haduh ba ym don ba lah ban thew ïa ka .

translation.en: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba dei ban don hapoh ka Hima yn bret noh sha ka jingdum , ha kaba kin lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .

translation.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out , and thou shalt break the sherds thereof , and pluck off thine own breasts : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Phan dih bad phan pynrngad tyrkhong ïa ka , bad da ki lyngkhot ba la pait jong ka phan tar ïa ka shadem jong pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks , he marketh all my paths .
translation.kha: U pyndait kynjri ha ki kjat jong nga ; u peit-thuh ïa ka jingïaid jong nga .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , Not so , my father : for this is the firstborn  ; put thy right hand upon his head .
translation.kha: U ong ha la u kpa ,  Pa , ym dei kumto . Une uba nyngkong ; buh ïa ka kti kamon jong phi ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: And David spake unto the  Lord  when he saw the angel that smote the people , and said , Lo , I have sinned , and I have done wickedly : but these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , be against me , and against my father s house .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa u angel uba u pynïap ïa ki briew , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Dei ma nga uba la leh pop . Nga dei uta uba la leh bakla . Kine ki briew bapli ki la leh aïu ? Me dei ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch , whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon : he went and said thus unto him  ; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon : bring me in before the king , and I will shew unto the king the interpretation .
translation.kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , ïa uba u syiem u la lah hukum ban pynïap ïa ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem . U la ong ha u ,  Wat pynïap ïa ki . Ïalam ïa nga sha u syiem , bad ngan ïathuh ha u aïu ka jingphohsniew jong u ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: Yea , if thou criest after knowledge , and liftest up thy voice for understanding  ;
translation.kha: ho-oid , kyrpad ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , bad kyrpad jur ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Speak , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , Pharaoh king of Egypt , the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers , which hath said , My river is mine own , and I have made it for myself .
translation.kha: To ong ba kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ïathuh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt : Nga long u nongshun jong me , ma me u kuratia bakynsha , uba dem ha ka wah . Me ong ba ka wah Nile ka long ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka .

translation.en: Either three years  famine  ; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes , while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee  ; or else three days the sword of the  Lord  , even the pestilence , in the land , and the angel of the  Lord  destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel . Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me .
translation.kha: Lai snem ka jingkyrduh bam ? Lane , lai bnai kaba phet krad na ki nongshun jong me ? Lane lai sngi ha kaba U  Trai  u tur ïaleh ïa me da ka waitlam bad phah ka jingïapthem halor ka ri jong me , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u angel jong u ban wallam ka jingïap ha kylleng ka Israel ? Kaei ka jubab ba ngan ai ha U  Trai  ?

translation.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid um shym leit rah shuh ïa ka sha Jerusalem . Pynban , u ieh ïa ka ha ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Obed Edom , u traishnong ka nongbah Gath .

translation.en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy ; as it is written , For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles , and sing unto thy name .
translation.kha: bad ban pynlah wat ïa ki Jentil ban ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingisynei jong u . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Bad kumta ngin ïaroh ïa me hapdeng ki Jentil ; ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .

translation.en: And it came to pass the third day , which was Pharaoh s birthday , that he made a feast unto all his servants : and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants .
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi , ha ka lyngkhuh sngi kha jong u , u syiem u pynlong ka jingkhawai ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ; u la pyllait noh ïa u nongrah khuri bad ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah jong u , bad u la wallam ïa ki ha khmat ki rangbah synshar jong u .

translation.en: And of Naphtali he said , O Naphtali , satisfied with favour , and full with the blessing of the  Lord  : possess thou the west and the south .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Naphtali u ong ,  U Naphtali u long uba la ïoh kyrhai ki jingkyrkhu da ka jingsngewbha U  Trai  ; Ka ri jong ki shaphang shathie ka kot haduh duriaw Galilaïa .

translation.en: And landing at Syracuse , we tarried there three days .
translation.kha: Ka lynti jong ka jingpynim U Blei

translation.en: But they refused to hearken , and pulled away the shoulder , and stopped their ears , that they should not hear .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki kyntait da ka jingmynthi ban pynshahshkor ïa nga . Ki khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki

translation.en: Men groan from out of the city , and the soul of the wounded crieth out : yet God layeth not folly to them .
translation.kha: Ha ki nongbah , kiba mynsaw bad kiba la jan ïap ki lynñiar , hynrei U Blei um patiaw ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: And when the seventh month was come , and the children of Israel were in the cities , the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba la dap hynñiew bnai , ki Israel ki la ïashongduh ha la ki shnong jong ki . Nangta baroh ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ,

translation.en: But Jesus said ,  Suffer little children , and forbid them not , to come unto me : for of such is the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ba kin wan sha nga bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima ki bneng ka long ïa kiba kum kine .

translation.en: And his concubine , whose name was Reumah , she bare also Tebah , and Gaham , and Thahash , and Maachah .
translation.kha: Ka Reuma , ka tnga kliar jong u Nahor , ka la kha ïa u Tebah , u Gaham , u Tahash , bad u Maakah .

translation.en: Your gold and silver is cankered  ; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you , and shall eat your flesh as it were fire . Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days .
translation.kha: Ka ksiar bad ka rupa jong phi ka la bam sarang , bad kane ka sarang kan long ka sakhi pyrshah ïa phi bad kan sa bam duh ïa ka doh jong phi kum ka ding . Phi la kynshew spah ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh .

translation.en: And when they forgat the  Lord  their God , he sold them into the hand of Sisera , captain of the host of Hazor , and into the hand of the Philistines , and into the hand of the king of Moab , and they fought against them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la klet noh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , bad kumta u la shah ïa ki Philistia bad ïa u syiem Moab bad ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ka kynhun shipai ka nongbah Hasor , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ban jop ïa ki .

translation.en: For he clave to the  Lord  , and departed not from following him , but kept his commandments , which the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U long uba ïaineh ha U  Trai  bad um ju leh bymkohnguh ïa u , hynrei u husiar ban bat ïa ki hukum kiba U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses .

translation.en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom , that she defiled the land , and committed adultery with stones and with stocks .
translation.kha: bad kam shym lehrain satia . Ka la pyntngit ïa ka ri , bad ka la leh awria da kaba mane ïa ki maw bad ki dieng .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come near to enter into Egypt , that he said unto Sarai his wife , Behold now , I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon :
translation.kha: Hamar ba un sa rung ha ri Ijipt , u ong ha ka Sarai ka tnga jong u ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba bhabriew .

translation.en: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll : and he took it out of Elishama the scribe s chamber . And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king , and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king .
translation.kha: Te u syiem u la phah ïa u Jehudi ban leit shim ïa ka kot kli . U la leit shim na ka kamra u Elishama bad u la pule ïa ka ha u syiem bad ha baroh ki rangbah synshar kiba ïeng sawdong jong u .

translation.en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah , that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga la ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ym shym la aiti ïa nga ha ki briew bad shah pynïap .

translation.en: Certain men , the children of Belial , are gone out from among you , and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city , saying , Let us go and serve other gods , which ye have not known  ;
translation.kha: ba don ki riewbymman napdeng jong phi kiba la ïalam bakla ïa la ki para shnong para thaw ban mane ïa ki blei kiba phim ju mane mynno mynno .

translation.en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day : and there escaped not a man of them , save four hundred young men , which rode upon camels , and fled .
translation.kha: Ka tang shu kynjat shai ha kawei pat ka sngi u Dabid u tur pyrshah bad u ïaleh ïa ki haduh janmiet . Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lait im lait noh tang sawspah ngut ki samla shynrang kiba kiew ha ki ut bad kiba phet ïap .

translation.en: So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Dorbar ka la maham ïa ki kham tyngeh bad nangta la pyllait noh ïa ki . Ki la ïohi ba ka long ka bym lah long ban pynshitom ïa ki , namar ki paidbah baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kaei kaba la jia .

translation.en: And what nation is there so great , that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law , which I set before you this day ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khraw katno katno , kaba don ki aiñ kiba hok kat kito kiba nga la hikai ïa phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And he took all the gold and the silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed–edom , and the treasures of the king s house , the hostages also , and returned to Samaria .
translation.kha: U la rah pat sha Samaria kum ka mar lute ïa baroh ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba ha ka Templ , ki tiar ki tar ka Templ ïa kiba la ap phira da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Obed Edom , bad ïa ki jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem . U la ïalam ruh ïa ki koidi lem bad u .

translation.en: And if some of the branches be broken off , and thou , being a wild olive tree , wert grafted in among them , and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne na ki tnat jong u dieng Olib ba la thung , la pynkheiñ noh , bad ba ïa u tnat jong u dieng Olib khlaw la pynïasoh bad u . Ma phi ki Jentil phi long kum ki dieng Olib khlaw , bad mynta phi ïadon bynta ha ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem bakhlaiñ jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day  ; and he took the city , and slew the people that was therein , and beat down the city , and sowed it with salt .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka la neh baroh shi sngi . U Abimelekh u kurup ïa ka nongbah , u pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka , u pynkhyllem ïa ka , bad u tap ïa ka madan da ka mluh .

translation.en: O God , thou hast taught me from my youth : and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works .
translation.kha: Me la hikai ïa nga naduh ba nga dang samla , bad nga dang ïai ïathuh ïa ki kam kiba phylla jong me .

translation.en: Then said Absalom , If not , I pray thee , let my brother Amnon go with us . And the king said unto him , Why should he go with thee ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ong ,  Lada kumta te , phin shah mo la kumno kumno ïa u Amnon , u para jong nga ban wan ?   Balei un leit ?  u syiem u kylli .

translation.en: Then said Saul , I have sinned : return , my son David : for I will no more do thee harm , because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day : behold , I have played the fool , and have erred exceedingly .
translation.kha: U Saul u jubab ,  Nga la leh bakla ; wan phai pat ko Dabid , u khun jong nga . Namar ba phi la kheiñ kor ïa ka jingim jong nga ha kane ka miet , lano lano ngan ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa phi . Nga la leh bieit shisha , bad nga la bakla palat .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar s , and unto God the things which be God s .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ,  Da kumta , te , siew sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Blei .

translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on , and prospereth in their hands .
translation.kha: Ko syiem , phi dei ban tip ba ngi la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judah bad shem ba ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bakhraw la dang shna biang da ki maw baheh bad da ki bim dieng ba la pyndait ha ka kynroh . Ïa ka kam la pyntrei ha ka rukom kaba biang bha bad ka dang ïaid shaphrang .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the ways of David his father , and declined neither to the right hand , nor to the left .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  ; u bud ïa ka nuksa u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , da kaba bud thik ïa ki hukum U Blei baroh .

translation.en: Then said God , Call his name Lo–ammi : for ye are not my people , and I will not be your God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , ‘ u Lo-ammi ,’ namar ki briew ka Israel kim dei ki briew jong nga , bad ngam long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Baalah , and Iim , and Ezem ,
translation.kha: ka Baalah , ka Iim , ka Esem ,

translation.en: And when he was in affliction , he besought the  Lord  his God , and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers ,
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshitom jong u , u la pynrit ïa lade , u phai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong u , bad u kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong u .

translation.en: For ye were sometimes darkness , but now are ye light in the Lord : walk as children of light :
translation.kha: Phi hi phi la ju long mynno mynno ha ka jingdum , hynrei namar phi la long ki briew jong U Trai , phi long ha ka jingshai . Kumta phi dei ban im kum ki briew kiba don ha ka jingshai ,

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  saith , Because the daughters of Zion are haughty , and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes , walking and mincing as they go , and making a tinkling with their feet :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha khmih haduh katno ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ki long kiba sarong ! Ki ïaid da kaba pynhieng ïa la ki khmut . Ki ju long borabor kiba kynshleiñ . Ki shim ki sien jam kiba rit itynnat bad ki jingdeng ha ki matsohlah ki sawa .

translation.en: And the child grew , and she brought him unto Pharaoh s daughter , and he became her son . And she called his name Moses : and she said , Because I drew him out of the water .
translation.kha: Ynda uta u khunlung u la san , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha ka khun u Pharaoh ; ka ruh ka ri ïa u kum la u khun , bad ka khot kyrteng ïa u , u Moses ,  Namar ,  ka ong ,  nga la sei ïa u na ka um .

translation.en: The  Lord  by wisdom hath founded the earth  ; by understanding hath he established the heavens .
translation.kha: U Trai u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei da ka jingstad jong u ; da ka jingshemphang jong u , u la buh beit ïa ka sahit bneng ha la ka jaka .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That in this place is one greater than the temple .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba ka don kaei kaei hangne kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: But if any man hate his neighbour , and lie in wait for him , and rise up against him , and smite him mortally that he die , and fleeth into one of these cities :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u briew u shun ïa la u paramarjan bad u apthap ïa u , bad u shoh bad pynmynsaw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap , bad nangta u phet sha kawei na kita ki shnong ban ïoh jingïada ,

translation.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .
translation.kha: Kan ym tip ba dei ma nga uba la ai ïa ka u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , bad baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head , or in his bald forehead , as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh  ;
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban khmih bha ïa u , bad lada ka don shisha ka prum kaba byrsaw-lieh ,

translation.en: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day . So the  Lord  turned from the fierceness of his anger . Wherefore the name of that place was called , The valley of Achor , unto this day .
translation.kha: Ki pynïeng ruh halor jong u ïa ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang don haduh mynta . Dei namar kata ba ïa kata jaka la dang ïai khot ka Them Jingjynjar . Da kumta U  Trai  um shym da bitar shla shuh .

translation.en: After Armageddon , earth will be made into a paradise
translation.kha: Hadien ka Armagedon , yn sa pynlong ïa ka pyrthei ka Paradais

translation.en: And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink , did not ye eat for yourselves , and drink for yourselves ?
translation.kha: Bad haba ki la bam bad dih , ka long na ka bynta ka jingpynhun ïa ki hi .

translation.en: But they cried out , Away with him , away with him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Shall I crucify your King ? The chief priests answered , We have no king but Caesar .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta biang ,  To pynïap noh ïa u ! Pynïap noh ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !  U Pilat u la kylli ïa ki ,  Phi kwah ïa nga ba ngan sahnarphna ïa u syiem jong phi ?  Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la jubab ,  U syiem uba ngi don u dei tang u Patsha !

translation.en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner , whose house is by the sea side : he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do .
translation.kha: Une u sah shipor ha ka ïing u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon , uba shong basah harud duriaw .

translation.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .
translation.kha: Ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ki la ïakynduh lang ban pyrkhat ïa kane ka jingkylli .

translation.en: And they told him , that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by .
translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Nasareth u dang ïaid nangne ,  ki la ïathuh ïa u .

translation.en: When he saw Jesus , he cried out , and fell down before him , and with a loud voice said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God most high ? I beseech thee , torment me not .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu , u la kyang jam , u la pyndem ïa lade ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu , U Khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh ! Me kwah aïu bad nga ? Nga kyrpad ïa me , wat pynshitom ïa nga !

translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and weakeneth the strength of the mighty .
translation.kha: U pynjahburom ïa kito kiba don ha ka bor bad pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki nongsynshar .

translation.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him , and given him a name which is above every name :
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw U Blei u la kyntiew eh ïa u sha ka jaka kaba hajrong tam eh , bad ai ha u ïa ka kyrteng kaba kham khraw ban ïa kano kano kawei pat ka kyrteng .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when she pressed him daily with her words , and urged him , so that his soul was vexed unto death  ;
translation.kha: Ka ïai kylli ïa u kawei ka sngi hadien kawei pat . U da ngiah hi shoiñ bad thait ïa ka jingthlia jong ka ïa u shaphang kata .

translation.en: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy  ; and he put us therein .
translation.kha: Hangta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la shem ïa ka lieng na Aleksandria kaba thmu ban leit sha Italy , kumta u la kyntiew ïa ngi ha ka .

translation.en: In the cities of the mountains , in the cities of the vale , and in the cities of the south , and in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ki shnong jong ka ri lum , ha ki kjat lum , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang shathie , ha ka ri ki Benjamin , ha ki shnongrit sawdong ka Jerusalem bad ha ki shnong ka Judah , ki nongaplangbrot sa shisien kin ñiew biang ïa la ki langbrot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness , through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue :
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Blei ka la ai ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi donkam ban im ïa ka jingim riewblei bashisha da ka jingtip jong ngi ïa uta uba la khot ïa ngi ban ïadon bynta ha ka burom bad ka jingbha jong u hi .

translation.en: Yet if thou warn the wicked , and he turn not from his wickedness , nor from his wicked way , he shall die in his iniquity  ; but thou hast delivered thy soul .
translation.kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew basniew , bad um shym sangeh na kaba leh pop , un ïap hi kum u nongpop , hynrei ïa ka jingim jong me yn pyllait .

translation.en: The elders have ceased from the gate , the young men from their musick .
translation.kha: Ki tymmen kim shong shuh ha ka khyrdop nongbah , bad ki samla kim tem jingtem shuh .

translation.en: And some fell among thorns , and the thorns grew up , and choked it , and it yielded no fruit .
translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai u la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , kiba mih bad kiba la kjap noh ïa ki jingthung , bad kim shym la pynmih kew ei ei .

translation.en: And he that sat upon the throne said , Behold , I make all things new . And he said unto me , Write : for these words are true and faithful .
translation.kha: Nangta uta uba shong ha ka khet u la ong ,  Bad mynta nga thaw thymmai ïa kiei kiei baroh !  U la ong ruh ïa nga ,  Thoh ïa kane , namar kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you  ; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la lah ong ha u Moses ,  U Pharaoh un ïai kyntait ban shahshkor ïa phi khnang ba nga lah ban leh kham bun ki kambah jong nga ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded , saying ,
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki paid Israel baroh ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum :

translation.en: And it came to pass , that after three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , both hearing them , and asking them questions .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , ki la shem ïa u hapoh ka Templ , u da shong bad ki nonghikai jong ki Jiw , da kaba shahshkor ïa ki bad kylli jingkylli .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me , and hath hired me , and I am his priest .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Nga don ka jingïakut bad u Mikah , u da siewdor ïa nga ba ngan shakri kum u lyngdoh jong u .

translation.en: And when we departed from Horeb , we went through all that great and terrible wilderness , which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites , as the  Lord  our God commanded us  ; and we came to Kadesh–barnea .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi . Ngi mih na u Lum Sinai bad ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap kaba ïar bad ba-ima sha ka ri lum Amor . Ynda ngi poi ha Kadesh Barnea ,

translation.en: At my first answer no man stood with me , but all men forsook me : I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge .
translation.kha: Ym don ba kyrshan ïa nga haba nga ïasaid da ïa lade nyngkong eh ha khmat ki bor synshar ; baroh ki la iehnoh ïa nga . Nga duwai ba U Blei un ym thew pyrshah ïa ki !

translation.en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the  Lord  , and said , If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands ,
translation.kha: U Jephthah u kular ha U  Trai  :  Lada me ai ha nga ka jingjop pyrshah ïa ki Ammon ,

translation.en: But for us also , to whom it shall be imputed , if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead ;
translation.kha: La thoh ïa ki na ka bynta jong ngi ruh ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok , kiba ngeit ha uta uba la pynmih na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And set two men , sons of Belial , before him , to bear witness against him , saying , Thou didst blaspheme God and the king . And then carry him out , and stone him , that he may die .
translation.kha: Pynshong ar ngut ki riewrunar ban mudui pyrshah ïa u , ba u la tim ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem jong u . Nangta sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: So those servants went out into the highways , and gathered together all as many as they found , both bad and good : and the wedding was furnished with guests .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la ïaleit sha ki lynti bah bad ki la ïalumlang ïa ki briew baroh kiba ki lah ban ïashem , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh , bad ïa ka kamra khawai shongkurim la pyndap da ki briew .

translation.en: And he said unto the men of Succoth , Give , I pray you , loaves of bread unto the people that follow me  ; for they be faint , and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna , kings of Midian .
translation.kha: Haba ki poi ha Sukkoth , u ong ha ki rangbah jong kata ka nongrit ,  Sngewbha ai ïa ki rangbah jong nga katto katne ki kpu . Ki la thait ïan , bad nga dang beh ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki syiem Midian .

translation.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phai la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :

translation.en: And said unto them that sold doves ,  Take these things hence  ; make not my Father s house an house of merchandise .
translation.kha: bad u la hukum ïa kito kiba ïadie paro ,  Rah noh ïa ki nangne ! Wat pynlong jaka ïew ïa ka ïing U Kpa jong nga !

translation.en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem , unto Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount of Olives , he sendeth forth two of his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la jan poi ha Jerusalem , hajan ki shnong Bethphage bad Bethania , ki la wan sha u lum ki Olib . U Jisu u la nang phah ar ngut na ki synran ha shuwa jong u bad kine ki jingbthah :

translation.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers , and to remember his holy covenant  ;
translation.kha: U la ong ba un pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad kynmaw ïa ka jutang bakyntang jong u .

translation.en: Then said the Jews , Behold how he loved him !
translation.kha: Khmih katno ba u la ieit ïa u !  ki briew ki la ong .

translation.en: And Gilead s wife bare him sons  ; and his wife s sons grew up , and they thrust out Jephthah , and said unto him , Thou shalt not inherit in our father s house  ; for thou art the son of a strange woman .
translation.kha: u don la ki khun shynrang ; bad kine ynda ki la san ki beh noh ïa u Jephthah na ïing . Ki ong ha u ,  Men ym ïoh bynta ei ei ha ïing i pa jong ngi , naba me dei u khun na kawei pat ka briew .

translation.en: And one went in , and told his lord , saying , Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Naaman u ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u syiem bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba ka khynnah ka la ong .

translation.en: I said , Days should speak , and multitude of years should teach wisdom .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha lade ba nga dei ban kren , ba ma phi kiba la kham rangbah phi dei ban ïasam lem ïa la ka jingstad .

translation.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease , her feast days , her new moons , and her sabbaths , and all her solemn feasts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkut noh ïa baroh ki kam sngewbha jong ka — ki jingkhawai ba man ka snem bad man u bnai bad ki jingrakhe ïa ka Sabbaton — bad ïa ki jinglehniam jong ka baroh .

translation.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood  ; and without shedding of blood is no remission .
translation.kha: Da shisha , kat kum ka Hukum , la jan baroh kiei kiei la pynkhuid da ka snam , bad ïa ki pop la map noh tang lada la theh ïa ka snam .

translation.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats , and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean , sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh :
translation.kha: Ka snam jong ki blang bad ki masi kyrtong bad u dpei jong u masi lud la synreit halor ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , bad kane ka pynkhuid ïa ki da kaba weng noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid katba kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: Boast not against the branches . But if thou boast , thou bearest not the root , but the root thee .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phim dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa kito kiba la pynkheiñ noh kum ki tnat . Kumno phi lah ban sngewsarong ? Phi long tang ka tnat ; phim kyrshan ïa ki thied — ki thied ki kyrshan ïa phi .

translation.en: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh , and reckoneth with them .
translation.kha: Hadien ka por kaba jlan u kynrad jong kito ki shakri u la wan pat bad u la pan jingkheiñ na ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  on high is mightier than the noise of many waters , yea , than the mighty waves of the sea .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u synshar hakhlieh eh ha bneng , kham khraw ban ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw-bah , kham donbor ban ïa ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .

translation.en: Ye shall know them by their fruits . Do men gather grapes of thorns , or figs of thistles ?
translation.kha: Phin ithuh ïa ki da kaei kaba ki leh . Ki bniap shiah kim ju pynmih ki sohwaiñ , bad ki shiah buid kim ju pynmih ki soh Dumbur .

translation.en: And he turned himself about from them , and wept  ; and returned to them again , and communed with them , and took from them Simeon , and bound him before their eyes .
translation.kha: U Joseph u iehnoh ïa ki bad u sdang ban ïam . Haba u la lah ban kren biang , u la wan pat , u shim ïa u Simeon bad u phah teh ïa u ha khmat jong ki .

translation.en: Forsake the foolish , and live  ; and go in the way of understanding .
translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa ka kynhun ki briew kiba bieit , bad men ïoh im . Ïaid ruh ha ka lynti ka jingtip .

translation.en: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day : for there shall be no night there .
translation.kha: Ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah kin plie baroh shi sngi ; yn ym khang ïa ki da lei lei , namar yn ym don ka miet hangta .

translation.en: By the blast of God they perish , and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .
translation.kha: Kum ka  erïong , U Blei u pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .

translation.en: My father made me swear , saying , Lo , I die : in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan , there shalt thou bury me . Now therefore let me go up , I pray thee , and bury my father , and I will come again .
translation.kha: ‘ Shuwa ba i pa in ïap , i la pynsmai ïa nga ba ngan leit tep ïa i ha ka jingtep ba i la pynkhreh ha Kanaan . Kumta shah ba ngan leit tep ïa i pa , bad hadien kata ngan sa wan phai pat .’

translation.en: And now , behold , the  Lord  hath kept me alive , as he said , these forty and five years , even since the  Lord  spake this word unto Moses , while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness : and now , lo , I am this day fourscore and five years old .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha khmih , ka la long sawphew san snem naduh ba U  Trai  u la ong ïa kata ha u Moses . Kata ka la long mynba ki Israel ki dang ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , bad U  Trai  , kumba u la kular , u la ri pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: I do not frustrate the grace of God : for if righteousness come by the law , then Christ is dead in vain .
translation.kha: Ngam treh ban kyntait ïa ka jingaiei U Blei . Hynrei lada la pynksan ïa u briew ha U Blei da ka Hukum , ka mut ba U Khrist u la ïap lehnoh-ei!

translation.en: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur  ; and a third part at the gate behind the guard : so shall ye keep the watch of the house , that it be not broken down .
translation.kha: sa shi bynta na ka lai bynta kin ïeng ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Sur , bad kiba sah shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi kin ïeng ap phira ha ka khyrdop ha lyndet jong kiwei ki nongap phira .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall return his blood upon his own head , who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he , and slew them with the sword , my father David not knowing thereof , to wit , Abner the son of Ner , captain of the host of Israel , and Amasa the son of Jether , captain of the host of Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa u Joab na ka bynta kito ki jingpynïap , kiba u la leh khlem ka jingtip u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U Joab u la pynïap ar ngut ki rangbah balui lui kiba kham bha ban ïa u — u Abner , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Israel , bad u Amasa , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Judah .

translation.en: And God looked upon the earth , and , behold , it was corrupt  ; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u la khmih ïa ka pyrthei bad u la ïohi ba ka la sniew , namar ki briew baroh ki la im ka jingim kaba sniew .

translation.en: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa , who labour in the Lord . Salute the beloved Persis , which laboured much in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa ka Truphina bad ka Truphosa , kiba trei ha ka kam U Trai bad ïa ka paralok ba-ieit jong nga , ka Persis , kaba la trei shibun ka kam na ka bynta U Trai .

translation.en: All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .
translation.kha: Ngi ïoh ban im ka jingim jong ngi ha ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih kthang , ngi khuslai , bitar bad ïohpang .

translation.en: Behold , therefore I will gather all thy lovers , with whom thou hast taken pleasure , and all them that thou hast loved , with all them that thou hast hated  ; I will even gather them round about against thee , and will discover thy nakedness unto them , that they may see all thy nakedness .
translation.kha: Namar kane ngan wallam lang ïa baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong pha kiba mynshuwa — kito kiba pha la sngewtynnat bad kito kiba pha la isih . Ngan wallam ïa ki sawdong jong pha ha ka jylli , bad nangta ngan law ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad shah ïa ki ban ïohi ba pha lyngkhuit .

translation.en: And I heard the angel of the waters say , Thou art righteous , O Lord , which art , and wast , and shalt be , because thou hast judged thus .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa u angel uba dei khmih ïa ki um ba u ong ,  Ki jingbishar kiba me la pynlong ki long kiba hok , A Uba Khuid , me uba long bad uba la long !

translation.en: So we laboured in the work : and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared .
translation.kha: Kumta , man ka sngi , naduh dang step phyrngab haduh ka por ba la mih ki khlur mynmiet , shiteng na ngi , ngi trei ha ka kynroh , katba shiteng kiwei pat , ki ïeng ap phira bad ki sum .

translation.en: And the man came into the house : and he ungirded his camels , and gave straw and provender for the camels , and water to wash his feet , and the men s feet that were with him .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u briew u leit rung sha kata ka ïing , bad u Laban u pynhiar ïa ki jingkit na kita ki ut bad u la ai phlangïap bad jingbam ïa ki . Nangta u la wanrah um ïa u shakri jong u Abraham bad ïa ki nongbud jong u ba kin sait ïa la ki kjat .

translation.en: And God said unto Balaam , Thou shalt not go with them  ; thou shalt not curse the people : for they are blessed .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Balaam ,  Wat leit bad ki , bad wat buh ka jingtim halor ki paid Israel , namar ki don ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga .

translation.en: The sons of Leah  ; Reuben , Jacob s firstborn , and Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Zebulun :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Leah ki long u Reuben ( u khun nyngkong u Jakob ) , u Simeon , u Lebi , u Judah , u Issakhar , bad u Sebulun .

translation.en: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries , and to be cooks , and to be bakers .
translation.kha: Ki khun kynthei jong phi kin hap shna ki jingiwbih ïa u , bad trei kum ki nongshet jingshet bad ki nongshet kpu jong u .

translation.en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep .
translation.kha: bad u Dabid , uba don ha ka ri khlaw , u ïohsngew shaphang kane ,

translation.en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite , to receive his pledge from the woman s hand : but he found her not .
translation.kha: U Judah u la phah ïa u Hirah u paralok jong u , ban leit lam ïa ka blang , bad ban shim noh na ka kynthei ïa ki tiar kiba u la kular , hynrei u Hirah um shym lap ïa ka .

translation.en: And as the king passed by , he cried unto the king : and he said , Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle  ; and , behold , a man turned aside , and brought a man unto me , and said , Keep this man : if by any means he be missing , then shall thy life be for his life , or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver .
translation.kha: Katba u syiem u dang ïaid , u nongïathuhlypa u khot ïa u bad ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , katba nga dang ïaleh thma , u shipai u wallam sha nga ïa u nongshun ba shah kem bad u ong , ‘ Ap bha ïa une u briew ; lada u lait phet , phin hap ban siew da la ka jong ka jingim lane phin hap siew kuna lai hajar ki sbai rupa .’

translation.en: And say thou unto the people , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow , and ye shall eat flesh : for ye have wept in the ears of the  Lord  , saying , Who shall give us flesh to eat ? for it was well with us in Egypt : therefore the  Lord  will give you flesh , and ye shall eat .
translation.kha: Mynta ong ïa ki paidbah , ‘ Pynkhuid ïa lade na ka bynta lashai ; bad phin sa ïoh ka doh ban bam . U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ba phi ïakren khñium bad ong ba phi mutdur ba phi don khyndiat ka doh , bad ba phi kham ïoh bam bha ha Ijipt . Te mynta U  Trai  un ai ka doh ba phin bam , bad phi dei ban bam ïa ka .

translation.en: And when the king came in to see the guests , he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment :
translation.kha: U syiem u la leit rung shapoh ban khmih ïa kiba shah khot sngewbha bad u la ïohi ïa u briew uba khlem phong ki jaiñ shongkurim .

translation.en: If that nation , against whom I have pronounced , turn from their evil , I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them .
translation.kha: hynrei hadien , kata ka jaitbynriew ka phai noh na ka jingsniew jong ka , ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .

translation.en: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains , and fill the valleys with thy height .
translation.kha: Ngan tap ïa ki lumbah bad ïa ki them da ka metïap bapyut jong me .

translation.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: kiba ka kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ha ka jingshakri ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: Then men shall say , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  God of their fathers , which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt :
translation.kha: Bad ka jubab kan long , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u la pynlong bad ki mynba u wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt .

translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O destroying mountain , saith the  Lord  , which destroyest all the earth : and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and roll thee down from the rocks , and will make thee a burnt mountain .
translation.kha: Ko Babilonia pha long kum u lumbah uba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long u nongshun jong pha . Ngan shim noh ïa pha , pynmadan ïa pha ha ka khyndew , bad ieh ïa pha ha u dpei .

translation.en: Haran , and Canneh , and Eden , the merchants of Sheba , Asshur , and Chilmad , were thy merchants .
translation.kha: Ki nongbah ka Haran , Kanneh , bad Eden , ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba , ki nongbah ka Asshur bad Khilmad — baroh ki ïakhaïi pateng bad pha .

translation.en: He teacheth my hands to war  ; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms .
translation.kha: U hikai ïa nga ban ïaleh thma , ba kumta nga lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka ryntieh kaba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah , and Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the proud men , saying unto Jeremiah , Thou speakest falsely : the  Lord  our God hath not sent thee to say , Go not into Egypt to sojourn there :
translation.kha: Nangta u Asaraïah u khun jong u Hoshaïah bad u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah bad baroh kiwei ki rangbah ba leh meng ki la ong ïa nga ,  Phi shukor . U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi um shym la phah ïa phi ban ong ha ngi ba ngin ym leit bad shong ha Ijipt .

translation.en: That all men should honour the Son , even as they honour the Father . He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym burom ïa U Khun um burom ïa U Kpa uba la phah ïa u .

translation.en: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness , and hidden riches of secret places , that thou mayest know that I , the  Lord  , which call thee by thy name , am the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ïa me ki jingkynshew na ki jaka ba-dum , bakynjah ; te men tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad ba U Blei ki Israel u la khot ïa me da ka kyrteng .

translation.en: And their border was toward Jezreel , and Chesulloth , and Shunem ,
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Jesreel , ka Khesulloth , ka Shunem ,

translation.en: Remember the days of old , consider the years of many generations : ask thy father , and he will shew thee  ; thy elders , and they will tell thee .
translation.kha: Pyrkhat ïa ki sngi kiba mynbarim , ïa ka por ba la leit noh , kylli na la ki kpa ban ïathuh ha phi aïu ka la jia , kylli na ki tymmen ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka mynnor .

translation.en: I have fought a good fight , I have finished my course , I have kept the faith :
translation.kha: Nga la ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka jingïamareh , nga la pyndep ïa ka jingïaphet , nga la ri ïa ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Again , David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u Dabid u khot lang ïa ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel , kiba long baroh laiphew hajar ngut ,

translation.en: And the children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array before the gate of the city : and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki ïaid bad ki pynskhem ïa ki jaka jong ki ha ka khyrdop sha Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ka ri jong ki , bad ki syiem kiba la wan ban ïarap , ki apthap ha ki rudnong .

translation.en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim . Then said Abner unto him , Go , return . And he returned .
translation.kha: U Paltiel u leit bud ïa ka haduh ka nongrit Bahurim , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Hynrei u Abner u ong ,  Khie leit noh sha ïing ,  bad u leh kumta .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , that he slew all the house of Baasha : he left him not one that pisseth against a wall , neither of his kinsfolks , nor of his friends .
translation.kha: Mar ïalong syiem , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot na ka longïing u Baasha . Ïa uwei pa uwei u ba-ha-ïing bad uwei pa uwei u paralok la pynïap .

translation.en: The east wind carrieth him away , and he departeth : and as a storm hurleth him out of his place .
translation.kha: ka lyer mihngi kan sar ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki ;

translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it to dogs .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ban shim ïa ka jingbam jong ki khun bad bret ïa ka sha ki ksew .

translation.en: And the king said unto them , I have dreamed a dream , and my spirit was troubled to know the dream .
translation.kha: u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la khuslai shaphang ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh . Nga kwah ban tip kaei ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother , his mother said , I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the  Lord  from my hand for my son , to make a graven image and a molten image : now therefore I will restore it unto thee .
translation.kha: U pynphai pat ïa ka pisa sha la ka kmie , bad ka ong ,  Ban khang ïa ka jingtim ban hap ha u khun jong nga , nga hi da lade nga aiti da kaba kyntang ïa kane ka rupa sha U  Trai . Yn pyndonkam ïa ka ban shna ka durblei da ka dieng ba la suit da ka rupa . Te mynta ngan ai pat ïa ki sbai rupa sha phi

translation.en: Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,
translation.kha: Shahshkor ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  ngi ïaleit kiew sha Jerusalem , ha kaba yn aiti ïa U Khun U Briew ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum .

translation.en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb  ; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet .
translation.kha: Haba phi la kdang , phin hap kyntait wat ïa ka ngap ruh ; hynrei haba phi thngan , wat ka jingbam kaba kthang ruh ka thiang .

translation.en: And David was greatly distressed  ; for the people spake of stoning him , because the soul of all the people was grieved , every man for his sons and for his daughters : but David encouraged himself in the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Dabid u don mynta ha ka jingma kaba khraw , namar ki briew jong u kiba la sngewkthang haba ki la duh ïa la ki khun ki kti bad ki byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa u ; hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u ai ha u ka jingshlur .

translation.en: And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house ,
translation.kha: Ki la shim la ka bainong bad ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u nongaikam .

translation.en: Rejoice , and be exceeding glad : for great is your reward in heaven : for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you .
translation.kha: To kmen , to sngewkmen , namar ïa ka bainong bakhraw la buh na ka bynta jong phi ha ki bneng . Kane ka long da kumno la pynshitom beiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la im ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols , and from blood , and from things strangled , and from fornication : from which if ye keep yourselves , ye shall do well . Fare ye well .
translation.kha: Wat bam kano kano ka jingbam kaba la kñia ha ki bleithaw ; wat bam kano kano ka snam ; wat bam kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait ; bad sumar ïa lade na ka jingawria . Phin manbha lada phi sumar ban ym leh ïa kine kiei kiei . Da ka jingkhublei babha tam jong ngi .
