translation.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul : neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own  ; but they had all things common .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki riewngeit ka la long ha kawei ka jingmut bad kawei ka mynsiem . Ym don uba ong ba kano kano ka jingdon jong u ba ka long ka jong u hi , hynrei baroh ki la ïasam iwei ïa iwei pat ïa kaei kaei kaba ki la don .

translation.en: Consistent with the laws of genetics , we have inherited that imperfection and death . —Romans 5 :12 .
translation.kha: Namar ba ngi dei ki khun jong ki ngi la iohpateng ia kita ki jingbymjanai bad jingiap . —Nong Rom 5 :12 .

translation.en: Notwithstanding , that I be not further tedious unto thee , I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngam kwah ban shim shibun ïa ka por jong me , kumta nga kyrpad ïa me ban sngewbha ban shahshkor ïa ka jingïathuh lyngkot jong ngi .

translation.en: And his mouth was opened immediately , and his tongue loosed , and he spake , and praised God .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat u Sekharaïah u la lah pat ban kren , bad u la sdang ban ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Of the nations concerning which the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall not go in to them , neither shall they come in unto you : for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods : Solomon clave unto these in love .
translation.kha: U shongkurim ïa ki wat haba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki Israel ban ym ïashongkha khleh bad kine ki briew , namar kin pynlong ïa ki Israel ban mane ïa kiwei ki blei .

translation.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat , saying , There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria  ; and , behold , they be in Hazazon–tamar , which is En–gedi .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonglamktien ki wan bad ki ïathuh ha u syiem Jehoshaphat :  Ka kynhun shipai babun paid na Edom ka la wan na sha shiliang ka Duriaw Baïap ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki la dep knieh ïa ka Hasason Tamar .  ( Kane ka dei kawei pat ka kyrteng jong ka Engedi . )

translation.en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings to cast stones .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u pynbiang ïa ka kynhun shipai da ki stieh , ki sum , ki jingda khlieh , ki jingphong nar , ki ryntieh bad ki khnam , bad ki maw ban kawang .

translation.en: For I determined not to know any thing among you , save Jesus Christ , and him crucified .
translation.kha: Naba katba nga dang don bad phi , nga la kut jingmut ban klet ïa kiei kiei baroh lait tang ïa U Jisu Khrist bad khamtam ïa ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna .

translation.en: And being brought on their way by the church , they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles : and they caused great joy unto all the brethren .
translation.kha: La leit on lynti ïa ki da ka balang ; bad kaba ki dang leit lyngba ka Phoenisia bad ka Samaria , ki la ïathuh kumno ba ki Jentil ki la phai sha U Blei ; kane ka khubor ka la wallam ka jingkmen bakhraw ïa ki parabangeit baroh .

translation.en: And the thing was known to Mordecai , who told it unto Esther the queen  ; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai s name .
translation.kha: U Mordekai u tip shaphang kane bad u ïathuh ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei ; kaba la ïathuh pat ïa u syiem ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u la shem .

translation.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian , in that he told him not that he fled .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la shukor ïa u Laban da kaba um shym la ïathuh ei ei ba u thmu ban phet noh .

translation.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it , he spake within himself , saying , This man , if he were a prophet , would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him : for she is a sinner .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharisi u la ïohi ïa kane , u la ong ha lade ,  Lada une u briew u dei shisha u nongïathuhlypa , un da la tip kaba kumno kane ka briew ka long kaba ktah ïa u ; un da la tip ka jait jingim bapop kaba kumno ka la im !

translation.en: Now therefore fear the  Lord  , and serve him in sincerity and in truth : and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood , and in Egypt  ; and serve ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynta te ,  u Joshua u bteng ,  pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , bad shakri ïa u da kaba sngur bad kaba shisha . Iehnoh syndon ïa ki blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la ju mane ha Mesopotamia bad ha Ijipt , bad shakri tang ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And when I looked , behold , an hand was sent unto me  ; and , lo , a roll of a book was therein  ;
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka kti ba la kner sha nga bad ka bat ïa ka kot kli .

translation.en: When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba ki sla jong ki , ki la sdang ban mih , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Where is he ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he is in the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , in Lo–debar .
translation.kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ha ïing u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , ha Lodebar ,  u Siba u jubab .

translation.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger , feed him ; if he thirst , give him drink : for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , to ai bam ïa u ; lada u sliang , to ai ïa u ban dih ; naba da kaba leh ïa kane phin pynlong ïa u ban ing da ka jingsngewlehrain .

translation.en: For it was said to me by the word of the  Lord  , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there , nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest .
translation.kha: Bad ngan ym bam ne dih ei ei bad phi hangne , namar U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam ne dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai sha ïing na kajuh ka lynti .

translation.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ai ha U Khun ïa ka hok ban bishar , namar u long U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: And charged the messenger , saying , When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king ,
translation.kha: bad u bthah ïa u nonglamktien ,  Hadien ba phi la ïathuh ha u syiem ïa baroh shaphang ka thma ,

translation.en: And if it be meet that I go also , they shall go with me .
translation.kha: Lada ka i long kaba myntoi ïa nga ban leit , te ki lah ban ïaleit ryngkat bad nga .

translation.en: And the children of Israel journeyed , and came unto their cities on the third day . Now their cities were Gibeon , and Chephirah , and Beeroth , and Kirjath–jearim .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki la mihnoh , bad hadien lai sngi ki la poi ha ki nongbah ha kaba kine ki briew ki shong : Ka Gibeon , ka Shephirah , ka Beeroth bad ka Kiriath Jearim .

translation.en: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the  Lord  said unto Moses  ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . And the land rested from war .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses . U Joshua u la ai ïa ka ha ki Israel kum ka jong ki hi bad u la pynbynta ïa ka ha ki lyngkhot , kawei kawei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait . Kumta ki paidbah ki la shongthait na ka thma .

translation.en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet , and cover the same with a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put in the staves thereof .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sumar ïa baroh ki tiar ki tar ka Ïingjaiñ bad ban pyndep ïa ki kamram kiba ïadei bad ki Israel .

translation.en: And , being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem , but wait for the promise of the Father ,  which ,  saith he ,  ye have heard of me .
translation.kha: Bad haba ki la ïawanlang , u la ai ha ki ïa kane ka hukum :  Wat leit noh na Jerusalem , hynrei ap ïa ka jingkular kaba nga la ïathuh , ka jingai kaba U Kpa jong nga u la kular .

translation.en: But as truly as I live , all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kular skhem ba kumba nga long uba im bad kumba ka jingdon jong nga ka dap ïa ka pyrthei baroh ,

translation.en: For he served Baal , and worshipped him , and provoked to anger the  Lord  God of Israel , according to all that his father had done .
translation.kha: U la mane bad shakri ïa u Baal , bad kumta u kpa jong u ha shuwa jong u , u la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let us fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for his mercies are great : and let me not fall into the hand of man .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba ngan shah pynshitom ha ki briew . Ai ba U  Trai  da lade hi un dei uta u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .

translation.en: To execute upon them the judgment written : this honour have all his saints . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew kumba U Blei u la hukum . Kane ka long ka jingjop jong ki briew jong U Blei . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And Er , Judah s firstborn , was wicked in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  slew him .
translation.kha: Ka rukom im jong u Er ka long bymman , bad kata ka la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  , kumta U  Trai  u la pynïap noh ïa u .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; This is Jerusalem : I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Khmih ïa ka Jerusalem . Nga buh ïa ka hapdeng ka pyrthei , bad kiwei pat ki ri sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: And they took counsel , and bought with them the potter s field , to bury strangers in .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la poi ha ka jingïamynjur lang shaphang kata , ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka Lyngkha u Nongthaw khiew , kum ka jaka tep ïa ki nongwei .

translation.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah : and God delivered them into their hand .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki phet ïap na ki Judia , bad U Blei u shah ïa ki Judia ban thombor ïa ki .

translation.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles : else the bottles break , and the wine runneth out , and the bottles perish : but they put new wine into new bottles , and both are preserved .
translation.kha: Lymne ym don uno uno u ban theh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hapoh ki lwa snieh kiba la pyndonkam , namar ki snieh kin pdang bad ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , bad ïa ki lwa snieh yn pynsniew . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ kaba thymmai la theh noh ha ki lwa snieh bym pat ju pyndonkam , bad baroh ar kin neh .

translation.en: Let your speech be always with grace , seasoned with salt , that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man .
translation.kha: Ka jingkren jong phi ka dei ban long borabor kaba sngewbang bad kaba sngewtynnat , bad phi dei ban tip kumno ban ai ka jubab kaba dei ha uwei uwei baroh .

translation.en: If Satan also be divided against himself , how shall his kingdom stand ? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub .
translation.kha: Kumta lada ka hima jong u Soitan ka don ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , kumno kan neh ? Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor ban leh kumta .

translation.en: And when a convenient day was come , that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords , high captains , and chief estates of Galilee  ;
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , ka Herodias ka la ïoh ïa ka kabu jong ka . Ka dei ha ka sngi kha jong u Herod , mynba la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta baroh ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan ha ka jingsynshar jong u , ki Rangbah shipai , bad ki nongshong shnong bapawkhmat jong ka Galilaïa .

translation.en: But the firstling of a cow , or the firstling of a sheep , or the firstling of a goat , thou shalt not redeem  ; they are holy : thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar , and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki blang ym dei ban thied pat ; ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , bad dei ban kñia ïa ki . Synreit ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan bad thang ïa ka khleiñ jong ki kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga .

translation.en: Then saith he to the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it forth  ; and it was restored whole , like as the other .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha u briew uba don ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang ,  To kner shabar ïa la ka kti .  U la kner shabar ïa ka bad ka la kylla bha pat , kumba long kata kawei pat .

translation.en: The thieves also , which were crucified with him , cast the same in his teeth .
translation.kha: Wat ki nonglute kiba la shah sahnarphna bad u ki la ïakren beiñ ïa u ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: This is the law , when a man dieth in a tent : all that come into the tent , and all that is in the tent , shall be unclean seven days .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u ïap hapoh ka ïingjaiñ , mano mano ba don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha ka por ba ïap lane ba rung hapoh jong ka u long u bymkhuid haduh hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: Then the king arose , and sat in the gate . And they told unto all the people , saying , Behold , the king doth sit in the gate . And all the people came before the king : for Israel had fled every man to his tent .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ïeng joit , bad u leit shong hajan ka khyrdop shnong . Ki rangbah jong u ki ïohsngew ba u don hangta , bad baroh ki la ïalumlang sawdong jong u . Ha kajuh ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la phet krad sha la ki jong ki ïing .

translation.en: Thou hast seen it  ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite , to requite it with thy hand : the poor committeth himself unto thee  ; thou art the helper of the fatherless .
translation.kha: Hynrei me , me ïohi ; me khmih ïa ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah shitom , bad me ïailong uba la kloi ban ïarap . U briew u bym don nongïarap u aiti ïa lade ha me ; me la ju ïarap ïa uba kyrduh .

translation.en: And , behold , there was lifted up a talent of lead : and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah .
translation.kha: Ka shang ka la don ka jingtap ba la shna da ka sisa . Katba nga dang khmih , la plied ïa ka jingtap , bad hangta hapoh ka shang la shong ka kynthei !

translation.en: And after him Ibzan of Beth–lehem judged Israel .
translation.kha: Hadien u Jephthah , u Ibsan uba na Bethlehem u ïalam ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah laiphew snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city , both man and beast : they shall die of a great pestilence .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ha kane ka nongbah ; ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ; kin ïap da ka khlam kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: Neither is it beyond the sea , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go over the sea for us , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?
translation.kha: Kam don ruh ha shiliang duriaw . Phim donkam ban da kylli , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit sha shiliang duriaw bad wallam ïa ka sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’

translation.en: And if the family of Egypt go not up , and come not , that have no rain  ; there shall be the plague , wherewith the  Lord  will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: Lada ki nong Ijipt ki kyntait ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep , te yn sa shoh ïa ki da kajuh ka jingpang kaba U  Trai  un phah ha ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba kyntait ban leit .

translation.en: Then came the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , into the desert of Zin in the first month : and the people abode in Kadesh  ; and Miriam died there , and was buried there .
translation.kha: Ha u bnai uba nyngkong , u paid Israel baroh u wan poi ha ka ri khlaw Sin bad u shong dara ha Kadesh . Hangta ka Miriam ka la ïap bad la tep ïa ka .

translation.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east , and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west , and there shall be a very great valley  ; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north , and half of it toward the south .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por un ïeng halor u lum Olib , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem . Te ïa u lum Olib yn sa kad arliang na mihngi sha sepngi da ka them kaba khraw . Shiteng jong u lumbah un kynriah shaphang shatei bad shiteng jong u shaphang shathie .

translation.en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth , which maketh himself a prophet to you ?
translation.kha: Balei phim shym leh ïa kane ha u Jeremaïah jong ka Anathoth , uba la kren kum u nongïathuhlypa sha ki briew ?

translation.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel , which provided victuals for the king and his household : each man his month in a year made provision .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la thung khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kum ki lat ka distrik ha Israel . Ki dei ban pynbiang bam na ki distrik jong ki ïa u syiem bad ïa ka longïing jong u , uwei uwei u rangbah u kitkhlieh na ka bynta uwei u bnai ha ka shisnem .

translation.en: And she fastened it with the pin , and said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awaked out of his sleep , and went away with the pin of the beam , and with the web .
translation.kha: Ka Delilah nangta ka kynoi thiah ïa u , ka shim ïa kita ki kynthrong shñiuh jong u , bad ka thain hynñiew tylli ïa ki . Ka pynskhem ïa ki da ki snar ïingjaiñ bad ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  Hynrei u khie joit bad u law pynsynjor ïa la u shñiuh na kata ka jingthain .

translation.en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews , and with the devout persons , and in the market daily with them that met with him .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïaphylliew jingmut ha ka synagog bad ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba mane ïa U Blei , bad ruh ha ki jaka paidbah man ka sngi bad ki briew kiba jia ryngkhat ki ïaid nangta .

translation.en: Now Heber the Kenite , which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses , had severed himself from the Kenites , and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanannim , which is by Kedesh .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Heber u jait Ken u pynïeng la ka dara marjan ïa ka Kedesh hajan u dieng Sning ha Saanannim . U la kynriah noh na kiwei pat ki jait Ken , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hobab , u kynum jong u Moses .

translation.en: All ye that are about him , bemoan him  ; and all ye that know his name , say , How is the strong staff broken , and the beautiful rod !
translation.kha: To ïambriew na ka bynta kata ka hima , phi kiba shong marjan , phi baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingpawnam jong ka . To ong , ‘ Ka jingsynshar bakhrawbor jong ka la pyndkut ; ka burom bad ka bor jong ka kam don shuh .’

translation.en: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance : I am their inheritance : and ye shall give them no possession in Israel : I am their possession .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki don ka jinglong lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki ïa kaei kaba nga la ai ha Israel ban hiarpateng na kawei ka pateng sha kawei pat . Kin ym don jingdon jingem ha Israel ; nga long tang ma nga uba ki donkam .

translation.en: Why Does God Have an Organization ?
translation.kha: Balei U Blei u Don la ka Jong ka Seng ?

translation.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar , and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee  ;
translation.kha: Kumta hamar ba phin ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei ha ka duwan bad hangta phi kynmaw ba u para jong phi u don ei ei pyrshah ïa phi ,

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a great tumult from the  Lord  shall be among them  ; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour , and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki ba kin shaïong jingmut bad sheptieng haduh katta ba uwei uwei baroh un kem ïa u briew hajan jong u bad tur ïaleh ïa u .

translation.en: They said therefore , What is this that he saith ,  A little while ?  we cannot tell what he saith .
translation.kha: Ka mut aïu kane ‘ sa tang shipor ?’ Ngim tip ba u kren shaphang kaei !

translation.en: How he met thee by the way , and smote the hindmost of thee , even all that were feeble behind thee , when thou wast faint and weary  ; and he feared not God .
translation.kha: Kim sheptieng ïa U Blei , bad kumta ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi haba phi la thait bad la duh bor , bad ki la pynïap lut ïa kito baroh kiba bud suki nadien .

translation.en: And I will turn thee back , and leave but the sixth part of thee , and will cause thee to come up from the north parts , and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel :
translation.kha: Ngan pynphai ïa u sha ka lynti bathymmai bad ngan ïalam ïa u shabar na shaphang shatei eh , haduh ba un da poi sha ki lumbah ka Israel .

translation.en: Now the Lord is that Spirit : and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty .
translation.kha: Mynta ,  U Trai  ha kane ka jingthoh u long U Mynsiem ; bad hangno haba U Mynsiem jong U Trai u don , hangta ka don ka jinglaitluid .

translation.en: And unto Eber were born two sons : the name of one was Peleg  ; for in his days was the earth divided  ; and his brother s name was Joktan .
translation.kha: U Eber u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang : ka kyrteng jong uwei ka long u Peleg , namar dei ha ki sngi jong u ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki briew ha ka pyrthei , bad ka kyrteng jong u para jong u pat ka long u Joktan .

translation.en: And ye have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto all these nations because of you  ; for the  Lord  your God is he that hath fought for you .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ha kine ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta jong phi . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh , fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind ; and were by nature the children of wrath , even as others .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , baroh na ngi , ngi la long kum ma ki bad ngi la im kat kum ki jingkwah ka doh jong ngi , da kaba leh ïa kano kano kaba ïahap kat kum ki jingkwah jong ki met bad ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi hi . Ha ka jinglong tynrai jong ngi , kumba long uwei pa uwei , la buh lypa ban shah pynshitom ha ka jingbitar U Blei .

translation.en: John bare witness of him , and cried , saying , This was he of whom I spake , He that cometh after me is preferred before me : for he was before me .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la kren shaphang jong u . U la pyrta jam ,  Une u long uta ïa uba nga la kren shaphang jong u , mynba nga la ong , ‘ U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u kham khraw ban ïa nga , namar u la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’

translation.en: And his mother answered and said , Not so  ; but he shall be called John .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kmie ka la ong ,  Em ! Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei ban long u Ïoannis .

translation.en: And I fell down before the  Lord  , as at the first , forty days and forty nights : I did neither eat bread , nor drink water , because of all your sins which ye sinned , in doing wickedly in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: Nangta sa shisien pat nga dem khrup ha khmat U  Trai  sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei ei , namar ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad phi la pynbitar ïa u .

translation.en: Also Jeshua , and Bani , and Sherebiah , Jamin , Akkub , Shabbethai , Hodijah , Maaseiah , Kelita , Azariah , Jozabad , Hanan , Pelaiah , and the Levites , caused the people to understand the law : and the people stood in their place .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïeng ha la ki jaka , bad kine ki Lebi ki batai ïa ka Hukum ha ki : u Jeshua , u Bani , u Sherebaïah , u Jamin , u Akkub , u Shabbethai , u Hodaïah , u Maaseïah , u Kelita , u Asaraïah , u Josabad , u Hanan , bad u Pelaïah .

translation.en: And the people spake against God , and against Moses , Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness ? for there is no bread , neither is there any water  ; and our soul loatheth this light bread .
translation.kha: Ki la khñium ,  Balei phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt ban ïap ha kane ka ri shyiap ha kaba ym don bam lane ka um ? Ngim sngewlah shuh ban bam kum kane ka jingbam !

translation.en: Lest there should be among you man , or woman , or family , or tribe , whose heart turneth away this day from the  Lord  our God , to go and serve the gods of these nations  ; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood  ;
translation.kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don napdeng jong phi u shynrang , lane ka kynthei , lane ka longïing , lane ka jait , ki ban phai noh na U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ban mane ïa ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Kum uta , un long kum u thied uba pynmih u soh uba kthang bad uba don bih .

translation.en: O  Lord  , how manifold are thy works ! in wisdom hast thou made them all : the earth is full of thy riches .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynlong shibun kiei kiei ! Haduh katno me la pynlong ha ka jingstad jong me ïa ki baroh ! Ka pyrthei ka dap tang da ki jingthaw jong me .

translation.en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced  ; I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .
translation.kha: Ngam shym pynlut ïa ka por jong nga bad kiwei pat ki briew , ha kaba ïa-rkhie bad ïasngewbha . Ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me nga la long marwei bad nga la dap da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much , and largeness of heart , even as the sand that is on the sea shore .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai ha u Solomon ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh kiba kham pher , bad ïa ka jingtip kaba khraw palat ïa ka ban thew .

translation.en: Behold , while thou yet talkest there with the king , I also will come in after thee , and confirm thy words .
translation.kha: Bad u Nathan u bynrap ,  Nangta , katba phi dang ïakren bad u Syiem Dabid , ngan wan rung shapoh bad pynskhem ïa ka khana jong phi .

translation.en: And Samson lay till midnight , and arose at midnight , and took the doors of the gate of the city , and the two posts , and went away with them , bar and all , and put them upon his shoulders , and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Samson u thiah tang haduh shiteng synñia . U khie nangta bad u bat khak ïa ka khyrdop shnong bad u rat syndon ïa ka — ki jingkhang , ki shawkad , u nar-khang bad baroh . U bah ïa ki ha la ka tyrpeng bad u rah ïa ki baroh artet lynti sha kliar jong u lum uba marpyrshah ïa ka Hebron .

translation.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner , to slay the righteous with the wicked : and that the righteous should be as the wicked , that be far from thee : Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right ?
translation.kha: Da shisha men ym pynïap ïa kiba hok ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . Mem lah ban leh kumta . Lada me leh kumta , kiba hok kin shah pynshitom ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . U nongbishar jong ka pyrthei baroh u dei ban lehhok .

translation.en: Then Uzziah was wroth , and had a censer in his hand to burn incense : and while he was wroth with the priests , the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the  Lord  , from beside the incense altar .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u ïeng hangta hapoh ka Templ harud ka duwan thang jingiwbih , bad u bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih . U la bitar ïa kita ki lyngdoh , bad mar kumta ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka mih ha ka shyllangmat jong u .

translation.en: The young men of Aven and of Pi–beseth shall fall by the sword : and these cities shall go into captivity .
translation.kha: Ki samla shynrang jong ki nongbah ka Heliopolis bad Bubastis kin ïap ha ka thma , bad kiwei ki briew kin shah rah kum ki koidi .

translation.en: Thine eye shall not pity him , but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel , that it may go well with thee .
translation.kha: Wat leh-isynei ïa u . Rat noh na Israel kum ïa uta u nongpynïap briew , khnang ba phin manbha .

translation.en: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïadih waiñ , u syiem u la kylli ïa ka ,  Ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pha kwah , bad phan ïoh ïa ka . Ngan ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong pha wat la phan pan shiteng na ka hima jong nga .

translation.en: Ye looked for much , and , lo , it came to little  ; and when ye brought it home , I did blow upon it . Why ? saith the  Lord  of hosts . Because of mine house that is waste , and ye run every man unto his own house .
translation.kha: Phi la kyrmen ïa ki jingot kiba bun , hynrei ki la kylla long tang khyndiat . Bad haba phi la wanrah ïa ka jingot sha ïing , nga pynher ïa ka sha jngai . Balei ba nga la leh ïa kata ? Namar ka Templ jong nga ka dang don ha ki jingjot katba uwei pa uwei na phi u bunkam ha ka jingtrei ïa la ka jong ka ïing .

translation.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer shall be abomination .
translation.kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum , U Blei un shem ïa ki jingduwai jong phi kiba ijli eh ban sngap .

translation.en: Assemble yourselves , and come , all ye heathen , and gather yourselves together round about : thither cause thy mighty ones to come down , O  Lord .
translation.kha: To pynkloi bad to wan , phi baroh ki jaitbynriew ba don sawdong , bad ïalumlang ha ka them .’   To phah , A  Trai  , ïa ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: But that ye also may know my affairs , and how I do , Tychicus , a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord , shall make known to you all things :
translation.kha: U Tukhikos u long u parabangeit ba-ieit jong ngi , bad u shakri baïaineh ha ka kam U Trai , un ïathuh lut ïa ka khubor shaphang jong nga , khnang ba phin tip kumno nga ïaid shaphrang .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the great trumpet shall be blown , and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria , and the outcasts in the land of Egypt , and shall worship the  Lord  in the holy mount at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi kan wan , ïa ka turoi yn put ban khot pat na Assyria bad Ijipt ïa baroh ki Israel kiba don ha ka jinglongmraw hangta . Kin wan bad mane ïa U  Trai  ha Jerusalem , ha u lum bakyntang jong u .

translation.en: A land which the  Lord  thy God careth for : the eyes of the  Lord  thy God are always upon it , from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u khmih sumar ïa kane ka ri bad u ap sumar ïa ka baroh shisnem .

translation.en: And again the word of the  Lord  came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , kaba arphew saw jong u bnai , U  Trai  u la ai ha u Haggai ïa ka khubor kaba ar

translation.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance  ; and I will fill their treasures .
translation.kha: nga pynriewspah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , da kaba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ki jingkynshew .

translation.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet : praise him with the psaltery and harp .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki turoi . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki jingtem ksai .

translation.en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment  ; and they shall judge it according to my judgments : and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies  ; and they shall hallow my sabbaths .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingmudui aiñ ka mih , ki lyngdoh kin ai jingrai ïa ka jingmudui kat kum ki aiñ jong nga . Kin pynïaid ïa ki jinglehniam kat kum ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih jong nga , bad kin rakhe khuid ïa ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him .
translation.kha: Naduh kata u Judas u la khmih ïa ka lad kaba biang ban aiti noh ïa U Jisu ha ki .

translation.en: Therefore hear now this , thou that art given to pleasures , that dwellest carelessly , that sayest in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me  ; I shall not sit as a widow , neither shall I know the loss of children :
translation.kha: To sngap ïa kane , pha kaba ieit ïa ka jinglehsngewbha , pha kaba pyrkhat ba pha shongshngain bad sngewskhem . Pha kam ba pha long kaba khraw kum U Blei — ba ym don mano mano pat kum ma pha . Pha pyrkhat ba da lei lei phan ym long ka riewkynthei lane mad ïa ka jingduh noh ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: No , nor yet Herod : for I sent you to him  ; and , lo , nothing worthy of death is done unto him .
translation.kha: Lymne ba u Herod u shem ïa u , uba la rem , naba u la phah biang ïa u sha ngi . Kam shym don kano kano kaba une u briew u la leh kaba u dei ban ïap .

translation.en: Children benefit when you encourage and commend them .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ïoh jingmyntoi haba phi pynshlur bad ïaroh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city :
translation.kha: Lada ka la pur , un hukum ba dei ban weng noh ïa ki maw ha kiba la bit bthuh bad bret noh ïa ki sha ka jaka theh ñiut shabar shnong .

translation.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent ; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ ;
translation.kha: Te phin long kiba lait na baroh ki jingbymkhuid bad khlem shah kynnoh pop ha ka Sngi U Khrist .

translation.en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs , and with wonders , and with a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with great terror  ;
translation.kha: Da ki kambah bad ki jingphylla kiba la pynsngewshyrkhei ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , me la pyndonkam ïa ka bor bad ka borbah jong me ban wallam ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me  ; and they have kept thy word .
translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga na ka pyrthei . Ki la long ki jong me , bad me la ai ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: And I answered , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said unto me ,  I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom thou persecutest .
translation.kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A Trai ?’ nga la kylli . ‘ Nga long U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ ,’ u la ong ha nga .

translation.en: And if ye salute your brethren only , what do ye more than others ? do not even the publicans so ?
translation.kha: Bad lada phi kren tang ïa ki paralok jong phi , hato phi lah leh ïa kaei kaei kaba kham pher ? Wat kiba mane blei thala ki leh ïa kata !

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent against him bands of the Chaldeans , and bands of the Syrians , and bands of the Moabites , and bands of the children of Ammon , and sent them against Judah to destroy it , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servants the prophets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ki kynhun kieng atiar jong ka Babilonia , ka Syria , ka Moab , bad ka Ammon pyrshah ïa u Jehoïakim ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , kumba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong u ba un leh .

translation.en: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us , who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ  ; what was I , that I could withstand God ?
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shai ba U Blei u la ai ïa kito ki Jentil ïa kajuh ka jingai kaba u la ai ha ngi myn haba ngi la ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ; nga long uei , te , ban pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa U Blei !

translation.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me , he hath crushed me , he hath made me an empty vessel , he hath swallowed me up like a dragon , he hath filled his belly with my delicates , he hath cast me out .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u la pynkut ïa ka Jerusalem bad bam ïa ka . U pynthylli ïa ka nongbah kum ïa u khra ; kum u mrad kynsha u la nguid ïa ka . U la shim kat ïa kaba u kwah bad bret noh ïa kiba sah .

translation.en: And the men are shepherds , for their trade hath been to feed cattle  ; and they have brought their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have .
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ha u ba phi dei ki nongri jingri , bad ba phi la wan ïalam ïa la ki kynhun langbrot , ïa kiwei de ki jingri , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba phi don .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , cause thy belly to eat , and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee . Then did I eat it  ; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli ba nga ai ha me , pyndap ïa ka kpoh jong me da ka .  Te nga bam ïa ka , bad ka thiang kum ka ngap .

translation.en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord , I die daily .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , nga ïakynduh ïa ka jingïap man la ka sngi! Ka jingsngew sarong kaba nga don ha phi , ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , ka pynlong ïa nga ban pynbna ïa kane .

translation.en: And in every province , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , there was great mourning among the Jews , and fasting , and weeping , and wailing  ; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes .
translation.kha: Ha baroh ki jylla , hangno hangno ba la pynbna paidbah ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , la don ka jingsawa jong ka jingïambriew hapdeng ki Jiw . Ki shahjingit , ki ïam bad lynñiar bad bun na ki , ki phong jaiñ khain bad thiah ha u dpei .

translation.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning  ; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even :
translation.kha: Kñia uwei u khunlangbrot mynstep bad uwei pat ynda janmiet .

translation.en: And in the second month , on the seven and twentieth day of the month , was the earth dried .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba arphew hynñiew jong u bnai uba ar , ka khyndew ka la rkhiang nadong shadong .

translation.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life , righteousness , and honour .
translation.kha: Lehsbun bad lehhok bad phin im slem ; kiwei kin burom ïa phi bad kin lehbha ïa phi .

translation.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity . Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus . Amen .
translation.kha: To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei pat da ka jingïadoh jong ka jingieit Khristan . To ka jingsuk kan long ïa phi baroh kiba dei ki jong U Khrist .

translation.en: And I heard another out of the altar say , Even so , Lord God Almighty , true and righteous are thy judgments .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na ka duwan kaba ong ,  Ko Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh ! Kaba shisha bad kaba hok ki long da shisha ki jingbishar jong me !

translation.en: And the border passed along to the side of Beth–hoglah northward : and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan : this was the south coast .
translation.kha: u da ïaid na shatei jong ka sharing lum jong ka Beth Hoglah , bad u kut ha ka jaka ba ka wah Jordan ka wan tuid ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka Duriaw Baïap . Une u dei u pud uba shaphang shathie .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh had let the people go , that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near  ; for God said , Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war , and they return to Egypt :
translation.kha: Mynba u Pharaoh u shah ïa uta u paidbah ban leit noh , U Blei um shym ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba poi shatei sha ka phang Philistia , wat la ka long kaba jan tam . U Blei u ong ,  Ngam kwah ba kine ki briew kin kylla dien bad kin leit phai pat sha Ijipt haba ki ïohi ba ki hap ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests , and captains of the temple , and the elders , which were come to him ,  Be ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and staves ?
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ha ki tymmen ki san kiba la wan hangta ban kem ïa u ,  Hato phi la dei ban ïawan bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ?

translation.en: For God is my record , how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei u long u sakhi jong nga , ba nga ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , haba nga ong ba ka jingsngew bajylliew na ka bynta jong phi baroh , ka wan na ka dohnud U Khrist Jisu hi .

translation.en: Persecutions , afflictions , which came unto me at Antioch , at Iconium , at Lystra ; what persecutions I endured : but out of them all the Lord delivered me .
translation.kha: Me tip lut ïa baroh kaba la jia ha nga ha Antiokh , Ikoniom , bad Lystra , ki jingpynshitom bashyrkhei kiba nga la ïaishah! Hynrei u Trai u la pyllait ïa nga na ki baroh .

translation.en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep .
translation.kha: U briew uba rung shapoh lyngba ka jingkhang u long u nongap jong ki langbrot .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: And I will give them one heart , and one way , that they may fear me for ever , for the good of them , and of their children after them :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa kawei ka jingthmu ha ka jingim : ban burom ïa nga ha ki por baroh , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki hi bad ka jingbha jong ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .

translation.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty , and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof .
translation.kha: U rangbah shipai uba stad u lah ban jop ïa ka nongbah kaba la ïada da ki briew kiba khlaiñ , bad pynkhyllem ïa ki kynroh ha kiba ki shaniah .

translation.en: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him : thousand thousands ministered unto him , and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him : the judgment was set , and the books were opened .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka wahduid da ka ding la theh noh na ka . La don bun hajar ngut ki briew hangta kiba shakri ïa u , bad da ki million ngut ki briew ki la ïeng ha khmat jong u . Ka ïingbishar ka la sdang ïa ka jingïalang jong ka , bad ïa ki kitab la plied .

translation.en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel . For Esaias saith , Lord , who hath believed our report ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ym baroh ki la pdiang ïa ka Khubor Babha . U Isaïah da lade hi u la ong ,  A Trai , uei uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ngi ?

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If thou wilt walk in my ways , and if thou wilt keep my charge , then thou shalt also judge my house , and shalt also keep my courts , and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong :  Lada me kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh ïa ki kamram kiba nga la shaniah ha me , te men ïailong uba khmih ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ïa ki phyllaw jong ka , bad ngan shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me , kumba nga shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki angel kiba don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga .

translation.en: And in process of time the daughter of Shua Judah s wife died  ; and Judah was comforted , and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnah , he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ka tnga jong u Judah ka la ïap . Hadien ba u la pyndep ïa ka por ka jingïam sngewsih , ma u lem bad u paralok jong u , u Hirah uba na Adullam ki la ïaleit sha Timnah , ha kaba la khap shñiuh ïa ki langbrot jong u .

translation.en: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay , they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men : but they shall not cleave one to another , even as iron is not mixed with clay .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ïa ka nar la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha . Kane ka mut ba ki nongsynshar jong kata ka hima kin pyrshang ban pynïatylli ïa ki longïing jong ki da ka jingïashongkha khleh , hynrei kin ym lah , kumba ka nar kam lah ban ïakhleh bad ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked , and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous .
translation.kha: To ai ba baroh kiba pyrshah ïa nga bad kiba ïaleh ïa nga yn pynshitom kum ïa ki briew bymman bad ki briew bymhok .

translation.en: The  Lord  is my strength and song , and he is become my salvation : he is my God , and I will prepare him an habitation  ; my father s God , and I will exalt him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada uba khlaiñ jong nga ; u long ma u , uba la pyllait im ïa nga . U dei U Blei jong nga , bad ngan ïaroh ïa u , U Blei jong u kpa jong nga , bad ngan rwai shaphang ka jingkhraw jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place , seeing it is most holy , and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation , to make atonement for them before the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Balei phim shym ïabam ïa kata ka jingkñia namar ka pop ha ka jaka kyntang ? Ka long kaba khuid bha , bad U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi na ka bynta ban kit noh ïa ka pop jong u paidlang .

translation.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel : he shall grow as the lily , and cast forth his roots as Lebanon .
translation.kha: Ngan long ïa ki paid Israel kum u slap ha ka dewryngkhiang . Kin phuh kum ki syntiew ; kin suhthied skhem kum ki dieng ha Lebanon .

translation.en: That chant to the sound of the viol , and invent to themselves instruments of musick , like David  ;
translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban thaw ïa ki jingrwai , kumba u Dabid u la thaw , bad tem ïa ki ha ki duitara .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , and his might that he shewed , and how he warred , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoshaphat u la leh , baroh ki kam shlur jong u bad ki thma jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah

translation.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant , she shall not go out as the menservants do .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u die mraw ïa la ka khun , kam lah ban ïoh laitluid kumba ki mraw shynrang ki ïoh .

translation.en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils , after whom they have gone a whoring . This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kim dei shuh ban lyndet ïa U  Trai  da kaba pynïap ïa ki mrad jong ki ha lum ha wah la kum ba kñia ainguh ïa ki sha ki ksuid . Ki paid Israel ki dei ban sumar ïa kane ka aiñ pateng la pateng .

translation.en: And as for the people , he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la pynlong mraw ïa ki briew na tduh sha tduh ka Ijipt .

translation.en: So Absalom fled , and went to Geshur , and was there three years .
translation.kha: U Absalom u la phet krad bad u la leit sha u Talmai , u khun jong u Ammihud , u syiem Geshur bad u la sah hangta lai snem . U Dabid u la ïambriew slem na ka bynta u Amnon u khun jong u ;

translation.en: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins  ; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they , and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done .
translation.kha: Ka Samaria kam shym leh pop shiteng na kaei kaba pha la leh . Pha la leh kham ijli ban ïa kaba ka la leh . Ka jingbamsap jong pha ka pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha ban i lui lui da kaba ïanujor .

translation.en: And thou shalt set up the court round about , and hang up the hanging at the court gate .
translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa ka phyllaw kaba baroh sawdong bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka khyrdop jong ka .

translation.en: Then came she and worshipped him , saying , Lord , help me .
translation.kha: Ha kane , ka briew ka la wan bad dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u .  To ïarap ïa nga , ko Kynrad !  ka la ong .

translation.en: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven , having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth , and to every nation , and kindred , and tongue , and people ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba her shajrong eh ha suiñ , lem bad ka khubor bymjukut jong ka Khubor Babha ban pynbna ha ki briew ka pyrthei , ha kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka jait , ka ktien bad ka kynja bynriew .

translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  stablished the kingdom in his hand  ; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents  ; and he had riches and honour in abundance .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa u Jehoshaphat ka jingsynshar baskhem halor ka hima Judah , bad baroh ki briew ki wallam ki jingai sngewbha , ba kumta u long uba riewspah bad ïoh ïa ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: Now I beseech you , brethren , mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned ; and avoid them .
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga : To da husiar na kito kiba pynlong ki jingïapait bad kiba pynkulmar ïa ka jingngeit jong ki briew bad kiba ïaid pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai kaba phi la ïoh . To kiar na ki !

translation.en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead four hundred young virgins , that had known no man by lying with any male : and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Hapdeng ki briew ha Jabesh ki lap sawspah ngut ki theisotti , kumta ki wan ïalam ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara ha Shiloh , kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence : and great multitudes followed him , and he healed them all  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , u la leit noh na kata ka jaka , bad bun ki briew ki la bud ïa u . U la pynkhiah ïa kito baroh kiba pang

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground : and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the  Lord  , worshipping the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Jehoshaphat u dem ngon , ka khmat jong u kaba dei ha ka khyndew , bad baroh u paidbah u dem ryngkat bad u bad mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the ark of the  Lord  continued in the house of Obed–edom the Gittite three months : and the  Lord  blessed Obed–edom , and all his household .
translation.kha: Ka la don hangta lai bnai , bad U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa u Obed Edom bad ïa ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Now let me die , since I have seen thy face , because thou art yet alive .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Mynta nga la kloi lada ïap noh ruh , namar ba nga la ïohi ïa me bad tip ba me dang im .

translation.en: Knowest thou not this of old , since man was placed upon earth ,
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba naduh ki por mynhyndai , mynba ïa u briew la buh nyngkong ha ka pyrthei ,

translation.en: The Lord then answered him , and said ,  Thou hypocrite , doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall , and lead him away to watering ?
translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab ïa u ,  Me uba arsap ! Uno uno na phi un law ïa la u masi dab lane ïa la ka kada na ka sem bad ïalam shabar ban ai um ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee , and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee , I will surely rend the kingdom from thee , and will give it to thy servant .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar ïa u Solomon , bad u la ong ha u ,  Namar ba me la leh khnang ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba me la ïateh bad nga bad ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , nga kular ban shim noh ïa ka hima na me bad ngan ai ha uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong me .

translation.en: Therefore , my brethren dearly beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , so stand fast in the Lord , my dearly beloved .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh katno phi long kiba ieit ïa nga bad haduh katno nga la sngewtmang ïa phi ! Haduh katno phi pynkmen ïa nga , bad haduh katno nga sngewsarong namar jong phi ! Kane te , ko ki parabangeit ba-ieit , ka long kumno phi dei ban ïeng skhem ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Trai .

translation.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil .
translation.kha: dei ban wanrah lai kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ar litar ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad ar litar ka waiñ .

translation.en: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores , and repented not of their deeds .
translation.kha: bad ki la tim ïa U Blei jong ka bneng namar ki jingpang bad ki prum jong ki . Hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ki lynti basniew jong ki .

translation.en: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good , and I will bring them again to this land : and I will build them , and not pull them down  ; and I will plant them , and not pluck them up .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih halor jong ki bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki sha kane ka ri . Ngan tei bha ïa ki bad ngan ym tar lyngkhot ïa ki ; ngan thung ïa ki bad ngan ym rat ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  God prepared a gourd , and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shadow over his head , to deliver him from his grief . So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  U Blei u la pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san kham jrong ïa u Jonah khnang ban ai ïa u katto katne ka jingkah syrngiew , khnang ba un kham tngen . U Jonah u la sngewkmen shibun ïa u jingthung .

translation.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them , and overcame them , and prevailed against them , so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba la don u mynsiem bymman u la tur puk sha ki da ka jinglehbor kaba haduh katta ba u la jop ïa ki baroh . Ki la phet noh na ka ïing jong u , kiba la mynsaw bad ha ki jaiñ kiba la shah tar .

translation.en: But when it pleased God , who separated me from my mother s womb , and called me by his grace ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la jied ïa nga wat shuwa ban kha ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga ban shakri ïa u .

translation.en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria , and unto the rest beyond the river , Peace , and at such a time .
translation.kha: U patsha u phah ïa kane ka jubab :  Ha u Rehum , u lat , ha u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , bad ha ki paralok jong ki kiba shong ha Samaria bad ha kiba sah jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , ki jingkhublei .

translation.en: And one shall say unto him , What are these wounds in thine hands ? Then he shall answer , Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends .
translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u kylli ïa u , ‘ Kiei kito ki jingmong ha ka shadem jong phi ?’ Un jubab , ‘ Nga la ïoh ïa ki ha ka ïing u paralok .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  discomfited them before Israel , and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon , and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth–horon , and smote them to Azekah , and unto Makkedah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkulmar jingmut ïa ki Amor ha ka jingïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel . Ki Israel ki pynïap ïa ki ha Gibeon bad ki la beh ïa ki arsut ïa ka khim lum ha Beth Horon , da kaba ïai ïaleh shaduh shaphang shathie ha Asekah bad Makkedah .

translation.en: For the Jews require a sign , and the Greeks seek after wisdom :
translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki kwah ïa ki kambah kum ka sakhi , bad ki Grik ki wad ïa ka jingstad .

translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Amor ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: But to us there is but one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we in him ; and one Lord Jesus Christ , by whom are all things , and we by him .
translation.kha: pynban ha ngi don tang uwei U Blei , U Kpa , uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh bad uba na ka bynta jong u ngi im ; bad don tang uwei U Trai , U Jisu Khrist , da u ba kiei kiei baroh la pynlong bad ha u ba ngi im .

translation.en: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman : howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba nga dei u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïajan bad ba nga don jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei don u briew uba dei u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïajan ban ïa nga .

translation.en: Woe is me for my hurt ! my wound is grievous : but I said , Truly this is a grief , and I must bear it .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki kyang jam ,  Haduh katno la pynmong jur ïa ngi ! Ki jingmong jong ngi kin ym koit . Bad ngi la pyrkhat ba kane ka dei kaei kaei kaba ngi lah ban shah !

translation.en: The  Lord  grant you that ye may find rest , each of you in the house of her husband . Then she kissed them  ; and they lifted up their voice , and wept .
translation.kha: Bad to ai ba U  Trai  un pynlah ïa phi baroh ar ngut ban shongkurim biang bad ban don la ka longïing .  Kumta ka Naomi ka doh khublei ïa ki . Hynrei ki la sdang ban ïam bad ki ong ha ka ,

translation.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Asa u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u bad ki shnong kiba u la tei pynskhem , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah . Hynrei ha ka jinglong tymmen u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat .

translation.en: Behold , this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom , pride , fulness of bread , and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters , neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .
translation.kha: Ma ka bad ki khun kynthei jong ka ki la sngewsarong namar ki la don kyrhai ban bam bad im ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingjar jar , hynrei kim shym la sumar ïa kiba duk bad ïa kiba rangli .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God , and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad um shym shahshkor da kaba pynrit ïa lade ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa , uba kren ïa ka ktien U  Trai .

translation.en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : to your tents , O Israel : now see to thine own house , David . So Israel departed unto their tents .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor ïa ki , ki la pyrta ,  Long ba la ñiewbeiñ ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ngin leit noh sha ïing ! To ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi ïa lade !

translation.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the  Lord  , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation , and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it .
translation.kha: Ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ , u syiem u la mane ïa U  Trai  da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha ka duwan rnong ; u la phah pynïap shihajar tylli ki jingri bad thang tylli halor jong ka .

translation.en: And there came a messenger unto Job , and said , The oxen were plowing , and the asses feeding beside them :
translation.kha: Katba ngi dang pynlur ïa ki lyngkha da ki masi lur ,  u la ong ,  bad ki kada ki dang ïabam phlang marjan .

translation.en: For I will send into her pestilence , and blood into her streets  ; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki jingpang ha pha bad ban shah ba ka snam kan tuid ha ki lynti bah jong pha . Phan shah tur ïaleh na baroh ki liang , bad ïa ki briew jong pha yn pynïap . Te phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Again , he limiteth a certain day , saying in David , To day , after so long a time  ; as it is said , To day if ye will hear his voice , harden not your hearts .
translation.kha: Ïa kane la pyn-i lyngba ka jingshisha ba U Blei u la buh ïa kawei pat ka sngi , ïa kaba la khot  Ha kane ka sngi .  Bun snem hadien u la kren lyngba u Dabid ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ïa kaba la lah kdew :  Lada phin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi , wat pyneh ïa la ki dohnud .

translation.en: Whence then cometh wisdom ? and where is the place of understanding ?
translation.kha: Hangno , namarkata , ka don ka thymmei jong ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban shemphang ?

translation.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ngi long ki bieit kum ki masi ?

translation.en: Behold the mounts , they are come unto the city to take it  ; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans , that fight against it , because of the sword , and of the famine , and of the pestilence : and what thou hast spoken is come to pass  ; and , behold , thou seest it .
translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki la tei ïa ki kynton kerkut sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban kurup ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa ka nongbah ban hap ha ki kti jong ki . Me lah ban ïohi ba baroh kaba me la kren ka la urlong shisha .

translation.en: And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders , rejoicing .
translation.kha: Haba u la shem ïa ka , u kmen haduh katta katta ba u buh ïa ka halor ki tyrpeng jong u bad bah pat ïa ka sha ïing .

translation.en: And Jesus , when he came out , saw much people , and was moved with compassion toward them , because they were as sheep not having a shepherd : and he began to teach them many things .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu la hiar na ka lieng , u la ïohi ïa une u paidbah babun , bad ïa ka mynsiem jong u la pyndap da ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki , namar ki la long kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Kumta u la sdang ban hikai bun kiei kiei ïa ki .

translation.en: And Amaziah said to the man of God , But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel ? And the man of God answered , The  Lord  is able to give thee much more than this .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa ,  Hynrei kumno pat shaphang ka rupa baroh kaba nga la dep siew ïa ki ?  U nongïathuhlypa u jubab ,  U  Trai  u lah ban ai pat sha me kham bun ban ïa kata !

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken  ; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished ? thou shalt not go unpunished , but thou shalt surely drink of it .
translation.kha: Wat lada kito ki bym dei hok ban shah pynshitom ki dei ban dih na ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ma phi phin lait noh khlem shah pynshitom ? Em , phi dei ban dih na kane ka khuri !

translation.en: The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la ong ha u ,  Nga tip ba U Messaïah un sa wan , bad haba u wan , un sa ïathuh ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: And Gideon came to Jordan , and passed over , he , and the three hundred men that were with him , faint , yet pursuing them .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por , u Gideon bad la ki laispah ngut ki rangbah ki la wan sha ka wah Jordan bad jam sha shiliang ïa ka . Ki la thait hi ïan , hynrei ki dang beh kthong ïa ki nongshun .

translation.en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: But a prophet of the  Lord  was there , whose name was Oded : and he went out before the host that came to Samaria , and said unto them , Behold , because the  Lord  God of your fathers was wroth with Judah , he hath delivered them into your hand , and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven .
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Oded , u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  ; u shong ha ka nongbah Samaria . U ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel kaba wan phai bad ki koidi Judia hamar ba kin rung sha ka nongbah bad u ong :  U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la bitar ïa ki Judah , bad u la shah ïa phi ban jop ; hynrei mynta u la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglehbeiñ palat jong phi ba phi pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers , specially they of the circumcision :
translation.kha: Naba don shibun , khamtam kiba la kylla na ka niam Jiw , kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba shukor ïa kiwei da ka jingleh bym don jingmut jong ki .

translation.en: If my step hath turned out of the way , and mine heart walked after mine eyes , and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands  ;
translation.kha: Lada nga la phai noh na ka lynti kaba dei lane shah ban pynthame ïa lade da kaba sniew , lada ki kti jong nga ki bit da ka pop ,

translation.en: Remove not the ancient landmark , which thy fathers have set .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynkynriah ïa u mawpud ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la thung naduh mynbarim .

translation.en: Then it shall be , that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me , when I return in peace from the children of Ammon , shall surely be the  Lord s  , and I will offer it up for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: ngan kñia ïa ka jingainguh da u briew ne ka briew ba mih nyngkong eh na ka ïing jong nga ban wan tan ïa nga , ynda nga wan phai na ka jingjop . Ngan ai ha me ïa uta ne kata ka briew kum ka jingainguh thang .

translation.en: But if thou wilt go , do it , be strong for the battle : God shall make thee fall before the enemy : for God hath power to help , and to cast down .
translation.kha: Me lah ban pyrkhat ba kin pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ ha ka thma , hynrei u dei U Blei uba don ka bor ban ai ka jingjop ne ka jingshahjop , bad un shah ïa ki nongshun jong me ban jop ïa me .

translation.en: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother s sister , nor of thy father s sister : for he uncovereth his near kin : they shall bear their iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmienah kmiesan , ne bad la ka ñiakha , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shahshitom namar kata ka kam sang .

translation.en: Then Simon Peter answered him , Lord , to whom shall we go ? thou hast the words of eternal life .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la jubab ïa u ,  Ko Trai , sha uno pat ngin leit ? Me don ki ktien kiba ai ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u syiem Hesekaïah u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u la phong ki jaiñ khain , bad u la leit sha ka Templ jong U  Trai .

translation.en: For ye , brethren , became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus : for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen , even as they have of the Jews :
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , kijuh kiei kiei kiba la jia ha phi ki la jia ha ki balang jong U Blei ha Judia , ha ki briew hangta kiba long ki jong U Khrist Jisu . Phi la shah ïa kijuh ki jingpynshitom beiñ na ki briew ki para ri jong phi hi kiba ki la shahshitom na ki Jiw ,

translation.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear , but hardened their necks , like to the neck of their fathers , that did not believe in the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh ; ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki bym shym la shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh ïa ki shynrang ba dang kham samla to kyntu jur ïa ki ban synshar bha ïa lade .

translation.en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon . And she said , Comest thou peaceably ? And he said , Peaceably .
translation.kha: Nangta u Adonijah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Haggith , u la leit sha ka Bathsheba , kaba dei ka kmie jong u Solomon .  Hato kane ka dei ka jingwan jngoh kaba sngewtynnat ?  Ka dei ,  u jubab ,

translation.en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you .
translation.kha: U maham ïa phi ban ym shah ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face , he is forehead bald : yet is he clean .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u hap shñiuh na shadien ne na sha khmat ka khlieh jong u , kata kam pynlong ïa u bymkhuid .

translation.en: Thou shalt also take one ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Shim uwei na kita ki langbrot shynrang , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: And I answered again , and said unto him , What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves ?
translation.kha: Bad kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki tnat dieng Olib hajan ki ar tylli ki tyndong ksiar na kaba la phylliew ïa ka umphniang Olib ?

translation.en: And on the morrow , when Agrippa was come , and Bernice , with great pomp , and was entered into the place of hearing , with the chief captains , and principal men of the city , at Festus  commandment Paul was brought forth .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan ha ka jingpynpaw burom kaba khraw bad ha ka jinglehkmen bad ki la rung sha ka kamra bishar lem bad ki rangbah shipai bad ki rangbah pawkhmat jong ka nongbah . U Phestos u la ai ka hukum , bad ïa u Paul la wallam shapoh .

translation.en: Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .
translation.kha: U la wan sha nga , u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad u la ong , ‘ Ko Saul , to men ïoh imat pat !’ Ha kata hi ka khyllipmat nga la lah ban peit pat , bad nga la khmih ïa u .

translation.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the  Lord  to bless Israel , he went not , as at other times , to seek for enchantments , but he set his face toward the wilderness .
translation.kha: Haduh mynta u Balaam u la tip ba U  Trai  u kwah ïa u ba un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel , kumta um shym leit wad shuh ïa ki dak ki shin kumba u la leh mynshuwa . U la phai la ki khmat shaphang ka ri shyiap ,

translation.en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers , and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites , every one in his business  ;
translation.kha: Nga pynkhuid ïa ki briew na kiei kiei kiba long nongwei : nga pynkhreh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi khnang ba uwei pa uwei un tip ïa la ka kamram ;

translation.en: I said in mine heart , God shall judge the righteous and the wicked : for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha lade ,  U Blei un bishar kumjuh ïa uba hok bad uba sniew , namar kaei kaei baroh , kano kano ka jingleh , kan jia ha ka por ba la buh ïa ka hi .

translation.en: And we know that we are of God , and the whole world lieth in wickedness .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ngi long ki jong U Blei , wat la ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u Basniew .

translation.en: And when they saw it , they all murmured , saying , That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la sdang ban khñium ,  Une u briew u la leit kum uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong u nongpop !

translation.en: This is the thing which the  Lord  doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , Let them marry to whom they think best  ; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry .
translation.kha: bad kumta U  Trai  u ong ba ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki lah ban ïashongkurim bad uno uno uba ki mon , hynrei tang hapoh ka jait jong ki hi .

translation.en: For he taught his disciples , and said unto them ,  The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men , and they shall kill him  ; and after that he is killed , he shall rise the third day .
translation.kha: Ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa ai noh ha ki briew ki ban pynïap ïa u . Pynban hadien lai sngi , un sa mihpat .

translation.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation , which sing among the branches .
translation.kha: Halor ki dieng ba don hajan , ki sim ki thaw ïa ki skum jong ki bad ki rwai .

translation.en: And say , How have I hated instruction , and my heart despised reproof  ;
translation.kha: Balei keiñ ba ngam peiphang ? Balei keiñ ba ngam shah ba kiwei kin pynbeit ïa nga ?

translation.en: Then said they unto him , What shall we do , that we might work the works of God ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ngi lah ban leh khnang ban ïoh leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ?

translation.en: Write ye also for the Jews , as it liketh you , in the king s name , and seal it with the king s ring : for the writing which is written in the king s name , and sealed with the king s ring , may no man reverse .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingpynbna ba la dep pynmih ha ka kyrteng u syiem bad ba la shon da ka muhor syiem , ym lah ban pynkylla . Phi lah pat ban thoh sha ki Jiw ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah ; bad phi lah ban thoh ïa ka ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad shon ïa ka da ka muhor syiem .

translation.en: And there came a man of God , and spake unto the king of Israel , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because the Syrians have said , The  Lord  is God of the hills , but he is not God of the valleys , therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Ahab bad ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Namar ba ki Syria ki ong ba nga long u blei jong ki lum bad ym jong ki jaka madan , ngan sa ai jingjop ïa phi halor ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong ki , bad ma phi bad ki briew jong phi kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .’

translation.en: So they came into the land of Egypt : for they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  : thus came they even to Tahpanhes .
translation.kha: Kim shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ki la leit sha Ijipt jngai shaduh ka nongbah Tahpanhes .

translation.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites , and they hanged them in the hill before the  Lord  : and they fell all seven together , and were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest .
translation.kha: U Dabid u aiti ïa ki ha ki paid Gibeon , kiba la phasi ïa ki halor u lum ha khmat U  Trai  — baroh hynñiew ngut ki la ïa-ïap lang . Ka dei haba jan kut artat ka pyrem , ha kaba sdang ka aïom ot barli , haba la pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: Know ye not , that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey , his servants ye are to whom ye obey ; whether of sin unto death , or of obedience unto righteousness ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba haba phi pyndem ïa lade kum ki mraw ban kohnguh ïano ïano , ha ka jingshisha , phi long ki mraw jong u kynrad uba phi kohnguh — lada ka long ka pop , kaba ka jingmih ka long ka jingïap , lane ka jingkohnguh , kaba ka jingmih ka long ka jingïasuk bad U Blei .

translation.en: The unity that we enjoy as an organization and the experience we have gained in working together enable us to mobilize quickly in times of need .
translation.kha: Ka jingïatyllilang bad ka jingïatreilang ka pynlah ïa ngi ban lum kloi kloi ïa ki jingïarap bad ïa ki nongtrei ha ka por ba donkam .

translation.en: And he said , Swear unto me . And he sware unto him . And Israel bowed himself upon the bed s head .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ,  Pynlong ka jingsmai ba phin leh kumta .  U Joseph u la pynlong ka jingsmai , bad u Jakob ruh u ainguh hangta ha jingthiah .

translation.en: And we beseech you , brethren , to know them which labour among you , and are over you in the Lord , and admonish you ;
translation.kha: Ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban ai ka burom kaba dei biang ïa kito kiba la trei hapdeng jong phi , kiba la ïalam bad hikai ïa phi ha ka jingim kum kiba ngeit .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , When thou goest to return into Egypt , see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh , which I have put in thine hand : but I will harden his heart , that he shall not let the people go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong biang ha u Moses ,  Mynta ba me leit phai sha Ijipt , da kynmaw ban leh ha khmat u Pharaoh ïa ki kambah baroh kiba nga la ai ha me ïa ka bor ban leh . Hynrei ngan pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad un ym shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .

translation.en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses , and said , Give us water that we may drink . And Moses said unto them , Why chide ye with me ? wherefore do ye tempt the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Ki la khñium ha u Moses , bad ki la ong ,  Ai um ïa ngi ban dih .  U Moses u ong ha ki ,  Balei keiñ phi ïakhñium ïa nga ? Balei phi tynjuh ïa U  Trai  ?

translation.en: In the resurrection therefore , when they shall rise , whose wife shall she be of them ? for the seven had her to wife .
translation.kha: Mynta , haba baroh kiba la ïap , kin sa mihpat ha kata ka sngi ka jingmihpat , ka tnga jongno kan long ? Baroh kita ki hynñiew ngut ki la lah shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered , that this woman was delivered also : and we were together  ; there was no stranger with us in the house , save we two in the house .
translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong nga , ka ruh ka kha khun shynrang . Ngi ïadon tang ma ngi hi ar ngut ha kata ka ïing — ym don mano mano ba don ryngkat .
