translation.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un synreit ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong ka duwan ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad un thang ïa ka khleiñ ban pynmih ïa ka jingiwbih kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And thou shalt write Aaron s name upon the rod of Levi : for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers .
translation.kha: bad nangta thoh ïa ka kyrteng u Aaron ha u diengduh na ka bynta ka jait Lebi . Dei ban don uwei u diengduh ïa u nongïalam jong kawei pa kawei ka jait .

translation.en: And she said unto him , There is no cause : this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me . But he would not hearken unto her .
translation.kha: Em ,  ka la jubab .  Ban phah noh ïa nga kumne ka long ka kam sniew kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaei kaba phi dang shu dep leh !  Hynrei u Amnon um sngap ïa ka ;

translation.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house , that he may set his nest on high , that he may be delivered from the power of evil !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la pynriewspah ïa la ka longïing da kaei kaba phi la shim da kaba leh jubor , bad phi la pyrshang ban pynlong ïa la ka ïing kaba lait na ki jingpynmynsaw bad jingma !

translation.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me , having a live coal in his hand , which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar :
translation.kha: Te uwei na ki seraph u la her sha tbian sha nga , da kaba rah ïa u rnga uba rhem uba u la khap da ka nap na ka duwan .

translation.en: And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,
translation.kha: Da ka sur kaba jam u pan ki jingkyrkhu na U Blei halor u paidbah baroh uba ïalumlang hangta .

translation.en: And they took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof , and all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining , according to all that he had done to Eglon  ; but destroyed it utterly , and all the souls that were therein .
translation.kha: Ki la pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka bad ïa uwei pa uwei baroh ha ka nongbah bad ha ki shnong kiba markhap . U Joshua u pynjot thiaw ïa kata ka nongbah , kumba u la leh ïa ka Eglon . Ym shym don uwei ruh hangta uba lait im .

translation.en: And I was afraid , and went and hid thy talent in the earth : lo , there thou hast that is thine .
translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng , kumta nga la leit bad buhrieh ïa ka pisa jong me ha ka khyndew . Ha khmih ! Kane hangne ka long kaba dei ka jong me .’

translation.en: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons , he gathered up his feet into the bed , and yielded up the ghost , and was gathered unto his people .
translation.kha: Ynda u Jakob u la dep sneng ïa la ki khun , u thiah noh , bad u la ïap .

translation.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame  ; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought .
translation.kha: hynrei un wanrah jingjahburom ïa kito kiba isih ïa me , bad ki ïing ki riewbymman kin jah noh .

translation.en: Which make oil within their walls , and tread their winepresses , and suffer thirst .
translation.kha: Ki khem ïa ki soh Olib na ka bynta ka umphniang , bad ïa ki sohwaiñ na ka bynta ka um sohwaiñ , hynrei ma ki ïa lade pat ki thynrang .

translation.en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life : the fruit of the wicked to sin .
translation.kha: Ka bainong ban lehbha ka lam sha ka jingim ; hynrei ka pop ka ïalam ban leh pop shuh shuh .

translation.en: Mr So-and-So is dead . Why would I bother going to his funeral since , I am certain , he won't come to mine ?
translation.kha: I bah ine-ine i lah iap . Balei ngan leit sha jingontep jong i haba nga lah thikna , in nym wan sha jingontep jongnga ?

translation.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed , and the diviners confounded : yea , they shall all cover their lips  ; for there is no answer of God .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei kin shah pynjahburom da ka jingbymlah jong ki . Baroh kin shah pynlehrain namar U Blei um shym jubab ïa ki .

translation.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir , the country of Edom .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jong u sha u Iso u hynmen jong u ha ri Edom .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ? follow thou me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Lada nga mon ïa u ba un im tad ynda nga wan , ka pher aïu ïa me ? To bud ïa nga !

translation.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city , and they said unto him , Shew us , we pray thee , the entrance into the city , and we will shew thee mercy .
translation.kha: kiba la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba wan mih bad ki ong ha u ,  Pyni ïa ngi kumno ngin ïohrung shapoh ka nongbah bad ngin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: And when they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , and cast out the wheat into the sea .
translation.kha: Hadien ba uwei uwei baroh u la bam kdang , ki la pynsting ïa ka lieng da kaba bret noh ïa u kew baroh sha ka duriaw .

translation.en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , bad kumta kin sa shahjingit .

translation.en: And say ye to Amasa , Art thou not of my bone , and of my flesh ? God do so to me , and more also , if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la bthah ruh ïa ki ban ong ha u Amasa ,  Phi dei u ba-ha-ïing jong nga . Naduh mynta nga buh ïa phi ban ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam leh kumta !

translation.en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found : but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki kren da ka jingshemphang , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba mutlop donkam ban pynshitom .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , In the seventh month , in the first day of the month , shall ye have a sabbath , a memorial of blowing of trumpets , an holy convocation .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel ,  Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynñiew , rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngi shongthait kaba kyrpang , bad haba ka turoi ka sawa , wan ïalumlang ban mane Blei .

translation.en: Then David and his men , which were about six hundred , arose and departed out of Keilah , and went whithersoever they could go . And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah  ; and he forbare to go forth .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u — kumba hynriewspah ngut baroh — ki mihnoh shisyndon na Keilah bad ki ïaid sa ïaid . Haba u Saul u tip ba u Dabid u la phet noh na Keilah , u la sangeh noh ïa la ka jingpynkhreh .

translation.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass , that the children of Israel asked the  Lord  , saying , Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first , to fight against them ?
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Joshua , ki paid Israel ki kylli ïa U  Trai  ,  Mano na ki jait jong ngi kaba dei ban leit nyngkong ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan ?

translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest , as a young lion among the flocks of sheep : who , if he go through , both treadeth down , and teareth in pieces , and none can deliver .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dang sah napdeng ki jaitbynriew kin long kum u sing uba wad jingbam ha ka khlaw ne ha ka jaka bam phlang : U rung hapdeng ki langbrot , u kynrup ïa ki , bad tar lyngkhot ïa ki — bad hangta ym don jingkyrmen ban lait im .

translation.en: Be of good courage , and let us play the men for our people , and for the cities of our God : and the  Lord  do that which seemeth him good .
translation.kha: To long kiba khlaiñ bad kiba shlur ! To ngin ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ki briew jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki nongbah jong U Blei jong ngi . Bad ai ba yn leh ïa ka mon U  Trai  !

translation.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people , he entered into Capernaum .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ban kren ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki paidbah , u la leit sha Kapernam .

translation.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ , who in presence am base among you , but being absent am bold toward you :
translation.kha: Nga u Paul , nga pynlong ka jingkyrpad ïa phi — ïa nga ïa kaba la ong ba nga long uba jemnud bad jai jai haba nga don bad phi , hynrei uba eh haba nga don jngai na phi .

translation.en: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew uba leit rung ha kata ka ïing kaba dang khang un long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: Are they not on the other side Jordan , by the way where the sun goeth down , in the land of the Canaanites , which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal , beside the plains of Moreh ?
translation.kha: ( Kine ki lum ar tylli ki don sha sepngi ka wah Jordan ha ka ri ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka Them Jordan . Ki don shaphang sepngi , ym da jngai na ki dieng kyntang ha Moreh hajan ka shnong Gilgal . )

translation.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God ;
translation.kha: Hynrei phi don ka dohnud kaba eh bad kaba kuman , bad kumta phi pynlong ka jingpynshitom ïa lade hi wat kham khraw ha ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ka jingbitar U Blei bad ki jingbishar bahok yn pynpaw .

translation.en: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy  ; for the  Lord  had made them to rejoice over their enemies .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u ïalam pat ïa ki shipai sha Jerusalem ha ka jingjop , namar U  Trai  u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: Then said some of his disciples among themselves , What is this that he saith unto us ,  A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me : and , Because I go to the Father ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u ki la ïakylli para ma ki ,  Ka mut aïu kane ? U ïathuh ïa ngi ba sa tang shipor ngin ym ïohi shuh ïa u ; bad nangta sa shipor hadien ngin sa ïohi ïa u ; bad u ong ruh , ‘ Ka long namar ba ngan sa leit noh sha U Kpa .’

translation.en: And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka kynthei ka bym pat shongkurim ka pynlong ka jingkular , da kaba mut khnang ne khlem da pyrkhat ban kyndiah na kano kano bad nangta ka shongkurim ,

translation.en: Then the king said to Haman , Make haste , and take the apparel and the horse , as thou hast said , and do even so to Mordecai the Jew , that sitteth at the king s gate : let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Haman ,  Pynkloi bad shim ïa ki jaiñphong bad ïa u kulai bad pyndonburom kumne ïa u Mordekai , u Jiw . Leh ïa u baroh kata kaba me la ai jingmut . Men shem ïa u ba u dang shong ha ka khyrdop jong ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite , and let them be of those that eat at thy table : for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother .
translation.kha: Hynrei pyn-i ka jinglehsbun ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Barsillai uba na Gilead bad ri sumar ïa ki , namar ki la lehsbun ïa nga mynba nga la phet krad na u Absalom , u hynmen jong me .

translation.en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here : and he shall slay me .
translation.kha: Te kumno phin hukum ïa nga ban leit ban ong ïa u syiem ba phi don hangne ? Un sa pynïap ïa nga !

translation.en: But when thou makest a feast , call the poor , the maimed , the lame , the blind :
translation.kha: Haba me khreh ka jingkhawai , khot sngewbha ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba dkoh , bad kiba matlah ;

translation.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise , and shall shew signs and wonders , to seduce , if it were possible , even the elect .
translation.kha: Namar ki Messaïah balamler bad ki nongïathuhlypa balamler kin mih . Kin leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla khnang ban shukor wat ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , lada long kaba lah .

translation.en: Quenched the violence of fire , escaped the edge of the sword , out of weakness were made strong , waxed valiant in fight , turned to flight the armies of the aliens .
translation.kha: Ki la set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing , ki la pynlip ïa ki ding kiba klang , ki la lait im na kaba shah pynïap da ka waitlam . Ki la long kiba tlot , hynrei ki la kylla long kiba khlaiñ ; ki la long kiba khlaiñbor ha ka thma bad ki la jop ïa ki kynhun shipai nongwei .

translation.en: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah , and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah  ; they laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , and the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
translation.kha: U Joïada , u khun jong u Paseah , bad u Meshullam , u khun jong u Besodeïah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Jeshanah . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .
translation.kha: U pynim ïa ki na kito kiba shun ïa ki ; u pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without , an hundred cubits eastward and northward .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kita ki ar tylli ki khyrdop bad ka long sanphew mitar .

translation.en: And looking round about upon them all , he said unto the man ,  Stretch forth thy hand .  And he did so : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
translation.kha: U la khmih sawdong jong ki baroh ; nangta U la ong ha uta u briew ,  To kner ïa ka kti jong me .  U la leh kumta , bad ka kti jong u ka la bha pat .

translation.en: How did you come ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi wan ?

translation.en: As an earring of gold , and an ornament of fine gold , so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear .
translation.kha: Ka jingmaham ba ai da u briew uba shemphang bha ha uno uno uba mon ban sngap ka long kaba kham kordor ban ïa ki sati ksiar ne ki jingdeng mawlynnai ba la saiñ na ka ksiar banylla .

translation.en: He is thy praise , and he is thy God , that hath done for thee these great and terrible things , which thine eyes have seen .
translation.kha: U long uba phi dei ban ïaroh — u long U Blei jong phi ; bad phi la ïohi da la ki khmat ïa ki kam kiba khraw bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And when this people , or the prophet , or a priest , shall ask thee , saying , What is the burden of the  Lord  ? thou shalt then say unto them , What burden ? I will even forsake you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , haba uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh u kylli ïa me , ‘ Kaei ka khubor jong U  Trai  ?’ Men ïathuh ha u , ‘ Me long ka jingkit ïa U  Trai  , bad un sa kynther noh ïa me .’

translation.en: O Israel , thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts .
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ki long ki bymmyntoi kum ki myrsiang kiba shong hapdeng ki jingjot jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently , who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you :
translation.kha: Ka dei shaphang kane ka jingpynim ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïawad bad ïit bha biang biang , bad ki la ïathuhlypa shaphang kane ka jingai ïa kaba U Blei un ai ha phi .

translation.en: And he arose , and rebuked the wind , and said unto the sea ,  Peace , be still .  And the wind ceased , and there was a great calm .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïeng bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer ,  Long jai jai !  bad u la ong ïa ki jingat phyllung ,  Long jai jai !  Ka lyer ka la kynjah jar bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .

translation.en: Shall it be told him that I speak ? if a man speak , surely he shall be swallowed up .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pan ban ïakren bad U Blei ; balei ngan ai ïa u ka lad ban pynjot ïa nga ?

translation.en: Tell ye , and bring them near  ; yea , let them take counsel together : who hath declared this from ancient time ? who hath told it from that time ? have not I the  Lord  ? and there is no God else beside me  ; a just God and a Saviour  ; there is none beside me .
translation.kha: Ale bad ai ïa ka kam jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; ai ba ki nongïasaid kin ïasyllok uwei ïa uwei pat . Mano ba la ïathuhlypa slem mynshuwa kaei ban jia ? Hato ym dei ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei uba pynim ïa la ki briew ? Ym don uwei pat U Blei .

translation.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .
translation.kha: lem bad katto katne ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba don hapoh ki pud sawdong jong ka Manasseh , hynrei kiba la ai ha ki Ephraim .

translation.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness , thou shalt not lack any thing in it  ; a land whose stones are iron , and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass .
translation.kha: Hangta lano lano phin ym thngan , bad phin ym kyrduh ei ei . Ha ki mawsiang jong ka don u nar , bad ha ki lum jong ka lah ban tih tama .

translation.en: And he killed it  ; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynïap ïa u , bad u theh ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .

translation.en: He shall be shaven , but the scall shall he not shave  ; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more :
translation.kha: uta u briew un khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh , lait noh ïa ka jaka bit prum . U lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: He answered them , He that made me whole , the same said unto me ,  Take up thy bed , and walk .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  U briew uba la pynkhiah ïa nga u la ong ha nga ba ngan rah ïa ka jingthiah bad ban ïaid .

translation.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem . Bad kano kano ka shnong lane ka longïing kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan khyllem ha ka jingpra .

translation.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters .
translation.kha: Ngam kwah ba kan paw kumba nga pyrshang ban pynsheptieng ïa phi da ki shithi jong nga .

translation.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way : and he that hateth reproof shall die .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kaei ka bymdei , yn pynshitom sat ïa phi ; phin ïap lada phim ailad ban pynbeit ïa phi .

translation.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering  ; ( for he is faithful that promised  ; )
translation.kha: To ngin batskhem da ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba ngi ïaphla , namar ngi lah ban shaniah ba U Blei u bat ïa la ka kular .

translation.en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants  ; and some of the king s servants be dead , and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
translation.kha: Nangta ki siat ïa ngi da ki khnam na ka kynroh , bad katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem kynrad ki la shah pynïap ; u Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .

translation.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us .
translation.kha: Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba im hapoh jong ngi , to sumar ïa kiei kiei kiba bha ïa kiba la pynkhamti ha me .

translation.en: And she brought it before Saul , and before his servants  ; and they did eat . Then they rose up , and went away that night .
translation.kha: Ka buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat u Saul bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ki ïabam . Nangta ki ïeng bad leit noh ha kata hi ka miet .

translation.en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul , both sure and stedfast , and which entereth into that within the veil  ;
translation.kha: Ngi don kane ka jingkyrmen kum u angkor ïa ki jingim jong ngi . Ka long kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad ka ïaid lyngba ka jingkah jong ka Templ ba kynja bneng shaduh ka kamra kaba kham shapoh .

translation.en: And the man Micah had an house of gods , and made an ephod , and teraphim , and consecrated one of his sons , who became his priest .
translation.kha: Une u Mikah u don la ka ïing mane blei . U shna katto katne ki bleithaw bad ka ephod , bad u thung ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: O thou king , the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom , and majesty , and glory , and honour :
translation.kha: U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynlong ïa u Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong me , u syiem uba khraw bad ai ha u ka burom bad ka jinglong syiem .

translation.en: But Jesus yet answered nothing  ; so that Pilate marvelled .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kyntait biang ban ong ei ei , bad u Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh .

translation.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me : though they called them to the most High , none at all would exalt him .
translation.kha: Ki ïaleh ban phai lyndet na nga . Kin sa lynñiar namar ka lyngkor kaba ban ïa ki , hynrei yn ym don ban weng ïa ka na ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering , and all his vessels , and sanctify the altar : and it shall be an altar most holy .
translation.kha: Nangta pynkyntang ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki tiar jong ka baroh da kaba synreit da ka umphniang pynsleh ; te kan sa long kaba kyntang nadong shadong .

translation.en: But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land , that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians : so we dwell at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la hiarthma ïa ka ri , ngi la rai ban wan sha Jerusalem ban lait na ki kynhun shipai ka Babilonia bad ka Syria . Dei na kane ka daw balei ba ngi ïashong ïasah ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners , saying , What shall we do to the ark of the  Lord  ? tell us wherewith we shall send it to his place .
translation.kha: ki briew ki khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongleh myntor bad ki kylli ,  Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ? Lada ngi phah biang ïa ka sha ka jaka jong ka da-ei ngin phah ryngkat bad ka ?

translation.en: Make ye mention to the nations  ; behold , publish against Jerusalem , that watchers come from a far country , and give out their voice against the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ki la wan ban maham ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ban ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki nongshun ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bah . Kine ki nongshun kin pyrta pyrshah ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah

translation.en: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan , that ye shall set up these stones , which I command you this day , in mount Ebal , and thou shalt plaster them with plaster .
translation.kha: bad ynda phi la poi sha shiliang ka Jordan , pynïeng ïa kita ki maw ha u lum Ebal , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi , bad ñiad astor ïa ki .

translation.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you , and ye shall fall by the sword : because ye are turned away from the  Lord  , therefore the  Lord  will not be with you .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïakhun ïa ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan , phin ïap ha ka thma ; U  Trai  un ym don lem bad phi , namar phi la kyntait ban bud ïa u .

translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king , unto all people , nations , and languages , that dwell in all the earth  ; Peace be multiplied unto you .
translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah ïa ka khubor harum sha ki briew jong baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ha ka pyrthei :  Khublei !

translation.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard it , they laughed us to scorn , and despised us , and said , What is this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?
translation.kha: Haba u Sanballat , u Tobiah , bad u nong Arab uba kyrteng u Geshem ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ngi la thmu ban leh , ki rkhie ïa ngi bad ong ,  Kaei kaba phi tharai phin leh ? Hato phin ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ?

translation.en: And Pilate asked him again , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? behold how many things they witness against thee .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la mudui ïa U Jisu shibun kiei kiei , kumta u Pilat u la kylli biang ïa u ,  Hato men ym jubab ? Sngap ïa ki jingmudui jong ki baroh !

translation.en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses , let us lay aside every weight , and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us ,
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi , ngi don katne u paid sakhi babun byllien sawdong jong ngi . Kumta te , to ngin ïabret noh na lade ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba wan pynwit ha lynti , bad ïa kata ka pop kaba shait snoh skhem ha ngi , bad to ngin ïaphet da ka jingkut jingmut ïa ka jingïaphet thong kaba don ha khmat jong ngi .

translation.en: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah , whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilon u la rah ïa u Jehoïakhin u syiem ka Judah ha ka jingringmraw na Jerusalem , ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki koidi , u Mordekai u long uwei na ki .

translation.en: And in her was found the blood of prophets , and of saints , and of all that were slain upon the earth .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilon la pynshitom namar ïa ka snam jong ki nongïathuhlypa bad jong ki briew jong U Blei la shem hapoh ka nongbah ; ho-oid , ka snam jong kito baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the evening , that he took Leah his daughter , and brought her to him  ; and he went in unto her .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet , ha ka jaka jong ka Rakhel , u shim ïa ka Leah bad leit ïalam ïa ka sha u Jakob , bad u Jakob u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .

translation.en: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man , I sent straightway to thee , and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him . Farewell .
translation.kha: Bad haba la pyntip ha nga ba ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , shisyndon nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha phi . Nga la ong ïa ki nongmudui jong u ban ai ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u ha khmat jong phi .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto Moses , Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh : for with a strong hand shall he let them go , and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta men sa ïohi aïu ngan leh ïa u Pharaoh . Ngan pynbor ïa u ban shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit . Ha ka jingshisha , ngan pynbor ïa u ban beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong u .

translation.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians : and they shall fight every one against his brother , and every one against his neighbour  ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynkhih ka thma poh-ïing ha Ijipt bad ngan pynphai ïa u para pyrshah ïa u para bad u paramarjan pyrshah ïa u paramarjan . Ki nongbah ba-ïashun kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , bad ki syiem ba-ïashun kin ïaksaid ban ïoh ïa ka bor .

translation.en: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites , and of the priests , and of the chief of the fathers of Israel , for the judgment of the  Lord  , and for controversies , when they returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha Jerusalem , u Jehoshaphat u thung ïa ki Lebi , ki lyngdoh bad katto katne ki riewkhmat ka shnong kum ki nongbishar ha ki kam ba ïadei bad ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum U  Trai  lane ki jingïakajia ba dei ïa ka aiñ hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months .
translation.kha: bad u la synshar ha Hebron halor ka Judah hynñiew snem shiteng .

translation.en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plummet of the house of Ahab : and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish , wiping it , and turning it upside down .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kumba nga la leh ïa ka Samaria , kumba nga la leh ïa u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ngan pynkhuid phar ïa ka Jerusalem na ki briew jong ka kumba khuid ka pliang ba la ñiad bad pyndem pyllup ïa ka .

translation.en: They bear him upon the shoulder , they carry him , and set him in his place , and he standeth  ; from his place shall he not remove : yea , one shall cry unto him , yet can he not answer , nor save him out of his trouble .
translation.kha: Ki kyntiew ïa ka ha la ki tyrpeng bad rah ïa ka ; ki buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka , bad hangta ka ïeng , khlem lah ban khih na ka jaka ba ka don . Lada don uno uno ba duwai ha ka , kam lah ban jubab lane pyllait ïa u na ka jingjot .

translation.en: For I give you good doctrine , forsake ye not my law .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi ka long kaba bha , kumta wat klet ïa ka .

translation.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit : he that is abhorred of the  Lord  shall fall therein .
translation.kha: Ka jingklim ka long ka jingriam — ka pynngat ïa kito kiba U  Trai  u bitar .

translation.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth :
translation.kha: U Baana , u khun jong u Hushai : ka thain Asher bad ka shnong Bealoth

translation.en: But with many of them God was not well pleased : for they were overthrown in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Hynrei bad kiba bun U Blei um shym la sngewbha , kumta ki metïap jong ki la pynsaphriang ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And the men of Judah said , Why are ye come up against us ? And they answered , To bind Samson are we come up , to do to him as he hath done to us .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah Judah ki kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi ?  Ki jubab ,  Ngi wan ban kem koidi ïa u Samson bad ban leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa ngi .

translation.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman and in a wide house .
translation.kha: Kan kham bha kaba shong ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang ha kajuh ka ïing bad ka tnga kaba wad daw .

translation.en: Then he said , Go , borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours , even empty vessels  ; borrow not a few .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki paramarjan jong phi bad pan kylliang bun tylli ki khra thylli kat kiba phi lah ban ïoh ,  u Elisha u la ong ha ka .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto David my father , Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name , thou didst well that it was in thine heart .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha u , ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba dei ba me kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa nga ,

translation.en: The  Lord  render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness : for the  Lord  delivered thee into my hand to day , but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ainong ïa kito baroh kiba hok bad ïaineh . Ha kane ka sngi u la aiti ïa phi ha ka bor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi , uta ïa uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem .

translation.en: Therefore prophesy against them , prophesy , O son of man .
translation.kha: Mynta te , to kren pyrshah ïa ki , ko khun u briew .

translation.en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days : and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Miriam ka shah khang shabar ka jaka sher dara hynñiew sngi , bad kita ki briew kim shym la mihnoh tad ynda la wan ïalam pat ïa ka shapoh .

translation.en: At that time the  Lord  said unto me , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first , and come up unto me into the mount , and make thee an ark of wood .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga , ‘ Shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba nyngkong bad shna ruh kawei ka synduk dieng ban buh ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that the beggar died , and was carried by the angels into Abraham s bosom : the rich man also died , and was buried  ;
translation.kha: U briew uba duk u la ïap bad la bah da ki angel ban shong hajan u Abraham ha ka jingkhawai ha bneng . U riewspah u la ïap bad la tep ,

translation.en: And to knowledge temperance  ; and to temperance patience  ; and to patience godliness  ;
translation.kha: ha ka jingtip jong phi pynlang ïa ka jingsynshar ïa lade ; ha ka jingsynshar ïa lade pynlang ïa ka jingïaishah ; ha ka jingïaishah pynlang ïa ka jinglong riewblei ;

translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad ka mrad .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob , his statutes and his judgments unto Israel .
translation.kha: U ai ïa ka khubor jong u sha ki briew jong u , ki jingbthah bad ki aiñ jong u ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way , and makest thine high place in every street  ; and hast not been as an harlot , in that thou scornest hire  ;
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka lynti bah pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti . Hynrei pham shym beh ïa ka pisa kumba long kano kano ka nuti .

translation.en: Ye are my brethren , ye are my bones and my flesh : wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king ?
translation.kha: Phi dei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga , ki para doh ki para snam jong nga ; balei phin dei kiba khatduh ban ïalam pat ïa nga ?

translation.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah  ; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba la tip bha ba ïa u la kha kum u dkhot jong ka jait Judah ; bad u Moses um shym kdew ïa kane ka jait haba u la kren shaphang ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And God hath set some in the church , first apostles , secondarily prophets , thirdly teachers , after that miracles , then gifts of healings , helps , governments , diversities of tongues .
translation.kha: Ha ka balang , U Blei u la buh ïa baroh ha la ka bynta : Ha ka bynta banyngkong u buh ïa ki Apostol , ha ka bynta kaba ar ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kaba lai ïa ki nonghikai ; nangta ïa kito kiba leh ïa ki kambah , bud sa kito ha kiba la ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah lane ban ïarap ïa kiwei lane ban pyn-i lem lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher .

translation.en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem , ( but he himself laid siege against Lachish , and all his power with him , ) unto Hezekiah king of Judah , and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba u Sennakherib bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang don ha Lakhish , u phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Hesekaïah bad sha ki paid Judah kiba dang don bad u ha Jerusalem :

translation.en: ( For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt  ; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by  ;
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw kumno ngi la im ha Ijipt bad kumno ka la jia bad ngi haba ngi ïaid lynti na ka ri jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And he said unto another ,  Follow me .  But he said , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
translation.kha: U la ong ha uwei pat u briew ,  Bud ïa nga .  Hynrei uta u briew u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , nyngkong to shah ïa nga ban leit phai pat bad ban tep ïa u kpa jong nga .

translation.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways : and a good man shall be satisfied from himself .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh . Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta ki kam jong ki .

translation.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah : and she , and he , and her house , did eat many days .
translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei ka leit bad ka leh kumba u Elijah u la ong ïa ka , bad baroh na ki , ki dap jingbam na ka bynta bun sngi .

translation.en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor , and ye take from him burdens of wheat : ye have built houses of hewn stone , but ye shall not dwell in them  ; ye have planted pleasant vineyards , but ye shall not drink wine of them .
translation.kha: Phi la banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad la shim jubor na ki ïa u kew jong ki . Bad kumta phin ym ïoh sah ha ki ïing maw ba-itynnat ba phi la tei lane dih waiñ na ki bri sohwaiñ kiba itynnat ba phi la thung .

translation.en: And the women also , which came with him from Galilee , followed after , and beheld the sepulchre , and how his body was laid .
translation.kha: Ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa ki la leit bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa ka jingtep bad kumno ba la buh ïa ka met ka jong U Jisu hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: And when he had spoken these things , while they beheld , he was taken up  ; and a cloud received him out of their sight .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingong ïa kane , la shim noh ïa u sha bneng katba ki dang khmih ïa u , bad u lyoh u la buhrieh ïa u na ka jingïohi jong ki .

translation.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed  ; the mighty men of Moab , trembling shall take hold upon them  ; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Edom ki la sngewshyrkhei ; ki rangbah bakhlaiñbor jong ka Moab ki sngewkyiuh ; ki briew ka Kanaan ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .

translation.en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man , or by all thy people Israel , which shall know every man the plague of his own heart , and spread forth his hands toward this house :
translation.kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . Lada uno uno na ki briew jong me ki Israel , da kaba sngewkynduh ha la ka mynsiem , ki kner la ki kti ha ka jingduwai sha kane ka Templ , to sngap ïa ka jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow , that thou mayest live , and inherit the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: Leh beit bad lehhok borabor , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad ba phin ïaishong hangta .

translation.en: Son of man , they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak , saying , Abraham was one , and he inherited the land : but we are many  ; the land is given us for inheritance .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong  Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot jong ka ri Israel ki ong : ‘ U Abraham u long tang uwei u briew , bad u la ïoh ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ngi ïadon bun ngut , kumta mynta ka ri ka dei ka jong ngi .’

translation.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm  ; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .
translation.kha: U la kner ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong u bad u la pynsakma ïa kiba sarong lem bad ki jingthmu jong ki .

translation.en: But I would have you know , that the head of every man is Christ ; and the head of the woman is the man ; and the head of Christ is God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kwah ïa phi ba phin sngewthuh ba U Khrist u long halor tam ïa uwei pa uwei briew , u tnga u long halor la ka tnga , bad U Blei u long halor tam ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself  ; but in me is thine help .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa phi , ko ki paid Israel ! Te uei uba lah ban ïarap ïa phi ?

translation.en: How is it then , brethren ? when ye come together , every one of you hath a psalm , hath a doctrine , hath a tongue , hath a revelation , hath an interpretation . Let all things be done unto edifying .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba nga mut , ko parabangeit jong nga . Haba phi ïashem lang ïa ka ban mane ïa U Blei , uwei u don ka jingrwai , uwei pat ïa ka jinghikai , uwei pat ïa ka jingpynpaw na U Blei , sa uwei pat ha ki thylliej bapher , bad sa uwei pat ïa ka jingbatai ïa kaei kaba la kren . Baroh ki dei ban long ki ban ïarap ïa ka balang .

translation.en: And Nibshan , and the city of Salt , and En–gedi  ; six cities with their villages .
translation.kha: ka Nibshan , ka nongbah Mluh , bad ka Engedi : hynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: This means that in a personal , private prayer you tell him that you are giving yourself to him to do his will .—Matthew 16 :24  ; 22 :37 .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ban ïathuh ha u ha ka jingduwai ba jar jar marwei , ba phi aiti ïalade ha u ban leh ïa ka mon jong u .—Mathaios 16 :24 ; 22 :37 .

translation.en: So I came to Jerusalem , and was there three days .
translation.kha: Nga ïai bteng ïa ka jingleit sha Jerusalem ,

translation.en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil , to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives ?
translation.kha: Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi bad ban ym kohnguh ïa U Blei jong ngi da kaba shongkurim ïa ki kynthei nongwei ?

translation.en: For they fled from the swords , from the drawn sword , and from the bent bow , and from the grievousness of war .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïaphet ban ïohlait im na ki waitlam kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa ki , na ki ryntieh kiba la khreh ban siat , na baroh ki jingma jong ka thma .

translation.en: Yet the  Lord  hath not given you an heart to perceive , and eyes to see , and ears to hear , unto this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi um pat shym la ai ha phi ban shemphang ïa kaei kaba phi la mad .

translation.en: What ye know , the same do I know also : I am not inferior unto you .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba me ong , nga la ïohsngew mynshuwa . Nga sngewthuh ïa kata baroh ; nga tip lut kat kaba me , me tip . Ngam long uba hapoh jong me .

translation.en: Envyings , murders , drunkenness , revellings , and such like : of the which I tell you before , as I have also told you in time past , that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: ki ïa-pihuin , ïabuaid , ki don jingkhawai jingdih kyiad , bad leh ïa kiwei kiei kiei kiba kum kine . Nga maham ïa phi mynta kumba nga la maham mynshuwa ; ba kita kiba ïai leh ïa kine kiei kiei kin ym ïohkynti ïa ka hima U Blei .

translation.en: And they had a king over them , which is the angel of the bottomless pit , whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon , but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon .
translation.kha: Ki don u syiem uba synshar halor jong ki , uba long u angel uba khmih ïa ka liewlong ba khlem trai . Ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Hebru ka long u Abaddon ; bad ha ka ktien Grik ka long u Apollyon ( kaba mut u  Nongpynjot  ) .

translation.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time , but at the end it shall speak , and not lie : though it tarry , wait for it  ; because it will surely come , it will not tarry .
translation.kha: To buh ha ka jingthoh , namar kam pat dei ka por ba kan urlong . Hynrei ka por ka wan kloi , bad kaei kaba nga pyn-i ha me kan urlong . Ka i kumba ka wan suki jai , hynrei to ap ïa ka ; kan sa jia long shisha , bad yn ym pyntud ïa ka .

translation.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them , nor with their gods .
translation.kha: Wat ïateh kano kano ka jutang bad ki lane bad ki blei jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king of Israel had read the letter , that he rent his clothes , and said , Am I God , to kill and to make alive , that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy ? wherefore consider , I pray you , and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Israel u pule ïa ka shithi , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingkhuslai bad u kyang jam ,  Kumno u syiem Syria u khmih lynti ïa nga ban pynkhiah ïa une u briew ? Hato u pyrkhat ba nga dei U Blei , lem bad ka bor jong ka jingim bad ka jingïap ? Ka shai kdar ba u pyrshang ban sdang ïakajia bad nga !

translation.en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah , and built Ramah , that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
translation.kha: U Baasha u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad u tei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah khnang ban ym shah ïa ka leit ka wan sha Judah .

translation.en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments , and stood before the angel .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la ïeng hangta , u da phong ki jaiñ bajakhlia .

translation.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep : so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .
translation.kha: U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Bad kumta ma u bad uta u paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer it unto the  Lord   ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno u Israel lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong ryngkat hapdeng jong ki , uba kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang lane ïa kano kano ka jingkñia kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  hangno hangno lait tang ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he said unto them , When ye pray , say ,  Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name . Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done , as in heaven , so in earth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Haba phi duwai , to ong ïa kane :   ‘ Ko Kpa : Ai ba ka kyrteng jong me kan long kaba la pyndonburom ; ai ban wan ka Hima jong me .

translation.en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes , O prince s daughter ! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a cunning workman .
translation.kha: Ko kaba bhabriew tam napdeng ki kynthei , shano uba ieit jong phi u la leit ? To ïathuh ïa ngi na kano ka lynti uba ieit jong phi u leit , ba kumta ngi lah ban ïarap ïa phi ban shem ïa u .

translation.en: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me , O children of Israel ? saith the  Lord . Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt ? and the Philistines from Caphtor , and the Syrians from Kir ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , nga da pyrkhat ïa ki briew ka Sudan kumba nga leh ïa phi . Nga la wallam ïa ki nong Philistia na Krit bad ïa ki nong Syria na Kir , kumba nga la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt .

translation.en: And I will sow them among the people : and they shall remember me in far countries  ; and they shall live with their children , and turn again .
translation.kha: Wat la nga la pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , pynban ha ki jaka kiba jngai eh kin kynmaw ïa nga . Ma ki bad ki khun jong ki kin lait im bad kin wan phai lang sha ïing .

translation.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for , thou camest down , the mountains flowed down at thy presence .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka por mynba me wan bad leh ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba ngim shym khmih lynti ; ki lumbah ki ïohi ïa me bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there : and they came not for Jesus  sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead .
translation.kha: Bun bah ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la don ha Bethania , kumta ki la leit shata , ym tang namar jong U Jisu hynrei ban ïohi ruh ïa u Lasaros , ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back , that they should not go with him to battle , fell upon the cities of Judah , from Samaria even unto Beth–horon , and smote three thousand of them , and took much spoil .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ki shipai Israel kiba u Amasaïah um shym la shah ba kin leit sha ka thma bad u ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Judia hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Beth Horon , ki la pynïap lai hajar ngut ki rangbah , bad ki la kurup shibun ki mar lute .

translation.en: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun , and it seemed great unto me :
translation.kha: Don sa kaei kaei kawei pat kaba nga la ïohi , ka nuksa kaba bha shaphang kumno ïa ka jingstad la ñiew ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Achbor the son of Michaiah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,
translation.kha: bad ai ïa kane ka hukum ha u Hilkaïah u lyngdoh , ha u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ha u Akhbor u khun jong u Mikaïah , ha u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ha u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :

translation.en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea , which cannot be measured nor numbered  ; and it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people , there it shall be said unto them , Ye are the sons of the living God .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Israel kin sa bun kum u shyiap ka duriaw , kin bun haduh bym lah shuh ban ñiew lane ban thew . Mynta U Blei u ong ïa ki ,  Phim dei ki briew jong nga ,  hynrei ka sngi kan poi ha kaba un ong ha ki ,  Phi dei ki khun jong U Blei uba im .

translation.en: And it came to pass from that time forth , that the half of my servants wrought in the work , and the other half of them held both the spears , the shields , and the bows , and the habergeons  ; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah .
translation.kha: Naduh kata , shiteng na ki rangbah jong nga ki trei bad shiteng ki ïeng ban ap phira , da kaba phong ki jingphong jong ka jingkieng atiar bad bat da ki sum , ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ai ka jingkyrshan batylli ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: And , Whosoever shall swear by the altar , it is nothing  ; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it , he is guilty .
translation.kha: Phi hikai ruh , ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da ka duwan , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka jingai sngewbha halor ka duwan , u long uba la shah teh .’

translation.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the  Lord  in the sabbaths , in the new moons , and on the set feasts , by number , according to the order commanded unto them , continually before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: bad ha man ba thang ïa ki jingainguh ba la ai sha U  Trai  ha ka Sabbaton , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha kiwei kiwei ki Jingkhawai Niam . La thaw ïa ki jingpynbeit ryntih da kaba kdew ïa ka jingdon ki Lebi kiba la pynkhamti ban leh ïa kane ka kam man ka por .

translation.en: If I bear witness of myself , my witness is not true .
translation.kha: Lada nga phla na ka bynta ïa lade , ïa kaei kaba nga ong ym dei ban pdiang kum ka jingpynshisha kaba dei .

translation.en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign : according to all that he hath done shall ye do : and when this cometh , ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Te ngan long ka dak ïa pha ; phan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh . U  Trai  u ong ba haba kane kan jia , phan ïoh tip ba u long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee ? will he enter with thee into judgment ?
translation.kha: Kam dei namar ba phi ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei ba u sneng ïa phi bad wanrah ïa phi sha ka jingbishar .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  No man , having put his hand to the plough , and looking back , is fit for the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Uno uno uba sdang ban lur bad nangta uba ïai kyrtiang dien um long uba myntoi ïa ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: And when he met with us at Assos , we took him in , and came to Mitylene .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïashem ïa ngi ha Assos , ngi la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng bad ngi la leit sha Mitylene .

translation.en: And Peter went out , and wept bitterly .
translation.kha: U Petros u la mihnoh bad u la ïam sngewsih eh .

translation.en: Son of man , take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre , and say unto him , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Thou sealest up the sum , full of wisdom , and perfect in beauty .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to sngewsih ïa ka kupar kaba ap ïa u syiem ka Tyros . Ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Shisien me la long u nuksa jong ka jingjanai . Katno uba stad bad uba bhabriew me la long !

translation.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa kata , ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa kaei kaba ki nongaplangbrot ki la ong .

translation.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ma me da ka bor bad ka mon jong me , me la lah thmu ba kan jia .

translation.en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think , according to the power that worketh in us ,
translation.kha: Ha uta uba da ka bor jong u kaba trei ha ngi u lah ban leh kham palat ban ïa kaba ngi pan , lane wat ïa kaba ngi pyrkhat ;

translation.en: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand , and set it down before the altar of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un shim ïa kata ka shang na phi bad buh ïa ka ha khmat ka duwan U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ;

translation.en: Leave thy fatherless children , I will preserve them alive  ; and let thy widows trust in me .
translation.kha: Ieh ïa ki khunswet bad nga , bad ngan sumar ïa ki . Ki riewkynthei ki lah ban shaniah ha nga .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And immediately he received his sight , and followed Jesus in the way .
translation.kha: Khie leit ,  U Jisu u ong ïa u ,  ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .  Mar kumta hi u la lah ban ïohi bad u la bud ïa U Jisu ha ka lynti .

translation.en: But I would not have you to be ignorant , brethren , concerning them which are asleep , that ye sorrow not , even as others which have no hope .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit , ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingshisha shaphang kito kiba la ïap , khnang ba phin ym sngewsih , kumba long kito ki bym don ka jingkyrmen .

translation.en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour , as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal .
translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ki jingphohsniew ba ki ïathuh kin pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban klet ïa nga , kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la klet ïa nga bad phai sha u Baal .

translation.en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and put my sword in his hand : but I will break Pharaoh s arms , and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan pynlong ïa ki ksang ti jong u syiem ka Babilonia kaba khlaiñ bad ngan buh ïa ka waitlam jong nga ha ki kti jong u . Hynrei ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt , bad un ud bad ïap ha khmat u nongshun jong u .

translation.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues , and the uppermost rooms at feasts :
translation.kha: kiba jied ban buh jaka lypa ha ki synagog bad jied ïa ki jaka babha tam ha ki jingkhawai .

translation.en: It is better to trust in the  Lord  than to put confidence in princes .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban ïa kaba shaniah ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew .

translation.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful , he said ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u la sngewsih bad u la ong ,  Katno ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew bariewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei !

translation.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .

translation.en: Go to now , ye rich men , weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , phi ki briew kiba riewspah , to shahshkor ïa nga ! to ïam bad to lynñiar ïa ki jinglanot ki ban wan hap ha phi !

translation.en: And her adversary also provoked her sore , for to make her fret , because the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
translation.kha: Ka Peninnah , kaba ju pyrshah ïa ka , ka pynshitom bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ka , namar ba U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ka .

translation.en: Circumcised the eighth day , of the stock of Israel , of the tribe of Benjamin , an Hebrew of the Hebrews ; as touching the law , a Pharisee ;
translation.kha: La otsher ïa nga haba nga la don shi taïew ka rta . Nga long u Israel naduh ba la kha ïa nga , na ka jait Benjamin , u Hebru uba nylla . Ha ka liang kaba sumar ïa ka hukum ki Jiw , nga la long u Pharisi , bad nga la long uba shitrhem katta katta haduh ba nga la pynshitom ïa ka balang .

translation.en: And David was displeased , because the  Lord  had made a breach upon Uzza : wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day .
translation.kha: bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Peres Ussah naduh kata ka por . U Dabid u la bitar namar U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u Ussah ha ka jingbitar .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben , Shall your brethren go to war , and shall ye sit here ?
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Phi ïakwah ban shong ban sah hangne katba kiwei pat ki Israel kin leit sha ka thma ?

translation.en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead , they departed every man unto his place .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ba u Abimelekh u la ïap , baroh ki leit phai noh sha ïing .

translation.en: And he said , What is the thing that the  Lord  hath said unto thee ? I pray thee hide it not from me : God do so to thee , and more also , if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh aïu ha phi ?  u Eli u kylli .  Wat buhrieh ei ei na nga . U Blei un pynshitom jur ïa phi lada phim ïathuh lut ha nga kat ïa kaba u la ong .

translation.en: And when Herod would have brought him forth , the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers , bound with two chains : and the keepers before the door kept the prison .
translation.kha: Ha ka miet shuwa ba u Herod un wallam ïa u sha u paidbah , u Petros u dang ïohthiah hapdeng ar ngut ki nongap phira . La teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri , bad la don ki nongap phira kiba ap ha ka khyrdop jong ka byndi .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait im ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .

translation.en: That I may see the good of thy chosen , that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation , that I may glory with thine inheritance .
translation.kha: Ai ba ngan ïohi ïa ka jingroi jingpar ki briew jong me bad ïadon bynta ha ka jingkmen jong ka jaitbynriew jong me , ha ka jingsarong bakmen jong kito kiba long ki jong me .

translation.en: And certain women , which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities , Mary called Magdalene , out of whom went seven devils ,
translation.kha: bad kumta ruh katto katne ngut ki kynthei kiba la ïohkhiah na ki mynsiem bymman bad ki jingpang : Ka Mari ( kaba la khot , ka nong Magdala ) , na ka ba la beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki ksuid ;

translation.en: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers , nor the desire of women , nor regard any god : for he shall magnify himself above all .
translation.kha: U syiem un ym suidñiew ïa u blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la shakri , bad ruh ïa u blei ba ki kynthei ki ieit . Ha ka jingshisha un ym suidñiew ïa uno uno u blei , namar un pyrkhat ba u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno na ki .

translation.en: What will ye ? shall I come unto you with a rod , or in love , and in the spirit of meekness ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi kham jied ? Hato ngan wan sha phi da u dieng sympat , ne ha ka mynsiem ka jingieit bad ka jingjemnud ?

translation.en: They have spoken words , swearing falsely in making a covenant : thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field .
translation.kha: Ki kren ki ktien bym don jingmut bad pynlong ki jingkular lamler bad ki jingïateh kular bymlarkam . Ka hok ka kylla long bymhok , ka nang san kum ki ñiut ba long bih ha ka lyngkha ba la dep lur .

translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments , and shall teach men so , he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven : but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno u bymkohnguh wat ïa iba rit tam jong ki hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei pat ban leh kumjuh , un long uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki bneng . Ha kawei pat ka liang , uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei ban leh kumjuh , un long uba khraw ha ka Hima ki Bneng .

translation.en: And they called unto Lot , and said unto him , Where are the men which came in to thee this night ? bring them out unto us , that we may know them .
translation.kha: Ki pyrta ïa u Lot bad kylli ïa u ,  Hangno kito ki rangbah kiba wan sah bad me ha kane ka miet ? Pynmih ïa ki shabar !  Ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki kwah ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki .

translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies  ; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months .
translation.kha: Ïa u mradkhlaw la shah ban pynlong ki jingkob sarong kiba long ki jingbeiñ ïa U Blei , bad la shah ïa u ban don ka bor synshar haduh sawphew ar bnai .

translation.en: And the sons of Merari  ; Mahli and Mushi : these are the families of Levi according to their generations .
translation.kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : U Mahli bad u Mushi . Kine ki long ki jait jong ki Lebi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .

translation.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it , no , not so much as to set his foot on : yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession , and to his seed after him , when as yet he had no child .
translation.kha: U Blei , mynkata , um shym la ai ha u Abraham ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka kum ka jong u hi , ym wat shi mitar sawdong jong ka khyndew , hynrei U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa ka ha u , bad ba kan long ka jong u bad ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ha ka por ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkular , u Abraham um pat don khun .

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes , the governors , and the captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
translation.kha: Te u syiem u la ai hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ban ïawanlang — ki khun syiem shynrang , ki lat , ki lat kiba kham hapoh , ki kommisshonor , ki nongbat tyngka , ki nongbishar , ki majistor , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ki jylla . Ki la dei ban wan sha ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka durbriew kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la kut jingmut ban ïaid ha ki lynti kiba ki briew basniew ki ïaid borabor ?

translation.en: And Nob , the city of the priests , smote he with the edge of the sword , both men and women , children and sucklings , and oxen , and asses , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: U Saul u la phah pynïap ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongshong shnong ha Nob , ka nongbah jong ki lyngdoh : ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , ki masi , ki kada , bad ki langbrot — ki la shah pynïap lut khoit .

translation.en: He wandereth abroad for bread , saying , Where is it ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand .
translation.kha: bad ki pukni ki ap ban ïoh puh ïa ka metïap jong u .

translation.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him  ; but he refused to be comforted  ; and he said , For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning . Thus his father wept for him .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong u baroh ki la ïawan ban pyntngen ïa u , hynrei u kyntait ban shah pyntngen bad u ong ,  Ngan leit noh sha ka ri kiba ïap bad ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u khun jong nga .  Kumta u ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u Joseph u khun jong u .

translation.en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel  ; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more : and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , the Holy One in Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan pynthikna ba ki briew jong nga ki Israel kin tip ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom . Te ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And he had two wives  ; the name of the one was Hannah , and the name of the other Peninnah : and Peninnah had children , but Hannah had no children .
translation.kha: U Elkanah u don ar ngut ki tnga , ka Hannah bad ka Peninnah . Ka Peninnah ka don ki khun ki kti , hynrei ka Hannah kam shym la don khun .

translation.en: For here have we no continuing city , but we seek one to come .
translation.kha: Naba ym don ka nongbah kaba ïaineh na ka bynta jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei , ngi ap khmih ïa ka nongbah ka ban sa wan .

translation.en: Then was Daniel brought in before the king . And the king spake and said unto Daniel , Art thou that Daniel , which art of the children of the captivity of Judah , whom the king my father brought out of Jewry ?
translation.kha: Ïa u Daniel la wallam shisyndon shapoh sha ka jaka ba don u syiem , bad u syiem u la ong ha u ,  Hato me dei u Daniel , uto u Jiw uba shah ringmraw ïa uba u kpa jong nga u syiem u la wallam hangne na Judah ?

translation.en: Behold , in this thou art not just : I will answer thee , that God is greater than man .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , ko Job , phi la bakla . U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew .

translation.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites , whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered , after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,
translation.kha: bad ai ïa kata ka rupa ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: Lift up your eyes , and behold them that come from the north : where is the flock that was given thee , thy beautiful flock ?
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ha khmih ! Ki nongshun jong pha ki wan hiar na shatei ! Hangno ki briew kiba la buh ha ka jingsumar jong pha , ki briew jong pha kiba pha la sngewsarong haduh katta katta ?

translation.en: And Aaron said unto Moses , Alas , my lord , I beseech thee , lay not the sin upon us , wherein we have done foolishly , and wherein we have sinned .
translation.kha: u la ong ha u Moses ,  Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat pynlong ïa ngi ban shah pynshitom namar ka jingleh pop ha ka jingbieit .

translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou be kind to this people , and please them , and speak good words to them , they will be thy servants for ever .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Lada phi lehsbun ïa kine ki briew bad phi pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki , da kaba ai ka jubab kaba jem kin shakri hok ïa phi borabor .

translation.en: Daniel answered and said , Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever : for wisdom and might are his :
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor ! to ïaroh ïa u junom la junom .

translation.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice : for I am not come to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad to wad kaei ka jingmut ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong : ‘ Dei ïa ka jingsbun ba nga kwah , ym ki jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew badonburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the time was come that he should be received up , he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Katba ka por ka nang jan haba ïa U Jisu yn shim noh sha bneng , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingmut bad u la leit ha la ka lynti sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Because ye have said , We have made a covenant with death , and with hell are we at agreement  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , it shall not come unto us : for we have made lies our refuge , and under falsehood have we hid ourselves :
translation.kha: Phi sarong ba phi la pynlong ïa ka jingïateh bad ka jingïap bad poi sha ka jingïakut bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Phi sngewthikna ba phin lait na ka jingjot haba kan wan , namar phi shaniah ha ki jinglamler bad ki jingshukor ban pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: The Lord  God  hath given me the tongue of the learned , that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary : he wakeneth morning by morning , he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la hikai ïa nga kaei ban ong , khnang ba ngan lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa kiba tlot bor . Man la ka step u pynlong ïa nga ban thrang eh ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba un hikai ïa nga .

translation.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David : and Abijah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid bad u khun jong u , u Abijah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga u la ong ,

translation.en: Only Luke is with me . Take Mark , and bring him with thee : for he is profitable to me for the ministry .
translation.kha: Tang u Loukas u don bad nga . Leit wad ïa u Markos bad wan ïalam ïa u ryngkat bad me , namar u lah ban ïarap ïa nga .

translation.en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver , and of gold , and of precious things , with fenced cities in Judah : but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram  ; because he was the firstborn .
translation.kha: U kpa jong ki u la ai ha ki shibun ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad kiwei kiwei ki markordor , bad u la buh ïa uwei pa uwei na ki ban peit ïa kawei kawei ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah ; hynrei namar u Jehoram u dei uba nyngkong eh , u Jehoshaphat u la pynlong ïa u , u nongmih bujli jong u .

translation.en: Speak now in the ears of the people , and let every man borrow of his neighbour , and every woman of her neighbour , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold .
translation.kha: Mynta kren ha ki paid Israel bad ong ïa ki baroh ban pan na la ki paramarjan ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa .

translation.en: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew , that I might gain the Jews ; to them that are under the law , as under the law , that I might gain them that are under the law ;
translation.kha: Katba nga dang trei bad ki Jiw , nga im kum u Jiw khnang ban jop ïa ki ; bad wat la ma nga hi ngam long hapoh ka Hukum u Moses , nga im kumba nga la long mynba nga dang trei bad kito kiba hapoh ka hukum , khnang ba ngan jop ïa ki .

translation.en: But thou shalt remember the  Lord  thy God : for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba dei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba ai spah ïa phi , ba un ïoh pynskhem haduh kane ka sngi ïa kata ka jutang ba u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah , twenty and four years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah u la long u syiem ka Israel baroh kawei , bad u la synshar arphew saw snem ha Tirsah .

translation.en: And the woman said to Elijah , Now by this I know that thou art a man of God , and that the word of the  Lord  in thy mouth is truth .
translation.kha: Ka la jubab ,  Mynta nga tip ba me long u briew jong U Blei , bad ba U  Trai  da shisha u kren lyngba jong me !

translation.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder , and bind it as a crown to me .
translation.kha: ngan sdien ïa kita ha la ka tyrpeng da kaba sngewsarong bad ngan buh ïa ki ha ka khlieh kum ka pansngiat .

translation.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba stad ki kren , ki pynlong ïa ka jingtip kaba pdiang hun , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki khlei ïa ka jingbieit .

translation.en: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun , and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold , as the light of seven days , in the day that the  Lord  bindeth up the breach of his people , and healeth the stroke of their wound .
translation.kha: U bnai un sa shai phyrnai kat ka sngi , bad ka sngi kan shai phyrnai hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba ju long , kum ka jingshai jong ki hynñiew sngi ha kawei ka sngi . Kane baroh kan jia haba U  Trai  un sop spaiñ bad pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong kiba u la ai ha ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi baroh : ïa kaei kaba phi khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ha bneng , bad ïa kaei kaba phi shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ha bneng .

translation.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning , and took the stone that he had put for his pillows , and set it up for a pillar , and poured oil upon the top of it .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la khie dang step phyrngab , u shim ïa uta u maw ïa uba u la syngkhlieh , bad u thung ïa u ban sah jingkynmaw . Nangta u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u ban pynkyntang ïa u sha U Blei .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I have dreamed a dream , and there is none that can interpret it : and I have heard say of thee , that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u ,  Nga la phohsniew ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai ïa ka . La ïathuh ha nga ba me lah ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew .

translation.en: Now there are diversities of gifts , but the same Spirit .
translation.kha: Ki don bun jait ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , hynrei ujuh U Mynsiem u ai ïa ki .

translation.en: And ye shall be holy unto me : for I the  Lord  am holy , and have severed you from other people , that ye should be mine .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban long kiba khuid ïa nga , namar nga long U  Trai  bad nga long uba khuid . Nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ba phin long ki jong nga .

translation.en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh : For God , said he , hath made me forget all my toil , and all my father s house .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga ban klet ïa ki jingshah shitom baroh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong i pa jong nga  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa uba nyngkong , u Manasseh .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Suffer it to be so now : for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness .  Then he suffered him .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ai ba kan long kumta ïa mynta . Naba kumne keiñ ngin pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba U Blei u dawa .  Kumta u Ïoannis u la mynjur .

translation.en: Then Daniel answered and said before the king , Let thy gifts be to thyself , and give thy rewards to another  ; yet I will read the writing unto the king , and make known to him the interpretation .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Buh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong phi na ka bynta ïa lade lane ai ïa ki hano hano ha uwei pat . Ngan pule na ka bynta u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba la thoh bad ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: And God Almighty bless thee , and make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , that thou mayest be a multitude of people  ;
translation.kha: To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un kyrkhu ïa ka shongkha shongman jong me bad un ai ïa me bun ki khun ki kti , ba men ïoh long u kpa jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines came up to seek David  ; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa ki Philistia ba la thung ïa u Dabid kum u syiem ki Israel , kumta ka kynhun shipai jong ki ka la mih ban leit kem ïa u . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u la leit hiar sha ka jaka ba la ker kynroh .

translation.en: A loving husband treats his wife with tenderness and understanding .
translation.kha: U tnga uba ieit u sumar bha ïa la ka tnga , da ka jingieit bad da ka jingsngewthuh .

translation.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Syria na Damaskos ki la phah ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u Hadadeser , u Dabid u la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: I was at ease , but he hath broken me asunder : he hath also taken me by my neck , and shaken me to pieces , and set me up for his mark .
translation.kha: Nga la im ha ka jingsuk , hynrei U Blei u shim ïa nga na ryndang bad shoh bad pynlwet ïa nga . U Blei u pyndonkam ïa nga kum ka sohpdung

translation.en: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say , A measure of wheat for a penny , and three measures of barley for a penny  ; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum ka sur kaba wan napdeng ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kaba la ong ,  Shi kilo u kew na ka bynta ka bainong shi sngi , bad lai kilo u barli na ka bynta ka bainong shi sngi . Hynrei wat pynjot noh ïa ki dieng Olib bad ïa ki bri sohwaiñ !
