translation.en: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel , saying , If ye do return unto the  Lord  with all your hearts , then put away the strange gods and Ashtoreth from among you , and prepare your hearts unto the  Lord  , and serve him only : and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Lada phin phai sha U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , phi dei ban bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baroh bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Astarte . Pynkyntang lut ïa lade sha U  Trai  bad mane tang ïa u , te un pyllait ïa phi na ka bor ki Philistia .

translation.en: O ye children of Benjamin , gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem , and blow the trumpet in Tekoa , and set up a sign of fire in Beth–haccerem : for evil appeareth out of the north , and great destruction .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Benjamin , to phet ban lait im ! Phet noh na Jerusalem ! Pynsawa ïa ka turoi ha Tekoa bad to thaw ka ding-ai-dak ha Beth Hakkherem . Ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot ki la wan artat na shatei .

translation.en: Arise , lift up the lad , and hold him in thine hand  ; for I will make him a great nation .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit bad khie leit shim ïa u , bad khroh ïa u . Ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble , as a strong people set in battle array .
translation.kha: Katba ki kynthih halor ki lumbah , ki riew kum ki kali ïapom ; ki sawa kum u phlangïap ha ka ding . Ki ïeng laiñ kum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: The king s wrath is as the roaring of a lion  ; but his favour is as dew upon the grass .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar u syiem ka long kum ka jingkyrhuh u sing , hynrei ka jingsngewbha jong u ka long kum u slap ba pdiang hun .

translation.en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land , and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it :
translation.kha: Nga shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga namar ki kam pynïap briew ba ki la leh ha ka ri bad namar ki bleithaw da kiba la pyntngit ïa ka .

translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves ?
translation.kha: bad u Abimelekh u kylli ïa u ,  Phi leh lei kumne ?

translation.en: Strangers have devoured his strength , and he knoweth it not : yea , gray hairs are here and there upon him , yet he knoweth not .
translation.kha: Ki shaniah ha ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ki bad kim sngewthuh ba kane ka jingshaniah ha ki nongwei ka la bam duh noh ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Ki sngi jong ki , ki la jan kut , hynrei kim shym la tip ïa kata .

translation.en: And Festus said , King Agrippa , and all men which are here present with us , ye see this man , about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me , both at Jerusalem , and also here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la ong ,  Ko syiem Agrippa bad baroh kiba don hangne bad ngi : Phi ïohi ïa une u briew ïa uba ki Jiw baroh , kiba hangne bad ha Jerusalem , ki la wallam ki jingujor sha nga . Ki pyrta ba um dei shuh ban im .

translation.en: And Deborah said unto Barak , Up  ; for this is the day in which the  Lord  hath delivered Sisera into thine hand : is not the  Lord  gone out before thee ? So Barak went down from mount Tabor , and ten thousand men after him .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Deborah ka ong ïa u Barak ,  Khie leit ! U  Trai  u ïalam ïa me ! Ha kane ka sngi u la ai ha me ka jingjop halor u Sisera .  Kumta u Barak u la leit arsut na u Lum Tabor lem bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah jong u .

translation.en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die : and he called his son Joseph , and said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh , and deal kindly and truly with me  ; bury me not , I pray thee , in Egypt :
translation.kha: Shuwa ba u Jakob un ïap , u khot ïa u Joseph u khun jong u , bad u ong ha u ,  Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong nga , bad kular da shisha ba phin ym tep ïa nga ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And they set them up Micah s graven image , which he made , all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh .
translation.kha: Ka bleithaw u Mikah ka ïaisah hangta ha kaba ka Ïingjaiñ ba mane ïa U Blei ka dang sah ha Shiloh .

translation.en: Jesus said ,  Take ye away the stone .  Martha , the sister of him that was dead , saith unto him , Lord , by this time he stinketh : for he hath been dead four days .
translation.kha: Pyntyllun noh ïa u mawkhang !  U Jisu u la hukum . Ka Martha , ka hynmen uta uba la ïap , ka la jubab ,  Kan sa don ka jingsma iwtung , ko Trai . La lah tep ïa u la saw sngi .

translation.en: And six branches going out of the sides thereof  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof :
translation.kha: Hynriew tylli ki tnat ki mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me .
translation.kha: Ïa ka shithi kaba phi la phah , la pynkylla ktien bad pule ha nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee : for they have not rejected thee , but they have rejected me , that I should not reign over them .
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u paidbah u ong ha me ; mem long ma me uba ki kyntait , Nga long ma nga ïa uba ki la kyntait kum u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: My little children , these things write I unto you , that ye sin not . And if any man sin , we have an advocate with the Father , Jesus Christ the righteous :
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane ha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , khnang ba phin ym leh pop ; hynrei lada uno uno u leh pop , ngi don uwei uba ïasaid bad U Kpa na ka bynta jong ngi — U Jisu Khrist , uta uba hok .

translation.en: But the  Lord  is the true God , he is the living God , and an everlasting king : at his wrath the earth shall tremble , and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long U Blei bashisha , me long U Blei uba im bad u syiem bymjukut . Haba me bitar , ka pyrthei ka khynñiuh ; ki jaitbynriew kim lah shah ïa ka jingbitar jong me .

translation.en: And Bath–sheba bowed , and did obeisance unto the king . And the king said , What wouldest thou ?
translation.kha: Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon ha khmat u syiem , bad u ong ,  Pha kwah aïu ?

translation.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes , nor regardeth the rich more than the poor ? for they all are the work of his hands .
translation.kha: Um ïashah liang bad ki nongsynshar ne pynpaw ba u kham lah ïa kiba riewspah ban ïa kiba duk , naba u la thaw ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: The king of Madon , one  ; the king of Hazor , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Madon , ka Hasor ,

translation.en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them : and they shall fear no more , nor be dismayed , neither shall they be lacking , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan thung ïa ki nongsynshar ki ban sumar ïa ki . Ki briew jong nga kin ym sheptieng ne sngewshyrkhei , bad ngan ym pynshitom shuh ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite , and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite :
translation.kha: Haba u Iso u la dap sawphew snem ka rta , u shongkurim ïa ar ngut ki kynthei Hit , ka Judith ka khun jong u Beeri bad ka Basemath ka khun jong u Elon .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Asher ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Before the mountains were settled , before the hills was I brought forth :
translation.kha: La kha ïa nga shuwa ki lumbah , ha shuwa ban pynïeng ïa ki lumrit ,

translation.en: He keepeth the paths of judgment , and preserveth the way of his saints .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa kito kiba lehhok ïa kiwei pat , bad u ïada ïa kito kiba aiti ha u .

translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria , which took Manasseh among the thorns , and bound him with fetters , and carried him to Babylon .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u shah ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . Ki la kem ïa u Manasseh , ki pyndait jingbnoh ha u , ki teh ki kynjri ïa u , bad ïalam ïa u sha Babilon .

translation.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity , that thou hast transgressed against the  Lord  thy God , and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree , and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Shu pdiang ba pha la bakla bad ba pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong pha . To phla ba hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam pha la ai ïa la ka jingieit ha ki blei nongwei bad ba pham shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Artaxerxes , king of kings , unto Ezra the priest , a scribe of the law of the God of heaven , perfect peace , and at such a time .
translation.kha: Na u patsha Artakserksis ha u Esra , u lyngdoh , riewstad ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng .

translation.en: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head : for that is even all one as if she were shaven .
translation.kha: Bad kano kano ka briew kaba duwai ne pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha ka jingïamane Blei lang khlem da tap ïa la ka khlieh ka pynjahburom ïa la u tnga ; kam don jingïapher hapdeng jong ka bad ka briew kaba la khi noh ïa la ka khlieh .

translation.en: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard , and his feet were as the feet of a bear , and his mouth as the mouth of a lion : and the dragon gave him his power , and his seat , and great authority .
translation.kha: Uta u mradkhlaw u ïasyriem ïa u  labasa , bad ki kjat kum ki kjat dngiem bad ka shyntur u kum ka shyntur sing . U Ïakjakor u la ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong u hi , ïa ka khet jong u , bad ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u .

translation.en: One is so near to another , that no air can come between them .
translation.kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei la pynïadait skhem bad kawei pat , ba wat ka lyer ruh kam lah ban rung hapdeng .

translation.en: And so Pilate , willing to content the people , released Barabbas unto them , and delivered Jesus , when he had scourged him , to be crucified .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u paidbah , kumta u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki . Nangta u la phah sympat ïa u Jisu bad aiti ïa u ban shah sahnarphna .

translation.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish  ; howl , ye inhabitants of the isle .
translation.kha: To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki briew ka Phoenisia ! Pyrshang ban phet ïap sha Spain !

translation.en: And there are also many other things which Jesus did , the which , if they should be written every one , I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written . Amen .
translation.kha: Mynta , don bun kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba U Jisu u la leh . Lada la thoh ïa ki baroh kawei pa kawei , nga tharai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan ym ngiam jaka ïa ki kitab ha kiba yn thoh .

translation.en: He is the Rock , his work is perfect : for all his ways are judgment : a God of truth and without iniquity , just and right is he .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong phi , ki lynti jong u ki long kiba janai , bad bahok ; U Blei jong phi u long uba ïaineh bad uba shisha ; u leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba beit .

translation.en: Thus were their faces : and their wings were stretched upward  ; two wings of every one were joined one to another , and two covered their bodies .
translation.kha: Ïa ki ar tylli ki thapniang jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw la rah shajrong kumta ba ki dei ïa ki khmut thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-marsyndah , bad ki ar tylli ki thapniang ki tap ïa ki met jong ki .

translation.en: And when he had so said , there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided .
translation.kha: Mar ïakren ïa kane , ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi ki la sdang ban ïakajia , bad ka kynhun ka la ïa-pait arliang .

translation.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed : but in the multitude of counsellors they are established .
translation.kha: Lum ïa ki jingai jingmut baroh katba phi lah , bad phin jop ; khlem kata phin shahjop .

translation.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood , but against principalities , against powers , against the rulers of the darkness of this world , against spiritual wickedness in high places .
translation.kha: Naba ngim ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew hynrei pyrshah ïa ki bor bymman ba kynja mynsiem ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng , ki nongsynshar , ki bor synshar , bad ki bor pyrthei jong kane ka juk ba-dum .

translation.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden  ; and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein was never man yet laid .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka ha kaba la pynïap ïa U Jisu , bad ha kata ka kper la don ka jingtep kaba thymmai ha kaba ym pat shym la tep ïano ïano .

translation.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid , and rose up , and went every man his way .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u Adonijah ki la sheptieng , bad baroh ki la ïeng joit bad leit noh , uwei uwei ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle , note that man , and have no company with him , that he may be ashamed .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba yn don uno uno u ban ym kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba ngi phah sha phi ha kane ka shithi . Lada ka long kumta , khmih ïa u bad wat ïadon bynta ei ei bad u , khnang ba un lehrain .

translation.en: A study of What Does the Bible Really Teach ? or a similar book published by Jehovah’s Witnesses is recommended in preparation for baptism .
translation.kha: Shuwa ban shim ïa ka jingpynbaptis kan kham bha lada pule sa kawei de ka kot ba la pynmih da ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .

translation.en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem , and cry unto her , that her warfare is accomplished , that her iniquity is pardoned : for she hath received of the  Lord s  hand double for all her sins .
translation.kha: To pynshlur ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem . To ïathuh ha ki ba ki la jynjar slem bha bad ïa ki pop jong ki la map mynta . Nga la pynshitom ïa ki la biang bha na ka bynta ki pop jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye shall say , Wherefore doeth the  Lord  our God all these things unto us ? then shalt thou answer them , Like as ye have forsaken me , and served strange gods in your land , so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli balei ba nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , ïathuh ïa ki , ko Jeremaïah , ba kumba ki la phai noh na nga bad shakri ïa ki blei nongwei ha ka ri jong ki hi , kumta kin shakri ïa ki nongwei ha ka ri ka bym dei ka jong ki .

translation.en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death : he hath cursed his father or his mother  ; his blood shall be upon him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .  Uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie un shah pynïap ; u la kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown ? would ye stay for them from having husbands ? nay , my daughters  ; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the  Lord  is gone out against me .
translation.kha: hato phi lah hi ban ap haduh ba kin da san ? Hato kane kan khanglad ïa phi na kaba shongkurim ïano ïano ? Em , ko khun kynthei jong nga , phi tip ba kata kam lah ban long . U  Trai  u la phai pyrshah ïa nga , bad nga sngewsih shikatdei eh ïa phi .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold , but climbeth up some other way , the same is a thief and a robber .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U briew u bym rung sha ka sem ki langbrot na ka jingkhang , hynrei uba shu kiew nawei pat , u long u nongtuh bad u nonglute .

translation.en: He found him in a desert land , and in the waste howling wilderness  ; he led him about , he instructed him , he kept him as the apple of his eye .
translation.kha: U lap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap ba ki ïaid sakma , ka ri shyiap kaba kynjah . Ïa ki u sumar bad u ker u da , kumba u ïada ïa lade .

translation.en: So the  Lord  blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning : for he had fourteen thousand sheep , and six thousand camels , and a thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand she asses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka bynta kaba khatduh jong ka jingim u Job kham palat ban ïa kaba u la kyrkhu ha kaba mynnyngkong . U Job u long trai ïa ki khatsaw hajar tylli ki langbrot , hynriew hajar tylli ki ut , ar hajar tylli ki masi , bad shihajar tylli ki kada .

translation.en: There shall nothing cast their young , nor be barren , in thy land : the number of thy days I will fulfil .
translation.kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei ha ka ri jong phi kaba hap khun lane kaba lyngki . Ngan pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi .

translation.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups , and I said unto them , Drink ye wine .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la buh ïa ki khuri bad ki pliang ba la dap waiñ ha khmat ki Rekhab , bad nga ong ïa ki ,  To dih waiñ khyndiat .

translation.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom .
translation.kha: U Solomon mynta u long u syiem .

translation.en: Now therefore , let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the  Lord  : for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea , as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains .
translation.kha: Wai ai ba ngan shah pynïap ha ka ri nongwei , jngai na U  Trai . Balei u syiem Israel un wan ban pynïap ïa u thyllah kum ïa nga ? Balei un beh ïa nga kumba beh ïa ka sim khlaw ?

translation.en: And whether we be afflicted , it is for your consolation and salvation , which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer : or whether we be comforted , it is for your consolation and salvation .
translation.kha: Lada ngi shahshitom , ka long na ka bynta ka jingïarap bad ka jingpynim jong phi ; lada la ïarap ïa ngi , te la ïarap ïa phi ruh bad la ai ïa ka bor ban ïaineh lem da ka jingïaishah ha kita kijuh ki jingshahshitom ba ngi ruh ngi la ïaineh .

translation.en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of his servants : and afterward it shall be inhabited , as in the days of old , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad ngan aiti ha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki , ha u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Hynrei shen hadien , ki briew kin shong kin sah biang ha Ijipt , kumba ki la leh ha ki por ba la leit . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And Abner said again to Asahel , Turn thee aside from following me : wherefore should I smite thee to the ground ? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother ?
translation.kha: Sa shisien u Abner u ong ha u ,  Sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa nga ! Balei men pynbor ïa nga ba ngan pynïap ïa me ? Kumno shuh ngan dang nud ban peit ïa ka khmat u Joab u hynmen jong me ?

translation.en: And he stood over her , and rebuked the fever  ; and it left her : and immediately she arose and ministered unto them .
translation.kha: U la leit bad ïeng harud ka jingthiah jong ka bad u la hukum ïa ka jingpang shit ban mihnoh na ka . Ka jingpang shit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la khie joit shisyndon bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa ki .

translation.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships , and servants that had knowledge of the sea  ; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir , and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold , and brought them to king Solomon .
translation.kha: U syiem Hiram u phah sha u ïa ki liengbah hapoh ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u hi ryngkat bad ba la ñiah da ki maji kiba la mlien bha . Kine ki leit bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Solomon sha ka ri ki Ophir , bad ki wan kit nangta palat khatsan hajar kilo ka ksiar ïa u syiem Solomon .

translation.en: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonished , as a mighty man that cannot save ? yet thou , O  Lord  , art in the midst of us , and we are called by thy name  ; leave us not .
translation.kha: Balei me long kum u briew uba la shah shim kynsan , kum u shipai u bymdonbor ban ïarap ? Da shisha , A  Trai  , me long bad ngi ! ngi long ki briew jong me ; wat iehnoh ïa ngi .’

translation.en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt , Jacob said unto his sons , Why do ye look one upon another ?
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u la tip ba don kew ha Ijipt , u ong ha la ki khun shynrang ,  Balei phim ïaleh ei ei ?

translation.en: ( Proverbs 6 :27-29 , 32 ) Wisely , therefore , the Bible urges : “Be happy with your wife and find your joy with the girl you married . . .
translation.kha: Ka jingklim bunsien ka pynjot ia ka longing longsem . —Proberb 6 :27-29 , 32 .

translation.en: And so did he unto them , and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel , that they slew them not .
translation.kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaba u Joshua u la leh : u ïada ïa ki bad um shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: And they cut off his head , and stripped off his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to publish it in the house of their idols , and among the people .
translation.kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlieh u Saul , ki loit noh ïa ki atiar jong u , bad ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Philistia ban pynbna ïa kata ka khubor babha sha ki blei jong ki bad ha ki briew jong ki .

translation.en: For it is written , He shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee :
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un hukum ïa ki angel jong u ban sumar bha ïa me .’

translation.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are , and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain : and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la long u briew kum ma ngi . U la duwai shitrhem ba kan ym hap slap , bad ym shym la hap slap halor ka khyndew haduh lai snem shiteng .

translation.en: Yea , his soul draweth near unto the grave , and his life to the destroyers .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong u mynta ka sdang ban leit noh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning , to return into the land of the Philistines . And the Philistines went up to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka step kaba bud u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki mihnoh dang step phyrngab ban leit phai sha ka ri ki Philistia , hynrei ki Philistia ki leit kiew sha Jesreel .

translation.en: He lost his job through his irresponsibility .
translation.kha: U duh ia ka kam jong u lyngba ka jingbymshimkhia jong u .

translation.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat , and for a place of refuge , and for a covert from storm and from rain .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong u kan kah ïa ka nongbah na ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka kaba shngain , kaba la da na u slap bad ka  erïong .

translation.en: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart : and the damsel s father said , Comfort thine heart , I pray thee . And they tarried until afternoon , and they did eat both of them .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba san u khreh ban mihnoh , hynrei u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong ,  Da bam shuwa , bad ap haduh ban da noh ka sngi .  Kumta kita baroh ar ngut ki ïabam ïadih lang .

translation.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near , and smote Micaiah upon the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u Mikaïah , u thab ïa u bad kylli ,  Naduh mynno u mynsiem U  Trai  u la mih na nga bad kren ha phi ?

translation.en: And the priest answered David , and said , There is no common bread under mine hand , but there is hallowed bread  ; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u ong ,  Ngam don shuh u kpu paidbah , don sa tang u kpu ba la pynkyntang ; phi lah ban bam ïa u tang lada ki rangbah jong phi kim shym la ïathiah shongkha dang shen .

translation.en: Beside the sabbaths of the  Lord  , and beside your gifts , and beside all your vows , and beside all your freewill offerings , which ye give unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kine ki Jingkhawai Niam ki long nalor ki Sabbaton ba ju rakhe , bad kine ki jingainguh ki long nalor ki jingai kiba phi ju ai , ki jingainguh ban pyndep ïa ka kular , bad ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites , that they might be encouraged in the law of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nalor kane ruh , u syiem u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kiba long ki bynta kiba dei jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , khnang ba ki lah ban ai ïa ka por jong ki baroh sha ki jingdawa jong ka Hukum jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And now , my daughter , fear not  ; I will do to thee all that thou requirest : for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman .
translation.kha: Ruth , mynta wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi pan ; kumba baroh ha shnong ki ïatip , phi dei ka kynthei kaba donburom .

translation.en: And , behold , a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts , and cried unto him , saying , Have mercy on me , O Lord , thou Son of David  ; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei nong Kanaan kaba shong ba sah ha kata ka thain ka la wan sha u .  Ko khun u Dabid !  ka la pyrta jam .  To isynei ïa nga , ko Kynrad ! Ka khun jong nga ka don u ksuid bad ka don ha ka jinglong bashyrkhei .

translation.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance : for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me , and art gone up  ; thou hast enlarged thy bed , and made thee a covenant with them  ; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it .
translation.kha: Phi pynïeng ïa ki blei ba-ijli ha khmat ka jingkhang ki jingkhang bah ki ïing jong phi . Phi la lyndet ïa nga ; phi law ïa la ki jaiñ bad kiew halor ki jingthiah baheh jong phi ryngkat bad kiba ieit jong phi , ïa kiba phi la siewdor ban ïathiah lang bad ki . Bad hangta phi pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong phi .

translation.en: His eyes were as a flame of fire , and on his head were many crowns  ; and he had a name written , that no man knew , but he himself .
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong u ki la long kum ka thylliej ding , bad u la phong shibun ki pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u . U la don ka kyrteng ïa kaba la thoh halor jong u ïa kaba ym don batip hynrei lait tang ma u hi .

translation.en: Them that sin rebuke before all , that others also may fear .
translation.kha: To sneng ha khmat kiba bun ïa kito baroh kiba leh ïa ki pop , khnang ba kita kiwei ruh kin sheptieng .

translation.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff , what hast thou found of all thy household stuff ? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren , that they may judge betwixt us both .
translation.kha: Mynta ba phi la khyllie lut ïa ki jingdon jingem jong nga baroh , ki tiar ïing aïu phi shem kiba dei ki jong phi ? To phriang ïa ki hangne ba ki briew jong phi bad ki jong nga kin ïohi , bad ai kin rai ba mano na ngi uba dei .

translation.en: For riches are not for ever : and doth the crown endure to every generation ?
translation.kha: namar ka spah kam neh junom . Ym don wat ki hima ruh ki ban neh junom .

translation.en: And these are the golden emerods which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering unto the  Lord   ; for Ashdod one , for Gaza one , for Ashkelon one , for Gath one , for Ekron one  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar ba ki Philistia ki phah pat kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingpalat sha U  Trai  ki long na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka shnong : Ka Ashdod , ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , ka Gath , bad ka Ekron .

translation.en: And said unto them , What will ye give me , and I will deliver him unto you ? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver .
translation.kha: bad u la kylli ,  Phin ai aïu ïa nga lada nga shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha phi ?  Ki la ñiew laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad ki la ai ïa kita ha u .

translation.en: For it is written in the law of Moses , Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn . Doth God take care for oxen ?
translation.kha: Ngi pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ,  Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh ïa u kew .  Mynta , hato U Blei u sngewkhia ïa u masi dab ?

translation.en: Wherefore if Demetrius , and the craftsmen which are with him , have a matter against any man , the law is open , and there are deputies : let them implead one another .
translation.kha: Lada u Demetrios bad ki nongtrei jong u ki don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïano ïano , ngi don ki bor synshar bad ki sngi kiba thikna ïa ka ïingbishar ; ïa ki jingmudui lah ban leh hangta .

translation.en: My son , attend to my words  ; incline thine ear unto my sayings .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; sngap ïa ki ktien jong nga .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image  ; which the  Lord  thy God hateth .
translation.kha: Wat pynïeng ruh ïa uno uno u païa maw na ka bynta ka jingmane bleithaw ; U  Trai  u isih ïa kita .

translation.en: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , Shall the sword devour for ever ? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? how long shall it be then , ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren ?
translation.kha: U Abner u pyrta ïa u Joab ,  Hato ngin hap ban ïaleh shi junom ? Hato mem ïohi ba ha kaba kut ym don ei ei hynrei tang ka jingkthang ? Ngi long ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi . Slem sa katno ha shuwa ba men hukum ïa ki rangbah jong me ban sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa ngi ?

translation.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger , and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
translation.kha: Uta uba da mutlop u kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ka ram u nongwei u dei hok ban buh ïa la ka jong ka jingdon jingem ban pynshisha ïa ka jingsiew .

translation.en: And he took his staff in his hand , and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook , and put them in a shepherd s bag which he had , even in a scrip  ; and his sling was in his hand : and he drew near to the Philistine .
translation.kha: U shim ïa la u diengduh bad u tam san tylli ki maw kiba jlih na ka wahduid bad u thep ïa ki ha ka pla kieng jong u . Lem bad ka jingshat maw ha kti , u tur ban ïakynduh ïa u Goliath .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long : for they are confounded , for they are brought unto shame , that seek my hurt .
translation.kha: Ngan kren shaphang ka hok jong me baroh shi sngi , namar kito kiba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa nga ki la shahjop bad shah pynlehrain .

translation.en: Even the life of an unborn child inside its mother is precious to Jehovah .
translation.kha: Wat ka jingim jong i khyllung i bym pat kha i ba don hakpoh jong ka kmie ruh i long iba kordor hakhmat U Jehobah .

translation.en: And thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy might .
translation.kha: Phin ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad da ka bor jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without , redeeming the time .
translation.kha: To long kiba stad ha ka rukom kaba phi leh ïa kiwei ki bym pat ngeit , da kaba pyndonkam ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa kawei pa kawei ka kabu kaba phi ïoh .

translation.en: Behold , I will bring evil upon thee , and will take away thy posterity , and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel ,
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan pynngat ïa ka jingjot ha me . Ngan sar noh phar ïa me , bad ngan pynduh khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang na ka longïing jong me , la u samla bad tymmen kumjuh .

translation.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate : for the hay is withered away , the grass faileth , there is no green thing .
translation.kha: Ka wahduid Nimrim ka rngad , u phlang harud jong ka u la ïapstai , bad ym don kano kano kaba jyrngam kaba dang sah .

translation.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof .
translation.kha: Bad ki lynti bah kin dap pat da ki khynnah shynrang bad kynthei kiba ïalehkai .

translation.en: And he searched , and began at the eldest , and left at the youngest : and the cup was found in Benjamin s sack .
translation.kha: U shakri jong u Joseph u la wad bniah da kaba sdang na uba nyngkong ter ter haduh uba khatduh , bad ïa ka khuri la shem ha ka byrni jong u Benjamin .

translation.en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .
translation.kha: U Jesse nangta u wan ïalam ïa u Shammah .  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïa une ruh  u Samuel u ong .

translation.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee : We have four men which have a vow on them  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me ban leh . Ki don saw ngut ki rangbah hangne kiba la shim jingsmai .

translation.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab : which Amasa was a man s son , whose name was Ithra an Israelite , that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah Joab s mother .
translation.kha: ( U Absalom u la buh ïa u Amasa ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . U Amasa u dei u khun jong u Jether u nong Ishmael ; ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka khun jong u Nahash bad ka para jong ka Seruïah , ka kmie jong u Joab . )

translation.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool  ; much less for a servant to have rule over princes .
translation.kha: Kiba bieit kim dei ban im ha ka pahuh pahai , bad ki mraw kim dei ban synshar halor ki briew badonburom .

translation.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai–roi  ; for he dwelt in the south country .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la wan sha ka ri khlaw jong  Ka Pukri jong uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga  bad ba u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shathie jong ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked , both riches , and honour : so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh ha me ïa kaei kaba mem shym la pan : baroh shi rta ka jingim jong me , men don ka spah bad ka burom , kham bun ban ïa kata ka jong uno uno uwei pat u syiem .

translation.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months : and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah .
translation.kha: U la synshar ha Hebron halor ka Judah haduh hynñiew snem shiteng , bad ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel bad Judah baroh haduh laiphew lai snem .

translation.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me , and mine ear received a little thereof .
translation.kha: Shisien ka khubor ka wan jar jar , kaba jar jar eh ba ngam da ïohsngew bha ïa ka .

translation.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord . Then prayed they him to tarry certain days .
translation.kha: Kumta u la hukum ba yn pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist . Te ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah bad ki sa khyndiat sngi .

translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven , but to them it is not given .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ïa ka jingtip shaphang kiei kiei kiba rieh jong ka Hima ki Bneng la ai ha phi , hynrei ym ha ki .

translation.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them , and served the  Lord  : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki bret noh ïa la ki blei nongwei bad ki la mane ïa U  Trai  ; bad u la pisa halor ka jingjynjar jong ki Israel .

translation.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination ? nay , they were not at all ashamed , neither could they blush : therefore they shall fall among them that fall : at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hato kin sngewlehrain namar ki la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli ? Em , kim shym la sngewlehrain satia ; kim tip hi ruh kumno ban sawkyr-ang . Bad kumta kin kyllon kumba kiwei ki la kyllon ; haba nga pynshitom ïa ki , kata kan long kaba kut jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master s servants that are come with thee : and as soon as ye be up early in the morning , and have light , depart .
translation.kha: Kumta te , Dabid , lashai dang step baroh na phi kiba la iehnoh ïa u Saul bad kiba la wan sha nga ki dei ban khie dang step bad mih mar shu kynjat shai .

translation.en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed , and sang praises unto God : and the prisoners heard them .
translation.kha: Kumba shiteng synñia , u Paul bad u Silas ki dang duwai bad rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U Blei bad kiwei pat ki koidi ki dang shahshkor ïa ki .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Hear , I pray you , this dream which I have dreamed :
translation.kha: U ong ,  Shahshkor ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga .

translation.en: In one house shall it be eaten  ; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house  ; neither shall ye break a bone thereof .
translation.kha: Dei ban bam ïa ka jingbam baroh hapoh ka ïing ha kaba la khreh ïa ka ; phim bit ban rah ïa ka shabar ; bad ym dei ban pynkheiñ wat tang kawei ruh ka shyieng jong u mrad .

translation.en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father  ; he turned not aside from it , doing that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  : nevertheless the high places were not taken away  ; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places .
translation.kha: Kum u Asa u kpa jong u , uba ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai  ; hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .

translation.en: Therefore the redeemed of the  Lord  shall return , and come with singing unto Zion  ; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head : they shall obtain gladness and joy  ; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away .
translation.kha: Kito kiba me la pyllait im kin ïoh poi ha Jerusalem da ka jingkmen , da kaba rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmen junom , junom kiba laitluid na ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang mynsiem .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thou hast said : nevertheless I say unto you , Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Me ong kumta . Hynrei nga ong ïa phi baroh : Naduh kane ka por phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u da shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Bakhrawbor tam bad u da wan ha ki lyoh bneng !

translation.en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear , and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign , saith the  Lord  , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ki un phet ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei , bad ki rangbah shipai kin sheptieng haduh katta katta haduh ba kin iehnoh ïa ki lama thma jong ki .  U  Trai  u la kren — U  Trai  ïa uba la mane ha Jerusalem bad uba ka ding jong u ka thang hangta ïa ki jingkñia .

translation.en: And saying , If thou be the king of the Jews , save thyself .
translation.kha: To pynim ïa lade lada me long u syiem ki Jiw !

translation.en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron , is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word ? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Namar ba me la phah ki nonglamktien ban kylli na u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron — i kumba ym don blei ha Israel ban kylli — men ym ïohkhiah ; men ïap !’

translation.en: And I will take thee , and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth , and shalt be king over Israel .
translation.kha: Jeroboam , ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel , bad men synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kat kaba me kwah .

translation.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine , he said unto Abner , the captain of the host , Abner , whose son is this youth ? And Abner said , As thy soul liveth , O king , I cannot tell .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa u Dabid ba u leit ban ïaleh bad u Goliath , u kylli ïa u Abner , u rangbah shipai jong u ,  Abner , u dei u khun jongno mo ?   Ngam don jingtip , syiem Kynrad ,  u Abner u jubab .

translation.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine : for he taught them as one that had authority , and not as the scribes .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka rukom ba u la hikai , namar um long kum ki nonghikai ka Hukum ; hynrei u la hikai da ka bor .

translation.en: He saith unto him , Which ? Jesus said ,  Thou shalt do no murder , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness ,
translation.kha: Ki hukum kiba kumno ?  u la kylli . U Jisu u la jubab ,  Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; wat tuh ; wat kynnoh bymdei ïano ïano ;

translation.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab , and on all his father s house  ; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue , or that is a leper , or that leaneth on a staff , or that falleth on the sword , or that lacketh bread .
translation.kha: To ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kane kan hap halor u Joab bad ka longïing jong u baroh ! Ha kawei pa kawei ka pateng to yn don u shynrang ha ka longïing jong u , uba don ka jingpang  ñiangkulia lane ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba shyrkhei lane uba hap ban trei tang ïa ka kam ba trei ki kynthei lane uba shah pynïap ha ka thma lane uba kyrduh bam !

translation.en: So the children went in and possessed the land , and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , and gavest them into their hands , with their kings , and the people of the land , that they might do with them as they would .
translation.kha: Ki la jop ïa ka ri Kanaan ; me la jop ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Me la ai ïa ki briew jong me ka bor ban leh ïa kaba ki sngewbha bad ki briew bad ki syiem ka Kanaan .

translation.en: And Ezra blessed the  Lord  , the great God . And all the people answered , Amen , Amen , with lifting up their hands : and they bowed their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  with their faces to the ground .
translation.kha: U Esra u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei uba khraw !  Baroh u paidbah u rah la ki kti shajrong bad ong ,  Amen ! Amen !  Ki dem khohsiew ha ka jingshakri , ki phai ki khmat jong ki sha khyndew .

translation.en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness , than , after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them .
translation.kha: Kan jin da la kham bha ïa ki ba kin ym jin da la tip ïa ka lynti ka hok ban ïa kaba tip ïa ka bad nangta pat ban phai dien noh na ka hukum bakyntang ïa kaba la ai ha ki .

translation.en: When I had waited , ( for they spake not , but stood still , and answered no more  ; )
translation.kha: Hato ngan ïai ap haduh ba kin da sngap jar ? Ki shu ïeng hangto khlem don ei ei shuh ban ong .

translation.en: And the king of Israel answered and said , My lord , O king , according to thy saying , I am thine , and all that I have .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u kynrad jong nga , u syiem Benhadad , ba nga mynjur ; u lah ban shim ïa nga bad ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga don ,  u Ahab u jubab .

translation.en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter , Art not thou also one of this man s disciples ? He saith , I am not .
translation.kha: Kata ka khynnah ha ka khyrdop ka la ong ha u Petros ,  Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong utai u briew ?   Em , ngam dei ,  la jubab u Petros .

translation.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also , and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place , whither he himself would come .
translation.kha: Hadien kane U Jisu u la jied sa hynñiewphew ar ngut ki rangbah bad u la phah ïa ki ar ar ngut , ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha ki shnong baroh bad ki jaka ha kaba ma u , u la mut ban leit .

translation.en: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho . And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sakkur , u khun jong u Imri u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge , God gave them over to a reprobate mind , to do those things which are not convenient ;
translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki briew ki la kyntait ban bat ha ka jingmut ïa ka jingtip bashisha shaphang U Blei , u la ai noh ïa ki sha ki jingmut bajakhlia , ba kumta ki leh ïa kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban leh .

translation.en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and every one of the curtains shall have one measure .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ kan long khat-ar mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ïa u Joshua

translation.en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward , and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth ?
translation.kha: Kumno uwei un sngewthikna ba ka mynsiem briew ka kiew artet katba ba ka mynsiem jong ka mrad ka hiar sha tbian sha ka khyndew ?

translation.en: They have sown wheat , but shall reap thorns : they have put themselves to pain , but shall not profit : and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la bet ïa u kew , hynrei ki la lum ïa ki ñiut ; ki la trei shitom , hynrei kim shym ïoh ei ei na ka bynta kata . Namar ka jingbitar shla jong nga ki jingthung jong ki kim shym long .

translation.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short , and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment ?
translation.kha: ym don u briew uba sniew uba kmen slem .

translation.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof , as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings  ; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Nangta un weng ïa ka khleiñ jong ka baroh , kumba ju weng ïa ka khleiñ na ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad un thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , khnang ba ka jingiw na ka kan pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew , bad yn map ïa u .

translation.en: And the five pillars of it with their hooks : and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold : but their five sockets were of brass .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , ki shna san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia bad ki sah ha ki san tylli ki bnoh ; ki suit da ka ksiar ïa ki shata    bad ki shrong jong ki , bad ki shna ruh san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong na ka bynta kita ki rishot .

translation.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof , and will slay all the princes thereof with him , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïap ïa u nongsynshar ka Moab bad ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ka ri .

translation.en: And as they were eating , Jesus took bread , and blessed it , and brake it , and gave it to the disciples , and said ,  Take , eat  ; this is my body .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , u la duwai ainguh , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synran jong u .  To shim bad to bam ïa u ,  u la ong ;  une u long ka met jong nga .

translation.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning : when he dresseth the lamps , he shall burn incense upon it .
translation.kha: Man ka step haba u Aaron u wan ban pynkhreh ïa ki sharak , u dei ban thang ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka .

translation.en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him , and he was wounded of the archers .
translation.kha: U Saul u don hapdeng ka jingïaleh kaba jur bha , bad u la shah siat da u khnam ha u nongshun bad u la mynsaw jur .

translation.en: I will bring it forth , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and it shall enter into the house of the thief , and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name : and it shall remain in the midst of his house , and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba un phah shabar ïa kane ka jingtim , bad kan rung shapoh ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei u nongtuh bad sha ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai . Kan ïaineh ha ki ïing jong ki bad ieh ïa ki ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace , so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof  ; and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have poured out my fury upon you .
translation.kha: Yn pynum ïa ki ha Jerusalem kumba pynum ïa ka rupa ha ka lawar ding , bad nangta kin tip ba ki mad ïa ka jingbitar jong U  Trai .

translation.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail  ;
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju kyrngah ban ïarap ïa kiba duk ; ngam pat ju shah ïa ki riewkynthei ban im jynjar

translation.en: She maketh fine linen , and selleth it  ; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant .
translation.kha: Ka thain ki jaiñkup bad ki jingpanpoh bad ka die ïa ki ha ki nongkhaïi .

translation.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh , Taanach with her suburbs , and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; two cities .
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , la ai ar tylli ki nongbah : ka Taanakh bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: Ye daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you in scarlet , with other delights , who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel .
translation.kha: Ko kynthei Israel , to ïam namar u Saul ! Uba la pynkup ïa phi da ki jaiñ saw syn-iang , Bad u la pyndeng ïa phi da ki mawlynnai bad ka ksiar .

translation.en: And the city shall be accursed , even it , and all that are therein , to the  Lord  : only Rahab the harlot shall live , she and all that are with her in the house , because she hid the messengers that we sent .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah bad baroh kiba don ha ka dei ban pynjot thiaw kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai . Tang ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka yn pyllait im , namar ka la pynrieh ïa ki nongsyntiat jong ngi .

translation.en: A false balance is abomination to the  Lord  : but a just weight is his delight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur thok . U sngewbha ha ki jingthew kiba hok .

translation.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables  ; and without a parable spake he not unto them :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki paidbah ; um ju ong ïa kano kano ha ki khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka pharshi .

translation.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .
translation.kha: To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit . Baroh ki balang jong U Khrist ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .

translation.en: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah hynñiew snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga

translation.en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets , and the rearward came after the ark , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
translation.kha: Kumta , kumba u Joshua u la hukum , ka kynhun shipai ka la ïaid ha shuwa ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki turoi ; hadien jong kine bud sa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , kiba la bud pat da ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day , and put themselves in array against Gibeah , as at other times .
translation.kha: Nangta lynter ha ka sngi kaba lai ki leit tur pyrshah ïa ki kynhun shipai Benjamin bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai pyrshah ïa ka Gibeah , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: And Joshua said , Why hast thou troubled us ? the  Lord  shall trouble thee this day . And all Israel stoned him with stones , and burned them with fire , after they had stoned them with stones .
translation.kha: Bad u Joshua u ong ,  Balei me la pynngat ha ngi ïa ka jynjar kaba kum kane ? U  Trai  mynta un pynngat ïa ka jynjar ha me !  Te ki briew baroh ki lynthem maw ïa u Akhan haduh ba un da ïap ; ki lynthem maw bad ki thang ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .

translation.en: And I scattered them among the heathen , and they were dispersed through the countries : according to their way and according to their doings I judged them .
translation.kha: Nga pynrem ïa ki namar ka rukom ba ki im bad ki leh , bad nga la pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ki ri nongwei .

translation.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein , and put them under saws , and under harrows of iron , and under axes of iron , and made them pass through the brickkiln : and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon . So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: bad u la pyntrei ïa ki briew jong ka ha ki kurat , ki mohkhiew , bad ki sdie nar , bad u la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ha kaba shna maw-it . U la leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei pat ki nongrit jong ka Ammon baroh . Nangta ma u lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel ?
translation.kha: ( Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynkheiñ ïa u nar , khamtam u nar na shatei uba la khleh bad ka rnong . )

translation.en: And she , being before instructed of her mother , said , Give me here John Baptist s head in a charger .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingaibuit ka kmie jong ka , ka la pan na u ,  To ai ïa nga mynta hangne ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ha ka pliang !

translation.en: Therefore watch , and remember , that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears .
translation.kha: To sharai , te , bad to kynmaw bad da ki ummat kiba bun , mynsngi bad mynmiet , nga la hikai ïa iwei pa iwei na phi haduh lai snem .

translation.en: These are the statutes , which the  Lord  commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father s house .
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki aiñ ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses kiba ïadei bad ki jingkular ba la pynlong da ka theisamla kaba dang sah ha ka ïing u kpa jong ka lane da ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim .

translation.en: And the king stood by a pillar , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul , to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book . And all the people stood to the covenant .
translation.kha: U ïeng ha ka jaka ïeng jong ki syiem , bad pynlong ka jutang bad U  Trai  ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki Aiñ bad ki hukum jong u , da ka dohnud bad mynsiem jong u baroh bad ban leh ïa ki jingdawa kiba ïadei bad ka jutang kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab . Bad baroh ki briew ki kular ban bat ïa ka jutang .

translation.en: The burden of Dumah . He calleth to me out of Seir , Watchman , what of the night ? Watchman , what of the night ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Edom . Don uwei uba pyrta ïa nga na Edom ,  Ko nongap phira , shen sa katno ba ka miet kan kut ? Ïathuh ïa nga sa katno shen kan kut noh .

translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon , and the house that he had built ,
translation.kha: Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka la ïohi ïa ka jingstad u Solomon , bad ka la ïohi ïa ka ïingsyiem ba u la tei .

translation.en: O house of David , thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute judgment in the morning , and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor , lest my fury go out like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ban ai ïa kane ka khubor ha ka ïingsyiem Judah , ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid :  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong . To khmih ba yn don ka jingbishar hok man la ka sngi . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba thok ïa u . Lada phim leh kumta , ka jingbymman kaba phi leh kan pynlong ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ban meh kum ka ding kaba ym lah ban pynlip .

translation.en: According to the grace of God which is given unto me , as a wise masterbuilder , I have laid the foundation , and another buildeth thereon . But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon .
translation.kha: Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingai kaba U Blei u la ai ha nga , nga la trei ïa ka kam u rangbah nongtei uba tbit bad nga la seng ïa ka nongrim , bad uwei pat u tei halor jong ka . Hynrei uwei pa uwei u dei ban sumar kumno u tei .

translation.en: And as thy servant was busy here and there , he was gone . And the king of Israel said unto him , So shall thy judgment be  ; thyself hast decided it .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la bunkam bad kiwei pat ki kam , kumta uta u briew u lait noh .  U syiem u jubab ,  Phi la pynbna hi ïa ka rai , bad phin hap siew ïa ka kuna .

translation.en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the  Lord  of all your tithes , which ye receive of the children of Israel  ; and ye shall give thereof the  Lord s  heave offering to Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom phi ruh phin wanrah kumjuh ïa ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na baroh kaba shiphew ba phi ïohpdiang na ki Israel . Phin ai ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang na ka bynta U  Trai  ha u Aaron u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Men and brethren , this scripture must needs have been fulfilled , which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas , which was guide to them that took Jesus .
translation.kha: Ko hynmen ko para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha ha kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u kren lyngba u Dabid , u la pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa shaphang u Judas , uba la long u nongïalam ïa kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language , whose words thou canst not understand . Surely , had I sent thee to them , they would have hearkened unto thee .
translation.kha: Lada nga la phah ïa me sha ki jaitbynriew bakhraw kiba kren ïa ki ktien kiba eh kiba mem sngewthuh , kin shahshkor ïa me .

translation.en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth , neither any green thing , neither any tree  ; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa ki ba kin ym pynmynsaw ïa u phlang lane ïa ki dieng lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingthung ; ki lah ban pynmynsaw tang ïa ki briew ki bym don ka shab jong U Blei ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty , and their houses a desolation : they shall also build houses , but not inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , but not drink the wine thereof .
translation.kha: Ïa ka spah jong ki yn lute bad ïa ki ïing jong ki yn pynjot . Kin ym shong ha ki ïing kiba ki tei lane dih ïa ka waiñ na ki bri sohwaiñ kiba ki thung .

translation.en: And Boaz answered and said unto her , It hath fully been shewed me , all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .
translation.kha: U Boas u jubab ,  Nga la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kaba phi la leh ïa la ka kiaw kurim naduh ba u tnga jong phi u la ïap . Nga tip kumno phi la iehnoh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa la ka ri ruh , bad kumno phi la wan ban shong ban sah hapdeng ki briew kiba phim pat ju ithuh mynno mynno .

translation.en: I think it is good that books still exist , but they do make me sleepy .
translation.kha: Nga tharai ka bha ba ki kot ki dang don , hynrei ki pynsamthiah ia nga .

translation.en: Then Peter said unto her , How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord ? behold , the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door , and shall carry thee out .
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la ong ha ka ,  Balei ba ma pha bad u tnga jong pha , phi kut jingmut ban tynjuh ïa U Mynsiem jong U Trai ? Ki samla kiba la tep ïa u tnga jong pha ki la don mynta ha ka jingkhang , bad kin bah noh ïa pha ruh shabar !

translation.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïaroh ïa ka jingstad , u kpa jong phi un sngewsarong ïa phi . Ka long ka jingpynlehnoh-ei ba-bieit ban pynlut pisa ha ki nuti .

translation.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance , when he separated the sons of Adam , he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la bynta jaka ïa ki jaitbynriew ; u la buh hangno ki briew kin shong . U la ai uwei u blei ïa kawei kawei ka jaitbynriew ,

translation.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans , and they that are thrust through in her streets .
translation.kha: Kin mynsaw bad kin ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ki nongbah jong ki .

translation.en: Who have for my life laid down their own necks : unto whom not only I give thanks , but also all the churches of the Gentiles .
translation.kha: kiba la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga . Nga dap da ka jingsngewnguh ïa ki — ym tang ma nga , hynrei baroh ki balang Jentil kumjuh .

translation.en: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , Jehu departed not from after them , to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth–el , and that were in Dan .
translation.kha: Hynrei u pyrthuh bud ïa ka pop jong u syiem Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop ha kaba mane ïa ki khun masi ksiar kiba u la pynïeng ha Bethel bad ha Dan .

translation.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder , and Aholibah her sister : and they were mine , and they bare sons and daughters . Thus were their names  ; Samaria is Aholah , and Jerusalem Aholibah .
translation.kha: Kaba kham shuwa ka kyrteng ka Oholah ( ka mih pli ïa ka Samaria ) , bad kaba hadien ka kyrteng ka Oholibah ( ka mih pli ïa ka Jerusalem ) . Nga shongkurim ïa ki baroh ar ngut , bad ki kha ïa ki khun ïa nga .

translation.en: For he is gone down this day , and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the king s sons , and the captains of the host , and Abiathar the priest  ; and , behold , they eat and drink before him , and say , God save king Adonijah .
translation.kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi u la leit ai jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid . U la khot sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh , ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , bad ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad mynta hi ki dang ïabam ïadih bad u bad ki pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Adonijah !’

translation.en: For they are gone up to Assyria , a wild ass alone by himself : Ephraim hath hired lovers .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kada khlaw , ki paid Israel kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki la leit ban wad jingïarap na ki Assyria , bad ki la siew ruh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ban ïada ïa ki .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said , Behold , the people of the land now are many , and ye make them rest from their burdens .
translation.kha: Phi mynta phi la kham ïabun paid ban ïa ki nong Ijipt . Bad mynta phi kwah ban sangeh trei !

translation.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , and like the appearance of lamps : it went up and down among the living creatures  ; and the fire was bright , and out of the fire went forth lightning .
translation.kha: Hapdeng kita ki jingthaw don kaei kaei kaba syriem kum ka dongmusa bameh , kaba ïai khih . Ka ding ka klang bad pynmih ki jingthaba leilieh .

translation.en: Now these are the kings of the land , which the children of Israel smote , and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun , from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon , and all the plain on the east :
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la lah jop bad kam kynti ïa ka ri kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan , naduh ka Them Arnon haduh ka Them Jordan bad shaduh u Lum Hermon ha ka phang bashatei . Ki la jop ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem .

translation.en: And the second is like unto it , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Kaba ar ka hukum kaba donkam tam ka long kum katei : ‘ Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ïa lade .’

translation.en: Yea , the hind also calved in the field , and forsook it , because there was no grass .
translation.kha: Ka skei kmie hapoh ka lyngkha ka iehnoh ïa la i khun ba dang kha namar bym don phlang .

translation.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day , and to morrow , and the day following : for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Pynban nga dei ban don ha ka lynti jong nga mynta ka sngi , la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ; kam long kaba dei ba ïa u nongïathuhlypa yn pynïap hangno hangno lait tang ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis , and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene ,
translation.kha: Ka la long ka snem kaba khatsan jong ka jingsynshar u Patsha Tiberios ; u Pontios Pilat u la long u lyngskor jong ka Judia , U Herod u la long u nongsynshar jong ka Galilaïa , bad u Philip u para jong u , u la long u nongsynshar jong ka thain Ituria bad Trakhonitis ; u Lysanias u la long u nongsynshar jong ka Abilene ,

translation.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth , and length , and depth , and height ;
translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi lem bad ki briew jong U Blei baroh , phin lah ban ïoh ka bor ban sngewthuh katno ka jingïar bad ka lynter , katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingjylliew , ka long ka jingieit U Khrist .

translation.en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh  ; for the Egyptians sold every man his field , because the famine prevailed over them : so the land became Pharaoh s .
translation.kha: Kumta keiñ u Joseph u thied lut ïa ka khyndew ha Ijipt na ka bynta u syiem . La pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei u nong Ijipt ban die ïa la ki lyngkha namar ba ka  nemsniew ka la jur palat ; bad baroh ka khyndew ka kylla long ka jong u syiem .

translation.en: It is like leaven , which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
translation.kha: Ka long kumne . Ka kynthei ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u  purew tad haduh ba ka lyngngun kpu baroh kawei ka sieb .

translation.en: And this I do for the gospel s sake , that I might be partaker thereof with you .
translation.kha: Ïa kane baroh nga leh na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba ngan ïoh bynta ha ki jingkyrkhu jong ka .

translation.en: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness , and for to shed innocent blood , and for oppression , and for violence , to do it .
translation.kha: Hynrei me lah ban ïohi tang ïa la ki jingmyntoi shimet ; me pynïap ïa kiba lui lui , bad me banbeiñ tyngeh ïa la ki briew . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil : all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilonia yn lute , bad kito kiba lute ïa ka kin shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kwah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Therefore it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it , that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven  ; thou shalt not forget it .
translation.kha: Te , ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ïa kata ka ri bad u la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh kiba shong sawdong jong phi , pynïap lut ïa ki Amalek baroh , khnang ban ym don shuh uba kynmaw ïa ki . Wat klet ïa kane !

translation.en: So neither I , nor my brethren , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard which followed me , none of us put off our clothes , saving that every one put them off for washing .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kylliang sopti wat ha ka por miet , lymne mano mano na ki paralok jong nga , lymne ki shakri jong nga , lymne ki nongap phira jong nga . Bad ma ngi baroh ngi bat ïa ki tiar ïaleh ha ka kti .

translation.en: Awake , awake , put on strength , O arm of the  Lord   ; awake , as in the ancient days , in the generations of old . Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab , and wounded the dragon ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  to khie bad ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyndonkam ïa la ka bor bad pynim ïa ngi ; pyndonkam ïa ka kum ha ka por mynbarim . Dei ma me uba la ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Rahab u mrad duriaw bakynsha .

translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom : take thou thy lord s servants , and pursue after him , lest he get him fenced cities , and escape us .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u ong ha u Abishai ,  U Sheba un kham pynjynjar ïa ngi ban ïa u Absalom . Shim ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad leit thwet ïa u , lym kumta u lah ban leit shong shnong ha ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad lait phet na ngi .

translation.en: And they went out quickly , and fled from the sepulchre  ; for they trembled and were amazed : neither said they any thing to any man  ; for they were afraid .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit noh bad mareh na ka jingtep , ki da sngewkhuslai bad sngewshyrkhei . Kim shym la ïathuh ei ei hano hano ruh , namar ki la sheptieng . [

translation.en: I am sought of them that asked not for me  ; I am found of them that sought me not : I said , Behold me , behold me , unto a nation that was not called by my name .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la kloi ban jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga , hynrei kim shym la duwai . Nga la ap ïa ki ban shem ïa nga , hynrei kim shym la pyrshang . Ka jaitbynriew kam shym la khot kyrpad ïa nga , wat lada nga long la kloi ban jubab , ‘ Hangne nga don ; ngan ïarap ïa phi .’

translation.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him  ; for his hands refuse to labour .
translation.kha: U briew uba jaipdeh uba kyntait ban trei u shu pynïap ei ïa lade ; baroh kaba u leh ka long ban pyrkhat shaphang kaei ba u kwah ban don .

translation.en: And this word , Yet once more , signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken , as of things that are made , that those things which cannot be shaken may remain .
translation.kha: Ki ktien  sa shisien pat  ki pyn-i shai ba ïa kiei kiei kiba la thaw yn pynkhynñiuh bad yn weng noh , khnang ba ïa kiei kiei ki bym lah ban pynkhynñiuh yn pynneh .

translation.en: And they also , if they abide not still in unbelief , shall be grafted in : for God is able to graft them in again .
translation.kha: Bad lada ki Jiw ki iehnoh ïa ka jingbymngeit jong ki , yn sa buh biang ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki ju don ; naba U Blei u lah ban leh ïa kata .

translation.en: I went by the field of the slothful , and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding  ;
translation.kha: Nga ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ jong u briew uba alhia , uba mutlop .

translation.en: Ye shall keep my statutes . Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind : thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed : neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Wat shah ba ki jingri jong phi kin ïapoi kha bad ki bym dei na kajuh ka jait . Wat thung ha kajuh ka lyngkha ar jait u symbai . Wat phong ïa ka jaiñ kaba la suh da ki ar jait ki ksai .

translation.en: Hadar , and Tema , Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah :
translation.kha: u Hadad , u Tema , u Jetur , u Naphish , bad u Kedemah .

translation.en: Why did the knees prevent me ? or why the breasts that I should suck ?
translation.kha: Balei te ka kmie jong nga ka thum ïa nga ha la pneh ? Balei ka ai buiñ ïa nga ha ka shadem jong ka ?

translation.en: Him therefore I hope to send presently , so soon as I shall see how it will go with me .
translation.kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ban phah shen ïa u sha phi tang mar shu tip kumno kiei kiei kin long na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Redeemer of Israel , and his Holy One , to him whom man despiseth , to him whom the nation abhorreth , to a servant of rulers , Kings shall see and arise , princes also shall worship , because of the  Lord  that is faithful , and the Holy One of Israel , and he shall choose thee .
translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid bad u nongpynim ki Israel u ong ïa uta uba shah ibeiñ , ïa uba la isih da ki jaitbynriew bad uba long u shakri jong ki nongsynshar :  Ki syiem kin ïohi ba la pyllait ïa me bad kin ïeng ban pynpaw ïa ka jingñiewburom jong ki ; ki khun syiem ruh kin ïohi ïa kata , bad kin dem khrup ban pyndonburom ïa me .  Kane kan jia namar U  Trai  u la jied ïa la u shakri ; U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel u bat ïa la ki kular .

translation.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning , and thine health shall spring forth speedily : and thy righteousness shall go before thee  ; the glory of the  Lord  shall be thy rearward .
translation.kha: Te ka jinglehieit jong nga kan tyngshaiñ ha phi kum ka sngi mynstep , bad ki jingmong jong phi kin sa koit kloi . Ngan don ryngkat bad phi borabor ban pyllait ïa phi ; ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga kan ïada ïa phi ha ki liang baroh .

translation.en: For this gird you with sackcloth , lament and howl : for the fierce anger of the  Lord  is not turned back from us .
translation.kha: Kumta to kup ka jaiñ khain , bad to ïam bad ud sngewsih namar ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai kam shym la phai noh na ka Judah .

translation.en: And it fell on a day , that he came thither , and he turned into the chamber , and lay there .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Elisha u la wan phai sha Shunem bad u la leit kiew sha la ka kamra ban pynjahthait .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and shall do against any of them :
translation.kha: ban ïathuh ha ki Israel ba uno uno u briew uba leh pop khlem tip bad u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U  Trai  , u dei ban bud ïa kine ki aiñ harum .

translation.en: For he spake , and it was done  ; he commanded , and it stood fast .
translation.kha: Haba u la kren , ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong ; ha ka hukum jong u baroh ka la paw .

translation.en: Behold , therefore I am against thee , and against thy rivers , and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate , from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia .
translation.kha: nga long u nongshun jong me bad u nongshun jong ka wah Nile jong me . Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt baroh kawei kaba suda khlem jingmyntoi , naduh ka nongbah Migdol ha ka phang bashatei haduh ka nongbah Aswan ha ka phang bashathie , baroh shi lynter haduh u pud ki Sudan .

translation.en: Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ngin ïit ïa la ki lynti bad phai pat sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Be patient therefore , brethren , unto the coming of the Lord . Behold , the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth , and hath long patience for it , until he receive the early and latter rain .
translation.kha: To long kiba ïaishah , namarkata , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh ba U Trai un wan . Khmih katno u nongrep u long uba ïaishah haba u ap ïa la ka khyndew ban pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba kordor . U ïaishah ban ap ïa u slap synrai bad ïa u slap pyrem .

translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :
translation.kha: bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka khubor u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai ,

translation.en: He shall fly away as a dream , and shall not be found : yea , he shall be chased away as a vision of the night .
translation.kha: Un jah noh kum ka jingphohsniew , kum ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad ba yn ym ïohi shuh .

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? Yea , I say unto you , and much more than a prophet .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid , da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi kham bun shah ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
