translation.en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks , and the bowls , and the cups : and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for every basin  ; and likewise silver by weight for every basin of silver :
translation.kha: U la ai jingbthah ruh katno ka ksiar nylla kan leit ha kaba pyndonkam ban shna ïa ki proh , ki pliang , bad ki khiew , bad katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha kaba shna ïa ki pliang ,

translation.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words , saith the  Lord  , which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them  ; but ye would not hear , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane kan jia ha ki namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba nga ju ïai phah sha ki lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga . Ki la kyntait ban shahshkor .

translation.en: You will be benefited spiritually by seeing the place called Bethel .
translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi kan kham skhem da kaba ïohi ïa ka jaka ba khot ka Bethel .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Fear not , Daniel : for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand , and to chasten thyself before thy God , thy words were heard , and I am come for thy words .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ko Daniel , to wat sheptieng . U Blei u la shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba me la kut jingmut ban pynrit ïa lade khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang . Nga la wan ban ai jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong me .

translation.en: And the king said unto her , Be not afraid : for what sawest thou ? And the woman said unto Saul , I saw gods ascending out of the earth .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ïa ka ,  Wat sheptieng ! Phi ïohi aïu ?   Nga ïohi ïa ka sna-ïap ba ka mih na khyndew ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano me leit , bad nga tip kumno ba me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar : it is a burnt offering unto the  Lord  : it is a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Thang ïa uta u langbrot baroh uwei ha kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh bam . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingainguh ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .

translation.en: And when king David came to Bahurim , behold , thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul , whose name was Shimei , the son of Gera : he came forth , and cursed still as he came .
translation.kha: Haba u Syiem Dabid u la wan poi ha Bahurim , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Saul , u Shimei , u khun jong u Gera , u la wan ïakynduh ïa u , u da tim ïa u katba u dang wan .

translation.en: And they say unto him , We have here but five loaves , and two fishes .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba ngi don hangne ki long san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: These are the things which defile a man : but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man .
translation.kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew . Hynrei ban bam khlem da thet ïa ki kti jong phi kumba ki ong ïa phi ban leh kumta — Kane kam pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew .

translation.en: Judge not , that ye be not judged .
translation.kha: Wat bishar ïa kiwei pat , khnang ba U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi ,

translation.en: The student refused to obey his teacher .
translation.kha: U khynnah u saitlah ban ngeit iau nonghikai .

translation.en: Thou art my God , and I will praise thee : thou art my God , I will exalt thee .
translation.kha: Me long U Blei jong nga , bad nga ainguh ïa me ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .

translation.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall not escape .
translation.kha: Lada phi lamler ha ka ïingbishar , phin shah pynshitom — yn ym don jingpyllait .

translation.en: And while he yet spake , behold a multitude , and he that was called Judas , one of the twelve , went before them , and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren mynba ka kynhun ki briew ka la wan poi , ïa kaba la ïalam da u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran . U la wan sha U Jisu ban doh ïa u .

translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city , and blessed shalt thou be in the field .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ki shnong jong phi bad ïa ki lyngkha jong phi .

translation.en: And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the  Lord  , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them , neither have I hurt one of them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la bitar lep , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Wat pdiang ïa kano kano ka jingainguh ba kine ki briew ki wallam . Ngam shym la leh bymdei ïa uwei ruh na ki ; ngam shym la shim ruh wat tang kawei na ki kada jong ki .

translation.en: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things : choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad ïathuh ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .

translation.en: And the children of Aram  ; Uz , and Hul , and Gether , and Mash .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aram ki long ki briew jong ka Us , ka Hul , ka Gether , bad ka Meshek .

translation.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee : thou saidst , Fear not .
translation.kha: Me la jubab ïa nga bad ong ïa nga ban ym sheptieng .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul , that Saul said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And Saul lifted up his voice , and wept .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la dep kren , u Saul u ong ,  Hato dei ma phi shisha , ko Dabid u khun jong nga ?  Bad u la sdang ban ïam .

translation.en: What ailed thee , O thou sea , that thou fleddest ? thou Jordan , that thou wast driven back ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia , ko Duriaw , ban pynlong ïa pha ban phet noh ? Bad ma pha , ko Jordan , balei ba pha sangeh ban tuid ?

translation.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh , the children of Israel lifted up their eyes , and , behold , the Egyptians marched after them  ; and they were sore afraid : and the children of Israel cried out unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa u Pharaoh bad u paidïapom jong u ba ki tur sha ki , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh , bad ki kyang jam sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: Turn you to the strong hold , ye prisoners of hope : even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee  ;
translation.kha: To wan phai , phi kiba shah ringmraw kiba mynta phi la don ka jingkyrmen ; to wan phai sha ka jaka jong phi kaba shngain . Mynta nga ong ïa phi ba ngan siew pat ar shah ïa phi da ka jingkyrkhu na ka bynta baroh kaba phi la shahshitom .

translation.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David  ; and the man that bare the shield went before him .
translation.kha: Uta u Philistia u sdang ban ïaid sha khmat sha u Dabid lem bad u nongrah atiar uba ïaid ha shuwa jong u .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if there remain ten men in one house , that they shall die .
translation.kha: Lada shiphew ngut ki dang sah ha kawei ka ïing , kin ïap .

translation.en: As the Father hath loved me , so have I loved you : continue ye in my love .
translation.kha: Nga ieit ïa phi kumba U Kpa u ieit ïa nga ; to ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga .

translation.en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself , ye do well :
translation.kha: Phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei lada phi kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong ka hima , ïa kaba la shem ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ,  To ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba ieit ïa lade .

translation.en: For I feared thee , because thou art an austere man : thou takest up that thou layedst not down , and reapest that thou didst not sow .
translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa me namar ba me long u briew uba eh . Me shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong me bad ot ïa kaei kaba mem shym bet .’

translation.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them  ; for they were taken with great fear : and he went up into the ship , and returned back again .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew na kata ka thain ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban leit noh , namar ba ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh . Kumta U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit noh .

translation.en: Thou , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles , shalt quicken me again , and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth .
translation.kha: Me la phah ki jingjynjar bad ki jingshitom halor jong nga , hynrei men pynïoh pat ka jingkhlaiñ ha nga ; men sumar ïa nga na ka jingtep .

translation.en: And Abigail came to Nabal  ; and , behold , he held a feast in his house , like the feast of a king  ; and Nabal s heart was merry within him , for he was very drunken : wherefore she told him nothing , less or more , until the morning light .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka leit phai sha u Nabal , uba don ha ïing ha ka jingkhawai kaba kat ka jingkhawai u syiem . U la buaid bad shongshit , kumta kam shym ïathuh ei ei haduh ka step kaba bud .

translation.en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus , of the seed of the Medes , which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans  ;
translation.kha: U Darius u nong Mid , uba long u khun jong u Serksis , u la synshar ïa ka hima Babilonia .

translation.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with his wife Priscilla  ; ( because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome : ) and came unto them .
translation.kha: Hangta u la ïakynduh ïa u Jiw uba kyrteng u Akwila , ïa uba la kha ha Pontos , uba dang shu wan shen na Italy lem bad ka Priskila ka tnga jong u , naba u Patsha Klaudius u la lah hukum ïa ki Jiw baroh ban mihnoh na Rom .

translation.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh un rah khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: But all the silver , and gold , and vessels of brass and iron , are consecrated unto the  Lord  : they shall come into the treasury of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba la shna da ka rupa , ka ksiar , ka rnong lane ka nar , la buh kyrpang na ka bynta U  Trai . Dei ban buh ïa kata ha ka ïing jingkynshew U  Trai .

translation.en: O thou sword of the  Lord  , how long will it be ere thou be quiet ? put up thyself into thy scabbard , rest , and be still .
translation.kha: Phi kyang jam , ‘ Ka waitlam jong U  Trai  ! Katno slem phin ïai talain ïa ka ? Khie leit phai noh sha ka jingsop , sah hangta bad shongthait !’

translation.en: And keep the charge of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and his testimonies , as it is written in the law of Moses , that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest , and whithersoever thou turnest thyself :
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Aiñ u Moses , khnang ba haba me leit shano shano me lah ban manbha ha kaei kaei kaba me leh .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Who art thou ? And I answered him , I am an Amalekite .
translation.kha: U kylli nga dei uei , bad nga la ïathuh ïa u ba nga dei u Amalek .

translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre , which shall devour the palaces thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Tyros , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  against all mine evil neighbours , that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit  ; Behold , I will pluck them out of their land , and pluck out the house of Judah from among them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga don ei ei ban ong shaphang ki paramarjan jong ka Israel kiba la pynjot ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan shim noh ïa kito ki briew bymman na ki ri jong ki kum ïa u jingthung ba la rat , bad ngan pyllait im ïa ka Judah na ki .

translation.en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves , according unto the word of the  Lord  which he commanded Joshua .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki shim ha lade ïa ki jingri bad ïa ki mar ki mata ba ki ïoh kurup na ka nongbah , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua .

translation.en: But God led the people about , through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea : and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa ki da ka lynti kyllaiñ lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba poi sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ki Israel ki long kiba la kieng atiar ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: And if men strive together , and one smite another with a stone , or with his fist , and he die not , but keepeth his bed :
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki ïakajia , bad uwei u shoh da u maw ne u kura da ka kti ïa uwei pat khlem da pynïap ïa u , yn ym pynshitom ïa u ,

translation.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood , whether it be of fowl or of beast , in any of your dwellings .
translation.kha: Kam pher la hangno hangno ki Israel ki shong ki sah , kim dei da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki sim ne ki mrad kum ka jingbam .

translation.en: Am I a sea , or a whale , that thou settest a watch over me ?
translation.kha: Balei ba me buh ïa nga hapoh u nongap phira ? Me pyrkhat ba nga dei u mrad kynsha ka duriaw ?

translation.en: And when he knew it of the centurion , he gave the body to Joseph .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïathuh u rangbah shipai , u Pilat u la ong ïa u Joseph ba u lah ban shim ïa ka met .

translation.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour , especially they who labour in the word and doctrine .
translation.kha: Ki nongsharai balang    kiba trei bha kum ki nongïalam ki dei hok ban ïohpdiang ar shah ïa ka jingsiew , khamtam kito kiba trei jur ha ka jingïalap bad jinghikai .

translation.en: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God : for they are foolishness unto him : neither can he know them , because they are spiritually discerned .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym don U Mynsiem , um lah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai kiba wan na U Mynsiem U Blei . Kum uta u briew da shisha um sngewthuh ïa ki ; ki long ka jingbieit ha u , namar ïa ka dor jong ki lah ban bishar tang na ka nongrim kaba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: For I know their works and their thoughts : it shall come , that I will gather all nations and tongues  ; and they shall come , and see my glory .
translation.kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki kam jong ki , ngan wan ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong ki hima baroh . Haba kin ïawanlang , kin sa ïohi kaei ba ka bor jong nga ka lah ban leh bad kin sa tip ba nga dei uta uba pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: The earth mourneth and fadeth away , the world languisheth and fadeth away , the haughty people of the earth do languish .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei ka tyrkhong bad ka stai noh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kylla tlot ; ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng , baroh ar , kin pyut noh .

translation.en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul , The magistrates have sent to let you go : now therefore depart , and go in peace .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongpeit phatok u la ïathuh ha u Paul ,  Ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ka hukum ban pyllait noh ïa me bad ïa u Silas . Te phi lah ban mihnoh , bad leit ha kaba suk .

translation.en: For the law made nothing perfect , but the bringing in of a better hope did  ; by the which we draw nigh unto God .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hukum u Moses kam lah ban pynlong janai ïa kano kano . Bad mynta la ai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba kham bha da kaba ngi lah ban wan sha jan U Blei .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy Redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; I am the  Lord  thy God which teacheth thee to profit , which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go .
translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel , U  Trai  uba pynim ïa phi , u ong :  Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uta uba kwah ban hikai ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi bad uba kdew ïa phi ïa ka lynti ba phi dei ban leit .

translation.en: And said unto the king , Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me , neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem , that the king should take it to his heart .
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Ko Syiem kynrad , to klet noh ïa ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh ha kato ka sngi kaba phi la iehnoh ïa ka Jerusalem . Wat buhnud ei ei pyrshah ïa nga lane pyrkhat shuh shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel : thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel : why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Ka shnong jong ngi ka dei ka nongbah kaba khraw , kawei na ki shnong kiba shongsuk shongsaiñ tam bad kohnguh syiem tam ha Israel . Balei phi pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka ? Balei phi kwah ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U  Trai  ?

translation.en: And have hope toward God , which they themselves also allow , that there shall be a resurrection of the dead , both of the just and unjust .
translation.kha: Nga don kajuh ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei kaba kine hi ki don , kata , ba ki briew baroh , kiba bha bad kiba sniew , kin mihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And Balak said unto him , Come , I pray thee , with me unto another place , from whence thou mayest see them : thou shalt see but the utmost part of them , and shalt not see them all : and curse me them from thence .
translation.kha: Nangta u Balak u ong ha u Balaam ,  Ale bad nga sha kawei pat ka jaka na kaba phi lah ban ïohi tang katto katne ki Israel . Tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga nangta .

translation.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which , when it is sown in the earth , is less than all the seeds that be in the earth :
translation.kha: Ka long kumne . U briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso , u symbai barit tam ha ka pyrthei , bad u thung ïa u ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: For unto every one that hath shall be given , and he shall have abundance : but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath .
translation.kha: Naba ïa uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ei ei , yn sa ai kham bun , bad un don kyrhai ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wat ïa kaba khyndiat kaba u don yn shim noh na u .

translation.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way .
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kaba kum kane ka por ba ka la don ka jingeh kaba jur ha Ephesos namar ka Lynti jong U Trai .

translation.en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will , and none shall stand before him : and he shall stand in the glorious land , which by his hand shall be consumed .
translation.kha: U nonghiarthma Syria un leh ïa ki kat kaba u sngewbha , khlem kano kano ka jingïapyrshah . Un ïeng ha ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un ïoh ïa ka baroh ha ka bor jong u .

translation.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly : and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground .
translation.kha: Ha ka jinglyng-a kaba khraw u la duwai kham jur shuh shuh ; ka syep jong u ka la long kum ki jingjaw ka snam kaba hap ha madan .

translation.en: And it shall be when the  Lord  shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers , and shall give it thee ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam ïa phi sha ka ri ki Kanaan ïa kaba u la kular skhem ha phi bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: Peace I leave with you , my peace I give unto you : not as the world giveth , give I unto you . Let not your heart be troubled , neither let it be afraid .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsuk nga iehnoh ha phi , ïa ka jingsuk jong nga hi , nga ai ha phi . Ngam ai ïa ka kumba ka pyrthei ka ai . Wat sngewkhuslai bad sngewdiaw ; wat sngewsheptieng .

translation.en: Awake , awake , stand up , O Jerusalem , which hast drunk at the hand of the  Lord  the cup of his fury  ; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling , and wrung them out .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to khie noh ! Khie joit ïa lade bad ïeng ! Pha la dih ïa ka khuri ka jingpynshitom kaba U  Trai  ha ka jingbitar jong u , u la ai ba phan dih ; pha dih lut ïa ka , bad ka la pynlong ïa pha ban ïaid sheng sheng .

translation.en: And the ark of God was taken  ; and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were slain .
translation.kha: La knieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ki khun shynrang jong u Eli baroh ar ngut , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shah pynïap .

translation.en: Hear counsel , and receive instruction , that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end .
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingmut bad phi kloi ban shah hikai , ha kawei ka sngi phin long uba stad .

translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away , but my words shall not pass away .
translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh da lei lei .

translation.en: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch , a knop and a flower  ; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch , a knop and a flower : so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei na kita ki hynriew tylli ki tnat ka don lai tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata bad ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye do not understand ?
translation.kha: Bad phim pat shemphang ?  u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: Now is my soul troubled  ; and what shall I say ? Father , save me from this hour : but for this cause came I unto this hour .
translation.kha: Mynta ka mynsiem jong nga ka pisa — bad aïu ngan ong ? Hato ngan ong , ‘ Ko Pa , wat ai ba kane ka kynta kan wan ha nga ?’ Hynrei dei na ka bynta kata nga la wan — khnang ba ngan ïoh ïaid lyngba kane ka kynta jong ka jingshah shitom .

translation.en: And now , O Lord  God  , thou art that God , and thy words be true , and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :
translation.kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me long U Blei ; me ju ïai bat ïa la ki kular , bad me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kular kaba phylla .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Sodom bad Gomorrah ban ïa ki briew jong kata ka nongbah !

translation.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy , because they have sinned against thee , and shall turn again to thee , and confess thy name , and pray , and make supplication unto thee in this house :
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki Israel ki shahjop ha ki nongshun jong ki namar ba ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta ki phai pat sha me bad wan sha kane ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaba sngewrit ha me na ka bynta ban ïoh jingmap , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .

translation.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede , even I , stood to confirm and to strengthen him .
translation.kha: Mynta u kitkhlieh ban ïarap bad ïada ïa nga .

translation.en: As the  Lord  thy God liveth , there is no nation or kingdom , whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee : and when they said , He is not there  ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation , that they found thee not .
translation.kha: Da U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong phi , nga smai ba u syiem u la phah wad ïa phi ha baroh sawdong ki ri ka pyrthei . Haba uno uno u nongsynshar ka ri u ïathuh ba phim don ha ka ri jong u , u Ahab un dawa na uta u nongsynshar ban smai ba phi long u bym lah ban shem .

translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , say unto the children of thy people , The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression : as for the wickedness of the wicked , he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness  ; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , ïathuh ha ki Israel ba haba u briew babha u leh pop , ka jingleh babha ba u leh kam lah ban pynim ïa u . Lada u briew basniew , u sangeh kaba leh bymman , yn ym pynshitom ïa u , bad lada u briew babha u sdang ban leh pop , ïa ka jingim jong u yn ym pynsah .

translation.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ap ïa uta uba ïaid sakma na ka lynti ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Who , having received such a charge , thrust them into the inner prison , and made their feet fast in the stocks .
translation.kha: Haba u nongpeit phatok u la ïoh ïa kane ka hukum , u la buh ïa ki sha ka kamra set kaba shapoh duh bad u la teh ïa ki kjat jong ki hapdeng ki dieng song kiba khia .

translation.en: Wherefore , brethren , covet to prophesy , and forbid not to speak with tongues .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , to ai ba ka dohnud jong phi kan kwah hir hir ïa ka ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei , hynrei wat adong ïa ka jingkren ha ki thylliej bapher .

translation.en: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven , and poured out drink offerings unto her , did we make her cakes to worship her , and pour out drink offerings unto her , without our men ?
translation.kha: Bad ki kynthei ki ong shuh shuh ,  Haba ngi shet ïa ki kpu ha ka dur kum ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , ngi ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka , bad theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ki tnga jong ngi ki mynjur ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .

translation.en: Mine eye trickleth down , and ceaseth not , without any intermission ,
translation.kha: Ki ummat jong nga kin mih kum ki wahduid ba ïai tuid .

translation.en: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries , and all thine enemies shall be cut off .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kan jop ïa ki nongshun jong ka bad pynjot ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And he left all , rose up , and followed him .
translation.kha: U Lebi u la ïeng joit , u la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad u la bud ïa u .

translation.en: And he said unto the people , Be ready against the third day : come not at your wives .
translation.kha: Kumta ki sait ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad u Moses u ong ha ki ,  La shi sngi , phi dei ban long kiba la pynkhreh bad ha kajuh ka por phim dei ban ïathiah shongkha .

translation.en: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity  ; but thou saidst , I will not hear . This hath been thy manner from thy youth , that thou obeyedst not my voice .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha phi mynba phi dang manbha , hynrei phi kyntait ban shahshkor . Kata ka long kaei kaba phi leh shi lynter ka jingim jong phi , phim ju treh ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine , for an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white , and with a great crown of gold , and with a garment of fine linen and purple : and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad .
translation.kha: U Mordekai u mih na ka ïingsyiem , ha ki jingphong syiem kiba jngum rong bad balieh , ka barandi linen ba sawbthuh bad ka pansngiat ksiar ba-itynnat . Nangta ki lynti bah ka Susa ki sawa da ki jingpyrta ïaroh jong ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians , and went and served Baal , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Kam shym pat biang ïa u ban leh pop kum u syiem Jeroboam ; u leit kham jngai shuh shuh bad u shongkurim ïa ka Jesebel , ka khun jong u Ethbaal u syiem ka Sidon , bad u la mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .  And when the devil had thrown him in the midst , he came out of him , and hurt him not .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem ,  Sngap jar bad mihnoh na une u briew !  U mynsiem bymkhuid u la bret ïa uta u briew sha madan ha khmat jong ki , bad u la mihnoh na u , khlem pynmynsaw ei ei ïa u .

translation.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision ; but faith which worketh by love .
translation.kha: Naba haba ngi long ha U Khrist Jisu , ka jingotsher lane ka jingbymdon jong ka kam don satia kano kano ka jingïapher ; kaei kaba kongsan ka long ka jingngeit kaba trei da ka jingieit .

translation.en: And they took their daughters to be their wives , and gave their daughters to their sons , and served their gods .
translation.kha: Ki la ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad ki la mane ïa ki blei jong ki .

translation.en: Then said his sister to Pharaoh s daughter , Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women , that she may nurse the child for thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta ka hynmen jong u ka ong ha ka khun u Pharaoh ,  Hato ngan leit khot ïa kawei ka kynthei Hebru ba kan ri bad sumar ïa une u khunlung na ka bynta jong phi ?

translation.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk ? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good ?
translation.kha: Ym don uba stad u ban kren kumba kren ma me lane ïada ïa lade da kum kita ki ktien bym don jingmut .

translation.en: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years : and he slept with his fathers , and Nadab his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u la synshar kum u syiem arphew ar snem . U la ïap bad la tep ïa u , bad u khun jong u , u Nadab u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And they said unto her , Surely we will return with thee unto thy people .
translation.kha: Em ! Ngin leit bad phi sha ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: And you , be ye fruitful , and multiply  ; bring forth abundantly in the earth , and multiply therein .
translation.kha: To phin ïoh bun ki khun ki kti , ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone , which Moses put there at Horeb , when the  Lord  made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ruh hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang lait tang ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba u Moses u la buh hangta ha u Lum Sinai , mynba U  Trai  u pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel katba ki dang wan mihnoh na ri Ijipt .

translation.en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord :
translation.kha: U long ma u , uta uba bat ïa ka jingtei baroh kawei , bad uba pynlong ïa ka ba kan san ha ka Templ kaba kyntang ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha U Trai .

translation.en: And he came to Ephesus , and left them there : but he himself entered into the synagogue , and reasoned with the Jews .
translation.kha: Ki la poi ha Ephesos , ha kaba u Paul u la iehnoh ïa ka Priskila bad ïa u Akwila . U la leit sha ka synagog bad u la pynlong ka jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki Jiw .

translation.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife , so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes :
translation.kha: Ha ki umpohliew ka Meribah ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa U  Trai bad u Moses u la shem jingeh namar jong ki .

translation.en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah , which is before Mamre , in the land of Canaan , which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace .
translation.kha: ha Makhpelah kaba sha mihngi na Mamre ha ka ri Kanaan . U Abraham u la thied ïa kane ka krem lem bad ka lyngkha u Ephron ban pynlong jaka tep ïa ka .

translation.en: Then called I upon the name of the  Lord   ; O  Lord  , I beseech thee , deliver my soul .
translation.kha: Te nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ,  Nga kyrpad ïa me , A  Trai  , to pynim ïa nga !

translation.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Kin ïoh kyrhai u slap Bad kin thung ïa la u symbai ha ki lyngkha ba ïoh um bha . U syiem jong ki un kham khraw ïa u Agag , Bad ka bor synshar jong u kan ïar kylleng sawdong .

translation.en: For the priesthood being changed , there is made of necessity a change also of the law .
translation.kha: Namar haba ka jinglong lyngdoh ka la kylla , ka dei ban don ruh ka jingkylla ha ka hukum .

translation.en: And there shall be no remnant of them : for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation .
translation.kha: Nga la buh ka por ïa ka ban wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki briew jong ka Anathoth , bad haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym don mano mano ruh na ki u ban lait im .

translation.en: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra : and , behold , a certain disciple was there , named Timothy , the son of a certain woman , which was a Jewess , and believed  ; but his father was a Greek :
translation.kha: U Paul u la nang leit sha Derbe bad Lystra , ha kaba uwei u Khristan uba kyrteng u Timothi u shong u sah . Ka kmie jong u , kaba long ruh ka Khristan , ka long ka Jiw , hynrei u kpa jong u , u long u Grik .

translation.en: O  Lord  , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction , the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth , and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and things wherein there is no profit .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long uta uba ïada ïa nga bad uba ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ; me ïarap ïa nga ha ki por jingjynjar . Ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha me na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei bad ong ,  Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la don ei ei hynrei tang ki blei thala , ym don ei ei hynrei tang ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .

translation.en: Woe unto you that are full ! for ye shall hunger . Woe unto you that laugh now ! for ye shall mourn and weep .
translation.kha: Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba pahuh mynta ; phin sa thngan ! Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba rkhie mynta ; phin sngewsih bad phin ïam !

translation.en: And Israel abode in Shittim , and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab .
translation.kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la shong dara ha ka Them Akasia , ki rangbah ki la sdang ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki kynthei Moab kiba don hangta .

translation.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father , and his heavy yoke that he put upon us , and we will serve thee .
translation.kha: U kpa jong phi u la buh ki jingkit kiba khia ïa ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine ki jingkit bad pynlong ïa ka jingim jong ngi kaba kham suk te ngin long ki khun ki raïot kiba shakri hok ïa phi .

translation.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year  ; lest the land become desolate , and the beast of the field multiply against thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ym beh noh ïa ki hapoh shisnem , lada nga leh kumta , ka ri kan long kaba kynjah , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bun palat ïa phi .

translation.en: Husbands , love your wives , even as Christ also loved the church , and gave himself for it ;
translation.kha: Ko ki shynrang , to ieit ïa la ki tnga kumba U Khrist u la ieit ïa ka balang bad u la ai ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ka .

translation.en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour .
translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum kaba la neh lai kynta .

translation.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at  ; but now commandeth all men every where to repent :
translation.kha: U Blei u la peit lyndet ïa ki por haba ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei mynta u hukum ïa ki baroh kylleng sawdong ban phai noh ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki .

translation.en: They say to their mothers , Where is corn and wine ? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city , when their soul was poured out into their mothers  bosom .
translation.kha: Khmih sha nga !  ka pyrta sha uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti najan .  Ym don mano mano ba don ka jingpang kum ka jong nga , ka Jingpang kaba U  Trai  u la wallam halor jong nga ha ka por ka jingbitar jong u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother s sister : for she is thy mother s near kinswoman .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka ñiakha ; ka dei ka kur kaba ïajan eh bad u kpa jong me . Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmienah kmiesan ; ka dei ka kur kaba jan eh bad ka kmie jong me .

translation.en: But when the fruit is brought forth , immediately he putteth in the sickle , because the harvest is come .
translation.kha: Haba u kew u la ih , u briew u sdang ban ot ïa u da ka rashi , namar ka aïom ot ka la poi .

translation.en: I have remembered thy name , O  Lord  , in the night , and have kept thy law .
translation.kha: Mynmiet nga kynmaw ïa me , A  Trai  , bad nga pyrkhat shaphang ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: Behold , I have taught you statutes and judgments , even as the  Lord  my God commanded me , that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it .
translation.kha: Nga la hikai ïa phi ïa ki hukum , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la hukum ïa nga . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .

translation.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard  ;
translation.kha: Lada u briew ne ka briew ki mih prum ha ka khlieh ne ha ka tmoh , u lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa ka .

translation.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .
translation.kha: Naba kim nud shuh ban kylli ïa u kano kano ka jingkylli .

translation.en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel , and made all that were present in Israel to serve , even to serve the  Lord  their God . And all his days they departed not from following the  Lord  , the God of their fathers .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u pynjot ïa baroh ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba don ha ka ri kaba dei jong ki paid Israel , bad katba u dang im , u dawa ba ki briew kin shakri ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen  ;
translation.kha: Uwei u bania uba kyrteng u Demetrios uba la thaw ïa ki dur templ jong ka blei Artemis da ka rupa , bad ka kam jong u ka la pynïohnong shibun eh ïa ki nongtrei .

translation.en: And when the sun was going down , a deep sleep fell upon Abram  ; and , lo , an horror of great darkness fell upon him .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la jan sep , u Abram u shoh samthiah eh , bad ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingsngew shyrkhei ka la wan ha u .

translation.en: Why do we sit still ? assemble yourselves , and let us enter into the defenced cities , and let us be silent there : for the  Lord  our God hath put us to silence , and given us water of gall to drink , because we have sinned against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Balei ba ngi ïashong khop ?  Ki briew jong U Blei ki ïakylli .  Ale , ngin ïaphet sha ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh , bad ïap hangta . U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynrem ïa ngi ban ïap ; u la ai ha ngi ka bih ban dih , namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them , Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers in Israel , that will offer his oblation for all his vows , and for all his freewill offerings , which they will offer unto the  Lord  for a burnt offering  ;
translation.kha: ban ong ha u Aaron , ha ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha ki Israel baroh ,  Haba uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba ha Israel u ai ïa ka jingainguh thang , la ka long ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha , kata ka jingainguh ,

translation.en: For , behold , I create new heavens and a new earth : and the former shall not be remembered , nor come into mind .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan thaw ïa ka khyndew bathymmai bad ïa ki bneng bathymmai . Kiei kiei kiba jia long mynshuwa yn ym kynmaw shuh .

translation.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong ka Para ba-ieit jong phi ki phah ïa ka jingai khublei ïa phi .

translation.en: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed , saying , Who then can be saved ?
translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kyndit thret .  Uei te uba lah ban lait im ?  ki la kylli .

translation.en: And the  Lord  visited Sarah as he had said , and the  Lord  did unto Sarah as he had spoken .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka Sarah kumba u la kular , bad ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang ïa u Abraham haba u la tymmen .

translation.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead . It is sown in corruption ; it is raised in incorruption :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno kan jia haba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Haba ïa ka met la tep , ka long kaba ïap ; haba la pynmihpat , ka long ka bymïap shuh .

translation.en: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him  ; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba u paidbah u ïa-pasiaw ïa kine kiei kiei shaphang U Jisu , kumta ma ki bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la phah katto katne ngut ki nongap phira ban kem ïa u .

translation.en: I will declare thy righteousness , and thy works  ; for they shall not profit thee .
translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat ba kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei ngan pynpaw ïa ki jingleh jong phi , bad ki bleithaw jong phi kin ym lah ban ïarap ei ei ïa phi .

translation.en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus , namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingpynbna kan treikam ha baroh ka hima Persia ha ka sngi ba la buh na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa ki Jiw , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .

translation.en: And some cried one thing , some another , among the multitude : and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult , he commanded him to be carried into the castle .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki paidbah ki la pyrta ïa kawei kaei kaei , kiwei ïa kawei pat . Ka la don ka jingkulmar kaba haduh katta ba u rangbah ai hukum um lah ban tip thikna ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , kumta u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban ïalam ïa u Paul sha ka kut shipai .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : and the knowledge of the holy is understanding .
translation.kha: Ban long kiba stad , nyngkong phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai . Lada phi tip ïa uta Uba Khuid , phi don ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: And Reuben said unto them , Shed no blood , but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness , and lay no hand upon him  ; that he might rid him out of their hands , to deliver him to his father again .
translation.kha: Shu bret ïa u ha kane ka pukri hangne ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei wat pynmynsaw ïa u .  U ong kumta namar ba u mut ban pyllait im ïa u na ki , bad ban phah pat ïa u sha la u kpa .

translation.en: Then will the  Lord  drive out all these nations from before you , and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves .
translation.kha: Te un sa beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , bad phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa phi .

translation.en: And then will I profess unto them , I never knew you : depart from me , ye that work iniquity .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ha ki , ‘ Ngam ju la ithuh ïa phi . Khie leit noh na nga , phi ki briew bymman !’

translation.en: Shall I then take my bread , and my water , and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers , and give it unto men , whom I know not whence they be ?
translation.kha: Ngan ym leit ban shim ïa la u kpu bad ka um , bad ki mrad kiba nga la pynïap na ka bynta ki nongot shñiuh langbrot jong nga , bad ai ïa kita ha ki briew kiba ngam tip nangno ki wan !

translation.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart : behold , he standeth behind our wall , he looketh forth at the windows , shewing himself through the lattice .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga , to pynskuiñ ïa ki rangbah kumba ka kulai ka pynskuiñ ïa ki kulai jong ki kali ïapom jong u Pharaoh .

translation.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work , and on the seventh day thou shalt rest : that thine ox and thine ass may rest , and the son of thy handmaid , and the stranger , may be refreshed .
translation.kha: Trei hynriew sngi shi taïew , hynrei wat trei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , khnang ba ki mraw jong phi bad ki nongwei kiba trei bad phi , bad wat ki jingri jong phi hi , kin ïoh shongthait .

translation.en: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived , and hid herself five months , saying ,
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , ka Elisabeth ka tnga jong u , ka la punkhun bad kam shym mih na ïing san bnai .

translation.en: But if any widow have children or nephews , let them learn first to shew piety at home , and to requite their parents : for that is good and acceptable before God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka riewkynthei ka don ki khun ne ki khun ksiew , ki dei ban nang shuwa nyngkong ban khmih ïa ki kam ba kynja mynsiem ka longïing la jong hi bad ha kane ka rukom ki siew kylliang ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa ki kmierad parad , namar kata ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Wherefore I say unto thee , Her sins , which are many , are forgiven  ; for she loved much : but to whom little is forgiven , the same loveth little .
translation.kha: Te nga ong ha me , ka jingieit bakhraw kaba ka la pyn-i ka pynshisha ba ïa ki pop jong ka kiba bun la map . Hynrei uno uno uba la ïohmap khyndiat u pyn-i tang khyndiat ka jingieit .

translation.en: So they brought the ark of God , and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it : and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God .
translation.kha: Ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u Dabid u la lah pynkhreh bad buh ïa ka hapoh . Nangta ki ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok sha U Blei .

translation.en: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , seven lambs of the first year without spot  ;
translation.kha: Man ba sdang u bnai , wanrah ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren , and went over to Shechem : and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gaal u khun jong u Ebed u wan sha Shekhem lem bad la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u .

translation.en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow  ; the willows of the brook compass him about .
translation.kha: Ki bniap shiah bad ki dieng Jamynrei    harud ka wahduid ki ai jakarieh ïa u ha ka jingkah syrngiew jong ki .

translation.en: Will he plead against me with his great power ? No  ; but he would put strength in me .
translation.kha: Hato U Blei un pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong u baroh pyrshah ïa nga ? Em , un sngap ïa nga katba nga dang kren .

translation.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  their God , but transgressed his covenant , and all that Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded , and would not hear them , nor do them .
translation.kha: Ka Samaria ka kyllon noh namar ki Israel kim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , hynrei ki pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad ki bad kim kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ ba la ai da u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai . Kim shahshkor bad kim kohnguh .

translation.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad , Make speed , haste , stay not . And Jonathan s lad gathered up the arrows , and came to his master .
translation.kha: Wat shu ïeng hangto ! Leh kyrkieh !  Uta u khynnah u tam ïa uta u khnam bad u wan phai sha la u kynrad ,

translation.en: And Israel beheld Joseph s sons , and said , Who are these ?
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u ïohi ïa ki khun u Joseph , u kylli ,  Kiei kine ki khynnah ?

translation.en: For David , after he had served his own generation by the will of God , fell on sleep , and was laid unto his fathers , and saw corruption :
translation.kha: Naba u Dabid u la shakri ïa ki jingthmu jong U Blei ha ka por jong u ; bad nangta u la ïap , la tep ïa u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad ka met jong u ka la pyut hapoh ka jingtep .

translation.en: Beside that he had of the merchantmen , and of the traffick of the spice merchants , and of all the kings of Arabia , and of the governors of the country .
translation.kha: nalor ki khajna ba la siew da ki nongkhaïi , ki jingïohnong na ka khaïi ka pateng , ka bai nguh syiem na ki syiem Arabia , bad na ki lat jong ki distrik ha Israel .

translation.en: And he saith unto me , Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book : for the time is at hand .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha nga ,  Wat bat kum kaba rieh ïa ki ktien ka jingïathuhlypa jong kane ka kitab , namar ka por ka la jan haba kane baroh kan jia .

translation.en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies , who vexed them : and in the time of their trouble , when they cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours , who saved them out of the hand of their enemies .
translation.kha: kiba ong ïa ki ba ki dei ban phai pat sha me . Ki la ñiewbeiñ ïa me na ka por sha ka por , ba kumta me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop bad synshar ïa ki . Ha ka jingeh jong ki , ki khot ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me jubab ïa ki na bneng . Ha ka jingisynei bakhraw me phah ki nongïalam ïa ki kiba pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: The same came for a witness , to bear witness of the Light , that all men through him might believe .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u nonglamktien jong u , u briew uba kyrteng u Ïoannis , uba la wan ban ïathuh ïa ki briew shaphang ka jingshai , ba baroh ki dei ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor bad ban ngeit .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them , every one that entereth into the service , to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Uba rangbah duh na ki Lebi u dei u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh . U dei uba khmih ïa kito kiba pyndep ïa ki kamram ha ka Jaka Kyntang .

translation.en: And he came out , and went , as he was wont , to the mount of Olives  ; and his disciples also followed him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na ka nongbah bad u la leit , kumba u la ju leh , sha u lum ki Olib ; bad ki synran ki la leit lem bad u .

translation.en: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone , where the beast and the false prophet are , and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa u Ksuid , uba la shukor ïa ki , la bret sha ka pung ka ding bad u kyndok , ha kaba la lah bret ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler , bad kin shah pynkordit mynsngi bad mynmiet junom la junom .

translation.en: Then they shall bring out the damsel to the door of her father s house , and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she die : because she hath wrought folly in Israel , to play the whore in her father s house : so shalt thou put evil away from among you .
translation.kha: te ki dei ban leit ïalam ïa kata ka briew ha khmat ka jingkhang ïing u kpa jong ka , bad ki rangbah jong kata ka shnong kin lynthem maw ïa ka hangta haduh ba kan da ïap . Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba jahburom ha Israel da kaba pynjot ïa la ka jingsotti shuwa ka jingshongkurim . Da kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .

translation.en: And when Joseph s brethren saw that their father was dead , they said , Joseph will peradventure hate us , and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong ki , ki hynmen u Joseph ki ïa-ong ,  Tip kan jia aïu keiñ lada u Joseph u dang buhnud bad thmu ban pynhiarkput ïa ngi namar ka kam sniew ba ngi la leh ïa u ?

translation.en: So Hazael went to meet him , and took a present with him , even of every good thing of Damascus , forty camels  burden , and came and stood before him , and said , Thy son Ben–hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Hasael u pynkit ïa baroh ki jait jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong ka Damaskos ha ki sawphew tylli ki ut bad u leit sha u Elisha . Haba u Hasael u la ïakynduh ïa u , u ong ,  U shakri jong phi u syiem Benhadad u la phah ïa nga ban kylli na phi la un dang koit ne em na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me :
translation.kha: To pynkloi ban wan noh sha nga .

translation.en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and spake to all the people of Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Zion shall be plowed like a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .
translation.kha: Mynba u Hesekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Mikah u nongïathuhlypa na Moresheth u la bthah ïa baroh ki briew ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong ,   ‘ Ïa ka Seïon yn lur kum ka lyngkha , ka Jerusalem kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra , bad u lum ka Templ un kylla khlaw .’

translation.en: And he answered and said ,  He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish , the same shall betray me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Uta uba wieh ïa u kpu ha ka pliang lem bad nga , un shetkylla ïa nga .

translation.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years , and bear your whoredoms , until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki kti jong phi kin ïaid sakma ha kane ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , kin shitom namar kata ka jingbymïaineh jong phi , tad haduh ba uba khatduh eh napdeng jong phi un ïap .

translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , then fled they also before Abishai , and entered into the city . So Joab returned from the children of Ammon , and came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ki Ammon ki ïohi ba ki Syria ki la her ïap , ki ruh ki la phet krad na u Abishai bad ki leit rung noh shapoh ka nongbah . Nangta u Joab u wan phai noh na ka jingïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad u leit noh sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: These values , as taught in the Bible , promote well-being and respect for others , along with such qualities as honesty and kindness .
translation.kha: Kumba la hikai ha ka Baibl , kine ki aiñ ki ïarap ïa ngi ban kyntiew ïa ka long-briew manbriew , ban burom ïa kiwei , bad ban long kiba sbun bad kiba leh hok .

translation.en: And when thou sendest him out free from thee , thou shalt not let him go away empty :
translation.kha: Haba phi pyllait ïa ki , wat phah noh thylli ïa ki .

translation.en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .
translation.kha: Kaba rwai jingrwai ha u briew uba khuslai mynsiem ka long kumba loit noh ïa ki jaiñ jong u ha ka por khriat lane kum kaba kyllan mluh ha ka jingmong .

translation.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty , and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ïa ki thiar jong phi yn pyndap da u kew , bad phin ïoh ruh shibun bha ka waiñ haduh ba phim lah shuh ban pynlang ïa ka .

translation.en: Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;
translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan pynkmen ïa phi , to long kiba ïaishah ha ki jingjynjar jong phi , bad to duwai ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That ye which have followed me , in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory , ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones , judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Phi lah ban thikna ba haba U Khun U Briew u shong ha ka khet badonburom jong u ha ka Ïa kaba thymmai , te ma phi ki khat-ar ngut ki nongbud jong nga phin ïashong ruh ha ki khet , ban synshar ïa ki khat-ar ki jait Israel .

translation.en: The gold for things of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers . And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: bad na ka bynta ki tiar ki tar baroh kiba ki nong-ohdur ki dei ban shna . Mynta mano pat ba mon ban ai kylluid mynsiem sha U  Trai  ?

translation.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me , or lifted up myself when evil found him :
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju kmen haba ki nongshun jong nga ki shah jynjar , ne sngewbha haba ki ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot ;

translation.en: If the priest s daughter also be married unto a stranger , she may not eat of an offering of the holy things .
translation.kha: Ka khun u lyngdoh kaba shongkurim bad u bym dei na ka longïing lyngdoh kam lah ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang .

translation.en: It is turned as clay to the seal  ; and they stand as a garment .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai kaba mynsngi ka pynlong ïa ki lum bad ki them ban ïeng kum ki jingkhylliap jong ka jaiñ , kaba shai kum ka dak jong ka shab ha ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: And Jesus answering them began to say ,  Take heed lest any man deceive you :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Sumar bha , bad wat ai ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: That's impossible for me .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bymlahlong ianga .

translation.en: And thou , Ezra , after the wisdom of thy God , that is in thine hand , set magistrates and judges , which may judge all the people that are beyond the river , all such as know the laws of thy God  ; and teach ye them that know them not .
translation.kha: Ma me , ko Esra , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei jong me u la ai ha me , men thung ki nongsynshar bad ki nongbishar ki ban synshar ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi kiba im da ka Hukum jong U Blei jong me . Me dei ban hikai ïa kato ka Hukum ha uno uno u bymtip ïa ka .

translation.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath . And when he came to the gate of the city , behold , the widow woman was there gathering of sticks : and he called to her , and said , Fetch me , I pray thee , a little water in a vessel , that I may drink .
translation.kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit sha Sarephath . Ynda u poi ha khyrdop shnong , u la ïohi ïa kawei ka riewkynthei kaba tam diengïap . U khot ïa ka , bad u ong ,  Sngewbha ai ha nga ka um ban dih .

translation.en: And take double money in your hand  ; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks , carry it again in your hand  ; peradventure it was an oversight :
translation.kha: Rah pisa ar shah bad phi , namar phin hap rah biang ïa kito ki pisa ïa kiba la buh pat ha khlieh ki byrni jong phi . Ka lah ban long tang ka jingbakla .

translation.en: The church that is at Babylon , elected together with you , saluteth you  ; and so doth Mark my son .
translation.kha: Ka Balang kaba ha Babilon , ïa kaba la jied ruh da U Blei , ka phah ïa ki jingai khublei sha phi , bad kumjuh ruh u Markos u khun jong nga .

translation.en: If ye keep my commandments , ye shall abide in my love  ; even as I have kept my Father s commandments , and abide in his love .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga , kumba nga la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Kpa jong nga bad nga ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong u .

translation.en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar :
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u la shong la sah ha Gerar .

translation.en: And he asked his father ,  How long is it ago since this came unto him ?  And he said , Of a child .
translation.kha: Slem katno u la long kumne ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u kpa jong u .  Naduh ba u dang rit ,  u la jubab .

translation.en: And Ain with her suburbs , and Juttah with her suburbs , and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs  ; nine cities out of those two tribes .
translation.kha: ka Ain , ka Juttah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki : khyndai tylli ki shnong na ki jait Judah bad Simeon .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath accomplished his fury  ; he hath poured out his fierce anger , and hath kindled a fire in Zion , and it hath devoured the foundations thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyllait ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong u ; u la pynmeh ka ding ha Seïon kaba la thang duh ïa ka haduh khyndew .

translation.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . So Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
translation.kha: U ong ha u samla nongrah atiar jong u ,  Sei ïa ka waitlam jong me bad dung ïap ïa nga , ban ym shah ba kine ki Philistia ki bym don blei kin ïuhbeiñ halor jong nga .  Hynrei uta u samla u la khynñiuh tyngeh ban leh ïa ka . Kumta u Saul u sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u rynsied ïa lade ha ka .

translation.en: And he denied him , saying , Woman , I know him not .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la len ïa kata ,  Ko kynthei , ngam ju ithuh ïa u !

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og , kings of the Amorites , and unto the land of them , whom he destroyed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew kumba u la leh ïa u Sihon bad u Og , ki syiem Amor , bad kumba u la pynjot ïa ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la iehnoh ïa kaei kaei kaba u don ha u Isaak ;

translation.en: And they said , The God of the Hebrews hath met with us : let us go , we pray thee , three days  journey into the desert , and sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God  ; lest he fall upon us with pestilence , or with the sword .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la jubab ,  U Blei jong ki Hebru u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  uba U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngim leh kumta , un sa pynïap ïa ngi da ka jingpang lane da ka thma .

translation.en: And they took Joseph s coat , and killed a kid of the goats , and dipped the coat in the blood  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ki la pynïap uwei  langsohmoh bad ki wieh ïa kata ka sopti jong u Joseph ha ka snam jong u .

translation.en: Of which , twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord   ; and six thousand were officers and judges :
translation.kha: U syiem u buh arphew saw hajar ngut na ki ban pynïaid ïa ka kam ha ka Templ , hynriew hajar ngut ban buh jingthoh bad ban bishar ïa ki kam ïakajia ,

translation.en: Who hate the good , and love the evil  ; who pluck off their skin from off them , and their flesh from off their bones  ;
translation.kha: pynban phi isih ïa kaei kaba bha bad phi ieit ïa kaei kaba sniew . Phi khoh snieh im ïa ki briew jong nga bad phi tar ïa ka doh na ki shyieng jong ki .

translation.en: Woe to thee , O land , when thy king is a child , and thy princes eat in the morning !
translation.kha: Ka ri ka don ha ka jingjynjar haba u syiem jong ka u dei u samla bad ki nongïalam jong ka ki ïakhawai baroh shi miet .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him , to destroy him without cause .
translation.kha: Hato me la peit-thuh ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew . Me kynshuit ïa nga ban shah ïa me ban tur pyrshah ïa u khlem don kano kano ka daw , hynrei u Job u ïailong hi uba ïaineh kumba u ju long .

translation.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching , and ye took me not : but the scriptures must be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi nga la don bad phi ban hikai ha ka Templ , bad phim shym la kem ïa nga . Hynrei ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki dei ban urlong shisha .

translation.en: In their heat I will make their feasts , and I will make them drunken , that they may rejoice , and sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hato ki jlawnguid ? Ngan pynkhreh ïa ki ka jingkhawai bad pynlong ïa ki ban buaid bad sngewtynnat . Kin ïohthiah bad kin ym kyndit shuh .

translation.en: Feed the flock of God which is among you , taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint , but willingly  ; not for filthy lucre , but of a ready mind  ;
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi ban long ki nongsharai ïa ka kynhun ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi bad ban sumar ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha , kumba U Blei u kwah ïa phi , bad ym da kaba shu pynbor . Trei ïa la ka kam , ym tang na ka bynta ka bainong , hynrei na ka jingthrang ban shakri .

translation.en: And it came to pass , before he had done speaking , that , behold , Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel , son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham s brother , with her pitcher upon her shoulder .
translation.kha: Shuwa ban kut ka jingduwai , ka Rebekka ka la wan poi bad u khiew um ha la ka tyrpeng . Ka dei ka khun jong u Bethuel , uba long u khun jong ka Milkah bad u Nahor , uba shi para bad u Abraham .

translation.en: But Peter said , Not so , Lord  ; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ,  Da lei lei ruh em , ko Trai ! ngam pat ju bam mynno mynno ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid lane kaba sang kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men , but unto God : for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries .
translation.kha: Uta uba kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher um kren ha kiwei pat hynrei ha U Blei , namar ym don ba sngewthuh ïa u . U kren ïa ki jingshisha barieh da ka bor U Mynsiem .

translation.en: And they prayed , and said , Thou , Lord , which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki la duwai ,  A Trai , me tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , kumta pyn-i ha ngi uno na kine ar ngut uba me la jied

translation.en: And from Bamoth in the valley , that is in the country of Moab , to the top of Pisgah , which looketh toward Jeshimon .
translation.kha: bad na Bamoth sha ka them ha ka ri Moab , harum ka kliar u Lum Pisgah na uba lah ban ïohi ïa kata ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her  ; and they rejoiced with her .
translation.kha: Ki paramarjan bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka , ki la ïohsngew haduh katno U Trai u la long ka jingbha kaba phylla ïa ka , bad baroh ki la shadkmen lem bad ka .

translation.en: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing  ; and he called his servants , and said unto them , Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel ?
translation.kha: U syiem Syria u khuslai jingmut shibun shaphang kane ; u la khot ïa la ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Uno napdeng jong phi uba long ha ka liang jong u syiem ka Israel ?

translation.en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces : and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold , and silver , and with precious stones , and pleasant things .
translation.kha: Pynban , un pyndonburom ïa u blei uba ïada ïa ki kut . Un ai ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawlynnai , bad kiwei kiwei ki jingai babha sha u blei uba ki kpa tymmen jong u kim shym la ju mane .

translation.en: And thou shalt offer peace offerings , and shalt eat there , and rejoice before the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: hangta ruh kñia bad bam ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad lehkmen ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And when they were come to Jerusalem , they were received of the church , and of the apostles and elders , and they declared all things that God had done with them .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerusalem , la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki da ka balang , da ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ha kiba ki la ïathuh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong ki .

translation.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom , according as I have covenanted with David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel .
translation.kha: ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong me mynba nga la ong ha u ba ïa ka Israel yn synshar borabor da ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: Then shalt thou say , O  Lord  , thou hast spoken against this place , to cut it off , that none shall remain in it , neither man nor beast , but that it shall be desolate for ever .
translation.kha: Nangta sa duwai , ‘ A  Trai  , me la ong ba men pynjot ïa kane ka jaka , haduh ba yn ym don jingthaw ba im ha ka , u briew lane u mrad , bad ba kan long kum ka ri shyiap junom .’

translation.en: Then Saul s anger was kindled against Jonathan , and he said unto him , Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman , do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion , and unto the confusion of thy mother s nakedness ?
translation.kha: U Saul u bitar lep ïa u Jonathan bad u ong ha u ,  Me u khun pongka ! Mynta nga tip ba me ïashah liang bad u Dabid bad me pynjahburom ïa lade bad ïa kato ka kmie jong me !

translation.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me , and those that have known thy testimonies .
translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba pyndonburom ïa me kin wan sha nga — kito baroh kiba tip ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn , and to restore every man s money into his sack , and to give them provision for the way : and thus did he unto them .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la hukum ban pyndap ïa ki byrni jong ki hynmen shynrang jong u da u kew , bad ban thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei ha ka byrni jong u , bad ban ai jingbam de ba kin ïoh bam ha lynti . Ïa kane la leh .

translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out , will I rule over you :
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , nga maham ïa phi ba ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan synshar halor jong phi da ka ksang ti kaba khlaiñ , da ka bor jong nga baroh .

translation.en: When will God bring an end to evil on earth ?
translation.kha: Lano U Blei un pynkut ïa ki jingsniew ha pyrthei ?

translation.en: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia , we came to Myra , a city of Lycia .
translation.kha: Ngi la jam ïa ka duriaw da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Kilikia bad Pamphylia , bad ngi la poi sha Mura , ha Lukia .

translation.en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock , upon the crag of the rock , and the strong place .
translation.kha: U thaw ïa ka skum halor ki mawsiang kiba kynjang eh bad pynlong ka kut jong ka ïa ki kliar lum kiba nep .

translation.en: Is not thy wickedness great ? and thine iniquities infinite ?
translation.kha: Em , ka dei namar ba phi la leh pop haduh katta katta ; ka long namar ka jingsniew baroh kaba phi leh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Jesus was returned , the people gladly received him : for they were all waiting for him .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan phai sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw , ki briew ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , namar baroh ki la ïa-ap ïa u .

translation.en: What are you doing ?
translation.kha: Dang leh aiu ?

translation.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue : the  Lord  hath sought him a man after his own heart , and the  Lord  hath commanded him to be captain over his people , because thou hast not kept that which the  Lord  commanded thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ka jingsynshar jong phi kan ym bteng . Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u , U  Trai  un wad ïa u briew uba u kwah bad un thung ïa u ban long nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Shall evil be recompensed for good ? for they have digged a pit for my soul . Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them , and to turn away thy wrath from them .
translation.kha: Hato ka jingsniew ka dei ka bainong na ka bynta kaba bha ? Pynban ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan hap ha ka . To kynmaw kumno ba nga la wan sha me bad kren na ka bynta jong ki , khnang ba men ym leh ei ei ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .

translation.en: My son , if thine heart be wise , my heart shall rejoice , even mine .
translation.kha: Ko khun , lada phi long uba stad , ngan sngewkmen shikatdei eh .

translation.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong kine ki jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: But know this , that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come , he would have watched , and would not have suffered his house to be broken up .
translation.kha: Lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka por ba u nongtuh un wan , phi lah ban thikna ba un jin da la peitmat bad un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Have all the gifts of healing ? do all speak with tongues ? do all interpret ?
translation.kha: Baroh kim long ki Apostol ne ki nongïathuhlypa ne ki nonghikai . Ym baroh ki don ïa ka bor ban leh ïa ki kambah lane ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher lane ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .

translation.en: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing : He shall be brought unto the priest :
translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid ïa u briew uba la koit na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh . Ha kata ka sngi ha kaba yn pynkhuid ïa u , yn wallam ïa u ha khmat u lyngdoh ,

translation.en: Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah , which are come from Babylon , and come thou the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah  ;
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Shim ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la ai da u Heldai , u Tobijah bad u Jedaïah kiba la shah ringmraw , bad leit shisyndon sha ka ïing jong u Josaïah u khun jong u Sephanaïah . Kine ki rangbah baroh ki la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia .

translation.en: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee , hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Job , shahshkor bha ïa nga ïa baroh kaba nga don ban ong .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah , and dwelt in Tirzah .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la sangeh noh ïa ka jingtei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah bad u leit sha Tirsah .

translation.en: Give none offence , neither to the Jews , nor to the Gentiles , nor to the church of God .
translation.kha: To im ha kata ka rukom ban ym thaw jingeh ïa ki Jiw ne ïa ki Jentil ne ïa ka balang U Blei .

translation.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls  ; every several gate was of one pearl : and the street of the city was pure gold , as it were transparent glass .
translation.kha: Ki khat-ar tylli ki khyrdop ki la long ki khat-ar tylli ki mawlynnai ; ïa kawei kawei ka khyrdop la shna na uwei u mawlynnai . Ka lynti bah jong ka nongbah ka la long da ka ksiar nylla , kaba lah ban ïohi lyngba kum ka ïit .

translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him  ; for they feared the people .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , bad kumta ki la pyrshang ban wad lad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu ha kaba jar jar .

translation.en: The rich and poor meet together : the  Lord  is the maker of them all .
translation.kha: Kiba riewspah bad kiba duk ki don ïa kane kajuh , U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki baroh ar .

translation.en: Now therefore write ye this song for you , and teach it the children of Israel : put it in their mouths , that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Mynta , thoh ïa kane ka jingrwai . Hikai ïa ka ha ki Israel , khnang ba ka kan ïeng kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah , and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim , which Asa his father had taken .
translation.kha: U pynap shipai ha ki nongbah ba la tei kut ka Judah , ha ki rudnong Judah , bad ha ki nongbah kiba u Asa u la jop ha ka ri ki Ephraim .

translation.en: As if a man did flee from a lion , and a bear met him  ; or went into the house , and leaned his hand on the wall , and a serpent bit him .
translation.kha: Kan long kum haba u briew u phet ïap na u sing bad u ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem ! lane kum haba u briew u wan sha la ïing bad buh ïa la ka kti ha ka kynroh — tang ban shah puh ha u bseiñ !

translation.en: And Samuel said , When thou wast little in thine own sight , wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel , and the  Lord  anointed thee king over Israel ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Wat la phi ñiew ïa lade ba phim long ei ei , phi dei u nongïalam jong ki jait Israel . U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa phi ban long u syiem jong ki Israel ,

translation.en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash , the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us look one another in the face .
translation.kha: Nangta u Amasaïah u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Jehoash u syiem ka Israel , u kob ïa u ban ïaleh .

translation.en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la iehnoh ïa u .

translation.en: At her feet he bowed , he fell , he lay down : at her feet he bowed , he fell : where he bowed , there he fell down dead .
translation.kha: U hap da ki khohsiew , U kyllon kram bad u thiah lyngktar ha ki kjat jong ka . Ha ki kjat jong ka u hap da ki khohsiew bad u kyllon ; U kyllon kram ha madan , uba la ïap .

translation.en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah , and smote the host : for the host was secure .
