translation.kha: U Gideon u ïaid na ka lynti na ki tduh jong ka ri shyiap , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nobah bad ka Jogbehah , bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ha kaba kim shym poi pyrkhat .

translation.en: And he said unto him , If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Lada me hi men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi , wat ai ba ngin mihnoh na kane ka jaka .

translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens , and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um shalor jong ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra buh tiar jong u .

translation.en: And Serug lived thirty years , and begat Nahor :
translation.kha: Haba u Serug u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Nahor ;

translation.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaishah ba pynkohnguh ka lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah bakhlaiñ tam bad ka lah ban pynngeit wat ïa ki nongsynshar .

translation.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters , washed with milk , and fitly set .
translation.kha: Ka ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga , ka nongleitkurim jong nga , ka long ka kper barieh , ka kper ba la ker kynroh , ka umpohliew bym dei paidbah ;

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against the Ammonites , and prophesy against them  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri ki Ammon .

translation.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom , nor your spouses when they commit adultery : for themselves are separated with whores , and they sacrifice with harlots : therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall .
translation.kha: Wat la katta ruh ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kane , namar ma phi hi phi ïa-ïaid lang bad ki nuti kiba ha ka templ , bad ryngkat bad ki , phi ai ki jingkñia ba-thala . Kumba ka proberb ka ong , ‘ Ki briew kiba khlem pyrkhat kin sa jot noh .’

translation.en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved , where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear ?
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew ki babha ba kin ïohlait im ; aïu te , kan long ïa ki nongpop ba khlem Blei ?

translation.en: And he brought me thither , and , behold , there was a man , whose appearance was like the appearance of brass , with a line of flax in his hand , and a measuring reed  ; and he stood in the gate .
translation.kha: U la rah ïa nga kham sha jan , bad nga la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba phyrnai kum ka rnong . U bat ha ka kti ïa u pita uba da ka jaiñ linen bad ïa u diengthew bad u ïeng hajan ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And he came to Nazareth , where he had been brought up : and , as his custom was , he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and stood up for to read .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha Nasareth , ha kaba la pynheh pynsan ïa u , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la leit sha ka synagog kumba ju long . U la ïeng ban pule ïa Ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ,

translation.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king : and sheweth mercy to his anointed , unto David , and to his seed for evermore .
translation.kha: U Blei u ai ki jingjop bakhraw ha u syiem jong u ; u pynpaw ka jingieit baïaineh ha uba u la jied , ha u Dabid bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom .

translation.en: Also he built Beth–horon the upper , and Beth–horon the nether , fenced cities , with walls , gates , and bars  ;
translation.kha: U Solomon u la tei biang ïa kine ki nongbah : ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , ( ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang ) ,

translation.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him , How is it that thou , being a Jew , askest drink of me , which am a woman of Samaria ? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la jubab ,  Me long u Jiw , bad nga long ka nong Samaria — te kumno me lah ban pan um na nga ban dih ?  ( Ki Jiw kim pyndonkam ïa kijuh ki khuri bad ki pliang kiba ki nong Samaria ki pyndonkam . )

translation.en: And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king s son , and Azrikam the governor of the house , and Elkanah that was next to the king .
translation.kha: Uwei u shipai Israel uba kyrteng u Sikhri , u la pynïap ïa u Maaseïah u khun jong u syiem Ahas , ïa u Asrikam u nongpynïaidkam ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa u Elkanah , uba ha ka kyrdan kaba ar ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people : for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ha kata ka sngi , kata ka jingkmen ïa ka jingjop ka la kylla sha ka jingsngewsih ïa baroh ki shipai jong u Dabid , namar ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem u ïambriew na ka bynta la u khun .

translation.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynpaw ha ki por baroh ki ban sa wan ïa ka jingkhraw tam eh ka jingaiei jong u ha ka jingieit ïa kaba u la pyn-i sha ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: For he remembered his holy promise , and Abraham his servant .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang jong u ïa u Abraham u shakri jong u .

translation.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon . And Julius courteously entreated Paul , and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Sidon . U Julius u la lehsbun ïa u Paul bad u la shah ïa u ban leit bad ïakynduh ïa la ki paralok , ba kin ai kat kaba u donkam .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face : they shall come out against thee one way , and flee before thee seven ways .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin shahjop haba ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi . Kin wan tur na kawei ka dong , hynrei kin sa her ïap na baroh ki dong .

translation.en: But in those days , after that tribulation , the sun shall be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light ,
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi hadien kata ka por jong ka jingjynjar , ka sngi kan sa kylla dum , u bnai un ym shai shuh ,

translation.en: Let no man deceive himself . If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world , let him become a fool , that he may be wise .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa lade hi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u pyrkhat ba u long uba stad da ka jingthew jong kane ka pyrthei , u dei ban long uba bieit khnang ba un long uba stad da shisha .

translation.en: Meddle not with them  ; for I will not give you of their land , no , not so much as a foot breadth  ; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession .
translation.kha: Kin tieng ïa phi , hynrei phim dei ban ïaknieh jaka bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ha phi wat tang khyndiat ruh na kata ka ri jong ki . Nga la ai ïa ka Edom ha ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .

translation.en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold , for all instruments of all manner of service  ; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight , for all instruments of every kind of service :
translation.kha: U ai jingbthah ruh katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar kan leit ha kaba shna ïa kita ki khiew ki pliang ,

translation.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because mine hand had gotten much  ;
translation.kha: ne sngewsarong ha ka jingdon jingem jong nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof , and shalt burn with fire the city , and all the spoil thereof every whit , for the  Lord  thy God : and it shall be an heap for ever  ; it shall not be built again .
translation.kha: Lumlang ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki briew baroh kiba shong hangta bad kynton ïa ki ha ka madan shnong . Nangta thang ïa kata ka shnong bad ïa kata ka spah ka phew baroh kum ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Ka dei ban sah junom ha ka jingjot bad ym dei ban tei pat .

translation.en: Though he spare it , and forsake it not  ; but keep it still within his mouth :
translation.kha: U bang bha ban leh ïa ka jingsniew bad u buh katto katne ha ka shyntur jong u ban sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbang jong ka .

translation.en: The word that the  Lord  spake to Jeremiah the prophet , how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ijipt , U  Trai  U la kren ha nga . U ong ,

translation.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother ? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother ? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ .
translation.kha: Ma phi te , kiba bam tang ki jhur — balei phi bishar ïa la u parabangeit ? Bad ma phi kiba bam ïa kiei kiei baroh — balei phi peitbeiñ ïa la u parabangeit ? Baroh na ngi , ngin hap ban ïeng ha khmat U Blei ban shah bishar da u .

translation.en: For there is nothing hid , which shall not be manifested  ; neither was any thing kept secret , but that it should come abroad .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaei ba la buhrieh yn sei shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kaei kaei ba la tap yn sa law noh .

translation.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought , and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe , and sent him again to Pilate .
translation.kha: U Herod bad ki shipai jong u ki la krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu bad kim ñiewburom ïa u ; nangta ki la buh ka jaiñkup ba-itynnat halor jong u bad u la phah pat ïa u sha u Pilat .

translation.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the  Lord  , Gideon said , Alas , O Lord  God  ! for because I have seen an angel of the  Lord  face to face .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u la sngewthuh ba dei u angel jong U  Trai  ba u la ïohi , bad u ong ha ka jingsheptieng ,  A  Trai  Bakhrawbor ! Nga la ïohi ïa u angel jong me markhmat !

translation.en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan : the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones  ; for they are come , and have devoured the land , and all that is in it  ; the city , and those that dwell therein .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la da don hapoh ka nongbah Dan ; ngi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa pynhiar mynsiem jong ki kulai jong ki . Ka ri baroh kawei ka khynñiuh haba ki kulai jong ki , ki pah . Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la wan ban pynjot ïa ka ri jong ngi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha ka , ka nongbah jong ngi bad baroh ki briew jong ka .

translation.en: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces : and they said , The  Lord  , he is the God  ; the  Lord  , he is the God .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kane , ki ïadem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ïa-pyrta jam ,  U  Trai  u long U Blei ; U  Trai  tang ma u , u long U Blei !

translation.en: ( Romans 6 :19  ; 12 :1  ; 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) It can be very hard to give up these habits .
translation.kha: ( Rom 6 :19 ; 12 :1 ; 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Ka lah ban long kaba eh ban iehnoh ïa kine ki jingmlien .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Are ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and with staves to take me ?
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha ki ,  Hato phi donkam ban wan ryngkat bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon ban kem ïa nga , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ?

translation.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders , and said , We have bound ourselves under a great curse , that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ong ,  Ngi la pynlong lang ka jingsmai ba sngewkhia ban ym bam kano kano tad ynda ngi la pynïap ïa u Paul .

translation.en: But the wise answered , saying , Not so  ; lest there be not enough for us and you : but go ye rather to them that sell , and buy for yourselves .
translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ kiba stad ki la jubab , ‘ kam don shibun ban dap ïa phi bad ïa ngi ruh . Khie leit sha dukan bad thied khyndiat na ka bynta ïa lade .’

translation.en: And Balaam said unto God , Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , hath sent unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  U syiem Balak ka ri Moab u la phah ïa ki ban ïathuh ha nga

translation.en: Would You Like to Know More About the Bible ?
translation.kha: Phi Kwah Ne Em Ban Tip Shuhshuh Shaphang Ka Baibl ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel dwelt in that land , that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father s concubine : and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u dang shong dang sah ha kata ka ri , u Reuben u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka Bilhah , kawei na ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u . U Jakob u la tip ïa kata bad u bitar shla . U Jakob u don khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang .

translation.en: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch , saying , I am shut up  ; I cannot go into the house of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ai ha u Barukh ïa kine ki jingbthah harum :  Ym shah shuh ïa nga ban rung hapoh ka Templ .

translation.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren , they hated him , and could not speak peaceably unto him .
translation.kha: Haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u ki la ïohi ba u kpa jong ki u kham ieit ïa u Joseph ban ïa ki baroh , ki la isih shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba kim kren bha kren miat shuh ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt bring them in , and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance , in the place , O  Lord  , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in , in the Sanctuary , O Lord , which thy hands have established .
translation.kha: Me wan ïalam ïa ki shapoh bad me buh ïa ki ha u lumbah jong me , ha ka jaka kaba me , ko  Trai  , me la jied na ka bynta ka ïing jong me , ka Templ kaba me hi me la tei .

translation.en: A sword is upon the liars  ; and they shall dote : a sword is upon her mighty men  ; and they shall be dismayed .
translation.kha: Ka Jingïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bashukor jong ka — katno ki long kiba bieit ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai jong ka — katno ki long kiba sheptieng !

translation.en: Which things also we speak , not in the words which man s wisdom teacheth , but which the Holy Ghost teacheth ; comparing spiritual things with spiritual .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ngim kren ha ki ktien ba la hikai da ka jingstad briew , hynrei ha ki ktien ba la hikai da U Mynsiem , kumba ngi batai ïa ki jingshisha ba kynja mynsiem ha kito kiba don U Mynsiem .

translation.en: That they have committed adultery , and blood is in their hands , and with their idols have they committed adultery , and have also caused their sons , whom they bare unto me , to pass for them through the fire , to devour them .
translation.kha: Ki la klim bad pynïap briew — kaba klim bad ki bleithaw bad ka jingpynïap ïa ki khun kiba la kha na ka bynta jong nga . Ki kñia ïa ki khun jong nga ha ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year .
translation.kha: ba ki samla kynthei kin leit saw sngi man la ka snem ban ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khun u Jephthah u nong Gilead .

translation.en: That seeing they may see , and not perceive  ; and hearing they may hear , and not understand  ; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them .
translation.kha: khnang ba ,   ‘ Kin khmih bad ïai khmih , pynban kin ym ïohi ; Kin sngap bad ïai sngap , pynban kin ym sngewthuh . Namar lada ki ïohi lane sngewthuh , kin phai sha U Blei , bad un map ïa ki .’

translation.en: And the scripture , foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith , preached before the gospel unto Abraham , saying , In thee shall all nations be blessed .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la ong lypa ba U Blei un pynksan ïa ki Jentil ha lade hi da ka jingngeit . Bad kumta ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka pynbna ïa ka khubor babha ha u Abraham :  Lyngba jong me , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: In the year of this jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka snem , ïa ka jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka .

translation.en: He shall die without instruction  ; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray .
translation.kha: U ïap namar ba um lah synshar ïa lade ; ka jingïailong mutlop jong u kan ïalam ïa u sha ka jingtep jong u hi .

translation.en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ , the Son of God  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu Khrist , U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity , because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the  Lord  : and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka un ngat ha ka jingpynrem ba u kheiñ dew thala ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night , roast with fire , and unleavened bread  ; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , ïa ka doh dei ban syang , bad bam ïa ka lem bad u kpu khlem thiat bad ki jhur kthang .

translation.en: They are all hot as an oven , and have devoured their judges  ; all their kings are fallen : there is none among them that calleth unto me .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingkhluit ka jingbitar jong ki , ki pynïap ïa la ki nongsynshar . Ki syiem jong ki , ki shah pynïap uwei hadien uwei , hynrei ym don na ki uba khot kyrpad ïa nga ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim , and came unto the house of Micah .
translation.kha: Ki leit sha khmat nangta bad ki wan poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba don ha ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus  ; and the Syrians became David s servants , and brought gifts . Thus the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
translation.kha: Nangta u pynïeng ki ïingjaiñ shipai ha ka ri jong ki , bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u bad ki siew khajna sha u . U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa u Dabid ha kylleng .

translation.en: Ye that have escaped the sword , go away , stand not still : remember the  Lord  afar off , and let Jerusalem come into your mind .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u kiba don ha Babilonia :  Phi la lait na ka jingïap ! Mynta to leit ! Wat ap ! Wat la phi don jngai na ïing , pyrkhat shaphang jong nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad kynmaw ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with  ; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished !
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingpynbaptis ban ïohpdiang , bad katno nga sngewkhia mynsiem tad haduh ba kan da kut noh !

translation.en: And Joshua rose up early in the morning , and numbered the people , and went up , he and the elders of Israel , before the people to Ai .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab u Joshua u la khie bad lumlang ïa ki shipai . Nangta ma u bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la ïalam ïa ki sha Ai .

translation.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked , and the scant measure that is abominable ?
translation.kha: Ha ki ïing jong ki briew kiba sniew don ki jingkynshew kiba ki la lum da kaba leh bymhok . Ki pyndonkam da ki jingthew bashukor , kaei kaei kaba nga isih .

translation.en: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he will send forth labourers into his harvest .
translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Trai ka jingot ba un phah ïa ki nongtrei ban ïalumlang ha ka jingot jong u .

translation.en: For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light .
translation.kha: Naba ka lyngkor kaba ngan ai ha phi ka long kaba jem , bad ka jingkit ba ngan buh halor jong phi ka long kaba sting .

translation.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka don ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki briew kiba stad ; kiba bieit kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingstad .

translation.en: Give me understanding , and I shall keep thy law  ; yea , I shall observe it with my whole heart .
translation.kha: To batai ïa ka aiñ jong me ha nga , bad ngan kohnguh ïa ka ; ngan sumar ïa ka da ka dohnud jong nga baroh .

translation.en: The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him .
translation.kha: ka jingriam ka ïoh ïa ki khongdong jat jong u bad bat khak ïa u .

translation.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself , in that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , when he led thee by the way ?
translation.kha: Ko Israel me la wallam ïa kane halor jong me ! Me la iehnoh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , katba nga dang ïalam ïa me ha ka lynti .

translation.en: And if he smite out his manservant s tooth , or his maidservant s tooth  ; he shall let him go free for his tooth s sake .
translation.kha: Lada u lop ïa ka bniat jong u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka bniat .

translation.en: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field ? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken ?
translation.kha: Hato ki kynjang mawsiang jong ka Lebanon ki ju long khlem ka ïor ? Hato ki wahduid ba dait-thah na ki lumbah ki ju rngad ?

translation.en: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints , but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingshakri kaba phi leh ym ba ka pyndap tang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew jong U Blei , hynrei ka pynshlei ruh ïa ka jingainguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: For ask now of the days that are past , which were before thee , since the day that God created man upon the earth , and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other , whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is , or hath been heard like it ?
translation.kha: Phai sha ka mynnor , sha kata ka por shuwa ban kha ïa phi , ter shi ter haduh kata ka por mynba U Blei u la thaw ïa u briew ha ka pyrthei . Wad ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Hato kaei kaei kaba khraw kat kane ka la ju jia mynshuwa ? Don mo u briew uba la ju ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei kaba kat kane ?

translation.en: As they gather silver , and brass , and iron , and lead , and tin , into the midst of the furnace , to blow the fire upon it , to melt it  ; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury , and I will leave you there , and melt you .
translation.kha: ha kajuh ka rukom ba ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ka rupa , ka tama , ka nar , ka sisa , bad ka tin la buh ha ka ding ban saiñ ïa ki . Ka jingbitar bad jingbitar shla jong nga kin pynum ïa ki kumba ka lawar ding ka pynum ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ki .

translation.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish , and gold from Uphaz , the work of the workman , and of the hands of the founder : blue and purple is their clothing : they are all the work of cunning men .
translation.kha: Ïa ki bleithaw jong ki la sop da ka rupa na Spain bad da ka ksiar na Uphas baroh ki jingtrei jong ki nongtrei ; la pynphong jaiñ ïa ki ha ki jaiñ ïongjngum bad sawbthuh ba la thain da ki nongthain jaiñ batbit .

translation.en: For he knoweth vain men : he seeth wickedness also  ; will he not then consider it ?
translation.kha: U Blei u tip kino ki briew ki bymlarkam ; u ïohi ïa ki kam sniew jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And she went , and sat her down over against him a good way off , as it were a bowshot : for she said , Let me not see the death of the child . And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice , and wept .
translation.kha: bad ïa lade ka leit shong kumba shispah mitar na kata ka jaka . Ka ong ha lade ,  Ngam lah shah ban ïohi ïa la u khun ba u ïap .  Katba ka dang shong hangta , ka la sdang ban ïam .

translation.en: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house  ; and the man stood by me .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u ïeng ha syndah jong nga hangta , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren ha nga shabar ka Templ bad ong :

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that when they make a long blast with the ram s horn , and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet , all the people shall shout with a great shout  ; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat , and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him .
translation.kha: Nangta ki dei ban pynsawa ïa kawei ka sur kaba jlan . Tang mar shu ïohsngew ïa kata , ki briew baroh ki dei ban risa jam , bad ki kynroh jong ka nongbah kin khyllem . Nangta ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei kan leit beit beit shapoh ka nongbah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ki la ïathmu sniew pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza  ; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley : how long wilt thou cut thyself ?
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewsih bakhraw ka la wan ha ki briew jong ka Gasa , bad ki briew jong ka Ashkelon ki sngap jar . Katno slem kiba dang sah ha Philistia kin ïam sngewsih ?

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together : and all that took them captives held them fast  ; they refused to let them go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ki paid Israel bad Judah ki shah banbeiñ . Baroh kiba kurup ïa ki , ki khmih pyrman ïa ki bad kin ym pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: Hath a nation changed their gods , which are yet no gods ? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano kawei pat ka jaitbynriew kaba kylla ïa la ki blei , wat la kim dei kiba shisha . Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la bujli ïa nga , U Blei uba la wanrah ha ki ka jingpyndonburom , da ki blei ki bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .

translation.en: Jehovah used the prehuman Jesus as his “master worker” in creating all other things in heaven and on earth .
translation.kha: Shuwa ba un wan long briew U Jehobah u la pyndonkam ïa u Jisu kum u “rangbah nongtrei” ha kaba thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha bneng bad ha khyndew .

translation.en: And when he had found him , he brought him unto Antioch . And it came to pass , that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church , and taught much people . And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch .
translation.kha: Haba u la shem ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha Antiokh , bad baroh shisnem kine ar ngut ki la ïakynduh ïa ki briew ka balang bad ki la hikai ïa ka kynhun kaba heh . Ka la long ha Antiokh ba ïa ki parabangeit la khot nyngkong eh  Ki Khristan .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  , your Holy One , the creator of Israel , your King .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  , U Blei bakhuid jong phi , nga la thaw ïa phi , ko Israel , bad nga long u Syiem jong phi .

translation.en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding : but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly .
translation.kha: Lada phi long jai jai , phi long kiba stad , hynrei lada phi long kiba shit khlieh , phi shu pyn-i katno ka jinglong mutlop phi long .

translation.en: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things , thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ , nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine , whereunto thou hast attained .
translation.kha: Lada me ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki parabangeit , men long u shakri babha jong U Khrist Jisu , kumba me bsa ïa lade ha ka mynsiem da ki ktien jong ka jingngeit bad jong ki jinghikai bashisha ïa kiba me la bud .

translation.en: Libnah , and Ether , and Ashan ,
translation.kha: Don ruh ka Libnah , ka Ether , ka Ashan ,

translation.en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the  Lord  God of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ki briew ka Judah bad Benjamin ki la ïohsngew ba kita kiba la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ki dang ïatei pat ïa ka Templ U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Son of man , hath not the house of Israel , the rebellious house , said unto thee , What doest thou ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  mynta ba kito ki Israel ba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ki kylli ïa me ïa kaei kaba me leh ,

translation.en: As it is written in the law of Moses , all this evil is come upon us : yet made we not our prayer before the  Lord  our God , that we might turn from our iniquities , and understand thy truth .
translation.kha: da kaba ai ha ngi ïa baroh ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka Aiñ jong u Moses . Hynrei wat mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , ngim shym la pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa me da kaba phai noh na ki pop jong ngi lane da kaba bud ïa ka jingshisha jong me .

translation.en: And he took their king s crown from off his head , the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones : and it was set on David s head . And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la shim ïa ka pansngiat ksiar na ka khlieh u blei Molekh , u bleithaw ki Ammon kaba khia kumba laiphew san kilo bad kaba don u mawkordor ha ka . U Dabid u la shim ïa u mawkordor bad u buh ïa u ha la ka pansngiat . U rah ruh shibun ki mar lute na ka nongbah

translation.en: But Abraham said , Son , remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things , and likewise Lazarus evil things : but now he is comforted , and thou art tormented .
translation.kha: Hynrei , u Abraham u la ong , ‘ To kynmaw , ko khun jong nga , ba ha ka por ka jingim jong me la ai ha me ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba bha , katba u Lasaros u la ïohpdiang ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba sniew . Hynrei mynta u lehkmen ïa lade hangne , katba me don ha ka jingshitom .

translation.en: One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter s brother , saith unto him ,
translation.kha: Uwei pat na ki synran jong u , u Andriw , uba long u para jong u Simon Petros , u la ong ,

translation.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them , and caused the light of his cloud to shine ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip kumno U Blei u ai hukum bad u pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba na ki lyoh ?

translation.en: And when he was come in , he did eat and drink , and said , Go , see now this cursed woman , and bury her : for she is a king s daughter .
translation.kha: u rung shapoh ïingsyiem , bad u bam jingbam . Hadien kata u ong ,  Shim ïa kato ka kynthei ba la shah tim , bad tep ïa ka ; naba ka dei ka khun jong u syiem .

translation.en: But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up , take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak , neither do ye premeditate : but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour , that speak ye : for it is not ye that speak , but the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Bad haba la kem ïa phi bad ïalam sha ka ïingbishar , wat khuslai lypa ïa kaei kaba phin kren ; haba ka por kan poi , to kren ïa kaei kaei kaba yn sa ai ha phi ha kata ka por . Namar ki ktien kiba phin sa kren , kin ym long ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: I shall come with you .
translation.kha: Ngan Wan lang bad phi .

translation.en: Ye shall not do so unto the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kumba leh kita ki briew .

translation.en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh  ; for he was the firstborn of Joseph  ; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead : because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .
translation.kha: Shi bynta jong ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ha ki katto katne ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph . U Makhir , u kpa jong u Gilead , u dei u khun nyngkong jong u Manasseh bad u khla-ka-wait uba pawnam ; kumta ïa ka Gilead bad ka Bashan , ha ka phang mihngi ka Jordan , la ai ha u .

translation.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali , with their mattocks round about .
translation.kha: U leh kumjuh ha ki nongbah bad ki jaka ba la ieh kynjah jong ki Manasseh , Ephraim , bad Simeon , bad jngai shaduh shatei haduh Naphtali .

translation.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money , neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices : but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins , thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities .
translation.kha: Phim shym la thied jingiwbih ïa nga lane pynhun ïa nga da ka khleiñ ki jingri jong phi . Pynban phi la bankhia ïa nga da ki pop jong phi ; phi la pynbtai ïa nga da ki jingbakla ba phi la leh .

translation.en: And she said unto her , Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband ? and wouldest thou take away my son s mandrakes also ? And Rachel said , Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son s mandrakes .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka jubab ,  Hato pham pat sngewhun ba pha la knieh noh ïa u tnga jong nga ? Mynta pat pha pyrshang ban shim sa ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong nga .  Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  Lada phan ai ïa nga ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong pha , pha lah ban thiah bad u Jakob mynta ka miet .

translation.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew yn pynkut bad ïa ka jinglehmeng ki briew yn pynjot . Ki bleithaw kin jah noh plain , bad tang ïa U  Trai  yn kyntiew burom ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany , and he lifted up his hands , and blessed them .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa ki shabar ka nongbah haduh ha Bethania , ha kaba u la rah ïa la ki kti bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .

translation.en: And he brought the burnt offering , and offered it according to the manner .
translation.kha: U wanlam ruh ïa u mrad na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang , bad u kñia ïa u katba kum ka jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: And Elijah said unto her , Fear not  ; go and do as thou hast said : but make me thereof a little cake first , and bring it unto me , and after make for thee and for thy son .
translation.kha: Wat khuslai  u Elijah u la ong ha ka .  Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei nyngkong shet ïa u kpu uba rit na kaei kaba pha don bad wanrah ïa u sha nga , bad nangta sa shet ïa kaba sah na ka bynta jong pha bad ïa u khun jong pha .

translation.en: That this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean ye by these stones ?
translation.kha: Kine ki maw kin pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh . Hadien habud , haba ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,

translation.en: Also the children of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head .
translation.kha: Ho-oid ki rangbah jong ka Memphis bad ka Tahpanhes ki la pynpait ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u .

translation.en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .
translation.kha: da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri Judah .

translation.en: And he said , Speak , I pray thee , unto Solomon the king , ( for he will not say thee nay , ) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Sngewbha kylli ïa u Syiem Solomon — nga tip un ym kyrngah ïa phi — ban shah ïa nga ban ïoh ïa ka Abishag , ka theisamla na Shunem , kum ka tnga jong nga .

translation.en: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men : in thy hills , and in thy valleys , and in all thy rivers , shall they fall that are slain with the sword .
translation.kha: Ngan tap ïa ki lumbah da ki metïap , bad ki met jong kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma kin tap ïa ki lumrit bad ki them .

translation.en: Then Jacob said unto his household , and to all that were with him , Put away the strange gods that are among you , and be clean , and change your garments :
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u ong ha la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ha kita baroh kiba don lem bad u ,  Bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baroh kiba phi don ; pynkhuid ïa lade , bad phong da ki jaiñ kiba khuid .

translation.en: And the men of David said unto him , Behold the day of which the  Lord  said unto thee , Behold , I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand , that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee . Then David arose , and cut off the skirt of Saul s robe privily .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka kabu jong phi ! U  Trai  u la ïathuh ïa phi ba un buh ïa u nongshun ha ka bor jong phi bad phi lah ban leh ïa u kat kaba phi kwah .  U Dabid u par sor sor bad u ot shi lyngkhot na ka jaiñkup u Saul khlem ka jingtip u Saul .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Let us go into the next towns , that I may preach there also : for therefore came I forth .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jisu u la jubab ,  Ngi dei ban leit sha kiwei nongrit ha kine ki thain . Nga dei ban ïalap ha ki ruh , namar dei na kata ka daw ba nga la wan .

translation.en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan , which was of the remnant of the giants , that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,
translation.kha: Ki la jop ruh ïa u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba long uwei na kiba khatduh jong ki Rephaim ; u synshar ha Ashtaroth bad ha Edrei .

translation.en: And thou shalt take the other ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Shim ïa uta uwei pat u langbrot — u langbrot ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang — bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time , who should walk after their own ungodly lusts .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha phi ,  Haba ki sngi bakhatduh kin wan , kin mih ki briew ki ban krenbeiñ ïa phi , ki briew kiba ïaid katba kum ki jingkwah brai bymriewblei jong ki hi .

translation.en: And a certain man found him , and , behold , he was wandering in the field : and the man asked him , saying , What seekest thou ?
translation.kha: U Joseph u poi ha Shekhem bad katba u dang ïaid sakma kylleng ïa ka shnong ha kaba uwei u briew u ïohi ïa u bad u kylli ,  Phi wad ïano ?

translation.en: I think myself happy , king Agrippa , because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews :
translation.kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga ñiew ïa lade uba donbok ba ha kane ka sngi nga dei ban ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong phi na baroh kita kiei kiei kiba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa nga ,

translation.en: Let a man so account of us , as of the ministers of Christ , and stewards of the mysteries of God .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pyrkhat ïa ngi kum ki shakri U Khrist , ïa kiba la buh ban sumar ïa ki jingshisha barieh jong U Blei .

translation.en: For he taught them as one having authority , and not as the scribes .
translation.kha: Um shym la long kum ki nonghikai Aiñ ; pynban , u la hikai da ka iktiar .

translation.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season , that thou shouldest receive him for ever  ;
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba u Onesimos u la don jngai na me katto katne por khnang ba men ïoh pat ïa u ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uta uba ngeit u don ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And I will sanctify my great name , which was profaned among the heathen , which ye have profaned in the midst of them  ; and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , saith the Lord  God  , when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes .
translation.kha: Ynda haba ngan pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew ïa ka jingkhuid ka kyrteng bakhraw jong nga — ka kyrteng ïa kaba phi la pynjahburom hapdeng jong ki — te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ngan pyndonkam ïa phi ban pyn-i ha ki jaitbynriew ba nga long uba khuid .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Rehoboam had established the kingdom , and had strengthened himself , he forsook the law of the  Lord  , and all Israel with him .
translation.kha: Mar ïadep pynskhem ïa la ka bor kum u syiem , u Rehoboam bad ki briew jong u baroh ki iehnoh ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Ye have not eaten bread , neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink : that ye might know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Phim shym ïoh kpu ban bam , bad phim shym ïoh waiñ lane kyiad ban dih , hynrei U  Trai  u pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong phi khnang ba phin tip ba u long U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked , and , lo , three men stood by him : and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door , and bowed himself toward the ground ,
translation.kha: Tang mar shu ïohi ïa ki , u mareh ban leit ïashem ïa ki . Da kaba u nguh ngon haduh khyndew , u ong ,

translation.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night , and said , Jacob , Jacob . And he said , Here am I .
translation.kha: Te U Blei u kren ha u ha ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad u ong ,  Jakob , Jakob !  U ruh u jubab ,  Oi , nga hangne .

translation.en: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah  ; we will go up by lot against it  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh : ngin ïakynting sbai bad ngin jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah .

translation.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest : for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people , and they shall flee every one to his own land .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba yn bet ïa ki symbai ha kata ka ri lane ai ba yn lum ïa ka jingmih . Man uwei pa uwei u nongwei uba shong hangta un sheptieng ïa ka kynhun shipai ba tur ïaleh bad ban leit phai ïing .

translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not in word , but in power .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long tang ha kaba kren hynrei ha ka bor .

translation.en: Why do the heathen rage , and the people imagine a vain thing ?
translation.kha: Balei ki jaitbynriew ki thmu ban ïaleh pyrshah ? Balei ki briew ki pynlong ïa la ki jingsylla bymmyntoi ?

translation.en: All that found them have devoured them : and their adversaries said , We offend not , because they have sinned against the  Lord  , the habitation of justice , even the  Lord  , the hope of their fathers .
translation.kha: Ki la shah tur ïaleh da baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa ki . Ki nongshun jong ki , ki ong , ‘ Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad kumta kaei kaba ngi la leh , kam long kaba bakla . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  , bad ma ki hi kiba la dei ban ïailong kiba ïaineh ha u .’

translation.en: And Abram said to the king of Sodom , I have lift up mine hand unto the  Lord  , the most high God , the possessor of heaven and earth ,
translation.kha: U Abram u ong ,  Nga la smai ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew , ba ngan ym bat ei ei ïa kaba dei ka jong me , wat ïa u  sai juti ruh .

translation.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar  ; two lambs of the first year day by day continually .
translation.kha: Man la ka sngi ha ki por ban wan , kñia ha kata ka duwan ar tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem .

translation.en: If a man abide not in me , he is cast forth as a branch , and is withered  ; and men gather them , and cast them into the fire , and they are burned .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u bymïaineh ha nga yn bret noh ïa u kum ka tnat bad u ïap tyrkhong ; kum ïa kita ki tnat , la lumlang bad la bret noh ha ka ding , ha kaba la thang ïa ki .

translation.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen .
translation.kha: U Solomon u don sawphew hajar tylli ki sem ïa ki kulai ring kali , bad khat-ar hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai .

translation.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household : for all her household are clothed with scarlet .
translation.kha: Haba hap ka ïor , kam khuslai namar kiba ha ka ïing jong ka ki biang ki jaiñ syaid .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when all our enemies heard thereof , and all the heathen that were about us saw these things , they were much cast down in their own eyes : for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongshun jong ngi kiba don ha ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ngi ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewthuh ba ki la poi ha ka jinglehrain , namar baroh ki tip ba ïa ka jingtrei la pyndep da ka jingïarap U Blei .

translation.en: I am clean without transgression , I am innocent  ; neither is there iniquity in me .
translation.kha: Ngam shym long uba la pynrem ; ngam shym la leh bakla ei ei . Nga long uba lui lui bad lait na ka pop .

translation.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died :
translation.kha: ngan ym beh shuh ïa kano kano na ki jaitbynriew kiba dang don ha ka ri haba u Joshua u la ïap .

translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted unto heaven , shalt be brought down to hell : for if the mighty works , which have been done in thee , had been done in Sodom , it would have remained until this day .
translation.kha: Bad ïa pha pat ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kwah ban kyntiew ïa lade sha bneng ? Ïa pha yn bret sha tbian sha dujok ! Lada ïa ki kambah ïa kiba la leh ha pha , la lah leh ha Sodom , kan jin da la sah haduh mynta !

translation.en: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .
translation.kha: To ap tad haduh ba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim kan kut , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ka Rakhel , lada men trei na ka bynta jong nga sa hynñiew snem .

translation.en: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers , nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me !
translation.kha: Ngam shym sngap ïa ki nonghikai jong nga , ngam shym la shahshkor ïa ki .

translation.en: Then answered I , and said unto him , What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u diengpynïeng sharak ?

translation.en: I have seen his ways , and will heal him : I will lead him also , and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi kumno ki im , hynrei ngan pynkhiah pat ïa ki . Ngan ïalam ïa ki bad ïarap ïa ki , bad ngan pyntngen ïa kito kiba ïam sngewsih .

translation.en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph : and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses , and for the flocks , and for the cattle of the herds , and for the asses : and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year .
translation.kha: Kumta ki wallam ïa la ki jingri sha u Joseph ; u pat u ïapli ïa ka jingbam bad ki kulai , ki langbrot , ki blang , ki jingri jingdup , bad ki kada . Ha kata ka snem u pyndap ïa ki da kaba shu ïapli bad ki jingri jingdup jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Then said they , We will restore them , and will require nothing of them  ; so will we do as thou sayest . Then I called the priests , and took an oath of them , that they should do according to this promise .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki la jubab ,  Ngin leh kumba phi ong . Ngin ai noh ïa ka jaka bad ngin pyrshang ban ym lum shuh ïa ki ram .  Nga khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad pynlong ïa ki nongïalam ban smai ha khmat jong ki ban bat ïa ka kular kaba ki la lah khlei .

translation.en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  their God , which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen : but I have gathered them unto their own land , and have left none of them any more there .
translation.kha: Te ki briew jong nga kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki . Kin sa tip ïa kane , namar nga la phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw bad mynta nga lumlang ïa ki bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri jong ki hi , khlem da iehnoh wat uwei na ki shadien .

translation.en: With him is strength and wisdom : the deceived and the deceiver are his .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba khlaiñ bad uba ïai jop ; baroh ar ngut — uba shah shukor bad u nongshukor ki don hapoh ka bor jong u .

translation.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter , and abode with him fifteen days .
translation.kha: Ka la long lai snem hadien ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïoh jingtip na u Petros , bad nga la sah bad u ar taïew .

translation.en: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel , and fought against all his enemies on every side , against Moab , and against the children of Ammon , and against Edom , and against the kings of Zobah , and against the Philistines : and whithersoever he turned himself , he vexed them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Saul u la long u syiem ki Israel , u la ïaleh ïa baroh ki nongshun jong u kylleng : ki paid Moab , Ammon , Edom , ki syiem ka Sobah , bad ki Philistia . Man kaba u ïaleh u jop .

translation.en: Then came the first , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained ten pounds .
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar da kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’

translation.en: Yea , and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after , as many as have spoken , have likewise foretold of these days .
translation.kha: Bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la don ka khubor , kynthup ïa u Samuel bad kito kiba mih hadien jong u , ki la pynbna ruh ïa kaei kaba la jia ha kine ki sngi .

translation.en: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity : there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness , and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka long ka bym don jingmut , hynrei ha ka nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh . Katto katne ki briew kiba bha ki lah ban ïap katba kiwei pat ki dang im wat haba ki long kiba sniew .

translation.en: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt , even unto this day , and in Israel , and among other men  ; and hast made thee a name , as at this day  ;
translation.kha: Naduh mynbarim , me la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla ha Ijipt , bad me ïai leh ïa ki haduh kane ka sngi , ha Israel bad hapdeng kiwei ki hima baroh , ba kumta ïa me mynta la tip kylleng sawdong .

translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes , and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls ! Will ye hunt the souls of my people , and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you ?
translation.kha: bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa ki :  Ma phi ki kynthei phi long kiba la tim ! Phi suh ki jingteh kti myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei baroh bad phi thaw ki jaiñ teh khlieh myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei ban phong ha ki khlieh jong ki , khnang ba ki lah ban don ka bor halor ka jingim jong kiwei pat ki briew . Phi kwah ban don ka bor jong ka jingim bad jingïap halor ki briew jong nga bad ban pyndonkam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa lade hi .

translation.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light  ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ha kito kiba im ha ka ri ba-dum jong ka jingïap ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ .

translation.en: Then Jesus went thence , and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit sha ka thain hajan ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon .

translation.en: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked , to overthrow the righteous in judgment .
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei ban pynksan ïa uba la rem bad ban khang ïa uba lui lui na kaba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets , and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te ïa ki samla shynrang jong ka yn pynïap ha ki surok bah jong ka nongbah , bad ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot ha kata ka sngi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour ;
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi ki shynrang u dei ban tip kumno ban ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga ha ka rukom kaba khuid bad kaba donburom ,

translation.en: Unto this day they do after the former manners : they fear not the  Lord  , neither do they after their statutes , or after their ordinances , or after the law and commandment which the  Lord  commanded the children of Jacob , whom he named Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki dang ïai leh hi ïa la ki rukom barim haduh kane ka sngi . Kim shym mane ïa U  Trai  lane kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba u la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa uba u pynkyrteng u Israel .

translation.en: Thy children shall make haste  ; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee .
translation.kha: Kito ki ban tei pat ïa pha kin sa wan shen , bad kito kiba pynjot ïa pha kin leit noh .

translation.en: She looked at me .
translation.kha: Ka peit ianga .

translation.en: Then thine handmaid said , The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable : for as an angel of God , so is my lord the king to discern good and bad : therefore the  Lord  thy God will be with thee .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ha lade ba ki kular jong phi , ko Kynrad , kin pynshngain ïa nga , namar ba u syiem u long kum u angel jong U Blei bad u lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew . To U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un long lem bad phi !

translation.en: And see , and , behold , if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances , then come ye out of the vineyards , and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh , and go to the land of Benjamin .
translation.kha: Haba ki theisamla na Shiloh ki wan shad ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi to wan mih na kita ki bri sohwaiñ . Uwei pa uwei na phi un shim da ka bor napdeng kita ki theisamla bad ïalam ban long ka tnga jong phi sha ka jaka ki Benjamin .

translation.en: And the king said , What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this ? Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , There is nothing done for him .
translation.kha: U syiem u kylli ,  Kumno ngi la pyndonburom bad ai bainong ïa u Mordekai na ka bynta kane ?  Ki shakri jong u ki jubab ,  Ym shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the  Lord   ; and a false balance is not good .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bymhok .

translation.en: But Samson s wife was given to his companion , whom he had used as his friend .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka tnga jong u la ai sha u briew uba la shong synran ïa u ha ka jingkyntiew kurim .

translation.en: For whom the  Lord  loveth he correcteth  ; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynbeit ïa kito kiba u ieit , kumba u kpa u pynbeit ïa u khun ïa uba u sngewsarong .

translation.en: Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyre , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thine heart is lifted up , and thou hast said , I am a God , I sit in the seat of God , in the midst of the seas  ; yet thou art a man , and not God , though thou set thine heart as the heart of God :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa u nongsynshar ka Tyros kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha u : Ba la pynhieng da ka jingsarong , me kam ba me dei U Blei . Me ong ba kum U Blei me shong ha ka khet , ba la ker sawdong da ki duriaw . Me lah ban leh mynleh kum U Blei , hynrei , em , me long uba kynja briew , ym uba kynja blei .

translation.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth , but they are exceeding wise :
translation.kha: Don saw jait ki mrad kiba rit ha ka pyrthei , hynrei kiba sian shikatdei eh :

translation.en: And the skin of the bullock , and all his flesh , with his head , and with his legs , and his inwards , and his dung ,
translation.kha: Hynrei un shim ïa ka snieh , ïa ka doh met , ïa ka khlieh , ïa ki kjat , bad ïa ki doh jem ba kynthup ïa ki snier ,

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he took bread , and gave thanks to God in presence of them all : and when he had broken it , he began to eat .
translation.kha: Ynda u la ong ïa kane , u Paul u la shim katto katne u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Blei ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la sdang ban bam .

translation.en: And of the Hebronites , Hashabiah and his brethren , men of valour , a thousand and seven hundred , were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the  Lord  , and in the service of the king .
translation.kha: Napdeng ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , u Hashabaïah bad shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki ba-ha-ïing jong u , baroh ki briew kiba tbit , la buh ban peit ïa ka kam synshar ha baroh ki kam niam bad ki kam hima sima ha Israel kaba shaphang sepngi jong ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: Then she fell on her face , and bowed herself to the ground , and said unto him , Why have I found grace in thine eyes , that thou shouldest take knowledge of me , seeing I am a stranger ?
translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka nguh ngon haduh khyndew , bad ka ong ha u Boas ,  Balei phi da pyrkhat ïa nga haduh katta katta ? Balei phi da lehsbun haduh katta katta ïa ka nongwei ?

translation.en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the  Lord  above all that were before him .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  palat ban ïa uno uno na kiba ha shuwa jong u .

translation.en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  A  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri borabor ïa me — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba dang sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !

translation.en: Despise not prophesyings .
translation.kha: wat ñiewbeiñ ïa ki khubor ba la pyrsad mynsiem .

translation.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .
translation.kha: U Petros u dang ïeng hangta ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Kumta kiwei pat ki la ong ha u ,  Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong uta u briew ?  Hynrei u Petros u la len ïa kata .  Em , ngam dei ,  u la ong .

translation.en: As one whom his mother comforteth , so will I comfort you  ; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ngan pyntngen ïa phi ha Jerusalem , kumba ka kmie ka pyntngen ïa la i khun .

translation.en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars  ; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory , brought out of the isles of Kittim .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki dieng Sning na Bashan ban shna boitha ; ki shna ïa ka rynsan jong pha na ki kseh ba na Sypros bad pyndait ha ka da ki bniat hati .

translation.en: When Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses  father in law , heard of all that God had done for Moses , and for Israel his people , and that the  Lord  had brought Israel out of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: U Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u kthaw kurim u Moses , u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta u Moses bad ki paid Israel mynba u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will raise up against Babylon , and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me , a destroying wind  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga wallam ïa ka lyer ka jingjot pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki briew jong ka .

translation.en: So Hushai David s friend came into the city , and Absalom came into Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta u Hushai , u paralok jong u Dabid , u la leit phai sha ka nongbah hamar ba u Absalom u dang wan poi .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto him , Get thee from me , take heed to thyself , see my face no more  ; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die .
translation.kha: U la ong ha u Moses ,  Mihnoh nangne ! Ngam kwah shuh ban ïohi ïa me ! Ha ka sngi ba nga ïohi ïa me , men ïap !

translation.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years  ; and they covered him with clothes , but he gat no heat .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid mynta u la tymmen bha , bad wat la ki shakri jong u ki tap ïa u da ki nep-syiad , um shym syaid satia .

translation.en: For Demas hath forsaken me , having loved this present world , and is departed unto Thessalonica ; Crescens to Galatia , Titus unto Dalmatia .
translation.kha: U Demas u la kham noh ha ki kam pyrthei bad u la iehnoh ïa nga , bad u la leit noh sha Thessaloni . U Kreskens u la leit sha Galatia ; u Titos sha Dalmatia .

translation.en: Salute Priscilla and Aquila , and the household of Onesiphorus .
translation.kha: ka jingai khublei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila bad ïa ka ïing u Onesiphoros .

translation.en: And Joshua blessed him , and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kyrkhu ïa u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh bad u la ai ha u ïa ka nongbah Hebron kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .

translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests , and said unto them , Take up the ark of the covenant , and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ong ha ki ,  Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad hynñiew ngut na phi kin leit ha shuwa jong phi , da kaba kieng ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: And he heard the words of Laban s sons , saying , Jacob hath taken away all that was our father s  ; and of that which was our father s hath he gotten all this glory .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïohsngew ba ki khun shynrang jong u Laban ki ïa-ong ,  U Jakob u la shim lut baroh kat kaba dei ka jong i pa jong ngi . U la ïoh lut ïa ka spah baroh na kaei kaba i pa jong ngi i don .

translation.en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee : thou sentest forth thy wrath , which consumed them as stubble .
translation.kha: Da ka jingjop bakhraw me pynliem ïa ki nongshun jong me ; ka jingbitar jong me ka meh bad ka bam duh ïa ki kum ïa u phlangïap .

translation.en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians , and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large , unto a land flowing with milk and honey  ; unto the place of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites .
translation.kha: bad kumta nga la wan ban pyllait ïa ki na ki nong Ijipt bad ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt sha kata ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh , kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ha kaba ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib bad ki Jebus ki shong mynta .

translation.en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create : for , behold , I create Jerusalem a rejoicing , and her people a joy .
translation.kha: To kmen bad to shadkmen junom ha kaei kaba nga thaw . Ka Jerusalem bathymmai kaba nga pynlong kan dap da ka jingkmen , bad ki briew jong ka kin shem sngewbha .

translation.en: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .
translation.kha: U syiem u la bitar tyngeh ; kumta u la phah ïa ki shipai jong u , kiba la pynïap ïa kito ki nongpynïap briew bad ki la thang duh ïa ka nongbah jong ki .

translation.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude , they went upon the housetop , and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus .
translation.kha: Pynban , namar u paidbah , kim lah ban shem lynti ban rah shapoh ïa u . Kumta ki la ïabah ïa u sha tnum ïing , ki la law ïa ki jingsop ïing bad ki la pynhiar shapoh ïa u ha ka jingthiah hamar pdeng jong ka kynhun ha khmat U Jisu .

translation.en: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms , and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen  ; and I will overthrow the chariots , and those that ride in them  ; and the horses and their riders shall come down , every one by the sword of his brother .
translation.kha: bad pynkyllon ïa ki hima bad pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki . Ngan pynkylla khongpong ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ki nongñiah jong ki ; ki kulai kin ïap , bad ki nongshong kulai kin ïa-pynïap para ma ki .

translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , What hast thou done unto me ? I took thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast blessed them altogether .
translation.kha: Te u Balak u ong ha u Balaam ,  Phi leh lei ïa nga kumne ? Nga la wan ïalam ïa phi hangne ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong nga , hynrei phi la kyrkhu pynban ïa ki .

translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves , and in the second year that which springeth of the same  ; and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruits thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ,  Kane ka long ka dak ïa kaei ka ban sa jia . Mynta ka snem bad ha ka snem ka ban wan , men ïoh tang ïa ki kew khlaw ban bam , hynrei ha ka snem kaba bud men lah ban bet ïa u kew bad ot ïa u , bad ban thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .

translation.en: And he answered , Thou shalt not smite them : wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow ? set bread and water before them , that they may eat and drink , and go to their master .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Em ! ym dei wat ïa ki shipai kiba me la ïohkem ha ka jingïaleh mem dei ban pynïap . Ai ïa ki katto katne ban bam bad dih , bad ieh kin leit phai sha la u syiem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they sat at the table , that the word of the  Lord  came unto the prophet that brought him back :
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïashong bam ha ka miej , ka ktien U  Trai  ka wan ha u nongïathuhlypa tymmen ,

translation.en: And he said , I will go out , and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And the  Lord  said , Thou shalt entice him , and thou shalt also prevail : go out , and do even so .
translation.kha: U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler .’ U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Khie leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin jop .’

translation.en: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams , and of silver ten thousand talents , and of brass eighteen thousand talents , and one hundred thousand talents of iron .
translation.kha: ïa kine harum na ka bynta ka jingtrei ha ka Templ : Palat ban ïa ka shispah hynñiewphew ton ka ksiar , palat ïa ka laispah sawphew ton ka rupa , bad la jan hynriewspah arphew ton ka rnong , bad palat ban ïa ka lai hajar sawspah ton ka nar .

translation.en: Then shall we know , if we follow on to know the  Lord  : his going forth is prepared as the morning  ; and he shall come unto us as the rain , as the latter and former rain unto the earth .
translation.kha: To ngin ïai pyrshang ban tip ïa U  Trai . Da shisha un sa wan sha ngi kum ka step phyrngab , shisha kum u slap pyrem uba ai um ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: Then Elisha said , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the  Lord  , To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , in the gate of Samaria .
translation.kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ! Kum ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi phin lah ban thied ha Samaria lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli tang shi sbai rupa .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment , than for thee .
translation.kha: Pha lah ban sngewthikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ka Sodom ban ïa pha !

translation.en: For though I preach the gospel , I have nothing to glory of : for necessity is laid upon me ; yea , woe is unto me , if I preach not the gospel!
translation.kha: Ngam don hok ban kob tang namar ba nga ïalap ïa ka Gospel . La katta ruh , nga don hapoh ki hukum ban leh kumta . Bad katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa nga lada ngam shym la ïalap ïa ka gospel!

translation.en: There is none greater in this house than I  ; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee , because thou art his wife : how then can I do this great wickedness , and sin against God ?
translation.kha: Ha kane ka ïing , nga don kajuh ka iktiar kumba u don , bad um shym la tyngkai ei ei shuh na nga lait noh tang ïa phi . Kumno keiñ nga lah ban leh kat ïa kata ka kam runar , bad ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: And said , I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the  Lord  , and he heard me  ; out of the belly of hell cried I , and thou heardest my voice .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jong nga , A  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad me la jubab ïa nga . Na ka jingjylliew jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap nga la khot kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me la ïohsngew ïa nga .

translation.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged : and by the fear of the  Lord  men depart from evil .
translation.kha: Long kiba kohnguh bad kiba ïaineh , bad U Blei un map ïa ka pop jong phi . To kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad kaba sniew kan ym jia ha phi .

translation.en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish , he shall not approach : a blind man , or a lame , or he that hath a flat nose , or any thing superfluous ,
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew uba don jingduna ha ka met ban ai ïa kata ka jingkñia : kum uba matlah , uba dkoh , uba la sniew ka durkhmat , lane uba la thawsha ka met ;

translation.en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground , and keep silence : they have cast up dust upon their heads  ; they have girded themselves with sackcloth : the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la lute ïa ka jingkynshew jong ka baroh . Ka la ïohi ïa ki , ba ki rung sha ka Templ hi , ha kaba U  Trai  u la lah khang ïa ki Jentil ban leit .

translation.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee  ; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee , and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa me ha shuwa ba nga ai jingim ïa me , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa me , nga la jied ïa me ban long u nongïathuhlypa sha ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him , as I took it from Saul , whom I put away before thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym weng noh na u ïa la ka jingkyrshan kumba nga la weng noh na u Saul , ïa uba nga la pynkynriah noh khnang ba men long syiem ma me .

translation.en: For when they shall say , Peace and safety ; then sudden destruction cometh upon them , as travail upon a woman with child ; and they shall not escape .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki ong ,  Kaei kaei baroh ka jar jar bad ka shngain ,  te kynsan ka jingpynjot kan lynshop ïa ki! Kan wan kyndit kum ki jingpang kiba wan ha ka briew kaba suh kha , bad ki briew kin ym lait phet .

translation.en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of Elijah  ; and the soul of the child came into him again , and he revived .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai u Elijah ; u khynnah u sdang ban ring mynsiem biang bad u la im pat .

translation.en: Neither shall ye build house , nor sow seed , nor plant vineyard , nor have any : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents  ; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ïa ngi ban ym tei ki ïing ne rep ki lyngkha , bad ban ym buh ki bri sohwaiñ lane thied ïa ki . U la hukum ïa ngi ba ngin shong ngin sah borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ , khnang ba ngin don ha kane ka ri ha kaba ngi im kum ki nongwei .

translation.en: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ , who hath abolished death , and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel :
translation.kha: U la ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jingaiei lyngba U Khrist Jisu ha shuwa ban sdang ka pyrthei , hynrei mynta la pynpaw da ka jingwan U Nongpynim jong ngi , U Khrist Jisu . U la pynkut noh ïa ka bor jong ka jingïap bad lyngba ka Gospel la pynpaw ïa ka jingim bymïap shuh .

translation.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people  ; and therein was found written , that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever  ;
translation.kha: Katba dang pule jam ïa ka Hukum u Moses ha u paidbah , ki poi ha ka bynta kaba ong ba ym dei ban shah ïa u nong Amon ne u nong Moab ban ïasnohlang bad ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people , he , and Hoshea the son of Nun .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ki ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai , ba ki Israel kin ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness , and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more .
translation.kha: Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki jingleh bymdei jong ki .

translation.en: But to the land whereunto they desire to return , thither shall they not return .
translation.kha: Men thrang ban ïohi ïa kane ka ri sa shisien pat , hynrei men ym ïoh wan phai shuh .

translation.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good ?
translation.kha: Kaba bha bad kaba sniew kumjuh ki jia ha ka hukum jong u .

translation.en: The earth is utterly broken down , the earth is clean dissolved , the earth is moved exceedingly .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan orpait bad kan kad .

translation.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother , and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath , and utterly destroyed it . And the name of the city was called Hormah .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leit ryngkat bad ki paid Simeon , bad ki la jop ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka nongbah Sephath . Ki la buh ka jingtim halor ka nongbah , ki la pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad ki la ai kyrteng ïa ka , ka Hormah .

translation.en: Give me my wives and my children , for whom I have served thee , and let me go : for thou knowest my service which I have done thee .
translation.kha: Ai ha nga ïa ki tnga jong nga bad ïa ki khun jong nga kiba nga la ïoh da kaba trei na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngan leit noh . Phi tip haduh katno nga la shakri hok ïa phi .

translation.en: If I whet my glittering sword , and mine hand take hold on judgment  ; I will render vengeance to mine enemies , and will reward them that hate me .
translation.kha: ba ngan shut pynnep ïa ka waitlam kaba phalang jong nga , bad ai ïa ka jingbishar bahok , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong nga bad pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa nga .

translation.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir : they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee .
translation.kha: Ki pyndonkam ïa ki dieng Kseh-Phir na u lum Hermon kum ki dieng shna ïing . Bad ïa ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon na ka bynta ki dieng sieh lama .

translation.en: Let your women keep silence in the churches : for it is not permitted unto them to speak ; but they are commanded to be under obedience , as also saith the law .
translation.kha: Kumba ka long ha ki balang jong u paidlang U Blei , ki kynthei ki dei ban sngap jar ha ki jingïaseng . Ym shah ïa ki ban kren ; kumba ka Hukum ki Jiw ka ong , kim dei ban leh trai khlieh .

translation.en: For this child I prayed  ; and the  Lord  hath given me my petition which I asked of him :
translation.kha: Ïa une u khunlung nga la pan na u , bad u la ai ha nga ïa kaba nga la pan .

translation.en: And God came unto Balaam , and said , What men are these with thee ?
translation.kha: U Blei u wan ha u Balaam , bad u ong ,  Kiei kine ki briew kiba sahmiet bad me ?

translation.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .
translation.kha: U briew uba alhia u pyrkhat ba u kham stad ban ïa hynñiew ngut ki briew kiba lah ban ai ki nia kiba bha na ka bynta ka jingmut jong ki .

translation.en: Among the bushes they brayed  ; under the nettles they were gathered together .
translation.kha: Shabar ha ki khlaw ki pah kum ki mrad bad ki ïa-thngian lang hapoh ki  lawlynnong .

translation.en: And the king said unto Joab , Behold now , I have done this thing : go therefore , bring the young man Absalom again .
translation.kha: Hadien nangta u syiem u ong ha u Joab ,  Nga la rai ban leh ïa kata kaba me kwah . Khie leit bad wad ïa u samla Absalom bad wan ïalam pat ïa u hangne .

translation.en: What is your age
translation.kha: afi kirteng ayu

translation.en: And Jonathan said to David , Go in peace , forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  be between me and thee , and between my seed and thy seed for ever . And he arose and departed : and Jonathan went into the city .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid ,  U Blei un don ryngkat bad phi . U  Trai  un pynthikna ba ma nga bad ma phi , bad kiba hiarpateng na phi bad kiba hiarpateng na nga , kin bat ïa ka kular bakyntang kaba ngi la pynlong iwei ïa iwei .  Nangta u Dabid u leit noh , bad u Jonathan u leit phai pat sha shnong .

translation.en: For though there be that are called gods , whether in heaven or in earth , ( as there be gods many , and lords many , )
translation.kha: Wat lada don kiba la shu khot  ki blei  , la ha bneng ne ha pyrthei , bad wat lada don shibun kum kine  ki blei  bad  ki trai  ;

translation.en: Javan , Tubal , and Meshech , they were thy merchants : they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market .
translation.kha: Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha Gris , Tubal , bad ha Meshekh bad ïakylliang ïa ki mar na ka bynta ki mraw bad na ka bynta ki tiar rnong .

translation.en: I was wroth with my people , I have polluted mine inheritance , and given them into thine hand : thou didst shew them no mercy  ; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke .
translation.kha: Nga la bitar ïa ki briew jong nga ; nga la shim ïa ki kumba kim dei shuh ki jong nga : Nga buh ïa ki ha ka bor jong pha , bad pham pyn-i jinglehisynei ïa ki ; wat ïa kiba la tymmen pha leh da kaba tyngeh .
