translation.en: When a bullock , or a sheep , or a goat , is brought forth , then it shall be seven days under the dam  ; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba kha ïa uno uno u khun masi , lane ïa u khunlangbrot , lane ïa u khunblang , ieh ïa u bad la ka kmie haduh hynñiew sngi , hynrei hadien kata lah ban pdiang ïa u kum ka jingainguh bam .

translation.en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression , and take away mine iniquity ? for now shall I sleep in the dust  ; and thou shalt seek me in the morning , but I shall not be .
translation.kha: Mem lah ban map da lei lei ïa ki pop jong nga ? Hato mem lah ban map ïa ka jingbymdei ba nga leh ? Shen , ngan sa don ha la ka jingtep bad ngan ym don shuh haba men khmih ïa nga .

translation.en: The ungodly are not so : but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba sniew kim long kumne da lei lei ; ki long kum u phlangïap uba ka lyer ka beh noh .

translation.en: And he was three days without sight , and neither did eat nor drink .
translation.kha: Haduh lai sngi um shym lah ban ïohi , bad ha kata ka por um shym la bam ne dih ei ei .

translation.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold , neither is there any end of their treasures  ; their land is also full of horses , neither is there any end of their chariots :
translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad ym don jingkut ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki . Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki kulai , bad ym don jingkut ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .

translation.en: I just want to forget about it .
translation.kha: Nga kwah klet noh shaphang kato .

translation.en: Great is our Lord , and of great power : his understanding is infinite .
translation.kha: Uba khraw bad uba donbor long U  Trai  jong ngi ; ïa ka jingstad jong u ym lah ban thew .

translation.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal , nor the churl said to be bountiful .
translation.kha: Yn ym don u ban pyrkhat ba uba bieit u long uba donburom lane ban ong ba u riewshukor u long uba hok .

translation.en: They are upright as the palm tree , but speak not : they must needs be borne , because they cannot go . Be not afraid of them  ; for they cannot do evil , neither also is it in them to do good .
translation.kha: Kiba kum kine ki bleithaw ki long kum ki jingpyntieng ïa ki sim ha ki lyngkha sohkhia ; kim lah ban kren ; la dei ban rah ïa ki namar kim lah ban ïaid . Wat sheptieng ïa ki : kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi , bad kim lah ban lehbha ïa phi .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man , and with the seed of beast .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ba ka por kan wan haba ngan pyndap ïa ka ri Israel bad Judah da ki briew bad ki mrad .

translation.en: The increase of his house shall depart , and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath .
translation.kha: Ïa ka spah jong u baroh yn pynjot ha ka jingshlei jong ka jingbitar U Blei .

translation.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping .
translation.kha: Lada un wan kynsan kynsan , um dei ban shem ïa phi ba phi ïohthiah .

translation.en: And , Thou , Lord , in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth  ; and the heavens are the works of thine hands :
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ,  Me , A Trai , ha kaba mynnyngkong me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , bad da la ki kti hi me la thaw ïa ki bneng .

translation.en: But Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , had no sons , but daughters : and these are the names of his daughters , Mahlah , and Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .
translation.kha: U Selophehad u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , um don khun shynrang ; hynrei tang ki khun kynthei . Ki kyrteng jong ki , ki long ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah .

translation.en: As concerning the rest of the beasts , they had their dominion taken away : yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw ki la shah knieh noh ka bor jong ki , hynrei la shah ïa ki ban im shipor .

translation.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency  ; and array thyself with glory and beauty .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , to ïeng ha la ka burom bad ka jingsarong ; kup ïa lade da ka jingitynnat bad ka burom ,

translation.en: And all flesh shall see that I the  Lord  have kindled it : it shall not be quenched .
translation.kha: Baroh kin ïohi ba ma Nga , U  Trai  , nga la thang ïa ka bad ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynlip ïa ka .

translation.en: When thy sisters , Sodom and her daughters , shall return to their former estate , and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate , then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate .
translation.kha: Kin sa manbha pat , bad ïa pha bad ki nongrit jong pha ruh yn sa pynneh .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Nga la ïathuh ha kito ki nonglamktien ba phi la phah sha nga ,

translation.en: All this have I proved by wisdom : I said , I will be wise  ; but it was far from me .
translation.kha: Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingstad ban tynjuh ïa kane baroh . Nga la kut jingmut ban long uba stad , hynrei ka la long palat pud ïa nga .

translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , How shall we know the word which the  Lord  hath not spoken ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban lyngngoh kumno phi lah ban ong haba ka khubor u nongïathuhlypa kam shym wan na U  Trai .

translation.en: And he commanded the foremost , saying , When Esau my brother meeteth thee , and asketh thee , saying , Whose art thou ? and whither goest thou ? and whose are these before thee ?
translation.kha: U la hukum ruh ïa u shakri uba ha khmat eh ,  Ynda u Iso u hynmen jong nga u ïakynduh ïa me , bad u kylli , ‘ Uei u kynrad jong me ? Shano men leit ? Uei u trai jong kine ki jingri kiba ha khmat jong me ?’

translation.en: Then said the king unto her , What wilt thou , queen Esther ? and what is thy request ? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom .
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingkwah jong pha , ko Esther , ko mahadei ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pha kwah , bad phan ïoh ïa kata — wat la ka long shiteng na ka hima jong nga .

translation.en: Sojourn in this land , and I will be with thee , and will bless thee  ; for unto thee , and unto thy seed , I will give all these countries , and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father  ;
translation.kha: To shong to sah hangne , bad ngan long lem bad me , bad ngan kyrkhu ïa me . Ngan sa ai ïa kane ka ri baroh ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me . Ngan bat ïa la ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha u Abraham u kpa jong me .

translation.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper ? the glory of his nostrils is terrible .
translation.kha: Hato me pynlong ïa ki ban kynthih kum ki puit bad pynsheptieng ïa ki briew da ka jingpah jong ki ?

translation.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee ? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death ?
translation.kha: Don mano mano ba la pyn-i ha me ïa ki khyrdop kiba ap phira ïa ka pyrthei ba-dum jong kiba ïap ?

translation.en: Am I therefore become your enemy , because I tell you the truth ?
translation.kha: Hato nga la kylla long mynta u nongshun jong phi da kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ?

translation.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory : drink thou also , and let thy foreskin be uncovered : the cup of the  Lord s  right hand shall be turned unto thee , and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory .
translation.kha: Markylliang yn tap ïa phi da ka jinglehrain ha ka jaka ka burom . Phi ruh phin ïadih bad ïaid sheng sheng . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa phi ban dih na la ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , bad ka burom jong phi kan kylla sha ka jingjahburom .

translation.en: Doth our law judge any man , before it hear him , and know what he doeth ?
translation.kha: U la ong ha kiwei ,  Kat kum ka Hukum jong ngi ngim lah ban pynrem ïa u briew ha shuwa ban ïohsngew na u bad ban shem kaei ba u la leh .

translation.en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou hast humbled thyself before the  Lord  , when thou heardest what I spake against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , that they should become a desolation and a curse , and hast rent thy clothes , and wept before me  ; I also have heard thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , kad ïa ki jaiñ jong phi bad ïam , haba phi ïohsngew kumno nga byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ka kaba ishyrkhei ban peit , ka jaka ha kaba ïa ka kyrteng jong ka , ki briew kin pyndonkam kum ka jingtim . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong phi ,

translation.en: And when they did mete it with an omer , he that gathered much had nothing over , and he that gathered little had no lack  ; they gathered every man according to his eating .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la thew ïa ka , kito kiba lum kham bun kim shym ïoh tam , bad kito kiba lum kham khyndiat kim shym ïoh duna ; man la u briew u lum tang katba u lah ban bam .

translation.en: Behold , my terror shall not make thee afraid , neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee .
translation.kha: Te phim don daw ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan ym leh jubor ïa phi .

translation.en: For mine eyes are upon all their ways : they are not hid from my face , neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki leh . Ym don kano kano kaba la buhrieh na nga ; ki pop jong ki kim lait phet na ka jingïohi jong nga .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  I that speak unto thee am he .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Dei ma nga , ma nga keiñ uba ïakren bad pha .

translation.en: If thy brother be waxen poor , and hath sold away some of his possession , and if any of his kin come to redeem it , then shall he redeem that which his brother sold .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u kylla duk bad u hap ban die ïa la ka khyndew , u ba-ha-ïing bajan eh jong u , un thied pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And other sheep I have , which are not of this fold : them also I must bring , and they shall hear my voice  ; and there shall be one fold , and one shepherd .
translation.kha: Don kiwei pat ki langbrot ki bym dei na kane ka sem langbrot . Nga dei ban wallam ïa ki ruh ; kin shahshkor ïa ka sur jong nga , bad kin ïalong kawei ka kynhun langbrot bad uwei u nongaplangbrot .

translation.en: I have shewed you all things , how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , how he said ,  It is more blessed to give than to receive .
translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ha phi ha kiei kiei baroh ba da kaba trei shitom ha kane ka rukom ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , da kaba kynmaw ïa ki ktien kiba U Trai Jisu da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ka don ka jingkmen kaba kham khraw ha kaba ai ban ïa kaba pdiang .’

translation.en: They hatch cockatrice  eggs , and weave the spider s web : he that eateth of their eggs dieth , and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper .
translation.kha: Ki jingïasylla bymman kiba phi pynlong ki long kiba shyrkhei kum ki pylleng jong ki bseiñ kiba don bih . Pynpait ïa kata ka pylleng , un mih u bseiñ .

translation.en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren , like unto thee , and will put my words in his mouth  ; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba kum ma me napdeng ki para jait jong ki hi ; ngan sa ïathuh ha u aïu un ong , bad un kren ha ki briew kat ïa kaba nga hukum .

translation.en: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus , who of God is made unto us wisdom , and righteousness , and sanctification , and redemption :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la wallam ïa phi ha U Khrist Jisu , bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa U Khrist ban long ka jingstad jong ngi . Da u , la pynïasuk ïa ngi bad U Blei ; ngi long ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei bad la pyllaitluid ïa ngi .

translation.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold ,
translation.kha: Man ka snem u syiem Solomon u ïohpdiang kumba arphew lai hajar kilo ka ksiar ,

translation.en: These things I have spoken unto you , that in me ye might have peace . In the world ye shall have tribulation : but be of good cheer  ; I have overcome the world .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingsuk da kaba phi long lem bad nga . Ka pyrthei kan pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom . Hynrei to long shlur ! Nga , nga la jop ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Whatsoever the  Lord  pleased , that did he in heaven , and in earth , in the seas , and all deep places .
translation.kha: U leh ïa kat kaba u mon ha bneng bad ha pyrthei , ha ki duriaw bad ha ki jingjylliew bashapoh .

translation.en: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth , Gog and Magog , to gather them together to battle : the number of whom is as the sand of the sea .
translation.kha: bad un mih shabar ban shukor ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba la pynsakma kylleng ka pyrthei , kata ka Gog bad ka Magog . U Soitan un wallam lang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïaleh thma , kiba bun kat ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw .

translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother s wife : it is thy brother s nakedness .
translation.kha: lane bad la ka hynmen kynsi ne ka para kynsi .

translation.en: If not , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I shall teach thee wisdom .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to long jar jar bad shahshkor ïa nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi kumno ba phi long uba stad .

translation.en: His left hand is under my head , and his right hand doth embrace me .
translation.kha: Wat khmih beiñ ïa nga namar ka rong sniehdoh jong nga , namar ba ka sngi ka la pynkylla rong ïa nga . Ki shynrang kiba shi para bad nga ki bitar ïa nga bad ki pyntrei ïa nga ha ka bri sohwaiñ . Ngam don por ban sumar ïa lade .

translation.en: But by what means he now seeth , we know not  ; or who hath opened his eyes , we know not : he is of age  ; ask him : he shall speak for himself .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngim tip kumno pat ba mynta u la ïoh imat , lymne ngim tip mano ba la pynkoit ïa u na ka jingmatlah jong u . Kylli ïa u ; u la biang ka rta , bad u lah ban jubab da lade hi !

translation.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Tang ma u hi u leh ïa ki kambah bakhraw ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the best gold .
translation.kha: U phah shna ruh kawei ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta na ka la tap da ka bniat hati , bad kaba sah pat la tap da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name  Jehovah  was I not known to them .
translation.kha: Nga la mihpaw ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob , kum U Blei Badonbor Baroh , hynrei ngam shym la pynithuh ïa lade ha ki da ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: And David said unto his men , Gird ye on every man his sword . And they girded on every man his sword  ; and David also girded on his sword : and there went up after David about four hundred men  ; and two hundred abode by the stuff .
translation.kha: Pyndait ïa la ki waitlam !  u la hukum , bad ki la leh kumta . U Dabid ruh u la pyndait ïa la ka waitlam bad u la mih lem bad kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah jong u , da kaba iehnoh shadien ïa ki arspah ngut lem bad ki jingkit jingbah .

translation.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed  ; and the number of the men was about five thousand .
translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ki la ngeit ; bad ka jingbun ki briew ka la roi sha kumba san hajar ngut .

translation.en: And herein I give my advice : for this is expedient for you , who have begun before , not only to do , but also to be forward a year ago .
translation.kha: Bad hangne nga ai jingmut , ka long ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban pyndep mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la sdang mynshem snem . Phi la long kiba nyngkong , ym tang ban trei ïa ka kam , hynrei ban long ruh kiba la kloi ban leh ïa ka .

translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , Master , who did sin , this man , or his parents , that he was born blind ?
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai , ka pop jongno kaba la pynlong ïa u ban kha matlah ? Hato ka dei ka pop jong u hi ne ka jong ki kmie ki kpa jong u ?

translation.en: But one in a certain place testified , saying , What is man , that thou art mindful of him ? or the son of man , that thou visitest him ?
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba la ong ha katto katne ki jaka ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid :  U briew u long aïu , A Blei , ba men pyrkhat ïa u , tang uba kynja briew , ba men suidñiew ïa u ?

translation.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day , that I am pure from the blood of all men .
translation.kha: Kumta nga pynbna skhem ha phi ha kane hi ka sngi : Lada uno uno na phi u dei ban jot noh , ngam don ka jingkitkhlieh .

translation.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons ? or his head with fish spears ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyndap ïa ka snieh jong u da ki sum pynïap dohkha ? ne dung ïa ka khlieh da u proh dung dohkha ?

translation.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls .
translation.kha: Ha ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh , ka khyndew ka pynmih shikatdei eh ki jingthung , ïa kiba u Joseph u lum bad kynshew ha ki nongbah .

translation.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them , they determined that Paul and Barnabas , and certain other of them , should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question .
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la poi sha ka jingïasaid nia kaba jur bad ki shaphang kane , kumta la ïakut ba u Paul bad u Barnabas bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ha Antiokh ki dei ban leit sha Jerusalem bad ïakynduh ïa ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang shaphang kane ka kam .

translation.en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain : the eleven curtains were of one size .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan ; bad baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingheh .

translation.en: Rejoice and be glad , O daughter of Edom , that dwellest in the land of Uz  ; the cup also shall pass through unto thee : thou shalt be drunken , and shalt make thyself naked .
translation.kha: To ïai rkhie , ko ki briew ka Edom bad ka Us ; to kmen katba phi dang lah . Ka jingpynjot ïa phi ruh ka wan ; ma phi ruh phin ïaid sheng sheng lyngkhuit ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: Come up unto me , and help me , that we may smite Gibeon : for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ale wan bad ïarap ïa nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeon , namar ba ki briew jong ka ki la ïasuk bad u Joshua bad ki Israel .

translation.en: And thou shalt make a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen of cunning work : with cherubims shall it be made :
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynpur itynnat ha ka da ka dur ki kherub .

translation.en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee  ; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet  ; and they shall call thee , The city of the  Lord  , The Zion of the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong kito kiba la banbeiñ ïa pha kin sa wan ban dem khrup ban burom ïa pha . Baroh kito kiba la ju ibeiñ ïa pha kin dem ngon ha ki kjat jong pha . Kin khot ïa pha , ‘ Ka Nongbah U  Trai  ,’ ‘ Ka Seïon , ka nongbah U Blei U Bakhuid ki Israel .’

translation.en: Then went Solomon to Ezion–geber , and to Eloth , at the sea side in the land of Edom .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u leit sha Esiongeber bad sha Elath , ki kadlieng harud ka Khmut Duriaw Akaba , ha ri ki Edom .

translation.en: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted within me ? hope in God : for I shall yet praise him , who is the health of my countenance , and my God .
translation.kha: Balei ba nga sngewsih haduh katta katta ? Balei ba nga sngew jynjar sat ? Ngan buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U Blei , bad sa shisien pat ngan ïaroh ïa u , U nongpynim jong nga bad U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: When thou criest , let thy companies deliver thee  ; but the wind shall carry them all away  ; vanity shall take them : but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land , and shall inherit my holy mountain  ;
translation.kha: Haba phi kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , ai ba kito ki bleithaw jong phi kin pyllait ïa phi ! Tang shisien pyrsad ka lyer kan rong noh ïa ki ! Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha nga kin ïoh im ha ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha ka Templ jong nga .

translation.en: Remember the former things of old : for I am God , and there is none else  ; I am God , and there is none like me ,
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba la jia la slem bah ; to pdiang ba tang ma nga , nga long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat kum ma nga .

translation.en: And shall put my spirit in you , and ye shall live , and I shall place you in your own land : then shall ye know that I the  Lord  have spoken it , and performed it , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pyrsad da ka mynsiem jong nga ha ki , bad kin im biang , bad ngan sa shah ïa ki ban im ha ka ri jong ki hi . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai . Nga la kular ba ngan leh ïa kane — bad ngan leh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Then came the Jews round about him , and said unto him , How long dost thou make us to doubt ? If thou be the Christ , tell us plainly .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka baranda u Solomon kaba ha ka Templ , haba ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u bad kylli ,  Sa katno men dang ïai pynap ïa ngi ha ka jinglyngngoh ? Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingshisha kaba shai kdar : Hato me long U Messaïah ?

translation.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets : but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter .
translation.kha: Uba lorni u thad ïa kaba la buhrieh , hynrei phi lah ban buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha uba lah ban buhrieh .

translation.en: And there I will meet with thee , and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan sa ïakynduh ïa me hangta , bad najrong jong ka jingtap kaba hapdeng kita ki kherub ar tylli , ngan ai ha me ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: Naked , and ye clothed me : I was sick , and ye visited me : I was in prison , and ye came unto me .
translation.kha: nga la lyngkhuit bad phi la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad phi la shim ban sumar ïa nga , nga la don ha ïingbyndi bad phi la wan jngoh ïa nga .’

translation.en: Then shall ye call upon me , and ye shall go and pray unto me , and I will hearken unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta phin khot kyrpad ïa nga . Phin wan bad duwai ha nga , bad ngan jubab ïa phi .

translation.en: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the  Lord   ; and they shall be afraid of thee .
translation.kha: Te ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei kin ïohi ba U  Trai  u la jied ïa phi ban long ki briew jong u , bad kin sheptieng ïa phi .

translation.en: That thine alms may be in secret : and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly .
translation.kha: Te kan long ka kam kaba rieh . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .

translation.en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki angel , te , ka briew ka dei ban don ka jingda halor la ka khlieh ban pyn-i ba ka long hapoh ka bor u tnga jong ka .

translation.en: For this cause , when I could no longer forbear , I sent to know your faith , lest by some means the tempter have tempted you , and our labour be in vain .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la phah ïa u Timothi . Ngam lah shah shuh , kumta nga la phah ïa u ban tip shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi . Da shisha kam lah ban long ba u Ksuid u la pynshoi ïa phi bad ba ka kam jong ngi baroh ka la long kaba lehnoh-ei !

translation.en: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters : and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .
translation.kha: hynrei u Eleasar u la ïap khlem don khun shynrang ; u don tang ki khun kynthei . Ki khun kynthei jong u ki shongkurim ïa ki bakha jong ki , ki khun u Kish .

translation.en: Hear this word , ye kine of Bashan , that are in the mountain of Samaria , which oppress the poor , which crush the needy , which say to their masters , Bring , and let us drink .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki kynthei ka Samaria , kiba nang sngaid kum ki masi ba la bsa bha jong ka Bashan , kiba lehbeiñ ïa kiba tlot , kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk , bad kiba dawa ba ki tnga jong phi kin pynbiang ïa phi da ka kyiad !

translation.en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul s bolster  ; and they gat them away , and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked : for they were all asleep  ; because a deep sleep from the  Lord  was fallen upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u shim ïa uta u sum bad ïa uta u khiew um najan ka khlieh u Saul , bad ma u bad u Abishai ki mihnoh . Ym don mano mano uba la ïohi lane tip ïa kata ; ym don ruh mano mano uba la kyndit — baroh ki dang ïohthiah lyngngai , namar ba U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingïohthiah kaba jur ha ki baroh .

translation.en: And when he was come near unto her , the woman said , Art thou Joab ? And he answered , I am he . Then she said unto him , Hear the words of thine handmaid . And he answered , I do hear .
translation.kha: U Joab u la leit , bad ka kylli ,  Phi dei u Joab ?   Ho-oid , nga dei ,  u jubab .  Kynrad , sngap ïa nga ,  ka ong .  Nga sngap keiñ ,  u jubab .

translation.en: And this land , which we possessed at that time , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , and half mount Gilead , and the cities thereof , gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites .
translation.kha: Ynda ngi la kam kynti ïa kata ka ri , nga ai ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ïa ka jaka kaba shatei na ka shnong Aroer hajan ka wah Arnon bad shiteng na ka ri lum Gilead lem bad ki shnong jong ka .

translation.en: And when thou hast accomplished them , lie again on thy right side , and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days : I have appointed thee each day for a year .
translation.kha: Haba me la dep ïa kata , phai pyrshing pat sha ka krung kamon jong me bad shahshitom sawphew sngi namar ki kam bymman ka ïing Judah — kawei ka sngi namar kawei kawei ka snem jong ka jingshah pynshitom jong ki .

translation.en: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity , which he hath given thee under the sun , all the days of thy vanity : for that is thy portion in this life , and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun .
translation.kha: To lehkmen ha ka jingim bad ka briew kaba phi ieit , katba phi dang im ka jingim ka bymmyntoi kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi ha kane ka pyrthei . Lehkmen ïa kawei pa kawei ka sngi bymmyntoi jong ka , namar kata baroh ka long kaba phin ïoh na ka bynta ka jingjynjar jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Now his elder son was in the field : and as he came and drew nigh to the house , he heard musick and dancing .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u khun ba kham heh u la don ha lyngkha . Ha ka lynti ba u wan phai , haba u la poi sha jan ka ïing , u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ka jingïashad .

translation.en: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity : he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword . Here is the patience and the faith of the saints .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba dei ban shah kem un shah kem da shisha ; uno uno uba dei ban shah pynïap da ka waitlam un shah pynïap shisha da ka waitlam . Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingïaishah bad ïa ka jingngeit na ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: I pray for them : I pray not for the world , but for them which thou hast given me  ; for they are thine .
translation.kha: Nga duwai na ka bynta jong ki . Ngam duwai na ka bynta ka pyrthei hynrei na ka bynta kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga , namar ki long ki jong me .

translation.en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to king Jehoshaphat , Shouldest thou help the ungodly , and love them that hate the  Lord  ? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa , u Jehu u khun jong u Hanani , u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem bad ong ha u ,  Hato ka long kaba dei ban ïarap ïa kito ki briew kiba sniew bad ban ïashah bad kito kiba isih ïa U  Trai  ? Kaei kaba phi la leh ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  halor jong phi .

translation.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread  ; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses : for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day , that soul shall be cut off from Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Hynñiew sngi lynter phin ym bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat — bam tang ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat . Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong phi dei ban bret noh ïa u thiat baroh na ïing jong phi , namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let my lord the king hear the words of his servant . If the  Lord  have stirred thee up against me , let him accept an offering : but if they be the children of men , cursed be they before the  Lord   ; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the  Lord  , saying , Go , serve other gods .
translation.kha: Ko syiem kynrad , sngap ïa kaei ba ngan ong . Lada dei U  Trai  uba la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa nga , ka jingainguh ïa u , to kan pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jong u ; hynrei lada ki briew ki la leh ïa ka , to ka jingtim U  Trai  kan hap ha ki . Naba ki la beh noh ïa nga na ka ri U  Trai  sha ka ri ha kaba nga lah ban mane tang ïa ki blei nongwei .

translation.en: And unto the married I command , yet not I , but the Lord , Let not the wife depart from her husband :
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba la shongkurim , nga don ka hukum ym ka jong nga hynrei ka jong U Trai : Ka tnga kam dei ban iehnoh ïa la u tnga ;

translation.en: And David commanded his young men , and they slew them , and cut off their hands and their feet , and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron . But they took the head of Ish–bosheth , and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ai hukum , bad ki shipai jong u ki la pynïap ïa u Rekhab bad ïa u Baanah bad ki la ot ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong ki , ïa kiba ki la sdien hajan ka pung ha Hebron . Ki la shim ïa ka khlieh jong u Ishbosheth bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u Abner hangta ha Hebron .

translation.en: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .
translation.kha: Ki nongaplangbrot ki la leit phai pat , ki da rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la ïohsngew bad ïohi ; ka la long thik kumba u angel u la ïathuh ha ki .

translation.en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you : and , lo , I am with you alway , even unto the end of the world . Amen .
translation.kha: bad hikai ïa ki ban kohnguh ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi . Bad ngan ïai don ryngkat lem bad phi , haduh kaba kut ka Ïa .

translation.en: Finally , be ye all of one mind , having compassion one of another , love as brethren , be pitiful , be courteous :
translation.kha: Kum ban pynkut : Phi baroh to ïadon kajuh ka jingmut bad kajuh ka jingsngew , to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat kum shi para , bad to long kiba sbun mynsiem bad kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And he confessed , and denied not  ; but confessed , I am not the Christ .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis um shym la kyntait ban jubab , hynrei , u la kren ha kaba paw bad da kaba shai , u da ong ,  Ngam dei u Messaïah .

translation.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city : wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein ?
translation.kha: Lada ki don sanphew ngut kiba hok ha kata ka nongbah , hato men pynjot noh ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei ? Men ym pyllait ïa ka ba ki sanphew ngut kin lait im ?

translation.en: Absalom said moreover , Oh that I were made judge in the land , that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me , and I would do him justice !
translation.kha: Bad u ju bynrap ,  Ba ngan jin da la long u nongbishar ! Te uno uno uba don ka jingïakajia lane ka jingkam ïa kano kano u lah ban wan sha nga , bad ngan ai ha u ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land : for they have heard that thou  Lord  art among this people , that thou  Lord  art seen face to face , and that thy cloud standeth over them , and that thou goest before them , by day time in a pillar of a cloud , and in a pillar of fire by night .
translation.kha: kin sa ïathuh ïa kata ha ki briew kiba shong ha kane ka ri . Kine ki briew ki la lah ïohsngew ba me , A  Trai  , me don lem bad ngi , bad ba me paw ha kaba ïohi shai haba u lyoh jong me u sangeh halor jong ngi bad ba me leit ha shuwa jong ngi ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi bad u rishot ding mynmiet .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  , will I assemble her that halteth , and I will gather her that is driven out , and her that I have afflicted  ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba ngan lumlang ïa ki briew kiba nga la pynshitom , kito kiba la shahshitom ha ka jingshah ringmraw .

translation.en: And as he prayed , the fashion of his countenance was altered , and his raiment was white and glistering .
translation.kha: Katba u dang duwai , ka durkhmat jong u ka la kylla dur , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki la kylla lieh phyrnai .

translation.en: And am no more worthy to be called thy son : make me as one of thy hired servants .
translation.kha: Ngam long uba dei ba yn khot u khun jong phi ; to ñiew ïa nga tang kum uwei na ki nongtrei wai jong phi .

translation.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam , and to the princes of Judah , that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak , and said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye have forsaken me , and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak .
translation.kha: U Shemaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Rehoboam bad ki nongïalam jong ka Judia kiba la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ban lait im na u Shishak . U ong ïa ki ,  Kane ka dei ka khubor na U  Trai  ïa phi : ‘ Phi la iehnoh ïa nga , te mynta nga la iehnoh ïa phi sha u Shishak .’

translation.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed .
translation.kha: ki la wan ban shahshkor ïa u bad ban ïoh jingkhiah na ki jingpang jong ki . Kito kiba la shah pynjynjar da ki mynsiem bymman ruh ki la wan bad la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: And the world passeth away , and the lust thereof : but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei bad kaei kaei baroh kaba don ha ka , kaba ki briew ki kwah kan sa jah noh ; hynrei kito kiba leh ïa ka mon U Blei kin im junom .

translation.en: Testifying both to the Jews , and also to the Greeks , repentance toward God , and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kumjuh nga la ai ka jingmaham da ka jingsngewkhia ba ki dei ban phai sha U Blei na ki pop jong ki bad ban ngeit ha U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And these are the words that the  Lord  spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah :

translation.en: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoash u khun jong u Jehoahas kum u syiem ka Israel , u Amasaïah u khun jong u Joash u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: I thank my God , I speak with tongues more than ye all :
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba nga kren ha ki thylliej bapher kham bun ban ïa uno uno na phi .

translation.en: And I will bring you out from the people , and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered , with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out .
translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga lumlang ïa phi bad wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri baroh sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi .

translation.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the  Lord  shall die : shall we be consumed with dying ?
translation.kha: Lada mano mano ban wan wat tang hajan ka Ïingjaiñ ruh un ïap , te ngi baroh ngi long hi kum kiba la ïap .

translation.en: And he said unto his lad , Run , find out now the arrows which I shoot . And as the lad ran , he shot an arrow beyond him .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u ,  Khie mareh , bad tam ïa ki khnam kiba ngan sa siat .  Uta u mareh , bad u Jonathan u siat ïa u khnam sha shuwa jong u .

translation.en: That thou mayest regard discretion , and that thy lips may keep knowledge .
translation.kha: Te phin sa nang kumno ban leh donakor , bad ki ktien jong phi kin pynpaw ba phi don ka jingtip .

translation.en: When they went , they went upon their four sides  ; they turned not as they went , but to the place whither the head looked they followed it  ; they turned not as they went .
translation.kha: Haba ki kherub ki khih , ki lah ban leit sha kano kano ka liang khlem da hap phai . Baroh lang ki leit sha ka dong kaba ki ïakwah leit , khlem da hap phai sawdong .

translation.en: Can a man be profitable unto God , as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself ?
translation.kha: Hato don u briew , wat la u long uba stad tam , uba la ju long uba larkam na ka bynta U Blei ?

translation.en: But now the  Lord  my God hath given me rest on every side , so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ai ha nga ka jingshongsuk ha baroh ki pud ki sam jong nga . Ngam don nongshun , bad kam don kano kano jingma jong ka jingshah tur ïaleh .

translation.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while , and then took his leave of the brethren , and sailed thence into Syria , and with him Priscilla and Aquila  ; having shorn his head in Cenchrea : for he had a vow .
translation.kha: U Paul u la nang sah kham bun sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Korinth , nangta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit da ka lieng lem bad ka Priskila bad u Akwila sha Syria . Ha shuwa ba un leit da ka lieng na Kenkhria u la phah khi ïa la ka khlieh namar ka jingsmai kaba u la pynlong .

translation.en: And now thy two sons , Ephraim and Manasseh , which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt , are mine  ; as Reuben and Simeon , they shall be mine .
translation.kha: U Jakob u bteng ,  Joseph , ki khun shynrang jong me ar ngut kiba me la ïoh ha Ijipt shuwa ba ngan wan hangne ki dei ki jong nga ; u Ephraim bad u Manasseh ki long ki khun jong nga kumba long u Reuben bad u Simeon .

translation.en: And he brought us out from thence , that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers .
translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt ban wan ïalam ïa ngi shane bad ban ai ha ngi ïa kane ka ri , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee , and peace be to thine house , and peace be unto all that thou hast .
translation.kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong ha u Nabal :  U Dabid u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , ko paralok jong nga , lem bad ki jingkyrkhu kyrdoh ïa phi , ïa ka longïing jong phi bad ïa baroh kiba dei ki jong phi .

translation.en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Moserah : there Aaron died , and there he was buried  ; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest s office in his stead .
translation.kha: ( Ki Israel ki mihnoh na ki pukri ki nong Jaakan bad ki leit sha Moserah . Hangta u Aaron u la ïap , bad hangta ruh la tep ïa u , bad u Eleasar u khun jong u , u shim ïa ka jaka jong u kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will send unto him wanderers , that shall cause him to wander , and shall empty his vessels , and break their bottles .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ka por ka poi haba ngan phah ïa ki briew ban theh noh ïa ka Moab kum ka waiñ . Kin pynthylli ïa ki khra buh waiñ bad pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki .

translation.en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing ? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father .
translation.kha: Naba tang shi pisa phi lah ban thied ar tylli ki sim ïing , pynban ym don kawei ka sim ïing kaba hap ha ka khyndew khlem ka jingshah U Kpa jong phi .

translation.en: As for the earth , out of it cometh bread : and under it is turned up as it were fire .
translation.kha: Ka jingbam ka mih na ka khyndew . Hynrei hapoh jong kajuh ka khyndew , baroh ka long ba la pra bad ba la phret .

translation.en: They shall eat the meat offering , and the sin offering , and the trespass offering  ; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs .
translation.kha: Ki jingkñia ainguh , ki jingkñia pop bad ki jingkñia na ka bynta ban siew pat , kin long ki jingbam jong ki lyngdoh , bad ki kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha Israel ïa kiba la pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And if a soul sin , and hear the voice of swearing , and is a witness , whether he hath seen or known of it  ; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Ki Jingkñia namar ka Pop ki donkam na ka bynta kine ki jingleh . Lada uno uno u shah khot da ki bor ba-halor ban ai sakhi ha ka ïingbishar bad um ïathuh ei ei ïa kata kaba u la ïohi ne u la ïohsngew , u dei ban kit hi ïa kaba mih nangta .

translation.en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw , ki la rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai banyngkong jong ka snem kaba bud .

translation.en: And these are they by the way side , where the word is sown  ; but when they have heard , Satan cometh immediately , and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka lynti ïaid ; ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , u Soitan u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka .

translation.en: The horn of Moab is cut off , and his arm is broken , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ka Moab la khñiot noh ; ïa ka bor jong ka la pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria u kylla dien bad phai noh sha Ninebeh .

translation.en: O worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness : fear before him , all the earth .
translation.kha: Dem ngon ha khmat uta Uba Khuid haba u wanpaw ; to khynñiuh ha khmat jong u , phi ka pyrthei baroh !

translation.en: And send them to the king of Edom , and to the king of Moab , and to the king of the Ammonites , and to the king of Tyre , and to the king of Zidon , by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban phah ka khubor sha ki syiem jong ka Edom , ka Moab , ka Ammon , ka Tyros , bad ka Sidon lyngba ki nongkit  tiensyiem jong ki , kiba lah wan sha Jerusalem ban jngoh ïa u syiem Sedekaïah .

translation.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand , and for frontlets between thine eyes : for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingrakhe ka long ka jingpynkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la teh ha ka kti jong ngi ne ha ka shyllangmat jong ngi ; kan pynkynmaw ïa ngi ba U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah jong u .’

translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta phin sumar bad leh ïa ki hukum jong nga : nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: He that spared not his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how shall he not with him also freely give us all things ?
translation.kha: Da shisha ym U Blei , u bym shym la tyngkai wat ïa la u jong U Khun hi , hynrei uba la ai sngewbha ïa u na ka bynta jong ngi baroh ! U la ai ha ngi ïa la U Khun — hato un ym ai sngewbha ïa kiei kiei baroh ?

translation.en: And told him , saying , Joseph is yet alive , and he is governor over all the land of Egypt . And Jacob s heart fainted , for he believed them not .
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ha u ,  U Joseph u dang im , bad u long u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .  U Jakob u dum ka buit ka stad , ba um sngewlah ngeit ïa ki .

translation.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness  ; and be content with such things as ye have : for he hath said , I will never leave thee , nor forsake thee .
translation.kha: Sumar bad kiar ïa la ka jingim na kaba ieit spah , bad sngewhun bad kita kiei kiei kiba phi don . Namar U Blei u la ong ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi , ngan ym kyntait ïa phi .

translation.en: And they had no child , because that Elisabeth was barren , and they both were now well stricken in years .
translation.kha: Kim don khun namar ba ka Elisabeth kam shym lah ban ïoh wat iwei ruh , bad ma ka lem bad u Sekharaïah ki la tymmen bha .

translation.en: And he said unto the people , Pass on , and compass the city , and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u la hukum ïa la ki briew ban sdang ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah , lem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba ïaid ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai .

translation.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of , behold , the  Lord  be between thee and me for ever .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jingkular kaba ngi la pynlong hapdeng jong ngi , U  Trai  un pynthikna ba ngin bat ïa ka junom .

translation.en: The way of an eagle in the air  ; the way of a serpent upon a rock  ; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea  ; and the way of a man with a maid .
translation.kha: u pukni u her ha suiñ , u bseiñ u par halor u mawsiang , ka liengbah kaba wad ïa la ka lynti ha ka duriaw , bad u briew bad ka briew kiba ïashoh jingieit .

translation.en: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God .
translation.kha: Naba ngam shym la buhrieh na kaba pynbna ha phi ïa ka jingthmu baroh ka jong U Blei .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man , and maketh flesh his arm , and whose heart departeth from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynrem ïa u briew uba phai noh na nga bad uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha u briew , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u briew u bym im junom .

translation.en: And when they go forth into the utter court , even into the utter court to the people , they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered , and lay them in the holy chambers , and they shall put on other garments  ; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments .
translation.kha: Shuwa ba kin leit sha ka phyllaw ba kham shabar ha kaba don ki paidbah , ki dei ban loit noh shuwa ïa ki sopti ba ki phong haba ki don ha ka kam hapoh ka Templ bad ban iehnoh ïa ki ha ki kamra bakhuid . Kin phong da kiwei pat ki sopti khnang ba kin buh noh ïa ki sopti bakyntang na kaba pynmynsaw ïa ki paidbah .

translation.en: Then they said one to another , We do not well : this day is a day of good tidings , and we hold our peace : if we tarry till the morning light , some mischief will come upon us : now therefore come , that we may go and tell the king s household .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien kata ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ngim dei ban leh kumne ! Ngi don ka khubor babha , bad ngim dei ban buh ïa ka tang ha lade hi . Lada ngi ap haduh mynstep ban ïathuh ïa ka , ngi thikna ba ngin shah pynshitom . Ïa ngin ïaleit noh shisyndon ban ïathuh ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem !

translation.en: And as Samuel turned about to go away , he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle , and it rent .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u phai ban leit noh , hynrei u Saul u ïohbat ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka la kad .

translation.en: And I commanded , and search hath been made , and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings , and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein .
translation.kha: Nga la hukum ban don ka jingtohkit , bad la shem shisha ba naduh ki por mynhyndai ka Jerusalem ka la ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka bor syiem bad ba ka dap da ki nongïaleh pyrshah bad ki nongthaw jingkulmar .

translation.en: Am I not an apostle ? am I not free ? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord ? are not ye my work in the Lord ?
translation.kha: Hato ngam long u briew uba laitluid ? Hato ngam long u Apostol ? Hato ngam shym la ïohi ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi ? Hato phi phim long u soh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta U Trai ?

translation.en: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward , from the hill that lieth before Beth–horon southward  ; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , a city of the children of Judah : this was the west quarter .
translation.kha: Nangta u khun sha kawei pat ka liang , da kaba phai shathie na ka liang sepngi jong uta u lum bad u suh shaduh ka Kiriath Baal ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) , kaba dei jong ka jait Judah . Une u dei u pud uba shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain ? or can the heavens give showers ? art not thou he , O  Lord  our God ? therefore we will wait upon thee : for thou hast made all these things .
translation.kha: Ym don kino kino ki bleithaw jong ki jaitbynriew kiba lah ban phah ïa u slap ; ka suiñbneng da lade hi kam lah ban pynhap slap . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , namar me long uta uba leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle  ; and the city shall be taken , and the houses rifled , and the women ravished  ; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity , and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam lang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ban ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ïa ka nongbah yn sa shim noh , ïa ki ïing la lute , bad ïa ki kynthei la batbor . Shiteng na ki briew kin leit sha ka jingshah ringmraw , hynrei ïa kiba sah na ki yn ym shim noh na ka nongbah .

translation.en: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work , that have the oversight of the house of the  Lord  : and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the  Lord  , to repair the breaches of the house ,
translation.kha: Ong ïa u ban ai ïa ka pisa ha ki rangbah kiba dei khmih ïa ka jingshna pynbha ïa k Templ .

translation.en: And know ye this day : for I speak not with your children which have not known , and which have not seen the chastisement of the  Lord  your God , his greatness , his mighty hand , and his stretched out arm ,
translation.kha: Kynmaw mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la tip shaphang U  Trai  lyngba ki jingïashem jong phi bad u . Dei ma phi , ym ki khun ki kti jong phi kiba la ïohmad ïa kine ki jingïashem . Phi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , ïa ka bor jong u , bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , bad ïa ki kambah jong u .

translation.en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the  Lord  : it shall not be treasured nor laid up  ; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the  Lord  , to eat sufficiently , and for durable clothing .
translation.kha: Ïa ka pisa kaba ka kamai da ka jingkhaïi pateng , yn pynkyntang sha U  Trai . Pynban kan ym buh tyngkai , hynrei kito kiba mane ïa U  Trai  , kin pyndonkam ïa ka pisa jong ka ban thied jingbam bad ki jaiñ ki nep kiba ki donkam .

translation.en: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone , they caught Paul and Silas , and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers ,
translation.kha: Haba ki kynrad jong ka ki sngewthuh ba ka lad thaw pisa jong ki ka la duh noh , ki la kem ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ki la tan ïa ki sha ki bor synshar ha ka jaka ïew .

translation.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him , to uncover their nakedness : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Wat ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano kaba ïadei kur dei jait bad me .

translation.en: And they took him , and cast him into a pit : and the pit was empty , there was no water in it .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la shim ïa u bad bret ïa u sha ka pukri , kaba la tyrkhong .

translation.en: And he said , Behold now , I am old , I know not the day of my death :
translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ,  Me ïohi ba nga la tymmen bad shen ngan sa ïap noh .

translation.en: Because I will publish the name of the  Lord  : ascribe ye greatness unto our God .
translation.kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  , bad ki briew jong u kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .

translation.en: And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief . And Eliezer had none other sons  ; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many .
translation.kha: U Elieser u don tang uwei u khun , u Rehabaïah , hynrei u Rehabaïah u don shibun ki khun ki ksiew .

translation.en: And they went about in Judah , and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah , and the chief of the fathers of Israel , and they came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaleit sha baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ki wallam pat bad ki sha Jerusalem ïa ki Lebi bad ïa baroh ki rangbah kur .

translation.en: Namely , Bezer in the wilderness , in the plain country , of the Reubenites  ; and Ramoth in Gilead , of the Gadites  ; and Golan in Bashan , of the Manassites .
translation.kha: Ïa kiba na ka jait Reuben , ka don ka shnong Beser ha kawei ka madan kaba halor lum ha ka ri shyiap ; ïa kiba na ka jait Gad , ka don ka Ramoth ha ri Gilead ; bad ïa kiba na ka jait Manasseh , ka don ka Golan ha ri Bashan .

translation.en: For he commandeth , and raiseth the stormy wind , which lifteth up the waves thereof .
translation.kha: U hukum , bad ka lyer bah ka sdang ban beh bad pynmih ki jingat phyllung .

translation.en: And a certain man saw it , and told Joab , and said , Behold , I saw Absalom hanged in an oak .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Dabid u la ïohi ïa u bad u la ïathuh ha u Joab ,  Kynrad , nga la ïohi ïa u Absalom ba u sdien ha u dieng Sning !

translation.en: And her father said , I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her  ; therefore I gave her to thy companion : is not her younger sister fairer than she ? take her , I pray thee , instead of her .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Samson ,  Nga nang pyrkhat ba me isih ïa ka , te kumta nga la ai noh ïa ka ha u paralok jong me . Hynrei kam pher , ka para jong ka , ka kham bhabriew ban ïa ka . Me lah ban shim noh da ka .

translation.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir , utterly to slay and destroy them : and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir , every one helped to destroy another .
translation.kha: Ki Amon bad ki Moab ki tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Edom bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad hadien kata , ki ïaphai pyrshah para ma ki ha ka jingïaleh bashyrkhei .

translation.en: Or have found that which was lost , and lieth concerning it , and sweareth falsely  ; in any of all these that a man doeth , sinning therein :
translation.kha: lane da kaba thok shaphang kano kano ba ka la jah noh bad u smai ba um shym shem pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And Abram was very rich in cattle , in silver , and in gold .
translation.kha: U Abram u la long uba riewspah shibun , ha ka jingdon ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , kumjuh ruh ha ka jingdon ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar .

translation.en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua  ; upon one stone shall be seven eyes : behold , I will engrave the graving thereof , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day .
translation.kha: Nga buh ha khmat jong u Joshua ïa uwei u maw uba don hynñiew tylli ki dong . Ngan shniah ka jingthoh halor jong u bad ha ka shi sngi ngan shim noh ïa ka pop jong kane ka ri .

translation.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him : how much more do his friends go far from him ? he pursueth them with words , yet they are wanting to him .
translation.kha: Wat ki hynmen ki para jong u briew uba duk kim long jingmyntoi ïa u ; kam pher ba um don paralok . Kam pher katno u pyrshang tyngeh , um lah ban ïoh paralok .

translation.en: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof , by the two corners of it , upon the two sides thereof , to be places for the staves to bear it withal .
translation.kha: U thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba ïa-pyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .

translation.en: What is written in the letter ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba Thoh ha ka Shithi ?

translation.en: Yet hath he not root in himself , but dureth for a while : for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word , by and by he is offended .
translation.kha: Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , bad kim shym neh slem . Kumta haba ka jingjynjar lane ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , ki iehnoh shisyndon .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams , over the rivers , and over the ponds , and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ba un rah ïa la u diengduh halor ki wah , halor ki nur-um , bad halor ki pung-um , bad pynmih ïa ki jakoid ba kin pyndap ïa ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long : but the righteous giveth and spareth not .
translation.kha: U briew uba hok , pat , u lah ban ai , bad ban ai kylluid .

translation.en: Haste ye , and go up to my father , and say unto him , Thus saith thy son Joseph , God hath made me lord of all Egypt : come down unto me , tarry not :
translation.kha: Mynta khreh kloi ban leit sha i pa , bad ong ha i ba u Joseph u khun jong i u ong kumne , ‘ U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh ; wan noh sha nga , bad wat pynslem .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house  ; for this thing is from me . They hearkened therefore to the word of the  Lord  , and returned to depart , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hynmen ki para jong phi hi , ki paid Israel . Khie ïaleit noh sha ïing phi baroh . Kaei kaba jia ka long kaba nga mon .  Baroh ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ki leit phai sha la ïing .

translation.en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul : but the belly of the wicked shall want .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki don kyrhai ban bam , hynrei ki bymman ki shahthngan borabor .

translation.en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God , and to heal the sick .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa ki ban ïalap ïa ka Hima U Blei bad ban pynkhiah ïa kiba pang ,

translation.en: And when Uriah was come unto him , David demanded of him how Joab did , and how the people did , and how the war prospered .
translation.kha: Haba u Uriah u la wan poi , u Dabid u kylli ïa u la u Joab bad ki kynhun shipai ki bit ki biang , bad kumno ka jingïaleh ka long .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , can these bones live ? And I answered , O Lord  God  , thou knowest .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , hato kine ki shyieng ki lah ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingim ?  Nga la jubab ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , tang ma me uba lah ban jubab ïa kata !

translation.en: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate : and they said one to another , Why sit we here until we die ?
translation.kha: Saw ngut ki rangbah kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh ki don shabar ki khyrdop jong ka Samaria , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Balei ngin shu ap hangne haduh ba ngin da ïap ?

translation.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea  ; and he shall be for an haven of ships  ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .
translation.kha: U Sebulun un shong harud duriaw ; Ka jaka shong jong u kan long ka jakarieh ïa ki liengbah , Bad ka khyndew ka shyiap jong u kan ïar haduh Sidon .

translation.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job : and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren .
translation.kha: Ym don kino kino ki kynthei ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei kiba bhabriew kat ki khun kynthei jong u Job . U kpa jong ki u ai ka bhah jingïohpateng ha ki lem bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong ki .

translation.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob  ; because they have not wholly followed me :
translation.kha: ‘ Nga smai ba namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga , uwei ruh na ki rangbah uba arphew snem lane kham heh uba la wan na Ijipt un ym ïohrung sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .’

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against the shepherds  ; and I will require my flock at their hand , and cause them to cease from feeding the flock  ; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more  ; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth , that they may not be meat for them .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga pynbna ba nga long u nongshun jong phi . Ngan shim noh ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba phin long ki nongsharai jong ki ; ngan ym shah shuh ba phin sumar bha tang ïa lade . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi bad ngan ym shah ba phin bam ïa ki .

translation.en: So I returned , and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun : and behold the tears of such as were oppressed , and they had no comforter  ; and on the side of their oppressors there was power  ; but they had no comforter .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmih biang ha baroh ki jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha kane ka pyrthei . Kiba la shah banbeiñ ki lynñiar , bad ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa ki . Ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa ki namar ki nongbanbeiñ jong ki , ki don ka bor ha ka liang jong ki .

translation.en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger , and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel , and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger !
translation.kha: Katno kaba kynjah long ka Jerusalem , kaba shisien ka long kaba dap da ki briew ! Shisien la pyndonburom da ka pyrthei , mynta ka long kum ka riewkynthei ; kaba donburom tam na ki nongbah ka la kyllon sha ka jinglongmraw .

translation.en: And the multitude rebuked them , because they should hold their peace : but they cried the more , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
translation.kha: U paidbah u la kynhied ïa ki bad ong ïa ki ban sngap jar . Hynrei ki la nang pyrta kham jam ,  Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And they gave the money , being told , into the hands of them that did the work , that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  : and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders , that wrought upon the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba la buh jingkheiñ katno ka dei , ki aiti ïa ka rupa ha ki rangbah kiba dei peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ , bad kine ki siew bainong ïa ki misteri , ki nongtei jingtei ,

translation.en: But if ye will not hearken unto me , and will not do all these commandments  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin shah pynshitom .

translation.en: The blessing of the  Lord  , it maketh rich , and he addeth no sorrow with it .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingkyrkhu U  Trai  kaba pynriewspah ïa phi . Ka jingtrei shitom kan ym lah ban kham pynriewspah ïa phi .

translation.en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter : so he made it again another vessel , as seemed good to the potter to make it .
translation.kha: Man ba u lyngkhot khiew um da wandur bha , u ju shim ïa ka dewbyrtha bad pynwandur ïa ka sha kawei pat .

translation.en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper , or hath a running issue  ; he shall not eat of the holy things , until he be clean . And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead , or a man whose seed goeth from him  ;
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , uba ngat ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh lane ka jingpang mih jor , ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh ba un da long uba khuid . Lada uta u ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid da kaba pyndei bad ka metïap , lane lada u ïoh ka jingpang mih jor ,

translation.en: Be ye afraid of the sword : for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword , that ye may know there is a judgment .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , to sheptieng ïa ka waitlam — ka waitlam kaba wanrah ïa ka jingbitar U Blei halor ka pop , khnang ba phin tip ba don uwei uba bishar .

translation.en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them , Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God , judge ye .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi hi bishar kano kaba dei ha khmat U Blei — ban kohnguh ïa phi ne ban kohnguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men , to be seen of them : otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Da pynthikna ba phin ym leh ïa ki kam niam jong phi ha kaba paw khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh . Lada phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei ha kaba paw , phin ym ïoh kano kano ka nong na U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng .

translation.en: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened .
translation.kha: bad ki dang ïakren para ma ki shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia .

translation.en: And provide them beasts , that they may set Paul on , and bring him safe unto Felix the governor .
translation.kha: Pynbiang kulai na ka bynta u Paul ban shong bad pynpoi ha kaba suk ïa u sha u Pheliks u Lyngskor .

translation.en: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples : and they are written for our admonition , upon whom the ends of the world are come .
translation.kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki la jia ha ki kum ki nuksa ïa kiwei pat , bad la thoh ïa kine kum ka jingmaham ïa ngi . Naba ngi im ha ka por ba kaba kut ka la jan poi .

translation.en: But when the fourteenth night was come , as we were driven up and down in Adria , about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country  ;
translation.kha: Ka la long ka miet kaba khatsaw , bad ngi la shah ïalam kylleng ha ka duriaw Mediterranian da ka  erïong . Kumba shiteng synñia ki maji ki la antad ba ngi la jan poi hajan ka ryngkew .

translation.en: It came even to pass on the third day , that , behold , a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent , and earth upon his head : and so it was , when he came to David , that he fell to the earth , and did obeisance .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei u samla u la wan poi na ka jaka sher dara jong u Saul . Ban pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngewsih , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad sleh ïa la ka khlieh da ka khyndew . U leit sha u Dabid bad u dem ngon da kaba burom haduh khyndew .

translation.en: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation , and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength , therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants , and shalt set it with strange slips :
translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha la klet noh ïa U Blei uba la pyllait ïa pha bad uba la ïada ïa pha kum u mawsiang bah . Pynban , pha la thung ki kper bakyntang khnang ban mane ïa u blei nongwei .

translation.en: Because strait is the gate , and narrow is the way , which leadeth unto life , and few there be that find it .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka khyrdop sha ka jingim ka long kaba khim bad ka lynti kaba ïalam sha ka , ka long kaba eh , bad don khyndiat ki briew kiba shem ïa ka .

translation.en: Lo , when the wall is fallen , shall it not be said unto you , Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it ?
translation.kha: Ka kynroh kan khyllem , bad uwei uwei baroh un kylli ïa phi kaba bha aïu ka la long da ka jingpushara lieh .

translation.en: And Aaron said unto them , Break off the golden earrings , which are in the ears of your wives , of your sons , and of your daughters , and bring them unto me .
translation.kha: U Aaron u ong ha ki ,  Law noh ïa ki sohshkor ksiar ba ki tnga jong phi , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi ki deng , bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .

translation.en: At least once a year , a day is set aside to do a major cleaning .
translation.kha: Shisien shisnem , la buh ïa kawei ka sngi ban pynkhuid bha nadong shadong .

translation.en: Then I said , I am cast out of thy sight  ; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba ïa nga la beh noh na ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad ba ngan ym ïohi shuh lano lano ruh ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong me .

translation.en: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women , so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes , when it shall be reported , The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him , but she came not .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha ka hima kan sdang ban peitbeiñ ïa u tnga jong ka tang shu ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ka mahadei ka la leh . Kin ong , ‘ U syiem Serksis u hukum ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei , ban wan sha u bad ka kyntait .’

translation.en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab–shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem . And they went up and came to Jerusalem . And when they were come up , they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool , which is in the highway of the fuller s field .
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u phah ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba bun na Lakhish ban tur ïaleh ïa u Hesekaïah ha Jerusalem ; hapoh ka jingai hukum ki lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ba-halor tam . Haba ki wan poi ha Jerusalem , ki pyndap ïa ka surok ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki trei , hajan ka nur-um kaba wan tuid um na ka pung ba haneng .

translation.en: And a mighty king shall stand up , that shall rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem bashlur un mihpaw . Un synshar halor ka hima bakhraw bad un leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u kwah .

translation.en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write  ; These things saith the Amen , the faithful and true witness , the beginning of the creation of God  ;
translation.kha: Thoh ha u angel jong ka balang ha Laodikaïa :  Kane ka long ka khubor na U Amen , uba ïaineh bad u sakhi bashisha , uba long u jingsdang jong baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw .

translation.en: Then I answered them , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la kren ha nga bad u la ong

translation.en: The waters compassed me about , even to the soul : the depth closed me round about , the weeds were wrapped about my head .
translation.kha: Ka um ka la tap bad ka set mynsiem ïa nga ; ka duriaw ka la tap lup ïa nga , bad ki phlang duriaw ki la sop baroh sawdong ïa ka khlieh jong nga .

translation.en: But though I be rude in speech , yet not in knowledge ; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things .
translation.kha: Lehse nga long u bym da nang ban kren , hynrei da kaba sngewthikna ym ha ka jingtip ; ngi la pynshai ïa kane ha phi man la ka por bad ha ki jingshem baroh .

translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , in whose sight I brought them out .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah ïohi ïa nga ba nga ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt .

translation.en: Greater love hath no man than this , that a man lay down his life for his friends .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit kaba khraw tam kaba u briew u lah ban don na ka bynta ki paralok jong u ka long ban aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake , that they should see his face no more . And they accompanied him unto the ship .
translation.kha: Ki da sngewsih kthang eh namar u la lah ong ba kin ym ïohi shuh ïa u . Bad kumta ki la ïaleit bad u sha ka lieng .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Behold , I will punish them : the young men shall die by the sword  ; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine :
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa ki ! Ki samla shynrang jong ki kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ki khun jong ki kin ïapthngan .

translation.en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink  ; for they could not drink of the water of the river .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt baroh ki ïatih shi lynter ïa ka rudwah baroh ban ïoh umdih , namar kim lah shuh ban dih ïa ka um na ka wah .

translation.en: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites , out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol , six hundred men appointed with weapons of war .
translation.kha: Kumta hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah na ka jait Dan ki mih na Sorah bad Eshtaol kiba la khreh ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: And they did so , and made them all sit down .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki synran ki la dep ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king sat in his house , and the  Lord  had given him rest round about from all his enemies  ;
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la sah ha la ka ïingsyiem , bad U  Trai  u la sumar ïa u na ki nongshun jong u baroh .

translation.en: And they shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
translation.kha: Kumta yn don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy son liveth .  And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him , and he went his way .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Khie leit , u khun jong me un im !  Uta u briew u la ngeit ïa ki ktien U Jisu bad u la leit noh .

translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , after that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah , when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah , which were carried away captive unto Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga hadien ba u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la lah pyllait ïa nga ha Ramah . Ïa nga la leit ïalam shata ha ki kynjri , ryngkat bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kiba la leit ïalam kum ki koidi sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Enter into the rock , and hide thee in the dust , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty .
translation.kha: Kin rieh ha ki krem ha ki mawsiang lum lane tih ki thliew ha khyndew ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar U  Trai  bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u !

translation.en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground : and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
translation.kha: Ïa ki um la kad arliang , bad ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba kita ki um ki long kum ki kynroh ha baroh arliang .

translation.en: How Do the Elders Serve the Congregation ?
translation.kha: Kumno ki Rangbah Balang ki Shakri ïa ka Balang ?

translation.en: As the  Lord  hath been with my lord the king , even so be he with Solomon , and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la don ryngkat bad u Syiem Kynrad , kumta ruh ai un don ryngkat bad u Solomon , bad pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar jong u kaba kham roi ban ïa ka jong phi .

translation.en: What if God , willing to shew his wrath , and to make his power known , endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction :
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kumjuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . U la kwah ban pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong u bad ban pynpaw ïa ka bor jong u . Hynrei u la long uba ïaishah haduh katta katta ïa kito kiba long ka daw jong ka jingbitar jong u , kiba la don ha ka lynti sha ka jingshah pynjot .

translation.en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city , and no city shall escape : the valley also shall perish , and the plain shall be destroyed , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
translation.kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka shnong ka ban lait na ka jingpynjot ; ki ri them bad ki ri thor kin shah pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies : but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth  ; for they proceed from evil to evil , and they know not me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki long borabor kiba kloi ban ïathuh lamler ; ka jingbymhok ha ka jaka jong ka jingshisha , ka synshar ïa ka ri . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki leh ïa kawei kaba sniew hadien kawei pat bad kim shym pdiang ïa nga kum U Blei jong ki .
