translation.en: Abide thou with me , fear not : for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life : but with me thou shalt be in safeguard .
translation.kha: To sah noh bad nga bad wat sheptieng . U Saul u kwah ban pynïap ïa phi bad ïa nga , hynrei phin lait na ka jingma bad nga .

translation.en: But thus saith the  Lord  , Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away , and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered : for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee , and I will save thy children .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Kane ka long kata kaei ka ban sa jia . Ïa ki koidi jong u shipai yn ïalam noh , bad ïa ka jinglute jong u nongsynshar leh jubor yn bat noh . Ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa uta uba ïaleh ïa pha , bad ngan pyllait ïa ki khun jong pha .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and his prayer unto his God , and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the  Lord  God of Israel , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh kiba u Manasseh u la leh , ka jingduwai ba u pynlong sha U Blei , bad ki khubor jong ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kren ha u ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Now , O king , establish the decree , and sign the writing , that it be not changed , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .
translation.kha: Kumta ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un pynmih ïa kane ka hukum bad soi ïa ka , bad kan treikam , ka aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka bym lah ban pynkylla .

translation.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people  ;
translation.kha: kaba me la pynkhreh ha khmat jong ki jaitbynriew baroh :

translation.en: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners , and the Ethiopians captives , young and old , naked and barefoot , even with their buttocks uncovered , to the shame of Egypt .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ka Assyria un ïalam lyngkhuit ïa ki koidi kiba u la kem na kito ki ar tylli ki ri . Kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin ïaid da ka kjat suda bad lyngkhuit , bad ki rain jong ki ba khlem tap , kaba wanrah ka jinglehrain halor ka Ijipt .

translation.en: Prepare thy work without , and make it fit for thyself in the field  ; and afterwards build thine house .
translation.kha: Wat tei ïa ka ïing jong phi bad pynskhem ïa ka longïing tad haduh ban pynbiang ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , bad phin thikna ba phi lah ban kamai ha ka jingim .

translation.en: And when he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .
translation.kha: U Herod u la kwah ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei u la sheptieng ïa ki paid Jiw , namar ki la ñiew ïa u Ïoannis kum u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: I will keep thy statutes : O forsake me not utterly .
translation.kha: Ngan kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me : A wat iehnoh da lei lei ïa nga !

translation.en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay , his lord commanded him to be sold , and his wife , and children , and all that he had , and payment to be made .
translation.kha: U shakri um shym don shibun ban siew ïa ka ram jong u , kumta u syiem u la hukum ba ïa uta dei ban die mraw noh , ïa ka tnga bad ki khun jong u bad baroh kiba u la don khnang ban siew ïa ka ram .

translation.en: O  Lord  , be gracious unto us  ; we have waited for thee : be thou their arm every morning , our salvation also in the time of trouble .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , to isynei ïa ngi . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen ha me . To ïada ïa ngi man la ka sngi bad to pynim ïa ngi ha ki por jong ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and said , God hath taken away my reproach :
translation.kha: Kumta ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U Blei u la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga da kaba ai khun shynrang ïa nga .

translation.en: The sword of the  Lord  is filled with blood , it is made fat with fatness , and with the blood of lambs and goats , with the fat of the kidneys of rams : for the  Lord  hath a sacrifice in Bozrah , and a great slaughter in the land of Edom .
translation.kha: Ïa ka waitlam jong u yn tap da ka snam bad ka khleiñ jong ki , kum ka snam bad ka khleiñ jong ki langbrot bad ki blang ïa kiba la kñia . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa kane ka jingkñia ha ka nongbah Bosrah ; un pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynïap bakhraw ha ka ri ki Edom .

translation.en: And now , O inhabitants of Jerusalem , and men of Judah , judge , I pray you , betwixt me and my vineyard .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta u paralok jong nga u ong :  Ma phi ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad Judah , to bishar hapdeng jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga .

translation.en: He that is despised , and hath a servant , is better than he that honoureth himself , and lacketh bread .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban long u riewmadan uba trei ban ïoh bam ban kaba leh mynleh kum uba khraw hynrei bad ka shahthngan .

translation.en: And Solomon s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour , and threescore measures of meal ,
translation.kha: Ki jingbam ba U Solomon u donkam man ka sngi ki long san hajar kilo u  purew bad shiphew hajar kilo ka jingbam ;

translation.en: And he carried away all Jerusalem , and all the princes , and all the mighty men of valour , even ten thousand captives , and all the craftsmen and smiths : none remained , save the poorest sort of the people of the land .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la ring koidi ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem , ïa ki khun syiem shynrang baroh , bad baroh ki rangbah bapawkhmat , baroh lang shiphew hajar ngut . U la pynryngkang par ruh ïa baroh ki nongtrei kiba tbit , kynthup ïa ki bania , da kaba iehnoh shadien ha Judah tang ïa ki briew kiba duk tam eh .

translation.en: And the sons of Izhar  ; Korah , and Nepheg , and Zichri .
translation.kha: U Ishar u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Korah , u Nepheg , bad u Sikhri .

translation.en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver , and his idols of gold , which your own hands have made unto you for a sin .
translation.kha: Ka por kan wan haba baroh na phi phin bret noh ïa ki bleithaw bapop kiba phi la thaw na ka rupa bad ka ksiar .

translation.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into a mountain apart to pray : and when the evening was come , he was there alone .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingphah noh ïa u paidbah , u la leit kiew ïa u lumrit marwei hi ban duwai .

translation.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen  ; and they that hated them ruled over them .
translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki ha ka bor jong ki nongmane bleithaw , bad ki nongshun jong ki , ki synshar halor jong ki .

translation.en: Upon man s flesh shall it not be poured , neither shall ye make any other like it , after the composition of it : it is holy , and it shall be holy unto you .
translation.kha: Wat theh ïa ka ha ka met jong uno uno u riewpaidbah bad wat pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka rukom khleh ban shna ïa kawei pat ka jait umphniang kaba kum kane . Kane ka long kaba kyntang , bad phi dei ban kheiñ kyntang ïa ka .

translation.en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart , Who hath begotten me these , seeing I have lost my children , and am desolate , a captive , and removing to and fro ? and who hath brought up these ? Behold , I was left alone  ; these , where had they been ?
translation.kha: Te phan ong ha lade , ‘ Mano ba la kha ïa kine ki khun baroh na ka bynta jong nga ? Nga la duh noh ïa la ki khun bad ngam lah ban ïoh khun shuh . Nga la shah ïalam mraw bad la shah beh noh — mano ba la pynheh pynsan ïa kine ki khun ? Nga la shah iehnoh marwei — nangno kine ki khun ki la wan ?’

translation.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism , he said unto them , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa shibun ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha u ban shah pynbaptis , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ki bseiñ — uei uba la ïathuh ha phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?

translation.en: Then the angel that talked with me went forth , and said unto me , Lift up now thine eyes , and see what is this that goeth forth .
translation.kha: U angel u la mihpaw biang bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Ïa kaei re kaei kawei pat kaba wan !

translation.en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood  ; rooms shalt thou make in the ark , and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch .
translation.kha: Shna kawei ka lieng na ka bynta ïa lade da u jait dieng uba bha ; shna ki kamra ha ka bad tah ruh ïa ka da ka bsiang na shapoh bad shabar .

translation.en: Their throat is an open sepulchre ; with their tongues they have used deceit ; the poison of asps is under their lips :
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki dap da ki jingshukor bashyrkhei ; ki jingthok ba-bymman ki mih na ki thylliej jong ki , bad ki jingbyrngem kiba ma , kum ka bih bseiñ , na ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ;

translation.en: If these men die the common death of all men , or if they be visited after the visitation of all men  ; then the  Lord  hath not sent me .
translation.kha: Lada kine ki briew ki ïap kumba ïap ki parabriew khlem da hap ha kano kano ka jingpynshitom na U Blei , te shisha U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: The city of confusion is broken down : every house is shut up , that no man may come in .
translation.kha: Ha ka nongbah , baroh kiei kiei ki long ha ka jingkulmar , bad ki briew ki la setkut ïa lade ha ki ïing jong ki ban shngain .

translation.en: Get you up from among this congregation , that I may consume them as in a moment . And they fell upon their faces .
translation.kha: Ïeng sharud na kine ki briew , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki hangto hi .  Baroh ar ngut ki la dem khrup ha khyndew ,

translation.en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people , Go , number Israel from Beer–sheba even to Dan  ; and bring the number of them to me , that I may know it .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ai ki hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie leit lyngba ka Israel , na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tip haduh katno ngut ki ïadon .

translation.en: Many daughters have done virtuously , but thou excellest them all .
translation.kha: U da ong ,  Shibun ki kynthei ki long ki tnga kiba bha , hynrei phi long kaba bha tam na ki baroh .

translation.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked , and this is the place of him that knoweth not God .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sniew , ka kupar jong kito ki bymsalia ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And they laid their hands on him , and took him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa U Jisu bad ki la batskhem ïa u .

translation.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof , like a roaring lion ravening the prey  ; they have devoured souls  ; they have taken the treasure and precious things  ; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki long kum ki sing kiba kyrhuh halor ki mrad kiba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew , ki shim ïa ka pisa baroh bad ki jingdon jingem kat kaba ki lah ban ïoh , bad da kaba pynïap briew ki pynsah riewkynthei ïa kiba bun .

translation.en: For this cause we also , since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you , and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding ;
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw , ngi ju duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi , naduh ba ngi la ïohsngew shaphang jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pyndap ïa phi da ka jingtip ïa ka mon jong u , da ka jingstad baroh bad ka jingshemphang ba U Mynsiem jong u , u ai .

translation.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u syiem Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan sha Kaisaria bad ki la leit pdiang sngewbha ïa u Phestos .

translation.en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed : but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded .
translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba bha , phi pan ïa ka jingjynjar ; bud ïa ka bad phin lait im .

translation.en: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted : but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka khraw haba kiba hok ki kyrkhu ïa ka ; hynrei ka nongbah ka jot noh da ki ktien jong ki bymman .

translation.en: And I sent the hornet before you , which drave them out from before you , even the two kings of the Amorites  ; but not with thy sword , nor with thy bow .
translation.kha: Katba phi nang tur sha khmat , nga la pynshaïong ïa ki khnang ban beh noh ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor . Ki waitlam bad ki ryntieh jong phi kim ïadon bynta ei ei bad kane .

translation.en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground , thou shalt not be established , nor thy kingdom . Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me , for he shall surely die .
translation.kha: Hato mem sngewthuh ba katba u Dabid u dang im , lano lano men ym ïoh long u syiem jong kane ka ri ? Mynta hi to khie leit bad wallam ïa u shane — u dei ban ïap !

translation.en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat , and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran katba ki dang ïabam . U la kren tyngeh ïa ki , namar kim shym la don jingngeit bad namar ka jingmutlop palat ïa ka ban ngeit ïa kito kiba la lah ïohi ïa u ba u im .

translation.en: But there is good news .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ka don ka khubor babha .

translation.en: These are that Aaron and Moses , to whom the  Lord  said , Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies .
translation.kha: U Aaron bad u Moses ki la long kita ha kiba U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ïalam noh ïa ki jait Israel na Ijipt .

translation.en: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born ? or because the number of thy days is great ?
translation.kha: Nga thikna ba me lah , namar me la tymmen bha bad me la don hangta mynba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Wherefore they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We beseech thee , O  Lord  , we beseech thee , let us not perish for this man s life , and lay not upon us innocent blood : for thou , O  Lord  , hast done as it pleased thee .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kyang sha U  Trai  ,  A  Trai  , ngi duwai , to wat pynshitom ïa ngi da ka jingïap ban shim ïa ka jingim jong une u briew ! Ma me , ko  Trai  , me kitkhlieh na ka bynta kane baroh ; ka long ka jingleh jong me .

translation.en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning  ; lo , he goeth out unto the water  ; and thou shalt stand by the river s brink against he come  ; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand .
translation.kha: Kumta khie leit bad ïakynduh ïa u mynstep ha ka por ba u leit hiar sha ka wah Nile . Rah bad me ïa u diengduh ïa uba la pynkylla bseiñ , bad ap ïa u harud wah .

translation.en: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns , and put it on his head , and they put on him a purple robe ,
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la thaw ïa ka pansngiat da ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la pynphong halor ka khlieh jong u ; nangta ki la pynkup ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh ha u bad ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith .
translation.kha: U Khrist u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkyrkhu kaba U Blei u la kular ha u Abraham kan ïoh wan ha ki Jentil da U Khrist Jisu , khnang ba lyngba ka jingngeit ngin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la kular da U Blei .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What wilt thou that I should do unto thee ?  The blind man said unto him , Lord , that I might receive my sight .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ko Nonghikai ,  uta u briew uba matlah u la jubab ,  Nga kwah ban ïoh imat biang .

translation.en: Whoso is wise , and will observe these things , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ai ba kito kiba stad kin pyrkhat shaphang kine kiei kiei ; to kin pyrkhat shaphang ka jingieit baneh U  Trai .

translation.en: Thy testimonies are very sure : holiness becometh thine house , O  Lord  , for ever .
translation.kha: Ki aiñ jong me ki neh bymjukut , A  Trai  , bad ka Templ jong me ka long kaba khuid da shisha , junom la junom .

translation.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron s consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : and it shall be thy part .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka shadem jong uta u langbrot bad pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh bakyrpang sha nga . Kane ka bynta jong u mrad ba la kñia ka dei ka jong me .

translation.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold , truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold .
translation.kha: Lada hynñiew ngut ki mynsiem yn pynïap ban siew na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa u Kain , Hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki mynsiem yn pynïap lada uno uno u pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paidbah jong u Dabid bad baroh ki paidbah ha Israel ki sngewthuh ba u syiem um don bynta ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .

translation.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger , in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïaishong ïaisah ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba u kpa jong u , u la shong la sah ,

translation.en: But if he be not able to restore it to him , then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee : and in the jubilee it shall go out , and he shall return unto his possession .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um kotbor ban thied pat ïa ka , kan ïaisah hi ha ka kti uta u nongthied haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat . Ha kata ka snem yn sa pynphai pat ïa ka sha u trai uba nyngkong .

translation.en: Therefore because the king s commandment was urgent , and the furnace exceeding hot , the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego .
translation.kha: Mynta namar ba u syiem u la ai ki hukum bapyrkhing na ka bynta ban pynlong ïa ka lawar ding kaba khluit haduh katta katta , ki thylliej ding ki la thang ïa ki nongap phira kiba ïalam ïa ki rangbah sha ka lawar ding .

translation.en: I will praise thee : for thou hast heard me , and art become my salvation .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me , A  Trai  , namar me la ïohsngew ïa nga , bad me la ai ka jingjop ïa nga .

translation.en: Lo now , his strength is in his loins , and his force is in the navel of his belly .
translation.kha: hynrei katno ka jingkhlaiñ kaba khraw ka don ha ka met jong u , bad katno ka bor kaba khraw ka don ha ki dohksah jong u !

translation.en: And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals  ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .
translation.kha: Ka la long kaba khriat , kumta ki shakri bad ki nongap phira ki la thang ding da u rnga bad ki la ïeng sawdong jong ka , ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Te u Petros u la leit shata bad u la ïa-ïeng bad ki , ban pynsyaid ïa lade .

translation.en: For the froward is abomination to the  Lord  : but his secret is with the righteous .
translation.kha: namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh bymman , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba hok u ïarap ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these parables , he departed thence .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ïathuh ïa kine ki pharshi , u la iehnoh ïa kata ka jaka

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  My time is not yet come : but your time is alway ready .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ka por kaba biang na ka bynta jong nga kam pat poi . Kano kano ka por na ka bynta ïa phi ka biang .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day , that Moses called Aaron and his sons , and the elders of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi hadien ba la pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang , u Moses u khot ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings , Jehu appointed fourscore men without , and said , If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape , he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him .
translation.kha: Nangta ma u bad u Jonadab ki la leit shapoh ban ai ki jingkñia bad jingainguh thang sha u Baal . U la pyn-ap phraphew ngut ki rangbah shabar ka templ bad u la ai jingbthah ïa ki :  Phi dei ban pynïap ïa kine ki briew baroh ; uno uno na phi uba shah ïa uwei na ki ban lait im , un siewdor ïa ka da la ka jong ka jingim !

translation.en: And saying , Alas , alas , that great city , that was clothed in fine linen , and purple , and scarlet , and decked with gold , and precious stones , and pearls !
translation.kha: Katno kaba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw ! Ka la ju riam ïa lade da ki jaiñ linen , kiba sawbthuh , bad kiba saw hain hain , bad ka kup ïa lade da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila !

translation.en: Remember ye not , that , when I was yet with you , I told you these things ?
translation.kha: Hato phim kynmaw ? Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane baroh mynba nga dang don lem bad phi .

translation.en: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth : but the righteous shall see their fall .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew basniew ki don ha ka bor synshar , ka kam sniew ka nang roi . Hynrei kiba hok kin im ban ïohi ïa ka jingkyllon jong kiba kum kita ki briew .

translation.en: And be ye kind one to another , tenderhearted , forgiving one another , even as God for Christ s sake hath forgiven you .
translation.kha: Pynban , to lehsbun bad long jemnud iwei ïa wei pat , bad to ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba U Blei u la map ïa phi ha U Khrist .

translation.en: For had ye believed Moses , ye would have believed me : for he wrote of me .
translation.kha: Lada phi la ngeit da shisha ha u Moses , phin jin da la ngeit ha nga , namar u la thoh shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy people Israel , and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers .
translation.kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong me bad wan ïalam biang ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs , singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord ;
translation.kha: To ïakren iwei ïa iwei pat da ki ktien ha ki salm , ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki jingrwai ba kynja mynsiem ; da kaba rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki salm sha U Trai da ki jingïaroh ha ki dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: Abraham saith unto him , They have Moses and the prophets  ; let them hear them .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ong , ‘ Ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me ki don u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki ; ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me ki dei ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ki ong .’

translation.en: If they shall fall away , to renew them again unto repentance  ; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh , and put him to an open shame .
translation.kha: Bad hadien kata ki la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ! Ka long ka bym lah long ban ïalam pat ïa ki ban kylla-kaba-mut biang , namar ki la sahnarphna biang ïa U Khun U Blei bad pynlehrain ïa u ha khmat ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Moses  father in law said unto him , The thing that thou doest is not good .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jethro u ong ,  Phim shym leh satia ïa kane ha ka rukom kaba dei .

translation.en: And David said , What have I now done ? Is there not a cause ?
translation.kha: Mynta nga la leh aïu keiñ ?  u Dabid u kylli .  Hato ngam lah seh ban kylli jingkylli ?

translation.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often , as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others  ;
translation.kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u leit rung shapoh ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam man ka snem ryngkat bad ka snam ki mrad . Hynrei U Khrist um shym la rung shapoh ban kñia ainguh ïa lade bunsien .

translation.en: I returned , and saw under the sun , that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favour to men of skill  ; but time and chance happeneth to them all .
translation.kha: Nga la sngewthuh sa kawei pat , ba ha kane ka pyrthei ki nongmareh kiba stet kim ju ïai jop sah ïa ki jingïamareh thong , bad kiba shlur kim ju ïai jop sah ïa ka thma . Ki briew kiba stad kim ju ïai kamai sah ban im , ki briew kiba proh jingmut kim ju ïai ïoh spah , bad ki briew kiba lah ban leh ei ei kim ju ïai kiew sha ki kyrdan bashalor . Ka kupar basniew ka jia ha uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof  ; neither is it found in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hapdeng ki briew ; ym don batip ïa ka dor bashisha jong ka .

translation.en: The  Lord  knoweth the thoughts of man , that they are vanity .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat ; u tip katno ki long ki bymshemphang ha kaba pynshong nongrim .

translation.en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace , his goods are in peace :
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba khlaiñ , uba la khreh ïa la ki tiar ïaleh baroh , u ap phira ïa la ka jong ka ïing , baroh ki jingdon jingem jong u ki don ha ka jingshngain .

translation.en: Go ye therefore , and teach all nations , baptizing them in the name of the Father , and of the Son , and of the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Kumta , khie leit , sha ki briew baroh kylleng bad pynlong ïa ki , ki synran jong nga : To pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Kpa , U Khun , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,

translation.en: But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down : for the man said unto us , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim treh ban phah ïa u , ngin ym leit , namar uta u briew u la ong ha ngi ba ngin ym lah shuh ban ïakynduh ïa u lymda u para jong ngi u don ryngkat lem bad ngi .

translation.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not  ; I will lead them in paths that they have not known : I will make darkness light before them , and crooked things straight . These things will I do unto them , and not forsake them .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki briew bamatlah jong nga na ki lynti kiba kim pat ju ïaid . Ngan pynkylla ïa ka jingdum jong ki sha ka jingshai bad pynlong ïa ki jaka khohruh khohram kiba jem ha khmat jong ki . Kine ki long ki jingkular jong nga , bad ngan batskhem ïa ki .

translation.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither hath he covered the darkness from my face .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la pynjot ïa ka jingshlur jong nga . Dei U Blei , ym ka jingdum , kata kaba pynlong ïa nga ban sheptieng — wat la ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa nga .

translation.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah , which they have done to provoke me to anger , they , their kings , their princes , their priests , and their prophets , and the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ka namar baroh kaba sniew ba la leh da ki paid ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki syiem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki .

translation.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof , and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno dei ban leit , lane ban phah noh biang ïa ki ?

translation.en: Speak not thou in thine heart , after that the  Lord  thy God hath cast them out from before thee , saying , For my righteousness the  Lord  hath brought me in to possess this land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  doth drive them out from before thee .
translation.kha: Wat ong ha la ka dohnud ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynher krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi , ka long namar ka hok jong ngi ba U  Trai  u la wan ïalam ïa ngi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .  Pynban ka long namar ka jingbymman kita ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  u la beh krad ïa ki namar jong phi .

translation.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years , and departed without being desired . Howbeit they buried him in the city of David , but not in the sepulchres of the kings .
translation.kha: U Jehoram u la don laiphew ar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem . Ym don mano mano ba sngewsih haba u ïap . Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time ,
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u khot ïa u Abraham ha kaba ar sien na bneng ,

translation.en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the children of Ammon made war against Israel .
translation.kha: Ka long hadien katto katne por ba ki Ammon ki leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Jesus Christ himself said : “ Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out . ”
translation.kha: U Jisu Krist da lade hi u la ong : “ Wat sngew kyndit ia kane , namar ka por ka la jia , ha kaba kito kiba don ha ki jing tep kin ioh sngew ia ka jingpyrta jong u bad kin ia mih noh . ”

translation.en: Then said Ziba unto the king , According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant , so shall thy servant do . As for Mephibosheth , said the king , he shall eat at my table , as one of the king s sons .
translation.kha: U Siba u jubab ,  Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ma phi Syiem Kynrad phi hukum .  Kumta u Mephibosheth u ïabam lang ha ka miej bam jong u syiem , kum uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u syiem .

translation.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ïano ba me pyrkhat ba me la ñiewbeiñ bad rkhiebeiñ ? Me la long uba khlem burom ïa nga , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel .

translation.en: Furthermore then we beseech you , brethren , and exhort you by the Lord Jesus , that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God , so ye would abound more and more .
translation.kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi la ïohnang na ngi kumno phi dei ban im khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei . Kane ka long da shisha , kumno phi la ju im . Bad mynta ngi kyrpad bad kyntu ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu ban leh kham bha shuh shuh .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut da kaba ong ,  To shahshkor te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sher dara ha ka ri Gilead .

translation.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people  ; then let him bring for his sin , which he hath sinned , a young bullock without blemish unto the  Lord  for a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada dei u Rangbah Lyngdoh uba leh pop bad da kumta u wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ha ki paidbah , un ai ïa u masi lyngraw u bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad un kñia sha U  Trai  namar ka pop jong u .

translation.en: Be ye therefore ready also : for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not .
translation.kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phi dei ban long kiba la kloi , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta haba phim shym khmih lynti ïa u .

translation.en: When I shall say to the righteous , that he shall surely live  ; if he trust to his own righteousness , and commit iniquity , all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered  ; but for his iniquity that he hath committed , he shall die for it .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban kular ha u briew uba bha , hynrei lada u sdang ban pyrkhat ba ka jingleh babha jong u kaba mynshuwa ka la biang bad u sdang ban leh pop , Ngan ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kaba bha ba u la leh . Un ïap namar ki pop jong u .

translation.en: If I then , your Lord and Master , have washed your feet  ; ye also ought to wash one another s feet .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai bad U Nonghikai jong phi , nga la sait ïa ki kjat jong phi . Phi , te , phi dei ban sait ïa ki kjat para ma phi .

translation.en: Heaven is my throne , and earth is my footstool : what house will ye build me ? saith the Lord : or what is the place of my rest ?
translation.kha: ‘ Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga , ong U Trai , bad ka khyndew ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Ka ïing kaba kumno te phin tei ïa nga ? Hangno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?

translation.en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the  Lord  it came to pass , that the  Lord  spake unto Joshua the son of Nun , Moses  minister , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  ; U  Trai  u la kren ha u nongïarap lem jong u Moses , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun .

translation.en: Wherefore the king said unto me , Why is thy countenance sad , seeing thou art not sick ? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart . Then I was very sore afraid ,
translation.kha: kumta u ong ,  Balei ba me imat sngewsih ? Mem shym pang , ka lah ban long ba me don jingsngewsih .

translation.en: And it came to pass the day after , that he went into a city called Nain  ; and many of his disciples went with him , and much people .
translation.kha: Shen hadien kata , U Jisu u la leit sha ka shnong kaba la khot , ka Nain , ki synran jong u lem bad u paidbah babun ki la ïadon ryngkat .

translation.en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the  Lord  continually , being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Man ka Sabbaton , u Aaron u dei ban buh ïa une u kpu ha khmat U  Trai  na ka bynta ki Israel kum ka jutang kaba neh junom .

translation.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry : they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki shah lehbeiñ , ki ud ; ki pyrta ba yn don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ki .

translation.en: Then Achish called David , and said unto him , Surely , as the  Lord  liveth , thou hast been upright , and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight : for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day : nevertheless the lords favour thee not .
translation.kha: U Akhish u khot ïa u Dabid , bad u ong ha u ,  Nga smai ha U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba phi long uba hok ïa nga ; bad nga hi nga sngewdei ba phin leit ryngkat bad nga sha ka thma ; naba ngam shym la shem kano kano ka jingbakla ha phi naduh ka sngi ba phi wan sha nga haduh kane ka sngi . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiem kim pdiang ïa phi .

translation.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets  ; all my bones shake  ; I am like a drunken man , and like a man whom wine hath overcome , because of the  Lord  , and because of the words of his holiness .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la lwet , bad nga la khynñiuh . Namar jong U  Trai  , namar ki ktien kiba khuid jong u , ba nga la long kum u briew uba buaid u briew uba la dih bun eh ka waiñ .

translation.en: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .
translation.kha: bad nangta u bsuh ïa kita ki dieng lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk .

translation.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John , and bound him in prison for Herodias  sake , his brother Philip s wife : for he had married her .
translation.kha: U Herod da lade hi u hukum ïa ka jingkem ïa u Ïoannis , bad u la phah teh kynjri ïa u bad phah set ha ka byndi . U Herod u la leh ïa kane namar ka Herodias , ïa kaba u la lah shongkurim , wat la ka la long ka tnga u para jong u , u Philip .

translation.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad , which is beyond Jordan , and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation : and he made a mourning for his father seven days .
translation.kha: Ynda ki poi ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba ha Atad , kaba sha mihngi na ka Jordan , ki ïapynlong hangta ïa ka jingïambriew kaba jur bad kaba kthang mynsiem ; bad u Joseph u pyndep ïa ka jingïambriew ïa la u kpa sa hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: And he said , Let us take our journey , and let us go , and I will go before thee .
translation.kha: U Iso u ong ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit noh ; ngan nang ïaid ma nga sha khmat .

translation.en: The thief cometh not , but for to steal , and to kill , and to destroy : I am come that they might have life , and that they might have it more abundantly .
translation.kha: U nongtuh u wan tang ban ïoh tuh , ban pynïap bad ban pynjot . Nga la wan khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingim — ka jingim ha ka jingdap kyrhai jong ka .

translation.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time , houses , and brethren , and sisters , and mothers , and children , and lands , with persecutions  ; and in the world to come eternal life .
translation.kha: Un ïohpdiang shispah shah shuh shuh ki ïing , ki hynmen ki para shynrang ne kynthei , ki kmie , ki khun bad ki lyngkha — bad ki jingshah pynshitom beiñ ruh kumjuh ; bad ha ka pateng ka ban sa wan un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And he called the multitude , and said unto them ,  Hear , and understand :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ïa ki paidbah sha u bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor bad to shemphang !

translation.en: Ye shall not eat one day , nor two days , nor five days , neither ten days , nor twenty days  ;
translation.kha: Phi dei ban bam ïa ka ym tang shi sngi ne ar sngi , ne san sngi , ne shiphew sngi , ne wat arphew sngi ruh ,

translation.en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; but not like his father , and like his mother : for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um da sniew eh kat u kpa jong u , lane kat ka Jesebel , ka kmie jong u ; u la pynkhyllem ïa ka dur kaba u kpa jong u , u la thaw na ka bynta ban mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: For all flesh is as grass , and all the glory of man as the flower of grass . The grass withereth , and the flower thereof falleth away :
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ki briew baroh ki long kum u phlang , bad ka burom jong ki baroh kum ki  tiewkhlaw . U phlang u ïapstai noh , bad ki syntiew ki tlor noh ,

translation.en: And Reuben answered them , saying , Spake I not unto you , saying , Do not sin against the child  ; and ye would not hear ? therefore , behold , also his blood is required .
translation.kha: U Reuben u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym ktah kti ïa u para , hynrei phim shym shahshkor . Kumta ngi hap shahshitom kylla mynta namar kata ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion , Behold , thy King cometh unto thee , meek , and sitting upon an ass , and a colt the foal of an ass .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ka nongbah Seïon , ha khmih , u Syiem jong pha u wan sha pha ! U long uba sngewrit bad u shong halor ka kada bad halor u khun kada .

translation.en: For he sent letters into all the king s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka khubor sha kawei pa kawei ka jylla jong u syiem ha ka ktien bad ka rukom thoh jong kata ka probins    , kaba ong ba uwei pa uwei u tnga u long u kynrad jong ka ïing jong u bad kaba u kren kan long ka bor kaba kut .

translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify them , that they may be most holy : whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy .
translation.kha: Pynkyntang ïa ki kumne ba kin dup long kiba khuid janai bad ïa uno uno ne kaei kaei kaba pyndei ïa ki yn pynmynsaw da ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ki .

translation.en: And let these my words , wherewith I have made supplication before the  Lord  , be nigh unto the  Lord  our God day and night , that he maintain the cause of his servant , and the cause of his people Israel at all times , as the matter shall require :
translation.kha: To ai ba un leh-isynei borabor ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa u syiem jong ki kat kum ki jingdonkam jong ki kiba man la ka sngi .

translation.en: The king of Eglon , one  ; the king of Gezer , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Eglon , ka Geser ,

translation.en: Go ye , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is kindled against us , because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad kylli na U  Trai  na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh jong ka Judah shaphang ka jinghikai jong kane ka Kitab . U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ngi namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la leh ïa kaei ba kane ka Kitab ka ong ba dei ban leh .

translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not  ; neither is there any breath in their mouths .
translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah ban ïohsngew ; kim lah wat ban pynhiar mynsiem .

translation.en: For we will destroy this place , because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  hath sent us to destroy it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkynnoh pyrshah kaba jur ïa kine ki briew bad u la phah ba ngin pynjot thiaw ïa ka Sodom .

translation.en: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name .
translation.kha: Bad u la wan poi sha Damaskos lem bad ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh ban kem ïa baroh kiba mane ïa me .

translation.en: The Lord  God  hath sworn by himself , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts , I abhor the excellency of Jacob , and hate his palaces : therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la ai kane ka jingmaham bakyntang :  Nga isih ïa ka jingsarong ki briew ka Israel ; nga ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ka nongbah bakhraw bad baroh kiba don ha ka , ha u nongshun .

translation.en: Counsel is mine , and sound wisdom : I am understanding  ; I have strength .
translation.kha: Nga don ki jingthmu bad nga pyntreikam ïa ki ; nga don ka jingshemphang , bad nga don ka bor .

translation.en: We have sinned with our fathers , we have committed iniquity , we have done wickedly .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh ; ngi la long bymman bad sniew .

translation.en: In a coming new world , life in perfect health and happiness . —Revelation 21 :3 , 4 .
translation.kha: Ha ka pyrthei ba thymmai , ka jingim kaba suk lem bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ba janai .—Jingpynpaw 21 :3 , 4 .

translation.en: And when he was gone forth into the way , there came one running , and kneeled to him , and asked him , Good Master , what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life ?
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u la sdang biang ha ka jingïaid lynti jong u , uwei u briew u la wan mareh , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai Babha , kaei kaba nga dei ban leh ban ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?

translation.en: These were born unto the giant in Gath  ; and they fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
translation.kha: Kine ki lai ngut kiba la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u , ki long kiba hiarpateng na ki ramhah ha Gath .

translation.en: And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot : and he also was the son of the giant .
translation.kha: Kawei pat ka thma ka jia ha Gath , ha kaba don u ramhah uba don hynriew tylli ki shympriah kti ha kawei kawei ka kti bad hynriew tylli ki shympriah kjat ha kawei kawei ka kjat . U long uba hiarpateng na ki ramhah mynhyndai .

translation.en: Who went in the way before you , to search you out a place to pitch your tents in , in fire by night , to shew you by what way ye should go , and in a cloud by day .
translation.kha: wat la u leit ha shuwa jong phi borabor ban wad ka jaka ba phin sher dara . Ban kdew lynti ïa phi , u ïaid ha shuwa jong phi ha u rishot ding mynmiet bad ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi .

translation.en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye that tremble at his word  ; Your brethren that hated you , that cast you out for my name s sake , said , Let the  Lord  be glorified : but he shall appear to your joy , and they shall be ashamed .
translation.kha: To sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u kren , phi kiba sheptieng bad kohnguh ïa u :  Namar phi long kiba ïaineh ha nga , katto katne na ki briew jong phi hi ki shun ïa phi bad kin ym don ïadon bynta ei ei bad phi . Ki rkhiebeiñ ïa phi bad ong , ‘ Ai ba U  Trai  un pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u bad pynim ïa phi , kumta ba ngin ïohi ïa phi ba phi shadkmen .’ Hynrei dei ma ki hi , ki ban jahburom !

translation.en: He that wasteth his father , and chaseth away his mother , is a son that causeth shame , and bringeth reproach .
translation.kha: Tang u briew uba khlemrain bad bym donburom un lehbeiñ ïa la u kpa lane beh noh ïa la ka kmie na ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And a certain ruler asked him , saying , Good Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
translation.kha: U nongïalam jong ki Jiw u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai Babha , kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?

translation.en: Beside the chief of Solomon s officers which were over the work , three thousand and three hundred , which ruled over the people that wrought in the work .
translation.kha: bad u la buh lai hajar laispah ngut ki riewkhmat kiba peit ïa ki bad kiba pynïaid ïa ki jingtrei jong ki .

translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself , and they enter in and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first . Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation .
translation.kha: Nangta u mihnoh bad u wan ïalam sa hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem wat kiba kham sniew ban ïa u , bad ki wan shongsah hangta . Kumta haba baroh ka la kut , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang . Kane ka long kaei ka ban jia ha ki briew kiba sniew jong kane ka por .

translation.en: But if I live in the flesh , this is the fruit of my labour : yet what I shall choose I wot not .
translation.kha: Hynrei , lada , da kaba nga lah ban leh shuh shuh ka kam kaba myntoi , te ngam thikna ïa kano nga dei ban jied .

translation.en: Against Egypt , against the army of Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt , which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba u ong shaphang ki kynhun shipai u Neko , u syiem ka Ijipt , ïa uba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la jop ha Karkhemish hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem ka Judah :

translation.en: But to the rest speak I , not the Lord : If any brother hath a wife that believeth not , and she be pleased to dwell with him , let him not put her away .
translation.kha: Ha kiwei nga ong ( ma nga da lade hi , ym dei U Trai ) : Lada u parabangeit u don ka tnga ka bymngeit bad ka mynjur ban ïaishong bad u , um dei ban pyllait noh ïa ka .

translation.en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon , saying , Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign , and David our lord knoweth it not ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Nathan u leit sha ka Bathsheba , ka kmie jong u Solomon , bad u ong ha ka ,  Phim pat ïohsngew ba u Adonijah , u khun jong ka Haggith u la thung syiem ïa lade ? Bad u Syiem Dabid um tip ei ei shaphang kata !

translation.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness , nor my tongue utter deceit .
translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong nga kin nym ong lano lano ïa kaba sniew , u thylliej jong nga un ym kren ïa kaba shukor lano lano ruh .

translation.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un paw , u da wan ha ki lyoh lem bad ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place , and all speak with tongues , and there come in those that are unlearned , or unbelievers , will they not say that ye are mad ?
translation.kha: Namarkata lada , ka balang baroh kawei ka ïaseng lang bad baroh ki sdang ban kren da ki thylliej bapher — bad lada ki riewpaidbah lane ki bymngeit ki rung hapoh , hato kin nym ong ba phi la ïalamwir ?

translation.en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years : then he turned and rebelled against him .
translation.kha: Mynba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem Babilonia u la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , bad lai snem la pynbor ïa u Jehoïakim ban pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u ; nangta u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: And David said unto God , I have sinned greatly , because I have done this thing : but now , I beseech thee , do away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha U Blei ,  Nga la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh ha kaba leh ïa kane ! Sngewbha map ïa nga . Nga la leh bieit .

translation.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face : and they do not return to the  Lord  their God , nor seek him for all this .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng ki paid Israel ka kyang pyrshah ïa ki hi . Wat haba kane baroh ka la jia , kim shym la wan phai sha nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , separated unto the gospel of God ,
translation.kha: U Paul , u shakri jong U Jisu Khrist , u ba la shah khot u apostol bad ba la jied da U Blei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong u .

translation.en: And this is the confidence that we have in him , that , if we ask any thing according to his will , he heareth us :
translation.kha: Ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei , namar ngi sngewskhem ba u ïohsngew ïa ngi lada ngi kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta kano kano kaba long kat kum ka mon jong u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thou shalt sleep with thy fathers  ; and this people will rise up , and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land , whither they go to be among them , and will forsake me , and break my covenant which I have made with them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shen men sa ïap noh , bad ynda me ïap u paidbah un sa phai noh na nga bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki . Kin kyntait ïa nga bad mane ïa ki blei thala jong kata ka ri sha kaba kin sa leit rung .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan , as the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel , and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged , and laid them down there .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki bud ïa ki hukum jong u Joshua . Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua , ki la shim khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel , ki la bah ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara , bad ki buh ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed ? for the end of those things is death .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi la ïoh jingmyntoi na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la sngewlehrain mynta ? Ka jingmih jong kita kiei kiei ka long ka jingïap !

translation.en: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;
translation.kha: Ngi sngewsarong ruh ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ngi , namar ngi tip ba ka jingshah shitom ka pynmih ïa ka jingïaishah ,

translation.en: And Jacob said unto them , My brethren , whence be ye ? And they said , Of Haran are we .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kylli ïa ki nongap langbrot ,  Ko paralok , phi dei kiba na-ei ?   Na Haran ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ai ki jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong ka long bymjukut .

translation.en: Ephraim , he hath mixed himself among the people  ; Ephraim is a cake not turned .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long kum u kpu bym pat ih bha .

translation.en: So man lieth down , and riseth not : till the heavens be no more , they shall not awake , nor be raised out of their sleep .
translation.kha: kumta ki briew ki ïap , khlem lah shuh ban khie . Kin ym lah ban kyndit shuh katba ka sahit bneng ka dang ïaishah ; kin ym lah ban khih shuh lano lano na ka jingïohthiah jong ki .

translation.en: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , and your tithes , and heave offerings of your hand , and your vows , and your freewill offerings , and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks :
translation.kha: Shata phi dei ban leit rah ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi , bad ïa ki jingainguh jong phi , ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba phi kular ïa U  Trai  , ïa ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi , bad ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .

translation.en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , to Debir  ; and fought against it :
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la phai noh pat sha Debir bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Enokh u la im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei haduh laispah snem bad u la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: For the creature was made subject to vanity , not willingly , but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope ,
translation.kha: Naba ïa ki jingthaw la pynrem ban duh noh ïa ka jingthmu jong ki , ym na ka mon la jong hi , hynrei namar ka mon U Blei uba la mon ïa kata . Pynban ka la don ka jingkyrmen

translation.en: If thou prepare thine heart , and stretch out thine hands toward him  ;
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa la ka dohnud kaba beit , ko Job . Phai sha U Blei .

translation.en: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he cast into the sea , than that he should offend one of these little ones .
translation.kha: Kan kham bha ïa u lada la teh ha ka ryndang jong u ïa u mawtylliat uba heh bad bret ïa u sha ka duriaw ban ïa kaba ma u , u pynlong ïa uwei na kine kiba rit ban leh pop .

translation.en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses , which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka jingïohi ki Israel , u Joshua u pruid ha ki maw ïa ka jingthoh jong ka Hukum kaba u Moses u la thoh .

translation.en: For if any be a hearer of the word , and not a doer , he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass :
translation.kha: Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa ka ktien hynrei u bym pyntreikam ïa ka u long kum u briew uba peit ha ka ïitkhmih bad ïohi ïa lade kumba u long .

translation.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables , when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , but were eyewitnesses of his majesty .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la shaniah ha ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw ha kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingwan ha ka bor jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi . Da la ki khmat jong ngi hi ngi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .

translation.en: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink , saying , Let alone  ; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh bad u spoiñ ba la wieh ha ka waiñ bym bha , bad ba la teh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng . Nangta u la rah shalor ha ki rmiang shyntur U Jisu bad u la ong ,  To ap , ngin ïakhmih la u Elijah un wan ban pynhiar ïa u na ka diengphna !

translation.en: ( For they shall hear of thy great name , and of thy strong hand , and of thy stretched out arm  ; ) when he shall come and pray toward this house  ;
translation.kha: Haba u nongwei uba shong jngai na ka ri u ïohsngew shaphang ka nam jong me bad ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba me la leh na ka bynta ki briew jong me , bad un wan ban mane ïa me bad duwai ha kane ka Templ , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong u .

translation.en: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley , and they that were on the other side Jordan , saw that the men of Israel fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , they forsook the cities , and fled  ; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel kiba ha shiliang kata ka them Jesreel bad kiba sha mihngi ka wah Jordan ki ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai ki Israel ka la phet ïap bad u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kyllon ïap , ki ruh ki iehnoh noh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong shnong hangta .

translation.en: Save now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  : O  Lord  , I beseech thee , send now prosperity .
translation.kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A  Trai  , to pynim ïa ngi ! to ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop , A  Trai  !

translation.en: Which Indian state has the largest population ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jylla kaba hapoh india ba bun briew tam ?

translation.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers  ; yea , upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city :
translation.kha: bad ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ ki mih ha ka ri ki briew jong nga . To ïam na ka bynta ki ïing baroh ha kaba ki briew ki la ju long kiba kmen bad ka nongbah kaba la ju dap da ka jingim .

translation.en: And Saul disguised himself , and put on other raiment , and he went , and two men with him , and they came to the woman by night : and he said , I pray thee , divine unto me by the familiar spirit , and bring me him up , whom I shall name unto thee .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u riam pher ïa lade da kaba phong da kiwei pat ki jaiñ , bad ynda la dum ma u bad ar ngut na ki rangbah jong u ki leit sha kata ka kynthei .  Wad jingtip na ki mynsiem na ka bynta jong nga bad to ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka ban sa jia ,  u ong ha ka .  Khot ïa uta u mynsiem jong uta u briew uba nga khot kyrteng .

translation.en: And I saw thrones , and they sat upon them , and judgment was given unto them : and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus , and for the word of God , and which had not worshipped the beast , neither his image , neither had received his mark upon their foreheads , or in their hands  ; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ki khet bad ha kito kiba shong ha ki la ai ïa ka bor ban bishar . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa ki mynsiem jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka jingshisha ïa kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw bad ïa ka ktien U Blei . Kim shym la mane ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka dur jong u , lymne ba ki la pdiang ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw ha ki shyllangmat jong ki lane ha ki kti jong ki . Ki la im pat bad ki la synshar kum ki syiem bad U Khrist shihajar snem .

translation.en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it  ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed , and that which she uttered with her lips , wherewith she bound her soul , of none effect : and the  Lord  shall forgive her .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U  Trai  un map ïa ka .

translation.en: The mountains saw thee , and they trembled : the overflowing of the water passed by : the deep uttered his voice , and lifted up his hands on high .
translation.kha: Haba ki lumbah ki la ïohi ïa me , ki kyiuh ; ka um ka hap na ki sahit bneng . Ki um hapoh ka khyndew ki kyrhuh , bad ki jingat phyllung jong ki , ki kiew shalor .

translation.en: So his father went down unto the woman : and Samson made there a feast  ; for so used the young men to do .
translation.kha: U kpa jong u , u leit sha ïing kata ka kynthei , bad u Samson u pynlong ka jingkhawai hangta . Kane ka long kaba ki ju leh hapdeng ki para samla shynrang .

translation.en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for , and there shall be none  ; and the sins of Judah , and they shall not be found : for I will pardon them whom I reserve .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym shem ïa ka pop ha Israel bad ïa ka jingbymman ha Judah , namar ngan map ïa kito ki briew kiba nga la pynsah ïa ka jingim jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles , and shalt suck the breast of kings : and thou shalt know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew bad ki syiem kin sumar ïa pha , kumba ka kmie ka sumar ïa la ki khun jong ka . Phan sa tip ba nga U  Trai  , nga la pyllait ïa pha , ba U Blei Bakhrawbor ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa pha .

translation.en: Woe be unto thee , O Moab ! the people of Chemosh perisheth : for thy sons are taken captives , and thy daughters captives .
translation.kha: Isynei ïa ki briew ka Moab ! Ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Khemosh la pynjot , bad ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei la ïalam noh kum ki koidi .

translation.en: Who hath declared from the beginning , that we may know ? and beforetime , that we may say , He is righteous ? yea , there is none that sheweth , yea , there is none that declareth , yea , there is none that heareth your words .
translation.kha: Uno na phi uba la ïathuhlypa ba kane kan jia , khnang ba ngin lah ban ong ba phi long uba dei ? Ym don na phi uba la ong wat shikyntien shaphang jong ka ; ym don uba la ïohsngew ïa phi ba phi ong ïa kata .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given a commandment concerning thee , that no more of thy name be sown : out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image : I will make thy grave  ; for thou art vile .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la rai shaphang ki nong Assyria :  Kin ym don kino kino kiba hiarpateng ki ban bah ïa ka kyrteng jong ki . Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw kiba don hapoh ka templ jong ki blei jong ki . Nga pynkhreh ka jingtep ïa ki nong Assyria — kim don hok ban im !

translation.en: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vine of the earth , and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God .
translation.kha: Kumta u angel u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , u la ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na uta u dieng sohwaiñ , bad u la bret ïa ki sha ka jaka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei .

translation.en: So David and his men came to the city , and , behold , it was burned with fire  ; and their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , were taken captives .
translation.kha: Ynda u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki poi , ki shem ba la thang ïa ka shnong , bad ba la rong noh ïa ki tnga jong ki , ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .

translation.en: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof : so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ïa u dieng Dumbur bad phin ïoh ïa ki soh ban bam . U shakri uba sumar bha ïa la u kynrad un ïoh burom .

translation.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Da sumar bha te , ban ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt , which thou wast afraid of  ; and they shall cleave unto thee .
translation.kha: Un pynngat ha phi sa shisien ïa ki jingpang kiba sngewshyrkhei , kiba phi la mad ha Ijipt , bad phin ym ïohkhiah .

translation.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba : then Abimelech rose up , and Phichol the chief captain of his host , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jingïateh kular ha Beersheba , u Abimelekh bad u Phikol ki leit phai pat sha Philistia .

translation.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .
translation.kha: Ka jingtip jong nga ka long kaba ïar ; ngan pyndonkam ïa kaba nga tip ban pyn-i ba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong nga , u long uba hok .

translation.en: How can you be a good husband , wife , or parent ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban long u lok , ka lok ne ki kmie ki kpa babha ?

translation.en: Of whom we have many things to say , and hard to be uttered , seeing ye are dull of hearing .
translation.kha: Don shibun kiei kiei ba ngi hap ban ong shaphang kane ka bynta , hynrei ka long kaba eh ban batai ïa phi , namar phi long kiba suki katta katta ïa ka ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: He is despised and rejected of men  ; a man of sorrows , and acquainted with grief : and we hid as it were our faces from him  ; he was despised , and we esteemed him not .
translation.kha: Ngi la ñiewbeiñ ïa u bad ngi la kyntait ïa u ; u la shah ïa ka jingshitom bad jingpang . Ym don mano mano wat ban peit ïa u — ngi la leh bymsalia ïa u kum u bym long ei ei .

translation.en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints , and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day .
translation.kha: haba u wan ha kata ka Sngi ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na ki briew jong u baroh bad ka jingpyndonburom na baroh kiba ngeit . Phi ruh phin long napdeng jong ki , namar ba phi la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ha phi .

translation.en: Rise ye up , take your journey , and pass over the river Arnon : behold , I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite , king of Heshbon , and his land : begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ngi la ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab , U  Trai  u ong ha ngi , ‘ Khreh mynta ban jam ïa ka wah Arnon . Nga la aiti ïa u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon jong ki Amor bad ïa ka hima jong u ha phi . Tur ïaleh ïa u bad kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .

translation.en: O house of Israel , cannot I do with you as this potter ? saith the  Lord . Behold , as the clay is in the potter s hand , so are ye in mine hand , O house of Israel .
translation.kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban leh ïa phi ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaba u nongthaw khiew u la leh ïa ka dewbyrtha ? Phi don ha ki kti jong nga kum ka dewbyrtha ha ki kti u nongthaw khiew .

translation.en: But they hearkened not , nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness , to burn no incense unto other gods .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim shahshkor satia lane pynleit jingmut . Phim iehnoh noh ïa ki jingmlien basniew ban kñia ha kiwei ki blei .

translation.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt , as we have not touched thee , and as we have done unto thee nothing but good , and have sent thee away in peace : thou art now the blessed of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngi kwah ba phin kular ba phin ym pynmynsaw ïa ngi , kumba ngi ruh ngim shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi . Ngi la lehsbun ïa phi bad ngi la shah ba phin leit da kaba suk . Mynta ka paw shai ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him , they took him down from the tree , and laid him in a sepulchre .
translation.kha: Bad hadien ba ki la lah pyndep ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong shaphang jong u , ki la pynhiar noh ïa u na ka diengphna bad ki la buh ïa u ha ka jingtep .

translation.en: Tom doesn't realise how his behaviour affects others .
translation.kha: U Tom um poi-pyrkhat kumno ka ka jinglong jong u ka ktah ia kiwei .

translation.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees  ; and they said unto them , Why have ye not brought him ?
translation.kha: Haba ki nongap phira ki la leit phai noh , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi khlem wan ïalam ïa u ?

translation.en: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem , and called for the elders of Israel , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers  ; and they presented themselves before God .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la lumlang ïa ki jait Israel baroh ha Shekhem . U la khot ïa ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki Israel , bad ki la ïawan sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei .

translation.en: Father , I will that they also , whom thou hast given me , be with me where I am  ; that they may behold my glory , which thou hast given me : for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ! Me la ai ïa ki ha nga , bad nga kwah ïa ki ba kin don bad nga ha kaba nga don , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga , ka burom ïa kaba me la ai ha nga ; naba me la ieit ïa nga ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And they had a few small fishes : and he blessed , and commanded to set them also before them .
translation.kha: Ki la don ruh katto katne tylli ki dohkha rit . U Jisu u la ainguh na ka bynta kine bad u la ong ïa ki synran ban sam ïa ki ruh .

translation.en: That their hearts might be comforted , being knit together in love , and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding , to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God , and of the Father , and of Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba yn pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshlur bad ba yn lah ban khring lang ïa ki ha ka jingieit , bad kumta kin ïoh ïa ka jingdap ba-pura ïa ka jingsngewskhem kaba ka jingshemphang ka wallam . Ha kane ka rukom kin tip ïa ka jingmaïan ka jong U Blei , kaba long U Khrist hi .

translation.en: Understand therefore this day , that the  Lord  thy God is he which goeth over before thee  ; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them , and he shall bring them down before thy face : so shalt thou drive them out , and destroy them quickly , as the  Lord  hath said unto thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei to tip mynta ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïaid ha shuwa jong phi kum ka ding kaba bam duh . Un jop bad pyndem ïa ki katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , ba phi lah ban beh krad bad pynjot ïa ki kloi kloi , kumba u la kular .

translation.en: They shall have like portions to eat , beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony .
translation.kha: U dei ban ïoh bynta mar katjuh ka jingbam kumba long kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , bad u lah ban buh ïa kano kano kaba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u ki phah sha u .

translation.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men : they make broad their phylacteries , and enlarge the borders of their garments ,
translation.kha: Ki leh ïa kiei kiei baroh khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki . Peit ïa ki jingteh  sai snieh kiba don ki jingthoh bakhuid ïa kiba ki teh ha ki shyllangmat bad ki ksang ti jong ki , bad khmih haduh katno ki long kiba heh ! Khmih ruh katno kiba jrong ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki jaiñkup jong ki !

translation.en: And it came to pass afterward , that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek , whose name was Delilah .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Samson u ibha ïa kawei ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Delilah , kaba shong basah ha ka Them Sorek .

translation.en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines : therefore they called that place Sela–hammahlekoth .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u sangeh noh na kaba thwet ïa u Dabid bad u leit noh ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Na kata ka daw , ïa kata ka jaka la khot U Lum ka Jingpynïakhlad .

translation.en: We have drunken our water for money  ; our wood is sold unto us .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban siew na ka bynta ka um kaba ngi dih ; ngi dei ban thied ïa ka dieng kaba ngi donkam ban thang .

translation.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord   ; so shall no man abide there , neither shall any son of man dwell therein .
translation.kha: Kajuh kaei kaei kan jia ïa ka Babilon kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , haba nga la pynjot ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong kiba marjan . Yn ym don ba shong shuh hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , and Ishui , and Malchi–shua : and the names of his two daughters were these  ; the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Saul ki long u Jonathan , u Ishbi , bad u Malkhishua . Ka khun kynthei baheh jong u ka kyrteng ka Merab , bad kaba kham rit ka Mikhal .

translation.en: If he beget a son that is a robber , a shedder of blood , and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,
translation.kha: Te tharai une u briew u don u khun uba lute bad uba pynïap , uba leh ïa kawei na kine kiei kiei kiba u kpa jong u um ju leh .

translation.en: She that hath borne seven languisheth : she hath given up the ghost  ; her sun is gone down while it was yet day : she hath been ashamed and confounded : and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka kmie kaba la duh noh ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki khun jong ka , ka la ïapler , ka da thrang ïa ka jingring mynsiem . Ka jingshai jong ka sngi jong ka , ka la kylla sha ka jingdum ; la pynjahburom ïa ka bad ka pang ka dohnud . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban pynïap ïa kito na phi kiba dang im . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: But with the precious blood of Christ , as of a lamb without blemish and without spot :
translation.kha: ka la long ka jingkñia kaba remdor jong U Khrist , uba la long kum u khunlangbrot uba khlem don jingthohbria lane jingduna .

translation.en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel , and made them heads over the people , rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .
translation.kha: bad u la jied ïa ki rangbah kiba tbit napdeng ki Israel baroh . U la thung ïa ki kum ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ki spah , ki sanphew , bad ki phew .

translation.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him , and said unto them ,  Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba ki la kwah ban kylli ïa u , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la ong , ‘ Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .’ Hato dei kane kaba phi ïakylli para ma phi hi ?

translation.en: And I went unto the angel , and said unto him , Give me the little book . And he said unto me , Take it , and eat it up  ; and it shall make thy belly bitter , but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey .
translation.kha: Nga la leit sha uta u angel bad nga la kyrpad ïa u ban ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli kaba rit . U la ong ïa nga ,  To shim ïa ka bad to bam ïa ka ; kan sa kylla jew ha ka  nierbah jong me , hynrei ha ka shyntur jong me kan long kaba thiang kum ka ngap .

translation.en: I will break also the bar of Damascus , and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven , and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden : and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop nongbah ka Damaskos , bad ngan weng ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Them Aben , bad ïa u nongsynshar ka Betheden . Ki briew ka Syria kin shah ring kum ki koidi sha ri Kir .

translation.en: And Kedesh , and Hazor , and Ithnan ,
translation.kha: ka Kedesh , ka Hasor , ka Ithnan ,

translation.en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith , and labour of love , and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ , in the sight of God and our Father ;
translation.kha: Naba ngi kynmaw ha khmat U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi ba kumno phi pyntreikam ïa ka jingngeit , kumta ba ka jingieit jong phi ka pynlah ïa phi ban trei shitom , bad kumno ka jingkyrmen jong phi ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ka long kaba skhem .

translation.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king s house with all the servants of his lord , and went not down to his house .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing ; pynban u la thiah ha ka khyrdop ïingsyiem lem bad ki nongap phira jong u syiem .

translation.en: The slave is faithful to Bible truths and to its commission to preach the good news , and it is discreet about how it wisely cares for Christ’s interests on earth .
translation.kha: U shakri u ngeit ïa ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl bad ïa ka hukum ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha , bad u long uba stad ha kaban sumar ïa kiei kiei ki jong u Khrist ha pyrthei .

translation.en: For it shall be , that on the day thou goest out , and passest over the brook Kidron , thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die : thy blood shall be upon thine own head .
translation.kha: Lada me tang shu mih bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid Kidron , men ïap da shisha — bad me hi men shah kynnoh .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Lord , evermore give us this bread .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ki la ong ïa u ,  to ai ha ngi ïa une u kpu borabor .

translation.en: The adversaries of the  Lord  shall be broken to pieces  ; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them : the  Lord  shall judge the ends of the earth  ; and he shall give strength unto his king , and exalt the horn of his anointed .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  yn pynjot ; kum u pyrthat na bneng un tied pyrshah ïa ki . U  Trai  un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ; Un ai ka bor ha la u syiem , Un pynlong ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u ban ïoh ïa ka jingjop .

translation.en: Just as the Israelites rejoiced at praising Jehovah “in assemblies ,” we too enjoy worshipping him together at special events .
translation.kha: Kumba ki khun Israel ki ïa lehkmen ban ïaroh ïa U Jehobah “ha ki jingiaseng ,” ngi ruh ngi kmen ban ïa mane lang ïa u ha kum kine ki jingïalang bakyrpang .

translation.en: Of the Izharites , Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel , for officers and judges .
