translation.kha: Napdeng kiba hiarpateng na u Ishar , ïa u Khenanaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u la buh ban peit ïa ki kam synshar khadar : Kaba buh jingthoh bad kaba bishar ïa ki paid Israel .

translation.en: These are the sons of Zilpah , whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter , and these she bare unto Jacob , even sixteen souls .
translation.kha: Kine khathynriew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Silpah ïa kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .

translation.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka jingduwai jong nga ka long ba ka jingïasyllok jong ngi bad me kum ki bangeit kan wallam ïa ka jingsngewthuh ba kham jylliew ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngi ïoh ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And he gave a sign the same day , saying , This is the sign which the  Lord  hath spoken  ; Behold , the altar shall be rent , and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out .
translation.kha: Bad u nongïathuhlypa u ïai kren ban ong ,  Kane ka duwan kan pra phum bad ïa u dpei yn pynsaphred . Te phin tip ba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba jong nga .

translation.en: And knowest his will , and approvest the things that are more excellent , being instructed out of the law ;
translation.kha: phi tip kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh , bad phi ïoh jinghikai na ka Hukum ban jied ïa kaei kaba dei ;

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Put up again thy sword into his place : for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword .
translation.kha: Thep noh ïa la ka waitlam ha ka jaka jong ka ,  U Jisu u la ong ha u .  Baroh kiba shim ïa ka waitlam kin ïap da ka waitlam .

translation.en: But as the days of Noah were , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
translation.kha: Ka jingwan U Khun U Briew kan long kum kaei kaba la jia ha ka por u Noah .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath chastened me sore : but he hath not given me over unto death .
translation.kha: U la pynshitom jur ïa nga , hynrei um shym la shah ïa nga ban ïap .

translation.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it , and put them in the four corners thereof  ; and two rings shall be in the one side of it , and two rings in the other side of it .
translation.kha: Thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong ka baroh saw tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: O my soul , come not thou into their secret  ; unto their assembly , mine honour , be not thou united : for in their anger they slew a man , and in their selfwill they digged down a wall .
translation.kha: Da lei lei ngan ym ïadon bad ki ha ki jingïaphylliew jingmut barieh jong ki . Da lei lei ngan ym ïasyllok lang bad ki ha ki jingïakynduh jong ki , naba haba ki khie bitar ki pynïap ïa ki briew , bad ki pyndkoh ïa ki masi shynrang kum ka jinglehkai sngewbha .

translation.en: Many shall be purified , and made white , and tried  ; but the wicked shall do wickedly : and none of the wicked shall understand  ; but the wise shall understand .
translation.kha: Ïa kiba bun ki briew yn pynkhuid . Kito kiba bymman kin ym sngewthuh hynrei kin ïailong bymman ; tang kito kiba stad kin shemphang .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto the woman , and said unto her , Behold now , thou art barren , and bearest not : but thou shalt conceive , and bear a son .
translation.kha: U angel U  Trai  u wanpaw ha ka bad u ong ,  Pham shym la lah ban ïoh khun , hynrei shen phan sa punkhun bad phan ïoh ïa u khun shynrang .

translation.en: And Ahishar was over the household : and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute .
translation.kha: Uba khmih ïa ki shakri ïingsyiem : U Ahishar Uba khmih ïa ka jingtrei kaba shu pynbor : u Adoniram , u khun jong u Abda .

translation.en: At the same time came to them Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , and said thus unto them , Who hath commanded you to build this house , and to make up this wall ?
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , u Tattenai , u lat ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , u Shethar Bosenai bad ki para rangbah synshar , ki wan sha Jerusalem bad ki dawa bad ong :  Mano ba ai hukum ïa phi ban tei ïa kane ka Templ bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ?

translation.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow .
translation.kha: Pynban , mynta , phi dei ban map ïa u bad ban pynshlur ïa u , khnang ban ïada ïa u na kaba sngewsih eh kat ban da kyntait noh shisyndon ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the king of Assyria , He shall not come into this city , nor shoot an arrow there , nor come before it with shields , nor cast a bank against it .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang u patsha Assyria : ‘ Un ym ïohrung ha kane ka nongbah lane siat ïa uwei u khnam pyrshah ïa ka . Yn ym don ki shipai lem bad ki stieh ki ban wan hajan ka nongbah , bad yn ym don ka kynton ba la tei ha sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin , a captain of the ward was there , whose name was Irijah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Hananiah  ; and he took Jeremiah the prophet , saying , Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga la poi ha ka Khyrdop Benjamin , u rangbah nongïalam uba dei khmih ïa ki shipai ba don ha ka kam hangta , u briew uba kyrteng u Irijah , u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u ksiew jong u Hananaïah , u la pynsangeh ïa nga bad u la ong ,  Phi la phet noh ban ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia !

translation.en: With your Bible teacher’s help , prepare a comment that you might make at the next meeting .
translation.kha: Lyngba ka jingïarap jong i nonghikai Baibl jong phi , pynkhreh ïa ka jubab kaba phi lah ban ai ha ka jingïalang ka ban bud .

translation.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon , and reacheth to Zebulun , and to the valley of Iphtah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek , and Neiel , and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand ,
translation.kha: Haba ka phai sha mihngi , u pud u suh sha Bethdagon , u da kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun bad ka Them Iphtahel ha ka lynti shaphang shatei sha Bethemek bad Neiel . U bteng shaphang shatei sha ka Kabul ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Abram was come into Egypt , the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair .
translation.kha: Haba u la rung sha ka ri Ijipt , ki nong Ijipt ki la ïohi ba ka tnga jong u ka la long kaba bhabriew .

translation.en: He saith unto them ,  Come and see .  They came and saw where he dwelt , and abode with him that day : for it was about the tenth hour .
translation.kha: To wan bad khmih ,  u la jubab . ( Ka la long ha kata ka por kumba saw baje janmiet . ) Kumta ki la leit bad u , bad ki la ïohi hangno u sah , bad ki la pynlut ïa kaba sah jong ka sngi bad u .

translation.en: Fear not , little flock  ; for it is your Father s good pleasure to give you the kingdom .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , ko kynhun barit , naba U Kpa jong phi u la sngewbha ban ai ha phi ïa ka Hima .

translation.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread , and comfort ye your hearts  ; after that ye shall pass on : for therefore are ye come to your servant . And they said , So do , as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Ngan wanrah ruh khyndiat ka jingbam ; kan ai bor ïa phi katba phi nang bteng ïa ka jingïaid lynti jong phi . Phi la pyndonburom ïa nga haba phi wan rung ha ïing jong nga , kumta shah ngan shakri ïa phi .  Ki jubab ,  Khublei shibun ; ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa kata .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar s , and to God the things that are God s .  And they marvelled at him .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ,  Te kumta , siew sha u patsha ïa kaei kaba long ka jong u patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba long ka jong U Blei .  Bad ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: Thou shalt call , and I will answer thee : thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Te men khot , bad ngan jubab , bad men shem sngewbha ïa nga , u jingthaw jong me .

translation.en: And I sent messengers unto them , saying , I am doing a great work , so that I cannot come down : why should the work cease , whilst I leave it , and come down to you ?
translation.kha: Nga phah nonglamktien ban ong ïa ki ,  Nga dang leh ka kam badonkam bad ngam lah ban leit hiar shata . Ngan ym shah ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam tang namar ban leit ïashem ïa phi .

translation.en: And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : so I drank , and she made the camels drink also .
translation.kha: Kumta hi ka pynhiar stet ïa u khiew um na la tyrpeng bad ka ong , ‘ To dih , bad ngan ai um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ba kin dih .’ Kumta nga la dih , bad ka la ai um ruh ïa ki ut .

translation.en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways , and be ashamed , when thou shalt receive thy sisters , thine elder and thy younger : and I will give them unto thee for daughters , but not by thy covenant .
translation.kha: Phan kynmaw kumno pha la leh , bad sngewlehrain ïa ka haba pha ïoh pat ïa ka hynmen bad ka para jong pha . Ngan shah ïa ki ban long kum ki khun kynthei jong pha , wat la kane kam dei ka bynta jong ka jutang jong nga bad pha .

translation.en: The burden of the beasts of the south : into the land of trouble and anguish , from whence come the young and old lion , the viper and fiery flying serpent , they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses , and their treasures upon the bunches of camels , to a people that shall not profit them .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor jong U Blei shaphang ki mrad jong ka ri shyiap bashathie :  Ki nongkit  tiensyiem ki ïaid lyngba ka ri bashyrkhei , ha kaba ki sing ki don bad ha kaba ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki Ïakjakor kiba her . Ki pynkit halor ki kada bad ki ut jong ki da ki jingai sngewbha baremdor na ka bynta ka hima ka bym lah ban ai ïa ki kano kano ka jingïarap .

translation.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam , Mithredath , Tabeel , and the rest of their companions , unto Artaxerxes king of Persia  ; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue , and interpreted in the Syrian tongue .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u patsha ka Persia , u Bishlam , u Mithredath , u Tabeel bad ki paralok jong ki , ki thoh shithi sha u patsha . Ïa ka shithi la thoh ha ka ktien Aramaik bad ban pynkylla ktien ha ka por ba pule ïa ka .

translation.en: Then was the part of the hand sent from him  ; and this writing was written .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei U Blei u la phah ïa ka kti ban thoh ïa kine ki kyntien .

translation.en: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet , and toward her children which she shall bear : for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness , wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates .
translation.kha: Wat ka kynthei kaba jem tam ka dohnud kaba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , kaba riewspah katta katta katba kam donkam ban ïaid shano shano , kan leh kumjuh . Ynda u nongshun u kerkut ïa ka shnong jong ka , kan sa kyrduh jingbam kat ban da bam buhrieh wat ïa la i khun ba ka dang shu kha bad ïa iba la kha ruh . Kan ym ai ei ei ïa la u tnga uba ka ieit lane ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them , Is it true , O Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , do not ye serve my gods , nor worship the golden image which I have set up ?
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Ko Shadrakh , Meshakh , bad Abednego , hato ka long kaba shisha ba phi kyntait ban mane ïa u blei jong nga bad ban dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba nga la phah pynïeng ?

translation.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , the king of Heshbon  ; and Israel said unto him , Let us pass , we pray thee , through thy land into my place .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phah nonglamktien sha u Sihon , u syiem Amor ha Heshbon , ban pan jingbit ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u sha ka ri la jong .

translation.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , Did not ye hate me , and expel me out of my father s house ? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jephthah u jubab ,  Phi la isih ïap ïa nga kat haduh ba phi da beh ïa nga na ïing i pa . Balei phi wan sha nga mynta haba phi la shem jynjar ?

translation.en: There were therefore seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and died without children .
translation.kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun .

translation.en: They say unto him , Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement , and to put her away ?
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei , te , ba u Moses u ai ka hukum ïa u briew ban ai ïa ka jingpynbna pyllait tnga ha ka tnga jong u bad phah noh ïa ka ?

translation.en: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies  lands  ; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them .
translation.kha: Katto katne na phi kiba dang lait im ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phi kin nang ringswai namar ka pop jong phi bad ka jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: But thou shalt utterly destroy them  ; namely , the Hittites , and the Amorites , the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee :
translation.kha: Pynduh khoit ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh : ïa ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord  went on continually , and blew with the trumpets : and the armed men went before them  ; but the rearward came after the ark of the  Lord  , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la khie dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki lyngdoh bad ki shipai ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep : nyngkong , ka kynhun shipai na sha khmat ; hadien kata , ki hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ; nangta , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ; bad khatduh , ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai .
translation.kha: U Hathakh u leh ïa kane ,

translation.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us , desolation and destruction .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïaid lyngba ka jingpynjot bad jingpra ; ngi im ha ka jingma bad ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Rob not the poor , because he is poor : neither oppress the afflicted in the gate :
translation.kha: Wat shim kabu ïa kiba duk tang namar ba phi lah ; wat shim kabu ïa kito kiba ïeng khlem jingïarap ha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest , the son of Buzi , in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar  ; and the hand of the  Lord  was there upon him .
translation.kha: Hangta ha Babilonia harud ka wah Khebar , nga la ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren ha nga bad nga la sngew ïa ka bor jong u .

translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Thy servant kept his father s sheep , and there came a lion , and a bear , and took a lamb out of the flock :
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad ,  u Dabid u ong ,  Nga la ju sharai ïa ki langbrot i pa jong nga . Man ba u sing lane ka dngiem ki wan rong ïa u khunlangbrot ,

translation.en: In which time Moses was born , and was exceeding fair , and nourished up in his father s house three months :
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kane ka por ba la kha ïa u Moses , u khunlung uba bhabriew haduh katta katta .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites , that he brought the gods of the children of Seir , and set them up to be his gods , and bowed down himself before them , and burned incense unto them .
translation.kha: Haba u Amasaïah u la wan phai na ka jingjop ïa ki Edom , u wanrah ïa ki bleithaw jong ki lem bad u , u pynïeng ïa ki , u la mane ïa ki , bad u thang jingiwbih ïa ki .

translation.en: So Moses went down unto the people , and spake unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leit hiar sha ki briew bad u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ong .

translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Abijah u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge : but he that hateth reproof is brutish .
translation.kha: Kino kino kiba ieit ïa ka jingtip ki kwah ban don ba pynong haba ki bakla . Ka long ka jingbieit ban isih haba don ba pynbeit .

translation.en: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning , saying , What city is like unto this great city !
translation.kha: bad ki la lynñiar jam haba ki la ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej dieng kiba la bam duh ïa ka :  Ym pat ju don kawei pat ka nongbah kum kane ka nongbah kaba khraw !

translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , among whom they were , in whose sight I made myself known unto them , in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , namar ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki briew ha kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki shong ki sah nga la lah pynbna ha ki Israel ba nga ngan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt .

translation.en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they die not : and it shall be a statute for ever to them , even to him and to his seed throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban da thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki kjat , ba kin ym ïap . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dei ban bud junom la junom .

translation.en: The brasen altar , and his grate of brass , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan rnong bad ka kriah rnong jong ka , ïa ki jingbah jong ka bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka ; ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka ;

translation.en: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it , and smote the high priest s servant , and cut off his right ear . The servant s name was Malchus .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros , uba kieng ïa ka waitlam , u la sei ïa ka bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u da mait ïa ka shkor kamon jong u . Ka kyrteng uta u mraw ka long u Malkhos .

translation.en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki la shong la sah ha ka ri ki Amor ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were come into Samaria , that Elisha said ,  Lord  , open the eyes of these men , that they may see . And the  Lord  opened their eyes , and they saw  ; and , behold , they were in the midst of Samaria .
translation.kha: Tang mar ïarung ha ka nongbah , u Elisha u duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ki bad ai ba kin ïohi .  U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , u pynïoh pat ïa ka jingimat jong ki , bad ki la ïohi ba ki lah da don hapoh Samaria .

translation.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus , whom ye slew and hanged on a tree .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi u la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , hadien ba phi la lah pynïap ïa u da kaba sahnar ïa u ha ka diengphna .

translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen , whither they be gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land :
translation.kha: Nangta to ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la leit , ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki , bad wanrah pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri .

translation.en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and he called his name Er .
translation.kha: U la shongkurim ïa ka , bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u , ïa uba u la khot kyrteng u Er .

translation.en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi , after their families , by the house of their fathers ,
translation.kha: U Aaron u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : U Nadab uba heh duh , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar .

translation.en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil , and pour it into the palm of his own left hand :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang Olib bad un theh ïa ka ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,

translation.en: The little chambers thereof , the posts thereof , and the arches thereof , and the windows to it round about : the length was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
translation.kha: Kum ma ki , ka ruh ka la don ki kamra ap phira , ki kynroh bashapoh ba la pynitynnat , ka kamra rung , bad ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong . Ka lynter jong ka baroh ka la long arphew san mitar , bad ka pyngkiang jong ka khat-ar mitar shiteng .

translation.en: Of a truth I say unto you , that he will make him ruler over all that he hath .
translation.kha: Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u baroh .

translation.en: And , behold , there came a great wind from the wilderness , and smote the four corners of the house , and it fell upon the young men , and they are dead  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
translation.kha: Ka rah ïa ka ïing bad pynïap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I , even I , will utterly forget you , and I will forsake you , and the city that I gave you and your fathers , and cast you out of my presence :
translation.kha: te ïathuh ïa ki ba da shisha ngan shim trait ïa ki , bad ngan bret noh ïa ki sha jngai na nga , ïa ki bad ïa ka nongbah kaba nga la ai ha ki bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him ?
translation.kha: Hato me long uba khlaiñ kum ma nga ? Hato ka sur jong me ka kyrhuh jam kum ka jong nga ?

translation.en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you  ; and evil will befall you in the latter days  ; because ye will do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba hadien ka jingïap jong nga , phin sa leh ïa ki kam bymman bad kyntait ïa kaba nga la hikai ïa phi . Bad ha ki sngi ki ban wan ka jingjynjar kan ngat ha phi , namar ba phin pynbitar ïa U  Trai  da kaba phi leh ïa kata kaba u la adong .

translation.en: A stone is heavy , and the sand weighty  ; but a fool s wrath is heavier than them both .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhia u maw bad u shyiap kam long ei ei ban haba ïanujor bad ka jingjynjar kaba uba mutlop u lah ban pynjia .

translation.en: The just man walketh in his integrity : his children are blessed after him .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki long kiba bha kupar lada ki don u kpa uba beit bad uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing : but righteousness delivereth from death .
translation.kha: Ka spah kaba phi ïoh da ka bymhok kam pynmyntoi ei ei , hynrei ka jinglonghok ka pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal , which he had built in Samaria .
translation.kha: U tei ka templ ïa u Baal ha Samaria , u shna ka duwan na ka bynta jong u bad u buh ïa ka ha ka templ .

translation.en: The priests the Levites , and all the tribe of Levi , shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel : they shall eat the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and his inheritance .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba na ka jait Lebi baroh kim dei ban ïohpateng ei ei na ka khyndew kumba long ki para Israel ; ha ka jaka kata , kin ïoh ka bam tang na ki jingainguh bad kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga wat ha ki shakri , ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kumjuh .

translation.en: This is what was intended , since God provided a wife to be “a helper for him , as a complement of him .”
translation.kha: Kane ka long khia jingthmu na duh ba sdang , ba u Blei u la pynkhreh , ka tnga kan long “Ka nongiarap jong u kum ka jing sumar ka ba biang .”

translation.en: And Cabbon , and Lahmam , and Kithlish ,
translation.kha: ka Kabbon , ka Lahmam , ka Shitlish ,

translation.en: Furthermore , when I came to Troas to preach Christ s gospel , and a door was opened unto me of the Lord ,
translation.kha: Haba nga la poi ha Troas ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist , nga la shem ba U Trai u la lah plie ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka kam hangto .

translation.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation  ; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you  ;
translation.kha: To khmih ïa ka jingïaishah slem U Trai jong ngi kum ka lad ba u ai ha phi ban ïoh im , kumba u Paul u para ba-ieit jong ngi u la thoh ha phi , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei u la ai ha u .

translation.en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself , or if thou hast thought evil , lay thine hand upon thy mouth .
translation.kha: Lada phi la long kiba bieit shisha ban sngewmeng bad ban thmu sniew , sangeh bad pyrkhat !

translation.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren , that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God , to make reconciliation for the sins of the people .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut , ba u dei ban long uba syriem kum ki para jong u ha kiei kiei baroh , ba un ïoh long u rangbah lyngdoh uba lah ban shaniah bad uba sngewsynei ha ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , kumta ba yn ïohmap noh ïa ki pop ki briew .

translation.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki kynriah jaka tang lada uta u lyoh u kiew shajrong na kata ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin , altars shall be unto him to sin .
translation.kha: Katba nang bun ki duwan ba ki paid Israel ki thaw ban pynkhuid ïa ki pop , katta nang bun ki jaka ba ki ïoh ban leh pop .

translation.en: Art thou bound unto a wife ? seek not to be loosed . Art thou loosed from a wife ? seek not a wife .
translation.kha: Hato phi don ka tnga ? Te wat pyrshang ban iehnoh ïa ka . Hato phim pat shongkurim ? Te wat ym wad tnga .

translation.en: And she took it up , and went into the city : and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned : and she brought forth , and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed .
translation.kha: Ka leit rah ïa u kew sha shnong bad ka pyn-i ha la ka kiaw kurim haduh katno ka la lum . Ka la ai ruh ha ka ïa kata ka jingbam kaba sah tam .

translation.en: My lord , hearken unto me : the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver  ; what is that betwixt me and thee ? bury therefore thy dead .
translation.kha: Ko rangbah , ka khyndew ka shongdor tang sawspah tylli ki sbai rupa — kan long aïu kata hapdeng jong ngi ? To tep ïa la ka tnga hangta .

translation.en: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand , and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand .
translation.kha: Te ngan pynhap noh ïa ka ryntieh jong u na ka kti kadiang jong u bad ki khnam jong u kin hap noh na ka kti kamon jong u .

translation.en: Thou blind Pharisee , cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter , that the outside of them may be clean also .
translation.kha: Ko Pharisi bamatlah ! To pynkhuid nyngkong ïa kaei kaba shapoh jong ka khuri , bad nangta kaba shabar kan long ruh kaba khuid !

translation.en: And she arose at midnight , and took my son from beside me , while thine handmaid slept , and laid it in her bosom , and laid her dead child in my bosom .
translation.kha: Ka la khie ha ka por mynmiet , ka shim ïa u khun jong nga na syndah jong nga katba nga dang ïohthiah , bad ka la rah ïa u sha ka jingthiah jong ka ; nangta ka buh ïa u khun ba la ïap ha ka jingthiah jong nga .

translation.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep ? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days .
translation.kha: Bad u briew u kham kor bun shah ban ïa ka langbrot ! Kumta te , ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa ngi ban ïarap ïano ïano ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: All hands shall be feeble , and all knees shall be weak as water .
translation.kha: Ki kti uwei pa uwei kin tlot , bad ki khohsiew kin kyiuh .

translation.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even , and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning , and according to the drink offering thereof , for a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa u khunlangbrot uba ar ynda janmiet , bad ainguh lang bad u katjuh u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka waiñ kumba leh mynstep . Kane ka long ka jingainguh bam sha nga U  Trai  , bad ka jingiwbih jong ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .

translation.en: For a whore is a deep ditch  ; and a strange woman is a narrow pit .
translation.kha: Ki nuti bad ki kynthei lyngkar ki long ka jingriam kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers  skins .
translation.kha: Thaw sa ar tylli ki jingkah , kawei kaba da ka snieh jong ki langbrot shynrang ba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh bha , ban long ka jingtap na shabar .

translation.en: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony , that they come up out of Jordan .
translation.kha: ban hukum ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ban wan kiew noh na ka Jordan .

translation.en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever  ; and of his kingdom there shall be no end .
translation.kha: bad un long u syiem jong ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob junom ; ka hima jong u kan ym kut shuh da lei lei !

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name , I will require it of him .
translation.kha: Un kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: As for Ephraim , their glory shall fly away like a bird , from the birth , and from the womb , and from the conception .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhraw ki Israel kan her noh kum ka sim , bad yn ym don shuh ki khun ban kha na ki , yn ym don shuh ki kynthei ki ban armet , yn ym don jingpunkhun shuh .

translation.en: Judas then , having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees , cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons .
translation.kha: Kumta u Judas u la leit sha kata ka kper , u da ïalam bad u ïa ka kynhun ki shipai Rom , bad katto katne ki nongap phira jong ka Templ ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ; ki la long kiba la kieng atiar bad ki la rah ïa ki sharak bad ki dongmusa .

translation.en: But as for you all , do ye return , and come now : for I cannot find one wise man among you .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada baroh kin wan bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga , ngan ym shem wat tang uwei ruh na ki ba u long uba stad .

translation.en: Soon Jesus will remove all wickedness and suffering from this earth .—Psalm 37 :9-11  ; Proverbs 2 :21 , 22 .
translation.kha: Shen , u Jisu un weng noh baroh ki jingsniew bad jingjynjar na kane ka pyrthei .—Salm 37 :9-11 ; Proberb 2 :21 , 22 .

translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom .
translation.kha: Ka la ong ha u Syiem Solomon ,  Kata kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad shaphang ka jingstad jong phi ka long kaba shisha !

translation.en: And the devil said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , command this stone that it be made bread .
translation.kha: U Soitan u la ong ïa u ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa une u maw ban kylla kpu .

translation.en: For he that will love life , and see good days , let him refrain his tongue from evil , and his lips that they speak no guile :
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban lehkmen ha ka jingim bad uba kwah ban ïohi ïa ki por kiba bha , u dei ban kiar na kaba kren sniew bad ban nym kren lamler .

translation.en: And David said unto him , How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the  Lord s  anointed ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Kumno keiñ me nud ban pynïap ïa u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai  ?

translation.en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee , whom the  Lord  thy God shall choose : one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee : thou mayest not set a stranger over thee , which is not thy brother .
translation.kha: Da kynmaw ba u briew uba phi jied ban long u syiem u dei ban long uta ïa uba U  Trai  hi u la jied . U dei ban long na ka jait ka kynja jong phi hi ; wat jied syiem ïa u nongwei .

translation.en: And it waxed great , even to the host of heaven  ; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground , and stamped upon them .
translation.kha: Ka la san khlaiñ eh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka bneng , ïa ki khlur hi , bad ka la bret katto katne na ki sha khyndew bad ka la ïuh halor jong ki .

translation.en: With Onesimus , a faithful and beloved brother , who is one of you . They shall make known unto you all things which are done here .
translation.kha: Lem bad u , u wan u Onesimos , uta u para ba-ieit bad uba lah ban shaniah , uba dei na ka kynhun jong phi . Kin ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba la jia hangne .

translation.en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust , and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away : yea , it shall be at an instant suddenly .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , baroh ki nongwei kiba tur ïaleh ïa pha kin shah beh noh kum ïa u pui pui , bad ki kynhun shipai bashyrkhei jong ki kin her kum u phlangïap .

translation.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line , and righteousness to the plummet : and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies , and the waters shall overflow the hiding place .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan long u  sai-thew na ka bynta ka nongrim , bad ka jinglehhok kan long u  sai-sawar jong ka .  U phria un sar noh ïa baroh ki jingshukor ha kiba phi shaniah , bad ki jingshlei kin pynjot ïa ki jingsngewshngain jong phi .

translation.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: There go the ships : there is that leviathan , whom thou hast made to play therein .
translation.kha: Ki liengbah ki ïaid halor jong ka , bad ha ka u Lebiathan u lehkai , u mrad kynsha ka duriaw uba me la thaw .

translation.en: And I will make drunk her princes , and her wise men , her captains , and her rulers , and her mighty men : and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynbuaid ïa ki nongsynshar jong ka — ki rangbah kiba stad , ki nongïalam , bad ki shipai . Kin ïohthiah bad kin ym kyndit shuh . Ma nga u syiem , nga la kren . Nga long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul , and told the tidings in the ears of the people : and all the people lifted up their voices , and wept .
translation.kha: Kita ki nonglamktien ki poi ha Gibeah ha kaba u Saul u shong , bad haba ki la ïathuh ha ki briew ïa kata ka khubor , baroh ki ïalynñiar da ka jingsngewsih .

translation.en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom , that was overthrown as in a moment , and no hands stayed on her .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga la pynshitom wat kham jur ban ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Sodom , kiba la ïashem da ka jingkyllon kaba kynsan ha ki kti jong U Blei .

translation.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha ki hajar ki pateng kiba ieit ïa nga , bad kiba sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: And Ahab made a grove  ; and Ahab did more to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him .
translation.kha: U pynïeng ruh ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah . U leh shibun ban pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , kham palat ban ïa ki syiem Israel baroh ha shuwa jong u .

translation.en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God .
translation.kha: bad ar ngut ki lyngdoh , u Benaïah bad u Jahasiel kin put ïa ki turoi borabor ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang .

translation.en: Yea , thou heardest not  ; yea , thou knewest not  ; yea , from that time that thine ear was not opened : for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously , and wast called a transgressor from the womb .
translation.kha: Nga la tip ba ïa phi ym lah ban shaniah , la ju tip ïa phi kum u nongïaleh pyrshah . Na kata ka daw phim pat ju ïohsngew satia ïa kane , balei ba wat shikyntien ruh kam shym la wan ha ki shkor jong phi ?

translation.en: And they came near unto him , and said , We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle , and cities for our little ones :
translation.kha: Ki la wan hajan u Moses bad ki ong ,  Nyngkong eh , shah ngin shna ki jingker maw hangne ïa ki langbrot jong ngi bad tei ïa ki shnong kiba la ker da ki kut baskhem na ka bynta kiba shaniah ha ngi .

translation.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite , of the kindred of Ram : against Job was his wrath kindled , because he justified himself rather than God .
translation.kha: Hynrei uba ïeng hajan hangta uba kyrteng u Elihu um lah kun shuh ïa la ka jingbitar , namar u Job u pynksan ïa lade bad u kynnoh ïa U Blei . ( U Elihu u dei u khun jong u Barakel , uba hiarpateng na u Bus , bad u dei na ka kur jong u Ram . )

translation.en: And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last , lo , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar u Asa naduh kaba nyngkong haduh kaba kut la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .

translation.en: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom , and thine heart hath lifted thee up : glory of this , and tarry at home : for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?
translation.kha: Mynta ko Amasaïah , me la jop ïa ki Edom , bad me dap da ka jingsarong . To sngewhun bad la ka nam bad shong khop ha ïing . Balei me pynkynroi jingkulmar ka ban wanrah tang ïa ka jingpynjot ha me bad ha ki briew jong me ?

translation.en: Why did he bring the bag ?
translation.kha: Balei u wanrah ia ka pla ?

translation.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister , and her nurse , and Abraham s servant , and his men .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shah ïa ka Rebekka bad ïa ka shakri ïing batymmen jong ka ba kin leit ryngkat bad u shakri jong u Abraham lem bad ki briew jong u .

translation.en: I am distressed for thee , my brother Jonathan : very pleasant hast thou been unto me : thy love to me was wonderful , passing the love of women .
translation.kha: Nga pangnud namar jong me , ko Jonathan u para jong nga ; Katno me long uba nga la sngewieit ! Katno phylla long ka jingieit jong me ïa nga , Kham palat ban ïa ka jingieit ki kynthei .

translation.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it : and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it .
translation.kha: Phin long kum u briew ba la thoh ha ka proberb , uba pyrshang ban thiah ha ka jingthiah kaba lyngkot palat bym lah ban jyrtieng , bad ka nep kaba rit palat ka bym lah ban tap ïa u .

translation.en: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit , and her company is round about her grave : all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which caused terror in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ki long baroh kiba la ïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki don ha ki bynta ba sha trai eh jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ki shipai jong ka baroh ki la kyllon ïap ha ka thma bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa u lum jingtep jong ka . Pynban shisien ki la pyntriem ïa ka ri kiba im .

translation.en: The rich man s wealth is his strong city , and as an high wall in his own conceit .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah , pynban , ki mutdur ba ka spah jong ki ka ïada ïa ki kum ki kynroh bajrong bakhlaiñ sawdong ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: Wherein was written , It is reported among the heathen , and Gashmu saith it , that thou and the Jews think to rebel : for which cause thou buildest the wall , that thou mayest be their king , according to these words .
translation.kha: La thoh :  U Geshem u ong ïa nga ba ka don ka hamsaïa kaba ïaid kylleng hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kaba don marjan , ba ma phi bad ka jaitbynriew Jiw phi don jingthmu ban ïaleh pyrshah bad dei na kane ka daw balei ba phi la tei pat ïa ka kynroh . U ong ruh ba phi thmu ban pynlong ïa lade u syiem

translation.en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm .
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , kine ki long ki briew kiba me la jied ban long ki jong me bad kiba me la wallam noh na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong me .’

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to fear him .
translation.kha: Kumta , leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi : im kat kum ki hukum jong u bad kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: Concerning the Ammonites , thus saith the  Lord   ; Hath Israel no sons ? hath he no heir ? why then doth their king inherit Gad , and his people dwell in his cities ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Ammon :  Shano ki rangbah ka Israel ? Hato ym don mano mano ban ïada ïa la ka ri ? Balei ba ki shah ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Molekh kin shim ïa ki jaka jong ka jait Gad bad shongduh hangta ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u paidbah u la sngewphylla ïa ka rukom kaba u la hikai .

translation.en: And David said to Abner , Art not thou a valiant man ? and who is like to thee in Israel ? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king ? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Abner , hato mem dei u briew uba khraw tam ha Israel ? Haba kumta , balei mem ïada ïa u syiem , u kynrad jong me ? Myntan uwei u briew u la ïohrung ha ka ïing dara ban pynïap ïa u syiem kynrad jong me .

translation.en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long , twelve broad , square in the four squares thereof .
translation.kha: Ka bynta kaba halor jong ka duwan ka long sawdong , hynriew mitar ha kawei pa kawei ka liang .

translation.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation : and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock .
translation.kha: Wallam ïa uta u masi lyngraw ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: They answered him , Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus saith unto them ,  I am he .  And Judas also , which betrayed him , stood with them .
translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Dei ma nga  u la ong . U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: The proud have forged a lie against me : but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong ki la ïathuh lamler shaphang jong nga , hynrei da la ka dohnud baroh nga kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong me .

translation.en: Howbeit the  Lord  God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever : for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler  ; and of the house of Judah , the house of my father  ; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , u la jied ïa nga bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ban synshar junom ïa ki Israel ; u la jied ïa ka jait Judah ban pynmih nongïalam , bad na ka jait Judah u la jied ïa ka ïing u kpa jong nga . Na baroh kata ka longïing ka long ka jingsngewbha jong u ban shim ïa nga bad ban pynlong ïa nga u syiem halor ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying ,  What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?
translation.kha: Ho-oid shisha ,  u Petros u la jubab . Haba u Petros u la rung shapoh ïing , U Jisu u la kren nyngkong ,  Ko Simon , kaei ka jingpyrkhat jong me ? Mano ba siew ïa ki bai khrong lane ki khajna sha ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei ? Ki traishnong jong ka ri ne ki nongwei ?

translation.en: And he took all the gold and silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and hostages , and returned to Samaria .
translation.kha: U shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kiba u lah ban ïoh , ki tiar ka templ baroh bad ki jingkynshew baroh jong ka ïingsyiem , bad u rah biang ïa ki sha Samaria . U rah ruh ïa ki koidi bad u .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him : for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it , and carried the people of it captive to Kir , and slew Rezin .
translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , haba jubab ïa ka jingkyrpad u Ahas , u tur sha khmat bad la ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Damaskos , u kurup ïa ka , u pynïap ïa u syiem Resin , bad u ïalam koidi ïa ki briew sha Kir .

translation.en: And if a man lie not in wait , but God deliver him into his hand  ; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka long tang kaba shu jia ryngkhat , bad um shym da mut shisha ban pynïap ïa u , u lah ban phet sha ka jaka kaba ngan jied na ka bynta jong phi , bad hangta un shngain .

translation.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood : but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them .
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki bymman ki long kum ban pynïap , hynrei ki ktien jong kiba hok ki pyllait im ïa kito kiba shah byrngem .

translation.en: When he was set down on the judgment seat , his wife sent unto him , saying , Have thou nothing to do with that just man : for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him .
translation.kha: Katba u Pilat u dang shong ha ka kamra ïingbishar , ka tnga jong u ka la phah khubor sha u :  Wat leh ei ei ïa uta u briew uba lui lui , namar ba ha ka jingphohsniew hynne mynmiet nga la shahshitom shikatdei eh na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: And in the morning , as they passed by , they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots .
translation.kha: Dang step bha ha ka step kaba bud , katba ki dang ïaid ha kata ka lynti , ki la ïohi ïa uta u dieng Dumbur . U la ïap baroh shi rynïeng haduh ki thied .

translation.en: Then he said , What title is that that I see ? And the men of the city told him , It is the sepulchre of the man of God , which came from Judah , and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth–el .
translation.kha: Ka jingtep jongno katai ?  u kylli . Ki briew ka Bethel ki jubab ,  Ka dei ka jingtep jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la wan na Judah bad uba la ïathuhlypa ïa kine kiei kiei kiba phi la leh ha kane ka duwan .

translation.en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas , thou filledst many people  ; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise .
translation.kha: Haba ki mar khaïi jong pha ki leit shabar ri , pha pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki hima baroh . la pynriewspah ïa ki syiem da ka spah jong ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead , that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , to take possession of it .
translation.kha: Shisyndon u Ahab u leit sha ka bri sohwaiñ ban shimti ïa ka .

translation.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers ? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity ?
translation.kha: Uei uba ïeng na ka bynta jong nga pyrshah ïa ki bymman ? Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga pyrshah ïa ki nongleh sniew ?

translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds , and by thousands : but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki ïaid sha khmat ryngkat bad la ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut bad kiba shihajar ngut , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid nadien bad u syiem Akhish .

translation.en: But we will bless the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore . Praise the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma ngi , kiba im , ngin ainguh ïa u mynta bad sha bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: Behold , the people shall rise up as a great lion , and lift up himself as a young lion : he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey , and drink the blood of the slain .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel ka long kum u sing uba khrawbor ; U bym shongthait tad haduh ba u la lah patar bad bam lut khoit , Haduh ba un da dep dih ïa ka snam jong kito kiba u la pynïap .

translation.en: To know wisdom and instruction  ; to perceive the words of understanding  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki proberb ki ban ïarap ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingstad bad ka jinghikai kaba bha , bad ban shemphang ïa ki jingong kiba jylliew jingmut .

translation.en: And Elijah came unto all the people , and said , How long halt ye between two opinions ? if the  Lord  be God , follow him : but if Baal , then follow him . And the people answered him not a word .
translation.kha: U Elijah u leit sha u paidbah bad ong ,  Sa katno slem ba phin pynbeit ïa ki jingmut jong phi ? Lada U  Trai  u dei U Blei , mane ïa u ; hynrei lada u Baal u dei U Blei , mane ïa u !  Hynrei u paidbah u la shu sngap jar .

translation.en: And when David came to Ziklag , he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah , even to his friends , saying , Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Ynda u Dabid u la wan phai sha Siklag , u phah ai bynta na kata ka mar lute sha ki paralok jong u , ki nongïalam ka Judah , bad ka khubor ,  Kane ka jingai sngewbha ïa phi na ka jinglute ba ngi la shim na ki nongshun U  Trai .

translation.en: And these bottles of wine , which we filled , were new  ; and , behold , they be rent : and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey .
translation.kha: Haba ngi pyndap ïa kine ki pla snieh waiñ , ki dang thymmai , hynrei ha khmih ! Ki la jot . Ki jaiñ bad ki juti jong ngi ki la jot namar ka jingïaid lynti kaba jngai .

translation.en: Without the veil of the testimony , in the tabernacle of the congregation , shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the  Lord  continually : it shall be a statute for ever in your generations .
translation.kha: Man la ka janmiet , u Aaron un thang ïa ki bad un ieh ba kin meh haduh mynstep ha khmat U  Trai  shabar ka jingkah kaba ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ïa kane ka hukum dei ban leh pateng la pateng .

translation.en: The sea is his , and he made it : and his hands formed the dry land .
translation.kha: U synshar halor ka duriaw , kaba u la thaw ; ka khyndew ruh , kaba u hi u la pynlong .

translation.en: Thus did your fathers , when I sent them from Kadesh–barnea to see the land .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei kaei ba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh haba nga la phah ïa ki na Kadesh Barnea ban leit swar ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Sing , O ye heavens  ; for the  Lord  hath done it : shout , ye lower parts of the earth : break forth into singing , ye mountains , O forest , and every tree therein : for the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and glorified himself in Israel .
translation.kha: To risa da ka jingkmen , phi ki bneng ! To risa , ko ki jaka bajylliew jong ka pyrthei ! To risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki lumbah , bad man la u dieng jong ka khlaw ! U  Trai  u la pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba u pynim ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel .

translation.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn , he espied his money  ; for , behold , it was in his sack s mouth .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ba ki ïasah miet , uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni ban ai bam ïa ka kada jong u , bad u lap ïa ka pisa jong u ha khlieh eh ka byrni .

translation.en: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba nga ong ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka Templ ,

translation.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord  ; and a fierce king shall rule over them , saith the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan aiti ïa ki nong Ijipt sha u nongsynshar lehbor , sha u syiem runar u ban synshar ïa ki . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .

translation.en: And he came to the ram that had two horns , which I had seen standing before the river , and ran unto him in the fury of his power .
translation.kha: U la wan sha u langbrot , uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng harud jong ka wah , bad u la mareh sha u da ka bor jong u baroh .

translation.en: Neither let us tempt Christ , as some of them also tempted , and were destroyed of serpents .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban tynjuh ïa U Trai , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad la pynïap ïa ki da ki bseiñ .

translation.en: Because they despised my judgments , and walked not in my statutes , but polluted my sabbaths : for their heart went after their idols .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular namar ba ki la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga , bad ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton — ki la kham jied ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work  ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it  ; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh ban pyndonkam ha kaba sngewthuh ïa ka mon jong U Blei . Shna ïa ka da kijuh ki tiar kiba la pyndonkam ha kaba suh ïa ka ephod , bad da kijuh ki jingsuh pynpur itynnat .

translation.en: Hath the rain a father ? or who hath begotten the drops of dew ?
translation.kha: Hato u slap lane ka umjer ki don u kpa ?

translation.en: But Festus , willing to do the Jews a pleasure , answered Paul , and said , Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem , and there be judged of these things before me ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Phestos u la kwah ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ki Jiw , kumta u la kylli ïa u Paul ,  Hato me mon ban leit sha Jerusalem ba yn bishar halor kine ki jingmudui ha khmat jong nga hangta ?

translation.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us , so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ .
translation.kha: Kumba ngi ïoh bynta na ki jingshah shitom babun jong U Khrist , kumta ruh , lyngba U Khrist , ngi ïoh bynta na kita ki jingïarap bakhraw jong U Blei .

translation.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God , a workman that needeth not to be ashamed , rightly dividing the word of truth .
translation.kha: To leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynksan ba-pura ha khmat U Blei , kum u nongtrei u bymlehraiñ ïa la ka kam , uta uba hikai beit ïa ka khubor jong ka jingshisha U Blei .

translation.en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , Who is this which speaketh blasphemies ? Who can forgive sins , but God alone ?
translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki ,  Uei une u briew uba kren kum kane ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei ! U Blei u long tang ma u hi uba lah ban map ïa ki pop !

translation.en: And he said unto the disciples ,  The days will come , when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man , and ye shall not see it .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran ,  Ka por kan poi ha kaba phin kwah ban ïohi ïa kawei na ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew , hynrei phin ym ïohi ïa ka .

translation.en: And he answered me and said , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
translation.kha: U la kylli ïa nga ,  Hato mem tip ?   Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah ,  nga la jubab .

translation.en: If then I do that which I would not , I consent unto the law that it is good .
translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba nga leh , ka dei kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka pyn-i ba nga ïamynjur ba ka Hukum ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: Now after two days he departed thence , and went into Galilee .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut ar sngi hangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh bad u la leit sha Galilaïa .

translation.en: I must work the works of him that sent me , while it is day : the night cometh , when no man can work .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang don ka sngi , ngi dei ban trei ïa ka kam jong uta uba la phah ïa nga ; ka miet ka wan haba ym don uba lah ban trei .

translation.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday  ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong me kan kham phyrnai ban ïa ka jingshai ka sngi ha ka por shiteng sngi , bad ki kynta ba-dum tam jong ka jingim kin phyrnai kum ka step phyrngab .

translation.en: He will surely reprove you , if ye do secretly accept persons .
translation.kha: Wat la ïa ka jingnoh shiliang la buhrieh , un pynrem ïa me ,

translation.en: And his miracles , and his acts , which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt , and unto all his land  ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi kumno u la leh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the  Lord  , and for the king s house , harps also and psalteries for singers : there came no such almug trees , nor were seen unto this day .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la pyndonkam ïa kine ki dieng ha kaba shna jingker ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ha kaba shna duitara bad jingtem ksai ïa ki nongput nongtem . Ki long ki dieng Kseh-Juniper kiba kynsai tam ïa kiba la wanrah sha Israel , ym don shuh kum kita ban dang lah ban ïohi biang . )

translation.en: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof : and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit .
translation.kha: Kaba kut jong kaei kaei ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsdang jong ka . Ka jingïaishah ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsarong .

translation.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance : praise him with stringed instruments and organs .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki ksing bad ka jingshad . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki tangmuri .

translation.en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad u la pan ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha ki synagog kiba ha Damaskos , khnang ba lada un lap ïano ïano hangta kiba bud ïa ka Lynti jong U Trai , un lah ban kem ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei bad wallam pat ïa ki sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar : I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons , to minister to me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong khuid ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa kata ka duwan , bad ngan pynkyrpang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And he made staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
translation.kha: U thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar ,

translation.en: Seek ye the  Lord  , all ye meek of the earth , which have wrought his judgment  ; seek righteousness , seek meekness : it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the  Lord s  anger .
translation.kha: To phai noh sha U  Trai  , phi baroh ki briew kiba sngewrit , kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . To leh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad to pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U  Trai . Lehse phin lait na ka jingpynshitom ha ka sngi haba U  Trai  u pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar jong u .

translation.en: And the boys grew : and Esau was a cunning hunter , a man of the field  ; and Jacob was a plain man , dwelling in tents .
translation.kha: Kita ki khynnah shynrang ki la nang san nang rangbah , bad u Iso u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit , u briew uba ieit ban shang lum shang wah , katba u Jakob pat u long u briew uba jar jar , uba shong tang ha ïing .

translation.en: Declare his glory among the heathen  ; his marvellous works among all nations .
translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka burom jong u ha ki jaitbynriew , ïa ki kam bakhrawbor ha ki briew .

translation.en: And say unto the Ammonites , Hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou saidst , Aha , against my sanctuary , when it was profaned  ; and against the land of Israel , when it was desolate  ; and against the house of Judah , when they went into captivity  ;
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ba kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Phi la ïasngewtynnat ban ïohi ba ïa ka Templ jong nga la pyntngit , ban ïohi ïa ka ri Israel la pynjot thiaw , ban ïohi ïa ki paid ka Judah ba ki shah ringmraw .

translation.en: But ye are not in the flesh , but in the Spirit , if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you . Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ , he is none of his .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim im kumba ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong phi ka ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , phi im kumba U Mynsiem u ong ïa phi ban leh — lada , shisha , U Mynsiem U Blei u don hapoh jong phi . Uno uno u bym don ïa U Mynsiem jong U Khrist , um long u jong u .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga

translation.en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath , so that the  Lord  was angry with you to have destroyed you .
translation.kha: Wat ha Lum Sinai ruh phi la pynbitar shla ïa U  Trai  kat haduh ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: And he shall dwell in that city , until he stand before the congregation for judgment , and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days : then shall the slayer return , and come unto his own city , and unto his own house , unto the city from whence he fled .
translation.kha: U lah ban sah ha ka nongbah haduh ban da bishar paidbah ïa u bad haduh ka jingïap jong u briew uba long u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kata ka por . Hadien kata , u lah ban leit phai pat sha ïing sha la ka shnong , na kaba u la phet ïap .

translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Bad balei ba phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U Blei bad phi bud ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai ?

translation.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar , and of the hazel and chesnut tree  ; and pilled white strakes in them , and made the white appear which was in the rods .
translation.kha: U Jakob u shim ïa ki tnat kiba dang im na ka dieng lieng , u diengsoh almond , bad u dieng Sning , bad u khoh snep ha katto katne jaka haduh ba ki tnat dieng kin da paw ka met lieh .

translation.en: And if Christ be in you , the body is dead because of sin ; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada U Khrist u im hapoh jong phi , U Mynsiem u long ka jingim na ka bynta jong phi namar la pynlong ka hok hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei .

translation.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa kane ka khleiñ bad un thang ha ka duwan ka jingkñia ainguh thang , kumba u ju leh ïa ka khleiñ na u mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ka jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: And he lifted up his face to the window , and said , Who is on my side ? who ? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs .
translation.kha: U Jehu u khmied shajrong bad u pyrta ,  Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga ?  Ar ne lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem ki peit sha u na ka jingkhangïit ,

translation.en: And , behold , two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus , which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , ar ngut na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki dang leit sha ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Emmaus , kumba khatwei kilomitar na Jerusalem ,

translation.en: Yet he sent prophets to them , to bring them again unto the  Lord   ; and they testified against them : but they would not give ear .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki ban phai pat sha u , hynrei ki paidbah ki kyntait ban shahshkor .

translation.en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed thee out of the house of servants  ; and I sent before thee Moses , Aaron , and Miriam .
translation.kha: Nga la wan ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ; nga la pyllait ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ; nga la phah ïa u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka Miriam ban ïalam ïa phi .

translation.en: Then David returned to bless his household . And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , How glorious was the king of Israel to day , who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself !
translation.kha: Hadien kata , haba u Dabid u la leit sha ïing ban khublei ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing , ka Mikhal ka wan mih ban ïakynduh ïa u .  U syiem ki Israel u la pynkhraw nam ïa lade ha kane ka sngi !  ka ong .  U la pynlyngkhuit ïa lade kum u bieit ha khmat ki shakri kynthei jong ki rangbah synshar jong u .

translation.en: What say I then ? that the idol is any thing , or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing ?
translation.kha: Hato nga thew , te , ba ka bleithaw ne ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ka , ka long ei ei ?

translation.en: Then David arose from the earth , and washed , and anointed himself , and changed his apparel , and came into the house of the  Lord  , and worshipped : then he came to his own house  ; and when he required , they set bread before him , and he did eat .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u khie joit na madan , u sum u sleh , u sad ïa la u shñiuh , bad u pli ïa la ki jaiñ . Nangta u la leit bad mane ha ka ïing U  Trai . Haba u la wan phai sha ka ïingsyiem ; u pan jingbam , bad u la bam ïa ka mar ïadep sam .

translation.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon : and they are come up from thence rejoicing , so that the city rang again . This is the noise that ye have heard .
translation.kha: Ki la pynshong ïa u halor u khashor jong u syiem , bad u Sadok bad u Nathan ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem ha ka Umpohliew Gihon . Nangta ki la leit sha ka nongbah , ki risa da ka jingkmen , bad ki paidbah mynta ki don ha ka jingkhihwin . Kata ka dei ka jingsawa kaba phi dang shu ïohsngew .

translation.en: And if a man purchase of the Levites , then the house that was sold , and the city of his possession , shall go out in the year of jubilee : for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Lada ïa ka ïing ha kawei na kine ki shnong la die da kiba na ka jait Lebi bad ym shym thied pat ïa ka , dei ban pynphai pat ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat , namar ki ïing jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi kiba don ha kita ki shnong jong ki , ki dei ki jingïohkynti jong ki hapdeng ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And these are they which are sown on good ground  ; such as hear the word , and receive it , and bring forth fruit , some thirtyfold , some sixty , and some an hundred .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba bha . Ki ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka , bad ki seisoh : katto katne laiphew , katto katne hynriewphew , bad katto katne shispah .

translation.en: Thou art thy mother s daughter , that lotheth her husband and her children  ; and thou art the sister of thy sisters , which lothed their husbands and their children : your mother was an Hittite , and your father an Amorite .
translation.kha: Pha long shisha ka khun jong ka kmie jong pha . Ka la isih jur ïa u tnga jong ka bad ïa ki khun jong ka . Pha long kum ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha , kiba la isih ïa la ki tnga bad ïa la ki khun . Ma pha bad ki nongbah kiba shi para bad pha , phi la don ka kmie ka nong Hit bad u kpa u nong Amor .

translation.en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation , and for the altar of the  Lord  , even unto this day , in the place which he should choose .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kajuh ka por u la pynlong mraw ïa ki ban thoh dieng bad kit um ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa ka duwan U  Trai . Haduh kane ka sngi ki la ïai bteng ïa kane ka kam ha ka jaka kaba u Trai u la jied ban mane ïa u .

translation.en: And he shall judge among the nations , and shall rebuke many people : and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
translation.kha: Un bishar ïa ki jingkajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew . Kin tied tyrnem ïa ki waitlam jong ki sha ki jinglur lyngkha bad ïa ki sum jong ki sha ki waitbnoh khyllad tnat . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh thma shuh .

translation.en: Wherefore I say unto you , All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men : but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohmap ïa kano kano ka pop bad ïa kano kano kaba sniew kaba ki ong ; hynrei uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap .

translation.en: Cretans and Arabians , we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God .
translation.kha: ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba la kylla sha ka niam Jiw , bad katto katne ngut na ngi , ngi dei na Krit bad na Arabia — pynban baroh na ngi , ngi ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien jong ngi shaphang kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U Blei u la leh !

translation.en: As when the melting fire burneth , the fire causeth the waters to boil , to make thy name known to thine adversaries , that the nations may tremble at thy presence !
translation.kha: Kin khynñiuh kum ka um ba dang shet halor ka ding kaba khluit . Ale bad pynpaw ïa ka bor jong me ha ki nongshun jong me , bad pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban khynñiuh ha khmat jong me !

translation.en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot , Jonathan cried after the lad , and said , Is not the arrow beyond thee ?
translation.kha: Haba uta u khynnah u poi ha ka jaka ba uta u khnam u la hap , u Jonathan u pyrta ïa u ,  U khnam u don kham sha jngai na phi !

translation.en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough , and followed Abimelech , and put them to the hold , and set the hold on fire upon them  ; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also , about a thousand men and women .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u pom mar kawei ka tnat dieng , nangta ki la bud ïa u Abimelekh bad ki kynton shajrong ïa ki dieng pyrshah ïa ka kut baskhem . Ki wiang ding ïa ka , lem bad ïa ki briew hapoh jong ka , bad baroh ki briew jong kata ka kut ki la ïap — kumba shihajar ngut ki shynrang bad kynthei .

translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Arise , get thee down unto the host  ; for I have delivered it into thine hand .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Gideon ,  Khie joit bad tur ïaleh ïa kata ka jaka sher dara ; nga ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong ka .

translation.en: And that which they have need of , both young bullocks , and rams , and lambs , for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven , wheat , salt , wine , and oil , according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem , let it be given them day by day without fail :
translation.kha: Man ka sngi , khlem pep , phi dei ban ai ïa ki lyngdoh ha Jerusalem ïa kaei kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ba ki donkam : ki masi lyngraw , ki langbrot , lane ki khunlangbrot ban kñia kum ki jingainguh sha U Blei jong ka Bneng , lane u kew , ka mluh , ka waiñ , lane ka umphniang Olib .

translation.en: Let Israel now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki paid Israel kin ong ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , No  ; but we will bind thee fast , and deliver thee into their hand : but surely we will not kill thee . And they bound him with two new cords , and brought him up from the rock .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , to  ki ong ,  ngin shu teh ïa me bad aiti ïa me ha ki . Ngin ym pynïap ïa me .  Kumta ki khum ïa u da ar tylli ki tyllai thymmai bad ki wanrah ïa u na kata ka krem .

translation.en: For whom he did foreknow , he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brethren .
translation.kha: Kito ïa kiba U Blei u la lah jied lypa u la pynkyrpang ruh ban long kum U Khun jong u , khnang ba U Khun un long uba nyngkong hapdeng ki para .

translation.en: Two tenons shall there be in one board , set in order one against another : thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: bad ar tylli ki tnaw kiba ïabiang khnang ba yn lah ban pyndait lang ïa kita ki jingker . Baroh kita ki jingker ki dei ban don ïa kine ki tnaw .

translation.en: But as for you , your carcases , they shall fall in this wilderness .
translation.kha: Phi , phin ïap ha kane ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion ? or fill the appetite of the young lions ,
translation.kha: Hato me wad jingbam na ka bynta ki sing ban bam , bad pynhun ïa ki sing samla kiba thngan ,

translation.en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest  ; because it did not rest in your sabbaths , when ye dwelt upon it .
translation.kha: Te ka ri kan ïoh lehkmen ha ki snem ka jingshongthait kaba pura ha kaba phin ym ai ei ei ïa ka ; kan long kaba la iehnoh bad kan ïoh shongthait , katba phi dang don ha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be multiplied and increased in the land , in those days , saith the  Lord  , they shall say no more , The ark of the covenant of the  Lord  : neither shall it come to mind : neither shall they remember it  ; neither shall they visit it  ; neither shall that be done any more .
translation.kha: Nangta haba phi la ïaroi bun ha kata ka ri , ki briew kin ym ïakren shuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang jong nga . Kin ym pyrkhat shuh shaphang jong ka lane kynmaw ïa ka ; kin ym donkam shuh ïa ka , lymne kin ym shna sa kawei pat .

translation.en: For then the king of Babylon s army besieged Jerusalem : and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison , which was in the king of Judah s house .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem , bad ïa nga la set ha ka phyllaw ba la kerkut jong ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: I robbed other churches , taking wages of them , to do you service .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang trei hapdeng jong phi , la siew ïa nga da kiwei pat ki balang . Kum ban shu ong noh , nga la lute na ki khnang ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duna ka jingtip ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ka jingbieit jong ki ka dei ban ïoh , hynrei ha kiba sian la ainong da ka jingtip .

translation.en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword  ; and they shall have none to bury them , them , their wives , nor their sons , nor their daughters : for I will pour their wickedness upon them .
translation.kha: Ki briew ha kiba ki la kren ïa kine kiei kiei kin ïap ha kajuh ka rukom . Ïa ki met jong ki yn bret shabar ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , bad yn ym don mano mano ban tep ïa ki . Kane kan jia ha ki baroh — kynthup ïa ki tnga jong ki , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki . Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki .

translation.en: Also in time past , when Saul was king over us , thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the  Lord  said to thee , Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be a captain over Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba la leit , wat haba u Saul u dang long u syiem jong ngi , phi la ïalam ïa ki rangbah Israel ha ka thma bad U  Trai  u la kular ïa phi ba phin ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad ban long u nongsynshar jong ki .

translation.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ki atiar jong u ha kawei na ki templ jong ki bad wah ïa ka khlieh jong u ha ka templ jong u Dagon u blei jong ki .

translation.en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh , and might save some of them .
translation.kha: Lehse , nga lah ban pynlong ïa ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong nga hi ban sngewbishni , ba kumta yn lah ban pynim katto katne na ki .

translation.en: After my words they spake not again  ; and my speech dropped upon them .
translation.kha: kim don ei ei shuh ban ai jingmut haba nga la dep kren . Ki ktien jong nga ki ngam kum ki jingjaw jong u slap ;

translation.en: And a third part shall be at the king s house  ; and a third part at the gate of the foundation : and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: sa shi bynta kin ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa kiba sah yn buh ha ka Khyrdop Nongrim . Ki briew baroh kin ïalumlang ha ki phyllaw ka Templ .

translation.en: Have I need of mad men , that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence ? shall this fellow come into my house ?
