translation.kha: Hato ngam shym la don lypa bun bah ki lamwir ? Balei phi wan ïalam sa uwei pat ban pynwit ïa nga da ki jingleh lamwir jong u hangne ha ka ïing jong nga ?

translation.en: Kiss the Son , lest he be angry , and ye perish from the way , when his wrath is kindled but a little . Blessed are all they that put their trust in him .
translation.kha: to khynñiuh bad to nguh dem ïa u , lym kumta ïa ka jingbitar jong u yn pynkhie kynsan , bad phin ïap kyndit . Suk kita baroh kiba leit sha u ban ïoh ka jingïada .

translation.en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him , Their gods are gods of the hills  ; therefore they were stronger than we  ; but let us fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem Benhadad ki ong ha u ,  Ki blei jong ki Israel ki dei ki blei lum , bad dei na kata ka daw ba ki Israel ki jop ïa ngi . Hynrei ngin sa jop khlem pep ïa ki lada ngi ïaleh ïa ki ha ki jaka madan .

translation.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine : but a broken spirit drieth the bones .
translation.kha: Kaba dap da ka jingkmen ka pynlong ïa phi ban shait ban khlaiñ . Ban sngewdiaw man ka por ka long ka jingïap suki pa suki .

translation.en: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year , which is the year of tithing , and hast given it unto the Levite , the stranger , the fatherless , and the widow , that they may eat within thy gates , and be filled  ;
translation.kha: Shisien man ka lai snem , ai kawei-na-kaba-shiphew — kaba shiphew na ki jingthung jong phi — ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba ha man la ka shnong kin ïoh bam kdang . Haba phi la leh ïa kane ,

translation.en: And they answered , John the Baptist : but some say , Elias  ; and others , One of the prophets .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me long u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab ;  kiwei pat ki ong ba me long u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee , leave not thy place  ; for yielding pacifieth great offences .
translation.kha: Lada u nongsynshar jong phi u bitar ïa phi , wat nym ai ïa ka jingiehnoh kam jong phi ; ïa ki jingbakla kiba khia lah ban map lada phi long jai jai .

translation.en: And there came a certain poor widow , and she threw in two mites , which make a farthing .
translation.kha: nangta , ka riewkynthei ka wan bad ka la noh ar tylli ki sbai tama , kiba shongdor kumba shi pisa .

translation.en: They break in pieces thy people , O  Lord  , and afflict thine heritage .
translation.kha: Ki pynlwet ïa ki briew jong me , A  Trai  ; ki banbeiñ ïa kito kiba long ki jong me .

translation.en: Though they dig into hell , thence shall mine hand take them  ; though they climb up to heaven , thence will I bring them down :
translation.kha: Wat lada ki tih ïa ka lynti jong ki shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan kem ïa ki . Wat lada ki kiew sha bneng , ngan patan ïa ki shapoh .

translation.en: Yet a little while , and the world seeth me no more  ; but ye see me : because I live , ye shall live also .
translation.kha: Sa tang shipor ka pyrthei kan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , hynrei phin ïohi ïa nga ; bad namar ba nga im , phi ruh phin ïoh im .

translation.en: The princes refrained talking , and laid their hand on their mouth .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong u paidbah kin sangeh noh na kaba kren ;

translation.en: For thou art my lamp , O  Lord  : and the  Lord  will lighten my darkness .
translation.kha: Ma me , ko  Trai  , me long ka jingshai jong nga , me beh noh ïa ka jingdum jong nga .

translation.en: And he gave heed unto them , expecting to receive something of them .
translation.kha: Kumta u la peit sha ki , da ka jingkhmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei na ki .

translation.en: Truly the light is sweet , and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun :
translation.kha: Ka long kaba bha ba yn lah ban lehkmen ïa ka jingshai itynnat jong ka sngi .

translation.en: Hear this word that the  Lord  hath spoken against you , O children of Israel , against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt , saying ,
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to sngew ïa kane ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la kren shaphang jong phi , ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei kaba u la wan ïalam na ka ri Ijipt ;

translation.en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken : they shall be for flocks , which shall lie down , and none shall make them afraid .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Syria yn sa iehnoh junom . Kin long ka jaka pynbamphlang ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi , bad ym don mano mano ba beh noh ïa ki .

translation.en: Ain , Rimmon , and Ether , and Ashan  ; four cities and their villages :
translation.kha: La don ruh ka Ain , ka Rimmon , ka Ether , bad ka Ashan : saw tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: And Mary said , My soul doth magnify the Lord ,
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la ong ,  Ka dohnud jong nga ka ïaroh ïa U Trai ;

translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it , and hath cast out many nations before thee , the Hittites , and the Girgashites , and the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , seven nations greater and mightier than thou  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un wan ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , bad un beh noh nangta ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , un beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki jaitbynriew kiba kham bun paid bad kham khrawbor ban ïa phi . Kita ki dei ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: And the next day we that were of Paul s company departed , and came unto Caesarea : and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist , which was one of the seven  ; and abode with him .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la poi ha Kaisaria . Hangta ngi la sah ha ka ïing jong u Philip u ebanjelist , uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba la jied kum ki nongïarap ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: A fool despiseth his father s instruction : but he that regardeth reproof is prudent .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba ibieit ban ym suidñiew ïa kaei kaba ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ki hikai ; ka long kaba jingstad ban pdiang ïa ka jingsneng jong ki .

translation.en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David . And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid bad u Jehoram u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: What is man , that thou shouldest magnify him ? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him ?
translation.kha: Balei ki briew ki long kiba donkam ha me ? Balei me da peit bniah ïa kaei ba ki leh ?

translation.en: And he charged them , saying ,  Take heed , beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , and of the leaven of Herod .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ,  U Jisu u la maham ïa ki ,  bad sumar ïa lade na u thiat jong ki Pharisi bad u thiat jong u Herod .

translation.en: Then Samuel said unto Saul , Stay , and I will tell thee what the  Lord  hath said to me this night . And he said unto him , Say on .
translation.kha: Sangeh !  u Samuel u hukum ,  bad ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha nga hynne mynmiet .   Ïathuh ïa nga ,  ong u Saul .

translation.en: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth , to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus , called to be saints , with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord , both theirs and ours :
translation.kha: Sha ka balang U Blei kaba ha Korinth , ha kito baroh kiba la khot ban long ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei , kiba dei ki jong u ha U Khrist Jisu , lem bad ki briew baroh kylleng kiba mane ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , uba long U Trai jong ki ruh :

translation.en: The  Lord  judge between me and thee , and the  Lord  avenge me of thee : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un bishar mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi ! To un pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingleh jong phi pyrshah ïa nga , naba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi da lei lei ruh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the vessels were full , that she said unto her son , Bring me yet a vessel . And he said unto her , There is not a vessel more . And the oil stayed .
translation.kha: Haba ki la pyndap ïa kita ki khra baroh , ka la kylli la dang don shuh ne em .  Uto u dei uba khatduh ,  uwei na ki khun shynrang jong ka u jubab . Bad ka umphniang Olib ka la sangeh ban tuid .

translation.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God , that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins :
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngdoh la jied napdeng ki parabriew , bad la thung ban shakri ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong ki , ban ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ka jingainguh na ka bynta ki pop .

translation.en: I shall not die , but live , and declare the works of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ym ïap ; hynrei ngan im bad ngan pynbna ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh .

translation.en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh  ; and they shall be drunken with their own blood , as with sweet wine : and all flesh shall know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa kiba banbeiñ ïa pha ban ïa-pynïap para ma ki ; kin shu buaid ha kaba pynïap briew bad ha ka jingbitar . Nangta u bynriew baroh un tip ba nga long U  Trai  , uta uba pynim ïa pha bad uba pyllaitluid ïa pha . Kin tip ba nga long U Blei bakhlaiñbor jong ki Israel .

translation.en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour , that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long ki mraw ki dei ban ñiew ba ki kynrad jong ki , ki long kiba dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka burom baroh , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ki ban kren sniew ïa ka kyrteng U Blei bad ïa ka jinghikai jong ngi .

translation.en: Behold , at that time I will undo all that afflict thee : and I will save her that halteth , and gather her that was driven out  ; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan pynshitom ïa ki nongbanbeiñ jong pha ; ngan pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dkoh bad ngan wallam sha ïing ïa kiba shah ringmraw . Ngan pynphai ïa ka jinglehrain jong ki sha ka jingdonburom , bad baroh ka pyrthei kan ïaroh ïa ki .

translation.en: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body , that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof .
translation.kha: Ka pop kam dei shuh ban synshar ïa ki met ki jong phi , da kaba pynkohnguh sha ki jingkwah jong ka jinglong tynrai jong phi .

translation.en: Egypt , and Judah , and Edom , and the children of Ammon , and Moab , and all that are in the utmost corners , that dwell in the wilderness : for all these nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew ka Ijipt , ka Judah , ka Edom , ka Ammon , ka Moab , bad ki briew ka ri shyiap , kiba la ot lyngkot ïa ki shñiuh jong ki . Kine ki briew baroh ki long kiba la otsher , hynrei ki bym shym la bat ïa ka jutang kaba ka thmu . Ym don mano mano na kine ki briew bad ym don mano mano na ki paid Israel kiba la bat ïa kane ka jutang jong nga .

translation.en: I have yet many things to say unto you , but ye cannot bear them now .
translation.kha: Nga dang don shibun kiei kiei ban ong ha phi , hynrei mynta kan long palat eh ïa phi ban shah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people , as he hath promised thee , and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi U  Trai  u la pdiang ïa phi kum la ki jong ki briew , kumba u la kular ïa phi ; bad u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakren bad ïasaidnia , U Jisu hi u la leit hajan bad u la ïaid lem bad ki ;

translation.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan , which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei , who remained of the remnant of the giants : for these did Moses smite , and cast them out .
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka hima jong u Og , uba khatduh jong ki Rephaim , uba la synshar ha Ashtaroth bad Edrei . U Moses u la jop ïa kine ki briew bad u la beh noh ïa ki .

translation.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house , that my name may be there for ever : and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
translation.kha: namar nga la jied ïa ka bad nga la pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan khmih halor jong ka bad ïada ïa ka ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: And the king of the south shall be strong , and one of his princes  ; and he shall be strong above him , and have dominion  ; his dominion shall be a great dominion .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Ijipt un long uba khlaiñ . Hynrei , uwei na ki nongïalam shipai jong u un kham khraw bad un synshar ïa ka hima kaba kham khraw .

translation.en: And he said ,  So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ka Hima U Blei ka ong kumne . U briew u bet symbai ha la ka lyngkha .

translation.en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country  ; and the white go forth after them  ; and the grisled go forth toward the south country .
translation.kha: Ka kali ïapom ba la tan da ki kulai rong ïong ka la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia , ki kulai rong lieh ki leit shaphang sepngi , bad ki kulai thohbroin ki leit sha ka ri bashathie .

translation.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga , they went down into Attalia :
translation.kha: Hangta ki la ïalap ïa ka khubor ha Perga bad nangta ki la leit sha Attalia ,

translation.en: She hath sent forth her maidens : she crieth upon the highest places of the city ,
translation.kha: Ka la phah ïa la ki shakri kynthei ban pyrta na ka jaka kaba jrong tam ha kata ka nongbah :

translation.en: And his breath , as an overflowing stream , shall reach to the midst of the neck , to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity : and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people , causing them to err .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka lyer ha shuwa jong u kum ka jingshlei kaba kit lut ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ka sar ïa ki hima sha ka jingjot bad u pynkut ïa ki jingthmu basniew jong ki .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the  Lord  out of heaven  ;
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , U  Trai  u pynhap ïa u kyndok ding ha ki nongbah Sodom bad Gomorrah ,

translation.en: ( For after all these things do the Gentiles seek : ) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things .
translation.kha: ( Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba ki nongmane blei thala ki ju ïai pyrkhat borabor . ) U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u tip ba phi donkam ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: But he turned , and rebuked them , and said ,  Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai bad u la dumok ïa ki bad u la ong ,  Phim tip phi dei na u jait Mynsiem aïu ; naba U Khun U Briew um shym la wan ban pynjot ïa ka jingim jong ki briew , hynrei ban pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: And the hand of the  Lord  was there upon me  ; and he said unto me , Arise , go forth into the plain , and I will there talk with thee .
translation.kha: Te nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  bad nga la ïohsngew ba u ong ha nga ,  Ïeng joit bad leit sha ka them . Ngan sa ïakren bad me hangta .

translation.en: And an highway shall be there , and a way , and it shall be called The way of holiness  ; the unclean shall not pass over it  ; but it shall be for those : the wayfaring men , though fools , shall not err therein .
translation.kha: Kan long ka lynti bah hangta , ba la khot  Ka Lynti jong ka Jingkhuid .  Yn ym don nongpop u ban ïaid ha kata ka lynti ; ym don ki riewbieit ki ban ïalam bakla ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka .

translation.en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool , and troubled the water : whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had .
translation.kha: Ki da ap ïa ka jingkhih jong ka um , namar u angel U Trai hateng hateng u ju hiar sha kata ka pungsum ban pynkhih ïa ka um . Ïa u nongpang uba nyngkong uba hiar ha ka pungsum hadien ba la pynkhih ïa ka um la pynkhiah na kano kano ka jingpang kaba u don .

translation.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , as an error which proceedeth from the ruler :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbymlehhok kaba jia ha ka pyrthei — ka jingbymlehhok kaba la pynlong da ki nongsynshar .

translation.en: And Saul also went home to Gibeah  ; and there went with him a band of men , whose hearts God had touched .
translation.kha: U Saul ruh u leit phai sha la ïing ha Gibeah . Katto katne ki rangbah kiba khlaiñ ryngkat bad ki nongïapom kiba U Blei u la ktah ïa ki dohnud jong ki , ki la leit lang bad u .

translation.en: Against whom when the accusers stood up , they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed :
translation.kha: Ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa u ki la ïeng , hynrei kim shym mudui ïa u ïa kano kano na ki kam runar kiba nga la pyrkhat ba kin leh .

translation.en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels  ; and then he shall reward every man according to his works .
translation.kha: Naba U Khun U Briew u la jan wan ha ka burom jong U Kpa jong u lem bad la ki angel , bad nangta un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ki kam jong u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto you out of the midst of the fire : ye heard the voice of the words , but saw no similitude  ; only ye heard a voice .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki kumno U  Trai  u la kren ha phi na kata ka ding , kumno phi la ïohsngew ba u kren hynrei phim shym la ïohi satia ïa ka dur jong u .

translation.en: And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba u syiem Baalis jong ki Ammon u la phah ïa u Ishmael ban pynïap ïa phi ?  Hynrei u Gedalaïah um shym ngeit ïa kata .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not see wind , neither shall ye see rain  ; yet that valley shall be filled with water , that ye may drink , both ye , and your cattle , and your beasts .
translation.kha: Wat la phim ïohi ïa uno uno u slap lane ïa ka lyer , yn sa pyndap ïa kane ka phud um da ka um , bad ma phi , ki jingri jong phi , bad ki kynhun mrad jong phi kin ïoh kyrhai ban dih .’

translation.en: A bruised reed shall he not break , and the smoking flax shall he not quench : he shall bring forth judgment unto truth .
translation.kha: Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u khah ba la dem un ym pynlip ïa ka sharak ba dang mehding , un wanrah ka jingbishar hok baneh ïa baroh .

translation.en: Consider what I say ; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things .
translation.kha: To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba nga ong , namar U Trai un pynlah ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka baroh .

translation.en: When thou passest through the waters , I will be with thee  ; and through the rivers , they shall not overflow thee : when thou walkest through the fire , thou shalt not be burned  ; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaid lyngba ïa ki um bajylliew , ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ki jingeh kin ym tyllep ïa phi . Haba phi ïaid lyngba ka ding , phin ym ing ; ki jingtynjuh ba-eh kiba wan kin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold : three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield . And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
translation.kha: bad laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba lai kilo . U phah buh ïa ki baroh ha ka Kamra Heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon   .

translation.en: Before their face the people shall be much pained : all faces shall gather blackness .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan , uwei pa uwei u sngewshyrkhei ; kawei pa kawei ka durkhmat ka kylla blad .

translation.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good : but evil came down from the  Lord  unto the gate of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Maroth ki ap da ka jinglyng-a ïa ka jingïarap , namar ba U  Trai  u la wallam ïa ka jingjot sha jan ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries : which is to them an evident token of perdition , but to you of salvation , and that of God .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong phi ; long borabor kiba shlur , bad kane hi kan pynshisha ha ki , ba kin shah rem bad ba phin jop , namar dei U Blei uba ai ïa phi ka jingjop .

translation.en: Yea , behold , being planted , shall it prosper ? shall it not utterly wither , when the east wind toucheth it ? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew .
translation.kha: Ho-oid la thung ïa ka , hynrei hato kan im bad san ? Hato kan ym ïapstai haba ka lyer mihngi ka shoh ïa ka ? Hato kan ym ïapstai hangta ha kaba ka san ?

translation.en: That thou appear not unto men to fast , but unto thy Father which is in secret : and thy Father , which seeth in secret , shall reward thee openly .
translation.kha: khnang ba kiwei kin ym tip ba phi shahjingit — tang U Kpa jong phi , ïa uba ym lah ban ïohi , un tip . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .

translation.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father s house , the priests that were in Nob : and they came all of them to the king .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Saul u phah khot ïa u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , kiba la long ruh ki lyngdoh ha Nob , bad ki la ïawan sha u .

translation.en: And did all drink the same spiritual drink : for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them : and that Rock was Christ .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam ïa ujuh u kpu ba kynja mynsiem bad ki la dih ïa kajuh ka jingdih ba kynja mynsiem . Ki la dih na uta u mawsiang ba kynja mynsiem ba la leit lem bad ki ; bad uta u mawsiang u la long U Khrist hi .

translation.en: And they shall build the old wastes , they shall raise up the former desolations , and they shall repair the waste cities , the desolations of many generations .
translation.kha: Kin tei pat ïa ki nongbah ba la jot la pra .

translation.en: Go and tell David my servant , Thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :
translation.kha: Leit bad ïathuh ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga ong ha u , ‘ Mem dei uta u ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan shong .

translation.en: And they shall not come near unto me , to do the office of a priest unto me , nor to come near to any of my holy things , in the most holy place : but they shall bear their shame , and their abominations which they have committed .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh lane leit hajan kano kano kaba khuid ïa nga lane ban rung shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam . Kane ka dei ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies : thou shalt go out one way against them , and flee seven ways before them : and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shah ba ki nongshun kin jop ïa phi . Phin tur pyrshah ïa ki na kawei ka dong , hynrei phin sa her ïap na kiba bun ki dong , bad ki briew ka pyrthei kin sngewsheptieng haba ki ïohi aïu ka jia ïa phi .

translation.en: And when he had spent all , there arose a mighty famine in that land  ; and he began to be in want .
translation.kha: U la pynlut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u don . Nangta ka  nemsniew kaba jur ka la saphriang kylleng jong kata ka ri , bad um don ei ei shuh .

translation.en: He that saith he is in the light , and hateth his brother , is in darkness even until now .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ong ba u don ha ka jingshai , pynban u isih ïa la u hynmen u para , u don ha ka jingdum haduh kane hi ka kynta .

translation.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father  ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .
translation.kha: Ngam lah ban kren bad phi kham slem , namar u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei un wan . Um donbor halor jong nga , hynrei , ka pyrthei ka dei ban tip ba nga ieit ïa U Kpa ; na kata ka daw balei ba nga leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u hukum ïa nga .  Ale , ïa ngin ïaleit noh na kane ka jaka .

translation.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him : and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind , with chariots , and with horsemen , and with many ships  ; and he shall enter into the countries , and shall overflow and pass over .
translation.kha: Haba ka kynta kaba khatduh jong u syiem ka Syria ka la jan wan artat , u syiem ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa u , bad u syiem ka Syria un ïaleh pyrshah da la ka bor baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ki liengbah kiba bun . Un hiarthma ïa kiba bun ki ri , kum ka jingshlei ki um .

translation.en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe , as the hole of an habergeon , with a band round about the hole , that it should not rend .
translation.kha: Ïa ka thliew ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh la suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong khnang ba kan ym kad .

translation.en: O sing unto the  Lord  a new song : sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth .
translation.kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai ! To rwai ha U  Trai  , ko phi ka pyrthei baroh !

translation.en: And all Judah stood before the  Lord  , with their little ones , their wives , and their children .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , ryngkat bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam , and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel , and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ngan pynhap ïa ka jingjynjar ha ka longïing syiem jong me bad ngan pynïap ïa ki khun ki ksiew shynrang baroh , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh . Ngan pynduh khoit ïa ka longïing jong me ; kumba sar lut ïa ka jakhlia .

translation.en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul : and when Saul saw any strong man , or any valiant man , he took him unto him .
translation.kha: Katba u dang im , u Saul u hap ban ïaleh tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Philistia . Kumta , man ka por ba u lap ïa u briew uba khlaiñ lane uba shlur , u ju pynrung ïa u ha ka kynhun ïapom jong u .

translation.en: And we said unto my lord , We have a father , an old man , and a child of his old age , a little one  ; and his brother is dead , and he alone is left of his mother , and his father loveth him .
translation.kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngi dang don i pa iba la tymmen , bad sa uwei u para uba la kha ha ka jinglong tymmen jong i . U hynmen jong u khynnah , u la ïap , bad na ki khun ka kmie jong u , dei sa tang ma u uba dang im ; i pa ruh i da ieit thep mynsiem ïa u .’

translation.en: Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him ,  Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now  ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .
translation.kha: Ko Trai , shano men leit ?  u Petros u la kylli ïa u .  Mem lah ban bud ïa nga mynta shano sha ba ngan sa leit ,  U Jisu u la jubab ;  hynrei hadien men sa bud ïa nga .

translation.en: And the Egyptians evil entreated us , and afflicted us , and laid upon us hard bondage :
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki lehbeiñ ïa ngi bad pyntrei jubor ïa ngi kum ki mraw .

translation.en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the king s hand .
translation.kha: Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh .  Leit kiew pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth , bad phin jop ,  ki ong .  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ka jingjop .

translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , the prophets say unto them , Ye shall not see the sword , neither shall ye have famine  ; but I will give you assured peace in this place .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga tip ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa ki briew ba yn ym don ka thma kane ka jingïapthngan , namar me la kular , ki ong , ba kan don tang ka jingsuk ha ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: What is the time now ?
translation.kha: Katno baje mynta ?

translation.en: And Uriah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus : so Uriah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus .
translation.kha: Kumta u Uriah u thaw ïa ka duwan thik kum kata , bad u pyndep ïa ka shuwa ba u Ahas un wan phai .

translation.en: The king shall mourn , and the prince shall be clothed with desolation , and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled : I will do unto them after their way , and according to their deserts will I judge them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem un ïam pangnud , u khun syiem un duh jingkyrmen , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ngan pynshitom ïa phi na ka bynta baroh kaba phi la leh , bad ngan bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi la bishar ïa kiwei . Kane kan pyn-i ha phi ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Ask ye of the  Lord  rain in the time of the latter rain  ; so the  Lord  shall make bright clouds , and give them showers of rain , to every one grass in the field .
translation.kha: To pan na U  Trai  ïa u slap ha ka pyrem jong ka snem . U dei U  Trai  uba phah ïa ki lyoh slap bad ïa u  lap praw , da kaba pynjyrngam ïa ki lyngkha na ka bynta uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: And he made his grave with the wicked , and with the rich in his death  ; because he had done no violence , neither was any deceit in his mouth .
translation.kha: La buh ïa u ha ka jingtep lem bad ki bymman , la tep ïa u bad kiba riewspah , wat la um shym la leh kano kano ka kam bymman lane um shym la shukor ïano ïano .

translation.en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Jakob , ka jutang ka ban neh junom .

translation.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone , thou shalt not build it of hewn stone : for if thou lift up thy tool upon it , thou hast polluted it .
translation.kha: Lada phi tei ïa nga ka duwan kaba da u maw , wat tei ïa ka da ki maw ba la shniah , namar lada phi pyndei nar ha kita ki maw , kim long kiba bit ba ngan pyndonkam .

translation.en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand : also they saw God , and did eat and drink .
translation.kha: U Blei um shym pynmynsaw ïa kine ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki Israel ; ki la ïohi ïa U Blei , bad hadien kata ki la ïabam bad ïadih .

translation.en: Therefore David ran , and stood upon the Philistine , and took his sword , and drew it out of the sheath thereof , and slew him , and cut off his head therewith . And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead , they fled .
translation.kha: U mareh sha u , u ïeng halor jong u , u sei ïa ka waitlam u Goliath na ka jingsop jong ka , bad u ot ïa ka khlieh jong u bad u pynïap ïa u . Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ba u rangkynsai jong ki u la shah pynïap , ki phet krad .

translation.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand , and all their earrings which were in their ears  ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ai ha u Jakob ïa kita ki blei nongwei baroh kiba ki don , bad ruh ïa ki sohshkor ba ki deng . U Jakob u buhrieh ïa ki ha trai u dieng Sning hajan Shekhem .

translation.en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham , to thee , and to thy seed with thee  ; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger , which God gave unto Abraham .
translation.kha: To un kyrkhu ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me kumba u la kyrkhu ïa u Abraham , bad ai ba men shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ha kaba me la shong la sah bad ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham !

translation.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it .
translation.kha: U Shaphan u ai ïa ka hukum syiem ha u Hilkaïah bad u Hilkaïah u ïathuh ïa u ba u la shem ïa ka Kitab ka hukum ha ka Templ . U Hilkaïah u la ai ha u ïa ka Kitab , bad u Shaphan u pule ïa ka .

translation.en: Ephraim , as I saw Tyre , is planted in a pleasant place : but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki khun jong ki ba ki shah beh kthong bad shah pynïap .

translation.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord ? for as for me , straightway there remained no strength in me , neither is there breath left in me .
translation.kha: Nga long kum u mraw uba ïeng ha khmat u kynrad jong u . Kumno nga lah ban ïakren bad phi ? Ngam donbor lane jingpynhiar mynsiem kaba dang sah ha nga .

translation.en: And he received the sign of circumcision , a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised : that he might be the father of all them that believe , though they be not circumcised ; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also :
translation.kha: Ïa u la otsher hadien , bad ka jingotsher ïa u ka la long ka dak ban pyn-i ba namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok shuwa ban otsher ïa u . Bad kumta u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong baroh kiba ngeit ha U Blei bad ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok da u , wat la ïa ki ym shym la otsher .

translation.en: Why don't you like me ?
translation.kha: Balei phim sngewtynnad ianga ?

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury  ; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger , and great hailstones in my fury to consume it .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan phah ïa ka lyer bajur , u slap bajur , bad u phria ban pynjot ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: Then the king made Daniel a great man , and gave him many great gifts , and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon , and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon .
translation.kha: Te u la ai ha u Daniel ka kyrdan kaba halor , u la ai sngewbha ïa u da ki jingai kiba kynsai tam , u la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa ka probins    jong ka Babilon , bad u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh jong baroh ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And had taken the women captives , that were therein : they slew not any , either great or small , but carried them away , and went on their way .
translation.kha: bad ki la ringmraw ïa ki kynthei baroh ; kim shym la pynïap ïano ïano , hynrei ki la rah noh lem bad ki haba ki leit noh .

translation.en: And Jonathan called David , and Jonathan shewed him all those things . And Jonathan brought David to Saul , and he was in his presence , as in times past .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jonathan u khot ïa u Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kita baroh ; nangta u ïalam ïa u sha u Saul , bad u Dabid u shakri ïa u syiem kumba u ju leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: Deliver me , I pray thee , from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau : for I fear him , lest he will come and smite me , and the mother with the children .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ba men pyllait ïa nga na ka kti u Iso u hynmen jong nga . Nga sheptieng — sheptieng ba u wan ban ïaleh bad pynïap lut ïa ngi baroh , wat ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh .

translation.en: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel , and an hundred of a thousand , and a thousand out of ten thousand , to fetch victual for the people , that they may do , when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin , according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha Israel kin wanrah jingbam ïa ka kynhun shipai , bad kiwei pat kin leit ban pynshitom ïa ka Gibeah namar kane ka kam khlemrain ba ki la leh ha Israel .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Ask counsel , we pray thee , of God , that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Sngewbha kylli na U Blei la ngin shem bha ne em ha kane ka jingleit jong ngi .

translation.en: As the truth of Christ is in me , no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia .
translation.kha: Da ka jingshisha U Khrist kaba don ha nga , nga kular ba ïa kane ka jingsngew sarong jong nga yn ym pynsngap jar hangno hangno ha Akhaïa baroh kawei .

translation.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him  ; and he said to Abiathar the priest , Bring hither the ephod .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ba u Saul u la pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa u , u la ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh ,  Wallam hangne ïa ka ephod .

translation.en: And David took all the flocks and the herds , which they drave before those other cattle , and said , This is David s spoil .
translation.kha: U la ïohknieh ruh ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi baroh ; ki briew jong u ki ñiah ïa kita ki jingri ha shuwa jong ki bad ki ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jong u Dabid !

translation.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive , and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed .
translation.kha: Kumta phin long kiba nyngkong ban leit sha ka jinglongmraw . Ki jingkhawai bad ki jingïadih ïabam sngewbha jong phi kin kut noh .

translation.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons , and the cruel venom of asps .
translation.kha: kiba ka waiñ na ki ka long kum ka bih bseiñ .

translation.en: What , my son ? and what , the son of my womb ? and what , the son of my vows ?
translation.kha: Phi long u khun ba-ieit jong nga , ka jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga . Kaei ngan ïathuh ïa phi ?

translation.en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month , in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land .
translation.kha: Nangta , ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , kaba dei ka Sngi ka Jingpynïasuk , phah ïa u briew ban pynsawa ïa ka turoi ha ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: And they said , Cornelius the centurion , a just man , and one that feareth God , and of good report among all the nation of the Jews , was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house , and to hear words of thee .
translation.kha: U Kornelios , u rangbah shipai u la phah ïa ngi ,  ki la jubab .  U long u briew uba bha uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba la ñiewburom shikatdei da ki Jiw baroh . U angel jong U Blei u la ïathuh ïa u ban khot sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi don ban ong .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given me knowledge of it , and I know it : then thou shewedst me their doings .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyntip ha nga ïa ki jingthmu sniew kiba ki nongshun jong nga ki la thaw pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And I am this day weak , though anointed king  ; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me : the  Lord  shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness .
translation.kha: Wat la nga long u syiem uba la jied da U Blei , nga sngewtlot mynta ka sngi . Kine ki khun shynrang jong ka Seruïah ki long ka jingma ïa nga . To U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa kine ki nongkamsniew kumba ki dei ban ïoh !

translation.en: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished , and I will cause my fury to rest upon them , and I will be comforted : and they shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it in my zeal , when I have accomplished my fury in them .
translation.kha: Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga haduh ba ngan da sngewhun . Haba kane baroh ka jia , phan sa sngewthuh ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren ïa pha namar nga la bitar shla ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong pha .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day  ; and his disciples began , as they went , to pluck the ears of corn .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Katba ki synran jong u ki dang ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad u , ki sdang ban khet ïa ki symboh kew .

translation.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the  Lord  had made his journey prosperous or not .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u dang ïai khmih jar jar ïa ka , ban peit la ka long ba U  Trai  u la ai jingjop ïa u .

translation.en: And I gave them my statutes , and shewed them my judgments , which if a man do , he shall even live in them .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ki hukum jong nga bad nga la hikai ha ki ïa ki aiñ jong nga , kiba wallam ka jingim ïa uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki .

translation.en: His legs of iron , his feet part of iron and part of clay .
translation.kha: ïa ki khohwah jong ka da ka nar ; bad ïa ki kjat jong ka shi bynta da ka nar bad shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei um ju shahshkor ïa ki nongpop ; u shahshkor ïa ki briew kiba burom ïa u bad ba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ki ban leh .

translation.en: But if this thing be true , and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka jingkynnoh ka long kaba shisha bad ym don sabut ban pyn-i ba kata ka briew ka long kaba dang sotti ,

translation.en: Brethren , my heart s desire and prayer to God for Israel is , that they might be saved .
translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong nga , katno nga kwah da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ba ki briew jong nga hi kin long ïa kiba la pynim ! Katno nga duwai ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong ki !

translation.en: And they that were sent , returning to the house , found the servant whole that had been sick .
translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien ki la leit phai pat sha ka ïing jong u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki la shem ba u shakri jong u , u la khiah .

translation.en: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka nongbah , ki ïaid sha ka Templ , ryngkat bad ki jingtem jingput ki duitara bad ki turoi .

translation.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them : therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem , and took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and possessed it , and dwelt therein , and called Leshem , Dan , after the name of Dan their father .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah na ka jait Dan ki la duh noh ïa la ka jaka , ki la leit sha Laish bad tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ki jop ïa ka , ki pynïap ïa ki briew hangta , bad ki kam kynti ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki shong ki sah hangta bad ki pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah na ka Laish sha ka Dan , da kaba kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kyrteng u Dan u kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam pat ju shong ha ka templ ; nga la leit kylleng kylleng da kaba shong ha ka ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom , and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Phin bam bad dih ha ka miej jong nga ha ka Hima jong nga , bad phin shong halor ki khet ban synshar halor ki khat-ar jait ki Israel .

translation.en: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him .
translation.kha: U la tip bha ba ki rangbah Jiw kiba ha ka bor ki la aiti ïa U Jisu ha u namar ba ki bishni .

translation.en: Attending meetings at the local Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses will help you to do so .—Isaiah 11 :9  ; Hebrews 10 :24 , 25 .
translation.kha: Ka jingleit jingïaseng ha ka Kingdom Hall Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , kan ïarap ïa phi ban leh kumta .—Isaiah 11 :9 ; Hebru 10 :24 , 25 .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the morning watch the  Lord  looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud , and troubled the host of the Egyptians ,
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kynjat shai , U  Trai  u la khmih ïa ka kynhun shipai Ijipt na u rishot ding bad u rishot lyoh bad u pynkulmar thlim ïa ki .

translation.en: There salute thee Epaphras , my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus  ;
translation.kha: U Epaphras , uba don lang bad nga ha ka byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , u phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong u ïa me ,

translation.en: So Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , went down , and caused Solomon to ride upon king David s mule , and brought him to Gihon .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sadok , u Nathan , u Benaïah , bad ki nongïada syiem ki pynshong ïa u Solomon halor u khashor jong u Syiem Dabid bad ki la synran ïa u sha ka Umpohliew Gihon .

translation.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants , even the daughter of my dispersed , shall bring mine offering .
translation.kha: Wat na ka Sudan kaba sha jngai , ki briew jong nga kiba la sakma kin wallam ki jingainguh sha nga .

translation.en: So the  Lord  alone did lead him , and there was no strange god with him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  da lade hi u ïalam ïa la ki briew , ym don u blei nongwei uba ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate , and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly .
translation.kha: Phi ki briew phi isih ïa uta uba pyrshah ïa ka jingbymhok bad kren ïa ka jingshisha baroh ha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood : for I will bring more upon Dimon , lions upon him that escapeth of Moab , and upon the remnant of the land .
translation.kha: Ha ka shnong Dibon ka wah ka saw da ka snam , bad U Blei u don kaei kaei kaba kham sniew ba la buh na ka bynta ki briew hangta . Ho-oid , yn don ka jingpynïap ba lyngkien snam ïa uwei uwei baroh ba la iehnoh ha Moab .

translation.en: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread  ; and they that were hungry ceased : so that the barren hath born seven  ; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la im pahuh pahai shisien mynta ki leit bylla ban ïoh bam , hynrei kito kiba thngan kim thngan shuh . Ka briew kaba lyngki ka ïoh khun hynñiew ngut , hynrei ka kmie kaba bun ki khun ka sah marwei .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , Fear not : for am I in the place of God ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Wat sheptieng ; ngam lah ban buh ïa lade ha ka jaka jong U Blei .

translation.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples ,  Let us go into Judaea again .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit phai noh sha Judia .

translation.en: Hear another parable : There was a certain householder , which planted a vineyard , and hedged it round about , and digged a winepress in it , and built a tower , and let it out to husbandmen , and went into a far country :
translation.kha: To shahshkor sa kawei pat ka pharshi ,  U Jisu u la ong .  La don shisien u trai jaka uba la thung ka bri sohwaiñ , u la buh ka jingker sawdong jong ka , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ka jaka khñiot waiñ , bad u la tei ka jaka ap phira . Nangta u la aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha ki nongshimwai bad u la leit jingleit .

translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of Moses , one of his young men , answered and said , My lord Moses , forbid them .
translation.kha: Te u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u naduh ba u dang samla , u ong ,  Ko Kynrad , pynsangeh ïa ki !

translation.en: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
translation.kha: bad u Ishmael u khun jong u pat u la dap khatlai snem ka rta .

translation.en: And now I beseech thee , lady , not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko Kynthei badonburom : To ai ba baroh ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat . Kane kam long ka hukum kaba thymmai kaba nga thoh sha phi ; ka long ka hukum kaba ngi la don naduh mynnyngkong .

translation.en: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts , men of valour , from Zorah , and from Eshtaol , to spy out the land , and to search it  ; and they said unto them , Go , search the land : who when they came to mount Ephraim , to the house of Micah , they lodged there .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Dan ki jied san ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit na baroh ki longïing ha ka jait bad ki phah ïa ki na ki shnong Sorah bad Eshtaol ryngkat bad ki jingbthah ba kin leit syntiat ïa ka ri . Ynda ki poi ha ri lum Ephraim , ki sah ha ïing u Mikah .

translation.en: And they burnt the house of God , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem , and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire , and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof .
translation.kha: U thang ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka nongbah , lem bad ki ïingsyiem baroh bad ka spah jong ka , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the tenth month , came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem , and they besieged it .
translation.kha: Ha u bnai ba-shiphew jong ka snem bakhyndai ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat , and Jehoram , and Ahaziah , his fathers , kings of Judah , had dedicated , and his own hallowed things , and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and in the king s house , and sent it to Hazael king of Syria : and he went away from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Joash u syiem ka Judah u shim lut ïa baroh ki jingai ba kiba ha shuwa jong u , u Jehoshaphat , u Jehoram , bad u Ahasaïah ki la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , u kynthup lang ïa ki jingai jong u bad ka ksiar baroh kaba ha ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ïa kita baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Hasael , uba ïalam noh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u na Jerusalem .

translation.en: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment , and two hundred shekels of silver , and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight , then I coveted them , and took them  ; and , behold , they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent , and the silver under it .
translation.kha: Napdeng kita ki mar kiba ngi la kurup , nga la ïohi kawei ka barandi Babilon kaba itynnat , kumba ar kilo ka rupa , bad shi lyngkhot ka ksiar kaba khia palat shiteng kilo . Nga la ikwah eh ïa ki , bad nga la shim ïa ki . Phin shem ba la tep ïa ki hapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong nga , bad ka rupa ka don ha trai .

translation.en: Then cried they all again , saying , Not this man , but Barabbas . Now Barabbas was a robber .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u da kaba pyrta jam ,  Em , ym dei ïa u ! Ngi kwah ïa u Barabbas !  ( u Barabbas u la long u nongkamsniew . )

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Ye will surely say unto me this proverb , Physician , heal thyself : whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum , do also here in thy country .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Nga thikna ba phin sot ïa kane ka proberb ha nga , ‘ Ko nongpynkhiah , to pynkhiah ïa lade .’ Phin ong ruh ïa nga ban leh hangne ha la ka shnong ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba phi la ïohsngew ïa kiba la leh ha Kapernam .

translation.en: Therewith bless we God , even the Father  ; and therewith curse we men , which are made after the similitude of God .
translation.kha: Ngi pyndonkam ïa u ban ainguh ïa U Trai bad U Kpa jong ngi bad ban tim ruh ïa la u parabriew , ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei .

translation.en: And Saul said , Hear now , thou son of Ahitub . And he answered , Here I am , my lord .
translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha u Ahimelekh ,  Shahshkor , Ahimelekh !   Nga hangne , ko kynrad ,  u jubab .

translation.en: And Ephraim said , Yet I am become rich , I have found me out substance : in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin .
translation.kha: ‘ Ngi long kiba riewspah’ ki ong . ‘ Ngi lah lum kyrhai ka spah . Bad ym don uwei ruh ban mudui ïa ngi ba ngi ïoh spah da ka lynti bymhok .’

translation.en: And I took the two tables , and cast them out of my two hands , and brake them before your eyes .
translation.kha: Kumta , hangta ha khmat jong phi nga bret ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap bad nga pynpait pharia ïa ki .

translation.en: In holiness and righteousness before him , all the days of our life .
translation.kha: khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba khuid bad kiba hok ha khmat jong u baroh ki sngi ka jingim jong ngi .

translation.en: Although many skilled tradesmen from the region volunteer their labor at every building site , members of the local congregation make up the bulk of the volunteer labor force .
translation.kha: Wat lada don shibun ki nongtrei mon sngewbha kiba tbit kiba wan na kiwei ki jaka , hynrei kiba bun pat ki dei ki para bangeit kiba trei mon sngewbha na kato hi ka jaka .

translation.en: And they laughed him to scorn . But when he had put them all out , he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel , and them that were with him , and entereth in where the damsel was lying .
translation.kha: Ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u , kumta u la phah noh ïa ki baroh shabar , u la shim ïa u kpa bad ïa ka kmie jong ka , bad ki lai ngut ki synran jong u , bad rung shapoh ka kamra ha kaba ka khynnah ka thiah .

translation.en: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law , but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds .
translation.kha: Nga la shem ba um shym la leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban ïap lane ban shah set byndi ; ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka dei bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka hukum jong ki hi .

translation.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom , and of the fields of Gomorrah : their grapes are grapes of gall , their clusters are bitter :
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ki , kiba jyrsieh kum ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , ki long kum ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba sei ki soh kiba kthang bad don bih ,

translation.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth , and perverse lips put far from thee .
translation.kha: Wat ju kren ïa kano kano ka bymshisha . Kiar na kaba kren lamler bad na ki ktien kiba ïalam bakla .

translation.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia , the brethren wrote , exhorting the disciples to receive him : who , when he was come , helped them much which had believed through grace :
translation.kha: Nangta u Apollos u la kut jingmut ban leit sha Akhaïa , kumta ki parabangeit ha Ephesos ki la ïarap ïa u da kaba thoh sha ki parabangeit kiba ha Akhaïa , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u . Haba u la poi , u la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa kito kiba da ka jingaiei jong U Blei ki la kylla long ki parabangeit .

translation.en: And that ye put on the new man , which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness .
translation.kha: bad phi dei ban kup ïa u briew uba thymmai ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei kaba pynpaw ïa lade ha ka jingim kaba shisha kaba long kaba beit bad kaba khuid .

translation.en: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life : and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ïohi ba U Saul u wad ban pynïap ïa u . U Dabid u don ha Horesh , ha ka ri khlaw hajan ka Siph .

translation.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab  ; he is very proud : even of his haughtiness , and his pride , and his wrath : but his lies shall not be so .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki ong ,  Ngi la ïohsngew katno ki briew jong ka Moab ki long kiba sarong . Ngi tip ba ki long kiba sngewmeng bad kiba sarong palat , hynrei ka jingkob jong ki ka long kaba thylli .

translation.en: What work do the ministerial servants perform for our benefit ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka kamram jong ki nongïarap ?

translation.en: Though thou , Israel , play the harlot , yet let not Judah offend  ; and come not ye unto Gilgal , neither go ye up to Beth–aven , nor swear , The  Lord  liveth .
translation.kha: Wat lada phi ki briew ka Israel phim ïaineh ha nga , ai ba ki Judah kin ym ngop ha kijuh ki jingleh pop . Wat leit mane sha Gilgal lane sha Bethaben , lane pynlong ki jingïateh kular ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba im .

translation.en: But the fields of the city , and the villages thereof , gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ki pyntha jong ka nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit jong ka la lah ai ha u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life , that , behold , the woman , whose son he had restored to life , cried to the king for her house and for her land . And Gehazi said , My lord , O king , this is the woman , and this is her son , whom Elisha restored to life .
translation.kha: Katba u Gehasi u dang ïathuh ïa u syiem kumno u Elisha u la pynim pat ïa u briew uba la ïap , kata ka briew ka la pynlong ïa ka jingkyrpad na u syiem . U Gehasi u ong ha u ,  Ko syiem kynrad , kane keiñ kata ka briew , bad une keiñ u khun jong ka ïa uba u Elisha u la pynim pat .

translation.en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward , with the gate Shallecheth , by the causeway of the going up , ward against ward .
translation.kha: U Shuppim bad u Hosah ki ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang sepngi bad ka khyrdop Shallekheth ha ka surok kaba na neng . Ïa ka jingap phira la pynbynta ha ki por ba la buh , kawei hadien kawei pat .

translation.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon , and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Babilon , jong ka jingïam pangnud namar ka jingpynjot ha ka ri .

translation.en: Behold , I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them , and will return your recompence upon your own head :
translation.kha: Mynta ngan wallam pat ïa ki na ki jaka na kiba ki la shah die . Ngan leh ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation : and all the congregation drew near and stood before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki wanlam sha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u la hukum , bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïalumlang ban mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the  Lord  into this wilderness , that we and our cattle should die there ?
translation.kha: Balei te ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri khlaw ? Hato ba ngin ïap hangne bad la ki jingri ?

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  I am : and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
translation.kha: Nga long ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew uba shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Badonbor Baroh bad ba u wan ha ki lyoh jong ka bneng !

translation.en: And it is turned round about by his counsels : that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth .
translation.kha: katba ki ïaid ha ka mon U Blei . Ki leh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u hukum , hangno hangno ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation : for when he is tried , he shall receive the crown of life , which the Lord hath promised to them that love him .
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba ïaineh hapdeng ki jingtynjuh , namar ynda u jop haba u la ïaid lyngba ïa kaba kum kata ka jingtynjuh , un ïohpdiang kum ka bainong jong u ïa ka jingim kaba U Blei u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that Leah was hated , he opened her womb : but Rachel was barren .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïohi ba ka jingieit ka kham duna ïa ka Leah ban ïa ka Rakhel , u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh khun , hynrei ka Rakhel ka ïailong kaba khlem khun .

translation.en: For since I spake , I cried out , I cried violence and spoil  ; because the word of the  Lord  was made a reproach unto me , and a derision , daily .
translation.kha: Man ba nga kren , nga hap ban kyang jam bad pyrta ,  Ka jingleh jubor ! Ka jingpynjot !  A  Trai  , ïa nga la rkhiebeiñ bad ibeiñ ha ki por baroh namar nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong me .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as the camels had done drinking , that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold  ;
translation.kha: Haba ka la dep ai um , uta u briew u shim ïa ka sati ksiar kaba remdor bad u pyndait ha ka khmut jong ka , bad u pyndeng ruh ar tylli ki khadu ksiar kiba heh ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka .

translation.en: And there came a man of God unto Eli , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father , when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh s house ?
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u wan sha u Eli bad ka khubor na U  Trai  :  Haba u Kpa tymmen jong me u Aaron bad ka longïing jong u ki dang long ki mraw jong u Pharaoh ka Ijipt . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha u Aaron .

translation.en: O daughter of my people , gird thee with sackcloth , and wallow thyself in ashes : make thee mourning , as for an only son , most bitter lamentation : for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  To kup jaiñ khain bad to tyllun ha u dpei . To ïam sngewsih lem bad ki ummat kthang kumba phin ïam ïa u khun marwei , namar uta uba wan ban pynjot ïa phi un tur ïaleh kynsan .

translation.en: And ye are puffed up , and have not rather mourned , that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you .
translation.kha: Kumno , te , phi sngewsarong ïa kata ? Ha kawei ka liang , phi dei bad dap da ka jingsngewsih , bad ïa u briew uba la leh ïa kaba kum kata kaei kaei la dei ban weng noh napdeng ka kynhun jong phi .

translation.en: Who appeared in glory , and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: kiba la paw ha ka burom ba kynja bneng bad ki la ïakren bad U Jisu shaphang ka rukom ha kaba shen un sa pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong U Blei da kaba ïap ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: But the olive tree said unto them , Should I leave my fatness , wherewith by me they honour God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
translation.kha: U dieng Olib u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih umphniang , ïa kaba la pyndonkam ban pyndonburom ïa ki blei jong ngi bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’

translation.en: Why did you tell him to go ?
translation.kha: Balei phi ong ia u ban leit noh ?

translation.en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , phin ïalumlang ban mane Blei , phim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam kaba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .

translation.en: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons , and their daughters go a whoring after their gods , and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong phi kin lah ban ïashongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , ki ban ïalam ïa ki ban ym ïaineh shuh ha nga bad ban mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki .

translation.en: But the court which is without the temple leave out , and measure it not  ; for it is given unto the Gentiles : and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat thew ïa ki phyllaw kiba shabar , namar la ai noh ïa ki ha kiba mane blei thala , ki ban sa ïuhroit ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid haduh sawphew ar bnai .

translation.en: The  Lord  is longsuffering , and of great mercy , forgiving iniquity and transgression , and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga , U  Trai  nga long uba suki ban bitar , bad nga pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ka jingïaineh bad map ïa ka pop bad ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah . Nalorkata , ngam pep ban pynshitom ïa ki khun bad ki ksiew haduh kaba lai bad kaba saw pateng namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .’

translation.en: I saw a dream which made me afraid , and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïoh ka jingphohsniew kaba pynsheptieng bad nga la ïohi ki jingïohipaw kiba shyrkhei mynba nga dang ïohthiah .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee , and I will destroy thy chariots :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha kata ka por ngan shim noh ïa ki kulai jong phi bad yn pynjot ïa ki kali ïapom .

translation.en: To whom they all gave heed , from the least to the greatest , saying , This man is the great power of God .
translation.kha: U la kam ba u long uba khraw , bad uwei uwei baroh ha ka nongbah , na ki kyrdan baroh ha ka imlang ka sahlang , ki pynshahshkor kmang ïa u .  Une u briew u long kata ka bor jong U Blei ïa kaba la khot ‘ Ka Borbah’ ,  ki la ong .

translation.en: He was oppressed , and he was afflicted , yet he opened not his mouth : he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter , and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb , so he openeth not his mouth .
translation.kha: U la shah lehbeiñ sat , hynrei u la shah da kaba sngewrit ; um shym la kren shikyntien ruh . Kum i khunlangbrot ban sa shah pynïap , kum ka langbrot ka ban sa shah khih ïa la u shñiuh , um shym kren shikyntien ruh .

translation.en: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms , The Lord said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,
translation.kha: Naba u Dabid hi u ong ha ka kitab Ki Salm ,   ‘ U Trai u la ong ha u Trai jong nga : to shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga

translation.en: Enter not into the path of the wicked , and go not in the way of evil men .
translation.kha: Wat leit sha kaba ki riewsniew ki leit . Wat pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki riewbymman .

translation.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness  ; and to brotherly kindness charity .
translation.kha: ha ka jinglong riewblei pynlang ïa ka jingïadei parabangeit ; bad ha ka jingïadei parabangeit pynlang ïa ka jingieit .

translation.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law , or the prophets : I am not come to destroy , but to fulfil .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba nga la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ka Hukum u Moses bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ki nongïathuhlypa . Ngam shym la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ki , hynrei ban pynurlong shisha ïa ki jinghikai jong ki .

translation.en: And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ki briew ,  U briew u ban wan hadien jong nga u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bit nam wat ban dem bad law ïa ki juti jong u .

translation.en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour , then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand  ; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour s standing corn .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaid lynti na ka lyngkha kew jongno jongno , phi lah ban sip    ïa u sohkew uba phi kheit da la ki kti , hynrei phim dei ban ot ïa u da ka rashi .

translation.en: The  Lord  your God which goeth before you , he shall fight for you , according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi , bad un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kumba phi la ïohi ïa u ba u leh ha Ijipt

translation.en: But the woman fearing and trembling , knowing what was done in her , came and fell down before him , and told him all the truth .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka , kumta ka la wan , ka da kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng , ka la dem khohsiew ha ki kjat jong u , bad ka la ïathuh ha u ïa ka jingshisha baroh .

translation.en: Ephraim is smitten , their root is dried up , they shall bear no fruit : yea , though they bring forth , yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long kum u jingthung uba ki thied ki la tyrkhong bad um pynmih soh ei ei shuh . Kin ym ïoh khun shuh , hynrei wat lada ki dang ïoh , ngan pynïap ïa ki khun thep mynsiem jong ki .

translation.en: He giveth to the beast his food , and to the young ravens which cry .
translation.kha: U ai ïa ki jingri ïa ka jingbam jong ki bad u bsa ïa ki khun tyngab haba ki pah .

translation.en: And they shall answer and say , Our hands have not shed this blood , neither have our eyes seen it .
translation.kha: bad kin phla , ‘ Ym dei ma ngi kiba pynïap ïa uto u briew , bad ngim shym ïohi ruh mano ba la leh ïa kata ka kam .

translation.en: But rejoice , inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ s sufferings  ; that , when his glory shall be revealed , ye may be glad also with exceeding joy .
translation.kha: Pynban to shadkmen ba phi ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingshahshitom u Khrist , khnang ba phi lah ban long kiba dap da ka jingkmen haba ïa ka burom jong u yn pynpaw .

translation.en: For the mountains shall depart , and the hills be removed  ; but my kindness shall not depart from thee , neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed , saith the  Lord  that hath mercy on thee .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah bad ki lumrit ki lah ban twa , hynrei ka jingieit jong nga ïa pha kan ym kut noh ; ngan pynneh junom ïa la ka kular jong ka jingsuk .  Kumta te ong U  Trai  uba ieit ïa pha .

translation.en: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps , and finished them in the seventh month .
translation.kha: Ki jingai ki sdang ban poi ha u bnai uba lai bad ki ïai kynton ha ki saw bnai kiba bud .

translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and the sons of David were chief about the king .
translation.kha: u Benaïah u khun jong u Jehoïada u khmih halor ka kynhun ap phira jong u Dabid ; ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki bat ïa ki kyrdan ba-halor ha ka jingshakri ïa u .

translation.en: And he said also unto his disciples ,  There was a certain rich man , which had a steward  ; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la don u shakri uba pynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u . La ïathuh ha une u briew bariewspah ba u sordar jong u , u la pynsep-ei ïa ka pisa u kynrad jong u ,

translation.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together , Jesus asked them ,
translation.kha: Haba katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la ïalumlang , U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,

translation.en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem , and did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  his God , like David his father .
translation.kha: Um shym bud ïa ki nuksa babha jong u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u ; pynban , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u bad u bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki syiem Israel .

translation.en: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins : they afflict the just , they take a bribe , and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right .
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno ki pop jong phi ki long kiba sngewshyrkhei bad katno kiba bun ki kam runar phi la leh . Phi pynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew kiba bha , phi bamsap , phi khang noh ïa kiba duk ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok ha ki ïingbishar .

translation.en: I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ? God is not the God of the dead , but of the living .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’ U long U Blei jong kiba im bad ym jong kiba ïap .

translation.en: For the  Lord  your God is he that goeth with you , to fight for you against your enemies , to save you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un leit ryngkat bad phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .’

translation.en: For I say unto you , That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi baroh ba ym don na kito ki rangbah kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki ban ïohmad ïa ka jingbam miet jong nga !’

translation.en: This spake he , signifying by what death he should glorify God . And when he had spoken this , he saith unto him ,  Follow me .
translation.kha: ( Ha kaba ong kumne , U Jisu u la kdew kaba kumno u Petros un ïap bad pyndonburom ïa U Blei . ) Te U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To bud ïa nga !

translation.en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day , death , and mourning , and famine  ; and she shall be utterly burned with fire : for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ha ka shi sngi yn sa shoh ïa ka da ki khlam — ka jingpang , ka jingsngewsih bad ka  nemsniew . Bad yn thang ïa ka da ka ding , namar ba U Trai uba U Blei , uba bishar ïa ka , u long uba khlaiñbor .

translation.en: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth , and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba kata kan jia , ngan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel kiba khlaiñ bad ngan shah ïa me , ko Esekiel , ban kren ha kaba baroh kin ïohsngew ïa me , khnang ba kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled  ; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt , and all the wise men thereof : and Pharaoh told them his dream  ; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ynda mynstep u la sngewkhuslai ; kumta u phah khot ïa ki nongleh myntor bad ïa ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Ijipt . U ïathuh ha ki ïa la ki jingphohsniew , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban batai ïa ki ha u .

translation.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor , which is by the river of the land of the children of his people , to call him , saying , Behold , there is a people come out from Egypt : behold , they cover the face of the earth , and they abide over against me :
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Balak u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban ïakynduh ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba don ha Pethor hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka ri jong ki Amaw . Ki wallam sha u ïa kane ka khubor na u Balak ,  Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip ba kawei ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka la wan na Ijipt ; kita ki briew ki la saphriang kylleng bad ki thmu ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds , or the noise of his tabernacle ?
translation.kha: Ym don batip kumno ki lyoh ki ïaid lane kumno u pyrthat u kyrhuh lyngba ka suiñbneng , ha kaba U Blei u shong .

translation.en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter , neither on the sabbath day :
translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym hap ban phet noh ha ka por tlang lane ha ka sngi Sabbaton !

translation.en: Then she saddled an ass , and said to her servant , Drive , and go forward  ; slack not thy riding for me , except I bid thee .
translation.kha: Nangta ka phah teh jin ïa ka kada , bad ka hukum ïa u shakri ,  Pynïaid stet ïa ka kada katba ka lah , bad wat pynsuki , lymda nga ong ïa me ban leh kumta .

translation.en: For it is the life of all flesh  ; the blood of it is for the life thereof : therefore I said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh : for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof : whosoever eateth it shall be cut off .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw uba im ka don ha ka snam , bad dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , bad ba ïa uno uno uba leh kumta yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands , which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay , and brake them to pieces .
translation.kha: Katba phi dang khmih ïa ka , u maw uba khraw u la lait na ka synrang khlem don mano mano ba ktah ïa u , u la shoh ïa ka kjat nar bad dewbyrtha jong ka durbriew , bad u la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage .
translation.kha: bad ha kane ka rukom , un pyllait ïa kita baroh kiba la long ki mraw shi lynter ka jingim jong ki , namar ka jingsheptieng jong ki ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully  ; help thou me .
translation.kha: Ki hukum jong me baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah ; ki briew ki pynshitom beiñ ïa nga da ki jinglamler — A ïarap ïa nga !

translation.en: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood  ; and I will rain upon him , and upon his bands , and upon the many people that are with him , an overflowing rain , and great hailstones , fire , and brimstone .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u da ka jingpang bad ka jingïa-umsnam . Ïa u  lapbah  lapsan bad u phria , ryngkat bad ka ding bad u kyndok , ngan theh noh ha u bad ha ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad halor kiba bun ki jaitbynriew kiba ïashah liang bad u .

translation.en: By which also ye are saved , if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you , unless ye have believed in vain .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ka gospel , ka khubor kaba nga la ïalap ha phi . Ïa phi la pynim da ka gospel lada phi batskhem ïa ka — lymda phi la ngeit lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: Therefore now ,  Lord  , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever , and do as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko  Trai  , to pyndep na ka bynta ka por baroh ïa ka kular jong me ïa nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh ïa kaei kaba me thmu ban leh .

translation.en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father s sake : but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son .
