translation.kha: Pynban , na ka bynta u Dabid u kpa jong me , ngan ym leh ïa kane katba me dang im , hynrei ha ka por jingsynshar u khun jong me .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  It is said , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Wat tynjuh ïa U Trai U Blei jong me .’

translation.en: Ye that love the  Lord  , hate evil : he preserveth the souls of his saints  ; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa kito kiba isih ïa kaba sniew ; u ïada ïa ka jingim jong ki briew jong u ; u pyllait im ïa ki na ka bor jong ki bymman .

translation.en: Behold , they are all vanity  ; their works are nothing : their molten images are wind and confusion .
translation.kha: Baroh kine ki blei ki long ki bymlarkam ; Kim lah ban leh ei ei ruh em — Kine ki bleithaw ki long kiba tlot bad ki bymdonbor .

translation.en: And as soon as the commandment came abroad , the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn , wine , and oil , and honey , and of all the increase of the field  ; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly .
translation.kha: Tang mar ïa-ai hukum , ki paid Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingai jong ki , kiba kynsai tam na u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ka ngap , bad kiwei de ki jingmih na ka lyngkha , bad ki wanrah ruh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong kiei kiei kiba ki don .

translation.en: Now therefore make a new cart , and take two milch kine , on which there hath come no yoke , and tie the kine to the cart , and bring their calves home from them :
translation.kha: Kumta pynkhreh kawei ka kali thymmai bad ar tylli ki masi kynthei ha kiba ym pat ju pyndait lyngkor ; teh ïa ki ha kata ka kali , bad ïalam noh ïa ki khun masi sha sem .

translation.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews  ; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness , into a city called Ephraim , and there continued with his disciples .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu um ïaid shuh ha Judia ha kaba paw , hynrei u la mihnoh bad leit sha ka jaka hajan ka ri shyiap , sha ka shnong ïa kaba la khot ka Ephraim , ha kaba u la sah bad ki synran .

translation.en: Sanctify them through thy truth : thy word is truth .
translation.kha: To pynkyntang ïa ki sha lade da kata ka jingshisha ; ka ktien jong me ka long ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and will gather the wheat into his garner  ; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable .
translation.kha: U don bad u ka byrsha pynher stait , ban shoh ïa u kew baroh bad ban lumlang ïa u kew shapoh ka thiar jong u ; hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bym ju lip .

translation.en: To Obed–edom southward  ; and to his sons the house of Asuppim .
translation.kha: U Obed Edom u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shathie , bad ki khun jong u ki hap peit ïa ka kamra buh tiar .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning the houses of this city , and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah , which are thrown down by the mounts , and by the sword  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga ong ba ki ïing ha Jerusalem bad ka ïingsyiem Judah kin sa shah pynkhyllem na ka daw jong ka jingshah kerkut bad ka jingtur ïaleh .

translation.en: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia : but we beseech you , brethren , that ye increase more and more ;
translation.kha: Bad shisha phi la leh ïa kane ha ki parabangeit baroh ha Makedonia . Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit , ba phin nang leh shuh shuh .

translation.en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition , queen Esther ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? and it shall be performed , even to the half of the kingdom .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïadih waiñ , u syiem u la kylli biang ïa ka ,  Mynta , ko Esther , ko mahadei , kaei kaba pha kwah ? Ïathuh ïa nga bad phan ïoh ïa kata . Ngan ai ha pha wat shiteng na ka hima .

translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day , as the king bade , saying , Come again to me on the third day .
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi u Jeroboam bad ki briew baroh ki leit pat sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .

translation.en: He shall lend to thee , and thou shalt not lend to him : he shall be the head , and thou shalt be the tail .
translation.kha: Kin don ka spah ka phew kat ban ai kylliang ïa phi , hynrei phi pat phin ym don ei ei ban ai kylliang ïa ki . Ha kaba khatduh kin sa long ki nongsynshar jong phi .

translation.en: Moab is spoiled , and gone up out of her cities , and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka la pynjot , ïa ki samla shynrang bakynsai tam la pynïap . Nga long u syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , bad nga la kren .

translation.en: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen  ; he shall surely deal with him : I have driven him out for his wickedness .
translation.kha: kumta nga la kyntait noh ïa u bad ai ha u nongsynshar nongwei . Un sa ainong ïa uta u dieng ïa kaei kaba u dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong u .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , a king of kings , from the north , with horses , and with chariots , and with horsemen , and companies , and much people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan wallam ïa u syiem bakhraw tam na baroh — u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia — ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Tyros . Un wan na shaphang shatei ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai babun , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai .

translation.en: Yet it came to pass , when the children of Israel were waxen strong , that they put the Canaanites to tribute  ; but did not utterly drive them out .
translation.kha: Wat haba ki Israel ki la kham khlaiñ , kim shym la beh noh ïa ki Kanaan baroh , hynrei ki la pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Let us pass , I pray thee , through thy country : we will not pass through the fields , or through the vineyards , neither will we drink of the water of the wells : we will go by the king s high way , we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed thy borders .
translation.kha: Sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lynti na ka hima jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri jong ngi , ngin ym sakma na ka lynti ïaid lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi , bad ngin ym dih um na ki pukri jong phi . Ngin ïaid na lynti bah haduh ba ngin da ïaid lait na ka hima jong phi .

translation.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gath–hepher , to Eth–kazin , and goeth out to Rimmon–methoar to Neah  ;
translation.kha: U bteng nangta sha ka phang mihngi haduh Gath Hepher bad Ethkasin , da kaba phai ha ka liang jong ka Neah ha ka lynti sha Rimmon .

translation.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another , It is manna : for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them , This is the bread which the  Lord  hath given you to eat .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka , kim tip ka dei kaei , bad kumta ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei mo kane ?  Te u Moses u ong ha ki ,  Une u dei u kpu ba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ban bam .

translation.en: He telleth the number of the stars  ; he calleth them all by their names .
translation.kha: U rai ïa ka jingdon jong ki khlur bad u khot ïa uwei pa uwei da ka kyrteng .

translation.en: Take this book of the law , and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , that it may be there for a witness against thee .
translation.kha: Shim ïa kane ka kitab ka Aiñ U Blei bad buh ïa ka ha syndah ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ba kan don hangta kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: And thou shalt swear , The  Lord  liveth , in truth , in judgment , and in righteousness  ; and the nations shall bless themselves in him , and in him shall they glory .
translation.kha: kan long kaba dei ïa phi ban smai da ka kyrteng jong nga . Nangta baroh ki jaitbynriew kin kyrpad ïa nga ban kyrkhu ïa ki , bad kin ïaroh ïa nga .

translation.en: Hearing of thy love and faith , which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus , and toward all saints  ;
translation.kha: Naba nga ïohsngew shaphang ka jingieit jong me ïa ki briew U Blei baroh bad ïa ka jingngeit kaba me don ha U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: Which none of the princes of this world knew : for had they known it , they would not have crucified the Lord of glory .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei , uba la tip ïa kane ka jingstad . Lada ki la tip ïa ka , kin ym da la sahnarphna ïa U Trai ka burom .

translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Hato ngin ong te , ba U Blei u long bymhok ? Ym kumta .

translation.en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp : and all the host ran , and cried , and fled .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha la ka jaka sawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun baroh ki phet ïap da kaba lynñiar .

translation.en: And as he was now going down , his servants met him , and told him , saying , Thy son liveth .
translation.kha: Katba u dang don ha lynti sha ïing , ki shakri jong u ki la wan shem ïa u bad ka khubor ,  U khun jong me un im !

translation.en: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them , and make merry , and shall send gifts one to another  ; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin ïakmen namar ka jingïap jong kine ki ar ngut . Kin ïalehkmen bad kin ïa-ai jingai sngewbha markylliang , namar ba kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wallam shibun ki jingshitom halor u bynriew .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .
translation.kha: Tang da ka jingduwai lah ban beh noh kum ïa une ,  u Jisu u la jubab ;  ym don kawei pat kaba lah .

translation.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory  ; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon , by the gate of Bath–rabbim : thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus .
translation.kha: Ko ba-ieit jong nga , phi long kaba bhabriew kum ka Jerusalem , kaba i-ieit kum ka nongbah Tirsah , kaba pynkyndeh mynsiem kum kine ki nongbah bakhraw .

translation.en: That the kingdom might be base , that it might not lift itself up , but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand .
translation.kha: ban bat ïa ka ri na kaba ïeng biang bad ban pynthikna ba yn sumar ïa ka jingïateh lok .

translation.en: And not as Moses , which put a veil over his face , that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished :
translation.kha: Bad ym kum u Moses , uba la hap ban buh da ka jingkah ha ka durkhmat jong u khnang ba ki paid Israel kin ym ïohi ba kata ka jingtyngshaiñ ka lip bad jah noh .

translation.en: But let a man examine himself , and so let him eat of that bread , and drink of that cup .
translation.kha: Kumta te , uwei uwei baroh u dei ban ïit nyngkong ïa lade , bad nangta un bam ïa u kpu bad dih na ka khuri .

translation.en: I tell you , in that night there shall be two men in one bed  ; the one shall be taken , and the other shall be left .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , nga ong ha phi , yn don ar ngut ki briew kiba thiah ha kajuh ka jingthiah : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: He shall enter into peace : they shall rest in their beds , each one walking in his uprightness .
translation.kha: Kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ki ïoh jingsuk bad jingjahthait ha ka jingïap .

translation.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth ? declare , if thou hast understanding .
translation.kha: Hato me don hangta mynba nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ? Lada me tip haduh katta katta , to ïathuh ïa nga shaphang kata .

translation.en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases , and cast out many devils  ; and suffered not the devils to speak , because they knew him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pynkhiah bun kiba pang na ki jait jingpang kiba bun bad beh noh ïa kiba bun ki ksuid . Um shah ba ki ksuid kin kren ei ei , namar ki la tip u long uei .

translation.en: Behold , I have given him for a witness to the people , a leader and commander to the people .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , u nongïalam bad u nongai hukum ïa ki jaitbynriew ; bad lyngba jong u nga la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka bor jong nga .

translation.en: Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .
translation.kha: To wat ieit ïa ka pyrthei , lymne ïa kaei kaei kaba dei jong ka pyrthei . Lada phi ieit ïa ka pyrthei , kata ka long ba phim ieit ïa U Kpa .

translation.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba lehhok kin ïoh ka jingim kaba kyrhai bad kaba suk . Hynrei lada phi long kyrkieh ban riewspah , phin ym lait na kaba shah pynshitom .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he spake these things , a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice , and said unto him , Blessed is the womb that bare thee , and the paps which thou hast sucked .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa kane , ka kynthei ka la kren na u paidbah bad ka la ong ha u ,  A katno kaba kmen long ka briew kaba la kha bad kaba la bsa la pjiah ïa me !

translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and clothe them with coats :
translation.kha: Wan ïalam sa ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynphong sopti ïa ki .

translation.en: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house : when I begin , I will also make an end .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba nga la kren pyrshah ïa ka ïing u Eli , naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut .

translation.en: And he said unto his disciples ,  Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat  ; neither for the body , what ye shall put on .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ban ym khuslai shaphang ka jingbam kaba phi donkam ban im lane shaphang ki jaiñ kiba phi donkam na ka bynta ka met jong phi .

translation.en: And he led them forth by the right way , that they might go to a city of habitation .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba beit sha ka nongbah ha kaba ki lah ban shong ban sah .

translation.en: And it came to pass the same year , in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the fourth year , and in the fifth month , that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet , which was of Gibeon , spake unto me in the house of the  Lord  , in the presence of the priests and of all the people , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka snem , ha u bnai uba san jong ka snem kaba saw ba u Sedekaïah u long syiem , u Hananaïah u khun jong u Assur , u nongïathuhlypa na ka shnong Gibeon , u la kren ha nga ha ka Templ . Ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki lyngdoh bad ki paidbah u la ong ïa nga

translation.en: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish , of the beeves , of the sheep , or of the goats .
translation.kha: khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa ka , ka dei ban long da u masi , ne da u langbrot , ne da u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks  ; and his eye seeth every precious thing .
translation.kha: Katba ki sam thliew lyngba ïa ki mawsiang , Ki shem ïa ki mawkordor .

translation.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look upon the earth beneath : for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke , and the earth shall wax old like a garment , and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner : but my salvation shall be for ever , and my righteousness shall not be abolished .
translation.kha: Khmih sha ki bneng ; peit ha ka pyrthei ! Ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem ; ka pyrthei kan jot noh kum ki jaiñ ba la rim , bad ki briew jong ka baroh kin ïap kum ki skain . Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba nga wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan long kaba kut .

translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah , and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha Judah bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish , bind the chariot to the swift beast : she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion : for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee .
translation.kha: Phi kiba shong ha Lakhish , teh ïa ki kali ïapom ha ki kulai . Phi pynbud ïa ki pop jong ki Israel bad kumta ka pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ban leh pop .

translation.en: And hallow my sabbaths  ; and they shall be a sign between me and you , that ye may know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka Sabbaton ka sngi kaba khuid , ba kumta kan long ka dak jong ka jutang ba ngi la thaw , bad kan pynkynmaw ïa phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: On the left hand , where he doth work , but I cannot behold him : he hideth himself on the right hand , that I cannot see him :
translation.kha: U Blei u trei ha ka kam shaphang shatei bad shathie , hynrei pynban ngam shym ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha nga :

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines , and I will cut off the Cherethims , and destroy the remnant of the sea coast .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga pynbna ba ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia bad ban pynjah syndon ïa ki . Ngan pynjot ïa kiba sah baroh kiba dang im ha ki jaka madan ka Philistia .

translation.en: I beheld the earth , and , lo , it was without form , and void  ; and the heavens , and they had no light .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ha ka pyrthei — ka la long ka jingsep ei suda , ha ka sahit bneng — ym don kano kano ka jingshai .

translation.en: You can enter into a special relationship with Jehovah
translation.kha: Phin lah ban don ka jingïadei ba kyrpang bad U Jehobah

translation.en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens , and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service : and of the Levites there were scribes , and officers , and porters .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki Lebi ki peit halor ka jingpynkit jingkit bad halor ki nongtrei ha ki kam bapher bapher , bad kiwei ki buh jingkheiñ lane ki shakri kum ki nongap phira .

translation.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus  ; Thou hast chastised me , and I was chastised , as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke : turn thou me , and I shall be turned  ; for thou art the  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Nga ïohsngew ïa ki paid Israel ba ki ong ha ka jingsngewsih , ‘ A  Trai  , ngi la long kum u mrad uba khlem shah hikai , hynrei me la hikai ïa ngi ban kohnguh . To wallam pat ïa ngi ; ngi long kiba la kloi ban wan phai pat sha me , U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And the man of God said , Where fell it ? And he shewed him the place . And he cut down a stick , and cast it in thither  ; and the iron did swim .
translation.kha: Hangno u hap ?  u Elisha u kylli . Ynda uta u briew u kdew ha u ïa kata ka jaka , bad u Elisha u daiñ ïa uwei u dieng , u pashat ïa u ha ka um , bad u pynper ïa u khlieh sdie .

translation.en: And the sons of Bela  ; Ezbon , and Uzzi , and Uzziel , and Jerimoth , and Iri , five  ; heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour  ; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four .
translation.kha: U Bela u don san ngut ki khun shynrang : u Esbon , u Ussi , u Ussiel , u Jerimoth , bad u Iri . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing ha ka kur bad ki dei baroh ki shipai bapawnam . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki kynthup ïa ki arphew ar hajar laiphew saw ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

translation.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler , consider diligently what is before thee :
translation.kha: Haba phi shong bam bad u briew uba donburom , da buh jingmut ba u long uei .

translation.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live , and shalt serve thy brother  ; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion , that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck .
translation.kha: Men im da ka waitlam , Hynrei men long u mraw jong u para jong me . Pynban haba me ïeng ban ïaleh pyrshah , Men lait na ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh jingbam kaba biang ban im , ngi la leit khrong sha Ijipt bad Assyria .

translation.en: Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah shajrong ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha kiba shah ringmraw ha Babilonia . Nangta ka jingïohipaw ka jah noh ,

translation.en: The  Lord  hath made all things for himself : yea , even the wicked for the day of evil .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  u la thaw ki don la ki jingkut ; bad ka jingkut jong u bymman ka long ka jingjot .

translation.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness  ; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei , uba khraw bad uba rit , u pyrshang ban shna pisa da ka jingbymhok ; wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thok ïa ki briew .

translation.en: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron , and in the hands of his sons  ; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Buh ïa kine baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ha ki kti ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ong ba kin pynkyntang ïa ki kum ka jingainguh kyrpang sha nga .

translation.en: Having eyes , see ye not ? and having ears , hear ye not ? and do ye not remember ?
translation.kha: Phi don ki khmat — hato phim lah ban ïohi ? Phi don ki shkor — hato phim lah ban ïohsngew ?

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I am the way , the truth , and the life : no man cometh unto the Father , but by me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Nga long ka lynti , ka jingshisha , bad ka jingim , ym don uno uno u ba leit sha U Kpa lait na nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children , and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , and when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .

translation.en: Then the elders of his city shall call him , and speak unto him : and if he stand to it , and say , I like not to take her  ;
translation.kha: Te ki nongïalam shnong kin khot ïa u bad ïakren bad u . Lada u dang kyntait ban shongkurim ïa ka ,

translation.en: And the three hundred blew the trumpets , and the  Lord  set every man s sword against his fellow , even throughout all the host : and the host fled to Beth–shittah in Zererath , and to the border of Abel–meholah , unto Tabbath .
translation.kha: Katba ki rangbah jong u Gideon ki dang put ïa la ki turoi , U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun ban tur ïaleh para ma ki da la ki waitlam . Ki la mareh sha Sarethan haduh Beth Shittah , haduh ka nongrit jong ka Abel Meholah hajan ka Tabbath .

translation.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  deliver them before me , shall I be your head ?
translation.kha: U Jephthah u ong ha ki ,  Lada phi ïalam biang ïa nga sha ïing ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa nga , nga dei ban long u nongsynshar jong phi .

translation.en: Then Saul , ( who also is called Paul , ) filled with the Holy Ghost , set his eyes on him ,
translation.kha: Te ïa u Saul — ïa uba la khot ruh u Paul — la pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ; u la khmih shlip ïa uta u nongleh myntor bad u la ong ,

translation.en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him , talk ye of all his wondrous works .
translation.kha: Rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; ïathuh ïa ki jingphylla kiba u la leh .

translation.en: Hath walked in my statutes , and hath kept my judgments , to deal truly  ; he is just , he shall surely live , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Uba kum une u briew u kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga bad u sumar biang biang ïa ki aiñ jong nga . U long uba hok , bad un im ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread , and came unto them to Troas in five days  ; where we abode seven days .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit da ka lieng na Philippi hadien ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , bad hadien san sngi ngi la ïasoh ïa ki ha Troas , ha kaba ngi la sah shi taïew .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath , I commanded that the gates should be shut , and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath : and some of my servants set I at the gates , that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ai hukum ban khang ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah ha kaba sdang jong kawei pa kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , tang shu sdang ka por janmiet , bad ban ym plie biang haduh ba ka sngi Sabbaton ka la kut . Nga la pynap katto katne ki rangbah jong nga ha ki khyrdop ban pynthikna ban ym don jingwanrah ei ei shapoh ka nongbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: Behold , I will command , saith the  Lord  , and cause them to return to this city  ; and they shall fight against it , and take it , and burn it with fire : and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ka hukum , bad kin wan biang sha kane ka nongbah . Kin tur ïaleh ïa ka , kin kurup ïa ka , bad thang duh ïa ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ki shnong ka Judah ba kin long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah ha ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And I , and all the people that are with me , will approach unto the city : and it shall come to pass , when they come out against us , as at the first , that we will flee before them ,
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong nga bad ma nga ngin leit tur sha ka nongbah . Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki wan mih pyrshah ïa ngi , ngin phai dien bad ngin phet , kumba ngi la leh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: And I will make the rivers dry , and sell the land into the hand of the wicked : and I will make the land waste , and all that is therein , by the hand of strangers : I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynrngad ïa ka wah Nile bad ngan buh ïa ka Ijipt hapoh ka bor jong ki briew kiba sniew . Ki nongwei kin pynjulor ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Have you already bought your ticket ?
translation.kha: Phi lah thied lypa ka ticket jong phi ?

translation.en: And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains , and defiled his neighbour s wife ,
translation.kha: U bam ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana bad u khroh pynbieit ïa ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki rangbah .

translation.en: And David lifted up his eyes , and saw the angel of the  Lord  stand between the earth and the heaven , having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem . Then David and the elders of Israel , who were clothed in sackcloth , fell upon their faces .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha shiteng suiñ , u da bat ïa la ka waitlam ha la ka kti , uba la pynkhreh ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jerusalem . Nangta u Dabid bad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah — baroh na ki , kiba la phong ki jaiñ khain — ki dem pynrit , bad la ki khlieh kiba kynduh ha madan .

translation.en: Behold , he spreadeth his light upon it , and covereth the bottom of the sea .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka leilieh kylleng ka suiñbneng hynrei ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ka ïailong kaba dum .

translation.en: And it came to pass , afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court , that the word of the  Lord  came to him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Isaïah u leit noh na u syiem , hynrei ha shuwa ba un ïaid lyngba ïa ka phyllaw pdeng ka ïingbishar jong ka ïingsyiem , U  Trai  u ong ïa u

translation.en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth ? behold , the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee  ; how much less this house that I have builded ?
translation.kha: Hynrei me lah mo , A Blei , ban shong shisha ha ka pyrthei ? Wat ka bneng baroh kam biang pura ban ngiam ïa me , kumta kumno ka lah ban long ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan heh haduh katta ?

translation.en: And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
translation.kha: Te u Petros u la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u , bad u la ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba ka long kaba shisha ! U Trai u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyllait ïa nga na ka bor jong u Herod bad na kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jiw ki la khmih lynti ba kan jia .

translation.en: To him give all the prophets witness , that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins .
translation.kha: Baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren shaphang jong u , da kaba ong ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop lyngba ka bor jong ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: But let us , who are of the day , be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love ; and for an helmet , the hope of salvation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi dei ki jong ka sngi , bad ngi dei ban pyngngad . Ngi dei ban kup ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kum ka jingda shadem , bad ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingda khlieh .

translation.en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city : and they told them , saying , We came to the camp of the Syrians , and , behold , there was no man there , neither voice of man , but horses tied , and asses tied , and the tents as they were .
translation.kha: Kumta ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria , ki leit phai sha Samaria bad ki la khot ïa ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop :  Ngi la leit sha ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria bad ngim shym la ïohi ne ïohsngew ïano ïano ; ki kulai bad ki kada kiba dang shah teh , bad ki ïingjaiñ ki long kumjuh kumba ki Syria ki la ieh ïa ki .

translation.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin , after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing , he shall be seen of the priest again :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka pur pat hadien ba u lyngdoh u la khmih bniah ïa u bad u la pynbna ba u long uba khuid , u dei ban leit pyn-i biang ïa lade ha u lyngdoh .

translation.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb : thou art he that took me out of my mother s bowels : my praise shall be continually of thee .
translation.kha: Nga la shaniah ha me shi lynter ka jingim jong nga ; me la ïada ïa nga naduh ka sngi ba la kha ïa nga . Ngan ïai ïaroh ïa me .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses held up his hand , that Israel prevailed : and when he let down his hand , Amalek prevailed .
translation.kha: Katba u Moses u dang rah shajrong ïa la ki kti , ki Israel ki jop , hynrei haba u pynhiar shapoh ïa la ki kti , ki Amalek ki jop .

translation.en: Brethren , I speak after the manner of men ; Though it be but a man s covenant , yet if it be confirmed , no man disannulleth , or addeth thereto .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , ngan pyndonkam ïa ka nuksa kaba ju long man ka sngi : Haba ar ngut ki briew ki ïamynjur halor kano kano ka kam da kaba soi ïa ka soskular , ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lane pyndap ei ei ha ka .

translation.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water : therefore leave off contention , before it be meddled with .
translation.kha: Ka jingsdang ïa ka jingïakajia ka long kum ka jingbthei banyngkong jong ka den-um ; pynsangeh ïa ka ha shuwa ba kan ïaid sha khmat .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme :
translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba ïa ki briew lah ban map ïa ki pop jong ki baroh , bad ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki lah ban ong .

translation.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling , that speaketh better things than that of Abel .
translation.kha: Phi la wan sha U Jisu , uba la pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai , bad sha ka snam ba la synreit , kaba kular bun kiei kiei kiba kham bha ban ïa ka snam u Abel .

translation.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban don khyndiat , kaba la kamai da ka hok , ban ïa kaba ïoh shibun , ba la lum da ka jingbymhok .

translation.en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by , let the first hold his peace .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada don uba shong lang ha ka jingïaseng u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na U Blei , uta uba kren u dei ban sangeh noh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while Apollos was at Corinth , Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus : and finding certain disciples ,
translation.kha: Katba u Apollos u dang don ha Korinth , u Paul u la leit lyngba ïa ki phang kiba shapoh jong ka probins    bad u la poi ha Ephesos . Hangta u la shem katto katne ngut kiba ngeit ,

translation.en: And there shall be no night there  ; and they need no candle , neither light of the sun  ; for the Lord God giveth them light : and they shall reign for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Yn ym don shuh kano kano ka miet , bad kin ym donkam ïa ki sharak lane ïa ka jingshai ka sngi , namar U Trai uba U Blei un long ka jingshai jong ki bad kin synshar kum ki syiem junom la junom .

translation.en: I say again , Let no man think me a fool ; if otherwise , yet as a fool receive me , that I may boast myself a little .
translation.kha: Nga ong pat : wat ai ba uno uno un ñiew ïa nga uba bieit . Hynrei lada phi pyrkhat kumta , la kumno kumno to pdiang ïa nga kum uba bieit , khnang ba ngan don ei ei ban sngewsarong .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that his master s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph  ; and she said , Lie with me .
translation.kha: U Joseph u long uba dap shynrang bad uba bhabriew lymphuin , bad hadien khyndiat por , ka tnga jong u kynrad jong u ka la sdang ban ikwah ïa u Joseph , bad ka la ong ïa u ban leit thiah bad ka .

translation.en: Why are our places of worship called Kingdom Halls ?
translation.kha: Balei la khot ïa ka jaka mane jong ngi ka Ïing Hima ?

translation.en: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet , and their cauls , and their round tires like the moon ,
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka wan haba U  Trai  un shim noh na ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki sngewsarong — ki jingdeng itynnat ba ki deng ha ki matsohlah jong ki , halor ki khlieh jong ki , bad ha ki ryndang jong ki ,

translation.en: And Kinah , and Dimonah , and Adadah ,
translation.kha: ka Kinah , ka Dimonah , ka Adadah ,

translation.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass , and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard , that kept the entrance of the king s house .
translation.kha: Ban bujli ïa ki , u Rehoboam u thaw ïa ki stieh da ka rnong bad aiti ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And David sent out ten young men , and David said unto the young men , Get you up to Carmel , and go to Nabal , and greet him in my name :
translation.kha: kumta u la phah shiphew ngut ki samla shynrang bad ka hukum ban leit sha Karmel , ban wad ïa u Nabal , bad ban ai ka jingkhublei na u .

translation.en: And there followed another angel , saying , Babylon is fallen , is fallen , that great city , because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication .
translation.kha: U angel uba ar u la bud ïa uba nyngkong , u da ong ,  Ka la kyllon ! Ka Babilon Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Ka la pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ kaba khor jong ka jingkwah brai khlem akor !

translation.en: These are murmurers , complainers , walking after their own lusts  ; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men s persons in admiration because of advantage .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kiba khñium bad borabor ki kynnoh ïa kiwei ; ki ïaid kat kum ki jingkwah brai jong ki ; ki kren sarong shaphang ïa lade bad ïaroh arsap ïa kiwei khnang ban ïoh leh ïa kaba ki kwah hi .

translation.en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law , and did obeisance , and kissed him  ; and they asked each other of their welfare  ; and they came into the tent .
translation.kha: kumta u Moses u mih ban leit ïakynduh ïa u , u dem ha khmat jong u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïakylli para ma ki kumno ki ïalong , bad nangta ki la leit sha ka ïingjaiñ jong u Moses .

translation.en: That the saying might be fulfilled , which he spake ,  Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane khnang ba ïa kaei kaba u la lah ong kan urlong shisha :  Ko Pa , ngam shym la duh noh wat uwei ruh na kita ïa kiba me la ai ha nga .  )

translation.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites , and speak unto them , and bring them into the house of the  Lord  , into one of the chambers , and give them wine to drink .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki dkhot jong ka kur Rekhab bad ïakren bad ki . Nangta wallam ïa ki sha kawei na ki kamra ha ka Templ bad tyrwa waiñ ïa ki khyndiat .

translation.en: But and if thou marry , thou hast not sinned ; and if a virgin marry , she hath not sinned . Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh : but I spare you .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phin shongkurim ruh , phim shym la leh pop ; bad lada ka briew ka bym pat shongkurim ka shongkurim noh , kam shym la leh pop . Hynrei ngan jin da la kwah ban pyllait ïa phi na ki jingeh kiba man ka sngi ïa kiba kita kiba la shongkurim kin don .

translation.en: And into whatsoever city ye enter , and they receive you , eat such things as are set before you :
translation.kha: Ha man ba phi leit shapoh ka nongrit bad la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , bam ïa kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi ,

translation.en: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women , and all that could hear with understanding , upon the first day of the seventh month .
translation.kha: Kumta u Esra u wanrah ïa ka sha ka jaka kaba u paidbah u la ïalumlang — ki rangbah , ki kynthei bad ki khynnah kiba la san kiba la lah ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: For Sarah conceived , and bare Abraham a son in his old age , at the set time of which God had spoken to him .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u khun la kha ha ka por ba U Blei u la buh ba yn sa kha ïa u .

translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen , Who is he , and where is he , that durst presume in his heart to do so ?
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Serksis u kylli ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei ,  Mano ba nud ban leh kum ïa kata kaei kaei ? Uei uta u briew ?

translation.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not  ; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh , and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them : wherefore they sold not their lands .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khyndew kaba dei ka jong ki lyngdoh te um shym thied . Kim donkam ban die ïa la ka khyndew namar ba ki ïoh ka baibam kaba thikna na u syiem , bad ki im da kata .

translation.en: They feared the  Lord  , and served their own gods , after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence .
translation.kha: Kumta ki mane ïa U  Trai  , hynrei ki mane ruh ïa la ki blei kat kum ki rukom jong ki hima na kiba ki wan .

translation.en: When I shall bring again their captivity , the captivity of Sodom and her daughters , and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters , then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat — ïa ka Sodom bad ki nongrit jong ka bad ka Samaria bad ki nongrit jong ka . Ho-oid ngan pynmanbha ïa pha ruh .

translation.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching , which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour ;
translation.kha: bad ha ka por kaba biang u la pynpaw ïa ka ha ka khubor jong u . Ïa kane la pynkhamti ha nga , bad nga pynbna ïa ka da ka hukum U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi .

translation.en: For indeed the hand of the  Lord  was against them , to destroy them from among the host , until they were consumed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba un da ïoh pynjot lut ïa baroh .

translation.en: Saying unto them ,  Go into the village over against you , and straightway ye shall find an ass tied , and a colt with her : loose them , and bring them unto me .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka nongrit kaba hangta ha khmat jong phi , bad shisyndon phin shem ïa ka kada kaba la teh lem bad u khun kada hajan jong ka . Loit noh ïa ki bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .

translation.en: As for thee also , by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Namar ka jutang jong nga bad phi kaba la shonshab da ka snam jong ki jingkñia , ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong phi — kaba laitluid na ki thliew bym don um jong ka jingshah ringmraw .

translation.en: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you , because ye go to law one with another . Why do ye not rather take wrong ? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded ?
translation.kha: Ka jingshisha ba phi ïadon ki jingïakajia hapoh ka aiñ hapdeng jong phi hi , ka pyn-i phi la rem nadong shadong . Hato kam kham bha ïa phi ban shah bymdei ? Hato kam kham bha ba phin shah lute noh ?

translation.en: Give not thy strength unto women , nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings .
translation.kha: Wat pynlut ïa la ka bor ha ka jingïathiah shongkha , bad ïa baroh ka pisa jong phi ha ki kynthei ; ki la pynjot ïa ki syiem .

translation.en: Consider the work of God : for who can make that straight , which he hath made crooked ?
translation.kha: Pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . Kumno keiñ uno uno un pynbeit ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkdor .

translation.en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep ai ki jingkñia , u la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joseph was come unto his brethren , that they stript Joseph out of his coat , his coat of many colours that was on him  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u wan ha la ki hynmen shynrang jong u , ki law noh ïa ka sopti jynsur jong u kaba jrong kti .

translation.en: And he lighted upon a certain place , and tarried there all night , because the sun was set  ; and he took of the stones of that place , and put them for his pillows , and lay down in that place to sleep .
translation.kha: Ha ka por sep sngi , u poi sha ka jaka bakhuid bad u la sher dara hangta . U dem ban thiah , u da pynshaniah ïa la ka khlieh halor u maw .

translation.en: I will be surety for him  ; of my hand shalt thou require him : if I bring him not unto thee , and set him before thee , then let me bear the blame for ever :
translation.kha: Ngan bahkhlieh da la ka jingim , bad ngan kitkhlieh na ka bynta jong u . Lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u sha phi bad buh ïa u ha khmat jong phi , ieh ngan kit pop ma nga shi rta .

translation.en: For these be the days of vengeance , that all things which are written may be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Naba kito kin long ‘ Ki Sngi ka Jingpynshitom ,’ ban pynlong ïa baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ban urlong shisha .

translation.en: Flee ye , turn back , dwell deep , O inhabitants of Dedan  ; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him , the time that I will visit him .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Dedan , to phai noh bad phet ! To rieh ! Ngan pynjot ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , namar ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us , for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans , that they might put us to death , and carry us away captives into Babylon .
translation.kha: U Barukh u khun jong u Neraïah u la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa ngi , kumta ki nong Babilonia kin ïa-ïohbor halor jong ngi bad ki lah ban pynïap ïa ngi ne ïalam noh ïa ngi sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Hear , O Israel : The  Lord  our God is one  Lord  :
translation.kha: To sngap ko ki Israel ! U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u long tang ma u hi U  Trai .

translation.en: And say to the forest of the south , Hear the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will kindle a fire in thee , and it shall devour every green tree in thee , and every dry tree : the flaming flame shall not be quenched , and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ka khlaw bashaphang shathie ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : Ha khmih ! Nga pynmeh ïa ka ding , bad kan thang khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng ha phi , la uba jyrngam ne uba tyrkhong . Yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynlip ïa ka . Kan pur na shathie haduh shatei , bad uwei uwei baroh un sngew ïa ka jingkhluit ki thylliej ding .

translation.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him ? and did not one fashion us in the womb ?
translation.kha: Ujuh U Blei uba la thaw ïa nga u la thaw ruh ïa ki shakri jong nga .

translation.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him , We will have no silver nor gold of Saul , nor of his house  ; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel . And he said , What ye shall say , that will I do for you .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ïa ka jingïakajia bad u Saul lem bad ka longïing jong u ym lah ban pynbeit da ka rupa lane ka ksiar , lymne ba ngi kwah ban pynïap ïa uno uno u Israel .   Te , kaei phi pyrkhat ba ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u Dabid u kylli .

translation.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba U Jisu un sdang ïa ka kam jong u , u Ïoannis u la ïalap ha ki paid Israel baroh ba ki dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ban shah pynbaptis .

translation.en: And as he journeyed , he came near Damascus : and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven :
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u la wan poi hajan ka nongbah Damaskos , kynsan ka jingshai na ka sahit bneng ka la thaba lep sawdong ïa u .

translation.en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed : and he divided the people that was with him , and the flocks , and herds , and the camels , into two bands  ;
translation.kha: U Jakob u la sheptieng bad khuslai . U la pynbynta ar kynhun ïa ki briew kiba don lem bad u , bad kumjuh ruh ïa ki langbrot , ki blang , ki jingri bad ki ut .

translation.en: And now , Israel , what doth the  Lord  thy God require of thee , but to fear the  Lord  thy God , to walk in all his ways , and to love him , and to serve the  Lord  thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul ,
translation.kha: Mynta , ko ki paid Israel , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u dawa na phi : Mane ïa U  Trai  bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum . Ieit ïa u , shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .

translation.en: And God looked upon the children of Israel , and God had respect unto them .
translation.kha: U ïohi ïa ka jinglongmraw jong ki Israel , bad u la sngewkhia na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Pekahaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And his brethren by Eliezer  ; Rehabiah his son , and Jeshaiah his son , and Joram his son , and Zichri his son , and Shelomith his son .
translation.kha: Lyngba u Elieser u para jong u Gershom u don ka jingïadei bad u Shelomith . U Elieser u dei u kpa jong u Rehabaïah , uba dei u kpa jong u Jeshaïah , u kpa jong u Joram , u kpa jong u Sikhri , u kpa jong u Shelomith .

translation.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .
translation.kha: U briew uba stad , uba rangbah jingmut u long uba paw ha ka jingshemphang jong u . Katba nang sngewtynnat ki ktien ba u kren , katta u nang lah ban pynkohnguh .

translation.en: And when the men of Israel turned again , the men of Benjamin were amazed : for they saw that evil was come upon them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phai kylla , bad ki Benjamin ki la kulmar hi thlim namar ki sngewthuh ba kin sa shah pynjot .

translation.en: And Jesus stood still , and commanded him to be called . And they call the blind man , saying unto him , Be of good comfort , rise  ; he calleth thee .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la ong ,  Khot ïa u .  Kumta ki la khot ïa uta u briew uba matlah .  To lehkmen !  ki la ong .  Ïeng joit , u khot ïa me .

translation.en: For example , employers often prefer workers who live by the Bible principles of honesty and diligence .
translation.kha: Kum ka nuksa , ki nongaikam ki kham jied ïa ki nongtrei kiba trei hok , kiba minot bad kiba bud ïa ki aiñ jong ka Baibl .

translation.en: How shall we sing the  Lord s  song in a strange land ?
translation.kha: Kumno keiñ ngi lah ban rwai ïa ka jingrwai ha U  Trai ha ka ri nongwei ?

translation.en: Because he hath set his love upon me , therefore will I deliver him : I will set him on high , because he hath known my name .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  Ngan pynim ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , bad ngan ïada ïa kito kiba ithuh ïa nga kum U  Trai .

translation.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the  Lord  , and until it was finished . So the house of the  Lord  was perfected .
translation.kha: Ha kum kane ka por la pyndep ïa ki kam ki jam u Solomon baroh . Naduh kaba seng ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ U  Trai  haduh ka jingpyndep ïa ka , baroh ka kam ka la long kaba jop .

translation.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world , and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes :
translation.kha: Ngi la shem ïa une u briew ba u long ka jingpynwit kaba shyrkhei ; u sdang ïa ka jingkhihwin hapdeng ki Jiw ha kylleng jong ka pyrthei bad u long u nongïalam jong ka kynhun kaba na Nasareth .

translation.en: Behold , this day thine eyes have seen how that the  Lord  had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave : and some bade me kill thee : but mine eye spared thee  ; and I said , I will not put forth mine hand against my lord  ; for he is the  Lord s  anointed .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban shem da lade hi ba dang myntan hapoh ka krem U  Trai  u la buh ïa phi hapoh ka bor jong nga . Katto katne ki rangbah jong nga ki ong ïa nga ban pynïap ïa phi , hynrei nga sngewsynei ïa phi bad ong ba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi , namar phi dei uta uba U  Trai  u la jied ban long syiem .

translation.en: When Israel was a child , then I loved him , and called my son out of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Mynba u Israel u dang khynnah , nga la ieit ïa u , bad nga la khot noh ïa u na Ijipt kum u khun jong nga .

translation.en: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel s father fifty shekels of silver , and she shall be his wife  ; because he hath humbled her , he may not put her away all his days .
translation.kha: uta u briew u dei ban siew ïa u kpa jong kata ka briew sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad kata ka briew kan long ka tnga jong u , namar u la pynbor ïa ka ban ïathiah shongkha bad u . Katba u dang im um lah shuh ban pyllait ïa ka .

translation.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood : two cubits shall be the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: The enemy said , I will pursue , I will overtake , I will divide the spoil  ; my lust shall be satisfied upon them  ; I will draw my sword , my hand shall destroy them .
translation.kha: U nongshun u ong , ‘ Ngan beh kthong bad kem ïa ki , ngan ïabynta ïa ka spah jong ki , bad ngan shim kat ïa kaba nga mon ; ngan sei ïa la ka waitlam , bad ngan shim ïa baroh kaba ki don .’

translation.en: Son of man , wail for the multitude of Egypt , and cast them down , even her , and the daughters of the famous nations , unto the nether parts of the earth , with them that go down into the pit .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  to ïamkthang namar baroh u paidbah babun ka Ijipt . Phah ïa ki ban hiar lem bad ki jaitbynriew badonbor sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: For rulers are not a terror to good works , but to the evil . Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power ? do that which is good , and thou shalt have praise of the same :
translation.kha: Naba ïa ki nongsynshar ym dei ban sheptieng da kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha , hynrei da kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew . Hato phi kwah ban long u bymsheptieng ïa u briew uba don ha ka bor ? Te to leh ïa kaei kaba bha , bad un ïaroh ïa phi ,

translation.en: Oh that I might have my request  ; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for !
translation.kha: Balei U Blei um ai ha nga ïa kaba nga pan ? Balei um jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga ?

translation.en: Can I make a phone call ?
translation.kha: Long ngan call ?

translation.en: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness , ( woe , woe unto thee ! saith the Lord  God   ; )
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Pha long kaba la tim ! Kaba la tim ! Pha la leh ïa kata kaba sniew baroh , bad nangta

translation.en: And , behold , men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy : and they sought means to bring him in , and to lay him before him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la wan da kaba bah ha ka jingthiah ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , bad ki la pyrshang ban rah ïa u shapoh ïing bad ban buh ha khmat jong U Jisu .

translation.en: Mercy unto you , and peace , and love , be multiplied .
translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingisynei , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingieit kan long ha phi ha ka jingthew ba-dap pura .

translation.en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness , unto the mount of the daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Na ka nongbah jong ka Sela ha ka ri shyiap , ki briew jong ka Moab ki phah u khunlangbrot kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta uba synshar ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?
translation.kha: Me la peit bniah ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh kano kano kaba sniew .

translation.en: All the valiant men arose , and went all night , and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth–shan , and came to Jabesh , and burnt them there .
translation.kha: baroh ki riewshlur ki leit bad ki ïaid baroh shi miet sha Beth Shan . Ki shim noh ïa ki met jong u Saul bad jong ki khun shynrang jong u na kata ka kynroh , ki wallam pat ïa ki sha Jabesh , bad ki thang ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: And for Aaron s sons thou shalt make coats , and thou shalt make for them girdles , and bonnets shalt thou make for them , for glory and for beauty .
translation.kha: Suh ki sopti , ki panpoh , bad ki tupia na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron ba kin ishongkun shongkhia bad itynnat .

translation.en: And David s men said unto him , Behold , we be afraid here in Judah : how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki ong ha u ,  Ngi don bun bah ban sheptieng hangne ha Judah ; kan long kaba kham sniew lada ngi leit sha Keilah bad tur ïaleh ïa ki kynhun ïapom jong ki Philistia !

translation.en: The waters wear the stones : thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth  ; and thou destroyest the hope of man .
translation.kha: Ka um ka khrud ïa ki mawsiang , bad u slap uba jur un rong noh ïa ka khyndew ; kumta me pynduh ïa ka jingkyrmen junom .

translation.en: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever , as I promised to David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel .
translation.kha: ngan pynneh junom ïa ka khet syiem jong me ha Israel , kumba nga la kular ha u Dabid u kpa jong me , da kaba ong , ‘ Men ym kyrduh u briew u ban shong ha ka khet Israel .’

translation.en: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength , and smote Jehoram between his arms , and the arrow went out at his heart , and he sunk down in his chariot .
translation.kha: U Jehu u wiat ïa la ka ryntieh bad katba don la ka bor u siat ïa u khnam bad u dei ïa u Joram na shadien bad u ngam haduh u klongsnam jong u . U Joram u kyllon ïap ha ka kali ïapom jong u ,

translation.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shah ïa u ban tip ba phi ieit ïa u da shisha .

translation.en: Until the Ancient of days came , and judgment was given to the saints of the most High  ; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom .
translation.kha: Nangta uta uba la im junom u la wan bad u la pynbna ïa ka jingbishar ha ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei ban pdiang ïa ka bor kaba kynja syiem .

translation.en: Are not Abana and Pharpar , rivers of Damascus , better than all the waters of Israel ? may I not wash in them , and be clean ? So he turned and went away in a rage .
translation.kha: Nalor kata , hato ki wah Abana bad Pharpar kiba ha Damaskos kim kham bha ban ïa kano kano ka wah ha Israel ? nga lah ban sum ha ki bad ban ïohkhiah !

translation.en: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir : and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher :
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah Judah ki la ïaid pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Debir , ha kata ka por la khot kyrteng ka Kiriath Sepher .

translation.en: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret .
translation.kha: U briew uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher , te , u dei ban duwai khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingai ban batai ïa kaei kaba u kren .

translation.en: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon , saith the  Lord  : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam pat ruh ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , lem bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah kiba la leit sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia . Ho-oid , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: I have seen the travail , which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it .
translation.kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingkit bakhia kiba U Blei u la buh halor jong ngi .

translation.en: And Judah gathered themselves together , to ask help of the  Lord  : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: Na kawei pat kawei ka nongbah jong ka Judah ki briew ki leit kloi kloi sha Jerusalem ban pan na U  Trai  ïa ka jingïalam ,

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Behold , I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah , that whosoever heareth of it , both his ears shall tingle .
translation.kha: Kumta nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ngan wallam ka jingjot ha Jerusalem bad Judah ba uwei pa uwei uba ïohsngew shaphang kata un lyngngoh .

translation.en: And when Jesus departed thence , two blind men followed him , crying , and saying , Thou Son of David , have mercy on us .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , bad katba u dang ïaid , ar ngut ki rangbah kiba matlah ki la sdang ban bud ïa u .  To isynei ïa ngi , ko khun u Dabid !  ki la pyrta .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction , therefore thy life shall go for his life , and thy people for his people .
translation.kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha u syiem ,  Kane ka dei ka ktien U  Trai  : ‘ Namar ba me la shah ïa u briew ban lait phet ïa uba nga la hukum ban pynïap , men hap ban siew da la ka jingim , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me yn pynjot namar ba la pyllait ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban lait phet .’

translation.en: And when he was come , the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about , and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul , which they could not prove .
translation.kha: Haba u Paul u la wan , ki Jiw kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki la ïeng sawdong ïa u bad ki la sdang ban buh shibun ki jingmudui kiba khia pyrshah ïa u , ïa kiba kim lah ban pynshisha .

translation.en: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet , and taketh not warning  ; if the sword come , and take him away , his blood shall be upon his own head .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa ka hynrei um suidñiew , bad u nongshun u wan bad pynïap ïa u , te un kit pop hi ïa la ka jong ka jingïap .

translation.en: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image , or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above , or that is in the earth beneath , or that is in the waters beneath the earth :
translation.kha: ‘ Wat thaw durblei ïa lade , lane ïa kaei kaei kaba don ha bneng shajrong , lane ha ka khyndew sha tbian , lane ha ka um hapoh ka khyndew .

translation.en: And killed the Prince of life , whom God hath raised from the dead  ; whereof we are witnesses .
translation.kha: Phi la pynïap ïa uta uba ïalam sha ka jingim , hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap — bad ngi long ki sakhi ïa kane .

translation.en: It is set up in heaven and will rule over this earth .
translation.kha: La seng ïa ka ha bneng bad kan synshar ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles , ministering the gospel of God , that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable , being sanctified by the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga shakri kum u lyngdoh ha kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei , khnang ba ki Jentil ki lah ban long ka jingkñia ba la pdiang sha U Blei , ba la pynkyntang sha u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , In this thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : behold , I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river , and they shall be turned to blood .
translation.kha: Mynta te , ko Syiem Kynrad , U  Trai  u ong ba phin sa tip u long uei da kaei kaba un sa leh . Ha khmih , ngan tied ïa ka sla um da une u diengduh , bad ka um kan kylla snam .

translation.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked : judgment and justice take hold on thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pynshitom kumba phi dei ban ïoh .

translation.en: Now the God of peace be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , un long ryngkat bad phi baroh . Amen .

translation.en: The tree that thou sawest , which grew , and was strong , whose height reached unto the heaven , and the sight thereof to all the earth  ;
translation.kha: U dieng , uba jrong katta katta uba la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , uba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God , which was committed to my trust .
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jinghikai la shem ha ka Gospel ïa kaba la pynkhamti ha nga ban pynbna , ka Khubor Babha na U Blei uba khrawburom bad ba la kyrkhu .

translation.en: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister : and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the  Lord  , and when he cometh out , that he die not .
translation.kha: U Aaron u dei ban phong ïa kane ka barandi haba u shakri kum u lyngdoh . Haba u wan ha khmat jong nga ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang , lane haba u mih nangta , yn ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki shakuriaw , bad un ym shah pynïap .

translation.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet  ; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven .
translation.kha: Ki la kmen namar kata ka jingjai jai , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingma bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka kadlieng kaba ki kwah .

translation.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .

translation.en: And Ebed–melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah , Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords . And Jeremiah did so .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga to buh ïa ki jaiñ rim ha ki ksang ti jong nga , khnang ba ki tyllai kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga .

translation.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning , and expounded it by order unto them , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la ai ha ki ka jingïathuh bniah ïa kaei kaba la jia naduh kaba sdang hi .

translation.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right : but the counsels of the wicked are deceit .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba beit kin lehbha ïa phi ; ki bymman ki kwah tang ban shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .
translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha um dei ban phai dien ban leit shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong u .

translation.en: Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it  ; yea further  ; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .
translation.kha: bad phin ym lah da lei lei ban sngewthuh aïu U Blei u leh . Wat haba phi pyrshang tyngeh ruh , phin ym shem da lei lei . Ki briew kiba stad ki lah ban kam ba ki tip , hynrei kim tip .

translation.en: Their idols are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .
translation.kha: Ïa ki blei jong ki la thaw da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ba la pynwandur da ki kti jong ki briew .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause .
translation.kha: Wat leh shiliang khmat ïa uba duk haba bishar ïa u .

translation.en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence  ; and he that is near shall fall by the sword  ; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine : thus will I accomplish my fury upon them .
translation.kha: Kito kiba sha jngai bah kin ïohpang bad ïap noh ; kito kiba hajan kin ïap ha ka thma ; kito kiba lait im kin ïapthngan . Kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga kaba nga la pynmih lut .

translation.en: Behold , he taketh away , who can hinder him ? who will say unto him , What doest thou ?
translation.kha: U shim kaei kaba u kwah , bad ym don ba lah ban khang ïa u . Ym don uba nud ban kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ?

translation.en: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning , to comfort them for the dead  ; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ban bam lane dih badno badno ban pyntngen ïa u mynba iba ieit bathoiñ i ïap . Ym don mano mano ban pyn-i jingsngewlem , wat ïa uta uba la duh noh ïa la u kpa lane ïa ka kmie .

translation.en: When Jesus heard it , he marvelled , and said to them that followed ,  Verily I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la lyngngoh bad u la ong ha ki briew kiba bud ïa u ,  Nga ong ha phi , ngam pat ju shem ïano ïano ha Israel lem bad ka jingngeit kaba kum kane .

translation.en: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go , and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense : but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem kin leit sha ki blei ha kiba ki ai ïa ki jingkñia bad kin kyang jam sha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Hynrei kito ki blei kin ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba kane ka jingpynjot ka wan .

translation.en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern , and running waters out of thine own well .
translation.kha: To ïaineh bad ka tnga jong phi bad ai ka jingieit tang ïa ka hi .

translation.en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka nong Magdala bad ka Mari ka kmie u Josis ki la khmih bad ïohi hangno ba la buh ïa ka met U Jisu .

translation.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka dei lyngba ka jingngeit ba phi baroh phi long ki khun U Blei ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And Hagar bare Abram a son : and Abram called his son s name , which Hagar bare , Ishmael .
translation.kha: Bad ka Hagar ka la ïoh khun shynrang na u Abram , bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael .

translation.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Put were in thine army , thy men of war : they hanged the shield and helmet in thee  ; they set forth thy comeliness .
translation.kha: Ki shipai na Persia , Lydia , bad Libya ki shakri ha ka kynhun shipai jong pha . Ki wah ïa ki stieh bad ïa ki jingïada khlieh jong ki ha ki jaka shong jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba la pynïohburom ïa pha .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king , that the king said unto him , Wherefore wentest not thou with me , Mephibosheth ?
translation.kha: Haba u Mephibosheth u wan poi na Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem , u syiem u ong ha u ,  Ko Mephibosheth , mem shym la leit bad nga , balei ?

translation.en: That saith to the deep , Be dry , and I will dry up thy rivers :
translation.kha: Da ki ktien ka hukum nga pyntyrkhong ïa ka duriaw-bah .

translation.en: As for Saul , he made havock of the church , entering into every house , and haling men and women committed them to prison .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u la pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka balang , da kaba leit na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat , u da paring shabar ïa ki riewngeit , shynrang bad kynthei , bad u la thep ïa ki sha ka ïingbyndi .

translation.en: Hear diligently my speech , and my declaration with your ears .
translation.kha: Mynta to sngap ïa ki ktien jingbatai jong nga .

translation.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour : and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious , he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u long u samla uba dap shynrang , bad haba u Solomon u ïohi katno ba u long uba trei shitom , u buh ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor ha ka thain jong ki jait Manasseh bad Ephraim .

translation.en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah , and made a king over themselves .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u Jehoram u synshar , ka Edom ka ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Judah , bad ka la kylla long ka hima kaba laitluid .

translation.en: For , behold , I am for you , and I will turn unto you , and ye shall be tilled and sown :
translation.kha: Nga don ha ka liang jong phi , bad ngan pynthikna ba yn lur biang ïa ka khyndew jong phi bad ïa ki symbai yn thung hangta .

translation.en: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias , which perished between the altar and the temple : verily I say unto you , It shall be required of this generation .
translation.kha: naduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Abel haduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Sekharaïah , uba la shah pynïap hapdeng ka duwan bad ka Jaka Bakyntang . Ho-oid , nga ong ha phi , ba ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk yn pynshitom na ka bynta jong ki baroh !

translation.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year .
translation.kha: Kumba ka long , namarkata , ki jingkñia ainguh ki don na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem ban pynkynmaw ïa ki briew shaphang ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple : whom we took , and would have judged according to our law .
translation.kha: U la pyrshang wat ban pyntngit ïa ka Templ , bad ngi la kem ïa u . Ngi la kwah ban bishar ïa u kat kum ka hukum jong ngi .

translation.en: But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David s brother slew him .
translation.kha: U ïeng pyrshah ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah uba shi para bad u Dabid , u pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Wherefore David blessed the  Lord  before all the congregation : and David said , Blessed be thou ,  Lord  God of Israel our father , for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh , u syiem Dabid u ïaroh ïa U  Trai . U ong  A  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ai ba yn ïaroh ïa me junom la junom !

translation.en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you , and a perpetual shame , which shall not be forgotten .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wanrah ha ki ïa ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom junom ïa kaba yn ym klet shuh .

translation.en: And when the king asked the woman , she told him . So the king appointed unto her a certain officer , saying , Restore all that was hers , and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land , even until now .
translation.kha: Haba jubab ïa ka jingkylli u syiem , ka pynthikna ïa ka jingïathuhkhana u Gehasi , bad kumta u syiem u la khot ïa u rangbah synshar bad ong ha u ba un pynphai pat ha ka ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong ka , kynthup ïa ka dor jong ki jingmih na ki lyngkha baroh ha kita ki hynñiew snem kiba ka don shawei pat .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Pekah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah . Then for Zechariah his son , a wise counsellor , they cast lots  ; and his lot came out northward .
translation.kha: U Shelemaïah u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang mihngi , bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u , u briew uba ai ki jingmut kiba bha na ka por sha ka por , u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei .

translation.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me .
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa uwei pat u blei hynrei tang ïa nga .

translation.en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat treikam ei ei .

translation.en: Here is wisdom . Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast : for it is the number of a man  ; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six .
translation.kha: Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingstad . Uno uno uba shemphang u lah ban batai ïa ka jingmut jong u dak jingkheiñ jong u mradkhlaw , namar u dak jingkheiñ u ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u briew . U dak jingkheiñ jong kata ka kyrteng u long hynriewspah hynriewphew hynriew .

translation.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely , neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ai ka jingkular ha ka kyrteng jong nga lada phim don jingmut ban bat ïa ka ; kata ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Until thy brother s anger turn away from thee , and he forget that which thou hast done to him : then I will send , and fetch thee from thence : why should I be deprived also of you both in one day ?
translation.kha: Te ngan sa phah shaw pat ïa me . Balei ngan shu duh ei ïa ki khun shynrang jong nga baroh ar ngut ha kajuh ka sngi ?

translation.en: That this shall be no grief unto thee , nor offence of heart unto my lord , either that thou hast shed blood causeless , or that my lord hath avenged himself : but when the  Lord  shall have dealt well with my lord , then remember thine handmaid .
translation.kha: te phim donkam ban sngew babe lane bynñiaw , ko kynrad , ba phi la pynïap khlem daw lane ba phi la pynhiarkput da lade hi . Bad haba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi , ko kynrad , sngewbha wat klet ïa nga .

translation.en: And he said , Lift up now thine eyes , and see , all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked , speckled , and grisled : for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee .
translation.kha: ‘ Ha khmih’ u la bteng , ‘ Baroh ki  langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki long kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria , bad kiba thohbroin . Nga pynlong ïa kane ban jia namar nga la ïohi ïa baroh kaba u Laban u la leh ïa me .

translation.en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together , and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of their fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin : and he numbered them from twenty years old and above , and found them three hundred thousand choice men , able to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield .
translation.kha: U Syiem Amasaïah u pynbeit ïa baroh ki rangbah jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin ha ki kynhun shipai , kat kum ki kur jong ki , bad u la buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka jingai hukum ïa ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut . Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba arphew snem ne kham ïaw , baroh ki long lai lakh ngut . Ki long ki shipai ba la jied , kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma , kiba tbit ban pyndonkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh .

translation.en: And Moses said , Thou hast spoken well , I will see thy face again no more .
translation.kha: Ka dei kaba phi ong ,  U Moses u jubab .  Phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga lano lano .
