translation.en: And all nations shall call you blessed : for ye shall be a delightsome land , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Te ki briew jong ki hima baroh kin khot ïa phi kiba suk , namar ka ri jong phi kan long ka jaka kaba bha ban shong ban sah .

translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins ,  ( he said unto the sick of the palsy , )  I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy couch , and go into thine house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  Nga ong ha me , to khie joit , shim ïa la ka jingthiah , bad khie leit noh sha ïing !

translation.en: Oh that one would hear me ! behold , my desire is , that the Almighty would answer me , and that mine adversary had written a book .
translation.kha: Hato ym don ba shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ? Nga smai ba kawei pa kawei ka ktien ka long kaba shisha . To ai ba U Blei Badonbor Baroh un jubab ïa nga . Lada kiba pyrshah ïa nga ki wanrah ïa ki jingmudui da kaba thoh ïa ki ngan lah ban ïohi ,

translation.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth ? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall , that he died in Thebez ? why went ye nigh the wall ? then say thou , Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
translation.kha: Phim kynmaw kumno u Abimelekh , u khun jong u Gideon u la shah pynïap ? Ka dei ha Thebes ba ka kynthei ka la pynhap shapoh ïa u mawtylliat na ka kynroh bad la pynïap ïa u . Balei , keiñ , phi leit tur sha jan eh jong ka kynroh ?’ Lada u syiem u kylli ïa kane na phi , ïathuh ïa u , ‘ U Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .’

translation.en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers , and their queens thy nursing mothers : they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth , and lick up the dust of thy feet  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me .
translation.kha: Ki syiem kin long kum ki kpa ïa pha ; ki mahadei kum ki kmie . Kin dem khrup ha khmat jong pha bad kin burom ïa pha ; da kaba pynrit kin pyn-i burom ïa pha . Te phan tip ba nga long U  Trai  ; uba ap ïa ka jingïarap jong nga un ym duh jingkyrmen .

translation.en: And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .
translation.kha: Mynba U Jisu u don marwei , katto katne ngut na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la wan sha u ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad ki la kylli ïa u ban batai ïa ki pharshi .

translation.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man : but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Naba ym don khubor jingïathuhlypa kaba la ju wan tang na ka mon u briew , hynrei ki briew ki la long hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid katba ki dang kren ïa ka khubor kaba la wan na U Blei .

translation.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah , and they shall sell them to the Sabeans , to a people far off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ba ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn die sha ki briew ka Judah ; ma ki kin sa die ïa ki sha jngai sha ki Sabean . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back ? and their mighty ones are beaten down , and are fled apace , and look not back : for fear was round about , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ba nga ïohi ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ki phai dien ha ka jingsheptieng . Ki shipai jong ki , ki shah beh noh ; kiba dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki mareh stet kat lah kat ïai bad kim kyrtiang dien .

translation.en: And now they sin more and more , and have made them molten images of their silver , and idols according to their own understanding , all of it the work of the craftsmen : they say of them , Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves .
translation.kha: Kin nang ïai leh pop shuh shuh da kaba saiñ ïa ki durblei ban mane — ki bleithaw kiba da ka rupa , kiba la saiñdur da ka jingpyrkhat briew , ba la shna da ki kti briew . Bad nangta ki ong ,  Ai ki jingkñia sha ki !  Kumno ki briew kin doh ïa kito ki bleithaw — ki bleithaw ha ka dur ki masi kyrtong !

translation.en: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee , go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone : if he shall hear thee , thou hast gained thy brother .
translation.kha: Lada u para jong me u leh pop pyrshah ïa me , khie leit sha u bad pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingbakla jong u . Hynrei leh ïa ka ha kaba jar jar , kumba tang hapdeng para ma phi . Lada u shahshkor ïa me , me la ïoh pat ïa la u para .

translation.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously , whether he be born in the land , or a stranger , the same reproacheth the  Lord   ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Hynrei mano mano ba leh pop khnang , la ki dei ki traishnong ne ki nongwei , ki long kiba la rem ba kim ñiewkor ïa U  Trai  , bad ki dei ban shah pynïap ,

translation.en: He saith unto him the third time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time , Lovest thou me ? And he said unto him , Lord , thou knowest all things  ; thou knowest that I love thee . Jesus saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .
translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba lai U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa nga ?  U Petros u la sngewsih namar ba U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ha ka sien kaba lai ,  Me ieit ïa nga ?  kumta u la ong ha u ,  Ko Trai , me tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ; me tip ba nga ieit ïa me !  U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To sumar ïa ki langbrot jong nga .

translation.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land : he brake the whole staff of bread .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah  nemsniew sha ka ri jong ki bad u la shim noh ïa baroh ka jingbam jong ki .

translation.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said , It is not reason that we should leave the word of God , and serve tables .
translation.kha: Kumta ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol ki la khot lang ïa ka kynhun riewngeit baroh kawei bad ki la ong ,  Kam long kaba dei ïa ngi ban leh klet ïa ka jingïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei khnang ban pynïaid ïa ka kam pisa tyngka .

translation.en: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold  ; beside ornaments , and collars , and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian , and beside the chains that were about their camels  necks .
translation.kha: Ki sohshkor ksiar ba u Gideon u ïohpdiang ki khia la jan arphew kilo , bad kane kam shym kynthup ïa ki jingdeng , ki kpieng bad ki jaiñ sawbthuh ba ki syiem Midian ki kup , lymne ki jingdeng kiba don sawdong ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .

translation.en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke , he that ruled the nations in anger , is persecuted , and none hindereth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki nongsynshar basniew kiba banbeiñ da ka jingbitar ïa ki briew bad ki bym ju sangeh ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba ki la jop .

translation.en: I speak not of you all : I know whom I have chosen : but that the scripture may be fulfilled , He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me .
translation.kha: Ngam shym kren shaphang jong phi baroh ; nga tip ïa kito kiba nga la jied . Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha , kaba ong , ‘ U briew uba la ïabam lang ïa ka jingbam jong nga u phai pyrshah ïa nga .’

translation.en: For they are the spirits of devils , working miracles , which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world , to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty .
translation.kha: Ki long ki mynsiem jong ki ksuid kiba leh ïa ki kambah . Kine lai tylli ki mynsiem ki leit noh sha ki syiem baroh jong ka pyrthei , ban lumlang ïa ki na ka bynta ka thma ha ka Sngi kaba khraw jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked , and plucked the spoil out of his teeth .
translation.kha: Nga la pynduhbor ïa ki briew kiba shyrkhei bad nga la pyllait ïa kiba shah lehbeiñ na ki .

translation.en: And when I shall put thee out , I will cover the heaven , and make the stars thereof dark  ; I will cover the sun with a cloud , and the moon shall not give her light .
translation.kha: Ynda nga pynjot ïa me , ngan tap ïa ka sahit bneng bad pyndum ïa ki khlur . Ka sngi kan buhrieh sha lyndet ki lyoh , bad u bnai un ym ai jingshai .

translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and behold a basket of summer fruit .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la ïohi shi shang ki soh .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shna ki lum jingtep ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki nongïathuhlypa bad phi pynitynnat ïa ki mot sahkynmaw jong kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ;

translation.en: They shall cast their silver in the streets , and their gold shall be removed : their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the  Lord  : they shall not satisfy their souls , neither fill their bowels : because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity .
translation.kha: Kin bret noh ïa la ka ksiar bad ka rupa ha ki lynti bah kum kiba la kyntait , namar ka ksiar lymne ka rupa kan ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba U  Trai  un theh noh ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u . Kin ym lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynhun ïa ka jingangnud jong ki ne pyndap ïa ki snier jong ki . Ka ksiar bad ka rupa ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingleh pop .

translation.en: They shall die of grievous deaths  ; they shall not be lamented  ; neither shall they be buried  ; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth : and they shall be consumed by the sword , and by famine  ; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Kin ïap na ki jingpang bashyrkhei , bad ym don mano mano ba ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki lane tep ïa ki . Ki met jong ki kin long kum ki kynton sboh halor ka khyndew . Kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane ïap na ka jingïapthngan , bad ki met jong ki kin long ki jingbam ïa ki sim bad ïa ki mradkhlaw .

translation.en: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him : and they sent him away , and his wife , and all that he had .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki briew jong u , kumta ki la shim ïa u Abram bad ki la leit buh ïa u shabar ka ri lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don .

translation.en: And that ye study to be quiet , and to do your own business , and to work with your own hands , as we commanded you ;
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka , ka jingthmu jong phi ban im ka jingim kaba jar jar , ban pyrkhat ïa la ka kam , ban kamai na ka bynta ka jingim jong phi hi , kumba ngi la bthah ïa phi mynshuwa .

translation.en: Fear not : for I am with thee : I will bring thy seed from the east , and gather thee from the west  ;
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng — nga long ryngkat bad phi !  Naduh mihngi bajngai bad sha sepngi bajngai tam , ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: And while they abode in Galilee , Jesus said unto them ,  The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :
translation.kha: Haba ki synran baroh ki la ïawanlang ha Galilaïa , U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u la jan ba un shah aiti ha ki briew ,

translation.en: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother , and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kiba sah na ki shipai jong u hapoh ka jingai hukum uba shi para bad u Abishai , uba pynap ïa ki shipai da kaba phai khmat sha ki Ammon .

translation.en: Having the glory of God : and her light was like unto a stone most precious , even like a jasper stone , clear as crystal  ;
translation.kha: bad ka da phyrnai da ka burom jong U Blei . Ka nongbah ka la phyrnai kum u mawkordor , kum u maw Jasper , kaba shai sngur bha .

translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward , and bear fruit upward :
translation.kha: Kito kiba lait im ha Judah kin roi kin san kum ki jingthung kiba ngam jylliew ki thied ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .

translation.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn , Up , and slay them . But the youth drew not his sword : for he feared , because he was yet a youth .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Jether , u khun nyngkong jong u ,  Khie , pynïap ïa ki !  Hynrei uta u khynnah um shym sei ïa la ka waitlam . Um sngew nud , namar ba u dang long tang u khynnah .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  went further , and stood in a narrow place , where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u angel u leit sha khmat ; u ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khim ha kaba ym don jaka ban ïaid na baroh arliang .

translation.en: For both prophet and priest are profane  ; yea , in my house have I found their wickedness , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki long ki bymriewblei ; nga la lap ïa ki ba ki leh bymman ha ka Templ hi .

translation.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh , and hast fenced me with bones and sinews .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ka met jong nga da ki shyieng , bad ki thied bad me la tap ïa ki shyieng da ki ksah bad ka sniehdoh .

translation.en: Let people serve thee , and nations bow down to thee : be lord over thy brethren , and let thy mother s sons bow down to thee : cursed be every one that curseth thee , and blessed be he that blesseth thee .
translation.kha: To ai ba ki jaitbynriew kin long ki shakri jong me , bad ki briew kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . To men synshar halor ki kur ki jait jong me baroh , bad to ai ba ki khun ki ksiew ka kmie jong me kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . Ai ba kito kiba tim ïa me kin long kiba la tim bad ai ba kito kiba me kyrkhu kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

translation.en: This we will do to them  ; we will even let them live , lest wrath be upon us , because of the oath which we sware unto them .
translation.kha: Ngin hap ban shah ïa ki ba kin im namar ka jingkular jong ngi ; lada ngim leh kumta , U Blei un pynshitom ïa ngi .

translation.en: And a certain scribe came , and said unto him , Master , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: U nonghikai Aiñ u la wan sha u .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la ong ,  Nga la kloi ban leit bad me kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: And the second day they compassed the city once , and returned into the camp : so they did six days .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba ar , ki ïaid tawiar biang ïa ka nongbah shisien bad nangta ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara . Ki la leh kumne haduh hynriew sngi .

translation.en: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword  ; and they that were his arm , that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen .
translation.kha: Kin ïahiar lang bad u sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ban pynïasoh bad kito kiba la khyllem lypa . Bad ïa baroh kiba im hapoh ka jingkah syrngiew jong u , yn pynsakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Then came in all the king s wise men : but they could not read the writing , nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ki la ïawan sha khmat , hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban pule ïa ka jingthoh lane ïathuh ha u syiem aïu ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: Because it is Jehovah’s will that “all sorts of people should be saved and come to an accurate knowledge of truth .” —1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 .
translation.kha: Namarba U Jehobah u “mon ba ki briew baroh kin ioh lait im , bad ba kin poi sha ka jingtip ia ka jingshisha .” —1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 .

translation.en: Ought ye not to know that the  Lord  God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever , even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Dabid ka bym lah ban pynkheiñ , da kaba ai ha u bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u ïa ka jinglong syiem junom halor ki Israel ?

translation.en: And one said , Be content , I pray thee , and go with thy servants . And he answered , I will go .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u pynbor ïa u ban ïaleit lang bad ki ; u la mynjur , bad u ïaleit ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause  ; and deceive not with thy lips .
translation.kha: Wat ïeng sakhi pyrshah ïano ïano khlem ka daw kaba dei , ne wat ong ïa kaei kaei ka ban ïalam bakla shaphang jong u .

translation.en: Blessed is he that waiteth , and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba ïaineh tad haduh ba ki shihajar laispah laiphew san sngi ki kut noh !

translation.en: O my people , remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted , and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal  ; that ye may know the righteousness of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Balak u syiem ka Moab u la thmu ban leh ïa phi bad kumno u Balaam u khun jong u Beor u la jubab ïa u . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei kiba la jia ha lynti na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia sha Gilgal . To kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei bad phin shem ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: And he made bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh khatsan tylli ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: Ponder the path of thy feet , and let all thy ways be established .
translation.kha: Da pyrkhat bha aïu phi leh , bad kat kaba phi leh kan long bha .

translation.en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments , and anoint him , and sanctify him  ; that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Pynkup ïa u Aaron da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh , pynsleh ïa u , bad da kane pynkyntang ïa u , ba u lah ban shakri ïa nga kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites , and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah , and upon the south of Caleb  ; and we burned Ziklag with fire .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit lute ïa ka ri ki Khereth ha ka bynta kaba shathie jong ka Judah bad ïa ka ri jong ka jait u Kaleb , bad ngi la thang ruh ïa ka Siklag .

translation.en: He that chastiseth the heathen , shall not he correct ? he that teacheth man knowledge , shall not he know ?
translation.kha: U mai ïa ki jaitbynriew — hato un ym pynshitom ïa ki ? U long u nonghikai jong ngi baroh — hato un ym don jingtip ei ei ?

translation.en: And Joshua passed from Libnah , and all Israel with him , unto Lachish , and encamped against it , and fought against it :
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Libnah sha Lakhish , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother , unto the church of God which is at Corinth , with all the saints which are in all Achaia :
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Sha ka balang U Blei kaba ha Korinth , bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh kiba ha Akhaïa :

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Zimri saw that the city was taken , that he went into the palace of the king s house , and burnt the king s house over him with fire , and died ,
translation.kha: Haba u Simri u ïohi ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon , u leit sha ka kut kaba shapoh jong ka ïingsyiem , u thang ïa ka ïingsyiem da ka ding bad u la ïap ha ki thylliej ding .

translation.en: And they brought the colt to Jesus , and cast their garments on him  ; and he sat upon him .
translation.kha: Ki la wallam ïa uta u kada ha U Jisu , ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki halor uta u khun kada , bad U Jisu u la shong halor jong u .

translation.en: He is ‘ the god of this world .’—2 Corinthians 4 :4 .
translation.kha: U dei ‘ u blei jong kane ka pyrthei .’—2 Korinth 4 :4 .

translation.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught , that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers .
translation.kha: U dei ban long uba batskhem ïa ka khubor kaba lah ban shaniah bad kaba ïadei bad ka jinghikai shongtynrai . Ha kane ka rukom un lah ban ai mynsiem ïa kiwei da ka jinghikai bashisha bad ban pyn-i ruh ïa ka jingbakla jong kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa ka .

translation.en: He is the chief of the ways of God : he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .
translation.kha: Uba phylla tam na ki jingthaw jong nga baroh ! Tang u Nongthaw jong u , uba lah ban jop ïa u .

translation.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee , Moab  ; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler : for the extortioner is at an end , the spoiler ceaseth , the oppressors are consumed out of the land .
translation.kha: To ngin shong ha ka ri jong ngi . To ïada ïa ngi na kito kiba kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi .  ( Ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingpynjot kin kut , bad kito kiba pynjot ïa ka ri kin jah noh .

translation.en: It seemed good unto us , being assembled with one accord , to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngi la ïakynduh lang bad baroh ngi la ïamynjur ban jied katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien bad phah ïa ki sha phi . Kin ïaleit bad ki paralok ba-ieit jong ngi : U Barnabas bad u Paul ,

translation.en: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod , and could not speak in the Jews  language , but according to the language of each people .
translation.kha: Shiteng na ki khun jong ki , ki kren ïa ka ktien Ashdod lane ïa kiwei ki ktien bad kim tip kumno ban kren ïa ka ktien jong ngi .

translation.en: And now , O God of Israel , let thy word , I pray thee , be verified , which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko Blei ki Israel , to kan long shisha kumta kumba me la kular ha la u shakri , u Dabid u kpa jong nga .

translation.en: Then Abram removed his tent , and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre , which is in Hebron , and built there an altar unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abram u kynriah noh ïa la ka dara , bad u wan shong wan sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre ha Hebron , bad hangta u tei ka duwan ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And he fenced it , and gathered out the stones thereof , and planted it with the choicest vine , and built a tower in the midst of it , and also made a winepress therein : and he looked that it should bring forth grapes , and it brought forth wild grapes .
translation.kha: U la tih ïa ka khyndew bad u la weng ïa ki maw na ka ; u la thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba kynsai . U la tei ka jaka ap phira ban khmih sumar ïa ki , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ban ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ . U la ap ïa ki sohwaiñ ban ih , hynrei uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ u long uba jew .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as I am gone from thee , that the Spirit of the  Lord  shall carry thee whither I know not  ; and so when I come and tell Ahab , and he cannot find thee , he shall slay me : but I thy servant fear the  Lord  from my youth .
translation.kha: Kumno kan long lada U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u rah noh ïa phi sha ka jaka bymtip tang mar ïamih ma nga ? Nangta , haba ngan ïathuh ïa u Ahab ba phi don hangne , bad um lah ban shem ïa phi , un sa pynïap ïa nga . To kynmaw ba nga long uba mane hok ïa U  Trai  naduh ba nga dang khynnah .

translation.en: Lord , now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace , according to thy word :
translation.kha: Mynta , A Trai , me la bat ïa la ka kular , bad men shah ïa u shakri jong me ban leit noh ha kaba suk .

translation.en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty , and kill him .
translation.kha: bad ki la ïapynlong ki jingthmu ban kem ïa U Jisu ha kaba rieh bad ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer , and lay them up without the camp in a clean place , and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation : it is a purification for sin .
translation.kha: Nangta uno uno u briew u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un khat ïa u dpei jong kata ka masi bad buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam shabar ka jaka sher dara , ha kaba dei ban buh kyrpang ïa ka hangta na ka bynta ka kynhun Israel ban pyndonkam ha kaba pynkhreh ïa ka um na ka bynta ka jingweng ïa ka jingbymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam . Ïa kane ka jinglehniam dei ban leh ban weng ïa ka pop .

translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took him out : and the king asked him secretly in his house , and said , Is there any word from the  Lord  ? And Jeremiah said , There is : for , said he , thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Hadien kata u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah khot ïa nga , bad hangta ha ka ïingsyiem u la kylli ïa nga ha kaba jar jar ,  Hato don khubor ei ei na U  Trai  ?   Ka don ,  nga la jubab , bad nga ong shuh shuh ,  Ïa phi yn sa aiti noh ha u syiem ka Babilonia .

translation.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way  ; yet saidst thou not , There is no hope : thou hast found the life of thine hand  ; therefore thou wast not grieved .
translation.kha: Phi pynthait ïa lade ban leit wad ïa kiwei pat ki blei , hynrei phim shym la sangeh . Phi pyrkhat ba ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong phi kin ai bor ïa phi , bad kumta phim ju khie tlot .

translation.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God , and contemned the counsel of the most High :
translation.kha: namar ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hukum jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh bad ki la kyntait ïa ki jingbthah jong u .

translation.en: But his sons shall be stirred up , and shall assemble a multitude of great forces : and one shall certainly come , and overflow , and pass through : then shall he return , and be stirred up , even to his fortress .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ka Syria kin pynkhreh ïa ka thma bad ki ïalum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw . Kawei na ki kan sar kum ka jingshlei um bad kan tur ïaleh ïa ka kut jong u nongshun .

translation.en: Yea , I will make many people amazed at thee , and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee , when I shall brandish my sword before them  ; and they shall tremble at every moment , every man for his own life , in the day of thy fall .
translation.kha: Kaei ba ngan leh ïa me ka pynkyndit ïa shibun ki jaitbynriew . Haba nga talain ïa ka waitlam jong nga , ki syiem kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ha ka sngi ba me kyllon , baroh na ki kin khynñiuh ha ka jingsheptieng na ka bynta ki jingim jong ki .

translation.en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed ? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard ? and how shall they hear without a preacher ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno kin lah ban khot kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta ka jingïarap lada kim shym la ngeit ? Bad kumno kin lah ban ngeit lada kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ? Bad kumno ki lah ban ïohsngew lada ïa ka khubor ym shym la pynbna ?

translation.en: When they stood , these stood  ; and when they were lifted up , these lifted up themselves also : for the spirit of the living creature was in them .
translation.kha: Haba ki kherub ki sangeh , ki shalyntem ruh ki sangeh ; bad haba ki kherub ki her , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki , namar ki kherub ki pynïaid ïa ki .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world , this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga ong skhem ha phi , ba shano shano ba yn ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ban kynmaw ïa ka .

translation.en: This is the law of the house  ; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy . Behold , this is the law of the house .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka hukum jong ka Templ : Baroh ka jaka sawdong jong ka halor jong u lum ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba khuid .

translation.en: And he spake also a parable unto them  ;  No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old  ; if otherwise , then both the new maketh a rent , and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  Ym don uno uno uba tar ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim . Lada u leh kumta , un tar ïa ka jaiñ bathymmai , bad kata ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ym ïadei ïa kaba rim .

translation.en: Not as though I had already attained , either were already perfect : but I follow after , if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kam ba nga la ïoh jop lypa lane ba la pynlong janai lypa . Nga ïai ïaleh shitom ban ïoh ïa ka prais ïa kaba U Khrist Jisu u la ïoh ïa nga sha lade hi .

translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore , thou , and thy seed after thee in their generations .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Me ruh me dei ban mynjur ban bat ïa ka jutang bad nga , ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ban wan .

translation.en: And Joab said unto him , Thou shalt not bear tidings this day , but thou shalt bear tidings another day : but this day thou shalt bear no tidings , because the king s son is dead .
translation.kha: Em ,  u Joab u jubab ,  mynta ka sngi men ym rah kano kano ka khubor babha . Ha kawei pat ka sngi me lah ban leh kumta , hynrei ym mynta , naba u khun jong u syiem u la ïap .

translation.en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief , and said unto him , Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection , according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the  Lord  , and of the congregation of Israel , for the tabernacle of witness ?
translation.kha: kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada , u nongïalam jong ki , bad u dawa ,  Balei ba phim peit ïa kane ba ki Lebi ki lum na Judah bad Jerusalem ïa ka khajna kaba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la pan na ki briew ban siew ïa ka ban kyrshan ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ?

translation.en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias , which saith , By hearing ye shall hear , and shall not understand  ; and seeing ye shall see , and shall not perceive :
translation.kha: Kumta ka jingïathuhlypa jong u Isaïah ka la treikam ha ki :   ‘ Kine ki briew kin shahshkor bad ïai shahshkor , hynrei kim shemphang ; kin khmih bad ïai khmih , hynrei kim ïohi ,

translation.en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased , they ceased in Israel , until that I Deborah arose , that I arose a mother in Israel .
translation.kha: Deborah , ki nongrit jong ka Israel ki sah kynjah , Ki ïeng thylli tad ynda pha wan , Pha wan kum ka kmie ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion , that they should believe a lie :
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u phah ïa ka bor ka jingbakla ban trei ha ki khnang ba kin ngeit ïa kaei ka bymshisha .

translation.en: For now they shall say , We have no king , because we feared not the  Lord   ; what then should a king do to us ?
translation.kha: Kine ki briew shen kin sa ong ,  Ngim don syiem , namar ngim shym la sheptieng ïa U  Trai . Hynrei kaei kaba u syiem un lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ngi ?

translation.en: When she had heard of Jesus , came in the press behind , and touched his garment .
translation.kha: Ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , kumta ka la wan ryngkat bad u paidbah nadien jong u ,

translation.en: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them , and said , What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel ? And they answered , Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath . And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither .
translation.kha: Kumta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad khot lang ïa baroh san ngut ki syiem Philistia bad kylli ïa ki ,  Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel ?   Leit rah ïa ka sha Gath ,  ki la jubab ; kumta ki bah ïa ka sha Gath , kawei pat ka nongbah ki Philistia .

translation.en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night  ; yea , with my spirit within me will I seek thee early : for when thy judgments are in the earth , the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness .
translation.kha: Mynmiet nga thrang ïa me da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ; haba me bishar ïa ka pyrthei bad ki briew jong ka , baroh kin tip kaei ka long ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka khubor shaphang u Jisu ka la phriang stet kylleng ka probins jong ka Galilaïa .

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake , and said , Blessed be the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , who hath sent his angel , and delivered his servants that trusted in him , and have changed the king s word , and yielded their bodies , that they might not serve nor worship any god , except their own God .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ! U la phah ïa u angel jong u bad pyllait im ïa kine ki rangbah kiba la shakri bad shaniah ha u . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga bad ki la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban ïa kaba dem ngon bad mane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang u jong ki hi .

translation.en: And of some , that Elias had appeared  ; and of others , that one of the old prophets was risen again .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ba u Elijah u la mihpaw , bad sa kiwei pat ki ong ba uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim u la mihpat .

translation.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,
translation.kha: Mynta , bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka por ? Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba ïashong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat ,

translation.en: Beside their genealogy of males , from three years old and upward , even unto every one that entereth into the house of the  Lord  , his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses  ;
translation.kha: Ki ai bynta ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba laiphew snem ka rta ne kham ïaw kiba don jingkitkhlieh man ka sngi ha ka Templ kat kum ki kyrdan jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall make thee the head , and not the tail  ; and thou shalt be above only , and thou shalt not be beneath  ; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , which I command thee this day , to observe and to do them :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi ki nongïalam napdeng ki jaitbynriew bad ym ki nongbud ; phin ïai manbha bad phin ym kyrduh lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that , as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka sngi kan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban sdang ban burom ïa me kum u riewkhraw , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long lem ryngkat bad me kumba nga la long bad u Moses .

translation.en: As for his father , because he cruelly oppressed , spoiled his brother by violence , and did that which is not good among his people , lo , even he shall die in his iniquity .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka liang , u kpa jong u , u la shukor bad lute bad u ïai leh ïa kaba sniew ha uwei pa uwei baroh . Bad kumta u la ïap namar ki pop kiba ma u hi u la leh .

translation.en: And David spake unto the  Lord  the words of this song in the day that the  Lord  had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies , and out of the hand of Saul :
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u Dabid na u Saul bad na kiwei pat ki nongshun , u Dabid u la rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the  Lord  out of all nations upon horses , and in chariots , and in litters , and upon mules , and upon swift beasts , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , saith the  Lord  , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kin wallam pat ïa baroh ki para kur ki para jait jong phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa nga . Kin wallam ïa ki sha u lum bakyntang jong nga ha Jerusalem ha ki kulai , ki khashor bad ha ki ut , bad ha ki kali ïapom bad ki kali kit jingkit , kumba ki Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingainguh bam sha ka Templ ha ki khiew lehniam kiba khuid .

translation.en: And he dealt to every one of Israel , both man and woman , to every one a loaf of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine .
translation.kha: U ai ha uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ha kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha Israel ïa u kpu bad ka dohthang bad katto katne ki soh Khajur .

translation.en: Now when the turn of Esther , the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai , who had taken her for his daughter , was come to go in unto the king , she required nothing but what Hegai the king s chamberlain , the keeper of the women , appointed . And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la dei na ka bynta ka Esther ban leit sha u syiem . Ka Esther — ka khun u Abihail bad ka bakha jong u Mordekai , uba la ri ïa ka kum la ka khun ; ka Esther — ïa kaba la ïaroh da baroh kiba ïohi ïa ka . Haba ka por jong ka , ka la poi , ka la riam thik kumba u Hegai , uta u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki kynthei , u la ai jingmut ïa ka ban riam .

translation.en: I have made the earth , and created man upon it : I , even my hands , have stretched out the heavens , and all their host have I commanded .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad pynlong ïa ki briew ban shong hangta . Da ka bor jong nga , nga pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; nga pynïaid ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur .

translation.en: We eat together every evening .
translation.kha: Ngi bam lang man ka janmiet .

translation.en: What are you buying ?
translation.kha: Phin leit thied aiu ?

translation.en: And likewise a Levite , when he was at the place , came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Lebi ruh u la wan ïaid , u la ïaid nalor bad u la khmih ïa uta u briew , bad nangta u la ïaid lait , na kawei ka liang .

translation.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar–jesus :
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid sha shiliang ka dewlynnong sha Paphos , ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ïa uwei u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Bar Jisu , u Jiw uba la kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: As the bird by wandering , as the swallow by flying , so the curse causeless shall not come .
translation.kha: Ki jingtim kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi lait tang haba phi dei hok ban ïoh ïa ki . Ki long kum ki sim kiba her bad ki bym ju shongneh .

translation.en: And he smote the men of Beth–shemesh , because they had looked into the ark of the  Lord  , even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men : and the people lamented , because the  Lord  had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynïap hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah kiba na Beth Shemesh namar ba ki khmih shapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang . Bad u paidbah u ïam pangnud namar ba U  Trai  u la pynjia kat kata ka jingpynïap hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: And Enoch walked with God : and he was not  ; for God took him .
translation.kha: U la pynlut la ka jingim ha kaba ïasyllok bad U Blei , bad hadien kata u la jah noh , namar U Blei u la shim noh ïa u .

translation.en: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , that made us this soul , I will not put thee to death , neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Sedekaïah u la kular ïa nga ha kaba rieh ,  Nga smai da U Blei uba im , U Blei uba ai jingim ïa ngi , ba ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lane ai noh ïa phi sha ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun , and the rest that were chosen , who were expressed by name , to give thanks to the  Lord  , because his mercy endureth for ever  ;
translation.kha: Hangta bad ki la don u Heman bad u Jeduthun bad kiwei ïa kiba la jied kyrpang ban rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit bymjukut jong u .

translation.en: And said unto the king , Let the king live for ever : why should not my countenance be sad , when the city , the place of my fathers  sepulchres , lieth waste , and the gates thereof are consumed with fire ?
translation.kha: Nga la kyndit bad nga jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , to im junom ! Kumno ngan lah khlem imat sngewsih haba ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong nga ka don hapdeng ki jingjot bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynjot ha ka ding ?

translation.en: For their feet run to evil , and make haste to shed blood .
translation.kha: Kim lah ap ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew . Ki long borabor kiba kloi ban pynïap .

translation.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion , they shall roar like young lions : yea , they shall roar , and lay hold of the prey , and shall carry it away safe , and none shall deliver it .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki kyrhuh kum ki sing kiba la pynïap ïa ka mrad bad kiba la rong ïa ka sha ka jaka ha kaba ym don ba lah ban knieh ïa ka na ki .

translation.en: We shall find all precious substance , we shall fill our houses with spoil :
translation.kha: Ngin ïoh kurup ïa ki markordor kiba har rukom bad pyndap ïa la ki ïing da ki mar lute !

translation.en: But God be thanked , that ye were the servants of sin , but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you .
translation.kha: Hynrei long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei! Naba wat mynshuwa haba phi la long ki mraw jong ka pop , phi la kohnguh da la ka dohnud baroh ïa ki jingshisha ba la shem ha ka jinghikai kaba phi la ïohpdiang .

translation.en: Thou hast heard , see all this  ; and will not ye declare it ? I have shewed thee new things from this time , even hidden things , and thou didst not know them .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba nga la ïathuh lypa , mynta ki la urlong ; phi hap ban pdiang ba ki jingïathuh lypa jong nga ki long kiba dei . Mynta ngan ong ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai ki ban wan , ki jingjia kiba ngam shym la pynpaw mynshuwa .

translation.en: Tom hit me first .
translation.kha: U Tom u shoh shwa ianga .

translation.en: For he that is entered into his rest , he also hath ceased from his own works , as God did from his .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular , un shongthait na ka kam jong u hi , kumba U Blei u la shongthait na ka kam jong u .

translation.en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me , and find you unprepared , we ( that we say not , ye ) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting .
translation.kha: Pynban , lada ki briew na Makedonia kin wan bad nga bad kin shem ba phim pat long kiba la kloi , katno kan long ka jingpynlehrain ïa ngi — khlem da kren ïa ka jinglehrain ïa phi — naba ngi la shaniah katta ïa phi!

translation.en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places : how are the mighty fallen !
translation.kha: Halor ki lum ka Israel ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ïap ! Kiba shlur tam na ki shipai jong ngi , ki la kyllon !

translation.en: So Rabshakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u la tip ba u patsha u la leit sha Lakhish bad u dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Libnah ka nongbah ba-marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban ïasyllok bad u .

translation.en: Thinkest thou this to be right , that thou saidst , My righteousness is more than God s ?
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei , ko Job , na ka bynta jong me ban ong ba me long uba lui lui ha khmat U Blei ,

translation.en: I thank my God always on your behalf , for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh borabor ïa U Blei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei ïa kaba u la ai ha phi da U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Which in his times he shall shew , who is the blessed and only Potentate , the King of kings , and Lord of lords ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynpaw jong u yn wallam da U Blei ha ka ïa kaba biang , uba la kyrkhu bad tang ma u hi , U Nongsynshar , U Syiem jong ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Full well ye reject the commandment of God , that ye may keep your own tradition .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la bteng da kaba ong ,  Phi don ka rukom basian jong ka jingkyntait ïa ka hukum U Blei ban pynneh ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai hi .

translation.en: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it . It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : every one that toucheth them shall be holy .
translation.kha: Ha ki por ki ban wan baroh uno uno na ki shynrang kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki lah ban bam ïa ka pateng la pateng kum ka bynta na ki jingkñia ainguh bam sha U  Trai . Uno uno uwei pat uba ktah ïa ka jingainguh bam un mynsaw na ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ka .

translation.en: Now therefore the wheat , and the barley , the oil , and the wine , which my lord hath spoken of , let him send unto his servants :
translation.kha: Kumta mynta to phah sha ngi ïa u kew , u barli , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba phi la kular .

translation.en: I will open rivers in high places , and fountains in the midst of the valleys : I will make the wilderness a pool of water , and the dry land springs of water .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki wah ban tuid hapdeng ki lum bymseisoh bad ka um ha ki wahduid kan tuid ha ki jaka them . Nga pynkylla ïa ki jaka shyiap sha ki pukri um bad ki dewryngkhiang sha ki umpohliew batuid .

translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  , even thou only .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria , kumta ba baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi me long U Blei .

translation.en: Come ye , say they , I will fetch wine , and we will fill ourselves with strong drink  ; and to morrow shall be as this day , and much more abundant .
translation.kha: ‘ Ïa ngin ïawad waiñ khyndiat ,’ kine ki nongdih kyiad ki ong , ‘ bad dih katba ngi lah ! Lashai kan kham palat ban ïa kaba mynta !’

translation.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki long ki jaka phlang ha kaba la bsa ïa ki , ha kaba ki wad ïa kano kano kaba jyrngam ban bam .

translation.en: Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon  ; there shalt thou be delivered  ; there the  Lord  shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .
translation.kha: To phai bad to ud , ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , kum ka briew ka ban sa kha khun , naba mynta phin sa hap ban ieh ïa ka nongbah bad ban im ha rudnong . Phi dei ban leit sha Babilon , hynrei hangta U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And the woman came unto Saul , and saw that he was sore troubled , and said unto him , Behold , thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice , and I have put my life in my hand , and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka leit sha u , bad haba ka ïohi ba u la sheptieng , kumta ka ong ha u ,  Sngewbha kynrad , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim da kaba leh ïa kaei ba phi ong .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread : and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the  Lord . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Manoah um shym tip ba u dei u angel jong U  Trai  , kumta u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha wat nym pat leit . Ai ba ngin ïoh shet uwei u khunblang na ka bynta jong phi .  Hynrei u angel u ong ,  Lada nga dei ban ap , ngan nym bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei lada phi kwah ban pynkhreh ïa ka , thang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And in their mouth was found no guile : for they are without fault before the throne of God .
translation.kha: Ym ju lap ïa ki ba ki ïathuh lamler ; ki long kiba khlem thohbria .

translation.en: And now , though thou wouldest needs be gone , because thou sore longedst after thy father s house , yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods ?
translation.kha: Nga tip ba me mihnoh namar ba me kynmaw ïing eh , hynrei balei pat me tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong nga ?

translation.en: And a stone was brought , and laid upon the mouth of the den  ; and the king sealed it with his own signet , and with the signet of his lords  ; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel .
translation.kha: Ïa u maw la buh halor ka jaka rung shapoh ka thliew , bad u syiem u la buh ïa ka muhor syiem jong u bad ka jong ki rangbah donburom jong u halor jong u maw , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyllait im ïa u Daniel .

translation.en: In the  Lord  shall all the seed of Israel be justified , and shall glory .
translation.kha: Nga , U  Trai  , ngan pyllait im ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , bad kin ai ka jingïaroh ïa nga .

translation.en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled , ye careless women : for the vintage shall fail , the gathering shall not come .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban sngewhun mynta , hynrei kum ha kane ka por ha ka snem ka ban wan , phin long ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen namar yn ym don sohwaiñ ba phin ïohlum .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the  Lord  thy God : because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever , therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ! U la pynpaw kaba katno u sngewbha ïa phi da kaba pynlong ïa phi u syiem u ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jong u . Namar ba u ieit ïa ki briew jong u , ki Israel , bad u kwah ban pynneh ïa ki junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban pynneh ïa ka hukum bad ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto them , Pass over before the ark of the  Lord  your God into the midst of Jordan , and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder , according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: bad u ong ha ki ,  Khie leit sha ka Jordan ha shuwa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Uwei pa uwei na phi un bah ïa u maw ha la ka tyrpeng jong phi , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .

translation.en: O  Lord  , there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , ym don uwei pat kum ma me ; ngi tip borabor ba me long tang ma me marwei U Blei .

translation.en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over , and set in the cities of Samaria , and the rest that are on this side the river , and at such a time .
translation.kha: ryngkat bad kiwei ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba u Ashurbanipal bakhraw bad badonbor , u la pynkynriah ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki bad pynsah ïa ki ha ka nongbah Samaria bad shawei shaei ha ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .

translation.en: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce  ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .
translation.kha: Long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar jong ki , Naba ka long kaba ishyrkhei ; Bad long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar shla jong ki , Naba ka long kaba shyrkhei katta katta . Kylleng ka ri Israel ngan pynsakma ïa ki , Bad hapdeng ki briew jong ka ngan pynsakma ïa ki .

translation.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant  ; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations  ;
translation.kha: Wat klet ïa ka jutang U Blei , kaba u la pynlong ban neh junom ,

translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king said , Behold , he is in your hand : for the king is not he that can do any thing against you .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la jubab ,  To leh te ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban leh ïa u ; ngam lah ban khang ïa phi .

translation.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird loose into the open field .
translation.kha: Un synreit ruh hynñiew sien ïa kata ka snam ha ka met uta u briew ïa uba yn dang pynkhuid na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad hadien kata un sa pynbna ba u long uba khuid . Un pyllait noh ïa kata ka sim kaba dang im ba kan her kat shaba ka mon .

translation.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you .
translation.kha: Ym shym la leh da U Blei , uba la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: I heard that he could even translate from Ancient Hebrew .
translation.kha: Nga iohsngew ba u lah ban pynkylla ktien na ka hebrew hyndai .

translation.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them : and a great number believed , and turned unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la long lem bad ki , bad kiba bun ki briew ki la ngeit bad ki la phai sha U Trai .

translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto them , Would to God we had died by the hand of the  Lord  in the land of Egypt , when we sat by the flesh pots , and when we did eat bread to the full  ; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness , to kill this whole assembly with hunger .
translation.kha: Kan jin da la bha ba U  Trai  u shoh ïap ïa ngi ha ri Ijipt . Hangta , la kumno kumno , ngi dang ïoh ban shong bad bam doh bad kyrhai ka jingbam kat kaba ngi kwah . Hynrei phi la wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri shyiap ban pynïapthngan ïa ngi baroh .

translation.en: And he said unto his men , The  Lord  forbid that I should do this thing unto my master , the  Lord s  anointed , to stretch forth mine hand against him , seeing he is the anointed of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  To U  Trai  un bat ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa u kynrad jong nga , ïa uba U  Trai  u la jied kum u syiem ! Ngam dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u , naba u dei u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai  !

translation.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return  ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat kin shong hapoh ka jingïada jong nga . Kin thung ïa u kew bad seisoh kum ka bri sohwaiñ . Kin pawnam kum ka waiñ jong ka Lebanon .

translation.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary , and they shall come near to my table , to minister unto me , and they shall keep my charge .
translation.kha: Dei tang ma ki , ki ban rung ha ka Templ jong nga , ban shakri ha ka duwan jong nga , bad ban pynïaid ïa ka jingmane ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir .
translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ka Gilead ha ki Makhir kiba na ka jait Manasseh .

translation.en: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart , having no necessity , but hath power over his own will , and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin , doeth well .
translation.kha: Khlemlait lada u briew , daym pynbor ban leh kumta , u la kut jingmut skhem ban ym shongkurim , bad lada ïa la ka mon u lah ban synshar bad ba u la rai kut ha ka jingmut jong u ïa kaei kaba un leh — te u leh ïa kaba dei ban ym shongkurim kata ka theisotti .

translation.en: Then commanded Belshazzar , and they clothed Daniel with scarlet , and put a chain of gold about his neck , and made a proclamation concerning him , that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u Belshassar u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri jong u ban pynphong ïa u Daniel ha ka jaiñkup syiem kaba sawbthuh bad ban pyndeng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u . Bad u la pynlong ïa u , uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .

translation.en: Forbidding to marry , and commanding to abstain from meats , which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth .
translation.kha: Kiba kum kita ki briew ki hikai ba ka long ka bym dei ban shongkurim bad ban bam kyndiah ïa ki katto katne ki jait jingbam . Hynrei U Blei u la thaw ïa kito ki jingbam ban bam , hadien ka jingduwai sngewnguh , da kito kiba long kiba ngeit bad kiba la tip ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily , eateth and drinketh damnation to himself , not discerning the Lord s body .
translation.kha: Naba , lada um tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka met jong U Trai haba u bam ïa u kpu bad dih na ka khuri , u wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha lade hi katba u dang bam bad dih .

translation.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured  ; and all thine adversaries , every one of them , shall go into captivity  ; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil , and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , baroh kiba klun ïa phi kin shah klun , bad ïa baroh ki nongshun jong phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa phi yn banbeiñ , bad ïa baroh kiba lute ïa phi yn lute .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall smite Egypt : he shall smite and heal it : and they shall return even to the  Lord  , and he shall be entreated of them , and shall heal them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki Ijipt , hynrei pynban un pynkhiah ïa ki . Kin phai sha u , bad un ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad pynkoit ïa ki .

translation.en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone : and there was a rainbow round about the throne , in sight like unto an emerald .
translation.kha: Ka durkhmat jong u ka phyrnai kum ki mawkordor , kum u Jasper bad u Karnelian , bad baroh sawdong ka khet la don u simpyllieng uba don ka rong kum ka jong u Emerald .

translation.en: The breaker is come up before them : they have broken up , and have passed through the gate , and are gone out by it : and their king shall pass before them , and the  Lord  on the head of them .
translation.kha: U Blei un plie ïa ka lynti na ka bynta jong ki bad un ïalam noh ïa ki na ka jingshah ringmraw . Kin mih bran na ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad kin long kiba laitluid . U syiem jong ki , U  Trai  da lade hi , un ïalam ïa ki shabar .

translation.en: Which when Jesus perceived , he said unto them ,  O ye of little faith , why reason ye among yourselves , because ye have brought no bread ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la ïakren , kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei ba phi ïakren para ma phi shaphang ka jingbymdon jingbam ei ei ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !

translation.en: Behold , it is written before me : I will not keep silence , but will recompense , even recompense into their bosom ,
translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut lypa ban pynshitom ïa ki , bad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki la dep buh jingthoh . Ngan ym leh bym ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , hynrei ngan siew kylliang ïa ki

translation.en: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them ,  They that are whole have no need of the physician , but they that are sick : I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab ,  Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang . Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew kiba donburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the plowman shall overtake the reaper , and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed  ; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine , and all the hills shall melt .
translation.kha: Ki sngi ki la poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba u kew un san stet ban ïa kaba lah ban ot , bad ki sohwaiñ kin san stet ban ïa ka waiñ ba lah ban shna . Ki lumbah kin jaw da ka waiñ kaba thiang , bad ki lumrit kin tuid da ka .

translation.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance : for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great .
translation.kha: Nga kloi ban phah ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad ïarap lem ïa ki jong phi ha kaba pynkhreh shibun ki dieng , namar kane ka Templ kaba nga mut ban tei kan long kaba khraw bad kaba ishongkun .

translation.en: The wise men are ashamed , they are dismayed and taken : lo , they have rejected the word of the  Lord   ; and what wisdom is in them ?
translation.kha: Ïa ki rangbah bastad jong phi la buh ha ka jinglehrain ; ki la shaïong bad shah riam . Ki la kyntait ïa ki ktien jong nga ; ka jingstad kaba kumno ki la ïoh mynta ?

translation.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king s most noble princes , that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour , and bring him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaim before him , Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour .
translation.kha: Nangta shim ïa uwei na ki riewdonburom uba don ka kyrdan ba-halor eh ban pynriam ïa uta u briew da kine ki jingriam bad un ïalam ïa u , ba la pynshong halor u kulai lyngba ka jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah . Ai ba uta u riewdonburom un pyrta katba ki nang ïaid : ‘ Peit kumno u syiem un ainong ïa u briew uba u kwah ban pyndonburom !’

translation.en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body , she did it for my burial .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka la leh ka long ban theh ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih ha ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh ïa nga na ka bynta ban tep .

translation.en: And the burden of the  Lord  shall ye mention no more : for every man s word shall be his burden  ; for ye have perverted the words of the living God , of the  Lord  of hosts our God .
translation.kha: Kumta kim dei shuh ban pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’ namar lada uno uno u leh kumta , ngan pynlong ïa ka khubor jong nga ka jingkit kaba khia shisha ïa u . Ki briew ki la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki ktien U Blei jong ki , U Blei uba im , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: But Rabshakeh said , Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words ? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall , that they may eat their own dung , and drink their own piss with you ?
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Phi tharai ba ma phi bad u syiem ki long tang kita kiba u patsha u la phah ïa nga ban kren ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Em , nga kren ruh ha ki briew kiba shong ha ka kynroh , kiba hap ban bam ïa la ka jakhlia bad dih ïa la ka um pynjhieh , kumba phi ruh phi hap ban leh kumta .

translation.en: Yea , he loved the people  ; all his saints are in thy hand : and they sat down at thy feet  ; every one shall receive of thy words .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa la ki briew , bad u ïada ïa la ki jong . Kumta ngi dem ha ki kjat jong u , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: For we are made partakers of Christ , if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end  ;
translation.kha: Naba ngi long baroh ki nongïoh bynta bad U Khrist lada ngi batskhem haduh kaba kut ïa kata ka jingsngewskhem kaba ngi la don naduh kaba sdang .

translation.en: And one goat for a sin offering , to make an atonement for you .
translation.kha: Kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: And their border went up toward the sea , and Maralah , and reached to Dabbasheth , and reached to the river that is before Jokneam  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u pud jong ka u suh beit shaphang sepngi shaduh Mareal , da kaba ktah ïa ka Dabbesheth bad ïa ka wahduid kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jokneam .

translation.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments  ; for therein do I delight .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa nga ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar ha ki nga shem ka jingkmen .

translation.en: But I say unto you , Swear not at all  ; neither by heaven  ; for it is God s throne :
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : wat pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai da ka bneng , naba ka long ka khet jong U Blei ;

translation.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant , and on them that are out of the way  ; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity .
translation.kha: Namar u hi u long uba tlot ha kiba bun rukom , u lah ban long uba jemnud bad kito ki bym don ka jingtip bad kiba leh bakla .

translation.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions abide me .
translation.kha: Kaba nga tip ka long ba ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la maham ïa nga ba ka byndi bad ki jingjynjar ki ap ïa nga .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel , and prophesy against them ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew  u la ong ,  phai khmat sha ki lum ka Israel , bad to ai ïa ka khubor jong nga ha ki .

translation.en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days , he went down unto Caesarea  ; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la sah sa phra ne shiphew sngi lem bad ki bad nangta u la leit sha Kaisaria . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la shong ha ka kamra bishar bad u la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa u Paul .

translation.en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of glory , may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him :
translation.kha: Nga kynmaw ïa phi ha ki jingduwai jong nga ; bad nga kyrpad na U Blei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , u Kpa uba dap da ka burom , ba un ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem , u ban pynlong ïa phi kiba stad bad un pynpaw ha phi ïa U Blei , khnang ba phin ïoh tip ïa u .

translation.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : for they did not drive them out .
translation.kha: Ki paid Asher ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka naba kim shym la beh ïa ki .

translation.en: She said moreover unto him , We have both straw and provender enough , and room to lodge in .
translation.kha: Don shibun u phlangïap bad ka jingbam ïa ki jingri ha ïing jong ngi , bad don ruh ka jaka na ka bynta jong phi ban sah .

translation.en: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab , the ruler of part of Beth–haccerem  ; he built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
translation.kha: U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Rekhab , u nongsynshar ïa ka Beth Hakkherem distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Synrum . U pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , pynkyntang ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka .

translation.en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said , Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la don ha ka jingjynjar haba la bthah ba ki dei ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la ju shna mynshuwa .

translation.en: Therefore it shall come to pass , that as all good things are come upon you , which the  Lord  your God promised you  ; so shall the  Lord  bring upon you all evil things , until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
translation.kha: Hynrei kumba u la bat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha phi , kumta ruh un pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingbyrngem .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam .
translation.kha: Bad baroh kiei kiei kiba u Abijah u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: Then did they spit in his face , and buffeted him  ; and others smote him with the palms of their hands ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki la bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u bad ki la shoh ïa u ; bad kito kiba la thab ïa u

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred , and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten , to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ka nongbah ha Israel ka phah noh shihajar ngut ki shipai , hynrei tang shispah ngut ki wan phai ; kawei pat ka nongbah ka phah shispah ngut , hynrei tang shiphew ngut ki wan phai pat .

translation.en: I have made the earth , the man and the beast that are upon the ground , by my great power and by my outstretched arm , and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me .
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ïa u khunbynriew , bad ïa baroh ki mrad kiba im ha ka khyndew ; bad nga ai ïa ka ha uno uno uba nga jied .

translation.en: Fear came upon me , and trembling , which made all my bones to shake .
translation.kha: Nga kyiuh bad sngew syier ; ka met jong nga baroh kawei ka khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: When a child dies , it is particularly hard for the mother .
translation.kha: Haba u khyllung u iap , ka long ka ba eh da shisha ia ka kmie .

translation.en: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field : and he shall make a fort against thee , and cast a mount against thee , and lift up the buckler against thee .
translation.kha: Kito kiba shong basah ha ki shnong ha ka ri kin shah pynïap ha ka jingïaleh . Ki nongshun kin tih ïa ki kharai , kin tei ïa ki kynton khyndew , bad pynlong ki kynroh baskhem pyrshah ïa pha .

translation.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither , but God : and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh , and lord of all his house , and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta ym dei shisha ma phi kiba la phah ïa nga shane , hynrei U Blei hi . U la pynlong ïa nga u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh . Nga dei u nongkhmih ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei ; nga long u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he said ,  Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee  ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ,  u duwai ,  Ko Pa jong nga ! Baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba lah ha me . Shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom . Pynban ym ïa kaei kaba nga kwah , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me kwah .

translation.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me , and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel , unto Abner the son of Ner , and unto Amasa the son of Jether , whom he slew , and shed the blood of war in peace , and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins , and in his shoes that were on his feet .
translation.kha: Ka dang don shuh sa kawei pat . Me kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la leh ïa nga da kaba pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki shipai Israel — u Abner , u khun jong u Ner bad u Amasa , u khun jong u Jether . Me kynmaw kumno u la pynïap ïa ki ha ka por suk pyrthei kum ka jingpynhiarkput ïa ka jingpynïap kaba ki la leh ha ka por thma . U la pynïap ïa ki rangbah balui lui , bad mynta nga bah ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kaei kaba u la leh , bad nga la shah jynjar na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And they that have believing masters , let them not despise them , because they are brethren ; but rather do them service , because they are faithful and beloved , partakers of the benefit . These things teach and exhort .
translation.kha: Ki mraw kiba long ki jong ki kynrad kiba ngeit kim dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , naba ki long ki parabangeit jong ki . Pynban , ki dei ban shakri ïa ki kham bha shuh shuh , namar kito kiba ïoh myntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki , ki long ki parabangeit ïa kiba ki ieit . Me dei ban hikai bad ïalap ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: And Nathan departed unto his house . And the  Lord  struck the child that Uriah s wife bare unto David , and it was very sick .
translation.kha: Nangta u Nathan u leit phai noh sha ïing . U  Trai  u la pynngat ka jingshitom bajur ha u khunlung ba ka tnga u Uriah ka la ïoh na u Dabid .

translation.en: Knowing , brethren beloved , your election of God .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u ieit ïa phi bad ba u la jied ïa phi ban long ki jong u hi .

translation.en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels of heaven , but my Father only .
translation.kha: Pynban , ym don uno uno ruh uba tip lano kata ka sngi bad ka kynta kan wan — ym ki angel ha bneng lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa hi uba tip .

translation.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me , that I may live : for thy law is my delight .
translation.kha: To isynei ïa nga , bad ngan im ; namar nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: But the Levites have no part among you  ; for the priesthood of the  Lord  is their inheritance : and Gad , and Reuben , and half the tribe of Manasseh , have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki Lebi kin ym ïoh kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri lem bad phi , namar ka bynta jong ki ka long ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai . Bad da shisha , ki jait Gad , Reuben , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi te ki la lah ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ïa kaba u Moses u shakri jong U  Trai  u la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread , two omers for one man : and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ki ïalum ar shah , saw kilo ïa uwei uwei u briew . Ki nongïalam baroh jong ka kynhun ki wan ïathuh shaphang kata ha u Moses ,

translation.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men .
translation.kha: Um don jingsngewbha ban pynlong ïa ngi ban sngewsih lane ban pang .

translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , What might this parable be ?
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa U Jisu aïu kane ka pharshi ka kit jingmut ,

translation.en: Thanks a lot
translation.kha: Khublei shibun

translation.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works :
translation.kha: To ngin pyrkhat khia uwei ïa uwei pat , ban ïarap uwei ïa uwei pat , ban pynpaw ïa ka jingïa-ieit bad ban lehbha .

translation.en: And straightway one of them ran , and took a sponge , and filled it with vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh shisyndon , u la shim ïa u spoiñ    , u la pynngam ïa u hapoh ka waiñ ka bym bha , u buh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng , bad u la pyrshang ban pyndih ïa u .

translation.en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week , he appeared first to Mary Magdalene , out of whom he had cast seven devils .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la mihpat na ka jingïap dang step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , u la mihpaw nyngkong ha ka Mari ka nong Magdala , na kaba u la pynmih noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki ksuid .

translation.en: And when Gaal saw the people , he said to Zebul , Behold , there come people down from the top of the mountains . And Zebul said unto him , Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men .
translation.kha: U Gaal u ïohi ïa ki , bad u ong ha u Sebul ,  Ha khmih ! La don ki briew kiba wan hiar na kliar ki lum !  Kito kim dei ki briew ,  jubab u Sebul .  Ki shu long tang ki syrngiew halor ki lum .

translation.en: The copy of the letter that Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and his companions the Apharsachites , which were on this side the river , sent unto Darius the king :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingïathuh ba ki la phah sha u patsha :

translation.en: And in that day it shall come to pass , that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin , and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka sngi ka wan ha kaba ka jingkhraw jong ka Israel kan poi sha kaba kut , bad ïa ka spah jong ka yn bujli da ka jingduk .

translation.en: What man is like Job , who drinketh up scorning like water ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la ïohi ïa uno uno u briew kum u Job ? Um ju pyn-i jingburom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ong ,  To ap , to ngin peit lada u Elijah un wan bad pyllait im ïa u !

translation.en: Egypt riseth up like a flood , and his waters are moved like the rivers  ; and he saith , I will go up , and will cover the earth  ; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka Ijipt , kaba shlei kum ka Nile , kum ka wah ba shlei ïa ki rud jong ka . Ka Ijipt ka ong , ‘ Ngan shlei bad ngan tyllep ïa ka pyrthei ; ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad ïa ki briew bashong hangta .

translation.en: And their feet were straight feet  ; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf s foot : and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass .
translation.kha: Ki pung kjat jong ki , ki long kiba beit , bad ki don ki khnap kum ki jong u masi dab , bad ki thaba kum ka rnong ba la shut pynphyrnai .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  tendeth to life : and he that hath it shall abide satisfied  ; he shall not be visited with evil .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad phin ïoh im slem , uba sngewhun bad uba shongshngain na ka jingma .

translation.en: Thefts , covetousness , wickedness , deceit , lasciviousness , an evil eye , blasphemy , pride , foolishness :
translation.kha: ban klim , ban lalot , bad leh baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew ; ka jingshukor , ka jingbymdon-burom , ka jingbishni , kaba kren sniew shaphang kiwei , ka jingsarong , bad ka jingbieit —
