translation.en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah  ; even Issachar , and also Barak : he was sent on foot into the valley . For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ka jait Issakhar ki wan bad ka Deborah ; Ho-oid , ki Issakhar ki wan bad u Barak ruh , Bad ki la bud ïa u sha ka them . Hynrei ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .

translation.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt , which came out of his loins , besides Jacob s sons  wives , all the souls were threescore and six  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob kiba la leit sha Ijipt , lait noh ki tnga jong ki khun shynrang jong u , ki long hynriewphew hynriew ngut .

translation.en: Then said Joab to Cushi , Go tell the king what thou hast seen . And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab , and ran .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa u mraw jong u na Sudan ,  Khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi .  U mraw u la nguh bad u la mareh bran .

translation.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings  ; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices . I have not caused thee to serve with an offering , nor wearied thee with incense .
translation.kha: Phim shym la wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang ki langbrot jong phi ; phim shym la burom ïa nga da ki jingkñia jong phi . Ngam shym la bankhia ïa phi da kaba dawa ki jingainguh lane pynbtai ïa phi da kaba pan jingiwbih .

translation.en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah khat-ar snem .

translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and causeth them to wander in the wilderness , where there is no way .
translation.kha: u pynpaw ka jingibeiñ ïa ki nongbanbeiñ bad u pynlong ïa ki ban sakma ha ki ri shyiap bym don lynti .

translation.en: And I have consumed them , and wounded them , that they could not arise : yea , they are fallen under my feet .
translation.kha: Nga shoh pynkyllon ïa ki , bad kim lah khie shuh ki thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha khmat jong nga .

translation.en: I chose out their way , and sat chief , and dwelt as a king in the army , as one that comforteth the mourners .
translation.kha: Nga pynïaidkam bad nga ai ki jingrai ; nga la ïalam ïa ki kumba u syiem u ïalam ïa la ki shipai , bad nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingshngain haba ki duh jingkyrmen .

translation.en: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass , which the  Lord  shall lay upon him , it shall be with tabrets and harps : and in battles of shaking will he fight with it .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u shoh bad u ïai shoh ïa ki , ki briew jong u pat kin ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jong ki ksing bad ki duitara . U Blei hi da lade un ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Assyria .

translation.en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la rwai ïa ka jingrwai bad ki la leit noh sha u lum ki Olib .

translation.en: Arise and thresh , O daughter of Zion : for I will make thine horn iron , and I will make thy hoofs brass : and thou shalt beat in pieces many people : and I will consecrate their gain unto the  Lord  , and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to leit bad pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong phi ! Ngan pynlong ïa phi kiba khlaiñ kum u masi kyrtong uba don ki reng nar bad ki kjat rnong . Phin pynlwet ïa ki jaitbynriew ba bun , bad ïa ka spah kaba ki la ïoh da ka jingleh jubor phin ai sngewbha ïa nga , U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the  Lord  : but the prayer of the upright is his delight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u sngewbha haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , hynrei u isih ïa ki jingkñia kiba ki bymman ki wallam ha u .

translation.en: And , behold , seven ears , withered , thin , and blasted with the east wind , sprung up after them :
translation.kha: Nangta sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , kiba raikhoh bad kiba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la nguid noh ïa kita kiba met .

translation.en: Take thee a roll of a book , and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel , and against Judah , and against all the nations , from the day I spake unto thee , from the days of Josiah , even unto this day .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka kot kli bad thoh ha ka ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me shaphang ka Israel bad ka Judah bad baroh ki jaitbynriew . Thoh lut ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me naduh ka por ba nga la kren nyngkong ha me , mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , haduh mynta .

translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord  God  is upon me  ; because the  Lord  hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek  ; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted , to proclaim liberty to the captives , and the opening of the prison to them that are bound  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem jong u . U la jied ïa nga bad phah ïa nga ban wallam ïa ka khubor babha sha kiba duk , ban pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud , ban pynbna ka jingpyllait ïa ki mraw bad ka jinglaitluid ïa kito kiba ha ka byndi .

translation.en: I will seek that which was lost , and bring again that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick : but I will destroy the fat and the strong  ; I will feed them with judgment .
translation.kha: Ngan wad ïa kito kiba la jah , ngan wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ngan sop spaiñ ïa kito kiba la mong , bad ngan pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , hynrei ïa kito kiba sngaid bad kiba khlaiñ ngan sa pynjot , namar nga long u nongaplangbrot uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and gat them up into the top of the mountain , saying , Lo , we be here , and will go up unto the place which the  Lord  hath promised : for we have sinned .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , ki la ïamih ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri lum , ki da ong ,  Mynta te ngi la kloi ban leit sha kata ka jaka ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha ngi . Ngi phla ba ngi la leh pop .

translation.en: And it was told him by certain which said , Thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to see thee .
translation.kha: Don uwei uba la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong me ki ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban ïohi ïa me .

translation.en: Commit thy works unto the  Lord  , and thy thoughts shall be established .
translation.kha: Kyrpad na U  Trai  ban kyrkhu ïa ki jingthmu jong phi , bad phin ïoh jingjop ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki .

translation.en: What then ? shall we sin , because we are not under the law , but under grace ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin leh pop , namar ngim long hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei U Blei ? Ym kumta!

translation.en: He is the  Lord  our God  ; his judgments are in all the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei jong ngi ; ki hukum jong u ki long na ka bynta ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: Thy tacklings are loosed  ; they could not well strengthen their mast , they could not spread the sail : then is the prey of a great spoil divided  ; the lame take the prey .
translation.kha: Baroh ki tyllai teh ha kito ki liengbah kim don jingmyntoi ; ki jaiñ pdiang lyer kim lah ban pyiar ! Ngin knieh noh ïa baroh ka spah jong ki kynhun shipai nongshun , bad kan bun haduh katta katta ba wat ki briew kiba dkoh ruh kin ïa-ïoh bynta . U  Trai  hi da lade un long u syiem jong ngi ; un synshar halor jong ngi bad un ïada ïa ngi .

translation.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth : for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Naduh kaba sdang eh jong ka histori jong ki , ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsngewsih ïa nga bad ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: Israel also came into Egypt  ; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u leit sha Ijipt bad u shongduh ha kata ka ri .

translation.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning , and looked upon them , and , behold , they were sad .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u la wan ha ki mynstep , u la ïohi ba ki leh diaw .

translation.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way  ; and he had clad himself with a new garment  ; and they two were alone in the field :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Jeroboam u dang mih na Jerusalem , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa uba na Shiloh , u ïakynduh ïa u marwei ha lynti kaba ha rudnong .

translation.en: And shalt return unto the  Lord  thy God , and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day , thou and thy children , with all thine heart , and with all thy soul  ;
translation.kha: Lada ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin phai pat sha U  Trai  , bad kohnguh da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh ïa ki hukum jong u kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ,

translation.en: And I will set my face against you , and ye shall be slain before your enemies : they that hate you shall reign over you  ; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you .
translation.kha: Ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , te phin shahjop ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad kito kiba phi isih kin synshar halor jong phi ; phin sngewsheptieng haduh katta katta ba phin phet ïap haba ym don ba beh ïa phi .

translation.en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah , who was sixteen years old , and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah baroh ki jied ïa u Ussaïah , u khun jong u Amasaïah , uba dang khathynriew snem ka rta , ban long syiem ha ka jaka u kpa jong u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee :
translation.kha: Lada ki mraw kiba phet na la u kynrad ki wan wad jingïada na phi , wat phah pat ïa ki sha u kynrad jong ki .

translation.en: But thou hast not called upon me , O Jacob  ; but thou hast been weary of me , O Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Hynrei phi la thait ïa nga , ko Israel ; phim shym la mane ïa nga .

translation.en: These be they who separate themselves , sensual , having not the Spirit .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba pynlong ki jingïapait , kiba shah ïalam ha ki jingkwah ba kynja doh jong ki , ki bym don U Mynsiem .

translation.en: Make no friendship with an angry man  ; and with a furious man thou shalt not go :
translation.kha: Wat ïalong paralok bad ki briew kiba domriang , kiba khong khong .

translation.en: The son of Geber , in Ramoth–gilead  ; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh , which are in Gilead  ; to him also pertained the region of Argob , which is in Bashan , threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars :
translation.kha: U Bengeber : ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead , bad ki shnong ha Gilead kiba dei jong ki kur u Jair , uba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , bad ka thain Argob ha Bashan , baroh hynriewphew tylli ki shnong kiba heh , kiba la ker da ki kynroh bad ki nar rnong ha ki khyrdop

translation.en: And brought them out , and said , Sirs , what must I do to be saved ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar bad u la kylli ,  Ko rangbah , kaei nga dei ban leh ba yn pynim ïa nga ?

translation.en: And your altars shall be desolate , and your images shall be broken : and I will cast down your slain men before your idols .
translation.kha: Ïa ki duwan yn pynjot noh bad ki duwan jingiwbih kin pra . Baroh ki briew kiba hangta kin shah pynïap ha khmat ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: I , even I , am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake , and will not remember thy sins .
translation.kha: Bad pynban , nga long U Blei uba map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad nga leh ïa kane namar uei ba nga long . Ngan ym bat ïa ki pop jong phi pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord : yet I give my judgment , as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ki briew ki bym pat shongkurim : Ngam don ka hukum na U Trai , hynrei nga ai ïa la ka jingmut kum uwei uba da ka jingisynei U Trai nga long uba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: But she is happier if she so abide , after my judgment : and I think also that I have the Spirit of God .
translation.kha: Kan kham suk pynban , lada ka shong marwei . Kata ka long ka jingai jingmut jong nga bad nga pyrkhat ba ïa nga ruh la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei .

translation.en: Wisdom hath builded her house , she hath hewn out her seven pillars :
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka la tei ïa la ka ïing , bad ka la pynïeng hynñiew tylli ki rishot ïa ka .

translation.en: Which when they had taken up , they used helps , undergirding the ship  ; and , fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands , strake sail , and so were driven .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntiew ïa ka , bad ki la teh katto katne ki tyllai sawdong ïa ka lieng . Ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ki lah ban tyngkhuh sha ka jaka kaba don shyiap jngai na ka rud duriaw jong ka Libya , kumta ki la pynhiar ïa ki jaiñ pynshah lyer bad ki la shah ïa ka lieng ban shah kit da ka lyer .

translation.en: And their father Israel said unto them , If it must be so now , do this  ; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels , and carry down the man a present , a little balm , and a little honey , spices , and myrrh , nuts , and almonds :
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha ki ,  Lada kumta te , to leit rah ïa ki jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong kane ka ri ha ki byrni jong phi kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta u lat : khyndiat ka jingiwbih , khyndiat ka ngap , ki musli musla , ka mirr , ki jait soh-ot , bad ki almond .

translation.en: And he also had made savoury meat , and brought it unto his father , and said unto his father , Let my father arise , and eat of his son s venison , that thy soul may bless me .
translation.kha: U ruh u la shet ïa ka jingbam kaba bang bad u leit rah ïa ka sha la u kpa . U ong ,  Ko pa , sngewbha , to khie shong bad bam khyndiat na kane ka doh ba nga la wanrah ïa phi , ba phi lah ban ai ha nga ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong phi .

translation.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt , and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time  ; and the Egyptians vexed us , and our fathers :
translation.kha: kumno ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leit sha Ijipt , ha kaba ngi la shong la sah hangta bun bun snem . Ki nong Ijipt ki la lehbeiñ ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad ïa ngi ruh ,

translation.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened  ; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter ym dei ban lap ïa u thiat ha ki ïing jong phi ; namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu uba la khleh thiat la u dei u nongwei ne u traishnong , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world , how he may please his wife .
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba la shongkurim u pyrkhat kiei kiei kiba kynja pyrthei , kumno ba un pynsngewbha ïa la ka tnga .

translation.en: Some therefore cried one thing , and some another : for the assembly was confused  ; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ka jingïalang baroh kawei ka la don ha ka jingkhynwin : Katto katne ngut ki briew ki pyrta ïa kawei , kiwei ki pyrta ïa kawei pat , namar kiba bun na ki kim da tip balei ba ki la ïawan lumlang .

translation.en: They shall roar together like lions : they shall yell as lions  whelps .
translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia baroh ki kyrhuh kum ki sing bad jlew kum ki khun sing .

translation.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe  ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .
translation.kha: bad kata ka bri ka khyndew kan ym leit na kawei ka jait sha kawei pat . Kawei pa kawei ka jait kan ïai bat ïa la ka bri ka khyndew .

translation.en: For I will lay the land most desolate , and the pomp of her strength shall cease  ; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate , that none shall pass through .
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , bad ka bor kaba ki ju sngewsarong katta katta kan sa kut noh . Ki lumbah ka Israel kin long khlaw kynjah ba ym don uba nud ban leit jingleit lyngba jong ki .

translation.en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way : and when he saw him , he passed by on the other side .
translation.kha: Ka la jia ryngkhat ba u lyngdoh u la leit hiar na kata ka lynti ; hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa uta u briew , u la ïaid lait na kawei ka liang .

translation.en: Wherefore laying aside all malice , and all guile , and hypocrisies , and envies , and all evil speakings ,
translation.kha: To bret noh na lade , namarkata , ïa ki jingsniew baroh ; ïa ka jingshukor lane ka jingarsap lane ka jingbishni lane ka jingkren sniew .

translation.en: So Joram went over to Zair , and all the chariots with him : and he rose by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him about , and the captains of the chariots : and the people fled into their tents .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoram u leit sha Sair bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , ha kaba ka kynhun shipai Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki . Ha ka por mynmiet ma u bad ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki kali ïapom ki la ïohlad ban lait bad ki phet ïap , bad ki shipai jong u ki phet sakma sha ki ïing jong ki .

translation.en: And reigned in mount Hermon , and in Salecah , and in all Bashan , unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites , and half Gilead , the border of Sihon king of Heshbon .
translation.kha: Ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa u Lum Hermon , ka Salekah , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh ki pud jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , bad shiteng jong ka Gilead haduh ka ri jong u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon .

translation.en: And the messengers returned to Jacob , saying , We came to thy brother Esau , and also he cometh to meet thee , and four hundred men with him .
translation.kha: Ynda kita ki nonglamktien ki la wan phai pat sha u Jakob , ki ong ,  Ngi la leit ïashem ïa u Iso u hynmen jong phi , bad u la don ha lynti ban wan ïashem ïa phi . U don sawspah ngut ki rangbah bad u .

translation.en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus , in the beginning of his reign , wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang jong ka jingsynshar u patsha Serksis , ki nongshun jong ki briew kiba shong basah ha Judah bad Jerusalem ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui da ka jingthoh pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God , and be more ready to hear , than to give the sacrifice of fools : for they consider not that they do evil .
translation.kha: Da sumar shaphang kaba leit sha ka Templ . Ka kham bha ban leit hangta ban ïoh jinghikai ban ïa kaba ai jingkñia kum ki briew ba-bieit ki bymtip ïa kaba dei na kaba bakla .

translation.en: The sword is without , and the pestilence and the famine within : he that is in the field shall die with the sword  ; and he that is in the city , famine and pestilence shall devour him .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingïashoh ha ki lynti ïaid , bad ka jingpang bad ka jingthngan hapoh ki ïing . Uno uno uba don ha rudnong u ïap ha ka jingïaleh , uno uno uba don ha nongbah u ïap da ka jingpang ne jingthngan .

translation.en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God  : and it shall become a spoil to the nations .
translation.kha: Ki nongtong dohkha kin pynrkhiang ïa la ki jar halor jong u , hangta ha kaba u ïeng ha ka duriaw . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ki jaitbynriew kin pynjot ïa ka Tyros .

translation.en: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood , and on which it was borne up , of the one with his right hand , and of the other with his left .
translation.kha: U Samson u bat ïa kita ki rishot pdeng ar tylli kiba kyrshan ïa kata ka ïing . Da kaba buh ïa kawei ka kti ha uwei u rishot bad kawei pat ha uwei u rishot , u khynñiat pyrshah ïa ki

translation.en: But if they had stood in my counsel , and had caused my people to hear my words , then they should have turned them from their evil way , and from the evil of their doings .
translation.kha: Lada ki la tip ïa ki jingmut barieh jong nga , te kin jin da la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga sha ki briew jong nga , bad kin jin da la pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa ki jingim basniew ba ki im bad na ki kam bymman ba ki leh .

translation.en: Saying ,  Father , if thou be willing , remove this cup from me : nevertheless not my will , but thine , be done .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ,  u la ong ,  lada me mon , shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom . Ym ïa ka mon jong nga , pynban , ïa ka mon jong me yn pyndep .

translation.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the  Lord   ; and great shall be the peace of thy children .
translation.kha: Nga da lade ngan hikai ïa ki briew jong pha , bad ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingmanbha bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house , and all Solomon s desire which he was pleased to do ,
translation.kha: Ynda u syiem Solomon u la dep tei ïa ka ïing U  Trai  bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , nalor kiwei pat kiba u la kwah ban tei ,

translation.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God ? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself ?
translation.kha: Hato me ïohsngew pateng ïa ki jingthmu U Blei ïa kiba u la thaw ? Hato ka jingstad briew ka dei ka jong me marwei ?

translation.en: While he thus spake , there came a cloud , and overshadowed them : and they feared as they entered into the cloud .
translation.kha: Katba u dang kren , u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u ; bad ki synran ki la sheptieng haba u lyoh u la wan halor jong ki .

translation.en: And David said to Abiathar the priest , Ahimelech s son , I pray thee , bring me hither the ephod . And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Abiathar , u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Ahimelekh ,  Wanrah ha nga ka ephod ,  bad u Abiathar u wanrah ïa ka ha u .

translation.en: For he maketh small the drops of water : they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof :
translation.kha: U dei U Blei uba shim ïa ka um na ka khyndew bad pynkylla ïa ka sha ki jingjaw jong u slap .

translation.en: I write unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I write unto you , young men , because ye have overcome the wicked one . I write unto you , little children , because ye have known the Father .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi ithuh ïa u uba la long naduh kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun samla , namar phi la jop noh thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .

translation.en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem , saying , There is a king in Judah : and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words . Come now therefore , and let us take counsel together .
translation.kha: bad ba phi la pynbeit ba katto katne ki nongïathuhlypa kin pynbna ha Jerusalem ba phi long u syiem ka Judah . U syiem , khlem pep , un ïohsngew shaphang kane , kumta nga ai jingmut ba ma phi bad nga ngin ïakynduh ban ïakren halor kane ka kam .

translation.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
translation.kha: Namar wat U Khun U Briew um shym la wan ba un shah shakri ; u la wan ban shakri bad ban aiti ïa la ka jingim ban pynim ïa kiba bun ki briew .

translation.en: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent , and thrust both of them through , the man of Israel , and the woman through her belly . So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U la shim ïa u sum , u la bud ïa uta u shynrang bad kata ka kynthei shapoh ïingjaiñ , bad u dung ïap da u sum ïa ki baroh ar ngut . Da kumne la pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem kaba la pynjot ïa ki Israel ,

translation.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones  ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .
translation.kha: U ong ha la ki briew ban lum katto katne ki mawbah bad ban kynton halor jong ki . Nangta ki ïashong bam hajan kata ka kynton maw .

translation.en: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God , and into the patient waiting for Christ .
translation.kha: Ai ba U Trai un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingshemphang ba kham khraw jong ka jingieit U Blei bad sha ka jingïaishah kaba la ai da U Khrist .

translation.en: O  Lord  , though our iniquities testify against us , do thou it for thy name s sake : for our backslidings are many  ; we have sinned against thee .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam sha nga , ‘ Wat la ki pop jong ngi ki pynrem ïa ngi , to ïarap ïa ngi , A  Trai  , kumba me la kular . Ngi la phai dien noh na me bun bunsien ; ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: Behold , here I am : witness against me before the  Lord  , and before his anointed : whose ox have I taken ? or whose ass have I taken ? or whom have I defrauded ? whom have I oppressed ? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith ? and I will restore it you .
translation.kha: Hangne nga don . Lada nga la leh ïa kano kano kaba bakla , sakhi pyrshah ïa nga ha khmat U  Trai  bad ha khmat u syiem uba u la pynsleh . Hato nga la shim ïa ka masi ne ka kada jongno jongno ? Hato nga la shukor ne banbeiñ ïano ïano ? Hato nga la bamsap nano nano ? Lada nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei ngan pynphai noh ïa kata kaba nga la shim .

translation.en: Though these three men , Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah , u Noah , u Daniel bad u Job ki don hangta , ka jingbha jong ki kan pynim tang ïa ka jingim jong ki hi .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you , I go away , and come again unto you . If ye loved me , ye would rejoice , because I said , I go unto the Father : for my Father is greater than I .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ong ha phi , ‘ Ngan sa leit noh , hynrei ngan sa wan pat sha phi .’ Lada phi la ieit ïa nga , phin kmen namar ba ngan sa leit sha U Kpa ; naba u long kham khraw ban ïa nga .

translation.en: Upright men shall be astonished at this , and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dawa ba ki long kiba hok ki la kyndit , bad baroh ki la pynrem ïa nga ba ngam don Blei .

translation.en: That the  Lord  appeared to Solomon the second time , as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u paw biang ha u kumba u la paw ha Gibeon .

translation.en: And he said ,  Verily I say unto you , No prophet is accepted in his own country .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane ,  U Jisu u la bynrap ,  ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju pdiang sngewbha ha la ka shnong .

translation.en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city , as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle .
translation.kha: Ki leit phai noh jar jar shapoh ka nongbah , kum ki shipai kiba lehrain haba ki phet noh na ka thma .

translation.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat : for this is for your health : for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te , to bam khyndiat ka jingbam ; phi donkam ïa ka khnang ban im . Wat iwei i shñiuh na ka khlieh jong phi in ym hap noh .

translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Thy money perish with thee , because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ïa u ,  Ai ba ïa me bad ka pisa jong me yn bret sha ka dujok , naba me pyrkhat ba me lah ban thied ïa ka jingai jong U Blei da ka pisa !

translation.en: And Lot went out at the door unto them , and shut the door after him ,
translation.kha: U Lot u mih shabar , u da khang tdam ïa ka jingkhang .

translation.en: What is my strength , that I should hope ? and what is mine end , that I should prolong my life ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingkhlaiñ kaba nga don ba ngan ïai im ? Balei ngan dang im haba ngam don ka jingkyrmen ?

translation.en: For he that is not against us is on our part .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno u bym long pyrshah ïa ngi u long ha ka liang jong ngi .

translation.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , la jan baroh shi shnong ki la wan ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .

translation.en: And cover not their iniquity , and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee : for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders .
translation.kha: Wat map ïa kaba sniew kaba ki leh bad wat klet ïa ki pop jong ki , namar ba ki la pynlehrain ïa ngi kiba dang ïatei .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor , it is time to thresh her : yet a little while , and the time of her harvest shall come .
translation.kha: Shen u nongshun un ot ïa ki bad un ïuhroit ïa ki kum u kew ha ka jaka tylliat kew . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .

translation.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light : they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death , upon them hath the light shined .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïaid ha ka jingdum ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ki la shong ha ka ri jong ki syrngiew , hynrei mynta ka jingshai ka la tyngshaiñ halor jong ki .

translation.en: And many among them shall stumble , and fall , and be broken , and be snared , and be taken .
translation.kha: Kiba bun kin jynthut ; kin kyllon bad kin shah pynlwet . Yn pynngat ïa ki ha ka jingriam .

translation.en: My glory was fresh in me , and my bow was renewed in my hand .
translation.kha: Baroh ki ïaroh ïa nga borabor , bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga kam ju duh noh na nga .

translation.en: But when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , the  Lord  raised them up a deliverer , Ehud the son of Gera , a Benjamite , a man lefthanded : and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la kyang jam ha U  Trai  , bad u la phah ïa uwei u briew ban pyllait ïa ki . Une u dei u Ehud , u briew uba trei da kadiang , u khun jong u Gera na ka jait Benjamin . Ki paid Israel ki phah ïa u Ehud ban leit ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha sha u Eglon u syiem Moab .

translation.en: Ye are not straitened in us , but ye are straitened in your own bowels .
translation.kha: Ym dei ma ngi kiba la khang khop ïa la ki dohnud sha phi ; dei ma phi kiba khang khop ïa la ki dohnud sha ngi .

translation.en: And great fear came upon all the church , and upon as many as heard these things .
translation.kha: Ka balang baroh kawei bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la sngewshyrkhei .

translation.en: They say unto him , Caesar s . Then saith he unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar s  ; and unto God the things that are God s .
translation.kha: Ki jong u Patsha ,  ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Kumta , te , to siew sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Blei .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I remember that which Amalek did to Israel , how he laid wait for him in the way , when he came up from Egypt .
translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki paid Amalek namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt .

translation.en: And said unto them ,  Thus it is written , and thus it behoved Christ to suffer , and to rise from the dead the third day :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la thoh : U Messaïah u dei ban shahshitom bad u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap hadien lai sngi ,

translation.en: A people great and tall , the children of the Anakims , whom thou knowest , and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak !
translation.kha: Ki briew pat ki long kiba radbah bad kiba jrong rynïeng ; ki dei ki ramhah , bad phi la bna ba don kiba ong ba ym don mano mano uba lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel , and said unto them , Why are ye come out to set your battle in array ? am not I a Philistine , and ye servants to Saul ? choose you a man for you , and let him come down to me .
translation.kha: U Goliath u ïeng bad u byrthen ïa ki Israel ,  Phi ïaleh aïu hangto , pynkhreh ban ïaleh thma ? Nga , nga dei u Philistia , phi ki mraw u Saul ! Jied uwei na ki rangbah jong phi ban ïaleh bad nga .

translation.en: And the king said unto Cushi , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Cushi answered , The enemies of my lord the king , and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt , be as that young man is .
translation.kha: Hato u samla Absalom u dang im ?  u syiem u kylli . U mraw u jubab ,  Ko Kynrad , nga sngew ba kaei kaba la jia ha u kan jin da la jia ha baroh ki nongshun jong ngi , bad ha baroh kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: And other fell on good ground , and sprang up , and bare fruit an hundredfold .  And when he had said these things , he cried ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Bad katto katne ki symbai ki la hap ha ka khyndew babha ; ki jingthung ki la san bad ki la pynmih symboh , da ki spah symboh uwei uwei .  Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: And Pharaoh s daughter said to her , Go . And the maid went and called the child s mother .
translation.kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka ,  Khie leit .  Kumta kata ka khynnah ka leit bad ka wan ïalam da ka kmie jong uta u khunlung hi .

translation.en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .
translation.kha: Bad mynta phi kwah ba ngan leit ïathuh ïa u ba phi don hangne ?

translation.en: Howl , O gate  ; cry , O city  ; thou , whole Philistia , art dissolved : for there shall come from the north a smoke , and none shall be alone in his appointed times .
translation.kha: To ud bad to kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , phi baroh ki nongbah ka Philistia ! To sngewshyrkhei , phi baroh ! U lyoh pui pui u wan na ka phang bashatei — u long ka kynhun shipai bym don ki khawpud hapoh ka kyrdan jong ka .

translation.en: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without , and that ye may have lack of nothing .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka jingñiewkor jong kito ki bym pat ngeit , bad phim donkam ban shaniah hano hano na ka bynta kaei kaba phi donkam .

translation.en: For this is the love of God , that we keep his commandments : and his commandments are not grievous .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingieit jong ngi ïa U Blei , ka mut ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . Bad ki hukum jong u kim long kiba eh katta katta ïa ngi ,

translation.en: Mischief shall come upon mischief , and rumour shall be upon rumour  ; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet  ; but the law shall perish from the priest , and counsel from the ancients .
translation.kha: Ka jingjynjar kan bud kawei hadien kawei pat , ka khubor basniew kan ïai tuid . Phin kyrpad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki ïohi lypa . Ki lyngdoh kin ym don ei ei shuh ban hikai ïa ki briew , bad ki tymmen ki san kin ym don jingsneng jingkraw shuh ban ai .

translation.en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence , and the valley of Achor for a door of hope : and she shall sing there , as in the days of her youth , and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ngan ai pat ha ka ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ka , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka Them Jingshitom sha ka khyrdop ka jingkyrmen . Hangta kan sa phai ktien ïa nga kumba ka la leh mynba ka dang samla , mynba ka wan mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And he said to the woman ,  Thy faith hath saved thee  ; go in peace .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew ,  Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynim ïa pha ; khie leit ha kaba suk .

translation.en: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged  ; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin  ; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder , the groves and images shall not stand up .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki pop jong ki Israel yn map tang haba ïa ki maw jong ki duwan ki blei thala la pynlwet jin kum u shok , bad ba ym don shuh ki duwan thang iwbih lane ki dur jong ka blei Asherah kiba dang sah .

translation.en: Shall not the day of the  Lord  be darkness , and not light ? even very dark , and no brightness in it ?
translation.kha: Ka sngi U  Trai  kan wallam ïa ka jingdum , bad ym ïa ka jingshai ; kan long ka sngi ka jingdum tliw tliw , khlem kano kano ka jingphyrnai .

translation.en: And said , Hail , King of the Jews ! and they smote him with their hands .
translation.kha: Im slem ko Syiem ki Jiw !  Bad ki la leit bad thab ïa u .

translation.en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .
translation.kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki long tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam biang .

translation.en: For David said , The  Lord  God of Israel hath given rest unto his people , that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ,  U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la ai ka jingsuk ha la ki briew , bad u hi un shong junom ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: So the  Lord  saved Israel that day : and the battle passed over unto Beth–aven .
translation.kha: ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti shaduh palat ka Bethaben . U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come , they told Joab , saying , Abner the son of Ner came to the king , and he hath sent him away , and he is gone in peace .
translation.kha: Haba u Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la poi , la ïathuh ha u ba u Abner u la wan sha u syiem Dabid , bad ba u Dabid u la phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .

translation.en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger , and make them drunk in my fury , and I will bring down their strength to the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh bad nga lynthaw ïa ki . Nga la theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha madan .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , because they had transgressed against the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar jong u ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong ki ha U  Trai  la pynshitom .

translation.en: Thy calf , O Samaria , hath cast thee off  ; mine anger is kindled against them : how long will it be ere they attain to innocency ?
translation.kha: Nga isih ïa u masi ksiar ba mane da ki briew jong ka nongbah Samaria . Nga bitar lep ïa ki . Sa katno kan shim por shuwa ba kin sangeh noh na kaba mane bleithaw ?

translation.en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light , and the sweet incense , and the daily meat offering , and the anointing oil , and the oversight of all the tabernacle , and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary , and in the vessels thereof .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u la leh kumta kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And it shall be , as with the people , so with the priest  ; as with the servant , so with his master  ; as with the maid , so with her mistress  ; as with the buyer , so with the seller  ; as with the lender , so with the borrower  ; as with the taker of usury , so with the giver of usury to him .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ïakynduh ïa kajuh ka kupar — ki lyngdoh bad ki briew , ki mraw bad ki kynrad , kiba thied bad kiba die , kiba ai kylliang bad kiba shim kylliang , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk .

translation.en: And he entered into one of the ships , which was Simon s , and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land . And he sat down , and taught the people out of the ship .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor kawei na ki lieng — kaba long ka jong u Simon — bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban ñiat tang khyndiat na ka rud duriaw . U Jisu u la shong ha ka lieng bad u la hikai ïa u paidbah .

translation.en: Then the men feared the  Lord  exceedingly , and offered a sacrifice unto the  Lord  , and made vows .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa ki maji ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai  ha kaba ki la ai ka jingkñia bad kular ban shakri ïa u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto her , Two nations are in thy womb , and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels  ; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people  ; and the elder shall serve the younger .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ka ,  Ar tylli ki jaitbynriew ki don hapoh jong pha ; Phan sa kha ar jait ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki . Kawei kan kham khlaiñ ban ïa kawei pat , Kaba ha shuwa kan shakri ïa kaba hadien .

translation.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father s house , the offspring and the issue , all vessels of small quantity , from the vessels of cups , even to all the vessels of flagons .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u baroh bad kiba hapoh ka ïing jong u kin long ka jingbankhia ïa u . Kin sdien ha u kum ki khiew bad ki pliang kiba la wah ha u snar !

translation.en: And he said , Hear now my words : If there be a prophet among you , I the  Lord  will make myself known unto him in a vision , and will speak unto him in a dream .
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ,  Mynta sngap aïu ngan ong ! Haba don ki nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong phi , nga pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha ka jingïohipaw bad nga kren ha ki ha ki jingphohsniew .

translation.en: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ba phi ai ïa kata ka song kew , kñia ruh kum ka jingainguh thang uwei u khunlangbrot u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Then shalt thou call , and the  Lord  shall answer  ; thou shalt cry , and he shall say , Here I am . If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke , the putting forth of the finger , and speaking vanity  ;
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , ngan jubab ïa phi . Haba phin khot ïa nga ngan jubab .  Lada phi pynkut noh ïa ka jingbanbeiñ , na man la ka jingleh ibeiñ , bad na man la ka ktien sniew ,

translation.en: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you .
translation.kha: La pynlong khuid lypa ïa phi da ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi , Let me now go to the field , and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace . And she said unto her , Go , my daughter .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka Ruth ka ong ha ka Naomi ,  Shah ba ngan leit sha ki lyngkha ban tam ïa u kew ba ki nongot ki ieh . Nga thikna ban shem u briew u ban shah ïa nga ban trei bad u .  Ka Naomi ka ong ,  Khie leit , ko khun jong nga .

translation.en: O  Lord  God , to whom vengeance belongeth  ; O God , to whom vengeance belongeth , shew thyself .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long U Blei uba pynshitom ; to pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong me !

translation.en: For the land is full of adulterers  ; for because of swearing the land mourneth  ; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up , and their course is evil , and their force is not right .
translation.kha: Ka ri ka jyllei da ki briew ki bymïaineh ha U  Trai  ; ki im ka jingim bymman bad pyndonkam bakla ïa la ka bor . Namar ka jingtim U  Trai  , ka ri ka ïamkthang , bad ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong .

translation.en: And Ananias went his way , and entered into the house  ; and putting his hands on him said , Brother Saul , the Lord , even Jesus , that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest , hath sent me , that thou mightest receive thy sight , and be filled with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ananias u la leit , u la rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba u Saul u don , bad u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u .  Ko Saul , u para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  U Trai u la phah ïa nga — U Jisu hi , uba la mihpaw ha me ha ka lynti katba me dang wan shane . U la phah ïa nga khnang ba men ïoh imat pat bad ban pyndap ïa me da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages : in the secret places doth he murder the innocent : his eyes are privily set against the poor .
translation.kha: U buhrieh ïa lade ha ki shnongrit , da kaba apthap ban pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui . U syntiat ïa ki lanot jong u , ki bym don nongïarap ,

translation.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold , and said , It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you : but seeing ye put it from you , and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life , lo , we turn to the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul bad u Barnabas ki la nang kham kren shlur :  Ka long kaba donkam ba ïa ka ktien jong U Blei dei ban kren nyngkong ha phi . Hynrei namar ba phi kyntait ïa ka bad ba phim ñiew ïa lade kiba bit ïa ka jingim bymjukut , ngin iehnoh ïa phi bad leit sha ki Jentil .

translation.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof : but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged .
translation.kha: Haba ka jaitbynriew ka leh pop , kan ïoh u nongsynshar uwei hadien uwei pat . Hynrei ka jaitbynriew kan long kaba khlaiñ bad kaba ïaineh haba ka don ki nongsynshar kiba stad bad bashemphang .

translation.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done , because they repented not :
translation.kha: Ki briew ha ki shnong ha kaba U Jisu u la leh kham bun ki kambah jong u , kim shym la phai noh na ki pop jong ki , kumta u la pynrem jur ïa kito ki shnong .

translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child , the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Uba khraw tam hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long uta uba pynrit ïa lade bad uba long kum une u khynnah .

translation.en: Thou , O king , hast made a decree , that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , shall fall down and worship the golden image :
translation.kha: U Syiem Kynrad u la pynmih ka hukum ba tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingtem , uwei pa uwei u dei ban dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar ,

translation.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high , covering the mercy seat with their wings , and their faces shall look one to another  ; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be .
translation.kha: Kita ki kherub kin ïaphai markhmat , na shiliang sha shiliang ka jingtap bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki kah ïa kata ka jingtap .

translation.en: The  Lord  possessed me in the beginning of his way , before his works of old .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw nyngkong eh ïa nga , kaba nyngkong eh na ki kam jong u , la slem bah .

translation.en: And the sons of Judah  ; Er , and Onan , and Shelah , and Pharez , and Zerah : but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan . And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul .
translation.kha: U Judah bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Shelah , u Peres , bad u Serah . ( Kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Judah : u Er bad u Onan ki la ïap noh ha Kanaan ) ; ki khun shynrang jong u Peres ki long u Hesron bad u Hamul .

translation.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold , and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof , which is in the side of the ephod inward .
translation.kha: Nangta , thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad buh ïa ki ha ka bynta ba sha trai jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ka tduh bashapoh hajan ka ephod .

translation.en: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half , and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves .
translation.kha: Ki briew na baroh ki hima , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , bad ki jaitbynriew kin shu khmih ïa kita ki metïap jong ki haduh lai sngi shiteng bad kin ym shah ban tep ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh  ; lo , he cometh forth to the water  ; and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Lashai dang step phyrngab , khie leit ap ïa u Pharaoh katba u dang leit sha ka wah , bad ïathuh ha u ba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga ba kin ïoh mane ïa nga .

translation.en: But it came to pass in the morning , when the wine was gone out of Nabal , and his wife had told him these things , that his heart died within him , and he became as a stone .
translation.kha: Nangta , ynda u la pyngngad , ka la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaei baroh . U la ïohpang kyndit bad u la long kum uba ïap baroh shi rynïeng .

translation.en: Lord , have mercy on my son : for he is lunatic , and sore vexed : for ofttimes he falleth into the fire , and oft into the water .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , to isynei ïa u khun jong nga ! U long uba pang ring bad u la don ka jingkhie ring kaba shyrkhei eh ba bunsien u hap ha ka ding lane ha ka um .

translation.en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled , for a son , or for a daughter , she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering , and a young pigeon , or a turtledove , for a sin offering , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest :
translation.kha: Ynda ka por pynkhuid ïa ka , ka la kut , la ka long na ka bynta u khun ne ka khun , ka dei ban wallam sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ïa u khunlangbrot uba shisnem kum ka jingainguh thang bad ïa ka lyngdkhur ne ka paro kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .

translation.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites , even unto Zarephath  ; and the captivity of Jerusalem , which is in Sepharad , shall possess the cities of the south .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun kiba shah ringmraw na ka Israel bashatei kan wan phai bad jop ïa ka Phoenisia jngai bah shaphang shatei haduh ka Sarephath . Kiba shah ringmraw na Jerusalem kiba don ha Sardis kin kurup ïa ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie .

translation.en: And the king said , Enquire thou whose son the stripling is .
translation.kha: Te khie leit wad jingtip  U syiem u hukum .

translation.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi katno ki dak heh nga pynlong haba nga thoh sha phi mynta da la ka jong ka kti!

translation.en: I go the way of all the earth : be thou strong therefore , and shew thyself a man  ;
translation.kha: Ka por jong nga ban ïap ka la wan . To long uba sngewskhem bha bad uba kut jingmut skhem , bad leh ïa kaei ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me u hukum ïa me ban leh .

translation.en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh , and even unto Jahaz , have they uttered their voice , from Zoar even unto Horonaim , as an heifer of three years old : for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang , bad ïa ka jingkyang jong ki lah ban ïohsngew shaduh sha Jahas ; lah ban ïohsngew da ki briew ha Soar , bad la ïohsngew shaduh sha Horonaim bad sha Eglath Shelishiyah . Wat ka wahduid Nimrim ka la rngad noh .

translation.en: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me , What are these , my lord ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u angel ,  Ko rangbah , kaei ka jingmut jong kine ki kali ïapom ?

translation.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin , and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel :
translation.kha: Ban weng ïa ka jingbymkhuid , shim khyndiat u dpei na kata ka masi rong saw ïa kaba la thang ban weng noh ïa ka pop bad buh ïa ka ha u khiew , bad theh hangta ïa ka um ba dang shu wan tong .

translation.en: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ bad jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses ha ki pyntha ka Moab sha shiliang ka wah Jordan na Jerikho .

translation.en: Then they told Saul , saying , Behold , the people sin against the  Lord  , in that they eat with the blood . And he said , Ye have transgressed : roll a great stone unto me this day .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ,  Khmih , ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .   Phi dei ki nongshetkylla !  u Saul u kyang .  Pyntyllun uwei u maw heh shane sha nga .

translation.en: An Invitation to Learn
translation.kha: Ka Jingkhot Sngewbha Ban Hikai

translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear not : for God is come to prove you , and that his fear may be before your faces , that ye sin not .
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Wat sheptieng , U Blei u la wan tang ban tynjuh ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi ban ïai kohnguh ïa u , khnang ba phin ym leh pop .

translation.en: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness , wherein were fiery serpents , and scorpions , and drought , where there was no water  ; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint  ;
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba ïar bad kaba ishyrkhei eh , ha kaba la don ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki  ñianglartham . Ha kata ka ri kaba tyrkhong bad ka bym don um , u la pynmih um na u mawsiang na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria came unto him , and distressed him , but strengthened him not .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ka Assyria , ha ka jaka ban ïarap ïa u Ahas , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad thaw jingeh ïa u .

translation.en: And Jesus , when he had found a young ass , sat thereon  ; as it is written ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shem ïa u kada bad u la shong halor jong u , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,

translation.en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father s sheep at Beth–lehem .
translation.kha: u Dabid u ju iehnoh ïa ki bad u leit phai sha Bethlehem na kawei ka por sha kawei pat ban sharai ïa ki langbrot u kpa jong u .

translation.en: That they sent and called him . And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came , and spake unto Rehoboam , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki paidbah na ki jait ba na shatei ki phah khot ïa u , bad nangta ma ki baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam bad ki ong ha u ,

translation.en: What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
translation.kha: U briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .

translation.en: Their slain also shall be cast out , and their stink shall come up out of their carcases , and the mountains shall be melted with their blood .
translation.kha: Yn ym tep ïa ki metïap jong ki , hynrei kin pyut hangta bad kin iwtung ; bad ki lumbah kin saw da ka snam .

translation.en: Do not abhor us , for thy name s sake , do not disgrace the throne of thy glory : remember , break not thy covenant with us .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki jingkular jong me bad wat ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi ; wat wallam ka jingjahburom halor ka Jerusalem ka jaka jong ka khet badonburom jong me . Wat pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba me la pynlong bad ngi .

translation.en: And this also is a sore evil , that in all points as he came , so shall he go : and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind ?
translation.kha: Hato kam dei kumta ? Ngi leit kumba ngi wan . Ngi trei , da kaba pyrshang ban kem ïa ka lyer bad aïu ngi ïoh ?

translation.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you , to inherit them for a possession  ; they shall be your bondmen for ever : but over your brethren the children of Israel , ye shall not rule one over another with rigour .
translation.kha: bad phi lah ban ai pateng ïa ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa kiba ki dei ban shakri katba ki dang im . Hynrei phim lah ban lehbeiñ ïa kino kino na ki para Israel jong phi .

translation.en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him : for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you  ; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you .
translation.kha: U Moses u la rah bad u ïa ka met u Joseph , kumba u Joseph u la pynsmai ïa ki Israel . U Joseph u la lah ong ,  Haba U Blei u wan pyllait ïa phi , phi dei ban kit noh ïa ka met jong nga na kane ka jaka .

translation.en: Fulfil ye my joy , that ye be likeminded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind .
translation.kha: Te , nga kyrpad ïa phi , ban pynshlei ïa ka jingkmen jong nga da kaba don kijuh ki jingpyrkhat , kiba ïasam ïa kajuh ka jingieit , bad kiba don kawei ka mynsiem bad ka jingmut .

translation.en: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen , and ten chariots , and ten thousand footmen  ; for the king of Syria had destroyed them , and had made them like the dust by threshing .
translation.kha: U Jehoahas um don ki shipai kieng atiar kiba dang sah , lait sa tang ki sanphew ngut ki shipai shong kulai , shiphew tylli ki kali ïapom , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat , namar u syiem ka Syria u la pynjot ïa kiwei , da kaba ïuh halor jong ki kum ïa u pui pui .

translation.en: And the second row shall be an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
translation.kha: u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Diamond ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;

translation.en: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane , phin pynsngewbha ïa U Blei bad ïa u briew .

translation.en: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece , from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest .
translation.kha: U Barukh , u khun jong u Sabbai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

translation.en: Thus shalt thou say unto him , The  Lord  saith thus  ; Behold , that which I have built will I break down , and that which I have planted I will pluck up , even this whole land .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la pyntwa noh ïa kaei kaba nga la tei bad rat noh ïa kaei kaba nga la thung . Ngan leh ïa kane ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just : and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked .
translation.kha: Uba hok u isih ïa u bymman , bad u bymman u isih ïa uba hok .

translation.en: Asshur shall not save us  ; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .
translation.kha: Ka Assyria kan ym lah da lei lei ban pyllait im ïa ngi , bad ki kulai thma kim lah ban ïada ïa ngi . Ngin ym ong shuh ha ki bleithaw jong ngi ba ki long U Blei jong ngi . A  Trai  , me pyn-i jingisynei ha kito ki bym don uno uno sha uba ki lah ban phai .

translation.en: And put a knife to thy throat , if thou be a man given to appetite .
translation.kha: Lada phi dei uba khlaiñ bam , da synshar bha ïa lade .

translation.en: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons : her priests have polluted the sanctuary , they have done violence to the law .
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki long ki bym don jingkitkhlieh bad kiba shetkylla ; ki lyngdoh ki pyntngit ïa kaei kaba kyntang , bad ki pynwan ïa ka aiñ jong U Blei sha ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter , but within they are full of extortion and excess .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang jong phi , katba kaba shapoh ka dap da kaei kaba phi ïoh da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingpyrkhat tang ïa lade .

translation.en: And at the end of three years they took it : even in the sixth year of Hezekiah , that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel , Samaria was taken .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut , ka Samaria ka kyllon ; kane ka dei ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah , bad ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea .

translation.en: Hear ye , and testify in the house of Jacob , saith the Lord  God  , the God of hosts ,
translation.kha: To shahshkor mynta , bad maham ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh ,

translation.en: Then I arose , and went forth into the plain : and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  stood there , as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar : and I fell on my face .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit sha ka them , bad hangta nga ïohi ïa ka burom U  Trai  , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka harud ka wah Khebar .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel for ever and ever . And all the people said , Amen , and praised the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ! Ïaroh ïa u mynta bad junom ! Nangta baroh u paidbah u ong ,  Amen ,  bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  They say unto him , Twelve .
translation.kha: Hato phim kynmaw mynba nga la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki briew ? Katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu kiba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ?   Khat-ar ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer an offering unto the  Lord  before the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; blood shall be imputed unto that man  ; he hath shed blood  ; and that man shall be cut off from among his people :
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u pynïap ïa u masi lane u langbrot lane  langsohmoh kum ka jingainguh ïa U  Trai  hangno hangno lait noh ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum . U la pynmih snam bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew ki jong U Blei .

translation.en: Then Samuel took a stone , and set it between Mizpah and Shen , and called the name of it Eben–ezer , saying , Hitherto hath the  Lord  helped us .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u shim uwei u maw , u pynïeng ïa u hapdeng ka Mispah bad ka Shen , bad ong ,  U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ngi baroh shi lynter lynti  — bad u la pynkyrteng ïa u ,  u maw ka jingïarap .

translation.en: For a certain woman , whose young daughter had an unclean spirit , heard of him , and came and fell at his feet :
translation.kha: Kawei ka briew , kaba ka khun jong ka , ka don u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ka , ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu bad mar kumta hi ka la wan sha u bad ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: For nothing is secret , that shall not be made manifest  ; neither any thing hid , that shall not be known and come abroad .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano kaba la buhrieh noh yn wallam shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kano kano kaba la tap yn sa lap bad yn sa pynpaw ha kaba shai .

translation.en: And I will say to my soul , Soul , thou hast much goods laid up for many years  ; take thine ease , eat , drink , and be merry .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ha lade , A u briew badonbok ! Me la don kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba me donkam na ka bynta bun snem . Wat khuslai ïa la ka jingim , to bam , to dih , bad to lehkmen ïa lade !’

translation.en: If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace , and he will deliver us out of thine hand , O king .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei uba ngi shakri u lah ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka lawar ding baklang bad na ka bor jong phi , te un leh .

translation.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation  ; and ye shall afflict your souls : ye shall not do any work therein :
translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ; wat bam ei ei bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

translation.en: Yet Michael the archangel , when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses , durst not bring against him a railing accusation , but said , The Lord rebuke thee .
translation.kha: Wat u Mikhael , u angel rangbah um shym la leh ïa kane . Ha ka jingïakajia jong u bad u Soitan , mynba ki la ïania shaphang uei u ban ïoh ïa ka met u Moses , u Mikhael um shym nud ban pynrem ïa u Soitan da ki ktien ban krenbeiñ , hynrei u la ong ,  U Trai un da sneng ïa me !

translation.en: Woe to the crown of pride , to the drunkards of Ephraim , whose glorious beauty is a fading flower , which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine !
translation.kha: Ka hima Israel ka la kut ! Ka burom jong ka , ka la jah kum ki pansngiat syntiew ha ki khlieh jong ki nongïalam buaid . Ïa ki khlieh basarong jong ki la pyniwbih bha , hynrei hangta ki ïathiah , ki buaid bhor .

translation.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof .
translation.kha: U shna saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba don ki kjat jong ka .

translation.en: For we have heard him say , that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place , and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ba une U Jisu uba na Nasareth un sa pynkyllon ïa ka Templ bad pynkylla ïa ki rukom kiba la wan sha ngi lyngba u Moses !

translation.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods , with abominations provoked they him to anger .
translation.kha: Ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki ka pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban ym lah shah , ki kam bymman jong ki , ki la pynlong ïa u ban bitar .

translation.en: Is there no balm in Gilead  ; is there no physician there ? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered ?
translation.kha: Hato ym don dawai ha Gilead ? Hato ym don doktor hangta ? Balei te ba ïa ki briew jong nga ym shym la pynkhiah ?

translation.en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth ,
translation.kha: U Trai u tip mynno ki mynsiem jong ngi ki shah pynlwet ha ka byndi ;

translation.en: And if the man be poor , thou shalt not sleep with his pledge :
translation.kha: Lada u dei u briew uba duk , wat bat ïa ka baroh shi miet ;

translation.en: And every one had four faces , and every one had four wings .
translation.kha: hynrei uwei uwei na ki u don saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw tylli ki thapniang .

translation.en: And Joktan begat Almodad , and Sheleph , and Hazarmaveth , and Jerah ,
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joktan ki dei ki briew jong ka Almodad , ka Sheleph , ka Hasarmabeth , ka Jerah ,

translation.en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor , and so northward , looking toward Gilgal , that is before the going up to Adummim , which is on the south side of the river : and the border passed toward the waters of En–shemesh , and the goings out thereof were at En–rogel :
translation.kha: na ka Them Jingjynjar artet sha Debir , bad nangta ka phai shatei sha Gilgal , kaba marpyrshah ka Khim Adummim ha ka phang bashathie jong ka them . Nangta ka ïaid sha ki umpohliew ka Enshemesh , ka mih sha Enrogel ;

translation.en: Then the  Lord  put forth his hand , and touched my mouth . And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have put my words in thy mouth .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga , bad u la ong ha nga ,  To shahshkor , nga ai ha me ki kyntien kiba me dei ban kren .

translation.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge host , with very many chariots and horsemen ? yet , because thou didst rely on the  Lord  , he delivered them into thine hand .
translation.kha: Hato ki Sudan bad ki Libya kim don ki kynhun shipai baheh paid ryngkat bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai ? Hynrei namar ba me la shaniah ha U  Trai  , u la ai ka jingjop ïa me halor jong ki .

translation.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .
translation.kha: U Joahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .

translation.en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee , and manifested forth his glory  ; and his disciples believed on him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leh ïa kane ka kambah kaba nyngkong ha Kana ha Galilaïa ; hangta , u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ngeit ha u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had finished all these sayings , he said unto his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep hikai ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , u la ong ha la ki synran .

translation.en: I reckoned till morning , that , as a lion , so will he break all my bones : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet nga kyang bad ka jingpang , la kumba u sing u pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga . Nga pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .

translation.en: For we are the circumcision , which worship God in the spirit , and rejoice in Christ Jesus , and have no confidence in the flesh .
translation.kha: Dei ma ngi , ym ma ki , kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingotsher kaba shisha , naba ngi mane ïa U Blei da U Mynsiem jong u bad ngi lehkmen ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu . Ngim buh ïa kano kano ka jingshaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar .

translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn , by slaying her son ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la duwai jam ,  Ko  Trai  U Blei jong nga , balei me la leh kat kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ïa kane ka riewkynthei ? Ka la lehsbun shibun ban sumar ïa nga , bad mynta me pynïap ïa u khun jong ka !

translation.en: Then I came to the governors beyond the river , and gave them the king s letters . Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me .
translation.kha: U patsha u la phah katto katne ki rangbah shipai bad shi kynhun ki nongshong kulai bad nga , bad nga leit sha ka Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi . Hangta nga ai ïa ki shithi u patsha ha ki lat .

translation.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been  ; as infants which never saw light .
translation.kha: Te ngan jin da la ïohthiah kum ki khun syiem kiba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , lane ïohthiah kum u khunlung ba dang shu kha .

translation.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law , being made a curse for us : for it is written , Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree :
translation.kha: Hynrei , da kaba kylla long ka jingtim na ka bynta jong ngi , U Khrist u la siewspah ïa ngi na ka jingtim kaba ka Hukum ka wanrah ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba la shah sdien ha u dieng un don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei .

translation.en: And he that was over the house , and he that was over the city , the elders also , and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu , saying , We are thy servants , and will do all that thou shalt bid us  ; we will not make any king : do thou that which is good in thine eyes .
translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ki riewpawkhmat bad ki nongsumar , ki la phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Jehu :  Ngi long ki shakri jong phi bad ngi long kiba la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi ong ; hynrei ngin ym thung syiem ïano ïano ; leh katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .

translation.en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land : and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver , that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand .
translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel , bad u Menahem u ai ïa u laiphew saw ton ka rupa ban ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u ban nang pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Menahem halor ka ri .

translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David , Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia , and out of Syria–maacah , and out of Zobah .
translation.kha: U syiem Hanun bad ki Ammon ki sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong ïa u Dabid u nongshun jong ki , kumta ki siew laiphew saw hajar kilo ka rupa ban wai ki kali ïapom bad ki nongñiah kali ïapom na ka Mesopotamia bashaneng bad na ki jylla Syria jong ka Maakah bad Sobah .

translation.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old  ; he hath broken my bones .
translation.kha: U la ieh ïa ka doh jong nga ha ka jing-lhieh bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga .

translation.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good , evil shall not depart from his house .
translation.kha: Lada phi siew kylliang ïa kaba bha da kaba sniew , da lei lei phin ym lah ban beh ïa kaba sniew na ka ïing jong phi .

translation.en: For who is God , save the  Lord  ? and who is a rock , save our God ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  tang ma u hi u long U Blei ; U Blei tang ma u hi uba long ka jingïada jong ngi .

translation.en: After that , he was seen of James ; then of all the apostles .
translation.kha: Nangta u la paw ha u Jakob , bad hadien ha baroh ki Apostol .

translation.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified  ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba ka balang ha kylleng ka Judia , Galilaïa bad Samaria ka la ïoh shongsuk . Da ka jingïarap jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid la pynshaitbor ïa ka bad ka la nang san ha ka jingbun briew , haba ka ïaid ha ka jingsheptieng ïa U Trai .

translation.en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good , both among yourselves , and to all men .
translation.kha: Khmih ba uno uno un ym siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew , hynrei ha ki por baroh to kut jingmut ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh .

translation.en: But David pursued , he and four hundred men : for two hundred abode behind , which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor .
translation.kha: U Dabid u nang ïai bteng la ka lynti jong u lem bad sawspah ngut ki rangbah ; kita arspah ngut kiwei pat , namar ba ki la thait eh , kim lah shuh ban jam sha shiliang ka wahduid , bad ki sah noh shadien .

translation.en: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business  ; and a fool s voice is known by multitude of words .
translation.kha: Kat phi nang bun jingkhuslai , katta phin ïoh ki jingphohsniew kynsha , bad kat phi nang bunktien katta phin liat ha kaba kren ïa kaei kaei kaba bieit .

translation.en: For an odious woman when she is married  ; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress .
translation.kha: ka kynthei kaba ijli kaba ïoh ban shongkurim , bad ka shakri haba ka ïoh ban shim ïa ka jaka ka kynrad jong ka .

translation.en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people , and after the division of the families of the Levites .
translation.kha: bad to pynbiang ïa lade khnang ba katto katne na phi phin long kiba la kloi ban ïarap ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing jong ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east  ; and it was shut .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba kham shabar ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi jong ka Templ .

translation.en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are : and when I see the blood , I will pass over you , and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you , when I smite the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka snam ha ki shawkad kan long ka dak ban pyn-i ïa ki ïing ha kiba phi shong . Haba nga ïohi ïa kata ka snam , ngan ïaid lait na phi , bad ngan ym ktah ïa phi haba nga pynshitom ïa ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: And the people gave a shout , saying , It is the voice of a god , and not of a man .
translation.kha: Ym dei u briew uba kren , hynrei u blei !  ki la pyrta .

translation.en: A pair of earrings is a nice present for her .
translation.kha: Shijur ki sohshkor ki long ki jingai ba itynnad iaka .

translation.en: Yea , I think it meet , as long as I am in this tabernacle , to stir you up by putting you in remembrance  ;
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ïa kane ba ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban pynkhih ïa ka jingkynmaw jong phi ïa kine kiei kiei katba nga dang im .

translation.en: And leaving Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capernaum , which is upon the sea coast , in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim :
translation.kha: Um shym la shong la sah ha Nasareth , hynrei u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Kapernam , ka nongrit harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka thain jong ka Sebulun bad ka Naphtali .

translation.en: Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .
translation.kha: Ïa kine kiei kiei lah ban sngewthuh tang kum ka jingringdur : Ki ar ngut ki kynthei ki ïeng ïa ki ar tylli ki jutang ; kawei ïa kaba ki khun la kha ha ka jinglongmraw ka long ka Hagar , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jutang ba la pynlong halor u lum Sinai .

translation.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and delivered them into the hand of his servants : and king Asa sent them to Ben–hadad , the son of Tabrimon , the son of Hezion , king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Asa u shim lut ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kiba dang sah ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ban rah ha la ki rangbah synshar sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , u khun jong u Tabrimmon bad u ksiew jong u Hesion , lem bad kane ka khubor :

translation.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees , which say that there is no resurrection , and asked him ,
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi don na ki Saddusi ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kam ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap .
