translation.en: As saith the proverb of the ancients , Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingong mynbarim , ‘ Ïa ka jingbymman la leh tang da ki riewbymman .’ Bad kumta ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: I am the vine , ye are the branches : He that abideth in me , and I in him , the same bringeth forth much fruit : for without me ye can do nothing .
translation.kha: Nga long u dieng sohwaiñ , bad phi long ki tnat . Uno uno uba ïaineh ha nga , bad ma nga ha u , un seisoh shibun ; naba phim lah ban leh ei ei khlem ma nga .

translation.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram : for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi , whom the  Lord  had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .
translation.kha: U Blei u pyndonkam ïa kane ka jingleit jngoh ïa u Joram ban wanrah ka jingkyllon noh jong u Ahasaïah . Katba u Ahasaïah u dang don hangta , ma u bad u Joram ki la shah kynroi ha u briew uba kyrteng u Jehu , u khun jong u Nimshi , uba U  Trai  u la jied ban pynjot ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Ahab .

translation.en: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart , to think that all the king s sons are dead : for Amnon only is dead .
translation.kha: Kumta wat ngeit ïa ka khubor ba ki khun shynrang jong me baroh ki la ïap ; tang u Amnon uba la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And I looked , and rose up , and said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , Be not ye afraid of them : remember the Lord , which is great and terrible , and fight for your brethren , your sons , and your daughters , your wives , and your houses .
translation.kha: Nga ïohi ba ki briew ki khuslai , kumta nga ong ha ki bad ha ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ngi . Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba shyrkhei , bad u ïaleh na ka bynta ki briew ka ri jong phi , ki khun jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki ïing jong phi .

translation.en: And Moses went up unto God , and the  Lord  called unto him out of the mountain , saying , Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob , and tell the children of Israel  ;
translation.kha: bad u Moses u la leit kiew sha u lum ban ïashem bad U Blei . U  Trai  u la khot ïa u na u lum bad u la bthah ïa u ban ong ha ki Israel , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob :

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land , and they shall no more be remembered : and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki bleithaw na ka ri , bad ym don mano mano ban kynmaw shuh ïa ki . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno uba kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa bad ngan shim noh ïa ka jingkwah ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And Isaac loved Esau , because he did eat of his venison : but Rebekah loved Jacob .
translation.kha: U Isaak u kham jied ïa u Iso , namar u bang bha ban bam ïa ki mrad kiba u Iso u pynïap , hynrei ka Rebekka ka kham jied ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain  ; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven , with darkness , clouds , and thick darkness .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki khun ki kti jong phi kumno phi leit ïeng ha trai uta u lum ha uba u lyoh tdem uba ïong synñia u tap bad na uba ka ding kaba rhem ka klang shaduh suiñbneng .

translation.en: But to Israel he saith , All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people .
translation.kha: Hynrei shaphang ki Israel u ong ,  Baroh shi sngi nga la rah ïa la ki kti ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: They are of the world : therefore speak they of the world , and the world heareth them .
translation.kha: Kito ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , ki kren shaphang kiei kiei ki jong ka pyrthei , bad ka pyrthei ka shahshkor ïa ki , namar ki long ki jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Saul cast the javelin  ; for he said , I will smite David even to the wall with it . And David avoided out of his presence twice .
translation.kha: Ngan sum ïa u ha ka kynroh ,  u Saul u ong ha lade , bad u kawang ïa u sum ha u ar sien ; hynrei ha baroh ar sien u Dabid u kynriah .

translation.en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer , but destruction cometh  ; it cometh out of the north .
translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka long kum ka masi baphylla , ba la tur ïaleh da u skain ba kynthah na shatei .

translation.en: And if it appear still in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a spreading plague : thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire .
translation.kha: Te , lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang , ka mut ba ka la wan pur biang , bad u trai u dei ban thang noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And to the genealogy of all their little ones , their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , through all the congregation : for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness :
translation.kha: La kyntiew kyrteng ïa ki baroh ryngkat lang bad ki tnga jong ki , ki khun , bad kiba hap ha ka jingsumar jong ki , namar ka donkam ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi ban leh ïa ki kam bakyntang ha kano kano ka por .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Moab , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Kim shym burom ïa ki shyieng u syiem Edom da kaba thang haduh ba kin da kylla dpei .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they saw him , that they brought thirty companions to be with him .
translation.kha: Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ïa u , ki phah laiphew ngut ki samla shynrang ban sah bad u .

translation.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Job u sngewskhem ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong u hi , kita ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki iehnoh ïa ka ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa u .

translation.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me : for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Ban pynkut : Wat ai ba uno uno un buh jingeh shuh ïa nga , namar ki dak mong kiba nga don ha ka met jong nga ki pyn-i ba nga long u mraw jong U Jisu .

translation.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah . Bad kumta u Baasha u long u syiem ka Israel ha ka jaka u Nadab .

translation.en: And David sent messengers to Ish–bosheth Saul s son , saying , Deliver me my wife Michal , which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Bad u Dabid ruh u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Ishbosheth ban ong ,  Ai noh ha nga ïa ka Mikhal ka tnga jong nga . Nga la siew shispah tylli ki doh otsher jong ki Philistia ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And the  Lord  did that thing on the morrow , and all the cattle of Egypt died : but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U  Trai  u la leh kumba u la ong bad ki jingri baroh jong ki nong Ijipt ki la ïap , hynrei kawei ruh na ki jingri jong ki Israel kam shym ïap .

translation.en: They eat up the sin of my people , and they set their heart on their iniquity .
translation.kha: Phi kylla riewspah na ki pop ki briew jong nga , bad kumta phi kwah ïa ki ban nang leh pop shuh shuh .

translation.en: Take heed to thyself , lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest , lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee :
translation.kha: Wat ïateh jutang bad ki briew jong kata ka ri sha kaba phi leit , namar kata ka lah ban long ka jingriam ka ban pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: For as the body is one , and hath many members , and all the members of that one body , being many , are one body : so also is Christ .
translation.kha: U Khrist u long kum kawei ka met , kaba don shibun ki dkhot ; ka long hi tang kawei ka met , wat haba la pynlong ïa ka da ki dkhot kiba ïapher .

translation.en: The burden of the desert of the sea . As whirlwinds in the south pass through  ; so it cometh from the desert , from a terrible land .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Babilonia . Kum ka  erlangthari kaba sar sha shiliang ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot kan wan na ka ri kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: Even so faith , if it hath not works , is dead , being alone .
translation.kha: Kumta ka long bad ka jingngeit : Lada ka long tang ma ka hi bad kam kynthup ïa ki kam , te ka long kaba ïap .

translation.en: For he loveth our nation , and he hath built us a synagogue .
translation.kha: U ieit ïa ki briew jong ngi bad u hi da lade u la tei ka synagog na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him , he touched the hollow of his thigh  ; and the hollow of Jacob s thigh was out of joint , as he wrestled with him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u briew u ïohi ba um lah jop ïa u Jakob , u kura ïa u na ka skhep ; bad kata ka skhep jong u ka la lait .

translation.en: They have stricken me , shalt thou say , and I was not sick  ; they have beaten me , and I felt it not : when shall I awake ? I will seek it yet again .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tied ,  phin ong ;  ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tangon , hynrei ngam kynmaw ïa ka . Balei ngam shym lah ban khie ? Nga donkam ban ïoh jingdih biang .

translation.en: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison : go ye , carry corn for the famine of your houses :
translation.kha: Ban pynshisha ba phi long ki briew kiba hok , uwei na phi un sah ha ka ïingbyndi ha kaba la set ïa phi , kiwei pat ki lah ban leit kit ïa u kew uba phi la thied sha ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi kiba shahthngan .

translation.en: Saying , Master , Moses said , If a man die , having no children , his brother shall marry his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  u Moses u la ong ba lada u briew u bym don khun u ïap , u para jong u , u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka tnga jong une uba la ïap khnang ba ki lah ban ïoh khun ïa kiba yn lah ban ñiew kum ki khun jong une u briew uba la ïap .

translation.en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption ; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting .
translation.kha: Lada u bet ha ka lyngkha jong ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong u , na ka un lum ïa ka jingot ka jingïap ; lada u bet ha ka lyngkha U Mynsiem , na U Mynsiem un lum ïa ka jingot jong ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Or crookbackt , or a dwarf , or that hath a blemish in his eye , or be scurvy , or scabbed , or hath his stones broken  ;
translation.kha: uba kdor ka ingdong lane u khyndai khup ; uba pang khmat , uba ïoh  ñiangdait , uba don prum , lane u ïunukh .

translation.en: And I will take the remnant of Judah , that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , and they shall all be consumed , and fall in the land of Egypt  ; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine : they shall die , from the least even unto the greatest , by the sword and by the famine : and they shall be an execration , and an astonishment , and a curse , and a reproach .
translation.kha: Bad ïa ki briew ka Judah kiba sah bad kiba la kut jingmut ban leit bad shong ha Ijipt , ngan khmih ïa kane ba baroh na ki kin jot noh . Baroh na ki , kiba rit bad ki bakhraw , kin ïap ha Ijipt , na ka thma ne na ka jingïapthngan . Kin long ka jingïohi ba-itriem ; ki briew kin ñiewbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .

translation.en: And another angel came out from the altar , which had power over fire  ; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle , saying , Thrust in thy sharp sickle , and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth  ; for her grapes are fully ripe .
translation.kha: Nangta sa uwei pat u angel , uba dei khmih ïa ka ding , u la wan na ka duwan . U la pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam sha uta u angel uba la don ka rashi kaba nep ,  To pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi , bad ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na ka bri sohwaiñ jong ka pyrthei , namar ba ki sohwaiñ ki la ih !

translation.en: I , even I , am he that comforteth you : who art thou , that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die , and of the son of man which shall be made as grass  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga long uta uba pynkhlaiñ ïa phi . Balei phin sheptieng ïa u briew u bym im junom , u bym kham neh ban ïa u phlang ?

translation.en: The  Lord  thy God , he will go over before thee , and he will destroy these nations from before thee , and thou shalt possess them : and Joshua , he shall go over before thee , as the  Lord  hath said .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi hi un leit ha shuwa jong phi bad un pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba shong hangta , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki ; bad u Joshua un long u nongïalam jong phi , kumba U  Trai  u la ong .

translation.en: Onyx stones , and stones to be set in the ephod , and in the breastplate .
translation.kha: ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ban buh ha ka ephod jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u .

translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of our fathers , art not thou God in heaven ? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen ? and in thine hand is there not power and might , so that none is able to withstand thee ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , me synshar ha bneng halor ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei . Me long uba donbor bad uba khrawbor , bad ym don ba lah ban pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away ? they die , even without wisdom .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kaba u don la shim noh ; u ïap , khlem pat dap pura ka jingstad .

translation.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep , and he said , Surely the  Lord  is in this place  ; and I knew it not .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la kyndit thiah , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u don hangne ! U don ha kane ka jaka , bad ngam shym tip ïa kata !

translation.en: Malchijah the son of Harim , and Hashub the son of Pahath–moab , repaired the other piece , and the tower of the furnaces .
translation.kha: U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Harim bad u Hasshub , u khun jong u Pahath Moab , ki tei baroh ar tylli ki bynta kiba bud bad ïa u Mot shet kpu .

translation.en: God chose the Israelites to be his witnesses .
translation.kha: U Blei u la jied ïa ki nong Israel ban long ki nongsakhi jong u .

translation.en: Take you twelve men out of the people , out of every tribe a man ,
translation.kha: Jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait ,

translation.en: If a brother or sister be naked , and destitute of daily food ,
translation.kha: Tharai don ki parabangeit shynrang bad kynthei kiba donkam jaiñ bad kim don ka bam kaba biang ban bam .

translation.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime : as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire .
translation.kha: Phin sa lwet kum ki maw ba la thang ban pynlong mawshun , kum ki shiah ba la thang haduh ba ki la kylla dpei .

translation.en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee , O Israel : and because I will do this unto thee , prepare to meet thy God , O Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paid Israel , ngan pynshitom ïa phi . Bad namar ba ngan leh ïa kane , to pynkhreh ban mad ïa ka jingbishar jong nga !

translation.en: Praise him , ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki bneng bajrong tam , bad ki um halor ka sahit bneng .

translation.en: Thy dead men shall live , together with my dead body shall they arise . Awake and sing , ye that dwell in dust : for thy dew is as the dew of herbs , and the earth shall cast out the dead .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dei napdeng ki briew jong ngi kiba la ïap kin im biang ! Ki met jong ki kin wan phai biang sha ka jingim . Baroh kito kiba ïohthiah ha ki jingtep jong ki kin kyndit thiah bad kin rwai namar ka jingkmen . Kumba ka umjer baphyrnai ka pynthymmai bor ïa ka khyndew , kumta ruh U  Trai  un pynkhie im pat ïa kito kiba la ïap la slem .

translation.en: It is of the  Lord s  mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit baneh bad ka jingisynei jong U  Trai  ka ïaineh ,

translation.en: Only in the land of Goshen , where the children of Israel were , was there no hail .
translation.kha: Ka thain Goshen , ha kaba ki Israel ki shong ki sah , ka long tang ma ka , ka jaka ha kaba u phria um shym hap .

translation.en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him , but slew his son . And when he died , he said , The  Lord  look upon it , and require it .
translation.kha: U syiem u la klet ïa ka jingshakri bahok ba u Jehoïada , u kpa jong u Sekharaïah u la ai ïa u , bad u la phah pynïap ïa u Sekharaïah . Shuwa ba u Sekharaïah un ïap , u pyrta ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh bad un pynshitom ïa phi !

translation.en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread , but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba um shym la maham ïa ki ban sumar ïa lade na u thiat uba pyndonkam ha u kpu , hynrei na ka jinghikai ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .

translation.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant , that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na ka jinglum soh .

translation.en: Then Jesus answered and said ,  O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him hither to me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  A katno ki bymngeit bad kiba bakla phi ki briew phi long ! Sa katno nga dei ban dang don bad phi ? Sa katno ngan dang ïaishah ïa phi ? To wallam ïa u khynnah shane sha nga !

translation.en: And he said , Lord  God  , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Abram u ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , kumno keiñ nga lah ban tip ba kan long ka jong nga ?

translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see in that day , when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
translation.kha: Phin sa shem haba phin leit shadien ka kamra ban rieh ,  U Mikaïah u jubab .

translation.en: And in this mountain shall the  Lord  of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things , a feast of wines on the lees , of fat things full of marrow , of wines on the lees well refined .
translation.kha: Hangne halor u Lum Seïon , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pynkhreh ka jingkhawai bah na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei — ka jingkhawai bah da ki jingbam bakyrhai eh bad ka waiñ bakynsai tam .

translation.en: ( For they could not endure that which was commanded , And if so much as a beast touch the mountain , it shall be stoned , or thrust through with a dart :
translation.kha: Namar kim lah ban shah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la hukum kaba ong ,  Wat lada u mrad un ktah ïa uta u lum , yn lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal , all his servants , and all his priests  ; let none be wanting : for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal  ; whosoever shall be wanting , he shall not live . But Jehu did it in subtilty , to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal .
translation.kha: Khot lang ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal baroh , ïa ki nongmane jong u baroh , bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u baroh . Uwei ruh um dei ban pep ; nga ai ka jingkñia ainguh kaba khraw ha u Baal , bad uno uno uba jah un shah pynïap .  ( Kane ka long ka buit sianti ha ka liang jong u Jehu da kaba u mut ban pynïap lut ïa ki nongmane ïa u Baal . )

translation.en: And Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah : and Ish–bosheth said to Abner , Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father s concubine ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ishbosheth u khun jong u Saul u kynnoh sniew ïa u Abner ba u ïathiah bad ka Rispah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka khun jong u Aïah .

translation.en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition , which ye have delivered : and many such like things do ye .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka jinghikai ba phi ai pateng sha kiwei pat ka pynduh noh ïa ka ktien jong U Blei . Bad don bun kiwei kiei kiei kum kane kaba phi leh .

translation.en: The  Lord  is slow to anger , and great in power , and will not at all acquit the wicked : the  Lord  hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm , and the clouds are the dust of his feet .
translation.kha: U  Trai  um ju bitar shen , hynrei u long uba khrawbor bad um ju shah ba kiba shah rai pynrem kin lait khlem shah pynshitom . Hangno ha kaba U  Trai  u ïaid , ki  erïong ki khie ; ki lyoh ki long ki pui pui ba la pynmih da ki kjat jong u !

translation.en: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir , and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim , which is Chesalon , on the north side , and went down to Beth–shemesh , and passed on to Timnah :
translation.kha: ha kaba u tawiar shaphang sepngi jong ka Baalah sha ka ri lum jong ka Edom , ter ter sha ka phang bashatei jong u Lum Jearim ( lane Khesalon ) , arsut sha Beth Shemesh , bad ter ter lyngba ka Timnah .

translation.en: Moreover he said , I am the God of thy father , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . And Moses hid his face  ; for he was afraid to look upon God .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob de .  Kumta u Moses u tap ïa la ka khmat , namar um nud ban peit sha U Blei .

translation.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven , and in the earth !
translation.kha: hynrei u dem shapoh ban peit ïa ki bneng bad ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing  ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonglam lynti kiba matlah ! Phi hikai , ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da ka Templ , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka ksiar hapoh ka Templ , u long uba la shah teh .’

translation.en: At midday , O king , I saw in the way a light from heaven , above the brightness of the sun , shining round about me and them which journeyed with me .
translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka lynti ha ka por shiteng sngi , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba kham phyrnai ban ïa ka sngi , kaba wan na sahit bneng bad kaba tyngshaiñ baroh sawdong ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit lang bad nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun , that Joshua commanded , and they took them down off the trees , and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid , and laid great stones in the cave s mouth , which remain until this very day .
translation.kha: Ha ka por sep sngi u Joshua u ai ka hukum , bad la pynhiar noh ïa kita ki metïap bad bret ha kajuh ka krem ha kaba ki la ïarieh mynshuwa . La buh ïa ki maw kiba heh ha ka jaka rung sha ka krem , bad ki dang don hangta .

translation.en: And another angel came out of the temple , crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud , Thrust in thy sickle , and reap : for the time is come for thee to reap  ; for the harvest of the earth is ripe .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei pat u angel u la wan mihnoh na ka Templ bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam sha uta uba shong halor u lyoh ,  To pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi bad to ot ïa ka jingot , namar ka por ka la poi ; ka pyrthei ka la ih na ka bynta ka jingot !

translation.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope , and let not thy soul spare for his crying .
translation.kha: Pynbeit ïa la ki khun katba ki dang lung ban shah hikai . Lada phim leh kumta , phi ïarap ïa ki ban pynjot da ki hi .

translation.en: Till a dart strike through his liver  ; as a bird hasteth to the snare , and knoweth not that it is for his life .
translation.kha: ha kaba u  namsop u dung ha u klongsnam jong u . U long kum ka sim kaba tur ruma sha ka jar — um shym tip ba ka jingim jong u ka don ha ka jingma .

translation.en: Is the seed yet in the barn ? yea , as yet the vine , and the fig tree , and the pomegranate , and the olive tree , hath not brought forth : from this day will I bless you .
translation.kha: Wat la ym don kew ba dang sah , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ , ki diengsoh Dumbur , ki diengsoh Pomkranet , bad ki diengsoh Olib kim pat shym pynmih soh , pynban naduh mynta ngan kyrkhu ïa phi .

translation.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested , being witnessed by the law and the prophets ;
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ka rukom ba U Blei u buh ba ki briew kin long ka hok bad u hi , la pynpaw . Kam don jingïadei ei ei bad ka Hukum , wat la ka Hukum u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ka jingsakhi ïa ka .

translation.en: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba don kita ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ki la pynkhreh ban put ïa ki .

translation.en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face : keep the munition , watch the way , make thy loins strong , fortify thy power mightily .
translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha don ha ka jingshah tur ïaleh ! Ka bor ka ban kynther ïa pha ka la wan . To buh briew ha ki jingïada ! To phira ïa ka lynti bah ! To pynkhreh ïa ka thma !

translation.en: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it  ; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them : and they were judged every man according to their works .
translation.kha: Nangta ka duriaw ka la aiti ïa kiba ïap jong ka . Ka jingïap bad kumjuh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ki la aiti ïa kiba ïap kiba ki la bat . Bad ïa baroh la bishar kat kum kaei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: Jehovah tells us to avoid sinful practices because he knows they will harm us .
translation.kha: U Jehobah u ong ïa ngi ban kiar na ka jingmlien ba long pop namar ba u tip ba kin pynsniew ïa ngi .

translation.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee , until thou be increased , and inherit the land .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngan beh noh ïa ki khyndiat pa khyndiat , tad haduh ba phin da ïabun paid ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .

translation.en: And kept back part of the price , his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
translation.kha: Bad da ka jingmynjur jong ka tnga jong u , u la buh katto katne ka pisa na ka bynta ïa lade bad u la ai ïa kaba sah baroh ha ki apostol .

translation.en: And it shall be answered , Because they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , and laid hold on other gods , and worshipped them , and served them : therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin jubab , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la iehnoh na U  Trai  U Blei uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ki la ai ïa la ka jingnguh ïa kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la mane ïa ki . Kata ka long balei ba U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ki ïa kane ka apot .’

translation.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail , that , behold , twins were in her womb .
translation.kha: Haba ka la dei por ïa ka ban kha , la shem ba kan sa kha khun synrap .

translation.en: And when he came to the den , he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel : and the king spake and said to Daniel , O Daniel , servant of the living God , is thy God , whom thou servest continually , able to deliver thee from the lions ?
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hangta , u la khot jam da ka jingkhmih lynti ,  Ko Daniel , u shakri jong U Blei uba im ! Hato U Blei uba me shakri hok katta katta u la lah mo ban pyllait im ïa me na ki sing ?

translation.en: Who , when they came to Caesarea , and delivered the epistle to the governor , presented Paul also before him .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalam ïa u sha Kaisaria , ki la ai ïa ka shithi ha u lyngskor , bad ki la aiti ïa u Paul ha u .

translation.en: How much distance to go ?
translation.kha: Katno ka jing-jngai ngi hap leit ?

translation.en: He sent darkness , and made it dark  ; and they rebelled not against his word .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa ka jingdum ha ka ri , hynrei ki nong Ijipt kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .

translation.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him : for he had said , I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers . And he laid him down upon his bed , and turned away his face , and would eat no bread .
translation.kha: U Ahab u leit phai sha la ïing , u da sngewsih bad bitar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth u ong ha u . U dem ha la ka jingthiah , u phai shaphang ka kynroh , bad um treh bam ei ei .

translation.en: And at midnight there was a cry made , Behold , the bridegroom cometh  ; go ye out to meet him .
translation.kha: Ka la da shiteng synñia haba ka jingpyrta ka la sawa jam , ‘ U nongleitkurim u la don hangne ! To wan bad ïashem ïa u !’

translation.en: In every thing give thanks : for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you .
translation.kha: to long kiba sngewnguh ha kiei kiei baroh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u kwah na phi ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the second time , while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison , saying ,
translation.kha: Katba nga dang don hi ha ka ïingbyndi ha ka phyllaw , ka khubor U  Trai  ka la wan biang ha nga .

translation.en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations , and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did , which were before him , and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols :
translation.kha: U syiem Manasseh u la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli , kiei kiei kiba kham sniew ban ïa kaei kaba ki nong Kanaan ki la leh , bad ryngkat bad ki bleithaw jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki briew jong ka Judah ban leh pop .

translation.en: Fear ye not therefore , ye are of more value than many sparrows .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng , phi kham kor bun shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïing .

translation.en: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword : she is delivered to the sword : draw her and all her multitudes .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Ijipt kin kyllon lang bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynïap lut ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword , and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter : because when I called , ye did not answer  ; when I spake , ye did not hear  ; but did evil before mine eyes , and did choose that wherein I delighted not .
translation.kha: Kan dei ka kupar jong phi ban ïap ka jingïap bashyrkhei , namar phim shym la jubab haba nga khot ïa phi lane shahshkor haba nga kren . Phi jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: Is not destruction to the wicked ? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity ?
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingjynjar bad jingpynjot ïa kito kiba leh bymhok .

translation.en: So Azariah slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Darts are counted as stubble : he laugheth at the shaking of a spear .
translation.kha: Ïa u , u dieng tangon u long u lyngkhot phlangïap bad u rkhie haba ki briew ki kawang sum ïa u ,

translation.en: And , behold , I will send a lad , saying , Go , find out the arrows . If I expressly say unto the lad , Behold , the arrows are on this side of thee , take them  ; then come thou : for there is peace to thee , and no hurt  ; as the  Lord  liveth .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ïa u shakri jong nga ban leit tam ïa ki . Bad lada nga ong ha u , ‘ Khmih , kito ki khnam ki don ha kane ka liang jong phi ; tam ïa ki ,’ kata ka mut ba kam lei lei bad phi lah ban mih shabar . Nga smai ha U  Trai  uba im ba phin ym don ha ka jingma .

translation.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab : which said , We will not come up :
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u phah khot ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , hynrei ki ong ,  Ngim wan !

translation.en: And they journeyed : and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them , and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki sdang ban mih , ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw ka la wan hap ha ki briew kiba don ha ki shnong ba-marjan , bad kim shym la beh satia ïa ki .

translation.en: Not for that we have dominion over your faith , but are helpers of your joy : for by faith ye stand .
translation.kha: Ngim shym pyrshang ban pynbor ïa kaei kaba phi dei ban ngeit ; ngi tip ba phi ïeng skhem ha ka jingngeit . Pynban , ngi ïatrei lem bad phi na ka bynta ka jingkmen jong phi hi .

translation.en: And David went up at the saying of Gad , which he spake in the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U  Trai  bad u leit , kumba u Gad u la ong ïa u .

translation.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north : with God is terrible majesty .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingphyrnai ksiar la ïohi ha ka phang bashatei , bad ka burom jong U Blei ka pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingtiengburom .

translation.en: Be not deceived : evil communications corrupt good manners .
translation.kha: To wat shah ba yn shukor .  Ki paralok kiba sniew ki pynjot ïa ka jinglong babha .

translation.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow .
translation.kha: Dei ha me , ym ha ki hynmen jong me , ba nga ai ïa ka Shekhem , kata ka jaka kaba seisoh ba nga la ïohknieh na ki Amor da ka waitlam bad ka ryntieh jong nga .

translation.en: His cheeks are as a bed of spices , as sweet flowers : his lips like lilies , dropping sweet smelling myrrh .
translation.kha: hangta ki jingthung ki plung . Ki san kum ka bri ki diengsoh Pomkranet bad ki sei ki soh bakynsai . Ym don kano kano ka jingduna ïa u henna bad ïa u nard ,

translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp , to deliver thee , and to give up thine enemies before thee  ; therefore shall thy camp be holy : that he see no unclean thing in thee , and turn away from thee .
translation.kha: Sumar khuid ïa ka jaka shong dara jong phi , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi hangta ban ïada ïa phi bad ai ha phi ka jingjop ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Wat leh ïa kano kano kaba khlem akor kaba lah ban pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban phai noh na phi .

translation.en: And upon Dibon , and upon Nebo , and upon Beth–diblathaim ,
translation.kha: Dibon , Nebo , Beth Diblathaim ,

translation.en: The king s favour is toward a wise servant : but his wrath is against him that causeth shame .
translation.kha: Ki syiem ki sngewtynnat ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba lah , hynrei ki pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynlehrain ïa ki .

translation.en: For the husband is the head of the wife , even as Christ is the head of the church : and he is the saviour of the body .
translation.kha: Naba u tnga u don ka iktiar halor la ka tnga kumba U Khrist u don ka iktiar halor ka balang ; bad U Khrist hi u long U Nongpynim jong ka balang , ka met jong u .

translation.en: Sanctify yourselves therefore , and be ye holy : for I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Pynkyntang khuid ïa lade , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: But Peter put them all forth , and kneeled down , and prayed  ; and turning him to the body said , Tabitha , arise . And she opened her eyes : and when she saw Peter , she sat up .
translation.kha: U Petros u la pynmih ïa ki baroh shabar ka kamra , bad u la dem khohsiew bad duwai ; nangta u la phai sha ka met bad u la ong ,  Ko Tabitha , khie joit !  Ka la plied ïa la ki khmat , bad haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros , ka la khie shong .

translation.en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony , and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ksiar ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Then take silver and gold , and make crowns , and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ;
translation.kha: To thaw ka pansngiat na ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba ki la ai , bad buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u khun jong u Jehosadak .

translation.en: Likewise from Tibhath , and from Chun , cities of Hadarezer , brought David very much brass , wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass .
translation.kha: U kurup ruh bun bah ka rnong na Tibhath bad Kun , ki nongbah ba synshar u Hadadeser . ( U Solomon hadien u pyndonkam ïa kane ka rnong ha kaba thaw ïa ka pung-um , ki rishot , bad ki khiew rong na ka bynta ka Templ . )

translation.en: And lest your heart faint , and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land  ; a rumour shall both come one year , and after that in another year shall come a rumour , and violence in the land , ruler against ruler .
translation.kha: Wat nym duh noh ïa ka jingshlur ne sheptieng namar ki khubor lamler ba phi ïohsngew . Man ka snem ki khubor lamler bapher ki phriang — ki khubor lamler shaphang ka jinglehbor ha ka ri bad ba uwei u syiem u ïaleh ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: And he made them a feast , and they did eat and drink .
translation.kha: U Isaak u pynkhreh ka jingkhawai ïa ki , bad ki ïabam ïadih .

translation.en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father , and said unto him , Wherefore shall he be slain ? what hath he done ?
translation.kha: Balei u dei ban ïap ?  u Jonathan u jubab .  U la leh aïu eh ?

translation.en: These things said he : and after that he saith unto them ,  Our friend Lazarus sleepeth  ; but I go , that I may awake him out of sleep .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa kane bad nangta u pynbud ,  U paralok jong ngi u Lasaros u la ïohthiah , hynrei ngan leit bad ngan kyrsiew noh ïa u .

translation.en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle  ; and , behold , Miriam became leprous , white as snow : and Aaron looked upon Miriam , and , behold , she was leprous .
translation.kha: bad u lyoh u kynriah noh na ka Ïingjaiñ , hangta hi ka sniehdoh jong ka Miriam ka la tap da ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh bad ka la kylla lieh kum ka ïor . Haba u Aaron u peit ïa ka bad u ïohi ba ka la ngat ïa kata ka jingpang ,

translation.en: The way of peace they know not  ; and there is no judgment in their goings : they have made them crooked paths : whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace .
translation.kha: Bad ym don ba long shngain haba phi don hangta . Baroh kaba phi leh ka long ka bymhok . Phi bud ïa ka lynti ïaid kaba kyllaiñ , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïaid na kata ka lynti u ban long shngain .

translation.en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts , their conscience also bearing witness , and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another ; )
translation.kha: Ka jingleh jong ki ka pyn-i ba ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ki jingïatiplem jong ki ruh ki pyn-i ba kane ka long kaba shisha , namar ki jingpyrkhat jong ki teng teng ki pynrem ïa ki bad teng teng ki kyrshan ïa ki .

translation.en: For which things  sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience :
translation.kha: Namar kiba kum kine kiei kiei , ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka wan ha kito ki bymkohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: Remember Lot s wife .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa ka tnga u Lot !

translation.en: Ye shall have one manner of law , as well for the stranger , as for one of your own country : for I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Kane ka hukum ka teh ïa phi baroh , ïa ki Israel bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death .
translation.kha: Ka Mikhal , ka khun jong u Saul , kam shym la ïoh khun .

translation.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
translation.kha: Te u Sennakherib u patsha ka Assyria u iehnoh bad leit phai sha Ninebeh .

translation.en: If thou shalt do this thing , and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure , and all this people shall also go to their place in peace .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane , kumba U Blei u hukum , phin ym pynthait ïa lade , bad kine ki briew baroh ki lah ban leit sha ïing hadien ba la bishar ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki .

translation.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease , neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest : but the  Lord  shall give thee there a trembling heart , and failing of eyes , and sorrow of mind :
translation.kha: Phin ym shongsuk hapdeng kita ki jaitbynriew , bad phin ym ïoh jaka ban kam kum la ka jong ; hangta U  Trai  un pynshong syier , un pynduh jingkyrmen , bad un pynswai mynsiem ïa phi .

translation.en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel . And it came to pass , when the man of God saw her afar off , that he said to Gehazi his servant , Behold , yonder is that Shunammite :
translation.kha: Kumta ka la leit , bad ka leit sha u Lum Karmel , ha kaba u Elisha u don . U Elisha u la ïohi ïa ka , ba ka wan katba ka dang don kham ha pajih , bad u ong ha u Gehasi , u shakri jong u ,  Ha khmih — katai ka briew na Shunem ka wan !

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Learn not the way of the heathen , and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven  ; for the heathen are dismayed at them .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Wat bud ïa ki rukom jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ; wat khih jingmut da ki jingïohi bym ju kham ïohi ha ka sahit bneng , wat la kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: As birds flying , so will the  Lord  of hosts defend Jerusalem  ; defending also he will deliver it  ; and passing over he will preserve it .
translation.kha: Kumba ka sim ka her tawiar halor ka skum jong ka ban ïada ïa ki khun rit jong ka , kumta ruh ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ngan ïada ïa ka Jerusalem bad kyrshan ïa ka .

translation.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: phi lah ban sngewskhem ba ka jingstad ka long kaba bha ïa ka mynsiem . To ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka lawei jong phi kan long kaba phyrnai .

translation.en: Take heed to yourselves , that your heart be not deceived , and ye turn aside , and serve other gods , and worship them  ;
translation.kha: Da husiar ban ym shah ïalam bakla noh na U  Trai  ban mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath : so Tibni died , and Omri reigned .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , kito kiba kwah ïa u Omri ki la jop ; u Tibni u la ïap bad u Omri u la long u syiem .

translation.en: Now when he had left speaking , he said unto Simon ,  Launch out into the deep , and let down your nets for a draught .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep kren , u la ong ha u Simon ,  To ñiat ïa ka lieng kham jngai sha ka um bajylliew , bad ma me lem bad ki paralok jong me to pynhap ïa ki jar ban tong dohkha .

translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , the brother of Caleb , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , uba shi para bad u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah , kumta u Kaleb u ai ïa ka Akhsah ha u ban shongkurim .

translation.en: Then the beasts go into dens , and remain in their places .
translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw ki leit sha la ki krem .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Whosoever shall put away his wife , and marry another , committeth adultery against her .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa ki ,  U briew uba pyllait ïa ka tnga jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew , u klim pyrshah ïa la ka tnga .

translation.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons  after him , to be anointed therein , and to be consecrated in them .
translation.kha: Ynda la ïap u Aaron , ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh jong u dei ban aiti ha ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin phong ha ka por ba pynkyntang ïa ki .

translation.en: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment , that , if any man knew where he were , he should shew it , that they might take him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ai ïa ka hukum ba lada uno uno u tip hangno ba U Jisu u don , u dei ban wanrah khubor , khnang ba kin ïohkem ïa u .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  out of Zion , which dwelleth at Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ha Seïon , ha Jerusalem , ka ïingshong jong u . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak , saying , Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; and a calf and a lamb , both of the first year , without blemish , for a burnt offering  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa uwei u  langsohmoh ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , uwei u khun masi uba shisnem , bad uwei u khunlangbrot uba shisnem , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna , ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh thang ,

translation.en: And these things give in charge , that they may be blameless .
translation.kha: To ai ha ki ïa kine ki jinghikai , khnang ba yn ym don ba wad daw ïa ki .

translation.en: They shall not build , and another inhabit  ; they shall not plant , and another eat : for as the days of a tree are the days of my people , and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands .
translation.kha: Kum ki dieng , ki briew jong nga kin im slem . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen pura ha kiei kiei kiba ki la trei shitom .

translation.en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod , ( when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him , ) and fought against Ashdod , and took it  ;
translation.kha: Ha ki hukum jong u Sargon , u patsha jong ka Assyria , u rangbah ai hukum bahakhlieh tam jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashdod ka nongbah Philistia .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned unto Zion , and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth  ; and the mountain of the  Lord  of hosts the holy mountain .
translation.kha: Ngan wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga , bad ban shong ban sah hangta . Ïa ka yn tip kum ka nongbah baïaineh , bad ïa u lum jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh yn khot u lum bakyntang .

translation.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind  ; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance .
translation.kha: Me la shah ïa ka lyer ban beh noh ïa nga ; me la kynting ïa nga ha ka  erïong bajur .

translation.en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a merciful God  ; ) he will not forsake thee , neither destroy thee , nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them .
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba isynei . Un ym iehnoh lane pynjot ïa phi , bad un ym klet ïa ka jutang kaba u hi u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: And Saul commanded his servants , saying , Commune with David secretly , and say , Behold , the king hath delight in thee , and all his servants love thee : now therefore be the king s son in law .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa la ki rangbah synshar ban ïakren jar jar bad u Dabid bad ban ïathuh ha u ,  U syiem u shem sngewbha ïa phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ki sngewtynnat ïa phi ; mynta ka dei ka por kaba biang ba phin shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u .

translation.en: I came
translation.kha: Nga La Wan

translation.en: Unto Shem also , the father of all the children of Eber , the brother of Japheth the elder , even to him were children born .
translation.kha: U Shem , u hynmen jong u Japheth , u la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Hebru baroh .

translation.en: The son of Abishua , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the chief priest :
translation.kha: u khun jong u Abishua , u khun jong u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar , u khun jong u Aaron .

translation.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles .
translation.kha: Ngam tharai ba nga long uba khampoh khyndiat ban ïa kito ki riewkyrpang ïa kiba la khot ki  apostol  jong phi!

translation.en: David therefore sent out spies , and understood that Saul was come in very deed .
translation.kha: u phah ïa ki nongsyntiat , bad u shem ba u Saul u la wan shisha hangta .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  This is the work of God , that ye believe on him whom he hath sent .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh ka long ban ngeit ha uta ïa uba u la phah .

translation.en: The sons of Merari  ; Mahli , and Mushi . The sons of Mahli  ; Eleazar , and Kish .
translation.kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Mahli bad u Mushi . U Mahli ruh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Eleasar bad u Kish ,

translation.en: Then were there brought unto him little children , that he should put his hands on them , and pray : and the disciples rebuked them .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khynnah sha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki bad ba un duwai na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei ki synran ki la mai ïa ki briew .

translation.en: And she said , Behold my maid Bilhah , go in unto her  ; and she shall bear upon my knees , that I may also have children by her .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Hangne ka don ka mraw jong nga ka Bilhah ; thiah bad ka , ba kumta kan ïoh khun na ka bynta jong nga . Da kane ka rukom ngan ïoh long kmie lyngba jong ka .

translation.en: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau  ; and they of the plain the Philistines : and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim , and the fields of Samaria : and Benjamin shall possess Gilead .
translation.kha: Ki briew na ka Judah bashathie kin ïoh ïa ka Edom ; kito kiba na ki kjat lum shaphang sepngi kin knieh ïa ka Philistia ; ki Israel kin ïoh ïa ka ri Ephraim bad Samaria ; ki briew jong ka Benjamin kin shim ïa ka Gilead .

translation.en: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall , and on the higher places , I even set the people after their families with their swords , their spears , and their bows .
translation.kha: Kumta nga pynkieng atiar ïa ki briew da ki waitlam , ki sum , bad ki ryntieh , bad nga pynap ïa ki da ki kur hadien ki kynroh , ha ki jaka bym pat dep tei .

translation.en: And he made fifty taches of gold , and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches : so it became one tabernacle .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad ki pynïasoh ïa kita ki jingkah ar tylli da kita ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang kawei .

translation.en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty , and before honour is humility .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba ïoh burom lymda u long uba sngewrit ; ki briew kiba meng ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And when they were come , and had gathered the church together , they rehearsed all that God had done with them , and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Antiokh , ki la lumlang ïa ki briew jong ka balang bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh bad ki , bad kumno u la plie ka lynti na ka bynta ki Jentil ban ngeit .

translation.en: He shall not fail nor be discouraged , till he have set judgment in the earth : and the isles shall wait for his law .
translation.kha: Un ym duh jingkyrmen ne jingshlur ; un pynlong ka jingbishar hok ha ka pyrthei . Ki ri bajngai ki ap kmang ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Hear what the unjust judge saith .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la bteng ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba uta u nongbishar bamsap u la ong .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against this land , to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book :
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa la ki briew bad u la pynngat ha ka ri jong ki ïa ki jingtim baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab .

translation.en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of them that were with me , I came into Damascus .
translation.kha: Nga la matlah namar ka jingshai baphyrnai , bad kumta ki paralok jong nga ki la btin ïa nga da ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa nga sha Damaskos .

translation.en: And the great city was divided into three parts , and the cities of the nations fell : and great Babylon came in remembrance before God , to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw la kad ha ki lai bynta , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki ri baroh la pynjot . U Blei u la kynmaw ïa ka Babilon bakhraw bad u la pynlong ïa ka ban dih ïa ka waiñ na ka khuri jong u — ka waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong u .

translation.en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , when thou wast naked and bare , and wast polluted in thy blood .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim ba-ijli jong pha kum ka nuti pham ju kynmaw shisien ruh ïa la ka jinglong khynnah — mynba pha long kaba lyngkhuit , bad ïaksaid ha la ka jong ka snam .

translation.en: The king said also unto Zadok the priest , Art not thou a seer ? return into the city in peace , and your two sons with you , Ahimaaz thy son , and Jonathan the son of Abiathar .
translation.kha: Bad u la bteng da kaba ong shuh shuh ha u Sadok ,  Peit shane , khie ïalam noh ïa u Ahimaas , u khun jong me bad ïa u Jonathan u khun jong u Abiathar sha ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God  unto the land of Israel  ; An end , the end is come upon the four corners of the land .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga kren ïa ka ri Israel : Kane ka dei kaba kut ïa ka ri baroh kawei !

translation.en: If you are studying the Bible with one of Jehovah’s Witnesses , you likely try to review the material in advance of each study .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïa pule Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , lehse phi ju pule lypa shuwa ban sdang ka jingïasyllok .

translation.en: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven : the cankerworm spoileth , and flieth away .
translation.kha: Pha pynmih bun ki nongkhaïi ban ïa ka jingbun ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng ! Hynrei mynta ki jah noh , kum ki puit kiba pyiar la ki thapniang bad ki her noh .

translation.en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd : he shall gather the lambs with his arm , and carry them in his bosom , and shall gently lead those that are with young .
translation.kha: Un sumar ïa ka kynhun jong u kum u nongaplangbrot ; un lumlang ïa ki khunlangbrot bad un rah ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong u ; un ïalam jai jai ïa ki kmie jong ki .

translation.en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat , and brought it to him from year to year , when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ka kmie jong u ka ju thain ïa u ka jaiñkup kaba rit , bad ka ju leit rah ïa ka haba ka leit lang bad la u tnga ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh kaba man ka snem .

translation.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them , each man his dream in one night , each man according to the interpretation of his dream , the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt , which were bound in the prison .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet hangta ha ka ïingbyndi , uta u nongrah khuri bad u nongshet kpu rangbah ki la phohsniew mar la ka jong ka jingphohsniew kaba don la ka jong ka jong ka jingmut .

translation.en: Woe unto the world because of offences ! for it must needs be that offences come  ; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh !
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei kan long ïa ka pyrthei ha kaba don kiei kiei kiba pynlong ïa ki briew ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki ! Kiba kum kine kiei kiei kin ïai jia — hynrei katno kaba shyrkhei ïa uta u briew uba pynjia ïa ki !

translation.en: After this , Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished , that the scripture might be fulfilled , saith ,  I thirst .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba mynta la pyndep ïa kiei kiei baroh ; bad khnang ban pynlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ban urlong shisha , u la ong ,  Nga sliang .

translation.en: For we know him that hath said , Vengeance belongeth unto me , I will recompense , saith the Lord . And again , The Lord shall judge his people .
translation.kha: Namar ngi tip uei uta uba la ong ,  Ngan sa pynhiarkput , ngan siew kylliang ;  bad uba la ong ruh ,  U Trai un bishar ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger , nor of the fatherless  ; nor take a widow s raiment to pledge :
translation.kha: Wat pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei lane ki khunswet , bad wat shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong ka riewkynthei kum ka bynda ïa kano kano ka ram .

translation.en: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy  ; and did run to bring his disciples word .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh ha ka jingkyrkieh na ka jingtep , da ka jingsheptieng bad pynban kiba la pyndap da ka jingkmen , bad ki la mareh ban ïathuh ha ki synran jong u .

translation.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust : quicken thou me according to thy word .
translation.kha: Nga thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha ka khyndew ; to pynkhie im biang ïa nga , kumba me la kular .

translation.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities , and shall consume his branches , and devour them , because of their own counsels .
translation.kha: Ka thma kan khie ha ki nongbah jong ki , bad kan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah . Kan pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki leh ïa kaei kaba ma ki hi ki pyrkhat ba ka long kaba bha tam .

translation.en: He is eating an apple .
translation.kha: U Bam Mynta ia u Soh Apple .

translation.en: He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as he came nigh unto the camp , that he saw the calf , and the dancing : and Moses  anger waxed hot , and he cast the tables out of his hands , and brake them beneath the mount .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la poi hajan kata ka jaka sher dara na kaba u ïohi ïa uta u khun masi bad ïa ka jingïashad jong kita ki paidbah , u Moses u bitar lep . Hangta ha trai u lum , u lynthaw ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap kiba u rah haduh ba ki da pait .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph , and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon : and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment , and came in unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: U syiem u la phah khot ïa u Joseph , bad mar kumta la wan sei ïa u na ka ïingbyndi . Ynda u la dep khi tmain bad bujli jaiñ , u leit ha khmat u syiem .

translation.en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him  ; and shalt anoint them , and consecrate them , and sanctify them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Pynphong ïa kine ki jaiñ ha u Aaron u hynmen jong me bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u . Nangta pynkupbor ïa ki bad pynkyntang da kaba pynsleh ïa ki da ka umphniang Olib , khnang ba ki lah ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: As the living Father hath sent me , and I live by the Father : so he that eateth me , even he shall live by me .
translation.kha: U Kpa uba im u la phah ïa nga , bad namar jong u nga ruh nga im . Ha kajuh ka rukom uno uno uba bam ïa nga un im namar jong nga .

translation.en: For this our heart is faint  ; for these things our eyes are dim .
translation.kha: Ngi pang ha ka dohnud jong ngi hi bad ngim lah ban ïohi bha lyngba ki ummat jong ngi ,

translation.en: Now therefore beware , I pray thee , and drink not wine nor strong drink , and eat not any unclean thing :
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid ;

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will save my people from the east country , and from the west country  ;
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri sha kiba la shim noh ïa ki ,

translation.en: They did not destroy the nations , concerning whom the  Lord  commanded them :
translation.kha: Kim shym la pynïap ïa ki nongmane bleithaw , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ,

translation.en: Till I come , give attendance to reading , to exhortation , to doctrine .
translation.kha: Tad ynda nga wan , to ai ïa ka por jong me bad ka jingpyrshang ban pule paidbah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad ban ïalap bad hikai .

translation.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la ju tip ba don uno uno na ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ne uwei u Pharisi kiba ngeit ha u ?

translation.en: Then said I , Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .
translation.kha: Nga la ïai-ong borabor ba ka jingstad ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym don mano mano ba pyrkhat ïa u briew uba duk ba u long uba stad lane pynshahshkor ei ei ïa kaei kaba u ong .

translation.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long , and waxed louder and louder , Moses spake , and God answered him by a voice .
translation.kha: Ka jingsawa ka turoi ruh ka nang jam nang jam . U Moses u la kren , bad U Blei u jubab ïa u ha ka sur u pyrthat .

translation.en: And the archers shot at king Josiah  ; and the king said to his servants , Have me away  ; for I am sore wounded .
translation.kha: Hapdeng ka thma u Syiem Josaïah u la shah siat da ki khnam u nong Ijipt . U hukum ïa la ki shakri ,  Rah noh ïa nga ; Nga la mynsaw jur !

translation.en: Art thou not from everlasting , O  Lord  my God , mine Holy One ? we shall not die . O  Lord  , thou hast ordained them for judgment  ; and , O mighty God , thou hast established them for correction .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , naduh kaba nyngkong eh me long U Blei . Me long U Blei jong nga , uba khuid bad uba bymjukut . A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga bad u nongïada , me la jied ïa ki nong Babilonia bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba khlaiñ khnang ba kin lah ban pynshitom ïa ngi .

translation.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children , Rachel envied her sister  ; and said unto Jacob , Give me children , or else I die .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Rakhel kam shym ïoh khun na u Jakob , kumta ka la bishni ïa la ka hynmen , bad ka ong ha u Jakob ,  Ai khun ïa nga , lane ngan ïap noh .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , will both search my sheep , and seek them out .
translation.kha: Ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba nga hi da lade ngan wad ïa ki langbrot jong nga bad sumar ïa ki .

translation.en: Whereby the world that then was , being overflowed with water , perished :
translation.kha: Ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong na ka um bad da ka um , bad ka la long ruh da ka um ; ka um jong ka jingshlei um , ba ïa ka pyrthei barim la pynjot .

translation.en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the  Lord  blessed the Egyptian s house for Joseph s sake  ; and the blessing of the  Lord  was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , namar jong u Joseph , U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka longïing longsem jong u nong Ijipt , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha ïing ka sem jong u lane ha lyngkha jong u .

translation.en: Then Jesus turned , and saw them following , and saith unto them ,  What seek ye ?  They said unto him , Rabbi , ( which is to say , being interpreted , Master , ) where dwellest thou ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai , u la ïohi ïa ki ba ki bud ïa u , bad u la kylli ,  Phi ïawad aïu ?  Ki la jubab ïa u ,  Hangno me sah , ko Rabbi ?  ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut  U Nonghikai . )

translation.en: And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , that is , to Kirjath–jearim , which belonged to Judah , to bring up thence the ark of God the  Lord  , that dwelleth between the cherubims , whose name is called on it .
translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki paidbah ki leit sha ka nongbah Baalah , kata ka dei ka Kiriath Jearim , ha ka ri Judah , ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , kaba don ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  uba shong halor ki Kherub .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , If her father had but spit in her face , should she not be ashamed seven days ? let her be shut out from the camp seven days , and after that let her be received in again .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Lada u kpa jong ka u bynthiew halor ka khmat jong ka , ka dei ban shah ïa ka jingjahburom hynñiew sngi . Kumta ieh kan shah khang shabar ka jaka sher dara shi taïew , bad hadien kata lah ban pynrung pat ïa ka .

translation.en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world , according to the prince of the power of the air , the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por phi bud ïa ka rukom im basniew jong ka pyrthei ; phi la kohnguh ïa u nongsynshar jong ki bor mynsiem ha ka haw haw , u mynsiem uba synshar mynta ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field , and his boughs were multiplied , and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters , when he shot forth .
translation.kha: Namar ba la ai um pahuh , u san kham shajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki dieng ki tnat jong u ki rben bad ki jrong .

translation.en: And be not drunk with wine , wherein is excess ; but be filled with the Spirit ;
translation.kha: Wat buaid da ka waiñ , ha kaba kan pynjot ïa phi ; pynban , to long kiba la pyndap da U Mynsiem .

translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and David s sons were chief rulers .
translation.kha: u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u long uba khmih ïa ki nongïada jong u Dabid ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki la long ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: Why not accept this invitation to attend our congregation’s next meeting and experience these things for yourself ?
translation.kha: Ngi khot sngewbha ïa phi ban wan sha ka jingïalang jong ngi , phin sa mad hi dalade ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them ,  Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and their great ones exercise authority upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh sha u bad u la ong ,  Phi tip ba ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew kum ki nongsynshar jong kita kiba mane blei thala , ki leh donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ïa ka bor nadong shadong .

translation.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness : they shall be driven on , and fall therein : for I will bring evil upon them , even the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki lynti ïaid ba ki bud kin long kiba btuit bad kiba dum ; ngan pynlong ïa ki ba kin jynthut bad kin kyllon . Ngan wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki ; ka por ka jingpynshitom ïa ki ka la nang wan , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Go and get a potter s earthen bottle , and take of the ancients of the people , and of the ancients of the priests  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad thied uwei u khra khyndew . U la ong ruh ïa nga ban ïalam katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san jong ki briew bad katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh ba la tymmen ,

translation.en: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah khatsan snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: And again he sent another  ; and him they killed , and many others  ; beating some , and killing some .
translation.kha: U trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw , ki la pynïap ïa u ; bad ki la leh ïa kiwei pat kiba bun ha kajuh ka rukom , da kaba shoh ïa ki katto katne ngut bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence , and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee : and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee  ; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds , and I will draw out a sword after them .
translation.kha: Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki briew jong pha kin ïap na ka jingpang bad jingthngan ha ka nongbah ; shi bynta pat kin ïap da ka waitlam shabar ka nongbah ; bad ïa ka shi bynta kaba dang sah ngan pynsakma sha ki sawlyer , bad ngan beh ïa ki nadien da ka waitlam .

translation.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone , and salt , and burning , that it is not sown , nor beareth , nor any grass groweth therein , like the overthrow of Sodom , and Gomorrah , Admah , and Zeboiim , which the  Lord  overthrew in his anger , and in his wrath :
translation.kha: Ki lyngkha kin long shrah bad kin ym seisoh shuh , naba kin dap da u kyndok bad ka mluh suda ; yn ym thung ei ei hangta , bad wat u ñiut ruh , un ym mih hangta . Ka ri jong phi kan long kum ki shnong Sodom bad Gomorrah , kum ka Admah bad ka Seboiim , ïa kiba U  Trai  u la pynjot mynba u bitar shla .

translation.en: And Jesus , walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren , Simon called Peter , and Andrew his brother , casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ïa ki ar ngut shi para kiba long ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon ( ïa uba la khot u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang tong dohkha ha ka duriaw da ka jar .

translation.en: And when they come from the market , except they wash , they eat not . And many other things there be , which they have received to hold , as the washing of cups , and pots , brasen vessels , and of tables .
translation.kha: lymne kim ju bam ïa kaei kaei kaba wanrah na ïew lymda ki sait shuwa ïa ka . Bad ki bud ïa kiba bun kiwei ki aiñ kiba ki la ïohpdiang , kum kaba sait ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa ki khuri , ki khiew , ki pliang rnong , bad ki jingthiah . )

translation.en: And Deborah , a prophetess , the wife of Lapidoth , she judged Israel at that time .
translation.kha: Mynta ka Deborah , ka tnga jong u Lappidoth , ka long ka nongïathuhlypa , bad ka shakri kum ka nongbishar ïa ki Israel ha kata ka por .

translation.en: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix  room : and Felix , willing to shew the Jews a pleasure , left Paul bound .
translation.kha: Hadien , ar snem ki la leit , u Porsius Phestos u la shim ïa ka jaka jong u Pheliks kum u lyngskor . U Pheliks u la kwah ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong ki Jiw , kumta u la iehnoh ïa u Paul ha ka byndi .

translation.en: And Jonathan said , Far be it from thee : for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee , then would not I tell it thee ?
translation.kha: Wat nym pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kata ?  u Jonathan u jubab . Lada nga la tip shai ba i pa i la kut jingmut ban pynsniew ïa phi , hato ngan ym ïathuh ïa phi ?

translation.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding .
translation.kha: Kam da jngai nangta la don ka kynhun bah ki sniang kiba dang ïabam jingbam .

translation.en: And Bilhah conceived , and bare Jacob a son .
translation.kha: Ka Bilhah ka la punkhun , bad ka kha khun shynrang ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Therefore , brethren , stand fast , and hold the traditions which ye have been taught , whether by word , or our epistle .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong ngi , to ïeng skhem bad batskhem ha kito ki jingshisha kiba ngi la hikai ïa phi , ha ka jingïalap jong ngi bad ha ka shithi jong ngi .

translation.en: In the city is left desolation , and the gate is smitten with destruction .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka long hapdeng ka jingjot , bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pyntwa noh .

translation.en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines , named Goliath , of Gath , whose height was six cubits and a span .
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Goliath , uba na ka shnong Gath , u wan mih na ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ban kob ïa ki Israel . U jrong kumba lai mitar

translation.en: And I will multiply men upon you , all the house of Israel , even all of it : and the cities shall be inhabited , and the wastes shall be builded :
translation.kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ka jingbun briew jong phi . Phin sa shong ha ki nongbah bad tei pat ïa baroh kaba sah ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: When I therefore was thus minded , did I use lightness ? or the things that I purpose , do I purpose according to the flesh , that with me there should be yea yea , and nay nay ?
translation.kha: Ha kane ka jingthmu , hato nga i kum u bymneh jingmut ? Haba nga pynlong ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , hato nga leh ïa ki da ki jingthmu ba khwan myntoi , kum uba la kloi ban ong  Ho-oid , ho-oid  bad  Em , em  ha kajuh ka por ?

translation.en: The  Lord  therefore be judge , and judge between me and thee , and see , and plead my cause , and deliver me out of thine hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un bishar bad un rai mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi . To un khmih ïa kane ka kam , un ïada ïa nga , bad un pyllait im ïa nga na phi .

translation.en: For though he was crucified through weakness , yet he liveth by the power of God . For we also are weak in him , but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you .
translation.kha: Wat la ka la long ha ka jingtlot ba u la shah pynïap halor ka diengphna , dei da ka bor U Blei ba u im . Ha u ngi ruh ngi long kiba tlot ; hynrei ha ki jingïadei jong ngi bad phi ngin ïa-ïoh bynta lem ïa ka bor U Blei ha ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: Now Hannah , she spake in her heart  ; only her lips moved , but her voice was not heard : therefore Eli thought she had been drunken .
translation.kha: Ka la duwai jar jar : tang ki rmiang shyntur jong ka ki khih , hynrei kam shym pynmih sur ei ei . Kumta u Eli la u pyrkhat ba ka la buaid ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  came , and stood , and called as at other times , Samuel , Samuel . Then Samuel answered , Speak  ; for thy servant heareth .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u wan bad u ïeng hangta , bad u khot kum mynshuwa ,  Samuel ! Ko Samuel !  U Samuel u jubab ,  To kren ; u shakri jong me u shahshkor .

translation.en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion in the way  ; a lion is in the streets .
translation.kha: Balei ba u briew uba jaipdeh um ju mih na la ïing ? Ïa kaei u sheptieng ? Ïa ki sing ?

translation.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksiar nylla , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .

translation.en: And in the morning , rising up a great while before day , he went out , and departed into a solitary place , and there prayed .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , slem shuwa ban shai , U Jisu u la ïeng bad mihnoh na ka ïing . U la mihnoh na ka shnong sha ka jaka bakynjah , hangta u la duwai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had buried him , that he spake to his sons , saying , When I am dead , then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried  ; lay my bones beside his bones :
translation.kha: Ynda ki la dep tep , u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha la ki khun ,  Ynda nga ïap , tep ïa nga ha kane ka jingtep bad buh ïa ka met jong nga syndah bad ka jong u .

translation.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death ; and to the other the savour of life unto life . And who is sufficient for these things ?
translation.kha: Ïa kito kiba jah noh , ka dei ka jingiwtung kaba pynïap ; hynrei ha kito kiba la pynim , ka long ka jingiwbih kaba wallam jingim . Uei keiñ , uba lah ban leh ïa kaba kum kata ka kam ?

translation.en: And when she had done giving him drink , she said , I will draw water for thy camels also , until they have done drinking .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep dih , ka ong ,  Ngan leit tong um sa ïa ki ut jong phi de bad to ai ba kin ïoh dih katba ki kwah .

translation.en: Which he wrought in Christ , when he raised him from the dead , and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places ,
translation.kha: Kane ka bor kaba trei ha ngi ka long kajuh kum ka jingkhlaiñbor ba u pyndonkam haba u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na kiba ïap , bad u la pynshong ïa u sha ka kti kamon jong u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .

translation.en: And why take ye thought for raiment ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow  ; they toil not , neither do they spin :
translation.kha: Bad balei phi khuslai shaphang ki jaiñ ? Khmih kumno ki  tiewkhlaw ki san : kim trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth–el , southward  ; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon .
translation.kha: Nangta u suh sha ka sharing lum ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Lus ( kaba la khot ruh ka Bethel ) , nangta arsut shaduh Ataroth Addar , ha u lum uba shathie na ka Beth Horon kaba sharum .

translation.en: If I go forth into the field , then behold the slain with the sword ! and if I enter into the city , then behold them that are sick with famine ! yea , both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not .
translation.kha: Haba nga leit sha ki lyngkha , nga ïohi ïa ki met jong ki rangbah kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ; haba nga leit sha ki shnong , nga ïohi ïa ki briew kiba ïapthngan . Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki trei la ki kam , hynrei kim tip ïa kaei ki leh .

translation.en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom , and burnt his children in the fire , after the abominations of the heathen whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .
