translation.kha: u thang jingiwbih ha ka Them Hinnom , bad u kñia wat ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang kum ki jingainguh thang ïa ki bleithaw , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ba-ijli jong ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Israel ki nang tur shaphrang .

translation.en: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house . And the child did minister unto the  Lord  before Eli the priest .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elkanah u leit phai sha la ïing ha Ramah , hynrei u khynnah Samuel u sah ha Shiloh bad u shakri ïa U  Trai  ha ka jingïalam u Eli u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Arise , go unto Nineveh , that great city , and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Khie leit sha Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah bakhraw , bad to pynbna ha ki briew ïa ka khubor kaba nga la ai ha me

translation.en: Study his Word each day .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka ktien jong U man la ka sngi .

translation.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him .
translation.kha: Wat lada phi shoh ïa u bieit haduh ba u la jan ïap , pynban phin ym lah satia ban weng ïa ka jingbieit na u .

translation.en: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope : for a living dog is better than a dead lion .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba im ha ka pyrthei kiba im u don katto katne ka jingkyrmen ; u ksew uba im u kham bha ban ïa u sing ba la ïap .

translation.en: A real hope of being reunited with your dead loved ones . —John 5 :28 , 29 .
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen bashisha ban ïashem biang bad kiba ieid ba thoin kiba la ïap .—Ioannis 5 :28 , 29 .

translation.en: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel , and made also molten images for Baalim .
translation.kha: U la thaw ki durblei nar jong u Baal ,

translation.en: He that hath knowledge spareth his words : and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit .
translation.kha: Uba sngewskhem ha lade um kren ha ki por baroh . Ki briew kiba long jai jai ki don ka jingïohi jngai da shisha .

translation.en: And knew not until the flood came , and took them all away  ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
translation.kha: pynban kim sngewthuh kaei kaba la jia tad haduh ba ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka rong noh ïa ki baroh . Kan sa long kumta haba U Khun U Briew u wan .

translation.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes  ; why then should I think upon a maid ?
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang ban nym khmih da ka jingkwah brai ïa ka kynthei .

translation.en: And they put him in ward , because it was not declared what should be done to him .
translation.kha: bad la buh hapoh ka jingkhmih ki nongap , namar ym pat don ka jingpynshai yn leh kumno ïa u .

translation.en: We are orphans and fatherless , our mothers are as widows .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kpa jong ngi la pynïap da u nongshun , bad mynta ki kmie jong ngi ki long ki riewkynthei .

translation.en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel , and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation  ; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .
translation.kha: Lum ïa kane ka jingainguh na ki Israel , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kane ka khajna ka long ka jingsiew na ka bynta la ka jingim , bad ngan kynmaw ban da ban ker ïa ki .

translation.en: Families everywhere are coming apart at the seams .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng sawdong ka longïng longsem ka pait ka pra na ba sdang .

translation.en: My days are past , my purposes are broken off , even the thoughts of my heart .
translation.kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki la nang ïaid ; ki jingthmu jong nga kim shym urlong ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka la duh noh .

translation.en: And he cometh the third time , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : it is enough , the hour is come  ; behold , the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
translation.kha: Haba u la wan pat ha ka sien kaba lai , u la ong ïa ki ,  Hato phi dang ïohthiah bad dang shongthait ? Ka la biang ! Ka kynta ka la poi ! Khmih , ïa U Khun U Briew yn ai noh mynta ha ka bor jong ki briew kiba pop .

translation.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not : whosoever sinneth hath not seen him , neither known him .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei uba long ha U Khrist , um ïai leh pop ; hynrei uno uno uba ïai leh pop , um pat shym la ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: Paul , and Silvanus , and Timothy , unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u Silas bad u Timothi — Ha ki parabangeit jong ka balang ha Thessaloni , kiba long ki jong U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad ki jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai :

translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the  Lord  and the king and the people , that they should be the  Lord s  people  ; between the king also and the people .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh , u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ban rung sha ka jingïateh jutang bad U  Trai  ba kin long ki briew jong U  Trai  ; u pynlong ruh ïa ka jingïateh jutang hapdeng u syiem bad ki paidbah .

translation.en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba , and the sweet cane from a far country ? your burnt offerings are not acceptable , nor your sacrifices sweet unto me .
translation.kha: Nga salia aïu ïa ka jingiwbih kaba ki wallam ïa nga na Sheba , lane ki musla na ka ri bajngai ? Ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingainguh jong ki lane ban sngewbha ha ki jingkñia jong ki .

translation.en: But he is a Jew , which is one inwardly ; and circumcision is that of the heart , in the spirit , and not in the letter ; whose praise is not of men , but of God .
translation.kha: Pynban , u Jiw bashisha u dei u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shapoh , kata , uba ïa ka dohnud jong u la otsher , bad kane ka dei ka jingtrei jong U Mynsiem jong U Blei , ym jong ka Hukum ba la thoh . Kum uta u briew u ïoh ïa la ka jingïaroh na U Blei , ym na u briew .

translation.en: And saying ,  The time is fulfilled , and the kingdom of God is at hand : repent ye , and believe the gospel .
translation.kha: Ka por kaba dei ka la poi ,  u ong ,  bad ka Hima U Blei ka la hajan ! To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha !

translation.en: Thou hast forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , thou art gone backward : therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee , and destroy thee  ; I am weary with repenting .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki briew phi la kyntait ïa nga ; phi la pynphai ïa la ki ingdong sha nga . Kumta nga la kner ïa la ka kti bad pynlwet ïa phi namar nga la thait ban teh lakam ïa ka jingbitar jong nga .

translation.en: In the 1870’s a small group of Bible students began rediscovering long-lost Bible truths .

translation.en: My harp also is turned to mourning , and my organ into the voice of them that weep .

translation.en: And when I passed by thee , and saw thee polluted in thine own blood , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live  ; yea , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïaid lyngba bad ïohi ba pha khih ha ka snam jong pha . La tap ïa pha da ka snam , hynrei ngam shym la shah ïa pha ban ïap .

translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself  ; and they enter in , and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first .
translation.kha: Nangta u mih bad wallam ïa ki hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem kiba kham sniew ban ïa u hi , bad ki wan bad shongsah hangta . Kumta haba ka la dep baroh , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong ba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang .

translation.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey , or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards : wilt thou put out the eyes of these men ? we will not come up .
translation.kha: Da shisha , phim shym la ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap lane ai ha ngi ïa ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad mynta phi pyrshang ban shukor ïa ngi . Ngim wan !

translation.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service , and a worldly sanctuary .
translation.kha: Ka jutang kaba nyngkong ka la don ki rukom pynïaid ïa ka jingmane Blei bad kumjuh ruh ka jaka ba la shna da u briew ban mane .

translation.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them , that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes  ; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sumar ïa kane ka jingpynbeit ryntih ha ki por ki ban wan baroh . Uta u briew uba synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid u dei ruh ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ ; uno uno uba ktah ïa kata ka um u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: For John was not yet cast into prison .
translation.kha: ( Kane ka la long ha shuwa ban set byndi ïa u Ïoannis . )

translation.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast , these shall hate the whore , and shall make her desolate and naked , and shall eat her flesh , and burn her with fire .

translation.en: The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew u la leit noh bad u la ïathuh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba dei U Jisu uba la pynkhiah ïa u .

translation.en: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah , I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans , lest they deliver me into their hand , and they mock me .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u la jubab ,  Nga sheptieng ïa la ki para ri kiba la phet bad ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia . Ka lah ban long ba ïa nga yn aiti noh sha ki bad kin pynshitom sat ïa nga .

translation.en: If I be not an apostle unto others , yet doubtless I am to you : for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord .
translation.kha: Wat lada kiwei kim pdiang ïa nga kum u Apostol , da shisha ma phi , phi pdiang! Namar ka jingim jong phi ha U Trai , ma phi hi phi long ka jingpynskhem ïa ka jingshisha ba nga long u apostol .

translation.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death  ; and found none .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban wad ki sakhi pyrshah ïa U Jisu khnang ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem kano kano ruh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them , and all the men of war , then they fled , and went forth out of the city by night , by the way of the king s garden , by the gate betwixt the two walls : and he went out the way of the plain .
translation.kha: Mynba u syiem Sedekaïah bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , ki la pyrshang ban phet na ka nongbah ha ka por mynmiet . Ki la phet na ka lynti jong ka kper syiem , ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop kaba pynïasoh ïa ki ar tylli ki kynroh , bad phet na ka liang jong ka Them Jordan .

translation.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father s sister to wife  ; and she bare him Aaron and Moses : and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years .

translation.en: Ye fools , did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also ?

translation.en: Leah was tender eyed  ; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured .

translation.en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice , rising early in the morning , it shall be counted a curse to him .

translation.en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you , or of man s judgment : yea , I judge not mine own self .

translation.en: And he made a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering of badgers  skins above that .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki jingtap , kawei kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , ban long kum ka jingtap nalor .

translation.en: It is thou , O king , that art grown and become strong : for thy greatness is grown , and reacheth unto heaven , and thy dominion to the end of the earth .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long u dieng , uba jrong bad uba khlaiñ . Phi la long khraw haduh katta kat ban kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , bad ka bor jong phi ka ïar halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: Now therefore go , and I will be with thy mouth , and teach thee what thou shalt say .

translation.en: And he spake to them a parable  ;  Behold the fig tree , and all the trees  ;

translation.en: Now as they were making their hearts merry , behold , the men of the city , certain sons of Belial , beset the house round about , and beat at the door , and spake to the master of the house , the old man , saying , Bring forth the man that came into thine house , that we may know him .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang pynsngewbha ïa lade kumta , kynsan kynsan la don ki riewthala na kata ka shnong ki kerkut ïa kata ka ïing , ki da tied tyngeh ïa ka jingkhang . Ki ong ha uta u tymmen ,  Sei shabar ïa uto u briew uba rung ha ïing jong phi ! Ngin ïathiah shongkha bad u !

translation.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Babylon  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them .
translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga la don pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Babilon bad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki briew jong ka . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , bad baroh kin sngewtriem .

translation.en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the  Lord  in their third generation .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki naduh kaba lai pateng bynriew ter ter lah ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the mountains shall drop down new wine , and the hills shall flow with milk , and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters , and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the  Lord  , and shall water the valley of Shittim .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ïa ki lumbah yn tap da ki bri sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki masi yn shem ha uwei pa uwei u lum ; yn don kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki wahduid baroh ha Judah . Ka wahduid kan tuid na ka Templ jong U  Trai  , bad kan ai um ïa ka Them Akasia .

translation.en: Go and tell Hananiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood  ; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .
translation.kha: ban leit bad ong ha u Hananaïah :  U  Trai  u la ong ba me lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor dieng , hynrei un bujli ïa ka da ka lyngkor nar .

translation.en: And again he sent a third : and they wounded him also , and cast him out .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u mraw uba lai ; ki nongshimwai ki la pynmynsaw ïa u ruh , bad ki la bret ïa u shabar .

translation.en: And Elisha saw it , and he cried , My father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof . And he saw him no more : and he took hold of his own clothes , and rent them in two pieces .
translation.kha: U Elisha u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la pyrta jam ha u Elijah ,  Ko pa jong nga , ko pa jong nga ! Ko nongïada bakhrawbor jong ki Israel ! Phi la leit noh !  Bad um shym la ïohi shuh ïa u Elijah . Ha ka jingsngewsih , u Elisha u la kad arliang ïa la ka jaiñkup .

translation.en: While he yet spake , there came from the ruler of the synagogue s house certain which said , Thy daughter is dead : why troublest thou the Master any further ?
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien ki la wan na ka ïing jong u Jairos bad ki la ong ïa u ,  Ka khun jong phi ka la lah ïap . Balei phin pynshitom shuh ïa U Nonghikai ?

translation.en: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah , at Beth–shemesh , and came to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate , four hundred cubits .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u kem koidi ïa u Amasaïah , u tur shaphrang sha Jerusalem , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah naduh Khyrdop Ephraim haduh Khyrdop Kyndong , ka jingjngai kumba arspah mitar .

translation.en: And there was war again with the Philistines  ; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite , whose spear staff was like a weaver s beam .
translation.kha: Ka don sa kawei ka thma bad ki Philistia , bad u Jair u khun jong u Elhanan u pynïap ïa u Lahmi , uba shi para bad u Goliath na Gath , uba u sum jong u , u don u dieng thung sum uba ka jingrben jong u ka long kat u khung jong u nongthain jaiñ .

translation.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown : but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish .
translation.kha: Ka ïing jong u briew uba bha kan dang ïeng hi hadien ba la pynjot ïa ka ïing jong u nongleh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: And they departed from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name .
translation.kha: Katba ki apostol ki mihnoh na ka Dorbar , ki la kmen , namar U Blei u la ñiew ïa ki , kiba bit ban shah ïa ka jahburom na ka bynta U Jisu .

translation.en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight , O Lord  God   ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant s house for a great while to come . And is this the manner of man , O Lord  God  ?
translation.kha: Pynban , mynta me la leh kham bun , A  Trai  Nongsynshar ; me la pynlong ki jingkular shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wan . Bad me shah ïa u briew ban ïohi ïa kane , A  Trai  Nongsynshar !

translation.en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them , he was received up into heaven , and sat on the right hand of God .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Trai Jisu u la lah kren bad ki , ïa u la shim noh sha bneng bad u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Noah begat three sons , Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khana shaphang u Noah . U Noah u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth . U Noah um don ka jingthohbria bad u la long tang ma u , u briew uba bha ha ki sngi jong u .

translation.en: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom  ; but they could find none occasion nor fault  ; forasmuch as he was faithful , neither was there any error or fault found in him .
translation.kha: Te kiwei pat ki nongpynïaid bad ki lat ki la ïapyrshang ban shem kaei kaei kaba bakla bad ka rukom kaba u Daniel u pynïaid ïa ka hima , hynrei kim lah , namar ba u Daniel u long uba lah ban shaniah , bad um shym leh kano kano kaba bakla lane ka jingbymhok .

translation.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer–sheba : and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father , and their little ones , and their wives , in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u mihnoh na Beersheba . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynshong ïa u , ïa ki khun rit jong ki , bad ïa ki tnga jong ki , ha kita ki kali kiba u syiem ka Ijipt u la phah ban kit ïa ki .

translation.en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword , and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok , even unto the children of Ammon : for the border of the children of Ammon was strong .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki la pynïap bun ki nongshun ha ka thma bad ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki naduh ka wah Arnon na shaphang shatei haduh ka Jabbok , kata , haduh ki Ammon , namar ka khappud ki Ammon ka long kaba khlaiñ bha ka jingïada .

translation.en: He removed the high places , and brake the images , and cut down the groves , and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made : for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it : and he called it Nehushtan .
translation.kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynpra ïa ki païa maw , bad u pyndkut ïa ki durblei jong ka blei Asherah . U pynpra ruh lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bseiñ rnong ïa uba u Moses u la shna , ïa uba la khot Nehushtan . Haduh kata ka por ki paid Israel ki la thang jingiwbih na ka bynta ka burom jong u .

translation.en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah shiphew snem .

translation.en: And the one went out from me , and I said , Surely he is torn in pieces  ; and I saw him not since :
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la iehnoh ïa nga . Khlem pep u la shah patar lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki mradkhlaw , namar ngam shym la ïohi shuh ïa u naduh ba u mih .

translation.en: I beheld , and , lo , the fruitful place was a wilderness , and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the  Lord  , and by his fierce anger .
translation.kha: Ka ri kaba seisoh ka kylla long ka ri shyiap , ki nongbah jong ka ki la don ha ka jingjot namar ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And he said unto her , What form is he of ? And she said , An old man cometh up  ; and he is covered with a mantle . And Saul perceived that it was Samuel , and he stooped with his face to the ground , and bowed himself .
translation.kha: Ka dur jong ka kaba kumno ?  u kylli .  Dei u tymmen uba wan mih ,  ka jubab .  U kup da ka barandi .  Kumta u Saul u tip ba uta u dei u Samuel , bad u dem ngon haduh khyndew da ka jingburom .

translation.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies , and hatest thy friends . For thou hast declared this day , that thou regardest neither princes nor servants : for this day I perceive , that if Absalom had lived , and all we had died this day , then it had pleased thee well .
translation.kha: Phi pyrshah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa phi bad kyrshan ïa kito kiba isih ïa phi ! Phi la pynpaw shai ba ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jong phi kim long ei ei ïa phi . Nga lah ban ïohi ba phin jin da la sngewhun lada u Absalom u dang im mynta bad ba ngi baroh ngin ïap .

translation.en: But when he seeth his children , the work of mine hands , in the midst of him , they shall sanctify my name , and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob , and shall fear the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba phin ïohi ïa ki khun kiba ngan ai ha phi , te phin sa pdiang ba nga long U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel . Phin sa burom ïa nga bad phin ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa nga .

translation.en: Thou shalt not see thy brother s ass or his ox fall down by the way , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again .
translation.kha: Lada ka kada ne ka masi u para Israel ka kyllon , wat shu ieh ïa ka kumta ; ïarap ïa u ban pynïeng pat ïa ka .

translation.en: Even us , whom he hath called , not of the Jews only , but also of the Gentiles ?
translation.kha: Naba ngi long ki briew kiba u la khot , ym tang napdeng ki Jiw hynrei napdeng ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: And Moses wrote this law , and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and unto all the elders of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u thoh ïa ka Hukum U Blei bad u ai ïa ka ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , bad ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings  courts .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u briew uba phong ki jaiñ kiba itynnat ? Ïa ki briew kiba riam kumta bad kiba shong ha ka jingdap kyrhai la shem ha ki ïingsyiem !

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Ye do err , not knowing the scriptures , nor the power of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  A katno phi long kiba bakla ! Ka long namar ba phim tip ïa ki jingthoh bakhuid lane ïa ka bor U Blei .

translation.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for it  ; and shall take of the blood of the bullock , and of the blood of the goat , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about .
translation.kha: un leit sha kata ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad un pynkhuid ïa ka . U dei ban shim khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u  langsohmoh bad un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong kata ka duwan .

translation.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bitar katba u la peit sawdong ïa ki , hynrei ha ka kajuh ka por u la sngewsih na ka bynta jong ki , namar ba ki eh mynsiem bad leh bymdei . Te u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Rah ïa la ka kti .  U la rah ïa ka , bad ka la khiah bha pat .

translation.en: And if one man s ox hurt another s , that he die  ; then they shall sell the live ox , and divide the money of it  ; and the dead ox also they shall divide .
translation.kha: Lada u masi kyrtong jong uwei u briew u pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong jong uwei pat , kita ki trai kin die ïa u masi kyrtong uba dang im bad kin ïasam ïa ka pisa ; kin ïasam ruh ïa ka doh jong uta u mrad uba shah pynïap .

translation.en: And Abimelech , and the company that was with him , rushed forward , and stood in the entering of the gate of the city : and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields , and slew them .
translation.kha: Katba u Abimelekh bad ka kynhun jong u ki tur pynkloi sha khmat ban ïada ïa ka khyrdop shnong , kiwei pat ki ar kynhun ki tur ïaleh ïa ki briew hapoh lyngkha bad ki pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Every man praying or prophesying , having his head covered , dishonoureth his head .
translation.kha: Kumta u briew uba duwai lane pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha ka jingïamane lang da kaba tap ïa la ka khlieh u pynjahburom ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: And there came one that had escaped , and told Abram the Hebrew  ; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite , brother of Eshcol , and brother of Aner : and these were confederate with Abram .
translation.kha: Te uwei uba la ïohlait u wan ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u Abram , u Hebru , uba la shong la sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre u kynja Amor . U Mamre bad ki para shynrang jong u , u Eshkol bad u Aber , ki dei ki paralok u Abram .

translation.en: When they were filled , he said unto his disciples ,  Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .
translation.kha: Haba baroh ki la ïakdang , u la ong ha la ki synran ,  To khar ïa ki lyngkhot kiba tam ; ngim dei ban pynsep-ei .

translation.en: So Joshua let the people depart , every man unto his inheritance .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u la phah noh ïa u paidbah , bad uwei pa uwei u leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka jong ka jaka .

translation.en: When he had thus spoken , he spat on the ground , and made clay of the spittle , and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , U Jisu u la biah ha ka khyndew bad u la khleh ktieh da ka umbiah ; u la kyllan da ita i sboh ktieh ha ki khmat uta u briew bad u la ong ,

translation.en: And when they had taken up the anchors , they committed themselves unto the sea , and loosed the rudder bands , and hoisted up the mainsail to the wind , and made toward shore .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ot noh ïa ki angkor bad ki la shah ïa ki ba kin ngam ha ka duriaw , bad ha kajuh ka por ki la pynkylluid ïa ki tyllai kiba la bat ïa ki boitha . Nangta ki la kyntiew ïa ka jaiñ pynshah lyer ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng khnang ba ka lyer ka lah ban beh ïa ka lieng sha khmat , bad ngi la ïaid beit sha ka ryngkew .

translation.en: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God : and if it first begin at us , what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God ?
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ka jingbishar ba kan sdang , bad ki briew jong U Blei hi kin long kiba nyngkong ban shah bishar . Lada ka sdang na ngi , kumno kan kut ha kito ki bym shym ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei ?

translation.en: Behold , the money , which we found in our sacks  mouths , we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan : how then should we steal out of thy lord s house silver or gold ?
translation.kha: Phi tip ba ngi la wanrah biang sha phi na Kanaan ïa kito ki pisa ba ngi lap ha khlieh ki byrni jong ngi . Balei keiñ ngin leit tuh kat ïa ka rupa ne ksiar na ka ïing u kynrad jong phi ?

translation.en: Who hath formed a god , or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing ?
translation.kha: Kam don jingbha ban thaw ïa ka dur nar ban mane kum u blei !

translation.en: Then saith he unto his disciples ,  The harvest truly is plenteous , but the labourers are few  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Ka jingot ka khraw eh , hynrei don khyndiat ki nongtrei ban lumlang ïa ka shapoh .

translation.en: Not to all the people , but unto witnesses chosen before of God , even to us , who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead .
translation.kha: ym ha baroh , hynrei tang ha ki sakhi kiba U Blei u la lah jied , kata , ha ngi kiba la ïabam bad ïadih bad u hadien ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin : even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength .
translation.kha: Ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka par baroh kawei ka met jong u bad ka pynlong ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u ban pyut .

translation.en: And the king said unto Ziba , What meanest thou by these ? And Ziba said , The asses be for the king s household to ride on  ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat  ; and the wine , that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Men leh aïu ïa kine katne katne ?  U Siba u jubab ,  Ki kada ki dei na ka bynta ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Syiem Kynrad ban shong , u kpu bad u soh ki dei na ka bynta ki rangbah jong phi ban bam , bad ka waiñ ka dei na ka bynta jong ki ban dih haba ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: And they blessed Rebekah , and said unto her , Thou art our sister , be thou the mother of thousands of millions , and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them .
translation.kha: Bad ki la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ka Rebekka da kine ki kyntien :  To phi , ka para , phin long ka kmie u paidbah byllien ! To ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin da jop thiaw ïa ki nongbah jong ki nongshun jong ki !

translation.en: And for thy cattle , and for the beast that are in thy land , shall all the increase thereof be meat .
translation.kha: ïa ki jingri jong phi , bad ïa ki mradkhlaw ha ki lyngkha jong phi . Kat kaba mih nangta lah ban bam .

translation.en: Pilate then went out unto them , and said , What accusation bring ye against this man ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la leit shabar sha ki bad u la kylli ,  Phi ïamudui aïu ïa une u briew ?

translation.en: And he shall say , Where are their gods , their rock in whom they trusted ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  un ong ha la ki briew , ‘ Shaei kito ki blei khrawbor ha kiba phi shaniah ?

translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that this place shall no more be called Topheth , nor The valley of the son of Hinnom , but The valley of slaughter .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ka por kan wan haba ïa kane ka jaka yn ym khot shuh ka Topheth lane ka Them Hinnom . Pynban yn tip ïa ka kum ka Them ka Jingpynïap .

translation.en: And they slew a bullock , and brought the child to Eli .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la pynïap ïa uta u masi , ki ïalam ïa uta u khynnah sha u Eli .

translation.en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem , unto the plain of Moreh . And the Canaanite was then in the land .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka ri Kanaan , u Abram u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri haduh ba un da poi ha u dieng kyntang jong u Moreh , ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem . ( Ha kata ka por , ki Kanaan ki dang don ha ka ri . )

translation.en: For it was so , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the  Lord  , that Obadiah took an hundred prophets , and hid them by fifty in a cave , and fed them with bread and water . )
translation.kha: bad haba ka Jesebel ka dang pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  , u Obadaïah u la shim bad pynrieh ïa ki shispah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ha ki krem , da kaba phiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun kiba sanphew ngut ha kawei kawei ka kynhun , bad u la pynbiang jingbam bad um ïa ki . )

translation.en: And he brought me to the door of the court  ; and when I looked , behold a hole in the wall .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa nga sha ka jaka rung sha ka phyllaw kaba shabar bad pyn-i ïa nga ïa ka thliew ha ka kynroh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as she spake to Joseph day by day , that he hearkened not unto her , to lie by her , or to be with her .
translation.kha: Wat la ka kyrpad ïa u Joseph man la ka sngi , um treh ban leit thiah bad ka .

translation.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen , and punishments upon the people  ;
translation.kha: ban jop ïa ki hima bad ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew ;

translation.en: The first shall say to Zion , Behold , behold them : and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings .
translation.kha: Nga , U  Trai  , nga long uba nyngkong ban ïathuh ïa ka Seïon ïa ka khubor ; nga phah ïa u nonglamktien sha Jerusalem ban ong , ‘ Ki briew jong phi ki wan ! Ki wan sha ïing !’

translation.en: Then when lust hath conceived , it bringeth forth sin : and sin , when it is finished , bringeth forth death .
translation.kha: Nangta ki jingkwah brai jong u ki pun hapoh jong u bad ka jingmih ka long ban leh ïa ka pop ; bad ka pop , haba ka la ih bha , ka pynmih ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes , and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground  ; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah ïa ki khñiang ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ jong phi kin dap da ki sohwaiñ .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication , that thou hast made before me : I have hallowed this house , which thou hast built , to put my name there for ever  ; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Nga la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad jingkyrpad rit jong me . Nga la pynkyntang ïa kane ka ïing kaba me la tei kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan peit ïa ka bad ngan don hangta borabor .

translation.en: And she said unto her husband , Behold now , I perceive that this is an holy man of God , which passeth by us continually .
translation.kha: Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga thikna ba une u briew uba wan bunsien hangne u dei u riewkhuid .

translation.en: Then Ananias answered , Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Ananias u la jubab ,  Ko Trai , bun ki briew ki la ïathuh ïa nga shaphang une u briew bad shaphang kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba u la leh ïa ki briew jong me ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia ;
translation.kha: Hadien kata , nga la leit sha ki thain ha Syria bad Kilikia .

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn by himself , saying , Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers  ; and they shall lift up a shout against thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la smai da la ka jong ka jingim ba un wallam shibun ki rangbah ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia kum shi kynhun ki puit , bad kin pyrta da ka jingjop .

translation.en: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard , so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit uba pyndonkam ïa ka jingong kaba stad u pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang u nongbuaid uba pyrshang ban phut ïa u shiah ha ka kti jong u .

translation.en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab s hand : so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib , and shed out his bowels to the ground , and struck him not again  ; and he died . So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri .
translation.kha: U Amasa um shym don jingïada na ka waitlam kaba u Joab u bat ha kawei pat ka kti jong u , bad u Joab u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh , bad ki snier jong u ki mih shaid ha madan . U ïap ha shen , bad u Joab um donkam ban dung biang sa shisien . Nangta u Joab bad u Abishai , u para jong u ki la leit thwet ïa u Sheba .

translation.en: And he said unto me ,  My grace is sufficient for thee : for my strength is made perfect in weakness .  Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities , that the power of Christ may rest upon me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jubab jong u ka la long :  Ka jingaiei jong nga ka long baroh kaba me donkam , naba ka bor jong nga ka khraw tam dei haba me tlot .  Nga kmen eh , namarkata , ban sngewsarong ha ki jingtlot jong nga , khnang ban mad ïa ka jingïada ka bor jong U Khrist halor jong nga .

translation.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence , because he hath borne it upon him .
translation.kha: Haba ngi shahshitom , ngi dei ban shong marwei ha ka jingïaishah bajar jar ;

translation.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the  Lord  , and likewise at even  ;
translation.kha: Bad ban ïaroh bad pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  man ka step bad man ka janmiet ,

translation.en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child s : he shall return to the days of his youth :
translation.kha: Ka met jong u kan khie lung kumba dang samla bad ban khlaiñ pat ;

translation.en: But now when Timothy came from you unto us , and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity , and that ye have good remembrance of us always , desiring greatly to see us , as we also to see you :
translation.kha: haba mynta u Timothi u la wanna ph sha ngi , bad u la wanrah sha ngi ïa ka khubor kaba sngewkmen shaphang ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi . Bad U la ïathuh ïa ngi ba phi ïai pyrkhat bha ïa ngi borabor ba phi kwah hir hir ban ïohi ïa ngi kumba ma ngi ruh , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa phi .

translation.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment .
translation.kha: Ïeng sharud na kine ki briew bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki kumne kumne .

translation.en: Behold , I will take away the posterity of Baasha , and the posterity of his house  ; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
translation.kha: Ki pop jong ki , ki la pynkhih bitar ïa nga , bad kumta ngan pyndam noh ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Jeroboam .

translation.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof , and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush : let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph , and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren .
translation.kha: To ka ri jong ki kan dap kyrhai da kaba bha baroh , Ba la kyrkhu da ka jingbha U  Trai  , Uba kren na ka  lawlynnong kaba mehding . To kine ki jingkyrkhu kin wan ha ka jait u Joseph , Namar u la long u nongïalam ïa la ki hynmen bad para .

translation.en: Dan shall judge his people , as one of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Dan un synshar ïa la ki briew , Kin long kum kiwei ki jait Israel .

translation.en: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten : for he had many wives .
translation.kha: U la don hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang , namar u don shibun ki tnga .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Be ye not as your fathers , unto whom the former prophets have cried , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye now from your evil ways , and from your evil doings : but they did not hear , nor hearken unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat long kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi . La slem bah ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong nga , da kaba ïathuh ha ki ban ym im bymman , ban ym im shuh ka jingim bapop . Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years , which had spent all her living upon physicians , neither could be healed of any ,
translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki la don ka kynthei kaba la shitom na ka jingpang mihsnam kaba jur la khat-ar snem ; ka la pynlut ïa baroh kaba ka don ha ki nongsumar , hynrei ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa ka .

translation.en: For God speaketh once , yea twice , yet man perceiveth it not .
translation.kha: Wat la U Blei u kren bad ïai kren , ym don uba pynsngap ïa kaei kaba u ong .

translation.en: For the promise is unto you , and to your children , and to all that are afar off , even as many as the Lord our God shall call .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular jong U Blei la pynlong ha phi bad ha ki khun jong phi , bad ha baroh kiba sha jngai — baroh kiba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u khot sha lade .

translation.en: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people , because he hath magnified himself against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab yn pynjot bad kan ym long shuh ka hima , namar ka ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And seeth two angels in white sitting , the one at the head , and the other at the feet , where the body of Jesus had lain .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la ïeng shabar ka jingtep ka da ïam . Katba ka dang ïam , ka la dem bad jngoh shapoh ka jingtep bad ka la ïohi ar ngut ki angel hangta kiba la phong da ki jaiñ balieh , ki da ïashong ha kaba la buh ïa ka met U Jisu , uwei sha khlieh bad uwei pat sha kjat .

translation.en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit , nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child : even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all .
translation.kha: U Blei u thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad phim lah ban shemphang shuh ïa kaei kaba u leh ban ïa kaba phi sngewthuh kumno ka jingim bathymmai ka sdang ha ka kpoh jong ka kynthei kaba armet .

translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little : thou mayest not consume them at once , lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee .
translation.kha: Suki pa suki un beh krad ïa kine ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang tur sha khmat . Phin ym lah ban pynduh lut ïa ki shisyndon , namar , lada phi leh kumta , ki mradkhlaw kin jyllei palat bad kin long ka jingma pynban ïa phi .

translation.en: And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprang up with it , and choked it .
translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , kiba la san ryngkat bad ki jingthung bad ki la kjap ïa ki .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha Ijipt bad ki ïalumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And Baalath , and Tamar in the wilderness , in the land ,
translation.kha: ka Baalath , ka Tamar ha ka ri khlaw Judah ,

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel , because they had done evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Namar kane keiñ U  Trai  u la pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Eglon u syiem ka Moab ban ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And saith unto him , All these things will I give thee , if thou wilt fall down and worship me .
translation.kha: Ïa kine baroh ngan ai ha me ,  u Soitan u la ong ,  lada men dem khohsiew bad mane ïa nga .

translation.en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief ; but was strong in faith , giving glory to God ;
translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong u kam shym la mihnoh na u , bad um shym la artatien ïa ka jingkular U Blei ; ka jingngeit jong u ka la pyndap ïa u da ka bor , bad u ai ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man , so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah , saith the  Lord   ; that they might be unto me for a people , and for a name , and for a praise , and for a glory : but they would not hear .
translation.kha: Kumba ki patlun lyngkot ki biang sbiak sawdong ka syngkai , kumta nga la thmu ba baroh ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah kin snoh skhem ha nga . Nga la leh ïa kane khnang ba kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad wallam ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; hynrei kim shym kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Consider now from this day and upward , from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , even from the day that the foundation of the  Lord s  temple was laid , consider it .
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi ka dei ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khyndai , ka sngi ha kaba la pyndep ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ . Ha khmih kaei ka ban sa jia naduh mynta .

translation.en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego  ; these men , O king , have not regarded thee : they serve not thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .
translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki Jiw ïa kiba phi la buh ban khmih ïa ka probins jong ka Babilon — u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego — ki bym shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum u Syiem Kynrad . Kim shym mane ïa u blei jong phi lane dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba phi la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath : for they had sworn with all their heart , and sought him with their whole desire  ; and he was found of them : and the  Lord  gave them rest round about .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid ka Judah ki la kmen namar ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jutang da ka dohnud baroh . Ki shem sngewbha ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , bad u pdiang ïa ki bad u ai ha ki ka jingsuk na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: With whom the  Lord  had made a covenant , and charged them , saying , Ye shall not fear other gods , nor bow yourselves to them , nor serve them , nor sacrifice to them :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jutang bad ki bad u la hukum ïa ki :  Wat mane ïa kiwei ki blei ; wat dem khrup ha ki lane shakri ïa ki lane ai ki jingkñia ïa ki .

translation.en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught , saying ,  Ye both know me , and ye know whence I am : and I am not come of myself , but he that sent me is true , whom ye know not .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kren ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Hato phi ithuh da shisha ïa nga bad tip nangno nga wan ? Ngam shym la wan da ka bor jong nga hi . Uta uba la phah ïa nga , pynban , u long uba shisha .

translation.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done , and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u ïathuh ha ka Jesebel ka tnga jong u ïa baroh kaba u Elijah u la leh bad kumno ba u la pynïap lut ïa ki nongïathuhlypa u Baal .

translation.en: And to the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to half the tribe of Manasseh , spake Joshua , saying ,
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Reuben bad jait Gad , bad ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Fear him not : for I will deliver him , and all his people , and his land , into thy hand  ; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat tieng ïa u . Ngan aiti ïa u , ïa ki briew jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh ha phi . Leh ïa u kumba phi la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .’

translation.en: The son of Hesed , in Aruboth  ; to him pertained Soco , and all the land of Hepher :
translation.kha: U Benhesed : ki nongbah Arubboth bad Sokoh bad baroh ka ri Hepher

translation.en: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven  ; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee , and thou , and thy lords , thy wives , and thy concubines , have drunk wine in them  ; and thou hast praised the gods of silver , and gold , of brass , iron , wood , and stone , which see not , nor hear , nor know : and the God in whose hand thy breath is , and whose are all thy ways , hast thou not glorified :
translation.kha: Phi la leh pyrshah ïa U Trai jong ka bneng bad phi la wallam shapoh ïa ki khuri bad ïa ki pliang kiba la shim na ka Templ jong u . Ma phi , ki rangbah donburom jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki tnga kliar jong phi ki la dih waiñ na ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa ki blei kiba la shna da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ka dieng , bad u maw — ki blei ki bym lah ban ïohi lane ïohsngew bad ba kim lah ban tip ei ei . Hynrei phim shym la pyndonburom ïa U Blei uba rai la phin im ne phin ïap bad uba synshar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  turned a mighty strong west wind , which took away the locusts , and cast them into the Red sea  ; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la pynkylla ïa ka lyer mihngi sha ka lyer sepngi kaba jur , kaba la rong noh ïa ki puit bad bret ïa ki sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ym shym sah shuh uwei ruh u puit ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , Sodom thy sister hath not done , she nor her daughters , as thou hast done , thou and thy daughters .
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ka Sodom ka para jong pha bad ki nongrit jong ka kim ju leh ïa ka jingsniew kaba ma pha bad ki nongrit jong pha phi la leh .

translation.en: And they feared exceedingly , and said one to another , What manner of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Uei une u briew ? Wat ka lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me  ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !
translation.kha: Lada u tang shu mon bad pynïap ïa nga !

translation.en: Behold , we are servants this day , and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof , behold , we are servants in it :
translation.kha: Bad mynta ngi long ki mraw ha ka ri ba me la ai ïa ngi , kane ka ri baseisoh kaba ai jingbam ïa ngi .

translation.en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people , Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and labour on the day .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por nga ong ïa ki rangbah kiba khmih ïa ka kam , ba ma ki bad ki nongïarap jong ki , ki hap ban sah ha Jerusalem ha ka por mynmiet , khnang ba ngi lah ban ap phira ïa ka nongbah mynmiet bad kumjuh ruh ban trei ha ka por mynsngi .

translation.en: Take heed now  ; for the  Lord  hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .
translation.kha: Me dei ban sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la jied ïa me ban tei ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u . Mynta leh ïa kata — bad leh ïa kata da ka jingkut jingmut baskhem .

translation.en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you , or among your cattle .
translation.kha: Yn ym don ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ka ban ïoh kat kine ki jingkyrkhu . Yn ym don mano mano u ban lyngki napdeng jong phi , lane napdeng ki jingri jong phi .

translation.en: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah , who had understanding in the visions of God : and as long as he sought the  Lord  , God made him to prosper .
translation.kha: Katba u Sekharaïah u nongaibuit jong u ha kaba ïadei bad ka niam u dang im ; u la shakri hok ïa U  Trai  bad U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u .

translation.en: Besides the cakes , he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings .
translation.kha: Nalor kita , u dei ruh ban wanrah kum ka jingainguh ïa ki kpu ba la khleh thiat .

translation.en: The  Lord  thy God in the midst of thee is mighty  ; he will save , he will rejoice over thee with joy  ; he will rest in his love , he will joy over thee with singing .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong pha u long bad pha ; ka bor jong u ka ai ha pha ka jingjop . U  Trai  un shem jingsngewbha ha pha , bad ha ka jingieit jong u un ai ha pha ka jingim bathymmai . Un rwai bad un kmen halor jong pha ,

translation.en: And set up over his head his accusation written , THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS .
translation.kha: Haneng ka khlieh jong u ki la buh ka jingthoh pynbna ïa ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u :  Une u long U Jisu , U Syiem ki Jiw .

translation.en: And the parched ground shall become a pool , and the thirsty land springs of water : in the habitation of dragons , where each lay , shall be grass with reeds and rushes .
translation.kha: u shyiap uba khluit un kylla long ka pung , bad ïa ka ri ryngkhiang yn pyndap da ki umpohliew . Ha ka jaka ba ju shong ki myrsiang , u phlang bad u khah ha ki jaka jyrsieh kin mih .

translation.en: The matter is not so : but a man of mount Ephraim , Sheba the son of Bichri by name , hath lifted up his hand against the king , even against David : deliver him only , and I will depart from the city . And the woman said unto Joab , Behold , his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall .
translation.kha: Kata kam dei ka jingthmu jong ngi . U briew uba kyrteng u Sheba , u khun jong u Bikri , uba na ka ri lum Ephraim , u la sdang ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Dabid . Aiti ïa une u briew , bad ngan kynriah noh na ka nongbah .   Ngin bret ïa ka khlieh jong u sha phi nalor ka kynroh ,  ka ong .

translation.en: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness , that I would scatter them among the heathen , and disperse them through the countries  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pynlong sa kawei pat ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap . Nga la smai ba ngan pynsakma ïa ki ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .
translation.kha: U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei nga ngam long uba bit wat ban law ïa ki ksai juti jong u .

translation.en: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel , and took counsel with his servants , saying , In such and such a place shall be my camp .
translation.kha: U syiem Syria u ïaleh thma bad ki Israel , u ïasyllok bad la ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad jied ïa ka jaka ban pynïeng ïa ka jaka sher dara jong u .

translation.en: Tom said it was all like a dream .
translation.kha: U Tom u ong ba dei tang ka jingphohsniew .

translation.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things : for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you :
translation.kha: Wat pynbyrsieh ïa lade da kano kano na kine ki kam , namar dei da kine ba ki briew ki bymngeit Blei ki la pyntngit ïa lade , kito ki jaitbynriew kiba im ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi bad ïa kiba ngan beh noh , ba phin ïoh leit rung hangta .

translation.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar , sweareth by it , and by all things thereon .
translation.kha: Kumta te , haba u briew u smai da ka duwan , u smai da ka bad da baroh ki jingai sngewbha halor jong ka ;

translation.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt , wherein ye dwelt , shall ye not do : and after the doings of the land of Canaan , whither I bring you , shall ye not do : neither shall ye walk in their ordinances .
translation.kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im ki briew ha ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi ruh shisien phi la shong , ne ïa ki jong ki briew ha ri Kanaan , sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .

translation.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour , who calleth upon God , and he answereth him : the just upright man is laughed to scorn .
translation.kha: Wat ki paralok jong nga ki rkhie ïa nga mynta ; ki rkhie , wat la nga long uba hok bad u bym shah kynnoh pop ; hynrei ka don ka por mynba U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga .

translation.en: (According as it is written , God hath given them the spirit of slumber , eyes that they should not see , and ears that they should not hear ;) unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumba la don ha thoh ,  U Blei u la pynluin ïa ki jingmut bad ki dohnud jong ki , haduh kane hi ka sngi kim lah ban ïohi ne ïohsngew .

translation.en: And Jehoash slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel  ; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter , and called her name Dinah .
translation.kha: Hadien ka la kha khun kynthei , ïa kaba ka la khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Dinah .

translation.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings : his heart is fixed , trusting in the  Lord .
translation.kha: Um sheptieng haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor kaba sniew ; ka jingngeit jong u ka long kaba khlaiñ , bad u shaniah ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And Elijah took the child , and brought him down out of the chamber into the house , and delivered him unto his mother : and Elijah said , See , thy son liveth .
translation.kha: U Elijah u rah biang ïa u khynnah shapoh sha ka kmie jong u bad u ong ha ka ,  Peit , u khun jong pha u la im !

translation.en: Then the glory of the  Lord  went up from the cherub , and stood over the threshold of the house  ; and the house was filled with the cloud , and the court was full of the brightness of the  Lord s  glory .
translation.kha: Te ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon U  Trai  ka la kiew noh na ki kherub sha ka jaka rung jong ka Templ . Te u lyoh u la tap ïa ka Templ , bad kata ka phyllaw ka phyrnai da ka jingshai .

translation.en: ( Of whom the world was not worthy : ) they wandered in deserts , and in mountains , and in dens and caves of the earth .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kam shym long kaba bha na ka bynta jong ki ! Kum ki nongphetwir ki shang kylleng ha ki ri shyiap bad sha ki lum , ki da shong ha ki krem bad ha ki thliew kiba don ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts : half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath , to make him king  ; and half followed Omri .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Israel ki ïa-pait : don napdeng jong ki kiba kwah ban pynlong syiem ïa u Tibni u khun jong u Ginath , bad kiwei pat ki kwah ïa u Omri .

translation.en: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness , they looked unto the multitude , and , behold , they were dead bodies fallen to the earth , and none escaped .
translation.kha: Haba ka kynhun shipai Judah ka la poi ha ka jaka ba don u mot ha ka ri shyiap , ki peit sha ki nongshun bad ïohi ba ki la thiah ïap ha madan . Ym don uwei uba lait phet .

translation.en: Idolatry , witchcraft , hatred , variance , emulations , wrath , strife , seditions , heresies ,
translation.kha: ha ka jingmane bleithaw bad ka jingai ksuid . Ki briew ki kylla long nongshun bad ki ïashoh ; ki ïa-bishni , bitar , bad ki kwah eh . Ki ïa-pait ha ki seng bad ki kynhun ;

translation.en: If a bird s nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree , or on the ground , whether they be young ones , or eggs , and the dam sitting upon the young , or upon the eggs , thou shalt not take the dam with the young :
translation.kha: Lada jia ba phi lap ïa ka skum sim ha u dieng ne ha khyndew lem bad ïa ka sim kmie kaba pdem ïa ki pylleng lane kaba kdup ïa la ki khun , phim dei ban kem ïa ka sim kmie .

translation.en: Praise ye him , sun and moon : praise him , all ye stars of light .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ka sngi bad u bnai ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki khlur baphyrnai .

translation.en: And the man said , They are departed hence  ; for I heard them say , Let us go to Dothan . And Joseph went after his brethren , and found them in Dothan .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Ki la ïaleit . Nga la ïohsngew ba ki ong ba kin leit sha Dothan .  Kumta u Joseph u leit beh nadien jong ki bad u lap ïa ki ha Dothan .

translation.en: And straightway he called them : and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants , and went after him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u tang shu ïohi ïa ki , u la khot ïa ki ; ki la iehnoh ïa la u kpa jong ki , u Sebedi ha ka lieng ryngkat bad ki rangbah kiba trei bylla , bad ki la leit bad U Jisu .

translation.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath , and above shall his branch be cut off .
translation.kha: Ki thied bad ki tnat jong u ki la sti bad tyrkhong .

translation.en: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli , that the iniquity of Eli s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever .
translation.kha: Namar kata nga la pynbna da ka jingsngewkhia ba ha ka ïing u Eli yn ym don jingkñia lane ka jingainguh kaba lah ban weng noh ïa kane ka pop bashyrkhei ba ka ïing jong u ka la leh .

translation.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus , being fallen into a deep sleep : and as Paul was long preaching , he sunk down with sleep , and fell down from the third loft , and was taken up dead .
translation.kha: Uwei u samla uba kyrteng u Ïutikhos u la shong ha ka jingkhangïit , bad katba u Paul u dang kren , u Ïutikhos u la shoh samthiah jur , kat haduh ba u la ïohthiah lyngngai bad u la hap na ka mala kaba lai sha madan . Haba ki la rah ïa u , u la ïap .

translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , putteth it in a secret place , neither under a bushel , but on a candlestick , that they which come in may see the light .
translation.kha: Ym don uba thang ïa ka sharak bad nangta u buhrieh ïa ka lane buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki wan rung shapoh .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Friend , wherefore art thou come ?  Then came they , and laid hands on Jesus , and took him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  To pynkloi shaphang jong ka , ko paralok !  Nangta ki la ïawan kiew , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , bad ki la batskhem ïa u .

translation.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing  ; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light .
translation.kha: Ki tih shaduh ki tyllong jong ki wah , bad ki wallam sha ka jingshai ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh .

translation.en: Grace unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: ka jingaiei kan don ha phi , bad jingsuk , na U Blei jong ngi U Kpa bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus , that as he had begun , so he would also finish in you the same grace also .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi la kyntu ïa u Titos , uba la sdang ïa kane ka kam , ban bteng ïa ka bad ban ïarap ïa phi ban pyndep ïa kane ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ka jingieit .

translation.en: And John was clothed with camel s hair , and with a girdle of a skin about his loins  ; and he did eat locusts and wild honey  ;
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la phong da ki jaiñ ba la shna na ki shñiuh ut , bad u panpoh snieh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .

translation.en: Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him  ; for we shall see him as he is .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , mynta ngi long ki khun U Blei , hynrei kam pat da shai aïu ngin sa long . Hynrei ngi tip ba ynda U Khrist un paw , ngin ïoh long kum ma u , namar ngin ïohi ïa u kumba u long da shisha .

translation.en: Thou shalt not kill .
translation.kha: Wat pynïap briew .

translation.en: And lo a voice from heaven , saying , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .
translation.kha: Nangta ka sur ktien ka la ong na bneng ,  Une u long U Khun uba ieit eh jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha eh .

translation.en: And certain of the chief of Asia , which were his friends , sent unto him , desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki bor synshar ka probins , kiba long ki paralok jong u , ki la phah ruh ka khubor sha u da kaba kyrpad ïa u ban ym pyn-i khmat ïa lade ha ka jaka leh tamasa .

translation.en: He spread a cloud for a covering  ; and fire to give light in the night .
translation.kha: U Blei u buh ïa u lyoh halor ki briew jong u bad ïa ka ding mynmiet ban ai jingshai ïa ki .

translation.en: But fear not thou , O my servant Jacob , and be not dismayed , O Israel : for , behold , I will save thee from afar off , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and be in rest and at ease , and none shall make him afraid .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , wat ym sheptieng , ko ki paid Israel , wat ym kyiuh . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri kaba jngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi la long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat sha ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin sngewshngain , bad yn ym don u ban pyntieng ïa phi .

translation.en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow , as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him : and we , or ever he come near , are ready to kill him .
translation.kha: Mynta te , ma phi bad ka Dorbar to phah ktien sha u rangbah ai hukum ka kynhun shipai Rom ban wallam ïa u Paul sha phi , da kaba leh mynleh ba phi kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba thikna shaphang jong u . Hynrei ngin long kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa u ha shuwa ba un poi hangne .

translation.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness  ; and many shall rejoice at his birth .
translation.kha: A katno men long uba shadkmen bad uba kmen , bad katno kiwei ruh kin kmen haba yn kha ïa u !

translation.en: And from thence to Philippi , which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia , and a colony : and we were in that city abiding certain days .
translation.kha: Nangta ngi la leit na ryngkew sha Philippi , ka nongbah jong ka distrik banyngkong jong ka Makedonia ; kaba long ruh ka kyntoit shnong jong ki nong Rom . Ngi la pynlut bun sngi hangta .

translation.en: Wherefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Ye eat with the blood , and lift up your eyes toward your idols , and shed blood : and shall ye possess the land ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Phi bam ïa ka doh kaba dang bit snam ha ka . Phi mane ïa ki bleithaw . Phi pynïap briew . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?

translation.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness  ; but of every one that is hasty only to want .
translation.kha: Da thmu bha bad phin ïoh kyrhai ; lada phi leh kyrkieh palat phin nym dap biang .

translation.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord  : but , lo , I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour s hand , and into the hand of his king : and they shall smite the land , and out of their hand I will not deliver them .
translation.kha: ( U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan ym isynei shuh ïano ïano ha ka pyrthei . Ma nga da lade ngan buh ïa ki briew baroh hapoh ka bor jong ki nongsynshar jong ki . Kine ki nongsynshar kin pynjot ïa ka pyrthei , bad ngan ym pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jong ki .  )

translation.en: As for me , behold , I am in your hand : do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad nga , nga don ha ka bor jong phi ! To leh ïa nga ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba biang bad kaba dei .

translation.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers ? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations ?
translation.kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Balei phi dei ban leh ïa kijuh ki pop kiba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh bad ba phi ïabud nadien ki bleithaw jong ki ?

translation.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee , and shall cry bitterly , and shall cast up dust upon their heads , they shall wallow themselves in the ashes :
translation.kha: Baroh ki ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong pha , ki da sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki bad tyllun ha u dpei .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kaba u Jehoïakim u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates  ; and the water thereof was dried up , that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis . Ka wah ka la rngad , ban pynbiang ka lynti ïa ki syiem kiba wan na mihngi .

translation.en: And the haft also went in after the blade  ; and the fat closed upon the blade , so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly  ; and the dirt came out .
translation.kha: Ka waitlam baroh kawei lem bad ka sping ka la rung shapoh bad ka khleiñ ka la tap ïa ka . U Ehud um shym la sei ïa ka na ka kpoh jong u syiem , bad ka la pei bla shadien , hapdeng ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: He setteth an end to darkness , and searcheth out all perfection : the stones of darkness , and the shadow of death .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ngam sha ki jaka bajylliew tam ka jingdum . Ki wad ïa ki jaka bajylliew ka pyrthei ; bad ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong uba ha shuwa jong u , u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth–el , that went not out after Israel : and they left the city open , and pursued after Israel .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha Ai u la leit beh ïa ki Israel , bad ki la iehnoh rynghang ïa ka nongbah , khlem don mano mano ban ïada ïa ka .

translation.en: But know ye for certain , that if ye put me to death , ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves , and upon this city , and upon the inhabitants thereof : for of a truth the  Lord  hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears .
translation.kha: Hynrei to tip skhem ïa kane : Lada phi pynïap ïa nga , ma phi bad ki briew jong kane ka nongbah phin long kiba la rem ha kaba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui namar u dei U  Trai  uba la phah ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kane ka jingmaham .

translation.en: For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith : and much people was added unto the Lord .
translation.kha: U Barnabas u la long u briew uba bha , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka jingngeit , bad bun ki briew la wallam sha U Trai .

translation.en: For I am persuaded , that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor powers , nor things present , nor things to come ,
translation.kha: Naba nga long thikna ba ym don kaba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit jong u : Ym ka jingïap lymne ka jingim , lymne ki angel , lymne kiwei ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng lane ki bor lymne jong kaba mynta lymne ka ban sa wan ,

translation.en: And Saul said to him , Whose son art thou , thou young man ? And David answered , I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth–lehemite .
translation.kha: U Saul u kylli ïa u ,  Ko samla , me dei u khun jongno ?   Nga dei u khun jong u shakri jong phi , u Jesse , uba na Bethlehem ,  U Dabid u jubab .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long will this people provoke me ? and how long will it be ere they believe me , for all the signs which I have shewed among them ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Sa katno kine ki briew kin kyntait ïa nga ? Sa katno ruh kin kyntait ban shaniah ha nga , wat la nga la leh bun ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ?

translation.en: For what glory is it , if , when ye be buffeted for your faults , ye shall take it patiently ? but if , when ye do well , and suffer for it , ye take it patiently , this is acceptable with God .
translation.kha: Naba ka nong aïu ka don lada phi ïaishah ïa ki jingshah sympat ba phi dei hok haba phi la leh ïa kaba bakla ? Hynrei lada phi ïaishah ïa ka jingshahshitom wat haba phi la leh ïa kaba dei , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: Therefore whether it were I or they , so we preach , and so ye believed .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kam pher lada ka la wan na nga ne na ki , kane ka long kaei kaba ngi baroh ngi ïalap , bad kane ka long kaei kaba phi ngeit .

translation.en: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ : for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth ; to the Jew first , and also to the Greek .
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingngeit baskhem ha ka Gospel ; ka long ka bor U Blei ban pynim ïa baroh kiba ngeit , nyngkong ïa ki Jiw bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .
translation.kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa u Dathan bad tep ïa u Abiram bad ka longïing jong u ;

translation.en: All things are delivered to me of my Father : and no man knoweth who the Son is , but the Father  ; and who the Father is , but the Son , and he to whom the Son will reveal him .
translation.kha: U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ym don batip U Khun u long uei lait tang U Kpa , bad ym don batip U Kpa u long uei lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba U Khun u jied ban pynpaw ïa U .

translation.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai dei ban thang noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And the channels of the sea appeared , the foundations of the world were discovered , at the rebuking of the  Lord  , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils .
translation.kha: Ka trai duriaw ka paw tyngkreiñ bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei ruh la pynpaw , haba U  Trai  u kynteit ïa ki nongshun jong u , bad u kyrhuh ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .

translation.en: For ye remember , brethren , our labour and travail : for labouring night and day , because we would not be chargeable unto any of you , we preached unto you the gospel of God .
translation.kha: Da shisha phi kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong ngi , kumno ba ngi la minot bad trei shitom ! Ngi la trei mynsngi bad mynmiet khnang ba ngin ym bankhia ïa phi haba ngi la ïalap ha phi ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei .

translation.en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him : talk ye of all his wondrous works .
translation.kha: To rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; ïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh .

translation.en: And they dwelt therein , and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki la shong la sah hangne bad tei ïa ka templ ban burom ïa me , da kaba tip

translation.en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall , and escaped his hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei la pynhiar ïa nga ha ka shang na ka jingkhangïit kaba ha ka kynroh bad la pyllait im ïa nga na u .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread , and shall say , Put me , I pray thee , into one of the priests  offices , that I may eat a piece of bread .
translation.kha: Kat uba dang sah na ki khun ki ksiew jong me un leit ha uta u lyngdoh bad pan na u ïa ka pisa bad ka jingbam , bad kyrpad ïa u ban shah ba un ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh khnang ba un ïoh ei ei ban bam .

translation.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away : for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ki jaka mane ba-thala ym shym la pynjot . Ki briew kim pat shym la phai da ka dohnud baroh ban shakri ïa U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall reign for ever , even thy God , O Zion , unto all generations . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem junom . U Blei jong pha , ko Seïon , un synshar baroh shi rta . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath : wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand , and dipped it in an honeycomb , and put his hand to his mouth  ; and his eyes were enlightened .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jonathan um shym la ïohsngew ba u kpa jong u , u la maham jur ïa ki rangbah da ka jingtim ; kumta u la kner da u dieng ba u rah , u pynngam ïa u ha ka rewngap , bad u bam khyndiat ka ngap . Hangta hi u la sngew ïohbor .

translation.en: And they commanded the people , saying , When ye see the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , and the priests the Levites bearing it , then ye shall remove from your place , and go after it .
translation.kha: bad ong ha ki paidbah ,  Haba phi ïohi ïa ki lyngdoh ba ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , loit noh ïa ka jaka shong dara bad bud ïa ki .

translation.en: And I will do in thee that which I have not done , and whereunto I will not do any more the like , because of all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Namar kiei kiei baroh kiba pha leh ki long kiba nga ijli , ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaba ngam pat ju leh mynno mynno , bad ïa kaba ngan ym leh shuh lano lano ruh .

translation.en: In this the children of God are manifest , and the children of the devil : whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God , neither he that loveth not his brother .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingïapher kaba shai kdar hapdeng ki khun U Blei bad ki khun u Soitan : Uno uno u bym leh ïa kaei kaba dei lane u bym ieit ïa la u hynmen u para um long u khun U Blei .

translation.en: And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .
translation.kha: U shipai rangbah uba ïeng hangta ha khmat ka diengphna u la ïohi kumno U Jisu u la ïap .  Une u briew u long shisha U Khun U Blei !  u la ong .

translation.en: And the fish that was in the river died  ; and the river stank , and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river  ; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki dohkha ha ka wah ki la ïap , bad ka la sma iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nong Ijipt kim nud shuh ban dih um na ka . Ka snam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And afterward they made ready for themselves , and for the priests : because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night  ; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves , and for the priests the sons of Aaron .
