translation.kha: Hadien ba la dep ïa kane , ki Lebi ki pynbiang doh na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron , namar ba ki lyngdoh ki bunkam haduh mynmiet , ha kaba thang tylli ïa ki jingri bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki jingkñia .

translation.en: But at the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name in , there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even , at the going down of the sun , at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U  Trai  un jied — ym hawei pat ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi . Leh ïa kata ha ka por sep sngi , kaba ïadei bad ka por ba phi mih na Ijipt .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Went not mine heart with thee , when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee ? Is it a time to receive money , and to receive garments , and oliveyards , and vineyards , and sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and maidservants ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Elisha u ong ,  Hato ngam shym la don hangta ha ka mynsiem haba u briew u hiar na ka kali ïapom jong u ban ïashem ïa me ? Kane kam dei ka por ban pdiang ïa ka tyngka bad ki jaiñ , ki brisoh olib bad ki bri sohwaiñ , ki langbrot bad ki masi lane ki shakri !

translation.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour , and trust ye not in any brother : for every brother will utterly supplant , and every neighbour will walk with slanders .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh u dei ban da sumar bha pyrshah ïa u paralok jong u , bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban shaniah ïa u hynmen u para shynrang jong u ; namar uwei pa uwei uba shi para u long uba dap da ka jingshukor kum u Jakob , bad uwei uwei u krenbeiñ ïa ki paralok jong u .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , dig now in the wall : and when I had digged in the wall , behold a door .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , pynpra ïa ka kynroh hangne .  Nga la pynpra lyngba ïa ka bad nga la shem ïa ka jingkhang .

translation.en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them not , shall be likened unto a foolish man , which built his house upon the sand :
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba bieit uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u shyiap .

translation.en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; as Moses commanded .
translation.kha: bad u ai ïa ki shadem bad ki kjat-dien kamon kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , kumba u Moses u la hukum .

translation.en: And God , which knoweth the hearts , bare them witness , giving them the Holy Ghost , even as he did unto us  ;
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , u la pyn-i ïa ka jingmynjur ïa ki Jentil da kaba ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki , kumba u la leh ha ngi .

translation.en: And I stood upon the sand of the sea , and saw a beast rise up out of the sea , having seven heads and ten horns , and upon his horns ten crowns , and upon his heads the name of blasphemy .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei u mradkhlaw uba wan mih na duriaw . U la don shiphew tylli ki reng bad hynñiew tylli ki khlieh ; halor kawei pa kawei jong ki reng jong ka , la don ka pansngiat , bad halor kawei pa kawei jong ki khlieh jong ka la don ka kyrteng kaba krenbeiñ Blei .

translation.en: And Hazar–shual , and Beer–sheba , and Bizjothjah ,
translation.kha: ka Hasar Shual , ka Beersheba , ka Bisiothaïah ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , when their hearts were merry , that they said , Call for Samson , that he may make us sport . And they called for Samson out of the prison house  ; and he made them sport : and they set him between the pillars .
translation.kha: Ki ïalehkmen para ma ki , kumta ki ong  Khot ïa u Samson , bad ngin phah ïa u ban pynbyrngia ïa ngi !  Haba ki la wallam ïa u Samson na ka byndi , ki phah ba un pynbyrngia ïa ki bad ki pynïeng ïa u hapdeng ki rishot . Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa u , ki rwai ïaroh sha u blei jong ki :  U blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor u nongshun jong ngi , uba la pynjot ïa ka ri jong ngi bad uba la pynïap shibun na ngi !

translation.en: If the  Lord  delight in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it us  ; a land which floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Lada U  Trai  u la sngewbha ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa ngi shata bad ai ha ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

translation.en: Then ye shall bring them both out unto the gate of that city , and ye shall stone them with stones that they die  ; the damsel , because she cried not , being in the city  ; and the man , because he hath humbled his neighbour s wife : so thou shalt put away evil from among you .
translation.kha: ïalam ïa ki baroh ar ngut shabar shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap . Kata ka briew ka dei ban ïap namar ba kam shym la kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , wat la ka don hapoh shnong , bad uta u shynrang pat u dei ban ïap namar u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka , bad kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .

translation.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the  Lord  thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou , nor thy son , nor thy daughter , thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates :
translation.kha: hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga . Ha kata ka sngi phim bit ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam — ma phi , ne ki khun jong phi , ne ki mraw jong phi , ne ki jingri jong phi , ne ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal , and Chimham went on with him : and all the people of Judah conducted the king , and also half the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la lah jam sha shiliang , ïa kaba la synran da baroh ki rangbah ka Judah bad shiteng na ki paid Israel , u la leit beit sha Gilgal , bad u Shimham u la leit bad u .

translation.en: How do we benefit from these gatherings ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingmyntoi ba ngi ïoh na kum kine ki jingïakynduhlang ?

translation.en: And he said ,  Come .  And when Peter was come down out of the ship , he walked on the water , to go to Jesus .
translation.kha: To wan !  la jubab U Jisu . Kumta u Petros u la hiar na ka lieng bad u la sdang ban ïaid halor ka um sha U Jisu .

translation.en: And when they were at Salamis , they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews : and they had also John to their minister .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Salamis , ki la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei ha ki synagog . Ki la don lang bad ki u Ïoannis Markos ban ïarap ha ka kam .

translation.en: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air , and unto the beasts of the earth , and no man shall fray them away .
translation.kha: Ynda phi ïap , ki sim bad ki mrad kin bam ïa ki metïap jong phi , bad yn ym don ba leit beh ïa ki .

translation.en: But he perceived their craftiness , and said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi lut ïa ka buit jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself , O God of Israel , the Saviour .
translation.kha: U Blei ki Israel , uba pynim ïa la ki briew , u long U Blei uba buhrieh ïa lade .

translation.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham s sight because of his son .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pyndiaw shibun eh ïa u Abraham , naba u Ishmael ruh u dei u khun jong u .

translation.en: Two things have I required of thee  ; deny me them not before I die :
translation.kha: Nga pan na me , A Blei , ban shah ïa nga ban don ar tylli kiei kiei shuwa ba ngan ïap :

translation.en: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings , because he had done good in Israel , both toward God , and toward his house .
translation.kha: Ki la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid kum ka dak ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingshakri kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki paid Israel , na ka bynta U Blei bad na ka bynta ka Templ .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Go in peace . So he arose , and went to Hebron .
translation.kha: Khie leit suk ,  u syiem u ong . Kumta u Absalom u la leit noh sha Hebron .

translation.en: And that he died for all , that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves , but unto him which died for them , and rose again .
translation.kha: U la ïap na ka bynta baroh , khnang ba kito kiba im kim dei shuh ban im na ka bynta ïa lade , hynrei tang na ka bynta jong uta uba la ïap bad ba la pynmihpat na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth .
translation.kha: Na ka jaka ba u synshar , u khmih shapoh halor baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , saying , I am thy servant and thy son : come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .
translation.kha: U Ahas u phah ïa ki rangbah sha u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :  Nga long u shakri baïaineh jong phi . To wan bad pyllait im ïa nga na ki syiem ka Syria bad Israel , kiba wan tur ïaleh ïa nga .

translation.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me ? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me .
translation.kha: Slem sa katno ba kine ki riewbymman kin khñium pyrshah ïa nga ? Nga la ïohsngew shibun ïa kine ki jingkhñium !

translation.en: Son of man , behold , they of the house of Israel say , The vision that he seeth is for many days to come , and he prophesieth of the times that are far off .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel ki pyrkhat ba ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingïathuhlypa jong me ki dei shaphang ka lawei kaba dang slem .

translation.en: Now when Job s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him , they came every one from his own place  ; Eliphaz the Temanite , and Bildad the Shuhite , and Zophar the Naamathite : for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him .
translation.kha: Lai ngut na ki paralok u Job ki long u Eliphas na ka nongbah Teman , u Bildad na ka ri Shuah , bad u Sophar na ka ri Naamah . Ynda ki la ïohsngew katno ba u Job u shah jynjar , ki ïakut ban leit bad pyntngen ïa u .

translation.en: And the golden mice , according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords , both of fenced cities , and of country villages , even unto the great stone of Abel , whereon they set down the ark of the  Lord  : which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua , the Beth–shemite .
translation.kha: Ki phah ruh ïa ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka nongbah ba la synshar da ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia , ki shnong ba la ker kynroh bad ki bym shym la ker kynroh . Uta u mawbah ha ka lyngkha u Joshua uba ha Beth Shemesh , ha uba ki buh ïa ka synduk ka Jutang , u dang don hangta kum u sakhi haduh kane ka sngi ïa kaei kaba la jia .

translation.en: And when all these kings were met together , they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom , to fight against Israel .
translation.kha: Kine ki syiem baroh ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan lang ban sher dara harud ka Wahduid Meron ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold : their hooks were of gold  ; and he cast for them four sockets of silver .
translation.kha: Ki shna saw tylli ki païa da ka dieng akasia ha kiba yn wah ïa kata ka pyrda , ki suit ïa ki da ka ksiar , bad ki buh ha ki ïa ki bnoh ksiar . Nangta ki shna saw tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa kiba batskhem ïa kita ki païa .

translation.en: Will open
translation.kha: Ngan sa Plie

translation.en: Ye also , as lively stones , are built up a spiritual house , an holy priesthood , to offer up spiritual sacrifices , acceptable to God by Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To wan kum ki maw ba-im , bad to shah ïa lade ba yn pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ ba kynja mynsiem , ha kaba phin shakri kum ki lyngdoh bakhuid ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ba kynja mynsiem bad ba pdiang hun ha U Blei da U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the door , to bring forth out of the temple of the  Lord  all the vessels that were made for Baal , and for the grove , and for all the host of heaven : and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron , and carried the ashes of them unto Beth–el .
translation.kha: Nangta u Josaïah u hukum ïa u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ïa ki lyngdoh ba ïarap ïa u , bad ïa ki nongap kiba treikam ha ka jaka rung sha ka Templ ban wanrah shabar ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal , ïa ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ki khlur . U syiem u la thang ïa kine ki tiar baroh shabar ka nongbah hajan ka Them Kidron , bad nangta ïa u dpei la rah sha Bethel .

translation.en: And the sons of Joseph , which were born him in Egypt , were two souls : all the souls of the house of Jacob , which came into Egypt , were threescore and ten .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Joseph ïa kiba la kha ha Ijipt ki long ar ngut ; kumta ki briew baroh kiba na ka ïing u Jakob kiba la wan sha Ijipt ki long hynñiewphew ngut .

translation.en: For all that do such things , and all that do unrighteously , are an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba shukor .

translation.en: So the children of Joseph , Manasseh and Ephraim , took their inheritance .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph , ka jait Ephraim bad ka jait Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , ki la ïohpdiang ïa kane ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him : therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy , and utterly to make away many .
translation.kha: Te ka khubor kaba wan na mihngi bad na shatei kan pynsheptieng ïa u , bad un ïaleh da jingbitar shla , da kaba pynïap shibun ngut ki briew .

translation.en: Through desire a man , having separated himself , seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki bym ïadei bad kiwei ki pyrkhat tang ïa lade ; kin ym ïahap bad kaei kaba baroh ki tip ba ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa sawspah lai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing , if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynthei kan ïohlait im ha ka por ba ka kha khun , lada ka ïaineh ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit bad ka jingkhuid , lem bad ka jingdon akor .

translation.en: But they mocked the messengers of God , and despised his words , and misused his prophets , until the wrath of the  Lord  arose against his people , till there was no remedy .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kim suidñiew ïa ki ktien jong u bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ha kaba kut ka jingbitar U  Trai  pyrshah ïa la ki briew ka long kaba jur katta katta kat ban ym don lad shuh ban lait na ka .

translation.en: And Paul , earnestly beholding the council , said , Men and brethren , I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day .
translation.kha: U Paul u la peit shlip sha ka Dorbar bad u la ong ,  Ko ki para nong Israel jong nga ! Ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka sngur shaphang ka rukom ha kaba nga la im ha khmat U Blei haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets , whom I sent unto you , both rising up early , and sending them , but ye have not hearkened  ;
translation.kha: bad da kaba pynshahshkor ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga , kiba nga la ju ïai phah sha phi . Phim pat ju kohnguh ïa kaei kaba ki la ong .

translation.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  unto his place , into the oracle of the house , to the most holy place , even under the wings of the cherubims .
translation.kha: Nangta ki lyngdoh ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka Templ bad ki buh ïa ka ha Ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam , hapoh ki kherub .

translation.en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus , and at Jerusalem , and throughout all the coasts of Judaea , and then to the Gentiles , that they should repent and turn to God , and do works meet for repentance .
translation.kha: Nyngkong ha Damaskos bad ha Jerusalem bad nangta ha ka Judia baroh bad hapdeng ki Jentil , nga la ïalap ba ki dei ban kylla-kaba-mut na ki pop jong ki bad ban phai sha U Blei bad leh ïa kiei kiei ki ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .

translation.en: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan , and Shimei .
translation.kha: U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ladan bad u Shimei .

translation.en: For when they shall rise from the dead , they neither marry , nor are given in marriage  ; but are as the angels which are in heaven .
translation.kha: Naba haba kiba la ïap kin mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng ba kin ym shongkurim shuh .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? none is good , save one , that is , God .
translation.kha: Balei me khot uba bha ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ym don uno uno uba bha lait tang U Blei .

translation.en: And her brother and her mother said , Let the damsel abide with us a few days , at the least ten  ; after that she shall go .
translation.kha: Hynrei u hynmen jong ka Rebekka bad ka kmie jong ka ki ong ,  Ai ba ka Rebekka kan sah shuwa bad ngi shi taïew ne shiphew sngi , bad hadien kata ka lah ban leit .

translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , O wicked man , thou shalt surely die  ; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew ba-bymman u dei ban ïap bad mem shym la maham ïa u ba un phai na ki lynti jong u khnang ba u lah ban pynim ïa la ka jingim , te un ïap , kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkit pop ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram , the rump , and that which covereth the inwards , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver :
translation.kha: U Aaron u buh ïa ki bynta bakhleiñ jong u masi lyngraw bad jong u langbrot

translation.en: Let them therefore , said he , which among you are able , go down with me , and accuse this man , if there be any wickedness in him .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki nongïalam jong phi kin leit sha Kaisaria lem bad nga bad mudui ïa uta u briew lada u leh ïa kano kano ka bymdei .

translation.en: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields , even they and their men , heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land , and had committed unto him men , and women , and children , and of the poor of the land , of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam ka Judah bad ki shipai kim shym la pyndem . Ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la lah pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat ka ri bad ba la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa kito baroh ki bym shym la ïalam noh sha Babilonia — ki briew kiba duk tam ha ka ri .

translation.en: The king answered and said to Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen , and the interpretation thereof ?
translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Daniel ( ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar ) ,  Hato me lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa kaei kaba nga phohsniew bad aïu ka kit jingmut ?

translation.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer ,
translation.kha: U Toi u syiem Hamath u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa baroh ka kynhun ïapom jong u Hadadeser .

translation.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb , sweet to the soul , and health to the bones .
translation.kha: Ki ktien sbun ki long kum ka ngap — kaba thiang ïa ka jingmad bad kaba bha ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel , saith the Lord  God  , that my fury shall come up in my face .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka sngi haba u Gog u hiarthma ïa ka Israel , ngan sa bitar lep .

translation.en: I will stand upon my watch , and set me upon the tower , and will watch to see what he will say unto me , and what I shall answer when I am reproved .
translation.kha: Ngan kiew ïa ka jaka ap phira jong nga bad ap ban khmih ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  un ïathuh ha nga ban ong bad kaei ka jubab ba un ai halor ka jingmudui jong nga .

translation.en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms , do not sound a trumpet before thee , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may have glory of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Kumta haba phi ai ei ei ha u briew uba kyrduh , wat pynsawa jam ïa ka , kumba ki riewarsap ki leh ha ki synagog bad ha ki lynti bah . Ki leh ïa ka khnang ba ki briew kin ïaroh ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ba ki la da ïoh ka jingsiew ba-pura .

translation.en: But if our gospel be hid , it is hid to them that are lost :
translation.kha: Naba lada la buhrieh ïa ka gospel kaba ngi ïalap , la buhrieh ïa ka tang na kito kiba la jah noh .

translation.en: And Joram turned his hands , and fled , and said to Ahaziah , There is treachery , O Ahaziah .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingshetkylla , ko Ahasaïah !  U Joram u kyang jam , katba u dang pynphai sawdong ïa ka kali ïapom jong u bad u phet ïap .

translation.en: Then Peter opened his mouth , and said , Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons :
translation.kha: U Petros u la sdang ban kren :  Mynta nga sngewthuh ba ka long kaba shisha ba U Blei u ñiew kumjuh ïa uno uno baroh .

translation.en: And Moses sware on that day , saying , Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children s for ever , because thou hast wholly followed the  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Namar ba nga la leh kumta , u Moses u la kular ïa nga ba ki khun ki kti jong nga bad ma nga , ngin ïohpdiang da kaba thikna kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba nga la ïuhkjat .

translation.en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David , saying , Bring him up to me in the bed , that I may slay him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u phah biang ïa ki ba kin da leit peit da lade ïa u Dabid . U hukum ïa ki ,  Rah lang ïa u hangne ha ka jingthiah jong u bad ngan pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man , seeking goodly pearls :
translation.kha: Kumjuh , ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u wad ïa ki mawlynnai kiba kordor ,

translation.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain  ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .
translation.kha: Kam myntoi ïa me ban shu ïai kren ; ka long kaba shai kdar ba mem sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me kren .

translation.en: Blessed are they that do his commandments , that they may have right to the tree of life , and may enter in through the gates into the city .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba sait pynkhuid ïa la ki jaiñkup bad kumta ki don ka hok ban bam ïa u soh na u dieng ka jingim bad ban leit lyngba ki khyrdop shapoh ka nongbah .

translation.en: We give thanks to God always for you all , making mention of you in our prayers ;
translation.kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi baroh bad ngi ïai kynmaw ïa phi borabor ha ki jingduwai jong ngi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses

translation.en: Who maketh his angels spirits  ; his ministers a flaming fire :
translation.kha: Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyer kum ki nonglamktien jong me bad ki jingthaba leilieh kum ki shakri jong me .

translation.en: And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them ,  It is enough .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Kine hangne ar tylli ki waitlam , ko Kynrad !   Kata ka la biang !  u la jubab .

translation.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the  Lord  his God :
translation.kha: U Asa u pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u , da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .

translation.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work  ; but they were men of war , and chief of his captains , and captains of his chariots and horsemen .
translation.kha: Ïa ki Israel ym shym la pyndonkam ha kaba pyntrei jubor , hynrei ki shakri kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki nongai hukum ïa kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai .

translation.en: For as the new heavens and the new earth , which I will make , shall remain before me , saith the  Lord  , so shall your seed and your name remain .
translation.kha: Kumba ka khyndew bathymmai bad ki bneng kiba thymmai , kin ïaisah da ka bor jong nga , kumta ruh ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ka kyrteng jong phi kin ïaisah .

translation.en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year , in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar , that the heavens were opened , and I saw visions of God .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba saw jong ka snem kaba laiphew , ma nga , u Esekiel u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Busi , nga dang ïashong ïasah ryngkat bad ki Jiw ba la shah ringmraw harud ka wah Khebar ha Babilonia . Ka bneng ka la plie wang , bad nga la ïohi ïa U Blei ha ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: In those days the  Lord  began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah .
translation.kha: Ka la jia ba katba u dang long syiem ba U  Trai  u phah nyngkong ïa u Resin u syiem ka Syria bad u Pekah u syiem ka Israel ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah .

translation.en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation , thou didst thresh the heathen in anger .
translation.kha: Me thom sawdong ka pyrthei ha ka jingbitar ; ha ka jingbitar shla me ïuh halor ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Brethren , be followers together of me , and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example .
translation.kha: To ïai pyrthuh bud ïa nga , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . To pynleit jingmut ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka nuksa kaba dei kaba ngi la buh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper : and one is hungry , and another is drunken .
translation.kha: Naba katba phi dang ïabam , phi ïabam shuwa ïa la ka jong ka jingbam miet , te don kiba la thngan katba kiwei ki lah da buaid .

translation.en: The burden of Egypt . Behold , the  Lord  rideth upon a swift cloud , and shall come into Egypt : and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence , and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Ijipt . U  Trai  u wan sha Ijipt , u da shong ha u lyoh uba ïaid stet . Ki bleithaw jong ki Ijipt ki khynñiuh ha khmat jong u , bad ki briew jong ka Ijipt ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .

translation.en: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad  ; and a gift destroyeth the heart .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban long uba stad , hynrei lada phi shukor ïano ïano , phi leh la kum u bieit . Lada phi shim klop , phi pynjot ïa la ka jinglong jingim .

translation.en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds , and destitute of the truth , supposing that gain is godliness : from such withdraw thyself .
translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ka niam ka long ka lynti ban riewspah .

translation.en: To make the weight for the winds  ; and he weigheth the waters by measure .
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u ai ha ka lyer ïa ka bor jong ka , bad ba u kheiñ ïa ka jingheh jong ka duriaw ;

translation.en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light : for whatsoever doth make manifest is light .
translation.kha: Bad haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la wallam sha ka jingshai , te ïa ka jinglong bashisha jong ki la pynpaw shynna ; naba kaei kaei kaba la pynpaw shynna ka kylla long ka jingshai .

translation.en: And as she was going to fetch it , he called to her , and said , Bring me , I pray thee , a morsel of bread in thine hand .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang leit shim ïa ka , u la ong ,  Bad sngewbha wanrah de khyndiat u kpu .

translation.en: And God came unto Balaam at night , and said unto him , If the men come to call thee , rise up , and go with them  ; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee , that shalt thou do .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la wan ha u Balaam bad u ong ,  Lada kine ki briew ki la wan khot ïa me ban leit bad ki , to khreh ban leit ; hynrei leh tang ïa kata kaba nga ong ha me .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto the people , Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the  Lord  , to serve him . And they said , We are witnesses .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki ,  Phi long ki sakhi ïa lade hi ïa ka jingshisha ba phi la jied ban shakri ïa U  Trai .   Ho-oid ,  ki ong ,  ngi long ki sakhi .

translation.en: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God , in much patience , in afflictions , in necessities , in distresses ,
translation.kha: Pynban , ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi leh ngi pyn-i ba ngi long ki shakri U Blei da kaba ïaishah slem ha ki jingjynjar , ki jingeh , bad ki jingshitom .

translation.en: But if ye will not hear these words , I swear by myself , saith the  Lord  , that this house shall become a desolation .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , te nga smai ha phi ba kane ka ïingsyiem kan ngat ha ki jingjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Judah  ; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain  ; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley , because they had chariots of iron .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki paid Judah , bad ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri lum . Hynrei kim shym la kurup ïa ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , lane ka Ekron lem bad ki jaka sawdong jong ki . Kine ki briew kiba shong basah harud duriaw ki don ïa ki kali ïapom da ka nar , bad kumta ki paid Judah kim shym la lah ban beh krad ïa ki .

translation.en: And from thence they went to Beer : that is the well whereof the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Gather the people together , and I will give them water .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit sha ka jaka ba la khot  Ki Pukri ,  ha kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Lumlang ïa ki briew , bad ngan ai um ïa ki .

translation.en: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort  ; and I answered them after the same manner .
translation.kha: Ki phah ïa nga ïa kajuh ka khubor saw sien , bad ha man la ki sien , nga phah ïa kijuh ki jubab .

translation.en: Howl , ye inhabitants of Maktesh , for all the merchant people are cut down  ; all they that bear silver are cut off .
translation.kha: To ïam bad to kyang haba phi ïohsngew ïa kane . Phi kiba shong basah ha ki bynta ba ha trai jong ka nongbah , namar baroh ki nongkhaïi kin ïap !

translation.en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses his servant , so did Moses command Joshua , and so did Joshua  ; he left nothing undone of all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki hukum jong u ha u Moses u shakri jong u , u Moses u la ai ïa kita ha u Joshua , bad u Joshua u la kohnguh ïa ki . U la leh ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us  ; thou art very wroth against us .
translation.kha: Lane hato me la kyntait ïa ngi junom ? Hato ym don jingkut ïa ka jingbitar jong me ?

translation.en: Folly is set in great dignity , and the rich sit in low place .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ba-mutlop la ai ki kyrdan ba don iktiar katba ïa kiba riewspah la leh bymsuidñiew .

translation.en: Ye eat the fat , and ye clothe you with the wool , ye kill them that are fed : but ye feed not the flock .
translation.kha: Phi dih ïa ka dud , phi kup ki jaiñ ba la thain na u  saiwul , phi pynïap bad bam na ki langbrot kiba kynsai tam . Hynrei phim ju sumar bha ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law .
translation.kha: Naba ngi pynkut ba u briew u don ka jinglonghok bad U Blei tang lyngba ka jingngeit , bad ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .

translation.en: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them ,  With men this is impossible  ; but with God all things are possible .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit shlip sha ki bad u la jubab ,  Kane ka long ka bym lah ha u briew , hynrei ha U Blei kiei kiei baroh ki long kaba lah .

translation.en: And we said unto my lord , The lad cannot leave his father : for if he should leave his father , his father would die .
translation.kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab ba u para um lah ban ieh ïa i pa ; namar lada u leh kumta , i pa in ïap .

translation.en: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle , that thou mayest eat and be full .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingbam baroh kaba phi kwah .

translation.en: And men shall dwell in it , and there shall be no more utter destruction  ; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin shong kin sah hangta ha ka jingshngain , kin ym shah byrngem shuh da ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: And the child Samuel grew on , and was in favour both with the  Lord  , and also with men .
translation.kha: Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san bad u nang shem ïa ka jingsngewbha na U  Trai  bad na ki briew .

translation.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled  ; a span shall be the length thereof , and a span shall be the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Ka dei ban long kaba sawdong , bad kaba la khylliap ar syrtap , kaba jrong arphew ar sentimitar bad kaba ïar arphew ar sentimitar .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joram , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoram u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: When Will Paradise Come ?
translation.kha: Lano ka Paradais Kan Wan ?

translation.en: I have sworn by myself , the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness , and shall not return , That unto me every knee shall bow , every tongue shall swear .
translation.kha: Ka jingkular jong nga ka long kaba shisha , bad kan ym kylla . Nga kular shisha da baroh kaba nga long ; baroh kin wan ban dem ha khmat jong nga bad kular ba ki long hok ha nga .

translation.en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put it upon a bar .
translation.kha: Phin thung ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban pyndep ïa ki kamram ka jinglong lyngdoh ; uno uno uwei pat uba pyrshang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap .

translation.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people , which walketh in a way that was not good , after their own thoughts  ;
translation.kha: Nga long uba la kloi borabor ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki briew jong nga , kiba long mutlop ban ïai leh ïa ka bymdei bad ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti ,

translation.en: It is God that avengeth me , and that bringeth down the people under me ,
translation.kha: U ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga , U pyndem ïa ki jaitbynriew hapoh jong nga ,

translation.en: And another angel came and stood at the altar , having a golden censer  ; and there was given unto him much incense , that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u angel , uba bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih kaba da ka ksiar , u la wan bad u la ïeng ha ka duwan . La ai ha u shikatdei ka jingiwbih ryngkat bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei baroh bad ban ai ïa ka halor ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat kata ka khet .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them , that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai s matters would stand : for he had told them that he was a Jew .
translation.kha: man ka sngi ki kyntu ïa u ban pyndem , hynrei um sngap ïa ki .  Nga dei u Jiw ,  u batai ,  bad ngam lah ban dem ha u Haman .  Kumta ki ïathuh ïa kane ha u Haman , bad ki pyrkhat la un lah ban shah ïa kane ka jingleh u Mordekai .

translation.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them : and a voice came out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
translation.kha: Nangta u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u , bad ka sur ka la wan na u lyoh ,  Une u long U Khun ba-ieit eh jong nga — to shahshkor ïa u !

translation.en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence , they were gathered together .
translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la pynsngap jar ïa ki Saddusi , ki la ïawanlang ,

translation.en: For the  Lord  will pass through to smite the Egyptians  ; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel , and on the two side posts , the  Lord  will pass over the door , and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Ijipt ban pynïap ïa ki nong Ijipt , un ïohi ïa ka snam ha u bim bad ha ki shawkad bad un ym shah ïa u Angel jong ka Jingïap ban rung shapoh ki ïing jong phi bad pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister s hands , and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister , saying , Thus spake the man unto me  ; that he came unto the man  ; and , behold , he stood by the camels at the well .
translation.kha: U Laban u la ïohi ïa ka sati khmut bad ïa ki khadu ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka para jong u , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka ba ka ïathuh ïa kaei kaba uta u briew u la ong ha ka . U leit sha u shakri jong u Abraham , uba ïeng hajan ki ut jong u harud kata ka pukri ,

translation.en: Shall not they teach thee , and tell thee , and utter words out of their heart ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ai ba ki riewstad mynbarim kin hikai ïa me , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ki don ban ong .

translation.en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh , and pronounce him to be unclean : for the raw flesh is unclean : it is a leprosy .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u , bad lada u ïohi ïa ka prum , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ka prum ka pyn-i ba ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee .
translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ïa u syiem Ijipt ,  Men mad ïa ka waitlam u syiem Babilon .

translation.en: And Saul s servants said unto him , Behold now , an evil spirit from God troubleth thee .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki ong ha u ,  Ngi tip ba u mynsiem bymman ba la phah U Blei u pynjynjar ïa phi .

translation.en: When once the master of the house is risen up , and hath shut to the door , and ye begin to stand without , and to knock at the door , saying , Lord , Lord , open unto us  ; and he shall answer and say unto you , I know you not whence ye are :
translation.kha: U kynrad jong ka ïing un khie bad un khang ïa ka jingkhang ; nangta haba phi ïeng shabar bad sdang ban tied ha ka jingkhang bad ong , ‘ To plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong ngi , ko kynrad !’ Un jubab ïa phi , ‘ Ngam ithuh ïa phi nangno phi ïawan !’

translation.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar : they kept his testimonies , and the ordinance that he gave them .
translation.kha: U la kren ha ki na u rishot lyoh ; ki kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba u la ai ha ki .

translation.en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar  ; and in the night by a pillar of fire , to give them light in the way wherein they should go .
translation.kha: Da u lyoh me ïalam ïa ki ha ka por mynsngi , bad mynmiet me pynshai ïa ka lynti jong ki da ka ding .

translation.en: The voice of joy , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride , the voice of them that shall say , Praise the  Lord  of hosts : for the  Lord  is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever : and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the  Lord . For I will cause to return the captivity of the land , as at the first , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kine ki jaka phin ïohsngew biang ïa ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingïabam khawai shongkurim . Phin ïohsngew ba ki briew ki ïarwai katba ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang sha ka Templ jong nga ; kin ïa-ong ,   ‘ To ainguh ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , namar u long uba bha bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .’ Ngan pynlong ïa kane ka ri kaba roi kyrhai kumba mynshuwa . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And they said unto Moses , Speak thou with us , and we will hear : but let not God speak with us , lest we die .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u Moses ,  Lada phi kren ha ngi , ngin shahshkor ; hynrei ngi sheptieng ba lada U Blei u kren ha ngi , ngin ïap .

translation.en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days : so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïambriew ïa u laiphew sngi hangta ha ri them Moab .

translation.en: Then Paul answered , What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart ? for I am ready not to be bound only , but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab ,  Phi ïaleh aïu , da kaba ïam kumne bad pynpait ïa ka dohnud jong nga ? Nga la kloi ym tang ban shah khum ha Jerusalem hynrei wat ban ïap ruh hangta na ka bynta U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: Rather , he told his disciples to memorialize , or remember , his death .
translation.kha: Hynrei , u ong ïa la ki synran ban iai-kynmaw , lane ban kynmaw ïa ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: Remember , and forget not , how thou provokedst the  Lord  thy God to wrath in the wilderness : from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt , until ye came unto this place , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ju klet kumno phi la pynbitar lep ïa U  Trai  ha ka ri shyiap . Naduh ka sngi ba phi mih na Ijipt haduh ba phi poi hangne , phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , he put no trust in his servants  ; and his angels he charged with folly :
translation.kha: U Blei um shaniah ïa ki shakri jong u ha bneng ; u shem ka jingduna wat bad ki angel jong u .

translation.en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up , and fought against Gath , and took it : and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Gath bad u jop ïa ka ; nangta u rai ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God hath cut off the nations , whose land the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their cities , and in their houses  ;
translation.kha: Ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew bad u ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki , bad hadien ba phi la ïohknieh ïa ki shnong bad ki ïing jong ki bad ba phi la shong la sah hangta ,

translation.en: For we are glad , when we are weak , and ye are strong : and this also we wish , even your perfection .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewkmen haba ngi long kiba tlot hynrei phi long kiba khlaiñ . Bad kumta ngi duwai ruh ba phin long kiba janai .

translation.en: And there came a messenger to David , saying , The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien u la ïathuh ha u Dabid ,  Ki Israel ki la ïakular ban ai jingkyrshan noh ïa u Absalom .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said ,  This voice came not because of me , but for your sakes .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Kam dei na ka bynta jong nga ba kane ka sur ka la kren , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: Among these were the divisions of the porters , even among the chief men , having wards one against another , to minister in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongap phira jong ka Templ la pynïabynta ha ki kynhun kynhun kat kum ki longïing , bad la pynkhamti ïa ki kam ha ka Templ kumba long lem kiwei pat ki Lebi .

translation.en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars , and commanded Judah and Jerusalem , saying , Ye shall worship before one altar , and burn incense upon it ?
translation.kha: Dei ma u uba pynjot ïa ki jaka mane bad ki duwan bad nangta u ong ïa ki paid Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ban mane bad thang jingiwbih tang ha kawei ka duwan .

translation.en: And when they had crucified him , they parted his garments , casting lots upon them , what every man should take .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad ki la ïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki , da kaba ïakynting sbai ban khmih mano ban ïoh ïa kano ka bynta jong ka jaiñ .

translation.en: And the house which I build is great : for great is our God above all gods .
translation.kha: Nga thmu ban tei ka Templ kaba khraw , namar U Blei jong ngi u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei .

translation.en: The words of a man s mouth are as deep waters , and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook .
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong u briew ki lah ban long ka umpohliew ka jingstad , kaba jylliew kat ki duriaw-bah , kaba sngur kum ki wahduid batuid .

translation.en: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him , and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast , whose deadly wound was healed .
translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U la pynbor ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka ban mane ïa u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , uba ka jingmynsaw jong u ka la ïohkhiah .

translation.en: And were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .
translation.kha: bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh hapoh ka Templ da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Thy words were found , and I did eat them  ; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart : for I am called by thy name , O  Lord  God of hosts .
translation.kha: Me la kren ïa nga , bad nga la shahshkor ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien . Nga long u jong me , A  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , bad kumta ki ktien jong me ki la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da kaba kmen bad ka jingsngewkmen .

translation.en: And David went on , and grew great , and the  Lord  God of hosts was with him .
translation.kha: U la nang khlaiñ ha ki por baroh , namar U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Tam u la don ryngkat bad u .

translation.en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate , Write not , The King of the Jews  ; but that he said , I am King of the Jews .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ong ha u Pilat ,  Wat ym thoh , ‘ U Syiem ki Jiw ,’ hynrei pynban , ‘ Une u briew u la ong , nga long u Syiem ki Jiw .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he went to Jerusalem , that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u don ha la ka lynti sha Jerusalem , u la leit na ka pud hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Galilaïa .

translation.en: And the waters returned , and covered the chariots , and the horsemen , and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them  ; there remained not so much as one of them .
translation.kha: Ki um ki ïadait biang bad ki la tyllep ïa ki kali ïapom , ïa ki nongñiah , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh jong u Pharaoh kaba la buddien ïa ki Israel sha duriaw , ym don kawei ruh na ki ïa kaba la iehnoh .

translation.en: At that time , saith the  Lord  , they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah , and the bones of his princes , and the bones of the priests , and the bones of the prophets , and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , out of their graves :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ïa ki shyieng jong ki syiem bad jong ki rangbah synshar ka Judah , kumjuh ruh ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh , jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad jong kiwei pat ki briew kiba la shong la sah ha Jerusalem , yn khlong noh na ki jingtep jong ki .

translation.en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth , and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers  ; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain , and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in :
translation.kha: La thaw ïa ka da uta uba shong halor ka khet jong u shajrong ka khyndew bad sha lyndet ka sahit bneng ; ki briew shapoh ki i rit tang kum ki dkhiew . U pynpyiar ïa ka suiñbneng kum ka pyrda , kum ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba yn shong .

translation.en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the  Lord  , Smite me , I pray thee . And the man refused to smite him .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum U  Trai  u dkhot jong ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa u hukum ïa la u para nongïathuhlypa ban shoh ïa u .

translation.en: And a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches going out of it .
translation.kha: Don kawei ka shata syntiew harum ki lai jur ki tnat kiba mih na u diengpynïeng sharak .

translation.en: Again , a new commandment I write unto you , which thing is true in him and in you : because the darkness is past , and the true light now shineth .
translation.kha: Pynban , ka hukum kaba nga thoh mynta sha phi ka long kaba thymmai , namar ka jingshisha jong ka , ka la paw ha U Khrist bad kumjuh ruh ha phi . Naba ka jingdum ka la jah noh , bad ka jingshai kaba shisha ka la da tyngshaiñ .

translation.en: So when they had gone through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .
translation.kha: Kumta hadien khyndai bnai bad arphew sngi ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: For I would that all men were even as I myself . But every man hath his proper gift of God , one after this manner , and another after that .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin long kum ma nga ; hynrei uwei pa uwei u don ïa ka jingai kaba kyrpang na U Blei , uwei da kane ka jingai , ïa uwei pat da katai ka jingai .

translation.en: Say ye to the righteous , that it shall be well with him : for they shall eat the fruit of their doings .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok kin kmen , bad kiei kiei baroh kin bit kin biang ïa ki . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ki la trei .

translation.en: He bowed the heavens also , and came down  ; and darkness was under his feet .
translation.kha: U tar ïa ka suiñbneng bad u wan hiar ; bad u lyoh uba dum hapoh ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt  ; they committed whoredoms in their youth : there were their breasts pressed , and there they bruised the teats of their virginity .
translation.kha: Mynba ki dang samla , ki shong ki sah ha Ijipt , ki la duh noh ka jinglong sotti bad ki kylla long ki nuti .

translation.en: That your days may be multiplied , and the days of your children , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give them , as the days of heaven upon the earth .
translation.kha: Te ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi phin sa ïoh shong slem ha kata ka ri katba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Phin ïaishong hangta katba ka suiñbneng ka dang neh halor ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , after that I have plucked them out I will return , and have compassion on them , and will bring them again , every man to his heritage , and every man to his land .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba nga la shim noh ïa ki , ngan don jingisynei halor jong ki ; ngan wallam pat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew sha ka ri jong ka bad sha ka shnong jong ka .

translation.en: Mark well , O Job , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I will speak .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko Job , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; long jar jar bad shah ba ngan kren .

translation.en: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all that oppressed you , and drave them out from before you , and gave you their land  ;
translation.kha: Nga la pyllait ïa phi na ki Ijipt bad na ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi hangne ha kane ka ri . Nga la beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat , bad nga la ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother , and his mother s sister , Mary the wife of Cleophas , and Mary Magdalene .
translation.kha: Kiba la ïa-ïeng ha syndah ka diengphna U Jisu ki la long ka kmie jong u , ka para jong ka kmie jong u , ka Mari ka tnga u Kleopas , bad ka Mari ka nong Magdala .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said unto him , The  Lord  is with thee , thou mighty man of valour .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la wanpaw ha u hangta , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad me , me u briew bashlur bad bakhlaiñ !

translation.en: If the iron be blunt , and he do not whet the edge , then must he put to more strength : but wisdom is profitable to direct .
translation.kha: Lada u sdie jong phi u luin bad phim shym shut pynnep ïa u , phi hap ban trei kham tyngeh ban pyndonkam ïa u . Ka long kaba kham don jingmut ban pynkhreh lypa .

translation.en: And the man of thine , whom I shall not cut off from mine altar , shall be to consume thine eyes , and to grieve thine heart : and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age .
translation.kha: Pynban ngan pynsah ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong me bad un shakri ïa nga kum u lyngdoh . Hynrei uta ruh un sa matlah bad duh jingkyrmen , bad baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me kin ïap shyrkhei .

translation.en: You can even print out a few pages to share with an interested person in his own language !
translation.kha: Phi lah ruh ban print katto katne sla ban sam  ïa ki briew kiba kwah ban tip ha ka ktien jong ki !

translation.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice , I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian , and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngam sngewthuh ïa ka ktien kaba la kren , u briew uba pyndonkam ïa ka un long u nongwei ha nga bad ngan long u nongwei ha u .

translation.en: Then said they all , Art thou then the Son of God ? And he said unto them ,  Ye say that I am .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ong ,  Hato ma me , te , me long U Khun U Blei ?  U la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi ong ba nga long .

translation.en: If there come any unto you , and bring not this doctrine , receive him not into your house , neither bid him God speed :
translation.kha: Te kumta , lada uno uno u wan ha phi khlem da wallam ïa kane ka jinghikai , to wat pdiang sngewbha ïa u ha ki ïing jong phi ; to wat da ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad phi .

translation.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren , and could not come at him for the press .
translation.kha: Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong U Jisu ki la wan sha u , hynrei kim lah ban ïadon bad u namar u paidbah .

translation.en: Then I Daniel looked , and , behold , there stood other two , the one on this side of the bank of the river , and the other on that side of the bank of the river .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ar ngut ki rangbah kiba ïeng harud wah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem : and they tarried there .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki bah biang ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha Jerusalem bad ki sah hangta .

translation.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and the right shoulder  ; for it is a ram of consecration :
translation.kha: Ot noh ïa ka khleiñ jong uta u langbrot , ïa u tdong jong u , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki  nierlang , ïa ka sbiar kaba haneng u dohnud , ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka lbong kamon .

translation.en: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah , and said unto them , What evil thing is this that ye do , and profane the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: Nga la sneng ïa ki nongïalam Jiw bad ong ,  Peit ïa kaba sniew kaba phi leh ! Phi pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: And if the  Lord  thy God enlarge thy coast , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers , and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers  ;
translation.kha: Bad lada U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynïar ïa ka ri jong phi , kumba u la ïathuh ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , bad u ai ha phi ïa kata ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular ,

translation.en: And he made an house of high places , and made priests of the lowest of the people , which were not of the sons of Levi .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u tei ruh ïa ki jaka mane ha kliar ki lum , bad u jied ïa ki lyngdoh napdeng ki longïing ki bym dei na ka jait Lebi .

translation.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother , Brother , let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye , when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye ? Thou hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of thine own eye , and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother s eye .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Ko para , sngewbha shah ïa nga ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong phi ,’ pynban phim lah ban ïohi ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ? Phi kiba arsap ! Nyngkong to shim noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na ka khmat jong phi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong u para jong phi .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man , and drink his blood , ye have no life in you .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Lada phim bam ïa ka doh jong U Khun U Briew bad dih ïa ka snam jong u , phin ym don ïa ka jingim ha lade .

translation.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .
translation.kha: Wat trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban sa sniew ; pynban , trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban neh sha ka jingim bymjukut . Kane ka long ka jingbam kaba U Khun U Briew un ai ha phi , namar ba U Blei uba U Kpa , u la sngewbha ban shonshab ha u .

translation.en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province  ; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done , nor his fathers  fathers  ; he shall scatter among them the prey , and spoil , and riches : yea , and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds , even for a time .
translation.kha: Un hiarthma khlem ka jingmaham ïa ka probins    jong ka ri bariewspah bad un leh ïa kiei kiei kiba ym don na ki kpa tymmen jong u kiba la ju leh . Nangta un pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongbud jong u ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa ki jingdon jingem kiba u la kurup ha ka thma . Un pynlong ki jingthmu ban tur ïaleh ïa ki kut , hynrei ka por jong u kan kut noh shen .

translation.en: And if a man lie with a beast , he shall surely be put to death : and ye shall slay the beast .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka mrad , ma u bad kata ka mrad ki dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in , but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi ym don mano mano ba lah ban wan bad leit ha ka jingshngain , namar ba ka la don ka jingjynjar bad jingkhihwin ha ka ri baroh .

translation.en: And Elijah took twelve stones , according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob , unto whom the word of the  Lord  came , saying , Israel shall be thy name :
translation.kha: U shim khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei uwei na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait ba la shim kyrteng na ki khun u Jakob , u briew ïa uba U  Trai  u la ai ka kyrteng u Israel .

translation.en: And he communed with them , saying , If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight  ; hear me , and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,
translation.kha: Lada phi shah ïa nga ban tep ïa la ka tnga hangne , to pynkyrpad lem ïa u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar ba un die ha nga ïa ka krem Makhpelah , kaba don ha trai ka lyngkha jong u .

translation.en: Be glad then , ye children of Zion , and rejoice in the  Lord  your God : for he hath given you the former rain moderately , and he will cause to come down for you the rain , the former rain , and the latter rain in the first month .
translation.kha: To lehkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , to shadkmen ha kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa phi . U la ai ïa phi ïa u slap synrai uba biang ; u la theh ïa u slap tlang na ka bynta jong phi bad ïa u slap pyrem kumba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Then measured he the porch of the gate , eight cubits  ; and the posts thereof , two cubits  ; and the porch of the gate was inward .
translation.kha: U la thew ïa kane ka kamra bad u la lap ba ka jylliew saw mitar shapoh . Ka pynlong ka tduh jong ka lynti rung kaba jan tam sha ka Templ bad sha bakut jong ka , ki kynroh ki rben shi mitar .

translation.en: And blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair ,
translation.kha: ka linen kaba ni ; u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; ka jaiñ ba la suh da u shñiuh blang ;

translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the  Lord  : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te u Jehoïada u shim ïa ka synduk , u ksam thliew ha ka jingtap , bad u buh ïa ka synduk hajan ka duwan , ha ka phang kamon haba rung sha ka Templ . Ki lyngdoh kiba dei treikam ha ka jaka rung ki thep ha ka synduk ïa ka pisa baroh kaba la ai da ki nongwan mane .

translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman , which have committed that wicked thing , unto thy gates , even that man or that woman , and shalt stone them with stones , till they die .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kaba shisha ba kum kata ka kam bymman ka la jia ha Israel , ïalam ïa kita ki briew shabar ka khyrdop shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap .

translation.en: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days , and say unto him , I profess this day unto the  Lord  thy God , that I am come unto the country which the  Lord  sware unto our fathers for to give us .
translation.kha: Leit sha u lyngdoh uba dei peit kam ha kata ka por , bad ong ha u , ‘ Nga pynbna mynta ka sngi ha U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ba nga la wan rung ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ban ai ha ngi .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  appointed a set time , saying , To morrow the  Lord  shall do this thing in the land .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la buh ïa ka sngi kaba la shai kum ka por ha kaba ngan leh ïa kane .’

translation.en: And as he spake , a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him : and he went in , and sat down to meat .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren , u Pharisi u la khot sngewbha ïa u ban ïabam bad u ; kumta u la leit shapoh bad u la shong ban bam .

translation.en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses , so do these also resist the truth : men of corrupt minds , reprobate concerning the faith .
translation.kha: Kumba u Jannes bad u Jambres ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Moses , kumta ruh kine ki briew ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha — ki briew kiba ki jingmut jong ki kim treikam bad kiba la shahjop ha ka jingngeit .

translation.en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them  ; and the desert shall rejoice , and blossom as the rose .
translation.kha: Ka ri shyiap kan shadkmen , bad ki syntiew kin phuh ha ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: But the Pharisees said , He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi ki la ong ,  U dei u rangbah jong ki ksuid uba ai ha u ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid .

translation.en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord , that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngi hikai ïa phi mynta ka long ka jinghikai jong U Trai : Ma ngi kiba dang im ha ka sngi ba U Trai u wan , ngin ym leit ha shuwa jong kito kiba la ïap .

translation.en: Rejoice in the  Lord  , ye righteous  ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .
translation.kha: Ko phi kiba hok baroh to lehkmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ! To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Blei uba khuid u la leh , bad to ainguh ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come , that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim , and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount , and he before them .
translation.kha: Haba u poi hangta ha ka ri lum ki Ephraim , u la put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki paid Israel sha ka thma ; nangta u la ïalam ïa ki arsut na ki lumrit .

translation.en: And Moses went out , and told the people the words of the  Lord  , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them round about the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mihnoh bad ïathuh ha uta u paidbah ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ong . U la lumlang hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam bad u la buh ïa ki sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And the families of the children of Kohath , the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath , even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki longïing jong ka kur Kohath ki ïoh katto katne ki nongbah na ka jaka jong ki Ephraim .

translation.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth , the Spirit , and the water , and the blood : and these three agree in one .
translation.kha: Ki don lai ki sakhi : U Mynsiem , ka um bad ka snam ; bad kine baroh lai ki ai ïa kajuh ka jingphla .

translation.en: And all things , whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer , believing , ye shall receive .
translation.kha: Lada phi ngeit , phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan ha ka jingduwai .

translation.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border : wherefore Israel turned away from him .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki Edom kim shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka hima jong ki , ki Israel ki la phai noh bad ïaid na kawei pat ka lynti .

translation.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow  ; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself : neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself .
translation.kha: Ki nongsiatkhnam kin ym lah ïeng ha la ki jaka ïeng , ki nongmareh kiba stet kin ym lah lait , bad ki nongshong kulai kin ym lah ban pyllait ïa la ka jong ka jingim .

translation.en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit , and saith ,  Why doth this generation seek after a sign ? verily I say unto you , There shall no sign be given unto this generation .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ud jylliew bad u la ong ,  Balei ba ki briew mynta ki kwah ban ïohi kambah ? Em , nga ong ïa phi ! Yn ym ai kum kata ka jingpynshisha ha kine ki briew !

translation.en: And when we had sailed slowly many days , and scarce were come over against Cnidus , the wind not suffering us , we sailed under Crete , over against Salmone  ;
translation.kha: Ngi la ïaid suki bun sngi , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw , khatduh ngi la poi harud jong ka shnong Knidos . Ka lyer kam ailad shuh ïa ngi ban ïaid sha khmat ha kata ka liang , kumta ngi la ïaid arsut na ka liang kaba kah lyer jong ka Krit , da kaba ïaid najan ka Salmone .

translation.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote upon it a writing , like to the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng da ka ksiar nylla , kaba long ka dak kaba khuid jong ka jingpynkyntang , bad ki thoh ha ka ,  La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth–el in mount Ephraim : and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment .
translation.kha: Ka ju shong hapoh uwei u Dieng Tlai hapdeng ka Ramah bad ka Bethel ha ka ri lum Ephraim , bad ki paid Israel ki ju leit hangta na ka bynta ki jingbishar jong ka .

translation.en: See , I have set before thee this day life and good , and death and evil  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi nga ai ba phin jied napdeng kaba bha bad kaba sniew , napdeng ka jingim bad ka jingïap .

translation.en: And they said unto him , From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the  Lord  thy God : for we have heard the fame of him , and all that he did in Egypt ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïathuh ha u ïa kane ka khana :  Bah , ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , namar ngi la ïohsngew shaphang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la leh ha Ijipt

translation.en: And the name of Saul s wife was Ahinoam , the daughter of Ahimaaz : and the name of the captain of his host was Abner , the son of Ner , Saul s uncle .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , ka khun jong u Ahimaas ; u rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u , u dei u Abner , u bakha jong u , u khun jong u Ner u kñi jong u .

translation.en: The king of Taanach , one  ; the king of Megiddo , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo ,

translation.en: Remember , I beseech thee , the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses , saying , If ye transgress , I will scatter you abroad among the nations :
translation.kha: To kynmaw mynta kaei kaba me la ong ha u Moses : ‘ Lada ma phi ki briew ka Israel phin ym ïaineh ha nga , ngan pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng kiwei ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings , and not one of them is forgotten before God ?
translation.kha: Hato ym dei ba ïa ki san tylli ki sim ïing la die tang ar pisa ? Pynban ym don kawei ruh ka sim ïing ïa kaba la klet noh da U Blei .

translation.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law .
translation.kha: Haba nga ïohi ïa ki bymman ba ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong me , nga la dap da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , That he shall make him ruler over all his goods .
translation.kha: Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u baroh .

translation.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar  ; it shall never go out .
translation.kha: Ka ding ka dei ban ïai meh lynter halor ka duwan bad ym dei ban shah ba kan lip noh .

translation.en: The law and the prophets were until John : since that time the kingdom of God is preached , and every man presseth into it .
translation.kha: Ka Hukum u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki treikam haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ; naduh kata ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei la ïai ïathuh , bad uwei pa uwei u bsut jubor shapoh .

translation.en: And if Satan cast out Satan , he is divided against himself  ; how shall then his kingdom stand ?
translation.kha: Kumta lada kawei ka kynhun ka ïaleh ïa kawei pat ka kynhun hapoh ka hima jong u Soitan , kane ka mut ba ka la da ïaphiah ha ki kynhun bad shen kan sa khyllem ha ka jingpra !

translation.en: And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .
translation.kha: Hangta hi u la lah ban imat pat , bad u la bud ïa U Jisu , da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude , and as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of mighty thunderings , saying , Alleluia : for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum u paid uba bun , kum ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyrhuh jong ka kshaid , kum ki jingtied jam jong u pyrthat . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Naba U Trai , U Blei Badonbor Baroh jong ngi , u long U Syiem !

translation.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith , and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ :
translation.kha: Haduh ngi baroh ngin wan ha ka jingtylli jong ka jingneit bad ha ka jingtip jong ngi ïa U Khun U Blei ; ngin long ki briew kiba rangbah bha , kiba kot shaduh ka rynïeng ka jinglong rangbah pura U Khrist .

translation.en: And when they had blindfolded him , they struck him on the face , and asked him , saying , Prophesy , who is it that smote thee ?
translation.kha: Ki la teh matlah ïa u bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Mano ba tied ïa me ? To antad !

translation.en: And when they had set the people , even all the host that was on the north of the city , and their liers in wait on the west of the city , Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley .
translation.kha: Ïa ki shipai la pynbeit na ka bynta ka thma bad ka jaka sher dara kaba shatei jong ka nongbah , bad ïa kiba sah na ki rangbah sha ka phang sepngi . U Joshua u sahmiet ha ka them .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynim ïa nga bad u la ai bor ïa nga , ba nga la lah ban ïalap ïa ka gospel , bad ba ki Jentil baroh kin ïohsngew ; U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And of Levi he said , Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one , whom thou didst prove at Massah , and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah  ;
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Lebi u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpaw ïa la ka mon da u Urim bad u Thummim   Lyngba ki Lebi , ki shakri kiba ïaineh jong me . Me la tynjuh ïa ki ha Massah , Bad me la phrang ïa ki ha ki um ka Meribah .

translation.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the  Lord  : we have blessed you out of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! Na ka Templ jong U  Trai  ngi kyrkhu ïa me .

translation.en: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen , and they shall possess their houses : I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease  ; and their holy places shall be defiled .
translation.kha: Ngan wanrah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sniew tam hangne bad ailad ïa ki ban shimti ïa ki ïing jong phi . Ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam jong phi kin duh noh ïa la ka jingsngewskhem ynda nga shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin pynjakhlia ïa ki jaka ha kaba phi mane .

translation.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward , they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben , and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad , and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .
translation.kha: Ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ha ka padun ri shyiap sha mihngi jong ka Jerikho , ki jied ïa ka Beser kaba ha ka jaka ki jait Reuben , ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead ha ka jaka ki jait Gad ; bad ïa ka Golan ha Bashan ha ka jaka ki jait Manasseh .

translation.en: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz .
translation.kha: U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u thom beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh shi lynter ka jingsynshar u Jehoahas ,

translation.en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria , and said , What do these feeble Jews ? will they fortify themselves ? will they sacrifice ? will they make an end in a day ? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?
translation.kha: Ha khmat ki paralok jong u bad ki shipai Samaria u ong ,  Kaei , kine ki Jiw shem-lanot , ki tharai ba ki leh ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba da ka jingkñia jingainguh ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka shi sngi ? Hato ki lah ban pynlong ïa ki maw jingtei na ki kynton jong ki synrum ba la ing ?

translation.en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , the son of Reuben : how the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their households , and their tents , and all the substance that was in their possession , in the midst of all Israel :
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw aïu u la leh ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun u Eliab uba na ka jait Reuben . Hangta ha khmat jong phi baroh , ka khyndew ka ang bad ka nguid ïa ki lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ïa ki ïingjaiñ , ki shakri , bad ki jingri jong ki baroh .

translation.en: For our conversation is in heaven ; from whence also we look for the Saviour , the Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ma ngi pynban , ngi long ki traishnong jong ka bneng , bad ngi ïa-ap hir hir ïa U Nongpynim , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ban wan na bneng .

translation.en: And the flax and the barley was smitten : for the barley was in the ear , and the flax was bolled .
translation.kha: U  saihon bad u barli ki la duh khoit , namar u barli u la ih bad u  saihon pat u dang shylluit .

translation.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man : and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mynjur ban shong ban sah noh hangta , bad u Jethro ruh u pynshongkurim ïa u bad ka Sipporah ka khun jong u kaba la kha khun shynrang ïa u Moses .

translation.en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her .”
translation.kha: Wat la phi don jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih pat “U Abraham u ngeit ba ka tnga jongu kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule “ba u Abraham u sngew sih bad iam namar jongka .”

translation.en: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the  Lord  which he did .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , phi dei kito kiba la ïohi ïa kine ki kambah baroh kiba U  Trai  u la leh .

translation.en: Ho , every one that thirsteth , come ye to the waters , and he that hath no money  ; come ye , buy , and eat  ; yea , come , buy wine and milk without money and without price .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To wan , phi kiba sliang — hangne ka don ka um ! To wan , phi ki bym don pisa — thied ïa u kew bad bam ! To wan ! Thied ïa ka waiñ bad ka dud — phin ym hap siew ei ei !

translation.en: And his servants said unto him , Behold now , we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings : let us , I pray thee , put sackcloth on our loins , and ropes upon our heads , and go out to the king of Israel : peradventure he will save thy life .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki leit sha u bad ki ong ,  Ngi ïohsngew ba ki syiem Israel ki long kiba isynei .
