Ai jingbit ïa ngi ba ngin leit sha u syiem jong ka Israel ryngkat bad ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ki syngkai jong ngi bad ki tyllai sawdong ki ryndang jong ngi , bad lehse un pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .
translation.kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki long tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam biang .

translation.en: Draw nigh to God , and he will draw nigh to you . Cleanse your hands , ye sinners  ; and purify your hearts , ye double minded .
translation.kha: To wan hajan U Blei , bad un wan hajan jong phi . To sait ïa la ki kti , ko phi ki nongpop ! To pynkhuid ïa la ki dohnud , phi kiba arsap !

translation.en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim , and were sojourners there until this day . )
translation.kha: Ki traishnong jong ka ki la phet sha Gittaim , ha kaba ki la shong la sah naduh kata ka por . )

translation.en: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests , which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities , in every several city , the men that were expressed by name , to give portions to all the males among the priests , and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites .
translation.kha: Napdeng ki lyngdoh kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew u Aaron , lane ha ki jaka phlang kiba dei jong kine ki nongbah , la don ki rangbah ba kitkhia ban sam ïa ka jingbam sha ki shynrang baroh ha ka longïing ki lyngdoh bad sha uwei pa uwei uba don kyrteng ha ka kur ki Lebi .

translation.en: Notwithstanding ye have well done , that ye did communicate with my affliction .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka long kaba bha shibun ïa phi ban ïarap ïa nga ha ki jingjynjar jong nga .

translation.en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow , that my days should be consumed with shame ?
translation.kha: Balei ba la kha ïa nga ? Hato kan dei tang ban ïoh ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih , ban pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga ha ka jingjahburom ?

translation.en: How is the gold become dim ! how is the most fine gold changed ! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street .
translation.kha: Ka ksiar baphyrnai jong ngi ka la jngut ; ki maw jong ka Templ ki don ha ka jingsaphred ha ki lynti bah .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz , and all that he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoahas u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And Moses charged the people the same day , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha ki paid Israel ,

translation.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Moab , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And Zacchaeus stood , and said unto the Lord  ; Behold , Lord , the half of my goods I give to the poor  ; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation , I restore him fourfold .
translation.kha: U Sakhaïos u la ïeng joit bad u la ong ha U Trai ,  To shahshkor , kynrad ! ngan ai shiteng na ki jingdon jingem jong nga ha kiba duk , bad lada nga la shukor ïano ïano , ngan siew pat ïa u sa saw shah .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that one told Joseph , Behold , thy father is sick : and he took with him his two sons , Manasseh and Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , la ïathuh ha u Joseph ba u kpa jong u , u pang . Kumta u ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ar ngut , u Manasseh bad u Ephraim , ban ïaleit khmih ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , What shall we do unto thee , that the sea may be calm unto us ? for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous .
translation.kha: Ka  erïong ka la nang jur ha kata ka por , kumta ki maji ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ïa me ban pynsangeh ïa ka  erïong ?

translation.en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them , saying ,  Be of good cheer  ; it is I  ; be not afraid .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ha ki shisyndon .  To long shlur !  u la ong .  Dei ma nga . To wat sheptieng !

translation.en: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords , and drank wine before the thousand .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet u syiem Belshassar u la khot sngewbha shihajar ngut ki rangbah donburom sha ka jingkhawai kaba khraw , bad ki la ïadih waiñ lang .

translation.en: She seeketh wool , and flax , and worketh willingly with her hands .
translation.kha: Ka trei smat ïa lade ban thir  saiwul bad thain jaiñ linen .

translation.en: For I am a man under authority , having soldiers under me : and I say to this man , Go , and he goeth  ; and to another , Come , and he cometh  ; and to my servant , Do this , and he doeth it .
translation.kha: Ma nga ruh , nga long u briew hapoh ka iktiar jong ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kham halor , bad nga don ruh ki shipai hapoh jong nga . Nga hukum ïa une uwei , ‘ Khie leit !’ bad u leit ; bad nga hukum ïa utai uwei , ‘ Ale !’ bad u wan ; bad nga hukum ïa u mraw jong nga , ‘ Leh ïa kane !’ bad u leh ïa kata .

translation.en: They wrote his thoughts, not their own .
translation.kha: Ki thoh ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong U Blei , ym ïa la ki jong .

translation.en: But in this will we consent unto you : If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised  ;
translation.kha: Ngin mynjur tang ha kane : ba phin long kum ma ngi da kaba ki shynrang jong phi baroh kin shah otsher .

translation.en: And when Jacob saw them , he said , This is God s host : and he called the name of that place Mahanaim .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki , u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jaka sher dara jong U Blei  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Mahanaim .

translation.en: But when the fulness of the time was come , God sent forth his Son , made of a woman , made under the law ,
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka ïa kaba biang ka la poi , U Blei u la phah ïa la U Khun .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , namar haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u , u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: Others said , This is the Christ . But some said , Shall Christ come out of Galilee ?
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U dei U Messaïah !  Hynrei kiwei ki la ong ,  U Messaïah un ym wan na Galilaïa ?

translation.en: The sons also of Jediael  ; Bilhan : and the sons of Bilhan  ; Jeush , and Benjamin , and Ehud , and Chenaanah , and Zethan , and Tharshish , and Ahishahar .
translation.kha: U Jediael u don uwei u khun , u Bilhan , bad u Bilhan u don hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeush , u Benjamin , u Ehud , u Khenaanah , u Sethan , u Tarshish , bad u Ahishahar .

translation.en: Then they sought to take him : but no man laid hands on him , because his hour was not yet come .
translation.kha: Te ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u , hynrei ym don uba la ktah kti ïa u , namar ba ka kynta jong u kam pat poi .

translation.en: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
translation.kha: Bad ïa uno uno u dieng u bym pynmih u soh uba bha la ju khet noh bad bret hapoh ka ding .

translation.en: Say not thou , What is the cause that the former days were better than these ? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this .
translation.kha: Wat ju ong ,  O ! balei mo kiei kiei ki kham bha shibun ha ki sngi mynbarim ?  Kam long ka jingkylli kaba shemphang .

translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Behold , I die : but God shall be with you , and bring you again unto the land of your fathers .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Kumba phi ïohi , nga la jan ïap , hynrei U Blei un don ryngkat bad me , bad un sa ïalam pat ïa me sha ka ri ki kpa tymmen jong me .

translation.en: So they went , and made the sepulchre sure , sealing the stone , and setting a watch .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynskhem ïa ka jingtep da kaba buh ïa ka muhor halor u maw bad buh ïa ki nongap phira ban ap .

translation.en: And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .
translation.kha: U thiah mynmiet , u khie bad ha ka por mynsngi , bad ha baroh kata ka por ki symbai ki speh bad ki nang san . Pynban um tip kumno kane ka jia .

translation.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban shong dara ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ shaphang mihngi . Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam niam baroh kiba dei ban pyndep ha ka Jaka Kyntang na ka bynta ki Israel . Uno uno uwei pat uba pyrshang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap .

translation.en: And will send unto Babylon fanners , that shall fan her , and shall empty her land : for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki nongwei ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia kum ka lyer kaba pynher noh ïa u phlangïap . Haba kata ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot ka wan , kin tur ïaleh na baroh sawdong bad kin ieh syllen ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return , and will build them , as at the first .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Judah bad Israel kiba roi kyrhai , bad ngan pynlong pat ïa ki kumba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Therefore did my heart rejoice , and my tongue was glad  ; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope :
translation.kha: Bad kumta la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen , bad ki kyntien jong nga ki dap da ka jingkmen . Bad ma nga , la nga long tang u briew , ngan ym khuslai ha ka jingkyrmen ,

translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Go down to thy house , and wash thy feet . And Uriah departed out of the king s house , and there followed him a mess of meat from the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Uriah ,  Khie leit sha la ïing bad pynjahthait katto katne .  U Uriah u la mih , bad u Dabid u la phah ka jingai sngewbha sha ïing jong u .

translation.en: And the name of the Midianite woman that was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur  ; he was head over a people , and of a chief house in Midian .
translation.kha: Ka kyrteng jong kata ka kynthei ka dei ka Kosbi . U Sur , u kpa jong ka u long u rangbah bahakhlieh jong kawei ka kynhun ki jait Midian .

translation.en: And it came to pass at noon , that Elijah mocked them , and said , Cry aloud : for he is a god  ; either he is talking , or he is pursuing , or he is in a journey , or peradventure he sleepeth , and must be awaked .
translation.kha: Ynda la dap shiteng sngi u Elijah u la sdang ban kren biria ïa ki :  Duwai kham jam ! U dei u blei ! Lehse u dang phohsniew lane u dang leit shabar lane lehse u dang leit jingleit ! Lane lehse u dang ïohthiah , phin hap ban kyrsiew ïa u !

translation.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night , and said , Rise up , and get you forth from among my people , both ye and the children of Israel  ; and go , serve the  Lord  , as ye have said .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet , u Pharaoh u la phah khot mar mar ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ,  Khie mihnoh na ka ri jong nga , ma phi bad ki Israel ! Khie leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  kumba phi la pan .

translation.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit , even so it is now .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u khun uba la kha ha ka rukom briew u la pynshitom beiñ ïa uta uba la kha namar U Mynsiem U Blei ; bad ka long kumjuh mynta .

translation.en: And he called it Shebah : therefore the name of the city is Beer–sheba unto this day .
translation.kha: U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri  Ka Jingsmai .  Dei kumta ba ka shnong Beersheba ka la ïoh ïa la ka kyrteng .

translation.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph s house  ; for he was yet there : and they fell before him on the ground .
translation.kha: Haba u Judah bad ki hynmen ki para jong u ki la wan sha ïing u Joseph , ki shem ba u dang don hi hangta .

translation.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge : but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sian ki sngap jar ïa kaei kaba ki tip , hynrei kiba mutlop ki thad ïa la ka jingbieit .

translation.en: Moreover it is required in stewards , that a man be found faithful .
translation.kha: Kawei kaba donkam ïa kum uta u shakri ka long ba un long uba ïaineh ha u kynrad jong u .

translation.en: In those days there was no king in Israel : and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in  ; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ym don syiem ha Israel . Ha kita ki sngi ki Dan ki dang wad jaka la ka jong ban shong ban sah namar kim pat shym la ïoh la ka jaka hapdeng ki jait Israel .

translation.en: Then call thou , and I will answer : or let me speak , and answer thou me .
translation.kha: To kren nyngkong , A Blei , bad ngan jubab . Lane to shah ngan kren , bad to jubab ïa nga .

translation.en: Rooted and built up in him , and stablished in the faith , as ye have been taught , abounding therein with thanksgiving .
translation.kha: Pynngam jylliew ïa ki nongrim jong phi ha u , to tei ïa ka jingim jong phi halor jong u , bad to nang kham khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit jong phi , kumba la hikai ïa phi . Bad to long kiba la pyndap da ka jingainguh .

translation.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them , and his hands waxed feeble : anguish took hold of him , and pangs as of a woman in travail .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , bad ki kti jong u ki noh kyrwep . U don ha ka jinglyng-a , da ka jingpang kum ka briew kaba suh kha .

translation.en: My son , despise not the chastening of the  Lord   ; neither be weary of his correction :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , haba U  Trai  u pynbeit ïa phi , da shahshkor bha , bad shim ïa ka kum ka jingmaham .

translation.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women , together with the daughter of Pharaoh , women of the Moabites , Ammonites , Edomites , Zidonians , and Hittites  ;
translation.kha: U Solomon u la ieit ïa kiba bun ki kynthei nongwei . Nalor ka khun u syiem ka ri Ijipt , u la shongkurim ruh ïa ki kynthei nong Hit bad ki kynthei nong Moab , Ammon , Edom bad Sidon .

translation.en: As for the living bird , he shall take it , and the cedar wood , and the scarlet , and the hyssop , and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water :
translation.kha: Un shim sa ïa kawei pat ka sim , ïa u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , ïa u  saiwul uba saw , bad ïa u tnat Hissop , bad un wieh lang ïa ki ha ka snam jong kata ka sim kaba u la pynïap .

translation.en: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part  ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .
translation.kha: Ynda haba ki shipai ki la lah sahnarphna ïa U Jisu , ki la ïashim ïa ki jaiñ jong u bad ki la ïabynta ha ki saw bynta , kawei ka bynta ïa uwei uwei u shipai . Ki la ïashim ruh ïa ka jaiñkup , ïa kaba la pynlong tang na kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain khlem kano kano ka jingsuh ha ka .

translation.en: He shall put on the holy linen coat , and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh , and shall be girded with a linen girdle , and with the linen mitre shall he be attired : these are holy garments  ; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water , and so put them on .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki jinghikai shuwa ba u Aaron un rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , u dei ban da sum , bad nangta un kup ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh ; ka sopti linen , ka patlun lyngkot , ka jingpanpoh , bad ka jaiñspong .

translation.en: For verily I say unto you , That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see , and have not seen them  ; and to hear those things which ye hear , and have not heard them .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba bun ki nongïathuhlypa bad bun ki briew ki jong U Blei ki la kwah shikatdei eh ban ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi , hynrei kim lah ïohi , bad ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew , hynrei kim shym la lah ïohsngew .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years , wherein Solomon had built the house of the  Lord  , and his own house ,
translation.kha: Ka la shim por arphew snem ïa u Solomon ban tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .

translation.en: Thou believest that there is one God  ; thou doest well : the devils also believe , and tremble .
translation.kha: Hato phi ngeit ba don tang uwei U Blei ? Kata ka bha ! Ki ksuid ruh ki ngeit — bad ki kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng !

translation.en: And he beheld them , and said ,  What is this then that is written , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih sha ki bad u la kylli ,  Aïu , te , kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kit jingmut ?   ‘ U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .’

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , and make thereto a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla , bad pynpur da ka ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: Neither pray I for these alone , but for them also which shall believe on me through their word  ;
translation.kha: Nga duwai ym tang na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei na ka bynta kito ruh kiba ngeit ha nga namar ka khubor jong ki .

translation.en: And Terah lived seventy years , and begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Terah u la dap hynñiewphew snem ka rta , u la long u kpa jong u Abram , u Nahor , bad u Haran .

translation.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha u ong ha kawei pat ka bynta :   ‘ Men ym shah ïa u shakri baneh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtep .’

translation.en: Remember me , O my God , concerning this , and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for the offices thereof .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei jong nga , ïa baroh kine kiei kiei kiba nga la leh na ka bynta ka Templ jong me bad ka jingmane jong ka .

translation.en: And they laughed him to scorn , knowing that she was dead .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la rkhie ïa u , namar ki la tip ba ka la ïap .

translation.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly , and gave the sense , and caused them to understand the reading .
translation.kha: Ki ai ka jingpynkylla da ka ktien bad ki batai ïa ka khnang ba u paidbah u lah ban sngewthuh ïa ka .

translation.en: Whom I have sent again : thou therefore receive him , that is , mine own bowels :
translation.kha: Nga phah pat sha me ïa u mynta , lem bad u ka long lem ka dohnud jong nga .

translation.en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet s reward  ; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man s reward .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pdiang ïa u nonglamktien jong U Blei namar ba u long u nonglamktien jong U Blei , un ïoh bynta ha ka bainong jong u . Bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa u briew uba bha namar ba u long uba bha , un ïoh bynta ha ka bainong jong u .

translation.en: So I got a girdle according to the word of the  Lord  , and put it on my loins .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la thied ïa ki bad phong ïa ki .

translation.en: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John , all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon s , greatly wondering .
translation.kha: Katba uta u briew u don ryngkat bad u Petros bad u Ïoannis ha ka baranda u Solomon , kumba la khot ïa ka , ki paidbah ki la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la mareh sha ki .

translation.en: There is a generation , O how lofty are their eyes ! and their eyelids are lifted up .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba ki long kiba bha palat — oh , katno ka jingbha ki pyrkhat ba ki long !

translation.en: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart  ; and they defile the man .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiei kiei kiba mihnoh shabar na ka shyntur ki wan na ka dohnud , bad kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: We have shot at them  ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon , and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which reacheth unto Medeba .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki la shah pynjot , Shi lynter naduh Heshbon haduh Dibon , Naduh Nashim haduh Nophah , hajan ka Medeba .

translation.en: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates , whatsoever thy soul lusteth after , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee : the unclean and the clean may eat thereof , as of the roebuck , and as of the hart .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , phi lah ban pynïap bad bam ïa ki jingri jong phi kat shaba phi shong phi sah . Phi lah ban bam kat kumba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi . Baroh na phi , kiba khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .

translation.en: And they mourned , and wept , and fasted until even , for Saul , and for Jonathan his son , and for the people of the  Lord  , and for the house of Israel  ; because they were fallen by the sword .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewsih kthang , ki ïambriew , bad ki la shahjingit haduh janmiet na ka bynta u Saul bad u Jonathan bad na ka bynta ki Israel , ki briew jong U  Trai  , namar bun bah ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramath–mizpeh , and Betonim  ; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir  ;
translation.kha: ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Heshbon haduh Ramath Mispeh bad Betonim , naduh Mahanaim haduh ka khappud jong ka Lodebar .

translation.en: And Elon , and Timnah , and Ekron ,
translation.kha: ka Elon , ka Timnah , ka Ekron ,

translation.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod , and shalt deliver his soul from hell .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: And there ye shall serve gods , the work of men s hands , wood and stone , which neither see , nor hear , nor eat , nor smell .
translation.kha: Hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei dieng bad ki blei maw ïa kiba la thaw da ka kti briew , ki bym lah ban ïohi lane ban ïohsngew , ban bam lane ban sma .

translation.en: Now the earth is divided up into many countries .
translation.kha: Ia ka pyrthei mynta la pynïakhlad ha kiba bun tylli ki ri .

translation.en: That which dieth of itself , or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Um bit ban bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba shu ïap hi , lane uba la shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw ; kata kan pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas .
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha khmat bad ki la ap ïa ngi ha Troas .

translation.en: But if he wash them not , nor bathe his flesh  ; then he shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada um leh kumta , un kit hi ïa la ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah , even as the heart of one man  ; so that they sent this word unto the king , Return thou , and all thy servants .
translation.kha: Ki kyntien jong u Dabid ki la pynïoh ïa ka jingshaniah tylli jong baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , bad ki la phah ktien sha u ban wan phai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .

translation.en: For thou art my hope , O Lord  God  : thou art my trust from my youth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Nongsynshar , nga buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me ; nga la shaniah ha me naduh ba nga dang samla .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians , and from the Amorites , from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab ,  Ki Ijipt , ki Amor , ki Ammon , ki Philistia

translation.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar  ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .
translation.kha: Nga la ithuh ba kine ki long kijuh ki jingthaw ba-im ba nga la ïohi kiba shong hapoh U Blei ki Israel harud ka wah Khebar .

translation.en: And his power shall be mighty , but not by his own power : and he shall destroy wonderfully , and shall prosper , and practise , and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people .
translation.kha: Un long uba khlaiñ — hynrei ym da ka bor jong u hi . Un pynlong ka jingpynjot bashyrkhei bad un jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh . Un wallam ka jingjot halor ki rangbah kiba donbor bad halor ki briew jong U Blei hi .

translation.en: Is Ephraim my dear son ? is he a pleasant child ? for since I spake against him , I do earnestly remember him still : therefore my bowels are troubled for him  ; I will surely have mercy upon him , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , phi long u khun ba-ieit eh jong nga , u khun uba nga ieit tam . Man ba nga ong ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , nga pyrkhat shaphang jong phi da ka jingieit . Ka dohnud jong nga ka leit sha phi ; ngan isynei ïa phi .

translation.en: And Ben–hadad sent unto him , and said , The gods do so unto me , and more also , if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam bun ki rangbah ban pynjot ïa kane ka nongbah jong me bad ban rah mar shi kham ka khyndew ha ki kti jong ki . Ai ba ki blei kin shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam leh kumta !

translation.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee ? is there any secret thing with thee ?
translation.kha: U Blei u tyrwa ha me ïa ka jingpyntngen ; balei ba me dang kyntait ïa ka ? Ngi la ïakren bad u ha ki ktien bajai jai .

translation.en: So David hid himself in the field : and when the new moon was come , the king sat him down to eat meat .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit rieh ïa lade ha ki bri . Ha ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , u syiem Saul u wan shong bam ,

translation.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only , but also in power , and in the Holy Ghost , and in much assurance ; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake .
translation.kha: Naba ngi la wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi , ym tang ha ki ktien , hynrei ruh ha ka bor bad ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad da ka jingsngewthuh pura ïa ka jingshisha jong ka . Phi tip kumno ngi la im mynba ngi la don bad phi ; ka la long na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Is he well ? And they said , He is well : and , behold , Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep .
translation.kha: Hato u shait u khlaiñ ?  u kylli biang .  U shait u khlaiñ ,  ki jubab .  Khmih , hangne ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ka wan lem bad ki kynhun langbrot jong u .

translation.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit , nor of uncleanness , nor in guile :
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ïa phi kam dei kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingbakla lane ha ki jingthmu bymkhuid , lymne ba ngi pyrshang ban shukor ïano ïano .

translation.en: But flesh with the life thereof , which is the blood thereof , shall ye not eat .
translation.kha: Kawei kaba phim dei ban bam ka long ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka ; nga khang pyrshah ïa kane namar ba ka jingim ka don ha ka snam .

translation.en: Examine yourselves , whether ye be in the faith ; prove your own selves . Know ye not your own selves , how that Jesus Christ is in you , except ye be reprobates ?
translation.kha: To tynjuh ïa lade bad bishar hi da lade , ban shem la phi im ne em ha ka jingngeit . Hato da shisha phi tip ba U Khrist Jisu u don ha phi ? — lymda phi la long kiba la shahjop noh .

translation.en: With three rows of great stones , and a row of new timber : and let the expenses be given out of the king s house :
translation.kha: Ïa ki kynroh dei ban tei da shi syrtap ka dieng halor man ki lai syrtap ki maw . Ïa baroh ki jingpynlut pynsep dei ban siew na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem .

translation.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day : for he thought , Something hath befallen him , he is not clean  ; surely he is not clean .
translation.kha: Ka jaka shong u Dabid ka thylli , hynrei u Saul um shym ong ei ei ha kata ka sngi , namar u pyrkhat ,  Kaei re kaei ka la jia ïa u , bad um shym long uba bit kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: And Saul said , Draw ye near hither , all the chief of the people : and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day .
translation.kha: Te u Saul u ong ha ki nongïalam jong u paidbah ,  Ale hangne bad wad ka pop aïu la leh ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: When they were past the first and the second ward , they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city  ; which opened to them of his own accord : and they went out , and passed on through one street  ; and forthwith the angel departed from him .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid najan ka jaka ap phira kaba nyngkong bad nangta ïa kaba ar , bad ki la poi khatduh ha ka khyrdop nar kaba lam sha ka nongbah . Ka khyrdop ka la plie hi na ka bynta jong ki , bad ki la mih shabar . Ki la ïaid ha ka lynti bah , bad kynsan u angel u la iehnoh ïa u Petros .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will allure her , and bring her into the wilderness , and speak comfortably unto her .
translation.kha: Te ngan leit ïalam biang ïa ka sha ri shyiap ; hangta ngan khroh biang ïa ka da ki ktien ieit .

translation.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth  ; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit  ; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul .
translation.kha: Em ! Ngam lah ban shu sngap jar ! Nga bitar bad nga kthang mynsiem . Nga dei ban kren .

translation.en: And they said , The  Lord  commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel : and my lord was commanded by the  Lord  to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban ïasam ïa ka ri ha ki paid Israel da kaba kynting sbai . U la hukum ruh ïa phi ban ai ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong u para kur jong ngi u Selophehad ha ki khun kynthei jong u .

translation.en: Then king Solomon sware by the  Lord  , saying , God do so to me , and more also , if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u la ai ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ,  To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pynlong ïa u Adonijah ban peiñ da ka jingim jong u namar ba u pan ïa kane !

translation.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them : but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness .
translation.kha: Ka hok ka pyllait ïa kito kiba lehhok , hynrei kito ïa kiba ym lah ban shaniah ki shah riam ha la ka jong ka jingkwah brai hi .

translation.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?
translation.kha: Phi tharai ngam shym kren ei ei hynrei tang ka lyer ; te balei phi jubab ïa ki ktien ka jingkutlad jong nga ?

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  See ye not all these things ? verily I say unto you , There shall not be left here one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  u la ong ,  phi lah ban khmih ïa kine baroh . Nga ong ha phi ïa kane : Yn ym don uwei u maw hangne u ban dang neh ha la ka jaka ; uwei pa uwei na ki un shah pynhap .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , I send thee to the children of Israel , to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me : they and their fathers have transgressed against me , even unto this very day .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ngan phah ïa me sha ki paid Israel . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah bad ki phai lyndet ïa nga bad ki dang ïai pyrshah hi , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la long .

translation.en: And God met Balaam : and he said unto him , I have prepared seven altars , and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram .
translation.kha: bad U Blei u ïakynduh ïa u . U Balaam u ong ha u ,  Nga la tei hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad nga la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei na ki .

translation.en: Which when they had read , they rejoiced for the consolation .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la pule ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingkmen da ka khubor ka jingpynshlur .

translation.en: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together , and appoint themselves one head , and they shall come up out of the land : for great shall be the day of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah bad ki briew ka Israel kin ïasoh lang kawei sa shisien . Kin sa jied tang uwei u nongïalam na ka bynta jong ki , bad sa shisien pat kin sa manbha bad roi kyrhai ha la ka ri . Ho-oid , ka sngi jong ka Jesreel kan long ka sngi kaba khraw !

translation.en: And God saw their works , that they turned from their evil way  ; and God repented of the evil , that he had said that he would do unto them  ; and he did it not .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ; u la ïohi ba ki la iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki . Kumta u la kylla jingmut bad um shym la pynshitom ïa ki kumba u la ong ban leh .

translation.en: Beware of dogs , beware of evil workers , beware of the concision .
translation.kha: To kiar noh na kito kiba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew , na kita ki ksew , kita ki briew kiba pynbor ïa ka ban ot ïa ka met .

translation.en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you ,
translation.kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei , U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , haba ngi duwai na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant , and as a root out of a dry ground : he hath no form nor comeliness  ; and when we shall see him , there is no beauty that we should desire him .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka mon jong U  Trai  ba u shakri jong u un san kum u jingthung uba ksam ïa ki thied ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong . Um don main ne jingitynnat ban pynlong ïa ngi ban peit ïa u . Ym don kano kano kaba ngin ibha ïa u , ym don kano kano ka ban khring ïa ngi sha u .

translation.en: And he answered him to never a word  ; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u kyntait ban jubab wat tang shikyntien , kaba da pynlyngngoh shikatdei eh ïa u lyngskor .

translation.en: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs , that he should bring certain of the children of Israel , and of the king s seed , and of the princes  ;
translation.kha: U syiem u la hukum ïa u Ashpenas , u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh jong u , ban jied napdeng ki nong Israel kiba la shah ringmraw ïa ki katto katne ngut ki samla shynrang na ka longïing syiem bad na ki longïing ki riewkhraw .

translation.en: Nathanael saith unto him , Whence knowest thou me ? Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Before that Philip called thee , when thou wast under the fig tree , I saw thee .
translation.kha: U Nathanael u la kylli ïa u ,  Kumno me ithuh ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ha shuwa ba u Philip un khot ïa me .

translation.en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , for the corn which they bought : and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh s house .
translation.kha: Katba ki nang thied kew , u Joseph u lumlang ïa ka pisa bad u leit ai ïa ki sha ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army . And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field .
translation.kha: Te u la hukum ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban leit na Lakhish sha Jerusalem lem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw ban dawa ba u syiem Hesekaïah u dei ban pyndem . U rangbah synshar u ïeng ha ka surok ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , harud ka nur kaba wanrah um na ka pung kaba haneng .

translation.en: Only then will Jehovah answer your prayers .—Hebrews 11 :6 .
translation.kha: Tang da kumta , U Jehobah un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi .—Hebru 11 :6 .

translation.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver .
translation.kha: Ka jingmut kaba la pynshai bha ka long kum ka dur oh-shrong ksiar ba la pyndait ha ka rupa .

translation.en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God , wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat ?
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kaba khuid bad ba la pynkyntang sha U Blei , katba phi dang ap khmih ïa ka Sngi jong U Blei bad phi leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynlong ïa ka ba kan wan kloi — ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ki bneng yn thang duh noh bad yn pynjot , bad ïa ki metbneng yn sa pynum ha ka jingkhluit .

translation.en: And his deeds , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Josaïah u la leh — ka jingaiti lut jong u sha U  Trai  , ka jingkohnguh jong u ïa ka Hukum , bad ïa ka histori jong u naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut — la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah .

translation.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Edom  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them .
translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga don pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Edom , bad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah Teman . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , bad uwei pa uwei un sngewtriem .

translation.en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers : every man shall be put to death for his own sin .
translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap namar ki kam runar ki khun jong ki , bad ki khun ruh kim dei ban shah pynïap namar ki kam runar ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; u briew u dei ban shah pynïap tang namar ka kam runar jong u hi .

translation.en: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience , I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation , which shall come upon all the world , to try them that dwell upon the earth .
translation.kha: Namar ba pha la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga ban shahshitom , nga ruh ngan ri sumar ïa pha ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar ka ban wan ha ka pyrthei ban tynjuh ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy  ; I will shew them the back , and not the face , in the day of their calamity .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong nga ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki , kum ïa u pui pui ba la beh da ka lyer mihngi . Ngan pynphai ïa la ka ingdong halor jong ki ; ngan ym ïarap ïa ki haba ka jingpynjot ka wan .

translation.en: Making request , if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you .
translation.kha: Nga pan ba U Blei ha ka mon babha jong u ha kaba khatduh un pynlah ïa nga ban wan jngoh ïa phi mynta .

translation.en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride : but the lips of the wise shall preserve them .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingsarong , kiba bieit ki kren shaba palat ; ki ktien jong kiba stad ki ïada ïa ki .

translation.en: And the people saw them departing , and many knew him , and ran afoot thither out of all cities , and outwent them , and came together unto him .
translation.kha: Kumno re kumno , la don bun ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa ki ba ki leit bad ki la tip shisyndon ba ki long kiei ; kumta ki la ïaleit na baroh ki shnong bad mareh na ryngkew bad ki la poi ha ka jaka shuwa ïa U Jisu bad ki synran .

translation.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity  ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?
translation.kha: Ka mon jong phi ban im kan kyrshan ïa phi haba phi pang , hynrei lada phi duh ïa ka , ka jingkyrmen jong phi kaba sah ka la jah noh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , after the year was expired , at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab , and his servants with him , and all Israel  ; and they destroyed the children of Ammon , and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried still at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha ka por jong ka snem haba ki syiem ki ju leit sha ka thma , u Dabid u la phah ïa u Joab lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad ka kynhun shipai Israel ; ki la jop ïa ki Ammon bad ki la kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah . Hynrei u Dabid hi u la sah ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth–el . ( Now the name of the city before was Luz . )
translation.kha: Ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la leit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Bethel , kaba ha kata ka por la khot kyrteng ka Lus . U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki . Ki la phah ïa ki nongsyntiat sha ka nongbah ,

translation.en: This is an international , nonprofit religious organization of people who willingly serve God .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka seng jong ki briew kiba shakri ïa U Blei da la ka mon sngewbha , ka bym don jingïohnong eiei bad ka don ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt not slack to pay it : for the  Lord  thy God will surely require it of thee  ; and it would be sin in thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai kano kano ka jingkular ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynslem ha kaba pyndep ïa ka , U  Trai  un bat ïa ka kular jong phi , bad ka long ka pop ban ym pyndep ïa ka .

translation.en: Bind them upon thy fingers , write them upon the table of thine heart .
translation.kha: sumar ïa ki jinghikai jong nga ha ki por baroh ; thoh ïa ka ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder :
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u rai hangno ba u slap un hap , bad ïa ka lynti ki lyoh ba pynlong pyrthat ;

translation.en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean , and those things , before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un ïalam ïa uta u briew lem bad ïa kita ki jingainguh jong u ha khmat ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague : and , behold , if the scall spread not , and there be in it no yellow hair , and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin  ;
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa kata ka prum ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada kam pat pur lane ym don u shñiuh uba lam stem ha ka , bad kam paw ruh ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka ,

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Neither hath this man sinned , nor his parents : but that the works of God should be made manifest in him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka jingmatlah jong u kam don ei ei bad ki pop jong u ne ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong u . U la long matlah khnang ban ïohi ba ka bor jong U Blei ka trei ha u .

translation.en: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about , so that in the day of the  Lord s  anger none escaped nor remained : those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed .
translation.kha: To pynrem ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki baroh ; to pynshitom ïa ki kumba me la pynshitom ïa nga na ka bynta ki pop jong nga . Nga ud ha ka jingjynjar , bad nga pang ha ka dohnud jong nga .

translation.en: And , behold , there was a great earthquake : for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven , and came and rolled back the stone from the door , and sat upon it .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan la don ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; u angel U Trai u la wan hiar na bneng , u la pyntyllun ïa u maw , bad u la shong halor jong u .

translation.en: But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei baroh u la sngewphylla .  U briew uba kumno une u long ?  ki la ong .  Wat ki lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting : but the substance of a diligent man is precious .
translation.kha: Lada phi long uba jaipdeh , phin ym ïoh da lei lei ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban long hadien , hynrei lada phi trei minot , phin ïoh spah .

translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed , and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out , and who shall turn it back ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane , u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u .

translation.en: And he sent out arrows , and scattered them  ; lightning , and discomfited them .
translation.kha: U siat ïa ki khnam bad u pynsaphriang ïa ki nongshun jong u ; da ka jingthaba ka leilieh u pynher ïa ki .

translation.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the  Lord  : whosoever is of a willing heart , let him bring it , an offering of the  Lord   ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
translation.kha: Wallam ka jingainguh sha U  Trai . Kat uba kwah ban leh ïa kata un wanrah ïa kata ka jingainguh da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong ;

translation.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un mihpaw , da kaba wan ha ki lyoh ha ka bor bakhraw bad ka burom .

translation.en: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names : for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar  ; and to Hananiah , of Shadrach  ; and to Mishael , of Meshach  ; and to Azariah , of Abed–nego .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh u la ai kyrteng thymmai ïa ki : u Belteshassar , u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego .

translation.en: And now , I beseech thee , let the power of my Lord be great , according as thou hast spoken , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko  Trai  , nga kyrpad ïa me , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa la ka bor bad leh kumba me la kular haba me ong ,

translation.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you , to do them , to love the  Lord  your God , to walk in all his ways , and to cleave unto him  ;
translation.kha: Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi : Ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum , bad ïaineh ha u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ahab heard those words , that he rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his flesh , and fasted , and lay in sackcloth , and went softly .
translation.kha: Haba u Elijah u la dep kren , u Ahab u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ , u la law ïa ki bad u phong da ki jaiñ khain . Um treh bam , u thiah ha ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit phai da kaba khuslai bad rit mynsiem .

translation.en: And daily in the temple , and in every house , they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Bad man ka sngi hapoh ka Templ bad ha ki ïing jong ki briew ki ïai bteng ban hikai bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu U Messaïah .

translation.en: And he set captains of war over the people , and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city , and spake comfortably to them , saying ,
translation.kha: U buh ïa baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah hapoh ka jingai hukum ki rangbah shipai bad u hukum ïa ki ban ïalumlang ha ka jaka kaba kylluid ha ka khyrdop ka nongbah .

translation.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord  ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :
translation.kha: Mynta , kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel ha ki sngi ki ban wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong nga ha ki jingmut jong ki , bad ngan thoh ïa ki ha ki dohnud jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad ki kin long u paidlang jong nga .

translation.en: I create the fruit of the lips  ; Peace , peace to him that is far off , and to him that is near , saith the  Lord   ; and I will heal him .
translation.kha: Nga ai jingsuk ïa baroh , ïa kiba hajan bad ïa kiba sha jngai ! Ngan pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace : none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki rangbah jong u Joshua ki la wan phai suk sha u ha ka jaka sher dara ha Makkedah . Ym don uwei ruh u briew ha kata ka ri uba nud ban kren pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the light shall not be clear , nor dark :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh ka jingkhriat lane u thah ,

translation.en: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day , and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men  ; all these drew the sword .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki Benjamin ki wan mih na Gibeah , bad ha kane ka sien ki pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai batbit ka Israel .

translation.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon , and there shall he be until I visit him , saith the  Lord  : though ye fight with the Chaldeans , ye shall not prosper .
translation.kha: Ïa u Sedekaïah yn rah noh sha Babilonia bad un sah hangta haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kaei ban leh ïa u . Wat lada un ïaleh ïa ki nong Babilonia , un ym lah ban jop . Ma nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .
translation.kha: Balei me kylli na nga shaphang kaei kaba bha ?  la jubab U Jisu .  Don tang Uwei uba bha . To sumar ïa ki hukum lada me kwah ban rung sha ka jingim .

translation.en: So I sware in my wrath , They shall not enter into my rest . )
translation.kha: Nga la bitar bad nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait !’

translation.en: And as they came down from the mountain , he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen , till the Son of man were risen from the dead .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lum , U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi , tad haduh ba U Khun U Briew u la mihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And the men , which Moses sent to search the land , who returned , and made all the congregation to murmur against him , by bringing up a slander upon the land ,
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba u Moses u la phah swar ïa ka ri , ki la wanrah ïa ka kaiphod balamler kaba la pynlong ïa u paidbah ban khñium pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac , to thee I will give it , and to thy seed after thee will I give the land .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u Abraham bad ha u Isaak , bad ngan ai ïa ka ruh ha ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me .

translation.en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna , What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor ? And they answered , As thou art , so were they  ; each one resembled the children of a king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u kylli ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ,  Kumno shaphang ki briew kiba phi la pynïap ha Tabor ?  Ki jubab ,  Ki syriem ïa phi — uwei pa uwei na ki u syriem ïa u khun jong u syiem .

translation.en: Whiles they see vanity unto thee , whiles they divine a lie unto thee , to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain , of the wicked , whose day is come , when their iniquity shall have an end .
translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw ba phi ïohi ki long ki bymdei , bad ki jingïathuh lypa ba phi pynlong ki long kiba shukor . Phi long kiba bymman bad kiba sniew , bad ka sngi jong phi ka la wan , ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot kaba kut . Ka waitlam kan hap ha ki ryndang jong phi .

translation.en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the  Lord  on all manner of instruments made of fir wood , even on harps , and on psalteries , and on timbrels , and on cornets , and on cymbals .
translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki Israel baroh ki la ïashad kmen bad ïarwai shitrhem da ka bor baroh ban burom ïa U  Trai . Ki da tem ïa ki duitara , ki jingtem ksai , ki ksing , ki kanjari , bad ki shakuriaw .

translation.en: And I wept much , because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book , neither to look thereon .
translation.kha: Nga la ïamkthang namar ym shym lah ban shem ïa uno uno uba dei hok ban plied ïa ka kot kli lane ban khmih shapoh jong ka .

translation.en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , one ram , seven lambs of the first year  ;
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , when Moses was grown , that he went out unto his brethren , and looked on their burdens : and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew , one of his brethren .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , haba u la rangbah , u Moses u leit jngoh ïa la ki para jait , ki Hebru , bad u ïohi kumno la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . U ïohi ruh ïa uwei u nong Ijipt ba u pynïap ïa uwei u Hebru , u para jait jong u Moses hi .

translation.en: Be ye therefore merciful , as your Father also is merciful .
translation.kha: Long kiba sngewsynei kumba U Kpa jong phi u long uba sngewsynei .

translation.en: When the Almighty was yet with me , when my children were about me  ;
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la long bad nga ha kata ka por , bad ïa nga la ker sawdong da baroh ki khun jong nga .

translation.en: He rebuked the Red sea also , and it was dried up : so he led them through the depths , as through the wilderness .
translation.kha: U la ai hukum ïa ka Duriaw Basaw bad ka rkhiang ; u ïalam ïa ki briew jong u sha shiliang halor ka khyndew ba-rkhiang .

translation.en: And Obed–edom with their brethren , threescore and eight  ; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters :
translation.kha: U Obed Edom u khun jong u Jeduthun bad ki hynriewphew phra ngut ki rangbah jong ka kur jong u kin ïarap ïa ki . Ïa u Hosah bad u Obed Edom la buh ban ap phira ïa ki khyrdop .

translation.en: And they slew every one his man : and the Syrians fled  ; and Israel pursued them : and Ben–hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen .
translation.kha: bad uwei pa uwei u la pynïap ïa u briew uba u ïaleh . Ki nong Syria ki phet ïap , bad ki Israel ki beh kthong , hynrei u Benhadad u la lait im da kaba u shong halor u kulai , ïa kaba la synran da katto katne ngut ki shipai shong kulai .

translation.en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  A  Trai  , U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri ïa me borabor — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba dang sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !

translation.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation , which shall devour the adversaries .
translation.kha: Pynban , kaei kaba dang sah ka long ban ap da ka jingsheptieng ïa ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan bad ïa ka ding kaba klang ka ban sa bam duh ïa kita kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei !

translation.en: Thy bow was made quite naked , according to the oaths of the tribes , even thy word . Selah . Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers .
translation.kha: Me pynkhreh ban pyndonkam ïa la ka ryntieh , me khreh ban siat ïa la ki khnam . Ka leilieh jong me ka pynpait ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: And it was so , that after the  Lord  had spoken these words unto Job , the  Lord  said to Eliphaz the Temanite , My wrath is kindled against thee , and against thy two friends : for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job hath .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U  Trai  u la dep kren ha u Job , U ong ha u Eliphas ,  Nga bitar ïa me bad ïa ki ar ngut ki paralok jong me , namar mem shym kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga , kumba u Job u shakri jong nga u la leh .

translation.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying : and in a trance I saw a vision , A certain vessel descend , as it had been a great sheet , let down from heaven by four corners  ; and it came even to me :
translation.kha: Katba nga dang duwai ha ka nongbah Joppa , nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw . Nga la ïohi ïa kaei re kaei kaba wan hiar na bneng kaba i kum ka jaiñ siang kaba heh ïa kaba la pynhiar na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka , bad ka la sangeh hajan jong nga .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , after the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang , U Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished , the people cried to Pharaoh for bread : and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians , Go unto Joseph  ; what he saith to you , do .
translation.kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt ki la sdang ban kyrduh bam , ki la leit ud sha u syiem ba un ai bam ïa ki . Kumta u la hukum ïa ki ban leit sha u Joseph , bad ban leh kat kaba u ong ïa ki .

translation.en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ , and hath anointed us , is God ;
translation.kha: U dei U Blei hi uba pynlong ïa ngi , ryngkat bad phi , ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist ; u dei U Blei hi da lade uba la pynkyrpang ïa ngi ,

translation.en: Wherefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people with his own blood , suffered without the gate .
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw U Jisu ruh u la ïap shabar ka nongbah , khnang ban pynkhuid ïa u paidlang na ka pop da ka snam jong u hi .

translation.en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate , which shall come with an army , and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north , and shall deal against them , and shall prevail :
translation.kha: Shen hadien kata , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka un long syiem . Un tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem Syria , un rung shapoh ki kut jong ki , bad jop ïa ki .

translation.en: And it was so , when Elijah heard it , that he wrapped his face in his mantle , and went out , and stood in the entering in of the cave . And , behold , there came a voice unto him , and said , What doest thou here , Elijah ?
translation.kha: Haba u Elijah u la ïohsngew ïa ka , u tap ïa la ka khmat da la ka barandi bad u leit ban ïeng ha khmat kata ka krem . Ka sur kaba kren ha u ,  Elijah , me leh aïu hangne ?

translation.en: Peter then denied again : and immediately the cock crew .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ong biang  Em  — bad mar kumta u syiar u la kyn-ih .

translation.en: And the cherubims were lifted up . This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar .
translation.kha: ( Ki long kijuh ki jingthaw kiba nga ïohi harud ka wah Khebar ) .

translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father s brother , thou shalt not approach to his wife : she is thine aunt .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u para u kpa jong me , naba ka dei hi ka kmienah jong me .

translation.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God , God dwelleth in him , and he in God .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynbna ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei , u im ha U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .

translation.en: Behold , here is my daughter a maiden , and his concubine  ; them I will bring out now , and humble ye them , and do with them what seemeth good unto you : but unto this man do not so vile a thing .
translation.kha: Khmih ! Hangne ka don ka tnga kliar jong u bad ka khun jong nga , kaba dang sotti . Ngan wan ïalam ïa ki mynta shabar , bad phi lah ban shim ïa ki . Leh ïa ki katba phi sngewkwah . Hynrei wat leh ïa ka kam bymman ha une u briew !

translation.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions , be not terrified : for these things must first come to pass  ; but the end is not by and by .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki thma bad ki jingïakhih pyrshah bor synshar ; kiba kum kine ki dei ban jia nyngkong , hynrei kim mut ba kaba kut ka la jan .

translation.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands  ; as saith the prophet ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh um shong ha ki ïing ba la tei da ki briew , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u ong ,

translation.en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant ? for thou knowest thy servant .
translation.kha: Aïu ngan ong shuh ha me ! Me tip bha ïa nga , bad pynban me pyndonburom ïa nga , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: So she caught him , and kissed him , and with an impudent face said unto him ,
translation.kha: Ka kynrup trait ïa uta u samla , ka doh ïa u , ka peit shlip ha ki khmat jong u , bad ka ong ,

translation.en: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus , named Ananias  ; and to him said the Lord in a vision ,  Ananias .  And he said , Behold , I am here , Lord .
translation.kha: La don uwei u riewngeit ha Damaskos uba kyrteng u Ananias . U la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Ananias !   Hangne nga don , A Trai ,  u la jubab .

translation.en: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ban rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki ar ngut ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki Israel :

translation.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger , I will not return to destroy Ephraim : for I am God , and not man  ; the Holy One in the midst of thee : and I will not enter into the city .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga ; ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki Israel . Namar nga dei U Blei bad ym u briew . Ma nga , uta Uba Khuid ngan long bad phi . Ngan ym wan sha phi ha ka jingbitar .

translation.en: And thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye will not hearken to me , to walk in my law , which I have set before you ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la ong ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga da kaba bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai ha phi ,

translation.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling ;
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba la phai dien noh na kine bad ki la jah lynti ha ki jingïatainia ba-bieit .

translation.en: And the  Lord  will take away from thee all sickness , and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt , which thou knowest , upon thee  ; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi na ka jait jingpang baroh , bad un ym pynngat ha phi wat tang kawei ruh na ki jingpang kiba sngewtriem ba phi la mad ha ka ri Ijipt , hynrei un pynngat ïa ki ha ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: Who ought to have been here before thee , and object , if they had ought against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut ki Jiw na ka probins    jong ka Asia ki la don hangta ; ki hi ki dei ban wan ha khmat jong me bad buh ïa ki jingmudui jong ki lada ki don ei ei pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: Receiving the end of your faith , even the salvation of your souls .
translation.kha: namar phi ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim ïa ki mynsiem jong phi , kaba long ka jingthmu jong ka jingngeit jong phi ha U .

translation.en: And of the angels he saith , Who maketh his angels spirits , and his ministers a flame of fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei shaphang kita ki angel U Blei u la ong ,  U Blei u la pynlong ïa la ki angel kum ki lyer , bad ïa ki shakri jong u kum ki thylliej ding .

translation.en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked  ; ( for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies : )
translation.kha: U Moses u ïohi ba u Aaron u la pyllait lan ïa kita ki paidbah kat haduh ba ki la pynkhlemrain ïa lade ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: Children , obey your parents in all things : for this is well pleasing unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Ki khun , ïai kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , naba kata ka long kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

translation.en: That they gathered themselves together , to fight with Joshua and with Israel , with one accord .
translation.kha: Ki la ïakynduh lang baroh bad ki la ïasnohkti lang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Joshua bad ki Israel .

translation.en: Moab is destroyed  ; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynjot ; ha sngap ïa ki khynnah ba ki ïam .

translation.en: Be strong , and quit yourselves like men , O ye Philistines , that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews , as they have been to you : quit yourselves like men , and fight .
translation.kha: Long shlur , ko ki Philistia ! Ïaleh kum ki rangbah , lym kumta ngin kylla long ki mraw ha kine ki Hebru , kumba ma ki , ki la long ki mraw jong ngi . Kumta to ïaleh kum ki rangbah !

translation.en: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life , set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church .
translation.kha: Lada kum kita kiei kiei ki jia , hato phin leit rah ïa ki ban pynbeit da ki briew ki bym don nongrim ha ka balang ?

translation.en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee , in making thee desolate because of thy sins .
translation.kha: Te nga la dep sdang ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingpynpra ïa phi namar ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: He saith unto them ,  How then doth David in spirit call him Lord , saying ,
translation.kha: Balei , te ,  U Jisu u la kylli ,  ba U Mynsiem u pynshlur ïa Dabid ban khot ïa u , ‘ U Trai’ ? U Dabid u la ong ,

translation.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass , and put the taches into the loops , and couple the tent together , that it may be one .
translation.kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka rnong , pyndait ïa ki ha kita ki kyrwoh , bad suh lang ïa kita ki jaiñ jingtap ar tylli ba kin long kawei ka jingtap .

translation.en: Then the king s servants , which were in the king s gate , said unto Mordecai , Why transgressest thou the king s commandment ?
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ka jingtreikam ha ïingsyiem ki la kylli ïa u balei ba um kohnguh ïa ka hukum u syiem ;

translation.en: And Moses said , We will go with our young and with our old , with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds will we go  ; for we must hold a feast unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Ngin ïaleit lut baroh , kynthup ki khun jong ngi haduh ki tymmen jong ngi . Ngin ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ngi , lem bad ki langbrot bad ki blang , bad ki masi jong ngi , namar ngi dei ban pynlong ka jingkhawai ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Beloved , think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you , as though some strange thing happened unto you :
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , to wat sngewphylla ïa ka jingtynjuh ba-eh kaba phi shahshitom , kumba kiei kiei kiba khyllah ki wan jia ha phi .

translation.en: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day .
translation.kha: Ki tur pyrshah ïa ki Benjamin ha ka sien kaba ar .

translation.en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God , to them who are the called according to his purpose .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ha kiei kiei baroh , U Blei u trei na ka bynta ka jingpynbha ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u , ïa kito ïa kiba u la khot kat kum ka jingthmu jong u .

translation.en: And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Trai , to khmih ïa ki jingbyrngem kiba ki la pynlong , bad shah ïa ngi , ki shakri jong me , ban kren ïa ka khubor jong me da ka jingshlur baroh .

translation.en: Then say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God  , The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it , that her time may come , and maketh idols against herself to defile herself .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ka nongbah ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Namar ba pha la pynïap ïa kiba bun ki briew la jong bad pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , ka por jong pha ka la poi .

translation.en: What sort of men are the ministerial servants ?
translation.kha: Ki nongïarap balang ki dei ki briew kiba kumno ?

translation.en: And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber : and the king was very old  ; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit jngoh ïa u syiem ha ka kamra thiah jong u . U la tymmen bha , bad ka Abishag , ka samla kynthei na Shunem , ka sumar ïa u .

translation.en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the  Lord  , even against the word of the  Lord  , which he kept not , and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit , to enquire of it  ;
translation.kha: U Saul u la ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u ha U  Trai . Um shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ; u pyrshang ban wad jingshai da kaba kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap , ha ka jaka ba un kylli na U  Trai .

translation.en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol ? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure ? wherefore are they cast out , he and his seed , and are cast into a land which they know not ?
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Hato u syiem Jehoïakhin u la kylla long kum u khra uba la pait uba la bret noh bad u bym don ba kwah shuh mano mano ? Hato ka long kata balei ba ma u bad ïa ki khun jong u la ringmraw sha ka ri kaba kim tip ei ei ?

translation.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work shall the candlestick be made : his shaft , and his branches , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , shall be of the same .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa uwei u diengpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar nylla . Shna ïa ka trai bad ka met jong u da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong jong u kiba kynthup ïa ki shylluit bad ki sla syntiew jong ki , kin ïasoh lang kawei bad u .

translation.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me : give me understanding , that I may learn thy commandments .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa nga , bad me sumar ïa nga ; to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngan lah ban nang ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place , and hast made thee an high place in every street .
translation.kha: harud jong kawei pa kawei ka surok pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti .

translation.en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling  ; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki kyrwoh da ka jaiñ kaba jngum ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud duh na kita ki jingkah baroh ar tylli .

translation.en: And the smoke of the incense , which came with the prayers of the saints , ascended up before God out of the angel s hand .
translation.kha: Ka tdem jong ka jingainguh thang ka la kiew shalor ryngkat lem bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei na ki kti u angel uba ïeng ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: So after he had washed their feet , and had taken his garments , and was set down again , he said unto them ,  Know ye what I have done to you ?
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la sait ïa ki kjat jong ki , u la kup biang ïa ka jaiñkup bad u la leit phai sha la ka jaka ha ka miej .  Phi sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba nga dang shu dep ban leh ïa phi ?  u la kylli .

translation.en: And he will take your menservants , and your maidservants , and your goodliest young men , and your asses , and put them to his work .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa ki shakri jong phi , bad ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki jingri bad ki kada jong phi , bad un pyntrei ïa ki ha ka kam jong u .

translation.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount , the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron , and said unto him , Up , make us gods , which shall go before us  ; for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u Moses um pat shym wan hiar na u lum hynrei u la sah slem hangta , ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u Aaron , bad ki la ong ha u ,  Ngim tip satia ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , uba la ïalam ïa ngi ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta to thaw ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .

translation.en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her  ; they shall pitch their tents against her round about  ; they shall feed every one in his place .
translation.kha: ki syiem kin sher dara hangta lem bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki . Kin pynïeng ïa la ki ïingjaiñ sawdong ka nongbah , bad uwei uwei un sher dara hangno hangno ba u kwah .

translation.en: And who , as I , shall call , and shall declare it , and set it in order for me , since I appointed the ancient people ? and the things that are coming , and shall come , let them shew unto them .
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano ba la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ? Mano ba la ïathuh lypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia naduh kaba mynnyngkong haduh kaba kut ka por ?

translation.en: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jehonadab your father , and kept all his precepts , and done according unto all that he hath commanded you :
translation.kha: Te nga la ong ïa ka kur Rekhab ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Phi la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u kpa tymmen jong phi u Jonadab u la ai ha phi ; phi la bud ïa baroh ki jingbthah jong u , bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses  hand , when he came down from the mount , that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him .
translation.kha: Mynba u Moses u wan hiar na u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki Shiphew Hukum , ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ namar ba u la ïakren bad U  Trai  ; hynrei um tip satia ïa kata .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations  ; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka bor bakhuid jong u ; un pynim ïa la ki briew , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohi ïa kata .

translation.en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure , having this seal , The Lord knoweth them that are his . And , Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka nongrim baskhem kaba U Blei u la buh ym lah ban pynkhih ; bad halor jong ka la thoh ïa kine ki ktien :  U Trai u ithuh ïa kito kiba dei ki jong u  bad  Baroh kiba ong ba ki dei ki jong U Trai ki dei ban phai noh na kaba leh bymdei .

translation.en: And I said unto the king , If it please the king , and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight , that thou wouldest send me unto Judah , unto the city of my fathers  sepulchres , that I may build it .
translation.kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ka Bneng , bad nangta nga ong ha u patsha ,  Lada ma me , ko syiem , me don ka jingsngewbha ïa nga bad ai sngewbha ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , shah ïa nga ba ngan leit sha ka ri Judah , sha ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong nga , khnang ba nga lah ban tei pat ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And he said , Go and spy where he is , that I may send and fetch him . And it was told him , saying , Behold , he is in Dothan .
translation.kha: Khie leit wad ha-ei u don ,  u syiem u hukum ,  bad ngan sa phah kem ïa u .  Haba la ïathuh ba u Elisha u don ha Dothan ,

translation.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing : they commit adultery , and walk in lies : they strengthen also the hands of evildoers , that none doth return from his wickedness : they are all of them unto me as Sodom , and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki nongïathuhlypa ka Jerusalem nga la ïohi ba ki leh kaba kham sniew : ki klim bad ki kren lamler ; ki pynshlur ïa ki briew ban leh ïa ka bymdei , kumta ba ym don ba sangeh noh ïa kaei kaba sniew . Ha nga , ki long baroh kiba sniew kum ki briew ka Sodom , bad ka Gomorrah .

translation.en: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers : and , behold , this vine did bend her roots toward him , and shot forth her branches toward him , that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation .
translation.kha: La don sa uwei u pukni radbah uba don ki thapniang kiba khraw bad ki sner kiba rben . Bad mynta u dieng sohwaiñ u pyiar ïa la ki thied sha u bad u la pynphai ïa la ki sla sha u , ha ka jingkyrmen ba un ai ïa u kham bun ka um ban ïa kaba ka don ha ka kper ha kaba u san .

translation.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool .
translation.kha: tad ynda nga buh ïa ki nongshun jong me kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong me .’

translation.en: So he departed from Elisha , and came to his master  ; who said to him , What said Elisha to thee ? And he answered , He told me that thou shouldest surely recover .
translation.kha: U Hasael u leit phai sha u Benhadad , uba kylli ïa u ,  U Elisha u ong kumno ?  U Hasael u jubab ,  U ong ha nga ba phin sa koit sa khiah bha pat .

translation.en: And as he did so year by year , when she went up to the house of the  Lord  , so she provoked her  ; therefore she wept , and did not eat .
translation.kha: Kane ka ïailong na ka snem sha ka snem ; man ka por ba ki leit sha ka ïing U  Trai  , ka Peninnah ka ju pynsngewsih palat ïa ka Hannah , haduh ba kan da ïam bad kam treh ban bam ei ei .

translation.en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God , I will send them prophets and apostles , and some of them they shall slay and persecute :
