translation.kha: Na kane ka daw ka Jingstad jong U Blei ka la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ha ki ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki nonglamktien ; kin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki bad kin pynshitom beiñ ïa kiwei pat .’

translation.en: And , behold , Cushi came  ; and Cushi said , Tidings , my lord the king : for the  Lord  hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u mraw na Sudan u wan poi bad u ong ha u syiem ,  Nga don ka khubor babha ïa u Syiem Kynrad ! Ha kane ka sngi U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor kito baroh kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi !

translation.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :
translation.kha: hynriew kilo ka kassia , ( ïa kiba la thew kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jaka kyntang ) . Bynrap sa saw litar ka umphniang Olib ,

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Thou hast both seen him , and it is he that talketh with thee .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Me la lah ïohi ïa u , bad u dei uta uba ïakren bad me mynta .

translation.en: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house .
translation.kha: U Gideon u leit phai pat sha la ïing bad u shongduh hangta .

translation.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted :
translation.kha: U parabangeit uba duk u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u kyntiew ïa u , bad u parabangeit uba riewspah u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u pynhiar ïa u .

translation.en: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee : by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things , whereof we accuse him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Lusias u la ai hukum ba ki nongmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul kin wan ha khmat jong me . Lada me kylli ïa une u briew , me hi me lah ban tip na u ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi mudui ïa u .

translation.en: And the king commanded , and they brought great stones , costly stones , and hewed stones , to lay the foundation of the house .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum u Solomon ki la shtah ïa ki maw kiba heh itynnat na ka bynta ka nongrim jong ka Templ .

translation.en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury  ; and I , even I , will chastise you seven times for your sins .
translation.kha: te ha ka jingbitar ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , bad sa shisien ngan pynshitom jur shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba la long mynshuwa .

translation.en: And they laid the ark of the  Lord  upon the cart , and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kata ka kali , lem bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba la thep ïa ki dur khnai bad ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Then the priest of Jupiter , which was before their city , brought oxen and garlands unto the gates , and would have done sacrifice with the people .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh jong u blei Seus , uba ka templ jong u ka ïeng kham pajih shabar shnong , u la wallam ïa ki masi dab bad ki syntiew sha ka khyrdop , naba ma u bad ki paidbah ki la kwah ban ai ka jingkñia sha ki apostol .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Korah , Hear , I pray you , ye sons of Levi :
translation.kha: U Moses u la bteng ban kren ha u Korah ,  Da sngap bha , phi ki Lebi !

translation.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face  ; that sacrificeth in gardens , and burneth incense upon altars of brick  ;
translation.kha: Kim lehrain satia ban ïai pynbitar ïa nga . Ki ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala ha ki kper bakyntang bad thang jingiwbih ha ki duwan ba-thala .

translation.en: And Isaac s servants digged in the valley , and found there a well of springing water .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la tih ïa ka pukri ha kata ka them bad ki lap ba ka don um .

translation.en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem : thou shalt weep no more : he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry  ; when he shall hear it , he will answer thee .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem phin ym ïam shuh lano lano ruh . U  Trai  u long uba sngewsynei , bad haba phi kyang sha u ban ïoh jingïarap , un jubab ïa phi .

translation.en: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants , even Esther s feast  ; and he made a release to the provinces , and gave gifts , according to the state of the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba khraw kum ka jinglehburom ïa ka Esther bad khot sngewbha ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar bad nongpynïaidkam . U la pynbna shuti ha ka hima baroh kawei bad ai ki jingai sngewbha kiba shongdor kum ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb , then she shall bring two turtles , or two young pigeons  ; the one for the burnt offering , and the other for a sin offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for her , and she shall be clean .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka kynthei kam lah ban ai ïa u khunlangbrot , kan wallam ar tylli ki lyngdkhur ne ar tylli ki paro , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh namar ka pop bad u lyngdoh un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka , bad kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid .

translation.en: And the man of God said unto the king , If thou wilt give me half thine house , I will not go in with thee , neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place :
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u jubab ,  Wat lada phi ai ïa nga shiteng na ka spah jong phi , ngan ym leit bad phi lane bam lane dih ei ei bad phi .

translation.en: Harden not your heart , as in the provocation , and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness :
translation.kha: Wat long uba mutlop , kumba ki kpa tymmen ki la long ha Meribah , kumba ki la long ha kato ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap ha Massah .

translation.en: And he divided himself against them , he and his servants , by night , and smote them , and pursued them unto Hobah , which is on the left hand of Damascus .
translation.kha: Hangta u pynbynta kynhun kynhun ïa la ki briew , u tur pyrshah ïa ki nongshun mynmiet , bad u jop ïa ki . U beh ruh ïa ki haduh Hobah , kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Damaskos , bad u la ïoh pat ruh ïa kat kaba ki la lute .

translation.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife , being great with child .
translation.kha: U la leit ban thoh kyrteng lem bad ka Mari , kaba la ïatehktien bad u .

translation.en: ( As it is written in the law of the Lord , Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord  ; )
translation.kha: kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ jong U Trai :  Ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong dei ban pynkyntang sha U Trai .

translation.en: And , behold , the man clothed with linen , which had the inkhorn by his side , reported the matter , saying , I have done as thou hast commanded me .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen u la leit phai bad wan ïathuh ha U  Trai  ,  Nga la leh kumba me la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness :
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap baroh ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses bad u Aaron bad ki la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: Which have forsaken the right way , and are gone astray , following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor , who loved the wages of unrighteousness  ;
translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti kaba beit bad ki la jah lynti ; ki la bud ïa ka lynti jong u Balaam , u khun jong u Beor , uba ieit ïa ka pisa kaba u ïoh da ka kam bymhok

translation.en: Then I saw that she was defiled , that they took both one way ,
translation.kha: Nga ïohi ïa ka jinglong jakhlia ba-pura jong ka , ba ka para kaba bud ka long kaba sniew kum kaba ha shuwa .

translation.en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song , until they were ended .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai baroh kawei katba ki paid Israel baroh ki shahshkor .

translation.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren , an east wind shall come , the wind of the  Lord  shall come up from the wilderness , and his spring shall become dry , and his fountain shall be dried up : he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels .
translation.kha: Wat lada ki paid Israel ki roi kum ki ñiut , ngan phah ïa ka lyer khluit na mihngi kaba na ri shyiap , bad kan pyntyrkhong ïa ki umpohliew bad ki pung-um jong ki . Kan rong noh ïa kano kano kaba kordor .

translation.en: Jehovah is so great and powerful , yet he listens to our prayers !
translation.kha: U Jehobah u long uba khraw bad badonbor tam , hynrei u sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi !

translation.en: But my words and my statutes , which I commanded my servants the prophets , did they not take hold of your fathers ? and they returned and said , Like as the  Lord  of hosts thought to do unto us , according to our ways , and according to our doings , so hath he dealt with us .
translation.kha: Lyngba ki shakri jong nga ki nongïathuhlypa nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham , hynrei ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la shahshitom ïa kaba mih nangta . Nangta ki la kylla-kaba-mut bad ki la pdiang ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la lah pynshitom ïa ki kumba ki dei ban shah bad kumba nga la kut jingmut ban leh .’

translation.en: Praising God , and having favour with all the people . And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved .
translation.kha: da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei , bad lehkmen ha ka jingbhasbun jong ki briew baroh . Bad man ka sngi U Trai u nang pynïasoh ha ka kynhun jong ki ïa kito kiba la pynim .

translation.en: And when it was day , he departed and went into a desert place : and the people sought him , and came unto him , and stayed him , that he should not depart from them .
translation.kha: Tang shu kynjat shai , U Jisu u la mihnoh na shnong bad u la leit sha ka jaka bakynjah . Ki paidbah ki la sdang ban wad ïa u , bad haba ki la shem ïa u , ki la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leit noh .

translation.en: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech , that was in the court of the prison : and they let down Jeremiah with cords . And in the dungeon there was no water , but mire : so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa nga bad ki la pynhiar ïa nga da ki tyllai shapoh ka pung u khun syiem Malkhaïah , kaba don hapoh ka phyllaw ïingsyiem . Ym don um ha kata ka pung , tang ka ktieh , bad nga la ngam shapoh ha ka .

translation.en: And the Jews  passover was nigh at hand : and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover , to purify themselves .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan , bad bun ki briew ki la leit kiew na ki nongkyndong sha Jerusalem ban pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: And Moses turned , and went down from the mount , and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand : the tables were written on both their sides  ; on the one side and on the other were they written .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leit hiar na uta u lum , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum ha baroh arliang .

translation.en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingïathuh shaphang U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng ha kata ka thain .

translation.en: And he asked him ,  What is thy name ?  And he answered , saying , My name is Legion : for we are many .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ?  Uta u briew u la jubab ,  Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long ‘ U Paidbah’ — ngi ïadon shibun !

translation.en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses , though we have rebelled against him  ;
translation.kha: Me long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba map , wat la ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: And he laid his hands on her : and immediately she was made straight , and glorified God .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa la ka kti halor jong ka , bad kumta hi ka la pynbeit ïa la ka met bad ka la ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the  Lord  : Thou sayest , Prophesy not against Israel , and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong . Me bthah ïa nga ban sangeh kaba ïathuhlypa , ban sangeh kaba kren lamwir pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Israel .

translation.en: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father s brother king in his stead , and changed his name to Zedekiah .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la pynlong ïa u Mattanaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad u la pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Sedekaïah .

translation.en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire , and used divination and enchantments , and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: Ki kñia ïa ki khun shynrang bad kynthei kum ki jingainguh thang sha ki blei thala ; ki wad jingmut na ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongpeit kti , bad ki aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei kaba bakla ha khmat U  Trai  , bad kumta ki pynkhih bitar ïa U .

translation.en: Judge me , O God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation : O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man .
translation.kha: A Blei , to pynbna ba nga long uba lui lui , bad ïasaid da ïa nga na ki bymriewblei ; pyllait ïa nga na ki briew kiba shukor bad kiba sniew !

translation.en: Is any sick among you ? let him call for the elders of the church  ; and let them pray over him , anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord :
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba pang ? U dei ban phah khot ïa ki nongsharai balang , ki ban duwai na ka bynta jong u bad pynsleh ha u da ka umphniang Olib ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .

translation.en: And so all Israel shall be saved : as it is written , There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer , and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob :
translation.kha: Bad baroh ki Israel yn pynim . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Nongpynim un wan na Seïon bad un weng noh ïa baroh ka jingbymman na ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .

translation.en: I have not sent these prophets , yet they ran : I have not spoken to them , yet they prophesied .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngam shym la phah ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , hynrei wat la katta ki leit la ka leit . Ngam shym la ai kano kano ka khubor ha ki , hynrei pynban ki kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.en: And he will take the tenth of your seed , and of your vineyards , and give to his officers , and to his servants .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na u kew bad na u sohwaiñ jong phi na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar Aiñ bad kiwei ki rangbah synshar .

translation.en: Now the parable is this : The seed is the word of God .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingmut jong ka pharshi : U symbai u long ka ktien U Blei .

translation.en: And this is the charge of their burden , according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars thereof , and the pillars thereof , and sockets thereof ,
translation.kha: Na ka jait u Merari ki mih ki longïing jong u Mahli bad u Mushi .

translation.en: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch , teaching and preaching the word of the Lord , with many others also .
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la pynlut katto katne por ha Antiokh , bad ryngkat lem bad bun kiwei pat , ki la hikai bad ïalap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .

translation.en: Just balances , just weights , a just ephah , and a just hin , shall ye have : I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki tarajur kiba biang , ki mawthew kiba biang , bad ïa ki tiar thew kiba biang . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad nga wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .
translation.kha: U la pynhun ïa kito kiba sliang bad pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha .

translation.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the  Lord  , and spake , saying , I will sing unto the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously : the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U  Trai  :  Ngan rwai ha U  Trai namar ka jingjop kaba khraw jong u ; sha duriaw u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai .

translation.en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites , to serve , and for burdens :
translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw kaba long baroh sawdong ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ka duwan , bad ïa ka pyrda ïa ka jingkhang jong ka phyllaw . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine ki tiar ki tar .

translation.en: These things said Esaias , when he saw his glory , and spake of him .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u la ong ïa kane namar u la ïohi ïa ka burom U Jisu bad u la kren shaphang jong u .

translation.en: Joshua therefore sent them forth : and they went to lie in ambush , and abode between Beth–el and Ai , on the west side of Ai : but Joshua lodged that night among the people .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u phah noh ïa ki , bad ki la leit sha la ka jakarieh bad ap hangta , ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Ai , hapdeng ka Ai bad ka Bethel . U Joshua pat u sahmiet ha ka jaka sher dara .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them : because I have spoken unto them , but they have not heard  ; and I have called unto them , but they have not answered .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam halor jong phi ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ïa baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga la kular . Ngan leh ïa kane namar phim shym la shahshkor haba nga la kren ha phi , bad phim shym la jubab haba nga la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: And the table and his furniture , and the pure candlestick with all his furniture , and the altar of incense ,
translation.kha: ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar bad ki tiar ki tar jong u baroh , ïa ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ,

translation.en: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron , and with the point of a diamond : it is graven upon the table of their heart , and upon the horns of your altars  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong ka Judah , ïa ka pop jong phi la thoh da u khulom nar ; la pruid jylliew halor ki dohnud jong phi da u diamond banep bad la ohdur halor ki dong jong ki duwan jong phi .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered , and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen , then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ngan wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel na ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin tip ba nga long uba khuid . Ki paid Israel kin im ha la ka ri , ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob .

translation.en: And he said ,  Lord  God of Israel , there is no God like thee , in heaven above , or on earth beneath , who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart :
translation.kha: bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , ym don U Blei uba kum ma me ha bneng shajrong ne ha khyndew shapoh ! Me bat ïa ka jutang bad me pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha la ki jong ki briew kiba kohnguh ïa me naduh ka mynsiem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had been there a long time , that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window , and saw , and , behold , Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife .
translation.kha: Haba u Isaak u la don hangta katto katne por , u syiem Abimelekh u peit na ka jingkhangïit bad u ïohi ïa u Isaak bad ka Rebekka ba ki ïaleh ieit .

translation.en: But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Amor , pynban , ki la phet ïap bad rieh hapoh ka krem ha Makkedah .

translation.en: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel : for the Philistines said , Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears :
translation.kha: Ym shym la don ki kamar ha Israel , namar ki Philistia ki la kut jingmut ban ym ailad ïa ki Hebru ban shna ïa ki waitlam ne ki sum .

translation.en: For she said , If I may touch but his clothes , I shall be whole .
translation.kha: da kaba ong ha lade ,  Lada nga tang shu ïohktah ïa ki jaiñkup jong u , ngan ïohkhiah .

translation.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance , though ye once knew this , how that the Lord , having saved the people out of the land of Egypt , afterward destroyed them that believed not .
translation.kha: Naba wat ba phi la tip ïa kane baroh , nga kwah ban pynkynmaw biang ïa phi ba kumno U Trai u la pyllait im shisien ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt , hynrei hadien , u la pynjot ïa kito ki bym shym la ngeit .

translation.en: Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , lada ka jingïatiplem kam pynrem ïa ngi , ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: Thou shalt not do so unto the  Lord  thy God : for every abomination to the  Lord  , which he hateth , have they done unto their gods  ; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods .
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kumba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , namar ba ha kaba mane ïa ki , ki leh ruh ïa ki kam isaitmet baroh kiba U  Trai  u isih . Ki kñia wat ïa la ki khun ki kti ruh ha ka ding halor ki duwan jong ki .

translation.en: And shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Even so will I break this people and this city , as one breaketh a potter s vessel , that cannot be made whole again : and they shall bury them in Topheth , till there be no place to bury .
translation.kha: bad ban ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong ,  Ngan pynpait ïa kane ka jaitbynriew bad ïa kane ka nongbah , bad kan long kum une u khra khyndew ba la pait u bym lah ban pyndait pat . Ki briew kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki ha Topheth namar yn ym don hangno hangno hawei pat ban tep ïa ki .

translation.en: And for me , that utterance may be given unto me , that I may open my mouth boldly , to make known the mystery of the gospel ,
translation.kha: Bad to duwai ruh na ka bynta jong nga ba U Blei un ai ha nga ïa ka khubor haba nga la kloi ban kren , khnang ba nga lah ban kren shlur bad pynpaw shai ïa ka jingmaïan ka gospel .

translation.en: ( That also was accounted a land of giants : giants dwelt therein in old time  ; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims  ;
translation.kha: ( Ïa kane ka ri la ju tip kum ka ri ki Rephaim , ka kyrteng jong kita ki briew kiba ju shong hangta . Ki Ammon ki khot ïa ki , ki Samsummim .

translation.en: But in every nation he that feareth him , and worketh righteousness , is accepted with him .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa u bad kiba leh ïa kaba dei ki long kiba la pdiang sngewbha da u , kam pher na kano ka jaitbynriew ki long .

translation.en: And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together  ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .
translation.kha: Haba ki la dep duwai , ka jaka ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ka la khynñiuh . La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei da ka jingshlur .

translation.en: And when he had opened the second seal , I heard the second beast say , Come and see .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba ar ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba ar uba ong ,  To wan !

translation.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la sngewsih haba nga ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki kynthei jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: I beheld , and the same horn made war with the saints , and prevailed against them  ;
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , kata ka reng ka pynlong thma bad ki briew jong U Blei bad ka la jop ïa ki .

translation.en: But he said unto them ,  I have meat to eat that ye know not of .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab ,  Nga don ka jingbam ban bam ïa kaba phi phim tip ei ei .

translation.en: Meats for the belly , and the belly for meats : but God shall destroy both it and them . Now the body is not for fornication , but for the Lord ; and the Lord for the body .
translation.kha: Don uwei pat u ban ong ,  Ka jingbam ka dei na ka bynta ka kpoh , bad ka kpoh na ka bynta ka jingbam .  Ho-oid , hynrei U Blei un sa pynduh ïa baroh ar . Ïa ka met ym dei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam awria , hynrei ïa ka ban shakri ïa U Trai ; bad U Trai u bsa ïa ka met .

translation.en: And Moses said unto them , If ye will do this thing , if ye will go armed before the  Lord  to war ,
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Lada phi da mut shisha kumba phi ong , te hangne ha khmat U  Trai  to khreh ban leit sha ka thma .

translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink ; but righteousness , and peace , and joy in the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long ha kaba bam bad kaba dih , hynrei ka long ka hok , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingkmen kiba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ai .

translation.en: And stay ye not , but pursue after your enemies , and smite the hindmost of them  ; suffer them not to enter into their cities : for the  Lord  your God hath delivered them into your hand .
translation.kha: hynrei ma phi pat wat sah hangta . Ïai beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi , bad tur ïaleh ïa ki na shadien ; wat ailad ba kin ïohrung sha la ki jong ki nongbah ! U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki .

translation.en: Say unto wisdom , Thou art my sister  ; and call understanding thy kinswoman :
translation.kha: Ñiew ïa ka jingstad kum ka para jong phi , bad ïa ka jingshemphang kum ka paralok ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong phi .

translation.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the  Lord  : for they shall all know me , from the least of them unto the greatest of them , saith the  Lord  : for I will forgive their iniquity , and I will remember their sin no more .
translation.kha: Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban hap hikai ïa la u para ri ban tip ïa U  Trai  , namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam . Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki jingbakla jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid , and great pain shall come upon them , as in the day of Egypt : for , lo , it cometh .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan bad ïa ka Ijipt la pynjot , ngan phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha ki liengbah ban pynkhih ïa ki briew ki bym poi pyrkhat jong ka Sudan , bad kin sngewtriem . Kata ka sngi ka la jan wan !

translation.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah , they were thy merchants : they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices , and with all precious stones , and gold .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki mar jong pha ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba bad Raamah ki ai kylliang da ki mawkordor , ka ksiar , bad ki musli musla bakynsai tam .

translation.en: And give him no rest , till he establish , and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban ai shongthait ïa u tad ynda u dep tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , bad pynlong ïa ka , ka nongbah ha kaba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïaroh .

translation.en: Asaph the chief , and next to him Zechariah , Jeiel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Mattithiah , and Eliab , and Benaiah , and Obed–edom : and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps  ; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals  ;
translation.kha: Ïa u Asaph la thung nongïalam bad ïa u Sekharaïah kum u nongïarap . La thung ïa u Jeiel , u Shemiramoth , u Jehiel , u Mattithaïah , u Eliab , u Benaïah , u Obed Edom bad u Jeiel ban tem ki duitara . U Asaph un pynsawa ki shakuriaw ,

translation.en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store , as God hath prospered him , that there be no gatherings when I come .
translation.kha: Man la ka Sngi U Trai , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban buh kyrpang katto katne ka pisa , kat kum ka jingïoh , bad pynlang ïa ka , khnang ba yn ym da donkam ban lum ïa ka pisa ynda nga poi .

translation.en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Uno uno u dkhot na ka longïing jong me uba ïap ha ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’

translation.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman  ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka tnga ka bymïaineh ka leh kumne : ka klim , ka sum , bad ka ong ,  Hynrei ngam shym leh ei ei ka bymdei !

translation.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .
translation.kha: Hynrei um shym ong ei ei ha kaba jubab ïa ki jingmudui jong ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .

translation.en: If a man beget an hundred children , and live many years , so that the days of his years be many , and his soul be not filled with good , and also that he have no burial  ; I say , that an untimely birth is better than he .
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban don shispah ngut ki khun bad ban im slem , hynrei kam pher haduh katno ngi im , lada ngim ïoh ïa la ka bynta jong ka jingsngewkmen bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingontep kaba donburom , te nga ong ba kham bha u khunlung uba la kha ïap .

translation.en: The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him : but the desire of the righteous shall be granted .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki thrang , hynrei ki riewbymman ki ïoh ïa kata kaba ki sheptieng eh .

translation.en: Be not desirous of his dainties : for they are deceitful meat .
translation.kha: Wat kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh ; u lah ban pyrshang ban riam ïa phi .

translation.en: And of Gad he said , Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad : he dwelleth as a lion , and teareth the arm with the crown of the head .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Gad u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U Blei uba pynïar ïa ka ri jong ki . U Gad u ap ktem kum u sing ban patar ïa ka kti ne ïa ka snieh khlieh .

translation.en: Of sin , because they believe not on me  ;
translation.kha: Ki bakla shaphang ka pop , namar ba kim shym la ngeit ha nga ;

translation.en: If he called them gods , unto whom the word of God came , and the scripture cannot be broken  ;
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ïa kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ka long kaba shisha junom ; bad U Blei u la khot ïa kito ki briew ki blei , ki briew ha kiba U Blei u la ai ïa ka khubor jong u .

translation.en: For the man is not of the woman ; but the woman of the man .
translation.kha: U briew um donkam ban tap ïa la ka khlieh , namar u pynphalang ïa ka dur bad ka burom U Blei . Hynrei ka briew ka pynphalang ïa ka burom jong u briew ; naba ïa u briew ym shym la thaw ïa na ka briew , hynrei ïa ka briew na u briew .

translation.en: Keep my commandments , and live  ; and my law as the apple of thine eye .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin ïoh im . Da sumar bha ban bud ïa ki jinghikai jong nga kumba phi sumar ïa la ki khmat ;

translation.en: Christmas and Easter come from ancient false religions
translation.kha: Ka Khrismas bad Easter ki wan na ki niam ba hikai bakla naduh hyndai

translation.en: Trust in the  Lord  with all thine heart  ; and lean not unto thine own understanding .
translation.kha: Shaniah ha U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . Wat shaniah ha kaei ba phi pyrkhat ba phi tip .

translation.en: Then the king went to his palace , and passed the night fasting : neither were instruments of musick brought before him : and his sleep went from him .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la leit phai pat sha ka ïingsyiem bad u la pynlut ïa ka miet khlem ïohthiah , khlem bam lane khlem kano kano ka jingpynsngewbha .

translation.en: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger , fatherless , and widow . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: But the  Lord  of hosts shall be exalted in judgment , and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba leh ïa kaba dei , bad u pynpaw ïa ka jingkhuid jong u da kaba bishar ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: Now Rachel had taken the images , and put them in the camel s furniture , and sat upon them . And Laban searched all the tent , but found them not .
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka la shim ïa kita ki blei ïing bad ka la lah thep ïa ki hapoh ka jin    ut bad ka shong halor jong ki . U Laban la u wad kylleng hapoh kata ka ïingjaiñ , hynrei um lap ïa ki .

translation.en: Stand now with thine enchantments , and with the multitude of thy sorceries , wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth  ; if so be thou shalt be able to profit , if so be thou mayest prevail .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki jingleh myntor bad jingkhan jong pha baroh ; pha la pyndonkam ïa ki naduh ba pha dang samla . Lehse ki lah ban long jingïarap katto katne ïa pha ; lehse pha lah ban pyntieng ïa ki nongshun jong pha .

translation.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew . Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias ? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la kyntait ïa la ki jong ki briew , ïa kiba u la jied naduh kaba sdang . Phi tip ïa kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ha ka jingïathuh shaphang u Elijah ba u ïasaid bad U Blei pyrshah ïa ki Israel :

translation.en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations , and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished :
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Trai u tip kumno ban pyllait im ïa ki briew kiba riewblei na ki jingtynjuh jong ki bad kumno ban pynhap ïa ki bymman ha ka jingpynshitom ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , khamtam ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki jingkwah brai jakhlia jong ka met bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka bor synshar jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he sat down , and called the twelve , and saith unto them ,  If any man desire to be first , the same shall be last of all , and servant of all .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shong , u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban long nyngkong u dei ban buh khatduh eh ïa lade bad u dei ban long u shakri ïa baroh .

translation.en: ( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given  ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified . )
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane shaphang U Mynsiem , uba kito kiba la ngeit ha u kin ïohpdiang . Ha kata ka por ïa U Mynsiem ym pat shym la ai , namar ïa U Jisu ym pat shym la kyntiew sha ka burom .

translation.en: Hearken unto this , O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .
translation.kha: Sangeh shipor , ko Job , bad shahshkor ; pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba U Blei u leh .

translation.en: I hate , I despise your feast days , and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga isih ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi ; ngam lah shah ïa ki !

translation.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel : and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains , and caves , and strong holds .
translation.kha: Ki Midian ki long kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki Israel , bad ki paid Israel ki rieh ïa lade na ki ha ki krem bad ha kiwei pat ki jaka bashngain ha ki lumrit .

translation.en: What doth it profit , my brethren , though a man say he hath faith , and have not works ? can faith save him ?
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kan myntoi aïu ïa uba ong ba u don ka jingngeit lada da ki kam jong u , um pynshisha ïa kata ? Hato kata ka jingngeit kan pynim ïa u ?

translation.en: And it came to pass after forty years , that Absalom said unto the king , I pray thee , let me go and pay my vow , which I have vowed unto the  Lord  , in Hebron .
translation.kha: Hadien saw snem , u Absalom u ong ha u syiem Dabid ,  Kynrad , shah ngan leit sha Hebron ban pyndep ïa la ka kular ba nga la ai ha U  Trai .

translation.en: If there be among you any man , that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night , then shall he go abroad out of the camp , he shall not come within the camp :
translation.kha: Lada don u briew u bymkhuid da kaba liat ksuit mynmiet , u dei ban leit sah shabar kata ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: How long , ye simple ones , will ye love simplicity ? and the scorners delight in their scorning , and fools hate knowledge ?
translation.kha: A , phi ki briew kiba bieit ! Slem katno keiñ phi dang kwah ban sah bieit ? Sa katno keiñ phin dang kmen ha kaba krenbeiñ ïa ka jingtip ? Hato phim kwah ban ïoh jinghikai ?

translation.en: That ye would walk worthy of God , who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory .
translation.kha: Ngi la pynshlur ïa phi , ngi la pyntngen ïa phi , bad ngi ïai kyrpad ïa phi ban im ka jingim kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , uba khot ïa phi ban ïa-ïoh bynta lem ha ka Hima bad ka burom jong u hi .

translation.en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba na ki ba-ha-ïing jong me uba ïap hapoh ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni .

translation.en: Do ye thus requite the  Lord  , O foolish people and unwise ? is not he thy father that hath bought thee ? hath he not made thee , and established thee ?
translation.kha: Pleng da kumne mo phi siew kylliang ïa U  Trai  , a , phi ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit bad kaba anna ? Hato um dei u kpa jong phi , uba la thaw ïa phi , uba la seng ïa phi kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ?

translation.en: I will say unto God , Do not condemn me  ; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me .
translation.kha: Wat pynrem ïa nga , A Blei , Ïathuh ïa nga ! Kaei ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa nga ?

translation.en: And said unto him ,  Go , wash in the pool of Siloam ,  ( which is by interpretation , Sent . ) He went his way therefore , and washed , and came seeing .
translation.kha: To khie leit bad bta ïa ka khmat jong me ha ka Pung Siloam .  ( Kane ka kyrteng ka mut  Ba la phah .  ) Kumta uta u briew u la leit , u la bta ïa la ka khmat , bad u la wan phai uba imat pat .

translation.en: They which builded on the wall , and they that bare burdens , with those that laded , every one with one of his hands wrought in the work , and with the other hand held a weapon .
translation.kha: Wat kito kiba kit ïa ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka jingtei , ki trei da kawei ka kti bad bat ha kawei pat ïa ka tiar ïaleh thma ,

translation.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom : but the friend of the bridegroom , which standeth and heareth him , rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom s voice : this my joy therefore is fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ka nongleitkurim ka dei ka jong u nongleitkurim ; hynrei u paralok jong u nongleitkurim , uba ïeng marsyndah bad shahshkor , u kmen haba u ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u nongleitkurim . Kane ka long kumno ba ïa ka jingkmen jong nga la pyndap pura .

translation.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword  ; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me , and made me a polished shaft  ; in his quiver hath he hid me  ;
translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa ki ktien jong nga kiba nep kum ka waitlam . Da la ka kti u ïada ïa nga . U la pynlong ïa nga kum u khnam , uba nep bad ba la biang ban pyndonkam .

translation.en: He takes the lead in helping his family to learn about God and His purposes .
translation.kha: Kum u khlieh jong ka ïing u dei ban long u banyngkong ha ka ban ïarap ban hikai ïa ki shaphang U Blei bad ki jingthmu jong U .

translation.en: And he spake this parable unto them , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :

translation.en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest , that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the  Lord  , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people :
translation.kha: Khie leit sha u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingkheiñ ïa ka pisa ba ki lyngdoh kiba treikam ha ka khyrdop jong ka Templ ba ki la ïohlum na ki briew .

translation.en: Again he said unto her , Stand in the door of the tent , and it shall be , when any man doth come and enquire of thee , and say , Is there any man here ? that thou shalt say , No .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa ka ,  Ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka dara , bad lada uno uno u wan bad kylli ïa phi la hangne don briew ne em , sa ong em .

translation.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree  ; and none shall make them afraid : for the mouth of the  Lord  of hosts hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un shongsuk hapdeng ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur la ki jong hi , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa u . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kular ïa kane .

translation.en: Ye have not chosen me , but I have chosen you , and ordained you , that ye should go and bring forth fruit , and that your fruit should remain : that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you .
translation.kha: Phim shym la jied ïa nga ; nga la jied ïa phi bad nga la thung ïa phi ban leit bad ban seisoh shibun , u jait soh uba ïaineh . Bad kumta U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.en: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures , a great and a small .
translation.kha: Wat shukor haba phi thew jingthew da u mawser ne da u diengthew .

translation.en: Now we beseech you , brethren , by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , and by our gathering together unto him ,
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingwan pat ka jong U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi bad ka jinglum lang ïa ngi ban long lem bad u : Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jong nga ,

translation.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , ka syiem jong ka Sheba kan ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ka la wan na la ka ri bajngai ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong U Syiem Solomon ; bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Solomon !

translation.en: A wise man feareth , and departeth from evil : but the fool rageth , and is confident .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki husiar ban kiar na kaba sniew , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kim suidñiew bad ki tur ruma kat shaba lap .

translation.en: Because they have committed villany in Israel , and have committed adultery with their neighbours  wives , and have spoken lying words in my name , which I have not commanded them  ; even I know , and am a witness , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka kupar jong ki namar ki la shah rem na ki pop bashyrkhei — ki la leh awria bad ki la ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai . Kane ka long pyrshah ïa ka mon ka jong U  Trai  ; u tip ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , bad u long u sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: On what pattern are our congregation meetings based ?
translation.kha: Ha kano ka rukom la pynshong nongrim ïa ki jingïalang jong ngi ?

translation.en: And straightway they forsook their nets , and followed him .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jar bad ki la leit bad u .

translation.en: And James and John , the sons of Zebedee , come unto him , saying , Master , we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi , ki la wan ha U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ka don kaei kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me ban leh na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them , shall be thine , and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .
translation.kha: Lada men dang ïoh khun shuh nalor jong ki , kita kin ym dei ki jong nga ; kano kano ka bynta kaba kin ïohpateng kan wan na u Ephraim bad u Manasseh .

translation.en: But David could not go before it to enquire of God : for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the  Lord .
translation.kha: hynrei u Dabid um shym lah ban leit shata ban mane ïa U Blei , namar u la sheptieng ïa ka waitlam jong u angel jong U  Trai .

translation.en: A minister of the sanctuary , and of the true tabernacle , which the Lord pitched , and not man .
translation.kha: U shakri kum U Rangbah Lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam , kata ka long , ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba shisha ïa kaba U Trai u la pynïeng , ym da u briew .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Nay , my lord , but to buy food are thy servants come .
translation.kha: Em , kynrad ,  ki jubab .  Ngi la ïawan kum ki mraw jong phi ban thied jingbam .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring me an offering : of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel ba kin wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh . Pdiang ïa kino kino ki jingainguh kat kiba uno uno u mon ban ai .

translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the earth rejoice  ; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem ! Ko pyrthei , to lehkmen ! To shadkmen , ko ki dewlynnong ha ki duriaw !

translation.en: Most congregations of Jehovah’s Witnesses have meetings three times each week .
translation.kha: Bun na ki balang jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki ju pynlong jingïaseng arsien shitaiew .

translation.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine , they were dismayed , and greatly afraid .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul bad ki briew jong u ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewsheptieng her .

translation.en: Behold now , I have two daughters which have not known man  ; let me , I pray you , bring them out unto you , and do ye to them as is good in your eyes : only unto these men do nothing  ; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof .
translation.kha: Khmih shane , nga don ar ngut ki khun kynthei kiba dang sotti . Shah ngan wallam ïa ki sha phi , bad phi lah ban leh ïa ki katba phi mon . Hynrei wat leh ei ei ïa kine ki rangbah ; ki dei kiba nga la khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong nga , bad nga dei ban ïada ïa ki .

translation.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap : he layeth up the depth in storehouses .
translation.kha: U lumlang ïa baroh ki duriaw-rit ha kawei ka jaka ; u khang ïa ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah ha ki ïing jingkynshew .

translation.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bym don jingmyntoi ki la iehnoh na kaba ïaineh ha me .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel , How long are ye slack to go to possess the land , which the  Lord  God of your fathers hath given you ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Sa katno phin ap ha shuwa ban phin rung bad shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la ai ha phi ?

translation.en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws , which the  Lord  made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ki long ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses , ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel .

translation.en: But for his kin , that is near unto him , that is , for his mother , and for his father , and for his son , and for his daughter , and for his brother ,
translation.kha: lait noh kiba ïadei jan eh , kum ka kmie , u kpa , u khun , ka khun , u hynmen u para ,

translation.en: And he increased his people greatly  ; and made them stronger than their enemies .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai shibun ki khun ïa ki briew jong u bad pynlong ïa ki kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: Tell them therefore , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will make this proverb to cease , and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel  ; but say unto them , The days are at hand , and the effect of every vision .
translation.kha: Mynta ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga don ban ong shaphang kata . Ngan buh ka jingkut ïa kata ka proberb . Yn ym ïai kren shuh ïa ka da lei lei ha Israel . Pynban to ïathuh ïa ki : Ka por ka la wan , bad ki jingïathuhlypa ki la urlong shisha !

translation.en: And they said , An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and also drew water enough for us , and watered the flock .
translation.kha: Uwei u nong Ijipt u pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongap langbrot ,  ki jubab ;  u pyntong um lem ïa ngi , bad u ïarap ai um de ïa ki jingri jong ngi .

translation.en: For the  Lord  knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .
translation.kha: Ïa kiba hok la ïalam lynti bad ïada da U  Trai  , hynrei kiba sniew ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot jong ki .

translation.en: I sent Moses also and Aaron , and I plagued Egypt , according to that which I did among them : and afterward I brought you out .
translation.kha: Kham hadien , nga la phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad nga la wallam ka jingjynjar bakhraw halor ka Ijipt .

translation.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave , and the noise of thy viols : the worm is spread under thee , and the worms cover thee .
translation.kha: Me la mlien ban ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ki sur jingtem ki duitara , hynrei mynta hangne me don ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Me thiah ha ka jingthiah jong ki ksaiñ bad la tap nep da ki wieh .’

translation.en: Say not ye , There are yet four months , and then cometh harvest ? behold , I say unto you , Lift up your eyes , and look on the fields  ; for they are white already to harvest .
translation.kha: Phi don ka jingong , ‘ Sa saw bnai bad nangta pat ka aïom ot .’ Hynrei nga ong ïa phi , to da khmih ïa ki lyngkha ; ki jingthung mynta ki la ih bad ki la dei ban ot !

translation.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar u briew kam lah ban jop ïa ka jingthmu bahok jong U Blei .

translation.en: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty , and drink the blood of the princes of the earth , of rams , of lambs , and of goats , of bullocks , all of them fatlings of Bashan .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban bam ïa ki met jong ki shipai bad dih ïa ka snam jong ki nongsynshar ka pyrthei , ïa ki baroh yn pynïap kumba pynïap ïa ki langbrot shynrang ne ki khunlangbrot ne ki blang ne ki masi dab kiba sngaid .

translation.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael , an hundred and thirty and seven years : and he gave up the ghost and died  ; and was gathered unto his people .
translation.kha: U Ishmael u ïap haba u la dap shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .

translation.en: Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Take from hence thirty men with thee , and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon , before he die .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la hukum ïa u Ebedmelekh ban shim bad u lai ngut ki rangbah bad ban tan noh ïa nga na ka pung shuwa ba ngan ïap .

translation.en: I will overturn , overturn , overturn , it : and it shall be no more , until he come whose right it is  ; and I will give it him .
translation.kha: Ka jingjot , ka jingjot ! Ho-oid , ngan pynlong ïa ka nongbah ka jot . Hynrei kane kan ym jia tad haduh ba uta uba nga la jied ban pynshitom ïa ka nongbah u la wan . Nangta ngan sa ai ïa ka ha u .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim , and Ashtoreth , and the gods of Syria , and the gods of Zidon , and the gods of Moab , and the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines , and forsook the  Lord  , and served not him .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba mane ïa ki Baal bad ïa ki Astarte , lem bad ïa ki blei jong ki Syria , jong ki Sidon , jong ki Moab , jong ki Ammon , bad jong ki Philistia . Ki la iehnoh ïa U  Trai  bad ki la sangeh ban mane ïa u .

translation.en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel , and slew the men of the city .
translation.kha: U la pyntwa ruh ïa u mot ha Penuel bad pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: And give occasions of speech against her , and bring up an evil name upon her , and say , I took this woman , and when I came to her , I found her not a maid :
translation.kha: bad u pynbudnam ïa ka bad u kynnoh sniew ïa ka da kaba ong nga la shim ïa kane ka briew hynrei haba nga leit sha ka ngam shem ïa ki dak ka jinglong sotti jong ka .

translation.en: Behold therefore , I will gather thee unto thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace  ; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place . And they brought the king word again .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ngan wallam ha Jerusalem kan nym wan haduh hadien ka jingïap jong phi . Ngan shah ïa phi ban ïap ha kaba suk .  Ki rangbah ki leit phai pat sha u syiem Josaïah bad kane ka khubor .

translation.en: By what way is the light parted , which scattereth the east wind upon the earth ?
translation.kha: Hato me la ju poi sha ka jaka ha kaba ka sngi ka wan mih , lane sha ka jaka na kaba ka lyer mihngi ka beh ?

translation.en: And Moses gat him into the camp , he and the elders of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , See , I have made thee a god to Pharaoh : and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan pynlong ïa me kum U Blei ha u Pharaoh , bad u Aaron u hynmen jong me un kren ha u kum u nongïathuhlypa jong me .

translation.en: And he said , I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills , as sheep that have not a shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master : let them return every man to his house in peace .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki Israel ba ki sakma ha ki lum kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Bad U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim don nongïalam ; ai kin leit phai noh sha ïing da kaba suk .’

translation.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , and say unto them , Ye shall be holy : for I the  Lord  your God am holy .
translation.kha: Long kiba khuid , namar nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga long uba khuid .

translation.en: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel , saying , Beware that thou pass not such a place  ; for thither the Syrians are come down .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Elisha u phah ktien sha u syiem ka Israel , da kaba maham ïa u ban ym leit sha jan kata ka jaka , namar ba ki Syria ki ap ktem hangta .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the Philistine arose , and came and drew nigh to meet David , that David hasted , and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine .
translation.kha: U Goliath u sdang ban wan tur sha khmat sha u Dabid , bad u Dabid u mareh stet sha ka madan thma ban ïaleh ïa u .

translation.en: But if ye say unto me , We trust in the  Lord  our God : is not that he , whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away , and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem , Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki bteng ,  Lane phin ïathuh ïa nga ba phi shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ? Ka dei ki jaka mane ïa U  Trai  bad ki duwan kiba u Hesekaïah u la pynjot , haba u ïathuh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban mane tang ha ka duwan ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people , and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver  ; yea , even their servants bare rule over the people : but so did not I , because of the fear of God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u lat uba don ha ka kam ha shuwa jong nga , u la long ka jingbankhia ïa ki briew bad ki ju dawa sawphew ki pisa rupa shi sngi na ka bynta ka jingbam bad ka waiñ . Wat ki shakri jong ki , ki ju banbeiñ ïa ki briew . Hynrei ngam shym leh kumta , namar nga burom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And supper being ended , the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , to betray him  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu bad la ki synran ki dang ïabam jingbam miet . U Ksuid u la bsuh lypa ha ka dohnud jong u Judas , u khun jong u Simon Iskariot , ka jingpyrkhat ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  the maker thereof , the  Lord  that formed it , to establish it  ; the  Lord  is his name  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  , uba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uba la pynlong ïa ka bad buh ïa ka ha la ka jaka , u la kren ha nga . Uta uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  , u la ong ,

translation.en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , what the  Lord  saith unto me , that will I speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Katba im U  Trai  , nga kular ban ong ïa kaei kaba u ïathuh ïa nga !

translation.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib .
translation.kha: Phi ïamihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ha kane ka sngi jong u bnai uba nyngkong , u bnai Abib .

translation.en: And he said , I may not return with thee , nor go in with thee : neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place :
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u jubab ,  Ngam lah ban leit sha ïing bad phi lane pdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong phi .

translation.en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ïa u Joab ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei .

translation.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah , and built Ramah , to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u syiem ka Israel u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad sdang ban tei kut ïa ka Ramah khnang ban khang noh ïa ka jingïaid lynti shapoh bad shabar ka Judah .

translation.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour : but a man of understanding holdeth his peace .
translation.kha: Ka long bieit ban krenbeiñ ïa kiwei . Lada phi long uba sngewthuh , phin shu sngap jar jar .

translation.en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did  ; they departed not from them  ;
translation.kha: Ki bud ïa u Jeroboam bad ki ïai bteng ban leh ïa ki pop baroh ba u la leh ,

translation.en: The  Lord  God of heaven , which took me from my father s house , and from the land of my kindred , and which spake unto me , and that sware unto me , saying , Unto thy seed will I give this land  ; he shall send his angel before thee , and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei jong ka bneng , u la ïalam noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga bad na ka ri ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad u la kular skhem ha nga ba un ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Un phah ïa u angel jong u ha shuwa jong me , ba me lah ban pynïoh hangta ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga .

translation.en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread , to slay the souls that should not die , and to save the souls alive that should not live , by your lying to my people that hear your lies ?
translation.kha: Phi pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat ki briew jong nga khnang ban ïoh katto katne kham u barli bad khyndiat tylli ki lyngkhot kpu . Phi pynïap ïa ki briew ki bym dei hok ban ïap , bad phi pynsah im ïa ki briew ki bym dei hok ban im . Kumta phi ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ki briew jong nga , bad ki ngeit ïa phi .

translation.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him , with the pieces thereof , and the head : and he burnt them upon the altar .
translation.kha: Ki ai ha u ïa ka khlieh bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngkhot doh , bad u thang ïa ki ha ka duwan .

translation.en: Now these are the nations which the  Lord  left , to prove Israel by them , even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan  ;
translation.kha: Kumta te , U  Trai  u iehnoh katto katne ki jaitbynriew ha ka ri ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel ki bym pat mad ïa ki thma ha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh , Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women  ; for they are lively , and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them .
translation.kha: Kita ki nongpynkha khun ki jubab ,  Ki kynthei Hebru kim long kum ki kynthei Ijipt ; ki kha suk ïa ki khun , bad katba ngin da poi ma ngi , ki la lah kha .

translation.en: Dimnah with her suburbs , Nahalal with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Dimnah , bad ka Nahalal , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you , and the stranger that shall come from a far land , shall say , when they see the plagues of that land , and the sicknesses which the  Lord  hath laid upon it  ;
translation.kha: Ha ki pateng ki ban wan , ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ki nongwei na ki ri kiba jngai kin ïohi ïa ki jingpynjot bad ki jingshah shitom ba U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: Beareth all things , believeth all things , hopeth all things , endureth all things .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit kam sangeh noh shiteng ; bad ka jingngeit , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingïaishah jong ka kim duh noh .

translation.en: And all wept , and bewailed her : but he said ,  Weep not  ; she is not dead , but sleepeth .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba don hangta ki la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khynnah . U Jisu u la ong ,  Wat ïam ; ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !

translation.en: And he said , An hundred measures of oil . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and sit down quickly , and write fifty .
translation.kha: ‘ Shispah pipa ka umphniang Olib ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ha u ; ‘ to shong bad thoh sanphew .’

translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time .
translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab ,  Ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai ha phi ha kane ka por kam long kaba bha .

translation.en: Pilate answered , What I have written I have written .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la jubab ,  Ïa kaei kaba nga la thoh , la thoh .

translation.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats , and exalted them of low degree .
translation.kha: U la pynhiar ïa ki syiem bakhrawbor na ki khet jong ki , bad u la kyntiew shajrong ïa kiba rangli .

translation.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers : all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .
translation.kha: Ki misteri liengbah na Biblos ki long ki rangbah ba la ïoh jinghikai bha . Ki maji na baroh ki liengbah duriaw ki la ïakhaïi pateng ha ki dukan jong pha .

translation.en: And when the people complained , it displeased the  Lord  : and the  Lord  heard it  ; and his anger was kindled  ; and the fire of the  Lord  burnt among them , and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sdang ban ujor ha U  Trai  shaphang ki jingjynjar jong ki . Haba U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la bitar lep bad u phah da ka ding ha kita ki paidbah . Kata ka ding ka klang hapdeng jong ki bad ka la pynjot ïa kawei ka dong jong ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: And Samuel took a sucking lamb , and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the  Lord  : and Samuel cried unto the  Lord  for Israel  ; and the  Lord  heard him .
translation.kha: U Samuel u pynïap uwei u khunlangbrot bad u thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingkñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Nangta u duwai ha U  Trai  ban ïarap ïa ki Israel , bad U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .

translation.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil  ; and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .
translation.kha: Nalor kita , u don ki ïing kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta u kew , ka waiñ , bad umphniang Olib , ki sem masi , bad ki jaka set ïa ki langbrot jong u .

translation.en: And they cried out all at once , saying , Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas :
translation.kha: Ki paidbah baroh ki la pyrta ,  Pynïap ïa u ! Pyllait ïa u Barabbas ha ngi !

translation.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt  ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron u rah ïa la u diengduh halor kita ki um ; te ki jakoid ki ïamih bad ki tap lin ïa kata ka ri .

translation.en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob , and hath not pitied : he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah  ; he hath brought them down to the ground : he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet lynter ka ïam ; ki ummat ki tuid ha ki ngab jong ka . Na baroh ki paralok jong ka kiba mynshuwa , ym don iwei ruh iba sah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Kiba ïateh lok bad ka ki la shetkylla ïa ka bad baroh ki la long pyrshah ïa ka mynta .

translation.en: And when he had made an end of prophesying , he came to the high place .
translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u la dep kata ka jingïashad shongshit bad ka jingrisa , u leit kiew sha ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum .

translation.en: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah , saying , Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah , which is before Jeshimon ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Siph ki wan sha u Saul ha Gibeah bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Dabid u dang rieh ha u Lum Hakhilah ha tduh jong ka ri khlaw Judia .

translation.en: And thine elder sister is Samaria , she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand : and thy younger sister , that dwelleth at thy right hand , is Sodom and her daughters .
translation.kha: Ka hynmen jong pha , ka dei ka Samaria ha ka phang bashatei , ryngkat bad ki nongrit jong ka . Ka para jong pha lem bad ki nongrit jong ka , ka dei ka Sodom ha ka phang bashathie .

translation.en: Then said Samuel to the people , Come , and let us go to Gilgal , and renew the kingdom there .
translation.kha: Bad u Samuel u ong ha ki ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad sa shisien ngin pynbna ïa u Saul kum u syiem jong ngi .

translation.en: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together , and to stand for their life , to destroy , to slay , and to cause to perish , all the power of the people and province that would assault them , both little ones and women , and to take the spoil of them for a prey ,
translation.kha: Kine ki shithi ki batai ba u syiem u shah ïa ki Jiw ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ban ïalumlang para ma ki ban ïada ïa lade . Lada ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ha kano kano ka probins ki tur ïaleh ïa ki rangbah Jiw , ïa ki khun jong ki ne ïa ki kynthei jong ki , ki Jiw ki lah ban ïaleh pyrshah bad pynjot ïa kiba wan ïaleh pyrshah ; ki lah ban pynïap ïa baroh na ki bad shim ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki .

translation.en: Know that thus saith the  Lord  of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David , and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity  ;
translation.kha: Pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang u syiem uba synshar ïa ka hima kaba u Dabid u la synshar bad shaphang ki briew jong kane ka nongbah , kata , ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi ki bym shym la shah rah noh kum ki koidi lem bad phi .

translation.en: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins ,
translation.kha: ban ïathuh ha ki briew jong u ba yn pynim ïa ki da kaba ki ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus , saith the  Lord  , whose name is The God of hosts .
translation.kha: haba ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha ka ri sha lyndet ka Damaskos ,  ong U  Trai  , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Have faith in God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  To don ka jingngeit ha U Blei .

translation.en: Even when I remember I am afraid , and trembling taketh hold on my flesh .
translation.kha: Haba nga pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa nga , ngam sngewlah pyrkhat shuh , nga kyiuh bad nga kyrngah .

translation.en: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort : yea , and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus , because his spirit was refreshed by you all .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba la pynshlur ïa ngi . Ym tang ba la pynshlur ïa ngi ; haduh katno u Titos u la pynkmen ïa ngi da ka jingkmen jong u halor ka rukom kaba phi baroh phi la ïarap ban pynkmen ïa u !

translation.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa ki ban mihnoh na ka kamra ka Dorbar , bad nangta ki la sdang ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki .

translation.en: And her husband arose , and went after her , to speak friendly unto her , and to bring her again , having his servant with him , and a couple of asses : and she brought him into her father s house : and when the father of the damsel saw him , he rejoiced to meet him .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew u leit bud ïa ka bad u pyrshang ban khroh ïa ka ba kan wan phai pat sha u . U ïalam bad u ïa uwei u shakri bad ar tylli ki kada . Ka kynthei ka ïalam ïa u Lebi sha ïing , bad haba u kpa jong ka u ïohi ïa u , u pdiang sngewbha ïa u da kaba kmen .

translation.en: All flesh is not the same flesh : but there is one kind of flesh of men , another flesh of beasts , another of fishes , and another of birds .
translation.kha: Bad ka doh jong ki kynja ba-im kam long kajuh ka jait ; u bynriew u don kawei ka jait doh , ki mrad da kawei pat , ki sim da kawei , bad ki dohkha da kawei pat .

translation.en: Heshbon with her suburbs , Jazer with her suburbs  ; four cities in all .
translation.kha: ka Heshbon , bad ka Jaser , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: Now is she without , now in the streets , and lieth in wait at every corner . )
translation.kha: lane ka ïeng apthap ha kyndong , teng teng ha ki surok bah , bad teng teng ha ka jaka ïew .

translation.en: And she wept before him the seven days , while their feast lasted : and it came to pass on the seventh day , that he told her , because she lay sore upon him : and she told the riddle to the children of her people .
translation.kha: Ka la ïam shaphang kata ha baroh kita ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai . Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u ïathuh ha ka , ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip , naba ka ïai thlia ïa u katta katta . Nangta ka ïathuh pat ha kita ki Philistia .

translation.en: And do this thing , Take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their rooms :
translation.kha: Mynta , weng noh ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki nongsynshar na ka kyrdan ai hukum bad bujli noh ïa ki da ki rangbah ai hukum na madan thma .

translation.en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  God of our fathers , the  Lord  heard our voice , and looked on our affliction , and our labour , and our oppression :
translation.kha: Te ngi kyang sha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ban ïarap ïa ngi . U la shahshkor ïa ngi , bad u la ïohi ba ngi shah jynjar , ngi hap trei shitom , bad ngi shah lehbeiñ .

translation.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters : so doth the grave those which have sinned .
translation.kha: Kumba ka ïor ka jah noh ha ka jingshit bad ka jingryngkhiang , kumjuh ruh u nongpop u jah noh na ka ri jong kiba im .

translation.en: The pure candlestick , with the lamps thereof , even with the lamps to be set in order , and all the vessels thereof , and the oil for light ,
translation.kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , ïa ki sharak jong u , ïa ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ïa ka umphniang ïa ki sharak jong u ;

translation.en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies  ; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them  ; and they shall flee , as fleeing from a sword  ; and they shall fall when none pursueth .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ha kito na phi kiba dang sah ha ka jinglongmraw ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw kat haduh ba ka jingriew ka sla dieng ha ka jingbeh ka lyer kan pynher krad ïa phi . Phin her ïap la kumba shah beh ha madan thma , bad phin kyllon haba u nongshun um pat don hajan .

translation.en: And upon every high tower , and upon every fenced wall ,
translation.kha: ïa uwei pa uwei u mot bakynjang , bad ïa ki kynroh jong kawei pa kawei ka kut .

translation.en: But he saith unto them ,  It is I  ; be not afraid .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  dei ma nga !

translation.en: After this manner therefore pray ye : Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name .
translation.kha: Kane keiñ , ka long kumno phi dei ban duwai :   ‘ Ko Kpa jong ngi uba ha bneng : Ai ba ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me kan long kaba la pyndonburom ;

translation.en: But if a man be just , and do that which is lawful and right ,
translation.kha: Tharai don u briew uba bha shisha , uba hok bad uba beit .

translation.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom , seeing he hath no heart to it ?
translation.kha: Kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha lada pynlut pisa ha ka jingpynnang pynstad ïa uba bieit , namar um don jingshemphang satia .

translation.en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb : in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the  Lord  for a drink offering .
translation.kha: Kum ka jingainguh da ka waiñ lem bad u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , theh shi litar ka waiñ ha ka duwan .

translation.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the  Lord  , to do evil in his sight ? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword , and hast taken his wife to be thy wife , and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Balei te ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ? Balei ba me la leh ïa kane ka kam bymman ? Me la pynlong ïa u Uriah ban shah pynïap ha ka thma ; me la shah ïa ki Ammon ban pynïap ïa u , bad nangta me shim ïa ka tnga jong u !

translation.en: Therefore turn thou to thy God : keep mercy and judgment , and wait on thy God continually .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , shaniah ha U Blei jong phi bad wan phai pat sha u . Long kiba ïaineh bad kiba lehhok , bad ap da kaba ïaishah ïa U Blei jong phi ban leh .

translation.en: And there went a man of the house of Levi , and took to wife a daughter of Levi .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , uwei u briew na ka jait Lebi u shongkurim ïa ka khun jong uwei u Lebi bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Behold , thou art with child , and shalt bear a son , and shalt call his name Ishmael  ; because the  Lord  hath heard thy affliction .
translation.kha: Phan sa ïoh khun shynrang , bad phan khot kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael , namar U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud sngew jynjar jong pha .

translation.en: And being fully persuaded that , what he had promised , he was able also to perform .
translation.kha: U la thikna bha ba U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular .

translation.en: And after that they had mocked him , they took the robe off from him , and put his own raiment on him , and led him away to crucify him .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la dep pyrthuh beiñ ïa u , ki la weng noh ïa ka jaiñkup bad ki la pynphong biang ïa u da ki jaiñ jong u . Nangta ki la ïalam ïa u shabar ban sahnarphna ïa u .

translation.en: The king of Aphek , one  ; the king of Lasharon , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Aphek , ka Lasharon ,

translation.en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari , whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: da kaba siewdor ïa uwei uwei san shekel ka rupa kat kum ka jingthew kaba buh ryntih ,

translation.en: The sting of death is sin ; and the strength of sin is the law .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ïoh na ka pop ïa ka bor ban pynmong , bad ka pop ka ïoh ïa ka bor jong ka na ka Hukum .

translation.en: I should have been as though I had not been  ; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave .
translation.kha: Ban leit beit na ka kpoh sha ka jingtep , kan jin da la long kaba bha kum ka bym shym don .

translation.en: Now it came to pass on the third day , that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king s house , over against the king s house : and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house , over against the gate of the house .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai jong ka jingshah jingit , ka Esther ka phong ïa ki jingriam syiem jong ka bad ka leit bad ïeng ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka ïingsyiem , kaba phai khmat sha ka kamra ba don ka khet syiem . U syiem u don hapoh , u shong halor ka khet syiem , da kaba phai khmat sha ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And I looked , and , lo , a Lamb stood on the mount Sion , and with him an hundred forty and four thousand , having his Father s name written in their foreheads .
translation.kha: Te nga la peit , bad la don U Khunlangbrot uba ïeng halor u lum Seïon ; lem bad u la don shi lakh sawphew saw hajar ngut ki briew kiba la don ïa ka kyrteng jong u , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong U Kpa jong u ïa kaba la thoh ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .

translation.en: And Moses said , It is not meet so to do  ; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the  Lord  our God : lo , shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes , and will they not stone us ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ba ngin leh kumta , namar ki nong Ijipt kin thut haba ngin kñia ïa ki mrad kiba ngi ai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .
