Lada ngi pyndonkam ïa kine ki mrad bad pynmong ïa ki nong Ijipt da kaba kñia ïa kine ki jingri ha ka jaka ba ki lah ban ïohi , kin sa lynthem maw ïa ngi .

translation.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting .
translation.kha: Hynrei tang ka jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit kaba lah ban beh noh shabar ïa une u jait ; ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba lah .

translation.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice , and stopped their ears , and ran upon him with one accord ,

translation.en: Run now , I pray thee , to meet her , and say unto her , Is it well with thee ? is it well with thy husband ? is it well with the child ? And she answered , It is well .

translation.en: And thou , son of man , be not afraid of them , neither be afraid of their words , though briers and thorns be with thee , and thou dost dwell among scorpions : be not afraid of their words , nor be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .

translation.en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What is this ? that thou shalt say unto him , By strength of hand the  Lord  brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage :
translation.kha: Hadien habud , ynda u khun jong phi u kylli ïa phi ka mut aïu kane ka jingrakhe , phin jubab ïa u , ‘ Da kaba pyndonkam ïa la ka borbah , U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba ngi la long ki mraw .

translation.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself , and the fat of that which is torn with beasts , may be used in any other use : but ye shall in no wise eat of it .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khleiñ jong uno uno u jait mrad uba shu ïap hi ne uba la shah pynïap ha u mradkhlaw ym dei ban bam , hynrei lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei pat ki jingthmu .

translation.en: And Heber begat Japhlet , and Shomer , and Hotham , and Shua their sister .
translation.kha: U Heber u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Japhlet , u Shomer , bad u Hotham , bad kawei ka khun , ka Shua .

translation.en: The word that the  Lord  spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha nga shaphang ka nongbah Babilon bad ki briew jong ka :

translation.en: And she said , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awoke out of his sleep , and said , I will go out as at other times before , and shake myself . And he wist not that the  Lord  was departed from him .
translation.kha: Nangta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  U khie joit bad u pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynsynjor bad pyllait war , kumba mynshuwa .  Um shym tip ba U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa u .

translation.en: Pilate saith unto them , What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ ? They all say unto him , Let him be crucified .
translation.kha: Kaei , te , ngan leh ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?   Sahnarphna ïa u !  Baroh ki la jubab .

translation.en: And it shall be at that day , saith the  Lord  , that thou shalt call me Ishi  ; and shalt call me no more Baali .
translation.kha: Nangta sa shisien pat kan sa khot biang ïa nga u tnga jong ka — kan ym khot shuh ïa nga u Baal jong ka .

translation.en: How can you benefit from their visits ?
translation.kha: Kumno phin ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingwan jong ki ?

translation.en: Shew me the tribute money .  And they brought unto him a penny .
translation.kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa ka pisa na ka bynta ban siew ïa ka khajna !  Ki la wanrah ha u ïa ka pisa ,

translation.en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent , and turn away from his fierce anger , that we perish not ?
translation.kha: Lehse U Blei un kylla ka jingmut jong u ; lehse un sangeh noh na kaba bitar , bad ngin ym ïap !

translation.en: There shall no evil befall thee , neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling .
translation.kha: bad kumta ka jingpynjot kan ym shoh ïa me , ka jingleh jubor kan ym wan hajan ka ïing jong me .

translation.en: All things were made by him  ; and without him was not any thing made that was made .
translation.kha: Da u , la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ; ym don kawei ruh na ka jingpynlong baroh kaba la thaw khlem ma u .

translation.en: They that go down to the sea in ships , that do business in great waters  ;
translation.kha: Katto katne ki leit da ka liengbah halor ka duriaw-bah , ki trei na ka bynta ka jingim jong ki ha ki duriaw-rit .

translation.en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance , and joined affinity with Ahab .
translation.kha: Haba u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u la riewspah bad pawnam , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingshongkurim hapdeng u dkhot ka longïing jong u bad ka longïing u Ahab u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven : and the  Lord  sent thunder and hail , and the fire ran along upon the ground  ; and the  Lord  rained hail upon the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u rah ïa la u diengduh shajrong , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u pyrthat bad ïa u phria , bad ka leilieh ruh ka la tied ïa ka khyndew . U  Trai  u phah ïa u phria uba jur , lem bad ka leilieh kaba thaba .

translation.en: And I beheld , and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders : and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand , and thousands of thousands  ;
translation.kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki angel , da ki hajar bad ki million na ki ! Ki la ïeng sawdong ka khet , ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ki nongsharai balang ,

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise in the congregation of saints .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai ïa U  Trai  ; to ïaroh ïa u ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew baïaineh jong u !

translation.en: He will swallow up death in victory  ; and the Lord  God  will wipe away tears from off all faces  ; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar un pynkut noh ïa ka jingïap junom ! Un ñiad noh ïa ki ummat na ki khmat jong baroh bad un weng noh ïa ka jingjahburom kaba ki briew jong u ki la shah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U  Trai  hi da lade u la kren !

translation.en: And Abraham said , Because I thought , Surely the fear of God is not in this place  ; and they will slay me for my wife s sake .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  Nga la pyrkhat ba yn ym don hangne kiba sheptieng burom ïa U Blei , ba kumta kin pynïap ïa nga ban ïoh ïa ka tnga jong nga .

translation.en: So he set it before them , and they did eat , and left thereof , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u shakri u buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat jong ki , bad , kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , baroh ki la bam bad dang don bun kaba sah tam .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron did as the  Lord  commanded them , so did they .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan , and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water , ( for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest , )
translation.kha: Ka dei ka aïom ot , bad ka wah ka don ha ka jingshlei um . Haba u paidbah u la mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ban jam ïa ka Jordan , ki lyngdoh ki la leit ha shuwa jong ki , ki da bah ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang . Hamar ba ki lyngdoh ki ïuh ha ka wah ,

translation.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house  ; but he that hateth gifts shall live .
translation.kha: Kaba pyrshang ban ïohnong da ka bymhok , ka pynngat ïa la ka longïing ha ka jingjynjar . Wat bamsap bad phin ïoh im slem .

translation.en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ai hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Yet they went in unto her , as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot : so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah , the lewd women .
translation.kha: Ki leit phai bad ïai leit sha kine ki nuti . Ki leit biang sha ka Oholah bad ka Oholibah ; kito ki kynthei barunar .

translation.en: And he stood between the dead and the living  ; and the plague was stayed .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynsangeh ïa ka khlam bad u la shu ïeng hapdeng kiba im bad kiba ïap .

translation.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven , and when thou seest the sun , and the moon , and the stars , even all the host of heaven , shouldest be driven to worship them , and serve them , which the  Lord  thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven .
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym shah pynshoi kat haduh ban da mane bad shakri ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi ha sahit bneng — la ka long ka sngi , u bnai , lane ki khlur , ïa kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha kiwei pat ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba kin ïoh mane .

translation.en: O  Lord  , thou hast seen my wrong : judge thou my cause .
translation.kha: To bishar ha ka liang jong nga ; me tip ïa ki jingbakla kiba la leh pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And , behold , I will lay bands upon thee , and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another , till thou hast ended the days of thy siege .
translation.kha: Ngan teh ngan khum ïa me kumta ba men ym lah ban phai na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , tad ynda la pynkut ïa ka jingshah kerkut .

translation.en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us , to be one people , if every male among us be circumcised , as they are circumcised .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki briew ki kohnguh ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong ngi tang ha ka kyndon ba ngin otsher ïa ki shynrang jong ngi baroh , kumba ki ruh ki la shah otsher .

translation.en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her , and commended her before Pharaoh : and the woman was taken into Pharaoh s house .
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar ki la ïohi ïa ka bad ki la ïathuh ha u syiem haduh katno ka la long kaba bhabriew ; kumta te ki la ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïing u syiem .

translation.en: And Balak sent yet again princes , more , and more honourable than they .
translation.kha: Nangta u Balak u la phah kham bun ki nongïalam kiba kham pawkhmat ban ïa kito kiba mynshuwa .

translation.en: And ye shall smite every fenced city , and every choice city , and shall fell every good tree , and stop all wells of water , and mar every good piece of land with stones .
translation.kha: Phin jop ïa baroh ki nongbah ba-itynnat jong ki ïa kiba la ker kynroh ; phin pom ïa baroh ki diengsoh jong ki , phin pynsangeh ïa baroh ki umpohliew jong ki ; bad phin pynjot ïa baroh ki lyngkha baseisoh jong ki da kaba tap ïa ki da ki maw .

translation.en: When you meet members of our local congregation , try to get to know them better .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïakynduh ïa ki dkhot ka balang jong ngi , pyrshang ban tip kham bha ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  came down in the pillar of the cloud , and stood in the door of the tabernacle , and called Aaron and Miriam : and they both came forth .
translation.kha: Ki la leit , bad U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u rishot lyoh , u la ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad u pyrta  Aaron ! Miriam !  Baroh ar ngut ki wan sha khmat ,

translation.en: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart , to keep thy commandments , thy testimonies , and thy statutes , and to do all these things , and to build the palace , for the which I have made provision .
translation.kha: Ai ha u Solomon u khun jong nga ka jingkwah naduh ka dohnud ban kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me la hukum bad ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa kaba nga la pynlong kine ki jingpynkhreh .

translation.en: And the whole earth was of one language , and of one speech .
translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong , ki briew ha ka pyrthei baroh ki la don tang kawei ka ktien ka thylliej bad pyndonkam ïa kijuh ki kyntien .

translation.en: And unto man he said , Behold , the fear of the Lord , that is wisdom  ; and to depart from evil is understanding .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ïa ki briew ,  Ban long uba stad , phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai . Ban shemphang , phi dei ban phai noh na kaba sniew .

translation.en: And also that nation , whom they shall serve , will I judge : and afterward shall they come out with great substance .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba teh mraw ïa ki , bad haba kin ïamihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei , kin da kit ruh shibun ka spah .

translation.en: How many apples are there in my hand ?
translation.kha: Katno tylli ki soh apple ki don ha ka kti jong nga ?

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will bring again the captivity of Jacob s tents , and have mercy on his dwellingplaces  ; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap , and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan buh pat ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri jong ki bad ngan isynei ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing ; ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat , bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong ka yn pynbha pat .

translation.en: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and smote the waters , and said , Where is the  Lord  God of Elijah ? and when he also had smitten the waters , they parted hither and thither : and Elisha went over .
translation.kha: U la tied ïa ka um da ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah , bad u ong ,  Hangno U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Elijah ?  Nangta u la tied biang ïa ka um , bad ka la kad arliang , bad u la ïaid sha shiliang .

translation.en: And the curious girdle of the ephod , which is upon it , shall be of the same , according to the work thereof  ; even of gold , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
translation.kha: Ïa u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha da kijuh ki tiar dei ban pyndait ha ka ephod khnang ba kan ïalong kawei ka lyngkhot bad ka .

translation.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving , and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms .
translation.kha: To ngin ïawan ha khmat jong u da ka jingainguh bad rwai kmen da ki jingrwai ïaroh !

translation.en: And Moses said , Let no man leave of it till the morning .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki ,  Uno uno ruh um dei ban pynsah ïa ka wat tang khyndiat ruh na ka bynta kaba la shai .

translation.en: Ye have been rebellious against the  Lord  from the day that I knew you .
translation.kha: Naduh ba nga la ithuh ïa phi , phi shait ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel  ; After those days , saith the  Lord  , I will put my law in their inward parts , and write it in their hearts  ; and will be their God , and they shall be my people .
translation.kha: Ka jutang bathymmai kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel kan long kane : Ngan buh ïa ka aiñ jong nga hapoh jong ki bad thoh ïa ka ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a man shall nourish a young cow , and two sheep  ;
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , wat lada u nongrep u lah ban pynsah im tang iwei i khun masi bad ar tylli ki blang ,

translation.en: Then I said unto them , What is the high place whereunto ye go ? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ïa ki : Kine ki jaka bajrong sha kiba phi leit ki dei kiei ? Kumta la khot ïa kine ‘ Ki jaka bajrong’ naduh kata ka por .

translation.en: And the  Lord  stirred up an adversary unto Solomon , Hadad the Edomite : he was of the king s seed in Edom .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la pynjia ba u Hadad , na ka longïing syiem jong u Edom , ban phai pyrshah ïa u Solomon .

translation.en: All we like sheep have gone astray  ; we have turned every one to his own way  ; and the  Lord  hath laid on him the iniquity of us all .
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi la long kum ki langbrot ba la sakma , uwei pa uwei na ngi u leit ha la ka jong ka lynti . Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynlong ba ka jingpynshitom kan hap halor jong u , ka jingpynshitom kaba baroh ngi dei hok ban ïoh .

translation.en: These four were born to the giant in Gath , and fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
translation.kha: Kine saw ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ramhah ka Gath , bad ki la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ha ki rangbah jong u .

translation.en: As a cage is full of birds , so are their houses full of deceit : therefore they are become great , and waxen rich .
translation.kha: Kumba u nongriam sim u pyndap ïa ka ruh jong u da ki sim , ki la pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka jinglute . Dei kata keiñ balei ba ki long kiba donbor bad kiba riewspah ,

translation.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel , and because of their transgressions in all their sins : and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation , that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam namar ka jingbymkhuid jong ki Israel bad namar ki pop jong ki baroh . U dei ban leh kumne ha ka Ïingjaiñ namar ka ïeng hapdeng ka jaka shong dara , ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka long ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: Afterward came also the other virgins , saying , Lord , Lord , open to us .
translation.kha: Hadien la wan poi kita kiwei pat ki theisotti . ‘ Ko kynrad , ko Kynrad ! to plie ïa ngi !’ ki la pyrta jam .

translation.en: And Joram slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David : and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoram u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering .
translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong ka bad un pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: And he said , Behold , I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation : for at the time appointed the end shall be .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Nga pyn-i ha me ïa kaei kaba mih na ka jingbitar U Blei kan long . Ka jingïohipaw ka kdew ïa ka por jong ka jingkut .

translation.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way , where was a cave  ; and Saul went in to cover his feet : and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave .
translation.kha: U wan poi ha ka krem hajan ki katto katne ki jaka set blang kiba harud lynti , bad u rung shapoh ban leit shabar   . Ka jia ryngkhat ba ka dei kajuh ka krem ha kaba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki rieh kham shapoh jong kata ka krem .

translation.en: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah .
translation.kha: Tang mar ïabna ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jong ka , ka Athalaïah , ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka la ai hukum ban pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem Judah .

translation.en: The Bible says : “The wolf will actually reside for a while with the male lamb , and with the kid the leopard itself will lie down , and the calf and the maned young lion and the well-fed animal all together  ; and a mere little boy will be leader over them .”—Isaiah 11 :6-9  ; Hosea 2 :18 .
translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka ong “Te u suri un shong lem bad u khun ‘ langbrot , u labasa ruh un dem bad u khun blang ; u khun masi bad u sing samla bad u masi sngaid lang bad u khynnah rit un ïalam ïa ki .” —Isaïah 11 :6-9 ; Hosea 2 :18 .

translation.en: And Saul said , Disperse yourselves among the people , and say unto them , Bring me hither every man his ox , and every man his sheep , and slay them here , and eat  ; and sin not against the  Lord  in eating with the blood . And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and slew them there .
translation.kha: Nangta u ai sa kawei ka hukum :  Khie leit sha ki briew bad ong ïa ki ban wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki langbrot hangne . Ki dei ban pynïap ïa ki bad bam ïa ki hangne ; kim dei ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .  Kumta ha kata ka miet baroh ki wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki pynïap ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears , and bucklers , and shields , that had been king David s , which were in the house of God .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh kiba dei ki jong u syiem Dabid bad kiba la buh ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that he took a thick cloth , and dipped it in water , and spread it on his face , so that he died : and Hazael reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Hasael u shim ïa ka jaiñkup thiah , u wieh ïa ka ha ka um , bad u tap khlup ïa u syiem haduh ba un da ïap op . Bad u Hasael u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki Israel ki sdang wanrah biang sha ki kamra buh tiar ïa kiba shiphew na u kew jong ki , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Seest thou these great buildings ? there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab  Phi ïoh kine ki jingtei bakhraw ? Ïa uwei u maw ruh yn ym iehnoh ha ka jaka jong u ; ïa uwei pa uwei na ki yn sa pynkhyllem noh .

translation.en: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father , saying , Thou hast clothing , be thou our ruler , and let this ruin be under thy hand :
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi ha kaba ki dkhot jong ka kur kin jied uwei napdeng jong ki bad ong ha u ,  Ma phi la kumno kumno phi don ei ei ban phong , kumta to long u nongïalam jong ngi ha kane ka por ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad , and said unto him , Go , carry them to the city .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ai ïa kita ki tiar ïaleh u ha uta u khynnah , bad u ong ïa u ban leit rah ïa ki baroh sha shnong .

translation.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship : and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went .
translation.kha: Nangta da kaba kmen ki la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng , bad kumta hi ka lieng ka la poi ha ryngkew ha ka jaka sha kaba ki thmu .

translation.en: Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , and Rabbah  ; two cities with their villages :
translation.kha: Don ka Kiriath Baal ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) bad ka Rabbah : ar tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore it shall come to pass , when the Egyptians shall see thee , that they shall say , This is his wife : and they will kill me , but they will save thee alive .
translation.kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt kin ïohi ïa pha , kin tharai ba pha dei ka tnga jong nga , bad kumta kin pynïap ïa nga bad shah ïa pha , ban im .

translation.en: So the spirit lifted me up , and took me away , and I went in bitterness , in the heat of my spirit  ; but the hand of the  Lord  was strong upon me .
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan ha nga da ka borbah , bad katba U Mynsiem jong u , u rah noh ïa nga , nga la sngewkthang bad sngewbitar .

translation.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it : Ahab went one way by himself , and Obadiah went another way by himself .
translation.kha: Ki la ïamynjur ïa kano ka bynta jong ka ri uwei uwei un leit wad , bad ki ïaleit sha la ka jong ka jong ka lad .

translation.en: But Elisha sat in his house , and the elders sat with him  ; and the king sent a man from before him : but ere the messenger came to him , he said to the elders , See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head ? look , when the messenger cometh , shut the door , and hold him fast at the door : is not the sound of his master s feet behind him ?
translation.kha: Bad u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban wallam ïa u Elisha . Ha kajuh ka por , u Elisha u don ha ïing lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san kiba dang wan jngoh ïa u . Shuwa ba u nonglamktien jong u syiem un poi , u Elisha u ong ha kita ki tymmen ki san ,  Uto u nongpynïap u la phah briew ban pynïap ïa nga ! Mynta , ynda uta u briew u poi hangne , khang ïa ka jingkhang bad wat shah ba un rung hapoh . U syiem da lade un wan nadien jong u .

translation.en: And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Nangno ngin ïoh bam kaba biang ha kane ka ri shyiap ban bsa ïa une u paidbah ?

translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  stood in a path of the vineyards , a wall being on this side , and a wall on that side .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u ïeng ha ka lynti kaba khim kaba don hapdeng ar tylli ki bri sohwaiñ ba la ker da ka kynroh maw baroh arliang .

translation.en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him , saying , Lord , behold , he whom thou lovest is sick .
translation.kha: Kita ki kynthei shi para ki la phah khubor sha U Jisu :  Ko Trai , u paralok uba me ieit u pang .

translation.en: And the people thirsted there for water  ; and the people murmured against Moses , and said , Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la thynrang palat bad ki la ïai khñium ha u Moses . Ki la ong ,  Balei keiñ ba phi wan ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap da ka jingsliang ïa ngi bad ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi , bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi ?

translation.en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way , at the head of the two ways , to use divination : he made his arrows bright , he consulted with images , he looked in the liver .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïeng hajan ka dak jingkdew ha kaba ka lynti ka ïakhlad . Ban tip shano ban leit , u pynkhih ïa ki khnam ; u wad jingmut na ki bleithaw jong u ; u khmih thuh ïa u khyllai jong u mrad ba la kñia .

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he dismissed the assembly .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kren ïa kane , u la pynwai ïa ka jingïalang .

translation.en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer : but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day , and serve under tribute .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym beh noh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha Geser ; kumta ki Kanaan ki la shong la sah hapdeng ki Ephraim haduh kane ka sngi , hynrei la pynbor ïa ki ban trei kum ki mraw .

translation.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps : and the land stank .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la lum thup ïa ki shi jaka jaka haduh ba la iwtung lut ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that they humbled themselves , the word of the  Lord  came to Shemaiah , saying , They have humbled themselves  ; therefore I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance  ; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kane , u kren sa shisien ha u Shemaïah bad u ong ha u ,  Namar ba ki phla ïa la ki pop , ngan ym pynjot ïa ki . Hynrei haba u Shishak u tur ïaleh , kin ym lait im .

translation.en: And there followed him a great company of people , and of women , which also bewailed and lamented him .
translation.kha: U paidbah babun u la bud ïa u ; hapdeng jong ki , la don katto katne ngut ki kynthei kiba la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Say not thou , I will recompense evil  ; but wait on the  Lord  , and he shall save thee .
translation.kha: Wat shim ha lade ban siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew . Shaniah ha U  Trai  bad un pynlong ïa ka kaba dei .

translation.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them , What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kren biang ha u paidbah ,  Kaei te , phi kwah ïa nga ban leh ïa uta uba phi khot u syiem jong ki Jiw ?

translation.en: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you : ye shall not sow , neither reap that which groweth of itself in it , nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban bet ha ki lyngkha jong phi lane ot ïa u kew uba shu mih hi lane kheit ïa ki soh na ki brisoh jong phi kiba phim shym la khyllad .

translation.en: Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :
translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi , la ïarap ïa nga da U Blei , bad kumta nga ïeng hangne ban ai ïa ka jingsakhi jong nga ha baroh , ha uba rit bad ha uba khraw kumjuh . Kaei kaba nga ong ka long kajuh hi kaba ki nongïathuhlypa bad u Moses ki la ong ba kan sa jia :

translation.en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after : and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things .
translation.kha: ( Naba kiba mane blei thala jong kane ka pyrthei ki ïai pyrkhat shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh . ) U Kpa jong phi u tip ba phi donkam ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: And it come to pass , when he heareth the words of this curse , that he bless himself in his heart , saying , I shall have peace , though I walk in the imagination of mine heart , to add drunkenness to thirst :
translation.kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don hangne mynta ka sngi uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jutang , pynban uba pynngeit ïa lade ba kaei kaei kan ym jia ïa u wat la u ïaid mon da ka dohnud kaba mutlop . Ka jingmih na kata kan long ba phi baroh phin jot thiaw , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh .

translation.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb .
translation.kha: Kumta hadien ba ki la mihnoh na u Lum Sinai , ki Israel kim deng jingdeng shuh .

translation.en: And to his father he sent after this manner  ; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt , and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way .
translation.kha: Ïa la u kpa ruh u phah lam shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa ki mar Ijipt kiba bha tam , bad shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa u kew , u kpu bad kiwei pat ki jait jingbam ba u kpa jong u un ïoh bam ha lynti .

translation.en: And here is the mind which hath wisdom . The seven heads are seven mountains , on which the woman sitteth .
translation.kha: Kane ka khot ïa ka jingstad bad jingshemphang . Ki hynñiew tylli ki khlieh ki long hynñiew tylli ki lum , ha kiba kata ka briew ka shong . Ki long ruh ki hynñiew ngut ki syiem :

translation.en: That led them through the deep , as an horse in the wilderness , that they should not stumble ?
translation.kha: Hangno u don U  Trai  , uba da ka bor jong u , u la leh ki kam bakhraw lyngba u Moses , u da kad arliang ïa ki um ka duriaw bad ïalam ïa ki briew jong u lyngba ki um kiba jylliew , ban ïoh ïa ka nam baneh junom na ka bynta ïa lade ?  Ha ka jingïalam U  Trai  , ki kjat jong ki , ki long skhem kum ki kulai khlaw , bad kim ju jynthut .

translation.en: The ark of the testimony , and the staves thereof , and the mercy seat ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki mawlyngkniap , ïa ki jingbah bad ïa ka jingtap jong ka ;

translation.en: Therefore many of them believed  ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .
translation.kha: Bun na ki , ki la ngeit , bad bun ki kynthei Grik kiba ha ka kyrdan ba-halor ha ka imlang ka sahlang bad bun ki rangbah Grik ruh ki la ngeit .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand , and was fled forth ,
translation.kha: Haba ka la ïohi ba u la iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup bad ba u la mareh shabar ïing ,

translation.en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  shall choose : because the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase , and in all the works of thine hands , therefore thou shalt surely rejoice .
translation.kha: Pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da kaba phi rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kata ka jaka mane Blei . To lehkmen , namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ki jingmih baroh ba phi la ïoh ot bad ïa ka kam jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Return unto thy rest , O my soul  ; for the  Lord  hath dealt bountifully with thee .
translation.kha: To sngewskhem , ko mynsiem jong nga , namar U  Trai  u la lehbha ïa nga .

translation.en: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month , which is the month Tebeth , in the seventh year of his reign .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong u Serksis kum u syiem , ha u Tebeth , u bnai ba-shiphew , ïa ka Esther la wallam sha u syiem Serksis ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice , and sent to Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , the son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us see one another in the face .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah bad ki nongai jingmut jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa ka Israel . Kumta u la phah khubor sha u Jehoash u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Jehoahas bad u ksiew jong u Jehu , da kaba kob ïa u ban ïaleh .

translation.en: And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .
translation.kha: Lada um don khun kynthei , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .

translation.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace , but of debt .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew uba trei , la siew bainong ïa u , hynrei ym shym la ñiew ïa ka kum ka jingai sngewbha ; ka long kaei kaei kaba u la kamai .

translation.en: Then thou shalt say unto them , I presented my supplication before the king , that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan s house , to die there .
translation.kha: Shu ong ïa ki ba me kyrpad ïa nga ban ym phah pat ïa me sha byndi ban ïap hangta .

translation.en: And Moses alone shall come near the  Lord  : but they shall not come nigh  ; neither shall the people go up with him .
translation.kha: Tang ma me marwei men wan sha jan jong nga ; kita kiwei pat kim bit ban wan sha jan . U paidbah lei lei um bit ban wan kiew sha uta u lum .

translation.en: And the other issued out of the city against them  ; so they were in the midst of Israel , some on this side , and some on that side : and they smote them , so that they let none of them remain or escape .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kiba hapoh ka nongbah mynta ki wan hiar ban ïasoh lem ha ka thma . Kumta ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki shem ïa lade ba ki la shah kerkut ha ki Israel , bad ba ki la shah pynïap lut . Ym don uwei ruh uba lait im , bad ym don uwei ruh uba lait na kata lait tang u syiem jong ka Ai .

translation.en: Behold , I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb  ; and thou shalt smite the rock , and there shall come water out of it , that the people may drink . And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .
translation.kha: Nga ngan ïeng ha khmat jong me ha u mawsiang ha u Lum Sinai . Tied ïa u mawsiang ; te ka um kan sa mih na u ba u paidbah un ïoh dih .  U Moses u leh kumta ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And the sons of Ulla  ; Arah , and Haniel , and Rezia .
translation.kha: bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ulla ki dei u Arah , u Hanniel , bad u Risia .

translation.en: How much did he pay you ?
translation.kha: Katno u siew ia phi ?

translation.en: You are welcome .
translation.kha: Ym lei lei .

translation.en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak , and not to please ourselves .
translation.kha: Ma ngi kiba long kiba khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit , ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot ba kin bah ïa ki jingkit jong ki . Ngim dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade .

translation.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest .
translation.kha: Te u Annas u la phah noh ïa u , uba dang shah khum , sha u Kaïaphas u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; A voice was heard in Ramah , lamentation , and bitter weeping  ; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children , because they were not .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha Ramah , ka jingsawa jong ka jingïam kthang . Ka Rakhel ka ïam namar ki khun jong ka ; ki la ïap noh , bad kam treh ba yn pyntngen ïa ka .

translation.en: Art thou called being a servant ? care not for it : but if thou mayest be made free , use it rather .
translation.kha: Hato phi la long u mraw mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi ? Kam pher , wat pynkhuslai ei ei ; hynrei lada phi ïoh ïa ka lad ban long uba laitluid , pyndonkam ïa ka .

translation.en: But as many as received him , to them gave he power to become the sons of God , even to them that believe on his name :
translation.kha: Katto katne pat , ki la pdiang ïa u bad ki la ngeit ha u ; kumta u la ai bor ha ki , ban long ki khun U Blei .

translation.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes  ; keep them in the midst of thine heart .
translation.kha: Wat shah ba kin phet noh na phi ; kynmaw bad ri kyndong ïa ki ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: Behold , I am vile  ; what shall I answer thee ? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth .
translation.kha: Nga la kren kum u bieit , ko  Trai . Aïu ngan jubab ? Ngan ym pyrshang ban ong ei ei shuh .

translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Ahab u syiem Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .

translation.en: And Hezekiah prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Te u la leit sha ka Templ , u buh ïa ka shithi hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u duwai ,

translation.en: So are the paths of all that forget God  ; and the hypocrite s hope shall perish :
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba khlem Blei ki long kum kito ki khah ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh , shisien ba la klet ïa U Blei .

translation.en: There is one come out of thee , that imagineth evil against the  Lord  , a wicked counsellor .
translation.kha: Na pha , ko Ninebeh , la wan u briew uba dap da ki jingpyrkhat bymman , uba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Zidon , and prophesy against it ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to kren pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Sidon .

translation.en: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write  ; These things saith he that is holy , he that is true , he that hath the key of David , he that openeth , and no man shutteth  ; and shutteth , and no man openeth  ;
translation.kha: Thoh ha u angel jong ka balang ha Philadelphia :  Kane ka long ka khubor na uta uba khuid bad uba shisha . U don u shabi jong u Dabid , bad haba u plie ïa ka jingkhang , ym don uba lah ban khang ïa ka , bad haba u khang ïa ka , yn ym don uba lah ban plie ïa ka .

translation.en: Yea , he had power over the angel , and prevailed : he wept , and made supplication unto him : he found him in Beth–el , and there he spake with us  ;
translation.kha: U ïaleh bad u angel bad u la jop . U la ïam bad pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu . Bad ha Bethel U Blei u la wan sha u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jakob bad u la ïakren bad u .

translation.en: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle , as if it were of a garden : he hath destroyed his places of the assembly : the  Lord  hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion , and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest .
translation.kha: Ka burom ba-itynnat tam jong ka Jerusalem ka long ka bynta jong ka mynnor . Ki nongïalam jong ka ki long kum ki skei kiba tlot na ka jingthngan , kaba ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki , ka la jan duh noh katba ki phet na ki nongbeh mrad .

translation.en: Consider the lilies how they grow : they toil not , they spin not  ; and yet I say unto you , that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
translation.kha: Ha khmih kumno ki syntiew khlaw ki san : Kim shym trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade . Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon ha ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat kat uwei na kine ki syntiew .

translation.en: Then said he , Lo , I come to do thy will , O God . He taketh away the first , that he may establish the second .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Nga hangne , A Blei , ban leh ïa ka mon jong me .  Kumta U Blei u la pynsangeh noh ïa baroh ki jait jingkñia kiba rim bad u la pynlong ba ka jingkñia U Khrist kan mih bujli ha ka jaka jong ki .

translation.en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy  ; then it was well with him : was not this to know me ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U bishar hok ïa kiba duk , bad baroh ki ïaid beit bad u . Kata ka long ka jingmut ban ithuh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Vex the Midianites , and smite them :
translation.kha: Tur ïaleh ïa ki Midian bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki ,

translation.en: Phrygia , and Pamphylia , in Egypt , and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene , and strangers of Rome , Jews and proselytes ,
translation.kha: na Phrygia bad na Pamphylia , na Ijipt bad na ki thain ka Libya hajan ka Kyrini . Katto katne ngut na ngi , ngi dei na Rom ,

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  When I sent you without purse , and scrip , and shoes , lacked ye any thing ?  And they said , Nothing .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Haba nga la phah noh ïa phi ha kato ka por khlem ka pla pisa , ka pla , lane ki juti , hato phi ïaduna ei ei ?   Ym duna wat kawei ruh ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: He answereth him , and saith ,  O faithless generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him unto me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Haduh katno phi long ki briew ki bymngeit ! Haduh katno ngan don bad phi ? Haduh katno ngan ïaishah bad phi ? Wallam ïa u khynnah ha nga !

translation.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables , saying ,  Behold , a sower went forth to sow  ;
translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa ki shibun kiei kiei .  Shisien la don u briew uba la mihnoh ban bet symbai .

translation.en: Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel , while he was zealous for my sake among them , that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy .
translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba u Phinehas u la leh , ngam bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel . U kyntait ban shah ïa ka jingmane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang ïa nga , bad namar kata ngam shym la pynjot ïa ki wat haba nga la bitar .

translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O house of Levi : ye that fear the  Lord  , bless the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki Lebi ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi baroh kiba mane ïa U !

translation.en: And he arose , and departed to his house .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la leit sha ïing .

translation.en: His prayer also , and how God was entreated of him , and all his sin , and his trespass , and the places wherein he built high places , and set up groves and graven images , before he was humbled : behold , they are written among the sayings of the seers .
translation.kha: Ka jingduwai u syiem bad ka jingjubab U Blei ïa ka , bad ka jingthoh shaphang ki pop kiba u la leh ha shuwa ba un kylla-kaba-mut — ka jingsniew kaba u la leh , ki jaka mane blei thala bad ki durblei jong ka blei Asherah kaba u la thaw bad ki bleithaw kiba u la mane — baroh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong ki Nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant : there have they dealt treacherously against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki tang mar ïarung ïa ka ri ha Adam , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la ïateh bad ki .

translation.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region .
translation.kha: Ka ktien jong U Trai ka la phriang kylleng ha kata ka thain .

translation.en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate , she said , Had Zimri peace , who slew his master ?
translation.kha: Katba u Jehu u dang rung lyngba ka khyrdop , ka la pyrta ,  Me u Simri ! Me u nongpynïap briew ! Balei me wan hangne ?

translation.en: But I certify you , brethren , that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba ka Gospel ba nga ïalap ha phi kam long kaba na ka tynrai u briew .

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith , and the ark of the testimony ,
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ka , ban pynsleh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ,

translation.en: And the king took his ring from his hand , and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews  enemy .
translation.kha: U syiem u law ïa la ka sati ba pyndonkam ha kaba shon muhor ban pynkupbor ïa ki jingpynbna , bad ai ïa ka ha u nongshun jong ka jaitbynriew Jiw , u Haman u khun jong u Hammedatha , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .

translation.en: And David arose , and fled that day for fear of Saul , and went to Achish the king of Gath .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u mihnoh , u da phet krad na u Saul , bad u la leit sha u Akhish u syiem ka Gath .

translation.en: But if any man seem to be contentious , we have no such custom , neither the churches of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u kwah ban ïasaidnia shaphang kata , baroh kaba nga don ban ong ka long ba ma ngi lymne ki balang U Blei ngi don da kawei pat ka rukom ha ka jingmane .

translation.en: And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki synran jong u Jisu ki la wan phai , bad ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh ban lap ïa u ba u ïakren bad kata ka briew . Hynrei ym don na ki uba la ong ïa ka ,  Pha kwah aïu ?  lane uba la kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba me ïakren bad ka ?

translation.en: Hearken , my beloved brethren , Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith , and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! U Blei u la jied ïa ki briew kiba duk ha kane ka pyrthei ban long kiba riewspah ha ka jingngeit bad ban kam kynti ïa ka hima kaba u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .

translation.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth , that he might eat the increase of the fields  ; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock , and oil out of the flinty rock  ;
translation.kha: U ai ba kin synshar ïa ki ri lum , bad ki bam ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha . Hapdeng ki mawsiang ki lap ïa ka ngap ; ki diengsoh Olib jong ki , ki san ki plung ha ki jaka maw .

translation.en: And there went great multitudes with him : and he turned , and said unto them ,
translation.kha: Shisien mynba ki paidbah babun ki la ïaleit lem bad U Jisu , u la phai sha ki bad u la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , he shall even die thereby .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba hok u keiñ noh na kaba leh ïa kaba bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew , un ïap na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: Behold now , thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life  ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me , and I die :
translation.kha: Phi la lehsbun shikatdei eh bad phi la pyllait im ïa nga . Hynrei ki lum ki jngai palat ïa nga ; ka jingjynjar kan lap ïa nga , bad nga lah ban ïap noh shuwa ban poi shata .

translation.en: Then came to him the disciples of John , saying , Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft , but thy disciples fast not ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongbud jong U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki da kylli ,  Balei ba ma ngi bad ki Pharisi ngi shahjingit bunsien , hynrei ki synran jong me kim ju shahjingit da lei lei ?

translation.en: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him  ; and they were full of eyes within : and they rest not day and night , saying , Holy , holy , holy , Lord God Almighty , which was , and is , and is to come .
translation.kha: Baroh kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , ki don mar hynriew tylli ki thapniang , bad ïa ki la tap da ki khmat , shapoh bad shabar . Mynsngi bad mynmiet kim ju sangeh noh na kaba rwai :  Bakhuid , bakhuid , bakhuid , long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , Uba la long , uba long bad u ban sa wan .

translation.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , saying ,
translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Sihon u syiem Amor ban ong :

translation.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him , and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him , that stood before him .
translation.kha: Hynrei um kheiñ kor ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kita ki riewrangbah , bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba ïaheh ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .

translation.en: While he yet spake , there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue s house , saying to him , Thy daughter is dead  ; trouble not the Master .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , u nonglamktien u la wan na ka ïing u rangbah synshar .  Ka khun jong me ka la ïap ,  u la ong ha u Jairos ;  wat pynshitom shuh ïa u nonghikai .

translation.en: Now these are thy servants and thy people , whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power , and by thy strong hand .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , kine ki dei ki shakri jong me , ki briew jong me hi . Me la pyllait ïa ki da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong me .

translation.en: Because thy rage against me , and thy tumult , is come up into mine ears , therefore will I put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong kata ka jingbitar shla bad ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan buh ïa u khwai ha ka khmut jong me bad u bnoh ha ka shyntur jong me bad ngan pynphai pat na ka lynti ha kaba me la wan .

translation.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour s wife , to defile thyself with her .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; naba kata kan pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .

translation.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man : he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich .
translation.kha: Kaba byrngia ha ki jingim pahuh , ka waiñ bad ka jingbam lutphut kin ym pynlong ïa phi uba riewspah .

translation.en: A nation of fierce countenance , which shall not regard the person of the old , nor shew favour to the young :
translation.kha: Kin ym map lane leh-isynei ïano ïano , la ki dei ki samla ne ki tymmen .

translation.en: And he sent them to Lebanon , ten thousand a month by courses : a month they were in Lebanon , and two months at home : and Adoniram was over the levy .
translation.kha: bad u buh ïa u Adoniram ban khmih ïa ki . U la pynbynta ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun kiba don shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kawei kawei ka kynhun , bad kawei pa kawei ka kynhun ka pynlut shi bnai ha Lebanon bad ar bnai pat ha la shnong .

translation.en: He was not that Light , but was sent to bear witness of that Light .
translation.kha: U hi da lade um dei ka jingshai ; u la wan ban ïathuh shaphang ka jingshai .

translation.en: Kings of the earth , and all people  ; princes , and all judges of the earth :
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki syiem bad phi ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki khun syiem shynrang bad baroh kiwei ki nongsynshar ;

translation.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am : and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain ; but I laboured more abundantly than they all : yet not I , but the grace of God which was with me .
translation.kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei nga long kumba nga long , bad ka jingaiei kaba u la ai ha nga kam shym long lehnoh-ei . Ha kawei ka liang , nga la kham trei shitom ban ïa uno uno uwei pat na ki apostol , wat la kam shym la long da ka jingleh jong nga hi , hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei kaba trei ha nga .

translation.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai na ka skul jong ki Epikuri bad ki Stoik ki la ïatainia ruh bad u . Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la kylli ,  Aïu une u sarong bieit u pyrshang ban kren ?  Kiwei pat ki jubab ,  U i kumba u kren shaphang ki blei nongwei .  Ki la ong ïa kane namar ba u Paul u la ïalap shaphang U Jisu bad ka jingmihpat .

translation.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation  ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba ki paid Israel ki leh naduh mynstep haduh da miet ka long ka bymmyntoi bad kaba pynjot . Ka jingshetkylla bad ki jingleh jubor ki nang jyllei hapdeng jong ki . Ki ïateh jutang bad ka Assyria , bad ki ïakhaïi bad ka Ijipt .

translation.en: The nakedness of thy father , or the nakedness of thy mother , shalt thou not uncover : she is thy mother  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmie , namar mem dei ban pynjahburom ïa la ka jong ka kmie .

translation.en: Behold , O  Lord  , and consider to whom thou hast done this . Shall the women eat their fruit , and children of a span long ? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord ?
translation.kha: Ha khmih , A  Trai  , ha ka jingkordit jong nga , ha ka jingjynjar sat ka mynsiem jong nga ! Ka dohnud jong nga ka pait ha ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop jong nga . Ka don ka jingpynïap ha ki lynti bah ; wat hapoh ïing ka don ka jingïap .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud hadien ka thma , ki Philistia ki leit bad lute ïa ki metïap , bad ki lap ïa ki met jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba ki don halor u Lum Gilboa .

translation.en: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst , saying , The  Lord  our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u ïathuh ïa phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pyllait ïa phi na ka bor jong ngi , hynrei u Hesekaïah u shukor ïa phi bad un shah ba phin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingsliang .

translation.en: And brought the ass , and the colt , and put on them their clothes , and they set him thereon .
translation.kha: ki la wallam ïa ka kada bad ïa u khun kada , ki la siang ïa la ki jaiñkup halor jong ki , bad U Jisu u la kiew ban shong .

translation.en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation ; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kumba da kawei ka pop la pynrem ïa u bynriew baroh , ha kajuh ka rukom kawei ka kam bahok ka pyllait bad ka ai jingim ïa u bynriew baroh .

translation.en: Behold , with a great plague will the  Lord  smite thy people , and thy children , and thy wives , and all thy goods :
translation.kha: Namar kata , U  Trai  un pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki briew jong me , ïa ki khun jong me , bad ïa ki tnga jong me , bad un pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingdon jingem jong me .

translation.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit , dividing to every man severally as he will .
translation.kha: Hynrei dei tang uwei bad ujuh hi U Mynsiem uba leh ïa kane baroh ; ha ka mon jong u , u ai ïa ka jingai bapher ha uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when I bring a cloud over the earth , that the bow shall be seen in the cloud :
translation.kha: Ha man ba nga tap ïa ka suiñbneng da u lyoh , bad ba u simpyllieng u paw ,

translation.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth : the strength of the hills is his also .
translation.kha: U synshar halor ka pyrthei baroh , na ki krem kiba jylliew tam sha kliar ki lum bajrong tam .

translation.en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah , saying , So let the gods do to me , and more also , if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time .
translation.kha: Ka la phah khubor sha u Elijah :  Ai ba ki blei kin pynïap ïa nga lashai kum ha kane ka por lada ngam leh ïa kajuh kaba me la leh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .
translation.kha: Ki skain kiba ïap ki lah ban pyniwtung ïa baroh ka jingiwbih hapoh ka dabi , bad tang khyndiat ka jingmutlop ka lah ban pynduh ïa ka jingstad kaba khraw tam .

translation.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab , and mine inward parts for Kir–heres .
translation.kha: Nga la ud da ka jingsngewsih namar ka Moab , da ka jingpangnud namar ka Kir Heres .

translation.en: And the anointing oil , and sweet incense for the holy place : according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do .
translation.kha: ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , bad ïa ka jingiwbih basma sngewtynnat na ka bynta Ka Jaka Kyntang . Ha kaba shna ïa kine baroh , ki dei ban leh thik kat kumba nga la hukum ïa me .

translation.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass , as willows by the water courses .
translation.kha: Kin san kin plung kum u phlang ba la ai um bha , kum ki dieng Jamynrei harud ki wahduid jong ka um batuid .

translation.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel , and the stranger that sojourneth among them  ; seeing all the people were in ignorance .
translation.kha: Te yn map ïa ka kynhun Israel baroh bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki , namar iwei pa iwei ki la don bynta ha ka jingbakla .

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Samuel , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,

translation.en: So Ebed–melech took the men with him , and went into the house of the king under the treasury , and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags , and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit bad ki rangbah sha ka kamra buh jingbam ha ka ïingsyiem bad la ïoh katto katne ki jaiñphong ba la rim kiba u la pynhiar sha nga da ki tyllai .

translation.en: And while he yet spake , lo , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and elders of the people .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren haba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la wan poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah babun uba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .

translation.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel , thirty thousand chariots , and six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude : and they came up , and pitched in Michmash , eastward from Beth–aven .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel ; ki don laiphew hajar tylli ki kali thma , hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad ki shipai kiba bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw . Ki leit sha Mikhmash , kaba sha mihngi na Bethaben bad ki sher dara hangta .

translation.en: And when the year was expired , king Nebuchadnezzar sent , and brought him to Babylon , with the goodly vessels of the house of the  Lord  , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ka pyrem ka la poi , u syiem Nebukhadnessar u ïalam ïa u Jehoïakhin sha Babilon kum u koidi , bad u rah lang ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . Nangta u Nebukhadnessar u pynlong ïa u Sedekaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And when the mourning was past , David sent and fetched her to his house , and she became his wife , and bare him a son . But the thing that David had done displeased the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ïambriew ka la kut , u Dabid u phah wan ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem ; ka la long noh ka tnga jong u , bad ka kha u khun shynrang na u . Hynrei U  Trai  um sngewbha ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord hath a mighty and strong one , which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm , as a flood of mighty waters overflowing , shall cast down to the earth with the hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ïa uta uba khlaiñ bad badonbor uba la kloi ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , uta u ban wan kum u phria bajur , kum u  lapbah , kum ka jingshlei um bakhlaiñbor , bad kan tap lup ïa ka ri .

translation.en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning , and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even  ;
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa uwei mynstep bad uwei pat janmiet ,

translation.en: For the  Lord  shall be thy confidence , and shall keep thy foot from being taken .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ri sumar ïa phi . Un ym shah ba phin hap ha ka jingriam .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam , that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem :
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar u Rehoboam , u syiem Shishak jong ka Ijipt u la leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Let Reuben live , and not die  ; and let not his men be few .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Reuben , u Moses u ong ,  Ai ba ka jait Reuben kan im , wat la ka long kaba khyndiat briew .

translation.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee , and shew kindness , I pray thee , unto me , and make mention of me unto Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house :
translation.kha: Hynrei sngewbha kynmaw lem ïa nga haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , bad sngewbha ruh ban ïathuh lem shaphang jong nga ha u syiem bad ïarap lem ïa nga ban ïohlait noh na kane ka ïingbyndi .

translation.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering  ; and my servant Job shall pray for you : for him will I accept : lest I deal with you after your folly , in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right , like my servant Job .
translation.kha: Mynta shim hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang bad leit sha u Job bad ai ïa ki kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ïa lade . U Job un duwai na ka bynta jong me , bad ngan jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u bad ngan ym pynjahburom ïa me kumba ka dei hok ïa me . Mem shym la kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga kumba u la leh .

translation.en: And when king Arad the Canaanite , which dwelt in the south , heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies  ; then he fought against Israel , and took some of them prisoners .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem ka Arad , u nong Kanaan uba shong shaphang shathie ka ri Kanaan , u la ïohsngew ba ki Israel ki wan ïaid lynti na shaphang Atharim , u la tur ïaleh ïa ki bad u la ïohkem katto katne ngut na ki .

translation.en: Will you come with me ?
translation.kha: Phin wan lem ne em bad nga ?

translation.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper , and they that provoke God are secure  ; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongtuh bad ki briew bym don Blei ki im ha ka jingsuk , wat la u blei jong u long tang ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki hi .

translation.en: There is no end of all the people , even of all that have been before them : they also that come after shall not rejoice in him . Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban ym don pud ïa ka jingdon ki briew kiba u syiem u synshar ; haba um don shuh , ym don mano mano uba sngewnguh ïa kaei kaba u la leh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  will make thy plagues wonderful , and the plagues of thy seed , even great plagues , and of long continuance , and sore sicknesses , and of long continuance .
translation.kha: un phah ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkoit bad ïa ki jingïapthem kiba sngewtriem bad kiba neh slem .

translation.en: Then asked they him , What man is that which said unto thee ,  Take up thy bed , and walk ?
translation.kha: Ki la kylli ïa u ,  Uei uta u briew uba la ong ïa me ban leh kumne ?

translation.en: And he went forth again by the sea side  ; and all the multitude resorted unto him , and he taught them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit phai pat sharud ka duriaw Galilaïa . U paidbah u la wan sha u bad u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki .

translation.en: The children of Shem  ; Elam , and Asshur , and Arphaxad , and Lud , and Aram .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shem — u Elam , u Asshur , u Arpakhshad , u Lud , bad u Aram — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .

translation.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy , that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering , for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting .
translation.kha: hynrei U Blei u la leh-isynei ïa nga khnang ba U Khrist Jisu un ïoh pynpaw ïa ka jingïaishah slem jong u ha kaba ïadei bad nga , uba sniew tam na kiba pop , kum ka nuksa ïa kito baroh ki ban sa ngeit ïa u hadien bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor  ; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart .
translation.kha: Wat banbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong phi , lane mano mano kiwei pat kiba kyrduh . Bad wat pyrkhat ïa ki rukom ban pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat .’

translation.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple , and said unto him ,  Behold , thou art made whole : sin no more , lest a worse thing come unto thee .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , U Jisu u la shem ïa u ha ka Templ bad u la ong ,  Peit shane , me la khiah mynta ; te sangeh na kaba leh pop , ïoh kaei kaei kaba kham sniew ka lah ban jia ïa me .

translation.en: So he took him , and brought him to the chief captain , and said , Paul the prisoner called me unto him , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee , who hath something to say unto thee .
translation.kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shim ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha u rangbah ai hukum , bad u la ong ,  U Paul , u koidi , u la khot ïa nga bad kyrpad ïa nga ban wallam ïa une u samla sha me , namar ba u don ei ei ban ong ha me .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Get thee up into this mount Abarim , and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Leit kiew sha u Lum Abarim bad khmih ïa kata ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki Israel .

translation.en: Even he shall build the temple of the  Lord   ; and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit and rule upon his throne  ; and he shall be a priest upon his throne : and the counsel of peace shall be between them both .
translation.kha: U long ma u , u ban tei ïa ka bad ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba dei ïa u syiem bad un synshar ïa ki briew jong u . U lyngdoh un ïeng hajan ka khet jong u , bad kin ïatreilang ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingïasngewtynnat .’

translation.en: And Moses said , The people , among whom I am , are six hundred thousand footmen  ; and thou hast said , I will give them flesh , that they may eat a whole month .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Hangne nga ïalam ïa ki hynriew lakh ngut ki briew , bad me , me ong ban men ai doh ïa ki ka ban biang haduh shi bnai ?

translation.en: And he called Gehazi , and said , Call this Shunammite . So he called her . And when she was come in unto him , he said , Take up thy son .
translation.kha: U Elisha u khot ïa u Gehasi , bad u ong ïa u ban khot ïa ka kmie jong u khynnah . Haba ka la wan shapoh , u ong ha ka ,  Une u khun jong phi .

translation.en: And their coast was from Heleph , from Allon to Zaanannim , and Adami Nekeb , and Jabneel , unto Lakum  ; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan :
translation.kha: U pud jong ka , u suh na Heleph sha u dieng Sning ha Saanannim , nangta beit beit sha Adaminekeb bad sha Jamnia , haduh Lakkum , bad u kut ha ka Jordan .

translation.en: Wherefore , behold , I send unto you prophets , and wise men , and scribes : and some of them ye shall kill and crucify  ; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues , and persecute them from city to city :
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ba ngan phah ha phi ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki briew kiba stad bad ïa ki nonghikai ; phin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki , phin sahnarphna ïa kiwei pat , bad phin sympat ïa kiwei pat ha ki synagog bad beh ïa ki na kawei ka shnong sha kawei pat .

translation.en: Because it entereth not into his heart , but into the belly , and goeth out into the draught , purging all meats ?
translation.kha: namar kam rung sha ka dohnud , hynrei , shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nangta ka mih shabar na ka met .  ( Ha kaba u ong ïa kane , U Jisu u la pynbna ba baroh ki jingbam ki long kiba bit ban bam . )

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I am against the prophets , saith the  Lord  , that steal my words every one from his neighbour .
translation.kha: Nga pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba shim ktien uwei na uwei bad pynbna ïa ki kum ka khubor jong nga .

translation.en: For our rejoicing is this , the testimony of our conscience , that in simplicity and godly sincerity , not with fleshly wisdom , but by the grace of God , we have had our conversation in the world , and more abundantly to you-ward .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewsarong ba ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynskhem ïa ngi ba ka jingim jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei , bad khamtam eh ba ki jingïadei jong ngi bad phi , la pynïaid da kata ka jingkhuid bad ka jingsngur kaba na U Blei , da ka bor ka jingaiei U Blei bad ym da ka jingstad briew .

translation.en: Wrath is cruel , and anger is outrageous  ; but who is able to stand before envy ?
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar ka long kaba shyrkhei bad kaba pynjot , hynrei kam long ei ei haba ïanujor bad ka jingpihuiñ .

translation.en: Then came the soldiers , and brake the legs of the first , and of the other which was crucified with him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shipai ki la leit bad pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong uta uba nyngkong bad nangta sa ïa ki jong uwei pat kiba la shah sahnarphna lem bad U Jisu .

translation.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery , and remember it as waters that pass away :
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki jingjynjar jong me kin shu jah noh na ki jingkynmaw jong me , kum ki jingshlei um kiba la ïaid lait noh bad ym don jingkynmaw shuh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land , then I said , O Lord  God  , forgive , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki puit ba ki bam duh ïa baroh kaei kaei kaba jyrngam ha ka ri , bad nangta nga la ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to map ïa ki briew jong me ! Kumno ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !

translation.en: And when he was come to the king , the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And he said , Go ye up , and prosper , and they shall be delivered into your hand .
translation.kha: Haba u ïeng ha khmat u syiem Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Ko Mikaïah , hato u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ?   Tur !  u Mikaïah u ong .  Da shisha phin jop . U  Trai  un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .

translation.en: Order ye the buckler and shield , and draw near to battle .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah shipai ka Ijipt ki pyrta , ‘ Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi bad tur sha ka thma !

translation.en: Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .
translation.kha: Mynta ka dei ka por ba ïa kane ka pyrthei yn bishar ; mynta ïa u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei yn pynhiar khet .

translation.en: And when he was gone , a lion met him by the way , and slew him : and his carcase was cast in the way , and the ass stood by it , the lion also stood by the carcase .
translation.kha: Ha lynti , u la ïakynduh ïa u sing uba la pynïap ïa u . Ka metïap jong u ka don ha ka lynti bah , bad ka kada bad u sing ki ïeng ha syndah jong ka .

translation.en: And she said , Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Shah ba u Adonijah , u hynmen jong me un ïoh ïa ka Abishag kum ka tnga jong u .

translation.en: Now therefore , my lord , as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , seeing the  Lord  hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood , and from avenging thyself with thine own hand , now let thine enemies , and they that seek evil to my lord , be as Nabal .
translation.kha: U dei U  Trai  uba la khang ïa phi ban pynhiarkput bad pynïap ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Bad mynta nga smai ha phi da U  Trai  uba im ba ki nongshun jong phi bad baroh kiba kwah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi kin shah pynshitom kum u Nabal .

translation.en: It is for the prince  ; the prince , he shall sit in it to eat bread before the  Lord   ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate , and shall go out by the way of the same .
translation.kha: Hynrei u khun syiem uba synshar , u lah ban rung hangta ban bam ïa ka jingbam bakhuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga . Un rung bad mih ïa ka khyrdop lyngba ka kamra ban rung ban mih ha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh .

translation.en: And there went forth a wind from the  Lord  , and brought quails from the sea , and let them fall by the camp , as it were a day s journey on this side , and as it were a day s journey on the other side , round about the camp , and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Kyndit kyndit U  Trai  u phah ïa ka lyer kaba wan kit ïa ki  iar khiar na duriaw , kiba her kumba shi mitar na sla khyndew . Kine ki dem ha ka jaka sher dara bad baroh sawdong jong ka da bun bun kilomitar kat shaba phai .

translation.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven , and say , I live for ever .
translation.kha: Kumba nga long U Blei uba im , nga rah la ka kti bad nga smai ,

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Shi sngi hadien ka thma ki Philistia ki leit ban lute na ki metïap , ki lap ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut ba ki thiah ïap ha Lum Gilboa .

translation.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus : and great grace was upon them all .
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw ki apostol ki la sakhi ïa ka jingmihpat jong U Trai Jisu , bad U Blei u la theh ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ha ki baroh .

translation.en: He wrote well in the examination .
translation.kha: U thoh bha ha ka Examination .

translation.en: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa u kew jong phi bad ïa ki jingbam ba phi khreh da u .

translation.en: And he builded an altar there , and called upon the name of the  Lord  , and pitched his tent there : and there Isaac s servants digged a well .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la tei ka duwan hangta bad mane ïa U  Trai . Nangta u sher ïa la ka dara hangta , bad ki shakri jong u ki ïatih sa kawei pat ka pukri .

translation.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament ; not of the letter , but of the spirit : for the letter killeth , but the spirit giveth life .
translation.kha: dei ma u , uba pynlah ïa ngi ban shakri ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , kaba khlem kynthup ïa ka hukum ba la thoh hynrei kaba da U Mynsiem . Ka hukum ba la thoh ka wallam ïa ka jingïap , hynrei U Mynsiem u ai jingim .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron ;  Ïathuh ha ki Israel bad ha u Pharaoh ba nga la hukum ïa phi ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: In like manner shalt thou do with his ass  ; and so shalt thou do with his raiment  ; and with all lost thing of thy brother s , which he hath lost , and thou hast found , shalt thou do likewise : thou mayest not hide thyself .
translation.kha: Leh kumjuh haba phi lap ïa ka kada , ka jaiñkup , lane kaei kaei kaba jah kaba dei ka jong u para Israel jong phi ; wat shu ieh khlem da ïarap .

translation.en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season , the first rain and the latter rain , that thou mayest gather in thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , un sa pynhap slap ha ka khyndew jong phi ha ka aïom kaba biang , ha ka por synrai bad ha ka por pyrem , khnang ba phin ïohlum ïa u kew , ïa ka waiñ , bad ïa ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta jong phi hi , bad ïa u phlang na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi .

translation.en: Say thou thus unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword , and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured , and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga maham ïa ki ba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot kin shah pynïap . Kito kiba shong ha ka ri kin shah bam da ki mradkhlaw . Kito kiba rieh ha ki lumbah bad ki krem kin ïap da ka jingpang .

translation.en: That whosoever would not seek the  Lord  God of Israel should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .
translation.kha: Mano mano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , ki bym mane ïa U , la pynïap .

translation.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse , in the openings of the gates : in the city she uttereth her words , saying ,
translation.kha: ka da pyrta jam ha ki khyrdop nongbah bad kat haba ki briew ki ïalumlang :

translation.en: Let him drink , and forget his poverty , and remember his misery no more .
translation.kha: Shah kin dih bad kin klet ïa la ka jingduk , bad ïa ka jingsngewsih .
