translation.en: Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .
translation.kha: U Simon hi ruh u la ngeit ; bad hadien ba la pynbaptis ïa u , u la bud ha kti ha kjat ïa u Philip bad u la sngewlyngngoh haba u la ïohi ïa ki kamphylla bad ki kambah ïa kiba la leh .

translation.en: There is no darkness , nor shadow of death , where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves .
translation.kha: Ym don jingdum ka ban dum tliw palat ban buhrieh ïa u nongpop na U Blei .

translation.en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls , and their kings shall minister unto thee : for in my wrath I smote thee , but in my favour have I had mercy on thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Ki nongwei kin tei pat ïa ki kynroh jong pha , bad ki syiem jong ki kin shakri ïa pha . Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei mynta ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bad jingisynei jong nga ïa pha .

translation.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me : but I will consider thy testimonies .
translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki apthap ban pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngan puson ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: And Jesus put forth his hand , and touched him , saying ,  I will  ; be thou clean .  And immediately his leprosy was cleansed .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u .  Nga mon ,  u la jubab .  To men long khuid !  Shisyndon la pynkhiah ïa u briew na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne , and worship him that liveth for ever and ever , and cast their crowns before the throne , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba ki leh kumta , kita ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup ha khmat uta uba shong halor ka khet , bad mane ïa u , uba im junom la junom . Ki bret ïa ki pansngiat jong ki ha khmat jong ka khet bad ki ong ,

translation.en: Dearly beloved , avenge not yourselves , but rather give place unto wrath : for it is written , Vengeance is mine ; I will repay , saith the Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynhiarkput , ko ki paralok jong nga , hynrei pynban , to ai ba ka jingbitar jong U Blei kan leh ïa kata . Namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ngan pynhiarkput , ngan siew kylliang , ong U Trai .

translation.en: Therefore at that time , when all the people heard the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and all kinds of musick , all the people , the nations , and the languages , fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , mar syn ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki tiar put tiar tem , ki briew jong baroh ki ri , ki jaitbynriew , bad ki jait ktien ki la ïadem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kaba u Syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep , and seeing the prison doors open , he drew out his sword , and would have killed himself , supposing that the prisoners had been fled .
translation.kha: U nongpeit phatok u la kyndit na kaba ïohthiah , bad haba u la ïohi ba ki jingkhang ka byndi ki la plie , u la pyrkhat ba ki koidi ki la phet ; kumta u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la mut ban dung ïap ïa lade .

translation.en: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house  ; because thou hast despised me , and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha man la ka pateng , katto katne na ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin ïap ka jingïap kaba sngewma namar ba mem shym kohnguh ïa nga bad ba me la shim ïa ka tnga jong u Uriah .

translation.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle , and all the vessels of the ministry .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Moses ruh u la synreit ïa ka snam halor kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang bad halor kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .

translation.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid  ; they shall prevail against him , as a king ready to the battle .
translation.kha: U tip ba ka lawei jong u ka long kaba dum ; ka jingbymman , kum u syiem badonbor , ka apthap ban tur ïaleh ïa u .

translation.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau  ; and the kingdom shall be the  Lord s .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongjop jong ka Jerusalem kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Edom bad kin synshar halor jong ka . Bad U  Trai  da lade hi un long u Syiem .

translation.en: Search the scriptures  ; for in them ye think ye have eternal life : and they are they which testify of me .
translation.kha: Phi pule ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , namar phi pyrkhat ba ha ki phin shem ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Bad kine hi ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki kren shaphang jong nga !

translation.en: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite , and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah , brother to Joab , saying , Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp ? And Abishai said , I will go down with thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ïa u Ahimelekh u nong Hit bad ïa u Abishai u para u Joab , ( ka kmie jong ki ka dei ka Seruïah ) ,  Mano napdeng jong phi ar ngut ban leit bad nga sha ka jaka shong dara u Saul ?   Ma nga ,  u Abishai u jubab .

translation.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–serah , which is in mount Ephraim , on the north side of the hill of Gaash .
translation.kha: Ki la tep ïa u ha ka ri kynti jong u hi ha Timnath Serah ha ka ri lum Ephraim , ha ka phang bashatei jong u Lum Gaash .

translation.en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad : for Absalom hated Amnon , because he had forced his sister Tamar .
translation.kha: Bad u Absalom u la isih ïa u Amnon haduh katta katta namar ka jingbatbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u kat haduh ba um mon shuh ban kren ïa u .

translation.en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs , and a target of brass between his shoulders .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kjat jong u la sop da ka rnong , bad u kieng ïa u sum rnong ba tawah ha ka tyrpeng .

translation.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew ki mih shabar ban trei ïa ki kam jong ki bad ki trei haduh ynda la janmiet .

translation.en: But since ye say , The burden of the  Lord   ; therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Because ye say this word , The burden of the  Lord  , and I have sent unto you , saying , Ye shall not say , The burden of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Bad lada kim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga bad pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’

translation.en: As snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honour is not seemly for a fool .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaroh ïa uba bieit kam long kaba dei , kum ka ïor ha ka por lyiur lane u slap ha ka aïom ot .

translation.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the  Lord  , all ye of the captivity , whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon :
translation.kha: Ma phi baroh kiba nga la phah sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong .’

translation.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people : and they marvelled at his answer , and held their peace .
translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat jong ki paidbah , kim shym la lah ban kem daw ïa u ha kano kano , kumta ki la sngap jar , ki da lyngngoh ha ka jingjubab jong u .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath turned away the excellency of Jacob , as the excellency of Israel : for the emptiers have emptied them out , and marred their vine branches .
translation.kha: ( U  Trai  u la sdang artat ban pynïoh pat ïa ka burom jong ka Israel , kumba ka la long ha khmat ki nongshun kiba la lute ïa ka . )

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Ahijah , Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son  ; for he is sick : thus and thus shalt thou say unto her : for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself to be another woman .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u ba ka tnga u Jeroboam kan wan wad jingtip na u shaphang u khun jong ka , uba pang . Bad U  Trai  u bthah ïa u Ahijah aïu ban ong . Haba ka tnga u Jeroboam ka la poi , ka leh mynleh ïa lade kum kawei pat ka briew .

translation.en: Let no man therefore despise him : but conduct him forth in peace , that he may come unto me : for I look for him with the brethren .
translation.kha: Ym dei ban don mano mano ba ibeiñ ïa u , hynrei phi dei ban ïarap ïa u ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong u ha kaba suk , khnang ba un ïoh wan phai pat sha nga ; naba nga khmih lynti ba un wan phai ryngkat bad ki parabangeit .

translation.en: I came forth from the Father , and am come into the world : again , I leave the world , and go to the Father .
translation.kha: Nga la wan na U Kpa , bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthei ; bad mynta ngan sa iehnoh ïa ka pyrthei bad ngan leit sha U Kpa .

translation.en: Even unto this present hour we both hunger , and thirst , and are naked , and are buffeted , and have no certain dwellingplace ;
translation.kha: Haduh kane hi ka khyllipmat ngi shahthngan bad ngi sliang ; la pynkup ha ngi da ki jaiñjot ; la shohbeiñ ïa ngi ; ngi ïaidwir na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ; ngi la thait la jrem ïa lade na ka jingtrei shitom .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed , and be cut down , and fall  ; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka jia , u snar uba la pynskhem un sa kylluid bad hap . Bad kata kan long ka jingkut jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la sdien ha u .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: Or if his sin , which he hath sinned , come to his knowledge : then he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a female without blemish , for his sin which he hath sinned .
translation.kha: te un tang shu tip ba u la leh pop kumta , un wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa ka blang kynthei ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And unleavened bread , and cakes unleavened tempered with oil , and wafers unleavened anointed with oil : of wheaten flour shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , u bym pat khleh thiat , bad shet katto katne ki kpu ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib , bad katto katne khlem umphniang bad katto katne ki kpu lyngkniap ba la shu kyllan da ka umphniang .

translation.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold , and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba don ki kjat jong ka .

translation.en: If any man will do his will , he shall know of the doctrine , whether it be of God , or whether I speak of myself .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba mon ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah , un tip la kaei kaba nga hikai ka wan na U Blei ne la nga kren ha ka bor jong nga hi .

translation.en: Blessed art thou , O  Lord  : teach me thy statutes .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me , A  Trai  ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki lynti jong me .

translation.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry , by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant , which was established upon better promises .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Jisu u la ai ïa ka kam lyngdoh kaba kham halor ban ïa ka jong ki , kumba ka jutang ïa kaba u la pynbeit hapdeng U Blei bad la ki briew ka long kaba kham bha , namar la seng nongrim ïa ka ha ki jingkular ïa kiei kiei kiba kham bha .

translation.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller : as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki la knieh bad la rah noh kum ka jinglute .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said , The word of the  Lord  is with him . So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him .
translation.kha: U dei u nongïathuhlypa bashisha ,  u syiem Jehoshaphat u ong . Kumta ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la leit sha u Elisha .

translation.en: And called , and asked whether Simon , which was surnamed Peter , were lodged there .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta bad kylli ,  Don mo u nongshong basa hangne uba kyrteng u Simon Petros ?

translation.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning , and sware one to another : and Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei pa uwei u la kular bad pynskhem da kaba shim smai . U Isaak u khublei khatduh ïa ki , bad ki ïakhlad kum ki paralok .

translation.en: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son :
translation.kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsynei ïa u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  descended in the cloud , and stood with him there , and proclaimed the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la ïeng bad u hangta , bad u la pynbna ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong u , U  Trai .

translation.en: Through wisdom is an house builded  ; and by understanding it is established :
translation.kha: Ïa ki ïing la tei halor ka nongrim jong ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: And this is the manner of the release : Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it  ; he shall not exact it of his neighbour , or of his brother  ; because it is called the  Lord s  release .
translation.kha: Haba map , dei ban leh kumne . Uwei pa uwei uba ai ram ha la u para Israel u dei ban map ïa kata ka ram ; um dei ban dawa shuh ïa ka , namar ba U  Trai  hi u la map ïa ka .

translation.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits  ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew na ki jingshitom jong ki , ki jingpang jong ki , bad na ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad u la ai ka jingïohi pat ha kiba bun ki briew kiba matlah .

translation.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness : thou hast said , None seeth me . Thy wisdom and thy knowledge , it hath perverted thee  ; and thou hast said in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me .
translation.kha: Pha sngewshngain ïa lade ha la ki kam sniew ; pha pyrkhat ba ym don mano mano ba ïohi ïa pha . Ka jingstad bad ka jingtip jong pha ki ïalam bakla ïa pha , bad pha ong ha lade , ‘ Nga long U Blei — ym don uno uno pat kum ma nga .’

translation.en: But camest back , and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place , of the which the  Lord  did say to thee , Eat no bread , and drink no water  ; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers .
translation.kha: Pynban , phi la wan phai bad phi bam phi dih ha ka jaka ha kaba u la khang ïa phi ban bam ban dih . Namar kane yn sa pynïap ïa phi , bad ïa ka met jong phi yn ym tep ha ka jingtep ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: The dead are not able to see or hear or do anything . —Ecclesiastes 9 :5 , 10 .
translation.kha: Kiba ïap kim lah ban ïohi ne ïohsngew ne leh ei ei .—Eklesiastis 9 :5 , 10 .

translation.en: And they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We have sinned , because we have forsaken the  Lord  , and have served Baalim and Ashtoreth : but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies , and we will serve thee .
translation.kha: Nangta ki kyang sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , bad ki ong , ‘ Ngi la leh pop , namar ngi la phai noh na me , ko  Trai  , bad ngi la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong u Baal bad ki Astarte . To pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi , bad ngin mane ïa me !’

translation.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears : in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him .
translation.kha: Ki jingsawa ba-sngewtriem kin pah ha ki shkor jong ki , bad ki nonglute kin wan kurup ïa ki haba ki dang pyrkhat ba ki shngain .

translation.en: And the fourth angel sounded , and the third part of the sun was smitten , and the third part of the moon , and the third part of the stars  ; so as the third part of them was darkened , and the day shone not for a third part of it , and the night likewise .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba saw u la put ïa la ka turoi . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi la shoh , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bnai , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki khlur , ba ka jingshai jong ki ka la jah noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka jingtyngshaiñ ; ym shym la don jingshai ha ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi bad ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka miet .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he had made an end of speaking all these words , that the ground clave asunder that was under them :
translation.kha: Mar ïadep kren ïa kine ki ktien , ka khyndew ha kaba u Dathan bad u Abiram ki ïeng ka la kad arliang

translation.en: Tom is a couple of years older than me , I think .
translation.kha: U Tom u heh ia nga tang katto-katne snem .

translation.en: And , behold , the courses of the priests and the Levites , even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God : and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man , for any manner of service : also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment .
translation.kha: Ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi la pynbynta kam ba kin leh ha ka Templ . Ki nongtrei kiba don jingtbit ha ki jait kam baroh ki thrang ban ïarap ïa me , bad baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki don hapoh ka hukum jong me .

translation.en: Prove thy servants , I beseech thee , ten days  ; and let them give us pulse to eat , and water to drink .
translation.kha: To tynjuh ïa ngi shiphew sngi ,  u la ong .  Ai ha ngi ki jhur ban bam bad ka um ban dih .

translation.en: Now this I say , that every one of you saith , I am of Paul ; and I of Apollos ; and I of Cephas ; and I of Christ .
translation.kha: Ai ba ngan buh ha kane ka rukom : Uwei pa uwei na phi u ong ïa kaei kaei kaba ïapher . Uwei u ong ,  Nga bud ïa u Paul ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Apollos ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Petros ;  bad uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: Moreover , if he be gotten into a city , then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city , and we will draw it into the river , until there be not one small stone found there .
translation.kha: Lada u kynran dien sha ka nongbah , ki briew jong ngi baroh kin wallam ïa ki tyllai bad kin shu tan ïa ka nongbah shapoh ka them . Yn ym don uwei ruh u maw ïa uba yn iehnoh ha kliar lum .

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ;

translation.en: And all these blessings shall come on thee , and overtake thee , if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , te kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh kin wan ha phi .

translation.en: And now I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I come to thee . Holy Father , keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me , that they may be one , as we are .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga wan noh sha me ; ngam don shuh ha kane ka pyrthei , hynrei ma ki , ki don ha ka pyrthei . Ko Pa Bakhuid ! To ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga , ba kin ïoh long kawei kumba ma me bad nga ngi ïalong kawei .

translation.en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw , and the signs , and the wonders , and the mighty hand , and the stretched out arm , whereby the  Lord  thy God brought thee out : so shall the  Lord  thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ruh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba shyrkhei kiba phi la ïohi , da ki kambah bad ki kamphylla , bad da ka borbah da ka ksang ti kaba la kner da kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi , kumta ruh un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh ïa kiba phi sheptieng .

translation.en: But the flesh of the bullock , and his skin , and his dung , shalt thou burn with fire without the camp : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka doh jong uta u masi lyngraw , ïa ka snieh jong u , bad ïa ki  nierlang jong u , dei ban thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara . Kane ka long ka jingainguh ban sait ïa ki pop jong ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: Howl , fir tree  ; for the cedar is fallen  ; because the mighty are spoiled : howl , O ye oaks of Bashan  ; for the forest of the vintage is come down .
translation.kha: To ïam bad to ud , ko dieng Kseh-Sypress — ki Kedar ki la kyllon ; ïa kito ki dieng badonburom la pynjot ! To ïam bad to ud , ko ki dieng Sning jong ka Bashan — ïa ka khlaw kaba rben la khet noh !

translation.en: And Saul said to David , Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him : for thou art but a youth , and he a man of war from his youth .
translation.kha: Em ,  la jubab u Saul .  Kumno men lah ban leit ïaleh ïa u ? Me long tang u khynnah , katba ma u , u la long u shipai ha baroh ka jingim jong u !

translation.en: For my people is foolish , they have not known me  ; they are sottish children , and they have none understanding : they are wise to do evil , but to do good they have no knowledge .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki long kiba mutlop ; kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki long kiba bieit kum ki khynnah ; kim don kano kano ka jingshemphang . Ki long kiba tbit ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew , hynrei ki bym lah ban leh ïa kaba bha .

translation.en: Behold , I have done according to thy words : lo , I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart  ; so that there was none like thee before thee , neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ban ïa uno uno uba la don ha shuwa lane u ban sa ïoh pat hadien .

translation.en: But we all , with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord , are changed into the same image from glory to glory , even as by the Spirit of the Lord .
translation.kha: Te , baroh na ngi , ngi phalang ïa ka burom jong U Trai da ki durkhmat ba khlem tap , bad kata kajuh ka burom , kaba wan na U Trai , uba long U Mynsiem , ka pynkylla dur ïa ngi sha ka jingïasyriem ïa u ha kata ka kyrdan kaba kham khraw jong ka burom .

translation.en: For they are my servants , which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : they shall not be sold as bondmen .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long ki mraw jong U  Trai  , bad u wallam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt ; ym dei ban die mraw ïa ki .

translation.en: Let brotherly love continue .
translation.kha: To ïaineh ha kaba ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei kum ki parabangeit .

translation.en: But this I say , He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly ; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba u briew uba bet tang khyndiat ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh khyndiat ; uta uba bet shibun ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh shibun .

translation.en: God is the  Lord  , which hath shewed us light : bind the sacrifice with cords , even unto the horns of the altar .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei ; u la long uba bha ïa ngi . Lem bad ki tnat dieng ha ki kti jong phi , to sdang ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam bad ïaid sawdong ïa ka duwan .

translation.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity , than he that is perverse in his lips , and is a fool .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban long uba duk hynrei uba beit ban ïa kaba long u bieit uba shukor .

translation.en: Every purpose is established by counsel : and with good advice make war .
translation.kha: Pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba bha bad phin ïoh jingjop ; wat leit tur thma khlem da don ka dur pynkhreh .

translation.en: But if ye turn unto me , and keep my commandments , and do them  ; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven , yet will I gather them from thence , and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi phai pat sha nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum ïa phi , ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jaka sha kaba nga la jied ban mane ïa nga , wat la ïa phi la pynsakma sha kiba kut ka pyrthei .’

translation.en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them , to shew it unto Esther , and to declare it unto her , and to charge her that she should go in unto the king , to make supplication unto him , and to make request before him for her people .
translation.kha: U ai ha u Hathakh ïa ka kopi jong ka jingpynbna kaba u la pynmih ha Susa , kaba hukum ïa ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw . U Mordekai u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ka sha ka Esther , ban batai ha ka ïa kaei kaba long , bad ban ong ïa ka ban ïasaid bad u syiem bad kyrpad ïa u ban don jingisynei ïa ki briew jong ka .

translation.en: And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom  ; )
translation.kha: Kito sha kiba u ju phai khmat bunsien na ka bynta ka jingai jingmut ki long u Karshena , u Shethar , u Admatha , u Tarshish , u Meres , u Marsena bad u Memukan — ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah synshar jong ka Persia bad ka Media kiba bat ïa ki kyrdan treikam bahakhlieh duh jong ka hima .

translation.en: And he went his way , and communed with the chief priests and captains , how he might betray him unto them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Judas u la leit noh bad u la ïakren bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka Templ shaphang kumno u lah ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .

translation.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the  Lord  upon the house , they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement , and worshipped , and praised the  Lord  , saying , For he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohi ïa ka ding ba ka wan hiar na bneng bad ba ka jingshai ka dap ha ka Templ , ki dem khrup ha lynti ba la siang maw , ki da mane ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa U namar ka jingbha bad ka jingieit bymjukut jong u .

translation.en: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers  skins , and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue , and shall put in the staves thereof .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa kiba na ka jait Lebi bad thung ïa ki kum ki shakri ïa u Aaron u lyngdoh .

translation.en: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices : and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne , which are the seven Spirits of God .
translation.kha: Na ka khet la mih ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh , ki jingsawa u pyrthat . Ha khmat jong ka khet , la don hynñiew tylli ki dongmusa bameh , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynsiem jong U Blei .

translation.en: He said unto them , Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed ? And they said unto him , We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid haba phi la long kiba ngeit ?   Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ba don U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body .
translation.kha: Ha ki por baroh ngi kit halor ki met baïap jong ngi ïa ka jingïap U Jisu , khnang ba ka jingim jong u ruh kan paw ha ki met jong ngi .

translation.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns : and Abraham went and took the ram , and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son .
translation.kha: U Abraham u khmih sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa u langbrot uba la sahkut ki reng ha ka bniap . U leit ban shim ïa u , bad kñia ïa u kum ka jingainguh thang ha ka jaka u khun jong u .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also : for therefore am I sent .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la ong ha ki ,  Nga dei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei ha kiwei pat ki shnong ruh , namar kata ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la phah ïa nga ban leh .

translation.en: And he came unto his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I  ; who art thou , my son ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u leit sha la u kpa bad u ong ,  Ko Pa !   Oi ,  u jubab .  Phi dei uei na ki khun shynrang jong nga ?

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , Ye shall eat no manner of fat , of ox , or of sheep , or of goat .
translation.kha: Ym dei ban bam ïa ka khleiñ jong ki masi , ki langbrot , ne ki blang .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine , until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh na kane ka waiñ tad haduh kata ka sngi ba nga dih na ka waiñ bathymmai ha ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip , Go near , and join thyself to this chariot .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha u Philip ,  Khie leit sha jan ka kali kulai bad bud mar jan ïa ka .

translation.en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb , The dog is turned to his own vomit again  ; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia ha ki , ka pynpaw ba ki Proberb ki long kiba shisha :  U ksew u leit phai pat sha la ka prie  bad  u sniang ïa uba la pynsum pynsait u leit kyrsum pat ha ka ktieh .

translation.en: Butter of kine , and milk of sheep , with fat of lambs , and rams of the breed of Bashan , and goats , with the fat of kidneys of wheat  ; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape .
translation.kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jong ki , ki ai kyrhai ka dud , ki la don ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi ruh kiba da kynsai , u kew uba kynsai tam bad ka waiñ kaba bang tam .

translation.en: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven , all whose works are truth , and his ways judgment : and those that walk in pride he is able to abase .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ma nga , u Nebukhadnessar , nga ïaroh , nga pyndon burom , bad nga ai burom ïa U Syiem jong ka Bneng . Kaei kaei baroh kaba u leh ka long kaba dei bad kaba hok , bad u lah ban pynhiar ïa uno uno uba leh sarong .

translation.en: The fining pot is for silver , and the furnace for gold : but the  Lord  trieth the hearts .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ksiar bad ïa ka rupa la phrang ha ka ding , bad ïa ka dohnud jong u briew la phrang da U  Trai .

translation.en: And Moses took the rod from before the  Lord  , as he commanded him .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leit shim ïa uta diengduh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: In those days they shall say no more , The fathers have eaten a sour grape , and the children s teeth are set on edge .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por kan wan , ki briew kin ym ong shuh ,   ‘ Ki kmie ki kpa ki la bam ïa u sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki khun ki ïoh ïa ka jingmad kaba jew .’

translation.en: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , that thou shalt set thee up great stones , and plaster them with plaster :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ba phi jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad rung sha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , pynïeng katto katne tylli ki maw kiba heh , ñiad astor ïa ki ,

translation.en: And he shall pass through Judah  ; he shall overflow and go over , he shall reach even to the neck  ; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land , O Immanuel .
translation.kha: Kin sar lyngba ka Judah ha ka jingshlei um , da kaba kiew haduh tyrpeng bad tap lin ïa kaei kaei baroh .  U Blei u long lem bad ngi ! Ki thapniang jong u ba la pyiar shabar ki ïada ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them , and will bring them again to their folds  ; and they shall be fruitful and increase .
translation.kha: Ngan lum ïa kiba sah na ki briew jong nga na ki ri kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri . Kin ïoh bun ki khun bad kin nang roi ha ka jingbun briew .

translation.en: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first  ; and Moses rose up early in the morning , and went up unto mount Sinai , as the  Lord  had commanded him , and took in his hand the two tables of stone .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kita kiba mynshuwa . Dang step phyrngab u leit kiew ïa u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: ( John 14 :28 ) The holy spirit is not a person  ; it is God’s active force .—Genesis 1 :2  ; Acts 2 :18 .
translation.kha: ( Ioannis 14 :28 ) U mynsiem bakhuid um dei u jingthaw ka dei ka bor jong U Blei .—Jenesis 1 :2 ; Kam 2 :18 .

translation.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers  ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïap jong u , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And Joshua had commanded the people , saying , Ye shall not shout , nor make any noise with your voice , neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth , until the day I bid you shout  ; then shall ye shout .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym risa , lane kren shikyntien ruh tad haduh ba un da ai hukum .

translation.en: And David and his men went up , and invaded the Geshurites , and the Gezrites , and the Amalekites : for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land , as thou goest to Shur , even unto the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki ju leit hiarthma ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur , ki Girsi , bad ki Amalek , kiba la ju shong ha kata ka thain naduh mynhyndai . U ju leit lute ïa ka ri jong ki haduh Shur , baroh shi lynter lynti haduh ka ri Ijipt ,

translation.en: Then shall they call upon me , but I will not answer  ; they shall seek me early , but they shall not find me :
translation.kha: Hangta kin sa khot kyrpad ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ngan ym jubab ; phin sa wan wad ïa nga kylleng sawdong , hynrei phin ym shem ïa nga .

translation.en: Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself , cities great and fenced up to heaven ,
translation.kha: Shahshkor ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phin jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad knieh ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa phi . Ki shnong jong ki , ki long kiba heh , bad ki kynroh jong ki , ki kot haduh suiñbneng .

translation.en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art  ; the Holy One of God .
translation.kha: Ieh ! Kaei me kwah bad ngi , ko Jisu uba na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga ithuh me long uei : Me long u nonglamktien bakhuid jong U Blei !

translation.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .
translation.kha: Kynsan la don ka jingsawa na sahit bneng kaba sawa kum ka jingbeh ka lyer bajur , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing baroh kawei ha kaba ki la ïashong .

translation.en: Then said he unto all Israel , Be ye on one side , and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side . And the people said unto Saul , Do what seemeth good unto thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha ki ,  Phi baroh ïeng hangtai , u Jonathan bad nga ngin ïeng hangne .   Leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: And I heard a man s voice between the banks of Ulai , which called , and said , Gabriel , make this man to understand the vision .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba pyrta na shiliang ka wah Ulai ,  Ko Gabriel , to batai ïa u ïa ka jingmut jong kaei kaba u la ïohi .

translation.en: And he ran before , and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him : for he was to pass that way .
translation.kha: Kumta u la mareh ha shuwa jong ki paidbah bad u la kiew ïa u dieng Sykomore    ban ïohi ïa U Jisu , uba dei ban ïaid lyngba kata ka lynti .

translation.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the  Lord  : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u sngewbha ïa ki briew kiba bha , hynrei u pynrem ïa kito kiba thmu sniew .

translation.en: Ye hypocrites , well did Esaias prophesy of you , saying ,
translation.kha: Phi kiba arsap ! A katno ka long kaba dei haba u Isaïah u la ïathuhlypa shaphang jong phi !

translation.en: And will be a Father unto you , and ye shall be my sons and daughters , saith the Lord Almighty .
translation.kha: Ngan long U Kpa jong phi , bad phin long ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong nga , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; A great eagle with great wings , longwinged , full of feathers , which had divers colours , came unto Lebanon , and took the highest branch of the cedar :
translation.kha: ban pyntip ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong ha ki : La don u pukni radbah uba don ki sner ba-itynnat bad ki thapniang kiba khraw , kiba pyiar heh . U la her sha ki lumbah Lebanon bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka kliar jong u dieng Kedar ,

translation.en: For we preach not ourselves , but Christ Jesus the Lord ; and ourselves your servants for Jesus  sake .
translation.kha: Naba ym dei ïa lade ba ngi ïalap ; ngi ïalap ïa U Jisu Khrist kum U Trai , bad ma ngi kum ki shakri jong phi na ka bynta U Jisu .

translation.en: But a wife might choose to leave her husband if ( 1 ) he stubbornly refuses to support his family , ( 2 ) he is so violent that her health and life are in danger , or ( 3 ) his extreme opposition makes it impossible for her to worship Jehovah .—1 Corinthians 7 :12 , 13 .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka tnga ka lah ban jied ban shongkhlad na la u tnga tang lada ( 1 ) u leh bym salia bad um kitkhia ban bsa ïa la ka ïing ( 2 ) u shoh u dat haduh ba ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka jingim jong ka , ka shong syier lane ( 3 ) ka jingpynthut palat jong u ka khang lad ïa ka ha ka ban mane ïa U Jehobah , kum ha kaba pule ïa ka Baibl , ha kaba leit jingïaseng bad ha kaba leit ïalap .—1 Korinth 7 :12 , 13 .

translation.en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation , over against the table , on the side of the tabernacle southward .
translation.kha: U buh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie , marpyrshah kata ka miej ,

translation.en: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time  ; for it is an evil time .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kaba sngap jar ha kum kita ki por kiba sniew ka long kaba sian ban leh .

translation.en: I will do these things unto thee , because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen , and because thou art polluted with their idols .
translation.kha: Pha la long ka nuti ïa ki jaitbynriew bad pynjakhlia ïa lade bad ki bleithaw .

translation.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh : and when the hair in the plague is turned white , and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh , it is a plague of leprosy : and the priest shall look on him , and pronounce him unclean .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa kata ka prum , bad lada u shñiuh hangta u la kylla lieh bad kata ka prum ka i kumba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity , even the law of commandments contained in ordinances ; for to make in himself of twain one new man , so making peace ;
translation.kha: U la pynduh ïa ka hukum ki Jiw da la ki jong ki hukum bad ki kyndon , khnang ban ïoh pynlong ïa ki ar tylli ki jaitbynriew kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba thymmai ha u hi , ha kane ka rukom u wanrah jingsuk .

translation.en: And Elijah the Tishbite , who was of the inhabitants of Gilead , said unto Ahab , As the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , before whom I stand , there shall not be dew nor rain these years , but according to my word .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa uba kyrteng u Elijah , uba na Tishbe kaba ha Gilead , u la ong ha u Syiem Ahab ,  Ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei uba im jong ki Israel , ïa uba nga shakri , nga ong ha phi ba ha ki ar ne lai snem kiba bud yn ym don ka umjer lane u slap tad haduh ba ngan ong kumta .

translation.en: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people , when ye are come over Jordan  ; Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Joseph , and Benjamin :
translation.kha: Ynda phi la jam ïa ka wah Jordan , kine ki jait ki dei ban ïeng ha u lum Gerisim katba nang pynbna ïa ki jingkyrkhu : ka jait Simeon , ka jait Lebi , ka jait Judah , ka jait Issakhar , ka jait Joseph , bad ka jait Benjamin .

translation.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it , and too much .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la lah wallam ka la biang ban trei pyndep ïa ka kam baroh .

translation.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah , the son of Dodo , a man of Issachar  ; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Abimelekh , u Tola u khun jong u Puah bad u ksiew jong u Dodo , u la wan ban pyllait ïa ki Israel . U dei na ka jait Issakhar bad u shong ha Shamir ha ka ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son  ; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount : and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u la law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh na u Aaron bad u pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . Hangta ha kliar lum u Aaron u la ïap , bad u Moses bad u Eleasar ki wan hiar noh .

translation.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit  ; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah ki ju pyrkhat borabor ba ki long kiba stad , hynrei u briew uba duk , uba don ka jingsngewthuh shaphang ka jinglongbriew u tip kham bha .

translation.en: And they were all amazed , insomuch that they questioned among themselves , saying , What thing is this ? what new doctrine is this ? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits , and they do obey him .
translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ba ki la sdang ban ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Kaei kane ? Hato ka dei ka jait jinghikai thymmai ? Une u briew u don ka bor ban ai hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me , and increasest thine indignation upon me  ; changes and war are against me .
translation.kha: Me don borabor katto katne ngut ki nongsakhi pyrshah ïa nga ; ka jingbitar jong me ïa nga ka nang jur nang jur ; me thaw ki lad thymmai ban ïaleh ïa nga .

translation.en: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand , Come , ye blessed of my Father , inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world :
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem un ong ha ki briew kiba ha ka liang kamon jong u , ‘ To wan , phi kiba la kyrkhu da U Kpa jong nga ! To wan bad to ïoh ïa ka hima kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi naduh kaba pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Saul said , I will give him her , that she may be a snare to him , and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him . Wherefore Saul said to David , Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain .
translation.kha: U ong ha lade ,  Ngan ai ïa ka Mikhal ha u Dabid : ngan pyndonkam ïa ka ban riam ïa u , bad un sa shah pynïap ha ki Philistia .  Kumta ha ka sien kaba ar u Saul u ong ha u Dabid ,  Men sa long u pyrsa kurim jong nga .

translation.en: And as it was in the days of Noah , so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man .
translation.kha: Kumba ka la long ha ka por jong u Noah kumta kan long ha ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Shallum , and his conspiracy which he made , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Shallum u la leh , kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh ïa ka jingïasylla jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Peter , an apostle of Jesus Christ , to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus , Galatia , Cappadocia , Asia , and Bithynia ,
translation.kha: Na u Petros , u Apostol U Jisu Khrist — Sha ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei kiba im kum ki nongphetwir kiba la pynsakma kylleng ki probins jong ka Pontos , ka Galatia , ka Kappadokia , ka Asia bad ka Bithynia .

translation.en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba kren ka kyntien pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew lah ban map ; hynrei ïa uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map .

translation.en: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest  ; yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul .
translation.kha: Sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun bad phi lah ban sngewsarong borabor ïa u . Un ym long daw ïa phi ban shah lehrain .

translation.en: Then said Jesus ,  Let her alone : against the day of my burying hath she kept this .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Wat pynwit ïa ka ! To ai ba kan buh ïa kaei kaba ka don na ka bynta ka sngi ban tep jong nga .

translation.en: For if ye do this thing indeed , then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , he , and his servants , and his people .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh shisha kumba nga la hukum , te ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid kin ïailong syiem . Bad ma ki , lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki bad ki briew jong ki , kin ïai bteng ban ïaid lyngba ïa ki khyrdop jong kane ka ïingsyiem ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai .

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven , and a few little fishes .
translation.kha: Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ?  U Jisu u la kylli .  Hynñiew tylli ki kpu ,  ki la jubab ,  bad khyndiat ki dohkha rit .

translation.en: Provide neither gold , nor silver , nor brass in your purses ,
translation.kha: Wat rah ïa kano kano ka ksiar , ka rupa , lane ka pisa tama ha ki pla jong phi ;

translation.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this , and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the transgression of Jacob ? is it not Samaria ? and what are the high places of Judah ? are they not Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Kane baroh kan jia namar ba ki paid Israel ki la leh pop bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei . Ïano yn kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïaleh pyrshah ki Israel ? Ka Samaria hi , ka nongbah ! Mano ba shah kynnoh ïa ka jingmane bleithaw ha Judah ? Ka Jerusalem hi !

translation.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam uba ar u syiem ka Israel , u Ussaïah u khun jong u Amasaïah u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ïa ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: And the king stood in his place , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments , and his testimonies , and his statutes , with all his heart , and with all his soul , to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book .
translation.kha: U ïeng hajan ka jaka ïeng ki syiem bad u pynlong ka jutang bad U  Trai  ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u da la ka dohnud bad mynsiem baroh , bad ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingdawa ba ïasoh bad ka jutang , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab .

translation.en: He divideth the sea with his power , and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingkhlaiñ jong u kaba jop ïa ka duriaw ; da ka jingtbit jong u , u pynjot ïa u Rahab u mrad kynsha .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , What did this people unto thee , that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them ?
translation.kha: U ong ruh ha u Aaron ,  Aïu kine ki briew ki la leh ïa phi , haduh ba phi la pynlong ïa ki ban leh ïa ka pop kaba ishyrkhei kat kane ?

translation.en: And it came to pass in the third year , that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba lai , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u leit ïakynduh ïa u Ahab u syiem Israel .

translation.en: Then answered Esther , and said , My petition and my request is  ;
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka jubab ,

translation.en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace , and things wherewith one may edify another .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ngi dei borabor ban thmu ban leh ïa kita kiei kiei kiba wallam ka jingsuk bad kiba ïarap ban pynkhlaiñ iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass , and the earth that is under thee shall be iron .
translation.kha: U slap un ym hap , bad ka khyndew kan kylla eh kum u nar .

translation.en: Jesus wept .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïam .

translation.en: And after a little while another saw him , and said , Thou art also of them . And Peter said , Man , I am not .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por uwei u briew u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u la ong ,  Me ruh , me long uwei na ki !  Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ,  Ko rangbah , ngam dei !

translation.en: For Jerusalem is ruined , and Judah is fallen : because their tongue and their doings are against the  Lord  , to provoke the eyes of his glory .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka Jerusalem ka long ba la tim ! Ka Judah ka dang khyllem ! Kano kano kaba ki kren lane ki leh ka long pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ; ki ibeiñ khlem buhrieh ïa U Blei hi .

translation.en: And Saul asked counsel of God , Shall I go down after the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel ? But he answered him not that day .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u kylli ïa U Blei ,  Hato ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Hato men ai ha ngi ka jingjop ?  Hynrei U Blei um shym jubab ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon : for they heard that they should eat bread there .
translation.kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ban ai ha u Joseph ynda u wan ha ka por shiteng sngi , namar la ïathuh ha ki ba ki dei ban ïabam ryngkat bad u .

translation.en: And now , O  Lord  God , the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant , and concerning his house , establish it for ever , and do as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  U Blei , to pyndep ha ki por baroh ïa ka kular ba me la pynlong shaphang jong nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh kumba me la kren ba men leh .

translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have no bread .
translation.kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïakren para ma ki :  U ong ïa kane namar ngim don kpu .

translation.en: Lest thou learn his ways , and get a snare to thy soul .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban bud ïa ki jingmlien jong ki bad phin ym lah shuh ban kylla .

translation.en: Who did no sin , neither was guile found in his mouth :
translation.kha: Um shym la leh pop , bad ym shym don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglamler kaba mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong u .

translation.en: And they gave forth their lots  ; and the lot fell upon Matthias  ; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïakynting sbai ban jied napdeng ki ar ngut ki rangbah , bad uta uba la jied u la long u Matthias , ïa uba la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ki khatwei ngut ki apostol .

translation.en: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath–jearim , saying , The Philistines have brought again the ark of the  Lord   ; come ye down , and fetch it up to you .
translation.kha: ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki nong Kiriath Jearim ban ong ,  Ki Philistia ki la pynphai ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai . Ale wan shim noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And he opened his mouth , and taught them , saying ,
translation.kha: bad u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki :

translation.en: And Jesus answered them , saying ,  The hour is come , that the Son of man should be glorified .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ka kynta ka la poi mynta ïa U Khun U Briew ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba khraw .

translation.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness , which the Lord , the righteous judge , shall give me at that day : and not to me only , but unto all them also that love his appearing .
translation.kha: Bad mynta kaba ap ïa nga ka long ka bainong jong ka jingjop ïa kaba la buh beit da U Blei uba U Trai , u nongbishar bahok , u ban ai ha nga ha kata ka Sngi — ym tang ïa nga , hynrei ïa kito baroh kiba ap ïa u da ka jingieit ba un wanpaw .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the return of the year , that Ben–hadad numbered the Syrians , and went up to Aphek , to fight against Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud u la khot ïa ki rangbah bad u leit bad ki sha ka nongbah Aphek ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy : ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Phi tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga kum ki nongshun . Ki rangbah ki wan phai na ka thma , da kaba pyrkhat ba kin shngain ha ïing , hynrei hangta ki shem , ïa kiba ap ban tuh noh ïa ki jaiñphong na ka met jong ki .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : because his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , naba u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Likewise , the way we appear at meetings shows our esteem for “the Judge of all the earth ,” Jehovah God , and for the place where we worship him . —Genesis 18 :25 .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh , ka rukom riam jong ngi ha ki jingïalang ka pyni ba ngi burom ïa “U Nongbishar ka pyrthei baroh kawei ,” U Blei Jehobah , bad ïa ka jaka kaba ngi mane ïa u . —Jenesis 18 :25 .

translation.en: And another of his disciples said unto him , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew , uba la long u synran , u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , shah shuwa ïa nga ba ngan leit phai bad tep ïa i pa jong nga .

translation.en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh , and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïai bteng ban ym kohnguh , te ngan leh ïa kane ka Templ ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ka Shiloh , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong kane ka nongbah kum ka jingtim .

translation.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai kohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong me , junom la junom ;

translation.en: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth : for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away  ; and there was no more sea .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka bneng bathymmai bad ïa ka pyrthei bathymmai . Ka bneng banyngkong bad ka pyrthei banyngkong ki la jah noh , bad ka duriaw kam don shuh .

translation.en: And the man said unto me , Son of man , behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears , and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee  ; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither : declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U ong ha nga ,  To khmih , ko khun u briew , shahshkor kyndiang bad pynleit jingmut bha ïa kata baroh kaba nga pyn-i ha me ; namar ba na ka bynta kane la ïalam ïa me hangne . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kata baroh ba me ïohi sha ki briew ka Israel .

translation.en: Surely he scorneth the scorners : but he giveth grace unto the lowly .
translation.kha: Um donkam ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u lehsbun ïa kito kiba sngewrit .

translation.en: God promised that Jesus would become the King of His Kingdom .
translation.kha: U Blei u kular ba u Jisu un-long U Syiem jong ka Hima jong u .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king s office by the hand of the Levites , and when they saw that there was much money , the king s scribe and the high priest s officer came and emptied the chest , and took it , and carried it to his place again . Thus they did day by day , and gathered money in abundance .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi ki Lebi ki leit rah ïa kata ka synduk sha u nongpynïaidkam u syiem , uba dei peit ïa ka . Ha man ba ka dap , u sekretari syiem bad u nongmihkhmat ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh ki sei shabar ïa ka pisa bad ki leit buh biang ïa ka synduk ha ka jaka jong ka . Bad kumta ki la ïohlum shibun ka pisa .

translation.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue .
translation.kha: Sneng pynbeit ïa uno uno , bad hadien un ïaroh ïa ka kham bun ban ïa kaba pynroh .

translation.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light , neither cometh to the light , lest his deeds should be reproved .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew u isih ïa ka jingshai bad un ym wan sha ka jingshai , namar um kwah ba ïa ki kam sniew jong u yn paw .

translation.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers , he made a shew of them openly , triumphing over them in it .
translation.kha: Bad halor kata ka diengphna , U Khrist u la pyllaitluid ïa lade na ka bor jong ki nongsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad na ki bor synshar ; u la pynlong ka jingthadrong ïa ki da kaba ïalam ïa ki kum ki mraw ha ka jingïaid paidbah kaba jop jong u .

translation.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me  ; because I have hoped in thy word .
translation.kha: Kito kiba pyndonburom ïa me kin kmen haba ki ïohi ïa nga , namar nga la shaniah ha ka jingkular jong me .

translation.en: So likewise ye , when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you , say , We are unprofitable servants : we have done that which was our duty to do .
translation.kha: Ka long kumjuh bad phi ; haba phi la pyndep ïa baroh kaba la bthah ïa phi ban leh , to ong , ‘ Ngi long ki tang ki shakri , ngi la pyndep tang ïa ka kamram jong ngi .’

translation.en: And he came down with them , and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples , and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem , and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , which came to hear him , and to be healed of their diseases  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum lem bad ki apostol , u la ïeng ha ka jaka madan lem bad kiba bun ki synran jong u . U paid byllien u la don hangta na kylleng ka Judia bad na Jerusalem bad na ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon kiba harud duriaw ;

translation.en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour : and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels  ;
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u la kylla riewspah bha , bad uwei pa uwei u burom ïa u . U don ki kamra kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , ki musla , ki stieh , bad kiwei ki tiar baremdor jong u .

translation.en: And God said to Jonah , Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd ? And he said , I do well to be angry , even unto death .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Me don hok aïu ban bitar ïa u jingthung ?  U Jonah u la jubab ,  Nga don ka hok baroh ban bitar — ban bitar eh ban ïap !

translation.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee .
translation.kha: Te ngan long uba nyngkong ban ïaroh ïa me bad pdiang ba me la ïoh ka jingjop da lade hi .

translation.en: Behold now , this city is near to flee unto , and it is a little one : Oh , let me escape thither , ( is it not a little one ? ) and my soul shall live .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi ïa katai ka nongrit ? Katai te ka kham jan . Shah ngan leit shata — phi ïohi ïa ka ba ka long tang ka nongrit — bad ngan ïohlait im .

translation.en: But the heavens and the earth , which are now , by the same word are kept in store , reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki bneng bad ka pyrthei kiba long mynta la pynsah da kajuh ka hukum jong U Blei , khnang ban ïoh pynjot da ka ding . Ïa ki la pynsah na ka bynta ka sngi haba ïa ki briew ki bymtip Blei yn bishar bad pynjot noh .

translation.en: And it shall be , when ye are come nigh unto the battle , that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people ,
translation.kha: Shuwa ba phin sdang ïaleh , u lyngdoh un wan sha khmat bad kren ha kata ka kynhun shipai ,

translation.en: And I entreat thee also , true yokefellow , help those women which laboured with me in the gospel , with Clement also , and with other my fellowlabourers , whose names are in the book of life .
translation.kha: Bad ïa phi ruh , ko paralok baïaineh jong nga , nga kwah ïa phi ban ïarap ïa kine ki kynthei ; naba ki la trei shitom lem bad nga ban pynsaphriang ïa ka gospel , ryngkat bad u Klemen , bad baroh kiwei pat ki para nongïatrei lem jong nga , kiba ki kyrteng jong ki , ki don ha ka kitab jong kiba im jong U Blei .

translation.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said , Shall not Shimei be put to death for this , because he cursed the  Lord s  anointed ?
translation.kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah u la kren ,  Ïa u Shimei dei ban pynïap namar ba u la tim ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la jied kum u syiem .

translation.en: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty : from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ha Israel uba pawnam ha ka jingbhabriew kat u Absalom ; um don kano kano ka jingduna naduh khlieh haduh sla jat .

translation.en: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city , to finish the transgression , and to make an end of sins , and to make reconciliation for iniquity , and to bring in everlasting righteousness , and to seal up the vision and prophecy , and to anoint the most Holy .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sien ki hynñiewphew snem ki long ka jingjlan jong ka por ba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta ban pyllait im ïa ki briew jong me bad ïa ka nongbah bakhuid jong me na ka pop bad ka jingsniew . Ïa ka pop yn map bad yn seng ïa ka jingbishar hok bymjukut , khnang ba ka jingïohipaw bad ka jingïathuhlypa kin wan urlong shisha , bad ïa ka Templ bakhuid yn pynkyntang biang .

translation.en: Speak to the children of Israel , saying , Appoint out for you cities of refuge , whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Jied ïa ki nongbah jakarieh kiba nga la hukum ha u Moses ban ïathuh ha phi .

translation.en: And Moses said , Thus saith the  Lord  , About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt :
translation.kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Pharaoh ,  U  Trai  U ong , ‘ Ha ka por shiteng synñia ngan ïaid lyngba ïa ka Ijipt ,

translation.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us ? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Naba da kumno ki briew kin tip ba me sngewbha ïa une u paidlang bad ïa nga lada me men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi ? Ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad ngi kan pyn-i ba ngi long kiba pher na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps . There was not the like made in any kingdom .
translation.kha: Khat-ar tylli ki dur sing ki don ha ki mawkyrdon , uwei uwei ha ka tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyrdon . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha kawei pat ka hima .

translation.en: For the sons of Athaliah , that wicked woman , had broken up the house of God  ; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the  Lord  did they bestow upon Baalim .
translation.kha: ( Ki nongbud jong ka Athalaïah , kata ka kynthei bymman , ki la pynjot ïa ka Templ bad ki la pyndonkam ïa kiba bun ki tiar ki tar bakyntang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal . )

translation.en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double  ; because they have defiled my land , they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew ar shah na ka bynta ki pop bad ka jingbymman jong ki , namar ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri jong nga da ki bleithaw ki bym don jingim kum ki metïap , bad ki la pyndap ïa ka da ki blei thala jong ki .

translation.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven , strengthening him .
translation.kha: U angel na bneng u la paw ha u bad u la pynshaitbor ïa u .

translation.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed  ; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made  ; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near , and art come even unto thy years : therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen , and a mocking to all countries .
translation.kha: Pha long ba la pynrem namar kito ki jingpynïap briew baroh bad ba la pyntngit da ki bleithaw ba pha la thaw , bad te ka sngi jong pha ka la wan , ka por ka la kut ! Dei na kata ka daw nga la pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ibeiñ ïa pha bad ki ri baroh ki ñiewbeiñ ïa pha .

translation.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord , that ye will be none otherwise minded : but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment , whosoever he be .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga dang sngew shaniah ïa phi . Ka jingim jong ngi ha U Trai , ka pynlong ïa nga ban sngewskhem ba phin ym shim da kumwei pat bad uta u briew uba pynkulmar ïa phi , la u long uei uei , un shah pynshitom ha U Blei .

translation.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming : it stirreth up the dead for thee , even all the chief ones of the earth  ; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei jong kiba ïap ka pynkhreh ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u syiem jong ka Babilonia . Ki sna-ïap jong kito kiba donbor ha ka pyrthei ki ïakhih ksar . Ki sna-ïap jong ki syiem ki ïeng na ki khet jong ki .

translation.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet , See now , I dwell in an house of cedar , but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa ,  Nga shong hangne ha ka ïing ba la tei da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei pat la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !

translation.en: He trusted in God  ; let him deliver him now , if he will have him : for he said , I am the Son of God .
translation.kha: U shaniah ha U Blei bad u kam ba u long U Khun U Blei . Kumta , te , to ngin peit lada U Blei u kwah ban pynim ïa u mynta !

translation.en: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress , I say , that it is good for a man so to be .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jingjynjar kaba mynta , nga pyrkhat ba ka kham bha ïa u briew ban sah kumba u long .

translation.en: And have no root in themselves , and so endure but for a time : afterward , when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word s sake , immediately they are offended .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka khubor kam ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , bad kim neh slem . Kumta haba ka jingeh lane ka jingpynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , tang kumta hi ki phai dien noh .

translation.en: Can you write the exam ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thoh ia ka exam ?

translation.en: Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come .
translation.kha: Phin ïawad ïa nga , hynrei phin ym shem ïa nga , namar phim lah ban leit sha kaba ngan don .

translation.en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the  Lord  : for men abhorred the offering of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ka pop jong ki khun u Eli ka long kaba la shyrkhei palat ha khmat U  Trai  , namar ba ki la ñiew khlem ka jingburom ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: Am I now come up without the  Lord  against this place to destroy it ? The  Lord  said to me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad ban pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap jong U  Trai  ? U  Trai  da lade hi u ong ha nga ban tur ïaleh bad ban pynjot ïa ka .

translation.en: Then Rabshakeh stood , and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and said , Hear ye the words of the great king , the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Te u rangbah synshar u ïeng joit bad u pyrta ha ka ktien Hebru ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ïathuh ha phi .

translation.en: And straightway coming up out of the water , he saw the heavens opened , and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him :
translation.kha: U Jisu u tang shu mih na ka um , u la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad U Mynsiem ba u wan hiar halor jong u kum ka paro .

translation.en: Then Eli answered and said , Go in peace : and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him .
translation.kha: Khie leit ha kaba suk ,  u Eli u ong ,  bad to U Blei ki Israel un ai ha pha ïa kata kaba pha pan na u .

translation.en: Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabniah , Sherebiah , Hodijah , Shebaniah , and Pethahiah , said , Stand up and bless the  Lord  your God for ever and ever : and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .
translation.kha: Kine ki Lebi harum ki ai ïa ka jingkhot sha ka jingmane : u Jeshua , u Kadmiel , u Bani , u Hashabneïah , u Sherebaïah , u Hodaïah , u Shebanaïah , bad u Pethahaïah . Ki ong :  Ïeng bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; ïaroh ïa u junom la junom ! Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong u , wat la ym don ka jingïaroh ba kynja briew kaba khraw palat .

translation.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour , and cities which ye built not , and ye dwell in them  ; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka khyndew ha kaba phim shym la trei bad ïa ki nongbah kiba phim shym la tei . Mynta phi shong phi sah hangta bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym thung , bad ki soh Olib na ki dieng kiba phim shym thung .’

translation.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la ïai ai ka sakhi ïa ka jingdon jong u da kiei kiei kiba bha kiba u leh : U ai ha phi ïa u slap na sahit bneng bad ïa ki jingthung ha ki por babiang ; u ai ha phi ka jingbam bad u pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong phi da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u sngewsarong u ïoh ïa la ka jingpynshitom , wat u briew u bym don ka bor pyrkhat u ïoh jinghikai . Uta uba stad un nang na kata kaba la hikai ïa u .

translation.en: Ephraim shall say , What have I to do any more with idols ? I have heard him , and observed him : I am like a green fir tree . From me is thy fruit found .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kim don bynta ei ei shuh bad ki bleithaw ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad sumar ïa ki ; kum u dieng ba ïai jyrngam ngan kah tngen ïa ki ; nga long u tynrai jong ki jingkyrkhu jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
translation.kha: Ym don ba ïarap ïa U Blei ban pynïar ïa ki bneng lane ïuh halor ka met ki mrad kynsha ka duriaw .

translation.en: And I will set my glory among the heathen , and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed , and my hand that I have laid upon them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga ; bad ngan pynpaw ha ki kumno nga pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong nga ban pyndep ïa ki jingrai bahok jong nga .

translation.en: Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will prepare thee unto blood , and blood shall pursue thee : sith thou hast not hated blood , even blood shall pursue thee .
translation.kha: Kumta te — da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — ka jingïap ka long ka kupar jong pha , bad men ym lah lait na ka . Me long uba la rem na ka jingpynïap briew , bad ka jingpynïap briew kan buddien ïa me .

translation.en: And Saul said unto him , Why have ye conspired against me , thou and the son of Jesse , in that thou hast given him bread , and a sword , and hast enquired of God for him , that he should rise against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
translation.kha: U Saul u kylli ïa u ,  Balei ma me bad u Dabid me ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha u katto katne ka jingbam bad ka waitlam , bad ba me kylli na U Blei na ka bynta jong u ? Mynta u la phai pyrshah ïa nga bad u da ap ïa ka kabu ban ïoh pynïap ïa nga !

translation.en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth , from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias , whom ye slew between the temple and the altar .
translation.kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki rangbah balui lui kan hap halor jong phi , naduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Abel balui lui haduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Sakharaïah u khun jong u Berakhaïah , ïa uba phi la pynïap hapdeng ka Templ bad ka duwan .

translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your sons cast them out ? therefore shall they be your judges .
translation.kha: Lada kane ka long kumno ba nga beh noh ïa ki , da kumno ki nongbud jong phi ki beh noh ïa ki ? Ki nongbud jong phi hi ki pynshisha ba phi bakla !

translation.en: Howbeit then , when ye knew not God , ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba la leit phim shym la ithuh ïa U Blei , kumta phi long ki mraw jong ki jingthaw ki bym dei ki blei .

translation.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin , that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ïathuh ba ka pyrthei hi baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka bor jong ka pop ; bad kumta ïa ka jingai ïa kaba la kular halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist la ai ïa kito kiba ngeit .

translation.en: And the vine said unto them , Should I leave my wine , which cheereth God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u dieng sohwaiñ u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih ïa ka waiñ jong nga , kaba pynkmen ïa ki blei bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’

translation.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands , and becometh surety in the presence of his friend .
translation.kha: Tang u briew u bym don jingsngewthuh un kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ki ram jong uwei pat .

translation.en: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion  ; for he loved Hannah : but the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
translation.kha: Bad wat la u ieit eh ïa ka Hannah , u ai ïa ka tang shi bynta namar ba U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ka .

translation.en: Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light , to cause the lamps to burn continually .
translation.kha: Hukum ïa ki Israel ban wanrah ïa ka umphniang Olib kaba khuid bha na ka bynta kita ki sharak , ba kin ai jingshai man la ka por .

translation.en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod s steward , and Susanna , and many others , which ministered unto him of their substance .
translation.kha: Ka Ïoanna , uba u Khusa u tnga jong ka u long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka ïingbishar jong u Herod ; bad ka Susanna , bad bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la pyndonkam ïa la ki jong ki jingïoh ban ïarap ïa U Jisu bad ïa ki synran jong u .

translation.en: And they two made a covenant before the  Lord  : and David abode in the wood , and Jonathan went to his house .
translation.kha: Kita baroh ar ngut ki la pynlong ka jingïateh kular bakyntang iwei ïa iwei pat . U Dabid u sah ha Horesh , bad u Jonathan u leit noh sha ïing .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That Elias is come already , and they knew him not , but have done unto him whatsoever they listed . Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba u Elijah u lah da wan bad ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei ki la leh ïa u katba ki sngewbit . Ha kajuh ka rukom kin lehbeiñ ruh ïa U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: And Samuel heard all the words of the people , and he rehearsed them in the ears of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u shahshkor ïa baroh kaba ki ong , bad nangta u leit bad ïathuh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah , even the king s daughters , and all the people that remained in Mizpah , whom Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive , and departed to go over to the Ammonites .
translation.kha: Nangta u la pynlong koidi ïa ki khun kynthei u syiem bad ïa ki briew baroh ha Mispah kiba dang sah ïa kiba u Nebusaradan u rangbah shipai u la iehnoh ha ka jingpeit u Gedalaïah . U Ishmael u la shim ïa ki kum ki koidi bad u la leit ha ka phang jong ka ri ki Ammon .

translation.en: For if the woman be not covered , let her also be shorn : but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven , let her be covered .
translation.kha: Lada ka briew kam tap ïa la ka khlieh , ka lah ban khapnoh ïa la u shñiuh . Bad namar ba ka long kaba ikhlem-akor ïa ka briew ban khi ïa la ka khlieh ne khap ïa la u shñiuh , ka dei ban tap ïa la ka khlieh .

translation.en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering : they shall also prepare a young bullock , and a ram out of the flock , without blemish .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi na ka bynta hynñiew sngi men ai u  langsohmoh , u masi kyrtong , bad u langbrot kum ki jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Baroh ki dei ban long khlem kino kino ki jingduna .

translation.en: Through his Kingdom , Jehovah will soon end the suffering of each individual .
translation.kha: Lyngba ka Hima jong u , U Jehobah shen un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingjynjar jong iwei pa iwei i briew .

translation.en: And the drinking was according to the law  ; none did compel : for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house , that they should do according to every man s pleasure .
