translation.kha: Ym don jingbuh pud ïa ka jingdih waiñ ; u syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri ka ïingsyiem ba baroh ki lah ban dih katba ki sngewkwah .

translation.en: Because of the wrath of the  Lord  it shall not be inhabited , but it shall be wholly desolate : every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished , and hiss at all her plagues .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingbitar jong nga , yn ym don u ban shong ban sah ha Babilon ; kan sah ha ka jingjot , bad baroh kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad lyngngoh .

translation.en: And Zillah , she also bare Tubal–cain , an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron : and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah .
translation.kha: Ka Sillah ka la kha ïa u Tubal Kain , uba dei u kamar uba shna ïa ki jait tiar baroh na ka rnong bad ka nar . Ka para jong u Tubal Kain ka dei ka Naamah .

translation.en: And Hapharaim , and Shion , and Anaharath ,
translation.kha: ka Hapharaim , ka Shion , ka Anaharath ,

translation.en: And Terah took Abram his son , and Lot the son of Haran his son s son , and Sarai his daughter in law , his son Abram s wife  ; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldeans , to go into the land of Canaan  ; and they came unto Haran , and dwelt there .
translation.kha: U Terah u shim ïa u Abram u khun jong u , ïa u Lot u ksiew jong u , uba long u khun jong u Haran , bad ïa ka pyrsa kurim jong u ka Sarai , ka tnga jong u Abram , bad ki ïamih lang noh na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan . Ki la leit haduh ha Haran bad ki la ïashong ïasah noh hangta .

translation.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord , and all the Gentiles , upon whom my name is called , saith the Lord , who doeth all these things .
translation.kha: Bad kumta baroh kiba sah na u bynriew kin wan sha nga , baroh ki Jentil ïa kiba nga la khot ban long ki jong nga .

translation.en: I called upon the  Lord  in distress : the  Lord  answered me , and set me in a large place .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingkordit jong nga , nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ; u la jubab ïa nga bad u la pyllait ïa nga .

translation.en: Yet they say , The  Lord  shall not see , neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  U  Trai  um ym ïohi ïa ngi ; U Blei ki Israel um ithuh ei ei .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That ye resist not evil : but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek , turn to him the other also .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : wat pynhiarkput ïa uno uno uba leh sniew ïa phi . Lada uno uno u thab ïa phi na ka ngab kamon , ai ba un thab ïa ka ngab kadiang jong phi ruh .

translation.en: Then she came and told the man of God . And he said , Go , sell the oil , and pay thy debt , and live thou and thy children of the rest .
translation.kha: Ka la leit phai pat sha u Elisha , u nongïathuhlypa , uba la ong ïa ka ,  Die ïa ka umphniang Olib bad siew dep ïa ki ram jong phi baroh , ban yn don bun ka tyngka kaba tam na ka bynta jong phi bad ki khun shynrang jong phi ban im .

translation.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border : the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee , and prevailed against thee  ; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee : there is none understanding in him .
translation.kha: Kiba ïateh lok bad phi ki la shukor ïa phi ; ki la beh noh ïa phi na la ka ri . Ki briew kiba ïasuk bad phi , mynta ki la jop ïa phi . Kito ki paralok kiba ju ïabam lang bad phi , ki la pynap jingriam ïa phi ; ki ong shaphang jong phi , ‘ Shano kato ka jingstad-buit baroh ba u don ?’

translation.en: Now therefore , O king , come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down  ; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king s hand .
translation.kha: Ngi tip , ko syiem kynrad , haduh katno phi kwah ban kem ïa u ; kumta to wan sha ka ri jong ngi , bad ngin pynthikna ba phi ïohkem ïa u .

translation.en: And the passengers that pass through the land , when any seeth a man s bone , then shall he set up a sign by it , till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïaid shaneng bad sharum jong ka ri , man ba ki lap ïa ka shyieng briew , kin buh dak hajan kata , ba kumta ki nongtih jingtep kin wan bad tep ïa ka ha ka Them ka Kynhun Shipai u Gog .

translation.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Behold , we have forsaken all , and followed thee  ; what shall we have therefore ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la kren ,  Ha khmih ,  u la ong ,  ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me . Ngin ïoh aïu ?

translation.en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , and seven lambs of the first year : they shall be unto you without blemish :
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: For I will rise up against them , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and cut off from Babylon the name , and remnant , and son , and nephew , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon bad wallam ïa ka sha ka jingjot jingpra . Ngan ym pynsah ei ei — yn ym don khynnah , yn ym don mano mano ba lait im . Nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: Not because I desire a gift : but I desire fruit that may abound to your account .
translation.kha: Ym namar ba nga kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha ; pynban , nga kwah ban ïohi ba la pynlang ïa ka jingïohnong ha ka jingbuh jingkheiñ jong phi .

translation.en: Even so , Father : for so it seemed good in thy sight .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , Ko Kpa , kane ka la long kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan jia .

translation.en: And when the words were heard which David spake , they rehearsed them before Saul : and he sent for him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong , bad ki leit ïathuh ha u Saul , bad u phah khot ïa u .

translation.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the  Lord  of hosts of a people scattered and peeled , and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden under foot , whose land the rivers have spoiled , to the place of the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the mount Zion .
translation.kha: Ka por ka wan haba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pdiang ïa ki jingainguh na kane ka ri ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah , kane ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , ki briew kiba jrong bad kiba jlih ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha ka pyrthei baroh . Kin wan sha u Lum Seïon , ha kaba la mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Neither let us commit fornication , as some of them committed , and fell in one day three and twenty thousand .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban long kiba shah kynnoh ba leh awria , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad ha ka shi sngi , arphew lai hajar ngut na ki , ki la kyllon ïap .

translation.en: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding , and they that murmured shall learn doctrine .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bieit kin nang ban sngewthuh , bad kito kiba khñium borabor kin kmen ban ïoh jinghikai .

translation.en: And the field , and the cave that is therein , were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth .
translation.kha: Kumta kata ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong ki Hit , ryngkat bad ka krem kaba don hangta , ka la kylla long ka jingïohkynti jong u Abraham kum ka jaka tep briew .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  unto these bones  ; Behold , I will cause breath to enter into you , and ye shall live :
translation.kha: To ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki : Ngan pyrsad mynsiem ha phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jingim .

translation.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep : and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father s .
translation.kha: U Laban u la leit ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , bad ha ka por ba um don ka Rakhel ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing kiba long ki jong u kpa jong ka .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Where is Sarah thy wife ? And he said , Behold , in the tent .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïakylli ïa u ,  Ha-ei ka Sarah ka tnga jong me ?  U jubab ,  Ka don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And he went forward a little , and fell on the ground , and prayed that , if it were possible , the hour might pass from him .
translation.kha: U la leit kham ha pajih , u la dem pyllup ha khyndew , bad u la duwai ba lada don ka lad , un ym hap ban ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka por jong ka jingshah shitom .

translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and gave it to them , saying ,  Drink ye all of it  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki .  To dih ïa ka , phi baroh ,  u la ong ;

translation.en: And Jattir with her suburbs , and Eshtemoa with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: ka Jattir , ka Eshtemoa ,

translation.en: Men , brethren , and fathers , hear ye my defence which I make now unto you .
translation.kha: Ko ki para nong Israel jong nga , to shahshkor ïa nga katba nga dang pynlong ka jingïasaid na ka bynta ïa lade ha khmat jong phi !

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines  ; at which time Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai , that was of the children of the giant : and they were subdued .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ka thma ka khie biang bad ki Philistia ha Geser . Kane ka jia haba u Sibbekai na Hushah u pynïap ïa u ramhah uba kyrteng u Sippai , bad ïa ki Philistia la jop .

translation.en: By Silvanus , a faithful brother unto you , as I suppose , I have written briefly , exhorting , and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ka shithi kaba lyngkot da ka jingïarap u Silas , ïa uba nga ñiew kum u para Khristan baïaineh . Nga kwah ban pynshlur ïa phi bad ban ai ïa ka jingphla jong nga ba kane ka dei ka jingaiei bashisha jong U Blei . To ïeng skhem ha ka .

translation.en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in , and putting his hand on him , that he might receive his sight .
translation.kha: U dang duwai bad ha ka jingïohipaw u la ïohi ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias ba u wan rung bad buh ïa la ki kti ha u , khnang ba un ïoh imat pat .

translation.en: And there came a fire out from before the  Lord  , and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat : which when all the people saw , they shouted , and fell on their faces .
translation.kha: Kynsan U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding , bad ka bam duh ïa ka jingkñia ainguh thang bad ïa ki bynta bakhleiñ baroh ha ka duwan . Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïa-pyrta jam , bad ki ïadem ngon haduh khyndew .

translation.en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof , wherewith they minister about it , even the censers , the fleshhooks , and the shovels , and the basins , all the vessels of the altar  ; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers  skins , and put to the staves of it .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap Sinai U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses

translation.en: In the first chariot were red horses  ; and in the second chariot black horses  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom kaba nyngkong la tan da ki kulai rong saw , ïa kaba ar da ki kulai rong ïong ,

translation.en: So the angel that communed with me said unto me , Cry thou , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy .
translation.kha: bad uta u angel u la bthah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong :  Nga la don ka jingieit bajylliew bad jingsngewkhia ïa ka Jerusalem ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga ,

translation.en: After whom is the king of Israel come out ? after whom dost thou pursue ? after a dead dog , after a flea .
translation.kha: Ha khmih ïa kaei u syiem Israel u pyrshang ban pynïap ? Ha khmih ïano u beh kthong ! Ïa u ksew ïap , ïa u thyllah !

translation.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross .
translation.kha: Ka jingkren bymshisha kaba buhrieh ïa kaei ba phi pyrkhat shisha ka long kum ka jingsop ïit ha u khiew khyndew uba tat-dor .

translation.en: And there was one named Barabbas , which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him , who had committed murder in the insurrection .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u briew uba kyrteng u Barabbas u don ha ka byndi bad ki nongïaleh pyrshah kiba la pynïap briew ha ki por jingïakhih paidbah .

translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve , went unto the chief priests , to betray him unto them .
translation.kha: Te u Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la mihnoh ban leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh khnang ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .

translation.en: Behold , this have I found , saith the preacher , counting one by one , to find out the account :
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat , nga la shem ïa kane khyndiat pa khyndiat katba nga dang wad ïa ki jubab .

translation.en: And he slew it  ; and Moses took of the blood of it , and put it upon the tip of Aaron s right ear , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot .
translation.kha: U Moses u shim khyndiat ka snam bad u tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon jong u Aaron , ha ka  tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ka  jatkmie ba sha kamon jong u .

translation.en: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah : and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren , that they should not dwell in Shechem .
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u shong ha Arumah , bad u Sebul u beh krad ïa u Gaal bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u na Shekhem , ba kumta kim lah shuh ban shong ban sah hangta .

translation.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed , above all that their fathers had done .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ki leh palat ban pynkhih bitar ïa U pyrshah ïa ki ban ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki baroh ki la leh .

translation.en: But when Jesus heard it , he answered him , saying ,  Fear not : believe only , and she shall be made whole .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kata bad u la ong ha u Jairos ,  Wat sheptieng ; tang shu ngeit , bad kan sa khiah .

translation.en: And it was so , as she rode on the ass , that she came down by the covert of the hill , and , behold , David and his men came down against her  ; and she met them .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang shong halor ka kada hajan kaba khun ha ka sharing lum , kynsan ka la ïashem ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ba ki wan sha ka .

translation.en: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement ,
translation.kha: Shisien katba nga dang peit shabar ka jingkhangïit ka ïing jong nga ,

translation.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur , and builded Nineveh , and the city Rehoboth , and Calah ,
translation.kha: Na kata ka ri u leit sa sha Assyria , bad u tei hangta ïa ki nongbah ka Ninebeh , ka Rehoboth Ir , ka Kalah ,

translation.en: In measure , when it shooteth forth , thou wilt debate with it : he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da kaba phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw . U la shim ïa ki da ka lyer bashyrkhei na shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure :
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ma ngi hi ngi sngewsarong shaphang jong phi ha ki balang jong U Blei . Ngi sngewsarong shaphang ka rukom kaba phi ïaineh ban shah bad ban ngeit lyngba baroh ki jingpynshitom beiñ bad ki jingshahshitom kiba phi ïohmad .

translation.en: I opened to my beloved  ; but my beloved had withdrawn himself , and was gone : my soul failed when he spake : I sought him , but I could not find him  ; I called him , but he gave me no answer .
translation.kha: Ngan sah halor u lum ka mirr , u lum ka jingiwbih , tad ynda ka lyer step ka beh bad ba ka jingdum ka jah noh .

translation.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees , and he bowed himself with his face to the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u shim noh ïa ki na u , bad u nguh u dem ïa u haduh madan .

translation.en: I am a stranger in the earth : hide not thy commandments from me .
translation.kha: Nga don hangne ha ka pyrthei tang shipor ; wat buhrieh ïa ki hukum jong me na nga .

translation.en: And he took his brethren with him , and pursued after him seven days  journey  ; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad u la beh nadien ïa u Jakob kumba hynñiew sngi haduh ba un da lap ïa u ha ka ri lum Gilead .

translation.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban lehbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u maham ïa ki syiem :

translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground  ; who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with gladness  ;
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka khyndew ba long maw . Ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmen .

translation.en: And the word of God increased  ; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly  ; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka ktien U Blei ka la ïai saphriang . Ka jingdon jong ki synran ha Jerusalem ka la nang kiew bad nang kiew , bad bun bah ki lyngdoh ki la pdiang ïa ka jingngeit .

translation.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka synduk da ka dieng akasia , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: Why is my pain perpetual , and my wound incurable , which refuseth to be healed ? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar , and as waters that fail ?
translation.kha: Balei nga dei ban ïaishah shitom ? Balei ba ki jingmynsaw jong nga ym lah ban pynkoit ? Balei ba kim koit ? Hato me thmu ban pynnoh mynsiem ïa nga kum ka wahduid kaba ryngkhiang ha ka por lyiur ?

translation.en: One day , she told me that she wanted a pet cat .
translation.kha: Shisien ka sngi , ka iathuh ianga ba ka kwah miaw .

translation.en: And Jephthah came to Mizpah unto his house , and , behold , his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances : and she was his only child  ; beside her he had neither son nor daughter .
translation.kha: Haba u Jephthah u wan phai sha la ïing ha Mispah , ka khun jong u ka wan ban ïakynduh ïa u , ka da shad bad tem ïa ka ksing . Ka dei ka khun marwei jong u .

translation.en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews  preparation day  ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .
translation.kha: Te naba ka la long ka sngi shuwa ka Sabbaton bad namar ba ka jingtep ka don ha syndah , ki la buh ïa ka met U Jisu hangta .

translation.en: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not , lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ , who is the image of God , should shine unto them .
translation.kha: Kim shym la ngeit , namar ba ïa ki jingmut jong ki la kah dum da u blei basniew jong kane ka pyrthei . U khang ïa ki ba kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ha ki , ka jingshai kaba mihnoh na kata ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka burom jong U Khrist , uba long ka dur jong U Blei .

translation.en: Then I went to Euphrates , and digged , and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it : and , behold , the girdle was marred , it was profitable for nothing .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit , bad haba nga la shem ïa ka jaka ha kaba nga la buhrieh ïa ki , nga la ïohi ba ki la sniew bad kim long shuh ban pyndonkam .

translation.en: And he came up , and told his father and his mother , and said , I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines : now therefore get her for me to wife .
translation.kha: U leit phai pat sha la ïing bad u ong ha la u kpa bad ha la ka kmie ,  Ka don kawei ka kynthei Philistia hangthie ha Timnah kaba la pynïapmat ïa nga . Pynïoh ïa ka na ka bynta jong nga ; nga kwah ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee , and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor , and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee , or to the stock of the stranger s family :
translation.kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong bad phi u kylla riewspah , katba u para Israel u kylla duk bad u die mraw noh ïa lade ha uta u nongwei ne ha u dkhot ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world , or with the covetous , or extortioners , or with idolaters ; for then must ye needs go out of the world .
translation.kha: Mynta ngam mut ïa ki bymngeit kiba awria ne kiba lalot ne kiba long ki nongtuh ne kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw . Ban lait na kine phi dei ban mihnoh shisyndon na ka pyrthei .

translation.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands , lest thou dash thy foot against a stone .
translation.kha: Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki , ban ri ïa me na ka jingjynthut jong ki kjat jong me ha ki maw .

translation.en: For the poor always ye have with you  ; but me ye have not always .
translation.kha: Phin don borabor ki briew kiba duk lem bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh borabor ïa nga .

translation.en: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne , and before the four beasts , and the elders : and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand , which were redeemed from the earth .
translation.kha: Ki shi lakh sawphew saw hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïeng ha khmat ka khet , ha khmat ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ha khmat ki nongsharai balang ; ki la ïarwai ïa ka jingrwai kaba thymmai , kaba tang ma ki hi ki lah ban nang . Na ki bynriew baroh , ki long tang ma ki , kiba la siewspah .

translation.en: And it shall be , that the city which is next unto the slain man , even the elders of that city shall take an heifer , which hath not been wrought with , and which hath not drawn in the yoke  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam jong ka shnong kaba jan tam na kata ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin jied kawei ka masi lud ka bym pat ju ring lyngkor .

translation.en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree , slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks ?
translation.kha: Phi mane ïa ki blei pynkharoi da kaba ïathiah shongkha hapoh ki dieng bakyntang jong phi ; phi ai ïa la ki khun kum ki jingkñia hapoh ki synrang mawsiang harud ki phud wahduid .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ To mane ïa U Trai uba U Blei jong me bad shakri tang ïa u !’

translation.en: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment , and poured it on his head , as he sat at meat .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang bam , kawei ka kynthei ka la wan sha u lem bad ka dabi alabastar ba la pyndap da ka jingsleh iwbih baremdor , ïa kaba ka la theh halor ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him : and he was perplexed , because that it was said of some , that John was risen from the dead  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Herod , u nongsynshar ka Galilaïa , u la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , u la kulmar jingmut , namar katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la mihpat .

translation.en: According to the commandment of the  Lord  they were numbered by the hand of Moses , every one according to his service , and according to his burden : thus were they numbered of him , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad u ai ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God , and the law of the king , let judgment be executed speedily upon him , whether it be unto death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno um kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei jong me lane ki aiñ jong ka hima , ïa u dei ban pynshitom mardor : da ka jingïap lane da ka jingringmraw lane da kaba knieh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u lane da ka jingset byndi .

translation.en: He shall break also the images of Beth–shemesh , that is in the land of Egypt  ; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire .
translation.kha: Un pynjot ïa ki maw jingteinam bakyntang ha Heliopolis kaba ha Ijipt bad un thang ïa ki templ jong ki blei ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: And Joses , who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas , ( which is , being interpreted , The son of consolation , ) a Levite , and of the country of Cyprus ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba u Joseph , u Lebi uba la kha ha Sypros , ïa uba ki apostol ki khot u Barnabas ( kaba mut  Uta uba pynshlur  ) ,

translation.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , that wast inhabited of seafaring men , the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants , which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it !
translation.kha: Kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha :  Ïa nongbah bapawnam la pynjot ! Ïa ki liengbah jong ka la rong noh na ki duriaw . Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki synshar ïa ki duriaw bad pyntriem ïa baroh kiba shong harud duriaw .

translation.en: And Cush begat Nimrod : he began to be a mighty one in the earth .
translation.kha: U Kush u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Nimrod ; uba la long u nongjop pyrthei uba khraw banyngkong eh .

translation.en: He trusted in the  Lord  God of Israel  ; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah , nor any that were before him .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; ki Judah kim shym ïoh da uwei pat u syiem kum ma u , ha shuwa ne hadien ka por jong u .

translation.en: Again , I considered all travail , and every right work , that for this a man is envied of his neighbour . This is also vanity and vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Nga la tip ruh balei ba ki briew ki trei shitom ban jop : Ka dei namar ba ki bishni ïa kiei kiei kiba ki paramarjan jong ki , ki don . Hynrei ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .

translation.en: Then David said unto the messenger , Thus shalt thou say unto Joab , Let not this thing displease thee , for the sword devoureth one as well as another : make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it : and encourage thou him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha uta u nonglamktien ,  Pynshlur ïa u Joab bad ong ïa u ba un ym khuslai , namar phim lah ban ong mano ban ïap ha ka thma . Ïathuh ïa u ban pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kham khlaiñ ïa ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: Now when much time was spent , and when sailing was now dangerous , because the fast was now already past , Paul admonished them ,
translation.kha: Ngi la pynlut kham bun ka por hangta , tad ynda ka la long kaba ma ban bteng ïa ka jingleit da ka lieng , naba mynta ka Sngi ka Jingsiewspah ka la dep . Kumta u Paul u la ai ïa kane ka jingai jingmut ha ki :

translation.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend . And they said unto him , Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him .
translation.kha: U la kylli ïa ki ha ka por aïu ba u khun jong u , u la kham ïohbor , bad ki la jubab ,  Mynhynnin ha ka por shi baje nohphai sngi mynba ka jingshit na u ka la iehnoh .

translation.en: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the sons of the king , and Abiathar the priest , and Joab the captain of the host : but Solomon thy servant hath he not called .
translation.kha: U la ai ka jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid , bad u la khot sngewbha ruh sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , hynrei ïa u Solomon u khun jong phi um shym la khot .

translation.en: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la sdang ban kylli para ma ki uno napdeng jong ki uba lah ban long u ban sa leh ïa kane .

translation.en: And the men of the city went out , and fought with Joab : and there fell some of the people of the servants of David  ; and Uriah the Hittite died also .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun nongshun ki la wan mih na ka nongbah bad ki la ïaleh ïa ki kynhun jong u Joab ; katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Dabid ki la shah pynïap , bad kumta ruh ka la long ïa u Uriah .

translation.en: And they shall look unto the earth  ; and behold trouble and darkness , dimness of anguish  ; and they shall be driven to darkness .
translation.kha: lane peit shlip ha ka khyndew , pynban kin ym ïohi ei ei hynrei ka jingjynjar bad ka jingdum , ka jingdum kaba pyntriem sha kaba la beh ïa ki .

translation.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Phi ki paid Israel , phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad ïeng ïaleh ïa nga . Hynrei mynta , to phai pat sha nga !

translation.en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother  ;
translation.kha: u la lait na kaba ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ka kmie .

translation.en: And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ! To ai ka burom ïa nga ha khmat jong me mynta , kajuh ka burom kaba nga la don lem bad me ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , as did David his father .
translation.kha: U Asa u leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh .

translation.en: And white robes were given unto every one of them  ; and it was said unto them , that they should rest yet for a little season , until their fellowservants also and their brethren , that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ha uwei pa uwei na ki la ai ïa ka jaiñkup balieh , bad la ong ïa ki ba kin shongthait sa shipor , tad ynda la dep kheiñ lut ïa ki para shakri bad parabangeit kiba la shah pynïap , kumba la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked , and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible .
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ka bor jong ki rangbah bymman bad kiba leh jubor . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Tom was even busier than I was .
translation.kha: U Tom u kham bunkam ban ia nga .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  raised them up judges , then the  Lord  was with the judge , and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge : for it repented the  Lord  because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them .
translation.kha: Man ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , U  Trai  u ïarap ïa uta u nongïalam bad u pyllait im ïa ki briew na ki nongshun jong ki katba uta u nongïalam u dang im . U  Trai  u sngewsynei ïa ki namar ba ki la ud ha ki jingshitom bad jingshah banbeiñ jong ki .

translation.en: For if that first covenant had been faultless , then should no place have been sought for the second .
translation.kha: Lada kam shym la don kano kano kaba duna bad ka jutang kaba nyngkong , yn ym donkam ïa kaba ar .

translation.en: But none of these things move me , neither count I my life dear unto myself , so that I might finish my course with joy , and the ministry , which I have received of the Lord Jesus , to testify the gospel of the grace of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ñiew ïa la ka jingim ba ka long ka bymdondor ei ei ïa nga ; nga kwah tang ban pyndep ïa ka jingtrei jong nga bad pyndep pura ïa ka kam kaba U Trai Jisu u la ai ha nga ban leh , kaba long ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei .

translation.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother , and his father , and keep my sabbaths : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban burom ïa la ka kmie bad ïa la u kpa , bad u dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton , kumba nga la hukum . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah , and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beer–sheba , and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which were on a man s left hand at the gate of the city .
translation.kha: U wallam sha Jerusalem ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ju don ha ki nongbah ka Judah , bad ha kylleng jong ka ri u la ñiewsang ïa ki duwan ha kiba ki ju ai jingkñia . U la pyntwa ruh ïa ki duwan ba la pynkyntang sha ki ksuid-durblang hajan ka khyrdop ba la tei da u Joshua , u lat ka nongbah , kiba don sha kadiang jong ka khyrdop bah kaba ki ju rung sha ka nongbah .

translation.en: We looked for peace , but no good came  ; and for a time of health , and behold trouble !
translation.kha: Ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka por ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ; ka jingtriem ka wan pynban .

translation.en: And call ye on the name of your gods , and I will call on the name of the  Lord  : and the God that answereth by fire , let him be God . And all the people answered and said , It is well spoken .
translation.kha: Nangta ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin duwai ha u blei jong ki , bad ma nga ngan duwai ha U  Trai  , bad uta uba jubab da kaba phah ïa ka ding — uta u dei U Blei .  U paidbah u la pyrta bad ai ïa ka jingmynjur .

translation.en: And Moses said , This shall be , when the  Lord  shall give you in the evening flesh to eat , and in the morning bread to the full  ; for that the  Lord  heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him : and what are we ? your murmurings are not against us , but against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u la ong ,  Dei U  Trai  u ban ai ïa phi ka doh ban bam ha ka por janmiet bad kyrhai u kpu ha ka por mynstep , namar ba u la ïohsngew haduh katno phi la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u . Haba phi khñium pyrshah ïa ngi , phi ïakhñium shisha keiñ pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: If one be found slain in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it , lying in the field , and it be not known who hath slain him :
translation.kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , phi lap ha lum ha wah ïa u briew uba la shah pynïap , bad phim tip mano ba la pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And when there had been much disputing , Peter rose up , and said unto them , Men and brethren , ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us , that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel , and believe .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïatainia kaba slem u Petros u la ïeng bad u la ong ,  Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , phi tip ba la kham slem mynshuwa U Blei u la jied ïa nga napdeng jong phi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki Jentil , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohsngew bad ngeit .

translation.en: But I say unto you which hear , Love your enemies , do good to them which hate you ,
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi kiba shahshkor ïa nga : Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi , lehbha ïa kito kiba isih ïa phi ,

translation.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee s children .
translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki , ki long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob bad u Josis bad ka tnga u Sebedi .

translation.en: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law , when thou art passed over , that thou mayest go in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , a land that floweth with milk and honey  ; as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee .
translation.kha: bad thoh ha ki ïa kine ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh . Ynda phi la rung sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la kular ha phi ,

translation.en: So Joshua sent messengers , and they ran unto the tent  ; and , behold , it was hid in his tent , and the silver under it .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba mareh sha ka ïingjaiñ bad ki shem ba kita ki mar ba la shah kyntait la tep shisha hangta , bad ka rupa ha trai .

translation.en: And the king said , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Ahimaaz answered , When Joab sent the king s servant , and me thy servant , I saw a great tumult , but I knew not what it was .
translation.kha: Hato u samla Absalom u dang im ?  U syiem u kylli . U Ahimaas u jubab ,  Kynrad , haba u Joab u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u phah ïa nga , nga ïohi ïa ka jingkhihwin kaba jur , hynrei ngam tip ka dei kaei .

translation.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world , he saith , Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not , but a body hast thou prepared me :
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , haba U Khrist u la dei ban wan sha kane ka pyrthei u la ong ha U Blei :  Mem kwah ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh , hynrei me la pynkhreh ka met na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Saying , Surely blessing I will bless thee , and multiplying I will multiply thee .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Nga kular ba ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pynroi ïa me pateng la pateng .

translation.en: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness : and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast , full of names of blasphemy , having seven heads and ten horns .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad u angel u la rah ïa nga sha ka ri shyiap . Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka briew kaba shong halor u mradkhlaw rong saw uba la don ki kyrteng kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba la thoh baroh shi rynïeng jong u ; u mradkhlaw u la don hynñiew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki reng .

translation.en: And they took him , and brought him unto Areopagus , saying , May we know what this new doctrine , whereof thou speakest , is ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa u Paul , ki la wallam ïa u ha khmat ka dorbar jong ka nongbah , ka Ariopagos , bad ki la ong ,  Ngi kwah ban tip kaei kane ka jinghikai bathymmai kaba me kren .

translation.en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings , wherein thou hast transgressed against me : for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride , and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ma phi , ki briew jong nga phim donkam shuh ban lehrain ba phi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno baroh uba sarong bad uba sngewmeng , bad phin ym ïeng ïaleh pyrshah shuh da lei lei ïa nga ha u lum bakyntang jong nga .

translation.en: Then answered them the Pharisees , Are ye also deceived ?
translation.kha: Hato u la pynbieit ïa phi ruh ?  ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: I am come a light into the world , that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness .
translation.kha: Nga la wan sha ka pyrthei kum ka jingshai , ba baroh kiba ngeit ha nga kin ym sah ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning , that we should love one another .
translation.kha: Ka khubor kaba phi la ïohsngew naduh kaba mynnyngkong hi ka long kane : Ngi dei ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: But as an hired servant , and as a sojourner , he shall be with thee , and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee :
translation.kha: U dei ban shong bad phi kum u nongtrei bad shakri ïa phi haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .

translation.en: Who was before a blasphemer , and a persecutor , and injurious : but I obtained mercy , because I did it ignorantly in unbelief .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la leh-isynei ïa nga namar ngam pat shym la don ka jingngeit bad kumta ngam shym tip ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .

translation.en: And Manoah arose , and went after his wife , and came to the man , and said unto him , Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: U Manoah u ïeng joit bad u bud ïa la ka tnga . U leit sha uta u briew bad u kylli ,  Dei ma phi mo u briew uba la ïakren bad ka tnga jong nga ?   Ho-oid ,  u jubab .

translation.en: The  Lord  is great in Zion  ; and he is high above all the people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba khlaiñbor ha Seïon ; U long uba hakhlieh tam halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .
translation.kha: A katno pha long kaba kmen ban ngeit ba ka khubor jong U Trai ha pha kan urlong shisha !

translation.en: But let judgment run down as waters , and righteousness as a mighty stream .
translation.kha: Pynban , ai ba ka jingbishar hok kan tuid kum ka wahduid , bad ka jinglehhok kum ka wah ka bym ju rngad .

translation.en: 13 What Is the Good News About Religion ?
translation.kha: 13 Kaei ka Khubor Babha Shaphang ka Niam ?

translation.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel , and that I am the  Lord  your God , and none else : and my people shall never be ashamed .
translation.kha: Te , ma phi ki Israel , phin tip ba nga don hapdeng jong phi bad ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei jong phi bad ym don uwei pat . Ki briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .

translation.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city , he hungered .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka lynti ba u leit phai sha ka nongbah , U Jisu u la thngan .

translation.en: Or if he shall ask an egg , will he offer him a scorpion ?
translation.kha: Lane hato phin ai ïa u da ka  ñianglartham haba u pan ïa ka pylleng ?

translation.en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth .
translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la pynkut ïa ka Hukum , khnang ba uei uei baroh uba ngeit u don ka jingïadei bad U Blei .

translation.en: And they passed on and went their way  ; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah , which belongeth to Benjamin .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïaid lait ïa ka Jebus bad ki ïai bteng ha ka lynti jong ki . Ka la sep sngi haba ki wan poi ha Gibeah kaba ha ka ri ki Benjamin .

translation.en: And Gideon went in , and made ready a kid , and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour : the flesh he put in a basket , and he put the broth in a pot , and brought it out unto him under the oak , and presented it .
translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u la leit sha la ïing bad u shet uwei u khunblang bad u la pyndonkam shiphew kilo u  purew ban shet ïa u kpu khlem thiat . U buh ïa ka doh ha ka shang bad ïa ka syrwa hapoh u khiew , u la wallam ïa ki sha u angel jong U  Trai  ha trai u dieng Sning , bad u ai ïa ki ha u .

translation.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks  ; and let them choose one bullock for themselves , and cut it in pieces , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under : and I will dress the other bullock , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under :
translation.kha: Wallam ar tylli ki masi dab ; ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin shim uwei , pynïap ïa u , ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u bad buh halor ki diengthang — hynrei wat pynmeh ding . Nga ruh ngan leh kumjuh ïa uwei pat u masi dab .

translation.en: And Abimelech rose up , and all the people that were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abimelekh lem bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih mynmiet bad ki rieh shabar ka Shekhem ha ki saw kynhun .

translation.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei u leh ïa kaba dei haba u bishar ïa ki briew kiba leh ïa kiei kiei kum kine .

translation.en: To me belongeth vengeance , and recompence  ; their foot shall slide in due time : for the day of their calamity is at hand , and the things that shall come upon them make haste .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynhiarkput bad pynshitom ïa ki ; ka por kan poi haba kin kyllon ; ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki ka la jan .

translation.en: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure , as though we reached not unto you : for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ :
translation.kha: Bad namar ba phi don hapoh kita ki pud , ngim shym la jam palat ïa ki mynba ngi la wan sha phi , da kaba wanrah ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .

translation.en: And Absalom , and all the people the men of Israel , came to Jerusalem , and Ahithophel with him .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad baroh ki Israel baroh lem bad u ki rung sha Jerusalem , bad u Ahithophel u la don ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: And the king said unto Hazael , Take a present in thine hand , and go , meet the man of God , and enquire of the  Lord  by him , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
translation.kha: u la ong ha u Hasael , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Khie leit rah ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongïathuhlypa , bad kyrpad ïa u ban kylli na U  Trai  la ngan koit biang ne em .

translation.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold , silver , precious stones , wood , hay , stubble ;
translation.kha: Don ki ban pyndonkam da ka ksiar ne da ka rupa ne da ki mawkordor ha kaba tei halor ka nongrim ; kiwei pat kin pyndonkam da ka dieng ne da u phlang ne da u jyntang .

translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prepare thee stuff for removing , and remove by day in their sight  ; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight : it may be they will consider , though they be a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , to teh ïa ka song kumba u nongphetwir u leh bad mihnoh ha shuwa ban wan ka miet . Ai ba uwei uwei baroh un ïohi ba me mihnoh bad leit sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse kito kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah kin ïohi ïa me .

translation.en: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew khyndai snem .

translation.en: The  Lord  taketh my part with them that help me : therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me .
translation.kha: U dei U  Trai  uba ïarap ïa nga ; bad ngan ïohi ba ki nongshun jong nga ki shahjop .

translation.en: Just as a wise and loving father instructs his children , so God teaches people everywhere the best way to live .
translation.kha: Kumba da jingstad bad jingieit u kpa u hikai ïa la ki khun , kumta ruh U Blei u hikai ïa ki briew katsha ba bha tam ka rukom ban im .

translation.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot  ; they did eat , they drank , they bought , they sold , they planted , they builded  ;
translation.kha: Kan long kumba ka la long ha ka por jong u Lot . Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , da kaba ïathied bad ïadie , da kaba thung bad tei .

translation.en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices : wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngdoh la thung ban ai ki jingainguh bad ki jingkñia da ki mrad sha U Blei , bad kumta U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ngi u dei ruh ban don ei ei ban ainguh .

translation.en: And all the princes , and the mighty men , and all the sons likewise of king David , submitted themselves unto Solomon the king .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar bad ki shipai , bad wat kiwei pat ki khun shynrang baroh jong u Dabid ki kular ban kohnguh ïa u Solomon kum u syiem .

translation.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat , and kicked : thou art waxen fat , thou art grown thick , thou art covered with fatness  ; then he forsook God which made him , and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation .
translation.kha: Ki briew U  Trai  ki la riewspah , hynrei kiba ïaleh pyrshah ; ki la sngaid bad ki la dap bha da ka jingbam . Te ki la iehnoh ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki , bad ki la kyntait ïa u nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki .

translation.en: All nations compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  will I destroy them .
translation.kha: Shibun ki nongshun ki la don sawdong jong nga ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U  Trai  !

translation.en: Then said Achish unto his servants , Lo , ye see the man is mad : wherefore then have ye brought him to me ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Akhish u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Ha khmih ! Une u briew u lamwir ! Balei phi wan ïalam ïa u sha nga ?

translation.en: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , bun na ki briew , kynthup ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki sdang ban ujor pyrshah ïa ki para Jiw jong ki .

translation.en: He is like a man which built an house , and digged deep , and laid the foundation on a rock : and when the flood arose , the stream beat vehemently upon that house , and could not shake it : for it was founded upon a rock .
translation.kha: U long kum u briew uba , ha kaba tei ïa la ka ïing , u la tih jylliew bad u la pynshong nongrim halor u mawsiang . Ka wah ka la shlei bad ka la lynshop ïa kata ka ïing hynrei kam lah ban pynkhih ïa ka , namar la shna bha ïa ka .

translation.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess , a day of clouds and of thick darkness , as the morning spread upon the mountains : a great people and a strong  ; there hath not been ever the like , neither shall be any more after it , even to the years of many generations .
translation.kha: Kan sa long ka sngi kaba dum bad kaba pynlong jingkhuslai , ka sngi kaba ïong bad ba-dum lyoh . Ka kynhun bakhraw jong ki puit ka tur kum ka jingdum kaba pyiar halor ki lumbah . Ym ju don mynno mynno ruh kum kane , bad yn ym don shuh lano lano ruh .

translation.en: And when he had consulted with the people , he appointed singers unto the  Lord  , and that should praise the beauty of holiness , as they went out before the army , and to say , Praise the  Lord   ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ïakren bad u paidbah , u syiem u hukum ïa katto katne ki nongtem nongput ban phong ïa ki jingriam kiba ki ju phong ha ki por bakyntang bad ban ïaid na khmat ka kynhun shipai , da kaba rwai :  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long bymjukut !

translation.en: And they called Rebekah , and said unto her , Wilt thou go with this man ? And she said , I will go .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khot ïa ka Rebekka bad ki la kylli ,  Hato pha kwah ban leit bad une u briew ?   Ho-oid ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .
translation.kha: kiba ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba bha bad rai pynrem ïa kiba lui lui sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me : and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them .
translation.kha: Da shisha nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud ki briew jong nga , bad nga la ïohi ruh kumno ki nong Ijipt ki pynshitom beiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash , Bring out thy son , that he may die : because he hath cast down the altar of Baal , and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ong ha u Joash ,  Wallam shabar ïa u khun jong me hangne , ba ngin pynïap ïa u ! U la pynkhyllem ïa ka duwan ïa u Baal bad pynngat ïa ka dak jong ka Asherah kaba ha syndah jong ka .

translation.en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them , Come up hither . And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud  ; and their enemies beheld them .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam na bneng kaba ong ïa ki ,  To wan kiew shane !  Katba ki nongshun jong ki , ki dang khmih , ki la kiew sha bneng ha u lyoh .

translation.en: I have chosen the way of truth : thy judgments have I laid before me .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ban kohnguh ; nga la pynshahshkor ïa ki jingbishar jong me .

translation.en: And ships shall come from the coast of Kittim , and shall afflict Asshur , and shall afflict Eber , and he also shall perish for ever .
translation.kha: Ki nonghiarthma kin wan da ki lieng na Sypros ; Kin jop ïa u Assyria bad u Eber , Hynrei ma ki ruh kin jah noh jar .

translation.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband : but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones .
translation.kha: Ka tnga kaba bha ka long ka jingsarong bad jingkmen jong u tnga jong ka ; hynrei ka tnga kaba pynlehrain ïa la u tnga ka long kum ka jingpang bampong ïa ki shyieng jong u .

translation.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia .
translation.kha: U langbrot uba me ïohi uba la don ar tylli ki reng u ïeng na ka bynta ki hima jong ka Media bad Persia .

translation.en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell , to the sides of the pit .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynban , la pynhiar ïa me sha ka bynta kaba jylliew tam jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: For the  Lord  giveth wisdom : out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding .
translation.kha: Dei U  Trai  uba ai ïa ka jingstad ; na u ka wan ka jingtip bad ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: That which hath been is now  ; and that which is to be hath already been  ; and God requireth that which is past .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia lane kaba lah ban jia ka la lah jia mynshuwa . U Blei u pynlong ïa kajuh ban jia bad ïai jia .

translation.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh . If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh , I more :
translation.kha: Nga lah eh , da shisha , ban shaniah ha kum kito kiei kiei . Lada uno uno u pyrkhat ba u lah ban shaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar , nga don ka daw kaba kham khraw ban sngew kumta .

translation.en: By much slothfulness the building decayeth  ; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u jaipdeh shaba palat ban shna pynbha ïa ka tnum ïing jong u , kan jaw um , bad ka ïing kan khyllem .

translation.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa shispah khatkhyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: Save thyself , and come down from the cross .
translation.kha: Mynta to hiar noh na ka diengphna bad to pynim ïa lade !

translation.en: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men : and they fled before the men of Ai .
translation.kha: Kumta kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah Israel ki leit tur shata , hynrei ki hap ban phet ïap nangta .

translation.en: But Joshua the son of Nun , which standeth before thee , he shall go in thither : encourage him : for he shall cause Israel to inherit it .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynshlur ïa u nongïarap jong me , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun . Ma u , un sa ïalam ïa ki Israel ban kam kynti ïa kata ka ri .’

translation.en: The  Lord  shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses , and in all that thou settest thine hand unto  ; and he shall bless thee in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jong phi bad un pyndap ïa ki thiar jong phi da u kew . Un kyrkhu ïa phi ha kata ka ri ba un ai ha phi .

translation.en: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned seventeen years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u Joash u khun jong u Ahasaïah kum u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoahas u khun jong u Jehu u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: And the men did so  ; and took two milch kine , and tied them to the cart , and shut up their calves at home :
translation.kha: Ki ruh ki leh kumba la ong ; ki shim ar tylli ki masi kynthei bad ki teh ïa ki ha kata ka kali , bad ki set ïa ki khun masi ha sem .

translation.en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth , that thou shalt be dumb , and shalt not be to them a reprover : for they are a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Ngan teh ïa u thylliej jong me ba kumta men ym lah ban maham ïa kine ki riewïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord s day , and heard behind me a great voice , as of a trumpet ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi U Trai , U Mynsiem u la shim ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur bajam , kaba sawa kum ka turoi , kaba kren na shadien jong nga .

translation.en: And before him shall be gathered all nations : and he shall separate them one from another , as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats :
translation.kha: bad ïa ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh yn lumlang ha khmat jong u . Nangta un phiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun , kumba u nongaplangbrot u pynïakhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria , and I will deliver thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïapan dor bad phi ha ka kyrteng jong u patsha . Ngan ai ha phi ar hajar ki kulai lada phi lah ban pynïoh katta ngut ki briew ban shong ha ki !

translation.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness , and bringeth out to light the shadow of death .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingshai sha ki jaka ba-dum tliw kum ka jingïap .

translation.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following  ; for it shall be very grievous .
translation.kha: Ïa ka por ka jingpahuh yn klet lut baroh , namar ka  nemsniew ka ban bud kan long kaba shyrkhei katta katta .

translation.en: But the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them unto thee , and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction , until they be destroyed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un aiti ha phi ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad un pynkulmar ïa ki haduh ba kin da shah pynjot lut thiaw .

translation.en: And God s anger was kindled because he went : and the angel of the  Lord  stood in the way for an adversary against him . Now he was riding upon his ass , and his two servants were with him .
translation.kha: U Blei u la bitar ba u Balaam u la leit , bad katba u Balaam u dang leit da kaba shong halor ka kada jong u , la synran ïa u da ar ngut ki shakri jong u ; u angel U  Trai  u la ïeng ha ka surok ban khang lynti ïa u .

translation.en: And the  Lord s  anger was kindled the same time , and he sware , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ha kata ka sngi , bad u la kular ,

translation.en: Whom God hath raised up , having loosed the pains of death : because it was not possible that he should be holden of it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , da kaba pyllaitluid ïa u na ka bor jong ka , namar ka long ka bym lah long ba ka jingïap kan bat ïa u .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Uzza , and he smote him , because he put his hand to the ark : and there he died before God .
translation.kha: Hangta hi U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa u Ussah bad u pynïap ïa u namar ba u ktah ïa ka synduk . U ïap hangta ha khmat U Blei ,

translation.en: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah , the son of Koz . And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah , the son of Meshezabeel . And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baanah .
translation.kha: U Meremoth , u khun jong u Uriah bad u ksiew jong u Hakkos u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah bad u ksiew jong u Meshesabel u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sadok , u khun jong u Baana u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: Except it be for this one voice , that I cried standing among them , Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day .
translation.kha: lait tang kawei kaba nga la pyrta jam haba nga ïeng ha khmat jong ki : ‘ Ïa nga la bishar da ma phi ha kane ka sngi naba nga ngeit ba kiba ïap kin sa mihpat .’

translation.en: And I said , My strength and my hope is perished from the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ngam slem shuh ban im ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U  Trai  ka la duh .

translation.en: And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .
translation.kha: Ka la jia sa kawei pat ka  nemsniew ha kata ka ri , nalor kata kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la leit sha u Abimelekh u syiem jong ki Philistia , ha Gerar .

translation.en: How would you feel if you knew that a reunion with your loved ones was possible right here on earth under the best of conditions ?
translation.kha: Kumno phin sngew lada phi tip ba phin sa ia kynduh biang bad kiba ieit ki jongphi- ha kane ka pyrthei , hapdeng ka jinglong jingman ba bha tam .

translation.en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves , and they came to the battle : and , behold , every man s sword was against his fellow , and there was a very great discomfiture .
translation.kha: Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki ïaid sha ka thma pyrshah ïa ki Philistia , kiba ïaleh iwei ïa iwei pat ha ka jingkulmar bajur .

translation.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast , of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka khleiñ jong u mrad ïa uba wanlam kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life  ; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance .
translation.kha: Me la pyn-i ha nga ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba ïalam sha ka jingim , bad ka jingdon ryngkat jong me kan pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen .’

translation.en: For until the law sin was in the world : but sin is not imputed when there is no law .
translation.kha: La don ka pop ha ka pyrthei shuwa ba yn ai ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei hangno ha bym don ka hukum , ym don jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa ki pop .

translation.en: That there should be no schism in the body ; but that the members should have the same care one for another .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ba yn ym don ka jingïapait ïapra ha kata ka met , hynrei baroh ki dkhot met kiba ïapher kin ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: We encourage you to keep on taking in knowledge of God , to tell the rest of your family and friends about what you are learning , and to associate regularly with us at our Christian meetings . —Hebrews 10 :23-25 .
translation.kha: Ngi pynshlur ïa phi ba phin ïai bteng ban pule shaphang U Blei , ban ïathuh ïa la ki bahaïing hasem bad ki paralok jong phi shaphang kiei kiba phi pule bad ban ïasyllok bad ngi khlem da pud ha ki jingïalang Khristan jong ngi . —Hebru 10 :23-25 .

translation.en: But when they departed from Perga , they came to Antioch in Pisidia , and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and sat down .
translation.kha: Ki la nang leit na Perga bad ki la poi ha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki la leit sha ka synagog bad ki la shong .

translation.en: Go from the presence of a foolish man , when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge .
translation.kha: Kiar na ki briew kiba bieit ; kim don ei ei ban hikai ïa phi .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?
translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien , ïa kiba la phah da ki Pharisi , ki la kylli te ïa u Ïoannis ,  Lada mem dei u Messaïah lane u Elijah lane u nongïathuhlypa , balei pat me pynbaptis ?

translation.en: They are of those that rebel against the light  ; they know not the ways thereof , nor abide in the paths thereof .
translation.kha: Ki don ki briew kiba kyntait ïa ka jingshai ; kim sngewthuh ïa ka lane ki leit sha kaba ka ïalam .

translation.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding : therefore shalt thou not exalt them .
translation.kha: Me la khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki ban pyrkhat beit ; wat shah ïa ki ban jop halor jong nga mynta .

translation.en: And from thence he arose , and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon , and entered into an house , and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la mih bad leit noh sha ka jaka kaba hajan ka nongbah Tyros . U la leit sha kawei ka ïing bad um shym la kwah mano mano ban tip ba u don hangta , hynrei ba u lah ban shong ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand , and took Sela by war , and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ha ka Them Mluh ; u kurup ïa ka nongbah Sela ha ka thma bad u khot ïa ka , ka Joktheel , ka kyrteng kaba dang ïaisah .

translation.en: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Da kumta , phin weng noh ïa ka jingshah kynnoh pop napdeng jong phi , haba phi leh ïa kata kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: From that time many of his disciples went back , and walked no more with him .
translation.kha: Namar kane , kiba bun na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki la phai dien noh bad kim leit shuh bad u .

translation.en: Which removeth the mountains , and they know not : which overturneth them in his anger .
translation.kha: Khlem jingmaham u pynkynriah ïa ki lum , bad da ka jingbitar u pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: This is the word which the  Lord  hath spoken concerning him  ; The virgin , the daughter of Zion , hath despised thee , and laughed thee to scorn  ; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong  Ka nongbah Jerusalem ka rkhie ïa me , ko Sennakherib , bad ka ñiewbeiñ ïa me .

translation.en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm , thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land , thou , and all thy bands , and many people with thee .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u bad bun ki jaitbynriew kiba don bad u kin tur ïaleh kum ka  erïong bad tap ïa ka ri kum u lyoh .

translation.en: Fear not , daughter of Sion : behold , thy King cometh , sitting on an ass s colt .
translation.kha: Wat ym sheptieng , ko ka nongbah Seïon ! Hangne u syiem jong pha u wan , u da shong halor u khun kada .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Damascus , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Damaskos ki ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki ; ki la shohbeiñ ïa ki briew ka Gilead da ka kam runar ba khleh bieit .

translation.en: And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :
translation.kha: U la khot lang ïa ki synran jong u baroh bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ong ïa phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk , ka la pynnoh kham bun ha ka synduk jingainguh ban ïa baroh kiwei pat .

translation.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages , and gathereth fruit unto life eternal : that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together .
translation.kha: Uta uba ot u ïoh la ka bainong bad u lum ïa ka jingmih na ka bynta ka jingim bymjukut ; ba uta uba bet bad uta uba ot kin ïakmen lang .

translation.en: And thou shalt speak and say before the  Lord  thy God , A Syrian ready to perish was my father , and he went down into Egypt , and sojourned there with a few , and became there a nation , great , mighty , and populous :
translation.kha: nangta , hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  phin ong ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ U kpa tymmen jong nga u dei u nong Aram uba ïaidwir , uba la leit ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem sha Ijipt ban shong ban sah . Ki ïadon tang khyndiat eh mynba ki ïadon hangta , hynrei ki la man long ka jaitbynriew kaba bun paid bad kaba khrawbor .

translation.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time , and they shall search thine house , and the houses of thy servants  ; and it shall be , that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes , they shall put it in their hand , and take it away .
translation.kha: Mynta , la kumno kumno ngan phah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong nga ban ïit ha ka ïingsyiem jong me bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad ban shim ïa kaei kaei baroh kiba ki kheiñ kordor . Kin poi hangto lashai kumba katne por .

translation.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob , and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains : and mine elect shall inherit it , and my servants shall dwell there .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki khun Israel kiba dei na ka jait Judah , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong nga kaba ha ki lumbah . Ki briew ba la jied jong nga , kiba shakri ïa nga , kin shong hangta .

translation.en: Yea also , because he transgresseth by wine , he is a proud man , neither keepeth at home , who enlargeth his desire as hell , and is as death , and cannot be satisfied , but gathereth unto him all nations , and heapeth unto him all people :
translation.kha: Ka spah ka long kaba shukor . Ki briew kiba lalot ki long kiba sarong bad bym lah ban shong khop — kum ka jingïap hi da lei lei kim ju hun . Namarkata ki jop ïa kawei ka hima hadien kawei pat na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the  Lord  , because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Te ki briew ka Ijipt baroh kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .  U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki Israel ki la shaniah ha phi ko ki nong Ijipt ban ïarap ïa ki , hynrei phim long kham bha ban ïa u dieng uba tlot .

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Thy sins are forgiven .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew ,  Ïa ki pop jong pha la map .

translation.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki shim katto katne na ki jinglute ba ki ïohknieh ha ka thma bad pynkyntang ïa ki ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem : but he did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , like David his father :
translation.kha: U Ahas u long syiem haba u la dap arphew snem ka rta , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Um shym la bud ïa ka nuksa babha jong u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban u la leh ïa kaei ka bym pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  bad u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiem Israel .

translation.en: Therefore Saul removed him from him , and made him his captain over a thousand  ; and he went out and came in before the people .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u phah noh ïa u bad u thung ïa u kum u nongïalam ïa ki shihajar ki rangbah .

translation.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north , and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the  Lord   ; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you : for I am merciful , saith the  Lord  , and I will not keep anger for ever .
translation.kha: U la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad ong ha ka Israel ,  Ko Israel bymïaineh , to wan pat sha nga . Nga long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad ngan ym bitar ; ngan ym bitar ïa pha shi junom .

translation.en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God ,
translation.kha: khnang ba ha ka por ba mynta lyngba ka Balang , ki angel nongsynshar bad ki bor ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng ki lah ban tip ïa ka jingstad jong u ha baroh ki rukom ba-ïapher jong ki .

translation.en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry , My father , and my mother , the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u khynnah un heh un san ban ong ‘ Mei’ bad ‘ Pa’ , ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Damaskos bad ïa ka mar lute baroh jong ka Samaria yn kit noh da u patsha ka Assyria .

translation.en: When I have bent Judah for me , filled the bow with Ephraim , and raised up thy sons , O Zion , against thy sons , O Greece , and made thee as the sword of a mighty man .
translation.kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ka Judah kum ka ryntieh jong u shipai bad ïa ka Israel kum ki khnam . Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki rangbah jong ka Seïon kum ka waitlam , ban ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong ka Gris .

translation.en: Wherefore they are no more twain , but one flesh . What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
translation.kha: Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei . Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .

translation.en: Where is the wise ? where is the scribe ? where is the disputer of this world ? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?
translation.kha: hangno don kiba stad ? hangno don ki riewshemphang ? hangno don ki nongïatainia batbit jong kane ka pyrthei ? U Blei u la pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei ka long ka jingibieit !

translation.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies , and he put a trumpet in every man s hand , with empty pitchers , and lamps within the pitchers .
translation.kha: U pynbynta ïa ki laispah ngut ki rangbah ha ki lai kynhun , bad u ai ha uwei uwei u briew kawei ka turoi bad uwei u khra uba don ka dongmusa hapoh jong u .

translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son : and she said , Now will I praise the  Lord  : therefore she called his name Judah  ; and left bearing .
translation.kha: Nangta ka punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  Ha kane ka sien ngan ïaroh ïa U  Trai   ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Judah . Nangta ka la wai noh ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: Say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim , and the tribes of Israel his fellows , and will put them with him , even with the stick of Judah , and make them one stick , and they shall be one in mine hand .
translation.kha: to ïathuh ha ki , ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Israel , bad ngan buh lang ïa u bad uta uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Judah . Na kita ar tylli ngan pynlong uwei u dieng , bad ngan bat ïa u ha ka kti jong nga .

translation.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away .
translation.kha: Bun sngi ngim shym lah ban ïohi ïa ka sngi lane ïa ki khlur , bad ka lyer ka la nang beh jur . Ha kaba khatduh ngi la duh jingkyrmen ïa ka ban lait im .

translation.en: That saith , I will build me a wide house and large chambers , and cutteth him out windows  ; and it is ceiled with cedar , and painted with vermilion .
translation.kha: Kordit ïa u briew uba ong ,  Ngan tei ïa lade ka ïing paki dulan bad ki kamra kiba kylluid shajrong ki mala .  Kumta u buh ki jingkhangïit ha ka ïing jong u , bad u shna biar da ki dieng Kedar , bad u airong ïa ka da ka rong saw .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit , and a wife of youth , when thou wast refused , saith thy God .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha long kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , ba la iehnoh da u tnga jong ka bad ba sngew jynjar sat . Hynrei U  Trai  u khot pat ïa pha bad u ong :

translation.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings , and obey the voice of the  Lord  your God  ; and the  Lord  will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynkylla ïa ka rukom kaba phi im bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Lada phi leh kumta , un kylla ïa la ka jingmut na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ba un wallam halor jong phi .

translation.en: To whom we gave place by subjection , no , not for an hour ; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you .
translation.kha: Ki da kwah ban pynlong mraw ïa ngi , hynrei khnang ban pynneh ïa ka jingshisha ka Gospel na ka bynta jong phi , ngim shym la ailad ïa ki wat tang shi minit ruh .

translation.en: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs .
translation.kha: bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Ashkenas ban pyrkhat sngewlem ïa u Daniel .

translation.en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab , and in the streets thereof : for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Halor ki tnum ïing baroh ha Moab bad ha baroh ki jaka paidbah ym don ei ei hynrei tang ka jingïam sngewsih , namar nga la pynpait ïa ka Moab kum u khra uba ym don shuh mano mano ban kwah .

translation.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Kiriathaim ,
translation.kha: Ka jait Reuben ka tei biang ïa ka Heshbon , ka Elealeh , ka Kiriathaim ,

translation.en: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow , and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish : but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat haba ki khie lung bad ki phuh syntiew ha ka step ba pha thung ïa ki , yn ym don kano kano ka jingot . Yn don tang ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang ka bym lah pynkoit .

translation.en: Then said Paul , John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance , saying unto the people , that they should believe on him which should come after him , that is , on Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: U Paul u la ong ,  Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis ka long na ka bynta kito kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong ki ; bad u la ïathuh ha ki paid Israel ban ngeit ha uta u ban sa wan hadien jong u — kata , ha U Jisu .

translation.en: And David said unto Achish , But what have I done ? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day , that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king ?
