translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la leh bakla aïu eh keiñ , kynrad ? Lada , kumba phi ong , ba phim shym la shem jingbakla ha nga naduh ka sngi ba nga sdang ban shakri ïa phi , balei ba ngam dei ban leit bad phi , u kynrad bad u syiem jong nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ?

translation.en: Then Eli called Samuel , and said , Samuel , my son . And he answered , Here am I .
translation.kha: U Eli u la khot ïa u ,  Ko Samuel , ko khun jong nga !   Oi , kynrad ,  u Samuel u jubab .

translation.en: If a man vow a vow unto the  Lord  , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond  ; he shall not break his word , he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u kular ban ai ei ei sha U  Trai  , lane u smai ban kyndiah na kaei re kaei , um dei ban pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular , hynrei u dei ban pyndep lut ïa baroh kaba u la ong ban pyndep .

translation.en: And half Gilead , and Ashtaroth , and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan , were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh , even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families .
translation.kha: Ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Gilead , lem ruh bad ka Ashtaroth bad Edrei , ki nongbah jong ka hima u Og ha Bashan . Ïa kane baroh la ai ha kaba shiteng jong ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee , until he have consumed thee from off the land , whither thou goest to possess it .
translation.kha: Un phah ha phi ïa ka jingpang kawei hadien kawei haduh ba yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïohkynti .

translation.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all , because I have you in my heart ; inasmuch as both in my bonds , and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel , ye all are partakers of my grace .
translation.kha: Phi long borabor ha ka dohnud jong nga ! Kumta ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban sngew kumba nga sngew shaphang jong phi . Namar phi baroh phi la ïoh bynta lem bad nga ha kane ka lad kaba U Blei u la ai ha nga , mynta haba nga don ha byndi bad ruh haba nga la long laitluid ban ïada ïa ka gospel bad ha kaba tei pynskhem ïa ka .

translation.en: That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia ka dei kaba la rai lypa slem bah mynshuwa , bad ngi baroh ngi tip ba phim lah ban ïania bad uno uno uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi .

translation.en: Only the  Lord  give thee wisdom and understanding , and give thee charge concerning Israel , that thou mayest keep the law of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Bad ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un ai ha me ka jingtip bad ka jingstad ba kumta me lah ban synshar ïa ka Israel kat kum ki Hukum jong u .

translation.en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the  Lord  , and do all his commandments which I command thee this day .
translation.kha: bad phin kohnguh biang ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And there was a widow in that city  ; and she came unto him , saying , Avenge me of mine adversary .
translation.kha: Bad la don ka riewkynthei ha kata kajuh ka shnong kaba ïai wan sha u bad kyrpad na ka bynta ki hok jong ka , da kaba ong , ‘ To ïarap ïa nga pyrshah ïa u nongïaleh pyrshah jong nga !’

translation.en: And he said unto his daughters , And where is he ? why is it that ye have left the man ? call him , that he may eat bread .
translation.kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u kylli ïa la ki khun .  Balei phi shu ieh ïa uta u briew ? Khie leit khot ïa u ban ïabam bad ngi .

translation.en: And when they came to Jesus , they besought him instantly , saying , That he was worthy for whom he should do this :
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrpad jur ïa u ,  Une u briew u dei hok shisha ban ïoh ïa ka jingïarap jong me .

translation.en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself : but the Father that dwelleth in me , he doeth the works .
translation.kha: Hato mem ngeit , ko Philip , ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga ? Ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phi ,  U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  kim shym la wan na nga hi . U Kpa , uba ïaisah bad nga , u trei la ka jong ka kam .

translation.en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the  Lord  their God from that day and forward .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin tip naduh kata ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: I am he that liveth , and was dead  ; and , behold , I am alive for evermore , Amen  ; and have the keys of hell and of death .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba im ! Nga la ïap , hynrei mynta nga im junom la junom . Nga don ka bor halor ka jingïap bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: And Annas the high priest , and Caiaphas , and John , and Alexander , and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest , were gathered together at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki la ïakynduh bad u Annas u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u Kaïaphas , u Ïoannis , u Aleksandar , bad kiwei pat kiba dei na ka longïing jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

translation.en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem : for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king , and after certain days obtained I leave of the king :
translation.kha: Katba kane ka dang long kumne , ngam shym la don ha Jerusalem , namar ha ka snem kaba laiphew ar ba u Artakserksis u long u syiem ka Babilon , nga la dei ban leit phai ban ai jingtip sha u . Hadien katto katne por , nga la ïoh jingbit

translation.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the  Lord  , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations  ; from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek .
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingmane , ryngkat bad ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba u la kurup na ki jaitbynriew kiba u la jop — ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philistia bad ki Amalek .

translation.en: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction , and shall smite the waves in the sea , and all the deeps of the river shall dry up : and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down , and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away .
translation.kha: Haba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ka jingjynjar jong ki , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan shoh ïa ki jingat phyllung , bad ki jingjylliew jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong . Ïa ka Assyria kaba sarong yn pynpoh , bad ka Ijipt bakhlaiñbor kan duh noh ïa ka bor jong ka .

translation.en: Then they went along through the wilderness , and compassed the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , but came not within the border of Moab : for Arnon was the border of Moab .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , ki da ïaid tawiar ïa ka ri Edom bad ka ri Moab haduh ba kin da poi ha ka dong mihngi jong ka ri Moab , sha shiliang ka wah Arnon . Ki sher dara hangta , hynrei kim shym jam ïa ka Arnon namar u dei u pud ki Moab .

translation.en: For a just man falleth seven times , and riseth up again : but the wicked shall fall into mischief .
translation.kha: Kam pher katno sien uba hok u kyllon , borabor un khie pat ; hynrei ka jingjot ka pynjot ïa ki bymman .

translation.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times , and cleanse it , and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da la ka shynriah ti un synreit khyndiat na kata ka snam ha kata ka duwan hynñiew sien . Ha kane ka rukom u dei ban pynkhuid ïa ka na ki pop jong ki paid Israel , bad un pynlong khuid ïa ka .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as his fathers had done : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Ma u , kum kiba ha shuwa jong u , u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . U bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: But Herod the tetrarch , being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip s wife , and for all the evils which Herod had done ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ïoannis u la pynrem jur ïa u Herod , uba long u lyngskor , namar u la shongkurim ïa ka Herodias , ka tnga jong u para jong u , bad u la leh bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .

translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: Mynba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga .

translation.en: And they rose up before Moses , with certain of the children of Israel , two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly , famous in the congregation , men of renown :
translation.kha: U Korah u khun jong u Ishar na ka jait Lebi jong u Kohath , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingïalam jong u Moses . La wan ïasoh lem bad u da lai ngut ki dkhot na ka jait Reuben — u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun shynrang jong u Eliab , bad u On u khun jong u Peleth — bad da ki arspah sanphew ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah Israel , ki nongïalam kiba pawkhmat ba la jied da ka kynhun .

translation.en: Every valley shall be filled , and every mountain and hill shall be brought low  ; and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough ways shall be made smooth  ;
translation.kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei ka them dei ban pyndap , ïa uwei ba uwei u lumrit bad u lumbah dei ban pynmadan . Ïa ki lynti kiba kyllaiñ dei ban pynbeit , bad ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba khohruh khohram dei ban pynjlih .

translation.en: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him  ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa u la khot ïa la ki shakri . ‘ To pynkloi !’ u la ong . ‘ To wanlam ïa ka jaiñkup kaba bha tam bad pynkup ïa u . Pyndeng sati ha ka shynriah ti jong u bad pynphong juti ha ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the  Lord  , and he pondereth all his goings .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïohi ïa baroh kaba phi leh , kat shaba phi leit , u peit ïa phi .

translation.en: But ye , brethren , are not in darkness , that that day should overtake you as a thief .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko parabangeit , phim long ha ka jingdum , bad ba ka Sngi kan lap kyndit ïa phi kum u nongtuh .

translation.en: And they came to him , and awoke him , saying , Master , master , we perish . Then he arose , and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water : and they ceased , and there was a calm .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrsiew ïa u , da kaba ong ,  Kynrad , Kynrad ! Ngi la jan ïap !  U Jisu u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer bad ïa ka um ba khie  erïong ; ki la sangeh bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .

translation.en: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys , in caves of the earth , and in the rocks .
translation.kha: Ki la dei ban im ha ki krem , ha ki thliew ba la tih ha ki sharing jong ki riat .

translation.en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place , and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand : and they entered into the city , and took it , and hasted and set the city on fire .
translation.kha: bad u tang shu rah ïa la ka kti , ki rangbah kiba la rieh ki ïeng joit , ki mareh sha ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka . Mar mar ruh ki thang ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la don ha Bethania ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u briew uba la pang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: And he said to the king of Israel , Put thine hand upon the bow . And he put his hand upon it : and Elisha put his hands upon the king s hands .
translation.kha: bad u Elisha u ong ha u ba un pynkhreh ban siat . U syiem u leh kumta , bad u Elisha u buh ïa la ki kti ha ki kti u syiem .

translation.en: They said therefore among themselves , Let us not rend it , but cast lots for it , whose it shall be : that the scripture might be fulfilled , which saith , They parted my raiment among them , and for my vesture they did cast lots . These things therefore the soldiers did .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ong para ma ki ,  To ngin ym tar pynkad ïa ka , to ngin ïakynting sbai ban shem mano ba ïoh ïa ka .  Kane ka la jia khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha :  Ki la pynïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong nga hapdeng jong ki bad ki la ïakhalai ïa ka jaiñkup jong nga .  Kane ka long kaei kaba ki shipai ki la leh .

translation.en: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïamihnoh na Sukkoth bad ki sher dara ha Etham , ha ka tduh jong ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And they called the name of that place Bochim : and they sacrificed there unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad dei namar kata keiñ ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Bokhim . Hangta ki la ai jingkñia ha U  Trai .

translation.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right : thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father s brethren  ; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki kyrpad ka long kaba dei ; ai bynta lem na ka jingdon jingem jong ki kur ki jait u kpa jong ki . Ai ba ka jingïohkynti jong u kan hiarpateng ha ki .

translation.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds : but the wind passeth , and cleanseth them .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ka jingshai ha ka sahit bneng ka phyrnai eh , ka phyrnai haduh katta katta ïa ngi ban khmih ïa ka ; bad ïa ka sahit bneng la sar pynkhuid da ka lyer .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with a consumption , and with a fever , and with an inflammation , and with an extreme burning , and with the sword , and with blasting , and with mildew  ; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shoh ïa phi da ka jingkhrew , da ka khieshoh , da ka jingat thung , bad da ka jingshit kyr-ang ; un phah ruh ïa ka jingryngkhiang , ki lyer khluit , ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Kine ki jingpynjot kin ïailong bad phi haduh ba phin da ïap .

translation.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host : a mighty man is not delivered by much strength .
translation.kha: U syiem um shym jop namar ka kynhun shipai badonbor jong u ; u shipai um shym jop namar ka jingkhlaiñ jong u .

translation.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister  ; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand .
translation.kha: Pha bud ha ki dien jat ka hynmen jong pha , bad kumta ngan ai ha pha ïa kajuh ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom ban dih .

translation.en: Cease ye from man , whose breath is in his nostrils : for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
translation.kha: Wat buh jingshaniah shuh ha ki briew ki bym lah ban im junom . Ki dondor haduh katno ?

translation.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison  ;
translation.kha: bad ha ka jingdon jong u ha ka mynsiem , u la leit bad ïalap ha ki mynsiem kiba la shah khum .

translation.en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye women , and let your ear receive the word of his mouth , and teach your daughters wailing , and every one her neighbour lamentation .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  To sngap ïa U  Trai  , phi ki kynthei , bad to pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong u . To hikai ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi kumno ban ïambriew , bad ïa ki paralok jong phi kumno ban rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew .

translation.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth , and they that dwell therein are desolate : therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men left .
translation.kha: Kumta U Blei u la pynbna ïa ka jingtim ha ka pyrthei . Ki briew jong ka ki hap ban siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh . Kiba im ki la nang duna bad nang duna .

translation.en: And he shall bring them unto the priest , who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first , and wring off his head from his neck , but shall not divide it asunder :
translation.kha: Un wanrah ïa ki ha u lyngdoh , u ban kñia shuwa ïa ka sim na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Un khyrwait ïa ka ryndang jong ka khlem da pyndkut ïa ka khlieh na ka ,

translation.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax , and they that weave networks , shall be confounded .
translation.kha: Kito kiba thain ïa ka jaiñ linen kin don ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen ;

translation.en: But be not ye called Rabbi : for one is your Master , even Christ  ; and all ye are brethren .
translation.kha: Ïa phi ym dei ban khot ‘ ko Nonghikai ,’ namar ba phi baroh phi ïalong mar ryngkat bad don tang uwei U Nonghikai .

translation.en: Ye shall conceive chaff , ye shall bring forth stubble : your breath , as fire , shall devour you .
translation.kha: Phi pynlong ïa ki jingthmu bymlarkam bad kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh ki long ki bym don jingmyntoi . U Mynsiem jong nga u long kum ka ding ka ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: And now , behold , I know that ye all , among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God , shall see my face no more .
translation.kha: Nga la ïaid kylleng hapdeng jong phi baroh , da kaba ïalap ïa ka Hima U Blei . Bad mynta nga tip ba ym don mano mano na phi ki ban dang ïohi shuh ïa nga .

translation.en: And the cloths of service , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office ,
translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin pyndonkam haba ki shakri kum ki lyngdoh ,

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Come ye after me , and I will make you to become fishers of men .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Wan bad nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ban tong ïa ki briew .

translation.en: How that he was caught up into paradise , and heard unspeakable words , which it is not lawful for a man to utter .
translation.kha: Nga ong biang , nga tip ba ïa une u briew la rong noh sha ka Paradais (sa shisien , ngam tip la kane ka da jia shisha ne ka la long tang ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba tip) , bad hangta u la ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ym lah ban buh ha ki kyntien , kiei kiei kiba ki rmiang shyntur briew kim lah ban kren .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha nga ,

translation.en: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking , marrying and giving in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark ,
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi shuwa ka jingshlei um , ki briew ki ïabam bad ïadih , ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi hi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka ïinglieng ;

translation.en: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom , and they shall defile thy brightness .
translation.kha: ngan wanrah ki nongshun kiba sniew ban tur ïaleh ïa me . Kin pynjot ïa kiei kiei kiba itynnat baroh kiba me la pynïoh da ka jingtbit bad jingstad jong me .

translation.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men , much elder than thy father .
translation.kha: Ngi ïoh ïa ka jingstad na ki briew ba la phuh ñiuhlieh — kito ïa kiba la kha ha shuwa u kpa jong me .

translation.en: And tarry with him a few days , until thy brother s fury turn away  ;
translation.kha: Khie leit noh kumne hi sha u Laban u hynmen jong nga ha Haran , bad sah bad u shipor , tad haduh ba ka jingbitar u hynmen jong me kan pjah , bad ba u klet noh ïa kata kaba me la leh ïa u .

translation.en: Since Gilead’s founding in 1943 , more than 8 ,000 graduates of this school have been sent out as missionaries to give a witness “to the ends of the earth” with great success .
translation.kha: Naduh ba la sdang ïa ka Gilead ha u snem 1943 , palat 8 ,000 ngut ki la wan sha kane ka skul bad la phah ïa ki kum ki mishoneri ban sakhi “shaduh kaba kut ka pyrthei .”

translation.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them  ; saying ,
translation.kha: Ynda ki la wan poi ha u Jakob u kpa jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan , ki ïathuh lut ha u ïa kaba la jia ha ki baroh :

translation.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth ? are not his days also like the days of an hireling ?
translation.kha: Ka jingim briew ka long kum ka jingshakri u shipai ba shu pynbor , kum ka jingim u nongbylla sngi uba hap ban trei shitom ,

translation.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom , and the man that getteth understanding .
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba long stad — uba ïoh ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: And said unto me , What seest thou ? And I said , I have looked , and behold a candlestick all of gold , with a bowl upon the top of it , and his seven lamps thereon , and seven pipes to the seven lamps , which are upon the top thereof :
translation.kha: Kaei me ïohi ?  U la kylli .  U diengpynïeng sharak ba la shna da ka ksiar ,  nga la jubab . Ha ka kliar ka don ka pliang na ka bynta ka umphniang .  Halor u diengpynïeng sharak don hynñiew tylli ki sharak , kawei kawei bad ki jaka na ka bynta ki hynñiew tylli ki ksai sharak .

translation.en: And when they urged him till he was ashamed , he said , Send . They sent therefore fifty men  ; and they sought three days , but found him not .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïai ban haduh ba u la mynjur bad shah ïa ki ban leit . Ki sanphew ngut na ki , ki la leit bad ki la wad ïa u Elijah sha lum sha them haduh lai sngi , hynrei kim shym shem ïa u .

translation.en: I will hiss for them , and gather them  ; for I have redeemed them : and they shall increase as they have increased .
translation.kha: Ngan khot ïa ki briew jong nga bad ngan lumlang ïa ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba bun paid kumba ki ju long .

translation.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city  ; and every male was circumcised , all that went out of the gate of his city .
translation.kha: Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka nongbah ki la ïamynjur ïa kaei kaba u Hamor bad u Shekhem ki ai jingmut , bad baroh ki shynrang ki la shah otsher .

translation.en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver s beam  ; and his spear s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron : and one bearing a shield went before him .
translation.kha: U sum jong u , u rben kat u khung ha ka kor u nongthain jaiñ ; bad tang u sop nar jong u , u khia kumba hynñiew kilo . U shipai u ïaid ha shuwa jong u da kaba rah ïa ka stieh .

translation.en: And Lot went out , and spake unto his sons in law , which married his daughters , and said , Up , get you out of this place  ; for the  Lord  will destroy this city . But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law .
translation.kha: Nangta u Lot u la leit sha ki rangbah kiba la ïatehktien bad ki khun kynthei jong u , bad u ong ,  To pynkloi bad mihnoh nangne ; naba U  Trai  un sa pynjot thiaw ïa kane ka jaka .  Hynrei ki pyrkhat ba u shu kren biria .

translation.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges , but they went a whoring after other gods , and bowed themselves unto them : they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in , obeying the commandments of the  Lord   ; but they did not so .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel kim shym shahshkor ïa la ki nongïalam . Ki Israel kim shym la ïaineh ha U  Trai  bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki kpa jong ki , ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U  Trai  , hynrei kane ka pateng bathymmai shen ka la sangeh ban leh kumta .

translation.en: Then Peter , turning about , seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following  ; which also leaned on his breast at supper , and said , Lord , which is he that betrayeth thee ?
translation.kha: U Petros u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi hadien jong u ïa uta uwei pat u synran , ïa uba U Jisu u ieit — uta uba la shong shaniah ha U Jisu ha ka jingïabam miet bad uba la kylli ,  Ko Trai , uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa me ?

translation.en: Then the king said to the wise men , which knew the times , ( for so was the king s manner toward all that knew law and judgment :
translation.kha: Ka ju long ka rukom u syiem ban pan jingmut na ki riewshemphang halor kiei kiei kiba ïadei bad ka shongsuk shongsaiñ ka hima , kumta u khot ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u , kiba lah ban tip kaei kaba dei ban leh .

translation.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .
translation.kha: Hangne ngi ïohi katno U Blei u long uba sbun bad katno u long uba eh . U long uba eh ïa kito kiba la kyllon , hynrei uba sbun ïa phi — lada phi ïaineh ha ka jingsbun jong u . Hynrei lada phim leh kumta , ma phi ruh phin sa shah pynkheiñ .

translation.en: And I said , Let them set a fair mitre upon his head . So they set a fair mitre upon his head , and clothed him with garments . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa ki shakri ban pynspong ka jaiñspong bakhuid halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua . Ki la leh kumta , bad nangta ki la pynphong ki jaiñ thymmai ïa u katba u angel jong U  Trai  u dang ïeng hangta .

translation.en: And the other disciples came in a little ship  ; ( for they were not far from land , but as it were two hundred cubits , ) dragging the net with fishes .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki synran ki la wan sha ryngkew ha ka lieng , ki da ïatan ïa ka jar kaba la dap da ki dohkha . Kim shym da don jngai eh na ryngkew , kumba shispah mitar ei ei .

translation.en: The sons of Kohath  ; Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four .
translation.kha: U Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .

translation.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river , from Tiphsah even to Gaza , over all the kings on this side the river : and he had peace on all sides round about him .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kaba sha sepngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis , naduh Tiphsah kaba ha Ïuphratis haduh shaphang sepngi ka nongbah Gasa . Baroh ki syiem kiba sha sepngi jong ka Ïuphratis ki la hap hapoh jong u , bad u la don ha ka jingïasuk bad ki ri ba-marjan baroh .

translation.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth , and built him an house , and made booths for his cattle : therefore the name of the place is called Succoth .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jakob u la leit sha Sukkoth , ha kaba u la shna ka ïing ïa lade bad ki sem na ka bynta ki jingri jong u . Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Sukkoth .

translation.en: He lieth under the shady trees , in the covert of the reed , and fens .
translation.kha: U dem hapoh ki bniap shiah , bad u rieh hapdeng ki khah ha ki jaka sngem .

translation.en: And also unto the Levites  ; they shall no more carry the tabernacle , nor any vessels of it for the service thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Lebi kim donkam shuh ban kit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ïa ki tiar baroh ïa kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .

translation.en: Because my people hath forgotten me , they have burned incense to vanity , and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths , to walk in paths , in a way not cast up  ;
translation.kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki thang jingiwbih ïa ki bleithaw . Ki la jynthut ha ka lynti ba ki dei ban leit , kim shym bud shuh ïa ki lynti ba-mynshuwa ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti ba khlem buh dak .

translation.en: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil , and pour it upon his head , and anoint him .
translation.kha: Nangta , shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , theh ïa ka ha ka khlieh jong u , bad pynsleh ïa u .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter : for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land .
translation.kha: kin ai shibun ka dud kaba un dih kat kaba u donkam baroh . Ho-oid , khyndiat ngut kiba lait im kiba la iehnoh ha ka ri kin don ka dud bad ka ngap ban bam .

translation.en: And Joseph s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki shiphew ngut ki hynmen shynrang ar kmie jong u Joseph ki la ïaleit sha Ijipt ban thied kew ,

translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la lah ong :  Nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia .

translation.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch , and as the raiment of those that are slain , thrust through with a sword , that go down to the stones of the pit  ; as a carcase trodden under feet .
translation.kha: hynrei mem don kano kano ka jingtep , bad ïa ka metïap jong me la bret shabar ba kan pyut . La tap ïa ka da ki met jong ki shipai ba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , la kynting ïa ka lem bad ki ha ka thliew mawsiang , bad la ïuh ïa ka .

translation.en: But there is a spirit in man : and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding .
translation.kha: Hynrei dei U Mynsiem jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh uba wan sha ki briew bad uba ai ha ki ka jingstad .

translation.en: Wherefore , O king , let my counsel be acceptable unto thee , and break off thy sins by righteousness , and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor  ; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko Syiem Kynrad , to bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga . Sangeh ban leh pop , to leh ïa kaba dei , bad to sngewsynei ïa kiba duk . Te phin ïailong uba manbha .

translation.en: And I said unto my master , Peradventure the woman will not follow me .
translation.kha: Bad nga la kylli ha u kynrad jong nga , ‘ Kumno lada jia ba kata ka briew kam treh ban wan ryngkat bad nga ?’

translation.en: Then spake Haggai the  Lord s  messenger in the  Lord s  message unto the people , saying , I am with you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ai ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai  ha u paidbah :  Ngan long ryngkat bad phi — kata ka long ka jingkular jong nga .

translation.en: This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you entering on the sabbath , of the priests and of the Levites , shall be porters of the doors  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh . Haba ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki wan ban pyndep kam ha ka Sabbaton , shi bynta na ka lai bynta na ki kin ap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka Templ ,

translation.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth  ; but I forsook not thy precepts .
translation.kha: Sa khyndiat , ki la jan ban ïoh pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym leh lyndet ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And the people answered him after this manner , saying , So shall it be done to the man that killeth him .
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ïa kaei ba yn leh ïa uta u briew uba pynïap ïa u Goliath .

translation.en: Also take your flocks and your herds , as ye have said , and be gone  ; and bless me also .
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa la ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi , bad khie mihnoh . Duwai ruh na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu halor jong nga .

translation.en: And the sons of Issachar  ; Tola , and Phuvah , and Job , and Shimron .
translation.kha: U Issakhar bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Tola , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .

translation.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind , as with womankind : it is abomination .
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ban ïathiah shongkha para shynrang . U Blei u isih eh ïa kata .

translation.en: He shall build an house for my name , and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever .
translation.kha: Un dei ma u , u ban tei ka templ ïa nga , bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiem jong u kan ïaineh .

translation.en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash , and the other southward over against Gibeah .
translation.kha: Uwei u don ha ka phang bashatei jong ka khim , u da phai sha Mikhmash , bad uwei pat ha ka phang bashathie , u da phai sha Geba .

translation.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the  Lord  , What is thy name , that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour ?
translation.kha: U Manoah u jubab ,  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , khnang ba ngin lah ban ai burom ïa phi ynda ki ktien jong phi ki la urlong .

translation.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him , with the scribes and elders , said ,
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa u :

translation.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness : but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh bymman kam wanrah ïa ka jingshngain , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ki ïeng skhem .

translation.en: For as by one man s disobedience many were made sinners , so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous .
translation.kha: Bad kumba ïa baroh ki briew la pynlong ki nongpop na ka daw jong ka jingbymkohnguh jong uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom yn pynïasuk ïa ki baroh bad U Blei na ka daw jong ka jingkohnguh jong uwei u briew .

translation.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , which they offer unto the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban pyntngit ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh

translation.en: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain , so shall all the heathen drink continually , yea , they shall drink , and they shall swallow down , and they shall be as though they had not been .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la dih ïa ka khuri bakthang jong ka jingpynshitom ha u lum bakyntang jong nga . Hynrei ki jaitbynriew ha baroh sawdong kin dih ïa ka khuri kaba kham kthang jong ka jingpynshitom ; kin dih ïa ka baroh bad kin jah syndon .

translation.en: And some of them of understanding shall fall , to try them , and to purge , and to make them white , even to the time of the end : because it is yet for a time appointed .
translation.kha: Katto katne na kito ki nongïalam bastad kin shah pynïap , hynrei kaba mih na kane ka long ba yn pynkhuid ïa ki briew . Kane kan ïailong tad haduh ba kaba kut kan wan , ka por kaba U Blei u la buh .

translation.en: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high , and fears shall be in the way , and the almond tree shall flourish , and the grasshopper shall be a burden , and desire shall fail : because man goeth to his long home , and the mourners go about the streets :
translation.kha: Phin sheptieng ïa ki jaka kynjang bad ka jingïaid lynti kan long kaba ma . U shñiuh jong phi un kylla lieh ; da kaba shitom eh phin tan pynïaid ïa lade , bad baroh ki jingkwah jong phi kin duh noh . Ngi leit sha ka jaka shongthait kaba khatduh , bad nangta kan don ka jingïambriew ha ki lynti .

translation.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  like the house of Ahab : for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , namar hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u kiwei pat ki dkhot jong ka longïing u syiem Ahab ki la long ki nongai jingmut ïa u , bad ki la pynlong ïa ka jingkyllon noh jong u .

translation.en: And he taught in their synagogues , being glorified of all .
translation.kha: U la hikai ha ki synagog bad uwei pa uwei u la ïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: We who are Jews by nature , and not sinners of the Gentiles ,
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , la kha ïa ngi kum ki Jiw bad ym kum  ki Jentil bapop  kumba la khot ïa ki .

translation.en: Take heed therefore unto yourselves , and to all the flock , over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers , to feed the church of God , which he hath purchased with his own blood .
translation.kha: To sumar bha ïa lade bad ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ïa kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la buh ha ka jingsumar jong phi . To sharai ïa ka balang U Blei , ïa kaba u la pynlong ka jong u hi lyngba ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u khun jong U .

translation.en: The prophet that hath a dream , let him tell a dream  ; and he that hath my word , let him speak my word faithfully . What is the chaff to the wheat ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa uba ïoh ka jingphohsniew u dei ban ong ïa ka ba ka long tang ka jingphohsniew , hynrei u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong nga u dei ban pynbna hok ïa kata ka khubor . Kaei ka jingbha u jyntang ban ïanujor bad u kew ?

translation.en: And Elijah said , As the  Lord  of hosts liveth , before whom I stand , I will surely shew myself unto him to day .
translation.kha: U Elijah u jubab ,  Da u  Trai  uba im , ïa uba nga shakri , nga kular ba ngan ïeng ha khmat u syiem mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh , aloes , and cinnamon .
translation.kha: Nga la synreit ha ka ïa ka jingiwbih kaba da ka mirr , ka alos , bad ka siasia .

translation.en: For every kind of beasts , and of birds , and of serpents , and of things in the sea , is tamed , and hath been tamed of mankind :
translation.kha: U briew u la lah ban pynjuh bad u la pynjuh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki jait jingthaw — ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , ki mrad bapar bad ki dohkha .

translation.en: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah , and asked him : and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded . So they left off speaking with him  ; for the matter was not perceived .
translation.kha: Te baroh ki rangbah synshar ki la wan ban kylli ïa nga , bad nga la ong ïa ki thik kumba u syiem u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha ki . Ym don ei ei pat kaba ki lah ban leh , namar ym don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïakren .

translation.en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion , and sound an alarm in my holy mountain : let all the inhabitants of the land tremble : for the day of the  Lord  cometh , for it is nigh at hand  ;
translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi , to pynsawa ba don jingma ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong U Blei . To khynñiuh , ko ki paid Judah ! Ka sngi jong U  Trai  shen kan sa wan .

translation.en: And the sons of Gomer  ; Ashkenaz , and Riphath , and Togarmah .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Gomer ki long ki briew jong ka Ashkenas , ka Riphath , bad ka Togarmah .

translation.en: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron , and for his sons ,
translation.kha: Ki suh ïa ki sopti-poh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ,

translation.en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples , and of his doctrine .
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang ki synran jong u bad shaphang ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: Searching what , or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify , when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ , and the glory that should follow .
translation.kha: Ki pyrshang ban shem lano ka por kan long bad kumno kan wan . Kane ka la long ka por sha kaba U Mynsiem U Khrist uba don ha ki u kdew , ha kaba ïathuhlypa ïa ki jingshah shitom kiba U Khrist un hap ban shah bad ïa ka burom ka ban sa bud .

translation.en: And the king said , Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this ? And the woman answered and said , As thy soul liveth , my lord the king , none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken : for thy servant Joab , he bade me , and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid :
translation.kha: Hato dei u Joab uba la ai buit ïa pha ha kane baroh ?  u la kylli ïa ka . Ka jubab ,  Nga smai da kata baroh kaba kyntang , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba ym don kano kano ka lad ban kiar na kaba jubab ïa ka jingkylli jong phi . Ka dei kaba shisha ba u Joab , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi uba la bthah ïa nga ïa kaei ngan leh bad ïa kaei ngan kren .

translation.en: And Jehud , and Bene–berak , and Gath–rimmon ,
translation.kha: ka Jehud , ka Beneberak , ka Gathrimmon ,

translation.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot  ; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image , that shall not be moved .
translation.kha: U briew u bym lah ïoh rupa ne ksiar u jied da ka dieng ka ban ym pyut . U shem ïa u nongtrei dieng batbit ban shna ïa ka dur ka ban ym kyllon .

translation.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment , and didst increase thy perfumes , and didst send thy messengers far off , and didst debase thyself even unto hell .
translation.kha: Phi sleh ïa ki jingiwbih bad ki kynja jingsleh , bad leit ban mane ïa u blei Molekh . Ban lap ïa ki blei ban mane phi la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha jngai bah , wat shaduh ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded you , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you rest , and hath given you this land .
translation.kha: Kynmaw kumno u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la ïathuh ha phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan kum ka ïing jong phi .

translation.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations .
translation.kha: Phi la ïadon bad nga ha baroh ki jingshah tynjuh jong nga ;

translation.en: All the best of the oil , and all the best of the wine , and of the wheat , the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the  Lord  , them have I given thee .
translation.kha: Nga ai ha me ïa ki soh nyngkong kiba kynsai tam baroh na ka umphniang Olib , ka waiñ bad u kew ba ki Israel ki ai ïa nga man la ka snem .

translation.en: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi shahjingit , wat leh  mat sngewsih kumba ki riewarsap ki leh . Kim kheiñ ïa kaba paw shabar jong ki khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ba ki shahjingit . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .

translation.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant , because he loved him as his own soul .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïateh jutang jingïadei paralok bad u Dabid namar ka jingieit bajylliew ïa u .

translation.en: Whom Jason hath received : and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king , one Jesus .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong u Patsha , da kaba ong ba don uwei pat u syiem , uba kyrteng U Jisu .

translation.en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more .
translation.kha: Haba ki syiem kiba hap hapoh u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki pynlong ka jingïasuk bad u Dabid bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u . Ki Syria kim ju mon shuh ban ïarap ïa ki Ammon .

translation.en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab , on the other side Jordan , by Jericho , eastward .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba u Moses u la pynbynta ïa ka ri shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerikho bad ka Jordan mynba u don ha ki pyntha ka Moab .

translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Abijah u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: For the  Lord  spake thus to me with a strong hand , and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people , saying ,
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw jong u , U  Trai  u la maham ïa nga ban ym bud ïa ka lynti ba ki briew ki la bud . U ong ,

translation.en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense .
translation.kha: katba u paidbah habar u la duwai ha ka kynta ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .

translation.en: The  Lord  also shall roar out of Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the heavens and the earth shall shake : but the  Lord  will be the hope of his people , and the strength of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kyrhuh na u lum Seïon ; ka sur jong u ka byrthen na Jerusalem ; ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng ki khynñiuh . Hynrei un ïada ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant , but a son ; and if a son , then an heir of God through Christ .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phim long shuh u mraw hynrei u khun . Bad naduh ba phi long u khun jong U , U Blei un ai ha phi baroh kat kaba u don na ka bynta la ki khun .

translation.en: Do they not err that devise evil ? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah bad jingñiewkor na kiwei lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba bha ; lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba sniew , phi leh ïa kaba bakla .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities which are on his frontiers , the glory of the country , Beth–jeshimoth , Baal–meon , and Kiriathaim ,
translation.kha: ngan ai ba yn tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah kiba ïada ïa ki pud jong ka Moab , kynthup wat ïa ki nongbah bakynsai tam — ka Beth Jeshimoth , ka Baal Meon , bad ka Kiriathaim .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses in mount Sinai , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai bad u hukum ïa u , ban ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha u paid Israel .

translation.en: I have also spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and used similitudes , by the ministry of the prophets .
translation.kha: Nga la kren ha ki nongïathuhlypa bad ai ha ki shibun ki jingïohipaw , bad lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa nga ai jingmaham ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: This second epistle , beloved , I now write unto you  ; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance :
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane mynta ka long ka shithi kaba ar ba nga thoh sha phi . Ha baroh ar tylli ki shithi nga la pyrshang ban pynkhih ïa ki jingpyrkhat bakhuid ha ki jingmut jong phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: Behold their sitting down , and their rising up  ; I am their musick .
translation.kha: Naduh mynstep haduh mynmiet ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga .

translation.en: They sacrificed unto devils , not to God  ; to gods whom they knew not , to new gods that came newly up , whom your fathers feared not .
translation.kha: Ki kñia ha ki blei ki bym dei shisha ki blei , ha ki blei thymmai kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki kim ju tip , ki blei kiba ki Israel kim ju kohnguh .

translation.en: And he closed the book , and he gave it again to the minister , and sat down . And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kli pat ïa ka kot kli , u la ai pat ïa ka ha u shakri , bad u la shong . Baroh ki briew ha ka synagog ki la peit shlip sha u ,

translation.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them , walking on the sea .
translation.kha: Hapdeng lai bad hynriew baje mynstep U Jisu u la wan sha ki synran , da kaba ïaid halor ka um .

translation.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phoenicia , we went aboard , and set forth .
translation.kha: Hangta ngi la shem ïa ka lieng kaba thmu ban leit sha Phoenisia , kumta ngi la ïakiew ha ka bad ngi la leit noh .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Balak ,  Tei ïa nga hangne hynñiew tylli ki duwan , bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang .

translation.en: Then said Jesus ,  Father , forgive them  ; for they know not what they do .  And they parted his raiment , and cast lots .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Pa , to map ïa ki ! Kim tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh .  Ki la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki hi da kaba kynting sbai .

translation.en: And there followed him a certain young man , having a linen cloth cast about his naked body  ; and the young men laid hold on him :
translation.kha: Uwei u samla , uba kup tang da ka jaiñ linen , u bud ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :
translation.kha: Ka jingangnud kaba khraw tam jong ngi ka long ba uwei pa uwei na phi un don ka jingthrang kaba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , kumta ba kiei kiei kiba phi kyrmen kin wan urlong .

translation.en: Who , when they were come down , prayed for them , that they might receive the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , ki la duwai na ka bynta ki riewngeit ba kin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: They fought from heaven  ; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera .
translation.kha: Ki khlur ki ïaleh na sahit bneng ; Katba ki dang ïaid sha shiliang ka sahit bneng , Ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Sisera .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh , Glory over me : when shall I entreat for thee , and for thy servants , and for thy people , to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses , that they may remain in the river only ?
translation.kha: U Moses u phai ktien ,  Ngan da sngewbha eh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Buh da ka por lano nga dei ban kyrpad na ka bynta jong phi , na ka bynta ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad na bynta ki briew jong phi . Te phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .

translation.en: And Abner the son of Ner , and the servants of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon .
translation.kha: U Abner bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Ishbosheth ki la leit na Mahanaim sha ka nongbah Gibeon .

translation.en: And David saved neither man nor woman alive , to bring tidings to Gath , saying , Lest they should tell on us , saying , So did David , and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ju pynïap lut , shynrang bad kynthei , khnang ba yn ym don uba leit rah khubor sha Gath bad ïathuh aïu ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la leh . Kane ka long kaba u Dabid u la ju leh katba u dang sah ha ri Philistia .

translation.en: Then I was by him , as one brought up with him : and I was daily his delight , rejoicing always before him  ;
translation.kha: Nga don hajan jong u kum u nongring dur , man ka sngi nga la ai jingkmen ïa u , nga da shadkmen borabor ha khmat jong u —

translation.en: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold , and heaped up silver as the dust , and fine gold as the mire of the streets .
translation.kha: Ka Tyros ka la tei ki kut na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka la kynton shibun eh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka la kynrei kum ka tngit .

translation.en: Neither hath oppressed any , hath not withholden the pledge , neither hath spoiled by violence , but hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment ,
translation.kha: lane banbeiñ ïano ïano lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u ai ha u kum ka bynda . U bsa ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .

translation.en: When the house caught fire , an awful feeling came over me .
translation.kha: Mynba ka ïng ka ing , ka jingsngewma ka wan ha nga .

translation.en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes , and yet is not washed from their filthiness .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba tharai ba ki long kiba khuid hynrei kiba dap da ka tngit suda .

translation.en: And I called for a drought upon the land , and upon the mountains , and upon the corn , and upon the new wine , and upon the oil , and upon that which the ground bringeth forth , and upon men , and upon cattle , and upon all the labour of the hands .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ka jingtyrkhong ha ka ri — ha ki lumrit jong ka , ha ki lyngkha kew jong ka , ki bri sohwaiñ , ki brisoh Olib — ha baroh ki jingthung kiba ka khyndew ka pynmih , ha ki briew bad ki mrad , ha baroh kiba phi pyrshang ban pynmih .

translation.en: Sing and rejoice , O daughter of Zion : for , lo , I come , and I will dwell in the midst of thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  To rwai da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid ka Jerusalem ! Nga wan ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong phi !

translation.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever !
translation.kha: Lane da u shniah ban shniah ïa ki ktien jong nga ha u maw bad ban thoh ïa ki khnang ba kin sah junom .

translation.en: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that were in all the countries , heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah , and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , baroh ki paid Israel kiba don ha Moab , Ammon , Edom bad ha kiwei ki ri , ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la shah katto katne ki nong Israel ban ïaisah ha Judah bad ba u la pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat jong ki .

translation.en: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod .
translation.kha: Teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem bad ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u ksai uba jngum , khnang ba ka jingdeng shadem kan shong halor u panpoh bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod .

translation.en: Why tell others about what you are learning ?
translation.kha: Balei phi dei ban ïathuh lem ïa kiwei pat ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ?

translation.en: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers . And the king spake , and said to the wise men of Babylon , Whosoever shall read this writing , and shew me the interpretation thereof , shall be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about his neck , and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: U la pyrta ïano ïano ban wallam shapoh ïa ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti . Haba ki la ïawan shapoh , u syiem u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa uno uno uba lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka yn pynphong ha ki jaiñkup syiem kiba sawbthuh , un deng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u , bad un long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad u shah ba ki Philistia kin synshar ïa ki sawphew snem .

translation.en: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest  ; and dwelt with her mother in law .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka la trei bad ki bad ka la tam kew haduh ban da dep ot lut ïa u barli bad ïa u kew baroh . Bad ka la ïaishong sah bad la ka kiaw kurim .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , yet not like David his father : he did according to all things as Joash his father did .
translation.kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um long kum u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban , u leh ïa kaei kaba u Joash u kpa jong u , u la leh .

translation.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high , and the wilderness be a fruitful field , and the fruitful field be counted for a forest .
translation.kha: Hynrei sa shisien pat U Blei un phah ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u . Ka jaka shrah kan sa kylla seisoh , bad ki lyngkha kin sa pynmih ki jingbam kyrhai .

translation.en: But refuse profane and old wives  fables , and exercise thyself rather unto godliness .
translation.kha: Hynrei to kiar noh na ki khanatang bym don nongrim , ki bymmyntoi ban ïathuh . To men pynmlien ïa lade ïa ka jingim riewblei .

translation.en: Behold , I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth : thou shalt thresh the mountains , and beat them small , and shalt make the hills as chaff .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kor khlur-kba , lem bad ki bniat kiba thymmai banep . Men tylliat ïa ki lumbah bad pynlwet ïa ki ; ki lumrit kin lwet kum u pui pui .

translation.en: When thou art departed from me to day , then thou shalt find two men by Rachel s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah  ; and they will say unto thee , The asses which thou wentest to seek are found : and , lo , thy father hath left the care of the asses , and sorroweth for you , saying , What shall I do for my son ?
translation.kha: ynda me mih nangne mynta ka sngi , men ïakynduh ar ngut ki rangbah hajan ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel ha Selsah kaba ha ka ri Benjamin . Kin ïathuh ha me ba la lap ïa kita ki kada kiba me leit wad , bad i pa jong me im shym khuslai shuh shaphang jong ki , hynrei i khuslai shaphang jong me , i da ïai kylli , ‘ Ngan leh kumno keiñ shaphang la u khun ?’

translation.en: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years , O house of Israel ?
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , ngam shym la dawa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ha kito ki sawphew snem ha kaba nga la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: Sanctify the  Lord  of hosts himself  ; and let him be your fear , and let him be your dread .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long uba khuid , nga long uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng .

translation.en: And whether one member suffer , all the members suffer with it ; or one member be honoured , all the members rejoice with it .
translation.kha: Lada kawei ka dkhot jong ka met ka shitom , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïashitom lem bad ka ; lada kawei ka dkhot met ka ïoh jingïaroh , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingkmen .

translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread : but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don pahuh ka bam , hynrei ka long ka jingleh bieit ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka por ha ki kam bymmyntoi .

translation.en: Else , if thou wilt not let my people go , behold , I will send swarms of flies upon thee , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thy houses : and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies , and also the ground whereon they are .
translation.kha: Lada mem treh , ngan pynshitom ïa me da kaba phah ïa ki skain sha me , sha ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad sha ki briew jong me . Ki ïing jong ki nong Ijipt bad ka madan madiah baroh kin dap da ki skain suda .

translation.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : for they have wholly followed the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa uwei pa uwei baroh , lait noh u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh uba na ka jait Kenis bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ; ki la ïailong kiba kohnguh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And some began to spit on him , and to cover his face , and to buffet him , and to say unto him , Prophesy : and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la sdang ban bynthiew ïa U Jisu bad ki la tap-matlah ïa u bad ki la shoh ïa u .  Ïathuh uei uba la shoh ïa me !  ki la ong . Bad ki nongap phira ki la shim ïa u bad ki la thab ïa u .

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this day , even in this night , before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  Nga ong ïa me ba ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ar sien mynta ka miet , men sa ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: Ah Lord  God  ! behold , thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm , and there is nothing too hard for thee :
translation.kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng da ka bor bad ka borbah bakhraw ; ym don kaba eh than ïa me .

translation.en: And they said unto Jephthah , Come , and be our captain , that we may fight with the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Wan bad ïalam ïa ngi , ba ngin lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon .

translation.en: For all the gods of the people are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
translation.kha: Ki blei jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw , hynrei U  Trai  u thaw ïa ki bneng .

translation.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require  ; at the hand of every beast will I require it , and at the hand of man  ; at the hand of every man s brother will I require the life of man .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u shim ïa ka jingim briew , yn pynshitom ïa u . Ngan pynshitom da ka jingïap ïa uno uno u mrad uba shim ïa ka jingim briew .

translation.en: Wherefore , sirs , be of good cheer : for I believe God , that it shall be even as it was told me .
translation.kha: Kumta , ko ki rangbah , to sngew shlur ! Naba nga shaniah ha U Blei ba kan long thik kumba la ïathuh ha nga .

translation.en: O praise the  Lord  , all ye nations : praise him , all ye people .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki hima baroh ! A to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh !

translation.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue , which is called the synagogue of the Libertines , and Cyrenians , and Alexandrians , and of them of Cilicia and of Asia , disputing with Stephen .
translation.kha: Hynrei la pyrshah ïa u da katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba long ki dkhot ka synagog jong ki briew kiba la laitluid ( kumba la khot ïa ki ) , kaba kynthup ïa ki Jiw na Kyrini bad na Aleksandria . Ma ki bad kiwei pat ki Jiw na ki thain ka Kilikia bad Asia ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia bad u Stephan .

translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam bad u la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum khat-ar tukri pura jong kaei kaba la sah tam .

translation.en: And all they in the synagogue , when they heard these things , were filled with wrath ,
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ha ka synagog ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: And Ittai answered the king , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as my lord the king liveth , surely in what place my lord the king shall be , whether in death or life , even there also will thy servant be .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ittai u jubab ,  Ko Syiem kynrad , nga smai ha phi ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba ngan ïai leit bad phi kat shaba phi leit , wat la ka dei ban ïap .

translation.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals : praise him upon the high sounding cymbals .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki wiang rnong . To ïaroh ïa u da ki wiang rnong bajam .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto the fish , and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u dohkha ban prie noh ïa u Jonah harud duriaw , bad u la leh kumta .

translation.en: Alas ! for that day is great , so that none is like it : it is even the time of Jacob s trouble  ; but he shall be saved out of it .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kaba shyrkhei ka wan ; ym don kano kano kawei pat ka sngi kaba lah ban nujor bad ka — ka por ka jingnoh mynsiem na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , hynrei kin lait im .

translation.en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God , and his righteousness  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
translation.kha: Hynrei , to pyrkhat nalor kiei kiei baroh ïa ka Hima U Blei bad ïa kaei kaba u dawa na phi , bad un pyndap ïa phi da kine kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: But contrariwise , when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me , as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter ;
translation.kha: Da kumwei pat , ki la ïohi ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jentil , kumba u la ai ha u Petros ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jiw .

translation.en: We are confident , I say , and willing rather to be absent from the body , and to be present with the Lord .
translation.kha: Ngi dap da ka jingshlur bad ngi kham kwah ban iehnoh ïa kane ka ïing jong ngi ha ka met bad ban ïoh long ha ka ïing bad U Trai .

translation.en: And Absalom answered Joab , Behold , I sent unto thee , saying , Come hither , that I may send thee to the king , to say , Wherefore am I come from Geshur ? it had been good for me to have been there still : now therefore let me see the king s face  ; and if there be any iniquity in me , let him kill me .
translation.kha: U Absalom u jubab ,  Namar ba phim wan haba nga la phah khot ïa phi . Nga la kwah ïa phi ban leit sha u syiem bad ban kylli na ka bynta jong nga : ‘ Balei nga dei ban iehnoh ïa ka Geshur bad wan hangne ? Kan jin da la kham bha ïa nga ban sah hangta .’   U Absalom u bteng ,  nga kwah ïa phi ban pynbeit ïa nga ban ïohi ïa u syiem , bad lada nga la kit pop , te shah ïa u ban pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the  Lord  , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites , and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands ? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams , the same may be a priest of them that are no gods .
translation.kha: Phi beh noh shabar ïa ki lyngdoh ki jong U  Trai  , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , bad phi beh noh ïa ki Lebi . Ha ka jaka jong ki phi la thung ïa ki lyngdoh ha kajuh ka rukom ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki leh . Uno uno uba wanrah lang bad u masi ne hynñiew tylli ki langbrot u lah ban ïoh pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh jong kito kiba shu khot ki blei jong phi .

translation.en: For the perfecting of the saints , for the work of the ministry , for the edifying of the body of Christ :
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynkhreh ïa ki briew jong U Blei baroh na ka bynta ka kam jong ka jingshakri ba kynja mynsiem , khnang ban tei ïa ka met U Khrist .

translation.en: When she was brought forth , she sent to her father in law , saying , By the man , whose these are , am I with child : and she said , Discern , I pray thee , whose are these , the signet , and bracelets , and staff .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang shah sei kumta , ka la phah ktien sha la u kthaw kurim :  Nga la punkhun na uta u briew uba long u trai kine ki tiar . Peit ïa ki bad khmih ki dei ki jongno — kane ka muhor bad u ksai jong ka bad une u diengduh .

translation.en: And their father said unto them , What way went he ? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went , which came from Judah .
translation.kha: Na kano ka lynti u leit phai ?  u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month : and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta , ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong une u bnai , ki paid Israel baroh kin ïa-pynïap ïa kita ki mrad .

translation.en: But I have used none of these things : neither have I written these things , that it should be so done unto me : for it were better for me to die , than that any man should make my glorying void .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la pyndonkam ïa kano kano na kine ki jingmyntoi , lymne ngam shym la thoh ïa kane mynta khnang ban dawa ïa kiba kum kine ki hok na ka bynta ïa lade . Kan kham bha ïa nga ba ngan ïap shuwa ! Ym don mano mano ban pynkylla ïa ka jingkob badei hok jong nga sha ki kyntien ba thylli !

translation.en: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man , and he strengthened me ,
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u la bat ïa nga , bad nga la kham sngew ïohbor .

translation.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka pur hadien ba la pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid ,

translation.en: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots , and a noise of horses , even the noise of a great host : and they said one to another , Lo , the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites , and the kings of the Egyptians , to come upon us .
translation.kha: U Trai u la pynlong ïa ki Syria ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kum ka jingwan jong ki shipai babun , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad ki Syria ki la pyrkhat ba u syiem ka Israel u la khot nong ïa ki syiem Hit bad Ijipt bad ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki ban wan tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt consume all the people which the  Lord  thy God shall deliver thee  ; thine eye shall have no pity upon them : neither shalt thou serve their gods  ; for that will be a snare unto thee .
translation.kha: Pynjot ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kat ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u aiti ha phi , bad wat sngewsynei ïa ki . Wat mane ïa ki blei jong ki , namar kata kan long ka jingma ïa me .

translation.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things  ; and by liberal things shall he stand .
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba donburom u lehhok bad u ïeng skhem na ka bynta kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: And they answered the king , The man that consumed us , and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel ,
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  U Saul u la kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi bad ban ym pynsah iwei ruh hangno hangno ha Israel .

translation.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings , and will not be ashamed .
translation.kha: Ngan pynbna ïa ki hukum jong me ha ki syiem , bad ngan ym shah pynlehrain .

translation.en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early , when it was yet dark , unto the sepulchre , and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , katba ka dang dum , ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit sha kata ka jingtep bad ka la ïohi ba ïa u mawkhang la weng noh na ka jingkhang ka jingtep .

translation.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches , and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures :
translation.kha: Ka jingstad bad ka jingtbit jong me ka la pynriewspah ïa me da ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa .

translation.en: They shall be ashamed , and also confounded , all of them : they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols .
translation.kha: Kito kiba shna bleithaw baroh kin shah lehrain ; baroh na ki kin jahburom .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations , and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue :
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Shna ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki dong jaiñkup jong phi bad buh ïa u ksai uba jngum ha uwei uwei u jyrthiaw . Phi dei ban leh ïa kane shi lynter .

translation.en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour s landmark , which they of old time have set in thine inheritance , which thou shalt inherit in the land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it .
translation.kha: Ynda phi ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan jong phi ïa uba la thung naduh mynbarim .

translation.en: When Christ , who is our life , shall appear , then shall ye also appear with him in glory .
translation.kha: Ka jingim bashisha jong phi ka long U Khrist , bad haba u mihpaw , te ma phi ruh phin mihpaw lem bad u bad ïoh bynta ïa ka burom jong u!

translation.en: And the priest shall take one he lamb , and offer him for a trespass offering , and the log of oil , and wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Nangta un shim ïa uwei na ki khunlangbrot shynrang , ryngkat bad ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka umphniang , bad un ai kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingleh palat . Un ai ïa ki kum ka jingai kaba kham kyrpang ha U  Trai  na ka bynta u lyngdoh .

translation.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again , even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him .
translation.kha: Ngi ngeit ba U Jisu u la ïap bad u la mihpat , bad kumta ngi ngeit ba U Blei un shim pat bad U Jisu ïa kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha u .

translation.en: Then said Paul , I stand at Caesar s judgment seat , where I ought to be judged : to the Jews have I done no wrong , as thou very well knowest .
translation.kha: U Paul u la ong ,  Nga ïeng ha khmat ka kamra bishar ka jong u Patsha hi , ha kaba ka dei ban bishar ïa nga . Ngam shym leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa ki Jiw , kumba me hi me tip bha .

translation.en: To teach when it is unclean , and when it is clean : this is the law of leprosy .
translation.kha: Kine ki aiñ ki batai shai kumno yn leh haba kaei kaei ka long ka bymkhuid bad haba ka la long khuid .

translation.en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles  hands the Holy Ghost was given , he offered them money ,
translation.kha: U Simon u la ïohi ba la ai ïa U Mynsiem ha ki bangeit haba ki apostol ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki . Kumta u la tyrwa pisa ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,

translation.en: And Cain went out from the presence of the  Lord  , and dwelt in the land of Nod , on the east of Eden .
translation.kha: Bad u Kain u leit noh na ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la shong la sah ha ka ri ba la kyrteng  Ka Nod     kaba don shaphang mihngi na ka Kper Eden .

translation.en: And thorns shall come up in her palaces , nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof : and it shall be an habitation of dragons , and a court for owls .
translation.kha: Ki shiah bad shiah buid kin mih ha baroh ki ïingsyiem bad ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad ki myrsiang bad ki dkhoh kin shong ha ki .

translation.en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant , even as I had pity on thee ?
translation.kha: Me la dei ban don jingisynei ïa la u para shakri , kumba nga la isynei ïa me .’

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Sing with gladness for Jacob , and shout among the chief of the nations : publish ye , praise ye , and say , O  Lord  , save thy people , the remnant of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To rwai da ka jingkmen na ka bynta ki Israel , kiba khraw tam na ki jaitbynriew . To rwai ïa ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh jong phi , ‘ U  Trai  u la pynim ïa la ki briew ; u la pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dang sah .’

translation.en: And again , Praise the Lord , all ye Gentiles ; and laud him , all ye people .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh ka ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko ki Jentil baroh ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jaitbynriew baroh!

translation.en: But I have greater witness than that of John : for the works which the Father hath given me to finish , the same works that I do , bear witness of me , that the Father hath sent me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingphla na ka bynta jong nga kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jingphla kaba u Ïoannis u la ai : Kaei kaba nga leh , kata ka long , ki kam kiba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ïa nga ban leh , kine ki kren na ka bynta jong nga bad ki pyn-i ba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And I polluted them in their own gifts , in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb , that I might make them desolate , to the end that they might know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga shah ïa ki ban pyntngit ïa lade da ki jingainguh jong ki hi , bad nga shah ïa ki ban kñia ïa ki khun shynrang banyngkong jong ki . Kane ka la long ban pynshitom ïa ki bad pyn-i ha ki ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid , and whom God hath hedged in ?
translation.kha: U Blei u buhrieh ïa ka lawei na ki bad ker ïa ki na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: The spider taketh hold with her hands , and is in kings  palaces .
translation.kha: Ki  ñiangapïing : phi lah ban bat kawei ha la ka kti , hynrei phi lah ruh ban shem ïa ki ha ki ïingsyiem .

translation.en: Israel is swallowed up : now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad kin long ki bymlarkam kum u khra ba la pait .

translation.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid  ; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites . Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire ? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings ?
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop jong ka Seïon ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ki ong ,  Ka jingbishar U Blei ka long kum ka ding kaba meh junom . Hato uno uno na ngi un lait im na ka ding kaba kum kata ?

translation.en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came , if haply he might find any thing thereon : and when he came to it , he found nothing but leaves  ; for the time of figs was not yet .
translation.kha: U la ïohi na jngai ïa u dieng Dumbur ba la tap da ki sla , kumta u la leit ban peit la u lah ban shem ki soh ha u . Hynrei haba u la wan sha uta u dieng , u la shem tang ki sla , namar kam pat dei ka por ban mih soh .

translation.en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in , and served the idols that his father served , and worshipped them :
translation.kha: U pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh u kpa jong u , bad u mane ïa ki bleithaw ba u kpa jong u , u la mane .

translation.en: Whereas thou camest but yesterday , should I this day make thee go up and down with us ? seeing I go whither I may , return thou , and take back thy brethren : mercy and truth be with thee .
translation.kha: Phi la sah hangne tang khyndiat por , kumta balei ngan pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid sakma kylleng bad nga ? Ngam tip shano ngan leit . Khie leit phai noh bad ïalam bad phi ïa la ki jong ki briew — bad to U  Trai  un lehsbun bad ïaineh bad phi .

translation.en: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead .
translation.kha: Hynrei kin sa hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade ha U Blei , uba la kloi ban bishar ïa kiba im bad ïa kiba ïap .

translation.en: Ye shall not fear them : for the  Lord  your God he shall fight for you .
translation.kha: Wat tieng ïa ki , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong me un ïaleh na ka bynta jong me .’

translation.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain : pangs have taken hold upon me , as the pangs of a woman that travaileth : I was bowed down at the hearing of it  ; I was dismayed at the seeing of it .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew ha ka jingïohipaw ka la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem bad sngewpang , ka jingpang kum ka jong ka kynthei ha ka por suh kha .

translation.en: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him , because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah  ; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ha Judah ki la ïalong ha ka liang jong u na ka bynta u kthaw jong u , u Shekanaïah , uba long u Jiw , u khun jong u Arah . Nalor kata , u Jehohanan , u khun jong u , u la shongkurim ïa ka khun u Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah .

translation.en: The son of Amariah , the son of Azariah , the son of Meraioth ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Amaraïah , u khun jong u Asaraïah , u khun jong u Meraïoth ,
