translation.kha: U Eser , u khun jong u Jeshua , u nongsynshar jong ka Mispah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud kaba long ha khmat ka jaka buh tiar ïapom , haduh ka jaka ha kaba ka kynroh ka phai ;

translation.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture ! saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ka jingbishar U  Trai  ïa kita ki nongsynshar kiba pynjot bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong u !

translation.en: But the men were very good unto us , and we were not hurt , neither missed we any thing , as long as we were conversant with them , when we were in the fields :
translation.kha: Pynban ki la long kiba bha shikatdei ïa ngi ; kim ju pynthut ïa ngi , bad ha ki por baroh ba ngi don bad ki ha ki lyngkha , ym shym don kano kano ruh kaba dei ka jong ngi kaba la shah tuh .

translation.en: And when ye see this , your heart shall rejoice , and your bones shall flourish like an herb : and the hand of the  Lord  shall be known toward his servants , and his indignation toward his enemies .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia , phin sa shadkmen ; kan pynlong ïa phi ban long khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Te phin sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ïarap ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga pyn-i ïa la ka jingbitar pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because that Moab and Seir do say , Behold , the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Namar ba ka Moab ka la ong ba ka Judah ka long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ,

translation.en: And God did so that night : for it was dry upon the fleece only , and there was dew on all the ground .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u leh ïa kata . Ha ka step kaba bud u shñiuh langbrot u rkhiang , hynrei ka khyndew ka la jhieh da ka umjer .

translation.en: And from Jesus Christ , who is the faithful witness , and the first begotten of the dead , and the prince of the kings of the earth . Unto him that loved us , and washed us from our sins in his own blood ,
translation.kha: bad na U Jisu Khrist , u sakhi baïaineh , uba nyngkong ïa uba la pynmih na ka jingïap bad uba long ruh u nongsynshar jong ki syiem jong ka pyrthei . U ieit ïa ngi , bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki pop

translation.en: And the waters shall fail from the sea , and the river shall be wasted and dried up .
translation.kha: Ka um kan rit ha ka Nile , bad ka wah kan sdang ban rngad .

translation.en: Namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you , nigh unto thee , or far off from thee , from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth  ;
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , u lah ban pynshoi ïa phi ban mane ïa ki blei jong kita ki briew kiba shong marjan bad phi , lane kiba shong sha jngai na phi .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Let not your prophets and your diviners , that be in the midst of you , deceive you , neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga maham ïa phi ban ym shah ïa lade ban shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba im hapdeng jong phi lane da kino kino kiwei pat kiba kam ba ki lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei . Wat ym pynleit jingmut satia ïa ki jingphohsniew jong ki .

translation.en: But when Herod s birthday was kept , the daughter of Herodias danced before them , and pleased Herod .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kha jong u Herod , ka khun jong ka Herodias , ka la shad ha khmat jong ka kynhun baroh kawei .

translation.en: He will bless them that fear the  Lord  , both small and great .
translation.kha: Un kyrkhu ïa uwei pa uwei uba pyndonburom ïa u , kiba khraw bad kiba rit kumjuh .

translation.en: Anathoth with her suburbs , and Almon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Anathoth , bad ka Almon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: Know now that God hath overthrown me , and hath compassed me with his net .
translation.kha: Hato phim lah ban ïohi ba dei U Blei uba la leh ïa kane ? U la buh ïa ka jingriam ban kem ïa nga .

translation.en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out ! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them ! God distributeth sorrows in his anger .
translation.kha: Hato ïa ka jingshai jong u bymman la ju pynlip noh ? Hato uno uno na ki u ju ïakynduh ïa ka jingjot ? Hato U Blei u ju pynshitom ïa u bymman ha ka jingbitar

translation.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom , neither hath he imparted to her understanding .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uba pynlong ïa ka , kaba bieit bad ngam shym ai ha ka ïa ka jingstad .

translation.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined , or the moon walking in brightness  ;
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju mane ïa ka sngi ha ka jingthaba jong ka ne ïa u bnai ha ka itynnat jong u baroh .

translation.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour , in the which Jesus said unto him ,  Thy son liveth :  and himself believed , and his whole house .
translation.kha: Te u kpa u la kynmaw ba ha kata hi ka kynta mynba U Jisu u la ong ïa u ,  U khun jong me un im .  Kumta ma u bad ka longïing jong u baroh ki la ngeit .

translation.en: Then they came to Gilead , and to the land of Tahtim–hodshi  ; and they came to Dan–jaan , and about to Zidon ,
translation.kha: bad beit beit sha Gilead bad sha Kadesh ha ka ri ki Hit . Nangta ki leit sha Dan , bad na Dan ki leit shaphang sepngi sha Sidon .

translation.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways :
translation.kha: bad ka khot ïa ki briew kiba ïaid nangta , kiba dang leit sha la ka kam :

translation.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days  ; she shall touch no hallowed thing , nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Nangta kan shim por pat sa laiphew lai sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam . Kam dei ban ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba khuid lane rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ tad ynda la kut ka por pynkhuid ïa ka .

translation.en: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock ! the sword shall be upon his arm , and upon his right eye : his arm shall be clean dried up , and his right eye shall be utterly darkened .
translation.kha: Uta u nongaplangbrot u bymmyntoi ei ei u long uba la tim ! U la iehnoh ïa la ka kynhun langbrot . Ka thma kan pynjot khoit ïa ka bor jong u . Ka kti jong u kan ïapstai bad ka khmat kamon jong u kan long kaba matlah .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  I am the bread of life : he that cometh to me shall never hunger  ; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u kpu ka jingim ,  U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki .  Kito kiba wan sha nga da lei lei kin ym thngan ; kito kiba ngeit ha nga da lei lei kin ym sliang .

translation.en: And he charged them , saying , Thus shall ye do in the fear of the  Lord  , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .
translation.kha: U ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah :  Phi dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong phi ha ka jingsheptieng burom ïa U  Trai  , da kaba kohnguh hok ïa u ha kiei kiei ba phi leh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon , and to the king of Shimron , and to the king of Achshaph ,
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor shaphang ka jingjop ki Israel ka la poi ha u Jabin u syiem ka Hasor , u phah ktien sha u Jobab u syiem ka Madon , sha u syiem ka Shimron bad u syiem ka Akhshaph ,

translation.en: And all his servants passed on beside him  ; and all the Cherethites , and all the Pelethites , and all the Gittites , six hundred men which came after him from Gath , passed on before the king .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïeng hajan jong u , katba ka kynhun ki shipai ïada syiem ki dang ïaid na khmat jong u . Ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai kiba la bud ïa u na Gath ki la ïaid ,

translation.en: And at the side without , as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate , were two tables  ; and on the other side , which was at the porch of the gate , were two tables .
translation.kha: Shabar kata ka kamra la don ruh saw tylli ki miej kiba long kumjuh , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka khyrdop bashatei .

translation.en: Are there not mockers with me ? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?
translation.kha: Nga khmih kumno baroh ki krenbeiñ ïa nga da ka jingkthang .

translation.en: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïaid beit lyngba ka Mysia bad ki la leit sha Troas .

translation.en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah , and the letters of Tobiah came unto them .
translation.kha: Hapdeng kane ka por baroh , ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la ïadon hapdeng ka jingïathoh shithi bad u Tobiah .

translation.en: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place , and put themselves in array at Baal–tamar : and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places , even out of the meadows of Gibeah .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ka kynran dien bad ban ïakynduh lang biang ha Baaltamar , ki rangbah kiba khangkdong ïa ka Gibeah ki mih kynsan na la ki jakarieh ba don ha ki jaka maw jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit  ; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
translation.kha: U dieng uba plung um pynmih u soh uba sniew , lymne u dieng uba swai ïa u soh uba bha .

translation.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha Derbe bad ki la ïoh bun ki synran . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Lystra , sha Ikoniom , bad nangta sha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia .

translation.en: If we live in the Spirit , let us also walk in the Spirit .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la ai ha ngi ka jingim , u dei ruh ban synshar ïa ki jingim jong ngi .

translation.en: And Saul sent to Jesse , saying , Let David , I pray thee , stand before me  ; for he hath found favour in my sight .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u phah khubor sha u Jesse :  Nga sngewbha eh ïa u Dabid . Ieh un sah hangne ha ka jingtrei bad nga .

translation.en: But this man , after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever , sat down on the right hand of God  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Khrist u la ainguh shisien kñia namar ki pop , ka jingainguh kaba dap biang junom , bad hadien u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .

translation.en: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the  Lord  they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem  ; and he fled to Lachish : but they sent to Lachish after him , and slew him there .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por mynba u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u ha Jerusalem . Ha kaba khatduh u la phet sha ka nongbah Lakhish , hynrei ki nongshun jong u ki la buddien ïa u shata bad ki la pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Then the soldiers , as it was commanded them , took Paul , and brought him by night to Antipatris .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la leh ïa kaba la hukum ïa ki . Ki la shim ïa u Paul bad ki la ïalam ïa u ha kata ka miet haduh Antipatris .

translation.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal : and in the midst of the throne , and round about the throne , were four beasts full of eyes before and behind .
translation.kha: Ha khmat ka khet ruh la don kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw , kaba shai sngur bha . La ker ha baroh sawdong ka khet da saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kiba don ki khmat sha khmat bad shadien .

translation.en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God . And he said unto them , Behold , the king s son shall reign , as the  Lord  hath said of the sons of David .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïalumlang ha ka Templ bad hangta ki la pynlong ka jutang bad u Joash , u khun jong u syiem . U Jehoïada u ong ha ki ,  Une hangne u dei u khun jong u syiem ba la khlad noh ! Mynta u dei ban long syiem , kumba U  Trai  u la kular ba ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid kin long .

translation.en: And Abraham answered and said , Behold now , I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord , which am but dust and ashes :
translation.kha: U Abraham u kren biang ,  To map , ko Trai ïa ka jingshlur bieit jong nga ban kren ha me . Nga long tang u briew bad ngam don hok ban ong ei ei .

translation.en: For the wages of sin is death ; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Naba ka pop ka siew ïa la ka bainong — ka jingïap ; hynrei ka jingaiei jong U Blei ka long ka jingim bymjukut ha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And said , Naked came I out of my mother s womb , and naked shall I return thither : the  Lord  gave , and the  Lord  hath taken away  ; blessed be the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U ong ,  La kha ïa nga lyngkhuit khlem don ei ei bad ngan ïap lyngkhuit khlem don ei ei . U  Trai  u la ai , bad mynta u la shim noh . To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u !

translation.en: Wherefore my sentence is , that we trouble not them , which from among the Gentiles are turned to God :
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingpyrkhat jong nga ,  u Jakob u la ong ,  ba ngim dei ban pynjynjar ïa ki Jentil kiba la phai sha U Blei .

translation.en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah , and went out to the cities of mount Ephron  ; and the border was drawn to Baalah , which is Kirjath–jearim :
translation.kha: Na kata u suh sha ki umpohliew ka Nephtoah bad mih sha ki nongbah hajan u Lum Ephron . Hangta u phai sha Baalah ( lane Kiriath Jearim )

translation.en: So being affectionately desirous of you , we were willing to have imparted unto you , not the gospel of God only , but also our own souls , because ye were dear unto us .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi , ngi la long kiba la kloi ban ïabynta bad phi ym tang ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei hynrei wat ïa ka jingim jong ngi ruh . Phi la long kiba ieit thep mynsiem eh jong ngi!

translation.en: He created the first human pair Adam and Eve , placed them in an earthly paradise called Eden , and instructed them to have children and extend their Paradise home earth wide .
translation.kha: U la thaw nynkong ia ki shijur ki briew U Adam bad ka Im , bad u la buh ia ki haka kper Eden , bad u la hukum ia ki , ba kin ioh khun ioh kti , bad ban pyniar ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei kum ka kper Eden .

translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had eaten bread , and after he had drunk , that he saddled for him the ass , to wit , for the prophet whom he had brought back .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam dep dih , u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u la teh jin ïa ka kada na ka bynta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah , uba leit noh ha ka lynti .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel , and with the house of Judah :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan poi haba ngan sa pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai bad ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah .

translation.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters , and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: Ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap ki khynñiuh ha ki um hapoh ka pyrthei .

translation.en: He will take the tenth of your sheep : and ye shall be his servants .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na ki kynhun langbrot jong phi , bad phi phin long ki mraw jong u .

translation.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume , a confection after the art of the apothecary , tempered together , pure and holy :
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki ban shna jingiwbih , khleh ïa ki kum ka jingpyniwbih . Ber khyndiat ka mluh ban pynlong ïa ka kaba khuid bad kaba kyntang .

translation.en: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah ? hath thy soul lothed Zion ? why hast thou smitten us , and there is no healing for us ? we looked for peace , and there is no good  ; and for the time of healing , and behold trouble !
translation.kha: A  Trai  , hato me la kyntait ïa ka Judah nadong shadong ? Hato me isih ïa ki briew jong ka Seïon ? Balei ba me la pynmong jur ïa ngi ba ngim lah ban koit ? Ngi la wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei ym don kano kano jingbha kaba la jia , ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei ka wan pynban ka jingshyrkhei .

translation.en: Draw thee waters for the siege , fortify thy strong holds : go into clay , and tread the mortar , make strong the brickkiln .
translation.kha: To tong ïa ka um ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka jingshah kerkut , bad to pynkhlaiñ ïa ki kut jong pha ! To ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha ban shna ïa ki maw-it , bad to pynkhreh ïa ki tiar shna maw-it !

translation.en: The “ sheep ” are those who will have proved themselves his loyal subjects .
translation.kha: Ki “ langbrot ” ki dei kito kiba pyni ba ki long kiba kohnguh sneng ïa u .

translation.en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee , seven times seven years  ; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years .
translation.kha: Kheiñ hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snem , kata baroh kan long sawphew khyndai snem .

translation.en: And they shall be my people , and I will be their God :
translation.kha: Te kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram , but thy name shall be Abraham  ; for a father of many nations have I made thee .
translation.kha: Ka kyrteng jong me kan ym long shuh u Abram , hynrei u Abraham , naba nga pynlong ïa me u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kiba bun .

translation.en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth , as we have received a commandment from the Father .
translation.kha: Katno nga sngewkmen ban shem ba don na ki khun jong phi kiba ïaid ha ka jingshisha , kumba U Kpa u la hukum ïa ngi .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me , but evil ?
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Nga la ong ïa phi ba um juh ïathuhlypa ïa kano kano kaba bha ïa nga ; ka long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew !

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he shewed them his hands and his feet .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa kane bad u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ki kti jong u bad ïa ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth , and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un beh noh ïa ki riewbymman na ka ri , bad rat dyngkhong ïa ki nongpop na ka kum ïa ki jingthung na ka khyndew .

translation.en: And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master  ; and kissed him .
translation.kha: U Judas tang mar ïapoi , u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai !  bad u la doh ïa u .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Why speakest thou any more of thy matters ? I have said , Thou and Ziba divide the land .
translation.kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Mem donkam ban ong ei ei shuh shuh . Nga la rai ba ma me bad u Siba men ïabynta ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u Saul .

translation.en: For they sleep not , except they have done mischief  ; and their sleep is taken away , unless they cause some to fall .
translation.kha: Ki riewsniew kim nang ïohthiah lymda ki ïoh ban leh ïa ka kam sniew ; ki peitmat sah lymda ki la ïoh pynmynsaw ïano ïano .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; As I thought to punish you , when your fathers provoked me to wrath , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I repented not :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki pynbitar ïa nga , nga la pynkhreh ka jingpynjot ïa ki bad ngam shym pynkylla ïa la ka jingmut , hynrei nga pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .

translation.en: I have peace offerings with me  ; this day have I payed my vows .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ki jingainguh mynta , bad nga don ki doh kñia .

translation.en: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel : only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained .
translation.kha: Ym don napdeng ki Anakim kiba dang sah ha ka ri Israel ; pynban , tang katto katne , la iehnoh ha Gasa , Gath bad Ashdod .

translation.en: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light , and the stars shall fall from heaven , and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken :
translation.kha: Shen hadien ka jingjynjar jong kito ki sngi , ka sngi kan dum , u bnai un ym tyngshaiñ shuh , ki khlur kin hap na bneng , bad ki bor ha ka haw haw kin shah beh na ki lynti jong ki .

translation.en: But if ye shall still do wickedly , ye shall be consumed , both ye and your king .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi dang ïai leh pop , ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi yn pynjot noh .

translation.en: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation , and shall put off the linen garments , which he put on when he went into the holy place , and shall leave them there :
translation.kha: Nangta u Aaron un leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , un law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh kiba u la kup shuwa ba un leit rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un buh ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , and made thereunto a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: U suit ïa ka da ka ksiar kaba nylla , bad u buh u jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong ka rmiang jong ka .

translation.en: And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him .
translation.kha: Ynda u Noah u la pyngngad , bad u la tip aïu u khun khatduh jong u , u la leh ïa u ,

translation.en: But if ye shew the dream , and the interpretation thereof , ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour : therefore shew me the dream , and the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa baroh ar , ka jingphohsniew bad ïa ka jingmut jong ka , ngan ainong ïa phi da ki jingai sngewbha bad ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw . Te mynta , ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad kaei ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing every sickness and every disease among the people .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit jngoh kylleng ki nongbah bad ki nongrit . U la hikai ha ki synagog , u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki briew kiba don ki jingpang babun jait bad ki jingshitom .

translation.en: Be ye therefore followers of God , as dear children ;
translation.kha: Te phi kumta long ki nongbud jong u Trai , namar phi long ki khun kiba ieit eh jong U Blei ,

translation.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins : and not for ours only , but also for the sins of the whole world .
translation.kha: Bad U Khrist hi u long ka lynti da kaba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong ngi , bad ym tang ïa ki pop jong ngi , hynrei ruh ïa ki pop jong ki briew baroh .

translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth , he is clothed with majesty  ; the  Lord  is clothed with strength , wherewith he hath girded himself : the world also is stablished , that it cannot be moved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem . U kup da ka main longsyiem bad ka bor . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhih ïa ka .

translation.en: Then he said , I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master  ; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel ba la pynsakma halor ki lum kum ïa ki langbrot bym don nongsharai . Bad U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim don nongïalam ; ai ba kin leit phai noh sha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .’

translation.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow , and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine : and spare ye not her young men  ; destroy ye utterly all her host .
translation.kha: Wat ai por ïa ki shipai ban siat ïa ki khnam ne kieng ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong ki . Wat pyllait ïa ki samla shynrang ! Pynjot ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei !

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be come to the land which the  Lord  will give you , according as he hath promised , that ye shall keep this service .
translation.kha: Haba phi rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ban ai ha phi , phi dei ban leh ïa kane ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah , first and last , did Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , write .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah , u khun jong u Amos , u buh jingthoh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki kam ba u syiem Ussaïah u la leh ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day .
translation.kha: Baroh shi sngi nga ïaroh ïa me bad pynbna ïa ka burom jong me .

translation.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh : the Lord shall have them in derision .
translation.kha: Na ka khet jong u ha bneng U Trai u rkhie u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki jingthmu batlot jong ki .

translation.en: Knowing this , that the trying of your faith worketh patience .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to ñiew ïa lade ba phi long kiba donbok eh haba phi ïakynduh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba bun ha ka lynti ka jingim jong phi , naba phi tip ba haba ka jingngeit jong phi ka jop haba ïashem kum kita ki jingtynjuh , ka jingmih ka long ka jinglah ban ïaishah .

translation.en: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea , and they of Jerusalem , and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan , confessing their sins .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew na ka probins    jong ka Judia bad ka nongbah Jerusalem ki la leit ban ïohsngew ïa u Ïoannis . Ki la phla ïa la ki pop , bad u la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking , and they say , He hath a devil .
translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la wan , u la shahjingit bad um shym dih waiñ , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ong , ‘ Une uba shongksuid !’

translation.en: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be , then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem jong ka Jingpynïoh pat , ynda haba baroh ka bri ka khyndew ïa kaba la die la pynïoh pat sha ki trai khyndew , ïa ka jingïohkynti jong ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad yn kynthup lang junom ha kata ka jait kaba ki ïashongkurim bad kan long ka jingduh ïa ka jait jong ngi .

translation.en: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the  Lord  : seven days ye must eat unleavened bread .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan uta u bnai , ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ka sdang ; hynñiew sngi lynter phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .

translation.en: And over these three presidents  ; of whom Daniel was first : that the princes might give accounts unto them , and the king should have no damage .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh u la thung ïa u Daniel bad ar ngut kiwei pat ban khmih ïa ki lat bad ban khmih halor ki jingkwah jong u syiem .

translation.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink . And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel  ; and he cast himself down upon the earth , and put his face between his knees ,
translation.kha: Katba u Ahab u dang leit ban bam , u Elijah u kiew sha u lum Karmel , u dem khrup ha khyndew , u da buh ïa la ka khlieh hapdeng ki khohsiew jong u .

translation.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs , and Mephaath with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Kedemoth , bad ka Mephaath , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: I charge thee before God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , and the elect angels , that thou observe these things without preferring one before another , doing nothing by partiality .
translation.kha: Ha khmat jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist Jisu bad jong ki angel to kohnguh ïa kine ki jinghikai khlem jingujor lane khlem shah shiliang ïano ïano ha kano kano kaba me leh .

translation.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day s uproar , there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse .
translation.kha: Naba hadien kaei kaba la jia mynta ka sngi , ka don ka jingma ba yn mudui ïa ngi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin . Ym don kano kano ka jingmap na ka bynta kane ka jingkhihwin , bad ngim lah ban ai kano kano ka daw kaba dei na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And Elijah said unto Ahab , Get thee up , eat and drink  ; for there is a sound of abundance of rain .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u syiem Ahab ,  Mynta , khie leit bad bam . Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba u slap u wan .

translation.en: And straightway many were gathered together , insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no , not so much as about the door : and he preached the word unto them .
translation.kha: Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïawanlang shisien wan ba ym don jaka shuh kaba lait , ym don jaka shuh wat habar ha khmat ka jingkhang . U Jisu u dang ïalap ïa ka khubor ha ki ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear them not : for I have delivered them into thine hand  ; there shall not a man of them stand before thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Nga la ai lypa ha me ïa ka jingjop . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee : they hiss and gnash the teeth : they say , We have swallowed her up : certainly this is the day that we looked for  ; we have found , we have seen it .
translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba ki khmat jong nga ki shlei da ki ummat . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa nga ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban ai jingshlur ïa nga . U nongshun u la jop ïa nga ; ki briew jong nga kim don ei ei shuh kaba sah .

translation.en: And the servants of Saul told him , saying , On this manner spake David .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki ïathuh ha u Saul ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong ,

translation.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray  ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .
translation.kha: Shisien la don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la leit sha ka Templ ban duwai : Uwei u la long u Pharisi , uwei pat u long u nonglum khajna .

translation.en: These discovered her nakedness : they took her sons and her daughters , and slew her with the sword : and she became famous among women  ; for they had executed judgment upon her .
translation.kha: Ki law lyngkhuit ïa ka , ki kem ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong ka , bad nangta ki pynïap ïa ka da ka waitlam . Ki kynthei kylleng ki ïathuh lorni shaphang ka kupar jong ka .

translation.en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads , neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard .
translation.kha: Wat khap ïa u shñiuh ha ki kynriang ka khlieh jong phi lane khih ïa ki tmain

translation.en: Foretelling a key part of the sign of “the last days ,” Jesus said : “This good news of the kingdom will be preached in all the inhabited earth for a witness to all the nations  ; and then the end will come .” —Matthew 24 :14 .
translation.kha: Ka jingiathuhlypa ia ka jinglong bakongsan shaphang ki dak jong “Ki sngi bakhadduh ,” U Jisu u la ong : “Te ia kane ka gospel jong ka hima yn ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh , ia kaban long ka jingphla ha ki kynja bynriew baroh ; ynda kumta kein kan jia kata kaba kut .” —Mathaios 24 :14 .

translation.en: You're just not the person I thought you were .
translation.kha: Phim dei u briew uba nga mut ba phi dei .

translation.en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria , saying , The nations which thou hast removed , and placed in the cities of Samaria , know not the manner of the God of the land : therefore he hath sent lions among them , and , behold , they slay them , because they know not the manner of the God of the land .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa u patsha ka Assyria ba ki briew kiba u la pynshongduh ha ki nongbah ka Samaria kim shym la tip ïa ki aiñ jong u blei jong kata ka ri , bad kumta u blei u la phah ïa ki sing , kiba la pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: They say unto him , He will miserably destroy those wicked men , and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen , which shall render him the fruits in their seasons .
translation.kha: Da shisha un pynïap ïa kito ki briew kiba sniew ,  ki la jubab ,  bad un aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai , ki ban ai ha u ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit ha ka por kaba biang .

translation.en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem , and brought unto Babylon , be restored , and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem , every one to his place , and place them in the house of God .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa ruh kiba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la wallam sha Babilon na ka Templ ha Jerusalem , dei ban pynphai pat sha ka jaka jong ki ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Thou knowest how I have served thee , and how thy cattle was with me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Phi tip kumno nga la shakri ïa phi bad kumno ki kynhun jingri jong phi ki la roi ha ka jingsumar jong nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee , saying , Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness : and , behold , hitherto thou wouldest not hear .
translation.kha: Nangta ong ha u Pharaoh , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha phi ba phin shah ïa ki briew jong u ban leit , khnang ba kin ïoh ban mane ïa u ha ri shyiap . Hynrei haduh mynta phim shym shahshkor .

translation.en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people , to the priests , and to the Levites : Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel , rulers of the house of God , gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ruh ki ai sngewbha ïa ki paidbah , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi ba kin pyndonkam . Bad ki rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ka Templ — u Hilkaïah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Sekharaïah , bad u Jehiel — ki ai ïa ki lyngdoh ar hajar hynriewspah tylli ki langbrot bad ki khunblang bad laispah tylli ki masi lyngraw na ka bynta ki jingkñia ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , fornications , thefts , false witness , blasphemies :
translation.kha: Namar na ka dohnud jong u ki mih ki jingpyrkhat basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban pynïap briew , ban klim , bad ban leh ïa kiwei kiwei ki kam bajakhlia ; ban lute , ban lamler , bad ban kren sniew ïa kiwei .

translation.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof : it is most holy .
translation.kha: Uno uno u shynrang uba na ka longïing u lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingainguh ; ka dei kaba khuid bha .

translation.en: For they were about five thousand men . And he said to his disciples ,  Make them sit down by fifties in a company .
translation.kha: ( La don kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah hangta . ) U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  To pynshong ïa u paidbah ha ki kynhun kiba sanphew ngut kawei kawei .

translation.en: Then the Philistines said , Who hath done this ? And they answered , Samson , the son in law of the Timnite , because he had taken his wife , and given her to his companion . And the Philistines came up , and burnt her and her father with fire .
translation.kha: Haba ki Philistia ki kylli mano ba la leh ïa kane , ki tip ba dei u Samson uba la leh ïa kata namar ba u kthaw kurim jong u , uba na Timnah , u la ai noh ïa ka tnga jong u Samson ha u paralok jong u Samson . Kumta ki Philistia ki leit bad ki thang ïa kata ka kynthei ha ban da ïap bad thang ruh ïa ka ïing u kpa jong ka .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha u Moses , ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,

translation.en: Let there more work be laid upon the men , that they may labour therein  ; and let them not regard vain words .
translation.kha: Pyntrei shitom kham tyngeh ïa kine ki briew bad pynbunkam ïa ki , khnang ba kin ym don por ban shahshkor ïa ki nia lamler .

translation.en: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven , that one of these little ones should perish .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng um kwah ba iwei ruh na kine kiba rit in jah noh .

translation.en: And straightway all the people , when they beheld him , were greatly amazed , and running to him saluted him .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu , ki la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh , bad ki la wan mareh sha u ban khublei ïa u .

translation.en: For such an high priest became us , who is holy , harmless , undefiled , separate from sinners , and made higher than the heavens  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu , te , u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . U long uba khuid ; um shym don kano kano kaba bakla lane ka pop ha u ; la pynkyrpang ïa u na ki nongpop bad la kyntiew ïa u sha ki bneng .

translation.en: Tell it not in Gath , publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon  ; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice , lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph .
translation.kha: Wat pynbna ïa ka ha Gath lane ha ki surok ka Ashkelon . Wat pynlong ïa ki kynthei Philistia ban kmen , wat ai ba ki khun kynthei jong ki bymngeit blei kin risa .

translation.en: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land , and spake to all the assembly of the people , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien kata , katto katne ngut na ki tymmen ki san ki la ïeng joit bad ki ong ha ki paidbah kiba la ïalumlang ,

translation.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top : nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and Moses , departed not out of the camp .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki dang nud hi ban leit kiew sha kata ka ri lum , wat la ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  lymne u Moses kim shim mih na ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall increase you more and more , you and your children .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un ai ki khun ha phi — ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi !

translation.en: On the same day it shall be eaten up  ; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bam ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi bad wat pynsah ei ei haduh ka step kaba bud .

translation.en: The sons of Rachel  ; Joseph , and Benjamin :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Rakhel ki long u Joseph bad u Benjamin .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous  ;
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Abraham ,  Ki don ki jingkynnoh pyrshah kiba jur ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , bad ka pop jong ki ka long kaba khraw katta katta .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go through the midst of the city , through the midst of Jerusalem , and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Khie ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah Jerusalem bad buh dak ha ka shyllangmat jong uwei pa uwei uba shem jynjar bad khuslai namar ki kiei kiei baroh kiba ijli kiba la leh ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Go , set a watchman , let him declare what he seeth .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit bad buh u nongap phira , bad ong ïa u ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u ïohi .

translation.en: Take away the wicked from before the king , and his throne shall be established in righteousness .
translation.kha: Weng noh ïa ki nongai jingmut bymman na khmat u syiem , bad ïa ka jingsynshar jong u yn tip na ka bynta ka ïingbishar hok jong ka .

translation.en: And thou shalt do according to the sentence , which they of that place which the  Lord  shall choose shall shew thee  ; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee :
translation.kha: Kin ai ïa la ka jingrai jong ki , bad phi dei ban leh kumba ki ong ïa phi .

translation.en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting : and the children of Israel also wept again , and said , Who shall give us flesh to eat ?
translation.kha: Don ki nongwei kiba ïaleit lang bad ki Israel . Kine ki don ka jingkwah palat ban bam doh , bad wat ki Israel hi ki la sdang ban ud :  A , ba ma ngi ruh ngin da ïoh khyndiat ka doh !

translation.en: And said unto them ,  Why sleep ye ? rise and pray , lest ye enter into temptation .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Balei phi thiah ? Khie joit bad duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .

translation.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses , that they be not unfruitful .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ngi ki dei ban nang ban pynlut ïa la ka por ha kaba leh babha , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam bashisha ; kim dei ban im ka jingim ka bymlarkam .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount called the mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hajan Bethphage bad Bethania ha u lum ki Olib , u la phah ar ngut ki synran sha shuwa lem bad kine ki jingbthah :

translation.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me , O  Lord  , even thy salvation , according to thy word .
translation.kha: Pyni ïa nga haduh katno me ieit ïa nga , A  Trai  , bad pynim ïa nga kat kum ka kular jong me .

translation.en: Therefore , as ye abound in every thing , in faith , and utterance , and knowledge , and in all diligence , and in your love to us , see that ye abound in this grace also .
translation.kha: Phi long kiba riewspah katta katta ha baroh kiba phi don : Ha ka jingngeit , ka jingkren , bad ka jingtip , ha ka jingangnud ban ïarap bad ha ka jingieit jong phi ïa ngi . Bad kumta ngi kwah ïa phi ban long kiba sbun ruh ha kane ka jingshakri jong ka jingieit .

translation.en: Men do therefore fear him : he respecteth not any that are wise of heart .
translation.kha: Kam long kaba phylla , te , ba uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa u , bad ba um ñiew ïa kito kiba kam ba ki long kiba stad .

translation.en: Also I have made a decree , that whosoever shall alter this word , let timber be pulled down from his house , and being set up , let him be hanged thereon  ; and let his house be made a dunghill for this .
translation.kha: Nga hukum ruh ba lada uno uno um kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , dei ban sei ïa u bim dieng na ka ïing jong u , ban pynnep ha kawei ka liang , bad ban sam lyngba ïa ka met jong u . Bad ïa ka ïing jong u ban pynlong kum ka kynton ñiut .

translation.en: And Rachel said , God hath judged me , and hath also heard my voice , and hath given me a son : therefore called she his name Dan .
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  U Blei u la bishar hok ïa nga . U la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad u la ai khun shynrang ha nga  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Dan .

translation.en: And I saw as the colour of amber , as the appearance of fire round about within it , from the appearance of his loins even upward , and from the appearance of his loins even downward , I saw as it were the appearance of fire , and it had brightness round about .
translation.kha: Ka dur ka i phyrnai la kum ka rnong hapdeng ka ding .

translation.en: And Shaphan carried the book to the king , and brought the king word back again , saying , All that was committed to thy servants , they do it .
translation.kha: U ai ha u Shaphan ïa ka kitab , bad u Shaphan u leit rah sha u syiem . U ïathuh ,  Ngi la leh ïa baroh kaba phi la hukum .

translation.en: For I will restore health unto thee , and I will heal thee of thy wounds , saith the  Lord   ; because they called thee an Outcast , saying , This is Zion , whom no man seeketh after .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkoit pat ïa phi ; ngan pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong phi , la ki nongshun jong phi ki ong , ‘ Ka Seïon ka dei kaba shah kyntait ; ym don mano mano ba salia ïa ka .’ Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder : and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .
translation.kha: Haba ki shaniah ha phi , phi kheiñ noh , u dung ïa ki tohtit jong ki , bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynkdor ïa la ki met .

translation.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ma phi baroh , ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei , ïa u pyrthat uba mih na ka shyntur jong u .

translation.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen , a great people , that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude .
translation.kha: Nga don hangne hapdeng ki briew ïa kiba me la jied kum la ki jong , ki briew kiba bun paid katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: Pharaoh s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea : his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea .
translation.kha: U bret ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka Ijipt bad ïa ki kali ïapom jong ka sha ka duriaw ; ki rangbah pynïaidkam bakynsai jong ka ki la ïap jyllop ha ka Duriaw Basaw

translation.en: And they brought in the ark of the  Lord  , and set it in his place , in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it : and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki la wallam ïa ka Synduk bad buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ kaba u Dabid u la pynïeng na ka bynta jong ka . Nangta u ainguh ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sekharaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Wilt thou kill me , as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday ?
translation.kha: ‘ Hato me kwah ban pynïap ïa nga , kumba me la pynïap ïa uto u nong Ijipt mynhynnin ?’

translation.en: Turn ye not unto idols , nor make to yourselves molten gods : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat lyndet ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw ; wat thaw ïa ki blei ba shu saiñ na ka sisa bad ban mane ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u la phah ïa kane ka jubab sha u Amasaïah :  Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u phah khubor sha u dieng Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jong me ban shongkurim ïa u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïaid lynti nangta bad u ïuhroit ïa u dieng shiah .

translation.en: And God said unto him in a dream , Yea , I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart  ; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me : therefore suffered I thee not to touch her .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ïa u ha kata ka jingphohsniew ,  Ho-oid , nga tip ba me la leh ïa kane da ka jingïatiplem kaba sngur ; kumta nga la khang ïa me ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngam shym la shah ïa me ban ktah ïa ka .

translation.en: Blessed be the name of the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore .
translation.kha: To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u mynta bad sha bymjukut !

translation.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness , and walketh in darkness , and knoweth not whither he goeth , because that darkness hath blinded his eyes .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba isih ïa la u hynmen u para u don ha ka jingdum ; u ïaid ha ka bad um tip shano u leit , namar ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa u .

translation.en: Where were white , green , and blue , hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble : the beds were of gold and silver , upon a pavement of red , and blue , and white , and black , marble .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ïingsyiem la pynitynnat da ki pyrda bajngum bad balieh , ba la teh da ki tyllai linen sawjngum bani ha ki syrwiang rupa bad pyndait ha ki rishot maw marbl . Ïa ki jaka shong shaniah ha ka ïingsyiem , la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , bad ïa ka madan la siang da u maw marbl balieh , maw marbl basaw , u mawkordor baphyrnai , bad u mawkordor bajngum .

translation.en: As for our redeemer , the  Lord  of hosts is his name , the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa ngi — ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Save only that which the young men have eaten , and the portion of the men which went with me , Aner , Eshcol , and Mamre  ; let them take their portion .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shim ei ei na ka bynta ïa lade ; ngan pdiang tang ïa kata kaba ki briew jong nga ki la pyndonkam . Hynrei shah ba ki paralok jong nga , u Aner , u Eshkol , bad u Mamre ba kin shim ïa la ka bynta .

translation.en: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town , but was in that place where Martha met him .
translation.kha: ( U Jisu um pat shym la poi ha kata ka shnong , hynrei u dang don ha ka jaka ha kaba ka Martha ka la ïakynduh ïa u . )

translation.en: Then went I up in the night by the brook , and viewed the wall , and turned back , and entered by the gate of the valley , and so returned .
translation.kha: kumta nga hiar noh sharum sha ka them Kidron bad ïaid shaphrang , da kaba peit ïa ka kynroh . Nangta nga wan phai pat na kajuh ka lynti ba nga wan bad leit phai sha ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them .

translation.en: Buried with him in baptism , wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God , who hath raised him from the dead .
translation.kha: Naba haba la pynbaptis ïa phi , la tep ïa phi bad U Khrist , bad ha ka jingpynbaptis la pynmihpat ruh ïa phi bad U Khrist da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka bor ba-ïaitrei jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .

translation.en: Wherefore , O harlot , hear the word of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Mynta te , ko Jerusalem , pha ka nuti ! Sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong .

translation.en: But we know that the law is good , if a man use it lawfully ;
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ka hukum ka long kaba bha lada pyndonkam ïa ka kumba dei .

translation.en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem , which have ruled over all countries beyond the river  ; and toll , tribute , and custom , was paid unto them .
translation.kha: Ki syiem bakhlaiñbor ki la synshar hangto bad ki la synshar ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi baroh kawei , ki da lum khajna bad ki jingmih .

translation.en: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law , because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains ?
translation.kha: U ong ha kine ki rangbah ,  Ma nga , u syiem Serksis , nga la phah ïa ki shakri jong nga sha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ryngkat bad ka hukum , bad ka kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ka ! Aïu ka aiñ ka kren ba ngi dei ban leh ïa ka ?

translation.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her , Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee ? but hold now thy peace , my sister : he is thy brother  ; regard not this thing . So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom s house .
translation.kha: Haba u Absalom u hynmen jong ka u la ïohi ïa ka , u la kylli ,  Hato u Amnon u la ktah kti ïa phi ? Sngewbha , ko hep , wat shah ba kata kan pynsngewsih shibun ïa phi . U dei u ba ïalong shi para bad phi na ijuh i pa , kumta te wat ïathuh hano hano shaphang kata .  Kumta ka Tamar ka la sah ha ka ïing jong u Absalom , ka da sngewsih bad sngew marwei .

translation.en: They have seen vanity and lying divination , saying , The  Lord  saith : and the  Lord  hath not sent them : and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word .
translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw jong ki , ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa jong ki , ki long kiba lamler . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka khubor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la phah ïa ki . Pynban ki khmih lynti ba ki ktien jong ki kin urlong shisha !

translation.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches  ; with silver , iron , tin , and lead , they traded in thy fairs .
translation.kha: Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha Spain bad pha la shim ïa ka rupa , ka nar , ka tin , bad ka sisa da kaba siewdor na ka bynta ki tiar ba-dap kyrhai jong pha .

translation.en: Then asked we those elders , and said unto them thus , Who commanded you to build this house , and to make up these walls ?
translation.kha: Nangta , ngi kylli ïa ki nongïalam jong ki ban ïathuh ïa ngi mano ba la ai bor ïa ki ban tei biang ïa ka Templ bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka .

translation.en: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee  ; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee : for thy merchants were the great men of the earth  ; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingshai ka sharak yn ym ïohi shuh da lei lei ha pha ; ïa ka sur u nongleitkurim bad ka nongleitkurim yn ym ïohsngew shuh ha pha ! Ki nongkhaïi jong pha ki la long kiba donbor tam ha ka pyrthei baroh , bad da ka myntor balamler pha la shukor ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei !

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ben–hadad heard this message , as he was drinking , he and the kings in the pavilions , that he said unto his servants , Set yourselves in array . And they set themselves in array against the city .
translation.kha: U Benhadad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jubab u Ahab katba ma u bad kiba ïateh lok bad u , kiwei pat ki nongsynshar , ki dang ïadih ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , kumta ki ïeng ha la ki jaka jaka .

translation.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion .
translation.kha: Ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga ,  u ong ,  nga la thung ïa u syiem jong nga .

translation.en: And he changed his behaviour before them , and feigned himself mad in their hands , and scrabbled on the doors of the gate , and let his spittle fall down upon his beard .
translation.kha: Kumta ha man ba u Dabid u don hajan jong ki , u leh mynleh kum u bieit bad leh kum u lamwir haba ki pyrshang ban khang ïa u ; u da pruid ha ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad u ailad ïa ka umbiah ban jaw ha u  ñiuhtmoh jong u .

translation.en: And they entered in , and found not the body of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: hynrei kim shym shem ïa ka met jong U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all the days of Jehoiada the priest .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  katba u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u dang im .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , The prophets prophesy lies in my name : I sent them not , neither have I commanded them , neither spake unto them : they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination , and a thing of nought , and the deceit of their heart .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuh ïa ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; ngam shym phah ïa ki , lymne ngam shym la ai kino kino ki hukum lane kren shikyntien ha ki . Ki jingïohipaw kiba ki ïakren kim shym wan na nga ; ki jingïathuh lypa ki long kiei kiei ki bymdondor kiba ki la mutdur .

translation.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves ? against whom make ye a wide mouth , and draw out the tongue ? are ye not children of transgression , a seed of falsehood ,
translation.kha: Ïano phi leh biria ? Ïano phi ki nongshukor phi rkhiebeiñ ?

translation.en: Namely , five lords of the Philistines , and all the Canaanites , and the Sidonians , and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon , from mount Baal–hermon unto the entering in of Hamath .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dang sah ha kata ka ri ki long ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia , ki Kanaan baroh , ki Sidon , bad ki Hib kiba shong ha ki Lum Lebanon naduh u Lum Baal Hermon haduh ka Khim Hamath .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad phi knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta phi pyn-i ïa ka jingduwai bajlan ! Namar kane , ka jingpynshitom ïa phi kan long kaba kham sniew !

translation.en: Pilate saith unto him , What is truth ? And when he had said this , he went out again unto the Jews , and saith unto them , I find in him no fault at all .
translation.kha: Bad kaei kata ka jingshisha ?  u Pilat u la kylli . Nangta u Pilat u la mihpat shabar sha ki paidbah bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ngam lap kano kano ka daw ban pynrem ïa u .

translation.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters , or a way for the lightning of thunder  ;
translation.kha: Mano ba tih nur na ka bynta u slap uba hap bad ba pynkhuid ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka  erïong bad u pyrthat ?

translation.en: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , the flesh and the blood , upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God : and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God , and thou shalt eat the flesh .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka duwan U  Trai . Kñia ruh ïa kita ki jingainguh na kiba phi bam ïa ka doh jong ki , bad theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan .

translation.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me , and the breath came into them , and they lived , and stood up upon their feet , an exceeding great army .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba u la bthah ïa nga . Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ka la rung ha kita ki met , bad ki la khie im bad ki la ïeng joit . Ki la ïabun bah na ki kat ban pynlong ka kynhun shipai .

translation.en: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform  ; even a freewill offering , according as thou hast vowed unto the  Lord  thy God , which thou hast promised with thy mouth .
translation.kha: hynrei lada phi kular ei ei da la ka mon sngewbha , kynmaw ban pyndep ïa ka .

translation.en: And the king was exceeding sorry  ; yet for his oath s sake , and for their sakes which sat with him , he would not reject her .
translation.kha: Kane ka pynlong ïa u syiem ban sngewsih haduh katta katta , hynrei um lah ban kyrngah ïa ka namar ki jingsmai ba u la pynlong ha khmat jong baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .

translation.en: And they said unto her , There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha ka ,  Hynrei pham don uwei ruh na ki ba-ha-ïing uba kyrteng kumta !

translation.en: Hezekiah also had said , What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Te u syiem Hesekaïah u kylli ,  Kaei ka dak ban pynshisha ba nga lah ban leit sha ka Templ ?

translation.en: Harness the horses  ; and get up , ye horsemen , and stand forth with your helmets  ; furbish the spears , and put on the brigandines .
translation.kha: Teh jin ha ki kulai jong phi bad shong halor jong ki ! Ïeng ryntih bad phong ïa ki jingda khlieh jong phi ! Pynnep ïa ki sum jong phi ! Kieng ïa ka atiar jong phi !’

translation.en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins , and put ropes on their heads , and came to the king of Israel , and said , Thy servant Ben–hadad saith , I pray thee , let me live . And he said , Is he yet alive ? he is my brother .
translation.kha: Kumta ki sop da ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ïa ki syngkai jong ki bad ki tyllai sawdong ïa ki ryndang jong ki , ki leit sha u Ahab bad ong ,  U shakri jong phi u Benhadad u kyrpad ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .  U Ahab u jubab ,  U dang im ? Ka bha shibun ! U long kum uba shi para bad nga !

translation.en: But if thou return to the city , and say unto Absalom , I will be thy servant , O king  ; as I have been thy father s servant hitherto , so will I now also be thy servant : then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel .
translation.kha: hynrei phi lah ban ïarap ïa nga da kaba leit phai sha ka nongbah bad ong ïa u Absalom ba mynta phin shakri hok ïa u kumba phi la shakri ïa u kpa jong u . Bad leh ïa baroh kaba phi lah ban leh pyrshah ïa kano kano ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u ai .

translation.en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the  Lord  , without Jerusalem , unto the brook Kidron , and burned it at the brook Kidron , and stamped it small to powder , and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people .
translation.kha: U weng noh na ka Templ ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad rah ïa ka shabar ka nongbah sha ka Them Kidron , u thang ïa ka , u pynlwet phum ïa u dpei jong ka , bad pynsaphred ïa ka ha jingtep paidbah .

translation.en: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah , to go out to battle against the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Na ki nongbah baroh jong ka Benjamin ki wan sha Gibeah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Shall any teach God knowledge ? seeing he judgeth those that are high .
translation.kha: Hato u briew u lah ban hikai ïa U Blei Uba bishar wat ïa kito kiba heh kyrdan ?

translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance , obeyed  ; and he went out , not knowing whither he went .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban kohnguh haba U Blei u la khot ïa u ban leit sha ka ri kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ha u . U la mihnoh na la ka ri khlem tip shano ba un leit .

translation.en: In the tenth year , in the tenth month , in the twelfth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khat-ar jong u bnai uba shiphew ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And Noah builded an altar unto the  Lord   ; and took of every clean beast , and of every clean fowl , and offered burnt offerings on the altar .
translation.kha: Te u Noah u tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  ; u shim na kawei kawei ka jait ki mrad bad ki sim ïa kiba la ñiew ba ki long kiba khuid , bad u thang tylli ïa ki kum ka jingkñia ainguh halor kata ka duwan .

translation.en: Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai  , phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , phi ki jait jong ka Israel .

translation.en: This know also , that in the last days perilous times shall come .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kin sa wan ki por kiba jynjar ha ki sngi kiba khatduh .

translation.en: Declare ye in Judah , and publish in Jerusalem  ; and say , Blow ye the trumpet in the land : cry , gather together , and say , Assemble yourselves , and let us go into the defenced cities .
translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri ! To pyrta jam bad shai kdar ! Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ban phet sha ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .

translation.en: Was the  Lord  displeased against the rivers ? was thine anger against the rivers ? was thy wrath against the sea , that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation ?
translation.kha: Hato la dei ki wah kiba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar , A  Trai  ! Hato la dei ka duriaw kaba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar shla ? Me shong kulai halor ki lyoh ; u lyoh ka  erïong u la long ka kali ïapom jong me , mynba me la wallam jingjop ha la ki briew .

translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Now this time will my husband be joined unto me , because I have born him three sons : therefore was his name called Levi .
translation.kha: Sa shisien la ka punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei u khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  Mynta u tnga jong nga un sa kham jan sha nga , namar nga la kha lai ngut ki khun shynrang ïa u  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Lebi .

translation.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri , who willingly offered himself unto the  Lord   ; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: bad uba lai u dei u Amasaïah u khun jong u Sikhri uba don ar lakh ngut ki shipai . ( U Amasaïah u trei mon sngewbha ban shakri ïa U  Trai . )

translation.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour s wife  ; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law  ; and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father s daughter .
translation.kha: Don kiba klim , bad kiwei ki pynbieit ïa la ki pyrsa kurim ne ïa la ki bakha kynthei .

translation.en: All the cities of the plain , and all Gilead , and all Bashan , unto Salecah and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohknieh ïa ka ri u Og u Syiem Bashan baroh kawei : ïa ki nongbah baroh ha ka madan lum , ïa ki ri Gilead bad Bashan , haduh ki shnong Salekah bad Edrei shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest , which I have given to the fire for fuel , so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kumba ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la shim na ka khlaw bad la thang , kumta ngan shim ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem

translation.en: And he said , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A basket of summer fruit . Then said the  Lord  unto me , The end is come upon my people of Israel  ; I will not again pass by them any more .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Ko Amos , me ïohi aïu ?   Shi shang ki soh ,  nga la jubab . Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kaba kut ka la wan ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: Likewise , ye younger , submit yourselves unto the elder . Yea , all of you be subject one to another , and be clothed with humility : for God resisteth the proud , and giveth grace to the humble .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ma phi kiba dang kham samla phi donkam ban kohnguh ïa kiba la kham rangbah . Bad ma phi baroh phi dei ban phong ïa ka jaiñkup ka jingsngewrit , ban shakri iwei ïa iwei pat ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u ïaleh pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha ïa kiba sngewrit .

translation.en: Arab , and Dumah , and Eshean ,
translation.kha: Don ka Arab , ka Dumah , ka Eshan ,

translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye stouthearted , that are far from righteousness :
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki briew ba-mutlop kiba pyrkhat ba ka jingjop ka dang sha jngai bah .

translation.en: Against an elder receive not an accusation , but before two or three witnesses .
translation.kha: To wat pynshahshkor ïa ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u nongsharai balang lymda la wanrah da ki ar ngut ne bun ngut ki sakhi .

translation.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian , who passed by , coming out of the country , the father of Alexander and Rufus , to bear his cross .
translation.kha: Ha lynti ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Simon , uba dang wan sha ka nongbah na rudnong , bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u ban bah ïa ka diengphna U Jisu . ( U Simon u dei na Kyrini bad u la long u kpa jong u Aleksandar bad u Ruphos . )

translation.en: And he said , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All the things that are in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi aïu ha ka ïingsyiem ?   Ki la ïohi lut ïa kiei kiei . Ym don kano kano ha ki jaka buh tiar ïa kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the  Lord  : that it may be well with thee , and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers ,
translation.kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ba ka long kaba dei bad kaba bha , te phin manbha . Phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,

translation.en: If a man have two wives , one beloved , and another hated , and they have born him children , both the beloved and the hated  ; and if the firstborn son be hers that was hated :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u don ar ngut ki tnga bad baroh ar ki ïoh khun shynrang na u , hynrei u khun uba nyngkong um dei na ka tnga kaba u kham ieit ,

translation.en: So we can be confident that God’s Kingdom will soon bring an end to all such problems .
translation.kha: Te ngi lah ban shaniah skhem ba shen ka Hima jong U Blei kan pynkut ïa kum kita ki jingeh baroh .

translation.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up : who then is able to stand before me ?
translation.kha: Haba la pynkhih ïa u , u long uba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba nud bad ïeng ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If heaven above can be measured , and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath , I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada ha kawei ka sngi ïa ka suiñbneng la lah ban thew bad ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei la ïitbniah , tang kata hi ka ban pynlong ba un kyntait ïa ki paid Israel namar baroh kaba ki la leh . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: O  Lord  , truly I am thy servant  ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .
translation.kha: Nga long u shakri jong me , ko  Trai  ; nga shakri ïa me , kumba ka kmie jong nga ka la leh . Me la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap .

translation.en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan , until every thing was finished that the  Lord  commanded Joshua to speak unto the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua : and the people hasted and passed over .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki ïeng hapdeng jong ka Jordan haduh ban da pyndep lut ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua ban ong ïa u paidbah ban leh . Kane ka dei kata kaba u Moses u la hukum . U paidbah u la pynkloi sha shiliang ka wah .

translation.en: And Pharaoh sent , and called for Moses and Aaron , and said unto them , I have sinned this time : the  Lord  is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ha kane ka sien nga la leh pop ; U  Trai  u leh ïa kaba dei ; ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi la leh bakla .

translation.en: If he came in by himself , he shall go out by himself : if he were married , then his wife shall go out with him .
translation.kha: Lada u dang marwei mynba u wan long u mraw jong phi , um dei ban ïalam ïa ka tnga jong u haba u mihnoh ; hynrei lada u la shongkurim mynba u wan long u mraw jong phi , u lah ban ïalam ïa la ka tnga lem bad u .

translation.en: And they said unto Moses , Because there were no graves in Egypt , hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness ? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us , to carry us forth out of Egypt ?
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha u Moses ,  Hato ym don jingtep mo ha Ijipt ? Hato phin hap wan ïalam ïa ngi hangne ha ri shyiap ban ïap ? Peit aïu phi la leh ïa ngi da kaba phi wan ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !

translation.en: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee , and make thee vile , and will set thee as a gazingstock .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa pha khlem ka jingñiewkor bad tap ïa pha da ka jakhlia . Ki briew kin khmih ïa pha ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei .

translation.en: Then should I yet have comfort  ; yea , I would harden myself in sorrow : let him not spare  ; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One .
translation.kha: Lada nga la tip ba un leh , ngan rynsied da kaba kmen , kam pher katno khraw ka jingpang jong nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u long uba khuid ; ngam pat ju pyrshah ïa kaei kaba u hukum .

translation.en: And when the king was come from Damascus , the king saw the altar : and the king approached to the altar , and offered thereon .
translation.kha: Haba u wan phai na Damaskos , u Ahas u ïohi ba la dep shna ïa ka duwan ,

translation.en: Yet say ye , Why ? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father ? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right , and hath kept all my statutes , and hath done them , he shall surely live .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Balei ba u khun un ym shahshitom namar ki pop jong u kpa jong u ?’ Ka jubab ka long ba u khun jong u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha . U la sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad u la bud biang biang ïa ki , bad kumta un im da shisha .

translation.en: And furthermore , that ye have sent for men to come from far , unto whom a messenger was sent  ; and , lo , they came : for whom thou didst wash thyself , paintedst thy eyes , and deckedst thyself with ornaments ,
translation.kha: Ki phah bad ïai phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit khot sngewbha ïa ki rangbah ban wan na sha jngai bah , bad ki rangbah ki la wan . Baroh ar ngut shi para ki sum bad tah ïa ki  ñiuhmat bad deng ïa ki jingdeng mawkordor .

translation.en: Wisdom is good with an inheritance : and by it there is profit to them that see the sun .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba im u dei ban long uba stad ; ka long kaba bha kum ka jingïohpdiang ïa ka jingïohpateng

translation.en: Lacking appreciation for God’s kindness , Adam and Eve did disobey and were made to pay the prescribed penalty .
translation.kha: Namar ki khlem la niewkor ia ki jinglehsbun jong U Blei , u Adam bad ka Im ki la saitlah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent thee on a journey , and said , Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites , and fight against them until they be consumed .
translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa phi lem bad ka hukum , ban pynjot ïa ki Amalek , ki briew bymman . U la ong ïa phi ban ïaleh haduh ba phin da pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision : and so Abraham begat Isaac , and circumcised him the eighth day  ; and Isaac begat Jacob  ; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher kum ka dak jong ka jutang . Kumta u Abraham u la otsher ïa u Isaak hadien shi taïew naduh ba la kha ïa u ; u Isaak u la otsher ïa u Jakob u khun jong u bad u Jakob u la otsher ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen kiba pawnam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .

translation.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .
translation.kha: Yn ym don na ki u ban hikai ïa la u para shnong lane ong ïa la u para ri , ‘ To tip ïa U Trai .’ Namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam .

translation.en: Call unto me , and I will answer thee , and shew thee great and mighty things , which thou knowest not .
translation.kha: To khot kyrpad ïa nga , bad ngan jubab ïa phi ; ngan ïathuh ïa phi kiei kiei kiba phylla bad kiba sngewphylla kiba phim shym la tip ei ei shaphang jong ki .

translation.en: As is the earthy , such are they also that are earthy : and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dei jong ka pyrthei ki long kum uta uba la thaw na ka dewmet ; kito kiba dei jong ka bneng ki long kum uta uba la wan na bneng .

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: To ka jingaiei U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi baroh . Amen .

translation.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath , and vex them in his sore displeasure .
translation.kha: Nangta u maham ïa ki ha ka jingbitar bad u pyntriem ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla jong u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah , that sent you unto me to enquire of me  ; Behold , Pharaoh s army , which is come forth to help you , shall return to Egypt into their own land .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka don ha ka lynti ban ïarap ïa me , hynrei kan leit phai noh sha la ka ri .

translation.en: And as they did eat , he said ,  Verily I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ha phi , uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga .

translation.en: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah , that lieth before Shechem  ; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En–tappuah .
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki Manasseh ka ïar naduh Asher haduh Mikhmethath , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Shekhem . Nangta u pud u hiar arsut shaphang shathie ban kynthup ïa ki briew jong ka Entappuah .

translation.en: Then said Abishai to David , God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day : now therefore let me smite him , I pray thee , with the spear even to the earth at once , and I will not smite him the second time .
translation.kha: U Abishai u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ha kane ka miet , U Blei u la aiti ïa u nongshun jong phi ha ka bor jong phi . Mynta shah ngan tynrah tang shisien tynrah da une u sum jong u hi haduh khyndew ; ngam donkam ban da tynrah ïa u ar sien !

translation.en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them : they have made them a molten calf , and have worshipped it , and have sacrificed thereunto , and said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki la da ïaid sakma noh na kata ka lynti ha kaba nga la hukum ïa ki ban ïaid ; ki la thaw ïa lade u khun masi ba la saiñ da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamane ïa u , bad ki la ai jingkñia ha u . Ki ïa-ong ba une u long u blei jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt !

translation.en: ( 2 Corinthians 1 :24 ) Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .
translation.kha: ( 2 Korinth 1 :24 ) Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang . —Proberb 27 :23 .

translation.en: And the sons of Shamer  ; Ahi , and Rohgah , Jehubbah , and Aram .
translation.kha: U Shomer u para jong u , u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Rohgah , u Jehubbah , bad u Aram .

translation.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age , even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil .
translation.kha: Ka jingbam kaba eh , ha kawei pat ka liang , ka long ïa kiba la rangbah , kiba lyngba ka jingpynmlien ki lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew .

translation.en: And thou , profane wicked prince of Israel , whose day is come , when iniquity shall have an end ,
