translation.kha: Me u nongsynshar uba bymman bad bymkhuid jong ki Israel , ka sngi jong me , ka sngi jong ka jingpynshitom ba kut , ka wan .

translation.en: Only ye shall not eat the blood  ; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim bit ban bam ïa ka snam jong ki ; phi dei ban theh ïa ka ha ka khyndew kumba theh ïa ka um .

translation.en: And Elijah said unto all the people , Come near unto me . And all the people came near unto him . And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  that was broken down .
translation.kha: Hadien kata u Elijah u ong ïa u paidbah ,  Wan kham hajan sha nga ,  bad baroh ki la wan ïalum sawdong ïa u . U shna pynbha ïa ka duwan U  Trai  kaba la pra .

translation.en: Should I lie against my right ? my wound is incurable without transgression .
translation.kha: U Kylli ,  Kumno ngan lah ban shukor bad ong ba nga la bakla ? Nga la mynsaw jur palat , hynrei nga long uba khlem pop .

translation.en: And came even before the king s gate : for none might enter into the king s gate clothed with sackcloth .
translation.kha: Um shym la rung shapoh namar ym don uba lah ban rung shapoh ha ki jaiñ khain .

translation.en: And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .
translation.kha: Ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit ki dei ban pyndonkam da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , u  sai ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .

translation.en: And he trembling and astonished said , Lord , what wilt thou have me to do ? And the Lord said unto him ,  Arise , and go into the city , and it shall be told thee what thou must do .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ïeng joit bad leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , ha kaba yn ïathuh ïa me ïa kaei kaba me dei ban leh .

translation.en: And he sent Peter and John , saying ,  Go and prepare us the passover , that we may eat .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phah ïa u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis lem bad kine ki jingbthah :  Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ngi ban ïabam .

translation.en: Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gold , or the temple that sanctifieth the gold ?
translation.kha: Ko ki bieit bamatlah ! Kano kaba kham donkam , ka ksiar lane ka Templ kaba pynlong khuid ïa ka ksiar ?

translation.en: And while the day was coming on , Paul besought them all to take meat , saying , This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting , having taken nothing .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kynjat shai , u Paul u la kyrpad ïa ki baroh ban bam khyndiat ka jingbam :  Phi la ïa-ap la khatsaw sngi mynta , bad ha kane ka por baroh phim shym la bam ei ei .

translation.en: Then thou shalt say before the  Lord  thy God , I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house , and also have given them unto the Levite , and unto the stranger , to the fatherless , and to the widow , according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me : I have not transgressed thy commandments , neither have I forgotten them :
translation.kha: phin ong ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ‘ Ngam shym pynsah ei ei shuh ha ïing na kata kaba nga la lum kyrpang ; nga la ai ïa ka ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , kumba me la hukum ïa nga . Ngam shym la leh palat lane leh klet ïa ki hukum jong me kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .

translation.en: For in very deed , as the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , which hath kept me back from hurting thee , except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me , surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la khang ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa phi . Hynrei nga smai da U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba lymda phi la pynkloi ban ïashem bad nga , baroh ki briew jong u Nabal kin jin da la ïap lut kat ban da mih ka step !

translation.en: And it may be that I will abide , yea , and winter with you , that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban sah katto katne por bad phi , lehse baroh shi tlang , bad nangta phi lah ban ïarap ïa nga ha ka ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong nga , kat shano sha ba ngan leit .

translation.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens , and his head reach unto the clouds  ;
translation.kha: U lah ban man khraw , ban jrong shaduh suiñbneng , u khraw haduh ba ka khlieh jong u ka kot sha ki lyoh ,

translation.en: Marriage is honourable in all , and the bed undefiled : but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingshongkurim dei ban ri burom da baroh , bad kiba long shi tnga ki dei ban shaniah iwei ïa iwei pat . U Blei un sa bishar ïa kito kiba awria bad ïa kito kiba klim .

translation.en: Let them be confounded that persecute me , but let not me be confounded : let them be dismayed , but let not me be dismayed : bring upon them the day of evil , and destroy them with double destruction .
translation.kha: To wallam ka jingjahburom halor kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga , hynrei pyllait im ïa nga , A  Trai . Pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshyrkhei , hynrei wat pynshyrkhei ïa nga . To wallam ka jingjot ha ki bad pynkdiah lyngkhot ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when all that knew him beforetime saw that , behold , he prophesied among the prophets , then the people said one to another , What is this that is come unto the son of Kish ? Is Saul also among the prophets ?
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ithuh ïa u mynshuwa haba ki ïohi ïa u ba u leh ïa kane ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei kane kaba la wan jia ïa u khun jong u Kish ? Hato , u Saul ruh u la long nongïathuhlypa ?

translation.en: Lo , let that night be solitary , let no joyful voice come therein .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka kaba khlem seisoh , ka miet khlem ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , even in Chisleu  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba saw jong u bnai uba khyndai ( u bnai Kisleb ) , U  Trai  u la ai ka khubor ha nga .

translation.en: There are also celestial bodies , and bodies terrestrial : but the glory of the celestial is one , and the glory of the terrestrial is another .
translation.kha: Don ruh ki met kiba kynja bneng bad ki met kiba kynja doh ; ka jingitynnat jong kita ki met kiba kynja bneng ka ïapher na ka jingitynnat jong kita kiba kynja doh .

translation.en: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance , and there shall be holiness  ; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha u lum Seïon kin don ki ban lait im , bad kan long ka jaka bakyntang . Ki briew jong u Jakob kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri kaba dei hok ka jong ki .

translation.en: To whom hast thou uttered words ? and whose spirit came from thee ?
translation.kha: Mano , phi tharai u ban ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong phi baroh ? Mano ba la ai mynsiem ïa phi ban kren kumne ?

translation.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation , and said , They do alway err in their heart  ; and they have not known my ways .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la bitar ïa kita ki briew bad nga la ong , ‘ Ki la iehnoh ïa nga borabor bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’

translation.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart , to work all manner of work , of the engraver , and of the cunning workman , and of the embroiderer , in blue , and in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen , and of the weaver , even of them that do any work , and of those that devise cunning work .
translation.kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ka jingtbit ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh ba la ju trei da ki nong-ohdur , ki nongthawdur , bad ki nongsuh nongthain ïa ka linen kaba ni ; ïa u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait jaiñ . Ki nang ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh , bad ki long ruh ki nongpruid dur kiba tbit .

translation.en: And I will make Pathros desolate , and will set fire in Zoan , and will execute judgments in No .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt bashathie ban sah kynjah bad ngan tbeh ding ïa ka nongbah Soan ha ka phang shatei . Ngan pynshitom ïa ka nongbah Thebes .

translation.en: But he that knew not , and did commit things worthy of stripes , shall be beaten with few stripes . For unto whomsoever much is given , of him shall be much required : and to whom men have committed much , of him they will ask the more .
translation.kha: Hynrei u shakri u bymtip aïu u kynrad jong u , u kwah ; bad pynban , u leh ïa kaei re kaei ïa kaba u dei hok ban ïoh ka jingsympat , un shah pynshitom da ka jingsympat kaba sting . Shibun la dawa na u briew ha uba la ai kham bun ; kham bun shuh shuh la dawa na u briew ha uba la ai kham bun shuh shuh .

translation.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance , at the commandment of the  Lord  , these cities and their suburbs .
translation.kha: Kumta , kat kum ka hukum U  Trai  , ki paid Israel ki ai ha ki Lebi katto katne tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang na ki jaka jong ki .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush : and he looked , and , behold , the bush burned with fire , and the bush was not consumed .
translation.kha: Hangta u angel jong U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u ha ka dur ka thylliej ding napdeng kawei ka  lawlynnong . U Moses u ïohi ba kata ka  lawlynnong ka la kem ding , hynrei kam shym ing satia .

translation.en: That was the true Light , which lighteth every man that cometh into the world .
translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingshai kaba shisha — ka jingshai kaba wan sha ka pyrthei bad pynshai ha u bynriew baroh .

translation.en: And a girdle of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , of needlework  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad ki jingpanpoh da ka linen bani bad da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ba la pynpur itynnat bha , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine , and pour out their blood by the force of the sword  ; and let their wives be bereaved of their children , and be widows  ; and let their men be put to death  ; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ko  Trai  , ai ba ki khun jong ki , kin ym ïoh jingbam haduh ban da ïap ; ai ba kin shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ai ba ki kynthei kin duh noh ïa la ki tnga bad ïa ki khun jong ki ; ai ba ki rangbah kin ïap na ka jingpang bad ba ki samla shynrang kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: For Adam was first formed , then Eve .
translation.kha: Naba ïa u Adam la thaw nyngkong , nangta ïa ka Im .

translation.en: And they said unto him , We have dreamed a dream , and there is no interpreter of it . And Joseph said unto them , Do not interpretations belong to God ? tell me them , I pray you .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew la ka jong ka jong ka jingphohsniew , bad ym don mano mano hangne u ban batai ïa ka jingmut ki .  Te u Joseph u ong ,  Dei U Blei uba ai ka jinglah ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew . To ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingphohsniew jong phi .

translation.en: This heap be witness , and this pillar be witness , that I will not pass over this heap to thee , and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me , for harm .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ar — ka kynton bad une u maw pynsah jingkynmaw ki long ki jingpynkynmaw . Ngan ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa me , bad me ruh men ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton bad ïa une u maw pynsah kynmaw ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And they remembered his words ,
translation.kha: Te kita ki kynthei ki la kynmaw ïa ki kyntien jong u ,

translation.en: But they gave that to the workmen , and repaired therewith the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh la pyndonkam ban siew ïa ki nongtrei bad ban thied ïa ki tiar ha kaba shna pynbha .

translation.en: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years , and begat Lamech :
translation.kha: Haba u Methuselah u la dap shispah phraphew hynñiew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Lamekh ,

translation.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit , and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas .
translation.kha: Kin pynïap ïa me bad kin phah ïa me sha ka jingtep bashong um .

translation.en: And Absalom came to the king , and said , Behold now , thy servant hath sheepshearers  ; let the king , I beseech thee , and his servants go with thy servant .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u syiem Dabid bad u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , nga la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot . Hato ma phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi phin wan bad shim bynta ha ka jingïaleh-sngewbha ?

translation.en: And Abimelech said , Behold , my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Abraham ,  Kane baroh ka dei ka ri jong nga ; to shong to sah kat ha kaba me kwah .

translation.en: Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen  ; and I will cut thee off from the people , and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries : I will destroy thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Namar ïa kaei kaba phi la leh , ngan aiti noh ïa phi sha ki kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki ban lute ïa phi bad pynjot ïa phi . Ngan pynjot lut ïa phi ba phin ym long shuh ka jaitbynriew lane ban don ka ri la ka jong . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion , and trust in the mountain of Samaria , which are named chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel came !
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba shongsuk ha Seïon , bad ïa phi kiba sngewshngain ha Samaria — phi ki briew kiba khraw jong kane ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba khraw , phi sha kaba ki briew ki ju leit ban ïoh jingïarap !

translation.en: For Herod feared John , knowing that he was a just man and an holy , and observed him  ; and when he heard him , he did many things , and heard him gladly .
translation.kha: U Herod u la sheptieng ïa u Ïoannis namar u la tip ba u Ïoannis u long u briew uba bha bad uba khuid , bad kumta u ju da ïa u . U ju sngewbha ban sngap ïa u , wat la u shitom jingmut shikatdei eh man ka por ba u ïohsngew ïa u .

translation.en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites , and for all the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ai ruh ïa ki dur pynkhreh kiba ïadei bad ki jingpynbeit ryntih ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , bad pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , ban trei ïa ki kam jong ka Templ bad ban sumar ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Mary .  She turned herself , and saith unto him , Rabboni  ; which is to say , Master .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko Mari !  Ka la phai sha u bad ka la ong ha ka ktien Hebru ,  Rabboni !  ( Kane ka mut  Ko Nonghikai ! . )

translation.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee , I am God ? but thou shalt be a man , and no God , in the hand of him that slayeth thee .
translation.kha: Haba kin wan ban pynïap ïa me , hato men dang kam hi ba me long U Blei ? Haba me ïakynduh ïa ki nongpynïap briew , men long uba kynja briew bad ym satia uba kynja blei .

translation.en: So Samuel called unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  sent thunder and rain that day : and all the people greatly feared the  Lord  and Samuel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u la duwai , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u pyrthat bad u slap ha kata ka sngi . Te uta u paidbah baroh u la sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Samuel ,

translation.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah  ; none was exempted : and they took away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha had builded  ; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin , and Mizpah .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Asa u la phah ïa ka hukum kylleng ka ri Judah kaba dawa ïa uwei pa uwei , khlem lait ïano ïano , ban ïarap kit noh na Ramah ïa ki maw bad ki dieng ïa kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ban pynskhem ïa ka . Da kine ki tiar ki tar u Asa u tei pynskhem ïa ka Mispah bad ïa ka Geba , ka nongbah kaba don ha ka ri Benjamin .

translation.en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad , whom I have not made sad  ; and strengthened the hands of the wicked , that he should not return from his wicked way , by promising him life :
translation.kha: Da ki jinglamler jong phi , phi pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew babha , kiba ngam kwah ba kin sngewmong . Phi khang ïa ki briew basniew ban iehnoh ïa kaba sniew bad pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ki .

translation.en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron , and said unto them , Ye take too much upon you , seeing all the congregation are holy , every one of them , and the  Lord  is among them : wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang ha khmat u Moses bad u Aaron bad ki ong ha ki ,  Phi la leh shaba palat ! Baroh ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki long ki jong U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u don lem bad ngi baroh . Balei te Moses me buh ïa lade uba halor jong ka kynhun jong U  Trai  ?

translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which spake with his mouth unto David my father , and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ! uba la bat ïa la ka kular ba u la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga , mynba u ong ,

translation.en: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt , such as there was none like it , nor shall be like it any more .
translation.kha: Kan don ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , ka bym pat ju don mynno mynno kaba kum kata lane ka ban ym don shuh lano lano .

translation.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ,

translation.en: Thou hast planted them , yea , they have taken root : they grow , yea , they bring forth fruit : thou art near in their mouth , and far from their reins .
translation.kha: Me la thung ïa ki , bad ki la suhthied ; ki san bad ki pynmih soh . Ki ju kren bha shaphang jong me , pynban kim da salia eh shisha shaphang jong me .

translation.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingduwai u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa :

translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Execute true judgment , and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother :
translation.kha: La slem bah nga la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha ki briew jong nga : ‘ Phi dei ban peit ba ïa ka jinglehhok la pyndep , bad phi dei ban pyn-i ka jingbhasbun bad ka jingisynei iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And it was about the sixth hour , and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour .
translation.kha: Ka la long kumba khat-ar baje haba ka sngi ka la sangeh ban tyngshaiñ bad ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka ri baroh kawei haduh lai baje ;

translation.en: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ , but their own belly ; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple .
translation.kha: Naba kito kiba leh kum ïa kita kiei kiei kim shakri ïa U Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , hynrei ïa ki jingkwah jong ki hi . Da ki ktien jali ja-um bad ka jingkren pynroh , ki shukor ïa ki briew kiba lui lui .

translation.en: But ye shall be named the Priests of the  Lord  : men shall call you the Ministers of our God : ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles , and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves .
translation.kha: bad ïa phi yn khot ki lyngdoh U  Trai  , ki shakri jong U Blei jong ngi . Phin sa lehkmen ïa ka spah ki jaitbynriew , bad phin sa sngewsarong ba ka dei ki jong phi .

translation.en: And one of the same place answered and said , But who is their father ? Therefore it became a proverb , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
translation.kha: U briew uba shong hangta u jubab ,  Kumno shaphang kine kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa — ki kpa jong ki , ki dei kiei ?  Dei kumta ba la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la long u Nongïathuhlypa ?

translation.en: And the tables were the work of God , and the writing was the writing of God , graven upon the tables .
translation.kha: U Blei hi u la thaw ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad u la thoh ruh ïa kita ki hukum ha kita ki maw .

translation.en: And when the messengers of John were departed , he began to speak unto the people concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness for to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis ki la leit noh , U Jisu u la sdang ban kren shaphang jong u ha u paidbah :  Haba phi la leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , aïu phi la khmih lynti ban ïohi ? Hato ïa ka sla phlang kaba khun ha ka lyer ?

translation.en: Which may go out before them , and which may go in before them , and which may lead them out , and which may bring them in  ; that the congregation of the  Lord  be not as sheep which have no shepherd .
translation.kha: bad uba lah ban ai hukum ïa ki ha ka madan thma , khnang ba u paidlang jong me un ym long kum ki langbrot kiba khlem nongsharai .

translation.en: And David said in his heart , I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul : there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines  ; and Saul shall despair of me , to seek me any more in any coast of Israel : so shall I escape out of his hand .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha lade ,  Ha kawei na kine ka sngi , u Saul un sa pynïap ïa nga . Kaba bha tam eh ïa nga ban leh ka long ban phet noh sha ka ri ki Philistia . Te u Saul un sa sangeh ban wad ïa nga ha Israel , bad ngan sa lait na ka kti jong u .

translation.en: After that he brought me toward the south , and behold a gate toward the south : and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka liang kaba shathie , bad hangta ngi la ïohi sa ïa kawei pat ka khyrdop . U la thew ïa ki kynroh bashapoh bad ïa ka kamra rung jong ka , bad ka la long katjuh kum kito kiwei pat .

translation.en: Which had the golden censer , and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold , wherein was the golden pot that had manna , and Aaron s rod that budded , and the tables of the covenant  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka la buh ïa ka duwan ksiar na ka bynta ban thang ïa ki jingiwbih bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ïa kaba la sop ksiar bad la don u khiew ksiar lem bad ka manna ha u , u diengduh jong u Aaron uba la mih sla , bad ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum .

translation.en: And he went down with them , and came to Nazareth , and was subject unto them : but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la leit phai pat bad ki sha Nasareth , ha kaba u la kohnguh ïa ki . Ka kmie jong u ka la kynshew ïa kine kiei kiei baroh hapoh la ka dohnud .

translation.en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you : give me a possession of a buryingplace with you , that I may bury my dead out of my sight .
translation.kha: Nga long u nongwei uba im hapdeng jong phi ; die ïa nga khyndiat ka jaka ba ngan ïoh ban tep ïa la ka tnga .

translation.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
translation.kha: bad sa shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Israel , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they sold the righteous for silver , and the poor for a pair of shoes  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki die sha ka jinglongmraw ïa ki briew kiba hok ki bym lah siew pat ïa ki ram jong ki , ki briew kiba duk ki bym lah siew pat wat ïa ka dor shi jur ki juti .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that from one new moon to another , and from one sabbath to another , shall all flesh come to worship before me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha man kawei pa kawei ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha man kawei pa kawei ka Sabbaton , ki jaitbynriew na ki hima baroh kin wan ban mane ïa nga hangne ha Jerusalem ,  ong U  Trai .

translation.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God  ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .
translation.kha: U Moses u ïalam ïa ki shabar ka jaka sher dara ban ïashem bad U Blei , bad ki la ïeng ha kjat jong u lum .

translation.en: And when the woman saw Samuel , she cried with a loud voice : and the woman spake to Saul , saying , Why hast thou deceived me ? for thou art Saul .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka kynthei ka ïohi ïa u Samuel , ka lynñiar kliang , bad ka ong ha u Saul ,  Balei phi shet shukor ïa nga ? Phi dei u syiem Saul du !

translation.en: Saul reigned one year  ; and when he had reigned two years over Israel ,
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u la synshar ar snem ha Israel ,

translation.en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance , hewers and workers of stone and timber , and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work .
translation.kha: Me don bun ki nongtrei . Ki don ki rangbah ki ban trei ha ki par maw , bad ki don ki misteri maw bad misteri dieng , bad shibun ki nongtrei kti ha ki jait kam baroh ba ki lah ban trei ha ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong bad ka nar .

translation.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh  ; who also was gathered after him : and he sent messengers unto Asher , and unto Zebulun , and unto Naphtali  ; and they came up to meet them .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha kylleng ki bynta jong ka jaka ki Manasseh ban khot ïa ki ban bud ïa u . U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki jait Asher , Sebulun , bad ki Naphtali , bad ki ruh ki la wan ban ïasoh bad u .

translation.en: When your fathers tempted me , proved me , and saw my works forty years .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la tynjuh bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , ong U Blei , wat la ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ha ki sawphew snem .

translation.en: Go ye forth of Babylon , flee ye from the Chaldeans , with a voice of singing declare ye , tell this , utter it even to the end of the earth  ; say ye , The  Lord  hath redeemed his servant Jacob .
translation.kha: Khie mihnoh na Babilon , kiba laitluid ! Pyrta jam da ka jingkmen ïa ka khubor ; to pyntip ïa ka kylleng :  U  Trai  u la pynim ïa ki shakri jong u , ki Israel !

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams .
translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u ,  Tei ïa nga hangne hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang .

translation.en: The  Lord  will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynjot ïa ki longïing jong ki briew kiba sarong , hynrei un ïada ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ka riewkynthei .

translation.en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate , and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka ri lum Edom ka ri khlaw ; bad ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti na ka .

translation.en: Afterward he brought me to the gate , even the gate that looketh toward the east :
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba phai shaphang mihngi ,

translation.en: Behold , the noise of the bruit is come , and a great commotion out of the north country , to make the cities of Judah desolate , and a den of dragons .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka khubor ka wan ! Ka don ka jingkhihwin bakhraw ha ka jaitbynriew bashatei ; ka kynhun shipai jong ka kan pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ka Judah sha ka ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ki shong ki myrsiang .

translation.en: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ki jingthaw hi ha kawei ka sngi yn pyllaitluid na ki jinglongmraw sha ka jingpyut bad ban ïadon bynta ha ka jinglaitluid badonburom jong ki khun jong U Blei .

translation.en: For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .
translation.kha: Me kam ba kaei kaba me ong ka long kaba shisha ; me kam ba me long uba sngur ha ki khmat U Blei .

translation.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate , and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery .
translation.kha: Yn ym don ki ban hiarpateng ïa ki briew kiba khlem blei , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki ïing ba la tei da ka jingbamsap .

translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Ahab jong ki Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .

translation.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me , and plead against me my reproach :
translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat ba phi kham bha ban ïa nga bad phi ñiew ïa ki jingeh jong nga kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingkitpop jong nga .

translation.en: How long shall I see the standard , and hear the sound of the trumpet ?
translation.kha: Sa katno nga dei ban ïohi ïa ka thma kaba nang jur bad ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa jong ki turoi ?

translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God , that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , that I may dwell among them : I am the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Kin sa tip ruh ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba ngan ïoh shongduh hapdeng jong ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom , and understandeth it not , then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart . This is he which received seed by the way side .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka Hima hynrei ki bymshemphang ïa ka , ki long kum ki symbai kiba la hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat . Uta u Basniew u wan bad u knieh noh ïa kaei kaba la bet hapoh jong ki .

translation.en: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel , and to Beth–maachah , and all the Berites : and they were gathered together , and went also after him .
translation.kha: U Sheba u la leit lyngba ïa ka jaka jong ki jait Israel baroh bad u la wan poi ha ka nongbah Abel Beth Maakah , bad baroh ki dkhot jong ka kur Bikri ki la ïalumlang bad bud ïa u sha ka nongbah .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Except ye see signs and wonders , ye will not believe .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ngeit lymda u ïohi ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla .

translation.en: The word which came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards .
translation.kha: Ïa ka liang kaba shaphang sepngi jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki shna hynriew tylli ki jingker ,

translation.en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were smitten before Israel , they made peace with Israel , and served them . So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more .
translation.kha: Haba ki syiem kiba shah synshar ha u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki la pynlong ka jingïasuk bad ki bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong ki . Bad ki Syria ki la sheptieng ban ïarap biang ïa ki Ammon .

translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , O  Lord  God of Israel , when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time , or the third day , and , behold , if there be good toward David , and I then send not unto thee , and shew it thee  ;
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid ,  To ai ba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel un long u Sakhi hapdeng jong ngi ! Ha kum kane ka por lashai bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngan kylli jingkylli ïa i pa . Lada ka jingthmu jong i ïa phi ka bha , ngan sa phah ktien ïa phi .

translation.en: When a few years are come , then I shall go the way whence I shall not return .
translation.kha: Ki snem jong nga ki la nang ïaid mynta , bad nga ïaid ha ka lynti bym lah phai dien shuh .

translation.en: Suffer me a little , and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God s behalf .
translation.kha: To ïaishah bad shahshkor sa katto katne ïa kaei ba nga ong na ka liang jong U Blei .

translation.en: For their power is in their mouth , and in their tails : for their tails were like unto serpents , and had heads , and with them they do hurt .
translation.kha: Naba ka bor jong ki kulai ka don ha ki shyntur jong ki bad ruh ha ki tdong jong ki . Ki tdong jong ki , ki long kum ki bseiñ ba don ki khlieh , bad ki pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynmynsaw ïa ki briew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not : Am I my brother s keeper ?
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u kylli ïa u Kain ,  Shano u Abel u para jong me ?  U te u jubab ,  Ngam tip . Hato dei ma nga u ban sumar ïa u para jong nga ?

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons , Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations , as I commanded , saying , Aaron and his sons shall eat it .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u ,  Rah ïa kane ka doh sha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , shet ïa ka , bad bam hangta ïa ka bad u kpu uba don ha ka shang ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh ka jingpynkyntang , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And , hardly passing it , came unto a place which is called The fair havens  ; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw ngi la poi sha ka jaka ba la khot , Ka Jakarieh Lieng Bashngain , ka bym da jngai na ka shnong Lasaïa .

translation.en: He heweth him down cedars , and taketh the cypress and the oak , which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest : he planteth an ash , and the rain doth nourish it .
translation.kha: U lah ban pom ïa ki dieng Kedar ban pyndonkam , lane u jied da u dieng Sning lane u dieng Kseh-Sypress na ka khlaw . Lane u lah ban thung u dieng ba ïai jyrngam bad u ap ïa u slap ban pynmih ïa u .

translation.en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth : and unto them was given power , as the scorpions of the earth have power .
translation.kha: Ki puit ki la mih na kata ka tdem sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka bor kaba ki  ñianglartham ki don .

translation.en: Then the high priest rose up , and all they that were with him , ( which is the sect of the Sadducees , ) and were filled with indignation ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad baroh kiba synran ïa u , ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki Saddusi na kata ka jaka , ki la bishni shikatdei eh ïa ki apostol ; kumta ki la kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .

translation.en: Remember them which have the rule over you , who have spoken unto you the word of God : whose faith follow , considering the end of their conversation .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki nongïalam jong phi kiba mynshuwa , kiba la kren ha phi ïa ka khubor U Blei . To da pyrkhat kumno ki la im bad ki la ïap , bad pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingngeit jong ki .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done , which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan leh ïa pha ha ka rukom kaba pha dei hok ban ïoh , namar pha la leh bymsalia ïa ki jingkular jong pha bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang .

translation.en: For they heard them speak with tongues , and magnify God . Then answered Peter ,
translation.kha: Naba ki la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien kiba pher bad ki da ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei . U Petros u la kren :

translation.en: He healeth the broken in heart , and bindeth up their wounds .
translation.kha: U pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud bad u sop spaiñ ïa ki jingmong jong ki .

translation.en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another , and the noise of the wheels over against them , and a noise of a great rushing .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-im kiba ïatyngkhuh lang ha suiñ , bad ka jingkhynwin ki shalyntem , kiba sawa jam kum u jumai .

translation.en: Then Israel sang this song , Spring up , O well  ; sing ye unto it :
translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai :  Ko ki pukri , pynkyrsoi ïa ka um jong phi , Da ka jingrwai ngin pdiang sngewbha ïa ka .

translation.en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord , to the glory of God the Father .
translation.kha: bad baroh kin pynbna shynna ba U Jisu Khrist u long U Trai , ïa ka burom U Blei uba U Kpa .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus , that all the world should be taxed .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Patsha Augustus u la hukum ban shim jingkheiñ ïa ki briew baroh ha ka Hima Rom .

translation.en: And she said , As the  Lord  thy God liveth , I have not a cake , but an handful of meal in a barrel , and a little oil in a cruse : and , behold , I am gathering two sticks , that I may go in and dress it for me and my son , that we may eat it , and die .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong phi , ba ngam don kpu ei ei . Baroh kaba nga don ka long tang shi kham u  purew ha ka pliang bad shi jaw ka umphniang Olib ha u klong . Nga wan hangne ban lum khyndiat ki diengïap ban rah sha ïing bad ban pynkhreh na kaba khyndiat kaba nga don na ka bynta u khun jong nga bad ïa lade . Kata kan dei ka jingbam khatduh jong ngi , bad nangta ngin sa ïapthngan .

translation.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon , and all Israel with him  ; and they encamped against it , and fought against it :
translation.kha: Nangta pat , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Lakhish sha Eglon , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day , that ye may be strong , and go in and possess the land , whither ye go to possess it  ;
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Kumta te phin lah ban jam sha shiliang wah bad ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung .

translation.en: And he made the ephod of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
translation.kha: Ki suh ki thain ïa ka ephod da ka jaiñ linen kaba ni ; da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; bad da u  sai ksiar .

translation.en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you , and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God ;
translation.kha: Kito ki briew baroh , ki kren shaphang kumno ba phi la pdiang ïa ngi myn haba ngi la wan jngoh ïa phi , bad kumno ba phi la phai noh na ki bleithaw sha U Blei , ban shakri ïa U Blei uba shisha bad uba im

translation.en: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims , and took thereof , and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen : who took it , and went out .
translation.kha: Uwei na kita ki kherub u buh ïa la ka kti ha ka ding kaba don hangta hapdeng jong ki , u la shim khyndiat ki rnga ding , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ki kti u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen . Uta u briew u la shim ïa kita ki rnga ding bad u la mihnoh .

translation.en: And they straightway left their nets , and followed him .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jar bad ki la ïaleit bad u .

translation.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac s herdmen , saying , The water is ours : and he called the name of the well Esek  ; because they strove with him .
translation.kha: Ki nongap langbrot jong ka Gerar ki la ïakajia bad ki nongap langbrot jong u Isaak , bad ki ong ,  Kane ka um ka dei ka jong ngi .  Kumta u Isaak u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri  Ka Jingïakajia .

translation.en: And when they arose early on the morrow morning , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the  Lord   ; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold  ; only the stump of Dagon was left to him .
translation.kha: Kum la shai dang step phyrngab ki ïohi ba u mot u la kyllon biang ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ha kane ka sien ka khlieh bad ki kti jong u baroh ar tylli ki la dkut bad ki don hamar ka jingkhang ; sah sa tang ka met .

translation.en: And one cried unto another , and said , Holy , holy , holy , is the  Lord  of hosts : the whole earth is full of his glory .
translation.kha: Ki ïa-pyrta uwei ïa uwei pat :  Bakhuid , Bakhuid , Bakhuid ! U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u long uba khuid ! Ka burom jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: O earth , earth , earth , hear the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ka ri , ko ka ri , ko ka ri ! to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ;

translation.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground : and he took the seven loaves , and gave thanks , and brake , and gave to his disciples to set before them  ; and they did set them before the people .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa u paidbah ban shong ha madan . Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha la ki synran ban sam ha ki paidbah ; bad ki synran ki la leh kumta .

translation.en: And when he came to Samaria , he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria , till he had destroyed him , according to the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake to Elijah .
translation.kha: Haba ki poi hangta , u Jehu u pynïap lut ïa baroh ki kur ki jait jong u Ahab khlem pynsah wat uwei ruh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u Elijah ba kan jia .

translation.en: And to them which were in Rachal , and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites , and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites ,
translation.kha: bad Rakal ; sha ki kur u Jerahmeel , sha ki Ken ,

translation.en: Yet saith the house of Israel , The way of the Lord is not equal . O house of Israel , are not my ways equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki Israel phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long ka bym dei .’ Phi pyrkhat ba ka lynti jong nga kam shym long kaba dei , hato ym dei kumta ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dei .

translation.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance , in the chambers of their kings .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ri jong ki la pyndap da ki jakoid , wat ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ki .

translation.en: For I know nothing by myself ; yet am I not hereby justified : but he that judgeth me is the Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka shai , hynrei kata kam pynshisha ba nga long da shisha uba lui lui . U Trai u dei uta uba bishar ïa nga .

translation.en: And when they were assembled with the elders , and had taken counsel , they gave large money unto the soldiers ,
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïakynduh ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ïathaw buit ; ki la ai shibun ka pisa ïa ki shipai ,

translation.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God : for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them , and they have not known the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingsniew ba ki briew ki la leh , ka khanglad ïa ki ban wan phai sha U Blei jong ki . Ka jingmane bleithaw ka don ka jingbat bakhlaiñ ïa ki bad kim pdiang ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And he said , Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine , and that all Israel set their faces on me , that I should reign : howbeit the kingdom is turned about , and is become my brother s : for it was his from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Phi tip ba nga la dei ban long syiem bad ba uwei pa uwei baroh ha Israel u khmih lynti ïa kata . Hynrei ka la jia long da kumwei pat , bad u para jong nga u la long syiem namar ka dei ka mon U  Trai .

translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : because the spirit of the  Lord  bloweth upon it : surely the people is grass .
translation.kha: U phlang u ïapstai bad ki syntiew ki jlop , haba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka lyer ban beh halor jong ki . Ki briew kim neh slem ban ïa u phlang .

translation.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen : and it was a very great company .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki kali kulai bad ha ki kulai ruh ki ïaleit synran ïa u ; kumta ka kynhun ka long kaba bun .

translation.en: But that we write unto them , that they abstain from pollutions of idols , and from fornication , and from things strangled , and from blood .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngi dei ban thoh ka shithi da kaba ong ïa ki ban ym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ba la kñia ïa ka ha ki bleithaw ; ban kyndiah na ka jingawria ; bad ban ym bam ïa kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait , lane bam ïa kano kano ka snam .

translation.en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary .
translation.kha: Ka Templ jong ngi ka long kum ka khet badonburom , kaba ïeng halor jong u lumbah bajrong naduh kaba sdang .

translation.en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel , twelve years : six years reigned he in Tirzah .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba laiphew wei jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Omri u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar khat-ar snem . Ha ki hynriew snem kiba nyngkong u la synshar ha Tirsah ,

translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , which shall devour the palaces thereof :
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Gasa , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .

translation.en: My soul melteth for heaviness : strengthen thou me according unto thy word .
translation.kha: La ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewsih ; to pynkhlaiñ ïa nga , kumba me la kular .

translation.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard , and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la bret ïa u shabar jong ka bri sohwaiñ bad ki la pynïap ïa u .  Kaei , te , ba u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ïa ki nongshimwai ?  U Jisu u la kylli .

translation.en: And said to the mountains and rocks , Fall on us , and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne , and from the wrath of the Lamb :
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta ha ki lumbah bad ha ki mawsiang ,  To tap halor jong ngi bad to buhrieh noh ïa ngi na ki khmat jong uta uba shong halor ka khet bad na ka jingbitar U Khunlangbrot !

translation.en: For God , who commanded the light to shine out of darkness , hath shined in our hearts , to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei uba la ong ,  Na ka jingdum ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ!  u long ujuh U Blei uba la pynlong ïa ka jingshai jong u ban tyngshaiñ ha ki dohnud jong ngi , ban wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka burom U Blei kaba tyngshaiñ ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,

translation.en: And his father refused , and said , I know it , my son , I know it : he also shall become a people , and he also shall be great : but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he , and his seed shall become a multitude of nations .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa jong u , u kyrngah , bad u ong ,  Nga tip , khun ; nga tip . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Manasseh ruh kin sa kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Hynrei u para jong u un kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin kylla long ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw .

translation.en: At that time Merodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present to Hezekiah : for he had heard that he had been sick , and was recovered .
translation.kha: Hamar kaba kum kane ka por , u syiem ka Babilonia , u Merodakh Baladan , u khun jong u Baladan , u la ïohsngew ba u syiem Hesekaïah u pang , kumta u la phah sha u ïa ka shithi bad ka jingai sngewbha .

translation.en: These see the works of the  Lord  , and his wonders in the deep .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u lah ban leh , ki kam baphylla jong u ha ki duriaw-rit .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Khie leit phai bad ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew bad ïohi :

translation.en: And the king went forth , and all his household after him . And the king left ten women , which were concubines , to keep the house .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u phet noh , da ka jingsynran lem ka longïing jong u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , lait noh ki shiphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ïa kiba u la iehnoh shadien ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: Then said Elijah unto the people , I , even I only , remain a prophet of the  Lord   ; but Baal s prophets are four hundred and fifty men .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ,  Nga don sa tang ma nga u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  uba dang sah , hynrei ki don sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal .

translation.en: It is a faithful saying : For if we be dead with him , we shall also live with him :
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha :  Lada ngi la ïap bad u , ngin sa ïoh im ruh lem bad u .

translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Man , who made me a judge or a divider over you ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ko paralok jong nga , mano ba la ai ha nga ka bor ban bishar lane ban pynbynta ïa ka jingdon jingem hapdeng jong phi ar ngut ?

translation.en: But not as the offence , so also is the free gift . For if through the offence of one many be dead , much more the grace of God , and the gift by grace , which is by one man , Jesus Christ , hath abounded unto many .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ar kim long kumjuh , namar ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei kam long kum ka pop u Adam . Ka long kaba shisha ba bun ki briew ki la ïap namar ka pop jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei ka long kham khraw , bad kumta ruh ka jingai sngewbha ïa kiba bun ki briew lyngba ka jingaiei jong uta uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngi don ka kamram kaba ngi dei ban leh , hynrei kam dei ïa ngi ban im kat kum ka jingkwah jong ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong ngi .

translation.en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the  Lord  , which the  Lord  spake concerning the house of Ahab : for the  Lord  hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah .
translation.kha: Kane ka pynshisha ba baroh kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab ka wan jia shisha . U  Trai  u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular lyngba u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa jong u .

translation.en: And they kept that saying with themselves , questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean .
translation.kha: Ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u , hynrei para ma ki , ki la sdang ban ïakren shaphang kane ,  Aïu kane ‘ kaba mihpat na ka jingïap’ ka mut ?

translation.en: He that despised Moses  law died without mercy under two or three witnesses :
translation.kha: Uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa ka Hukum u Moses u shah pynïap khlem jingisynei haba la bishar pynrem halor ka sakhi jong ki ar ngut ne bun ki nongsakhi .

translation.en: And she vowed a vow , and said , O  Lord  of hosts , if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid , and remember me , and not forget thine handmaid , but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child , then I will give him unto the  Lord  all the days of his life , and there shall no razor come upon his head .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , to khmih ïa nga ka shakri jong me ! To peit ïa ka jingkordit jong nga bad kynmaw ïa nga ! To wat klet ïa nga ! Lada men ai khun shynrang ïa nga , nga kular ba ngan aiti ïa u sha me baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u , bad da lei lei yn ym khap ïa u shñiuh jong u .

translation.en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles  doctrine and fellowship , and in breaking of bread , and in prayers .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki ha kaba ïoh jinghikai na ki apostol , ha kaba ïashim bynta ha ka jingïasyllok , bad ha kaba ïa-ai lem ha ka jingïabam lang bad ha ki jingduwai .

translation.en: And I commanded you at that time , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you this land to possess it : ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel , all that are meet for the war .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ai ruh ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la ai ïa kane ka ri kaba sha mihngi na Jordan ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka . Mynta pat , pynkieng atiar ïa ki rangïapom jong phi bad phah ïa ki sha shiliang ka Jordan ha shuwa kiwei pat ki jait Israel ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïohkynti ïa ka bynta jong ki de .

translation.en: Why did you come ?
translation.kha: Balei phi wan ?

translation.en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian , Oreb and Zeeb : and what was I able to do in comparison of you ? Then their anger was abated toward him , when he had said that .
translation.kha: Nalor kata , da ka bor ka jong U Blei phi la pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jong ki Midian , u Oreb bad u Seeb . Nga la leh aïu ban ïanujor bad kata ?  Haba u la kren ïa kane , kim shym la bitar shuh .

translation.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  da ki jingleh jong ki , bad ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka la mih hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  Ki khun jong phi ki dang ïakhawai ha ïing u khun shynrang baheh duh jong phi , haba ka  erïong na ri shyiap ka wan beh shapoh .

translation.en: The lion hath roared , who will not fear ? the Lord  God  hath spoken , who can but prophesy ?
translation.kha: Haba u sing u kyrhuh , uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingtieng ? Haba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u kren , uei uba lah ban lait khlem pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u ?

translation.en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed , saying , Of a truth this fellow also was with him : for he is a Galilaean .
translation.kha: Bad kumba shi kynta hadien , sa uwei pat u briew u la ban jur ,  Ym don kano kano ka jingartatien ba une u briew u la don lem bad U Jisu , naba ma u hi ruh u long u nong Galilaïa !

translation.en: And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki la mih na ka synagog bad ki la leit beit sha ka ïing u Simon bad u Andriw .

translation.en: If any man come to me , and hate not his father , and mother , and wife , and children , and brethren , and sisters , yea , and his own life also , he cannot be my disciple .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba wan sha nga um lah ban long u synran jong nga lymda u ieit ïa nga kham palat ban ïa kaba u ieit ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong u , ïa ka tnga bad ki khun jong u , ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang bad kynthei jong u , bad ïa lade kumjuh .

translation.en: From that time Jesus began to preach , and to say ,  Repent : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u :  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi , namar ka hima ki bneng ka la jan !

translation.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat  ; and they draw near unto the gates of death .
translation.kha: kim lah ban peit ïa ka jingbam bad ki la jan ban ïap .

translation.en: Even the Spirit of truth  ; whom the world cannot receive , because it seeth him not , neither knoweth him : but ye know him  ; for he dwelleth with you , and shall be in you .
translation.kha: Uta u long U Mynsiem uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei . Ka pyrthei kam lah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ba kam ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u . Hynrei phi ithuh ïa u , namar ba u ïaisah bad phi bad u don hapoh jong phi .

translation.en: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee , and from Decapolis , and from Jerusalem , and from Judaea , and from beyond Jordan .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah byllien na Galilaïa bad Dekapolis , na Jerusalem , Judia bad na ka ri ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan ki la bud ïa u .

translation.en: Saying , Touch not mine anointed , and do my prophets no harm .
translation.kha: Wat pynmynsaw ïa ki shakri ba la jied jong nga ; wat ktah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .

translation.en: There shall be no more praise of Moab : in Heshbon they have devised evil against it  ; come , and let us cut it off from being a nation . Also thou shalt be cut down , O Madmen  ; the sword shall pursue thee .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun ki la knieh ïa ka Heshbon bad ki ïasylla ban pynjot ïa ka hima ki Moab . Ïa ka shnong Madmen yn pynsngap jar ; ki shipai kin tur pyrshah ïa ka .

translation.en: And she went up , and laid him on the bed of the man of God , and shut the door upon him , and went out .
translation.kha: Ka bah ïa u shalor sha ka kamra u Elisha , ka buh ïa u ha ka jingthiah bad ka mihnoh , da kaba khang ïa ka jingkhang .

translation.en: And this I say , that the covenant , that was confirmed before of God in Christ , the law , which was four hundred and thirty years after , cannot disannul , that it should make the promise of none effect .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad u Abraham bad u la kular ban bat ïa ka . Ka hukum , ïa kaba la ai hadien sawspah laiphew snem , kam lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad pyndam noh ïa ka jingkular U Blei .

translation.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window , and cried through the lattice , Why is his chariot so long in coming ? why tarry the wheels of his chariots ?
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u Sisera ka la khmih na ka jingkhangïit ; Ka la phngoid na shadien ka jingker .  Balei ka kali ïapom jong u ka slem ban wan ?  ka la ong .  Balei ki kulai jong u ki tud ban wan phai ?

translation.en: The lion is come up from his thicket , and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way  ; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate  ; and thy cities shall be laid waste , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ka jakarieh jong u , u nongpynjot jong ki jaitbynriew u la mihnoh . U wan ban pynjot ïa ka Judah . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn ieh ha ki jingjot , bad yn ym don mano mano bashong ba sah ha ki .

translation.en: Thou hast multiplied the nation , and not increased the joy : they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest , and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil .
translation.kha: Me la ai ha ki ka jingkmen kaba khraw , ko  Trai  ; me la pynlong ïa ki ban kmen . Ki shadkmen ha kaei kaba me la leh kumba ki briew ki shadkmen haba ki ot kew lane haba ki ïabynta ïa ka spah ba la ïoh kurup .

translation.en: I the  Lord  do keep it  ; I will water it every moment : lest any hurt it , I will keep it night and day .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih ïa ka bad ïai ai um ïa ka . Ngan ap phira ïa ka mynmiet bad mynsngi khnang ba yn ym don mano mano u ban pynsniew ïa ka .

translation.en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage , and ran into the army , and came and saluted his brethren .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ieh ïa kata ka jingbam ha u rangbah uba dei peit ïa ka bam , u mareh sha ba don ki hynmen , bad u kylli kumno ki ïalong .

translation.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .
translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng synñia nga khie ban ïaroh ïa me namar ki jingbishar hok jong me .

translation.en: Pilate therefore said unto him , Art thou a king then ? Jesus answered ,  Thou sayest that I am a king . To this end was I born , and for this cause came I into the world , that I should bear witness unto the truth . Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice .
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la kylli ïa u ,  Haba kumta , me , me dei u syiem ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me hi me ong ba nga long u syiem . Ïa nga la kha bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthei na ka bynta kane kawei ka jingthmu , ban kren shaphang ka jingshisha . Uno uno uba dei jong ka jingshisha u shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you , and many sleep .
translation.kha: Namar kane balei bun na phi , phi pang bad phi swai , bad bun bah ki la ïap .

translation.en: Then said I , Woe is me ! for I am undone  ; because I am a man of unclean lips , and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips : for mine eyes have seen the King , the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ym don jingkyrmen ïa nga ! Nga long ba la tim namar kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ka long kaba pop , bad nga shong nga sah hapdeng ki briew kiba kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka long kaba pop . Bad pynban , da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa U Syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: I'm just asking .
translation.kha: Nga shu kylli .

translation.en: Better is a dry morsel , and quietness therewith , than an house full of sacrifices with strife .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban bam ïa u kpu ba la tyrkhong lem bad ka jingsuk mynsiem ban ïa kaba bam khawai ha ka ïing kaba dap da ki jingjynjar .

translation.en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together : the  Lord  lighteneth both their eyes .
translation.kha: U briew baduk bad u nongbanbeiñ jong u ki ïadon ïa kane kumjuh — U  Trai  u ai ïa ki khmat ha baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: And , behold , as Barak pursued Sisera , Jael came out to meet him , and said unto him , Come , and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest . And when he came into her tent , behold , Sisera lay dead , and the nail was in his temples .
translation.kha: Haba u Barak u wan wad ïa u Sisera , ka Jael ka mih shabar ban ïakynduh ïa u , bad ka ong ha u ,  Ale hangne ! Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba phi wad .  Kumta u la leit shapoh bad ka , bad hangta ha madan don u Sisera , uba la ïap , bad u snar pynskhem dara lyngba ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: And there came forth a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will persuade him .
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki angel ki ong ïa kawei bad kiwei ki ong da kumwei pat , haduh ba u mynsiem u jam sha khmat , u wan sha U  Trai  bad u ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ïa u .’

translation.en: And the man increased exceedingly , and had much cattle , and maidservants , and menservants , and camels , and asses .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom u Jakob u kylla long uba riewspah eh . U la don shibun ki kynhun jingri , ki mraw , ki ut , bad ki kada .

translation.en: For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum lyngba u Moses , hynrei ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha ki la wan lyngba U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it , or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger , shall even be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba khleh ïa kaba kum kane , ne uba pyndonkam ïa ka wat tang khyndiat ruh ha uno uno u briew u bym dei u lyngdoh , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga !’

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Make the men sit down .  Now there was much grass in the place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand .
translation.kha: Pynshong ïa ki briew ha madan ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki . ( La don shibun u phlang hangta . ) Kumta ki briew baroh ki la shong ha madan ; ki la don kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: He will eat .
translation.kha: Yn sa Bam ma u .

translation.en: And if a man also strive for masteries , yet is he not crowned , except he strive lawfully .
translation.kha: U nongmareh thong uba mareh ïa ka thong un ym lah ban ïoh ïa ka prais lymda u kohnguh ïa ki rukom pynïaid .

translation.en: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .
translation.kha: Lada ki kohnguh ïa U Blei bad shakri ïa u , kin pynleit ïa ka jingim jong ki ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingmanbha .

translation.en: O Lord , what shall I say , when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies !
translation.kha: Aïu nga lah ban ong , A  Trai  , mynta ba ki Israel ki la kynran dien na u nongshun ?

translation.en: But if the watchman see the sword come , and blow not the trumpet , and the people be not warned  ; if the sword come , and take any person from among them , he is taken away in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at the watchman s hand .
translation.kha: Lada , kumno kumno , u nongap u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan bad um shym put ïa ka turoi jingmaham , u nongshun un wan bad un pynïap noh ïa kita ki nongpop ; hynrei ngan pynkit pop ïa u nongap na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .

translation.en: And Joseph knew his brethren , but they knew not him .
translation.kha: Wat la u Joseph u la ithuh ïa la ki hynmen , ki pat kim shym la ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Come again unto me after three days . And the people departed .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u jubab ,  Ai ïa nga lai sngi ba ngan pyrkhat ïa kane ka kam . Nangta sa wan pat .  Kumta kita ki briew ki leit noh .

translation.en: And I will give power unto my two witnesses , and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days , clothed in sackcloth .
translation.kha: Ngan sa phah ïa ki sakhi jong nga ar ngut kiba kup da ki jaiñ khain , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha kita ki shihajar arspah hynriewphew sngi .

translation.en: Then he said unto them , Go your way , eat the fat , and drink the sweet , and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared : for this day is holy unto our Lord : neither be ye sorry  ; for the joy of the  Lord  is your strength .
translation.kha: Mynta leit noh sha la ïing bad bam bad dih sngewbha . Ïasam ïa ka jingbam bad ka waiñ bad kito ki bym dap bym biang . Mynta ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ha U  Trai  jong ngi , kumta wat sngewsih . Ka jingkmen kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi kan pynlong khlaiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: Now therefore , if ye have done truly and sincerely , in that ye have made Abimelech king , and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house , and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands  ;
translation.kha: Mynta te ,  u Jotham u bteng ,  Hato phi lehhok bad da kaba khuid mynsiem shisha haba phi thung syiem ïa u Abimelekh ? Hato phi kynmaw burom ïa u Gideon bad lehbha ïa ka longïing jong u , kumba ki kam jong u ki dei ban ïoh ?

translation.en: And Me–jarkon , and Rakkon , with the border before Japho .
translation.kha: ka Mejarkon , bad ka Rakkon , kumjuh ruh ka jaka sawdong ka Joppa .

translation.en: Behold , I have longed after thy precepts : quicken me in thy righteousness .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ; to ai ha nga ka jingim bathymmai , namar me long uba hok .

translation.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me , and that which I was afraid of is come unto me .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga sheptieng bad sngewtriem ka wan jia shisha .

translation.en: And the second took her , and died , neither left he any seed : and the third likewise .
translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad u la ïap noh ruh khlem don khun . Ka la jia kumjuh ïa u para uba lai ,

translation.en: And Abraham took Ishmael his son , and all that were born in his house , and all that were bought with his money , every male among the men of Abraham s house  ; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day , as God had said unto him .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Abraham u la kohnguh ïa U Blei bad u la otsher ïa u Ishmael u khun jong u , bad ïa kiwei pat ki shynrang baroh na ka longïing longsem jong u , kynthup ruh ïa ki mraw baroh kiba la kha ha longïing longsem jong u bad kito kiba u la lah thied .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear not , neither be thou dismayed : take all the people of war with thee , and arise , go up to Ai : see , I have given into thy hand the king of Ai , and his people , and his city , and his land :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ïalam lang bad me ïa ki shipai baroh bad leit kiew sha Ai . Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop ïa u syiem ka Ai ; ki briew jong u , ka nongbah jong u , bad ka ri kan long ka jong me .

translation.en: Sharp stones are under him : he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire .
translation.kha: Ki snep ha ka kpoh jong u ki long kum ki syrwiang khiew kiba nep ; ki tar ïa ka madan ktieh kumba long ka lyntang shoh kew .

translation.en: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God , that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God , for which ye also suffer :
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka pynshisha ba ka jingbishar ka jong U Blei ka long kaba hok , bad kumta phin long kiba bit na ka bynta ka Hima jong u , kaba na ka bynta jong ka phi shahshitom .

translation.en: And they took them wives of the women of Moab  ; the name of the one was Orpah , and the name of the other Ruth : and they dwelled there about ten years .
translation.kha: kiba la shongkurim ïa ki kynthei Moab , ka Orpah bad ka Ruth . Kumba shiphew snem hadien ,

translation.en: Thy crowned are as the locusts , and thy captains as the great grasshoppers , which camp in the hedges in the cold day , but when the sun ariseth they flee away , and their place is not known where they are .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong pha ki long kum ka kynhun ki puit kiba dem ha ka kynroh ha ka sngi kaba khriat . Hynrei haba ka sngi ka mih , ki her noh , bad ym don mano mano batip shano ki la jah noh !

translation.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour , and did likewise .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka por khat-ar baje bad ruh ha ka por lai baje u la leh kumjuh .

translation.en: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kaba bha tam ka jong nga , nangta , ban thaw ka lad na ka bynta jong phi ban kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei ha ki por baroh hadien ka jingïap jong nga .

translation.en: And from Betah , and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , king David took exceeding much brass .
translation.kha: U la shim ruh shibun ka rnong na Betah bad na Berothai , ki nongbah kiba la synshar da u Hadadeser .

translation.en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together , going and weeping : they shall go , and seek the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba ka por ka poi , ki paid Israel bad Judah kin wan ïa-ïam , kin wad ïa nga , U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: The Lord said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand , till I make thine enemies thy footstool ?
translation.kha: ‘ U Trai u la ong ha U Trai jong nga : To shong hangne ha ka liang ka mon jong nga tad haduh ba ngan buh ïa ki nongshun jong me hapoh ki kjat jong me .’

translation.en: And Rab–shakeh said unto them , Speak ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ïa ki , ba u nongsynshar u kwah ban tip kaei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewskhem .

translation.en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Syros kum u patsha ka Babilonia , u Syros u la pynmih ïa ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Keep thy heart with all diligence  ; for out of it are the issues of life .
translation.kha: Da phikir kumno phi pyrkhat ; naba ki jingpyrkhat jong phi ki saiñdur ïa ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance : the  Lord  God of Israel was their inheritance , as he said unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . U ong ïa ki ba ka jingïohkynti jong ki ka dei ka bhah jong ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was in Egypt , whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king , heard it , that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban lait im na u syiem Solomon , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan phai noh sha ïing .

translation.en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you , if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kata ka long kumno ba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng un leh ïa uwei pa uwei na phi lymda phi ïamap ïa la u hynmen u para naduh ka dohnud .

translation.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki . ‘ Da shisha kin burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .

translation.en: Thy shepherds slumber , O king of Assyria : thy nobles shall dwell in the dust : thy people is scattered upon the mountains , and no man gathereth them .
translation.kha: Ko Patsha ka Assyria , ki lat jong me ki la ïap , bad ki rangbah donburom jong me ki ïohthiah junom ! Ïa ki briew jong me la pynsakma halor ki lumbah , bad ym don shuh mano mano ban wallam pat ïa ki sha ïing .

translation.en: Then she said , Did I desire a son of my lord ? did I not say , Do not deceive me ?
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka ong ha u ,  Kynrad , hato nga pan khun shynrang na phi ? Hato ngam shym ïathuh ïa phi ban ym kyntiew ïa ki jingkyrmen jong nga ?

translation.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence ;
translation.kha: Katno khraw ka long ka jingaiei U Blei , kaba u la ai ha ngi ha kat kata ka jingthew bakhraw!

translation.en: And we said unto him , We are true men  ; we are no spies :
translation.kha: ‘ Ngim dei ki nongsyntiat ,’ ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngi dei kiba shida .

translation.en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the  Lord  thy God , which thou shalt make thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi tei ïa ka duwan U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynïeng hajan jong ka ïa uno uno u dieng uba don ka dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah .

translation.en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God , to confirm the promises made unto the fathers :
translation.kha: Naba nga ong ïa phi ba ka jingim jong ka jingshakri U Khrist ka la long na ka bynta ki Jiw , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u long uba ïaineh , ban pynlong ïa ki kular jong u ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban urlong shisha ,

translation.en: And Mary said , Behold the handmaid of the Lord  ; be it unto me according to thy word . And the angel departed from her .
translation.kha: Nga long ka shakri jong U Trai ,  ka Mari ka la ong ,  ai kan long ha nga kumba me la ong .  Bad u angel u la leit noh na ka .

translation.en: But I fear , lest by any means , as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty , so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ .
translation.kha: Nga sheptieng ïoh ïa ki jingmut jong phi yn pynjngut noh bad ba phin iehnoh noh ïa ka jingaiti basngur pura jong phi ha U Khrist — kumba ïa ka Im la shukor da ki buit sianti uta u bseiñ .

translation.en: Take fast hold of instruction  ; let her not go : keep her  ; for she is thy life .
translation.kha: Kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba phi la nang . Ka jingnang jingtip jong phi ka dei ka jingim jong phi — ri kyndong ïa ka .

translation.en: And while he yet spake with them , Rachel came with her father s sheep : for she kept them .
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u dang ïakren bad ki , ka Rakhel ka la poi bad la ka kynhun langbrot .

translation.en: Is there any number of his armies ? and upon whom doth not his light arise ?
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki angel kiba shakri ïa u ? Hato don kano kano ka jaka kaba ka jingshai U Blei kam lah ban tyngshaiñ ?

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he .
translation.kha: Nga la pyllaitluid ïa ki paid Israel bad pynim ïa ki na ka hima bakhrawbor .

translation.en: Therefore is the name of it called Babel  ; because the  Lord  did there confound the language of all the earth : and from thence did the  Lord  scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah la khot kyrteng ka Babel , namar dei hangta ba U  Trai  u la pynkhleh ïa ka ktien jong ki briew baroh ; bad nangta la pynsaphred ïa ki sha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun , that there is one event unto all : yea , also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .
translation.kha: Kawei ka kupar ka wan kumjuh ha baroh , bad kane ka long kaba bakla kum kano kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei . Katba ki briew ki dang im , ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki dap da ka jingsniew bad ka jinglamwir , bad kynsan kynsan ki ïap .

translation.en: And he had in his hand a little book open : and he set his right foot upon the sea , and his left foot on the earth ,
translation.kha: U la don ïa ka kot kli barit ba la plied ha ka kti jong u . U la buh ïa ka kjat kamon jong u halor ka duriaw bad ïa ka kjat kadiang jong u halor ka khyndew ,

translation.en: All this , said David , the  Lord  made me understand in writing by his hand upon me , even all the works of this pattern .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Ïa kane baroh la kynthup ha ka dur pynkhreh kaba la thoh kat kum ki jingbthah kiba U  Trai  da lade hi u la ai ha nga ban pyntrei .

translation.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha , which by interpretation is called Dorcas : this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did .
