translation.kha: Ha Joppa la don ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Tabitha , kaba long ka riewngeit . ( Ka kyrteng jong ka ha ka Ktien Grik ka long ka Dorkas , kaba mut  ka skei .  ) Ka la pynlut ïa ka por jong ka baroh ha kaba leh babha bad ha kaba ïarap ïa kiba duk .

translation.en: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple , and went about to kill me .
translation.kha: Dei na kane ka daw ba ki Jiw ki la kem ïa nga katba nga dang don hapoh ka Templ , bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: And when they had brought them , they set them before the council : and the high priest asked them ,
translation.kha: Ki la wallam shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la pynïeng ïa ki ha ka Dorbar , bad u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: Then said David to the Philistine , Thou comest to me with a sword , and with a spear , and with a shield : but I come to thee in the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of the armies of Israel , whom thou hast defied .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Me wan ïaleh ïa nga da ka waitlam , da u lyngka , bad da u sum , hynrei nga wan pyrshah ïa me ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor , U Blei jong ki kynhun ïapom ki Israel , ïa uba me la ñiewbeiñ .

translation.en: Feed thy people with thy rod , the flock of thine heritage , which dwell solitarily in the wood , in the midst of Carmel : let them feed in Bashan and Gilead , as in the days of old .
translation.kha: To long u nongaplangbrot ïa la ki briew , A  Trai  , ki briew kiba me la jied . Wat la ki shong saphred ha ka ri khlaw , ka don ka jaka baseisoh sawdong jong ki . To ai ba kin leit bad bam na ki jaka phlang bajyrngam jong ka Bashan bad ka Gilead , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa la slem bah .

translation.en: And this shall be the priest s due from the people , from them that offer a sacrifice , whether it be ox or sheep  ; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder , and the two cheeks , and the maw .
translation.kha: Na ki jingkñia ainguh kiba da u masi ne ka langbrot , ki lyngdoh ki dei ban ïoh ïa ka tyrpeng , baroh ar ki ngab , bad ka  nierbah .

translation.en: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn , which are written in heaven , and to God the Judge of all , and to the spirits of just men made perfect ,
translation.kha: Phi la wan sha ka jingïalumlang kaba kmen jong ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong U Blei , kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha bneng . Phi la wan sha U Blei uba long u nongbishar ki bynriew baroh , bad sha ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba bha ïa kiba la pynjanai .

translation.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now , the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin  ; for they did unto thee evil : and now , we pray thee , forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi ba phin map ïa ka kam sniew kaba ngi , ki shakri jong U Blei u kpa jong phi , ngi la leh .  U Joseph u ïam haba u ïohsngew ïa kane .

translation.en: Judge not , and ye shall not be judged : condemn not , and ye shall not be condemned : forgive , and ye shall be forgiven :
translation.kha: Wat bishar ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi ; wat pynrem ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un ym pynrem ïa phi ; map ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un map ïa phi .

translation.en: Blessed is the man that heareth me , watching daily at my gates , waiting at the posts of my doors .
translation.kha: U briew uba shahshkor ïa nga un suk — u briew uba ap man ka sngi ha jingkhang jong nga , uba ap ha jaka rung ka ïing jong nga .

translation.en: But after they had rest , they did evil again before thee : therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies , so that they had the dominion over them : yet when they returned , and cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies  ;
translation.kha: Haba ka jingsuk ka la wan , ki leh pop biang , bad me shah biang ïa ki nongshun ban jop ïa ki . Pynban ki kylla-kaba-mut bad kyrpad ïa me ban pynim ïa ki , ha bneng me ïohsngew , bad na ka por sha ka por me pyllait ïa ki ha ka jingisynei bakhraw jong me .

translation.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans , saith the  Lord  , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon , and upon her princes , and upon her wise men .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka Jingïap ïa ka Babilonia ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki briew jong ka , ïa ki nongsynshar jong ka , ïa ki rangbah bastad jong ka .

translation.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow : but a prating fool shall fall .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba len ïa ka jingshisha u thaw jingkulmar , hynrei uta uba pyn-i markhmat u trei na ka bynta ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And join them one to another into one stick  ; and they shall become one in thine hand .
translation.kha: Nangta bat ïa kine ki ar tylli ki dieng na tduh ha tduh ha ka kti jong me ba kin i kum uwei u dieng .

translation.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron  ; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jabin u don khyndaispah tylli ki kali ïapom kiba da ka nar , bad u la synshar ïa ki Israel da kaba banbeiñ bad lehbor haduh arphew snem . Nangta ki paid Israel ki la kyang jam ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And Saul said unto Samuel , I have sinned : for I have transgressed the commandment of the  Lord  , and thy words : because I feared the people , and obeyed their voice .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga la leh pop ,  u Saul u jubab .  Ngam shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ïa ki jingsneng pyn-i jong phi . Nga la sheptieng ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad nga la leh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .

translation.en: For the scripture saith , Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn . And ,  The labourer is worthy of his reward .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong ,  Ym dei ban teh ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh kew  bad  u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa la ka bainong .

translation.en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .
translation.kha: Hynriew bnai kynthih , u la pyn-i ïa ki spah jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha ka jingitynnat bad jingkhraw jong ka .

translation.en: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said ,  I have compassion on the multitude , because they continue with me now three days , and have nothing to eat : and I will not send them away fasting , lest they faint in the way .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khot ïa la ki synran sha lade bad u la ong ,  Nga isynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la ïadon bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei ban bam . Ngam kwah ban phah noh ïa ki khlem da bsa ïa ki , naba ki lah ban ïapler ha ka lynti jong ki sha la ïing .

translation.en: But I say unto you , Love your enemies , bless them that curse you , do good to them that hate you , and pray for them which despitefully use you , and persecute you  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad duwai na ka bynta kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ,

translation.en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning , behold , the altar of Baal was cast down , and the grove was cut down that was by it , and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ha ka nongrit ki khie dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , ki shem ba ka duwan ïa u Baal bad ka dak jong ka Asherah la pynkhyllem , bad ba la thang ïa u masi kyrtong uba ar halor ka duwan ïa kaba la tei hangta .

translation.en: And unto his son will I give one tribe , that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem , the city which I have chosen me to put my name there .
translation.kha: hynrei ngan shah ba u khun jong u Solomon un ïoh ïa kawei ka jait , khnang ba borabor ngan don uwei uba mih pateng na u Dabid u shakri jong nga ban synshar ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jied kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when many evils and troubles are befallen them , that this song shall testify against them as a witness  ; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed : for I know their imagination which they go about , even now , before I have brought them into the land which I sware .
translation.kha: bad shibun ki jingjynjar kiba ishyrkhei kin wan ngat ha ki . Hynrei ïa kane ka jingrwai yn dang ïai rwai , bad ka kan ïeng kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . Wat mynta hi , shuwa ba ngan ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , nga tip aïu ki pyrkhat .

translation.en: And the people murmured against Moses , saying , What shall we drink ?
translation.kha: Kita ki paidbah ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses , bad ki la kylli ,  Ngin ïadih da-ei ?

translation.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord  ; and being fervent in the spirit , he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord , knowing only the baptism of John .
translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka Lynti jong U Trai , bad da ka jingshitrhem bakhraw u la pynbna bad hikai khlem bakla ïa ki jingshisha shaphang U Jisu . Pynban u la tip tang ïa ka jingpynbaptis jong u Ïoannis .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Balak took Balaam , and brought him up into the high places of Baal , that thence he might see the utmost part of the people .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Balak u la ïalam ïa u Balaam sha Bamoth Baal , na kaba u Balaam u lah ban ïohi shi bynta jong ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water , the flint into a fountain of waters .
translation.kha: uba pynkylla ïa ki mawsiang sha ki pung-um , bad ïa ki synrang ba-eh sha ki umpohliew kiba tuid .

translation.en: And Joshua adjured them at that time , saying , Cursed be the man before the  Lord  , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho : he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn , and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Joshua u maham tyngeh , u da ong ,  Uta uba pyrshang ban tei thymmai ïa ka nongbah Jerikho un long hapoh ka jingtim jong U  Trai  !  Uta uba seng ïa ka nongrim un duh noh ïa la u khun nyngkong ; Uta uba tei ïa ki khyrdop un duh noh ïa la u khun khatduh !

translation.en: And I will send a fire on Magog , and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan sdang ïa ka ding ha ka ri u Magog bad ha baroh shi lynter ki rud duriaw ; ha kaba ki briew ki shong khlem jingpynwit bad uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: To him that made great lights : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la thaw ïa ka sngi bad ïa u bnai ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: Can the fig tree , my brethren , bear olive berries ? either a vine , figs ? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh .
translation.kha: U dieng Dumbur , ko parabangeit jong nga , um lah ban sei ïa ki soh Olib ; ne u dieng sohwaiñ um lah ban sei ïa ki soh Dumbur , lymne ka umpohliew mluh kam lah ban pynmih ïa ka um kaba bang .

translation.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker : but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor .
translation.kha: Lada phi banbeiñ ïa ki briew kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki ; hynrei ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jinglehsbun ïa kiba duk ka long ka kam jong ka jingmane .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice , he said ,  Father , into thy hands I commend my spirit :  and having said thus , he gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pyrta ha ka sur bajam ,  Ko Pa ! Ha ki kti jong me nga aiti ïa la ka mynsiem !  U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .

translation.en: In all this Job sinned not , nor charged God foolishly .
translation.kha: Wat hapdeng kita kiei kiei kiba la jia , u Job um shym la leh pop da kaba kynnoh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth , saying , Give me thy vineyard , that I may have it for a garden of herbs , because it is near unto my house : and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it  ; or , if it seem good to thee , I will give thee the worth of it in money .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ahab u ong ha u Naboth ,  Ai noh ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ jong me ha nga ba ngan pynlong ka kper jhur ïa ka , namar ka don harud ka ïingsyiem jong nga . Ngan ai pli ïa me da ka bri sohwaiñ kaba kham bha ha ka jaka jong ka , lane , lada me sngewdei , ngan da siewdor kaba biang ïa ka .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , In my dream , behold , I stood upon the bank of the river :
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ,  Nga la phohsniew ba nga ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,

translation.en: They abhor me , they flee far from me , and spare not to spit in my face .
translation.kha: Ki peit ïa nga da ka jingisih ; ki pyrkhat ki kham bha palat ma ki ban ïa nga , bad ki wan wat ban bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious , even to the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O ye house of Israel , let it suffice you of all your abominations ,
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa kito ki paid Israel kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan ym lah shah shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki leh .

translation.en: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman , and hast a desire unto her , that thou wouldest have her to thy wife  ;
translation.kha: bad phi ïohi hapdeng jong ki ïa ka kynthei kaba bhabriew kaba phi imon ban shongkurim ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ïa u angel da ki kyntien pyntngen ,

translation.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof .
translation.kha: U nongshong basa ne u nongbylla um bit ban bam ïa ka .

translation.en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein , which brought fish , and all manner of ware , and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki rangbah na ka nongbah Tyros ki shong ki sah ha Jerusalem , bad ki wanrah dohkha bad baroh ki jait mar sha ka nongbah ban die ha ki briew jong ngi ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign . And this Seraiah was a quiet prince .
translation.kha: U nongsumar ïa u syiem Sedekaïah u dei u Seraïah , u khun jong u Neraïah bad u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Seraïah u dang leit sha Babilonia bad u , bad nga la ai ha u katto katne ki jingbthah .

translation.en: Jesus saith to him ,  He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Uno uno uba la dep sum u long uba la khuid bha bad um donkam ban da sait ïa lade , lait noh ïa la ki kjat . Baroh na phi , phi long kiba khuid — baroh lait noh uwei .

translation.en: And he said , Behold now , my lords , turn in , I pray you , into your servant s house , and tarry all night , and wash your feet , and ye shall rise up early , and go on your ways . And they said , Nay  ; but we will abide in the street all night .
translation.kha: U dem ngon ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong ,  Ko rangbah , nga don hangne ban shakri ïa phi . Sngewbha wan sha ïing jong nga . Phi lah ban sait ïa la ki kjat , bad ban sahmiet ruh . Lashai phi lah ban khie dang step , bad bteng ïa la ka jingleit .  Hynrei ki jubab ,  Em , ngin sahmiet hangne ha ka jaka bakylluid jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith  ; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising the shame , and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God .
translation.kha: To ngin ïakhmih shaiñ sha U Jisu , ha uba ka jingngeit jong ngi ka don naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . U bym shym la kynran dien namar ka diengphna ! Pynban , namar ka jingkmen kaba la ap ïa u , um shym pyrkhat ei ei ïa ka jingjahburom ban shahïap halor ka diengphna , bad mynta u la shong ha ka liang ka mon jong ka khet U Blei .

translation.en: And he said , To morrow . And he said , Be it according to thy word : that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u jubab ,  Duwai na ka bynta jong nga la shai .  U Moses u ong ,  Ngan leh kumba phi ong , ba phin ïoh tip ba ym don mano mano ruh uba kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers  ; even the chief of the fathers , as they were counted by number of names by their polls , that did the work for the service of the house of the  Lord  , from the age of twenty years and upward .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lebi , kat kum ki kur bad ki longïing , bad ïa uwei pa uwei na ki la buh jingthoh da ka kyrteng . Uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew , uba arphew snem ka rta ne tam , u ïoh ka bynta ha ka kam ha ka Templ jong U  Trai .

translation.en: For through the voice of the  Lord  shall the Assyrian be beaten down , which smote with a rod .
translation.kha: Ki Assyria kin khynñiuh haba kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur U  Trai  bad sngew ïa ka bor jong ka jingpynshitom jong u .

translation.en: So it came to pass , when the king s commandment and his decree was heard , and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace , to the custody of Hegai , that Esther was brought also unto the king s house , to the custody of Hegai , keeper of the women .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la pynmih ïa ka jingpynbna bathymmai bad shibun ki samla kynthei la wallam sha Susa , ka Esther ka la long kawei na ki . Ïa ka ruh la buh ha ka ïingsyiem hapoh ka jingsumar u Hegai , uba peit ïa ka ïing ki kynthei .

translation.en: Let your light so shine before men , that they may see your good works , and glorify your Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingshai jong phi ka dei ban shai ha khmat ki briew , khnang ba kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi leh bad ïaroh ïa u Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng .

translation.en: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen , and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym burom ïa pha , hynrei phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art , the Holy One of God .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba me kwah na ngi , ko Jisu na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga tip me long uei — me long u nonglamktien bakhuid jong U Blei !

translation.en: And he that shall swear by heaven , sweareth by the throne of God , and by him that sitteth thereon .
translation.kha: bad haba uno uno u smai da ka bneng , u smai da ka khet U Blei bad da uta uba shong halor jong ka .

translation.en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king s provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to take the spoil of them for a prey .
translation.kha: Ki nongrah-khubor ki la rah ïa kane ka jingpynbna sha kawei pa kawei ka probins jong ka hima . Ka don ki jingbthah ba tang ha kawei ka sngi , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , ïa baroh ki Jiw — samla bad tymmen , kynthei bad khynnah — dei ban pynïap . Ïa ki dei ban pynïap khlem jingisynei bad ba ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki dei ban shim noh .

translation.en: Cast in thy lot among us  ; let us all have one purse :
translation.kha: Ale bad ïoh bynta lang bad ngi , bad ngin ïasam ïa kaba ngi ïoh lute .

translation.en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year , in the fifteenth day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: At that time will I bring you again , even in the time that I gather you : for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth , when I turn back your captivity before your eyes , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong pha kiba la shah pynsakma ; ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba pawnam ha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba manbha pat .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days , that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made :
translation.kha: Hadien sawphew sngi u Noah u plie ïa ka jingkhangïit , bad u pyllait ïa ka tyngab .

translation.en: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
translation.kha: Kumta U Khun U Briew u long U Kynrad jong ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon , shall the inhabitant of Zion say  ; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea , shall Jerusalem say .
translation.kha: To ai ba ki briew ka Seïon kin ong ,  To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jinglehbor halor jong ngi !  To ai ba ki briew ka Jerusalem kin ong ,  To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la shahshitom !

translation.en: And Moses let his father in law depart  ; and he went his way into his own land .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u khublei ïakhlad bad u Jethro , bad u Jethro u leit phai pat sha la ïing .

translation.en: The  Lord  will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people , and the princes thereof : for ye have eaten up the vineyard  ; the spoil of the poor is in your houses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wallam sha ka jingbishar ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ïa ki nongïalam . U pynlong ïa kane ka jingkynnoh :  Phi la lute ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki ïing jong phi ki dap da kiei kiei kiba phi la shim na kiba duk .

translation.en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight .
translation.kha: Bad u la siew ïa u Araunah hynriewspah ki sbai ksiar na ka bynta ka jaka shoh kew .

translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :
translation.kha: Nangta u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka khubor u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai kdar ,

translation.en: They have not known nor understood : for he hath shut their eyes , that they cannot see  ; and their hearts , that they cannot understand .
translation.kha: Kum kita ki briew ki long kiba bieit eh ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh . Ki khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad ïa la ki jingmut na ka jingshisha .

translation.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son s hand , and will give it unto thee , even ten tribes .
translation.kha: Ngan knieh ïa ka hima na u khun jong u Solomon bad ngan ai ha me shiphew jait ,

translation.en: And bring your youngest brother unto me : then shall I know that ye are no spies , but that ye are true men : so will I deliver you your brother , and ye shall traffick in the land .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ruh ïa u para khatduh jong phi sha nga . Da kumta ngan tip ba phim dei ki nongsyntiat , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ; ngan ai pat ha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad phi lah ban sah hangne bad khaïi ruh .’

translation.en: For the land , whither thou goest in to possess it , is not as the land of Egypt , from whence ye came out , where thou sowedst thy seed , and wateredst it with thy foot , as a garden of herbs :
translation.kha: Kata ka ri ba phin sa ïohkynti kam dei kum ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi shong mynshuwa . Hangta , haba phi bet ïa u symbai , phi hap ban da trei shitom ban ai um ïa ki lyngkha ;

translation.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee , which was given thee by prophecy , with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery .
translation.kha: Wat leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingai ba kynja mynsiem kaba don ha me , ïa kaba la ai ha me mynba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren bad ki nongsharai balang    ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong me .

translation.en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban ym ïathuh hano hano ba u long U Messaïah .

translation.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master , tell me : and if not , tell me  ; that I may turn to the right hand , or to the left .
translation.kha: Mynta , lada phi mut ban pyndep ïa ka jingkitkhlieh kaba phi don ïa u kynrad jong nga bad ban lehhok ïa u , to sngewbha ïathuh ïa nga ; te lada kam long , to ong kumta , bad ngan sa rai aïu ngan leh .

translation.en: But every man in his own order : Christ the firstfruits ; afterward they that are Christ s at his coming .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynmihpat kat kum ka jingbuh ryntih : Ïa U Khrist nyngkong eh na baroh ; nangta ha ka jingwan jong u , sa ïa kito kiba dei ki jong u .

translation.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David  ; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king : and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the  Lord  , and made them sin a great sin .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U  Trai  u la pynkyrpang ïa ka Israel na ka Judah , ki Israel ki pynlong ïa u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat kum u syiem jong ki . U Jeroboam u pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh noh ïa U  Trai  bad u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh ïa ki pop kiba shyrkhei .

translation.en: And she said unto her , All that thou sayest unto me I will do .
translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka jubab ,  Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ong .

translation.en: And he went up and down among the lions , he became a young lion , and learned to catch the prey , and devoured men .
translation.kha: Haba u la san dap rynïeng , u la ïaleit thap mrad bad kiwei pat ki sing . Ma u ruh u la nang ban behmrad bad u kylla long u nongbam briew .

translation.en: And he said to Gehazi his servant , Call this Shunammite . And when he had called her , she stood before him .
translation.kha: U ong ïa u Gehasi u shakri jong u ban leit bad khot ïa kata ka briew . Haba ka la wan ,

translation.en: They are dead , they shall not live  ; they are deceased , they shall not rise : therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them , and made all their memory to perish .
translation.kha: Mynta ki la ïap noh bad kin ym im shuh ; ki sna-ïap jong ki kin ym mih , namar me la pynshitom bad pynjot ïa ki . Ym don uwei ruh u ban kynmaw shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: ( For from my youth he was brought up with me , as with a father , and I have guided her from my mother s womb  ; )
translation.kha: Baroh shi jingim jong nga , nga la kitkhia ïa ki .

translation.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul  ; but he that despiseth his ways shall die .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ki hukum U Blei bad phin im slem ; lada phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , phin ïap .

translation.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok , Let me now run , and bear the king tidings , how that the  Lord  hath avenged him of his enemies .
translation.kha: Nangta u Ahimaas , u khun jong u Sadok u ong ha u Joab ,  Shah ngan leit sha u syiem bad ka khubor babha ba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u na ki nongshun jong u .

translation.en: And also that every man should eat and drink , and enjoy the good of all his labour , it is the gift of God .
translation.kha: Baroh na ngi , ngi dei ban bam bad dih bad lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he that killeth a beast , he shall restore it : and he that killeth a man , he shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba pynïap ïa uno uno u jingri u dei ban buria ïa u , hynrei uta uba pynïap ïa la u parabriew u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: The kings came and fought , then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo  ; they took no gain of money .
translation.kha: Ha Taanakh , harud ka wahduid jong ka Megiddo , Ki syiem ki la wan bad ïaleh ; Ki syiem Kanaan ki la ïaleh , Hynrei kim shym ïoh rah ïa kano kano ka rupa .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat :
translation.kha: U Moses , u Aaron , bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki sait ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ki kjat

translation.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech s head , and all to brake his skull .
translation.kha: Hynrei kawei ka kynthei ka pynhap najrong da u mawtylliat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ka shynrong khlieh jong u ka la pait .

translation.en: And he looked up , and said , I see men as trees , walking .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la khmied bad ong ,  Ho-oid , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki briew , hynrei nga ïohi kum ki dieng kiba ïa-ïaid .

translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear . Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up  ; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait ban shahshkor , kumta u syiem Jehoash u tur shaphrang lem bad ki rangbah jong u bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ha Beth Shemesh ha Judah .

translation.en: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .
translation.kha: bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa ha trai jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnaw hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita ki tnaw jong ka ar tylli .

translation.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men .
translation.kha: Ka jingdon ki rangbah ïa kiba la bsa ka la long san hajar ngut .

translation.en: You may go to a local Kingdom Hall or speak to any of Jehovah’s Witnesses and request a publication in your language that will help you to understand the Bible .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban leit sha ka Ïing Hima kaba don hajan jong phi ne ong ïa ino ino i Nongsakhi U Jehobah ban ai ïa phi ki kot kiba lah ban ïarap ïa phi ban sngewthuh ïa ka Baibl .

translation.en: And when they were by Jebus , the day was far spent  ; and the servant said unto his master , Come , I pray thee , and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites , and lodge in it .
translation.kha: Uta u briew um treh shuh ban sah ha kata ka miet , kumta ma u bad ka tnga kliar jong u ki sdang ïa ka jingleit jong ki , ryngkat bad u shakri jong ki bad kita ki kada ar tylli kiba kit jingkit ha ki jin . Ka sngi ka la jan sep haba ki wan poi hajan Jebus ( kata ka dei ka Jerusalem ) , kumta u shakri u ong ha la u kynrad ,  Balei ngim sangeh ban sahmiet ha kane ka nongbah ki Jebus ?

translation.en: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and went back , and stood by the bank of Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u tam ïa ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah kaba la hap na u , bad u leit phai bad ïeng harud ka Jordan .

translation.en: And he said , Lord , I believe . And he worshipped him .
translation.kha: Nga ngeit , ko Trai !  uta u briew u la ong , bad u la dem khohsiew ha khmat U Jisu .

translation.en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house : and all that came into Solomon s heart to make in the house of the  Lord  , and in his own house , he prosperously effected .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Syiem Solomon u la pyndep ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , u da pyndep janai ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u la buh jingmut ban leh ïa ki ,

translation.en: And for the other side of the tabernacle , which is toward the north corner , he made twenty boards ,
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh arphew tylli ki jingker na ka bynta ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: Who is he that condemneth ? It is Christ that died , yea rather , that is risen again , who is even at the right hand of God , who also maketh intercession for us .
translation.kha: Mano te , ki ban pynrem ïa ki ? Ym U Khrist Jisu , uba la ïap , lane , ïa uba la pynmihpat bad uba don ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , uba ïasaid bad u na ka bynta jong ngi!

translation.en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword , from the famine , and from the pestilence  ; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan shah katto katne ngut na ki ban lait im na ka thma , ka  nemsniew , bad na ki jingpang , khnang ba hangta hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kin sngewthuh haduh katno kiba ijli ki long ki jingleh jong ki bad kin pdiang ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: For enquire , I pray thee , of the former age , and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers :
translation.kha: Khmih shipor sha ka jingstad mynbarim ; pyrkhat ïa ki jingshisha ba ki kpa jong ngi ki la nang .

translation.en: Peter therefore went forth , and that other disciple , and came to the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Te u Petros bad uta uwei pat u synran ki la leit sha ka jingtep .

translation.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said , It is the man of God , who was disobedient unto the word of the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  hath delivered him unto the lion , which hath torn him , and slain him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake unto him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u ïohsngew ïa kata , u ong ,  Utai u dei u nongïathuhlypa uba la lyndet ïa ka hukum U  Trai . Bad kumta U  Trai  u phah ïa u sing uba la patar bad pynïap ïa u , kumba U  Trai  u la kren ha u .

translation.en: And it shall be , when thou art come in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and possessest it , and dwellest therein  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad phi la shong la sah hangta ,

translation.en: And her mother in law said unto her , Where hast thou gleaned to day ? and where wroughtest thou ? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee . And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought , and said , The man s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz .
translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka kylli ïa ka ,  Hangno phi ïohlum ïa kine baroh ? Ha ka lyngkha jongno phi ïoh trei ? To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u briew uba shem jingsngewbha ha phi !  Kumta ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka Naomi ba ka la trei ha ka lyngkha kaba dei jong u briew uba kyrteng u Boas .

translation.en: And the sons of Cush  ; Seba , and Havilah , and Sabtah , and Raamah , and Sabtecha : and the sons of Raamah  ; Sheba , and Dedan .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kush ki long ki briew jong ka Seba , ka Habilah , ka Sabtah , ka Raamah , bad ka Sabteka . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Raamah ki long ki briew jong ka Sheba , bad ka Dedan .

translation.en: Hear ye this , O priests  ; and hearken , ye house of Israel  ; and give ye ear , O house of the king  ; for judgment is toward you , because ye have been a snare on Mizpah , and a net spread upon Tabor .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki lyngdoh ! To pynleit jingmut , phi ki paid Israel ! To shahshkor , phi kiba na ka longïing u syiem ! La khmih lynti ïa phi ban bishar da ka hok — Kumta ka jingbishar kan wan hap ha phi ! Phi la long ka jingriam ha Mispah , ka jar ba la pynap ha u lum Tabor ,

translation.en: A good man sheweth favour , and lendeth : he will guide his affairs with discretion .
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba sbun ha ka jingairam jong u , uba pynïaid hok ïa ka kam khaïi jong u .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  My kingdom is not of this world : if my kingdom were of this world , then would my servants fight , that I should not be delivered to the Jews : but now is my kingdom not from hence .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Ka Hima jong nga kam long na ka jong kane ka pyrthei , lada ka hima jong nga ka la long na ka jong kane ka pyrthei , ki nongbud jong nga kin jin da la ïaleh ban ïada ïa nga na kaba aiti ha ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Em , ka hima jong nga kam long hangne !

translation.en: And when it was day , he called unto him his disciples : and of them he chose twelve , whom also he named apostles  ;
translation.kha: Haba ka la shai , u la khot ïa la ki synran sha u bad u la jied khat-ar ngut na ki , ïa kiba u la ai kyrteng , ki apostol :

translation.en: Turn you at my reproof : behold , I will pour out my spirit unto you , I will make known my words unto you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor haba nga mai tyngeh ïa phi ; ngan ai ïa phi ïa ki jinghikai kiba bha bad ngan ïathuh lang ïa ka jingtip jong nga bad phi .

translation.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly , he said unto him ,  Thou art not far from the kingdom of God .  And no man after that durst ask him any question .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi katno u la long uba stad ha ka jingjubab jong u , bad kumta U la ong ïa u ,  Mem long jngai na ka Hima U Blei .  Hadien kane , ym don shuh mano mano ba nud ban kylli kino kino ki jingkylli ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields , and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard , which kept the door of the king s house .
translation.kha: Ban buh bujli ïa ki , u syiem Rehoboam u thaw da ki stieh rnong bad u aiti ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop jong ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem–melech , and their men , to pray before the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Bethel ki la phah ïa u Shareser bad ïa u Regemmelekh bad ïa ki rangbah jong ki sha ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong U  Trai

translation.en: He shall glorify me : for he shall receive of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
translation.kha: Un ai burom ïa nga , namar un shim ïa kaei ba nga ong bad ïathuh ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the  Lord  smote Nabal , that he died .
translation.kha: Kumba hadien shiphew sngi , U  Trai  u shoh ïa u Nabal bad u la ïap .

translation.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land , and upon the isles of the sea .
translation.kha: U syiem Serksis u la pynlong ka jingpyntrei jubor ïa ki briew kiba ha ki rud duriaw jong ka hima jong u kumjuh ruh ïa kito ki briew kiba shong shapoh .

translation.en: And the men of Israel , beside Benjamin , were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword : all these were men of war .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki jait Israel ki ïalumlang saw lakh ngut ki shipai kiba tbit bha .

translation.en: But thanks be to God , which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you .
translation.kha: Katno ngi ainguh ïa U Blei ba u la pynlong ïa u Titos ban thrang kum ma ngi ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine , the  Lord  appeared to Abram , and said unto him , I am the Almighty God  ; walk before me , and be thou perfect .
translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la dap khyndaiphew khyndai snem ka rta , U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong ,  Nga long U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Kohnguh ïa nga bad ïai leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you  ; for thee , and for thy servant , and for thy maid , and for thy hired servant , and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee ,
translation.kha: Wat la ka khyndew ha kata ka snem ka sah shrah , kan pynmih jingbam hi ïa phi , ïa ki mraw jong phi , ïa ki nongbylla jong phi , ïa ki nongwei kiba shong bad phi ,

translation.en: And of the ten horns that were in his head , and of the other which came up , and before whom three fell  ; even of that horn that had eyes , and a mouth that spake very great things , whose look was more stout than his fellows .
translation.kha: Bad nga la kwah ban tip shaphang ki shiphew tylli ki reng halor ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka reng kaba la mih hadien bad kaba la pynhap ïa ki lai tylli ki reng . Ka la don ki khmat bad ka shyntur bad ka da kob sarong . Ka la kham ishyrkhei ban ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Yet they obeyed not , nor inclined their ear , but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart : therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant , which I commanded them to do  ; but they did them not .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor lane kohnguh . Pynban , uwei uwei baroh u ïai bteng ban long uba mutlop bad uba sniew kumba u ju long . Nga la hukum ïa ki ban bat ïa ka jutang , hynrei ki la kyntait . Kumta nga la wallam halor jong ki baroh ïa ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka .

translation.en: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us .
translation.kha: Nga sngew ba kaei kaba ngi shahshitom ha kane ka por kaba mynta , ym lah ban ïanujor satia bad ka burom ïa kaba yn sa pynpaw ha ngi .

translation.en: What shall we then say to these things ? If God be for us , who can be against us ?
translation.kha: Halor kane baroh , kaei kaba ngi lah ban ong ? Lada U Blei u long na ka bynta jong ngi , mano ba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi ?

translation.en: I will scatter them also among the heathen , whom neither they nor their fathers have known : and I will send a sword after them , till I have consumed them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïohsngew , bad ngan phah ki kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ki tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot khoit ïa ki .

translation.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you , and said , We will send men before us , and they shall search us out the land , and bring us word again by what way we must go up , and into what cities we shall come .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi ïawan sha nga , bad phi ïa-ong , ‘ To ngin ïaphah shuwa ïa ki rangbah ban leit syntiat ïa kata ka ri , khnang ba ki lah ban wan ïathuh ha ngi na kano ka lynti kaba biang eh ba ngin leit kiew bad kiba kumno ki jait shnong kiba don hangta .’

translation.en: After him repaired the Levites , Rehum the son of Bani . Next unto him repaired Hashabiah , the ruler of the half part of Keilah , in his part .
translation.kha: Kine ki Lebi ki tei pat ïa kiba bun ki bynta kiba bud jong ka kynroh : U Rehum u khun jong u Bani u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ; U Hashabaïah , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud na ka bynta ka distrik jong u ;

translation.en: That thou mayest love the  Lord  thy God , and that thou mayest obey his voice , and that thou mayest cleave unto him : for he is thy life , and the length of thy days : that thou mayest dwell in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give them .
translation.kha: To ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kohnguh bad ïaineh ha u ; te ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .

translation.en: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan , he divided their land to them by lot .
translation.kha: U la pynjot ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki jaitbynriew ha ka ri Kanaan bad u la pynlong ïa ki briew jong u ki trai jong ka ri .

translation.en: That this is a rebellious people , lying children , children that will not hear the law of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ki long borabor kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , kiba ïai shukor , kiba ïai kyntait ban shahshkor ïa ki jinghikai U  Trai .

translation.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries : and the land of Egypt shall not escape .
translation.kha: Haba u hiarthma ïa kito ki ri baroh , wat ïa ka Ijipt ruh yn ym ieh .

translation.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias , and saluted Elisabeth .
translation.kha: Ka la leit sha ka ïing jong u Sekharaïah bad ka la khublei ïa ka Elisabeth .

translation.en: Talk no more so exceeding proudly  ; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth : for the  Lord  is a God of knowledge , and by him actions are weighed .
translation.kha: Sngap noh na kaba kren kob ; sngap jar na kaba kren meng . Naba U  Trai  u long U Blei uba tip lut , bad u bishar ïa ki jingleh ki briew baroh .

translation.en: And Saul s uncle said unto him and to his servant , Whither went ye ? And he said , To seek the asses : and when we saw that they were no where , we came to Samuel .
translation.kha: U kñi jong u Saul u ïohi ïa u bad ïa uta u shakri , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïajah shano ?   Ngi ïaleit wad ïa ki kada ,  u Saul u jubab .  Ynda ngim lap ïa ki , ngi leit sha u Samuel .

translation.en: The king of Kedesh , one  ; the king of Jokneam of Carmel , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Kedesh , ka Jokneam ( ha Karmel ) ,

translation.en: But none saith , Where is God my maker , who giveth songs in the night  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei kim phai sha U Blei , u Nongthaw jong ki , uba ai jingkyrmen ïa ki ha ki kynta kiba dum .

translation.en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah , and will save them by the  Lord  their God , and will not save them by bow , nor by sword , nor by battle , by horses , nor by horsemen .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa ki briew ka Judah . Ma nga U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ngan pyllait im ïa ki ; hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata da ka thma — da ki waitlam lane ki ryntieh , bad ki khnam lane ki kulai bad ki shipai shong kulai .

translation.en: And when she had weaned him , she took him up with her , with three bullocks , and one ephah of flour , and a bottle of wine , and brought him unto the house of the  Lord  in Shiloh : and the child was young .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha Shiloh ryngkat bad uwei u masi uba dang lai snem , shiphew kilo u  purew , bad shi pla snieh ka waiñ . Ka ïalam ïa u Samuel , wat la u dang khynnah eh , sha ka ïing U  Trai  ha Shiloh .

translation.en: Unto me , who am less than the least of all saints , is this grace given , that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga long uba rit na kiba rit tam na ki briew jong U Blei baroh ; pynban , U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kabu ban ïalap sha ki Jentil ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingkynrei spah bymkut shuh jong U Khrist , bad ban pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban ïohi kumno ba la pyntreikam ïa ka jingthmu bamaïan U Blei .

translation.en: Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another , do ye so mock him ?
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u khmih bha ïa me , hato un shem kano kano kaba bha ? Hato me pyrkhat ba me lah ban shukor ïa U Blei kumba me shukor ïa ki briew ?

translation.en: Slay all her bullocks  ; let them go down to the slaughter : woe unto them ! for their day is come , the time of their visitation .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki shipai jong ki baroh ! Mait ïa ki ! Ki briew ka Babilonia ki la kordit ! Ka por ka la poi ïa ki ban shah pynshitom !

translation.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt , and died , he , and our fathers ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la leit sha Ijipt , ha kaba ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap .

translation.en: Yea , ye overwhelm the fatherless , and ye dig a pit for your friend .
translation.kha: Phi te phi nud ban kynting sbai ïa ki khunswet mraw bad pynlong riewspah ïa lade na ki paralok bajan tam eh .

translation.en: And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a second son .
translation.kha: Ka Silpah ka kha sa uwei pat u khun ïa u Jakob ,

translation.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh : but he received it not .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la pyrshang ban ai ïa u ïa ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka jingdih ba la khot ka mirr , hynrei U Jisu um dih ïa ka .

translation.en: And the liers in wait hasted , and rushed upon Gibeah  ; and the liers in wait drew themselves along , and smote all the city with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Kine ki rangbah ki mareh kloi sha pyrshah ka Gibeah ; ki phet sha baroh ki liang ka nongbah bad ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei baroh hangta .

translation.en: And this did she many days . But Paul , being grieved , turned and said to the spirit , I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her . And he came out the same hour .
translation.kha: Ka la leh ïa kane bun sngi , haduh ba u Paul u la sngew salia eh ba u la phai sawdong bad u la ong ha uta u mynsiem bymman ,  Ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist nga hukum ïa me ban mihnoh na ka !  Uta u mynsiem bymman u la mihnoh na ka ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .

translation.en: He , that being often reproved hardeneth his neck , shall suddenly be destroyed , and that without remedy .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïai mutlop man la ka por ba phi shah pynbeit , ha kawei ka sngi phin sa shah pynlwet bad phin ym lah khie shuh .

translation.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John , whose surname was Mark .
translation.kha: U Barnabas u la kwah ban ïalam ïa u Ïoannis Markos lem bad ki ,

translation.en: And they went after them unto Jordan : and , lo , all the way was full of garments and vessels , which the Syrians had cast away in their haste . And the messengers returned , and told the king .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki leit shaduh Jordan , bad baroh shi lynter lynti ki ïohi ïa ki jaiñkup bad ki tiar ki tar ba ki Syria ki la bret katba ki dang phet ïap . Nangta ki wan phai bad ki leit ïathuh ha u syiem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister s son , that he ran to meet him , and embraced him , and kissed him , and brought him to his house . And he told Laban all these things .
translation.kha: Ka leit bran bran ban ïathuh ha la u kpa ; bad haba u la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang u pyrsa jong u , u Jakob , mar mar u leit ban ïashem ïa u ; u la kdup bad u doh ïa u , bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ïing .

translation.en: In those days , while Mordecai sat in the king s gate , two of the king s chamberlains , Bigthan and Teresh , of those which kept the door , were wroth , and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Katba u Mordekai u dang long u nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem , u Bigthana bad u Teresh , kiba long ar ngut na ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ka khyrdop sha ki kamra u syiem , ki la shun ïa u syiem Serksis bad sylla ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And the children of Joseph said , The hill is not enough for us : and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both they who are of Beth–shean and her towns , and they who are of the valley of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ka ri lum kam biang ïa ngi ; hynrei ki Kanaan ha ki ri thor ki don ki kali ïapom da ka nar , na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha Beth Shan bad ïa ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ka bad na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha ka Them Jesreel .

translation.en: Know for a certainty that the  Lord  your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you  ; but they shall be snares and traps unto you , and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes , until ye perish from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
translation.kha: to tip skhem ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym beh shuh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Pynban , kin long ka jingmynsaw ïa phi kum ka shangkhawiah lane ka thliew bad kaba pang shikatdei eh kum ka jingsympat ha ka ingdong jong phi lane ki shiah ha ki khmat jong phi . Bad kane kan neh tad haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh napdeng jong phi uba dang lait im ha kane ka ri kaba bha ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses , your heavenly Father will also forgive you :
translation.kha: Namar lada phi map ïa kiwei ïa ki jingpalat kiba ki la leh ïa phi , U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un map ruh ïa phi .

translation.en: Thou hidest thy face , they are troubled : thou takest away their breath , they die , and return to their dust .
translation.kha: Haba me phai noh na ki , ki sheptieng , haba me pynphai noh ïa ka jingpyrsad jong me , ki ïap bad ki phai pat sha ka khyndew na kaba ki la wan .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go .  And when they were come out , they went into the herd of swine : and , behold , the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea , and perished in the waters .
translation.kha: Khie leit ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ; kumta ki la mihnoh bad ki la leit shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh kawei ka la mareh arsut ïa ka riat jong ka synrang shapoh ka duriaw bad ka la ïap jyllop .

translation.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us . God is love  ; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God , and God in him .
translation.kha: Bad ma ngi da lade ngi tip bad ngeit ïa ka jingieit kaba U Blei u don na ka bynta jong ngi . U Blei u long ka jingieit , bad uno uno uba im ha ka jingieit , u im bad U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .

translation.en: When Jesus was on earth , he always prayed to his Father , not to anyone else .
translation.kha: Por ba u Jisu u don ha ka pyrthei , manla ka-por u duwai ha la u Kpa , ym ha kiwei pat .

translation.en: Therefore said he unto them ,  The harvest truly is great , but the labourers are few : pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he would send forth labourers into his harvest .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Ka don ka jingot bakhraw , hynrei tang khyndiat ngut ki nongtrei ban ïalum ïa ka . To kyrpad ïa u trai jong ka jingot ba un phah ïa ki nongtrei ban lumlang ha ka jingot jong u .

translation.en: For do I now persuade men , or God ? or do I seek to please men ? for if I yet pleased men , I should not be the servant of Christ .
translation.kha: Hato kane ka i kumba nga pyrshang ban ïoh jingpynshisha na u briew ? Em , ym kumta! Kaei kaba nga kwah ka long ban pynshisha na U Blei! Hato nga pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki briew ? Lada nga dang long uba pyrshang ban leh kumta , ngam pat long u shakri U Khrist .

translation.en: And the night following the Lord stood by him , and said ,  Be of good cheer , Paul : for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem , so must thou bear witness also at Rome .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Trai u la ïeng hajan u Paul bad u la ong ,  Wat sheptieng ! Me la ai ka jingsakhi na ka bynta jong nga hangne ha Jerusalem , bad me dei ban leh kumjuh ruh ha Rom .

translation.en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain , and passed over Jordan , and went through all Bithron , and they came to Mahanaim .
translation.kha: U Abner bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka Them Jordan baroh shi miet ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan , bad hadien ba ki la ïaid baroh shi step ha ka step kaba bud , ki la wan poi biang ha Mahanaim .

translation.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee , which frameth mischief by a law ?
translation.kha: Mem don ei ei ban leh ïa ki nongsynshar bymhok , kiba pynlong ïa ka jingbymhok ban ksan ,

translation.en: Be ye angry , and sin not : let not the sun go down upon your wrath :
translation.kha: Lada phi bitar , wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong phi kan ïalam ïa phi ban leh pop , wat bitar sah baroh shi sngi .

translation.en: The first was like a lion , and had eagle s wings : I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked , and it was lifted up from the earth , and made stand upon the feet as a man , and a man s heart was given to it .
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u syriem kum u sing , hynrei u don ki thapniang kum u pukni . Katba nga dang khmih la pynkdiah ïa ki thapniang . Ïa u mradkhlaw la rah shajrong bad la pynlong ïa u ban ïeng kum u briew . Bad nangta la ai ha u ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kum u briew .

translation.en: Nay , much more those members of the body , which seem to be more feeble , are necessary :
translation.kha: Hynrei da khongpong , ngim lah ban leh ei ei khlem ki dkhot jong ka met kiba i kham tlot ;

translation.en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt , and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka jingpynshitom ka ban hap halor ka Ijipt bad ha baroh kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew lada kim rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: The  Lord  said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king , Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done ? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .
translation.kha: Mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Hato me la ïohi ïa kaei ba ka Israel , kata ka kynthei bymïaineh , ka la leh ? Ka la phai lyndet noh na nga , bad halor uwei pa uwei u lum bajrong bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ka la leh kum ka nuti .

translation.en: And he answering said unto him , Lord , let it alone this year also , till I shall dig about it , and dung it :
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongsumar kper u la jubab , ‘ Iehnoh shuwa , ko kynrad , sa tang shisnem ; ngan tih sawdong jong u bad ai sboh katto katne .

translation.en: And he that stealeth a man , and selleth him , or if he be found in his hand , he shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba rong tuh ïa u briew da kaba mut ban die mraw ne ban ri mraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work : only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way .
translation.kha: Ka Jingbymman Bamaïan ka la da trei , hynrei , kaei ka ban jia , kan ym jia tad ynda ïa uta uba bat ïa ka la weng noh na ka lynti .

translation.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver , and for an homer of barley , and an half homer of barley :
translation.kha: Kumta nga la siew khatsan lyngkhot ka rupa bad shispah sanphew kilo u barli ban thied ïa ka .

translation.en: Which say , It is not near  ; let us build houses : this city is the caldron , and we be the flesh .
translation.kha: Ki ong , ‘ Shen ngin tei pat ïa ki ïing . Ka nongbah ka long kum u khiew shet , bad ngi long kum ka doh hapoh jong u , hynrei la kumno kumno u la ïada ïa ngi na ka ding .’

translation.en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair  ; and they took them wives of all which they chose .
translation.kha: katto katne na ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng    ki la ïohi ba kine ki samla kynthei ki long kiba bhabriew , kumta ki la shim ïa kita kiba ki la mon .

translation.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the  Lord  , which is in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering , which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta un tah snam khyndiat ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan ka jingiwbih thang kaba hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . U dei ban theh ïa ka snam kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan ki jingkñia ainguh thang kiba don ha khmat jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And it came to pass , whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive , that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters , that they might conceive among the rods .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingri kiba kham khlaiñ ki ïa-pakor , u Jakob u buh ïa ki tnat dieng ha khmat jong ki ha ki shyngoid dih um , ba kin dup seng khun hapdeng kita ki tnat dieng .

translation.en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites , What shall I do for you ? and wherewith shall I make the atonement , that ye may bless the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u khot hajir ïa ki paid Gibeon bad u ong ha ki ,  Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ? Nga kwah ban pynbeit noh ïa ka jingbakla ïa kaba la leh ïa phi , khnang ba phin kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong U  Trai  ?

translation.en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord . But the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  was not yet laid .
translation.kha: Wat la ki briew kim pat shym la sdang ban tei biang ïa ka Templ , ki la sdang ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai bahynñiew ban thang ki jingkñia sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab : all these were the sons of Joktan .
translation.kha: ka Ophir , ka Habilah , bad ka Jobab . Kine baroh ki dei kiba hiarpateng na u Joktan .

translation.en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
translation.kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ïa phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma ki .

translation.en: Then answered they and said before the king , That Daniel , which is of the children of the captivity of Judah , regardeth not thee , O king , nor the decree that thou hast signed , but maketh his petition three times a day .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u syiem ,  U Daniel , uwei na kiba shah ringmraw na Judah , um shym burom ïa u Syiem Kynrad lane kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba phi la pynmih . U la duwai tista lai sien shi sngi .

translation.en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side  ; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate : the length thereof was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
translation.kha: Ki kamra ap phira lai tylli baroh arliang ka lynti ïaid , ki kynroh hapdeng jong ki , bad ka kamra rung baroh ki la don ki jingthew kiba katjuh kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Ka khyrdop baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .

translation.en: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward , and went down unto Arabah :
translation.kha: bad u ïaid lyngba na shatei jong ka sharing lum na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta u hiar arsut sha ka them ,

translation.en: And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: Mynta hangne , kane ka briew kaba hiarpateng na u Abraham ïa kaba u Soitan u la khum la khatphra snem ; hato ym dei ban pyllait ïa ka ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?

translation.en: And they sung a new song , saying , Thou art worthy to take the book , and to open the seals thereof : for thou wast slain , and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred , and tongue , and people , and nation  ;
translation.kha: Ki la rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai :  Me long uba dei hok ban shim ïa ka kot kli bad ban pynpait ïa ki jingpyndait jong ka . Naba la pynïap ïa me , bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong me me la siew kuna na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei na kawei pa kawei ka jait , ka jait ktien , ka hima bad ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And Peter said , Man , I know not what thou sayest . And immediately , while he yet spake , the cock crew .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ,  Ko rangbah , ngam sngewthuh shaphang kaei phi ïakren !  Kumta hi , katba u dang kren , u syiar u la kyn-ih .

translation.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness : and thou shalt know the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan bat ïa ka kular jong nga bad nga pynlong ïa pha ka jong nga , bad phan sa pdiang ïa nga kum U  Trai .

translation.en: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you : for morning by morning shall it pass over , by day and by night : and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report .
translation.kha: Kan shoh bad kan ïai shoh ïa phi , na kawei ka step sha kawei pat . Phin hap ban shah ïa ka bad sngi bad miet . Kawei pa kawei ka khubor thymmai na U Blei kan wanrah ïa ka jingshyrkhei bathymmai !

translation.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife  ; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife  ; and there I buried Leah .
translation.kha: Dei hangta ba ki la tep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka Sarah ka tnga jong u ; hangta ruh ki la tep ïa u Isaak bad ïa ka Rebekka ka tnga jong u ; bad dei hangta ba nga la tep ïa ka Leah .

translation.en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , and bound him in fetters , to carry him to Babylon .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah , u kem ïa u Jehoïakim , bad u ïalam ïa u sha Babilonia da kaba khum ha ki kynjri .

translation.en: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel : none went out , and none came in .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khyrdop Jerikho la khang khop bad la ap phira ban ym ïohrung ki Israel . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban rung shapoh lane mih shabar ka nongbah .

translation.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed , which do err from thy commandments .
translation.kha: Me sneng ïa kiba sarong ; kito ki bymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ki long kiba la tim .

translation.en: And David said on that day , Whosoever getteth up to the gutter , and smiteth the Jebusites , and the lame and the blind , that are hated of David s soul , he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said , The blind and the lame shall not come into the house .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi u Dabid u ong ha ki rangbah jong u ,  Hato don uno uno hangne uba isih ïa ki Jebus kumba isih ma nga ? Haduh katta kat ban pynïap ïa ki ? Te khie leit kiew lyngba ka nur-um bad tur ïaleh ïa kito ki bapli ki matlah bad ki dkoh .  ( Dei na kata ka daw ba la ong ,  Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh kim lah ban rung sha ka ïing ka jong U  Trai .  )

translation.en: Wherefore the law is holy , and the commandment holy , and just , and good .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ka Hukum hi ka long kaba khuid , bad ka jinghukum ka long kaba khuid , kaba dei bad kaba bha .

translation.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost .
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew u la wan ban wad bad ban pynim ïa kiba la jah noh .

translation.en: Are thy days as the days of man ? are thy years as man s days ,
translation.kha: Hato ka jingim jong me ka lyngkot kum ka jong ngi ?

translation.en: Then the steward said within himself , What shall I do ? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship : I cannot dig  ; to beg I am ashamed .
translation.kha: U shakri u la ong ha lade , ‘ U Kynrad jong nga un sa beh ïa nga na ka kam jong nga . Kaei ba ngan leh ? Ngam long uba khlaiñ ban tih kharai , bad nga sngewlehrain ban khrong .

translation.en: Am I a God at hand , saith the  Lord  , and not a God afar off ?
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba don ha ki jaka baroh bad ym tang ha kawei ka jaka .

translation.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ki kambah kiba kham phylla lyngba u Paul .

translation.en: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house , before the priest go into it to see the plague , that all that is in the house be not made unclean : and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un hukum ba dei ban pynmih lut napoh ïing ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh shuwa ba un leit khmih ïa kata ka jingbthuh ; lym kumta , yn pynbna ba baroh kaba don ha kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid . Nangta un sa leit rung shapoh ïing bad un khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .

translation.en: The  Lord  will be terrible unto them : for he will famish all the gods of the earth  ; and men shall worship him , every one from his place , even all the isles of the heathen .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshyrkhei ïa ki . Un pynhiar ïa ki blei jong ka pyrthei sha ka bym long ei ei , bad kumta kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kan mane ïa u , kawei kawei ha la ka jong ka ri .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph  ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him  ; for they were troubled at his presence .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha la u para ,  Nga dei u Joseph ! Shisha i pa i dang im ?  Ki hynmen shynrang jong u kim lait ang shuh , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh kat haduh ba kim lah ban jubab .

translation.en: Now therefore what is under thine hand ? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand , or what there is present .
translation.kha: Te nangta , phi don jingbam ei ei ? Ai ïa nga san tylli ki kpu ne kano kano kaba phi don .

translation.en: And I , behold , I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the  Lord  , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uta uba la jied ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me , ki Lebi , napdeng ki Israel kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa me . Ki , ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers , beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us .
translation.kha: Man ka por , nga ai jingbam ha ka miej jong nga ïa shispah sanphew ngut ki Jiw bad ki nongïalam jong ki , nalor ki briew kiba wan sha nga na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .

translation.en: And he said , He that shewed mercy on him . Then said Jesus unto him ,  Go , and do thou likewise .
translation.kha: U Nonghikai ka Hukum u la jubab ,  Uta uba la lehbha ïa u .  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Te , ma me khie leit bad leh kumjuh .

translation.en: This shall they have for their pride , because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno ki briew jong ka Moab bad ka Ammon kin shah pynshitom na ka bynta ka jingsarong bad jingmeng jong ki bad na ka bynta ka jingkrenbeiñ ïa ki briew jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls : for Joseph was in Egypt already .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kiba hiarpateng beit na u Jakob ki long baroh hynñiewphew ngut .    U khun jong u , u Joseph u la don lypa ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and laid before their faces all these words which the  Lord  commanded him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u wan hiar bad u la khot lang ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable , O man , whosoever thou art that judgest : for wherein thou judgest another , thou condemnest thyself ; for thou that judgest doest the same things .
translation.kha: Hato , ko paralok jong nga , phi bishar ïa kiwei pat ? Phim lah lait satia , lada phi long uei uei ruh . Namar haba phi bishar ïa kiwei bad nangta phi leh ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba ki leh , phi pynrem ïa lade .

translation.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha , ïa kaba dei ban pdiang pura bad ban ngeit .

translation.en: The field is the world  ; the good seed are the children of the kingdom  ; but the tares are the children of the wicked one  ;
translation.kha: ka lyngkha ka long ka pyrthei ; u symbai babha u long ki briew kiba long ki jong ka Hima ; ki ñiut ki long ki briew kiba long ki jong Uta u Basniew ;

translation.en: A time to kill , and a time to heal  ; a time to break down , and a time to build up  ;
translation.kha: ka por ban pynïap bad ka por ban pynkhiah , ka por ban pynkhyllem bad ka por ban tei .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived , that I lifted up mine eyes , and saw in a dream , and , behold , the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked , speckled , and grisled .
translation.kha: Ha ka aïom pakor nga la phohsniew , bad nga la ïohi ba ki  langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki long kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria bad kiba thohbroin .

translation.en: And they digged another well , and strove for that also : and he called the name of it Sitnah .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la ïatih ïa kawei pat ka pukri , bad hangta ruh la don ka jingïakajia shaphang jong ka , kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  Ka Jingïashun .

translation.en: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof : and the going up to it had eight steps .
translation.kha: Ka kamra rung ka long marpyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La oh-shrong ïa ki dieng Tlai halor ki kynroh baroh shi lynter ka lynti ïaid . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the sun did arise , that God prepared a vehement east wind  ; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah , that he fainted , and wished in himself to die , and said , It is better for me to die than to live .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka sngi ka la mih , U Blei u la phah ïa ka lyer mihngi kaba shit , bad u Jonah u la jan ïapler na ka jingshit jong ka sngi kaba shoh halor ka khlieh jong u . Kumta u la kwah ban ïap noh .  Ka kham bha ïa nga ban ïap noh ban ïa kaba im ,  u la ong .

translation.en: And unto the children of Gershon , of the families of the Levites , out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Beesh–terah with her suburbs  ; two cities .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki kynhun jong ki Lebi , ka kur Gershon , ka ïohpdiang ar tylli ki nongbah na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha Mihngi : ka Golan ha Bashan ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) bad ka Beeshterah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka jingkhuid ka dohnud bad ka jingkren badonburom , u syiem un long u paralok jong phi .

translation.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof , and spoons thereof , and covers thereof , and bowls thereof , to cover withal : of pure gold shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki pliang , ki khiew bad ki khuri ban pyndonkam ha ka jingainguh dih . Ïa kine baroh dei ban thaw da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , to be set by the four corners of it  ; even two rings upon the one side of it , and two rings upon the other side of it .
translation.kha: U thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong ka baroh saw tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: And another said , I have married a wife , and therefore I cannot come .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga dang shu shongkurim , bad na kata ka daw ngam lah ban wan .’

translation.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uta uba la lehbeiñ ïa uta uwei pat u la khynñiat sharud ïa u Moses . ‘ Mano ba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ u la kylli .

translation.en: But ye shall destroy their altars , break their images , and cut down their groves :
translation.kha: Pynban , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki , bad pom pynduh ïa ki shab jong ka Asherah , ka blei jong ki .

translation.en: And withal they learn to be idle , wandering about from house to house ; and not only idle , but tattlers also and busybodies , speaking things which they ought not .
translation.kha: Ki nang ruh ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa la ka por ha kaba kyntiap na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat ; hynrei kaba kham sniew , ki nang ban ïa-lorni bad pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por , da kaba ki kren ïa kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban kren .

translation.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters , or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters , no man is with us  ; see , God is witness betwixt me and thee .
translation.kha: U Laban u ong shuh shuh ,  Lada phi lehbeiñ ïa ki khun kynthei jong nga lane lada phi shongkurim ïa kiwei pat ki kynthei , wat la ngam lah ban tip shaphang kata , to kynmaw ba U Blei u khmih ïa ngi .

translation.en: The mountains quake at him , and the hills melt , and the earth is burned at his presence , yea , the world , and all that dwell therein .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki khynñiuh ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ; ki lumrit ki um noh ha khmat jong u . Ka pyrthei ka khih haba U  Trai  u mihpaw ; ka pyrthei bad ki briew jong ka baroh ki kyiuh .

translation.en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people , and they shall say , What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted ? let him go and return unto his house , lest his brethren s heart faint as well as his heart .
translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar kin ong ruh ha uta u paidïapom , ‘ Don mo hangne uba sheptieng bad uba rit mynsiem ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u pynsyier mynsiem ïa kiwei pat .’

translation.en: I and my Father are one .
translation.kha: U Kpa bad ma nga ngi long kawei .

translation.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease : for I was but a little displeased , and they helped forward the affliction .
translation.kha: bad nga bitar shikatdei eh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sngewkmen ïa ka jingjar jar bad ka jingsuk . Namar katba nga dang bat ïa ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ïa ki briew jong nga , kito ki jaitbynriew ki la kham pynsniew ïa ki jingshitom jong ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: Then the chief captain came near , and took him , and commanded him to be bound with two chains  ; and demanded who he was , and what he had done .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul , u la kem ïa u , bad u la hukum ban teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri . Nangta u la kylli ,  Uei une u briew , bad u la leh aïu ?

translation.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses , the tent , and all his furniture , his taches , his boards , his bars , and his pillars , and his sockets ,
translation.kha: Ki wallam sha u Moses ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka baroh , ïa ki bnoh jong ka , ïa ki jingker jong ka , ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka ;

translation.en: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him , whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin mane ïa u , lait noh ïa kito kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ha ka kitab jong kiba im kiba dei ki jong uta U Khunlangbrot ïa uba la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark  ; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki mawlyngkniap hapoh ka synduk , bad ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka .

translation.en: And he called the porters  ; and they told it to the king s house within .
translation.kha: Ki nongap khyrdop ki pynbna ïa kata ka khubor , bad la leit rah ïa ka sha ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines , he was afraid , and his heart greatly trembled .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Philistia , u la sngewsheptieng ,

translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel , See , the  Lord  hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah  ;
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki Israel ,  U  Trai  u la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u khun ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah .
