translation.en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat , Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth–gilead ? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , I am as thou art , my people as thy people , my horses as thy horses .
translation.kha: Bad u Ahab u kylli ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Phin leit lang bad nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Nga la kloi , haba phi la kloi ,  u Jehoshaphat u jubab  bad kumta ruh ki briew bad ki shipai bad ki shipai shong kulai jong nga ruh .

translation.en: But sin , taking occasion by the commandment , wrought in me all manner of concupiscence . For without the law sin was dead .
translation.kha: Hynrei da kata ka hukum , ka pop ka la ïoh ka lad ban pynkhih ïa baroh ki jait jingkwah khwan myntoi kiba ha nga . Ha bym don ka hukum , ka pop ka long kaei kaei kaba ïap .

translation.en: Then said I unto them , Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes , and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nga la bthah ïa ki ban bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba ki la ieit bad ban ym pynlong ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki blei ba-thala jong ka Ijipt , namar ba nga , nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , took either of them his censer , and put fire therein , and put incense thereon , and offered strange fire before the  Lord  , which he commanded them not .
translation.kha: U Nadab bad u Abihu , ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron , ki shim ïa la ki khiew thang jingiwbih , ki buh rnga ding ha ki , ki thang ïa ka jingiwbih hangta , bad ki kñia ainguh ïa ka ha U  Trai . Hynrei kane ka ding ka long ka bymkhuid , namar U  Trai  um shym la hukum ïa ki ban leh kumta .

translation.en: For he hath put all things under his feet . But when he saith all things are put under him , it is manifest that he is excepted which did put all things under him .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u .  Ka long kaba shai , da shisha , ba ki ktien  kiei kiei baroh  kim kynthup ïa U Blei hi , uba buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh U Khrist .

translation.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight , saying , No eye shall see me : and disguiseth his face .
translation.kha: Uba klim u ap ïa ka por janmiet ba kan wan ; u tap ïa la ka khmat khnang ban ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: And he shall take all his fat from him , and burn it upon the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta un shim ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh bad thang halor ka duwan .

translation.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking  ; and ye say , Behold a gluttonous man , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners !
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew u la wan , bad u la bam bad u la dih , bad phi la ong , ‘ Khmih ïa une u briew ! U long u lalot bad u nongbuaid , u paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait !’

translation.en: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood : and in thee they eat upon the mountains : in the midst of thee they commit lewdness .
translation.kha: Don na ki briew jong phi kiba ïathuh lamler shaphang kiwei khnang ban ïoh pynïap ïa ki . Don na ki , kiba bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ai ha ki bleithaw . Don kiba sngewhun borabor ha la ki jingkwah brai .

translation.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father , that he may eat , and that he may bless thee before his death .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban leit rah ïa ka sha i pa jong phi ba in bam bad in sa ai ïa phi ka jingkyrkhu jong i shuwa ba in ïap .

translation.en: If he cut off , and shut up , or gather together , then who can hinder him ?
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u kem ïa me bad u wallam ïa me sha ka jingbishar , uei uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u ?

translation.en: And when they heard that , they lifted up their voice to God with one accord , and said , Lord , thou art God , which hast made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all that in them is :
translation.kha: Haba ki riewngeit ki la ïohsngew ïa kata , baroh ki la ïasoh lang ha ka jingduwai sha U Blei :  Ko Kynrad bad ko Nongthaw ïa ka bneng , ka pyrthei , bad ka duriaw , bad ïa baroh kaba don ha ki !

translation.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .
translation.kha: Hynrei u pyllait ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki bad pynlong ïa ki longïing jong ki ban roi kum ki jingri .

translation.en: And Hadoram , and Uzal , and Diklah ,
translation.kha: ka Hadoram , ka Usal , ka Diklah ,

translation.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him , and gave it to David , and his garments , even to his sword , and to his bow , and to his girdle .
translation.kha: U law ïa ka jaiñkup ba u phong bad u ai ïa ka ha u Dabid , ryngkat bad ka jingkieng atiar jong u bad ruh ïa ka waitlam , ka ryntieh , bad u panpoh jong u .

translation.en: And when Jesus was come into Peter s house , he saw his wife s mother laid , and sick of a fever .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u Petros bad hangta u la ïohi ïa ka kiaw kurim u Petros ba ka thiah pang lem bad ka jingshit .

translation.en: ( Deuteronomy 32 :4  ; Job 12 :13  ; Isaiah 40 :26  ; 1 John 4 :8 ) The Bible tells us that he is also merciful , kind , forgiving , generous , and patient .
translation.kha: ( Deuteronomi 32 :4 ; Job 12 :13 ; Isaiah 40 :26 ; 1 Ioannis 4 :8 ) Ka Baibl ka ïathuh ruh ïa ngi , ba U Blei u long uba isynei , uba sbun , uba map ei , uba kylluid mynsiem , bad uba ïaishah slem .

translation.en: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law , and if thou turn unto the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .
translation.kha: hynrei phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai jong u . Phi dei ban phai sha u da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Rejoice not thou , whole Philistia , because the rod of him that smote thee is broken : for out of the serpent s root shall come forth a cockatrice , and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Philistia , u dieng uba la tied ïa phi u la kheiñ , hynrei phim don kano kano ka daw ban shadkmen . Haba uwei u bseiñ u ïap , uwei pat uba kham sniew u wan ha ka jaka jong u . Ka pylleng bseiñ ka pynmih ïa u Ïakjakor uba her .

translation.en: The people answered him , We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever : and how sayest thou ,  The Son of man must be lifted up ?  who is this Son of man ?
translation.kha: U paidbah u la jubab ,  Ka hukum jong ngi ka ïathuh ba U Messaïah un im junom . Kumno , te , me lah ban ong ba ka dei ïa U Khun U Briew ban kyntiew ? Uei une U Khun U Briew ?

translation.en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds  ; and the cloud is not rent under them .
translation.kha: U dei U Blei uba pyndap ïa ki lyoh da ka um bad u pynlong ïa ki ban ym bthei noh na ka jingkhia .

translation.en: Every one had four faces apiece , and every one four wings  ; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki durkhmat , saw tylli ki thapniang , bad kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti briew hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .

translation.en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar , he shall bring the live goat :
translation.kha: Ynda u Aaron u la lah pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , ïa kaba sah jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad ïa ka duwan , un ai sha U  Trai  ïa uta u  langsohmoh uba dang im uba la jied na ka bynta u Asasel .

translation.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean : but if he purify not himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade da ka um ka jingpynkhuid ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , te kin sa long kiba khuid . Hynrei lada kim pynkhuid ïa lade ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , kin ym long kiba khuid .

translation.en: And he knew their desolate palaces , and he laid waste their cities  ; and the land was desolate , and the fulness thereof , by the noise of his roaring .
translation.kha: U la pynjot ïa ki kut , u la pynpra ïa ki shnong . Ki briew jong ka ri ki la sngewshyrkhei man ka por ba u kyrhuh .

translation.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you , and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body s sake , which is the church :
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga kmen shaphang ki jingshahshitom jong nga na ka bynta jong phi , naba da ki jingshahshitom jong nga ha ka doh , nga ïarap ban pyndep ïa kaei kaba dang sah na ki jingshahshitom jong U Khrist na ka bynta ka balang , kaba long ka met jong u .

translation.en: My soul is weary of my life  ; I will leave my complaint upon myself  ; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul .
translation.kha: Nga la sngewthait ban im . To sngap ïa ki jingud kthang jong nga .

translation.en: Who can stand before his indignation ? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger ? his fury is poured out like fire , and the rocks are thrown down by him .
translation.kha: Haba u bitar , uei uba lah ban lait im ? Uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei jong u ? U theh noh ïa ka jingbitar bameh ding jong u ; ki mawsiang ki lko pum ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: And she went , and came , and gleaned in the field after the reapers : and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz , who was of the kindred of Elimelech .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ki lyngkha bad ka ïaid nadien jong ki nongot , ka da tam ïa u kew uba ki ieh . Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba ka don ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Boas .

translation.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it , and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed , receiveth blessing from God :
translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew kaba kjit noh ïa u slap uba hap bunsien ha ka bad kaba pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba ai jingmyntoi na ka bynta kita kiba rep ha ka .

translation.en: And many resorted unto him , and said , John did no miracle : but all things that John spake of this man were true .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew ki la wan sha u .  U Ïoannis um leh kambah ei ei ,  ki la ong ,  hynrei kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ong shaphang une u briew ka la long kaba shisha .

translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ruh ban ym leh klet ïa ki Lebi katba phi dang shong ha la ka ri .

translation.en: Six of their names on one stone , and the other six names of the rest on the other stone , according to their birth .
translation.kha: katba kum ka jinglong hynmen para jong ki , hynriew na ki kyrteng jong ki ha uwei u mawkordor bad hynriew ha uwei pat u mawkordor .

translation.en: He beholdeth all high things : he is a king over all the children of pride .
translation.kha: U peit ibeiñ wat ïa ki mrad kiba iphieng tam ; u long u syiem jong ki mradkhlaw baroh .

translation.en: Can the rush grow up without mire ? can the flag grow without water ?
translation.kha: Ki khah kim lah ban mih haba ym don um ; yn ym lah ban shem shabar ka jaka sngem .

translation.en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly , than to divide the spoil with the proud .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban long uba sngewrit bad sah duk ban ïa kaba long uba meng bad ïoh bynta na ka jinglute jong ki .

translation.en: And I will walk among you , and will be your God , and ye shall be my people .
translation.kha: Ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ngan long U Blei jong phi , bad phin long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the  Lord  : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him  ; he is unclean .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki ïailong ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid halor jong ki . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of David thy father , Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,
translation.kha: U Elijah u nongïathuhlypa u la phah shithi sha u Jehoram , kaba ong kumne harum :  U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Dabid , u kpa tymmen jong me , u pynrem ïa me , namar mem shym bud ïa ki nuksa u syiem Jehoshaphat , u kpa jong me lane ïa ka jong u syiem Asa , u kparad jong me .

translation.en: Wherefore , if God so clothe the grass of the field , which to day is , and to morrow is cast into the oven , shall he not much more clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangne mynta bad u bym don shuh lashai , uba la thang duh ha ka lawar ding . Hato un ym da la kham leh thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !

translation.en: If this man were not of God , he could do nothing .
translation.kha: Lymda une u briew u la wan na U Blei , un ym lah ban leh ïa kaba kum kane .

translation.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden , and the high arm shall be broken .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka sngi ka phyrnai eh ïa ki nongleh bymman , bad ka khanglad ïa ki na ki kam leh jubor .

translation.en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet , and wept as he went up , and had his head covered , and he went barefoot : and all the people that was with him covered every man his head , and they went up , weeping as they went up .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u leit shalor u Lum ki Olib da kaba ïam ; u ïaid da ka kjat suda bad u tap ïa la ka khlieh kum ka dak ka jingsngewsih . Baroh kiba bud ïa u ki la tap ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la ïam ruh .

translation.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said unto Joseph , I also was in my dream , and , behold , I had three white baskets on my head :
translation.kha: Haba u nongshet kpu rangbah u la ïohi ba kata ka jingbatai ïa ka jingphohsniew jong u nongrah khuri ka long kaba ai jinghun , u ong ha u Joseph ,  Nga ruh nga la phohsniew ; nga la kit lai tylli ki shang kpu halor ka khlieh jong nga .

translation.en: If I wait , the grave is mine house : I have made my bed in the darkness .
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka dei ka pyrthei kiba ïap , sha kaba ngan sa dem ban thiah ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats  ; one lot for the  Lord  , and the other lot for the scapegoat .
translation.kha: Hangta un kynting sbai da ki ar tylli ki maw , uwei na ka bynta U  Trai  bad uwei pat na ka bynta u Asasel .

translation.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away : and David rescued his two wives .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la pyllait im ïa baroh bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki Amalek ki la knieh kynthup ïa ki tnga jong u ar ngut .

translation.en: And the king of Egypt said unto them , Wherefore do ye , Moses and Aaron , let the people from their works ? get you unto your burdens .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Pharaoh u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Phi mut kumno da kaba pynlong ïa ki briew ban leh klet ïa la ki kam ? Ong ïa ki ban leit sha la ki kam ki kam !

translation.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the  Lord  , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa uta u masi lyngraw hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: For sin , taking occasion by the commandment , deceived me , and by it slew me .
translation.kha: Ka pop ka la ïoh ïa ka lad , bad da ka lad jong ka hukum , ka la shukor ïa nga bad ka la pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: Flee , save your lives , and be like the heath in the wilderness .
translation.kha: ‘ Pynkloi , phet ban lait im !’ ki ong . ‘ Mareh kum u kada khlaw ka ri shyiap !’

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the priests were come out of the holy place , that the cloud filled the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: Haba ki lyngdoh ki dang mih na ka Templ , kyndit kyndit la pyndap ïa ka da u lyoh ,

translation.en: Be it known unto you all , and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom ye crucified , whom God raised from the dead , even by him doth this man stand here before you whole .
translation.kha: te ma phi baroh phi dei ban tip , bad baroh ki paid Israel ki dei ban tip , ba une u briew u ïeng hangne ha khmat jong phi uba la khiah kran da ka bor jong ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth — ïa uba phi la sahnarphna bad ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city , and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword , and thy land shall be divided by line  ; and thou shalt die in a polluted land : and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko Amasaïah , U  Trai  u ong ïa me , ‘ Ka tnga jong me kan long ka nuti ha ki lynti bah , bad ïa ki khun jong me yn sa pynïap ha ka thma . Ïa ka khyndew jong me yn phiah bad sam ha kiwei pat ; bad me ïa lade men ïap ha ka ri bymngeit blei . Bad ki paid Israel da shisha kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’

translation.en: For it is better , if the will of God be so , that ye suffer for well doing , than for evil doing .
translation.kha: Naba ka kham bha ban shahshitom haba leh ïa kaba bha , lada kane shisha ka long ka mon U Blei , ban ïa kaba leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the  Lord  : and my prayer came in unto thee , into thine holy temple .
translation.kha: Haba nga la sngew kumba ka jingim jong nga ka la syntuid noh na nga , te , A  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad ha ka Templ bakhuid jong me , me la ïohsngew ïa nga .

translation.en: Howbeit I believed not their words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me : for thou exceedest the fame that I heard .
translation.kha: ngam shym la ngeit ïa kaei kaba ki ïathuh ïa nga tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi da lade hi . Ngam shym pat ïohsngew wat tang shiteng na ka jingstad jong phi . Phi kham stad shuh shuh ban ïa kaba ki briew ki ong .

translation.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the  Lord  as king instead of David his father , and prospered  ; and all Israel obeyed him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u kiew ïa ka khet u Dabid u kpa jong u ïa kaba U Blei U  Trai  u la seng . U la long u syiem uba jop , bad ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka la kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , they , and their princes , the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem : and this city shall remain for ever .
translation.kha: Nangta ki syiem bad ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki kin rung ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem bad kin don kajuh ka bor ba kynja syiem kaba u Dabid u la don . Ryngkat lem bad ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , kin shong ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai , bad ka nongbah Jerusalem kan ïai dap borabor da ki briew .

translation.en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead . As for Saul , he was yet in Gilgal , and all the people followed him trembling .
translation.kha: kiwei pat ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha ki ri Gad bad Gilead . U Saul u dang don ha Gilgal , bad ki briew kiba bad u ki la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: That they may believe that the  Lord  God of their fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath appeared unto thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Leh ïa kane ban pynshisha ha ki Israel ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , u la mihpaw ha me .

translation.kha: Ban ïoh jingmyntoi na ine i kot :

translation.en: Neither let the son of the stranger , that hath joined himself to the  Lord  , speak , saying , The  Lord  hath utterly separated me from his people : neither let the eunuch say , Behold , I am a dry tree .
translation.kha: U nongwei uba pynïasoh bad u paidlang jong U  Trai  um dei ban ong ,  U  Trai  un ym shah ïa nga ban mane bad ki briew jong u .  U briew ba la shah dab um dei ban pyrkhat namar ba um lah ban don khun , um lah ban don bynta lang bad ki paidlang U Blei .

translation.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering  ; the fat that covereth the inwards , and all the fat that is upon the inwards ,
translation.kha: Na uta u masi un shim noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki snier ,

translation.en: Or what king , going to make war against another king , sitteth not down first , and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand ?
translation.kha: Lada u syiem u mih bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ban ïaleh ïa uwei pat u syiem uba wan pyrshah ïa u lem bad arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah , nyngkong un shong bad rai la u long uba khlaiñ bha ban ïakynduh ïa uwei pat u syiem .

translation.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .
translation.kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew uba sarong bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba hangamei , uba sarong bad u bym ju kheiñ briew .

translation.en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah  ; they shall feed thereupon : in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening : for the  Lord  their God shall visit them , and turn away their captivity .
translation.kha: Ki paid ka Judah kiba lait im kin buhai ha ka ri jong phi . Kin pynbamphlang ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki hangta bad thiah hapoh ki ïing ka Ashkelon . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki un long lem bad ki bad un pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad u Aaron

translation.en: But while men slept , his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat , and went his way .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , haba baroh ki la ïohthiah , u nongshun u la wan bad u la bet ïa ki ñiut hapdeng u kew , bad u la leit noh .

translation.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass , and his foot also of brass , to wash withal : and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar , and thou shalt put water therein .
translation.kha: Shna kawei ka dabor rnong , kaba ka jingpynshong jong ka ruh dei da ka rnong . Buh ïa ka hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap um ïa ka .

translation.en: And the man that will do presumptuously , and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the  Lord  thy God , or unto the judge , even that man shall die : and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba nud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u nongbishar lane ïa u lyngdoh uba shakri ha kata ka por ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynkhuid ïa kata ka jingbymman na Israel .

translation.en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day  ; but have gone from tent to tent , and from one tabernacle to another .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam shym la shong ha ka templ ; nga la shong borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ bad kynriah na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat .

translation.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets , and of your young men for Nazarites . Is it not even thus , O ye children of Israel ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la jied katto katne na ki khun shynrang jong phi ban long ki nongïathuhlypa , bad katto katne na ki samla shynrang jong phi ban long ki Nasir . Hato kane kam long kaba shisha , ko ki paid Israel ? Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Zebudah , the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sebidah , ka khun u Pedaïah na ka shnong Rumah .

translation.en: Hear ye the word which the  Lord  speaketh unto you , O house of Israel :
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa ka khubor ba U  Trai  u don na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth , the noise of them that rejoice endeth , the joy of the harp ceaseth .
translation.kha: bad ka sur bakmen jong ki duitara bad ki ksing jong ki ka la duh noh .

translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him , and between all the people , and between the king , that they should be the  Lord s  people .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba pynlong ka jutang ba kin long ki briew jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice  ; it is because the thing is established by God , and God will shortly bring it to pass .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaiban ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phi ka mut ba ïa kane la pynskhem da U Blei bad ba un pynurlong shen ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he sat at the table with them , he took bread , and blessed it , and brake , and gave to them .
translation.kha: U la shong bam bad ki , u la shim ïa u kpu , bad u la duwai ; nangta u la kdiah ïa u kpu bad u la ai ïa u ha ki .

translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Many good works have I shewed you from my Father  ; for which of those works do ye stone me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la leh shibun ki kam babha ha khmat jong phi ïa kiba U Kpa u la ai ïa nga ban leh ; kano na kine ba phi kwah ban lynthem maw ïa nga ?

translation.en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and so blood be upon thee .
translation.kha: To leh ïa kane , ba ki briew kiba shida kin ym shah pynïap ei , bad kumta phin ym kit pop ba dei ma phi kiba la pynïap ïa ki ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u ai ha phi .

translation.en: And said unto them ,  It is written , My house shall be called the house of prayer  ; but ye have made it a den of thieves .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong nga yn khot ka ïing ka jingduwai .’ Hynrei phi pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh ïa ki nongtuh !

translation.en: We certify the king that , if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up , by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewskhem , namarkata , ba lada ïa kane ka nongbah la tei pat bad ba ïa ki kynroh la pyndep , ko Syiem , phin ym lah shuh ban pynïaid ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .

translation.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam , by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom :
translation.kha: Kiwei ki pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop , hynrei ïa la ki jong ngam ju buhrieh .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel , the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea : and it shall stop the noses of the passengers : and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude : and they shall call it The valley of Hamon–gog .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba kane baroh ka jia , ngan ai ïa u Gog ka jaka tep hangta ha Israel , ha ka them ki nongleit jingleit , shaphang mihngi ka Duriaw Baïap ; hangta yn tep ïa u Gog bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ïa ka them yn khot ïa ka , ‘ Ka them ka kynhun shipai u Gog .’

translation.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof .
translation.kha: Haba u byrthen ïa ki rishot kiba bat ïa ka suiñbneng , ki khih bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword , destroying it utterly , and all that is therein , and the cattle thereof , with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: pynïap lut khoit ïa ki briew baroh ha kata ka shnong bad ïa ki jingri jong ki baroh ruh . Pynjot de thiaw ïa kata ka shnong .

translation.en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal : and there was a dearth in the land  ; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him : and he said unto his servant , Set on the great pot , and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets .
translation.kha: Shisien , haba la don ka  nemsniew ha kylleng ka ri , u Elisha u la leit phai sha Gilgal . Katba u dang hikai ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa , u la ong ïa u shakri jong u ban tiew ïa u khiew uba heh ha ding bad shet syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God , and he shall go no more out : and I will write upon him the name of my God , and the name of the city of my God , which is new Jerusalem , which cometh down out of heaven from my God : and I will write upon him my new name .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa uta uba jop , u rijied ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong nga , bad un ïailong hangta . Ngan thoh halor jong u ïa ka kyrteng U Blei jong nga bad ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah jong U Blei jong nga , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , ka ban wan hiar na bneng na U Blei jong nga . Ngan thoh ruh halor jong u ïa ka kyrteng bathymmai jong nga .

translation.en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin shah pynïap kylleng , bad kito kiba lait im kin sa sngewthuh ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: That he would grant unto us , that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear ,
translation.kha: Da ka jingsmai kyntang ha u Abraham u kpa tymmen jong ngi u la kular ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi bad shah ïa ngi ban shakri ïa u khlem jingsheptieng ,

translation.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast , when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u paidbah byllien uba la wan sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And his men that were with him did David bring up , every man with his household : and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ruh ïa la ki briew bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki , bad ki la shongduh ha ki nongrit sawdong ïa ka Hebron .

translation.en: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul , and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah , from Dan even to Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kular ha u Dabid ba un shim noh ïa ka hima na u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u , bad un thung ïa u Dabid kum u syiem jong ki Israel bad ki Judah , naduh na kawei ka tduh sha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka ri . Mynta to U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pynurlong shisha ïa kane !

translation.en: I saw the film last week .
translation.kha: Nga Iohi ia ka film mynshem taiew .

translation.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron , Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly , and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died , for the blood of Asahel his brother .
translation.kha: Haba u Abner u la wan poi ha Hebron , u Joab u ïalam ïa u kham sharud ha ka khyrdop , kumba u kwah ban ïakren jar jar bad u , bad hangta u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh . Bad kumta la pynïap ïa u Abner namar ba u la pynïap ïa u Asahel , u para u Joab .

translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  , ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , baroh ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei , ïaroh ïa ka burom bad ka bor jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the third month , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba lai jong ka snem kaba khatwei ha ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: But Christ as a son over his own house  ; whose house are we , if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end .
translation.kha: Hynrei , U Khrist u long uba lah ban shaniah kum U Khun uba dei peit ïa ka ïing U Blei . Ngi long ka ïing jong u lada ngi ïaineh ha ka jingshlur bad ngi long skhem ha kaei kaba ngi kyrmen .

translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U Blei u ong ha u Nathan ,

translation.en: Saying , The Lord is risen indeed , and hath appeared to Simon .
translation.kha: U Trai u la mihpat da shisha ! U la paw ha u Simon !

translation.en: Let the heavens be glad , and let the earth rejoice : and let men say among the nations , The  Lord  reigneth .
translation.kha: To kmen , ko pyrthei bad sahit bneng ! Ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  u long u syiem .

translation.en: Fear not , thou worm Jacob , and ye men of Israel  ; I will help thee , saith the  Lord  , and thy redeemer , the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Uba rit bad uba tlot kumba me long , ko Israel , wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me . Nga , U Blei uba khuid ki Israel , nga long uta uba pynim ïa me .

translation.en: But glory , honour , and peace , to every man that worketh good , to the Jew first , and also to the Gentile :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un ai ka burom , ka nam babha bad ka jingsuk ïa baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba bha , ïa ki Jiw nyngkong bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife : and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction .
translation.kha: Ban sngewtynnat ïa ka pop ka long ban sngewtynnat ban thaw jingkulmar . Lada phi kob man ka por , phi pan kwah ïa ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: If ye will fear the  Lord  , and serve him , and obey his voice , and not rebel against the commandment of the  Lord  , then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the  Lord  your God :
translation.kha: Lada phi tiengburom ïa U  Trai  , phi shakri ïa u , phi shahshkor ïa u , bad phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , bad lada ma phi bad u syiem uba synshar ïa phi , phi bud ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , baroh kan manbha bad phi .

translation.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner :
translation.kha: Nangta uta u rangbah ai hukum u la thoh ïa ka shithi kumne :

translation.en: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise : and another shall rise after them  ; and he shall be diverse from the first , and he shall subdue three kings .
translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng ki long ki shiphew ngut ki syiem ki ban synshar ïa kata ka hima . Nangta sa uwei pat u syiem un mihpaw ; un long uba pher bak lbak ïa kiba mynshuwa bad un pynkhyllem ïa ki lai ngut ki syiem .

translation.en: I will walk before the  Lord  in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la ïaid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai ha ka pyrthei jong kiba im .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter , till they were consumed , that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities .
translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jong ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa ki , wat la katto katne ki ïohlad ban shem jaka lait im hapoh ki kynroh shnong bad ba ki khlem shah pynïap .

translation.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter , to cause her to be a whore  ; lest the land fall to whoredom , and the land become full of wickedness .
translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la ki khun kynthei da kaba pynlong nuti ïa ki ha ki jaka mane bleithaw ; lada phi leh kumta , phin phai noh sha kiwei ki blei bad ka ri kan jyllei da ka jingjyrsieh .

translation.en: Nevertheless they were disobedient , and rebelled against thee , and cast thy law behind their backs , and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee , and they wrought great provocations .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong me ki ïaleh pyrshah bad leh bymkohnguh ïa me ; ki phai dien noh na ka Hukum jong me . Ki pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba maham ïa ki ,

translation.en: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod , and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba ïakhleh jaitbynriew kin shong kin sah ha Ashdod . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pyndem lut ïa kine ki Philistia kiba sarong .

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  of hosts came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah :

translation.en: Is it not wheat harvest to day ? I will call unto the  Lord  , and he shall send thunder and rain  ; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great , which ye have done in the sight of the  Lord  , in asking you a king .
translation.kha: Mynta ka dei ka aïom rang ryngkhiang , ym dei ? Hynrei ngan duwai , bad U  Trai  un phah ïa u pyrthat bad u slap . Haba kane ka wan jia , phin sa sngewthuh haduh katno phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynba phi pan syiem na u .

translation.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation , that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble , by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God .
translation.kha: U ïarap ïa ngi ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïarap ïa kiwei kiba don ki jingjynjar babun jait , da kaba pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka lad jingïarap kaba ngi hi ngi la ïohpdiang na U Blei .

translation.en: For it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will break his yoke from off thy neck , and will burst thy bonds , and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong :  Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba don sawdong ka ryndang jong ki bad ngan weng ïa ki kynjri jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ki nongwei .

translation.en: But God raised him from the dead :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap ,

translation.en: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and went northward , and said unto Jephthah , Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon , and didst not call us to go with thee ? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah Ephraim ki khreh ban ïaleh thma ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha Saphon bad ki ong ha u Jephthah ,  Balei phi leit ïaleh ïa ki Ammon khlem da khot lem ïa ngi ban leit lang bad phi ? Ngin thang im ïa me hapoh ïing !

translation.en: Also he sent forth a dove from him , to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground  ;
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Noah u la pyllait ïa ka paro ban tip la kata ka um ka la rngad ne em , hynrei namar ba ka um ka dang tap ïa ka khyndew , kata ka paro kam shym lap jaka ban dem .

translation.en: For if I be an offender , or have committed any thing worthy of death , I refuse not to die : but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me , no man may deliver me unto them . I appeal unto Caesar .
translation.kha: Lada nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum bad leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynrem da ka jingïap , ngam kyrpad ban lait na ka . Hynrei lada ym don ka jingshisha ha ki jingmudui ïa kiba ki wallam pyrshah ïa nga , ym don uno uno uba lah ban aiti ïa nga sha ki . Nga apil sha u Patsha .

translation.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart , when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments .
translation.kha: Kumba nga la ïoh jinghikai ïa ki jingbishar bahok jong me , ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka dohnud kaba sngur .

translation.en: A wise man s heart is at his right hand  ; but a fool s heart at his left .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba ju long ba u briew uba stad u leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad uba bieit u leh ïa ka bymdei .

translation.en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith : as it is written , The just shall live by faith .
translation.kha: Naba ka Gospel ka pynpaw kumno U Blei u pynlong ïa ki briew ban don ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U hi : Ka long lyngba ka jingngeit naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U briew uba beit bad U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .

translation.en: But whosoever shall deny me before men , him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , ngan kyntait ïa u ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

translation.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth : his word runneth very swiftly .
translation.kha: U ai hukum ïa ka pyrthei , bad ïa kaei kaba u ong la leh kloi .

translation.en: Whereof I was made a minister , according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power .
translation.kha: Ïa nga keiñ la pynlong u shakri jong kata ka gospel da ka jingai bakyrpang U Blei , kaba u la ai ha nga lyngba ka jingtrei ka bor jong u .

translation.en: Now there were men lying in wait , abiding with her in the chamber . And she said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he brake the withs , as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire . So his strength was not known .
translation.kha: Ka la pynbeit ban don katto katne ki rangbah ha kawei pat ka kamra , kumta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  Hynrei u bthat ïa kita ki  saisiej kumba dkut u  saihon haba dei ding . Kumta kim shym tip satia ïa kaba rieh ka borbah jong u .

translation.en: And the angel said unto her , Fear not , Mary : for thou hast found favour with God .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ha ka ,  To wat sheptieng , ko Mari ; U Blei u la sngewbha ïa pha .

translation.en: No servant can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other  ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .
translation.kha: Ym don u shakri uba lah ban long u mraw jong ki ar ngut ki kynrad ; un isih ïa uwei bad un ieit ïa uwei pat ; un kohnguh ïa uwei bad un ñiewbeiñ ïa uwei pat . Phim lah ban shakri ïa U Blei bad ïa ka spah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Get thee up  ; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ïeng joit ! Balei me dem sah kumne ha khyndew ?

translation.en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets , and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals , to praise the  Lord  , after the ordinance of David king of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah ki la sdang ban tei ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ , ki lyngdoh ha ki jingriam jong ki , ki ïeng ha la ki jaka bad ki turoi ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki Lebi jong ka kur Asaph ki ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki shakuriaw . Ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  kat kum ki jingbthah ba la ai pateng naduh ka por u syiem Dabid .

translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  thy God would not hearken unto Balaam  ; but the  Lord  thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee , because the  Lord  thy God loved thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym sngap ïa u Balaam ; u pynkylla pynban ïa kata ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu , namar ba u ieit ïa phi .

translation.en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day , that Pharaoh should have the fifth part  ; except the land of the priests only , which became not Pharaoh s .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u shna ïa ka aiñ kaba ïadei bad ka khyndew ha ri Ijipt ba kaba shi bynta na ka san bynta na ka jinglum ha ka aïom ot kan long ka jong u syiem . Kane ka aiñ ka dang neh haduh kane ka sngi . Tang ka khyndew jong ki lyngdoh te kam shym kylla long ka jong u syiem .

translation.en: And I said unto you , I am the  Lord  your God  ; fear not the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but ye have not obeyed my voice .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ha phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ba phim dei ban mane ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , ha ka ri jong ki ba phi ïashong mynta . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: The lion s whelps have not trodden it , nor the fierce lion passed by it .
translation.kha: Ym don sing lane uno uno u mrad bashyrkhei uba ïaid ïa kita ki lynti bakynjah .

translation.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban , Because I was afraid : for I said , Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nga la sheptieng , namar nga pyrkhat ïoh phin knieh jubor ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi na nga .

translation.en: Son of man , there were two women , the daughters of one mother :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  la don shisien ar ngut ki kynthei kiba shi para .

translation.en: And they received of Moses all the offering , which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary , to make it withal . And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohpdiang na u ïa kita ki jingai baroh ba ki Israel ki la wallam na ka bynta ban tei ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang . Hynrei ki Israel ki nang ïai wallam sha u Moses ïa ki jingainguh jong ki man ka step .

translation.en: So the messenger went , and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u nonglamktien u la leit sha u Dabid bad u la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la hukum ïa u ban ong .

translation.en: And he asked for a writing table , and wrote , saying , His name is John . And they marvelled all .
translation.kha: U Sekharaïah u la pan ïa ka kynja sleit bad u la thoh ,  Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Ïoannis .  A katno baroh ki la ïasngew kyndit !

translation.en: They are terrible and dreadful : their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves .
translation.kha: Ki wallam ïa ka jingtieng bad jingpyntriem , bad ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki shim ïa ka aiñ ha lade .

translation.en: For the  Lord  shall rise up as in mount Perazim , he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon , that he may do his work , his strange work  ; and bring to pass his act , his strange act .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïaleh kumba u la leh ha u lum Perasim bad ha ka them Gibeon , khnang ba un leh ïa kaei kaba u thmu ban leh — wat la ki jingleh jong u kin long kum kiba ikhyllah . Un pyndep ïa ka kam jong u baroh , ka kam bamaïan jong u .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: For his princes were at Zoan , and his ambassadors came to Hanes .
translation.kha: Wat la ki nongkit  tiensyiem jong ki , ki la lah poi lypa ha ki nongbah ka Ijipt , ka Soan bad ka Hanes ,

translation.en: And , behold , ye are risen up in your fathers  stead , an increase of sinful men , to augment yet the fierce anger of the  Lord  toward Israel .
translation.kha: Bad mynta phi la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ka pateng bynriew bathymmai jong ki riewbymman kaba kloi ban pynwan biang ïa ka jingbitar kaba shyrkhei jong U  Trai  halor ki Israel sa shisien pat !

translation.en: Hear my words , O ye wise men  ; and give ear unto me , ye that have knowledge .
translation.kha: Phi ki rangbah phi long kiba da stad , kiba sian bha , to shahshkor mynta ïa kaei kaba nga ong .

translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come before him : worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom U  Trai  ; wallam ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u . To dem ha khmat Uba Khuid haba u wanpaw ;

translation.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain  ; for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
translation.kha: Wat pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na ka bynta ki jingthmu kiba sniew , naba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream , saying , Jacob : And I said , Here am I .
translation.kha: U angel U Blei u la kren ïa nga ha ka jingphohsniew bad u ong , ‘ Jakob !’ ‘ Oi’ nga la jubab .

translation.en: I am that bread of life .
translation.kha: Nga long u kpu ka jingim .

translation.en: Let me win . But if I cannot win , let me be brave in the attempt .
translation.kha: Ai ngan jop . Hynrei lada ngam lah jop , ai ngan long shlur ha ka jingpyrshang .

translation.en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word .
translation.kha: Kita ki riewngeit ïa kiba la pynsakma ki la leit kylleng , ki da ïalap ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: But Peter said , Ananias , why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost , and to keep back part of the price of the land ?
translation.kha: U Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ko Ananias , balei me la shah ïa u Soitan ban bat synshar ïa me bad pynlong ïa me ban lamler ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid da kaba bat noh katto katne ka pisa kaba me la ïohpdiang na kaba die ïa ka jaka ?

translation.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame , and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren .
translation.kha: U shakri uba sian un ïoh long khlieh halor u khun bymlarkam jong u kynrad bad ïohpdiang shi bynta na ka jingïohpateng .

translation.en: And I knew that thou hearest me always : but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba me shahshkor ïa nga borabor , hynrei nga ong ïa kane na ka bynta u paidbah hangne , ba kumta kin ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And said unto the children of Israel , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought up Israel out of Egypt , and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all kingdoms , and of them that oppressed you :
translation.kha: bad u ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Nga la wan ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt bad nga la pyllait ïa phi na ki nong Ijipt bad na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew kiba la pynshitom beiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: But he said ,  Yea rather , blessed are they that hear the word of God , and keep it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Pynban , katno kaba kmen long kito kiba shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka !

translation.en: Reprobate silver shall men call them , because the  Lord  hath rejected them .
translation.kha: Yn khot ïa ki , ka eitnar bymdondor , namar ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kyntait ïa ki .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia ban pyndkut noh ïa ka spah jong ka Ijipt .

translation.en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia : Grace be unto you , and peace , from him which is , and which was , and which is to come  ; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne  ;
translation.kha: Na u Ïoannis sha ki hynñiew tylli ki balang ha ka probins    jong ka Asia : Ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ïa phi na U Blei , uba long , uba la long bad u ban sa wan , bad na ki hynñiew ki mynsiem kiba ha khmat ka khet jong u ,

translation.en: And when forty years were expired , there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki sawphew snem ki la ïaid , u angel u la paw ha u Moses ha ki thylliej ding jong ka  lawlynnong kaba ing hajan u lum Sinai .

translation.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth , and shall be turned unto fables .
translation.kha: Kin phai noh na kaba shahshkor ïa ka jingshisha bad kin pynleit jingmut ha ki puriskam kai .

translation.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle , and her hands hold the distaff .
translation.kha: Ka thir hi ïa la u ksai , bad ka thain hi ïa la ka jaiñ .

translation.en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren , and dwelt in the land of Tob : and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah , and went out with him .
translation.kha: U Jephthah u phet na la ki hynmen bad u leit shong ha ri Tob . Hangta shi kynhun ki nongkamsniew ki ïapynlong paralok bad u , bad ki leit lang kylleng lem bad u .

translation.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation .
translation.kha: Naba ka long da ka jingngeit jong ngi ba ngi don ka jingïadei bad U Blei ; ka long da ka jingphla jong ngi ba ïa ngi la pynim .

translation.en: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours : from the wilderness and Lebanon , from the river , the river Euphrates , even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew baroh ha kaba phin ïuhkjat kan long ka jong phi . Ka ri jong phi kan ïar naduh ka ri shyiap shaphang shathie haduh ki lum Lebanon shaphang shatei , bad naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shaphang mihngi haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: And I will bring distress upon men , that they shall walk like blind men , because they have sinned against the  Lord  : and their blood shall be poured out as dust , and their flesh as the dung .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan wallam ïa ki jingpynjot kiba kum kine ha u bynriew ba uwei uwei baroh un tare shane shatai kum u briew bamatlah . Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad mynta ïa ka snam jong ki yn theh noh kum ka um , bad ki metïap jong ki kin pyut ha khyndew .

translation.en: And the rulers knew not whither I went , or what I did  ; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews , nor to the priests , nor to the nobles , nor to the rulers , nor to the rest that did the work .
translation.kha: Ym don na kino kino ki rangbah synshar kiba na kata ka jaka kiba la tip shano ba nga la leit bad kaei kaba nga la leh . Haduh kata ka por , ngam pat shym la ong ei ei ïano ïano ruh na ka para Jiw jong nga — ki lyngdoh , ki nongïalam , ki rangbah synshar , lane mano mano ruh u ban ïashim bynta ha ka kam .

translation.en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king s commandment by his chamberlains : therefore was the king very wroth , and his anger burned in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki shakri ki la ïathuh ïa ka hukum u syiem ha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ka la kyntait ban wan . Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u syiem .

translation.en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another  ; but thou shalt fear thy God : for I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa la u para Israel , hynrei kohnguh ïa U  Trai  uba U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him : for there went virtue out of him , and healed them all .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la pyrshang ban ktah ïa u , naba ka bor ka la mih na u bad ka da pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: So Joshua took all that land , the hills , and all the south country , and all the land of Goshen , and the valley , and the plain , and the mountain of Israel , and the valley of the same  ;
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa ka ri baroh — ka ri lum bad ki kjat lum , ïa kaba shatei bad shathie , ka jaka jong ka Goshen baroh , bad ki ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang shathie jong ka , kumjuh ruh ïa ka Them Jordan .

translation.en: But we see Jesus , who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death , crowned with glory and honour  ; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi da ïohi ïa U Jisu , ïa uba la pynlong shipor kham hapoh ban ïa ki angel , kumta ba lyngba ka jingaiei ka jong U Blei , u dei ban shahïap na ka bynta uwei pa uwei baroh . Mynta ngi ïohi ïa u , ba la pynphong pansngiat da ka burom bad da ka jingpyndonburom namar ka jingïap kaba u la shah .

translation.en: But Paul said unto them , They have beaten us openly uncondemned , being Romans , and have cast us into prison  ; and now do they thrust us out privily ? nay verily  ; but let them come themselves and fetch us out .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Ym shym la shem ïa ngi kiba la shah pynrem na kano kano ka kam runar , pynban ki la sympat ïa ngi ha khmat u paidbah — bad ngi dei ki traishnong ka Hima Rom ! Nangta ki la thep ïa ngi sha ka byndi , bad mynta ki kwah ban phah noh jar jar ïa ngi . Ka bym lah long ! Ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom ki dei ban wan hi da lade hangne bad pyllait ïa ngi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the  Lord  to gaze , and many of them perish .
translation.kha: U Moses u leit , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit hiar bad maham ïa ki briew ban ym jam ïa u pud ban wan khmih ïa nga ; lada ki leh kumta , bun na ki kin ïap .

translation.en: As he did to the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , when he destroyed the Horims from before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead even unto this day :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la leh kumjuh na ka bynta ki Edom , ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , kiba shong ha ri lum Edom . U pynjot ïa ki Hor , kumta ki Edom ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shongsah hangta haduh mynta .

translation.en: That hath taken off his hand from the poor , that hath not received usury nor increase , hath executed my judgments , hath walked in my statutes  ; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father , he shall surely live .
translation.kha: U kyntait ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad um ju ai pisa kylliang ban ïohnong . U sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Un ym ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong u kpa jong u , hynrei un im da shisha .

translation.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer : now the  Lord  will feed them as a lamb in a large place .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long mutlop kum ki khashor . Kumno ngan bsa ïa ki kum ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang ?

translation.en: Who died for us , that , whether we wake or sleep , we should live together with him .
translation.kha: uba la ïap na ka bynta jong ngi khnang ba ngi lah ban ïa-im lem bad u , la ngi im lane ngi ïap haba u wan .

translation.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom  ; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake which I have chosen .
translation.kha: Bad ngan ym shim na u ïa ka hima baroh kawei , pynban ngan ai ha u ïa kawei ka jait na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la pynlong ka jong nga .

translation.en: And I will stretch out my hand , and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof : and after that he will let you go .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyn-i ïa la ka bor bad ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri Ijipt da kaba leh hangta ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei . Hadien kata un sa shah ba phin leit .

translation.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .
translation.kha: U Asa u syiem Judah bad u Baasha u syiem Israel ki don borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma hapdeng jong ki katba ki dang don ha ka bor .

translation.en: And the incense altar , and his staves , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan thang jingiwbih bad ki jingbah ïa ka ; ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ; ïa ka jingiwbih ; ïa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ;

translation.en: And this man shall be the peace , when the Assyrian shall come into our land : and when he shall tread in our palaces , then shall we raise against him seven shepherds , and eight principal men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Assyria ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi bad tur lyngba ki jingïada jong ngi , ngin phah ïa ki nongïalam bakhlaiñ tam ban ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob : then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph , which was of the sons of the giant .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , la don ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , ha kaba u Sibbekai uba na Hushah u la pynïap ïa u ramhah uba kyrteng u Saph .

translation.en: Nicodemus saith unto them , ( he that came to Jesus by night , being one of them , )
translation.kha: Uwei na ki Pharisi hangta u dei u Nikodemos , u briew uba la leit mynshuwa ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eloi , Eloi , lama sabachthani ?  which is , being interpreted ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
translation.kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,   Eloi , Eloi , lema sabakhthani ?   kaba mut ,  A Blei jong nga , A Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?

translation.en: And let them make haste , and take up a wailing for us , that our eyes may run down with tears , and our eyelids gush out with waters .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ong ,  Ïathuh ïa ki ban pynkloi bad rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong ngi , tad haduh ba ki khmat jong ngi kin dap da ki ummat , bad ba ki irmat jong ngi ki jhieh na kaba ïam .

translation.en: And if any mischief follow , then thou shalt give life for life ,
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka kynthei ka mynsaw , ka jingpynshitom ka dei ban long ka jingim namar ka jingim ,

translation.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge .
translation.kha: U long u shabi uba plie ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ba la buhrieh jong ka jingstad bad ka jingtip U Blei .

translation.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about  ; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about .
translation.kha: U shna ïa ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong jong ka , bad u pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .

translation.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .
translation.kha: U Hadad u ïoh ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad u syiem u ai ïa ka para kynsi , ka para jong ka Syiem Tahpenes ha u Hadad ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit bad u .

translation.en: So he brought down the people unto the water : and the  Lord  said unto Gideon , Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue , as a dog lappeth , him shalt thou set by himself  ; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ïalam ïa kita ki briew sha um , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Pynkhlad ïa uwei pa uwei uba jliah ïa ka um da la u thylliej kum u ksew , na uwei pa uwei uba dem khohsiew ban dih um .

translation.en: So Gad came to David , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Choose thee
translation.kha: U Gad u la leit sha U Dabid , u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano men jied ?

translation.en: Art thou better than populous No , that was situate among the rivers , that had the waters round about it , whose rampart was the sea , and her wall was from the sea ?
translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , hato pha kham bha ban ïa ka Thebes , ka nongbah jong ka Ijipt ? Ma ka ruh ka la don ka wah ban ïada ïa ka kum ka kynroh — Ka wah Nile ka la long kum ka jingker jong ka .

translation.en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .
translation.kha: Pynban , kum u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat uba ha shuwa jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop , bad um shym sangeh .

translation.en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt : but I wholly followed the  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba ïaleit ryngkat bad nga , pynban , ki pynsheptieng ïa ki briew jong ngi . Hynrei nga , nga la kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands , and that he was come from God , and went to God  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba U Kpa u la ai ha u ïa ka bor baroh ; u la tip ba u la wan na U Blei bad ba un sa leit sha U Blei .

translation.en: And he must needs go through Samaria .
translation.kha: Kumta haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ki la ïa-ong , u la mihnoh na Judia bad u la leit phai sha Galilaïa ; ha ka lynti jong u shata u la dei ban ïaid lyngba ka Samaria .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that in process of time , after the end of two years , his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness : so he died of sore diseases . And his people made no burning for him , like the burning of his fathers .
translation.kha: Kumba ar snem ka la nang jur tad haduh ba u syiem u la ïap ha ka jingkordit . Ki raïot jong u kim shym thang ding shabar ha kaba ïambriew ïa u kumba la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong u .

translation.en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought , in that they are turned unto other gods .
translation.kha: Te ngan kyntait ban ïarap ïa ki namar ba ki la leh bymman bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: And Abner said unto David , I will arise and go , and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king , that they may make a league with thee , and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth . And David sent Abner away  ; and he went in peace .
translation.kha: U Abner u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ngan leit noh mynta , bad ngan pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha phi ko Syiem Bakhraw . Kin pdiang ïa phi kum u syiem , bad nangta phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi la kwah bad phin synshar halor ka ri baroh kawei .  U Dabid u ai ka jingkular jingshngain ïa u Abner bad u phah noh ïa u .

translation.en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume .
translation.kha: Ki khñiang kin bam duh ïa ki dieng bad ki jingthung jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ : that whether I come and see you , or else be absent , I may hear of your affairs , that ye stand fast in one spirit , with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel ;
translation.kha: Mynta , ka bynta kaba donkam eh ka long , ba ka rukom ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kat kumba ka gospel U Khrist ka dawa , khnang ba , la nga lah ne ngam lah ban leit bad ïohi ïa phi , ngan ïohsngew ba phi ïeng skhem ha kawei ka jingthmu , bad kata , da kawei ka jingthrang , phi ïakhun lang na ka bynta ka jingngeit ha ka gospel .

translation.en: And he will love thee , and bless thee , and multiply thee : he will also bless the fruit of thy womb , and the fruit of thy land , thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep , in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee .
translation.kha: Un ieit bad kyrkhu ïa phi , ba phin nang roi kyrhai . Un kyrkhu ruh ba phin ïoh shibun ki khun ki kti ; un kyrkhu ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ba phin ïoh u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ; bad un kyrkhu ruh ïa phi da kaba ai ha phi shibun ki masi bad ki langbrot , ha kata ka ri ïa kaba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha phi .

translation.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people , the praise of all his saints  ; even of the children of Israel , a people near unto him . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka hima jong u kaba khlaiñ , ba kumta baroh ki briew jong u ki ïaroh ïa u — ki paid Israel , kiba u ieit eh . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  The foxes have holes , and the birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ki myrsiang ki don ki krem , bad ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don jaka hangno hangno ban dem bad ban pynjahthait .

translation.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari , the rest of the Levites , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Jokneam with her suburbs , and Kartah with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Kiba sah jong ki Lebi , ka kur Merari , ka la ïohpdiang na ka jaka jong ka jait Sebulun saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Jokneam , ka Kartah ,

translation.en: From thence they removed , and pitched in the valley of Zered .
translation.kha: Nangta pat ki leit sher dara ha Them Sered .

translation.en: Because it is a trial , and what if the sword contemn even the rod ? it shall be no more , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Nga tynjuh ïa la ki briew , bad lada ki kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut , kine kiei kiei baroh kin wan jia ha ki .

translation.en: And it repented the  Lord  that he had made man on the earth , and it grieved him at his heart .
translation.kha: u la sngewsih ba u lah thaw bad buh ïa ki ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And when they entered unto the heathen , whither they went , they profaned my holy name , when they said to them , These are the people of the  Lord  , and are gone forth out of his land .
translation.kha: Kat shaba ki leit , ki pynlehrain ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ba ki briew ki ïoh kynnoh , ‘ Kine ki long ki briew jong U  Trai  , pynban ki hap ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .’

translation.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels , intruding into those things which he hath not seen , vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind ,
translation.kha: Wat shah ïa lade ban shah pynrem da uno uno uba kam ba u long uba kham hakhlieh namar ki jingïohipaw kiba kyrpang bad uba ïai ban ha ka jingsngewrit bymdei bad ha kaba mane ïa ki angel . Naba khlem kano kano ka daw , ïa kiba kum kine ki briew la pynmeng shikatdei da ka rukom pyrkhat briew bad ki la sangeh ban batskhem ha U Khrist , uba long u khlieh jong ka met .

translation.en: Being forty days tempted of the devil . And in those days he did eat nothing : and when they were ended , he afterward hungered .
translation.kha: ha kaba u la shah pynshoi ha u Soitan haduh sawphew sngi . Ha baroh kata ka por u khlem bam ei ei , ba kumta u la thngan eh haba ka la kut .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Know ye Laban the son of Nahor ? And they said , We know him .
translation.kha: U kylli ,  Phi ithuh ïa u Laban u khun jong u Nahor ?   Ho-oid , ngi ithuh ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the  Lord  unto all the children of Israel : and they looked , and took every man his rod .
translation.kha: U Moses u la shim ïa kita ki diengduh baroh bad u la pyn-i ïa ki ha ki Israel . Ki la ïohi ïa kaba la jia , bad uwei pa uwei u nongïalam u la shim noh ïa la u jong u diengduh .

translation.en: He is gone up to Bajith , and to Dibon , the high places , to weep : Moab shall howl over Nebo , and over Medeba : on all their heads shall be baldness , and every beard cut off .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Dibon ki kiew ïa u lum ban ïam ha ka jaka mane blei . Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïam ha ka jingsngewsih ïa ki nongbah jong ka Nebo bad Medeba ; ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ïa u  ñiuhtmoh ha ka jingsngewsih .

translation.en: For as the Father hath life in himself  ; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself  ;
translation.kha: Kumba U Kpa da lade hi u long u tyllong jong ka jingim , ha kajuh ka rukom u la pynlong ïa U Khun jong u ban long u tyllong jong ka jingim .

translation.en: And to him they agreed : and when they had called the apostles , and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .
translation.kha: Ki la khot shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la phah sympat ïa ki , bad hukum ïa ki ban ym kren shuh da lei lei ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu ; bad nangta ki la pyllait noh ïa ki .

translation.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went , and did according as the  Lord  commanded them : the  Lord  also accepted Job .
translation.kha: U Eliphas , u Bildad bad u Sophar ki la leh ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa ki ban leh , bad U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u Job .

translation.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day , and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night , and I will destroy thy mother .
translation.kha: Mynmiet bad mynsngi phi ïaid bakla , bad ki nongïathuhlypa kim long kham bha ban ïa phi . Ngan sa pynjot ïa ka Israel , ka kmie jong phi .

translation.en: Yet the children of thy people say , The way of the Lord is not equal : but as for them , their way is not equal .
translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong me ki ong ba kaei kaba nga leh kam long ka badei ! Em , ka dei ka lynti jong ki ka bymdei .

translation.en: And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .
translation.kha: Ki la ïapoi haduh ki mawkyrdon lem bad u , bad nangta ki shipai ki la dei ban bah ïa u namar u paidbhur u la lamwir palat .

translation.en: He revealeth the deep and secret things : he knoweth what is in the darkness , and the light dwelleth with him .
translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa kiei kiei kiba jylliew bad kiba rieh ; u tip kaei kaba la buhrieh ha ka jingdum , bad ïa u hi la ker sawdong da ka jingshai .

translation.en: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbour , and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee :
translation.kha: Ïa ka khyndew dei ban buh dor kat kum ka jingdon jong ki snem ha kiba kata ka khyndew ka lah ban pynmih soh shuwa ban poi ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .

translation.en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the other priests , and said unto them , Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance , but deliver it for the breaches of the house .
translation.kha: Kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngdoh bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei ba phim shym shna pynbha ïa ka Templ ? Naduh mynta phim dei shuh ban bat ïa ka pisa kaba phi ïohpdiang ; phi dei ban aiti noh , khnang ban ïoh shna pynbha .

translation.en: Where the word of a king is , there is power : and who may say unto him , What doest thou ?
translation.kha: U syiem u trei bad ka iktiar , bad ym don uba lah ban pyrshah ïa kaei ba u leh .

translation.en: They conceive mischief , and bring forth vanity , and their belly prepareth deceit .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba thmu ban pynjynjar bad ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; ki dohnud jong ki , ki dap borabor da ka jingshet shukor .

translation.en: And Achish answered and said to David , I know that thou art good in my sight , as an angel of God : notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said , He shall not go up with us to the battle .
translation.kha: Nga mynjur ,  u Akhish u jubab ,  Nga ñiew ïa phi uba hok kum u angel U Blei . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiem Philistia ki ong ba phim dei ban leit ryngkat bad ngi sha ka thma .

translation.en: And he brought the other ram , the ram of consecration : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u wanlam ïa u langbrot uba ar uba long na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki lyngdoh , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a trespass offering .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang ïa kata ka khleiñ baroh halor kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai . Ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat .

translation.en: It is the answer .
translation.kha: Haoid kadei ka Jubab .

translation.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king , and asked , saying , I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi ka khynnah ka la leit phai kloi kloi pat sha u syiem bad ka la dawa ,  Nga kwah ïa phi ban ai mynta hangne ha ka pliang , ïa ka khlieh u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis !

translation.en: O send out thy light and thy truth : let them lead me  ; let them bring me unto thy holy hill , and to thy tabernacles .
translation.kha: Phah ïa ka jingshai jong me bad ka jingshisha jong me ; to ai ba kin ïalam ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong me , bad sha ka Templ jong me , ha kaba me shong .

translation.en: He shall suck the poison of asps : the viper s tongue shall slay him .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u briew uba sniew u nguid ka long kum ka bih ; ka pynïap ïa u kum ka jingpuh jong u bseiñ bashyrkhei .

translation.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary , and the charge of the altar : that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me ki dei ban pyndep ïa ki jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka Jaka Kyntang bad ka duwan , khnang ba ngan ym khie bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold , ( the vessels being diverse one from another , ) and royal wine in abundance , according to the state of the king .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingdih la sam ha ki khuri ksiar , kiba ïapher dur kawei na kawei pat , bad u syiem u la ai pahuh ïa ka waiñ jong u .

translation.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness  ; there is nothing froward or perverse in them .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh kiba nga kren ki long kiba shisha ; ym don ei ei ha ki kaba lamler lane ïalam bakla .

translation.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant , ye children of Jacob , his chosen ones .
translation.kha: Ma phi kiba hiarpateng na u Jakob , u shakri jong U Blei , kiba hiarpateng na u Israel , ïa uba U Blei u la jied , kynmaw ïa ki kambah kiba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .

translation.en: And it was so on the morrow , that Saul put the people in three companies  ; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch , and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day : and it came to pass , that they which remained were scattered , so that two of them were not left together .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet u Saul u pynbynta ïa u paidïapom jong u ha ki lai kynhun , bad ynda mynstep ki tur sha ka jaka shong dara ki nongshun bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Ammon . Ha ka por shiteng sngi ki la lah pynïap ïa ki . Kiba lait im ki phet ïap , marwei marwei ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did so , and gathered , some more , some less .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïaleh kumta , don kiba lum kham bun , kiwei pat ki lum kham khyndiat .
