translation.en: For mine own sake , even for mine own sake , will I do it : for how should my name be polluted ? and I will not give my glory unto another .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynta jong nga hi — Ngan ym shah ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom lane mano mano ban ïadon bynta lang ïa ka burom kaba dei ka jong nga bad ka jong nga hi .

translation.en: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God .
translation.kha: Ki jingthaw baroh ki ap da ka jingthrang hir hir ba U Blei un pynpaw ïa ki khun jong u .

translation.en: Who is weak , and I am not weak ? who is offended , and I burn not ?
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u tlot , te nga ruh nga tlot ; haba uno uno u hap ha ka pop , la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkthang mynsiem .

translation.en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse . The first said unto him , I have bought a piece of ground , and I must needs go and see it : I pray thee have me excused .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh ki la sdang , uwei hadien uwei pat , ban ai daw . Uba nyngkong u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ Nga la thied ïa ka lyngkha bad nga dei ban leit bad khmih ïa ka ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jong nga .’

translation.en: To Titus , mine own son after the common faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha u Titos , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïadon lang . To U Blei uba long U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba long U Nongpynim jong ngi un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: But they had heard only , That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed .
translation.kha: Ki la tip tang ïa kaei ba kiwei pat ki ong :  U briew uba la ju pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi mynta pat u ïalap ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba shisien u la pyrshang ban pynduh !

translation.en: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at even , ye shall eat unleavened bread , until the one and twentieth day of the month at even .
translation.kha: Naduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong haduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba arphew wei jong uta u bnai , phin ym ïabam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .

translation.en: When I say , My bed shall comfort me , my couch shall ease my complaint  ;
translation.kha: Nga thiah bad pyrshang ban pynjahthait ; nga khmih ban ïohlait na ka jingpang jong nga .

translation.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted ? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One  ; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers :
translation.kha: Hato ym don u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynshitom beiñ ? Ki la pynïap ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kiba slem bah mynshuwa ki la pynbna ïa ka jingwan jong u shakri bahok jong u .

translation.en: My beloved is white and ruddy , the chiefest among ten thousand .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong phi ka pynkmen ïa nga , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem bad ko nongleitkurim jong nga . Ka jingieit jong phi ka kham bha ban ïa ka waiñ ; ka jingsleh jong phi ka kham iwbih ban ïa uno uno u musla .

translation.en: And it shall be , when ye have taken the city , that ye shall set the city on fire : according to the commandment of the  Lord  shall ye do . See , I have commanded you .
translation.kha: Ynda phi la kurup ïa ka nongbah , thang ïa ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kine ki long ki hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: Yet I will rejoice in the  Lord  , I will joy in the God of my salvation .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai lehkmen bad shadkmen , namar U  Trai  U Blei u long u nongpynim jong nga .

translation.en: And he took and put the testimony into the ark , and set the staves on the ark , and put the mercy seat above upon the ark :
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli bad u buh ïa ki hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang . U bsuh ïa ki dieng jingbah ha ki kyrwoh jong kata ka synduk bad u buh ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka .

translation.en: But if thou fear to go down , go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada me sheptieng ban tur ïaleh , leit hiar sha ka jaka sher dara lem bad u Purah u shakri jong me .

translation.en: And when I beheld , lo , the sinews and the flesh came up upon them , and the skin covered them above : but there was no breath in them .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang peit , la sop ïa ki shyieng da ki thied , bad ka dohksah , bad nangta da ka sniehdoh . Hynrei ym don jingpynhiar mynsiem ha kita ki met .

translation.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me , and the ships of Tarshish first , to bring thy sons from far , their silver and their gold with them , unto the name of the  Lord  thy God , and to the Holy One of Israel , because he hath glorified thee .
translation.kha: Ki dei ki liengbah kiba wan na ki ri kiba jngai , ki wallam ïa ki paidlang U Blei sha la ïing . Ki wanrah ryngkat bad ki ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai U Blei Bakhuid ka Israel , uba pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ban pyndonburom ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: If he said thus , The speckled shall be thy wages  ; then all the cattle bare speckled : and if he said thus , The ringstraked shall be thy hire  ; then bare all the cattle ringstraked .
translation.kha: Ha man ba i ong , ‘ Ki blang kiba thohbria kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohbria suda . Haba i ong , ‘ Kita kiba thohshuid kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ kata ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohshuid suda .

translation.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba ïohi ïa kaba shapoh ki dohnud jong ngi , u tip kaei ka long jingmut jong U Mynsiem ; namar U Mynsiem u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta la ki briew bad kat kum ka mon jong u .

translation.en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry : for anger resteth in the bosom of fools .
translation.kha: Bat synshar ïa la ka jingkhluit khlieh ; ka long ka jingbieit ban pynlang ïa ka jingbatnud .

translation.en: And this he said to prove him : for he himself knew what he would do .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane ban tynjuh ïa u Philip ; ha ka jingshisha u la lah tip lypa ïa kaei ba un leh . )

translation.en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou didst humble thyself before God , when thou heardest his words against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , and humbledst thyself before me , and didst rend thy clothes , and weep before me  ; I have even heard thee also , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad to kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , da kaba kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad da kaba ïam , haba me ïohsngew kumno nga la byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka .

translation.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms , wrought righteousness , obtained promises , stopped the mouths of lions ,
translation.kha: Da ka jingngeit ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa baroh ki hima bad ki la jop . Ki la leh ïa kaei kaba dei hok bad ki la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .
translation.kha: U Elijah shisha u wan shuwa ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  bad un pynkhreh ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood , planted by the waters : she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong me ka la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba la thung hajan ka wahduid . Namar ba la don kyrhai ka um , ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la tap da ki sla bad u soh .

translation.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it , that the  Lord  hearkened unto the voice of a man : for the  Lord  fought for Israel .
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don mynno mynno , bad yn ym don lano lano , ba la don kum kata ka sngi , mynba U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa u bynriew . U  Trai  u ïaleh ha ka liang ki Israel !

translation.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him : let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .
translation.kha: To kmen , ko Israel , namar u Nongthaw jong phi ; to shadkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , na ka bynta u syiem jong phi !

translation.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .
translation.kha: Wat ai ïa kaei kaba khuid ha ki ksew — kin shu phai pynban bad tur ban dait ïa phi . Wat bret ïa ki mawlynnai ha khmat ki sniang — kin shu ïuh pynban ïa ki hapoh ka kjat .

translation.en: So that the  Lord  could no longer bear , because of the evil of your doings , and because of the abominations which ye have committed  ; therefore is your land a desolation , and an astonishment , and a curse , without an inhabitant , as at this day .
translation.kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi ka ri jong phi kan sah ha ki jingjot bad ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah ha ka . Ka la long ka jingïohi ba-itriem , bad ki briew ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingtim , namar U  Trai  um lah shah shuh ïa ki kam bymman bad basniew jong phi .

translation.en: In the courts of the  Lord s  house , in the midst of thee , O Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew jong me baroh , ha ka jaka kyntang jong ka Templ jong me ha Jerusalem , ngan ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: But if she bear a maid child , then she shall be unclean two weeks , as in her separation : and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days .
translation.kha: Khatsaw sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun kynthei , kan long ka bymkhuid kum ha ka por ba ka poi bnai . Nangta kan shim por pat sa hynriewphew hynriew sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam .

translation.en: A window shalt thou make to the ark , and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above  ; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof  ; with lower , second , and third stories shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ka tnum ïa kata ka lieng bad pyllait jaka kumba sawphew saw sentimitar hapdeng ka tnum bad ki krung . Shna ïa ka lai mala bad buh ïa ka jingkhang ha krung jong ka .

translation.en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïadon baroh arspah hynñiewphew hynriew ngut ha ka lieng .

translation.en: Neither shall he go in to any dead body , nor defile himself for his father , or for his mother  ;
translation.kha: Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba leit sha jan ka metïap , wat la ka dei ka jong u kpa ne ka kmie jong u .

translation.en: Now there were with us seven brethren : and the first , when he had married a wife , deceased , and , having no issue , left his wife unto his brother :
translation.kha: Mynta , la don hynñiew ngut ki shynrang ba shi para kiba la ju shong ju sah hangne . Uba heh duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun , kumta u la iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u ha la u jong u para .

translation.en: We roar all like bears , and mourn sore like doves : we look for judgment , but there is none  ; for salvation , but it is far off from us .
translation.kha: Ngi la sheptieng bad kordit . Ngi thrang dik dik ba U Blei un pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbanbeiñ bad jingleh bymdei hynrei kam shym jia long kumta .

translation.en: Their knops and their branches were of the same : all of it was one beaten work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Ki shata , ki tnat , bad ka ktang u diengpynïeng sharak ki long kiba ïadait lang kawei da ka ksiar nylla ba la shoh .

translation.en: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out  ; it speaketh deceit : one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth , but in heart he layeth his wait .
translation.kha: Ki thylliej jong ki , ki long ki khnam kiba shyrkhei ; ki ïathuh lamler borabor . Uwei uwei u kren ki kyntien sngewieit ïa u paramarjan jong u , hynrei ha ka jingshisha u pynap ka jingriam ïa u .

translation.en: And all the brethren which are with me , unto the churches of Galatia :
translation.kha: Ki parabangeit baroh kiba don hangne ki ïasnohkti lang bad nga ha kaba phah ïa ki jingai khublei sha ki balang ha Galatia :

translation.en: Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings  ; and the years of thy life shall be many .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga , shim khia ïa kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi , bad phin im slem .

translation.en: But we , brethren , being taken from you for a short time in presence , not in heart , endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire .
translation.kha: Te ma ngi , ko parabangeit , haba ïa ngi la pynïakhlad na phi shipor — ym ha ki jingpyrkhat jong ngi , shisha , hynrei tang ha ka met — kumno ba ngi la sngewkynjah khlem ma phi bad katno ngi la pyrshang jur ban ïohi pat ïa phi !

translation.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean , behold , the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon s house , and stood before the gate ,
translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang sngewlyngngoh shaphang ka jingmut jong kane ka jingïohipaw , ki rangbah kiba u Kornelios u la phah ki la tip hangno ka ïing jong u Simon ka don , bad mynta ki la ïeng ha khmat ka khyrdop .

translation.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him , being read in the synagogues every sabbath day .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum u Moses la pule la slem bah ha ki synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ïa ki ktien jong u la ïalap ha man ki shnong .

translation.en: For all his judgments were before me : and as for his statutes , I did not depart from them .
translation.kha: Nga la leh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ; Ngam shym la lyndet ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit , and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes : even so , Father  ; for so it seemed good in thy sight .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la pyndap ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad u la ong ,  Ko Kpa , U Trai jong ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me namar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymnang bymstad ïa kaei kaba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba shemphang . Ho-oid , ko Kpa , kane ka la long kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan jia .

translation.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban hikai ïa ki shaphang ki hukum jong U Blei bad batai ïa ki kumno ki dei ban im bad aïu ki dei ban leh .

translation.en: For the  Lord  will plead their cause , and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïasaid ïa ka kam jong ki na ka bynta jong ki , bad un byrngem ïa ka jingim jong uno uno uba byrngem ïa ki .

translation.en: Son of man , when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land , they defiled it by their own way and by their doings : their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  haba ki Israel ki dang shong ha la ka ri , ki la pyntngit ïa ka da ki rukom ba ki im bad ki leh , nga ñiew ïa ka rukom im jong ki kum ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam kum ka kynthei ha ka por ba ka poi bnai .

translation.en: And he continued there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Paul u la sah hangta shisnem shiteng , u da hikai ha ki ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .

translation.en: And after he had spent some time there , he departed , and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order , strengthening all the disciples .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut katto katne por hangta , u la mihnoh bad u la leit lyngba ka thain jong ka Galatia bad Phrygia , da kaba pynkhlaiñ ïa ki parabangeit baroh .

translation.en: And the sons of Levi  ; Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
translation.kha: U Lebi bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Gershon , u Kohath , bad u Merari .

translation.en: It is a trespass offering : he hath certainly trespassed against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat ïa ka pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field , and with the fowls of heaven , and with the creeping things of the ground : and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth , and will make them to lie down safely .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ngan pynlong ka jutang bad baroh ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , khnang ba kin ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan weng noh ruh ïa baroh ki tiar thma na ka ri , baroh ki waitlam bad ki ryntieh , bad ngan ailad ba ki briew jong nga kin ïoh im ha ka jingsuk bad jingshngain .

translation.en: “Better to eat a dry crust of bread with peace of mind than have a banquet in a house full of trouble .”
translation.kha: “Lah kaba shikyntien ka ja suda ha ba bad ka jingsuk , ban ia ka ing kaba dap da ka jingkhawai lem bad ka jingialeh .”

translation.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart , when they howled upon their beds : they assemble themselves for corn and wine , and they rebel against me .
translation.kha: Kim shym la duwai ha nga naduh la ka dohnud , hynrei pynban ki bret ïa lade ha madan bad ïam pangnud kumba leh kiba mane blei thala . Haba ki duwai ban ïoh ïa u kew bad ka waiñ , ki ot pynmong ïa lade kum kiba mane blei thala . A haduh katno ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah !

translation.en: They are created now , and not from the beginning  ; even before the day when thou heardest them not  ; lest thou shouldest say , Behold , I knew them .
translation.kha: Dei tang mynta ba nga pynurlong ïa ki ; ym don ei ei kum kane kaba la jia mynshuwa . Lada ka la jia , phin jin da la kam ba phi la dep tip lut shaphang kane .

translation.en: There was a certain rich man , which was clothed in purple and fine linen , and fared sumptuously every day :
translation.kha: La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la riam ha ki jaiñ kiba remdor eh bad uba im ha ka jingpahuh bakhraw man la ka sngi .

translation.en: Wherefore now let the fear of the  Lord  be upon you  ; take heed and do it : for there is no iniquity with the  Lord  our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of gifts .
translation.kha: Burom ïa U  Trai  bad trei bha , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi um lah shah ïa ka jingleh bymdei lane ka jingleh shiliang khmat lane ka jingshim pisa thok .

translation.en: But I am the  Lord  thy God , that divided the sea , whose waves roared : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; nga pynphaloh ïa ka duriaw bad nga pynlong ïa ki jingat phyllung ban kyrhuh . Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh !

translation.en: O  Lord  , thou hast deceived me , and I was deceived : thou art stronger than I , and hast prevailed : I am in derision daily , every one mocketh me .
translation.kha: A  Trai  me la shukor ïa nga , bad ïa nga la shukor . Me long uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa nga , bad me la jop ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei u rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ; ki krenbeiñ ïa nga baroh shi sngi .

translation.en: So Solomon , and all the congregation with him , went to the high place that was at Gibeon  ; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  had made in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki la leit shata namar dei hangta ba ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ka don , ha kaba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la pynïeng ha ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: And he said , This will I do : I will pull down my barns , and build greater  ; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngan leh ,’ u la ong ha lade ; ‘ ngan pynpra ïa ki thiar jong nga bad shna ïa kiba kham heh , ha kaba ngan kynshew ïa u kew jong nga bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki mar jong nga .

translation.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for want of a shelter .
translation.kha: Ki jhieh ha u slap uba hap halor ki lumbah , bad ki ïa-thngian harud ki mawsiang ban rieh .

translation.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him , and walk in darkness , we lie , and do not the truth :
translation.kha: Lada , namarkata , ngi ong ba ngi don ka jingïasyllok bad u , pynban , ha kajuh ka por ngi ïaid ha ka jingdum , ngi lamler da ki ktien jong ngi bad ha ki kam jong ngi .

translation.en: And if the priest look , and , behold , the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it  ; then he shall rend it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof :
translation.kha: Hynrei , haba u lyngdoh u la khmih bha pat ïa ka , lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la nang duna , u dei ban tar noh ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh na kata ka jaiñ ne na kata ka snieh .

translation.en: But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ngi u don ha bneng ; u leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon .

translation.en: And at this house , which is high , every one that passeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss  ; and they shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and to this house ?
translation.kha: Kane ka ïing kaba da kat ka ïing kan kylla long kaba sah kynjah , bad kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un kyndit thret bad un pang met ; bad kin ïakylli , ‘ Balei mo U  Trai  u la leh sat kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka ïing ?’

translation.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him  ; and he cried , Cause every man to go out from me . And there stood no man with him , while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph um sngewlah kun shuh ïa la ka jingsngew ha khmat ki shakri jong u , kumta u la hukum ïa ki baroh ba kin mihnoh na ka kamra . Ym shym don mano mano lem bad u haba u Joseph u pynithuh ïa lade ha ki hynmen shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley , even before the dragon well , and to the dung port , and viewed the walls of Jerusalem , which were broken down , and the gates thereof were consumed with fire .
translation.kha: Ka dang long mynmiet katba nga la mihnoh na ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them shaphang sepngi bad leit shaphang shathie da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Umpohliew u Ïakjakor sha ka Khyrdop Synrum . Katba nga dang leit , nga khmih ïa ki kynroh ba la pra jong ka nongbah bad ki khyrdop ïa kiba la pynjot da ka ding .

translation.en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth , and cry mightily unto God : yea , let them turn every one from his evil way , and from the violence that is in their hands .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki mrad ki dei ban phong ki jaiñ khain . Uwei pa uwei u dei ban duwai jur ha U Blei bad u dei ban iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman bad ki kam sniew jong u .

translation.en: And Peter said unto him , Aeneas , Jesus Christ maketh thee whole : arise , and make thy bed . And he arose immediately .
translation.kha: Ko Ainias ,  u Petros u la ong ha u ,  U Jisu Khrist u pynkhiah ïa me . To ïeng joit bad pynbeit ïa la ka jingthiah .  Mar kumta hi u Ainias u la ïeng joit .

translation.en: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served . And he sent to meet them : for the men were greatly ashamed . And the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shikatdei ban leit phai sha ïing . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ktien sha ki ba kin sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad haduh ba ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki da san biang .

translation.en: But if there be no interpreter , let him keep silence in the church ; and let him speak to himself , and to God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai , te uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher u dei ban sngap jar noh bad kren tang ha lade bad ha U Blei .

translation.en: While the earth remaineth , seedtime and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night shall not cease .
translation.kha: Katba ka pyrthei ka dang sah , kan don ka aïom bet bad ka aïom ot . Kan don ka jingkhriat bad ka jingshit , ka lyiur bad ka tlang , ka sngi bad ka miet .

translation.en: But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba ïaineh , bad un pynshaitbor ïa phi bad ri sumar ïa phi na Uta u Basniew .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem , and thine arm shall be uncovered , and thou shalt prophesy against it .
translation.kha: Phai beit ïa la ki khmat sha ka Jerusalem ba la shah kerkut , pynkhih ïa la ka kti ba la kham , sha ka phang ka nongbah bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka .

translation.en: The second tool is a free program of home Bible study .
translation.kha: Kaba ar pat de , ka dei ka jinghikai Baibl ha ïing jong phi khlem jingsiew eiei .

translation.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old , having been the wife of one man ,
translation.kha: To wat kynthup ïa kano kano ka riewkynthei ha ka thup ki riewkynthei lymda ka la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Out of the eater came forth meat , and out of the strong came forth sweetness . And they could not in three days expound the riddle .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Na u nongbam wan mih ka jingbam ; Na uba khlaiñ wan mih kaba thiang .  Hadien lai sngi ruh kim shym lah ban batai ïa kata ka jingkyntip .

translation.en: And when they found not his body , they came , saying , that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .
translation.kha: Ki la wan phai pat da kaba ong ba ki la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ïa ki angel kiba la ïathuh ha ki ba u im .

translation.en: All nations before him are as nothing  ; and they are counted to him less than nothing , and vanity .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kim long ei ei satia ha u .

translation.en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness , so that there is no place clean .
translation.kha: Ïa ki miej ha kiba ki shong la tap da ka prie bad ym don shuh ka bynta kaba khuid .

translation.en: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts , known and read of all men :
translation.kha: Ma phi hi phi long kata ka shithi ba ngi don , ïa kaba la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ngi khnang ba baroh kin tip bad kin pule .

translation.en: Follow after charity , and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingieit keiñ , ba phi dei ban ïabeh . To ai ba dohnud kan kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , khamtam ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei .

translation.en: The way of the  Lord  is strength to the upright : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïada ïa ki briew kiba ïaid hok ; hynrei u pynjot ïa kito kiba leh bymdei .

translation.en: But other fell into good ground , and brought forth fruit , some an hundredfold , some sixtyfold , some thirtyfold .
translation.kha: Hynrei khyndiat ki symbai u la hap ha ka khyndew kaba bha , bad ki jingthung ki la pynmih symboh ; katto katne ki la pynmih shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad kiwei pat laiphew tylli .

translation.en: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him , and overcome him , he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted , and divideth his spoils .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u briew uba kham khlaiñ u tur ïaleh ïa u bad jop ïa u , u kit noh ïa baroh ki tiar ïaleh kiba u trai u la shaniah bad u ïasam ïa kaei kaba u la lute .

translation.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga dem khohsiew ha khmat U Kpa ,

translation.en: The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :
translation.kha: Kine ki leh kumta na ka jingieit , namar ki tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ban ïada ïa ka gospel .

translation.en: And they brought him on horses : and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David .
translation.kha: Ïa ka metïap jong u la rah biang sha Jerusalem halor u kulai bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .

translation.en: Give wings unto Moab , that it may flee and get away : for the cities thereof shall be desolate , without any to dwell therein .
translation.kha: To buh ïa u maw jingtep na ka bynta ka Moab ; shen yn pynjot ïa ka . Ïa ki shnong jong ka yn ieh ha ka jingjot , bad yn ym don shuh uwei ruh u ban shong ban sah pat hangta .

translation.en: Wherefore ? Because they sought it not by faith , but as it were by the works of the law . For they stumbled at that stumblingstone ;
translation.kha: Bad balei kam shym la long kumta ? Namar kim shym la shaniah ha ka jingngeit hynrei ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Bad kumta ki la jynthut ha  U maw jong ka jingjynthut

translation.en: Then she said , Let me find favour in thy sight , my lord  ; for that thou hast comforted me , and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid , though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens .
translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka jubab ,  Kynrad , phi la lehsbun shibun ïa nga . Phi la pynlong ïa nga ban kham sngewbiang da kaba kren jem jai jai ïa nga , wat la ngam ïaryngkat kyrdan bad kawei na ki shakri jong phi .

translation.en: That ye may eat the flesh of kings , and the flesh of captains , and the flesh of mighty men , and the flesh of horses , and of them that sit on them , and the flesh of all men , both free and bond , both small and great .
translation.kha: Ale bad bam ïa ka doh jong ki syiem , ki nongïalam shipai , bad jong ki shipai , ka doh jong ki kulai bad ki nongshong jong ki , ka doh jong ki briew baroh , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , kiba rit bad kiba khraw !

translation.en: And , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Speak unto every feathered fowl , and to every beast of the field , Assemble yourselves , and come  ; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you , even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel , that ye may eat flesh , and drink blood .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to khot ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh kiba ha khlaw , ban ïawan na baroh sawdong ban ïabam ïa ka jingkñia kaba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki . Kan long ka jingkhawai kaba heh ha ki lumbah Israel , ba kin ïabam ïa ka doh bad dih ïa ka snam .

translation.en: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee : and seek ye the priesthood also ?
translation.kha: U la ai ïa phi bad ïa kiwei pat ki Lebi ban ïoh ïa kane ka burom — bad mynta pat phi pyrshang ban ïoh sa ïa ka kam lyngdoh ruh !

translation.en: Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass , that Jesus also being baptized , and praying , the heaven was opened ,
translation.kha: Ynda haba la dep pynbaptis ïa ki briew baroh , la pynbaptis ruh ïa u Jisu . Katba U dang duwai , la plie ïa ka bneng ,

translation.en: To take a spoil , and to take a prey  ; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited , and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations , which have gotten cattle and goods , that dwell in the midst of the land .
translation.kha: Men leit kurup , bad lute ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah kiba shisien ki don ha ka jingjot . Ki long kiba la lumlang na ki jaitbynriew , bad mynta ki don la ki jingri bad ki jingdon jingem , bad ki shong ha ki lad bah ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And I made an ark of shittim wood , and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first , and went up into the mount , having the two tables in mine hand .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la thaw kawei ka synduk kaba da u dieng Akasia bad nga la shtah ruh ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kita kiba nyngkong , bad nga leit rah ïa ki shalor uta u lum .

translation.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die , but after this the judgment :
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban ïap tang shisien , bad hadien kata yn bishar da U Blei .

translation.en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh , which God had sworn to Abraham , the people grew and multiplied in Egypt ,
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la nang jan na ka bynta U Blei ban bat ïa ka kular kaba u la kular ha u Abraham , ka jingdon jong ki briew jong ngi ha Ijipt ka la roi bun shah .

translation.en: Ye ask , and receive not , because ye ask amiss , that ye may consume it upon your lusts .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi pan , phim ïoh ïa ka , namar ki jingthmu jong phi ki long kiba sniew ; phi pan ïa kiei kiei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingsngewbha jong phi hi .

translation.en: Neither shall they shave their heads , nor suffer their locks to grow long  ; they shall only poll their heads .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban khi ïa la ki khlieh ne ban ieh jrong ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Kin ieh ïa u shñiuh ha ka jingjrong kat ban biang .

translation.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him ?
translation.kha: Haba ka jingeh ka wan , hato U Blei un ïohsngew ïa ki jingïam jong ki ?

translation.en: And when they had sent away the multitude , they took him even as he was in the ship . And there were also with him other little ships .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la iehnoh ïa u paidbah ; ki synran ki la kiew halor ka lieng ha kaba U Jisu u la lah shong , bad ki la ïalam ïa u bad ki . Kiwei ki lieng ruh ki la don hangta .

translation.en: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself : but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .
translation.kha: Dei ma phi ban ïoh ïa ka jingmyntoi , lada phi don ka jingstad , bad lada phi kyntait ïa ka , phi hi phin shem jynjar .

translation.en: And so commanded he the second , and the third , and all that followed the droves , saying , On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau , when ye find him .
translation.kha: U la ai kajuh ka hukum ïa uba ar , uba lai , bad ïa kita baroh kiba khmih ïa kita ki kynhun jingri ,  Phi dei ban ong kumne ha u Iso haba phi ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter , even you , O poor of the flock . And I took unto me two staves  ; the one I called Beauty , and the other I called Bands  ; and I fed the flock .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la thied bad die ïa ki langbrot ki la wai ïa nga , bad nga la long u nongaplangbrot jong ki langbrot kiba la dei ban shah shohdoh . Nga la shim ar tylli ki dieng : Ïa uwei nga la khot  U Jingsngewbha  bad ïa uwei pat  U Jingtylli .  Bad nga la sumar ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
translation.kha: Hato ki blei jong kino kino ki hima ki la pyllait im ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?

translation.en: But , lo , he speaketh boldly , and they say nothing unto him . Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ ?
translation.kha: Ha khmih ! U ïakren ha u paidbah , bad kim ong ei ei pyrshah ïa u ! Hato ka lah ban long ba kim ithuh shisha ïa u ba u dei U Messaïah ?

translation.en: For every one of the house of Israel , or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel , which separateth himself from me , and setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me  ; I the  Lord  will answer him by myself :
translation.kha: Man ba uwei na ki Israel lane uwei na ki nongwei uba shong hapdeng ka kynhun ki Israel u phai noh na nga bad u mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad nangta u leit ban kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ai ha u ïa ka jubab jong u !

translation.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him .
translation.kha: Hynrei hapoh ka kpoh jong u ka jingbam ka kylla kthang , ka kthang kum ka bih .

translation.en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God s elect ? It is God that justifieth .
translation.kha: Uei u ban mudui ïa kiba la jied jong U Blei ? U Blei hi da lade u la pynbna ba ki long khlem pop!

translation.en: And being not weak in faith , he considered not his own body now dead , when he was about an hundred years old , neither yet the deadness of Sara s womb :
translation.kha: Bad da kaba khlem tlot jingngeit , u um shim hi ba kamet jongu mynta ka la iap , ha ka por ba u la dap shispah snem ka rta , lane ïa ka plakhun jong ka Sarah .

translation.en: If a ruler hearken to lies , all his servants are wicked .
translation.kha: Lada u nongsynshar u shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingtip balamler , baroh ki rangbah synshar kin kylla long ki riewlamler .

translation.en: But they were exceedingly afraid , and said , Behold , two kings stood not before him : how then shall we stand ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar ka Samaria ki la sheptieng ,  Kumno ngi lah ban pyrshah ïa u Jehu ,  ki la ong ,  naba wat u syiem Joram lymne u syiem Ahasaïah kim lah ?

translation.en: And Moses made haste , and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshipped .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynkloi ban nguh dem haduh khyndew bad u la mane .

translation.en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  , when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed .
translation.kha: Ynda haba nga pynshitom ïa ki briew namar ki pop jong ki bad pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the  Lord  , neither was the word of the  Lord  yet revealed unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khot biang ïa u Samuel . U khynnah um shym tip satia ba dei U  Trai  , namar U  Trai  um pat ju la kren bad u mynshuwa . Kumta u khie joit bad u leit sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hynrei u Eli u jubab ,  Khun jong nga , ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang .

translation.en: Now therefore deliver us the men , the children of Belial , which are in Gibeah , that we may put them to death , and put away evil from Israel . But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Mynta aiti noh ïa kito ki riewbymman ha Gibeah , ba ngin ïoh pynïap ïa ki bad ban weng noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel .  Hynrei ki briew ka Benjamin kim salia ïa kiwei pat ki jait Israel .

translation.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land  ;
translation.kha: Kaba sngewshyrkhei bad kaba sngewkyndit ka la jia ha kane ka ri :

translation.en: So your good conduct may draw others to listen to the message you tell them .—Matthew 5 :16  ; 1 Peter 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .
translation.kha: Kumta ka akor babha jong phi ka lah ban khring ïa kiwei pat ban shahskhor ïa ka khubor ba phi ïathuh ha ki .—Mathaios 5 :16 ; 1 Petros 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .

translation.en: Behold , ye are of nothing , and your work of nought : an abomination is he that chooseth you .
translation.kha: Phi bad baroh kaba phi leh kim long ei ei ; kito kiba mane ïa phi ki long kiba isaitmet !

translation.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me , ye or your children , and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you , but go and serve other gods , and worship them :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ma me lane ki khun ki ksiew jong me phi phai dien noh na nga , bad phim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi , hynrei phi leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,

translation.en: For the Egyptians shall help in vain , and to no purpose : therefore have I cried concerning this , Their strength is to sit still .
translation.kha: Ka jingïarap kaba ka Ijipt ka ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta nga la khot-sin ïa ka Ijipt , ‘ U Ïakjakor bym lah pynmynsaw .’

translation.en: Now as touching things offered unto idols , we know that we all have knowledge . Knowledge puffeth up , but charity edifieth .
translation.kha: Mynta , shaphang kaei kaba phi la thoh ïa ka jingbam ba la kñia sha ki bleithaw . Ka long kaba shisha , te , ba  ma ngi baroh ngi don ka jingtip ,  kumba ki ong . Pynban , kum kata ka jingtip , ka pynmeng ïa u briew da ka jingsarong ; hynrei ka jingieit ka tei keiñ .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone , a tried stone , a precious corner stone , a sure foundation : he that believeth shall not make haste .
translation.kha: Kane , mynta , ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan buh ha Seïon ka nongrim kaba skhem bad bakhlaiñ . Ha ka ngan buh ïa u mawdong baskhem ha uba yn thoh ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingngeit kaba skhem ka long ruh kaba ïaishah .’

translation.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire , and felt no harm .
translation.kha: , u Paul u batai ruh ïa ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum U Blei bad ka bor jong U Mynsiem U Blei ha ka jingim jong uba ngeit . Nangta u apostol u ïaleh shitom ban pynshai ïa ka jingkylli kumno ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki don ka jingïadei bad ka jingthmu U Blei ïa ki jaitbynriew . U pynkut ba ka jingkyntait jong ki Jiw ïa U Jisu ka long ka bynta jong ka jingthmu U Blei ban wallam ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew hapoh ka jylli jong ka jingaiei jong U Blei da U Jisu Khrist , bad u ngeit ba ki Jiw kin ym kyntait sah ïa U Jisu . Khatduh u Paul u thoh shaphang kumno ban im ka jingim Khristan , khamtam shaphang ka lynti jong ka jingieit ha ka jingïadei bad kiwei pat . U thoh kiwei pat ki phangpdeng kum ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , ka kamram ki Khristan ha ka jingïadei bad ka hima sima bad ka imlang sahlang , bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka jingïatiplem . U pynkut ïa ka shithi da ki khubor bashimet bad ki ktien ïaroh ïa U Blei . Ki Jingkdew Ka jinglamphrang bad ka phangpdeng

translation.en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus , and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead , thou shalt be saved .
translation.kha: Lada phi phla ba U Jisu u long U Trai bad ngeit ba U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , phin lait im .

translation.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters , and masons : and they built David an house .
translation.kha: U syiem Hiram jong ka Tyros u phah ka kynhun ki nongkhaïi sha u Dabid ; u pynbiang ïa u ki dieng sawdong Kedar bad ki misteri dieng bad ki misteri maw ban tei ïing ïa ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death ?
translation.kha: A katno nga long u briew u bym don jingsuk! Uei u ban pyllait noh ïa nga na kane ka met kaba ïalam ïa nga sha ka jingïap ?

translation.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways .
translation.kha: U briew uba kum uta , um lah ban kut jingmut bad ban rai ha kiei kiei baroh ba u leh , um dei ban pyrkhat ba un sa ïohpdiang ei ei na U Trai .

translation.en: For it is written , Rejoice , thou barren that bearest not ; break forth and cry , thou that travailest not : for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband .
translation.kha: Naba la thoh ,  Suk , pha ka kynthei kaba lyngki ! To risa bad kyang da ka jingkmen , pha ka bym ju la ïohmad ïa ki jingpang jong ka jingsuh kha ! Naba kata ka kynthei kaba la shah iehnoh kan ïoh kham bun ki khun ban ïa ka kynthei kaba u tnga um ju iehnoh ïa ka .

translation.en: And the people served the  Lord  all the days of Joshua , and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua , who had seen all the great works of the  Lord  , that he did for Israel .
translation.kha: Katba u Joshua u dang im , ki paid Israel ki shakri ïa U  Trai  , bad wat hadien ka jingïap jong u ki ïai leh kumta katba dang im ki nongïalam kiba la ïohi da lade ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U  Trai  u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: And David rose up early in the morning , and left the sheep with a keeper , and took , and went , as Jesse had commanded him  ; and he came to the trench , as the host was going forth to the fight , and shouted for the battle .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Dabid u khie dang step phyrngab , u ieh ïa ki langbrot ha uwei pat u nongsharai , u rah ïa kata ka jingbam , bad u leit kumba u Jesse u la bthah ïa u . U poi ha ka jaka sher dara hamar ba ki Israel ki dang leit sha ka madan thma , ki da ïarisa ha ka sur-thma .

translation.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the  Lord  , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did , to make Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar ki pop jong u pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Kum u Jeroboam uba ha shuwa jong u , u la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  da ki pop jong u hi bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And he said unto me , It is done . I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end . I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ,  La pyndep ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang bad uba kut . Ha uno uno uba sliang ngan ai ïa ka hok ban dih na ka umpohliew jong ka um ka jingim khlem da siewdor ïa ka .

translation.en: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba nga pynshitom ïa ka Ijipt ha kane ka rukom , kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia bad u la phah noh ïa ki sha Joppa .

translation.en: And Michal took an image , and laid it in the bed , and put a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster , and covered it with a cloth .
translation.kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ka bleithaw na ïing , ka pyndem ïa ka ha jingthiah , ka buh ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlieh jong kata , bad ka buh jingtap halor jong ka .

translation.en: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar , O king , live for ever .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha u syiem Nebukhadnessar ,  Ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !

translation.en: And when Jesus came into the ruler s house , and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise ,
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka ïing jong u rangbah synshar . Haba u la ïohi ïa ki nongput nongtem na ka bynta ka jingontep bad ba ki briew baroh ki la khihwin ,

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Because of your unbelief : for verily I say unto you , If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye shall say unto this mountain , Remove hence to yonder place  ; and it shall remove  ; and nothing shall be impossible unto you .
translation.kha: Ka la long namar phim don ka jingngeit kaba biang ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lada phi don ka jingngeit kaba heh kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban ong ïa une u lumrit , ‘ Khie leit noh nangne shatai !’ bad un leit . Phi lah ban leh ïa kano kano !

translation.en: Then all those virgins arose , and trimmed their lamps .
translation.kha: Ki shiphew ngut ki theisotti ki la khie joit bad ki la pynkhreh ïa la ki sharak .

translation.en: And , behold , Boaz came from Beth–lehem , and said unto the reapers , The  Lord  be with you . And they answered him , The  Lord  bless thee .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u Boas da lade hi u wan poi na Bethlehem bad u ai khublei ïa ki nongtrei .  To U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad phi !  u ong .  U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa phi !  ki jubab .

translation.en: That the  Lord  sent a prophet unto the children of Israel , which said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought you up from Egypt , and brought you forth out of the house of bondage  ;
translation.kha: bad u la phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba wallam ha ki ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel :  Nga la wallam ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt .

translation.en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet , and said , Hear me , my brethren , and my people : As for me , I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and for the footstool of our God , and had made ready for the building :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ïeng ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong ,  Ko ki para ri jong nga , to shahshkor ïa nga . Nga la kwah ban tei ka ïingshong neh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ka jingïuhkjat jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Nga la pynkhreh ban tei ïa ka Templ ban ai burom ïa u ,

translation.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers , neither shall any of them that provoked me see it :
translation.kha: Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei ruh sha kata ka ri kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Yn ym don uwei ruh na kito kiba la kyntait ïa nga u ban ïohrung sha ka .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Again there shall be heard in this place , which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast , even in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , that are desolate , without man , and without inhabitant , and without beast ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba kane ka jaka ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ba kam don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im ha ka . Bad ki ong ïa kaba dei ; ki shnong ka Judah bad ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki long thylli ; ym don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im hangta .

translation.en: And his daughter in law , Phinehas  wife , was with child , near to be delivered : and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken , and that her father in law and her husband were dead , she bowed herself and travailed  ; for her pains came upon her .
translation.kha: Ka pyrsa kurim u Eli , ka tnga u Phinehas , ka la armet , bad ka la jan dei ka por ba kan kha khun . Haba ka ïohsngew ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ba u kthaw kurim bad u tnga jong ka ki la ïap , kynsan ka la suh kha bad ka la kha .

translation.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and saw , and behold four horns .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw nga la ïohi saw tylli ki reng masi dab .

translation.en: And David said to Solomon , My son , as for me , it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Ko khun jong nga , nga kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel , out of every tribe a man .
translation.kha: Mynta to jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait Israel .

translation.en: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will recompense their way upon their own heads , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba ieit ban mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-isaitmet bad ba-ijli . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven , and all that is dressed in the fryingpan , and in the pan , shall be the priest s that offereth it .
translation.kha: Ka jingainguh bam baroh ïa kaba la syang ha dpei , lane ïa kaba la sdieh ha ka karai lane ha u khiew ba la tap ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei .

translation.en: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it  ; and whoso breaketh an hedge , a serpent shall bite him .
translation.kha: Lada phi tih ïa ka thliew , phin hap hapoh jong ka , lada phi phrung lyngba ka kynroh , u bseiñ un puh ïa phi .

translation.en: Behold , there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt :
translation.kha: Yn don ka jingseisoh kaba khraw ha ki hynñiew snem ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

translation.en: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you , seeing your master s sons are with you , and there are with you chariots and horses , a fenced city also , and armour  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka shithi la thoh :  Phi dei ki nongpeit ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem jong phi bad phi don ruh bad phi ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , ki tiar ïapom bad ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .

translation.en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear , ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away .
translation.kha: Bad ynda U Nongaplangbrot Rangbah un paw , phin ïohpdiang ïa ka pansngiat badonburom kaba ka jingtyngshaiñ kan ym jah na ka lano lano ruh .

translation.en: If we assay to commune with thee , wilt thou be grieved ? but who can withhold himself from speaking ?
translation.kha: Ko Job , hato men sngewmong lada nga kren ? Ngam lah shuh ban shu sngap jar .

translation.en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things : and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba bha ; u briew uba sniew u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba sniew .

translation.en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him , he gave commandment to depart unto the other side .
translation.kha: Haba u Jisu u la ïohi ïa u paidbah sawdong jong u , u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban leit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .

translation.en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family , which remain in all the places whither I have driven them , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong kane ka jaitbynriew basniew kiba dang im , kiba shong ha ki jaka kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , kin jied ban ïap ban ïa kaba ki ïai im . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .
translation.kha: Mano ba bsa ïa ki tyngab haba ki sakma haba thngan , haba ki khun rit jong ki , ki kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingbam ?

translation.en: But he that received the seed into stony places , the same is he that heareth the word , and anon with joy receiveth it  ;
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap ha ka jaka mawsiang ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba pdiang ïa ka khubor da kaba kmen mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: When Jesus saw him lie , and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him ,  Wilt thou be made whole ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u ba u thiah hangta , bad u la tip ba uta u briew u la pang la slem bah ; kumta u la kylli ïa u ,  Me kwah ban ïohkhiah ?

translation.en: And she said unto them , Call me not Naomi , call me Mara : for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me .
translation.kha: Wat khot ïa nga , ka Naomi ,  ka jubab ;  khot noh ïa nga , ka Marah , namar U Blei Bakhrawbor u la pynlong ïa ka jingim jong nga kaba kthang .

translation.en: So then death worketh in us , but life in you .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba ka jingïap ka trei hapoh jong ngi , hynrei , ka jingim ka trei hapoh jong phi .

translation.en: For men verily swear by the greater : and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u smai , u pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong uno uno uba kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ka jingsmai ka pynbeit ïa baroh ki jingïatainia .

translation.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah : these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor , Abraham s brother .
translation.kha: Ka Milkah ka ïoh ïa kine ki phra ngut ki khun na u Nahor , u para u Abraham .

translation.en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering , and one ram for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki dei ban ai ïa u Aaron ar tylli ki  langsohmoh ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia thang .

translation.en: And his brethren went to feed their father s flock in Shechem .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u Joseph ki leit ïalam bam phlang ïa ki jingri jong u kpa jong ki sha Shekhem ,

translation.en: Now the next day , that followed the day of the preparation , the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , kaba dei ka sngi Sabbaton , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïakynduh ïa U Pilat

translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans , but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon , and shall speak with him mouth to mouth , and his eyes shall behold his eyes  ;
translation.kha: Yn aiti noh ïa u ha u syiem ka Babilonia ; un peit ïa u markhmat bad un kren ïa u hi da lade .

translation.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia , and Cyprus , and Antioch , preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki parabangeit ïa kiba la pynsakma da ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ kaba la jia myn haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , ka la pur shaduh sha Phoenisia , Sypros , bad Antiokh , da kaba ïathuh ïa ka khubor tang ha ki Jiw .

translation.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger , and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times :
translation.kha: Nangta u Eleasar un shim khyndiat na ka snam jong ka bad un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien da la ka shynriah ti sha ka phang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid : yea , thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet .
translation.kha: Phin ym sheptieng haba phi thiah , bad phin ïohthiah suk baroh shi miet .

translation.en: And think not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .
translation.kha: Bad wat leit pyrkhat ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom da kaba ong ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u lah ban shim ïa kine ki maw bad pynlong ki khun ki ksiew na ka bynta u Abraham !

translation.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days : for yet the vision is for many days .
translation.kha: Nga la wan ban pynsngewthuh ïa me ïa kaei ka ban jia ha ki briew jong me ha ka lawei . Kane ka dei ka jingïohipaw ïa ka lawei .

translation.en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels , and have not charity , I am become as sounding brass , or a tinkling cymbal .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban kren ha ki ktien jong ki briew bad wat ha ka jong ki angel ruh , hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , ka jingkren jong nga ka long kum ka wiang rnong ba sawa ne kum ka shakuriaw bariew shaw shaw .

translation.en: And Sarah said , God hath made me to laugh , so that all that hear will laugh with me .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka ong ,  U Blei u la wanrah ka jingkmen bad ka jingrkhie ïa nga . Kat kiba ïohsngew ïa kane kin ïa-rkhie bad nga .

translation.en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the  Lord  , and called it Jehovah–shalom : unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
translation.kha: U Gideon u tei hangta ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  U  Trai  u long ka Jingsuk .  ( Ka dang ïeng ha Ophrah , kaba dei jong ki kur jong u Abieser . )

translation.en: Children , obey your parents in the Lord : for this is right .
translation.kha: Phi ki khun , ka long ka kamram kum kiba ngeit ban kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , namar kane ka long kaba phi dei ban leh .

translation.en: Then came in the magicians , the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers : and I told the dream before them  ; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Te la wallam shapoh ïa baroh ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga , hynrei kim lah ban batai ïa ka ha nga .

translation.en: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the  Lord  , and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you . And this shall come to pass , if ye will diligently obey the voice of the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba sah sha jngai bah kin wan bad ïarap ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai . Bad haba la tei pat ïa ka , phin tip ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga sha phi . Kane baroh kan jia lada phi kohnguh lut ïa ki hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And cast him into the bottomless pit , and shut him up , and set a seal upon him , that he should deceive the nations no more , till the thousand years should be fulfilled : and after that he must be loosed a little season .
translation.kha: U angel u la bret ïa u sha ka  liewlong khlem trai , u la khang tala ïa ka , bad u la pynskhem ïa ka , khnang ba un ym lah ban shukor shuh ïa ki jaitbynriew tad haduh ba ki shihajar snem ki la kut . Hadien kata ïa u dei ban pyllait shipor .

translation.en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans , The thing is gone from me : if ye will not make known unto me the dream , with the interpretation thereof , ye shall be cut in pieces , and your houses shall be made a dunghill .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la kut jingmut ba phi dei ban ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad nangta ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Lada phim lah , ngan phah tar ïa ka kti ka kjat jong phi kawei na kawei pat bad ngan pynlong ïa ki ïing jong phi ka kynton ki jingjot .

translation.en: For the multitude of the people followed after , crying , Away with him .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïawan hadien jong u bad ki la pyrta ,  Pynïap ïa u !

translation.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart : they call to Egypt , they go to Assyria .
translation.kha: Ka Israel ka her kum ka paro kaba bieit ; nyngkong ki briew jong ka ki wad jingïarap na Ijipt , bad nangta ki mareh sha Assyria !

translation.en: For , behold , in those days , and in that time , when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha kata ka por ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka jingroi kyrhai jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And there was a great famine in Samaria : and , behold , they besieged it , until an ass s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a cab of dove s dung for five pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Na kane ka jingkerkut , ka jingkyrduh bam ha ka nongbah ka la long kaba jur katta katta kat haduh ba kawei ka khlieh kada ka shongdor phraphew ki sbai rupa , bad arspah gram ka eit paro    ka shongdor san sbai rupa .

translation.en: The burden of Nineveh . The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor shaphang ka Ninebeh , ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïohipaw kaba la ïohi da u Nahum , uba dei na Elkosh .

translation.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb ? Oh that I had given up the ghost , and no eye had seen me !
translation.kha: Balei , A Blei , me shah ba yn kha ïa nga ? Nga la dei ban ïap ha shuwa ba uno uno un ïohi ïa nga !

translation.en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries , that have delivered their country out of mine hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno na kine ki blei jong ki ri baroh kiba la ju pyllait im ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem ?

translation.en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria , even a blessing in the midst of the land :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka Israel yn kyrdan lang bad ka Ijipt bad ka Assyria , bad kine ki lai tylli ki ri kin long ka jingkyrkhu ïa ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: And one of the multitude answered and said , Master , I have brought unto thee my son , which hath a dumb spirit  ;
translation.kha: Uwei u briew hapdeng u paidbah u la jubab ,  Ko Nonghikai , nga la wallam ïa u khun jong nga sha me , namar u don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u bad um nang kren .

translation.en: And he wrote on the tables , according to the first writing , the ten commandments , which the  Lord  spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly : and the  Lord  gave them unto me .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kijuh ki ktien ba u la thoh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ ba u la ai ha phi mynba u la kren napdeng ka ding ha kata ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U  Trai  u ai ha nga ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad nga phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum .

translation.en: So I took the evidence of the purchase , both that which was sealed according to the law and custom , and that which was open :
translation.kha: Te nga la shim ïa baroh ar tylli ki kopi ka dulir thied jaka — ka kopi ba la shon muhor kaba don ka jingïakut bad ki kyndon , bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor —

translation.en: And the  Lord  God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel , and they smote them : so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites , the inhabitants of that country .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa u Sihon bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki shimti ïa baroh ka ri jong ki Amor kiba shong ha kata ka thain .

translation.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them  ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingainguh : ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong ;

translation.en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife , She is my sister : and Abimelech king of Gerar sent , and took Sarah .
translation.kha: Hadien , katba u dang shong ha Gerar , u la ong ba ka tnga jong u , ka Sarah ka dei ka para jong u . Te u Abimelekh jong ka Gerar u la phah ban wallam ïalam ïa ka Sarah sha u .

translation.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing , and drew away much people after him : he also perished  ; and all , even as many as obeyed him , were dispersed .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Judas u nong Galilaïa u la mih ha ka por jong ka jingkheiñbriew ; u la khring ïa u paidbah ban bud ïa u , hynrei ïa u ruh la pynïap , bad ïa baroh ki nongbud jong u la pynsakma .

translation.en: The eye that mocketh at his father , and despiseth to obey his mother , the ravens of the valley shall pick it out , and the young eagles shall eat it .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh biria ïa la u kpa lane uba ñiewbeiñ ïa la ka kmie ha ka jinglong tymmen jong ka u dei ban shah bam ha ki pukni ne shah khlaw ki khmat ha ki tyngab khlaw .

translation.en: And he ran unto Eli , and said , Here am I  ; for thou calledst me . And he said , I called not  ; lie down again . And he went and lay down .
translation.kha: bad u la mareh sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hynrei u Eli u jubab ,  Ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang .  Kumta u Samuel u leit thiah biang .

translation.en: They shall howl , saying , How is it broken down ! how hath Moab turned the back with shame ! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynkhynñiuh ! To kyang jam ! Ïa ka Moab la pynjahburom . Ka don ha ki jingjot , bad baroh ki hima ba don sawdong ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land , and say , Sword , go through the land  ; so that I cut off man and beast from it :
translation.kha: Lane nga lah ban wallam ka thma ha ka ri bad phah ki tiar pynjot ban pynduh lut ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ,

translation.en: Yet the  Lord  testified against Israel , and against Judah , by all the prophets , and by all the seers , saying , Turn ye from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki Israel bad Judah :  Iehnoh noh ïa ki lynti kynriang bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , ïa kiba la don ha ka Aiñ kaba nga la ai ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kaba nga la aiti pateng ha phi lyngba ki shakri jong nga bad ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Then shall it be for a man to burn : for he will take thereof , and warm himself  ; yea , he kindleth it , and baketh bread  ; yea , he maketh a god , and worshippeth it  ; he maketh it a graven image , and falleth down thereto .
translation.kha: U briew u pyndonkam shi bynta jong u dieng ban thang ding bad shi bynta jong u ban pynlong bleithaw . Da shi bynta u pynmeh ding ban pynsyaid ïa lade bad shet kpu ; da kawei pat ka shi bynta u shna blei bad mane ïa ka .

translation.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim , Hilkiah s son , which was over the house , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , Asaph s son , the recorder .
translation.kha: Lai ngut ki nong Judia ki wan ban ïakynduh ïa u ; u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah ; u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Shebna ; bad u rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh , u Joah u khun jong u Asaph .

translation.en: When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :
translation.kha: mynba u buh ïa ki lyoh ha sahit bneng , mynba u seng ïa ki umpohliew ka duriaw-bah ,

translation.en: Shall we give , or shall we not give ? But he , knowing their hypocrisy , said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ? bring me a penny , that I may see it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka buit bashapoh jong ki bad u la jubab ,  Balei ba phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ? Wallam ïa ka sbai rupa , bad ai ba ngan khmih ïa ka .

translation.en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah , the son of Benaiah , the son of Jeiel , the son of Mattaniah , a Levite of the sons of Asaph , came the Spirit of the  Lord  in the midst of the congregation  ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u wan ha u Lebi uba don hapdeng u paidbah . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Jahasiel , u khun jong u Sekharaïah ; u long u dkhot jong ka kur u Asaph bad u hiarpateng na u Asaph lyngba u Mattanaïah , u Jeiel bad u Benaïah .

translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon , my servant , and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid  ; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them .
translation.kha: Nangta sa ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam ïa u shakri jong nga u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia sha kane ka jaka , bad un buh ïa ka khet jong u halor kine ki maw kiba me la tep , bad un pyiar ïa ka ïingjaiñ syiem halor jong ki .

translation.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child , that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb ? yea , they may forget , yet will I not forget thee .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u jubab ,  Hato ka briew ka lah ban klet noh ïa la i khunlung bad ban ym ieit ïa i khun iba ka la kha ? Wat la ka kmie ka lah ban klet ïa la i khun , da lei lei ngan ym klet ïa phi .

translation.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth , to be thine inheritance , as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant , when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt , O Lord  God .
translation.kha: Me la jied ïa ki napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ban long u paidlang jong me , kumba me la ïathuh ha ki lyngba u Moses u shakri jong me mynba me wan ïalam noh na Ijipt ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty , or the lawful captive delivered ?
translation.kha: Hato pha lah ban shim noh ïa ka jinglute na u shipai ? Hato pha lah ban pyllait ïa ki koidi na u nongsynshar uba leh jubor ?

translation.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away : and who shall declare his generation ? for his life is taken from the earth .
translation.kha: La pynjahburom ïa u , bad ym shym la bishar hok ïa u . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u , namar ba ka jingim jong u ha ka pyrthei ka la kut .

translation.en: And now , little children , abide in him  ; that , when he shall appear , we may have confidence , and not be ashamed before him at his coming .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ko ki khun jong nga , to ïaisah ha u , khnang ba ynda u wanpaw , ngin long kiba dap da ka jingshlur bad ngim donkam ban rieh ha ka jinglehrain na u ha ka Sngi kaba u wan .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Joseph , and he was a prosperous man  ; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynmanbha ïa u .

translation.en: The sons of Amram  ; Aaron and Moses : and Aaron was separated , that he should sanctify the most holy things , he and his sons for ever , to burn incense before the  Lord  , to minister unto him , and to bless in his name for ever .
translation.kha: U Amram , u khun nyngkong jong u , u dei u kpa jong u Aaron bad u Moses . ( Ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u la pynkyrpang ban sumar junom ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba khuid , ban thang jingiwbih ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , ban shakri ïa u , bad ban kyrkhu ïa ki briew ha ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: But one thing is needful : and Mary hath chosen that good part , which shall not be taken away from her .
translation.kha: hynrei , tang kawei kaba donkam . Ka Mari ka la jied ïa kaei kaba dei , bad yn ym shim noh ïa kata na ka .

translation.en: And they called Barnabas , Jupiter  ; and Paul , Mercurius , because he was the chief speaker .
translation.kha: Ki la khot ïa u Barnabas da ka kyrteng Seus , bad ïa u Paul da ka kyrteng Hermes , namar ba u long u nongkren uba kham ha khmat .

translation.en: He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .
translation.kha: U la bret ïa nga ha ka ktieh ; ngam da ïapher shuh na ka jaboh .

translation.en: For now I will stretch out my hand , that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence  ; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth .
translation.kha: Lada nga la rah ïa la ka kti bad shoh ïa me bad ki briew jong me da ka jingpang , phin jin da la ïap lut khoit .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , All these things shall come upon this generation .
translation.kha: Nga ong shisha ha phi : Ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kine ki jingpynïap baroh kan hap halor ki briew jong kane ka juk !

translation.en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may continue for ever before thee : for thou , O Lord  God  , hast spoken it : and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la kular ïa kane , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan ïaisah bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga junom .

translation.en: Then Jesus saith unto them ,  Children , have ye any meat ?  They answered him , No .
translation.kha: Kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ko samla , phi la ïangat ei ei ?   Ei ei ruh em ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king s heart was toward Absalom .
translation.kha: U Joab u tip ba u Syiem Dabid u kynmaw ieit haduh katta katta ïa u Absalom ,

translation.en: I will be his father , and he shall be my son : and I will not take my mercy away from him , as I took it from him that was before thee :
translation.kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u bad un long u khun jong nga , ngan ym weng noh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong nga na u kumba nga la leh ïa u Saul , ïa uba nga la weng khnang ba me lah ban long syiem .

translation.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes , and juniper roots for their meat .
translation.kha: Ki la phut ïa ki jingthung jong ka ri shyiap bad bam ïa ki , wat ïa ki thied bym don jingmad jong u diengsynshar !

translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people , even like Israel , whom God went to redeem for a people to himself , and to make him a name , and to do for you great things and terrible , for thy land , before thy people , which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt , from the nations and their gods ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kaba kum ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki , ki briew jong me hi . Kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba phylla me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki la pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng satlak ka pyrthei . Me la beh noh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki blei jong ki katba ki briew jong me ki nang ïaid shaphrang , ki briew ïa kiba me la pyllaitluid na Ijipt ban long ki jong me hi .

translation.en: And I Daniel fainted , and was sick certain days  ; afterward I rose up , and did the king s business  ; and I was astonished at the vision , but none understood it .
translation.kha: Nga la noh mynsiem bad shitom bun bun sngi . Hadien kata nga la khie bad leit pat sha ka kam kaba u syiem u la ai ha nga , hynrei nga la shaïong da ka jingïohipaw bad ngam lah ban shemphang ïa ka .

translation.en: He that overcometh , the same shall be clothed in white raiment  ; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life , but I will confess his name before my Father , and before his angels .
translation.kha: Ïa kito kiba ïoh ka jingjop yn pynkup ïa ki kumne ha ki jaiñkup balieh , bad ngan ym weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab jong kiba im . Ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga bad ki angel jong u , ngan pynbna paidbah ba ki long ki jong nga .

translation.en: How much she hath glorified herself , and lived deliciously , so much torment and sorrow give her : for she saith in her heart , I sit a queen , and am no widow , and shall see no sorrow .
translation.kha: To ai ha ka , katta ka jingshitom bad ka jingsngewsih kat ka burom bad ka jingpahuh kaba ka la ai ïa lade . Naba ka ïai-ong ïa lade : ‘ Hangne nga shong , ka syiem ! Ngam long ka riewkynthei , ngan ym tip ïa ka jingsngewsih !’

translation.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation , and condemn them : for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar , ka syiem jong ka Sheba kan ïeng bad mudui ïa ki briew kiba mynta , namar ka la wan jngai na la ka jong ka ri ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong u syiem Solomon ; bad nga ong ha phi ba don uei re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Solomon .

translation.en: For he cometh in with vanity , and departeth in darkness , and his name shall be covered with darkness .
translation.kha: Kam wanrah jingbha ïa ita i khunlung i ban sa kha , i jah noh sha ka jingdum , ha kaba la klet noh ïa i .

translation.en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet  ; and he called his name Jedidiah , because of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad u la hukum ïa u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa ban jer kyrteng ïa u khynnah , u Jedidaïah , namar ba U  Trai  u la ieit ïa u .

translation.en: It took Tom several hours to assemble a bunk bed that the instructions said would take less than an hour to assemble .
translation.kha: Ka shim i'u Tom katto-katne kynta ban pyndait ia ka jingthiah ba ki jingbatai ki ong ba kan shim shikynta duna ban pyndait .
