translation.en: And they shall come from the east , and from the west , and from the north , and from the south , and shall sit down in the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi , na shatei bad na shathie , bad shong ha ka jingkhawai ha ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: His disciples said unto him , Lo , now speakest thou plainly , and speakest no proverb .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran jong u ki la ong ha u ,  Mynta te me kren shai kdar , khlem pyndonkam ïa ki rukom kren bapher .

translation.en: All the kings of the nations , even all of them , lie in glory , every one in his own house .
translation.kha: Baroh ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki thiah ha ki jingtep kiba itynnat ,

translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  was very angry with Israel , and removed them out of his sight : there was none left but the tribe of Judah only .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki Israel bad u pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u , da kaba iehnoh tang ïa ka hima Judah .

translation.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life , because we love the brethren . He that loveth not his brother abideth in death .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ngi la iehnoh ïa ka jingïap bad ngi la wan noh sha ka jingim ; ngi tip ïa ka namar ba ngi ieit ïa la ki hynmen ki para . Uno uno u bym ieit , u dang don hi hapoh ka bor jong ka jingïap .

translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , even the forgiveness of sins :
translation.kha: da uba la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ba la map ïa ki pop jong ngi .

translation.en: These are the sons of Ishmael , and these are their names , by their towns , and by their castles  ; twelve princes according to their nations .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong ki khat-ar jait , bad da ki kyrteng jong ki la jer ïa ki shnong bad ïa ki jaka sher dara jong ki .

translation.en: Fear not , O land  ; be glad and rejoice : for the  Lord  will do great things .
translation.kha: Ko ki lyngkha , wat sheptieng , hynrei to risa bad lehkmen namar baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa phi .

translation.en: The nations also heard of him  ; he was taken in their pit , and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang jong u bad ki la riam ïa u ha ka thliew . Da ki bnoh ki tan noh ïa u sha Ijipt .

translation.en: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba ïalam lynti bakla ïa u briew uba matlah .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign  ; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Abi , the daughter of Zachariah .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abijah , ka khun jong u Sekharaïah .

translation.en: I have heard what the prophets said , that prophesy lies in my name , saying , I have dreamed , I have dreamed .
translation.kha: Nga tip aïu kito ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong , ki da kren lamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad kam ba nga la ai ha ki ïa ki khubor jong nga ha ki jingphohsniew jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when she was in hard labour , that the midwife said unto her , Fear not  ; thou shalt have this son also .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingsuh kha ki la thar eh , ka nongpynkha khun ka ong ïa ka ,  Wat sheptieng , ko Rakhel ; u dei sa uwei pat u shynrang .

translation.en: And they said unto them , We cannot do this thing , to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised  ; for that were a reproach unto us :
translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong ,  Ngim lah ban ai ïa la ka jong ka para ba kan ïashongkurim bad u briew u bym shym la otsher ; kata kan long ka jingjahburom ïa ngi .

translation.en: His archers compass me round about , he cleaveth my reins asunder , and doth not spare  ; he poureth out my gall upon the ground .
translation.kha: bad siat ïa nga da ki khnam na baroh sawdong — ki khnam kiba sam lyngba ki pynmynsaw ïa nga : bad wat la katta ruh um pyn-i jingisynei .

translation.en: As they went out , behold , they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil .
translation.kha: Katba ki rangbah ki dang ïamih , katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wanlam sha U Jisu ïa u briew u bymnang kren namar ba u shongksuid .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead , that they might enlarge their border :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Ammon ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ha ki thma jong ki ban pynïoh bun ki jaka , ki la puid wat ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun ha Gilead .

translation.en: By honour and dishonour , by evil report and good report : as deceivers , and yet true ;
translation.kha: Ïa ngi la pyndonburom bad la pynlehrain ; la krenbeiñ bad la ïaroh . La ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongshukor , pynban ngi kren ïa ka jingshisha ;

translation.en: All that openeth the matrix is mine  ; and every firstling among thy cattle , whether ox or sheep , that is male .
translation.kha: Man la u khun ba la kha nyngkong , bad man la uba la kha nyngkong na ki jingri , ki dei ki jong nga . Hynrei phi dei ban thied biang ïa u kada ,

translation.en: He that heareth you heareth me  ; and he that despiseth you despiseth me  ; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa phi u shahshkor ïa nga ; uno uno uba kyntait ïa phi u kyntait ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga u kyntait ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Until the day in which he was taken up , after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban shim noh shajrong ïa u , u la ai ki jingbthah da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki rangbah kiba u la jied kum ki apostol jong u .

translation.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near , and smote Micaiah on the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit kiew sha u Mikaïah , u thab ïa u na ka ngab jong u , bad kylli ,  Naduh mynno u mynsiem jong U  Trai  u iehnoh ïa nga bad u kren ha me ?

translation.en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the  Lord  their God , but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat ki paid Judah ruh kim shym kohnguh ïa ki aiñ U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ki pyrthuh bud ïa ki rukom ba dang bat da ki paid Israel .

translation.en: When I heard , my belly trembled  ; my lips quivered at the voice : rottenness entered into my bones , and I trembled in myself , that I might rest in the day of trouble : when he cometh up unto the people , he will invade them with his troops .
translation.kha: Nga ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , bad nga kyiuh ; ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ki khih da ka jingsheptieng . Ka met jong nga ka jem lwep , bad ki kjat jong nga ki jynthut hapoh jong nga . Ngan ap jar jar ïa ka por ka ban wan haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa ngi .

translation.en: I will accept you with your sweet savour , when I bring you out from the people , and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered  ; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la wallam ïa phi na ki ri sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi bad nga lumlang ïa phi , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi thang , bad ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ba nga long uba khuid .

translation.en: O thou that art named the house of Jacob , is the spirit of the  Lord  straitened ? are these his doings ? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly ?
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki paid Israel ki don hapoh ka jingtim ? Hato U  Trai  u la duh noh ïa la ka jingïaishah ? Hato un da leh shisha ïa kine kiei kiei ? Hato um shym kren bha ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba dei ?

translation.en: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei um shym la pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jong u shaphang jongno ba u jied bad u kyrkhu .

translation.en: And David said unto him , How went the matter ? I pray thee , tell me . And he answered , That the people are fled from the battle , and many of the people also are fallen and dead  ; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba la jia ,  u Dabid u la ong .  Ka kynhun shipai jong ngi ka la phet krad na ka madan thma ,  u la jubab ,  bad bun na ki rangïapom jong ngi ki la shah pynïap . U Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ruh ki la shah pynïap .

translation.en: And he also that is valiant , whose heart is as the heart of a lion , shall utterly melt : for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man , and they which be with him are valiant men .
translation.kha: Nangta wat ki rangbah kiba shlur tam , ki bym ju tieng kum ki sing , kin sheptieng namar uwei pa uwei ha Israel u tip ba u kpa jong phi u dei u shipai bakhraw bad ba ki rangbah jong u ki dei ki nongïaleh kiba satar .

translation.en: But there the glorious  Lord  will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams  ; wherein shall go no galley with oars , neither shall gallant ship pass thereby .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyn-i ha ngi ïa ka burom jong u . Ngin shong ngin sah harud ki wah bad ki wahduid kiba ïar , hynrei ki liengbah jong ki nongshun kin ym ïaid ha ki .

translation.en: And she took a pan , and poured them out before him  ; but he refused to eat . And Amnon said , Have out all men from me . And they went out every man from him .
translation.kha: bad ka la shim ïa ki na u khiew shet na ka bynta jong u ban bam , hynrei um treh . U ong ,  Phah noh shabar ïa iwei pa iwei baroh  — bad baroh ki la mihnoh .

translation.en: Then he saith , I will return into my house from whence I came out  ; and when he is come , he findeth it empty , swept , and garnished .
translation.kha: u ong ha lade , ‘ Ngan leit phai pat sha la ïing .’ Kumta u leit phai pat bad u shem ba ka ïing ka thylli , ka khuid , bad baroh la buh ryntih .

translation.en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron : ( now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba : ) and they slew Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid pyrshah ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong basah ha ka nongbah Hebron , ïa kaba la ju khot ka Kiriath Arba . Hangta ki la jop ïa ki kur jong u Sheshai , u Ahiman bad u Talmai .

translation.en: And when he had opened the third seal , I heard the third beast say , Come and see . And I beheld , and lo a black horse  ; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba lai ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba lai uba ong ,  To wan !  Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai uba ïong . U nongshong kulai u la bat ïa ka tarajur ha la ka kti .

translation.en: Yea , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the  Lord  of hosts : and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them , and seethe therein : and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u khiew shet ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh ka Judah yn pynkyrpang na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ki briew kiba ai ïa ki jingkñia kin pyndonkam ïa ki ban phon ïa ka doh jong ki jingkñia . Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh uno uno u nongkhaïi ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Then the moon shall be confounded , and the sun ashamed , when the  Lord  of hosts shall reign in mount Zion , and in Jerusalem , and before his ancients gloriously .
translation.kha: U bnai un kylla dum , bad ka sngi kan ym tyngshaiñ shuh , namar U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un long u syiem . Un synshar ha Jerusalem halor u Lum Seïon , bad ki nongïalam jong ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong u .

translation.en: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal , to shew the people and the princes her beauty : for she was fair to look on .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki ban wallam shapoh ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei ba la phong ïa ka pansngiat syiem . Ka mahadei ka long ka briew kaba bhabriew , bad u syiem u kwah ban pyn-i sarong ïa ka jingbhabriew jong ka ha ki rangbah synshar bad ha baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .

translation.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison , he departed into Galilee  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ba ïa u Ïoannis la thep ha ka ïingbyndi , u la leit noh sha Galilaïa .

translation.en: And he set the one in Beth–el , and the other put he in Dan .
translation.kha: U buh ïa uwei u khun masi ksiar ha Bethel bad ïa uwei pat ha Dan .

translation.en: Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance : for God had given him substance very much .
translation.kha: Nalor kine , U Blei u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi bad shibun ka spah ka phew ba u ïoh ban tei shibun ki nongbah .

translation.en: Now therefore stand still , that I may reason with you before the  Lord  of all the righteous acts of the  Lord  , which he did to you and to your fathers .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïeng beit hangto , bad hangne ha khmat U  Trai  ngan mudui pyrshah ïa phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang ki kam kiba khraw ba U  Trai  u la leh ban pyllait ïa phi bad ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear you , when ye depart thence , shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them . Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
translation.kha: Lada phi wan poi ha ka shnong kaba ki briew kim khot sngewbha ïa phi lane kim sngap ïa phi , mihnoh na ka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi . Kata kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki !

translation.en: And I said unto them , We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews , which were sold unto the heathen  ; and will ye even sell your brethren ? or shall they be sold unto us ? Then held they their peace , and found nothing to answer .
translation.kha: Katba ngi lah , ngi la ïathied pat ïa ki para Jiw ïa kiba la die sha ki nongwei . Mynta phi pynlong ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi ban die ïa lade ha phi , ki para Jiw jong ki !  Ki nongïalam ki la sngap jar bad kim don ei ei ban ong .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Stand ye in the ways , and see , and ask for the old paths , where is the good way , and walk therein , and ye shall find rest for your souls . But they said , We will not walk therein .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  To ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad bad to khmih . Kylli shaphang ki lynti ïaid kiba mynbarim bad hangno ka don ka surok babha tam . To ïaid ha ka , bad phin im ha ka jingsuk .  Hynrei ki ong ,  Em , ngin ym leh !

translation.en: With him is wisdom and strength , he hath counsel and understanding .
translation.kha: Ki riewtymmen ki don ka jingstad , hynrei U Blei u don ka jingstad bad ka bor . Ki riewtymmen ki don ka jingïohi jngai ; U Blei u don ka jingïohi jngai bad ka bor ban pyntreikam .

translation.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead , she mourned for her husband .
translation.kha: Haba ka Bathsheba ka la ïohsngew ba u tnga jong ka u la shah pynïap , ka ïambriew na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Their houses are safe from fear , neither is the rod of God upon them .
translation.kha: U Blei um wallam satia ka jingpynjot ha ki longïing jong ki ; kim ju im ha ka jingshyrkhei .

translation.en: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in , and sat in the middle gate , even Nergal–sharezer , Samgar–nebo , Sarsechim , Rab–saris , Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: ( Haba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem , baroh ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan jong u syiem ka Babilonia ki la wan bad ki la ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Khyrdop Pdeng , kaba kynthup ïa ka Nergal Sareser , ka Samgar Nebo , ka Sarsekhim , bad kawei pat ka Nergal Sareser . )

translation.en: And he said , This is wickedness . And he cast it into the midst of the ephah  ; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ,  Kane ka kynthei ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jingbymman .  Nangta u ñiat ïa ka sha tbian shapoh jong ka shang bad u tap pat shapoh ïa ka jingtap .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Azariah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Ussaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: But the  Lord  your God ye shall fear  ; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ngan pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kaba nyngkong , ha ka por ka jingpynlong , ‘ U Blei u la thaw ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei ,’ kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .

translation.en: They come to fight with the Chaldeans , but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men , whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury , and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city .
translation.kha: Katto katne kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nong Babilonia , ki ban pyndap ïa ki ïing da ki metïap jong kito kiba ngan sa pynïap namar ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Nga la phai noh na kane ka nongbah namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki briew jong ka ki la leh .

translation.en: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God , and in the law , and in the commandments , to seek his God , he did it with all his heart , and prospered .
translation.kha: U la long uba jop , namar baroh kaba u la leh na ka bynta ka Templ lane ha kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum , u la leh ha ka mynsiem kaba ïaineh tylli bad aiti lut ha U Blei jong u .

translation.en: Eastward were six Levites , northward four a day , southward four a day , and toward Asuppim two and two .
translation.kha: Shaphang mihngi , don hynriew ngut ki nongap phira man la ka sngi ; shaphang shatei , bad shaphang shathie , saw ngut saw ngut la buh na ka bynta ka kamra buh tiar .

translation.en: And the wild asses did stand in the high places , they snuffed up the wind like dragons  ; their eyes did fail , because there was no grass .
translation.kha: Ki kada khlaw ki ïeng halor ki kliar lum bad ki thrang ban ring mynsiem kum ki myrsiang ; ka jingïohi ki khmat jong ki kam ïarap ïa ki namar kim don jingbam .

translation.en: Judah and Israel were many , as the sand which is by the sea in multitude , eating and drinking , and making merry .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah bad Israel ki long kiba bun paid kat u shyiap harud duriaw ; ki ïabam ki ïadih , bad ki suk ki saiñ .

translation.en: And went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak : and he said unto him , Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: Ki leh kumta , bad halor jong ka u la hiar arsut ha ka lynti nadien u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah bad u lap ïa u ba u shong ha trai uwei u dieng Sning .  Hato phi dei uta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ?  u kylli .  Nga dei ,  uta u briew u jubab .

translation.en: And I saw heaven opened , and behold a white horse  ; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True , and in righteousness he doth judge and make war .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba plie , bad la don u kulai uba lieh . Ïa u nongshong ha u la khot Uba Ïaineh bad Uba Shisha ; ka long da ka jinglehhok ba u bishar bad u ïaleh ïa ki jingïaleh thma jong u .

translation.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king , and said unto him , It appertaineth not unto thee , Uzziah , to burn incense unto the  Lord  , but to the priests the sons of Aaron , that are consecrated to burn incense : go out of the sanctuary  ; for thou hast trespassed  ; neither shall it be for thine honour from the  Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Ko Ussaïah ! Phim don hok ban thang jingiwbih ha U  Trai . Dei tang ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ïa kiba la pynkyntang ban leh ïa kane . Khie mihnoh na kane ka jaka kyntang . Phi la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai U Blei , bad phin ym ïoh shuh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u .

translation.en: And he said , I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life  ; and , lo , Sarah thy wife shall have a son . And Sarah heard it in the tent door , which was behind him .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u ong ,  Ngan sa wan biang sha me hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah ka tnga jong me kan sa ïoh khun shynrang .  Ka Sarah kaba ïeng hadien jong u ha ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ , ka pynshahshkor .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , why weepest thou ? whom seekest thou ?  She , supposing him to be the gardener , saith unto him , Sir , if thou have borne him hence , tell me where thou hast laid him , and I will take him away .
translation.kha: Ko kynthei , balei pha ïam ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ka ,  Ïano pha wad ?  Ka la nang pyrkhat ba u la dei u nongsumar kper , kumta ka la ong ha u ,  Lada me la rah noh ïa u , ko kynrad , to ïathuh ïa nga hangno me la buh ïa u , bad ngan ïoh leit bad shim ïa u .

translation.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa kine nalor ki jingainguh thang kiba man ka step .

translation.en: And thus they returned us answer , saying , We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth , and build the house that was builded these many years ago , which a great king of Israel builded and set up .
translation.kha: Ki jubab , ‘ Ngi dei ki shakri jong U Blei ka bneng bad ka khyndew , bad ngi tei pat ïa ka Templ kaba lah dep tei bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat bun snem mynshuwa da u syiem bakhrawbor ka Israel .

translation.en: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword , utterly destroying them : there was not any left to breathe : and he burnt Hazor with fire .
translation.kha: Ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba don hangta , ym don shuh uwei ruh uba dang lait im , bad la thang ruh ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon him , and he judged Israel , and went out to war : and the  Lord  delivered Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand  ; and his hand prevailed against Chushan–rishathaim .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la wan ha u , bad u kylla long u nongïalam jong ki Israel . U Othniel u leit sha ka thma , bad U  Trai  u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor u syiem ka Mesopotamia .

translation.en: If his master have given him a wife , and she have born him sons or daughters  ; the wife and her children shall be her master s , and he shall go out by himself .
translation.kha: Lada u kynrad jong u , u pynïoh ïa u ka tnga , bad ka ïoh khun shynrang ne kynthei na u , kata ka briew bad ki khun jong ka kin long ki jong u kynrad jong ka , bad uta u briew un mihnoh tang marwei .

translation.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you , and for them at Laodicea , and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh ;
translation.kha: To shah ngan ïathuh ïa phi haduh katno nga la trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi , bad na ka bynta ki briew ha Laodikaïa bad na ka bynta kiwei pat baroh ki bym ithuh ïa nga markhmat .

translation.en: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us  ; for thou hast done right , but we have done wickedly :
translation.kha: Me leh ïa kaba dei ban pynshitom ïa ngi ; Me long uba ïaineh , wat la ngi la leh pop .

translation.en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul , when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites , and David had abode two days in Ziklag  ;
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Saul , u Dabid u wan phai na ka jingjop jong u ïa ki Amalek bad u sah ar sngi ha Siklag .

translation.en: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for God will deliver it into the king s hand .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot shapoh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato ngan leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ?   Tur ïaleh ïa ka ,  ki jubab .  U Blei un ai jingjop ïa phi .

translation.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world , who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh . This is a deceiver and an antichrist .
translation.kha: Kiba bun ki nongshukor ki la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh , ki briew ki bym pdiang ba U Jisu Khrist u la wan kum u briew . Kum uta u briew , u long u nongshukor bad u Nongshun jong U Khrist .

translation.en: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Pha dei ban shahshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba jakhlia bad kiba ijli kiba pha la leh .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: They forgat God their saviour , which had done great things in Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Ki la klet ïa U Blei uba la pyllait im ïa ki da ki kam badonbor jong u ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And Judah said , Let her take it to her , lest we be shamed : behold , I sent this kid , and thou hast not found her .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Ai kan bat ïa kito ki tiar . Ngim kwah ba ki briew kin rkhie ïa ngi . Nga la pyrshang ban siew ïa ka , hynrei phim shym lap ïa ka .

translation.en: And he answered him , I am : go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga dei u Elijah ,  u jubab .  Khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem , u kynrad jong phi ba nga don hangne .

translation.en: And thus shall ye eat it  ; with your loins girded , your shoes on your feet , and your staff in your hand  ; and ye shall eat it in haste : it is the  Lord s  passover .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ïabam kyrkieh ïa ka , namar phi dei ban riam na ka bynta ban leit jingleit , lem bad ki juti ha ki kjat jong phi bad u diengduh ha ka kti jong phi . Ka dei ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side . This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin , by the coasts thereof round about , according to their families .
translation.kha: Ka Jordan ka dei u pud uba shaphang mihngi . Kine ki dei ki pud jong ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Hereby know we that we dwell in him , and he in us , because he hath given us of his Spirit .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi im ha U Blei bad ba u im hapoh jong ngi , namar ba u la ai ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u .

translation.en: For whoremongers , for them that defile themselves with mankind , for menstealers , for liars , for perjured persons , and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine ;
translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei ban kynmaw , da shisha , ba ïa ki hukum la thaw , ym na ka bynta ki briew ki babha , hynrei ïa ki nongpynkheiñ hukum bad ki riewrunar , na ka bynta kiba khlem Blei bad kiba pop , na ka bynta kito ki bymriewblei ne ki bym long kiba kynja mynsiem , kito kiba pynïap ïa la ki kpa bad ki kmie , na ka bynta ki nongpynïap briew , na ka bynta kiba leh kam ba-ijli , na ka bynta kiba awria , ki nongrahbor , na ka bynta kito kiba shukor bad kiba ai jingphla lamler lane kito kiba leh ïa kano kano kaba markhongpong ïa ka jinghikai kaba shisha .

translation.en: And ye murmured in your tents , and said , Because the  Lord  hated us , he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt , to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites , to destroy us .
translation.kha: Phi la ïakren khñium para ma phi : ‘ U  Trai  u isih ïa ngi . U la wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt tang ban aiti ïa ngi ha kine ki Amor , ba kin ïoh pynïap ïa ngi .

translation.en: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers , and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury .
translation.kha: Kumta , te , me la dei ban thep ïa ka pisa jong nga ha ka jaka kynshew pisa , bad ngan jin da la ïohpdiang ïa ka baroh lem bad ka sut haba nga la wan phai .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God .
translation.kha: Balei me khot babha ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ym don uba bha lait noh tang U Blei hi .

translation.en: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works , and by works was faith made perfect ?
translation.kha: Hato phim ïohi ? Ka jingngeit jong u bad ki kam jong u ki ïatreilang ; ïa ka jingngeit jong u la pynlong janai da ki kam jong u .

translation.en: Say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Shall it prosper ? shall he not pull up the roots thereof , and cut off the fruit thereof , that it wither ? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring , even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga kylli : Hato une u dieng sohwaiñ un im bad san ? Hato u pukni uba nyngkong un ym rat ïa u na ki thied , phut noh ïa ki sohwaiñ , bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat bad shah ïa ki ban ïapstai ? Kam da shim shibun eh ka jingkhlaiñ lane ka hima bakhlaiñbor ban rat ïa ka .

translation.en: Without father , without mother , without descent , having neither beginning of days , nor end of life  ; but made like unto the Son of God  ; abideth a priest continually .
translation.kha: Ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang u kpa lane ka kmie lane jong kino kino ki kpa tymmen jong u Melkhisedek ; ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang ka jingkha lane ka jingïap jong u . U syriem ïa U Khun U Blei , u ïaisah u lyngdoh junom .

translation.en: And Joab returned from following Abner : and when he had gathered all the people together , there lacked of David s servants nineteen men and Asahel .
translation.kha: Haba u Joab u la keiñ noh ïa ka jingbeh kthong , u la lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , bad u la shem ba khatkhyndai ngut na ki , ki la jah , nalor u Asahel .

translation.en: And the land was not able to bear them , that they might dwell together : for their substance was great , so that they could not dwell together .
translation.kha: Kumta ka jaka bam phlang kam biang ïa ki baroh ar ngut ban ïasah ryngkat , namar ba ki don shibun eh ki jingri .

translation.en: And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Israel — ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw — da ka jingkmen ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And the people stood up all that day , and all that night , and all the next day , and they gathered the quails : he that gathered least gathered ten homers : and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki ïakem  iar khiar baroh shi sngi ha kata ka sngi , baroh shi miet , bad baroh shi sngi ha kawei pat ka sngi ; ym don uwei ruh uba lum duna ïa ka shihajar kilo . Nangta ki thad ïa ki sawdong kata ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man s hands shall be rendered unto him .
translation.kha: Ka bainong jong phi ka shong ha kaei kaba phi ong bad kaei kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi dei hok .

translation.en: And he laid his hands on them , and departed thence .
translation.kha: U la buh la ki kti halor jong ki bad nangta u la leit noh .

translation.en: And I said , Should such a man as I flee ? and who is there , that , being as I am , would go into the temple to save his life ? I will not go in .
translation.kha: Nga jubab ,  Ngam dei u briew uba shait phet bad rieh . Hato phi pyrkhat ba ngan pyrshang ban pynim ïa la ka jingim da kaba rieh ha ka Templ ? Ngan ym leh kumta .

translation.en: If my land cry against me , or that the furrows likewise thereof complain  ;
translation.kha: Lada nga la tuh ïa ka jaka kaba nga rep bad knieh ïa ka na ki trai kiba dei hok —

translation.en: And I saw no temple therein : for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it .
translation.kha: Ngam shym ïohi ïa ka templ ha ka nongbah , namar ka templ jong ka , u long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh bad U Khunlangbrot .

translation.en: I say unto you , Though he will not rise and give him , because he is his friend , yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth .
translation.kha: Te , kaei pat ? Nga ong ha phi ba wat la un ym khie bad ai ha phi ïa u kpu , namar ba phi dei u paralok jong u , pynban un khie joit bad ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi donkam namar ba phim lehrain ban ïai pan .

translation.en: Moreover he put out Zedekiah s eyes , and bound him with chains , to carry him to Babylon .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , la pynmatlah ïa ki khmat u Sedekaïah bad la teh ïa u da ki kynjri ban rah ïa u sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Behold , these shall come from far : and , lo , these from the north and from the west  ; and these from the land of Sinim .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin wan na jngai bah , na shatei bad na sepngi , bad na Aswan kaba don shathie .

translation.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word , saying , When wilt thou comfort me ?
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki thait ïan ha kaba ap ïa ka jingkular jong me ; katba nga kylli ,  Lano keiñ men ïarap ïa nga ?

translation.en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers , uncircumcised in heart , and uncircumcised in flesh , to be in my sanctuary , to pollute it , even my house , when ye offer my bread , the fat and the blood , and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations .
translation.kha: Ki la pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga da kaba shah ïa ki nongwei bym shym la otsher , ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa nga ban rung sha ka Templ katba ïa ka khleiñ bad ka snam jong ki jingkñia la dang ainguh ha nga . Kumta ki briew jong nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga da baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .

translation.en: They say unto him , Because no man hath hired us . He saith unto them , Go ye also into the vineyard  ; and whatsoever is right , that shall ye receive .
translation.kha: ‘ Ym don mano mano ba khot bylla ïa ngi ,’ ki la jubab . ‘ Lada kumta , te , phi ruh khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ ,’ u la ong ha ki .

translation.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons that were left , Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and eat it without leaven beside the altar : for it is most holy :
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron , bad ha ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u kiba dang sah , u Eleasar bad u Ithamar ,  Shim ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba sah na kata ka jingbam kaba la kñia sha U  Trai  , pynlong kpu khlem thiat da ka bad bam ïa ka harud ka duwan , namar kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba khuid bha .

translation.en: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me , and set me upon my feet , that I heard him that spake unto me .
translation.kha: Katba kata ka sur ka dang kren , U Mynsiem U Blei u la rung ha nga , bad u la pynïeng ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur ba ka dang ïai kren ,

translation.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not , nor rejected ; but received me as an angel of God , even as Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat la ka jinglong ka met jong nga ka la long ka jingtynjuh bakhraw ïa phi , phim shym la ibeiñ ne kyntait ïa nga . Pynban phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa u angel na bneng ; phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu hi .

translation.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him , saying , Master , eat .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki synran ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , to bam ei ei !

translation.en: And he came to the second , and said likewise . And he answered and said , I go , sir : and went not .
translation.kha: Nangta u kpa u la leit sha uwei pat u khun bad u la ong ïa kajuh . ‘ Ho-oid , pa’ u la jubab , hynrei um shym la leit .

translation.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil : and in his lips there is as a burning fire .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki wad ïa ki lynti ban pynmynsaw ïa kiwei ; wat ki ktien jong ki , ki long kiba thang da ka jingsniew .

translation.en: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the  Lord  , and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the  Lord . So he finished the house .
translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , u Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh pynïasuk ha kata ka duwan ba u la tei ha U  Trai . U thang ruh ïa ka jingiwbih ha khmat U  Trai . Bad kumta u pyndep kaba tei ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and shall return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynjia ïa u nongsynshar ban ïohsngew ïa ka hamsaïa ka ban pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka ri , bad U  Trai  un pynjia ba yn pynïap ïa u hangta .

translation.en: But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :
translation.kha: Nga da kwah eh ba phin long kiba lait na ka jingkhuslai . U briew u bym shym shongkurim u pyrkhat ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai , namar u wad ban pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .

translation.en: In transgressing and lying against the  Lord  , and departing away from our God , speaking oppression and revolt , conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me , kyntait ïa me , bad ngim treh ban bud ïa me . Ngi la banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad phai lyndet na me . Ki jingmut jong ngi ki long kiba bakla ; ki ktien jong ngi ki long kiba lamler .

translation.en: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country  ; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine .
translation.kha: Kumta u la leit ban trei na ka bynta uwei na ki traishnong jong kata ka ri , uba la phah ïa u sha ka jaka ri jingri jong u ban sumar ïa ki sniang .

translation.en: If any man speak in an unknown tongue , let it be by two , or at the most by three , and that by course ; and let one interpret .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u mut ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , la kumno kumno ar ne lai ngut ki dei ban kren , uwei hadien uwei pat , bad uwei pat u dei ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .

translation.en: Send them away , that they may go into the country round about , and into the villages , and buy themselves bread : for they have nothing to eat .
translation.kha: To phah noh ïa ki briew , bad ai ba kin leit sha ki lyngkha kiba hajan bad ki nongrit khnang ba kin thied ei ei ïa lade ban bam .

translation.en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king : his mouth transgresseth not in judgment .
translation.kha: U syiem u kren da ka iktiar blei ; ki rai jong u borabor ki long kiba dei .

translation.en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven : behold , it shall come down upon Edom , and upon the people of my curse , to judgment .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhreh ïa ka waitlam jong u ha bneng , bad mynta kan mait ïa ki Edom , kita ki briew ïa kiba u la pynrem sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab : and Eglon was a very fat man .
translation.kha: Nangta u leit rah ïa ki jingai sngewbha sha u Eglon , uba long u briew uba sngaid shibun .

translation.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph : and these are the names of his daughters  ; Mahlah , Noah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Tirzah .
translation.kha: Ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah , ki long ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph .

translation.en: Let all your things be done with charity .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ki kam jong phi baroh da ka jingieit .

translation.en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ba u patsha un ïohsngew ïa ka jingbna wer wer ka ban pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka ri , bad U  Trai  un shah ba yn pynïap ïa u hangta .

translation.en: And , behold , there came an old man from his work out of the field at even , which was also of mount Ephraim  ; and he sojourned in Gibeah : but the men of the place were Benjamites .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , uwei u tymmen uba dang wan phai na lyngkha bad ïaid nangta ynda la janmiet . U dei uba na ri lum Ephraim , hynrei ha kata ka por u shong u sah ha Gibeah . ( Kiwei kiba shong hangta ki dei na ka jait Benjamin . )

translation.en: If you apply God’s Word , you will be a happier person .
translation.kha: Lada phi pyndonkam ïa ka ktien u Blei , phin long ki briew ba kmen tam .

translation.en: Concerning Kedar , and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite , thus saith the  Lord   ; Arise ye , go up to Kedar , and spoil the men of the east .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka jait Kedar bad ïa ki distrik hapoh ka jingpynïaid u Hasor , ïa kiba la jop thma da u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia :  Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Kedar bad pynjot ïa kata ka jait jong ki briew na mihngi !

translation.en: And went to him , and bound up his wounds , pouring in oil and wine , and set him on his own beast , and brought him to an inn , and took care of him .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u , u la theh umphniang bad ka waiñ ha ki jingmong jong u bad u la spaiñ ïa ki ; nangta u la buh ïa uta u briew halor u jingri jong u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbasa    , ha kaba u la sumar ïa u .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; It shall also come to pass , that at the same time shall things come into thy mind , and thou shalt think an evil thought :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa u Gog :  Haba kata ka por ka la poi , men sa sdang pyrkhat ïa ka buit sniew .

translation.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant , that I may live , and keep thy word .
translation.kha: To long uba bha ïa nga , u shakri jong me , khnang ba ngan ïoh im , bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me .

translation.en: He hath destroyed me on every side , and I am gone : and mine hope hath he removed like a tree .
translation.kha: U la shoh ïa nga na baroh sawdong . U la jynrat noh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga bad u iehnoh ïa nga ban tyrkhong bad ban ïap .

translation.en: Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee  ; who is he that will strike hands with me ?
translation.kha: Nga long hok , A Blei . Pdiang ïa ka ktien jong nga . Ym don mano mano u ban kyrshan ïa kaba nga ong .

translation.en: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death , and have crucified him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongsynshar jong ngi ki la aiti noh ïa u ban rai pynïap , bad ïa u la sahnarphna .

translation.en: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord , which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh ;
translation.kha: Ka dei shaphang U Khun jong u , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi : Shaphang ka jinglongbriew jong u , ïa u la kha uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ;

translation.en: For all that is in the world , the lust of the flesh , and the lust of the eyes , and the pride of life , is not of the Father , but is of the world .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba dei jong ka pyrthei — kaei kaba ka malade bapop ka brai , kaei kaba ki briew ki ïohi bad kwah , bad baroh kiei kiei kiba ha ka pyrthei kiba ki briew ki sngewsarong — ym don na kane kaba wan na U Kpa ; baroh ka wan na ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah : but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim  ;
translation.kha: Ka jaka sawdong jong ka Tappuah ka dei jong ka jait Manasseh , hynrei ka shnong Tappuah , ha khappud , ka dei ka jong ki khun ki ksiew u Ephraim .

translation.en: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief : but a man of understanding hath wisdom .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba bieit ban sngewtynnat haba leh bymdei . Ki briew kiba stad ki sngewbha ha ka jingstad .

translation.en: I shall see him , but not now : I shall behold him , but not nigh : there shall come a Star out of Jacob , and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel , and shall smite the corners of Moab , and destroy all the children of Sheth .
translation.kha: Nga khmih sha ka lawei , Bad nga ïohi ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . U syiem , uba kum u khlur phyrnai , un mih ha kata ka jaitbynriew . Kum u  lur dih duma un wan mih na Israel . Un shoh ïa ki nongïalam ki Moab , Bad un pyndem ïa ki briew jong u Seth .

translation.en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power  ; and the earth was lightened with his glory .
translation.kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba wan hiar na bneng . U la don ka bor bakhraw , bad ka jingphyrnai jong u ka la pynthaba ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: He esteemeth iron as straw , and brass as rotten wood .
translation.kha: Ïa u , u nar u stang kum u phlangïap , bad ka rnong ka jem kum ka dieng pyut .

translation.en: They give drink to every beast of the field : the wild asses quench their thirst .
translation.kha: Ki pynbiang um ïa ki mradkhlaw ; hangta ki kada khlaw ki pynjah ïa ka jingsliang jong ki .

translation.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness , and not cut down , it withereth before any other herb .
translation.kha: Lada ka um ka tyrkhong noh , dei ma ki kiba ïapstai nyngkong , katba ki dang rit eh ïa ka ban ot bad pyndonkam .

translation.en: And when he came into the house , he suffered no man to go in , save Peter , and James , and John , and the father and the mother of the maiden .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha ïing , um shym shah ïano ïano ban rung shapoh bad u lait noh u Petros , u Ïoannis bad u Jakob , bad u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka khynnah .

translation.en: Speak unto Rehoboam , the son of Solomon , king of Judah , and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin , and to the remnant of the people , saying ,
translation.kha: ban ai ka khubor ha u Rehoboam bad ha ki briew baroh jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin :

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Go unto the altar , and offer thy sin offering , and thy burnt offering , and make an atonement for thyself , and for the people : and offer the offering of the people , and make an atonement for them  ; as the  Lord  commanded .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Aaron ,  Khie leit sha ka duwan bad kñia ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa ka jingainguh thang ba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong phi bad ïa ki pop jong ki paidbah . Leh ïa kane ba yn ïohmap noh ïa ki pop jong ki paidbah , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: In those days shall Judah be saved , and Jerusalem shall dwell safely : and this is the name wherewith she shall be called , The  Lord  our righteousness .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem yn pyllait im bad kin im hapdeng ka jingshngain . Ïa ka nongbah yn khot ‘ U  Trai  ka Jingpynim jong ngi .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned , and was dead , that Jezebel said to Ahab , Arise , take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , which he refused to give thee for money : for Naboth is not alive , but dead .
translation.kha: Ka Jesebel mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor , ka ong ïa u Ahab ,  U Naboth u la ïap . To khie leit mynta bad shimti noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ kaba um shym treh ban die ha phi .

translation.en: I have seen , I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt , and I have heard their groaning , and am come down to deliver them . And now come , I will send thee into Egypt .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshah shitom bashyrkhei jong ki briew jong nga ha Ijipt . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingud jong ki , bad nga la wan hiar ban pyllaitluid ïa ki . Ale mynta ; ngan phah ïa me sha Ijipt .’

translation.en: To whom I answered , It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die , before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face , and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ïa ki ba ma ngi ki nong Rom ngim ju mlien ban aiti ïa uno uno uba la shah kynnoh ha ka kam runar ha shuwa ba un ïakynduh ïa ki nongmudui jong u markhmat bad ba u la ïoh ka lad ban ïasaid da ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka jingkynnoh .

translation.en: And it was so , that , after they had carried it about , the hand of the  Lord  was against the city with a very great destruction : and he smote the men of the city , both small and great , and they had emerods in their secret parts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ka la poi hangta , U  Trai  u pynshitom sa ïa kata ka nongbah ruh bad u pynkhih kulmar ïa ka . U pynshitom ïa ki da ki jingpang thung kiba mih ha baroh ki briew jong ka nongbah , ki samla bad tymmen kumjuh .

translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka bang palat — katno ngi sngewieit ban nguid tylli ïa ka !

translation.en: Then they went out to see what was done  ; and came to Jesus , and found the man , out of whom the devils were departed , sitting at the feet of Jesus , clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ïaleit ban peit ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , bad haba ki la poi ha U Jisu , ki la shem ïa u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh , ba u da shong ha ki kjat jong U Jisu , u la phong jaiñ bad ha ka jingtipbriew ; bad baroh ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka mane blei thala , ha ki lum , bad hapoh ka syrngiew jong ki dieng baroh , u Ahas u ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih .

translation.en: The words of king Lemuel , the prophecy that his mother taught him .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien shongkhia kiba ka kmie u syiem Lemuel ka kren ha u :

translation.en: And the sons of Midian  ; Ephah , and Epher , and Hanoch , and Abida , and Eldaah . All these were the children of Keturah .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Midian ki long u Ephah , u Epher , u Hanokh , u Abida , bad u Eldaah . Kine baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Keturah .

translation.en: Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong : but I will make them suddenly run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?
translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ki khlaw barben kiba don shi lynter ka rud Jordan haduh ka jaka phlang bajyrngam , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan wan bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Babilonia ban phet krad kynsan na ka nongbah jong ki . Te u nongïalam uba nga jied un synshar ïa ka hima . Mano ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba nud ban wan kob ïa nga ? Uei u nongsynshar uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa nga ?

translation.en: This I had , because I kept thy precepts .
translation.kha: Nga shem ïa ka jingkmen jong nga ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: One shall say , I am the  Lord s   ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob  ; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the  Lord  , and surname himself by the name of Israel .
translation.kha: Uwei hadien uwei , ki briew kin ong , ‘ nga long u jong U TRAI’ . Kin ïawan ban ïasnoh bad u paid Israel . Uwei pa uwei un shon ha ka ksang ti jong u ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad un khot ïa lade uwei na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John , and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men , they marvelled  ; and they took knowledge of them , that they had been with Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohi kumno u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la long kiba shlur bad ban tip ba ki long ki riewpaidbah ki bymnang bymstad . Ki la sngewthuh te ba ki la long ki nongsynran jong U Jisu .

translation.en: The Spirit of God hath made me , and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga bad uba ai jingim ïa nga .

translation.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la ong ban pynjot ïa ki briew jong u , u shakri ba la jied jong u , u Moses , u la ïeng pyrshah ïa U Blei bad khang ïa ka jingbitar jong u na kaba pynjot noh ïa ki .

translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field , neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba don ha ki tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit ban ot ruh ïa u sohkew uba sah hadien ba phi la lum .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live  ; for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Uno uno uba shong ha ka nongbah un ïap ha ka thma lane ka jingïapthngan lane ka jingpang . Hynrei uno uno uba mihnoh bad uba pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , yn ym pynïap ; la kumno kumno un pyllait ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: He is a merchant , the balances of deceit are in his hand : he loveth to oppress .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long bymhok kum ki nong Kanaan ; ki sngewtynnat ban shukor ïa ki nongthied da ki tarajur bymhok .

translation.en: With him is an arm of flesh  ; but with us is the  Lord  our God to help us , and to fight our battles . And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah .
translation.kha: U don ka bor briew , hynrei ngi don U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïaleh ïa ki thma jong ngi .  Ki briew ki ïoh ïa ka jingpynshlur da kine ki ktien jong u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night , and said to him , Behold , thou art but a dead man , for the woman which thou hast taken  ; for she is a man s wife .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , U Blei u mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew , bad u ong ha u ,  Men sa ïap , namar me la shim ïa kane ka briew ; ka la dep shongkurim .

translation.en: Said with a loud voice , Stand upright on thy feet . And he leaped and walked .
translation.kha: To ïeng beit ha la ki kjat jong me !  Uta u briew u la kynthih bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylleng .

translation.en: And the same man had four daughters , virgins , which did prophesy .
translation.kha: U la don saw ngut ki khun kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .

translation.en: And I have oxen , and asses , flocks , and menservants , and womenservants : and I have sent to tell my lord , that I may find grace in thy sight .
translation.kha: Nga don ki masi , ki kada , ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki mraw . Nga phah ktien sha phi ko kynrad da ka jingkyrmen ba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .

translation.en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty . And the third captain of fifty went up , and came and fell on his knees before Elijah , and besought him , and said unto him , O man of God , I pray thee , let my life , and the life of these fifty thy servants , be precious in thy sight .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u syiem u la phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah . U la leit kiew ïa u lum , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat u Elijah , bad u la ïasaid ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , to isynei ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga . To pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ngi !

translation.en: Is he the God of the Jews only ? is he not also of the Gentiles ? Yes , of the Gentiles also :
translation.kha: Lane ba U Blei u long U Blei tang jong ki Jiw ? Hato um dei U Blei jong ki Jentil ruh ? Da shisha u dei .

translation.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight . He said unto them , He put clay upon mine eyes , and I washed , and do see .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi , te , ki la kylli biang ïa uta u briew kumno u la ïoh imat pat . U la ïathuh ïa ki ,  U la tah khyndiat ka ktieh ha ki khmat jong nga ; nga la bta khmat , bad mynta nga la imat .

translation.en: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances , and have not kept them . Return unto me , and I will return unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts . But ye said , Wherein shall we return ?
translation.kha: Ma phi , kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha shuwa jong phi , phi la phai noh na ki aiñ jong nga bad phim shym la sumar ïa ki . To phai pat sha nga , bad ngan phai sha phi . Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ban phai pat sha me ?’

translation.en: Then cried he upon me , and spake unto me , saying , Behold , these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la pyrta jam sha nga ,  Ki kulai kiba la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia ki la pynjai jai ïa ka jingbitar jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Thou wilt say then , The branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in .
translation.kha: Hynrei phin ong ,  Ho-oid , ïa ki tnat la pynkheiñ noh ban ai jaka na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki jingker kiba pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .

translation.en: Either make the tree good , and his fruit good  ; or else make the tree corrupt , and his fruit corrupt : for the tree is known by his fruit .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh ïa u soh uba bha phi dei ban don u dieng uba plung bha ; lada phi don u dieng uba swai , phin ïoh u soh uba sniew . Ïa u dieng la tip da u jait soh ba u pynmih .

translation.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side :
translation.kha: Dei ban don hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: I remembered thy judgments of old , O  Lord   ; and have comforted myself .
translation.kha: Nga kynmaw ïa ki jingbishar jong me kiba mynbarim , bad ki wallam jingpyntngen ïa nga , A  Trai .

translation.en: With clouds he covereth the light  ; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt .
translation.kha: U kem ïa ka leilieh da la ki kti bad u hukum ïa ka ban tied ïa kaba thmu .

translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall hate you , and when they shall separate you from their company , and shall reproach you , and cast out your name as evil , for the Son of man s sake .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki isih ïa phi ; kiba kyntait ïa phi , ki krenbeiñ ïa phi , bad ki ong ba phi long uba sniew , baroh namar U Khun U Briew !

translation.en: And there were seven steps to go up to it , and the arches thereof were before them : and it had palm trees , one on this side , and another on that side , upon the posts thereof .
translation.kha: La don hynñiew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka , bad ka kamra rung jong ka , ka la don ha kaba kut marpyrshah ïa ka phyllaw . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong ha ki halor ki kynroh bashapoh kiba phai khmat sha ka lynti ïaid .

translation.en: And this was done three times : and all were drawn up again into heaven .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia lai sien , bad khatduh ïa kata baroh kawei la tan pat sha bneng .

translation.en: But Abram said unto Sarai , Behold , thy maid is in thy hand  ; do to her as it pleaseth thee . And when Sarai dealt hardly with her , she fled from her face .
translation.kha: U Abram u ong ,  Ñiuma , ka dei ka mraw jong pha bad hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong pha ; leh ïa ka katba pha sngewbit .  Kumta ka Sarai ka lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa ka kat haduh ba ka la phet noh .

translation.en: And there was also a strife among them , which of them should be accounted the greatest .
translation.kha: Ka jingïasaid nia ka la jia hapdeng ki synran ba ïa uno na ki yn ñiew ba u long uba khraw tam .

translation.en: And Bilhah Rachel s maid conceived again , and bare Jacob a second son .
translation.kha: Ka Bilhah ka la punkhun biang , bad ka la kha khun shynrang uba ar ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .
translation.kha: To ngin long shlur , te , bad ong ,  U Trai u long u nongïarap jong nga , ngan ym sheptieng . Uei uba lah ban leh ei ei ïa nga ?

translation.en: And he went out , and followed him  ; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel  ; but thought he saw a vision .
translation.kha: U Petros u la bud ïa u shabar jong ka byndi , khlem da tip , la kaei kaba u angel u la leh ka long kaba shisha ; u la pyrkhat ba u la ïohi ka jingïohipaw .

translation.en: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand , which is the token in every epistle : so I write .
translation.kha: Da ki kti jong nga hi , nga thoh ïa kane : Ki jingkhublei na u Paul . Kane ka dei ka rukom ba nga soi ïa kawei pa kawei ka shithi ; kane ka long kumno nga thoh .

translation.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki jingpyrta da kaba kmen ïa ka jingjop ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki briew jong U Blei :  Ka borbah jong U  Trai  ka la leh ïa ka !

translation.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge : because thou hast rejected knowledge , I will also reject thee , that thou shalt be no priest to me : seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God , I will also forget thy children .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki shu jot ei namar kim pdiang ïa nga . Phi ki lyngdoh phim suidñiew ban pdiang ïa nga bad phi la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad kumta nga la kyntait noh ïa phi bad ngan ym pdiang ïa ki khun jong phi kum ki lyngdoh jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , they shall surely gather together , but not by me : whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u tur ïaleh ïa pha u leh ïa ka khlem ka jingaibor jong nga ; uno uno uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa pha un kyllon noh .

translation.en: A just weight and balance are the  Lord s  : all the weights of the bag are his work .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kwah ba ki tarajur bad ki mawthew ki dei ban long kiba beit bad baroh ka jingïadie ïathied kan long kaba hok .

translation.en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee ? was he found among thieves ? for since thou spakest of him , thou skippedst for joy .
translation.kha: Ko Moab , to kynmaw kumno pha rkhiebeiñ ïa ki paid Israel ? Pha la leh ïa ki kumba ki la ngat ha ka kynhun ki nonglute .

translation.en: And now abideth faith , hope , charity , these three ; but the greatest of these is charity .
translation.kha: Kine lai tylli kin ïaisah : Ka jingngeit , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingieit ; bad kaba khraw tam na kine ka long ka jingieit .

translation.en: But let your communication be , Yea , yea  ; Nay , nay : for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil .
translation.kha: Shu ong ‘ Ho-oid’ lane ‘ Em’ — kano kano kawei pat kaba phi ong ka wan na Uta uba Sniew .

translation.en: This image s head was of fine gold , his breast and his arms of silver , his belly and his thighs of brass ,
translation.kha: Ïa ka khlieh jong ka la shna da ka ksiar banylla tam ; ïa ka shadem bad ki kti jong ka la shna da ka rupa ; ïa ka syngkai bad ka skhep jong ka da ka rnong ;

translation.en: For where envying and strife is , there is confusion and every evil work .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ka don ka jingpihuiñ bad ka jingkhwan myntoi , hangta ka don ruh ka jingbymïaid ryntih bad ki jait jingsniew baroh .

translation.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron  ; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the  Lord  : and they anointed David king over Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan sha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron . U la pynlong ïa jingïateh lok bakyntang bad ki , ki la pynsleh ïa u , bad u la long u syiem ki Israel .

translation.en: As thou hast sent me into the world , even so have I also sent them into the world .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ki sha ka pyrthei , kumba me la phah ïa nga sha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: A fruitful land into barrenness , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka khyndew basboh ban kylla ri khlaw mluh namar ka jingbymman jong kito kiba shong hangta .

translation.en: Pass ye unto Calneh , and see  ; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great : then go down to Gath of the Philistines : be they better than these kingdoms ? or their border greater than your border ?
translation.kha: Khie leit bad khmih ïa ka nongbah Kalneh . Nangta ïai leit sha ka nongbah bakhraw ka Hamath bad leit hiar sha Gath , ka nongbah ki Philistia . Hato ki kham bha ma ki ban ïa ki hima jong ka Judah bad Israel ? Hato ka ri jong ki ka kham heh ban ïa ka jong phi ?

translation.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet , which wanteth not liquor : thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies .
translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u la leit sha la ka kper , ha kaba ki dieng balsam ki mih . U dang pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u bad lum ïa ki  tiew lili .

translation.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim , saying , Come down against the Midianites , and take before them the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan . Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and took the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan .
translation.kha: U Gideon u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ka ri lum Ephraim baroh ban ong ,  Ale wan hiar ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian . Ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah , ban khang ïa ki Midian na kaba jam ïa ki sha shiliang .  Ki rangbah Ephraim ki la ïalumlang , bad ki la ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha kita ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah .

translation.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps : there was not the like made in any kingdom .
translation.kha: Ka khet ka don hynriew kyrdon ban kiew shajrong ïa ka , ka don ka dur u sing uwei uwei ha ki tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyndon . Ba baroh ka long khat-ar tylli ki sing . Hadien jong ka khet la don ka dur khlieh jong u khun masi dab , bad ha syndah kawei pa kawei na ki ar tylli ki jingbat kti don ka dur jong u sing . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha kawei pat ka hima .

translation.en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself  ; and discover not a secret to another :
translation.kha: Lada ma phi bad la u paramarjan phi don ka jingïapher jingmut , ïakren pynbeit para ma phi bad wat pynpaw ïa kino kino ki kam barieh .

translation.en: Then touched he their eyes , saying ,  According to your faith be it unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ktah ïa ki khmat jong ki bad u la ong ,  Ai ba kan jia long , te , kumba phi ngeit !  —

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joram saw Jehu , that he said , Is it peace , Jehu ? And he answered , What peace , so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many ?
translation.kha: Hato me wan ha ka jingsuk ?  u Joram u kylli ïa u . U Jehu u jubab ,  Kumno kan don ka jingsuk haba ngi dang don baroh ki jingleh byrtong bad ki jingmane bleithaw kiba ka Jesebel ka kmie jong me ka la sdang ?

translation.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , even from following the sheep , that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta ong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga ong ha u , ‘ nga la shim ïa me na kaba sumar ïa ki langbrot ha ki jaka phlang bad pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel .

translation.en: But woe unto you that are rich ! for ye have received your consolation .
translation.kha: Hynrei katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba riewspah mynta ; phi la lah ïoh ïa ka jingim suk !

translation.en: Behold , he putteth no trust in his saints  ; yea , the heavens are not clean in his sight .
translation.kha: Balei , U Blei um shaniah wat ïa ki angel jong u ; wat ma ki kim long kiba khuid ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: And it was revealed in mine ears by the  Lord  of hosts , Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die , saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh da lade hi u la kren ha nga bad ong ,  Ïa kane kaba sniew jong ki yn ym map da lei lei katba ki dang im . Ma nga , U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh nga la kren .

translation.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil , and of the blood which was upon the altar , and sprinkled it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon his sons  garments with him  ; and sanctified Aaron , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
translation.kha: U Moses u shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh bad khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha ka duwan bad u synreit ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom u pynkyntang ïa ki bad ïa ki jaiñ jong ki sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not , neither did the cruse of oil fail , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Elijah .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la kular lyngba u Elijah , ka pliang  purew kam shym la thylli lymne u klong um shym long khlem umphniang .

translation.en: Giving no offence in any thing , that the ministry be not blamed :
translation.kha: Ngim kwah ïano ïano ban wad daw ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi , kumta ngi pyrshang ban ym buh ïa ki jingjynthut ha ka lynti jongno jongno .

translation.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them .
translation.kha: Kumta phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad kiba kum kita ki briew .

translation.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites , that dwelt in the mountain , and in the south , and in the valley .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , ki leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka ri lum , ha ki trai ki lum , bad ha ka ri ryngkhiang kaba shaphang shathie .

translation.en: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi phla ïa ki pop jong ngi ha U Blei , un bat ïa la ka kular bad un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un map ïa ngi ïa ki pop jong ngi bad un pynkhuid ïa ngi na ki kam bymman baroh .

translation.en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the ending ,  saith the Lord ,  which is , and which was , and which is to come , the Almighty .
translation.kha: Nga long u Alpha bad u Omega ,  ong U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uba long , uba la long bad u ban sa wan .

translation.en: They shall take up serpents  ; and if they drink any deadly thing , it shall not hurt them  ; they shall lay hands on the sick , and they shall recover .
translation.kha: lada ki shim ïa ki bseiñ lane dih kano kano ka bih , kin ym mynsaw ; kin buh ïa la ki kti ha kiba pang , ki ban ïoh ka jingkhiah .

translation.en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts , to the which also ye are called in one body ; and be ye thankful .
translation.kha: Ka jingsuk kaba U Khrist u ai , ka long ban kdew lynti ïa phi ha ki rai kiba phi shim ; naba dei ïa kane ka jingsuk ba U Blei u la khot lang ïa phi ha kawei ka met . Bad to long kiba sngewnguh .

translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
translation.kha: Balei ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat jong u para jong phi , hynrei phim pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha ka khmat jong phi ?

translation.en: And Moses gave unto them , even to the children of Gad , and to the children of Reuben , and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph , the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , the land , with the cities thereof in the coasts , even the cities of the country round about .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ha ki jait Gad bad Reuben , bad ha ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ïa ka hima jong u Syiem Sihon jong ki Amor bad ïa ka hima u syiem Og jong ka Bashan , kynthup ïa ki shnong bad ki jaka sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Moreover as for me , God forbid that I should sin against the  Lord  in ceasing to pray for you : but I will teach you the good and the right way :
translation.kha: Ïa nga shimet , U  Trai  um shah da lei lei ba ngan leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba sangeh noh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Pynban ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei kaba bha bad kaba dei ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field , and shalt gather but little in  ; for the locust shall consume it .
translation.kha: Shibun u symbai phin bet ha lyngkha , hynrei tang khyndiat pat phin ïoh ot , namar ki puit kin bam ïa ki jingthung jong phi .

translation.en: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling , and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second .
translation.kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud eh jong ka sut    kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli ha rmiang jong ka jaiñ ka sut kaba ar .

translation.en: And when thou hast seen it , thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people , as Aaron thy brother was gathered .
translation.kha: Ynda me la ïohi ïa ka , men sa ïap noh , kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïap ,

translation.en: Because ye have said , The  Lord  hath raised us up prophets in Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Phi ong ba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ha phi ha Babilonia .

translation.en: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all , that ye say , We will be as the heathen , as the families of the countries , to serve wood and stone .
translation.kha: Phi la pynbeit ïa la ki jingmut ba phi ïakwah ban long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , kum ki briew kiba shong basah ha kiwei pat ki ri bad kiba mane ïa ki dieng bad ki mawsiang . Hynrei kata kan ym long da lei lei .

translation.en: And he causeth all , both small and great , rich and poor , free and bond , to receive a mark in their right hand , or in their foreheads :
translation.kha: U mradkhlaw u la pynbor ïa ki briew baroh , kiba rit bad kiba khraw , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , ban don ka shab ïa kaba la buh ha ki kti kamon jong ki lane ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .

translation.en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful , and I will make nations of thee , and kings shall come out of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad katto katne na ki , kin long ki syiem . Men ïoh shibun ki khun ki ksiew kiba yn sa long ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Who is among you that feareth the  Lord  , that obeyeth the voice of his servant , that walketh in darkness , and hath no light ? let him trust in the name of the  Lord  , and stay upon his God .
translation.kha: Phi baroh kiba burom ïa U  Trai bad kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien u shakri jong u , ka lynti kaba phi ïaid ka lah ban long kaba dum da shisha , hynrei shaniah ha U  Trai  , aiti ha U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it  ; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh ïa ka ; uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei un ri ïa ka sha ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And David said to all the congregation , Now bless the  Lord  your God . And all the congregation blessed the  Lord  God of their fathers , and bowed down their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  , and the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la hukum ïa u paidbah ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi !  Bad kiba la ïalumlang baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki la pyndem la ki khlieh bad ai burom ïa U  Trai  bad ruh ïa u syiem .

translation.en: O Lord , by these things men live , and in all these things is the life of my spirit : so wilt thou recover me , and make me to live .
translation.kha: A Trai , ngan im na ka bynta jong me , bad tang ïa me hi ; to pynkhiah ïa nga bad ai ngan im .

translation.en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat , (whatsoever they were , it maketh no matter to me : God accepteth no man s person :) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me :
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba idei ban long ki nongïalam — nga ong ïa kane namar kam pher ei ei ïa nga la ki long kiba kumno kumno ruh ; U Blei um bishar na ki durkhmat bashabar — kito ki nongïalam , nga ong , kim don ei ei ki jingai jingmut bathymmai na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: For the scripture saith , Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ngat ha ka jingsngewsih .

translation.en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity , in the beginning of the year , in the tenth day of the month , in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten , in the selfsame day the hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and brought me thither .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong ka snem thymmai , kaba long ka snem kaba arphew san hadien ba la ringmraw ïa ngi bad khatsaw snem hadien ba la jop ïa ka Jerusalem . Ha kata ka sngi nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  , bad u la rah noh ïa nga .

translation.en: And to our beloved Apphia , and Archippus our fellowsoldier , and to the church in thy house :
translation.kha: bad ha ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong me , bad ka Apphia ka para jong ngi , bad u Arkhippos u para shipai jong ngi :

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  I will come and heal him .
translation.kha: Ngan leit bad pynkhiah ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong .

translation.en: And the woman bare a son , and called his name Samson : and the child grew , and the  Lord  blessed him .
