translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka kha ïa u khun shynrang bad ka ai kyrteng ïa u , u Samson . Uta u khunlung u la nang san bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods .
translation.kha: Wat thaw bad mane ïa kano kano ka durblei ba la saiñ da kano kano ka jait nar .

translation.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel , that no stranger , which is not of the seed of Aaron , come near to offer incense before the  Lord   ; that he be not as Korah , and as his company : as the  Lord  said to him by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel ba uno uno u bym shym la hiarpateng na u Aaron um bit ban wan sha ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat U  Trai  , lym kumta un shah pynjot thiaw kum u Korah bad ki nongbud jong u . Ïa kane baroh la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Eleasar da u Moses .

translation.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïakhih pyrshah , da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang jong ki briew kiba shong shnong ha ka ri Judah .

translation.en: These practices are wrong because ( 1 ) they make us their slaves , ( 2 ) they harm our bodies , and ( 3 ) they are unclean .
translation.kha: Kine ki jingmlien ki long ki bymdei namar ( 1 ) Ki pynlong ïa ngi ki mraw jong ki ( 2 ) Ki pynsniew ïa ka met jong ngi , bad ( 3 ) Ki long ki bymkhuid .

translation.en: For I will not contend for ever , neither will I be always wroth : for the spirit should fail before me , and the souls which I have made .
translation.kha: Nga ai ka jingim ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ngan ym mudui sah ïa ki lane bitar ïa ki junom .

translation.en: And he said , Is not he rightly named Jacob ? for he hath supplanted me these two times : he took away my birthright  ; and , behold , now he hath taken away my blessing . And he said , Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me ?
translation.kha: U Iso u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka sien kaba ar ba u la shet shukor ïa nga . Kam long kaba phylla ba ka kyrteng jong u ka dei u Jakob . U la shim noh ïa ki hok ka jinglong khun nyngkong jong nga , bad mynta pat u la shim sa ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Hato phim shym la tyngkai ka jingkyrkhu ïa nga ?

translation.en: So kill the passover , and sanctify yourselves , and prepare your brethren , that they may do according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . Mynta pynlong ïa lade kiba la khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad pynkhreh ïa ki jingkñia ba ki para Israel kin ïoh bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .

translation.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees  ; and brake the trees of their coasts .
translation.kha: u la pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ jong ki bad ïa ki dieng Dumbur bad u la pynkheiñ ïa baroh ki dieng .

translation.en: He was a burning and a shining light : and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la long kum ka sharak , kaba meh bad kaba tyngshaiñ , bad phi la mon shipor ban lehkmen ha ka jingshai jong u .

translation.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the  Lord  your God ,
translation.kha: Pynban haba nga la kren haduh katta ruh , phim shym shaniah ha U  Trai  ,

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Thou hast well seen : for I will hasten my word to perform it .
translation.kha: Me ong kaba dei  U  Trai  u la ong ,  bad nga dang khmih ban ïohi ba ki kyntien jong nga ki wan urlong shisha .

translation.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly , seeketh not her own , is not easily provoked , thinketh no evil ;
translation.kha: ka jingieit kam leh khlem akor lane wad ïa la ka jingmyntoi lane khapnap ; ka jingieit kam ju buh jingkynmaw ïa ki jingbakla ;

translation.en: Let her not be as one dead , of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother s womb .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba kan long kum u khunlung ba la kha ïap , uba la shah bam noh shiteng ka met jong u .

translation.en: For they being ignorant of God s righteousness , and going about to establish their own righteousness , have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God .
translation.kha: Kim shym la tip ïa kata ka lynti kaba U Blei u pynlong ka jingïadei hapdeng ki briew bad ma u hi , bad pynban , ki la pyrshang ban thaw hi da la ka jong ka lynti ; bad kumta kim shym la pyndem ïa lade ha ka lynti U Blei ban pynlong ka jingïadei bad ki .

translation.en: Which say , Stand by thyself , come not near to me  ; for I am holier than thou . These are a smoke in my nose , a fire that burneth all the day .
translation.kha: Bad nangta ki ong ïa kiwei pat , ‘ To ïeng jngai na ngi , naba ngi long kiba khuid shaba palat ym bit ban ktah ïa ngi !’ Ngam lah ban shah ïa ki briew kiba kum kita — ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ïa ki ka long kum ka ding ka bym ju lip shuh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , This is the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , saying , I will give it unto thy seed : I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes , but thou shalt not go over thither .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Kane ka long kata ka ri ba nga la kular ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki . Nga la shah ïa me ban ïohi ïa ka , hynrei ngan ym shah ba men leit shata .

translation.en: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon , and out of the mouth of the beast , and out of the mouth of the false prophet .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi lai tylli ki mynsiem bymkhuid kiba i kum ki jakoid . Ki la ïamih na ka shyntur jong u Ïakjakor , na ka shyntur jong u mradkhlaw , bad na ka shyntur jong u nongïathuhlypa balamler .

translation.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the  Lord  , as the waters cover the sea .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka pyrthei kan long ba la dap da ka jingtip ïa ka burom U  Trai  kumba ki duriaw ki dap da ka um .

translation.en: And they rose up in the twilight , to go unto the camp of the Syrians : and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria , behold , there was no man there .
translation.kha: Kumta , haba ka la sdang dum , ki leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria , hynrei ynda ki poi ha ka , ym don mano mano hangta .

translation.en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen , either in the warp , or woof , or any thing of skins , to pronounce it clean , or to pronounce it unclean .
translation.kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata ka aiñ kaba ïadei bad ka jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup , la ka dei kaba da u  saiwul ne da ka linen , lane ha kaei kaei kaba la shna da ka snieh , dei ha kane ka rukom yn bishar la ka long kaba khuid ne ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka jingkhihwin ka la jem jai , u Paul u la khot lang ïa ki parabangeit bad da ki ktien pynshlur u la khublei ïakhlad bad ki . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u la leit sha Makedonia .

translation.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him , that he had been blind , and received his sight , until they called the parents of him that had received his sight .
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , pynban , kim mon ban ngeit ba une u briew u la long uba matlah bad mynta u la lah ban imat pat , tad ynda ki la khot ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong u bad kylli na ki ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  , he it is that doth go before thee  ; he will be with thee , he will not fail thee , neither forsake thee : fear not , neither be dismayed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  hi un ïalam ïa me bad un don ryngkat bad me . Un ym ieh ïa me lane kyntait ïa me ; kumta wat syier bad wat sheptieng .

translation.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God , and laid it upon the ass , and brought it back : and the old prophet came to the city , to mourn and to bury him .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa tymmen u shim ïa kata ka metïap bad u kyntiew ïa ka halor ka kada , bad u leit kit pat ïa ka sha Bethel ban ïam sngewsih bad ban tep ïa ka .

translation.en: So Amnon lay down , and made himself sick : and when the king was come to see him , Amnon said unto the king , I pray thee , let Tamar my sister come , and make me a couple of cakes in my sight , that I may eat at her hand .
translation.kha: Kumta u Amnon u leit thiah bad u la leh mynleh kum uba pang . U Syiem Dabid u la leit jngoh ïa u , bad u Amnon u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha shah ïa i Tamar ban wan bad shet katto katne ki kpu hangne ha kaba nga lah ban ïohi ïa i , bad nangta in ai bam ïa nga da ma i hi .

translation.en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things , so will we hearken unto thee : only the  Lord  thy God be with thee , as he was with Moses .
translation.kha: Ngin kohnguh ïa me kumba ngi la ju kohnguh ïa u Moses , bad ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un long ryngkat bad me kumba u la long bad u Moses !

translation.en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the  Lord  : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand .
translation.kha: Bad u Elisha u bteng ,  Hynrei kane ka long kaba jem ïa U  Trai  ban leh ; un ai ruh ha phi ka jingjop halor ki Moab .

translation.en: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time , then Mordecai sat in the king s gate .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u syiem u la thung ïa u Mordekai ha ka kam synshar khadar .

translation.en: Which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Addi , which was the son of Cosam , which was the son of Elmodam , which was the son of Er ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Melkhi , u khun jong u Addi , u khun jong u Kosam , u khun jong u Elmadam , u khun jong u Er ,

translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh un shun ïa phi namar jong nga .

translation.en: But shun profane and vain babblings : for they will increase unto more ungodliness .
translation.kha: To kiar noh na ki jingïakren ba-thala bad ba-bieit , tang ban ïalam ïa ki briew kham jngai na U Blei .

translation.en: Yea , thou castest off fear , and restrainest prayer before God .
translation.kha: Lada me ïoh ha lade , yn ym don uba sheptieng ïa U Blei ; yn ym don u ban duwai ha u .

translation.en: And Pharaoh called Abram , and said , What is this that thou hast done unto me ? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife ?
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la khot ïa u Abram , bad u kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ïa nga ? Balei mem shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka dei ka tnga jong me ?

translation.en: Neither is worshipped with men s hands , as though he needed any thing , seeing he giveth to all life , and breath , and all things  ;
translation.kha: Lymne ba u donkam ei ei kaba ngi lah ban ai da kaba trei na ka bynta jong u , namar ba u long ma u hi uba ai ka jingim bad ka jingpyrsad mynsiem bad ïa kaei kaei baroh ha uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: Also the sons of the stranger , that join themselves to the  Lord  , to serve him , and to love the name of the  Lord  , to be his servants , every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and taketh hold of my covenant  ;
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u ong ha kito ki nongwei kiba la pynïasoh bad ki briew jong u , kiba ieit ïa u bad kiba shakri ïa u , kiba sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad kiba batskhem ïa ka jutang jong u .

translation.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it , it is folly and shame unto him .
translation.kha: Da sngap ha shuwa ba phin jubab . Lada phim leh kumta , phi long uba bieit bad shah rkhiebeiñ .

translation.en: And Rabbith , and Kishion , and Abez ,
translation.kha: ka Rabbith , ka Kishion , ka Ebes ,

translation.en: And when he was at the place , he said unto them ,  Pray that ye enter not into temptation .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha kata ka jaka , u la ong ha ki ,  Duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .

translation.en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel , Because the king is near of kin to us : wherefore then be ye angry for this matter ? have we eaten at all of the king s cost ? or hath he given us any gift ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Judah ki jubab ,  Ngi leh ïa kata namar ba u syiem u long uwei na ngi . Balei kane kan pynbitar ïa phi ? Um shym la siew na ka bynta ka bam jong ngi lane um shym la ai ei ei ïa ngi .

translation.en: Go thou near , and hear all that the  Lord  our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the  Lord  our God shall speak unto thee  ; and we will hear it , and do it .
translation.kha: Khie leit biang , ko Moses , bad shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u don ban ong . Nangta wan phai pat bad ïathuh ha ngi aïu u la kren ha phi . Ngin shahshkor bad kohnguh ïa ka .’

translation.en: And in the wilderness , where thou hast seen how that the  Lord  thy God bare thee , as a man doth bear his son , in all the way that ye went , until ye came into this place .
translation.kha: bad ha ka ri shyiap . Phi la ïohi kumno u la bah ïa phi khlem jingmynsaw baroh shi lynter lynti haduh kane ka jaka , kumba u kpa u bah ïa la u khun .’

translation.en: And God spake unto Noah , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah ,

translation.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee , and not I : yea , thine own lips testify against thee .
translation.kha: Kam da donkam ïa nga ban pynrem ïa me ; la pynrem ïa me da kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ba me kren .

translation.en: Take counsel , execute judgment  ; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday  ; hide the outcasts  ; bewray not him that wandereth .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha ki briew jong ka Judah ,  Ong ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh . To ïada ïa ngi kum u dieng uba shat syrngiew tngen ha ka jingshit jong ka shiteng sngi , bad shah ïa ngi ban pynjahthait ha ka jingda jong me . Ngi long ki phetwir ; to buhrieh ïa ngi ha ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano ban shem ïa ngi .

translation.en: Let this mind be in you , which was also in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Ka jingmut kaba phi dei ban don ka long kata kaba U Khrist Jisu u la don :

translation.en: Of this man s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour , Jesus :
translation.kha: U la dei U Jisu , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ïa uba U Blei u la pynlong u Nongpynim ïa ki paid Israel , kumba u la lah kular .

translation.en: He answered and said , I will not : but afterward he repented , and went .
translation.kha: ‘ Ngam sngewkwah ,’ u la jubab , hynrei hadien , u la kylla ka jingmut bad u la leit .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my sake , and the gospel s ,
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  bad nga ong ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing ne ki hynmen ki para shynrang ne kynthei lane ka kmie lane u kpa lane ki khun lane ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka gospel , un ïohpdiang kham palat ha kane ka pateng ba mynta .

translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O my soul . O  Lord  my God , thou art very great  ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga ! A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , katno me long uba khraw ! Me kup da ka burom syiem bad ka burom ;

translation.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .
translation.kha: Shna ïa kine ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Therefore snares are round about thee , and sudden fear troubleth thee  ;
translation.kha: Kumta mynta ki don ki jingriam baroh sawdong jong phi , bad kynsan kynsan phi dap da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Our father died in the wilderness , and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the  Lord  in the company of Korah  ; but died in his own sin , and had no sons .
translation.kha: I pa jong ngi i la ïap ha ka ri khlaw khlem khun shynrang . Im shym ïadon lang bad ki nongbud jong u Korah kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ; i la ïap namar ka pop la jong .

translation.en: And his name shall be called in Israel , The house of him that hath his shoe loosed .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ïing jong u yn tip ha Israel kum ‘ Ka ïing jong uta u briew uba la shah loit juti .’

translation.en: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also , who trusted in God , adorned themselves , being in subjection unto their own husbands :
translation.kha: Naba ki kynthei bariewblei ha ki por ba la leit noh ki la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei , ki ju pynbhabriew ïa lade da kaba pynkohnguh ha la ki tnga .

translation.en: But they , supposing him to have been in the company , went a day s journey  ; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance .
translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u kim tip shaphang kane ; ki dang pyrkhat ba u la don lang bad ka kynhun , kumta ki la ïaleit lynti baroh shi sngi , bad nangta , ki la sdang ban wad ïa u hapdeng ki ba-ha-ïing bad ki paralok .

translation.en: And they went and told it unto the residue : neither believed they them .
translation.kha: Ki la wan phai bad ki la ïathuh ha kiwei pat , hynrei kim shym la ngeit ïa kata .

translation.en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof : thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian , when he cometh into our land , and when he treadeth within our borders .
translation.kha: Da ka borbah jong ki tiar thma kin jop ïa ki Assyria , ka ri jong u Nimrod , bad kin pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria haba ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass , drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Yn tep ïa u kumba tep ïa u kada , un sa shah ring bad bret ïa u shabar ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: But I determined this with myself , that I would not come again to you in heaviness .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la kut jingmut ban ym wan shuh sha phi ïoh ka pynsngewsih ïa phi .

translation.en: Circumcise yourselves to the  Lord  , and take away the foreskins of your heart , ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my fury come forth like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad pynkyntang ïa lade ha nga , phi ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem . Lymda kumta , ka jingbitar jong nga kan ing kum ka ding namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba phi la leh . Kan pluh , bad yn ym don mano mano ba pynlip ïa ka .

translation.en: I entreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me da la ka dohnud baroh ; ban isynei ïa nga , kumba me la kular !

translation.en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee ? what thing shall I liken to thee , O daughter of Jerusalem ? what shall I equal to thee , that I may comfort thee , O virgin daughter of Zion ? for thy breach is great like the sea : who can heal thee ?
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka ding nalor , ka ding kaba thang hapoh jong nga . U la buh ka jingriam na ka bynta jong nga bad u la wanrah ïa nga sha khyndew . Nangta u la iehnoh ïa nga bad ieh ïa nga ha ka jingpang baneh .

translation.en: His branches shall spread , and his beauty shall be as the olive tree , and his smell as Lebanon .
translation.kha: Kin khie im da ka jingsan bathymmai , bad kin itynnat kum ki dieng Olib . Kin iwbih kum ki dieng Kedar ka Lebanon .

translation.en: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them , that they may cleanse the land .
translation.kha: Kan shim por ïa ki Israel hynñiew bnai ban tep ïa ki metïap baroh bad ban pynlong khuid pat ïa ka ri .

translation.en: So I went , and hid it by Euphrates , as the  Lord  commanded me .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit bad buhrieh ïa ki hajan ka Ïuphratis .

translation.en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up :
translation.kha: Phin ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki turoi , ba la bud da ka jingput ïa ki tangmuri , ki jingtem ksai , ki marynthing , bad ki duitara ; bad nangta sa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar put tiar tem kin ïasoh lang . Tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingtem , phi dei ban dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king : and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword  ; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki la ai jingtip ha u syiem ïa ka jingdon baroh jong ki rangbah kiba bit ban long shipai : phra lakh ha Israel bad san lakh ha Judah .

translation.en: And so return unto thee with all their heart , and with all their soul , in the land of their enemies , which led them away captive , and pray unto thee toward their land , which thou gavest unto their fathers , the city which thou hast chosen , and the house which I have built for thy name :
translation.kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut da kaba shisha bad kaba sngur mynsiem , bad ki duwai ha me da kaba phai khmat sha kane ka ri kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , sha kane ka nongbah kaba me la jied , bad sha kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: Simon Peter saith unto him , Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la jubab ,  Ko Trai , to wat sait tang ïa ki kjat jong nga , te ! To sait ruh ïa ki kti bad ïa ka khlieh jong nga ruh .

translation.en: O thou afflicted , tossed with tempest , and not comforted , behold , I will lay thy stones with fair colours , and lay thy foundations with sapphires .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ka Jerusalem , pha ka nongbah ba shah jynjar bad bymdonbor , bad ym don u ban pyntngen ïa pha , ngan tei pat ïa ki nongrim jong pha da ki mawkordor .

translation.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah : cry aloud at Beth–aven , after thee , O Benjamin .
translation.kha: To put ïa ki turoi thma ha Gibeah ! Pynsawa ïa ka jingkyrsiew ha Ramah ! Pyrta jam shaphang ka thma ha Bethaben ! Tur sha ka thma , ko ki rangbah Benjamin !

translation.en: But I beseech you , that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence , wherewith I think to be bold against some , which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh .
translation.kha: Da ka jingjemnud bad jingbha U Khrist , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban nym pynbor ïa nga ban long uba eh haba nga wan ; naba nga thikna ba nga lah ban leh da kaba eh ïa kito kiba ong ba ngi leh ïa kiei kiei na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrthei .

translation.en: I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :
translation.kha: Dei namar kata , nga mareh beit sha ka thong ; dei namar kata balei ba nga long kum nongïakura u bym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingkura jong u .

translation.en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years  ; and the  Lord  said unto him , Thou art old and stricken in years , and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed .
translation.kha: U Joshua mynta u la tymmen bha . U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Me la tymmen bha , hynrei dang bun ka jaka kaba dei ban ïohkynti .

translation.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee , and will multiply thee exceedingly .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang jong nga bad me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of two months , that she returned unto her father , who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed : and she knew no man . And it was a custom in Israel ,
translation.kha: Hadien ar bnai ka wan phai sha la u kpa . U leh kumba u la kular ha U  Trai  , bad ka la ïap haba ka dang sotti . Kane ka la long ka thymmei ïa ka ban bud kum ka rukom ha Israel

translation.en: And they gathered together to Mizpah , and drew water , and poured it out before the  Lord  , and fasted on that day , and said there , We have sinned against the  Lord . And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki tong ïa ka um bad ki theh ïa ka kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai  bad ki shahjingit baroh shi sngi . Ki ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .  Dei ha Mispah ba u Samuel u pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki Israel .

translation.en: And truly the Son of man goeth , as it was determined : but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed !
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew un ïap kumba U Blei u la thmu , hynrei a katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa uta u briew uba shetkylla ïa u !

translation.en: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool , and rewardeth transgressors .
translation.kha: U nongaikam uba khot bylla ïa uno uno uba bieit uba u ïakynduh , u long tang ban pynmynsaw kat ïa kiba ïatreilang .

translation.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .
translation.kha: Wat thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ki blei kiba da ka rupa ne da ka ksiar ban mane ïa ki nalor jong nga .

translation.en: And ye shall eat it in every place , ye and your households : for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi , phi lah ban bam ïa kata kaba dang sah ha kano kano ka jaka , namar ka long ka bainong ïa ka jingshakri jong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded him : and he took Joshua , and set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation :
translation.kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u . U la pynïeng ïa u Joshua ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad uta u paidlang baroh .

translation.en: Thus did Moses : according to all that the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .
translation.kha: U Moses u leh ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: And there are diversities of operations , but it is the same God which worketh all in all .
translation.kha: Don bun ki jinglah ban shakri kiba ïapher , hynrei ujuh U Blei uba pynlah ïa baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ki .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondmen , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ban ong ha ki paidbah :  Nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba nga la pyllait ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt bad pyllaitluid ïa ki na ka jinglongmraw .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah , which reigned instead of Josiah his father , which went forth out of this place  ; He shall not return thither any more :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang u Joahas , u khun jong u Josaïah , uba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u kum u syiem ka Judah ,  U la leit noh nangne , un ym wan phai shuh .

translation.en: If any man or woman that believeth have widows , let them relieve them , and let not the church be charged ; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka parabangeit ka don ki riewkynthei ha ka longïing jong ka , ka dei ban sumar ïa ki bad ban ym bankhia ïa ka balang , khnang ba ka lah ban sumar ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long marwei .

translation.en: There is a generation that curseth their father , and doth not bless their mother .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba tim ïa la ki kpa bad ki bym ju pyn-i ïa la ka jingïaroh ïa la ki kmie .

translation.en: And he said , Let him alone  ; let no man move his bones . So they let his bones alone , with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria .
translation.kha: Ieh ïa ka kumba ka long ,  u Josaïah u hukum .  Ïa ki shyieng jong u ym dei ban pynkhih .  Kumta ïa ki shyieng jong u , ym shym la pynkhih , lymne jong kito ki jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la wan na Samaria .

translation.en: Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Return to thine own house , and shew how great things God hath done unto thee .  And he went his way , and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him .
translation.kha: Khie leit noh sha ïing bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta jong me .  Uta u briew u la leit lyngba ïa ka shnong , u da ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: In Hebrew , “Gilead” means “Witness Pile .”
translation.kha: Ha ka ktien Hebru “Gilead” ka mut “Ka Sakhi ba Kynton .”

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will cast thee from off the face of the earth : this year thou shalt die , because thou hast taught rebellion against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  hi u ong ba un weng noh ïa me . Ha shuwa ban kut kane ka snem men ïap namar me la ong ïa ki briew ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness  ; yea , the  Lord  our God shall cut them off .
translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki bad un pynjot ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki ; U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi un pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: Raging waves of the sea , foaming out their own shame  ; wandering stars , to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki jingat phyllung ba khih phaloh jong ka duriaw , da ki jingleh bakhlemrain jong ki , ki pynpaw kum ki sboh sabon . Ki long kum ki khlur ba ïaid sakma , ïa kiba U Blei u la buh lypa ïa ka jaka kaba dum tliw tliw junom .

translation.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day , it shall not be accepted , neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it : it shall be an abomination , and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada la bam ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba lai , U Blei un ym pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong uta u briew . Ïa kata ka jingainguh yn ym ñiew kum ka jingainguh jong u hynrei yn kheiñ ba ka long ka bymkhuid , bad uno uno uba bam ïa ka un kit hi ïa la ka pop .

translation.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes  ; that I be not ashamed .
translation.kha: Ai ba ngan kohnguh janai ïa ki hukum jong me , ba ngan lait na ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop .

translation.en: So the last shall be first , and the first last : for many be called , but few chosen .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kumta kiba khatduh kin long ha shuwa , bad kito kiba ha shuwa kin long khatduh .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Go in , and behold the wicked abominations that they do here .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Rung shapoh , bad peit ïa kaba sniew , ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki ïaleh hangta .

translation.en: And ye became followers of us , and of the Lord , having received the word in much affliction , with joy of the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Phi la pyrthuh bud ïa ngi bad ïa U Trai ; wat la phi la shahshitom shikatdei eh , phi la pdiang ïa ka khubor da ka jingkmen kaba wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: Therefore I was left alone , and saw this great vision , and there remained no strength in me : for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption , and I retained no strength .
translation.kha: La iehnoh ïa nga marwei hangta , da kaba khmih ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phylla . Ngam donbor shuh , bad ka durkhmat jong nga ka la kylla dur haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , through the way of the plain from Elath , and from Ezion–geber , we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi la nang ïaid , bad ngi kiar ïa ka lynti kaba leit na ki shnong Elath bad Esiongeber sha ka Duriaw Baïap , bad ngi phai shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi sha ka ri Moab .

translation.en: Therefore wait ye upon me , saith the  Lord  , until the day that I rise up to the prey : for my determination is to gather the nations , that I may assemble the kingdoms , to pour upon them mine indignation , even all my fierce anger : for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy .
translation.kha: Shu ap ,  U  Trai  u ong .  Ap ïa ka sngi haba ngan ïeng ban pynrem ïa ki jaitbynriew . Nga la pynbeit ïa la ka jingmut ban lumlang ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima khnang ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar shla jong nga .

translation.en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , so that he would not let the children of Israel go .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad kumta um shym pyllait ïa ki Israel ban leit .

translation.en: Saying ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests , and unto the scribes  ; and they shall condemn him to death , and shall deliver him to the Gentiles :
translation.kha: Sngap ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  ngi dang leit kiew sha Jerusalem ha kaba ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Kin rai pynrem ban pynïap ïa u bad nangta kin aiti ïa u sha ki Jentil ,

translation.en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot , and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , and the drink offering thereof :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ainguh ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta bad ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna lem bad ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh , and upon Egypt  ; afterwards he will let you go hence : when he shall let you go , he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan phah sa tang kawei ka jingpynshitom ha u Pharaoh bad ki briew jong u . Hadien kata , un sa shah ba phin ïamihnoh . Ha ka jingshisha , un sa beh lut ïa phi nangne .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring thee , and thy king which thou shalt set over thee , unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known  ; and there shalt thou serve other gods , wood and stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un leit rah ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi sha ka ri nongwei , ha kaba ma phi lane ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim pat ju poi ; hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei kiba da u dieng bad da u maw .

translation.en: And sold their possessions and goods , and parted them to all men , as every man had need .
translation.kha: Ki die noh ïa ka jaka ka puta bad ka jingdon jingem jong ki , bad sam ïa ka pisa hapdeng jong ki baroh , kat kum kaei kaba uwei uwei u donkam .

translation.en: And gave them for the potter s field , as the Lord appointed me .
translation.kha: bad ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka lyngkha u nongthaw khiew , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth , blood , and fire , and pillars of smoke .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ki jingmaham shaphang kata ka sngi ha ka suiñbneng bad ha ka khyndew ; kan don ka jingumsnam , ka ding bad ki lyoh tdem .

translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon , she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem , with a very great company , and camels that bare spices , and gold in abundance , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
translation.kha: Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka bna shaphang ka nam u Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerusalem ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingkylli kiba eh . Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba kit ki musla , ki mawkordor , bad shibun ka ksiar . Haba ka la ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli lut ïa baroh ki jingkylli kat kiba don ha ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la ïap bad u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal  ; and he sat down among the ashes .
translation.kha: U Job u leit bad u shong ha ka kynton ñiut bad u shim da ki saraw khiew ba la pait ban trud ïa ki tohjaw kiba don ha u .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh , The dream of Pharaoh is one : God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha u syiem ,  Ki jingphohsniew baroh ar tylli ki mut ïa kajuh . U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba un sa leh .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee , unto me , and I will bless them .
translation.kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Kine ki dei ki khun jong nga kiba U Blei u la ai ïa nga hangne ha Ijipt .  U Jakob u ong ,  Wan ïalam ïa ki sha nga ba ngan ïoh kyrkhu ïa ki .

translation.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering  ; he shall put no oil upon it , neither shall he put any frankincense thereon : for it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wanrah ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur , un wallam shi kilo u  purew kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Um dei ban theh kano kano ka umphniang Olib ne kano kano ka jingiwbih halor jong u , namar ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ym ka jingkñia bam .

translation.en: But John forbad him , saying , I have need to be baptized of thee , and comest thou to me ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ïoannis u la pyrshang ban pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jong u .  Nga dei ban shah pynbaptis ha me ,  u Ïoannis u la ong ,  bad me la wan pynban sha nga !

translation.en: For thou art an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God : the  Lord  thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself , above all people that are upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Namar phi long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . U la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba phin long ka jaitbynriew kaba kyrpang jong u .

translation.en: They are vanity , the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
translation.kha: Kim dondor bad dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ; ïa ki yn sa pynjot haba U  Trai  u wan ban leh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then Jesus went with them . And when he was now not far from the house , the centurion sent friends to him , saying unto him , Lord , trouble not thyself : for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof :
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la leit bad ki . Um shym da jngai na ka ïing mynba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la phah ïa ki paralok ban ong ha U ,  Kynrad , wat pynshitom ïa lade . Ngam dei hok ban pdiang ïa me ha ka ïing jong nga ,

translation.en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people  ; ( and they were all with one accord in Solomon s porch .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la leh shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla hapdeng ki briew . Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka baranda u Solomon .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon , and all that he did , and his wisdom , are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Solomon u la leh , ka jingtrei jong u bad ka jingstad jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori U Solomon .

translation.en: Hear thou , my son , and be wise , and guide thine heart in the way .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko khun jong nga , long uba stad bad pynleit jingmut bha ha ka lynti ka ba phi im .

translation.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love , joy , peace , longsuffering , gentleness , goodness , faith ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem u pynmih ïa ka jingieit , ka jingkmen , ka jingsuk , ka jingïaishah , ka jinglehsbun , ka jingbha , ka jingïaineh , ka jingsngewrit , bad ka bor halor lade .

translation.en: And the four beasts said , Amen . And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ki la jubab ,  Amen !  Bad ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane .

translation.en: And beside this , giving all diligence , add to your faith virtue  ; and to virtue knowledge  ;
translation.kha: Te namar kane hi ka daw phi dei ban leh ïa kaba bha tam jong phi ban pynlang ïa ka jingbha ha ka jingngeit jong phi ; ha ka jingbha jong phi pynlang ïa ka jingtip ;

translation.en: When they had heard these words , they marvelled , and left him , and went their way .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la lyngngoh ; bad ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la leit noh .

translation.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven , whiles they lie in wait : their baker sleepeth all the night  ; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ki khluit kum ka tyndur da ki jingïasylla jong ki . Baroh shi miet , ka jingbitar jong ki ka nang ing , bad mynstep ka mih kynsan kum ki thylliej ding .

translation.en: If the world hate you , ye know that it hated me before it hated you .
translation.kha: Lada ka pyrthei ka shun ïa phi , to kynmaw ba ka la shun ïa nga nyngkong .

translation.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy , lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely , and lest they should say , Our hand is high , and the  Lord  hath not done all this .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban kren kob ba ki dei ma ki kiba la pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga , haba dei ma nga hi uba la khñiot ïa ki .’

translation.en: And their camels shall be a booty , and the multitude of their cattle a spoil : and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners  ; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ki ut jong ki bad ïa baroh ki jingri jong ki ! Ngan pynsakma sha ki liang baroh ba kito ki briew kiba la khap lyngkot ïa la ki shñiuh , bad ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ki na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when his master heard the words of his wife , which she spake unto him , saying , After this manner did thy servant to me  ; that his wrath was kindled .
translation.kha: U kynrad jong u Joseph u la bitar lep

translation.en: Of Syria , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines , and of Amalek , and of the spoil of Hadadezer , son of Rehob , king of Zobah .
translation.kha: ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philistia , bad ki Amalek — kumjuh ruh shi bynta na ka jinglute kaba u la kurup na u Hadadeser .

translation.en: Then answered Doeg the Edomite , which was set over the servants of Saul , and said , I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob , to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub .
translation.kha: U Doeg u dang ïeng hangta bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Saul , bad u ong ,  Nga la ïohi ïa u Dabid mynba u leit sha u Ahimelekh u khun jong u Ahitub ha Nob .

translation.en: But Jehoiada waxed old , and was full of days when he died  ; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynjoh ka rta kaba la tymmen bha haba u la don shispah laiphew snem , u la ïap .

translation.en: We are of God : he that knoweth God heareth us  ; he that is not of God heareth not us . Hereby know we the spirit of truth , and the spirit of error .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi , ngi long ki jong U Blei . Uno uno uba ithuh ïa U Blei , u shahshkor ïa ngi ; uno uno u bym long u jong U Blei , um shahshkor ïa ngi . Kane te , ka long kumno ngi lah ban ïathuh ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng U Mynsiem ka jingshisha bad u mynsiem ka jinglamler .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .
translation.kha: U ong ha ka ,  Khie leit phai pat sha la ka kynrad , bad long ka mraw jong ka .

translation.en: I cry unto thee , and thou dost not hear me : I stand up , and thou regardest me not .
translation.kha: Nga khot ïa me , A Blei , hynrei mem ju jubab ; bad haba nga duwai , mem sngap shuh .

translation.en: And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah : because there they buried the people that lusted .
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Kibroth Hattaabah ( kaba mut  ki Jingtep ka jingkwah rhah  ) , namar hangta ki la tep ïa ki briew kiba la kwah rhah ban bam doh .

translation.en: And they come again to Jerusalem : and as he was walking in the temple , there come to him the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders ,
translation.kha: Ki la poi biang sa shisien ha Jerusalem . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka Templ , ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan ha u

translation.en: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits .
translation.kha: Kata ka lynti ïaid baroh shi lynter naduh ka khyrdop kaba shabar shaduh ka liang ba kut jong ka kamra bakhatduh ka la long arphew san mitar .

translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the  Lord  , she came to prove him with hard questions .
translation.kha: Ka Syiem jong ka ri Sheba ka bna shaphang ka nam u Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerusalem ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingkylli kiba eh .

translation.en: ( Who also , when he was in Galilee , followed him , and ministered unto him  ; ) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki la lah bud ïa U Jisu mynba u don ha Galilaïa bad ïarap ïa u . Bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la wan sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u ki la ïadon ruh hangta .

translation.en: And they set the priests in their divisions , and the Levites in their courses , for the service of God , which is at Jerusalem  ; as it is written in the book of Moses .
translation.kha: Ki la buh ryntih ruh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi na ka bynta ka jingshakri ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem , kat kum ki jingbthah bad don ha ka kitab u Moses .

translation.en: Fear ye not , neither be afraid : have not I told thee from that time , and have declared it ? ye are even my witnesses . Is there a God beside me ? yea , there is no God  ; I know not any .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , ko ki briew jong nga ! Phi tip ba naduh ki por mynbarim haduh mynta nga la ïathuhlypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia , bad phi long ki sakhi jong nga . Hato don uno uno uwei pat U Blei ? Hato don kiwei pat ki blei badonbor ba ngam shym ïohsngew ?

translation.en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you , and ye shall be clean : from all your filthiness , and from all your idols , will I cleanse you .
translation.kha: Ngan synreit ïa phi da ka um khuid , bad ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki bleithaw jong phi bad na baroh kiei kiei kiba la pyntngit ïa phi .

translation.en: And there went out after him Joab s men , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , and all the mighty men : and they went out of Jerusalem , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .
translation.kha: Kumta ki rangbah jong u Joab , ki nongïada ïa u syiem , bad kiwei pat ki shipai ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad u Abishai ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .

translation.en: Wherefore I give you to understand , that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed : and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord , but by the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin tip ba ym don uno uno uba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei u lah ban ong  Long ba la tim ïa U Jisu!  bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban phla  U Jisu u long U Trai ,  lymda la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt , being eighteen thousand men .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la nang kham pawnam shuh shuh haba u la wan phai na kaba pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki nong Edom ha ka Them Mluh .

translation.en: Yea , they made their hearts as an adamant stone , lest they should hear the law , and the words which the  Lord  of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets : therefore came a great wrath from the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: bad ki pynlong ïa ki dohnud jong ki , kiba eh kum u mawsiang . Namar ba kim shym la shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la phah lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la im slem bah , nga la bitar shikatdei eh .

translation.en: And thou shalt say , I will go up to the land of unwalled villages  ; I will go to them that are at rest , that dwell safely , all of them dwelling without walls , and having neither bars nor gates ,
translation.kha: Men sa rai ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri ka bym don jingïarap ha kaba ki briew ki ïashongsuk shongshngain ha ki shnong kiba khlem ker kynroh bad ki bym don jingker .

translation.en: Wherefore I abhor myself , and repent in dust and ashes .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewlehrain ïa baroh kaba nga la ong bad nga kylla-kaba-mut ha u pui pui bad u dpei .

translation.en: Therefore hath the  Lord  watched upon the evil , and brought it upon us : for the  Lord  our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth : for we obeyed not his voice .
translation.kha: Ma me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , me la pynkhreh ban pynshitom ïa ngi , bad me la leh kumta , namar borabor me ju ïai leh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad ngim shym la pynshahshkor ïa me .

translation.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh : as it is said to this day , In the mount of the  Lord  it shall be seen .
translation.kha: U Abraham u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka  U  Trai  U Pynbiang .  Bad haduh kane ka sngi ruh , ki briew ki dang ong ,  Ha u lum jong U  Trai  u pynbiang .

translation.en: Not as Cain , who was of that wicked one , and slew his brother . And wherefore slew he him ? Because his own works were evil , and his brother s righteous .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban long kum u Kain ; u la long jong u Basniew bad u la pynïap ïa u Abel , u para jong u . Balei u Kain u la pynïap ïa u ? Namar kiei kiei kiba u la leh da lade hi ki la long ki bym dei , hynrei kiei kiei kiba u para jong u , u la leh ki la long kiba dei .

translation.en: I am come in my Father s name , and ye receive me not : if another shall come in his own name , him ye will receive .
translation.kha: Nga la wan da ka iktiar U Kpa jong nga ; hynrei phim shym la pdiang ïa nga ; pynban , haba don uno uno uba wan ha la ka jong ka iktiar , phin pdiang ïa u .

translation.en: And he humbled thee , and suffered thee to hunger , and fed thee with manna , which thou knewest not , neither did thy fathers know  ; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the  Lord  doth man live .
translation.kha: U la pyndem ïa phi , u la pynshahthngan ïa phi , bad hadien kata u la ai ha phi ïa ka manna ban bam , ka jingbam kaba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju ïoh mynno mynno . Ban hikai ïa phi ba u briew um im tang da u kpu hynrei da ka ktien baroh kaba mih na U  Trai .

translation.en: And Joshua , and all Israel with him , took Achan the son of Zerah , and the silver , and the garment , and the wedge of gold , and his sons , and his daughters , and his oxen , and his asses , and his sheep , and his tent , and all that he had : and they brought them unto the valley of Achor .
translation.kha: U Joshua , lem bad ki paid Israel , ki shim ïa u Akhan , ka rupa , ka barandi , ka lyngkhot ksiar , lem bad ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong u Akhan , ki jingri jong u , ki kada jong u , bad ki langbrot jong u , ka ïingjaiñ jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka Them Jingjynjar .

translation.en: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah , the men that were in the houses near to Micah s house were gathered together , and overtook the children of Dan .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi kham ha pajih na ka ïing , u Mikah u khot ïa ki paramarjan ban leit ïaleh thma ïa ki . Ki lap ïa ki rangbah na Dan

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ïa nga ban leit bad ong ha ki paid Judah bad ka Jerusalem ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga kylli ïa phi balei ba phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye can break my covenant of the day , and my covenant of the night , and that there should not be day and night in their season  ;
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jutang ïa ka sngi bad ka miet , khnang ba kin wan mih ha la ki por kiba biang ; bad ïa ka jutang yn ym lah ban pynkheiñ .

translation.en: When they told it unto David , he sent to meet them , because the men were greatly ashamed : and the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shaba palat ban leit phai ïing . Haba u Dabid u la tip ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la phah ktien sha ki ban sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad ynda ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki la san biang .

translation.en: O that they were wise , that they understood this , that they would consider their latter end !
translation.kha: Kim lah sngewthuh balei ba ki la shahjop ; kim lah shemphang ïa kaba la jia .

translation.en: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven , and mine understanding returned unto me , and I blessed the most High , and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever , whose dominion is an everlasting dominion , and his kingdom is from generation to generation :
translation.kha: Haba ki hynñiew snem ki la leit ,  la ong u syiem ,  Nga la khmih shajrong sha sahit bneng , bad ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai . Nga la ïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh bad nga la ai ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom ïa uta uba im junom .  Un synshar junom , bad ka hima jong u kan neh ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of sins , according to the riches of his grace ;
translation.kha: Naba da ka jingïap ba la kñia jong U Khrist la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ïa ki pop jong ngi la map ei .

translation.en: Then took he him up in his arms , and blessed God , and said ,
translation.kha: u Simeon u la shim ïa u khunlung ha ki ksang ti jong u bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei :

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Receive thy sight : thy faith hath saved thee .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Te , to peit ! Ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .

translation.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest , shall be servant of all .
translation.kha: bad lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long nyngkong , u dei ban long u mraw jong baroh .

translation.en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi ïa ki ban mane ïa nga , namar ki hikai ïa ki aiñ ba la thaw da ki briew kumba ki dei ki aiñ U Blei !’

translation.en: And he arose and departed , and came to Samaria . And as he was at the shearing house in the way ,
translation.kha: U Jehu u mih na Jesreel ban leit sha Samaria . Ha lynti , ha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka Jaka Sah ki Nongap Langbrot ,

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  For this saying go thy way  ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ïa ka ,  Namar kata ka jubab , khie leit phai pat sha ïing , ha kaba phan shem ba u ksuid u la mihnoh na ka khun jong pha !

translation.en: Then said I , O Lord  God  , cease , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to keiñ noh ! Kumno ki briew jong me ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !

translation.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him , and said unto her , Go up in peace to thine house  ; see , I have hearkened to thy voice , and have accepted thy person .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la pdiang ïa kaei kaba ka la wallam ïa u bad u ong ha ka ,  Khie leit phai noh sha ïing bad wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah .

translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time  ; the only begotten Son , which is in the bosom of the Father , he hath declared him .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ruh uba la ïohi ïa U Blei . U Khun ba marwei jong u , uba long kumjuh kum U Blei bad uba don ha syndah jong U Kpa , u la pynpaw shynna ïa u .

translation.en: Go , tell Jeroboam , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people , and made thee prince over my people Israel ,
translation.kha: Khie leit ïathuh ha u Jeroboam ba kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa u : ‘ Nga la jied ïa me napdeng u paidbah bad nga la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel .

translation.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth , and upon every fowl of the air , upon all that moveth upon the earth , and upon all the fishes of the sea  ; into your hand are they delivered .
translation.kha: Baroh ki mrad , ki sim , bad ki dohkha kin im ha ka jingsheptieng ïa phi . La buh ïa ki hapoh ka bor jong phi .

translation.en: And Solomon went to Hamath–zobah , and prevailed against it .
translation.kha: U la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka Hamath bad Sobah bad u kerkut ïa ka nongbah Palmyra ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And in those days , when the number of the disciples was multiplied , there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews , because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba ka jingdon ki synran ka nang ïai kiew , la don ka jingïania hapdeng ki Jiw kiba kren Grik bad ki Jiw kiba kren ktien tynrai . Ki Jiw kiba kren Grik ki la kam ba ïa ki riewkynthei la leh klet ha ka jingsam pisa kaba man ka sngi .

translation.en: Jesus said unto her ,  I am the resurrection , and the life : he that believeth in me , though he were dead , yet shall he live :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Nga long ka jingmihpat bad ka jingim . Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un im , wat la u la ïap ; un ïoh im , bad uno uno uba im , bad uba ngeit ha nga un ym ïap lano lano ruh .

translation.en: And that day was the preparation , and the sabbath drew on .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi Thohdieng , bad ka sngi Sabbaton ka la jan sdang .

translation.en: For he wist not what to say  ; for they were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Ma u bad kiwei pat ki la sheptieng katta katta haduh ba um tip ïa kaei ban ong .

translation.en: Because the  Lord  was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them , therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness .
translation.kha: ba me pynïap ïa la ki briew ha ka ri khlaw namar ba mem lah ban ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la kular ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynring kyrthat ïa u briew , u la lynñiar jam , bad u la mihnoh na u .

translation.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself .
translation.kha: Long kiba sbun , bad phin manbha . Ïarap ïa kiwei , bad yn ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet . For in that he put all in subjection under him , he left nothing that is not put under him . But now we see not yet all things put under him .
translation.kha: La ong ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa u briew  u nongsynshar halor kiei kiei baroh ;  kane ka paw shai ba ka kynthup ïa kiei kiei baroh . Pynban , ngim pat ïohi ba u briew un synshar halor kiei kiei baroh mynta .

translation.en: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God , saying ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u kren ha u Shemaïah u nongïathuhlypa

translation.en: Envy thou not the oppressor , and choose none of his ways .
translation.kha: Wat ju kwah ban long kum ki briew ba leh jubor lane pyrshang ban leh ïa kaba ki leh ,

translation.en: O  Lord  , I have heard thy speech , and was afraid : O  Lord  , revive thy work in the midst of the years , in the midst of the years make known  ; in wrath remember mercy .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba me la leh , bad nga la dap da ka jingtiengburom . Mynta to leh biang ha ki por jong ngi ïa ki kam bakhraw kiba me la ju leh . To leh-isynei , wat haba me bitar .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu , and all that he did , and all his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehu u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki kam shlur jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel

translation.en: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart , and after Baalim , which their fathers taught them :
translation.kha: Pynban , ki la long kiba mutlop bad ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw u Baal kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la hikai ïa ki ban leh .

translation.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings , and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices .
translation.kha: Yn sa rong noh ïa ki kumba kit da ka lyer , bad kin sa shah ka jinglehrain namar ba ki kñia ha ki blei thala .

translation.en: And I persecuted this way unto the death , binding and delivering into prisons both men and women .
translation.kha: Nga la pynshitom beiñ haduh kaba pynïap ïa ki briew kiba la bud ïa kane ka Lynti . Nga la kem ïa ki rangbah bad ki kynthei bad nga la thep ïa ki ha ka byndi .

translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his saltness , wherewith will ye season it ? Have salt in yourselves , and have peace one with another .
translation.kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha ; hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingbang jong ka , kumno phi lah ban pynbang pat ïa ka ?  To don ïa ka mluh jong ka jingïalong paralok hapdeng jong phi , bad para ma phi , to im hapdeng ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , Go ye , sacrifice to your God in the land .
translation.kha: Te u Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u la ong ,  Khie leit bad ai jingkñia ha U Blei jong phi hangne ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: Teach me , and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .
translation.kha: Kam lei lei , hikai ïa nga ; ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingbakla jong nga . Ngan sngap jar bad shahshkor ïa phi .

translation.en: And Samson said concerning them , Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines , though I do them a displeasure .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ,  Mynta ka kynti , ngan ym kitkhlieh ïa kaei ba ngan sa leh ïa ki Philistia .

translation.en: And the kings of the earth , who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her , shall bewail her , and lament for her , when they shall see the smoke of her burning ,
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei kiba la ïashim bynta ha ka jingawria bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka kin lynñiar bad ïam na ka bynta ka nongbah haba ki ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba bam duh ïa ka .

translation.en: And Elon the Zebulunite died , and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun .
translation.kha: Hadien kata u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha Aijalon kaba ha ri Sebulun .

translation.en: But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his farm , another to his merchandise :
translation.kha: Hynrei kiba la shah khot sngewbha kim suidñiew bad ki la leit sha la ki kam ki jam : Uwei sha ka lyngkha jong u , uwei pat sha ka dukan jong u ,

translation.en: Then said he , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All that is in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
translation.kha: Kaei ba ki la ïohi ha ka ïing syiem ?   Ki la ïohi ïa baroh . Ym don kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki ha ki ïing jingkynshew .

translation.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication , with the women , and Mary the mother of Jesus , and with his brethren .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang tista ban duwai kum ka kynhun , ryngkat lem bad ki kynthei bad ka Mari ka kmie jong U Jisu bad ki para shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto Abram , and said , Unto thy seed will I give this land : and there builded he an altar unto the  Lord  , who appeared unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Abram bad u ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ngan ai ha ki khun ki ksiew ong me .  Nangta u Abram u la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  , uba lah mihpaw ha u .

translation.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron , and unto all the congregation .
translation.kha: La leit lam ïa u ha u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka kynhun baroh kawei ,

translation.en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses , know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God ? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew bym lah shaniah ! Hato phim tip ba ka jingïalang lok bad ka pyrthei ka long ka nongshun jong U Blei ? Uno uno uba kwah ban pynlong lok bad ka pyrthei u pynlong ïa lade u nongshun jong U Blei .

translation.en: Now upon the first day of the week , very early in the morning , they came unto the sepulchre , bringing the spices which they had prepared , and certain others with them .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step Sngi U Trai ki kynthei ki la leit sha ka jingtep ki da rah ïa ki musla kiba ki la pynkhreh .

translation.en: He sent Moses his servant  ; and Aaron whom he had chosen .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa u shakri jong u , u Moses , bad u Aaron , ïa kiba u la jied .

translation.en: For though we walk in the flesh , we do not war after the flesh :
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba ngi im ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ngim ïaleh na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrthei .

translation.en: And one of you say unto them , Depart in peace , be ye warmed and filled  ; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body  ; what doth it profit ?
translation.kha: Kan myntoi aïu da kaba ong ha ki ,  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi ! To phong syaid bad to bam bha !  — lada phim ai ha ki ïa ki jingdonkam jong ka jingim ?

translation.en: These be the sons of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob in Paddan–aram , with his daughter Dinah : all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three .
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki khun shynrang ba ka Leah ka la kha na u Jakob ha Mesopotamia nalor ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Dinah . Baroh ki khun ki ksiew kiba u ïoh na ka Leah ki long laiphew lai ngut .

translation.en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah u im khatsan snem hadien ka jingïap u Jehoash u Syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words .
translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa ki jingujor jong ki , nga la bitar bad kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Are there not twelve hours in the day ? If any man walk in the day , he stumbleth not , because he seeth the light of this world .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Hato ym don khat-ar kynta ha ka shi sngi ? Kumta uno uno uba ïaid haba dang shai ka sngi un ym jynthut , naba u ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Because your fathers have forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , and have walked after other gods , and have served them , and have worshipped them , and have forsaken me , and have not kept my law  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la ong , ‘ Ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la phai dien noh na nga bad ki la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad kim shym kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong nga .

translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children , how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him ?
translation.kha: Phi kiba sniew eh , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Kaba katno tam keiñ , ba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un ai kiei kiei kiba bha ha kito kiba pan na u !

translation.en: The son of Dekar , in Makaz , and in Shaalbim , and Beth–shemesh , and Elon–beth–hanan :
translation.kha: U Bendeker : ki nongbah Makas , Shaalbim , Beth Shemesh , Elon , bad Beth Hanan

translation.en: This was the word of the  Lord  which he spake unto Jehu , saying , Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation . And so it came to pass .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ka jingkular la pyndep ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha u syiem Jehu :  Ki khun ki ksiew jong me , haduh ka pateng kaba saw , kin long ki syiem ha Israel .

translation.en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God , and may with you be refreshed .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan wan sha phi da ka jingkmen kaba dap , lada ka long ka mon jong U Blei , bad ngan dap da ka jinghun ba pynpyngngad haba ngan wan khmih ïa phi .

translation.en: And Jesus arose , and followed him , and so did his disciples .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit ryngkat bad u .

translation.en: And when thou prayest , thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets , that they may be seen of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , wat long kum ki riewarsap ! Ki ieit ban ïeng bad duwai ha ki synagog bad ha ki kyndong surok , khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .

translation.en: Wherefore that field was called , The field of blood , unto this day .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba la khot  Ka Lyngkha Ka Snam  haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king , and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz , prayed and cried to heaven .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Hesekaïah bad u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos ki duwai ha U Blei bad ki khot kyrpad ïa u ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the instruction of wisdom  ; and before honour is humility .
translation.kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka long ka jinghikai na ka hi . Phi dei ban long kiba sngewrit ha shuwa ba phin ïoh ïa ki jingkyntiew burom .

translation.en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; I remember thee , the kindness of thy youth , the love of thine espousals , when thou wentest after me in the wilderness , in a land that was not sown .
translation.kha: ban pynbna ïa kane ka khubor ha uwei pa uwei ha Jerusalem ,  Nga kynmaw kumno phi la long kiba ïaineh mynba phi dang khynnah , kumno phi la ieit ïa nga mynba ngi dang shongkurim nyngkong ; phi la bud ïa nga lyngba ka ri shyiap , lyngba ka ri ka bym pat shym la thung jingthung .

translation.en: ( Luke 1 :30-33 ) When Jesus was on earth , he proved that he would be a kind , just , and perfect Ruler .
translation.kha: ( Loukas 1 :30-33 ) Mynba u Jisu u don ha ka pyrthei , u la pynshisha ba un long u Nongsynshar uba sbun , uba hok bad uba janai .

translation.en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre , they are all mighty men .
translation.kha: Ki rang bahryntieh jong ki , ki long ki shipai bakhrawbor kiba pynïap khlem jingisynei .

translation.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ka Ammon ban manbha biang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted  ; that I might learn thy statutes .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynshitom jong nga ka la long kaba bha ïa nga , namar ka pynlong ïa nga ban nang ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And Azariah the priest went in after him , and with him fourscore priests of the  Lord  , that were valiant men :
translation.kha: U Asaraïah u lyngdoh ryngkat bad phraphew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba khlaiñ bad bashlur ki bud nadien jong u Syiem Ussaïah ban khang ïa u .

translation.en: And he said unto him , See , I have accepted thee concerning this thing also , that I will not overthrow this city , for the which thou hast spoken .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Kata ruh ka biang hi . Ngan nym pynjot ïa kata ka nongrit .

translation.en: That then the  Lord  thy God will turn thy captivity , and have compassion upon thee , and will return and gather thee from all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath scattered thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un leh-isynei ïa phi . Un wan ïalam pat ïa phi napdeng kita ki jaitbynriew sha kiba u la pynsakma ïa phi , bad un pynbha pat ïa phi .

translation.en: And the governor said , Why , what evil hath he done ? But they cried out the more , saying , Let him be crucified .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ,  Ka kam runar aïu u la leh ?  Nangta ki la sdang ban pyrta da ka sur kaba jam tam :  Sahnarphna ïa u !

translation.en: Whether any do enquire of Titus , he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you : or our brethren be enquired of , they are the messengers of the churches , and the glory of Christ .
translation.kha: Hato don ba kylli shaphang u Titos , u long u nongïatrei lang bad nga ban ïarap ïa phi ; bad shaphang kiwei pat ki parabangeit kiba ïaleit lang bad u , ki mihkhmat ïa ki balang bad ki wallam ka burom ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded  ; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss .
translation.kha: Ki khot lang arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai na ki nongbah jong ki ha kata ka sngi . Nalor kine , ki nongshong shnong ka Gibeah ki lumlang hynñiewspah ngut ki rangdajied kiba la jied kyrpang kiba treikam da kadiang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u tbit ban kawang maw khlem da lait wat ha u  ñiuhkhlieh .

translation.en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool .
translation.kha: U briew uba shemphang u ïoh jinghikai kham bun na kawei ka jingsneng ban kaba uba bieit u ïoh jinghikai na kaba shah sympat shispah sien .

translation.en: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides  ; and they four had their faces and their wings .
translation.kha: Nalor ki saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw tylli ki thapniang jong ki , uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki kti briew , hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .

translation.en: When heaven is shut up , and there is no rain , because they have sinned against thee  ; if they pray toward this place , and confess thy name , and turn from their sin , when thou afflictest them :
translation.kha: Haba me khang ïa u slap ban hap namar ba ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta haba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad phai khmat sha kane ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaba sngewrit ha me , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .

translation.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead , if the dead rise not at all ? why are they then baptized for the dead ?
translation.kha: Mynta , aïu kan long ïa kito ki briew kiba la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ? Aïu ki kyrmen ban pyndep ? Lada ka long kaba shisha , kumba don kiba kam , ba ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , balei ïa kito ki briew la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ?

translation.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps .
translation.kha: katba kita kiba stad ki la rah ïa la ki jingdiang ba la pyndap da ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak jong ki .

translation.en: A fool also is full of words : a man cannot tell what shall be  ; and what shall be after him , who can tell him ?
translation.kha: U bieit u kren bad ïai kren . Ym don mano mano batip kaei ka ban jia marbud , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh kan jia aïu hadien ba ngi ïap .

translation.en: Then said the lord of the vineyard , What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son : it may be they will reverence him when they see him .
translation.kha: Te u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ u la ong , ‘ Kaei ngan leh ? ngan phah ïa u khun ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga ; da kaba thikna kin burom ïa u !’

translation.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give  ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam don satia ka hok ban jied mano u ban shong sha kamon jong nga bad sha kadiang jong nga . Dei U Blei u ban ai ïa kine ki jaka ha kito ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ïa ki .

translation.en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture , Behold , I lay in Sion a chief corner stone , elect , precious : and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la jied ïa u maw uba kordor ïa uba nga buh kum u mawdong ha Seïon ; bad uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym noh mynsiem da lei lei .

translation.en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , and in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship ,
translation.kha: bad nga la pyndap ïa u da ka bor jong nga . Nga la ai ha u ka jingshemphang , ka jingtbit bad ka jingnang ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh —

translation.en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods , and the high places , and brake down the images , and cut down the groves :
translation.kha: U weng noh ïa ki duwan nongwei bad ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynpra ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang , bad u ot noh ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Tell us , we pray thee , for whose cause this evil is upon us  ; What is thine occupation ? and whence comest thou ? what is thy country ? and of what people art thou ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa u :  Mynta te , ïathuh ïa ngi ! Mano uba long ka daw na ka bynta kane ? Me leh aïu hangne ? Me wan na kano ka ri ? Kaei ka jinglong traishnong jong me ?

translation.en: And on the morrow when he departed , he took out two pence , and gave them to the host , and said unto him , Take care of him  ; and whatsoever thou spendest more , when I come again , I will repay thee .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u la sei ar tylli ki sbai rupa bad u la ai ïa ki ha u trai ïing . ‘ To sumar ïa u ,’ u la ong ïa u trai ïing , ‘ bad ynda nga wan phai na kane ka lynti , ngan siew ïa me ïa kano kano kaba me pynlut halor jong u .’
