translation.en: Then cometh he to his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : behold , the hour is at hand , and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat sha ki synran bad u la ong ,  Phi dang ïohthiah bad pynjahthait ? Ha khmih ! Ka por ka poi ïa U Khun U Briew ba yn aiti noh ha ka bor ki briew kiba pop .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the morning , behold , it was Leah : and he said to Laban , What is this thou hast done unto me ? did not I serve with thee for Rachel ? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me ?
translation.kha: Dei tad ynda ka la shai mynstep ba u Jakob u shem ba ka dei pynban da ka Leah . U leit sha u Laban , bad u ong ,  Balei phi leh ïa kane ha nga ? Nga la trei ban ïoh ïa ka Rakhel ? Balei phi la shukor ïa nga ?

translation.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah , and all Israel with him , unto Libnah , and fought against Libnah :
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit na Makkedah sha Libnah bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers , and none shall deliver her out of mine hand .
translation.kha: Ngan law lyngkhuit ïa ka ha khmat kiba ieit jong ka , bad yn ym don uno uno ruh uba lah ban pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jong nga .

translation.en: The king s strength also loveth judgment  ; thou dost establish equity , thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem bakhlaiñbor , me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei ; me la pynskhem ïa ka jingbishar hok ha Israel ; me la wanrah ïa ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .

translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these , and it shall be forgiven him : and the remnant shall be the priest s , as a meat offering .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop ba uta u briew u la leh , bad yn map ïa u . U purew uba dang sah un long jong u lyngdoh , kumba ka long ha ka jingkñia ainguh bam .

translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will burn her chariots in the smoke , and the sword shall devour thy young lions : and I will cut off thy prey from the earth , and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard .
translation.kha: Nga long u nongshun jong pha !  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .  Ngan thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong pha . Ïa ki shipai jong pha yn pynïap ha ka thma , bad ngan shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la shim na kiwei . Ïa ka jingdawa jong ki nongsynran jong pha yn ym ïohsngew shuh .

translation.en: And Joshua at that time turned back , and took Hazor , and smote the king thereof with the sword : for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u wan phai , u la kurup ïa ka Hasor bad pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka . ( Ha kata ka por , ka Hasor ka long kaba khlaiñ tam na kito ki hima baroh . )

translation.en: And he that regarded not the word of the  Lord  left his servants and his cattle in the field .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat kim suidñiew ïa ka jingmaham U  Trai  bad ki ieh ïa la ki mraw bad ïa la ki jingri ha lum .

translation.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .
translation.kha: Lada phi thmu sniew borabor , phin sa ïoh nam kum u nongthaw kulmar .

translation.en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali , and out of Asher , and out of all Manasseh , and pursued after the Midianites .
translation.kha: Nangta la khot ïa ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtali , Asher , bad na ka jait Manasseh baroh ar bynta , ki beh kthong ïa ki Midian .

translation.en: And he saw that rest was good , and the land that it was pleasant  ; and bowed his shoulder to bear , and became a servant unto tribute .
translation.kha: Hynrei u ïohi ba ka jaka shongthait ka long kaba bha , Bad ba ka khyndew ka long kaba itynnat . Kumta u pyndem la ka met ban kit ïa ka jingkit , Bad la pynbor ban trei kum u mraw .

translation.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty , and taketh away the understanding of the aged .
translation.kha: U pynsngap jar ïa kito ki lah ban shaniah , bad u shim noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki riewtymmen .

translation.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up , and be gathered unto thy people  ; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor , and was gathered unto his people :
translation.kha: Men sa ïap halor uta u lum kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïap ha u Lum Hor ,

translation.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .
translation.kha: Katba phi nang bunktien , katta phi nang leh pop . Lada phi long uba stad phin sngap jar .

translation.en: And the  Lord  went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud , to lead them the way  ; and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light  ; to go by day and night :
translation.kha: Mynsngi , U  Trai  u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot lyoh ban kdew lynti ïa ki , bad mynmiet pat u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot ding ban ai jingshai ïa ki , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaid mynsngi bad mynmiet .

translation.en: Turn again , and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of David thy father , I have heard thy prayer , I have seen thy tears : behold , I will heal thee : on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban leit phai pat sha u Hesekaïah , u nongsynshar jong ki briew U  Trai  , bad ban ong ha u ,  Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong me , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me bad nga la ïohi ïa ki ummat jong me . Ngan pynkhiah ïa me , bad hadien lai sngi men leit sha ka Templ .

translation.en: Concerning zeal , persecuting the church ; touching the righteousness which is in the law , blameless .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u lah ban long uba hok da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingong ka hukum , nga long uba khlem jingrem .

translation.en: The noise of a whip , and the noise of the rattling of the wheels , and of the pransing horses , and of the jumping chariots .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingsawa u shabuk , ka jingriew ki shalyntem , ka jingsawa ka jingïaid ki kulai , ka jingkynthih jong ki kali ïapom !

translation.en: And as I may so say , Levi also , who receiveth tithes , payed tithes in Abraham .
translation.kha: Bad kum ban shu ong , haba u Abraham u la siew ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew , u Lebi ( kiba hiarpateng na u ki lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew ) ruh u la siew ïa ka .

translation.en: The tabernacle of the congregation , and the ark of the testimony , and the mercy seat that is thereupon , and all the furniture of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ïa ka jingtap jong ka , ïa ki jingpynriam baroh jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north . So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north , and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , peit shaphang shatei .  Nga la peit , bad hangta hajan ka duwan harud ka jaka rung ka khyrdop nga la ïohi ïa ka dur bleithaw kaba long ka jingijli ba pynbitar ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  answered Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
translation.kha: Nangta napdeng ka  erïong U  Trai  u la kren ha u Job .

translation.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering , and laid it upon Isaac his son  ; and he took the fire in his hand , and a knife  ; and they went both of them together .
translation.kha: U Abraham u pynkit ha u Isaak ïa ki dieng na ka bynta ka jingkñia , bad ma u pat u rah ïa ka tari bad ïa ki rnga barhem ban sliew ding . Katba baroh ar ngut ki dang ïa-ïaid ,

translation.en: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land , and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years .
translation.kha: Phi dei ruh ban thung ïa kiwei ki rangbah synshar bad shim ïa kawei na kaba san bynta na ki jingthung ha ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh .

translation.en: The glory of the  Lord  shall endure for ever : the  Lord  shall rejoice in his works .
translation.kha: To ka burom jong U  Trai  kan neh junom ! To U  Trai  un kmen ïa kaei kaba u la thaw !

translation.en: But now having no more place in these parts , and having a great desire these many years to come unto you ;
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ha kine ki thain bad namar ba nga la ju kwah la bun snem ban wan khmih ïa phi , nga kyrmen ban leh kumta mynta .

translation.en: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families , the family of Matri was taken , and Saul the son of Kish was taken : and when they sought him , he could not be found .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u pynwan sha khmat ïa ki ïing na ka jait Benjamin , bad ka ïing u Matri ka la shah jied . Nangta ki rangbah na ka ïing kur u Matri ki wan sha khmat , bad u Saul u khun jong u Kish u la shah jied . Ki wad ïa u hynrei haba kim shem ïa u ,

translation.en: The lot is cast into the lap  ; but the whole disposing thereof is of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakynting sbai ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei , hynrei U Blei da lade hi u ai ïa ka jubab .

translation.en: And I will not have mercy upon her children  ; for they be the children of whoredoms .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki khun jong ka ; ki long ki khun jong ka nuti bym don jinglehrain .

translation.en: But the word is very nigh unto thee , in thy mouth , and in thy heart , that thou mayest do it .
translation.kha: Em , ka don hangne bad phi . Phi tip ïa ka bad phi lah ban sot ïa ka ; kumta mynta , kohnguh ïa ka .

translation.en: The benefit of learning how to apply Bible principles .
translation.kha: Ka jingmyntoi ban tip kumno ban bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ka Baibl .

translation.en: And his servant Zimri , captain of half his chariots , conspired against him , as he was in Tirzah , drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah .
translation.kha: U Simri , uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam uba peit ïa shiteng ki kali ïapom jong u syiem , u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u . Ha kawei ka sngi ha Tirsah , u Elah u buaid ha ka ïing jong u Arsa , uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity , but rejoiceth in the truth ;
translation.kha: ka jingieit kam kmen ha ka jingbymman , hynrei ka kmen ha ka jingshisha .

translation.en: But I tell you of a truth , many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias , when the heaven was shut up three years and six months , when great famine was throughout all the land  ;
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa nga : Ka long kaba shisha ba ki don shibun ki riewkynthei ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elijah , haba ym shym la don slap haduh lai snem shiteng bad ba ka  nemsniew bajur ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab ? did he ever strive against Israel , or did he ever fight against them ,
translation.kha: Me tharai ba me kham bha ban ïa u Balak , u khun jong u Sippor , u syiem Moab ? Um ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel . Hato u la ju ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ngi ?

translation.en: I know you have it with you .
translation.kha: Nga tip phi don maphi kato .

translation.en: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee , into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them .
translation.kha: Ki khatwei ngut ki synran ki la leit sha u lumrit ha Galilaïa ha kaba U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ban leit .

translation.en: He croucheth , and humbleth himself , that the poor may fall by his strong ones .
translation.kha: Ki lanot ki bym ïoh jingïarap ki dem ha ka jinglwet ; ka jingkhlaiñ ba thombor ka la jop ïa ki .

translation.en: Then the Philistines went up , and pitched in Judah , and spread themselves in Lehi .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki wan bad sher dara ha Judah , bad ki hiarthma ïa ka shnong Lehi .

translation.en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
translation.kha: Ki paid ka Judah ki pynïap kylla ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki pynlong syiem ïa u Josaïah u khun jong u .

translation.en: And they said , Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jubab ,  Ngin ym shah ban leh ïa ka para jong ngi kum ka nuti .

translation.en: Thus the  Lord  saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians  ; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u pyllait im ïa ki Israel na ki Ijipt , bad ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ki ba ki thiah ïap harud duriaw .

translation.en: Marvel not , my brethren , if the world hate you .
translation.kha: Phi wat sngewlyngngoh , ko ki para jong nga , lada ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki isih ïa phi .

translation.en: They envied Moses also in the camp , and Aaron the saint of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap ki la pihuiñ ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , ki shakri bakhuid jong U  Trai .

translation.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint : but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment .
translation.kha: Mem shym la ai ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta ka khlieh jong nga , hynrei ka la tap ïa ka khlieh jong nga da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih .

translation.en: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie , saying , I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink  ; he shall even be the prophet of this people .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki kwah ïa u jait nongïathuhlypa uba ïaid kylleng uba dap da ka lamler bad jingshukor bad u ong , ‘ Nga ïathuhlypa ba ka waiñ bad ka kyiad kin tuid na ka bynta jong phi .’

translation.en: And they judged the people at all seasons : the hard causes they brought unto Moses , but every small matter they judged themselves .
translation.kha: Ki la shakri kum ki nongbishar na ka bynta u paidbah ha ki por baroh , da kaba wallam ïa ki kam kiba eh sha u Moses hynrei ki bishar hi ïa ki jingïakajia kiba rit .

translation.en: We asked their names also , to certify thee , that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them .
translation.kha: Ngi kylli ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khnang ba ngi lah ban pyntip sha phi mano ki nongïalam jong kane ka kam ki dei .

translation.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban lait na ka jingjynjar to sumar ïa kaei kaba phi ong .

translation.en: For yet a little while , and he that shall come will come , and will not tarry .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Namar sa tang shibit eh , bad uta uba wan un wan ; un ym slem shuh .

translation.en: For the pastors are become brutish , and have not sought the  Lord  : therefore they shall not prosper , and all their flocks shall be scattered .
translation.kha: Nga la jubab ,  Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki long kiba mutlop ; kim shym kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïalam . Dei kane keiñ balei ba ki shahjop , bad ki briew jong ngi ki la shah pynsakma .

translation.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt  ; for I have kept thy testimonies .
translation.kha: To pyllaitluid ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ bad jingkrenbeiñ jong ki , namar nga la sumar ïa ki aiñ jong me ;

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto him , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Elijah ,

translation.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar , the coast of Moab , this day :
translation.kha: ‘ Mynta ka sngi phi dei ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab ha Ar .

translation.en: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets , rising early and sending them , saying , Oh , do not this abominable thing that I hate .
translation.kha: Nga ïai phah sha phi ïa ki shakri jong nga kiba long ki nongïathuhlypa , kiba la ong ïa phi ban ym leh ïa kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba nga isih .

translation.en: But Paul thought not good to take him with them , who departed from them from Pamphylia , and went not with them to the work .
translation.kha: hynrei u Paul um shym pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei ban ïalam ïa u , namar um shym la sah bad ki haduh kaba kut ka kam jong ki , hynrei u la leit phai pat bad u la iehnoh ïa ki ha Pamphylia .

translation.en: O the hope of Israel , the saviour thereof in time of trouble , why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land , and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night ?
translation.kha: Tang ma me , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; me long uta uba la pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingpynjot . Balei me long kum u nongwei ha ka ri jong ngi , kum u nongleit jingleit uba sah tang shi miet ?

translation.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood , Awake  ; to the dumb stone , Arise , it shall teach ! Behold , it is laid over with gold and silver , and there is no breath at all in the midst of it .
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi ong ha ka lyngkhot dieng ,  Khie noh !  ne ïa u maw ,  Ïeng joit !  Hato ka bleithaw ka lah ban pynpaw ei ei ïa phi ? Lah ban suit ïa ka da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , hynrei ym don jingim ha ka .

translation.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not : but what they know naturally , as brute beasts , in those things they corrupt themselves .
translation.kha: Hynrei , kine ki briew , ki tur ïaleh da kaba krenbeiñ da kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh ; bad kito kiei kiei kiba ki tip da ka bor tipthuh kum ki mradkhlaw , ki long kita hi kiei kiei kiba pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand : and he sent them away .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam ha ban da kdang — la don kumba saw hajar ngut ki briew . Nangta ki synran ki la ïalum hynñiew tukri kiba la dap da ki lyngkhot lyngkhai ba la sah tam . U Jisu u la phah noh ïa ki briew

translation.en: And David perceived that the  Lord  had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel s sake .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u Dabid u sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la pynskhem ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel bad u la kyntiew ïa ka hima jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong u .

translation.en: All things are lawful for me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but all things edify not .
translation.kha: Ïa ngi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh ,  kumta ki ong . Kata ka long kaba shisha , hynrei ym kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba bha .  Ïa ngi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh  — hynrei ym baroh ka long kaba myntoi .

translation.en: And when they shall say unto you , Seek unto them that have familiar spirits , and unto wizards that peep , and that mutter : should not a people seek unto their God ? for the living to the dead ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kin ong ïa me ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongkren byrtong kiba kren jam bad kiba kren mian mian . Kin ong ,  Nalor baroh , ki briew ki dei ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki mynsiem bad kylli na kiba ïap na ka bynta kiba im .

translation.en: And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner .
translation.kha: U Pharisi u la kyndit haba u ïohi ba U Jisu um shym la thet ha shuwa ban bam .

translation.en: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host , which was with him , Go now through all the tribes of Israel , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , and number ye the people , that I may know the number of the people .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u la ai hukum ïa u Joab , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u :  Khie leit bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi ha kylleng ki jait Israel na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tip ki don haduh katno .

translation.en: For he said unto him ,  Come out of the man , thou unclean spirit .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane namar U Jisu u la ong ,  Me u mynsiem bymkhuid , mihnoh na une u briew !  )

translation.en: What ? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body ? for two , saith he , shall be one flesh .
translation.kha: Lane lehse phim tip ba u briew uba pynïasoh ïa la ka met bad ka nuti u long kawei ka met bad ka ? Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shai kdar ,  Baroh ar kin ïalong kawei ka doh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were come , that he looked on Eliab , and said , Surely the  Lord s  anointed is before him .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la poi , u Samuel u ïohi ïa u Eliab u khun jong u Jesse bad u ong ha lade ,  Une uba ïeng hangne ha khmat U  Trai  da shisha u dei uba U la jied .

translation.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear : for thy judgments are good .
translation.kha: To pyllait ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ kiba nga sheptieng ; A katno kiba phylla long ki jingbishar jong me !

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house , and I will take thy wives before thine eyes , and give them unto thy neighbour , and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun .
translation.kha: Nga smai ha me ba ngan pynlong ïa uwei na ka longïing jong me hi ban wallam jingjynjar halor jong me . Men ïohi ïa ka haba nga shim na me ïa ki tnga jong me bad ai ïa ki ha uwei pat u briew ; bad un ïathiah shongkha bad ki haba dang shai ka sngi .

translation.en: Which rejoice exceedingly , and are glad , when they can find the grave ?
translation.kha: Kim shym long kiba kmen haduh ka jingïap bad la tep ïa ki ;

translation.en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills , and of the south , and of the vale , and of the springs , and all their kings : he left none remaining , but utterly destroyed all that breathed , as the  Lord  God of Israel commanded .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u la jop thiaw ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei . U la jop ïa ki syiem jong ka ri lum , kiba ha ki sharing lum ha ka phang mihngi , bad kiba ha trai ki lum ha ka phang sepngi , bad ïa kito ki jong ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang bashathie . Um shym la pynsah ïano ïano , u pynïap lut khoit ïa ki baroh . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la hukum .

translation.en: And , behold , there arose a great tempest in the sea , insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves : but he was asleep .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan ka  erïong kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la don ha ka jingma ban sa ngam . Hynrei u Jisu u la ïohthiah .

translation.en: The wicked will be destroyed . —2 Peter 3 :7 .
translation.kha: Yn sa pynjot noh thiaw ïa kiba sniew .—2 Petros 3 :7 .

translation.en: Honour thy father and thy mother , as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee  ; that thy days may be prolonged , and that it may go well with thee , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , kumba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga hukum ïa phi , khnang ba phin manbha bad im slem ha kata ka ri ba nga ai ha phi .

translation.en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a jealous God among you ) lest the anger of the  Lord  thy God be kindled against thee , and destroy thee from off the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Lada phi mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ka jingbitar U  Trai  kan wan bad thang ïa phi kum ka ding bad kan pynjot thiaw ïa phi , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba don ryngkat bad phi , um lah shah ba phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry : and I will multiply them , and they shall not be few  ; I will also glorify them , and they shall not be small .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sah hangta kin rwai ïaroh ; kin pyrta jam da ka jingkmen . Da ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kin roi ha ka jingbun paid ; ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kan wallam ha ki ka burom .

translation.en: And Absalom said to Hushai , Is this thy kindness to thy friend ? why wentest thou not with thy friend ?
translation.kha: La jia aïu ïa ka jingkyrshan jong me ïa u Dabid , u paralok jong me ?  u Absalom u la kylli ïa u .  Balei mem leit ryngkat bad u ?

translation.en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee ? let them arise , if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble : for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods , O Judah .
translation.kha: Hangno ki blei kiba phi la thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ? Haba phi don ha ka jingjynjar , ai ba ma ki kin pynim ïa phi — lada ki lah ! Ko Judah pha la don shibun ki blei kumba pha don ki nongbah .

translation.en: And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her .
translation.kha: Te u Jakob u ong ha u Laban ,  Ka por ka la kut noh ; to shah ba ngan shongkurim noh ïa ka khun jong phi .

translation.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night , I and he  ; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew mar la ka jingphohsniew kaba don la ka jong ka jong ka jingmut .

translation.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows , I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent .
translation.kha: Lada nga phuh samrkhie bad pyrshang ban klet ïa la ka jingpang , baroh ka jingshitom jong nga ka wan biang ban pynkhuslai ïa nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u rai pynrem ïa nga .

translation.en: And all the people of Judah took Azariah , which was sixteen years old , and made him king instead of his father Amaziah .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah Judah te ki pynkup syiem ïa u khun jong u , u Ussaïah uba don khathynriew snem ka rta .

translation.en: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi da ka iktiar jong U Trai ban pule ïa kane ka shithi ha ki parabangeit baroh .

translation.en: How great are his signs ! and how mighty are his wonders ! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and his dominion is from generation to generation .
translation.kha: Katno kiba khraw ki long ki jingphylla jong U Blei kiba u pyn-i ha ngi ! Katno kiba khrawbor ki long ki kambah kiba u leh ! U Blei u long u syiem junom ; un synshar ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots , wagons , and wheels , and with an assembly of people , which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about : and I will set judgment before them , and they shall judge thee according to their judgments .
translation.kha: Kin tur ïaleh ïa pha naphang shatei , da kaba wanrah ïa ka kynhun shipai babun lem bad ki kali ïapom bad ki , ki kali ba-dap kyrhai ka jingbam . Da kaba kieng da ki stieh bad ki jingïada khlieh , kin ker sawdong ïa pha . Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki , bad kin bishar ïa pha da la ki jong ki aiñ .

translation.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .
translation.kha: Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh hangta ! Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh ha ka Duriaw Basaw !

translation.en: But they also have erred through wine , and through strong drink are out of the way  ; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink , they are swallowed up of wine , they are out of the way through strong drink  ; they err in vision , they stumble in judgment .
translation.kha: Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid bha bad ki ïaid sheng sheng . Ki la dih waiñ bad dih kyiad haduh katta katta haduh ba ki jynthut kulmar . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïabuaid haduh katta katta ba kim sngewthuh shuh ïa ki jingïohipaw ba U Blei u phah , bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid haduh ba kim lah shuh ban ai jingrai ïa ki kam ba la wanrah ha ki .

translation.en: Love ye therefore the stranger : for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Namar kata , ieit ïa kita ki nongwei , namar phi ruh phi la long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And thy servant my father said unto us , Ye know that my wife bare me two sons :
translation.kha: Nangta i pa i ong ha ngi , ‘ Phi tip ba ka Rakhel ka tnga jong nga ka ïoh tang ar ngut ki khun shynrang na nga .

translation.en: And I will make of thee a great nation , and I will bless thee , and make thy name great  ; and thou shalt be a blessing :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ïa me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad kin sa long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pyndonnam ïa ka kyrteng jong me , ba kumta men sa long ka jingkyrkhu .

translation.en: That which was from the beginning , which we have heard , which we have seen with our eyes , which we have looked upon , and our hands have handled , of the Word of life  ;
translation.kha: Ngi thoh sha phi shaphang U Ktien ka jingim , uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi la ïohi ïa u da la ki khmat ; ho-oid , ngi la ïohi ïa u , bad ki kti jong ngi ki la ïohktah ïa u .

translation.en: And Judah said , What shall we say unto my lord ? what shall we speak ? or how shall we clear ourselves ? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants : behold , we are my lord s servants , both we , and he also with whom the cup is found .
translation.kha: U Judah u ong ,  Ko kynrad , ngin ong aïu pat ha phi ? Kumno keiñ ngin ïasaid ? Kumno keiñ ngi lah ban sait khuid ïa lade ? U Blei u la lap ïa kane ka kam bymman jong ngi . Mynta te , baroh ngi long ki mraw jong phi , bad ym tang uta na uba la shem ïa ka khuri .

translation.en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees , branches of palm trees , and the boughs of thick trees , and willows of the brook  ; and ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God seven days .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi kaba nyngkong , phin shim ïa ki soh kiba kynsai , ïa ki tnat dieng Tlai , bad ïa ki tnat dieng kiba bun sla , bad sdang ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the day when the  Lord  spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt ,
translation.kha: Mynba U  Trai  u la kren ha u Moses ha ka ri Ijipt , u la ong ,  Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And he said unto me ,  Depart : for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles .
translation.kha: ‘ Khie leit ,’ U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ naba ngan phah ïa me sha jngai sha ki Jentil .’

translation.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul : but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding .
translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ban shah hikai , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa lade . Lada phi pdiang ïa ka jingpynbeit , phin long kiba kham stad .

translation.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ïano me pyrkhat ba me ibeiñ bad krenbeiñ ? Me la leh bymsuidñiew ïa nga , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel .

translation.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingieit kaba U Mynsiem u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Therefore said he , Take it up to thee . And he put out his hand , and took it .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u ,  u hukum bad uta u briew u dem bad u la shim ïa u .

translation.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father , and set him before Pharaoh : and Jacob blessed Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u wan ïalam ïa u Jakob u kpa jong u bad u pynithuh ïa u ha u syiem . U Jakob u kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa u syiem ,

translation.en: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , at Beth–shemesh , and brought him to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate , four hundred cubits .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u la ïohkem ïa u Amasaïah bad u ïalam ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh nongbah naduh ka Khyrdop Ephraim haduh ka Khyrdop Dong , ka jingjngai kumba arspah mitar .

translation.en: He answered and said , Lo , I see four men loose , walking in the midst of the fire , and they have no hurt  ; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God .
translation.kha: Te balei ba nga ïohi saw ngut ki rangbah kiba ïaid ha ka ding ?  u la kylli .  Ïa ki ym shym la khum , bad kim shym pyn-i kano kano ka dak jong ka jingmynsaw — bad uba saw u i kum u angel .

translation.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand .
translation.kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah , u jop ïa ki Edom ha ka Them Mluh bad pynïap khatphra hajar ngut na ki .

translation.en: Therefore , son of man , speak unto the house of Israel , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me , in that they have committed a trespass against me .
translation.kha: Mynta te , ko khun u briew , ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki . Kane ka dei kawei pat ka rukom kaba ki kpa jong ki , ki la ibeiñ ïa nga da ka jingbymïaineh jong ki .

translation.en: And their windows , and their arches , and their palm trees , were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east  ; and they went up unto it by seven steps  ; and the arches thereof were before them .
translation.kha: Ka kamra rung , ki jingkhangïit , bad ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong , ki la long kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Hangne la don hynñiew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka khyrdop , bad ka kamra rung ka la long ha kaba kut marpyrshah ka phyllaw .

translation.en: And they cried aloud , and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets , till the blood gushed out upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la duwai kham jam bad ki la ot ïa lade da ki tari bad ki waitsum , kat kum ki rukom lehniam jong ki , haduh ba ka snam ka la tuid .

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And when they had taken security of Jason , and of the other , they let them go .
translation.kha: Ki bor synshar ki la pynlong ïa u Jason bad ïa kiwei pat ban siew ïa ka pisa kaba donkam ban ïohlait , bad nangta ki la pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him .
translation.kha: U Hamor u kpa jong u Shekhem u la leit ban ïakren bad u Jakob , hamar ba ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la wan phai na ki pyntha .

translation.en: And Elijah said unto them , Take the prophets of Baal  ; let not one of them escape . And they took them : and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon , and slew them there .
translation.kha: U Elijah u hukum bad ong ,  Kem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ; wat ai ba uno uno na ki un lait phet !  Ki paidbah ki la kem ïa ki baroh , bad u Elijah u la ïalam ïa ki sha ka wah Kishon bad pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: And the men of Beth–shemesh said , Who is able to stand before this holy  Lord  God ? and to whom shall he go up from us ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki rangbah na Beth Shemesh ki ïa-ong ,  Uei uba lah ban ïeng ha khmat U  Trai  , une U Blei uba Khuid ? Shano ngi lah ban phah ïa u ba un lait noh na ngi ?

translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and said unto her , Entice him , and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him , that we may bind him to afflict him : and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit sha ka bad ki ong ,  Khroh ïa u Samson ban ïathuh ha pha balei ba u long uba khlaiñbor bad kumno ngin lah ban jop ïa u , khum ïa u bad pynlong ba un ym lah leh ei ei shuh . Uwei pa uwei na ngi un ai ïa pha mar shihajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image , an abomination unto the  Lord  , the work of the hands of the craftsman , and putteth it in a secret place . And all the people shall answer and say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba thaw durblei da u maw , da u dieng , lane da u nar bad uba mane ïa ka ha kaba rieh ; U  Trai  u isih ïa ka jingmane bleithaw .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him  ; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him , Make this fellow return , that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him , and let him not go down with us to battle , lest in the battle he be an adversary to us : for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master ? should it not be with the heads of these men ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongïalam jong ki Philistia ki bitar ïa u Akhish , bad ki ong ha u ,  Phah un leit noh sha ka jaka kaba phi la ai ïa u . Wat shah ba un leit bad ngi sha ka thma , ïoh u phai pyrshah ïa ngi katba ngi dang ïaleh . Naba na-ei un ïoh ka lad kaba kham bha ban pynsngewbha biang ïa la u kynrad ? Hato ym dei da ka jingïap ki briew jong ngi ?

translation.en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel , who dwelt in Egypt , was four hundred and thirty years .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki sah ha Ijipt sawspah laiphew snem .

translation.en: And I will harden Pharaoh s heart , that he shall follow after them  ; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host  ; that the Egyptians may know that I am the  Lord . And they did so .
translation.kha: Ngan pynmutlop ïa u , bad un sa wan thwet nadien jong phi ; bad kumta ka jingjop jong nga ïa u Pharaoh bad ka kynhun shipai jong u kan long ka burom ïa nga . Te ki nong Ijipt kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .  Ki Israel ki leh kumba la hukum ïa ki .

translation.en: For if I do this thing willingly , I have a reward : but if against my will , a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me .
translation.kha: Lada nga la trei ïa la ka kam da ka mon sngewbha , te nga la lah ban khmih lynti ban ïoh ïa ka bainong ; hynrei nga leh ïa ka tang kum ka kamram , namar U Blei u la aiti ha nga ïa kane ka kam .

translation.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt : your young men have I slain with the sword , and have taken away your horses  ; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka khlam ha phi kum kata kaba nga la phah ha Ijipt . Nga la pynïap ïa ki samla shynrang jong phi ha ka thma bad nga la knieh noh ïa ki kulai jong phi . Nga la pyndap ïa ki thliew khmut jong phi da ka jingiwtung ki metïap ha ki jaka shong dara jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .

translation.en: In vain have I smitten your children  ; they received no correction : your own sword hath devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .
translation.kha: Nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei kam shym wanrah kano kano ka jingbha ; phan ym da la shah ïa nga ban pynbeit ïa pha . Kum u sing uba shyrkhei , pha la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .

translation.en: He buildeth his house as a moth , and as a booth that the keeper maketh .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki tei ki ïing kum ka snur thapbawa lane kum ka ïingtrep u mraw uba ap phira ïa ki lyngkha .

translation.en: For this cause therefore have I called for you , to see you , and to speak with you : because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ha ka jingthmu U Blei

translation.en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee : the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned : so all the people shall be in peace .
translation.kha: bad nangta ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh sha phi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba wan phai sha la u jong u tnga . Phi kwah ban pynïap tang ïa uwei u briew ; kiba sah na ki paidbah kin lait im .

translation.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea , they supposed it had been a spirit , and cried out :
translation.kha: hynrei ki la ïohi ïa u ba u ïaid halor ka um .  Ka dei ka rngai !  ki la pyrkhat , bad ki la lynñiar .

translation.en: The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed  ; for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father s commandment : notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking  ; but ye hearkened not unto me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ban ym dih waiñ , bad haduh kane hi ka sngi ym don uwei ruh na ki uba dih ïa kaba kumno kumno ruh ka waiñ . Hynrei nga la ïai kren ha phi , bad phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: I have heard the check of my reproach , and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi la ong ka long ka jingñiewbeiñ , hynrei nga tip kumno ngan jubab ïa phi .

translation.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have sanctified for my name , will I cast out of my sight , and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations .
translation.kha: te ngan weng noh ïa phi na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan iehnoh ïa kane ka Templ ba nga la pynkyntang kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga . Ki briew kylleng kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ka .

translation.en: Because , even because they have seduced my people , saying , Peace  ; and there was no peace  ; and one built up a wall , and , lo , others daubed it with untempered mortar :
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da kaba ong ba baroh ka bit ka biang . Baroh kam long shisha kaba bit babiang ! Ki briew jong nga ki la pynïeng ka kynroh ki maw bym skhem , bad nangta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wan bad ki tap ïa ka da ka jingpushara lieh .

translation.en: My lord the king , these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet , whom they have cast into the dungeon  ; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is : for there is no more bread in the city .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem , kaei kaba kine ki briew ki la leh ka long ka bym dei . Ki la thep ïa u Jeremaïah ha ka pung , ha kaba , da shisha , un sa ïap ha ka jingïapthngan , namar ym don jingbam shuh ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: And speak unto him , saying , Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH  ; and he shall grow up out of his place , and he shall build the temple of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa u ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ U briew ïa uba la khot U Tnat un manbha ha kaba u don bad un tei ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai .

translation.en: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .
translation.kha: Kine keiñ ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ham kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .

translation.en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias . And when he had opened the book , he found the place where it was written ,
translation.kha: bad la ai ha u ïa ka kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa . U la plied ïa la kot kli bad u la shem ïa ka bynta ha kaba la thoh ,

translation.en: And now , behold , I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand . If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon , come  ; and I will look well unto thee : but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon , forbear : behold , all the land is before thee : whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go , thither go .
translation.kha: Mynta , ngan law noh ïa ki kynjri na ki ryndang-kti jong phi bad pyllait noh ïa phi . Lada phi kwah ban leit sha Babilonia ryngkat bad nga , phi lah ban leh kumta , bad ngan sumar ïa phi . Hynrei lada phim kwah ban leit , phi lah ban ym leit . Phi don ïa ka ri baroh kawei ban jied , phi lah ban leit shano shano ba phi kwah .

translation.en: Providing for honest things , not only in the sight of the Lord , but also in the sight of men .
translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong ngi ka long ban leh ïa kaba dei , ym tang ha khmat U Trai , hynrei ha khmat u briew ruh .

translation.en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did , they had not had sin : but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father .
translation.kha: Kin ym da la sngewrem ïa ka pop lada ngam shym la leh hapdeng jong ki ïa kiei kiei kiba ym don uno uno uwei pat uba la ju leh ; kumba ka long , ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh , bad ki shun ïa nga bad ïa U Kpa jong nga .

translation.en: In the evening she went , and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women , to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king s chamberlain , which kept the concubines : she came in unto the king no more , except the king delighted in her , and that she were called by name .
translation.kha: Kan leit hangta ha ka por janmiet , bad ha ka step babud yn ïalam ïa ka sha kawei pat ka ïing ki kynthei bad yn buh hapoh ka jingpeit jong u Shaashgas , u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki tnga kliar u syiem . Kan ym leit shuh sha u syiem lymda u sngewtynnat eh ïa ka ba un phah khot ïa ka da ka kyrteng .

translation.en: And it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give thee great and goodly cities , which thou buildedst not ,
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , un ai ha phi ïa ka ri kaba don ki shnong kiba heh bad kiba pahuh pahai kiba phim shym la tei .

translation.en: He answereth and saith unto them , He that hath two coats , let him impart to him that hath none  ; and he that hath meat , let him do likewise .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Uta uba don ar tylli ki sopti , u dei ban ai kawei ha u briew u bym don , bad uno uno uba don jingbam u dei ban ïasam ïa ka .

translation.en: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : because they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ki briew jong ka Ninebeh kin ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki mynba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga ong ha phi ba don hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Jonah !

translation.en: How goodly are thy tents , O Jacob , and thy tabernacles , O Israel !
translation.kha: Ki ïingjaiñ jong ki Israel ki long kiba itynnat , Kum ki dieng Tlai kiba ïeng laiñ .

translation.en: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles , that eat , asking no question for conscience sake :
translation.kha: Phi long kiba laitluid ban bam ïa kano kano kaba die ha ka ïew die doh , khlem da kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .

translation.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner , that he came to deceive thee , and to know thy going out and thy coming in , and to know all that thou doest .
translation.kha: U la wan shane ban shukor ïa phi bad ban tip ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh bad ïa ka leit ka wan jong phi . Khlem pep , phi tip ïa kata !

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge , and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart , to destroy it for the old hatred  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ki Philistia ki la pynhiarkput jubor ïa ki nongshun ba la slem bha bad ki la pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingshun jong ki .

translation.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem , and reigned : for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u synshar ha Jerusalem bad u nang khraw ha ka bor kum u syiem . U don sawphew wei snem mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah kaba U  Trai  u la jied na ki jaka baroh jong ka Israel kum ka jaka hangno ba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie jong u Rehoboam ka dei ka Naamah , na ka ri ki Ammon .

translation.en: The son of Shallum , the son of Zadok , the son of Ahitub ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Shallum , u khun jong u Sadok , u khun jong u Ahitub ,

translation.en: Shall not the land tremble for this , and every one mourn that dwelleth therein ? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood  ; and it shall be cast out and drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka khyndew kan khynñiuh , bad uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un long ha ka jinglanot . Ka ri baroh kawei kan khynñiuh ; kan kiew bad kan hiar kum ka wah Nile .

translation.en: Are we not counted of him strangers ? for he hath sold us , and hath quite devoured also our money .
translation.kha: I ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongwei . I la die ïa ngi , bad mynta i la pynlut ïa ka pisa baroh kaba long ka dor jong ngi .

translation.en: I would that ye all spake with tongues , but rather that ye prophesied : for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues , except he interpret , that the church may receive edifying .
translation.kha: Nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin kren ha ki thylliej bapher ; hynrei nga da kwah ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Naba u briew uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kham kor ban ïa uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher — lymda don uno uno uba batai ïa kaei kaba u kren , khnang ba kan long ka jingïarap ïa ka balang baroh kawei .

translation.en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste , and the land shall be desolate  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah kiba mynta ki dap da ki briew yn pynjot , bad ïa ka ri yn pynkylla ri khlaw . Nangta te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: ( And the  Lord  gave Israel a saviour , so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians : and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents , as beforetime .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki na ki Syria , bad kumta ki Israel ki im ha ka jingsuk , kumba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness  ; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday .
translation.kha: ne ïa ki khlam kiba shoh ha kaba dum , ne ïa ki jingsniew kiba pynïap haba shai ka sngi .

translation.en: These all died in faith , not having received the promises , but having seen them afar off , and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth .
translation.kha: Dei ha ka jingngeit ba kine ki briew baroh ki la ïap . Kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba U Blei u la kular , hynrei na sha jngai ki ïohi ïa ki bad ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , bad ki la pynbna paidbah ba ki la long ki nongwei bad ki sohshnong ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Cursed shalt thou be in the city , and cursed shalt thou be in the field .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa ki shnong bad ki lyngkha jong phi .

translation.en: They shall cut down her forest , saith the  Lord  , though it cannot be searched  ; because they are more than the grasshoppers , and are innumerable .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ki , ki bun shaba palat ban ñiew ; ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ban ïa ki puit .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers : now the magicians of Egypt , they also did in like manner with their enchantments .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot ïa ki riewstad bad ïa ki nongleh myntor jong u , bad ki ruh ki leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki .

translation.en: And I took my staff , even Beauty , and cut it asunder , that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u dieng uba la khot  U Jingsngewbha  bad nga la kdiah ïa u , ban pyndam noh ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: As I live , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts , Surely as Tabor is among the mountains , and as Carmel by the sea , so shall he come .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long u syiem . Nga long U Blei Uba im . Kumba u lum Tabor u ïeng kynjang tam ïa ki lum bad u lum Karmel u ïeng hajrong tam ïa ka duriaw , kumta kan long ka jingkhlaiñ jong uta uba tur ïaleh ïa me .

translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God , and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left .
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba-im . Ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingkrenbeiñ bad pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ïa ki . Kumta to duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew jong ngi kiba lait im .

translation.en: And I saw in a vision  ; and it came to pass , when I saw , that I was at Shushan in the palace , which is in the province of Elam  ; and I saw in a vision , and I was by the river of Ulai .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw nga la shem kynsan ïa lade ha ka nongbah Susa ba la ker kynroh ha ka probins    jong ka Elam . Nga la ïeng harud ka wah Ulai ,

translation.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ , and the love of God , and the communion of the Holy Ghost , be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: Ka jingaiei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , ka jingieit jong U Blei bad ka jingïasyllok jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid kin long lem bad phi baroh .

translation.en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever , if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u ka ban neh junom lada u ïai kohnguh thikna ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh kumba u leh mynta .’

translation.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully , and said , because he had defiled Dinah their sister :
translation.kha: Namar ba u Shekhem u la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka Dinah ka para jong ki , ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la phai ktien ïa u Shekhem bad u Hamor u kpa jong u da ka buit shukor .

translation.en: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
translation.kha: Ngan ïada ïa kane ka nongbah bad ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom jong nga hi bad namar ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid .’

translation.en: And they sat down , and did eat and drink both of them together : for the damsel s father had said unto the man , Be content , I pray thee , and tarry all night , and let thine heart be merry .
translation.kha: Kumta kita baroh ar ngut ki shong bad ki ïabam ïadih lang . Nangta u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha sahmiet noh hangne bad pynsngewbha ïa lade .

translation.en: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the  Lord  our God , to walk in his laws , which he set before us by his servants the prophets .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la shahshkor ïa me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , mynba me la ong ïa ngi ban im kat kum ki aiñ kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong me .

translation.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem , and had taken it , and smitten it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kurup ïa ka . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: Also in the day of the firstfruits , when ye bring a new meat offering unto the  Lord  , after your weeks be out , ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , haba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh da u kew thymmai sha U  Trai  , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei .

translation.en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her ,  O woman , great is thy faith : be it unto thee even as thou wilt .  And her daughter was made whole from that very hour .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jubab ïa ka ,  Pha long ka briew kaba khraw ka jingngeit ! Ïa kaei kaba pha kwah yn leh na ka bynta jong pha .  Bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa ka khun jong ka .

translation.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ki kmie ki kpa jong U Jisu ki leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: For every one shall be salted with fire , and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh yn pynkhuid da ka ding kumba ïa ka jingkñia la pynkhuid da ka mluh .

translation.en: How can it be quiet , seeing the  Lord  hath given it a charge against Ashkelon , and against the sea shore ? there hath he appointed it .
translation.kha: Kumno ka lah ban shongthait , haba nga la ai kam ïa ka ban leh ? Nga la hukum ïa ka ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashkelon bad ïa ki briew kiba sah ha ki rud duriaw .

translation.en: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait , that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Israel kiba kham ha khmat bad ki rangbah kiba don ha ka jakarieh ki la ïapynbeit ïa ka dak .

translation.en: He is not here : for he is risen , as he said . Come , see the place where the Lord lay .
translation.kha: Um don hangne ; la pynmihpat ïa u , kumba u la ong . Ale hangne bad peit ïa ka jaka ha kaba u la thiah .

translation.en: Then they took all the men , and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit nadien jong u ryngkat bad ki briew jong ki bad lap ïa u hajan ka pung kaba heh ha Gibeon .

translation.en: And king Solomon shall be blessed , and the throne of David shall be established before the  Lord  for ever .
translation.kha: Hynrei un kyrkhu ïa nga , bad un pynskhem ïa ka hima u Dabid junom .

translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jotham u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead , now no more to return to corruption , he said on this wise , I will give you the sure mercies of David .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang kaba pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ym ban pyut noh ha ka jingtep :   ‘ Ngan ai ha me ïa kita ki jingkyrkhu bakyntang bad kiba thikna kiba nga la kular ha u Dabid .’

translation.en: Or when saw we thee sick , or in prison , and came unto thee ?
translation.kha: Mynno ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me pang lane ba me don ha ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngi wan jngoh ïa me ?’

translation.en: He sent redemption unto his people : he hath commanded his covenant for ever : holy and reverend is his name .
translation.kha: U pyllaitluid ïa la ki briew , bad u pynlong ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Uba khuid bad uba khrawbor u long ma u !

translation.en: Then Jacob went on his journey , and came into the land of the people of the east .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la bteng ïa ka jingleit jong u bad u la leit sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother , I have not seen him  ; neither did he acknowledge his brethren , nor knew his own children : for they have observed thy word , and kept thy covenant .
translation.kha: Ki kham shaniah ïa me Ban ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki hynmen ki para , ne ki khun ki kti . Ki kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me Bad ki ïaineh ha ka jutang jong me .

translation.en: Then ye shall let your children know , saying , Israel came over this Jordan on dry land .
translation.kha: phin ïathuh ha ki shaphang ka por mynba ki Israel ki la jam ïa ka Jordan halor ka dewryngkhiang .

translation.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth , and they shall no more be remembered by their name .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah shuh ba kan dang kren ïa ka kyrteng u Baal .

translation.en: Now therefore hearken unto me , O ye children : for blessed are they that keep my ways .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko samla , shahshkor ïa nga . Leh kumba nga ong , bad phin long suk .

translation.en: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges ? who planteth a vineyard , and eateth not of the fruit thereof ? or who feedeth a flock , and eateth not of the milk of the flock ?
translation.kha: Uei u shipai uba ju dei ban siew ïa la ki jingpynlut ha ka kam shipai ? Uei u nongrep u bym bam ïa ki soh na la ka bri sohwaiñ ? Uei u nongaplangbrot u bym pyndonkam ïa ka dud na la ki jong ki langbrot ?

translation.en: It came to pass after this also , that the children of Moab , and the children of Ammon , and with them other beside the Ammonites , came against Jehoshaphat to battle .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki kynhun shipai jong ka Moab bad ka Ammon , ryngkat bad kiba ïateh lok bad ki , ki Meun , ki hiarthma ïa ka Judah .

translation.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers : I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her like the top of a rock .
translation.kha: Kin pynjot ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah jong pha bad kin pynpra ïa ki kut jong pha . Nangta ngan sar lut khoit ïa ki pui pui bad ngan ieh sa tang ïa u mawsiang .

translation.en: Every man s work shall be made manifest : for the day shall declare it , because it shall be revealed by fire ; and the fire shall try every man s work of what sort it is .
translation.kha: Bad ïa ka dor ka jingtrei jong uwei pa uwei u briew yn sa ïohi haba ka Sngi U Khrist kan pynpaw ïa ka . Naba ha kata ka Sngi , ka ding kan pynpaw ïa ka jingtrei jong uwei pa uwei ; ka ding kan tynjuh ïa ka bad kan pyn-i ïa ka dor bashisha .

translation.en: For if that which is done away was glorious , much more that which remaineth is glorious .
translation.kha: Naba lada la don ka burom ha kata kaba la neh tang shipor , kaba haduh katno keiñ ka burom ka don ha kata kaba neh junom !

translation.en: I saw the ram pushing westward , and northward , and southward  ; so that no beasts might stand before him , neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand  ; but he did according to his will , and became great .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ïa u langbrot ba u tynrah da ki reng jong u sha sepngi , shatei , bad shathie . Ym don uno uno u mrad uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u lane lait phet na ka bor jong u . U la leh katba u sngewbha bad u la nang sngewmeng .

translation.en: And Ishbi–benob , which was of the sons of the giant , the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight , he being girded with a new sword , thought to have slain David .
translation.kha: U ramhah uba kyrteng u Ishbibenob , uba rah ïa u sum rnong uba khia kumba lai kilo shiteng bad uba kieng ka waitlam bathymmai , u la pyrkhat ba u lah ban pynïap ïa u Dabid .

translation.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee , but thou doest me wrong to war against me : the  Lord  the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Em , ngam shym leh bymdei ei ei ïa me . Ma me uba leh bymdei ïa nga da kaba ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa nga . U  Trai  u long u Nongbishar . Un rai mynta ka sngi hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Ammon .

translation.en: It is as high as heaven  ; what canst thou do ? deeper than hell  ; what canst thou know ?
translation.kha: Ka sahit bneng kam dei kaba kut ïa U Blei , hynrei ka don palat ïa kaba me lah ban kynjoh . U Blei u tip ïa ka pyrthei kiba ïap , hynrei me mem tip ïa ka .

translation.en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead , nor print any marks upon you : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: lane pruid dak ha la ka met lane pynmong ïa la ka doh ban ïambriew ïa kiba ïap . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau  ; Thy servant Jacob saith thus , I have sojourned with Laban , and stayed there until now :
translation.kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong ,  Nga u Jakob , u shakri bakohnguh jong phi , nga pyntip ha u kynrad jong nga u Iso ba nga la shong la sah bad u Laban , bad nga la pynslem ban wan phai haduh mynta .

translation.en: I pray thee , let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga , A Trai , ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad ïohi ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh shatai sha shiliang , ka ri lum kaba itynnat , bad ki lum Lebanon .’

translation.en: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king : let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee  ; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Sngewbha wat phah pat ïa nga sha ka byndi ha ka ïing u Jonathan . Lada phi leh kumta , da shisha ngan sa ïap hangta .

translation.en: And the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , buried they in Shechem , in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver : and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph .
translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u Joseph , kaba ki paid Israel ki la wanrah na Ijipt , la tep ha Shekhem , ha kata ka jaka ba u Jakob u la thied ha ka dor shispah tylli ki sbai rupa na ki khun jong u Hamor , u kpa jong u Shekhem . Ïa kane ka jaka la ïohpateng da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph .

translation.en: Likewise when the  Lord  sent you from Kadesh–barnea , saying , Go up and possess the land which I have given you  ; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God , and ye believed him not , nor hearkened to his voice .
translation.kha: Bad haba u hukum ïa phi na Kadesh Barnea ban leit kam kynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la ai ha phi , phi ïaleh pyrshah pynban ïa u ; phim shym shaniah bad kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man s friend by hearty counsel .
translation.kha: Ki umphniang sleh bad ba-iwbih ki pynlong ïa phi ban sngewkmen , hynrei ka jingjynjar ka pynkulmar ïa ka jingsuk jingmut jong phi .

translation.en: In his days Judah shall be saved , and Israel shall dwell safely : and this is his name whereby he shall be called , THE  Lord  OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS .
translation.kha: Haba u long syiem , ki paid Judah kin shongshngain bad ki paid Israel kin im ha ka jingsuk . Yn khot ïa u , ‘ U  Trai  ka jingpynim jong ngi .’

translation.en: If we believe not , yet he abideth faithful : he cannot deny himself .
translation.kha: Lada ngim long kiba ïaineh , u ïaisah hi uba ïaineh , namar um lah ban shukor ïa lade .

translation.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down , but the remnant of them the fire consumeth .
translation.kha: Ïa kata baroh kaba ki bymman ki don la pynjot , bad ka ding ka thang duh ïa kano kano kaba dang sah .

translation.en: And the young man that told him said , As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa , behold , Saul leaned upon his spear  ; and , lo , the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba nga don ha u Lum Gilboa , bad nga la ïohi ïa u Saul ba u dang shaniah ha la u sum katba ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai jong ki nongshun ki la hajan jong u .

translation.en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head , and he was armed with a coat of mail  ; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass .
translation.kha: bad u phong ka jingkieng atiar da ka rnong kaba khia kumba sanphew hynñiew kilo bad ka jingda khlieh da ka rnong .

translation.en: Then spake Solomon , The  Lord  said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u duwai :  Me , A  Trai  , me la buh ïa ka sngi ha ka sahit bneng , pynban me la jied ban shong ha ki lyoh bad ka jingdum .

translation.en: Now we exhort you , brethren , warn them that are unruly , comfort the feebleminded , support the weak , be patient toward all men .
translation.kha: Ngi kyntu ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban maham ïa kiba jaipdeh , ban pynshlur ïa kiba khawpud , ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , ban ïaishah ïa baroh .

translation.en: Again , thou shalt say to the children of Israel , Whosoever he be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel , that giveth any of his seed unto Molech  ; he shall surely be put to death : the people of the land shall stone him with stones .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel , uno uno na phi lane u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong phi , uba ai ïa uwei na ki khun jong u ha u blei Molekh , u dei ban shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: Beloved , believe not every spirit , but try the spirits whether they are of God : because many false prophets are gone out into the world .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , wat ngeit ïa baroh kiba kam ba ki don U Mynsiem , hynrei , to phin da tynjuh ïa ki ban shem lada u mynsiem ba ki don u wan ne em na U Blei . Naba shibun ki nongïathuhlypa balamler ki la leit kylleng sawdong .

translation.en: And when we had accomplished those days , we departed and went our way  ; and they all brought us on our way , with wives and children , till we were out of the city : and we kneeled down on the shore , and prayed .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka por jong ngi bad ki ka la kut , ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la nang leit ha ka jingleit jong ngi . Ma ki baroh , lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki la ïaleit lem bad ngi na ka nongbah sha ka rud duriaw , ha kaba ngi la ïadem khohsiew bad duwai .

translation.en: Behold , thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not , and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the  Lord  thy God , and for the Holy One of Israel  ; for he hath glorified thee .
translation.kha: Mynta phin phah khot ïa ki hima ri nongwei ; mynshuwa kim shym la tip ïa phi , hynrei mynta kin wan mareh ban ïasoh bad phi ! Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , ngan pynjia ïa kane baroh ; ngan ai ha phi ïa ka burom bad jingpyndonburom .

translation.en: They took their sheep , and their oxen , and their asses , and that which was in the city , and that which was in the field ,
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ki kynhun jingri , ki jingri , ki kada , bad baroh katba don ha shnong bad ha lyngkha .

translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , sa ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,

translation.en: But they know not the thoughts of the  Lord  , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki jaitbynriew kim tip ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u don ha ka jingmut jong u . Kim sngewthuh ba la lumlang ïa ki ban shah pynshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ba wanrah ïa u kew ban shoh .

translation.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft , and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry . Because thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , he hath also rejected thee from being king .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u ka long kaba sniew hi kum ka jingleh byrtong , bad ka jingmeng ka long hi ka pop kum ka jingmane bleithaw . Namar ba me la kyntait ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , u la kyntait ïa me kum u syiem .

translation.en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house . And Jehu followed after him , and said , Smite him also in the chariot . And they did so at the going up to Gur , which is by Ibleam . And he fled to Megiddo , and died there .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Ahasaïah u ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , kumta u phet ïap ha la ka kali ïapom sha ka shnong Beth Haggan , ba la beh kthong da u Jehu .  Pynïap ïa u ruh !  U Jehu u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u katba u dang ñiah ïa ka kali ïapom jong u ha ka lynti kaba kiew sha Gur kaba hajan ka shnong Ibleam . Hynrei u la ïohlad ban nang leit tad haduh ba un da poi ha ka nongbah Megiddo , ha kaba u ïap .

translation.en: Was then that which is good made death unto me ? God forbid . But sin , that it might appear sin , working death in me by that which is good ; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful .
translation.kha: Hynrei hato kane ka mut ba kaei kaba bha ka pynlong ïa ka jingïap ïa nga ? Ym kumta! Ka dei ka pop kaba pynlong ïa kata ; da kaba pyndonkam ïa kaei kaba bha , ka pop ka la wallam ka jingïap ïa nga , khnang ba ïa kata ka jinglong bashisha jong ka pop yn pynpaw . Bad kumta , lyngba ka hukum , ïa ka pop la pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham shyrkhei .

translation.en: Then the spirit entered into me , and set me upon my feet , and spake with me , and said unto me , Go , shut thyself within thine house .
translation.kha: Nga dem khrup da pyllup ha madan , hynrei U Mynsiem jong U Blei u rung hapoh jong nga bad u pynïeng ïa nga . U Trai u la ong ha nga :  Khie leit sha ïing bad set khop ïa lade hapoh ïing .

translation.en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters , but they only shall be delivered themselves .
translation.kha: bad wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Hynrei tang ïa la ka jong ka jingim .

translation.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil : but to the counsellors of peace is joy .
translation.kha: Kito kiba thmu sniew kin don ha ka jingkyndit thret , hynrei kito kiba trei na ka bynta kaba bha kin shem ïa ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Or he that exhorteth , on exhortation : he that giveth , let him do it with simplicity ; he that ruleth , with diligence ; he that sheweth mercy , with cheerfulness .
translation.kha: lada ka long ban pynshlur ïa kiwei , ngi dei ban leh kumta . Uno uno uba ïasam bad kiwei u dei ban leh ïa kata da ka jingkylluid mynsiem ; uno uno uba don ka iktiar u dei ban trei shitom ; uno uno uba pyn-i ka jingsbun ïa kiwei u dei ban leh da kaba kmen .

translation.en: And Manoah said , Now let thy words come to pass . How shall we order the child , and how shall we do unto him ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Manoah u kylli ,  Ynda la wan urlong ki ktien jong phi , uta u khynnah u dei ban leh aïu ? Ka jingim kaba kumno u dei ban im ?

translation.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Paddan–aram  ;
translation.kha: U la shem ba u Jakob u la kohnguh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad u la leit sha Mesopotamia .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they said unto Samson s wife , Entice thy husband , that he may declare unto us the riddle , lest we burn thee and thy father s house with fire : have ye called us to take that we have ? is it not so ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw ki ong ïa ka tnga jong u Samson ,  Khroh ïa u tnga jong pha ban ïathuh ha ngi ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip . Lada pham lah , ngin wiang ding ïa ka ïing u kpa jong pha bad ngin thang lang ïa pha hangta . Pha ruh pha la khot sngewbha ïa ngi khnang ban lute ïa ngi , hato kam long kumta ?

translation.en: His troops come together , and raise up their way against me , and encamp round about my tabernacle .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban tur ïaleh ïa nga ; ki tih ïa ki kharai ban rieh bad ki kerkut ïa ka ïingjaiñ jong nga .

translation.en: Therefore sprang there even of one , and him as good as dead , so many as the stars of the sky in multitude , and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable .
translation.kha: La u Abraham u la ïap shisha , na une uwei u briew , la mih bun kiba hiarpateng kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng , kat u shyiap bymlah ñiew shuh harud duriaw .

translation.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the  Lord  and of the king s house , and sent to Ben–hadad king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Asa u shim rupa bad ksiar na ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem bad phah sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :

translation.en: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast , which was diverse from all the others , exceeding dreadful , whose teeth were of iron , and his nails of brass  ; which devoured , brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with his feet  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kwah ban tip kham bun shaphang jong u mradkhlaw uba saw , u bym long kum kiwei pat — u mradkhlaw bakynsha uba khñiot pynlwet ïa kiba u la ïoh da ki tnaw rnong bad da ki bniat nar bad nangta u kyrdem halor jong ki .

translation.en: How do ye say , We are wise , and the law of the  Lord  is with us ? Lo , certainly in vain made he it  ; the pen of the scribes is in vain .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ba phi long kiba stad , bad ba phi tip ïa ki aiñ jong nga ? Ha khmih , ïa ki aiñ la pynkylla da ki nongthoh bymhok .

translation.en: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved  ; he shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away : the desire of the wicked shall perish .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki bitar ; u peit bitar ha ka jingisih bad ki jah noh ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh junom .

translation.en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear , and the horse that the king rideth upon , and the crown royal which is set upon his head :
translation.kha: Kumta u jubab ïa u syiem ,  Ai hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jaiñphong syiem na ka bynta une u briew — ki jaiñphong kiba ma phi , phi phong . Hukum ïa ki jingdeng syiem ban pyndeng ha u kulai jong phi .

translation.en: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord  God  , the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , baroh ki shynrang ki dei ban wan mane ïa nga U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto Jerusalem  ; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan  ; thy father was an Amorite , and thy mother an Hittite .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha ka :  La kha ïa pha ha ka ri Kanaan . U kpa jong pha u dei u nong Amor bad ka kmie jong pha ka dei ka nong Hit .

translation.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Abijah u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba u la kren ha ki shaphang u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis .

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi , namely , Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
