translation.kha: U Dabid u pynbynta ïa ki Lebi ha ki lai kynhun kat kum ki kur jong ki : Gershon , Kohath , bad Merari .

translation.en: I am hungry
translation.kha: Nga lah thngan

translation.en: And when the people were come into the wood , behold , the honey dropped  ; but no man put his hand to his mouth : for the people feared the oath .
translation.kha: Ki dieng ki la dap da ka ngap , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba la bam ei ei na ka namar baroh ki sheptieng ïa ka jingtim ka jong u Saul .

translation.en: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la hap hapoh u Eglon haduh khatphra snem .

translation.en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night .
translation.kha: Naba phi hi da lade phi tip bha ba ka Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh mynmiet .

translation.en: As for Samaria , her king is cut off as the foam upon the water .
translation.kha: Ïa u syiem jong ka yn kit noh , kum ka thalab dieng halor um .

translation.en: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me , which to you-ward is not weak , but is mighty in you .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingpynshisha baroh kaba phi kwah ba U Khrist u kren ha nga . Haba u pynbeit ïa phi , um long uba tlot , pynban , u pynpaw ïa la ka bor hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: Now therefore come thou , let us make a covenant , I and thou  ; and let it be for a witness between me and thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ngam lah leh ei ei ban bat ïa la ki khun kynthei bad ïa ki khun jong ki , nga kloi ban pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad me . To ngin ïakynton ïa ki maw ki ban pynkynmaw ïa ka jingïateh kular jong ngi .

translation.en: For when they came into the house , he lay on his bed in his bedchamber , and they smote him , and slew him , and beheaded him , and took his head , and gat them away through the plain all night .
translation.kha: Mar ïarung shapoh , ki leit sha ka kamra thiah u Ishbosheth , ha kaba u dang ïohthiah lyngngai , bad ki la pynïap ïa u . Nangta ki la ot ïa ka khlieh jong u , ki rah ïa ka bad ki , bad ki ïaid baroh shi miet lyngba ka Them Jordan .

translation.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .
translation.kha: Kumta to kieng mynta ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei! Nangta haba ka sngi basniew ka wan , phin lah ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki bor ïaleh u nongshun ; bad hadien ba ka jingïaleh ka la kut , phin dang ïeng skhem ha ka nongrim jong phi .

translation.en: But now our soul is dried away : there is nothing at all , beside this manna , before our eyes .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta te ka bor met ruh ngim don shuh . Ym don ei ei ban bam — thylli lait sa tang kane ka manna na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat !

translation.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh , saying , I do remember my faults this day :
translation.kha: Nangta u nongrah khuri u ong ha u syiem ,  Nga dei ban phla mynta ba nga la leh bakla .

translation.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man , saying , We will eat our own bread , and wear our own apparel : only let us be called by thy name , to take away our reproach .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , hynñiew ngut ki kynthei kin bat ïa uwei u briew bad ong ,  Ngi lah ban bsa bad pynkup jaiñ ïa lade , hynrei sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ong ba phi long u tnga jong ngi , ba kumta ngim donkam ban shah ïa ka jinglehrain jong ka jinglong bym pat shongkurim .

translation.en: Who changed the truth of God into a lie , and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator , who is blessed for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki bujli ïa ka jingshisha U Blei da ka jinglamler ; ki mane bad shakri ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la thaw , ha ka jaka ban mane bad shakri ïa U Nongthaw hi , ïa uba dei ban ïaroh junom ! Amen .

translation.en: And he made his son pass through the fire , and observed times , and used enchantments , and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards : he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: U kñia ïa la u khun kum ka jingainguh thang . U khan bad u leh myntor , bad u ïasyllok bad ki nongpeit kti bad ki nongleh byrtong . U la leh pop palat pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynkhih bitar ïa u .

translation.en: So there was gathered much people together , who stopped all the fountains , and the brook that ran through the midst of the land , saying , Why should the kings of Assyria come , and find much water ?
translation.kha: ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki rai ban ot noh ïa ka jingpynpoi um shabar ka nongbah khnang ban khanglad ïa ki nong Assyria ban ïoh um ynda kin poi ha Jerusalem . Ki rangbah synshar ki ïalam ïa u paidbah babun ban ïamih bad ban set noh ïa baroh ki umpohliew , khnang ba yn ym don um ka ban tuid shabar na ki .

translation.en: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters : for the children of Israel have sworn , saying , Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin .
translation.kha: hynrei ngim lah pat ban shah ba kin shongkurim ïa ki khun kynthei jong ngi , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingtim ha uno uno na ngi uba shah ïa u Benjamin ban shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong ngi .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles , and set up my standard to the people : and they shall bring thy sons in their arms , and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha la ki briew :  Ngan pyn-i dak sha ki jaitbynriew , bad kin wallam ïa ki khun jong pha sha ïing .

translation.en: And the sons of Korah  ; Assir , and Elkanah , and Abiasaph : these are the families of the Korhites .
translation.kha: U Korah u la don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Assir , u Elkanah , bad u Abiasaph ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ka jait Korah .

translation.en: Concerning Damascus . Hamath is confounded , and Arpad : for they have heard evil tidings : they are fainthearted  ; there is sorrow on the sea  ; it cannot be quiet .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Damaskos :  Ki briew ha ki nongbah jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ki khuslai bad ki sngew jynjar namar ki la ïohsngew ïa ki khubor basniew . Ka jinglyng-a ka tyllun halor jong ki kum ka duriaw , bad kim ïoh jahthait .

translation.en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel , they spake unto her , saying , David sent us unto thee , to take thee to him to wife .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la leit sha ka ha Karmel bad ki ong ha ka ,  U Dabid u la phah ïa ngi ban shim ïa phi sha u ban long ka tnga jong u .

translation.en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine .
translation.kha: Hynrei naduh ba ngi sangeh ban ai jingkñia ha ka Syiem jong ka Bneng bad ngi sangeh ban theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ngim shym don ei ei shuh , bad ki briew jong ngi ki ïap ha ka thma bad na ka jingïapthngan .

translation.en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country : Is not the  Lord  in Zion ? is not her king in her ? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images , and with strange vanities ?
translation.kha: Shahshkor ! Ha kylleng ka ri nga ïohsngew ba ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam ,  Hato U  Trai  um don shuh ha Seïon ? Hato u syiem ka Seïon um don shuh hangta ?  U  Trai  , u syiem jong ki , u jubab ,  Balei phi la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong phi bad da kaba nguh dem ïa ki blei nongwei bymmyntoi ?

translation.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel , and found Abishag a Shunammite , and brought her to the king .
translation.kha: Kumta la wad ïa ka samla bhabriew ha kylleng ka ri Israel , bad ki lap ha Shunem ïa kaba kum kata ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Abishag , bad ki la wallam ïa ka sha u syiem .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord  : for it is good to sing praises unto our God  ; for it is pleasant  ; and praise is comely .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ka long kaba bha ban rwai ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi ; ka long kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba dei ban ïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , of Ahab the son of Kolaiah , and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah , which prophesy a lie unto you in my name  ; Behold , I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall slay them before your eyes  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la kren shaphang u Ahab u khun jong u Kolaïah bad u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Maaseïah , kiba ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong U . U la ong ba un aiti ïa ki ha ka bor jong u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , u ban pynïap ïa ki ha khmat jong phi .

translation.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning  ; but the end thereof shall not be blessed .
translation.kha: Kaba ïoh ïa ka spah da kaba suk eh , tang khyndiat eh kan pynbha ïa phi .

translation.en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests , and they builded the sheep gate  ; they sanctified it , and set up the doors of it  ; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it , unto the tower of Hananeel .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba la tei pat ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u ki la tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Langbrot , ki pynkyntang ïa ka , bad pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop . Ki la pynkyntang ïa ka kynroh haduh u Mot ki Shispah bad u Mot Hananel .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when we came to the inn , that we opened our sacks , and , behold , every man s money was in the mouth of his sack , our money in full weight : and we have brought it again in our hand .
translation.kha: Haba ngi la poi ha ka jaka ban sahmiet , ngi plied ïa la ki byrni , bad uwei pa uwei na ngi u lap ïa la ki pisa ha la ka jong ka jong ka byrni — ki pisa ki biang thik . Ngi la wanrah biang ïa ki sha phi .

translation.en: Then shall they cry unto the  Lord  , but he will not hear them : he will even hide his face from them at that time , as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings .
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi haba phin kyang sha U  Trai  , hynrei un ym jubab ïa phi . Un ym sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , naba phi la leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the judgments , which the  Lord  your God commanded to teach you , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it :
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .

translation.en: For the day of the  Lord  of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty , and upon every one that is lifted up  ; and he shall be brought low :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pynpoh ïa uwei pa uwei uba khrawbor , ïa uwei pa uwei uba sarong bad uba sngewmeng .

translation.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth  ; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth  ; because the former troubles are forgotten , and because they are hid from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Te uno uno uba ha ka ri uba pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu , un pan ban ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei uba ïaineh . Uno uno uba shim smai un smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei uba ïaineh ; Ki jingjynjar kiba mynshuwa kin leit noh bad yn klet noh .

translation.en: If David then call him Lord , how is he his son ?
translation.kha: Kumta lada u Dabid u khot ïa u ‘ U Trai ,’ kumno ka lah ban long ba U Messaïah un dei uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?

translation.en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city , and his servants did besiege it .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingkerkut u Nebukhadnessar da lade hi u la wan sha Jerusalem ,

translation.en: Thy sons have fainted , they lie at the head of all the streets , as a wild bull in a net : they are full of the fury of the  Lord  , the rebuke of thy God .
translation.kha: Ha ki khongdong ha man ki surok bah ki briew jong pha ki kyllon noh na ka jingtlot ; ki long kum ka skei kaba la ngat ha ka jar jong u nongbeh mrad . Ki la mad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U Blei .

translation.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel , and Eder , and Jagur ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba sha jngai eh shaphang shathie kiba dei ki jong ki , kito kiba hajan u pud jong ka Edom , ki long ka Kabseel , ka Eder , ka Jagur ,

translation.en: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram s cattle and the herdmen of Lot s cattle : and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land .
translation.kha: Kumta la mih ka jingïakajia hapdeng ki nongap jingri jong u Abram bad ki nongap jingri jong u Lot . ( Ha kata ka por ki Kanaan bad ki Peris ki dang shong ha kata ka ri . )

translation.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land , and said , Mark , I pray you , and see how this man seeketh mischief : for he sent unto me for my wives , and for my children , and for my silver , and for my gold  ; and I denied him not .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka ri bad u ong ,  Phi ïohi ba une u briew u kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi . U la phah khubor sha nga da kaba dawa ïa ki tnga bad ki khun jong nga , ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong nga bad nga la mynjur .

translation.en: So that I come again to my father s house in peace  ; then shall the  Lord  be my God :
translation.kha: bad lada ngan wan phai pat da kaba suk sha ïing u kpa jong nga , te men long U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ba wat la ka Israel ka la phai noh na u , ka la lah pynshisha ba ka long kaba kham bha ban ïa ka Judah ka bymïaineh .

translation.en: And they shall spread them before the sun , and the moon , and all the host of heaven , whom they have loved , and whom they have served , and after whom they have walked , and whom they have sought , and whom they have worshipped : they shall not be gathered , nor be buried  ; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ban lumlang bad ban tep , ki shyieng jong ki kin long kum ka sboh kaba don ha madan . Yn pynphriang ïa ki shabar ha khmat ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur , kiba kine ki briew ki ieit bad shakri , bad kiba ki la ïakylli bad mane .

translation.en: I said , Surely thou wilt fear me , thou wilt receive instruction  ; so their dwelling should not be cut off , howsoever I punished them : but they rose early , and corrupted all their doings .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba kumta ki briew jong nga kin da la ñiewkor ïa nga bad pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jong nga , ba kin ym da la klet ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la hikai ïa ki . Hynrei shen shen ki la leh bymman kumba ki ju leh .

translation.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth ? I tell you , Nay  ; but rather division :
translation.kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la wan ban wallam ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ? Em , ym ka jingsuk , hynrei ka jingïapait .

translation.en: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh , Speak , I pray thee , unto thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and speak not to us in the Jews  language , in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
translation.kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la ong ha u rangbah synshar ,  Kren ha ngi da ka ktien Aramaik . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïa-shahskhor .

translation.en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees , saying ,  Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: bad U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa ki Pharisi ,  Hato ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ne em ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?

translation.en: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas : I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday : I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly , and terrors upon the city .
translation.kha: La don kham bun ki riewkynthei ha ka ri jong phi ban ïa ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw . Nga la pynïap ïa ki rangsamla jong phi ha ka rta kaba dang khie bha bad pynlong ïa ki kmie jong ki ban shahshitom . Nga lynshop kynsan ïa ki da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingtriem .

translation.en: But ye say , If a man shall say to his father or mother , It is Corban , that is to say , a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ; he shall be free .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi hikai ba lada u briew u don ei ei , kaba u lah ban pyndonkam ha kaba ïarap ïa u kpa lane ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka Korban’ ( kaba mut , ka long sha U Blei ) ,

translation.en: The heads thereof judge for reward , and the priests thereof teach for hire , and the prophets thereof divine for money : yet will they lean upon the  Lord  , and say , Is not the  Lord  among us ? none evil can come upon us .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongsynshar ka nongbah la tap-lup da ki jingbamsap , ki lyngdoh ki pynbatai ïa ka hukum na ka bynta ka tulop , ki nongïathuhlypa ki ai ïa ki jingpynpaw jong ki na ka bynta ka pisa — bad baroh ki kam ba U  Trai  u don bad ki .  Yn ym don jingma ka ban hap halor jong ngi ,  ki ong .  U  Trai  u long lem bad ngi .

translation.en: And Satan stood up against Israel , and provoked David to number Israel .
translation.kha: U Soitan u la kwah ban wallam jingjynjar ha ki paid Israel , kumta u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban rai ban shim ka jingkheiñbriew .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said ,  Were there not ten cleansed ? but where are the nine ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  La don shiphew ngut ki rangbah ïa kiba la pynkhiah ; shano kiwei pat ki khyndai ngut ?

translation.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; which went out , and fell upon him , that he died . And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la mih shabar bad pynïap ïa u Shimei . U Solomon mynta u la ïoh ka jingsynshar kaba pura .

translation.en: Let us make a little chamber , I pray thee , on the wall  ; and let us set for him there a bed , and a table , and a stool , and a candlestick : and it shall be , when he cometh to us , that he shall turn in thither .
translation.kha: To ngin shna kawei ka kamra halor tnum ïing , ngin buh kawei ka jingthiah , kawei ka miej , kawei ka shuki , bad kawei ka sharak hapoh jong ka , bad u lah ban sah hangta man ba u wan jngoh ïa ngi .

translation.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me .
translation.kha: Nga don ka bor ban mad ïa baroh ki jinglong da ka bor kaba U Khrist u ai ïa nga .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Judas , betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Judas , hato dei da ka jingdoh ba me la shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ?

translation.en: This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk , in the vanity of their mind ,
translation.kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Trai , te , nga maham ïa phi ; wat ïai im kum kiba mane blei thala , kiba ki jingpyrkhat jong ki kim donbor , bad kiba ki jingmut jong ki , ki long ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge : every founder is confounded by the graven image : for his molten image is falsehood , and there is no breath in them .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohi ïa kane , ki rangbah ki sngew mutlop bad kim sngewthuh ei ei ; kito kiba shna bleithaw ki shah pynthame , namar ki blei kiba ki shna ki long kiba bakla bad kim don jingim .

translation.en: And they took every man his censer , and put fire in them , and laid incense thereon , and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding , u buh hangta ïa u rnga ding uba rhem bad ka jingiwbih , bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ lem bad u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: And within were hooks , an hand broad , fastened round about : and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering .
translation.kha: Ïa ki bnoh , kiba jrong hynñiewphew san milimitar la pynskhem na khap ki miej baroh sawdong . Ïa ka doh baroh ba dei ban ai kum ka jingkñia la buh halor ki miej .

translation.en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hairs therein , and if it be not lower than the skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa kata ka dak bad u shem ba u shñiuh uba hangta um pat kylla lieh , bad ba kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek : for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ïa baroh , namar ym don ka jingïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ; U Blei u long ujuh U Trai ïa baroh bad u kyrkhu kyrhai ïa baroh kiba khot kyrpad ïa u .

translation.en: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath ? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created , in the land of thy nativity .
translation.kha: ‘ Buh ïa ka waitlam ! Ngan bishar ïa me ha ka jaka ba la kha ïa me , ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .

translation.en: Which when the apostles , Barnabas and Paul , heard of , they rent their clothes , and ran in among the people , crying out ,
translation.kha: Haba u Barnabas bad u Paul ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba kin sa leh , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñphong bad ki la mareh sha pdeng u paidbah , da kaba pyrta ,

translation.en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him ? I trow not .
translation.kha: U shakri um dei hok ban ïoh ka jingkhublei na ka bynta ka jingkohnguh hukum jong u , hato kam long kumta ?

translation.en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings , to sacrifice before the  Lord   ; and a meat offering mingled with oil : for to day the  Lord  will appear unto you .
translation.kha: bad sa uwei u masi bad uwei u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok . Dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba la khleh bad ka umphniang . Ki dei ban leh ïa kane namar U  Trai  un wanpaw ha ki mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: Then said Samuel , Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites . And Agag came unto him delicately . And Agag said , Surely the bitterness of death is past .
translation.kha: Wallam ïa u syiem Agag hangne ha nga ,  u Samuel u hukum . U Agag u la wan sha u da kaba khynñiuh da ka jingtieng , u da pyrkhat ha lade ,  Katno ka long kaba kthang ban ïap .

translation.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion : as a leopard by the way will I observe them :
translation.kha: Kumta ngan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u sing . Kum u  labasa ngan apthap ha ki lynti ïaid jong phi .

translation.en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David : but David waxed stronger and stronger , and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh hapdeng ki kynhun ïaleh kiba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul bad kito kiba ïashah ïa u Dabid ka la neh slem bha . Katba u Dabid u nang khlaiñ nang khlaiñ , ki nongïaleh pyrshah jong u ki la nang tlot nang tlot .

translation.en: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee ? for thou hast taught them to be captains , and as chief over thee : shall not sorrows take thee , as a woman in travail ?
translation.kha: Aïu phan ong haba ki briew kiba pha pyrkhat ki long ki paralok jong pha , ki jop ïa pha bad ki synshar halor jong pha ? Phan don ha ka jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba kha khun .

translation.en: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations , which they have done unto their gods  ; so should ye sin against the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki , ba kin ym ïoh hikai shuh ïa phi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba isaitmet ba ki ju leh haba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , kumta ba phin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And , behold , one came and said unto him , Good Master , what good thing shall I do , that I may have eternal life ?
translation.kha: Shisien uwei u briew u la wan sha U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la kylli ,  kaei kaba bha kaba nga dei ban leh ba ngan ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?

translation.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel , which came into Egypt  ; every man and his household came with Jacob .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Jakob kiba la leit ryngkat bad u sha Ijipt , lem bad la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , ki long

translation.en: The  Lord  recompense thy work , and a full reward be given thee of the  Lord  God of Israel , under whose wings thou art come to trust .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un ainong ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh . Ai ba phin ïoh ka bainong kaba pura na U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , sha uba phi la wan ban ïoh jingïada .

translation.en: And David said , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , because his father shewed kindness to me . And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father . So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun , to comfort him .
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u ong ,  nga dei ban pyn-i ïa ka jinglong paralok bashisha ïa u Hanun , kumba u kpa jong u , u Nahash u la leh ïa nga .  Kumta u Dabid u phah ki nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . Haba ki la poi ha Ammon bad ïakynduh ïa u syiem Hanun ,

translation.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way , and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred , and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by , and multiplied thy whoredoms .
translation.kha: Pha pynbyrsieh ïa la ka jingbhabriew ha ka ktieh , pha ai ïa lade ha uwei pa uwei uba wan najan , bad pha la kham long kum ka nuti man la ka sngi .

translation.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us , to drink no wine all our days , we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters  ;
translation.kha: Ngi la kohnguh ïa baroh ki jingbthah ba u Jonadab u la ai ha ngi . Ma ngi hi ngim ju dih waiñ , lymne ki tnga jong ngi , ki khun shynrang jong ngi , lane ki khun kynthei jong ngi .

translation.en: Hear now my reasoning , and hearken to the pleadings of my lips .
translation.kha: Shahshkor katba nga dang ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga .

translation.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day , saith the Lord  God  : there shall be many dead bodies in every place  ; they shall cast them forth with silence .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki jingrwai ha ka ïingsyiem kin kylla long ki jinglynñiar ka jingïambriew . Ki metïap kin don kylleng sawdong . Kin sa shah bret noh ha ka jingjar jar .

translation.en: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee , and the spoil of beasts , which made them afraid , because of men s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein .
translation.kha: Phi la pynduh ïa ki khlaw ka Lebanon ; mynta yn pyndkut ïa phi . Phi la pynïap ïa ki mrad ha ka ; mynta ki mrad kin pyntriem ïa phi . Kane kan jia namar ki kam pynïap ba phi la leh bad namar ki kam leh jubor pyrshah ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei bad ki nongbah jong ka .

translation.en: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end  ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , don sa kawei pat kaba phi hap ban ap khmih lynti . Ym don jingkut ïa ka jingthoh kot bad ka jingpule bniah shaba palat kan pynlwait ïa phi .

translation.en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the  Lord  God of Israel with all his heart : for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam , which made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehu um shym la kohnguh da ka dohnud baroh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; pynban u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong u Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: He that rejecteth me , and receiveth not my words , hath one that judgeth him : the word that I have spoken , the same shall judge him in the last day .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga bad u bym pdiang ïa ka khubor jong nga , u don uwei u ban bishar ïa u . Ki ktien kiba nga la kren kin long u nongbishar jong u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh !

translation.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers : for thereby some have entertained angels unawares .
translation.kha: Da kynmaw ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongwei ha ki ïing jong phi . Don kiba la leh kumta bad pdiang sngewbha ïa ki angel khlem da tip ïa kata .

translation.en: But now being made free from sin , and become servants to God , ye have your fruit unto holiness , and the end everlasting life .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pyllaitluid na ka pop bad phi long ki mraw jong U Blei . Ka jingmyntoi ïa phi ka long ka jingim ba la aiti lut sha u , bad ka jingmih ka long ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Say , I am your sign : like as I have done , so shall it be done unto them : they shall remove and go into captivity .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba kaei kaba me la leh ka dei ka dak jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki — kin long ki nongphetwir bad kiba shah ring koidi .

translation.en: Doubtless thou art our father , though Abraham be ignorant of us , and Israel acknowledge us not : thou , O  Lord  , art our father , our redeemer  ; thy name is from everlasting .
translation.kha: Me long u kpa jong ngi . U Abraham bad u Jakob , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , kim pdiang ïa ngi , hynrei ma me , ko  Trai  , me long u kpa jong ngi , uta uba pyllait im ïa ngi borabor .

translation.en: But if the cloud were not taken up , then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up .
translation.kha: Katba u lyoh u dang neh sah hajuh , ki ruh kim kynriah na ka jaka sher dara .

translation.en: And Joseph died , and all his brethren , and all that generation .
translation.kha: Katba ka por ka nang ïaid u Joseph , ki hynmen jong u , bad sa kiwei pat ruh jong kata ka pateng , ki la ïap noh ,

translation.en: And Solomon s builders and Hiram s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers : so they prepared timber and stones to build the house .
translation.kha: Ki nongtrei jong u Solomon bad jong u Hiram lem bad ki rangbah na ka nongbah Biblos ki la pynkhreh ïa ki maw bad ïa ki dieng ban shna ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Go ye up upon her walls , and destroy  ; but make not a full end : take away her battlements  ; for they are not the  Lord s .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki nongshun ban khet ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki briew jong nga , hynrei ym ban pynjot khoit ïa ki . Ngan ong ïa ki ban khet noh ïa ki tnat jong ki , namar kito ki tnat kim dei ki jong nga .

translation.en: They have hands , but they handle not : feet have they , but they walk not : neither speak they through their throat .
translation.kha: Ki don ki kti , hynrei kim lah ban tba , bad ki kjat , hynrei kim lah ban ïaid ; kim lah ban pynmih sur jingsawa .

translation.en: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God , and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God , and shut up the doors of the house of the  Lord  , and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nalor kata u shim ïa baroh ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ , bad u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki ; u khang noh ïa ka Templ , bad u tei ki duwan ha man la ki dong jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And a certain Jew named Apollos , born at Alexandria , an eloquent man , and mighty in the scriptures , came to Ephesus .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por uwei u Jiw uba kyrteng u Apollos ïa uba la kha ha Aleksandria , u la wan poi sha Ephesos . U long u nongkren uba pnah bad uba don ka jingtip babniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .

translation.en: And as he talked with him , he went in , and found many that were come together .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ïai kren ïa u Kornelios katba u dang leit shapoh ïing , ha kaba u la shem bun ki briew kiba la ïalumlang .

translation.en: Then thine heart be lifted up , and thou forget the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage  ;
translation.kha: kynmaw ban ym sngewsarong bad ban ym klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .

translation.en: To the praise of the glory of his grace , wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved .
translation.kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U Blei namar ka jingaiei ba-dap da ka burom jong u , ïa ka jingai ei u la ai ha ngi ha U Khun uba ieit jong u!

translation.en: Do we then make void the law through faith ? God forbid : yea , we establish the law .
translation.kha: Hato kane ka mut ba da kane ka jingngeit ngi kyntait noh ïa ka Hukum ? Em , ym kumta ; pynban , ngi pynskhem ïa ka Hukum .

translation.en: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house , and flourishing in my palace :
translation.kha: Nga la shongsuk ha la ka ïing syiem , da kaba lehkmen ïa ka jingmanbha bakhraw .

translation.en: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem  ; and the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , drank in them .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ïa ki khuri ksiar bad rupa la wallam shapoh , bad ma ki baroh ki la ïadih waiñ na ki

translation.en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee , cut them off , and cast them from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed , rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire .
translation.kha: Lada ka kti lane ka kjat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to ot noh bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kti lane ka kjat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki kti bad ki kjat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka ding bymjukut .

translation.en: We should pray for God’s Kingdom to come . —Matthew 6 :10 .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban duwai na ka bynta ka Hima U Blei ba kan wan .—Mathaios 6 :10 .

translation.en: Now will I rise , saith the  Lord   ; now will I be exalted  ; now will I lift up myself .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki jaitbynriew ,  Mynta ngan leh ïa la ka kam . Ngan pyn-i katno nga long uba donbor .

translation.en: Behold , what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us , that we should be called the sons of God : therefore the world knoweth us not , because it knew him not .
translation.kha: Ha khmih haduh katno U Kpa u la ieit ïa ngi ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba ïa ngi la khot ki khun U Blei — bad kumta , ha ka jingshisha , ngi long . Dei kane ba balei ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa ngi : Kam pat la ithuh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Even the country which the  Lord  smote before the congregation of Israel , is a land for cattle , and thy servants have cattle :
translation.kha: Kane ka thain ba U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki Israel ban ïohkynti — ki shnong Ataroth , Dibon , Jaser , Nimrah , Heshbon , Elealeh , Sibmah , Nebo bad Beon — ka long ka jaka kaba bha na ka bynta ki jingri , bad ngi don shibun bah ki jingri .

translation.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely : but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid hok ki shongshngain bad sngewskhem , hynrei uta u bym lehhok un shah kem .

translation.en: And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse , and laid it in a tomb .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la wan bad shim noh ïa ka met jong u bad tep noh ïa ka .

translation.en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war : and they besieged Ahaz , but could not overcome him .
translation.kha: U Resin u syiem ka Syria bad u Pekah u syiem ka Israel ki tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kerkut ïa ka , hynrei kim shym lah ban jop ïa u Ahas .

translation.en: Remember the word that I said unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord . If they have persecuted me , they will also persecute you  ; if they have kept my saying , they will keep yours also .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ha phi : ‘ U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa la u Kynrad .’ Lada ki pynshitom ïa nga , kin pynshitom ïa phi ruh ; lada ki la kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , kin kohnguh ïa ka jong phi ruh .

translation.en: But if the priest s daughter be a widow , or divorced , and have no child , and is returned unto her father s house , as in her youth , she shall eat of her father s meat : but there shall no stranger eat thereof .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka khun u lyngdoh kaba la long riewkynthei lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga , ka bym don khun , bad kaba la wan phai ban shong ban sah bad la u kpa kumba ka la leh mynba ka dang samla , ka lah ban bam ïa kata ka jingbam ba u kpa jong ka u ïohpdiang kum u lyngdoh . Dei tang uta uba na ka longïing lyngdoh uba lah ban bam ïa ka .

translation.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble , and the wicked cometh in his stead .
translation.kha: Uba hok u lait na ka jingjynjar ; pynban u bymman u hap ha ka .

translation.en: Who are these that fly as a cloud , and as the doves to their windows ?
translation.kha: Kiei kine ki liengbah kiba per kum u lyoh , kum ki paro ki wan phai sha la ki sem ?

translation.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies : for they are ever with me .
translation.kha: Ka hukum jong me ka don bad nga ha ka por baroh bad ka pynlong ïa nga uba kham stad ban ïa ki nongshun jong nga .

translation.en: And he ordained twelve , that they should be with him , and that he might send them forth to preach ,
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha u , bad u la jied khat-ar ngut , ïa kiba u la khot apostol .  Nga la jied ïa phi ban long lem bad nga ,  u la ong ïa ki .

translation.en: And behold another beast , a second , like to a bear , and it raised up itself on one side , and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it : and they said thus unto it , Arise , devour much flesh .
translation.kha: U mradkhlaw uba ar u syriem kum ka dngiem kaba ïeng ha ki kjat-dien jong ka . Ka la bat lai tylli ki shyieng krung hapdeng ki bniat jong ka , bad ka sur ka la ong ha ka ,  Khie leit , bam shibun ka doh katba pha lah !

translation.en: Yea , the  Lord  will answer and say unto his people , Behold , I will send you corn , and wine , and oil , and ye shall be satisfied therewith : and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen :
translation.kha: U la jubab ïa ki :  Mynta ngan ai ïa phi u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , bad phin long kiba la sngewhun . Kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym ñiewbeiñ shuh ïa phi .

translation.en: And David sent to Joab , saying , Send me Uriah the Hittite . And Joab sent Uriah to David .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la phah ktien sha u Joab :  Phah sha nga ïa u Uriah u nong Hit .  Kumta u Joab u phah ïa u sha u Dabid .

translation.en: Our holy and our beautiful house , where our fathers praised thee , is burned up with fire : and all our pleasant things are laid waste .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka Templ jong ngi , ka jaka kyntang bad ba-itynnat ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la ïaroh ïa me , la pynjot noh da ka ding . Baroh ki jaka kiba ngi ieit ki la don ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: My root was spread out by the waters , and the dew lay all night upon my branch .
translation.kha: Nga la long kum u dieng uba ki thied ki ïoh um borabor bad uba ki tnat ki jhieh da ki umjer .

translation.en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us , saying , Take victuals with you for the journey , and go to meet them , and say unto them , We are your servants : therefore now make ye a league with us .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ngi bad ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ka ri jong ngi ki ong ïa ngi ban khreh katto katne ka jingbam na ka bynta ka jingleit bad ban leit ïakynduh ïa phi . La ong ba ngi dei ban buh ïa lade ban shakri ïa phi bad ban kyrpad ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .

translation.en: And they brought the young man alive , and were not a little comforted .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalam sha ïing ïa uta u samla uba dang im , bad la pyntngen ïa ki shikatdei eh .

translation.en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones , and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale , for abundance .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ka rupa ka don kynrei ha Jerusalem kumba don u maw , bad ïa u dieng Kedar kumba pahuh u dieng Dumbur ha ki kjat lum ka Judah .

translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given to it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas :
translation.kha: Katno kiba sniew bad bym don blei ki long ki briew jong kane ka por !  U Jisu u la pynbna .  Phi pan na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tang ka kambah jong u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: A husband should love his wife just as he loves himself .
translation.kha: U tnga u dei ban ieit ïa la ka tnga kumba u ieit ïalade .

translation.en: And he brought him forth abroad , and said , Look now toward heaven , and tell the stars , if thou be able to number them : and he said unto him , So shall thy seed be .
translation.kha: U Trai u ïalam ïa u shabar bad u ong ,  Khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , bad pyrshang ñiew ïa ki khlur ; men ïoh bun ki khun ki ksiew kat kita .

translation.en: For the king will hear , to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba phin shahshkor bad pyllait im ïa nga na uta uba pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga bad ïa u khun jong nga , bad kumta ban weng noh ïa ngi na ka ri kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki briew jong u .

translation.en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first  ; and Ben–hadad sent out , and they told him , saying , There are men come out of Samaria .
translation.kha: Ki shipai samla ki la tur nyngkong . Ki nongsyntiat ba la phah da u Benhadad , ki leit ïathuh ha u ba shi kynhun ki shipai ki la wan mih na Samaria .

translation.en: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known .
translation.kha: U Jisu , da ka ktien kaba eh u la hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid ban ym ïathuh ïano ïano ba u long uei .

translation.en: And Simeon blessed them , and said unto Mary his mother , Behold , this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel  ; and for a sign which shall be spoken against  ;
translation.kha: U Simeon u la kyrkhu ïa ki bad u la ong ha ka Mari , ka kmie jong u ,  Ïa une u khunlung la jied da U Blei na ka bynta ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynim ïa kiba bun ha Israel . Un long ka dak na U Blei ïa kaba kiba bun ki briew kin kren pyrshah bad kumta un pynpaw ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong ki .

translation.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us , because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world , that we might live through him .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei u la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi da kaba phah ïa la U Khun ba marwei sha ka pyrthei , khnang ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingim da u .

translation.en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el : and the horns of the altar shall be cut off , and fall to the ground .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta ki pop jong ki , ngan pynjot ïa ki duwan ka Bethel . Ïa ki dong jong kawei pa kawei ka duwan yn pom noh bad kin hap ha madan .

translation.en: And God heard the voice of the lad  ; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven , and said unto her , What aileth thee , Hagar ? fear not  ; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung , bad na bneng u angel jong U Blei u kren ha ka Hagar ,  Ko Hagar , pha khuslai ïa-ei ? Wat sheptieng . U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung .

translation.en: Moreover , my father , see , yea , see the skirt of thy robe in my hand : for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe , and killed thee not , know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand , and I have not sinned against thee  ; yet thou huntest my soul to take it .
translation.kha: Ha khmih , ko pa jong nga , khmih ïa ka lyngkhot ka jaiñkup jong phi kaba nga bat ! Ngan jin da la pynïap ïa phi , hynrei pynban nga shu ot noh tang ïa kane . Kane ka dei ban pynthikna ïa phi ba ngam don jingmut ei ei ban ïaleh pyrshah ne pynmynsaw ïa phi . Phi la beh mrad ïa nga ban pynïap ïa nga , wat la ngam shym leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa phi .

translation.en: I am my beloved s , and his desire is toward me .
translation.kha: Kaei kane kaba ka jingkhmih jong ka , ka long kum ka step ? Ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba phyrnai , ka jingphyrnai kum ka sngi ne u bnai .

translation.en: A fool uttereth all his mind : but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bieit ki pynpaw ïa la ka jingbitar ha kaba paw , hynrei ki briew kiba shemphang ki ïaishah bad ki set khop ïa ka .

translation.en: And he said , My son shall not go down with you  ; for his brother is dead , and he is left alone : if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go , then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jakob u ong ,  U khun jong nga um lah ban leit ryngkat bad phi ; u hynmen jong u , u la ïap , bad u sah sa tang marwei . Kaei kaei ka lah ban ngat ha u ha lynti . Nga dei u briew uba la tymmen , bad ka jingsngewsih kaba phin pynjia ha nga kan sa pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?
translation.kha: Te ïathuh ïa ngi me dei uei ,  ki la ong .  Ngi hap ban rah ïa ka jubab sha kito kiba la phah ïa ngi . Kumno me ong shaphang ïa lade ?

translation.en: A portion of the reading could be assigned to each family member , and then all can discuss what was learned from the Scriptures .
translation.kha: Baroh ki dkhot jong ka ïing ki lah ban pule lang mar khyndiat , nangta baroh ki lah ban ïasam ïa kaei kaba ki sngewthuh .

translation.en: Behold , ye are all children of Israel  ; give here your advice and counsel .
translation.kha: Phi baroh kiba don hangne phi dei ki Israel . Kaei ngin leh ha kaba ïadei bad kane ?

translation.en: I say the truth in Christ , I lie not , my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost ,
translation.kha: Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha , nga long u jong U Khrist bad ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha . Ka jingïatiplem , ba la synshar da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ruh ka kren skhem ba ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha

translation.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering , so shall he do with this : and the priest shall make an atonement for them , and it shall be forgiven them .
translation.kha: Un leh kumjuh ïa une u masi lyngraw kumba u ju leh ïa u masi lyngraw jong ka jingkñia ainguh namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u paidlang , bad yn map ïa ki .

translation.en: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh , and on all his servants , and on all the people of his land : for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them . So didst thou get thee a name , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Me pynjia ki kambah baphylla pyrshah ïa u Pharoah , pyrshah ïa ki rangbah synshar ki briew jong ka ri jong u , namar me tip kumno ki la banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong me . Me la jop ha kata ka por , ka nam kaba me dang don ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: In the third year of his reign , he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants  ; the power of Persia and Media , the nobles and princes of the provinces , being before him :
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongpynïaidkam . Ki kynhun shipai ka Persia bad ka Media ki la ïadon lang , kumjuh ruh ki lat bad ki riewpawkhmat jong ki jylla .

translation.en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath , which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad : and he also delivered Israel .
translation.kha: U nongïalam uba bud u dei u Shamgar , u khun jong u Anath . Une ruh u la pyllait ïa ki Israel , bad u la leh kumta da kaba pynïap hynriewspah ngut ki Philistia da u dieng ñiah masi .

translation.en: Shimei the son of Elah , in Benjamin :
translation.kha: U Shimei , u khun jong u Ela : ka ri Benjamin

translation.en: So Abram departed , as the  Lord  had spoken unto him  ; and Lot went with him : and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran .
translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la dap hynñiewphew san snem ka rta , u la mihnoh na Haran , kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa u ban leh ; bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .

translation.en: But Peter stood at the door without . Then went out that other disciple , which was known unto the high priest , and spake unto her that kept the door , and brought in Peter .
translation.kha: Nangta uta uwei pat u synran u la mih biang shabar , u la ïakren bad ka khynnah ha ka khyrdop , bad u la ïalam ïa u Petros shapoh .

translation.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening , even the time that women go out to draw water .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi , u pyndem khohsiew ïa kita ki ut harud ka pukri kaba don shabar jong ka nongbah . Ka dei haba la janmiet bha , ka por ha kaba ki kynthei ki ju wan tong um .

translation.en: Render therefore to all their dues : tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom ; fear to whom fear ; honour to whom honour .
translation.kha: To siew te , kaei kaba phi dei ban siew ïa ki ; to siew sha ki ïa ki khajna shimet bad kiba dei ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi , bad to pyn-i ka jingburom bad to ai ka burom ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now .
translation.kha: Naba ngi tip ba haduh ka por ba mynta , ki jingthaw baroh ki ud da ka jingpang , kum ka jingpang jong ka jingsuh kha .

translation.en: And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain .
translation.kha: Bad wat la kim shym la shem kano kano ka daw ban rai pynïap ïa u , ki la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban phah pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom , and the  Lord  his God was with him , and magnified him exceedingly .
translation.kha: U Solomon u khun jong u syiem Dabid u la pynskhem ïa ka jingsynshar ïa ka hima Israel , bad U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa u bad pynlong ïa u uba khlaiñbor shikatdei eh .

translation.en: In that day shall the  Lord  of hosts be for a crown of glory , and for a diadem of beauty , unto the residue of his people ,
translation.kha: Ka sngi kan wan haba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un long kum ka pansngiat badonburom jong ki syntiew na ka bynta ki briew jong u kiba dang sah .

translation.en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might , and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .
translation.kha: katba u Dabid bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïashad da ka bor baroh ban ainguh ïa U Blei . Ki rwai bad ki tem ïa ki jingtem — ki duitara , ki ksing , ki shakuriaw , bad ki turoi .

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Lada me kwah ban long uba janai , to khie leit bad die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta to wan bad bud ïa nga .

translation.en: As the valleys are they spread forth , as gardens by the river s side , as the trees of lign aloes which the  Lord  hath planted , and as cedar trees beside the waters .
translation.kha: Lane kum ki kper harud ka wah , Kum ki Alos ba U  Trai  u la thung , Lane kum ki dieng Kedar harud ki um .

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian .
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul ,  Ha kane ka por balyngkot , hato me pyrkhat ba men pynlong Khristan ïa nga ?

translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise from the end of the earth , ye that go down to the sea , and all that is therein  ; the isles , and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai ïa U  Trai  ; rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! ïaroh ïa u , phi kiba ïaid lynti ha duriaw ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jingthaw baroh ka duriaw ! Rwai , phi ki ri bajngai bad baroh kiba shong hangta .

translation.en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the  Lord  : and because of these abominations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh ïa kine ki kam kiba isaitmet , bad dei namar kata ba u la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na kata ka ri katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

translation.en: And I will make your cities waste , and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation , and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingijli bakhraw , ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki shnong jong phi , ngan pynpra ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi , bad ngan kyntait ïa ki jingkñia ainguh jong phi .

translation.en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .
translation.kha: bad ki la thang lut ïa ki blei jong ki — ki bym long satia ki blei , tang ki dur jong u dieng bad u maw ba la shna da ki kti briew .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha , and what he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Baasha u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha ka  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea ? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth ?
translation.kha: Hato me la ju poi sha ki umpohliew ha ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ? Hato me la ju ïaid ha ki madan jong ka duriaw-bah ?

translation.en: They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .
translation.kha: ki tare ha ka jingdum bad ïaid sheng sheng kum ki nongbuaid .

translation.en: So the people sent to Shiloh , that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  of hosts , which dwelleth between the cherubims : and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were there with the ark of the covenant of God .
translation.kha: Kumta ki phah nonglamktien sha Shiloh bad ki wanrah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , uba shongkhet halor ki Kherub . Bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Eli , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki wan ryngkat hangta bad ka Synduk ka Jutang .

translation.en: And they took him , and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa uta u khun bad ki la pynïap ïa u bad bret ïa ka met jong u shabar ka bri sohwaiñ .

translation.en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee , and awake that shall vex thee , and thou shalt be for booties unto them ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ba phin tip ïa ka , phi kiba la jop ïa kiwei phin don ha ka ram ïa lade bad shah pynbor ban siew ïa ka sut . Ki nongshun kin wan bad pynkyiuh ïa phi . Kin thombor ïa phi !

translation.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men , which they had given him , and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him , and which stood before him :
translation.kha: Hynrei u kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki riewrangbah bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba la ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height , and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs , and his heart is lifted up in his height  ;
translation.kha: Mynta te , ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar ngan ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa uta u dieng uba la san haduh ba u la kot ïa ki lyoh . Katba u nang san kham jrong u la nang sngewsarong ,

translation.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka la ïohi ba la lap ïa ka , kumta ka la wan da kaba khynñiuh bad ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu . Hangta ha khmat jong uwei pa uwei baroh , ka la ïathuh ïa u balei ba ka la ktah ïa u bad kumno ba la pynkhiah ïa ka shisyndon .

translation.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard , that I have not done in it ? wherefore , when I looked that it should bring forth grapes , brought it forth wild grapes ?
translation.kha: Don kano kano kaba ngam shym la leh ïa ka ? Te balei ka pynmih ki sohwaiñ kiba jew bad ym kiba bha kumba nga la khmih lynti ?

translation.en: I called my servant , and he gave me no answer  ; I entreated him with my mouth .
translation.kha: Haba nga khot ïa u shakri , um jubab — wat la nga kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap ïa nga .

translation.en: Then ye shall come up after him , that he may come and sit upon my throne  ; for he shall be king in my stead : and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah .
translation.kha: Bud biang ïa u shane haba u wan ban shong ha ka khet jong nga . Un long syiem hadien jong nga , namar u dei ma u , uta uba nga la jied ban long u nongsynshar jong ka Israel bad ka Judah .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; An evil , an only evil , behold , is come .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kawei ka jingjynjar hadien kawei pat kan wan ha pha .

translation.en: And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki , u la leit noh , bad u la duwai ha ka sien kaba lai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki kyntien .

translation.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin sngewkhuslai wat hapdeng ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki baroh . Ha ka jinglyngngoh kin set ïa la ki shyntur bad tap ïa la ki shkor .

translation.en: For he hath made him to be sin for us , who knew no sin ; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him .
translation.kha: U Khrist u la long uba khlem pop , hynrei na ka bynta jong ngi U Blei u la pynlong ïa u ban don bynta ha ka pop jong ngi khnang ba haba ngi don ha u ngin lah ban ïoh bynta na ka hok U Blei .

translation.en: But ask now the beasts , and they shall teach thee  ; and the fowls of the air , and they shall tell thee :
translation.kha: Wat ki sim bad ki mrad ki don shibun ban hikai ïa me ;

translation.en: Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na phi un ong ha nga ,  Lada kane ka long kumta , kumno U Blei un shem jingbakla badno badno ? Uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka mon U Blei ?

translation.en: That at that time ye were without Christ , being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel , and strangers from the covenants of promise , having no hope , and without God in the world :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por phi la long khlem U Khrist . Phi la long ki nongwei bad phim shym la dei ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei . Phim shym la don bynta ha ki jutang , kiba la pynshong nongrim ha ki jingkular jong U Blei sha ki briew jong u , bad phi la im ha kane ka pyrthei khlem jingkyrmen bad khlem U Blei .

translation.en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord , who hath enabled me , for that he counted me faithful , putting me into the ministry ;
translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ka jingnguh sha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba la ai ha nga ïa ka jingkhlaiñ na ka bynta ka kam jong nga . Nga ainguh ïa u ba la ñiew ïa nga uba bit bad la thung ïa nga ban shakri ïa u , wat la ha ka por ba la leit noh nga la kren sniew ïa u bad pynshitom beiñ bad krenbeiñ ïa u .

translation.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning , it was told Samuel , saying , Saul came to Carmel , and , behold , he set him up a place , and is gone about , and passed on , and gone down to Gilgal .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud u leit wad ïa u Saul . U ïohsngew ba u Saul u la leit sha ka nongrit Karmel , ha kaba u la tei mot ïa lade , bad nangta u la leit sha Gilgal .

translation.en: In the twilight , in the evening , in the black and dark night :
translation.kha: ha ka por janmiet ynda ka la dum .

translation.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction : and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki briew ka Kushan ba ki sheptieng bad ki briew ka Midian ki khynñiuh .

translation.en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ki sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka sngi kaba phra jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: Now as he was speaking with me , I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground : but he touched me , and set me upright .
translation.kha: Mynba u dang kren , nga la kyllon ha madan khlem tipbriew . Hynrei u la bat ïa nga , u la khyllie pynïeng ïa nga ,

translation.en: And in the mountains , Shamir , and Jattir , and Socoh ,
translation.kha: Ha ka ri lum don ka Shamir , ka Jattir , ka Sokoh ,

translation.en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow , making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly  ;
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynrem ïa ki nongbah ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , da kaba pynjot ïa ki da ka ding , bad u la pynlong ïa ki ka nongmuna jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki bymtip Blei .

translation.en: And they were coupled beneath , and coupled together at the head thereof , to one ring : thus he did to both of them in both the corners .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong la pynïasoh lang naduh trai baroh shi lynter haduh khlieh . La shna ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate : and the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died , as the man of God had said , who spake when the king came down to him .
translation.kha: Ka leit jingjia ryngkhat ba u syiem ka Israel u la buh ha ka khyrdop nongbah hapoh ka jingpeit jong u rangbah pynïaidkam uba dei u nongïarap ba-hajan jong u . U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shah ïuh hangta ha ki paidbah bad u la ïap kumba u Elisha u la ïathuh lypa mynba u syiem u la leit ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: And he , casting away his garment , rose , and came to Jesus .
translation.kha: U la bret noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , u la rynsied , bad u la wan sha U Jisu .

translation.en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned twelve years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat , u syiem Judah , u Joram u khun jong u Ahab u la long u syiem ka Israel ; bad u la synshar khat-ar snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingïapait biang hapdeng ki briew namar kine ki ktien .

translation.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision , but a new creature .
translation.kha: Kam pher ei ei satia la otsher ne ym shym la otsher , kaei kaba donkam ka long ban long u jingthaw uba thymmai .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment : and whosoever shall say to his brother , Raca , shall be in danger of the council : but whosoever shall say , Thou fool , shall be in danger of hell fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : ïa uno uno uba bitar ïa la u para yn wallam sha ka jingbishar , ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ Me u bymlarkam ei ei !’ yn wallam ha khmat ka Dorbar Bah , bad ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ u bieit bymmyntoi’ un don ha ka jingma ka jingleit sha ka dujok ding .

translation.en: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth , which thou shalt bring of thy land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt put it in a basket , and shalt go unto the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name there .
translation.kha: iwei pa iwei na phi phin buh ha ka shang ïa u soh nyngkong hadien ba phi la lum na uwei pa uwei u jait jingthung , bad leit rah ïa ka sha ka jaka mane Blei .

translation.en: And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah  ; nine cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Keilah , ka Akhsib , bad ka Mareshah : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Alas , who shall live when God doeth this !
translation.kha: U Balaam u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Kiei kine ki briew kiba ïalumlang shaphang shatei ?

translation.en: And Absalom rose up early , and stood beside the way of the gate : and it was so , that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment , then Absalom called unto him , and said , Of what city art thou ? And he said , Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U ju khie dang step phyrngab bad u ju leit ïeng harud lynti ha ka khyrdop shnong . Haba uno uno u briew u wan hangta bad ka jingïakajia kaba u kwah ïa u syiem ban pynbeit , u Absalom u ju khot ïa u , bad kylli ïa u , u dei uba nangno . Bad hadien ba u briew u la ïathuh ïa u na kano ka jait u dei ,

translation.en: And this is the writing that was written , MENE , MENE , TEKEL , UPHARSIN .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la thoh : ‘ Ka dak jingkheiñ , ka dak jingkheiñ , ka jingthew , ki jingbynta .’

translation.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Hammoth–dor with her suburbs , and Kartan with her suburbs  ; three cities .
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang lai tylli ki nongbah : ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Hammoth Dor , bad ka Kartan , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: Withhold not correction from the child : for if thou beatest him with the rod , he shall not die .
translation.kha: Wat pyntud ban sneng pynbeit ïa u khynnah . Ka jingsympat kaba dei kan ym pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Observe the month of Abib , and keep the passover unto the  Lord  thy God : for in the month of Abib the  Lord  thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night .
translation.kha: Burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da kaba phi rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha u bnai Abib , naba dei ha kawei ka miet jong uta u bnai ba u la pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt .

translation.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man , by what means he is made whole  ;
translation.kha: Lada yn kylli ïa ngi mynta shaphang ka kam babha ïa kaba la leh ha u briew uba dkoh bad kumno la pynkhiah ïa u ,

translation.en: Also I said , It is not good that ye do : ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ,  Kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba bakla ! Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei bad leh ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ba phin ym pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , ki Jentil , ïa kano kano ka daw ba kin krenbeiñ ïa ngi .

translation.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter . Eubulus greeteth thee , and Pudens , and Linus , and Claudia , and all the brethren .
translation.kha: To pynkloi ban wan shuwa ka tlang . U Ïubulos bad u Pudens bad u Linos bad ka Klaudia bad kumjuh ruh kiwei pat ki parabangeit baroh ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong ki .

translation.en: John answered , saying unto them all , I indeed baptize you with water  ; but one mightier than I cometh , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire :
translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei don uwei pat uba wan uba kham khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bit wat ban loit ïa ki juti jong u . Un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding .

translation.en: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .

translation.en: And I will camp against thee round about , and will lay siege against thee with a mount , and I will raise forts against thee .
translation.kha: U Blei un tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , un don sawdong jong ka bad un kerkut ïa ka .

translation.en: Oh that my words were now written ! oh that they were printed in a book !
translation.kha: Katno nga da kwah ban don ki ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien jong nga bad ban buh jingthoh ïa ki ha ka kitab !

translation.en: And in the morning , then ye shall see the glory of the  Lord   ; for that he heareth your murmurings against the  Lord  : and what are we , that ye murmur against us ?
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynstep phin ïohi ïa ka jingshai baphyrnai jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai . U la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong phi pyrshah ïa u — ho-oid , pyrshah ïa u , namar ngi te ngi shu kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u .

translation.en: Even so the tongue is a little member , and boasteth great things . Behold , how great a matter a little fire kindleth !
translation.kha: Kumta ka long bad u thylliej : La u long uba rit , u lah ban sngewsarong shaphang kiei kiei kiba khraw . Shu pyrkhat kat ka  lawbah lah ban pynpluh ïa ka da i thylliej ding iba rit !

translation.en: And Joshua called for all Israel , and for their elders , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers , and said unto them , I am old and stricken in age :
translation.kha: kumta u khot ïa ki Israel baroh , ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u paidbah , bad u ong ,  Nga la tymmen bha mynta .

translation.en: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness : but the expectation of the wicked shall perish .
translation.kha: Ki jingkyrmen jong ki briew kiba bha ki lam sha ka jingkmen , hynrei ka jingkhmih lynti ki riewbymman kam lam shano shano .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , the place of my throne , and the place of the soles of my feet , where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever , and my holy name , shall the house of Israel no more defile , neither they , nor their kings , by their whoredom , nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , hangne ka dei ka khet jong nga . Ngan shong hangne hapdeng ki paid Israel bad synshar halor jong ki junom . Ki paid Israel lymne ki syiem jong ki , kin ym pynjahburom shuh ïa kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da kaba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei lane da kaba tep ïa ki metïap jong ki syiem jong ki ha kane ka jaka .

translation.en: For we can do nothing against the truth , but for the truth .
translation.kha: Naba ngim lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei tang na ka bynta ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And his feet like unto fine brass , as if they burned in a furnace  ; and his voice as the sound of many waters .
translation.kha: ki kjat jong u ki phyrnai kum ka rnong ba la phrang bad ba la pynphyrnai , bad ka sur jong u ka sawa kum ka kshaid bakyrhuh .

translation.en: Yea , before the day was I am he  ; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand : I will work , and who shall let it ?
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei bad ngan ïailong . Ym don u ban lait im na ka bor jong nga ; ym don uba lah ban pynkylla ïa kaei ba nga leh .

translation.en: The sons of Laadan  ; the chief was Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three .
translation.kha: U Ladan u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jehiel , u Setham , bad u Joel ,

translation.en: And when they came to Marah , they could not drink of the waters of Marah , for they were bitter : therefore the name of it was called Marah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la wan poi ha ka jaka ïa kaba la khot ka Marah , hynrei ka um hangta ka long kaba kthang haduh katta katta ba kim lah ban dih ïa ka . Dei na kata ka daw ba la khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Marah .

translation.en: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire , and the house of Joseph a flame , and the house of Esau for stubble , and they shall kindle in them , and devour them  ; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau  ; for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong u Jakob bad jong u Joseph kin long kum ka ding ; kin pynjot ïa ki briew u Iso kumba ka ding ka thang ïa u phlangïap . Yn ym don uba hiarpateng na u Iso u ban lait im . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Even as Abraham believed God , and it was accounted to him for righteousness .
translation.kha: To pyrkhat ïa ka jingïashem u Abraham , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .

translation.en: But I have all , and abound : I am full , having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you , an odour of a sweet smell , a sacrifice acceptable , wellpleasing to God .
translation.kha: Hangne , te , ka long ka jingïohpdiang jong nga ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi la ai ha nga — bad ka la long palat ban ïa kaba nga donkam! Nga don ïa baroh kaba nga donkam mynta ha kaba u Epaphroditos u la wanrah sha nga ïa ki jingai sngewbha baroh jong phi . Ki long kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih sha U Blei , ka jingkñia kaba pdiang hun bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .

translation.en: And if ye will receive it , this is Elias , which was for to come .
translation.kha: bad lada phi mon ban ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ki , u Ïoannis u long u Elijah , uba ïa ka jingwan jong u la ïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .
translation.kha: Ynda la kyntiew ïa nga na ka pyrthei , ngan khring ïa ki briew baroh sha nga .

translation.en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places , yet unto the  Lord  their God only .
translation.kha: Wat la ki paidbah ki ïai bteng ban ai jingainguh thang ha kiwei ki jaka mane , ki ainguh ïa ki tang sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Like these good figs , so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah , whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga pyrkhat ba ki briew kiba la ringmraw sha Babilonia ki long kum kine ki soh Dumbur kiba bha , ngan lehbha ïa ki da ka jingsbun .

translation.en: Saying , This man began to build , and was not able to finish .
translation.kha: ‘ Une u briew u la sdang ban tei hynrei um lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam !’ kin ong .

translation.en: Hell and destruction are never full  ; so the eyes of man are never satisfied .
translation.kha: Ki jingkwah u briew ki long kum ka pyrthei kiba ïap — Ka don borabor ka jingkwah shuh shuh .

translation.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And Joseph said , Give your cattle  ; and I will give you for your cattle , if money fail .
translation.kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Lada phim don pisa shuh , wallam ïa ki jingri jong phi ; te ngan ïapli ïa ka jingbam bad kita ki jingri .

translation.en: And they buried him in his own sepulchres , which he had made for himself in the city of David , and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries  art : and they made a very great burning for him .
translation.kha: bad la tep ha ka jingtep mawsiang ïa kaba u la shna na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka nongbah u Dabid . Ki la pyndonkam ki musla bad ki umphniang iwbih ban pynkhreh ïa ka met jong u na ka bynta ka jingontep , bad ki la tei ïa ka ding kaba khraw ban leh sngewsih ïa ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together , that it might be one .
translation.kha: Ki thaw sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka rnong ban pyndait lang ïa kita ki ar tylli ki sut ba kin long kawei ka jingtap .

translation.en: Whose soever sins ye remit , they are remitted unto them  ; and whose soever sins ye retain , they are retained .
translation.kha: Lada phi map ïa ki pop jong ki briew , la map ïa ki ; lada phim map ïa ki , ïa ki ym shym la map .

translation.en: They bow themselves , they bring forth their young ones , they cast out their sorrows .
translation.kha: Hato me tip lano kin dem ban wallam ïa ki khun rit sha ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: For , lo , I will make thee small among the heathen , and despised among men .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa pha ban nang tlot , bad yn ym don baburom ïa pha .

translation.en: And the king turned his face about , and blessed all the congregation of Israel : ( and all the congregation of Israel stood  ; )
translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïeng hangta , u Syiem Solomon u phai khmat sha ki bad pan ka jingkyrkhu U Blei halor jong ki .

translation.en: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast  ; and his kingdom was full of darkness  ; and they gnawed their tongues for pain ,
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba san u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka khet jong u mradkhlaw . Ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka hima jong u mradkhlaw , bad ki briew ki la dait ïa la ki thylliej namar ka jingpang jong ki ,

translation.en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas , and took Titus with me also .
translation.kha: nangta khatsaw snemhadien  nga la leit pat sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u Barnabas , nga da ïalam lang ruh ïa u Titos .

translation.en: And they found Adoni–bezek in Bezek : and they fought against him , and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites .
translation.kha: Ki la lap ïa u Adonibesek hangta bad ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
