translation.en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree , and the increase of the field , that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen .
translation.kha: Ngan pynroi kyrhai ïa ka jingmih na ki diengsoh bad na ki lyngkha jong phi , ba kan ym don shuh ka  nemsniew ka ban pynjahburom ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: Unto thee it was shewed , that thou mightest know that the  Lord  he is God  ; there is none else beside him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha phi ïa kane , ban pynshisha ha phi ba tang ma u hi u long U Blei , bad ba ym don uwei pat lait na u .

translation.en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection : on such the second death hath no power , but they shall be priests of God and of Christ , and shall reign with him a thousand years .
translation.kha: Katno kiba suk bad kiba la ïoh jingkyrkhu shikatdei eh ki long kito kiba la kynthup ha kane ka jingpynmihpat banyngkong ïa kiba ïap . Ka jingïap kaba ar kam donbor halor jong ki ; kin long ki lyngdoh jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist , bad kin synshar bad u shihajar snem .

translation.en: Have I conceived all this people ? have I begotten them , that thou shouldest say unto me , Carry them in thy bosom , as a nursing father beareth the sucking child , unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers ?
translation.kha: Ngam shym thaw ïa ki lymne pynkha ïa ki ! Balei ba me ong ïa nga ba ngan long nongri khun bad rah ïa ki kum ïa ki khunlung shi lynter lynti shaduh ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ?

translation.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall : but the  Lord  helped me .
translation.kha: La tur ïaleh jur ïa nga bad nga la shahjop , hynrei U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa nga ,

translation.en: For I bear him record , that he hath a great zeal for you , and them that are in Laodicea , and them in Hierapolis .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban sakhi da lade hi ïa ka jingtrei shitom jong u na ka bynta jong phi bad na ka bynta ki briew kiba ha Laodikaïa bad ha Hierapolis .

translation.en: To whom will ye liken me , and make me equal , and compare me , that we may be like ?
translation.kha: Badno phin nujor ïa nga ?  ong U  Trai .  Hato don uno uno uba kum ma nga ?

translation.en: And Jeroboam s wife did so , and arose , and went to Shiloh , and came to the house of Ahijah . But Ahijah could not see  ; for his eyes were set by reason of his age .
translation.kha: Kumta ka leit sha ka ïing jong u Ahijah ha Shiloh . Ka jinglong tymmen ka la pynlong ïa u Ahijah ban matlah .

translation.en: For the  Lord  is great , and greatly to be praised : he is to be feared above all gods .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba dei eh ban ïaroh ; u long uba dei ban shah pyndonburom kham palat ïa ki blei baroh .

translation.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel : nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days .
translation.kha: Wat la u Asa um shym pynjot ïa baroh ki jaka mane blei thala ha ka ri , u ïailong uba ïaineh ha U  Trai  shi lynter ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: When thou art in tribulation , and all these things are come upon thee , even in the latter days , if thou turn to the  Lord  thy God , and shalt be obedient unto his voice  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi don ha ka jynjar , bad kita kiei kiei baroh ki wan jia ha phi , te ha kaba khatduh phin phai sha U  Trai  bad kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: Then Jerubbaal , who is Gideon , and all the people that were with him , rose up early , and pitched beside the well of Harod : so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them , by the hill of Moreh , in the valley .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Gideon bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki la sher dara harud ka Umpohliew Harod . Ki Midian pat ki sher dara shaphang shatei na ki , ha ka them kaba harud u Lum Moreh .

translation.en: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war , by casting up mounts , and building forts , to cut off many persons :
translation.kha: Wat ka kynhun shipai kaba khlaiñ tam jong u syiem ka Ijipt kam lah ban ïarap ïa u ban ïaleh haba ki nong Ijipt ki tei ki jingtei khyndew bad tih ki kharai khnang ban pynïap bun ngut ki briew .

translation.en: For I am full of matter , the spirit within me constraineth me .
translation.kha: Ngam lah ap shuh , nga kwah ban kren . Ngam lah shuh ban kun ïa ki ktien .

translation.en: And one told David , saying , Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . And David said , O  Lord  , I pray thee , turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness .
translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Dabid ba u Ahithophel u la ïasoh lang bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong u Absalom , u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , sngewbha pynpulom ïa ka jingaibuit u Ahithophel .

translation.en: All these things did Araunah , as a king , give unto the king . And Araunah said unto the king , The  Lord  thy God accept thee .
translation.kha: U Araunah u la ai lut ha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  To U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong phi .

translation.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jehoram u la long syiem haba u don laiphew ar snem ka rta , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face , and bowed himself , and thanked the king : and Joab said , To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight , my lord , O king , in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant .
translation.kha: U Joab u dem khrup haduh khyndew ha khmat u Dabid da ka jingburom bad u ong  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ! Mynta nga tip ba phi sngewbha ïa nga , namar phi la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga .

translation.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , He is come forth to make war with thee . And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba la poi ktien ha ki Assyria ba ki shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u syiem Tirhakah jong ka Sudan , u dang wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first month , in the seventh day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew jong u bnai uba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: God is jealous , and the  Lord  revengeth  ; the  Lord  revengeth , and is furious  ; the  Lord  will take vengeance on his adversaries , and he reserveth wrath for his enemies .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei um lah shah ïa kino kino ki nongïaleh pyrshah ; u pynshitom ïa kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u . Ha ka jingbitar jong u , u siew kylliang ïa ki .

translation.en: In time , you may qualify to begin preaching with the local congregation of Jehovah’s Witnesses .
translation.kha: Shen phin sa lah ban leit ïalap ryngkat bad kiwei pat ki para bangeit jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka shnong jong phi .

translation.en: Whom the  Lord  of hosts shall bless , saying , Blessed be Egypt my people , and Assyria the work of my hands , and Israel mine inheritance .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un kyrkhu ïa ki bad un ong ,  Ngan kyrkhu ïa pha , ko Ijipt , ki briew jong nga ; ïa pha , ko Assyria , kaba nga la thaw ; bad ïa pha , ko Israel , ki briew kiba la jied jong nga .

translation.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you , to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year . And he did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban rakhe pateng la pateng . Ïa kane ka rukom lehniam dei ban leh shisien shisnem ban pynkhuid ïa ki Israel na ki pop jong ki . Kumta u Moses u leh , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is to hate evil : pride , and arrogancy , and the evil way , and the froward mouth , do I hate .
translation.kha: Ban pyndonburom ïa U Blei ka long ban isih ïa kaba sniew ; nga isih ïa ka jingsarong bad ka jingsngewmeng , ïa ki lynti bymman bad ki ktien lamler .

translation.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled  ; he is unclean : he shall dwell alone  ; without the camp shall his habitation be .
translation.kha: Un ïaisah u bymkhuid katba kata ka jingpang ka dang don , bad u dei ban sah kyrpang shabar ka jaka shong dara , jngai na kiwei pat .

translation.en: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance , and deliver them into the hand of their enemies  ; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies  ;
translation.kha: Ngan iehnoh ïa ki briew kiba lait im bad aiti ïa ki ha ki nongshun jong ki , ki ban jop ïa ki bad lute ïa ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not : for a fire is kindled in mine anger , which shall burn upon you .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban shakri ïa ki nongshun jong ki ha ka ri kaba kim don jingtip ei ei , namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka long kum ka ding , ban kan pluh junom .

translation.en: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten : for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites , because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah .
translation.kha: te ki Benjamin ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop . Ki Israel kiba ha khmat eh ki la kynran dien na ki Benjamin namar ba ki shaniah ha kita ki rangbah ba la buh ban apthap baroh sawdong ïa ka Gibeah .

translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  When it is evening , ye say , It will be fair weather : for the sky is red .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Haba ka sngi ka sep , phi ong , ‘ Ngin sa ïoh ïa ka suiñbneng kaba bha , namar ka sahit bneng ka saw .’

translation.en: Then went up Moses , and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel :
translation.kha: U Moses , u Aaron , u Nadab , u Abihu , bad hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , ki ïaleit kiew ïa uta u lum ,

translation.en: Then all the children of Israel , and all the people , went up , and came unto the house of God , and wept , and sat there before the  Lord  , and fasted that day until even , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew ka Israel ki leit kiew sha Bethel bad ki ïamkthang . Ki shong hangta ha khmat U  Trai  bad kim shym bam ei ei haduh janmiet . Ki kñia ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk — baroh ha jingdon ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing  ; for the wind was contrary unto them : and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them , walking upon the sea , and would have passed by them .
translation.kha: U la ïohi ba ki synran jong u ki dang ïaleh shitom ha ki boitha , namar ki dang king pyrshah ïa ka lyer , kumta katto katne por hapdeng lai bad hynriew baje mynstep u la wan sha ki , da kaba ïaid halor ka um . U la don jingmut ban ïaid najan jong ki ,

translation.en: For such are false apostles , deceitful workers , transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ .
translation.kha: Kito ki briew kim long ki apostol kiba shisha — ki long ki apostol lamler , kiba shukor shaphang ka jingtrei jong ki bad thawdur ïa lade ban i kum ki apostol bashisha jong U Khrist .

translation.en: Thou shalt fan them , and the wind shall carry them away , and the whirlwind shall scatter them : and thou shalt rejoice in the  Lord  , and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Men kynting ïa ki ha ka lyer ; ka lyer kaba jur kan kit lut ïa ki , bad yn pynsaphriang ïa ki da ka  erïong . Te men sa kmen namar nga long U Blei jong me ; men ïaroh ïa nga , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel .

translation.en: And they said , Go to , let us build us a city and a tower , whose top may reach unto heaven  ; and let us make us a name , lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth .
translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong ,  Mynta to ngin ïatei kawei ka nongbah kaba don u mot uba kot haduh sahit bneng , ba kumta , ngin lah ban thaw nam ïa lade bad ym ban ïasakma ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And sitting down they watched him there  ;
translation.kha: Hadien kata ki la ïashong hangta , bad ki la ïa-ap ïa u .

translation.en: And Saul said to David , Behold my elder daughter Merab , her will I give thee to wife : only be thou valiant for me , and fight the  Lord s  battles . For Saul said , Let not mine hand be upon him , but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha u Dabid ,  Kane ka dei ka Merab ka khun jong nga kaba kham shuwa . Ngan ai ïa ka ha me kum ka tnga jong me halor ka kyndon ba me dei ban shakri ïa nga kum u shipai bashlur bad baïaineh , bad ïaleh ïa ki thma U  Trai .  ( U Saul u nang pyrkhat ba ha kane ka rukom ki Philistia kin ïoh pynïap ïa u Dabid bad um da donkam ban leh da lade . )

translation.en: To devise cunning works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,
translation.kha: ban pruid dur ba-itynnat bad ban saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ha ka rupa , bad ha ka rnong ;

translation.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it  ; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim un ïoh ïa ka .

translation.en: And I will set my throne in Elam , and will destroy from thence the king and the princes , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , bad ngan buh ïa ka khet jong nga hangta .

translation.en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , neither did he hearken unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongleh myntor jong u Pharaoh ki la leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki ; bad u Pharaoh u dang mutlop hi kumba u long . Kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , u Pharaoh u la kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest , as he said , As I have sworn in my wrath , if they shall enter into my rest : although the works were finished from the foundation of the world .
translation.kha: Ngi kiba ngeit , te , ngi ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular . Ka la long kumba u la ong ,  Nga la bitar bad pynlong ka jingkular kyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ka jingjahthait !’   U la kren ïa kane wat haba la pyndep ïa ka kam jong u naduh ka por ba u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Saying , Give me also this power , that on whomsoever I lay hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  To ai ïa kane ka bor ha nga ruh , khnang ba uno uno ha uba nga buh ïa la ki kti un ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: Fear them not therefore : for there is nothing covered , that shall not be revealed  ; and hid , that shall not be known .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa ki briew . Ïa kaei kaba la kah mynta yn weng noh , bad ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh yn pynpaw .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word  ; Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Every bottle shall be filled with wine : and they shall say unto thee , Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ . Kin jubab ba ki tip ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ .

translation.en: Even when we were dead in sins , hath quickened us together with Christ , ( by grace ye are saved ; )
translation.kha: ba haba ngi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong ba kynja mynsiem ha ka jingbymkohnguh jong ngi u la wallam ïa ngi sha ka jingim lem bad U Khrist . Ka dei da ka jingaiei U Blei ba la pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken , nor Judah of his God , of the  Lord  of hosts  ; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , ngam pat shym la iehnoh ïa ka Israel bad ka Judah , wat la ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And when they had ordained them elders in every church , and had prayed with fasting , they commended them to the Lord , on whom they believed .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka balang ki la thung ïa ki nongsharai balang , bad da ki jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit ki la aiti ïa ki sha U Trai , ha uba ki la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah .

translation.en: And the scribe said unto him , Well , Master , thou hast said the truth : for there is one God  ; and there is none other but he :
translation.kha: Uta u nonghikai ka Hukum u la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Kaba dei , ko Nonghikai ! Ka long kaba shisha , kumba me la ong , ba tang U Trai u long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat u blei hynrei tang ma u .

translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  commandeth , and he will smite the great house with breaches , and the little house with clefts .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ai ïa ka hukum , ki ïing kiba rit bad kiba heh kin shah pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai .

translation.en: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah . And Saul said , God hath delivered him into mine hand  ; for he is shut in , by entering into a town that hath gates and bars .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la leit sha Keilah , bad u ong ,  U Blei u la buh ïa u ha ka bor jong nga . U Dabid u la pynngat ïa lade da kaba leit sha ka nongrit ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba skhem .

translation.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon : it hath consumed Ar of Moab , and the lords of the high places of Arnon .
translation.kha: Shisien na kane ka nongbah Heshbon Ka kynhun ïapom jong u Sihon ka mih kum ka ding ; Ka da pynjot ïa ka nongbah Ar ha Moab Bad ka bam duh ïa ki lum ka Arnon bashaneng .

translation.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour , and he was the son of an harlot : and Gilead begat Jephthah .
translation.kha: U Jephthah , u shipai bashlur na Gilead u dei u khun jong ka nuti . U kpa jong u , u Gilead

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Foxes have holes , and birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ki myrsiang ki don ki thliew , bad ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don hangno hangno ban thiah bad pynjahthait .

translation.en: And a certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , which worshipped God , heard us : whose heart the Lord opened , that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul .
translation.kha: Kawei na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa ngi ka dei ka Lydia kaba na Thiatira , ka dei ka nongdie ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh . Ka long ka briew kaba mane ïa U Blei , bad U Trai u la plie ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ka ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u Paul u ong .

translation.en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer , and said unto him , Draw thy sword , and slay me , that men say not of me , A woman slew him . And his young man thrust him through , and he died .
translation.kha: Mar kumta , u khot kyrkieh ïa u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong u , bad u hukum ïa u ,  Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad pynïap ïa nga . Ngam kwah ba yn ong ba ka kynthei ka la pynïap ïa nga .  Kumta u samla u dung lyngba ïa u , bad u la ïap .

translation.en: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity  ; and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them  ; but they hearkened not .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa me , ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me , bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong me namar ki pop kiba ma phi baroh phi la leh . Ma me lymne ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki la sngap ïa ki jingmaham jong nga , bad kumta ngan wallam halor baroh ïa ka jingpynjot ïa kaba nga la dep kren pyrshah .

translation.en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , The Chaldeans made out three bands , and fell upon the camels , and have carried them away , yea , and slain the servants with the edge of the sword  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  Lai kynhun ki nonglute Khaldi ki wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi , ki shim noh ïa ki ut , bad ki pynïap ïa baroh ki shakri jong phi lait sa tang ïa nga . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: But the God of all grace , who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus , after that ye have suffered a while , make you perfect , stablish , strengthen , settle you .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba phi la shahshitom tang khyndiat por , U Blei jong ka jingaiei baroh , uba la khot ïa phi ban ïoh bynta na ka burom bymjukut jong u ha U Khrist , ma u hi keiñ un pynjanai ïa phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingsngewskhem , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka nongrim kaba skhem shisha .

translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki proberb u Solomon : U khun uba stad u pynsngew sarong ïa la u jong u kpa ; uba bieit u wallam ka jingsngewsih ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ , which God gave unto him , to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass  ; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John :
translation.kha: Kane ka kitab ka long ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa ki jingjia kiba U Jisu Khrist u la pynpaw . U Blei u la ai ha u ïa kane ka jingpynpaw khnang ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen . U Khrist u la pynlong ïa kine kiei kiei ban tip da u shakri jong u , u Ïoannis da kaba phah ïa la u angel sha u ,

translation.en: Which remain among the graves , and lodge in the monuments , which eat swine s flesh , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki leit sha ki krem bad sha ki jaka tep ban ïasyllok bad ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap . Ki bam doh sniang bad ki dih ïa ka syrwa ba la shet da ka doh ba la ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala .

translation.en: And Absalom met the servants of David . And Absalom rode upon a mule , and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak , and his head caught hold of the oak , and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth  ; and the mule that was under him went away .
translation.kha: Kynsan u Absalom u ïakynduh katto katne ki rangbah jong u Dabid . U Absalom u dang shong ha u khashor , bad katba u khashor u dang ïaid napoh u dieng Sning uba heh , ka khlieh u Absalom ka sahkut ha ki tnat dieng . U khashor u la mareh bad u Absalom u la shah iehnoh da kaba sdien ha shiteng suiñ .

translation.en: And set up false witnesses , which said , This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place , and the law :
translation.kha: Nangta ki la wallam katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban ïathuh lamler shaphang jong u .  Une u briew ,  ki la ong ,  u ïai kren borabor pyrshah ïa ka templ bakyntang bad ïa ka hukum u Moses .

translation.en: Then he turned his face to the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phai ïa la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :

translation.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue ? cannot my taste discern perverse things ?
translation.kha: Hynrei phi tharai ba nga shukor — bad phi tharai ba ngam lah ban ïathuh ïa ka badei na ka bymdei .

translation.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time , and the children of Judah prevailed , because they relied upon the  Lord  God of their fathers .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki paid Judah ki la long nongjop halor ki Israel , namar ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: And Hannah answered and said , No , my lord , I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit : I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink , but have poured out my soul before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Em kynrad , ngam shym buaid  ka la jubab .  Ngam shym dih ! Nga jynjar sat bad nga dang duwai bad khlei lut ïa ki jingjynjar baroh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering , behold , Samuel came  ; and Saul went out to meet him , that he might salute him .
translation.kha: U la ainguh ïa ka jingainguh thang , bad hamar ba u dep , u Samuel u la wan poi . U Saul u mih ban ïakynduh ïa u bad pdiang sngewbha ïa u ,

translation.en: And the Levites shall compass the king round about , every man with his weapons in his hand  ; and whosoever else cometh into the house , he shall be put to death : but be ye with the king when he cometh in , and when he goeth out .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki dei ban ïeng ïada sawdong ïa u syiem , lem bad ki waitlam jong ki , kiba ki la sei , bad ki dei ban don ryngkat bad u syiem kat shaba u leit . Uno uno uba pyrshang ban rung shapoh ka Templ u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed , and was delivered of a child when she was past age , because she judged him faithful who had promised .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ïoh long u kpa , wat haba u la tymmen bha bad ka Sarah hi kam lah ban ïoh khun . U la shaniah ba U Blei un bat ïa la ka kular .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when I heard these words , that I sat down and wept , and mourned certain days , and fasted , and prayed before the God of heaven ,
translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , nga shong bad nga ïam . Bun sngi nga la sngewsih bad ngam shym bam .

translation.en: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face :
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u ïohsngew ïa kane , u la dem khrup ha khyndew bad u duwai .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thomas , because thou hast seen me , thou hast believed : blessed are they that have not seen , and yet have believed .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Hato me ngeit namar ba me ïohi ïa nga ? Katno ki kmen kito kiba ngeit khlem da ïohi ïa nga !

translation.en: The eternal God is thy refuge , and underneath are the everlasting arms : and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee  ; and shall say , Destroy them .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïailong ka jingïada jong phi ; Ki ksang ti uba na bymjukut ki kyrshan ïa phi . U beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , Bad u ong ïa phi ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: That every man should let his manservant , and every man his maidservant , being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess , go free  ; that none should serve himself of them , to wit , of a Jew his brother .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki la pynlong ka jingïakut ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ki mraw Hebru , ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , khnang ba uno uno ruh un ym don u para jait Israel kum u mraw .

translation.en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon , as thou comest to Gerar , unto Gaza  ; as thou goest , unto Sodom , and Gomorrah , and Admah , and Zeboiim , even unto Lasha .
translation.kha: haduh ba ki pud ka Kanaan ki la ïar naduh Sidon , beit beit shathie shaphang Gerar hajan Gasa , bad shaphang mihngi shaduh Sodom , Gomorrah , Admah , bad Seboiim hajan Lasha .

translation.en: What were the questions ?
translation.kha: Kiei Kiei Ki Jingkylli ?

translation.en: And when he went out the second day , behold , two men of the Hebrews strove together : and he said to him that did the wrong , Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow ?
translation.kha: Haba u leit sa ha kawei pat ka sngi , u ïohi ar ngut ki Hebru kiba ïashoh . U ong ha uta uba leh bymdei ,  Balei me da shoh ïa la u para Hebru ?

translation.en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered , saying , Master , we would see a sign from thee .
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katto katne ki Pharisi ki la kren .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa me ba me leh kambah .

translation.en: The watchman said , The morning cometh , and also the night : if ye will enquire , enquire ye : return , come .
translation.kha: Nga jubab ,  Ka step ka wan , hynrei ka miet kan wan biang . Lada phi kwah ban kylli biang , sa wan pat bad kylli .

translation.en: ( For those priests were made without an oath  ; but this with an oath by him that said unto him , The Lord sware and will not repent , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec : )
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la long u lyngdoh da ka jingsmai haba U Blei u la ong ha u ,  U Trai u la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang bad un ym kylla shuh : ‘ Me , me long u lyngdoh junom .’

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Go , call thy husband , and come hither .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad khot ïa u tnga jong pha ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ka ,  bad sa wan biang .

translation.en: Then beware lest thou forget the  Lord  , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
translation.kha: kynmaw ba phin ym klet ïa U  Trai  uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .

translation.en: And when he rose up from prayer , and was come to his disciples , he found them sleeping for sorrow ,
translation.kha: Haba u la ïeng joit na ka jingduwai jong u , u la leit pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ïa ki ba ki ïohthiah , kiba la shoh lwait da ka jingsngewsih jong ki .

translation.en: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters  ; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more , nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïap ïa ki jingri jong me ha man la ki jaka dih um . Yn ym don shuh ki briew ne jingri ban pynjngut pat ïa ka um .

translation.en: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind , and the ointment of his right hand , which bewrayeth itself .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban pynsngap jar ïa ka ? Hato phi la ju pyrshang ban khang ïa ka lyer lane phi la ju pyrshang ban kham ha ka kti ïa ka umphniang ?

translation.en: And say , Thus saith the king , Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I return in peace .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki ban thep ïa u ha ka byndi bad ban ai ha u ïa u kpu bad ka um haduh ba ngan da wan phai khlem shah pynïap .

translation.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money , then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , lada shah ïa uta u trai ban siew da ka kuna , ban pyllait im ïa u , u dei ban siew dep ïa ka dor kaba dei ban siew .

translation.en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth–maachah , and they cast up a bank against the city , and it stood in the trench : and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall , to throw it down .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Joab ki la ïohsngew ba u Sheba u don hangta , bad kumta ki la leit ban kerkut ïa ka nongbah . Ki tei ka kynton stong marpyrshah ïa ka kynroh kaba phai shabar bad ki la sdang ruh ban tih sha trai ka kynroh ban pynkhyllem ïa ka .

translation.en: And the  Lord  have removed men far away , and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land .
translation.kha: Ngan phah sha jngai bah ïa ki briew bad ngan pynlong kynjah ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Thy riches , and thy fairs , thy merchandise , thy mariners , and thy pilots , thy calkers , and the occupiers of thy merchandise , and all thy men of war , that are in thee , and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee , shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin .
translation.kha: Ka spah jong ki mar khaïi jong pha baroh , ki maji jong pha baroh , ki misteri liengbah bad ki nongkhaïi jong pha baroh , uwei pa uwei u shipai halor ka liengbah — baroh , baroh ki la ngam jyllop ha ka duriaw mynba ka liengbah jong pha ka la shah pynjot .

translation.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka jingstad jong U Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da baroh kiba pdiang ïa ka .

translation.en: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering , of a cubit and an half long , and a cubit and an half broad , and one cubit high : whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice .
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki miej ha ka kamra ba la pynïasoh ba la pynkhreh ban ai kum ki jingkñia batylli , ki la long da u maw ba shu phiah . Ki jrong sanphew sentimitar bad ha ki khlieh jong ki ka long hynñiewphew san sentimitar sawdong . Ïa ki tiar baroh ba pyndonkam ban pynïap ïa ki mrad ban kñia la buh halor kine ki miej .

translation.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over  ; that they turn not again to cover the earth .
translation.kha: Me buh ïa u pud ba kim lah ban jam palat , ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym tap biang ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves , covetous , boasters , proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,
translation.kha: Naba U briew u long u ba khwan myntoi , kiba lalot , kiba leh sarong , bad kiba kyr-eit ; kin krenbeiñ , kin ym kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki bymsngewnguh , bad ki bymriewblei ;

translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Destroy him not : for who can stretch forth his hand against the  Lord s  anointed , and be guiltless ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u ong ,  Phim dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u . U  Trai  un pynshitom shisha ïa uta uba pynmynsaw ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u .

translation.en: But he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait im .

translation.en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim , and went over Jordan with the king , to conduct him over Jordan .
translation.kha: U Barsillai , uba na Gilead , u la wan hiar ruh na Rogelim ban synran ïa u syiem sha shiliang ka Jordan .

translation.en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger , and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst , and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them .
translation.kha: Haba ki thngan , me ai kpu ïa ki na bneng , bad ka um na u mawsiang haba ki sliang . Me ong ïa ki ban shimti bad pynïaid ïa ka ri kaba me la kular ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature , and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree : how much more shall these , which be the natural branches , be grafted into their own olive tree ?
translation.kha: Namar phi long kum ka tnat jong u dieng Olib khlaw ïa uba la pynkheiñ bad nangta , pyrshah ïa ka jinglong tynrai , la pynïasoh bad u dieng Olib ba la thung . Ki Jiw ki long kum une u dieng uba la thung ; bad kan long kaba kham suk ïa U Blei ban pynïasoh biang ïa kine ki tnat ba la pynkheiñ sha ki dieng jong ki hi .

translation.en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house , and shut up the house seven days :
translation.kha: un mihnoh na kata ka ïing bad un khang ïa ka hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: Then thou shalt see , and flow together , and thine heart shall fear , and be enlarged  ; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee , the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee .
translation.kha: Phin sa ïohi ïa kane bad yn pyndap da ka jingkmen . Phin khynñiuh da ka jingsngewkmen . Ki spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn wallam sha pha ; na shiliang ka duriaw ki spah jong ki kin wan .

translation.en: And Noah began to be an husbandman , and he planted a vineyard :
translation.kha: U Noah , uba long u nongrep , u long u briew uba nyngkong eh ban thung ka bri sohwaiñ .

translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka por Ka Jingkhawai Niam ,  ki la ong ,  lymda kumta ki paidbah ki lah ban khih kulmar .

translation.en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood : the length of it was a cubit , and the breadth of it a cubit  ; it was foursquare  ; and two cubits was the height of it  ; the horns thereof were of the same .
translation.kha: U shna ïa ka duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih . Ka long kaba sawdong , ka don sawphew san sentimitar ka lynter bad sawphew san sentimitar ka jingïar bad khyndaiphew sentimitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng jong ka ha ki saw tylli ki dong ki ïadait lang kawei bad ka .

translation.en: I tell you , this man went down to his house justified rather than the other : for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased  ; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  u nonglum khajna , bad ym u Pharisi , uba don ha ka liang kaba dei bad U Blei haba u leit noh sha ïing . Naba ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit yn pynkhraw .

translation.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him , and a taunting proverb against him , and say , Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his ! how long ? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay !
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la shahjop ki beiñ pyrshah ïa kiba jop ïa ki bad ki pyn-i jingisih ïa ki . Kin ong ,  Phi shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong phi , hynrei phi long ba la tim ! Katno slem phin ïailong kiba riewspah da kaba pynbor ïa ki nongshim ram jong phi ban siew noh ?

translation.en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines , and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines . And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha baroh ki Israel ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia bad ba ki Philistia ki la isih ïa ki . Kumta ki paidbah ki jubab ïa ka jingkhot ban ïasoh bad u Saul ha Gilgal .

translation.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight , and a good blessing shall come upon them .
translation.kha: Ki nongbishar kiba pynshitom ïa uba shah pynrem , kin manbha bad kin ïoh ka nam babha .

translation.en: O my mountain in the field , I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil , and thy high places for sin , throughout all thy borders .
translation.kha: bad halor ki lumbah ha ka rudnong bym don jingkah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban shim noh ïa ka spah bad ïa ki jingkynshew jong phi namar ki pop baroh kiba phi la leh ha kylleng ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles , which is a witness against me : and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face .
translation.kha: Me la kem ïa nga ; me dei u nongshun jong nga . Nga la sah sa tang ka snep bad ki shyieng , bad ki briew ki shim ïa kata kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingkitpop jong nga .

translation.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .
translation.kha: To ai hukum , te , ba yn da ap phira biang biang ïa ka jingtep jong u tad haduh ka sngi kaba lai , khnang ba ki synran jong u kin ym lah ban leit ban tuh ïa ka met , bad nangta ban ïathuh ha ki briew ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap . Kane ka jinglamler kaba khatduh kan long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not  ; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself , and that wicked one toucheth him not .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ym don uno uno napdeng ki khun U Blei uba ïai leh pop , naba U Khun U Blei u sumar ïa u , bad u Basniew um lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child : then she shall be unclean seven days  ; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun shynrang , kan long ka bymkhuid , kumba ka long ha ka por ba ka poi bnai .

translation.en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the  Lord  : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki , bad u la ai ha kawei pa kawei na ki jait kiba sah jong ki Israel shi bynta jong ka ri .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , when the priests blew with the trumpets , Joshua said unto the people , Shout  ; for the  Lord  hath given you the city .
translation.kha: Ha ka sien ïaid tawiar kaba hynñiew , hamar ba ki lyngdoh kin put ïa ki turoi , u Joshua u hukum ïa u paidbah ban risa , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ïa ka nongbah !

translation.en: And as soon as the lad was gone , David arose out of a place toward the south , and fell on his face to the ground , and bowed himself three times : and they kissed one another , and wept one with another , until David exceeded .
translation.kha: Hadien ba uta u khynnah u la leit , u Dabid u ïeng nadien kata ka kynton maw , bad u dem khohsiew bad u nguh lai sien . Baroh ar ngut , ma u bad u Jonathan ki ïa-ïam katba ki dang ïadoh markylliang ; ka jingsngewsih u Dabid ka kham jur ban ïa ka jong u Jonathan .

translation.en: This was the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba la leh da U Trai ; A haduh katno ka long kaei kaei kaba iphylla !’

translation.en: And he turned unto her by the way , and said , Go to , I pray thee , let me come in unto thee  ; ( for he knew not that she was his daughter in law . ) And she said , What wilt thou give me , that thou mayest come in unto me ?
translation.kha: U leit sha ka harud jong ka lynti bad u ong ,  To ong , katno phi buh dor ?  ( Um shym tip ba ka dei ka pyrsa kurim jong u . ) Ka ong  Phin ai aïu ïa nga ?

translation.en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a damsel came to hearken , named Rhoda .
translation.kha: U Petros u la tied ïa ka jingkhang kaba shabar , bad ka shakri kaba kyrteng ka Rhoda ka la wan ban peit uei uba tied .

translation.en: According to the custom of the priest s office , his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord .
translation.kha: Kat kum ka rukom ba la bud da ki lyngdoh , la jied ïa u da kaba kynting sbai ban thang jingiwbih halor ka duwan . Kumta u la leit shapoh ka Templ jong U Trai ,

translation.en: Because they said , He hath an unclean spirit .
translation.kha: ( U Jisu u la ong ïa kane namar katto katne ki briew ki ïa-ong ,  U don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u .  )

translation.en: God brought them out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ; U ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki la kum u masi prut .

translation.en: Because ye were glad , because ye rejoiced , O ye destroyers of mine heritage , because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass , and bellow as bulls  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki paid ka Babilonia , phi la lute ïa ka jaitbynriew jong nga . Phi kmen bad phi sngewbha , phi da leh kum ka masi ba ïaid haba shoh kba ne kum u kulai uba pah ,

translation.en: For I have sworn by myself , saith the  Lord  , that Bozrah shall become a desolation , a reproach , a waste , and a curse  ; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes .
translation.kha: Nga da lade hi nga la smai ba kane ka nongbah Bosrah kan long ka jingïohi ba-itriem bad ka ri shyiap ; ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ka bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingtim . Baroh ki nongrit ba-marjan kin don ha ka jingjot junom . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: When I shall send Artemas unto thee , or Tychicus , be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis : for I have determined there to winter .
translation.kha: Ynda nga phah ïa u Artemas lane ïa u Tukhikos sha me , ïaleh shitom ban wan sha nga ha Nikopolis , namar nga la rai ban pynlut ïa ka tlang hangta .

translation.en: And Jotham ran away , and fled , and went to Beer , and dwelt there , for fear of Abimelech his brother .
translation.kha: Te namar ba u sheptieng ïa u Abimelekh , u hynmen jong u , u Jotham u la phet ïap bad u leit shong ha Beer .

translation.en: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael , Slay us not : for we have treasures in the field , of wheat , and of barley , and of oil , and of honey . So he forbare , and slew them not among their brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei la don shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha ka kynhun kiba la ong ha u Ishmael ,  Sngewbha wat pynïap ïa ngi ! Ngi don u kew , u barli , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap ba la buhrieh ha ki lyngkha .  Kumta u la pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: And say to Archippus , Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord , that thou fulfil it .
translation.kha: Bad ong ïa u Arkhippos ,  Pynthikna ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba la ai ha me ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai .

translation.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ , in them that are saved , and in them that perish :
translation.kha: Naba ngi long kum ka jingiwbih ba la ai da U Khrist sha U Blei , kaba saphriang hapdeng kito kiba la pynim bad kito kiba la jah noh .

translation.en: The king of Tappuah , one  ; the king of Hepher , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Tappuah , ka Hepher ,

translation.en: Lord  , thou hast heard the desire of the humble : thou wilt prepare their heart , thou wilt cause thine ear to hear :
translation.kha: A  Trai  , men shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong kiba rit kyrdan ; me ai ha ki ka jingshlur .

translation.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations , there was given to me a thorn in the flesh , the messenger of Satan to buffet me , lest I should be exalted above measure .
translation.kha: Hynrei ban pyllait ïa nga na kaba dap da ka jingsarong namar kiei kiei kiba bun kiba phylla ba nga la ïohi , la buh ha nga ïa ka jingpang kaba jur ha ka met , kaba long kum u nonglamktien jong u Soitan ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ban pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsngew sarong .

translation.en: And Jacob took a stone , and set it up for a pillar .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u shim uwei u maw bad u pynïeng ïa u kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw .

translation.en: But if the unbelieving depart , let him depart . A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases : but God hath called us to peace .
translation.kha: Pynban , lada u bymngeit u kwah ban iehnoh ïa tnga ka bangeit , ai ba kan long kumta . Ha kiba kum kita ki khep u tnga ne ka tnga bangeit , ki la laitluid ban jied . U Blei u la khot ïa phi ïa ka ban im ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together , and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them , and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Kiba bun kito kiba ju leh myntor ki la wallam lang ïa ki kitab jong ki baroh bad thang ïa kita ha khmat u paidbah . Ki la kheiñlang ïa ka dor jong ki kitab , bad ka jingkheiñ ka long kumba sanphew hajar tylli ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: But now , O  Lord  , thou art our father  ; we are the clay , and thou our potter  ; and we all are the work of thy hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me long u Kpa jong ngi . Ngi long kum ka dewbyrtha , bad me long kum u nongthaw khiew .

translation.en: And when they had nothing to pay , he frankly forgave them both . Tell me therefore , which of them will love him most ?
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban siew pat sha u , kumta u la pyndam noh ïa ki ram jong ki baroh ar ngut . Uno na kine , te , u ban ieit kham bun ïa u ?

translation.en: And they laid hands on them , and put them in hold unto the next day : for it was now eventide .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa ki bad ki la buh ïa ki ha phatok haduh ka sngi kaba bud , namar ba ka la dier eh .

translation.en: Save that the high places were not removed : the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  to Tyre  ; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall , when the wounded cry , when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u don ïa kane ban ong ïa ka nongbah Tyros :  Haba la jop ïa pha , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki rud duriaw kin sngewtriem ha ka jinglynñiar jong kito kiba shah pynïap .

translation.en: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him , and smote him before the people , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Sekharaïah , u pynïap ïa u ha Ibleam , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And he looked this way and that way , and when he saw that there was no man , he slew the Egyptian , and hid him in the sand .
translation.kha: U Moses u peit shane shatai , bad haba u ïohi ba ym don mano mano ba peit sha u , u pynïap ïa u , bad u tep ïa u hapoh u shyiap .

translation.en: I have even heard of thee , that the spirit of the gods is in thee , and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me bad ba me long uba tbit bad me don ka jingtip bad ka jingstad .

translation.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians , that ye might remove them far from their border .
translation.kha: Phi la rah noh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad Jerusalem jngai na ka ri jong ki hi bad die ïa ki ha ki Grik .

translation.en: Saying , We give thee thanks , O Lord God Almighty , which art , and wast , and art to come  ; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power , and hast reigned .
translation.kha: Nangta ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang kiba shong ha ki khet jong ki ha khmat U Blei ki la dem ngon ïa lade bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba ong :  Ko Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uta uba long bad uba la ju long ! Ngi ainguh ïa me ba me la shimti ïa ka bor bakhraw jong me bad me la sdang ban synshar !

translation.en: And having this confidence , I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith ;
translation.kha: Nga sngewskhem ïa kane bad kumta nga tip ba ngan dang sah . Ngan dang ïaisah bad phi baroh , ban pynsan shuh shuh ïa phi bad ïa ka jingkmen ha ka jingngeit ,

translation.en: He that passeth by , and meddleth with strife belonging not to him , is like one that taketh a dog by the ears .
translation.kha: Kaba leit tuklar ha ka jingïania ka bym dei ka kam jong phi ka long kumba leit sha lynti bah bad kem ïa u ksew na ki shkor .

translation.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand , and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof  ; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin roi kum ki symboh shyiap , bad ngan jin da la pynthikna ba yn ym pynjot ïa ki da lei lei .

translation.en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment .
translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha , um dei ban leit phai pat sha ïing na ka bynta ka jaiñkup .

translation.en: And always , night and day , he was in the mountains , and in the tombs , crying , and cutting himself with stones .
translation.kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet u ju shang ha ki jaka tep briew bad ki jaka lum , da kaba lynñiar bad ot ïa lade da ki maw .

translation.en: When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: Let that day be darkness  ; let not God regard it from above , neither let the light shine upon it .
translation.kha: Pynkylla ïa kata ka sngi sha ka jingdum , A Blei . Wat kynmaw shuh ïa kata ka sngi ; Wat ai ba ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ pat halor jong ka .

translation.en: And he took the fat , and the rump , and all the fat that was upon the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and their fat , and the right shoulder :
translation.kha: U shim ïa ka khleiñ , ïa ka dongnai , ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki doh jem , ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud , ïa ki khyllai ba sop khleiñ , bad ïa ka kjat-dien kamon .

translation.en: Some also there were that said , We have mortgaged our lands , vineyards , and houses , that we might buy corn , because of the dearth .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki ong ,  Ngi la bynda ïa ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki ïing jong ngi ban ïoh kew uba biang ban lait na ka jingshahthngan .

translation.en: But if ye will not hear it , my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride  ; and mine eye shall weep sore , and run down with tears , because the  Lord s  flock is carried away captive .
translation.kha: Lada phin ym shahshkor , ngan ïam ha kaba jar jar namar ka jingsarong jong phi ; ngan ïamkthang eh , bad ki ummat jong nga kin tuid namar ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la shah ring noh kum ki mraw .

translation.en: And , behold , a man of the company cried out , saying , Master , I beseech thee , look upon my son : for he is mine only child .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew u la pyrta na u paidbah ,  Ko Nonghikai ! Nga kyrpad ïa me , ban khmih ïa u khun jong nga — u khun marwei jong nga !

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  of hosts , Go , get thee unto this treasurer , even unto Shebna , which is over the house , and say ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la ong ïa nga ban leit sha u Shebna , u nongpynïaidkam ha ka longïing syiem , bad ong ha u ,

translation.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing , because he had delight in Jacob s daughter : and he was more honourable than all the house of his father .
translation.kha: bad uta u samla ruh um shym la pynslem ban leh ïa kata kaba la ai jingmut , namar ba u la ibha eh ïa ka khun jong u Jakob . U long ruh uba donburom tam na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u baroh .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land which I give you , then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda phi rung ha kata ka ri kaba U  Trai  u ai ha phi , phin burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba phin ym rep ïa ka khyndew ha man la ka snem kaba hynñiew .

translation.en: And it was so , when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court , that she obtained favour in his sight : and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand . So Esther drew near , and touched the top of the sceptre .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u ïohi ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei , ba ka ïeng habar , ka la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u , bad u pyn-i ïa ka ïa u diengsynshar ksiar . Nangta ka kiew shalor bad ka ktah ïa ka tduh uta u diengsynshar .

translation.en: And , behold , as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes , so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the  Lord  , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation .
translation.kha: Kumba nga la pyllait im ïa ka jingim jong phi ha kane ka sngi , ai ba U  Trai  un leh kumjuh ïa nga bad pyllait ïa nga na ki jingjynjar jong nga baroh !

translation.en: And she put her widow s garments off from her , and covered her with a veil , and wrapped herself , and sat in an open place , which is by the way to Timnah  ; for she saw that Shelah was grown , and she was not given unto him to wife .
translation.kha: Kumta ka la kylliang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei ba ka phong , ka la tap ïa la ka khmat da ka jingkah khmat , bad ka la leit shong ha ka khyrdop ban rung sha Enaim , ka shnong kaba don ha ka lynti sha Timnah . Kumba ka la tip bha ba u Shelah u khun khatduh jong u Judah , u la rangbah mynta , pynban ym pat shym la ai ïa ka ha u ban shongkurim .

translation.en: And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the  Lord  : the sword to slay , and the dogs to tear , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kut jingmut ba saw tylli kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin jia ha ki : kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki met jong ki yn patan noh da ki ksew ; ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bam ïa kaei kaba sah .

translation.en: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband , and a man find her in the city , and lie with her  ;
translation.kha: Lada lap hapoh shnong ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew kaba la ïatehktien bad uwei pat u briew ,

translation.en: Everything done at a branch contributes to the orderly accomplishment of the preaching work . —1 Corinthians 14 :33 , 40 .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei kiba la leh ha ka tnad treikam ka wanrah ïa ka jingryntih ha ka kam ïalap . —1 Korinth 14 :33 , 40 .

translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that triest the righteous , and seest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I opened my cause .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ko  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me tynjuh hok ïa ki briew ; me tip kaei kaba don hapoh ki dohnud bad ka jingmut jong ki . Kumta shah ngan ïohi ba me pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong nga , namar nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me .

translation.en: Hear me , O  Lord  , hear me , that this people may know that thou art the  Lord  God , and that thou hast turned their heart back again .
translation.kha: Jubab ïa nga , A  Trai  , jubab ïa nga , khnang ba une u paidbah un tip ba me , U  Trai  , me long U Blei , bad ba men sa wallam pat ïa ki sha lade hi .

translation.en: And Joshua said , Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave , and set men by it for to keep them :
translation.kha: U ong ,  Pyntyllun katto katne ki maw kiba heh ha khmat kata ka krem . Buh katto katne ki nongap phira hangta ,

translation.en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another  ; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another .
translation.kha: Bteng lang san tylli na ki ba kin long kawei ka jingkah , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki san tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .

translation.en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah , in the sepulchre of Kish his father : and they performed all that the king commanded . And after that God was entreated for the land .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la tep ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad u Jonathan ha ka jingtep jong u Kish , u kpa jong u Saul , ha Sela ha ka ri Benjamin , ki da pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba u syiem u la hukum . Bad hadien kata , U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki na ka bynta ka ri .

translation.en: And when they came to Reuel their father , he said , How is it that ye are come so soon to day ?
translation.kha: Ynda ki leit phai sha la u kpa , u kylli ïa ki ,  Kumno phi ïawan kloi mynta ka sngi ?

translation.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul , and besought him ,
translation.kha: ha kaba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall open unto thee his good treasure , the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season , and to bless all the work of thine hand : and thou shalt lend unto many nations , and thou shalt not borrow .
translation.kha: Un pynhap ïa u slap ha la ka aïom na ka ïing kynshew jong u ha bneng bad un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh ai kylliang ha kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , katba ma phi pat phin ym hap shim kylliang nano nano .

translation.en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick , he abode two days still in the same place where he was .
translation.kha: Pynban haba u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba u Lasaros u la pang , U la nang sah sa ar sngi ha ka jaka kaba U la don .

translation.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose , and shouted , and pursued the Philistines , until thou come to the valley , and to the gates of Ekron . And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim , even unto Gath , and unto Ekron .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Israel bad Judah ki risa shaid bad ki mareh nadien jong ki , ki beh kthong haduh Gath bad shaduh ki khyrdop ka Ekron . Ki Philistia ki la kyllon mynsaw baroh shi lynter lynti naduh Shaaraim , haduh Gath bad Ekron .

translation.en: And Saul said , There shall not a man be put to death this day : for to day the  Lord  hath wrought salvation in Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u ong ,  Ym dei ban pynïap ïano ïano ha kane ka sngi , naba kane ka dei ka sngi ba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And Moses said , Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings , that we may sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Lada kumta , phin hap pynbiang ïa ngi da ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh thang ban ai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: But the rich , in that he is made low : because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away .
translation.kha: Naba uba riewspah un tlor noh kum u syntiew jong u jingthung ha khlaw .

translation.en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
translation.kha: Hato mem tip ?  U la kylli ïa nga .  Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah ,  nga la jubab .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the  Lord  would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind , that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ba U  Trai  u shim noh ïa u Elijah sha bneng ha ka  erlangthari . U Elijah bad u Elisha ki la mihnoh na Gilgal ,

translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded to be given them of the children of Israel , in the day that he anointed them , by a statute for ever throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki paid Israel ban ai ïa kane ka bynta jong ka jingainguh . Ka dei ka aiñ ba ki paid Israel ki dei ban kohnguh pateng la pateng .

translation.en: For they are a nation void of counsel , neither is there any understanding in them .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki long ka jaitbynriew ka bym don ka bor sngewthuh ; kim don satia ka jingstad .

translation.en: Well ; because of unbelief they were broken off , and thou standest by faith . Be not highminded , but fear :
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha . Ïa ki la pynkheiñ noh namar kim shym la ngeit , katba phi sah ha la ka jaka namar ba phi ngeit . Hynrei wat sngewsarong na ka bynta kata ; pynban , to sheptieng .

translation.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .
translation.kha: Te phin shaniah ha U Blei borabor bad shem ba u long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen jong phi .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  to me  ; Make thee bonds and yokes , and put them upon thy neck ,
translation.kha: ban shna ïa lade ka lyngkor da ki tyllai snieh bad ki dieng jingphna bad ban buh ïa ka ha u ryndang jong nga .

translation.en: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .
translation.kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Nga long u Jiw , ïa uba la kha ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , u traishnong ka nongbah ba-donnam . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban kren ha u paidbah .

translation.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh  ; he shall see it , and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon , and to his children , because he hath wholly followed the  Lord .
translation.kha: lait tang u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh . U te u ïaineh ha nga , kumta ngan ai ha u bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la leit syntiat .’

translation.en: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears , and in the ears of all the people  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi bad ha ki paidbah .

translation.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies : thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me : thou hast delivered me from the violent man .
translation.kha: bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong nga . A  Trai  , me ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga bad me ïada ïa nga na ki riewthombor .

translation.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof , and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it  ; that he may return unto his possession .
translation.kha: Lada kumta , u dei ban siew sha uta u briew uba la thied ïa ka ha ka dor ka ban ïahap bad ki snem kiba dang sah haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat kaba bud , hadien kata un ïoh pat ïa la ka khyndew .

translation.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where was a synagogue of the Jews :
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Silas ki la leit lyngba ka Amphipolis bad ka Apollonia , bad ki la wan poi sha Thessaloni , ha kaba la don ka synagog .

translation.en: He said unto me again , Stand , I pray thee , upon me , and slay me : for anguish is come upon me , because my life is yet whole in me .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong , ‘ Ale hangne bad pynïap ïa nga . Nga la mynsaw palat bad nga la jan ïap .’

translation.en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead : fear them not , neither be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me uba skhem kum u mawsiang , uba eh kum u diamond ; wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: If a soul commit a trespass , and sin through ignorance , in the holy things of the  Lord   ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the  Lord  a ram without blemish out of the flocks , with thy estimation by shekels of silver , after the shekel of the sanctuary , for a trespass offering :
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba kum klet ban wan ai ïa ka jingsiew ba long kyntang sha U  Trai  , un wallam ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat sha U  Trai  da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kumba la buh .

translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of them that seek their life , and into the hand of the king of Babylon s army , which are gone up from you .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u sha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki . Ngan aiti ïa ki sha ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , kaba la sangeh ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .

translation.en: And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
translation.kha: U Jakob , u Petros , bad u Ïoannis , kiba i ba ki long ki nongïalam , ki la tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam bakyrpang ; kumta ki la ïakhublei kti ïa u Barnabas lem bad ïa nga de , kum ka dak ba ngi ïalong baroh ki nongïatrei lang . Ngi la ïamynjur ba u Barnabas bad nga , ngin ïatrei hapdeng ki Jentil , bad ki pat hapdeng ki Jiw .

translation.en: And take every man his censer , and put incense in them , and bring ye before the  Lord  every man his censer , two hundred and fifty censers  ; thou also , and Aaron , each of you his censer .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi un rah ïa la u khiew buh ding , un buh hangta ïa ka jingiwbih , bad nangta un wanrah ïa ka sha ka duwan .

translation.en: And David cried to the people , and to Abner the son of Ner , saying , Answerest thou not , Abner ? Then Abner answered and said , Who art thou that criest to the king ?
translation.kha: u pyrta ïa ki shipai u Saul bad ïa u Abner ,  Ko Abner ! Hato phi ïohsngew ïa nga ?   Uei uta uba pyrta bad uba pynkyndit thiah ïa u syiem ?  u Abner u kylli .

translation.en: Moreover , thou son of man , take thee one stick , and write upon it , For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions : then take another stick , and write upon it , For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa ki ktien ‘ Ka Hima Judah .’ Nangta shim sa uwei pat u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ Ka Hima Israel .’

translation.en: O generation , see ye the word of the  Lord . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel ? a land of darkness ? wherefore say my people , We are lords  ; we will come no more unto thee ?
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Hato nga la long kum ka ri shyiap ïa phi , kum ka ri kaba dum bad kaba ma ? Balei te ba phi ong ba phin leh kat kaba phi sngewbha , ba phin ym wan phai shuh sha nga ?

translation.en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen , the signs , and those great miracles :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ïa ki khlam kiba ishyrkhei , ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba khraw ba U  Trai  u la leh .

translation.en: And Samuel said , How can I go ? if Saul hear it , he will kill me . And the  Lord  said , Take an heifer with thee , and say , I am come to sacrifice to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban leh ïa kata ?  U Samuel u kylli .  Lada u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kata , un pynïap ïa nga !  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Shim ïa u khun masi bad ong ba me don hangta ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering :
translation.kha: Un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang na la ka sla ti bad khyndiat ka snam jong u khunlangbrot bad un tah ha ka shkor kamon , ka  tikmie kamon , bad ka  jatkmie kamon jong uta u briew ïa uba yn pynkhuid .

translation.en: Then released he Barabbas unto them : and when he had scourged Jesus , he delivered him to be crucified .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pilat u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki ; bad hadien kata , u la phah sympat ïa U Jisu , u la aiti ïa u ban sahnarphna .

translation.en: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Paul u la ïalam ïa kita ki rangbah bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid lem bad ki . Nangta u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la pyntip katno sngi kan long haduh kaba kut ka por jong ka jingpynkhuid , haba yn ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta jong ki baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: Non his son , Jehoshua his son .
translation.kha: u Nun , u Joshua .

translation.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness , and despise government . Presumptuous are they , selfwilled , they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities .
translation.kha: Kine ki nonghikai balamler ki long kiba shlur bad kiba kyr-eit , bad kim pyn-i jingñiewburom ïa ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ; pynban ki krenbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the  Lord  with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma u bad ki Israel baroh ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  shatei sha Jerusalem da ka jingrisa kmen bad ka jingpynsawa ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh ? or seest thou as man seeth ?
translation.kha: Hato me ïohi ïa kiei kiei kumba ngi ïohi ?

translation.en: Then she runneth , and cometh to Simon Peter , and to the other disciple , whom Jesus loved , and saith unto them , They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre , and we know not where they have laid him .
translation.kha: Ka la leit mareh sha u Simon Petros bad sha uwei pat u synran , uba U Jisu u ieit , bad ka la ïathuh ha ki ,  Ki la ïarah noh ïa U Trai na ka jingtep , bad ngim tip hangno ki la ïabuh ïa u !

translation.en: And he said , I beseech thee , shew me thy glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Moses u kyrpad ,  Sngewbha shah ngan ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong me .

translation.en: As they ministered to the Lord , and fasted , the Holy Ghost said , Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïashakri ïa U Trai bad shahjingit , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha ki ,  Pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga ïa u Barnabas bad u Saul , ban trei ïa ka kam sha kaba nga la khot ïa ki .

translation.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name s sake , that he might make his mighty power to be known .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la pynim ïa ki , kumba u la kular , khnang ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bakhraw jong u .

translation.en: But Peter , standing up with the eleven , lifted up his voice , and said unto them , Ye men of Judaea , and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem , be this known unto you , and hearken to my words :
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ïeng joit lem bad kiwei pat ki khatwei ngut ki apostol bad ha ka sur bajam u la sdang ban kren ha u paidbah :  Ko para Jiw bad phi baroh kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , to shahshkor ïa nga bad shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi aïu kane ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath been mindful of us : he will bless us  ; he will bless the house of Israel  ; he will bless the house of Aaron .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kynmaw ïa ngi , bad un kyrkhu ïa ngi ; un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh jong U Blei .

translation.en: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God : for it is not subject to the law of God , neither indeed can be .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u briew u long u nongshun jong U Blei haba u shah pynïaid ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh ; namar um kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei , bad ha ka jingshisha um lah ban kohnguh ïa ka .

translation.en: And the light shineth in darkness  ; and the darkness comprehended it not .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka shai ha kaba dum , bad ka jingdum kam lah ban pynlip ïa ka .

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,   ‘ Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , da la ka mynsiem baroh , bad da la ka jingmut baroh .’

translation.en: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth , and called thee from the chief men thereof , and said unto thee , Thou art my servant  ; I have chosen thee , and not cast thee away .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa me na kiba kut ka pyrthei ; nga la khot ïa me naduh ki pud bajngai bah jong ka bad nga la ong ha me ‘ me long u shakri jong nga ,’ ngam shym la kyntait ïa me , hynrei nga la jied ïa me .

translation.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice , and do all that I speak  ; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies , and an adversary unto thine adversaries .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi kohnguh ïa u , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum , ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .

translation.en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses , HOLINESS UNTO THE  Lord   ; and the pots in the  Lord s  house shall be like the bowls before the altar .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por wat ïa ki baje ha ki tyllai teh jong ki kulai yn thoh da ki kyntien  Ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai .  Ki khiew shet ha ka Templ kin long kiba kyntang kum ki jingdiang ha khmat ka duwan .

translation.en: Because it is written , Be ye holy  ; for I am holy .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  To long phi kiba khuid namar nga long uba khuid .

translation.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever , and forsake us so long time ?
translation.kha: Balei ba me la iehnoh ïa ngi slem katta katta ? Hato men dang kynmaw biang ïa ngi ?

translation.en: And Jacob went out from Beer–sheba , and went toward Haran .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la mihnoh na Beersheba bad u leit shaphang Haran .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Edom , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he did pursue his brother with the sword , and did cast off all pity , and his anger did tear perpetually , and he kept his wrath for ever :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Edom ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la beh krad ïa la ki hynmen ki para , ïa ki Israel bad khlem da pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki . Ka jingbitar jong ki kam don pud bad kim shah ba kin ïap .

translation.en: And make ye marriages with us , and give your daughters unto us , and take our daughters unto you .
translation.kha: To ngin pynlong ka jingïateh kular ba kan don noh ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi bad ki jong phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks . Then said Jeremiah unto him , The  Lord  hath not called thy name Pashur , but Magor–missabib .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Pashhur u la pyllait ïa nga na ki kynjri , nga la ong ha u ,  U  Trai  um shym kyrteng ïa me u Pashhur . Ka kyrteng kaba u la lah ai ha me ka dei ‘ Ka Jingshyrkhei ha kylleng .’

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  came again the second time , and touched him , and said , Arise and eat  ; because the journey is too great for thee .
translation.kha: U angel U  Trai  u la wan biang bad kyrsiew ïa u ha ka sien kaba ar bad u ong ,  Khie joit bad bam , lymda kumta men shitom ha ka jingïaid lynti .

translation.en: But the Egyptians pursued after them , all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , and his horsemen , and his army , and overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pi–hahiroth , before Baal–zephon .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai baroh , ki kali ïapom , bad ki nongñiah , ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la lap ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki la sher dara harud ka Duriaw Basaw , hajan ka Pi Hahiroth bad ka Baal Sephon .

translation.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents , and they came as grasshoppers for multitude  ; for both they and their camels were without number : and they entered into the land to destroy it .
translation.kha: Ki wan lem bad la ki jingri bad ki dara kumba rben ki kynhun puit . Ma ki lem bad ki ut jong ki , ki bun haduh katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki . Ki wan bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka ri ,

translation.en: Nevertheless in those days , saith the  Lord  , I will not make a full end with you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Wat ha kito ki sngi ngan ym pynjot khoit ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And as he thus spake for himself , Festus said with a loud voice , Paul , thou art beside thyself  ; much learning doth make thee mad .
