translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ïasaid da ïa lade ha kane ka rukom , u Phestos u la pyrta ha u ,  Me la lamwir , ko Paul ! Ka jingstad bakhraw jong me ka la pynlamwir ïa me !

translation.en: From thence they removed , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites : for Arnon is the border of Moab , between Moab and the Amorites .
translation.kha: Nangta pat ki la mihnoh bad sher dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Wah Arnon , ha ka ri khlaw kaba ïar shaduh ki khappud ka ri Amor . ( Ka wah Arnon ka la long ka pud hapdeng ka ri Moab bad ki Amor . )

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , believe me , the hour cometh , when ye shall neither in this mountain , nor yet at Jerusalem , worship the Father .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  To ngeit ïa nga , ko ka briew , ba ka por kan poi haba ki briew kin ym mane ïa U Kpa halor une u lum ne ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: I ate no pleasant bread , neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth , neither did I anoint myself at all , till three whole weeks were fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ngam shym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam bang lane kano kano ka doh , lane dih ïa kano kano ka waiñ , lane sad ïa u shñiuh jong nga tad haduh ba ki lai taïew ki la leit noh .

translation.en: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka lehbha bun shah ïa u briew ban ïa kaba ki shiphew ngut ki nongsynshar ki lah ban leh ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me . And he said , What needeth it ? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u ong ,  Te kumta , shah ngan ieh katto katne ngut ki briew jong nga bad phi .  Hynrei u Jakob u ong ,  Ym da donkam ban leh kumta namar nga kwah tang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .

translation.en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people ? for they weep unto me , saying , Give us flesh , that we may eat .
translation.kha: Nangno nga lah ban pynbiang doh ïa kine ki paidbah ? Ki ud sa ud bad ki pan doh ban bam .

translation.en: Therefore the law is slacked , and judgment doth never go forth : for the wicked doth compass about the righteous  ; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth .
translation.kha: Ka aiñ ka tlot bad kam myntoi ei ei , bad ym ju don ka jingbishar hok . Ki briew kiba sniew ki ïoh ïa kaba kham bha ban ïa kiba hok , bad kumta ïa ka jingbishar hok la pynjngut .

translation.en: As he spake to our fathers , to Abraham , and to his seed for ever .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ban pyn-i jingisynei ha u Abraham bad ha baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom !

translation.en: The cup of blessing which we bless , is it not the communion of the blood of Christ ? The bread which we break , is it not the communion of the body of Christ ?
translation.kha: Ka khuri kaba ngi pyndonkam ha ka Jingkhawai U Trai bad ïa kaba ngi ainguh ïa U Blei : Haba ngi dih na ka , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka snam U Khrist . Bad u kpu uba ngi kdiah : Haba ngi bam ïa u , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka met U Khrist .

translation.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways :
translation.kha: ki ieh ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot shano shano ba ki leit .

translation.en: When he gave to the sea his decree , that the waters should not pass his commandment : when he appointed the foundations of the earth :
translation.kha: bad pynbeit ïa ki um ka duriaw ba kin ym kiew palat ban ïa kaba u la ong . Nga la don hangta mynba u buh ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah , saying , Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood , in the hill of Hachilah , which is on the south of Jeshimon ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew na Siph ki la leit sha u Saul ha Gibeah bad ki ong ,  U Dabid u rieh ha ka ri jong ngi ha Horesh halor u Lum Hakhilah , ha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri khlaw Judia .

translation.en: Therefore it is of faith , that it might be by grace ; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed ; not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham ; who is the father of us all ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka kular la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit , khnang ba ïa ka jingngeit yn pynthikna kum ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei ïa baroh kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham — ym tang ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka Hukum , hynrei ïa kito ruh kiba ngeit kumba u Abraham u la leh . Namar u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi baroh ;

translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; and thou givest him not warning , nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way , to save his life  ; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew basniew , un sa ïap noh bad mem shym la maham u ban kylla noh na ki lynti jong u , khnang ba u lah ban pyllait ïa la ka jingim , un ïap hi kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkitkhlieh ha me ïa ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: They have set up kings , but not by me : they have made princes , and I knew it not : of their silver and their gold have they made them idols , that they may be cut off .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la jied ïa ki syiem . Hynrei ki la leh ïa kata ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki thung ïa ki nongïalam , hynrei khlem ka jingpynskhem jong nga . Ki shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki bad ki thaw ïa ki bleithaw — na ka bynta ka jingjot jong ki hi .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Because I said unto thee , I saw thee under the fig tree , believest thou ? thou shalt see greater things than these .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Hato me ngeit tang namar ba nga la ïathuh ïa me ba nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ? Men sa ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba kham khraw ban ïa kane !

translation.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool : but whoso walketh wisely , he shall be delivered .
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingbieit ban bud ïa la ki jong ki jingsngewthuh . To long shngain , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew kiba kham stad .

translation.en: Because of the Chaldeans : for they were afraid of them , because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land .
translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng ïa ki nong Babilonia namar ba u Ishmael u la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah , uba u syiem ka Babilon u la pynlong u lat jong kata ka jaka . Kumta ki la leit noh sha Ijipt , khnang ba kin lait na ki nong Babilonia . Ha lynti , ki la sangeh ha Shimham , kaba hajan Bethlehem .

translation.en: The apostle Paul told one of the congregations in his day : “I am longing to see you , . . . that we may have an interchange of encouragement by one another’s faith , both yours and mine .”
translation.kha: U apostol Paul u la ong ha kawei na ki balang : “Nga kwah hir hir ban iohi ia phi , . . . ba ha phi yn pyniasngew tngen lem ia nga bad phi , da la ka jingngeit jingngeit . . . ka jong phi ruh bad ka jong nga de .”

translation.en: He saved others  ; himself he cannot save . If he be the King of Israel , let him now come down from the cross , and we will believe him .
translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa kiwei , hynrei um lah ban pynim ïa lade ! Hato um dei une u syiem ka Israel ? Lada u la hiar noh mynta na ka diengphna , ngin ngeit ha u !

translation.en: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds : lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown , and the fruit of thy vineyard , be defiled .
translation.kha: Wat bet ïa uwei pat u symbai ha kajuh ka bri ba phi thung dieng sohwaiñ ; lada phi leh kumta , phim lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki sohwaiñ lane ïa u soh jong uta uwei pat u jingthung .

translation.en: I have sinned  ; what shall I do unto thee , O thou preserver of men ? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee , so that I am a burden to myself ?
translation.kha: Hato la pynmynsaw ïa phi da ka pop jong nga , ko phi u nongap byndi ? Balei me pyndonkam ïa nga na ka bynta ka sohpdung-jinghikai jong me ? Hato nga long ka jingkit kaba khia eh ïa me ?

translation.en: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah , when he fought against Hazael king of Syria . And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel , because he was sick .
translation.kha: U la leit phai sha ka nongbah Jesreel ban ïoh jingkoit ïa ki jingmong jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shata ban jngoh ïa u .

translation.en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above , and signs in the earth beneath  ; blood , and fire , and vapour of smoke :
translation.kha: Ngan leh ki kambah ha ka sahit bneng shajrong bad ïa ki jingphylla ha ka khyndew sha tbian . Kan don ka snam , ka ding , bad ka tdem kaba rben ;

translation.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab , saith the  Lord  , him that offereth in the high places , and him that burneth incense to his gods .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh ïa ki briew ka Moab na kaba thang jingainguh ha ki jaka mane jong ki bad ban ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ki blei jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint them , as thou didst anoint their father , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office : for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa ki kumba me leh ïa u kpa jong ki , ba ki lah ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh . Da kane ka jingpynsleh , kin ïailong ki lyngdoh shi rta .

translation.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .
translation.kha: Bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei uba kum une u khynnah , u pdiang ïa nga .

translation.en: Seeing it is one God , which shall justify the circumcision by faith , and uncircumcision through faith .
translation.kha: U Blei u long tang uwei , bad un pynlong ha lade hi ka hok bad ki Jiw halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit jong ki , bad un pynlong ka hok bad ki Jentil lyngba ka jingngeit jong ki .

translation.en: And he shall take of it his handful , of the flour of the meat offering , and of the oil thereof , and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering , and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour , even the memorial of it , unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta un shim shi kham u  purew bad ka umphniang , bad ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka , bad un thang ha ka duwan kum ka dak ba ïa kata baroh la kñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Ka jingiw na kane ka jingainguh ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the king said unto Zadok , Carry back the ark of God into the city : if I shall find favour in the eyes of the  Lord  , he will bring me again , and shew me both it , and his habitation :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Sadok ,  Khie leit rah biang ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka nongbah . Lada U  Trai  u sngewbha ïa nga , shisien ka sngi un shah ba ngan wan biang ban ïohi ïa ka bad ïa ka jaka ha kaba ka don .

translation.en: The hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and carried me out in the spirit of the  Lord  , and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones ,
translation.kha: Nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  bad U Mynsiem jong u , u la ïalam bad pynshong ïa nga hapoh ka them ha kaba ka madan ka dap da ki shyieng .

translation.en: And the cart came into the field of Joshua , a Beth–shemite , and stood there , where there was a great stone : and they clave the wood of the cart , and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kata ka kali ka wan sha ka lyngkha jong u briew uba kyrteng u Joshua , uba shong ha Beth Shemesh , bad ka sangeh hajan u mawbah . Kita ki briew ki pom lyngkhot ïa kata ka kali dieng , ki pynïap ïa kita ki masi kynthei bad ki kñia ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said , The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . For the  Lord  had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the  Lord  might bring evil upon Absalom .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki Israel baroh ki ong ,  Ka jingai jingmut jong u Hushai ka kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Ahithophel .  U  Trai  u la rai ban pynpulom ïa ka jingai jingmut babha ka jong u Ahithophel , khnang ba ka jingjot kan wan ha u Absalom .

translation.en: Watch ye therefore : for ye know not when the master of the house cometh , at even , or at midnight , or at the cockcrowing , or in the morning :
translation.kha: To ap phira bha te , namar phim tip lano u kynrad jong ka ïing un wan — ka lah ban long ha ka por janmiet lane ha ka por shiteng synñia lane ha shuwa ka step phyrngab lane ha ka por tang shu mih sngi .

translation.en: Therefore let us keep the feast , not with old leaven , neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness ; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth .
translation.kha: To ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam , te , ym da u kpu uba don u thiat uba rim jong ka pop bad ka jingbymman , hynrei da u kpu u bym don thiat , u kpu jong ka jingkhuid bad ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , I prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la ai ïa ka dulir thied jaka ha u Barukh , nga la duwai ,

translation.en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment , between blood and blood , between plea and plea , and between stroke and stroke , being matters of controversy within thy gates : then shalt thou arise , and get thee up into the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose  ;
translation.kha: Lada don ki kam kiba kham eh ïa ki nongbishar shnong ban rai , kum ki mokotduma ïaknieh khyndew , lane kiba dei shaphang kaba ïashoh ïadat , lane kito kiba hap ban pynïapher hapdeng ka jingpynïap briew bad kawei pat ka jait jingpynïap briew , leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ïa kaba la jied da U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,

translation.en: So he sent his brethren away , and they departed : and he said unto them , See that ye fall not out by the way .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah noh ïa la ki hynmen , bad katba ki dang ïakhreh mih , u ong ,  Wat ïakajia ha lynti .

translation.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies , then keep thee from every wicked thing .
translation.kha: Haba phi don ha ka jaka shong dara ha ka por thma , kiar na kano kano ka ban pynlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .

translation.en: Yea , though they have hired among the nations , now will I gather them , and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ngan lumlang ïa ki bad pynshitom ïa ki . Shen shen kin sa kyrthat ha ka jingpang , haba u patsha ka Assyria u banbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: Not for your sakes do I this , saith the Lord  God  , be it known unto you : be ashamed and confounded for your own ways , O house of Israel .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , nga kwah ba phin tip ba ngam shym leh ïa kane baroh namar jong phi . Nga kwah ba phin da sngewlehrain bad sngewjahburom ïa kaei kaba phi la leh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius , a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,
translation.kha: La don u briew ha Kaisaria uba kyrteng u Kornelios , uba long u rangbah shipai ha ka kynhun shipai ka Hima Rom ba la khot  Ka Kynhun shipai Italian .

translation.en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years : and he died .
translation.kha: U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah laiphew snem .

translation.en: Six days may work be done  ; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest , holy to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day , he shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka long ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha nga . Uno uno uba trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .

translation.en: And there shall ye remember your ways , and all your doings , wherein ye have been defiled  ; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed .
translation.kha: Te phin kynmaw ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba jahburom kiba phi la leh bad kumno phi la pyntngit ïa lade . Phin sa isih ïa lade namar kiei kiei kiba sniew baroh kiba phi la leh .

translation.en: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift , and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints .
translation.kha: Da ka mon sngewbha jong ki hi , ki la kyrpad ïa ngi bad ïasaid na ka bynta ka lad ban ïadon bynta ha kaba ïarap ïa ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .

translation.en: But Jonathan Saul s son delighted much in David : and Jonathan told David , saying , Saul my father seeketh to kill thee : now therefore , I pray thee , take heed to thyself until the morning , and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself :
translation.kha: kumta u ong ha u ,  I pa i pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Sngewbha da leh husiar lashai mynstep ; rieh ha ka jaka bym don batip bad sah hangta .

translation.en: And he went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold therein , and them that bought  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la sdang ban beh noh ïa ki nongkhaïi da kaba ong ha ki ,

translation.en: And Moses said unto him , As soon as I am gone out of the city , I will spread abroad my hands unto the  Lord   ; and the thunder shall cease , neither shall there be any more hail  ; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the  Lord s .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u ,  Nga tang shu poi shabar kane ka shnong , ngan duwai ha U  Trai . U pyrthat un sangeh , bad u phria un ym hap shuh , ba phin ïoh tip ba ka pyrthei ka long ka jong U  Trai .

translation.en: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee , and unto thy seed for ever . And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ka jingpang jong u Naaman kan wan halor jong me , bad ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin ïoh ïa ka shi junom !  Haba u Gehasi u la mihnoh , u la ïoh ïa ka jingpang — ka sniehdoh jong u ka la lieh kum ka ïor .

translation.en: So the ark of the  Lord  compassed the city , going about it once : and they came into the camp , and lodged in the camp .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kane ka kynhun ki rangbah ban rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sawdong ka nongbah shisien . Nangta ki wan phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara bad ki sahmiet hangta .

translation.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast , and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward  ;
translation.kha: Kata ka khubor ïa kaba la pynbna da ki angel ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ka long kaba shisha , bad uno uno u bym shym bud ïa ka lane u bym shym kohnguh ïa ka u shah pynshitom kumba ka dei hok ïa u .

translation.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved  ; but he that believeth not shall be damned .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba ngeit bad uba shah pynbaptis , yn pynim ; ïa uno uno u bymngeit , yn pynrem .

translation.en: And the  Lord  God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers , rising up betimes , and sending  ; because he had compassion on his people , and on his dwelling place :
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u ïai phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba u kwah ban da ïa ki bad ïa ka templ .

translation.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la leit kylleng ka thain baroh jong ka wah Jordan , u da ïalap ,  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah ba yn pynbaptis , bad U Blei un map ïa ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had  ; and they cried before him , Bow the knee : and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U la ai ha u ïa ka kali syiem kaba ar ba un shong ; bad ki nongap ïa ka ïingsyiem ki ïaid ha khmat jong u bad ki pyrta ,  Kynriah ! kynriah !  Bad kumta la thung lat ïa u Joseph halor ka ri Ijipt baroh .

translation.en: I will go and return to my place , till they acknowledge their offence , and seek my face : in their affliction they will seek me early .
translation.kha: Ngan lyndet noh ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin shahshitom ha ban da biang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki bad wan ban wad ïa nga . Lehse ha ki jingshah shitom jong ki , kin pyrshang ban wad ïa nga .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare ?
translation.kha: Hangno ba me kwah ïa ngi ban pynkhreh ïa ka ?  ki la kylli ïa u .

translation.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei na kita kiba la shong bam kiba la sngewthuh balei U Jisu u la ong ïa kane ha u .

translation.en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la pynïap ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki la pynlong syiem u Josaïah u khun jong u .

translation.en: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot , the mistress of witchcrafts , that selleth nations through her whoredoms , and families through her witchcrafts .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh , ka nuti la nang pynshitom . Kaba khring bad kaba dap da ki jingpynshohbieit kiba ma , ka la pynshohbieit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ka la ringmraw ïa ki .

translation.en: But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la sngap jar bad um ong shikyntien ruh . U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli biang ïa u ,  Hato me long U Messaïah , U Khun jong U Blei ba la kyrkhu ?

translation.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me , therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .
translation.kha: U shahshkor ïa nga , man ka por ba nga khot kyrpad ïa u .

translation.en: What hast thou here ? and whom hast thou here , that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here , as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high , and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock ?
translation.kha: Me mut me dei uei ? Me don hok aïu ban shna ka jingtep ïa lade ha ka sharing mawsiang ?

translation.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar , or no ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong ngi ba ngi dei ban siew khajna sha u Patsha ka Hima Rom , ne kumno ?

translation.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop yn pynrem da U Blei bad yn pynïakhlad ïa ki na ki briew ki jong U Blei hi .

translation.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee ? And again , I will be to him a Father , and he shall be to me a Son ?
translation.kha: Namar U Blei um shym la ong ha uno uno na ki angel jong u ,  Me long u khun jong nga ; mynta ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .  Lymne U Blei um shym la ong shaphang uno uno u angel ,  Ngan long U Kpa u jong u bad un long u khun jong nga .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar , that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon .
translation.kha: Wat shna ïa ka duwan kaba don ki kyrdon kiba kiew sha ka ; lada phi leh kumta , phi pynpaw khlem akor ïa lade haba phi kiew ïa ki .

translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king had appointed , saying , Come to me again the third day .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien u Jeroboam bad ki paidbah baroh ki wan biang sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .

translation.en: That ye shall say , It is the sacrifice of the  Lord s  passover , who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt , when he smote the Egyptians , and delivered our houses . And the people bowed the head and worshipped .
translation.kha: Phin jubab , ‘ Ka long ka jingkñia jong ka Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , naba u la ïaid lait ïa ki ïing jong ki Israel ha ka ri Ijipt . U la pynïap ïa ki nong Ijipt , hynrei u la pyllait im ïa ngi .’   Ki Israel ki la dem khohsiew bad ki la mane .

translation.en: Just as a good father wishes the best for his children , our heavenly Father desires that we enjoy eternal happiness .
translation.kha: Kumba u kpa uba bha u kwah ïa kaba bha tam na ka bynta ki khun , u Kpa bneng jong ngi ruh u kwah ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingkmen bymjukut .

translation.en: At thy rebuke they fled  ; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away .
translation.kha: Haba me sneng ïa ki um , ki phet ; ki phet noh haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jingpyrta jong ka hukum jong me .

translation.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due , when it is in the power of thine hand to do it .
translation.kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba phi ïoh ka kabu , leh ïa kaba bha ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: And the west border was to the great sea , and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families .
translation.kha: kaba pynlong ïa ka pud sepngi . Hapoh kine ki pud sawdong ki shong ki sah ki briew kiba na ki longïing u Judah .

translation.en: And Jael went out to meet Sisera , and said unto him , Turn in , my lord , turn in to me  ; fear not . And when he had turned in unto her into the tent , she covered him with a mantle .
translation.kha: Ka Jael ka mih shabar ban ïakynduh ïa u Sisera bad ka ong ha u ,  Ale shapoh , kynrad ; wan sha ka dara jong nga . Wat sheptieng .  Kumta u leit shapoh , bad ka pynrieh ïa u hadien ka pyrda .

translation.en: And Rebekah arose , and her damsels , and they rode upon the camels , and followed the man : and the servant took Rebekah , and went his way .
translation.kha: Te ka Rebekka bad ki kynthei samla jong ka ki la dep khreh bad kiew ban shong halor ki ut ban leit bad u shakri jong u Abraham , bad ki ïamih lang baroh .

translation.en: But , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north , and from all the lands whither he had driven them : and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers .
translation.kha: Pynban , kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri bashatei bad na baroh kiwei pat ki ri ha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa ki . Ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri ka jong ki hi , sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Da kumta u Moses u ai ha ki Israel ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingrakhe ïa ka jinglehniam ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Even a child is known by his doings , whether his work be pure , and whether it be right .
translation.kha: Wat u khynnah u pynpaw ïa kaei kaba u long da kaei kaba u leh ; phi lah ban ong lada u long uba hok bad uba bha .

translation.en: And I myself also am persuaded of you , my brethren , that ye also are full of goodness , filled with all knowledge , able also to admonish one another .
translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong nga : Nga hi nga sngewskhem ba phi dap da ka jingbha , ba phi don ka jingtip baroh , bad ba phi lah ban hikai iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Keep silence before me , O islands  ; and let the people renew their strength : let them come near  ; then let them speak : let us come near together to judgment .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  To sngap jar bad to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki ri sha jngai bah ! To pynkhreh ban wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; phin ïoh ïa ka lad jong phi ban kren . To ngin ïawanlang ban rai mano ba dei .

translation.en: For the man was above forty years old , on whom this miracle of healing was shewed .
translation.kha: U briew ha kaba la leh ïa kane ka kambah ka jingpynkhiah u la palat sawphew snem ka rta .

translation.en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion , and shall flow together to the goodness of the  Lord  , for wheat , and for wine , and for oil , and for the young of the flock and of the herd : and their soul shall be as a watered garden  ; and they shall not sorrow any more at all .
translation.kha: Kin wan bad rwai da ka jingkmen ha u lum Seïon bad kin kmen ha ki jingai sngewbha jong nga — ki jingai sngewbha da u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ki jingai sngewbha da ki langbrot bad ki masi . Kin long kum ka kper bad la ai um bha ; kin don baroh kat kaba ki donkam .

translation.en: Their enemies also oppressed them , and they were brought into subjection under their hand .
translation.kha: Ki la shah banbeiñ ha ki nongshun jong ki bad ki la long nadong shadong hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong ki .

translation.en: We will become perfect humans just as Adam and Eve were before they sinned .
translation.kha: Ngin sa long ki briew kiba janai kum u Adam bad ka Im shuwa ba kin leh pop .

translation.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la lah ïap . U la khot ïa u rangbah shipai bad u la kylli ïa u la U Jisu u la lah ïap la slem .

translation.en: And Jacob said unto his father , I am Esau thy firstborn  ; I have done according as thou badest me : arise , I pray thee , sit and eat of my venison , that thy soul may bless me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nga dei u Iso u khun rangbah jong phi ; nga la leh kumba phi la bthah ïa nga . Sngewbha khie shong , bad bam khyndiat na kane ka doh kaba nga la wallam ïa phi , ba phin ïoh ai ha nga ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong phi .

translation.en: And these things will they do unto you , because they have not known the Father , nor me .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin leh ïa kine kiei kiei ïa phi namar ba kim pat ithuh ïa U Kpa lymne ïa nga .

translation.en: And Shaaraim , and Adithaim , and Gederah , and Gederothaim  ; fourteen cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Shaaraim , ka Adithaim , ka Gederah , bad ka Gederothaim : khatsaw tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits : every hand of the wicked shall come upon him .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingkiew rasong ka jingjop jong u , pynban ka jingkhia jong ka jingjynjar kan ban halor jong u .

translation.en: Let us go up against Judah , and vex it , and let us make a breach therein for us , and set a king in the midst of it , even the son of Tabeal :
translation.kha: Ki la thmu ban hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ban pyntieng ïa ki briew ban ïasoh ha ka liang jong ki , bad nangta ban buh ïa u khun jong u Tabeel halor ka khet .

translation.en: All unrighteousness is sin : and there is a sin not unto death .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jingleh bymdei ki long ka pop , hynrei ka don ka pop ka bym ïalam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: In the fear of the  Lord  is strong confidence : and his children shall have a place of refuge .
translation.kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka wanrah ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingshngain ïa u briew bad ïa ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the  Lord  : it was the priests .
translation.kha: Ïa ka pisa ba la ai na ka bynta ki jingainguh ba hap siew pat    bad na ka bynta ki jingkñia pop ym shym thep ha ka synduk ; ka dei ka jong ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth .
translation.kha: Bad ka long kaba bha tam ban nang ïa kane ka jingïaishah ha ka jinglong samla jong ngi .

translation.en: But a lover of hospitality , a lover of good men , sober , just , holy , temperate ;
translation.kha: U dei ban long uba lehsbun bad uba ieit ïa kaei kaba bha . U dei ban long uba synshar ïa lade , uba beit , u bakhuid , bad uba leh ryntih .

translation.en: Joseph is a fruitful bough , even a fruitful bough by a well  ; whose branches run over the wall :
translation.kha: U Joseph u long kum u kada khlaw harud ka umpohliew u khun kada khlaw ha sharing lum .

translation.en: And he said , Thou shalt no more rejoice , O thou oppressed virgin , daughter of Zidon : arise , pass over to Kittim  ; there also shalt thou have no rest .
translation.kha: Ko ka nongbah Sidon , ka jingkmen jong pha ka la kut , bad ki briew jong pha ki shah banbeiñ . Wat la kin lait phet sha Sypros , pynban kin ym pat lait na ka jingma .

translation.en: But thou , O  Lord  , knowest me : thou hast seen me , and tried mine heart toward thee : pull them out like sheep for the slaughter , and prepare them for the day of slaughter .
translation.kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me ithuh ïa nga ; me ïohi kaei ba nga leh , bad kumno nga la ieit ïa me . To paring sharud ïa kine ki rangbah basniew kum ïa ki langbrot ki ban shah ot doh ; to sumar ïa ki tad haduh ba ka dei ka por ïa ki ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin , to separate himself thence in the midst of the people .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sdang ban mihnoh na Jerusalem bad ban leit sha ka thain Benjamin ban leit shim ïa ka bynta jong nga na ka nongkynti ka longïing .

translation.en: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication , and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication .
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh awria bad ka , bad ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki la buaid na kaba dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka jingawria jong ka .

translation.en: And his servants came near , and spake unto him , and said , My father , if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing , wouldest thou not have done it ? how much rather then , when he saith to thee , Wash , and be clean ?
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki leit sha u , bad ki ong ,  Ko kynrad , lada u nongïathuhlypa u la phah ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba jwat , phin jin da la leh ïa ka . Mynta balei phim shu sait ïa lade , kumba u ong bad ban ïohkhiah ?

translation.en: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it , as the shaking of an olive tree , two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough , four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof , saith the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Tang khyndiat ki briew kin lait im , bad ka Israel kan long kum u dieng Olib na kaba la kheit lut ïa ki soh Olib lait noh ar ne lai tylli kiba ha kliar eh , lane khyndiat kiba la iehnoh ha ki tnat kiba shapoh . Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .

translation.en: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob , and the mercy to Abraham , which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old .
translation.kha: Men pyn-i ïa ka jingïaineh jong me bad ka jingieit baneh ha la ki briew , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham bad jong u Jakob , kumba me la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi la slem bah .

translation.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the  Lord  of hosts in the land of Egypt : for they shall cry unto the  Lord  because of the oppressors , and he shall send them a saviour , and a great one , and he shall deliver them .
translation.kha: Kin long ka dak jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ha Ijipt . Haba ïa ki briew hangta la banbeiñ bad ki la kyang jam sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , un phah ïa uno uno ban pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner , and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka bapra jong ki nongbah , ki khunlangbrot kin bam phlang bad ki blang samla kin shem ka jaka bam phlang .

translation.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster .
translation.kha: U briew uba jaipdeh u long uba sniew kum uno uno uba pynjot .

translation.en: And the multitude said , This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee .
translation.kha: Une u long uta U Jisu u nongïathuhlypa , uba na Nasareth ha Galilaïa ,  ki paidbah ki la jubab .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God , and do it .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong nga ki long kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka .

translation.en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee , and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee , and thou shalt find them no more at all .
translation.kha: Ki nongkhaïi ki ong ha ka ,  Baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba pha la angnud ban ïoh ki la jah noh , bad baroh ka spah jong pha bad ka rong phong jong pha ki la leit noh , phan ym shem shuh ïa ki !

translation.en: And the man , the master of the house , went out unto them , and said unto them , Nay , my brethren , nay , I pray you , do not so wickedly  ; seeing that this man is come into mine house , do not this folly .
translation.kha: Hynrei u tymmen u mih shabar bad u ong ha ki ,  Em , ko paralok jong nga ! Sngewbha ! Wat leh kaba kum kata ka kam bymman , ka kam bakhlemrain ! Une u briew u long uba nga la khot sngewbha .

translation.en: And many spread their garments in the way : and others cut down branches off the trees , and strawed them in the way .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la siang ïa ki jaiñkup ha lynti . Katba kiwei pat ki dang ïa-ot ïa ki tnat dieng ha ki lyngkha bad ki la siang ïa ki ha ka lynti .

translation.en: Delivering thee from the people , and from the Gentiles , unto whom now I send thee ,
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ki paid Israel bad na ki Jentil sha kiba ngan phah ïa me .

translation.en: Hearken to me , ye that follow after righteousness , ye that seek the  Lord  : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn , and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ;  To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba kwah ban ïoh jingim , phi kiba wan sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap . Puson halor u mawsiang na uba phi la wan , ka par maw na kaba la tih ïa phi .

translation.en: When he giveth quietness , who then can make trouble ? and when he hideth his face , who then can behold him ? whether it be done against a nation , or against a man only :
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u rai ban nym leh ei ei ruh , ym don uno uno uba lah ban wad daw ïa u . Lada u buhrieh ïa ka khmat jong u , ki briew kin long kiba khlem ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: But if ye believe not his writings , how shall ye believe my words ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ba phim ngeit ïa kaei kaba u la thoh , kumno phi lah ban ngeit ïa kaei kaba nga ong ?

translation.en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings , and mounted up from the earth in my sight : when they went out , the wheels also were beside them , and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the  Lord s  house  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
translation.kha: Ki pynpyiar la ki thapniang bad kiew shajrong na ka khyndew katba nga dang peit ïa ki , bad ki shalyntem ki bud lang ïa ki . Ki sangeh shiphang ha ka phalor kaba shaphang mihngi ka Templ , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ka shong halor jong ki .

translation.en: And fields shall be bought in this land , whereof ye say , It is desolate without man or beast  ; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba kane ka ri kan long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba ki briew lymne ki mrad kin im , bad ba ïa ka yn ai noh sha ki nong Babilonia . Hynrei ïa ki lyngkha yn sa thied pat ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families  ; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast .
translation.kha: Ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang shi bynta ka jaka kumba la batai harum : Ka ri ka kynjoh shathie sha ka tduh eh kaba shathie jong ka ri khlaw Sin , ha ka pud jong ka Edom .

translation.en: I rose up to open to my beloved  ; and my hands dropped with myrrh , and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh , upon the handles of the lock .
translation.kha: Ka shadem jong phi ka long kum ki khiat , ki ar tylli ki skei synrap kiba bam jingbam hapdeng ki  tiew lili .

translation.en: We heard him say , I will destroy this temple that is made with hands , and within three days I will build another made without hands .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ba u ong , ‘ Ngan pynjot ïa kane ka Templ kaba ki briew ki la tei , bad hadien lai sngi ngan tei ïa kawei pat kaba ym shym la shna da ki briew’

translation.en: Tarry this night , and it shall be in the morning , that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman , well  ; let him do the kinsman s part : but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee , then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee , as the  Lord  liveth : lie down until the morning .
translation.kha: Sah hangne baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por mynstep ngin sa wad la un shim jingkitkhlieh ne em na ka bynta jong phi . Lada ka long kumta , ka la bha ; lada kam long kumta , te nga smai ha U  Trai  Uba im ba ngan shim ïa ka jingkitkhlieh . Mynta to thiah bad sah hangne haduh mynstep .

translation.en: Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us : if we hear the voice of the  Lord  our God any more , then we shall die .
translation.kha: Hynrei balei ngin shu ïap ei ? Kata ka ding kaba ishyrkhei kan thang duh ïa ngi . Khlem pep ngin ïap lada ngi ïohsngew biang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u kren .

translation.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la king kumba san ne hynriew kilomitar haba ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïaid halor ka um , u la nang wan sha jan ka lieng , bad ki la sngewtriem .

translation.en: Did you buy me anything ?
translation.kha: Phi thied eiei ianga ?

translation.en: Every valley shall be exalted , and every mountain and hill shall be made low : and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough places plain :
translation.kha: To pyndap ha man la ka jaka them ; to pynmadan ïa man la u lumbah , ki lumrit ki kylla madan , bad ïa ki jaka khohruh khohram yn pynjlih .

translation.en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you ; though the more abundantly I love you , the less I be loved .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewkmen ban pynlut baroh kaba nga don , bad ïa lade ruh , khnang ban ïoh ïarap ïa phi . Hato phin ieit duna ïa nga namar ba nga ieit palat ïa phi ?

translation.en: And the land of the Giblites , and all Lebanon , toward the sunrising , from Baal–gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath .
translation.kha: ka ri jong ki Gebal , ka Lebanon baroh shaphang mihngi , naduh Baalgad , kaba don shaphang shathie jong u Lum Hermon , haduh ka Khim Hamath .

translation.en: Thou , O  Lord  , remainest for ever  ; thy throne from generation to generation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long u syiem junom , bad men synshar sha kaba kut ka por .

translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven kine , fatfleshed and well favoured  ; and they fed in a meadow :
translation.kha: haba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki la wan mih na ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .

translation.en: And the damsel s father shall say unto the elders , I gave my daughter unto this man to wife , and he hateth her  ;
translation.kha: U kpa jong kata ka briew un ong ha ki , ‘ Nga la ai ïa la ka khun ha une u briew ban long ka tnga jong u , bad mynta um mon shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble , Come thou , and reign over us .
translation.kha: Kumta te ki dieng baroh ki ong ha u dieng shiah , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’

translation.en: And , behold , the angel that talked with me went forth , and another angel went out to meet him ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba la lah kren ha nga ba u jam sha khmat bad ba uwei pat u angel u la wan ban ïashem ïa u .

translation.en: But if a man walk in the night , he stumbleth , because there is no light in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u ïaid ha ka por mynmiet u jynthut , namar um don ka jingshai .

translation.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked , and all the brown in the flock of Laban  ; and he put his own flocks by themselves , and put them not unto Laban s cattle .
translation.kha: U Jakob u buh pynkhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang bad u pynphai ïa ki khmat jong ki sha kito kiba thohshuid bad kiba ïong na ka kynhun u Laban . Ha kane ka rukom u pynroi ïa la ka kynhun jingri bad u buh pynkhlad ïa ki na ka jong u Laban .

translation.en: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , Two measures of barley for a shekel , and a measure of fine flour for a shekel , shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria :
translation.kha: U Elisha u la ïathuh ha u syiem ba ha kaba kum kata ka por ha ka sngi kaba bud lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli yn die ha Samaria ha ka dor shi sbai rupa ,

translation.en: And I will bring you in unto the land , concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob  ; and I will give it you for an heritage : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular skhem ban ai ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob ; bad ngan ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka nongkynti jong phi hi . Nga long U  Trai .’

translation.en: Or for a ram , thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil .
translation.kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u langbrot , ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad shi litar shiteng ka umphniang Olib dei ban ai kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar shiteng ka waiñ .

translation.en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time , and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit , that thou be not inhabited  ; and I shall set glory in the land of the living  ;
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa pha sha trai jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap ban pynïasoh bad ki briew kiba shong ha ki por mynbarim . Ngan pynlong ïa pha ba phan shong ha kata ka pyrthei kaba shapoh ka khyndew hapdeng ki jingjot bymjukut , ban ïadon lang bad kiba ïap . Namarkata phan ym lah shuh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba im .

translation.en: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully : over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler , and Shimei his brother was the next .
translation.kha: bad ki buh ïa ki jingai baroh bad kawei-na-kaba-shiphew hangta ban shngain . Ki thung ïa u Lebi uba kyrteng u Konanaïah ban peit bad ki pynlong ïa u para jong u , u Shimei kum u nongïarap lem jong u .

translation.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families : and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid :
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba lai la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun . Ka jaka kaba ki la ïohpdiang ka kot haduh Sarid .

translation.en: And when thou hast stayed three days , then thou shalt go down quickly , and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand , and shalt remain by the stone Ezel .
translation.kha: La shi sngi , ka jingbymdon jong phi kan kham paw shuh shuh ; te leit hiar sha kato ka jaka ha kaba phi rieh mynshuwa ; bad rieh ha lyndet ka kynton maw hangto .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto her ,  If thou knewest the gift of God , and who it is that saith to thee , Give me to drink  ; thou wouldest have asked of him , and he would have given thee living water .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Lada pha tang shu la tip ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ai bad uei uta uba pan umdih na pha , phan jin da la pan na u , bad u un jin da la ai ha pha ïa ka um kaba ai jingim .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u shakri U  Trai  , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .

translation.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread : ( thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days , as I commanded thee , in the time appointed of the month Abib  ; for in it thou camest out from Egypt : and none shall appear before me empty : )
translation.kha: Ha u bnai Abib , u bnai ha uba phi la mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , rakhe ïa Ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ha ka rukom kaba nga la hukum ïa phi . Ha ki hynñiew sngi jong kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , wat bam ïa uno uno u kpu ba la khleh thiat . Wat ju wan mane ïa nga khlem da wallam kano kano ka jingainguh .

translation.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things , from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses .
translation.kha: Ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip , ko ki para Israel jong nga , bad ka long lyngba U Jisu ba ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingmap ïa ki pop la ïalap ha phi ; bad ba ïa uwei uwei baroh uba ngeit ha u la pyllait na ki pop baroh na kiba ka Hukum u Moses kam lah ban pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: Then the five men departed , and came to Laish , and saw the people that were therein , how they dwelt careless , after the manner of the Zidonians , quiet and secure  ; and there was no magistrate in the land , that might put them to shame in any thing  ; and they were far from the Zidonians , and had no business with any man .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki rangbah san ngut ki mihnoh bad ki leit sha ka shnong Laish . Ki ïohi kumno ki briew hangta ki ïashong shngain , kumba long ki nong Sidon . Ki long kiba ïashongsuk bad ki briew kiba jar jar , kim don jingïania badno badno ; ki don lut kat kaba ki donkam . Ki shong kham jngai na ki nong Sidon bad kim pynïadei bad kiwei ki briew .

translation.en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel  ; so that they shall not say , This is Jezebel .
translation.kha: Ïa kaba sah jong ka yn pynsaphriang hangta kum ka jakhlia , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano uba lah ithuh ïa ki .’

translation.en: But he said , Then bring meal . And he cast it into the pot  ; and he said , Pour out for the people , that they may eat . And there was no harm in the pot .
translation.kha: U Elisha u pan khyndiat u  purew , u ber ïa u ha uta u khiew , bad u ong ,  To theh kham bun ka syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .  Bad kam shym don kano kano kaba sniew ha ka .

translation.en: And I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came four chariots out from between two mountains  ; and the mountains were mountains of brass .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh sa kawei pat ka jingïohipaw . Ha kane ka por nga la ïohi saw tylli ki kali ïapom kiba wan mih napdeng ki ar tylli ki lumbah rnong .

translation.en: The king said moreover to Shimei , Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to , that thou didst to David my father : therefore the  Lord  shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head  ;
translation.kha: Me tip biang biang ïa ka jingleh bakla baroh kaba me la leh ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa me namar kata .

translation.en: But this I confess unto thee , that after the way which they call heresy , so worship I the God of my fathers , believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets :
translation.kha: Nga phla ïa kane ha me : Nga mane ïa U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi da kaba bud ïa kata ka Lynti ïa kaba ki ong ba ka long kaba bakla . Hynrei nga ruh nga ngeit ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses bad ha ki kitab jong ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And he smote them from Aroer , even till thou come to Minnith , even twenty cities , and unto the plain of the vineyards , with a very great slaughter . Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U jop thiaw da kaba pynïap ïa ki naduh Aroer haduh ka thain Minnith , baroh ki long arphew tylli ki nongbah , bad haduh Abel Keramim . Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew kaba jur , bad ki Ammon ki shahjop ha ki Israel .

translation.en: Simon Peter , a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ , to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Na u Simon Petros , u shakri bad u Apostol jong U Jisu Khrist — Sha kito ha kiba da ka hok jong U Blei jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim la ai ïa ka jingngeit kaba kordor kum ka jong ngi :

translation.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth , and thou hearest the sound thereof , but canst not tell whence it cometh , and whither it goeth : so is every one that is born of the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ka lyer ka beh kat sha kaba ka mon ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba ka pynmih , hynrei mem tip nangno ba ka wan lane shaei ba ka leit . Ka long kumta ïa uwei pa uwei ïa uba la kha na U Mynsiem .

translation.en: Behold , a king shall reign in righteousness , and princes shall rule in judgment .
translation.kha: Kan don ka sngi ha kaba yn don u syiem u ban synshar ha ka jinglong ba-beit , bad ki nongïalam ka ri ki ban synshar ha ka jinglehhok .

translation.en: And they , continuing daily with one accord in the temple , and breaking bread from house to house , did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart ,
translation.kha: Na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat ki ju ïakynduh kum ka kynhun hapoh ka Templ , bad ki ïabam jingbam lang ha ki ïing jong ki , ki da bam da ka dohnud kaba kmen bad kaba sngewrit ,

translation.en: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet , and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin , which was by the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: u la hukum ba yn tied ïa nga bad ban pyndait kynjri hajan ka Khyrdop Benjamin bashaneng hapoh ka Templ .

translation.en: Behold , my belly is as wine which hath no vent  ; it is ready to burst like new bottles .
translation.kha: Lada ngam ïoh ïa ka lad ban kren , ngan sa bthei kum ka lwa snieh kaba dap da ka waiñ bathymmai .

translation.en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven : they pursued us upon the mountains , they laid wait for us in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Kham stet ban ïa ki pukni kiba suh wia na sahit bneng , ki beh kthong ïa ngi sha tbian . Ki lap ïa ngi ha ki lumrit ; ki kurup ïa ngi ha ka jingkyndit ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it , when ye have heaved from it the best of it : neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel , lest ye die .
translation.kha: Haba phi la wanrah ïa kaba bha tam sha U  Trai  , phim long kiba shah rem haba phi bam ïa ka . Hynrei da sumar ban ym pyntngit ïa ki jingai kiba khuid jong ki Israel da kaba bam ïa kino kino ki jingai shuwa kaba ai ïa kaba bha tam . Lada phi leh kumta , yn pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: They have built also the high places of Baal , to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal , which I commanded not , nor spake it , neither came it into my mind :
translation.kha: bad ki la tei ki duwan ïa u Baal khnang ban thang ïa ki khun jong ki ha ka ding kum ki jingkñia . Ngam ju hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ; kam shym rung hi ruh ha ka jingpyrkhat jong nga .

translation.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah , and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication , and compelled Judah thereto .
translation.kha: U la tei wat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ha ki ri lum Judia bad u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation , We have sworn unto them by the  Lord  God of Israel : now therefore we may not touch them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki jubab ,  Ngi la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang jong ngi ha ki ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel . Mynta ngim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa ki .

translation.en: Their webs shall not become garments , neither shall they cover themselves with their works : their works are works of iniquity , and the act of violence is in their hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingïasylla jong phi kim wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa phi — ki long bymlarkam kum ka jaiñphong ba la thain da ka snur thapbawa !

translation.en: Oil for the light , spices for anointing oil , and for sweet incense ,
translation.kha: ka umphniang ïa ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingthang iwbih ;

translation.en: When the Philistines took the ark of God , they brought it into the house of Dagon , and set it by Dagon .
translation.kha: nangta ki leit rah ïa ka sha ka templ u blei jong ki , u Dagon , bad ki buh ïa ka ha syndah u mot jong u .

translation.en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent unto them Peter and John :
translation.kha: Ki apostol ha Jerusalem ki la ïohsngew ba ki nong Samaria ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei , kumta ki la phah ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis sha ki .

translation.en: And the spirit cried , and rent him sore , and came out of him : and he was as one dead  ; insomuch that many said , He is dead .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la lynñiar , u la pynring kyrthat jur ïa u khynnah , bad u la mihnoh . U khynnah u la i kum uba ïap , bad baroh ki la ïa-ong ,  U la ïap !

translation.en: Redeeming the time , because the days are evil .
translation.kha: To pyndonkam bha ïa ki kabu baroh ba phi ïoh , namar kine ki long ki sngi kiba sniew .

translation.en: Jesus therefore , knowing all things that should come upon him , went forth , and said unto them ,  Whom seek ye ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaei baroh ka ban sa jia ïa u , kumta u la tur sha khmat bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ïano phi ïawad ?

translation.en: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the veil :
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka duwan ksiar hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha khmat ka pyrda ,

translation.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind , called Euroclydon .
translation.kha: Hynrei shen ka lyer kaba jur — kata kaba la khot ka lyer  Shatei-lam-mihngi  — ka la beh na ka dewlynnong .

translation.en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of your words , and was wroth , and sware , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong phi bad u la bitar lep , bad kumta da kaba sngewkhia u ong ,

translation.en: And Jesus answering them said ,  Have ye not read so much as this , what David did , when himself was an hungred , and they which were with him  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Hato phim shym la pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh mynba ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan ?

translation.en: These are the sons of Bilhah , which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter , and she bare these unto Jacob : all the souls were seven .
translation.kha: Kine hynñiew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Bilhah kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .

translation.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death .
translation.kha: Ka spah ba phi ïoh da ka jingbymhok shen kan jah noh ; hynrei ym ha shuwa ba kan ïalam ïa phi sha ki tyngam jong ka jingïap .

translation.en: And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Skin for skin , yea , all that a man hath will he give for his life .
translation.kha: U Soitan u jubab ,  U briew un iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh tang ban pynsah ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , Abner took him , and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand .
translation.kha: Kumta ynda u Dabid u wan phai sha ka jaka sher dara na kaba pynïap ïa u Goliath , u Abner u ïalam ïa u sha u Saul . U Dabid u dang rah hi ïa ka khlieh u Goliath .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Son of man , mark well , and behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the  Lord  , and all the laws thereof  ; and mark well the entering in of the house , with every going forth of the sanctuary .
translation.kha: Nga la dem pyllup ha ka khyndew , bad U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,  Ko khun u briew , shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh ba me ïohi bad ïohsngew . Ngan ïathuh ïa me ïa ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ka Templ . Khmih bha ïa kiba kumno ki briew la shah ban leit shapoh bad mih shabar ka Templ bad ïa kiba kumno ki briew ym shah .

translation.en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah , and troubled them in building ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri ki pyrshang ban pynduh mynsiem bad pyntieng ïa ki Jiw bad ban khanglad ïa ka jingtrei .

translation.en: For so the  Lord  said unto me , I will take my rest , and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs , and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan jngoh sha tbian na bneng kumba ka umjer ka wandur jar jar ha ki miet basyiad ha ka aïom ot , kumba ka sngi ka phyrnai itynnat ha ka jingshit ka sngi .

translation.en: And God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingud jong ki ka kiew sha U Blei , uba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud jong ki bad kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .

translation.en: When Jacob was come into Egypt , and your fathers cried unto the  Lord  , then the  Lord  sent Moses and Aaron , which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt , and made them dwell in this place .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob bad ka ïing jong u ki leit sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Ijipt ki banbeiñ ïa ki , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki kyang ban ïoh jingïarap sha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba la wan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad pynshong pynsah ïa ki ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: And when they had fasted and prayed , and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .
translation.kha: Ki la shahjingit bad ki la duwai , ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , bad ki la phah noh ïa ki .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumta u shah ïa ki Midian ban synshar ïa ki haduh hynñiew snem .

translation.en: And there were also sodomites in the land : and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Kaba kham sniew ïa baroh , ka long ba don ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba shakri kum ki nuti ha kita ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki paid Judah ki la leh ïa kine ki kam kiba ilehrain ba ju leh da kito ki briew ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Israel ki dang leit kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the  Lord  turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath , wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah , because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka jingbitar shla U  Trai  la pynkhih pyrshah ïa ka Judah da kaei kaba u syiem Manasseh u la leh , bad wat mynta ruh kam shym la duh noh .

translation.en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim : therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land , save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance .
translation.kha: U Moses u la dep ai ïa ka ri ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ha kiwei pat ki ar jait bad shiteng jong kawei jait . ( Ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Joseph la bynta ha ki ar jait : Manasseh bad Ephraim . ) Wat la katta , u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka bynta jong ka jaka ïa ki Lebi . Tangba , ki la ïoh ïa ki nongbah ban shong ban sah , lem bad ki pyntha na ka bynta ki jingri jong ki .

translation.en: Who concerning the truth have erred , saying that the resurrection is past already ; and overthrow the faith of some .
translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti ka jingshisha bad pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingngeit jong ki katto katne ki bangeit da kaba ong ba ka jingpynmihpat ïa ngi ka la dep jia .

translation.en: So shall it be at the end of the world : the angels shall come forth , and sever the wicked from among the just ,
translation.kha: Kan long kumne ha kaba kut ka Ïa : ki angel kin mihnoh ban lumlang ïa ki briew kiba sniew napdeng kiba bha

translation.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand , and laid it upon Ephraim s head , who was the younger , and his left hand upon Manasseh s head , guiding his hands wittingly  ; for Manasseh was the firstborn .
translation.kha: U Jakob u phna ïa la ki kti bad u buh ïa ka kti kamon ha ka khlieh u Ephraim , wat la u long uba kham rit , bad ïa ka kti kadiang ha ka khlieh u Manasseh , uba kham san .

translation.en: Then he shall minister in the name of the  Lord  his God , as all his brethren the Levites do , which stand there before the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad u lah ban shakri hangta kum u lyngdoh jong U  Trai  U Blei jong u , kum kiwei pat ki Lebi kiba ïashakri hangta .

translation.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity .
translation.kha: Un shongkurim ïa ka theisotti ,

translation.en: After these things , and the establishment thereof , Sennacherib king of Assyria came , and entered into Judah , and encamped against the fenced cities , and thought to win them for himself .
translation.kha: Hadien kine ki jingjia , ha kaba u syiem Hesekaïah u la ïaineh ha ka jingshakri ïa U  Trai  , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . U kerkut ïa ki nongbah ba la tei kynroh bad u ai ki hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban pynpra ïa ka lynti lyngba ki kynroh .

translation.en: For my mouth shall speak truth  ; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips .
translation.kha: Kat kaba nga kren ka dei ka jingshisha , ha nga ki ktien lamler ki long kiba ijli .

translation.en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel , so that they lifted up their heads no more . And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Midian ki la shahjop ha ki Israel bad kim shym long shuh ka jingma ïa ki . Ka ri ka la don ha ka jingsuk haduh sawphew snem , haduh ba u Gideon u ïap .

translation.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven , but he that came down from heaven , even the Son of man which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba la ju leit kiew sha bneng lait tang U Khun U Briew , uba la wan hiar na bneng .

translation.en: Hast thou not known ? hast thou not heard , that the everlasting God , the  Lord  , the Creator of the ends of the earth , fainteth not , neither is weary ? there is no searching of his understanding .
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ? Phim pat ïohsngew ? U  Trai  u long U Blei bymjukut ; u thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh . Um ju sngewthait ne sngewlwait . Ym don uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong u

translation.en: So she gleaned in the field until even , and beat out that she had gleaned : and it was about an ephah of barley .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka ïai tam kew ha ka lyngkha haduh janmiet , bad haba ka la shoh ïa u , ka shem ba ka la ïohlum la jan shiphew kilo .

translation.en: Neither murmur ye , as some of them also murmured , and were destroyed of the destroyer .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban khñium , kumba don na ki , kiba la khñium — bad la pynjot ïa ki da u Angel ka Jingïap .

translation.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague , and shut up it that hath the plague seven days :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bha ïa ka , bad un buh kyrpang ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh haduh hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: So David s young men turned their way , and went again , and came and told him all those sayings .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki leit phai noh bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Nabal u la lah ong .

translation.en: And Jehu sent through all Israel : and all the worshippers of Baal came , so that there was not a man left that came not . And they came into the house of Baal  ; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another .
translation.kha: La pynlong ka jingpynbna bad u Jehu u phah ktien ha kylleng ka ri Israel . Baroh kiba mane ïa u Baal ki la wan ; ym don uwei ruh na ki uba pep . Baroh ki leit rung ha ka templ u Baal , da kaba pyndap ïa ka na kut ha kut .

translation.en: So they laid hands on her  ; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king s house , they slew her there .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ka , ki ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem , bad hangta ha ka Khyrdop Kulai ki pynïap ïa ka .

translation.en: ( Matthew 15 :30 , 31  ; John 5 :28 ) After Jesus died , God restored him to life as a spirit person .
translation.kha: ( Mathaios 15 :30 , 31 ; Ioannis 5 :28 ) Hadien ba u Jisu u la ïap , U Blei u la ai biang ha u ïa ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: But he refused , and said unto his master s wife , Behold , my master wotteth not what is with me in the house , and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand  ;
translation.kha: U la kyrngah bad u ong ha ka ,  Ha khmih , u kynrad jong nga um donkam ban pynkhuslai shuh shaphang ïa lade bad kano kano ka kam hapoh ïing , namar nga don hangne .

translation.en: For ye suffer , if a man bring you into bondage , if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself , if a man smite you on the face .
translation.kha: Phi ïaishah ïa uno uno uba hukum ïa phi lane uba shim kabu ïa phi lane uba riam pah lane uba peit poh ïa phi lane uba thab ïa phi ha ka ngab .

translation.en: Samaria shall become desolate  ; for she hath rebelled against her God : they shall fall by the sword : their infants shall be dashed in pieces , and their women with child shall be ripped up .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Samaria yn pynshitom namar ka ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki briew jong ka kin ïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki khunlung yn bret sha madan , ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun yn patar .

translation.en: And Barak said unto her , If thou wilt go with me , then I will go : but if thou wilt not go with me , then I will not go .
translation.kha: U Barak u jubab ,  Ngan leit lada phin leit ryngkat bad nga ; hynrei lada phim leit bad nga , nga ruh ngan ym leit .

translation.en: Which were cut down out of time , whose foundation was overflown with a flood :
translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba ka por jong ki kan wan , ki la shah rong noh da ka jingshlei .

translation.en: And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Ngam pat shym la tip hi ba u dei ma u , hynrei U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis da ka um , u la ong ha nga , ‘ Men sa ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar bad u shongsah ha u briew ; u dei uta , uba pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .’

translation.en: For wisdom is better than rubies  ; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it .
translation.kha: Nga long ka Jingstad , nga kham kordor ban ïa ki mawlynnai ; baroh kaba phi angnud kam lah ban ïanujor bad nga .

translation.en: But a certain Samaritan , as he journeyed , came where he was : and when he saw him , he had compassion on him ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u nong Samaria uba la leit jingleit na kata ka lynti u la wan lap ïa uta u briew , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei .

translation.en: And if the priest see that , behold , the scab spreadeth in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a leprosy .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u sa shisien , bad lada kata ka prum ka la pur , un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid ; ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner , because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joab bad u Abishai u para jong u ki la pynhiarkput ïa u Abner namar ka jingpynïap ïa u Asahel u hynmen u para jong ki ha ka thma ha Gibeon .

translation.en: And Adam was not deceived , but the woman being deceived was in the transgression .
translation.kha: Bad ym dei u Adam uba la shah shukor ; dei ka kynthei kaba la shah shukor bad pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum U Blei .

translation.en: And he made haste , and came down , and received him joyfully .
translation.kha: U Sakhaïos u la hiar pynstet bad u la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingkmen kaba khraw .

translation.en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images , the star of your god , which ye made to yourselves .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , namar ba phi la mane ïa ki durblei jong u Sakkuth , u blei syiem jong phi , bad ïa u Kaiwan , u blei khlur jong phi , phin hap ban kit ïa kito ki durblei

translation.en: Now therefore give pledges , I pray thee , to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïathong bad phi ha ka kyrteng u patsha . Ngan ai ïa phi ar hajar tylli ki kulai lada phi lah ban shem katta ngut ki rangbah ki ban shong ha ki .

translation.en: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans : and thou shalt not escape out of their hand , but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon : and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire .
translation.kha: Te nga la ong shuh shuh ,  Ïa baroh ki kynthei bad ki khun jong phi , yn rah noh sha ki nong Babilonia , bad ma phi ruh ïa lade phin ym lait na ki . Yn sa ïalam ïa phi kum u koidi da u syiem ka Babilonia , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn sa thang lut khoit .

translation.en: Yea , ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch , and the star of your god Remphan , figures which ye made to worship them : and I will carry you away beyond Babylon .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka ïingjaiñ jong u blei Molekh uba phi la bah , bad ka dur jong u Rephan , u blei khlur jong phi ; ki la long ki bleithaw kiba phi la thaw ïa ka ban mane . Bad kumta ngan phah ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha palat ka Babilon .’

translation.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , saying , He hath spoken blasphemy  ; what further need have we of witnesses ? behold , now ye have heard his blasphemy .
translation.kha: Ha kane , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ bad u la ong ,  Ka jingkrenbeiñ blei ! Ngim donkam shuh bun ki sakhi ! Phi la dang shu ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ blei jong u !

translation.en: And nation was destroyed of nation , and city of city : for God did vex them with all adversity .
translation.kha: Kawei ka jaitbynriew ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , bad kawei ka nongbah ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pat ka nongbah , namar U Blei u wanrah ka jingjynjar bad jingshitom ha ki .

translation.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel .
translation.kha: U Solomon u long u syiem jong ki Israel baroh ,

translation.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah : the same is a great city .
translation.kha: bad ka Resen , kaba don hapdeng ka Ninebeh bad ka nongbah bakhraw ka Kalah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath blessed my master greatly  ; and he is become great : and he hath given him flocks , and herds , and silver , and gold , and menservants , and maidservants , and camels , and asses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa u kynrad jong nga bad u la pynlong ïa u , u briew uba riewspah . U la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad blang , ki masi , ka rupa , ka ksiar , ki mraw shynrang bad kynthei , ki ut bad ki kada .

translation.en: Have we not power to eat and to drink ?
translation.kha: Hato ngim don bor ban bam bad ban dih ?

translation.en: For if ye turn away from after him , he will yet again leave them in the wilderness  ; and ye shall destroy all this people .
translation.kha: Lada phi ki briew na ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad phi kyntait ban bud ïa u mynta , sa shisien un iehnoh ïa kine ki briew baroh ha ka ri khlaw , bad phin kitkhlieh ïa ka jingpynjot thiaw ïa ki .

translation.en: And when they were come to the multitude , there came to him a certain man , kneeling down to him , and saying ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan phai pat sha u paidbah , uwei u briew u la wan sha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u ,

translation.en: Greet Mary , who bestowed much labour on us .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa ka Mari , kaba la trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And above all these things put on charity , which is the bond of perfectness .
translation.kha: Bad nalor kine ki jinglong baroh , to bynrap ïa ka jingieit , kaba tehsong lang ïa kiei kiei baroh lang ha ka jingïatylli kaba janai .

translation.en: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the taches , that thou mayest bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony : and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy .
translation.kha: Wah ïa kata ka pyrda na ki jingpyndait kiba don hapoh tnum Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba don ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap buh ïa ka sha lyndet ka pyrda . Kata ka pyrda kan pynïakhlad ïa ka Jaka Kyntang na ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam .

translation.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof , wherewith they minister unto it :
translation.kha: Ka kamram ba ki Lebi ki don ka long tang ban shakri ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: But woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men : for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi khang ïa ka jingkhang sha ka Hima ki bneng na khmat ki briew , hynrei ma phi da lade hi phim leit rung shapoh , lymne ba phi shah shapoh ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban rung !

translation.en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore  ; for he offereth the bread of thy God : he shall be holy unto thee : for I the  Lord  , which sanctify you , am holy .
translation.kha: U paidbah u dei ban ñiew ba u lyngdoh u long uba khuid , namar u wallam ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga . Nga long U  Trai  ; nga long uba khuid , bad nga pynkyntang khuid ïa ki briew jong nga .
