translation.en: For thou shalt worship no other god : for the  Lord  , whose name is Jealous , is a jealous God :
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei , namar ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngam lah shah ïa kino kino ki ban ïakob ïa nga .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto him , This is the interpretation of it : The three branches are three days :
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  Kane ka mut kumne : kita ki tnat lai tylli ki long lai tylli ki sngi .

translation.en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat : and no man gave unto him .
translation.kha: U la kwah ban pynkdang ïa lade da ki jingbam ba bam ki sniang , hynrei ym don mano mano ba ai ei ei ïa u ban bam .

translation.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you : for whom he hath sent , him ye believe not .
translation.kha: Phim pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u lane phim pat ju ïohi ïa ka khmat jong u , bad phim ju sumar ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi , naba phim ngeit ha uta ïa uba u la phah .

translation.en: And immediately the man was made whole , and took up his bed , and walked : and on the same day was the sabbath .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la ïohkhiah , u la rah ïa la ka jingthiah bad u la sdang ban ïaid .

translation.en: And at that time came Joshua , and cut off the Anakims from the mountains , from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab , and from all the mountains of Judah , and from all the mountains of Israel : Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por u Joshua u la leit bad u pynduh khoit ïa ka jait ka kynja ki ramhah ba la khot kyrteng ki Anakim kiba shong basah ha ka ri lum — ha Hebron , Debir , Anab , bad ha baroh ka ri lum jong ka Judah bad ka Israel . U Joshua u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki .

translation.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him , they besought him that he would tarry with them : and he abode there two days .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ki nong Samaria ki la wan ha u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah bad ki , bad U Jisu u la sah hangta ar sngi .

translation.en: Should it be according to thy mind ? he will recompense it , whether thou refuse , or whether thou choose  ; and not I : therefore speak what thou knowest .
translation.kha: Te naba me pyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u leh , hato me khmih lynti ïa u ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ? Ka rai ka long ka jong me , kam dei ka jong nga ; ïathuh ïa ngi mynta kaei kaba me pyrkhat .

translation.en: For that ye ought to say , If the Lord will , we shall live , and do this , or that .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi dei ban ong ka long kane :  Lada U Trai u mon , ngin im bad ngin leh ïa kane lane ïa katai .

translation.en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him , and in an hour that he is not aware of ,
translation.kha: Nangta u kynrad jong uta u shakri un wan pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um tip .

translation.en: And when the men of Ai looked behind them , they saw , and , behold , the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven , and they had no power to flee this way or that way : and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki phai shadien , ki ïohi ïa ka tdem kaba kiew sha suiñbneng . Ym don lad shuh ba kin lait im , naba ki Israel kiba la phet sha ka jaka bashrah mynta ki phai kylla ban ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  to the men of Judah and Jerusalem , Break up your fallow ground , and sow not among thorns .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,  To lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ki bym pat ju lur ; wat bet ïa ki symbai jong phi hapdeng ki shiah .

translation.en: And if the ear shall say , Because I am not the eye , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?
translation.kha: Bad lada ka shkor kan ong ,  Namar ba ngam dei ka khmat , te ngam dei ka jong ka met ,  kata kam pynlong ïa ka , ba kam dei ka dkhot jong ka met .

translation.en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger  ; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction  ; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress .
translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym risa beiñ halor ka jingshem jynjar jong ki hynmen ki para jong pha ha Judah . Pha la dei ban ym lehkmen ha ka sngi ka jingpynjot ïa ki . Pha la dei ban ym rkhie ïa ki ha ka jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Lusias , u rangbah shipai u la tuklar bad u la knieh jubor ïa u na ngi .

translation.en: Came behind him , and touched the border of his garment : and immediately her issue of blood stanched .
translation.kha: Ka la wan ha u paidbah na shadien jong U Jisu bad ka la ktah ïa ka tduh ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka jingmihsnam jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon .

translation.en: Whether it be in the warp , or woof  ; of linen , or of woollen  ; whether in a skin , or in any thing made of skin  ;
translation.kha: lane ha kano kano ka lyngkhot jaiñ linen ne jaiñ  saiwul , lane ha ka snieh , lane ha kaei kaei kaba la shna da ka snieh ,

translation.en: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength , Israel burned none of them , save Hazor only  ; that did Joshua burn .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki Israel kim shym thang ïa kano kano na ki nongbah kiba la tei halor ki lumrit , lait tang ka Hasor , kaba u Joshua u la thang .

translation.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you , and ye shall bear the sins of your idols : and ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki ar ngut shi para — ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingleh awria bad ka pop jong ka jingmane bleithaw . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah : fear ye not .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga pynkhreh ban kyrkhu ïa ki paid ka Jerusalem bad Judah . Kumta wat sheptieng .

translation.en: And Jethro said , Blessed be the  Lord  , who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of Pharaoh , who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  uba la pyllait im ïa phi na u Pharaoh bad na ki nong Ijipt ! Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  uba la pyllait im ïa une u paidbah na ka jinglongmraw !

translation.en: And they cast out many devils , and anointed with oil many that were sick , and healed them .
translation.kha: Ki la beh noh bun ki ksuid , bad ki la tah umphniang Olib ha kiba bun ki briew kiba pang bad ki la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap , neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed : for it is a year of rest unto the land .
translation.kha: Wat ot ruh ïa u kew uba shu mih hi , bad wat kheit soh na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym la khyllad ; ka dei ka snem ban iehnoh shrah ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that the child died . And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead : for they said , Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spake unto him , and he would not hearken unto our voice : how will he then vex himself , if we tell him that the child is dead ?
translation.kha: Hadien shi taïew u khunlung u la ïap bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u ïa ka khubor . Ki ong ,  Mynba i khunlung i dang im , u Dabid um ju jubab ïa ngi haba ngi kren ïa u . Kumno ngin lah ban ïathuh ïa u ba i khun jong u i la ïap ? U lah ban pynmynsaw ïa lade !

translation.en: But now I go my way to him that sent me  ; and none of you asketh me , Whither goest thou ?
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ngan leit noh sha uta uba la phah ïa nga , pynban ym don uwei ruh na phi uba kylli ïa nga shaei ba ngan leit .

translation.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter , and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood : so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife .
translation.kha: Lada phi king kynruh ïa ka dud , ka pynmih makhon . Lada phi tied ïa ka khmut jongno jongno , ka pynmih snam . Lada phi pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar , phi ngat ha ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: If I do not the works of my Father , believe me not .
translation.kha: Wat ngeit ïa nga , namarkata , lada ngam leh ïa kiei kiei kiba U Kpa jong nga u kwah ïa nga ban leh .

translation.en: And when he had gone a little further thence , he saw James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , who also were in the ship mending their nets .
translation.kha: U la leit kham katto katne nangta bad u la ïohi ar ngut kiwei pat shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi . Ki don halor ka lieng jong ki ba ki dang ïapynbiang ïa ki jar jong ki .

translation.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite , he hardened his heart , and hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Pharaoh u ïohi ba kita ki jakoid ki la ïap , u la kylla mutlop biang , bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , u Pharaoh um shym la shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: Thus will I magnify myself , and sanctify myself  ; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations , and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ngan pyn-i ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ba nga long uba khraw bad uba khuid . Kin sa tip , te , ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints ; given to hospitality .
translation.kha: To ïasam lem ïa ki jingdon jong phi bad ki parabangeit kiba kyrduh , bad to pdiang sngewbha sha ki ïing jong phi ïa ki nongwei .

translation.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Shim ar tylli ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad thoh ha ki ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ,

translation.en: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard , thou shalt not glean it afterward : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .
translation.kha: Haba phi la lum ïa ki sohwaiñ shisien , wat leit biang sha ki dieng sohwaiñ sa shisien ; ki sohwaiñ kiba dang sah hangta ki dei ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .

translation.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor : but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment .
translation.kha: Ki lyngkha ba sah shrah ki lah ban pynmih shibun ka jingbam ïa kiba duk , hynrei ki bymhok kin shu ieh ïa kine khlem rep .

translation.en: And he gave some , apostles ; and some , prophets ; and some , evangelists ; and some , pastors and teachers ;
translation.kha: U la long ma u , uba  la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u bynriew ;  u la thung katto katne ngut ban long ki apostol ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïathuhlypa ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïalap ; ïa kiwei pat , ki nongsharai balang bad ki nonghikai .

translation.en: Fear before him , all the earth : the world also shall be stable , that it be not moved .
translation.kha: to kyiuh ha khmat jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah pynkhih shuh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was in a certain city , behold a man full of leprosy : who seeing Jesus fell on his face , and besought him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
translation.kha: Shisien U Jisu u la don ha kawei ka shnong ha kaba la don u briew uba la pang  ñiangthohlieh . Haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu u la pyndem khrup ïa lade ha madan bad u la kyrpad ïa u ,  Ko kynrad , lada me mon , me lah ban pynlong ïa nga uba khuid !

translation.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God  ; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant s house for a great while to come , and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O  Lord  God .
translation.kha: Pynban mynta me ïai leh shuh shuh ; me la pynlong ki kular na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wan , bad me , ko  Trai  U Blei , me la lah pynlong ïa nga kum u briew uba khraw .

translation.en: Be not among winebibbers  ; among riotous eaters of flesh :
translation.kha: Wat ïalang lok bad ki briew kiba kyrni dih waiñ lane bad kiba lalot jingbam .

translation.en: And he said ,  Of a truth I say unto you , that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all :
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Nga ong ha phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk ka la thep kham bun shah ban ïa kiwei .

translation.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head , and honour the face of the old man , and fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Pyni burom ïa ki briew ba la tymmen bad ai burom ïa ki . Da kaba tiengburom kohnguh ïa nga ; Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites : and I being few in number , they shall gather themselves together against me , and slay me  ; and I shall be destroyed , I and my house .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Simeon bad ha u Lebi ,  Phi la pynjynjar ïa nga ; ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad kat kiba don ha kane ka ri , mynta kin sa shun ïa nga . Ngam dei uba bun paid ; lada ki ïa-tylli lang kawei pyrshah ïa nga , bad ki ïaleh ïa nga , ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga baroh ngin sa shah pynjot .

translation.en: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta uba pynïasoh ïa lade sha U Trai u long kawei bad u ha kaba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man s wisdom , but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power :
translation.kha: Kumta haba nga la wan sha phi , nga la long uba tlot bad uba kyiuh baroh shi rynïeng da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka jinghikai bad ka khubor jong nga ym shym la pynïoh da ki ktien batbit jong ka jingstad briew , hynrei da ka jingpynshisha baskhem jong ka bor U Mynsiem U Blei .

translation.en: Then ye answered and said unto me , We have sinned against the  Lord  , we will go up and fight , according to all that the  Lord  our God commanded us . And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war , ye were ready to go up into the hill .
translation.kha: Te phi la jubab , ‘ Moses , ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Hynrei mynta ngin leit tur , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi .’ Nangta uwei pa uwei na phi u khreh ban ïaleh thma , u da tharai ba ka long kaba jem ban leit hiarthma ïa kata ka ri .

translation.en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled , and your agreement with hell shall not stand  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , then ye shall be trodden down by it .
translation.kha: Ka jingïateh kular kaba phi la pynlong bad ka jingïap yn pynduh , bad ïa ka jingïakut jong phi bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap yn pyndam noh . Haba ka jingjot ka sar , phin shahjop noh .

translation.en: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried , and the house was filled with smoke .
translation.kha: Ka jingsawa ka sur jong ki ka pynlong ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban khynñiuh , bad ka Templ hi ka kylla dap da ka tdem .

translation.en: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand  ; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers :
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jingleh myntor kiba phi pyndonkam bad ngan iehnoh ïa phi khlem ki nongkren byrtong .

translation.en: Then shall I not be ashamed , when I have respect unto all thy commandments .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynshahshkor ïa ki hukum jong me baroh , te yn ym buh ïa nga ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: Remove not the old landmark  ; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless :
translation.kha: Wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud uba rim lane knieh ïa ka khyndew ba long trai da ki khunswet .

translation.en: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers , and the wickedness of the kings of Judah , and the wickedness of their wives , and your own wickedness , and the wickedness of your wives , which they have committed in the land of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la klet ïa ki kam bymman baroh ïa kiba la leh ha ki shnong jong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem da ki kpa tymmen jong phi , da ki syiem ka Judah bad ki tnga jong ki , bad da ma phi bad ki tnga jong phi ?

translation.en: And he said unto him , Well , thou good servant : because thou hast been faithful in a very little , have thou authority over ten cities .
translation.kha: ‘ Me la lehbha ,’ u la ong ; ‘ me long u shakri uba bha ! Namar ba me long uba lah ban shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba rit , ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa ki shiphew tylli ki nongbah .’

translation.en: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh , as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nong Moab kin ym sngewbha ïa u blei Khemosh jong ki , kumba ki Israel kim sngewbha ïa u blei Bethel ha uba ki shaniah .

translation.en: And when they heard it , they were glad , and promised to give him money . And he sought how he might conveniently betray him .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewkmen ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u don ban ong , bad ki la kular ban ai pisa ïa u . Kumta u Judas u la sdang ban wad ïa ka lad kaba biang ban aiti noh ïa U Jisu sha ki .

translation.en: Therefore was the wrath of the  Lord  kindled against his people , insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki briew jong u ; u la sngewngiah ïa ki .

translation.en: And he shall have it , and his seed after him , even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood  ; because he was zealous for his God , and made an atonement for the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin bat ïa ka kam lyngdoh junom , namar ba um shym la shah ïa kiba ïakob bor bad nga bad ba u la wallam ka jingïohmap na ka bynta ka pop jong ki briew .

translation.en: He taught me also , and said unto me , Let thine heart retain my words : keep my commandments , and live .
translation.kha: I ju ong ,  Kynmaw bha ïa kaba nga ong bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano ruh . Leh kumba nga ong ïa phi , bad phin im .

translation.en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head , and the  Lord  shall reward thee .
translation.kha: Phin pynlong ïa u ba la thang da ka jinglehrain bad U  Trai  un ainong ïa phi .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the enemy hath said against you , Aha , even the ancient high places are ours in possession :
translation.kha: Ki nongshun ki Israel ki kren sarong bad ki ong , ‘ Mynta kito ki lum ba-mynhyndai ki long ki jong ngi !’

translation.en: And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel had appointed : but Samuel came not to Gilgal  ; and the people were scattered from him .
translation.kha: U la ap hynñiew sngi ïa u Samuel , kumba u Samuel u la bthah ïa u ban leh , hynrei u Samuel um pat shym wan poi sha Gilgal .

translation.en: And as for me also , mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity , but I will recompense their way upon their head .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym isynei ïa ki , Ngan leh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma ki , ki la leh ïa kiwei .

translation.en: Comfort your hearts , and stablish you in every good word and work .
translation.kha: un pynshlur ïa phi bad pynshaitbor ïa phi ban ïai leh bad kren ïa kaei kaba bha .

translation.en: And out of the tribe of Dan , Eltekeh with her suburbs , Gibbethon with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Dan la ai ha ki saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Eltekeh , ka Gibbethon ,

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Elah u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong Ki Syiem Israel .

translation.en: And when they heard that , they entered into the temple early in the morning , and taught . But the high priest came , and they that were with him , and called the council together , and all the senate of the children of Israel , and sent to the prison to have them brought .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la kohnguh , bad haba dang byrngut ki la rung sha ka Templ bad ki la sdang ban hikai . U Rangbah Lyngdoh bad kiba synran ïa u ki la khot lang ïa ki tymmen ki san jong ki Jiw na ka bynta ka jingïalang ba-pura jong ka Dorbar ; nangta ki la phah hukum sha ka byndi ban wallam ïa ki apostol ha khmat jong ki .

translation.en: And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all  ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .
translation.kha: Katba baroh ki dang ïa-peit , uta u briew u la ïeng joit , u la rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad mar kumta hi u la leit noh . Baroh ki la ïa-sngewlyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da ong ,  Ngim pat ju ïohi kum kane kaei kaei !

translation.en: And it was told the Gazites , saying , Samson is come hither . And they compassed him in , and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city , and were quiet all the night , saying , In the morning , when it is day , we shall kill him .
translation.kha: Ki nong Gasa ki shem ba u Samson u don hangta , kumta ki kerkut ïa kata ka jaka bad ki ap ïa u baroh shi miet ha khyrdop shnong . Ki ap jar jar baroh shi miet , da kaba pyrkhat ha lade ,  Ngin ap haduh ban da kynjat shai , ban nangta ngin sa pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors , we borrow it from our children .
translation.kha: Ngi khlem iohpateng iakane ka pyrthei na ki mynbarim jongngi , ngi pankylliang na ki khun jongngi .

translation.en: And when the sun is down , he shall be clean , and shall afterward eat of the holy things  ; because it is his food .
translation.kha: Un sa long uba khuid hadien ba ka sngi ka la sep , bad nangta u lah ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang , kiba dei ka jingbam jong u .

translation.en: Therefore is judgment far from us , neither doth justice overtake us : we wait for light , but behold obscurity  ; for brightness , but we walk in darkness .
translation.kha: U paidlang u ong ,  Mynta ngi tip balei U Blei um pyllait ïa ngi na kito kiba banbeiñ ïa ngi . Ngi kyrmen ïa ka jingshai ban ïaid ryngkat , hynrei ka don tang ka jingdum ,

translation.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree , and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree : and it shall be to the  Lord  for a name , for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: Ki dieng Kseh-Sypress kin san ha ka jaka kaba mynta ki don ki dieng shynraiñ ; ki dieng Martl kin mih ha ka jaka ki shiah . Kane kan long ka dak ka ban neh junom , ka jingpynkynmaw ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la leh .

translation.en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines : and the Philistines said , Behold , the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shah ïa ki Philistia ban ïohi ïa ki , bad ki Philistia ki ong ,  Ha khmih ! katto katne ki Hebru ki wan mih na ki thliew ha kiba ki rieh !

translation.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ki khun jong u Job ki dang ïakhawai sngewbha ha ïing jong u hynmen rangbah duh , u nonglamktien u la wan mareh sha u Job .

translation.en: Which was the son of Aminadab , which was the son of Aram , which was the son of Esrom , which was the son of Phares , which was the son of Judah ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Amminadab , u khun jong u Admin , u khun jong u Arni , u khun jong u Hesron , u khun jong u Peres , u khun jong u Judah ,

translation.en: And unclean spirits , when they saw him , fell down before him , and cried , saying , Thou art the Son of God .
translation.kha: Bad man ba ki briew kiba don ki mynsiem bymkhuid ha ki , ki la ïohi ïa u , ki dem khrup ha khmat jong u bad ki lynñiar ,  Me long U Khun U Blei !

translation.en: Hast thou given the horse strength ? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder ?
translation.kha: Hato dei ma me , ko Job , uba pynkhlaiñ haduh katta katta ïa ki kulai bad ai ha ki ïa ki treng kiba noh rymphum ?

translation.en: He that is unjust , let him be unjust still : and he which is filthy , let him be filthy still : and he that is righteous , let him be righteous still : and he that is holy , let him be holy still .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba sniew u dei ban ïai leh sniew , bad uno uno uba jaboh u dei ban ïai jaboh ; uno uno uba bha u dei ban ïai lehbha , bad uno uno uba khuid u dei ban ïailong khuid .

translation.en: And such were some of you : but ye are washed , but ye are sanctified , but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus , and by the Spirit of our God .
translation.kha: Don na phi kiba la ju long kumta . Hynrei la pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop ; la pynkyntang ïa phi sha U Blei ; la pynksan ïa phi bad U Blei da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad da U Mynsiem U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house  ; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters , and six years for thy cattle : and thou hast changed my wages ten times .
translation.kha: Ka la long kumta ha baroh ki arphew snem kiba nga la don bad phi . Khatsaw snem nga la shakri ban ïoh ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi ar ngut — bad hynriew snem na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi . Wat la katta ruh , phi la pynkylla ïa ka bainong jong nga haduh shiphew sien .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel , according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law :
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa u ka nuksa hapdeng ki jait Israel baroh , bad un wallam ki jingpynjot halor jong u kat kum kita ki jingtim ba la jer ha ka jutang ïa kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai U  Trai .

translation.en: Notwithstanding , if he continue a day or two , he shall not be punished : for he is his money .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uta u mraw u im shi sngi lane ar sngi , uta u briew um dei ban shah pynshitom . Ka jingduh jong u ïa la u mraw uba long ka spah jong u ka la long hi ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: For David is not ascended into the heavens : but he saith himself , The  Lord  said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,
translation.kha: Naba ym shym dei u Dabid uba la leit kiew sha bneng ; pynban u la ong :   ‘ U Trai u la ong ha u Trai jong nga : Shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga

translation.en: Backbiters , haters of God , despiteful , proud , boasters , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,
translation.kha: Ki ïa-lorni bad kren sniew uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki long kiba shun ïa U Blei , kiba pynbitar , kiba sarong bad kiba sngewmeng ; ki pyrkhat ïa kiba bun ki lynti ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; kim kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ;

translation.en: And when his servants told David these words , it pleased David well to be the king s son in law : and the days were not expired .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Saul ki leit ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kaba u Saul u la ong , bad u Dabid u sngewbha ïa ka jingpyrkhat ba un sa long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem . Ha ka sngi shuwa ka jingkyntiew kurim ,

translation.en: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes ,  Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me ? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple , and ye laid no hold on me .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kren ha u paidbah ,  Hato phi donkam ban wan bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon ban kem ïa nga , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ? Man la ka sngi nga la shong bad hikai hapoh ka Templ , bad phim shym la kem ïa nga .

translation.en: I will also gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat , and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations , and parted my land .
translation.kha: Ngan lumlang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Hangta ngan bishar ïa ki na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la leh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ki la pynsakma ïa ki Israel sha ki ri nongwei bad ki la phiah ïa ka Israel , ka ri jong nga .

translation.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon , and saith unto him , We have found the Messias , which is , being interpreted , the Christ .
translation.kha: Mar kumta u la shem ïa u Simon , u para jong u bad u la ong ha u ,  Ngi la shem ïa u Messaïah .  ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut  U Khrist . )

translation.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them : and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki paramarjan baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ka khubor shaphang kine kiei kiei ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri lum Judia .

translation.en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely  ; he shall even restore it in the principal , and shall add the fifth part more thereto , and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth , in the day of his trespass offering .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u leh pop ha kano kano na kine , u dei ban siew pat ïa kata baroh kaba u la ïoh da ki lad bymdei . Ha kata ka sngi ba la lap ba u la leh pop , u dei ban pynphai pura sha u trai , lem bad arphew bynta na ka shispah .

translation.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh ; but he of the freewoman was by promise .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  khun jong u , uba na ka kynthei mraw la kha katba kum ka rukom briew ; hynrei ïa u khun jong u na ka kynthei kaba laitluid la kha ha ka jingkular U Blei .

translation.en: So he let him go : then she said , A bloody husband thou art , because of the circumcision .
translation.kha: Te ka Sipporah ka tnga jong u , ka la shim ïa u maw uba nep , ka otsher ïa u khun jong ka , nangta ka pyndei tiak da ka doh otsher ïa ki kjat    u Moses . Namar ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher ka la ong ha u Moses ,  Me long u tnga da ka snam ïa nga .     Kumta U  Trai  u la pynsah ïa ka jingim u Moses .

translation.en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I , my son . And he said , Behold the fire and the wood : but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ?
translation.kha: u Isaak u ong ,  Ko pa !  U jubab ,  Oi , khun ?  U Isaak u kylli ,  Nga ïohi ïa ki rnga barhem bad ïa ki dieng , hynrei hangno pat u khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia ?

translation.en: For if ye live after the flesh , ye shall die : but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body , ye shall live .
translation.kha: Naba lada phi im kat kum ka jinglong ba kynja doh , phin sa ïap ; hynrei lada da U Mynsiem phi pynïap noh ïa ki jingleh ka pop , phin im .

translation.en: Notwithstanding , lest we should offend them , go thou to the sea , and cast an hook , and take up the fish that first cometh up  ; and when thou hast opened his mouth , thou shalt find a piece of money : that take , and give unto them for me and thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngim kwah ban pynmong ïa kine ki briew . Kumta khie leit sha ka pung bad bret ïa u khwai . Shim ïa ka dohkha ba la ngat nyngkong , bad hapoh ka shyntur jong ka men shem ïa ka pisa kaba shongdor biang na ka bynta ka khajna Templ ïa nga bad ïa me . To shim ïa ka bad siew ïa ki khajna jong ngi .

translation.en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near , and spake before Moses , and before the princes , the chief fathers of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Ki khlieh jong ki longïing longsem ha ka kur u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir u ksiew jong u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , ki la leit sha u Moses bad kiwei pat ki nongïalam .

translation.en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion , and loosed him , and forgave him the debt .
translation.kha: U Syiem u la sngewsynei ïa u , kumta u la map ïa ka ram jong u bad u la pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty , they prevented with their bread him that fled .
translation.kha: to ai um ïa ki briew kiba sliang kiba wan sha phi . Phi ki briew jong ka ri Tema , to ai jingbam ïa ki nongphetwir .

translation.en: All this have I seen , and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun : there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kane baroh haba nga pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kane ka pyrthei , ka pyrthei ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki don ka bor bad kiwei pat ki dei ban shahshitom hapoh jong ki .

translation.en: Then died Ibzan , and was buried at Beth–lehem .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha Bethlehem .

translation.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before that great and notable day of the Lord come :
translation.kha: ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla saw kum ka snam , ha shuwa Ka Sngi kaba khraw bad kaba donburom jong U Trai ka wan .

translation.en: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar ki briew jong ka Ninebeh kin ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don uei re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Jonah !

translation.en: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite , David s counsellor , from his city , even from Giloh , while he offered sacrifices . And the conspiracy was strong  ; for the people increased continually with Absalom .
translation.kha: Bad katba u dang ai jingkñia , u Absalom u phah khot ruh na ka shnong Gilo ïa u Ahithophel , uba long uwei na ki nongaibuit jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka jingthmu barieh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka nang jur , bad ki nongbud jong u Absalom ki nang bun .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses

translation.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison , whom they had desired  ; but he delivered Jesus to their will .
translation.kha: U la pyllait noh ïa u briew uba ki la kwah , uta uba la shah set byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin bad ka jingpynïap briew , bad u la aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki ban leh kumba ki la kwah .

translation.en: Then cometh the end , when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God , even the Father ; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power .
translation.kha: Te kaba kut kan poi ; U Khrist un jop noh thiaw ïa ki bor mynsiem , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor , bad un aiti ïa ka Hima ha U Blei uba U Kpa .

translation.en: And in the morning came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Located there is the Governing Body , a central group of experienced elders who oversee the worldwide congregation .
translation.kha: Hangta la don ki dkhot ba la khot ka Governing Body , ka kynhun jong ki elders kiba tbit bha , ki ban peit ïa ki balang ha satlak ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For in the eighth year of his reign , while he was yet young , he began to seek after the God of David his father : and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places , and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba phra ba u Josaïah u long syiem , haba u dang khynnah bha , u sdang ban mane ïa U Blei jong u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u . Saw snem hadien u sdang ban pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad baroh kiwei de ki bleithaw .

translation.en: But it shall not be so among you : but whosoever will be great among you , let him be your minister  ;
translation.kha: Kane , la kumno kumno , kam dei ka rukom ban long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uwei na phi u kwah ban long uba khraw , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei pat ;

translation.en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion , and turneth the shadow of death into the morning , and maketh the day dark with night : that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki khlur , ki Pleïades    bad Orion    , u pynkylla ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai mynsngi , bad ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U khot na ka bynta ki um jong ka duriaw bad theh ïa ki ha sla khyndew . Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei U  Trai .

translation.en: And the desolate land shall be tilled , whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ju ïaid narud ki lyngkha jong phi ki la ïohi ba kumno ba la san jrong bad ba la iehnoh khlaw ïa ki , hynrei ngan shah ba phin rep biang ha ki .

translation.en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds , and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph . And Saul sought him every day , but God delivered him not into his hand .
translation.kha: U Dabid u sah ha ka jakarieh ha ri lum kaba ha ka ri khlaw hajan ka Siph . U Saul u ïai pyrshang ban shem ïa u , hynrei U Blei um shym la aiti ïa u Dabid ha u .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I die : and God will surely visit you , and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
translation.kha: Te u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen ,  Nga la jan ïap , hynrei U Blei un ri un da ïa phi , bad un ïalam noh ïa phi na kane ka ri sha kata ka ri kaba u la kular skhem ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob .

translation.en: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes : and it shall be , that the tribe which the  Lord  taketh shall come according to the families thereof  ; and the family which the  Lord  shall take shall come by households  ; and the household which the  Lord  shall take shall come man by man .
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki ba ha ka por mynstep yn ïalam ïa ki sha khmat , kawei ka jait hadien kawei pat . Ka jait kaba nga jied kan wan sha khmat , shi kur shi kur . Ka kur kaba nga jied kan wan sha khmat , kawei ka longïing hadien kawei pat . Ka longïing kaba nga la jied kan wan sha khmat uwei hadien uwei pat .

translation.en: And so , after he had patiently endured , he obtained the promise .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ïaishah slem , bad kumta u la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: There is none holy as the  Lord  : for there is none beside thee : neither is there any rock like our God .
translation.kha: Ym don uba khuid kum U  Trai  ; ym don uba kum ma u , ym don nongïada uba kum U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And when the south wind blew softly , supposing that they had obtained their purpose , loosing thence , they sailed close by Crete .
translation.kha: Ka lyer kaba jai jai na shathie ka la sdang ban beh , bad ki rangbah ki la pyrkhat ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong ki , kumta ki la ïaring noh ïa u angkor bad ki la king kham jan katba lah marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw jong ka Krit .

translation.en: And Abimelech came unto the tower , and fought against it , and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire .
translation.kha: Haba u Abimelekh u wan ban tur ïaleh ïa uta u mot , u la leit sha ka jingkhang bad thang ïa uta u mot .

translation.en: Therefore I make a decree , That every people , nation , and language , which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , shall be cut in pieces , and their houses shall be made a dunghill : because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort .
translation.kha: Te mynta nga hukum ba lada uno uno na kano kano ka hima , ka jaitbynriew , lane ka ktien uba kren khlem burom ïa U Blei jong u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , dei ban tar ïa u na ka kti bad kjat , bad ïa ka ïing jong u dei ban pynlong ka kynton ki jingpra . Ym don uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im kumne .

translation.en: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore , or the price of a dog , into the house of the  Lord  thy God for any vow : for even both these are abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Nalor kata , ym dei ban wanrah ïa ka kamai nuti , la ka dei ka jong u shynrang ne ka kynthei , sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kum ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai , namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ki nuti ha ka jaka mane blei .

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , appoint thee two ways , that the sword of the king of Babylon may come : both twain shall come forth out of one land : and choose thou a place , choose it at the head of the way to the city .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  pruid dak ar tylli ki lynti na kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u lah ban wan lem bad la ka waitlam . Baroh ar tylli ki dei ban sdang na kajuh ka ri . Buh ïa ka dak jingkdew shano ba ki lynti ki ïakhlad .

translation.en: Say I these things as a man ? or saith not the law the same also ?
translation.kha: Ngam donkam ban ñiew tang na kine ki nuksa ba man la ka sngi , namar ka hukum ka ong hi ïa kajuh .

translation.en: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer–sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh , naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka ri haduh kawei pat ka tduh , ki tip ba u Samuel u long shisha u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise God in his sanctuary : praise him in the firmament of his power .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka Templ jong u ! To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong u ha bneng !

translation.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eli , Eli , lama sabachthani ?  that is to say ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
translation.kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka jingpyrta bajam ,   Eli , Eli , lema Sabakhthani ?  kaba mut  U Blei jong nga , U Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?

translation.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture , and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness : therefore he said to his chariot man , Turn thine hand , that thou mayest carry me out of the host  ; for I am wounded .
translation.kha: Kumno re kumno pat , u shipai Syria u siat ïa u khnam uba dei ïa u syiem Ahab hapdeng ka jaka bapyndait ïa ka jingkieng atiar jong u .  Nga la mynsaw !  u pyrta sha u nongñiah ka kali ïapom jong u .  Phai noh bad phet noh na ka thma !

translation.en: And the number of them , after their genealogy by their generations , heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour , was twenty thousand and two hundred .
translation.kha: Ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew da ki longïing ki long arphew hajar arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

translation.en: And they answered and said unto him , Where , Lord ? And he said unto them ,  Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno , ko Trai ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalum hangta .

translation.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light , that his deeds may be made manifest , that they are wrought in God .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba shisha u wan sha ka jingshai khnang ba ka jingshai kan pynpaw ïa kaei kaba u la leh ka long da kaba kohnguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And the king sat upon his seat , as at other times , even upon a seat by the wall : and Jonathan arose , and Abner sat by Saul s side , and David s place was empty .
translation.kha: bad u shong ha ka jaka ba u ju shong hajan kynroh . U Abner u shong hajan jong u , bad u Jonathan ha pyrshah jong u .

translation.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth , and the stock thereof die in the ground  ;
translation.kha: Wat la ki thied jong u ki man tymmen noh , bad u dyngkhong jong u , u ïap ha ka khyndew ,

translation.en: And he taught , saying unto them ,  Is it not written , My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer ? but ye have made it a den of thieves .
translation.kha: Nangta u la hikai ïa u paidbah :  La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai ïa ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh .’ Hynrei phi la pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh jong ki nongtuh !

translation.en: And satest upon a stately bed , and a table prepared before it , whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil .
translation.kha: Ki da shong ha ki jingthiah ba-itynnat , bad ha khmat jong ki kin buh ïa ka miej ba la dap da kiei kiei kiba bha , ba kynthup ïa ki jingiwbih bad ka umphniang Olib kaba nga la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is Remaliah s son . If ye will not believe , surely ye shall not be established .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Samaria , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Samaria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Pekah .  Lada ka jingngeit jong phi kam long kaba ïaineh , phin ym ïaineh .

translation.en: Woe to the bloody city ! it is all full of lies and robbery  ; the prey departeth not  ;
translation.kha: Long kaba la tim ka nongbah kaba pynïap bad kaba lamler , kaba dap da ka spah ban shah lute bad shah kurup !

translation.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour : but through knowledge shall the just be delivered .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban jot noh da ka jingkren ki briew kiba khlem blei , hynrei ka jingstad jong kiba hok ka lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace : but he cried the more a great deal , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la kynhied ïa u bad ki la ong ïa u ban sngap jar . Hynrei u la pyrta kham jam shuh shuh ,  Ko Khun U Dabid , to isynei ïa nga !

translation.en: These ten times have ye reproached me : ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me .
translation.kha: Na kawei ka por sha kawei pat phi pynjahburom ïa nga bad phim don ka jinglehrain haba phi krenbeiñ ïa nga .

translation.en: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin  ; neither say thou before the angel , that it was an error : wherefore should God be angry at thy voice , and destroy the work of thine hands ?
translation.kha: Wat ai ba ki kyntien jong phi kin ïalam ïa phi sha ka pop , ba kumta phi hap ban ïathuh ïa u lyngdoh jong U Blei ba phim shym mut shisha . Balei ban pynlong ïa U Blei ban bitar ïa phi ? Balei yn shah ïa u ban pynjot thiaw ïa kaei kaba phi la trei ?

translation.en: TEKEL  ; Thou art weighed in the balances , and art found wanting .
translation.kha: Ka jingthew  , ïa phi la thew ha ki tarajur bad la shem ba phi duna palat ;

translation.en: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people , and blessed them , and came down from offering of the sin offering , and the burnt offering , and peace offerings .
translation.kha: Haba u Aaron u la pyndep lut ïa kita ki jingkñia , u rah ïa la ki kti sha uta u paidbah bad u kyrkhu ïa ki ; bad nangta u wan hiar noh .

translation.en: A time to cast away stones , and a time to gather stones together  ; a time to embrace , and a time to refrain from embracing  ;
translation.kha: ka por ban phylliew jingieit bad ka por ban ym phylliew jingieit , ka por ban ïadoh bad ka por ban ym ïadoh .

translation.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus , and sought to slay him , because he had done these things on the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la sdang ban wad dong ban pynshitom ïa U Jisu , namar ba u la leh ïa kane ka jingpynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh  ; and he dwelt therein .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa ka Gilead ha ka kur jong u Makhir , bad ki la shong la sah hangta .

translation.en: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness ; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God .
translation.kha: Naba ka khubor shaphang ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna ka long ka jingibieit ha kito kiba jot noh ; hynrei ïa ngi kiba la pynim , ka long ka bor U Blei .

translation.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .
translation.kha: U Philip u la leit bad u la ïathuh ha u Andriw , bad baroh ar ngut ki la leit bad ïathuh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast  ; saying to them that dwell on the earth , that they should make an image to the beast , which had the wound by a sword , and did live .
translation.kha: Bad u la shukor ïa ki briew baroh kiba im ha ka pyrthei da ki kambah ïa kiba la shah ïa u ban leh ha khmat jong uta u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong . U mradkhlaw u la ong ïa ki ban tei ka durblei ha ka jingpyndonburom ïa u mradkhlaw ïa uba la shah pynmynsaw da ka waitlam bad pynban uba dang im .

translation.en: Thou sayest , Lo , thou hast smitten the Edomites  ; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast : abide now at home  ; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?
translation.kha: Mynta ko Amasaïah , me kob ba me la jop ïa ki Edom , hynrei nga ai jingmut ïa me ba men shong ha ïing . Balei me pynkhih jingkulmar ka ban shu wanrah tang ka jingjot ha me bad ki briew jong me ?

translation.en: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars : see that ye be not troubled : for all these things must come to pass , but the end is not yet .
translation.kha: Phin sa ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa ki thma kiba hajan bad ïa ki khubor thma kiba sha jngai ; hynrei wat khih khuslai . Kiba kum kine kiei kiei ki dei ban jia , hynrei kim mut ba kaba kut ka la poi .

translation.en: Upon earth there is not his like , who is made without fear .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano ha ka pyrthei kaba lah ban ïanujor bad u , u dei u jingthaw u bym don jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Moses gave you not that bread from heaven  ; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  kaei kaba u Moses u la ai ha phi kam dei u kpu na bneng ; dei U Kpa jong nga uba ai ha phi ïa u kpu bashisha na bneng .

translation.en: For I the  Lord  thy God will hold thy right hand , saying unto thee , Fear not  ; I will help thee .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong me ; nga pynkhlaiñ ïa me bad nga ong , ‘ wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me .’

translation.en: Now therefore go to , speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I frame evil against you , and devise a device against you : return ye now every one from his evil way , and make your ways and your doings good .
translation.kha: Mynta te , to ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ba nga thaw ki jingthmu bathymmai pyrshah ïa ki bad nga khreh ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ïathuh ïa ki ban sangeh ban im ka jingim ba-dap da ka pop — ban pynkylla ïa ki rukom im jong ki bad ïa kiei kiei kiba ki leh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that at even the quails came up , and covered the camp : and in the morning the dew lay round about the host .
translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet , shi kynhun bah ki  iar khlaw ki la wan her , kat ban dap ïa ka jaka sher dara , bad ha ka por mynstep la don ka umjer ha kylleng ka jaka sher dara .

translation.en: And he went out from thence , and came into his own country  ; and his disciples follow him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit phai pat sha la shnong ; ki synran ki bud ïa u .

translation.en: Then went the devils out of the man , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake , and were choked .
translation.kha: Ki la mihnoh na uta u briew bad ki la rung shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh ka la noh sha riat shapoh ka duriaw bad ki la ïap jyllop .

translation.en: For if the inheritance be of the law , it is no more of promise : but God gave it to Abraham by promise .
translation.kha: Naba lada ka jingai U Blei ka shong ha ka Hukum , te ka jingaiei kam shong shuh ha ka jingkular jong u . Pynban ka long namar ka jingkular jong u ba U Blei u la ai ïa kata ka jingai sngewbha ha u Abraham .

translation.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them , Say ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ha ki ba u Patsha u kwah tip kaei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewskhem .

translation.en: Son of man , speak unto the elders of Israel , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye come to enquire of me ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kren ha kine ki nongïalam bad ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : Phi la ïawan ban kylli ïa ka mon jong nga , hato ym dei kumta ? Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban kylli ei ei ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga la kren .

translation.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth  ; the flesh profiteth nothing : the words that I speak unto you , they are spirit , and they are life .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ai jingim dei U Mynsiem jong U Blei ; ka bor briew kam myntoi ei ei ruh em . Ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phi ki wallam ïa U Mynsiem ba ai jingim jong U Blei .

translation.en: And shall come forth  ; they that have done good , unto the resurrection of life  ; and they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of damnation .
translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh ha kane ; ba ka por kan wan haba baroh kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u bad kin mihnoh na ki jingtep jong ki : Kito kiba la leh ïa kaba bha kin mihpat bad kin im , bad kito kiba la leh ïa kaba sniew kin mihpat bad yn pynrem ïa ki .

translation.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day , to lead them in the way  ; neither the pillar of fire by night , to shew them light , and the way wherein they should go .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem shym iehnoh ïa ki hangta ha ka ri shyiap , namar ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw . Mem shym la shim noh ïa u lyoh lane ïa ka ding uba pyn-i ha ki ïa ka lynti mynsngi bad mynmiet .

translation.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem  ; them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .
translation.kha: U weng noh na ka kam ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ki syiem Judah ki la pynkyntang ban ai jingkñia halor ki duwan ba-thala ha ki nongbah ka Judah bad ha ki jaka hajan Jerusalem ― ïa baroh ki lyngdoh kiba ai jingkñia sha u Baal , sha ka sngi , u bnai , ki metbneng , bad ki khlur .

translation.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart , so let him give ; not grudgingly , or of necessity : for God loveth a cheerful giver .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban ai , namarkata , kumba phi la kut jingmut , ym da kaba bynñiaw ne da kaba sngew kum ka kamram ; naba U Blei u ieit ïa uta uba ai da kaba kmen .

translation.en: When did Jehovah’s Witnesses have their modern-day start ?
translation.kha: Mynno la sdang ïa ka seng Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka por ba mynta ?

translation.en: Saying ,  There was in a city a judge , which feared not God , neither regarded man :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka shnong la don u nongbishar u bymsheptieng ïa U Blei lymne burom ïa u briew .

translation.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season ? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban kdew lynti ïa ki khlur na kawei ka aïom sha kawei pat bad me pynïaid ïa ka thup khlur baheh bad barit ?

translation.en: Therefore hearken unto me , ye men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness  ; and from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki rangbah kiba don jingshemphang ! Hato U Blei Badonbor Baroh u leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ?

translation.en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man , and he seeth all his goings .
translation.kha: U peit-thuh ïa ki sien jam ba ki briew ki jam .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  my God  ; Feed the flock of the slaughter  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ong ha nga ,  To leh ïa ka bynta jong u nongaplangbrot jong ka kynhun langbrot kaba dei ban shah shohdoh .

translation.en: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations , and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her : for they have refused my judgments and my statutes , they have not walked in them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hukum jong nga , ka da pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kiwei pat ki ri , ka la long bymkohnguh kham palat ïa ki ri kiba don sawdong jong ka . Ka Jerusalem ka la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga bad kam kohnguh satia ïa ki aiñ jong nga .

translation.en: And ye said , Behold , the  Lord  our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire : we have seen this day that God doth talk with man , and he liveth .
translation.kha: bad ki ïa-ong , ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynpaw ha ngi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka burom jong u haba ngi ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren napdeng ka ding ! Mynta ka sngi ngi la ïohi ba u briew u dang lah hi ban im , wat la U Blei u la kren ha u .

translation.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa u ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada ha ka jingshem jong u ba kata ka prum ka long kumjuh bad kam shym pur , un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: The Bible states : “God saw everything he had made and , look ! it was very good .”
translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka ong : “U Blei u la iohi ia Kiei Kiei baroh ba u la thaw , ha khmih ruh , ka la bha eh .”

translation.en: A land of wheat , and barley , and vines , and fig trees , and pomegranates  ; a land of oil olive , and honey  ;
translation.kha: ka ri kaba pynmih ïa u kew bad u barli , u dieng sohwaiñ bad u diengsoh Dumbur , u diengsoh Pomkranet bad u diengsoh Olib , bad ka ngap .

translation.en: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come , and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem , and against all the walls thereof round about , and against all the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: namar nga khot ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka phang bashatei ban ïawan . Ki syiem jong ki kin pynïeng ïa ki khet jong ki ha ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem bad sawdong ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ruh sawdong ïa kiwei pat ki nongbah jong ka Judah .

translation.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness , Zion is a wilderness , Jerusalem a desolation .
translation.kha: Ki nongbah bakyntang jong me ki long kum ka ri shyiap ; ka Jerusalem ka long ka jaka kynjah ba la pynjot ,

translation.en: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not ; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth : for God hath received him .
translation.kha: U briew uba bam ïa kiei kiei baroh , um dei ban peitbeiñ ïa uta u bym bam ; katba uta uba bam tang da ki jhur um dei ban bishar ïa uta uba bam ïa kaei kaei ruh ; naba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .

translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book .
translation.kha: u la ong ha nga :  To thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me ,

translation.en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace , whose mind is stayed on thee : because he trusteth in thee .
translation.kha: Ma me , A  Trai  , me ai ka jingsuk bajanai ïa kito kiba batskhem ïa ka jingthmu jong ki bad kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha me .

translation.en: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours , great of flesh  ; and hast increased thy whoredoms , to provoke me to anger .
translation.kha: Pha la shah ïa ki paramarjan bakwah brai , ki nong Ijipt ban leit ïathiah bad pha , bad pha la pyndonkam ïa ka jingleh nuti jong pha ban pynbitar ïa nga .

translation.en: Then David sent home to Tamar , saying , Go now to thy brother Amnon s house , and dress him meat .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u phah ktien sha ka Tamar ha ka ïingsyiem :  Khie leit sha ka ïing u Amnon bad khreh katto katne ka jingbam ïa u .

translation.en: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel  ; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth–el , and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin : and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent .
translation.kha: u jied lai hajar ngut ki rangbah ; u bat ar hajar ngut na ki bad u ha Mikhmash bad ha ka ri lum jong ka Bethel bad u phah shihajar ngut bad u Jonathan u khun jong u sha Gibeah , ha ka thain Benjamin . Ïa kiba sah pat u phah noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day , that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it  ; ye shall not prolong your days upon it , but shall utterly be destroyed .
translation.kha: Nga khot ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew ban sakhi pyrshah ïa phi ba , lada phim kohnguh ïa nga , phin sa jah noh shen na kata ka ri ; phin ym im slem ha kata ka ri sha shiliang ka Jordan ïa kaba phin sa ïohkynti . Yn sa pynjot thiaw ïa phi .

translation.en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death , and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus , I have determined to send him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shem ba u la leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban shah rai pynïap . Bad namar ba ma u hi u la lah apil sha u Patsha , nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha u .

translation.en: So Joseph died , being an hundred and ten years old : and they embalmed him , and he was put in a coffin in Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u ïap ha Ijipt haba u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka rta . Ki kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met jong u , bad hangta ha Ijipt ki buh ïa u ha ka synduk ïapbriew .

translation.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag , and thou sewest up mine iniquity .
translation.kha: Men map ïa ki bad men weng noh sharud ïa ki ; men ñiad noh ïa ki jingbakla baroh ba nga la leh .

translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers , were two thousand and six hundred and thirty .
translation.kha: U Moses u kohnguh bad u buh jingthoh ïa ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong ha Israel kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ,

translation.en: And he took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave it to them : and they all drank of it .
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ha U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki ; bad baroh ki la dih na ka .

translation.en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him , and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul , and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him  ; and they went over Jordan before the king .
translation.kha: U la don bad u shihajar ngut ki rangbah na ka jait Benjamin . Bad u Siba ruh , u shakri jong ka longïing jong u Saul , u la wan lem bad ki khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang jong u bad arphew ngut ki shakri , bad ki la wan poi ha Jordan ha shuwa jong u syiem .

translation.en: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat , because he eateth not of faith : for whatsoever is not of faith is sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u sngew artatien ïa kaei kaba u bam , U Blei u pynrem ïa u haba u bam ïa ka , namar kaei kaba u leh , kam shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit . Bad kaei kaei ka bym shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit ka long ka pop .

translation.en: I have raised him up in righteousness , and I will direct all his ways : he shall build my city , and he shall let go my captives , not for price nor reward , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Nga da lade hi nga la pynkhih ïa u Syros ban leh ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong nga bad buh beit ïa kiei kiei . Ngan pynbeit ïa ka lynti baroh ba u leit . Un tei biang ïa ka nongbah jong nga , ka Jerusalem , bad un pyllait ïa ki briew ba shah set byndi jong nga . Ym don ba la shim wai ïa u ne ba la pynbam klop ïa u ban leh ïa kane .  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren .

translation.en: And it came to pass about this time , that Joseph went into the house to do his business  ; and there was none of the men of the house there within .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi haba u Joseph u leit rung shapoh ïing ban trei ïa la ka kam , uwei ruh na ki shakri ïing um don .

translation.en: And again , whom should I serve ? should I not serve in the presence of his son ? as I have served in thy father s presence , so will I be in thy presence .
translation.kha: Nalor kata baroh , ïano pat ngan shakri , lada ym dei ïa u khun jong u kynrad jong nga ? Kumba nga la shakri ïa i pa jong phi , kumta mynta ngan shakri ïa phi .

translation.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance , and is humbled in me .
translation.kha: Nga ïai pyrkhat ïa ka bad ka mynsiem jong nga ka noh sngewsih .

translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil : three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram  ;
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba dei da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,

translation.en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced , and brought in , and cast into the chest , until they had made an end .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki briew bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , bad ki la wallam ïa ka khajna jong ki bad ki pyndap ïa ka synduk da ka .

translation.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand  ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïar ïa ki pud jong ka ri jong phi naduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba haduh ka duriaw Mediterranian bad naduh ka ri shyiap haduh ka wah Ïuphratis . Ngan ai ha phi ka bor halor ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka ri , bad phin beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

translation.en: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine , neither let her drink wine or strong drink , nor eat any unclean thing : all that I commanded her let her observe .
translation.kha: Kam dei ban bam ïa kano kano kaba mih na u dieng sohwaiñ ; kam dei ban dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid . Ka dei ban leh ïa kata baroh ïa kaba nga la ong ha ka .

translation.en: Go ye , get you straw where ye can find it : yet not ought of your work shall be diminished .
translation.kha: Phi hap ban leit ïawad hi kat naba phi lap , hynrei phi dei ban shna katjuh ki maw-it .

translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart , and hear with thine ears .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ko khun u briew , sngap bha bad kynmaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga ong ha me .

translation.en: Samuel also said unto Saul , The  Lord  sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people , over Israel : now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul ,  Dei ïa nga ba U  Trai  u la phah ban pynsleh ïa phi ban long u syiem jong ki briew jong u , ki Israel . Mynta , sngap ïa kaba U  Trai  u ong .

translation.en: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle , Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons : for they said , Surely they are smitten down before us , as in the first battle .
translation.kha: Haba kin ïohi ïa u lyoh tdem uba kiew shajrong na kata ka nongbah , ki Israel kiba ha madan thma ki dei ban phai kylla . Hynrei kat haduh kane ka por , ki Benjamin ki la ïoh pynïap laiphew ngut ki Israel . Ki ong ha lade ,  Ho-oid , ngi la jop ïa ki kumba ngi la leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree , but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day  ; ( for he that is hanged is accursed of God  ; ) that thy land be not defiled , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
translation.kha: ym dei ban ieh ïa ka metïap hangta baroh shi miet . Tep ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi , namar ka metïap kaba sdien ha u dieng ka long ka jingtim U Blei , khnang ba phin ym pyntngit ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

translation.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved , and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll : and all their host shall fall down , as the leaf falleth off from the vine , and as a falling fig from the fig tree .
translation.kha: Ka sngi , u bnai bad ki khlur kin lwet jin . Ka sahit bneng kan jah noh kum ka kitab ba la kli , bad ba ki khlur kin hap kum ki sla na u dieng sohwaiñ bad u dieng Dumbur .

translation.en: But charge Joshua , and encourage him , and strengthen him : for he shall go over before this people , and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see .
translation.kha: Hukum ïa u Joshua , bad pynshlur ïa u , naba un ïalam ïa u paidbah shatai sha shiliang ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba me ïohi .’

translation.en: When pride cometh , then cometh shame : but with the lowly is wisdom .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong kin shah pynjahburom . Ka long kaba kham stad ban long kiba sngewrit .

translation.en: And they returned , and came to En–mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar .
translation.kha: Nangta ki phai dien bad ki wan poi biang sha Kadesh ( kaba la tip mynshuwa kum ka Enmishpat ) . Ki la jop ïa ka ri baroh jong ki Amalek , bad ki la jop ïa ki Amor ruh kiba shong basah ha Hasason Tamar .

translation.en: And after him Elon , a Zebulunite , judged Israel  ; and he judged Israel ten years .
translation.kha: Hadien u Ibsan , u Elon uba na Sebulun u ïalam ïa ki Israel shiphew snem .

translation.en: Forbear to cry , make no mourning for the dead , bind the tire of thine head upon thee , and put on thy shoes upon thy feet , and cover not thy lips , and eat not the bread of men .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba yn pynsngew ïa ki jingïam jong pha . Wat leit kumto khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem jingsopkjat kum ka dak jong ka jingïam pangnud . Wat tap ïa la ka khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the  Lord   ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Moses u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Phi la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Mynta ngan leit kiew biang sha U  Trai  ; lehse nga lah ban pynïoh ïa ka jingmap ïa ka pop jong phi .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea : for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and brought no present to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year : therefore the king of Assyria shut him up , and bound him in prison .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka snem u Hoshea u phah nonglamktien sha u So , u syiem ka Ijipt , ban pan ïa ka jingïarap jong u , bad u sangeh noh ka jingsiew ïa ka jingnguh syiem ba man ka snem sha ka Assyria . Haba u Shalmaneser u tip ïa kane , u phah kem ïa u Hoshea bad buh ïa u ha ka byndi .

translation.en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness , and ye believed him not : but the publicans and the harlots believed him : and ye , when ye had seen it , repented not afterward , that ye might believe him .
translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan ha phi da kaba pyn-i ha phi ïa ka lynti ïaid kaba dei , bad phim shym la ngeit ïa u ; hynrei ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki la ngeit ïa u . Wat haba phi la ïohi ïa kane , phim shym la kylla ïa la ki jingmut hadien bad ngeit ïa u .

translation.en: As it is written , Behold , I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence : and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
translation.kha: uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kren shaphang uta :  Ha khmih , nga buh ha Seïon ïa u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ban kyllon . Hynrei uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym shem ïa kaba sngewsih .

translation.en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor , and Shimshai the scribe , and the rest of their companions  ; the Dinaites , the Apharsathchites , the Tarpelites , the Apharsites , the Archevites , the Babylonians , the Susanchites , the Dehavites , and the Elamites ,
translation.kha: Na u Rehum , u lat , na u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , na ki paralok jong ki , ki nongbishar bad na baroh ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar , kiba long ki rangbah traishnong na Erekh , Babilon bad Susa ha ka ri Elam ,

translation.en: How much more , if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found ? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines ?
translation.kha: Haduh katno kan jin da la kham bha lada ki briew jong ngi ha kane ka sngi ki la bam ïa ka jingbam ba ki la shim haba ki jop ïa ki nongshun . Shu pyrkhat haduh katno ngut shuh shuh ki Philistia kin jin da la pynïap .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and will go to the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . So the king of Israel disguised himself  ; and they went to the battle .
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Haba ngi leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei ma phi , phong ïa ki jaiñ syiem jong phi .  Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha thma ha ka jingriam pher .

translation.en: All they shall speak and say unto thee , Art thou also become weak as we ? art thou become like unto us ?
translation.kha: Ki baroh ki khot ïa u , ‘ Mynta me la tlot kumba long ma ngi ! Me long uwei na ngi !

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land whither I bring you ,
translation.kha: ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel ban bud ha ka ri kaba u mut ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: Woe to the land shadowing with wings , which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia :
translation.kha: Sha lyndet ki wah jong ka Sudan don ka ri ha kaba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa jong ki thapniang .

translation.en: And he was there with the  Lord  forty days and forty nights  ; he did neither eat bread , nor drink water . And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant , the ten commandments .
translation.kha: U Moses u la sah hangta bad U  Trai  sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , khlem bam khlem dih . U thoh ruh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa ki ktien jong kata ka jutang — ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ .

translation.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh , which is called the Passover .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la jan na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ïa kaba la khot ka Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples , saying , Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun jong ki , ki la khñium ha ki synran jong U Jisu .  Balei ba phi ïabam bad ïadih bad ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait ?  Ki la kylli .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga

translation.en: And whither I go ye know , and the way ye know .
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam sha kata ka jaka shano sha ba nga leit .

translation.en: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall live thereby .
translation.kha: Haba u briew bymman u sangeh noh na kaba leh pop bad u leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha , u la pynim ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet , saying , And they took the thirty pieces of silver , the price of him that was valued , whom they of the children of Israel did value  ;
translation.kha: Te kaei kaba u Jeremaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong , ka la urlong shisha :  Ki la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa , ka dor kaba ki paid Israel ki la mynjur ban siew na ka bynta jong u ,

translation.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites .
translation.kha: bad u la ïohi ruh ïa ka riewkynthei kaba duk haduh katta katta ba ka thep ar tylli ki sbai tama .

translation.en: The high places also of Aven , the sin of Israel , shall be destroyed : the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars  ; and they shall say to the mountains , Cover us  ; and to the hills , Fall on us .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kliar lum Aben , ha kiba ki paid Israel ki mane ïa ki bleithaw , yn pynjot noh . Ki shiah bad ki ñiut kin san ha ki duwan jong ki ; ki briew kin sa pyrta ha ki lumbah ,  To buhrieh ïa ngi !  bad ha ki lumrit ,  To tap ïa ngi .

translation.en: Yea , thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea , or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast .
translation.kha: Phin sngew kumba phi don halor ka duriaw-bah , phi ïohpang duriaw , shah pynshad kynting shajrong ha ka jingshah pynkhih ka liengbah .

translation.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction : but he that refuseth reproof erreth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shahshkor haba ki shah pynbeit kin ïoh im , hynrei kito ki bym pdiang ba ki bakla ki don ha ka jingma .

translation.en: And one of them that stood by drew a sword , and smote a servant of the high priest , and cut off his ear .
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na kita kiba ïa-ïeng hangta u la sei ïa ka waitlam bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ïoh mait ïa ka shkor jong u .

translation.en: If the whole body were an eye , where were the hearing ? If the whole were hearing , where were the smelling ?
translation.kha: Lada ka met baroh kawei ka long tang ka khmat , da kumno yn ïohsngew ? Bad lada ka long tang ka shkor , da kumno yn iw ?

translation.en: I beheld till the thrones were cast down , and the Ancient of days did sit , whose garment was white as snow , and the hair of his head like the pure wool : his throne was like the fiery flame , and his wheels as burning fire .
