translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , la buh ïa ki khet ha la ki jaka . Uta uba la im junom u la shong halor kawei na ki khet . Ki jaiñ jong u ki la long kiba lieh kum ka ïor , bad u shñiuh jong u , u long kum u  saiwul nylla . Ïa ka khet jong u , la buh halor ki shalyntem ding , kaba la klang da ka ding ,

translation.en: If he set his heart upon man , if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath  ;
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u shim noh ïa ka jingpynhiar mynsiem na ka jingim ,

translation.en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them , and shewed them all the house of his precious things , the silver , and the gold , and the spices , and the precious ointment , and all the house of his armour , and all that was found in his treasures : there was nothing in his house , nor in all his dominion , that Hezekiah shewed them not .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nonglamktien bad u pyn-i ha ki ïa ka spah ka phew jong u — ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong u , ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih jong u , bad baroh ki tiar thma ki jong u . Ym don shuh kano kano kaba don ha ki jaka buh tiar jong u lane hangno hangno ha ka hima jong u kaba um shym la pyn-i ha ki .

translation.en: They say unto him , Lord , that our eyes may be opened .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ki la jubab ,  ngi kwah ïa me ban ai ha ngi ka jinglah ban ïohi !

translation.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east , and went up the stairs thereof , and measured the threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad  ; and the other threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad .
translation.kha: Nangta u la leit sha ka khyrdop kaba phai sha mihngi . U la kiew ïa ki mawkyrdon , bad ha kliar u la thew ïa ka tyngkong ; ka la long lai mitar shapoh ha ka jingjylliew .

translation.en: For some , when they had heard , did provoke : howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses .
translation.kha: Kiei kita ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Blei bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ? Baroh kito ïa kiba la ïalam noh na Ijipt da u Moses ?

translation.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom : but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame .
translation.kha: Ka jingsneng bad ka jingpynbeit ki long kiba bha ïa ki khynnah . Lada u khynnah u ïoh leh katba u mon , u pynlehrain ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: And there came a voice to him ,  Rise , Peter  ; kill , and eat .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka la ong ha u ,  Ïeng joit , ko Petros ; to pynïap bad to bam !

translation.en: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes , and thou shalt not eat thereof : thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face , and shall not be restored to thee : thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies , and thou shalt have none to rescue them .
translation.kha: Ïa ki masi jong phi yn pynïap ha khmat jong phi hi , hynrei phin ym ïoh bam ïa ka doh jong ki . Ïa ki kada jong phi yn rong jubor ha khmat jong phi hi , bad yn ym pynphai pat ïa ki sha phi . Ïa ki langbrot jong phi yn ai noh ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad yn ym don ba ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: And as he reasoned of righteousness , temperance , and judgment to come , Felix trembled , and answered , Go thy way for this time  ; when I have a convenient season , I will call for thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei katba u Paul u dang batai shaphang ka jingbha , ka bor halor lade , bad ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan , u Pheliks u la sheptieng bad u la ong ,  Mynta me lah ban leit noh shuwa . Ngan sa phah khot pat haba nga ïohlad .

translation.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple , sweareth by it , and by him that dwelleth therein .
translation.kha: bad haba u smai da ka Templ , u smai da ka bad da U Blei , uba don hangta ;

translation.en: And they waited for me as for the rain  ; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain .
translation.kha: baroh ki pdiang ïa ki kumba ki nongrep ki pdiang sngewbha ïa u slap ha ka por pyrem .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times ? behold , I went out to withstand thee , because thy way is perverse before me :
translation.kha: U angel u la kylli ,  Balei me da sympat kumne ïa la ka kada ha kine lai sien ? Nga la wan ban khang lynti ïa me namar mem shym la dei ban leit sha kane ka jingleit .

translation.en: Make a chain : for the land is full of bloody crimes , and the city is full of violence .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki kulmar lut — ka ri ka kynrei da ki jingïa-pynïap bad ki nongbah ki shlei da ka jingleh thombor .

translation.en: It was said unto her , The elder shall serve the younger .
translation.kha: Hynrei khnang ba ka jingjied ïa uwei u khun shynrang kan long nadong shadong ka jingmih jong ka jingthmu U Blei hi , U Blei u la ong ïa ka ,  U hynmen un shakri ïa u para .  U la ong ïa kane shuwa ba yn kha ïa ki , shuwa ba ki la leh ïa kano kano kaba bha ne kaba sniew ; kumta ïa ka jingjied U Blei la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingkhot jong u , bad ym ha kano kano kaba ki la lah leh .

translation.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous , and despised others :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ruh ïa kane ka pharshi ha ki briew kiba la sngewthikna ïa la ka jingbha jong ki hi bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa baroh kiwei pat .

translation.en: But when ye sin so against the brethren , and wound their weak conscience , ye sin against Christ .
translation.kha: Bad ha kane ka rukom phin leh pop pyrshah ïa U Khrist keiñ da kaba leh pop pyrshah ïa la ki parabangeit bad pynmong ïa ka jingïatiplem batlot jong ki .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Moses , and he said , Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother ? I know that he can speak well . And also , behold , he cometh forth to meet thee : and when he seeth thee , he will be glad in his heart .
translation.kha: Ha kane U  Trai  u la bitar ïa u Moses , bad u ong ,  Kumno shaphang u para jong me U Aaron , u Lebi ? Nga tip u tbit bha ban kren . Ha ka jingshisha , mynta u dang wan ban ïakynduh ïa me bad un kmen ban ïohi ïa me .

translation.en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way , and divide the coasts of thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to inherit , into three parts , that every slayer may flee thither .
translation.kha: phiah ïa kata ka ri ha ki lai bynta . Kawei ka bynta kan don kawei ka shnong ha kaba yn don ruh ka lynti ka syngkien . Te u briew uba pynïap ïano ïano u lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na ki .

translation.en: And he saith unto them , Be not affrighted : Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth , which was crucified : he is risen  ; he is not here : behold the place where they laid him .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u la ong .  Nga tip ba phi ïawad ïa U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa uba la sahnarphna . Um don hangne — u la mihpat ! Ha khmih , hangne ka jaka ha kaba ki la buh ïa u .

translation.en: For the same cause also do ye joy , and rejoice with me .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , phi ruh phi dei ban shadkmen , bad ïasam bynta lem ïa ka jingkmen jong phi bad nga .

translation.en: And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :
translation.kha: Phi khot ïa u , U Kpa , haba phi duwai ha U Blei , uba bishar ïa ki briew baroh da kajuh ka jingthew , katba kum kaei kaba uwei pa uwei u la leh ; kumta te , to pynlut ïa kaba sah ka jingim jong phi hangne ha ka pyrthei ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U .

translation.en: And all the people departed every man to his house : and David returned to bless his house .
translation.kha: Hadien kata baroh ki leit noh sha la ïing , bad u Dabid u la leit sha la ïing ban pynlut katto katne por bad ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: And it was about the space of three hours after , when his wife , not knowing what was done , came in .
translation.kha: Kumba hadien lai kynta , ka tnga jong u , ka bymtip ïa kaba lah jia , ka la wan rung shapoh .

translation.en: Therefore seeing we have this ministry , as we have received mercy , we faint not ;
translation.kha: Kumta ngi iohi ia ka jongisynei jingblei , ba u la ai ha ngi ka jingisynei , te ngim dei ban kyllon

translation.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed : even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice .
translation.kha: Phi leit sha ki lum kiba jrong ban kñia ainguh bad ïathiah shongkha .

translation.en: Therefore , my beloved brethren , be ye stedfast , unmoveable , always abounding in the work of the Lord , forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga , to long phi kiba ïeng skhem bad kiba ïaineh . To long kiba ïai trei minot ïa ka kam U Trai , namar phi tip ba kano kano kaba phi leh ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai kam ju long kaba lehnoh-ei .

translation.en: I will come
translation.kha: Ngan Sa Wan

translation.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments ! then had thy peace been as a river , and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea :
translation.kha: Tang lada phi la sngap ïa ki hukum jong nga ! Te ki jingkyrkhu kin jin da la tuid ha phi kum ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad ! Ka jingjop kan jin da la wan ha phi kum ki jingat phyllung kiba phaloh ha ka rud duriaw .

translation.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south : also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision  ; but they shall fall .
translation.kha: Te shibun ki briew kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . Bad katto katne ki rangbah thombor na ka jaitbynriew jong me , ko Daniel , kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah namar ka jingïohipaw kaba ki la lah ïohi , hynrei kin sa shahjop .

translation.en: Then one of them , which was a lawyer , asked him a question , tempting him , and saying ,
translation.kha: bad uwei na ki , u nonghikai ka Hukum , u la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da ka jingkylli .

translation.en: My lord asked his servants , saying , Have ye a father , or a brother ?
translation.kha: Kynrad , phi la kylli ïa ngi , ‘ Phi dang don kpa ne phi dang don para shynrang shuh ?’

translation.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments , which I have loved  ; and I will meditate in thy statutes .
translation.kha: Nga burom bad nga ieit ïa ki hukum jong me ; ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .

translation.en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter : for thy heart is not right in the sight of God .
translation.kha: Mem don bynta lane ïoh bynta ha ka kam jong ngi , namar ka dohnud jong me kam long kaba beit ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa , and the disciples had heard that Peter was there , they sent unto him two men , desiring him that he would not delay to come to them .
translation.kha: Ka Joppa kam shym da jngai na Lydda , bad haba ki parabangeit ha Joppa ki la ïohsngew ba u Petros u la don ha Lydda , ki la phah ar ngut ki rangbah sha u lem bad ka khubor ,  To pynkloi bad wan sha ngi .

translation.en: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .
translation.kha: Wat rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba ki briew ki ïakhawai . Wat shong bad ki ban bam bad dih .

translation.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me , the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la siat da ki khnam ïa nga , bad ka bih jong ki ka par baroh kawei ka met jong nga . Da ki jingshyrkhei U Blei u la pynap riang pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And he went down , and talked with the woman  ; and she pleased Samson well .
translation.kha: Nangta u leit ïakren bad kata ka kynthei , bad u la itynnat ïa ka .

translation.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge ,
translation.kha: Nga la thoh laiphew tylli ki jingkren na ka bynta jong phi . Ki kynthup ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingkyntu babha ,

translation.en: And Moses told it unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata kaba u Moses u la ong ha u Aaron , ha ki khun shynrang u Aaron , bad ha ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u kan long kaba don ba em bad kaba riewspah ; bad un roi kyrhai junom .

translation.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine . So Pharaoh awoke .
translation.kha: bad kita ki masi kynthei kiba raikhoh ki la bam lut plain ïa kita ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid . Nangta u syiem u la kyndit thiah .

translation.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw ka long kaba bha ; ym dei ban kyntait ei ei , hynrei ïa kiei kiei baroh dei ban pdiang lem bad ka jingduwai sngewnguh , namar ïa ka la pynkyntang da ka ktien U Blei bad ka jingduwai , kiba pynlong ïa ki ba la pdiang da U Blei .

translation.en: The memory of the just is blessed : but the name of the wicked shall rot .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba bha yn ïai kynmaw kum ka jingkyrkhu ; hynrei ïa ki riewbymman yn klet noh .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that every place shall be , where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings , it shall even be for briers and thorns .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ki bri sohwaiñ babha , kawei kawei ka don shihajar tylli ki dieng sohwaiñ bad kawei kawei ka shongdor shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , kin shlei da ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ .

translation.en: And Rebekah had a brother , and his name was Laban : and Laban ran out unto the man , unto the well .
translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka don u hynmen uba kyrteng u Laban ; bad u Laban u la mareh bran bran shabar ban leit sha kata ka pukri ha kaba u shakri jong u Abraham u don .

translation.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art , to bring thee in , to give thee their land for an inheritance , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Katba nang ïaid sha khmat , u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi , khnang ba un buh ïa phi ha ka ri jong ki , bad ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi .

translation.en: He said moreover , I have somewhat to say unto thee . And she said , Say on .
translation.kha: bad nangta u bynrap ,  Nga don ei ei ban kylli na phi .   Kaei kata ?  ka kylli .

translation.en: For unto us was the gospel preached , as well as unto them : but the word preached did not profit them , not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .
translation.kha: Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka Khubor Babha , kumba ma ki ruh ki la ïohsngew . Ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ruh ïa ki , namar haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , kim shym la pdiang ïa ka da ka jingngeit .

translation.en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the  Lord  exceedingly .
translation.kha: bad u la sher dara hajan ka Sodom , kaba ki briew jong ka , ki la long kiba bymman bad kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: But it came to pass , when Ahab was dead , that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Ahab u syiem Israel u la ïap , u Mesha u ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And all the people came up after him , and the people piped with pipes , and rejoiced with great joy , so that the earth rent with the sound of them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki baroh ki la ïabud ïa u , da ka jingrisa jam bad put ïa ki sharati , da kaba pynmih ka jingsawa kaba jur kat ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: When the wicked cometh , then cometh also contempt , and with ignominy reproach .
translation.kha: Ka pop bad ka jinglehrain ki ïaid lang . Pynjah noh ïa ka burom jong phi , bad phin ïoh ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ ha ka jaka jong ka .

translation.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so : for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewbha ïa kata ka jingai jingmut bad ki la ïamynjur .

translation.en: Six days thou shalt work , but on the seventh day thou shalt rest : in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei jingtrei , hynrei wat trei ei ei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , wat la ka long ha ka aïom lur ne ka aïom ot .

translation.en: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle s son , that was in Anathoth , and weighed him the money , even seventeen shekels of silver .
translation.kha: Nga la thied ïa ka lyngkha na u Hanamel bad nga thew ïa ka pisa na ka bynta jong u ; ka shongdor khathynñiew lyngkhot ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah , after that the king had burned the roll , and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba u syiem Jehoïakim u la lah thang ïa ka kot kli kaba nga la ong ha u Barukh ban thoh ,

translation.en: And all the people , even the people of war that were with him , went up , and drew nigh , and came before the city , and pitched on the north side of Ai : now there was a valley between them and Ai .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ki shipai ki ïaleit sha ka khyrdop bah jong ka nongbah bad ki sher dara ha ka phang bashatei , ha kaba don ka them hapdeng jong ki bad ka Ai .

translation.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king , for her bowels yearned upon her son , and she said , O my lord , give her the living child , and in no wise slay it . But the other said , Let it be neither mine nor thine , but divide it .
translation.kha: Ka kmie kaba shisha , da ka dohnud kaba shlei da ka jingieit ïa la u khun , ka ong ha u syiem ,  Sngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka !  Hynrei kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong ,  Wat ai ïa u hano hano na ngi ; to leh bad phiah arliang ïa u .

translation.en: And I contended with them , and cursed them , and smote certain of them , and plucked off their hair , and made them swear by God , saying , Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons , nor take their daughters unto your sons , or for yourselves .
translation.kha: Nga la sneng ïa ki rangbah , nga la tim ïa ki , shoh ïa ki bad pajut ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Nangta nga la pynlong ïa ki ban smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei ba kim dei shuh ba ma ki ne ki khun jong ki kin shongkha khleh bad ki nongwei .

translation.en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened , and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped .
translation.kha: Kiba matlah kin lah ban ïohi , bad kiba kyllut kin ïohsngew .

translation.en: Set up the standard toward Zion : retire , stay not : for I will bring evil from the north , and a great destruction .
translation.kha: To kdew ïa ka lynti sha Seïon ! To phet ban lait im ! Wat ym pynslem ! U  Trai  u wallam ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot kaba khraw na shatei .

translation.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the  Lord  God of Israel , and to speak against him , saying , As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand , so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand .
translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u patsha u la thoh ka kren pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . Ka ong ,  Ki blei jong ki hima kim shym lah ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jong nga , bad da lei lei U Blei jong u Hesekaïah un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa la ki briew na nga .

translation.en: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates , until thy high and fenced walls come down , wherein thou trustedst , throughout all thy land : and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .
translation.kha: Kin tur pyrshah ïa ki shnong jong phi baroh ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , bad ki kynroh kiba jrong bad kiba skhem ha kiba ai jingshngain ïa phi kin kyllon .

translation.en: Assemble yourselves and come  ; draw near together , ye that are escaped of the nations : they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image , and pray unto a god that cannot save .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ale lang , ko ki briew jong ki hima , baroh kiba lait im na ka jingkyllon ka hima-patsha ; ai ïa lade na ka bynta ka jingbishar ! Ki briew kiba ïaid bad la ki bleithaw kiba da ki dieng bad duwai sha ki blei ki bym lah ban pynim ïa ki — kito ki briew ki bymtip ei ei satia !

translation.en: Will a man rob God ? Yet ye have robbed me . But ye say , Wherein have we robbed thee ? In tithes and offerings .
translation.kha: Nga kylli ïa phi , hato ka long kaba dei ba u briew un shukor ïa U Blei ? Ha ka jingshisha ym dei , pynban phi shukor ïa nga . ‘ Da kumno ?’ phi kylli . Ha kaba ïadei shaphang kawei-na-kaba-shiphew bad ki jingainguh .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you , and perform my good word toward you , in causing you to return to this place .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Haba ki hynñiewphew snem jong ka Babilonia ki la kut , ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia jong nga na ka bynta jong phi bad bat ïa ka kular jong nga ban wallam pat ïa phi sha ïing .

translation.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .
translation.kha: bad sa ar tylli ki jingker ïa ki dong jong ka .

translation.en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus , when I went into Macedonia , that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine ,
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa me ba men sah ha Ephesos , kumba nga la bthah ïa me mynba nga la don ha ka lynti sha Makedonia . Don na ki briew hangta kiba la ai ïa ki jinghikai lamler , bad me dei ban maham ïa ki ban sangeh .

translation.en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow , because her hour is come : but as soon as she is delivered of the child , she remembereth no more the anguish , for joy that a man is born into the world .
translation.kha: Haba ka briew kan sa kha khun , ka sngewsih namar ba ka kynta jong ka jingshahshitom jong ka , ka la poi ; hynrei haba la kha ïa i khunlung , ka klet noh ïa la ka jingshah shitom , namar ka kmen ba la kha ïa i khunlung sha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And when he had given thanks , he brake it , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body , which is broken for you : this do in remembrance of me .
translation.kha: Naba nga la ïohpdiang na U Trai ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai pateng ha phi : Ba U Trai Jisu , ha kata ka miet ha kaba la shetkylla ïa u , u la shim ïa u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ong ,  Une u long ka met jong nga , na ka bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .

translation.en: Love not sleep , lest thou come to poverty  ; open thine eyes , and thou shalt be satisfied with bread .
translation.kha: Lada phi pynlut ïa ka por ha kaba thiah , phin long uba duk . Ïai trei shitom bad phin ïoh kyrhai ka bam .

translation.en: But when his heart was lifted up , and his mind hardened in pride , he was deposed from his kingly throne , and they took his glory from him :
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u la long uba sarong , uba eh ryndang , bad uba runar , la weng noh ïa u na ka khet syiem bad u la duh noh ïa ka jaka badonburom jong u .

translation.en: Honour and majesty are before him : strength and beauty are in his sanctuary .
translation.kha: Ka burom bad ka main longsyiem ki ker sawdong ïa u ; ka bor bad ka jingitynnat ki pyndap ïa ka Templ jong u .

translation.en: And his brethren said to him , Shalt thou indeed reign over us ? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us ? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams , and for his words .
translation.kha: Hato me pyrkhat ba men sa long u syiem bad synshar ïa ngi ?  Ki hynmen shynrang jong u ki ong . Kumta ki la nang kham isih shuh shuh ïa u namar ki jingphohsniew jong u bad namar kaei kaba ba u la kren shaphang jong ki .

translation.en: And Atroth Shophan , and Jaazer , and Jogbehah ,
translation.kha: Atroth Shophan , Jaser , Jogbehah ,

translation.en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die : yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die .
translation.kha: Ka long kaei kaei kaba eh ïa uno uno ban ïap na ka bynta u briew uba hok . Ka lah ban long ba don uno uno uba nud ban ïap na ka bynta u briew uba bha .

translation.en: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee  ; this is thy wickedness , because it is bitter , because it reacheth unto thine heart .
translation.kha: Ko Judah , pha la wallam ïa kane halor lade da ka rukom kaba pha la im bad da kiei kiei kiba pha la leh . Ka pop jong pha ka la pynjia ïa kane ka jingjynjar ; ka la dung ïa pha lyngba ka dohnud .

translation.en: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird , and with the running water , and with the living bird , and with the cedar wood , and with the hyssop , and with the scarlet :
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing da ka snam jong kata ka sim , ka um sngur , ka sim kaba dang im , u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u tnat Hissop , bad u  saiwul saw .

translation.en: And Moses said before the  Lord  , Behold , I am of uncircumcised lips , and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u la jubab ,  Me tip ba nga long uba duna ha ka ktien ka thylliej ; kumno keiñ u Pharaoh un shahshkor ïa nga ?

translation.en: To offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening , and to do according to all that is written in the law of the  Lord  , which he commanded Israel  ;
translation.kha: Man ka step bad man ka janmiet kin thang tylli ïa ki jingkñia ha ka duwan kat kum ba la thoh ha ka Hukum kumba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin , so shall thy sons marry thee : and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride , so shall thy God rejoice over thee .
translation.kha: Kum u samla uba shim ïa ka theisotti kum ka nongleitkurim jong u , uta uba pynlong ïa pha un shongkurim ïa pha , kumba u nongleitkurim u shem sngewbha bad ka nongleitkurim jong u , kumta U Blei jong pha un shem sngewbha ïa pha .

translation.en: But new wine must be put into new bottles  ; and both are preserved .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka waiñ bathymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai !

translation.en: Send therefore now , and gather thy cattle , and all that thou hast in the field  ; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field , and shall not be brought home , the hail shall come down upon them , and they shall die .
translation.kha: Mynta ai hukum ban pynrieh ïa ki jingri jong me bad ïa kiwei kiwei pat baroh kiba me don ha lum . U phria un hap ha ki briew bad ki mrad kiba don habar khlem jingda , bad baroh kin ïap lut .’

translation.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger : for these pine away , stricken through for want of the fruits of the field .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma ki la long kiba kham bit ban ïa kito kiba ïap hadien , kiba ïap suki ha ka jingthngan , khlem kano kano ka jingbam ban ri pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: If there be a messenger with him , an interpreter , one among a thousand , to shew unto man his uprightness :
translation.kha: Lehse u angel u lah ban wan ïarap ïa u — uwei na ki hajar ki angel jong U Blei , uba pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa ki kamram jong ki .

translation.en: And all the men were about twelve .
translation.kha: Ki la don baroh khat-ar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: She crieth at the gates , at the entry of the city , at the coming in at the doors .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka rung sha ka nongbah , harud ki khyrdop , ka pyrta :

translation.en: When Jesus had thus said , he was troubled in spirit , and testified , and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la ong ïa kane , u la khuslai jur bad u la pynbna da kaba shai ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uwei na phi un sa shetkylla ïa nga .

translation.en: Son of man , What is the vine tree more than any tree , or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kumno yn nujor ïa u dieng sohwaiñ bad u dieng ? Ka bha aïu ka tnat u dieng sohwaiñ haba nujor bad ki dieng ha khlaw ?

translation.en: And he was casting out a devil , and it was dumb . And it came to pass , when the devil was gone out , the dumb spake  ; and the people wondered .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang beh noh ïa u ksuid u bym lah ban kren ; bad haba u ksuid u la mihnoh , uta u briew u la sdang ban kren . Ki paidbah ki la sngewlyngngoh ,

translation.en: He answered them , I have told you already , and ye did not hear : wherefore would ye hear it again ? will ye also be his disciples ?
translation.kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa phi ,  u la jubab ,  bad phim shym la shahshkor . Balei ba phi kwah ban ïohsngew biang ïa ka ? Lehse ma phi , ruh , phi kwah ban long ki synran jong u ?

translation.en: And he was driven from the sons of men  ; and his heart was made like the beasts , and his dwelling was with the wild asses : they fed him with grass like oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven  ; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men , and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will .
translation.kha: La beh noh ïa u na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew , bad ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u ka la long kum u mrad . U la shong la sah bad ki kada khlaw , u la bam phlang kum u masi dab bad u la thiah ha ka jaka bym don jingkah khlem kano kano ka ban ïada ïa u na ka umjer . Ha kaba khatduh u la pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u synshar ïa baroh ki hima ki briew bad u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .

translation.en: Then said the Jews , Forty and six years was this temple in building , and wilt thou rear it up in three days ?
translation.kha: Hato men tei pat ïa ka ha ki lai sngi ?  ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ka la shim por sawphew hynriew snem ban tei ïa kane ka Templ !

translation.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday , and to day , and for ever .
translation.kha: U Jisu Khrist u long ujuh mynhynnin , mynta bad sha ki bymjukut .

translation.en: Then the glory of the  Lord  departed from off the threshold of the house , and stood over the cherubims .
translation.kha: Te ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka mihnoh na ka jaka rung ka Templ bad ka ïaid shaphang ka jaka kaba halor kita ki jingthaw .

translation.en: But he that heareth , and doeth not , is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth  ; against which the stream did beat vehemently , and immediately it fell  ; and the ruin of that house was great .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba la tei ïa la ka ïing khlem da pynshong nongrim ; haba ka jingshlei um ka lynshop ïa kata ka ïing , ka khyllem shisyndon — bad katno ka jingkhyllem kaba shyrkhei kata ka la long !

translation.en: And she arose , and went away , and laid by her veil from her , and put on the garments of her widowhood .
translation.kha: Ka Tamar ka la leit phai pat sha la ïing , ka law noh ïa ka jingkah khmat , bad ka phong biang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei .

translation.en: And Samuel said unto the people , Fear not : ye have done all this wickedness : yet turn not aside from following the  Lord  , but serve the  Lord  with all your heart  ;
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Wat sheptieng ; la phi la leh ïa ka kam bymman , wat phai noh na U  Trai  , hynrei shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness , and judgment , and equity  ; yea , every good path .
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa nga , phin sa tip kaei kaba dei , kaba hok , bad kaba ïaid beit . Phin sa tip ïa kaei kaba phi dei ban leh .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Why art thou , being the king s son , lean from day to day ? wilt thou not tell me ? And Amnon said unto him , I love Tamar , my brother Absalom s sister .
translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Amnon ,  Phi dei u khun jong u syiem ; pynban na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat nga ïohi ba phi i sngewsih . Jia aïu ?   Nga ibha ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u Absalom , uba ïalong shi para bad nga na ijuh i pa ,  u la jubab .

translation.en: Then said Thomas , which is called Didymus , unto his fellowdisciples , Let us also go , that we may die with him .
translation.kha: U Thomas ( ïa uba la khot uba Kha Synrap ) u la ong ha la ki para synran ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh bad u Nonghikai , ba ngin ïa-ïap ryngkat bad u !

translation.en: But , behold , the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ha khmih ! Uta uba shetkylla ïa nga u don hangne ha ka miej lem bad nga !

translation.en: Slay utterly old and young , both maids , and little children , and women : but come not near any man upon whom is the mark  ; and begin at my sanctuary . Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki tymmen , ki samla shynrang , ki samla kynthei , ki longkmie bad ki khynnah rit . Hynrei wat ktah kti ïa uno uno uba don ka dak ha ka shyllangmat jong u . Sdang nangne na ka Templ jong nga .  Kumta ki la sdang na ki nongïalam kiba ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge : for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol ; and their conscience being weak is defiled .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym baroh uba tip ïa kane ka jingshisha . Don ki briew kiba la ju myllen bad ki bleithaw ba haduh kane ka sngi haba ki bam kum ïa kata ka jingbam ki dang pyrkhat hi ïa ka kum ka jingbam kaba dei jong ka bleithaw ; ka jingïatiplem jong ki ka long kaba tlot , bad ki sngew ba la pynjakhlia ïa ki da kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: Then said the king to Amasa , Assemble me the men of Judah within three days , and be thou here present .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Amasa ,  Khot lang ïa ki rangbah Judah bad wan biang shane la shi sngi lem bad ki .

translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul , and after his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , the sons of Saul .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki , bad ki la pynïap ïa lai ngut na ki khun shynrang jong u Saul , u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .

translation.en: But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field , and the man force her , and lie with her : then the man only that lay with her shall die :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïakynduh ha lum ïa ka briew kaba la ïatehktien bad uwei pat u briew , bad u batbor ïa ka , dei ban pynïap tang ïa uta u shynrang .

translation.en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs , and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta u sait ïa ki doh jem bad ïa ki kjat-dien bad u thang lang ïa ki ha ka duwan halor kita kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Gog , the land of Magog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal , and prophesy against him ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa u Gog , u nongsynshar rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew Meshekh bad Tubal ha ka ri Magog .

translation.en: And this is the record of John , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , Who art thou ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ha Jerusalem ki la phah katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi sha u Ïoannis , ban kylli ïa u ,  Me dei uei ?

translation.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind , a light of them which are in darkness ,
translation.kha: Bad phi thikna ba phi long daladie  u nongïalam ïa uba matlah , ka jingshai ïa kito kiba ha ka jingdum ,

translation.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shadow from the heat , when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall .
translation.kha: Kiba duk bad ki bym don jingïarap ki phet sha me bad ki shongshngain ha ki por ka jingjynjar . Me ai jakarieh ïa ki na ki  erïong bad ka jakarieh tngen na ka jingshit kyr-ang . Ki riewrunar ki tur ïaleh kum ka  erïong tlang ,

translation.en: But now bring me a minstrel . And it came to pass , when the minstrel played , that the hand of the  Lord  came upon him .
translation.kha: Mynta wallam ha nga ïa u nongtem .  Katba u nongtem u dang tem ïa la ka duitara , ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan halor u Elisha ,

translation.en: And they that heard it said , Who then can be saved ?
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la kylli ,  Mano , te , uba lah ban lait im ?

translation.en: And it shall be , when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain , that we will say unto them , Be favourable unto them for our sakes : because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war : for ye did not give unto them at this time , that ye should be guilty .
translation.kha: Lada ki kpa lane ki hynmen shynrang jong ki , ki wan ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi , phi lah ban ong , ‘ Sngewbha shah ba kin don bad ngi , namar ngim shym shim ïa ki na phi ha ka madan thma ban long ki tnga jong ngi . Bad haba phim shym la ai ïa ki ha ngi , phim long kiba la pynrem ba phi la pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular .’

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , U  Trai  un siaw kum ka dak ïa ki Ijipt ban wan kum ki skain na ki shnat kiba jngai eh jong ka wah Nile , bad ïa ki Assyria ban wan kum ki ngap na ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master , and departed  ; for all the goods of his master were in his hand : and he arose , and went to Mesopotamia , unto the city of Nahor .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri uba peit halor ki jingdon jingem jong u Abraham , u shim shiphew tylli ki ut jong u kynrad jong u bad u leit sha ka nongbah ha kaba u Nahor u shong u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shatei ka ri Mesopotamia .

translation.en: And now , saith the  Lord  that formed me from the womb to be his servant , to bring Jacob again to him , Though Israel be not gathered , yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the  Lord  , and my God shall be my strength .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kha ïa nga , U  Trai  u la thung ïa nga ; u la pynlong ïa nga u shakri jong u ban wallam pat ïa ki briew jong u , ban wallam pat ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba la saphriang kylleng . U  Trai  u ai ha nga ka burom ; u long u tyllong jong ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga .

translation.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit  ; and they shall prophesy :
translation.kha: Ho-oid , wat ha ki shakri jong nga , baroh shynrang bad kynthei , ngan theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha kita ki sngi , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga .

translation.en: My brethren , have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Lord of glory , with respect of persons .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kum kiba ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Trai ka burom , phim dei ban ñiew ïa ki parabriew da ki rukom kiba pher na kaei kaba ïohi ïa ki na shabar .

translation.en: But howsoever , said he , let me run . And he said unto him , Run . Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain , and overran Cushi .
translation.kha: Long katba ka long ,  u Ahimaas u ong biang ,  Nga kwah ban leit .   Khie leit ,  u Joab u ong . Kumta u Ahimaas u mareh bran na ka lynti kaba na ka Them Jordan , bad shen u la tam ïa uta u mraw .

translation.en: Send therefore to Joppa , and call hither Simon , whose surname is Peter  ; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side : who , when he cometh , shall speak unto thee .
translation.kha: Phah ïano ïano sha Joppa ban shem ïa u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros . U shong basa ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u nongpdem snieh , uba shong basah harud duriaw .’

translation.en: And Joseph s master took him , and put him into the prison , a place where the king s prisoners were bound : and he was there in the prison .
translation.kha: bad u la phah kem ïa u Joseph bad u set ïa u ha ka byndi ha ka jaka ba la set ïa ki koidi jong u syiem , bad hangta la pynsah ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the law , that he rent his clothes .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingpule na kata ka kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih

translation.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters .
translation.kha: U la don hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang bad lai ngut ki khun kynthei , bad u don ruh hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot , lai hajar tylli ki ut , shihajar tylli ki masi dab , bad sanspah tylli ki kada .

translation.en: Wherefore I beseech you , be ye followers of me .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , namarkata , ba phin pyrthuh bud ïa nga .

translation.en: That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba ma phi bad ma nga ngin ïoh ka jingïarap ha kajuh ka por , ma phi da ka jingngeit jong nga bad ma nga da ka jong phi .

translation.en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart : but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king s gate , that he stood not up , nor moved for him , he was full of indignation against Mordecai .
translation.kha: Haba u Haman u la mihnoh na ka jingkhawai u la kmen bad dap da ka jingsngewbha . Hynrei u ïohi pat ïa u Mordekai ha ka khyrdop bad um shym la ïeng lane pyn-i kano kano ka dak jong ka jingburom haba u ïaid nangta , u Haman u la bitar ïa u .

translation.en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified . And they took Jesus , and led him away .
translation.kha: Te u Pilat u la aiti noh ïa U Jisu sha ki ïa ka ban sahnarphna . Kumta ki la shimti noh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And , behold , I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance , for their service which they serve , even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la ai ha ki Lebi ïa ka bynta kaba shiphew baroh ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga . Kane ka long ka jingsiew ïa ka jingshakri jong ki ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , I waited for your words  ; I gave ear to your reasons , whilst ye searched out what to say .
translation.kha: Nga la shahshkor bha katba phi dang kren bad nga ap katba phi dang sei ïa la ki jingkren bastad .

translation.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ha ngi ka jingsngewskhem ha phi , bad ngi thikna ba phi leh bad phin ïai leh ïa kaei kaba ngi ong ïa phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Fear him not : for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land  ; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wat sheptieng ïa u . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u , ïa ki briew jong u baroh , bad ïa ka ri jong u . Leh ïa u kumba me la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .

translation.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one bullock  ; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one ram  ;
translation.kha: Kum ka jingainguh bam , wanrah u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw ; ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ;

translation.en: And when they were departed from him , ( for they left him in great diseases , ) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest , and slew him on his bed , and he died : and they buried him in the city of David , but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings .
translation.kha: U la mynsaw jur , bad haba ki nongshun ki la leit noh , ar ngut ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka jingthiah jong u ban pynhiarkput ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u khun jong u Jehoïada , u lyngdoh . La tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .

translation.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together , and encamp against the city , and take it : lest I take the city , and it be called after my name .
translation.kha: Mynta , lumlang ïa kiba sah jong ki shipai jong phi , tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , bad knieh ïa ka da lade hi . Ngam kwah ban ïoh ka burom ïa ka jingïohknieh ïa ka .

translation.en: Many will entreat the favour of the prince : and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts .
translation.kha: Baroh ki pyrshang ban shem sngewbha bad ki briew kiba khraw ; baroh ki kob ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad kito kiba lah ban pynsngewbha .

translation.en: But ye are forgers of lies , ye are all physicians of no value .
translation.kha: Me tap ïa ka jingbymtip jong me da ka jingshukor ; Me long kum ki doktor ki bym lah ban pynkoit ïano ïano .

translation.en: And immediately he rose up before them , and took up that whereon he lay , and departed to his own house , glorifying God .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la khie joit ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la shim ïa ka jingthiah ha kaba u la thiah bad u la leit noh sha ïing , da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Kerioth is taken , and the strong holds are surprised , and the mighty men s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki shnong bad ki kut yn kurup . Ha kata ka sngi ki shipai jong ka Moab kin sheptieng kum ka briew kaba suh kha .

translation.en: And it came to pass on a certain day , as he was teaching , that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by , which were come out of every town of Galilee , and Judaea , and Jerusalem : and the power of the Lord was present to heal them .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u dang hikai , katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka shnong na Galilaïa bad Judia bad na Jerusalem ; ki la ïashong hangta . Ka bor jong U Trai ka la don na ka bynta U Jisu ban pynkhiah ïa kiba pang .

translation.en: And Saul said unto the Kenites , Go , depart , get you down from among the Amalekites , lest I destroy you with them : for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel , when they came up out of Egypt . So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites .
translation.kha: U la phah ka jingmaham sha ki Ken , ki briew kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la lehsbun ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt :  Khie leit bad iehnoh ïa ki Amalek , ba kumta ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lem bad ki .  Kumta ki Ken ki mihnoh .

translation.en: So then neither is he that planteth any thing , neither he that watereth ; but God that giveth the increase .
translation.kha: Uta uba bet bad uta uba ai um kim long ei ei da shisha . Dei U Blei uba kongsan , namar u pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san .

translation.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread  ; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning .
translation.kha: Wat ainguh ha nga da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi kñia ïa ka mrad ha nga . Ym bit ban ieh haduh mynstep ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la kñia ha nga ha kine ki Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the plague be turned into white  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : he is clean .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka prum ka la kylla lieh , uta u briew u long uba khuid , bad uta u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Nevertheless the king s word prevailed against Joab . Wherefore Joab departed , and went throughout all Israel , and came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u pynkohnguh ïa u Joab ban leh ïa ka hukum jong u . U Joab u mihnoh , u la leit lyngba ka ri Israel baroh kawei , bad nangta u wan phai pat sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And she said to her father , Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee  ; for the custom of women is upon me . And he searched , but found not the images .
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ha la u kpa ,  Wat bitar ïa nga , ko kynrad , hynrei ngam lah ban ïeng ha khmat jong phi , nga dang poi bnai .  U Laban u la wad , hynrei um shym la shem satia ïa kita ki blei ïing jong u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them : but shalt well remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Pharaoh , and unto all Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki ; hynrei to ïai kynmaw aïu U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh .

translation.en: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents , saying , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me five talents : behold , I have gained beside them five talents more .
translation.kha: U shakri uba la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ai ïa kiwei ki san hajar . ‘ Ko kynrad , me la ai ha nga san hajar tylli ki sbai ,’ u la ong . ‘ Ha khmih ! Kine hangne sa san hajar tylli kiba nga la ïohnong .’

translation.en: So that his life abhorreth bread , and his soul dainty meat .
translation.kha: U briew uba pang u duh noh ïa ka jingkwah ban bam , bad wat ka jingbam kaba bang tam ka pyn-i ngiah .

translation.en: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved , even as they .
translation.kha: Em ! Ngi ngeit bad la pynim ïa ngi da ka jingaiei jong U Trai Jisu , kumba long ma ki .

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,

translation.en: Hear , ye children , the instruction of a father , and attend to know understanding .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , to shahshkor ïa kaei ba u kpa jong phi u hikai ïa phi . Shahshkor bha , bad phin ïoh ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Ye blind guides , which strain at a gnat , and swallow a camel .
translation.kha: Ko ki nonglam lynti bamatlah ! Phi pjiar ïa u skain na ka jingdih jong phi , hynrei phi nguid ïa ka ut !

translation.en: And ye went over Jordan , and came unto Jericho : and the men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Girgashites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; and I delivered them into your hand .
translation.kha: Phi la jam ïa ka Jordan bad wan poi sha ka Jerikho . Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , kumba la leh ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Hib bad ki Jebus . Hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Mine eyes do fail with tears , my bowels are troubled , my liver is poured upon the earth , for the destruction of the daughter of my people  ; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka ki ud katba ki wad ei ei ban bam ; ki ïa-bujli ïa la ki jingkynshew na ka bynta ka jingbam ban pynsah im ïa lade .  To khmih sha nga , A  Trai  ,  ka nongbah ka kyang ;  to peit ïa nga ha ka jinglong rangli jong nga .

translation.en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan , and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain , and pitched his tent toward Sodom .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shong la sah ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u Lot u la shong la sah hapdeng ki nongbah ha ka them

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against mount Seir , and prophesy against it ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri Edom .

translation.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness , who have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , and worshipped the works of their own hands .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki la leh pop ; ki la phai dien noh na nga , ki la ai jingkñia sha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la shna ïa ki bleithaw bad mane ïa ki .

translation.en: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin  ; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah .
translation.kha: Ki leit ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin , bad ki pynïeng ïa ki shipai marpyrshah kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba tip kaba kumno ka long ban shah pynshitom ha U Blei .

translation.en: And they tarried till they were ashamed : and , behold , he opened not the doors of the parlour  ; therefore they took a key , and opened them : and , behold , their lord was fallen down dead on the earth .
translation.kha: Ki la ap haduh ba ki dang lah ban ap , hynrei haba um shym la plie ïa ka jingkhang , ki la shim ïa u shabi bad plie ïa ka . Bad hangta u don u kynrad jong ki , u da thiah ïap ha madan .

translation.en: As he saith also in Osee , I will call them my people , which were not my people ; and her beloved , which was not beloved .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong ha ka Kitab U Hosia :  Ki briew ki bym shym la long ki jong nga ngan khot ‘Ki Briew jong nga .’ Ka jaitbynriew kaba ngam shym la ieit ngan khot ‘Kaba ieit jong nga .’

translation.en: And no sin offering , whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place , shall be eaten : it shall be burnt in the fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada wanrah wat tang khyndiat na ka snam shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba lehniam ban ïohmap ïa ki pop , ïa u mrad ym dei ban bam ; dei ban thang lut khoit ïa u .

translation.en: He hath put my brethren far from me , and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me .
translation.kha: U Blei u pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para jong nga ban iehnoh ïa nga ; nga kylla long u nongwei ha kito kiba ithuh ïa nga ;

translation.en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last first .
translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba long nyngkong mynta kin sa long khatduh , bad bun kiba long khatduh mynta kin sa long nyngkong .

translation.en: And when Moses heard that , he was content .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewhun .

translation.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man s wife , even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour s wife , the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u klim bad ka tnga jong u para Israel , ma u bad kata ka kynthei kin shah pynïap .

translation.en: And he said , While the child was yet alive , I fasted and wept : for I said , Who can tell whether  God  will be gracious to me , that the child may live ?
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  u Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la shahjingit bad ïam katba i dang im . Nga la pyrkhat ba U  Trai  lehse un sngewsynei ïa nga bad un ym shah ba i khunlung in ïap .

translation.en: The son of Zerahiah , the son of Uzzi , the son of Bukki ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Serahaïah , u khun jong u Ussi , u khun jong u Bukki ,

translation.en: And they said , The Lord hath need of him .
translation.kha: U Kynrad u donkam ïa u ,  ki la jubab , bad ki la ïalam ïa u khun kada sha U Jisu .

translation.en: And it was so , that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance , he put forth his hand , and took him , and kissed him .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u wan hajan u Absalom ban nguh ha khmat jong u , u Absalom u ju kner la ki kti , u bat ïa u , bad u doh ïa u .

translation.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners , and stripes for the back of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit uba sngewmeng u thikna ban ïoh ïa ka jingshah sympat .

translation.en: For they prophesy a lie unto you , to remove you far from your land  ; and that I should drive you out , and ye should perish .
translation.kha: Ki da shukor ïa phi bad kin pynlong ïa phi ban shah rah sha jngai na ka ri jong phi . Ngan beh noh shabar ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn pynjot noh .

translation.en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem , he assayed to join himself to the disciples : but they were all afraid of him , and believed not that he was a disciple .
translation.kha: U Saul u la leit sha Jerusalem bad u la pyrshang ban ïasoh bad ki synran . Hynrei kim lah ban ngeit ba u la long u synran , bad baroh ki la sheptieng ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan .
translation.kha: Phin tip ba U Blei uba im u don hapdeng jong phi haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  jong ka pyrthei baroh kan jam ïa ka Jordan ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again , because he feared him .
translation.kha: U Ishbosheth u la sheptieng eh ïa u Abner kat haduh ba um nang ang wat tang shikyntien ruh .

translation.en: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :
translation.kha: Reuben , khun phrangsngi jong nga , Me long ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , U soh nyngkong ka jinglong rangbah jong nga , Uba sarong tam bad uba khlaiñ tam Na ki khun jong nga baroh .

translation.en: Those things , which ye have both learned , and received , and heard , and seen in me , do : and the God of peace shall be with you .
translation.kha: Pyntreikam ïa kaei kaba phi la nang bad ïohpdiang na nga , na ki ktien jong nga bad ki kam jong nga . Bad U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk , un long lem bad phi .

translation.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace , that we may obtain mercy , and find grace to help in time of need .
translation.kha: To ngin sngewskhem , te , bad leit sha ka khet U Blei , ha kaba don ka jingaiei . Hangta ngin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei bad ngin shem ïa ka jingaiei ka ban ïarap ïa ngi ha ka por ba ngi donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing : this hath more rest than the other .
translation.kha: Im ïohi da lei lei ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi lane tip kumno ka jingim ka long , hynrei la kumno kumno i la shem ka jingjahthait —

translation.en: And this is the blessing of Judah : and he said , Hear ,  Lord  , the voice of Judah , and bring him unto his people : let his hands be sufficient for him  ; and be thou an help to him from his enemies .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Judah u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , to shahshkor haba ki kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap ; Tehsong ïa ki kawei bad la ki para jait . Ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki , ko  Trai  , Bad ïarap ïa ki pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: At that time Jesus answered and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Kpa , U Trai ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me namar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymstad ïa kaei kaba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba la ïoh jinghikai .

translation.en: For the  Lord  shall smite Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water , and he shall root up Israel out of this good land , which he gave to their fathers , and shall scatter them beyond the river , because they have made their groves , provoking the  Lord  to anger .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki Israel , bad kan khynñiuh kumba pynkhih ïa u khah ha ka wahduid . Un rat dyngkhong ïa ki paid Israel na kane ka ri kaba bha kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad un pynsakma ïa ki sha lyndet ka wah Ïuphratis , namar ba ki la pynbitar lep ïa u da kaba thaw ïa ki bleithaw jong ka blei Asherah .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath chosen Jacob unto himself , and Israel for his peculiar treasure .
translation.kha: U la jied ïa u Jakob na ka bynta ïa lade , ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta jong u hi .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  This is my blood of the new testament , which is shed for many .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam jong nga ïa kaba la pynmih na ka bynta kiba bun , ka snam jong nga kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang U Blei .

translation.en: That drink wine in bowls , and anoint themselves with the chief ointments : but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph .
translation.kha: Phi dih waiñ na ki khuri ba-dap , bad phi pyndonkam da ki jingsleh kiba kynsai tam , hynrei phim shym ïam sngewsih halor ka jingshah pynjot ki Israel .

translation.en: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal , and , lo , there was a great earthquake  ; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair , and the moon became as blood  ;
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynriew . Ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba jur , bad ka sngi ka la kylla rong ïong kum ka jaiñ ïong kaba khain , bad u bnai u la kylla rong saw kum ka snam .

translation.en: Then shalt thou enquire , and make search , and ask diligently  ; and , behold , if it be truth , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought among you  ;
translation.kha: Leit tohkit bniah shaphang kata ; bad lada ka long kaba shisha ba la leh kum ïa kata ka kam bymman ,

translation.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand , and three hundred chariots  ; and came unto Mareshah .
translation.kha: U nong Sudan uba kyrteng u Serah u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai kaba don shi million ki rangbah bad laispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ki tur shaphrang haduh Mareshah .

translation.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites : and the children of Aaron the priest , which were of the Levites , had by lot out of the tribe of Judah , and out of the tribe of Simeon , and out of the tribe of Benjamin , thirteen cities .
translation.kha: Ki longïing na ka kur Kohath jong ka jait Lebi ki long kiba nyngkong eh ban ïoh ïa ki nongbah . Ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron u lyngdoh ki ïoh khatlai tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah , Simeon bad Benjamin .

translation.en: For if , when we were enemies , we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son , much more , being reconciled , we shall be saved by his life .
translation.kha: Ngi la long ki nongshun jong U Blei , hynrei u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong u lyngba ka jingïap U Khun jong u . Mynta ba ngi long ki paralok jong U Blei , katno tam ba yn pynim ïa ngi da ka jingim U Khrist !

translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , I beseech thee , save thou us out of his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  God , even thou only .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , to pyllait ïa ngi na ki Assyria , khnang ba baroh ki hima ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi , U  Trai  , me long U Blei .

translation.en: Rise , let us be going : behold , he is at hand that doth betray me .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit , ïa ngin leit noh . Ha khmih , hangne u don u briew uba shetkylla ïa nga !

translation.en: But Saul increased the more in strength , and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus , proving that this is very Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïalap jong u Saul ka la nang kham khrawbor , bad ki jingpynshisha jong u ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah ki long kiba skhem ba ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Damaskos kim lah ban jubab ïa u .

translation.en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet , Hear now , Hananiah  ; The  Lord  hath not sent thee  ; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa kane ha u Hananaïah , bad nga la bynrap ,  To shahshkor , ko Hananaïah ! U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa me , bad la pynlong ïa kine ki briew ban ngeit ïa ka lamler .

translation.en: The nobles held their peace , and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth .
translation.kha: wat ki rangbah kiba kham paw eh ki sngap jar .

translation.en: These wait all upon thee  ; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season .
translation.kha: Baroh na ki , ki shaniah ha me ban ai ïa ki ka jingbam haba ki donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: And the Philistines fought , and Israel was smitten , and they fled every man into his tent : and there was a very great slaughter  ; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki la ïaleh tyngeh bad ki la jop ïa ki Israel , kiba phet ïap sha la ki ïing . Ka la don ka jingshah pynïap kaba khraw : Laiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Israel ki shah pynïap .

translation.en: And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah , as he journeyed .
translation.kha: U mihnoh na Bethlehem ban leit wad jaka shong shawei . Katba u dang don ha ka jingleit kumta , u wan poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba ha ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: My son , let not them depart from thine eyes : keep sound wisdom and discretion :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , batskhem ïa la ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh . Wat shah lano lano ba kin lait noh na phi .

translation.en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . So the  Lord  was entreated for the land , and the plague was stayed from Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u la thaw ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka jingïapthem ha Israel ka la sangeh .

translation.en: O  Lord  our God , other lords beside thee have had dominion over us : but by thee only will we make mention of thy name .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , ïa ngi la synshar da kiwei pat , hynrei tang ma me , me long U  Trai  jong ngi .

translation.en: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument , neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin  ; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff , and the cummin with a rod .
translation.kha: Um ju pyndonkam da u diengtied uba khia ban shoh ïa ki symbai dil ne kumin ; hynrei u pyndonkam da ki dieng kiba sting kiba biang ka jingheh .

translation.en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one  ; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee : till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain , and as an ensign on an hill .
translation.kha: Shihajar ngut na phi kin ïaphet krad haba phi ïohi ïa uwei u shipai nongshun , bad san ngut ki shipai ki la biang ban pynlong ïa phi baroh ban phet krad . Yn ym don shuh ka kynhun shipai jong phi ka ban dang sah , lait noh sa tang u dieng lama ba sah marwei ha kliar jong u lum !

translation.en: They say still unto them that despise me , The  Lord  hath said , Ye shall have peace  ; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart , No evil shall come upon you .
translation.kha: Ha ki briew kiba kyntait ban sngap ïa kaei kaba nga la ong , ki ïai-ong ba baroh ka long bha bad ki . Bad ki ïathuh ïa uwei uwei baroh uba mutlop ba ka jingjot kan ym ktah ïa u .

translation.en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth , the same shall he receive of the Lord , whether he be bond or free .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba U Trai un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei , la u mraw ne uba laitluid , namar ka kam babha ba u trei .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u wan phai khlem shah pynïap sha ka ïingsyiem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: For he is not a man , as I am , that I should answer him , and we should come together in judgment .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u dei u briew , ngan jin da la jubab ïa u , Ngi lah ban leit sha ka ïingbishar ban rai ïa ka jingïakajia jong ngi .

translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood , standing up .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ki jingker ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .

translation.en: Amam , and Shema , and Moladah ,
translation.kha: ka Amam , ka Shema , ka Moladah ,

translation.en: There is that maketh himself rich , yet hath nothing : there is that maketh himself poor , yet hath great riches .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba leh riewspah , hynrei kim don ei ei . Kiwei ki leh duk , hynrei ki don ka spah bah .

translation.en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord , and he shall lift you up .
translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U Trai , bad un pynkhraw ïa phi .

translation.en: Which was the son of Jesse , which was the son of Obed , which was the son of Booz , which was the son of Salmon , which was the son of Naasson ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Jesse , u khun jong u Obed , u khun jong u Boas , u khun jong u Salmon , u khun jong u Nahshon ,

translation.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant , and to his supplication , O  Lord  my God , to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer , which thy servant prayeth before thee to day :
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , nga long u shakri jong me . Shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga , bad to ai ïa ki jingkyrpad kiba nga la pan na me ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them , and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth , and gavest them water for their thirst .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbha jong me , me ong ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban leh ; me la bsa ïa ki da ka manna bad ai um ïa ki ban dih .

translation.en: But if any have caused grief , he hath not grieved me , but in part : that I may not overcharge you all .
translation.kha: Mynta , lada don mano mano ba la pynsngewsih ïano ïano , um shym la leh ïa kata ha nga hynrei ha phi baroh — la kumno kumno shi bynta . (Nga ong ïa kane namar ngam kwah ban da leh tyngeh halor jong u .)

translation.en: For by fire and by his sword will the  Lord  plead with all flesh : and the slain of the  Lord  shall be many .
translation.kha: Da ka ding bad ka waitlam un pynshitom ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei kiba u shem ba la pynrem — bad shibun kin shah pynïap .

translation.en: And all the people took notice of it , and it pleased them : as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people .
translation.kha: Ki la buh jingmut ïa kane bad ki la sngewbha eh . Da shisha , kaei kaei baroh kaba u syiem u la leh ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki paidbah .

translation.en: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men , that went out to war by bands , according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler , under the hand of Hananiah , one of the king s captains .
translation.kha: U don ruh ka kynhun shipai kaba heh kaba la kloi na ka bynta ka thma . Ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka la sumar da u Jeiel u bad u Maaseïah , ki sekretari jong u hapoh ka jingpeit u Hananaïah , u dkhot jong ki nongtrei jong u syiem .

translation.en: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces , and wash the inwards of him , and his legs , and put them unto his pieces , and unto his head .
translation.kha: Ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa uta u langbrot , sait ïa ki snier bad ki kjat-dien jong u , nangta sa buh lang ïa ki halor kita ki lyngkhot doh bad ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ha u , ïa phi ruh la tei lang lem bad kiwei pat da U Mynsiem jong u ha ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u shong .

translation.en: So when they were dismissed , they came to Antioch : and when they had gathered the multitude together , they delivered the epistle :
translation.kha: La phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki la leit sha Antiokh , ha kaba ki la lumlang ïa ka kynhun baroh jong ki parabangeit bad ki la ai ha ki ïa ka shithi .

translation.en: And it be told thee , and thou hast heard of it , and enquired diligently , and , behold , it be true , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought in Israel :
translation.kha: phi dei ban tohkit bniah ïa kata .

translation.en: And he said , Go forth , and stand upon the mount before the  Lord . And , behold , the  Lord  passed by , and a great and strong wind rent the mountains , and brake in pieces the rocks before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  was not in the wind : and after the wind an earthquake  ; but the  Lord  was not in the earthquake :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Mih shabar bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga halor u lum .  Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la ïaid nangta bad u la phah ïa ka lyer bajur kaba la kad arliang ïa ki lum bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki mawsiang — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha ka lyer . Ka lyer ka sangeh ban beh , bad nangta la khie u jumai — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha u jumai .

translation.en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord , Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father , that he hath sent comforters unto thee ? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee , to search the city , and to spy it out , and to overthrow it ?
translation.kha: ki nongïalam jong ki Ammon ki ong ha u syiem ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei na ka bynta ka burom jong u kpa jong phi ba u Dabid u la phah ïa kine ki rangbah ban pynpaw ka jingsngewlem ha phi ? Ym kumta da shisha ! U la phah ïa ki hangne kum ki nongsyntiat ban swar ïa ka nongbah , ba kumta u lah ban jop ïa ngi !

translation.en: Then thou shalt cut off her hand , thine eye shall not pity her .
translation.kha: wat isynei ïa ka ; ot noh ïa ka kti jong ka .

translation.en: And when we heard these things , both we , and they of that place , besought him not to go up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ngi la ïohsngew ïa kane , ma ngi bad kiwei pat kiba hangta , ngi la kyrpad ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And they said one to another , We are verily guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the anguish of his soul , when he besought us , and we would not hear  ; therefore is this distress come upon us .
translation.kha: Ki te ki ïakohnguh ban leh kumta , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ho-oid , mynta ngi shah jynjar namar kaei kaba ngi la leh ïa la u jong u para . Ngi la ïohi haduh katno u khuslai mynba u kyrpad ba ngin ïarap ïa u , bad ngim shym la shahshkor . Dei namar kata ba ngi shah jynjar kumne mynta .

translation.en: Or a man that is brokenfooted , or brokenhanded ,
translation.kha: uba la duh bor ha ka kti lane ka kjat ;

translation.en: That the slayer might flee thither , which should kill his neighbour unawares , and hated him not in times past  ; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live :
translation.kha: sha kiba u briew u lah ban phet rieh bad lait im lada jia ba u kum pynïap ïa uno uno u briew u bym dei u nongshun jong u . U lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na kine ki shnong bad un ym shah pynïap .

translation.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp , the name of the one was Eldad , and the name of the other Medad : and the spirit rested upon them  ; and they were of them that were written , but went not out unto the tabernacle : and they prophesied in the camp .
translation.kha: Ar ngut na kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam , u Eldad bad u Medad , ki sah ha ka jaka shong dara bad kim shym la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ . Hangta ha ka jaka shong dara , kata ka bor mynsiem ka wan ha ki , bad ki ruh ki sdang ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And the children of the Kenite , Moses  father in law , went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah , which lieth in the south of Arad  ; and they went and dwelt among the people .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kthaw kurim u Moses , na ka jait Ken , ki la leit ryngkat bad u paid Judah na Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai , sha ka ri shrah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Arad ha Judah . Ki shongduh hangta hapdeng ki Amalek .

translation.en: And Jacob s anger was kindled against Rachel : and he said , Am I in God s stead , who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb ?
translation.kha: U Jakob u la sngewbitar ïa ka Rakhel bad u ong ,  Ngam lah ban shim ïa ka jaka U Blei . Dei ma u uba khang ïa pha ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: And the same hour was there a great earthquake , and the tenth part of the city fell , and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand : and the remnant were affrighted , and gave glory to the God of heaven .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat hi la jia ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; shi bynta na ka shiphew bynta jong ka nongbah la pynjot , bad hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïap . Kita kiwei pat ki briew ki la sngewtriem bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw U Blei jong ka bneng .

translation.en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jotham u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long syiem bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: If they say thus unto us , Tarry until we come to you  ; then we will stand still in our place , and will not go up unto them .
translation.kha: Lada ki ong ïa ngi ban ap haduh ba kin da wan sha ngi , ngin ïeng thik ha la ka jaka .

translation.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master , and the servant as his lord . If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub , how much more shall they call them of his household ?
translation.kha: Kumta uba shah hikai u dei ban sngewhun ban long kum u nonghikai jong u , bad u mraw kum u kynrad jong u . Lada ïa u khlieh jong ka longïing la khot u Beelsebul , ïa ki dkhot jong ka longïing yn khot da ki kyrteng kiba kham sniew !

translation.en: ( 1 Corinthians 15 :24 ) Why not tell your friends and loved ones about what God’s Kingdom will do ?
translation.kha: ( 1 Korinth 15 :24 ) Te balei phim ïathuh lem ha la ki paralok bad kiba ieit ba thoiñ shaphang aiu ka Hima U Blei kan leh ?

translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will come and help thee .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u ,  Lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga ; bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit bad ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: ( 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) Applying God’s counsel found in the Bible also promotes happiness in marriage and self-respect .—1 Corinthians 6 :18 .
translation.kha: ( 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingsneng ba don ha ka Baibl kan wanrah ka jingkmen ha ka jingshong kurim bad ha jingburom ïalade . —1 Korinth 6 :18 .

translation.en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saveth them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted from off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wilt thou ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka , ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada jong ka , bad u Kaleb u kylli ïa ka aïu ka kwah .
