translation.en: Yea , I will rejoice over them to do them good , and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewbha ha kaba leh kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan buh pynskhem junom ïa ki ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: And Samuel said , Hath the  Lord  as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices , as in obeying the voice of the  Lord  ? Behold , to obey is better than sacrifice , and to hearken than the fat of rams .
translation.kha: Te u Samuel u ong ,  Kaei kaba U  Trai  u kham sngewbha : ka jingkohnguh ne ki jingainguh bad ki jingkñia ? Ka kham bha ban kohnguh ïa u ban ïa kaba kñia ha u ïa ka langbrot kaba kynsai tam .

translation.en: And beheld among the simple ones , I discerned among the youths , a young man void of understanding ,
translation.kha: bad nga la ïohi shibun ki samla shynrang kiba shida jingmut , hynrei nga la ïohi kyrpang ïa uwei u samla uba duna ka jingsngewthuh .

translation.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch , and of the houses thereof , and of the treasuries thereof , and of the upper chambers thereof , and of the inner parlours thereof , and of the place of the mercy seat ,
translation.kha: U Dabid u ai ha u Solomon ïa ka dur pynkhreh jong ka jingtei baroh jong ka Templ , bad ïa ki kamra buh tiar jong ka bad ïa kiwei pat ki kamra bad ïa ka jaka kaba kyntang tam , ha kaba la map ïa ki pop .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with him  ; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth : and he rebelled against the king of Assyria , and served him not .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u long lem bad u , bad u long uba jop ha kiei kiei kiba u leh . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ka Assyria bad u kyntait ban pyndem ha u .

translation.en: I beseech you therefore , brethren , by the mercies of God , that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice , holy , acceptable unto God , which is your reasonable service .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar ka jingisynei bakhraw jong U Blei ïa ngi , nga kyrpad ïa phi : To aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia ba-im sha U Blei , ba la pynkyntang ha ka jingshakri ïa u bad ka jingpynsngewbha ïa u . Kane ka long ka jingmane bashisha kaba phi dei ban ai .

translation.en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple , and taught .
translation.kha: Hamar kaba shiteng na ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la jan kut U Jisu u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la sdang ban hikai .

translation.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places , and famines , and pestilences  ; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven .
translation.kha: Yn don ki jingkhynñiuh jumai kiba shyrkhei , ki  nemsniew , bad ki khlam ha kylleng kylleng ; kin don kiei kiei kiba phylla bad kiba pyntriem kiba wan na sahit bneng .

translation.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem , all the city was moved , saying , Who is this ?
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah baroh kawei ka la khynwin jlang .  Uei une ?  ki briew ki la kylli .

translation.en: They are joined one to another , they stick together , that they cannot be sundered .
translation.kha: La pynïadait skhem haduh katta katta ïa ki baroh ba ym don kano kano kaba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ki .

translation.en: Take us the foxes , the little foxes , that spoil the vines : for our vines have tender grapes .
translation.kha: Phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno ki khmat jong phi ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit !

translation.en: Now ye Philippians know also , that in the beginning of the gospel , when I departed from Macedonia , no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving , but ye only .
translation.kha: Phi ki nong Philippi phi tip bha shibun ba haba nga la mihnoh na Makedonia ha ki sngi kiba sdang ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha , phi dei tang ma phi ka balang ban ïarap ïa nga ; phi dei tang ma phi kiba la shim bynta ha ki jingïoh bad jingduh jong nga .

translation.en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others , and thy years unto the cruel :
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , kiwei pat kin ïoh ïa ka burom kaba phi la ïoh shisien , bad phin ïap samla ha ki kti ki briew ki bym don jingisynei .

translation.en: Then stood up upon the stairs , of the Levites , Jeshua , and Bani , Kadmiel , Shebaniah , Bunni , Sherebiah , Bani , and Chenani , and cried with a loud voice unto the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jaka bakynjang , na ka bynta ki Lebi bad halor jong ka , u ïeng u Jeshua , u Bani , u Kadmiel , u Shebanaïah , u Bunni , u Sherebaïah , u Bani , bad u Khenani . Ki la duwai jam ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice : but , being stronger than she , forced her , and lay with her .
translation.kha: Hynrei um sngap ïa ka ; bad namar ba u kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka , u la jop , bad u la batbor ïa ka .

translation.en: I was a derision to all my people  ; and their song all the day .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki rkhie ïa nga baroh shi sngi ; nga long ka jingbiria ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Ye mountains of Gilboa , let there be no dew , neither let there be rain , upon you , nor fields of offerings : for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away , the shield of Saul , as though he had not been anointed with oil .
translation.kha: Wat ai ban hap u slap ne ka umjer halor ki lum Gilboa ; Ai ba ki lyngkha jong ka kin ïailong shrah ! Naba ki stieh jong kiba shlur ki don hangta ha ka jingjahburom ; ïa ka stieh u Saul ym shym la shut phyrnai shuh da ka umphniang .

translation.en: He has a bruise on his right leg .
translation.kha: U don ka dakmong ha kjat kamon .

translation.en: And Iron , and Migdal–el , Horem , and Beth–anath , and Beth–shemesh  ; nineteen cities with their villages .
translation.kha: ka Yiron , ka Migdalel , ka Horem , ka Bethanath , bad ka Beth Shemesh : khatkhyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: And she spake unto him according to these words , saying , The Hebrew servant , which thou hast brought unto us , came in unto me to mock me :
translation.kha: Nangta ka la ïathuh ha u ïa kajuh ka khana :  Uto u mraw Hebru ba phi la wan ïalam hangne , u la wan rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad pynjahburom ïa nga .

translation.en: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia , the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul , and brought him to the judgment seat ,
translation.kha: Haba ïa u Gallio la pynlong u lyngskor jong ka Akhaïa kaba ha ka hima Rom , ki Jiw ki la ïalumlang hangta , ki la kem ïa u Paul , bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God , an altar of stones : thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them .
translation.kha: Tei ïa ka duwan hangta da ki maw ïa kiba ym pat pyndei shniah .

translation.en: And wheresoever the children of men dwell , the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand , and hath made thee ruler over them all . Thou art this head of gold .
translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa phi u nongsynshar ïa baroh ka pyrthei bashongbriew bad u nongsynshar ïa baroh ki mrad bad ki sim . Phi long ka khlieh kaba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Thus will I do unto this place , saith the  Lord  , and to the inhabitants thereof , and even make this city as Topheth :
translation.kha: Nga kular ba ngan pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa kiba shong ha ka kum ka Topheth .

translation.en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind : and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart .
translation.kha: Kito kiba wanrah jingeh ha la ki longïing kin ym don ei ei ha kaba kut . Ki briew kiba bieit kin long borabor ki shakri jong kiba stad .

translation.en: And when the time was that Elkanah offered , he gave to Peninnah his wife , and to all her sons and her daughters , portions :
translation.kha: Man ka por ba u Elkanah u kñia ainguh , u ju ai shi bynta na ka doh ha ka Peninnah bad shi bynta ha uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki kti jong ka .

translation.en: Shew the things that are to come hereafter , that we may know that ye are gods : yea , do good , or do evil , that we may be dismayed , and behold it together .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ka lawei ka don — Te ngin tip ba phi long ki blei ! Leh katto katne kaba bha ne wallam katto katne ka jingpynjot ; pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingsheptieng bad jingkhynñiuh !

translation.en: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh–barnea even unto Gaza , and all the country of Goshen , even unto Gibeon .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh u Joshua ka ïalam ïa u naduh Kadesh Barnea ha ka phang shathie haduh Gasa hajan ka rud duriaw , kaba kynthup ïa baroh ki jaka ka ri Goshen haduh Gibeon ha ka phang bashatei .

translation.en: And I say unto you , That many shall come from the east and west , and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba shibun kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad kin ïashong lem bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob ha ka jingkhawai hapoh ka Hima ki bneng .

translation.en: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger , in that they went to burn incense , and to serve other gods , whom they knew not , neither they , ye , nor your fathers .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Phi hi da lade phi la ïohi ïa ka jingpynjot kaba nga la wanrah ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh kiwei ki nongbah ka Judah . Wat mynta ki dang sah ha ki jingjot , bad ym don ba sah ha ki namar ki briew jong ki , ki la leh ïa kaba sniew bad ki la pynlong ïa nga ban bitar . Ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba ma ki ne ma phi ne ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju mane .

translation.en: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations , but now is made manifest to his saints :
translation.kha: kaba long ka jingmaïan kaba u la buhrieh lyngba ki rta baroh kiba mynshuwa na ki jaitbynriew baroh hynrei mynta la pynpaw ha ki briew jong u .

translation.en: For what is our hope , or joy , or crown of rejoicing ? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming ?
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , dei ma phi — ma phi keiñ , khlem duna ïa kiwei pat ! — kiba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi , ka jingkmen jong ngi , bad ka daw jong ngi ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingjop jong ngi ha khmat jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi haba u wan .

translation.en: Behold , as wild asses in the desert , go they forth to their work  ; rising betimes for a prey : the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children .
translation.kha: Kumta kiba duk , kum ki kada khlaw , ki wad jingbam ha ka ri khlaw ba-tyrkhong ; ym don jaka hangno hangno ban shem jingbam na ka bynta ki khun jong ki .

translation.en: As keepers of a field , are they against her round about  ; because she hath been rebellious against me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad yn kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem kumba ki rangbah ki ap phira ïa ka lyngkha , namar ki briew jong ka ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: Therefore judge nothing before the time , until the Lord come , who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness , and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts : and then shall every man have praise of God .
translation.kha: Kumta phim dei ban bishar ïano ïano shuwa ba ka por kaba dei kan poi . Ka jingbishar bakhatduh ka dei ban ap tad ynda U Trai un wan ; un wallam ha ka jingshai ïa ki jingbuhrieh ba-dum bad pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu barieh jong ki jingmut ki briew . Bad nangta uwei pa uwei un ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka jingïaroh kaba u dei hok ban ïoh .

translation.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him : the fir trees were not like his boughs , and the chesnut trees were not like his branches  ; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty .
translation.kha: Ym don dieng Kedar ha ka kper U Blei uba lah ban ïanujor bad u , ym don dieng Kseh uba la ju don kum kita ki tnat , bad ym don u dieng ha madan uba don kum kita ki tnat , ym don u dieng ha ka kper jong U Blei uba itynnat katta katta .

translation.en: And have put on the new man , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him :
translation.kha: Une u long u jingthaw bathymmai uba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong u , u ïai pynthymmai ha ka dur jong u hi , khnang ban wallam ïa phi sha ka jingtip ba-pura shaphang jong u .

translation.en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing , but that rather a tumult was made , he took water , and washed his hands before the multitude , saying , I am innocent of the blood of this just person : see ye to it .
translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohi ba kam donkam ban pynjlan , hynrei ba kan pynmih pynban ka jingkhynwin , u la shim khyndiat ka um , u la thet ïa la ki kti ha khmat u paidbah , bad u la ong ,  Ngam don jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong une u briew ! Kane ka dei ka jingleh jong phi !

translation.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil  ; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering .
translation.kha: Ryngkat bad uta u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , ainguh kumba shi kilo u kew ba la tylliat ni bha ba la khleh lang bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha . Theh ruh shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses  ; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment :
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la leh kumba u Moses u la lah ong ; bad ki la pan na ki nong Ijipt ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem de .

translation.en: But neither so did their witness agree together .
translation.kha: Wat la kumta ruh , kim shym la lah ban pynlong ïa ki jingïathuh jong ki kiba ïahap .

translation.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord ? or who hath been his counsellor ?
translation.kha: Uei uba tip ïa ka jingmut U Trai ? Uei uba lah ban ai jingmut ïa U ?

translation.en: And walk in love , as Christ also hath loved us , and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingim jong phi dei ban synshar da ka jingieit , kumba U Khrist u la ieit ïa ngi bad u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih bad ka jingkñia ba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

translation.en: We are fools for Christ s sake , but ye are wise in Christ ; we are weak , but ye are strong ; ye are honourable , but we are despised .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta U Khrist ngi long kiba bieit ; hynrei , phi long kiba stad ha U Khrist ! Ngi long kiba tlot , hynrei phi long kiba khlaiñ ! Ngi long kiba la ibeiñ , hynrei phi long kiba la pyndonburom !

translation.en: For many bare false witness against him , but their witness agreed not together .
translation.kha: Bun ki nongsakhi ki la shu sakhi lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu , hynrei ki jingïathuh jong ki kim ïahap satia .

translation.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes .
translation.kha: U syiem u shong ban bishar bad u tip ïa kaba sniew haba u ïohi ïa ka .

translation.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me  ; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously , and the spoiler spoileth . Go up , O Elam : besiege , O Media  ; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw jong ki jingjia ba-ishyrkhei , ka jingïohipaw ïa ka jingshetkylla bad ka jingpynjot . Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Elam , to tur ïaleh ! Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Media , to kerkut ïa ki nongbah ! U Blei un pynkut ïa ka jingshitom kaba la wanrah da ka Babilon .

translation.en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house . Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus , who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa ka balang kaba ïaseng ha ka ïing jong ki . Ki jingkhublei ïa u paralok ba-ieit jong nga u Epainetos , uba long u rangbah uba nyngkong ha ka probins    jong ka Asia ban ngeit ha U Khrist .

translation.en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs : if they be shaken , they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater .
translation.kha: Baroh ki kut jong pha kin long kum ki diengsoh Dumbur bad ki soh Dumbur ba la ih : Khynñiuh ïa ki dieng bad ki soh kin hap beit hapoh ka shyntur jong pha !

translation.en: And the Amorites , which dwelt in that mountain , came out against you , and chased you , as bees do , and destroyed you in Seir , even unto Hormah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Amor kiba shong ha kita ki lum ki la wan tur pyrshah ïa phi kumba beh u ngap . Ki la beh ïa phi shaduh Hormah , bad ki la jop ïa phi hangta ha ri lum Edom .

translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is the law sin ? God forbid . Nay , I had not known sin , but by the law : for I had not known lust , except the law had said , Thou shalt not covet .
translation.kha: Hato ngin ong te , ba ka Hukum hi ka long kaba pop ? Ym kumta keiñ ! Hynrei ka la long ka Hukum kaba pynlong ïa ngi ban tip kaei ka pop . Lada ka Hukum kam shym la ong ,  Wat kwah ïa kaei kaba dei jong uwei pat ,  ngan ym jin da la tip ïa kum kata ka jingkwah .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Yet a little while is the light with you . Walk while ye have the light , lest darkness come upon you : for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka jingshai kan don hapdeng jong phi sa katto katne por . To nang ïaid katba ka jingshai ka dang don , ba ka jingdum kan ym wan lap ïa phi ; naba uta uba ïaid ha ka jingdum um tip shano ba u leit .

translation.en: Then said Samuel , Wherefore then dost thou ask of me , seeing the  Lord  is departed from thee , and is become thine enemy ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Balei keiñ ba me da khot ïa nga haba U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa me bad u la kylla long u nongshun jong me ?

translation.en: And he informed me , and talked with me , and said , O Daniel , I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding .
translation.kha: U la batai ,  Ko Daniel , nga la wan hangne ban ïarap ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka jingïathuhlypa .

translation.en: He had eaten .
translation.kha: U la bam .

translation.en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael , and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham s son , the sister of Nebaioth , to be his wife .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit sha u Ishmael u khun jong u Abraham , bad u shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Mahalath , kaba long ka para jong u Nebaïoth .

translation.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .
translation.kha: Lada phi long kiba shemphang , phin ïoh jingïaroh ; lada phi long kiba mutlop , ki briew kin peitbeiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice , saying , Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near , even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ba U Blei u pyrta ,  Wan hangne , phi ki briew kiba leit ban pynshitom ïa ka nongbah . Wallam ïa ki tiar ïaleh bad phi .

translation.en: Then the priest shall come and look , and , behold , if the plague be spread in the house , it is a fretting leprosy in the house : it is unclean .
translation.kha: Lada ka la pur , kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: Now a certain man was sick , named Lazarus , of Bethany , the town of Mary and her sister Martha .
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Lasaros , uba sah ha Bethania , u la pang . Ka Bethania ka dei ka shnong ha kaba ka Mari bad ka Martha ka para jong ka , ki shong ki sah .

translation.en: Then saith he unto me , See thou do it not : for I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren the prophets , and of them which keep the sayings of this book : worship God .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha nga ,  Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u shakri ryngkat bad me lem bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki para jong me bad jong kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien hapoh jong kane ka kitab . To mane ïa U Blei !

translation.en: But now thus saith the  Lord  that created thee , O Jacob , and he that formed thee , O Israel , Fear not : for I have redeemed thee , I have called thee by thy name  ; thou art mine .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , U Blei uba la thaw ïa phi u ong ,  Wat sheptieng — ngan pyllait im ïa phi , nga la khot ïa phi da ka kyrteng — phi long u jong nga .

translation.en: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder , and upon thy seed for ever .
translation.kha: Kin long ka dak kaba sakhi ïa ka jingbishar U Blei ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi junom .

translation.en: And Balak s anger was kindled against Balaam , and he smote his hands together : and Balak said unto Balaam , I called thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast altogether blessed them these three times .
translation.kha: U Balak u kham tyngeh ïa la ki sla kti da ka jingbitar bad u ong ha u Balaam ,  Nga la khot ïa me ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong nga , hynrei la lai sien me la kyrkhu pynban ïa ki .

translation.en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art  ; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man .
translation.kha: U dei u parabriew jong me uba shahshitom na ki pop jong me , bad kaba bha kaba me leh ka ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help  ; and stay on horses , and trust in chariots , because they are many  ; and in horsemen , because they are very strong  ; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel , neither seek the  Lord  !
translation.kha: Kito kiba leit sha Ijipt ban ïoh jingïarap kin jot ! Ki shaniah ha ka bor shipai bakhraw jong ka Ijipt — ki kulai , ki kali ïapom , bad ki shipai . Hynrei kim tip ban shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel , lane pan na u ïa ka jingïarap .

translation.en: And refused to obey , neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them  ; but hardened their necks , and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage : but thou art a God ready to pardon , gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and forsookest them not .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ; ki la klet ïa baroh kaba me la leh ; ki la klet noh ïa ki kambah kiba me la leh . Ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki la jied u nongïalam ban ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt . Hynrei me long U Blei uba map ; me long uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingieit , uba suki ban bitar . Ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw ; mem shym iehnoh ïa ki .

translation.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass , and put it upon a pole , and it came to pass , that if a serpent had bitten any man , when he beheld the serpent of brass , he lived .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shna ïa u  seiñ rnong bad u wah ïa u ha u dieng . Kat uba shah puh bseiñ u peit sha uta u  seiñ rnong bad u koit .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the seven years  end , that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines : and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land .
translation.kha: Ynda la kut kita ki hynñiew snem , ka la wan phai sha Israel bad ka la leit sha u syiem ban kyrpad ïa u ban pynphai biang sha ka ïa ka ïing bad ka khyndew jong ka .

translation.en: Fools because of their transgression , and because of their iniquities , are afflicted .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki la long kiba bieit , ki shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki bad namar ka jingsniew jong ki ;

translation.en: And he arose , and came to his father . But when he was yet a great way off , his father saw him , and had compassion , and ran , and fell on his neck , and kissed him .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha la u kpa .  U dang kham pajih ha ka lynti na ïing haba u kpa jong u , u la ïohi ïa u ; ka dohnud jong u ka la dap da ka jingisynei , bad u la mareh , u la piam ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u , bad u la doh ïa u .

translation.en: And strangers , the terrible of the nations , have cut him off , and have left him : upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen , and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land  ; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow , and have left him .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei barunar ki khet noh ïa u bad iehnoh ïa u . Ki tnat dieng ba la kdiah jong u kin hap ha man la u lumbah bad ka them ha ka ri . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba im ha ki jingkah syrngiew jong u kin phet noh .

translation.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant , who is devoted to thy fear .
translation.kha: Pyndep ïa ka kular jong me ha nga , u shakri jong me — ka jingkular kaba me pynlong ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa me .

translation.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne , and lay them on men s shoulders  ; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers .
translation.kha: Ki teh pynbah ha ki met jong ki briew ïa ki jingkit kiba khia bad kiba eh ban kit , pynban kim mon bad rah la ki kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa kito ki jingkit .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto Moses , Behold , I will rain bread from heaven for you  ; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day , that I may prove them , whether they will walk in my law , or no .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta ngan pynhap bam na bneng ïa phi baroh . Ki briew ki dei ban mih shabar man ka sngi ban lum kat ban biang na ka bynta kata ka sngi . Da kumta nga lah ban tynjuh ïa ki ban shem la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .

translation.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead , and become the firstfruits of them that slept .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingshisha ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kum ka jingbahkhlieh ba ïa kito kiba la ïap yn sa pynmihpat ruh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then he said unto me , Lo , I have given thee cow s dung for man s dung , and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith .
translation.kha: Kumta U Blei u la ong ,  Ka bha shibun . Ngan shah ïa me ba men pyndonkam noh da ka eit masi pynban , bad me lah ban shet ïa la u kpu ha ka .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa ,

translation.en: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit , and knowledge , and understanding , interpreting of dreams , and shewing of hard sentences , and dissolving of doubts , were found in the same Daniel , whom the king named Belteshazzar : now let Daniel be called , and he will shew the interpretation .
translation.kha: U la don ka jinglah kaba kham pher bad u long uba stad bad uba tbit ha kaba batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , uba ai jubab ïa ki jingkyntip , bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan ; kumta to phah khot ïa une u briew , u Daniel , ïa uba u syiem u la ai kyrteng u Belteshassar , bad un ïathuh ïa phi aïu kane baroh ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath–jearim , who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah :
translation.kha: ( La don uwei pat u briew , u Uriah u khun jong u Shemaïah na Kiriath Jearim , uba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  pyrshah ïa kane ka nongbah bad ka jaitbynriew kumba u Jeremaïah u la leh .

translation.en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah , and lift up thine eyes westward , and northward , and southward , and eastward , and behold it with thine eyes : for thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha kliar u Lum Pisgah , bad peit baroh sawdong , shatei , shathie , sha mihngi , bad sha sepngi . Peit bha ïa kaei kaba me ïohi , namar lano lano ruh men ym ïoh leit sha shiliang ka Jordan .

translation.en: The living , the living , he shall praise thee , as I do this day : the father to the children shall make known thy truth .
translation.kha: Dei kiba im kiba ïaroh ïa me , kumba nga ïaroh ïa me mynta . Ki kpa ki ïathuh ïa la ki khun katno me long uba ïaineh .

translation.en: And this know , that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come , he would have watched , and not have suffered his house to be broken through .
translation.kha: Bad phi lah ban sngewthikna ba lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka por haba u nongtuh un wan , un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Then saith one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , which should betray him ,
translation.kha: U Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki synran jong u — uta u ban sa shetkylla ïa u — u la ong ,

translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill  ;
translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba duk na ka khyndew ; u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingsangsot jong ki ,

translation.en: And Samuel said to Saul , Why hast thou disquieted me , to bring me up ? And Saul answered , I am sore distressed  ; for the Philistines make war against me , and God is departed from me , and answereth me no more , neither by prophets , nor by dreams : therefore I have called thee , that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul ,  Balei me la pynthut ïa nga ? Balei me pynlong ïa nga ban wan pat ?  U Saul u jubab ,  Nga la poi ha ka khim khait ! Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma ïa nga , bad U Blei u la iehnoh ïa nga . Um shym jubab shuh ïa nga , la da ki nongïathuhlypa , lane da ki jingphohsniew . Bad kumta nga la khot ïa phi ba phin ïathuh ïa nga aïu nga dei ban leh .

translation.en: And if he shall come in the second watch , or come in the third watch , and find them so , blessed are those servants .
translation.kha: A katno kin long kiba kmen lada u shem ïa ki ba ki long kiba kloi , wat haba un wan ha ka por shiteng synñia lane wat kham dier ruh !

translation.en: But ye , brethren , be not weary in well doing .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko ki parabangeit , to wat man thait ha kaba leh ïa kaba bha .

translation.en: To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,
translation.kha: To wan sha U Trai , u maw uba im uba la kyntait da u briew kum u bymmyntoi hynrei uba la jied da U Blei ba u long uba kordor .

translation.en: And wherefore hath the  Lord  brought us unto this land , to fall by the sword , that our wives and our children should be a prey ? were it not better for us to return into Egypt ?
translation.kha: Balei keiñ U  Trai  u ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri ? Ngin shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki tnga jong ngi lem bad ki khun ki kti kin shah kem . Hato kam long kaba kham bha ba ngin ïaleit phai pat sha Ijipt ?

translation.en: Therefore hear ye the word of the  Lord  , all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt  ; Behold , I have sworn by my great name , saith the  Lord  , that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt , saying , The Lord  God  liveth .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta to shahshkor ïa ka jingsmai kaba ma nga U  Trai  , nga la pynlong ha ka kyrteng bakhrawbor jong nga sha phi ki Israel baroh kiba don ha Ijipt : ngan ym shah shuh ïano ïano na phi ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ban pynlong jingsmai da kaba ong , ‘ Nga smai da U  Trai  Nongsynshar uba im !’

translation.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew : when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased , the palmerworm devoured them : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka lyer khluit ban pyntyrkhong ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Ki puit ki la bam duh ïa baroh ki kper bad bri sohwaiñ jong phi , ki dieng Dumbur bad ki dieng Olib jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .

translation.en: Go , I pray you , prepare yet , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who hath seen him there : for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad da pynthikna bha sa shisien pat ; wad biang biang ha-ei u don , bad uei uba la ïohi ïa u hangta . Nga tip ba u long uba sianti bha .

translation.en: But which of you , having a servant plowing or feeding cattle , will say unto him by and by , when he is come from the field , Go and sit down to meat ?
translation.kha: Tharai uwei na phi u don u shakri uba dang lur lyngkha lane dang sharai ïa ki langbrot . Haba u wan shapoh ïing na lyngkha hato phi ong ïa u ban pynkloi bad bam ïa la ka jingbam ?

translation.en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate : and he measured the south gate according to these measures  ;
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashathie sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop , bad ka la don kajuh ka jingheh kum kito kiba ha ki kynroh kiba shabar .

translation.en: For her wound is incurable  ; for it is come unto Judah  ; he is come unto the gate of my people , even to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingmong ka Samaria yn ym lah pynkhiah , bad ka Judah kan shahshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ; ka jingpynjot ka la poi haduh ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem hi , ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong .

translation.en: But all that heard him were amazed , and said  ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la kylli ,  Hato une um dei uto uba ha Jerusalem u la pynïap ïa kito kiba mane ïa uta U Jisu ? Bad hato um shym wan hangne na ka bynta kajuh ka jingthmu ban kem ïa kito ki briew bad ban ïalam pat ïa ki sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ?

translation.en: Behold , a whirlwind of the  Lord  is gone forth in fury , even a grievous whirlwind : it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong U ka long ka  erïong , ka  erlangthari ka ban khih bitar halor ki khlieh jong ki bymman ,

translation.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , thaw san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar . Ki bnoh jong ki ruh ki dei ban long da ka ksiar . Thaw san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong ha ka bynta kine ki rishot .

translation.en: Abstain from all appearance of evil .
translation.kha: bad kiar na kano kano kaba sniew .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are as graves which appear not , and the men that walk over them are not aware of them .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ! Phi long kum ki lum jingtep ki bym don dien shuh ha kaba ki briew ki ïaid nalor khlem tip ïa ka .

translation.en: He even raised the dead .
translation.kha: U pynim wat ïa kiba la ïap .

translation.en: How come you're late ?
translation.kha: Balei phi slem ?

translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they rose early about the dawning of the day , and compassed the city after the same manner seven times : only on that day they compassed the city seven times .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom — dei tang ha kane ka sngi ba ki ïaid tawiar ïa ka hynñiew sien .

translation.en: And whosoever will not receive you , when ye go out of that city , shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them .
translation.kha: hangno hangno ha kaba ki briew kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to iehnoh ïa kata ka shnong bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi kum ka jingmaham ïa ki .

translation.en: Be afflicted , and mourn , and weep : let your laughter be turned to mourning , and your joy to heaviness .
translation.kha: To leh sngewsih , to ïam , bad to ïamkthang ; to pynlong ïa ka jingrkhie ban kylla sha ka jingïam , ka jingkmen sha ka jingsngewdiaw !

translation.en: So I took the chief of your tribes , wise men , and known , and made them heads over you , captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , and captains over fifties , and captains over tens , and officers among your tribes .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki nongïalam kiba stad bad kiba khraw jingmut ïa kiba phi hi phi la jied na ki jait jong phi , bad nga la buh ïa ki ban peit halor ïa phi . Don na ki , kiba peit ïa ki shihajar ngut , don kiba peit ïa ki shispah ngut , don kiba peit ïa ki sanphew ngut , bad don ruh kiba peit ïa ki shiphew ngut . Nalor kitei , nga la thung ruh ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  shewed me , and , behold , two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the  Lord  , after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , and the princes of Judah , with the carpenters and smiths , from Jerusalem , and had brought them to Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pyn-i ha nga ar shang ki soh Dumbur ba la buh ha khmat ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hadien ba u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la ringmraw ïa u Jehoïakhin , u syiem ka Judah , u khun jong u Jehoïakim , kum u koidi na Jerusalem , lem bad ki nongïalam ka Judah , ki nongtrei dieng , bad ki nongtrei batbit . )

translation.en: And it came to pass , when I prophesied , that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died . Then fell I down upon my face , and cried with a loud voice , and said , Ah Lord  God  ! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel ?
translation.kha: Katba nga dang ïathuhlypa , u Pelataïah u la kyllon ïap . Nga la rynsied pyllup ïa lade ha khyndew bad pyrta jam ,  Em , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Hato men pynïap ïa uwei uwei baroh ba dang sah ha Israel ?

translation.en: But some man will say , How are the dead raised up ? and with what body do they come ?
translation.kha: Don u ban kylli ,  Kumno lah ban pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap ? Ka met kaba kumno kin don ?

translation.en: Gather the people together , men , and women , and children , and thy stranger that is within thy gates , that they may hear , and that they may learn , and fear the  Lord  your God , and observe to do all the words of this law :
translation.kha: Khot lang ïa ki shynrang , ïa ki kynthei , bad ïa ki khynnah baroh , bad ïa ki nongwei ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi , khnang ba uwei pa uwei un ïohsngew ïa ka bad un nang ban burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong U .

translation.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka kabu ïa phi ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha .

translation.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the  Lord  against Baasha , and against his house , even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the  Lord  , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands , in being like the house of Jeroboam  ; and because he killed him .
translation.kha: Kata ka khubor na U  Trai  pyrshah ïa u Baasha bad ïa ka longïing jong u la ai da u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa namar ki pop ba u Baasha u la leh pyrshah ïa u  Trai . U la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  ym tang namar ki kam bymman ba u la leh , kumba u syiem Jeroboam u la leh ha shuwa jong u , hynrei ruh namar ba u la pynïap ïa baroh na ka longïing jong u Jeroboam .

translation.en: His head and his hairs were white like wool , as white as snow  ; and his eyes were as a flame of fire  ;
translation.kha: U shñiuh jong u , u la long uba lieh kum u  saiwul lane kum ka ïor , bad ki khmat jong u kiba klang kum ka ding ;

translation.en: The glory of young men is their strength : and the beauty of old men is the gray head .
translation.kha: Ngi itynnat ïa ka jingkhlaiñ ka jinglong samla bad ngi burom ïa u ñiuhlieh ka jinglong tymmen .

translation.en: Ask Jehovah to help you do what is good .
translation.kha: To pan na U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phi ban leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed , and thou shalt possess it  ; and he will do thee good , and multiply thee above thy fathers .
translation.kha: khnang ba phin ïoh kam kynti biang ïa kata ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la shong shisien . Un pynmanbha bad un pynroi ïa phi kham bun shah ban ïa kaba u la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: He delivereth and rescueth , and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth , who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions .
translation.kha: U pynim bad u pyllait im ; u leh ïa ki jingphylla bad ki kambah ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . U la pynim ïa u Daniel na kaba shah pynïap ha ki sing .

translation.en: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then believed ye him not ?
translation.kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki ,  Kaei ba ngin ong ? Lada ngi ong , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , ba phim shym la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’

translation.en: And it came to pass , as I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled out .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga la kyang jam , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .

translation.en: And it shall be , if thou do at all forget the  Lord  thy God , and walk after other gods , and serve them , and worship them , I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish .
translation.kha: Lada phi klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad phi phai sha kiwei pat ki blei ban mane bad ban shakri ïa ki , nga maham jur ïa phi ha kane ka sngi ba phin ïap da shisha .

translation.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee ? will he speak soft words unto thee ?
translation.kha: Hato un kyrpad ïa me ban pyllait ïa u ? Hato un ïasaid bad me ban ïoh jingisynei ?

translation.en: Associate yourselves , O ye people , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; and give ear , all ye of far countries : gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces .
translation.kha: To ïalumlang ha ka jingsheptieng , phi ki jaitbynriew ! To shahshkor , phi ki bynta ba sha jngai jong ka pyrthei . Pynkhreh ban ïaleh , hynrei to sheptieng ! Ho-oid to pynkhreh , hynrei to sheptieng !

translation.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life ; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier .
translation.kha: U shipai ha ka jingtrei minot u kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa la u rangbah shipai bad kumta um ïakhleh bad ki kam ha ka jingim kaba ïadei lang .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith : neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto : it is confusion .
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ne ka briew ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki mrad ; kum kata ka kam khyllah ka pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .

translation.en: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac , which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan bat ïa la ka jutang bad u khun jong me u Isaak , ïa uba ka Sarah kan sa kha ha me kum ha kane ka aïom ha ka snem ka ban wan .

translation.en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found , and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground : and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one .
translation.kha: Ngin shem ïa u Dabid hangno hangno ha kaba u don , bad ngin tur ïaleh ïa u ha shuwa ba un tip kaei kaba jia . Ma u lane uno uno na ki rangbah jong u kin ym lait im .

translation.en: But thou shalt surely kill him  ; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterwards the hand of all the people .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa u ! Sdang nyngkong ma phi ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad nangta uwei pa uwei ruh un lynthem maw ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass at that time , when Eli was laid down in his place , and his eyes began to wax dim , that he could not see  ;
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet u Eli , uba la kham byr-ïe ki khmat , u thiah ha la ka kamra ;

translation.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Phim bit wat tang ban sliew ding ruh ha la ïing ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works  sake .
translation.kha: To ngeit ïa nga haba nga ong ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga . Lymda kumta , to ngeit namar kiei kiei kiba nga leh .

translation.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings , yea , moreover of bonds and imprisonment :
translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne la rkhiebeiñ bad sympat , bad ïa kiwei pat la teh ha ki kynjri bad la set phatok ïa ki .

translation.en: And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me , neither yet heard I of it , but to day .
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u ong ,  Ngam shym tip mano ba la leh ïa kane . Mem shym la ïathuh ei ei shaphang kane ha nga , bad kane ka long ka sien kaba nyngkong ba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night , and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both man and beast  ; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet ngan ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Ijipt , da kaba pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh , la u dei u briew ne u mrad , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki blei ka ri Ijipt baroh . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp  ; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head , and let all the congregation stone him .
translation.kha: Pynmih ïa uto u briew shabar ka jaka shong dara . Uno uno u briew uba la ïohsngew ïa u ba u tim u tla un sakhi ïa kata da kaba u buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad nangta u paidbah baroh un lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: And another also said , Lord , I will follow thee  ; but let me first go bid them farewell , which are at home at my house .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew u la ong ,  Ngan bud ïa me , ko kynrad ; hynrei nyngkong shah ïa nga ban leit bad khublei ïa ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed : howl for her  ; take balm for her pain , if so be she may be healed .
translation.kha: Ka Babilonia kynsan kynsan ka kyllon bad la pynjot noh ! To ïam namar jong ka ! Pynïoh dawai na ka bynta ki jingmong jong ka , bad lehse yn lah ban pynkhiah .

translation.en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness , and pray God , if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee .
translation.kha: To kylla-kaba-mut , te , na kane ka jingthmu bymman jong me , bad duwai ha U Trai ba un map ïa me na kaba pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kane .

translation.en: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain  ; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain .
translation.kha: Kumta la pynmih ïa ka hukum na ka bynta jong ki baroh ban shah pynïap , kynthup ïa u Daniel bad ki paralok jong u .

translation.en: And the priest said , The sword of Goliath the Philistine , whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah , behold , it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod : if thou wilt take that , take it : for there is no other save that here . And David said , There is none like that  ; give it me .
translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u jubab ,  Nga don ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Philistia ïa uba phi la pynïap ha ka Them Elah ; ka don ha lyndet ka ephod , kaba la sop da ka jaiñ . Lada phi kwah ïa ka , to shim — dei tang ma ka , ka atiar hangne .   Ai ïa ka ha nga ,  u Dabid u ong .  Ym don hangno hangno ka waitlam kaba kham bha !

translation.en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way , an adder in the path , that biteth the horse heels , so that his rider shall fall backward .
translation.kha: U Dan un long kum u bseiñ harud lynti bah , Bad kum u  seiñpuh harud lynti , Uba puh na ka khongdong jat jong u kulai Khnang ba u nongshong un shah bret shadien .

translation.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim : For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction .
translation.kha: U ong ruh ,  U Blei u la ai khun ïa nga ha ka ri ba nga shah jynjar  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa u khun ba ar , u Ephraim .

translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , I had not thought to see thy face : and , lo , God hath shewed me also thy seed .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Ngam shym poi pyrkhat ba ngan dang ïohi biang ïa ka khmat jong me ; pynban U Blei u la shah ba ngan ïohi sa ïa ki khun jong me ruh .

translation.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love  ; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ba ki briew kin sngewtynnat ïa phi , to map ïa ki haba ki kum leh bakla ïa phi . To kynmaw ba ki jingbakla ki lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .

translation.en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion : the same is the city of David .
translation.kha: ( Hynrei u Dabid u la ïohknieh ïa ka kut Seïon jong ki , bad la tip kyrteng ïa ka kum ka  Nongbah u Dabid .  )

translation.en: Shake thyself from the dust  ; arise , and sit down , O Jerusalem : loose thyself from the bands of thy neck , O captive daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Kynther ïa lade , ko Jerusalem ! Ïeng joit na u pui pui bad shong halor la ka khet ! Law noh ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa pha , ki briew ba la shah khum jong ka Seïon !

translation.en: That the aged men be sober , grave , temperate , sound in faith , in charity , in patience .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa kiba la kham rangbah ba kin long kiba adkar , kiba tipbriew bad kiba synshar ïa lade ; kiba skhem ha ka jingngeit , ka jingieit bad ka jingïaishah jong ki .

translation.en: It is like a letter from a loving father to his children .
translation.kha: Ka long kum ka shithi na u kpa u baieit thep mynsiem sha la ki khun .

translation.en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the  Lord  , and their works are in the dark , and they say , Who seeth us ? and who knoweth us ?
translation.kha: Kito kiba pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ki jingthmu jong ki na U  Trai  , kin jot noh ! Ki pynïaid ïa ki rukom treikam jong ki ha kaba rieh bad ki pyrkhat ba yn ym don ba ïohi ïa ki lane tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh .

translation.en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard .
translation.kha: Naba men long u sakhi na ka bynta jong u ban ïathuh ha uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi bad ïohsngew .

translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  shall be revealed , and all flesh shall see it together : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Te ïa ka burom jong U  Trai  yn sa pynpaw , bad baroh ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka . U  Trai  da lade u la kular ïa kane .

translation.en: And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ïa ka jingduwai ka Leah , bad ka la punkhun bad ka kha ïa u khun uba san ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Men and brethren , children of the stock of Abraham , and whosoever among you feareth God , to you is the word of this salvation sent .
translation.kha: Ko para Israel jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , bad baroh ki Jentil hangne kiba mane ïa U Blei : Ka long ha ngi , ba la phah ïa kane ka khubor ka jingpynim !

translation.en: And this woman s child died in the night  ; because she overlaid it .
translation.kha: Te ha kawei ka miet ka la kum ban ïa la i khun bad i la ïap .

translation.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift .
translation.kha: To ngin ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingai jong u ka bym lah ban pynshongdor !

translation.en: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God , saying , Tell me , I pray thee , all the great things that Elisha hath done .
translation.kha: Ka shem ba u syiem u dang ïakren bad u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha ; u syiem u kwah ban tip shaphang ki kambah jong u Elisha .

translation.en: The Lord  God  which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith , Yet will I gather others to him , beside those that are gathered unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar , uba la wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel sha ïing na ka ri ka jinglongmraw , u la kular ba un sa wallam ïa kiwei pat ki briew ban ïasoh lang bad ki .

translation.en: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her : the daughters of the nations shall lament her : they shall lament for her , even for Egypt , and for all her multitude , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingmaham bakyntang kan long ka jingrwai ïapbriew . Ki kynthei na ki jaitbynriew kin ïarwai sngewsih na ka bynta ka Ijipt bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh . Ma nga , u  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble , and the flame consumeth the chaff , so their root shall be as rottenness , and their blossom shall go up as dust : because they have cast away the law of the  Lord  of hosts , and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , kumba u skum kba bad u phlang tyrkhong ki ran bad ing ha ka ding , ki thied jong phi kin pyut bad ki syntiew jong phi kin tyrkhong bad shah rong noh ha ka lyer , namar ba phi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei bakhuid ka Israel u la hikai ïa ngi .

translation.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven , that a man may eat thereof , and not die .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpu uba wan hiar na bneng u long uta ïa uba uno uno uba bam ïa u un ym ïap .

translation.en: I believed , therefore have I spoken : I was greatly afflicted :
translation.kha: Nga la ïaineh ha ka jingngeit , wat haba nga ong ,  La pynlwet khoit ïa nga ,

translation.en: His 12-year-old daughter had died .
translation.kha: Naba ka khun jongu kaba la 12 snem karta ka la iap .

translation.en: Behold the day , behold , it is come : the morning is gone forth  ; the rod hath blossomed , pride hath budded .
translation.kha: Ka sngi jong ka jingjot ka la wan ïa ka Israel . Ka jingleh jubor ka nang roi . Ka jingsarong ka ïeng rasong .

translation.en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have  ; and , behold , all things are clean unto you .
translation.kha: Hynrei ai ïa kaei kaba hapoh ki khuri bad ki pliang jong phi ha kiba duk , bad kiei kiei baroh kin long kiba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And why call ye me , Lord , Lord , and do not the things which I say ?
translation.kha: Balei ba phi khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ,’ bad pynban phim leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi ?

translation.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth . He shall come as an eagle against the house of the  Lord  , because they have transgressed my covenant , and trespassed against my law .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham ! Ki nongshun ki hiar kynsan shapoh ha ka ri jong nga kum ki pukni ! Ki briew jong nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la ïateh bad ki , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai jong nga .

translation.en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee , knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say .
translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna , katba nga dang thoh ïa kane , ba men leh ïa kaei kaba nga kyrpad — ha ka jingshisha nga tip ba men leh wat kham palat ïa kane .

translation.en: And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon  ;
translation.kha: ka Ebron , ka Rehob , ka Hammon , bad ka Kanah , shaduh Sidon .

translation.en: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph , and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father .
translation.kha: Ki la ïashongkurim hapoh ki kur kiba na ka jait u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , bad ka bri ka khyndew jong ki ka ïaisah bad ka jait u kpa jong ki .

translation.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon , Solomon built them , and caused the children of Israel to dwell there .
translation.kha: U thymmai ruh ïa ki nongbah ba u syiem Hiram u la ai ïa u , bad u phah ïa ki Israel ban shongduh ha ki .

translation.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High ,
translation.kha: u tip mynno ngim shym ïoh ïa ki hok jong ngi kiba u la ai ïa ngi ;

translation.en: As for us , our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .
translation.kha: Ngi la khmih tad haduh ba ngim lah shuh ban khmih ïa ka jingïarap ka bym ju wan . Ngi la ïai ap ïa ka jingïarap na ka hima ka bym don ei ei ban ai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when your children shall say unto you , What mean ye by this service ?
translation.kha: Haba ki khun jong phi ki kylli ïa phi , ‘ Ka mut aïu kane ka jinglehniam ?’

translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out : it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire :
translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong me ka pynlong ïa me ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong me , khlaw noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei tang da kawei ka khmat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret sha dujok .

translation.en: These are the words of the covenant , which the  Lord  commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab , beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien jong kata ka jutang ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban pynlong bad ki Israel ha ka ri ki Moab ; kane baroh ka la long ka jingbynrap shuh shuh halor kata ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki ha u Lum Sinai .

translation.en: When I lie down , I say , When shall I arise , and the night be gone ? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day .
translation.kha: Haba nga dem ban thiah , ki kynta ki ïaid suki nga khih pisa baroh shi miet bad ka slem ban kynjat shai .

translation.en: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer ,
translation.kha: Ïa ka histori jong u syiem Dabid naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut la buh jingthoh ha ki kot buh jingkynmaw jong ki lai ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Samuel , u Nathan , bad u Gad .

translation.en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau , which were with her in the house , and put them upon Jacob her younger son :
translation.kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ki jaiñ kiba bha tam jong u Iso , ïa kiba ka buh ha ïing , bad ka pynphong ïa ki ha u Jakob .

translation.en: The  Lord  will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish : but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .
translation.kha: U  Trai  um shah ïa ki briew kiba bha ban shahthngan , hynrei u khang ïa ki bymman ban ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .

translation.en: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled , and maketh the judges fools .
translation.kha: U shim noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki nongsynshar bad u pynlong ïa ki nongïalam kum kiba bieit .

translation.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius  ; and said , Behold , I am he whom ye seek : what is the cause wherefore ye are come ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la leit hiar bad u la ong ha kita ki rangbah ,  Dei ma nga uta uba phi ïawad . Phi donkam aïu ?

translation.en: For a bishop must be blameless , as the steward of God ; not selfwilled , not soon angry , not given to wine , no striker , not given to filthy lucre ;
translation.kha: Namar ba u nongïalam balang u long uba pynïaid ïa ka kam U Blei , u dei ban long u bym don jingshah kynnoh pop . Um dei ban long uba leh meng ne uba bitar shen , ne uba buaid ne uba leh jubor ne uba lalot pisa .

translation.en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin , and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot , wheresoever the priest looketh  ;
translation.kha: Lada kata ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la pur ha ka met jong u naduh khlieh haduh kjat ,

translation.en: Thou fool , that which thou sowest is not quickened , except it die :
translation.kha: A me u bieit! Haba me bet ïa u symbai ha ka khyndew , um lah ban shylluit lymda u ïap noh .

translation.en: Did not Moses give you the law , and yet none of you keepeth the law ? Why go ye about to kill me ?
translation.kha: U Moses u la ai ha phi ïa ka Hukum , hato ym dei kumta ? Hynrei ym don uwei na phi uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum . Balei ba phi pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ?

translation.en: And Paul chose Silas , and departed , being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God .
translation.kha: katba u Paul u la jied ïa u Silas bad u la leit noh , la aiti ïa ki da ki riewngeit ha ka jingïada jong ka jingaiei jong U Trai .

translation.en: For I came down from heaven , not to do mine own will , but the will of him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno ïa uba U Kpa jong nga u ai ha nga un wan sha nga . Ngan ym kyntait ïa uno uno uba wan sha nga , namar nga la wan hiar na bneng ban leh ym ïa ka mon ka jong nga hynrei ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years : so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years .
translation.kha: U Jakob u sah ha Ijipt khathynñiew snem , haduh ba un da dap shispah sawphew hynñiew snem ka rta .

translation.en: And the multitude cometh together again , so that they could not so much as eat bread .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha ïing . U paidbah babun u la ïalum biang kat haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shuh ban bam .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them  ; all that enter in to perform the service , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ïa ka jingsop kaba shapoh bad kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ka pyrda jong ka jingkhang ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he was returned , having received the kingdom , then he commanded these servants to be called unto him , to whom he had given the money , that he might know how much every man had gained by trading .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u briew la thung syiem bad u la wan phai pat . Mar kumta hi , u la hukum ïa ki shakri ban wan mih ha khmat jong u , khnang ban shem haduh katno ki la kamai .

translation.en: Go to , let us go down , and there confound their language , that they may not understand one another s speech .
translation.kha: Ïa , ngin ïaleit hiar bad pynkhleh ïa ka ktien jong ki , ba kumta kin ym ïasngewthuh shuh iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us , that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation perish not .
translation.kha: Hato phim sngewthuh ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban shah ba uwei u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew , ban ïa kaba ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka jot noh ?

translation.en: Ye lust , and have not : ye kill , and desire to have , and cannot obtain : ye fight and war , yet ye have not , because ye ask not .
translation.kha: Phi kwah ei ei , hynrei phim ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi pynïap ; phi da kwah eh , hynrei phim lah ban ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi ïania bad phi ïaleh thma . Phim ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah , namar ba phim pan na U Blei ïa ka .

translation.en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift , and the strong shall not strengthen his force , neither shall the mighty deliver himself :
translation.kha: Wat ki nongmareh stet kin ym lait im , ki rangbah kiba khlaiñ kin duh ïa la ka bor , bad ki shipai kin ym lah wat ban pyllait ïa la ka jong ka jingim .

translation.en: Where no wood is , there the fire goeth out : so where there is no talebearer , the strife ceaseth .
translation.kha: Khlem ka diengïap , ka ding ka lip noh ; khlem ka jinglorni , ka jingïakajia ka kut noh .

translation.en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones  ; for I say unto you , That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: To sumar ba phin ym ibeiñ ïano ïano na kine kiba rit . Ki angel jong ki ha bneng , nga ong ha phi , ki ïai don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

translation.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt  ; because they continued not in my covenant , and I regarded them not , saith the Lord .
translation.kha: Kan ym long kum ka jutang ïa kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha kata ka sngi ha kaba nga la btin ïa ki bad la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Kim shym ïaineh ha kata ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki , bad kumta ngam shym shahshkor shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth , and to Naarath , and came to Jericho , and went out at Jordan .
translation.kha: Nangta u hiar arsut na Janoah sha Ataroth bad Naarah , u poi haduh ka Jerikho bad kut ha ka Jordan .

translation.en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me : as soon as they hear , they shall be obedient unto me .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong nga ; haba ki ïohsngew ïa nga , ki kohnguh .

translation.en: And when the messengers were come in , behold , there was an image in the bed , with a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster .
translation.kha: Ki leit rung shapoh bad ki shem ïa kata ka bleithaw na ïing ha ka jingthiah bad ïa ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlieh jong kata .

translation.en: For the king of the north shall return , and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former , and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Syria un leit phai pat bad lum ka kynhun shipai kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba u la don mynshuwa . Haba ka por babiang ka poi , un wan phai bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad kaba la kieng atiar bha .

translation.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep : and when they were awake , they saw his glory , and the two men that stood with him .
translation.kha: U Petros bad ki paralok jong u ki la ïohthiah lyngngai , hynrei ki la kyndit thiah bad ki la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Jisu bad ïa kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la ïeng lem bad u .

translation.en: And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly  ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyrpad jong me na ka bynta u Ishmael , kumta ngan kyrkhu ïa u bad ngan ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Un long u kpa jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun syiem , bad ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: And Israel took all these cities : and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites , in Heshbon , and in all the villages thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ki Amor baroh , lem bad ïa ka Heshbon bad ïa ki shnongrit baroh sawdong jong ka , bad ki la shong la sah hangta .

translation.en: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves ; but our sufficiency is of God ;
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ha ngi kaba ngi lah ban dawa ba ngi long kiba bit ban leh ïa kane ka kam . Ka jinglah jong ngi ka wan na U Blei ;

translation.en: Now I will come unto you , when I shall pass through Macedonia : for I do pass through Macedonia .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wan sha phi hadien ba nga la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Makedonia — naba nga dei ban leit lyngba ka Makedonia .

translation.en: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation , and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him ?
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw bad kaba donbor , bad da u ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet , and old garments upon them  ; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy .
translation.kha: Ki phong da ki jaiñjot bad ki slipar snieh ba la jot kiba la dep syrdep . U kpu ba ki rah u long uba tyrkhong bad uba bthuh .

translation.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation ,
translation.kha: Da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa ka jingpynim jong me ,

translation.en: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing : a sojourner of the priest , or an hired servant , shall not eat of the holy thing .
translation.kha: Dei tang uta uba na ka longïing lyngdoh uba lah ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang ; uwei pat um lah ban bam ïa ki , la u long u nongwei uba shong basah bad u lyngdoh lane u nongtrei jong u .

translation.en: While on earth , Jesus fed the hungry , healed the sick , and restored life to the dead !
translation.kha: Mynba u don ha ka pyrthei , u Jisu u la pynkdang ïa kiba thngan , pynkhiah ïa kiba pang bad pynmihpat ïa kiba la ïap !

translation.en: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed , and keep all my statutes , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba sniew u sangeh ban leh pop bad u sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga , lada u leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha , un ym ïap ; un im da shisha .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh s heart is hardened , he refuseth to let the people go .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  U Pharaoh u long uba mutlop eh bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ki paidbah ban leit .

translation.en: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land , and they go a whoring after their gods , and do sacrifice unto their gods , and one call thee , and thou eat of his sacrifice  ;
translation.kha: Wat ïateh kano kano ka jutang bad ki briew jong kata ka ri , namar haba ki mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki , bad kñia ha ki , kin sa khot sngewbha ïa phi ban ïasoh bad ki , bad phin shah pynshoi ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba ki ai ïa ki blei jong ki .

translation.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid narud ka duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ar ngut ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang ïatong dohkha da ka jar .

translation.en: And the maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness of him  ; and he speedily gave her her things for purification , with such things as belonged to her , and seven maidens , which were meet to be given her , out of the king s house : and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women .
translation.kha: U Hegai u la itynnat ïa ka Esther , bad ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehsbun jong u . Um shym pynslem ha kaba ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew bad ki jingbam bakyrpang . U ai ïa ka , ka jaka babha tam ha ka ïing ki kynthei bad buh hynñiew ngut ki samla kynthei ba la jied kyrpang na ka ïingsyiem ban shakri ïa ka .

translation.en: And the king said to him , How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ahab u jubab ,  Haba phi ong ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , ong ïa ka jingshisha ! Katno sien ba nga hap ban ong ha phi ïa kata ?

translation.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side , and two tables on that side , to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka kamra rung , la don saw tylli ki miej , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka kamra . Dei halor kine ki miej ba la pynïap ïa ki mrad ba dei ban ai kum ki jingkñia , lane ban thang tylli , lane ban long ki jingkñia sait pop ne kum ki jingtyrwa siew kylliang .

translation.en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them , because he knoweth not how to go to the city .
translation.kha: Tang uta uba mutlop shaba palat ban lap ka lynti sha ïing un pynthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei .

translation.en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth  ; that there be just men , unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked  ; again , there be wicked men , to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous : I said that this also is vanity .
translation.kha: Hynrei kane ka long ka bym don jingmut . Khmih kaei kaba jia ha ka pyrthei : Teng teng uba hok u ïoh ïa ka jingshah pynshitom jong u bymman , bad ki riewbymman ki ïoh ïa ka bainong jong kiba hok . Nga ong ba ka long ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens , and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them .
translation.kha: U buh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ban trei ha kaba pynbiang ïa ki tiar ki tar , bad phraphew hajar ngut ban trei ha kaba tih maw . La don lai hajar hynriewspah ngut kiwei pat kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta ban pynïaid ïa ka kam .

translation.en: But thus shall ye deal with them  ; ye shall destroy their altars , and break down their images , and cut down their groves , and burn their graven images with fire .
translation.kha: Kumta , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynpait pharia ïa ki rishot mawkyntang jong ki , mait ïa ki dak ka blei Asherah jong ki , bad thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: What is thy beloved more than another beloved , O thou fairest among women ? what is thy beloved more than another beloved , that thou dost so charge us ?
translation.kha: Kaba khmih ïa ki khmat jong phi , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem bad ko nongleitkurim jong nga , bad u jingdeng ryndang ba phi deng ka la tuh ïa ka dohnud jong nga .

translation.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour ?
translation.kha: Bad na ka bynta jong ngi — balei ma ngi ngin kheiñduh ïa lade man la ka kynta ?

translation.en: The  Lord  hath been sore displeased with your fathers .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la bthah ïa u Sekharaïah ban ong ha ki briew ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la bitar shikatdei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,

translation.en: The king of Hormah , one  ; the king of Arad , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Hormah , ka Arad ,

translation.en: And I the  Lord  will be their God , and my servant David a prince among them  ; I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad u syiem kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long u nongsynshar jong ki . Nga la kren .

translation.en: The king of Jarmuth , one  ; the king of Lachish , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Jarmuth , ka Lakhish ,

translation.en: And when the governor had read the letter , he asked of what province he was . And when he understood that he was of Cilicia  ;
translation.kha: U Lyngskor u la pule ïa ka shithi bad u la kylli ïa u Paul na kano ka probins    u la wan . Haba u la tip ba u dei na Kilikia ,

translation.en: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him , they cried out , saying , Crucify him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Take ye him , and crucify him : for I find no fault in him .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongap phira jong ka Templ ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la pyrta jam ,  Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !  U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Shim noh ma phi ïa u , te , bad sahnarphna ïa u . Ngam lap daw ei ei ïa ka ban pynrem ïa u .

translation.en: But the  Lord  is with me as a mighty terrible one : therefore my persecutors shall stumble , and they shall not prevail : they shall be greatly ashamed  ; for they shall not prosper : their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long ha ka liang jong nga , uba khlaiñ bad bakhrawbor , bad kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga kin ym jop , kin shah pynlehrain junom , namar kim lah ban jop . Ïa ka jingjahburom jong ki yn ym klet noh da lei lei .

translation.en: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt , and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast , throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Uta u dpei un sa her kum u pui pui uba ni ha ka ri Ijipt baroh , bad kat haba u hap un pynmih ki tohjaw kiba kylla prum ha u briew bad ha u mrad .

translation.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven , and proclaim and publish the free offerings : for this liketh you , O ye children of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ïaid shaphrang bad rah ïa u kpu jong phi kum ka jingainguh sha U Blei , bad to sngewsarong shaphang ki jingainguh ba tam ba phi wallam ! Kane ka long ka rukom ïa kaei kaei kaba phi ieit ban leh .

translation.en: Or who hath first given to him , and it shall be recompensed unto him again ?
translation.kha: Uei uba la ju ai ei ei ïa u , ba u hap ban siew pat ïa kata ?

translation.en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead : for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest . So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Arab ki la leit lute bad pynïap ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u Jehoram lait noh u Ahasaïah , uba khatduh . Te mynta ki briew ka Jerusalem ki thung ïa u Ahasaïah kum u syiem ba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea , and throughout all the region round about .
translation.kha: Kane ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng jong ka ri bad sha ki thain kiba don sawdong .

translation.en: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake : I beheld even till the beast was slain , and his body destroyed , and given to the burning flame .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , nga dang lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka reng barit ba ka kren sarong eh bad kob . Katba nga dang ap khmih , la pynïap ïa u mradkhlaw uba saw , bad ïa ka met jong u la bret sha ki thylliej ding bad ka pynjot .

translation.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily . Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh , shall he find faith on the earth ?
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , un bishar ha ka liang jong ki bad un leh kloi ïa ka . Hynrei hato U Khun U Briew un shem mo ïa ka jingngeit ha ka pyrthei haba u wan ?

translation.en: And Naaman said , Shall there not then , I pray thee , be given to thy servant two mules  burden of earth ? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods , but unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Naaman u ong ,  Lada phim pdiang ïa ka jingai jong nga , te shah ïa nga ban rah sha ïing ar kit khashor ka khyndew , namar naduh mynta ngan ym ai jingkñia lane jingainguh thang ha uno uno u blei lait noh tang U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that he went out into a mountain to pray , and continued all night in prayer to God .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , U Jisu u la leit kiew sha u kum ban duwai bad ban pynlut baroh shi miet hangta da kaba duwai ha U Blei .

translation.en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivah ?
