translation.kha: Shano ki syiem jong ki nongbah Hamath , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena , bad Ibbah ?

translation.en: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army , and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent , and with earth upon his head .
translation.kha: Uwei u rangbah uba na ka jait Benjamin u la mareh na ka madan thma shaduh Shiloh bad u la poi hangta ha kajuh ka sngi . Ban pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngewsih u da kad ïa la ki jaiñ , bad u sleh ïa la ka khlieh da ka khyndew .

translation.en: But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki la pyrshah da u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Elumas ( kata ka long ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Grik ) , uba la pyrshang ban pynphai noh ïa u lyngskor na ka jingngeit .

translation.en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains , and to the beasts of the earth : and the fowls shall summer upon them , and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them .
translation.kha: Ïa ki metïap jong ki shipai jong ki yn iehnoh ha ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw . Ha ka lyiur ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ha ka tlang ki mrad .

translation.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots , and all the chariots of Egypt , and captains over every one of them .
translation.kha: U la mih lem bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ki hynriewspah tylli ki kali ïapom jong u kiba bha tam , ïa kiba la ai hukum da ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki .

translation.en: These things said he in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa kane katba u dang hikai ha ka synagog ha Kapernam .

translation.en: Only fear the  Lord  , and serve him in truth with all your heart : for consider how great things he hath done for you .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad shakri hok ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And wheresoever he shall go in , say ye to the goodman of the house , The Master saith , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
translation.kha: Bud ïa u sha ka ïing ba un rung bad ong ïa u trai jong ka ïing : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong ,  Hangno ka kamra ha kaba ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin ïabam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?  ’

translation.en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body , as it hath pleased him .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , U Blei u la buh ïa ki dkhot kiba ïapher ha ka met kumba u kwah ïa ki ba kin long .

translation.en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press , they uncovered the roof where he was : and when they had broken it up , they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay .
translation.kha: Na ka daw jong u paidbah , kim shym la lah ban wallam ïa uta u briew sha u . Kumta ki la weng ïa ka jingsop na ka tnum ïing hamar ka jaka ba U Jisu u don . Haba ki la dep weng ïa ka jingsop ïing , ki la pynhiar ïa uta u briew shapoh , u da thiah ha ka jingthiah jong u .

translation.en: For the bodies of those beasts , whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin , are burned without the camp .
translation.kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u wanrah ïa ka snam ki mrad ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam ïa ka ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia namar ki pop ; hynrei ïa ki met jong ki mrad la thang shabar ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: In a moment shall they die , and the people shall be troubled at midnight , and pass away : and the mighty shall be taken away without hand .
translation.kha: U briew u lah ban ïap kynsan mynmiet . U Blei u shoh-ïap ïa ki briew bad ki jot noh ; u pynïap ïa kiba khrawbor da kaba suk .

translation.en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east , and unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea on the east , the way to Beth–jeshimoth  ; and from the south , under Ashdoth–pisgah :
translation.kha: ka kynthup ïa ka Them Jordan naduh Duriaw Galilaïa arsut shaduh Beth Jeshimoth ( shaphang mihngi jong ka Duriaw Baïap ) bad sha trai jong u Lum Pisgah .

translation.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart , and the tongue of the dumb sing : for in the wilderness shall waters break out , and streams in the desert .
translation.kha: Kiba dkoh kin rynsied bad shad , bad kito ki bym lah ban kren kin pyrta da ka jingkmen . Ki wahduid kin tuid lyngba ka ri shyiap ;

translation.en: And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .
translation.kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa ki mraw jong u , ki shoh ïa uwei , ki pynïap ïa uwei pat , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: But the Comforter , which is the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he shall teach you all things , and bring all things to your remembrance , whatsoever I have said unto you .
translation.kha: Uta U Nongïarap , U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ïa uba U Kpa un phah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , un hikai ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh bad un pynkynmaw ïa baroh kaba nga la ïathuh ha phi .

translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  , bless his name  ; shew forth his salvation from day to day .
translation.kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  , bad to ïaroh ïa u ! Pynbna man ka sngi ïa khubor babha ba u la pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives , which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods .
translation.kha: U tei ruh ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kaba ki tnga nongwei jong u baroh kin ïoh thang ïa ki jingiwbih bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki .

translation.en: And if it be not so now , who will make me a liar , and make my speech nothing worth ?
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano ba lah ban len ba kane ka long kumta ? Hato don mano mano ba lah ban pynshisha ba ki ktien jong nga ki long ki bymshisha ?

translation.en: See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms , to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down , to build , and to plant .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka iktiar halor ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima ban rat bad ban pynkhyllem , ban pynjot bad ban bret sharud , ban tei bad ban thung .

translation.en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath , in the days of Jael , the highways were unoccupied , and the travellers walked through byways .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi u Shamgar u khun jong u Anath , Ha ki sngi jong ka Jael , Ki kynhun nongkhaïi kim shym leit shuh lyngba ka ri , Bad ki nongleit jingleit ki pyndonkam ïa ki lynti na shadien .

translation.en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings , which he offered unto the  Lord  , two and twenty thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . Bad kumta u syiem bad ki paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: His lord answered and said unto him , Thou wicked and slothful servant , thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not , and gather where I have not strawed :
translation.kha: ‘ Me u shakri uba sniew bad uba jaipdeh !’ u kynrad jong u , u la ong . ‘ Me la tip , ym dei , ba nga ot ïa ki jingot na kaba ngam shym bet , bad lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba ngam shym bet symbai ?

translation.en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet  ; and none of them was cleansed , saving Naaman the Syrian .
translation.kha: Bad la don bun ki briew kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh kiba la im ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa ; pynban ym shym la pynkhiah ïa uno uno na ki , hynrei , tang ïa u Naaman u nong Syria .

translation.en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours : therefore acknowledge ye them that are such .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba kum kine ki dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingithuh .

translation.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la don khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar ha Jerusalem sanphew san snem .

translation.en: And she had a sister called Mary , which also sat at Jesus  feet , and heard his word .
translation.kha: Ka don kawei ka para kaba kyrteng ka Mari , kaba la shong hajan ki kjat jong U Trai bad ka la pynshahshkor ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute  ; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram , uba khmih ïa ki nongtrei ba la shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Israel , hynrei ki la lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Ha kane u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work , and shod thee with badgers  skin , and I girded thee about with fine linen , and I covered thee with silk .
translation.kha: Nga la pynphong jaiñ ïa pha ha ki jaiñ jynsur kiba la suh syntiew bad nga la ai ha pha ki juti na ki snieh kiba bha tam , ka jingteh khlieh linen bad ka tapmoh rusom .

translation.en: And I have heard of thee , that thou canst make interpretations , and dissolve doubts : now if thou canst read the writing , and make known to me the interpretation thereof , thou shalt be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about thy neck , and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: Mynta nga la ïohsngew ba me lah ban shem ïa ki jingmut barieh bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan . Lada me lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga aïu ka kit jingmut , yn pynkup ïa me ha ki jaiñkup syiem ba sawbthuh , yn pyndeng ha me ïa u kynjri ksiar jong ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong me , bad men long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .

translation.en: But thanks be to God , which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei to long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei , uba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop thiaw lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi !

translation.en: For now will I break his yoke from off thee , and will burst thy bonds in sunder .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkut mynta ïa ka bor jong ka Assyria halor jong phi bad ngan pyndkut ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa phi .

translation.en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive , he armed his trained servants , born in his own house , three hundred and eighteen , and pursued them unto Dan .
translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la ïohsngew ba la kem koidi ïa u pyrsa jong u , u khot lang ïa ki nongïapom kiba don hapoh ka dara jong u , baroh ki long laispah khatphra ngut , bad u la thwet ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem haduh Dan .

translation.en: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly .
translation.kha: Bad nga shaniah ha U Trai ba nga da lade hi , nga lah ban wan shen sha phi .

translation.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof : it shall be eaten in the holy place : it is most holy .
translation.kha: Uno uno u shynrang na ka longïing lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa ka , hynrei dei ban bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid , naba ka long kaba khuid bha .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt . And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh , and went throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la dap laiphew snem ka rta mynba u sdang ban treikam na ka bynta u syiem Ijipt . U la iehnoh ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u leit kylleng ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: For mine enemies speak against me  ; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together ,
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong nga ki kwah ban pynïap ïa nga ; ki ïakren bad sylla pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him , all ye gods .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba mane bleithaw kin shah pynlehrain , baroh ki blei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Which were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .
translation.kha: Kim shym la long ki khun U Blei katba kum ka rukom , kata , da kaba kha kum ki khun u kpa ha ka doh ; U Blei hi u la long U Kpa jong ki .

translation.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts , not to meditate before what ye shall answer :
translation.kha: Buh jingmut lypa ban ym khuslai shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïa lade ,

translation.en: And he went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u leit noh na u Pharaoh , bad u la duwai ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death . And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem  ; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria , except the apostles .
translation.kha: Bad u Saul u la mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Stephan . Ha kata hi ka sngi , ka balang ha Jerusalem ka la sdang ban mad ïa ka jingpynshitom beiñ kaba shyrkhei . Baroh ki riewngeit , lait noh ki apostol , ki la sakma sha kylleng jong ki thain ka Judia bad ka Samaria .

translation.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips  ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki sngap ïa ki jingmut kiba sniew , bad ki nongshukor ki sngap ïa ki jingshukor .

translation.en: They shall run to and fro in the city  ; they shall run upon the wall , they shall climb up upon the houses  ; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief .
translation.kha: Ki rung stet sha ka nongbah ; ki mareh nalor ki kynroh ; ki kiew sha ki ïing bad ki rung lyngba ki jingkhangïit kum ki nongtuh .

translation.en: And I have also established my covenant with them , to give them the land of Canaan , the land of their pilgrimage , wherein they were strangers .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ruh ka jutang bad ki , da kaba kular ban ai ha ki ïa ka ri Kanaan , ka ri ha kaba ki la shong la sah kum ki sohshnong .

translation.en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways , and your doings that were not good , and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations .
translation.kha: Phin sa kynmaw ïa ki jingleh bymman jong phi bad ïa ki jingbakla ba phi la leh , bad phin sa isih ïa lade namar ki pop jong phi bad ki jingleh palat jong phi .

translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was come to years , refused to be called the son of Pharaoh s daughter  ;
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Moses , haba u la rangbah , ban kyntait ba yn khot ïa u , u khun jong ka khun u Pharaoh .

translation.en: And ten young men that bare Joab s armour compassed about and smote Absalom , and slew him .
translation.kha: Nangta shiphew ngut na ki shipai jong u Joab ki ker sawdong ïa u Absalom bad pyndep ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ha u to ai ba kan long ka bor junom ! Amen .

translation.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings : because the brasen altar that was before the  Lord  was too little to receive the burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi u pynkyntang ruh ïa ka bynta kaba hapdeng ka phyllaw , kata ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u kñia hangta ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad na ka bynta ka jingainguh jingïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba kata ka duwan rnong ka rit than eh na ka bynta baroh kine ki jingainguh .

translation.en: And saw heaven opened , and a certain vessel descending unto him , as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners , and let down to the earth :
translation.kha: U la ïohi ba la plie ïa ka bneng bad kaei re kawei kaba wan hiar kaba i kum ka jaiñ siang kaba heh ïa kaba la pynhiar na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka sha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And he had thirty sons , and thirty daughters , whom he sent abroad , and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons . And he judged Israel seven years .
translation.kha: U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang bad laiphew ngut ki khun kynthei . U pynshongkurim ïa la ki khun kynthei shabar na ka kur ka jait , bad u wanrah pat laiphew ngut ki samla kynthei nabar ka kur ka jait la jong ba kin shongkurim bad ki khun shynrang jong u . U Ibsan u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynñiew snem ,

translation.en: On that day the  Lord  magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel  ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ha kata ka sngi , ka la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ban ñiew ïa u Joshua u riewkhraw . Ki burom ïa u shi lynter ka jingim jong u , kumba ki la burom ïa u Moses .

translation.en: But when the officers came , and found them not in the prison , they returned , and told ,
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki rangbah synshar ki la poi , kim shym shem ïa ki apostol ha byndi , kumta ki la wan phai noh sha ka Dorbar bad ki la ïathuh ,

translation.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ngi , u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingai bakyrpang kat kum ka jingthew ïa kaei kaba U Khrist u la ai .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria , and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes :
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u ïalam ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki koidi bad u pynshong pynsah ïa ki katto katne na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto katne hajan ka wah Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad katto katne ha ki nongbah ka Media .

translation.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  , Israel is my son , even my firstborn :
translation.kha: Te me dei ban ong ha u ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong , ‘ U Israel u long u khun nyngkong jong nga .

translation.en: And he kneeled down , and cried with a loud voice , Lord , lay not this sin to their charge . And when he had said this , he fell asleep .
translation.kha: U la dem khohsiew bad u la kyang da ka ktien bajam ,  A Trai ! wat kynmaw ïa kane ka pop pyrshah ïa ki !  U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .

translation.en: The  Lord  God is my strength , and he will make my feet like hinds  feet , and he will make me to walk upon mine high places . To the chief singer on my stringed instruments .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ . U pynlong ïa nga uba skhem ki kjat kum ka skei bad u sumar ïa nga halor ki lumbah .

translation.en: But those riches perish by evil travail : and he begetteth a son , and there is nothing in his hand .
translation.kha: bad nangta ki duh lut ïa ka ha ki katto katne ki jingïakhaïi basniew bad ki kut ha ka jingbymdon ei ei shuh ban ai pateng ha la ki khun ki kti .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you , and have not walked in my statutes , neither have kept my judgments , neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you  ;
translation.kha: Mynta to sngew , ko Jerusalem , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , Nga ong . Da kaba pham kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga ne sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , pha la pynmih kham bun ki jingeh ban ïa kito ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong pha , pha la shu bud tynneng ïa ki rukom leh jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And Solomon built Gezer , and Beth–horon the nether ,
translation.kha: Da kaba pyntrei jubor ïa ki briew , u Solomon u tei ruh ïa ka Beth Horon kaba shathie ,

translation.en: And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him ,  Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And when he thought thereon , he wept .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u syiar u kyn-ih ha ka sien kaba ar , bad u Petros u la kynmaw kumno ba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa u ,  Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ar sien , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .  Bad u la pait ka dohnud bad u la lynñiar kthang .

translation.en: ( Proverbs 1 :8 ) Jehovah requires a wife to care for her family lovingly .
translation.kha: ( Proberb 1 :8 ) U Jehobah u kwah ïa ka tnga ban sumar sukher ïa la ka ïing ka sem da ka jingieit .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said , I will let you go , that ye may sacrifice to the  Lord  your God in the wilderness  ; only ye shall not go very far away : entreat for me .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u ong ,  Ngan shah ba phin ïaleit ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha ka ri shyiap ; lada phim leit jngai than . Duwai na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And John answered and said , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name  ; and we forbad him , because he followeth not with us .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la kren ,  Ko Kynrad , ngi la ïohi ïa u briew uba beh noh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong me , bad ngi la ong ïa u ban sangeh , namar um shym long u jong ka kynhun jong ngi .

translation.en: All that are with me salute thee . Greet them that love us in the faith . Grace be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïadon ryngkat bad nga ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei ïa me . To ai khublei ïa ki paralok jong ngi kiba ha ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei U Blei kan long lem bad phi baroh .

translation.en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeroboam uba ar u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar hynriew bnai ha Samaria .

translation.en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters : but God shall rebuke them , and they shall flee far off , and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind , and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki ïaid shaphrang kum ki jingat phyllung kiba wan stet , hynrei U Blei u sneng ïa ki bad ki kynran , la beh noh ïa ki kum u pui pui ha ki sharing lum , kum u phlangïap ha ka  erlangthari .

translation.en: And he took him aside from the multitude , and put his fingers into his ears , and he spit , and touched his tongue  ;
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la shim ïa u tang marwei na u paidbah , U la buh ïa la ki shympriah kti ha ki shkor jong uta u briew , U la biah , bad U la ktah ïa u thylliej jong uta u briew .

translation.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or any poor without covering  ;
translation.kha: Haba nga shem ïa uno uno uba kyrduh , uba duk palat ban ïoh thied jaiñ thied nep ,

translation.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said ,  Why tempt ye me , ye hypocrites ?
translation.kha: U Jisu pat , u la sngewthuh ïa ka jingthmu basniew jong ki , bad kumta u la ong ,  Phi kiba arsap ! balei phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ?

translation.en: And Araunah said , Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant ? And David said , To buy the threshingfloor of thee , to build an altar unto the  Lord  , that the plague may be stayed from the people .
translation.kha: bad u kylli ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi wan shane ?  U Dabid u jubab ,  Ban thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew jong phi bad ban tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai  , khnang ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem .

translation.en: And Moses lifted up his hand , and with his rod he smote the rock twice : and the water came out abundantly , and the congregation drank , and their beasts also .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u rah shajrong ïa u diengduh bad u la tied ar sien ïa uta u mawsiang ; te ka um kaba heh ka la mih , bad baroh ki briew lem bad ki jingri ki la ïadih .

translation.en: I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms  ; but they knew not that I healed them .
translation.kha: Pynban dei ma nga uba hikai ïa ki Israel ban ïaid . Nga la rah ïa ki briew jong nga ha la ki ksang ti , hynrei kim shym la pdiang ba nga la sumar ïa ki .

translation.en: And God said unto Noah , This is the token of the covenant , which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ka dak jong ka jingkular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki jingthaw ba-im baroh .

translation.en: With whom took he counsel , and who instructed him , and taught him in the path of judgment , and taught him knowledge , and shewed to him the way of understanding ?
translation.kha: Badno ba U Blei un ïasyllok khnang ban tip bad sngewthuh bad ban hikai kumno ba ïa kiei kiei dei ban leh ?

translation.en: But love ye your enemies , and do good , and lend , hoping for nothing again  ; and your reward shall be great , and ye shall be the children of the Highest : for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil .
translation.kha: Em ! Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad lehbha ïa ki ; to ai kylliang bad wat khmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei pat . Te phin ïoh ka bainong kaba khraw , bad phin long ki khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh . Naba u long uba bha ïa u bymsngewnguh bad ïa uba bymman .

translation.en: They shall be burnt with hunger , and devoured with burning heat , and with bitter destruction : I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them , with the poison of serpents of the dust .
translation.kha: Kin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingpang shit ; kin ïap na ki jingpang kiba ishyrkhei . Te ngan phah ki mradkhlaw ban kynrup ïa ki , bad ki bseiñ kiba don bih ban puh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father  ; and his kingdom was established greatly .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la kiew khet kum u syiem hadien u Dabid , u kpa jong u , bad ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem jong u la pynskhem bha .

translation.en: For the love of Christ constraineth us ; because we thus judge , that if one died for all , then were all dead :
translation.kha: La synshar ïa ngi da ka jingieit U Khrist , mynta ba ngi tip ba uwei u briew u la ïap na ka bynta jong uwei pa uwei , kaba mut ba baroh ki ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites  ; and the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad ki Israel kim lah leh ei ei pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam , and took cities from him , Beth–el with the towns thereof , and Jeshanah with the towns thereof , and Ephrain with the towns thereof .
translation.kha: U Abijah u beh kthong ïa ka kynhun shipai u Jeroboam bad u ïohknieh katto katne na ki nongbah jong u : ka Bethel , ka Jeshanah , bad ka Ephron , bad ki nongrit kiba hajan jong kine ki nongbah .

translation.en: O  Lord  our God , all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand , and is all thine own .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , ngi la wallam lang ïa kane ka spah baroh ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me , hynrei kane baroh ka la wan na me bad ka long ka jong me .

translation.en: And they departed thence , and passed through Galilee  ; and he would not that any man should know it .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad ki la ïaleit lyngba ka Galilaïa . U Jisu um shym la kwah mano mano ruh ban tip hangno u don , namar u dang hikai ïa ki synran jong u :

translation.en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said , Rise thou , and fall upon us : for as the man is , so is his strength . And Gideon arose , and slew Zebah and Zalmunna , and took away the ornaments that were on their camels  necks .
translation.kha: Nangta u Sebah bad u Salmunna ki ong ha u Gideon ,  Shim , pynïap hi ma phi ïa ngi . Ka dei ïa u rangbah ban leh ïa ka kam rangbah .  Kumta u Gideon u la pynïap ïa ki bad u shim ïa ki jingdeng kiba ha ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .

translation.en: If they shall confess their iniquity , and the iniquity of their fathers , with their trespass which they trespassed against me , and that also they have walked contrary unto me  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin phla ïa la ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba pyneh ïa nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ,

translation.en: And having an high priest over the house of God  ;
translation.kha: Ngi don u lyngdoh uba khraw uba peit ïa ka ïing U Blei .

translation.en: Neither do men light a candle , and put it under a bushel , but on a candlestick  ; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba thang ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; hynrei u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , na kaba ka ai jingshai ïa baroh kiba hapoh ka ïing .

translation.en: And Esther answered , If it seem good unto the king , let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him .
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka la jubab ,  Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong nga mynta ka miet ha ka jingkhawai ba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: Wherefore they came again , and told him . And he said , This is the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel :
translation.kha: Haba ki leit ïathuh ïa kane ha u Jehu , u la ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia , mynba u la kren lyngba u shakri jong u , u Elijah : ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka Jesebel ha ka thain Jesreel .

translation.en: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon .
translation.kha: Tang khat-ar bnai hadien , katba u dang ïaid halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Babilon ,

translation.en: Thy name , O  Lord  , endureth for ever  ; and thy memorial , O  Lord  , throughout all generations .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ïa me yn pynbna borabor kum U Blei ; ki pateng bynriew baroh kin kynmaw ïa me .

translation.en: Woe unto thee , Chorazin ! woe unto thee , Bethsaida ! for if the mighty works , which were done in you , had been done in Tyre and Sidon , they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes .
translation.kha: Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha , ko Khorasin ! Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha ruh , ko Bethsaida ! Lada ïa ki kambah kiba la leh ha phi la lah leh ha Tyros bad Sidon , la kham slem ki briew hangta kin jin da la phong da ka jaiñ khain bad synreit da u dpei halor lade , ban pyn-i ba ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki !

translation.en: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying ,  The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and sowed in his field :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso bad u bet ïa u hapoh ka lyngkha jong u .

translation.en: And when he putteth forth his own sheep , he goeth before them , and the sheep follow him : for they know his voice .
translation.kha: Haba u la pynmih ïa ki shabar , u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki , bad ki langbrot ki bud ïa u , namar ba ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .

translation.en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , with all the remnant of the people , obeyed the voice of the  Lord  their God , and the words of Haggai the prophet , as the  Lord  their God had sent him , and the people did fear before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te u Serubbabel bad u Joshua bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia , ki la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la ong ïa ki ban leh . Ki la sheptieng bad ki la kohnguh ïa u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa , u nonglamktien jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And she said , The glory is departed from Israel : for the ark of God is taken .
translation.kha: Ka burom U Blei ka la phet na Israel ,  ka ong ,  namar ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei .

translation.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
translation.kha: U Balaam u leh kumta , bad u kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan .

translation.en: Brethren , be not children in understanding : howbeit in malice be ye children , but in understanding be men .
translation.kha: Wat long kum ki khynnah ha ka rukom pyrkhat jong phi , ko parabangeit jong nga ; to long khynnah ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingbymman , hynrei to long rangbah ha ka rukom pyrkhat .

translation.en: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal , he , and all the people of war with him , and all the mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba kynsai tam , ki la mihnoh na Gilgal .

translation.en: Then shall two be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: So the people went forth , and brought them , and made themselves booths , every one upon the roof of his house , and in their courts , and in the courts of the house of God , and in the street of the water gate , and in the street of the gate of Ephraim .
translation.kha: Kumta ki briew ki la ïoh ïa ki tnat bad shna ïa ki ïingtrep halor ki tnum ïing ba madan jong ki ïing jong ki , ha la ki jaka , ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , bad ha ki jaka paidbah basawdong hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad hajan ka Khyrdop Ephraim .

translation.en: And said unto the woman , Now we believe , not because of thy saying : for we have heard him ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Saviour of the world .
translation.kha: Ngi ngeit mynta , ym namar kaei kaba pha la ïathuh , hynrei namar ma ngi hi da lade ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi tip ba une da shisha u long u Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: As newborn babes , desire the sincere milk of the word , that ye may grow thereby :
translation.kha: To long kum ki khunlung kiba dang shu kha , kiba kwah hir hir borabor ïa ka dud bakhuid ba kynja mynsiem , khnang ba da kaba dih ïa ka phin san bad yn pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God  ; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled  ;
translation.kha: To sumar ban ym phai dien noh na ka jingaiei U Blei . Wat ai ba uno uno un long kum u jingthung uba kthang , uba san bad uba pynjynjar da ka bih jong u .

translation.en: The wife hath not power of her own body , but the husband : and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body , but the wife .
translation.kha: Ka tnga kam long kynrad halor ka met jong ka hi , hynrei u tnga jong ka u long ; kumjuh ruh u tnga um long kynrad halor ka met jong u hi , hynrei ka tnga jong u ka long .

translation.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests , and Samuel among them that call upon his name  ; they called upon the  Lord  , and he answered them .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la long ki lyngdoh jong u , bad u Samuel u la long uwei uba la duwai ha u ; kiba la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u la jubab ïa ki .

translation.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives , the disciples came unto him privately , saying , Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign of thy coming , and of the end of the world ?
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang shong halor u lum ki Olib , ki synran ki la wan sha u ha kaba jar jar .  To ïathuh ha ngi lano kane baroh kan long ,  ki la kylli ,  bad kaei ka ban jia ban pyn-i ba ka la dei ka por ïa ka jingwan jong me bad kaba kut ka Ïa .

translation.en: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea , and they went out into the wilderness of Shur  ; and they went three days in the wilderness , and found no water .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka Duriaw Basaw sha ka ri shyiap Shur . Lai sngi lynter ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , hynrei kim shym lap um satia .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The labour of Egypt , and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans , men of stature , shall come over unto thee , and they shall be thine : they shall come after thee  ; in chains they shall come over , and they shall fall down unto thee , they shall make supplication unto thee , saying , Surely God is in thee  ; and there is none else , there is no God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ki Israel ,  Ka spah ki Ijipt bad ki Sudan kan long ka jong phi , bad ki rangbah bajrong jong ka Seba kin long ki mraw jong phi ; kin bud ïa phi ha ki kynjri . Kin dem ngon ha phi bad kin phla , ‘ U Blei u don ryngkat bad phi — tang ma u , u long U Blei .

translation.en: And moreover , because the preacher was wise , he still taught the people knowledge  ; yea , he gave good heed , and sought out , and set in order many proverbs .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u Stad saiñpyrkhat u long uba stad , u ïai hikai ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba u tip . U la pule bniah ïa ki proberb bad da kaba sngur mynsiem u da tynjuh ïa ka jingshisha jong ki .

translation.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , Who is on the  Lord s  side ? let him come unto me . And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta u ïeng ha ka khyrdop jong ka jaka sher dara , bad u la pyrta ,  Kat uba don ha ka liang jong U  Trai  , wan shane !  Kumta baroh kiba na ka jait Lebi ki ïalumlang ha u ,

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will diligently learn the ways of my people , to swear by my name , The  Lord  liveth  ; as they taught my people to swear by Baal  ; then shall they be built in the midst of my people .
translation.kha: Lada kin pdiang da ka dohnud jong ki baroh ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong nga bad kin smai , ‘ Kumba U  Trai  u im’ — kumba shisien ki la hikai ïa ki briew jong nga ban smai da u Baal — nangta ki ruh kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga ban kin manbha .

translation.en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you : for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another .
translation.kha: Ym da donkam ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïa-ieit ïa ki parabangeit jong phi . Ma phi hi phi long kiba la ïoh hikai na U Blei kumno phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And when they were come , they say unto him , Master , we know that thou art true , and carest for no man : for thou regardest not the person of men , but teachest the way of God in truth : Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar , or not ?
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , ngi tip ba me kren ïa ka jingshisha , khlem da khuslai ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat . Mem ñiew ïa ka kyrdan u briew , hynrei me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew . To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban siew ki khajna sha u Patsha ka Rom ? Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban siew ne ban ym siew ?

translation.en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the  Lord  into the hand of Asaph and his brethren .
translation.kha: Ka long naduh kata ka por ba u Dabid u la ai nyngkong eh ha u Asaph bad ki para Lebi jong u ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel : and from Nahaliel to Bamoth :
translation.kha: bad nangta ki leit sha Nahaliel , bad na Nahaliel sha Bamoth ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , that as he was come nigh unto Jericho , a certain blind man sat by the way side begging :
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang wan hajan ka Jerikho , la don u briew bamatlah uba shong harud ka lynti bah , u da khrong .

translation.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen , and thou shalt be near unto me , thou , and thy children , and thy children s children , and thy flocks , and thy herds , and all that thou hast :
translation.kha: Phin shong ha ri Goshen , bad phin don hajan jong nga — ma phi , ki khun jong phi , ki ksiew jong phi , lem bad ki kynhun langbrot jong phi , ki blang jong phi , kiwei kiwei de ki jingri jong phi , bad baroh kat kiba phi don .

translation.en: For , behold , the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts , doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff , the whole stay of bread , and the whole stay of water ,
translation.kha: Mynta u Trai , U  Trai  Badonbor baroh un sa shim noh na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kaei kaei baroh bad ïa uwei pa uwei ba ki briew ki shaniah . Un shim noh ïa ka jingbam bad ka um jong ki ,

translation.en: And it shall be , if thou have no delight in her , then thou shalt let her go whither she will  ; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money , thou shalt not make merchandise of her , because thou hast humbled her .
translation.kha: Te , lada phim mon shuh ïa ka , phi lah ban pyllait ïa ka . Namar ba phi la pynbor ban ïathiah shongkha bad ka , phim lah ban ñiew ïa ka kum ka mraw bad die ïa ka .

translation.en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath , and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks .
translation.kha: U la ïaphylliew jingmut hapoh synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , da kaba pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki Jiw bad ki Grik .

translation.en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain , and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second  ; that the loops may take hold one of another .
translation.kha: Buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka jingkah kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh ba la suh lang ha ka jingkah kaba ar . Pynphai marpyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: For she doted upon their paramours , whose flesh is as the flesh of asses , and whose issue is like the issue of horses .
translation.kha: Ka la dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki rangbah ba-dap da ka jingbrai kiba don ka jingthrew jakhlia la kum ki kada bad ki khashor .

translation.en: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people , and the veil that is spread over all nations .
translation.kha: Hangne un sa weng kynsan ïa u lyoh jong ka jingsngewsih uba ju tap halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon : and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men  ; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom , and slew two thousand men of them .
translation.kha: Kiba sah ki phai bad phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon . San hajar ngut na kita ki shah pynïap ha lynti bah . Ki Israel ki ïai beh ïa kiba dang sah haduh Gidom , ki da pynïap ar hajar ngut na kita .

translation.en: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel ,
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u synshar ïa ki Israel haduh lai snem .

translation.en: And base things of the world , and things which are despised , hath God chosen , yea , and things which are not , to bring to nought things that are :
translation.kha: U la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka ñiew poh bad ibeiñ , bad ka pyrkhat ba kam long ei ei , khnang ban pynjot ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam .

translation.en: And I will cast thee out , and thy mother that bare thee , into another country , where ye were not born  ; and there shall ye die .
translation.kha: Ngan sa bret ïa me bad ïa ka kmie jong me sha ka jinglongmraw . Men leit sha ka ri ha kaba ym shym la kha ïa me , bad hangta phin ïap baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock , and out of thy floor , and out of thy winepress : of that wherewith the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him .
translation.kha: Ai kylluid mynsiem ïa ki na ki jingkyrkhu kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi — na ki langbrot , na u kew , bad na ka waiñ jong phi .

translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I would not that ye should be ignorant , how that all our fathers were under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la bud ïa u Moses . Baroh ki la don hapoh ka jingïada jong u lyoh , bad baroh ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw .

translation.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding : and they would not come .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki shakri jong u ban ïathuh ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ban wan sha ka jingkhawai , hynrei kim kwah ban wan .

translation.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled , and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down , and the  Lord  alone shall be exalted in that day .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kan wan ha kaba yn pynkut ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew bad yn pynjot thiaw ïa ka jinglehmeng ba kynja briew . Nangta tang ïa U  Trai  hi yn kyntiew burom .

translation.en: And again he said ,  Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ,  Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka Hima U Blei ?

translation.en: And when the Lord saw her , he had compassion on her , and said unto her ,  Weep not .
translation.kha: Haba U Trai u la ïohi ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingisynei ïa ka , bad u la ong ha ka ,  Wat ïam .

translation.en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up , for to shew in thee my power  ; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ka bor jong nga , nga la shah ba men dang im , khnang ba yn ïoh pynbna ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: Whose arrows are sharp , and all their bows bent , their horses  hoofs shall be counted like flint , and their wheels like a whirlwind :
translation.kha: Ki khnam jong ki , ki long kiba nep , bad ki ryntieh jong ki , ki long kiba la pynkhreh ban siat . Ki poh jat jong ki kulai jong ki , ki eh kum ki mawshamok bad ki shaka jong ki kali ïapom jong ki , ki kylla long kum ka  erlangthari .

translation.en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity : because they trespassed against me , therefore hid I my face from them , and gave them into the hand of their enemies : so fell they all by the sword .
translation.kha: Bad ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ki Israel ki la shah ringmraw namar ki pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga . Nga la phai noh na ki bad nga la shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ban pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma .

translation.en: And Aaron said , Let not the anger of my lord wax hot : thou knowest the people , that they are set on mischief .
translation.kha: U Aaron u jubab ,  Wat bitar ïa nga . Phi tip ba kine ki briew ki long kiba im sngi tang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: He also shall be my salvation : for an hypocrite shall not come before him .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba ka jingshlur jong nga kan pyllait im ïa nga , namar yn ym don u riewsniew u ban nud ban ïakynduh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho , unto the water of Jericho on the east , to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth–el ,
translation.kha: Ïa u pud bashaphang shathie jong ka ri la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph ; u sdang na ka Jordan hajan ka Jerikho , ha ka bynta kaba sha mihngi jong ki umpohliew ka Jerikho , bad u suh sha ka ri shyiap . U suh na ka Jerikho artet sha ka ri lum haduh ka Bethel .

translation.en: And one goat for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones , even four rows of stones : the first row shall be a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this shall be the first row .
translation.kha: Pyndait ha ka , saw kyrdon ki mawkordor , u Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong ;

translation.en: These are the generations of Jacob . Joseph , being seventeen years old , was feeding the flock with his brethren  ; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah , and with the sons of Zilpah , his father s wives : and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report .
translation.kha: bad kane ka dei ka khana shaphang ka longïing longsem jong u Jakob . U Joseph , u samla uba la khathynñiew snem ka rta , u ap sumar ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang lem bad la ki hynmen shynrang jong u , ki khun shynrang jong ka Bilhah bad ka Silpah , ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u . U Joseph u wanrah ki jingïathuh bymsngewtynnat ha la u kpa shaphang kaei ba ki hynmen jong u ki leh .

translation.en: And the people chode with Moses , and spake , saying , Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the  Lord  !
translation.kha: bad u ïakren khñium :  Kan jin da la kham bha lada ngi la ïap ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  lem bad kiwei pat ki para Israel .

translation.en: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly , and came unto him .
translation.kha: Haba ka Mari ka la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka la ïeng joit bad ka la leit kyrkieh ban ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: The  Lord  is my portion , saith my soul  ; therefore will I hope in him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long baroh kaba nga don , bad kumta nga buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha u .

translation.en: And he said ,  Therefore said I unto you , that no man can come unto me , except it were given unto him of my Father .
translation.kha: Bad u la pyndap ,  Kane hi ka dei ka daw kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba ym don uba lah ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa u pynlah ïa u ban leh kumta .

translation.en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor , and though I give my body to be burned , and have not charity , it profiteth me nothing .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban ai baroh kaba nga don , bad wat ïa ka met jong nga ïa ka ban thang — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , kane kam myntoi ei ei ïa nga .

translation.en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches , and the multitude of his children , and all the things wherein the king had promoted him , and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king .
translation.kha: U la kren sarong ha khmat jong ki kumno ba u long uba riewspah , ba u don bun ki khun shynrang , kumno ba u syiem u la pynkiew ïa u sha ka kyrdan ba-halor , bad kumno ba u long uba kham donkam ban ïa kiwei ki rangbah synshar u syiem .

translation.en: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren , my kinsmen according to the flesh :
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ki nga kwah ba ngan jin da la don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ba la pynïakhlad na U Khrist .

translation.en: So Gad came to David , and told him , and said unto him , Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land ? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies , while they pursue thee ? or that there be three days  pestilence in thy land ? now advise , and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me .
translation.kha: u Gad u la leit sha u , ban ïathuh ïa u ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano kata ka ban long ? Lai snem ka  nemsniew ha ka ri jong phi , lane lai bnai kaba phet ïap na ki nongshun jong phi , ne lai sngi ka jingïapthem ha ka ri jong phi ? Mynta to pyrkhat , bad ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jubab ba ngan leit rah sha U  Trai .

translation.en: But in the last days it shall come to pass , that the mountain of the house of the  Lord  shall be established in the top of the mountains , and it shall be exalted above the hills  ; and people shall flow unto it .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi ki ban wan u lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng un long uba jrong tam na baroh , uba tyllep ïa ki lumrit baroh . Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun kin wan tuid sha u ,

translation.en: ( Revelation 3 :14 ) Jesus himself said that he ‘ made God’s name known’ and kept ‘ bearing witness to the truth’ about God .
translation.kha: ( Jingpynpaw 3 :14 ) U Jisu hi u la ong ba u la ‘ pyntip ia ka kyrteng jong U Blei’ bad u la ïai “phla skhem ia ka jingshisha” shaphang U Blei .

translation.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .
translation.kha: Ki Apostol bad kiwei pat ki riewngeit ha kylleng ka Judia ki la ïohsngew ba ki Jentil ruh ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall guide thee continually , and satisfy thy soul in drought , and make fat thy bones : and thou shalt be like a watered garden , and like a spring of water , whose waters fail not .
translation.kha: Bad ngan ïalam ïa phi borabor , bad pynkdang ïa phi da kiei kiei kiba bha . Ngan pynlong ïa phi kiba khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Phin long kum ka kper kaba pahuh um , kum ka umpohliew ka bym ju rngad .

translation.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth  ; for I have hoped in thy judgments .
translation.kha: Pynlah ïa nga ban kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ki por baroh , namar ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka long ha ki jingbishar jong me .

translation.en: According to all that I shew thee , after the pattern of the tabernacle , and the pattern of all the instruments thereof , even so shall ye make it .
translation.kha: Shna ïa ka bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka baroh kat kum ka dur kaba ngan pyn-i ha me .

translation.en: And it was found written , that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king s chamberlains , the keepers of the door , who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Ka bynta ba ki pule ka kynthup ïa jingbuh jingthoh shaphang kumno u Mordekai u la lap ïa ka jingsylla ban pynïap ïa u syiem — ka jingsylla da u Bigthana bad u Teresh , ki ar ngut ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ki kamra u syiem .

translation.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising , a scab , or bright spot , and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy  ; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest , or unto one of his sons the priests :
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u mih prum , lane u mih tohjaw , lane u tyrha ka sniehdoh , bad kata ka lah ban kylla sha ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , dei ban leit ïalam ïa u ha lyngdoh uba na ka longïing jong u Aaron .

translation.en: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying , as soon as I was sent for : I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me ?
translation.kha: Bad kumta haba phi la phah khot ïa nga , nga la wan khlem kano kano ka jingpyrshah . Nga kylli ïa phi , te , balei ba phi phah khot ïa nga ?

translation.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers , Except these abide in the ship , ye cannot be saved .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha u rangbah shipai bad ha ki shipai ,  Lada ki maji kim don ha ka lieng , phim don jingkyrmen shuh ban lait im .

translation.en: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen , and whom ye have desired ! and , behold , the  Lord  hath set a king over you .
translation.kha: Mynta hangne u don u syiem uba phi la jied ; phi la pan ïa u , bad mynta U  Trai  u la ai ïa u ha phi .

translation.en: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks , and laid them on the fire , there came a viper out of the heat , and fastened on his hand .
translation.kha: ) . Nangta u Paul u thoh kham shai shuh ïa kane ka phangpdeng . Baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , ki donkam ban don ka jinglonghok bad U Blei , naba baroh ki don hapoh ka bor jong ka pop . Ka jinglonghok ki briew bad U Blei ka long lyngba ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist . Nangta u Paul u batai ïa ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist kaba mih na kane ka jingïadei bathymmai bad U Blei . Uba ngeit u don ka jingïasuk bad U Blei bad ïa u la pyllait da U Mynsiem jong U Blei na ka bor jong ka pop bad ka jingïap . Ha ki lynnong

translation.en: Turn again , my daughters , go your way  ; for I am too old to have an husband . If I should say , I have hope , if I should have an husband also to night , and should also bear sons  ;
translation.kha: Khie leit phai noh sha ïing , naba nga la tymmen ban shongkurim biang . Wat lada nga pyrkhat ba dang don jingkyrmen , bad kumta ban shongkurim ha kane ka miet bad ïoh khun shynrang ,

translation.en: For from Israel was it also : the workman made it  ; therefore it is not God : but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces .
translation.kha: U nongsaiñdur na Israel uba la thaw ïa u bleithaw , bad um dei satia u blei ! Ïa u khun masi ksiar ba mane ha Samaria yn sa pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years , even the selfsame day it came to pass , that all the hosts of the  Lord  went out from the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba kut jong kita ki sawspah laiphew snem , baroh ki paid U  Trai  ki mihnoh na Ijipt .

translation.en: You can recognize them by the way they take no part in politics or social conflicts .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ithuh ïa ki namar kim ju shim bynta ha ki kam saiñ pyrthei ne ha kam ïaleh pyrshah ha ka imlang sahlang .

translation.en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the  Lord  , offer it at your own will .
translation.kha: Haba phi pynlong ïa ka jingkñia ainguh sngewbha sha U  Trai  , bud beit ïa ki rukom lehniam khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa phi .

translation.en: Will you please explain to me the exact meaning of the word ?
translation.kha: Sngewbha batai ianga ka jingmut ba iahap tam jong ka kyntien .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while Saul talked unto the priest , that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased : and Saul said unto the priest , Withdraw thine hand .
translation.kha: Katba u Saul u dang kren ha uta u lyngdoh , ka jingkulmar ha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka nang kham jur ; kumta u Saul u ong ha u ,  Ym don por ban kylli ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And as Jesus passed by , he saw a man which was blind from his birth .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid artat , u la ïohi ïa u briew ïa uba la kha matlah .

translation.en: And when she came to her mother in law , she said , Who art thou , my daughter ? And she told her all that the man had done to her .
translation.kha: Haba ka la poi ha ïing , ka kiaw jong ka , ka kylli ïa ka ,  Ka long kumno , ko khun kynthei jong nga ?  Ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Boas u la leh na ka bynta jong ka .

translation.en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and the brass for things of brass , the iron for things of iron , and wood for things of wood  ; onyx stones , and stones to be set , glistering stones , and of divers colours , and all manner of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .
translation.kha: Nga la leh katba nga lah ban pynbiang ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka Templ — Ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ki dieng , ki mawkordor , bad ki mawlynnai , ki maw na ka bynta ki jingthaw dur , bad shibun u maw marbl .

translation.en: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal , but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds .
translation.kha: Ki atiar kiba ngi pyndonkam ha ka jingïaleh jong ngi kim long ki atiar jong ka pyrthei hynrei ki atiar kiba donbor jong U Blei , ïa kiba ngi pyndonkam ban pynpra ïa ki kut baskhem .

translation.en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron , saying , Ye have killed the people of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ka kynhun baroh ka la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad ka ong ,  Phi la pynïap katto katne ngut ki briew jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Then he returned , and walked in the house to and fro  ; and went up , and stretched himself upon him : and the child sneezed seven times , and the child opened his eyes .
translation.kha: U Elisha u khie joit , u ïaid shane shatai hapoh kamra , bad nangta u leit biang bad u pyiar ïa lade halor u khynnah . U khynnah u la synriah hynñiew sien bad u peit la ki khmat .

translation.en: And he said unto them , What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people , which have spoken to me , saying , Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us ?
translation.kha: Kaei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ?  u kylli .  Kaei ba ngan ong ha ki briew kiba ong ïa nga ba ngan pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?

translation.en: Nay , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us .
translation.kha: Em , ha kine baroh ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop baroh lyngba jong uta uba la ieit ïa ngi!

translation.en: Stand therefore , having your loins girt about with truth , and having on the breastplate of righteousness ;
translation.kha: Kumta to ïeng ba la pynkhreh , da ka jingshisha kum u panpoh ba la pyndait ha ka syngkai jong phi , da ka hok kum ka jingda shadem jong phi ,

translation.en: By faith Noah , being warned of God of things not seen as yet , moved with fear , prepared an ark to the saving of his house  ; by the which he condemned the world , and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Noah ban shahshkor ïa ki jingmaham U Blei shaphang kiei kiei ki ban sa jia ïa kiba um shym lah ban ïohi . U la kohnguh ïa U Blei bad u la thaw ïa ka ïinglieng ha kaba ma u bad ka longïing jong u ki la ïohlait im . Da kane , la pynrem ïa ka pyrthei , bad u Noah u la ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka hok kaba wan da ka jingngeit .

translation.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , even the prophecy : the man spake unto Ithiel , even unto Ithiel and Ucal ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien bashongkhia jong u Agur u khun jong u Jakeh :  U Blei um long bad nga , U Blei um long bad nga , bad nga long khlem jingïarap .

translation.en: Say ye unto your brethren , Ammi  ; and to your sisters , Ru–hamah .
translation.kha: Kumta khot ïa ki para Israel  Ki briew jong U Blei  bad  kiba ieit da U Trai .

translation.en: It is a continual burnt offering , which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi ba la thang lut , kaba la leh nyngkong ha u Lum Sinai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria :
translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u la phah ka khubor ban ïathuh ha u syiem Hesekaïah kaba jubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem .

translation.en: And he said , Let me go , for the day breaketh . And he said , I will not let thee go , except thou bless me .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u ong ,  Pyllait noh ïa nga ; ka la sdang kynjat shai .   Em , ngan ym pyllait , lymda me kyrkhu ïa nga ,  ong u Jakob .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa jong u kpa jong u , u Ussaïah , u Jotham u la leh hi ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt  ; and he shall burn them , and carry them away captives : and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt , as a shepherd putteth on his garment  ; and he shall go forth from thence in peace .
translation.kha: Ngan tbeh ïa ka ding ha ki templ jong ki blei ki Ijipt , bad u syiem ka Babilonia un thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ne ïalam noh ïa ki . Katba ki nongap langbrot ki dang jied ïa ki jaiñ jong ki kiba lait na ki jynreiñ , te u syiem ka Babilonia un jied pynkhuid ïa ka ri Ijipt bad nangta ki mih da ka jingjop .

translation.en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god , and we will walk in the name of the  Lord  our God for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ka mane bad kohnguh ha ïa la u jong u blei , hynrei ngi ngin mane bad kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi junom la junom .

translation.en: And now art thou cursed from the earth , which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother s blood from thy hand  ;
translation.kha: La buh ïa me hapoh ka jingtim bad men ym lah shuh ban rep ha ka khyndew . Ka la kjit noh ïa ka snam u para jong me , i kumba ka la ang ïa la ka shyntur ban pdiang ïa kata mynba me la pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold : none were of silver  ; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki khuri jong u syiem Solomon la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon    ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ha ki sngi u Solomon ïa ka rupa ym pat ñiew kaba kordor .

translation.en: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan , in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood : and they are there unto this day .
translation.kha: U Joshua u pynïeng ruh khat-ar tylli ki maw hapdeng jong ka Jordan , ha kaba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïeng . ( Kito ki maw ki dang don hangta . )

translation.en: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes , part of potters  clay , and part of iron , the kingdom shall be divided  ; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron , forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ki kjat bad ki shympriah kjat ki long shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha bad shi bynta da ka nar . Kane ka mut ba kan long ka hima kaba la pynïakhlad . Kan don kaei kaei kaba eh kum ka nar , namar la don ka nar kaba la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: They mount up to the heaven , they go down again to the depths : their soul is melted because of trouble .
translation.kha: Ki liengbah ki shah kynting sha suiñ bad ki ngam shapoh ki jingjylliew . Hapdeng kum kata ka jingma ki briew ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur ;

translation.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice , for one lamb .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba wanrah ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kum ka jingainguh thang ha U  Trai  u dei ban wallam lem bad kata ka jingri shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar ka waiñ .

translation.en: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death , and those that are ready to be slain  ;
translation.kha: Wat pynslem ban pyllait ïa uno uno uba la jan shah rai pynrem bymhok .

translation.en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place , according to the commandment of David , and Asaph , and Heman , and Jeduthun the king s seer  ; and the porters waited at every gate  ; they might not depart from their service  ; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongtem nongput harum na ka kur u Asaph jong ki Lebi ki don ha la ki jaka ba la aiti ha ki da ki jingbthah u Syiem Dabid : u Asaph , u Heman , bad u Jeduthun , u nongïathuhlypa jong u syiem . Ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop ka Templ kim shym donkam ban mihnoh na ki jaka ba ki ap , namar kiwei pat ki Lebi ki pynkhreh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him .
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .
translation.kha: Namar kata , phin ïoh ïa kaba phi pan kwah , bad ki kam jong phi hi kin pynshitom ïa phi .

translation.en: Yea , I will gather you , and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath , and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ngan lumlang ïa ki ha Jerusalem , buh ïa ka ding hapoh jong ki , bad pynum ïa ki da ka jingbitar jong nga .

translation.en: Thy throne is established of old : thou art from everlasting .
translation.kha: Ka khet jong me , A  Trai  , ka la long kaba skhem naduh mynnyngkong , bad me la long shuwa ka jingsdang ka por .

translation.en: But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal s wife , saying , Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master  ; and he railed on them .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki shakri jong u Nabal u ong ha ka Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal ,  Hato phi ïohsngew ? U Dabid u la phah katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien na ka ri khlaw lem bad ka jingai khublei ïa u kynrad jong ngi , hynrei u la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: ( Hebrews 6 :1 ) As you continue , you will be better able to take in “solid food”—that is , deeper truths .
translation.kha: ( Hebru 6 :1 ) Lada phi iaineh phin sa lah ban bam “ka jingbam kaba eh” —kata ka long ka jingshisha kaba jylliew .

translation.en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee : bind them about thy neck  ; write them upon the table of thine heart :
translation.kha: Wat ai ba ka jinglong bashaniah bad baïaineh kin iehnoh ïa phi . Teh ïa ki sawdong ka ryndang jong phi ; thoh ïa ki ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall , called Praetorium  ; and they call together the whole band .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu shapoh sha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingshong u lat bad ki la khot lang ïa baroh ki shipai ba dang sah jong ka kynhun .

translation.en: These are the three sons of Noah : and of them was the whole earth overspread .
translation.kha: Kine lai ngut ki khun u Noah ki long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong kata ka mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan .

translation.en: ( For not the hearers of the law are just before God , but the doers of the law shall be justified .
translation.kha: Naba ym dei da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Hukum ba ki briew ki don ka jingïadei bad U Blei , hynrei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .

translation.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee , and their kings shall be sore afraid , they shall be troubled in their countenance .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shong ha lynter ka rud duriaw u kyndit ïa ka kupar jong pha . Wat ki syiem jong ki , ki sngewtriem , bad ka jingsheptieng ka paw ha ki khmat jong ki .

translation.en: For the builders , every one had his sword girded by his side , and so builded . And he that sounded the trumpet was by me .
translation.kha: bad baroh uba trei , u don ka waitlam ba la teh ha ka syngkai jong u . U briew uba pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham da ka jingput ronsing u don bad nga .

translation.en: And Lot lifted up his eyes , and beheld all the plain of Jordan , that it was well watered every where , before the  Lord  destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah , even as the garden of the  Lord  , like the land of Egypt , as thou comest unto Zoar .
translation.kha: U Lot u la khmih sawdong bad u la ïohi ba ka them Jordan baroh kawei haduh Soar , ka don kyrhai ka um , kum ka Kper jong U  Trai  lane kum ka ri Ijipt . ( Kane ka long ha shuwa ba U  Trai  un pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . )

translation.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt  ; and I will also surely bring thee up again : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .
translation.kha: Ngan leit lang bad me sha Ijipt , bad ngan wan ïalam biang ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me sha kane ka ri . U Joseph ruh un don ryngkat bad me ynda me ïap .

translation.en: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear : and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them , seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God .
translation.kha: Nga la pynïap ïa ki sing bad ki dngiem , bad ngan leh kumjuh ïa une u Philistia ba mane blei thala , uba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong U Blei uba im .

translation.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought  ; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised , and her magnificence should be destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worshippeth .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingma , te , ba kane ka kam jong ngi kan budnam . Ym tang kata , hynrei ka don ruh ka jingma ba ka templ jong ka blei Artemis kan ym don jingmut ei ei shuh bad ba ïa ka jingkhraw jong ka yn pynduh — ka blei ba la mane da uwei pa uwei ha Asia bad ha ka pyrthei baroh !

translation.en: For of him , and through him , and to him , are all things : to whom be glory for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Naba ïa baroh kiei kiei la thaw da u , bad baroh kiei kiei ki long lyngba jong u bad na ka bynta jong u . Ha U Blei , to long ka burom junom ! Amen .

translation.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah khyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins , exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads , all of them princes to look to , after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea , the land of their nativity :
translation.kha: Ka nang ngam nang ngam ha ka jinglong bajakhlia jong ka . Ka ïapmat ïa ki durbriew jong ki rangbah shipai ka Babilonia ba la ohdur ha ka kynroh bad ba la airong da ka rong saw baphyrnai , lem bad ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki bad ki jaiñspong ba-itynnat ha ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: Or those eighteen , upon whom the tower in Siloam fell , and slew them , think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Kumno shaphang kito ki khatphra ngut ki briew ha Siloam kiba la shah pynïap mynba ka jaka ap phira ka hap halor jong ki ? Hato phi tharai ba kane ka pynshisha ba ki long kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ?

translation.en: Because thou servedst not the  Lord  thy God with joyfulness , and with gladness of heart , for the abundance of all things  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa phi ha ki bynta baroh , hynrei phim shym shakri ïa u da ka dohnud kaba sngewbha bad kaba kmen .

translation.en: And the king said to Absalom , Nay , my son , let us not all now go , lest we be chargeable unto thee . And he pressed him : howbeit he would not go , but blessed him .
translation.kha: Em , ko khun jong nga ,  u syiem u jubab .  Kan bankhia shibun eh ïa phi lada ngi baroh ngi ïaleit .  U Absalom u la ïai ban , hynrei u syiem um shym mynjur , bad u la ong ïa u Absalom ban mihnoh .

translation.en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages : they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me : their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly .
translation.kha: Ki khnam jong me ki sam lyngba ïa u nongïalam ka kynhun shipai jong u haba u la wan kum ka  erïong ban pynsakma ïa ngi , da ka jingsarong kum kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth  ; and my delights were with the sons of men .
translation.kha: nga lehkmen ha ka pyrthei , bad leh sngewbha bad ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass , and cut the bars of iron in sunder .
translation.kha: U la pynpait ïa ki jingkhang rnong bad pynpra ïa ki nar kiba ker .

translation.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet , until his disease was exceeding great : yet in his disease he sought not to the  Lord  , but to the physicians .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai ba u Asa u long syiem , u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat kaba jur ; wat la katta ruh um shym la phai sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïarap , hynrei sha ki nongpynkhiah .

translation.en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries , when they had heard that the  Lord  fought against the enemies of Israel .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka hima kaba la ïohsngew kumno U  Trai  u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki Israel , ka la sheptieng haduh katta katta .

translation.en: And it grew , and became a spreading vine of low stature , whose branches turned toward him , and the roots thereof were under him : so it became a vine , and brought forth branches , and shot forth sprigs .
translation.kha: U jingthung u la speh bad u la long u dieng sohwaiñ uba lyngkot bad uba pyiar kylleng . Ki tnat ki san shajrong sha u pukni , bad ki thied ki suh jylliew . La tap ïa u dieng sohwaiñ da ki tnat bad ki sla .

translation.en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner , nor a stone for foundations  ; but thou shalt be desolate for ever , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Yn ym don ki maw na ki jingjot jong pha ba yn pyndonkam pat na ka bynta ki jingtei . Phan long kum ka ri shyiap junom . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we shall be saved from wrath through him .
translation.kha: Da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , mynta la pynlong ka jingïadei hapdeng jong ngi bad U Blei ; katno tam te , ngin long kiba lait im da u na ka jingbitar U Blei!

translation.en: Or have ye not read in the law , how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath , and are blameless ?
translation.kha: Lane phim pat ju pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ba man la ka sngi Sabbaton ki lyngdoh hapoh ka Templ ki pynkheiñ shisha ïa ka aiñ sngi Sabbaton , pynban kim shah pynrem ?

translation.en: He is not the God of the dead , but the God of the living : ye therefore do greatly err .
translation.kha: U long U Blei jong kiba im , ym jong kiba ïap . Phi la bakla shikatdei eh !

translation.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen  ; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities , and with the king at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u don saw hajar tylli ki sem kulai na ka bynta ki kali ïapom bad ki kulai jong u , bad u don khat-ar hajar tylli ki kulai thma . Katto katne na ki u buh ha Jerusalem bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .

translation.en: Now Caiaphas was he , which gave counsel to the Jews , that it was expedient that one man should die for the people .
translation.kha: Dei u Kaïaphas uba la ai jingmut ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba ka kham bha ba uwei u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka briew baroh .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jonah the second time , saying ,
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jonah .

translation.en: In those days , and at that time , will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David  ; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan jied kum u syiem ïa u nonghiarpateng uba hok na u Dabid . Uta u syiem un leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba hok ha ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he went through the cities and villages , teaching , and journeying toward Jerusalem .
