translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit lyngba ki nongbah bad ki nongrit , u da hikai ïa ki briew bad u da thew ïa la ka lynti sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Who is he that overcometh the world , but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God ?
translation.kha: Uei uba lah ban jop ïa ka pyrthei ? Tang u briew uba ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: And they appointed two , Joseph called Barsabas , who was surnamed Justus , and Matthias .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la tyrwa ar ngut ki rangbah : U Joseph ïa uba la khot u Barsabbas ( ïa uba la tip ruh kum u Justos ) , bad u Matthias .

translation.en: And he doeth great wonders , so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men ,
translation.kha: Une u mradkhlaw uba ar , u la leh ki kambah kiba khraw ; u la pynlong ïa ka ding ban wan hiar na bneng sha ka pyrthei ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei baroh .

translation.en: And there was nothing lacking to them , neither small nor great , neither sons nor daughters , neither spoil , nor any thing that they had taken to them : David recovered all .
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei kaba jah . U Dabid u ïoh pat ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei baroh jong ki briew jong u , bad ïa ki mar lute baroh ba ki Amalek ki la kit .

translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw the women and the children  ; and said , Who are those with thee ? And he said , The children which God hath graciously given thy servant .
translation.kha: Haba u Iso u phai sawdong , bad u ïohi ïa ki kynthei bad ïa ki khynnah , u ong ,  Kiei kine ki briew kiba bad phi ?  U Jakob u jubab ,  Kine , kynrad , ki dei ki khun kiba U Blei u la sngewbha eh ban ai ïa nga .

translation.en: I live in Shillong .
translation.kha: Nga sah ha Shillong .

translation.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe , that ye may look upon it , and remember all the commandments of the  Lord  , and do them  ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes , after which ye use to go a whoring :
translation.kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin long kum ki jingpynkynmaw , bad man ka por ba phi ïohi ïa ki , phin kynmaw ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad kohnguh ïa ki ; te kumta phin ym phai noh na nga bad bud ïa ki jingkwah mon bad ki jingkwah brai jong phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall send upon thee cursing , vexation , and rebuke , in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do , until thou be destroyed , and until thou perish quickly  ; because of the wickedness of thy doings , whereby thou hast forsaken me .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kaba sniew bad kyntait ïa U  Trai  , un wallam ha phi ka jingpynjot , ka jingkulmar , bad ka jingjynjar ha kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh , haduh ba phin da jot thiaw bad ïap syndon .

translation.en: He saith among the trumpets , Ha , ha  ; and he smelleth the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .
translation.kha: Ha man ba riew ka turoi ki pah sngewshyrkhei ; ki lah ban iw ïa ka thma ha shuwa ba kin poi hajan , bad ki sngew ïa ka sur hukum jong ki rangbah shipai .

translation.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day , that he went into a ship with his disciples : and he said unto them ,  Let us go over unto the other side of the lake .  And they launched forth .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng lem bad ki synran jong u bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw .  Kumta ki la ïaleit .

translation.en: And he had seven hundred wives , princesses , and three hundred concubines : and his wives turned away his heart .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la shongkurim hynñiewspah ngut ki khun syiem kynthei bad laispah ngut ruh ki tnga kliar .

translation.en: The kings of the earth set themselves , and the rulers take counsel together , against the  Lord  , and against his anointed , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ki , ki ïeng pyrshah , ki nongsynshar jong ki , ki ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa U  Trai bad pyrshah ïa u syiem uba u la jied .

translation.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves , that we should not trust in ourselves , but in God which raiseth the dead :
translation.kha: Ngi la sngew kumba la rai pynrem ïa ngi ban ïap . Hynrei kane ka la jia khnang ba ngi dei ban shaniah , ym ha ngi hi , hynrei tang ha U Blei keiñ , uba pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap .

translation.en: If thou sayest , Behold , we knew it not  ; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it ? and he that keepeth thy soul , doth not he know it ? and shall not he render to every man according to his works ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ong ba kam dei ka kam jong phi , hynrei U Blei u tip bad u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi . U ïai ap khmih ïa phi ; u tip . Un ainong ïa phi kat kum kaei kaba phi leh .

translation.en: What I tell you in darkness , that speak ye in light : and what ye hear in the ear , that preach ye upon the housetops .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ha kaba dum phi dei ban ïathuh ha kaba shai , bad ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohsngew ha kaba rieh phi dei ban pynbna na ki tnum ïing .

translation.en: And she went down unto the floor , and did according to all that her mother in law bade her .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ka jaka dung kew bad ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka kiaw kurim jong ka , ka la bthah ïa ka .

translation.en: Behold , the hope of him is in vain : shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him ?
translation.kha: Mano mano ba ïohi ïa u Lebiathan u duh ka jingshlur bad u kyllon ha madan .

translation.en: But Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah , and the mighty men , and Solomon his brother , he called not .
translation.kha: hynrei um shym la khot ïa u Solomon , u para jong u na ujuh u kpa lane ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa , lane ïa u Benaïah , lane ïa ki nongïada jong u syiem .

translation.en: Turn thou us unto thee , O  Lord  , and we shall be turned  ; renew our days as of old .
translation.kha: To wallam pat ïa ngi sha me , ko  Trai  ! To wallam pat ïa ngi ! To pynïoh pat ïa ka burom ba-mynbarim .

translation.en: What then ? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for ; but the election hath obtained it , and the rest were blinded
translation.kha: Kaei pat te ngin ïa-ong ? Ki paid Israel kim shym la shem ïa kaei kaba ki ïawad . Ka la long tang ka kynhun kaba rit kaba U Blei u la jied , kaba la shem ïa kata ; kiba sah na kita ki la set kyllut ïa ka jingkhot jong U Blei .

translation.en: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh , Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up , that I might shew my power in thee , and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ïa u syiem ka Ijipt ,  Nga la pynlong syiem ïa me khnang ban pyndonkam ïa me ban pyn-i ïa ka bor jong nga bad ban pynphriang ïa ka nam jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be king over all the earth : in that day shall there be one  Lord  , and his name one .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  un long u syiem jong ka pyrthei baroh ; uwei pa uwei baroh un mane ïa u kum U Blei bad tip ïa u da kajuh ka kyrteng .

translation.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you .
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei jong nga , man la ka por ba nga pyrkhat shaphang jong phi .

translation.en: For I will cast out the nations before thee , and enlarge thy borders : neither shall any man desire thy land , when thou shalt go up to appear before the  Lord  thy God thrice in the year .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi , bad pynïar ruh ïa ki pud jong phi , yn ym don mano mano u ban pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri jong phi haba phi rakhe ïa kita ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor , the harvest of the river , is her revenue  ; and she is a mart of nations .
translation.kha: To ïam pangnud , phi ki nongkhaïi ka Sidon ! Phi phah ïa ki rangbah sha shiliang ka duriaw ban thied bad ban die ïa u kew uba mih ha Ijipt bad ban ïakhaïi bad baroh ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding , that the king enquired of them , he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm .
translation.kha: Kam pher kaei ka jingkylli ba u syiem u la kylli , lane kano ka jingeh kaba u pynpaw , kine ki saw ngut ki la kham tip shiphew shah ban ïa uno uno u nongbatai kupar lane u nongleh myntor ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms , Let his habitation be desolate , and let no man dwell therein : and his bishoprick let another take .
translation.kha: Naba la thoh ha ka kitab ki Salm ,   ‘ Ai ba ka ïing jong u kan kylla long kaba thylli ; ai ban ym don mano mano bashong hapoh jong ka .’   La thoh ruh ,   ‘ Ai ba uwei pat un shim ïa ka jaka jong u ha ka jingshakri .’

translation.en: This is thy lot , the portion of thy measures from me , saith the  Lord   ; because thou hast forgotten me , and trusted in falsehood .
translation.kha: U la ong ba kane kan dei ka kupar jong pha . Kane ka dei kaei kaba u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa pha , namar pha la klet ïa u bad pha la shaniah ha ki blei thala .

translation.en: Whether therefore ye eat , or drink , or whatsoever ye do , do all to the glory of God .
translation.kha: Kumta , ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , ha kaba bam ne ha kaba dih , to leh phi ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .

translation.en: Hate the evil , and love the good , and establish judgment in the gate : it may be that the  Lord  God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph .
translation.kha: Isih ïa kaei kaba sniew , ieit ïa kaei kaba bha , bad peit ba ka jingbishar hok ka ïeng ha ki ïingbishar . Lehse U  Trai  , un isynei ïa ki briew jong kane ka hima kiba dang pynsah ban im .

translation.en: Remember me , O  Lord  , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people : O visit me with thy salvation  ;
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa nga , A  Trai  , haba me ïarap ïa ki briew jong me ; kynthup ïa nga ruh haba me pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: For a voice declareth from Dan , and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim .
translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien na ka nongbah Dan bad na ki lum Ephraim ki pynbna ïa ka khubor basniew .

translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?
translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat bad wat uwei u rangbah synshar uba rit tam jong ki Assyria bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki Ijipt ba kin phah ha phi ïa ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai .

translation.en: And when he was come into the house , the blind men came to him : and Jesus saith unto them ,  Believe ye that I am able to do this ?  They said unto him , Yea , Lord .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ka ïing , ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba matlah ki la ïawan sha u , bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi ngeit ba nga lah ban pynkhiah ïa phi ?   Ho-oid , Kynrad !  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Because ye have burned incense , and because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , nor walked in his law , nor in his statutes , nor in his testimonies  ; therefore this evil is happened unto you , as at this day .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingjot mynta ka la wan ha phi namar ba phi ai jingkñia sha kiwei ki blei bad leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .

translation.en: And David said unto Ahimelech , And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword ? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me , because the king s business required haste .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Ahimelekh ,  Hato phi don u sum ne ka waitlam ba phi lah ban ai ïa nga ? Ki hukum jong u syiem ki la pynlong ïa nga ban mih kyrkieh kumne haduh ba ngam don por ban leit shim ïa la ka waitlam lane ïa kano kano ka atiar .

translation.en: How much less shall I answer him , and choose out my words to reason with him ?
translation.kha: Kumta da kumno ngan shem ki kyntien ban jubab ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock , and the third part of an hin unto a ram , and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb : this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year .
translation.kha: Ka jingainguh waiñ kaba biang ka long ar litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , shi litar shiteng ka waiñ lem bad u langbrot , bad shi litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . Kane ka long ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka jingainguh thang na ka bynta ka sngi nyngkong kaba man la u bnai baroh shisnem .

translation.en: And the napkin , that was about his head , not lying with the linen clothes , but wrapped together in a place by itself .
translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen kiba la don hangta , bad ïa ka jaiñ kaba spaiñ ïa ka khlieh U Jisu . Kane kam shym don lang bad ki jaiñsop linen hynrei kaba la kli ïa ka jong .

translation.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp , and stoned him with stones , and he died  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kumta ka kynhun baroh kawei ka ïalam ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara bad la lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons , and one daughter , whose name was Tamar : she was a woman of a fair countenance .
translation.kha: U Absalom u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad kawei ka khun kaba kyrteng ka Tamar , ka kynthei kaba bhabriew katta katta .

translation.en: Know ye not that we shall judge angels ? how much more things that pertain to this life ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ngin sa bishar ïa ki angel ? Katno tam , te , ïa kiei kiei ki jong kane ka jingim !

translation.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth–lehem–judah , whose name was Jesse  ; and he had eight sons : and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dei u khun jong u Jesse , uba dei u nong Ephrath na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . U Jesse u don phra ngut ki khun shynrang , bad ha ka por ba u Saul u long syiem , u la tymmen bha .

translation.en: Get thee hence , and turn thee eastward , and hide thyself by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
translation.kha: Mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit shaphang mihngi , bad leit rieh ïa lade hajan ka wahduid Kherith , kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan .

translation.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing , being fruitful in every good work , and increasing in the knowledge of God ;
translation.kha: Nangta phin lah ban im kumba U Trai u kwah bad ba phin ïai leh borabor ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Ka jingim jong phi kan pynmih ïa baroh ki jingleh babha babun jait , bad phin san ha ka jingtip jong phi ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Is Israel a servant ? is he a homeborn slave ? why is he spoiled ?
translation.kha: U Israel um dei u mraw ; ym shym la kha ïa u sha ka jinglongmraw . Balei te ba ki nongshun jong u ki behmrad ïa u ?

translation.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments , which I have loved .
translation.kha: Nga shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar nga ieit ïa ki .

translation.en: Both for the shewbread , and for the fine flour for meat offering , and for the unleavened cakes , and for that which is baked in the pan , and for that which is fried , and for all manner of measure and size  ;
translation.kha: ban kitkhlieh ha kaba peit ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei , ïa u  purew ba la ju pyndonkam ha ki jingainguh , ïa ki kpu stang kiba la shet khlem thiat , ïa ki jingainguh kiba shu syang , ïa u  purew ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang Olib , ban thew ban woh ïa ki jingainguh ha ka Templ .

translation.en: And there they burnt incense in all the high places , as did the heathen whom the  Lord  carried away before them  ; and wrought wicked things to provoke the  Lord  to anger :
translation.kha: bad ki thang jingiwbih ha baroh ki duwan ki blei thala , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki briew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri . Ki pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  da ki jingleh kynriang jong ki baroh

translation.en: The Son of man came eating and drinking , and they say , Behold a man gluttonous , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners . But wisdom is justified of her children .
translation.kha: Haba U Khun U Briew u la wan , u la bam bad u la dih , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ong , ‘ Ha khmih ïa une u briew ! U long uba lalot bad u nongdih , u paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait !’ Pynban , ïa ka jingstad Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da kiba mih na ka .

translation.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar  ; for the fear of the  Lord  came upon them : and they spoiled all the cities  ; for there was exceeding much spoil in them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la lah ban pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ki phang ka Gerar , namar ba ki briew hangta ki la khynñiuh ïa U  Trai . Ka kynhun shipai ka la lute ïa baroh kito ki nongbah bad ki kurup shibun ka jinglute .

translation.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth , but because ye know it , and that no lie is of the truth .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , namarkata , ym namar ba phim tip ïa ka jingshisha ; pynban , ka long namar ba phi da tip ïa ka , bad phi tip ruh ym don ka lamler kaba ju mihnoh na ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you , saying , The king of Babylon shall not come against you , nor against this land ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la ong ïa phi ba u syiem ka Babilonia un ym tur ïaleh ïa phi lane ïa ka ri ?

translation.en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it , the  Lord  repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed the people , It is enough : stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Haba u angel U  Trai  u la jan pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , U  Trai  u la kylla ka jingmut ban pynshitom ïa ki briew bad u ong ha u angel uba pynïap ïa ki ,  Sangeh ! Ka la biang katto !  U angel u la don hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .

translation.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren : the  Lord  is their inheritance , as he hath said unto them .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban don bynta na ka khyndew ka shyiap kum kiwei pat ki para jait jong ki ; ka bynta jong ki ka long ka kabu ka jinglong ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai  , kumba u la kular .

translation.en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai . Then was the king s wrath pacified .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa u Haman la sdien ha ka diengphasi kaba u la shna na ka bynta u Mordekai . Nangta ka jingbitar u syiem ka la long jai jai .

translation.en: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession , and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee : they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .
translation.kha: Namar ba phi la sngewkmen , ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka ri shyiap ba na mihngi ban jop ïa phi . Kin sher ïa ki dara jong ki ha ka ri jong phi bad shongduh hangta . Kin bam ïa u soh bad kin dih ïa ka dud kiba dei ki jong phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that it was told Abraham , saying , Behold , Milcah , she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor  ;
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat por , u Abraham u la tip ba ka Milkah ka la kha phra ngut ki khun ïa u Nahor u para jong u :

translation.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth , and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand , that I may plant the heavens , and lay the foundations of the earth , and say unto Zion , Thou art my people .
translation.kha: Nga la pynpyiar ïa ki bneng bad pynïeng ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei ; nga ong ïa ka Jerusalem , ‘ Phi long ki briew jong nga ! Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad nga ïada ïa phi da ka ksang ti jong nga .’

translation.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and shall be joined unto his wife , and they two shall be one flesh .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Namar kane ka daw , u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïalong kawei bad la ka tnga , bad ki ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem , the sword , and the famine , and the noisome beast , and the pestilence , to cut off from it man and beast ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan phah ïa ki saw tylli ki jingpynshitom basniew tam jong nga ha ka Jerusalem — ka thma , ka  nemsniew , ki mradkhlaw , bad ka jingpang — ban pynjot ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .

translation.en: Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies  ; thy father s children shall bow down before thee .
translation.kha: Judah , ki hynmen ki para jong me kin ïaroh ïa me ; Me shim na ka ryndang ïa ki nongshun jong me ; Ki hynmen ki para jong me kin nguh kin dem ïa phi .

translation.en: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church .
translation.kha: Hamar kane ka por u Syiem Herod u la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka balang .

translation.en: To become a friend of God , you must obtain a good knowledge of Bible truth ( 1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 ) , put faith in the things you have learned ( Hebrews 11 :6 ) , repent of your sins ( Acts 17 :30 , 31 ) , and turn around in your course of life .
translation.kha: Ban long u paralok jong U Blei , phi dei ban tip bha shaphang ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl ( 1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 ) , ngeit ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ( Hebru 11 :6 ) , kylla ka bamut na ki pop jong phi ( Kam 17 :30 , 31 ) , bad pynkylla noh ïa la ka rukom im .

translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them out of the land of Egypt , and followed other gods , of the gods of the people that were round about them , and bowed themselves unto them , and provoked the  Lord  to anger .
translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei uba la wallam ïa ki na Ijipt , bad ki la sdang ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong ki . Ki mane dem ïa ki , bad ki la pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban bitar .

translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  thy God hath set the land before thee : go up and possess it , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath said unto thee  ; fear not , neither be discouraged .
translation.kha: nga ong , ‘ Mynta phi la poi ha ri lum Amor , kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u ai ha ngi . Peit ïa ka hangtai . Khie leit kam kynti ïa ka kumba u la hukum . Wat leh tud , bad wat sheptieng .’

translation.en: Let no man deceive you with vain words : for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience .
translation.kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi da ki ktien bieit , namar dei na kine kiei kiei ba ka jingbitar U Blei kan wan ha kito ki bymkohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , ki briew jong ka hima bashatei jong ka Israel ki ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid .

translation.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing , as the uncleanness of man , or any unclean beast , or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which pertain unto the  Lord  , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh , lada uno uno u bam ïa ka doh jong kane ka jingainguh hadien ba u la ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , la ka dei kaba na u briew ne na u mrad , ïa u ruh yn ym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother , Come up with me into my lot , that we may fight against the Canaanites  ; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot . So Simeon went with him .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki ong ha ki paid Simeon ,  Ale leit bad ngi sha ka ri ba la ai ha ngi , bad ngin ïakhun lang ïa ki Kanaan . Nangta ngin ïaleit bad phi sha ka ri kaba la ai ha phi .  Kumta ki jait Simeon

translation.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo , and brought him to Jerusalem , and buried him in his own sepulchre . And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and anointed him , and made him king in his father s stead .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki buh ïa ka met jong u ha ka kali ïapom bad kit ïa ka sha Jerusalem , ha kaba la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Ki briew ka Judah ki la jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah , bad pynsleh syiem ïa u .

translation.en: And when David enquired of the  Lord  , he said , Thou shalt not go up  ; but fetch a compass behind them , and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .
translation.kha: Sa shisien u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  , uba jubab ,  Wat tur ïaleh ïa ki nangne , hynrei leit sawdong bad pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ki na kawei ka liang , najan ki dieng Balsam .

translation.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me , and then eat ye every man of his own vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern :
translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa u Hesekaïah . U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa phi ban mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem wait . Yn shah ïa phi ba phin bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki soh Dumbur na ki dieng ki jong phi hi , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jong phi hi —

translation.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry , and said unto his father , Bless me , even me also , O my father .
translation.kha: Haba u Iso u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u lynñiar jam bad ïamkthang ruh , bad u ong ,  Ko Pa ! to ai ha nga ruh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong me .

translation.en: And the chief captain answered , With a great sum obtained I this freedom . And Paul said , But I was free born .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong ,  Nga la long u traishnong da kaba siew shibun ka pisa .   Hynrei nga long traishnong naduh dang kha ,  u Paul u la jubab .

translation.en: And they fetched up , and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver , and an horse for an hundred and fifty : and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites , and for the kings of Syria , by their means .
translation.kha: Ki pynbiang ïa ki syiem jong ka Hit bad ka Syria da ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , da kaba die ïa ki kali ïapom ha ka dor hynriewspah ki sbai rupa kawei bad ïa ki kulai ha ka dor shispah sanphew ki sbai rupa uwei .

translation.en: Then let my wife grind unto another , and let others bow down upon her .
translation.kha: te to ai ba ka tnga jong nga kan shet ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta uwei pat u briew bad ban thiah ha ka jingthiah jong uwei pat .

translation.en: And the elders of the Jews builded , and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo . And they builded , and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel , and according to the commandment of Cyrus , and Darius , and Artaxerxes king of Persia .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la pynïaid bha ïa ka jingtei ïa ka Templ , ba la ai jingpynshlur da ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad u Sekharaïah . Ki pyndep ïa ka Templ kumba la hukum da U Blei ki Israel bad da u Syros , u Darius bad u Artakserksis , ki patsha ka Persia .

translation.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind ;
translation.kha: Dei ban pynthymmai nadong shadong ïa ki dohnud bad ïa ki jingmut jong phi ,

translation.en: And he said , When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women , and see them upon the stools  ; if it be a son , then ye shall kill him : but if it be a daughter , then she shall live .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïarap pynkha ïa ki kynthei Hebru , bad phi ïohi ba u dei u shynrang , pynïap ïa u ; hynrei lada dei ka kynthei , ai kan im .

translation.en: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah , and all their victuals , and went their way .
translation.kha: Kita ki saw ngut ki syiem ki la shim lut khoit kat kaba don ha Sodom bad Gomorrah , kaba kynthup ruh ïa ka jingbam bad ki la leit noh .

translation.en: Now if I do that I would not , it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .
translation.kha: Lada nga leh ïa kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka mut ba ngam long shuh uta uba leh ïa kata ; pynban , ka dei ka pop kaba im hapoh jong nga .

translation.en: I know , O  Lord  , that thy judgments are right , and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba ki jingbishar jong me ki long kiba hok , A  Trai  , bad ba me la pynshitom ïa nga namar me long uba ïaineh .

translation.en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north , he measured the length thereof , and the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u briew u la thew ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei , kaba lam sha ka phyllaw bashabar .

translation.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds , the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip kumno ki lyoh ki per ha ka sahit bneng , ka jingtrei jong ka jingtbit bakhraw jong U Blei ?

translation.en: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace  ; thou shalt be buried in a good old age .
translation.kha: Me pat , men im tymmen , men ïap ha kaba suk , bad yn sa tep ïa me .

translation.en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth , and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyndonburom ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad pha mynba pha dang samla , bad ngan pynlong ka jutang bad pha ka ban neh junom .

translation.en: And the battle increased that day : and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians , and died at even : and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot .
translation.kha: Katba ka thma ka dang jur bha , u syiem Ahab u la shu kyrshan ha ka kali ïapom jong u , u da phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria . Ka snam na ka jingmong jong u ka tuid bad ka tap shaduh trai jong ka kali ïapom , bad haba la janmiet u la ïap .

translation.en: He had gone .
translation.kha: U la Leit Ma u .

translation.en: For God is not the author of confusion , but of peace , as in all churches of the saints .
translation.kha: Ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka dei ban long kaba lah ban synshar da uba kren , namar U Blei um kwah ïa ngi ban long ha ka jingkynrum kynram hynrei ha ka jingryntih bad ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: For without are dogs , and sorcerers , and whoremongers , and murderers , and idolaters , and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie .
translation.kha: Hynrei shabar ka nongbah ki don ki riewkhyllah bad kito kiba leh byrtong , kiba awria bad ki nongpynïap briew , kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad kito kiba lamler ha ki ktien bad ki kam .

translation.en: Others said , That it is Elias . And others said , That it is a prophet , or as one of the prophets .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  U dei u Elijah .  Kiwei ki ong ,  U dei u Nong ïathuhlypa , kum uwei na ki Nongïathuhlypa jong ki por ba-mynshuwa .

translation.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman , from the stranger which flattereth with her words .
translation.kha: Kin pyllait ïa phi na ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki briew , na ki kynthei kiba nang ban kren ïa ki ktien kiba pynshohbieit .

translation.en: And the east border was the salt sea , even unto the end of Jordan . And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan :
translation.kha: Ka pud kaba shaphang mihngi ka dei ka Duriaw Baïap , artet haduh ka jaka ha kaba ka Jordan ka tuid sha ka . Ka pud kaba shaphang shatei ka sdang nangta ,

translation.en: And he went a little further , and fell on his face , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if it be possible , let this cup pass from me : nevertheless not as I will , but as thou wilt .
translation.kha: U la leit kham jngai sa katto katne , u la dem khrup ïa lade bad ka khmat sha khyndew , bad u la duwai ,  Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ka long kaba lah , to shim noh ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom na nga ! Pynban , ym ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me mon .

translation.en: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works , when she had received the messengers , and had sent them out another way ?
translation.kha: Ka la long kumjuh ruh bad ka Rahab kaba long ka nuti . La pynksan ïa ka ha U Blei lyngba ki kam jong ka , mynba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki Israel kiba la wan syntiat bad ïarap ïa ki ban lait phet na kawei pat ka lynti .

translation.en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom : also he observed times , and used enchantments , and used witchcraft , and dealt with a familiar spirit , and with wizards : he wrought much evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: U kñia ïa la ki khun shynrang ha ka Them Hinnom kum ki jingainguh thang . U leh ïa ki jingkhan bad ki jingleh myntor bad u wad jingmut na ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongleh byrtong . U leh pop palat pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar jong U .

translation.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon , throughout their families , and by the house of their fathers ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Buh jingthoh ïa ki shynrang ba la kha nyngkong baroh jong ki Israel naduh kiba shi bnai lane kham heh , bad ñiew ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .

translation.en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear  ; they are cruel , and have no mercy  ; their voice roareth like the sea  ; and they ride upon horses , set in array as men for war against thee , O daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitlam ; ki long kiba runar bad ki bym don jingisynei . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki shong ha ki kulai jong ki . Ki la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: I lead in the way of righteousness , in the midst of the paths of judgment :
translation.kha: Nga ïaid ha ka lynti ka hok , nga bud ïa ki lynti ka jinglehhok ,

translation.en: Therefore they enquired of the  Lord  further , if the man should yet come thither . And the  Lord  answered , Behold , he hath hid himself among the stuff .
translation.kha: ki kylli na U  Trai  ,  Dang don shuh mano mano ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  u Saul u don hangtai , u rieh ha lyndet ki jingkit .

translation.en: And if a man shall open a pit , or if a man shall dig a pit , and not cover it , and an ox or an ass fall therein  ;
translation.kha: Lada u briew u weng ïa ka jingtap na ka thliew , ne lada u tih thliew bad um tap ïa ka , bad u masi ne u kada u hap hangta ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled , and got him out .
translation.kha: Haba u ïohsngew ba nga lynñiar , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .

translation.en: And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart : and all those signs came to pass that day .
translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u phai ban leit noh na u Samuel , U Blei u buh ha u ka jinglong kaba thymmai . Bad kita baroh kiba u Samuel u la ïathuh ha u ki wan jia long ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits , and the breadth eleven cubits  ; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it : and there were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .
translation.kha: Ki mawkyrdon ki lam sha ka kamra rung ha kaba ka la long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang bad hynriew mitar ka jingjylliew . La don ar tylli ki païa , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka tyngkong .

translation.en: Exalt the  Lord  our God , and worship at his holy hill  ; for the  Lord  our God is holy .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , bad to mane ha u lum bakyntang jong u ! U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u long uba khuid .

translation.en: He spake , and there came divers sorts of flies , and lice in all their coasts .
translation.kha: U Blei u la hukum , bad ki skain bad ki mait ki la dap kylleng ïa ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession , unto the praise of his glory .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u long ka jingbahkhlieh ba ngin sa ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ha ki briew jong u , bad kane ka pynthikna ïa ngi ba U Blei un ai ka jinglaitluid kaba pura ha kito kiba long ki jong u . To ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom jong u!

translation.en: Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  : it is a mighty nation , it is an ancient nation , a nation whose language thou knowest not , neither understandest what they say .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , U  Trai  u wallam ka jaitbynriew na sha jngai ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ka long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba la rim , ka jaitbynriew kaba ïa ka ktien jong ka phim tip .

translation.en: But Esaias is very bold , and saith , I was found of them that sought me not ; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me .
translation.kha: Bad u Isaïah u la long uba kham shlur haba u ong ,  Ïa nga la shem da kito ki bym shym la wad ïa nga ; nga la paw ha kito ki bym shym la kylli ïa nga .

translation.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
translation.kha: Ki dur khyllah kin paw ha ki khmat jong phi , bad phin ym lah ban pyrkhat ne kren shai .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , will I take thee , O Zerubbabel , my servant , the son of Shealtiel , saith the  Lord  , and will make thee as a signet : for I have chosen thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan shim ïa me , ko Serubbabel u shakri jong nga , bad ngan thung ïa me ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jong nga . Me long uta uba nga la jied .  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren .

translation.en: And he remembered for them his covenant , and repented according to the multitude of his mercies .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ki u kynmaw ïa ka jutang jong u , bad namar ka jingieit bakhraw jong u , u la kylla jingmut .

translation.en: And in the valley , Beth–haram , and Beth–nimrah , and Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , Jordan and his border , even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward .
translation.kha: Ha ka Them Jordan ka kynthup ïa ka Beth Haram , ka Bethnimrah , ka Sukkoth , bad ka Saphon , kaba sah na ka hima u Sihon u syiem Heshbon . Ka pud bashaphang sepngi jong ki ka dei ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka phang bashatei .

translation.en: When the sin , which they have sinned against it , is known , then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin , and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: kumta haba la bna ïa kata ka pop , u paidlang un wanlam ïa u masi lyngraw kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop . Kin wanrah sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler of the treasures .
translation.kha: U Shebuel , uba na ka kur u Gershon , u khun jong u Moses , u dei u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh uba kitkhlieh ïa ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ .

translation.en: For to this end also did I write , that I might know the proof of you , whether ye be obedient in all things .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh sha phi ïa kato ka shithi namar nga la kwah eh ban tip haduh katno phi la ïeng ha kata ka jingtynjuh bad la phi la kloi borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .

translation.en: And I will strengthen them in the  Lord   ; and they shall walk up and down in his name , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki briew jong nga ; kin ïamane bad kohnguh ïa nga .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And Joab said to Amasa , Art thou in health , my brother ? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u Amasa ,  Phi long kumno , ko paralok jong nga ?  bad u bat ïa u Amasa na u  ñiuhtmoh jong u da la ka kti kamon ban doh ïa u .

translation.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives , of which the name of the one was Shiphrah , and the name of the other Puah :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u ong ha ki nongpynkha khun kiba na ki kynthei Hebru , kawei kaba kyrteng ka Shiphrah bad kawei pat ka Puah ,

translation.en: And Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites , and all mount Hermon , and all Bashan unto Salecah  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Gilead , ki thain jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , u Lum Hermon baroh , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh Salekah .

translation.en: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ïa ki jingdawa bahok jong ka Hukum yn pyndep nadong shadong ha ngi kiba im kat kum U Mynsiem , bad ym kat kum ka jinglong ba kynja doh .

translation.en: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us : thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .
translation.kha: Me la thwet ïa ngi bad pynïap ïa ngi ; ïa ka jingisynei jong me la buhrieh da ka jingbitar jong me ,

translation.en: For I speak to you Gentiles , inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles , I magnify mine office :
translation.kha: Nga kren mynta ha phi ki Jentil : Katba nga dang long u apostol sha ki Jentil , ngan sngewsarong ha ka kam jong nga .

translation.en: And when they came to Nachon s threshingfloor , Uzza put forth his hand to the ark of God , and took hold of it  ; for the oxen shook it .
translation.kha: Haba ki wan poi ha jaka shoh kew jong u Nakon , ki masi dab ki la jynthut , bad u Ussah u kner bad ïohbat ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang .

translation.en: All these evil things come from within , and defile the man .
translation.kha: baroh kine kiei kiei ki wan napoh u briew bad pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: All these were the children of Asher , heads of their father s house , choice and mighty men of valour , chief of the princes . And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing , ki riewïaleh bapawnam , ki nongïalam kiba pawkhmat . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher ki kynthup ïa ki arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

translation.en: And said unto him , Take these vessels , go , carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be builded in his place .
translation.kha: U patsha u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ki bad pynphai sha ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ha ka jaka ba ka la ïeng mynshuwa .

translation.en: The morning is come unto thee , O thou that dwellest in the land : the time is come , the day of trouble is near , and not the sounding again of the mountains .
translation.kha: Kaba kut ka la wan ha phi ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . Ka por ka la jan ha kaba yn ym don shuh ka jingïaleh kmen ha ki jaka mane ha ki lumbah , tang ka jingkulmar suda .

translation.en: And he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , of which the  Lord  said , In Jerusalem will I put my name .
translation.kha: U tei ïa ki duwan ba-thala ha ka Templ , ka jaka kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba dei ban mane ïa u .

translation.en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted .
translation.kha: Ka ri kan long kaba shah ieh kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka yn ieh kumto ha ki jingjot .

translation.en: For to me to live is Christ , and to die is gain .
translation.kha: Naba kaei ka jingim ? Ïa nga , ka long U Khrist . Da ka jingïap , te , ngan wallam kham bun .

translation.en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king , and brought the king word again , and said , Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house , and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work , that have the oversight of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ïathuh :  Ki shakri jong phi ki la shim ïa ka pisa kaba don ha ka Templ , bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki rangbah kiba dei khmih ïa ki jingshna pynbha .

translation.en: Be silent , O all flesh , before the  Lord  : for he is raised up out of his holy habitation .
translation.kha: To pynjar jar , uwei pa uwei baroh , ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  , namar u wan na ka jaka shong kaba khuid jong u .

translation.en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him , and said unto him ,  One thing thou lackest : go thy way , sell whatsoever thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , take up the cross , and follow me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaiñ ha u da ka jingieit bad u la ong ,  Me donkam tang kawei kaei kaei . Khie leit bad die ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men ïoh ïa ka spah ha bneng ; nangta sa wan bad bud ïa nga .

translation.en: Behold , I will gather them out of all countries , whither I have driven them in mine anger , and in my fury , and in great wrath  ; and I will bring them again unto this place , and I will cause them to dwell safely :
translation.kha: Ngan sa lumlang ïa ki briew na baroh ki ri na kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ha ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha kane ka jaka bad shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah hangne ha ka jingshngain .

translation.en: There is that scattereth , and yet increaseth  ; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet , but it tendeth to poverty .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pynlut kai ïa la ka pisa bad ki nang ïai riewspah . Kiwei ki husiar , bad pynban ki nang ïai kyrduh .

translation.en: Having the understanding darkened , being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them , because of the blindness of their heart :
translation.kha: Kim don bynta ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u ai , naba ki long kiba bieit tasam bad kiba eh dohnud .

translation.en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out  ; and they could not .
translation.kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa ki synran jong me ban beh noh ïa u , hynrei kim lah .

translation.en: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house : and I looked , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house of the  Lord  : and I fell upon my face .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashaphang shatei haduh ha khmat ka Templ . Katba nga dang khmih , nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ U  Trai  la pyndap da ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .

translation.en: Jesus and the 144 ,000 form a righteous heavenly government —God’s Kingdom . —Revelation 14 :1-3 .
translation.kha: U Jisu lem bad ki 1 ,44 ,000 ngut kin seng ïa ka hima ha bneng . Kata ka dei ka Hima jong U Blei .—Jingpynpaw 14 :1-3 .

translation.en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob , neither is there any divination against Israel : according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel , What hath God wrought !
translation.kha: Ym don myntor , ym don jingleh byrtong , Kaba lah ban pyndonkam pyrshah ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Mynta ki briew kin ïakren shaphang ki Israel , ‘ Khmih aïu U Blei u la leh !’

translation.en: Who is a God like unto thee , that pardoneth iniquity , and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage ? he retaineth not his anger for ever , because he delighteth in mercy .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei pat u blei kum ma me , A  Trai  ; me map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong me kiba la lait im . Mem neh junom ha ka jingbitar , hynrei me sngewbha haba me pynpaw ïa ka jingieit baïaineh jong me .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , that the ark may be borne with them .
translation.kha: Bsuh ïa kita ki dieng jingbah lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk , ba yn ïoh bah ïa ka da ki .

translation.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever : he hath made a decree which shall not pass .
translation.kha: da ki hukum jong u ïa ki la pynneh ha ki jaka jong ki junom , bad kim lah khlem kohnguh .

translation.en: Tom gave his seat to an elderly lady .
translation.kha: U Tom u ai ia ka jakashong jong u ha I tymmen kynthei .

translation.en: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah , What shall be the sign that the  Lord  will heal me , and that I shall go up into the house of the  Lord  the third day ?
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u kylli ,  Kaei ka dak ban pynshisha ba U  Trai  un pynkhiah ïa nga bad ba hadien lai sngi ngan sa lah ban leit sha ka Templ ?

translation.en: And there was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah  ; and his wife was barren , and bare not .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba kyrteng u Manoah na ka shnong Sorah . U dei na ka jait Dan . Ka tnga jong u kam pat shym la lah ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: And he blessed them that day , saying , In thee shall Israel bless , saying , God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh : and he set Ephraim before Manasseh .
translation.kha: Kumta u kyrkhu ïa ki ha kata ka sngi , u da ong ,  Ki Israel kin sa shim ïa ki kyrteng jong phi haba ki kyrkhu kyrdoh ïano ïano . Kin ïa-ong , ‘ To U Blei un pynlong ïa phi kum u Ephraim bad kum u Manasseh .’   Da kumta u la buh ïa u Ephraim ha shuwa u Manasseh .

translation.en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba  ; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims . And the land had rest from war .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa kane , ïa ka Hebron la khot ka nongbah jong U Arba . ( U Arba u la long uba khraw tam napdeng ki Anakim ) . Mynta ka don ka jingsuk ha ka ri .

translation.en: And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies  ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki nongshun jong u ha Edom , Bad un pynlong ïa ka ri jong ki ka jingïohkynti jong u , Katba ki Israel kin ïai jop .

translation.en: For it became him , for whom are all things , and by whom are all things , in bringing many sons unto glory , to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei eh ba U Blei , uba thaw bad pynneh ïa kiei kiei baroh , un pynlong ïa U Jisu uba janai lyngba ka jingshah shitom , khnang ban pynwan ïa kiba bun ki khun ban ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong u . Namar U Jisu u long uta uba ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingpynim .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ,

translation.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah bad Simeon ïa kiba la ai

translation.en: And Abraham drew near , and said , Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked ?
translation.kha: U Abraham u wan hajan U  Trai  , bad u kylli ,  Hato men shu pynjot noh ïa kiba hok ruh ryngkat bad ki bymman ?

translation.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .
translation.kha: Haba u la tip ba U Jisu u la dei na ka thain ba la synshar da u Herod , u la phah ïa u sha u Herod , uba la don ruh ha Jerusalem ha kata ka por .

translation.en: Speak not evil one of another , brethren . He that speaketh evil of his brother , and judgeth his brother , speaketh evil of the law , and judgeth the law : but if thou judge the law , thou art not a doer of the law , but a judge .
translation.kha: Wat ïa-wohnia para ma phi , ko parabangeit jong nga . Uno uno uba wohnia ïa u parabangeit ne bishar ïa u , u wohnia ïa ka Hukum bad u bishar ïa ka . Lada phi bishar ïa ka Hukum , te phim long shuh uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , hynrei uwei uba bishar ïa ka .

translation.en: When I washed my steps with butter , and the rock poured me out rivers of oil  ;
translation.kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jong nga ki la ai shibun ka dud , bad ki dieng Olib ki la san ha ki khyndew jong ki jaka maw .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Say now unto her , Behold , thou hast been careful for us with all this care  ; what is to be done for thee ? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king , or to the captain of the host ? And she answered , I dwell among mine own people .
translation.kha: u ong ha u Gehasi ,  Kylli ïa ka kaei kaba nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ka ban siew kylliang na ka bynta ki jinglehshitom baroh ha kaba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . Lehse kan kwah ba ngan leit sha u syiem lane sha u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai bad ban pynïakren na ka bynta jong ka .   Nga don hangne baroh kaba nga donkam hapdeng ki briew jong nga ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: And they were haughty , and committed abomination before me : therefore I took them away as I saw good .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewsarong bad mutlop bad leh ïa kiei kiei kiba nga isih , kumta nga la pynjot ïa ki , kumba pha tip bha .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  Be not afraid : go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee , and there shall they see me .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki .  Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa ki para jong nga ban leit sha Galilaïa bad hangta kin ïohi ïa nga .

translation.en: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God , those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ai sngewbha sha U Blei ha Jerusalem ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ïa kiba la ai ha phi ban pyndonkam ha ki jingshakri ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah :
translation.kha: Nga ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew baroh da ka jingtim ba la thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaba la pule ha khmat u syiem .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  thy God hath delivered it into thine hands , thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword :
translation.kha: Te , ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ïa kata ka shnong , pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang .

translation.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God  ; for God is love .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym ieit , um ithuh ïa U Blei , naba U Blei u long ka jingieit .

translation.en: And there they left their images , and David and his men burned them .
translation.kha: Haba ki Philistia ki la phet , ki la iehnoh shadien ïa ki bleithaw jong ki , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la rah noh ïa ki .

translation.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves , as in the days of Gibeah : therefore he will remember their iniquity , he will visit their sins .
translation.kha: Ki la long sniew khlem jingkyrmen ha kaei kaei kaba ki leh , kumba ki la long ha Gibeah . U Blei un kynmaw ïa ka pop jong ki , bad un pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom we have now received the atonement .
translation.kha: Hynrei kam long tang kumta ; ngi lehkmen na ka bynta kaei kaba U Blei u la leh lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , uba mynta u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong U Blei .

translation.en: The  Lord  is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , U  Trai  u shahshkor , hynrei u long jngai ïa kito kiba leh sniew .

translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them ,
translation.kha: U Moses u kyrpad jur ïa U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pyn-i ha u ïa uwei u lyngkhot dieng , ïa uba u la bret hapoh ka um ; bad ka um ka la kylla long kaba bit ban dih . Dei hangta ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ ba kin bud , bad dei hangta ruh ba u la tynjuh ïa ki .

translation.en: Woe unto them ! for they have fled from me : destruction unto them ! because they have transgressed against me : though I have redeemed them , yet they have spoken lies against me .
translation.kha: A ki long kiba la tim ! Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ïeng pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa ki yn pynduh noh . Nga la kwah ban pyllait im ïa ki , hynrei ka jingmane jong ki ïa nga ka long kaba thala .

translation.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses , when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them : for they have digged a pit to take me , and hid snares for my feet .
translation.kha: To phah ïa u paidbhur ban lute ïa ki ïing jong ki khlem ka jingmaham ; pynlong ïa ki ban kyang ha ka jingshyrkhei . Ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ban hap ha ka bad ki la pynap ki jingriam ban pynngat ïa nga .

translation.en: And the city had no need of the sun , neither of the moon , to shine in it : for the glory of God did lighten it , and the Lamb is the light thereof .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah kam donkam ïa ka sngi lane ïa u bnai ban tyngshaiñ halor jong ka , namar ba ka burom jong U Trai ka tyngshaiñ halor jong ka , bad U Khunlangbrot u long ka sharak jong ka .

translation.en: But Zion said , The  Lord  hath forsaken me , and my Lord hath forgotten me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong ,  U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa ngi ! U la klet ïa ngi .

translation.en: A fool s wrath is presently known : but a prudent man covereth shame .
translation.kha: Haba uba bieit u phoi , u pynpaw kumne kumne ba yn tip . Ki briew kiba sian kim patiaw ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ .

translation.en: And saying , Thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days , save thyself . If thou be the Son of God , come down from the cross .
translation.kha: Me u ban sa pynkhyllem ïa ka Templ bad ban tei pat ïa ka ha ki lai sngi ! To pynim ïa lade lada me long U Khun U Blei ! To hiar noh na ka diengphna !

translation.en: Also I say unto you , Whosoever shall confess me before men , him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God :
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno uno uba pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , U Khun U Briew un leh kumjuh ïa u ha khmat ki angel jong U Blei .

translation.en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him , and he halted upon his thigh .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la mih haba u Jakob u mihnoh na Peniel , u da ïaid dkoh namar kata ka skhep .

translation.en: And entered into a ship , and went over the sea toward Capernaum . And it was now dark , and Jesus was not come to them .
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki synran U Jisu ki la leit hiar sha ka duriaw , ki la kiew ha ka lieng , bad ki la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw shaphang Kapernam . Ka miet ka la poi bad U Jisu um pat wan satia sha ki .

translation.en: And he saith unto me , The waters which thou sawest , where the whore sitteth , are peoples , and multitudes , and nations , and tongues .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ruh ha nga ,  Ki um ïa kiba me la ïohi , ha kaba kata ka nuti ka shong , ki long ki jaitbynriew , ki paidlang , ki kynja bynriew bad ki jait ktien .

translation.en: This gate of the  Lord  , into which the righteous shall enter .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khyrdop jong U  Trai  ; tang kiba hok ki lah ban rung shapoh .

translation.en: Read Acts 15 :1-35 , and see how the first-century governing body discussed and resolved a dispute with the help of the Scriptures and holy spirit .
translation.kha: Pule ki Kam 15 :1-35 , peit kumno ba ha ka spah snem banyngkong , ka kynhun pynïaidkam ka la ïamir jingmut bad pynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia lyngba ki Jingthoh bakhuid bad u mynsiem bakhuid .

translation.en: Is not this thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?
translation.kha: Me mane ïa U Blei , bad ka jingim jong me ka long ka bym shah kynnoh pop ; bad kumta me dei ban don ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen .

translation.en: What did you do ?
translation.kha: Kaei Phi Leh ?

translation.en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the  Lord  by the hand of the priests the Levites , whom David had distributed in the house of the  Lord  , to offer the burnt offerings of the  Lord  , as it is written in the law of Moses , with rejoicing and with singing , as it was ordained by David .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ . Ki dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram kiba la bynshet ha ki da u syiem Dabid bad ban thang ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ai sha U  Trai  kat kum ka Aiñ u Moses . Ki la peit ruh ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ïa ka jinglehkmen .

translation.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah : I will water thee with my tears , O Heshbon , and Elealeh : for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen .
translation.kha: Mynta nga ïam ïa ki sohwaiñ jong ka Sibmah kumba nga ïam namar ka Jaser . Ki ummat jong nga ki hap na ka bynta ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh , namar ym don kano kano ka jingkheit soh kaba pynkmen ïa ki briew .

translation.en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves , and the spoil of the cities which we took .
translation.kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri jong ki bad ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .

translation.en: For , when we were come into Macedonia , our flesh had no rest , but we were troubled on every side ; without were fightings , within were fears .
translation.kha: Wat hadien ba ngi la poi ha Makedonia , ngim shym la ïoh shongthait . Ki la don ki jingjynjar ha kylleng sawdong , ki jingïakajia bad kiwei pat , ki jingsheptieng ha ki dohnud jong ngi .

translation.en: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the  Lord  of hosts in Shiloh . And the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , the priests of the  Lord  , were there .
translation.kha: Man ka snem , u Elkanah u mih na Ramah ban leit mane bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ha Shiloh ; ha kaba u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Eli , ki long ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .

translation.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki wallam ha lade ka jingjynjar ïa kaba ki pyrshang ban pynjia ha ki briew kiba bha .

translation.en: Then the same day at evening , being the first day of the week , when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews , came Jesus and stood in the midst , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .
translation.kha: Ka la long la kham janmiet jong ka Sngi U Trai , bad ki synran ki la ïalumlang hapoh ka kamra kaba la khang skhem , namar ba ki la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Nangta U Jisu u la wan bad u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki .  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi ,  u la ong .

translation.en: Yea , thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised , and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ba kumno ïa ki Ijipt yn pynlwet hapdeng kiba khlem otsher kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: But we will not boast of things without our measure , but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us , a measure to reach even unto you .
translation.kha: Pynban na ka bynta jong ngi , ki jingkob sarong jong ngi kin ym ïaid palat pud ; kan don hapoh u pud jong ka jingtrei kaba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi , bad kane ka kynthup ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: And the children of Israel were numbered , and were all present , and went against them : and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids  ; but the Syrians filled the country .
translation.kha: La khot ïa ki Israel bad la pynkieng atiar ïa ki ; ki la ïaleit bad sher dara ha ki ar kynhun ban ïaleh ïa ki Syria . La ïohi ïa ki Israel ba ki long kum ar tylli ki kynhun blang barit haba ïanujor bad ki nong Syria , kiba la pyndap ïa ki rudnong .

translation.en: The hireling fleeth , because he is an hireling , and careth not for the sheep .
translation.kha: U nongbylla sngi u phet noh namar ba u long tang u nongbylla sngi bad um salia ei ei ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: A little one shall become a thousand , and a small one a strong nation : I the  Lord  will hasten it in his time .
translation.kha: Wat ka jait ka kynja kaba rit bad ba duk tam kan sa long kaba khraw kum ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor . Haba ka por kaba biang ka la wan , ngan pynjia kloi ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga long U  Trai  !

translation.en: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah , and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph , another piece . After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber .
translation.kha: U Hananaïah , u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u Hanun , u khun bahynriew jong u Salaph , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka jingtrei kaba ar jong ki . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: Break forth into joy , sing together , ye waste places of Jerusalem : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , he hath redeemed Jerusalem .
translation.kha: To risa lang da ka jingkmen , phi ki jingpra ka Jerusalem ! U  Trai  un pyllait ïa la ka nongbah bad un pyntngen ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ  ;
translation.kha: Kumta te , to ai ba ki jingmut jong phi kin pynkhreh ban treikam . To long adkar bad buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi baroh phar ha ka jingkyrkhu ïa kaba yn sa ai ha phi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .

translation.en: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites , that were beyond Jordan , to Sihon king of Heshbon , and to Og king of Bashan , which was at Ashtaroth .
translation.kha: bad kaei kaba u la leh ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor kiba ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan : u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon bad u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba shong ba sah ha Ashtaroth .

translation.en: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph , even over against his house . And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah .
translation.kha: U Jedaïah , u khun jong u Harumaph u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba don hajan ka ïing jong u hi . U Hattush , u khun jong u Hashabneïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest , and my jealousy shall depart from thee , and I will be quiet , and will be no more angry .
translation.kha: Te ka jingbitar jong nga kan kut bad ngan long jai jai . Ngan ym bitar lane bishni shuh .

translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : but the word of our God shall stand for ever .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , u phlang u ïapstai bad ki syntiew ki jlop , hynrei ka ktien jong U Blei jong ngi ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , Come , and let us go out into the field . And they went out both of them into the field .
translation.kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ki bri ,  u Jonathan u jubab . Kumta ki ïaleit lang .

translation.en: For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba leh ïa kaba bha ha ki por baroh bad u bym ju leh bakla .

translation.en: And now , behold , the hand of the Lord is upon thee , and thou shalt be blind , not seeing the sun for a season . And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness  ; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand .
translation.kha: Ka kti U Trai kan sa wan ha me mynta ; men sa matlah bad men ym ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi shipor .  Mar kumta hi u Elumas u la sngew ba u lyoh khyndew uba ïong u la tap ïa ki khmat jong u , bad u la ïaid kylleng da kaba pyrshang ban wad ïano ïano ban ïalam ïa u na ka kti .

translation.en: And when Elisha was come into the house , behold , the child was dead , and laid upon his bed .
translation.kha: Haba u Elisha u la poi , u la leit marwei shapoh ka kamra bad u la ïohi ïa u khynnah ba u thiah ïap halor ka jingthiah .

translation.en: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you , whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all , how with fear and trembling ye received him .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka jingieit jong u ïa phi ka nang khraw , kumba u kynmaw kumno phi baroh phi la kloi ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kumno phi la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkyiuh .

translation.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents , and tribute silver  ; and the Arabians brought him flocks , seven thousand and seven hundred rams , and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki Philistia ki wallam sha u Jehoshaphat shibun bah ka rupa bad kiwei ki jingai sngewbha , bad katto katne ki Arab ki wallam hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki langbrot bad hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki blang .

translation.en: And when he saw their faith , he said unto him ,  Man , thy sins are forgiven thee .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki la don , u la ong ha uta u briew ,  La map ïa ki pop jong me , ko paralok jong nga .

translation.en: Have you noticed in the pictures in this brochure how well-dressed Jehovah’s Witnesses are when attending their congregation meetings ?
translation.kha: Haba phi peit ïa ki dur ha ine i kot lyngkdop , hato phi la ïohi kumno ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki riam ki beit haba ki leit sha ki jingïalang jong ki ?

translation.en: An angry man stirreth up strife , and a furious man aboundeth in transgression .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba kloi ban bitar ki pynlong shibun ki jingïakajia bad ki jingkulmar .

translation.en: These words spake Jesus , and lifted up his eyes to heaven , and said ,  Father , the hour is come  ; glorify thy Son , that thy Son also may glorify thee :
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la dep ong ïa kane , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ong ,  Ko Pa , ka kynta ka la poi . To ai ka burom ïa la U Khun , ba U Khun un ïoh ban ai ka burom ïa me .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen , and against all Edom , which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart , with despiteful minds , to cast it out for a prey .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren ha ka jingbitar lep jong nga pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong bad khamtam pyrshah ïa ka Edom . Da kaba shadkmen bad da kaba leh ibeiñ , ki kurup ïa ka ri jong nga bad shim kynti ïa ki jaka phlang jong ka .

translation.en: And when the king s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire , ( for it is great , ) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour , both to great and small .
translation.kha: Haba ïa ka jingpynbna jong phi la pynphriang sha kylleng sawdong jong kane ka hima baïar , kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kan ai ha ki tnga jong ki ïa ka burom ba dei , la u riewspah ne duk .

translation.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you , do ye even so to them : for this is the law and the prophets .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kiwei ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ïa ki ba kin leh na ka bynta jong phi : Kane ka long ka jingmut jong ka Hukum u Moses bad jong ki jinghikai ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Sa kawei pat ka khubor ka la wan ha nga na U  Trai .

translation.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death , and the father the child : and the children shall rise up against their parents , and cause them to be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kin aiti noh ïa la ki jong ki hynmen bad para ïa ka ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun ; ki khun kin phai ïaleh pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin phah pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses  ; but some of them left of it until the morning , and it bred worms , and stank : and Moses was wroth with them .
translation.kha: Hynrei don ki bym shym shahshkor ïa u Moses , bad ki la tyngkai khyndiat . Ha ka step kaba bud kata kaba sah ka la boi ksaiñ bad ka sma iwjit , bad u Moses u la bitar ïa ki .

translation.en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock , and his horns are like the horns of unicorns : with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth : and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim , and they are the thousands of Manasseh .
translation.kha: U Joseph u khlaiñ kat u masi kyrtong , Kat ki reng u masi prut . Ki reng jong u kiba kat ki hajar jong u Manasseh , Bad kat ki shiphew hajar jong u Ephraim . Da ki , u tur pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew , Bad u shop ïa ki sha kaba kut jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: According to all that thou desiredst of the  Lord  thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly , saying , Let me not hear again the voice of the  Lord  my God , neither let me see this great fire any more , that I die not .
translation.kha: Ha kato ka sngi mynba phi ïalumlang ha u Lum Sinai , phi la kyrpad ba phim kwah ban ïohsngew shuh ïa ka sur U  Trai  , lymne ïohi shuh ïa ka ding ha kaba u don , namar ba phi sheptieng ïoh phi ïap .

translation.en: Ye shall not steal , neither deal falsely , neither lie one to another .
translation.kha: Wat tuh lane shukor lane lamler .

translation.en: And he turned from him toward another , and spake after the same manner : and the people answered him again after the former manner .
translation.kha: U phai sha uwei pat u rangbah bad u kylli ïa u ïa kajuh ka jingkylli , bad man ba u kylli , u ïoh ïa kajuh ka jubab .

translation.en: And the king commanded , and they brought those men which had accused Daniel , and they cast them into the den of lions , them , their children , and their wives  ; and the lions had the mastery of them , and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba la lah mudui ïa u Daniel , bad la bret ïa ki , lem bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun jong ki , shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . Ha shuwa ban kin poi sha tbian jong ka thliew , ki sing ki la kynrup ïa ki bad pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And now why tarriest thou ? arise , and be baptized , and wash away thy sins , calling on the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , balei me pyntud ? To ïeng joit bad shah ba yn pynbaptis ïa me bad sait noh ïa ki pop jong me da kaba duwai sha u .’

translation.en: ( For all these abominations have the men of the land done , which were before you , and the land is defiled  ; )
translation.kha: Ki la leh ïa kita ki kam kiba ijli bad pyntngit ïa ka ri , hynrei phi phim dei ban leh ïa ki . Baroh na phi , la ki Israel ne ki nongwei kiba wan shong hapdeng jong phi , phi dei ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats  hair .
translation.kha: Ki thir ruh ïa u shñiuh blang .

translation.en: Them did Moses the servant of the  Lord  and the children of Israel smite : and Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites , and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh .
translation.kha: Kine ki ar ngut ki syiem ki la shahjop ha u Moses bad ki paid Israel . U Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ïa ka ri jong ki ha ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad ha shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son , he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u thied mraw ïa ka kynthei ban ai ïa ka ha la u khun , u dei ban ñiew ïa ka kum la ka khun .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Yet once , it is a little while , and I will shake the heavens , and the earth , and the sea , and the dry land  ;
translation.kha: Shen ngan pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei , ïa ka khyndew bad ka duriaw .

translation.en: And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again  ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and , behold , it was turned again as his other flesh .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Bsuh biang ïa kato ka kti jong me shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me .  U ruh u leh kumta , bad haba u sei ïa ka , u ïohi ba ka la koit pat , kumba ka long mynshuwa .

translation.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon , saying , This captivity is long : build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .
translation.kha: Dei ban pynsangeh ïa u namar u la ong ïa ki briew ha Babilonia ba kin long ki koidi slem bah hangta bad ba kin tei ïa ki ïing , kin shongduh , kin thaw ki kper , bad bam ïa kaei kaba ki thung .

translation.en: All things that the Father hath are mine : therefore said I , that he shall take of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba U Kpa jong nga u don ka long ka jong nga ; na kata ka daw nga la ong ba U Mynsiem un shim ïa kaei kaba nga ai ha u bad ïathuh ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: Behold , I build an house to the name of the  Lord  my God , to dedicate it to him , and to burn before him sweet incense , and for the continual shewbread , and for the burnt offerings morning and evening , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts of the  Lord  our God . This is an ordinance for ever to Israel .
translation.kha: Nga tei ka Templ ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga . Kan long ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngin mane ïa u da kaba thang ki jingiwbih da ki musla iwbih , bad ha kaba ngin ïai ai ki jingainguh ha u da u kpu kyntang , bad ha kaba ngin ai ki jingainguh thang man ka step bad janmiet , kumjuh ruh ha ki sngi Sabbaton , ki Jingrakhe Bnai Thymmai , bad kiwei pat ki sngi khuid ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . U la hukum ïa ki Israel ban leh ïa kane junom la junom .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ,

translation.en: Now therefore send , and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel , and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty , and the prophets of the groves four hundred , which eat at Jezebel s table .
