translation.kha: Mynta hukum ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban ïakynduh ïa nga ha u Lum Karmel . Wallam ruh sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal bad sawspah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka blei Asherah kiba ïoh jingkyrshan na ka syiem Jesebel .

translation.en: Tom is just finishing setting up .
translation.kha: U Tom u dang shu dep pynkhreh .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families , the cities , and their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit ïa kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Gad kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them , and hid my face from them .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymman jong ki , bad nga la phai noh na ki .

translation.en: Therefore he said unto his servants , See , Joab s field is near mine , and he hath barley there  ; go and set it on fire . And Absalom s servants set the field on fire .
translation.kha: Kumta u Absalom u ong ha la ki shakri ,  Ha khmih , ka lyngkha u Joab ka don markhap bad ka jong nga , bad ka don u barli uba mih ha ka . Khie leit bad wiang ding ïa ka .  Kumta ki la leit bad wiang ding ïa ka lyngkha .

translation.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them ,  Go your way , and tell John what things ye have seen and heard  ; how that the blind see , the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , the deaf hear , the dead are raised , to the poor the gospel is preached .
translation.kha: U la jubab ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis ,  Khie leit noh bad ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi bad ïohsngew : Kiba matlah ki lah ban ïohi , kiba dkoh ki lah ban ïaid , kito kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh ki la long khuid , kiba kyllut ki lah ban ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïap pynim pat , bad ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ha kiba duk .

translation.en: And greetings in the markets , and to be called of men , Rabbi , Rabbi .
translation.kha: ki ieit ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew bad ban shah khot ha ki briew ‘ ko Nonghikai .’

translation.en: And another came , saying , Lord , behold , here is thy pound , which I have kept laid up in a napkin :
translation.kha: Uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , kane ka long ka sbai ksiar jong me ; nga la buhrieh ïa ka hapoh ka jaiñ rumal .

translation.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey , and the stout lion s whelps are scattered abroad .
translation.kha: Kum ki sing ki bym don ei ei ban pynïap bad ban bam , ki ïap , bad ki khun jong ki baroh ki sakma .

translation.en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world : and this is the victory that overcometh the world , even our faith .
translation.kha: namar man u khun U Blei u lah ban jop noh thiaw ïa ka pyrthei . Bad ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop halor ka pyrthei lyngba ka jingngeit jong ngi .

translation.en: Nevertheless we , according to his promise , look for new heavens and a new earth , wherein dwelleth righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi ap ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular : Ïa ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ïa ka khyndew kaba thymmai , ha kaba ka hok kan don .

translation.en: The fault lies , not with all religion , but with false religion .
translation.kha: Ka jingkynnoh ka long ym ia baroh ki jaitniam , hynrei tang ia kito ki niam kiba kyntiew ia ki kam bymman .

translation.en: Then shall they also answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , or athirst , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and did not minister unto thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta kin jubab ïa u , ‘ Mynno , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ba me thngan lane sliang lane ba me long u nongwei lane ba me la lyngkhuit lane ba me pang lane hapoh ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngim shym la ïarap ïa me ?’

translation.en: And the man , the lord of the country , said unto us , Hereby shall I know that ye are true men  ; leave one of your brethren here with me , and take food for the famine of your households , and be gone :
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab , ‘ Da kumne ngan tip ba phim dei ki riewshukor , uwei na phi un sah bad nga ; ieh kiwei pat kin leit kit kew sha la ki ba-ha-ïing kiba shahthngan , bad kin leit noh .

translation.en: ( Luke 23 :43 ) Also , millions of dead ones will be resurrected to human life on the earth .
translation.kha: ( Loukas 23 :43 ) Shuh shuh yn sa pynmihpat ïa ki milian ngut ki briew kiba la ïap sha ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas , and destroy Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la pynkohnguh ïa u paidbah ban kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban pyllait ïa u Barabbas bad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And he took it , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof  ; and they smote them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining : as he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to the king thereof  ; as he had done also to Libnah , and to her king .
translation.kha: U la kurup ïa ka bad ïa u syiem jong ka , bad ïa baroh ki shnong kiba markhap . Ki pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei hangta . U Joshua u la leh ïa ka Debir bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa ka Hebron bad ïa ka Libnah bad u syiem jong ka .

translation.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynmih ïa ka jingïatainia kaba tyngeh hapdeng jong ki .  Kumno une u briew u lah ban ai ha ngi ïa ka doh jong u ban bam ?  ki la kylli .

translation.en: And he knew it , and said , It is my son s coat  ; an evil beast hath devoured him  ; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces .
translation.kha: U ruh u ithuh ïa ka , bad u ong ,  Ho-oid , ka dei ka sopti jong u ! U mradkhlaw aïu re u la pynïap ïa u . Ïa u Joseph u khun jong nga la tar lyngkhot lyngkhai !

translation.en: Thus shall they know that I the  Lord  their God am with them , and that they , even the house of Israel , are my people , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Baroh kin tip ba nga ïada ïa ki Israel bad ba ki long ki briew jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel , because he was sick .
translation.kha: U la leit phai pat sha ka nongbah Jesreel ban ïohkhiah na ki jingmong jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shata ban jngoh ïa u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy redeemer , and he that formed thee from the womb , I am the  Lord  that maketh all things  ; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone  ; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself  ;
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  , u Nongpynim jong phi ; nga long uta uba la thaw ïa phi . Nga long U  Trai  , u Nongthaw ïa baroh kiei kiei . Nga marwei hi nga pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; haba nga thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ym don u ban ïarap ïa nga .

translation.en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel , a Pirathonite , judged Israel .
translation.kha: Hadien u Elon , u Abdon u khun jong u Hillel uba na Pirathon u ïalam ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together  ; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places .
translation.kha: Ka sahit bneng ka la jah noh kum ka kot kli ba la kli , bad ïa ki lum bad ki dewlynnong baroh la pynkynriah na ka jaka ba ki don .

translation.en: And put no difference between us and them , purifying their hearts by faith .
translation.kha: Um shym la pynïapher ei ei hapdeng jong ngi bad ki ; u la map ïa ki pop jong ki namar ba ki la ngeit .

translation.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with pure gold .
translation.kha: U syiem u phah shna ruh ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta jong ka la sop da ka bniat hati , bad ïa kaba sah jong ka la sop da ka ksiar kaba nylla .

translation.en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim , which is the salt sea .
translation.kha: Kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki la ïasoh lang kum kawei ka kynhun shipai ha ka Them Siddim , kaba long mynta ka Duriaw Baïap .

translation.en: And of thy garments thou didst take , and deckedst thy high places with divers colours , and playedst the harlot thereupon : the like things shall not come , neither shall it be so .
translation.kha: Pha la pyndonkam katto katne tylli ki jaiñ jong pha ban pynitynnat ïa ki jaka mane jong pha , bad kum ka nuti , pha la ai ïa lade ha uei uei baroh .

translation.en: So Samuel turned again after Saul  ; and Saul worshipped the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u leit phai ryngkat bad u , bad u Saul u la mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the  Lord  , in the majesty of the name of the  Lord  his God  ; and they shall abide : for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: Haba u wan , un sa synshar ïa la ki briew da ka jingkhlaiñ kaba wan na U  Trai  bad da ka burom jong U  Trai  U Blei hi . Ki briew jong u kin shong ha ka jingshngain namar ki briew na kylleng ka pyrthei kin ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , bad un wanrah ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: The lambs are for thy clothing , and the goats are the price of the field .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thain jaiñ na u  saiwul jong ki langbrot jong phi bad thied jaka da ka pisa kaba phi ïoh na kaba die na ki katto katne ki blang jong phi .

translation.en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated , and that he himself had dedicated , silver , and gold , and vessels .
translation.kha: U buh ha ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba u Abijah u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , kumjuh ruh ïa ki tiar ba la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba u hi u la pynkyntang .

translation.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba ar , kñia khat-ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name : ask , and ye shall receive , that your joy may be full .
translation.kha: Haduh mynta phim ju pan ei ei ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; to pan bad phin ïohpdiang , khnang ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .

translation.en: Study the Bible with us .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka Baibl bad ngi .

translation.en: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown , and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land , neither bear the shame of the heathen any more .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa ki jaka rep kiba seisoh bad ngan pynkut noh ka jingïapthngan ha ka ri . Kiwei pat ki ri kin ym rkhiebeiñ shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me , and sat before me .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan ban kylli na nga shaphang ka mon U  Trai .

translation.en: And Adah bare Jabal : he was the father of such as dwell in tents , and of such as have cattle .
translation.kha: Ka Adah ka la kha ïa u Jabal , uba dei u kpa tymmen jong kito kiba ri jingri bad kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan , where John was baptizing .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la jia ha Bethania kaba don ha ka phang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ha kaba u Ïoannis u la pynbaptis .

translation.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt , and out of all lands .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kulai na ka bynta u Solomon la wan kit na Musri bad na kiwei pat ki ri .

translation.en: Therefore is the anger of the  Lord  kindled against his people , and he hath stretched forth his hand against them , and hath smitten them : and the hills did tremble , and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa la ki briew bad u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lumbah kin khynñiuh bad ïa ki met jong kito kiba la ïap yn ieh ha ki lynti kum ka synrum . Pynban wat la katta ruh ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  ym shym la pynkut , hynrei ka kti jong u kan ïai kner ban pynshitom .

translation.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man  ; for I will demand of thee , and answer thou me .
translation.kha: Mynta to ïeng joit kum u rangbah bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli kiba nga kylli ïa me .

translation.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good . But if thou do that which is evil , be afraid ; for he beareth not the sword in vain : for he is the minister of God , a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil .
translation.kha: namar u long u shakri jong U Blei uba trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaba sniew , te to sheptieng ïa u , namar ka bor jong u ban pynshitom ka long kaba dei . U long u shakri jong U Blei bad u pyntreikam ïa ka jingpynshitom U Blei halor kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , Nay  ; but whom the  Lord  , and this people , and all the men of Israel , choose , his will I be , and with him will I abide .
translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab ,  Balei ngan leh kumta ? Nga dei ha ka liang jong uta uba la jied da U  Trai  , da kine ki briew , bad da ki Israel baroh . Ngan sah bad phi .

translation.en: And they set on for him by himself , and for them by themselves , and for the Egyptians , which did eat with him , by themselves : because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews  ; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ïa u Joseph la ai ha kawei ka miej , bad ïa ki hynmen jong u ha kawei pat . Ki nong Ijipt kiba ïabam hangta ruh ki shong kyrpang , namar ki kheiñ poh ban ïashong bam ryngkat bad ki Hebru .

translation.en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he delivered them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u la pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: Wherefore ye shall make images of your emerods , and images of your mice that mar the land  ; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel : peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you , and from off your gods , and from off your land .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban thaw ïa ki dur jong u thung bad ki dur khnai kiba la pynjulor ïa ka ri jong phi , bad phi dei ban ai burom ïa U Blei ki Israel . Lehse un sa sangeh noh na kaba pynshitom ïa phi , ïa ki blei jong phi , bad ïa ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth , but had pleasure in unrighteousness .
translation.kha: Kaba mih ka long , ba ïa kito baroh ki bym shym la ngeit ïa ka jingshisha hynrei kiba la sngewbha ha ka pop , yn pynrem .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob , Surely I will never forget any of their works .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la smai ,  Ngan ym klet lano lano ïa ki kam sniew jong ki .

translation.en: But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban s , and the stronger Jacob s .
translation.kha: Hynrei um shym buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki jingri kiba kham tlot . Tang hapdeng khyndiat por u Laban u la ïoh ïa baroh ki jingri kiba tlot , bad u Jakob pat u ïoh baroh ki jingri kiba khlaiñ .

translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire .
translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to khlong bad to bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim tang da kawei ka khmat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka dujok ding .

translation.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days , tempted of Satan  ; and was with the wild beasts  ; and the angels ministered unto him .
translation.kha: ha kaba u la shong hangta sawphew sngi , da kaba shah pynshoi ha u Soitan . Ki mradkhlaw ki la don ruh hangta , hynrei ki angel ki la wan bad ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: And the messenger answered and said , Israel is fled before the Philistines , and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people , and thy two sons also , Hophni and Phinehas , are dead , and the ark of God is taken .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien u jubab ,  Ki Israel ki la phet ïap na ki Philistia ; ka la long ka jingshahjop kaba shyrkhei ïa ngi ; bad nalor kata ki khun jong phi , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shah pynïap , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei la shah knieh noh !

translation.en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym la shaniah ïa lade ha ki , namar ba u la tip ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: The moon and stars to rule by night : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: ïa u bnai bad ki khlur ban synshar halor ka miet ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Ye shall do no manner of work : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
translation.kha: Kane ka hukum ka teh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi baroh kat haba ki don .

translation.en: And , behold , there came a man named Jairus , and he was a ruler of the synagogue : and he fell down at Jesus  feet , and besought him that he would come into his house :
translation.kha: Te u briew uba kyrteng u Jairos u la wan poi ; u la long u rangbah synshar ha ka synagog kaba ha kata ka shnong . U la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha ïing jong u ,

translation.en: Have not I commanded thee ? Be strong and of a good courage  ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa me ban long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem ! Wat sheptieng lane noh mynsiem , namar nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , nga long ryngkat lem bad me kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: And there they abode long time with the disciples .
translation.kha: Bad ki la sah slem hangta bad ki riewngeit .

translation.en: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself , or torn , whether it be fowl or beast .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka sim ne mrad kaba la ïap hi lane kaba la shah pynïap ha uwei pat u mrad .

translation.en: So they took up Jonah , and cast him forth into the sea : and the sea ceased from her raging .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la shim ïa u Jonah bad bret ïa u sha ka duriaw , bad ka la long jai jai ha ka shikhyllipmat .

translation.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him , Behold , thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth , and of the dew of heaven from above  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u ong ha u ,  Ym don umjer na bneng na ka bynta jong me , Ym don lyngkha baseisoh na ka bynta jong me .

translation.en: And the shepherds came and drove them away : but Moses stood up and helped them , and watered their flock .
translation.kha: Hynrei don ki nongap langbrot kiba wan beh noh ïa ki . Te u Moses u leit ban ïada ïa ki bad u ïarap ai um ruh ïa ki jingri jong ki .

translation.en: But every man s servant that is bought for money , when thou hast circumcised him , then shall he eat thereof .
translation.kha: hynrei uno uno u mraw ba phi la thied u lah ban bam ïa ka lada phi otsher shuwa ïa u .

translation.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen , and gave them unto Abimelech  ; and both of them made a covenant .
translation.kha: Nangta u Abraham u la ai katto katne tylli ki langbrot bad ki masi ha u Abimelekh , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki ïateh kular .

translation.en: For decades , Jehovah’s Witnesses used , printed , and distributed various versions of the Bible .
translation.kha: Da ki phew snem , ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki la pyndonkam , ki la shon bad ki la sam ïa ki Baibl bapher bapher .

translation.en: Avoiding this , that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us :
translation.kha: Ngi da sumar ba yn ym shah kynnoh ha ki jingmudui ïa ka rukom pynïaid ïa kane ka jingai sbun mynsiem .

translation.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah , after their generations , in their nations : and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Noah , ha la ka jait ka jait , kat kum la ki jingkheiñ jait bapher bapher ha ka jinghiarpateng . Hadien ka jingshlei um , baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ki hiarpateng na ki khun shynrang jong u Noah .

translation.en: Be not rash with thy mouth , and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God : for God is in heaven , and thou upon earth : therefore let thy words be few .
translation.kha: Da pyrkhat shuwa ba phin kren , bad wat pynlong kino kino ki jingkular kyrkieh ha U Blei . U don ha bneng bad ma phi ha khyndew , kumta wat ong ei ei palat ban ïa kaba phi dei ban ong .

translation.en: I also will laugh at your calamity  ; I will mock when your fear cometh  ;
translation.kha: Kumta ynda phi shah jynjar , ngan sa ïoh rkhie ïa phi . Ngan sa rkhiebeiñ ïa phi ynda phi hap ha ka jingsheptieng —

translation.en: For we commend not ourselves again unto you , but give you occasion to glory on our behalf , that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance , and not in heart .
translation.kha: Ngim pyrshang biang ban ïaroh ïa lade ha khmat jong phi ; pynban , ngi pyrshang ban ai ha phi ïa ka daw kaba biang ba phin sngewsarong shaphang jong ngi , khnang ba phin lah ban ai jubab sha kito kiba sngewsarong shaphang kata kaba paw shabar jong u briew bad ym ha ka jinglong jingim jong u .

translation.en: And returned from the sepulchre , and told all these things unto the eleven , and to all the rest .
translation.kha: ki la leit phai noh na ka jingtep , bad ki la ïathuh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran bad ha baroh kiwei pat .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Touch me not  ; for I am not yet ascended to my Father : but go to my brethren , and say unto them , I ascend unto my Father , and your Father  ; and to my God , and your God .
translation.kha: Wat ktah ïa nga ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  namar ngam pat shym la leit kiew sha U Kpa . Hynrei khie leit sha ki para jong nga bad ïathuh ïa ki ba ngan leit phai sha u , uba long U Kpa jong nga bad U Kpa jong ki , U Blei jong nga bad U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Who is blind , but my servant ? or deaf , as my messenger that I sent ? who is blind as he that is perfect , and blind as the  Lord s  servant ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba kham matlah ban ïa u shakri jong nga , uba kham kyllut ban ïa u nonglamktien ba nga phah ?

translation.en: Yea , when they had made them a molten calf , and said , This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt , and had wrought great provocations  ;
translation.kha: Ki la thaw bleithaw ha ka dur jong u khun masi bad ong ba u dei u blei uba la ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ! Haduh katno ki la pynjahburom ïa me , Ko  Trai  !

translation.en: And how shall they preach , except they be sent ? as it is written , How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace , and bring glad tidings of good things !
translation.kha: Bad kumno ïa ka khubor lah ban pynbna lada ïa ki nongrah-khubor ym shym la phah ? Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Katno ka long kaba phylla ka jingwan jong ki nongrah-khubor kiba wallam ïa ka khubor babha !

translation.en: For the  Lord  will judge his people , and he will repent himself concerning his servants .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrshan ïa la ki briew ; un sngewsynei ïa la ki shakri .

translation.en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , and taken Gezer , and burnt it with fire , and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city , and given it for a present unto his daughter , Solomon s wife .
translation.kha: ( U syiem ka ri Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Geser bad u la ïohknieh ïa ka , u la pynïap ïa ki traishnong hangta bad u la thang ïa ka . Nangta u la ai ïa ka ha ka khun jong u kum ka jingïoh bynta jong ka ha ka por ba ka shongkurim ïa u Solomon , bad u Solomon u tei thymmai ïa ka . )

translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as Gideon was dead , that the children of Israel turned again , and went a whoring after Baalim , and made Baal–berith their god .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap jong u Gideon , ki paid Israel kim shym ïaineh shuh bad U Blei bad ki la mane ïa ki Baal . Ki la pynlong ïa u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang ban long u blei jong ki ,

translation.en: I speak as concerning reproach , as though we had been weak . Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold , ( I speak foolishly , ) I am bold also .
translation.kha: Nga sngewlehrain ban phla ba phim shym la long kiba shlur ban leh ïa kito kiei kiei! Hynrei lada uno uno ud nud ban sngewsarong shaphang kaei kaei — nga kren kum uba bieit — ngan shu long uba shlur .

translation.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips , and layeth up deceit within him  ;
translation.kha: U riewarsap u buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun ha lyndet ki ktien pynkhyllew .

translation.en: For the customs of the people are vain : for one cutteth a tree out of the forest , the work of the hands of the workman , with the axe .
translation.kha: Ka niam jong kine ki briew ka long ka bymdondor ei ei . La khet ïa u dieng ha khlaw ; la ohdur da ki tiar u nong-ohdieng ,

translation.en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee  ; and thou hast well done that thou art come . Now therefore are we all here present before God , to hear all things that are commanded thee of God .
translation.kha: Bad kumta shisyndon nga la phah khot ïa me , me ruh me la long uba sbun eh ban wan . Mynta ngi baroh ngi don hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , da kaba ap ban ïohsngew ïa kano kano kaba U Trai u la bthah ïa me ban ong .

translation.en: The bellows are burned , the lead is consumed of the fire  ; the founder melteth in vain : for the wicked are not plucked away .
translation.kha: Ka lawar ding ka klang rhem bha , hynrei ka eitnar kam um bad ka tuid noh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi ban ïai phrang ïa ki briew jong nga , namar ïa kito kiba sniew ym shym la weng noh .

translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  are in every place , beholding the evil and the good .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïohi kaei kaba jia ha ki jaka baroh ; u khmih halor jong ngi , la ngi leh ïa kaba bha ne kaba sniew .

translation.en: We then , as workers together with him , beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtrei jong ngi lem bad U Blei , namarkata , ngi kyrpad ïa phi kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingaiei U Blei ban ym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka .

translation.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la sngewbha eh ïa u Noah .

translation.en: His disciples say unto him , If the case of the man be so with his wife , it is not good to marry .
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la ong ïa u ,  Lada ka long kumne hapdeng u briew bad la ka tnga , ka kham bha ban ym shongkurim .

translation.en: But rise , and stand upon thy feet : for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose , to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen , and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei khie joit bad ïeng . Nga la paw ha me ban thung ïa me kum u shakri jong nga . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kiwei pat ïa kaba me la ïohi ïa nga ha kane ka sngi , bad ïa kaei kaba ngan pyn-i ha me ha ka ban sa wan .

translation.en: Be ye followers of me , even as I also am of Christ .
translation.kha: To pyrthuh bud ïa nga , te , kumba nga ruh nga pyrthuh bud ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have opened your graves , O my people , and brought you up out of your graves ,
translation.kha: Haba ngan plie ïa ki jingtep ha kiba la tep ïa ki briew jong nga bad sei noh ïa ki , kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: So Jacob came to Luz , which is in the land of Canaan , that is , Beth–el , he and all the people that were with him .
translation.kha: U Jakob u wan poi bad la ki briew baroh ha Lus , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethel , ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: Blessed are the merciful : for they shall obtain mercy .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba isynei ïa kiwei pat ; U Blei un isynei ïa ki !

translation.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken : and if it be sodden in a brasen pot , it shall be both scoured , and rinsed in water .
translation.kha: Ïa u khiew khyndew ha kaba la shet ïa ka doh dei ban pynpait noh ïa u , bad lada dei u khiew shet da ka rnong , dei ban da kyrshut bha ïa u bad phler da ka um .

translation.en: But now is made manifest , and by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the everlasting God , made known to all nations for the obedience of faith :
translation.kha: Mynta pat , ïa kata ka jingshisha la pynmih ha kaba paw lyngba ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ; bad da ka hukum jong U Blei bymjukut , ïa ka la pyntip sha baroh ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba baroh ki lah ban ngeit bad kohnguh .

translation.en: Now unto the King eternal , immortal , invisible , the only wise God , be honour and glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ha u Syiem bymjukut , u bymïap shuh bad u bym lah ban ïohi , uba tang ma u hi U Blei — ha u to long ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom junom la junom ! Amen .

translation.en: For first of all , when ye come together in the church , I hear that there be divisions among you ; and I partly believe it .
translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong eh , la ïathuh ïa nga ba ha ki jingïaseng jong phi , ki don ki kynhun kiba ïa-pyrshah ; bad kane nga ngeit ka don katto katne ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Tarry here to day also , and to morrow I will let thee depart . So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day , and the morrow .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ,  Te sah hangne ha kane ka sngi , bad lashai ngan phah pat ïa phi .  Kumta u Uriah u la sah ha Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi bad ha ka sngi kaba bud .

translation.en: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth , even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs , when she is shaken of a mighty wind .
translation.kha: Ki khlur ki la hap ha pyrthei , kum ki soh Dumbur bym pat ih na u dieng haba kynther ka lyer kaba jur .

translation.en: He that hath the Son hath life  ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba don U Khun , u don ïa kane ka jingim ; uno uno u bym don U Khun U Blei , um don ka jingim .

translation.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead  ; even so will I certainly do this day .
translation.kha: ba ha kane ka sngi ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha pha ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , ba u Solomon , u khun jong pha un long syiem hadien jong nga .

translation.en: For I will surely deliver thee , and thou shalt not fall by the sword , but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee : because thou hast put thy trust in me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ka jingma , bad yn ym pynïap ïa me . Men lait im namar me la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  U briew uba la bet ïa u symbai babha u long U Khun U Briew ;

translation.en: Let him know , that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death , and shall hide a multitude of sins .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , lada uwei na phi u ïaid sakma na ka jingshisha bad uwei pat u pynphai pat ïa u , to kynmaw ïa kane : Uno uno uba pynphai pat ïa u nongpop na ka lynti kaba bakla un pynim ïa ka mynsiem jong uta u nongpop na ka jingïap bad yn map ïa ki pop kiba bun byllien jong u .

translation.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner .
translation.kha: U maw uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la jia long uba donkam eh na baroh .

translation.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka por ba la buh man ka snem .

translation.en: Purge out therefore the old leaven , that ye may be a new lump , as ye are unleavened . For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us :
translation.kha: Phi dei ban weng noh ïa u thiat barim jong ka pop ba kumta phin long khuid nadong shadong . Te phin long kum kawei pat ka jingkhleh jong u kpu im uba khlem don thiat , kumba da shisha nga tip phi long kumta . Naba ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait la pynkhreh , mynta ïa U Khrist , u khunlangbrot ka Jinglait jong ngi , la lah kñia .

translation.en: I bring near my righteousness  ; it shall not be far off , and my salvation shall not tarry : and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory .
translation.kha: Nga wallam ïa ka sngi ka jingjop sha jan — kam long satia kaba dang sha jngai . Ïa ka jingjop jong nga yn ym pynslem . Ngan pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem bad ngan wallam ïa ka burom ka Israel hangta .

translation.en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself  ; for his mouth craveth it of him .
translation.kha: Ka jingkwah bam jong u nongbylla sngi ka pynlong ïa u ban kham trei shitom , namar u kwah ban pynhun ïa la ka jingthngan .

translation.en: And he said unto him , My lord knoweth that the children are tender , and the flocks and herds with young are with me : and if men should overdrive them one day , all the flock will die .
translation.kha: U Jakob u phai ktien ,  Phi tip ba ki khynnah ki tlot , bad nga dei ruh ban pyrkhat shaphang ki langbrot bad ki jingri kiba dang ai buiñ . Lada yn ñiah jubor ïa ki wat tang shi sngi ruh , baroh ki jingri kin ïap lut .

translation.en: Wealth maketh many friends  ; but the poor is separated from his neighbour .
translation.kha: Borabor kiba riewspah ki ïakynduh ïa ki paralok kiba thymmai , hynrei kiba duk kim lah ban bat ïa kiba khyndiat ngut kiba ki don .

translation.en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the  Lord  deceitfully , and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood .
translation.kha: ( Long ba la tim ïa u briew u bym leh ïa ka kam U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong u baroh ! Long ba la tim ïa uno uno u bym pom bad pynïap ! )

translation.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba ai khublei da ka jingsuk , u kylla long uba ïatreilang ha ki kam sniew ba u leh .

translation.en: So David went up thither , and his two wives also , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail Nabal s wife the Carmelite .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u la leit sha Hebron , u da ïalam bad u ïa ki ar ngut ki tnga jong u : Ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad ka Abigail , ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .

translation.en: Blessed are the meek : for they shall inherit the earth .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba sngewrit ; kin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular !

translation.en: But draw near hither , ye sons of the sorceress , the seed of the adulterer and the whore .
translation.kha: Ale hangne ban shah bishar , a phi ki nongpop ! Phim long kham bha ban ïa ki nongleh byrtong , kiba klim bad ki nuti .

translation.en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks , and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in , for my people that have sought me .
translation.kha: Kin mane ïa nga bad ïalam ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jong ki sha ki jaka phlang ha ka Pyntha ka Sharon ha ka phang sepngi bad ha ka Them ka Jingshitom ha ka phang mihngi .

translation.en: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah  ; and the goings out thereof were at the sea . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families .
translation.kha: U pud u suh sha sepngi na Tappuah sha ka wahduid Kanah bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Kane ka long ka jaka ba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Ephraim kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki ,

translation.en: Then saith he to Thomas ,  Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands  ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .
translation.kha: Te u la ong ha u Thomas ,  Buh ïa ka shynriah ti jong me hangne , bad peit ïa ki kti jong nga ; nangta kner ïa la ka kti bad buh ïa ka ha ka krung jong nga . Wat artatien shuh bad to ngeit !

translation.en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword , not of a mighty man  ; and the sword , not of a mean man , shall devour him : but he shall flee from the sword , and his young men shall be discomfited .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Assyria yn pynjot ha ka thma , hynrei ym da ka bor briew . Ki nong Assyria kin phet ïap na ka thma , bad ïa ki samla shynrang jong ki yn pynlong mraw .

translation.en: Saying ,  The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses  seat :
translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki long kiba la pynkupbor ban batai ïa ka Hukum u Moses .

translation.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness  ; and all that were numbered of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , which have murmured against me ,
translation.kha: Phin ïap bad ïa ki metïap jong phi yn pynphriang ha kylleng kane ka ri khlaw . Namar ba phi la khñium pyrshah ïa nga , yn ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la palat arphew snem ka rta u ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath opened his armoury , and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation : for this is the work of the Lord  God  of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Nga la plie ïa ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa ki atiar jong nga , bad ha ka jingbitar nga la shim noh ïa ki , namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga don ka kam ban leh ha Babilonia .

translation.en: ( Who for a certain sedition made in the city , and for murder , was cast into prison . )
translation.kha: ( Ïa u Barabbas la buh ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin kaba lah jia ha ka nongbah , bad namar ka jingpynïap briew . )

translation.en: The sons of Zophah  ; Suah , and Harnepher , and Shual , and Beri , and Imrah ,
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Sophah ki long u Suah , u Harnepher , u Shual , u Beri , u Imrah ,

translation.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads , and your shoes upon your feet : ye shall not mourn nor weep  ; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities , and mourn one toward another .
translation.kha: Phan ym leit khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem sopkjat lane sngewsih ne ïam . Phan pynsep-ei namar ki pop jong pha , bad phan ïa-ud iwei ha iwei .

translation.en: But when Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done ,
translation.kha: U Johanan bad baroh ki nongïalam ka kynhun shipai kiba don bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa ka kam runar kaba u Ishmael u la leh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they departed from him , Peter said unto Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias : not knowing what he said .
translation.kha: Katba kita ki rangbah ki dang leit noh na U Jisu , u Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah .  ( Um tip da shisha ïa kaei kaba u kren . )

translation.en: And the eunuch answered Philip , and said , I pray thee , of whom speaketh the prophet this ? of himself , or of some other man ?
translation.kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la kylli ïa u Philip ,  To ïathuh ïa nga , shaphang jongno u nongïathuhlypa u kren ïa kane ? Shaphang ïa lade ne shaphang uwei pat ?

translation.en: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard , when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u la ong ïa ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ïohsngew ba u Barukh u la pule ha ki paidbah .

translation.en: The bloodthirsty hate the upright : but the just seek his soul .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba thrang snam ki isih ïa uno uno uba lehhok , hynrei ki briew bahok kin ïada ïa ka jingim jong kum uta u briew .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Joash was minded to repair the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda u la long syiem katto katne por , u Joash u la kut jingmut ban shna pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Now hear me therefore , and deliver the captives again , which ye have taken captive of your brethren : for the fierce wrath of the  Lord  is upon you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor , ïa nga ! Kine ki koidi ki dei ki hynmen ki para jong phi . Pyllait noh ïa ki , ne U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong u .

translation.en: The beast of the field shall honour me , the dragons and the owls : because I give waters in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen .
translation.kha: Wat ki mradkhlaw kin burom ïa nga ; ki myrsiang bad ki ostrit kin ïaroh ïa nga haba ngan pynlong ïa ki wah ba kin tuid ha ka ri shyiap ban ai um ïa ki briew ba la jied jong nga .

translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .
translation.kha: Katno kiba suk ki long kito ki bym don jingartatien shaphang jong nga !

translation.en: And if Satan rise up against himself , and be divided , he cannot stand , but hath an end .
translation.kha: Kumta lada ka hima u Soitan ka phiah ha ki kynhun , kan ym lah ban neh , hynrei kan kyllon noh bad poi sha ka jingkut .

translation.en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering , and poured his drink offering , and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar .
translation.kha: kumta u thang jingkñia da ki mrad bad ki jingainguh bam , bad u theh ïa ka jingainguh waiñ bad ka snam jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok ha ka .

translation.en: But he said unto me , Behold , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and now drink no wine nor strong drink , neither eat any unclean thing : for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death .
translation.kha: Hynrei u da ong ha nga ba ngan sa punkhun bad ïoh khun shynrang . U ong ïa nga ban nym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid , namar uta u khunlung un long uba yn pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir katba u dang im .

translation.en: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit , and the earth shall yield her increase , and they shall be safe in their land , and shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have broken the bands of their yoke , and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them .
translation.kha: Ki dieng kin sei ïa u soh , ki lyngkha kin pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad uwei pa uwei un shongshngain ha la ka ri . Ynda haba nga dkhat ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa ki briew jong nga bad nga pyllait ïa ki na kito kiba pynlong mraw ïa ki , te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot  ; yea , thou shalt be stedfast , and shalt not fear :
translation.kha: Nangta sa khmied biang ïa ka pyrthei , kum uba skhem bad uba shlur .

translation.en: He hath stripped me of my glory , and taken the crown from my head .
translation.kha: U la shim noh ïa ka spah jong nga baroh bad pynjot ïa ka burom jong nga .

translation.en: Then king David sent , and fetched him out of the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , from Lo–debar .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Dabid u phah shaw ïa u .

translation.en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat , saying , Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah , the  Lord  hath broken thy works . And the ships were broken , that they were not able to go to Tarshish .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Elieser u khun jong u Dodabahu , na ka shnong Mareshah , u la maham ïa u Jehoshaphat bad ong ,  Namar ba phi la ïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah , U  Trai  un sa pynjot ïa kaei kaba phi la tei .  Bad ki liengbah ki la shah pynjot bad kim shym la lah ban ïaid duriaw .

translation.en: Then the king commanded , and they brought Daniel , and cast him into the den of lions . Now the king spake and said unto Daniel , Thy God whom thou servest continually , he will deliver thee .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa u Daniel bad ban bret ïa u shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . U la ong ha u Daniel ,  Ai ba U Blei jong me , ïa uba me shakri hok katta katta , un pyllait im ïa me .

translation.en: And Zanoah , and En–gannim , Tappuah , and Enam ,
translation.kha: ka Sanoah , ka Engannim , ka Tappuah , ka Enam ,

translation.en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Moab , u Balak u khun jong u Sippor , u la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba ki Israel ki la leh ïa ki Amor , bad ïa ka jingbun paid ki Israel ,

translation.en: But he said , Ye are idle , ye are idle : therefore ye say , Let us go and do sacrifice to the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la jubab ,  Phi kiba jaipdeh bad phim kwah ban treikam , bad dei kata balei ba phi kyrpad ïa nga ban shah ïa phi ban leit bad ai ki jingkñia sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And that which fell among thorns are they , which , when they have heard , go forth , and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life , and bring no fruit to perfection .
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; hynrei ki jingkhuslai bad ka spah bad ki jingsngewbha jong kane ka jingim ki ïatyllep bad kjap ïa ki , bad ki soh jong ki kim ju ih .

translation.en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the veil of the covering , and covered the ark of the testimony  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u buh ïa kata ka synduk hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bad u wah ïa ka pyrda . Da kumne u kah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon .
translation.kha: Nangta ki mynsiem ki la wallam lang ïa ki syiem ha ka jaka kaba ha ka ktien Hebru la khot  Ka Armageddon .

translation.en: And when these days are expired , it shall be , that upon the eighth day , and so forward , the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar , and your peace offerings  ; and I will accept you , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Haba la kut shi taïew , ki lyngdoh kin sdang ki jingainguh thang halor ka duwan bad ki jingainguh thang jingïasyllok ki paidbah . Te ngan sngewbha na bynta jong phi baroh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: Really good !
translation.kha: Bha bha !

translation.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan , Tell me what thou hast done . And Jonathan told him , and said , I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand , and , lo , I must die .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u kylli ïa u Jonathan ,  Me la leh aïu ?  U Jonathan u jubab ,  Nga la bam khyndiat ka ngap da u dieng uba nga rah . Nga don hangne — nga la kloi ban ïap .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the  Lord s  sacrifice , that I will punish the princes , and the king s children , and all such as are clothed with strange apparel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka jingpynïap ,  ong U  Trai  ,  ngan pynshitom ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki khun shynrang jong u syiem , bad baroh kiba leh ïa ki rukom nongwei .

translation.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king , and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant , who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him ?
translation.kha: Hato u Syiem Kynrad u mynjur ïa kane baroh bad ym shym ïathuh wat ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi mano ban long syiem hadien jong phi ?

translation.en: I can of mine own self do nothing : as I hear , I judge : and my judgment is just  ; because I seek not mine own will , but the will of the Father which hath sent me .
translation.kha: Nga ngam lah ban leh ei ei da la ka jong ka bor ; nga bishar tang kat kaba U Blei u ong ïa nga , kumta ka jingbishar jong nga ka long kaba hok , namar ba ngam pyrshang ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba uta uba la phah ïa nga u mon .

translation.en: Judah was his sanctuary , and Israel his dominion .
translation.kha: ka Judah ka la kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba khuid jong U  Trai  , bad ka Israel ka kylla long ka jingïohkynti jong u hi .

translation.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :
translation.kha: wat la don katto katne ngut kiba kwah ban pyndep ïa ka . Da kaba leh mynleh kum ki parabangeit , kine ki rangbah ki la ïohrung shapoh ka kynhun jong ngi kum ki nongsyntiat , khnang ban lap shaphang ka jinglaitluid kaba ngi la mad da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And he said unto me , The  Lord  , before whom I walk , will send his angel with thee , and prosper thy way  ; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred , and of my father s house :
translation.kha: U la jubab , ‘ U  Trai  , ïa uba nga la ju kohnguh , un phah ïa u angel jong u lem bad me bad ai ha me ka jingjop . Men pynïoh ïa u khun jong nga ka tnga na ki briew jong nga hi , bad na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u kpa jong nga .

translation.en: And he said , If now I have found grace in thy sight , O Lord , let my Lord , I pray thee , go among us  ; for it is a stiffnecked people  ; and pardon our iniquity and our sin , and take us for thine inheritance .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ko  Trai  , lada me sngewbha shisha ïa nga , nga kyrpad ïa me ban wan ryngkat bad ngi . Kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop , hynrei map ïa ka jingbymman bad ka pop jong ngi , bad pdiang ïa ngi kum ki briew ki jong me hi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa u Moses ,

translation.en: I thought on my ways , and turned my feet unto thy testimonies .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ïa ka rukom im jong nga , bad nga kular ban bud ïa ki jingbthah jong me .

translation.en: And the multitude rose up together against them : and the magistrates rent off their clothes , and commanded to beat them .
translation.kha: Bad u paidbah u la ïasoh lang ha kaba tur pyrshah ïa u Paul bad u Silas . Ki rangbah synshar ki la tar ïa ki jaiñ jong u Paul bad u Silas , bad ki la ai hukum ban sympat ïa ki .

translation.en: For the day of the  Lord  is near upon all the heathen : as thou hast done , it shall be done unto thee : thy reward shall return upon thine own head .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan ha kaba ma nga , U  Trai  ,  ngan bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh . Ko Edom , ïa kaei kaba pha la leh yn sa leh ha pha . Phan sa ïoh pat ïa kaei kaba pha la ai .

translation.en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka ki la sakma lyngba ki lynti bah kum ki rangbah kiba matlah , kiba la bit da ka snam haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ban ktah ïa ki .

translation.en: For in six days the  Lord  made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day : wherefore the  Lord  blessed the sabbath day , and hallowed it .
translation.kha: Ha ki hynriew sngi , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ki , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew nga la shongthait . Namar kata , nga U  Trai  , nga la kyrkhu ïa ka Sabbaton , bad nga la pynkyntang khuid ïa ka .

translation.en: Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi lano kane kan sa long ,  ki la ong ,  bad to ïathuh ïa ngi kaei ka ban jia ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta kine kiei kiei baroh ban long .

translation.en: They are built with donations made to a central fund .
translation.kha: La tei ïa kine da ka jingbei tyngka na ka Pla Tyngka Pdeng .

translation.en: And he went , and fetched , and brought them to his mother : and his mother made savoury meat , such as his father loved .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit shim ïa ki bad u wanrah sha ka , bad ka ruh ka shet ïa ka jait jingbam kaba u kpa jong u , u ju sngewtynnat .

translation.en: I say then , Have they stumbled that they should fall ? God forbid : but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles , for to provoke them to jealousy .
translation.kha: Nga kylli te : Haba ki Jiw ki jynthut , hato ki hap sha ka jingjot jong ki ? Em , ym kumta ! Namar ki la leh pop , ka jingpynim ka la wan sha ki Jentil , ban pynlong ïa ki Jiw ban bishni ïa ki .

translation.en: Then were the king s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month , and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king s lieutenants , and to the governors that were over every province , and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language  ; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written , and sealed with the king s ring .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la khot ïa ki sekretari jong u syiem bad u la pule ha ki ba kin bud ïa ka jingpynbna bad ong ïa ki ban pynkylla ktien sha baroh ki jait ktien bad rukom thoh ba la pyndonkam ha ka hima bad ban phah sha baroh ki nongsynshar , ki lat bad rangbah synshar . La pynmih ha ka kyrteng jong u syiem Serksis bad shon muhor da ka sati jong u .

translation.en: ( And they said unto him , Lord , he hath ten pounds . )
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ong ha u , ‘ Ko kynrad , u la don lypa shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar !’

translation.en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things , O  Lord  ? wilt thou hold thy peace , and afflict us very sore ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  , hato yn ym pynkhih ïa me da kane baroh ? Hato men ym leh ei ei bad shah ba ngin shah jynjar palat ïa kaba ngi lah ban shah ?

translation.en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there  ; for that was the great high place : a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka khep u la leit sha Gibeon ban ai jingkñia namar kata kaba don hangta ka long ka duwan kaba donnam tam . U la ai da ki spah tylli ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka por ba la leit .

translation.en: And Babylon shall become heaps , a dwellingplace for dragons , an astonishment , and an hissing , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Kata ka ri kan long kum ka kynton ñiut ha kaba ki mradkhlaw ki im . Kan long kaba shyrkhei ban peit ; yn ym don mano mano ban sah hangta , bad baroh kiba ïohi ïa ka kin sngewshyrkhei .

translation.en: And it was told Joshua , saying , The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah .
translation.kha: Don kiba lap ïa ki , bad la ïathuh ha u Joshua ha-ei ba ki ïarieh .

translation.en: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem  ; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together , gold , and silver , and apparel , in great abundance .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Judah ki ïaleh ban ïada ïa ka Jerusalem . Kin shim kum ka jinglute ïa ka spah jong ki hima baroh — ka ksiar , ka rupa bad ki jaiñphong babun .

translation.en: For all the wells which his father s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father , the Philistines had stopped them , and filled them with earth .
translation.kha: Kumta ki tep khyndew noh ïa ki pukri baroh kiba ki shakri jong u kpa jong u , u Abraham ki la tih mynba u Abraham u dang im .

translation.en: I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon , and thou wast not aware : thou art found , and also caught , because thou hast striven against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Babilonia , pha ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , bad pha la shah riam ha ka jingriam kaba nga la buh ïa pha , wat la pham shym la tip ïa ka .

translation.en: This people have I formed for myself  ; they shall shew forth my praise .
translation.kha: Ki long ki briew ba nga la pynlong na ka bynta ïa lade , bad ki rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong nga !

translation.en: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones . The first foundation was jasper  ; the second , sapphire  ; the third , a chalcedony  ; the fourth , an emerald  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki maw nongrim jong ka kynroh ka nongbah la pynkup itynnat da ki jait maw bakordor baroh . U maw nongrim uba nyngkong u la long u maw Jasper , uba ar u maw Sapphir , uba lai u maw Agate , uba saw u maw Emerald ,

translation.en: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of , knowing of whom thou hast learned them ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , to ïaineh ha ki jingshisha kiba me la ïoh jinghikai bad kiba me ngeit skhem .

translation.en: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , wherein this passover was holden to the  Lord  in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh , ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josaïah , la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Woe unto you , lawyers ! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge : ye entered not in yourselves , and them that were entering in ye hindered .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi la bat noh ïa u shabi uba plie ïa ka khyrdop sha ka ïing jong ka jingtip ; phi hi phim leit rung shapoh , bad phi khang ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban rung shapoh !

translation.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ngi ka kynton jakhlia jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For he that is called in the Lord , being a servant , is the Lord s freeman : likewise also he that is called , being free , is Christ s servant .
translation.kha: Naba u mraw uba la khot da U Trai u long uba laitluid na ka bynta U Trai ; kumjuh ruh u briew uba laitluid ïa uba la khot da U Khrist u long u mraw jong U .

translation.en: Yea , brother , let me have joy of thee in the Lord : refresh my bowels in the Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta , ko para jong nga , sngewbha ban leh ïa kane na ka bynta U Trai ; kum u para ha u Khrist , to pynkmen ïa nga !

translation.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams , and terrifiest me through visions :
translation.kha: Hynrei me — me pyntriem ïa nga da ki jingphohsniew ; me phah ha nga da ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingphohsniew kynsha

translation.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph , and said to him , In my dream , behold , a vine was before me  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u nongrah khuri rangbah u ong ,  Ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga , la don uwei u dieng sohwaiñ ha khmat jong nga , uba don lai tylli ki tnat .

translation.en: And if any man say unto you , Why do ye this ? say ye that the Lord hath need of him  ; and straightway he will send him hither .
translation.kha: Bad lada uno uno u kylli ïa phi balei phi leh ïa kata , ong ïa u ba U Kynrad u donkam ïa u bad ban pynphai mar mar pat ïa u .

translation.en: For death is come up into our windows , and is entered into our palaces , to cut off the children from without , and the young men from the streets .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka la wan shapoh lyngba ki jingkhangïit jong ngi bad ka la rung sha ki ïingsyiem jong ngi ; ka la ot ïa ki khynnah ha ki surok bad ïa ki samla shynrang ha ki jaka ïew .

translation.en: A drought is upon her waters  ; and they shall be dried up : for it is the land of graven images , and they are mad upon their idols .
translation.kha: Wallam ïa ka jingrang ryngkhiang ha ka ri jong ka bad pynrngad lut ïa ki wah jong ka . Ka Babilonia ka long ka ri jong ki bleithaw ba-ishyrkhei , kiba la pynkylla bieit ïa ki briew .

translation.en: He shall not see the rivers , the floods , the brooks of honey and butter .
translation.kha: Un ym im ban ïohi ïa ki wah ka umphniang Olib lane ïa ki wahduid kiba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

translation.en: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters : they came to the pits , and found no water  ; they returned with their vessels empty  ; they were ashamed and confounded , and covered their heads .
translation.kha: Ki briew bariewspah ki phah ïa la ki shakri ban tong um ; ki leit sha ki thliew pynlang um , hynrei kim shem um ; ki wan phai pat bad ki khra thylli . Ki la noh mynsiem bad shaïong jingmut , ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .

translation.en: And when we had launched from thence , we sailed under Cyprus , because the winds were contrary .
translation.kha: Ngi la nang leit nangta , bad namar ba ka lyer ka beh pyrshah ïa ngi , ngi la ïaid sha ka liang ba kah lyer jong ka dewlynnong Sypros .

translation.en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools , the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish : how say ye unto Pharaoh , I am the son of the wise , the son of ancient kings ?
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka nongbah Soan ki dei ki bieit ! Ki briew kiba stad tam jong ka Ijipt ki ai ka jingai jingmut ba khlem pyrkhat bha ! Kumno ki nud ban ïathuh ïa u syiem ba ki dei ki nongmih bujli ïa ki riewstad hyndai bad ïa ki syiem ?

translation.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them .
translation.kha: Kito kiba lyndet ïa ka hukum ki ïaroh ïa ki bymman ; hynrei kito kiba bat ïa ka ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: Then came his disciples , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended , after they heard this saying ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Hato me tip ba la pynmong ïa ki jingsngew jong ki Pharisi da kaei kaba me la ong ?

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , be of good comfort : thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko khun jong nga , ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba suk .

translation.en: Will he esteem thy riches ? no , not gold , nor all the forces of strength .
translation.kha: Kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban kyang jam ban ïoh ka jingïarap ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong phi baroh kam lah ban ïarap ïa phi mynta .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour , and Lord Jesus Christ , which is our hope ;
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol jong U Khrist Jisu kat kum ka hukum U Blei u Nongpynim jong ngi bad U Khrist Jisu uba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi —

translation.en: For the idols have spoken vanity , and the diviners have seen a lie , and have told false dreams  ; they comfort in vain : therefore they went their way as a flock , they were troubled , because there was no shepherd .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki nongbatai kupar , hynrei ki jubab kiba ki ïoh ki long ki jinglamler bad ki bym don jingmut . Katto katne ki pyrshang ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , hynrei tang ban shu ïalam bakla ïa phi ; ka jingpyntngen ba ki ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta ki briew ki sakma kylleng kum ka langbrot ba la jah . Ki don ha ka jingjynjar namar ba kim don u nongïalam .

translation.en: Therefore he said unto Judah , Let us build these cities , and make about them walls , and towers , gates , and bars , while the land is yet before us  ; because we have sought the  Lord  our God , we have sought him , and he hath given us rest on every side . So they built and prospered .
translation.kha: U ong ïa ki paid Judah ,  To ngin pynskhem ïa ki nongbah da kaba tei ïa ki kynroh bad ki kut , bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang khyrdep . Ngi long trai ïa ka ri namar ba ngi la leh ïa ka mon U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . U la ïada ïa ngi bad u la ai jingshngain na ki liang baroh .  Bad kumta ki tei bad ki manbha .

translation.en: And Saul called all the people together to war , to go down to Keilah , to besiege David and his men .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u khot ïa ki kynhun nongïapom jong u sha ka thma , ban ïaid pyrshah ïa ka Keilah bad ban kem ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u .

translation.en: And Moses said unto God , Who am I , that I should go unto Pharaoh , and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ha U Blei ,  Ngam long ei ei . Kumno nga lah ban leit sha u Pharaoh bad ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt ?

translation.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making : they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Syria ki la thied ïa ki mar khaïi bad ïa ki jingmih ba bun jong pha . Ki la ai ïa ki mawkordor Emerald , ki jaiñ bajngum , ki jingthain ba-itynnat , ki linen bakynsai , ki Koral , bad ki mawkordor Rubi kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: Howbeit when he , the Spirit of truth , is come , he will guide you into all truth : for he shall not speak of himself  ; but whatsoever he shall hear , that shall he speak : and he will shew you things to come .
translation.kha: Pynban , haba U Mynsiem un wan , uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei , un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingshisha baroh . Un ym kren ha ka bor jong u hi , hynrei un kren ïa kaei kaba u ïohsngew , bad un ïathuh ha phi ïa kiei kiei ki ban sa wan .

translation.en: And said unto them , Ye shall not bring in the captives hither : for whereas we have offended against the  Lord  already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass : for our trespass is great , and there is fierce wrath against Israel .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Wat wan ïalam ïa kito ki koidi shane , Ngi la leh pop lypa pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynbitar la biang ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi . Mynta phi kwah ban leh ei ei ban nang pynkit pop ïa ngi .

translation.en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself , or that which was torn with beasts , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger , he shall both wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the even : then shall he be clean .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew , la u dei u Israel ne u nongwei , uba bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba shu ïap hi , ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad un sum , bad ap haduh janmiet shuwa ba yn ñiew ïa u ba u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Therefore , O ye shepherds , hear the word of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki nongsharai .

translation.en: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour , and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls , having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication :
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la riam ha ki jaiñ ba sawbthuh bad basaw hain hain , bad ba la tap da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila . Ha ka kti jong ka , ka la bat ïa ka khuri ksiar kaba dap da kiei kiei kiba isaitmet bad ijakhlia , kiba mih na ka jingawria jong ka .

translation.en: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet , and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from one end of heaven to the other .
translation.kha: Ka turoi bakhraw kan sawa , bad un phah ïa ki angel jong u sha ki sawlyer jong ka pyrthei , ban kin lumlang ïa ki briew kiba la jied jong u na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .

translation.en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house , neither enter therein , to take any thing out of his house :
translation.kha: U briew uba don halor ka tnum jong ka ïing jong u , um dei ban pynlut por da kaba hiar shapoh ka ïing ban shim ei ei ban rah bad u .

translation.en: Bread corn is bruised  ; because he will not ever be threshing it , nor break it with the wheel of his cart , nor bruise it with his horsemen .
translation.kha: Um pynsniew noh ïa u kew da kaba peh palat ïa u , bad u tip kumno ban ïuh ïa u da kaba pynïaid ïa ka kali dieng halor jong u khlem pynkhlur noh ïa ki symbai .

translation.en: And when she is departed out of his house , she may go and be another man s wife .
translation.kha: bad lada ka ïapoi shongkurim bad uwei pat u briew ,

translation.en: I form the light , and create darkness : I make peace , and create evil : I the  Lord  do all these things .
translation.kha: Nga thaw ïa ka jingshai bad ïa ka jingdum ; nga wanrah ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el : for it is the king s chapel , and it is the king s court .
translation.kha: Wat ïathuhlypa shuh hangne ha Bethel . Kane ka dei ka jaka mane Blei jong u syiem , ka Templ jong ka hima .

translation.en: And David laid up these words in his heart , and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath .
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki la shon jur ha u Dabid , bad u sheptieng shikatdei eh ïa u syiem Akhish .

translation.en: And he said , Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant ? for what have I done ? or what evil is in mine hand ?
translation.kha: Nangta u ong shuh shuh ,  Balei keiñ , syiem kynrad , ba phi thwet ïa u shakri jong phi ? Nga la leh aïu keiñ ? Ka kam palat aïu nga la leh ?

translation.en: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves , and had beaten the graven images into powder , and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel , he returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha baroh kawei ka ri jong ka Hima bashatei u pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ki durblei jong ka Asherah , u pynlwet ïa ki bleithaw kum ki pui pui , bad pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa baroh ki duwan jingiwbih . Nangta u leit phai sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor , and their hosts with them , about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east : for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword .
translation.kha: U Sebah bad u Salmunna ki don ha Karkor lem bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki . Na ka kynhun shipai baroh jong ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , tang kumba khatsan hajar ngut ki dang sah ; shi lakh arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ki la shah pynïap .

translation.en: Who was delivered for our offences , and was raised again for our justification .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , la aiti ïa u ban ïap , bad ïa u la pynmihpat khnang ban pynlong ka hok ïa ngi bad U Blei .

translation.en: And Nathan said , My lord , O king , hast thou said , Adonijah shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ?
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , Hato phi la dep pynbna ba u Adonijah un long syiem hadien jong phi ?

translation.en: And Saul s servants spake those words in the ears of David . And David said , Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king s son in law , seeing that I am a poor man , and lightly esteemed ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kane , bad u jubab ,  Ka long ka burom kaba khraw ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem , kaba khraw than ïa uba kum ma nga uba duk bad u bymdondor ei ei .

translation.en: And I fell unto the ground , and heard a voice saying unto me ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
translation.kha: Nga la hap sha madan bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha nga , ‘ Saul , Saul ! Balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?’

translation.en: When the dust groweth into hardness , and the clods cleave fast together ?
translation.kha: u slap uba pyneh ïa u pui pui sha ki  dew tylli ?

translation.en: And he set the priests in their charges , and encouraged them to the service of the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U aiti ha ki lyngdoh ïa ki kamram kiba ki dei ban trei ha ka Templ bad u pynshlur ïa ki ban da lehbha ïa ki .

translation.en: And Joshua went up from Eglon , and all Israel with him , unto Hebron  ; and they fought against it :
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit kiew na Eglon sha ki lum ka Hebron , ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad ki la kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: I know that , whatsoever God doeth , it shall be for ever : nothing can be put to it , nor any thing taken from it : and God doeth it , that men should fear before him .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba kaei kaei kaba U Blei u leh kan neh junom . Phim lah ban bynrap ei ei ha ka lane shim noh ïa kano kano na ka . Bad kawei kaba U Blei u leh ka long ban pynlong ïa ngi ban ïeng ha ka jingburom ïa u .

translation.en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people , and they shall trust in the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ieh hangta ïa ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kiba duk , ki ban wan sha nga na ka bynta ka jingïarap .

translation.en: They made shoulderpieces for it , to couple it together : by the two edges was it coupled together .
translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki jingteh tyrpeng bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ka ephod na baroh arliang , khnang ba lah ban teh skhem ïa ka .

translation.en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal  ; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus .
translation.kha: To kner ïa la ka kti ban pynkhiah , bad ai ba ki kamphylla bad ki kambah yn leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu u Shakri bakhuid jong me .

translation.en: Again , when I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; if he turn from his sin , and do that which is lawful and right  ;
translation.kha: Nga lah ban maham ïa u briew uba sniew ba u dei ban ïap , hynrei lada u sangeh na kaba leh pop bad leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha —

translation.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters , abundant in treasures , thine end is come , and the measure of thy covetousness .
translation.kha: Kata ka ri ka don shibun ki wah bad ka spah kyrhai , hynrei ka por jong ka , ka la kut , bad ïa u ksai jingim jong ka , la pyndkut .

translation.en: I am coming .
translation.kha: Nga lah wan .

translation.en: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same , and made them other five talents .
translation.kha: U shakri uba la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la leit shisyndon bad u la khaïi ïa la ka pisa bad u la ïohnong sa san hajar .

translation.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the  Lord   ; but they shall not find him  ; he hath withdrawn himself from them .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jong ki ban ai kum ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  hynrei kane kan ym wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa ki . Kin ym shem ïa u namar u la iehnoh ïa ki .

translation.en: And Mary abode with her about three months , and returned to her own house .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la sah bad ka Elisabeth kumba lai bnai bad nangta ka la leit pat sha ïing .

translation.en: Wisdom is the principal thing  ; therefore get wisdom : and with all thy getting get understanding .
translation.kha: Kaba ïoh ïa ka jingstad ka long kaei kaei kaba donkam tam ba phi dei ban leh . Nalor kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ïoh , to ïoh ruh ïa ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence , which hath great recompence of reward .
translation.kha: To wat duh noh ïa la ka jingshlur , te , namar ka wallam bad ka , ïa ka bainong kaba khraw .

translation.en: So Rab–shakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ka Assyria u ïoh jingtip ba u patsha u la mih na Lakhish bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Libnah kaba don marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban twad jingmut na u .

translation.en: He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kheiñ kor bha ïa kano kano ka sngi , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , uno uno u ban bam ïa kaei kaei , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , namar u ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kata ka jingbam . Uno uno uba kyntait ban bam ïa kino kino ki jingbam , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai bad u ainguh sha U Blei .

translation.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .
translation.kha: Ka jingthoh jong ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka long :  U Syiem jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and to the residue of the people , saying ,
translation.kha: U la ong ïa u Haggai ban kren ha u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah , ha u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ha ki paidbah , bad ban ong ha ki ,

translation.en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight  ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad katno ka ksiar nylla ha kaba shna ïa ka duwan ha kaba yn thang jingiwbih , bad ha kaba shna ïa ka kali ïapom na ka bynta ki Kherub kiba pyiar la ki thapniang halor Ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai .

translation.en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod , and Abiezer , and Mahalah .
translation.kha: Ka Hammolekheth , ka para u Gilead , ka ïoh lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ishod , u Abieser , bad u Mahlah .

translation.en: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him : he hath done that which is lawful and right  ; he shall surely live .
translation.kha: Ngan map noh ïa ki pop ba u la leh , bad un im namar ba u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .

translation.en: Behold , when it was whole , it was meet for no work : how much less shall it be meet yet for any work , when the fire hath devoured it , and it is burned ?
translation.kha: ka la long ka bymmyntoi wat ha shuwa ba yn thang ïa ka . Mynta ba ka ding ka la thang ïa ka bad pynkylla rnga ïa ka , ka la nang long shuh shuh ka bymmyntoi ei ei .

translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  , O ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ; ïaroh ïa ka burom bad ka jingkhlaiñbor jong u .

translation.en: For to this end Christ both died , and rose , and revived , that he might be Lord both of the dead and living .
translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la ïap bad u la mihpat sha ka jingim khnang ban long U Trai jong kiba im bad jong kiba ïap .

translation.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit  ; and he cried out ,
translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por uwei u briew uba don u mynsiem bymkhuid u la wan rung hapoh ka synagog bad u la lynñiar ,
