translation.en: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , of needlework  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki shna ka pyrda kaba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad ha kaba la suh pynpur itynnat bha .

translation.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :
translation.kha: Phi la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga baroh , bad phim mon ba ngan pynbeit ïa phi .

translation.en: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him ? and what his soul desireth , even that he doeth .
translation.kha: U long u bym ju kylla . Ym don ba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u lane pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ban leh .

translation.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest :
translation.kha: Nalor katei , ka don ruh ka jingsmai ka jong U Blei . Ym shym la don ka jingsmai kaba kum kata haba la pynlong lyngdoh ïa kita kiwei pat .

translation.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me : as my strength was then , even so is my strength now , for war , both to go out , and to come in .
translation.kha: Khmih sha nga ! nga la dap phraphew san snem ka rta bad nga dang shait dang khlaiñ mynta kumba nga la long mynba u Moses u la phah ïa nga . Nga dang shait dang khlaiñ bha ban leit ïaleh thma ne na ka bynta kano kano .

translation.en: But if thine heart turn away , so that thou wilt not hear , but shalt be drawn away , and worship other gods , and serve them  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh bad phi kyntait ban shahshkor , bad phi shah ïalam bakla ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,

translation.en: And said , This fellow said , I am able to destroy the temple of God , and to build it in three days .
translation.kha: Khatduh ar ngut ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong ,  Une u briew u la ong , ‘ Nga lah ban pynjot ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bad ha ki lai sngi ngan tei pat ïa ka .’

translation.en: Multitudes , multitudes in the valley of decision : for the day of the  Lord  is near in the valley of decision .
translation.kha: Da ki hajar hajar ki don ha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Dei hangta ba ka Sngi jong U  Trai  shen kan wan .

translation.en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day , which were all valiant men  ; because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers .
translation.kha: Namar ba u syiem Ahas u la leh pop , U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la shah ïa u syiem ka Syria ban jop ïa u bad ban ring koidi bun bah na ki Judia sha Damaskos . U  Trai  u la shah ruh ïa u Pekah u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Remalaïah , ban jop ïa u Ahas bad pynïap shi lakh arphew hajar ki shipai Judia kiba shlur bha tang hapoh shi sngi . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki u la shah ïa kane ban jia , namar ki briew ka Judah ki la kyntait noh ïa u .

translation.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha u tip ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , hynrei ki briew basniew kim lah sngewthuh kum ïa kita kiei kiei .

translation.en: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house  ; and it fell not : for it was founded upon a rock .
translation.kha: U slap u la hap , ki wah ki la shlei , bad ka lyer ka la beh jur pyrshah ïa kata ka ïing . Hynrei kam shym la khyllem , namar la tei ïa ka halor u mawsiang .

translation.en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband , so have ye dealt treacherously with me , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei kum ka tnga ka bymïaineh , pham shym la ïaineh ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: He maketh my feet like hinds  feet : and setteth me upon my high places .
translation.kha: U pynstet ïa ki kjat jong nga kum ka skei ; u sumar ïa nga ha ki lumbah .

translation.en: A voice was heard upon the high places , weeping and supplications of the children of Israel : for they have perverted their way , and they have forgotten the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa halor ki kliar lum : ki dei ki paid Israel kiba ïam bad ïasaid , namar ba ki la im ka jingim ba-dap da ka pop bad ba ki la klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Again , he sent other servants more than the first : and they did unto them likewise .
translation.kha: Sa shisien uta u briew u la phah biang ïa kiwei pat ki mraw , kham bun ïa kaba nyngkong , bad ki nongshimwai ki la leh ïa ki ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner , and became one troop , and stood on the top of an hill .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïalumlang sa shisien sawdong ïa u Abner bad ki la ïeng ha kliar uwei u lum .

translation.en: For ye have need of patience , that , after ye have done the will of God , ye might receive the promise .
translation.kha: Phi donkam ban long kiba ïaishah , khnang ba phi lah ban leh ïa ka mon U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa kata kaba u kular .

translation.en: Whose hatred is covered by deceit , his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation .
translation.kha: U lah ban buhrieh arsap ïa la ka jingisih , hynrei baroh kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bymman ba u leh .

translation.en: And you , that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works , yet now hath he reconciled
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por phi la long jngai eh na U Blei bad phi la long ki nongshun jong u namar jong kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba phi la leh bad pyrkhat .

translation.en: He saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ? go and see .  And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Katno phi don kpu ? Khie leit bad khmih .  Haba ki la shem , ki la ïathuh ïa u ,  San tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha ruh .

translation.en: The life is more than meat , and the body is more than raiment .
translation.kha: Ka jingim ka long kaba donkam kham bun shah ban ïa ka jingbam , bad ka met ka long kaba donkam kham bun shah ban ïa ki jaiñphong .

translation.en: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow , nor her that is put away : but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel , or a widow that had a priest before .
translation.kha: Uno uno u lyngdoh um lah ban shongkurim ïa ka briew ba la iehnoh tnga ; un shongkurim tang ïa ka theisotti Israel lane ïa ka riewkynthei jong uwei pat u lyngdoh .

translation.en: And call Jesse to the sacrifice , and I will shew thee what thou shalt do : and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee .
translation.kha: Khot sngewbha ïa u Jesse sha kata ka jingkñia , bad ngan sa ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ba men leh . Men sa pynsleh kum u syiem ïa u briew uba ngan ïathuh ha me .

translation.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , beside the mischief that Hadad did : and he abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .
translation.kha: U dei u nongshun jong ki Israel baroh shi lynter jingim u Solomon .

translation.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days , according unto the days that ye abode there .
translation.kha: Kumta , hadien ba ngi la sah slem ha Kadesh ,

translation.en: With a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: da ka kti bakhlaiñ jong u , ka ksang ti badonbor jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: And when they came again to him , ( for he tarried at Jericho , ) he said unto them , Did I not say unto you , Go not ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit phai sha u Elisha , uba dang ap ïa ki ha Jerikho , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym leit ?

translation.en: And as David came to Ornan , Ornan looked and saw David , and went out of the threshingfloor , and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground .
translation.kha: U Araunah mar ïa-ïohi ba u Syiem Dabid u wan , u la iehnoh ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad u dem rit , bad la ka khlieh kaba kynduh ha madan .

translation.en: When it shall hail , coming down on the forest  ; and the city shall be low in a low place .
translation.kha: ( Hynrei u phria un hap ha ki khlaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn pynjot . )

translation.en: And , behold , one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips : then I opened my mouth , and spake , and said unto him that stood before me , O my lord , by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me , and I have retained no strength .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel , uba syriem ïa u briew , u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga . Nga la ong ha u ,  Ko rangbah , kane ka jingïohipaw ka pyntlot ïa nga haduh katta katta ba ngam lah ban sangeh ban khynñiuh .

translation.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga la ïambriew haduh lai taïew .

translation.en: My son , walk not thou in the way with them  ; refrain thy foot from their path :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat ïashang bad ki briew kiba kum kita . Kiar na ki .

translation.en: For if they which are of the law be heirs , faith is made void , and the promise made of none effect :
translation.kha: Naba lada kaei kaba U Blei u kular ban ai ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , te ka jingngeit u briew kam don jingmut bad ka jingkular U Blei kam dondor ei ei .

translation.en: Both thy bondmen , and thy bondmaids , which thou shalt have , shall be of the heathen that are round about you  ; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids .
translation.kha: Lada phi donkam ïa ki mraw , phi lah ban thied na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi .

translation.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike .
translation.kha: Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka long syriem kum ka um kaba jaw jrop shi jrop ha ka sngi ba slap .

translation.en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham , and of his oath unto Isaac  ;
translation.kha: ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad u Abraham , ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong bad u Isaak .

translation.en: If brethren dwell together , and one of them die , and have no child , the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger : her husband s brother shall go in unto her , and take her to him to wife , and perform the duty of an husband s brother unto her .
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut shi para ki ïashong lang ha kajuh ka jaka bad uwei na ki u ïap khlem da ïoh khun shynrang , ka tnga jong uta uba ïap kam dei ban shongkurim ïa uno uno u bym dei na ka ïing ka sem jong u ; u para jong uta uba la ïap u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them  ; and the people shall be gathered against them , when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows .
translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa kine ki briew bymman bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki jaitbynriew kin ïalumlang pyrshah ïa ki , bad yn pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop kiba bun ki jong ki .

translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder , which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old .
translation.kha: Kumta u la jubab ,  Kane ka mut , te , ba uwei pa uwei u nonghikai Aiñ uba long u synran hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long kum u trai jong ka ïing uba la sei shabar ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai bad kiba rim napoh ka kamra kynshew jong u .

translation.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth : and unto them were sons born after the flood .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth , ki khun shynrang jong u Noah . Kine lai ngut ki la ïoh khun shynrang hadien kata ka jingshlei um .

translation.en: And David enquired at the  Lord  , saying , Shall I pursue after this troop ? shall I overtake them ? And he answered him , Pursue : for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Ngan leit beh ne em ïa kine ki nonglute ? Ngan lap ne em ïa ki ?  U jubab ,  Khie leit beh ïa ki ; men lap ïa ki , bad men pyllait ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .

translation.en: Whom , though I were righteous , yet would I not answer , but I would make supplication to my judge .
translation.kha: Wat la nga long uba lui lui , baroh kaba nga lah ban leh ka long tang ban kyrpad ïa ki jingisynei U Blei u nongbishar jong nga .

translation.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah , and with Abiathar the priest : and they following Adonijah helped him .
translation.kha: U la ïakren bad u Joab ( uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Seruïah ) bad u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad ki la ïamynjur ban kyrshan ïa ka jingthmu jong u .

translation.en: But Philip was found at Azotus : and passing through he preached in all the cities , till he came to Caesarea .
translation.kha: U Philip u shem ïa lade ha Asotos ; u la nang leit sha Kaisaria , bad ha lynti u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong .

translation.en: I said in the cutting off of my days , I shall go to the gates of the grave : I am deprived of the residue of my years .
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ha ka jingdap pura ka jingim , nga la leit sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ban ym lah ban pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .

translation.en: And I came to Jerusalem , and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah , in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God .
translation.kha: bad nga wan phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta nga la kyndit ban shem ba u Eliashib u shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field , and as plantings of a vineyard : and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley , and I will discover the foundations thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ka Samaria ka kynton ñiut ha rudnong , ka jaka ban thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ . Ngan theh noh ïa ka jakhlia jong ka nongbah sha ka jaka them , bad ngan pynpaw shabar tang ïa ki maw nongrim jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: One way is by observing the things he has created and thinking deeply about what they tell us .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki lad ka long da kaba peit bniah ïa ki jingthaw kiba u la thaw bad ban pyrkhat jylliew ïa kaei kaba ki , ki ïathuh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And , behold , there was a man in Jerusalem , whose name was Simeon  ; and the same man was just and devout , waiting for the consolation of Israel : and the Holy Ghost was upon him .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba shong basah ha Jerusalem uba kyrteng u Simeon . U la long u briew uba bha , uba sheptieng ïa U Blei bad uba ïai ap na ka bynta ki Israel ban ïoh jingpynim .

translation.en: And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings , and commanded Judah to serve the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: U tei pynbha ïa ka duwan ha kaba ïa U  Trai  la mane , bad u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki jingainguh thang ha ka . U hukum ïa ki paid Judah baroh ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of ? for I bear you record , that , if it had been possible , ye would have plucked out your own eyes , and have given them to me .
translation.kha: Haei ken kata ka jingkyrkhu ka ba phi la ong ? Nga hi nga lah ban ong ba phin da la khlaw noh ïa la ki jong ki khmat , lada phi lah , bad ban ai noh ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Paul u la ïoh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw , ngi la khreh ban leit sha Makedonia , namar ngi la rai ba U Blei u la khot ïa ngi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki briew hangta .

translation.en: They took therefore two chariot horses  ; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians , saying , Go and see .
translation.kha: Ki jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah , bad u syiem u phah ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki kali ïapom lem bad ki jingbthah ban leit bad wad jingtip ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria .

translation.en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ ;
translation.kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to ïai ainguh borabor na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh sha U Blei uba U Kpa .

translation.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow , and all my members are as a shadow .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewsih jong nga ka la jan pynmatlah ïa nga ; ki kti bad ki kjat jong nga ki la rit kum ki syrngiew .

translation.en: For they will turn away thy son from following me , that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and destroy thee suddenly .
translation.kha: ïoh kin phai dien noh na U  Trai  ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Lada jia kumta , U  Trai  un bitar lep ïa phi bad un pynjot ïa phi shisyndon .

translation.en: For thy Maker is thine husband  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name  ; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel  ; The God of the whole earth shall he be called .
translation.kha: U Nongthaw jong pha un long kum u tnga ïa pha — U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u . U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel un pynim ïa pha — u long u nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: The king of Libnah , one  ; the king of Adullam , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Libnah , ka Adullam ,

translation.en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool , which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda , having five porches .
translation.kha: Hajan ka Khyrdop Langbrot ha Jerusalem ka la don ka pungsum kaba don san tylli ki baranda ; ha ka ktien Hebru la khot ïa ka ,  ka Bethesda .

translation.en: They arose , all the valiant men , and took away the body of Saul , and the bodies of his sons , and brought them to Jabesh , and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .
translation.kha: ki rangbah bashlur tam ki leit bad shim ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad jong ki khun jong u , bad ki wanrah ïa ki sha Jabesh . Ki tep ïa ki hangta hapoh u dieng Sning , bad ki shahjingit hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them : but they understood not .
translation.kha: ( U la pyrkhat ba ki briew jong u kin shemphang ba U Blei un sa pyndonkam ïa u ban pyllaitluid ïa ki , hynrei kim shym shemphang . )

translation.en: And if a house be divided against itself , that house cannot stand .
translation.kha: Lada ka longïing ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka longïing kan kyllon noh .

translation.en: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians , saying , Master , we know that thou art true , and teachest the way of God in truth , neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la phah sha u katto katne ngut na ki synran jong ki bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka kynhun u Herod .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ngi tip ba me ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew , khlem da khuslai shaphang kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat , namar ba mem pyrkhat ïa ka kyrdan jongno jongno .

translation.en: Be not thou envious against evil men , neither desire to be with them .
translation.kha: Wat bishni ïa ki riewsniew , bad wat pyrshang ban ïalang paralok bad ki .

translation.en: But Jesus turned him about , and when he saw her , he said ,  Daughter , be of good comfort  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And the woman was made whole from that hour .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la ong ,  To long shlur , ko ka khun jong nga ! Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkoit ïa pha .  Ha kata ka khyllipmat ka kynthei ka la koit .

translation.en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship , asleep on a pillow : and they awake him , and say unto him , Master , carest thou not that we perish ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u don ha ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka lieng , u da ïohthiah , ka khlieh jong u ha ka syngkhlieh . Ki synran ki la kyrsiew ïa u bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , hato mem sngewlem ïa ngi ba ngin sa ïap ?

translation.en: Not every one that saith unto me , Lord , Lord , shall enter into the kingdom of heaven  ; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Ym u briew baroh uba khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai’ u ban ïohrung shapoh Ka Hima ki bneng , hynrei tang kito kiba leh ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng u kwah ïa ki ban leh .

translation.en: But be it so , I did not burden you : nevertheless , being crafty , I caught you with guile .
translation.kha: Phin mynjur , namarkata , ba ngam shym la long ka jingbankhia ïa phi . Hynrei don ki ban ong ba nga la long uba sianti , bad riam ïa phi da ki jingshukor .

translation.en: And Moses did so : as the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .
translation.kha: U Moses u leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin , if she pass the flower of her age , and need so require , let him do what he will , he sinneth not : let them marry .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki ar ngut kiba la ïatehktien kiba la rai ba kin ym ïashongkurim : Lada uta u briew u sngew ba um shym leh kaba dei ïa ka theisotti bad lada ki jingkwah brai jong u ki jur haduh katta katta bad u sngew ba u dei ban shongkurim , te ki dei ban ïashongkurim noh , kumba u kwah . Kam don pop ei ei ha kane .

translation.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering thereof , and their drink offerings .
translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw his brother Benjamin , his mother s son , and said , Is this your younger brother , of whom ye spake unto me ? And he said , God be gracious unto thee , my son .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u ïohi ïa u Benjamin u para jong u , u ong ,  Une seh u para khatduh jong phi , uta uba phi la ïathuh ha nga ? U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , khun .

translation.en: But unto the sons of the concubines , which Abraham had , Abraham gave gifts , and sent them away from Isaac his son , while he yet lived , eastward , unto the east country .
translation.kha: hynrei mynba u dang im , u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang ba u la ïoh na kiwei pat ki tnga jong u . Nangta u phah noh ïa kine ki khun shynrang sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi , jngai na u khun jong u , u Isaak .

translation.en: And when he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta , ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba ju long .

translation.en: But we have dwelt in tents , and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .
translation.kha: Ngim ju tei ki ïing ki sem ban shong ban sah — ngi shong ha ki ïingjaiñ — bad ngim don ki bri sohwaiñ la ki jong , ki lyngkha , lane u kew . Ngi la kohnguh tylli ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jonadab u la hukum ïa ngi .

translation.en: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her , then she left speaking unto her .
translation.kha: Haba ka Naomi ka ïohi ba ka Ruth ka la kut jingmut skhem ban leit bad ka , kam shym ong ei ei shuh .

translation.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound : therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Nga la bitar namar ba ki nongïalam ka Judah ki la hiarthma ïa ka Israel bad tuh jaka na ka . Kumta ngan theh noh ka jingpynshitom halor jong ki kum ka jingshlei um .

translation.en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life , and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest , even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: bad ngan ai ïa me ha ki briew ïa kiba me sheptieng , ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa me . Ngan ai ïa me ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ha ki shipai jong u .

translation.en: And many that believed came , and confessed , and shewed their deeds .
translation.kha: Kiba bun na kiba ngeit ki la ïawan , ki da phla ha kaba paw bad ki da pynpaw ïa kaei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength , the joy of their glory , the desire of their eyes , and that whereupon they set their minds , their sons and their daughters ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Mynta , ko khun u briew , ngan shim noh na ki ïa ka Templ bakhraw kaba la long ka jingsarong bad ka jingkmen jong ki , kaba ki sngewtynnat ban khmih bad ban leit jngoh . Bad ngan shim noh ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .

translation.en: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David , and gave it thee : and yet thou hast not been as my servant David , who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do that only which was right in mine eyes  ;
translation.kha: Nga la shim noh ïa ka hima na kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid bad nga la ai ïa ka ha me . Hynrei mem shym long kum u Dabid u shakri jong nga , uba bud tylli ïa nga , uba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , bad uba leh ïa kaba dei ha khmat jong nga .

translation.en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning , and bread and flesh in the evening  ; and he drank of the brook .
translation.kha: U la dih um na ka wahduid bad ki tyngab ki wanrah kpu bad wanrah doh ïa u man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet .

translation.en: Whom they set before the apostles : and when they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ka la aiti ïa ki ha ki apostol , kiba la duwai bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki .

translation.en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course , and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds , and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons , with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki Israel ban ïalumlang ha Jerusalem . Kumta baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïaid ïa ka kam jong ka Hima , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , ki nongpeit ïa ki jingdon jingem bad ki jingri kiba dei jong u syiem bad ki khun shynrang jong u — Shisha ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki shipai kiba lamkhmat , bad ki rangbah badonkam — ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it , and on the morrow : and if ought remain until the third day , it shall be burnt in the fire .
translation.kha: Ïa ka doh kñia dei ban bam ha kajuh ka sngi ba la pynïap ïa uta u mrad lane ha ka sngi kaba bud . Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai dei ban thang noh ,

translation.en: For , lo , as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears , the babe leaped in my womb for joy .
translation.kha: Naba tang mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhublei jong pha , i khunlung hapoh jong nga i la kynthih da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , that the tabernacle was reared up .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba ar hadien ba ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , la pynïeng ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: Unto an hundred talents of silver , and to an hundred measures of wheat , and to an hundred baths of wine , and to an hundred baths of oil , and salt without prescribing how much .
translation.kha: haduh lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa , shiphew hajar kilo u kew , ar hajar litar ka waiñ , ar hajar litar ka umphniang Olib , bad katba donkam ka mluh .

translation.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing : but the honour of kings is to search out a matter .
translation.kha: Ngi burom ïa U Blei namar kaei kaba u la buhrieh ; ngi burom ïa ki syiem ïa kaei kaba ki batai .

translation.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him , that he seeth not  ; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven .
translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat ki lyoh barben kin pynlong ba un ym lah ban ïohi , katba u ïaid halor ka sahit bneng .

translation.en: The sons of Gershon  ; Libni , and Shimei , according to their families .
translation.kha: U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Libni bad u Shimei , bad ki ruh ki don bun ki khun ki ksiew .

translation.en: O daughter of Babylon , who art to be destroyed  ; happy shall he be , that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us .
translation.kha: Ko ka Babilon , yn sa pynjot ïa pha . Suk uta u briew uba siew kylliang ïa pha na ka bynta kaei kaba pha la leh ïa ngi —

translation.en: They that come after him shall be astonished at his day , as they that went before were affrighted .
translation.kha: Na mihngi sha sepngi , baroh kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kupar jong u ki suhjer ka met bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And they possessed his land , and the land of Og king of Bashan , two kings of the Amorites , which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;
translation.kha: Ki la ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong u bad ïa ka ri u Og u syiem Bashan , uwei pat u syiem Amor uba shong sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof , and put it on the four horns of it , and on the four corners of the settle , and upon the border round about : thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it .
translation.kha: Me dei ban shim katto katne na ka snam jong u bad ban buh ïa ka ha ki reng ha ki saw tylli ki dong kiba halor ha ka duwan , bad ha ki dong jong ka bynta ba hapdeng jong ka duwan , bad ha baroh sawdong jong ki tduh . Ha kane ka rukom men pynkhuid ïa ka duwan bad pynkyntang ïa ka .

translation.en: When Judah saw her , he thought her to be an harlot  ; because she had covered her face .
translation.kha: Haba u Judah u ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrkhat ba ka dei ka nuti , namar ba ka la kah ïa la ka durkhmat .

translation.en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing , that ye may abound in hope , through the power of the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingkyrmen , un pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen baroh bad ka jingsuk kaba long da ka jingngeit jong phi ha u , khnang ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan ïai san da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: And their coast was from Aroer , that is on the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain by Medeba  ;
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them bad kynthup ïa ka jaka padun baroh sawdong ka Medeba .

translation.en: Be not overcome of evil , but overcome evil with good .
translation.kha: To wat ai ba ka jingsniew kan jop ïa phi ; pynban , to jop ïa kaba sniew da kaba bha .

translation.en: And they answered , Thy servant our father is in good health , he is yet alive . And they bowed down their heads , and made obeisance .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  I pa jong ngi , u shakri barit jong phi , i dang im bad i shait i khlaiñ .  Bad ki la dem khohsiew bad nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: Then brought he me into the outward court , and , lo , there were chambers , and a pavement made for the court round about : thirty chambers were upon the pavement .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop sha ka phyllaw bashabar . La don laiphew tylli ki kamra ba la tei ha syndah ka kynroh bashabar bad ha khmat jong ki , la don ka jaka ba la siang maw kaba poi sawdong ka phyllaw .

translation.en: I have waited for thy salvation , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , nga ap ïa ka jingpyllait im jong me .

translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it  ;
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym kren shaphang kata hano hano ruh ; hynrei katba u nang hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh , katta ki nang ïathuh .

translation.en: Hide them in the dust together  ; and bind their faces in secret .
translation.kha: Tep ïa ki baroh hapoh ka khyndew ; teh ïa ki ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: Butter and honey shall he eat , that he may know to refuse the evil , and choose the good .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u la rangbah bha ban pynlong ïa la ki jingkut jingmut , ki briew kin dih dud bad bam ngap .

translation.en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus , This man might have been set at liberty , if he had not appealed unto Caesar .
translation.kha: Bad u Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos ,  Ïa une u briew la dei ban pyllait noh lymda u la lah apil sha u Patsha .

translation.en: But to him that worketh not , but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly , his faith is counted for righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba shaniah ha ka jingngeit jong u , ym ha ki kam jong u , bad uba ngeit ha U Blei uba pynbna ïa uba la rem , ban long uba lui lui , ka long ka jingngeit jong u ba U Blei u pdiang khnang ban pynlong hok ïa uta u briew bad u hi .

translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , As for Sarai thy wife , thou shalt not call her name Sarai , but Sarah shall her name be .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Men ym khot shuh ïa ka tnga jong me — ka Sarai ; naduh mynta ka kyrteng jong ka kan long noh — ka Sarah .

translation.en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars , and burned men s bones upon them , and returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U pynïap lut ïa ki lyngdoh nongmane blei thala halor ki duwan ba ki shakri , bad u thang ïa ki shyieng briew ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan . Nangta u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool : but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof , neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago .
translation.kha: Khnang ban pynlang ïa ka um , phi la shna ka jaka pynlang um hapoh jong ka nongbah ban bat ïa ka um kaba tuid na ka pung kaba rim . Hynrei phim shym la pynshahshkor ïa U Blei , uba la thmu ïa kane baroh la slem bah bad uba la pynurlong ïa ka .

translation.en: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , wat ki samla shynrang bad kynthei kiba koit bakhiah kin kyllon na ka jingsliang .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Oh my Lord , wherewith shall I save Israel ? behold , my family is poor in Manasseh , and I am the least in my father s house .
translation.kha: U Gideon u jubab ,  Hynrei  Trai  , kumno ngan lah ban pyllait ïa ki Israel ? Ka kur jong nga ka long kaba tlot tam hapoh ka jait Manasseh , bad nga long uba rit tam na ki dkhot ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .
translation.kha: bad thang ïa ki blei — ki bym long da shisha ki blei , tang ki dur da ka dieng bad u maw ba la thaw da ki kti ki briew .

translation.en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand , wherewith thou shalt do signs .
translation.kha: Shim ïa une u diengduh bad me , namar da u men sa leh ïa ki kambah .

translation.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner , whomsoever they desired .
translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u Pilat kumba long ka rukom u ju pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi uba ki briew ki kwah .

translation.en: And every wise hearted among you shall come , and make all that the  Lord  hath commanded  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki nongtrei kiba tbit napdeng jong phi ki dei ban ïawan shna ïa kita baroh ïa kiba U  Trai  u la hukum :

translation.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver , but also of wood and of earth ; and some to honour , and some to dishonour .
translation.kha: Ha ka ïing kaba heh don ki khiew kiba bun jait : Don na ki ïa kiba la thaw da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , kiwei pat da ka dieng bad ka dewbyrtha ; don na ki na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam kyrpang , kiwei pat ban pyndonkam man ka por .

translation.en: For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïadei bad ka Hukum , la kumno kumno nga la ïap — la pynïap da ka Hukum hi — khnang ba nga lah ban im na ka bynta U Blei . La pynïap ïa nga lem bad U Khrist ha ka diengphna jong u ,

translation.en: But the land , whither ye go to possess it , is a land of hills and valleys , and drinketh water of the rain of heaven :
translation.kha: hynrei kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung ka dei ka ri lum bad ri them , kaba ïoh um na u slap .

translation.en: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes , and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres : because the riches that he hath gotten are perished .
translation.kha: Te ka dohnud jong nga ka ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka Moab bad na ka bynta ki briew ka Kir Heres , kumba mano re ba tem ïa ka jingrwai ïapbriew ha ka tangmuri , namar baroh kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong ki kim don shuh .

translation.en: And he that curseth his father , or his mother , shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: But now we are delivered from the law , that being dead wherein we were held ; that we should serve in newness of spirit , and not in the oldness of the letter .
translation.kha: Mynta pat , ngi la lait na ka Hukum , namar ngi la ïap noh ïa kata kaba shisien ka la khum ïa ngi kum ki koidi . Ngim shakri shuh ha ka rukom barim jong ka hukum ba la thoh , hynrei ha ka rukom bathymmai jong U Mynsiem .

translation.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .
translation.kha: To ïaleh shitom ban pynneh ïa ka jinglong shi tylli ïa kaba U Mynsiem u ai lyngba ka jingsuk kaba tehsong lang ïa phi .

translation.en: For his letters , say they , are weighty and powerful ; but his bodily presence is weak , and his speech contemptible .
translation.kha: Don u ban ong ,  Ki shithi u Paul ki long kiba pyrkhing bad kiba khia , hynrei haba u don bad ngi markhmat , u long uba tlot , bad ki ktien jong u kim long ei ei!

translation.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel  ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .
translation.kha: U Syiem Solomon u la jied laiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah kum ki nongtrei ba shah pynbor na kylleng ka ri Israel ,

translation.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger , and shall burn unto the lowest hell , and shall consume the earth with her increase , and set on fire the foundations of the mountains .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong nga kan meh lep kum ka ding , bad kan thang duh katba don ha sla pyrthei . Kan pur de shaduh ñiamra , bad kan thang ïa ki tynrai jong ki lumbah .

translation.en: Which say to the seers , See not  ; and to the prophets , Prophesy not unto us right things , speak unto us smooth things , prophesy deceits :
translation.kha: Ki ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban sngap jar . Ki ong ,  Wat kren ha ngi shaphang kaei kaba dei . Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi kwah ban ïohsngew . Ai ba ki jingïohi rngai jong ngi kin sah bad ngi .

translation.en: And build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God upon the top of this rock , in the ordered place , and take the second bullock , and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down .
translation.kha: Tei ka duwan kaba la shna bha ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong me ha kliar kane ka kynton . Nangta shim ïa u masi kyrtong uba ar bad thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingainguh , da kaba pyndonkam diengthang da ki dak jong ka Asherah ïa kaba me la pynkhyllem .

translation.en: In those days came John the Baptist , preaching in the wilderness of Judaea ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Ïoannis Nongpynbaptis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap jong ka Judia bad u la sdang ban ïalap .

translation.en: And he sought Ahaziah : and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , ) and brought him to Jehu : and when they had slain him , they buried him : Because , said they , he is the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the  Lord  with all his heart . So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom .
translation.kha: La pynlong ka jingleit wad bniah ïa u Ahasaïah , bad la shem ïa u ba u rieh ha Samaria . Ki la leit lam ïa u sha u Jehu bad pynïap ïa u . Hynrei ki la tep ïa ka met jong u naba ki burom ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat u kparad jong u , uba la leh kat kaba u lah ban shakri ïa U  Trai . Ym don uno uno u dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Ahasaïah uba dang sah uba lah ban synshar ïa ka hima .

translation.en: Be honest .
translation.kha: Iathuh hok .

translation.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance , lest they bear sin for it , and die therefore , if they profane it : I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh baroh , namar kata , ki dei ban sumar ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba nga la ai . Lym kumta kin kit hi ïa la ka pop bad kin ïap , namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba kyntang . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa ki .

translation.en: And Manoah said unto his wife , We shall surely die , because we have seen God .
translation.kha: U Manoah u ong ha la ka tnga ,  Ngin sa ïap shisha , namar ba ngi la ïohi ïa U Blei !

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u sangeh na kaba tei kut ïa ka Ramah bad iehnoh ïa ka kam .

translation.en: And they said one to another , Did not our heart burn within us , while he talked with us by the way , and while he opened to us the scriptures ?
translation.kha: Ki la ong para ma ki ,  Hato kam shym la long kum ka ding kaba klang hapoh jong ngi mynba u la kren ha ngi ha ka lynti bad batai ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ha ngi ?

translation.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow : for every purpose of the  Lord  shall be performed against Babylon , to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad ka khynñiuh namar ba U  Trai  u pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong u ban pynlong ïa ka Babilonia ka ri shyiap , ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah .

translation.en: And his fellow answered and said , This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel : for into his hand hath God delivered Midian , and all the host .
translation.kha: U paralok jong u , u phai ktien ,  Ka dei ka waitlam jong u nong Israel , u Gideon u khun jong u Joash ! Kam mut da kumwei pat ! U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki Midian bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ngi baroh .

translation.en: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings , and eat it  ; but the  Lord  accepteth them not  ; now will he remember their iniquity , and visit their sins : they shall return to Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki ai ïa ki jingkñia sha nga bad ki bam ïa ka doh kñia . Hynrei ma nga U Trai , ngam sngewbha ïa ki , bad mynta ngan kynmaw ïa ki pop jong ki bad pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kata ; ngan phah biang ïa ki sha Ijipt .

translation.en: Ebed–melech went forth out of the king s house , and spake to the king , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit shata bad ong ïa u syiem .

translation.en: They have corrupted themselves , their spot is not the spot of his children : they are a perverse and crooked generation .
translation.kha: Pynban phi , phi long kiba ïaid kdor , ki bym dei hok ban long ki briew jong u , ka jaitbynriew kaba pop bad kaba shukor .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt : and there shall nothing die of all that is the children s of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïapher ïa ki jingri jong ki Israel na ki jong ki nong Ijipt , bad kumta yn ym don wat kawei ruh ka jingri ki Israel ka ban ïap noh .

translation.en: And they went out into the fields , and gathered their vineyards , and trode the grapes , and made merry , and went into the house of their god , and did eat and drink , and cursed Abimelech .
translation.kha: Baroh ki ïaleit sha la ki bri sohwaiñ bad kheit ïa ki sohwaiñ , ki shna waiñ na ki , bad ki pynlong ka jingïaleh kmen . Ki leit sha ka templ jong u blei jong ki , ha kaba ki la ïabam bad ïadih bad ki krenbeiñ ïa u Abimelekh .

translation.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel , that offered themselves willingly among the people . Bless ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka long bad ki nongai hukum jong ki Israel , Lem bad u paidbah uba tyrwa mon sngewbha da kaba kmen . Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,
translation.kha: U la poi kham jan sha ka nongbah , bad haba u la ïohi ïa ka , u la ïam na ka bynta jong ka , u da ong ,

translation.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa went before them . And Joab s garment that he had put on was girded unto him , and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof  ; and as he went forth it fell out .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u mawsiang bah ha Gibeon , u Amasa u la ïakynduh ïa ki . U Joab u la phong ka jaiñ ïaleh thma , bad ka waitlam hapoh ka jingsop jong ka ïa kaba la teh pynskhem ha u panpoh jong u . Katba u wan sha khmat ka waitlam ka la hap .

translation.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing , he sought to slay Moses . But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh , and dwelt in the land of Midian : and he sat down by a well .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharaoh u ïohsngew ïa kata , u pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u Moses ; hynrei u Moses u la phet ïap , bad u leit shong noh ha ri Midian .

translation.en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart , both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , so that the wrath of the  Lord  came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah .
translation.kha: Khatduh pat u Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki pynrit ïa lade , bad kumta U  Trai  um shym pynshitom ïa ki briew haduh hadien ka jingïap u Hesekaïah .

translation.en: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth–el , unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning , between Beth–el and Ai  ;
translation.kha: Te u la mihnoh nangta bad u la ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , da kaba leit sha Bethel .

translation.en: Behold , there is a people come out of Egypt , which covereth the face of the earth : come now , curse me them  ; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them , and drive them out .
translation.kha: ba ka jaitbynriew kaba la wan na Ijipt ka la saphriang ha ka ri baroh kawei . U kwah ïa nga ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïaleh pyrshah bad beh noh ïa ki .

translation.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now ;
translation.kha: namar ka rukom kaba phi la ïarap ïa nga ha ka kam jong ka gospel sha kiwei pat naduh ka sngi kaba sdang haduh mynta .

translation.en: His lord said unto him , Well done , good and faithful servant  ; thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .
translation.kha: ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba bha tam , me u shakri uba bha bad uba lah ban shaniah !’ la ong u kynrad jong u . ‘ Me la long uba lah ban shaniah ha kaba pynïaid ïa kaba khyndiat , kumta ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa kaba kham bun . To wan rung shapoh bad ïoh bynta lem na ka jingkmen jong nga !’

translation.en: And seven days were fulfilled , after that the  Lord  had smitten the river .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki la leit hadien ba U  Trai  U la shoh ïa ka wah .

translation.en: Having a diversified writing staff allows us to address multicultural subjects that give our publications an international appeal .
translation.kha: Ka jingdon jong ki nongthoh bapher bapher ka ïarap ïa ngi ban ïoh jingtip ïa ki phang bapher bapher kiba khring ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: Doth not wisdom cry ? and understanding put forth her voice ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingstad ka pyrta jam . Ka jingshemphang ka kren jam .

translation.en: This is the third time I am coming to you . In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established .
translation.kha: Kane ka long mynta ka sien kaba lai ba nga wan jngoh ïa phi . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ïa kano kano ka jingmudui dei ban pynksan da ka jingpynshisha da ki ar ngut ki sakhi ne tam ïa kata .

translation.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him , Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders , but eat bread with unwashen hands ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki synran jong me kim bud ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , hynrei pynban ki bam da ki kti bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ?

translation.en: Don't look at me .
translation.kha: Wat peit ianga .

translation.en: And if the son of peace be there , your peace shall rest upon it : if not , it shall turn to you again .
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba ieit ïa ka jingsuk u shong hangta , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ha u ; lymda kumta , shim noh ïa ka jingkhublei jingsuk .

translation.en: And the man bowed down his head , and worshipped the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u briew u la dem khohsiew bad mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: ( For my father fought for you , and adventured his life far , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian :
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba i pa jong nga i la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi . I la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait im ïa phi na ki Midian .

translation.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things , reserved from the fire : every oblation of theirs , every meat offering of theirs , and every sin offering of theirs , and every trespass offering of theirs , which they shall render unto me , shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons .
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jong me na ki jingainguh kiba kyntang tam ïa ki bym shym la thang ha ka duwan : ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ki jingainguh namar ka jingpalat . Baroh kaba la wanrah ha nga kum ka jingainguh bakyntang ka long ka jong me bad jong ki khun shynrang jong me .

translation.en: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much : and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much .
translation.kha: Uno uno ïa uba lah ban shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba rit un long uba lah ban shaniah ha kiba kham khraw ; uno uno uba leh bymhok ha kiei kiei kiba rit un long u bymhok ha kiba kham khraw .

translation.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them , to overthrow them in the wilderness :
translation.kha: Kumta u la ai ïa ka jingmaham kaba eh ba un pynlong ïa ki ba kin ïap ha ka ri shyiap

translation.en: And Saul said , Let us go down after the Philistines by night , and spoil them until the morning light , and let us not leave a man of them . And they said , Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee . Then said the priest , Let us draw near hither unto God .
translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha ki rangbah jong u ,  Ïa ngin leit hiar bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia mynmiet , ngin lute ïa ki haduh ban da kynjat shai , bad ngin pynïap lut ïa ki baroh .   Leh ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  ki jubab . Hynrei u lyngdoh u ong ,  To ngin da kylli shuwa na U Blei .

translation.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not . Thus the land was desolate after them , that no man passed through nor returned : for they laid the pleasant land desolate .
translation.kha: Kum ka  erïong nga la sar noh ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri nongwei . Ïa kane ka ri babha la iehnoh kynjah ïa ka , khlem don mano mano bashong ba sah hangta .

translation.en: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul , in fifty and two days .
translation.kha: Hadien sanphew ar sngi jong ka jingtrei , ïa ka kynroh baroh kawei la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba arphew san jong u bnai Elul .

translation.en: And humbled not himself before the  Lord  , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself  ; but Amon trespassed more and more .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym kum u kpa jong u , um shym long uba pynrit ïa lade bad phai sha U  Trai  ; u kham long uba pop ban ïa kaba long u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And though they say , The  Lord  liveth  ; surely they swear falsely .
translation.kha: Wat la phi kam ba phi mane ïa U  Trai  , phim shym mut kumba phi ong .

translation.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders , and with a certain orator named Tertullus , who informed the governor against Paul .
translation.kha: Hadien san sngi , u Ananias , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la leit sha Kaisaria lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san bad uwei u riewsaid aiñ uba kyrteng u Tertullos . Ki la wan ha khmat jong u Pheliks bad ki la ai ïa ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u Paul .

translation.en: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel , Go , lie down : and it shall be , if he call thee , that thou shalt say , Speak ,  Lord   ; for thy servant heareth . So Samuel went and lay down in his place .
translation.kha: kumta u ong ha u ,  Khie leit thiah biang , bad lada u khot biang ïa phi sa shisien , sa ong , ‘ To kren , ko  Trai  , u shakri jong me u sngap .’   Kumta u Samuel u leit biang sha la ka jaka thiah .

translation.en: And they told what things were done in the way , and how he was known of them in breaking of bread .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut te ki la batai ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia ha kata ka lynti , bad ba kumno ki la ithuh ïa U Trai mynba u la kdiah ïa u kpu .

translation.en: Which now of these three , thinkest thou , was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves ?
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Ha ka jingsngew jong me , uei na kine lai ngut uba la leh kum u paramarjan ïa u briew uba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki nonglute ?

translation.en: And all the devils besought him , saying , Send us into the swine , that we may enter into them .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Phah ïa ngi ha kitei ki sniang , bad shah ïa ngi ban rung hapoh jong ki .

translation.en: And thou , son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning the Ammonites , and concerning their reproach  ; even say thou , The sword , the sword is drawn : for the slaughter it is furbished , to consume because of the glittering :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki nong Ammon , kiba krenbeiñ ïa ki Israel . Ong ha ki :   ‘ Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynjot ; ïa ka la pynphyrnai ban pynïap , ban thaba kum ka leilieh .

translation.en: Look even out the best and meetest of your master s sons , and set him on his father s throne , and fight for your master s house .
translation.kha: Kumta te , tang mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa kane ka shithi phi dei ban jied ïa uba kynsai tam bad uba bit tam na ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem , pynlong syiem ïa u , bad ïaleh ban ïada ïa u .

translation.en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew ar snem .

translation.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews also weeping which came with her , he groaned in the spirit , and was troubled ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka ba ka ïam , bad u la ïohi kumno ba ki briew kiba la ïadon lem bad ka , ki ruh ki la ïa-ïam ; ka la ktah ïa ka dohnud jong u , bad la pynkhih jur ïa u .

translation.en: And five of them were wise , and five were foolish .
translation.kha: San ngut na ki , ki la long kiba bieit , bad san ngut kiwei pat ki la long kiba stad .

translation.en: They that sanctify themselves , and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst , eating swine s flesh , and the abomination , and the mouse , shall be consumed together , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kaba kut ka la jan ïa kito kiba pynkhuid ïa lade na ka jingmane ba-thala , kiba ïaid paidbah ha ka kynhun sha ki kper bakyntang , bad kito kiba bam ïa ka doh sniang , bad ïa ka doh khnai bad kiwei pat ki jingbam ba-ijli .

translation.en: Only he shall not go in unto the veil , nor come nigh unto the altar , because he hath a blemish  ; that he profane not my sanctuaries : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
translation.kha: hynrei namar ba u don ka jingduna ha ka met , um bit ban wan hajan ka jingkah pyrda kaba kyntang ne ban leit sha jan ka duwan . Um dei ban pynbit tngit ïa kine ki jaka kyntang jong nga ; namar nga long U  Trai  bad nga pynkyntang ïa ki .

translation.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar , and dwelt in the mountain , and his two daughters with him  ; for he feared to dwell in Zoar : and he dwelt in a cave , he and his two daughters .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Lot u sheptieng ban sah ha Soar , ma u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u ki la kynriah sha ki lum , bad ki ïashong ïasah ha kawei ka krem .

translation.en: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood , and leave off righteousness in the earth ,
translation.kha: Phi long kiba la tim , phi kiba pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok bad kiba shukor ïa ki briew ban pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki !

translation.en: And in that day did the Lord  God  of hosts call to weeping , and to mourning , and to baldness , and to girding with sackcloth :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la khot ïa phi ha kato ka por ban ïam bad ïam pangnud , ban khi ïa ki khlieh jong phi bad ban phong ki jaiñ khain .

translation.en: But Samuel ministered before the  Lord  , being a child , girded with a linen ephod .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u khynnah Samuel u ïai shakri ïa U  Trai  , u da phong da ka sopti-lor da ka jaiñ linen kaba kyntang .

translation.en: And Isaac his father said unto him , Who art thou ? And he said , I am thy son , thy firstborn Esau .
translation.kha: U Isaak u kylli ,  Me dei uei ?   Nga dei u Iso , u khun nyngkong jong phi ,  u jubab .

translation.en: Call together the archers against Babylon : all ye that bend the bow , camp against it round about  ; let none thereof escape : recompense her according to her work  ; according to all that she hath done , do unto her : for she hath been proud against the  Lord  , against the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: To ong ïa ki nongsiatkhnam ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon . Phah ïa baroh kiba nang ban pyndonkam ïa ka ryntieh bad ïa u khnam . Kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad wat ai ba yn don ba lait phet . Siew kylliang pat ïa kiei kiei baroh ba ka la leh , bad leh ïa ka kumba ka la leh ïa kiwei , namar ba ka la leh da ka jingsarong pyrshah ïa nga , U Bakhuid ki Israel .

translation.en: And said unto me , Behold , I will make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , and I will make of thee a multitude of people  ; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga , ‘ Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba kumta ki nongmih pateng jong me kin sa long ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Ngan ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ba kan long ka ri kynti jong ki junom .’

translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place , and shall not be quenched .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai ïa ki jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta la pynkhih bitar ïa nga da baroh kaba ki leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka khie pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kan ym duh noh .

translation.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord , that he may instruct him ? But we have the mind of Christ .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Mano batip ïa ka jingmut U Trai ? Mano ba lah ban ai jingmut ïa u ?  Pynban , ma ngi , ngi don ïa ka jingmut U Khrist .

translation.en: Which justify the wicked for reward , and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him !
translation.kha: Hynrei tang namar ka jingïoh pisa bymdei phi shah ïa kiba shah pynrem ban lait bad phi khang ïa kiba lui lui na kaba ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king : and his throne is upholden by mercy .
translation.kha: U syiem un ïai don ha ka bor katba ka jingsynshar jong u ka dang long kaba khuid , kaba hok , bad kaba biang .

translation.en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent : for he is not a man , that he should repent .
translation.kha: U Blei bakhraw jong ki Israel um ju lamler lane kylla la ka jingmut . Um dei u briew — um ju kylla la ka jingmut .

translation.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit mynta kum u rangbah , bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga .

translation.en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities , and against the high towers .
translation.kha: ka sngi kaba dap da ka jingsawa ki turoi thma bad ka jingpyrta-thma jong ki shipai kiba tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ïa ki kut bajrong .

translation.en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you .
translation.kha: Naba U Moses u la ong , ‘ U Trai uba U Blei jong phi un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uwei na ki briew jong phi hi . Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u ong ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour s landmark . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: Our Creator can hear even silent prayers .
translation.kha: U Nongthaw u lah ban ïohsngew wat ïa ki jingduwai bajarjar .

translation.en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people , the disciples suffered him not .
translation.kha: U Paul hi u la kwah ban leit ha khmat u paidbah , hynrei ki parabangeit kim shah ïa u .

translation.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains , and burn incense upon the hills , under oaks and poplars and elms , because the shadow thereof is good : therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom , and your spouses shall commit adultery .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka kyntang ha kliar ki lumbah ki kñia ainguh , bad ha ki lumrit ki thang jingiwbih hapoh ki dieng kiba jrong bad kiba ïar namar ka jingkahtngen jong ki ka long kaba sngewtynnat !  Kaba mih nangta , ki khun kynthei jong phi ki ïaleh nuti , bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong phi ki ïaklim .

translation.en: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth  ;
translation.kha: ïa u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah :  Nga la jan ban pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew

translation.en: They take up all of them with the angle , they catch them in their net , and gather them in their drag : therefore they rejoice and are glad .
translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki kem ïa ki briew da ki khwai , la kumba ki dei ki dohkha . Ki ring ïa ki na ki jar bad ki risa da ka jingkmen ïa ka jingïoh jong ki !

translation.en: The north wind driveth away rain : so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka wanrah ïa ka jingbitar kumba da shisha ka lyer na shatei ka wanrah slap .

translation.en: Say not unto thy neighbour , Go , and come again , and to morrow I will give  ; when thou hast it by thee .
translation.kha: Wat ong ha la u paramarjan ap haduh lashai lada phi lah ban ïarap ïa u mynta .

translation.en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon , nor burnt sacrifice , nor meat offering  ; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon .
translation.kha: Wat thang halor jong ka ïa ka jingiwbih ba lah khang , ne ïa ka jingainguh thang da ki mrad ne ïa ka jingainguh bam , bad wat theh halor jong ka ïa ka jingainguh kaba da ka waiñ .

translation.en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man , and to birds , and fourfooted beasts , and creeping things .
translation.kha: ha ka jaka ba kin mane ïa U Blei uba im , ki mane ïa ki dur ba la thaw ban i kum u briew ne ki sim ne ki mrad ne ki mrad bapar kiba ïap noh .

translation.en: All who put their faith in Jesus can have their sins forgiven and receive everlasting life .—1 Timothy 2 :5 , 6  ; John 3 :16  ; Romans 5 :18 , 19 .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba don jingngeit ha u Jisu kin ïoh map na ki pop bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .—1 Timothi 2 :5 , 6 ; Ioannis 3 :16 ; Rom 5 :18 , 19 .

translation.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel , until we have brought them unto their place : and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land .
translation.kha: Nangta ngin khreh ban leit bad la kiwei pat ki Israel sha ka thma bad ngin ïalam ban tur ïaleh haduh ba ngin da pynïoh pynsah ïa ki ha ka ri ka ban long ka jong ki . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba hap hapoh ka jingsumar sukher jong ngi ki lah ban sah hangne ha ki shnong kiba la ker da ki kut baskhem , khlem jingma na ki briew jong kane ka ri .

translation.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil : so do stripes the inward parts of the belly .
translation.kha: Teng teng ka donkam ban mad ïa ka jingshem kaba kthang ha ka jingim ban pynlong ïa ngi ban kylla ïa ki lynti jong ngi .

translation.en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple  ; and he healed them .
translation.kha: Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh ki la wan sha u ha ka Templ , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: And Moses wrote all the words of the  Lord  , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Moses u thoh ïa ki hukum baroh jong U  Trai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u tei ïa ka duwan ha trai jong u lum , bad u pynïeng ruh khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei u maw na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .

translation.en: Then said Boaz unto Ruth , Hearest thou not , my daughter ? Go not to glean in another field , neither go from hence , but abide here fast by my maidens :
translation.kha: Nangta u Boas u ong ha ka Ruth ,  Shah ngan ai jingmut katto katne ïa phi . Wat leit tam kew shawei pat lait tang ha kane ka lyngkha . Trei para kynthei hangne ;

translation.en: Then we turned , and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea , as the  Lord  spake unto me : and we compassed mount Seir many days .
translation.kha: ngi leit phai sha ka ri shyiap shaphang ka Duriaw Basaw , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , bad ngi la pynlut por slem ha kaba ïaid sakma ha ri lum Edom .

translation.en: Remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Miriam by the way , after that ye were come forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kynmaw aïu U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa ka Miriam mynba phi wan na Ijipt .

translation.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly : and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother .
translation.kha: Ki don ki jingïadei paralok ki bymneh , hynrei ki don ki paralok kiba lah ban shaniah palat ban ïa ki hynmen ki para .

translation.en: And of all my sons , ( for the  Lord  hath given me many sons , ) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the  Lord  over Israel .
translation.kha: U la ai ïa nga shibun ki khun shynrang bad napdeng jong ki baroh u la jied ïa u Solomon ban synshar halor ka Israel , ka hima ka jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Nadab u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Thou shalt be visited of the  Lord  of hosts with thunder , and with earthquake , and great noise , with storm and tempest , and the flame of devouring fire .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan bad khlem poi pyrkhat U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pyllait im ïa pha da ki  erïong bajur bad ki jingkhih jumai . Un phah ïa ki  erlangthari bad ka ding baklang ;

translation.en: Then he called for a light , and sprang in , and came trembling , and fell down before Paul and Silas ,
translation.kha: U nongpeit phatok u la pan ïa ka jingshai , u la rung shapoh , bad u la dem da kaba khynñiuh ha ki kjat jong u Paul bad u Silas .

translation.en: So he used a serpent to tell Eve that if she ate the fruit from that tree , she would not die , but she would be like God .
translation.kha: Te u la pyndonkam da u bsein ban kren ha ka Im ba lada ka bam ïa u soh na uta u dieng , kan ym ïap , hynrei kan long kum U Blei .

translation.en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin kaba na Jerusalem .

translation.en: And I say unto thee , Let my son go , that he may serve me : and if thou refuse to let him go , behold , I will slay thy son , even thy firstborn .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa me ban shah ïa u khun jong nga ban leit , khnang ba un ïoh mane ïa nga , hynrei me la kyntait . Mynta te ngan pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong jong me .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel , Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel :  Phi la ïohi kumno ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren ha phi na bneng .

translation.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest , and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight , and have made thee a great name , like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la don ryngkat bad me kat shaba me leit , bad nga la jop ïa ki nongshun jong me baroh katba me nang ïaid shaphrang . Ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kat ki nongïalam kiba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: The impotent man answered him , Sir , I have no man , when the water is troubled , to put me into the pool : but while I am coming , another steppeth down before me .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba pang u la jubab ,  Ko Kynrad , ngam don mano mano hangne ban leit buh ïa nga ha ka pungsum haba la pynkhih ïa ka um ; katba nga dang pyrshang ban hiar ha ka , uwei pat u poi nyngkong ha ka .

translation.en: Each of them has his own car .
translation.kha: Uwei-pa-uwei naki u don kali .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Stand in the court of the  Lord s  house , and speak unto all the cities of Judah , which come to worship in the  Lord s  house , all the words that I command thee to speak unto them  ; diminish not a word :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To ïeng ha ka ïingbishar jong ka Templ bad to pynbna ïa baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa me ban ong ha ki briew kiba wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah ban mane hangta . Wat ym iehnoh ei ei ruh em .

translation.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded  ; they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong hangta ki long khlem bor ; ki la sheptieng bad lyngngoh . Ki la long kum u phlang ha lyngkha ne ki ñiut kiba san ha tnum haba ka lyer khluit ba na mihngi ka beh ha ki .

translation.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand , because they dealt faithfully .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka kam ki long kiba da khuid hok , te kim donkam ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa ka jingmih .

translation.en: For thou verily givest thanks well , but the other is not edified .
translation.kha: Wat lada ka jingduwai ainguh jong phi ka biang bha , kam ïarap ei ei ïa uwei pat u briew .

translation.en: And they answered and said unto Jesus , We cannot tell . And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: Kumta ka jubab jong ki ïa U Jisu ka la long ,  Ngim tip .  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ruh ngan ym ïathuh ïa phi te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: And John bare record , saying , I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove , and it abode upon him .
translation.kha: Bad u Ïoannis u la ai ïa kane ka jingphla :  Nga la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar kum ka paro na bneng , bad u shongsah halor jong u .

translation.en: Nevertheless for thy great mercies  sake thou didst not utterly consume them , nor forsake them  ; for thou art a gracious and merciful God .
translation.kha: Bad pynban , namar ka jingkhraw ka jingisynei jong me , mem shym iehnoh ne pynjot ïa ki . Me long U Blei ka jingaiei bad ka jingisynei !

translation.en: And Jehu slept with his fathers : and they buried him in Samaria . And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ha Samaria , bad u Jehoahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore the rather , brethren , give diligence to make your calling and election sure : for if ye do these things , ye shall never fall :
translation.kha: Naba kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , to pyrshang kham tyngeh ban pynlong ïa ka jingkhot jong U Blei bad ka jingjied jong u ïa phi , ka jingshem baneh junom ; lada phi leh kumta , phin ym iehnoh da lei lei ïa ka jingngeit jong phi .

translation.en: And the lord commended the unjust steward , because he had done wisely : for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light .
translation.kha: Kaba mih ka long ba u trai jong une u sordar bymhok u la ïaroh ïa u ba u leh ïa kaba kum kane kaba sianti ; namar ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei ki long kiba kham sianti ha kaba trei ïa la ki kam ban ïa ki briew kiba long ki jong ka jingshai .

translation.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and saith of him ,  Behold an Israelite indeed , in whom is no guile !
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u Nathanael ba u wan sha u , u la ong shaphang jong u ,  Une u dei u kynja Israel uba shisha , ym don kano kano ka bymshisha ha u !

translation.en: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth , and horror shall cover them  ; and shame shall be upon all faces , and baldness upon all their heads .
translation.kha: Kin kup da ka jaiñ khain bad kin kyiuh ha ki jaka baroh . Yn khi lyndum ïa ki khlieh jong ki , bad yn pynlehrain ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: If a man also lie with mankind , as he lieth with a woman , both of them have committed an abomination : they shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha para shynrang , ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram : once in three years came the navy of Tarshish , bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .
translation.kha: U don shi kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha duriaw ryngkat bad ka kynhun lieng u Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki kynhun lieng jong u ki ju wan phai , ki da wan kit ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .

translation.en: To morrow go ye down against them : behold , they come up by the cliff of Ziz  ; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook , before the wilderness of Jeruel .
translation.kha: Tur pyrshah ïa ki la shai ka sngi haba kin wan kiew na ka them ha Sis . Phin ïakynduh ïa ki ha kaba kut jong ka them kaba poi sha ka ri khlaw hajan Jeruel .

translation.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer , and for this I make haste .
translation.kha: Ko Job , phi la pynbitar ïa nga . Mynta ngam lah ap shuh ban jubab .

translation.en: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity  ; and their delectable things shall not profit  ; and they are their own witnesses  ; they see not , nor know  ; that they may be ashamed .
translation.kha: Baroh kito kiba shna bleithaw kim long ei ei , bad u blei ba ki ñiewkor shibun um long uba larkam . Kito kiba mane ïa kine ki blei ki long kiba matlah bad kiba bieit bad kin shah pynjahburom .

translation.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah  ; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u leit sha Ramah , bad u syiem Saul u leit sha la ïing ha Gibeah .

translation.en: Hast thou not heard long ago , how I have done it  ; and of ancient times , that I have formed it ? now have I brought it to pass , that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps .
translation.kha: Hato mem pat ju ïohsngew ba nga la thmu ïa kane baroh slem mynshuwa ? Bad mynta nga pynurlong ïa ka . Nga ai ha me ka bor ban pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh sha ki kynton theh ñiut .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ? then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Such as are for death , to death  ; and such as are for the sword , to the sword  ; and such as are for the famine , to the famine  ; and such as are for the captivity , to the captivity .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli ïa me shano ki dei ban leit , ïathuh ïa ki ba nga la lah ong :  Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tim ban ïap da ka jingpang — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiwei pat la tim ban ïap ha ka thma — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tim ban ïap na ka jingïapthngan — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiwei pat la tim ban shah ring noh kum ki koidi — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit !

translation.en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool : much less do lying lips a prince .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba donburom kim ju kren ïa kaba lamler , bad kiba bieit kim don ei ei kaba dondor ban ong .

translation.en: I will make waste mountains and hills , and dry up all their herbs  ; and I will make the rivers islands , and I will dry up the pools .
translation.kha: Nga pyntwa ïa ki lumrit bad ki lumbah ngan pyntyrkhong ïa u phlang bad ki dieng . Ngan pynkylla ïa ki them wah sha ki jaka shyiap bad pyntyrkhong ïa ki pukri um .
