translation.en: Put not your trust in princes , nor in the son of man , in whom there is no help .
translation.kha: Wat buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew ; ym don u briew uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: And David answered the priest , and said unto him , Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days , since I came out , and the vessels of the young men are holy , and the bread is in a manner common , yea , though it were sanctified this day in the vessel .
translation.kha: Da shisha kim shym leh kumta ,  u Dabid u jubab .  Ki rangbah jong nga ki ju sumar khuid ïa lade kat kum ka jinglehniam wat haba ngi don ha ka jingïaleh kaba malu mala ; katno tam lei lei ha kane ka por ha kaba ngi don ha ka jingïaleh kaba kham kyrpang !

translation.en: Huram said moreover , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , that made heaven and earth , who hath given to David the king a wise son , endued with prudence and understanding , that might build an house for the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew ! U la ai ha u syiem Dabid , ïa u khun uba stad , uba dap da ka jingshemphang bad ka jingtbit , uba mynta u thmu ban tei ka Templ na ka bynta U  Trai  bad ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled , he pursued after them , and took the two kings of Midian , Zebah and Zalmunna , and discomfited all the host .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem Midian , u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki her ïap , hynrei u beh kthong ïa ki bad u ïohkem ïa ki , bad u pynkulmar thlim ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki ,  Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba nga la ïathuh ha phi mynba nga dang don lem bad phi : Kaei kaei baroh kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka Hukum u Moses , ha ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ha Ki Salm ka dei ban urlong shisha .

translation.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam . In the day that God created man , in the likeness of God made he him  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka thup kyrteng jong ki khun ki ksiew u Adam . ( Mynba U Blei U la thaw ïa ki briew , u la thaw ïa ki ha ka dur jong U hi .

translation.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the  Lord s  name is to be praised .
translation.kha: Naduh mihngi shaduh sepngi A to ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  !

translation.en: If I be wicked , why then labour I in vain ?
translation.kha: Namar ba la rai pynrem ïa nga , balei te ngan salia shuh ?

translation.en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley , and the border even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
translation.kha: Ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad nga ai ïa kata ka ri kaba naduh Gilead haduh ka wah Arnon . U pud uba shaphang shathie u long napdeng jong kata ka wah , bad u pud uba shaphang shatei pat u long ka wah Jabbok ; kaba shi bynta na kata ka pynlong ruh ïa u pud ki Ammon .

translation.en: What should I do ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga hap ban leh ?

translation.en: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation : at the light of thine arrows they went , and at the shining of thy glittering spear .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingthaba jong ki khnam baher stet bad ka jingtyngshaiñ na u sum baphyrnai , ka sngi bad u bnai ki sangeh hajuh .

translation.en: And when ye stand praying , forgive , if ye have ought against any : that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi ïeng bad duwai , to map ïa kaei kaei kaba phi lah ban don pyrshah ïano ïano , khnang ba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un map ïa ki jingleh bymdei kiba phi la leh .

translation.en: And take the helmet of salvation , and the sword of the Spirit , which is the word of God :
translation.kha: Bad to pdiang ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingïada khlieh , bad ka ktien U Blei kum ka waitlam kaba U Mynsiem u ai ha phi .

translation.en: Then Judas , which had betrayed him , when he saw that he was condemned , repented himself , and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders ,
translation.kha: Haba u Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ba ïa U Jisu la dep pynrem , u la kylla-kaba-mut bad u la leit rah biang ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san .

translation.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach , because we trust in the living God , who is the Saviour of all men , specially of those that believe .
translation.kha: Ngi ïaleh tyngeh bad trei shitom , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U Blei uba im , uba long U Nongpynim ïa baroh bad khamtam ïa kito kiba ngeit .

translation.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise .
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor haba phi shah pynbeit , phi long kiba stad .

translation.en: Thine own friend , and thy father s friend , forsake not  ; neither go into thy brother s house in the day of thy calamity : for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off .
translation.kha: Wat nym klet ïa la ki paralok lane ïa ki paralok u kpa jong phi . Lada phi don ha ka jingjynjar , wat ong ïa u hynmen ne para jong phi ban ïarap ; u paramarjan uba hajan u lah ban ïarap ïa phi kham bha ban ïa u hynmen ne para uba sha jngai .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed , and beware of covetousness : for a man s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth .
translation.kha: Bad u la ïai kren ha ki baroh ,  To khmih bha bad sumar ïa lade na kano kano ka jait jinglalot ; namar ba ïa ka jingim bashisha jong u briew ym shym la pynlong da kiei kiei kiba u don , kam pher haduh katno u lah ban long uba riewspah .

translation.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled , and overthroweth the mighty .
translation.kha: u pynrit khop ïa ki lyngdoh bad ïa ki rangbah kiba don ha ka bor .

translation.en: Jarmuth , and Adullam , Soco , and Azekah ,
translation.kha: ka Jarmuth , ka Adullam , ka Sokoh , ka Asekah ,

translation.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them , neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynban nga la pyrkhat isynei ïa ki . Nga la rai ban ym pynïap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant , saying , When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan , ye shall stand still in Jordan .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ba ynda ki poi ha ka wah , ki dei ban ïaid ha ki um bad ban ïeng hajan ka rudwah .

translation.en: And Israel saw that great work which the  Lord  did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the  Lord  , and believed the  Lord  , and his servant Moses .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka borbah da kaba U  Trai  u jop ïa ki Ijipt , ki la ïeng da kaba tiengburom ïa U  Trai  ; bad kumta ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  bad ha u Moses u shakri jong u .

translation.en: And the messenger said unto David , Surely the men prevailed against us , and came out unto us into the field , and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ki nongshun jong ngi ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ngi , bad ki la wan mih shabar na kata ka nongbah ban ïaleh ïa ngi ha madan , hynrei ngi beh krad biang ïa ki sha ka khyrdop shnong .

translation.en: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah , in the fourth month , the ninth day of the month , the city was broken up .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khyndai jong u bnai basaw jong ka snem kaba khatwei ka jinglong syiem u Sedekaïah , ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah la pynpra lut .

translation.en: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest , the next day they lightened the ship  ;
translation.kha: Ka  erïong kaba jur ka la neh , kumta ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la sdang ban bret noh katto katne ki jingkit kiba don ha ka lieng ,

translation.en: And the one of them , whose name was Cleopas , answering said unto him , Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem , and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days ?
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kleopas , u la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me long tang ma me uba wan sha Jerusalem u bymtip ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hangta ha kine ki khyndiat sngi ba la leit ?

translation.en: In the eighth month , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha u bnai uba phra jong ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah u nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Berekhaïah bad u ksiew jong u Iddo .

translation.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded .
translation.kha: U Moses u ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel .

translation.en: And Jesus , immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him , turned him about in the press , and said ,  Who touched my clothes ?
translation.kha: Mar kumta U Jisu u la tip ba ka bor ka la mihnoh na u , kumta u la phai sawdong sha u paidbah bad u la kylli ,  Mano ba la ktah ïa ki jaiñkup jong nga ?

translation.en: And when he went in to his wife , she conceived , and bare a son , and he called his name Beriah , because it went evil with his house .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïathiah shongkha biang bad ka tnga jong u , bad ka la armet bad ïoh khun shynrang . Ki khot kyrteng ïa u , u Beraïah , namar ka jingjynjar ka la ngat ha ka longïing jong ki .

translation.en: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely , every man under his vine and under his fig tree , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , all the days of Solomon .
translation.kha: Katba u dang im , ki briew ha kylleng ka Judah bad Israel , ki im ha ka jingshngain , kawei kawei ka longïing ka don la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur .

translation.en: And the Israelite woman s son blasphemed the name of the  Lord  , and cursed . And they brought him unto Moses : ( and his mother s name was Shelomith , the daughter of Dibri , of the tribe of Dan : )
translation.kha: Don uwei u briew uba u kpa jong u , u dei u nong Ijipt bad ka kmie jong u pat ka dei ka Israel kaba kyrteng ka Shelomith , ka khun u Dibri uba na ka jait Dan . Une u briew u ïakajia bad uwei u Israel hapoh ka jaka shong dara . Katba ki dang ïakajia kumta , une u briew u krenbeiñ ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  : kumta ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Moses .

translation.en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it  ; and commanded that something should be given her to eat .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ai ïa ki ka hukum bapyrkhing ban ym ïathuh hano hano ruh , bad u la ong ,  Ai ei ei ïa ka ban bam .

translation.en: And , behold , there was a man which had his hand withered . And they asked him , saying , Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days ? that they might accuse him .
translation.kha: ha kaba la don u briew uba don ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang . Katto katne ki briew hangta kiba la kwah ban mudui ïa U Jisu ha ka jingleh bakla , kumta ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hato ka long pyrshah ïa Ka Aiñ jong ngi ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?

translation.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless , when I saw my help in the gate :
translation.kha: Lada nga la kum shukor ïa u khunswet , da kaba tip ba ngan ksan ha khmat ka ïingbishar ,

translation.en: And he said , Thy name shall be called no more Jacob , but Israel : for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men , and hast prevailed .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u ong ,  Ka kyrteng jong me kam long shuh u Jakob . Me la ïaleh bad U Blei bad ki briew , bad me la jop ruh ; kumta ka kyrteng jong me kan long noh u Israel .

translation.en: And the younger , she also bare a son , and called his name Ben–ammi : the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day .
translation.kha: Ka khun kaba ar ruh ka la kha khun shynrang ïa uba ka jer kyrteng u Ben-ammi . U la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Ammon haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim , and the horse from Jerusalem , and the battle bow shall be cut off : and he shall speak peace unto the heathen : and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea , and from the river even to the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan weng noh ïa ki kali thma na Israel bad shim ïa ki kulai na Jerusalem ; ïa ki ryntieh ba la pyndonkam ha ka thma yn pynjot . U syiem jong phi un pynlong jingïasuk hapdeng ki jaitbynriew ; un synshar na ka duriaw sha ka duriaw , na ka wah Ïuphratis sha kiba kut jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: So Joab came to the king , and told him : and when he had called for Absalom , he came to the king , and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king : and the king kissed Absalom .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joab u la leit sha u Syiem Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Absalom u la ong . U syiem u la phah khot ïa u Absalom ; uba la leit sha u bad u dem ngon ha khyndew ha khmat jong u . U syiem u la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingdoh .

translation.en: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong , so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress .
translation.kha: U wallam jingjot ha kiba khlaiñ bad ïa ki Kut baskhem jong ki .

translation.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned : therefore , behold , I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king .
translation.kha: Nga tip , kynrad , ba nga la leh pop , bad dei kane keiñ balei ba nga long uba nyngkong na ki jait bashaphang shatei ban wan bad ïakynduh ïa U Syiem Kynrad ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: Now the  Lord  hath brought it , and done according as he hath said : because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed his voice , therefore this thing is come upon you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la byrngem ïa kane ka ri da ka jingjot , bad mynta u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la ong ba un leh . Baroh kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong phi ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad kim shym la kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him : he will ever be mindful of his covenant .
translation.kha: U pynbiang jingbam ïa kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u ; um ju klet ïa ka jutang jong u .

translation.en: For he is not a Jew , which is one outwardly ; neither is that circumcision , which is outward in the flesh :
translation.kha: Haba kumta , uei uba dei u Jiw bashisha , ba la otsher shisha ? Ym dei uta u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shabar , uba ka jingotsher ka long ha ka doh .

translation.en: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living : and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword , even Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u syiem Ijipt ba un pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im , hynrei ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kin shah pynïap bad kin thiah ha ka jingjahthait lem bad baroh kiba khlem otsher kiba ïap ha ka thma ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: The way of the just is uprightness : thou , most upright , dost weigh the path of the just .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me pynlong ka lynti kaba beit na ka bynta ki briew kiba bha ; ka surok kaba ki ïaid ka long kaba madan .

translation.en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar , who had made him swear by God : but he stiffened his neck , and hardened his heart from turning unto the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba pynbor ïa u bad smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei ba un ïaineh ha u . Da kaba leh mutlop u kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban phai pat sha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: On that night could not the king sleep , and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles  ; and they were read before the king .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka miet u syiem um ïohthiah satia , kumta u hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka hima bad ban pule ha u .

translation.en: That they all may be one  ; as thou , Father , art in me , and I in thee , that they also may be one in us : that the world may believe that thou hast sent me .
translation.kha: Nga duwai ba ki baroh kin ïalong kawei . Ko Pa ! To ai ba kin ïalong ha ngi , kumba me long ha nga bad ma nga ha me . To ai ba kin ïalong kawei , khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Behold , I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard : I cry aloud , but there is no judgment .
translation.kha: Nga pyrshah ïa kane ka jingleh jubor jong u , hynrei ym don ba shahshkor ; ym don uba ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong nga ban ïoh ïa ka hok .

translation.en: Brethren , let every man , wherein he is called , therein abide with God .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei ha kata kajuh kumba phi la long mynba la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs , and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young , and under his shadow dwelt all great nations .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jait sim ki thaw skum ha ki tnat jong u ; ki mradkhlaw ki kha ïa la ki khun ha ki jingkah jong u ; ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei ki shong jahthait hapoh ka syrngiew jong u .

translation.en: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse  ; Reuben , Gad , and Asher , and Zebulun , Dan , and Naphtali .
translation.kha: Bad kine ki jait kin ïeng ha u lum Ebal katba dang pynbna ïa ki jingtim : ka jait Reuben , ka jait Gad , ka jait Asher , ka jait Sebulun , ka jait Dan , bad ka jait Naphtali .

translation.en: And he arose , and went into the house  ; and he poured the oil on his head , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I have anointed thee king over the people of the  Lord  , even over Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta ar ngut na ki , ki leit rung shapoh ïing , bad u nongïathuhlypa samla u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib ha ka khlieh u Jehu , bad u ong ha u ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem jong ki briew jong nga , ki Israel .

translation.en: Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron , and unto Piram king of Jarmuth , and unto Japhia king of Lachish , and unto Debir king of Eglon , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Adonisedek u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Hoham u syiem ka Hebron , u Piram u syiem ka Jarmuth , u Japhia u syiem ka Lakhish , bad sha u Debir u syiem ka Eglon :

translation.en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him , Why hast thou served us thus , that thou calledst us not , when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites ? And they did chide with him sharply .
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Ephraim ki ong ha u Gideon ,  Balei phim shym khot ïa ngi haba phi la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian ? Balei phi leh kumne ïa ngi ?  Ki la khñium tyngeh shaphang kane .

translation.en: Curse not the king , no not in thy thought  ; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber : for a bird of the air shall carry the voice , and that which hath wings shall tell the matter .
translation.kha: Wat wad daw ïa u syiem , wat ha kaba jar jar , bad wad daw ïa kiba riewspah , wat ha ka jingkyrpang ka kamra thiah jong phi . Ka sim ka lah ban rah ïa ka khubor bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba phi kren .

translation.en: And the men of Judah came , and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah . And they told David , saying , That the men of Jabesh–gilead were they that buried Saul .
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah ka Judah ki la wan sha Hebron bad ki la pynsleh ïa u Dabid kum u syiem ka Judah . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ba ki briew ka Jabesh ha Gilead ki la tep ïa u Saul ,

translation.en: They slay the widow and the stranger , and murder the fatherless .
translation.kha: Ki pynïap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ïa ki khunswet , bad shoh pynïap ïa u nongwei uba shong ha ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured , saying , This man receiveth sinners , and eateth with them .
translation.kha: ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sdang ban khñium ,  Une u briew u pdiang sngewbha ïa kiba shah kyntait bad u da ïabam lem bad ki !

translation.en: And he hasted , and took the ashes away from his face  ; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u tar ïa ka jaiñ na ka khmat jong u , bad kumta hi u syiem u ithuh ïa u bad u long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive , and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: u la kem im ïa u Agag , u syiem Amalek bad u la pynïap ïa ki briew baroh .

translation.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name .
translation.kha: Namarkata , to ngin ai jingïaroh ïa U Blei khlem da pud kum ka jingkñia da U Jisu , kaba long ka jingainguh da ki rmiang shyntur kiba phla ïa u kum U Trai .

translation.en: Lord  , in trouble have they visited thee , they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them .
translation.kha: Me pynshitom ïa la ki briew , A  Trai bad ha ka jinglyng-a ki duwai ha me .

translation.en: The anger of the  Lord  shall not return , until he have executed , and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart : in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly .
translation.kha: bad kan ym kut haduh ba un da leh ïa baroh kaba U thmu ban leh . Ha ki sngi ki ban wan ki briew jong U kin sa sngewthuh shai ïa kane .

translation.en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it , in the midst thereof : it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it , as it were the hole of an habergeon , that it be not rent .
translation.kha: Ka dei ban don ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh , bad suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong kumba leh ïa ka jymphong , khnang ba kan ym kad .

translation.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre , unto the city of Arbah , which is Hebron , where Abraham and Isaac sojourned .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la leit sha u Isaak u kpa jong u ha Mamre , hajan Hebron , ha kaba u Abraham bad u Isaak ki la ju shong ju sah .

translation.en: A time to be born , and a time to die  ; a time to plant , and a time to pluck up that which is planted  ;
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban kha bad ka por ban ïap , ka por ban thung bad ka por ban rat noh ,

translation.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Ha ki dieng Jamynrei kiba don hajan ngi la wah ïa la ki duitara .

translation.en: And these signs shall follow them that believe  ; In my name shall they cast out devils  ; they shall speak with new tongues  ;
translation.kha: Ïa kiba ngeit yn ai ka bor ban leh ïa ki kambah : Kin beh noh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; kin kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher ;

translation.en: O  Lord  , correct me , but with judgment  ; not in thine anger , lest thou bring me to nothing .
translation.kha: Pynbeit ïa ki briew jong me , A  Trai  ; hynrei wat leh tyngeh halor jong ngi lane pynshitom ïa ngi haba me bitar ; kata ka lah ban long ka jingkut jong ngi .

translation.en: Then I consulted with myself , and I rebuked the nobles , and the rulers , and said unto them , Ye exact usury , every one of his brother . And I set a great assembly against them .
translation.kha: Nga la pynrem ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki paidbah bad ong ïa ki ,  Phi la banbeiñ ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi !  Nga la khot ïa ka jingïalang paidbah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh bad nga ong ,

translation.en: Some fell upon stony places , where they had not much earth : and forthwith they sprung up , because they had no deepness of earth :
translation.kha: Khyndiat pat u la hap halor ka jaka maw ha kaba don tang khyndiat ka khyndew . Shen ki symbai ki la speh , namar ka khyndew kam da jylliew .

translation.en: Then shall he answer them , saying , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these , ye did it not to me .
translation.kha: U Syiem un jubab , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ha man ba phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa iwei na kine kiba rit tam , phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga .’

translation.en: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the  Lord  : and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof , and it shall devour all things round about it .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan thang ïa ka ïingsyiem jong pha da ka ding , bad kan bam duh ïa baroh kat kaba don sawdong jong ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Honour all men . Love the brotherhood . Fear God . Honour the king .
translation.kha: To ñiewburom ïa baroh , to ieit ïa la ki parabangeit , to tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad ñiewburom ïa u Patsha .

translation.en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better , than that a man should rejoice in his own works  ; for that is his portion : for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him ?
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewthuh te ba kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba ngi lah ban leh . Ym don kano kano ka lynti ïa ngi ban tip kaei ka ban jia ynda ngi ïap .

translation.en: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the  Lord  : this is that king Ahaz .
translation.kha: Katba ki jingjynjar ki nang jur , u Ahas u la leh pop shuh shuh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: He went away again the second time , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if this cup may not pass away from me , except I drink it , thy will be done .
translation.kha: Sa shisien U Jisu u la leit noh bad u la duwai ,  Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ym lah ban shim noh lymda nga dih ïa ka , ïa ka mon jong me yn leh .

translation.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters : I will give them an everlasting name , that shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: te ïa ka kyrteng jong me yn ïai kynmaw ha ka templ jong nga bad hapdeng ki briew jong nga kham slem ban ïa kaba me don ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei . Yn ym klet ïa me lano lano ruh .

translation.en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the  Lord s  passover .
translation.kha: Ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ïa kaba ju rakhe ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , ka sdang ha ka por sep sngi ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong .

translation.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim , which is in mount Ephraim , and said , Hear me , thou Jeroboam , and all Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai ki ïakynduh ha ri lum Ephraim . U syiem Abijah u kiew sha u lum Semaraim bad u pyrta sha u Jeroboam bad ki Israel :  Shahshkor ïa nga !  u ong .

translation.en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness  sake , happy are ye : and be not afraid of their terror , neither be troubled  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada phi hap ban shahshitom haba phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , katno kiba kmen phi long ! Wat sheptieng ïano ïano , bad wat khuslai .

translation.en: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate , and at the valley gate , and at the turning of the wall , and fortified them .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u pynkhlaiñ ïa ki jingker kynroh ïa ka Jerusalem da kaba tei ïa ki kut ha Khyrdop Dong , ha Khyrdop Them , bad ha ka jaka ba khun ka kynroh .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that as the  Lord  rejoiced over you to do you good , and to multiply you  ; so the  Lord  will rejoice over you to destroy you , and to bring you to nought  ; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u pynmanbha bad pynroi ïa phi da kaba kmen , kumta ruh da kaba kmen un pynjot bad pynduh pyndam ïa phi . Yn sa rat dyngkhong ïa phi na kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .

translation.en: Children : “Children , be obedient to your parents in union with the Lord .”—Ephesians 6 :1 .
translation.kha: Ki khun : “Phi ki khun to kohnguh ia la ki kmie ki kpa ha U Trai .” —Ephesos 6 :1 .

translation.en: Son of man , I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel : therefore hear the word at my mouth , and give them warning from me .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  ngan buh ïa me kum u nongap phira na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Israel . Men pynsngew ha ki ïa ki jingmaham kiba nga ai ïa me .

translation.en: For the seed shall be prosperous  ; the vine shall give her fruit , and the ground shall give her increase , and the heavens shall give their dew  ; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things .
translation.kha: Kin thung ïa ki jingthung jong ki ha ka jingsuk . Ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki kin pynmih ki sohwaiñ , ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad u slap un don kyrhai . Ngan ai ïa kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh ha ki briew jong ka hima jong nga kiba dang lait im .

translation.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :
translation.kha: hynrei ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba bit ban mihpat na ka jingïap bad ban im ha ki pateng ban wan kin ym shongkurim shuh .

translation.en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him , because he not only had broken the sabbath , but said also that God was his Father , making himself equal with God .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingong ka la pynlong ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba kin nang wad dong shuh shuh ban pynïap ïa u ; ym tang ba u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum Sabbaton , hynrei ba u la ong ba U Blei hi u dei U Kpa jong u bad da kumne u la pynlong ïa lade uba ïaryngkat bad U Blei .

translation.en: And he said unto them , What counsel give ye that we may answer this people , who have spoken to me , saying , Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter ?
translation.kha: Kaei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ?  U kylli .  Kaei ngan ong ïa ki briew kiba kyrpad ïa nga ban pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?

translation.en: Ye are cursed with a curse : for ye have robbed me , even this whole nation .
translation.kha: Ka jingtim ka long halor jong phi baroh namar ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka shukor ïa nga .

translation.en: And he spake three thousand proverbs : and his songs were a thousand and five .
translation.kha: U la thoh lai hajar tylli ki proberb bad palat hajar tylli ki jingrwai .

translation.en: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken , Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Nga pynbna ha ka jingbitar bameh ding jong nga ba ha kata ka sngi kan don ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ha ka ri Israel .

translation.en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth–el the fifteenth day of the eighth month , even in the month which he had devised of his own heart  ; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel : and he offered upon the altar , and burnt incense .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba phra , ka sngi kaba u hi u la buh , u leit sha Bethel bad u kñia ka jingainguh ha ka duwan ban rakhe ïa ka jingkhawai niam ba u la seng na ka bynta ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And it was so , when the days of their feasting were gone about , that Job sent and sanctified them , and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all : for Job said , It may be that my sons have sinned , and cursed God in their hearts . Thus did Job continually .
translation.kha: Ha man ka step kaba bud jong ka jingkhawai , u Job u ju khie dang step bad u ai ïa ki jingkñia na ka bynta iwei pa iwei na ki khun jong u ban pynkhuid ïa ki . U ju leh ïa kane borabor namar u pyrkhat ba ïoh iwei na ki i leh pop da kaba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei khlem poi pyrkhat .

translation.en: For thy word s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all these great things , to make thy servant know them .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka mon jong me bad ka jingthmu jong me , ban leh ïa kane ; me la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba khraw khnang ban hikai ïa nga .

translation.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways  ; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of .
translation.kha: Wat la katta , shibun kin bud ïa ki lynti bajakhlia jong ki ; bad namar kaei kaba ki leh , kiwei kin kren sniew ïa ka Lynti jong ka jingshisha .

translation.en: But there came a man of God to him , saying , O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee  ; for the  Lord  is not with Israel , to wit , with all the children of Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Wat shim ïa kine ki shipai Israel bad me . U  Trai  um don bad kine ki kynhun shipai kiba na ka Hima bashatei .

translation.en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people , and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead .
translation.kha: Bad u la hukum ïa ngi ban ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki briew , bad ban sakhi ba u long uta ïa uba U Blei u la thung ban long u Nongbishar ïa kiba im bad kiba ïap .

translation.en: She is hardened against her young ones , as though they were not hers : her labour is in vain without fear  ;
translation.kha: Ka leh kumba ki pylleng kim dei ki jong ka , bad kam salia ba ki jingpyrshang jong ka ki pulom .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa uba khraw tam na ki blei baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Yet , behold , therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth , both sons and daughters : behold , they shall come forth unto you , and ye shall see their way and their doings : and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem , even concerning all that I have brought upon it .
translation.kha: Lada don uba lait im bad uba pyllait im ïa ki khun jong u , to khmih sha ki haba ki wan sha phi . Peit haduh katno ki long kiba sniew , bad to sngewthikna ba ka jingpynshitom kaba nga wallam ha ka Jerusalem ka long kaba dei hok ,

translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have wrought with you for my name s sake , not according to your wicked ways , nor according to your corrupt doings , O ye house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Haba nga leh ban da ïa la ka burom , ma phi ki Israel phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  , namar ngam shym leh ïa phi kat kum ki jingbymman jong phi , ki jingleh basniew kiba phi dei hok ban ïoh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lumlang ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa ki mraw jong u sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te namarkata , haba ka por ka poi ba ïa ka ri yn ai pat sha ki briew jong U  Trai  , yn ym don shuh ka bynta ïano ïano na phi .

translation.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon , he and all the people that were with him  ; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it , and laid it on his shoulder , and said unto the people that were with him , What ye have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done .
translation.kha: kumta u la leit kiew sha u Lum Salmon bad la ki rangbah . Hangta u shim uwei u sdie , u pom kawei ka tnat na u dieng , bad u bah ïa ka ha la ka tyrpeng . U ong ïa la ki rangbah ban pynkloi bad ban leh kumjuh .

translation.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened ? or who laid the corner stone thereof  ;
translation.kha: Mano ba bat ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa ka khyndew ? Mano ba buh ïa u mawdong jong ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: And they came to Ophir , and fetched from thence gold , four hundred and twenty talents , and brought it to king Solomon .
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha ka ri Ophir bad ki wan kit nangta haduh khatsaw hajar kilo ka ksiar .

translation.en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets , he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la batai ha ki ïa kaei kaba la ong shaphang jong u hi ha baroh ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , da kaba sdang da ki kitab u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa baroh .

translation.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day : and on the seventh day he shall purify himself , and wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at even .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , u briew uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa ka um ha kita ki briew ki bymkhuid . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u dei ban pynkhuid ïa kito , kiba , hadien ba ki la sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad sum ïa lade , ki kylla long kiba khuid ha ka por sep sngi kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword  ; all these were men of valour .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Benjamin kiba shah pynïap ha kata ka sngi ki long arphew san hajar ngut — baroh na ki , ki dei ki shipai bashlur .

translation.en: ( James 1 :17 ) You will come to know how to approach him in prayer .
translation.kha: ( U Jakob 1 :17 ) Phin ioh tip kumno ban wan shajan jong u lyngba ka jingduwai .

translation.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way , and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase : the lion had not eaten the carcase , nor torn the ass .
translation.kha: Ki ruh ki leh kumta , bad u leit noh bad u la lap ïa kata ka metïap u nongïathuhlypa ha lynti bah , lem bad ka kada bad u sing kiba dang ïeng hajan jong ka . U sing um shym la bam ïa kata ka metïap lymne patar ïa ka kada .

translation.en: For whether we live , we live unto the Lord ; and whether we die , we die unto the Lord : whether we live therefore , or die , we are the Lord s .
translation.kha: Lada ngi im , ka long na ka bynta U Trai ba ngi im , bad lada ngi ïap , ka long na ka bynta U Trai ba ngi ïap . Kumta lada ngi im lane ngi ïap , ngi long ki jong U Trai .

translation.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls , O Jerusalem , which shall never hold their peace day nor night : ye that make mention of the  Lord  , keep not silence ,
translation.kha: Ha ki kynroh jong pha , ko Jerusalem , nga la buh ïa ki nongap phira ; mynsngi ne mynmiet kin ym sngap jar . Kin pynkynmaw ïa U  Trai  ïa ki kular jong u , bad kin ym shah ba un klet ïa ki .

translation.en: The aged women likewise , that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness , not false accusers , not given to much wine , teachers of good things ;
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh hikai ïa ki kynthei kiba la kham san ba kin im donakor kum ki kynthei kiba dei ban leh , kiba im ka jingim bakhuid . Kim dei ban long kiba kren siar lane kiba kyrni ha ka dih waiñ .

translation.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest , that he may bring her forth without the camp , and one shall slay her before his face :
translation.kha: bad kin ai ïa ka ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh . Dei ban ïalam ïa ka shabar ka jaka sher dara bad dei ban pynïap ïa ka hangta ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: And Laban said , It is better that I give her to thee , than that I should give her to another man : abide with me .
translation.kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Ka kham bha ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi ban ïa kaba nga ai ha uwei pat ; to sah hangne bad nga .

translation.en: All the brethren greet you . Greet ye one another with an holy kiss .
translation.kha: Baroh ki parabangeit hangne ki phah ka jingkhublei . To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit .

translation.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God , and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u Philip shaphang ka khubor babha jong ka Hima U Blei bad shaphang U Jisu Khrist , la pynbaptis ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , I will hear , saith the  Lord  , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan phah ïa u slap ba un hap ha ka khyndew

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when the kingdom was established to him , that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father .
translation.kha: Mar ïaskhem ha ka bor , u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba la pynïap ïa u kpa jong u .

translation.en: Then were they all of good cheer , and they also took some meat .
translation.kha: Ki la sngew ïoh mynsiem bad uwei uwei na ki ruh , ki la bam khyndiat ka jingbam .

translation.en: And every one had four faces : the first face was the face of a cherub , and the second face was the face of a man , and the third the face of a lion , and the fourth the face of an eagle .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei u kherub u don saw tylli ki durkhmat . Ka khmat kaba nyngkong ka dei ka jong u masi kyrtong , kaba ar ka jong u briew , kaba lai ka jong u sing , bad kaba saw ka jong u pukni .

translation.en: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed , I also was standing by , and consenting unto his death , and kept the raiment of them that slew him .
translation.kha: Bad haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , u sakhi jong me , nga hi nga la don hangta , nga da mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u bad nga da sumar ïa ki jaiñ jong ki nongpynïap ïa u .’

translation.en: Who needeth not daily , as those high priests , to offer up sacrifice , first for his own sins , and then for the people s : for this he did once , when he offered up himself .
translation.kha: Um long kum kiwei pat ki rangbah lyngdoh ; um da donkam ban da ai jingkñia man ka sngi na ka bynta ki pop jong u hi nyngkong ïa lade bad nangta na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew . U ai kawei ka jingkñia , tang shisien hi , haba u la kñia noh ïa lade .

translation.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man , neither be partaker of other men s sins : keep thyself pure .
translation.kha: To wat leh kyrkieh ha kaba buh ïa ki kti halor jongno jongno ban pynkyntang ïa u sha ka kam U Trai . To wat ïadon bynta ha ki pop jong kiwei ; to ri ïa lade uba sngur .

translation.en: He shall therefore burn that garment , whether warp or woof , in woollen or in linen , or any thing of skin , wherein the plague is : for it is a fretting leprosy  ; it shall be burnt in the fire .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang noh ïa ka , namar ka dei ka jingpang bthuh kaba pur , kaba dei ban pynduh da ka ding .

translation.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka gospel , nga long u nongkit  tiensyiem wat la mynta nga don ha ïingbyndi . To duwai ba nga lah ban long uba shlur ha ka jingkren shaphang ka gospel kumba nga dei .

translation.en: What is it then ? I will pray with the spirit , and I will pray with the understanding also : I will sing with the spirit , and I will sing with the understanding also .
translation.kha: Kaei ken kane ? Ngan duwai da ka mynsiem jong nga , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmut jong nga ; ngan rwai da la ka mynsiem , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmut jong nga .

translation.en: Seek the  Lord  and his strength , seek his face continually .
translation.kha: Leit sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad mane khlem kut .

translation.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment .
translation.kha: Ki nongbishar kiba bamsap ki pdiang ïa ki jingai ha kaba rieh , bad nangta kam don ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Dedan ki ïakylliang ïa ki jaiñ-jin na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin  ; but he slipped away out of Saul s presence , and he smote the javelin into the wall : and David fled , and escaped that night .
translation.kha: U Saul u thmu ban sum ïa u Dabid ha ka kynroh , hynrei u Dabid u kynriah , bad uta u sum u sahkut ha ka kynroh . U Dabid u phet ïap bad u lait im .

translation.en: And they said unto me , The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach : the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down , and the gates thereof are burned with fire .
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ïa nga ba kito kiba dang im bad kiba la poi biang ha la ka jong ka ri , ki don hapdeng ka jingeh bakhraw bad ba ki nongwei kiba shong basah marjan , ki peitbeiñ ïa ki . Ki ïathuh ruh ïa nga ba ki kynroh ka Jerusalem ki la pra bad ba ïa ki khyrdop ym shym la pynbha pat naduh ka por ba la thang ïa ki .

translation.en: But the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon Gideon , and he blew a trumpet  ; and Abi–ezer was gathered after him .
translation.kha: U mynsiem jong U  Trai  u bat synshar ïa u Gideon ; bad u put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki rangbah na ka kur Abieser ban bud ïa u .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki la long ki syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Mikah , uba na ka shnong Moresheth . U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha u Mikah ïa kine kiei kiei baroh shaphang ka Samaria bad ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: There is no healing of thy bruise  ; thy wound is grievous : all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee : for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually ?
translation.kha: Ym don jingpynkoit ei ei ïa ki jingmynsaw jong me , bad ïa ki jingmong jong me ym lah ban pynkoit . Baroh kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingpynjot ïa me ki thap ïa la ki kti ha ka jingkmen . Hato uno uno un lait phet na ka jinglong runar bymkut jong me ?

translation.en: The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her ,  Thou hast well said , I have no husband :
translation.kha: Ngam don tnga ,  ka la jubab . U Jisu u la phai ktien ,  Ka long kaba dei haba pha ong ba pham don tnga .

translation.en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of his father , and in the way of his mother , and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin :
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh basniew jong u Ahab u kpa jong u , ka Jesebel ka kmie jong u , bad jong u syiem Jeroboam , kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house , being a leper  ; for he was cut off from the house of the  Lord  : and Jotham his son was over the king s house , judging the people of the land .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim ba dang sah jong u syiem Ussaïah , u la long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ka jingpang jong u . Namar ba um lah shuh ban rung sha ka Templ u shong u sah ha la ka ïing , khlem da leh shuh ïa la ki kamram , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u synshar ïa ka ri .

translation.en: For even hereunto were ye called : because Christ also suffered for us , leaving us an example , that ye should follow his steps :
translation.kha: Ka dei ïa kane ba U Blei u la khot ïa phi , naba U Khrist hi u la shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi bad u la iehnoh ha phi ïa ka nuksa , khnang ba phin bud ha ki dien jat jong u .

translation.en: And here men that die receive tithes  ; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki lyngdoh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da ki briew kiba dei ban ïap ; hynrei ïa u Melkhisedek ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da uta uba im , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .

translation.en: And he stooping down , and looking in , saw the linen clothes lying  ; yet went he not in .
translation.kha: U la dem bad u la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen , hynrei um shym la rung shapoh .

translation.en: If he will contend with him , he cannot answer him one of a thousand .
translation.kha: Da kumno uno uno u lah ban ïasaid bad u ? U lah ban kylli shihajar tylli ki jingkylli , ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban jubab .

translation.en: And the  Lord  passed by before him , and proclaimed , The  Lord  , The  Lord  God , merciful and gracious , longsuffering , and abundant in goodness and truth ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïaid na khmat jong u , bad u pynbna ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei uba dap da ka jinglehsbun bad jinglehisynei , uba suki ban bitar bad uba pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ïa ka jingïaineh skhem .

translation.en: Then shall ye do unto him , as he had thought to have done unto his brother : so shalt thou put the evil away from among you .
translation.kha: u dei ban shah pynshitom kumba u thmu ban leh ïa la u para . Da kumta phin rat noh ïa kane ka jingbymman .

translation.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment : the waters stood above the mountains .
translation.kha: Me buh ïa ka duriaw-bah halor jong ka kum ka barandi , bad ka um ka tap ïa ki lumbah .

translation.en: But beware of men : for they will deliver you up to the councils , and they will scourge you in their synagogues  ;
translation.kha: To sumar , naba kin don ki briew ki ban kem ïa phi bad ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , bad kin sympat ïa phi ha ki synagog .

translation.en: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation , in all the wealth which God shall give Israel : and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever .
translation.kha: Te yn pynkordit ïa me bad men peit da ka jingsngewpihuiñ haba me ïohi ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha kiwei pat ki briew jong ka Israel , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na ka ïing jong me u ban im tymmen .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , that this generation shall not pass , till all these things be done .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei kin jia shuwa ba ki briew kiba dang im mynta , ki la ïap noh .

translation.en: Are they Hebrews ? so am I . Are they Israelites ? so am I . Are they the seed of Abraham ? so am I .
translation.kha: Hato ki long ki Hebru ? Nga ruh nga long . Hato ki long ki Israel ? Nga ruh nga long . Hato ki long kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham ? Nga ruh nga long .

translation.en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour  ; but shalt fear thy God .
translation.kha: Wat pynshitom beiñ ïa ki , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace ? and when thou mockest , shall no man make thee ashamed ?
translation.kha: Ko Job , hato me pyrkhat ba ngim lah ban jubab ïa me ? Ba ki kyntien beiñ jong me kin ieh ïa ngi ban nym nang kren shuh ?

translation.en: Ye that fear the  Lord  , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
translation.kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi baroh kiba mane ïa u . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .

translation.en: Therefore be ye also ready : for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phi dei ban long kiba ïai pynkhreh , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta kaba phim shym khmih lynti ïa u .

translation.en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath , and bringing in sheaves , and lading asses  ; as also wine , grapes , and figs , and all manner of burdens , which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day : and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga ïohi ba ki briew ha Judah ki khñiot umsoh na ki sohwaiñ ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Kiwei pat ki dang kyntiew halor ki kada jong ki ïa u kew , ka waiñ , sohwaiñ , soh Khajur , bad kiwei kiei kiei bad leit rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem ; nga la maham ïa ki ban ym die ei ei ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: Woe to the rebellious children , saith the  Lord  , that take counsel , but not of me  ; and that cover with a covering , but not of my spirit , that they may add sin to sin :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren :  Kito kiba synshar ïa ka Judah kin jot noh namar ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki bud ïa ki jingthmu kiba ngam shym la shna , bad ki soi ïa ki jingïateh kular pyrshah ïa ka mon jong nga , da kaba kynton kawei ka pop halor kawei pat .

translation.en: They come to encourage us .
translation.kha: Ki wan ban pynshlur ïa ngi .

translation.en: And so I saw the wicked buried , who had come and gone from the place of the holy , and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done : this is also vanity .
translation.kha: Ho-oid nga la ïohi ïa ki riewbymman ba la tep bad hapoh ki jingtep jong ki , hynrei ha ka lynti leit phai na lum jingtep ki briew ki ïaroh ïa ki ha kata ka nongbah ha kaba ki la leh ïa ki kam sniew jong ki . Ka long ka bym don jingmut .

translation.en: So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u lumlang ïa ki paid Israel na baroh kawei ka ri , naduh khappud Ijipt ha ka phang shathie sha Khim Hamath ha ka phang shatei , khnang ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang na Kiriath Jearim sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then he asked the men of that place , saying , Where is the harlot , that was openly by the way side ? And they said , There was no harlot in this place .
translation.kha: U la kylli na ki katto katne ki rangbah ha Enaim ,  Shano kato ka nuti kaba don hangne harud lynti ?   Ym ju don nuti hangne ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: But the other of love , knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat , kim ïalap ïa U Khrist da kaba sngur , hynrei na ka mynsiem ka jingkwah rhah ; ba ki da pyrkhat ba kin nang pynjynjar shuh shuh ïa nga katba nga dang don ha byndi .

translation.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye , and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pyrkhat tang ïa lade ki kyrkieh ban ïoh spah ha kaba kim tip lano ka jingduk kan lap .

translation.en: Liars will not enter God’s Kingdom .
translation.kha: Kiba lamler kin ym ïoh rung ha ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem , and to Tobijah , and to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the temple of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka pansngiat kan long ka jingpynsah kynmaw ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  ha ka jingñiewburom ïa u Heldai , u Tobijah , u Jedaïah , bad u Josaïah .

translation.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness , that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap ba ngan ym rah ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri bakynsai tam na baroh .

translation.en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did , and they divided the land .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la bynta ïa ka ri kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: ( James 1 :27  ; 4 :4 ) Can you identify a religious group in your community that has these marks of true Christianity ?
translation.kha: ( Jakob 1 :27 ; 4 :4 ) Phi lah mo ban ithuh ïa ka kynhun ha shnong jong phi kaba don kum kine ki dak jong ka jinglong Khristan bashisha ?

translation.en: And thou say in thine heart , My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth .
translation.kha: Husiar ïoh phi ong ha lade , ‘ Ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga hi ki la pynriewspah katne ïa nga .’

translation.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Declare unto us this parable .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kren ,  To batai ïa kane ka jingong ha ngi .

translation.en: And Pharaoh s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand .
translation.kha: Nga la bat ïa ka khuri jong u syiem ; kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki sohwaiñ bad nga khem ïa ki ha kata ka khuri , bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u .

translation.en: There is a league between me and thee , as there was between my father and thy father : behold , I have sent thee silver and gold  ; go , break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me .
translation.kha: To ngin ïalong paralok , kumba ki kpa jong ngi ki la ïalong . Kane ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki long ka jingai sngewbha ïa phi . Mynta pynkheiñ noh ïa ka jingïateh lok bad u Baasha u syiem Israel khnang ba un weng noh ïa ki shipai jong u na ka ri jong nga .

translation.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was in quiet : and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king s house .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la dap da ka jingkmen , bad ka nongbah ka kynjah , naba mynta la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: But I will hope continually , and will yet praise thee more and more .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me , ngan ïaroh ïa me shuh shuh .

translation.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades , or loose the bands of Orion ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban teh lang ïa ki Pleïades    , ne pynsynjor ïa ki jingkhum kiba teh ïa u Orion    ?

translation.en: Therefore sent he thither horses , and chariots , and a great host : and they came by night , and compassed the city about .
translation.kha: u phah shata ïa ka kynhun babun ryngkat bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ki la poi ha ka nongbah mynmiet bad ki kerkut ïa ka .

translation.en: Behold also the ships , which though they be so great , and are driven of fierce winds , yet are they turned about with a very small helm , whithersoever the governor listeth .
translation.kha: Lane to pyrkhat ïa ka lieng kaba heh : La ka heh katno katno bad la pynïaid ïa ka da ki lyer bakhlaiñ , la ñiah ïa ka da u boitha uba rit eh , bad ka ïaid kat shaba u nongking lieng u mon ba kan leit .

translation.en: Or what man is there of you , whom if his son ask bread , will he give him a stone ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi uba long u kpa un ai ïa la u khun da u maw haba u pan ïa u kpu ?

translation.en: And the people flew upon the spoil , and took sheep , and oxen , and calves , and slew them on the ground : and the people did eat them with the blood .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por ki Israel ki la tlot palat na ka jingthngan , bad kumta ki la kynrup ïa kata kaba ki la ïohknieh na ki nongshun , ki la shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri , ki la pynïap ïa ki hangta , bad ki la bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: And Joseph fell upon his father s face , and wept upon him , and kissed him .
translation.kha: U Joseph u dem kynsan ha ka met u kpa , u da ïam , bad doh ïa u .

translation.en: But them that are without God judgeth . Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person .
translation.kha: Wat la katta , kam dei ka kamram jong nga ban bishar ïa kiba nabar . U Blei un sa bishar ïa ki . Hynrei hato kam dei ban bishar ïa ki dkhot na la ka jong ka kynhun hi ? Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Pynmih noh ïa u briew uba sniew na ka kynhun jong phi .

translation.en: The bows of the mighty men are broken , and they that stumbled are girded with strength .
translation.kha: Ïa ki ryntieh jong ki shipai kiba khlaiñ la pynkheiñ , hynrei kiba tlot ki ïohbor .

translation.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance  ; but she of her want did cast in all that she had , even all her living .
translation.kha: Naba kiwei ki la pynnoh ïa kaei kaba tam na ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la pynnoh ïa baroh kaba ka don — ka la ai ïa baroh kaba kyrshan ïa ka jingim jong ka .

translation.en: After sin and death entered the world , God revealed that it was his purpose that the dead be restored to life by means of a resurrection .
translation.kha: Hadien ka pop bad ka jingiap ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , U Blei u la pynpaw ba ka long ka jingthmu jong u , ba kiba iap kin ioh biang ia ka jingim da ka jingmihpat .

translation.en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia : and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh u ïeng na ka bynta ka hima Gris , bad ka reng kaba paw bha hapdeng ki khmat jong u ka dei u syiem banyngkong .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have spoken vanity , and seen lies , therefore , behold , I am against you , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha ki ,  Ki ktien jong phi ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïohipaw jong phi ki long kiba lamler . Nga long pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: And now , behold , I have brought the firstfruits of the land , which thou , O  Lord  , hast given me . And thou shalt set it before the  Lord  thy God , and worship before the  Lord  thy God :
translation.kha: Kumta nga wallam mynta sha U  Trai  ïa u soh nyngkong na ka jingot ba u la ai ha nga .’  Nangta buh ïa ka shang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  bad mane hangta .

translation.en: Ye have sown much , and bring in little  ; ye eat , but ye have not enough  ; ye drink , but ye are not filled with drink  ; ye clothe you , but there is none warm  ; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes .
translation.kha: Phi la bet shibun u kew , hynrei phi la ot tang khyndiat . Phi don ka bam ban bam , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynkdang ïa phi . Phi don ka waiñ ban dih , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynbuaid ïa phi ! Phi don ki jaiñkup , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynsyaid ïa phi . Bad u nongtrei um lah ban kamai kat ban biang ban im .

translation.en: For what shall it profit a man , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew u ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei lada u ïoh ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em , un ym ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei !

translation.en: And the angel said unto him , Gird thyself , and bind on thy sandals . And so he did . And he saith unto him , Cast thy garment about thee , and follow me .
translation.kha: Te u angel u la ong ,  To panpoh ïa lade bad phong ïa la ki juti .  U Petros u la leh kumta , bad u angel u la ong ,  To tawah ïa la ka jaiñkup sawdong jong me bad wan bad nga .

translation.en: In my Father s house are many mansions : if it were not so , I would have told you . I go to prepare a place for you .
translation.kha: Don shibun ki kamra ha ka ïing U Kpa jong nga , bad ngan leit ban pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi . Ngan ym jin da la ïathuh ïa phi lada kam long kumta .

translation.en: I Tertius , who wrote this epistle , salute you in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ma nga , u Tertios , uba thoh ïa kane ka shithi , nga phah ïa phi ki jingkhublei parabangeit .

translation.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom , which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist .
translation.kha: namar ngan ai ha phi ki kyntien bad ka jingstad kiba ym don na ki nongshun jong phi kiba lah ban kyntait lane ïa-pyrshah ïa kaei kaba phi ong .

translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  But now , he that hath a purse , let him take it , and likewise his scrip : and he that hath no sword , let him sell his garment , and buy one .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  uno uno uba don ka pla pisa lane ka pla u dei ban rah ïa ka ; bad uno uno u bym don ka waitlam u dei ban die noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u bad thied kawei .

translation.en: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose : and thou shalt turn in the morning , and go unto thy tents .
translation.kha: Shet ïa ka doh bad bam ïa ka ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ; bad ha ka step kaba bud , leit phai noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: Awake , awake  ; put on thy strength , O Zion  ; put on thy beautiful garments , O Jerusalem , the holy city : for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to long khlaiñ bad long khraw biang ! Ko nongbah Bakhuid jong U Blei , to kup ïa lade da ka burom ! Kiba mane blei thala kin ym ïohrung shuh da lei lei lyngba ki khyrdop jong pha .

translation.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work , and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom : to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai un pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingmynsaw baroh bad un ri pynim bad ïalam ïa nga sha ka hima jong u ha bneng .

translation.en: Appoint a way , that the sword may come to Rabbah of the Ammonites , and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced .
translation.kha: Kawei ka dak kan pyn-i ïa u syiem ïa ka lynti sha Rabbah ka nongbah ki Ammon , bad kawei pat ka lynti sha Judah , sha Jerusalem ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh .

translation.en: Then he sheweth them their work , and their transgressions that they have exceeded .
translation.kha: U Blei u pyn-i ha ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïa ka jingsarong jong ki .

translation.en: Yea , truth faileth  ; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey : and the  Lord  saw it , and it displeased him that there was no judgment .
translation.kha: Ka jinglonghok ka la nang duna katta katta ba uno uno uba kiar na kaba leh bymman u shem ïa lade ba u long u lanot jong ka kam runar .  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kane , bad ka la pynsngewsih ïa u ba ym don shuh ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Unto whom it was revealed , that not unto themselves , but unto us they did minister the things , which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven  ; which things the angels desire to look into .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynpaw ha kine ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka jingtrei jong ki kam shym la long na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , katba ki dang lah kren shaphang kito kiei kiei ïa kiba phi la ïohsngew mynta na ki nonglamktien kiba la pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ba la phah na bneng . Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba wat ki angel ki thrang ban shemphang .

translation.en: He will keep the feet of his saints , and the wicked shall be silent in darkness  ; for by strength shall no man prevail .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa ka jingim jong kito kiba shaniah ha u , hynrei kiba bymman kin shu jah lngaid ha ka jingdum ; u briew u jop ym da ka bor la jong .

translation.en: Yea , they shall not be planted  ; yea , they shall not be sown : yea , their stock shall not take root in the earth : and he shall also blow upon them , and they shall wither , and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble .
translation.kha: Ki long tang kum ki jingthung ba dang lung , ba dang shu mih bad bym pat suhthied , haba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka lyer , ki tyrkhong noh bad kit noh kum u phlangïap .

translation.en: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh , despise dominion , and speak evil of dignities .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ruh , kine ki briew ki ïoh ïa ki jingïohipaw kiba pynlong ïa ki ban leh pop pyrshah ïa la ki jong ki met ; ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingsynshar jong U Blei bad ki ïakren beiñ ïa ki jingthaw badonburom ha bneng .

translation.en: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered . Fear not therefore : ye are of more value than many sparrows .
translation.kha: Wat ïa ki shñiuh jong ka khlieh jong phi la dep ñiew baroh . Kumta to wat sheptieng ; phi kham kor bun shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïing !

translation.en: The  Lord  is on my side  ; I will not fear : what can man do unto me ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don bad nga , ngan ym sheptieng ; u briew un lah leh aïu ïa nga ?

translation.en: Yea , they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils ,
translation.kha: Ki la ai ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei kum ki jingkñia ha ki bleithaw jong ka Kanaan .

translation.en: Both riches and honour come of thee , and thou reignest over all  ; and in thine hand is power and might  ; and in thine hand it is to make great , and to give strength unto all .
translation.kha: Ka spah baroh ka wan na me ; me synshar halor kiei kiei baroh da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka bor jong me , bad me lah ban pynlong ïano ïano uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord  God  : for the day of the  Lord  is at hand : for the  Lord  hath prepared a sacrifice , he hath bid his guests .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan haba U  Trai  un shong ha ka jingbishar ; kumta to sngap jar ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U  Trai  u pynkhreh ban kñia ïa ki briew jong u bad u la khot sngewbha ïa ki nongshun ban lute ïa ka Judah .

translation.en: For unto me the children of Israel are servants  ; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: U Israel um lah ban long u mraw baroh shi rta , namar ki Israel ki long ki mraw jong U  Trai . U wallam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt ; u long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba long U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And when he came to himself , he said , How many hired servants of my father s have bread enough and to spare , and I perish with hunger !
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la kyndit bynriew bad u la ong , ‘ Baroh ki nongtrei wai jong i pa jong nga ki don kyrhai ban ïa kaba ki lah ban bam , bad nga pat hangne ngan sa ïapthngan !

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Take heed to yourselves , and bear no burden on the sabbath day , nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba lada ki ieit ïa la ka jingim , kim dei ban kit kano kano ka jingkit ha ka Sabbaton ; kim dei ban rah ïa kano kano shapoh lyngba ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem

translation.en: And this stone , which I have set for a pillar , shall be God s house : and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee .
translation.kha: Une u maw buh jingkynmaw ïa uba nga la thung un long ka jaka ha kaba ïa me yn mane , bad ngan ai sha me ïa kaba shiphew na kiei kiei baroh kiba me ai ïa nga .

translation.en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you , and Mark , sister s son to Barnabas , ( touching whom ye received commandments : if he come unto you , receive him ; )
translation.kha: U Aristarkhos , uba ha byndi lem bad nga , u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , bad kumta ruh u Markos , u bakha jong u Barnabas . ( Phi la da ïohpdiang lypa ïa ki jingbthah ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u Markos lada u wan sha phi . )

translation.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him , dark waters , and thick clouds of the skies .
translation.kha: U kah ïa lade da ka jingdum ; ki lyoh barben , kiba dap da ka um , ki ker sawdong ïa u ;

translation.en: Some remove the landmarks  ; they violently take away flocks , and feed thereof .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki pynkynriah ïa ki mawpud ban kurup jaka shuh ; ki tuh ïa ki langbrot bad buh ïa ki ha la ki jong ki kynhun jong ki .

translation.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst  ; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them : for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them , even by the springs of water shall he guide them .
translation.kha: Kin ym shahthngan lane sliang shuh . Ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad ka ri shyiap kin ym pynjynjar ïa ki , namar yn ïalam ïa ki da uta uba ieit ïa ki . Un ïalam ïa ki sha ki umpohliew .

translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded Moses in mount Sinai , in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the  Lord  , in the wilderness of Sinai .
translation.kha: Hangta halor u Lum Sinai ha ka ri shyiap , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Moses ha kata ka sngi ba u la ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh jong ki .

translation.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone ;
translation.kha: Ïa phi ruh , la tei ha ka nongrim ba la buh da ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa , u mawdong uba long U Khrist Jisu hi .

translation.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth ? declare if thou knowest it all .
translation.kha: Hato me don jingtip haduh katno ka heh ka pyrthei ? To jubab ïa nga lada me tip .

translation.en: Take thou no usury of him , or increase : but fear thy God  ; that thy brother may live with thee .
translation.kha: Wat shim sut ei ei na u , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad shah ïa uta u para Israel jong phi ban shong marjan bad phi .

translation.en: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place  ; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies , and by the hands of them that seek their lives : and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka jaka ngan pynpulom ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban risa halor jong ki bad pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma . Ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki ha ki sim bad ha ki mradkhlaw kum ka jingbam .

translation.en: And mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  that smiteth .
translation.kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha lane pyn-i kano kano ka jingisynei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli kiba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad dei ma nga uba pynshitom ïa pha .

translation.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country : and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka pur kylleng ki rudnong , bad kham bun ki rangbah ki la ïap ha khlaw ban ïa kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: It is good neither to eat flesh , nor to drink wine , nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth , or is offended , or is made weak .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei ban ym bam doh , dih waiñ , lane ban leh kano kano ka ban pynlong ïa la u parabangeit ban kyllon noh .

translation.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people , that they should be ready against that day .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingthoh ha ka jingpynbna dei ban pyntip paidbah ha kawei pa kawei ka probins , khnang ba baroh kin long ba la pynkhreh haba kata ka sngi kan wan .

translation.en: For by him were all things created , that are in heaven , and that are in earth , visible and invisible , whether they be thrones , or dominions , or principalities , or powers : all things were created by him , and for him :
translation.kha: Namar da u , U Blei u la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew , kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïohi bad kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi , kynthup ïa ki bor ba kynja mynsiem , ki kynrad , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor synshar . U Blei u la thaw ïa ka jingpynlong baroh kawei da u na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth , when ye shall see Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , and all the prophets , in the kingdom of God , and you yourselves thrust out .
translation.kha: A katno phin ïam bad kyr-iat ïa la ki bniat haba phi ïohi ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka Hima U Blei , katba ïa phi la bret noh shabar !

translation.en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about , and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place :
translation.kha: Hadien kata , un phah khrud ïa ki kynroh baroh hapoh ïing , bad bret ïa kata ka khyndew shabar shnong ha ka jaka theh ñiut .

translation.en: Yea , thou shalt go forth from him , and thine hands upon thine head : for the  Lord  hath rejected thy confidences , and thou shalt not prosper in them .
translation.kha: Phin phai noh na ka Ijipt , da kaba sdien ïa ka khlieh jong phi ha ka jinglehrain . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kyntait ïa kito kiba phi la shaniah ; phin ym ïoh kano kano ka jingmyntoi na ki .

translation.en: An end is come , the end is come : it watcheth for thee  ; behold , it is come .
translation.kha: Kan wan halor jong pha baroh . Kane ka long kaba kut . Phan sa jot noh .

translation.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick .
translation.kha: Dei ban don uwei u shylluit syntiew hapoh , ha trai jong ki lai jur ki tnat .

translation.en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me ? because he humbleth himself before me , I will not bring the evil in his days : but in his son s days will I bring the evil upon his house .
translation.kha: Me la ïohi ne em kumno u Ahab u la pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga ? Namar ba u la leh kumne , ngan ym pynjot ïa u katba u dang im ; kan long ha ka pateng u khun jong u , ba ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ka longïing jong u Ahab .

translation.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , ka dang ïaisah hi ka jingjahthait ïa ki briew jong U Blei kumba U Blei u shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew .

translation.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold , and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate .
translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki dong kiba shaneng jong ka jingdeng shadem ,

translation.en: They that were foolish took their lamps , and took no oil with them :
translation.kha: Kita kiba bieit ki la rah ïa la ki sharak hynrei kim shym la rah tam ïa ka umphniang bad ki ,

translation.en: For whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee  ; or to say , Arise , and walk ?
translation.kha: Hato ka kham suk ban ong , ‘ La map ïa ki pop jong me ,’ lane ban ong , ‘ To ïeng joit bad to ïaid ?’

translation.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory , and my miracles , which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness , and have tempted me now these ten times , and have not hearkened to my voice  ;
translation.kha: yn ym don uwei ruh na kine ki briew ki ban im ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri . Ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ na ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , bad ïa ki kambah ba nga la leh ha Ijipt bad ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei ki la tynjuh ïa ka jingïaishah jong nga la bunsien bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga .
