translation.en: And they called the name of the city Dan , after the name of Dan their father , who was born unto Israel : howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first .
translation.kha: Ki pynkylla kyrteng ïa ka Laish sha ka Dan , kum ka kyrteng u kpa tymmen u Dan , u khun jong u Jakob .

translation.en: Even the very dust of your city , which cleaveth on us , we do wipe off against you : notwithstanding be ye sure of this , that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat ïa u pui pui na ka shnong jong phi uba dambit ha ki kjat jong ngi , ngi ñiad noh pyrshah ïa phi . Hynrei kynmaw ba ka Hima U Blei ka la wan hajan jong phi !’

translation.en: And they glorified God in me .
translation.kha: Bad ki ïaroh ïa U Blei ha nga .

translation.en: I have not spoken in secret , in a dark place of the earth : I said not unto the seed of Jacob , Seek ye me in vain : I the  Lord  speak righteousness , I declare things that are right .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kren ha kaba rieh lane buhrieh ïa ka jingthmu jong nga . Ngam shym la dawa na u paid Israel ban khmih ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la iehnoh suda . Nga long U  Trai  , bad nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ; nga pynlong ban tip ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: He blesseth them also , so that they are multiplied greatly  ; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease .
translation.kha: U kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki don bun ki khun ki kti ; u pynlong ba ki jingri jingdup jong ki kin ym duna .

translation.en: And Abram took Sarai his wife , and Lot his brother s son , and all their substance that they had gathered , and the souls that they had gotten in Haran  ; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan  ; and into the land of Canaan they came .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shim ïa ka Sarai ka tnga jong u , bad ïa u Lot u pyrsa jong u , bad ïa ka spah ka phew baroh , bad ïa ki mraw baroh ba ki la lah ïoh ha Haran , bad ki la ïamihnoh ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people ; there shall they be called the children of the living God .
translation.kha: Bad ha kata hi ka jaka ha kaba ki la ong , ‘Phim dei ki briew jong nga .’ Hangta yn khot ïa ki , ki khun jong U Blei ba-im .

translation.en: I speak to your shame . Is it so , that there is not a wise man among you ? no , not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren ?
translation.kha: Ka long kaba sngewlehrain ïa phi! Da shisha yn don la kumno kumno u briew uba stad ha ka kynhun jong phi uba lah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia hapdeng ki parabangeit .

translation.en: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed : then he wrote the dream , and told the sum of the matters .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong kaba u Belshassar u long u syiem ka Babilonia , nga la phohsniew bad nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet . Nga la thoh ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad kane ka dei ka jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohi ha kata ka miet :

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I have lifted up mine hand , Surely the heathen that are about you , they shall bear their shame .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga kular kyntang ba ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong kin shah pynpoh .

translation.en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me , but walk contrary unto me  ;
translation.kha: Lada hadien kat kane phim treh ban shahshkor ïa nga bad phi dang ïai pyrshah hi ïa nga ,

translation.en: It cannot be gotten for gold , neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof .
translation.kha: Ym lah ban thied da ka rupa lane ka ksiar .

translation.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother , and saith , It is no transgression  ; the same is the companion of a destroyer .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat ba kam long kaba bakla ban tuh na la ki kmie ki kpa um long kham bha ban ïa u nongtuh uba la ju mlien .

translation.en: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues , and talked with me , saying , Come hither , I will shew thee the bride , the Lamb s wife .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki angel uba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang kiba dap da ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam kiba khatduh u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,  To wan , bad ngan pyn-i ha me ïa ka Nongleitkurim , ka tnga jong U Khunlangbrot .

translation.en: Then saith Jesus unto him ,  Get thee hence , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la jubab ,  Khie leit noh , ko Soitan ! Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ To mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong me bad shakri tang ïa u hi !’

translation.en: For the  Lord  had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech , because of Sarah Abraham s wife .
translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba la jia ha ka Sarah , ka tnga jong u Abraham , U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei baroh ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Abimelekh . Kumta u Abraham u duwai na ka bynta u Abimelekh , bad U Blei u la pynkhiah ïa u . U la pynkhiah ruh ïa ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ki mraw kynthei jong u , ba kumta ki ruh ki lah ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon , and all Israel with him , and they besieged Tirzah .
translation.kha: U Omri bad ki shipai jong u ki mihnoh na Gibbethon bad leit kerkut ïa ka Tirsah .

translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel , and they fled every man to his tent .
translation.kha: ka kynhun shipai Judia ka la shahjop , bad ki shipai ki la phet sha la ki ïing .

translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the bloody city , to the pot whose scum is therein , and whose scum is not gone out of it ! bring it out piece by piece  ; let no lot fall upon it .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ka nongbah jong ki nongpynïap briew ba la tim ! Ka long kum u khiew ba sarang u bym ju pynkhuid . Ïa kawei hadien kawei ka dkhot doh la sei shabar , bad ym shym pynsah kawei ruh .

translation.en: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies , and the  Lord  thy God hath delivered them into thine hands , and thou hast taken them captive ,
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynjop thma ïa phi bad phi ïohkem koidi ,

translation.en: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion , and the  Lord  will discover their secret parts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki — Ngan khi ïa ki khlieh jong ki bad ngan ieh lyndum ïa ki .

translation.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand ,  Stand forth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Wan shane sha khmat .

translation.en: A sword is upon their horses , and upon their chariots , and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her  ; and they shall become as women : a sword is upon her treasures  ; and they shall be robbed .
translation.kha: Pynjot ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ka ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai ba shu wai — Katno ki long kiba tlot ! Pynjot ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka ; lute bad rong noh .

translation.en: Wherefore remember , that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh , who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands ;
translation.kha: Phi ïa kiba la kha kum ki Jentil — ïa kiba la khot  ki bymotsher  da ki Jiw , kiba ïa lade pat ki khot  kiba la otsher  (kaba thew ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki leh ha ki met jong ki) — to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi la long mynshuwa .

translation.en: Be strong and of a good courage : for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land , which I sware unto their fathers to give them .
translation.kha: Kut jingmut triang bad long skhem , namar men long u nongïalam jong kine ki briew katba ki shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast , and ye be disposed to go ; whatsoever is set before you , eat , asking no question for conscience sake .
translation.kha: Lada u bymngeit u khot bam sngewbha ïa phi bad phi mon ban leit , bam ïa kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi , khlem kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .

translation.en: And all the elders of that city , that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley :
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam baroh na kata ka shnong kaba jan eh bad ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin thet ïa la ki kti halor kata ka masi ,

translation.en: As it is written , Jacob have I loved , but Esau have I hated .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la ieit ïa u Jakob , hynrei nga la isih ïa u Iso .

translation.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit , neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
translation.kha: U dieng uba plung bha um lah ban pynmih ki soh kiba sniew , bad u dieng uba swai um lah ban pynmih ki soh kiba bha .

translation.en: So that servant came , and shewed his lord these things . Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant , Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in hither the poor , and the maimed , and the halt , and the blind .
translation.kha: U shakri u la leit phai bad u la ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u kynrad jong u . U kynrad u la bitar shla bad u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ To leit kloi sha ki lynti bah bad ki lynti rit jong ka nongbah , bad wallam ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba matlah , bad kiba dkoh .’

translation.en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple : and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him .
translation.kha: bad haba ki la ithuh ïa u kum u nongkhrong uba la ju shong ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , baroh ki la kyndit bad lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u .

translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh satia .

translation.en: And thou shalt be blessed  ; for they cannot recompense thee : for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just .
translation.kha: bad men long uba la kyrkhu , namar kim lah ban siew kylliang ïa me . U Blei un siew pat ïa me ha ka sngi ba ki briew kiba bha ki mihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Gezer with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: La ai ha ki , saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Shekhem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ha ka ri lum Ephraim ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Geser ,

translation.en: And David took the head of the Philistine , and brought it to Jerusalem  ; but he put his armour in his tent .
translation.kha: U Dabid u shim ïa ka khlieh u Goliath bad u rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem , hynrei u buh ïa ki atiar u Goliath ha la ka dara .

translation.en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field , and from the land of Moab  ; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses : none shall tread with shouting  ; their shouting shall be no shouting .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingkmen la shim noh na ki jaka baseisoh jong ka Moab . Nga la pynlong ïa ka waiñ ban sangeh ban tuid na ki jaka khñiot waiñ ; ym don shuh mano mano ba shna ïa ka waiñ bad ban pyrta da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them : thus were all these cities .
translation.kha: Na ka ri ba ki Israel ki la ïoh , la ai ha ki Lebi sawphew phra tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: While the sun , or the light , or the moon , or the stars , be not darkened , nor the clouds return after the rain :
translation.kha: Kata ka long haba ka jingshai jong ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur kan sdang lip ïa phi , bad ki lyoh slap kin ym leit noh da lei lei .

translation.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God unto thee , and to thy seed after thee .
translation.kha: Ngan bat ïa la ka kular bad me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ki ban dang wan ba kan long ka jutang kaba ïaineh junom . Ngan long U Blei jong me bad U Blei jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me .

translation.en: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field , and hast forgot a sheaf in the field , thou shalt not go again to fetch it : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa u kew bad phi kum klet shi song ha lyngkha , wat leit tam shuh ïa u ; ieh ïa u hangta na ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ka kam jong phi baroh .

translation.en: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent  ; for they shall march with an army , and come against her with axes , as hewers of wood .
translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka phet krad , ka pyrsad kum u bseiñ , katba ka kynhun shipai u nongshun ka wan tur . Ki tur ïaleh ïa ka da ki sdie , kum ki rangbah kiba pom ïa ki dieng bad kiba pynjot ïa ka khlaw barben .

translation.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
translation.kha: Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba kit ki jingiwbih , ki mawlynnai , bad shibun ka ksiar . Ynda ka ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli ïa u ïa ki jingkylli baroh kat kiba ka lah ban pyrkhat .

translation.en: And when the tempter came to him , he said , If thou be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread .
translation.kha: Te u Soitan u la wan ha U bad u la ong ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa kine ki maw ban kylla kpu .

translation.en: They are all adulterers , as an oven heated by the baker , who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough , until it be leavened .
translation.kha: Baroh ki long kiba shetkylla bad ki bym lah shaniah . Ka jingisih jong ki , ka ing suki kum ka ding ha ka tyndur , ka bym shym la pynkhih da u nongshet kpu haduh ba u  purew u lah long ban shet .

translation.en: That in blessing I will bless thee , and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven , and as the sand which is upon the sea shore  ; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies  ;
translation.kha: nga kular ba ngan ai ha me ïa ki khun ki ksiew kat ki khlur ka sahit bneng , lane kat ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw . Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: For meat destroy not the work of God . All things indeed are pure ; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence .
translation.kha: To wat pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh , na ka daw ka jingbam . Ki jingbam baroh ki long kiba lah ban bam , hynrei ka long ka bym dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka ban pynlong ïano ïano ban hap ha ka pop .

translation.en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ki shabi jong ka Hima ki bneng , kaei kaba me khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ïa ka ha bneng , bad kaei kaba me shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ïa ka ha bneng .

translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , like as did the house of Ahab : for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife : and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U bud ïa ka jingleh bymman jong u Syiem Ahab bad kiwei pat ki syiem Israel , namar u la shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong u Ahab , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner  ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
translation.kha: bad ki la phah ïa kane ka shithi harum lyngba jong ki :  Ma ngi , ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ki hynmen ki para jong phi , ngi phah ki jingkhublei ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi kiba la kha na ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Antiokh , ha Syria bad ha Kilikia .

translation.en: Again I will build thee , and thou shalt be built , O virgin of Israel : thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets , and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ngan tei ïa phi . Sa shisien pat phin shim ïa ki kanjari bad phin shad da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them , nor be an help nor profit , but a shame , and also a reproach .
translation.kha: ki briew jong ka Judah kin babe ba ki la shaniah ha kata ka hima ka bym lah ban shaniah , ka hima ka bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki haba ki khmih lynti ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: In contrast , consider how just two Bible proverbs help us to see what is important to happiness .
translation.kha: Ha ba ia nujor bad pyrkhat kumno artylli na ki kitab jong ka Proberb ka iarap ia ngi , kaei kaba donkam ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ .

translation.en: And his master saw that the  Lord  was with him , and that the  Lord  made all that he did to prosper in his hand .
translation.kha: U la shong la sah ha ka ïing jong u nong Ijipt uba long u kynrad jong u , uba la ïohi ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad ba u la pynmanbha ïa u ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: They answering said , John the Baptist  ; but some say , Elias  ; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim uba la mihpat .

translation.en: And David comforted Bath–sheba his wife , and went in unto her , and lay with her : and she bare a son , and he called his name Solomon : and the  Lord  loved him .
translation.kha: Te u Dabid u la pyntngen ïa ka Bathsheba ka tnga jong u . U la ïathiah shongkha bad ka ; bad ka la kha khun shynrang , ïa uba u Dabid u la ai kyrteng u Solomon . U  Trai  u la ieit ïa u khynnah ,

translation.en: I have digged , and drunk water  ; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places .
translation.kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih ïa ki pukri bad dih um ha ki ri nongwei , bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïuh ha ka wah Nile ba-rkhiang .

translation.en: Now therefore go to , proclaim in the ears of the people , saying , Whosoever is fearful and afraid , let him return and depart early from mount Gilead . And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand  ; and there remained ten thousand .
translation.kha: Pynbna ha u paidbah , ‘ Uno uno uba sheptieng u dei ban leit phai noh sha ïing , bad ngi ngin sah hangne ha u lum Gilead .’   Kumta arphew ar hajar ngut ki leit phai noh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki sah .

translation.en: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams : for the  Lord  your God proveth you , to know whether ye love the  Lord  your God with all your heart and with all your soul .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pyndonkam ïa u ban tynjuh ïa phi , ban khmih la phi ieit ne em ïa U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

translation.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death , and prayed unto the  Lord  : and he spake unto him , and he gave him a sign .
translation.kha: Ha kaba kum kane ka por u syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U duwai , bad U  Trai  u ai ha u ïa ka dak ba un sa khiah pat .

translation.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon , and Ataroth , and Aroer ,
translation.kha: Ka jait Gad ka tei biang ïa ki shnong ba la ker da ki kut : Dibon , Ataroth , Aroer ,

translation.en: And the Philistines took the ark of God , and brought it from Eben–ezer unto Ashdod .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ki kit ïa ka na Ebeneser sha ka nongbah jong ki ha Ashdod ,

translation.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shean and her towns , nor Taanach and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns : but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
translation.kha: Ki jait Manasseh kim shym la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha Beth Shan , Taanakh , Dor , Ibleam , Megiddo bad ha ki nongrit kiba hajan ; ki Kanaan ki dang shong hangta .

translation.en: And all went to be taxed , every one into his own city .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh , te , u la leit ban ai kyrteng ïa lade , uwei uwei sha la ka jong hi ka shnong .

translation.en: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men , whom he had slain because of Gedaliah , was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain .
translation.kha: Ka pukri ha kaba u Ishmael u la bret ïa ki metïap jong kita ki rangbah kiba u la pynïap ka long kaba heh bha kaba u syiem Asa u la tih mynba u la shah tur ïaleh ha u Baasha , u syiem ka Israel . U Ishmael u la pyndap ïa kata ka pukri da ki metïap .

translation.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil : the Lord reward him according to his works :
translation.kha: U Aleksandar , u kamar-tama u la pyndik eh ïa nga ; U Trai un sa ainong ïa u kat kum ki kam jong u .

translation.en: The arrow cannot make him flee : slingstones are turned with him into stubble .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno u khnam uba lah ban pynher krad ïa u ; ki mawbah kiba la kawang ïa u ki long kum ki lyngkhot phlangïap .

translation.en: For in him we live , and move , and have our being  ; as certain also of your own poets have said , For we are also his offspring .
translation.kha: kumba don uba la ong ,   ‘ Ha u ngi im , ngi khih bad ngi long .’   Ka long kumba katto katne na ki myllung jong phi kiba la ong ,   ‘ Ngi ruh ngi long ki khun jong u .’

translation.en: As for that night , let darkness seize upon it  ; let it not be joined unto the days of the year , let it not come into the number of the months .
translation.kha: Tap noh ïa kata ka miet na ka snem , bad wat ai ba yn ñiew biang ïa ka ;

translation.en: And if ye have erred , and not observed all these commandments , which the  Lord  hath spoken unto Moses ,
translation.kha: Hynrei lehse don uba kum bakla khlem da mut khnang ha kaba sumar ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .

translation.en: I have long time holden my peace  ; I have been still , and refrained myself : now will I cry like a travailing woman  ; I will destroy and devour at once .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  La slem bah nga la sngap jar ; ngam shym la jubab ïa ki briew jong nga . Hynrei mynta ka por ban leh ka la wan ; nga kyang jam kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .

translation.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob : and he went to Paddan–aram unto Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob s and Esau s mother .
translation.kha: U Isaak u phah noh ïa u Jakob sha Mesopotamia , sha u Laban , uba long u khun jong u Bethuel u nong Aram , bad u hynmen jong ka Rebekka , ka kmie jong Jakob bad u Iso .

translation.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread ? and your labour for that which satisfieth not ? hearken diligently unto me , and eat ye that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in fatness .
translation.kha: Balei ban pynlut pisa ha kaei ka bym ai jinghun ? Balei ban pynlut ïa ka bainong jong phi bad ban dang hap shahthngan hi ? To shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbam kaba bang tam na baroh .

translation.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well s mouth , and spread ground corn thereon  ; and the thing was not known .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong uta u briew ka shim kawei ka jingtap , ka siang ïa ka halor kata ka pukri , bad ka la thad kew halor jong ka , khnang ba mano mano kin ym ïohi ei ei .

translation.en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given unto it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas .  And he left them , and departed .
translation.kha: Katno kiba sniew bad ki bym don blei ki long ki briew jong kane ka juk ! Phi kyrpad na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tang ka kambah jong u Jonah .  Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit noh .

translation.en: The floods have lifted up , O  Lord  , the floods have lifted up their voice  ; the floods lift up their waves .
translation.kha: Ki jingjylliew ka duriaw ki sawa jam , A  Trai  ; ki sawa jam bad ki kyrhuh .

translation.en: And Elijah said unto Elisha , Tarry here , I pray thee  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Beth–el . And Elisha said unto him , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . So they went down to Beth–el .
translation.kha: bad ha lynti u Elijah u ong ïa u Elisha ,  Mynta ap hangne ; U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha Bethel .  Hynrei u Elisha u jubab ,  Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  uba im bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi .  Kumta ki la leit sha Bethel .

translation.en: Or I only and Barnabas , have not we power to forbear working ?
translation.kha: Lane hato tang u Barnabas bad ma nga mo kiba dei ban trei na ka bynta ban im ?

translation.en: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down , yea , we wept , when we remembered Zion .
translation.kha: Harud ki wah ka Babilon ngi la shong ; hangta ngi ïam haba ngi kynmaw ïa ka Seïon .

translation.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God .
translation.kha: Kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki jinglong ba kynja doh , kim lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Finally , brethren , whatsoever things are true , whatsoever things are honest , whatsoever things are just , whatsoever things are pure , whatsoever things are lovely , whatsoever things are of good report ; if there be any virtue , and if there be any praise , think on these things .
translation.kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong nga , to pyndap ïa ki jingmut jong phi da kito kiei kiei kiba bha bad kita kiba dei ïaroh : Kiei kiei kiba shisha , kiba donburom , kiba beit , kiba khuid , kiba itynnat , bad kiba donburom .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Did ye never read in the scriptures , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner : this is the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Hato phim pat ju pule ïa kaei ba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ?   ‘ Ïa u maw ba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh . Ïa kane la leh da U Trai ; katno ka long kaba itynnat !’

translation.en: What is your name ?
translation.kha: Phi Kyrteng Aiu ?

translation.en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned two years in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Amon u la don arphew ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: I gave my back to the smiters , and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair : I hid not my face from shame and spitting .
translation.kha: Nga pynshah da ka met sha kito kiba shoh ïa nga . Ngam shym pynsangeh ïa ki haba ki krenbeiñ ïa nga , haba ki patrong ïa ki shñiuh na u  ñiuhtmoh jong nga bad bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .

translation.en: And the publican , standing afar off , would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven , but smote upon his breast , saying , God be merciful to me a sinner .
translation.kha: Hynrei u nonglum khajna u la ïeng ha pajih bad um shym khmied la ka durkhmat sha bneng , hynrei u ïai tied ïa la ka shadem bad u la ong , ‘ A Blei , to isynei ïa nga , u nongpop !’

translation.en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the  Lord  , choose you this day whom ye will serve  ; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood , or the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but as for me and my house , we will serve the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te lada phim mon ban shakri ïa u , jied ha kane hi ka sngi ïano phin shakri , ïa ki blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la mane ha Mesopotamia , ne ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , kiba ha ka ri jong ki phi shong phi sah mynta . Hynrei ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga , ngin shakri ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Brethren , I beseech you , be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jong nga , ba phin long kum ma nga . La shisha , nga long hi kum ma phi . Phim shym la leh sniew ei ei ïa nga .

translation.en: Her priests have violated my law , and have profaned mine holy things : they have put no difference between the holy and profane , neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean , and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths , and I am profaned among them .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong nga bad kim burom ïa kaei kaba khuid . Kim pynïapher hapdeng kaei kaba khuid bad kaei ka bymkhuid . Kim hikai ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kiba khuid bad kiba jakhlia , bad kim suidñiew ïa ka Sabbaton . Kaba mih ka long ba ki paid Israel kim ñiewkor ïa nga .

translation.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the  Lord  hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jubab ,  Kynrad , ngin leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , that the table may be borne with them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .

translation.en: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever . And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you .
translation.kha: hynrei ka ktien jong U Trai ka ïaineh junom .  Kane ka ktien ka long ka Khubor Babha ïa kaba la pynbna ha phi .

translation.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt  ; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies  ; but provoked him at the sea , even at the Red sea .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ha Ijipt kim shym la sngewthuh ïa ki kam baphylla jong U Blei ; ki la klet ba bunsien u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingieit jong u , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh ha ka Duriaw Basaw .

translation.en: And Saul gathered the people together , and numbered them in Telaim , two hundred thousand footmen , and ten thousand men of Judah .
translation.kha: U Saul u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u bad u peit bniah ïa ki ha Telem : la don ar lakh ngut ki shipai na Israel bad shiphew hajar ngut na Judah .

translation.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait , and as a lion in secret places .
translation.kha: U la ap ïa nga kum ka dngiem ; u kynrup ïa nga kum u sing .

translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem ? come , and I will send thee unto them . And he said to him , Here am I .
translation.kha: u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Nga kwah ba men leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki hynmen shynrang jong me ki ap sumar ïa ki kynhun jingri .  U Joseph u jubab ,  Nga kloi .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u la long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren ha nga shaphang ka ri Elam .

translation.en: So he brought him into his house , and gave provender unto the asses : and they washed their feet , and did eat and drink .
translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa ki sha la ïing bad u ai bam ïa ki kada jong ki . Ki ruh ki ïasait ïa la ki kjat bad ki ïabam jingbam miet .

translation.en: And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .
translation.kha: Ngi thoh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan long kaba dap pura .

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Somebody hath touched me : for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Don mano mano ba la ktah ïa nga , naba nga tip ïa ka mynba ka bor ka la mihnoh na nga .

translation.en: When I said , My foot slippeth  ; thy mercy , O  Lord  , held me up .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Nga la kyllon noh  ; hynrei ka jingieit baneh jong me , A  Trai  , ka batskhem ïa nga .

translation.en: Take ye wives , and beget sons and daughters  ; and take wives for your sons , and give your daughters to husbands , that they may bear sons and daughters  ; that ye may be increased there , and not diminished .
translation.kha: To ïashongkurim bad to ïoh ki khun ki kti . Nangta shah ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban shongkurim , ba kumta ma ki ruh kin don ki khun ki kti . Phi dei ban roi ha ka jingbun briew bad ym ban duna .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; An adversary there shall be even round about the land  ; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee , and thy palaces shall be spoiled .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , u nongshun un kerkut ïa ka ri , un pyntwa ïa ki jingker jong ki , bad un lute ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki .

translation.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock  ; he overturneth the mountains by the roots .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ba-eh tam , ki tih ha trai jong ki lumbah .

translation.en: Before thy wickedness was discovered , as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria , and all that are round about her , the daughters of the Philistines , which despise thee round about .
translation.kha: bad ha shuwa ba yn pynpaw ïa ka jingsniew kaba pha la leh ? Mynta pha long kum ma ka — ka jingbiria ïa ki nong Edom , ki Philistia bad kiwei pat ki paramarjan jong pha kiba isih ïa pha .

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines , and of the Arabians , that were near the Ethiopians :
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Philistia bad ki Arab ki shong ki sah hajan ka jaka ha kaba katto katne ngut ki nong Sudan ki la shongduh harud ka duriaw . U  Trai  u la pynkhih ïa ki ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Jehoram .

translation.en: And when he numbered them in Bezek , the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .
translation.kha: U Saul u khot lang ïa ki ha Besek : ki rangbah Israel ki don lai lakh ngut , bad ki rangbah Judah pat laiphew hajar ngut .

translation.en: That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .
translation.kha: bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem shynrang , ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki briew jong u .

translation.en: But if they obey not , they shall perish by the sword , and they shall die without knowledge .
translation.kha: Hynrei lymda kumta , kin ïap ha ka jingbymtip bad ryngkang ïa ka wah sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shemphang ïa ka jingjubab jong u .

translation.en: And the king went forth , and all the people after him , and tarried in a place that was far off .
translation.kha: Katba u syiem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , ki la sangeh ha ka ïing kaba khatduh .

translation.en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons   ; and they shall eat it in the holy place : for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire by a perpetual statute .
translation.kha: Uta u kpu u dei na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Ki dei ban bam ïa u ha ka jaka kaba kyntang , naba uta u long ka bynta kaba kyntang eh na ki jingainguh bam ba la kñia sha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And he took the captains of hundreds , and the nobles , and the governors of the people , and all the people of the land , and brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  : and they came through the high gate into the king s house , and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah shipai , ki riewpawkhmat , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki briew baroh , ki ïadon lang bad u Jehoïada ha jingïa-ïaid paidbah kaba wan ïalam ïa u syiem na ka Templ sha ka ïingsyiem . Ki rung na ka khyrdop bah , bad u syiem u shong halor ka khet .

translation.en: Then Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , was astonished for one hour , and his thoughts troubled him . The king spake , and said , Belteshazzar , let not the dream , or the interpretation thereof , trouble thee . Belteshazzar answered and said , My lord , the dream be to them that hate thee , and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies .
translation.kha: Ha kane , u Daniel , ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar , u la sngewsheptieng katta katta ba um lah ban ong ei ei . U syiem u la ong ha u ,  Ko Belteshassar , wat ai ba ka jingphohsniew bad ka khubor jong ka kin pynsheptieng ïa me .  U Belteshassar u la phai ktien ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kwah ba ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingbatai ïa ka kan dei ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad ym ïa phi .

translation.en: Then Manoah entreated the  Lord  , and said , O my Lord , let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us , and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born .
translation.kha: Te u Manoah u duwai ha U  Trai  ,  A  Trai  , nga kyrpad ba men shah ïa u briew jong U Blei ïa uba me la phah ban wan biang sha ngi bad ban ong ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh ïa uta u khunlung ynda la kha ïa u .

translation.en: Peter therefore was kept in prison : but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him .
translation.kha: Kumta la buh ïa u Petros ha ka phatok , hynrei ki briew jong ka balang ki la duwai jur ha U Blei na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion  ; they , they are thy lot : even to them hast thou poured a drink offering , thou hast offered a meat offering . Should I receive comfort in these ?
translation.kha: Phi shim ïa ki maw kiba jlih nangta bad mane ïa ki kum ki blei . Phi theh ïa ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh ïa ki bad wallam sha ki ïa ki jingainguh kew . Phi tharai ba ngan sngewbha da kine kiei kiei ?

translation.en: Satan the Devil—where did he come from ?
translation.kha: U Soitan , u Ksuid—u wan nangno ?

translation.en: And Peter followed him afar off , even into the palace of the high priest : and he sat with the servants , and warmed himself at the fire .
translation.kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai bad u la leit shapoh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U shong hangta bad ki nongap phira , u pynsyaid ïa lade harud ding .

translation.en: And I brought him to thy disciples , and they could not cure him .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa u ha ki synran jong me , hynrei kim lah ban pynkhiah ïa u .

translation.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth : and there is none that holdeth with me in these things , but Michael your prince .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Hato me tip balei ba nga la wan sha me ? Ka long ban pynpaw ha me ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jingshisha . Mynta nga dei ban leit noh pat bad ban ïaleh ïa u angel ïada jong ka Persia . Hadien kata , u angel ïada jong ka Gris un mihpaw . Ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga lait noh u Mikhael , u angel ïada jong ka Israel .

translation.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering , he shall bring it a female without blemish .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u wallam ïa ka langbrot kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop , ka dei ban long ka langbrot ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the  Lord  , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him ,
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangïapom jong phi kin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad hapoh ka jingïalam jong U  Trai  ki dei ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi haduh ba U  Trai  un da jop thiaw ïa ki

translation.en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass , when they eat their holy things : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
translation.kha: da kaba shah ïa uno uno u briew u bym dei hok ban bam ïa ki ; kata kan pynhap ïa uta u briew ha ka pop , bad un shah pynshitom . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa ki jingainguh .

translation.en: For though I be absent in the flesh , yet am I with you in the spirit , joying and beholding your order , and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ .
translation.kha: Naba wat la ngam don ryngkat ha ka met , pynban nga don bad phi ha ka mynsiem , bad nga kmen haba nga ïohi ïa ka jingkut jingmut kaba skhem da kaba phi ïa-ïeng lang ha ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist .

translation.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba proh jingmut u wanrah ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa uba bieit , uba bieit u shu rkhie bad u hylla bad u tim .

translation.en: Or unto governors , as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers , and for the praise of them that do well .
translation.kha: bad ha ki lat , ïa kiba la thung da u ban pynshitom ïa ki nongkam bymman bad ban ïaroh ïa kita kiba leh babha .

translation.en: And Moses reared up the tabernacle , and fastened his sockets , and set up the boards thereof , and put in the bars thereof , and reared up his pillars .
translation.kha: Ha kaba pynïeng ïa ka , u Moses u pynskhem ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka , u pynïeng ïa ki jingker jong ka , u pyndait ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , bad u pynïeng ïa ki rishot jong ka .

translation.en: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished . This is the first resurrection .
translation.kha: ( Kiba sah na kiba ïap kim shym la im pat tad ynda ki shihajar snem ki la kut . ) Kane ka dei ka jingpynmihpat kaba nyngkong ïa kiba ïap .

translation.en: And when they were come in , they went up into an upper room , where abode both Peter , and James , and John , and Andrew , Philip , and Thomas , Bartholomew , and Matthew , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon Zelotes , and Judas the brother of James .
translation.kha: Ki la rung sha ka nongbah bad ki la leit sha ka kamra ha kaba ki la sah : U Petros , u Ïoannis , u Jakob bad u Andriw , u Philip bad u Thomas , u Bartholomai bad u Matthaïos , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , u Simon u Riew-ieit Ri , bad u Judas u khun jong u Jakob .

translation.en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “ Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her . ”
translation.kha: Wat la phi don jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih pat “ U Abraham u ngeit ba ka tnga jongu kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule ” ba u Abraham u sngew sih bad iam namar jongka .

translation.en: But other of the apostles saw I none , save James the Lord s brother .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la ïakynduh ïa kiwei pat ki Apostol lait noh tang ïa u Jakob , u para jong U Trai .

translation.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter , James , and John his brother , and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart ,
translation.kha: Hadien hynriew sngi U Jisu u la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis bad u la ïalam ïa ki sha u lumbah uba jrong ha kaba ki la ïadon tang ma ki hi .

translation.en: But thou , O son of man , behold , they shall put bands upon thee , and shall bind thee with them , and thou shalt not go out among them :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , yn sa khum sa teh ïa me da ki tyllai , bad men ym lah ban leit sha jaka paidbah .

translation.en: If thou doest well , shalt thou not be accepted ? and if thou doest not well , sin lieth at the door . And unto thee shall be his desire , and thou shalt rule over him .
translation.kha: Lada me la leh ïa kaba dei , men jin da la phuh samrkhie ; hynrei namar ba me la leh ïa kaba sniew , ka pop ka apthap ha ka jingkhang jong me . Ka kwah ban synshar ïa me , hynrei me dei ban jop ïa ka .

translation.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day .
translation.kha: namar U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity , and cause me to behold grievance ? for spoiling and violence are before me : and there are that raise up strife and contention .
translation.kha: Balei ba me pynlong ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kaba kum kane ka jingjynjar ? Kumno me lah ban shu peit ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh bymdei ? Ka jingpynjot bad ka jinglehbor ki don baroh sawdong jong nga , bad ka don ka jingïaleh bad jingïakajia ha kylleng .

translation.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet , and drinketh damage .
translation.kha: Lada phi shah ba uba bieit un sam ïa ka khubor , ka long kumba ot ïa la ki jong ki kjat ; phi pan ïa ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: For he found her in the field , and the betrothed damsel cried , and there was none to save her .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la batbor ïa kata ka briew kaba la ïatehktien , bad wat la ka la lynñiar ruh , ym don mano mano ba wan ïarap ïa ka .

translation.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop : but a good word maketh it glad .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhuslai kan lute ïa ka jingkmen na phi , hynrei ki ktien sbun kin pynkmen ïa phi .

translation.en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty . And he answered and said unto him , O man of God , thus hath the king said , Come down quickly .
translation.kha: U syiem u la phah sa uwei pat u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah , kiba la leit kiew bad ong ha u Elijah ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban wan hiar shisyndon !

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The hour is coming , and now is , when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ba ka por kan poi — ka por ka la lah poi — haba kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Khun U Blei , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kin ïoh im .

translation.en: And David danced before the  Lord  with all his might  ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .
translation.kha: U Dabid , uba shu pien tang da ka jaiñ linen , u la shadkmen da ka bor jong u baroh ban burom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy ? are we stronger than he ?
translation.kha: Hato phi kwah ban pynlong ïa U Blei ba un thut shen ? Hato ngi pyrkhat ba ngi kham khlaiñ ban ïa u ?

translation.en: I am this day fourscore years old : and can I discern between good and evil ? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink ? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women ? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king ?
translation.kha: Nga la dap phraphew snem ka rta , bad ym don shuh kata kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ngam don jingmad shuh ïa kaei ba nga bam bad dih , bad ngam lah shuh ban ïohsngew ïa ki sur jong ki nongrwai . Ngan long tang ka jingbankhia ïa U Syiem Kynrad .

translation.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee , and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt : so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them , nor remember Egypt any more .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ïa ki jingijli kiba pha la leh naduh ba pha dang don ha Ijipt . Phan ym khmih shuh ïa ki bleithaw ne pyrkhat shuh shaphang ka Ijipt .

translation.en: So David reigned over all Israel , and executed judgment and justice among all his people .
translation.kha: U Dabid u synshar ha baroh ka Israel bad u pynthikna ba ïa ki briew jong u yn lehbha bad lehhok borabor .

translation.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God  ; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities : and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people  ; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation .
translation.kha: Da la ki bleithaw ïa nga ki pynbitar , ïa ki blei jong ki , ki bym dei shisha ki blei , ngam lah shah . Kumta ngan pyndonkam da kito ki bym dei ka jaitbynriew ban pynbitar ïa ki , ngan kynshoit ruh ïa ki da ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit katba kin ym lah shah .

translation.en: 20 When Will Paradise Come ?
translation.kha: 20 Lano ka Paradais Kan Wan ?

translation.en: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him , and said , Bring this young man unto the chief captain : for he hath a certain thing to tell him .
translation.kha: Te u Paul u la khot ïa uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad u la ong ha u ,  Ïalam ïa une u samla sha u rangbah ai hukum , u don ei ei ban ïathuh ha u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , waters rise up out of the north , and shall be an overflowing flood , and shall overflow the land , and all that is therein  ; the city , and them that dwell therein : then the men shall cry , and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl .
translation.kha: U ong :  Ha khmih ! Ki um ki la nang shlei na shatei bad kin tuid stet kum ka wah ba la shlei um . Kin tap ïa ka ri bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka , ki nongbah bad ki briew kiba im hangta . Ki briew kin pyrta jingïarap ; baroh kiba ha ka pyrthei kin ïamkthang .

translation.en: My righteousness I hold fast , and will not let it go : my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live .
translation.kha: Ngan ym randien lano lano ruh na ka jingdawa ba ngam shym bakla ; ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka beit .

translation.en: And thou shalt speak my words unto them , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear : for they are most rebellious .
translation.kha: Men ong ha ki ïa kaei ba nga bthah ïa me ban ong , lada ki sngap ne kim sngap . Kynmaw ba ki long ki nongïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , The  Lord  rebuke thee , O Satan  ; even the  Lord  that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee : is not this a brand plucked out of the fire ?
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la ong ha u Soitan ,  To U  Trai  un pynrem ïa me , ko Soitan ! To U  Trai  , uba ieit ïa ka Jerusalem , un pynrem ïa me . Une u briew u long kum u dieng ïa uba la sei noh na ka ding .

translation.en: But before they lay down , the men of the city , even the men of Sodom , compassed the house round , both old and young , all the people from every quarter :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha kin leit thiah noh , ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki la kerkut ïa ka ïing . Baroh ki shynrang jong kata ka nongbah , bad samla bad tymmen , ki la ïadon hangta .

translation.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak , Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .
translation.kha: U Kaleb u beh krad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Anak na ka nongbah — ki kur Sheshai , Ahiman , bad Talmai .

translation.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause .
translation.kha: Wat pynduh ïa ka jingbishar hok ïa uba duk haba u wan ha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges , of a cubit length  ; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh .
translation.kha: U Ehud u shna da lade hi kawei ka waitlam arliang syrti kaba shi phut shiteng ka jingjrong . U teh ïa ka ha ka liang kamon jong u hapoh la ki jaiñkup .

translation.en: And Esther said , The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman . Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen .
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka ong ,  U nongshun jong ngi , u nongpynshitom jong ngi , u dei une u briew uba sniew , u Haman !  U Haman u khmih sha u syiem bad ka mahadei da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , When thou wast young , thou girdedst thyself , and walkedst whither thou wouldest : but when thou shalt be old , thou shalt stretch forth thy hands , and another shall gird thee , and carry thee whither thou wouldest not .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Haba me dang samla , me ju long uba la pynkhreh bad me leit kat shaba me mon ; hynrei haba me la tymmen , men kner la ki jong ki kti bad uwei pat un teh un khum ïa me bad un ïalam ïa me sha kaba mem kwah ban leit .

translation.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah , of the house of Issachar , conspired against him  ; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines  ; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon .
translation.kha: U Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah , uba na ka jait Issakhar , u la ïasuhbuit pyrshah ïa u Nadab bad u la pynïap ïa u katba u Nadab bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang kerkut ïa ka nongbah Gibbethon ha Philistia .

translation.en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much , till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another  ; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin , in doing that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la pynïap bun ki briew balui lui , haduh ba ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki la tuid da ka snam ; u la leh ïa kane nalor ba u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah sha ka jingmane bleithaw da kaba pynlong ïa ki ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this , there is none so discreet and wise as thou art :
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei u la pynpaw ha me ïa kane baroh , kumta ka long kaba shai ba me don ka jingstad bad jingshemphang kaba kham khraw ban ïano ïano .

translation.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule , and her stature was exalted among the thick branches , and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches .
translation.kha: Ki tnat jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ bad ki san ban long u diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . U dieng sohwaiñ u la san jrong eh ban kot ïa ki lyoh ; uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi haduh katno u la long uba rben ki sla bad uba jrong .

translation.en: Rather , God’s Word teaches that you are a soul , that your soul is really you , with all your physical and mental qualities .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ktien u Blei ka hikai ba mangi ngi long ka mynsiem , ba ka mynsiem ka dei shisha mangi , ha ka met bad ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad baroh ka jinglong jongngi hi .

translation.en: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king s meat .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la kut , ki la kham i khiah krat bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa kito baroh kiba la bam ïa ka jingbam syiem .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Why are ye so fearful ? how is it that ye have no faith ?
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ,  Balei ba phi sheptieng ? Hato phim pat don jingngeit satia ?

translation.en: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering , in the holy place : for as the sin offering is the priest s , so is the trespass offering : it is most holy :
translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot ha ka jaka kaba kyntang ha kaba la ju pynïap ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ki jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa ki jingkñia ainguh thang . U dei ban leh ïa kane namar ba ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpalat , kumba long ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh , bad ka long kaba khuid bha .

translation.en: And to have power to heal sicknesses , and to cast out devils :
translation.kha: Ngan phah ruh ïa phi ban ïalap , bad phin don ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid .

translation.en: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the  Lord  , he arose from before the altar of the  Lord  , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Solomon u la pynkut ïa kane ka jingduwai ha U  Trai  , u ïeng noh na khmat kata ka duwan , na ka jaka ba u la dem khohsiew da kaba rah ïa la ki kti .

translation.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people , he said , Ye men of Ephesus , what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana , and of the image which fell down from Jupiter ?
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , u nongtrei sorkar u la lah ban pynjai jai ïa u paidbah .  Ko para nong Ephesos !  u la ong .  Uwei pa uwei u tip ba ka nongbah Ephesos ka dei ka nongsumar ïa ka templ jong ka Artemis bakhraw bad ïa u mawkyntang uba la hap na sahit bneng .

translation.en: And Jesus , when he was baptized , went up straightway out of the water : and , lo , the heavens were opened unto him , and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove , and lighting upon him :
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la shah pynbaptis , u la wan kiew noh na ka um . Nangta ïa ka bneng la plie ha u , bad u la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem jong U Blei uba wan hiar kum ka paro bad ka da wan shong halor jong u .

translation.en: And now , O  Lord  my God , thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father : and I am but a little child : I know not how to go out or come in .
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei , me la shah ïa nga ban long syiem hadien i pa jong nga , wat la nga dang khynnah bad ngam tip kumno ban synshar .

translation.en: For this shall the earth mourn , and the heavens above be black : because I have spoken it , I have purposed it , and will not repent , neither will I turn back from it .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan ïam sngewsih ; ka sahit bneng kan sdang dum . U  Trai  u la kren bad un ym kylla ïa ka jingmut jong u . U la pynlong ïa ka jingrai jong u bad un ym kylla dien .

translation.en: Son of man , speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , and to his multitude  ; Whom art thou like in thy greatness ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to ong ha u syiem jong ka Ijipt bad ha ki briew jong u baroh :  Katno ka jingkhrawbor jong me ! Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa me ?

translation.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet , Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la ong ha uta u angel uba hynriew ,  To pyllait noh ïa ki saw ngut ki angel kiba la shah khum ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis !

translation.en: Ye also helping together by prayer for us , that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf .
translation.kha: Kumta kan long ba ïa ki jingduwai babun na bynta jong ngi yn sa jubab , bad U Blei un kyrkhu ïa ngi ; bad bun kin kyntiew ïa ki sur jingïaroh jong ki sha u ha ka jingainguh na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Nay , ye do wrong , and defraud , and that your brethren .
translation.kha: Pynban , ma phi hi phi ïaleh bymdei iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïalute iwei ïa iwei pat , wat ïa la ki jong ki parabangeit!

translation.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the  Lord  , in the courts , and in the chambers , and in the purifying of all holy things , and the work of the service of the house of God  ;
translation.kha: bad la shaniah ha ki ïa kine ki kam : ban ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron bad ïa ka jingmane ha ka Templ , ban sumar ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra jong ka , bad ban sumar khuid ïa kata baroh kaba kyntang ;

translation.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the  Lord  our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .
translation.kha: To ai ba ma phi , ki briew jong u , phin ïailong kiba ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh , kumba phi leh ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee : thou shalt be a terror , and never shalt thou be any more .
translation.kha: Me la jah , jah junom , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba la ithuh ïa me ki la sngewma , sngewtieng ba kin ïadon bynta ha ka kupar jong me .

translation.en: Neither , because they are the seed of Abraham , are they all children : but , In Isaac shall thy seed be called .
translation.kha: Lymne kiba hiarpateng baroh na u Abraham ki long ki khun jong U Blei . U Blei u la ong ha u Abraham ,  Ka long lyngba u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa kiba hiarpateng kiba nga la kular ïa me .

translation.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead , and took it , and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it .
translation.kha: Ka kur u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh ka la hiarthma ïa ka ri Gilead , bad ka la ïohknieh ïa ka , bad beh krad ïa ki Amor kiba don hangta .

translation.en: And David said to Abishai , and to all his servants , Behold , my son , which came forth of my bowels , seeketh my life : how much more now may this Benjamite do it ? let him alone , and let him curse  ; for the  Lord  hath bidden him .
translation.kha: Bad u Dabid u ong ha u Abishai bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ,  U khun jong nga hi u pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga , te balei phin lyngngoh ïa une u nong Benjamin ? U  Trai  u la ong ïa u ban tim ; kumta wat pynwit ïa u , ai un leh ïa ka .

translation.en: Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh : he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa phi ki Moab ! Phi kiba mane ïa u Khemosh , phi la jot ! U blei jong phi u pynphetwir ïa ki shynrang , Bad ïa ki kynthei u pynlong ki mraw jong u syiem Amor .

translation.en: But now the  Lord  hath spoken , saying , Within three years , as the years of an hireling , and the glory of Moab shall be contemned , with all that great multitude  ; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble .
translation.kha: Bad mynta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha ki lai snem thik , ka spah bakhraw jong ka Moab kan jah noh . Na ki briew kiba bun jong ka , tang khyndiat ki ban lait im , bad kin long kiba tlot .

translation.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man , rather than a fool in his folly .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem kaba la duh noh ïa la ki khun ban ïa kaba ïakynduh ïa uno uno uba bieit uba bunkam ha ka kam mutlop .

translation.en: And the bramble said unto the trees , If in truth ye anoint me king over you , then come and put your trust in my shadow : and if not , let fire come out of the bramble , and devour the cedars of Lebanon .
translation.kha: U dieng shiah u jubab , ‘ Lada phi kwah shisha ban pynlong ïa nga u syiem jong phi , te ale wan bad riehtngen hapoh ka syrngiew jong nga . Lada phim kwah , ka ding kan klang na ki tnat shiah jong nga bad bam duh ïa ki dieng Kedar ka Lebanon .’

translation.en: So when even was come , the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward , Call the labourers , and give them their hire , beginning from the last unto the first .
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u trai u la bthah ïa la u sordar , ‘ To khot ïa ki nongtrei bad siew ïa ka bainong jong ki , sdang na kito kiba la shah khot bylla khatduh bad pynkut ha kito kiba la shah khot bylla nyngkong .’

translation.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf , nor put a stumblingblock before the blind , but shalt fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat tim ïa u briew uba kyllut lane wat buh ei ei ha khmat uba matlah ban pynlong ba un jynthut halor uta . Tiengburom ïa nga ; nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast clapped thine hands , and stamped with the feet , and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : phi la thab ïa ki kti bad kynthih da ka jingkmen . Phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ka ri ki Israel .

translation.en: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market : and thou wast replenished , and made very glorious in the midst of the seas .
translation.kha: Ïa ki mar khaïi jong pha la pynkit ha ki kynhun liengbah kit mar baheh tam .  Pha long kum ka liengbah ha duriaw ba la pynkit da ki jingkit bakhia .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came unto me again , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga

translation.en: And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: bad haba ki la wan ha U Jisu , ki la ïohi ïa uta u briew uba ju don shibun ki ksuid hapoh jong u . U la shong hangta , u la phong jaiñ bad ba u la tipbriew , bad baroh ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pyllait la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ïa ka .

translation.en: For where a testament is , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh    , ka long kaba donkam ban pynshisha ba u briew uba ai ïa ka u la ïap ,

translation.en: But if we hope for that we see not , then do we with patience wait for it .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi kyrmen ïa kaei kaba ngim ïohi , ngi ap ïa kata da ka jingïaishah .

translation.en: And they were all amazed , and they glorified God , and were filled with fear , saying , We have seen strange things to day .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïalyngngoh shikatdei eh ! Ki la dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da ong ,  A katno kiei kiei kiba phylla ngi la ïohi ha kane ka sngi !

translation.en: Sell that ye have , and give alms  ; provide yourselves bags which wax not old , a treasure in the heavens that faileth not , where no thief approacheth , neither moth corrupteth .
translation.kha: Die noh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk . Pynbiang ïa lade ki pla kynshew ki ban ym jot noh , bad kynshew ïa ka spah jong phi ha bneng , ha kaba kan ym duna , namar ba ym don u nongtuh uba lah ban ïoh ïa ka , bad ym don khñiang ba lah ban pynjot ïa ka .

translation.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To beh kthong ïa ki bad ñiad noh ïa ki na ka khyndew !

translation.en: And he said unto me , To build it an house in the land of Shinar : and it shall be established , and set there upon her own base .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Sha Babilonia , ha kaba kin tei ka templ na ka bynta jong ka . Haba la dep shna ïa ka Templ , ïa ka shang yn buh hangta ïa ka ba yn mane .

translation.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness , and prayed .
translation.kha: Hynrei u ju leit noh sha ki jaka kynjah , ha kaba u la duwai .

translation.en: And his disciples went forth , and came into the city , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit , ki la rung sha ka nongbah , bad shem kiei kiei baroh kumba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa ki ; bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  will come with fire , and with his chariots like a whirlwind , to render his anger with fury , and his rebuke with flames of fire .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wan bad ka ding . Un shong ha ki thapniang jong ka  erïong , ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba u la bitar .

translation.en: We would have healed Babylon , but she is not healed : forsake her , and let us go every one into his own country : for her judgment reacheth unto heaven , and is lifted up even to the skies .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei kiba sah hangta ki ong , ‘ Ngi la pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ka Babilonia , hynrei ka la dier palat . To ngin ieh ïa ka mynta bad ngin leit phai noh sha ïing . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka Babilonia da ka bor jong u baroh bad u la pynjot thiaw ïa ka .’

translation.en: Take heed unto yourselves , lest ye forget the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he made with you , and make you a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , which the  Lord  thy God hath forbidden thee .
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynlong bad phi . Kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u ban ym thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ïa kano kano ka durblei ,

translation.en: And when he was called forth , Tertullus began to accuse him , saying , Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness , and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence ,
translation.kha: Nangta la khot shapoh ïa u Paul , bad u Tertullos u la sdang ban ai ïa ka jingmudui jong u ïa u Paul kumne harum :  Pheliks Badonburom ! Ka jingïalam bastad jong me ka la wanrah ha ngi ïa ka por shongsuk kaba kham slem , bad ïa shibun ki jingpynbeit thymmai kiba donkam la thaw na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishion with her suburbs , Daberath with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Kishion , ka Daberath ,

translation.en: But he said , Nay  ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .
translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ u la jubab , ‘ namar haba phi lumlang ïa ki ñiut phi lah ban kum jynrat katto katne u kew lem bad ki .

translation.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned two years over Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Ahab u sdang ban synshar ha Israel ; bad u synshar ar snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: And upon her forehead was a name written , MYSTERY , BABYLON THE GREAT , THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH .
translation.kha: Ha ka shyllangmat jong ka , la thoh ïa ka kyrteng kaba don ka jingmut kaba rieh :  Ka Babilon Bakhraw , ka kmie jong ki nuti baroh bad kiba sakma baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Mark me , and be astonished , and lay your hand upon your mouth .
translation.kha: Khmih ïa nga . Hato kata kam la biang ba phin khmih ïa nga ha ka jingkyndit bad ban sngap noh jar ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki kur u Gershon ki dei ban shong dara shaphang sepngi shadien ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: At his day thou shalt give him his hire , neither shall the sun go down upon it  ; for he is poor , and setteth his heart upon it : lest he cry against thee unto the  Lord  , and it be sin unto thee .
translation.kha: Man la ka sngi shuwa ban sep sngi , siew dep ïa ka bainong jong u ha kata ka sngi , namar u dei uba duk bad u ap dngong ban ïoh ïa ka . Lada phim ai ïa ka , un kyang ha U  Trai  pyrshah ïa phi , bad kata kan long ka pop ïa phi .

translation.en: Be thou prepared , and prepare for thyself , thou , and all thy company that are assembled unto thee , and be thou a guard unto them .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ha u ban pynkloi bad ban pynkhreh ïa la ki kynhun baroh hapoh ka jingïalam jong u .

translation.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly , nor standeth in the way of sinners , nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki briew basniew ki bym bud ïa ka jingleh ki nongpop lane ïasoh bad kito ki bymdonkam ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds , and cedar wood , and scarlet , and hyssop :
translation.kha: Ban pynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing , un shim ar tylli ki sim , khyndiat u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u  saiwul uba saw , bad uwei u tnat Hissop .

translation.en: In the mountains , and in the valleys , and in the plains , and in the springs , and in the wilderness , and in the south country  ; the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Canaanites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites :
translation.kha: Kane ka bynta ka kynthup ïa ka ri lum , ki kjat lum ha ka phang sepngi , ka Them Jordan bad ki kjat lum jong ka , ka sharing lum ha ka phang mihngi bad ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka ri ka la ju long ka ïing jong ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: And he brought also the brasen altar , which was before the  Lord  , from the forefront of the house , from between the altar and the house of the  Lord  , and put it on the north side of the altar .
translation.kha: Ka duwan rnong ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  ka don hapdeng ka duwan bathymmai bad ka Templ , te u Ahas u pynkynriah noh ïa ka sha ka bynta bashaneng jong ka duwan bathymmai .

translation.en: And if a man shall take his brother s wife , it is an unclean thing : he hath uncovered his brother s nakedness  ; they shall be childless .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïoh ïa ka tnga u hynmen jong u , baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun . U la leh ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid bad u la pynkheiñ burom ïa la u hynmen .

translation.en: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him : neither will he go unto the wise .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba meng kim sngewtynnat ban shah sneng ; kim ju pan ïa ki jingai jingmut na kito kiba kham stad .

translation.en: Only the people sacrificed in high places , because there was no house built unto the name of the  Lord  , until those days .
translation.kha: Ïa ka templ ym pat shym la tei na ka bynta U  Trai  , bad kumta ki briew ki dang ai ki jingkñia ha ki duwan bapher bapher .

translation.en: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth , and there is none other that can shew it before the king , except the gods , whose dwelling is not with flesh .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u Syiem Kynrad u pan ka long kaba eh haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban leh ïa kata lait tang ki blei , bad kim shong kim sah hapdeng ki bynriew .

translation.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered ? and should a man full of talk be justified ?
translation.kha: Hato ym don u ban jubab ïa kane ka jingkren bieit baroh ? Hato kaba kren bunktien ka pynksan ïa u briew ?

translation.en: But I say , Have they not heard ? Yes verily , their sound went into all the earth , and their words unto the ends of the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kylli : Hato ka long kaba shisha ba kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ? Da shisha ki la ïohsngew — naba kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ka jingsawa jong ka sur jong ki ka la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh ; ki ktien jong ki , ki la poi shaduh kiba kut ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And her two sons  ; of which the name of the one was Gershom  ; for he said , I have been an alien in a strange land :
translation.kha: bad ïa u Gershom bad u Elieser ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka . ( U Moses u la ong ,  Nga long u sohshnong ha ka ri nongwei  ; kumta u la jer kyrteng ïa uwei na ki  u Gershom .

translation.en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria , and drave the Jews from Elath : and the Syrians came to Elath , and dwelt there unto this day .
translation.kha: ( Ha kajuh ka por , u syiem ka Edom u ïoh pat ïa ka nongbah Elath , bad u beh krad ïa ki nong Judia kiba sah hangta . Ki nong Edom ki shongsah ha Elath , bad ki dang sah hi hangta . )

translation.en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib , that dwelt by the river of Chebar , and I sat where they sat , and remained there astonished among them seven days .
translation.kha: Kumta nga leit poi sha Tel Abib hajan ka wah Khebar , ha kaba shong kiba la shah ringmraw bad nga sah hangta hynñiew sngi bad ka jingsngew shaïong shaphang kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew .

translation.en: An elder or a ministerial servant coordinates the work , usually following a checklist of things to do .
translation.kha: U rangbah balang ne u nongïarap balang u pynïaid ïa ki kam , bad u peit ïa kiei ba ki dei ban leh .

translation.en: And , ye fathers , provoke not your children to wrath : but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord .
translation.kha: Phi ruh ki kmie ki kpa , wat leh ïa la ki khun ha kata ka rukom ban pynbitar ïa ki , pynban to pynheh pynsan ïa ki ha ka jingsneng bad jinghikai ba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it . And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God , the God of their fathers .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki paid Benjamin bad uwei pa uwei uba don ha Jerusalem ban kular ban sumar ïa ka jutang . Bad kumta ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki kohnguh ïa ki jingdawa ka jutang kiba ki la pynlong bad U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with you  ; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood  ; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth .
translation.kha: Da kine ki ktien , nga pynlong ka jutang bad phi : Nga kular ba lano lano ruh ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im da ka jingshlei um , da lei lei ruh ka jingshlei um kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Ornan said unto David , Take it to thee , and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes : lo , I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meat offering  ; I give it all .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka , Syiem Kynrad ,  u Araunah u ong ,  bad leh ïa ka katba phi sngewbit . Hangne ki don ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh ha ka duwan , bad hangne ki don ki lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang , bad u kew ban ai kum ka jingainguh . Nga ai ïa ki baroh ha phi .

translation.en: Nay , my lord , hear me : the field give I thee , and the cave that is therein , I give it thee  ; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee : bury thy dead .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko rangbah , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka lyngkha baroh kawei , bad ïa kata ka krem kaba don hangta . Hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki para jait jong nga , ngan ai ïa ka ha phi khnang ba phin ïoh tep ïa la ka tnga .

translation.en: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high , and covered with their wings over the mercy seat , with their faces one to another  ; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims .
translation.kha: Kita ki Kherub ki ïaphai markhmat halor kata ka jingtap , bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki kah ïa ka .

translation.en: She hath killed her beasts  ; she hath mingled her wine  ; she hath also furnished her table .
translation.kha: Ka la shah ba kin pynïap ïa ki jingri jong ka na ka bynta ka jingkhawai , ka la khleh jingiwbih ha ka waiñ , bad ka la pynkhreh ïa ka miej .

translation.en: So the resurrection tells us about Jehovah’s love and undeserved kindness .
translation.kha: Te ka jingpynmihpat ka batai ïa ngi shaphang ka jingieit bad jingaiei jong U Jehobah .

translation.en: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me  ; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee , and they have believed that thou didst send me .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor kaba me la ai ha nga , bad ki la pdiang ïa ka ; ki tip ba ka long kaba shisha ba nga la wan na me , bad ki ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: But when Jesus heard that , he said unto them ,  They that be whole need not a physician , but they that are sick .
