translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab ,  Ki briew kiba koit bakhiah kim donkam ïa u nongsumar , hynrei tang kito kiba pang .

translation.en: And Hazael said , But what , is thy servant a dog , that he should do this great thing ? And Elisha answered , The  Lord  hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria .
translation.kha: Kumno keiñ ngan long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta katta ?  u Hasael u kylli .  Ngam long ei ei ruh em !  U Elisha u phai ktien ,  U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha nga ba men sa long u syiem ka Syria .

translation.en: Upon this I awaked , and beheld  ; and my sleep was sweet unto me .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ki briew kin ong , ‘ Nga la leit thiah bad nga la kyndit ha ka jingthymmai bor .’

translation.en: Reprove not a scorner , lest he hate thee : rebuke a wise man , and he will love thee .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynbeit ïa u briew uba hangamei ; un isih ïa phi na ka bynta kata . Hynrei lada phi pynbeit ïa u briew uba stad , un burom ïa phi .

translation.en: Neither will I hide my face any more from them : for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan theh buk ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha ki paid Israel , bad ngan ym phai dien shuh na ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: Is any among you afflicted ? let him pray . Is any merry ? let him sing psalms .
translation.kha: Hato don napdeng jong phi ba shem jynjar ? U dei ban duwai . Hato don uba kmen ? U dei ban rwai ïaroh .

translation.en: Also I shook my lap , and said , So God shake out every man from his house , and from his labour , that performeth not this promise , even thus be he shaken out , and emptied . And all the congregation said , Amen , and praised the  Lord . And the people did according to this promise .
translation.kha: Nangta nga shim ïa ka jaiñ ba nga teh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong nga bad kynther ïa ka .  Kumne U Blei un kynther ïano ïano na phi u bym bat ïa la ka kular ,  nga ong .  U Blei un shim noh ïa ki ïing jong phi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi don , bad un iehnoh ïa phi khlem don ei ei shuh .  Baroh kiba don hangta ki ong ,  Amen !  bad ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai . Bad ki nongïalam ki bat ïa ka kular jong ki .

translation.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear : Fear him , which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell  ; yea , I say unto you , Fear him .
translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïano ban sheptieng : To sheptieng ïa U Blei , uba , hadien ka jingpynïap , u don ka bor ban bret sha ka dujok . To ngeit ïa nga , u long ma u uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng !

translation.en: When he prepared the heavens , I was there : when he set a compass upon the face of the depth :
translation.kha: Nga la lah don hangta mynba u thaw ïa ka sahit bneng , mynba u pynïar ïa ka jylli halor ka duriaw ,

translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , and put words in his mouth : and I will be with thy mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what ye shall do .
translation.kha: Me lah ban ïakren bad u , bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba un ong . Ngan ïarap ïa phi baroh ar ngut ban kren , bad ngan ïathuh ha phi aïu phin leh .

translation.en: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee , and shall pursue thee , and overtake thee , till thou be destroyed  ; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee :
translation.kha: Kine ki jingpynjot baroh kin sa ngat ha phi , bad kin bam bad lynshop ïa phi haduh ba phin da jot thiaw , namar ba phim kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad phim sumar ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem , and to hinder it .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïasylla lang ban wan bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad thaw jingkulmar ,

translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray , and not to faint  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha la ki synran ïa ka pharshi ban hikai ïa ki ba ki dei ban duwai borabor ban ym noh mynsiem da lei lei ruh .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and forgat the  Lord  their God , and served Baalim and the groves .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa u bad mane ïa ki bleithaw Baal bad Asherah .

translation.en: These words the  Lord  spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire , of the cloud , and of the thick darkness , with a great voice : and he added no more . And he wrote them in two tables of stone , and delivered them unto me .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ïa kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi baroh mynba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U la kren da ka sur kaba donbor napdeng kata ka ding bad u lyoh uba rben , mynba u ai ïa ki ha phi khlem da bynrap ïa kiwei pat . Nangta u thoh ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap bad u ai ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will make thee a terror to thyself , and to all thy friends : and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies , and thine eyes shall behold it : and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall carry them captive into Babylon , and shall slay them with the sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ngan pynlong ïa me ka jingshyrkhei ïa me hi bad ïa ki paralok jong me , bad men ïohi ïa ki baroh ba ki shah pynïap da ki waitlam jong ki nongshun jong ki . Ngan buh ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah hapoh ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia ; un shim katto katne ngut kum ki koidi sha ka ri jong u bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Tom didn't come home until 2 :30 .
translation.kha: U Tom u khlem wan ïng haduh 2 :30 .

translation.en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains  ; the earth with her bars was about me for ever : yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption , O  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Nga la ngam shaduh ki trai jong ki lumbah , sha ka ri kaba ki khyrdop ki khang junom . Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  U Blei jong nga , me la wanrah im pat ïa nga na ki jingjylliew .

translation.en: Awake , awake , Deborah : awake , awake , utter a song : arise , Barak , and lead thy captivity captive , thou son of Abinoam .
translation.kha: Ïalam , Deborah , ïalam ! Ïalam ! Rwai ka jingrwai ! Ïalam ! Tur sha khmat , ko Barak , u khun jong u Abinoam , Ïalam noh ïa ki mraw jong me !

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of knowledge : but fools despise wisdom and instruction .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , nyngkong phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai . Ki briew kiba mutlop kim don ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingstad bad ki kyntait ban shah hikai .

translation.en: He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki pud jong phi ban long skhem bad u pynkdang ïa phi da u kew babha tam .

translation.en: Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you :
translation.kha: To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie ïa phi .

translation.en: Then they told David , saying , Behold , the Philistines fight against Keilah , and they rob the threshingfloors .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ïohsngew ba ki Philistia ki tur ïaleh ïa ka nongrit Keilah bad lute ïa ki kew ba dang shu lah ot .

translation.en: Look to yourselves , that we lose not those things which we have wrought , but that we receive a full reward .
translation.kha: To phin sumar ïa lade , namarkata , khnang ba phin ym duh noh ïa kaei kaba ngi , ngi la trei , hynrei phin ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong kaba pura .

translation.en: And Jeremiah said , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga

translation.en: And the law is not of faith : but , The man that doeth them shall live in them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Hukum kam don ei ei ban leh bad ka jingngeit . Pynban kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Jar uba leh ïa baroh ïa kaba ka hukum ka dawa un ïoh im .

translation.en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love , and they defiled her with their whoredom , and she was polluted with them , and her mind was alienated from them .
translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki wan ïathiah shongkha bad ka . Ki pyndonkam ïa ka bad ki pyntngit ïa ka katta katta haduh ba khatduh kan da sngewngiah ïa ki .

translation.en: And they come unto him , bringing one sick of the palsy , which was borne of four .
translation.kha: haba saw ngut ki rangbah ki la poi , ki da rah ïa u briew uba pang ïapshiliang sha U Jisu .

translation.en: And David said to Solomon his son , Be strong and of good courage , and do it : fear not , nor be dismayed : for the  Lord  God , even my God , will be with thee  ; he will not fail thee , nor forsake thee , until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ha u Solomon u khun jong u ,  To long uba sngewskhem bad uba kut jingmut . Sdang ïa ka kam bad wat ai kano kano ruh kan pynsangeh ïa me . U  Trai  U Blei , uba nga shakri un don bad me . Un ym iehnoh ïa me , hynrei un don ryngkat bad me tad haduh ba men pyndep ïa ka kam kaba dei ban trei ha ka Templ jong u .

translation.en: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure
translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ ka khyndew jong u Ephron kaba ha Makhpelah , kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , ka kylla long ka jong u Abraham . Ka kynthup ïa ka lyngkha , ïa ka krem kaba don hangta , bad ïa ki dieng baroh kiba don hapoh ki pud jong ka .

translation.en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth ; fornication , uncleanness , inordinate affection , evil concupiscence , and covetousness , which is idolatry :
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynïap troiñ , te , ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei kiba trei hapoh jong phi , kum ka jingawria , ka jingkhlem-akor , ka jingkwah brai , ki jingkwah basniew , bad ka jinglalot (naba ka jinglalot ka long kawei pat ka dur jong ka jingmane bleithaw) .

translation.en: Any one of Jehovah’s Witnesses will be pleased to help you to reason on the meaning of the Scriptures . —Read Luke 24 :32 , 45 .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ong ïa iwei na Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phi ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingmut jong ki dkhot Baibl .—Pule Loukas 24 :32 , 45 .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when David was come to Mahanaim , that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo–debar , and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim ,
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la wan poi ha Mahanaim , u Shobi , u khun jong u Nahash , na ka shnong Rabbah kaba ha Ammon , u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , na Lodebar , bad u Barsillai , na Rogelim kaba ha Gilead , ki la wan ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: For these things were done , that the scripture should be fulfilled , A bone of him shall not be broken .
translation.kha: Ïa kane la leh ban pynurlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid :  Yn ym pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki shyieng jong u .

translation.en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers : now thy shepherds which were with us , we hurt them not , neither was there ought missing unto them , all the while they were in Carmel .
translation.kha: U la ïohsngew ba phi dang ot shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , bad u kwah ïa phi ban tip ba ki nongap langbrot jong phi ki don bad ngi bad ngim shym pynmynsaw ïa ki . Ym shym la tuh ïa kano kano kaba dei ka jong ki ha ki por baroh haba ki don ha Karmel .

translation.en: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the  Lord  , and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small , and bring it within the veil :
translation.kha: un shim ïa u khiew thang jingiwbih ba la pyndap da u rnga ding barhem na ka duwan bad ar kham ka jingiwbih , bad un wanrah ïa ki sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam .

translation.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
translation.kha: Ka ong ruh , ‘ Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me kin ym mynsaw ha ki maw .’

translation.en: And whosoever will be chief among you , let him be your servant :
translation.kha: bad lada uwei na phi u kwah ban long uba nyngkong , u dei ban long u mraw jong phi —

translation.en: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by the prophet Haggai , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew wei jong u bnai uba hynñiew ha kata kajuh ka snem , U  Trai  u la kren biang lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial  ; they knew not the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Eli ki dei ki riewbymman . Kim ju shahshkor ïa U  Trai

translation.en: Also every sickness , and every plague , which is not written in the book of this law , them will the  Lord  bring upon thee , until thou be destroyed .
translation.kha: Un phah sa ïa ki jait jingpang bad jingïapthem baroh ïa kiba ym shym la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai U Blei , bad phin sa jot thiaw .

translation.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me , and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies .
translation.kha: U Blei u bitar bad tur pyrshah ïa nga ; u leh ïa nga kum ïa u nongshun basniew tam jong u .

translation.en: And the Lord said unto him ,  Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter  ; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness .
translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Mynta te , phi ki Pharisi phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang jong phi , hynrei hapoh , phi dap da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingsniew .

translation.en: And now I ask one petition of thee , deny me not . And she said unto him , Say on .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga don kawei ka jingkyrpad ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga .   Kaei kata ?  ka Bathsheba ka kylli .

translation.en: And Moses brought their cause before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u wanrah ïa ka kam jong ki ha khmat U  Trai  ,

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  said unto me , Take thee a great roll , and write in it with a man s pen concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga ,  Shim ka lyngkhot tiar thoh jingthoh kaba heh bad thoh ha ka da ki dak kiba heh : ‘ Maher-shalal-hash-bas .   ’

translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron , and said , Entreat the  Lord  , that he may take away the frogs from me , and from my people  ; and I will let the people go , that they may do sacrifice unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron , bad u ong ,  To kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kine ki jakoid , bad ngan sa pyllait ïa ki briew jong phi ba kin ïoh kñia ainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: From thence she seeketh the prey , and her eyes behold afar off .
translation.kha: Na kata ka jaka u peit shane bad shatai ban ïoh ei ei ban pynïap bad ban bam .

translation.en: And the border went up to Beth–hoglah , and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah  ; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben :
translation.kha: ka ïar sha Beth Hoglah , nangta ka ïaid shaphang shatei jong ka kynjang ha kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta ka kiew artet sha u Maw jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,

translation.en: And their forty sockets of silver  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
translation.kha: lem bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei ka jingker .

translation.en: Because they provoked his spirit , so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkthang ïa u haduh katta katta haduh ba u la kren khlem da ap ban pyrkhat .

translation.en: Then said David , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , as his father shewed kindness unto me . And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father . And David s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Nga dei ban pyn-i ïa ka jingneh ka jingïalong paralok ïa u Hanun , kumba u Nahash , u kpa jong u , u la leh ïa nga .  Kumta u Dabid u phah ki nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . Haba ki la poi ha Ammon ,

translation.en: And as they departed , Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
translation.kha: Katba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki dang mihnoh , U Jisu u la kren shaphang jong u ha ki paidbah ;  Haba phi leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , kaei kaba phi khmih lynti ban ïohi ? Ïa u sla phlang ba la pynkhun ha ka lyer !

translation.en: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves , and that they should come and keep the gates , to sanctify the sabbath day . Remember me , O my God , concerning this also , and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy .
translation.kha: Nga la hukum ïa ki Lebi ban pynkhuid ïa lade bad ban leit bad pahara ïa ki khyrdop ban pynthikna ba ïa ka sngi Sabbaton la sumar khuid ïa ka . Kynmaw ïa nga , A Blei , na ka bynta kane ruh , bad tyngkai ïa nga namar ka jingieit bakhraw jong me .

translation.en: For God shall bring every work into judgment , with every secret thing , whether it be good , or whether it be evil .
translation.kha: U Blei un bishar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ngi leh , la kaba bha ne kaba sniew , wat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kaba rieh .

translation.en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests ,
translation.kha: Ka dei namar kane ka jingthmu ba nga la leit sha Damaskos da ka bor bad ka hukum na ki rangbah lyngdoh .

translation.en: Be merciful , O  Lord  , unto thy people Israel , whom thou hast redeemed , and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel s charge . And the blood shall be forgiven them .
translation.kha: A Trai , map ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait na Ijipt . Map ïa ngi bad wat pynkit pop ha ngi namar ka jingpynïap ïa uta uba lui lui .’

translation.en: But and if that servant say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens , and to eat and drink , and to be drunken  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uta u shakri u ong ha lade ba u kynrad jong u , u shim por slem ban wan phai bad lada u sdang ban shoh ïa kiwei pat ki shakri , shynrang bad kynthei , bad bam bad dih bad buaid ,

translation.en: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus . The brethren which are with me greet you .
translation.kha: To ai khublei ïa uwei pa uwei na ki briew jong U Blei kiba ha U Khrist Jisu . Ki parabangeit hangne lem bad nga ki phah sha phi ki jingkhublei jong ki .

translation.en: And he said , It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery , neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome : but the noise of them that sing do I hear .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ,  Kata kam shym sawa kum ka jingrisa jop thma , lane kum ka jinglynñiar kiba shahjop ; hynrei ka dei ka jingsawa jong ka jingïarwai .

translation.en: And the priest that offereth any man s burnt offering , even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered .
translation.kha: Ka snieh jong u mrad ba la kñia ïa uba la wanrah kum ka jingainguh thang ruh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .

translation.en: As for me , this is my covenant with them , saith the  Lord   ; My spirit that is upon thee , and my words which I have put in thy mouth , shall not depart out of thy mouth , nor out of the mouth of thy seed , nor out of the mouth of thy seed s seed , saith the  Lord  , from henceforth and for ever .
translation.kha: Bad ngan pynlong ka Jutang bad phi : Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ki jinghikai jong nga kin long bad phi junom , bad naduh mynta phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad hikai ïa ki khun jong phi bad ïa ki pateng jong phi ban kohnguh ïa nga ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Take these evidences , this evidence of the purchase , both which is sealed , and this evidence which is open  ; and put them in an earthen vessel , that they may continue many days .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la hukum ïa phi ban shim ïa kine ki dulir thied jaka baroh ar tylli , ka dulir thied jaka ba la shon muhor bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor , bad ban buh ïa ki ha u khra khyndew , khnang ba kin neh ha ki snem ki ban wan .

translation.en: Through the tender mercy of our God  ; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us ,
translation.kha: U Blei jong ngi u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba jemnud . Un pynlong ïa ka step baphyrnai jong ka jingpynim ban mih ha ngi

translation.en: And he answering said to his father , Lo , these many years do I serve thee , neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment : and yet thou never gavest me a kid , that I might make merry with my friends :
translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab ïa la u kpa , ‘ Ha khmih , baroh kine ki snem nga la trei kum u mraw na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngam pat ju saitlah ïa ki hukum jong phi . Phi la ai aïu ïa nga ? Ym don wat tang kawei ka blang na ka bynta jong nga ban ïakhawai bad ki paralok jong nga !

translation.en: And there came also Nicodemus , which at the first came to Jesus by night , and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes , about an hundred pound weight .
translation.kha: U Nikodemos , uba ha kaba nyngkong u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa U Jisu mynmiet , u la leit ryngkat bad u Joseph , u da rah bad u kumba laiphew kilo ki musla , ka jingkhleh lang jong ka mirr bad ka alos .

translation.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together , and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock : and dust shall be the serpent s meat . They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki suri bad ki khunlangbrot kin ïabam lang , ki sing kin bam phlang , kumba bam ki masi , bad ki bseiñ kin ym long shuh ka jingma . Ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga yn ym don shuh ka jingma ne kaba sniew .

translation.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :
translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki ïai leh ïa kaba bha , bad wad burom , ka nam babha , bad ka jingim bymïap shuh ; ïa ki U Blei un ai ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: And she said , Oh my lord , as thy soul liveth , my lord , I am the woman that stood by thee here , praying unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka ong ha u ,  Ko kynrad ! Phi dang kynmaw mo ïa nga ? Nga dei kato ka briew kaba phi ïohi kaba ïeng hangne kaba duwai ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And I will shake all nations , and the desire of all nations shall come : and I will fill this house with glory , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkyllon ïa ki hima baroh , bad ïa ki jingkynshew yn wallam shane , bad ïa ka Templ yn pyndap da ka spah .

translation.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame , and thine infamy turn not away .
translation.kha: Lym kumta baroh kin tip ba phi long u bym lah ban set ïa kiei kiei kiba rieh bad phin ym lah ban lait na kane ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: And he came unto the men of Succoth , and said , Behold Zebah and Zalmunna , with whom ye did upbraid me , saying , Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand , that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u leit sha ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth bad u ong ,  Kynmaw haba phi la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga ? Phi ong ba phim lah ban ai jingbam ei ei ïa ki shipai jong nga kiba la thait ïan namar ba ngam pat shym la ïohkem ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna . Te , kine hangne !

translation.en: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf : but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good , and simple concerning evil .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel , bad na ka bynta kane , nga sngewkmen shibun shaphang jong phi . Nga kwah ïa phi ban long kiba stad shaphang kaei kaba bha , hynrei ban long lui lui ha kaei kaba sniew .

translation.en: Ammiel the sixth , Issachar the seventh , Peulthai the eighth : for God blessed him .
translation.kha: U don ruh u Obed Edom , uba U Blei u la kyrkhu da kaba ai ha u phra ngut ki khun shynrang , kiba la jer ter ter kat kum ka rta : u Shemaïah , u Jehosabad , u Joah , u Sakhar , u Nethanel , u Ammiel , u Issakhar , bad u Peullethai .

translation.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son , and to all his servants , that they should kill David .
translation.kha: U Saul u ïathuh ha u Jonathan u khun jong u bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ba u thmu ban pynïap ïa u Dabid . Hynrei u Jonathan u sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid ,

translation.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud , and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth  ; so the Lord  God  will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations .
translation.kha: Shisha kumba u symbai u khie lung bad u san , U  Trai  Nongsynshar un ïada ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin ïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: And Jonadab said unto him , Lay thee down on thy bed , and make thyself sick : and when thy father cometh to see thee , say unto him , I pray thee , let my sister Tamar come , and give me meat , and dress the meat in my sight , that I may see it , and eat it at her hand .
translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u ,  Khie leit thiah , bad leh mynleh pang . Haba i pa jong phi i wan jngoh ïa phi , ong ha i , ‘ Sngewbha ong ïa i para jong nga i Tamar ban wan bad ai bam ïa nga . Nga kwah ïa i ban pynkhreh jingbam hangne ha kaba nga lah ban ïohi ïa i , bad ba in ai bam ïa nga da ma i hi .’

translation.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba , daughter of Amminadab , sister of Nahshon , to wife  ; and she bare him Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .
translation.kha: U Aaron u shongkurim ïa ka Elisheba , ka khun jong u Amminadab bad ka para jong u Nahshon . Ka la kha ïa u Nadab , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar .

translation.en: Who smote great nations , and slew mighty kings  ;
translation.kha: U la pynjot bun ki jaitbynriew bad u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba khrawbor :

translation.en: And Abram journeyed , going on still toward the south .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , u da leit shaphang ka bynta bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: But now he hath made me weary : thou hast made desolate all my company .
translation.kha: Me la pynduhbor ïa nga , A Blei ; me la shah ba yn pynïap ïa ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: And the angel came in unto her , and said , Hail , thou that art highly favoured , the Lord is with thee : blessed art thou among women .
translation.kha: U angel u la wan sha ka bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad pha ! U Trai u long ryngkat bad pha bad u la kyrkhu eh ïa pha !

translation.en: Nevertheless , to avoid fornication , let every man have his own wife , and let every woman have her own husband .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba kynrei than ka jingleh awria , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban don la ka jong ka tnga , bad kawei pa kawei ka briew ka dei ban don la u jong u tnga .

translation.en: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one : and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour .
translation.kha: Ym don jingïapher hapdeng u briew uba bet bad u briew uba ai um ; U Blei un ai bainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ka kam kaba u la leh .

translation.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance , both young men and old together : for I will turn their mourning into joy , and will comfort them , and make them rejoice from their sorrow .
translation.kha: Nangta ki samla kynthei kin shad bad kin kmen , bad ki shynrang , kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin shadkmen . Ngan pyntngen ïa ki bad pynkylla ïa ka jingïambriew sha ka jingkmen , ïa ka jingsngewsih jong ki sha ka jingsngewbha .

translation.en: And I will be found of you , saith the  Lord  : and I will turn away your captivity , and I will gather you from all the nations , and from all the places whither I have driven you , saith the  Lord   ; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga ong , phin shem ïa nga , bad ngan buh pat ïa phi ha ka ri jong phi hi . Ngan lumlang ïa phi na kawei pa kawei ka ri bad na kawei ka jaka sha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka ri na kaba nga la phah noh ïa phi sha ka jingshah ringmraw . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’

translation.en: And these are their names : The son of Hur , in mount Ephraim :
translation.kha: Kine harum ki dei ki kyrteng jong kine ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki distrik kiba ki dei khmih : U Benhur : ka ri lum Ephraim

translation.en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt  ; I am black  ; astonishment hath taken hold on me .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la shah pynlwet namar ki briew jong nga ki la shah pynlwet ; nga ïam sngewsih ; nga la shaïong jur .

translation.en: For while one saith , I am of Paul ; and another , I am of Apollos ; are ye not carnal ?
translation.kha: Haba uwei na phi u ong ,  Nga bud ïa u Paul ,  bad uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Apollos  — hato phim dang leh kum ki riewpyrthei ?

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me  ; This gate shall be shut , it shall not be opened , and no man shall enter in by it  ; because the  Lord  , the God of Israel , hath entered in by it , therefore it shall be shut .
translation.kha: Ka khyrdop ka khang , bad U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kane ka khyrdop kan long ba la khang bad yn ym plie lano lano ruh . Yn ym don u briew ïa uba yn shah ban plie ïa ka , namar ma nga U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la rung lyngba jong ka . Kan sah ba la khang ïa ka .

translation.en: Behold , God exalteth by his power : who teacheth like him ?
translation.kha: To kynmaw katno kaba khraw ka bor jong U Blei ; u dei u nonghikai uba khraw tam na baroh .

translation.en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous , and his ears are open unto their prayers : but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil .
translation.kha: Naba U Trai u khmih halor kiba hok bad u shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki ; hynrei u pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass , and he hath set darkness in my paths .
translation.kha: U Blei u la khang ïa ka lynti , bad ngam lah ban ïaid lyngba ; u la buhrieh ïa ka lynti jong nga ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: As for thee , O king , thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed , what should come to pass hereafter : and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass .
translation.kha: Mynba u Syiem Kynrad u dang ïohthiah , phi la phohsniew shaphang ka lawei ; bad U Blei uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan , u la pyn-i ha phi kaei ka ban sa jia .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , and unto his father s house , I will go up , and shew Pharaoh , and say unto him , My brethren , and my father s house , which were in the land of Canaan , are come unto me  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha ki khun ki kti u kpa jong u ,  Nga dei ban leit ïathuh ha u syiem ba ki hynmen ki para jong nga bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem i pa kiba shong ha Kanaan ki la wan poi sha nga .

translation.en: Then said they , Come , and let us devise devices against Jeremiah  ; for the law shall not perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let us smite him with the tongue , and let us not give heed to any of his words .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew ki la ong ,  To ngin leh ei ei shaphang u Jeremaïah ! Yn don borabor ki lyngdoh ki ban hikai ïa ngi , ki rangbah bastad ban ai jingsyllok ïa ngi , bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei . To ngin wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u , bad sangeh ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u ong .

translation.en: Nevertheless , whereto we have already attained , let us walk by the same rule , let us mind the same thing .
translation.kha: La kumno kumno , lada kata ka lah ban long , to ngin ïa-ïaid sha khmat kat kum kijuh ki kyndon kiba ngi la bud haduh mynta .

translation.en: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves ; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth ;
translation.kha: Me dei ban long uba lehsbun ïa baroh , u nonghikai uba bha bad ba-ïaishah , uba jemnud ha kaba pynbeit ïa ki nongïaleh pyrshah jong me , naba ka lah ban long ba U Blei un ai ha ki ïa ka lad ba kin kylla-kaba-mut bad wan sha ka jingtip ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid .
translation.kha: ( U Laban u ai ïa ka mraw jong u ka Silpah ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban shakri ïa ka . )

translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  They need not depart  ; give ye them to eat .
translation.kha: Kim donkam ban leit ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ban bam !

translation.en: Also we certify you , that touching any of the priests and Levites , singers , porters , Nethinims , or ministers of this house of God , it shall not be lawful to impose toll , tribute , or custom , upon them .
translation.kha: La khang pyrshah ïa phi na kaba lum khajna na ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem , ki nongap phira , ki nongtrei lane kino kino kiba don ka jingïadei bad kane ka Templ .

translation.en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea : and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me , and will cause them to be discharged there , and thou shalt receive them : and thou shalt accomplish my desire , in giving food for my household .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong nga kin pynpoi ïa ki dieng tylli na Lebanon shathie sha ka duriaw bad kin teh lang ïa ki ha ki bur ban pynkie ïa ki sharum jong ka rud duriaw sha ka jaka kaba me jied . Hangta ki rangbah jong nga kin law ïa ki jingteh , bad ki rangbah jong me kin shimti ïa ki . Na ka liang jong me , nga kwah ïa me ban pynbiang jingbam ïa ki rangbah jong nga .

translation.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap noh ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah sanphew snem .

translation.en: And Rachel died , and was buried in the way to Ephrath , which is Beth–lehem .
translation.kha: Haba ka Rakhel ka la ïap , la tep ïa ka harud ka lynti kaba leit sha Ephrath , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethlehem .

translation.en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty : for it was perfect through my comeliness , which I had put upon thee , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Pha la long kaba pawnam ha ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta ka jingbhabriew bajanai jong pha , namar nga long uta uba la pynlong ïa pha kaba ibhabriew .  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .

translation.en: And they said , Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement , and to put her away .
translation.kha: Ka jingjubab jong ki ka long ,  U Moses u la shah ïa u briew ban pyntip da ka jingthoh ïa ka jingpyllait tnga bad iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u .

translation.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire .
translation.kha: Thang noh ïa ka doh ne ïa u kpu ba sah baroh .

translation.en: And ye have seen their abominations , and their idols , wood and stone , silver and gold , which were among them : )
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ïa ki bleithaw kiba isaitmet jong ki , kiba da u dieng , da u maw , da ka rupa , bad da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Till the  Lord  look down , and behold from heaven .
translation.kha: Tad haduh ba U  Trai  un da khmih sha tbian na bneng bad ïohi ïa ngi .

translation.en: And he said , Open the window eastward . And he opened it . Then Elisha said , Shoot . And he shot . And he said , The arrow of the  Lord s  deliverance , and the arrow of deliverance from Syria : for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek , till thou have consumed them .
translation.kha: Nangta , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah u nongïathuhlypa , u syiem u plie ïa ka jingkhang kaba phai khmat sha Syria .  Siat ïa u khnam !  u Elisha u hukum . Hamar ba u syiem u siat ïa u khnam , u nongïathuhlypa u pyrta ,  Me long u khnam jong U  Trai  , da u , un sa ïoh ka jingjop halor ka Syria . Men ïaleh ïa ki Syria ha Aphek haduh ba men da jop thiaw ïa ki .

translation.en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers  ; and ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .
translation.kha: Te phin shong ha ka ri ba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Phin long ki briew jong nga bad ngan long U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king , and said thus unto him , King Darius , live for ever .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit ban jngoh ïa u syiem bad ki la ong ,  Ko syiem Darius , ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Say now Shibboleth : and he said Sibboleth : for he could not frame to pronounce it right . Then they took him , and slew him at the passages of Jordan : and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand .
translation.kha: Ki bthah ïa u ban ong ,  Shibboleth .  Hynrei un ong  Sibboleth ,  namar um nang kynnoh beit ïa ka . Kumta ki kem bad ki pynïap ïa u ha kawei na kita ki jaka na kiba dei ban jam ïa ka Jordan . Sawphew ar hajar ngut ki Ephraim ki shah pynïap ha kata ka por .

translation.en: In Gibeon the  Lord  appeared to Solomon in a dream by night : and God said , Ask what I shall give thee .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew bad u kylli ïa u ,  Kaei me mon ïa nga ban ai ha me ?

translation.en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself , and took the captains of hundreds , Azariah the son of Jeroham , and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan , and Azariah the son of Obed , and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah , and Elishaphat the son of Zichri , into covenant with him .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingap kaba hynriew snem , u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la rai ba ka la dei ka por ban leh ei ei . U ïateh kular bad san ngut ki rangbah shipai : u Asaraïah u khun jong u Jeroham , u Ishmael u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Asaraïah u khun jong u Obed , u Maaseïah u khun jong u Adaïah , bad u Elishaphat u khun jong u Sikhri .

translation.en: And Leah conceived again , and bare Jacob the sixth son .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka la punkhun biang bad ka kha ïa u khun uba hynriew ïa u Jakob .

translation.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler , and from the noisome pestilence .
translation.kha: Un ri sumar ïa me na ki jingma barieh baroh bad na ki jingpang bashyrkhei baroh .

translation.en: For who maketh thee to differ from another ? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive ? now if thou didst receive it , why dost thou glory , as if thou hadst not received it ?
translation.kha: Uei uba pynlong ïa phi ban sngew kham halor ïa kiwei pat ? Hato ym dei U Blei uba la ai ha phi baroh kaba phi don ? Kumta , te , kumno phi lah ban sngewsarong , kumba kaei kaba phi don , kam dei ka jingai sngewbha ?

translation.en: Please keep your voice down .
translation.kha: Sngewbha jarjar .

translation.en: And the Pharisees said unto him , Behold , why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Peit , ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ba ki synran jong me kin leh ïa kata ha ka sngi Sabbaton !

translation.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet , I should have slept : then had I been at rest ,
translation.kha: Lada ngan jin da la ïap ha kata ka por , ngan jin da la don ha ka jingjahthait mynta ,

translation.en: Ish–bosheth Saul s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel , and reigned two years . But the house of Judah followed David .
translation.kha: U la don sawphew snem ka rta mynba la thung ïa u kum u syiem Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem . Hynrei ka jait Judah ka ïaineh skhem ha u Dabid ,

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ? as long as they have the bridegroom with them , they cannot fast .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi khmih lynti ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka jingshongkurim ban leit khlem jingbam ? Ym kumta ! Katba u nongleitkurim u don ryngkat bad ki , kin ym shahthngan .

translation.en: And Naboth said to Ahab , The  Lord  forbid it me , that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohpateng ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ na ki kpa tymmen jong nga .  U Naboth u jubab .  U  Trai  u khang ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: And ran through that whole region round about , and began to carry about in beds those that were sick , where they heard he was .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïamareh ha baroh kata ka thain ; bad shano shano ba ki la ïohsngew ba u don , ki la wallam ha u ïa ki briew kiba pang kiba thiah ha ki jingthiah jong ki .

translation.en: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite  ; for he is thy brother : thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian  ; because thou wast a stranger in his land .
translation.kha: Wat ibeiñ ïa ki Edom ; ki long hi ki para jong phi . Bad wat ibeiñ ïa ki Ijipt ; phi la shong shipor ha ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: For the days shall come upon thee , that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee , and compass thee round , and keep thee in on every side ,
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi haba ki nongshun jong pha kin ker sawdong ïa pha da ki jingker , ki jingkhanglad ïa pha , bad ki nang tur jan sha pha na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; call upon his name : make known his deeds among the people .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And the sons of Uzzi  ; Izrahiah : and the sons of Izrahiah  ; Michael , and Obadiah , and Joel , Ishiah , five : all of them chief men .
translation.kha: U Ussi u don uwei u khun , u Israhaïah . U Israhaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u saw ngut , u Mikhael , u Obadaïah , u Joel , bad u Isshaïah , ki dei baroh ki khlieh jong ki longïing .

translation.en: A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .
translation.kha: U sakhi uba lah ban shaniah , borabor u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei u bym lah ban shaniah , u ïathuh tang ïa kaba lamler .

translation.en: And the graves were opened  ; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose ,
translation.kha: ki jingtep ki la ang , bad ïa shibun ki briew jong U Blei kiba la ïap la pynmihpat .

translation.en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly  ; and shalt thou be delivered ?
translation.kha: Me la ïohsngew kaei ba u patsha Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato me pyrkhat ba men lait im ?

translation.en: And as Peter was coming in , Cornelius met him , and fell down at his feet , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang rung , u Kornelios u la leit kynduh ïa u , u la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la nguh dem ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool .
translation.kha: Hangta u ap mynta tad ynda U Blei u la pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong u kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he : hold him fast .
translation.kha: U nongshetkylla u la lah ai dak ïa u paidbah :  U briew uba ngan doh u long uta uba phi kwah . To kem ïa u !

translation.en: My righteousness is near  ; my salvation is gone forth , and mine arms shall judge the people  ; the isles shall wait upon me , and on mine arm shall they trust .
translation.kha: Ngan wan kloi bad ngan pynim ïa ki ; ka por jong ka jingjop ka la hajan . Nga da lade hi ngan synshar halor ki jaitbynriew . Ki ri ba hajngai bah ki ap ïa nga ba ngan wan ; ki ap da ka jingkyrmen ïa nga ban pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted , to the oppressing city !
translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem ka long kaba la tim , kata ka nongbah kaba ijli , kaba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , kaba banbeiñ ïa la ki jong ki briew .

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Let her alone  ; why trouble ye her ? she hath wrought a good work on me .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Ieh ïa ka marwei ! Balei ba phi pynwit ïa ka ? Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha bad ba-itynnat na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes : but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop borabor ki pyrkhat ba ki leh ïa kaba dei . Ki briew kiba stad ki shahshkor ïa ki jingpyn-i lem .

translation.en: I said , I will go up to the palm tree , I will take hold of the boughs thereof : now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine , and the smell of thy nose like apples  ;
translation.kha: Ai ba u syiem un don hynriewphew ngut ki mahadei , phraphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ki kynthei ba dang samla khlem ka jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon jong ki !

translation.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions , he was bruised for our iniquities : the chastisement of our peace was upon him  ; and with his stripes we are healed .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ki pop jong ngi ïa u la pynmong , la sympat namar ka jingbymman kaba ngi la leh . La pynkhiah ïa ngi da ka jingpynshitom kaba u la shah , la pynkhiah ïa ngi da ki jingsympat kiba u la ïoh .

translation.en: Wherefore we would have come unto you , even I Paul , once and again ; but Satan hindered us .
translation.kha: Ngi la kwah ban wan phai pat sha phi . Nga hi nga la pyrshang ban leit phai pat palat ïa ka shisien , hynrei u Soitan um ailad ïa ngi .

translation.en: O inhabitant of Aroer , stand by the way , and espy  ; ask him that fleeth , and her that escapeth , and say , What is done ?
translation.kha: Phi kiba shong ha Aroer , ïeng harud lynti bad ap ; kylli na kito kiba ïaphet noh , wad jingtip na ki ïa kaei kaba la jia .

translation.en: Let all bitterness , and wrath , and anger , and clamour , and evil speaking , be put away from you , with all malice :
translation.kha: To bret noh ïa baroh ka jingkthang mynsiem , ka jingkwah brai bad ka jingbitar . Keiñ noh ka jingkaw kaw , lane ka jingkrenbeiñ bad keiñ noh ki jingsngew isih la ha kano kano ka rukom .

translation.en: Also to punish the just is not good , nor to strike princes for equity .
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei ban pynlong ïa u briew balui lui ban siew ïa ka kuna ; ka pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingbishar bahok haba ki briew kiba bha ki shah pynshitom .

translation.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it , by the two corners thereof , upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it  ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba marpyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .

translation.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him : for some said , He is a good man : others said , Nay  ; but he deceiveth the people .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingïa-pasiaw kaba jur shaphang jong u hapdeng u paidbah .  U long u briew uba bha ,  don kiba la ong .  Em ,  kiwei ki la ong ,  u ïalam bakla ïa ki briew .

translation.en: Saying ,  If thou hadst known , even thou , at least in this thy day , the things which belong unto thy peace ! but now they are hid from thine eyes .
translation.kha: Lada phan jin da la tip mynta ïa kaei kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingsuk ! Hynrei mynta pham lah ban ïohi ïa ka !

translation.en: And the winepress was trodden without the city , and blood came out of the winepress , even unto the horse bridles , by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs .
translation.kha: Ïa ki sohwaiñ la khñiot ha ka jaka khñiot waiñ shabar ka nongbah , bad ka snam ka la mihnoh na ka jaka khñiot waiñ ha ka jingshlei kumba laispah kilomitar ka jingjrong bad la jan ar mitar ka jingjylliew .

translation.en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol , and saw the land , they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel , that they should not go into the land which the  Lord  had given them .
translation.kha: Ki la leit haduh ka Them Eshkol bad ki la ïohi ïa ka ri , hynrei ynda ki la wan phai ki la pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew na kaba leit rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki .

translation.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u bitar ïa phi , ka jingai sngewbha kaba ai ha kaba rieh ka pynjem jai ïa u .

translation.en: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars , and maketh diviners mad  ; that turneth wise men backward , and maketh their knowledge foolish  ;
translation.kha: Nga pynpaw bieit ïa ki nongpeit kti bad pynkulmar ïa ki jingïathuh lypa ki nongbatai kupar . Ki ktien jong kiba stad nga kyntait bad pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong ki ka long ka jingbieit .

translation.en: Men shall buy fields for money , and subscribe evidences , and seal them , and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , and in the cities of the mountains , and in the cities of the valley , and in the cities of the south : for I will cause their captivity to return , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin thied ïa ki , bad ïa ki dulir thied jaka yn soi , shon muhor bad yn sakhi . Kane kan jia ha ka ri Benjamin , ha ki shnong sawdong ka Jerusalem , ha ki shnong ka Judah , bad ha ki shnong ka ri lum , ha ki kjat lum , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ngan pynïoh pat ha ki briew ïa ka ri jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is , than a stalled ox and hatred therewith .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban bam ïa ki jhur bad ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ban ïa kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba bha tam ha kaba don ka jingpihuiñ .

translation.en: Last of all the woman died also .
translation.kha: Khatduh na ki baroh , kata ka briew ka la ïap .

translation.en: We will not return unto our houses , until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance .
translation.kha: Ngin ym leit phai sha la ki longïing jong ngi tad haduh ba kiwei pat ki Israel baroh ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba la ai ha ki .

translation.en: Who are they among all the gods of these lands , that have delivered their land out of my hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno na ki blei baroh jong kine ki ri uba la ju pyllait ïa la ka ri na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u lah ban pyllait ïa ka Jerusalem ?

translation.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate , and thy neck is an iron sinew , and thy brow brass  ;
translation.kha: Nga la tip ba phin pynshisha ba phi long kiba mutlop , kiba pyneh kum ka nar bad ka rnong bym lah ban pynkdor .

translation.en: And Samuel died  ; and all the Israelites were gathered together , and lamented him , and buried him in his house at Ramah . And David arose , and went down to the wilderness of Paran .
translation.kha: Te u Samuel u la ïap , bad ki Israel baroh ki ïawanlang bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong u . Nangta ki tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u ha Ramah . Hadien kane , u Dabid u leit sha ka ri khlaw Paran .

translation.en: But his bow abode in strength , and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob  ; ( from thence is the shepherd , the stone of Israel : )
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ryntieh jong u ka neh khlem khih , Bad ïa ki ksang ti jong u la pynkhlaiñ Da ka bor jong U Blei Uba Khlaiñbor jong u Jakob , Da u Nongap langbrot , U nongïada jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And they were filled with madness  ; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla bad ki la sdang ban ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki ïa kaei ba ki lah ban leh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And when the ship was caught , and could not bear up into the wind , we let her drive .
translation.kha: Ka la lynshop ïa ka lieng , bad namar ka long ka bym lah ban king ïa ka lieng sha khmat pyrshah ïa ka lyer , ngi la sangeh ban pyrshang bad ngi la shah ïa ka ban shah kit katba shaba beh ka lyer .

translation.en: My tabernacle is spoiled , and all my cords are broken : my children are gone forth of me , and they are not : there is none to stretch forth my tent any more , and to set up my curtains .
translation.kha: La pynjot ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ïa ki tyllai ba pynskhem ïa ki la pyndkut . Ki khun jong ngi ki la leit noh baroh ; ym don shuh mano mano ba dang sah ban pynïeng pat ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ym don shuh mano mano ban wah ïa ki pyrda jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: And  God  saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth , and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingsniew jong uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka pyrthei bad katno ki jingmut jingpyrkhat bymman jong ki ha ki por baroh ,

translation.en: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the  Lord  , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .
translation.kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka tynrai jong ka jingim jong ngi , ïa u syiem uba U  Trai  u la jied , uta uba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na uno uno u nonghiarthma .

translation.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof .
translation.kha: Te ïa ka hukum kaba mynshuwa la buh sharud , namar ba ka long kaba tlot bad ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: For this is the day of the Lord  God  of hosts , a day of vengeance , that he may avenge him of his adversaries : and the sword shall devour , and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood : for the Lord  God  of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka sngi jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh : ha kane ka sngi un pynhiarkput ; ha kane ka sngi un pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u . Ka waitlam jong u kan bam ïa ki haduh ban da kdang , bad dih ïa ka snam jong ki haduh ban da sngewhun . Ha kane ka sngi u Badonbor Baroh u kñia ïa kiba la shah pynmong ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis .

translation.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered  ; he shall not leave any of it until the morning .
translation.kha: Ïa ka doh jong uta u mrad dei ban bam noh ha kata hi ka sngi ba la kñia ïa u ; ym dei ban pynsah wat tang khyndiat ruh haduh ka step kaba bud .

translation.en: For I say unto you , That unto every one which hath shall be given  ; and from him that hath not , even that he hath shall be taken away from him .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga ong ha phi ,’ u la jubab , ‘ ba ha uno uno u briew uba don ei ei , yn ai kham bun shuh shuh ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wat ïa kaba rit kaba u don yn shim noh na u .

translation.en: That ye be not slothful , but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises .
translation.kha: Ngim kwah ïa phi ba phin long kiba alhia , hynrei ban long kum kita kiba ngeit bad ban long kiba ïaishah , bad kumta ban ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shipai ki aiti noh ïa kita ki koidi bad ïa ki mar lute ha ki paidbah bad ki nongïalam jong ki ,

translation.en: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria , Whereon do ye trust , that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Ma nga , u Sennakherib , u Patsha ka Assyria , nga kylli uei uba ai ha phi ba phin don ïa ka jingsngewskhem katba ka Jerusalem ka dang don ha ka jingshah kerkut .

translation.en: And Eli said unto her , How long wilt thou be drunken ? put away thy wine from thee .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha ka ,  Keiñ noh kane ka jingleh buaid jong pha ! Wat dih shuh bad pynpyngngad noh !

translation.en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day , even toward the place of which thou hast said , My name shall be there : that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place .
translation.kha: Khmih halor kane ka Templ mynsngi bad mynmiet , kane ka jaka ha kaba me la jied ban mane ïa me . Shahshkor ïa nga haba nga phai ka khmat sha kane ka templ ban duwai .

translation.en: There were once a King and a Queen , and they had a son called Sigurd , who was very strong and active , and good-looking .
translation.kha: Shisien ka por la don u syiem bad ka syiem , bad ki don u khun ba kyrteng u Sigurd uba khlain ba smat , bad ba bhabriew bha .

translation.en: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and shalt put water therein .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ka dabor hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap ïa ka da ka um .

translation.en: But all the cattle , and the spoil of the cities , we took for a prey to ourselves .
translation.kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri , bad ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , stand upon thy feet , and I will speak unto thee .
translation.kha: Te nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ,  Ko khun u briew ïeng joit . Nga kwah ban ïakren bad me .

translation.en: The king spake , and said , Is not this great Babylon , that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power , and for the honour of my majesty ?
translation.kha: u la ong ,  Ha khmih katno khraw ka Babilon ka long ! Nga la tei ïa ka kum ka nongbah jong nga ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , ka burom jong nga bad ka jinglong syiem jong nga .

translation.en: All flesh shall perish together , and man shall turn again unto dust .
translation.kha: te uwei pa uwei uba im un ïap bad un kylla long dewmet sa shisien .

translation.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek  ; after thee , Benjamin , among thy people  ; out of Machir came down governors , and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer .
translation.kha: Ki la wan na Ephraim sha ka them , Hadien ka jait Benjamin bad ki briew jong ka . Ki nongai hukum ki la wan hiar na Makhir , Ki rangbah pynïaidkam na Sebulun .

translation.en: Take the millstones , and grind meal : uncover thy locks , make bare the leg , uncover the thigh , pass over the rivers .
translation.kha: Pynshad ïa u mawtylliat ! Pynlwet ïa u  purew ! Weng ïa ka jingkah khmat ! Law noh ïa ki jaiñ bani jong pha ! Syndong ïa la ki jaiñphong ban jam ïa ki wahduid !

translation.en: And there was there with us a young man , an Hebrew , servant to the captain of the guard  ; and we told him , and he interpreted to us our dreams  ; to each man according to his dream he did interpret .
translation.kha: Uwei u samla Hebru u la don hangta lem bad ngi , uba dei u mraw jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira . Ngi la ïathuh ha u ïa la ki jingphohsniew , bad u la batai ïa ki ha ngi .

translation.en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , even holy convocations , which ye shall proclaim in their seasons .
translation.kha: Pynbna paidbah ïa kine ki Jingkhawai Niam ha ki por ba la buh ban pynlong ïa ki .

translation.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul : he heareth cursing , and bewrayeth it not .
translation.kha: U para nongtuh u long u nongshun uba sniew tam jong u hi . Un shah pynshitom lada u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ha ka ïingbishar , U Blei un tim ïa u lada um leh kumta .

translation.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil  ; the harvest is the end of the world  ; and the reapers are the angels .
translation.kha: bad u nongshun uba la bet ïa ki ñiut u long u Ksuid . Ka jingot ka long kaba kut jong ka Ïa , bad ki nongot ki long ki angel .

translation.en: And the  Lord  gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers  ; and they possessed it , and dwelt therein .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular da kaba kyntang ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ba un ai ha ki . Haba ki la shimti ïa ka , ki la shongduh hangta .

translation.en: But they understood not that saying , and were afraid to ask him .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la sngewthuh aïu kane ka jinghikai ka kit jingmut , bad ki la sngewsheptieng ban kylli ïa u .

translation.en: I will surely assemble , O Jacob , all of thee  ; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel  ; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as the flock in the midst of their fold : they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan lumlang ïa phi , phi baroh ki paid Israel kiba dang sah . Ngan wallam lang ïa phi kum ki langbrot sha ka kynhun . Kum ka jaka bam phlang ba-dap da ki langbrot , ka ri jong phi kan dap biang sa shisien da ki paidbah babun .

translation.en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his  ; and it came to pass , when he went in unto his brother s wife , that he spilled it on the ground , lest that he should give seed to his brother .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Onan u la tip ba ki khun kin ym long ki jong u , kumta haba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u hynmen jong u , u pynhap noh ïa la u symbai sharud , khnang ban yn ym pynïoh khun ïa u hynmen jong u .

translation.en: For who shall have pity upon thee , O Jerusalem ? or who shall bemoan thee ? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Mano ban isynei ïa phi , ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , bad mano ban ïam sngewsih halor jong phi ? Mano ban sangeh kham slem ban kylli phi long kumno ?

translation.en: But he began to curse and to swear , saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak .
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ,  Nga smai ba nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa nga lada ngam long kumta ! Ngam tip shaphang uta u briew uba phi kren !

translation.en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel , nor in all the days of the kings of Israel , nor of the kings of Judah  ;
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum kane ïa kaba la rakhe da uno uno na ki syiem Israel ne Judah , naduh ka por mynba ki nongbishar ki synshar ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Follow me , and I will make you fishers of men .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To wan bad nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ban tong briew .

translation.en: And Saul saw and knew that the  Lord  was with David , and that Michal Saul s daughter loved him .
translation.kha: U Saul u sngewthuh shai ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u Dabid bad ba ka Mikhal ka khun jong u ka ieit ïa u .

translation.en: Know ye not , brethren , (for I speak to them that know the law ) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phin sa sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba ngan sa ong , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar phi baroh phi tip ïa ka hukum . Ka hukum ka synshar halor ki briew tang haba ki dang im .

translation.en: For vain man would be wise , though man be born like a wild ass s colt .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop kin sdang ban long kiba stad haba kha ïa ki kada khlaw ban long kum kiba la pynjuh .

translation.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion , sanctify a fast , call a solemn assembly :
translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi halor u lum Seïon ; to ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingshah jingit bad khot ïa ka jingïaseng bah !

translation.en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern , and pools of water : and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka Babilon sha ka ahor ktieh , bad ki dkhoh kin shong hangta . Ngan sar ïa ka Babilon da u synsar u ban sar lut khoit ïa kaei kaei baroh . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .

translation.en: And Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel  ; and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–maim , and all the store cities of Naphtali .
translation.kha: U Benhadad u la mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Israel . Ki jop ïa ka Ijon , Dan , Abel Beth Maakah , bad baroh ki nongbah ka Naphtali ha kiba la buh ïa ki mar ki mata .

translation.en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him , and slew the king in his own house .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka hok ba-pura ban rung sha ka Hima bymjukut jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi .

translation.en: But thus do unto them , that they may live , and not die , when they approach unto the most holy things : Aaron and his sons shall go in , and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden :
translation.kha: Na ka jait u Gershon ki mih ki longïing jong u Libni bad u Shimei ; kine ki long ki jait Gershon .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai  ; for I will give it into thine hand . And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Kdew ïa u sum jong me ha ka Ai ; nga ai ïa ka ha me .  U Joshua u leh kumba la bthah ,

translation.en: Then he said to Gehazi , Gird up thy loins , and take my staff in thine hand , and go thy way : if thou meet any man , salute him not  ; and if any salute thee , answer him not again : and lay my staff upon the face of the child .
translation.kha: U Elisha u phai sha u Gehasi bad u ong ,  Pynkloi ! Shim ïa u diengduh jong nga bad khie leit . Wat sangeh ban khublei ïano ïano ba me ïakynduh , bad lada uno uno u khublei ïa me , wat shim por ban jubab . Leit beit sha ka ïing bad buh ïa u diengduh jong nga halor jong u khynnah .

translation.en: Neither was the man created for the woman ; but the woman for the man .
translation.kha: Lymne ym shym la thaw ïa u briew na ka bynta ka briew , hynrei ïa ka briew na ka bynta u briew .

translation.en: Great men are not always wise : neither do the aged understand judgment .
translation.kha: Kam dei ka rta kaba pynstad ïa ngi lane kaba ïarap ïa ngi ban tip kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: Now my days are swifter than a post : they flee away , they see no good .
translation.kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki mareh stet , ym don kawei na ki kaba bha .

translation.en: And it was told Abimelech , that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Abimelekh ba ki la ïalum hangta ,

translation.en: Hilkiah the second , Tebaliah the third , Zechariah the fourth : all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen .
translation.kha: U Hilkaïah , u Tebalaïah , bad u Sekharaïah . Ha baroh ki ïadon khatlai ngut ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Hosah kiba dei ki nongap phira ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And he saith unto me , Write , Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb . And he saith unto me , These are the true sayings of God .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga ,  To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito ïa kiba la khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim jong U Khunlangbrot .  Bad u angel u la bynrap ,  Kine ki long ki ktien kiba shisha jong U Blei .

translation.en: Return , ye backsliding children , and I will heal your backslidings . Behold , we come unto thee  ; for thou art the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: To wan phai , phi baroh kiba la phai lyndet na U  Trai  ; un pynkhiah ïa phi bad un pynlong ïa phi kiba ïaineh . Phi ong ,  Ho-oid , ngi wan sha U  Trai  , namar u dei U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And when he was come into his house , he took a knife , and laid hold on his concubine , and divided her , together with her bones , into twelve pieces , and sent her into all the coasts of Israel .
translation.kha: Ynda u la poi , u rung shapoh ïing bad u shim kawei ka tari . U shim ïa ka met ka tnga kliar jong u , u ot ïa ka khat-ar lyngkhot , bad u phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei na ki khat-ar jait ki Israel .

translation.en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : and as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,
translation.kha: Ale wan shane , phi ki briew kiba duna ka jingsngewthuh !  Ha u briew uba bieit ka ong ,

translation.en: And as he was yet a coming , the devil threw him down , and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit , and healed the child , and delivered him again to his father .
translation.kha: Katba uta u khynnah u dang wan , u mynsiem bymman u la shoh pynkyllon ïa u sha madan bad u la bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring . U Jisu u la ai hukum ïa u mynsiem bymman , U la pynkhiah ïa uta u khynnah , bad U la ai pat ïa u ha u kpa jong u .

translation.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings , and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka shadem jong u mrad ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang , bad ka kjat-dien kamon ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang kaba U  Trai  u la shim na ki paid Israel bad ban ai ha ki lyngdoh . Kane ka long kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ha ki lyngdoh pateng la pateng .

translation.en: Let thine eyes look right on , and let thine eyelids look straight before thee .
translation.kha: Peit beit sha khmat da ka jingsngewskhem kaba hok ; wat pyndem ïa la ka khlieh ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: Is Christ divided ? was Paul crucified for you ? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul ?
translation.kha: Te ïa U Khrist la phiah ha ki kynhun ! Hato dei u Paul uba la ïap halor ka diengphna namar jong phi ? Hato la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong u Paul ?

translation.en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel , saying , Now when this letter is come unto thee , behold , I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee , that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy .
translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u rah ka ong :  Kane ka shithi kan pynithuh ïa u Naaman , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong nga . Nga kwah ïa phi ban pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: Then David said , This is the house of the  Lord  God , and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ka Templ jong U  Trai  U Blei kan don . Hangne ka don ka duwan ha kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ki jingainguh thang .

translation.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof  ; the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards ,
translation.kha: Ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh dei ban weng bad ainguh halor kata ka duwan : ka dongnai , ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki doh jem ,

translation.en: And when they were come to Capernaum , they that received tribute money came to Peter , and said , Doth not your master pay tribute ?
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la wan sha Kapernam , ki nonglum ïa ka khajna Templ ki la wan ha u Petros bad ki la kylli ,  Hato u Nonghikai jong phi u siew ïa ka khajna Templ ?

translation.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place , where there is no straitness  ; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wallam noh ïa phi na ka jingjynjar bad u shah ïa phi ban kmen ha ka jingshngain ; ka miej jong phi ka shlei da ka jingbam .

translation.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days , saith the Lord , I will put my laws into their hearts , and in their minds will I write them  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki , ha ki sngi ki ban sa wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong nga hapoh ki dohnud jong ki bad thoh ïa ki ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki .

translation.en: O my threshing , and the corn of my floor : that which I have heard of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , have I declared unto you .
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel jong nga , phi la shah shoh kumba shoh kew , hynrei mynta nga la pynbna ha phi ïa ka khubor babha ba nga la ïohsngew na U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And his brethren envied him  ; but his father observed the saying .
translation.kha: Ki hynmen u Joseph te ki la bishni ïa u , hynrei u kpa jong u , u ïai puson shaphang kata baroh .

translation.en: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire : and them that had gotten the victory over the beast , and over his image , and over his mark , and over the number of his name , stand on the sea of glass , having the harps of God .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw kaba la khleh lang bad ka ding . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa kito kiba la jop ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad ïa uta uba ka kyrteng jong u la mihkhmat da u dak jingkheiñ . Ki la ïeng hajan ka ïit bakhraw , ki da bat ïa ki duitara kiba U Blei u la ai ha ki

translation.en: It took me by surprise .
translation.kha: Ka pynkyndit ia nga .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Have ye never read what David did , when he had need , and was an hungred , he , and they that were with him ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phim ju pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh ha kata ka por mynba u la donkam ei ei ban bam ? Ma u bad ki rangbah kiba bad u ki la ïa-thngan ,

translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  was unto them precept upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little  ; that they might go , and fall backward , and be broken , and snared , and taken .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw ba U  Trai  un sa hikai ïa phi kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai . Te phin jynthut ha kawei pa kawei ka jingjam ba phi shim . Phin sa mynsaw , shah riam bad phin long koidi .

translation.en: And that which thou sowest , thou sowest not that body that shall be , but bare grain , it may chance of wheat , or of some other grain :
translation.kha: Bad ïa uei uba me bet , u long tang u symbai , lehse u long u symbai kew ne uwei pat u symbai , ym u jingthung ba la san pura u ban san hadien .

translation.en: They stand fast for ever and ever , and are done in truth and uprightness .
translation.kha: Ki neh slem ha ki por baroh ; la ai ïa ki ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka hok .

translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate : and verily I say unto you , Ye shall not see me , until the time come when ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh . Nga pynthikna ïa pha ba phan ym ïohi ïa nga tad ynda ka por ka poi haba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .’

translation.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp , bearing his reproach .
translation.kha: Te , to ngin leit sha u shabar ka jaka shong dara ban ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingshah lehrain jong u .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said , Alas ! that the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab !
translation.kha: Ngi la jan ïap !  u syiem Joram u la kyang jam .  U  Trai  u la buh ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong u syiem Moab !

translation.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem : and they sent forth Barnabas , that he should go as far as Antioch .
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang kane ka la poi ha ka Balang ha Jerusalem , kumta ki la phah ïa u Barnabas sha Antiokh .

translation.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full , and hast built goodly houses , and dwelt therein  ;
translation.kha: Wat ynda phi la ïoh ban bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah bad tei la ki ïing kiba itynnat ban shong ,

translation.en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe , according to the working of his mighty power ,
translation.kha: bad katno ka jingkhraw eh long kata ka bor kaba trei ha ngi kiba ngeit .

translation.en: In my opinion , the meeting was a success .
translation.kha: Ha jingpyrkhat jongnga , ka meeting ka long kaba seisoh .

translation.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord  , and went down to Joppa  ; and he found a ship going to Tarshish : so he paid the fare thereof , and went down into it , to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jonah pynban , u la leit sha ka jaka kaba marpyrshah khnang ban phet noh na U  Trai . U la leit sha Joppa , ha kaba u la shem ïa ka liengbah ka ban sa leit sha Spain . U la siew ïa ka bai lynti bad u la rung shapoh ryngkat bad ki nongtrei liengbah kiba leit sha Spain , ha kaba un long jngai na U  Trai .

translation.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so did they .
translation.kha: Kumta keiñ la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei baroh ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki Israel ki la thaw ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: Bless ,  Lord  , his substance , and accept the work of his hands : smite through the loins of them that rise against him , and of them that hate him , that they rise not again .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , to ïarap ïa ka jait jong ki ba kan nang khlaiñ ; To pdiang sngewbha kat ïa kaba ki pyndep , To pynlwet ïa ki nongshun jong ki , Ba kin ym khie khlieh shuh lano lano .

translation.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report : put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynphriang ïa ki khubor lamler , bad wat ïarap ïa u nongleh bymman da kaba sakhi lamler .

translation.en: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod , of Ammon , and of Moab :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga shem ruh ba bun na ki rangbah Jiw ki la shongkurim ïa ki kynthei na Ashdod , Ammon , bad Moab .
