translation.en: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance , and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly , and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which should not be done , and are guilty  ;
translation.kha: Lada dei u paid Israel baroh uba leh pop khlem tip bad u hap ha ka jingpynrem ba u la pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: These are terms given to God’s chief enemy .
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki kyrteng ba la ai ïa u nongshun bakhraw tam jong U Blei .

translation.en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon s work , five hundred and fifty , which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work .
translation.kha: Don sanspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba peit ïa ki briew kiba tei ïa ki jingtei u Solomon .

translation.en: And said ,  Verily I say unto you , Except ye be converted , and become as little children , ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lymda phi kylla bad long kum ki khynnah , phin ym ïohrung da lei lei shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .

translation.en: And as they came out , they found a man of Cyrene , Simon by name : him they compelled to bear his cross .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïamih shabar , ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew na Kyrini uba kyrteng u Simon , bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u ban bah ïa ka diengphna jong U Jisu .

translation.en: But in the place which the  Lord  shall choose in one of thy tribes , there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , and there thou shalt do all that I command thee .
translation.kha: hynrei leit rah ïa ki tang ha kawei ka jaka ha kaba U  Trai  un jied na ka ri jong kawei na ki jait jong phi , bad hangta phin leh ïa kita baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: For the Pharisees , and all the Jews , except they wash their hands oft , eat not , holding the tradition of the elders .
translation.kha: ( Na ka bynta ki Pharisi , kumjuh ruh na ka bynta ki Jiw baroh , ki bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba ki la ïoh na ki kpa tymmen jong ki : Kim ju bam lymda ki sait ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaba dei ;

translation.en: But I say unto you , That every idle word that men shall speak , they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar uwei pa uwei un hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka bymmyntoi kaba u la kren .

translation.en: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men ,
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la pynpaw ïa ka jingaiei jong U na ka bynta ka jingpynim jong ki briew baroh .

translation.en: Binding his foal unto the vine , and his ass s colt unto the choice vine  ; he washed his garments in wine , and his clothes in the blood of grapes :
translation.kha: U teh ïa u khun kada ha u dieng sohwaiñ Ha u dieng sohwaiñ uba bha tam ; U sait ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka um sohwaiñ , kaba saw snam .

translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ngi ,

translation.en: Then we turned , and went up the way to Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan came out against us , he and all his people , to battle at Edrei .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ngi la ïaleit shaphang shatei sha ka thain Bashan , bad u Og u Syiem jong ka u la wan ryngkat bad la ki rangïapom ban ïaleh ïa ngi hajan ka shnong Edrei .

translation.en: He shall build an house for my name  ; and he shall be my son , and I will be his father  ; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever .
translation.kha: Un tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong nga . Un long u khun jong nga bad ngan long u kpa jong u . Ka longïing syiem jong u kan synshar ïa ka Israel junom .’

translation.en: A new commandment I give unto you , That ye love one another  ; as I have loved you , that ye also love one another .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ai ha phi ka hukum kaba thymmai ; to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei .

translation.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house , as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after  ;
translation.kha: U Moses u long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka ïing U Blei kum u shakri , bad u kren ïa kiei kiei kiba U Blei un sa kren ha ki por ki ban sa wan .

translation.en: I will not conceal his parts , nor his power , nor his comely proportion .
translation.kha: Shah ngan ïathuh ïa me shaphang ki khohwah jong u Lebiathan bad batai haduh katno u long uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .

translation.en: When ye were but few , even a few , and strangers in it .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And spared not the old world , but saved Noah the eighth person , a preacher of righteousness , bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly  ;
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la shah jem ïa ka pyrthei mynbarim , hynrei u la wanrah ïa ka jingshlei um ha ka pyrthei jong ki briew bymtip Blei ; kita kiba u pyllait im ki long u Noah , uba la ïalap ïa ka hok , bad hynñiew ngut kiwei pat .

translation.en: ( The  Lord  God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are , and bless you , as he hath promised you ! )
translation.kha: Ai ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi un nang pynroi shuh shuh ïa phi bun hajar shah bad un pynmanbha ïa phi , kumba u la kular !

translation.en: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect , by reason of the glory that excelleth .
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban ong ba namar jong kata ka burom kaba kham khraw mynta , kata ka burom kaba la tyngshaiñ bha ha ka por ba la leit , ka la jah noh .

translation.en: I have written to him the great things of my law , but they were counted as a strange thing .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh ki jinghikai bym lah ñiew shuh na ka bynta ki briew , hynrei ki kyntait ïa ki kum kaei kaei kaba khyllah bad long nongwei .

translation.en: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him : and the chief captain also was afraid , after he knew that he was a Roman , and because he had bound him .
translation.kha: Mar kumta ki rangbah kiba la leit ban tohkit ïa u Paul ki la kynriah noh na u , bad uta u rangbah ai hukum u la sheptieng haba u la sngewthuh ba u Paul u la long u traishnong ka Hima Rom bad ba u la lah phah khum kynjri ïa u .

translation.en: And when they had eaten them up , it could not be known that they had eaten them  ; but they were still ill favoured , as at the beginning . So I awoke .
translation.kha: hynrei ym don mano mano batip shaphang kata , namar ki i kumjuh kumba ki long mynshuwa . Nangta nga la kyndit thiah .

translation.en: When they therefore were come together , they asked of him , saying , Lord , wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel ?
translation.kha: Haba ki apostol ki la ïalumlang bad U Jisu , ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Kynrad , hato ha kane ka por men ai pat ïa ka Hima ha ki Israel ?

translation.en: And then shall he send his angels , and shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven .
translation.kha: Un phah noh ïa ki angel sha sawdong ka pyrthei ban ïalumlang ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , na kawei ka dong jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .

translation.en: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place , and put on his garments , and come forth , and offer his burnt offering , and the burnt offering of the people , and make an atonement for himself , and for the people .
translation.kha: U dei ban sum ha ka jaka kaba khuid bad phong da la ki jong ki jaiñ . Hadien kata , un mih shabar bad un kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang ban weng noh ïa ki pop jong u bad ïa ki pop jong u paidbah de .

translation.en: And the people shall be oppressed , every one by another , and every one by his neighbour : the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient , and the base against the honourable .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un shim kabu ïa uwei pat . Ki samla kin ym burom ïa ki rangbah , bad ki riewpoh kin ym burom ïa kiba halor jong ki .

translation.en: That in those days , when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Shushan the palace ,
translation.kha: Na ka khet syiem ha ka nongbah Susa jong ka Persia , u syiem Serksis u synshar halor ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki jylla , naduh India haduh Sudan .

translation.en: They shall run like mighty men  ; they shall climb the wall like men of war  ; and they shall march every one on his ways , and they shall not break their ranks :
translation.kha: Ki tur ïaleh kum ki khla-ka-wait ; ki kiew ïa ki kynroh kum ki shipai . Ki baroh ki ïatur beit sha khmat bad kim phai sha kadiang ne kamon

translation.en: And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel was there , according to the vision that I saw in the plain .
translation.kha: Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ kaba pyn-i ïa ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka haba nga don harud ka wah Khebar .

translation.en: And it came to pass after many days , that the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , go to Euphrates , and take the girdle from thence , which I commanded thee to hide there .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit pat sha ka Ïuphratis bad shim ïa ki patlun lyngkot .

translation.en: And I , brethren , could not speak unto you as unto spiritual , but as unto carnal , even as unto babes in Christ .
translation.kha: Kumba ka dei ban long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngam shym lah ban kren ha phi kumba nga kren ha ki briew kiba don U Mynsiem ; nga hap ban kren ha phi la kumba phi dei ki jong kane ka pyrthei , kum kiba dang khynnah ha ka jingngeit Khristan .

translation.en: Where are the gods of Hamath , and of Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Shano ki don mynta , ki blei jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ? Shano ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim , ka Hena , bad ka Ibbah ? Hato don na ki kiba la pyllait im ïa ka Samaria ?

translation.en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation , lest they bear sin , and die .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki Israel kim dei shuh ban wan sha jan ka Ïingjaiñ ïoh ki wallam ha lade ïa ka jingshah pynshitom da ka jingïap .

translation.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee , O Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his servants .
translation.kha: Hangta u la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ban pynshitom ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .

translation.en: Then Jonah prayed unto the  Lord  his God out of the fish s belly ,
translation.kha: Na ka jingjylliew hapoh u dohkha u Jonah u la duwai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong u :

translation.en: And he said unto them the third time , Why , what evil hath he done ? I have found no cause of death in him : I will therefore chastise him , and let him go .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha ki ha ka sien kaba lai ,  Hynrei kaei ka kam runar kaba u la leh ? Ngam lah ban shem ïa kano kano kaba u la leh kaba u dei ban ïap ! Ngan phah sympat ïa u bad pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: He is wise in heart , and mighty in strength : who hath hardened himself against him , and hath prospered ?
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor katta katta ; ym don u briew uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .
translation.kha: Ki bania bad ki nongkhaïi , ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba kut eh , na ka kamra ha ka dong haduh ka Khyrdop Langbrot .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall scatter thee among all people , from the one end of the earth even unto the other  ; and there thou shalt serve other gods , which neither thou nor thy fathers have known , even wood and stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei , bad hangta phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei kiba da ka dieng bad da u maw , ki blei kiba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju mane mynshuwa .

translation.en: Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard  ; publish , and conceal not : say , Babylon is taken , Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces  ; her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ka khubor sha ki jaitbynriew ! Pynbna ïa ka ! Ai ka dak bad pynbna ïa ka khubor ! Wat buhrieh ïa ka ! Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! U Marduk u blei jong ka u la khynñiuh ! Ïa ki bleithaw jong Babilon la buh ha ka jinglehrain , ïa ki dur ba-ijli jong ka la pynlwet !

translation.en: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven , and saying , Hew the tree down , and destroy it  ; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth , even with a band of iron and brass , in the tender grass of the field  ; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven , and let his portion be with the beasts of the field , till seven times pass over him  ;
translation.kha: Katba u Syiem Kynrad u dang peit , u angel u la wan hiar na bneng bad u la ong , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad pynjot ïa u , hynrei iehnoh ïa ka dyngkhong ha ka khyndew . Teh da u syrwiang nar bad rnong sawdong jong ka , bad iehnoh hangta ha ka pyntha lem bad u phlang . Ai ba ka umjer kan hap halor jong une u briew , bad shah ïa u ban im hangta bad ki mrad na ka bynta hynñiew snem .’

translation.en: And when he looked on Amalek , he took up his parable , and said , Amalek was the first of the nations  ; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u Balaam u la ïohi ïa ki Amalek , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  U Amalek u long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñbor tam na baroh , Hynrei ha kaba kut un jah noh jar .

translation.en: His children shall seek to please the poor , and his hands shall restore their goods .
translation.kha: bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin ai noh pat ïa kaei kaba u la tuh na kiba duk .

translation.en: So the people rested on the seventh day .
translation.kha: Kumta u paidbah um shym leh kano kano ka kam ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew .

translation.en: For Moses said , Honour thy father and thy mother  ; and , Whoso curseth father or mother , let him die the death :
translation.kha: Naba u Moses u la hukum , ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad , ‘ uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie yn pynïap .’

translation.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him , and every man shall draw after him , as there are innumerable before him .
translation.kha: bun hajar ki ïasoh lang ha ka jingleit ontep , bad wat ka khyndew ka tap suki jai halor ka met jong u .

translation.en: Woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues , and greetings in the markets .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ieit ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog bad ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew .

translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When his branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is nigh :
translation.kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un hikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnat jong u ki jyrngam bad khie lung bad u sdang ban sei sla , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .

translation.en: Speak , ye that ride on white asses , ye that sit in judgment , and walk by the way .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa kata , phi kiba shong halor ki kada balieh , Kiba shong ha ki jin , Bad phi kiba hap ïaid kjat kat shaba phi leit .

translation.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen : but they were men of war , and his servants , and his princes , and his captains , and rulers of his chariots , and his horsemen .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki Israel u Solomon um shym la pynlong mraw ; ki la shakri ïa u kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki rangbah ai hukum , ki kapten kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai jong u .

translation.en: Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el , and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , both that altar and the high place he brake down , and burned the high place , and stamped it small to powder , and burned the grove .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka jaka mane ha Bethel kaba la tei da u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop . U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka duwan , u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki maw jong ka , bad u pynlwet phum ïa ki ; u la thang ruh ïa ka dur jong ka Asherah .

translation.en: For many are called , but few are chosen .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Shibun la khot sngewbha , hynrei khyndiat la jied .

translation.en: By faith Joseph , when he died , made mention of the departing of the children of Israel  ; and gave commandment concerning his bones .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa U Joseph , ha shuwa ba un ïap , ban kren shaphang ka jingmihnoh ki khun Israel na Ijipt , bad ai ka jingbthah shaphang kaei ba ki dei ban leh ïa ka met jong u .

translation.en: And he gathered an host , and smote the Amalekites , and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them .
translation.kha: U ïaleh da kaba shlur bad u jop wat ïa ki paid Amalek . U la pyllait im ïa ki Israel na baroh ki jingtur ïaleh .

translation.en: Now , behold , thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed , even upon Egypt , on which if a man lean , it will go into his hand , and pierce it : so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him .
translation.kha: Phi khmih lynti ba ka Ijipt kan ïarap ïa phi , hynrei kata kan long kumba pyndonkam ïa u khah kum u diengduh — un kdiah bad un dung ïa ka kti jong phi . Kata ka dei kaei kaba u syiem ka Ijipt u long haba mano mano ki shaniah tylli ha u .

translation.en: And all Israel , and their elders , and officers , and their judges , stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , as well the stranger , as he that was born among them  ; half of them over against mount Gerizim , and half of them over against mount Ebal  ; as Moses the servant of the  Lord  had commanded before , that they should bless the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki Israel lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki nongbishar ryngkat lem bad ki nongwei kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki la ïeng ha baroh arliang jong ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , da kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba bah ïa ka . Shiteng na u paidbah ki ïeng ha kaba ka lyngkdong jong ki ka phai sha u Lum Gerisim bad shiteng kiwei pat , ki lyngkdong jong ki , ki phai sha u Lum Ebal . U Moses u shakri U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ynda poi ka por ïa ki ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu .

translation.en: One of the two which heard John speak , and followed him , was Andrew , Simon Peter s brother .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la long u Andriw , uba shi para bad u Simon Petros .

translation.en: And Peleg lived thirty years , and begat Reu :
translation.kha: Haba u Peleg u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Reu ;

translation.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief . And he went round about the villages , teaching .
translation.kha: U la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei , namar ki briew kim shym don jingngeit . Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha ki nongrit kiba don sawdong ha kata ka thain , u da hikai ïa ki briew .

translation.en: Neither shall one thrust another  ; they shall walk every one in his path : and when they fall upon the sword , they shall not be wounded .
translation.kha: lane ïatyngkhuh para ma ki . Ki ïa-ïaid kynhun lyngba ïa ki jingker-ïada , bad ym don kano kano kaba lah ban pynsangeh ïa ki .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high , and the kings of the earth upon the earth .
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi haba U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki bor ba-halor bad ïa ki nongsynshar ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age  ; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women .
translation.kha: U Abraham bad ka Sarah ki la tymmen bha , bad ka Sarah ruh ka la palat ïa ka por ban dang ïoh khun .

translation.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates .
translation.kha: Nga ngeit ba phin ïoh tip ba ngim long kiba la shahjop .

translation.en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand , with part of the vessels of the house of God : which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god  ; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god .
translation.kha: U Trai u la shah ïa u ban kem ïa u Syiem Jehoïakim bad kurup katto katne ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . U la shim pat katto katne ngut ki koidi lem bad u sha ka templ jong ki blei jong u ha Babilon , bad u la buh ïa ka jingkynshew ba la ïoh kurup ha ki jaka kynshew ka templ .

translation.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord , and that he had spoken these things unto her .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit bad ïathuh ïa ki synran ba ka la ïohi ïa U Trai bad pynshai ha ki ïa kaei kaba u la ïathuh ïa ka .

translation.en: And whithersoever he entered , into villages , or cities , or country , they laid the sick in the streets , and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment : and as many as touched him were made whole .
translation.kha: Bad shano shano ba U Jisu u leit , sha ki nongrit , ki shnong , ki lyngkha , ki paidbah ki rah ïa kito kiba pang sha ki jaka ïew bad kyrpad ïa u ban shah ïa ki la kumno kumno ban ktah ïa ka rmiang jaiñkup jong u ; bad baroh kiba ktah ïa ka , ki ïohkhiah .

translation.en: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh : for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity ; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness .
translation.kha: (Nga pyndonkam ka ktien kaba ïakren man ka sngi namar ka jingtlot jong ka jingim tynrai jong phi .) Mynshuwa phi la pyndem ïa lade nadong shadong kum ki mraw ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymman na ka bynta ki jingthmu bymman . Ha kajuh ka rukom mynta phi dei ban pyndem ïa lade nadong shadong kum ki mraw jong ka hok na ka bynta ki jingthmu bakhuid .

translation.en: And if any man hear my words , and believe not , I judge him not : for I came not to judge the world , but to save the world .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong nga bad um kohnguh ïa ka , ngan ym bishar ïa u . Nga la wan , ym ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hynrei ban pynim ïa ka .

translation.en: And no man in heaven , nor in earth , neither under the earth , was able to open the book , neither to look thereon .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym shym la don ha bneng lane ha khyndew lane ha ka pyrthei kaba shapoh , uba lah ban plied ïa ka kot kli bad ban khmih shapoh jong ka .

translation.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee , O  Lord   ; thou art great , and thy name is great in might .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ym don uno uno uba kum ma me ; me long uba khrawbor , bad ka kyrteng jong me ka long kaba khraw bad kaba donbor .

translation.en: And we know that the Son of God is come , and hath given us an understanding , that we may know him that is true , and we are in him that is true , even in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God , and eternal life .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Khun U Blei u la wan bad u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngin ithuh ïa U Blei uba shisha . Ngi im ha U Blei uba shisha — ha U Jisu Khrist U Khun jong u . Une u long U Blei uba shisha , bad kane ka long ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away ? and what do thy eyes wink at ,
translation.kha: Hynrei me leh shitrhem bad peit shin ïa ngi da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: And he arose out of the synagogue , and entered into Simon s house . And Simon s wife s mother was taken with a great fever  ; and they besought him for her .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mih na ka synagog bad u la leit sha ïing jong u Simon . Ka kiaw kurim jong u Simon ka la pang bad ka jingpang shit kaba jur , bad ki la ïathuh ha U Jisu shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering : and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar .
translation.kha: Ïa u mrad na ka bynta kane ka jingkñia dei ban pynïap ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka duwan , ha kaba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad ba la wallam kum ki jingainguh thang , bad ïa ka snam jong u dei ban synreit ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .

translation.en: They take the timbrel and harp , and rejoice at the sound of the organ .
translation.kha: bad ki shad katba nang tem ïa ki duitara bad put ïa ki tangmuri .

translation.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things .
translation.kha: Katno nga kmen ba nga lah ban shaniah ha phi nadong shadong !

translation.en: And the third row a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .
translation.kha: u Turkwois , u Agate , bad u Amethyst ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;

translation.en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high  ; the lofty city , he layeth it low  ; he layeth it low , even to the ground  ; he bringeth it even to the dust .
translation.kha: U la pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong ; u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah baskhem ha kaba ki shong , bad u pynlong ba ki kynroh jong ka kin pra bad hap sha tbian .

translation.en: And when he cometh , he findeth it swept and garnished .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit phai pat bad u shem ïa ka ïing kaba khuid bad kaba la pynbeit ryntih .

translation.en: Are they ministers of Christ ? (I speak as a fool) I am more ; in labours more abundant , in stripes above measure , in prisons more frequent , in deaths oft .
translation.kha: Hato ki long ki shakri U Khrist ?(Nga kren kum uba lamwir) — hynrei nga long u shakri uba kham palat ban ïa ki ! Nga la trei kham shitom palat , nga la don bunsien ha byndi , nga la shah sympat kham bun , bad nga la jan sha ka jingïap kham bunsien .

translation.en: Now therefore why tempt ye God , to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples , which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?
translation.kha: Kumta te , balei mynta phi kwah ban tynjuh ïa U Blei da kaba buh ka jingkit halor ki met jong ki parabangeit ïa kaba ym don ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lymne ma ngi hi kiba lah ban kit ?

translation.en: But wilt thou know , O vain man , that faith without works is dead ?
translation.kha: Phi kiba bieit ! Hato phi kwah ban da pyn-i ba ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long ka bymmyntoi ?

translation.en: Saying to a stock , Thou art my father  ; and to a stone , Thou hast brought me forth : for they have turned their back unto me , and not their face : but in the time of their trouble they will say , Arise , and save us .
translation.kha: Ïa phi baroh yn pynjahburom — ma phi kiba ong ba u dieng u dei u kpa jong phi bad ba u mawsiang u dei ka kmie jong phi . Kane kan jia namar ba phi la phai noh na nga ha ka jaka ba phin phai sha nga . Hynrei haba phi don ha ka jingjynjar , phi kyrpad ïa nga ban wan bad pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken , he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue ,  Be not afraid , only believe .
translation.kha: U Jisu um shym la patiaw ïa kaei kaba ki la ong , hynrei u la ong ha u Jairos ,  Wat sheptieng , shu ngeit .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them : for the  Lord  thy God is among you , a mighty God and terrible .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa kita ki briew . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi ; u long U Blei uba donbor bad uba itieng .

translation.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul , and grace to thy neck .
translation.kha: Kin ai ha phi ïa ka jingim — ka jingim kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba kmen .

translation.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the skin , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a plague of leprosy , and shall be shewed unto the priest :
translation.kha: lada ka dei kaba lam jyrngam lane kaba lam saw , ka dei ka jingbthuh kaba pur bad dei ban leit pyn-i ïa ka ha u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Shall horses run upon the rock ? will one plow there with oxen ? for ye have turned judgment into gall , and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock :
translation.kha: Hato ki kulai ki ju mareh halor ki mawsiang ? Hato ki briew ki ju lur ïa ka duriaw da ki masi dab ? Pynban phi la pynkylla ïa ka jingbishar hok sha ka bih , bad ïa kaba dei sha ka bymdei .

translation.en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki la poi ha ka Them Rephaim bad ki ïohknieh ïa ka .

translation.en: For they vex you with their wiles , wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor , and in the matter of Cozbi , the daughter of a prince of Midian , their sister , which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor s sake .
translation.kha: namar ka kam bymman ba ki la leh ïa phi haba ki la shukor ïa phi ha Peor , bad namar ka Kosbi kaba la shah pynïap ha ka por jong ka jingïapthem ha Peor .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah , and his ways , and his sayings , are written in the story of the prophet Iddo .
translation.kha: Kaba sah jong ka histori u Abijah , kaei kaba u ong bad kaei kaba u leh , la thoh ha  Ka Histori jong u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised : it may be that the  Lord  will work for us : for there is no restraint to the  Lord  to save by many or by few .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u samla ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha shiliang sha ka jaka sher dara jong kito ki Philistia ba mane blei thala . Lehse U  Trai  un ïarap ïa ngi ; lada u ïarap , ym don ei ei kaba lah ban khang ïa u ban ai ha ngi ka jingjop , kam pher la ngi don tang khyndiat ruh .

translation.en: And the Jebusite , and the Amorite , and the Girgashite ,
translation.kha: U Kanaan u long ruh u kpa tymmen jong ki Jebus , ki Amor , ki Girgash ,

translation.en: And whatsoever house ye enter into , there abide , and thence depart .
translation.kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to sah ha kajuh ka ïing tad haduh ba phin da mihnoh na kata ka shnong ;

translation.en: Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , when I plead with thee : yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments : Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper ? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  , lada nga ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga bad me , men pynshisha ba me long ha kaba dei . Pynban nga dei ban kylli ïa me shaphang ki bynta ka jingbishar hok . Balei ba ki rangbah basniew ki manbha katta katta ? Balei ba ki rangbah bymhok ki jop ?

translation.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .
translation.kha: Ka spah kan ym lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha ha ka sngi ba phi ïashem ïa ka jingïap , hynrei ka jinglehhok kan pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: Who being the brightness of his glory , and the express image of his person , and upholding all things by the word of his power , when he had by himself purged our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high  ;
translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ ka burom U Blei bad u ïasyriem thik bad ka dur U Blei hi , uba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien badonbor jong u . Hadien ba u la ïohpdiang ka jingmap ïa ki pop u khunbynriew , u la shong ha bneng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Bakhrawbor Tam .

translation.en: And these went into Micah s house , and fetched the carved image , the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image . Then said the priest unto them , What do ye ?
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah ki leit rung shapoh ïing u Mikah bad shim ïa ki tiar bakyntang , u lyngdoh u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïaleh aïu ?

translation.en: But ye believe not , because ye are not of my sheep , as I said unto you .
translation.kha: hynrei phin ym ngeit , naba phim dei ki langbrot jong nga .

translation.en: This title then read many of the Jews : for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city : and it was written in Hebrew , and Greek , and Latin .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew ki la pule ïa ka , namar ka jaka ha kaba la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu kam da jngai na ka nongbah . Ka jingthoh ka la long ha ki ktien Hebru , Latin bad Grik .

translation.en: And they had then a notable prisoner , called Barabbas .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don uwei u koidi uba pawnam uba kyrteng u Jisu Barabbas .

translation.en: The thought of foolishness is sin : and the scorner is an abomination to men .
translation.kha: Kano kano ka jingthmu ba u bieit u pyrkhat ka long pop . Ki briew ki isih ïa u briew u bym don ei ei hynrei uba rkhiebeiñ ïa kiwei .

translation.en: And did eat and drink before the  Lord  on that day with great gladness . And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him unto the  Lord  to be the chief governor , and Zadok to be priest .
translation.kha: Kumta ha kata ka sngi ki la kmen shikatdei katba ki ïabam ïadih ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai . Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la thung syiem ïa u Solomon . Ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u nongsynshar jong ki bad ïa u Sadok kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: And as Obadiah was in the way , behold , Elijah met him : and he knew him , and fell on his face , and said , Art thou that my lord Elijah ?
translation.kha: Katba u Obadaïah u dang ïaid ha la ka lynti , kynsan u ïakynduh ïa u Elijah . U ithuh ïa u , u dem ngon ha khmat jong u bad u kylli ,  Dei shisha ma phi , ko kynrad ?

translation.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God .
translation.kha: Ki ieit ïa ka jingpynksan u briew ban ïa ka jingpynksan na U Blei .

translation.en: And he turned to the woman , and said unto Simon ,  Seest thou this woman ? I entered into thine house , thou gavest me no water for my feet : but she hath washed my feet with tears , and wiped them with the hairs of her head .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phai sha kata ka briew bad u la ong ha u Simon ,  Me ïohi ïa kane ka briew ? Nga la wan shapoh ka ïing jong me , bad mem shym la ai um ïa nga na ka bynta ki kjat jong nga , hynrei ka la sait ïa ki kjat jong nga da ki ummat jong ka bad ka la ñiad rkhiang ïa ki da u shñiuh jong ka .

translation.en: This is very good .
translation.kha: Ka bha bha kane .

translation.en: Egypt was glad when they departed : for the fear of them fell upon them .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la sheptieng ïa ki bad ki la kmen haba ki la mih .

translation.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom ? or who can stay the bottles of heaven ,
translation.kha: Uei uba stad haduh katta ban ñiew ïa ki lyoh bad pynkylla khongpong ïa ki ban theh ïa u slap ,

translation.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you  ; but now , behold , it is dry , and it is mouldy :
translation.kha: Khmih ïa u kpu jong ngi . Mynba ngi mihnoh na ïing bad u bad wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi , u dang syiad . Hynrei ha khmih ! Mynta u la tyrkhong bad la bthuh .

translation.en: I thank my God , making mention of thee always in my prayers ,
translation.kha: Ko Philemon u para jong nga , man ka por ba nga duwai , nga kynmaw ïa me bad ainguh ïa U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: 14 Why Does God Have an Organization ?
translation.kha: 14 Balei U Blei u Don la ka Jong ka seng ?

translation.en: He shall dwell with thee , even among you , in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates , where it liketh him best : thou shalt not oppress him .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban shong bad phi ha kano kano ka shnong ba ki mon , bad phim dei ban lehbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass that night , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Nathan , saying ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u ong ha u Nathan ,

translation.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki paidbah ban shong ha madan .

translation.en: And lead us not into temptation , but deliver us from evil : For thine is the kingdom , and the power , and the glory , for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh , hynrei sumar ïada ïa ngi na Uba Sniew . Naba ka jong me long ka hima , bad ka bor , bad ka burom junom . Amen .’

translation.en: And Saul took him that day , and would let him go no more home to his father s house .
translation.kha: U Saul u bat ïa u Dabid ban ïaisah bad u naduh kata ka sngi bad um shym shah ïa u ban leit phai sha la ïing .

translation.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food .
translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka bor uba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk u long kum u  lapbah  lapsan uba pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingthung .

translation.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong , he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed , and smote the Egyptian :
translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa uwei na ki ba u la shah lehbeiñ ha u nong Ijipt , kumta u la leit ban ïarap ïa u bad u la pynhiarkput ïa u nong Ijipt da kaba pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And James the son of Zebedee , and John the brother of James  ; and he surnamed them Boanerges , which is , The sons of thunder :
translation.kha: u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa ki , Boanerjes , kaba mut  ki Khun u Pyrthat  ) ;

translation.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah , and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jingïada jong ka Judah ki la khyllem . Haba kata ka la jia , phi la wallam ïa ki tiar ïaleh na ka jaka buh .

translation.en: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers , and said , Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Ahab u khot shapoh ïa u rangbah ka ïingsyiem bad ong ïa u ban leit bad wallam shisyndon ïa u Mikaïah .

translation.en: I am thine , save me  ; for I have sought thy precepts .
translation.kha: Nga long u jong me — A pynim ïa nga ! nga la pyrshang ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves , he cut it with the penknife , and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth , until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth .
translation.kha: Mar shu dep pule da u Jehudi ïa ki lai ne saw bynta , u syiem u la ot ïa ki da ka tari barit bad bret ïa ki ha ka ding . U ïai leh ïa kane haduh ba la thang lut ïa ka kot kli baroh kawei .

translation.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Da kaba kynting sbai , ki paid Israel ki ai ïa kine ki nongbah bad ki pyntha phlang ha ki Lebi , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself : but the simple pass on , and are punished .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki ïohi ïa ka jingma ba ka wan bad ki kynriah na ka , hynrei u briew u bym pyrkhat un ïaid beit ha ka bad un babe kylla hadien .

translation.en: And it was told David  ; and he gathered all Israel , and passed over Jordan , and came upon them , and set the battle in array against them . So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki shipai Israel , u jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad u buh ïa ki ha ka jaka ba phai khmat ïa ki Syria .

translation.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found , both let him die , and we also will be my lord s bondmen .
translation.kha: Bah , lada yn shem ïa ka ha uno uno na ngi , uta u dei ban ïap , bad kiba sah na ngi kin long noh ki mraw jong phi .

translation.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .

translation.en: Is any man called being circumcised ? let him not become uncircumcised . Is any called in uncircumcision ? let him not be circumcised .
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba la lah otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban pyrshang ban weng noh ïa ki dak jong ka jingotsher ; lada u briew uba khlem otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban shah otsher .

translation.en: And I said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , The work is great and large , and we are separated upon the wall , one far from another .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ki briew bad ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongïalam ,  Ka jingtreikam ka la ïar bad la pynïakhlad ïa ngi da ka jingjngai uwei na uwei pat ha ka kynroh .

translation.en: I will not leave you comfortless : I will come to you .
translation.kha: Ynda nga leit , phin ym sah tang marwei ; ngan wan pat sha phi .

translation.en: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal , and burned them .
translation.kha: ki sei shabar ïa u rishot bakyntang uba don hangta bad ki thang ïa u .

translation.en: As it is written , There is none righteous , no , not one :
translation.kha: Kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong :  Ym don uno uno uba hok ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land , and shall choose Jerusalem again .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ka Judah kan long ka nongkynti bakyrpang jong U  Trai  ha ka ri bakyntang jong u , bad ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah kaba u ieit tam na baroh .

translation.en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for he commanded , and they were created .
translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! U shu hukum , bad ïa ki la pynlong ;

translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Have ye understood all these things ?  They say unto him , Yea , Lord .
translation.kha: Hato phi shemphang ïa kine kiei kiei ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki .  Ho-oid ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country .
translation.kha: Bad u la ïai kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phah noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid na kata ka thain .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock , and he said unto them , Hear now , ye rebels  ; must we fetch you water out of this rock ?
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh ha khmat u mawsiang , bad u Moses u ong ,  Sngap mynta , phi ki nongïaleh pyrshah ! Hato ngi hap pynmih um na une u mawsiang na ka bynta jong phi ?

translation.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him  ; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed : and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days .
translation.kha: Ki shim por sawphew sngi ban pyndep ïa ka , namar ka bam por katta ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka metïap . Ki nong Ijipt ki pynlong ka jingïambriew ïa u hynñiewphew sngi .

translation.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne , and spreadeth his cloud upon it .
translation.kha: U buhrieh ïa u bnai bapyllun hadien ki lyoh .

translation.en: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment , that wickedness was there  ; and the place of righteousness , that iniquity was there .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh , nga la ïohi ruh ba ha kane ka pyrthei phi shem ka jingbymman ha ka jaka kaba ka jinglehhok bad ka hok ki dei ban don .

translation.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child , his name was called JESUS , which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb .
translation.kha: Hadien shi taïew , haba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ban otsher ïa u khunlung , la ai kyrteng ïa u , U Jisu , ka kyrteng kaba u angel u la lah ai na ka bynta jong U ha shuwa ba yn pun ïa U .

translation.en: Why died I not from the womb ? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly ?
translation.kha: A ba ngan da la ïap noh hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga lane ïap noh ha ka khyllipmat ba la kha ïa nga .

translation.en: Now the just shall live by faith : but if any man draw back , my soul shall have no pleasure in him .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , ki briew jong nga kiba hok kin ngeit bad kin im ; hynrei lada uno uno na ki u phai dien ngan ym sngewbha shuh ïa u .

translation.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant , or the eye of his maid , that it perish  ; he shall let him go free for his eye s sake .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shoh na ka pyllew khmat ïa la u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , bad kata ka khmat ka sep-ei noh , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka khmat .

translation.en: I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before , that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .
translation.kha: Ngam shym ong ïa kane ïa ka ban pynrem ïa phi ; naba kumba nga la ong mynshuwa , phi long kiba ngi ieit eh ba ngi ïalong lang borabor , lada ngi im lane ngi ïap .

translation.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise , And God did rest the seventh day from all his works .
translation.kha: Naba don ha Jingthoh Bakhuid la ong ïa kane shaphang ka sngi kaba hynñiew :  U Blei u la shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew na ka kam jong u baroh .

translation.en: And a stranger will they not follow , but will flee from him : for they know not the voice of strangers .
translation.kha: Kin ym bud ïa uwei pat ; pynban , kin phet ïap na uba kum uta u briew , namar kim sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .

translation.en: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work ? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon ?
translation.kha: Hato phi lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba shna ei ei ? Hato phi lah ban shna u snar na ka , ban wah ïa kiei kiei ha u ?

translation.en: Then the woman said , Let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak one word unto my lord the king . And he said , Say on .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , shah ïa nga ban ong sa tang kawei ,  ka briew ka ong .  To ong  u jubab .

translation.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations : thou hast established the earth , and it abideth .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaineh jong me ka ïaisah sha ki pateng bynriew baroh ; me la buh pynskhem ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka neh .

translation.en: And he gathered men unto him , and became captain over a band , when David slew them of Zobah : and they went to Damascus , and dwelt therein , and reigned in Damascus .
translation.kha: ( Kane ka jia hadien ba u Dabid u la jop ïa u Hadadeser bad u la pynïap ïa ki paralok jong u na Syria . ) U Reson bad ki rangbah jong u ki leit bad sah ha Damaskos , ha kaba ki rangbah jong u ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Syria .

translation.en: Wherefore , my dearly beloved , flee from idolatry .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , to kiar noh na kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left  ; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles , and make the desolate cities to be inhabited .
translation.kha: Phan sa pynïar ïa ki pud sawdong na baroh ki liang ; ki briew jong pha kin ïoh pat ïa la ka ri ïa kaba kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki la shim . Ki nongbah kiba la ieh kynjah yn pyndap pat da ki briew .

translation.en: And he said unto them , What have I done now in comparison of you ? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong ha ki ,  Kaei kaba nga lah ban leh kam long ei ei haba nujor bad kaei kaba phi la leh . Wat kata kaba rit eh kaba ma phi ki paid Ephraim phi la leh ka long kaba kham kor shikatdei eh ban ïa kaei kaba ka kur jong nga baroh ka la leh .

translation.en: And let it be , when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees , that then thou shalt bestir thyself : for then shall the  Lord  go out before thee , to smite the host of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Haba me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïaid halor ki kliar dieng , te tur ïaleh ïa ki namar ngan ïaid ha shuwa jong me ban jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki Philistia .

translation.en: He asked water , and she gave him milk  ; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish .
translation.kha: U Sisera u pan um , hynrei ka ai ha u da ka dud ; Ka wanrah malai ïa u ha ka pliang kaba itynnat .

translation.en: And their border was Helkath , and Hali , and Beten , and Achshaph ,
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Helkath , ka Hali , ka Beten , ka Akhshaph ,

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities , and the wastes shall be builded .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ynda haba ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki pop jong phi baroh , ngan sa shah ba phin shong biang ha ki nongbah jong phi bad shah ba phin tei pat ïa ki jaka ba la jot .

translation.en: And there was given him dominion , and glory , and a kingdom , that all people , nations , and languages , should serve him : his dominion is an everlasting dominion , which shall not pass away , and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed .
translation.kha: La ai ha u ka iktiar , ka jingpyndonburom , bad ka bor ba kynja syiem , khnang ba ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej kin shakri ïa u . Ka iktiar jong u kan neh junom , bad ka hima jong u kan ym kut shuh .

translation.en: And Araunah looked , and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him : and Araunah went out , and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground .
translation.kha: Haba u Araunah u la khmih sharum bad u ïohi ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ba ki ïawan kiew sha u . U rynsied ïa lade ha madan ha khmat jong u Dabid

translation.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u lumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel , bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .

translation.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue , and seeth the tumult , and them that wept and wailed greatly .
translation.kha: Ki la poi ha ka ïing jong u Jairos , ha kaba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka jingkhynwin bad u la ïohsngew ïa baroh ka jingïam bad ka jingïam kthang .

translation.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves , being not baptized of him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kyntait ïa ka jingthmu jong U Blei na ka bynta jong ki hi bad ki la kyntait ban shah pynbaptis ha u Ïoannis .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel , Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal–peor .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki rangbah synshar ,  Uwei pa uwei na phi un pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew na ka jait jong phi uba la long u nongmane ïa u Baal ki Peor .

translation.en: And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and the frogs died out of the houses , out of the villages , and out of the fields .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u leh kumba u Moses u kyrpad , bad kita ki jakoid kiba don hapoh ïing , ha phyllaw ïing , bad ha lum ruh , ki ïap lut phar .

translation.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers : the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works .
translation.kha: Na suiñbneng me phah ïa u slap halor ki lum , bad ïa ka pyrthei la pyndap da ki jingkyrkhu jong me .

translation.en: And the men took of their victuals , and asked not counsel at the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pdiang katto katne ka jingbam na ki , hynrei kim shym kynjoh ktien na U  Trai  shaphang kata .

translation.en: For if our heart condemn us , God is greater than our heart , and knoweth all things .
translation.kha: Lada ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynrem ïa ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi bad ba u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki im ka jingim kaba bha ha khmat U Blei bad ki la kohnguh lut ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong U Trai .

translation.en: And the children of Dan said unto him , Let not thy voice be heard among us , lest angry fellows run upon thee , and thou lose thy life , with the lives of thy household .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki ong ,  Kan bha ba phin ym bunktien lymda phi kwah ïa kine ki briew ban bitar bad ban kynrup ïa phi . Nangta ma phi bad ka longïing jong phi baroh phin ïap .

translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , even a ram for a trespass offering .
translation.kha: Uta u briew un wallam uwei u langbrot ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat jong u ,

translation.en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city , to drink water  ; but they were not satisfied : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtlot namar ka jingsliang , ki briew jong kiba bun ki nongbah ki la leit sha ka nongbah kaba ki kyrmen ban ïoh um , hynrei kim ïoh ka umdih ka ban biang . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .

translation.en: And Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people that were present with them , abode in Gibeah of Benjamin : but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .
translation.kha: U Saul , u Jonathan u khun jong u , bad ki rangbah jong ki , ki sher dara ha Geba ha ka thain Benjamin ; ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka dei ha Mikhmash .

translation.en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him , and he said , Even that which they build , if a fox go up , he shall even break down their stone wall .
translation.kha: U Tobiah uba ïeng hangta hajan jong u , u ong shuh shuh ,  Kaba kum kano ka kynroh ki lah ban tei ? Wat u myrsiang u lah ban pynpra ïa ka !

translation.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba  ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U Abraham u leit phai pat sha la ki shakri , bad ki ïaleit lang sha Beersheba , ha kaba u Abraham u shongneh hangta .

translation.en: But now are they many members , yet but one body .
translation.kha: Kumba ka long , don shibun ki dkhot hynrei tang kawei ka met .

translation.en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingbha ka long ka jingmih ba la pynmih na ki symbai kiba ki nongpynïasuk ki la bet ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning .
translation.kha: Kita ki jingthaw hi ki phet shane bad shatai bad ki stet la kum ka jingthaba ka leilieh .

translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Honour thy father and thy mother .
translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat tuh ; wat mudui lamler ïano ïano ; burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie .’

translation.en: The land of Zabulon , and the land of Nephthalim , by the way of the sea , beyond Jordan , Galilee of the Gentiles  ;
translation.kha: Ko ka ri Sebulun bad ka ri Naphtali , kaba ha lynti sha ka duriaw , ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan , ka Galilaïa , ka ri ki Jentil !

translation.en: Beasts , and all cattle  ; creeping things , and flying fowl :
translation.kha: baroh ki mrad ba la pynjuh bad kiba ha khlaw , ki mrad bapar bad ki sim .

translation.en: Owe no man any thing , but to love one another : for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law .
translation.kha: To long kiba laitluid na ka jingshah teh na uno uno — ka jingteh kaba phi dei ban shah , ka long tang ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei . Uno uno uba leh ïa kane , u la kohnguh ïa ka Hukum .

translation.en: And it came to pass that night , that the angel of the  Lord  went out , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet u angel jong U  Trai  u leit sha ka jaka sher dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san hajar ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , hangta ki la thiah lyngktar , baroh kiba la ïap !

translation.en: A man to whom God hath given riches , wealth , and honour , so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth , yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof , but a stranger eateth it : this is vanity , and it is an evil disease .
translation.kha: U Blei un ai ha ngi ka spah , ka burom bad ka jingdon jingem , ho-oid baroh kaba ngi kwah , hynrei un ym shah ïa ngi ban ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . Pynban uwei pat u nongwei un ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . Ka long ka bymmyntoi , bad ka shu long ka bym dei .

translation.en: And Jesus came and spake unto them , saying ,  All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan hajan bad u la ong ha ki ,  La ai ha nga baroh ka bor ha bneng bad ha khyndew .

translation.en: The poor useth entreaties  ; but the rich answereth roughly .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba duk u kren , u hap kyrpad donakor , hynrei haba u briew uba riewspah u jubab , u kren khor .

translation.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy , and in the night is as a thief .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab u nongpynïap briew u khie bad u mih ban leit pynïap ïa uba duk , bad mynmiet u tuh .

translation.en: God forbid that I should justify you : till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me .
translation.kha: Ngan nym ong ruh ba ma phi ki briew phim shym bakla ; ngan ïai ban ïa ka jinglui lui jong nga haduh ka sngi ba ngan sa ïap .

translation.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don kano kano kaba ki lah ban ong , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa u briew uba la ïohkhiah uba ïeng hangta lem bad u Petros bad u Ïoannis .

translation.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u buh kyrpang lai tylli ki shnong sha mihngi na wah Jordan

translation.en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped , and thou shalt speak , and be no more dumb : and thou shalt be a sign unto them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi men ïoh pat ïa ka bor ban kren ïa kaba me la duh noh , bad men ïakren bad u . Ha kane ka rukom men long ka dak ïa ki briew , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the  Lord s  house , that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :
translation.kha: Hapoh ar snem ngan wallam pat sha kane ka jaka ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ka Templ kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia .

translation.en: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces , and grind the faces of the poor ? saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
translation.kha: Phim don hok ban khñiot ïa ki briew jong nga bad ban shim kabu ïa kiba duk . Ma nga U Nongsynshar U  Trai  Badonbor baroh nga la kren .

translation.en: But if it be a question of words and names , and of your law , look ye to it  ; for I will be no judge of such matters .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ka long ka jingïatainia shaphang ki ktien bad ki kyrteng bad shaphang ka hukum jong phi , phi hi phi dei ban ïapynbeit ïa ka . Ngan ym long u nongbishar ïa kine kiei kiei !

translation.en: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam , and with Tidal king of nations , and Amraphel king of Shinar , and Arioch king of Ellasar  ; four kings with five .
translation.kha: ïa ki syiem jong ka Elam , ka Goiim , ka Babilonia bad ka Ellasar , ki san ngut ki syiem pyrshah ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem .

translation.en: Behold , the nations are as a drop of a bucket , and are counted as the small dust of the balance : behold , he taketh up the isles as a very little thing .
translation.kha: Ha U  Trai  ki jaitbynriew kim long ei ei , ym don wat tang shi jaw ka um ; ki dewlynnong ba sha jngai ki sting kum u pui pui .

translation.en: And I will bring a sword upon you , that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant : and when ye are gathered together within your cities , I will send the pestilence among you  ; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingpynkheiñ jutang jong phi , bad lada phi wad jingïada da kaba ïalumlang ha la ki shnong , ngan phah ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah hapdeng jong phi bad phin hap pyndem ha ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life , clear as crystal , proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb .
translation.kha: U angel u la pyn-i ruh ha nga ïa ka wah jong ka um ka jingim , kaba shat phyrnai sngur bha , bad kaba wan mih na ka khet jong U Blei bad ka jong U Khunlangbrot

translation.en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand , Depart from me , ye cursed , into everlasting fire , prepared for the devil and his angels :
translation.kha: Nangta un ong ha kito kiba ha ka liang kadiang jong u , ‘ Khie leit noh na nga , phi kiba hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei ! Khie leit noh sha ka ding bymjukut ïa kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta u Ksuid bad ki angel jong u !

translation.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jedidah , the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jedidah , ka khun jong u Adaïah , na ka shnong na Boskath .

translation.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–heres , in the mount of Ephraim , on the north side of the hill Gaash .
translation.kha: La tep ïa u ha ka ri kynti jong u hi ha Timnath Serah ha ka ri lum Ephraim kaba shaphang shatei jong u Lum Gaash .

translation.en: My bowels boiled , and rested not : the days of affliction prevented me .
translation.kha: Ïa nga la tar arliang da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingpang ; nga la ïoh ïa ka jingjynjar na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .

translation.en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear , and deliver my people out of your hand , and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan sloit ïa ki jaiñ teh khlieh jong phi bad ngan shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban lait shisyndon na ka bor jong phi . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Moreover the brasen altar , that Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , had made , he put before the tabernacle of the  Lord  : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it .
translation.kha: Ka duwan rnong kaba la thaw da u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , ka don ruh ha Gibeon ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . U syiem Solomon bad ki briew baroh ki la mane ïa U  Trai  hangta .

translation.en: And he brought up Hadassah , that is , Esther , his uncle s daughter : for she had neither father nor mother , and the maid was fair and beautiful  ; whom Mordecai , when her father and mother were dead , took for his own daughter .
translation.kha: U don ka bakha , ka Esther , kaba ka kyrteng Hebru jong ka , ka long ka Hadassah ; ka long ka samla ba-bhabriew , bad ka don ka rynïeng ryñiot ba-itynnat . Ha ka jingïap noh ki kmie ki kpa jong ka , u Mordekai u la ri bad pynheh pynsan ïa ka kum la ka jong ka khun .

translation.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines , and to the border of Egypt .
translation.kha: U long u nongsynshar uba hakhlieh tam na ki syiem baroh ha ka thain naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri Philistia bad haduh khappud ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai . . .    ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: As concerning the gospel , they are enemies for your sakes : but as touching the election , they are beloved for the fathers  sakes .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki kyntait ïa ka Khubor Babha , ki Jiw ki long ki nongshun jong U Blei na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil . Hynrei namar ka jingjied U Blei , ki long ki paralok jong u namar ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: And Jonathan Saul s son arose , and went to David into the wood , and strengthened his hand in God .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u la leit sha u hangta bad u la pynshlur ïa u da ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingïada jong U Blei ,

translation.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees  part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .
translation.kha: Ka jingpyrta ka la kham jam , bad katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun ki Pharisi ki la ïeng bad ki la pyrshah jur :  Ngim shem kano kano kaba bakla bad une u briew ! Lehse u mynsiem lane u angel u la kren shisha ha u !

translation.en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God , and of Jesus our Lord ,
translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ba-dap pura kin long ki jong phi lyngba ka jingtip jong phi ïa U Blei bad ïa U Jisu U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law : she is thy son s wife  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim

translation.en: Forsake her not , and she shall preserve thee : love her , and she shall keep thee .
translation.kha: Wat iehnoh ïa ka jingstad , bad kan ïada ïa phi ; ieit ïa ka , te kan sumar bha ïa phi .

translation.en: O  Lord  , are not thine eyes upon the truth ? thou hast stricken them , but they have not grieved  ; thou hast consumed them , but they have refused to receive correction : they have made their faces harder than a rock  ; they have refused to return .
translation.kha: Da shisha U  Trai  u peit ïa ka jingïaineh . U la shoh ïa phi , hynrei phim shym pynleit jingmut ; u la pynlwet ïa phi , hynrei phi la kyntait ban ïoh jinghikai . Phi long kiba mutlop bad phim shym phai na ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the  Lord  thy God , of the flock and the herd , in the place which the  Lord  shall choose to place his name there .
translation.kha: Leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei kaba U  Trai  un jied , bad kñia hangta kawei ka langbrot lane kawei ka masi jong phi na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait khnang ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath driven out from before you great nations and strong : but as for you , no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad badonbor katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , bad ym don mano mano ba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: Then said these men , We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel , except we find it against him concerning the law of his God .
translation.kha: Ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ngin ym shem kano kano da kaba ngi lah ban kynnoh ïa u Daniel lymda dei kaei kaei kaba ïasoh bad ka niam jong u .

translation.en: Take heed , brethren , lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief , in departing from the living God .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to sumar ïoh ba uno uno na phi u don ka dohnud kaba sniew eh bad bymngeit kat haduh ba un da phai dien noh na U Blei uba im .

translation.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances : for all are thy servants .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki neh haduh kane ka sngi namar ka hukum jong me , namar baroh ki long ki shakri jong me .

translation.en: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough , and an uppermost branch , which they left because of the children of Israel : and there shall be desolation .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , ïa ki nongbah kiba la ïada bha yn iehnoh bad yn ieh ha ka jingjot jingpra kum ki nongbah kiba ki Hib bad ki Amor ki la iehnoh mynba ki phet ïap na ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect : yet not the wisdom of this world , nor of the princes of this world , that come to nought :
translation.kha: La katta ruh , nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ka jingstad sha kito kiba la san ha ka jinglong mynsiem . Hynrei , kam long ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei lane jong ki bor kiba synshar ïa kane ka pyrthei — ki bor ki ban sa duh noh ïa ka bor jong ki .

translation.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Men ïap kum u ksew ha ka kti jong ki nongwei bym don blei . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la ai ïa ka hukum .

translation.en: The quiver rattleth against him , the glittering spear and the shield .
translation.kha: Ki atiar kiba ki nongshong jong ki , ki rah ; ki sawa bad ki thaba ha ka sngi .

translation.en: The  Lord s  voice crieth unto the city , and the man of wisdom shall see thy name : hear ye the rod , and who hath appointed it .
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingstad ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai . U pyrta ïa ka nongbah ,  To shahshkor phi ki briew kiba ïalum ha ka nongbah !

translation.en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord , and from the glory of his power ;
translation.kha: Kin shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingpynjot bymjukut , kiba la pynïakhlad na ka jingdon ryngkat ka jong U Trai bad na ka jingkhlaiñbor badonburom jong u ,

translation.en: Behold , therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made , and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynhap ïa ka ksang ti jong nga halor ki kam tuh bad pynïap briew .

translation.en: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house , when the man went in  ; and the cloud filled the inner court .
translation.kha: Ki kherub ki ïeng shaphang shathie na ka Templ haba u rung hapoh , bad u lyoh u tap ïa ka phyllaw kaba shapoh .

translation.en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord , and to all that were in his house .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Trai ha u bad ha baroh kiwei pat kiba ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And she arose , and bowed herself on her face to the earth , and said , Behold , let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka dem ngon ha khyndew bad ka ong ,  Nga long ka shakri jong u , kaba kloi ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki shakri jong u .

translation.en: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu u la wan ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .

translation.en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt , but the Assyrian shall be his king , because they refused to return .
translation.kha: Ki kyntait ban wan phai sha nga , bad kumta ki dei ban leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Assyria kin synshar halor jong ki .

translation.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness  ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .
translation.kha: Ka jingkmen jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi ; ka jingkthang jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi . Ym don uba lah ban ïasam ïa ki bad phi .

translation.en: He shall dwell on high : his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks : bread shall be given him  ; his waters shall be sure .
translation.kha: Te phin long shngain ; phin long skhem kum ka kut bakhlaiñ . Phin don ka jingbam ban bam bad ka um ban dih .

translation.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes , and saw a great company come unto him , he saith unto Philip ,  Whence shall we buy bread , that these may eat ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong bad u la ïohi ba u paidbah byllien u la nang wan sha u , kumta u la ong ha u Philip ,  Nangno ngi lah ban thied jingbam ka ban dap ban bsa ïa kine ki briew baroh ?

translation.en: I will make thee perpetual desolations , and thy cities shall not return : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me ka ri khlaw junom la junom , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong shuh ha ki nongbah jong me . Te men sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Where no counsel is , the people fall : but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew kan kyllon lada ym don ka jingïalam . Ha ka jingbun ki nongaibuit don ka jingshngain .

translation.en: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment : else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old , and the rent is made worse .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba pyndonkam ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka sopti barim , namar ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynkad katto katne ïa ka jaiñ barim , kan pynlong wat ïa ka jingkad kaba kham heh .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Which of you shall have a friend , and shall go unto him at midnight , and say unto him , Friend , lend me three loaves  ;
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Tharai uwei na phi un leit sha ka ïing u paralok jong phi ha ka por shiteng synñia bad ong ha u , ‘ Ko paralok , ai kylliang ïa nga lai tylli ki lyngkhot kpu .

translation.en: And he declared unto you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even ten commandments  ; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha phi kaei kaba phi dei ban leh ha kaba bat ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad phi , kata , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum ba u la thoh ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap .

translation.en: He answered and said to Arioch the king s captain , Why is the decree so hasty from the king ? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel .
translation.kha: u la kylli ïa u Ariokh balei ba u syiem u la pynmih kum kane ka hukum kaba eh . Kumta u Ariokh u la ïathuh ïa u Daniel ïa kaei kaba la lah jia .

translation.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year , and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year  ; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .
translation.kha: Haba phi bet ha ki lyngkha ha ka snem kaba phra , phin nang bam ïa kaei kaba la ot ha ka snem kaba hynriew , bad phin dang don kyrhai ban bam haduh ba phin da ot ïa u jingthung ha kata ka snem .

translation.en: And he said unto his brethren , My money is restored  ; and , lo , it is even in my sack : and their heart failed them , and they were afraid , saying one to another , What is this that God hath done unto us ?
translation.kha: La pynphai pat ïa ki pisa jong nga ,  u la khot ïa la ki hynmen shynrang .  Kane hangne ha ka byrni jong nga !  Mar kumta ki rit mynsiem ria , bad da kaba sheptieng ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei keiñ kane kaba U Blei u la leh ïa ngi ?

translation.en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe : for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers .
translation.kha: Ka bri ka khyndew jong uwei pa uwei u Israel kan sah ha ka jait jong u .

translation.en: And command them to say unto their masters , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say unto your masters  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ka Israel , u la bthah ïa nga ban hukum ïa ki ban ïathuh ïa ki syiem jong ki ba U  Trai  u la lah ong :

translation.en: For unclean spirits , crying with loud voice , came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies , and that were lame , were healed .
translation.kha: Ki mynsiem bymman ki la mihnoh na kiba bun ki briew da kaba lynñiar jam , bad ïa kiba bun kiba pang ïapshiliang bad kiba dkoh la pynkhiah .

translation.en: And if it will make no peace with thee , but will make war against thee , then thou shalt besiege it :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kim treh ïasuk , bad ki ïaleh pyrshah pynban ïa phi , kerkut ïa ka .

translation.en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot , and put him in the second chariot that he had  ; and they brought him to Jerusalem , and he died , and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers . And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah .
translation.kha: Ki sei ïa u na ka kali ïapom jong u , ki buh ïa u ha ka kali ïapom kaba ar kaba u don hangta , bad ki kit ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ki ïambriew namar ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur , that is before Egypt , as thou goest toward Assyria : and he died in the presence of all his brethren .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ishmael ki la shong la sah ha ka jaka kaba hapdeng ka Habilah bad ka Shur , sha ka phang mihngi jong ka ri Ijipt ha ka lynti sha Assyria . Kine ki la shong kyrpang na kiwei pat ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham .

translation.en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines , where Elhanan the son of Jaare–oregim , a Beth–lehemite , slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite , the staff of whose spear was like a weaver s beam .
translation.kha: La don sa kawei pat ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , bad u Elhanan , u khun jong u Jair uba na Bethlehem u la pynïap ïa u Goliath na Gath , uba u sum jong u , u don u dieng thung sum uba rben kat u khung jong u nongthain jaiñ .

translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom  ; for Moses had laid his hands upon him : and the children of Israel hearkened unto him , and did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U Joshua u khun jong u Nun u long uba la pyndap da ka jingstad , naba u Moses u la thung ïa u ban long u nongshimti pateng . Ki Israel ki kohnguh ïa u Joshua bad ki sumar ïa ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests , the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness .
translation.kha: bad u Annas bad u Kaïaphas ki la long ki rangbah lyngdoh . Ha kata ka por , ka ktien jong U Blei ka la wan ha u Ïoannis u khun jong u Sekharaïah , ha ka ri shyiap .
