translation.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
translation.kha: Un bat ïa ka jutang jong u junom , ki jingkular jong u na ka bynta ki hajar ki pateng .

translation.en: And , behold , there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the  Lord  unto Beth–el : and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u nongïathuhlypa na Judah u leit sha Bethel bad u la poi hangta hamar ba u Jeroboam u ïeng ha ka duwan ban kñia jingainguh .

translation.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias , to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children , and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just  ; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord .
translation.kha: Un leit ha shuwa jong U Trai , uba khlaiñ bad uba khrawbor kum u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa . Un pynïasuk pat ïa ki kpa bad ki khun ; un pynphai pat ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh sha ka rukom pyrkhat jong kiba hok ; un pynkhreh ïa ki briew jong U Trai na ka bynta jong U .

translation.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward , even unto the sea of the plain , under the springs of Pisgah .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa kata ka thain baroh kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Baïap kaba shaphang shathie , bad nangta haduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: For all those things hath mine hand made , and all those things have been , saith the  Lord  : but to this man will I look , even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit , and trembleth at my word .
translation.kha: Ma nga hi nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ! Nga shem sngewbha bad kito kiba sngewrit bad kiba kylla-kaba-mut , kiba sheptieng ïa nga bad kiba kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have estranged this place , and have burned incense in it unto other gods , whom neither they nor their fathers have known , nor the kings of Judah , and have filled this place with the blood of innocents  ;
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ki la pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka da kaba ai jingkñia hangne sha kiwei pat ki blei — ki blei kiba ym ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki lymne ki syiem jong ka Judah ki la tip ei ei . Ki la pyndap ïa kane ka jaka da ka snam jong ki briew kiba lui lui ,

translation.en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands , and brought that which they had spun , both of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine linen .
translation.kha: Baroh ki kynthei kiba nang ban thir ki wallam ïa u ksai linen uba ni , bad ïa u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .

translation.en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters  ; they only shall be delivered , but the land shall be desolate .
translation.kha: bad wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Kin lah ban pynim tang ïa la ka jong ka jingim , bad ka ri kan kylla long ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: I will bear the indignation of the  Lord  , because I have sinned against him , until he plead my cause , and execute judgment for me : he will bring me forth to the light , and I shall behold his righteousness .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , te mynta ngi dei ban ïaishah ïa ka jingbitar jong u shipor . Hynrei ha kaba kut un ïada ïa ngi bad un pynbeit ïa ka bymdei kaba la leh ha ngi . Un wallam ïa ngi shabar sha ka jingshai ; ngin im ban ïohi ba u pyllait im ïa ngi .

translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and , behold , the Lord  God  called to contend by fire , and it devoured the great deep , and did eat up a part .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la ïohi ïa u ba u dang pynkhreh ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da ka ding . Ka ding ka la thang lut ïa ka duriaw-bah bakhraw hapoh ka sla pyrthei , bad ka la sdang ban bam duh ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: Is it a book ?
translation.kha: Kane kadei ka kot ?

translation.en: Now she that is a widow indeed , and desolate , trusteth in God , and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day .
translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei kaba long tang marwei , ka bym don mano mano ban sumar ïa ka , ka la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei bad ka ïai duwai bad pan na u ïa ka jingïarap mynmiet bad mynsngi .

translation.en: But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing  ; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death : for as when a man riseth against his neighbour , and slayeth him , even so is this matter :
translation.kha: Ym dei ban leh ei ei ïa kata ka briew , namar kam shym la leh ïa ka pop ba ka dei ban ïap , naba kane ka kam ka ïasyriem kum ïa kato kaba u briew u shoh bad pynïap ïa uwei pat u briew .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter ,  Put up thy sword into the sheath : the cup which my Father hath given me , shall I not drink it ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  To bsuh noh ïa ka waitlam ha ka jingsop jong ka ! Me tharai ba ngan ym dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ?

translation.en: And Joab answered and said , Far be it , far be it from me , that I should swallow up or destroy .
translation.kha: Ym kumta !  u Joab u jubab .  Ngan ym pynsniew lane pynjot ïa ka nongbah jong phi !

translation.en: Then he answered and spake unto me , saying , This is the word of the  Lord  unto Zerubbabel , saying , Not by might , nor by power , but by my spirit , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: U angel u la bthah ïa nga ban ai ha u Serubbabel ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  :  Men jop , ym da ka bor shipai lymne da ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong me , hynrei da U Mynsiem jong nga .

translation.en: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom , that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace , to the house of the women , unto the custody of Hege the king s chamberlain , keeper of the women  ; and let their things for purification be given them :
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thung ki rangbah synshar ha man ki probins    jong ka hima bad hukum ïa ki ban wallam ïa baroh kine ki samla kynthei ba-bhabriew sha ka ïing ki kynthei jong phi hangne ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima . Buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingkhmih jong u Hegai , u ïunukh uba peit halor ki kynthei jong phi , bad ban ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki .

translation.en: And when the day was now far spent , his disciples came unto him , and said , This is a desert place , and now the time is far passed :
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sdang noh , ki synran ki la wan ha u bad ki la ong ,  Ka por ka dier palat , bad kane ka dei ka jaka kynjah .

translation.en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword , and took Dinah out of Shechem s house , and went out .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïalam noh ruh ïa ka Dinah na ïing u Shekhem , bad ki ïaleit noh .

translation.en: Come now therefore , and I will send thee unto Pharaoh , that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta nga phah ïa me sha u Pharaoh khnang ba men ïalam noh ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong nga , na Ijipt .

translation.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron : and the king lifted up his voice , and wept at the grave of Abner  ; and all the people wept .
translation.kha: La tep ïa u Abner ha Hebron , bad u syiem u ïam da kaba kyang jam ha ka jaka tep , bad ki briew baroh ki leh kumjuh .

translation.en: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon , and to call peaceably unto them .
translation.kha: Nangta ka jingïalang paidbah ka phah ktien sha ki Benjamin kiba don ha u Mawsiang Rimmon bad tyrwa ban pynwai noh ïa ka thma .

translation.en: How shall I curse , whom God hath not cursed ? or how shall I defy , whom the  Lord  hath not defied ?
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban tim ïa kaei kaba U Blei um shym la tim , Lane kren shaphang ka jingjot haba U  Trai  um shym kren ?

translation.en: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest : and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David , and said unto him , Why art thou alone , and no man with thee ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u leit sha u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh ha Nob . U Ahimelekh u mih da kaba sheptieng ban leit tan ïa u , bad u kylli ,  Balei ba phi wan hangne tang marwei ?

translation.en: And her spirit came again , and she arose straightway : and he commanded to give her meat .
translation.kha: Ka la im pat , bad ka la khie joit shisyndon , bad U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ai ei ei ha ka ba kan bam .

translation.en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses , saying , Behold , we die , we perish , we all perish .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki ong ha u Moses ,  Te kata ka dei kaba kut ïa ngi !

translation.en: Of righteousness , because I go to my Father , and ye see me no more  ;
translation.kha: ki bakla shaphang kaei kaba dei , namar ba ngan leit sha U Kpa bad phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga ;

translation.en: When they heard these things , they held their peace , and glorified God , saying , Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sangeh ïa ka jingwoh nia jong ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong ,  Te U Blei u la ai ruh ha ki Jentil ïa la lad ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban lait im !

translation.en: With long life will I satisfy him , and shew him my salvation .
translation.kha: Ngan ainong ïa ki da kaba pynslem ïa ka rta jong ki , ngan pynim ïa ki .

translation.en: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ ? shall I then take the members of Christ , and make them the members of an harlot ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba ki met jong phi ki long ki dkhot jong ka met U Khrist . Hato ngan shim noh shi lyngkhot na ka met U Khrist bad pynlong ïa ka shi bynta jong ka met jong ka nuti ? Kam lah ban long!

translation.en: The fishers also shall mourn , and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament , and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh uba kamai ïa lade da kaba khwai ha ka Nile un ud khuslai bad un ïam ; ki khwai bad ki jar jong ki kin long ki bymmyntoi shuh .

translation.en: In the beginning was the Word , and the Word was with God , and the Word was God .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban thaw ïa ka pyrthei , u Ktien u la lah don lypa ; u la don bad U Blei , bad u long kumjuh kum U Blei .

translation.en: But my servant Caleb , because he had another spirit with him , and hath followed me fully , him will I bring into the land whereinto he went  ; and his seed shall possess it .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Kaleb u shakri jong nga u don ka jinglong bapher bad u la ïaineh ha nga , ngan wallam ïa u sha kata ka ri kaba u la swar , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri

translation.en: And by their prayer for you , which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you .
translation.kha: Bad kumta da ka jingsngewieit bajylliew kin duwai na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei kaba kor tam kaba U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi .

translation.en: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa hynñiewspah phraphew ar snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: And he said , All these have I kept from my youth up .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  Naduh ba nga dang samla nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .

translation.en: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God , which thou shalt have occasion to bestow , bestow it out of the king s treasure house .
translation.kha: Bad kano kano kaba phi dang donkam shuh ha ka Templ , phi lah ban ïoh na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem .

translation.en: But when the multitudes saw it , they marvelled , and glorified God , which had given such power unto men .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la sheptieng , bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei uba la ai kum kata ka iktiar ha ki briew .

translation.en: He said unto them ,  Give place : for the maid is not dead , but sleepeth .  And they laughed him to scorn .
translation.kha: u la ong ,  To ïamihnoh shabar baroh ! Ka khynnah rit kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !  Te ki baroh ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u .

translation.en: We die because we all come from Adam and Eve .
translation.kha: Ngi ïap namarba ngi hiar pateng na u Adam bad ka Im .

translation.en: And I brought them into the house of the  Lord  , into the chamber of the sons of Hanan , the son of Igdaliah , a man of God , which was by the chamber of the princes , which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum , the keeper of the door :
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka kamra jong ki synran jong u Hanan u nongïathuhlypa u khun jong u Igdalaïah . Kane ka kamra ka long halor ka kamra u Maaseïah u khun jong u Shallum , u rangbah synshar bapawkhmat jong ka Templ , bad hajan ki kamra jong kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar .

translation.en: And all that believed were together , and had all things common  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïadon lang ha ka jingïasyllok bajan bad ki la ïasam ïa la ki jingdon jingem iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: And God spake all these words , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei u la kren , bad kine ki dei ki ktien jong u :

translation.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers :
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ïeng hangne ba yn bishar namar ka jingkyrmen kaba nga don ha ka jingkular kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi —

translation.en: And Beth–lebaoth , and Sharuhen  ; thirteen cities and their villages :
translation.kha: ka Beth Lebaoth , bad ka Sharuhen : khatlai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: My foot hath held his steps , his way have I kept , and not declined .
translation.kha: Nga bud beit ïa ka lynti ba u jied , bad ngam ju sakma sha kadiang ne kamon .

translation.en: And Rekem , and Irpeel , and Taralah ,
translation.kha: ka Rekem , ka Irpeel , ka Taralah ,

translation.en: And he said , Cast it on the ground . And he cast it on the ground , and it became a serpent  ; and Moses fled from before it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Bret ïa u ha madan .  Haba u Moses u bret ïa u , uta u diengduh u kylla bseiñ , bad u Moses u phet na uta .

translation.en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit , of the courts of the house of the  Lord  , and of all the chambers round about , of the treasuries of the house of God , and of the treasuries of the dedicated things :
translation.kha: U la ai ruh ha u ïa ki dur pynkhreh jong kita baroh kiba u don ha ka jingmut ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra sawdong jong ki bad ïa ki kamra buh ïa ki tiar jong ka Templ , bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai .

translation.en: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain , and a corrupt spring .
translation.kha: U briew babha uba ai ha uwei pat uba sniew ka pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ka umpohliew kaba la pynjngut ne ka pukri kaba la ai bih .

translation.en: When they shall go , I will spread my net upon them  ; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven  ; I will chastise them , as their congregation hath heard .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan riam da ka jar bad kem ïa ki kum ki sim katba ki dang ïaid . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman ba ki la leh .

translation.en: ( And the children of Israel went up and wept before the  Lord  until even , and asked counsel of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother ? And the  Lord  said , Go up against him . )
translation.kha: Te ki khun Israel ki leit kiew sha jaka mane Blei bad ki ïamkthang ha khmat U  Trai  haduh janmiet . Ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato ngin leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki para jait jong ngi ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ho-oid .  Kumta ki paidïapom ki Israel ki la ïoh mynsiem , bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep .

translation.en: O Belteshazzar , master of the magicians , because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee , and no secret troubleth thee , tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen , and the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Ko Belteshassar , u rangbah jong ki nongbatai kupar , nga tip ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me , bad ba me shemphang ïa ki jingmaïan baroh . Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew jong nga . To ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: The  Lord  looketh from heaven  ; he beholdeth all the sons of men .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khmih sha tbian na bneng , bad u ïohi ïa u khunbynriew baroh .

translation.en: But when we are judged , we are chastened of the Lord , that we should not be condemned with the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei la bishar bad la pynshitom ïa ngi da U Trai , khnang ba yn ym pynrem ïa ngi lem bad ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face  ; and they said , Behold , we be thy servants .
translation.kha: Nangta ki hynmen jong u hi ki ïawan bad ki ïadem ngon ha khmat jong u .  Ngi long ki mraw jong phi ,  ki ong .

translation.en: Yet someone may ask : ‘ Don’t humans have an immortal soul that survives death ?’
translation.kha: Jarkatta don kiba ong : ‘ Ym u briew u don ka mynsiem ka ba iaid lait na ka jingiap ?’

translation.en: Neither have our kings , our princes , our priests , nor our fathers , kept thy law , nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies , wherewith thou didst testify against them .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh Kim shym la sumar ïa ka Hukum jong me . Kim shym la sngap ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham jong me .

translation.en: Then Esther the queen answered and said , If I have found favour in thy sight , O king , and if it please the king , let my life be given me at my petition , and my people at my request :
translation.kha: Ka Esther , ka mahadei ka jubab ,  Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , ban ai ïa ka jingkyrpad barit jong nga , ka jingkwah jong nga ka long ba ngan lah ban im bad ba ki briew jong nga ruh kin im .

translation.en: But put forth thine hand now , and touch his bone and his flesh , and he will curse thee to thy face .
translation.kha: Hynrei tharai mynta me pynmong ïa ka met jong u — un tim ïa me markhmat !

translation.en: So that they shall take no wood out of the field , neither cut down any out of the forests  ; for they shall burn the weapons with fire : and they shall spoil those that spoiled them , and rob those that robbed them , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kin ym hap shuh ban khar diengïap sha lum sha wah ne thoh dieng na khlaw , namar ki don ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh , ban thang ding . Kin kurup bad lute ïa kito kiba la kurup bad lute ïa ki ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: Brethren , pray for us .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit , to duwai lem na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: And the Pharisees came to him , and asked him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife ? tempting him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan ha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u .  Ïathuh ïa ngi ,  ki la kylli ,  hato ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ne em ïa u briew ban pyllait ïa ka tnga jong u ?

translation.en: * Jesus’ first action as King was to throw Satan and his demons down to the earth .
translation.kha: * Ka kam kaba nyngkong eh kaba u Jisu u la leh ka long ban shop ïa u Soitan bad ïa ki ksuid jong u sha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore , and shall not swallow it down : according to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .
translation.kha: Un hap ban iehnoh ïa baroh kaba u la dep trei ; un ym ïohlad ban lehkmen halor ka spah jong u ,

translation.en: Now the house was full of men and women  ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there  ; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women , that beheld while Samson made sport .
translation.kha: Kata ka ïing ka khapngiah da ki shynrang bad ki kynthei . Ki syiem Philistia baroh san ngut ki don hangta , bad ki don kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah bad ki kynthei halor tnum ïing , kiba khmih kai ïa u ba u pynbyrngia ïa ki .

translation.en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , hato ka hok jong u Ïoannis ban pynbaptis ka wan na U Blei ne na u briew ?

translation.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles , Aaron and his sons , and put the bonnets on them : and the priest s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute : and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki , bad teh ïa ki tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom men pynkyntang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u . Ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin shakri ïa nga junom kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: My God , think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works , and on the prophetess Noadiah , and the rest of the prophets , that would have put me in fear .
translation.kha: Nga duwai ,  A Blei , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la leh bad to pynshitom ïa ki . To kynmaw ïa kato ka kynthei , ka Noadaïah , bad baroh kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .

translation.en: It does not belong to man who is walking even to direct his step .
translation.kha: Kam long ha u briew uba iaid ban pynbeit ia la ki jingjam .

translation.en: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men : for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim , and smote them in the going down : wherefore the hearts of the people melted , and became as water .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki beh krad ïa ki naduh ka khyrdop shnong haduh ki katto katne ki par bad ki la pynïap kumba laiphew hynriew ngut ha ka lynti sharum ki lumrit . Te ki Israel ki la duh ka jingshlur bad ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Phi la shem da lade haduh katno U Blei u long uba sbun .

translation.en: How shall we escape , if we neglect so great salvation  ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord , and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him  ;
translation.kha: Da kumno te ngin lait , lada ngi leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingpynim kaba khraw katta katta ? U Trai hi u la pynbna nyngkong ïa kane ka jingpynim , bad kita kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki pynshisha ha ngi ba ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: About whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him .
translation.kha: bad haba nga la leit sha Jerusalem , ki rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw lem bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u bad ki la kyrpad ïa nga ban rai pynrem ïa u .

translation.en: Also Hosah , of the children of Merari , had sons  ; Simri the chief , ( for though he was not the firstborn , yet his father made him the chief  ; )
translation.kha: Na ka kur jong u Merari la don u Hosah , uba don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shimri , ( u kpa jong u , u la pynlong nongïalam ïa u wat la um dei u khun nyngkong ) ,

translation.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .
translation.kha: U Melkhisedek um shym la hiarpateng na u Lebi , hynrei u la lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu ïa u , u briew uba la ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkular jong U Blei .

translation.en: Unstable as water , thou shalt not excel  ; because thou wentest up to thy father s bed  ; then defiledst thou it : he went up to my couch .
translation.kha: Me long kum ka umbah kaba shlei . Hynrei men ym ïoh ïa ka kyrdan bapawkhmat tam , Naba me la ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad me la pynjahburom ïa ka jingthiah u kpa jong me .

translation.en: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .
translation.kha: Ai ka jubab bieit ïa ka jingkylli bieit , bad uta uba kylli ïa ka un sngewthuh ba um long uba stad kumba u pyrkhat .

translation.en: And Isaiah said unto them , Thus shall ye say unto your master , Thus saith the  Lord  , Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard , wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha phi ban ym shah ba ki Assyria kin pynkhaw-eit ïa phi da ki jingkob jong ki ba um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: For now thou numberest my steps : dost thou not watch over my sin ?
translation.kha: Nangta men khmih man ka sien jam ba nga shim , hynrei men ym buddien ïa ki pop jong nga .

translation.en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals , and I heard , as it were the noise of thunder , one of the four beasts saying , Come and see .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait noh ïa kawei na ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei na ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ba u ong ha ka sur kaba sawa kum u pyrthat ,  To wan !

translation.en: And when the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  came into the camp , all Israel shouted with a great shout , so that the earth rang again .
translation.kha: Haba ka Synduk ka Jutang ka poi , ki Israel ki risa jam da ka jingkmen haduh ba ka khyndew ka khynñiuh .

translation.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten , and destruction shall be ready at his side .
translation.kha: U la ju long uba riewspah , hynrei mynta u ïaid ha ka jingthngan ; ka jingjot ka ïeng bad ka ap ha syndah jong u .

translation.en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules .
translation.kha: Pha la die ïa ki tiar jong pha na ka bynta ki kulai tan , ki kulai thma , bad ki kada na Beth Togarmah .

translation.en: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you .
translation.kha: Bad kumta la khanglad ïa nga bunsien na kaba wan sha phi .

translation.en: God is not a man , that he should lie  ; neither the son of man , that he should repent : hath he said , and shall he not do it ? or hath he spoken , and shall he not make it good ?
translation.kha: U Blei um long kum ki briew , kiba kren lamler ; Um long kum u briew uba kylla la ka jingmut . Kat kaba u kular , u pyndep ; U kren , bad la pyndep ïa kata .

translation.en: And David was afraid of God that day , saying , How shall I bring the ark of God home to me ?
translation.kha: Te u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U Blei bad u ong ,  Kumno ngan lah ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad nga mynta ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall cause his glorious voice to be heard , and shall shew the lighting down of his arm , with the indignation of his anger , and with the flame of a devouring fire , with scattering , and tempest , and hailstones .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shah ïa baroh ban ïohsngew ïa ka sur bamaïan jong u bad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar jong u . Kin don ki thylliej ding , ki jingjur eh u slap , ki phria bad u slap khlem sangeh .

translation.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab , and the revilings of the children of Ammon , whereby they have reproached my people , and magnified themselves against their border .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Nga la ïohsngew ba ki briew jong ka Moab bad Ammon ki krenbeiñ bad ki pynsalia ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ki kren khraw ba kin kurup ïa ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u nguh ha khmat kita ki Hit

translation.en: And he said unto Balak , Stand here by thy burnt offering , while I meet the  Lord  yonder .
translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga nang leit ïakynduh ïa U Blei hangtai .

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  For judgment I am come into this world , that they which see not might see  ; and that they which see might be made blind .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga la wan sha kane ka pyrthei ban bishar , khnang ba kiba matlah kin ïohi bad kito kiba ïohi kin long matlah .

translation.en: Then Peter began to say unto him , Lo , we have left all , and have followed thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U Petros u la kren ,  Khmih , ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me .

translation.en: After all this , when Josiah had prepared the temple , Neco king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates : and Josiah went out against him .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u syiem Josaïah u la leh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta ka Templ , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïaleh pyrshah ha Karkhemish ha ka wah Ïuphratis . U Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u , hynrei u Neko u phah sha u Josaïah ïa kane ka khubor :

translation.en: When I was daily with you in the temple , ye stretched forth no hands against me : but this is your hour , and the power of darkness .
translation.kha: Nga la don bad phi ha ka Templ man ka sngi , bad phim shym la pyrshang ban kem ïa nga . Hynrei kane ka dei ka kynta jong phi ban leh , haba ka bor jong ka jingdum ka synshar .

translation.en: And Asahel pursued after Abner  ; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner .
translation.kha: u la sdang ban beh kthong ïa u Abner , u da mareh beit beit sha u .

translation.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , upon the hem of the robe round about .
translation.kha: Ha ka rmiang ba sha trai jong ka , buh ïa ki dur soh Pomkranet ba la shna da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad hapdeng hapdeng suh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar .

translation.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread  ; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt : therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar dei ha kane ka sngi ba nga la ïalam noh ïa ki jait jong phi na ka ri Ijipt . Pateng la pateng phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil : he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bha ki ïaid na ka lynti kaba lait na kaba sniew ; te khmih shano ba phi leit — ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: Therefore it is come to pass , that as he cried , and they would not hear  ; so they cried , and I would not hear , saith the  Lord  of hosts :
translation.kha: Namar ba kim shym la shahshkor mynba nga la kren , ngam shym la jubab mynba ki la duwai .

translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O thou most proud , saith the Lord  God  of hosts : for thy day is come , the time that I will visit thee .
translation.kha: Ko Babilonia , pha la dap da ka jingsarong , te ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga long pyrshah ïa pha ! Ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pynshitom ïa pha .

translation.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son : but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes .
translation.kha: Lada phi pynshitom ïa la ki khun , phim ieit ïa ki . Lada phi ieit ïa ki , phin sneng pynbeit ïa ki .

translation.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness , fornication , wickedness , covetousness , maliciousness ; full of envy , murder , debate , deceit , malignity ; whisperers ,
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki da baroh ki jait jingbymman , ka jingsniew , ka jingkwah lalot bad ka jingthala ; ki dap da ka jingbishni , ka jingpynïap briew , ka jingïaleh , ka jingshukor , ka jingshun .

translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation : and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: lem bad u Elisaphan u khun jong u Ussiel kum u rangbah kur .

translation.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about , saying , Take heed to yourselves , that ye go not up into the mount , or touch the border of it : whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death :
translation.kha: Buh dak sawdong uta u lum khnang ba ki briew kim dei ban jam palat , bad ong ïa ki ba kin ym leit kiew sha u lum , lane wat ban leit tur sha jan jong u . Lada uno uno u leit ïuhkjat ha u lum , yn pynïap ïa u ;

translation.en: For there must be also heresies among you , that they which are approved may be made manifest among you .
translation.kha: (Khlem artatien ka don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong phi khnang ba yn ithuh shai ïa kita kiba leh ïa kaba dei .)

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine : turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ha nga ,  Ïa ka Israel yn sloit pynkhuid kum ka bri sohwaiñ na kaba la kheit ïa uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ . Kumta pha dei ban pyllait im ïano ïano katba pha lah katba dang don ka por .

translation.en: And Esau ran to meet him , and embraced him , and fell on his neck , and kissed him : and they wept .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Iso u mareh ban ïakynduh ïa u , u kdup ïa u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïa-ïam baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u Isaak um mynjur ïa ki kynthei nong Kanaan .

translation.en: And he made his seven lamps , and his snuffers , and his snuffdishes , of pure gold .
translation.kha: U shna hynñiew tylli ki sharak na ka bynta uta u diengpynïeng sharak , bad u thaw ruh ïa ki nap bad ki jingdiang jong u da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army  ; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army  ; but he shall not stand : for they shall forecast devices against him .
translation.kha: Un pynmih da ka jingshlur ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban tur ïaleh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt , u ban pynkhreh ban ïaleh pyrshah da ka kynhun shipai babun bad bakhrawbor . Hynrei ïa u syiem ka Ijipt yn shukor bad un ym jop .

translation.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery , dost thou commit adultery ? thou that abhorrest idols , dost thou commit sacrilege ?
translation.kha: Bad ba ong ba u briew um dei ban klim ,  — hynrei phi klim ? Phi isih ïa ki bleithaw — hynrei phi lute ha ki templ ?

translation.en: When Jesus therefore saw his mother , and the disciple standing by , whom he loved , he saith unto his mother ,  Woman , behold thy son !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa la ka kmie bad ïa u synran ïa uba u ieit ba ki ïa-ïeng hangta ; te u la ong ha la ka kmie ,  Une u long u khun jong phi .

translation.en: And he erected there an altar , and called it El–elohe–Israel .
translation.kha: U pynïeng ïa ka duwan hangta , bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ka da ka kyrteng El , U Blei jong ki Israel .

translation.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam , even to cut it off , and to destroy it from off the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Kane ka pop kaba u la leh ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingduh jingdam noh ka longïing syiem jong u .

translation.en: Ye have feared the sword  ; and I will bring a sword upon you , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hato phi sheptieng ïa ki waitlam ? Ngan wallam ïa ki briew ryngkat bad ki waitlam ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .

translation.en: But ye that did cleave unto the  Lord  your God are alive every one of you this day .
translation.kha: hynrei kito na phi kiba ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ki dang im haduh mynta .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah tang mar ïohsngew ïa kaba la ïathuh , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit sha ka Templ jong U  Trai .

translation.en: And he called him , and said unto him , How is it that I hear this of thee ? give an account of thy stewardship  ; for thou mayest be no longer steward .
translation.kha: kumta u la khot shapoh ïa u bad u la ong , ‘ Kaei kane kaba nga ïohsngew shaphang jong me ? To ai ha nga ïa ka jingkheiñ kaba pura ïa ka jingpynïaid jong me ïa ka jingdon jingem jong nga , namar men ym lah shuh ban long u sordar jong nga .’

translation.en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood , and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree , and the head slippeth from the helve , and lighteth upon his neighbour , that he die  ; he shall flee unto one of those cities , and live :
translation.kha: Kum ka nuksa , haba ar ngut ki briew ki leit thoh dieng lang sha khlaw bad , katba uwei na ki u dang khet ïa uwei u dieng , u sdie u lait na u sping bad u leit dei ha uta uwei pat , bad kumta u ïap , u lah ban phet sha kawei na kita ki lai tylli ki shnong , bad un leit rieh bad ïohlait im hangta .

translation.en: For they have sown the wind , and they shall reap the whirlwind : it hath no stalk : the bud shall yield no meal : if so be it yield , the strangers shall swallow it up .
translation.kha: Haba ki bet ïa ka lyer , kin ïoh ot ïa ka  erlangthari ! U kew baroh shi pynthor u bym pat ih un ym lah ban pynmih kpu . Hynrei wat lada u pynmih ruh , ki nongwei kin bam ei ïa u .

translation.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more : thine eyes are upon me , and I am not .
translation.kha: Me ïohi ïa nga mynta , hynrei mem ïohi shuh lada me peit ïa nga , nga la jah noh !

translation.en: And the king said to Doeg , Turn thou , and fall upon the priests . And Doeg the Edomite turned , and he fell upon the priests , and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ïa u Doeg ,  Ma me , pynïap ïa ki !  — bad u Doeg u la pynïap ïa ki baroh . Ha kata ka sngi u la pynïap phraphew san ngut ki lyngdoh kiba bit ban phong ïa ka ephod .

translation.en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves ? or need we , as some others , epistles of commendation to you , or letters of commendation from you ?
translation.kha: Hato kane ka pynpaw kumba ngi pynsarong biang shaphang ïa lade ? Hato ka lah ban long ba , kumba long lem kiwei ki briew ruh , ngi donkam ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha phi lane na phi ?

translation.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses , at the rushing of his chariots , and at the rumbling of his wheels , the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands  ;
translation.kha: Kin ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa ki jingjam jong ki kulai , ki jingriew jong ki kali ïapom , ki jingtyllun jong ki shaka . Ki kpa kin phai pat na ka bynta la ki khun ; ki kti jong ki kin noh kyrwep .

translation.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , and companion in labour , and fellowsoldier , but your messenger , and he that ministered to my wants .
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingpyrkhat ba ka donkam ban phah sha phi ïa u para jong ngi u Epaphroditos , uba la trei bad ïaleh ha syndah jong nga bad uba la shakri kum u nonglamktien jong phi ha kaba ïarap ïa nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as her soul was in departing , ( for she died ) that she called his name Ben–oni : but his father called him Benjamin .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jan ïap , bad haba kan sa dkut mynsiem , ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benoni , hynrei u kpa jong u , u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benjamin .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  , Thou hast had pity on the gourd , for the which thou hast not laboured , neither madest it grow  ; which came up in a night , and perished in a night :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u ,  Une u jingthung u la san ha ka shi miet bad jah noh ha kaba bud ; mem shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u , bad mem shym la pynlong ïa u ban san — pynban me la sngewsih na ka bynta jong u !

translation.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land , which they shall bring unto the  Lord  , shall be thine  ; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it .
translation.kha: Baroh ki long ki jong me . Uwei pa uwei na ka ïing jong me uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam u lah ban bam ïa ki .

translation.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ki briew kiba kham rit rta , ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ! Ki kpa jong ki , ki long borabor ki bymdondor kiba ngan ym shah ïa ki ban ïarap ïa ki ksew jong nga ban ap ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: And he left the linen cloth , and fled from them naked .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u , hynrei u la phet lyngkhuit , da kaba iehnoh ïa ka jaiñ shadien jong u .

translation.en: Come now therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people  ; for they are too mighty for me : peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them , and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .
translation.kha: Ki kham bun paid ban ïa ngi ; kumta sngewbha wan bad tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga . Ïoh lehse ngin lah ban jop ïa ki bad beh noh ïa ki na kane ka ri . Nga tip ba haba phi pynbna ka jingkyrkhu , ki briew ki ïoh ka jingkyrkhu , bad haba phi pynbna ka jingtim , la buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingtim .

translation.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith , the same are the children of Abraham .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sngewthuh te , ba ki khun ki ksiew bashisha jong u Abraham ki long ki briew kiba don ka jingngeit .

translation.en: In the morning thou shalt say , Would God it were even ! and at even thou shalt say , Would God it were morning ! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear , and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .
translation.kha: Ka shadem jong phi kan kyndeh da ka jingsheptieng kat ïa kaba phi ïohi . Man ka step phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka janmiet ; man ka janmiet pat phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka step .

translation.en: He looketh upon men , and if any say , I have sinned , and perverted that which was right , and it profited me not  ;
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ong ha kaba ïohsngew paidbah ,  Nga la leh pop . Ngam shym la leh kaba dei , hynrei U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga .

translation.en: For how shall I go up to my father , and the lad be not with me ? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father .
translation.kha: Kumno keiñ nga lah ban leit phai sha i pa lada u para um don ryngkat bad nga ? Ngan ym lah shah ban ïohi kum ïa kata ka apot ba kan wan jia ha i pa .

translation.en: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath , he and his men , every man with his household , even David with his two wives , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail the Carmelitess , Nabal s wife .
translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki sah ha Gath ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . U Dabid u don ar ngut ki tnga lem bad u , ka Ahinoam na Jesreel , bad ka Abigail , ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .

translation.en: But the poor man had nothing , save one little ewe lamb , which he had bought and nourished up : and it grew up together with him , and with his children  ; it did eat of his own meat , and drank of his own cup , and lay in his bosom , and was unto him as a daughter .
translation.kha: katba uba duk pat u don tang iwei i khunlangbrot , iba u la thied . U sumar ïa i , bad i heh i san ha ïing jong u lem bad ki khun ki kti jong u . U ju bsa ïa i na ka jingbam jong u hi , bad shah ïa i ban dih na ka khuri jong u , bad u thum ïa i ha ka pneh jong u . Ita i khunlangbrot i la long kum ka khun kynthei ïa u .

translation.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you , neither shall ye diminish ought from it , that ye may keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God which I command you .
translation.kha: Wat pyntam ei ei nalor kaba nga hukum ïa phi , lane pynduna ei ei na ka . Kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda , we had much work to come by the boat :
translation.kha: Ngi la ïoh katto katne ka jakarieh lieng haba ngi la ïaid shaphang shathie jong ka dewlynnong kaba rit jong ka Kauda . Hangta da kaba eh , ngi la lah ban pynskhem ïa ka lieng rit .

translation.en: And when Jesus came to the place , he looked up , and saw him , and said unto him ,  Zacchaeus , make haste , and come down  ; for to day I must abide at thy house .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la poi ha kata ka jaka , u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong ha u Sakhaïos ,  Hiar kloi , ko Sakhaïos , namar nga dei ban sah ha ka ïing jong me ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth , there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins ,
translation.kha: Naba yn ym don shuh kano kano ka jingkñia kaba lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop lada ngi ïai leh pop hadien ba ngi la tip ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Also the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul , and never eateth with pleasure .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat kim don jingkmen satia ; ki im bad ki ïap ryngkat bad ka jingkthang ha ki dohnud .

translation.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa ki pharshi jong U Jisu bad ki la tip ba u la kren shaphang jong ki ,

translation.en: ( For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else , but either to tell , or to hear some new thing . )
translation.kha: ( Naba baroh ki traishnong jong ka Athens bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hangta ki sngewtynnat ban pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh ha kaba ïathuh bad sngap ïa kaei kaei kaba thymmai tam . )

translation.en: And when she was come to her house , she found the devil gone out , and her daughter laid upon the bed .
translation.kha: Ka la leit sha ïing bad ka la shem ïa ka khun jong ka ba ka thiah ha ka jingthiah ; u ksuid u la lah mihnoh shisha na ka .

translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread : but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don kyrhai ban bam . Ki briew kiba pynsyrwa ïa la ka por kin duk lynter .

translation.en: For they that sleep sleep in the night ; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night .
translation.kha: Ka long ha ka por miet ba ki briew ki thiah ; ka dei ha ka por miet ba ki buaid .

translation.en: For a servant when he reigneth  ; and a fool when he is filled with meat  ;
translation.kha: u mraw uba kylla long syiem , u bieit uba u ïoh ban bam ïa baroh kat kaba u kwah ,

translation.en: As righteousness tendeth to life : so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kut jingmut ban leh ïa kaba dei un im , hynrei uno uno uba ïai beh ban leh ïa kaba sniew un ïap .

translation.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven , and destroyed them all .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba u Lot u mih na Sodom , ka ding bad u kyndok ki la hap na bneng bad la pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about : all ye that bend the bow , shoot at her , spare no arrows : for she hath sinned against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko nongsiatkhnam , to ïeng ryntih na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilon bad kerkut ïa ka . To siat ïa ki khnam jong phi baroh ïa ka Babilon , namar ka la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U  Trai .

translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children : how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him ?
translation.kha: Kiba sniew kumba phi long , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Katno tam , te , ba U Kpa ba ha bneng un ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha kito kiba pan na u !

translation.en: Pack your bags .
translation.kha: Song ki tiar .

translation.en: But their laying await was known of Saul . And they watched the gates day and night to kill him .
translation.kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet ki la ap ha ki khyrdop shnong khnang ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And I beseech you , brethren , suffer the word of exhortation : for I have written a letter unto you in few words .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban shahshkor bha ïa kane ka khubor ka jingpynshlur ; naba kane ka shithi kaba nga la thoh sha phi kam da long kaba jrong eh .

translation.en: So he went with them . And when they came to Jordan , they cut down wood .
translation.kha: Ynda ki poi ha Jordan , ki la sdang ïa ka kam .

translation.en: And they did eat , and were all filled : and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang , bad ki synran ki la lum khat-ar tukri na kaei kaba la sah tam .

translation.en: For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno lada katto katne na ki kim long kiba ïaineh ? Hato kane ka mut ba U Blei un ym long uba ïaineh ?

translation.en: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban shahshkor ïa ki ktien kiba jar jar jong uno uno uba stad ban ïa ki jingpyrta jong u nongsynshar ha ka dorbar jong ki bieit .

translation.en: Two men shall be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: The voice of my beloved ! behold , he cometh leaping upon the mountains , skipping upon the hills .
translation.kha: Phim tip seh ïa ka jaka , ko kaba bhabriew tam napdeng ki kynthei ? Khie leit bad bud ïa ka kynhun langbrot ; to wad ïa ki pyntha phlang na ka bynta ki blang jong phi hajan ki ïingjaiñ jong ki nongap langbrot .

translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , as did the house of Ahab : for the daughter of Ahab was his wife : and he did evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka khun jong u Ahab , bad kumba long kiba na ka ïing u Ahab , u ruh u bud ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki syiem ka Israel . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ki hima , da kaba sdang na ka Ijipt .

translation.en: Waters flowed over mine head  ; then I said , I am cut off .
translation.kha: Ka um ka la sdang ban tyllep ïa nga , bad nga la pyrkhat ba ka jingïap ka la jan .

translation.en: And they were astonished out of measure , saying among themselves , Who then can be saved ?
translation.kha: Ha kane ki synran ki la sngewphylla haduh katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Mano keiñ uba lah ban lait im ?

translation.en: Yea , whereto might the strength of their hands profit me , in whom old age was perished ?
translation.kha: Ki la long ki briew ki bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh , kiba tlot palat ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the  Lord  his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the  Lord  put them under the soles of his feet .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba namar ki thma ba ïai khie , u Dabid , u kpa jong nga u la dei ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ri jong ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong u , um shym la lah ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u tad haduh ba u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong u baroh .

translation.en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king : and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward ?
translation.kha: Ngam don hok ïa kaba kum kane ka bainong bakhraw . Kumta ngan shu leit on lynti ïa phi tang katto katne palat ïa ka Jordan .

translation.en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber , which is beside Eloth , on the shore of the Red sea , in the land of Edom .
translation.kha: U Syiem Solomon u shna shi kynhun ki lieng ha Esiongeber , kaba hajan Elath , harud jong ka Khmut duriaw Akaba , ha ka ri Edom .

translation.en: And Moses took them from off their hands , and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering : they were consecrations for a sweet savour : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka jingbam na ki bad u thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , halor ka jingkñia ainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh jingpynkyntang . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh bam , bad ka jingiw na ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon , he , and his mother , and his servants , and his princes , and his officers : and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign .
translation.kha: bad u syiem Jehoïakhin lem bad ka kmie jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki la pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia . Ha ka snem kaba phra jong ka jingsynshar u Nebukhadnessar u la shim koidi ïa u Jehoïakhin

translation.en: Have they not sped ? have they not divided the prey  ; to every man a damsel or two  ; to Sisera a prey of divers colours , a prey of divers colours of needlework , of divers colours of needlework on both sides , meet for the necks of them that take the spoil ?
translation.kha: Ki dang ïawad ïa kiei kiei ban kurup bad ïabynta , Kawei lane ar ngut ki kynthei na ka bynta uwei uwei u shipai , ka jaiñ baremdor na ka bynta u Sisera , bad ki jaiñ ba la thain itynnat na ka bynta ka ryndang jong ka syiem .

translation.en: they will come
translation.kha: Kin Sa Wan

translation.en: Let them now that fear the  Lord  say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin ong ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing : and a wise man s heart discerneth both time and judgment .
translation.kha: Katba phi dang kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , phi don ha ka jingshngain , bad u briew uba stad u tip kumno bad lano ban leh ïa ka .

translation.en: And when Herod had sought for him , and found him not , he examined the keepers , and commanded that they should be put to death . And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea , and there abode .
translation.kha: U Herod u la ai hukum ban wad ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem ïa u . Kumta u la phah tohkit ïa ki nongap phira bad u la hukum ban pynïap ïa ki . Hadien kane , u Herod u la iehnoh ïa ka Judia bad u la pynlut katto katne por ha Kaisaria .

translation.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee : therefore I command thee this thing to day .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi ruh phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ïa kane ka hukum .

translation.en: Who shall change our vile body , that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body , according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself .
translation.kha: U ban pynkylla ïa ki met batlot jong ngi bad pynlong ïa ki kum ka met ba-dap da ka burom jong u hi , da kata ka bor da kaba u lah ban wallam ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power , resisteth the ordinance of God : and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshah ïa ka bor kaba synshar , u pyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la hukum ; bad uno uno uba leh kumta un wallam ka jingbishar pynrem halor lade hi .

translation.en: To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .
translation.kha: Kaba ñiewshiliang ka long kaba bakla . Hynrei don katto katne ki nongbishar ki ban leh bymdei ban ïoh wat tang kaba rit tam ka jingbamsap .

translation.en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day , he shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi yn ñiew uba la shah tait na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: A voice of noise from the city , a voice from the temple , a voice of the  Lord  that rendereth recompence to his enemies .
translation.kha: Ha sngap ! kata ka jingsawa kaba jam ha ka nongbah ! kata ka jingsawa ha ka Templ , ka long ka jingsawa U  Trai  uba pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u !

translation.en: And Saul was very wroth , and the saying displeased him  ; and he said , They have ascribed unto David ten thousands , and to me they have ascribed but thousands : and what can he have more but the kingdom ?
translation.kha: U Saul um sngewtynnat ïa kane , bad u bitar lep . U ong ,  Ïa u Dabid ki ai nam da ki phew hajar , hynrei ïa nga pat tang da ki hajar . Kin sa pynlong syiem ïa u hadien nangne !

translation.en: Thou wilt surely wear away , both thou , and this people that is with thee : for this thing is too heavy for thee  ; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone .
translation.kha: Phin shu ïa-pynthait ïa lade bad ruh ïa kine ki briew . Kane ka khia than eh ba phin leh tang marwei hi .

translation.en: The Chaldeans answered before the king , and said , There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king s matter : therefore there is no king , lord , nor ruler , that asked such things at any magician , or astrologer , or Chaldean .
translation.kha: Ki nongai jingmut ki la jubab ,  Ym don mano mano ha sla pyrthei kiba lah ban ïathuh ïa u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban tip . Ym don u syiem , ym don wat uba khraw tam bad uba donbor tam , uba la pynlong kum kane ka jingdawa na ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor bad ki nongleh byrtong .

translation.en: I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ba ngan hikai ïa phi katno ka khraw ka bor U Blei , bad ban batai kaei kaba U Blei Badonbor baroh u la thmu lypa .

translation.en: Wherefore come out from among them , and be ye separate , saith the Lord , and touch not the unclean thing ; and I will receive you ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Trai u ong ,  Phi dei ban iehnoh ïa ki bad pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki . Wat ïadon bynta bad kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , bad ngan pdiang ïa phi .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days , and keep the charge of the  Lord  , that ye die not : for so I am commanded .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sah ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ miet la bad sngi haduh hynñiew sngi , ban leh ïa kata kaba U  Trai  u la hukum . Lada phim leh kumta , phin ïap . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: For some of them thought , because Judas had the bag , that Jesus had said unto him , Buy those things that we have need of against the feast  ; or , that he should give something to the poor .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Judas u long uba bat ïa ka pla pisa , don na ki synran ki la pyrkhat ba U Jisu u la ong ïa u ban leit bad thied ïa kaei kaba ki donkam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam , lane ban ai ei ei ïa kiba duk .

translation.en: The first angel sounded , and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood , and they were cast upon the earth : and the third part of trees was burnt up , and all green grass was burnt up .
translation.kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la put ïa la ka turoi . U phria bad ka ding , ba la khleh lang bad ka snam , ki la hap halor ka khyndew . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka khyndew la thang duh noh , shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki dieng , bad ïa baroh ki phlang bajyrngam .

translation.en: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven , and came to the land of Judah , to Gedaliah , unto Mizpah , and gathered wine and summer fruits very much .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh na ki jaka ba la pynsakma ïa ki bad ki la wan phai pat sha Judah . Ki la wan sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah , bad hangta ki la ïalum shibun bah ka waiñ bad ki soh .

translation.en: And as Josiah turned himself , he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount , and sent , and took the bones out of the sepulchres , and burned them upon the altar , and polluted it , according to the word of the  Lord  which the man of God proclaimed , who proclaimed these words .
translation.kha: Nangta u Josaïah u peit baroh sawdong , bad ïohi katto katne ki jingtep hangta halor lum ; u sei shabar ïa ki shyieng na ki bad u thang ha ka duwan . Ha kane ka rukom u ñiewsang ïa ka duwan , u leh ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la ïathuh lypa mynshuwa eh ha ka por ka jinglehniam katba u syiem Jeroboam u dang ïeng hajan ka duwan . U syiem Josaïah u peit sawdong bad ïohi ïa ka jingtep jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïathuhlypa ïa kane .

translation.en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance : but the other holy offerings sod they in pots , and in caldrons , and in pans , and divided them speedily among all the people .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki syang ïa ki jingkñia ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka ding , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih , bad ki syrwa ïa ki jingainguh bakyntang ha ki khiew , ki khiew heh , ki khiew rit , bad kloi lan ki sam ïa ka doh ha ki briew .

translation.en: And also Maachah his mother , even her he removed from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove  ; and Asa destroyed her idol , and burnt it by the brook Kidron .
translation.kha: U weng noh ïa ka Maakah , ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan syiemsad , namar ba ka la thaw ïa ka bleithaw ba-ijli jong ka Asherah ka blei jingkharoi . U Asa u pynkyllon ïa ka bleithaw bad u thang ïa ka ha ka them jong ka wah Kidron .

translation.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom , and upright ones with him  ; thus shall he do : and he shall give him the daughter of women , corrupting her : but she shall not stand on his side , neither be for him .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Syria un pynkhreh ka jinghiarthma , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei . Nangta , khnang ban pynjot ïa ka hima jong u nongshun , un pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u bad tyrwa ha u ban shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei ka jingthmu jong u kan ym jop .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What things ?  And they said unto him , Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people :
translation.kha: Kiei kita ?  u la kylli .  Kiei kiei kiba la jia ha U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Une u briew u la long u nongïathuhlypa bad la ñiew da U Blei bad da ki briew baroh ba u long uba donbor ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u kren bad leh .

translation.en: It is naught , it is naught , saith the buyer : but when he is gone his way , then he boasteth .
translation.kha: U nongthied borabor u khñium ba ka dor ka rem eh , hynrei nangta u leit noh bad u kren sarong ba u la ïoh da kaba ïadait dor .

translation.en: They shall be turned back , they shall be greatly ashamed , that trust in graven images , that say to the molten images , Ye are our gods .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba shaniah ha ki bleithaw , kiba khot ïa ki dur ki blei jong ki , yn pynpoh bad pynjahburom .

translation.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness , and the watersprings into dry ground  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki wah ban rngad lut bad pynsangeh ïa ki umpohliew ban mih .

translation.en: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness : and the end of his talk is mischievous madness .
translation.kha: U sdang da ka jingkren bieit bad u kut ha ka jinglamwir .

translation.en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer , and of the kings that were with him , at the valley of Shaveh , which is the king s dale .
translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la wan phai na ka jingjop ïa u Khedorlaomer bad ïa kita kiwei pat ki syiem , u syiem jong ka Sodom u leit ban ïashem ïa u ha ka them Shabeh ( ïa kaba la khot ruh ka Them u Syiem ) .

translation.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for : and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hiram u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Solomon :  Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong me , bad nga kloi ban leh ïa kaei kaba me pan . Ngan pynbiang ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh .

translation.en: Behold , I come as a thief . Blessed is he that watcheth , and keepeth his garments , lest he walk naked , and they see his shame .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Nga wan kum u nongtuh ! Suk uta uba peitmat bad uba sumar ïa la ki jaiñkup , khnang ba un ym ïaid lyngkhuit kylleng bad shah pynlehrain ha khmat ki briew !

translation.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly , he shall not save of that which he desired .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jinglalot jong u ym lah ban pynhun .

translation.en: But as for us , the  Lord  is our God , and we have not forsaken him  ; and the priests , which minister unto the  Lord  , are the sons of Aaron , and the Levites wait upon their business :
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi pat ngi dang ïai shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi bad ngim shym pat iehnoh ïa u . Ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , bad ki Lebi ki ïarap lem ïa ki .

translation.en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west , from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir  ; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions  ;
translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem baroh kiba ha ka ri kaba sha sepngi jong ka Jordan , naduh Baalgad ha Them Lebanon haduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang shathie hajan Edom . U Joshua u pynïabynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki jait Israel bad u ai ïa ka ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti baneh junom .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Abraham , Wherefore did Sarah laugh , saying , Shall I of a surety bear a child , which am old ?
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ha u Abraham ,  Balei ka Sarah ka rkhie bad ong , ‘ Hato ngan dang ïoh khun shisha haba nga la tymmen ?’

translation.en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: U Ahas u shim ïa ki rupa bad ksiar na ka Templ bad na ka ïing jingkynshew ha ïingsyiem bad u phah kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongsynshar .

translation.en: Thus said the  Lord  unto me  ; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people , whereby the kings of Judah come in , and by the which they go out , and in all the gates of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , khie leit bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ha ka Khyrdop Paidbah , kaba lyngba jong ka ki syiem jong ka Judah ki rung shapoh bad mih shabar ka nongbah ; nangta leit sha baroh kiwei pat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And his servants spake yet more against the  Lord  God , and against his servant Hezekiah .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki la ong ïa kiei kiei kiba kham sniew shaphang U  Trai  U Blei bad ïa u Hesekaïah , u shakri U  Trai .

translation.en: And I took my concubine , and cut her in pieces , and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel : for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel .
translation.kha: Nga shim ïa ka met jong ka , nga ot lyngkhot ïa ka , bad nga phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei ka jait Israel . Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba bymman bad ba-ijli hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah–kadesh , in the wilderness of Zin  ; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: namar baroh ar ngut phi la leh palat ïa nga ha khmat ki Israel . Mynba phi ïadon ha ki um Meribah , hajan ka shnong Kadesh , ha ka ri khlaw Sin , phi la pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat u paidbah .

translation.en: And Enos lived ninety years , and begat Cainan :
translation.kha: Haba u Enosh u la dap khyndaiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Kenan ,

translation.en: And Samuel said , What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears , and the lowing of the oxen which I hear ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u kylli ,  Balei te , ba nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingpah ki masi bad ki langbrot ?

translation.en: But thou , O Daniel , shut up the words , and seal the book , even to the time of the end : many shall run to and fro , and knowledge shall be increased .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Bad mynta , ko Daniel to khylliap noh ïa ka kitab bad shon muhor halor jong ka haduh ka jingkut jong ka pyrthei . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba bun ki briew kin pynlehnoh-ei ïa ki jingpyrshang jong ki ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba jia .

translation.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad , Tell my lord the king , All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do : but this thing I may not do . And the messengers departed , and brought him word again .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u jubab ha ki nonglamktien jong u Benhadad ,  Ïathuh ha u syiem u kynrad jong nga , ba nga mynjur ïa ka jingdawa kaba nyngkong jong u , hynrei ngam lah ban mynjur ïa kaba ar .  Ki nonglamktien ki leit noh bad nangta ki wan biang da kawei pat ka khubor na u Benhadad ;

translation.en: And I wrote this same unto you , lest , when I came , I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice ; having confidence in you all , that my joy is the joy of you all .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw nga la thoh ïa kata ka shithi sha phi — ngam shym kwah ban wan sha phi bad ba yn pynsngewsih da kita hi ki briew kiba la dei ban pynkmen ïa nga . Naba nga sngewdei ba haba nga kmen , te ma phi baroh phi ïakmen lang .

translation.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee , neither did thy foot swell , these forty years .
translation.kha: Ha kine ki sawphew snem ki jaiñkup jong phi kim shym man rim bad ki kjat jong phi ruh kim shym at .

translation.en: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people , saying , Keep all the commandments which I command you this day .
translation.kha: Te u Moses lem bad ki nongïalam Israel , ki ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber , where they were gathered together .
translation.kha: La thang shibun ki sharak ha ka kamra ba haneng ha kaba ki la ïalang .

translation.en: And he said unto her , Give me thy son . And he took him out of her bosom , and carried him up into a loft , where he abode , and laid him upon his own bed .
translation.kha: Ai ïa u khynnah ha nga ,  u Elijah u la ong . U shim ïa uta u khynnah na ki kti jong ka , u rah ïa u shalor sha ka kamra kaba u sah , bad u pynthiah ïa u ha ka jingthiah .

translation.en: For I say unto you , I will not drink of the fruit of the vine , until the kingdom of God shall come .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba naduh mynta ngan ym dih ïa kane ka waiñ tad ynda ka Hima U Blei ka wan .

translation.en: Then said the king to the servants , Bind him hand and foot , and take him away , and cast him into outer darkness  ; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ïa ki shakri jong u , ‘ To khum ïa u bad kti bad kjat , bad bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum . Hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’

translation.en: And Laban said , Behold , I would it might be according to thy word .
translation.kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Nga mynjur . Ngin leh kumba phi ai jingmut .

translation.en: But if any man love God , the same is known of him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u briew uba ieit ïa U Blei la ithuh da u .

translation.en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty . So she turned and went to her own country , she and her servants .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jong ka ri Sheba ïa baroh kaba ka pan , nalor kiwei pat ki jingai sngewbha kat kum ka dustur ïa kiba u la lah ai ha ka na ka jingjynsur mynsiem . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .

translation.en: For it was of the  Lord  to harden their hearts , that they should come against Israel in battle , that he might destroy them utterly , and that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki ban kut jingmut ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel , ba kumta kin shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot thiaw bad ba baroh kin shah pynïap khlem ka jingisynei . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: Then said David , Ye shall not do so , my brethren , with that which the  Lord  hath given us , who hath preserved us , and delivered the company that came against us into our hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u jubab ,  Ko ki hynmen ki para jong nga , phim dei ban leh kumta ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ngi ! U la ri la da ïa ngi , bad u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor kito ki nonglute .

translation.en: And , behold , thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite of Bahurim , which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim : but he came down to meet me at Jordan , and I sware to him by the  Lord  , saying , I will not put thee to death with the sword .
translation.kha: Don ruh u Shimei , u khun jong u Gera , na ka shnong Bahurim kaba ha Benjamin . U la tim tyngeh ïa nga ha ka sngi kaba nga leit sha Mahanaim , hynrei haba u la ïakynduh ïa nga ha ka wah Jordan , nga la ai ha u ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ba ngan ym shah ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: I thank God that I baptized none of you , but Crispus and Gaius ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba ngam shym la pynbaptis ïano ïano na phi lait noh ïa u Krispos bad u Gaïos .

translation.en: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins , and Jeremiah had remained there many days  ;
translation.kha: Ïa nga la set ha ka kamra kaba shapoh khyndew bad la set slem ïa nga hangta .

translation.en: Hear , all ye people  ; hearken , O earth , and all that therein is : and let the Lord  God  be witness against you , the Lord from his holy temple .
translation.kha: To sngew ïa kane , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ; to sngap ïa kane , ko phi kiba im ha ka pyrthei ! U  Trai  Nongsynshar un sakhi pyrshah ïa phi . To shahshkor ! U kren na ka templ ba kynja bneng .

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Amen .
translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu Khrist kan long lem bad phi baroh .

translation.en: Be ye also patient  ; stablish your hearts : for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh .
translation.kha: Phi ruh phi dei ban long kiba ïaishah . To batskhem ïa ki jingkyrmen jong phi , naba ka sngi ka jingwan U Trai ka la jan .

translation.en: And the sign or the wonder come to pass , whereof he spake unto thee , saying , Let us go after other gods , which thou hast not known , and let us serve them  ;
translation.kha: khnang ban ïalam ïa phi ban mane bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba phim pat ju mane mynshuwa . Wat la kata kaba u kular ka urlong shisha , wat shahshkor ïa u .

translation.en: Declaring the end from the beginning , and from ancient times the things that are not yet done , saying , My counsel shall stand , and I will do all my pleasure :
translation.kha: Naduh mynnyngkong nga la tip lypa ïa kaei ka ban mih ; la slem bah nga la ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban jia . Nga la ong ba ki jingthmu jong nga kin ym duh da lei lei , ngan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga thmu ban leh .

translation.en: Brethren , I count not myself to have apprehended : but this one thing I do , forgetting those things which are behind , and reaching forth unto those things which are before ,
translation.kha: Da shisha , ko parabangeit jong nga , nga shisha ngam pyrkhat ba nga la jop lypa ïa ka ; ïa kane kawei nga leh , la kumno kumno , da kaba klet noh ïa kaei kaei kaba shadien jong nga bad nga ïaleh shitom ban poi sha kaei kaba sha khmat .

translation.en: Glory and honour are in his presence  ; strength and gladness are in his place .
translation.kha: Ka burom bad ka jinglong syiem ki ker sawdong ïa u , ka bor bad ka jingkmen ki dap ïa ka Templ jong u .

translation.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial ? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel ?
translation.kha: Kumno U Khrist bad u Ksuid kin ïahap jingmut ? Kumno uba ngeit u don bynta bad u bymngeit ?

translation.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka la kren na u lyoh ,  Une u long U Khun jong nga , uba nga la jied — shahshkor ïa u !

translation.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in , whether it be a woollen garment , or a linen garment  ;
translation.kha: Lada don ka jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup la ka jaiñ  saiwul ne ka jaiñ linen ,

translation.en: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak : Peradventure there shall thirty be found there . And he said , I will not do it , if I find thirty there .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  A Trai , wat bitar ba ngan kren biang . Kumno lada don tang laiphew ngut ?  U ong ,  Ngan ym leh ei ei ïa ka lada nga shem laiphew ngut hangta .

translation.en: God having provided some better thing for us , that they without us should not be made perfect .
translation.kha: Namar ba U Blei u la pynkhreh lypa ïa kaei kaei kaba kham bha na ka bynta jong ngi . Ka jingthmu jong u ka la long ba tang ha ka jingïadon ryngkat bad ngi ba yn pynjanai ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore the princes said unto the king , We beseech thee , let this man be put to death : for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city , and the hands of all the people , in speaking such words unto them : for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people , but the hurt .
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah synshar ki la leit sha u syiem bad ki ong ,  Ïa une u briew dei ban pynïap . Da kaba u kren kumne , u pynlong ïa ki shipai ha ka nongbah ban duh noh ïa ka jingshlur , bad u leh kumjuh ïa uwei pa uwei baroh ba dang sah ha ka nongbah .
