Um shym pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ki paidbah ; u kwah tang ban pynmong ïa ki .

translation.en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar : and he said , Smite the lintel of the door , that the posts may shake : and cut them in the head , all of them  ; and I will slay the last of them with the sword : he that fleeth of them shall not flee away , and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u ïeng harud ka duwan . U la ai ka hukum :  Tied tyngeh ïa ki khlieh rishot jong ka Templ haduh ba ka shyngkub baroh kawei kan da khih . Pynpait ïa ki bad ai ba kin hap halor ki khlieh jong ki briew . Ngan pynïap ha ka thma ïa ki briew kiba dang sah . Yn ym don u ban ïohphet ; wat uwei ruh un ym lait im .

translation.en: I beseech Euodias , and beseech Syntyche , that they be of the same mind in the Lord .
translation.kha: Nga sngewbha ban kyrpad ïa ka Ïuodia bad ka Suntukhi , ban pyrshang ban ïamynjur kum shi para ha U Trai .

translation.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham , Cast out this bondwoman and her son : for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son , even with Isaac .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka la ïohi ïa ki , bad ka ong ha u Abraham ,  Beh noh ïa kane ka mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka . U khun jong kane ka briew um dei ban ïoh bynta ei ei ïa ka spah ka phew jong me , kaba u khun jong nga , u Isaak u dei ban ïohpateng .

translation.en: But when Moses went in before the  Lord  to speak with him , he took the veil off , until he came out . And he came out , and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Moses u leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ban ïakren bad U  Trai  , u weng noh ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat . Ynda u mih biang shabar u ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kata baroh ïa kaba la hukum ïa u ban kren ,

translation.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you , and thou shalt love him as thyself  ; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ki kumba phi leh ïa la u para Israel , bad ieit ïa ki kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Kynmaw ba phi ruh shisien phi la long ki nongwei ha ri Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And they set in it four rows of stones : the first row was a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this was the first row .
translation.kha: Ki buh saw kyrdon ki mawkordor ha ka ; ïa u Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong ;

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Consider ye , and call for the mourning women , that they may come  ; and send for cunning women , that they may come :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ,  To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba jia ! Khot ïa ki nongïambriew ban wan , ïa ki kynthei kiba rwai ki jingrwai ïapbriew .

translation.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea , tossed with waves : for the wind was contrary .
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , U Jisu u la don hangta marwei ; bad hamar kane ka por ka lieng ka la don jngai ha ka duriaw , ba la kynting shane shatai da ki jingat phyllung , namar ba ka lyer ka la beh pyrshah ïa ka .

translation.en: I have seen thine adulteries , and thy neighings , the lewdness of thy whoredom , and thine abominations on the hills in the fields . Woe unto thee , O Jerusalem ! wilt thou not be made clean ? when shall it once be ?
translation.kha: U la ïohi ba pha leh ïa kiei kiei kiba u isih . U la ïohi ba pha bud ïa ki blei thala halor ki lum bad ki lyngkha , kum u briew uba threw jakhlia ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong u lane kum u kulai ïa ka kulai . Ko ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , phi long kiba la tim ! Lano phin ïoh long kiba khuid ?

translation.en: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw , even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city : and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar  ; and I fell upon my face .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw ka la long kum kaba nga la ïohi mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kum kaba nga la ïohi harud ka wah Khebar . Nangta nga la dem pyllup ïa lade ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Pynban , phi dei ban leit sha ki langbrot kiba la jah noh jong ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And when he thus had spoken , he cried with a loud voice ,  Lazarus , come forth .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la lah ong ïa kane , u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,  Ko Lasaros , to mihnoh !

translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto her , The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee , and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee : therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God .
translation.kha: U angel u la jubab ,  U Mynsiem Bakhuid un sa wan ha pha , bad ka bor jong U Blei kan shong halor jong pha . Na kane ka daw , ïa i khunlung bakhuid yn khot U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba , and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia ha Geba , bad ki Philistia baroh ki ïohsngew shaphang kata . Nangta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban khot ïa ki Hebru sha ka thma da kaba put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: The coming judgment of false religion is good news .
translation.kha: Ka khubor babha ka long ruh ba ka jingbishar ïa ki niam kiba hikai bakla kan sa wan shen .

translation.en: Wilt thou judge them , son of man , wilt thou judge them ? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers :
translation.kha: Hato me la kloi ban ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong ki , ko khun u briew ? Te to leh kumta . Pynkynmaw ïa ki shaphang kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki kpa jong ki , ki la leh .

translation.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him  ; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness .
translation.kha: To hikai ïa ngi aïu ngin ong ha U Blei ; ki jingmut jong ngi ki thylli ; ngim don ei ei ban ong .

translation.en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman , that is a bondmaid , betrothed to an husband , and not at all redeemed , nor freedom given her  ; she shall be scourged  ; they shall not be put to death , because she was not free .
translation.kha: Lada kano kano ka mraw ka long ka tnga kliar ba la ithuh jong u briew bad ym pat shym la siew dep ïa ka dor jong ka bad pyllaitluid , te lada uno uno u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka , yn pynshitom ïa ki , hynrei ym dei ban pynïap namar ka dei ka mraw .

translation.en: Remember them that are in bonds , as bound with them  ; and them which suffer adversity , as being yourselves also in the body .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kito kiba don ha ïingbyndi , la kumba phi don lang bad ki ha ïingbyndi . Kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom , la kumba phi ruh phi shahshitom kum ma ki .

translation.en: If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband , then they shall both of them die , both the man that lay with the woman , and the woman : so shalt thou put away evil from Israel .
translation.kha: Lada lap ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shah pynïap , bad kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel .

translation.en: Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .
translation.kha: To shahshkor! Nga , u Paul , nga ïathuh ha phi ba lada phi shah ban otsher ïa lade , ka mut ba U Khrist un ym myntoi da lei lei ïa phi .

translation.en: And Moses besought the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people , which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power , and with a mighty hand ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u la ïasaid bad U  Trai  U Blei jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ko  Trai  , balei ba men bitar haduh katne ïa la ki jong ki briew , kiba me la pyllait na ka ri Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw bad da ka bor ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel ,

translation.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kumta u Jehu u la pynduh pyndam ïa ka jingmane ïa u Baal ha Israel .

translation.en: And they asked them , saying , Is this your son , who ye say was born blind ? how then doth he now see ?
translation.kha: Hato une u dei u khun jong phi ? Phi ong ba la kha matlah ïa u ; te kumno pat mynta u la imat ?

translation.en: And let that man be as the cities which the  Lord  overthrew , and repented not : and let him hear the cry in the morning , and the shouting at noontide  ;
translation.kha: Ai ba un long kum kito ki nongbah kiba U  Trai  u la pynjot khlem jingisynei . Ai un ïohsngew ïa ka jingud pang ha ka por mynstep bad ka jingmaham thma ha ka por shiteng sngi ,

translation.en: And seek not ye what ye shall eat , or what ye shall drink , neither be ye of doubtful mind .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh wat sngewdiaw , da kaba pyrkhat ïa kaei phin bam bad dih .

translation.en: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the  Lord  , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek , therefore hath the  Lord  done this thing unto thee this day .
translation.kha: Namar ba mem shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad mem shym la pynjot thiaw ïa ki Amalek bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don . Na kata ka daw U  Trai  u la leh kumne ïa me mynta .

translation.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye , neither desire thou his dainty meats :
translation.kha: Wat ïabam ha ka miej u briew uba khapnap lane uba kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh .

translation.en: Now when all the princes , and all the people , which had entered into the covenant , heard that every one should let his manservant , and every one his maidservant , go free , that none should serve themselves of them any more , then they obeyed , and let them go .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki mraw bad ban ym pynlong mraw shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: Behold , I will bring again the shadow of the degrees , which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz , ten degrees backward . So the sun returned ten degrees , by which degrees it was gone down .
translation.kha: Ha ka lynti mawkyrdon ba la tei da u syiem Ahas , U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien .  Bad ka syrngiew ka kynriah shiphew jam shadien .

translation.en: The word “devil” means someone who tells wicked lies about another person .
translation.kha: Ka Ktien “ksuid” kamut uno uno uba kren lamler shaphang kiwei pat .

translation.en: And , behold , all the men of Israel came to the king , and said unto the king , Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away , and have brought the king , and his household , and all David s men with him , over Jordan ?
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki Israel ki la leit sha u syiem bad ki ong ha u ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong ngi , ki rangbah ka Judah , ki pyrkhat ba ki don ka hok ban rah noh ïa phi bad synran ïa phi , ïa ka longïing jong phi , bad ïa ki rangbah jong phi sha shiliang ka Jordan ?

translation.en: And many people shall go and say , Come ye , and let us go up to the mountain of the  Lord  , to the house of the God of Jacob  ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for out of Zion shall go forth the law , and the word of the  Lord  from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: bad ki briew jong ki , kin ong ,  Ïa ngin kiew ïa u lum jong U  Trai  , sha ka Templ jong U Blei ka Israel . Un hikai ïa ngi kaei kaba u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ; ngin ïaid ha ki lynti kiba u la jied . Naba ka jinghikai jong U  Trai  ka wan na Jerusalem ; na Seïon u kren ha ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land , which I sware to give unto your fathers ,
translation.kha: ‘ Na kane ka pateng bymman , yn ym don uwei ruh u ban ïoh leit rung ha kata ka ri kaba seisoh ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,

translation.en: When all Israel is come to appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose , thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka ha ki paid Israel haba ki wan ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ha kata ka jaka mane Blei .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that David wrote a letter to Joab , and sent it by the hand of Uriah .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Dabid u thoh shithi sha u Joab bad u phah rah ïa ka ha u Uriah .

translation.en: The  Lord  openeth the eyes of the blind : the  Lord  raiseth them that are bowed down : the  Lord  loveth the righteous :
translation.kha: bad u pynpeit pat ïa kiba matlah . U khyllie ïa kito kiba la kyllon noh ; u ieit ïa ki briew kiba hok jong u .

translation.en: For Moses had said , Consecrate yourselves to day to the  Lord  , even every man upon his son , and upon his brother  ; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki Lebi ,  Mynta ka sngi phi la pynkyntang ïa lade kum ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri ïa U  Trai  da kaba pynïap ïa la ki khun shynrang bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang , kumta U  Trai  u la ha phi ïa ki jingkyrkhu jong u .

translation.en: Then I testified against them , and said unto them , Why lodge ye about the wall ? if ye do so again , I will lay hands on you . From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath .
translation.kha: Nga maham ïa ki ,  Kam myntoi ban ap hangto habar ki kynroh ka nongbah na ka bynta ka step ka ban wan . Lada phi pyrshang biang ïa kane , ngan pyndonkam da ka bor pyrshah ïa phi .  Naduh kata , kim ju wan shuh ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Namar kane , u Moses um shym lah ban leit rung shapoh kata ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates , and cut it into wires , to work it in the blue , and in the purple , and in the scarlet , and in the fine linen , with cunning work .
translation.kha: Ki shoh stang kum ki jingsiang ïa ka ksiar bad ki ot ïa ka ksiar kum ki ksai ïa ka ban suh ha kata ka jaiñ linen kaba ni , bad ha u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .

translation.en: He hath holpen his servant Israel , in remembrance of his mercy  ;
translation.kha: U la bat ïa ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad u la wan ban ïarap ïa u shakri jong u , u Israel .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head , and put the holy crown upon the mitre .
translation.kha: Pynphong ïa ka jaiñspong ha ka khlieh jong u bad teh halor jong ka ïa ka dak bakyntang jong ka jingpynkyntang ba la thoh ‘ La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .’

translation.en: Whether you have the New World Translation in your language or not , we encourage you to get into a good routine of reading Jehovah’s Word every day . —Joshua 1 :8  ; Psalm 1 :2 , 3 .
translation.kha: La phi don ne phim don ïa ka Jingpynkyllaktien Pyrthei Bathymmai ha ka ktien jong phi , ngi pynshlur ïa phi ban pule ïa ka ktien jong U Jehobah man la ka sngi . —Joshua 1 :8 ; Salm 1 :2 , 3 .

translation.en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him , even unto Artaxerxes the king  ; Thy servants the men on this side the river , and at such a time .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingthoh ha ka shithi :  Ha u patsha Artakserksis , na ki shakri jong , ki rangbah ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .

translation.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land , died by the plague before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la shoh ïa ki da ka jingpang , bad ki la ïap .

translation.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof , that it may yield unto you the increase thereof : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba san phi lah ban bam ïa u soh . Lada phi leh ïa kane baroh , ki diengsoh jong phi kin seisoh kham bun . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding  ; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: U briew uba shemphang u thew ban leh ïa ka kam bastad , hynrei uba bieit u sdang shisien sdang na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it , he said unto them ,  Doth this offend you ?
translation.kha: Khlem da don ba ïathuh , U Jisu u la tip ba ki ïakhñium shaphang kane , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Hato kane ka pynlong ïa phi ba phin kwah iehnoh ?

translation.en: And he came thither unto a cave , and lodged there  ; and , behold , the word of the  Lord  came to him , and he said unto him , What doest thou here , Elijah ?
translation.kha: Hangta u la rung shapoh krem bad sahmiet hangta . Kynsan kynsan U  Trai  u kren ha u ,  Elijah me leh aïu hangne ?

translation.en: And said , Remember now , O  Lord  , I beseech thee , how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , ba nga la shakri hok bad ïaineh ha me , bad ba nga la pyrshang borabor ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh ,  bad u sdang ban ïamkthang .

translation.en: And David said to Saul , Let no man s heart fail because of him  ; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Saul ,  Syiem Kynrad , mano mano ruh kim dei ban tieng ïa une u Philistia ! Ngan leit ban ïaleh ïa u .

translation.en: Now Jacob s well was there . Jesus therefore , being wearied with his journey , sat thus on the well : and it was about the sixth hour .
translation.kha: Ka pukri u Jakob ka la don hangta , bad U Jisu , uba la thait na kata ka jingleit , u la shongthait harud kata ka pukri . Ka long kumba shiteng sngi .

translation.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves  ; and they said , The  Lord  is righteous .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki nongïalam ki phla ba ki la leh pop , bad ki ong ,  Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long kaba shongnia .

translation.en: Woe to them that devise iniquity , and work evil upon their beds ! when the morning is light , they practise it , because it is in the power of their hand .
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewtriem kan long ïa kito kiba peitmat bad thmu ïa kaba sniew ! Haba poi ka step , mar ïa-ïoh ïa ka kabu , ki leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ki la thmu .

translation.en: But it was so , that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house .
translation.kha: Hynrei kat haduh ka snem kaba arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u Joash ki lyngdoh kim pat shym la shna pynbha ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them  ; and they declare their sin as Sodom , they hide it not . Woe unto their soul ! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingnoh shiliang jong ki yn bat pyrshah ïa ki . Ki leh pop khlem rieh kumba ki briew ka Sodom ki la leh . Ki long kiba la tim , bad ki la wallam ïa ka halor jong ki hi .

translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) However , others also need to hear the good news so that they too can be saved .
translation.kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hynrei , kiwei ruh ki donkam ban ïohsngew ïa ka khubor babha , khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ïoh lait im .

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , prophesy unto the mountains of Israel , and say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko khun u briew , to kren ha ki lumbah ki Israel bad ong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga don na ka bynta jong ki :

translation.en: And the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the flanks , and the caul that is above the liver , with the kidneys , it shall he take away :
translation.kha: ki khyllai bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud .

translation.en: And he said , Do it the second time . And they did it the second time . And he said , Do it the third time . And they did it the third time .
translation.kha: Ki la leh kumta , bad u ong ,  Leh biang kumta  — bad ki la leh biang kumta . U la ong ,  Leh biang sa shisien ,  bad ki la leh kumta .

translation.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon the garments of his sons with him : and he shall be hallowed , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
translation.kha: Shim khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha kata ka duwan bad khyndiat ka umphniang pynsleh , bad synreit ha u Aaron bad ha ki jaiñkup jong u , bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ma ki bad ki jaiñkup jong ki kin long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha nga .

translation.en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing , and I have heard the voice of thy words , saying ,
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba nga ïohsngew ïa kaba phi la ong :

translation.en: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece , over against the great tower that lieth out , even unto the wall of Ophel .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka bynta kaba ar jong ki , naduh ka bynta kaba marpyrshah ïa ka jaka ap phira ka Templ kaba heh haduh ka kynroh hajan ka Ophel .

translation.en: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day , wherewith they have forsaken me , and served other gods , so do they also unto thee .
translation.kha: Naduh ba nga la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt , ki la phai noh na nga bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; bad mynta ki leh ïa me kumba ki la ju leh ïa nga .

translation.en: Son of man , prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy , and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka Israel kiba shu thaw hi ïa la ki jong ki jingïathuhlypa . Ïathuh ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien ka jong U  Trai .

translation.en: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria . )
translation.kha: Haba kane ka jingkheiñbriew kaba nyngkong ka la jia , u Kyrinios u long u lyngskor jong ka Syria .

translation.en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for his name alone is excellent  ; his glory is above the earth and heaven .
translation.kha: Ai ba ma ki baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! Ka kyrteng jong u ka kham khraw ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ; ka burom jong u ka long halor ka pyrthei bad ka bneng .

translation.en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the  Lord  in Jerusalem , but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren .
translation.kha: Ïa kito ki lyngdoh ym shym la shah ban shakri ha ka Templ , hynrei ki lah ban bam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat ba la ju ai ïa ki para lyngdoh jong ki .

translation.en: And said unto him , Behold , thou art old , and thy sons walk not in thy ways : now make us a king to judge us like all the nations .
translation.kha: bad ki ong ha u ,  Peit , phi te mynta phi la tymmen , bad ki khun jong phi kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi . Kumta , thung noh da u syiem ban synshar halor jong ngi , ba kumta ngin don noh la u Syiem kumba kiwei pat ki ri ki don .

translation.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank , that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury ?
translation.kha: Kumta , te , balei mem buh ïa ka pisa jong nga ha ka jaka kynshew pisa ? Nangta te ngan jin da la ïohpdiang pat ïa ka lem bad ka sut haba nga la wan phai .’

translation.en: And he smote Moab , and measured them with a line , casting them down to the ground  ; even with two lines measured he to put to death , and with one full line to keep alive . And so the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .
translation.kha: Nangta u jop ïa ki Moab . U la phah thiah ïa ki koidi ha madan bad pynïap ar ngut na man ki lai ngut . Kumta ki Moab ki kylla long noh ki raïot jong u , bad ki siew khajna sha u .

translation.en: Be not wroth very sore , O  Lord  , neither remember iniquity for ever : behold , see , we beseech thee , we are all thy people .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa ngi , kumta wat bitar eh ïa ngi , lane bat ïa ki pop jong ngi pyrshah ïa ngi junom . Ngi long ki briew jong me ; to isynei ïa ngi .

translation.en: And blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair ,
translation.kha: ka jaiñ linen kaba ni , u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; ka jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang ;

translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will help thee .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ïa u ,  Lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga , bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: But as for you , ye thought evil against me  ; but God meant it unto good , to bring to pass , as it is this day , to save much people alive .
translation.kha: Phi shisha phi la thmu sniew ïa nga , hynrei U Blei u la pynphai ïa kata sha kaba bha , khnang ba bun ki briew kiba dang im mynta kin ïoh im namar kaba la jia .

translation.en: And now , behold , we are in thine hand : as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us , do .
translation.kha: Mynta ngi don hapoh ka bor jong phi , leh ha ngi ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: Whom should I contact ?
translation.kha: Haei nga hap ban pyntip ?

translation.en: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath , and Jehozabad the son of Shomer , his servants , smote him , and he died  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem Joash ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ar ngut na kine , u Josakar u khun jong u Shimeath bad u Jehosabad u khun jong u Shomer , ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïing kaba u la tei halor ka jaka ba la pyndap khyndew kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem , ha ka lynti kaba hiar sha Silla . Ïa u Joash la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Amasaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: For Jacob my servant s sake , and Israel mine elect , I have even called thee by thy name : I have surnamed thee , though thou hast not known me .
translation.kha: Nga la thung ïa me ban ïarap ïa u shakri jong nga u Israel , ki briew kiba nga la jied . Nga la ai ha me ka burom bakhraw , wat la mem shym la ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  answered me , and said , Write the vision , and make it plain upon tables , that he may run that readeth it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka jubab :  To thoh shai ha ki lyngkniap dewbyrtha ïa kaei ba ngan pynpaw ha me , khnang ban lah ban pule mar syn peit .

translation.en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification , and exhortation , and comfort .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kren ha ki briew bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingïarap , ka jingpynshlur , bad ka jingpyntngen .

translation.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them  ; and the  Lord  delivered them into his hands .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jephthah u jam sha shiliang wah ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai ha u ka jingjop .

translation.en: Philip answered him , Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may take a little .
translation.kha: U Philip u la jubab ,  Lada uwei uwei un ïoh tang mar khyndiat , kan donkam palat ïa ka arspah tylli ki sbai rupa ban thied kpu kat ban biang .

translation.en: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction : but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured .
translation.kha: Kino kino ki bym kwah ban shah hikai kin ïailong kiba kyrduh . Hynrei uno uno uba sngap ïa ka jingpynbeit u long ba la ñiewkor .

translation.en: And he hardened Pharaoh s heart , that he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh , pynban , u la ïai mutlop bad kumba U  Trai  u la ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: Then said the Lord to him , Put off thy shoes from thy feet : for the place where thou standest is holy ground .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u , ‘ Loit noh ïa ki juti , naba ka jaka ha kaba me ïeng ka long ka khyndew kaba khuid .

translation.en: My God hath sent his angel , and hath shut the lions  mouths , that they have not hurt me : forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me  ; and also before thee , O king , have I done no hurt .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing khnang ba kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga . U la leh ïa kane namar u tip ba nga la long uba lui lui bad namar ba ngam shym la leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad .

translation.en: For if the dead rise not , then is not Christ raised :
translation.kha: Naba lada ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , te ïa U Khrist ruh ym shym la pynmihpat .

translation.en: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you , as a father doth his children ,
translation.kha: Kumba phi tip kumno ba ngi ioh jingkyrmen bad jingaimynsiem bad jingsiew ïa baroh na phi , kumba u kpa u leh ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ , that his soul was not left in hell , neither his flesh did see corruption .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Blei un leh ha ka lawei , bad kumta u la kren shaphang ka jingmihpat jong U Messaïah haba u ong ,   ‘ Ym shym la iehnoh ïa u ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; ka met jong u kam shym la pyut hapoh ka jingtep .’

translation.en: But they rebelled against me , and would not hearken unto me : they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes , neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt : then I said , I will pour out my fury upon them , to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad ki la kyntait ban shahshkor . Kim shym la bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong ki lane iehnoh ïa ki blei jong ki nong Ijipt . Nga la kloi ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha Ijipt .

translation.en: They shall not dwell in thy land , lest they make thee sin against me : for if thou serve their gods , it will surely be a snare unto thee .
translation.kha: Wat shah ba kita ki briew kin shong kin sah ha ka ri jong phi ; lada phi leh kumta , kin pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga . Lada phi mane ïa ki blei jong ki , kan long ka jingriam ka ban pynïap duh ïa phi .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki Israel ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam ki Ïingtrep ka sdang na ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew , bad ka neh hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: If the men of my tabernacle said not , Oh that we had of his flesh ! we cannot be satisfied .
translation.kha: Baroh kito kiba trei bad nga ki tip ba nga la ju pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongwei .

translation.en: And I gave thee thy master s house , and thy master s wives into thy bosom , and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah  ; and if that had been too little , I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha me ïa ka hima jong u bad ïa ki tnga jong u ; nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem halor ki Israel bad ki Judah . Lada kane kam pat biang , ngan jin da la ai shuh sa ar shah ïa me .

translation.en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants  ; behold , his bedstead was a bedstead of iron  ; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon ? nine cubits was the length thereof , and four cubits the breadth of it , after the cubit of a man .
translation.kha: ( U Og u long u syiem uba khatduh na ki Rephaim . Ka jingthiah jong u , kaba la shna da u nar , ka long saw mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka pyngkiang , kat kum ka jingthew ba dei rukom . Dang lah ban ïohi ïa ka ha ka nongbah Rabbah jong ki Ammon . )

translation.en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment , for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment , and the rent is made worse .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim da ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba thymmai , naba kata ka syrdep bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynlong ka thliew kaba kham heh ha ka jaiñkup .

translation.en: And he hath cast the lot for them , and his hand hath divided it unto them by line : they shall possess it for ever , from generation to generation shall they dwell therein .
translation.kha: U dei U  Trai  u ban ïasam ïa ka ri hapdeng jong ki bad ai hapdeng jong ki ban ïa-ïoh bynta lang . Kin ïa-im ha ka ri na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad kan long ka jong ki junom .

translation.en: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day , because that he wholly followed the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka Hebron ka dang dei ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kaleb , u khun jong u Jephunneh u nong Kenis , namar ba u la kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: I said , I will answer also my part , I also will shew mine opinion .
translation.kha: Em , ngan ai ïa ka jubab jong nga hi mynta bad ngan ïathuh ïa phi kaei kaba nga pyrkhat .

translation.en: And they brought up the ark of the  Lord  , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle , even those did the priests and the Levites bring up .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh ruh ki pynkynriah noh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ki tiar ki tar baroh jong ka sha ka Templ .

translation.en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab . And there was a sore famine in Samaria .
translation.kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit . Ka  nemsniew ha Samaria ka la don ha ka por kaba jur bha ,

translation.en: To cause it to rain on the earth , where no man is  ; on the wilderness , wherein there is no man  ;
translation.kha: Mano ba pynhap ïa u slap ha ka jaka bym don bashong basah ?

translation.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him , and he heareth the cry of the afflicted .
translation.kha: Ki pynbor ïa kiba duk ban kyrpad jam sha U Blei , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingpyrta jong ki ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , What deed is this that ye have done ? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine ?
translation.kha: Ki la dem ngon ha khmat jong u , bad u Joseph u ong ,  Kaei kane kaba phi la leh ? Phim tip ba u briew uba ha ka kyrdan jong nga u lah ban lap ïa phi da ka kheiñ ka bishar ?

translation.en: And said , I pray you , brethren , do not so wickedly .
translation.kha: U ong ïa ki ,  Paralok , nga kyrpad ïa phi , wat leh ïa kaba kum kane ka kam kaba sniew !

translation.en: The world cannot hate you  ; but me it hateth , because I testify of it , that the works thereof are evil .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kam lah ban shun ïa phi , hynrei ka shun ïa nga , namar ba nga ïai-ong ba ki lynti jong ka ki long kiba sniew .

translation.en: Behold , we count them happy which endure . Ye have heard of the patience of Job , and have seen the end of the Lord  ; that the Lord is very pitiful , and of tender mercy .
translation.kha: Ngi khot ïa ki kiba suk namar ki la long kiba ïaishah . Phi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaishah u Job , bad phi tip kumno U Trai u la pyndap ïa u ha kaba kut . Naba U Trai u long uba dap da ka jinglehisynei bad jinglehsbun .

translation.en: I verily thought with myself , that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth .
translation.kha: Nga hi nga la pyrkhat ba nga dei ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga lah pyrshah ïa ka jingthmu U Jisu uba na Nasareth .

translation.en: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem , and turned his name to Jehoiakim . And Neco took Jehoahaz his brother , and carried him to Egypt .
translation.kha: U Neko u pynlong ïa u Eliakim u para jong u Joahas kum u syiem ka Judah bad u pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoïakim . Ïa u Joahas la ïalam sha Ijipt da u Neko .

translation.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki nongleh kam runar uba la sdien hangta u la krenbeiñ ïa u :  Hato mem long U Messaïah ? To pynim ïa lade bad ïa ngi !

translation.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him , Beth–el .
translation.kha: U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Bethel .

translation.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee , O inhabitant of Mareshah : he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Mareshah , U  Trai  un aiti noh ïa phi ha u nongshun , u ban kurup ïa ka shnong jong phi . Ki nongïalam ka Israel kin leit bad rieh ha ka krem ha Adullam .

translation.en: And the children of Israel arose , and went up to the house of God , and asked counsel of God , and said , Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin ? And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up first .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki leit sha ka jaka mane ha Bethel , bad hangta ki kylli na U Blei ,  Ka jait jongno ka ban leit ïaleh nyngkong ïa ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ka jait Judah .

translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  raised up judges , which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ki nongïalam kiba la pyllait im ïa ki na ki nonglute .

translation.en: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah :
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa ka longïing jong u Ahab kumba nga leh ïa ka longïing jong u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel bad jong u Baasha u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold , because he did this thing , and because he had no pity .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingleh ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh barunar , u dei ban buria saw shah ïa kaba u la shim .

translation.en: Thou shalt not consent unto him , nor hearken unto him  ; neither shall thine eye pity him , neither shalt thou spare , neither shalt thou conceal him :
translation.kha: Hynrei wat shah ïa u ban pynkohnguh ïa phi ; wat shahshkor ruh ïa u . Wat isynei ïa u lane wat sngewsynei ïa ki , bad wat ïada ïa ki .

translation.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears : for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men .
translation.kha: Wat klet ïa kaei kaba ngan ïathuh ha phi ! Yn sa aiti noh ïa U Khun U Briew ha ka bor jong ki briew .

translation.en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself , and in all the cities thereof together , husbandmen , and they that go forth with flocks .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin shong kin sah ha Judah bad ha baroh ki shnong jong ka , bad kin don ki nongrep , bad ki nongap langbrot ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .

translation.en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases , and removed the laver from off them  ; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it , and put it upon a pavement of stones .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahas u shim kyrpang ïa ki kali rnong ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ bad weng noh ïa ki khiew kiba don halor jong ki ; u shim ïa ka pipa rnong na ki bynta ba shadien jong ki khat-ar tylli ki masi dab rnong , bad u buh ha u maw nongrim .

translation.en: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment , and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him , he shall be put to death : only be strong and of a good courage .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba artatien ïa ka iktiar jong me lane u bymkohnguh ïa kano kano na ki hukum jong me un shah pynïap . To long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem .

translation.en: The heaven for height , and the earth for depth , and the heart of kings is unsearchable .
translation.kha: Phim ju tip kaei u syiem u pyrkhat ; ki jingmut jong u ki long sha lyndet ka jingtip jong ngi , kumba jrong ka sahit bneng ne kumba jylliew ka duriaw-bah .

translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  Nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom :
translation.kha: U la ïai bteng ban ong ,  Ki ri kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat ; ki hima kin tur ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat .

translation.en: There shall the great owl make her nest , and lay , and hatch , and gather under her shadow : there shall the vultures also be gathered , every one with her mate .
translation.kha: Ki dkhoh kin thaw ïa ki skum jong ki , kin kha pylleng bad pynmih ki khun , bad sumar ïa ki hangta . Ki pukni kin ïalum hangta , kiwei hadien kiwei pat .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall scatter you among the nations , and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen , whither the  Lord  shall lead you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , bad hangta tang khyndiat eh na phi phin lait im .

translation.en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day , saying , This is done because of that which the  Lord  did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , pynsngewthuh ha ki khun shynrang jong phi ba phi leh ïa kane baroh namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ha phi mynba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon , and from Cuthah , and from Ava , and from Hamath , and from Sepharvaim , and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel : and they possessed Samaria , and dwelt in the cities thereof .
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u wallam ïa ki briew na ki nongbah Babilon , Kuth , Ibbah , Hamath , bad Sepharbaim , bad pynshongduh ïa ki ha ki nongbah ka Samaria , ha ka jaka jong ki Israel ba la shah ringmraw . Ki shimti ha lade ïa kine ki nongbah bad ki sah hangta .

translation.en: For now we live , if ye stand fast in the Lord .
translation.kha: Namar mynta ngi im shisha , lada phi ïeng skhem ha ka ha U Trai .

translation.en: He shall not cry , nor lift up , nor cause his voice to be heard in the street .
translation.kha: Un ym pyrta lane pynjam ïa ka sur jong u lane un ym pynmih ki ktien kren bajam ha ki lynti bah .

translation.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel kiba shong basah ha ka Them Jesreel ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai ka la phet ïap , bad ba u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap , ki iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong ha ki .

translation.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years , until Samuel the prophet .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la shim por kumba sawspah sanphew snem .  Hadien kane u la ai ha ki ïa ki nongbishar haduh ka por jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil : the same is Micaiah the son of Imlah . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .
translation.kha: U Ahab u jubab ,  Don sa uwei , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u namar um ju ïathuhlypa kaba bha ïa nga ; ka ju long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew .   Phim dei ban ong kumta !  u Jehoshaphat u jubab .

translation.en: Herein is our love made perfect , that we may have boldness in the day of judgment : because as he is , so are we in this world .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingieit la pynjanai noh ha ngi , ba ngin don ka jingshlur ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ; bad ngin don ïa ka namar ka jingim jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei ka long kumjuh kum ka jong U Khrist .

translation.en: I drew them with cords of a man , with bands of love : and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws , and I laid meat unto them .
translation.kha: Nga la ring ïa ki sha nga da ka jingsngewieit bad ka jingieit . Nga la rah ïa ki bad pyndei ïa ki ha ka ngab jong nga . Nga la dem sha ki bad nga la bsa ïa ki .

translation.en: But the king covered his face , and the king cried with a loud voice , O my son Absalom , O Absalom , my son , my son !
translation.kha: U syiem u tap ïa la ka durkhmat bad u kyang jam ,  A , ko khun jong nga ! Ko khun jong nga , ko Absalom ! ko Absalom , ko khun jong nga !

translation.en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains  ; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal : yea , ye shall flee , like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah : and the  Lord  my God shall come , and all the saints with thee .
translation.kha: Phin lait phet lyngba kane ka them kaba pynkhlad arliang ïa une u lumbah . Phin phet kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh mynba u jumai u khynñiuh ha ka por jong u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah . U  Trai  U Blei jong nga un wan , un wallam ïa ki angel baroh lem bad u .

translation.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil , who are taken captive by him at his will .
translation.kha: Bad nangta kin wan sha ka jingsngewthuh bad kin lait na ka jingriam u Ksuid , uba la pynngat ïa ki bad la pynlong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong u .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that he turned aside to see , God called unto him out of the midst of the bush , and said , Moses , Moses . And he said , Here am I .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïohi ba u Moses u wan kham hajan , u khot ïa u napdeng kata ka  lawlynnong , bad u ong ,  Moses ! Moses !  U ruh u jubab ,  Oi ! Nga don hangne .

translation.en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed , his anger was kindled .
translation.kha: U Sebul , u nongsynshar jong ka nongbah , u bitar lep haba u ïohsngew aïu u Gaal u ong .

translation.en: So went the present over before him : and himself lodged that night in the company .
translation.kha: U phah ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha shuwa jong u bad u la sahmiet ha kata ka miet ha ka jaka sher dara .

translation.en: And the Jews  passover was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Ka la jan dei artat ka por na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , kumta U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Therefore will I save my flock , and they shall no more be a prey  ; and I will judge between cattle and cattle .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait im ïa la ki langbrot bad ngan ym shah ba yn lehbeiñ shuh ïa ki . Ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na ki langbrot jong nga bad pynïakhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew .

translation.en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord , let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , ko kynrad , pdiang ïa kane ka jingai sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi , bad ai ïa ka ha ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: And when it was day , the magistrates sent the serjeants , saying , Let those men go .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud ki bor synshar ka Hima Rom ki la phah ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad ka hukum ,  Pyllait noh ïa kito ki briew .

translation.en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi , the tribe of thy father , bring thou with thee , that they may be joined unto thee , and minister unto thee : but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , kiba na ka jait Lebi , ban ïatreilang bad ïarap ïa me katba me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phi dang ïashakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And saying , Where is the promise of his coming ? for since the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .
translation.kha: Kin ibeiñ ïa phi bad kin kylli ,  U la kular ban wan , hato um shym la kular kumta ? Hangno u don ? Ki kpa tymmen ki la lah ïap , hynrei kiei kiei baroh ki dang ïaisah kumjuh kum mynba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: I had just put it before you ask me to .
translation.kha: Nga dang shu buh shwa ba phin phah hi .

translation.en: And he went up unto them into the ship  ; and the wind ceased : and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure , and wondered .
translation.kha: Nangta u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki , bad ka lyer ka la long jai jai . Ki synran ki la sngewlyngngoh haduh katta katta ,

translation.en: But the goat , on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat , shall be presented alive before the  Lord  , to make an atonement with him , and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh uba hap ha u Asasel yn wallam im ha khmat U  Trai  bad nangta yn pyllait ïa u sha ka ri shyiap sha u Asasel , khnang ba un kit noh ïa ki pop u paidbah .

translation.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither  ; because all the land shall become briers and thorns .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin behmrad hangta da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam . Ho-oid , ka ri baroh kawei kan dap da ki shynraiñ bad ki bniap shiah .

translation.en: And his father Isaac said unto him , Come near now , and kiss me , my son .
translation.kha: Nangta u kpa jong u , u ong ha u ,  Ale kham hajan ko khun bad to doh ïa nga .

translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .
translation.kha: bad u Judas Iskariot , uba la shetkylla ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And I will prepare destroyers against thee , every one with his weapons : and they shall cut down thy choice cedars , and cast them into the fire .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ki baroh kin wanrah ïa la ki sdie , kin pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba itynnat bad kin bret ïa ki ha ka ding .

translation.en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus , There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom  ; and their laws are diverse from all people  ; neither keep they the king s laws : therefore it is not for the king s profit to suffer them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u ong ïa u syiem .  Ka don kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba la saphriang kylleng sawdong ka hima jong phi bad ba lah ban shem ha kawei pa kawei ka probins   . Ki bud ïa ki dustur kiba ïapher na ki jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Nalor kata kim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka hima , kumta kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban shah ïa ki .

translation.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines , and they spoiled their tents .
translation.kha: Ynda ki Israel ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , ki lute ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki .

translation.en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years : and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt ka ri ba sah kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei . Na ka bynta sawphew snem ki nongbah ka Ijipt kin sah ha ka jingjot , ki jingjot kiba kham sniew ban ïa kito ha kiwei pat ki nongbah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ki nongphetwir . Kin phet sha man ki ri bad ban im hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while they were in the way , that tidings came to David , saying , Absalom hath slain all the king s sons , and there is not one of them left .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha lynti sha ïing , la ïathuh ha u Dabid ,  U Absalom u la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh — ym don uwei ruh uba lait !

translation.en: Why are they late for the meeting ?
translation.kha: Balei ki slem ban wan sha ka jingialang ?

translation.en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus , and of the love which ye have to all the saints ,
translation.kha: Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu bad ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki briew baroh ki jong U Blei .

translation.en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah  ; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field : but Manoah her husband was not with her .
translation.kha: U Blei u leh kumba u Manoah u la kyrpad , bad u angel jong U , u wan biang sha kata ka briew katba ka dang shong ha lyngkha . U Manoah , u tnga jong ka um shym don lang bad ka ,

translation.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki leh ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba phi lah ban pynlong ïa kiba shah khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim ban leit noh khlem bam katba u nongleitkurim u dang don bad ki ? Da shisha em !

translation.en: Out of him came forth the corner , out of him the nail , out of him the battle bow , out of him every oppressor together .
translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki , kin wan ki nongsynshar , ki nongïalam , bad ki rangbah ai hukum ki ban synshar ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And yet I say unto you , That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon lem bad ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat kum uwei na kine ki syntiew .

translation.en: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty .
translation.kha: Suh ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron u hynmen jong me khnang ba un ishongkun shongkhia bad idonburom .

translation.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son , and of thy son s son , what things I have wrought in Egypt , and my signs which I have done among them  ; that ye may know how that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad ba phi lah ban ïathuh ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kumno nga la pynpaw bieit ïa ki nong Ijipt haba nga leh ïa kine ki kambah . Phi baroh phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: But I have prayed for thee , that thy faith fail not : and when thou art converted , strengthen thy brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la duwai na ka bynta jong me , ko Simon , ba ka jingngeit jong me kan ym duh noh . Bad haba me la wan phai pat sha nga , me dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa ki hynmen ki para jong me .

translation.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them , and came unto Iconium .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong ki ha ka jingpyrshah ïa ki bad ki la leit noh sha Ikoniom .

translation.en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh s house , saying , Joseph s brethren are come : and it pleased Pharaoh well , and his servants .
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka poi ha ka ïingsyiem ba ki hynmen u Joseph ki la poi , u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la sngewbha shibun eh .

translation.en: And Jesus went into the temple of God , and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la beh noh ïa baroh kito kiba ïadie bad kiba ïathied hangta . U la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ sbai bad ïa ki jaka shong jong kito kiba die paro ,

translation.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them , and he served them : and they continued a season in ward .
translation.kha: Ki la don ha byndi la kham slem , bad u kapten u la buh ïa u Joseph ban peit ïa ki .

translation.en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin , and of Abner s men , so that three hundred and threescore men died .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la pynïap laispah hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah jong u Abner kiba na ka jait Benjamin .

translation.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God , Entreat now the face of the  Lord  thy God , and pray for me , that my hand may be restored me again . And the man of God besought the  Lord  , and the king s hand was restored him again , and became as it was before .
translation.kha: U Syiem Jeroboam u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa ,  Sngewbha duwai na ka bynta jong nga ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad kyrpad ba un pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong nga !  U nongïathuhlypa u la duwai ha U  Trai  , bad la pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong u syiem .

translation.en: But what saith it ? The word is nigh thee , even in thy mouth , and in thy heart : that is , the word of faith , which we preach ;
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka ong ka long kane :  Ka khubor U Blei ka don hajan jong phi , ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi bad ha ka dohnud jong phi  — kata , ka khubor jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïalap .

translation.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods , let him not live : before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me , and take it to thee . For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi shem ïa ki blei jong phi ha uno uno hangne , uta un shah pynïap . Hangne , lem bad ki briew jong ngi kum ki sakhi , peit ïa kano kano ka tiar kaba dei ka jong phi bad shim ïa kaba dei ka jong phi .  U Jakob um shym tip ba ka Rakhel ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong u Laban .

translation.en: I was not in safety , neither had I rest , neither was I quiet  ; yet trouble came .
translation.kha: Ngam don jingsuk , jingjahthait , bad ki jingjynjar jong nga kim don jingkut .

translation.en: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa kine kiei kiei bad pyndonkam pura ïa la ka iktiar haba me ai mynsiem bad haba sneng ïa ki nongsngap jong me . Wat ai ïano ïano na ki ban ibeiñ ïa me .

translation.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me : but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes .
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar ki ïakynduh lang bad ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga , hynrei ngan pule bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .

translation.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine .
translation.kha: Ka jingthngan ka la pynlong ïa ngi ban ing da ka jingshit , tad haduh ba ka sniehdoh jong ngi ka long kaba khluit kum ka pajwa .

translation.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money , that I may eat  ; and give me water for money , that I may drink : only I will pass through on my feet  ;
translation.kha: Ngin da siewdor ïa ka jingbam ba ngi bam bad ïa ka um ba ngi dih . Kaba ngi kwah ka long tang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong phi ,

translation.en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he commanded you , and have gone and served other gods , and bowed yourselves to them  ; then shall the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you .
translation.kha: Lada phim sumar ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa phi ban sumar bad lada phi shakri bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , kumta te ha ka jingbitar jong u , un pynshitom ïa phi , bad shen ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kane ka ri babha kaba u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , saying , Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish , let him not approach to offer the bread of his God .
translation.kha: Ong ha u Aaron , ym bit ïa uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pateng uba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared to Solomon by night , and said unto him , I have heard thy prayer , and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wanpaw ha u Solomon mynmiet . U ong ha u ,  Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad nga la pdiang ïa kane ka Templ kum ka jaka ha kaba yn ai ïa ki jingkñia ha nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years , that Pharaoh dreamed : and , behold , he stood by the river .
translation.kha: Hadien ar snem kynthih , u Syiem ka ri Ijipt u la phohsniew ba u ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,

translation.en: Tell me , ye that desire to be under the law , do ye not hear the law ?
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ban kylli ïa kito na phi kiba kwah ban im hapoh ka Hukum : Hato phim ïohsngew aïu ka Hukum ka ong ?

translation.en: And he took butter , and milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them  ; and he stood by them under the tree , and they did eat .
translation.kha: U shim katto katne ka malai , ka dud , bad ka doh , bad u buh ïa kita ki jingbam ha khmat jong kita ki rangbah . Hangta ha trai u dieng u la pynbiang ïa ki da lade hi , bad ki la ïabam .

translation.en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers : Of Judah , the captains of thousands  ; Adnah the chief , and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand .
translation.kha: U Adnah u long u nongïalam shipai na ki kur ka Judah , bad u don lai lakh ngut ki shipai hapoh jong u .

translation.en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children : they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynjot kaba la wan ha ki briew jong nga ka wallam ka jingsngew shyrkhei ; ki kmie kiba ieit ki shet ïa la ki khun ban long jingbam .

translation.en: Others mocking said , These men are full of new wine .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki kren biria ïa ki riewngeit , da kaba ong ,  Kine ki briew ki la buaid !

translation.en: Wherefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God   ; Surely , because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things , and with all thine abominations , therefore will I also diminish thee  ; neither shall mine eye spare , neither will I have any pity .
translation.kha: Namarkata , namar ba nga long U Blei uba im — kane ka long ka ktien U  Trai  Nongsynshar — namar pha la pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga da kiei kiei kiba basniew , ki kam ijli kiba pha la leh , ngan kyntait ïa pha khlem isynei .

translation.en: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses  ; and there is bread and wine also for me , and for thy handmaid , and for the young man which is with thy servants : there is no want of any thing .
translation.kha: wat la ngi don la u phlang bad ki jingbam ïa ki kada jong ngi , kumjuh ruh u kpu bad ka waiñ na ka bynta ïa lade bad ïa kane ka tnga kliar jong nga bad ïa une u shakri jong nga . Ngi don lut kat kaba ngi donkam .

translation.en: And Peter answered him and said , Lord , if it be thou , bid me come unto thee on the water .
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la jubab .  Ko Trai , lada dei shisha ma me , hukum ïa nga ban wan sha me halor ka um .

translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai : U Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada Ki lyngdoh : U Sadok bad u Abiathar

translation.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness  ; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time : but they went to Baal–peor , and separated themselves unto that shame  ; and their abominations were according as they loved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba nga lap nyngkong ïa ki Israel , ka long kumba lap ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba mih ha ri shyiap . Haba nga ïohi nyngkong ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ka long kumba ïohi ïa u soh Dumbur uba ih nyngkong ha ka aïom . Hynrei haba ki la wan sha u lum Peor , ki la sdang ban mane ïa u Baal , bad tang katto katne por ki la kylla long kiba isaitmet kum kita ki blei ba ki ieit .

translation.en: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse , that there may be meat in mine house , and prove me now herewith , saith the  Lord  of hosts , if I will not open you the windows of heaven , and pour you out a blessing , that there shall not be room enough to receive it .
translation.kha: Wallam ïa ka jingmih baroh jong kawei-na-kaba-shiphew sha ka Templ , khnang ba yn don ka bam kyrhai hangta . To tynjuh ïa nga bad phin sa ïohi ba ngan plie ïa ki jingkhangïit jong ka bneng bad theh noh ha phi kyrhai ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh .

translation.en: And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee , by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Em , Kynrad , sngewbha phah noh dano dano .

translation.en: And they said unto them , The  Lord  look upon you , and judge  ; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of his servants , to put a sword in their hand to slay us .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh , bad un pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi pynlong ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ban isih ïa ngi . Phi la ai daw ïa ki ban pynïap ïa ngi .

translation.en: Nor by the earth  ; for it is his footstool : neither by Jerusalem  ; for it is the city of the great King .
translation.kha: lymne da ka khyndew , naba ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong u ; lymne da ka Jerusalem , naba ka long ka nongbah jong U Syiem uba khraw .

translation.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men s lives , but to save them .  And they went to another village .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit sha kawei pat ka nongrit .

translation.en: And he brought forth the king s son , and put the crown upon him , and gave him the testimony  ; and they made him king , and anointed him  ; and they clapped their hands , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam ïa u Joash shabar , u buh ïa ka pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ ba pynïaid ïa ka jinglong syiem . Nangta ïa u Joash la pynsleh syiem bad la pynbna kum u syiem . Ki paidbah ki thab ïa la ki kti bad ki ïarisa ,  Im slem ko syiem !

translation.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai ban ha ka sur bajam ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba me la ai .

translation.en: And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïaleit sha u bad kyrsiew ïa u .  Pyllait im ïa ngi , A Trai !  ki la ong .  Ngin sa ïap !

translation.en: Hath not the potter power over the clay , of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour , and another unto dishonour ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , u briew uba thaw ïa ki khiew u don ka hok ban pyndonkam ïa ka dewbyrtha katba u kwah , bad ban thaw ar tylli ki khiew na kawei ka lyngngun dewbyrtha , ïa uwei na ka bynta ki por bakyrpang bad ïa uwei pat na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam paidbah .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while the ark abode in Kirjath–jearim , that the time was long  ; for it was twenty years : and all the house of Israel lamented after the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka don slem bha ha Kiriath Jearim , kumba arphew snem . Ha kata ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la kyang ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph , saying , Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee :
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph ,  I pa jong phi bad ki hynmen ki para jong phi ki la wan sha phi , ka ri Ijipt ka long ka jong ki .

translation.en: All ye inhabitants of the world , and dwellers on the earth , see ye , when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains  ; and when he bloweth a trumpet , hear ye .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , phi baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei ! To ap ïa ka lama ai dak kaba yn kyntiew halor ki kliar jong ki lumbah ! To shahshkor ïa ka jingput ïa ka ronsing !

translation.en: Saying unto Aaron , Make us gods to go before us : for as for this Moses , which brought us out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ha u Aaron , ‘ To thaw ïa ngi katto katne ki blei ki ban ïalam ïa ngi . Ngim tip kaei kaba la jia ïa une u Moses , uba la wallam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that before they call , I will answer  ; and while they are yet speaking , I will hear .
translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kin dep duwai ha nga , ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius , and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la manbha ha ka por ba u Darius u synshar bad ha ka jingsynshar jong u Syros u nong Persia .

translation.en: Now while he was not yet gone back , he said , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah , and dwell with him among the people : or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go . So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go .
translation.kha: Haba ngam shym la jubab , u Nebusaradan u la ong ,  Khie leit phai pat sha u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphan , ïa uba u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong ïa u , u lat jong ki shnong ka Judah . Phi lah ban sah bad u bad im hapdeng ki briew , lane phi lah ban leit shano shano ba phi pyrkhat ba phi dei ban leit .  Kumta u la ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha bad katto katne ka jingbam ban rah bad nga , bad u la shah ïa nga ba ngan leit noh ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: And he said , Lo , it is yet high day , neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together : water ye the sheep , and go and feed them .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Haba ka sngi ka dang jlan kumne bad ka por ruh kam pat dei ban leit set ïa ki langbrot , te balei phim nang ai um ïa ki bad ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka jaka bam phlang ?

translation.en: When the end comes , who will survive ?
translation.kha: Ynda wan kaba kut , Mano ban laitim ?

translation.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof , if thou knowest ? or who hath stretched the line upon it ?
translation.kha: Mano ba la rai haduh katno kan heh ? Mano ba ring ksai halor jong ka ? Hato me tip ïa ki jubab baroh ?

translation.en: And he went up thence to Penuel , and spake unto them likewise : and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .
translation.kha: U Gideon u la leit sha Penuel bad u la kyrpad kumjuh ïa ki briew kiba hangta , hynrei ki briew jong ka Penuel ki la ai kajuh ka jubab kum ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth .

translation.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway , to cut off those of his that did escape  ; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress .
translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad ban kem ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban lait im . Pha la dei ban ym aiti ïa ki sha ki nongshun ha ka sngi jong ka jingshipa jong ki .

translation.en: They , and all that appertained to them , went down alive into the pit , and the earth closed upon them : and they perished from among the congregation .
translation.kha: Da kumta ki la hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ryngkat bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki . Ka khyndew ka tap ïa ki , bad ki la jah jar .

translation.en: For wheresoever the carcase is , there will the eagles be gathered together .
translation.kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalumlang .

translation.en: And I will scatter you among the heathen , and will draw out a sword after you : and your land shall be desolate , and your cities waste .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynsakma ïa phi kylleng kylleng ki ri nongwei . Ka ri jong phi kan sah kynjah , bad ki shnong jong phi kin sah ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle , and it shall bring him to the king of terrors .
translation.kha: La weng ïa u na ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba u la ju im ha ka jingshngain , bad la tan ïa u ban ïeng markhmat bad u Syiem ka Jingïap .

translation.en: Take him , and look well to him , and do him no harm  ; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit wad ïa u Jeremaïah bad sumar bha ïa u . Wat pynmynsaw ïa u , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u kwah .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first , that he went through the corn fields  ; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn , and did eat , rubbing them in their hands .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Ki synran jong u ki la sdang ban kheit ïa ki kop kew , ki kyrjaw ïa ki ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki bam ïa ki symboh kew .

translation.en: And the land had rest forty years . And Othniel the son of Kenaz died .
translation.kha: La don ka jingsuk ha ka ri haduh sawphew snem , bad nangta u Othniel u la ïap .

translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Who am I ? and what is my life , or my father s family in Israel , that I should be son in law to the king ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga dei uei keiñ bad kaei ka longïing jong nga ba ngan ïoh long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem ?

translation.en: Son of man , put forth a riddle , and speak a parable unto the house of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ka pharshi ha ki Israel

translation.en: And when he was come into the temple , the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching , and said , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan pat sha ka Templ ; bad katba u dang hikai , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan sha u bad ki la kylli ,  Me don hok aïu ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  shewed me four carpenters .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la pyn-i ha nga saw ngut ki nongtrei kiba don bad ki tyrnem .

translation.en: Then I went down to the potter s house , and , behold , he wrought a work on the wheels .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit hangta bad nga la ïohi ïa u nongthaw khiew ba u trei ha ka shalyntem jong u .

translation.en: When Jesus understood it , he said unto them ,  Why trouble ye the woman ? for she hath wrought a good work upon me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki ïakren , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Balei ba phi pynsalia ïa kane ka briew ? Ka long kaei kaei kaba biang bad kaba itynnat ba ka la leh na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute ye judgment and righteousness , and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor : and do no wrong , do no violence to the stranger , the fatherless , nor the widow , neither shed innocent blood in this place .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga hukum ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaba beit . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba shukor ïa u . Wat lehbeiñ ne banbeiñ ïa ki nongwei , ki khunswet , ne ki riewkynthei , bad wat pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui ha kane ka jaka kaba khuid .

translation.en: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon , and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem , according to the good hand of his God upon him .
translation.kha: Ki mih na Babilonia ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai banyngkong , bad da ka jingïarap U Blei , ki poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai uba san .

translation.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Da ka jingstad jong u , u la thaw ïa ki bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: I have pursued mine enemies , and destroyed them  ; and turned not again until I had consumed them .
translation.kha: Nga beh kthong ïa ki nongshun jong nga , bad nga jop ïa ki ; ngam shym sangeh tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel , when he shall begin to sound , the mystery of God should be finished , as he hath declared to his servants the prophets .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u angel uba hynñiew u put ïa la ka turoi , te U Blei un pyndep ïa ka jingthmu barieh jong u , kumba u la pynbna ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , uwei uwei na phi un khot sngewbha ïa la u paramarjan ban wan bad ban lehkmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingshngain , ba la ker sawdong da ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur .

translation.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones . And the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa ki , hynrei kynsan ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ba ka paw halor ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And the bullock for the sin offering , and the goat for the sin offering , whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place , shall one carry forth without the camp  ; and they shall burn in the fire their skins , and their flesh , and their dung .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u masi lyngraw bad ïa uta  langsohmoh ïa kiba la kñia kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ïa kiba ka snam jong ki la leit rah sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam ban weng noh ïa ka pop , dei ban leit rah shabar ka jaka shong dara bad thang ïa ki hangta . Ïa ka snieh , ka doh , bad ki snier jong ki ruh dei ban thang lang hangta .

translation.en: His scales are his pride , shut up together as with a close seal .
translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u la shna da ki stieh ha ki laiñ , kiba la pynïadait lang bad kiba eh kum u maw .

translation.en: And Joshua burnt Ai , and made it an heap for ever , even a desolation unto this day .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la thang ïa ka Ai bad u iehnoh ïa ka ha ka jingjot . Ka dang sah kumta mynta .

translation.en: There is no fear of God before their eyes .
translation.kha: lymne ki la ïoh jinghikai ïa ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Dan ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword .
translation.kha: U la phah pynïap ïa u Jakob , u para jong u Ïoannis , da ka waitlam .

translation.en: And Joash slept with his fathers  ; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne : and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
