translation.kha: Kan ym long kumta! U Blei un long uba shisha , wat la uwei pa uwei u briew u long uba shukor . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ba yn lah ban pyn-i ïa phi ba phi long kiba shisha haba phi kren ; phi dei ban jop ïa ka jingïaleh haba la bishar ïa phi .

translation.en: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build , who also laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
translation.kha: Ka kur Hassenaah ka tei ïa ka Khyrdop Dohkha . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ïa ka khyrdop .

translation.en: For he saith to Moses , I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy , and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion .
translation.kha: Naba u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan leh-isynei ha uno uno uba nga kwah ; ngan sngewsynei ïa uno uno uba nga kwah .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Unto what then were ye baptized ? And they said , Unto John s baptism .
translation.kha: Da kumta , te , kaba kumno ka jingpynbaptis phi la ïohpdiang ?   Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me ; but I went into Arabia , and returned again unto Damascus .
translation.kha: lane ngam shym la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa kito kiba long ki apostol shuwa jong nga . Pynban shisyndon nga la leit sha Arabia , nangta nga la wan phai pat sha Damaskos .

translation.en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day , he sent them into his vineyard .
translation.kha: U la mynjur ban siew ïa ki ka bainong sngi , shi sbai rupa shi sngi , bad u la phah ïa ki ban trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ jong u .

translation.en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus  name , and sealed it with the king s ring , and sent letters by posts on horseback , and riders on mules , camels , and young dromedaries :
translation.kha: U Mordekai u la thoh ïa ki shithi ha ka kyrteng u syiem Serksis , bad u shon ïa ki da ka muhor syiem . La leit rah da ki nongshong kulai kiba shong ha ki kulai bastet na ki sem kulai syiem .

translation.en: The disciple is not above his master , nor the servant above his lord .
translation.kha: Ym don uba shah hikai uba kham khraw ban ïa u nonghikai jong u ; ym don u mraw uba kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u .

translation.en: How should one chase a thousand , and two put ten thousand to flight , except their Rock had sold them , and the  Lord  had shut them up ?
translation.kha: Balei ba shihajar kin shahjop tang ha uwei , bad shiphew hajar pat tang ha ki ar ngut ? U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la iehnoh ïa ki , bad U Blei badonbor jong ki u la kyntait noh ïa ki ?

translation.en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters , and cast the salt in there , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have healed these waters  ; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .
translation.kha: bad u la leit sha ka umpohliew , u la bret ïa ka mluh ha ka um , bad u ong ,  Kane ka dei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Nga pynkhuid ïa kane ka um , bad kan ym pynjia shuh kano kano ka jingïap lane ki jinghap khun .’

translation.en: And they had hair as the hair of women , and their teeth were as the teeth of lions .
translation.kha: U shñiuh jong ki u long kum u shñiuh kynthei , ki bniat jong ki , ki long kum ki bniat sing .

translation.en: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary , nor profane the sanctuary of his God  ; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Um dei ruh ban pyntngit ïa ka jaka kyntang da kaba mih shabar jong ka ; naba la pynkyntang ïa u sha nga da kaba pynsleh umphniang . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying , Why hast thou done so ? and he also was a very goodly man  ; and his mother bare him after Absalom .
translation.kha: Mynta ba u Absalom u la ïap , u Adonijah , u khun jong u Dabid bad ka Haggith , u dei u khun heh uba dang im . U long u briew uba bhabriew . U Dabid um pat ju sneng tyngeh ïa u shaphang kano kano , bad u la kwah eh ban long syiem . U la pynkhreh ïa lade ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ka kynhun synran kaba don sanphew ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land : therefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother , to thy poor , and to thy needy , in thy land .
translation.kha: Yn don hi man la ka por ki Israel kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh , bad kumta nga hukum ïa phi ban lehsbun ïa ki .

translation.en: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs  ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang , ki ai shispah tylli ki masi kyrtong , arspah ki langbrot , bad sawspah tylli ki khunlangbrot kum ki jingainguh thang , bad khat-ar tylli ki blang kum ki jingainguh ïa ka pop , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait ki Israel .

translation.en: But he , whom God raised again , saw no corruption .
translation.kha: Hynrei kane kam shym la jia ha uta ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And in this place again , If they shall enter into my rest .
translation.kha: Ïa kane kajuh ka bynta la kren biang ,  Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha kata ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait .

translation.en: Vanity of vanities , saith the preacher  ; all is vanity .
translation.kha: Ka bymmyntoi , ka bymmyntoi , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat . Baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: And he said , About this season , according to the time of life , thou shalt embrace a son . And she said , Nay , my lord , thou man of God , do not lie unto thine handmaid .
translation.kha: bad u Elisha u ong ha ka ,  Kum ha kane ka por ha ka snem kaba bud phin rah ïa u khun ha ki ksang ti jong phi .   O !  ka ong da kaba kyndit .  Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat lamler ïa nga . Phi dei u briew jong U Blei !

translation.en: Therefore also now , saith the  Lord  , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :
translation.kha: Hynrei wat mynta ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kylla-kaba-mut da shisha bad phai sha nga da ka jingshah jingit bad ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew .

translation.en: But if they be prophets , and if the word of the  Lord  be with them , let them now make intercession to the  Lord  of hosts , that the vessels which are left in the house of the  Lord  , and in the house of the king of Judah , and at Jerusalem , go not to Babylon .
translation.kha: Lada ki dei da shisha ki nongïathuhlypa bad lada ki don ïa ka khubor jong nga , shah ïa ki ban kylli ïa nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ban ym shah ïa ki jingkynshew kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem ban shah rah sha Babilonia .

translation.en: And he said to Jeroboam , Take thee ten pieces : for thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , Behold , I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon , and will give ten tribes to thee :
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Jeroboam ,  Shim shiphew lyngkhot ha lade , namar U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan knieh noh ïa ka hima na u Solomon , bad ngan ai ha me shiphew jait .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when Sanballat , and Tobiah , and Geshem the Arabian , and the rest of our enemies , heard that I had builded the wall , and that there was no breach left therein  ; ( though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates  ; )
translation.kha: U Sanballat , u Tobiah , u Geshem bad kiba sah na ki nongshun jong ngi , ki la ïohsngew ba ngi la lah pyndep ïa ka jingtei ïa ka kynroh bad ba ym don shuh ki jinglait thliew ha ka , wat la ngim pat shym la pynïeng ki khyrdop ha ki jaka ban shna ïa ki .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Though they be quiet , and likewise many , yet thus shall they be cut down , when he shall pass through . Though I have afflicted thee , I will afflict thee no more .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ki Israel :  Wat la ki nong Assyria ki khlaiñ bad ki kham bun paid , ïa ki yn pynjot thiaw bad kin jah noh . Ko ki briew jong nga , nga la pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom , hynrei ngan ym leh shuh ïa ka .

translation.en: Who can say , I have made my heart clean , I am pure from my sin ?
translation.kha: Hato don uba lah ban ong da shisha ba ka jingïatiplem jong u ka khuid , ba u la lah ban iehnoh ïa ka pop jong u ?

translation.en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel , and they shall build the waste cities , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and drink the wine thereof  ; they shall also make gardens , and eat the fruit of them .
translation.kha: Ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki briew jong nga sha la ka ri . Kin sa tei pat ïa ki shnong ba la jot bad kin shong hangta ; kin thung ki bri sohwaiñ bad kin dih ïa ka waiñ ; kin thung jingthung ha ki kper , bad kin bam na kaei kaba mih .

translation.en: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him ,  Thou hast rightly judged .
translation.kha: Nga tharai ,  u Simon u la jubab ,  un long uta uba la ïohmap kham bun .   Me ong kaba dei ,  U Jisu u la ong .

translation.en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease , and that this city be not builded , until another commandment shall be given from me .
translation.kha: Namarkata phi dei ban pynmih ki hukum ba kito ki rangbah kin sangeh noh na ka jingtei pat ïa ka nongbah haduh ba ngan da ai hukum da kumwei pat .

translation.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian , Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us , as the ox licketh up the grass of the field . And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time .
translation.kha: Ki nong Moab ki ong ha ki nongïalam jong ki Midian ,  Kane ka kynhun shen kan sa pynjot ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba don sawdong jong ngi , kum u masi uba bam phlang ha ka pyntha phlang .

translation.en: And I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , Thine eyes have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto these two kings : so shall the  Lord  do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ha u Joshua , ‘ Me la ïohi ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong me u la leh ïa kito ki ar ngut ki syiem , u Sihon bad u Og ; un leh kumjuh ïa kita baroh ïa kiba men dang hiarthma ha ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , I am indeed a widow woman , and mine husband is dead .
translation.kha: Kaei pha kwah ?  u la kylli ïa ka .  Kynrad , nga dei ka riewkynthei kaba duk ,  ka la jubab .  U tnga jong nga u la ïap .

translation.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne , having put on their robes , in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem , kiba riam da ki jaiñphong syiem jong ki , ki dang ïashong ha la ki khet ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba habar ka khyrdop Samaria bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki dang ïathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .

translation.en: Zion heard , and was glad  ; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Seïon ki lehkmen , bad ki nongbah ka Judah ki shadkmen namar ki jingbishar jong me , A  Trai .

translation.en: Wherefore ? because I love you not ? God knoweth .
translation.kha: Hato nga ong ïa kane namar ba ngam ieit ïa phi ? U Blei u tip ba nga ieit ïa phi !

translation.en: And thou shalt be secure , because there is hope  ; yea , thou shalt dig about thee , and thou shalt take thy rest in safety .
translation.kha: Men ïoh im uba skhem bad uba dap da ka jingkyrmen ; U Blei un ïada bad un ai jingjahthait ïa me .

translation.en: But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them , Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God  ; but we ourselves together will build unto the  Lord  God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us .
translation.kha: U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad ki rangbah kur ki ong ïa ki ,  Ngim donkam ïa ka jingïarap jong phi ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Ngin tei hi ïa ka da lade , kumba u Syros , u patsha ka Persia , u la hukum ïa ngi .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I have done one work , and ye all marvel .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la leh ïa kawei ka kambah , bad baroh phi ïa-sngewlyngngoh .

translation.en: Is not my help in me ? and is wisdom driven quite from me ?
translation.kha: Ngam donbor shuh ban pynim ïa lade ; ym don hangno hangno kaba nga lah ban phai ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: If ye abide in me , and my words abide in you , ye shall ask what ye will , and it shall be done unto you .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïaineh ha nga bad ki ktien jong nga ki ïaineh ha phi , te phin pan ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh ïa ka .

translation.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance , which Moses gave them , beyond Jordan eastward , even as Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them  ;
translation.kha: Ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad kawei pat ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ki la ïohpdiang lypa ïa ka ri kaba u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ha ki ; ka don ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: Eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot ,
translation.kha: ka khmat namar ka khmat , ka bniat namar ka bniat , ka kti namar ka kti , ka kjat namar ka kjat ,

translation.en: Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! behold , my soul hath not been polluted : for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself , or is torn in pieces  ; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la jubab ,  Em , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Ngam pat ju pyntngit ïa lade . Naduh dang khynnah ngam pat ju bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba ïap hi ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw . Ngam pat ju bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ba la kheiñ ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him , Master , rebuke thy disciples .
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut na ki Pharisi napdeng u paidbah ki la kren ïa U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  hukum ïa ki synran jong me ban sngap jar !

translation.en: And the sons of Noah , that went forth of the ark , were Shem , and Ham , and Japheth : and Ham is the father of Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Noah kiba la ïawan mih na kata ka lieng ki long u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth . ( U Ham u long u kpa jong u Kanaan . )

translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the tribute  ; and all Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram , uba peit ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Israel , hynrei ki lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Mar kumta , u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet rieh sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty : they shall behold the land that is very far off .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat phin ïohi ïa u syiem ba u synshar ha ka burom bakhraw ha ka hima kaba pyiar ha baroh ki liang .

translation.en: And Isaac entreated the  Lord  for his wife , because she was barren : and the  Lord  was entreated of him , and Rebekah his wife conceived .
translation.kha: Namar ba ka Rebekka kam ïoh khun , u Isaak u la duwai ha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ka . U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka Rebekka ka la punkhun .

translation.en: And there abode three months . And when the Jews laid wait for him , as he was about to sail into Syria , he purposed to return through Macedonia .
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan sha Akhaïa , ha kaba u la sah lai bnai . U la khreh ban leit sha Syria haba u la shem ba ki la don ki Jiw kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ; kumta u la kut jingmut ban leit phai pat lyngba ka Makedonia .

translation.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta la thied na ki Hit . Tep ïa nga hangta .

translation.en: So the shipmaster came to him , and said unto him , What meanest thou , O sleeper ? arise , call upon thy God , if so be that God will think upon us , that we perish not .
translation.kha: U kapten u la shem ïa u hangta bad u ong ïa u ,  Me leh aïu da kaba ïohthiah ? To khie bad to duwai ha u blei jong me na ka bynta ka jingïarap . Lehse un sngewlem ïa ngi bad pyllait im ïa ngi .

translation.en: Fools make a mock at sin : but among the righteous there is favour .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bieit kim suidñiew lada ki leh pop , hynrei ki briew kiba beit ki kwah ban ïohmap .

translation.en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time , then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place  ; but thou and thy father s house shall be destroyed : and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this ?
translation.kha: Lada pha sngap jar ha ka por kum kane , ka jingïarap kan wan na bneng ïa ki Jiw , bad kin lait im , hynrei phan ïap , bad ka longïing u kpa jong pha kan kut noh . Pynban mano ba lah ban tip — lehse ka dei na ka bynta ka por kum kane ba la pynlong mahadei ïa pha !

translation.en: Lie not one to another , seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds ;
translation.kha: Wat ïa-lamler iwei ïa iwei pat , naba phi la loit noh ïa ka jinglong barim lem bad ki jingmlien jong ka bad ba phi la kup ïa ka jinglong bathymmai .

translation.en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver : the heart of the wicked is little worth .
translation.kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki long kum ka rupa kaba kynsai ; ka jingai jingmut jong u riewbymman kim dondor ei ei .

translation.en: There was a little city , and few men within it  ; and there came a great king against it , and besieged it , and built great bulwarks against it :
translation.kha: La don kawei ka shnong kaba rit ka bym da don bun ngut ki briew hapoh jong ka . U syiem uba khlaiñ u la tur ïaleh ïa ka . U la kerkut ïa ka bad u la pynkhreh ban pynpra lyngba ïa ki kynroh .

translation.en: And forgive us our sins  ; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us . And lead us not into temptation  ; but deliver us from evil .
translation.kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ngi , naba ngi map ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla ïa ngi . Bad wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh .’

translation.en: But all this was done , that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled .  Then all the disciples forsook him , and fled .
translation.kha: Hynrei kane baroh ka la lah jia khnang ban pynlong ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban jia shisha .  Nangta baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet noh .

translation.en: Then answered the  Lord  unto Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
translation.kha: Te napdeng ka  erïong , U  Trai  u la kren ha u Job sa shisien pat .

translation.en: Now these things were our examples , to the intent we should not lust after evil things , as they also lusted .
translation.kha: Mynta , kane baroh ka long ka nuksa ïa ngi , ban maham ïa ngi ban ym kwah brai ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew , kumba ki la leh , lymne mane ïa ki bleithaw , kumba don na ki kiba la leh kumta .

translation.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: U dei ban wanlam sha u lyngdoh kum ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kat kum ba la buh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .

translation.en: And David said unto him , Fear not : for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father s sake , and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father  ; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u Dabid u jubab .  Ngan lehbha ïa phi na ka bynta u Jonathan , u kpa jong phi . Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul , u kparad jong phi , bad phin long uba la pdiang sngewbha borabor ha ka miej bam jong nga .

translation.en: Whereby , when ye read , ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ )
translation.kha: ( Nga la thoh khyndiat shaphang kane , bad lada phi pule ïa kaei kaba nga la thoh , phi lah ban tip shaphang ka jingsngewthuh jong nga ïa ka jingmaïan U Khrist . )

translation.en: How did their glasses get swapped ? Even they themselves didn't understand it !
translation.kha: Kumno ki iitkhmat jongki ki shah kylliang ? Maki ruh kim sngewthuh iakata .

translation.en: And whatsoever ye do , do it heartily , as to the Lord , and not unto men ;
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaei kaba phi leh , trei ïa ka naduh mynsiem , kumba phi trei na ka bynta U Trai bad ym na ka bynta ki briew .

translation.en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins , the just for the unjust , that he might bring us to God , being put to death in the flesh , but quickened by the Spirit :
translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki pop tang shisien bad na ka bynta ki por baroh , u briew uba bha na ka bynta ki nongpop , ba un ïoh ïalam ïa phi sha U Blei . La pynïap ïa u ha ka doh , hynrei la pynim pat ïa u ha ka mynsiem ,

translation.en: And Joshua answered them , If thou be a great people , then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants , if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee .
translation.kha: U Joshua u jubab ,  Lada phi ïabun paid haduh katta katta bad ba ka ri lum Ephraim ka rit than ïa phi , te khie leit sha ki khlaw bad prat na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka ri ki Peris bad ki Rephaim .

translation.en: The calamity of Moab is near to come , and his affliction hasteth fast .
translation.kha: Ka jingshahjop jong ka Moab ka la jan ; ka jingjot jong ka , ka la jan .

translation.en: For he hath said , It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God .
translation.kha: U ong ba kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha haba u pyrshang ban bud ïa ka mon U Blei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  plagued the people , because they made the calf , which Aaron made .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingpang ha kita ki briew , namar ba ki la pynlong ïa u Aaron ban thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar .

translation.en: We are imitating Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka nuksa jong u Jisu .

translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses , and fifty men to run before him .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Absalom u la pynbiang ïa lade kawei ka kali ïapom bad ki kulai lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah kiba synran ïa u .

translation.en: That ye may remember , and do all my commandments , and be holy unto your God .
translation.kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin pynkynmaw ïa phi ban sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad phin long ki jong nga nadong shadong .

translation.en: And it shall be , when he lieth down , that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie , and thou shalt go in , and uncover his feet , and lay thee down  ; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do .
translation.kha: Da pynthikna bha ha-ei u thiah , bad hadien ba u la ïohthiah , leit bad khyllied ïa ki jaiñ tap bad thiah ha ki kjat jong u . Un sa ïathuh ïa phi kaei ba phi dei ban leh .

translation.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder  ; so he shall open , and none shall shut  ; and he shall shut , and none shall open .
translation.kha: Ngan ai lut ha u , ka iktiar hapoh jong u syiem , uba hiarpateng jong u Dabid . Un don ki shabi jong ka jaka treikam ; kaei kaba u plie , ym don mano mano ban khang , bad kaei kaba u khang , ym don mano mano ban plie .

translation.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord , A pair of turtledoves , or two young pigeons .
translation.kha: Ki la leit ruh ban ai jingkñia da shi jur ki lyngdkhur lane ar tylli ki khun paro , kumba la dawa da ka aiñ jong U Trai .

translation.en: God wants us to benefit ourselves .
translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ba ngin pynmyntoi ïalade .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Behold now , there be with thy servants fifty strong men  ; let them go , we pray thee , and seek thy master : lest peradventure the Spirit of the  Lord  hath taken him up , and cast him upon some mountain , or into some valley . And he said , Ye shall not send .
translation.kha: bad ki ong ,  Don sanphew ngut na ngi hangne , baroh ki rangbah bakhlaiñ . Ïa ngin leit bad wad ïa u kynrad jong phi . Lehse U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la rah noh ïa u bad iehnoh ïa u halor uno re uno u lumbah lane ha kano re kano ka them .   Em , phim dei ban leit ,  u Elisha u jubab .

translation.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes : I will not forget thy word .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewbha eh ha ki aiñ jong me ; ïa ki hukum jong me ngan ym klet .

translation.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines , to sharpen every man his share , and his coulter , and his axe , and his mattock .
translation.kha: ( Ki Israel ki hap leit sha ki Philistia ban phah shut ïa ki nar lyngkor , ki mohkhiew , ki sdie , bad ki rashi jong ki ;

translation.en: He riseth from supper , and laid aside his garments  ; and took a towel , and girded himself .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïeng na ka miej bam , u la law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , bad u la teh ïa ka jaiñ ñiad ha la ka syngkai .

translation.en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things ? yet among many nations was there no king like him , who was beloved of his God , and God made him king over all Israel : nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ka dei na ka daw ki kynthei nongwei ba u syiem Solomon u la leh pop . U la long u briew uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno na ki syiem jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew . U Blei u la ieit ïa u bad pynlong syiem ïa u halor ki Israel , bad pynban u hap ha kane ka pop .

translation.en: Unless the  Lord  had been my help , my soul had almost dwelt in silence .
translation.kha: Lada U  Trai  um shym la ïarap ïa nga , ngan jin da la leit kloi sha ka ri kaba jar jar .

translation.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness : for the throne is established by righteousness .
translation.kha: Ki syiem kim lah shah ïa ka jingsniew , namar ka jingbishar hok ka dei kaba pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar kaba khlaiñ .

translation.en: In that day shall there be an altar to the  Lord  in the midst of the land of Egypt , and a pillar at the border thereof to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , kan don ka duwan ïa U  Trai  ha ka ri Ijipt bad u rishot maw ba la pynkyntang sha U ha ka pud Ijipt .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that God did tempt Abraham , and said unto him , Abraham : and he said , Behold , here I am .
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat por , U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham ; u khot ïa u ,  Abraham !  Bad u Abraham u jubab ,  Oi , nga hangne !

translation.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u ksai uba jngum , khnang ba kata ka jingdeng shadem kan neh halor kata ka jingpanpoh , bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: Behold , they shall be as stubble  ; the fire shall burn them  ; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame : there shall not be a coal to warm at , nor fire to sit before it .
translation.kha: Kin long kum ki lyngkhot phlangïap , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki ! Kin ym lah wat ban pyllait im ïa lade — ki thylliej ding kin khluit eh na ka bynta jong ki , yn ym don ka ding kaba rhem ban pynsyaid ïa lade .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt , upon their streams , upon their rivers , and upon their ponds , and upon all their pools of water , that they may become blood  ; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood , and in vessels of stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh bad ban rah ïa u halor ki wah , ki nur-um , bad ki pukri um baroh ha ka ri Ijipt . Ka um kan kylla snam , bad ha ka ri baroh kawei kan don ka snam , wat ha ki khiew dieng bad ki khiew maw ruh .

translation.en: Men and brethren , let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David , that he is both dead and buried , and his sepulchre is with us unto this day .
translation.kha: Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , nga dei ban kren shai shaphang U syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen bapawnam jong ngi . U la ïap bad la tep ïa u , bad ka jingtep jong u ka don hangne bad ngi haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man , that the righteous sin not , and he doth not sin , he shall surely live , because he is warned  ; also thou hast delivered thy soul .
translation.kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew uba bha ba un ym leh pop , bad u shahshkor ïa me bad um leh pop , un im da shisha , bad ïa ka jingim jong me ruh yn pyllait .

translation.en: To the only wise God our Saviour , be glory and majesty , dominion and power , both now and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: ha U Blei , uba tang ma u hi U Nongpynim jong ngi , da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to long ka burom , ka jingkhraw bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka jingsynshar , na ki rta ba la leit noh baroh , bad mynta , bad sha ki bymjukut bad bymjukut ! Amen .

translation.en: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar , their appearances and themselves : they went every one straight forward .
translation.kha: Ki durkhmat jong ki , ki syriem thik kum ki durkhmat ba nga la ïohi harud ka wah Khebar . Uwei pa uwei u kherub u ïaid beit sha khmat .
